anywaa: Wïlöölö Jwøk maal ki piny acwääe.
english: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.

anywaa: Ni bëët pinynyi jaak ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie; ni piny bëëdö na kut bäre, ni muudhö ena bäät pïï; ni Jwïëc Jwøk bëëdö ni määdö bäät pïï.
english: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Beerra man jït pinynyi ki tar.» Køøre piny aput jïtö ki tar.
english: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni joot gø ni tar beeye gïn mo beer. Køøre Jwøk tar ki muudhö apääŋŋe.
english: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwøl tar ni dïcäŋ, ni cwøl muudhö ni wäär. Ni tïme ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, ni «Beerra man tïm maalli ni dagø yïthakic pïï nee pïï pääŋŋe ki dïge.»
english: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni tïïc maal, ni pääŋ pïï ki dïge moa en piny ko maal ki pïï moa en løø maal løøga. Ni ö gïïögø ni thurge karge.
english: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwøl kuna en maal ni maal. Ni tïm pinynyi ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye riet nïne.
english: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Beerra man ö pïïyi moa en ko maalli piny ni cooŋge rege kanya ciel nee piny jïte ki kany mo otal.» Ni ö gïnögø ni thur kare.
english: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk kanya näk otal acwøle ni piny, ni ö pïïyi moa näk rege ege cooŋ kanya ciel ni cwøl ge ni näm. Ni ö Jwøki ni joot gïnögø na gïn mo beer.
english: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Beerra man tuc bäät pinynyi ki luum, ki gïïa marr bëët mo duunnö ki köödhi, ki jenni mo nyöödö ki nyïëdi mo duunnö ki köödhi. Beerra man jït jenni ki nyïëdi ki køør teeŋ wï jaath man nø bäät piny.» Køøre gïïögø athur karge.
english: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.

anywaa: Ni ö pinynyi ni tuue ki luum ki jenni ki gïïa marr bëët. Ni ö teeŋ wï gïna marri man nø ni jïte ki nyïëdi ki køør teeŋ wï tuuŋ man nø. Ni ö jenni ni jïtge ki nyïëdi ki køør teeŋ wï jaath man nø. Køøre Jwøk gïnögø ajoode na gïn mo beer.
english: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye dää nïne.
english: And the evening and the morning were the third day.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, ni «Beerra man dee gïï mo tar mo rieny maal kiper nee dïcäŋ ki wäär pääŋge; nee tïmge na nyuuthe kiper nïne, ki cwiiri, ki kwöra näk owäŋŋö yi cwiir.
english: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

anywaa: Beerra man bëëtge na tar mo rieny maal kiper nee cïpge ki tar bäät piny.» Køøre gïnögø aput thur kare.
english: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwääc gïïa tar na näk ariiø na døøŋŋø døc. Ni tar mana dwøŋŋa eni beeye mana bëën dïcäŋŋi. Ni ö mana thiinhnhi ni tïme ni wäär bëënna gøøni. Ni ö Jwøki ni cwääc ceer thuwø.
english: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

anywaa: Gïïögø acïp Jwøki maal kiper nee cïpge ki tar bäät piny,
english: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,

anywaa: kiper nee dïcäŋ ki wäär käärge na kare nee tar pääge ki muudhö. Ni ö Jwøki ni neen gïïögø ni joot ge ni beyø.
english: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye ŋweer nïne.
english: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, ni «Beerra man jït yïth nämmi ki gïï mo thööth mo dëëtge da jwïëy; ni jït maalli bäre ki weny mo määdö yie.»
english: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwääc lääya døøŋŋø yi naama dwøŋ, ki gïïa näk dëëtge da jwïëy bëët ni wø cäädhi yïth pïï; ni cwääc geni ni thööth na wï tuuŋ man nø. Ni cwääc weny bëët thuwø ki køør wï tuuŋ man nø. Ni ö gïïögø ni jooti ya Jwøki na gïï mo beyø.
english: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni gwïëth geni ni kööe, ni «Nyöödu, ni nyaayu, ni pääŋŋu yïth näpa døøŋŋø bëët. Beerra man ö wenynyi ni nyaacge bäät piny thuwø.»
english: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye bïï nïne.
english: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, ni «Beerra man jït pinynyi ki gïï ma teeŋi mo kwøw, teeŋ ka lääc paac, ki gïï mo muulö, ki lääc paap ki køør wï tuuŋ man nø.» Køøre gïnögø athur kare.
english: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwääc lääc paap bäät piny na wï tuuŋ man nø, ki lääc paac na wï tuuŋ man nø, ki gïïa näk muulö bäät piny bëët na wï tuuŋ man nø. Ni ö Jwøki ni joot gïnögø na gïn mo beer.
english: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

anywaa: Køør manøgø nø Jwøk aköö, «Beerra man cwääø ki dhaanhø mo rööma øøni mo kïte caala øøni. Eno bëëdö ni jïre da teek bäät rec naam, ki wec maal, ki lääc paac, këël bäät piny bäre ki gïïa näk muulö bëët bäät piny.»
english: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cwääc dhaanhø ni röömi ki eni, ni cwääc gøøni ni caala kïte. Ni cwääc geni na dïcwøø ki dhaagø.
english: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni gwïëth geni, ni kööe jïge, ni «Nyöödu ni nyaayu, ni pääŋŋu piny, ni dïïmmu gø, ni bëëdu ni jïïu da teek bäät rec naam ki wec maal ki gïïa näk dëëtge da jwïëy bëët mo bäät piny.»
english: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, «Ennø, gïïa näk kännö ki nyïëdi bëët moa näk otuy bäät piny bäre acïba jïïu, ki jenni bëët moa näk nyïïge duunnö ki köödhi, kiper nee tïmge na cam jïïu;
english: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.

anywaa: ni cïba gïïa marr bëët na cam jï lääy mo bäät piny bëët, ki wec maal bëët, ki gïïa näk cäädhö bëët na näk dëëtge da jwïëy.» Ni ö gïïögø ni thurge karge.
english: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk gïïa tïïe bëët aneene, ni joot ge ni beyø døc. Ni tïme ni da abøøya ka amöölla. Ni beeye bïcier nïne.
english: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

anywaa: Køøre nø, maal ki piny athum ki cwääc, këël gïïa thööth na en yïthge bëët.
english: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na bïriet nïne, ni Jwøk tïïe moe moa tïïe bëët ee nø thöör, eni ree ajwöme ri bïriet nïne kanya løny tïïe moe bëët moa tïïe.
english: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk bïriet nïne agwïëdhe, ni tïïc gø ni ena kur keere na mare, kiper beeye dïcäŋ mana jwöm ree yie ki tïïc kanya løny tïïe moe ki jammi bëët moa cwääe.
english: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.

anywaa: Man beeye luum cwääc mana cwääc maal ki piny ki gø. Kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na cwääc maal ki piny,
english: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,

anywaa: kar kaaca poot bäŋ teeŋ gïn mo thiinh mo cwøl na abuŋŋö mo otuy yïth ŋøøm bäät piny; ni bäŋ teeŋ gïn mo marr mo otuy bäät ŋøøm, kiper Wuuö Jwøk gïn cwøl ni køth en poot käre jääŋŋö bäät piny. Kar kaaca thuwø poot bäŋ dhaanhø mo purö wïth ŋøøm.
english: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the Lord God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba da rwöc mo wø ööa wøk ki yïth ŋøøm mo jwøya piny bäre.
english: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cwääc dhaanhø ri ŋøøp piny, ni kooth jam kwøw um dhaanhø, ni tïm dhaanhe ni ree da jwïëy mo kwøw.
english: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni piith ajïniina yi kanya cwøl ni Ëden na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Ni cïp dhaanhø mana cwääe kaace.
english: And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk ŋøøpøgø tuuö ki teeŋ jenni bëët mo nëëni ni mïërö, ni beyø kiper cam. Ni jaadha näk jaath kwøw thuwø ena dï ajïniinøgø; këël jaadha näk jaath wø ŋäc gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac ki køøre ena kaace thuwø.
english: And out of the ground made the Lord God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

anywaa: Yi kar kanyøgø da naam mo wø kwönnö ki yi Ëden mo jwøya ajïniinøgø. Ni ö naamøgø ni pääŋ ree keere ni tïme na näm aŋween.
english: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ mana dïkwøŋ cwøl ni Picön, ni caatha deŋ ŋööm Ëwlath bäre kanya näk yie da warkey.
english: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

anywaa: Ni warkey mar paanøgø beer; ni paanøgø yie da gïn mo cwøl ni bedöla, na näk dwøø mo ŋwääi ni met, ki cöyam, na näk waŋ kïdi mo pere leth.
english: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ riet naam maya cwøl ni Giyön, ni caatha deŋ ŋööm Kuuc bäre.
english: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ dää naam maya cwøl ni Thëgerø, ni cøøa ya Aciria jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Ni ŋweer naam cwøl ni Upareeti.
english: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni lwør dhaanhø ni kïth gø ya ajïniinna en Ëden kiper nee puure nee gwøe.
english: And the Lord God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kööm dhaanhø ni kööe, ni «Løny jïrï ki man cämï ri nyïïjenni bëët jaak moa en ya ajïniina.
english: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:

anywaa: 'Ba jaath wø ŋäc gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac ki køøre, kär nyïïe camï. Kiper dïcäŋo kööï ni nyaare camï camø, ï puta thøø møn.»
english: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ba doo beer ki man bëët dhaanhe keere. Beerra man cwääa ki ŋat mo kønya gø mo orømø kipere.»
english: And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk lääc paap ki wec maal bëët ee nø cwääc ri ŋøøp piny. Ni käl geni baŋ dhaanhø kiper nee nyeŋ mo cak geni ki gøøni nee neene. Køøre dhaanhø nyeŋ gïïa näk kwøw bëët acaae, ni nyeŋ moa cak ge ki geni aput tïmö na nyeŋ moge.
english: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaanhe ni cak nyeŋ lääc paac bëët ki nyeŋ wec maal ki nyeŋ lääc paap bëët. 'Ba kar kaaca poot bäŋ kunyi mo orømø mo onø joot kiper Adam.
english: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyeŋ dhaanhø amooe ki niine mo thööth døc ni bute. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kän wøk ki cöön ŋëëdö aciel røk ŋëët dhaanhø, ni kïth kar ŋëëdö ki rïŋ dëël.
english: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc ŋëëdö mana käl ri dhaanhø na dhaagø, ni kïth gø baŋ dhaanhø.
english: And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø aköö, ni «Man ennø, beeye cöö mana ö wøk ri cuu 'moa; ni beeye dëël mana käl rïŋ dëëra. Eno cwøl na dhaagø, kiper eni käl wøk ka dëër dïcwøø.»
english: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, dïcwøø wänni ki menni owiie ni dwätge na aciel ki cïïe, ni tïmge na dëël aciel.
english: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca dhaanhø ki cïïe ge bëëdö ni ge cäädhi ka dëëtge jaak, ni bäŋ laac wïc jïge.
english: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

anywaa: 'Ba ki dëët lääy bëët moa cwääc Wuuö Jwøki bäät piny, thwöl atïmö ni rieka waŋe. Køøre dhaagø apëënynye ni kööe, «?Aŋø, ka adïëri møn, Jwøk aköö ki uuni ni käru cämö ri nyïïjenni moa en ya ajïniina bëët?»
english: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

anywaa: Ni kö dhaage jï thwöl, ni «Løny jïwa ki man cämwa ri nyïïjenni moa en ya ajïniina.
english: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Käru cämö ri nyïï jaath mana en dï ajïniina wala u maara gø gut ki ceŋŋu, kiper nee u ba thøwu.› »
english: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.

anywaa: Ni kö thwölli jï dhaagø, ni «Ka adïëri møn, u ba thøw.
english: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

anywaa: Kiper ŋäc Jwøki ni dïcäŋo cämu ri nyïï jaath manøgø, nyeŋŋu rege japge jabø, ni tïmu nou caala Jwøk, ni gïna beer ki gïna raac ŋäyu.»
english: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dhaage na neen jaath na gïn mo orømø ki cam, ni nëëni na gïn mo mïërö ki nyeŋŋe, na jaath mo beer mo døøya waŋ dhaanhø mo riek, ena lwötö ri nyi gø ni cam gø, ni mëëk mør cwøre thuwø; ni ö cwøre ni cam gø.
english: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

anywaa: Køøre ge karge riet nyeŋge rege ajapge, ni putge gø joot ni ge bëëdö ka dëëtge; ni kwönyge dëëtge ki bøøk jenni, ni twöge gø dëëtge.
english: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

anywaa: Kanyøgø tiet Wuuö Jwøk awïnyge ni cäädhö ya ajïniina kany wø kwöc cäŋŋi. Køøre dhaanhø ki cïïe dëëtge akange dï jenni moa en ya ajïniina kiper mana nut Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God amongst the trees of the garden.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk dhaanhø acwøle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ï enï kaa ŋø?»
english: And the Lord God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?

anywaa: Ni kö dhaanhe, ni «Tietï awïnynya ya ajïniina, ni lwäya kiper a bëëdö ka dëëra; køøre raa akana.»
english: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, «?Aŋø, ocaana ŋa jïrï niï bëëdö ka dëërï? ?Aŋø, ïïna cämö ri nyïï jaath mana köömma ïïni ki gøøni ni kär camï?»
english: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?

anywaa: Ni kö dhaanhe, ni «Dhaagø mana cïpï jïra kiper nee bëëde ki aani, aana mooe ki nyi jaath ni cama gø.»
english: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï dhaagø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni iï tïïö en?» Ni kö dhaage, ni «Aana cøøk thwölli ni cäma.»
english: And the Lord God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï thwöl, ni «Kiper mana tïïyï teeŋ gïnögø, acïëni oen bäätï keerï dï lääc paac, ki lääc paap bëët. Ïïno cäädhi ki bäp yiï, ni tïmï niï cama tør ki yïth nïr kwøw moï bëët.
english: And the Lord God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:

anywaa: Yïthakiyu ki dhaagø omooa ki män, ni mooa yïthakic nyïïï ki nyïïe ki män thuwø. Eni wïïï onyadhe, ni ö ïïni ni dwøŋï opuny tiere.»
english: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï dhaagø, ni «Rääm marï omeeda døc ri nyöödö marï; ï jïtö ki rääm ri lwaar marï ko obwöre. Cwïnyï otïmö ni ena køør cwørï, ni tïmï niï bëënna gø.»
english: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Adam, ni «Kiper mana leŋï dwør cïïï, ni camï nyi jaath mana köömma ïïni ki gø, na kööa, ni ‹Kärï cämö ri gø›, «Ŋøøm aciena kiperï; cam marï ojootï ki køør öölö mo teek døc yïth nïr kwøw moï bëët.
english: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;

anywaa: Koodhi ki luum otuy bäät piny kiperï; ni tïmï niï cama gïïo tuy yïth ŋøøm.
english: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;

anywaa: Cam marï ojootï ki køør kwäk marï këël mano tïme ni ŋuuda thøø marï no døøï yi ŋöömö, kiper ï käla ree. Ï käla ri ŋöömö; køøre ï døøa yi ŋöömö.»
english: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø dhaanhø nyeŋ cïïe acaae ni Iip, kiper ena mïïö mar jøøa kwøw bëët.
english: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïe ki dum pïën jï Adam ki cïïe, ni røø gø dëëtge.
english: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the Lord God make coats of skins, and clothed them.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Ennø dhaanhø atïmö ni caala øøni, ni gïna beer ki gïna raac ŋääe. 'Ba ennø, kany mør eni cäŋa lwötö thuwø ri jaadha näk jaath kwøw, ni cam gø, ni kwøe ni bëëde na bäre bäre.»
english: And the Lord God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, Wuuö Jwøk dhaanhø ariem wøk ki ya ajïniinna en Ëden, kiper nee tïme ni puura ŋøøm moa käl yïthge.
english: Therefore the Lord God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na riem dhaanhø wøk, eni nyïïatwiet maal mo cwøl ni kirubël, ko opëëllö mo leebe liel ki maac, mo løøŋŋa ree ki kwöre bëët, acïp jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ya ajïniinna en Ëden, kiper nee jöör jaath kwøw nee koorge.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

anywaa: Køøre Adam aci baŋ cïïe ma Iip, ni jït yie ki dhaanhø ni nywøl Keen, ni kö Iipi, ni «Aana jïtö ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ coki ma Eebel nywøllø. Ni ö Eebelli ni tïme na dïkwääc dïëk. 'Ba Keen atïmö na ŋat puur.
english: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø Keen akännö ki caammi moa ciek na puure ni cïp gø na muuce jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Eebelli ni känne ki kure røk rïŋ moa beyø mo kaai mo dïëk moe. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jïëc mar Eebel ko olämme moe.
english: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

anywaa: 'Ba mar Keen ki muuce moe käre jïëö. Køøre Keen agootø døc ni tïm täärnyïme ni cøl.
english: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Keen, «?Aperŋø ni gootï en? ?Aperŋø na tïm täärnyïmï ni cøl?
english: And the Lord said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk mo marï beer, täärnyïmï ba doo bëëdö ni leer? 'Ba ni näk mo marï ba beer, raay bëëdö no omøør piny dhi øtø marï; ni manynya ïïni. 'Ba gïna diï tïïö beeye ki man böötï gø.»
english: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.

anywaa: Køøre Keen acäänö ki coki ma Eebel nee cige yi pwödhö. 'Ba kanya enge yi pwödhö, Keen aö maal ni 'näk coki ma Eebel.
english: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Keen, «?Coku ma Eebel en kaa ŋø?» Ni kö Keenni, «?Aŋø, ŋääa? ?Aŋø, beeye aani na dïkuri mar coka?»
english: And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïyï enø? Dwør rem coku ajwöŋ baŋa ki tiet ŋøøm piny.
english: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.

anywaa: Ennø ïïna cien bäät ŋøøm, ni beeye ŋøøpa øc rem coku piny yie mana kønynyï piny ki cerï.
english: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;

anywaa: Kany wäro puurï ŋøøm, bäŋ gïn mo ciek yie jïrï na bäre. Ïïno tïmö na ŋat mo thääyö mo wïïrö jaak bäät piny.»
english: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

anywaa: Ni kö Keenni jï Wuuö Jwøk, na «Ajäla manøgø kee dwøŋ døc kiree kipera.
english: And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.

anywaa: Neenï, ennø dïcäŋi en aana riemï wøk ki yïth ŋøøm; ni bëëda naa ba en buutï këët. Ni tïma ni aana dhaanhø maa thääyö jaak mo wïïrö bäät piny; ni kanymør ŋato wäro joot aani jaak a di nääö.»
english: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïgø, ni «Ŋato köö jaak ni Keen nääe nääö, kwör di coolø dëëre kwöre abïriiø.» Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni muuny dëër Keen ki nyuudhi, kiper nee ŋato wäro joot gø nee ba nääe.
english: And the Lord said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

anywaa: Køøre Keen aay nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni ci kun bëëde yi ŋööm Nøt na en løø Ëden jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Keen aci baŋ cïïe, ni jït yie ki dhaanhø ni nywøl Inøk. Ni ö Keenni ni gëëde ki pääny, ni caa nyeŋ gø ri nyeŋ wääde ma Inøk.
english: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.

anywaa: 'Ba Inøk Irat anywøle, ni ö Irati ni nywøl Mëjël, ni ö Mëjëlli ni nywøl Matucaël, ni ö Matucaëlli ni nywøl Lamek.
english: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.

anywaa: Ni ö Lameki ni nyöömme ki mään ariiø, ni nyeŋ dhaagø maya cwøl ni Ada, ni nyeŋ maya cwøl ni Dhëla.
english: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.

anywaa: Ni ö Ada ni nywøl Jabal. Ni ö Jaballi ni tïme na kwar jø wø bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare na näk jïge da dhäk ki dïëk.
english: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ coki cwøl ni Jubal. Jubal beeye kwar jø wø pöödö ki thøme ni wø kudhö ko opele.
english: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhëla Tubalkeen anywøle, ni ö Tubalkeenni ni tïme na ŋat thäth ki jap jwëëlli ki jap nywïëny bëët. 'Ba coki mana näk dhaagø nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Nayma.
english: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal–cain, an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah.

anywaa: Køøre Lamek aköö ki määre, «Nya, Ada ki Dhëla, beerra man leŋŋu dwøra. U na määra, beerra man cegu ïthu ki luup 'moa. Aana nägö ki dhaanhø kiper mana këël aani, ni 'näga ki nyilaal kiper mana gøøc aani.
english: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

anywaa: Ni näk mo kwör Keen di coolø ki kwöre abïriiø, aani na näk Lamek kwöra tïmö ni cool ki kwöre ma pïërabïriiø ka abïriiø.»
english: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

anywaa: Køøre Adam acäŋ ci baŋ cïïe ni nyööt cïïe ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Cëth; ni kö Iipi, ni «Jwøk acäŋ cïpö ki dhaanhø mør jïra na kar Eebel na 'näk Keenni.»
english: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

anywaa: Ni ö Cëthi ni nyööte ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Ënöc. Køør manøgø nø, jiy aput tägö ki man lamge nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Adam. Dïcäŋa ö Wuuö Jwøki na cwääc dhaanhø, eni dhaanhø acwääe ni rööma Jwøk.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

anywaa: Ni cwääc geni na thwønh ki maath, ni gwïëth geni, ni cwøl geni na jiy dïcäŋa cwääc geni yie.
english: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

anywaa: Kar kanya tïm cwiic Adammi na dïpa ki pïëradäk, ena nyöötö ki wääde mo rööma eni mo ee caalø, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Cëth.
english: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

anywaa: Ni cwiiri moa beet Adammi kanya nø nywøl wääde ma Cëth beege cwiiri ma dïpe abära; ni cäŋ nyöödö thuwø ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiic Adam bëët moa beede beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïëradäk. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Cëthi ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma dïpa ka abïïc, ni nywøl wääde ma Ënöc.
english: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Cëthi na nywøl wääde ma Ënöc, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abära ka abïriiø, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Cëthi beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ka apaar kurriiø. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Ënöci ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërabïŋween, ni nywøl wääde ma Keenan.
english: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Ënöci na nywøl wääde ma Keenan, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abära ka apaar kurbïïc, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Ënöci beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ka abïïc. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Keenanni ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø, ni nywøl wääde ma Maalalel.
english: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Keenanni na nywøl wääde ma Maalalel, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abära ki pïëraŋween, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Keenanni beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ka apaar. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Maalalelli ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërabïciel ka abïïc, ni nywøl wääde ma Jaret.
english: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Maalalelli na nywøl wääde ma Jaret, Maalalel abëëdö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abära ki pïëradäk, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Maalalelli beege cwiiri ma dïpe abära ki pïërabïŋween ka abïïc. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Jareti ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïërabïciel kurriiø, ni nywøl wääde ma Inøk.
english: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Jareti na nywøl wääde ma Inøk, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abära, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Jareti beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïciel kurriiø. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Inøki ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërabïciel kurbïïc, ni nywøl wääde ma Mathucala.
english: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Inøki na nywøl wääde ma Mathucala, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe adäk ni bëëde ni caatha køør Jwøk, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Inøki beege cwiiri ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïciel kurbïïc.
english: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

anywaa: Ni ö Inøki ni bëëde ni caatha køør Jwøk, ni kär kare joodø, kiper ena lwør Jwøki.
english: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

anywaa: Ni ö Mathucala ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïërabära ka abïriiø, ni nywøl wääde ma Lamek.
english: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Mathucala na nywøl wääde ma Lamek, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabära kurriiø, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Mathucala beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïciel ka abïŋween. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Lameki ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïërabära kurriiø, ni nyööte ki wääde.
english: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋ gø acaae ni Nöa, ni kööe, ni «Ŋati en beeye ŋato jïtø ki cøm cwïny ki køøre ri öölö marø mana joodø ki køør tïïc mana leth kany wø puurø ŋöömö mana cien Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Lameki na nywøl wääde ma Nöa, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abïïc ki pïërabïŋween kurbïïc, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Lameki beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïriiø ka abïriiø. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöa ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma dïpe abïïyö; køøre Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth anywøle.
english: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanya tïm jiyi ni ge nyaay bäät piny, ni jïge da nyïïge ma nyïïakuue mo ege nywølø,
english: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,

anywaa: jiy moa näk wäät Jwøk, nyïï jiy møga ajootge ni mïërö, ni ö ŋati man nø ni lwør mana jiere jaak, ni nywømge dëëtge.
english: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jwïëy 'moa ba doo bëëdö ri dhaanhø na bäre bäre, kiper ena dëël jaak. 'Ba aŋuun cwiiri moe tïmö na dïpa ki pïërariiø.»
english: And the Lord said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.

anywaa: Kar kaaca jiy møøk mo cwøl ni Nëpilim bëëdö ni nutö bäät piny, ni bëëtge ni ge poot nutö thuwø yïth nïra ö jøøa näk wäät Jwøki na cige na nywømge nyïï jiy møga, ni nyöötge ko obwöre ki geni. Jøøgø beege jiy moa teek moa nyeŋge ŋäc cøøn dïkwøŋ.
english: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni joot rääö mar dhaanhø no opällö bäät piny, ni gïï wø caar dhaanhe bëët ki cwïnye beege gïï mo reyø keerge.
english: And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni päth cwïnye døc kiper mana cwääc dhaanhø bäät piny, ni bëëde ni cwïnye kïmmö.
english: And it repented the Lord that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, «Aani dhaanhø mana cwääa raanynya raanynyø bäät piny, ki mano täge ki dhaanhø këël mano këët ri lääy, ki gïï wø muuli, ki wec maal bëët; kiper cwïnya apädhö kiper mana cwääa geni.»
english: And the Lord said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

anywaa: 'Ba Nöa beeye ŋata tïm yi Wuuö Jwøki ni met ki gøøni.
english: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Nöa. Nöa beeye dhaanhø mo mare beer ri jøøa bëëdö kar kaaca, ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö mare. Ena bëëdö ni caatha køør Jwøk.
english: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni nyööde ki wääte adäk; ni nyeŋge beege Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth.
english: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgøøni piny atïmö ni päŋ ki raay nyïm Jwøk, ni tïm pinynyi ni päŋ bäre ki gïï mo leth mo wø tïïc jiyi.
english: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni neen bäät piny, ni joot gø ni päŋ ki raay; kiper jiy bëët jöör bëëtö marge ege raanynyø bäät piny.
english: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö jï Nöa, «Aani, aŋuun bëëtö mar jiy bëët anø ŋøla; kiper piny apäŋ ki gïï mo leth ki køør gïïa tïïcge. 'Ba ennø, ge raanynya raanynyø ki piny bëët na aciel.
english: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

anywaa: Beerra man tëëŋŋï dëërï ki jääy ri jaadha cwøl ni göper; ni tïïï ki uudi yi jääy, ni rwøthï yie ki ŋääe wøk bäre ki dwøø.
english: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

anywaa: Ni jöö mano tïïyï jääy ki gø beeye en; bär mar jääy wär näk ma gööye ma dïpe adäk, ni päl yie beeye gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö bär mar wïïe maal ki piny ni tïme na gööye ma pïëradägö.
english: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.

anywaa: Køøre wï jääy wär mooyï ki rëëbi, ni wëënnï yïthakic wïïe maal ki kööre piny ki gööyö aciel. Ni kølï dhi jääy tier-buute. Ni tïïyï yi jääy ni yïthe adäk, ni maya ena piny, ni rietge ena bääte maal, ni dääge ena maal bäätge.
english: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.

anywaa: Ennø, aani jwïïö jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäät piny, kiper nee gïn ma dëël jaak mo ree da jwïëy mo kwøw bäät piny nee raanynya. Ni ö gïïa kwøw bëët moa en bäät piny ni putge thøø.
english: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

anywaa: 'Ba aani aano tudö ki luubö ki ïïni. Ïïno ci yi jääy, ïïni, ki wäätï, ki cïïï, ki määr wäätï bëët na aciel.
english: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

anywaa: Ri gïïa näk dëëtge da jwïëy bëët na kwøw, wärï kädï ka ariiø ri wï tuuŋ man nø ni kïthï ge yi jääy, kiper nee bëëtge ni kwøw buutï. Beerra man kälï geni na thwønh ki maath.
english: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.

anywaa: Ki røk weny ri wï tuuŋ man nø, ki røk lääy ri wï tuuŋ man nø, ki røk gïï wø muuli bäät piny ri wï tuuŋ man nø, geno ö baŋï no oriewi riewi ni öge baŋï yi jääy, nee kwøwge buutï.
english: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni wärï kädï ki cam jïrï røk caammi bëët mo wø cam. Ni cooŋï gø kanya ciel kiper dëërï, ni tïme na cam jïrï ki jïge thuwø.»
english: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöa ni tïïc gïïögø; ni put gïïögø tïïc ki køør luup bëët moa köömmi ya Jwøki ki geni.
english: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Nöa, ni «Ïïni ki jø paarï bëët, cou yi jääy, kiper beeye ïïna ŋata jooda keere ni mare beer ri beenhnhø man bäre.
english: And the Lord said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

anywaa: Beerra man kädï jïrï røk lääy moa beyø ki thwönhi abïriiø ki mädhi abïriiø, ni kädï røk lääy moa ba beyø no oriewi riewi na thwønh ki maath.
english: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.

anywaa: Ni kädï thuwø røk wec maal ki thwönhi abïriiø ki mädhi abïriiø, kiper nee nyïëdi moge bëëtge ni kwøw buutï bäät piny bäre.
english: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.

anywaa: Kiper køør nïne abïriiø aani køth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäät piny, ni pädhe ki cääŋŋe ma pïëraŋween ki wärre ma pïëraŋween; ni ö gïïa cwääa bëët na näk kwøw ni puta geni raanynyø bäät piny.»
english: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöa ni tïïc gïnögø ki køør luup bëët moa köömmi ya Wuuö Jwøki ki geni.
english: And Noah did according unto all that the Lord commanded him.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanya ö jwïïö na mac bäät piny, cwiic Nöa kar kaaca beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïciel.
english: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöa ki wääte ki cïïe ki määr wääte ni cige yi jääy na aciel ki eni, kiper nee bøthge ki jwïïö.
english: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.

anywaa: Ni ö teeŋ lääy moa beyø ki teeŋ lääy moa ba beyø ki teeŋ weny ki teeŋ gïï wø muuli bëët bäät piny,
english: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,

anywaa: ni cige yi jääy baŋ Nöa no oriewi riewi na thwønh ki maath, kaawat mana ö Jwøki na kööm Nöa.
english: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne abïriiø moa wäŋ Jwøki, jwïïö aput ö bäät piny.
english: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

anywaa: Kanya tïm cwiic Nöa na dïpe abïciel, ni nïr dwääy mo riet dwäde apaar ka abïriiø, dïcäŋöca piny bäre aput mudö ki jwïïö, ni ö maalli ni put dhee jap,
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

anywaa: ni ö køthi mo päl døc ni pädhe bäät piny bäre ki cääŋŋe ma pïëraŋween ki wärre ma pïëraŋween.
english: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöa ki cïïe, ki wääte na näk Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth, ki määr wääte dääi ni putge ci yi jääy dïcäŋöca kiree,
english: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

anywaa: ni beege geni ki teeŋ wïth lääc paap bëët, ki teeŋ wïth lääc paac bëët, ki teeŋ wïth gïï wø muuli bëët bäät piny, ki teeŋ wïth weny bëët.
english: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.

anywaa: Ni ö gïïögø na näk dëëtge da jwïëy bëët ni cige yi jääy baŋ Nöa no oriewi riewi,
english: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.

anywaa: na thwønh ki maath, kaawat mana ö Jwøki na kööm Nöa. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïëk jääy bäät Nöa.
english: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in.

anywaa: Ni ö jwïïö ni put nyaay bäät piny ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni ö pïïyi ni meetge rege, ni tïïcge jääy ni thäärö, ni tïme ni kare bäär ki piny.
english: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö pïïyi ni kathge døc, ni meetge rege ni thaar bäät piny bäre, ni tïm jääyi ni thäärö bäät pïï.
english: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.

anywaa: Ni ö pïïyi ni cäŋge kadhø døc bäät piny; ni ö kïte moa bäyö bëët dï piny bäre ni mwønyi ya pïïyi.
english: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.

anywaa: Ni ö pïïyi ni nyänh maal, ni dööŋ kïte piny tiet pïï, kany mo ni rømi jïtö ki gööye ma apaar kurbïïc.
english: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

anywaa: Køøre gïïa näk kwøw bëët ni wø cäädhi bäät piny athøw; ni beege weny ki lääc paac ki lääc paap ki gïï wø muuli bëët bäät piny, ki jiy bëët.
english: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:

anywaa: Ni ö gïïa kwøw na en bäät piny bëët na näk dëëtge da jwïëy ni thøwge bëët.
english: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni raany gïïa kwøw bëët bäät piny, ki mana täge ri dhaanhø, këël mana këët ri lääy ki gïï wø muuli ki wec maal; gïïögø bëët araanynyi bäät piny. Ni ö Nöa keere ni dööŋe, ki jøøa en buute yi jääy.
english: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

anywaa: Køøre pïï abëëdö bäät piny ni piny ee maaø ki nïne ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc.
english: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wïïe kär wïl ki Nöa ki lääc paap bëët ki lääc paac bëët moa en buute yi jääy. Ni ö Jwøki ni wëëk jamø kwönnö bäät piny; ni ö pïïyi ni døøkge.
english: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters assuaged;

anywaa: Ni ö pï jwïïö ni cuŋge, ni ö kwöra käl kuunhnhi yïthge maal ni cïëgi, ni ö køthi mana pädhö ni cööe.
english: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;

anywaa: Kanyøgø pïï aput tägö ki man døøkge bäät piny ki yïth nïne bëët; ni put pïïyi døø døc køør nïne ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc.
english: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet dwäde ni nïr dwääy apaar ka abïriiø, jääy ajïtö ki kany mo cuŋŋe yie bäät kïdi mo cwøl na Ararat.
english: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.

anywaa: Ni tïm pïïyi ni cäätha piny këël mana këët ri paac dwäde. 'Ba na tïme na ri paac dwäde, ni dïcäŋa täk nïr dwääy yie na aciel, wïth kïte atïmö ni nëënö wøk.
english: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne ma pïëraŋween, Nöa dha awëërnyeŋ mana tïïe ri jääy ajabe;
english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:

anywaa: ni jääŋ agaak wøk, ni aae ni määde jaak, ni cøøa kun ni cøøa kun këël mana tal pïïyi bäät piny.
english: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Nöa akuuru na en buute ajääŋŋe wøk kiper nee pïï liee ki man näk mo odwön bäät piny.
english: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;

anywaa: 'Ba akuuru bäŋ kany mo ee joodø mo këël tiete piny yie; køøre ena duu baŋ Nöa yi jääy, kiper atïmö ni pïï poot dagø dï piny bäre. Ni ö Nöa ni rwaak cere wøk baŋ gø ni mak gø ni käl gø baŋe yi jääy.
english: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena kurö ki nïne abïriiø møøk ni cäŋ akuuru jääŋŋö wøk ki yi jääy.
english: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;

anywaa: Ni duu akuuru baŋe kanya tïme na kur abøøya, ni käädö ki ïth jaath mo marr ki dhee; ni puti ya Nöa ŋäc ni pïï onø dwön bäät piny.
english: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Nöa acäŋ kurö ki nïne abïriiø møøk ni cäŋ akuuru jääŋŋö wøk, 'ba akuuru kär duu baŋ Nöa këët.
english: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Nöa moa beede na dïpe abïciel ka aciel, kanya täk nïr dwääyi mana dïkwøŋ na aciel, pïï adwön bäät piny. Køøre Nöa wï jääy ajabe, ni räŋŋe ni joot piny bäre ni cäätha kur talø.
english: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri riet dwäde, ni nïr dwääy pïërariiø ka abïriiø, piny atal.
english: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk acäänö ki Nöa, ni kööe,
english: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci wøk ki yi jääy, ïïni ki cïïï ki wäätï ki määr wäätï ni en buutï.
english: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.

anywaa: Ni kälï gïïa näk kwøw bëët wøk na en buutï thuwø, na näk weny ki lääy ki gïï wø muuli bäät piny bëët, kiper nee nyöötge ni tïmge ni thööth, ni jïtge ki nyïëdi, ni nyaacge bäät piny.»
english: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Nöa aci wøk ki yi jääy; ni ö wääte ki cïïe ki määr wääte ni cige wøk ki eni.
english: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:

anywaa: Ni ö lääyi bëët, ki gïï wø muuli, ki weny bëët, na näk gïï wø cäädhi bäät ŋøøm bëët, ni cige wøk ki yi jääy na wï tuuŋ man nø.
english: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.

anywaa: Køøre Nöa atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni lwöte røk lääya beyø bëët ki røk weny moa beyø bëët, ni waaŋ geni no olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And Noah builded an altar unto the Lord; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni ŋwääc gïna duuŋ ni met, ni kööe ki cwïnye, ni «Aani køør man nø, piny ba cäŋa ciennø këët kiper gïna tïïc dhaanhe. Kiper acaac dhaanhø man wø caare ki cwïnye ki mana täge thïnhö cøøn beeye acaara mo raac cooth. Aani thuwø gïïa näk kwøw bëët ba cäŋa raanynyø këët kaawat mana tïïa en.
english: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour; and the Lord said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, kaawat man bëët pinynyi ni nut en, kar pïïdhö ki kar kac, ki lïëth piny ki ŋec piny, oput bëëtö ni nut cooth. Ni ö dhi køthi ka arïïa ni bëëtge ni dagø cooth; ni put waŋcäŋŋi ki wäär bëëdö ni ba cuŋ këët.»
english: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk Nöa agwïëdhe ki wääte, ni kööe jïge, ni «Nyöödu ni nyaayu ni pääŋŋu piny.
english: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö lääyi mo bäät piny bëët ki wec maal bëët këël gïï wø muuli bäät ŋøøm bëët ki rec naam bëët ni bëëtge ni lwäär ki uuni, ni tïmge ni ge böö ki uuni. Geno bëëdö ni ena ceŋŋu.
english: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

anywaa: Gïï wø cäädhi na kwøw bëët otïmö na cam jïïu. Gena cïba jïïu kaawat mana cïba gïïa näk otuy na marr bëët jïïu.
english: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.

anywaa: «'Ba rïŋö mo remø mare poot ena dëëre kär cammu, kiper remø beeye jwïëy moe.
english: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, kwör rem kwøw maru coola coolø dëët lääy bëët. Ni coola gø thuwø dëët jiy bëët. Kwör rem kwøw mar dhaanhø coola coolø dëër ŋati man nø.
english: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.

anywaa: «Ŋat mo kønynya rem dhaanhø piny jaak, remme okøny dhaanhe mørri piny thuwø; kiper Jwøk dhaanhø acwääe ki kïdö mo caala mare.
english: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, jïtu ki nyïëdi ni nyaayu, ni pääŋŋu piny nou thööth døc ni nyaayu yie.»
english: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk acäänö ki Nöa ki wääte na en buute, ni kööe,
english: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ennø, aani a tudö ki luubö ki uuni ki nyïïkwaayu moo ööi køøru.
english: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;

anywaa: Ni tuuda gø thuwø ki gïïa kwøw bëët na en buutu, ni beege weny ki lääc paac ki lääc paap bëët na en buutu, na näk gïïa ö wøk bëët ki yi jääy ki uuni na aciel, këël mana këët ri lääc bäät piny bëët.
english: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

anywaa: Luubö mara tuuda tuudö ki uuni. Køør man en nø gïïa kwøw bëët bäät piny ba doo ränynyö këët ki jwïïö, ni doo bäŋ jwïïö mo duui këët mo caala man mo raanynya piny bäre.»
english: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Man beeye nyuudhi mar luumma tuuda yaakiyø ki uuni ki gïïa näk kwøw bëët na en buutu, kiper beenhnhø bäre thuwø mano ööi yi nyïme.
english: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

anywaa: Aani daanø mara acïba yi pöölö maal, nee tïme na nyuudhi mar luumma tuuda yaakicwa ki piny.
english: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.

anywaa: Køøre kany wäro käla pøøl bäät piny, daanø puta nëënnö yïth pøøl.
english: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:

anywaa: Ni ö aani ni para wïïa ki luumma tuuda na en yïthakiyø ki uuni ki gïïa kwøw bëët, ni pïï ba cäŋ duuö këët na jwïïö kuna raany gïïa kwøw bëët.
english: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

anywaa: Kany wäro tïme ni daanø ena yi pöölö maal, eni neena neenø, ni puta wïïa par ki luumma tuut na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe na en yïthakicwa, a na Jwøk, ki gïïa näk kwøw bëët na en bäät piny.»
english: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki jï Nöa, ni «Man beeye nyuudhi mar luumma tuuda na tïïa nee bëëde yïthakicwa ki gïïa näk kwøw bëët na en bäät piny.»
english: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Nöa na ö wøk ki yi jääy kar kaaca beege Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth. Ni ö Kaammi ni tïme na wää Keenanni.
english: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.

anywaa: Ni jøøgø na adäk yøø beege jøøa näk wäät Nöa, ni jiy moa nyaay bäät piny bëët käla rege.
english: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

anywaa: Køøre Nöa na näk ŋat puur atägö ki man piith pwöth omøki.
english: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki ni meere, ni käl abïïe wøk dëëre, ni dööŋe ki dëëre yo oduŋkaara mare.
english: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

anywaa: Ni ö Kaammi na näk wää Keenanni ni raŋ jï wänni jaak ni bëëdö ka dëëre, ni døø wøk ni caan gø jï nyïïmenni riet.
english: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëm ki Jaapeth alwötö ka abïï ni kïthge gø göökge, ni cääthge ni ŋäthge ege løø, ni cige ni rïëpge wääge na näk bëëdö ka dëëre; ni løøge nyïmge wøk kiper nee wääge na näk bëëdö ka dëëre nee ba neenge.
english: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.

anywaa: Kanya ö Nöa na pääe ni lëëny wïïe ki meec køøŋø, gïna tïïc wääde mana thiinh dëëre awïnynye.
english: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, na «Acïëni oen bäät Keenan, ni tïme ni kadha laŋ mare dï laaŋe mo nyïïmenni.»
english: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö thuwø, ni «Pwøc oen jï Wuuö Jwøk, na näk Jwø Cëm; beerra man tïm Keenanni na laŋŋø mare.
english: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki ni wëëk Jaapeth nyaay, ni bëëde yïth oduŋkaare mo Cëm, ni tïm Keenanni na laŋŋø marge.»
english: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

anywaa: 'Ba Nöa abëëdö ki cwiiri ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïïc køør jwïïö.
english: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.

anywaa: Ni cwiiri moa beet Nöa bëët beege cwiiri ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïïc. Køøre ena thøw.
english: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth na näk wäät Nöa. Kanya tïme na køør jwïïö gena nyöödö, ni jïtge ko obwöre.
english: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

anywaa: Wäät Jaapeth beege Gömër, ki Magöök, ki Madë, ki Jawan, ki Tubal, ki Möcak, ki Tëra.
english: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

anywaa: Ni wäät Gömër beege Ackena, ki Ripath, ki Tögarma.
english: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Jawanni ni näkge beege Elica, ki Tarcëc, ki Kitim, ki Rödanim.
english: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøgø, jø wø bëëdö bäät näm dëëtge apääŋge yïth ŋøøm moge, ni jøøi nø ŋäya dhøk marge, ni ge bëëdö na wï tuuŋ man nø, na teeŋ wï jur man nø.
english: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

anywaa: Wäät Kaam beege Kuuc, ki Micram, ki Put, ki Keenan.
english: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

anywaa: Ni wäät Kuuc beege Ceba, ki Ëwlath, ki Cabta, ki Raama, ki Cabteka; ni ö wäät Raama ni näkge beege Cïïba ki Didan.
english: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

anywaa: Kuuc Namrut anywøle, ni ö Namruti ni tïme ni beeye ŋata kwøŋ bëëtö no oteeø bäät piny.
english: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

anywaa: Ni tïme na ŋat mo thöör ŋääe døc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper manøgø nø, jiy atïmö ni ŋääta ree, ni köge, ni «Ï caala Namrut, ŋata näk dïthöödhi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ŋøøm moe tägi ka Babel ki Ërëk ki Akat ki Kalnë, mïëya en yi Cinaar.
english: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

anywaa: Ni tïŋŋe yi ŋöömmögø, ni aae ni pööth Aciria, ni geer Nineba ki Rööböth-Ir ki Kala,
english: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,

anywaa: ni geer Rëcën na en yïthakic Nineba ki Kala, ni tïmge na pääny aciel mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.

anywaa: 'Ba Micram beeye na kwar jø Ludim, ki jø Anamim, ki jø Laabim, ki jø Neptalëm,
english: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

anywaa: ki jø Petruc, ki jø Kaclu, ki jø Kaptör, na näk jøøa käl jø Pilitinni dëëtge.
english: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphtorim.

anywaa: Keenan wääde ma Caydan na näk kanynye anywøle, ni nywøl Këth thuwø.
english: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,

anywaa: Ni ö jø Jeebuc ki jø Amör ki jø Gërgëca,
english: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

anywaa: ki jø Ëwi ki jø Aruk ki jø Cini,
english: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

anywaa: ki jø Arbat ki jø Dhemari ki jø Amath ni kälge ree. Køøre cään tuuŋ jø Keenan anyaay ni keethge.
english: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋøømmi mo jø Keenan ni nyaacge, ni tägi ka Caydan ni cøøa jï kuna en Gërar këël mana këët Geedha, ni pööth jï kuna en Cødam ki Gømöra ka Adama ki Dheböym këël mana këët Laca.
english: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboiim, even unto Lasha.

anywaa: Moøgø beege nyïïkwaac Kaam; ni jøøi nø bëëdö na wï tuuŋ man nø, ni ge ŋäya dhøk marge, ni ge bëëdö yïth ŋøøm moge na teeŋ wï jur man nø.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø Cëm, na näk kwar jø Eber, anyöötö ko obwöre. Cëm beeye cok Jaapethi, ni dwøŋŋa eni ki coki ma Jaapeth.
english: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.

anywaa: Wäät Cëm beege Ilam ki Acör ki Arpakat ki Lut ka Aram.
english: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Arammi ni näkge Uc ki Uul ki Gëthër ki Möcak.
english: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

anywaa: Ni ö Arpakat ni nywøl Ceela, ni ö Ceela ni nywøl Eber.
english: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.

anywaa: Ni ö Eberri ni nyööte ki wääte ariiø; ni nyeŋ wääde maya cwøl ni Pelek kiper na tïme na ree kar kaaca, jiy akeethø dï piny; ni ö nyeŋ coki ni cwøli ni Jöktan.
english: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

anywaa: Ni ö Jöktanni ni nywøl Almödat ki Calëp ki Acremöt ki Jerak,
english: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

anywaa: ka Adöram ka Udhal ki Dekla,
english: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

anywaa: ko Obal ka Abimaal ki Cïïba;
english: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

anywaa: ko Öpïr ki Ëwlath ki Jöbap. Jøøgø bëët beege wäät Jöktan.
english: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

anywaa: Ŋøøm moa bëëtge yïthge atägö ki kanya cwøl ni Mëca ni pïïe jï kuna en Cipar, paana näk po kïte, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.

anywaa: Jøøgø bëët beege nyïïkwaac Cëm, ni jøøi nø bëëdö na wï tuuŋ man nø, ni ge ŋäya dhøk marge, ni ge bëëdö yïth ŋøøm moge na teeŋ wï jur man nø.
english: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø beege nyïïkwaac Nöa ki køør tuuŋ marge, ni jøøi nø bëëdö na teeŋ wï jur man nø. Ki røk jøøgø wïth juurre anyaay bäät piny bäre køør jwïïö.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgøøni jø bäät piny bëët atïmö ni cäänö ka dhøk aciel, ni luup moge dïët na aciel bëët.
english: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya paanyge dëëtge jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, gena aay ni jïtge ki gool yi ŋööm Cinaar ni bëëtge yie.
english: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni «Øøni nø, beerra man tïïø ki thuube ni bulø geni ni beyø døøc.» Køøre gena jïtö ki thuube mo gëëtge ki ge na kar kïte, ni jïtge ko odhöönh mo nwaaŋ na gïn caamge thuube ki gø.
english: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for mortar.

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Øøni nø, beerra man gëënnø dëëtø ki pääny ki øt pööki mo wïïe guta maal, kiper nee nyeŋŋø wïnye, kiper nøø ba keethø bäät piny bäre.»
english: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aö piny kuna neen pääny ki pööki mana geer jiyi.
english: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Ennø, jøøi gena tuuŋ aciel, ni dhøk marge aciel bëët. Teeŋ gïn ennø atäkge ki man tïïcge gø; ni gïn wø caarge jaak yi nyïme nee tïïcge, ba dhäthi jïge møn.»
english: And the Lord said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, «Øøni nø, beerra man cøø piny baŋge ni kierø wï dhøk marge kaace, kiper nee ŋati man nø nee dhi wati maya ba wïnynye.»
english: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.

anywaa: Køøre gena keeth Wuuö Jwøki kaace bëët dï piny bäre, ni kärge päänyögø geerø këët.
english: So the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace acwøl ni Babel, kiper kaace beeye kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na kier wï dhøk mar jø bäät piny bëët yie, ni wëëk geni keethø kaace bëët dï piny bäre.
english: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the Lord did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the Lord scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Cëm. Kanya tïme na køør cwiiri ariiø mo jwïïö, ni Cëm cwiiri moe dïpa, ena nyöötö ki wääde mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Arpakat.
english: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:

anywaa: 'Ba køør kanya ö Cëmmi na nywøl wääde ma Arpakat, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe abïïc, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Arpakati ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurbïïc, ni nywøl wääde ma Ceela.
english: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Arpakati na nywøl wääde ma Ceela, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ka adäk, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Ceela ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk, ni nywøl wääde ma Eber.
english: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Ceela na nywøl wääde ma Eber, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ka adäk, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Eberri ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurŋween, ni nywøl wääde ma Pelek.
english: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Eberri na nywøl wääde ma Pelek, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Peleki ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk, ni nywøl wääde ma Reew.
english: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Peleki na nywøl wääde ma Reew, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe ariiø ka abïŋween, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Reewi ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurriiø, ni nywøl wääde ma Ceeruk.
english: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Reewi na nywøl wääde ma Ceeruk, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe ariiø ka abïriiø, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Ceeruki ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk, ni nywøl wääde ma Neeyör.
english: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Ceeruki na nywøl wääde ma Neeyör, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpe ariiø, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Neeyörri ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween, ni nywøl wääde ma Teera.
english: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:

anywaa: Køør kanya ö Neeyörri na nywøl wääde ma Teera, ena cäŋ bëëtö ki cwiiri ma dïpa ka apaar ka abïŋween, ni nyööde ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: Ni ö Teera ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø, ni nywøl wääte ma Abram ki Neeyör ki Aaren.
english: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Teera. Teera anyöötö ni nywøl wääte na näk Abram ki Neeyör ka Aaren; ni ö Aarenni ni nywøl wääde ma Løøt.
english: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.

anywaa: 'Ba Aaren athøw ni wänni ma Teera poot nut ni kwøw. Ni eni thøøa yi Ur yi ŋöömma nywøli yie na näk po jø Kaldia.
english: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ki Neeyör ni nyöömge dëëtge ki mään. Ni nyeŋ cï Abram cwøl ni Caray, ni ö nyeŋ cï Neeyör ni cwøli ni Milka. Milka beeye nyi Aaren. Aaren beeye wää Milka ki Icka.
english: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.

anywaa: 'Ba Caray atïmö na bwøc, ni jïre bäŋ nyilaal.
english: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.

anywaa: Køøre Teera wääde ma Abram ki nyïïkwaare ma Løøt wär Aaren ki cï nyaare ma Caray na näk cï wääde ma Abram alwøre, ni tïŋge na aciel bëët ki yi Ur po jø Kaldia, ni ge cøøa ŋööm Keenan. 'Ba na pïïcge paana cwøl na Aaren, gena put bëëte kaace.
english: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Teera beege cwiiri ma dïpe ariiø ka abïïc. Køøre Teera athøø Aaren.
english: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ka Abram, ni kööe, ni «Wec pou ki tuuŋu ki dhi øt wäru, ni ciï yi ŋöömmo nyoodha jïrï.
english: Now the Lord had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:

anywaa: «Ïïno tïïa na wï jur mo dwøŋ, ni gwïëdha ïïni, ni tïŋa nyeŋŋï maal, ni jït jiyi ki gwïëth ki køørï.
english: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:

anywaa: Ni jøw wäro gwïëth ïïni, gwïëdha gwïëdhö; ni ŋat wäro cien ïïni, ciena cienø thuwø. 'Ba wïth tuŋi bëët mo bäät piny ogwïëth ki køørï.»
english: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.

anywaa: Køøre Abram atïŋŋö kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïre. Ni ö Løøti thuwø ni aae ki eni. 'Ba kanya tïŋ Abrammi ki yi Aaren, cwiiri moe kar kaaca beege cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø kurbïïc.
english: So Abram departed, as the Lord had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni lwør cïïe ma Caray, ki ö coki ma Løøt, ki jammi moge bëët moa jootge, ki jiy bëët moa jootge Aaren; ni aacge ni ge cøøa ŋööm Keenan. Køøre gena pïï yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni pöödhe ki dï ŋöömmögø këël mana pïïe kanya cwøl ni Cekam na en jaadha dwøŋŋi yie mar Mörë. 'Ba yi kar kanyøgø jø Keenan oløny ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø.
english: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Abram ni kööe, ni «Aani ŋøøpi ii cïba cïbö jï nyïïkwaayï.» Køøre Abram atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree jïgø.
english: And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the Lord, who appeared unto him.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïŋŋö ki kaace ni cøøa ri kïdi mana en Bëthël, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Ni gur oduŋkaara mare piny, ni Bëthël ee wii jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni Gaay ee wii jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Køøre ena tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni wøør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el, and pitched his tent, having Beth–el on the west, and Ai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the Lord, and called upon the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni cäŋ tïŋŋö kaace, ni aae ni coonya kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp.
english: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

anywaa: Kanyøgø piny atïmö ni da käc. Køøre Abram aci Ijep nee bëëde kaace na wëëllö, kiper käc atïmö ni dwøŋ døc.
english: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni kare cään ki man pïïe Ijep, ena köö jï cïïe ma Caray, ni «Kawaane ennø, ŋääa ni ïïna dhaagø mo kïte mïërö.
english: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:

anywaa: Kanymør no ö jø Ijepi noo jootge ïïni, ge köö, ni ‹Man beeye cïïe;› køøre a 'näkge nääö, ni wecge ïïni niï kwøw.
english: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.

anywaa: Beerra man kööï ni ïïna coka, kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo tägi dëëra, naa kwøa ki køørï.»
english: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Abrammi Ijep, jø Ijep Caray ajootge na dhaagø mo kïte mïërö.
