english: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre mo Peerø ni jootge nyijøøgø, ni pwøcge gø døc buut Peerø, ni ö nyijøøgø ni käli ni kïthi po Peerø.
english: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø ni tïïe ki gïn mo beer jï Abram kiper nyijøøgø; ni ö Abrammi ni jïte ki dïëk ki dhäk ka arëëni, ki jø tïïc ma mään ki cwøw, ka arëëni ma mädhi, ka athïrööle.
english: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk täwe mo leth døc akïth bäät Peerø ki jø paan dwøŋ mare ki køør Caray cï Abram.
english: And the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø Abram acwøle, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïyï dëëra en? ?Aperŋø na ba caanï gø jïra en ni nyijøøgø cïïï?
english: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

anywaa: ?Aŋø na kööï ni ena coku en, ni puta eni lwør na dhaagø jïra? 'Ba cïïï ennø, lwørï ni aayï ki gø.»
english: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø ni kööm jiye kiper Abram. Ni ö jiye ni jiethge Abram ge ki cïïe ki gïïa en jïre bëët.
english: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

anywaa: Køøre Abram aö wøk ki Ijep ki cïïe ki gïïa en jïre bëët, ni aae ni cøøa kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp; ni ö Løøti ni aae ki eni ciel.
english: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

anywaa: Kar kaace Abram ena dhaanhø mo okwär døc, ni jïre da lääc paac mo thööth ki warkey mo päl.
english: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni tïŋŋe ki Nëgëp ni cäädhe këël mana pïïe Bëthël, kanya kwøŋ twïër mare tïïc yie yaakic Bëthël ki Gaay,
english: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Beth–el and Ai;

anywaa: ni beeye kanya kwøŋ tïïö yie ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Køøre Abram nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk awøøre kaace.
english: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Løøt na aay ka Abram bëët, jïre da pïïth dïëk ki pïïth dhäk ko oduŋkaare thuwø.
english: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace yi ŋöömma pïge piny yie kär rømø kiperge ki lääy moge bëët; kiper gïïa käärge thööth, ni tïme ni ba løny jïge ki man bëëtge na aciel.
english: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni atïmö ni da män yïthakic jø kwaath mo Abram ki jø kwaath mo Løøt. Kar kaaca jø Keenan ki jø Përec oløny ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø.
english: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

anywaa: Ni kö Abrammi jï Løøt, ni «Beerra man bëëdø ni bäŋ män yïthakiyø ki ïïni, wala yïthakic jø kwaath 'moa ki jø kwaath moï, kiper øøna tuuŋ.
english: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, piny ba nëëni jïrï ni laac jaak ice? Beerra man paanyï riï buuta; ni näk miï jiera bäät caam, a cøøa bäät cwïïc. Ni näk miï jiera bäät cwïïc, a cøøa bäät caam.»
english: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Løøt wïïe atïŋ maal ni raŋ gool mar Jördan, no ojwøc pïïyi bäre, ni poot caala ajïniina mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni caala ŋööm Ijep mana en buut Dhöär, ni manøgø beeye kanya poode ni Wuuö Jwøk Cødam ki Gømöra poot käre raanynyø.
english: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

anywaa: Køøre Løøt gool mar Jördan bäre ajiere jïre; ni put Løøti tägö ki wääth ni cøøa jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Ni put tïmö ni beeye keethø marge.
english: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni put bëëte yi ŋööm Keenan, ni ö Løøti ni bëëde yïth päänye mo gool mar Jördan, ni daaŋ twëëre moe këël mana pïïe buut Cødam.
english: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Cødam bëëdö na jø raay mo tïïö ki gïï mo reyø døc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the Lord exceedingly.

anywaa: Køøre kanya ö Løøti na pääge ka Abram, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Abram, ni «Tïŋ wïïï maal ki kanyo enï yie enø, ni neenï but piny karge bëët ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ;
english: And the Lord said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

anywaa: kiper ŋøøpo nëëni jïrï bëët yøø ocïba jïrï na bäre bäre këël nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï.
english: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

anywaa: Ni tïïa kwään nyïïkwaayï ni thööth ni caala tør bäät piny; køøre ni näk da dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man kwaan tør bäät piny, løny thuwø ki man kwaan nyïïkwaayï.
english: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

anywaa: Ö maal, ni caathï dï ŋöömmögø bäre; kiper cïba cïbö jïrï.»
english: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Abram twïër mare adaae ni aae ni bëëde buut jera døøŋŋø mo Mamrë na en Keeprön, ni tïïe ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïra bëët Amrapëlli na nyeny Cinaar, ki Aryök nyeny Elacar, ki Kedör-Laömer nyeny Ilam, ki Tidal nyeny Göyim, da gïn maa tägö.
english: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

anywaa: Nyeye moøgø aci baŋ leny ki Bera nyeny Cødam, ki Birca nyeny Gømöra, ki Cenaap nyeny Adama, ki Cëmëber nyeny Dheböym ki nyeny Bëla paana cwøl ni Dhöär.
english: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

anywaa: Nyeye moøgø na abïïc yøø dëëtge adwalge na aciel kiper leny yi Gool mar Cidim na tïmö na Naam Acäbö.
english: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

anywaa: Kiper gena kwøŋ bëëdö tier nyeya ma Kedör-Laömer ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø. 'Ba na tïme na ri cwiiri apaar kurdäk gena gëëmö ki gø.
english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar kurŋween, Kedör-Laömer ki nyeye moa en ree, gena cøø ni dïïmge jø Rapayim yi Actharöth-Karnayim, ni dïïmge jø Dhudhim yi Kaam ki jø Ëmim yi Caawe-Kiryatayim,
english: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

anywaa: ni dïïmge jø Öör poge ma Cëër na näk po kïte, këël mana këët El-Paran na en deŋ paap.
english: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El–paran, which is by the wilderness.

anywaa: Køøre dëëtge aløkge ni cige ya Ayn-Micpath na näk Kadëc, ni dïïmge mïëri bëët mo jø Amalëk, ni dïïmge jø Amör thuwø ni wø bëëdö yi Acëcön-Tamar.
english: And they returned, and came to En–mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni nyeny Cødam, ki nyeny Gømöra, ki nyeny Adama, ki nyeny Dheböym, ki nyeny Bëla na näk Dhöär, gena ö wøk ni jiiŋge dëëtge kiper leny yi gool mar Cidim;
english: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

anywaa: nee këëtge ki Kedör- Laömer nyeny Ilam, ki Tidal nyeny Göyim, ka Amrapël nyeny Cinaar ki Aryök nyeny Elacar, ni nyeye aŋween këëdi ka nyeye abïïc.
english: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

anywaa: 'Ba yi gool mar Cidim da aguule mo thööth mo päŋ ko odhöönh mo nwaaŋ. Kanya ö nyeny Cødam ki nyeny Gømöra na bwøkge, gena reeŋø ni päthge yïth aguule. 'Ba moa bøth areeŋø ni pïïcge bäät kïte.
english: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

anywaa: Køøre nyeye moa näk aŋween jap jø Cødam bëët ki jap jø Gømöra ki caammi moge bëët alwørge ni aacge.
english: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

anywaa: Ni makge Løøt thuwø o cöök Abrammi, ni lwørge jammi moe ni aacge. Kiper Løøt kar kaaca bëëdö Cødam.
english: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mør mo obøth aöö ni caan gø jï Abram na näk nyï Ibaru. Kar kaaca Abram bëëdö buut jera døøŋŋø mo Mamrë nyï Amör na näk cöök Ëcköl ka Anër. Jøøgø gena dwätö ka Abram ni tïmge ni ge ena løøe.
english: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi Abrammi ni o coki amak ri leny, jiye ma dïpe adäk ka apaar ka abära moa nywøl paare na näk opwönynyö abwødhe kiper leny; ni aacge ni ge määnyö këël mana këëtge Daan.
english: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni pääŋ jiye ki dï wäär, ni ö eni ki jiye ni tukge jøøgø, ni böötge geni ni riemge geni këël mana këëtge Ööba na en ŋää Damacka.
english: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

anywaa: Køøre jammi bëët aduue, ni lwør o coki ma Løøt ki jape ki mään ki jiy, ni duu geni bëët.
english: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

anywaa: Kanya duu Abrammi ki kuna dïïm Kedör-Laömer ki nyeye moa en ree, nyeny jø Cødam aci wøk baŋ gø kuna jøl gø yi gool mar Caawe na näk gool mar nyeya.
english: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.

anywaa: Ni ö Melkidhedeki nyeny Calem ni känne ki dääpe ki køøŋø. Melkidhedek beeye kwääy lam thuwø mar Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

anywaa: Eni Abram agwïëdhe, ni kööe, ni «Gwïëth oen bäät Abram na näk dhaanh Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, Jwøa en maalli cere ki piny;
english: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

anywaa: ni ö pwøci ni en jï Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, Jwøa cïp nyïïmän moï cerï.» Køøre Abram acïpö jï Melkidhedek ki paac wïth jammi bëët.
english: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeny Cødam jï Abram, ni «Mëëk a jiya keerge, ni lwørï jammi na moï.»
english: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

anywaa: 'Ba Abram aköö jï nyeny Cødam, ni «Aano nø kööŋ ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, Jwøa en maalli cere ki piny,
english: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the Lord, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

anywaa: ni aani a ba doo løny ki man käda ki gïn mo thiinh, këël waarø wala thøør warø wala nyi gïn mør jaak ma marï; kiper kanymør ï köö jaak, na ‹Abram tïïya aani na kwäärö ki jammi.›
english: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

anywaa: Aani bäŋ gïn mo lwøra, 'ba beeye gïïa cam jiya keerge. 'Ba kiper kur jøøa aay ki aani, na näk Anër ki Ëcköl ki Mamrë, beerra man lwørge kurge.»
english: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

anywaa: Køør gïïögø bëët dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Abram ki yïth lääk, ni kööe, na «Abram, kärï lwäyö; aani, aana kwöt leny man wø gëëŋ ïïni; ïïno ŋada ki gïn mo dwøŋ.»
english: After these things the word of the Lord came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

anywaa: Ni kö Abrammi, «?Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, agïnaŋø noo cïpï jïra? Kiper aani jïra bäŋ nyilaal, ni ŋato dööŋ na lwiidhø wï paara beeye Eliëdher nyï Damacka.»
english: And Abram said, Lord God, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Abrammi köö, ni «Kiper mana näk a kärï mooø ki nyilaal, neenï, laŋŋa nywøl paara beeye noo dööŋ na lwiidhø wï paara.»
english: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääte, ni kööe, ni «Ŋati en ba dööŋ na lwiidhø wï paarï; 'ba ïïno jïti ki dhaanhø mo käla dëërï kiree, ni put dööŋö na lwiidhø wï paarï.»
english: And, behold, the word of the Lord came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl Abram wøk ki yi øtø ni kööe, ni «Raŋ maal ni kwaanï ceer, ni näk mo løny jïrï ki man kwaanï ge bëët.» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Abram, ni «Nyïïkwaayï thuwø otïmö ni caala geni.»
english: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jïëc Abram ni ena dhaanhø mo mare beer ki køør ŋäädhe mare.
english: And he believed in the Lord; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Abram, ni «Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na käl ïïni wøk ki yi Ur po jø Kaldia, kiper nee ŋöömmi cïba jïrï nee tïme na moï.»
english: And he said unto him, I am the Lord that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans, to give thee this land to inherit it.

anywaa: Ni kö Abrammi, ni «?Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, oŋääa gø nidïï ki man näk tïmö na 'moa?»
english: And he said, Lord God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Abram, ni «Kännï jïra ki dhieŋ mo cwiiye adäk, ka ateea ma maath mo cwiiye adäk, ki nywø røømmø mo cwiiye adäk, ka akuuru mar paac ki mar paap.»
english: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

anywaa: Køøre gïïögø bëët akäl Abrammi jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋøør ge ki dïge, ni peeth thääŋ man nø piny ni dïët ki thääŋ maya. 'Ba akuyi käre ŋørø.
english: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

anywaa: Køøre weny alööny piny nee rïŋ camge, ni ö Abrammi ni riem geni.
english: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

anywaa: Køøre kanya tïme ni cäŋ kwaara piny, Abram nyeŋŋe ajïtö ki niine ni bute døc, ni ö muudhö mo cøl døc ki lwär mo päl ni öge bääte.
english: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki jï Abram, ni «Wär ŋäyï møn ni nyïïkwaayï obëëdö na wëëlle yi ŋöömma näk paa marge, ni tïnyge jøøgø ni gena laaŋe, ni ö nyïïkwaayï ni caari ki cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween.
english: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

anywaa: 'Ba aani thuwø jø otïnyge ojääla; køøre nyïïkwaayï ööa wøk paanøgø ni jïge da jammi mo thööth.
english: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ïïno thøw ni läpï køør kwäyu ni yiï met; ni koony ïïni ni jalø mana jalï ki gø poot beer.
english: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaayï oruu paanøgø këël ŋweer beenhnhe, køøre geno duu kany, kiper raay mo jø Amör poot kär këët kanya manynyi ki man raany ge.»
english: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päth cäŋŋi, piny atïmö ni cøl døc, ni ö maaci mo duuŋ yi dak ka ameet mo liel ni pööthge ki dïër yïthakic thäk lääya näk oŋørø ki dïge.
english: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca Wuuö Jwøk atudö ki luubö ka Abram, ni kööe, ni «Ŋöömö man acïba jï nyïïkwaayï, ki mano täge ki naam jø Ijep këël mano këët naama dwøŋ, na näk Upareeti,
english: In the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

anywaa: ni beeye ŋøøp jø Këën, ki jø Kënec, ki jø Kadmön,
english: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

anywaa: ki jø Këth, ki jø Përec, ki jø Rapayim,
english: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

anywaa: ki jø Amör, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Gërgëca, ki jø Jeebuc.»
english: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

anywaa: 'Ba Caray na näk cï Abram bäŋ obwöre mo ege nywølø ka Abram. 'Ba jïre da laŋŋø ma nyi jø Ijep mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Eegar.
english: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

anywaa: Ni kö Caray jï Abram, ni «Ennø, Wuuö Jwøk aana mäne ki man nyööda ko obwöre. Beerra man ciï baŋ dhaaŋŋa näk laŋŋø mara; kanymør aano jïti ko obwöre ki køøre.» Køøre Abram dwør cïïe ma Caray aleŋe.
english: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the Lord hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

anywaa: Ni ö Caray cï Abram ni lwør Eegar nyi jø Ijep na näk laŋŋø mare, ni cïp gø jï cwøre ma Abram nee tïme na cïïe. Ni gïnögø tägi ka køør cwiiri apaar moa beet Abrammi yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

anywaa: Ni ö Abrammi ni ci baŋ Eegar, ni jït yi Eegarri ki dhaanhø. 'Ba kanya ö Eegarri na joot gø ni yie da dhaanhø, ena tägö ki man raŋ Caray na tïnynye ni ee taaø.
english: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

anywaa: Køøre Caray aköö jï Abram, ni «Bääyö mana baac Eegarri dëëra en, tiere käla baŋï, kiper nyaana näk laŋŋø mara acïba jïrï na cïïï; 'ba kanya joot gø ni yie da dhaanhø, aana raŋŋe naa ee taaø. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni ŋøl luubö manøgø yïthakiyø ki ïïni.»
english: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the Lord judge between me and thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Abram aköö jï Caray, ni «Kare møn, laŋŋø manøgø ena cerï; gïna caarï ni beerra eni jaak ki jïrï wär tïïyï dëëre.» Køøre Caray laŋŋøgø aput caannø ki caannø mo leth, ni ö nyaanøgø ni put päär wøk buute.
english: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Eegar ajoot nyïïatwielli mar Wuuö Jwøk ni ena buut jøøro dï paap, ni jøøro manøgø ena jööra näk cøøa paana cwøl ni Cur.
english: And the angel of the Lord found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwielli jïre, ni «?Eegar laŋ Caray, ï kälï kaa? ?Ï ciï kaa ŋø?» Ni dwøk gø jïgø, na «A päny wøk ki baŋ Caray ŋata tïnynya.»
english: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni «Døø baŋ Caray na tïnynyï, ni cïpï dëërï jïre ni bëëdï niï ena tiere.»
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel Wuuö Jwøki jïre thuwø, ni «Nyïïkwaayï otïïa ni thööth, ni nyaacge këël mano tïmge ni ba løny ki kwaan.»
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyïïatwiel Wuuö Jwøki köö jïre, ni «Neenï, yiï oløny ni da dhaanhø; ïïno lwaar ki gø na dïcwøø; ni cagï nyeŋŋe ni Icmiel, kiper Wuuö Jwøk gïïa jwørï bëët awïnynye.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the Lord hath heard thy affliction.

anywaa: 'Ba eno bëëdö na dhaanhø mo caala arëën-paap, ni bëëde na dhaanhø mo manynya leny ki jiy bëët, ni tïm jiyi bëët ni manynya leny ki eni thuwø; 'ba eno bëëdö no opääö ki tuuŋge.»
english: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

anywaa: Køøre Eegar nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na cäänö ki eni acaae, ni kööe, ni «Ïïna El-Röi, » ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ki køør mana jooda Jwøk kany en, a poot bëëdö naa kwøw møn?»
english: And she called the name of the Lord that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, iith mana en kaace aput cwøl ni Bëër- Laay-Röi; ni iidhøgø ena yaakic Kadëc ki Berët.
english: Wherefore the well was called Beer–lahai–roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

anywaa: 'Ba Eegar alwaar ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø ni jït Abrammi ki wääde; ni ö Abrammi ni cak nyeŋ wääde na lwaar Eegarri ki gø ni Icmiel.
english: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

anywaa: Kar kanya ö Abrammi na joot wääde ma Icmiel na lwaar Eegarri ki gø, Abram cwiiye oløny na pïërabära ka abïciel.
english: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Abrammi ni cwiiye pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween, Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Abram, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Aana Jwøa en teeki jïre; beerra man cäädhï nyïma, ni bëëdï ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö marï.
english: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the Lord appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

anywaa: 'Ba aani luumma tuuda tïïa tïïö nee bëëde ni nut yïthakiyø ki ïïni. Ni wëëga ïïni nyaay døc kiree.»
english: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

anywaa: Køøre Abram dëëre aleeŋ piny, ni cään Jwøki ki gø ni kööe,
english: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Aani gïna tuuda ki ïïni beeye en, ïïno tïmö na kwar wïth juurre mo thööth.
english: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋï ba cwøl na Abram këët; 'ba nyeŋŋï ocwøl ni Eeberam, kiper ï tïïa tïïö na kwar wïth juurre mo thööth,
english: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

anywaa: ni wëëga ïïni nyaay døc, ni tïïa wïth juurre ki nyeye ni käla riï.
english: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

anywaa: Ni ö luumma tuuda ni wëëga gø bëëtö yïthakiyø ki ïïni ki nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï, këël yi beenhnhø marge bäre, ni tïm luumma tuuda na gïn mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, kiper naa bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru ki nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï bëët.
english: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömmi ni bëëdï yie ni ïïna wëëllö en, na näk ŋööm Keenan bäre, ocïba jïrï ki nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï, nee bëëde na marge na bäre bäre; ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge.»
english: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki jï Eeberam, ni «Ïïni thuwø, luubö mana tuuda ki ïïni diï gwøø, ïïni këël nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï ki yïth beenhnhe moge bëët.
english: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

anywaa: Ni luumma tuuda noo gwøgï, nee bëëde yïthakiyø ki ïïni këël nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï, beeye en; jiy moa näk cwøw bëët dïïu wär geni daŋ.
english: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

anywaa: Ni këël uuni ki dëëtu wär dëëtu daŋŋu, kiper nee tïme na nyuudhi mar luumma tuuda ki uuni.
english: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

anywaa: Ni ö obwöre mou moo näk cwøw bëët ni daŋi kanyo tïme ni nïne abära wøk, këël mano këët ri beenhnhe mou bëët; ni këël laŋŋø mo onywølø paac marï jaak, wala ŋeew ka gwel yi tuuŋ mo path ni ba en ri nyïïkwaayï, wär daŋ bëët.
english: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

anywaa: Laŋŋø mo onywølø paarï jaak wala ŋeewï ka gwel, ka adïëri møn wär geni daŋ; kiper nee luumma tuuda bëëde ni nëënö dëëtu na luubö mo otuudö na bäre bäre.
english: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø ma dïcwøø mo kär daŋø, ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge; kiper mana käre luubö mana tuuda gwøø.»
english: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö jï Eeberam, ni «Caray na näk cïïï, kär cwølï këët ni Caray, 'ba nyeŋŋe ocwøl ni Ceera.
english: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

anywaa: 'Ba eno gwïëdha, këël mano mooa ïïni ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø mo käla dëëre kiree. Eni gwïëdha gwïëdhö, ni tïme na mii wïth juurre; ni tïm nyeye mo wïth juurre ni käla ree.»
english: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam ree aleeŋ piny ni put ŋeethø, ni kööe ki yi cwïnye, ni «?Dhaanhø mo cwiiye oløny na dïpa doo nyöötö ki nyilaal møn? Ceera thuwø cwiiye oløny na pïërabïŋween. ?Eni poot nyöötö ki nyilaal møn?»
english: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aköö jï Jwøk, ni «Wui, Icmiel ni näk bëëdö nyïmï ni kwøw, doo beer.»
english: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Ceera na näk cïïï nyöötö ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø ni jïtï ki wäädï, ni cagï nyeŋŋe ni Aydhak. Ni ö luumma tuuda ni wëëga gø bëëtö yïthakicwa ki eni na bäre bäre, këël nyïïkwaaye mo ööi køøre bëët.
english: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana caanï kiper Icmiel awïnynya; ennø, eno gwïëdha, ni tïïa gø nee känne ki nyïëdi mo thööth, ni wëëga eni nyaay døc. Eno tïmö na wää kwääri apaar kurriiø, ni tïïa eni na wï jur mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma tuuda owëëga bëëtö yïthakicwa ki wäädï ma Aydhak, no lwaar Ceera ki gø cwiino ööi kar kany nø.»
english: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jwøki ki cäänö ki Eeberam, Jwøk aay buut Eeberam.
english: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam wääde ma Icmiel, ki jiy moa nywøl paare bëët na näk laaŋe, këël moa ŋeew ki gwete bëët, jiy moa näk cwøw bëët moa en paare akäle ni put geni daŋ bëët dïcäŋöca kiree, kaawat mana caani ya Jwøki jïre.
english: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya daŋ Eeberam kar kaaca, cwiiye oløny na pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween.
english: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

anywaa: Ni ö wääde ma Icmiel ni daŋi ni cwiiye oløny na apaar kurdäk.
english: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

anywaa: Ni beeye dïcäŋögø na aciel enø na daŋ Eeberam yie ki wääde ma Icmiel bëët.
english: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa näk cwøw bëët na en paare, moa nywøl paare ki moa ŋeew ki gwel yi tuuŋ mo path, ni daŋ geni ki eni ciel.
english: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Eeberam buut jera døøŋŋø mo Mamrë, ni Eeberam opï piny dho oduŋkaara mare kanya tïm cäŋŋi ni ena dhöör.
english: And the Lord appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Eeberammi na tïŋ wïïe maal ni lwïthe nyïme, jiy adäk ajoode ni cuŋŋö ni dïët ki eni. 'Ba na joot geni, ena pär maal ki dho oduŋkaara na bëëde yie ni reŋ baŋge nee røømme ki geni. Kanyøgø cøŋŋe akëël piny nyïmge,
english: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

anywaa: ni kööe, na «Awuuö, ni näk mo yiï met ki aani, a na laŋŋï, a kwaya ïïni ki man ba pöödhï ki buuta jaak,
english: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

anywaa: kiper naa känna ki pïï mo thenh kiper nee tietu lwøgu ki ge, ni jwömmu dëëtu tier jaadhi en;
english: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

anywaa: naa känna ki gïn cam mo thiinh, kiper nee dëëtu nigethïk; køøre nø uuno pöödhi, kiper uuna nø lïïmmö baŋa, a na laŋŋø maru.» Køøre gena köö, ni «Beer, tïïyï kaawat mana caanï gø.»
english: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgøøni Eeberam aput rwäth yo oduŋkaara baŋ Ceera, ni kööe, ni «Laar määnyö ki møø mo pøøth ma rumme adäk, ni cootï gø, ni tïïyï gø na dääpe.»
english: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni reŋ kaal thuwø, ni lwöte ki nyirøøa mo dëëre beer mo olør, ni wëëk gø ŋat tïïc mare; ni ö ŋat tïïci ni laar nyirøøa jiiŋŋø.
english: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetched a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam caak moa cøt ki caak moa näk ciebe ki nyirøøa mana näk ee nø jiiŋŋø kiperge akäle ni cïp ge nyïmge; ni ö eni ni cuŋŋe buutge kanya cämge yie tier jaath.
english: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jïre, ni «Cïï ma Ceera en kaa?» Ni kööe, ni «Eni ena yo oduŋkaara kaace.»
english: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel røk jøøgø aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, cwiino ööi kar kany nø aano duu baŋï; ni ö cïïï ma Ceera ni nyööte ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.» 'Ba kar kaaca Ceera ïthe ee ciiø dho oduŋkaara ŋää ŋatøgø.
english: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø Eeberam ki Ceera gena jiy mo onø jalø, ni cwiicge oløny ni thööth døc; këël Ceera ki dëëre kar nyöödö mare onø pöödhö.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

anywaa: 'Ba Ceera aŋeethø ki yi cwïnye, ni kööe, ni «Kawaane ennø aano nø jalø, ni këël dïcwøø mara thuwø onø jalø. ?Aŋø, aani gïr dïcwøø poot dagø cwïnya këët?»
english: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Eeberam, na «?Aperŋø na ŋeeth Ceera, ni kööe, na ‹?A doo nyöötö ki nyilaal møn, ni aano nø jalø ennø?›?
english: And the Lord said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da gïn mo dhäthö jï Wuuö Jwøk? Ki kanya näk ocaanø aano duu baŋï cwiino ööi kar kany nø, ni ö Ceera ni nyööte ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.»
english: Is any thing too hard for the Lord? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

anywaa: 'Ba Ceera ree amooŋe, ni kööe, na «A kär ŋeethø;» kiper mana lwäye. 'Ba ŋata cäänö aköö, ni «Jïre bäär, ïïna ŋeethø møn.»
english: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø atïŋŋö ki kaace, ni ge neeta Cødam ya amät piny; ni ö Eeberammi ni aae ki geni ciel ni jietha geni.
english: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, na «?Aŋø, gïno tïïa en daa mooŋø ki Eeberam?
english: And the Lord said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn Eeberam tïmö na wï jur mo dwøŋ mo teek, ni bee eni no gwïëth wïth juurre mo bäät piny bëët ki køøre.
english: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

anywaa: Kiper ena jiera, nee obwöre moe këël nyïïkwaaye mo ööi køøre nee pwönynye ki man caathge køør dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge bëëdö ka bëëtö mo beer, ni ge tïïya tïïe ma adïëri; kiper nee gïna buua jï Eeberam nee tïïa jïre.»
english: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the Lord, to do justice and judgment; that the Lord may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Luup ajäla kiper Cødam ki Gømöra atïmö ni thööth døc, ni ö raay moge ni kathge døc.
english: And the Lord said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

anywaa: Ennø, a cøøa baŋge kuna neena geni ki man näk gïnögø ege tïïö møn ki køør luup ajäla moa wïnynya; 'ba ni näk paa adïëri, løny ki man ŋääa gø.»
english: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø rege aløkge ni aacge ni ge coonya Cødam. 'Ba Eeberam adööŋ ni poot cuŋŋö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni nyiik buute, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ka adïëri møn, jiy moa bëëtge beyø nyïmï ki moa näk tïïya raay raanynyï raanynyø na aciel bëët?
english: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

anywaa: A kanymør da jiy mo bëëtge beyø nyïmï mo jïtö ki kar pïërabïïc yi paanøgø. ?Aŋø, paac manøgø diï raanynyø ni ba wëënnï ki køør jøøgø na pïërabïïc ni bëëtge beyø nyïmï yøø?
english: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

anywaa: Ba doo løny ki man tïïyï teeŋ gïnögø na bäre bäre, ki man 'nägï jøøa näk bëëtge beyø nyïmï ki jøøa näk tïïya raay na aciel bëët; caana gø ni jiy moa näk bëëtge beyø nyïmï ki jiy moa näk temma raay iï päärö na aciel bëët. Teeŋ gïnögø ba diï tïïö na bäre bäre. ?Aŋø, ŋat wø ŋøl luup mo bäät piny bëët, bäŋ wø ŋøl luup ma karge cooth?»
english: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ni näk maa jïtö Cødam ki jiy ma pïërabïïc mo bëëtö marge beer nyïma yi päänyögø kiree, løny jïra ki man wëënna paanøgø bäre ni ba raanynya ki køørge.»
english: And the Lord said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Eeberammi ni kööe, ni «Ennø, a maaŋŋa raa ki man cääna ki ïïni, ï na Wuuö, këël na bëëde ni aana dëël ma tør na bur jaak.
english: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

anywaa: Kanymør dëët jøøgø na pïërabïïc yøø da abïïc mo tøørø. ?Aŋø, päänyögø diï raanynyø bäre kiper na tøør abïïci keerge?» Ni kööe, ni «Ba daa raanynyø ni näk maa jïtö ki pïëraŋween kurbïïc kaace.»
english: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam acäŋ cäänö jïgø, ni kööe, «?A kanymør ni näk beege pïëraŋween keerge noo joot kaace?» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Gïnögø ba tïïa kiper kwään jøøgø na pïëraŋween yøø.»
english: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aköö, ni «Wui Wuuö, beerra man ba cwat yiï, kiper a poot cäänö. ?A kanymør ni näk beege pïëradäk noo joot kaace?» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Gïnögø ba tïïa ni näk maa jïtö ki pïëradäk kaace.»
english: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Raa amaaŋŋa ki man cääna ki ï na Wuuö. ?A kanymør ni näk beege pïërariiø noo joot kaace?» Ni kööe, ni «Ba daa raanynyø kiper kwään jøøgø na pïërariiø yøø.»
english: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aköö, ni «Wui Wuuö, beerra man ba cwat yiï, naa cäänna yie man keere. ?A kanymør ni näk beege apaar noo joot kaace?» Ni kööe, ni «Ba daa raanynyø kiper kwään jøøgø na apaar yøø.»
english: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Wuuö Jwøki ki cäänö ki Eeberam, ena aay; ni ö Eeberammi ni døø kanya bëëde yie.
english: And the Lord went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwieli moa näk ariiø ni pïïcge Cødam ka abøøya ni pinynya ŋec wëëlle, ni Løøt opï piny dhi kiir Cødam. 'Ba kanya ö Løøti na joot geni, ena ö maal nee røømme ki geni, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïmge ni kuul wïïe piny.
english: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Wëëga, beerra man gääu paac mana näk mar laŋŋø maru, nou butu yie wääni, nee tietu lwøgu; køøre nø uuno møøl ni pööthu kuna cou yie.» Ni köge, ni «Bäŋ gïre, waani wa buta bura wääni.»
english: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gena møøthe døc kiree, ni putge gaa baŋe ni cige paare; ni tëën geni ki cam mo päl, ni tëëde jïge ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, ni cämge.
english: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge poot kär ci baŋ niine, cwøw mo päänyögø na näk jø Cødam bëët, ki mana täge ko obwöre këël jäle, ni beeye dhaanh pääny bäre, øtø mar Løøt amarge.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

anywaa: Ni cøørge Løøt, ni köge jïre, na «?Age jiy moa ö paarï wäär man en? Käl geni wøk baŋwa nee wa butwa ki ge.»
english: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

anywaa: 'Ba Løøt adøny wøk baŋge dhi øtø, ni cïëk dhi øtø ni cuŋŋe ni ee luk ŋääe.
english: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Jaay nyïïmera, a kwaya uuni ki man ba tïïyu teeŋ gïnögø ni raac enø.
english: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

anywaa: Kawaane ennø møn, aani jïra da nyïïa ariiø mo dëëtge poot kuc cwøwi; beerra man käla ge wøk baŋu, ni tïïyu gïna manynyu ki ge jaak, 'ba kär dee gïn tïïyu dëët jiy moi ni kany en, kiper geno nø duny paara.»
english: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, ni «Daak riï.» Ni cäŋge köö, ni «Nyeni en aö kany nee bëëde na wëëllö, 'ba kawaane ennø ree atïïe na dïŋut luup. Nyie, ennø da gïn mo tïïcwa tïïö dëërï mo raac døc mo kaala mana dewa tïïö dëët jøøge.» Køøre Løøt aputge cööyö døc ni nyiikge dhi øtø kiper nee toorge.
english: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk ariiø ceŋge arwääge wøk ni tuutge Løøt yi øtø baŋge, ni cïëkge øtø bäätge.
english: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

anywaa: Køøre jiy moa en dhi øtø atïïcge na cööye, ki mana täge ko obwöre këël jäle, ni öölge dëëtge jaak ki thäämmö ni ge manynya dhi øtø.
english: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa näk ariiø aköö jï Løøt, ni «?Da jiy mo ena kany ma jic dëërï? Cwøw nyïï, ki wäätï, ki nyïï, këël ŋat mo ena pääny man ma dhaanh dëërï jaak, bwøth geni wøk yi päänyi en;
english: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

anywaa: kiper paac man raanywa raanynyø, kiper luup ajäla moa en bäät jiy moa en yie atïmö ni thööth, ni beeye na ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ waani en nee raanywa.»
english: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the Lord; and the Lord hath sent us to destroy it.

anywaa: Ni ö Løøti ni døny wøk baŋ cwøw nyïïe moa näk manynya nywöm, ni cääne ki ge, ni kööe, «Ööu maal ni laaru aa wøk paani, kiper Wuuö Jwøk manynya man raany kany ennø.» 'Ba ki baŋ cwøw nyïïe, mare beeye kwääk jaak.
english: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ruu øwi, nyïïatwieli Løøt alacge, ni köge, «Ö maal ni laarï cïïï ki nyïï karge riedi na en buutï kany lwør, kiper nou ba rwöp ajäle mano pïï bäät paani en.»
english: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Løøti ni dwiil, eni ki cïïe ki nyïïe ceŋge amak jøøgø, ni kïthge geni wøk ŋää päänyögø, kiper mana bëëde ni mëëc Wuuö Jwøk ena bääte.
english: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the Lord being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø kïthge geni wøk, dhaanhø aciel dïge aköö, «Reŋu nø, ni gwøgu jwïëyu, kär dee ŋat lwïthi ŋääe, ni ba ruuwu gool man en këët; cou reŋŋu bäät kïte kiper nou ba rwöp ki jøøi.»
english: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

anywaa: 'Ba Løøt aköö jïge, ni «Wui wëëga, a kwaya uuni,
english: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

anywaa: ennø, met ec anø wëëgu a na laŋŋø maru, ni nyoothu mëëya dwøŋ jïra ki køør mana gwøgu jwïëya. 'Ba ba løny jïra ki man pïïa bäät kïte, kiper ränynyö mano pïï bäät paanøgø a maae maaø øtjöö, ni thøøa jaak.
english: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

anywaa: Kawaane ennø, päänyo ni thiinh enøgø kare cään ki man reŋŋa yie. Beerra man reŋŋa yie, kiper ka pääny mo thiinh, nee jwïëya gwøa yie.»
english: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwielli manøgø jï Løøt, ni «Ennø, luubö marï ajïëa; pääny mana cäänï kipere enø ba raanynya këët.
english: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

anywaa: Laar reŋ yie, kiper bäŋ gïn mo tïïa këël mano pïïyï kaace.» Kiper manøgø nø, nyeŋ pääny manøgø acwøl ni Dhöär.
english: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

anywaa: Kar kanya pïïc Løøti Dhöär, cäŋ oløny ni ena maal.
english: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk maac ki tør mo liel døc ajääŋŋe bäät Cødam ki Gømöra ni pänhnhi ki maal baŋ Wuuö Jwøk kaamar køth,
english: Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven;

anywaa: ni ö päänye moøge, ki gøli moa en kwöreke bëët, ki jøøa bëëdö yïth päänye moøgø bëët, këël gïïa näk otuy na marr yïth ŋøøpøgø, ni puti ya Wuuö Jwøki raanynyø.
english: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba cï Løøt na cäädhö ŋää cwøre alwïthö køøre ni neena kanya kälge yie; ni put talø ni teek ni dööŋ dëëre na acäbö.
english: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, Eeberam amøøl wøk ni aa kanya cuŋŋe yie nyïm Wuuö Jwøk;
english: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord:

anywaa: ni neen ya amät piny, ni joot Cødam ki Gømöra, ki gøli moa en ŋøøpøgø bëët, ni jïrö mo dwøŋ døc nyäälö bäätge ni caala jïc dwaar.
english: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki na raany päänye moøge ki gøli moge, eni wïïe kär wïl ki Eeberam, ni käl Løøt wøk ki yi paana raanynyi na bëëde yie, ni raany gø ni Løøt tøør yie.
english: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

anywaa: 'Ba Løøt, kiper mana lwäye ki bëëtö Dhöär, ena aay ki nyïïe karge riet ni bëëde bäät kïte yi øtø ma øt kïdi, ki nyïïe na näk ariiø.
english: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

anywaa: Ni kö nyaana dwøŋŋi jï coki mana thiinh, na «Awuuö anø jalø, ni bäŋ cwøw kany en mo ø nywømge nywømø kaawat man wø tïïc jiyi bëët bäät piny.
english: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

anywaa: Ööï, ø maadhø awuuö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki nee meere, kiper nøø cøø baŋe, nee wïthø nywölø wøk ka awuuö.»
english: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

anywaa: Køøre wääge aputge maath ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wäänögø, ni ö nyaana dwøŋŋi ni ci baŋ wänni, ni bäŋ gïn ŋäc wänni na bäre bäre këël mana døø wøk.
english: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, nyaana dwøŋ aköö jï coki, ni «Wääna witïni aana ci baŋ awuuö. Ennø, cäŋø eni maathø ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wääni, kiper niï ci baŋe thuwø, nee wïthø nywölø wøk ka awuuö.»
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

anywaa: Køøre wäänögø wääge acäŋge maathø ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni ci nyaana thiinhnhi baŋ wänni thuwø, ni bäŋ gïn ŋäc wänni na bäre bäre këël mana døø wøk.
english: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

anywaa: Køøre nyïï Løøt karge riet yïthge ajïtö ki jiy mo jaaya wääge.
english: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

anywaa: Ni ö nyaana dwøŋŋi ni nywøl dhaanhø na dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ wääde ni Möap; ni beeye na kwar jø Möap këël dïcäŋi ennø.
english: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

anywaa: Ni ö nyaana thiinhnhi ni nywøl dhaanhø mare na dïcwøø thuwø, ni cak nyeŋ wääde ni Ben-Ami; ni beeye na kwar jø Amön këël dïcäŋi ennø.
english: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Ben–ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam adak kanya bëëde yie, ni aae ni cøøa ŋööm Nëgëp, ni bëëde yïthakic Kadëc ki Cur, ni bëëde na wëëllö yi Gërar.
english: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

anywaa: Kanya bëëde Gërar, ena köö ni cïïe ma Ceera beeye coki. Kanyøgø Abimëlëk na näk nyeny Gërar ajääk baŋ Ceera ni lwør gø.
english: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aö bäät Abimëlëk ki yïth lääk ki wäär, ni kööe jïgø, «Ennø, kee ïïna dhaanhø mo othøw kiree, kiper dhaaŋŋøgø na lwørï enøgø beeye dhaagø mo da cwøre.»
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Abimëlëk poot bäŋ gïn mo ee tïïö ki nyijøøgø. Køøre ena köö, «?Aŋø Awuuö, paac diï raanynyø këël na bëëde ni bäŋ gïn ewa baaø?
english: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, paa Eeberam ki dëëre na caan gø jïra, ni ‹Nyaanøgø beeye coka›? Ni ö nyijøøgø thuwø ki dëëre ni caan gø, ni ‹Ena coka.› Gïna tïïa en tïïa ka cwïny mo leer, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö.»
english: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jwøk acäänö ki eni ki yïth lääk ni kööe, ni «Kare møn, gïna tïïyï enøgø, ŋääa ni tïïyï ka cwïny mo leer. 'Ba aani thuwø ïïna mäna ki man ba ciï baŋ nyaanøgø, kiper niï ba bääyï dëëra.
english: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, dwøk cï ŋatøgø jïre, kiper ena nyikuŋ Jwøk; køøre eno lämö kiperï kiper niï kwøwï. 'Ba ni näk nyaanøgø ba dwøgï, wär ŋäyï niï thøw møn, ïïni ki jø paarï bëët.»
english: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, Abimëlëk apäny maal, ni cwøl jø døøŋŋø moe bëët, ni caan gïïögø bëët ni wïnyö jïge; ni ö jøøgø ni lwäcge døc.
english: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk Eeberam acwøle, ni kööe jïgø, «?Aŋø, a teeŋ gïnaŋø na tïïyï dëëtwa en? ?A teeŋ bääyö mo nyïëdi na baaa dëërï en, ni putï kän bääta ki jø paara ki bääyö mo dwøŋ en? Ïïna tïïö dëëra ki gïn mo ba doo maar tïïc cøøn.»
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Abimëlëki köö jï Eeberam, ni «?Tiere aŋøøni na tïïyï teeŋ gïnögø kipere?»
english: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

anywaa: Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Ka adïëri møn beeye kiper mana jooda gø ni jøøi ni kany en nëëni keda jiy mo ba lwäär ki Jwøk; ni nëëni keda a 'näkge nääö jaak kiper dhaagø mara.
english: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, nyaanøgø acwøla ni coka, kiper ena nyi wära, 'ba mëëkwa kethe, køøre nø ena put tïmö na cïïa.
english: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

anywaa: Ni ki køør mana ö Jwøki ni wëëk a wääth kwör mo bäyö ki po wära, aana köö jï dhaagø mara, ni ‹Gïno tïïyï cooth niï nyootha mëër mana mëërï ki aani beeye en; kany wäro cøø yie jaak, wärï wø kööï ni aana coku.› »
english: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk akän wøk ki dïëk ki dhäk ki laaŋe ma cwøw ki mään ni mëëk geni Eeberam, ni dwøk cïïe ma Ceera jïgø.
english: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

anywaa: Ni kö Abimëlëki, ni «Neenï, ŋöömö mara ni nyïmï bäre enø; bëëdï kanya manynyï na met yiï ki gø jaak.»
english: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï Ceera, ni «Neenï, coku amooa ki gwel ma kuma kiper nee tïme na gïn mo rïëpa luubö manøgø, nee wödö marï nëëne ni mïërö nyeŋ jøøa en buutï bëët, nee ŋäc jiyi thuwø ni bäŋ gïn mo iï baaø.»
english: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam alämö jï Jwøk; ni ö Jwøki ni køny Abimëlëk ki cïïe ki laaŋe moa näk mään moe, ni ö geni ni nyöötge ko obwöre.
english: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk mään moa en po Abimëlëk bëët ee mänö ki man jïtge ko obwöre kiper mana ö Abimëlëki na lwør Ceera cï Eeberam.
english: For the Lord had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aö kuna køny Ceera kaawat mana caane, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gïna kwøŋ buuk jïgø.
english: And the Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

anywaa: Ni ö Ceera ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni jït Eeberammi ki wääde ni eno nø jalø, kar kanya caan Jwøki jïre kiree.
english: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni cak nyeŋ wääde na nywøl cïïe ma Ceera ni Aydhak.
english: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam wääde ma Aydhak adaŋe kanya tïme ni nïre abära wøk, ki køør mana köömmi ya Jwøki.
english: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Eeberammi na joot wääde ma Aydhak, cwiiye oløny na dïpa.
english: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

anywaa: Køøre Ceera aköö, ni «Jwøk aana wëëk ŋeethø, ni ŋat wäro wïny gø jaak puta ŋeethø kaamar mara.»
english: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, na «?A ŋata ŋa na doo köö jï Eeberam ni Ceera odhwödhö ki nyilaal? Kiper aana nø lwaar, ni jït Eeberammi ki wääde ni eno nø jalø.»
english: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

anywaa: Ni ö nyilaalli ni døøŋŋe ni mäni ki caak, ni ö Eeberammi ni tïme ka ajwöma mo päl døc dïcäŋa män Aydhak yie ki caak.
english: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

anywaa: 'Ba Ceera, wär Eeberam mana nywøle ki Eegar na näk nyi jø Ijep ajoode ni buuö cooth.
english: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

anywaa: Ni kö Ceera jï Eeberam, ni «Riem laŋŋøgø ki wääde, kiper nee wääde ba tïme na lwiidhø ki wääda ma Aydhak bëët.»
english: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø atïmö na gïn mo cwïny Eeberam opädhö ki gø døc kiper wääde ma Icmiel.
english: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jï Eeberam, ni «Kär cwïnyï pädhö kiper nyilaal ki menni na näk laŋŋø marï; gïno caan Ceera jïrï jaak, wär leŋï, kiper Aydhak beeye no cwøl nyeŋ nyïïkwaayï ki køøre.
english: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

anywaa: 'Ba o nyaana näk laŋŋø marï tïïa tïïö na wï jur thuwø, kiper eni käla dëërï.»
english: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

anywaa: Køøre kanya tïme na amöölla cøøn, Eeberam amøøl wøk, ni lwöte ki cam ka agwäy mar pïï ni wëëk geni Eegar, ni jiee gø göön gø, ni cïp nyilaal jïgø, ni wëëk gø wääth. Ni ö Eegarri ni aae, ni wïïre dï paap Bëërcïïba.
english: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø thum pïïyi moa en ya agwäy ki maath, Eegar nyilaal awii tier abuŋŋö aciel dï paap kaace.
english: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

anywaa: Køøre ena aay ni pï piny kany mo bäär mëëth mo bäye caala cuŋ atheerø mo othöörö, kiper mana kööe, ni «Beerra man thøw nyilaalli manøgø ni ba nëëni jïra.» 'Ba na pï piny kaace ni dïët ki nyilaal, ena tägö ki man gööe ko oduuru.
english: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni wïny dwør nyilaal ni jwöŋö thuwø; ni ö nyïïatwiel Jwøki ni cwøl Eegar ki maal, ni kööe jïgø, «?Eegar, agïnaŋø na tägö dëërï? Kärï lwäyö, kiper Jwøk dwør nyilaal awïnynye ni jwöŋö kanyo en yie enø.
english: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

anywaa: Ö maal, ni ciï ni tïŋï nyilaal maal, ni magï gø ki cerï; kiper eno tïïa na wï jur mo dwøŋ.»
english: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeŋ Eegar ajap Jwøki ni joot iith; ni cøøe ni pääŋ ya agwäy ki pïï, ni maath nyilaal ki pïï.
english: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk abëëdö ki nyilaal, ni døøŋŋe; ni bëëde dï paap, ni tïme na ŋat mo dwaar ŋääe ka atheerø.
english: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

anywaa: Ni bëëde dï paap Paran; ni nyöömmi ya menni ki dhaagø ma nyi jø Ijep.
english: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kar kaaca, Abimëlëk aöö ki Piköl ŋata näk kwääy lwaak mare, ni cääne ki Eeberam, ni kööe, ni «Jwøk ena buutï ki ri jammi bëët mo wø tïïyï.
english: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man kööŋï nyïma ki nyeŋ Jwøk, ki man ba tïïï ka atade dëëra, ki røk wääta këël røk nyïïkwaaya bëët; 'ba ki køør bäth ec mana nyoodha jïrï, bäth ec diï nyoodhø jïra thuwø, këël jï paan bëëdï yie ni ïïna wëëllö enø.»
english: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

anywaa: Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Wøp, aana kööŋ.»
english: And Abraham said, I will swear.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam luubö mør mo obøth apare jï Abimëlëk, kiper gïna tïïc jiyi mo Abimëlëk na dwøcge iith.
english: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.

anywaa: Ni kö Abimëlëki, ni «Aani ŋata tïïc gïnögø kuua; kiper kärï caanø jïra, beeye wïnynye jïra dïcäŋi ennø.»
english: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam alwötö ki dïëk ki dhäk, ni mëëk geni Abimëlëk; ni ö geni karge riet ni tutge ki luubö.
english: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni cïp nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma mädhi kur keerge mo lwøre ri pïïth dïëk moe.
english: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba Abimëlëk aköö jï Eeberam, na «?Aŋø, nyïïrööm moi na mädhi ni iï cïp kur keerge na abïriiø ii, tiere agïnaŋø?»
english: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

anywaa: Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Nyïïrööm moi na abïriiø na mädhi ii lwørï lwørø cera, nee tïme ni beeye nyuudhi kiper iith mana näk yaa koonyø kany, nee ŋäc ni koonya aani.»
english: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, kaace acwøl Eeberammi ni Bëërcïïba, kiper kaace beeye kanya öge ni kööŋge yie karge riedi.
english: Wherefore he called that place Beer–sheba; because there they sware both of them.

anywaa: Kanya nø tutge ki luubö Bëërcïïba, Abimëlëk ki Piköl na näk kwääy lwaak mare aö maal ni døøge yi ŋööm Pilitin.
english: Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam apïïdhö ki jaath mo cwøl ni temïr Bëërcïïba, ni wøør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk kaace, na näk Jwø wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba, and called there on the name of the Lord, the everlasting God.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni bëëde ki nïne mo thööth na wëëllö yi ŋööm jø Pilitin.
english: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør gïïögø bëët, Jwøk Eeberam apääre, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nyie Eeberam.» Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Aani en.»
english: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Ennø, lwør wäädï ma Aydhak na näk aciel keere, na mëërï ki gø, ni ciï ŋööm Möria; ni cïpï gø no olämi man wø waaŋ bäät kïdi aciel mano caana jïrï røk kïte moo en kaace.»
english: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, Eeberam aö maal ni jiiŋ jammi bäät arëën mare, ni lwöte ki jiy ariiø røk jø tïïc moe, ni lwør wääde ma Aydhak; ni kääe ki jenni mo waaŋ olämi ki gø, ni ö maal ni ci kanya caan Jwøki jïre.
english: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne, Eeberam alwïthö nyïme, ni joot kanyøca ki kany mo bäär.
english: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aköö jï jaga näk ariiø, ni «Dööŋŋu kany ka arëën, nee aani ki nyilaal nee wa ciwa kuna wøørwa nyeŋ Jwøk kaace; køøre waano duu baŋu.»
english: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni lwør jenni mo waaŋ olämi ki gø, ni cïp ge göön wääde ma Aydhak, ni lwør maac ki caakïïn ni käär ge ki cere, ni putge aay na aciel karge riedi.
english: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak acäänö ki wänni ma Eeberam ni kööe, na «Awuuö.» Ni kö wänni, ni «Aani en, wääda.» Ni kö Aydhaki, ni «Ennø, maac ki jenni nutö. ?'Ba age nyidiel mano cïp no olämi man wø waaŋ?»
english: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

anywaa: Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Nyie wääda, Jwøk ki dëëre cïpö ki nyidiel mano waaŋ no olämi.» Køøre gena put aay na aciel karge riedi.
english: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø pïïcge kanya näk ocaan Jwøki, Eeberam atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämi bääte kaace, ni peeth jenni na karge, ni twöc wääde ma Aydhak, ni pïël gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämi bääte bäät jenni maal.
english: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam cere arwaak baŋ caakïïn ni lwør gø nee wääde ŋaale.
english: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk acwötö ki maal ni kööe, ni «Eeberam! Eeberam!» Ni kö Eeberammi, ni «Aani en.»
english: And the angel of the Lord called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwielli, ni «Kär cerï ŋaapï bäät nyilaal; kär dee gïn mo tïïyï dëëre, kiper kawaane ennø møn, aŋääa niï lwäär ki Jwøk, kiper wäädï ma aciel keere kärï mänö ki aani.»
english: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam wïïe atïŋ maal ni lwïthe, ni joot nywø røømmø ni tuge omak abuŋŋö; ni ö Eeberammi ni cøøe ni lwør nywø røømmø manøgø, ni ŋaal gø ni cïp gø no olämi man wø waaŋ na kar wääde.
english: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam nyeŋ kanyøgø aput cwøl ni «Wuuö Jwøk cïpö,» kaawat man poot caani dïcäŋi en, ni «Bäät kïdi manøgø, Wuuö Jwøk cïpö yie.»
english: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the Lord it shall be seen.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, Eeberam acäŋ cwøllø ki maal ri rietge,
english: And the angel of the Lord called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper gïna tïïyï enøgø, ni kärï wäädï ma aciel keere mänö,
english: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the Lord, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

anywaa: aana kööŋ ŋëëta keera ki man gwïëdha ïïni døc kiree, ni tïïa nyïïkwaayï nee nyaacge ni caala ceer mo maal, ni caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ; ni ö nyïïkwaayï ni maanyge mïëc nyïïmänge.
english: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

anywaa: Ni ö wïth juurre mo bäät piny bëët ni gwïëdhi ki køør nyïïkwaayï, kiper mana leŋï dwøra.› »
english: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam adøø baŋ jaga näk ariiø, ni öge maal ni aacge na aciel ni ge døøa Bëërcïïba; ni ö Eeberammi ni put bëëdö Bëërcïïba.
english: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør gïïögø bëët, luup møøk acaan jï Eeberam, ni køp, ni «Milka cï coku ma Neeyör anyöödö ko obwöre, ni jït coku ko obwöre;
english: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

anywaa: ni beege Uc na näk kaa, ki coki ma Buc, ki Këmuël wää Aram,
english: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

anywaa: ki Ködhat, ki Adhö, ki Pildac, ki Jitlap, ki Batuël.»
english: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

anywaa: Ni ö Batuëlli ni nywøl nyaare ma Rebëëka. Jøøgø na abära yøø beege wäät Neeyör cok Eeberammi na nywøl Milka.
english: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre mo Neeyör moa nywøl dhaaŋŋa näk kwanynyø, na näk nyeŋŋe Rëëma, beege Theba, ki Gaam, ki Taac, ki Maika.
english: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Ceera bëët beege cwiiri ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka abïriiø.
english: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

anywaa: Køøre Ceera athøø Kiriat-Arba na näk Keeprön yi ŋööm Keenan; ni ö Eeberammi ni jwøk cïïe ma Ceera ni kïmme kipere.
english: And Sarah died in Kirjath–arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aö maal ki bäät thøø ni ci baŋ jø Këth, ni cääne ki ge, ni kööe,
english: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

anywaa: ni «Aani a bëëdö buutu kany ni aana wëëllö naa path; cïpu jïra ki ŋøøm buutu kany mo kunynya yie, kiper nee dëër dhaanhø mana thøw ice kana yie, nee ba raŋŋa këët.»
english: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

anywaa: Køøre aløk jø Këthi jï Eeberam, ni köge,
english: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

anywaa: ni «Kwäärö, wïny marwa; ïïna dhaanhø mo karï dwøŋ døc buutwa kany; kan dhaanhø mana näk othøw yi kää mana näk ojierø na beerra eni døc røk kääk moa näk mowa; bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïwa kany mo kää mare mäne mänö ki ïïni ki man kanï dëër dhaanhø mana näk othøw yie.»
english: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam aö maal ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm wëëk ŋøømmi na näk jø Këth.
english: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

anywaa: Ni cääne ki geni, ni kööe, «Ni näk mo uuno jïëy ki man kana dëër dhaanhø mana näk othøw, nee ba raŋŋa këët, wïnynyu mara; pëënynyu Ëprön wär Dhöar jïra,
english: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

anywaa: kiper nee kään kïdi mana näk mare, na en cuŋ pwöthe na en Makpila, nee cïbe jïra nyïmmu kany, kiper nee gäte bäre cïba jïre, nee tïme na kany kunynya yie.»
english: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø Ëprön nutö dï jø poge ma jø Këth; ni ö Ëprönni nyï Këth ni dwøk gø jï Eeberam ni wïnyö jï jø Këth bëët, ni beege jøøa näk öö kar acooŋa mar pääny poge, ni kööe,
english: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwäärö, beerra man wïnynyï mara; pwödhö manøgø ki kään kïdi mana en yie acïba jïrï bëët. Acïba jïrï møn nyïm jø powa bëët; kan dëër dhaanhø mana näk othøw yie.»
english: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam wïïe aput kuul piny nyïm wëëk ŋøømmi.
english: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

anywaa: Ni cääne ki Ëprön ni wïnyö jï wëëk ŋøømmi, ni kööe, ni «Ni näk mo mara wïnynyï wïnynyö nø, doo beer; aani gät pwödhö manøgø cïba cïbö jïrï; jïëyï ki man lwørï gäte baŋa, kiper nee dëër dhaanhø mana näk othøw kana yie kaace.»
english: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

anywaa: Ni ö Ëprönni ni løk gø jï Eeberam, ni kööe jïgø,
english: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

anywaa: ni «Kwäärö, wïny mara nø; gät thäk ŋøøm moøgø doo rømø ki gwel ma dïpe aŋween keerge. ?Aŋø, da gïn mo ø doo pïëmö ki ïïni kipere cøøn? Kan dëër dhaanhø mana näk othøw yie.»
english: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam dwør Ëprön aleŋe; ni ö Eeberammi ni put gwel-bïrö røm nyïm jø Këth kaa mana caani Ëprönni ni wïnyö jïge bëët, ni beege gwel ma dïpe aŋween, ki køør rumi man wø rum jø gathi ki gø.
english: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

anywaa: Køøre pwöth Ëprön na en Makpila, na näk dïët ki Mamrë, pwöthögø bäre ki kään kïdi mana en yie, ki jenni moa en yie bëët, aci jï Eeberam,
english: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

anywaa: ni put tïmö na mare nyïm jø Këth, jøøa näk oci kar acooŋa bëët mar päänyögø.
english: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

anywaa: Køøre nø, Eeberam cïïe ma Ceera akan yi kään kïnna en Makpila na näk dïët ki Mamrë, na näk Keeprön na en yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: Ni ö pwöthögø ki kään kïdi mana en yie bëët, ni ci jï Eeberam ni tïme na kany kuny yie buut jø Këth.
english: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam atïmö na jaal ni cwiiri moe thööth døc, ni eno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
