anywaa: Kanyøgø Eeberam acäänö ki ŋat tïïc mare mana dwøŋŋa eni dï jø paare, na en jammi moe bëët cere, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Beerra man cïbï cerï bäät ääma,
english: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

anywaa: kiper a manynya ïïni niï kööŋï ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal ki piny, ki man ba nyöömmï wääda ki dhaagø røk nyïïakuk Keenan ni bëëda dïge en;
english: And I will make thee swear by the Lord, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

anywaa: 'ba ï doo cøøa powa baŋ tuuŋwa, ni kännï ki dhaagø jï wääda ma Aydhak.»
english: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

anywaa: Køøre ŋat tïïc aköö jï Eeberam, «?A ni näk mo dhaaŋŋøca ba jïëy ki man öwa ki gøøni pööthi, wäädï wär lwøra ni dwøga gø pou kanya ööï ki yie?»
english: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

anywaa: Ni kö Eeberammi jïgø, ni «Ba doo løny na bäre bäre ki man dwøgï wääda kunöce.
english: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal, ŋata käl aani wøk ki po wära yïth ŋøøpa nywøl aani yie, na cäänö na buŋ aani na köö, ni ‹Ŋöömö man omëëga nyïïkwaayï,› eni ki dëëre nyïïatwiel maal mare jääŋŋe jääŋŋö nyïmï, ni ö ïïni ni jïtï ki dhaagø jï wääda kaace.
english: The Lord God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaaŋŋøca ba jïëy ki man ööu ki gøøni, kööŋ mana wëëga ï kööŋ ki gø otïmö ni ba en bäätï këët. 'Ba wääda keere kär niï dwøga gø kunöce.»
english: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋat tïïc cere acïp bäät ääm kwääye ma Eeberam ni kööŋe jïgø kiper luummögø.
english: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

anywaa: Køøre ŋat tïïc alwötö ka athïrööle apaar røk athïrööle mo kwääye, ni lwør jammi moa beyø beyø røk jap kwääye, ni tïŋŋe ni ci Mecöpatemia, ni pïïe pääny mana bëët Neeyörri yie.
english: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni wëëk athïrööle but piny buut iith ŋää paac wøk. 'Ba kar kanyøca piny oløny na abøøya, ni beeye kar kany wø um määnni ki pïï.
english: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwø kwääya ma Eeberam, a kwaya ïïni ki man wëëgï gïna ööa kipere thur kare jïra dïcäŋi, ni nyoothï mëëyï ni wø ba jøøl jï kwääya ma Eeberam.
english: And he said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

anywaa: Ennø, a cuŋŋa lak iith, ni nyïïakuk paani ööa wøk kuna umge ki pïï.
english: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

anywaa: 'Ba nyakøønno kööa ki gø, ni ‹Cïp daaï piny ni mooyï aani ki pïï naa mätha,› ni duunne jïra, ni kööe, ni ‹Mäthï, na athïrööle moï maadha thuwø,› beerra man tïm nyakøønneca ni beeye dhaaŋŋa jierï jï dhaanhnhï ma Aydhak. Ni näk mo teeŋ gïnögø tïmö na kare, puta ka ŋäc møn ni mëëyï ni wø ba jøøl iï nyoodhø jï kwääya.»
english: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni eni poot cäänö, Rebëëka nyi Batuël o Milka aput öö ni dak mare kääre ka göönne. 'Ba Milka beeye cï Neeyör cöök Eeberammi.
english: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

anywaa: Rebëëka beeye nyakøø mo kïte mïërö døc mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue. Ena ci yi iith ni pääŋ daae ki pïï ni duu wøk.
english: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋat tïïc aput reŋ baŋ gø kuna røømge ki gø, ni kööe, na «A kwaya ïïni naa mätha ki pïï mo thenh yi daaï.»
english: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

anywaa: Ni kö Rebëëka, «Mäthï nø, Awuuö.» Ni ö Rebëëka ni put dak mare jøl ki cere, ni mooc ŋatøgø ki pïï mo maadhe.
english: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lønye ki mooc ŋatøgøøni ki pïï, ena köö, na «A døøa kuna umma ki pïï jï athïrööle moï thuwø këël mano rømge bëët ki maath.»
english: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

anywaa: Køøre pïï moa en yi dak alaar køny yi pöö yi gïn wø mäth dhäki yie, ni laar døø bäät iith kuna umme ki pïï, ni tööm athïrööle moe bëët ki pïï.
english: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø bëëdö ni lïŋö jaak ni neeta jï nyaanøgø, kiper eni manynya man ŋäc gø ki man näk wääth mare owëëk Wuuö Jwøki thur kare wala jïre bäär.
english: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny athïrööle ki maath pïï, ŋatøgø akän wøk ki gwel warkey mo peek mare thääŋ rumi, ni kän wøk thuwø ko oguudi ariiø mo warkey mo peek marge jïtö ki rumme apaar, kiper nee kïth ceŋŋe.
english: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

anywaa: Ni pëëny gø, ni kööe, ni «?Ïïna nyi ŋa?» Ni cäŋ gø pëënynyö, ni «?Da kany mo wa røma yie yi øt wäru kiper kar niine? Beerra man caanï gø jïra.»
english: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father's house for us to lodge in?

anywaa: Ni kö nyaanøgø jïgø, ni «Aana nyi Batuël, Batuël o Milka na nywølge ki Neeyör.»
english: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyaanøgø köö, ni «Jïwa da luum mo orømø ki cam mar lääy, ki kar niine thuwø.»
english: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋatøgø wïïe akuul piny ni wøør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwääya ma Eeberam. Eni adïëri mare ki mëëye ni wø ba jøøl käre paanyø bäät kwääya. Eni thuwø aana bwødhe ni kïth aani yi øt jø tuuŋ kwääya.»
english: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master's brethren.

anywaa: Køøre Rebëëka areŋ paac ni caan gïïögø bëët jï menni ki jøøa en buute.
english: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother's house these things.

anywaa: 'Ba Rebëëka jïre da coki ma dïcwøø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Leeban. Kanyøgø Leeban areŋ wøk baŋ ŋatøgø bäät iith,
english: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

anywaa: ni ci baŋ gø kanya joot gwel warkey ko oguudi ceŋ coki ma Rebëëka, ni wïny luup thuwø moa caan coki kiper luupa caan ŋatøce jïre; ni ö Leeban ni joot ŋatøgø ni cuŋŋö buut athïrööle bäät iith.
english: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister's hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

anywaa: Ni kö Leeban, ni «Ööï, ø aa paayø, ïïni no ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki en. ?Aŋø ni cuŋŋï wøk en? Aani øtø yaa nø jiiŋŋø jïrï, këël kar athïrööle thuwø yaa nø jiiŋŋø.»
english: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the Lord; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋatøgø aci paayø, ni ö Leeban ni pät jammi wøk bäät athïrööle, ni mooc geni ki luum mo otal ki gïï wø cam lääyi. Ni mooc ŋatøce ki pïï mo lwøk tiete ki ge, ni mooc jøøa cäädhö ki eni thuwø ki pïï mo lwøkge tietge ki ge.
english: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cïp gïn cam nyïme kiper nee cäme, ena köö, ni «Aani a ba laar cam dituru, këël mano caana tier gïna ööa kipere jïïu.» Ni kö Leeban, ni «Caanï nø.»
english: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Aani, aana ŋat tïïc mar Eeberam.
english: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, kwääya ma Eeberam ee gwïëdhö døc, ni tïme na dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ, ni mooc gø ki dïëk ki dhäk ki warkey ki jø tïïc ma cwøw ki mään ka athïrööle ka arëëni.
english: And the Lord hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

anywaa: Ni ö Ceera cï kwääya ni nyöötge ki kwääya ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø ni eno nø jalø. Ni ö Eeberammi ni cïp jammi bëët moa en jïre jï wääde.
english: And Sarah my master's wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääya aana wëëk kööŋ, ni kööe, ni ‹Wääda ba diï nyöömmö røk nyïïakuk Keenan, paan bëëda yie en,
english: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

anywaa: 'ba ï doo cøøa po wära baŋ tuuŋwa ni kännï ki dhaagø jï wääda.›
english: But thou shalt go unto my father's house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

anywaa: «Køøre aana köö jï kwääya, ‹?A ni näk ma nyakøønnaca ba jïëy ki man öwa ki gø?›
english: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

anywaa: «Køøre ena köö jïra, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, ŋata bëëda naa caatha køøre, nyïïatwiel maal mare ojääŋŋe ki ïïni kiper nee gïna aayï kipere wëëk thur kare, ni kännï ki dhaagø jï wääda røk tuuŋwa na näk jø po wära;
english: And he said unto me, The Lord, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father's house:

anywaa: køøre kar kaaca nø, kööŋ mara tïmö ni ba en bäätï këët; kiper no ciï baŋ tuuŋwa, no ba cïpge dhaagø jïrï, kööŋ mara tïmö ni tøør bäätï këët.›
english: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

anywaa: «Ni beeye tiere ennø ni ööa bäät iith dïcäŋi en, ni kööa, ni ‹Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwääya ma Eeberam, ni näk mo tier gïna ööa kipere wëëgï thur kare nø,
english: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O Lord God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:

anywaa: ennø, a cuŋŋa bäät iith; beerra man ö nyakøønno ummi ki pïï no cääna ki gø no kwaa, ni «Mooc aani ki pïï mo thiinh yi dak marï mo maadha,»
english: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

anywaa: ni løk gø jïra, ni «Mäthï; aano ummi thuwø jï athïrööle moï;» beerra man tïm nyakøønnaca ni beeye mana jier Wuuö Jwøki jï o kwääya.›
english: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the Lord hath appointed out for my master's son.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya poode naa poot cäänö ki yi cwïnya, Rebëëka aput öö ni dak mare kääre ka göönne, ni ci yi iith ni töömme ki pïï. Ni kööa jïre, na ‹A kwaya ïïni, mooc aani ki pïï mo maadha.›
english: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

anywaa: «Ni ö eni ni laar dak mare jiee piny, ni kööe, ni ‹Mäthï; athïrööle moï thuwø omaadha.› Kanyøgø aana mäthö, ni ö eni ni maath athïrööle thuwø.
english: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

anywaa: «Køøre ena pëënynya, ni kööa, ni ‹?Ïïna nyi ŋa?› «Ni kööe, ni ‹Aana nyi Batuël o Neeyör na nywøle ki cïïe ma Milka.› «Kanyøgø gwelø aputa kïth ume ni kïtha oguudi ceŋŋe,
english: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

anywaa: ni kuulla wïïa piny ni wøøra nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøa Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø kwääya ma Eeberam na bwøth aani ki øtjöö ma kare ki man jïta ki nyakøø røk tuuŋ kwääya jï wääde.
english: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the Lord, and blessed the Lord God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master's brother's daughter unto his son.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ni näk mo gïn mo beer ki gïn ma adïëri tïïyu tïïö kiper kwääya, wala ba tïïyu, wär caannu jïra nee ŋääa, kiper nee gïna daa tïïö nee ŋääa.»
english: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban ki Batuël marge acaange, ni köge, ni «Gïnögø käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba ennø, bäŋ gïn mør mo caanwa jïrï këët.
english: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the Lord: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

anywaa: Ennø, Rebëëka nutö nyïmï. Lwørï ni aayï ki gøøni, nee tïme na cï o kwääyï, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master's son's wife, as the Lord hath spoken.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋat tïï Eeberammi na wïny luup moa caan jøøgø, wïïe akuul piny ni wøør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham's servant heard their words, he worshipped the Lord, bowing himself to the earth.

anywaa: Køøre ena kän wøk ki jap warkey ka abïïe ni wëëk ge Rebëëka. Ni mooc mii Rebëëka thuwø ki coki ki jammi mo perge leth.
english: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

anywaa: Køøre eni ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni bëët gena cämö ni mäthge, ni butge kaace. 'Ba kanya päcge ka amöölla, ena köö, ni «Wëëgu aani wääth, naa døøa baŋ kwääya.»
english: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

anywaa: 'Ba cöök Rebëëka ki menni aköö, ni «Beerra man dööŋ nyilaalli ki waani dituru ki nïne mo nøk jaak mo jïtö ki kar apaar, køøre nø eno ööi.»
english: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat tïï Eeberam aköö jïge, ni «Kär aani gaalu këët; kiper Wuuö Jwøk gïna ööa kipere anø wëëk thur kare. Wëëgu aani wääth kiper naa døøa baŋ kwääya.»
english: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the Lord hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena köö, ni «Nyilaal cwølwa cwølø, na acaara mare pëënywa dituru.»
english: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

anywaa: Køøre Rebëëka acwølge, ni pëënyge gø, ni köge, ni «?Ï aay ki ŋati?» Ni løk gø, na «A aay ki gøøni.»
english: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyige ma Rebëëka ki ŋat tïïc mare na pïr gø aputge wec nee aacge ki ŋat tïï Eeberam ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni bëët.
english: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his men.

anywaa: Ni gwïëthge nyige ma Rebëëka, ni köge, «Nya nyiwa, ïïno tïmö na mii jiyi ma kum kum, ni ö nyïïkwaayï ni maanyge mïëc nyïïmän moge.»
english: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

anywaa: Køøre Rebëëka atïŋŋö ki nyïïakuue moa näk jø tïïc moe, ni ge cäädhi ka bäät athïrööle, ni cige køør ŋat tïïc mar Eeberam; ni ö ŋat tïïci mar Eeberam ni käl Rebëëka ni aacge.
english: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø Aydhak onø duuö ki Bëër-Laay-Röi, kiper kar bëëtö mare ena Nëgëp.
english: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋcäŋ aciel ka abøøya ena cääth yi pwöla ni cädö ki cwïnye. 'Ba na tïŋ wïïe maal, ena lwïthö ni joot athïrööle ni cäänhnhö.
english: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Rebëëka na lwïthe, Aydhak ajoode, ni put ïnh piny ki bäät athïrööl.
english: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

anywaa: Ni pëëny ŋat tïïc mar Eeberam, ni kööe, na «?Aŋa ni cäänhnhi ice dï pwöla ni ö kun røømme ki øøni?» Ni kö ŋat tïïci, ni «Beeye kwääya.» Kanyøgø Rebëëka abïï mare alwøre ni loop wïïe ni bøøny dëëre bäre.
english: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a veil, and covered herself.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat tïïc gïïa tïïe bëët acaane jï Aydhak.
english: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak Rebëëka alwøre ni kïth gø yo oduŋkaany menni ma Ceera, ni put tïmö na dhaagø mare ni mëër ki gø. Køøre Aydhak ajïtö ki cøm cwïny køør thøw menni ma Ceera.
english: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam acäŋ määnyö ki dhaagø mør mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Këthura.
english: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

anywaa: Ni ö nyaanøgø ni nyöötge ko obwöre ki Eeberam, ni beege Dhemran, ki Jökcan, ki Mëdan, ki Midien, ki Ecbök, ki Cuwëk.
english: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

anywaa: Ni ö Jökcanni ni nyööde ki wääte mo nyeŋge cwøl ni Cïïba ki Didan. Ni wäät Didan beege jø Acör, ki jø Lethuca, ki jø Lewuma.
english: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

anywaa: Ni wäät Midien beege Gëpër, ki Ëpër, ki Anök, ka Abida, ki Eldaa. Jøøgø bëët beege jiy moa käl dëër Këthura.
english: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam gïïa en jïre bëët awii cer wääde ma Aydhak;
english: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

anywaa: 'ba wääte moa nywøle kööth määre moa na akwanya amooe ki muuce, ni wëëk geni wääth; ni cige yïth ŋøøm moa en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni bëëtge ni karge bäyö ki wääde ma Aydhak. Gïïögø bëët tïïe kanya poode ni eni poot kwøw.
english: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Eeberammi beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïërabïriiø kurbïïc.
english: And these are the days of the years of Abraham's life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

anywaa: Køøre ena thøw ni ena dhaanhø mo ojal ki jalø ma wøp, na jaal mo bëëtö ee pwøø wøk; ni put läp køør jø poge.
english: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

anywaa: Ni ö wääte na näk Aydhak ki Icmiel ni koonyge wääge yi kään kïnna en Makpila, yi pwöth Ëprön o Dhöar na näk nyï Këth, kanya näk dïët ki Mamrë.
english: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

anywaa: Ni beeye pwötha ŋeew Eeberammi baŋ jø Këth; ni put Eeberam koony yie kaace buut cïïe ma Ceera.
english: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

anywaa: 'Ba køør thøw Eeberam, Jwøk Aydhak wär Eeberam agwïëdhe; ni ö Aydhaki ni bëëde buut iith mana cwøl ni Laay-Röi.
english: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Icmiel, wär Eeberam mana nywøle kö Eegar nyi jø Ijep, na näk laŋ Ceera;
english: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

anywaa: ni nyeŋ wäät Icmiel, na cak ki køør nyöödö mana nywøl ge ki gø, beege Nebayöt na näk kany Icmiel, ki Këdar, ki Adebiel, ki Mepcam,
english: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

anywaa: ki Macma, ki Duma, ki Maca,
english: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

anywaa: ki Adat, ki Tëma, ki Jetur, ki Napëc, ki Këdema.
english: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

anywaa: Moøgø beege nyeŋ wäät Icmiel, ki køør mïëcge ki twëëre moge, ni gena kwääri apaar kurriiø mo wïth tuŋi moge.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Icmielli beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø; ni thøøe, ni put läp køør jø poge.
english: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaaye abëëdö yaakic Ëwlath ki Cur, løø Ijep jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, jöö mana näk pöötha Aciria; ni putge bëëtö ni geno pääö ki tuuŋge.
english: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Aydhak wär Eeberam. Eeberam Aydhak anywøle.
english: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son: Abraham begat Isaac:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Aydhaki ni cwiiye pïëraŋween, Rebëëka nyi Batuël na näk nyï Aram, paana en Padan-Aram, anywøme. Rebëëka beeye cöök Leeban na näk nyï Aram thuwø.
english: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan–aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper cïïe, kiper cïïe jïre bäŋ obwöre mo ee nywølø; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny lam mare, ni jït yi cïïe ma Rebëëka ki dhaanhø.
english: And Isaac entreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was entreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre atïmö ni ge cäbö yi Rebëëka; ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, a teeŋ gïnaŋø no otägö dëëra en?» Køøre ena aay ni läme ni pëëny Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïre, ni «Jiy ma wïth juurre ariiø beege ni en yiï yøø; ni jiy ariiø moøge onywølï, ni bëëtge ni dëëtge ege pääŋŋö; ni ö acielli dëëtge ni tïme ni teeka eni døc ki maya; ni ö mana dwøŋŋi ni tïny mana thiinh.»
english: And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kar lwaar mare kiree, ena put lwaar ko obwöre ma cïp Jwøk.
english: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

anywaa: Ni mana kwøŋ ö wøk kwaar ni dëëre da jïër; ni cakge nyeŋ gø ni Icøø.
english: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

anywaa: Køøre cään coki alwaarø ki gøøni, ni ö wøk no opuny Icøø ee maaø ki cere, ni cakge nyeŋ gø ni Jeekap. 'Ba kar kanya ö Rebëëka na nywøl obwöre moøgø, Aydhak cwiiye oløny na pïërabïciel.
english: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøŋ obwöre moøgø, Icøø atïmö na dhaanhø mo dwaar ŋääe døc kiree, ni put bëëdö na ŋat paap. 'Ba Jeekap ena dhaanhø mo yie ee cïp piny jaak, ni bëëdö paac cooth.
english: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydhak mëër ki Icøø døc ni kaala Jeekap, kiper yie met ki rïŋ mo wø käle jïre ki baŋ dwaar ni wø came. 'Ba Rebëëka mëër ka Jeekap døc ni kaala Icøø.
english: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ aciel ni Jeekap otëëdö ki kadø, Icøø aöö ki paap ni eno näk käci;
english: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

anywaa: ni kö Icøø jï Jeekap, na «A mooc ki gïno kwaar enøgø nee weedha, kiper aano näk käci.» Kiper manøgø nø nyeŋŋe acwøl ni Ëdöm.
english: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap aköö, ni «Kwøŋ dööŋö marï ŋeew ki aani dïkwøŋ.»
english: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

anywaa: Ni kö Icøø, ni «Ennø, kara oløny ni cään ki man thøøa. ?Aŋø, dööŋö mara oduu ŋø jïra cøøn?»
english: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Kwøŋ kööŋ dïkwøŋ nø;» ni put kööŋ, ni ŋeew dööŋö mare ki Jeekap.
english: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap Icøø amooe ki cam ki kat adaci; ni cäme ni mäthe ki pïï, ni ö maal ni aae, ni gïr dööŋö mare ee taaø jaak.
english: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

anywaa: 'Ba meel mør acäŋ tägö bäät piny, køør meel mana kwøŋ tägö yïth nïra beet Eeberammi. Køøre Aydhak aa Gërar po Abimëlëk nyeny jø Pilitin.
english: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth ree jï Aydhak, ni kööe, ni «Kär niï cøøa Ijep; bëëdï yi ŋöömmo caana jïrï en.
english: And the Lord appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

anywaa: Pï piny yi ŋöömmi, ni bëëdï ni ïïna wëëllö; 'ba aano en buutï ni gwïëdha ïïni, kiper ŋöömö man bäre en ocïba jïrï ki nyïïkwaayï, ni wëëga kööŋ mana kööŋa ki gø jï wäru ma Eeberam thur kare.
english: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

anywaa: Ni tïïa nyïïkwaayï nee nyaacge ni caala ceer mo maal, ni wëëga ŋöömö man bäre en geni; ni ö wïth juurre mo bäät piny bëët ni gwïëdhi ki køørge.
english: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët otïïa kiper mana ö Eeberammi na leŋ dwøra ni gwøk luupa, ki ciik 'moa, ki gïïa cema ki pwöc 'moa bëët.»
english: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak aput bëëdö Gërar.
english: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø paanøgø na pëënyge eni kiper cïïe, ena köö, ni «Nyaanøgø beeye coka,» kiper ena lwäyö ki man caan gø ni cïïe, kiper ee caarø ni kanymør jø paanøgø eni 'näkge nääö jaak kiper Rebëëka na kïte mïërö.
english: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø bëëde kaace ki kany mo bäär mëëth, Abimëlëk nyeny jø Pilitin alwïthö wøk ki dha awëërnyeŋ, ni joot Aydhak ni kwääk ki cïïe ma Rebëëka.
english: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk Aydhak acwøle, ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, nyaani en beeye cïïï. ?Aperŋø na kööï ni ena coku?» Ni kö Aydhaki jïre, ni «Beeye kiper mana caara gø ni kanymør naa di nääö jaak kipere.»
english: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

anywaa: Ni kö Abimëlëki, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïyï dëëtwa en? A kanymør nø, doo da dhaanhø aciel røk jøøi mo ci baŋ cïïï na dhaagø; ni tïme ni beeye ïïni na doo käl ajäla manøgøøni kiree bäätwa.»
english: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk jiye bëët aceme, ni kööe, ni «Ŋato gut nyenøgø jaak wala cïïe, ŋatøca wär thøøe.»
english: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydhak apurö yi ŋöömmögø, ni ciek caammi jïre døc cwiinaca. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni gwïëth eni,
english: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.

anywaa: ni tïme na kwäärö døc, ni ö kwärri mare ni meet ree, ni put tïmö ni cäätha maal;
english: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

anywaa: kiper eni jïre da pïïth dïëk ki pïïth dhäk ki jø tïïc mo thööth. 'Ba jø Pilitin cwïnyge ajïtö ki keec ki eni.
english: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Pilitinni ni dïïrge ïïdhi moa näk okoony jø tïïci mo wänni ma Eeberam yïth nïra beede, ni pääŋge ge ki ŋøøm.
english: For all the wells which his father's servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk aköö jï Aydhak, ni «Aayï buutwa kany, kiper atïmö ni teeka ïïni døc ki waani.»
english: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

anywaa: Ni ö Aydhaki ni put kaagø wec, ni aae ni tïïc twïër mare yi goor Gërar, ni bëëde kaace.
english: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak ïïdhi mo pïï moa näk okoonyø yïth nïra beet wänni ma Eeberam acäŋ koonynyø, kiper mana näk odïïr jø Pilitin køør thøw Eeberam; ni cwøl ge ki nyeŋ moa dïkwøŋ na cøøri wänni ki ge.
english: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø tïïci mo Aydhak na kunyge yi gool mana en kaace, gena jïtö ki iith mo cwïër.
english: And Isaac's servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kwaathi mo Gërar ni pïëmge ki jø kwaath mo Aydhak, ni köge, ni «Pïï moi mowa.» Køøre Aydhak nyeŋ iith manøgø acwøle ni Ëcëk, kiper na pïëm jøøgø ki eni.
english: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

anywaa: Køøre gena cäŋ kunyö ki iith mør, ni cäŋge pïëm kipere thuwø, ni cwøl nyeŋ gø ni Citna.
english: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

anywaa: Ni daak ree kaace ni kuny jiye ki iith mør, 'ba ge kär pïëmö kipere këët; ni cwøl nyeŋ gø ni Rööböth, kiper ena köö, ni «Ennø, Wuuö Jwøk acïpö jïïø ki kany mo laac; øøno nyaai yi ŋöömmi nø.»
english: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the Lord hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak aay kaace ni ci Bëërcïïba.
english: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth ree jïre yi wäänögø kiree, ni kööe, ni «Aana Jwø wäru ma Eeberam; kärï lwäyö, kiper a ena buutï. Ïïno gwïëdha, ni meeda nyïïkwaayï ni nyaacge ki køør dhaanhnha ma Eeberam.»
english: And the Lord appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace, ni wøør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni gur oduŋkaare moe piny kaace; ni ö jø tïïci moe ni kunyge ki iith kaace.
english: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk aö baŋ Aydhak ki paare na näk Gërar, ni bee eni ki nyinyïme ma Aköjath, ki Piköl ŋata näk kwääy lwaak mare.
english: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

anywaa: Ni kö Aydhaki jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø na öömu baŋa, ni uuno nø männö ki aani, ni riemmu aani buutu?»
english: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, na «Ajootwa møn ka adïëri ni Wuuö Jwøk ena buutï; ni beeye ni köwa ennø, ni beerra man kööŋø yïthakiyø ki ïïni, nee ø tudø ki luubö ki ïïni,
english: And they said, We saw certainly that the Lord was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo tïïyï dëëtwa, kaawat mana kärwa ïïni gudö ni kärwa tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëërï, 'ba beeye gïn mo beer keere na tïïcwa, këël mana wëëkwa ïïni wääth ki met ec jaak. Ni ennø, ï nëënï ni ïïna dhaanhø mo ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki møn.»
english: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Aydhak cam mo päl ajiiŋŋe jïge, ni cämge ni mäthge.
english: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

anywaa: Køøre na tïme na amöölla cøøn gena päny maal ni kööŋge yïthakicge; ni ö Aydhaki ni wëëk geni wääth, ni putge aay buute ni yïthge met.
english: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba na poode na dïcäŋögø kiree, jø tïïc mo Aydhak aö baŋe ni ge køpa gïr iith mana koonyge, ni köge jïre, ni «Iith atuc.»
english: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac's servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

anywaa: Ni ö Aydhaki ni put nyeŋ iidhøgø cwøl ni Cïïba; kiper manøgø nø, nyeŋ pääny mana en kaace poot cwøl ni Bëërcïïba këël dïcäŋi ennø.
english: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Icøø ni cwiiye pïëraŋween, ena nyöömmö ki mään ariiø ma nyïï jø Këth, ni beege Judit nyi Bëëri ki Bacimat nyi Ëlön.
english: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

anywaa: Ni ö gïr nyïgöge ni tïme na pänh cwïny mo dwøŋ jï Aydhak ki Rebëëka.
english: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïm Aydhaki ni dwøŋ, ni nyeŋŋe rääbö ni ba nëënö døøc këët, wääde ma Icøø na näk kanynye acwøle, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nyie wääda.» Ni kö Icøø jï wänni, ni «Aani en.»
english: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

anywaa: Ni kö Aydhaki, ni «Ennø, aana nø døøŋŋø ni dïcäŋ man thøøa yie kiree kuua.
english: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man lwørï jap dwaar moï, na näk athëëre moï ka atum marï, ni ciï paap baŋ dwaar ni kännï ki rïŋö jïra;
english: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

anywaa: ni tëënnï aani ki cam mo met døc mo yia met ki gø, ni kälï gø baŋa nee cama, kiper niï gwïëdha kany pooda naa poot kär thøw en.»
english: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Aydhaki na cään wääde ma Icøø, Rebëëka bëëdö ni ïthe ee ciiø ni wïnynya luup moøgø. Køøre kanya nø aa Icøø paap baŋ dwaar nee jïte ki rïŋö mo käl paac,
english: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

anywaa: Rebëëka aköö jï wääde ma Jeekap, ni «Ennø, luubö mør awïnynya dhi wäru ni cäänna coku ma Icøø, ni kööe
english: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

anywaa: ni Icøø känne jïre ki rïŋö, ni thaal gø ni met døc nee came, kiper nee gwïëdhe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kany poode ni eni poot kär thøw ice.
english: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø wääda, wïny dwøra man caana jïrï en.
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

anywaa: Ci kaal kaace ni kännï jïra ki nyïïdïëk ariiø ma atëëe mo beyø, kiper nee thaala na cam mo met døc jï wäru, ni caala man wø met yie ki gø.
english: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

anywaa: Køøre nø, kïthï baŋ wäru nee came, kiper niï gwïëdhe kany poode ni eni poot kär thøw ice.»
english: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jeekapi jï menni ma Rebëëka, ni «Kare møn nø; a coka ma Icøø kaa dhaanhø mo dëëre da jïër, ni aani aana dhaanhø mo dëëra pøøth jaak.
english: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

anywaa: Kanymør wära noo mul dëëra, eni köö naa pääta gø, ni manøgøøni caana gø naa käla acïëni bääta ni paa gwïëth.»
english: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

anywaa: 'Ba menni aköö jïgø, ni «Nyie wääda, acïëni marï bee, oen bääta. Leŋ dwøra keere; ciï ni kälï gïïa caana jïrï baŋa.»
english: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

anywaa: Køøre ena aay ni lwør nyïïdïëk, ni put ge kälö jï menni; ni ö menni ni tïïe ki cam mo met døc ni caala man wø met yi Aydhaki ki gø wø bëëde.
english: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

anywaa: Ni ö Rebëëka ni lwør abïïk wääde ma Icøø na näk kanynye; ni beege abïïge moa beyø døc na en yi øtø buute, ni røø ge dëër wääde ma Jeekap na thiinh.
english: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

anywaa: Ni rïëp pëët nyïïdïëk moøgø ceŋ wääde ki ŋute na pøøth.
english: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

anywaa: Ni cïp cama met døc na tïïe cer wääde ma Jeekap.
english: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

anywaa: Ni put Jeekapi ö baŋ wänni, ni kööe, na «Awuuö.» Ni kö Aydhaki, ni «Aani en. ?Aŋø, ïïna wääda mane?»
english: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi jï wänni, ni «Aana Icøø na näk kanynyï; gïna caanï jïra atïïa. Ö maal nø, ni camï rïŋö mana käla, naa gwïëthï.»
english: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydhak aköö jï wääde, na «?Aŋø nyie wääda, iï laar joot yi wäne kawaane en?» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, na tïïc gø nee laar lønyø jïra.»
english: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak aköö jï Jeekap, ni «Nyie wääda, beerra man nyänhnhï buuta, nee dëërï mula ki man näk ïïna wääda ma Icøø møn wala paa ïïni.»
english: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni put nyiik buut wänni ma Aydhak, ni ö Aydhaki ni mul dëër wääde, ni kööe, ni «Dwøl bëëdö keda dwør Jeekap, 'ba ceŋ beege ceŋ Icøø.»
english: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydhak wääde käre ŋiiø, kiper mana tïme ni ceŋŋe da jïër ni caala ceŋ coki ma Icøø. 'Ba kanya tïme ni manynya man gwïëth gø,
english: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau's hands: so he blessed him.

anywaa: ena cäŋ pëënynyö, ni kööe, «?Ka adïëri møn, ïïna wääda ma Icøø?» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Beeye aani.»
english: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

anywaa: Ni kö Aydhaki, ni «Käl gïna kälï ki paap baŋa nø, nee rïŋ wääda cama, kiper niï gwïëdha.» Ni put cam kälö jï wänni, ni cäme; ni ö Jeekapi ni känne jï wänni ki køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø, ni mädhe.
english: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak aköö jï wääde, ni «Nyie wääda, beerra man nyänhnhï buuta kany ni nuumï dhaa.»
english: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni nyiik buute ni nuum dhi gø. 'Ba kanya ŋwääc ŋwääny abïïk wääde, wääde agwïëdhe, ni kööe, ni «Ennø, ŋwääny dëër wääda, ŋwääi keda ŋwääny paap mo ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki ni wëëk thööy mo maal ïïni, ki lurö mar ŋöömö; ni mooc ïïni ki bëëlö mo päl, ki kwøk nyïïomøki mo thööth;
english: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

anywaa: beerra man tïm wïth juurre ni tïnynya ïïni, ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïmï ni wøørge ïïni; ni tïmï ni ïïna kwäärö wïth nyïïmeru, ni ö geni ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïmï ni wøørge ïïni. Acïëni oen bäät jø ocien ïïni, ni ö gwïëthi ni en bäät jø ogwïëth ïïni.»
english: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother's sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Aydhaki ki gwïëth Jeekap, ni Jeekap onø aa wøk buut wänni ma Aydhak, coki ma Icøø aput pïï ki baŋ dwaar.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki cam mo met døc thuwø, ni käl gø baŋ wänni; ni kööe jï wänni, na «Awuuö, ö maal nø, ni camï rïŋ wäädï, naa gwïëthï.»
english: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son's venison, that thy soul may bless me.

anywaa: Ni kö wänni ma Aydhak, na «?Aŋø, ïïna ŋa?» Ni kö Icøø, ni «Aana wäädï ma Icøø, na näk kanynyï.»
english: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak dëëre atïmö ni miel døc, ni kööe, na «?Aŋata ŋa na kwøŋ öö ki rïŋö ya adïëti ni käl gø baŋa, ni cama gø bäre kanya poode niï poot kär öö, ni nø gwïëdha gø? Ni ka adïëri møn, bee eni noo gwïëth.»
english: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Icøø na wïny dwør wänni, ena köök ki dwøl mo päl døc, ni jwöŋe ni cwïnye ee keeyø døc kiree, ni kööe jï wänni, ni «Wui, Awuuö, gwïëth aani, gwïëth aani thuwø.»
english: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

anywaa: Ni kö Aydhaki, ni «Coku anø öö ki cwøk, ni ö gwïëthi mana daa ï gwïëdhö ki gø ni ci jïre.»
english: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø aköö, na «Aŋø, nyeŋŋe kaa Jeekap møn, ni beeye ni put kara manynyø kwöre ariiø en. Dïkwøŋ dööŋö mara akwøŋ lwør; kawaane ennø, gwïëth mana di a gwïëdhö ki gø acäŋ lwørrø.» Ni cäŋ Icøø köö, na «?Aŋø, caana gø ni bäŋ gwïëth mo odööŋ jïra këët nø?»
english: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Aydhaki, ni kööe jï Icøø, ni «Ennø, Jeekap atïïa na kwäärö marï, ni cïba jø tuuŋe bëët jïre na jø tïïc moe; ni mooa eni ki bëëlö mo päl, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki. ?Age ennø nyie wääda, agïnaŋø noo tïïa kiperï këët ennø?»
english: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

anywaa: 'Ba Icøø aköö jï wänni, na «?Aŋø Awuuö, beeye gwïëth aciel keere na en jïrï? Wui Awuuö, gwïëth aani, gwïëth aani thuwø.» Køøre Icøø aput jwøk døc kiree.
english: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk wänni ma Aydhak, ni kööe, ni «Ennø, ïïno bëëdö ni karï bäär ki lurö mar ŋöömö, ki thööy mo maal.
english: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

anywaa: Ïïno bëëdö na ŋat tøŋ, ni tïnynyï coku; 'ba kanyo cwat yiï ki bëëtö manøgø, teek mare ojarï wøk bäätï.»
english: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø cwïnye ajïtö ki gïn mo raac ki Jeekap kiper gwïëth mana joode baŋ wänni; ni ö Icøø ni cääne ki cwïnye keere, ni kööe, ni «Nïr kïmmö kiper thøw wära kare aløny ni cään; kar kaaca nø, coka ma Jeekap onääa.»
english: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

anywaa: 'Ba Rebëëka luup moa car kanynye ma Icøø, kanya caani jïre, ena jääk baŋ wääde ma Jeekap na thiinh nee ööe, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ennø, coku ma Icøø cwïnye ee cïp piny, ni cädö niï nääe nääö.
english: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø bee, nyie wääda, leŋ dwøra; ö maal ni reŋŋï Aaren baŋ coka ma Leeban;
english: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

anywaa: ni bëëdï buute kaace di turu, këël mano ö gïna lïëth ni en cwïny coku ice noo kwöye,
english: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother's fury turn away;

anywaa: këël mano aac gootø mar coku mana goote ki ïïni ki gø, ni wïl wïïe ki gïïa tïïyï dëëre. Køøre nø, aano jääŋ baŋï niï duuï ki kunöce. ?Aŋø, wïthu doo dïdö karuriet ki dïcäŋ aciel buuta møn?»
english: Until thy brother's anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

anywaa: Køøre Rebëëka aköö jï Aydhak, ni «Aana ööl ki bëëtö bäät piny kiper määrögø na nyïï jø Këth yøø. ?Aŋø, ni näk mo Jeekap cäŋa nyöömmö ki dhaagø dëët nyïï jø Këth, na näk wëëk ŋøømmi, ni caala moi ii, ba theemma man thøøa jaak nø?»
english: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak Jeekap acwøle ni gwïëth gø, ni kööm gø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Kär niï nyöömmö ki dhaagø røk nyïïakuk Keenan, paan bëëdø yie en.
english: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

anywaa: Ö maal, ni ciï Padan-Aram, dhi øt kwaru ma Batuël wää meru, ni nyöömmï ki dhaagø kaace dëët nyïï nääru ma Leeban cöök meru.
english: Arise, go to Paddan–aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk na en teeki jïre ïïno gwïëdhe, ni tïïc ïïni niï kännï ki nyïëdi ni nyaayï, ni tïmï ni ïïna lwaa wï jur.
english: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cïp gwïëth mana gwïëth Eeberam ki gø jïrï ki nyïïkwaayï bëët, kiper nee ŋöömmo bëëdï yie ni ïïna wëëllö enø nee lwørï na marï, ni beeye ŋöömma cïp Jwøki jï Eeberam.»
english: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

anywaa: Køøre Aydhak Jeekap awëëk wääth, ni ci Padan-Aram baŋ Leeban o Batuël nyï Aram, na näk cok Rebëëka mii Jeekap ki Icøø.
english: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

anywaa: 'Ba ajoot Icøø ni Aydhak Jeekap ee gwïëdhö ni wëëk gø wääth man ci Padan-Aram, nee nyöömme ki dhaagø kaace; ni jooti Icøø thuwø ni Aydhak Jeekap agwïëdhe ni kööm gø ki man ba nyöömme røk nyïïakuk Keenan.
english: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Paddan–aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

anywaa: Ni joot gø thuwø ni Jeekap dwør wänni ki menni ee leŋø ni put aa Padan- Aram.
english: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan–aram;

anywaa: Køøre aput Icøø ŋäc ni wänni ma Aydhak yie raac ki nyïga näk nyïï jø Keenan.
english: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

anywaa: Ni ö Icøø ni ci baŋ Icmiel wär Eeberam, ni nywøm nyi Icmiel ma Maalët cok Nebayöt, ni meet gø bäät määre moa kwøŋ nywøm.
english: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap atïŋŋö Bëërcïïba ni cøøa Aaren.
english: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba, and went toward Haran.

anywaa: Ni pïïe kany mør dï paap ni but kaace, kiper mana päth cäŋŋi. Ni lwør kïdi aciel røk kïte moa en kaace, ni but piny ni thäänhe ki gø.
english: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

anywaa: Køøre ena lägö kede doo ogat mo ocwöth piny mo wïïe okëët maal; ni nyïïatwieli mo Jwøk cøøa maal ni duua piny ki bääte.
english: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

anywaa: Ni kar kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk cuŋŋa bääte, ni kööe, ni «Aana Wuuö Jwøk, na näk Jwø kwaru ma Eeberam ki wäru ma Aydhak; ŋöömmi bäre ni ïïno but piny yie en, cïba cïbö jïrï ki nyïïkwaayï.
english: And, behold, the Lord stood above it, and said, I am the Lord God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

anywaa: Ni tïïa kwään nyïïkwaayï ni caala tør bäät piny, ni nyaayu ni këëtu but piny karge bëët ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ; 'ba wïth tuŋi bëët mo bäät piny ogwïëth ki køørï ki nyïïkwaayï.
english: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

anywaa: Ni ennø, a ena buutï, ni kany oci yie jaak ï gwøa gwøø, ni duua ïïni yi ŋöömmi; kiper ï ba wiia këël mano tïïa gïna caana jïrï en.»
english: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap apäy ki yïth niine, ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ena kany, 'ba kuua ni ena kany.»
english: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the Lord is in this place; and I knew it not.

anywaa: 'Ba ena lwäyö, ni kööe, ni «Kany beeye kany mo di lwäyö ki yie, ni beeye kar bëëtö mar Jwøk møn kiree, ni man beeye dhi øtjöö mar maal.»
english: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn Jeekap aö maal, ni lwør kïdi mana thäänhe ki gø, ni cwöth gø piny kaace na nyuudhi, ni thii maaw wï gø.
english: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni cwøl nyeŋ kaace ni Bëthël; 'ba dïkwøŋ nyeŋ päänya en yi ŋöömmögø cwøl ni Löja.
english: And he called the name of that place Beth–el: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap akööŋ, ni kööe, ni «Ni näk Jwøk puta en buuta møn, ni gwøk aani ki wääth man caadha en, ni mooc aani ki gïn mo cama, ka abïï mo røøa dëëra,
english: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

anywaa: ni duu aani po wära ni dëëra jööt, Wuuö Jwøk puta bëëtö na Jwøk mara møn.
english: So that I come again to my father's house in peace; then shall the Lord be my God:

anywaa: Ni ö kïnni ni yaa cwöth piny na nyuudhi en ni tïme na gïn mo nyootha kar bëëtö mar Jwøk; ni gïï ocïp Jwøki jïra bëët, paac wïthge cïba cïbö jïre thuwø.»
english: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God's house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap atïŋŋö ni put wääth ni pïïe yïth ŋøøp jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

anywaa: 'Ba na lwïthe, iith ajoode dï pwöla, ni joot athwöe adäk mo pïïth dïëk no obut piny bäät iidhøgø, ni beeye iith wø maathge obëëde. 'Ba kïdi mana en dhi iith manøgø beeye kïdi mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well's mouth.

anywaa: Ni kany wø ö dïëki bëët wø cooŋi kanya aciel kaace, jø kwaath kïdi wø ŋielge wøk, ni maathge dïëk, ni cäŋge kïdi dwøk kare dhi iith manøgø.
english: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well's mouth in his place.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap aköö jï jø kwaath, ni «?Nyie jaay nyïïmera, uuna jø kaa?» Ni köge, ni «Waana jø Aaren.»
english: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Leeban nyïkwaar Neeyör ŋäyu?» Ni köge, ni «Yaa, eni ŋäcwa.»
english: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jeekapi köö jïge, ni «?Eni dëëre jööt?» Ni köge, ni «Yaa, dëëre jööt; këël nyaare ma Reecal beeye ni ööi ki dïëk ice.»
english: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Ennø, cäŋ poot dwøŋ, ni paa kare ki man cooŋ dïëk kanya aciel kar kany nø. Maathu geni ki pïï nø, ni cou, ni kïthu geni baŋ luum.»
english: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, ni «Manøgø ba tïïcwa këël mano ö dïëki bëët noo cooŋge dëëtge kanya aciel, noo ŋïël kïdi wøk mana en dhi iith; køøre nø, dïëk maathwa maadhø ki pïï nø.»
english: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni poot cäänö ki jøøgø, Reecal aput pïï ki dïëk wänni, kiper bee eni ni kwaac geni.
english: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jeekapi na joot Reecal nyi nääri ma Leeban cöök menni, ki dïëk nääri ma Leeban, Jeekap aput cøø, ni ŋïël kïdi wøk mana en dhi iith, ni maath dïëk nääri ma Leeban.
english: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap dhi Reecal anuume ni put jwøk.
english: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni caan tuuŋ jï Reecal ki man näk gena tuuŋ ki wää gø, ni eni beeye o Rebëëka, ni ö Reecalli ni reŋ paac ni waac gø jï wänni.
english: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's brother, and that he was Rebekah's son: and she ran and told her father.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Leeban na wïny ööny o coki ma Jeekap, ena put reŋ baŋe nee røømge ki gø, ni gääm gø ni nuum dhi gø, ni käl gø paare. Ni ö Jeekapi ni caan jammi bëët jï Leeban.
english: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

anywaa: Ni kö Leeban jïgø, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ïïna tuuŋwa mana näk rem dëëra kiree.» Ni ö Jeekapi ni put bëëdö ki dwääy aciel buut Leeban.
english: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban aköö jï Jeekap, na «?Aŋø, a diï puta tïnynyö jaak nø ni bäŋ gïrpiny kiper mana näk øøna tuuŋ? Caan jammi moo magï baŋa.»
english: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban da nyïïe ariiø; ni nyeŋ mana dwøŋ beeye Liia, ni ö nyeŋ mana thiinhnhi ni näk Reecal.
english: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

anywaa: Ni Liia beeye nyakøø mo nyeŋŋe therø, 'ba Reecal kïte mïërö ki dëëre bäre, këël täärnyïme.
english: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap mëër ka Reecal døc, ni kööe jï Leeban, ni «Aani ïïno tïnynya ki cwiiri abïriiø kiper nyaarï ma Reecal na thiinh.»
english: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

anywaa: Ni kö Leeban, ni «Theemma eni ki man cïba gø jïrï ki mana daa gø cïbö jï dhaanhø mør; bëëdï buuta.»
english: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap atïïö ki cwiiri abïriiø kiper Reecal, ni cwiiyøgø nëëni keda nïne mo nøk jaak, kiper mana bëëde ni mëër ki Reecal døc.
english: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap aköö jï Leeban, ni «Wëëk a cïïa nø, nee ö baŋa, kiper kanya wäŋŋa athum.»
english: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

anywaa: Ni ö Leeban ni cooŋ jø paanøgø bëët kanya aciel, ni tïïe ki cam nywöm.
english: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na wïthïënhö, Leeban nyaare ma Liia alwøre, ni käl gø baŋ Jeekap; ni ö Jeekapi ni ci baŋ gø na dhaagø.
english: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban nyaan ma ŋat tïïc mare mo nyeŋŋe Dhelpa, acïbe jï nyaare ma Liia nee tïme na ŋat tïïc mare.
english: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, ajoot Jeekapi ni beeye Liia. Ni kööe jï Leeban, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïyï dëëra en? ?Aŋø, paa Reecal na tïnynya ïïni kipere na bëëde? ?Aperŋø nø na nøønï aani en?»
english: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban aköö, ni «Manøgø paa kööŋŋö mar powa, ki man nywøm ŋata thiinh ni ŋata dwøŋ poodi.
english: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

anywaa: Thöör jwøk mar nywöm man turu nø, køøre nyiwa maya ocïpwa jïrï thuwø, køøre nø ï cäŋa tïïö jïra ki cwiiri abïriiø møøk.»
english: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni jïëc gø, ni thöör jwøk mar nywöm mar Liia, ni ö Leeban ni cïp nyaare ma Reecal jïgø na cïïe.
english: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban nyaan ma ŋat tïïc mare mo nyeŋŋe Bila, acïbe jï nyaare ma Reecal nee tïme na ŋat tïïc mare.
english: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni ci baŋ Reecal na dhaagø thuwø. 'Ba Jeekap mëër ka Reecal døc ni kaala Liia, ni ö Jeekapi ni cäŋ tïïö ki cwiiri abïriiø møøk jï Leeban.
english: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Wuuö Jwøki ni Liia ba mëërö ki gø døøc, Liia akønye ki man jïte ko obwöre, ni dööŋ Reecalli ni bäŋ obwöre jïre.
english: And when the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

anywaa: Ni ö Liia ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Ruben, kiper mana kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk can mara ajoode, 'ba ki mano täge ennø, cwøra otïmö ni mëër ki aani.»
english: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the Lord hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

anywaa: Køøre Liia yie acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk ki man näk ba mëërö ki aani awïnynye, ni beeye tiere ni cäŋ nyilaal man cïpö jïra en.» Ni ö Liia ni cak nyeŋ wääde ni Cimien.
english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the Lord hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

anywaa: Køøre Liia yie acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni kööe, ni «Køør man ennø, cwøra puta dwätö ki aani, kiper ena jïtö ko obwöre adäk ma cwøw mo yaa nywølø.» Kiper manøgønø nyeŋ wääde aput cak ni Libay.
english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

anywaa: Køøre Liia yie acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni kööe, ni «Yie man nø Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø.» Kiper manøgø nø, nyeŋ wääde acaae ni Juuda. Ni put cuŋŋö køør obwöre moøgø.
english: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the Lord: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Reecalli na joot gø ni bäŋ obwöre mo ege nywølø jï Jeekap, cwïnye ajïtö ki këëny ki coki ma Liia, ni kööe ki Jeekap, «A manynya man nyöötï kööra ko obwöre, 'ba ni näk ï ba nyööt kööra, theemma man thøøa jaak.»
english: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap awëër døc ki Reecal, ni kööe, «?Aŋø, aana Jwøk na män ïïni ki man nyöödï ko obwöre?»
english: And Jacob's anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God's stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

anywaa: Ni kö Reecalli, ni «Ŋat tïïc mara ma Bila en; ci baŋe na dhaagø, nee nyööde jïra ko obwöre, kiper naa jïta ko obwöre ki ree.»
english: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees, that I may also have children by her.

anywaa: Køøre Reecal Bila na näk ŋat tïïc mare amëëk cwøre ma Jeekap, ni ö Jeekapi ni ci baŋ gø.
english: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

anywaa: Ni ö Bila ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø.
english: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

anywaa: Køøre Reecal aköö, ni «Jwøk aana ŋunne, ni wïny dwøra møn, ni put aani mooc ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.» Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ gø aput cak ni Daan.
english: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

anywaa: Ni ö Bila na näk ŋat tïïc mar Reecal ni cäŋ yie jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø, ni jïtge ki riet nyilaal ma dïcwøø ki Jeekap.
english: And Bilhah Rachel's maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Reecal aköö, ni «Waana läädö døc ki coka, ni kaadha cere.» Ni ö Reecalli ni cak nyeŋ nyilaal ni Naptali.
english: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Liia na joot gø ni eno cuŋŋö ni ba nyööti, ŋat tïïc mare na näk Dhelpa akäle ni cïp gø jï Jeekap na dhaagø.
english: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

anywaa: Ni ö Dhelpa ŋat tïïc mar Liia ni nyöötge ki Jeekap ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.
english: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a son.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Liia aköö, ni «Dëëra gum møn.» Køøre nyeŋ nyilaal acaae ni Gaat.
english: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

anywaa: Ni ö Dhelpa ŋat tïïc mar Liia ni cäŋge nyöötö ki Jeekap ki riet nyilaal ma dïcwøø.
english: And Zilpah Leah's maid bare Jacob a second son.

anywaa: Ni kö Liia, ni «Aana jïtö ki met ec; ennø, met ec mara caan määnni caanø.» Køøre nyeŋ nyilaal acaae ni Acer.
english: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kar kac ki beel, Ruben aci yi pwödhö ni jïte ki nyïïjenni mo ociek, mo caala nyïï ocøøk, ni käl geni jï menni ma Liia. Ni kö Reecalli jï Liia, na «A kwaya ïïni ki man mooyï aani røk nyïïjenni moa käl wäädï jïrï.»
english: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son's mandrakes.

anywaa: 'Ba Liia aköö jïgø, «?Aŋø, ki mana mayï cwøra ki jïrï beeye gïn mo jööt jaak? ?A ennø, ï manynya man cäŋï nyïïjer wääda källö thuwø?» Køøre Reecal aköö, ni «Beerra man but Jeekapi buutï dïwääni na kar nyïïjenni moa käl wäädï noo cïpï jïra.»
english: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duu Jeekapi ka abøøya ki yi pwödhö, Liia aci kuna røømge ki gø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wärï ö baŋa dïwääni, kiper ïïna ŋeea ki nyïïjenni mo wääda.» Køøre Jeekap aci baŋ Liia dïwäänögø.
english: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son's mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni wïny mar Liia, ni ö Liia ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø, ni jootge bïï obwöre ma dïcwøø ki cwøre ma Jeekap.
english: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Liia aköö, ni «Jwøk aana cunne kiper nyaana näk ŋat tïïc mara acïba jï cwøra.» Køøre nyeŋ nyilaal acaae ni Icakar.
english: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

anywaa: Ni ö Liia ni cäŋ yie jïtö ki dhaanhø ni lwaare ki gø, ni jïtge ki bïcier obwöre ma dïcwøø ki cwøre ma Jeekap.
english: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

anywaa: Ni kö Liia, ni «Jwøk aana mooe ki muuy mo beer. Ennø, cwøra tïmö ni bëëdö ka aani, kiper waana nyöödö ki gø ko obwöre abïciel.» Køøre nyeŋ nyilaal acaae ni Dhebulan.
english: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ nyöötö ki nyakøø ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Dina.
english: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wïïe acaare kiper Reecal, ni wïny mar gø, ni wëëk gø nyöödö.
english: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

anywaa: Ni ö Reecalli ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni kööe, ni «Jwøk, lään wïc mara apaanye bääta.»
english: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

anywaa: Ni cak nyeŋ nyilaal ni Jocep, ni kööe, ni «Beerra man ö Jwøki ni cäŋ nyilaal mør ma dïcwøø meetø jïra.»
english: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The Lord shall add to me another son.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Reecalli na nywøl Jocep, Jeekap aköö jï Leeban, ni «Wëëk a wääth nø, kiper naa døøa powa kanya käla yie;
english: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

anywaa: ni cïpï mään ko obwöre 'moa jïra moa tïnynya ïïni kiperge, naa aa nø, kiper tïïc mana tïïa jïrï bäre ŋäyï.»
english: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban aköö jïgø, ni «Ni näk mo yiï met ki aani ennø, beerra man bëëdï buuta, kiper ajooda ni Wuuö Jwøk aana gwïëdhe ki køørï.»
english: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the Lord hath blessed me for thy sake.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Leeban köö, ni «Caan jammi moo magï, kiper nee cïba jïrï.»
english: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap aköö jï Leeban, ni «Ïïni ki dëërï tïïc mana tïnynya ïïni ki gøøni ŋäyï, ni gwøk mana gwøa dïëk moï ki gø thuwø ŋäyï,
english: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

anywaa: kiper dïkwøŋ nuta dïëk mo nøk keerge jïrï; 'ba kanya ööa, gena nyaay ni tïmge ni thööth, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni gwïëth ïïni ki køøra. ?'Ba ennø, aano luunynya tïïc yi wäne thuwø kiper paara?»
english: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the Lord hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

anywaa: Kanyøgø Leeban aköö, na «?Agïnaŋø noo cïba jïrï nø?» Ni kö Jeekapi, na «A ba many gïn mør mo cïpï cïbö jïra, 'ba ni näk mo gïrpiny aciel mør kany tïïyï tïïö jïra, aani a puta bëëtö naa kwaaya dïëk moï ni gwøa geni.
english: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

anywaa: Beerra man wëëgï aani ciin dï pïïth dïëk moï dïcäŋi, kiper nee rööm moa näk dëëtge da kït, ki nyïïrööm moa cøl, ka atëëe moa näk dëëtge da kït bëët nee jiera, nee tïmge na 'moa na kar tïïc mara.
english: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

anywaa: Yi nyïme thuwø ki man näk mo bëëtö mara adïëri jootï joodø kanyo ööï no liewï dïëk moøgø. Ni näk miï jïtö ka ateea mo dëëre bäŋ kït røk atëëe 'moa, ki nyirøømmø mo ba cøl røk nyïïrööm 'moa, gïnögø wär put kwaan bääta na käw.»
english: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

anywaa: Ni kö Leeban, «Wøp nø, beerra man tïme kaawat mana caanï enø.»
english: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban atëëe bëët moa näk apøøli ki moa näk dëëtge da kït, ki rööm moa cøl bëët, ajiere ni mëëk ge wääte kiper nee gwøkge.
english: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

anywaa: Ni ö Leeban ni daak dïëk moøgø buut Jeekap, ni kïth ge kany mo bäär mëëth mo caath ka nïne adäk. Ni ö Jeekapi ni dööŋe ni kwaaya dïëk Leeban moa dööŋ.
english: And he set three days' journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap alwötö ki bäät jenni mo poot thec røk teeŋ jenni adäk, ni lør geni ni kwör møøk nëënö ni tar.
english: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

anywaa: Ni ö athøre moa løre ni cïp ge nyïm dïëk yi gïn wø mäth dïëki yie ki pïï, kar maath marge, ni kany wø öge baŋ maath ki pïï, ge käädö.
english: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

anywaa: Ni ö dïëki ni käätge buut athøre, ni nyöötge ki nyïïdïëk mo dëëtge da kït ni møøk apøøli.
english: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni pääŋ nyïïrööm ni kïth ge kur keerge, ni cïp dïëk møga kur keerge ni dïët ki dïëk moa näk apøøli ki moa näk kït moge cøl bëët na en dï dïëk Leeban. Ni ö Jeekapi ni cïp dïëk moe kur keerge, ni käre jääbö ki dïëk Leeban.
english: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban's cattle.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro tïme ni dïëk moa näk dëëtge teek käädö, Jeekap athøre cïbe nyïmge yi gïn wø mäthge yie ki pïï, kiper nee käätge buut athøre.
english: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper dïëk moa jägö, athøre ba cïp piny nyïmge. Køøre dïëk moa jägö atïmö ni beege mo Leeban, ni ö moa dëëtge teek ni tïmge na mo Jeekap.
english: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban's, and the stronger Jacob's.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap aput kwärö døc ni jïte ki dïëk mo thööth døc, ni tïme ni jïre da jø tïïc ma cwøw ki mään, ni jïre da athïrööle ka arëëni.
english: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap luup moa car wäät Leeban awïnynye, kanya köge, ni «Jeekap jammi bëët mo wääwa alwøre, ni beege jammi mo wääwa ni kwäre ki geni yøø.»
english: And he heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father's; and of that which was our father's hath he gotten all this glory.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni neen bëëtö mar Leeban no odak, ni nëëni ni ba mëër ki eni ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jeekap, ni «Døø po wäru baŋ tuuŋu; 'ba aani, aano en buutï.»
english: And the Lord said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni jääk baŋ Reecal ki Liia nee öge baŋe paap kanya en dïëki moe yie,
english: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Bëëtö mar wääu ajooda no odak, ni nëëni ni ba mëër ki aani ni caala mana dïkwøŋ; 'ba Jwø wära ena buuta.
english: And said unto them, I see your father's countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

anywaa: Ennø, ŋäyu ni wääu atïnynya ki teek mana en jïra bäre.
english: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

anywaa: 'Ba wääu bëëdö ni møønna aani, ni wel jammi mo wø maa kwöre apaar; 'ba ena män Jwøki ki man tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëëra.
english: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

anywaa: Ni näk mo eno köö, ni ‹Nyïïdïëk moo nywøl ni dëëtge da kït bëët tïmö na moï,› køøre nyïïdïëk moo nywøl tïmö ni dëëtge da kït bëët. Ni näk mo köö eni, ni ‹Moa näk apøøli bëët tïmö na moï,› køøre nyïïdïëk moo nywøl tïmö na apøøli bëët.
