english: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

anywaa: Ki køør manøgø nø, Jwøk dïëk mo wääu alwøre ni cïp ge jïra.
english: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya tïme na kar käädö mar dïëk, aana lägö ni jooda nyööi ni käädö, ni nyööi moa käädö dëëtge da kït, ni møøk apøøli.
english: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel Jwøk aköö jïra ki yïth lääk, ni ‹Jeekap,› ni kööa, ni ‹Aani en.›
english: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni ‹Ennø, tïŋ wïïï maal, ni neenï nyööi moø ni käädö bëët yøø. Nyööi moøgø dëëtge da kït, ni møøk apøøli; gïnögø atïïa kiper aani gïïa tïïc Leeban dëërï bëët ajooda.
english: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

anywaa: Aana Jwøa nyooth dëëre jïrï Bëthël, kanya thiiï maaw bäät kïnna cwödhï piny na nyuudhi, ni beeye kanya kööŋï jïra yie. 'Ba ennø, ö maal ni weyï paani, ni døøï paana nywøl ïïni yie.› »
english: I am the God of Beth–el, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Reecalli ki Liia ni köge jï Jeekap, na «?Aŋø, da thäk jap wääwa mo odööŋ jïwa yi øt wääwa këët cøøn?
english: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wa ba nëëni kaamar jiy mo path jaak ki baŋe? Kiper eni waana ŋeee, ni cam jammi yie jaak moa køøl køørwa.
english: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, jap kwärö bëët moa lwør Jwøki baŋ wääwa yøø beege mowa ko obwöre mowa. 'Ba ennø, gïna caan Jwøki jïrï enø, tïïyï.»
english: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children's: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap aput ö maal ni cïp obwöre moe ki määre bäät athïrööle;
english: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

anywaa: ni køøl lääc paac moe bëët nyïme, ni aae ki jap paare bëët moa joode Padan- Aram, ni täge ki wääth ki man ci baŋ wänni ma Aydhak yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Paddan–aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Leeban oci kuna nyaar jïëc dïëk moe; ni ö Reecalli ni kwal gïï lam moa näk mo wänni.
english: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father's.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap Leeban nyï Aram anøøne, ni bäŋ gïr wääth mo ee caanø jïgø ki man näk eni päära wøk.
english: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

anywaa: Ni put päär wøk ki jammi moa en jïre bëët; ni aae ni ŋøl naama cwøl ni Upareeti, ni aae ni coonya paana näk po kïte na cwøl ni Gelät.
english: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne, acaan jï Leeban ni Jeekap opäär wøk.
english: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

anywaa: Ni ö Leeban ni lwør tuuŋge, ni läpge køør Jeekap ki wääth mo caath ka nïne abïriiø; ni ö Leeban ni maa Jeekap Gelät, paana näk po kïte.
english: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days' journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aö bäät Leeban nyï Aram ki wäär yïth lääk, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Gwøk riï ki man ba cäänï ki Jeekap ki gïn mo mäna wääth mare.»
english: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

anywaa: 'Ba Leeban Jeekap amaae ni Jeekap oduŋkaare moe ee nø gur piny paana näk po kïte, ni ö Leeban ki tuuŋge ni gurge oduŋkaare moge piny Gelät na näk po kïte thuwø.
english: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban aköö jï Jeekap, na «?Aŋø na nøønï aani en, ni päärï wøk ki nyïïa ni käärï geni kaamar jiy mo omaaø ki tøŋ?
english: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

anywaa: ?Aŋø na päärï wøk niï kwala riï, ni nøønï aani ni wääth kärï caanø jïra en? Kiper ï daa wëëk wääth ki met ec, ni jø wär ki dudi, ni buri ki thøme di pwödö.
english: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na mänï aani ki man määdha nyïïkwaaya ki nyïïa en? Gïna tïïyï enøgø, atïïyï ni wïïï kärï caarø.
english: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

anywaa: Doo da gïn mo tïïa tïïö dëëtu ennø na bëëde ki køør teek mana en jïra, 'ba Jwø wääu acäänö ki aani ki yïth lääk yawïtïni, ni kööe, ni ‹Gwøk riï ki man ba cäänï ki Jeekap ki gïn mo mäna wääth mare.›
english: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

anywaa: Kawaane ennø møn, ïïna aay kiper cwïnyï atïmö ni lääŋŋa man døøï po wäru. ?'Ba aperŋø na kwalï gïï lam moa näk 'moa?»
english: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father's house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jeekapi ni kööe jï Leeban, ni «Päär wøk mara beeye kiper mana lwäya ni kanymør nyïïï kälï kälö ki teek baŋa.
english: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋato jootï gïï lam moa näk moï baŋe, wär thøøe. Beerra man ŋeyï gïïa näk moï røk japa nyïm tuuŋø, ni lwørï geni.» 'Ba kanya ö Jeekapi na caan gïnögø, kuue ni gïïögø okwal Reecalli.
english: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban aci yo oduŋkaara mar Jeekap, ki yo oduŋkaara mar Liia, ki yo oduŋkaara mar nyïga näk jø tïïc moa näk ariiø, 'ba gïï lam moa näk moe käre joodø. Køøre ena duny wøk ki yo oduŋkaara mar Liia ni døny yo oduŋkaara mar Reecal.
english: And Laban went into Jacob's tent, and into Leah's tent, and into the two maidservants' tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah's tent, and entered into Rachel's tent.

anywaa: 'Ba Reecal gïï lam moøgø ee nø lwør, ni kïth geni tier køøm man wø kïth bäät athïrööl, ni pï piny bäätge. 'Ba kanya ö Leeban na bäp yo oduŋkaara bäre, geni käre joodø.
english: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

anywaa: Ni kö Reecalli jï wänni, na «Awuuö, kärï wëër kiper mana kära ö maal nyïmï, kiper aani gïr mään otägö dëëra.» Køøre Leeban amäänyö døc, 'ba gïï lam moøgø käre joodø.
english: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap awëër døc ni jääl Leeban; ni ö Jeekapi ni dwøk gø, ni kööe jï Leeban, na «?Agïnaŋø na baaa? ?Gïna raac na tïïa, agïnaŋø, na rïŋŋï køøra ki teeŋ öönynyögø enø?
english: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

anywaa: ?Këël mana bäpï jammi 'moa bëët, agïnaŋø na jootï røk jap paarï? Cïp piny dïër kany nyïm tuuŋa ki tuuŋï, kiper nee yi luubö manøgø neenge yïthakiyø riet ki ïïni.
english: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

anywaa: Cwiiyi na pïërariiø bëët ii abeeda ki ïïni; mädhi mo rööm moï ki mädhi mo atëëe moï bäŋgø mo obwön wøk ri nywøl marge, ni bäŋ nywø røømmø mo ya lwørø ri pïïth dïëk moï nee cama.
english: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

anywaa: Ni kany wø dee diel mo wø cam cwienynyi camø, aani ki dëëra wø coola coolø, naa ba ö baŋï ki gøøni nee nyoodha jïrï. Ni këël diel mo okwalø ki dïcäŋ wala wäär, a wø pëënynyï pëënynyö kipere.
english: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

anywaa: Ni bëëda ni cäŋ ki kööc wäär bäre 'näga aani, ni bäŋ niine nyeŋŋa.
english: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

anywaa: Cwiiyi na pïërariiø bëët ii abeeda paarï; ni beege cwiiri apaar kurŋween na tïnynya ïïni ki ge kiper nyïïï na näk ariiø, ki cwiiri abïciel moa tïnynya ïïni kiper naa jïta ki dïëk baŋï. 'Ba jammi mo wø maa awellï kwöre apaar.
english: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

anywaa: A onää Jwø kwara ma Eeberam, na näk Jwø wø lwäär wära ma Aydhak ki gø, ba en buuta, caana gø naa diï wëëk wääth ki ceŋŋa jaak møn. 'Ba Jwøk can mara ki öölö mar tïïc mana tïïa ajoode, ni beeye na jook ïïni yawïtïni enø.»
english: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Leeban ni kööe jï Jeekap, ni «Mään moøgø ni jïrï yøø beege nyïïa, no obwöre moøgø poot na 'moa, ni dïëk moøgø beege dïëk 'moa, këël gïïögø ni neetï bëët yøø beege 'moa. ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na daa tïïö dïcäŋi en dëët nyïïa ko obwöre moge na nywølge?
english: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man ööï nee ø tudø ki luubö mo bëëdö na gïn ma nyuudhi yïthakiyø ki ïïni.»
english: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap alwötö ki kïdi ni cwöth gø piny na nyuudhi.
english: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi jï tuuŋge, ni «Kännu ki kïte.» Ni ö jøøgø ni känge ki kïte ni löörge gø kanya ciel, ni cämge buut kïte moa löörge kanya ciel kaace.
english: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

anywaa: Ni ö Leeban ni cwøl nyeŋ gø ni Jagar-Caadutha. 'Ba acwøl Jeekapi ni Galïït.
english: And Laban called it Jegar–sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

anywaa: Ni kö Leeban, ni «Kïte moi no olöör kanya ciel ii, ki mano täge dïcäŋi, obëëdö na gïn ma nyuudhi yïthakiyø ki ïïni.» Kiper manøgø nø, nyeŋŋe aput cwøl ni Galïït.
english: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

anywaa: Ni cwøli ni Micpa thuwø, kiper mana kö Leeban, ni «Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni neet øøni bëët, kany wø tøør wati maya buut wati maya.
english: And Mizpah; for he said, The Lord watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

anywaa: Ni näk mo da gïn mo raac mo tïïyï tïïö dëët nyïïa, wala marï nywöm ki mään møøk nee meedï bäät nyïïa, këël na bäŋe dhaanhø mo nut buutø, manøgø wär ŋäyï ni beeye Jwøk noo bëëdö yïthakiyø ki ïïni na lïŋi.»
english: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

anywaa: Køøre Leeban aköö jï Jeekap, ni «Ennø, neen kïte moi moa näk olöör kanya ciel ki kïdi mana näk yaa cwöth piny na nyuudhi yïthakiyø ki ïïni.
english: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

anywaa: Kïte moi no olöör kanya ciel ii bëëdö na nyuudhi; këël kïdi mana näk ocwöth piny na nyuudhi bëëdö na gïn ma nyuudhi thuwø, ni nyootha gø ni kïte moi ba daa kaalø ki man pöönhnha baŋï naa tïïa ki gïn mo raac dëërï; ni ïïni thuwø kïte moi ki kïnna näk ocwöth piny na nyuudhi ba diï kaalø ki man pöönhnhï baŋa niï tïïï ki gïn mo raac dëëra.
english: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

anywaa: Jwøa näk Jwø Eeberam ki Neeyör, obëëdö na dïŋut luup yïthakiyø.» Ni ö Jeekapi ni put kööŋ ri nyeŋ Jwø wø lwäär wänni ma Aydhak.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap acïpö ko olämi, ni ŋaal gø kanya bëëtge yie bäät kïdi, ni cwøl tuuŋge baŋ cam, ni cämge ni putge but bäät kïdi dïwäänögø.
english: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn Leeban aö maal, ni määth nyïïkwaaye ki nyïïe ni gwïëth geni. Køøre Leeban aay ni døø paare.
english: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap aay ki wääthe na caadhe, ni ö nyïïatwiet Jwøki ni røømge ki gøøni.
english: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jeekapi na joot geni, ena köö, ni «Moi beege lwaa Jwøk.» Køøre nyeŋ kaace acaae ni Maanayim.
english: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap ajääk nyïme ki jiy baŋ coki ma Icøø na en yi ŋööm Cëër po jø Ëdöm.
english: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

anywaa: Ni kööm geni, ni kööe, ni «Wär caannu jï kwääya ma Icøø ni laŋŋï ma Jeekap aköö, ni ‹Aana bëëdö ni aana wëëllö buut Leeban, ni ruua buute këël dïcäŋi en;
english: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

anywaa: ni jïta ki dhäk ka arëëni ki dïëk ki jø tïïc ma mään ki cwøw. 'Ba ennø, aana jääŋ baŋï nee gïïögø caan jïrï, ï na kwääya, kiper naa jïta ki met ec nyïmï.› »
english: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa jääŋŋi aduu baŋ Jeekap, ni köge, ni «Waana pïï buut coku ma Icøø. 'Ba ennø, eno løny ni ena øtjöö, ni ööa baŋï kiper nou røømmu ki gø, ni eni cäädhi ka jiy ma dïpe aŋween.»
english: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap alwäyö, ni tïme ni cädö døc; ni pääŋ jøøa cäädhö ki eni na dhøgi ariiø, ki dïëk ki dhäk ka athïrööle.
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

anywaa: Kiper mana caare, ena köö, ni «Ni näk Icøø öö ni tuk lwaak maya, kanymør lwaak maya bøth.»
english: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni läme, ni kööe, ni «Wui Awuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwø kwara ma Eeberam ki wära ma Aydhak, ïïna cäänö ki aani ni kööï, ni ‹Ci døø pou baŋ tuuŋu; 'ba bëëtö marï otïïa ni beer.›
english: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the Lord which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

anywaa: 'Ba a na Jeekap, a paa dhaanhø mo orømø ki mëëyï ni wø ba jøøl, ka adïëri marï na nyoothï jïra, aani na näk laŋŋï. Aani dïkwøŋ naam Jördan en aŋøla naa käära athøra keere ki cera. 'Ba ennø, aana tïmö ni jïra da lwaae ariiø.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

anywaa: Ennø, a kwaya ïïni, Awuuö Jwøk, naa kønyï ki man wëëgï aani bødhø cer coka ma Icøø, kiper aana lwäyö ki gøøni, kiper kanymør eni öö jaak ni tuk aani ki mään ko obwöre.
english: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jwøk, ïïna köö ni bëëtö mara tïïyï tïïö ni beer møn, ni tïïyï kwään nyïïkwaaya ni thööth kaamar nyeŋ akwöny naama dwøŋ ni ba thum ki kwaan.»
english: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap abut kaace wäänögø. Ni lwöte røk gïïa en jïre bëët kiper nee cïbe jï coki ma Icøø.
english: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

anywaa: Ni gïïa lwøre beege atëëe ma dïpe ariiø ma mädhi ki nyöök atëëe ma pïërariiø, ki rööm ma dïpe ariiø ma mädhi ki nyöök rööm ma pïërariiø,
english: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

anywaa: ka athïrööle ma pïëradäk mo yïthge da caak ki nyïïge, ki dhäk ma pïëraŋween ma mädhi ki rwädhe apaar, ka arëëni ma pïërariiø ma mädhi ka arëëni apaar ma thwönhi.
english: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

anywaa: Ni cïïm geni ceŋ jø tïïc moe ni ee pääŋŋö, ni wï lääy man nø ena kur keere. Ni kööe jï jø tïïc moe, ni «Cou pööthu nyïma nø, ni jäthu yïthakic wï lääy man nø ki wï lääy maya.»
english: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni kööm ŋata bwøth maal, ni kööe, ni «Kanyo røømmu ki coka ma Icøø, ni pëëny ïïni, ni kööe, ni ‹?Ïïna dhaanh ŋa? ?Ï ciï kaa ŋø? ?Lääyögø ni en nyïmï yøø a mo ŋa?›
english: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

anywaa: wärï kööï, ni ‹Beege mo laŋŋï ma Jeekap, ni beege gïïa jääŋŋe kiper nee cïp jï kwääye ma Icøø; ni eni na näk Jeekap ki dëëre cäädhö køørwa.› »
english: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob's; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap riet dhaanhø ki dääge ki jøøa kwør lääy møga, jøøgø bëët aköömme thuwø, ni kööe, ni «Teeŋ luummögø wär caannu jï Icøø kanyo jootu eni;
english: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

anywaa: ni kööu thuwø, ni ‹Ennø, laŋŋï ma Jeekap cäädhö køørwa.› » Kiper ena köö, ni «Aani, wa døøa kanya ciel ki Icøø ki køør muuy ni bwøth maal nyïma enø. Køøre nø kanyo røømwa ki gø, kanymør eni jïëy ki mara.»
english: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap gïïa näk muuce awëëk bwøth maal nyïme, ni ö eni ki dëëre ni dööŋe twïër dïwäänögø.
english: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

anywaa: 'Ba ki dïwäänögø ena ö maal ni lwør määre karge riet ki nyïga näk jø tïïc moe ko obwöre moe na näk apaar kurciel, ni kath løøga ki caara mar naam Jabök.
english: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

anywaa: Ni jwïëk geni ni kaath geni løø naam løøga ki jammi moe bëët.
english: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap adööŋ keere, ni ö dhaanhe mørri baŋe, ni ŋäpge ki gø këël mana ruu øwi.
english: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya ŋatøgø ni ba løny jïre ki man bööt Jeekap, eni waŋ ocwii Jeekap agude, ni ö wöl Jeekapi ni pääe ki cuu moe kanya ŋäpge.
english: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aköö, ni «Wec aani na aa, kiper kar øw aløny ni cään.» 'Ba Jeekap aköö, ni «Ba løny ki man wiia ïïni niï aayï, këël mano gwïëthï aani.»
english: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

anywaa: Ni kö ŋatøgø jï Jeekap, ni «?Nyeŋŋï aŋa?» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Nyeŋŋa Jeekap.»
english: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

anywaa: Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Nyeŋŋï ba cwøl ni Jeekap këët, 'ba ocwøl ni Icriel, kiper ïïna ŋäbö ki Jwøk ni ŋäbï ki jiy thuwø, ni tïme ni käädhö ïïni.»
english: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena pëëny Jeekapi, ni kööe, na «A kwaya ïïni ki man caanï nyeŋŋï jïra.» 'Ba ena köö, na «?Aperŋø ni pëënynyï nyeŋŋa en?» Ni ö ŋatøgø ni gwïëth Jeekap kaace.
english: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap nyeŋ kaace acaae ni Peniël, kiper ena köö, ni «Aani Jwøk ki dëëre møn ajooda, 'ba jwïëya apiem.»
english: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

anywaa: Kanyøgø cäŋ aput tuulö bääte ni poot na kanya kaal Peniël, ni eni cäädhi ni kwömö ni pätha bäät tiere.
english: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, këël dïcäŋi en, jø Icriel ba cämö ki läär moa en waŋ oŋannø, kiper ŋata ŋäbö ki Jeekap läär moa en waŋ ocwii Jeekap na en waŋ oŋannø agude.
english: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap wïïe atïŋ maal ni lwïthe ni joot Icøø ni cäänhnhö, ni cäädhi ka jiy ma dïpe aŋween. Ni ö Jeekapi ni pääŋ obwöre jï mëëkge na näk Liia, ki Reecal, ki määra näk ariiø na näk jø tïïc.
english: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

anywaa: Ni kïth määra näk ariiø nyïm ko obwöre moge, ni kïth Liia ko obwöre moe køørge, ni kïth Reecal ki Jocep ya aŋuudi.
english: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki dëëre ena pööth nyïm, ni cäädhe ni cøŋŋe këëlle piny ni wïïe kuulle piny kwöre abïriiø, këël mana pïïe kany mo cään ki coki.
english: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø areŋ baŋe nee røømge ki gø, ni gääm gø, ni määth gø døc, ni nuum dhi gø, ni putge jwøk.
english: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

anywaa: Ni ö Icøø ni tïŋ wïïe maal ni joot mään ko obwöre, ni kööe, «?A moi a jø kaa ni cäädhi ki ïïni en?» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Beege obwöre moa cïp Jwøki jïra ki met yie, a na laŋŋø marï.»
english: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

anywaa: Køøre määra näk ariiø na näk jø tïïc ko obwöre moge anyänhnhö, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni kuulge wïthge piny.
english: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

anywaa: Ni ö Liia ko obwöre moe ni nyänhge, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni kuulge wïthge piny. Køøre cään Jocep ki menni ma Reecal anyänhnhö, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni kuulge wïthge piny.
english: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø aköö, na «?Aŋø, pïïth lään päl bäre ice na røømma ki gø, tiere aŋøøni?» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Beeye kiper naa jïta ki met ec baŋï, ï na kwääya.»
english: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Icøø aköö, ni «Nyie coka, aani jïra dagø mo thööth; beerra man ö moa näk moï ni putge bëëtö jïrï.»
english: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Ba løny; ni näk mo yiï met ki aani, a kwaya ïïni ki man lwørï muuy mana cïba jïrï, kiper täärnyïmï ajooda ni waany ni nëëni kaaman wø neen täärnyïm Jwøk; ni pänhnhï aani ki met ec.
english: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

anywaa: Beerra man lwørï muuy mana käli jïrï, kiper Jwøk aana mooe ki køør met yie, ni jïra dagø mo thööth.» Ni ö eni ni cøk Icøø këël mana jïëe ni lwør gø.
english: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø aköö, ni «Beerra man tïŋø wääth nee ø aa nø; aano bwøth maalø.»
english: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap aköö jïgø, ni «Ŋäyï, ï na kwäärö mara, no obwöre therø, ni ŋäyï ni dïëk ki dhäk moa näk nyoori poot raŋŋa jïra. Ni ni näk mo ge di kwørø døc këël dïcäŋ aciel keere, ge puta thøø bëët.
english: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

anywaa: Beerra man ö kwäärö mara ni pööth maal nyïm laŋŋe; 'ba aano ööi mëëth ki køør wääth mano caath dïëki ki dhäk moo en nyïma, ki køør wääth mano caath obwöre thuwø, këël mano pïïa buutï, ï na kwäärö mara, yi Cëër.»
english: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø aköö, ni «Beerra man dööŋ jiya møøki ki ïïni.» 'Ba Jeekap aköö, ni «Bäŋ gïre. Mana manynya keere beeye ki man bëëdï ni yiï met ki aani.»
english: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Icøø ni put tïŋŋö dïcäŋögø ni døøa Cëër.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni aae ni pïïe Cuköt; ni tïny dëëre ki kar bëëtö, ni gëëde ka abïle jï dïëk ki dhäk moe. Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace acwøl ni Cuköt.
english: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jeekapi ki Padan-Aram, ena pïï ki jööt dëël päänya cwøl ni Cekam, na en yi ŋööm Keenan, ni tïïc twïër mare ŋää pääny.
english: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan–aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni ŋeew thäk ŋøøm moa näk oduŋkaare moe ee gur piny yie baŋ wäät Eemör na näk wää Cekam, ni ŋeee ka gwel ma dïpa.
english: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for an hundred pieces of money.

anywaa: Køøre ena put tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace, ni cwøl gø ni El-Elöy-Icriel.
english: And he erected there an altar, and called it El–elohe–Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Dina nyi Liia, na nywølge ki Jeekap, alaŋ wøk baŋ nyïïakuk paanøgø.
english: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cekammi wär Eemör nyï Ëwi, na näk kwääc paanøgø, na joot Dina, Dina amaae ki teek ni butge ki gø na dhaagø.
english: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

anywaa: Køøre Cekam cwïnye aput tïmö ni ena køør Dina nyi Jeekap, ni put mëëyö ki gø døc, ni cään gø ki luup mo cøm cwïny.
english: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

anywaa: Ni ö Cekammi ni cääne ki wänni ma Eemör, ni kööe, ni «Nywøm nyakøø man jïra nee tïme na cïïa.»
english: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

anywaa: Kanyøgø awïny Jeekapi ni nyaare ma Dina oraany Cekammi; 'ba kiper mana näk wääte ena paap baŋ kwaath, ena lïŋö ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø këël mana duu wääte paayø.
english: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

anywaa: Køøre Eemör wää Cekam aci baŋ Jeekap nee cääne ki gø.
english: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö wäät Jeekapi na wïnyge gïnögø, gena duuö ki kar kwaath; ni päth cwïnyge, ni wëërge døc kiper mana ö Cekammi na bute ki nyi Jeekap na dhaagø, ni tïïe ka aranya dëët jø Icriel, ni beeye gïn mo ba doo maara tïïc cøøn.
english: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob's daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

anywaa: 'Ba Eemör acäänö ki geni, ni kööe, ni «Cwïny wääda ma Cekam apädhö kiper nyou; a kwaya uuni ki man cïpu nyou jï wääda nee ci jïre na dhaagø.
english: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

anywaa: Beerra man nywømø dëëtø; cïpu nyïïu jïwa, ni nywømmu nyïïwa thuwø.
english: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

anywaa: Køøre u puta bëëtö ki waani, ni bëëdu yïth ŋøøm moi kanya manynyu jaak, ni pïïu piny ni gädhu, ni jïtu ki ŋøøm yie ma mou.»
english: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

anywaa: Ni kö Cekammi jï wää Dina ki nyïïmenni, ni «Ni näk mo u jïëy, gïn wäro pëënynyu baŋa jaak cïba cïbö jïïu.
english: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

anywaa: Pëënynyu jap nywöm ki teeŋ jammi møøk jaak, køøre cïba cïbö jïïu ki køør mana caannu, këël thööth nidïï. 'Ba cïpu nyou jïra keere nee ci jïra na dhaagø.»
english: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk wäät Jeekapi ki cwøk jï Cekam ki wänni ma Eemör, kiper mana ö Cekammi na raany cöökge ma Dina.
english: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

anywaa: Ni kö wäät Jeekapi, ni «Waani ba løny jïwa ki man tïïcwa gïnögø, kiper tïmö na lään wïc bäätwa ki man cïpwa nyiwa jï dhaanhø mo kär daŋø.
english: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

anywaa: 'Ba gïrpiny aciel keere mo ø doo dwätö ki køøre beeye en; ni näk mo u tïmö kaamar marwa, ni jiy bëët moa näk cwøw mou daŋŋu daŋø,
english: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

anywaa: nyïïwa cïpwa cïbö jïïu, ni nywømwa nyïïu, køøre nø wa bëëdö ki uuni ni tïmø ni øøna aciel.
english: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo luubö marwa ba wïnynyu, ni ba daŋ uuni, waani nyiwa lwørwa lwørø ni aacwa.»
english: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

anywaa: Kanyøgø luubö mana caan wäät Jeekapi atïmö na luubö mo beer ki jï Eemör ki wääde ma Cekam.
english: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor's son.

anywaa: Ni ö Cekammi ni put tägö ki man tïïc gïnögø, kiper eni cwïnye okäl nyi Jeekap døc. 'Ba Cekam beeye dhaanhø mo pere leth døc dï jiy moa en po wänni bëët.
english: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

anywaa: Køøre Eemör ki wääde ma Cekam aö dhi kiir kar acooŋa mar pääny marge, ni cäänge jø poge, ni köge,
english: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

anywaa: ni «Jøøi ii mëër ki øøni; kiper manøgø nø, beerra man bëëtge pøø ni gäthge yie, kiper ŋøøm thööth ni rømø kiperge. Beerra man lwørø nyïïge ni nywømø ge, ni cïbø nyïïø jïge.
english: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba gïrpiny aciel keere mo ø doo dwätö ki ge ki køøre nee ge bëëtge ki øøni, nee ø tïmø ni øøna aciel ki ge beeye en; jiy bëët moa näk cwøw dïïø døø daŋø kaamar marge.
english: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dhäk moge ki dïëk moge ki gïïa en jïge bëët këël lääc paac moge ba doo tïmö na moø? Beerra man jïëø marge keere, køøre ge bëëdö ki øøni.»
english: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøw bëët moa näk løny jïge ki ciin baŋ leny ajïëy ki luum Eemör ki wääde ma Cekam. Ni ö cwøwi bëët moa näk løny jïge ki ciin baŋ leny ni daŋ geni.
english: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dää nïne ni dëët cwøw moa daŋ poot leth døc, wäät Jeekap ariiø na näk Cimien ki Libay, nyïïmii Dina, opëëlle moge akwanyge ni dønyge dï pääny mëëth ni putge cwøw bëët 'näk.
english: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

anywaa: Ni 'näkge Eemör ki wääde ma Cekam ko opëëlle, ni putge cöökge ma Dina lwør po Cekam ni aacge.
english: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house, and went out.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Jeekapi møga ni cige dï jøøa thøw ni twierge pääny kiper mana ö jøøgø na raanyge cöökge.
english: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

anywaa: Ni kälge dïëk ki dhäk ka arëëni ki gïïa en dï pääny bëët këël gïïa en yïth pwöth bëët.
english: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

anywaa: Ni twierge jammi moge bëët, ni kälge obwöre ki mään këël gïïa en yïth uudi bëët.
english: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap aköö jï Cimien ki Libay, ni «Uuna kän bääta ki gïn mo leth, ni raanynyu nyeŋŋa dï jø Keenan ki jø Përec na näk jø paani. Aani kwään jiya nøk. 'Ba ni näk mo jøøgø dëëtge dwalge dwalø ni öge baŋa ni tukge aani, a 'näkge nääö ki jø paara bëët.»
english: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimien ki Libay aköö, na «?Aŋø, cöökwa doo tïïc Cekammi kaamar dhaagø ma kääbi jaak cøøn?»
english: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö jï Jeekap, ni «Ö maal ni ci Bëthël, ni bëëdï yie kaace, ni tïïï ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace jïra, a na Jwøk na nyooth dëëre jïrï kanya reŋï niï ŋwieya coku ma Icøø.»
english: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Beth–el, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap aköö jï jø paare ki jøøa en buute bëët, ni «Wetu juuga path na en dïïu, ni døøyu dëëtu mo waany, ni wiillu abïïe mou.
english: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

anywaa: Køøre øøno tïŋŋi ni cøø Bëthël; køøre aano tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace jï Jwøk, Jwøa wïny kwac mara kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth, ni beeye Jwøa bëëdö ni nutö buuta yïth kwöra caadha bëët.»
english: And let us arise, and go up to Beth–el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøgø juuga path bëët na en jïge ki gwet ïthi moge acïpge jï Jeekap, ni ö Jeekapi ni koony ge piny tier jaadha teek na en buut Cekam.
english: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïŋge wääth marge, lwär mo päl mo käla baŋ Jwøk aö bäät päänye moa näk kwörge cärö ki geni bëët; ni ö jiyi moa en yïth päänye moøgø ni kärge reŋ køør jic Jeekap.
english: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni bëët ni pïïcge Löja na näk Bëthël na en yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Beth–el, he and all the people that were with him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni tïïe ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace, ni cwøl nyeŋ kaace ni El-Bëthël, kiper kaace beeye kanya ö Jwøki na nyooth ree jïgø kanya reeŋe ni ŋwieya coki.
english: And he built there an altar, and called the place El–beth–el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Diböra, ŋat tïïc mar Rebëëka na pïr gø, athøw, ni koonyi tier jaadha teek kany mo cään ki Bëthël, ni cak nyeŋ jaadhøgø ni Allön-Bakuth.
english: But Deborah Rebekah's nurse died, and she was buried beneath Beth–el under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon–bachuth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duu Jeekapi ki yi Padan- Aram, Jwøk ree acäŋ nyoothø jïgø ni gwïëth gø,
english: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Paddan–aram, and blessed him.

anywaa: ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nyeŋŋï beeye Jeekap; 'ba nyeŋŋï ba cwøl ni Jeekap këët, 'ba nyeŋŋï ocwøl ni Icriel.» Køøre nyeŋ gø aput Jwøki cwøl ni Icriel.
english: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jwøki köö jï Jeekap, ni «Aana Jwøa en teeki jïre; nyöödï ni nyaayï piny, ni ö wï jur na näk lwaa wï jur ni tïme ni käla riï, ni ö nyeye ni öge wøk ki dëërï.
english: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

anywaa: Ŋöömma cïba jï kwaru ma Eeberam ki wäru ma Aydhak, cïba cïbö jïrï; ni cïba gø jï nyïïkwaayï mo ööi køørï.»
english: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aay buut Jeekap kanya cäänge yie ki gøøni.
english: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni cööth piny ki nyuudhi ma kïdi kanya cään Jwøki ki gøøni yie, ni thïïm bäät gø ki køøŋø na jëëdhi, ni thii maaw bäät gø.
english: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap nyeŋ kanya cään Jwøki ki gøøni yie acaae ni Bëthël.
english: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Beth–el.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïŋŋö Bëthël. 'Ba kanya poode ni karge poot bäyö mëëth ki man pïïcge Eeparata, Reecal ree ajïtö ki mäc lwaar, ni tïm lwaarri mare ni teek døc.
english: And they journeyed from Beth–el; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør lwaar mo teek døc, dïcöödi aköö jïgø, ni «Kärï lwäyö, kiper nyilaal man poot na dïcwøø.»
english: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm jwïëy moe ni manynya aay dëëre kiper nee thøøe, eni nyeŋ wääde acaae ni Benöni, 'ba wänni nyeŋ wääde acaae ni Benjamen.
english: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben–oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Reecal aput thøø ni koonyi jöö mana ci Eeparata na näk Bethelem.
english: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Beth–lehem.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni cööth piny ki kïdi na nyuudhi bäät bwöc gø, ni beeye nyuudhi mar bwöc Reecal këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel's grave unto this day.

anywaa: Køøre Icriel atïŋŋö kaace, ni aae ni gur oduŋkaara mare piny ŋää kanya cwøl ni Makdal-Adër.
english: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Icrielli ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø, wääde ma Ruben aci baŋ Bila, dhaaŋŋa näk kwanynyø mar wänni, ni butge ki gøøni; ni ö wänni ma Icriel ni wïny gïnögø.
english: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jeekap beege apaar kurriiø.
Wääte moa nywøle ki Liia beege Ruben na näk kany Jeekap, køøre ki Cimien ki Libay ki Juuda ki Icakar ki Dhebulan;
english: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

anywaa: ni wääte moa nywøle ki Reecal beege Jocep ki Benjamen;
english: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

anywaa: ni wääte moa nywøle ki Bila, dhaaŋŋa näk ŋat tïïc mar Reecal, beege Daan ki Naptali;
english: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

anywaa: ni wääte moa nywøle ki Dhelpa, dhaaŋŋa näk ŋat tïïc mar Liia, beege Gaat ka Acer. Moøgø beege wäät Jeekap moa nywøle yi Padan-Aram.
english: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Paddan–aram.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap aö baŋ wänni ma Aydhak yi Mamrë yi Kiriat-Arba na näk Keeprön, kanya ö kwari ma Eeberammi ki wänni ma Aydhak na bëëtge yie na wëëlle.
english: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace cwiic Aydhak oløny na dïpa aciel ki pïërabära.
english: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

anywaa: Ni ö Aydhaki ni jwïëe ka aŋuudi ni put thøø, ni läp køør tuuŋge, ni ena jaal mo ojal ki jalø ma wøp. Ni ö wääte na näk Icøø ki Jeekap ni koonyge eni.
english: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Icøø na näk Ëdöm.
english: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

anywaa: Icøø anyöömö ki mään røk nyïïakuk Keenan; ni mään moa nywøme beege Ada nyi Ëlön nyï Këth, ki Öölibama nyi Ana na näk nyikwaar Dhibøn nyï Ëwi,
english: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

anywaa: ki nyi Icmiel na näk Bacimat cöök Nebayöt.
english: And Bashemath Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

anywaa: Køøre Ada Elipath anywølge ki Icøø, ni ö Bacimati ni nywøl Raguël,
english: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

anywaa: ni ö Öölibama ni nywøl Jeuc ki Jalam ki Köra. Moøgø beege wäät Icøø moa nywøle yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: Køøre Icøø määre ki wääte ki nyïïe ki jø paare bëët ki dïëk ki dhäk moe bëët ki lääc paac moe bëët ki jammi moe bëët moa joode yi ŋööm Keenan alwøre ni aae, ni ci paac mør mo kare bäär ki coki ma Jeekap.
english: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

anywaa: Kiper jammi moa en jïge atïmö ni thööth døc, ni ba løny jïge ki man bëëtge kanya ciel, ni ö ŋøømmi moa bëëtge yie ni gena wëëlle ni tïmge ni ba rømi jïge; kiper lääc paac moge thööth.
english: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

anywaa: Ni ö Icøø na näk Ëdöm ni daa Cëër, paana näk po kïte, ni bëëde yie.
english: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Icøø na näk kwar jø Ëdöm moa bëëdö Cëër paana näk po kïte.
english: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

anywaa: Nyeŋ wäät Icøø beege Elipath na näk o cïïe ma Ada, ki Raguël na näk o cïïe ma Bacimat.
english: These are the names of Esau's sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Elipath beege Tëman ki Omar ki Dhepø ki Götöm ki Kënec.
english: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

anywaa: Timna beeye dhaagø ma kwanynyø mar Elipath wär Icøø. Timna Amalëk anywølge ki Elipath. 'Ba moøgø beege nyïïkwaac Ada na näk cï Icøø.
english: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Raguël beege Naath ki Dheera ki Cimia ki Midha. Ni moøgø beege nyïïkwaac Bacimat na näk cï Icøø.
english: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Öölibama cï Icøø na näk nyi Ana nyikwaar Dhibøn, wääte moa nywøle ki Icøø beege Jeuc ki Jalam ki Köra.
english: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau's wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Icøø na näk kwääri beege ii. Kwääri moa näk wäät Elipath kany Icøø beege Tëman ki Omar ki Dhepø ki Kënec,
english: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

anywaa: ki Götöm ka Amalëk. Kwääri moøgø beege kwääri moa bëëdö yi ŋööm Ëdöm na käl ri Elipath. Geni, gena nyïïkwaac Ada.
english: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Raguël wär Icøø na näk kwääri beege Naath ki Dheera ki Cimia ki Midha. Moøgø beege kwääri moa bëëdö yi ŋööm Ëdöm na käl ri Raguël. Geni, gena nyïïkwaac Bacimat na näk cï Icøø.
english: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri moa näk wäät Öölibama cï Icøø beege Jeuc ki Jalam ki Köra. Moøgø beege kwääri moa nywøl Öölibama cï Icøø na näk nyi Ana.
english: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau's wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau's wife.

anywaa: Jøøgø bëët beege nyïïkwaac Icøø na näk Ëdöm ki wääte bëët, ni kwääri moøgø beege kwääri mo jø Ëdöm.
english: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ bëëdö paanøgø, na näk wäät Cëër nyï Öör, beege Löthan, ki Cöbal, ki Dhibøn, ki Ana,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

anywaa: ki Dicön, ki Ëdhör, ki Dican. Jøøgø beege kwääri moa käl ri jø Öör, na näk wäät Cëër na bëëdö yi ŋööm Ëdöm.
english: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Löthan beege Ori ki Ëman. 'Ba cöök Löthanni mana näk dhaagø nyeŋŋe beeye Timna.
english: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.

anywaa: Wäät Cöbal beege Alwan ki Manëat ki Ëbal ki Cipø ki Önam.
english: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Dhibøn beege Aya ki Ana. Ana kany mo yie da pïï mo lëëthö dï paap ajoode kanya en baŋ kwaath ka arëëni mo wänni ma Dhibøn.
english: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Aiah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre mo Ana beege Dicön ki nyaare ma Öölibama.
english: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

anywaa: Wäät Dicön beege Ëmdan, ki Ëcban, ki Ithran, ki Kiran.
english: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

anywaa: Ni wäät Ëdhör beege Bilaan ki Dhaawan ka Akan.
english: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

anywaa: Ni wäät Dican beege Uc ka Aran.
english: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri moa käl ri jø Öör beege Löthan ki Cöbal ki Dhibøn ki Ana,
english: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

anywaa: ki Dicön ki Ëdhör ki Dican. Jøøgø beege kwääri moa käl ri jø Öör, na kwaan ki køør dhøk uut tuuŋ kwär moge yi ŋööm Cëër.
english: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye moa en teeki ceŋge yi ŋööm Ëdöm kanya poode ni poot bäŋ nyeya mo bëën jø Icrielli beege ii:
english: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

anywaa: Nyeŋ nyeya mana dïkwøŋ beeye Bëla o Beeyör na bëëdö na nyeya Ëdöm, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl ni Dinaaba.
english: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

anywaa: Køøre Bëla athøw, ni ö Jöbap o Dheera nyï Bödhra ni tïme na nyeya kar gø.
english: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Jöbap athøw, ni ö Ëcam nyï po jø Tëman ni tïme na nyeya kar Jöbap.
english: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Ëcam athøw, ni ö Adati o Badat, ŋata dïïm jø Midien yïth ŋøøp jø Möap, ni tïme na nyeya kar Ëcam, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl na Awit.
english: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

anywaa: Køøre Adat athøw, ni ö Camla nyï Mecrëka ni tïme na nyeya kar Adat.
english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Camla athøw, ni ö Caulli nyï Rööböth paana en bäät naam Upareeti ni tïme na nyeya kar Camla.
english: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Caul athøw, ni ö Baal- Anan wär Akbör ni tïme na nyeya kar Caul.
english: And Saul died, and Baal–hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Baal-Anan wär Akbör athøw, ni ö Adati ni tïme na nyeya kar Baal-Anan, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl ni Pau; ni nyeŋ cïïe beeye Meethabël nyi Methrët na näk nyi Mëdhaap.
english: And Baal–hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ kwääri moa käl ri Icøø, ki køør dhøk tuŋi moge ki kwöra bëëtge yïthge, beege Timna ka Alwa ki Jethëth,
english: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

anywaa: ki Öölibama ki Ëla ki Pinön,
english: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

anywaa: ki Kënec ki Tëman ki Mibcar,
english: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

anywaa: ki Magdiel ki Iram. Jøøgø beege kwääri mo Ëdöm na kwaan ki køør kwöra bëëtge yïthge yi ŋöömma makge na marge. 'Ba Icøø beeye kwar jø Ëdöm.
english: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap abëëdö yi ŋööm Keenan na näk ŋöömma bëët wänni yie na wëëllö.
english: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Jeekap. Kanya tïm Jocepi o Jeekap na nyilaal mo cwiiye apaar ka abïriiø, ena bëëdö ni kwaaya dïëk ki uutwänni na näk wäät Bila ki Dhelpa na näk määr wänni. Kanyøgø Jocep nyeŋ uutwänni awaae ni cääne ki dwøl mo raac jï wääge kiperge.
english: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

anywaa: Kar kaaca Jeekap mëër ki Jocep døc ni kaala wääte møga, kiper mana nywøl gø ni eno nø jalø. Ni mooc gø ka abïï mo mïërö.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya uutwänni ni wääge mëër ki eni ni kaala geni, gena männö ki gø døc, ni bëëtge ni ge ba cäänö ki gø ki met ec.
english: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jocep alägö ki lääk. 'Ba kanya par gø jï uutwänni, män marge ki eni aput kadhø døc.
english: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kööe jïge, ni «Wïnynyu lääga läga ki gø.
english: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

anywaa: Kanya läga nëëni kere øøni nø, ø ena yi pwödhö ni ø töö ka acook abäy, ni ö acooŋa mara ni cuŋŋe, ni ö mou ni cooŋge rege lak mara ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïm acooŋ abäy mara.»
english: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

anywaa: Køøre uutwänni aköö jïre, «?Aŋø, riï cuumï cuumö bäätwa? ?Aŋø, ï tïmö møn ni ïïna kwäärö bäätwa?» Køøre män marge ki eni akadhø døc kiper luup moa caane kiper lääk moe.
english: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ lägö ki lääk mør, ni par gø jï uutwänni, ni kööe, «Aani nø, aana cäŋ lägö ki lääk mør. Kanya läga nëëni kere cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer apaar kurciel wïthge ege kuul piny nyïma.»
english: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

anywaa: 'Ba na par gø jï uutwänni ki wänni, ena jook wänni ni kööe, «?A teeŋ lääga ŋø na lägï yøø? ?Aŋø, beeye aani møn ki meru ki uutwäru noo ööi noo kuul wïthge piny nyïmï?»
english: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

anywaa: Ni ö uutwänni ni päŋ cwïnyge ki keec ki eni. 'Ba wänni luummögø akan cwïnye.
english: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

anywaa: Kanyøgø uutwänni aci kuna køølge pïïth dïëk wääge yi kany mo cään ki Cekam.
english: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.

anywaa: Ni kö Icrielli jï Jocep, «Uutwäru ena baŋ kwaath ki dïëk buut Cekam. Ööï nø niï jääŋŋa baŋge.» Ni kö Jocepi jïre, «Wøp, a cøø.»
english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

anywaa: Køøre wänni aköö, «Ciï nø ni neenï uutwäru nee geni dëëtge jööt ki dïëk bëët. Køøre wärï duuï ni caanï gø jïra.» Køøre ena jääŋŋe ki yi gool mar Keeprön, ni ö eni ni ci Cekam.
english: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

anywaa: Ni jooti ya nyen mørri ni eni wïdö jaak yïth pwöth, ni pëënynyi ya nyenøgø, ni «?Ï manynyï ŋø cøøn?»
english: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi, ni «Aani a manynya uutwära. Beerra man caanï kanya kwääcge yie ki dïëk.»
english: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aköö, «Dëëtge apaanyge kany, kiper awïnynya ni ge cäänö, ni ‹Ø aa Döthan.› » Køøre Jocep aläp køør uutwänni ni nwän geni yi Döthan.
english: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jootge Jocep ni kare poot bäär mëëth ki geni, ni eni poot kär pïï buutge, gena cuuŋö yïthakicge keerge ki man 'näkge gø.
english: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

anywaa: Ni cäänge yaakicge keerge ni köge, ni «Ŋat lääk aöö ice.
english: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

anywaa: Ööu nø nee eni nääø ni leeŋø gø yi buur jaak, ni caanø gø ni kööø ni ena cam lääyi mør mo owär; køøre nø nee lääk moe neenø mano tïmge nidïï.»
english: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø awïny Rubenni ni wëëk gø bødhø ceŋ uutwänni, ni kööe, «Kär eni nääø.»
english: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Rubenni köö jïge, «Kär remme kønynyu piny. Beerra man leeŋu gø yi buur man dï paap kany, 'ba kär dee ŋat gut gø ki cere.» Gïnögø acaane ni eni gwøga gø ceŋge kiper nee eni dwøk baŋ wänni.
english: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Jocepi buut uutwänni, geni abïïna mïërö na kääre acöötge wøk dëëre.
english: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

anywaa: Ni putge gø mak ni leeŋge gø yi buur. 'Ba buur manøgø beeye buur mo odwön mo bäŋ pïï yie.
english: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

anywaa: Køøre gena pï piny nee ge cämge. 'Ba na lwïthge, jø tuuŋ Icmiel mo dïgäthe ajootge ni öö ki yi Gelät ka athïrööle moge, ni ge käära dwøk ki mädhi ma teeŋi, ni kïtha Ijep.
english: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Juuda aköö jï nyïïmenni ki uutwänni, «?Agïnaŋø ni beer no duue jïïø ni näk mo rem owääø yøø køny piny jaak ni mooŋø gø?
english: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

anywaa: Ööu nø nee gadhø baŋ jø tuuŋ Icmiel, ni ba gudø gø ki ceŋŋø, kiper eni beeye owääø ni rem dëëtø aciel ki gø.» Køøre luummögø aleŋ nyïïmenni ki uutwänni.
english: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

anywaa: Kanya pöönh jø Midienni ki buutge, geni Jocep apëëge wøk ki yi buur, ni putge gø gath ki jø tuuŋ Icmiel ki gwel ma pïërariiø, ni ö jø tuuŋ Icmielli ni kïthge Jocep Ijep.
english: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni na duu Rubenni na neen Jocep ni tøør yi buur, abïïge ajeeye.
english: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

anywaa: Ni døø baŋ nyïïmenni ki uutwänni ni kööe, «Nyilaal tøør. ?Aano cøøa kaa nø?»
english: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

anywaa: Køøre geni abïïn Jocep akälge, ni ŋätge ki diel, ni cøtge abïï yi remø.
english: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni jääŋge abïïna mïërö ni kïthge gø baŋ wääge ni köge, «Abïï man ajootwa. Neenï nø ni näk beeye abïïn wäädï wala path.»
english: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son's coat or no.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni ŋec gøøni, ni kööe, «Man beeye abïïn wääda. Ena nø cam lääyi mør mo owär. Jocep dëëre anø cööti na thäŋi møn.»
english: And he knew it, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap abïïge ajeeye, ni kïth dëëre ki keeca, ni kïmme kiper wääde ki nïne mo thööth.
english: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

anywaa: Kanyøgø wääte bëët ki nyïïe bëët aöö ki man cømge cwïnye, 'ba ena kweer ki man cøm cwïnye, ni kööe, ni «Jïra bäär, aani a cøøa kar thøø køør wääda naa kïmmö.» Ni ö Jeekapi ni bëëde ni kïmmö kiper wääde.
english: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep onø gath jø Midienni ki nyen mør Ijep mo cwøl ni Pötipar, mo tïïö buut Peerø nyeny Ijep, ni ena kwääy jø leny moe.
english: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, and captain of the guard.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Juuda buut uutwänni ki nyïïmenni awiie ni aae ni gaa buut nyen mør mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Ëra ma nyï Adulam.
english: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

anywaa: Kanyøce Juuda nyi nyen mør ma nyï Keenan mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Cëwa ajoode. Ni ö eni ni nywøm gø, ni ci baŋ gø.
english: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shua; and he took her, and went in unto her.

anywaa: Ni ö nyaanøgø ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni ö Juuda ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Er.
english: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ yi nyaanøgø jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Önan.
english: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyöötö ki nyilaal mør ma dïcwøø ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Ceela. 'Ba na ö nyaanøgø na nywøl wääde manøgø, Juuda ena Kejip.
english: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

anywaa: Køøre Juuda wääde ma Er mana näk kanynye anyöömme ki dhaagø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Tamar.
english: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

anywaa: 'Ba Er, na näk kany Juuda, ena ŋat raay ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; køøre ena wëëk Wuuö Jwøki thøø.
english: And Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord slew him.

anywaa: Køøre Juuda aköö jï Önan, «Ci baŋ cï coku, ni bëëdu ki gø kaawat man wø dööŋ dhaanhe ki cï mädhi, ni ciï baŋe ni nywølï wï coku.»
english: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother's wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

anywaa: 'Ba na neeni ya Önanni no obwöre moo nywøle paa moe, ena ci baŋ cï mädhi ni käre kööthe wiiø ki man cige dëër gø, 'ba cøøa piny jaak, kiper nee ba jïte ki nyilaal jï coki.
english: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïe beeye gïn mo raac ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; køøre ena wëëk Wuuö Jwøki thøø thuwø.
english: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord: wherefore he slew him also.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Juuda aköö jï cï nyaare ma Tamar, «Ci døø po wäru ni bëëdï ni ïïna cï thøø, këël mano døøŋ wääda ma Ceela.» Kiper Juuda alwäyö ni kanymør Ceela thøw kaamar nyïïmenni. Køøre Tamar aay ni ci kuna bëëde po wänni.
english: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father's house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør cwiiri møøk, cï Juuda nyi Cëwa athøw. 'Ba kanya nø løny Juuda ki cøm cwïny, eni ki nyawatge ma Ëra nyï Adulam gena ci baŋ jø wø nyaar jïëc dïëk moe yi Temna.
english: And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah's wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Tamar, ni «Kwaru cøøa yi Temna kuna nyaar jïëc dïëk moe.»
english: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

anywaa: Køøre Tamar abïïk thøø akäl wøk dëëre, ni lwöte ka abïï mør ni uum gø dëëre. Køøre ena pï piny buut dhi kiir Enayim na en jöör Temna. Gïnögø atïïc Tamarri kiper ajoode ni Ceela anø døøŋŋø, ni eni kär mëëk Ceela nee dööŋe ki gø.
english: And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Juuda, ki jïre ni beeye dhaagø ma kääbi, kiper mana näk täärnyïme ee uumö.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

anywaa: Køøre ena gaa baŋ gø thääŋ øtjöö, ni kööe, «Ööï naa ööa baŋï na dhaagø,» kiper eni kuue ni beeye cï nyaare. Køøre Tamar aköö, «?Agïnaŋø noo mëëgï aani kiper niï ööï baŋa?»
english: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

anywaa: Ni ö Juuda ni løk gø jïre, «Ïïno mooa ki nyidiel ri dïëga.» Ni ö Tamarri ni kööe, «?Agïnaŋø noo cïpï na dïgïti këël mano jääŋŋï gø?»
english: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

anywaa: Ni ö Juuda ni kööe, «?A dïgïti ma ŋø noo mëëga ïïni?» Ni løk gø jïre, na «A manynya gwel lweedø marï man wø käärï ki cwaagï, ka athøra mano ni en cerï enø.» Køøre eni gïïögø bëët acïbe ni ci baŋ gø ni jaac gø.
english: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

anywaa: Køøre Tamar aö maal ni aae, ni käl abïïne wøk dëëre ni dwøk abïïk thøø dëëre.
english: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Juuda na jääŋ nyidiel ki nyawatge ma nyï Adulam kiper nee dïgïte moa cïbe lwøre baŋ dhaaŋŋøce, nyawatge dhaaŋŋøgø käre joodø.
english: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand: but he found her not.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni pëëny jøøa näk wëëk kaace, ni kööe, na «?Age dhaaŋŋa näk kääbi na en deŋ jöö buut dhi kiir Enayim?» Ni köge jïre, «Kee bäŋ kääbi mo ena kany.»
english: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

anywaa: Køøre ena døø baŋ Juuda ni kööe, «Dhaaŋŋøca kära joodø. Këël jøøa näk wëëk paaci thuwø aköö, ni ‹Bäŋ dhaagø ma kääbi kany.› »
english: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Juuda jïre, ni «Beerra man bëët jammi moøgø na moe nø, kiper nee jiy ba ŋeethge bäätø. Neenï, kawaane nyidieri ajääŋŋa baŋe, 'ba eni kärï joodø.»
english: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør dwäde adäk acaan jï Juuda, ni «Cï nyaarï ma Tamar ree atïïe kaamar kääbi, 'ba ki køør mana tïïe, eni kawaane yie da dhaanhø.» Køøre Juuda aköö, «Kälu eni wøk nee waaŋ.»
english: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

anywaa: 'Ba na käl eni wøk, ena jäägö ki dwøl baŋ kwari, ni kööe, «Ŋata näk wää japi beeye ŋata mooc aani ki dhaanhø. Beerra man ŋeyï gïïögø. ?Aŋø, wää gwel lweedø man ka athøra man aŋa?»
english: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

anywaa: Køøre Juuda japøge aŋiie ni kööe, «Mana tïïe enøgø atïmö ni theemma eni ki mara, kiper eni kära mëëk wääda ma Ceela.» Køøre Juuda kär ci baŋ gø këët.
english: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kar lwaar mare, atïmö ni yie da nyïï Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

anywaa: 'Ba na cäädhe ki mäc, nyilaal aciel dïge cere arwää wøk, ni ö dïcöödi ni tööny cer gø ki waarø mo kwaar, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye mana kwøŋ ö wøk.»
english: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na ö eni na dwøk cere, coki aput ö wøk, ni tïme ni beeye kaa. Ni kö dïcöödi, «?Aŋø ni jämmï riï keerï en?» Køøre, kiper mana jäm ree keere, nyeŋŋe acak ni Peereth.
english: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

anywaa: Køøre nø coki na en waaya kwaar cere aö wøk, ni ö nyeŋŋe ni caai ni Dheera.
english: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zerah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep akïth Ijep. Ni ö nyï Ijepi mo cwøl ni Pötipar, kwääy jø leny man wø tïïö buut Peerø, ni ŋeew Jocep ceŋ jø tuuŋ Icmiel na kïth gø Ijep.
english: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites, which had brought him down thither.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nut buut Jocep, ni ö Jocepi ni jïte ki bëëtö ma wøp. Ni tïme ni bëëdö øt kwääye na näk nyï Ijep.
english: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

anywaa: Ni jooti ya kwääye ni Wuuö Jwøk nutö buut Jocep, ni jammi bëët moa tïïe cäädhi ni beyø.
english: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni jïte ki met ec baŋ kwääye, ni tïny gøøni; ni ö eni ni tïïc Jocep na kwäärö man wø raŋ jap paare bëët, ni cïp teek jïre bäät jap paare bëët.
english: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïïc eni na ŋat raŋ jape, ni cïp teek jïre bäät jap paare bëët, gwïëth Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyï Ijep manøgø ki køør Jocep, ni ö gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki ni en bäät japa en paare bëët ki moa en pwödhö.
english: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the Lord was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

anywaa: Ni wii jape bëët cer Jocep, ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋe këët kiper jape, 'ba beeye gïr cam mare keere ni wø lääŋŋe. 'Ba Jocep beeye dhaanhø mo kïte wøp døc ni nëëni ni mïërö.
english: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, cï kwääye waŋe atïmö ni ena baŋ Jocep ni kööe, na «A manynya man butï ki aani.»
english: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep akweer ni kööe jï cï kwääye, ni «Neenï, kawaane kwääya bäŋ gïn lääŋŋe kiper gïïa en paare bäre kiper aana ŋat tïïe, ni jape bëët ee wii cera.
english: But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo dwøŋŋa eni ki aani paare; ni bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ mo käre cïbö jïra, 'ba beeye ï keerï, kiper ïïna cïïe. ?Aŋø na daa tïïc teeŋ raayøgø ni dwøŋ enø, ni bääya dëër Jwøk?»
english: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët nyaanøgø ni cäänö cooth ri Jocep ki yïth nïne bëët, Jocep kär jïëy ki man butge ki gø, këël ki man bëëde buut gø thuwø.
english: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel na ö Jocepi na ci yi øtø baŋ tïïc mare ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel kaace røk jø wø tïïö yi øtø,
english: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

anywaa: ena mak nyaanøgø ka abïï mare, ni kö nyaanøgø, «Butï ki aani.» 'Ba Jocep abïïne awii cer gø ni reeŋe ni päär wøk yi øtø.
english: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö nyaanøgø na raŋ gø na abïï mare ee wii cere ni reŋ wøk ki yi øtø,
english: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

anywaa: eni jø wø tïïö yi øtø acwøle ni kööe jïge, «Neennu, nyï Ibaru akäl kany nee ø pääde. Ena ö baŋa ki man bute ki aani; 'ba aana köök ki dwøl mo päl.
english: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

anywaa: Køøre na neen gø ni dwøra yaa tïŋ maal naa cwödö, ena reŋ wøk ki yi øtø ni wii abïïne cera.»
english: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

anywaa: Køøre nyaanøgø abïï akan buute këël mana ö kwääc Jocepi paayø.
english: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø acaane jï cwøre ni kööe, «Laŋŋa näk nyï Ibaru na kälï dïwa aö baŋa naa pääde.
english: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

anywaa: 'Ba na jwöŋa ni dwøra ena maal, ena put reŋ wøk ki yi øtø ni wii abïïne cera.»
english: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kwääc Jocepi na wïny luup bëët moa caan cïïe jïre na kööe, ni «Gïna tïïc laŋŋï dëëra beeye enøgønø,» ena gootø døc.
english: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääc Jocep ni lwør Jocep ni kïth gø øt twöc kanya näk jøøa twöc nyeya otwöö yie, ni ö Jocepi ni put bëëtö yi øt twöc manøgø.
english: And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nutö buut Jocep ni nyooth mëëye ni wø ba jøøl jïgø, ni tïïc gø na nyïïawäädi ki ŋata en øt twöci cere.
english: But the Lord was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata en øt twöci cere ni tïïc Jocep na wïth jø twöc bëët, ni kany wø tïme ni da gïn mo di tïïö kaace beeye Jocep ni tïïc gø.
english: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata en øt twöci cere ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋe kiper gïïa en cer Jocep, kiper Wuuö Jwøk nutö buute, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put tïïe moe bëët gwïëth.
english: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the Lord was with him, and that which he did, the Lord made it to prosper.
