anywaa: Kanyøgøøni na tïme na køør gïïögø bëët, ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø mar nyeny jø Ijep ki ŋata bëëdö ni tïï dääpe mo nyeya ena cere, gena bääyö dëër kwääcge ma nyeny jø Ijep.
english: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø nyeny Ijep agootø ki geni karge riet, ŋata bëëdö ni nyikeenø ki ŋata en tïï dääpe cere,
english: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

anywaa: ni ö eni ni leeŋ geni øt twöc yi øt kwääy jø leny, ni beeye øt twöc mana en Jocepi yie.
english: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääy jø leny ni cïp geni cer Jocep, ni ö Jocepi ni gwøk geni, ni bëëtge øt twöc ki kany mo bäär mëëth.
english: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

anywaa: 'Ba dï wäär aciel ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø ki ŋata en tïï dääpe cere, jøøa leeŋ øt twöc, gena lägö bëët karge riet, ni ŋati man nø lääge ena kur keere, ni tier lääk man nø ena kur keere.
english: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jocepi baŋge ka aruunnø, gena joode ni cwïnyge opädhö.
english: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

anywaa: Ni pëëny geni, ge na jø tïï Peerø moa näk otwöö ki eni bëët yi øt kwääye, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na päth cwïnynyu kipere dïcäŋi?»
english: And he asked Pharaoh's officers that were with him in the ward of his lord's house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jïre, «Waana lägö ki lääk, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo caan tiet lääk jïwa.» Ni kö Jocepi jïge, «?Aŋø, løk lääk ba doo käla baŋ Jwøk? Beerra man parru läägu jïra.»
english: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.

anywaa: Køøre ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø, lääk mare apare jï Jocep ni kööe jïre, «Lääk mara bëët ka araŋa jaath omøk,
english: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

anywaa: mo ree da bäädi adäk mo okar, ni thiiwge, ni ŋøøkge, ni ö nyïëdi wøk mo ociek ki rege.
english: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

anywaa: No ogubayu mar Peerø ena cera, ni lwøra nyïïomøki ni biia ge yo ogubany Peerø. Køøre ogubanynyøgø acïba cer Peerø.»
english: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aköö jïre, «Tier lääk manøgøøni beeye en, bäädi moøgøøni na adäk yøø beege nïne adäk.
english: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

anywaa: Ki ri dää nïne Peerø ïïno päde, ni dwøk ïïni kar tïïc marï, ni cäŋï ogubany Peerø cïp cere keda mana wara tïïyï dïkwøŋ kanya bëëdï ni ïïna nyikeenø mare.
english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

anywaa: 'Ba noo jïtï ki bëëtö mo beer, wär wïïï parï ki aani. Beerra man caanï aani jï Peerø kiper naa käl wøk yi øt twöc man.
english: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani a kwalla po jø Ibaru, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö pööthi maa doo kïtha øt twöc kipere.»
english: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na jooti ya ŋata en tïï dääpe cere ni lääk moøgø tietge beyø, ena köö jï Jocep, «Aana lägö thuwø, ni lääk 'moa nëëni kere a tïëta gupe adäk ki wïïa mo yïthge da dääpe mo tar.
english: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

anywaa: Ni gupa mana en maal yie da wïth dääpe bëët mo onø bul kiper Peerø. 'Ba weny aöö ni camge gø yi gupa mana en wïïa.»
english: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jocepi jïre, «Man beeye tier lääk manøgø, gupe moø na adäk yøø beege nïne adäk.
english: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

anywaa: Ki ri dää nïne Peerø wïïï oŋul wøk, ni ŋaap ïïni bäät jaath, ni ö dëërï ni cami ya wenynyi.»
english: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne, atïmö na kanya lwaarø ki Peerø yie, ni tïme ka ajwöma kiper jø tïïc moe bëët. Ni ö eni ni pät ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø ki ŋata en tïï dääpe cere dï jø tïïc moe.
english: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

anywaa: Ni dwøk ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø kar tïïc mare, ni ö eni ni cïp ogubayu cer Peerø.
english: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata en tïï dääpe cere aput Peerø ŋaap bäät jaath kaa mana caani ya Jocepi jïge kanya caan tiet lääk moge.
english: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø wïïe käre parø ki Jocep. Eni wïïe awïl ki gø.
english: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri ariiø, Peerø alägö kede eni cuŋŋö bäät naam.
english: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

anywaa: Ni ö dhäki abïriiø wøk ki yi naamøgø, na dhäk mo nëëni ni beyø mo olør, ni cam marge beeye luum bäp naam.
english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

anywaa: Ni ö dhäki abïriiø møøk ki køørge ki yi naam, ni gena dhäk mo odwat døc mo nëëni ni reyø, ni ge ena buut dhäk møga bäät ageela.
english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

anywaa: Ni ö dhäki moa näk odwat døc ni camge dhääa näk abïriiø na näk olør. Ni ö Peerø ni pääe.
english: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ butö ni cäŋ lägö ki riet lääk, ni kede da jööth abäy abïriiø mo ee joodø mo døøŋŋø ni beyø døc, ni ge ena ri theeŋŋø aciel.
english: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

anywaa: Ni ö jööthi møøk ma abïriiø wøk ki køørge, mo nyeŋge omat ni geno waaŋ cäŋŋi.
english: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

anywaa: Ni ö jöötha näk odwat ni mwønyge jöötha näk abïriiø na näk døøŋŋø ni beyø døc. Ni ö Peerø ni pääe ni joot gøøni ni beeye lääk.
english: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø, lääk moi wï Peerø akierge døc. Køøre ena jäägö ni cwøl jiye moa nyeŋge reegø bëët mo Ijep ka ajuuk bëët, ni par lääk moe jïge. 'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo oløny jïre ki man caan tier gø jï Peerø.
english: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Køøre ŋata bëëdö na nyikeenø, ena köö jï Peerø, «Aani bääyö mara acaara dïcäŋi.
english: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

anywaa: Kanya ö Peerø na goote ki waani na jø tïïe, waana kïth øt twöc ki ŋata en tïï dääpe cere yi øt twöc mana en cer kwääy jø leny mo nyeya.
english: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard's house, both me and the chief baker:

anywaa: Ni öwa ni läkwa bëët ki wäär aciel, aani ki ŋatøgø, ni ŋati man nø tiet lääge ena kur keere.
english: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

anywaa: Ni kaace da nyilaal ma wøp ma nyï Ibaru ma laŋ kwääy jø leny mo nyeya. 'Ba na parwa lääk mowa jïre, eni tiet lääk mowa acaane jïwa, ni caan tiet lääk ŋati man nø jïre ka mana läk gøøni.
english: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

anywaa: Ni gïïa caane bëët aput tïmö na adïëri, ni ööa ni dwøk aani kar tïïc mara, ni ö ŋata en dääpe cere ni nääi ni ŋaabi bäät jaath.»
english: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø ajäägö ni cwøl Jocep, ni ö geni ni laarge eni käl wøk ki yi øt twöc. Ni ö Jocepi ni liel jïëc tïïe, ni wiil abïïe moe, ni ö nyïm Peerø.
english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Jocep, «Aani, aana lägö ki lääk, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo caan tiere jïra. 'Ba luubö mør awïnynya kiperï, ni ni näk da lääk mo iï wïnynyö, ni løny jïrï ki man caanï tiere.»
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jocepi jï Peerø, ni «Manøgøøni ba en jïra; 'ba beeye Jwøk noo løk gøøni na kare jï Peerø.»
english: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Jocep, «Lääk mara beeye en, aani nëëni kede a cuŋŋa bäät ageel naam.
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

anywaa: Ni ö dhäki abïriiø wøk mo olør mo nëëni ni beyø mo käla yi naam, ni cam marge beeye luum bäp naam.
english: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

anywaa: Ni ö dhäki abïriiø møøk wøk ki køørge mo can mo odwat døc mo nëëni ni reyø, mo teeŋge kära kwøŋ joot yi ŋööm Ijep cøøn.
english: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

anywaa: Ni ö dhääa näk odwati na reyø ni camge dhääa näk abïriiø na näk olør na kwøŋ ö wøk dïkwøŋ.
english: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

anywaa: 'Ba na nø camge ge, atïmö ni nëëni kede kärge camø, kiper ge poot no odwat ni caala mana dïkwøŋ. Køøre aana päy.
english: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

anywaa: «Køøre aana cäŋ lägö kede da jööth abäy abïriiø mo otuy ri theeŋŋø aciel mo päŋ ni beyø døc.
english: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

anywaa: Ni ö jööth abäy møøk ma abïriiø mo otal mo nyeŋge omat mo owaaŋ cäŋŋi, ni tucge køørge.
english: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

anywaa: Ni ö jööth abäya näk obäp ni mwønyge abäya beyø na näk abïriiø. Køøre gïnögøøni acaana jï ajuuk, 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo oløny jïre ki man caan tier gø jïra.»
english: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aköö jï Peerø, «Lääk mo Peerø beeye lääk aciel. Jwøk nyuunhnha Peerø ki gïno tïïe.
english: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

anywaa: Dhäk moø na abïriiø ni beyø yøø beege cwiiri abïriiø, ni jööth abäya näk abïriiø na beyø yøø beege cwiiri abïriiø. Tier lääk beeye aciel.
english: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

anywaa: Ni dhääa näk abïriiø na näk odwat døc na näk nëëni ni reyø na öö køørge beege cwiiri abïriiø mo käc, ni jööth abäya näk abïriiø na näk nyeŋge omat na näk owaaŋ cäŋŋi beege cwiiri abïriiø mo käc manøgø thuwø.
english: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

anywaa: «Ni manøgøøni beeye kare na caana jï Peerø, ni Jwøk nyuunhnha Peerø ki gïno tïïe.
english: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ennø, da cwiiri abïriiø mo öö, ni ciek cammi mo päl yi ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør cwiiyøgø, cwiiri abïriiø mo käc oööi, ni wïl wïth jiyi kede bäŋ cam mo päl mo ege kwøŋ joot Ijep. Ni ö käci ni raany ŋöömö bäre.
english: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør käc manøgø, päl cam mana dïkwøŋ otïmö na gïn mo wïc ba par ki gø këët, kiper käc manøgø dwøŋ døc.
english: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

anywaa: Ni lääk manøgøøni aö baŋ Peerø kwöre ariiø, kiper gïnögø onø ŋøl Jwøki piny, 'ba otïïc Jwøki møn ki kany mo cään.
english: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø nø, beerra man määny Peerø ki dhaanhø mo waŋe riek mo wïïe da acaara, ni tïïc gø na kwäärö bäät ŋööm Ijep.
english: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Peerø ni tïïc gïnögøøni, ni ö eni ni määnye ki jø tïïc mo raŋŋa ŋöömö bäre, ni lwötge ka acooŋa aciel dëët acooŋe abïïc moi nø røk caammi moo ciek ni thööth yi ŋööm Ijep yïth cwiiyø na abïriiø yøø.
english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni cooŋge caammi moo ciek yïth cwiiyø ni beyø noo ööi yøø, ni kange ge yïth päänye moa en cer Peerø, ni gwøkge caammi moøgø.
english: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

anywaa: Ni caammi moøgø kan kaper paac, kiper käc mano ööi ki cwiiyø na abïriiø yøø yi ŋööm Ijep, nee paac ba raany käci.»
english: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

anywaa: Ni tïm luummögøøni ni nëëni ni beer ki jï Peerø ki jø tïïe bëët.
english: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø jï jø tïïe, «?Aŋø, ø doo jïtö ki dhaanhø mo kaala nyeni na dhaanhø mo päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk?»
english: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Jocep, «Kaa mana ö Jwøki na nyuunh gïïögø bëët ïïni, bäŋ dhaanhø mør këët mo wïïe leer mo kaala ïïni.
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

anywaa: Ïïni nø, teek paara oen cerï, ni ö jiya bëët ni wïnyge luup moï. 'Ba kiper mana näk aana nyeya, aano bëëdö naa dwøŋ, niï kaala ka nyec keere.»
english: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø jï Jocep, «Ennø, ïïna tïïa na wïth jø Ijep bëët.»
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø gwel lweedø mare akäl wøk ki lweete ni kïth gø lweet Jocep, ni røø abïïe dëëre mo beyø døc, ni kïth warkey jedhe.
english: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

anywaa: Ni wëëk eni wääth ki yi riet jääne. Ni ö jiyi ni bwøthge maal nyïme ni rëëtge ni köge, ni «Këëllu cøŋŋu piny nyïme.» Gïïögø bëët atïïc Peerø ni cuum Jocep yi ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Jocep, «Aani aana Peerø. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel yi Ijep bäre mo tïïö ki gïrpiny ma aciel ni näk mo ba caana ïïni.»
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø ni cak nyeŋ Jocep ni Dhapenath-Pania, ni nywøm Acenath jï Jocep, nyi Pötipëëra kwääc lam mar pääny Ön. Ni ö Jocepi ni cäädhe dï Ijep bäre.
english: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath–paneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jocepi na täk tïïc man ni dwøŋ en buut Peerø nyeny Ijep, eno løny ni dwøŋ ni cwiiye pïëradäk. Ni ö eni ni ci wøk nyïm Peerø ni cäädhe dï Ijep bäre.
english: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth cwiiya näk abïriiø na beyø, piny aciek ki cam mo päl døc kiree.
english: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cooŋ caammi bëët ki cwiiya näk abïriiø na päl cammi yïthge Ijep, ni kïth ge yïth odïï dï mïëri bëët. Ni ö eni ni kïth yi paac man nø ko odek ni kïth caammi yïthge moa ciek yïth pwöth mo paac man nø.
english: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni cooŋ beel mo thööth døc mo caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ, gøøc mana dhäthe jïre ki man kwaan ge, kiper ba thum ki kwaan.
english: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni cwiic käc poot kär öö, Jocep anyöötö ki wääte ariiø ka Acenath nyi Pötipëëra, kwääc lam mar pääny Ön.
english: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni cak nyeŋ kanynye ni Maneeca, kiper ena köö, ni «Jwøk aana tïïe ki man wïl wïïa ki gïïa jwøra, ni wëëk wïïa wïlö thuwø ki jø tuuŋwa.»
english: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.

anywaa: Ni cak nyeŋ julle ni Ipariem, kiper ena köö, ni «Jwøk aana tïïe ki man jïta ki nyïëdi yi paana jwøra gïïa leth yie.»
english: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

anywaa: Ni ö cwiiya näk abïriiø na beyø na päl cammi yïthge yi ŋööm Ijep ni thumge.
english: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

anywaa: Ni ö cwiiya näk abïriiø na näk cwiic käc ni täkge, kaa mana caani ya Jocepi. Ni tïme ni da käc yïth mïëri bëët, 'ba cam dagø yi Ijep bäre.
english: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm Ijepi bäre ni da käc, jiy ajwöŋö ri Peerø kiper cam. Ni kö Peerø jï jø Ijep bëët, «Cou baŋ Jocep. Gïno caane wär tïïyu.»
english: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

anywaa: Køøre na nyaac käci bäät piny bäre, Jocep odïï mo beel ajabe ni käl beel ni dwøk ge pwödhö ki jø Ijep, kiper käc atïmö ni päl døc yi Ijep.
english: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö tiet mïëri bëët ni aage baŋ Jocep Ijep kuna ŋëëwge ki beel, kiper käc atïmö ni dwøŋ døc bäät piny bäre.
english: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Jeekapi ni Ijep yie da beel, ena köö jï wääte, na «?Aŋø ni raŋŋu nyeŋŋu jaak en?»
english: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kööe, «Kawaane awïnynya ni da beel Ijep. Cou kunöce nou ŋëëu ki beel kiperø, kiper nee ø kwøø nøø ba thøø.»
english: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

anywaa: Køøre uutwää Jocep karge paari gena ci kunöce kuna ŋëëwge ki beel Ijep.
english: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Benjamen cöök Jocepi kär jääŋ Jeekapi ki uutwänni, kiper ena lwäyö ni kanymør da gïn mo raac mo tägö dëëre.
english: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

anywaa: Køøre wäät Icriel alöömmö ki jø møøk, ni öge Ijep kuna ŋëëmge ki beel, kiper meel atïmö ni dagø poge Keenan.
english: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep beeye ŋata näk kwäärö Ijep, ni bee eni na en ŋïëwi cere mo beel kiper jø mïëri bëët. Kanyøgø uutwänni aö baŋe ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïme ni määthge gø.
english: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni neen uutwänni, ni ŋec geni, 'ba eni gena neene kaamar jiy mo kuue, ni cääne ki geni ki luup mo teek ni kööe, «?U kälu kaa cøøn?» Ni köge, «Wa käla powa Keenan ni wa ŋëëmmö ki cam.»
english: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jocep uutwänni aŋiie, 'ba eni kär ŋec uutwänni.
english: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni par wïïe ki lääk moe moa läge kiperge; ni kööe jïge, «Uuna ö kany ni uuna dïlëëwe, nou ööi kaper nee jäk mar paac neennu.»
english: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïre, «Jïwa bäyö, Kwäärö; wa na laaŋe moï, waana ö kany kiper ŋïëw ki beel.
english: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

anywaa: Waana wäät dhaanhø aciel, ni waana jiy mo caana adïëri, ni waani na laaŋe moï, wa patha dïlëëwe.»
english: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jïge, «Jïre bäär. Uuna öö kiper nee jäk mar paac neennu.»
english: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïre, «Wa na laaŋe moï, waana uutwëëe apaar kurriiø. Ni waana wäät dhaanhø aciel mo ena yi ŋööm Keenan. Ni mana thiinh odööŋ buut wääwa, 'ba aciel tøørø.»
english: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jïge, «Kaa mana caana gø jïïu, uuna dïlëëwe.»
english: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep akööŋ ri Peerø ni kööe, «U di päänynyö na ennø: Ni näk owääu mana thiinh ba ö kany, u ba doo aay kany.
english: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

anywaa: Jäägu ki dhaanhø aciel rou nee owääu käle. 'Ba jøw odööŋ rou bëëdö øt twöc, kiper nee gïru joot ki man näk maru adïëri wala patha adïëri. Aana kööŋ ŋëët Peerø ni ni näk gïna caannu patha adïëri, uuna dïlëëwe.»
english: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kïth geni øt twöc ki nïne adäk.
english: And he put them all together into ward three days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne Jocep aköö jïge, «Kiper nou kwøw, tïïyu gïn noo caana jïïu en, kiper aani a lwäär ki Jwøk.
english: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

anywaa: Ni näk uuna jiy mo maru adïëri, beerra man dööŋ dhaanhø acielli dïïu øt twöc, ni cou kuna källu beel jï tuuŋu kiper käc.
english: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

anywaa: Ni kälu owääu mana thiinh baŋa, kiper nee ŋäc ni maru adïëri; køøre u ba thøw.» Ni ö geni ni tïïcge mana caan jïge.
english: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

anywaa: Køøre gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, «Øøna bääyö dëër owääø, kiper can mare ajoodø, 'ba ïthø kärø ciiø ki kwac mare, ni beeye tiere ni tïme ni gïï mo leth tägö dëëtø en.»
english: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

anywaa: Ni kö Rubenni jïge, «?Aŋø, kära caanø jïïu ni käru bääyö dëër nyilaal? 'Ba mara käru wïnynyö. Neennu, kawaane ennø, ajäl remme aö bäätø.»
english: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

anywaa: 'Ba kucge ni luupge wïnyö jï Jocep, kiper da dïdwök luup buutge.
english: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

anywaa: Køøre ena aa kur keere buutge ni jwöŋe. Ni duu baŋge ni cääne ki geni. Ni lwør Cimien ni twöc gø nyïmge.
english: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jocep acïpö ki dwøl nee opïri moge pääŋ ki beel, ni dwøk gwet ŋati man nø yo opïr mare, ni cïp cam kiper wääth marge. Ni ö gïïögø ni tïï kiperge.
english: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

anywaa: Køøre geni opïri mo beel akïthge bäät arëëni moge ni tïŋge.
english: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

anywaa: Ba na ö dhaanhø acielli dïge na jap opïr mare kanya butge yie, ni mooya arëën mare ki cam, eni gwel moe ajoode dho opïr mare.
english: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï nyïïmenni, «Gwel 'moa aduui jïra. Nutö cøøn ennø dho opïr mara.» Kanyøgø cwïnyge apädhö ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi, ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge ni köge, «?Agïnaŋø na tïïc Jwøki dëëtø en?»
english: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

anywaa: Køøre gena ö baŋ wääge ma Jeekap yi Keenan ni caange jammi bëët jïre moa tägö dëëtge, ni köge,
english: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

anywaa: «Nyen mør ma wää ŋøømmi acäänö ki waani ki luubö mo teek døc, ni kööe ni wa cii ni wa liewa poge.
english: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

anywaa: 'Ba waana köö jïre, ‹Waana jiy jaak, ni wa paa dïlëëwe.
english: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

anywaa: Waana uutwëëe ma apaar kurriiø ni waana wäät dhaanhø aciel bëët. 'Ba aciel tøørø, ni mana thiinh beeye no odööŋ ki wääwa yi ŋööm Keenan.›
english: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: «Køøre nyenøgø na wää ŋøømmi enø aköö jïwa, ni ‹Ki ri gïn nø, u ŋääa ŋääö ni uuna jiy mo marge adïëri: Wiiu owääu aciel buuta kany, ni aayu ni källu beel jï tuuŋu kiper käc.
english: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

anywaa: Ni kälu owääu mana thiinh baŋa. Køør manøgøøni nø, u ŋääa ŋääö ni uuna jiy mo paa dïlëëwe, ni puta gø ŋäc ni uuna jiy mo marge adïëri. Køøre owääu päda pädö, ni tïmu nou gädhö yi ŋöömmi.› »
english: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya kønyge opïri moge, ŋati man nø gwel moe ajoode yo opïr mare, 'ba na neenge gwel, geni ki wääge bëët, gena put lwäyö døc.
english: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

anywaa: Ni kö wääge ma Jeekap jïge, «Uuni nyïïa athöörru buuta. Jocep aløny ni tøør, ni Cimien tøør thuwø. 'Ba kawaane ennø, u manynya man källu Benjamen. Gïïögø bëët na tägö dëëra beege gïï mo leth.»
english: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

anywaa: Køøre Ruben aköö jï wänni, «Beerra man cïpï Benjamen jïra. Ni näk mo eni ba duua baŋï, wär wääta karge riet 'nägï. Eni duua duuö jïrï møn.»
english: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap aköö, «Wääda ba doo aay ki uuni, kiper coki anø thøw, ni bee eni keere na dööŋ. Ni näk da gïn mo leth mo tägö dëëre kanyo aayu ki gø, a na wïïa da lwaar a puta tïmö naa thuunhnha uuni, ni thøøa naa kïmmö.»
english: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

anywaa: Køøre meel atïmö ni dwøŋ døc paac.
english: And the famine was sore in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba na thöörge beel moa kälge ki Ijep, wääge aköö jïge, «Cou, cäŋu døø kuna ŋëëwu ki beel mo nøk kiper nøø jïtö ki cam.»
english: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

anywaa: 'Ba Juuda aköö jïre, «Nyenøce waana ceme døc kiree, ni kööe, ni ‹Täärnyïma ba neennu ni näk owääu ba ööi ki uuni ciel.›
english: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

anywaa: Ni näk owääwa jääŋŋï jääŋŋö ki waani ciel, wa doo cøø ni ŋëëmwa ïïni ki cam.
english: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk eni ba jääŋŋï, wa ba ci kunöce. Kiper acaan nyenøce jïwa, ni ‹Täärnyïma ba neennu ni näk owääu ba ööi ki uuni ciel.› »
english: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

anywaa: Køøre Icriel aköö, na «?Aŋø na tïïyu gïn ni raac dëëra en? Aperŋø na caannu gø jï nyenøce ni da owääu mør mo odööŋ en?»
english: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïre, ni «Nyenøce waana tete døc ki bëëtwa ki tuuŋwa. Ni kööe, ni ‹?Wääu poot kwøw? ?Jïïu da owääu mør?› Ni moa løkwa jïre beeye kiper pïëc moøgø moa pëëny waani ki ge. ?Aŋø, ŋäcwa këët ni eni köö, ni ‹Kälu owääu pööthi?› »
english: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

anywaa: Ni kö Juuda jï wänni ma Icriel, ni «Beerra man jääŋŋï nyilaal ki aani, nee wa ciwa, kiper nee waani ki ïïni ko obwöre mowa nee ø kwøø nøø ba thøø.
english: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

anywaa: Aani ki dëëra, aano tïmö na waaci kipere; ni tïm luumme ni ena bääta. Ni näk eni ba duua baŋï ni ba cïba gø jïrï, køøre ajäla oen bääta na bäre bäre.
english: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

anywaa: Doo na wa kär ruu kawaane ennø, doo na waano nø jïtö ki kwör wäädhi ariiø.»
english: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

anywaa: Køøre wääge ma Icriel aköö jïge, «Ni näk ma enøgønø, tïïyu gïn. Lwötu ki gïï mo perge leth dï paac kany, teeŋ kaa riie mo ŋwääi ni met, ki nyïïjenni mo beyø mo di camø, ki maar kïc mo thiinh, ni kïthu ge yïth opïri mou, ni kääru ge na muuce jï nyenøce.
english: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

anywaa: Käädu ki gwel mo thööth mo orømø, ni dwøgu gwel moa duuö na en dhøk opïri mou, kiper kanymør ööi ni kuc.
english: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

anywaa: Lwørru owääu thuwø ni ööu maal ni aayu, ni døøu baŋ nyenøce.
english: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki na en teeki jïre ni døøc yi nyenøce mo met ki uuni kiper nee owääu ma Cimien jääŋŋe ki uuni ki Benjamen na aciel. 'Ba ni näk wääta othøw, aano tïmö naa bëëdö ka bëët ränynyö jaak.»
english: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

anywaa: Køøre geni muuce ki gwel mo thööth alwørge, ni kälge Benjamen, ni tïŋge ni cige Ijep, ni cuŋge nyïm Jocep.
english: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jocepi na joot Benjamen ni ena dïge, ena köö jï nyikeenø mare, «Kïthu jøøgø paac ni ŋaallu dhieŋ ni jiiŋŋu cam kiper nee wa cämwa ki cam waŋcäŋ ki geni.»
english: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

anywaa: Ni ö nyenøgø ni tïïc gïnögø kaa mana caani ya Jocepi jïre, ni kïth jøøgø po Jocep.
english: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena lwäyö kiper na kïth geni po Jocep, ni köge, ni «Kanymør per gwel wän, na näk odwøk yïth opïri 'moø dïkwøŋ, ni beeye tiere na käl øøni kany; ni eni manynya man kïth luubö mør bäätø, nee ø tïïe ni øøna laaŋe moe, ni cam arëëni 'moø ni tïmge na moe.»
english: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

anywaa: Køøre gena ci baŋ nyikeenø mar po Jocep, ni cäänge ki gø dhi øtø.
english: And they came near to the steward of Joseph's house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

anywaa: Ni köge, «Wui, Kwäärö, waana ö kany dïkwøŋ kun ŋëëmwa ki cam.
english: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøkwa na pïïcwa kanya butwa yie, opïri mowa ajapwa, ni ö ŋati man nø ni joot gwete dho opïr mare, ni gwetwa päŋ karge; 'ba ennø gwetøgø aduuwa.
english: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

anywaa: Ni waano kuunnö ki gwel møøk thuwø, nee wa ŋëëwa ki cam. Kucwa këët nø ŋata dwøk gwel mowa yïth opïri mowa.»
english: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, «Cïbu cwïnynyu piny; käru lwäyö; Jwøu na näk Jwø wääu beeye na cïp kwär manøgøøni jïïu ni dwøk gwetu yïth opïri mou. Aani gwetu alwøra.» Køøre Cimien akäl wøk baŋge.
english: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

anywaa: Ni ö nyenøgø ni kïth jøøgø po Jocep ni mooc geni ki pïï, ni lwøkge tietge; ni ö eni ni mooc arëëni moge ki cam.
english: And the man brought the men into Joseph's house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

anywaa: Køøre geni muuce ajiiŋge kiper ööny Jocep ki waŋcäŋ, kiper awïnyge ni geni cämö ki cam waŋcäŋ kaace.
english: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

anywaa: Kanya ö Jocepi paayø, geni muuce moa kälge jïre akälge baŋe paac, ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïme ni määthge gø.
english: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni määth geni ni pëëny jööt dëël marge; ni kööe, «?Wääu dëëre jööt, jaara dwøŋ na cäänu kipere? ?Eni poot kwøw?»
english: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «Laŋŋï ma wääwa dëëre jööt; eni poot kwøw.» Ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïme ni wøørge gø.
english: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni lwïthe ni joot coki ma Benjamen, na näk miige aciel ki gø, ni kööe, ni «?Man beeye owääu mana thiinh, ŋata gïre caannu jïra? Met ec mar Jwøk oen bäätï, wääda.»
english: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep cwïnye apädhö ki gïr coki, ni laar ci kuna many kany jwöŋe yie. Ni ci yi thääŋ øtø maya ni jwöŋe kaace.
english: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

anywaa: Køøre täärnyïme alwøe ni duu wøk baŋge, ni mak cwïnye ni kööe, «Jiiŋŋu cam ni kälu gø nyïmwa nø.»
english: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

anywaa: Ni jiiŋge cam kipere keere, ni jiiŋge mar jøøgø kur keere, ni jiiŋge mar jø Ijep moo cämö ki eni ciel kur keere; kiper jø Ijep ba cämö na aciel ki jø Ibaru, kiper ki man cämge na aciel beeye gïn mo raac døc ki baŋ jø Ijep.
english: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre uutwänni apï piny nyïme, ni ŋati man nø pïïa kare kanya näk ocaanø jïre, ni tägi ka ŋata dwøŋ këël mana këët ri ŋata thiinh. Ni ö geni ni neetge nyeŋge, ni yïthge othäŋŋö.
english: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni pääŋ cam mana en nyïme jïge, 'ba cam mar Benjamen apöödhö kwöre abïïc ni kaala moge bëët, ni ö geni ni cämge ni mäthge ki eni na aciel ni yïthge met.
english: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin's mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep nyikeenø aköömme ni kööe, ni «Pääŋ opïri mo jøøgø ki beel mo orømø ki tëër marge, ni dwøgï gwet ŋati man nø dho opïr mare,
english: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man's money in his sack's mouth.

anywaa: ni kïthï ogubanynya näk mara mana näk tïïc ka gwel-bïrö dho opïr nyilaal mana thiinh ki gwel mo beel moe.» Ni ö nyikeenø ni tïïc gïnögøøni kaa mana caani ya Jocepi jïre.
english: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack's mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø, jøøgø awëëk wääth, ni aacge ka arëëni moge.
english: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø aacge ni karge poot cään mëëth ki paac, Jocep aköö jï nyikeenø, ni «Ci läp køør jøøgø; noo magï geni, kööï jïge, na ‹?Aŋø ni tïïyu gïn mo raac na kar gïna beer na tïïc jïïu en?
english: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ogubanynyøgø na kwallu enø, paa gïn wø mäth kwääya ki gøøni, ni beeye gïn wø køny gøøni ki man ŋec gïï mo poot ena nyïm? Uuna bääyö døc ki gïna tïïyu enøgø.› »
english: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya reŋ køørge, gena maae, ni caan luummögø jïge.
english: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «?Aperŋø na ö kwääcwa na caan teeŋ luummögø? Laaŋe moï teeŋ gïnögø ba dïge tïïö.
english: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

anywaa: Neenï, gweta jootwa dhøk opïri mowa aduuwa baŋu ki yi ŋööm Keenan. ?Warkey a dewa gø kwalø nidïï yi øt kwääyï?
english: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks' mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord's house silver or gold?

anywaa: 'Ba dï laagï bëët, ŋato jootï gø baŋe, wär eni thøøe, ni tïmwa ni waana laak kwääcwa.»
english: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord's bondmen.

anywaa: Ni kö nyikeenø, «Beerra man tïme kaawat mana caannu enøgø; ŋato joot gïnögø baŋe otïmö na laŋŋa, 'ba u bëët bäŋ ajäla bäätu.»
english: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words: he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

anywaa: Køøre opïri moge alaarge øl piny, ni ö ŋati man nø ni jap opïr mare.
english: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

anywaa: Ni ö nyikeenø ni määnye ni tägi ka jøøa døøŋŋø ni päth baŋ moa therø. Ni joot ogubayu yo opïr Benjamen.
english: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

anywaa: Køøre abïïe moge aputge jeeyø, ni ö ŋati man nø ni kïth opïr mare bäät arëëne ni døøge pääny.
english: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïc Juuda ki uutwänni yi øt Jocep, Jocep ki dëëre poot nutö kaace, ni ö geni ni leeŋge rege piny nyïme.
english: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïyu en? ?Aŋø, kuyu ni aana dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man ŋäc gïrpiny mo tïïc no okanø?»
english: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

anywaa: Ni kö Juuda, na «?Agïnaŋø noo caanwa këët jï kwääcwa? ?Waano loopwa ŋø? ?Rewa owaanywa gø nidïï? Kiper Jwøk bääyö mar laaŋe moï ee nø joot. 'Ba ennø waani bëët ki ŋata joot ogubayu cere waano tïmö na laak kwääcwa.»
english: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord's servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep aköö, «Manøgøøni ba doo løny jïra ki man tïïa gø. Ŋata joot ogubayu cere keere beeye noo tïïa na laŋŋa. 'Ba uuni bëët, cou baŋ wääu ki met ec.»
english: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

anywaa: Køøre Juuda anyiik buut Jocep, ni kööe, «Wui, kwäärö, a kwaya ïïni, wec aani na näk laŋŋï nee dwøra caana jïrï, ni ba gootï ki aani, kiper ïïni ï caala Peerø ki dëëre.
english: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord's ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ï na kwäärö, waani na laaŋe moï, waana pëënynyï ni kööï, ni ‹?Jïïu da wääu, wala owääu?›
english: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

anywaa: Ni caanwa gø jïrï, ni ‹Wääwa dagø ma jaal, ko owääwa mo thiinh ma aŋuudö; 'ba coki athøw, ni bee eni keere na dööŋ jï menni; ni wänni mëër ki gø døc.›
english: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

anywaa: «Køøre ïïna köö jï laaŋe moï, ni ‹Kälu eni baŋa kany kiper nee eni jooda.›
english: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

anywaa: Ni caanwa gø jï kwääcwa, ni ‹Nyilaal ba løny ki man aae buut wänni, kiper ni näk mo aay buut wänni, wänni thøw.›
english: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

anywaa: Køøre ïïna köö jï laaŋe moï, ‹Ni näk owääu mana thiinh ba ö kany ki uuni, uuni täärnyïma ba dou neenø këët.›
english: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

anywaa: 'Ba na døøwa baŋ laŋŋï ma wääwa, luubö mana caanï, ï na kwäärö, acaanwa jïre.
english: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

anywaa: «'Ba na kö wääwa, ni ‹Cou, døøu Ijep ni ŋëëwu ki cam mo thiinh jïïø,›
english: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

anywaa: waana köö jïre, ni ‹Wa ba cii këët. 'Ba ni näk mo owääwa mana thiinh aay ki waani, waani wa cøø. Kiper ni näk owääwa mana thiinh ba aay ki waani, täärnyïm nyenøce ba løny ki man neenwa gø.›
english: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man's face, except our youngest brother be with us.

anywaa: «Køøre laŋŋï ma wääwa aköö jïwa, ni ‹Ŋäyu no obwöre ariiø keerge na nywølwa ki cïïa;
english: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

anywaa: maya aay buuta ni kära eni joodø këët këël kawaane; ni mana ŋääa kipere beeye ni eno cööt lääyi na thäŋi møn.
english: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

anywaa: Ni näk coki källu kälö thuwø buuta, ni päth gïn mo lethi bääte, a ni wïïa da lwaar en, a puta tïmö naa thuunhnha uuni, ni thøøa naa kïmmö.›
english: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø ni näk aano døø baŋ laŋŋï ma wära, ni nyilaal kär døøk ki waani, køøre nø, kaawat man bëëde ni kwøw mare ena ri nut nyilaal mare,
english: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad's life;

anywaa: noo joot gø ni nyilaal kär öö ki waani, eni puta thøø, ni ö wääwa na näk wïïe da lwaar ni put thuunh waani, ni thøøe ni kïmmö.
english: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

anywaa: Aani na laŋŋï, aana tïmö na waaci mar nyilaal jï wära, ni kööa, ni ‹Ni näk eni ba duua baŋï, ajäla otïmö ni ena bääta nyïmï na bäre bäre.›
english: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba kawaane ennø a kwaya ïïni, beerra man tïma ni aana laŋ kwääya na kar nyilaal, ni weyï eni nee aae ki uutwänni.
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

anywaa: ?Kiper aano døøa baŋ wära nidïï ni näk nyilaal tøør buuta? Aana lwäyö kiper gïna raac mano neena noo tägi dëër wära.»
english: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni kär løny jï Jocep ki man mak cwïnye këët buut jøøa cuŋŋö buute, ni ö eni ni tïŋ dwøre maal døc ni kööe, «Beerra man aac jøwi buuta bëët.» Ni aac jiyi bëët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mør mo odööŋ buute. Køøre dëëre acaane jï uutwänni.
english: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

anywaa: Ni jwöŋe ni dwøre ena maal døc, ni wïnynyi ya jø Ijepi, ni caani jï jø po Peerø.
english: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jï uutwänni, ni «Aana Jocep.» Ni kööe, ni «?Wära poot kwøw møn?» 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo løk uutwänni jïre, kiper geni cwïnyge abwøk nyïme.
english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aköö jï uutwänni, «Nyänhnhu buuta kany.» Køøre gena nyiik buute. Ni kööe, ni «Aana owääu ma Jocep ŋata gathu na kïth Ijep.
english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, këël na bëëde naa you gadhø, kär cwïnynyu pädhö ni gootu ki dëëtu keeru, kiper Jwøk aana jääŋŋe nyïmmu kiper nee jiy kwøwge ki køøra.
english: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

anywaa: Kiper meel atïmö ni dagø piny bäre ki cwiiyi na ariiø ii, ni poot da cwiiri ma abïïc mo poot no odööŋ ni bäŋ puur wala kac beel.
english: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aana jääŋŋe nyïmmu kiper nou bøthu ni dööŋŋu nou kwøw bäät piny ki køør køny mare na dwøŋ.
english: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, paa uuni na jääŋ aani kany, 'ba beeye Jwøk, ni bee eni na tïïc aani kaamar wää Peerø, ni näga kwäärö yi paare bäre, ni tïïc aani ni aana kwäärö bäät ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: «Ennø, laaru ci baŋ wära ni caannu gø jïre, ni ‹Wäädï ma Jocep aköö, ni «Aana tïïc Jwøki na kwäärö yi Ijep bäre. Ö baŋa pööthi. Kärï ruu.
english: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

anywaa: Ïïno bëëdö yi ŋööm Göcën, ni karï cään ki aani, ïïni, ki nyïïï, ki nyïïkwaayï, ki dïëgï, ki dhäk moï, ki gïïa en jïrï bëët.
english: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

anywaa: Ni aani ïïno kønya kunöce, kiper poot da cwiic meel abïïc mo poot no odööŋ mo öö, niï ba tïmï niï can ki gïn cam, ïïni wala tuuŋu wala gïïa en jïrï bëët.» ›
english: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

anywaa: «Kawaane ajootu ki nyeŋŋu, ni jooti ya coka ma Benjamen ni beeye aani ki dëëra na cäänö ki uuni en.
english: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

anywaa: Kwär mara yi Ijep ki gïïa jootu bëët dou caanø jï wära. 'Ba ennø, laaru aay ni kälu wära kany.»
english: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep dëëtge agäämge ki coki ma Benjamen ni jwöŋe, ni ö Benjamenni ni jwöŋe ni dëëtge ege gäämö ki coki.
english: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni nuum dhøk uutwänni bëët ni jwöŋe bäätge. Køøre uut wänni atägö ki man wääge ki eni.
english: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö luummögø na wïnye po Peerø, ni cöök Jocepi ki uutwänni bëët aöö, Peerø yie atïmö ni met, këël jø kööre moe bëët.
english: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø jï Jocep, «Caanï jï uutwäru, ni Peerø aköö, ni ‹Kïthu bäät lääy mou ki beel, ni døøu ŋööm Keenan,
english: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

anywaa: ni kälu wääu ki tuuŋu baŋa. Køøre uuno mooa ki ŋøøm mo beyø døc yi Ijep, ni cam maru oen ri gïïa beyø paani.› »
english: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Peerø köö jï Jocep, ni «Wär caanï jïge thuwø, ni kööï, ni ‹Kädu Ijep ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi kiper nyïïu moa therø ki määru, ni kälu wääu ni ööu. Beerra man tïïyu gïnögø.
english: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper jammi mou, kiper jammi moa beyø na en yi ŋööm Ijep bäre otïmö na mou.› »
english: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

anywaa: Køøre wäät Icriel gïnögø atïïcge. Ni ö Jocepi ni cïp jïëth wø tut okwëënyi jïge kaawat mana caan Peerø, ni mooc geni ki cam kiper wääth marge.
english: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

anywaa: Ni mooc ŋati man nø ka abïïe mo beyø mo røø dëëre. 'Ba Benjamen amooe ki gwel ma dïpe adäk ka abïïe abïïc mo beyø.
english: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

anywaa: Ni jääk baŋ wänni ki gïï mo thööth. Ni gïïa jääŋŋe baŋ wänni kiper wääth mare beege arëëni apaar mo bäätge päŋ ki jap Ijep moa beyø, ka arëëni apaar ma mädhi mo bäätge päŋ ki beel ki dääpe ki cam.
english: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

anywaa: Køøre eni uutwänni awëëk wääth ni aacge. 'Ba na aacge, ena köö jïge, «Käru pïëmö øtjöö.»
english: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

anywaa: Køøre gena aay ni wecge Ijep ni öge Keenan baŋ wääge ma Jeekap.
english: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

anywaa: Ni caange gø jïre, ni «Jocep poot kwøw, ni bee eni na kwäärö yi ŋööm Ijep bäre.» 'Ba wääge cwïnye abwøk, kiper gïna caange käre ŋäädhö.
english: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not.

anywaa: Køøre luup bëët moa caan Jocepi jïge acaange jïre. 'Ba kanya ö wääge ma Jeekap na joot jïëth wø tut okwëënyi moa jääŋ Jocepi nee eni kääri ki ge, jwïëy moe aput duu ree.
english: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

anywaa: Ni kö wääge ma Icriel, «Arømø nø. Wääda ma Jocep poot kwøw. Kawaane a cøø nee eni neena kany poode naa poot kär thøw en.»
english: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

anywaa: Køøre Icriel atïŋŋö ni aae ki gïïa en jïre bëët; ni ö yi Bëërcïïba ni cïpe ko olämme jï Jwø wänni ma Aydhak.
english: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer–sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni cääne ki Icriel ki wäär ki yïth lääk, ni kööe, «Jeekap! Jeekap!» Ni kö Jeekapi, ni «Aani en.»
english: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö, «Aana Jwøk, Jwøa näk Jwø wäru. Kärï lwäyö ki man ciï Ijep, kiper ïïno tïïa na wï jur mo dwøŋ kunöce.
english: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

anywaa: Aani aano cäädhi ki ïïni kanyo ciï Ijep, ni cäŋa ïïni duuö ki kunöce thuwø, ni ö Jocepi ni ŋen nyeŋŋï ki ceŋŋe kiree.»
english: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap atïŋŋö ki yi Bëërcïïba. Ni ö wääte ni kïthge eni, ko obwöre moge, ki määrge yïth jïëth wø tut okwëënyi moa jääŋ Peerø nee wääge kääri ki ge.
english: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ki nyïïkwaaye bëët ni lwørge dhäk moge ki jammi moge moa jootge yi ŋööm Keenan, ni öge Ijep.
english: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

anywaa: Ni bee eni ki wääte, ki wäät wääte, ki nyïïe, ki nyïï wääte. Ni ö eni ni käl nyïïkwaaye bëët Ijep.
english: His sons, and his sons' sons with him, his daughters, and his sons' daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

anywaa: Nyeŋ wäät Icriel, ni beeye Jeekap, ki nyeŋ wäät wääte na ci Ijep beege ii. Nyeŋ kanynye beeye Ruben.
english: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob's firstborn.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Ruben beege Anök, ki Pallu, ki Eedharan, ki Karmi.
english: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Pallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Cimien beege Jemuël, ki Jamin, ko Okat, ki Jaakin, ki Dhöar, ki Caul, o dhaaŋŋa näk nyi jø Keenan.
english: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Libay beege Gërcön, ki Kät, ki Mërari.
english: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Juuda beege Er, ki Önan, ki Ceela, ki Peereth, ki Dheera. 'Ba Er ki Önan, gena thøw yi ŋööm Keenan. 'Ba wäät Peereth beege Eedharan, ki Amul.
english: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zerah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Icakar beege Töla, ki Puwa, ki Jööp, ki Cimrön.
english: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Dhebulan beege Cërët, ki Ëlön, ki Jaalël.
english: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

anywaa: Ruben, ki Cimien, ki Libay, ki Juuda, ki Icakar, ki Dhebulan beege wäät Liia, na nywøle ki Jeekap yi Padan-Aram, ni nyaare ma Dina nywøle ka gø thuwø. Ni kwään jagøgø bëët ki wäätge beege pïëradäk kurdäk.
english: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

anywaa: Nyeŋ wäät Gaat beege Dhepön, ka Agi, ki Cuni, ki Ëdhbön, ki Ëri, ka Arödi ka Arëli.
english: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Acer beege Yimna, ki Yecuwa, ki Yecuwi, ki Beria; ni nyeŋ cöök jagøgø mana näk dhaagø beeye Cëëra. 'Ba wäät Beria beege Eber ki Melkiël.
english: And the sons of Asher; Imnah, and Ishuah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

anywaa: Gaat ka Acer beege wäät Dhelpa, dhaaŋŋa näk ŋat tïïc na cïp Leeban jï nyaare ma Liia, ni beege wääte na nywøle ki Jeekap; ni kwään jagøgø bëët ki wäätge beege apaar ka abïciel.
english: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

anywaa: Wäät Reecal cï Jeekap beege Jocep ki Benjamen.
english: The sons of Rachel Jacob's wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jocep na nywøle yi ŋööm Ijep beege Maneeca ki Ipariem, na nywølge ka Acenath, nyi Pötipëëra, kwääc lam mar pääny Ön.
english: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him.

anywaa: Ni wäät Benjamen beege Bëla, ki Bëkër, ka Acbël, ki Gëra, ki Neeman, ka Aki, ki Röc, ki Mupim, ki Upim, ka Art.
english: And the sons of Benjamin were Bela, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

anywaa: Jocep ki Benjamen beege wäät Reecal na nywøle ki Jeekap; ni kwään jagøgø bëët ki wäätge beege jiy apaar kurŋween.
english: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

anywaa: Nyeŋ o Daan beeye Ucim.
english: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Naptali beege Jaadhël, ki Guni, ki Jedher, ki Cilëm.
english: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

anywaa: Daan ki Naptali beege wäät Bila, dhaaŋŋa näk ŋat tïïc na cïp Leeban jï nyaare ma Reecal; ni beege wääte na nywøle ki Jeekap; ni kwään jagøgø bëët ki wäätge beege abïriiø.
english: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

anywaa: Kwään jiy bëët moa näk jic Jeekap, na näk dhi øde na ö Ijep, beege jiy ma pïërabïciel ka abïciel; 'ba määr wääte kär kwaan dëëtge.
english: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob's sons' wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

anywaa: Ni wäät Jocep na nywøle Ijep beege ariiø. Ni tuuŋ Jeekap bëët na ö Ijep beege jiy ma pïërabïriiø.
english: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeekap Juuda ajääŋŋe nyïme baŋ Jocep, kiper nee øtjöör Göcën nyoodhe jïge; ni ö geni ni pïïcge yi ŋööm Göcën.
english: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Jocep jääne ni wø tut okwëënyi ajiiŋŋe ni ci kuna røømge ki wänni ma Icriel yi Göcën; 'ba kanya pïïe buute, wänni agääme ki ŋut gø ni jwöŋe ki kany mo bäär mëëth.
english: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

anywaa: Ni kö Icrielli jï Jocep, ni «Kawaane kaawat mana jooda täärnyïmï niï poot kwøw, këël a doo thøw køør man nø, bäŋ gïre.»
english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aköö jï uutwänni ki tuuŋ wänni bëët, ni «Aani a cøøa kuna caana gø jï Peerø, ni kööa, ni ‹Nyïïmera ki tuuŋ wära, jøøa en yi ŋööm Keenan, gena ö baŋa.
english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father's house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father's house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

anywaa: 'Ba gena jiy ma dïkwääc dïëk, ni tïïc marge beeye kwaac lääc paac. 'Ba pïïth dïëk moge ki dhäk moge bëët akälge, ki japa en jïge bëët.›
english: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

anywaa: 'Ba noo ö Peerø noo cwøl uuni ni pëëny uuni, ni ‹?Tïïc mana ŋäyu a tïïa ŋø?›,
english: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

anywaa: wäru kööu, ni ‹Tïïc mar laagï beeye kwaac lääc paac ki mana kälge thïnhö këël kawaane; ni beeye tïïc mana ŋäcwa, këël kwäcwa thuwø.› Kiper ni näk luummögø caannu caannø, løny jïïu ki man bëëdu ŋööm Göcën. Kiper tïï dïkwääy beeye gïn mo raac døc ki baŋ jø Ijep.»
english: That ye shall say, Thy servants' trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aci baŋ Peerø ni caan gø jïgø, ni «Wära ki uutwära ki coka gena öö ki yi Keenan ki dïëk ki dhäk moge ki gïïa en jïge bëët; ni kawaane ge ena yi ŋööm Göcën.»
english: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep alwötö ki jiy abïïc dï uutwänni ni kïth ge baŋ Peerø.
english: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø jïge, ni «?Tïïc mana ŋäyu a tïïa ŋø?» Ni köge jï Peerø, ni «Waani na laagï, waana dïkwääc dïëk, kaamar kwäcwa.»
english: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge köö jï Peerø, «Waana öö ki man bëëtwa yi ŋöömö marï; kiper meel atïmö ni dwøŋ yi ŋööm Keenan, ni bäŋ luum mo cam dïëki mowa, wa na laaŋe moï. 'Ba kawaane wa kwaya ïïni ki man ö laagï ni bëëtge yi ŋööm Göcën.»
english: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Jocep, «Wäru ki uutwäru ki coku aö baŋï.
english: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

anywaa: Ŋööm Ijep ena cerï; mooc wäru ki uutwäru ki coku ki ŋöömö mo beer døc. Beerra man ö geni ni bëëtge yi ŋööm Göcën. 'Ba ni näk da jiy dïge mo ŋäyï mo nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, geni wär tïïyï na jiy mo lääc paac 'moa bëët ena ceŋge.»
english: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep wänni ma Jeekap akäl nyïm Peerø, ni ö Jeekapi ni gwïëth Peerø.
english: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø jï Jeekap, ni «?Cwiiri moa beetï adïï?»
english: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi jï Peerø, ni «Cwiiri moa beeda beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëradäk, naa bëëdö naa wïdö jaak. 'Ba cwiiri moa beeda beege cwiiri mo nøk, ni beeda ki bëëtö mo leth; ni cwiiri moøgø nøka geni ki cwiiri moa beet kwäya dïkwøŋ ni ge wïdö jaak.»
english: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni gwïëth Peerø, ni aae nyïm gø.
english: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep wänni ki uutwänni ki coki amooe ki kar bëëtö, ni mooc ge ki kurge yi ŋööm Ijep, na ŋöömö mo beer døc yi ŋööm Ramcë, kaa mana caani Peerø jïre.
english: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni gwøk wänni ki uutwänni ki jic wänni bëët, ni mooc geni ki cam mo orømø kiperge ki nyïïge bëët.
english: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father's household, with bread, according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgøøni ŋööm Ijep bäre atïmö ni bäŋ cam yie, kiper meel atïmö ni dwøŋ døc, ni tïm ŋööm Ijepi ki ŋööm Keenan no ogwäl ki cam kiper meel na päl.
english: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni cooŋ gwel bëët mo jø Ijep ki jø Keenan na kar beel moa ŋeewge; ni ö Jocepi ni kïth gwel bëët yi øt Peerø.
english: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö gwelli bëët na thumge ceŋ jø Ijep ki jø Keenan, jø Ijep bëët aö baŋ Jocep, ni köge, «Mooc wa ki cam. ?Aŋø ni thøwa buutï jaak en? Kiper gwel mowa athum bëët.»
english: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jocepi jïge, ni «Kiper mana näk mo gwel mou onø thumö, kälu lääc paac mou, nou mooa ki caammi na karge.»
english: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

anywaa: Køøre geni lääc paac moge akälge baŋ Jocep, ni ö Jocepi ni mooc geni ki cam na kar okwëënyi moge, ki dïëk moge, ki dhäk moge, ka arëëni moge. Ni ö eni ni mooc geni ki cam na kar lääy moge bëët ki yi cwiinøgø.
english: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aŋuun cwiinøgø, gena cäŋ ö baŋe yi cwiir maya ni köge jïre, «Waani bäŋ gïn mo dewa kanø ki kwääcwa, kiper gwetwa athum, ni lääc paac mowa bëët atïmö na mo kwääcwa. Bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ jïwa këët, 'ba beeye dëëtwa ki ŋøøm mowa keere.
english: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni thøwa buutï jaak en, ni räny ŋøøpwa en? Ŋeew waani ki ŋøøm mowa nee wa jïtwa ki cam, kiper nee wa tïmwa na laaŋe jï Peerø, ni tïm ŋøøpwa na moe. Mooc waani ki köödhi, kiper nee wa kwøwa nee wa ba thøwa, kiper nee ŋöömö ba ränynye.»
english: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni ŋeew ŋööm Ijep bäre jï Peerø, kiper jø Ijep bëët pwöth moge aŋeewge, kiper meel atïmö ni päl bäätge, ni dööŋ pwöthi mo Ijep na mo Peerø.
english: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh's.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni käl jiy yïth päänye ki dï Ijep bäre, ni tägi ki cuŋŋe maya këël cuŋŋe maya.
english: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ŋøøp dïlämme keerge na käre ŋeeø, kiper cam mar dïlämme wø jootge baŋ Peerø, ni cam marge ena cer Peerø cooth. Ni beeye tiere na kärge ŋøøm moge ŋeeø.
english: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aköö jï jiy, «Kawaane uuna ŋeea ki ŋøøpu bëët jï Peerø. Källu köödhi en, ni piithu pwöth nø.
english: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na kar kac, bïï thäŋi wär cïpu jï Peerø, ni dööŋ ŋweerge jïïu na köödhi kiper pwöth mou, kiper nee uuni ki tuuŋu ki nyïïu nou jïtu ki cam thuwø.»
english: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, «Jwïëy mowa agwøgï møn. Beerra man bëët Peerø ni yie met ki waani, ni bëëtwa ni waana laaŋe jïre.»
english: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.

anywaa: Ba ciik mana cïp Jocepi kar kaaca yi ŋööm Ijep atïmö na ciik mo poot nut këël dïcäŋi en. Ni ciik manøgø beeye ni Peerø jïre doo da bïï thäŋi. 'Ba ŋøøp dïlämme keerge kär tïmö na mo Peerø.
english: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh's.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel abëëdö Ijep, yi ŋööm Göcën, ni meetge rege ni nyaayge ni thööth ni kwärge.
english: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeekapi ni bëëde Ijep ki cwiiri apaar ka abïriiø; 'ba cwiiri moa beede ni kwøw beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëraŋween ka abïriiø.
english: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cään kar thøw Icrielli, eni wääde ma Jocep acwøle ni kööe, «Ni näk yiï met ki aani, cïp cerï bäät ääma ni kööŋï ki man tïïyï gïn mo beer ma adïëri kipera, ni ba koonyï aani yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man koonyï aani buut wära ki kwara. Käl aani ni kïthï aani wøk ki yi Ijep, ni koonyï aani kanya koony geni yie.» Ni løk gø jïgø, no «Otïïa kaawat mana caanï enø.»
english: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi, «Kööŋ ŋëëta.» Ni ö Jocepi ni kööŋ ŋëët gø. Køøre Icriel cøŋŋe akëël piny wï pëëme ni pwøc Jwøk.
english: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed's head.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgøøni acaan jï Jocep, ni «Wäru tuu døc.» Ni ö Jocepi ni lwør wääte riet na näk Maneeca ki Ipariem, ni put aay ki geni.
english: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni acaan jï Jeekap, ni «Wäädï ma Jocep aö baŋï.» Køøre Icriel dëëre anithïk, ni ö maal ni bëëde bäät pëëm.
english: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeekapi jï Jocep, «Jwøk na en teeki jïre ree anyoodhe jïra yi Löja yi ŋööm Keenan ni gwïëth aani,
english: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

anywaa: ni kööe jïra, ‹Ïïno tïïa niï kännï ki nyïëdi, ni nyaayï, ni tïmï na lwaa wï jur, ni cïba ŋööm Keenan jïge, ge na nyïïkwaayï moo ööi køørï, ni tïm ŋöömö na marge na bäre bäre.›
english: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

anywaa: «'Ba kawaane Maneeca ki Ipariem na näk wäätï moa nywølï yi ŋööm Ijep kanya pooda naa poot kär ö baŋï Ijep, gena 'moa. Geno tïmö na 'moa kaamar wääta ma Ruben ge ki Cimien.
english: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

anywaa: 'Ba moo cäŋï nywøllø køørge, beege moï geni. Ni ŋöömö mano dööŋ jïge na marge ojootge ki køør Maneeca ki Ipariem.
english: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

anywaa: Kiper kanya ööa ki yi Padan, kanya poode ni piny poot bäär mëëth naa poot kär pïï Eeparata, meru ma Reecal athøø buuta øtjöö yi ŋööm Keenan, ni koonya gø kaace øtjöör Eeparata, paana cwøl ni Bethelem.»
english: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth–lehem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Icrielli na joot wäät Jocep, ena köö, ni «?Moi aŋaani?»
english: And Israel beheld Joseph's sons, and said, Who are these?

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jï wänni, «Beege wääta moa cïp Jwøki jïra kany.» Ni kö Icrielli, «Beerra man kälï geni baŋa, kiper nee ge gwïëdha.»
