english: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgøøni nyeŋ Icriel onø tïmö ni rääbö, ni eni ba rääŋö ni beer. Ni ö Jocepi ni käl wääte kany mo cään ki wänni, ni ö eni ni nuum dhøkge ni gääm geni.
english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

anywaa: Ni kö Icrielli jï Jocep, «Aani kära caarø ni täärnyïmï jooda joodø, 'ba ennø Jwøk aana käle ki man jooda wäätï thuwø.»
english: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep wääte adaae bäät cøŋ wänni, ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm gø.
english: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

anywaa: Ni lwør wääte riet ni käl geni buut wänni, ni Ipariem ena bäät cer cwïïe kuna dïët ki bäät caam Icriel, ni ö Maneeca ni en bäät caame kuna dïët ki bäät cer cwïï Icriel.
english: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand, and brought them near unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Icriel ceŋŋe agwäye ni rwaak cere mana näk cwïïe ni cïp gø bäät wï Ipariem ŋata thiinh, ni cïp caame bäät wï Maneeca, këël na bëëde ni Maneeca beeye kaa.
english: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim's head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh's head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni gwïëth Jocep ni kööe, «Jwøa cääth kwara ma Eeberam ki wära ma Aydhak køøre, Jwøa bwøth aani ki yïth nïne bëët këël dïcäŋi en,
english: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

anywaa: na näk nyïïatwiella køny aani yïth gïïa reyø bëët, beerra man gwïëth obwöre moi, ni bëët nyeŋŋa ki nyeŋ kwara ma Eeberam ki nyeŋ wära ma Aydhak ni di cwølø ki køørge, ni tïmge ni thööth na lwaak mo päl dï piny bäre.»
english: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jocepi na neen wänni ni cere mana näk cwïïe ee cïp bäät wï Ipariem, yie atïmö ni ba met ki gø; ni mak cer wänni kiper nee daae wï Ipariem nee kïth wï Maneeca.
english: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father's hand, to remove it from Ephraim's head unto Manasseh's head.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jï wänni, «Manøgø paa kare Awuuö, kiper Maneeca beeye kaa. Cïp cer cwïïï bäät wïïe.»
english: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

anywaa: 'Ba wänni akweer ni kööe, «Ŋääa, wääda. Ŋääa ni Maneeca beeye kaa. Eni thuwø tïmö na lwaak mo dwøŋ; 'ba coki mana thiinh en otïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni, ni tïm nyïïkwaaye na lwaa jiy mo thööth.»
english: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

anywaa: Køøre gena gwïëdhe dïcäŋögø, ni kööe, «Jø Icriel ogwëëth rou ni köge, ni ‹Jwøk uuno tïïe kaamar Ipariem ki Maneeca.› » Ki køør manøgøøni Icriel Ipariem atïïe ni ena nyïm ki Maneeca.
english: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

anywaa: Køøre Icriel aköö jï Jocep, «Ennø, kara aløny ni cään ki man thøøa, 'ba Jwøk obëëdö buutï, ni cäŋ ïïni dwøk yi ŋööm kwäyu.
english: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö mana lwøra ri leny baŋ jø Amör acïba jïrï ni kaala mana cïba jï uutwäru.»
english: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap wääte acwøle, ni kööe, ni «Cooŋŋu rou kanya ciel buuta, kiper nee gïïo tägi dëëtu yi nyïme nee caana jïïu.
english: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

anywaa: «Beerra man cooŋŋu rou ni cegu ïthu, u na wäät Jeekap; ni leŋŋu mar wääu ma Icriel.
english: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

anywaa: «Nyie, Ruben, beeye ïïni na kanynya, ni bee ï teek mara, ni ïïna ŋata kwøŋa nywøl dïkwøŋ na näk wïth laaya. Ïïna jïtö ki wödö ki teek mo kaala wääta møga.
english: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna dhaanhø mo waŋŋi niï caala pïï; karï ba tïmö ni ena maal këët, kiper ïïna døny bäät cï wäru, ni päätï gø ki køør mana ciï baŋe.
english: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

anywaa: «Cimien ki Libay beege nyïïmëëe. Tøøŋi moge atïïcge na gïï nääŋge jiy ki ge jaak.
english: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

anywaa: A ba doo pïïa piny ki geni ciel kany wø cuŋge; ni ba dwäta ki geni kar acooŋa marge, kiper jiy anäkge jaak kanya wëërge, ni ŋørge ojwöc dhäk jaak ki køør dïwït marge.
english: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

anywaa: Acïën Jwøk en bäät wëër marge, kiper gena wëër ki wëër mo teek døc; ni ö ajäla mare ni en bäät wëër marge na raac. Geno pääŋŋa yi ŋööm Jeekap, ni keetha geni dï jø Icriel.
english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

anywaa: «Ïïni na Juuda, ïïno pwøc nyïïmeru ki uutwäru; cerï oen bäät ŋut nyïïmännï. Nyïïmeru ki uutwäru wïthge okuulge piny nyïmï.
english: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.

anywaa: Juuda rööma nyi ŋuu mo teek, ni caala ŋuu mo ö maal no ojäŋ ki rïŋö. Ena gääŋ, ni tïme kaamar ŋuu mo omøør piny. Ni bëëde kaamar ŋuu ma maath. ?Aŋø, aŋa ni ba lwäär ki man jiec gø?
english: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

anywaa: Athøc kwär ba aay cer Juuda, ni kwär ba aay dhi øde, këël mano ö ŋat ma athøc kwär dööŋ jïre; ni tïm jiyi bëët ni leŋa ciik moe.
english: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

anywaa: Arëën mare, man wø cäädhe ki bäät gø, wø twöe twöö ro omøk, ni twöc nya arëën mare ro omøk mana näk nyïëdi moe beyø døc. Abïïe moe penye ka køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni peny abïïe moe ki pï nyïïomøki moa kwaar.
english: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

anywaa: Nyeŋŋe mïërö ni kaala køøŋ nyïïomøki mo tøŋ døc, ni lage tar ni kaala caak.
english: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

anywaa: «Dhebulan obëëdö lak ageel naama dwøŋ, ni tïme na dhi waath jï baabuure, ni keew mare ena jï kuna en Caydan.
english: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

anywaa: «Icakar bëëdö kaamar arëën mo teek, mo obut piny jaak yïthakic baae moe moa kääre.
english: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

anywaa: Kany wø joot kar jwömö mare ni beer, ni neen ŋöömö ni mïërö, køøre gööge dwøge piny kiper nee kääde ki baae, ni tïme na laŋŋø mo tïïö ka gïti.
english: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

anywaa: «Daan otïmö na kwääc løøk mar jø poge, kaa mana bëëde ni ena wï tuuŋ aciel ki røk tuŋi mo Icriel.
english: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Daan otïmö kaamar thwöl mo ena øtjöö, na thwöl mo dhee da cïm mo bëëdö thääŋ jöö, ni kac tier okweeny; ni ö ŋata en bäät okweenynyi ni päth piny ŋää okweeny.
english: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, Awuuö Jwøk, a koora køny marï.
english: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

anywaa: «Gaat, dïtwïëte ööa paare ni twierge eni; 'ba eno läp køørge ni läw geni twier.
english: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

anywaa: «Acer, cam mare otïmö ni päl døc, ni jïte ki cam mo orømø man wø cam nyeya.
english: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

anywaa: «Naptali otïmö kaamar purra mo opädö ni cäädhö jaak; ni nyööte ki nyïïe mo beyø.
english: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

anywaa: «Jocep otïmö na bat jaath mo kännö ki nyïëdi, na bat jaath mo kännö ki nyïëdi mo ena bäät pïï mo kwödö; ni bäädi moe olaa bäät kal.
english: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

anywaa: Nyïïmän moe mo ceŋge da jap leny akëëdö ki eni døc, ni thööcge eni ka athëëre, ni cwaatge yi gø døc.
english: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

anywaa: 'Ba gïr leny mare poot bëëdö ni ee maa ni teek ni kär dak cere, ni bääte ee maa ni teek ni cere rwäänhnhö ri leny; ni teege joode ka køør teek man wø cïp ŋata en teeki jïre, ni beeye Jwø Jeekap, eni na dïkwääy ni wø gwøk jø Icriel.
english: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

anywaa: Ï na Jocep, teek marï ojootï baŋ Jwøa näk Jwø wäru, Jwø wø køny ïïni, ni beeye Jwøa en teeki jïre ni wø gwïëth ïïni, na ŋato gwïëth ïïni ki gwïëth mo ööi ki maal, ki gwïëth mo käla piny thuwø; ni gwïëth ïïni ni jïtï ko obwöre ki lääc paac mo thööth.
english: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

anywaa: Gwïëth mo wäru bëëdö ni teeka geni ki kïte moa kwøŋ bëëtö cøøn, ni kaala thuuri mo wø bëëdö na bäre bäre. Beerra man bëët gwïëthi moøgø bäät Jocep, ni tïmge ni ena bääte, eni na näk dwøŋŋa kare ki uutwänni.
english: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

anywaa: «Benjamen otïmö ni caala orudö mo owär, mo maga lääy ka amöölla ni cam gø ki law ec. 'Ba no tïme na wïthïënhö, jammi moa twiere di pääŋŋö.»
english: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

anywaa: Jøøgø bëët beege wïth tuŋi apaar kurriiø mo Icriel, ni luupögø beege moa caan wääge jïge kanya gwïëth geni. Gena gwïëdhe ki gwïëth mo orømø ki ŋati man nø.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

anywaa: Køøre gena köömme ni kööe jïge, «Aani kara cään ki man thøøa. Beerra man koonyu aani buut wära ki kwara yi kään kïdi na en yi pwöth Ëprön nyï Këth,
english: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

anywaa: ni beeye käänna en kanya cwøl ni Makpila na en buut Mamrë yi ŋööm Keenan. Kää manøgø aŋeew Eeberammi na aciel ki pwöth Ëprön baŋ Ëprön nyï Këth na kany koony ge yie.
english: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

anywaa: Køøre Eeberam akoonyge kaace ki cïïe ma Ceera. Ni kaace beeye kanya koony Aydhak yie ki cïïe ma Rebëëka. Køøre Liia akoonya kaace thuwø.
english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

anywaa: Pwödhö manøgø ki käänna en yie beege moa ŋeew baŋ jø Këth.»
english: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jeekapi na lønye ki kööm wääte, eni tiete adwøk maal bäät pëëm, ni nyaaŋ ree piny, ni put jwïëy ka aŋuudi, ni thøøe, ni läp køør jø poge.
english: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Jocep apäth nyïm wänni ni jwöŋe bäät gø, ni nuum dhi gø.
english: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni kööm jø tïïc moe mo wø ŋäc tïï akïïm ki man jiiŋge dëër wänni kiper nee ba kwääe; køøre jøøgø dëër Icriel ajiiŋge.
english: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc manøgø manynya nïne ma pïëraŋween ki man jiiŋ dëër dhaanhø mo othøw. Kanyøgøøni jø Ijep Icriel ajwøkge ki nïne ma pïërabïriiø.
english: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

anywaa: 'Ba na thum nïne moa jwøkge eni ki gø, Jocep acäänö ki jic Peerø ni kööe, «Kawaane ni näk mou mëër ki aani, caannu jï Peerø ni kööu,
english: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Jocep aköö ni wänni acäänö ki eni ni kööe, ni «Aani kar thøwa acäännö; wär aani koony yi käänna jiiŋŋa kipera yi ŋööm Keenan.» Ni ö Jocepi ni kööŋe ki man tïïc gïnögø. 'Ba kawaane eni kwaya ïïni ki man ci kunöce nee wänni koonye. Køøre eno duui.› »
english: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Peerø, ni «Ciï ni koonyï wäru kaa mana caane jïrï na kööŋï.»
english: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep aci kuna koony wänni, ni eni cäädhi ki jaae mo Peerø, ki jø tïïc moe, ki jaae mo ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

anywaa: Ni lööbe ki jø paare, ki coki ki uutwänni, ki tuuŋ wänni bëët. 'Ba obwöre keerge, ki pïïth dïëk moge, ki dhäk moge awiige piny ni dööŋge yi Göcën.
english: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

anywaa: Ni ö jø okwëënyi ki jïëth wø tut okwëënyi ni aacge ki eni thuwø na aciel. Ni ö lwaaki moa cäädhö ki eni ni tïmge ni thööth døc.
english: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge yi laara kar dïn mana en Atöt, na en løø Naam Jördan løøga, gena göö ko oduuru mo dwøŋ døc kaace, ni kïïnge gïr wää Jocep ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö wëëk ŋøømmi, ni beege jø Keenan, na jootge kïmmö mar jøøgø yi laara kar dïn mana en Atöt, gena köö, «Man beeye kïmmö mo dwøŋ døc jï jø Ijep.» Køøre nyeŋ kaace acwøl ni Abël-Midhirayim, ni tiere beeye kar kïmmö mar jø Ijep; ni kanyøgø ena løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Icrielli ni tïïcge gïnögø kiper wääge kaawat mana kööm geni.
english: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

anywaa: Ni käärge wääge ni kïthge gø yi ŋööm Keenan, ni koonyge gø yi kään kïdi yi pwötha en Makpila, na en buut Mamrë; ni beeye käänna ŋeew Eeberammi na aciel ki pwöth Ëprön baŋ Ëprön nyï Këth, na kany koony eni yie.
english: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

anywaa: 'Ba na løny Jocepi ki koony wänni, eni ki coki ki uutwänni ki jøøa aay ki eni bëët kuna koonyge wänni, gena døø Ijep.
english: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya neeni ya uutwää Jocepi ni wääge othøw, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «Kanymør Jocep gïïa reyø bëët na tïïø dëëre coole coolø dëëtø ni männe ki øøni.»
english: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

anywaa: Køøre gena jääk baŋ Jocep ki dwøl ni köge, ni «Wäru dwøre acaane kanya poode ni eni poot kär thøw ni kööe,
english: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Caannu jï Jocep ni wäru kwaya ïïni ki man weyï bääyö mar uutwäru ki gïïa reyø na tïïcge dëërï, këël na bëëde ni geno bääyö dëërï.› 'Ba ennø, wa kwaya ïïni ki man wëënnï bääyö marwa, waani na laak Jwø wäru.» Kanyøgø Jocep ajwöŋö kiper mana caange gïnögø jïre.
english: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

anywaa: Køøre uutwänni aöö ni leeŋge dëëtge piny nyïme ni köge, «Neenï, kawaane waana laagï.»
english: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep aköö jïge, «Käru lwäyö. ?Aŋø, aana tïmö naa ena kar Jwøk?
english: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

anywaa: Ki jïïu mana caarru ki cwïnynyu beeye ki man tïïu ki gïn mo raac dëëra, 'ba ki køør mana en cwïny Jwøk, gïnögø atïïe na gïn mo beer, kiper nee jiy mo thööth kwøwge kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, käru lwäyö. Uuno gwøa ki nyïïu moø ni therø yøø.» Gïnögø acaane jïge ki luup mo met ni cøma cwïnyge.
english: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jocep ki jø po wänni bëët gena bëëdö Ijep. Ni cwiic Jocep moa beede ni eni kwøw beege cwiiri ma dïpa ka apaar.
english: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni joot nyïïkwaac wääde ma Ipariem këël mana pïïe ri dää beenhnhe; ni ö wäät nyikwaare ma Makir o Maneeca ni cïp geni bäät ääme.
english: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.

anywaa: Ni kö Jocepi jï coki ki uutwänni, ni «Aani kar thøwa aløny ni cään, 'ba Jwøk ööa baŋu kuna køny uuni, ni käl uuni wøk yi ŋöömmi, ni kïth uuni yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jï Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap.»
english: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep acäänö ki wäät Icriel ni kööe, ni «Jwøk ööa baŋu kuna køny uuni. Kar kaaca cuu 'moa wär kwanynyu kany ni källu geni.» Ni ö Jocepi ni wëëk geni kööŋ ki man tïïcge gïnögø.
english: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep athøw ni cwiiye dïpa ka apaar. Ni jiiŋge dëëre ni kïthge gø ya acanduk yi Ijep.
english: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ wäät Icriel moa öö Ijep ki wääge ma Jeekap, ni ŋati man nø ööi ka jø paare,
english: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.

anywaa: beege Ruben, ki Cimien, ki Libay, ki Juuda;
english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,

anywaa: ki Icakar, ki Dhebulan, ki Benjamen;
english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,

anywaa: ki Daan, ki Naptali, ki Gaat, ka Acer.
english: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

anywaa: Kwään jiy bëët moa käl ri Jeekap beege jiy ma pïërabïriiø. 'Ba Jocep kar kaaca oløny ni ena Ijep.
english: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.

anywaa: Køøre Jocep ki coki ki uutwänni, ki beenhnhø mana enge yie bäre, gena thøw.
english: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Icriel gena nyöödö ni meetge rege ni thööth, ni nyaacge, ni tïmge ni teek døc; ni ö paaci bäre ni pääŋe ki geni.
english: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.

anywaa: 'Ba Ijep ajïtö ki nyeya mør mo nyään mo Jocep kuue.
english: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï jiye, ni «Ennø, jiy moa näk nyïïkwaac Icriel atïmö ni thööth ni teeka geni døc ni kaala øøni.
english: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:

anywaa: Ööu nø, nee ge tïïø ki riek waŋ, nee ge ba nyaacge, kiper ni näk mo da leny mo ööa baŋø, kanymør ge rööpö ki nyïïmän 'moø ni duuge dëëtø, ni päärge wøk paayø.»
english: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.

anywaa: Køøre jø Ijep aput röönyö ki jiy mo käär tïïe bäät nyïïkwaac Icriel, nee bëëtge ni ege caannø ki køør tïïe moo tïïcge na teek. Ni ö nyïïkwaac Icrielli ni gëëtge ki päänye mo cuŋ yïthge ki caammi jï Peerø, ni beege päänye moa cwøl ni Pithöm ki Raamcic.
english: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Rameses.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët jø Ijepi ni nyïïkwaac Icriel ege caannø døc, nyïïkwaac Icriel anyaay døc ni thöönhge, ni tïm jø Ijepi ni lwäär ki geni.
english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Ijepi ni caange nyïïkwaac Icriel ki køør tïïe moa teek na eelge bäätge.
english: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

anywaa: Ni tïïcge bëëtö mar nyïïkwaac Icriel ni teek døc ki køør tïïe moa teek na näk tïï thuube ko odhöönh man wø caam thuube ki gø, ki teeŋ tïïe møøk mo wø tïïc yïth pwöth, ni beege tïïe bëët mo wø tïïcge no oeel bäätge ni geno caannø.
english: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in mortar, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Ijep acäänö ki dïcööte mo jø Ibaru, mo nyeŋge cwøl ni Cipara ki Puwa;
english: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Kany wäru cøøllu määr Ibaru mo wø lwaar, noo jootu nyilaal mano ö wøk, ni näk ma dïcwøø, wär 'nägu; 'ba ni näk ma nyakøø, wär weyu ni kwøw.»
english: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcööte alwäyö ki Jwøk, ni kärge gïna caan nyeny Ijepi tïïö, ni wecge obwöre moa näk cwøw ni kwøw.
english: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Ijep dïcööte acwøle, ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø na tïïyu gïn en, ni weyu obwöre moa näk cwøw ni kwøw?»
english: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?

anywaa: Ni kö dïcööte jï Peerø, ni «Beeye kiper määr Ibaru ba caal määr Ijep; kiper geni ge teek, ni kanyo poode ni dïcöödi poot kär pïï buutge, ge laara lwaar.»
english: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk atïïö ki gïn mo beer kiper dïcööte, ni ö nyïïkwaac Icrielli ni nyaacge, ni tëënge døc.
english: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïm dïcööte ni ge lwäär ki Jwøk, Jwøk dhøk uudi mo dïcööte atïïe ni teek.
english: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø jiye bëët aceme, ni kööe, ni «Nyilaal mo onywølø na dïcwøø jaak røk jø Ibaru wär leeŋu yi naam, ni weyu nyakøø ni kwøw.»
english: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kar kanyøgø, dhaanhø ma ŋat tuuŋ Libay acøø ni nyöömme ki dhaagø ma nyi jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.

anywaa: Ni ö nyijøøgø ni jït yie ki dhaanhø ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø. 'Ba kanya joot gø na nyilaal mo mïërö, nyilaal akane ki dwäde adäk.
english: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni nyilaal ba løny ki kan jïre këët, ena lwötö ki gïn mo caala luul mo ocwääö ko otöök, ni rwøth gø ko odhöönh mo nwaaŋ ki dwøø. Køøre nyilaal apïël yi gø, ni cøøe ni kïth gø yo otöök mana näk otuy deŋ naam.
english: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.

anywaa: 'Ba cöök nyilaalli mana näk nyakøø acuŋŋö kany mo bäär mëëth ni neeta coki ki gïno tägi dëër gø.
english: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.

anywaa: Køøre nyi Peerø aö naam kuna lwöŋŋe, ni ö nyïïakuue moa näk jø tïïc moe ni cääthge bäät ageela. Ni ö nyi Peerø ni joot gïna näk caala luul yo otöök, ni jääŋ ŋat tïïc mare baŋ gø, ni ö nyaanøgø ni cøøe ni käl gø.
english: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jap gø, eni nyilaal ajoode, ni nyilaal jwöŋö. Ni päth cwïnye ki gïr gø ni kööe, ni «Man beeye nyilaal mar jø Ibaru.»
english: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.

anywaa: Køøre cöök nyilaarøgø aköö jï nyi Peerø, ni «?Ba beerra man cøøa naa cwöta ki nyi jø Ibaru mo kööre da caak, nee nyilaal dhwødhe jïrï?»
english: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?

anywaa: Ni kö nyi Peerø jï cöök nyilaarøgø, ni «Ciï nø.» Ni ö nyilaarøgø ni cøøe ni cwøl mii nyilaal.
english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.

anywaa: Køøre nyi Peerø aköö jï nyijøøgø, ni «Lwør nyilaal man ni aayï ki gø ni dhwøthï gø jïra. 'Ba aani, ïïno mooa ki jammi na kar tïïc marï.» Ni ö nyijøøgø ni lwør nyilaal ni aae ki gø, ni bëëde ni dhwøtha gø.
english: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.

anywaa: Ni ö nyilaalli ni rïënne, ni ö nyijøøgø ni kïth nyilaal baŋ nyi Peerø, ni tïme na wääde. Ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Modhe, ni kööe, ni «Tiere beeye kiper mana lääma gø wøk ki yïth pïï.»
english: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel, kanya tïme ni Modhe oløny ni dwøŋ, ena laŋ wøk baŋ tuuŋge, ni joot tïïc marge ni teek døc; ni joot ŋat Ibaru aciel na näk tuuŋge ni pwöt ŋat Ijepi pwödö.
english: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.

anywaa: Køøre ena lwïthö kun ki kun; 'ba kanya joot gø ni bäŋ dhaanhø, eni ŋat Ijep anääe ni kan gø ya akwöö.
english: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na riet nïne ena cäŋ laŋ wøk, ni joot jø Ibaru ariiø ni ge këëdö keerge; ni kööe jï ŋata no obääyö, na «?Aŋø ni gøøyï wadu en?»
english: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø aköö, na «?Aŋa na tïïc ïïni na wïthwa na dïŋut luup bäätwa? ?Aŋø, ï manynya gø naa 'nägï, kaamar nyï Ijep mana 'nägï?» Køøre Modhe alwäyö, ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, gïnögø aløny ni ŋäc.»
english: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Peerø na wïny gïnögø, ena tïmö ni manynya Modhe nee nääe. 'Ba Modhe apäär wøk po Peerø ni aae ni bëëde yi ŋööm jø Midien.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.

anywaa: 'Ba Raguël na näk kwääc lam mar jø Midien jïre da obwöre abïriiø ma nyïïakuue. Dïcäŋ aciel ni Modhe opï piny bäät iith, nyïgögø aö kun töömge ki pïï, ni pääŋge yïth gïï wø mäth dïëki yïthge ki pïï, kiper nee dïëk wääge maathge.
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.

anywaa: Køøre jø kwaath aöö ni riicge nyïgögø, 'ba Modhe aö maal ni køny geni, ni maath dïëkge.
english: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøge paac baŋ wääge ma Raguël, wääge aköö, na «?Aŋø, kee uuna laar duu paac dïcäŋi?»
english: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Nyen mør ma nyï Ijep waana kønye ceŋ jø kwaath; ni tööme ki pïï thuwø ni maath dïëk.»
english: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.

anywaa: Ni kö Raguëlli jï nyïïe, na «?Age nyeneca? ?Aperŋø na weyu gø en? Cwøllu eni nee jïte ki gïn came.»
english: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe yie met ki man bëëde buut Raguël. Køøre Raguël nyaare ma Dhipöra acïbe jï Modhe na dhaagø.
english: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.

anywaa: Køøre Dhipöra alwaar ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø, ni ö Modhe ni cak nyeŋ dhaanhø ni Gërcöm, kiper mana kööe, ni «Aana bëëdö na wëëllö yïth ŋøøm mo path.»
english: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri mo thööth, nyeya mar Ijep athøw. Ni ö nyïïkwaac Icrielli ni coocge kiper bëët laŋ mana en bäätge, ni gööge ko oduuru; ni ö oduuru mana gøøcge kiper køny kiper bëët laŋ marge ni pïïe maal baŋ Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk cooyø marge awïnynye; ni ö Jwøki ni par wïïe ki luumme na tuude ki Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap.
english: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni joot bëëtö mana teek na beet nyïïkwaac Icriel; ni ö Jwøki ni cäde kiperge.
english: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Modhe ni kwaaya dïëk wää cïïe na näk Jëthrö na näk kwääc lam mar jø Midien, eni dïëk akøøl dï paap kuya, ni pïïe ri Kïn Körëp, kïnna näk Kïn Jwøk.
english: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Modhe ki yi maac mo liel dï abuŋŋö; ni ö Modhe ni lwïthe, ni joot abuŋŋö ni liel, 'ba abuŋŋö kär waaŋ.
english: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, na «A doo gak nø, nee gïn ni rëëm ec en nee neena, ki man bëëde na abuŋŋö ba waaŋ enøgø.»
english: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na neen gø ni Modhe gää kuna nëënne, Jwøk acwötö ki dï abuŋŋö ni kööe, ni «Modhe! Modhe!» Ni kö Modhe, ni «Aani en.»
english: And when the Lord saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Kärï nyänh kany; gööny war moï wøk tietï, kiper kanyo cuŋŋi yie enø beeye ŋöömö mo ena kur keere.»
english: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Aana Jwø kwäyï, Jwøa näk Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap.» Kanyøgø Modhe täärnyïme aume kiper mana lwäye ki man neen Jwøk.
english: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, can mar jiya na en Ijep ajooda, ni wïnynya jwøk marge mana jwöŋge ki gø kiper gïïa leth na tïïc jø wø käär tïïe moge dëëtge. Aani gïïa jwørge bëët ŋääa.
english: And the Lord said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;

anywaa: Ennø, aana ö piny kuna käla ge wøk ceŋ jø Ijep, kiper nee ge käla wøk yi ŋöömmöce, ni kïtha geni yi ŋöömma beer na näk yie laac, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, na näk po jø Keenan ki jø Këth ki jø Amör ki jø Përec ki jø Ëwi ki jø Jeebuc.
english: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

anywaa: Ennø, jwøk mana jwöŋ jø Icrielli ki gø awïnynya; këël caannø thuwø mana ö jø Ijepi na caange geni ki gø, ajooda.
english: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ï na Modhe en, ööï nø, niï jääŋŋa baŋ Peerø, kiper nee jiya ma jø Icriel nee kälï wøk ki yi Ijep.»
english: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï Jwøk, ni «?Aana ŋa, ni ci baŋ Peerø kuna käla jø Icriel wøk ki yi Ijep en?»
english: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aano en buutï; 'ba gïno ŋäyï gø ki gø ni beeye aani na jääŋ ïïni beeye en, kanyo nø kälï jiy wøk ki yi Ijep, aano wøørru ni aana Jwøk maru bäät kïdi man en.»
english: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Jwøk, «Beer nø; ennø, a cøøa baŋ jø Icriel ni kööa jïge, ni ‹Jwøk na näk Jwø kwäyu aana jääŋŋe baŋu.› A kanymør a pëënyge pëënynyö ni köge, ni ‹?Nyeŋ Jwøøgø aŋa?› ?Køøre nø, agïnaŋø noo løøa jïge?»
english: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Beeye aani ni nut en.» Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Wär caanï jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Jwøa cwøl ni «Aani ni nut en» bee eni na jääŋ aani baŋu.› »
english: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jwøki köö jï Modhe, ni «Wär caanï jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø kwäyu, na näk Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, bee eni na jääŋ aani baŋu.› Wuuö Jwøk, na näk tiere beeye ‹Aani ni nut en› beeye nyeŋŋa na bäre bäre, na nyeŋ man wø ö jiyi wø parge wïthge ki aani ki gø këël yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.

anywaa: «Ciï ni cooŋï jø døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel kanya ciel ni kööï jïge, ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø kwäyu, na näk Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, ree anyoodhe jïra ni kööe, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, a cädö kiperu këël kiper gïïa tïïc dëëtu Ijep,
english: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The Lord God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:

anywaa: ni beeye ni kööa ennø nou käla wøk ki yi Ijep na näk kar can, ni kïtha uuni po jø Keenan ki jø Këth ki jø Amör ki jø Përec ki jø Ëwi ki jø Jeebuc, yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie.›
english: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.

anywaa: «'Ba geni dwørï mano caanï oleŋge. Køøre ïïni ki jø døøk Icriel u cøøa baŋ nyeny Ijep ni caannu gø jïre ni kööu, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø jø Ibaru ree anyoodhe jïwa. 'Ba ennø, wa kwaya ïïni ki man aawa dï paap kany mo caath ka nïne adäk kuna cïpwa ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa.›
english: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the Lord our God.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ŋääa ni nyeny Ijep wääth ba cïbe jïïu ki man aayu ni näk mo ba tïïc ka teek.
english: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cera orwiea bäät jø Ijep, ni tïïa gïï mo leth dëëtge ki ri gïï mo rëëma ec moo tïïa yi Ijep. Køøre nø, wääth cïbe cïbö jïïu.
english: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.

anywaa: Ni tïïa jø Ijep na jiy mo yïthge met ki uuni; køøre kanyo tïme na kar wääth maru, u ba aay jaak ki ceŋŋu.
english: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø man nø ŋat atut mare, wala dhaaŋŋa bëëtge ki gø na aciel yi øtø mare, di pëënynyö kiper jap warkey, ki jap gwel-bïrö, ka abïïe, ni kïthu ge dëët wäätu ki nyïïu, ni putu jø Ijep twier.»
english: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Modhe ni kööe, «?A ni näk maa ba ŋääth jø Icrielli, wala dwøra ba leŋge? Kiper kanymør ge köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk ree käre nyoodhø jïrï.› »
english: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The Lord hath not appeared unto thee.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni cerï enøgø?» Ni kö Modhe, ni «Beeye athøra.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Leeŋ piny.» Ni leeŋ gø piny, ni tïme na thwöl; ni ö Modhe ni reeŋe ki gø.
english: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Rwaak cerï ni magï gø ki jïbe.» Ni rwaak cere ni mak gø, ni cäŋ tïmö na athøra cere.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Gïnögø wär tïïyï nyïm jø Icriel kiper nee ŋääthge ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø kwäcge, na näk Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, ree ee nyoodhø jïrï møn.»
english: That they may believe that the Lord God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jïgø, ni «Kïth cerï tierjwöthï.» Ni ö Modhe ni kïth cere tierjwöthe, 'ba kanya käl cere wøk, onø jïtö ki täw mo raac, no nipwøth ni tar
english: And the Lord said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Dwøk cerï tierjwöthï.» Ni dwøk cere tierjwöthe; 'ba kanya käl gø wøk ki tierjwöthe, cere onø døø kare ni caala dëëre.
english: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, «Ni näk miï ba ŋääthge wala dwørï ba leŋge kanyo nyoothï nyuudhi mana dïkwøŋ, kanymør riet nyuudhi ŋääthge ŋäädhö.
english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk nyuuthe moøgø na ariiø yøø ba ŋääthge wala dwørï ba leŋge, wärï lwötï ki pïï røk pïï moa en naam ni kønynyï gø piny kany mo otal. Pïïögø na lwørï naam yøø otïmö na remø piny kanya no otal.»
english: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Wui Awuuö, a paa dhaanhø mo caan luup ŋääe, ki mana bëëda cøøn, këël man cäänï ki aani dïcäŋi en, a na näk laŋŋï; kiper aana dhaanhø mo cäänö teek jïra ni leeba ba rwäänhnhi.»
english: And Moses said unto the Lord, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïgø, na «?Aŋa na cwääc dhi dhaanhø? ?Wala aŋa ni wø tïïc dhaanhø ni ba cäänö, wala na miiŋ, wala ni nyeŋŋe nëënö wala na cwør? ?Aŋø, paa aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk?
english: And the Lord said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ciï. Aani ki dëëra kiree, aano en buutï, ni jaba dhiï ki man cäänï, ni pwönynya ïïni ki luup bëët moo carï.»
english: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, ni «Wui Kwäärö, ennø beerra man jäägï ki dhaanhø mør jaak mana manynyï.»
english: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki Modhe døc ni kööe, na «Aŋø, coku ma Aran na näk nyikwaar Libay ba nut? Eni ŋääa ni beeye dhaanhø mo cäänö løny jïre. Eni thuwø ööa baŋï kiper nou røømmu ki gø; ni kanyo joot ïïni, yie puta mïnnö.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno cäänö ki eni ni cïbï luup bëët dhee; 'ba aani ki dëëra kiree, aano en buutï ni jaba dhiï, ni ena buute thuwø ni jaba dhee, ni pwönynya uuni ki gïïo tïïyu.
english: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.

anywaa: Eni thuwø, eno tïmö ni cäänö eni jï jiy na karï; ni tïme na dhøk marï, ni tïmï niï caala Jwøk ki baŋe.
english: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.

anywaa: Athøra man thuwø käärï ki cerï, nee tïme ni beeye gïno tïïyï nyuuthe ki gøøni.»
english: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aay ni døø baŋ Jëthrö na näk wää cïïe, ni kööe jïgø, na «A kwaya ïïni ki man aa, naa døøa baŋ tuuŋwa na en Ijep, nee ge neena ki man näk ge poot kwøw.» Ni kö Jëthrö jï Modhe, ni «Wøp, cäädhï ki jööt dëël.»
english: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki Modhe Midien, ni kööe, ni «Døø Ijep nø, kiper jøøa many ïïni niï 'näkge gena thøw bëët.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe cïïe ki wääte alwøre ni kïth geni bäät arëën, ni aae ni døøa ŋööm Ijep. Ni ö Modhe thuwø ni lwør athøra mar Jwøk ni käär gø ki cere.
english: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Modhe, ni «Kanyo døøï Ijep, nyuuthe bëët moa cïba teek marge jïrï nee tïïyï, wär tïïyï nyïm Peerø; 'ba aani cwïny Peerø odøøya mo teek nee jø Icriel mäne ki man aacge.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.

anywaa: Køøre ïïno köö jï Peerø, ni gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Jø Icriel bëët neeta kaamar wäädö man wø näk kaa, ni beeye kanynya.
english: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:

anywaa: Acaana jïrï, ni «Wec kanynya nee aae, kiper naa tïnynye»; 'ba ïïna kweer ki man aae. Ennø, wäätu moa näk kaai bëët nääa nääø.› »
english: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na pïïe kar niine øtjöö, Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jïgø, ni tïme ni manynya man 'näk gø.
english: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the Lord met him, and sought to kill him.

anywaa: Køøre cïïe ma Dhipöra alwötö ki kïdi mo deŋŋe beth, ni daŋ wääde ki gø, ni leeŋ buyö mana daaŋe tiet cwøre, ni kööe, ni «Ïïno put bëëtö ni ïïna cwøra ki køør rem wääda.»
english: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wec Modhe ni käre nääö. Kar kanyøgø Dhipöra acäŋ köö, ni «Ïïno put bëëtö ni ïïna cwøra ki køør rem wääda.» Gïnögø acaane kiper luum daŋ.
english: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Aran, ni «Ciï nou røømmu ki Modhe dï paap.» Ni aae ni røømge ki Modhe buut kïnna näk Kïn Jwøk, ni nuum dhi gø ni määtha gø.
english: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe luup bëët moa jääŋŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki kiperge acaane jï Aran, këël nyuuthe bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre noo tïïe.
english: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the Lord who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran gena aay ni cooŋge jø døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel bëët kanya ciel.
english: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:

anywaa: Kanyøgø Aran luup bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe acaane, ni tïïc nyuuthe moøgø nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And Aaron spake all the words which the Lord had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni ŋääthge; 'ba kanya wïnyge gø ni Wuuö Jwøk alïïmmö baŋge ni joot caannø marge, wïthge akuulge piny ni wøørge gø.
english: And the people believed: and when they heard that the Lord had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.

anywaa: Køøre cään Modhe ka Aran gena ci baŋ Peerø ni köge jïgø, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø Icriel beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Wec jiya nee aacge nee tïïge ka ajwöma jïra dï paap.› »
english: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø aköö, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk aŋa ni wïnynya dwøre nee jø Icriel aacge en? Aani Wuuö Jwøk kuua, këël aani thuwø jø Icriel ba wëëga wääth nee aacge.»
english: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the Lord, neither will I let Israel go.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran aköö, ni «Jwø jø Ibaru ree anyoodhe jïwa. 'Ba ennø, wa kwaya ïïni ki man aawa dï paap kany mo caath ka nïne adäk, nee wa cïpwa ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa, kiper nee ba kän bäätwa ki täwe mo leth wala leny.»
english: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the Lord our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Ijep aköö jïge, ni «Nyie Modhe ka Aran, ?aperŋø na mänu jiy ki man tïïcge tïïe moge? Cou døøu baŋ tïïe mou.»
english: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Peerø köö, ni «Neennu, kawaane jø pou dï paani atïmö ni thööth døc. 'Ba ennø, u tïïya jiy nee tïïe moge wecge.»
english: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.

anywaa: 'Ba na poode na dïcäŋögø kiree, Peerø akän wøk ki ciik jï jø wø käär tïïe ni wø wëëk jiy tïïc, ki jøøa näk wïth jø tïïe, ni kööe,
english: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kär nou kännö ki juuk beel mo wø tïïc thuube ki ge jï jøøgø këët kaawat mana dïkwøŋ; beerra man cige keerge nee känge ki juuk beel.
english: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään thuube mo poot caala kwään moa dïkwøŋ wär manynyu bäätge, ni kär nou känna wøk rege, këël aciel. Kiper geni ge jägö, ni beeye tiere ni jwöŋge enø, ni köge, ni ‹Wa wec nee wa ciwa kuna cïpwa ko olämme jï Jwøwa.›
english: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm tïïci ni päl bäätge, nee tïïge ni bäŋ jwöm røk, kiper nee ba cätge ki luup mo oballe jaak.»
english: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.

anywaa: Køøre jø wø käär tïïe, ki jøøa näk wïth jø tïïe, gena aa wøk ni caange gø jï jiy, ni köge, ni «Man beeye dwør Peerø, ena köö, ni ‹Aani a ba cïpi jïïu ki juuk beel këët.
english: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.

anywaa: Cou ni cääu ki juuk beel keeru kanyo jïtu yie jaak; 'ba bäŋ gïn mo käla wøk ri tïïc maru.› »
english: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.

anywaa: Køøre jiy akeethø dï ŋööm Ijep bäre nee ge känge ki juuk beel.
english: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø käär tïïe ni lacge ge, ni köge, ni «Thööru tïïc mana näk omanynyø bäätu ki dïcäŋ man nø, kaawat mana wara bëëde ni di kännö jïïu ki juuk beel.»
english: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, wïth jø tïïe na näk jø Icriel, na näk orøøny jic Peerø mo wø käär tïïe nee bëëtge na wïthge, atïmö ni ge di pöötö ni ge di pëënynyö, na «?Aperŋø na ba thööru kwään thuube moa näk okwaanø ya awääre wala dïcäŋi, kaawat mana wara kwøŋu tïïc cøøn?»
english: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?

anywaa: Køøre wïth jø tïïe moa näk jø Icriel gena öö ni jwöŋge dëër Peerø, ni köge, na «?Aperŋø na tïïyï teeŋ gïn dëëtwa, wa na laaŋe moï ii?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?

anywaa: Bäŋ juuk beel mo wëëk laaŋe moï, 'ba ge poot köö ki waani, ni ‹Tïïyu thuube.› Ennø, wa na laaŋe moï wa di pöötö; 'ba bääyö manøgø beeye mar jiyï ki dëëtge kiree.»
english: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø aköö, ni «Uuni u jägö, u jägö døc kiree; ni beeye tiere ni kööu enø, ni ‹Wa wec nee wa ciwa kuna cïpwa ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, cou ni tïïu; kiper juuk beel bäŋgø mo di cïbö jïïu, 'ba kwään thuube poot pääŋŋu pääŋö na karge.»
english: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

anywaa: Ni ö wïth jø tïïe moa näk jø Icriel ni putge gø ŋäc ni bëëtö marge leth møn kiper acaan jïge, ni «Kär nou känna wøk ri kwään thuube moa näk omanynyø kiper dïcäŋ man nø.»
english: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duuge wøk ki baŋ Peerø, gena røømmø ki Modhe ka Aran na näk køya geni.
english: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:

anywaa: Ni kö wïth jø tïïe moøgø jï Modhe ka Aran, ni «Wuuö Jwøk luubö manøgø oraaŋe bäätu ni ŋøl uuni wøk, kiper mana tïïyu wa kaamar gïn mo ŋwäänynye raac ki jï Peerø ki jø kööre moe, ni cïbu tøøŋi ceŋge nee wa 'näkge.»
english: And they said unto them, The Lord look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe adøø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ?aperŋø na tïïyï teeŋ gïn ni raac en dëët jøøi ii? ?Aperŋø na jääŋŋï aani thuwø?
english: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?

anywaa: Ni këël kanya ööa baŋ Peerø na cääna ki nyeŋŋï, ena cäŋ tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëët jøøi ii; 'ba ïïni jøøi kärï kønyø na bäre.»
english: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ennø, gïno tïïa dëër Peerø jootï joodø. Peerø jø Icriel wëëge wääth ki køør gïno teek noo tïïa dëëre, ni put geni riem wøk paare ki køør teek manøgø.»
english: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jwøki cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe jïgø, ni «Aana Wuuö Jwøk;
english: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the Lord:

anywaa: aani dëëra anyoodha jï Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap ni aana Jwøa en teeki jïre. 'Ba ki man näk mo nyeŋŋa Wuuö Jwøk kära nyoodhø jïge ki man ŋäcge gø.
english: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name Jehovah was I not known to them.

anywaa: Aani thuwø luubö mara mana tuuda ki geni atïïa nee bëëde, ni beeye ki man cïba ŋööm Keenan jïge, na näk ŋöömma bëëtge yie ni gena wëëlle mo path.
english: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø cooyø mar jø Icriel awïnynya, kiper geno mak jø Ijepi ni teek nee bëëtge ki bëët laŋ. 'Ba aani wïïa acaara ki gïna tuuda ki geni.
english: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø nø, ï na Modhe en, caanï jï jø Icriel ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk. Uuni uuno käla wøk ki yïth gïïa leth na kïth jø Ijepi bäätu, ni käla uuni wøk ki yi bëët laŋ, ni wïïla uuni wøk thuwø ki køør teek bada ki ŋøl mana dwøŋ noo tïïa.
english: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the Lord, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:

anywaa: Ni lwøra uuni ni uuna jiya, ni tïma ni aana Jwøk maru, ni putu gø ŋäc møn ni aana Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu na käl uuni wøk ki yïth gïïa leth na kïth jø Ijepi bäätu.
english: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.

anywaa: Ni kïtha uuni yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere nee cïba jï Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, ni cïba gø jïïu ni tïme na maru. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe gïnögø acaane jï jø Icriel. 'Ba mar Modhe kärge leŋø kiper pänh cwïny marge ki bëët laŋ marge na leth na enge yie.
english: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Peerø nyeny Ijep, kiper nee jø Icriel wiie nee aacge paare.»
english: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe mare acaane nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Ennø, këël jø Icriel ki dëëtge mara kärge leŋø. ?A tugi ki Peerø nø, mara oleŋ gø nidïï, aani ni cäänö kuua døøc en?»
english: And Moses spake before the Lord, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööm geni kiper gïïo caange jï jø Icriel ki Peerø nyeny Ijep, kiper nee jø Icriel kälge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba moi ii beege nyeŋ jiy moa näk wïth tuŋi na käl dhi øt kwarge ma Icriel. Wäät Ruben na näk kany Icriel beege Anök ki Pallu ki Eedharan ki Karmi. Moøgø beege wïth tuŋi mo dhi øt Ruben.
english: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cimien beege Jemuël ki Jamin ko Okat ki Jaakin ki Dhöar ki Caul o dhaaŋŋa näk nyi jø Keenan. Moøgø beege wïth tuŋi mo dhi øt Cimien.
english: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ wäät Libay ki køør tuuŋ marge beege Gërcön ki Kät ki Mërari. 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Libay ni kwøw beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø.
english: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.

anywaa: Ni wäät Gërcön ki køør tuuŋ marge beege Löbeni ki Cimiy.
english: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimei, according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Kät beege Amram ki Icaar ki Keeprön ki Udhiel. 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Käti ni kwøw beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëradäk kurdäk.
english: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.

anywaa: Ni wäät Mërari beege Maali ki Muci. Jøøgø bëët beege wïth tuŋi moa käl dhi øt Libay ki køør tuuŋ marge.
english: And the sons of Merari; Mahli and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.

anywaa: 'Ba Amram waai cöök wänni mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jökabit anywøme, ni nyöötge ki gø ni nywølge Aran ki Modhe. 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Amrammi ni kwøw beege cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø.
english: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.

anywaa: Wäät Icaar beege Köra ki Napëk ki Dhikri.
english: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

anywaa: Wäät Udhiel beege Micaël ki Eldapan ki Citri.
english: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran Elicëba nya Aminadap anywøme. Ëlicëba beeye cöök Nacøn. Jiy moa nywøl Aranni ki Ëlicëba beege Nadap ka Abiyu ki Eliedhar ki Itamer.
english: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Nahshon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

anywaa: Wäät Köra beege Acër ki Elkana ka Abiyacap. Moøgø beege tuuŋ Köra.
english: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.

anywaa: Ni ö Eliedharri wär Aran ni nyöömme røk nyïï Putiëël, ni nyöötge ki gø ni nywølge Piniac. Moøgø beege wïth tuŋi moa käl dhi øt Libay ki køør tuuŋ marge.
english: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran ki Modhe beege jøøa cään Wuuö Jwøki ki geni nee jø Icriel kälge wøk ki yi Ijep ki køør lwaae moge,
english: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the Lord said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.

anywaa: ni beege Modhe ka Aran na cäänö ki Peerø nyeny Ijep kiper nee jø Icriel kälge wøk ki yi Ijep.
english: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa ö Wuuö Jwøki na cääne ki Modhe yi ŋööm Ijep,
english: And it came to pass on the day when the Lord spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,

anywaa: ena cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe, ni «Aana Wuuö Jwøk. Gïïa caana jïrï bëët ciï ni caanï ge jï Peerø nyeny Ijep.»
english: That the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, I am the Lord: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe mare acaane nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Ennø, aana dhaanhø mo cäänö kuua døøc. ?Mara owïnynyi ya Peerø nidïï?»
english: And Moses said before the Lord, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Neenï, ïïno tïïa kaamar Jwøk ki jï Peerø, ni ö coku ma Aran ni tïme na nyikugö marï.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.

anywaa: Luup bëët moo caana jïrï ocaanï jï coku ma Aran, ni ö eni ni caan gø jï Peerø, kiper nee jø Icriel wiie nee aacge yi ŋöömö mare.
english: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cwïny Peerø odøøya mo teek, ni tïïa ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec 'moa ni thööth yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Peerø no ba wïny luummu, aani cera orwiea bäät jø Ijep ni tïïa ki gïï mo leth dëëtge, ni ö lwaae 'moa na näk jiya ma jø Icriel ni käla ge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ki ŋøl mo dwøŋ.
english: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo rwiea cera bäät jø Ijep ni käla jø Icriel wøk ki dïge, beeye no ŋäyi jø Ijepi døøc nø ni aana Wuuö Jwøk møn.»
english: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ni tïïcge gø kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïge, ni putge gïnögø tïïc møn.
english: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded them, so did they.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanya ö Modhe ka Aran ni cäänge ki Peerø, Modhe cwiiye pïërabära na Aran cwiiye pïërabära kurdäk.
english: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo ö Peerø noo cääne ki uuni, ni kööe, ni ‹Nyuuthu ki ŋïï,› køøre ï na Modhe en, wärï kööï ka Aran, ni ‹Lwør athøra marï ni leeŋï gø piny nyïm Peerø, nee tïme na thwöl.› »
english: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran gena ö baŋ Peerø, ni tïïcge gø kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïge; ni ö Aranni ni leeŋ athøra mare piny nyïm Peerø ki jø kööre moe, ni put tïmö na thwöl.
english: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the Lord had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø ni cwøl jøøa nyeŋge reegø ka ajuuk bëët, ni ö geni thuwø ni tïïcge jap ajuuk ni ŋwaalge ŋïï manøgø.
english: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.

anywaa: Ŋati man nø athøra mare aleeŋ piny, ni tïm athøre moge na thwöre. 'Ba athøra mar Aran, athøre mo jøøgø aløønye.
english: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø cwïnye poot bëëdö ni teek, ni käre luumge wïnynyö, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan jï Modhe.
english: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Peerø cwïnye poot teek; ena kweer ki man wec jiy nee aacge.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.

anywaa: Wärï ci baŋ Peerø ka amöölla kanyo aa naam, ni koorï eni lak naam nou røømmu ki gø; ni käärï athønynya tïmö na thwöl ki cerï.
english: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.

anywaa: Ni caanï gø jï Peerø, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø jø Ibaru aana jääŋŋe baŋï, ni kööe, ni «Wec jiya nee aacge naa tïnyge dï paap. 'Ba këël ennø, luumma poot ba wïnynyï.»
english: And thou shalt say unto him, The Lord God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.

anywaa: Ni man poot na dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni «Ki køør man nø, oŋäyï døøc ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.» Ennø, pïï mo naam ogøøa ka athøra man ni cera en, nee tïmge na remø.
english: Thus saith the Lord, In this thou shalt know that I am the Lord: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.

anywaa: Ni ö reci moa en yi naam ni thøwge, ni tïm naammi ni ŋwääö no okwäk; ni tïme ni teek jï jø Ijep ki man mäthge ki pï naamøgø.› »
english: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï Aran ni kööï, ni ‹Lwør athøra marï ni rwieyï cerï bäät pï Ijep bëët, ni beege näm moge, ki nyeŋŋi moge, ki puri moge, ki kwöra näk pïï ocooŋ yïthge bëët, kiper nee tïmge na remø; ni ö kwöra näk yïthge da pïï dï ŋööm Ijep bäre ni tïmge na remø, këël pïï moa en yïth dääe moa näk tïïc ka jenni wala moa näk tïïc ka kïte bëët.› »
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ni tïïcge gø kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïge. Ni ö Aranni ni tïŋ athøra maal ni gøøc pïï moa en naam nyïm Peerø ki jø kööre moe, ni ö pïïyi moa en yi naam manøgø ni tïmge na remø.
english: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the Lord commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.

anywaa: Ni ö reci moa en yi naam manøgø ni thøwge, ni tïm naammi ni ŋwääö no okwäk, ni tïm jø Ijepi ni ba løny jïge ki man mäthge ki pï naamøgø. Ni ö pïïyi moa en yi ŋööm Ijep bäre ni put tïmö na remø.
english: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba ajuuk mo jø Ijep gena tïïö ki jap ajuuk ni ŋwaalge ŋïï manøgø; ni ö Peerø ni bëëde ni cwïnye poot teek ni käre luumge wïnynyö, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan jï Modhe.
english: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the Lord had said.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø ree aløøe ni døø paare ni bäŋ gïn mo ee lääŋŋö kiper gïnögø.
english: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Ijepi bëët ni kunyge ki ïïdhi deŋ naam nee jïtge ki pïï mo maathge, kiper mana tïme ni ba løny jïge ki man mäthge røk pï naam.
english: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.

anywaa: Ni tïm nïne na abïriiø ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na gøøc naam.
english: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the Lord had smitten the river.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ci baŋ Peerø ni caanï gø jïre ni kööï, ni gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Wec jiya nee aacge kiper naa tïnyge.
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ïïno kweer ki man weyï geni nee aacge, ka adïëri møn, aani paarï bäre raanynya raanynyø ko ogwäle.
english: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

anywaa: Ni ö ogwäle ni nyaacge yi naam, ni öge wøk ki yi naam ni cige yi øtø marï, ki kar niine marï, këël bäät pëëm marï, ni cige yïth uudi mo jø kööre moï ni pärge bäät jiyï bëët, ni cige yïth këënne mou këël yïth gïï wø tëëdu ki ge.
english: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:

anywaa: Ni ö ogwäle ni pärge bäätï ki jiy moï ki jø kööre moï bëët.› »
english: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï Aran na athøra mana en cere nee rwiee bäät näm ki bäät nyeŋŋi ki bäät puri, kiper nee ogwäle öge wøk bäät ŋøøp Ijep.»
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Aran cere arwiee bäät näp Ijep, ni ö ogwäle ni öge wøk ni pääŋge ŋøøp Ijep.
english: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba ajuuk atïïö ki jap ajuuk ni ŋwaalge teeŋ gïnögø, ni putge ogwäle wëëk ööny bäät ŋøøp Ijep.
english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø Modhe ka Aran acwøle ni kööe, ni «Kwayu Wuuö Jwøk kiper nee ogwäle paanye bääta ki jiya bëët. Køøre jø Icriel wiia wiiø nee cige kuna cïpge ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Entreat the Lord, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jï Peerø, ni «Kanyo manynyï ki man kwaa Jwøk yie wär caanï jïra, kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk kwaa kiperï ki jø kööre moï ki jiyï, kiper nee ogwäle tïmge ni bäŋgø dïïu ki yïth uudi mou, nee tïme ni dööŋŋa yi naam keere.»
english: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I entreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø, ni «Kwac Wuuö Jwøk jïra diøø.» Ni kö Modhe, ni «Beerra man tïme kaawat mana caanï enøgø, kiper nee putï ŋäc møn ni bäŋ jwøk mo caala Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa.
english: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the Lord our God.

anywaa: Kiper ogwäle puta aay buutï ki yïth uudi moï, ni aacge buut jø kööre moï ki jiyï bëët, ni tïme ni dööŋŋa yi naam keere.»
english: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe ka Aran gena aay buut Peerø, ni ö Modhe ni kwac Wuuö Jwøk kiper ogwäle moa jääŋŋe bäät Peerø.
english: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the Lord because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gø kaawat mana caan Modhe, ni ö ogwäle moa en yïth uudi ki dï käälle, ki moa en yïth pwöth, ni putge thøø.
english: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Ijepi ni cøŋge ogwäle na athwöe, ni put pinynyi kwääö ki geni.
english: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Peerø na neen gø ni piny oniwaany, cwïnye acäŋ døøc mo teek ni kweere ki man wïny mana caan Modhe ka Aran, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan jï Modhe.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï Aran ni kööï, ni ‹Rwiec athøra marï ni gøøyï tør piny, kiper nee tïme na nyuu dï po jø Ijep bäre.› »
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ni tïïcge gïnögø. Ni ö Aranni ni rwiec athøra mana en cere ni gøøc tør piny, ni put nyuuwi tïmö ni dagø dëët jiy ki lääy bëët. Ni ö tørri bäre ni put tïmö na nyuu dï po jø Ijep bäre.
english: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö ajuuki ni päärge gø ki man tïïge ki jap ajuuk kiper nee ge känge ki nyuu. 'Ba kär løny jïge. Ni ö nyuuwi moa en dëët jiy ki dëët lääy ni put bëëtö dëëtge.
english: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

anywaa: Køøre ajuuk aköö jï Peerø, ni «Gïnögø beeye gïn mo tïïya Jwøki.» 'Ba cwïny Peerø poot bëëdö ni teek ni kweere ki man wïny mana caan Modhe ka Aran, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan jï Modhe.
english: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had said.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ö maal ka amöölla cøøn ni nyoothï riï jï Peerø kanyo ci naam, ni caanï gø jïre ni kööï, ni gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Wec jiya nee aacge, kiper naa tïnyge.
