english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jiya ba weyï nee aacge, ka adïëri møn, lwaa lwaŋŋø mo päl jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätï ki bäät jø kööre moï ki bäät jiyï bëët ki yïth uudi moï; ni ö yïth uudi mo jø Ijep ki ŋøøm mo wø bëëtge yïthge thuwø ni tïmge no ogääbö ki lwaa lwaŋŋø.
english: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïcäŋeca ŋööm Göcën na bëët jiya yie owiia kur keere ni bäŋ lwaa lwaŋŋø mo ena yie, kiper nee ŋäyï ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni bëëdö dï paani en;
english: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the Lord in the midst of the earth.

anywaa: ni pääŋŋa jiya ki jiyï. 'Ba nyuudhi manøgø puta tägö diøø.› »
english: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø atïïc Wuuö Jwøki. Ni ö lwaa lwaŋŋø mo päl ni ö yi øt Peerø ki yïth uut jø kööre moe, ni ö ŋööm Ijepi bäre ni put ränynyö kiper lwaa lwaŋŋø mana en dï paac bäre.
english: And the Lord did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø Modhe ka Aran acwøle ni kööe, ni «Cou ni cïpu ko olämme jï Jwøu dï paac kany keere.»
english: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, ni «Gïnögø ba beer ki man tïïcwa gø, kiper gïïo cïpwa jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa beege gïï mo jø Ijep yïthge reyø ki ge. ?Aŋø, ni näk mo wa cïpö ko olämme ni nëënö jï jø Ijep, ni beege olämme mo yïthge reyø ki ge, wa ba këërge ki kïte ni 'näkge waani?
english: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the Lord our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?

anywaa: Wa doo cøøa dï paap ki wääth mo caath ki nïne adäk, nee wa cïpwa ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa kaawat mana caan gø jïwa.»
english: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the Lord our God, as he shall command us.

anywaa: Ni kö Peerø, ni «Wääth cïba cïbö jïïu kiper nou cou nou cïpu ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk Jwøk maru dï paap. 'Ba käru ci kany mo bäär ki paac. Beerra man kwayu Jwøk kipera.»
english: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the Lord your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: entreat for me.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, ni «Ennø, aana aa wøk buutï. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk okwaa kiper nee lwaa lwaŋŋø aae buutï diøø, ïïni na Peerø, ki jø kööre moï, këël jø paarï bëët. 'Ba ï na Peerø, kär näk miï cäŋa cäänö ki cwøk këët ki man mänï jiy ki ciin kuna cïpge ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will entreat the Lord that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ree apaanye buut Peerø ni ci kuna kwac Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and entreated the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gïna pëëny Modhe ki eni, ni paany lwaa lwaŋŋø bäät Peerø ki jø kööre moe, këël jø paare bëët; ni bäŋ aciel mo odööŋ.
english: And the Lord did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø cwïnye acäŋ døøc mo teek yie man thuwø, ni kweere ki man cïp wääth jï jø Icriel.
english: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ci baŋ Peerø ni caanï gø jïre, ni gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø jø Ibaru beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Wec jiya nee aacge, kiper naa tïnyge.
english: Then the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ïïno kweer ki man weyï geni nee aacge, ni ge poot iï maaø ni teek,
english: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk cera rwiea rwieø ki täw mo raac døc bäät lääc paac moï moa en pwöla bëët, kaamar okwëënyi, ka arëëni, ka athïrööle, ki pïïth dhäk, ki pïïth dïëk.
english: Behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, lääc paac mo jø Icriel ki lääc paac mo jø Ijep opääŋŋa, ni bäŋe gø mo thøw røk mo jø Icriel.› »
english: And the Lord shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acïpö ki kany mo ŋäc ni beeye kanyo täk gïnögø yie ni kööe, ni «Diøø a na Wuuö Jwøk gïnögø tïïa tïïö yi ŋöömmi.»
english: And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk gïnögø atïïe ka amöölla, ni thøw lääc paaci mo jø Ijep bëët; 'ba bäŋ aciel mo thøw røk lääc paac mo jø Icriel.
english: And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø ni jääk kanya bëët jø Icrielli yie, ni wïny gø ni bäŋgø mo othøw wala aciel røk lääc paac mo jø Icriel. 'Ba Peerø cwïnye poot bëëdö ni teek, ni käre jø Icriel wiiø nee aacge.
english: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe ka Aran, ni «Lwötu ki bur yi këënnö mo päŋ yïth ceŋŋu, nee jør Modhe maal nyïm Peerø.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.

anywaa: Bur manøgø otïmö na tør bäät ŋööm Ijep bäre, ni tïme na børi mo pänynya wøk dëët jiy ki lääc paac bëët dï ŋööm Ijep bäre.»
english: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre gena lwötö ki bur yi këënnö, ni cuŋge nyïm Peerø; ni ö Modhe ni jør gø maal, ni put tïmö na børi dëët jiy ki lääc paac bëët.
english: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.

anywaa: 'Ba kär løny jï ajuuk ki man cuŋge nyïm Modhe kiper børi moa no opäny wøk dëëtge, kiper børi moa no opäny wøk dëët jø Ijep bëët dagø dëët ajuuk thuwø.
english: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïny Peerø adøøc mo teek, ni ö Peerø ni käre luumge wïnynyö, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan jï Modhe.
english: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the Lord had spoken unto Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ö maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni ciï ni cuŋŋï nyïm Peerø ni kööï jïre, ni gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø jø Ibaru beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Wec jiya nee aacge, kiper naa tïnyge.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.

anywaa: Kiper yie man ennø, gïï mo leth mo käla baŋa jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätï, ki jø kööre moï, ki jiyï bëët, kiper nee ŋäyï ni bäŋ jwøk mo caala aani bäät piny bäre.
english: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.

anywaa: Kiper këël kawaane ennø, doo naa oløny jïra ki man rwiea cera ni gøøa ïïni ki jiyï bëët ki täw mo raac, ni putu tïmö nou tøør bäät pinyi en.
english: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna wiia ïïni kipere niï bëëdï, beeye kiper nee teek mara nyoodha jïrï, nee gïra køp bäät piny bäre.
english: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.

anywaa: Ennø, dëërï poot iï thïïŋö bäät jiya, ni mänï geni ki man aacge.
english: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?

anywaa: Neenï, diøø kar kany nø, køth mo ree da pey mo døøŋŋø jääŋŋa jääŋŋö, mo teeŋe poot kär tägö Ijep ki mana geeri këël kar kany ennø.
english: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, jääk baŋ lääc paac moï, ki gïïa en yi pwöla moa näk moï bëët nee käl paayø, nee kwøwge. Kiper kanyo ö peyi bäät jiy ki lääc paac moo en pwöla na näk kär käl paac bëët, ge thøw.› »
english: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.

anywaa: Køøre ki røk jø kööre mo Peerø, moa lwäär ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk laaŋe moge ki lääc paac moge alaarge käl paac.
english: He that feared the word of the Lord among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:

anywaa: 'Ba moa näk dwør Wuuö Jwøk ege taaø, laaŋe moge ki lääc paac moge awiige pwöla jaak.
english: And he that regarded not the word of the Lord left his servants and his cattle in the field.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Tïŋ cerï maal kiper nee køth mo ree da pey pädhe bäät ŋööm Ijep bäre, ni beeye bäät jiy ki lääc paac ki gïïa näk otuy yïth pwöth dï ŋööm Ijep bäre.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tïŋ athøra mare maal, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ odäru ki pey, ni put køthi tïmö ni pöödö bäät piny. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc køth mo ree da pey nee pädhe bäät ŋööm Ijep.
english: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the Lord rained hail upon the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni put tïmö ni da pey na agaackøth mal dïëre, ni beege pey mo teeŋge poot kär tägö yi ŋööm Ijep cøøn ki mana geeri na paac.
english: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

anywaa: Ni ö peyi ni put gïïa en yi pwöla bëët dï ŋööm Ijep bäre gøøc, ni beege jiy ki lääc paac bëët; ni ö peyi ni gøøc gïïa näk otuy yïth pwöth bëët ni tøc jenni moa en pwöl paanøgø bëët.
english: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët jø Icrielli yie keere na näk Göcën kødha näk ree da pey kär pädhö yie.
english: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø ajääk baŋ Modhe ka Aran nee öge, ni kööe jïge, ni «Aani aana bääyö yie man; Wuuö Jwøk beeye na näk mare adïëri, 'ba aani ki jiya marwa raac.
english: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the Lord is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.

anywaa: Kwayu Wuuö Jwøk, kiper odäru ki pey moa jääŋŋe yøø, orømø nø; uuno wiia ni aayu, nou ba bëëdu kany këët.»
english: Entreat the Lord (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïgø, ni «Kanyo aa wøk yi pääny kiree, ceŋŋa othaaŋa jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö odäru ni cuŋŋe, ni tïme ni bäŋ pey këët, kiper nee putï ŋäc møn ni piny beeye mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the Lord; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the Lord's.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki jø kööre moï, ki man näk mou poot ba lwäär ki Jwøk na näk Wuuö Jwøk ŋääa.»
english: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, gïna cwøl ni telba, ni wø thøøthe cwääc na abïï, ki teeŋ bëëlö mo cwøl ni gäbci bëët onø raany peyi, kiper mana näk gäbci onø ŋøø, ni telba poot ena yïth kuge.
english: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.

anywaa: 'Ba beel moa cwøl ni cïndë ka aja, ge kär ränynyö, kiper kar ciek marge poodi.
english: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put aa wøk yi pääny nyïm Peerø, ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö odäru ki pey ni cuŋge, ni cöök køthi bäät piny.
english: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the Lord: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Peerø na joot gø ni køth ki pey ko odäru ocuŋŋö, eni bääyö mare acäŋ kadhø, ni døøc cwïnye mo teek, ni bee eni ki jø kööre moe.
english: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø cwïnye poot bëëdö ni teek, ni käre jø Icriel wiiø nee aacge, kaawat mana kwøŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki caan ki dhi Modhe.
english: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the Lord had spoken by Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ci baŋ Peerø, kiper cwïnye ki cwïny jø kööre moe døøya aani mo teek, kiper nee ŋïïce moi na 'moa ii nee tïïa dïge;
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:

anywaa: kiper nee ïïni na Modhe en nee teeŋ gïïa leth na tïïa dëët jø Ijep ki teeŋ ŋïïce moa tïïa dïge, nee caanï jï wäätï ki nyïïkwaayï, ni putu gø ŋäc møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran aci baŋ Peerø ni köge jïgø, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø jø Ibaru beeye en, ena köö, na ‹?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø, noo bëëdï niï kweeyø ki man dwøgï dëërï piny ki aani? Wec jiya nee aacge kiper naa tïnyge.
english: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ïïno kweer ki man weyï jiya nee aacge, ka adïëri møn, diøø a puta kän dï paarï ki lwaa bäänyö;
english: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:

anywaa: ni öge ni gääpge ŋöömö bäre, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany mo nëëni bäät ŋøøm, ni camge gïïa bøth thuwø na näk odööŋ jïïu dhi pey, ni camge jenni mou bëët moa näk otuy jïïu na en yïth pwöth mou;
english: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:

anywaa: ni pääŋge yïth uudi moï, ki yïth uudi mo jø kööre moï bëët, ki yïth uudi mo jø Ijep bëët. 'Ba teeŋ gïnögø beeye teeŋ gïn mo poot kär kwøŋ wëëgu ki kwäyu joot cøøn ki mana cwääc geni bäät piny këël dïcäŋi en.› » Køøre Modhe ree aløøe ni aa wøk buut Peerø.
english: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ni kö jø kööre mo Peerø jï Peerø, na «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët nyenøgø ni bïtha øøni? Beerra man weyï jøøgø nee aacge kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøge nee tïnyge. ?Aŋø, ki man näk Ijep oränynyö poot kuyï en?»
english: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the Lord their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran adwøk baŋ Peerø, ni kö Peerø jïge, ni «Aayu ni tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. ?'Ba jøw aay dëëtu aŋaani cøøn?»
english: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the Lord your God: but who are they that shall go?

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Wa aay ko obwöre mowa ki jäle mowa bëët, ki wäätwa ki nyïïwa bëët, këël pïïth dïëk mowa ki pïïth dhäk mowa bëët. Wa aay bëët kiper nee wa tïïwa ka ajwöma jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jïge, «Ni näk mo uuni ki nyïïu bëët u wiia wiiø nou aayu møn, kanymør per mana näk Jwøk ena buutu wän nø. Uuni, gwøgu rou, kiper uuna jiy mo cwïnyge da gïï mo reyø.
english: And he said unto them, Let the Lord be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.

anywaa: Ennø, ba doo løny ki man wiia uuni. Ba jiy moa näk cwøw keerge dïïu aacge nee Wuuö Jwøk tïnyge, kiper beeye gïna manynyu.» Kanyøgø Modhe ka Aran aput riem wøk nyïm Peerø.
english: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the Lord; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Rwiec cerï bäät ŋööm Ijep kiper nee lwaa bäänyö ööe bäät ŋööm Ijep, kiper nee gïïa näk otuy bëët yïth ŋøøm, këël moa bøth dhi pey bëët nee camge.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe athøra mare arwiee bäät ŋööm Ijep, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk jamø kwönnö ki jï løø kur tuulcäŋ bäät ŋööm Ijep dïcäŋeca bäre ki di wäänöca bäre. 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, jam wø ööi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ lwaa bäänyö akööle.
english: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the Lord brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaa bäänyö ni tïme ni ena bäät ŋööm Ijep, ni pïge piny dï ŋööm Ijep bäre ni ge thööth døc; ni poot bäŋ teeŋ bäänyö mo päl mo caala manøgø cøøn. Ni këël yi nyïme thuwø bäŋ teeŋ bäänyö mo caala manøgø mo cäŋa öö.
english: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.

anywaa: Kiper ŋööm paac bäre agääpge, ni put bäät ŋöömö tïmö ni cøl bäre ki geni, ni camge gïïa näk otuy bëët ki nyïïjenni bëët moa bøth dhi pey; ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn mo marr moo dööŋ bäät jenni këët, këël gïïa näk otuy yïth pwöth bëët dï ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Peerø Modhe ka Aran alaar cwøl ni kööe, ni «Aana bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni bääya dëëtu thuwø.
english: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the Lord your God, and against you.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a kwaya uuni ki man wëënnu bääyö mara man keere, ni kwayu Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kiper nee thøø man keere paanye bääta.»
english: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and entreat the Lord your God, that he may take away from me this death only.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe aput aay buut Peerø, ni kwac Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he went out from Pharaoh, and entreated the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk wï jamø awiire ni tïm jamø ni kwönni ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni kwönni ni teek døc ni tïŋ lwaa bäänyö maal ni køøl gø yi Naama Kwaar, ni tïme ni bäŋ bäänyö mo odööŋ yi ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: And the Lord turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïny Peerø adøøc mo teek, ni ö Peerø ni kweere ki man wec jø Icriel nee aacge.
english: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Tïŋ cerï maal, kiper nee tïme ni da muudhö bäät ŋööm Ijep, na muudhö mo cøl døc.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe cere atïŋ maal, ni tïme ni da muudhö mo cøl døc dï ŋööm Ijep bäre ki nïne adäk;
english: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:

anywaa: ni tïme ni ba løny jï ŋati man nø ki man neen wati, ni bëëtge piny ki nïne adäk ni bäŋ ŋat mo paany dëëre kare. 'Ba jø Icriel bëët kanya enge yie keere da tar.
english: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Peerø Modhe acwøle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Cou ni tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk. Obwöre mou thuwø løny jïge ki man aacge ki uuni. 'Ba pïïth dïëk mou ki pïïth dhäk mou wär dööŋge.»
english: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the Lord; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, ni «Wa diï mooø ki lääy kiper nee cïpwa no olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa.
english: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the Lord our God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, dhäk mowa ki dïëk mowa wa aay ki geni bëët, ni bäŋ aciel mo dööŋ kany; kiper wa känna wøk dëëtge ni cïpwa ge jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa. Kiper waani ki dëëtwa gïno cïpwa jï Wuuö Jwøk poot kucwa këël mano pïïcwa kunöce.»
english: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the Lord our God; and we know not with what we must serve the Lord, until we come thither.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïny Peerø adøøc mo teek, ni ö Peerø ni kweere ki man wec jø Icriel nee aacge.
english: But the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø aköö jï Modhe, ni «Daak dëërï buuta. Ïïni, gwøk riï, kär täärnyïmï jooda këët. Kiper ni näk mo täärnyïmï cäŋa ka jootø, ï puta thøø dïcäŋeca.»
english: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Marï kare. Täärnyïmï ba cäŋa jootø këët møn.»
english: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Da gïrpiny aciel mør mo leth døc mo odööŋ mo poot jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäät Peerø ki bäät Ijep. 'Ba ki køør manøgø nø, Peerø wääth ocïbe jïïu ni putu aay kany. 'Ba kanyo cïp wääth jïïu nou aayu, ka adïëri møn, uuno put riem wøk bëët kany.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.

anywaa: Ennø, caanï ni wïnyö jï jø Icriel bëët, ni dïcwøø man nø doo pëëö baŋ nyawati ma ŋat Ijep, ni ö dhaage man nø ni pëëe baŋ nyawati ma ŋat Ijep kiper nee jïtge ki jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey ki moa näk tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.»
english: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk yïth jø Ijep atïïe ni met ki jø Icriel. Ni ö Modhe ni nëëne na dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ yi ŋööm Ijep ki jï jø kööre mo Peerø ki jø Ijep bëët.
english: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Modhe köö jï Peerø, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Kanyo tïme na dhöör dï wäär aano ö dï Ijep,
english: And Moses said, Thus saith the Lord, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

anywaa: ni ö obwöc cwøwi moa näk kaai na en yi ŋööm Ijep bëët ni thøwge, ni tägi ka kaa mar Peerø na en paaci cere, këël kany dhaagø ma laŋŋø mo gudö bäät kïn guur, këël kaai mo lääc paac bëët.
english: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.

anywaa: Ni ö oduuru mo dwøŋ døc ni tïme ni dagø yi ŋööm Ijep bäre, ni beeye oduuru mo teeŋe poot kär tägö cøøn, ni ba cäŋ tägö këët.
english: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.

anywaa: 'Ba ki baŋ jø Icriel, ki mano täge ki dhaanhø këël lään paac, bäŋ gwök mo guyi bäätge, kiper nee putu ŋäc møn ni Wuuö Jwøk da apääk mo ee tïïö yïthakic jø Ijep ki jø Icriel.› »
english: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Modhe köö jï Peerø, ni «Jø kööre moï bëët moi ni kany ii, ge ööa baŋa ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïma, ni köge, ni ‹Ïïni ki jøøa caath køørï bëët cou wøk powa.› Ki køør manøgø nø, aano put ci wøk.» Ni ö Modhe ni put døny wøk nyïm Peerø no owëër døc.
english: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø onø caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Kiper nee gïï mo rëëma ec 'moa rege meetge bäät Ijep, Peerø luubö maru ba wïnynye.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe ka Aran gïï mo rëëma ec moøgø atïïcge nyïm Peerø; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïny Peerø poot døøye mo teek, ni ö Peerø ni män jø Icriel ki man aacge paare.
english: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the Lord hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran yi ŋööm Ijep, ni kööe jïge,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,

anywaa: ni «Dwääy man otïmö na dwääy mano tägu ki gø røk dwäde; ni tïme na dwääy mana dïkwøŋŋa eni jïïu røk dwäde mo cwiir.
english: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.

anywaa: Caannu jï lwaa Icriel bäre, ni kööu jïge, ni ‹Kanyo tïm nïr dwääyi man na apaar, ŋati man nø doo lwötö ki nyidiel kiper paare, ki køør mïëri moge, ni beeye nyidiel aciel kiper paac man nø.
english: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kwään jiy moa en paac man nø nøk, ni ba rømi ki nyidiel, wää paaci man nø ki wää paac mana en buute ge doo lwötö ki nyidiel aciel ki køør kwään jiy moa nut dïge; nyidiel manøgø dege pääŋŋö na kare ki køør mana doo cam ŋati man nø.
english: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.

anywaa: Nyïïdïëk mou wär näk bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi rege, ni beege nyïïdïëk ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele; ni nyïïdïëk moøgø wär näk lwørru røk rööm wala røk atëëe.
english: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïdïëk moøgø dou gwøø këël kanyo tïm nïr dwäänögø na apaar kurŋween, ni beeye kanyo ö lwaa Icriel bäre noo ŋarge nyïïdïëk moge kanyo tïme ni cäŋ manynya pädhö.
english: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø ge doo lwötö ki remø ni rwøthge dhøk uudi moo cämge yïthge, ni beeye dhi øtø løøi ki løøi ki maal.
english: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.

anywaa: Ni camge rïŋ gø dïwäänögø ni ege bulö, ni camge gø ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø ko omarø mo keec.
english: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

anywaa: Kär nou cama rïŋ gø ni numö wala no othaalø ki pïï, 'ba ki mano täge ri wïc ki tiel këël gïïa en ec ni wø cam, wär cammu ni you bulö ki maac.
english: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

anywaa: Ni kär dee gø mo weyu mo këët amöölla. 'Ba no dee gø moo dhäthö mo okëët amöölla, wär waaŋŋu ki maac.
english: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.

anywaa: Jöö mano cämu ki gø beeye en; wäru cämu na abïïk wääth you røø, ni war ena tietu, na athøre mou ena ceŋŋu; nou cämö nou läädö. Ni manøgø beeye cam mar Cäŋo Pööth Thøøe Yie mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord's passover.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk aano cäädhi dï ŋööm Ijep dïwäänögø, ni nääa obwöc cwøw moa näk kaai moa en yi ŋööm Ijep bëët, ni beege kaai mo jiy ki kaai mo lääc paac bëët; ni ŋøla luumma bäät juuk Ijep bëët. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba remø otïmö na nyuudhi kiperu røk uudi moa bëëdu yïthge; ni kanyo jooda remø, aano pöödhi ki buutu, ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn mo leth mo pïï bäätu mo raanynya uuni kanyo raanynya Ijep.
english: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.

anywaa: « ‹Dïcäŋögø otïmö na cäŋ par wïc jïïu, ni wøørru gø na ajwöma jï Wuuö Jwøk; cäŋ manøgø wär wøørru cooth ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët.
english: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.

anywaa: U doo bëëdö ki nïne abïriiø nou cama møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, 'ba dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ thuumme moa en yïth uudi mou dou käla wøk; kiper ki mano täge cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ këël bïriet nïne, ŋat moo cämö ki møø mo ree da thømmø jaak, wär tïme ni tøør ri jø Icriel.
english: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.

anywaa: Kanyo tïme na dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ, u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, ni cäŋu jïtö ka acooŋa mør mo ena kur keere ri bïriet nïne; kär dee tïïe mo tïïyu yïth nïne moøgø na ariiø yøø. 'Ba tïïc mano tïïyu keere beeye tïï cam man wø cam ŋati man nø.
english: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni ajwöma mar møga näk ree bäŋ thømmø dou gwøø thuwø, kiper dïcäŋ manøgø tïmö na dïcäŋo käla lwaae mou wøk yie ki yi Ijep; kiper manøgø nø cäŋ manøgø dou gwøø cooth ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët.
english: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.

anywaa: Kanyo tïm dwääyi mana dïkwøŋ ni nïre apaar kurŋween, ni pinynya wïthïënhö, u doo cämö ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, këël mano tïm nïr dwäänögø ni pïërariiø kurciel ni pinynya wïthïënhö.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.

anywaa: Nïne moøgø na abïriiø yøø wär näk mo bäŋ thuumme yïth uudi mou; kiper ŋat mo ocämö ki møø mo ree da thømmø jaak, nee wëëllö mo path wala o thwønh paac, ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør ri lwaa Icriel.
english: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn mo cammu camø ni ree da thømmø; 'ba ki kwör bëëte mou bëët, u doo cama møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø keere.› »
english: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel bëët acwøle, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni lwötu ki nyïïdïëk jïïu ki køør kwään jiy moa en mïëri mou, ni ö wää paaci man nø ni ŋaal nyidiel kiper nee thøø pöödhe ki bäätu.
english: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.

anywaa: Ni lwötu ki bøøge ri jaadha cwøl ni icöp ni cøtu gø yi remø mana näk you löö ya awal, ni rwødhu remø mana en ya awal dhøk uudi mou maal, ki løøi ki løøi; 'ba kär dee dhaanhø mo døny wøk ki dhi øtø mare këël mano tïm pinynyi na amöölla.
english: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ocäädhi dï paac nee jø Ijep nääe; 'ba kanyo joot remø dhi øtø maal, ki løøi ki løøi, eni na Wuuö Jwøk opöödhi ki dhi øtø, ni män dïnääy ki man duny yïth uudi mou nou nääe.
english: For the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.

anywaa: «'Ba uuni ki nyïïkwaayu gïnögø dou gwøø nee bëëde na gïn mo nut cooth.
english: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pïïyu yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïïu keda mana caane, ajwöma manøgø dou gwøø.
english: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the Lord will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.

anywaa: Kany wäro kö obwöre mou ki uuni, na ‹?Aŋø, gïn tiere agïnaŋø?›
english: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?

anywaa: u doo köö jïge, ni ‹Beeye olämi mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper kanya 'näk jø Ijep, ena pöödhö ki buut uut jø Icriel, ni wec mïëri 'moø.› » Ni ö jiyi bëët ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the Lord's passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aay ni tïïcge gø na kare; ni putge jammi bëët tïïc kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ka Aran.
english: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dhöör dï wäär, Wuuö Jwøk obwöc cwøw moa näk kaai bëët na en yi ŋööm Ijep anääe, ni tägi ki kany Peerø na en paaci cere këël mana këët røk kaai mo jøøa en øt twöc, këël kaai mo lääc paac bëët thuwø.
english: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.

anywaa: Ni päny Peerø maal ki dï wäär, ni bee eni, ki jø kööre moe, ki jø Ijep bëët; ni tïm oduuru ni päl døc dï Ijep, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ paac mo obøth ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo othøw yie.
english: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.

anywaa: Køøre Peerø Modhe ka Aran aput cwøl ki dï wäär ni kööe jïge, ni «Ööu maal! Aau wøk dï jiya, uuni ki jø Icriel karubëët. Ni aayu ni tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana caannu gø.
english: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the Lord, as ye have said.

anywaa: Lwørru pïïth dïëk ki pïïth dhäk mou kaawat mana caannu gø, ni aayu. 'Ba a wär gwïëthu thuwø.»
english: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Ijepi ni lacge jø Icriel nee laarge aa wøk poge, kiper mana köge, ni «Waani wa thøw bëët jaak.»
english: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni lwørge muunni moge moa näk ege cöödö ni poot kärge kïthö ki thuumme, ki dääk thaal moge, ni bäcge ge ka abïïe ni käärge ge ki göökge.
english: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca jø Icriel jammi bëët atïïcge ki køør luup moa car Modhe. Kiper geno nø pëëö baŋ jø Ijep ka abïïe, ki jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey, ki moa näk tïïc ka gwet-bïrö;
english: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:

anywaa: ni Wuuö Jwøk yïth jø Ijep ee nø tïïc ni met ki jø Icriel, ni ö gïïa pëëny jø Icrielli bëët ni cïpi ya jø Ijepi jïge, ni putge jø Ijep twier.
english: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö ki Ramcë ni pïïcge Cuköt, ni jiy moa aay bëët beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ni ge cäädhi ka tietge, ni mään ko obwöre kär kwaan rege.
english: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi møøk mo thööth thuwø ni aacge ki geni ciel, ki pïïth dïëk ki pïïth dhäk, ni beege lääc paac mo thööth døc.
english: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni thaalge muunni moa käärge na kälge wøk ki Ijep na näk rege kär kïthö ki thuumme. Kiper poot kärge kïthö ki thuumme, kiper gena riem wøk ki Ijep ni ge kär ruu, ni tïme ni bäŋ cam mo ege jiiŋŋø kiper dëëtge.
english: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet jø Icrielli Ijep beege cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk.
english: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aŋuun cwiiyøgø na dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk yøø, dïcäŋögø kiree, lwaae bëët mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk jø Icriel aput aa wøk yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba wäär mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl jø Icriel wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep beeye wäär mo doo gwøø jï Wuuö Jwøk; wäänögø doo gwøk jø Icrielli bëët jï Wuuö Jwøk këël yïth beenhnhe moge bëët.
english: It is a night to be much observed unto the Lord for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the Lord to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe ka Aran, ni «Man beeye ciik mar cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie: «Kär dee jur mør mo cämö ree.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋø mar ŋati man nø mo ŋeew ka gwel, kanyo näk mo eno nø daŋ, løny jïre ki man cäme ri gø.
english: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.

anywaa: Wëëllö mo path wala dhaanhø mo tïïö ka gwel kär cämö ri gø.
english: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

anywaa: «Camøgø doo cam jøøi moi nø yi øtø aciel; ni bäŋe rïŋö mo kälu wøk ki yi øtø, ni kär dee cöö mo toorru ri camøgø.
english: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.

anywaa: Lwaa Icriel bäre gïnögø dege tïïö.
english: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu, ni manynya man tïïc cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie jï Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man daŋ cwøw bëët moa en paare, køøre eni doo öö ni tïïc gø; ni tïme kaamar o thwønh paac. 'Ba dhaanhø mo kär daŋø ba doo cämö ri gø.
english: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

anywaa: Ni beeye ciik aciel bäre kiper o thwønh paac ki wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu.»
english: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët gïïögø atïïcge na kare; ni putge jammi bëët tïïc kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ka Aran.
english: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca kiree, Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel akäl wøk yi ŋööm Ijep ki køør lwaae moge.
english: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the Lord did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cïp kaai moa näk cwøw bëët kur keerge jïra, ni beege kaai bëët moa lwaarø ki geni dï jø Icriel. Ki mana täge ki kany dhaanhø këël kaai mo lääc paac bëët, beege 'moa.»
english: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Lääŋŋu dïcäŋa ööu wøk yie ki Ijep na näk po laŋ; kiper uuna käl Wuuö Jwøki wøk kaagø ki teek mare. Kiper manøgø nø, kär dee møø mo ree da thømmø mo cam dïcäŋögø.
english: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

anywaa: Dïcäŋi en yi dwääy mana cwøl na Abip, u tïŋŋö yie.
english: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo kïth uuni yïth ŋøøp jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Amör, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc, na kööŋe jï kwäyu kiper nee cïbe jïïu, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, u doo tïïya tïïc man yi dwääni en.
english: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

anywaa: Nïne abïriiø u doo cama møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne wär tïme ni da ajwöma jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the Lord.

anywaa: Møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø wär tïme ni camma gø ki nïne abïriiø; ni kär dee møø mo ree da thømmø mo joot buutu; kär dee thømmø mo di joodø buutu thuwø këël kwöro bëëdu yïthge bëët.
english: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

anywaa: 'Ba wär caan ŋati man nø jï wääde dïcäŋögø, ni kööe, ni ‹Man beeye kiper gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki kipera kanya ööa wøk Ijep.›
english: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø doo bëëdö na nyuudhi kaamar gïn mo otwöö ceŋŋu, ni caala gïn mo ena täärnyïmmu, nee ciik Wuuö Jwøk bëëde ni ena dhøgu, kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl uuni wøk Ijep ki teek mare.
english: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the Lord's law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the Lord brought thee out of Egypt.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, gïnögø dou gwøø ki kanya näk owäŋŋö ki yi cwiir cooth.
english: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo kïth uuni yi ŋööm jø Keenan, kaawat mana kööŋe jïïu ki kwäyu, kanyo cïp gø jïïu,
english: And it shall be when the Lord shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

anywaa: kaai moa näk cwøw bëët mo olwaarø ki ge dou cïba kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö kaai mo lääc paac mou bëët moa näk cwøw ni tïmge na mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: That thou shalt set apart unto the Lord all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the Lord's.

anywaa: 'Ba kaa ma mar arëën dou wiilø ki nyidiel. 'Ba ni näk mo ba wiillu, ŋute dou meenø. 'Ba kaai mo jiy na näk wäätu bëët dou wïïla wøk.
english: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

anywaa: «'Ba yi nyïme, kanyo ö wäätu noo pëënyge uuni, ni köge, ni ‹?Gïn tiere aŋøøni?›, u doo köö jïge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk øøna käl wøk ki teek mare Ijep na näk po laŋ.
english: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the Lord brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

anywaa: Ni kanya ö Peerø na døøc cwïnye mo teek ni kweere ki man aaø, Wuuö Jwøk kaai moa näk cwøw bëët moa en yi ŋööm Ijep anääe, ni beege kaai mo jiy ki kaai mo lääc paac bëët. Kiper manøgø nø, waani kaai mo lääc paac moa näk cwøw bëët wø cïpwa cïbö no olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba wäätwa moa näk kaai wø wïïlwa wøk.›
english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the Lord slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the Lord all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl øøni wøk Ijep ki teek mare, gïnögø doo bëëdö na nyuudhi kaamar gïn mo you twöö ceŋŋu, ni caala gïn mo ena täärnyïmmu.»
english: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the Lord brought us forth out of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Peerø na wec jø Icriel nee aacge, ge kär bwøth Jwøki ki jöör ŋööm Pilitin, këël na bëëde ni cäänna jöörögø; kiper mana kö Jwøki, ni «Beeye kiper nee jø Icriel acaacge ba wiilge ni døøge Ijep kanyo dee leny.»
english: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, Jwøk jiy abwødhe ki jöör dï paap ni ee meenø ni ge coonya Naama Kwaar. Ni ö jø Icrielli wøk ki Ijep ni ge cäädhi kaamar jiy mo cøøa baŋ leny.
english: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni lwør cuu Jocep, ni käär geni, kiper Jocep jø Icriel awëëk kööŋ dïkwøŋ, ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Jwøk ööa baŋu kuna køny uuni; 'ba kar kaaca nø, cuu 'moa wär kwanynyu kany ni källu geni.»
english: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö Cuköt ni tïïcge twïër marge Ëtham na en deŋ paap.
english: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cäädha nyïmge ki dïcäŋ ki yi pöölö mo ree ee wenyø, ni bwøtha geni ki jöö mano cørge, ni pööllögø liel kaamar maac ki wäär ni cïpö ki tar jïge, nee lønye jïge ki man cääthge ki dïcäŋ ki wäär.
english: And the Lord went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

anywaa: 'Ba pöölö man wø nëëni ki dïcäŋ ni wø liel na maac ki wäär ree käre paanyø nyïm jø Icriel këët.
english: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel nee døøge ŋäthge mëëth ni tïïcge twïër marge nyïm Pii-Ayröt, yïthakic Migdöl ki Naama Kwaar; u doo tïïö ki twïër bäät Naama Kwaar ni dïët ki Baal-Dhapön.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi–hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal–zephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

anywaa: Kiper Peerø oköö ni jø Icriel thääyö dï paap jaak, ni geno ciel paapi dïër.
english: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

anywaa: Køøre aani cwïny Peerø odøøya mo teek, ni läm køøru. 'Ba aani teek mara onyoodha ki ri Peerø ki lwaak mar leny mare bäre; ni ö jø Ijepi ni putge gø ŋäc møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.» Ni ö jø Icrielli ni døøge ŋäthge keda mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïge.
english: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the Lord. And they did so.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Peerø nyeny Ijep ni jø Icriel anø jöömmö, eni ki jø kööre moe acaara marge awiilge kiper jø Icriel, ni köge, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïø en? ?Aŋø, jø Icriel awiiø møn ki man ba tïnyge øøni këët?»
english: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

anywaa: Køøre Peerø jääy mare man wø tut okwëënyi ajiiŋŋe, ni aae ki lwaak mar leny mare na aciel;
english: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

anywaa: ni lwør jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo ojierø ma dïpe abïciel, ki jïëthe mo Ijep møga bëët mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni jääy man nø kwäärö mare ena bääte.
english: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni døøc cwïny Peerø nyeny Ijep mo teek, ni ö Peerø ni läp køør jø Icriel, ni jø Icriel cäädhi ni cwïnyge da cer.
english: And the Lord hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Ijep aläp køør jø Icriel ko okwëënyi mo Peerø bëët ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø okwëënyi moe, ki lwaak mar leny mare, ni maage ge bäät Naama Kwaar kanya näk twïër marge ege tïïö yie nyïm Pii-Ayröt na näk dïët ki Baal-Dhapön.
english: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi–hahiroth, before Baal–zephon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm kar Peerø ni cään ki geni, jø Icriel alwïthö, ni jootge jø Ijep ni lämma køørge, ni putge lwäyö døc kiree; ni ö jø Icrielli ni jwöŋge jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jï Modhe, na «?Aŋø, beeye kiper mana bäŋe bwör Ijep na kälï waani wøk nee wa thøøwa dï paabi en? ?A teeŋ gïnaŋø na tïïyï dëëtwa na kälï waani wøk jaak ki Ijep en?
english: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kärwa caanø jïrï na bëëde kanya enø Ijep, ni köwa, ni ‹Wec wa nee jø Ijep tïnywa›? Kiper doo beerra eni jïwa ki mana dewa jø Ijep tïnynyö jaak ki man thøøwa dï paabi en.»
english: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Käru lwäyö; cuŋŋu karu ni neennu køny mar Wuuö Jwøk mano tïïe kiperu dïcäŋi en; kiper jø Ijep moø neetu dïcäŋi yøø, ge ba cäŋu neennø këët na bäre bäre.
english: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the Lord, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk okëëdi kiperu, 'ba uuni u doo bëëdö mëëth jaak.»
english: The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, na «?Aperŋø ni jwöŋï dëëra en? Caanï jï jø Icriel nee pööthge nyïmge.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, kwany athøra marï ni rwieyï gø bäät Naama Kwaar, ni pääŋŋï pïï ki dïge, nee jø Icriel pööthge ki dï Naama Kwaar kanya no otal.
english: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cwïny jø Ijep odøøya mo teek møn ni lämge køør jø Icriel; 'ba aani teek mara onyoodha ki ri Peerø ki lwaak mar leny mare bäre, ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø okwëënyi moe.
english: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

anywaa: Køøre oput jø Ijepi ŋäc møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo nyoodha teek mara ki ri Peerø, ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø okwëënyi moe bëët.»
english: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the Lord, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mar Jwøk, na näk cäädha nyïm lwaa Icriel, ni paany ree ni ci ŋäthge; ni ö pöölö ni daak ree nyïmge ni cuŋŋe ŋäthge,
english: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

anywaa: ni tïme ni ena yïthakic lwaa Ijep ki lwaa Icriel. Ni bëët pöölö manøgø ni piny ee tïïö na muudhö ki baŋ jø Ijep, ni poot cïpö ki tar ki wäär jï jø Icriel. Ni put tïmö ni ba løny jï jø Ijep ki man öge kany mo cään ki jø Icriel dïwäänögø bäre.
english: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe cere arwiee bäät Naama Kwaar; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni dwøk naam ŋääe ki køør jamø mana teek na tïïe nee kwöde ki yi wäär bäre, ni kwönni ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö pïïyi ni pääŋge rege, ni ö naammi ni tale.
english: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the Lord caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni cørge dï naam ni ge cäädhi ki kanya no otal, ni pïï cuŋŋi kaamar dëër øtø bäät cämge ki bäät cwïcge.
english: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

anywaa: Køøre jø Ijep aput läpö ko okwëënyi mo Peerø bëët, ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø okwëënyi moe, ni cige køørge ni ge cøra dï Naama Kwaar.
english: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na köök gwïën, Wuuö Jwøk lwaa leny mar jø Ijep aneene ki yi pöölla näk liel kaamar maac ki wäär, ni kier wï lwaa leny mar jø Ijep.
english: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the Lord looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni twöc tiet jïëthe moge mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni tïïc ge ni ba cäädhi ni beyø. Køøre jø Ijep aköö, ni «Beerra man daaø røgø buut jø Icriel, kiper Wuuö Jwøk cwaga geni ni këëdö ki øøni.»
english: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the Lord fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Rwiec cerï bäät Naama Kwaar, kiper nee pïï duuge bäät jø Ijep, ki bäät jïëthe moge mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø okwëënyi moge.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni rwiec cere bäät Naama Kwaar, ni ö naammi ni døø kare ki bäc øw kaa mana bëëde dïkwøŋ. 'Ba kanya ö jø Ijepi na reŋge ni ge ŋwieya pïï moa ö bäätge, Wuuö Jwøk jø Ijep amaa dï naam.
english: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the Lord overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

anywaa: Ni ö pïïyi ni duuge ni mwønyge jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø okwëënyi, këël lwaa leny mar Peerø bäre na cäädhö køør jø Icriel dï Naama Kwaar; ni bäŋgø mo odööŋ këël aciel dïge.
english: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäädhö ki kany mo otal dï Naama Kwaar, ni pïï cuŋŋi kaamar dëër øtø bäät cwïcge ki bäät cämge.
english: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel akønye ceŋ jø Ijep, ni ö jø Icrielli ni jootge dëët jø Ijep moa no othøw deŋ Naama Kwaar.
english: Thus the Lord saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jootge teek Wuuö Jwøk na dwøŋ na nyoodhe dëët jø Ijep, gena put lwäyö ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋääthge Wuuö Jwøk ki dhaanhnhe ma Modhe.
english: And Israel saw that great work which the Lord did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the Lord, and believed the Lord, and his servant Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ki jø Icriel duut man awärge jï Wuuö Jwøk ni köge, ni «Aani a wär jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ena tïmö na ajieme cäätha maal. Okweeny ki ŋata en bäät gø aleeŋ yi Naama Kwaar.
english: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the Lord, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mara ni bee eni na cäŋŋa ki duut; ena tïmö na dïkunyi mara. Ena Jwøk mara, ni eni daa pwøø; ena Jwø kwara, ni eni daa jiemø.
english: The Lord is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.

anywaa: «Wuuö Jwøk beeye ŋat leny; ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye nyeŋŋe.
english: The Lord is a man of war: the Lord is his name.

anywaa: Jïëthe mo Peerø mo wø tut okwëënyi ki lwaak mar leny mare aleeŋ yi Naama Kwaar; ni ö kwääc leny moe moa näk ojierø ni mutge yi Naama Kwaar.
english: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

anywaa: Gena mwøny athaŋ Naama Kwaar, ni negelïŋ piny yi kut kaamar kïdi.
english: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cer cwïïï teek døc; wui Wuuö Jwøk, cer cwïïï, nyïïmän wø raanynye raanynyø.
english: Thy right hand, O Lord, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O Lord, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.

anywaa: Nyïïmän mo wø ö maal bäätï wø raanynyï raanynyø ki køør ajiem marï na dwøŋ; ni jääŋŋï wëëyï na teek bäätge, ni thöör geni kaamar lethø mo waaŋ.
english: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

anywaa: Ki køør mana jwïëyï jaak ki umï, pïï rege aputge cooŋ kanya aciel, ni ö pïïyi moa näk kwödö ni cuŋge kaamar gïï mo ocooŋ kanya aciel; na athaga ree ee maaø dï Naama Kwaar.
english: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

anywaa: «Ni kö nyimänni, ni ‹Aani a läpö nee ge maa, ni twiera geni ni pääŋŋa jammi moge; ni tïïa gïna manynya dëëtge; aani opëëllö mara owödha wøk, ni raanynya geni ki cera.›
english: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni jamø marï awëëgï kwönnö, ni ö Naama Kwaarri ni mwøny nyïïmän bëët; ni negelïŋ piny kaamar ley yïth pïïa teek.
english: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ?aŋa ni pääri ki ïïni dï juu bëët? ?Aŋa ni pääri ki ïïni na dwøŋ, ni bëëtö mare ena kur keere? ?Aŋø, paa ï na Jwøk keerï na doo lwäärö kiper ajiem marï ki gïï wø rëëm ec ni wø tïïyï?
english: Who is like unto thee, O Lord, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

anywaa: Cer cwïïï arwieyï, ni ö ŋøømmi ni mwøny nyïïmän moï.
english: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

anywaa: «'Ba jiyï moa wïïlï wøk ki køør mëëyï ni wø ba jøøl obwøthï; ni kïthï geni kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere ki teek marï.
english: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.

anywaa: Gïrï owïny juurre ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi; ni ö jø Pilitinni ni tïmge ni böö.
english: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia.

anywaa: Køøre kwääri mo Ëdöm obëëdö ni cwïnyge opädhö; ni ö dïbwöthe mo Möap ni tïm dëëtge ni miel; ni ö jøøa bëëdö Keenan ni bwøkge.
english: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

anywaa: Lwär mo dwøŋ døc ki böök mo päl otägi dëëtge; wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo jootge teek marï na dwøŋ, geno bëëdö ni lïŋö jaak kaamar kïdi; këël mano pööth jiyï ki buutge, ni beege jiyï moa wïïlï wøk.
english: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O Lord, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, geno bwøthï ni këëllï tietge piny bäät kïdi mana näk marï, kanya näk iï tïïö na näk kar bëëtö marï, ni beeye kanya en kur keere na näk marï na jiiŋŋï ki dëërï.
english: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O Lord, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk obëëdö na wïth gïïa en bäät piny bëët na bäre bäre.»
english: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

anywaa: Kanya ö okwëënyi mo Peerø ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi moe ki jø okwëënyi moe na cige yi Naama Kwaar, Wuuö Jwøk pï Naama Kwaar adwøk bäätge; 'ba jø Icriel acäädhö ki kany mo otal dï Naama Kwaar.
english: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the Lord brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgøøni Mariyam na näk nyikuŋ Jwøk, na näk cöök Aranni mana näk dhaagø, anëëdö alwøre, ni ci määnni bëët wøk køøre ni ge pöödö ka anëët ni ge miel.
english: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

anywaa: Ni ö Mariyammi ni jøl duut ni kööe, ni «Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ena tïmö na ajieme cäätha maal; okweeny ki ŋata en bäät gø aleeŋ yi Naama Kwaar.»
english: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø Icriel abwødhe ni tïŋge ki bäät Naama Kwaar, ni aage wøk dï paap Cur; ni cääthge ki nïne adäk dï paap ni bäŋ pïï mo ege joodø.
english: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge kanya cwøl ni Maara, pï Maara atïmö ni ba løny ki man maathge gø, kiper beeye pïï mo keec; kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace aput cwøl ni Maara.
english: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel aŋurö ki nyeŋ Modhe, ni köge, na «?Agïnaŋø noo maathwa nø?»
english: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ajwöŋö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth jaath jïgø; ni ö Modhe ni leeŋ jaadhøgø yïth pïï, ni tïm pïïyi ni met. 'Ba kaace beeye kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na kän wøk jïge yie ki ciik ki luup ŋøl. Ni beeye kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na pääny geni yie.
english: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Ni näk mo dwøra leŋŋu leŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni tïïyu gïna beer nyïma, ni cegu ïthu ki gïïa cema, ni gwøgu ciik 'moa bëët, täwe moa kïtha bäät jø Ijep ba kïtha bäätu; kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø køny uuni.»
english: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.

anywaa: Køøre gena ö Ëlim kany mo yie da jøøre mo pïï ma apaar kurriiø ki twöe ma pïërabïriiø, ni putge tïïö ki twïër buut pïï kaace.
english: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa Icriel bäre atïŋŋö ki Ëlim, ni aacge ni pïïcge dï paap mo cwøl ni Cin ni nïr dwääy apaar kurbïïc mar riet dwäde moa aage wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep. 'Ba paabøgø ena yïthakic Ëlim ki Kïn Caynay.
english: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø lwaa Icriel bäre atïmö ni ŋurö ki nyeŋ Modhe ka Aran dï paap.
english: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

anywaa: Ni köge jï Modhe ka Aran, na «?Aŋø, ba doo beerra mana dewa thøø cer Wuuö Jwøk jaak yi ŋööm Ijep kanya bëëtwa yie ni waano pï piny lak dääe mo rïŋ, ni wa cämö ki kwane ni jäŋwa? 'Ba ennø, waana kälu wøk ni kälu waani dï paabi en kiper nee lwaak man bäre 'nägu ki käc.»
english: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the Lord in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ennø, muunni wëëga pänhnhö ki maal kaamar køth kiperu. Køøre jiy ocii ni cooŋge muunni moøgø kanya ciel mo orømø kiper dïcäŋ man nø cooth. Gïnögø tïïa tïïö naa päänynya geni ki man näk mo ge cäädhi ka køør ciik 'moa wala jïge bäyö.
english: Then said the Lord unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø ri bïcier nïne, kany wø jiiŋge moa kwanyge, puta tïmö ni päl ni rømø kiper nïne ariiø.»
english: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran aköö jï jø Icriel bëët, ni «Kanyo tïme na abøøya kawaane, putu ka ŋäc møn ni Wuuö Jwøk bee eni na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep;
english: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the Lord hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:

anywaa: noo tïme na amöölla thuwø, ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk neennu neenø; kiper ŋurö maru mana ŋuru dëëre ki gøøni awïnynye. ?Aŋø, ni ŋuru dëëtwa en, waana ŋaani cøøn?»
english: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the Lord; for that he heareth your murmurings against the Lord: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Modhe köö, ni «Beeye Wuuö Jwøk noo mooc uuni ki rïŋö man cammu ka abøøya, ki møø man jäŋŋu ki gø ka amöölla. Kiper eni na Wuuö Jwøk ŋurö mana ŋuru dëëre ki gøøni awïnynye. ?Aŋø, waana ŋaani cøøn? Ŋurö maru ba en bäätwa, 'ba ena bäät Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Moses said, This shall be, when the Lord shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the Lord heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe aköö jï Aran, ni «Caanï jï lwaa Icriel bäre ni kööï, ni ‹Ööu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ŋurö maru mana ŋuru ki gøøni awïnynye.› »
english: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the Lord: for he hath heard your murmurings.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde na Aran cäänö ki lwaa Icriel bäre, gïn mør atägö. Geni gena lwïthö kuna näk da paap; køøre ajiem Wuuö Jwøk anëënö ki yi pöölö.
english: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the Lord appeared in the cloud.

anywaa: Ni cään Wuuö Jwøki ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ŋurö mana ŋur jø Icrielli ki gøøni awïnynya. Ennø, caanï jïge ni kööï, ni ‹Kanyo tïm cäŋŋi ni manynya pädhö, uuno cämö ki rïŋö; ka amöölla thuwø uuno jäŋ ki møø, ni putu gø ŋäc møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.› »
english: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na abøøya møn, ajwëëyi aput öö ni pääŋge twïër; køøre ka amöölla lak twïër atïmö ni da thööy mo thööth.
english: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö thööy na talge, gïï møøk mo thenh thenh mo reep mo caala bøøge mo kwön ajoot piny dï paap, ni piny ege gääbö bäre.
english: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jootge gø, kiper na kucge tier gïnögø, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «?Man agïnaŋø?» Køøre Modhe aköö jïge, ni «Gïnögø beeye møø mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïïu kiper nee cammu.
english: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the Lord hath given you to eat.

anywaa: Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper gïnögø beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ŋati man nø wär cuŋ kanya ciel ki møø mo orømø kiper cam mare. U doo lwötö ki kar rumi mana cwøl ni omer jï ŋati man nø, ki køør kwään jiy moa en yo oduŋkaara mar ŋati man nø.› »
english: This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel gïna caan jïge atïïcge. Ni cuŋge ki muunni, ni jø møøk dëëtge cooŋa mo thööth ni møøk cooŋa mo nøk.
english: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya rømge gø ki rumi mana cwøl ni omer, ŋata no cuuŋö ki mo thööth, bäŋgø mo odööŋ wøk wïth moe. Ŋata näk cooŋa mo nøk thuwø bäŋgø mo orëëm wïth moe. Ŋati man nø cooŋa mo orømø kiper cam mare.
english: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïge, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo wëëö ri mare kiper amöölla mør.»
english: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

anywaa: 'Ba luum Modhe kärge leŋø. Køøre jø møøk dëëtge thäk moge akange kiper amöölla, ni ö moa kange ni jït yïthge ki twöŋi ni kwäkge. Ni ö Modhe ni put wëër ki geni.
english: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

anywaa: 'Ba geni ka amöölla cooth muunni wø cooŋge cooŋø, ni ŋati man nø cooŋa mo orømø kiper cam mare. 'Ba kany wø lëënh cäŋŋi, muunni moa en dï pwöla puta leenyø.
english: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na bïcier nïne, gena cuuŋö ki muunni mo orømø kiper nïne ariiø. Ni ö ŋati man nø ni jïte ki kar rumme ariiø, ni rømge ka rumi mana cwøl ni omer. 'Ba kanya ö wïth lwaae na caange gø jï Modhe,
english: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

anywaa: Modhe aköö jïge, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Diøø beeye cäŋ jwömö, ni beeye cäŋ jwömö mana en kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk. Dïcäŋi deellu gïïa dou deelø, ni thaallu gïïa dou thaalø, ni kannu moa näk odööŋ jïïu kiper amöölla.› »
english: And he said unto them, This is that which the Lord hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the Lord: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

anywaa: Køøre moa näk odööŋ aputge kan kiper amöölla, kaawat mana caani ya Modhe jïge. 'Ba bäŋgø mo okwäk wala mo yie ojïtö ki twöŋi.
english: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Cammu muunni moøgø dïcäŋi. Kiper dïcäŋi en beeye cäŋ jwömö na mar Wuuö Jwøk; ni bäŋ møø mo jootu dïcäŋi dï pwöla.
english: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the Lord: to day ye shall not find it in the field.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa näk abïciel, løny jïïu ki man cuuŋu ki muunni; 'ba no tïme na bïriet nïne na näk cäŋ jwömö, tïmö ni bäŋgø.»
english: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

anywaa: Køøre kanya tïme na ri bïriet nïne, jø møøk dëëtge aa wøk nee cuŋge kiper dëëtge; 'ba bäŋgø mo ege joodø.
english: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, na «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø no bëëdu nou kweeyø ki man gwøgu ciik 'moa ki gïïa cema?
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

anywaa: Ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, uuna mooa ki cäŋ jwömö. Kiper manøgø nø, u mooa mooø ki muunni ma kar nïne ariiø ri bïcier nïne. Ŋati man nø beerra man bëëde kare, ni bäŋe dhaanhø mo paany ree kare ri bïriet nïne.»
english: See, for that the Lord hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

anywaa: Køøre jiy ajwöm ri bïriet nïne.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel nyeŋ møø acwølge ni meena. 'Ba møø manøgø tar ni caala nyeŋ nyïmi, ni ŋweethe caala møø mo okïthö ki maar kïc.
english: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
