anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Beerra man känu ki møø mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni omer ni päŋ. Ni bëëde ni you kanø ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët, kiper nee møø mana caama uuni ki gøøni dï paap kanya käla uuni wøk ki yi Ijep nee joot beenhnhe moøgø.› »
english: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe aköö jï Aran, ni «Lwötï ki dak ni kïthï yie ki meena mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni omer, ni cïbï dak manøgø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee bëëde no okanø këël yïth beenhnhe mou bëët.»
english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the Lord, to be kept for your generations.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe, Aran acøø ni cïp dak manøgø piny nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, kiper nee kan.
english: As the Lord commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel abëëdö ni cama meena ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween këël mana pïïcge yi ŋöömma bëët jiyi yie. Ni putge bëëtö ni ge cama gø këël mana pïïcge keew mar ŋööm jø Keenan.
english: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

anywaa: 'Ba rumi mana cwøl ni omer yïthe apaar tïmö na rumi aciel mar rumi mana cwøl ni iipa.
english: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa Icriel bäre atïŋŋö ki dï paap Cin ni cääthge ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni tïïcge twïër marge Rapidim; 'ba atïmö ni bäŋ pïï mo maathge.
english: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the Lord, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, jiy atïïö ko okiera dëër Modhe ni köge, ni «Mooyu wa ki pïï mo maathwa.» Ni kö Modhe jïge, na «?Aperŋø ni tïïu ko okiera dëëra en? ?Aŋø ni päänynyu Wuuö Jwøk en?»
english: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba jiy anäk riewi kaace ni ge manynya pïï; ni ŋurge ki nyeŋ Modhe ni köge, na «?Aŋø na kälï wa wøk ki Ijep, ni 'nägï wa ki riew ko obwöre mowa ki lääc paac mowa en?»
english: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni jwöŋe jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa jï jøøi ennø? Gena løny ni ge manynya aani naa këërge ki kïte.»
english: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Cør dï jiy ni lwötï ki jø døøŋŋø røk jø døøk Icriel, ni kwanyï athøra mana gøøyï naam ki gø ni aayu ki geni.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano cuŋŋi nyïmï bäät kïdi kaace buut Kïn Körëp; ni gøøyï kïdi manøgø, ni ö pïïyi ni kwönge wøk ki yie, nee jiy mäthge ki pïï.» Ni ö Modhe ni tïïc gïnögø ni nëënö jï jø døøk Icriel.
english: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni cwøl nyeŋ kaace ni Meriba, kiper beeye kanya ö jø Icrielli na tïïge ko okiera yie, ni cwøl gø thuwø ni Maca, kiper beeye kanya ö jø Icrielli na päänyge Wuuö Jwøk yie, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ena buutø, wala jïre bäär?»
english: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the Lord, saying, Is the Lord among us, or not?

anywaa: Køøre jø Amalëk aöö ni këëtge ki jø Icriel Rapidim.
english: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jï Jøcua, ni «Kwänyï ki jiy, ni cou wøk ni këëdu ki jø Amalëk. Diøø aano cuŋŋi wï kïdi maal na athøny Jwøk ena cera.»
english: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.

anywaa: Ni tïïyi Jøcua kaawat mana caani ya Modhe jïgø, ni këëtge ki jø Amalëk; ni ö Modhe ka Aran ki Ur ni cige wï kïdi maal.
english: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca kany wø tïm Modhe ni ceŋŋe tïŋe maal, jø Icriel puta rëëmmö; ni kany wø dwøk ceŋŋe piny, jø Amalëk puta rëëmmö.
english: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

anywaa: 'Ba ceŋ Modhe aööl; ni ö Aranni ki Ur ni lwötge ki kïdi ni cïpge gø piny, ni ö Modhe ni pï piny bäät gø; ni ö Aranni ki Ur ni jølge ceŋ Modhe, ni dhaanhø aciel ena ri cere man ni dhaanhø maya ena ri cere maya. Ni put ceŋ Modhe bëëtö ni teek këël mana päth cäŋŋi.
english: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua jø leny mo jø Amalëk abööte ri leny manøgø.
english: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Göör gïnögø piny yi warakata na gïn ma gïr par wïc, ni caanï gø ni wïnyö jï Jøcua, kiper acaara mo di caarø kiper jø Amalëk otïïa ni bäŋgø bäät piny na bäre bäre.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tïïe ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni cwøl nyeŋ gø ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye bëëra mara».
english: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovah–nissi:

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk akööŋ, ni kööe, ni ‹A na Wuuö Jwøk, jïra poot da leny ki jø Amalëk këël yïth beenhnhe moge bëët.› »
english: For he said, Because the Lord hath sworn that the Lord will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lam mar jø Midien na näk Jëthrö wää cï Modhe, gïïa tïïc Jwøki bëët kiper jiye ma jø Icriel ki Modhe, ni beeye mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl jø Icriel wøk ki yi Ijep, awïnynye.
english: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the Lord had brought Israel out of Egypt;

anywaa: 'Ba Jëthrö nyaare ma Dhipöra na näk cï Modhe, na jääŋ Modhe baŋe, ee nø pänhnhö kar kaaca,
english: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,

anywaa: ki wääte karge riet. 'Ba wääte moøgø, nyeŋ maya cwøl ni Gërcöm, kiper wänni ma Modhe aköö, ni «Aana bëëdö ni aana wëëllö po juurre møøk mo path.»
english: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ maya cwøl ni Eliëdher, kiper wänni ma Modhe aköö, ni «Jwøk na näk Jwø kwara bee eni na køny aani, ni käl aani wøk dho opëëllö mar Peerø.»
english: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

anywaa: Køøre Jëthrö wää cï Modhe aö baŋ Modhe dï paap yi twïër kanya en yie buut Kïn Jwøk, ni wäät Modhe ki cï Modhe cäädhi ka eni ciel.
english: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:

anywaa: Ni ö Jëthrö ni jääge ki dwøl baŋ Modhe ni kööe, ni «Aana Jëthrö wää cïïï; aani ki cïïï ko obwöre moï karge riet waana ö baŋï.»
english: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe aput aa wøk kuna røømge ki wää cïïe, ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni nuum dhi gø ni määtha gø, ni putge dëëtge pëënynyö ki jööt dëël marge, ni dønyge yo oduŋkaara.
english: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni caan gïïa tägö bëët jï wää cïïe, ni beege gïïa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëër Peerø ki jø Ijep kiper jø Icriel, këël gïïa leth bëët na pïï bäät jø Icriel ri wääth, ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki thuwø na køny geni.
english: And Moses told his father in law all that the Lord had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the Lord delivered them.

anywaa: Ni ö Jëthrö ni mïn yie ki gïïa beyø na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel, na køny geni ceŋ jø Ijep.
english: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the Lord had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

anywaa: Køøre Jëthrö aköö, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk na køny uuni ceŋ jø Ijep ki cer Peerø. Bee eni na køny jø Icriel ceŋ jø Ijep.
english: And Jethro said, Blessed be the Lord, who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

anywaa: Kawaane ajooda møn ni Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋŋa eni ki juu bëët, kiper køny manøgø atïïe kiper atöör mana tïïc jø Ijepi bäät jø Icriel.»
english: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jëthrö wää cï Modhe akännö ko olämi man wø waaŋ ko olämme møøk ni cïp ge jï Jwøk, ni ö Aranni ki jø døøŋŋø bëët mo jø Icriel ni öge kiper nee ge cämge na aciel ki Jëthrö wää cï Modhe nyïm Jwøk.
english: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses' father in law before God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, Modhe apï piny kiper nee luup jiy ŋøle. Ni ö jiyi ni cuŋge nyïm Modhe ki mana täge ka amöölla këël abøøya.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö wää cï Modhe na joot gïïa tïïc Modhe bëët kiper jiy, Modhe apëënynye ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni tïïyï en kiper jiy? ?Aperŋø ni tïme ni luup jøøi bëët ŋøla ïïni keerï en, ni jiy bëët cuŋŋö nyïmï ki mana täge ka amöölla këël abøøya?»
english: And when Moses' father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that thou doest to the people? why sittest thou thyself alone, and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even?

anywaa: Køøre adwøk Modhe jï wää cïïe ni kööe, ni «Beeye kiper jiy atïmö ni ööa baŋa kiper nee luup moo ŋøl Jwøki kiperge nee pëënyge ki aani.
english: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of God:

anywaa: Ni kany wø tïme ni da luup yïthakicge, ge ööa baŋa, ni ŋøla luum ŋati man nø piny ki wati, ni pwönynya geni ki ciik Jwøk.»
english: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.

anywaa: 'Ba wää cï Modhe aköö jï Modhe, ni «Gïnögø ni tïïyï enø patha wøp.
english: And Moses' father in law said unto him, The thing that thou doest is not good.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ïïni ki jøøgø bëët ni en buutï yøø, u ööl; kiper tïïc manøgø teek kiperï kiree, ni ba løny ki tïïc jïrï ï keerï.
english: Thou wilt surely wear away, both thou, and this people that is with thee: for this thing is too heavy for thee; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïny luubö mara mano caana jïrï. 'Ba Jwøk oen buutï. Gïna diï tïïö beeye en; ï doo cuŋŋö nyïm Jwøk kiper jøøgø, ni caanï luup bëët mo wø tägi yïthakicge jï Jwøk.
english: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:

anywaa: Ni pwönynyï geni ki ciik ki gïïa cem Jwøki, ni nyoothï jöö jïge mana dege cäädhö ki gøøni ki gïïa dege tïïö.
english: And thou shalt teach them ordinances and laws, and shalt shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø ï doo jëëdö røkge bëët ki jiy mo nyeŋge reegø mo lwäär ki Jwøk, na jiy mo di ŋäädhö, na jiy mo män ki møt; ni tïïyï geni na wïth jø Icriel, ni tïmge na kwääri mo lwaa jiy ma kume ki ma dïpe ki ma pïërobïïci ki mo opaarri.
english: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men, such as fear God, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni tïmge ni luup mo jiy ŋøla geni cooth. 'Ba kany wø näk mo da luubö mo teek, dege bwödha nyïmï. 'Ba luubö mo jööt jaak, dege ŋølø keerge. Køøre nø, tïïc marï doo tïmö ni jööt, ni tïm tïïci ni nywaaga uuni ki jøøgø bëët.
english: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto thee, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with thee.

anywaa: Ni näk mo gïna caana jïrï enøgø tïïyï tïïö, ni ö Jwøki thuwø ni kööm ïïni na enøgø nø, doo løny jïrï ki man cuŋŋï niï teek. Køøre jøøgø bëët doo døøa kwörge ni yïthge met.»
english: If thou shalt do this thing, and God command thee so, then thou shalt be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe dwør wää cïïe aleŋe, ni tïïc gïïa caan wää cïïe jïre bëët.
english: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put jëëdö ki jiy mo nyeŋge reegø dëët jø Icriel bëët, ni tïïc geni na wïth jiy, na kwääri mo lwaa jiy ma kume ki ma dïpe ki ma pïërobïïci ki mo opaarri.
english: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni tïmge ni ge ŋøla luup jiy cooth. 'Ba luup moa teek wø bwøthge nyïm Modhe, ni ö luupi moa jööt jaak ni tïme ni ŋøla ge keerge.
english: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe wää cïïe ajiedhe, ni ö wää cïïe ni aae, ni døø poge.
english: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää dwäde ni jø Icriel onø ö wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, dïcäŋ manøgø kiree gena pïï dï paap Caynay.
english: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca ge tïŋŋi ka Rapidim ni pïïcge dï paap Caynay, ni tïïcge twïër marge dï paabøgø buut Kïn Caynay.
english: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni ci maal bäät kïdi nee røømge ki Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki Modhe ki bäät kïdi, ni kööe, ni «Caanï jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap na näk jø Icriel ni kööï jïge,
english: And Moses went up unto God, and the Lord called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

anywaa: ni ‹Uuni ki dëëtu kiree gïna tïïa dëët jø Ijep ajootu ki nyeŋŋu, na käla uuni wøk ki Ijep, ni gwøa uuni kaa man wø ö odhuuthi wø käär nyaare ki bwöpe, ni käla uuni baŋa.
english: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ni näk mo luumma wïnynyu wïnynyö na adïëri møn, ni gwøgu gïna tuuda ki uuni, u puta tïmö ni uuna 'moa dï wïth juurre bëët, kiper piny bäre beeye mara;
english: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

anywaa: ni tïmu ni uuna dïlämme mo tuuŋ kwär jïra, ni uuna wï jur mo ena kur keere.› Moøgø beege luup moo caanï jï jø Icriel.»
english: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aduu piny ni cwøl jø døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel, ni peeth luup moøgø bëët nyïmge, ni beege luup moa cem Wuuö Jwøki jïre.
english: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the Lord commanded him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aløk jø Icrielli bëët ki dwøl aciel ni köge, ni «Luup bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki tïïcwa tïïö.» Ni ö Modhe ni dwøk luubö mana caan jiyi baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the Lord hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, a ööa baŋï naa ööi ka yi pöölö mo cøl, kiper nee luup moo cara ki ïïni nee wïny jiyi, niï ŋääthge na bäre bäre thuwø.» Køøre Modhe luubö mana caan jøøgø aput caan jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Modhe, ni «Ci baŋ jø Icriel ni døøyï ge mo waany dïcäŋ man ki dïcäŋ mar diøø, ni penyge abïïe moge;
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

anywaa: ni jiiŋge dëëtge kiper dää nïne, kiper noo tïme na dää nïne, a na Wuuö Jwøk a ööa piny bäät Kïn Caynay naa nëënö jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the Lord will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

anywaa: 'Ba wärï tïïï ki keew lak kïdi manøgø bäre kiper jiy, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Gwøgu rou ni ba cou maal bäät kïdi, ni kär nou guta keew manøgø; no dee dhaanhø mo guta kïdi manøgø jaak, ka adïëri møn, ŋatøca put ka 'näk.
english: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

anywaa: Kär dee dhaanhø mo gut ŋatøgø, 'ba eni wär këëri ki kïte wala ka athëëre; këël lääy wala dhaanhø, ba doo bëëdö ni kwøw këët.› 'Ba kanyo köök tuuŋŋi ni dwøre bäär, kar kaaca nø jø Icriel wär öge buut kïdi.»
english: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aduu piny ki bäät kïdi ni ö baŋ jiy ni døøc jiy mo waany, ni ö jiyi ni penyge abïïe moge.
english: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jï jiy, ni «Jiiŋŋu dëëtu kiper dää nïne; kär dee ŋat mo ci baŋ dhaagø.»
english: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dää nïne, ni piny amöölla, bäät kïdi aput jïtö ki køth mo pöödö, ka agaackøth mo mal, ki pöölö mo cøl; ni ö dwølli mo päl ma dwør tuuŋ ni wïnye. Køøre jiy moa en twïër bëët dëëtge aput tïmö ni kwanynyi.
english: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni käl jiy wøk ki yi twïër nee røømge ki Jwøk; ni putge cuŋŋö tier kïdi piny.
english: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø Kïn Caynay atïmö na jïrö bäre, kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na ö bäät kïdi manøgø ki maac. Ni put jïrö tïmö ni nyäälö bäät kïdi kaamar jïc dwaar, ni ö kïdi manøgø bäre ni put tïmö ni jäŋŋi døc.
english: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the Lord descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni dwør tuuŋ jwöŋi ni cäätha maal ni døøŋŋø døøŋŋø, Modhe aluupö ni dwøgi ya Wuuö Jwøki jïgø ki dwør odäru.
english: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

anywaa: Ni put Wuuö Jwøki öö bäät Kïn Caynay, wï kïdi kiree; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cwöl Modhe baŋe wï kïdi manøgø, ni put Modhe ci maal.
english: And the Lord came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the Lord called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe, ni «Ci piny, ni köömmï jiy nee keew mara ba kaalge ki man neenge aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper jø okaal gø bëët puta thøø.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the Lord to gaze, and many of them perish.

anywaa: Ni caanï gø jï dïlämme thuwø mo wø nyänh buuta nee dëëtge døøcge mo waany, kiper nee ge ba nääa, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And let the priests also, which come near to the Lord, sanctify themselves, lest the Lord break forth upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Jiy ba løny ki man öge bäät Kïn Caynay, kiper waana cemï ni kööï, ni ‹Tïïu ki keew lak kïdi manøgø bäre, nee kïdi manøgø bëëde na kïdi mo ena kur keere.› »
english: And Moses said unto the Lord, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ci piny ni cäŋï duu maal, ni löömmu ka Aran; 'ba dïlämme ki jiy møga kär wëëk kaal keew nee öge baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nee ge ba nääa.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the Lord, lest he break forth upon them.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put ö piny baŋ jiy ni caan dwørøgø jïge.
english: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk luup moi bëët acaane, ni kööe,
english: And God spake all these words, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beeye a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, paana näk po laŋ.
english: I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

anywaa: «Kär dee juu møøk jïrï këët nyïma.
english: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

anywaa: «Kär dëërï tëëŋŋï ki kït gïn mør jaak mo caala kït gïrpiny mo ena maal, wala mo ena bäät piny, wala mo ena yi naam.
english: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

anywaa: Kär geni lamï, ni ba tïnynyï geni, kiper aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï, aana Jwøk ma ŋat keec, ni jø wø män ki aani, gïïa bacge kïtha bäät obwöre moge ni jääla geni këël dää beenhnhe, ni put pïï ri ŋweer beenhnhe.
english: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø mëër ki aani ni wø gwøk ciik 'moa, mëëya ni wø ba jøøl nyoodha nyoodhø jïge, këël mano pïïe ri jiy ma kum kum.
english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

anywaa: «Kär nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï cwølï jaak, kiper ŋat wø cwøl nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki jaak ba doo wec Wuuö Jwøki ka ajäla.
english: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

anywaa: «Caar wïïï ki cäŋ jwömö, nee bëëde ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

anywaa: Tïïï ki nïne abïciel, ni tïïyï tïïe moa diï tïïö bëët ki yïth nïne moøgø.
english: Six days shalt thou labour, and do all thy work:

anywaa: 'Ba bïriet nïne beeye cäŋ jwömö jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï. Kär dee gïn mo tïïyï dïcäŋöce, ïïni wala wäädï wala nyaarï, wala ŋat tïïc marï ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø, wala lääc paac moï, wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö ka ïïni.
english: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk maal ki piny ki näm ki gïïa en yïthge bëët acwääe ki nïne abïciel, ni jwöm ree ri bïriet nïne. Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk cäŋ jwömö agwïëdhe ni tïïc gø na cäŋ mo ena kur keere.
english: For in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

anywaa: «Wøør wäru ki meru, kiper nee nïr kwøw moï thöönhge yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
english: Honour thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

anywaa: «Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø.
english: Thou shalt not kill.

anywaa: «Kärï kännö ki luk.
english: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

anywaa: «Kärï kwätö.
english: Thou shalt not steal.

anywaa: «Kärï cäänö ki tööt dëër wadu.
english: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.

anywaa: «Kär cwïnyï päl ki po wadu; ni ba päth cwïnyï kiper cï wadu, wala ŋat tïïc mare ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø, wala rwaath mare wala arëën mare; këël gïn mør jaak mo mar wadu, kär cwïnyï päl kipere.»
english: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi bëët na jootge gø ni køth pöödö, na agaackøth mal, ni tuuŋ jwöŋö, ni kïdi duuŋ ki jïrö, jiy dëëtge aput tïmö ni kwanynyi, ni cuŋge kany mo bäär.
english: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jï Modhe, ni «Beerra man tïme ni cäänö ïïni ki dëërï kiree ki waani; luubö marï leŋwa leŋø. 'Ba kiper nee wa ba thøwa, beerra man ba cään Jwøki ki waani.»
english: And they said unto Moses, Speak thou with us, and we will hear: but let not God speak with us, lest we die.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jïge, ni «Käru lwäyö; kiper Jwøk ööi ni päänynya uuni, nou bëëdu nou lwäär ki eni, kiper nou ba bääyu.»
english: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for God is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that ye sin not.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø jiy aput cuŋŋö kany mo bäär, ni ö Modhe ni put nyiik buut pöölla cøl kanya en Jwøki yie.
english: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï, ni ‹Uuni ki dëëtu kiree aana jootu naa cäänö ki uuni naa ena maal.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel, Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

anywaa: Kär a rwöpu ki juu møøk; juu mo tïïc ka warkey wala juu mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö kär tïïyu kiper dëëtu.
english: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold.

anywaa: « ‹Wäru tïïu jïra ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo tïïc ko odhöönh, ni cïpu bääte ko olämme mo wø waaŋ ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni cïpu røk rööm mou ki rwädhe mou. Ki yïth kwöro wäŋŋa bëët ni wïc di parø ki aani, aani, a ööa baŋu kaaca ni gwïëdha uuni.
english: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me, and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings, and thy peace offerings, thy sheep, and thine oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee, and I will bless thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou tïïö jïra ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki kïte, kär nou tïïya gø ki kïte mo otøø, kiper ni näk mo you gudö ki nywïënyö mar tøk, u pääta gøøni.
english: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

anywaa: Käru tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jïra mo dhaanhø etha maal ki bäät gïïa näk othørø, kiper nee ŋat wø edhi nee bathe ba joot jiyi.› »
english: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar, that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe, ni «Moi beege ciik moo peedhï nyïm jø Icriel.
english: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.

anywaa: «Ni näk wadu ma ŋat Ibaru ŋeewï ŋeeø na laŋŋø, ï dee tïnynyö ki cwiiri abïciel; 'ba noo tïme na bïriet cwiiri eni doo wiiø ni aae jaak ni bäŋ gïn mo manynyi bääte.
english: If thou buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ööa eni ki dëëre keere, eni doo aay keere; 'ba ni näk ma dhaanhø mo ööi ka cïïe, eni doo aay ki dhaagø mare.
english: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo laŋŋø manøgø onyööm kwääye ki dhaagø, ni geno nyöödö ko obwöre ma cwøw wala ma mään, dhaagø manøgø ko obwöre moe doo dööŋ jï kwääye, ni ö eni ni aae keere.
english: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master's, and he shall go out by himself.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo laŋŋø manøgø mare caane caanø ki cwïnye bäre ni kööe, ni ‹Aani a mëër ki kwäärö mara ki dhaagø mara ko obwöre 'moa, naa ba many aay kaamar dhaanhø mo owiiø jaak,›
english: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

anywaa: kanyøgø nø, eni wär lwør kwääye ni käl gø nyïm jø ŋøl luup. Køøre dee dwøga paac, ni wëëk gø cuŋŋö ro odhuulu wala ri jaath dhi øtø, ni ö kwääye ni thuth ïth gø ki muda; køøre nø, eno put tïnynyö na bäre bäre.
english: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl; and he shall serve him for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo ŋeewa nyaare na ŋat tïïc jï dhaanhø mør, eni ba doo wiiø nee aae jaak kaamar laaŋe moa näk cwøw.
english: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhaaŋŋøgø ojøøl waŋ kwääye na jier gø kiper dëëre, eni dhaaŋŋøgø dee wëëga wïïl wøk. Eni dhaaŋŋøgø ba dee ŋeeø ki jiy mo wëëlle mo path, kiper wï gø akwøŋ maaŋŋø.
english: If she please not her master, who hath betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo mare mïëk jï wääde, dee gwøø ki køør kööŋŋö man wø tïïc dhaanhe kiper nyaare.
english: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

anywaa: Køøre ni näk mo ŋatøgø cäŋa nyöömmö ki dhaagø mør, cere ba doo teek ki man mooc dhaaŋŋa dïkwøŋ ki cam, ka abïï, wala ba dee wiiø ni ba ci baŋ gø na dhaagø.
english: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋatøgø gïïögø na adäk yøø ba tïïe jï dhaagø manøgø, dhaagø manøgø doo aay jaak, ni bäŋ gwel mo dwøgi.
english: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

anywaa: «Ŋato gøøc dhaanhø mør ni thøøe, ka adïëri møn, eni doo nääö.
english: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ba kame, ni gïno wär Jwøki jaak, kanyøgønø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aano nyuuthi ki kany reŋ ŋatøgø yie.
english: And if a man lie not in wait, but God deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø cwïnye ränynyö, ni 'näk wati ki riek waŋ, ŋatøgø këël ree ee kan buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk mara cøøn, eni doo lwørø ni nääi.
english: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

anywaa: «Ŋato gøøc wänni wala menni, ka adïëri møn, eni doo nääö.
english: And he that smiteth his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

anywaa: «Ŋato kwal dhaanhø nee ŋeee wala joota cere jaak, ka adïëri møn, eni doo nääö.
english: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: «Ŋato jaany wänni wala menni, ka adïëri møn, eni doo nääö.
english: And he that curseth his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo jiy ariiø wëër, ni ö dhaanhø acielli dïge ni këël dhaanhø maya ki kïdi, wala gøøya gø ni cere ee miiø, ni kär ŋatøgø thøw, 'ba eni bëëdö ni tuu no obut piny,
english: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keepeth his bed:

anywaa: kanyo thëëm dëëre ni ö maal ni caath tiete ni kwömö ka athøra, kanyøgønø ŋata gööyö enøgø dööŋ wøk ni bäŋ gïn mo tïïc dëëre. 'Ba kar kanya beet ŋatøgø piny ni kär tïïö dee coolø, ni tuu gø këël mano jöön dëëre na bäre bäre.
english: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø laŋŋø mare ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø di pwödö ka athøra ni thøø cere, ŋata pöödö enøgø, bääte da kwör.
english: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋata pwöt enøgø obëëdö ki dïcäŋ aciel wala nïne ariiø ni kär thøw, ŋatøgø bääte bäŋ kwör; kiper beeye nyeŋ gwete.
english: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo jiy ariiø këëdö, ni ö dhaanhø acielli dïge ni cöör dhaagø mo ŋëëte ena maal, ni ö nyilaalli mana en ec ni bwön wøk, këël na bäŋe gïn mo leth mo otägö dëër nyijøøgø, ka adïëri møn, ŋata cöör nyijøøgø enø doo cudö ki jammi moo many cø dhaagø manøgø bääte; ni cool gïïögø ki køør mano ŋøl jø wø ŋøl luup.
english: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da gïn mør mo otägö dëër mïïö, doo coolø ki køør mana tägö, kiper jwïëy cool ka jwïëy,
english: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,

anywaa: ni waŋ cool ka waŋ, ni lëëö cool ka lëëö, ni cenø cool ka cenø, ni tielø cool ka tielø,
english: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

anywaa: ni waaŋ mar maac cool ka waaŋ mar maac, ni gïn mo ena dëël mo leth cool ka gïn mo ena dëël mo leth, ni pöödö cool ka pöödö.
english: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø waŋ laŋŋø mare ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø ee gøø, ni løy waŋ laŋŋø manøgø, ŋatøgø laŋŋø mare dee wiiø nee aae jaak na kar waŋe na løy.
english: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye's sake.

anywaa: Ni näk mo lëëc laŋŋø mare ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø ee tëëŋ wøk, eni laŋŋø mare dee wiiø nee aae jaak na kar lëëö mare.
english: And if he smite out his manservant's tooth, or his maidservant's tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth's sake.

anywaa: «Ni näk dhieŋ da dhaanhø ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø mo ee cwøbø, ni thøw ŋatøgø, ka adïëri møn, dhieŋ manøgø doo këërö ki kïte ni thøøe; ni ö rïŋŋe ni ba cami. 'Ba wää dhieŋŋi manøgø doo wiiø ni bäŋ gïn mo tïïc dëëre.
english: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhieŋ manøgø wïnni ni cööbö dïkwøŋ cøøn, no ocar jiyi jï wänni nee koore na wøp, ni käri ya ŋatøgø tïïö, ni näk mo dhieŋ manøgø ocööpö ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø ni thøøe, dhieŋ manøgø doo këërö ki kïte ni thøøe, ni ö wää dhieŋŋi manøgøøni thuwø ni nääi.
english: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it hath been testified to his owner, and he hath not kept him in, but that he hath killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo manynya jap cuut kwör bääte, eni jap cuut kwör moa manynyi bääte yøø, këël thööth ni nyïëdi cøøn, dee cïbö na kar jwïëy moe.
english: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhieŋ manøgø cwøpa nyilaal ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø, luubö manøgø doo ŋøla bäät wää dhieŋ manøgø ki køør ciik manøgø na aciel enø.
english: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhieŋ manøgø cwøpa laŋŋø ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø, wää dhieŋ manøgø doo cïpö ki gwel ma pïëradäk mo gwel-bïrö jï kwääc laŋŋø manøgø, ni ö dhieŋŋi manøgø ni këëri ki kïte ni thøøe.
english: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø buur di jabø, wala mare koony ki buur ni wec gø jaak ni käre uumö, ni ö dhieŋ wala arëën ni päth yi buur manøgø,
english: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

anywaa: wää buurri manøgø doo cudö; eni doo cïpö ki gwel jï wää lääyi, ni ö dëër mana no othøw ni dööŋ jïre.
english: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo da dhieŋ mar dhaanhø ni cwøp dhieŋ mar dhaanhø mør ni thøøe, dhieŋ mano kwøw enø dege dwøga pwödhö ni pääŋge gwete ni röömi; ni pääŋge dëër dhieŋ mana no othøw thuwø.
english: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhieŋ manøgø ŋäc ni wïnni ni cööbö dïkwøŋ cøøn, ni käri ya wänni koorø na wøp, ka adïëri møn, wää dhieŋŋi manøgø doo cudö ki dhieŋ na kar dhieŋ, ni ö dëër mana no othøw ni dööŋe jïre.
english: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past, and his owner hath not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

anywaa: «Ni näk dhaanhø dhieŋ wala diel ee kwalø, ni ŋaal gø wala ŋeewa gø, kuu manøgø doo cudö ki dhäk abïïc na kar dhieŋ mana kwale, wala dïëk aŋween na kar diel mana kwale.
english: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo kuu omaaø ni turö ki øtø, ni gøøi ni thøøe, doo bäŋ kwöre.
english: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo cäŋ onø tuulö bääte ni nääi, da kwöre. Ka adïëri møn, kuu manøgø doo na mare cuut cøøn. 'Ba ni näk mo bäŋ gïï cude ki ge kiper gïna kwale, eni doo ŋeeø na kar gïna kwale.
english: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo lääy mana kwale ojoodø cere møn ni kwøw, nee dhieŋ wala arëën wala diel, dee coolø kwöre ariiø.
english: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø lään paac mare ee køøl yi pwödhö wala ya ajïniina mo gïïa en yie onø kac, ni wec gø ni pööth yi pwöth ŋat mør mo poot kär kaaø, eni doo cudö røk liil moa en yi pwöthe wala ya ajïniina mare.
english: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man's field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø juu moa en yi pwöthe nyebe nyebø, ni ö maaci manøgø ni nyaae ni gam luum ni pööth yi pwöth ŋat mør, ni waaŋ beel moa näk onø cooŋ wala beel moa näk poot kär kaaø, wala waaŋŋa pwödhö bäre, ka adïëri møn, ŋata nyep maac enø doo cudö.
english: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø okän baŋ wati ki gwel wala gïï møøk, ni kwali bäät ŋatøgø, ni näk mo kuu manøgø omaaø, eni doo cudö kwöre ariiø.
english: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man's house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kuu manøgø kär maaø, wää øtø doo käla nyïm jø ŋøl luup, nee ŋäc møn ki man näk cere käre rwaak ri jap wati.
english: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour's goods.

anywaa: Luup pïëm bëët moo tägi, nee kiper dhieŋ, wala kiper arëën, wala kiper diel, wala kiper abïï, wala kiper gïrpiny mo orwäänyö jaak, ni kö dhaanhe mørri, ni ‹Gïn beeye mara›, jøøgø na pïëmö yøø luubö marge dege käla nyïm jø ŋøl luup; ni ö ŋata jääl jø ŋøl luupi ni mare raac ni cude jï wati kwöre ariiø.
english: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø bäät wati ee kännö ka arëën, wala dhieŋ, wala diel, wala lään paac mør jaak, ni thøøe wala da gïn mo otägö ree, wala maka ri leny ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ojoot gø,
english: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

anywaa: jøøgø na ariiø yøø doo kööŋ nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee ŋäc møn ni ŋata kän bääte enøgø cere käre rwaak ri jap wati. Ni ö wää lääyi manøgø ni jïëc gø, ni ö ŋata rwääny gïnögø bääte ni ba cude këët.
english: Then shall an oath of the Lord be between them both, that he hath not put his hand unto his neighbour's goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kwalla bääte møn, eni doo cudö jï wää lääyi manøgø.
english: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ocam lään paapi, dëëre mana dööŋ enøgø dee käla paac na nyuudhi. Eni ba doo cudö kiper mana cami ya lään paapi.
english: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø pëëö ki lään paac baŋ wati, ni jït dëër läänögø ki gïn mo leth wala ni thøøe ni wää gø tøør ree, ka adïëri møn, ŋata pëëö enøgø doo cudö.
english: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk wää gø nutö ree, ŋatøgø ba doo cudö. Ni näk mo käl kiper nee wää gø cunni, wär cääp ki gät cuut.
english: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø maaŋŋa wï nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue mo poot kär miiø, ni ci baŋ gø na dhaagø, eni na tïïc gïnögø enø doo köödö ki gwel køør nyaanøgø ni tïme na cïïe.
english: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo wää nyaanøgø okweer na bäre bäre ki man cïp nyaare jï ŋatøgø, ŋatøgø doo cudö ki gwel mo caala mo wø køøl køør nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue.
english: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

anywaa: «Dhaagø mo tïïya tïï thïëth jaak kär weyu ni kwøw.
english: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

anywaa: «Ŋat mo oci baŋ lääy jaak ni mare niine ki gø, ka adïëri møn, ŋatøgø doo nääö.
english: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: «Ŋat mo ocïpö ko olämi jï jwøk mør jaak, ni paa jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk keera, wïïe doo dïdö na bäre bäre.
english: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto the Lord only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

anywaa: «Käru bääyö dëër dhaanhø mo bëëdö na wëëllö mo path, ni ba tïïu ree ki gïn mo raac, kiper uuna bëëdö yi ŋööm Ijep ni uuna wëëlle mo path.
english: Thou shalt neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: «Kär dee dhaagø ma cï thøø wala dhaanhø ma kïïc mo caannu.
english: Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ge you caannø, ni jwöŋge baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, kwac marge leŋa leŋø;
english: If thou afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

anywaa: ni ö wëërri mara ni jääŋŋa gø bäätu, ni tïïa uuni nou thøwu ri leny; ni ö määnni mou ni tïmge na määr thuunhnhi, ni ö obwöre mou ni tïmge na kïïe mo bäŋ wëëkge.
english: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø aciel røk jiya moø bëëdö dïïu ni can yøø omäyö ki gwel baŋï ni cïpï gø jïre, ï ba doo tïmö na ŋat miï meeta gø bääte; gwetøgø ba diï lwørø baŋe nee duuge ni bääte da mëëdi.
english: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

anywaa: Ni näk ma abïï rïëp mar wadu iï kälö na dïgïti, wär dwøgï jïre kanyo poode ni cäŋ poot kär pädhö;
english: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:

anywaa: kiper beeye mar rïëpa eni keere jïre, ni beeye abïï rïëp man wø rïëp dëëre ki gø. ?Aŋø, dagø mo odööŋ jïre këët mo rëëbe ki gø? Kanyo täk teeŋ gïnögønø, ni ö ŋata abïïne lwør ni jwöŋe ni pëënynya aani, eni dwøre leŋa leŋø, kiper aani a bëëdö ni yia met ki jiy.
english: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he crieth unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

anywaa: «Kär Jwøk janynyï, ni ba cienï kwääc pou.
english: Thou shalt not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of thy people.

anywaa: «Kärï ruu ki man laarï cïpö jïra ki muuy røk beel mo wø kayï, ki røk køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wø biiyï. Wäätu moa näk kaai bëët dou cïbö jïra.
english: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

anywaa: Kaai mo dhäk mou ki kaai mo dïëk mou dou cïbö jïra thuwø. Kaa man nø røk kaai moøgø kanyo nywøli doo bëëdö ki menni ki nïne abïriiø; 'ba no tïme na bäc nïne, dou cïbö jïra.
english: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.

anywaa: «U doo bëëdö ni uuna jiy mo ena kur keerge jïra. Kiper manøgønø, u ba doo cämö ki rïŋö mo kwany no ocam lääy mørri paap; teeŋ rïŋö manøgø dou leeŋa baŋ guu.
english: And ye shall be holy men unto me: neither shall ye eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; ye shall cast it to the dogs.

anywaa: «Kär luubö ma luum tööt waayï. Kärï rööpö ki ŋat mo raac ki man cäänï ki luum tööt dëër dhaanhø mør.
english: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

anywaa: «Kärï dwätö ki jøøa thööth ki man tïïï ki gïn mo raac. Kärï cäänö ki luubö kar løøk niï caatha køør jøøa thööth kiper nee luubö mana näk adïëri daagï.
english: Thou shalt not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shalt thou speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

anywaa: Kär dhaanhø cwagï kar løøk kiper can mare.
english: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

anywaa: «Ni näk miï røømmø ki dhieŋ wala arëën mar nyimän marï no orwäänyö, ka adïëri møn, wär dwøk baŋe.
english: If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.

anywaa: Ni näk ma arëën dhaanhø mo män ki ïïni iï joodø no opädhö ni baa ena dïŋääe, kärï aay buute jaak; ka adïëri møn, eni diï kønyø ki tïŋ gø maal.
english: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help with him.

anywaa: «Luum ŋata can kär kaatï kar løøk.
english: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.

anywaa: Bëëdï ni karï bäär ki luum løøk mo yie da tööt, ni ba ŋølï thøø bäät dhaanhø mo mare beer mo bäŋ gïn ee baaø, kiper aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, jøøa reyø ba wëënna.
english: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.

anywaa: «Kärï jïëy ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny, kiper jammi mo wø cïp ki piny waŋ ŋata wïïe leer di cøørø, ni wiil luum ŋata näk mare adïëri.
english: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.

anywaa: «Kär wëëllö mo path caannu; kiper uuni ki dëëtu gïr bëët wëël ŋäyu, kiper uuna kwøŋ bëëtö ni uuna wëëlle yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger: for ye know the heart of a stranger, seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: «Pwöth mou wär piithu ki caammi cooth ki cwiiri abïciel, ni kayu geni.
english: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits thereof:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, wär weyu ni ba puurru, kiper nee caammi mo otuy keerge yïthge nee tïmge na cam jï jø pou moa can; ni ö moo dhäthi ni tïmge na cam jï lääc paap. Ajïniine mou thuwø wär weyu ni caala pwöth mou.
english: But the seventh year thou shalt let it rest and lie still; that the poor of thy people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner thou shalt deal with thy vineyard, and with thy oliveyard.

anywaa: «Tïïe mou dou tïïö ki yïth nïne moa näk abïciel. 'Ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne, tïïc dou wiiø, kiper nee dhäk mou ka arëëni mou dëëtge jwömge, ni ö wäät laaŋe moa nywøl mïëyu bëët ki wëëlle moa path mo wø tïny uuni ni jïtge ki jwöm dëël.
english: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

anywaa: «'Ba gïïa caana jïïu bëët yøø, beerra man magu rou ki man gwøgu geni. Kär dee nyeŋ juu møøk mo cøøru wala gïrge wïnyö dhøgu.
english: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of thy mouth.

anywaa: «U doo tïïö ka ajwöm jïra kwöre adäk ki yi cwiir.
english: Three times thou shalt keep a feast unto me in the year.

anywaa: «Ajwöm Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø dou gwøø. U dou cämö ki nïne abïriiø ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, kaawat mana köömma uuni. 'Ba møgøgø cammu yi kanya näk owäŋŋö yi dwääna cwøl na Abip; kiper beeye dwääna ööu wøk yie ki Ijep. 'Ba kär dee ŋat mo ö nyïma ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread: (thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded thee, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it thou camest out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

anywaa: «Ajwöm Kac thuwø mar caammi moa kwøŋ ciek na jootu ri caammi moa piithu yïth pwöth mou wär wøørru; ni wøørru Ajwöm Thum Kac mar aŋuun cwiir kany wø kïthu caammi yïth odïï mou moa jootu yïth pwöth.
english: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

anywaa: «Kwöre adäk ki yi cwiir cooth cwøw mou bëët doo ööa nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en teeki cere.
english: Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord God.

anywaa: «Olämi man wø ŋaal ni wø remme cïpu jïra, kär cïpu na aciel ki møø mo ree da thømmø. Kär dwäälö mar olämi man wø cïpu jïra bëëdö këël amöölla ni ba waaŋŋu.
english: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

anywaa: «Thwöth caammi moa beyø moo kwøŋ ciek dïkwøŋ yïth pwöth mou, dou kïtha yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. «Kär nyidiel thaallu ki caa menni.
english: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

anywaa: «Ennø, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a jääŋŋö ki nyïïatwiel maal mo cäädhi nyïmmu mo gwøga uuni ki yi wääth maru, kiper nou kïth kanya näk yaa jiiŋŋø kiperu.
english: Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou nyïme, ni leŋŋu dwøre. Käru kweer ki mare, kiper eni gïïo baayu ba wëënne, kiper gïno tïïe, otïïe ki nyeŋŋa.
english: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dwøre leŋŋu leŋø møn, ni tïïyu gïï wø caana jïïu bëët, a puta tïmö naa män ki nyïïmän mou, ni caanna jø wø caan uuni.
english: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïatwiel maal mara manøgø ocäädhi maal nyïmmu, ni kïth uuni yïth ŋøøp jø Amör, ki jø Këth, ki jø Përec, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc; ni puta geni raanynyø na bäre.
english: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

anywaa: Kär juu mo jøøgø lammu, wala u tïnynya geni, wala u ŋwaala tïïe mo jøøgø. Juu moge dou raanynyø na bäre, ni tøgu gïï wø lamge na näk ege cwöth piny.
english: Thou shalt not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but thou shalt utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

anywaa: 'Ba tïnynyu aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu; køøre uuno gwïëdha ki caammi mou ki pïï mou, ni paanya täwe bäätu.
english: And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread, and thy water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø mo nyilaal bwönna wøk yie, wala dhaanhø ma bwøc tïmö ni bäŋgø pou; ni ö nïr kwøwi mou ni pääŋa ge na karge.
english: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in thy land: the number of thy days I will fulfil.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, lwär mo dwøŋ jääŋŋa jääŋŋö nyïmmu kanyo cou yie, ni kiera wïth jø ocou baŋge kaace, ni løøa nyïm nyïïmän mou wøk ni reŋge ki uuni.
english: I will send my fear before thee, and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come, and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee.

anywaa: Aani piini ojääŋŋa nyïmmu kiper nee jø Ëwi ki jø Keenan ki jø Këth nee riemge wøk nyïmmu.
english: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø ba riema wøk nyïmmu ki yi cwiir aciel yie aciel bëët, kiper nee paac ba dööŋe na paap jïïu, ni ö lääc paapi ni tïmge ni thööth yie.
english: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø riema wøk mëëth nyïmmu, këël mano tïmu nou thööth ni mayu piny.
english: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee, until thou be increased, and inherit the land.

anywaa: Ni tïïa keew maru ni tägi ka Naama Kwaar këël mano këët ri naam jø Pilitin, ni ö keewi maya ni täge ki dï paap këël mano këët ri Naam Upareeti. Jøøa bëëdö yïth ŋøøpøgø ocïba ceŋŋu, ni putu geni riem wøk nyïmmu.
english: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and thou shalt drive them out before thee.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn mo tuutu ki geni wala ki juu moge.
english: Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

anywaa: Kär ge wëëgu bëëtö yïth ŋøøm mou, kiper nou ba wëëkge bääyö dëëra; kiper ni näk mo juu moge lammu lamø, ka adïëri møn, ge tïmö ni ge caala abïëp kiperu.»
english: They shall not dwell in thy land, lest they make thee sin against me: for if thou serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ïnhnhu maal baŋa bäät kïdi, ïïni ka Aran ki Nadap ka Abiyu ki jiy ma pïërabïriiø røk jø døøk Icriel. 'Ba kanyo tïme ni karu poot bäär mëëth ki aani, wäru cuŋŋu kaace ni wøørru aani.
english: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto the Lord, thou, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship ye afar off.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni na Modhe keerï en, wärï nyänh buuta, 'ba jø møga kär nyänhnhö, këël jiy bëët thuwø ba doo ïnhnha maal ki ïïni.»
english: And Moses alone shall come near the Lord: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aduu piny ni køp luup bëët jï jiy, moa caan Wuuö Jwøki ki ciik moe bëët; ni ö jiyi bëët ni løkge gø ki dwøl aciel ni köge, ni «Luup bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki tïïcwa tïïö.»
english: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the Lord, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which the Lord hath said will we do.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni göör luup piny bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki. Køøre ena ö maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni cøøe ni tïïe ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte tier kïdi, ni tïïc gø ki kïte apaar kurriiø mo ee cwöth piny ni ee päärö ki kwään wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni jääge ki jiy mo dëëtge poot teek røk jø Icriel, ni cige ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ, ni ŋarge rwädhe no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he sent young men of the children of Israel, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni lwør thääŋ remø ni kïth gø yïth athääe, ni ö thääŋ mana dööŋ ni jør gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø.
english: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basins; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

anywaa: Kanyøgø wëëlö mana gööre, na näk luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, alwøre ni kwaan gø ni wïnyö jï jiy; ni kö jiyi, ni «Gïïa caan Wuuö Jwøki bëët yøø jïëcwa jïëö, ni tïïcwa geni.»
english: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that the Lord hath said will we do, and be obedient.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni lwør remø mana dööŋ ni jør gø dëët jiy ni kööe, ni «Man beeye rem luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki uuni ki køør luup moøgø bëët.»
english: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which the Lord hath made with you concerning all these words.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran ki Nadap ka Abiyu ki jiy ma pïërabïriiø røk jø døøk Icriel gena eth maal bäät kïdi,
english: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:

anywaa: ni jootge Jwø Icriel, ni kuna en tiete yie jï piny da gïn mo keda thudhi mo caala kïdi mo paŋŋi ni tøŋ ni caala maal.
english: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo ee tïïö dëët jøøgø na näk dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel yøø. Geni Jwøk ajootge; køøre gena cämö ni mäthge kaace.
english: And upon the nobles of the children of Israel he laid not his hand: also they saw God, and did eat and drink.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jï Modhe, ni «Ïnh maal baŋa bäät kïdi ni bëëdï kany; køøre opäp kïte moa näk ciik ki gïïa cema yaa göör piny bäätge cïba cïbö jïrï, kiper nee jiy pwönynyï ki geni.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give thee tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that thou mayest teach them.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe atïŋŋö ki Jøcua na näk ŋat tïïc mare, ni cige maal bäät Kïn Jwøk.
english: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Modhe ki Jøcua ni ge poot kär tïŋŋö, Modhe aköö jï jø døøŋŋø, ni «Koorru waani kany këël kanyo duuwa baŋu. Ennø, Aran ki Ur nutö buutu; wäro dee ŋat mo jïre da løøk, wär eni ci baŋge.»
english: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aci maal bäät kïdi, ni ö pöölö ni uum kïdi.
english: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ajiem Wuuö Jwøk aput ö ni bëëde bäät Kïn Caynay; ni ö Kïn Caynay ni bëëde no ouum pöölö ki nïne abïciel. 'Ba na tïme na ri bïriet nïne, Wuuö Jwøk acwötö ki yi pöölö ni cwøl Modhe.
english: And the glory of the Lord abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ajiem Wuuö Jwøk nëënö jïge bäät kïdi keda maac mo waaŋ mo thööra jammi bëët.
english: And the sight of the glory of the Lord was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni døny dï pöölö ni ci maal bäät kïdi, ni bëëde bäät kïdi ki cääŋŋe ma pïëraŋween ki wärre ma pïëraŋween.
english: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel nee cïpge ki muuce jïra. Ŋato yie met ki man cïp muuy mare jïra ki cwïnye bäre, wär lwørï baŋe.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.

anywaa: Muuce moo lwørï baŋge beege warkey, ki gwelbïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël,
english: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

anywaa: ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ki jïëc dïëk ma atëëe,
english: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

anywaa: ki pëët nyöök rööm mo otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ki pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta,
english: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

anywaa: ki maar lamba, ki gïï wø ŋwääi ni met kiper nee jääp ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïï wø waaŋ wø jïye ŋwääi ni met,
english: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

anywaa: ki nyeŋ kïte moa cwøl ni cöyammi na näk kïte mo perge leth, ki teeŋ nyeŋ kïte møøk thuwø mo perge leth, kiper nee kïth dëër abïïna cwøl ni ëëput ka abïï käw ni wø käär Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

anywaa: «Beerra man ö jiyi ni tïïge jïra ki kar lam mo ena kur keere, naa bëëda dïge.
english: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

anywaa: Gïnögø wär tïïyu na kare ki køør nyuudhi mar oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara ki nyuudhi mar jammi bëët moo manynyi kiper yie moo nyoodha jïrï.
english: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.

anywaa: «'Ba jø Icriel wär tïïge ka acanduk ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme ariiø ki thääŋö, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

anywaa: Ni leenyï warkey mana tøŋ yie ki ŋääe wøk, ni jiiŋŋï deŋŋe bäre ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.

anywaa: Oguudi aŋween mo warkey diï thiiø kiper acanduk, ni kïthï ge tiete karge ŋweeri, no oguudi ariiø ena løøk aciel man, no oguudi ariiø møga ena løøk maya.
english: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki jer tëër ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni leenyï warkey dëëtge.
english: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

anywaa: Jer tëër moøgø wär rwaak yïth oguudi moa en ra acanduk løøi ki løøi, nee tïmge na gïï biel acanduk ki ge.
english: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

anywaa: Jer tëër moøgø wär putge bëëtö yïth oguudi moa en ra acanduk, ni ba käl ge wøk këët ki ree.
english: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

anywaa: Køøre opäp kïte moa näk ciik ogöör bäätge ni wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy moo cïba jïrï wär kïth ya acanduk manøgø.
english: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.

anywaa: «Køøre rëëbi mar acanduk manøgø, na näk beeye nyuudhi mar wëën raay, wär tïïyï ki warkey mana tøŋ, ni bär mare beeye rumme ariiø ki thääŋö, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

anywaa: Wärï thädhï ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli ni tïïc ka warkey, ni ena bäät rëëbi mar acanduk mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, na aciel man nø ena ya aŋuun rëëbi manøgø.
english: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

anywaa: 'Ba wär tïïyï no ogääbö na aciel ki rëëbi, ni kirubël aciel ena ya aŋuun rëëbi man, ni kirubël maya ena ya aŋuunne maya.
english: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö kirubëlli ni bëëtge ni bwöpge ege tïŋ maalø ni ege peerø, ni rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay ege uumö ki bwöpge ni ge neeta nyeŋge; ni ö kirubëlli ni bëëtge ni wïthge ege kuul bäät rëëbi.
english: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

anywaa: Køøre nø, opäp kïte moa näk ciik ogöör bäätge ni wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy moo cïba jïrï, wär kïth ya acanduk, ni kïthï rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay bäät acanduk.
english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aano wäro røømmi ki ïïni kaace, ni cääna ki ïïni ni dwøra wïnyö ki bäät rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, yïthakic kirubëlli riet na en bäät acanduk maal, ni beeye acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy; ni caana ciik 'moa jïrï bëët na näk ciik kiper jø Icriel.
english: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki tharabëëta ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme ariiø, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

anywaa: Ni leenyï warkey mana tøŋ dëëre, ni jiiŋŋï deŋŋe bäre ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki kwör mo owëënnö deŋŋe, mo lweedi mo cenø moa na aŋween røma yie; ni jiiŋŋï deŋŋe bäre kwöra näk owëënnö yøø ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ko oguudi aŋween mo warkey kiper tharabëëta, ni kïthï oguudi moøgø deŋŋe kwöra en tiete na näk aŋween yïthge.
english: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

anywaa: Oguudi wär tïïc ni karge cään ki kwöra näk owëënnö deŋŋe, nee tïmge na gïï mak jer tëër mo wø biel tharabëëta ki ge.
english: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

anywaa: 'Ba jer tëër wär tïïyï ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni leenyï warkey dëëtge, ni ö jer tëër moøgø ni tïmge na gïï biel tharabëëta ki ge.
english: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ki cäänne ka apät ko ogubääye ki kuure na mo thïïö ki jëëthe, ni gïïögø bëët tïïyï ka warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.

anywaa: Køøre nø, muunni moa näk nyuuthe wär wø bëëde nyïma cooth bäät tharabëëta kaace nø.
english: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte ni tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ. Gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte doo thäädhö ni tägi ka tiere këël mano këët ri tuge; ni tïïc gïïa no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk røk tuge, no ogääbö na aciel ki gø bäre.
english: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

anywaa: 'Ba tuge wär tïïc na abïciel; ni tuŋi adäk ena løøi, ni tuŋi adäk møga ena løøe løøga.
english: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

anywaa: Gïïa no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö kede wïth jenni mo oŋøøk wär tïïc na adäk ri tuuŋ aciel man nø røk tuŋi moa näk abïciel na en ri gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte.
english: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

anywaa: Ni ö dëër gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte ni tïnynyi ki gïï mo ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö mo keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk ma aŋween.
english: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

anywaa: Teeŋ gïnögø aciel wär tïïc røk tuŋi piny moa näk okuurö na aciel moa dïkwøŋ, ni tïïö ki teeŋ gïnögø mør røk riet tuŋi piny, ki teeŋ gïnögø mør thuwø røk dää tuŋi piny, ni tïïc kiper tuŋi moøgø na abïciel bëët yøø mo otïïc ri gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte.
english: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte manøgø, tuge ki gïïo no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö yøø keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk wär tïïc no ogääbö na aciel ki dëëre bäre, no othäädhö na warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

anywaa: «Køøre nø, wärï tïïï ki lambae abïriiø; ni kïthï lambae moøgø maal nee cïpge ki tar ni meenyge nyïm gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte.
english: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

anywaa: Gïï wø 'näk mäc lambae ki ge, ki cäänne moge wär näk mo tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

anywaa: Gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte ki jape bëët wär tïïc ki warkey mana tøŋ mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar.
english: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Modhe en, gïïögø bëët wär ŋäyï ki man tïïyï ge na karge ki køør nyuudhi mana nyoodha jïrï bäät kïdi.
english: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.

anywaa: «'Ba oduŋkaara mana näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, wär tïïyï ka abïïe apaar mo cwääc ka waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle ki ma dïmuur ki mo kwaar. Abïïe moøgø wär tïïyï ni dëëtge da kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar abïï man nø beeye gööye ma pïërariiø ka abära, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye aŋween. 'Ba abïïe bëët wär näk mo gööye moge röömi.
english: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

anywaa: Abïïe abïïc wär kwøc na abïï aciel, ni ö abïïci møga ni kwøi na abïï aciel thuwø.
english: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

anywaa: Køøre deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ wär kïthï ki waare mo odølø mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ni kïthï deŋ abïï maya thuwø ki waare mo odølø ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ wär kïthï ki waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc, ni kïthï deŋ maya thuwø ki waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc. Waare moa no odølø moo kïthï deŋ abïïe moøgø wär näk mo man nø dïët ki maya.
english: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki nywïëny ma pïërabïïc mo tïïc ka warkey ni dhøkge ogønø, ni kuupï abïïe moø na ariiø yøø ki geni, kiper nee oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara nëëne na gïrpiny aciel.
english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ka abïïe mo tïïc ka jïëc dïëk ma atëëe, kiper nee rïëp bäät oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara. Abïïe moo tïïc wär näk ma abïïe apaar kurciel.
english: And thou shalt make curtains of goats' hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar abïï man nø wär näk ma gööye ma pïëradäk, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye aŋween. 'Ba abïïe moøgø na apaar kurciel yøø wär näk mo gööye moge röömi.
english: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

anywaa: Køøre abïïe abïïc wär kwøyï kur keerge, ni kwøyï moa dööŋ na näk abïciel kur keerge. 'Ba bïcier abïï mana näk okwøø ri møga wär ban maal bäät dho oduŋkaara.
english: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ wär kïthï ki waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc, ni kïthï deŋ maya thuwø ki waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc.
english: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki nywïëny ma pïërabïïc mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël ni dhøkge ogønø, ni kïthï geni yïthakic waare moa no odølø, ni kuupï abïïe nee tïme na rëëbi aciel.
english: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ abïï mano dööŋ wøk røk abïïe moa kuup na rëëbi wär pööth piny mëëth ni kaal abïï oduŋkaara, nee dööŋe ni lïërö ŋää oduŋkaara.
english: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni ö deŋ abïï rëëbi ni pööth piny mëëth løø oduŋkaara løøi ki løøga, ni deŋ abïï oduŋkaara ee kaalø ki gööye oceele, kiper nee oduŋkaara uume.
english: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki rëëbi kipere mo tïïc ka pëët nyöök rööm mo otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ni tïïï ki rëëbi mør thuwø mo kïth bääte maal mo tïïc ka pëët lääy mo onyøŋø.
english: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers' skins.

anywaa: «Køøre ï doo tïïö ko opämi mo jaadha cwøl ni cïta kiper oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara, ni cïbï ge piny ni cuŋŋö.
english: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar opäm man nø beeye rumme apaar, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

anywaa: 'Ba wär näk da tiel ariiø ro opäm man nø mo løny ki man gääp opämi ki ge. Køøre opämi bëët mo oduŋkaara diï tïïö ni caala manøgø.
english: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Tïïï ko opämi ma pïërariiø kiper jï løø tier-piny mar oduŋkaara.
english: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïëraŋween mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö kiper nee opämi moa näk pïërariiø cwöth yïthge, ni gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ariiø moi nø ena tier opäm man nø kiper tiete na näk ariiø.
english: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
