anywaa: Ni tïïï ko opämi ma pïërariiø thuwø kiper jï løø wï-piny mar oduŋkaara,
english: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

anywaa: ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïëraŋween mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ni gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ariiø moi nø ena tier opäm man nø.
english: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ko opämi abïciel kiper ŋää oduŋkaara na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ko opämi ariiø kiper gøøde moa en ŋää oduŋkaara.
english: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

anywaa: Ni ö opämi mo gøøt ni kuubi ni tägi ka tiere piny këël mano këët røk oguudi moa en maal. Ni ö opämi mo gøøde karge riet ni tïïi ni caala manøgø.
english: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään opämi moo en ŋää oduŋkaara beege abära, no opäm man nø jïre da gïï wø cwöth tiete yïthge ariiø mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ni gïï wø cwöth tiet opämi yïthge bëët beege apaar ka abïciel.
english: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki jenni mo caala läämme ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni beege abïïc kiper opämi moa en løø oduŋkaara løøi,
english: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

anywaa: ka abïïc kiper opämi moa en løø oduŋkaara løøga, ka abïïc møøk kiper opämi moa en ŋää oduŋkaara na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

anywaa: Ni ö läämmö mana en dïër ki man mak opämi ki dïge, ni rwaagi ki teegø man këël mano këët teegø maya.
english: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

anywaa: 'Ba dëët opämi wär lëënynyï ki warkey, ni tïïï ko oguudi mo warkey kiperge, nee tïmge na mäge kiper jenni moa näk caala läämme, ni leenyï warkey dëët jenni moøgø.
english: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.

anywaa: «Køøre nø, oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara wär gur piny ki køør nyuudhi mana nyoodha jïrï bäät kïdi.
english: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø, ni tïïc ka waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni tïïyï dëëre ni da kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli; ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And thou shalt make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:

anywaa: Ni lïërï abïï manøgø røk cööthe aŋween mo tïïc ka jaadha cwøl ni cïta ni dëëtge olëënynyö ki warkey, ni nywïëny moge moa no ogøn tïïc ka warkey, ni cööthe moøgø cuŋŋa bäät gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma aŋween mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.
english: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

anywaa: Abïï mana näk gëëŋi wär lïër maal ni dïët ki nywïëny moa no ogønø na näk abïï mar oduŋkaara okuubö ki ge, ni bëëde ni lïërö tiet nywïëny moøgø. 'Ba acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy wär käl kanya no ogëëŋö; ni ö abïï mana näk gëëŋi ni bëëde ni ena yïthakic kanya en kur keere ki kanya en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony: and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.

anywaa: Ni kïthï rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay bäät acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, na acanduk ena kanya en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.

anywaa: 'Ba tharabëëta wär cïp wøk ŋää abïï mana näk gëëŋi; ni cïbï gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte thuwø wøk ni dïët ki tharabëëta ni ena jï kuna näk da tierpiny kany wø døny yo oduŋkaara; ni tharabëëta ena jï kuna näk da wï-piny yo oduŋkaara.
english: And thou shalt set the table without the veil, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ka abïï mo mar gëëŋ kiper dho oduŋkaara, ni cwääc ka waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki cööthe abïïc ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta kiper abïï mana näk gëëŋi mana näk mar dho oduŋkaara, ni leenyï warkey dëëtge, ni tïïyï nywïëny moge moa no ogøn thuwø ki warkey; ni ö gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ni tïïyï ge na abïïc ni tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni tïïc ka jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme abïïc, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumme abïïc; gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø wär näk deŋŋe karge ŋweeri röömi, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumme adäk, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And thou shalt make an altar of shittim wood, five cubits long, and five cubits broad; the altar shall be foursquare: and the height thereof shall be three cubits.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ki gïï mo caala tuŋi mo ena maal wïth deŋŋe moa näk aŋween; ni tuŋi moøgø ogääbö na aciel ki dëëre, ni lëënynyï dëëre bäre ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And thou shalt make the horns of it upon the four corners thereof: his horns shall be of the same: and thou shalt overlay it with brass.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ki dääe moe mo wø jøøp bur yïthge, ka akaape, ki cäänne, ki gïï wø lääm rïŋ wøk ki ge, ka athääk jwëëlli mo wø käär mäc ki ge. Jape moøgø bëët wär näk tïïyï ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And thou shalt make his pans to receive his ashes, and his shovels, and his basins, and his fleshhooks, and his firepans: all the vessels thereof thou shalt make of brass.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ki gïn mo keda oŋana mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël no okatø ni caala ajääp, ni kïthï deŋŋe karge ŋweeri ko oguudi aŋween mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And thou shalt make for it a grate of network of brass; and upon the net shalt thou make four brasen rings in the four corners thereof.

anywaa: Ni kïthï gïnögø yi gïn wø cïp olämme bääte no onyiik piny mëëth dïëre ni ena tier gïna no opööth wøk ki deŋŋe.
english: And thou shalt put it under the compass of the altar beneath, that the net may be even to the midst of the altar.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki jenni mo käär gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki ge ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni lëënynyï dëëtge ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And thou shalt make staves for the altar, staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with brass.

anywaa: Kany wø tïme na ri käär gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, jer tëër moøgø wär rwaak yïth oguudi, kwöra näk ariiø na en løøi ki løøi.
english: And the staves shall be put into the rings, and the staves shall be upon the two sides of the altar, to bear it.

anywaa: Gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø wär tïïyï ko opämi ni yie owiiø ni ŋaam, ni tïïc ki køør nyuudhi mana nyoodha jïrï bäät kïdi.
english: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki kal kiper oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara. Ni tïïï ka abïï mar gëëŋ kiper løø kal jï kuna en tierpiny nee bëëde ni lïërö, na abïï manøgø tïïc ka lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni bär mar deŋŋe beeye gööye ma dïpa.
english: And thou shalt make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen of an hundred cubits long for one side:

anywaa: 'Ba jer kal wär näk ma pïërariiø, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïërariiø thuwø mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni ö nywïëny mo ogøn moa näk mo jer kal, ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge, ni tïï ki gwel-bïrö.
english: And the twenty pillars thereof and their twenty sockets shall be of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

anywaa: Løø kal jï kuna en wï-piny thuwø wär tïïc ni caala maya, no okïthö ka abïï mo olïërö mo bär mar deŋŋe beeye gööye ma dïpa, ki jer kal ma pïërariiø, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïërariiø mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni ö nywïëny moa no ogøn mo jer kal ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge ni tïï ki gwel-bïrö.
english: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

anywaa: «'Ba løø kal ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ wär kïthi ka abïï mo olïërö mo bär mare beeye gööye ma pïërabïïc, ki jer kal apaar, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma apaar thuwø.
english: And for the breadth of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits: their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

anywaa: «'Ba dööŋ yi kal ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ beeye rumme ma pïërabïïc, ni røm ka cenø.
english: And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

anywaa: Køøre buut dhi kal løøk aciel man, wär kïthi ka abïï mo olïërö mo bär mar deŋŋe beeye gööye apaar kurbïïc, ki jer kal moe ma adäk, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma adäk thuwø.
english: The hangings of one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

anywaa: Ni kïth løøk maya ka abïï mo olïërö ma gööye apaar kurbïïc, ki jer kal moe ma adäk, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma adäk thuwø.
english: And on the other side shall be hangings fifteen cubits: their pillars three, and their sockets three.

anywaa: «'Ba wär näk da abïï mo mar gëëŋ ma gööye ma pïërariiø kiper dhi kal, no ocwääö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, ki jer kal moe ma aŋween, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma aŋween thuwø.
english: And for the gate of the court shall be an hanging of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework: and their pillars shall be four, and their sockets four.

anywaa: Jer kal bëët wär tïïc ni da gïï wø maai piny ki ge mo tïïc ka gwelbïrö, ki nywïëny moge mo ogøn mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: All the pillars round about the court shall be filleted with silver; their hooks shall be of silver, and their sockets of brass.

anywaa: Bär mar kal ki deŋŋe wär tïme na rumme ma dïpa, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumme ma pïërabïïc, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø, ni bär mar abïïe moa näk gëëŋŋe ki piny beeye gööye obïïci. Na abïïe moa näk gëëŋŋe moøgø tïïc ka lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni ö gïï wø cwöth tiet jer kal yïthge ni tïï ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty every where, and the height five cubits of fine twined linen, and their sockets of brass.

anywaa: Jammi møga bëët moa näk mo tïïc mo oduŋkaara, ki dïnööy moe bëët, ki dïnööy mo kal bëët, wär tïïc ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: All the vessels of the tabernacle in all the service thereof, and all the pins thereof, and all the pins of the court, shall be of brass.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni jø Icriel diï köömmö nee känge jïrï ki maaw mana tøŋ kiper lambae, mo käla ri nyïï jenni mo wø wel na mädhi, nee lambae bëëtge ni liel cooth.
english: And thou shalt command the children of Israel, that they bring thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

anywaa: Aran ki wääte lambae dege jiiŋŋø na karge nee lielge nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye ki mano täge ki wïthïënhö këël amöölla. Ni tïïc manøgø tïïcge yo oduŋkaany røømmø ŋää gëëŋi wøk na en nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy. Gïnögø wär tïme na ciik jï jø Icriel cooth këël mano këët røk beenhnhe moge moo ööi bëët.
english: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the veil, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before the Lord: it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni na Modhe en, cöögu ma Aran ki wääte wär nyïï buutï, ni lwørï ge dï jø Icriel, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme. Ni beeye Aran ki wääte na näk Nadap ka Abiyu ki Eliedhar ki Itamer.
english: And take thou unto thee Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Israel, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's sons.

anywaa: Ni tïïï ka abïïe mo ena kur keerge nee tïmge na jap ajiem ni jap mïërö jï cöögu ma Aran.
english: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty.

anywaa: Wär caanï jï jiy bëët moa näk nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, na näk yaa mooø ki leec wïc, na abïïe mo Aran tïïcge, kiper na Aran tïme na dhaanhø mo ena kur keere, naa tïnynye ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron's garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

anywaa: 'Ba abïïe moo tïïc jøøgø jï Aran ki wääte beege abïï käw, ka abïï mana cwøl ni ëëput, ki jalabiiya mo ciek, ki jalabiiya mør mo okwøø ni bäär no ocwääö ni waŋe orïëm, ka abïï man wø meen wïc, ka abïï mo ocwääö na kaw. Ni ö abïïe moøgø ni tïïcge ge ni ena kur keerge kiper cöögu ma Aran ki wääte, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme.
english: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron thy brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

anywaa: Jøøgø ni nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc yøø wär lwötge ki warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, na abïïe moøgø bëët tïïcge ki ge.
english: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

anywaa: «'Ba abïï mana cwøl ni ëëput wär tïïcge ki warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

anywaa: Abïï mana cwøl ni ëëput, røk gööge karge riet wär tïïc ni da gïï ma ariiø mo gääba gø ki kwöra näk da gööge.
english: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

anywaa: 'Ba kaw mar abïï man wø twöö abïïna cwøl ni ëëput piny ki gø wär cwääc ki riek waŋ ni caala ëëput; ni cwääc ka teeŋ gïïa cwääc ëëput ki ge, ni beege warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

anywaa: «Køøre kïte ariiø moa cwøl ni cöyammi na näk kïte mo perge leth wär lwørï ni göörï nyeŋ wäät Icriel na näk apaar kurriiø bäätge,
english: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:

anywaa: ni nyeŋ jiy abïciel ena bäät kïdi aciel, ni nyeŋ jiy abïciel møga ena bäät kïdi maya, ni iï göör piny ki køør nyöödö mana nywøl ge ki gø.
english: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

anywaa: Kïte moøgø na ariiø yøø nyeŋ wäät Icriel na näk apaar kurriiø diï gööra bäätge, ni gööra dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø; ni kïthï kïte moøgø yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel: thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold.

anywaa: Køøre kïte moøgø na ariiø yøø wär kïth kwöra näk da göök abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, nee bëëtge na kïte mo wïc di parø ki køørge kiper nyeŋ wäät Icriel na en dëëtge, ni ö Aranni ni käl nyeŋge nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ena røk gööge karge riet, kiper nee wïc wø par ki ge.
english: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the Lord upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ki gïï wø mäk piny ki ge ki warkey,
english: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;

anywaa: ni tïïï ki tiimme ariiø ki warkey mana tøŋ; ni tïïyï ge ni caala thøøl mo owenyø, ni kïthï ge røk gïï wø mäk piny ki ge.
english: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ka abïï käw man wø nyooth adïëri mar Jwøk ki køøre, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, no otïïö ni caala tïïc mana tïïc abïïna cwøl ni ëëput ki gø; ni tïïc ka warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.

anywaa: Ni tïïyï gø ni deŋŋe röömi bëët no obanø na dïrïbi, ni bär mar deŋŋe beeye rumi mar yïthakic lweedi, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi mar yïthakic lweedi.
english: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

anywaa: Ni kïthï dëëre ki teeŋ kïte mo perge leth mo mïërö no ocaanø na kwöre aŋween; ni tïïyï mana dïkwøŋ na mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo kwaar ni caala dha adhieŋ, ki mo piilli kaamar warkey, ki mo ŋwaŋŋi døc mo caala keenh-orwëëdhö;
english: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

anywaa: ni tïïyï rietge na mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo ränni ni tøŋ, ki mo caala dïmuuy, ki mo piilli ni lïw;
english: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

anywaa: ni tïïyï dääge na mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo caala abïcøle, ki mo caala otïït, ki mo caala dïmuur;
english: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

anywaa: ni tïïyï ŋweerge na mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo caala okwëër, ki kïdi mo pere leth mo cwøl ni cöyam, ki mo ŋwaŋŋi døc ni tøŋ keda wïlli; ni kïthï kïte moøgø bëët yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

anywaa: Kïte moøgø ni perge leth yøø beege kïte apaar kurriiø, na aciel man nø nyeŋ dhaanhø aciel røk wäät Icriel ogöör bääte, ni nyootha wïth tuŋi apaar kurriiø mo jø Icriel.
english: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

anywaa: «Ni kïthï dëër abïï käw ki tiimme mo caala thøøl mo owenyø, ni tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ko oguudi ariiø mo thiiwï ka warkey, ni gänï ge ra abïï käw røk deŋŋe moa en maal karge riet.
english: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

anywaa: Tiimme moa näk ariiø yøø na näk caala thøøl mo owenyø wär roopï ki yïth oguudi moa näk ariiø na en røk deŋ abïï käw.
english: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.

anywaa: Ni ö dhøk tiimme møga ni roopï ge ki yïth gïïa näk ariiø ni wø mäk piny ki ge na en røk göök abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, ni ena jï kuna näk da nyïm en.
english: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.

anywaa: Køøre wärï cäŋ tïïö ko oguudi ariiø mo thiiwï ka warkey ni gänï ge ra abïï käw røk deŋŋe moa en piny, ni ena kuna en da ec mar abïïna cwøl ni ëëput.
english: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.

anywaa: Wärï tïïï ko oguudi ariiø møøk thuwø ni thiiwï ka warkey, ni gänï ge røk ceŋ abïïna cwøl ni ëëput na en røk gööge karge riet jï piny mëëth, ni ena jï kun da nyïm ni kare cään ki kanya kuubi ki yie, ni ena jï maal mëëth ki kaw mar abïï man wø twöö ëëput piny ki gø na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ.
english: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï käw wär twöc ki røk oguudi moa en deŋŋe, ni twöi røk oguudi moa en dëër ëëput, ni twöc ka waare mo owenyø mo kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni løny ki man bëëde ni teek ri kaw mar abïï man wø twöö ëëput piny ki gø na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ, kiper na abïï käw ba bëëde ni lwäägö kanyo en ri ëëput.
english: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø døny Aranni kanya en kur keere, abïï käw man wø nyooth adïëri mar Jwøk ki køøre wär näk ee røø, ni käär nyeŋ wäät Icriel ki kööre ni ena ra abïïnögø, kiper nee bëëde na gïr par wïc nyïma cooth, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the Lord continually.

anywaa: Abïï käw man wø nyooth adïëri mar Jwøk ki køøre, yie wär kïthï ki gïïa cwøl ni Urim ki Thumim, nee kany wø duny Aranni nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nee bëëtge ni ena ya abïïnögø kööre; ni ö Aranni ni käär gïn wø nyooth adïëri mar Jwøk jï jø Icriel ni ena kööre cooth kany wø ö nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the Lord: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the Lord continually.

anywaa: «Køøre jalabiiya mana ciek man wø røø tier abïïna cwøl ni ëëput wär tïïyï bäre ni kïte caala kït abïcøle.
english: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

anywaa: Ni wëën dïëre maal ki kany mo ŋaam na kar wïc; ni cwääc deŋŋe kanya no owiiø ni ŋaam enø ki waare ni teek, kiper nee ba jeee.
english: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.

anywaa: Deŋ jalabiiya manøgø mana en piny bäre wär kïthï ki gïï mo caala nyïïadikwäle mo otïïö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar; ni yïthakicge da gare mo otïïö ki warkey.
english: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:

anywaa: Ni kelï ge ni kany nø da waŋ gara mo tïïc ka warkey, køøre ki waare moa no otïïö ni caala nyaadikwala, këël mano wïrï deŋ jalabiiya manøgø ki piny bäre.
english: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.

anywaa: Jalabiiya manøgø wär näk ena dëër Aran kany wø tïïc tïï dïlämi. Ni kany wø duny kanya en kur keere nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, wala kany wø døny wøk, dööt gare moa näk tïïc ka warkey ra abïï manøgø løny ki man wïnye, kiper nee eni ba thøøe.
english: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the Lord, and when he cometh out, that he die not.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki gïn mo ŋwaŋŋi no otïïö ki warkey mana tøŋ, ni göönnï dëëre ki gööre mo køp, ni ‹Eni ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Lord.

anywaa: Ni twöï gø ra abïï man wø meen wïc, ni twöc ka waare moa no owenyø na näk kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni ena jï kun da nyïm en.
english: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

anywaa: Ni ö gïnögø ni bëëde täärnyïm Aran; ni ö Aranni ni lwør ajäl raay mana doo en bäät jø Icriel ki køør gïï wø cïpge ni patha karge røk japa en kur keerge bëët mo wø kälge baŋa. Ni ö gïnögø ni bëëde täärnyïm Aran cooth, nee gïïo cïpge jïëa, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the Lord.

anywaa: «Køøre jalabiiya mana bäär wär cwääc ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö ni cwääi ni waŋe orïëm; ni tïïc abïï man wø meen wïc ki lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni cwääö ki kaw mar abïï, ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki jalabiiye mo okwøø ni bäyö kiper wäät Aran; ni cwääï ki kaae mo abïïe jïge thuwø, ni tïïï ki cöörri, kiper nee tïmge na jap ajiem ni jap mïërö jïge.
english: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.

anywaa: Køøre nø, gïïögø bëët wär kïth dëër cöögu ma Aran, ni kïthï mo wääte dëëtge na aciel ki eni bëët; ni jørï geni ki maaw, ni røønyï geni, ni tïïyï ge na jiy mo ena kur keerge, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme.
english: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

anywaa: «Ni tïïï jïge ki libaae mo tïïc ka lïïna mo tar, nee dëëtge kwöra määnö uumge ki ge; ni kwøi no orøm pier no okëët ämmi.
english: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø døny Aranni ki wääte yo oduŋkaany røømmø, wala kany wø nyiikge buut gïna näk caala tharabëëta ni wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte ni ge tïïya tïï dïlämme kanya en kur keere, abïïe moøgø wär näk mo ena dëëtge, kiper nee ba tïme na raay bäätge, ni ba thøwge. Gïnögø wär bëëde na ciik cooth jï Aran këël mano këët røk wääte ki nyïïkwaaye bëët moo ööi køøre.
english: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.

anywaa: «'Ba jöö mano tïïyï Aran ki wääte na jiy mo ena kur keerge ki gø, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme, beeye en. Wärï lwötï ki nyirøøa ma rwaath ki nyöök rööm ariiø mo bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi dëëtge,
english: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,

anywaa: ki muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø, ni beege muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø mo odeelø no opamø mo ojääbö ki maaw, ki muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø mo odeelø no opamø ni reep mo bäätge okïthö ki maaw; ni muunni moøgø tïïc ka møø mo pøøth.
english: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

anywaa: Ni kïthï muunni moøgø yo opïr aciel, ni cïpï opïr manøgø na muuy ki nyirøøa na aciel mana näk rwaath ki nyöök rööm moa näk ariiø.
english: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.

anywaa: Køøre Aran ki wääte diï käla dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ni lwøgï geni ki pïï.
english: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.

anywaa: Ni lwørï abïïe, ni beege jalabiiya mana bäär ki jalabiiya mana ciek man wø røø tier abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, ki ëëput, ka abïï käw, ni røøï geni dëër Aran, ni twöï kaw mar abïï dëëre, ni beeye kaw man wø twöö ëëput piny ki gø na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ;
english: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

anywaa: ni kïthï abïï man wø meen wïc wïïe, ni ö gïna no otïïö ni ŋwaŋŋi ki warkey na näk nyuudhi mar ŋat mo ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk ni twöï gø ra abïï man wø meen wïc manøgø.
english: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.

anywaa: Køøre maaw mar rööny wär lwørï ni thiiï gø wï Aran ni røønyï eni.
english: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

anywaa: Ni cwølï wääte, ni ö jalabiiye moa näk okwøø ni bäyö ni røøï ge dëëtge,
english: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.

anywaa: ni twöï kaae moa näk mo abïïe dëëtge, ni kïthï cöörri wïthge. Ni tïm tïï dïlämme ni ena ceŋge cooth, ni put tïïci manøgø bëëtö na ciik jïge. Ni manøgø beeye jöö mano cïbï tïïc mar Aran ki wääte ceŋge ki gø.
english: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.

anywaa: «Køøre nyirøøa mana näk rwaath diï käla nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge wï nyirøøa manøgø.
english: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.

anywaa: Ni ŋaalï nyirøøa manøgø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, dho oduŋkaany røømmø kaagø.
english: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the Lord, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø wärï lwötï ki rem nyirøøa ki lweetï ni gweelï gïïa näk caala tuŋi ri gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; ni kønynyï remø bäre mana dööŋ dëër gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï kun da piny en.
english: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.

anywaa: Køøre oraapø mar dwäälö man wø en bäät ec, ko oraapø man wø en bäät cwïny, ki røgi karge riet ki dwäälö marge, wär lwørï ni waaŋï gø no olämi bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋ nyirøøa manøgø, ki pïëne, ki weenynye moe, wär waaŋï ki maac ŋää twïër wøk; ni beeye olämi mar raay.
english: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.

anywaa: «Køøre nywø røømmø aciel wär lwørï, ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge wï nywø røømmø manøgø;
english: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

anywaa: ni ŋaalï nywø røømmø manøgø, ni lwørï remø mare ni jørï gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte deŋŋe manøgø bäre.
english: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.

anywaa: Køøre nywø røømmø manøgø ŋøørï ŋøørø, ni penyï cïïn moe ki tiete, ni cïbï ge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki wïïe bëët na aciel.
english: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.

anywaa: Ni cïpï nywø røømmø manøgø bäre no olämi man wø waaŋ bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye gïn mo ŋwäänynye met, ni näk olämi man wø waaŋ jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the Lord: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: «Køøre nywø røømmø maya wär lwørï thuwø, ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge wï nywø røømmø manøgø.
english: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.

anywaa: Ni ŋaalï nywø røømmø manøgø, ni lwötï ki remø ni gweelï olap ïth Aran mar bäät cwïïe, ko olap ïth wääte mo bäät cwïcge, ki lweet ceŋge moa døøŋŋø mo bäät cwïcge, ki lweet tietge moa døøŋŋø mo bäät cwïcge, ni jørï remø mana dööŋ bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte deŋŋe manøgø bäre.
english: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

anywaa: Køøre wärï lwötï ki remø ri remø mana en bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni lwötï ki maaw ri maaw mar rööny ni wø judö ki gø, ni jørï gø dëër Aran ki dëër abïïge, ki dëët wääte ki dëët abïïkge, ni jørï na aciel ki wääge bëët. Kanyøgø nø, Aran ka abïïge, këël wääte na en kanya ciel ki eni ka abïïkge, tïmö ni ge ena kur keerge.
english: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

anywaa: «Køøre dwäälö mar nywø røømmø manøgø, na näk dwäälö mana en jïbe, ko oraapø mar dwäälö man wø en bäät ec, ko oraapø man wø en bäät cwïny, ki røgi karge riet ki dwäälö marge, ki ääm mar bäät cwïïc wär lwørï, kiper nywø røømmø manøgø beeye mar rööny.
english: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

anywaa: Ni lwötï ki møø aciel, ki møø aciel mør mo thiinh mo ojääbö ki maaw, ki møø aciel mør mo reep, ni lwørï røk muunni moa näk rege bäŋ thømmø na en yo opïr mana näk ocïp piny nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk;
english: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the Lord:

anywaa: ni cïbï gïïögø bëët ceŋ Aran ki ceŋ wääte, ni tuuŋge gïïögø yi jamø na jëëdhi man wø tuuŋŋi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni lwørï gïïögø ceŋge, ni waaŋï ge ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk; ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the Lord: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: «Køøre gøŋŋø mar nywø røømmø mana ŋaal na mar rööny, na Aran tïme na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, wär lwørï, ï na Modhe en, ni tuuŋŋï gø yi jamø na jëëdhi man wø tuuŋŋi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nee tïme ni beeye kurï eni.
english: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the Lord: and it shall be thy part.

anywaa: «'Ba kwöra käl wøk ri nywø røømmø mar rööny mar Aran ki wääte, ni beege gøŋŋø mana tuuŋŋi yi jamø ki ääm, wär tïïyï nee bëëtge na gïï mo ena kur keerge.
english: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

anywaa: Yi nyïme thuwø, moøgø wär tïmge na kur Aran ki wääte cooth røk olämme mo wø cïp jø Icrielli. Ni manøgø beeye jëëdhi mana doo cïp jø Icrielli jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, røk olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba abïïe mo Aran na en kur keerge wär dööŋge jï wääde mano dööŋ kare, këël mano këët ri nyïïkwaaye, ni røøny geni ni cïp tïï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ceŋge na abïïe moøgø ege røø.
english: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

anywaa: Wär Aran mano dööŋ kar wänni na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, abïïe moøgø wär røøe ni käär ge ki nïne abïriiø kany wø døny yo oduŋkaany røømmø ni mare tïïc kanya en kur keere.
english: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.

anywaa: «'Ba rïŋ nywø røømmø mana ŋaal na mar rööny enø wär lwørï ni thaalï gø kany mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni camge rïŋö manøgø, ki muunni moa näk ena yo opïr; ni camge dho oduŋkaany røømmø kaagø.
english: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Gïïögø na cïp no okïdi mo wëënna raay yøø dege camø, ni cïba tïïc marge ceŋge ni tïmge na jiy mo ena kur keerge; 'ba dhaanhø mør jaak ba doo cämö rege, kiper gena gïï mo ena kur keerge.
english: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo rïŋö manøgø na näk mar rööny enø, wala muunni odhäthö ni këët amöölla, wär waaŋï ki maac; ni ba cami këët, kiper beege gïï mo oløny ni ena kur keerge.
english: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

anywaa: «'Ba gïïögø diï tïïö na karge jï Aran ki wääte ki køør mana caana jïrï bäre; ni røønyï ge yïth nïrøgø na abïriiø yøø.
english: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ aciel man nø ï doo cïpö ki nyirøøa ma rwaath no olämi mar raay kiper nee tïme no okïdi mo wëënna raay, ni døøyï gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo waany kanyo cïpï okïdi manøgø bääte; ni gweelï gø ki maaw nee tïme na gïn mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.

anywaa: Okïdi man wø wëën raay wär tïïyï ki nïne abïriiø kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte nee tïme na gïn mo ena kur keere; køøre nø, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte tïmö na gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth, ni gïn mo gïnögø ee gudö jaak puta tïmö na gïn mo ena kur keere.
english: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.

anywaa: «'Ba olämme mo ocïpï cooth bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte beege nyïïdïëk ariiø mo cwiicge oceele kiper dïcäŋ aciel man nø.
english: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

anywaa: Ni cïpï nyidiel aciel no olämi ka amöölla, ni cïpï maya no olämi kany wø tïme na abøøya;
english: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:

anywaa: ni cïp ka muuy mar møø mo pøøth ma rumi aciel ki ri caapiia mo yie da rumme apaar, mo ojääbö ki maaw ma cuŋguthi ariiø, ni cïpï ki køøŋ nyïïomøki ma cuŋguthi ariiø na jëëdhi thuwø kiper nyidiel aciel.
english: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

anywaa: 'Ba nyidiel maya mano cïp no olämi kanyo tïm cäŋŋi ni manynya pädhö wär cïpï na aciel ki muuy mar møk beel, ki jëëdhi mar køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni caala mana cïp ka amöölla, kiper nee tïme na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: «Manøgø wär tïme ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre cooth këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou, ni cïpa dho oduŋkaany røømmø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye kany wø røømma ki uuni yie, ni cääna ki uuni kaace.
english: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.

anywaa: Aano wäro røømmi ki jø Icriel kaace, ni tïm kaace na kany mo ena kur keere ki køør ajiem mara.
english: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

anywaa: «'Ba aani oduŋkaany røømmø ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte tïïa tïïö ni bëëtge na gïï mo ena kur keerge; ni tïïa Aran ki wääte na jiy mo ena kur keerge thuwø, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme.
english: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, aano bëëdö dï jø Icriel, ni puta bëëtö ni aana Jwøk marge.
english: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.

anywaa: Ni puti ya jø Icrielli ŋäc møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marge na käl geni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ki man bëëda dïge. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marge.
english: And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the Lord their God.

anywaa: «Køøre wärï tïïï ki gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta.
english: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.

anywaa: Ni bär mar deŋŋe beeye rumi aciel, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel, ni deŋŋe karge ŋweeri röömi; ni ö bärri mare ki piny ni tïï na rumme ariiø, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø. Wïth deŋŋe maal karge ŋweeri wär tïïc ni da gïï mo caala tuŋi, no ogääbö na aciel ki dëër gø bäre.
english: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

anywaa: 'Ba bääte maal, ki bute ki deŋŋe bäre, ki gïïa no otïïö ni caala tuŋi, wär lëënynyï ki warkey mana tøŋ. Ni ö deŋŋe bäre ni tïïi ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.

anywaa: Wärï thïïï ko oguudi ariiø mo warkey kiper nee kïth deŋŋe mana no otïïö ni mïërö jï piny; ni kïthï oguudi moøgø bute karge riet na näk dïët, nee tïmge na gïï mak jer tëër mo biel gïna näk caala tharabëëta ki ge.
english: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

anywaa: 'Ba jer tëër moøgø wär tïïyï ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni lëënynyï dëëtge ki warkey.
english: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

anywaa: «Køøre gïn wø waaŋ jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte enø wär cïp ŋää abïï wøk man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø, ni dïët ka acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, na en kany wø røømma ki ïïni yie.
english: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ni waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäät gïnögø, ni waaŋe ka amöölla man nø cooth kany wø jiiŋ lambae.
english: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met waaŋŋø kany wø nyep lambae kany wø tïm cäŋŋi ni manynya pädhö. Kanyøgønø, gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bëëdö ni di waaŋø cooth nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, këël mano këët røk beenhnhe moo ööi bëët.
english: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the Lord throughout your generations.

anywaa: Kär dee teeŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met mør jaak mo waaŋï bäät gø, ni kär niï cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ wala muuy mar beel bääte. Kär dee jëëdhi mar køøŋ nyïïomøki mo kønynyï bääte.
english: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran wär tïïe ko okïdi mar wëën raay røk gïïa näk caala tuge yie aciel ki yi cwiir; okïdi mar wëën raay manøgø wär tïïc Aranni ki rem olämi man wø cïp no okïdi mar wëën raay, ni beeye yie aciel ki yi cwiir cooth këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou moo ööi bëët. Gïnö ni caal tharabëëta enø beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo kwaanï jø Icriel moa näk cwøw ni marï kwäny, ŋati man nø doo cïpö jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki jap cuut kwör kiper dëëre, kiper kanyo kwaanï ge nee bäŋe gïn mo leth mo pïï dëëtge.
english: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the Lord, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.

anywaa: Gïno cïp ŋati man nø røk jiy moo kwaan beeye thääŋ gwelø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ni røm na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere. Ni tïm jammi moøgø ni cïpa jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the Lord.

anywaa: Jiy moo kwaan wär täk ki jiy moa näk cwiicge pïërariiø këël wïthge, ni ö ŋati man nø dëët jiy moa kwaan bëët ni cïp jammi moøgø na karge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo cïpu jammi moøgø jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni caala okïdi mo wëën raay moo tïïyu kiper dëëtu, ŋata no okwär ba doo cïpö ki gwel mo thööth ni kaala thääŋ rumi mana cwøl ni cekel; ni ö ŋata canni ni ba cïpe ki gwel mo nøk mo orëëm ki thääŋ rumi mana cwøl ni cekel.
english: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Modhe en, japa näk caala okïdi mo wëën raay yøø wär lwørï baŋ jø Icriel, ni cïpï ge na jap tïïc mo oduŋkaany røømmø, nee tïmge na jap par wïc jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper jø Icriel, ni caala okïdi moo tïïyu kiper dëëtu, ni wø wëën raay mou.»
english: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the Lord, to make an atonement for your souls.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «Wärï tïïï ki gïr lwøk mo caala thecet ni tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni tïïyï gïre man wø cïbi bäät gø ki nywïënyö ma jwïël thuwø; ni cïbï gø yïthakic oduŋkaany røømmø ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kïthï yie ki pïï.
english: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni lwøkge ceŋge ki tietge røk pïï moa en yie;
english: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

anywaa: ni kany wø dønyge yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ge doo löö røk pïï moøgø, nee ge ba thøwge. Ni kany wø nyänhge buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni marge tïïc, ni ge cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac bäät gø jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk,
english: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the Lord:

anywaa: geni ceŋge ki tietge dege lwøø, nee ge ba thøwge. Ni ö gïnögø ni put tïmö na ciik kiper Aran ki wääte ki nyïïkwaaye këël mano këët røk beenhnhe moge moo ööi.»
english: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: Moreover the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwötï ki gïï mo ŋwääö ni met; ni beege dwøø mo poot jööm mar jaadha cwøl ni kerbëë ma rumme ma dïpe abïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ka apøk jaath man wø ŋwääi ni met ma rumme ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ki teeŋ thieŋ mo wø ŋwääi ni met ma rumme ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel,
english: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,

anywaa: ki teeŋ jaath mør mo ŋwääö ni met ma rumme ma dïpe abïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere, ki maar nyïïjer wø nyïïge wel na maaw ma rumi aciel mar rumi mana cwøl ni in.
english: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø mo ena kur keere ki gïïögø, na riia mo ŋwääi ni met, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, nee bëëde na maar rööny man wø judö ki gø mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

anywaa: Køøre oduŋkaany røømmø, ka acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy,
english: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

anywaa: ki tharabëëta ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki lambae ki gïna cuŋge bäät gø ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte,
english: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bääte, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet ki gïre man wø cïbi bäät gø, wär gweelï ki maaw manøgø.
english: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye jöö mano cïbï gïïögø kur keerge ki gø, ni putge tïmö na gïï mo ena kur keerge ni perge leth; ni gïn moo gut ge jaak puta tïmö na gïn mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

anywaa: «Ni jørï Aran ki wääte niï røønya geni, ni cïbï geni kur keerge, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme.
english: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.

anywaa: 'Ba wär caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Man en beeye maaw mo ena kur keere na mar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ni wø tïny aani ki gø këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou bëët moo ööi.
english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

anywaa: Maaw manøgø kär wïïr dëër dhaanhø jaak, ni kär dee teeŋe mo tïïyu tïïö ni caala gø; kiper beeye maaw mo ena kur keere, ni put bëëtö ni ena kur keere jïïu.
english: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo tïïö jaak ki teeŋe, wala ŋat mo wïïr dëër dhaanhø mør ki gø jaak, ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.› »
english: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jï Modhe, ni «Lwötï ki gïï wø waaŋ ni wø ŋwääi ni met, ni beege teeŋ dwøk moa cwøl ni natap, ki cekëëleth, ki kelbena, ki teeŋ dwøø maya mana tar døc mana cwøl ni leböna; ni lwør ni röömi ki røkge bëët.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

anywaa: Ni tïïï ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ki gïïögø, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, no ojääbö ka acäbö, no otïïö na kare, na gïn mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

anywaa: Ni lwötï ree ni wälï gø no oŋeth, ni cïbï gø nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na en yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni beeye kany wø røømma ki ïïni yie; ni put tïmö na gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth jïïu.
english: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met manøgø noo tïïyï enø, kär teeŋe tïïyu kiper dëëtu; 'ba wär tïme ni ena kur keere jïïu kipera, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wäro tïïö ki teeŋe jaak, nee tïïe na gïn wø ŋwääi ni met jïre, wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.»
english: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Neenï, Bacaliil wär Uri na näk nyikwaar Ur, na en ri tuuŋ Juuda, ajiera.
english: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:

anywaa: Ni eni yaa mooø ki Jwïëc Jwøk, nee jïte ki leec wïc, ki riek waŋ man ŋäc acaara, ki riek waŋ man kwany jammi, ki man ŋäc teeŋ tïïe bëët,
english: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

anywaa: ni løny jïre ki man cäde ki man nyøth tïï warkey, ki gwelbïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël,
english: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

anywaa: ki tïï tieŋ nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth mo wø kïth yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge, ki tïï tieŋ jenni; nee lønye jïre ki man tïïc teeŋ tïïe bëët ki riek waŋ.
english: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aani ki dëëra kiree, Oliyap wär Aycamak, na käl ri tuuŋ Daan, acïba nee Bacaliil kønye ki tïïe moøgø; ni tïïa jiy bëët moa nyeŋge reegø ki man ŋäcge tïïc, nee tïme ni løny jïge ki man tïïcge jammi bëët na karge moa köömma ïïni ki geni;
english: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;

anywaa: ni beege oduŋkaany røømmø, ka acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, ki rëëbi na en bääte na näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, ki jammi bëët moo manynyi kiper yo oduŋkaara,
english: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

anywaa: ki tharabëëta ki jap tïïc moe, ki lambae ki gïn wø cïbi bäät gø mana no otïïö ki warkey mana tøŋ, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte,
english: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bääte ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet ki gïre man wø cïbi bäät gø,
english: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

anywaa: ka abïïe moa no ocwääö ki riek waŋ na en kur keerge kiper Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka abïïe mo wääte, ni beege abïïe mo wø røcge kany wø tïnyge aani ni gena dïlämme;
english: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,

anywaa: ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïn wø waaŋ kanya en kur keere wø jïye ŋwääi ni met. Gïïögø bëët dege tïïö ki køør mana köömma ïïni ki gø bäre.»
english: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, wär caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï, ni ‹Kiper naa ŋäyu ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp uuni kur keeru, ka adïëri møn, gwøgu nïr jwöm 'moa; ni manøgø beeye nyuudhi mano bëëdö yïthakiyø ki uuni këël beenhnhe mou bëët mo ööi.
english: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the Lord that doth sanctify you.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgønø, cäŋ jwömö dou gwøø, kiper beeye cäŋ mo ena kur keere jïïu. Ni ŋato päät gø jaak, ka adïëri møn, wär thøøe; kiper ŋato tïïö cäŋ manøgø jaak, wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

anywaa: Tïïe doo tïïö ki nïne abïciel, 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne, beeye cäŋ jwömö man jwöm røk yie, ni beeye cäŋ mo ena kur keere jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk; ni ŋato tïïö jaak ki cäŋ jwömö, ka adïëri møn, wär thøøe.›
english: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the Lord: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel cäŋ jwömö dege gwøø, ni wøørge gø këël beenhnhe moge bëët moo ööi, na luubö mo otuudö na bäre bäre.
english: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

anywaa: Gïnögø bëëdö na nyuudhi mo ena yïthakicwa ki jø Icriel na bäre bäre; kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, maal ki piny acwääa ki nïne abïciel; 'ba na tïme na bïriet nïne, aani raa ajwöma, ni koodha ŋëëta.»
english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na lønye ki cäänö ki Modhe bäät Kïn Caynay, eni Modhe amooe ko opäp kïte ariiø moa näk ciik ogöör bäätge, ni ciik moa en bäät opäp kïte moøgø gööra Jwøki ki cere.
english: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jootge gø ni Modhe oruu ni kär laar duu piny ki bäät kïdi, geni dëëtge acooŋge buut Aran, ni köge jïgø, ni «Ööï, ni tïïï jïwa ki juu mo cäädhi nyïmwa; kiper nyenøgø na Modhe enø, na käl waani wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, gïna no otägö dëëre kucwa.»
english: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

anywaa: Ni kö Aranni jïge, ni «Tøyu gwet ïdhi mo warkey na en ïth määru ki wäätu ki nyïïu, ni kälu geni baŋa.»
english: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët gwet ïdhi mo warkey moa en ïthge aputge tøyø ni kälge ge baŋ Aran.
english: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ni lwør gïïögø ceŋge, ni leeny ge na gïn mo caala nyirøøa, ni tieŋ gø ki gïn wø tëëŋö ki gø; ni köge, ni «Wui, jø Icriel, moi beege juu mou na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.»
english: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Aranni na neen gïnögø, ena tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte nyïm nyirøøa; ni ö Aranni ni gøø awaaci piny, ni kööe, ni «Diøø tïmö ni da ajwöma jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn gena put päny maal ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ, ni känge ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër; ni ö jiyi ni pïge piny ni cämge ni mäthge, ni öge maal ni mielge.
english: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe, ni «Laar ci piny, kiper jiyï, na kälï wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, dëëtge araanyge keerge.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

anywaa: Gena laar gaa wøk ki øtjöö mana köömma geni ki gø, ni tïïge ki gïn mo oleenyø mo caala nyirøøa kiper dëëtge, ni wøørge gø, ni cïpge ko olämme jïgø, ni köge, ni ‹Wui, jø Icriel, moi beege juu mou na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.› »
english: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Modhe, ni «Aani jøøgø aneena døøc; ka adïëri møn, gena jiy mo wïthge teek.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wec aani, nee wëër mara jääŋŋa bäätge, nee ge raanynya; 'ba ïïni, ïïno tïïa na wï jur mo päl.»
english: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøe akwaae, ni kööe, ni «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ?aperŋø na kööï ni wëër marï jääŋŋï jääŋŋö bäät jiyï na kälï wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ki køør teek badï na dwøŋ?
english: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a jø Ijep noo köge, ni ‹Jwøk jiye akäl wøk ki rääc ec nee nää yïthakic kïte, ni raany geni bäät piny›? Awuuö Jwøk, akwaya ïïni ki man cïbï cwïnyï piny ni wiilï acaara marï, ni ba tïïï ki gïn mo raac dëët jiyï.
english: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.

anywaa: Caar wïïï ki Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Icriel, na näk jiyï, na kööŋï jïge ki dëërï kiree, ni kööï, ni ‹Aani nyïïkwaayu otïïa nee nyaacge ni caala ceer mo maal, ni cïba ŋöömö man bäre ni cääna kipere en jï nyïïkwaayu, ni put tïmö na marge na bäre bäre.› »
english: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye aware ki gïna dee tïïö na raac dëët jiye na caane.
english: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aduu piny ki bäät kïdi no opäp kïte moa näk ariiø na näk ciik ogöör bäätge kääre käärö ki cere, ni beege opäp kïte moa näk ogöörö ki kwöre bëët, ni beege ki løøi ki løøk maya.
english: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

anywaa: 'Ba opäp kïte moøgø tïïya Jwøki; ni gööre moa näk ogöör bäätge, gööra Jwøki.
english: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcua na wïny dööt jiy ni ge lweelli døc, ena köö jï Modhe, ni «Da dwøl mo keda dwør leny mo ena twïër.»
english: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, ni «Manøgø ba wïnyi na dööt jiy mo orëëmmo wala dööt jiy mo oböötö; 'ba dwøl manøgø ni wïnynya enø beeye dwør meeŋ.»
english: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Modhe kare cään ki twïër, gïna näk caala nyirøøa ajoode, ni jiy miel; ni ö Modhe ni put wëër døc, ni leeŋ opäp kïte piny na en cere, ni putge tøyø tier kïdi kaagø.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

anywaa: Ni lwør gïna näk caala nyirøøa na näk ege tïïö, ni waaŋ gø ki maac, ni guur gø këël mana tïme ni caala tør, ni køny gø bäät pïï, ni tïïc gø nee maath jø Icrielli.
english: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Aran, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïc jøøi dëërï, ni kïthï bääyö man ni dwøŋ bäätge en?»
english: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?

anywaa: Ni kö Aranni, ni «Kwäärö, kärï wëër ki aani døc; ïïni ki dëërï kiree, ŋäyï ni jøøi ii cwïnyge ena køør gïï mo reyø.
english: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.

anywaa: Kiper beeye geni na köö ki aani, ni ‹Ööï ni tïïï jïwa ki juu mo cäädhi nyïmwa; kiper nyenøgø na Modhe enø, na käl waani wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, gïna no otägö dëëre kucwa.›
english: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

anywaa: Ni kööa jïge, ni ‹Ŋat mo jïre da warkey jaak, wär tuur wøk.› Ni putge gø tïïc ni kälge ge baŋa, ni leeŋa ge yi maac, ni put tïmö na gïna näk caala nyirøøa enø.»
english: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na joot jiy ni bëëdö ka wïthge keerge, kiper mana weyi Aranni nee bëëtge ki wïthge keerge, ni tïmge na jiy mo ojøøŋŋø ki baŋ nyïïmänge;
english: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

anywaa: kanyøgø eni na Modhe enø, ena ci dhi kiir mar twïër, ni kööe, ni «Ŋat mo ena løø Wuuö Jwøk jaak, beerra man ö baŋa.» Ni ö nyïïkwaac Libay moa näk cwøw bëët ni putge rege cooŋ buute.
english: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord's side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïge, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø Icriel beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ŋati man nø dëëtu opëëllö mare dee lwørø, ni cøøe ni cäädhe dï kiir bäre, ni 'näk ŋata joode ni bëëdö ka wïïe, këël coki, këël watge, këël ŋat atut mare.› »
english: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaac Libay ni putge gø tïïc kaawat mana caani ya Modhe, ni thøw jiyi mo jïtö ki kume adäk dïcäŋeca.
english: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, ni «Kiper na cïbu dëëtu kur keeru jï Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋ man en, ni männu ki wäätu ki nyïïmëëgu, Wuuö Jwøk thuwø uuna gwïëdhe dïcäŋ man en.»
english: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the Lord, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, Modhe aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Uuni, uuna bääyö ki bääyö mo dwøŋ døc kiree; 'ba ennø, a cøøa maal bäät kïdi baŋ Wuuö Jwøk; kanymør løny jïra ki man dee gïn mo tïïa tïïö mo wëënna bääyö maru.»
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the Lord; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe adøø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Wui Awuuö Jwøk, jøøgø abääyö ki bääyö mo dwøŋ døc kiree, ni tïïge ki juu ma warkey kiper dëëtge.
english: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ni näk løny, beerra man wëënnï bääyö marge; 'ba ni näk mo ba løny, akwaya ïïni nee nyeŋŋa raanynyï yi wëëlö mana näk nyeŋ jiyï iï göör yie.»
english: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin―; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Ŋata näk obääyö dëëra beeye noo nyeŋŋe raanynya yi wëëlö mara.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ciï ni bwødhï jø Icriel kanya näk yaa caanø jïrï. Ka adïëri møn, nyïïatwiel maal mara ojääŋŋa nyïmï; 'ba kanyo tïme na kar ŋøl luup, kar kaaca nø bääyö marge oŋøla bäätge.»
english: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk gïï mo leth ajääŋŋe bäät jø Icriel kiper gïna tïïcge na wøørge gïna näk caala nyirøøa mana tieŋ Aranni.
english: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe, ni «Aayu kany, ni beeye ïïni ki jøøgø na kälï wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep yøø; ni cou yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jï Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap, na kööa, ni ‹Ŋöömö manøgø cïba cïbö jï nyïïkwaayu.›
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal ojääŋŋa nyïmï, ni riemma jø Keenan, ki jø Amör, ki jø Këth, ki jø Përec, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc.
english: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

anywaa: Cou yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie; 'ba kiper mana näk uuna jiy mo wïthu teek, a ba cäädhi na aciel ki uuni, nou ba thööra øtjöö.»
english: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi na wïnyge luup moøgø na reyø yøø, cwïnyge apädhö døc, ni bäŋe dhaanhø dïge mo jap mïërö moe ee kïth dëëre.
english: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

anywaa: Gïnögø atïïcge kiper Wuuö Jwøk onø cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe, ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Uuna jiy mo wïthu teek; ni näk mo aano cäädhö na aciel ki uuni këël kany mo thiinh jaak, u puta ka thöör. 'Ba ennø, kälu jap mïërö mou wøk dëëtu; køøre nø, gïno tïïa kiperu løny man ŋääa gø.› »
english: For the Lord had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel dëëtge aputge loony ni kärge jap mïërö moge dwøk dëëtge këët, ki mana täkge ki ri Kïn Körëp.
english: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe da oduŋkaara mo wø gure wøk ŋää twïër, ni kare bäär mëëth ki twïër, ni cwøl gø no oduŋkaany røømmø. Ni kany wø tïme ni da ŋat mo manynya Wuuö Jwøk, eni cøøa wøk kanya en oduŋkaany røømmø yie ŋää twïër.
english: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the Lord went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme ni Modhe manynya ci yo oduŋkaany røømmø, jiy bëët puta ö maal ni cuŋge, ni ŋati man nø ena dho oduŋkaara mare, ni nyeŋge ege tee ri Modhe këël mano døny yo oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni kany wø døny Modhe yo oduŋkaany røømmø, pöölö puta ö piny, ni cuŋŋe dho oduŋkaara; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put cäänö ki Modhe.
english: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the Lord talked with Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö jiyi wø jootge pöölö ni cuŋŋö dho oduŋkaara, jiy bëët puta ö maal ni wøørge nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋati man nø ena dho oduŋkaara mare.
english: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki Modhe ni løøŋge dhøkge ki gø, kaawat man wø cään dhaanhe ki nyawatge jaak. 'Ba kany wø duu Modhe twïër, ŋat tïïc mare ma nyen mo poot na wøp, na näk Jøcua o Nun, ree bäŋ wø daae yo oduŋkaara kaace.
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Neenï, ïïna köö ki aani, ni ‹Bwøth jøøgø.› 'Ba ïïni ŋato jääŋŋï ki aani kärï caanø jïra. Ni cäŋï köö ki aani thuwø, ni ‹Ï yaa nø ŋäc døc, ni yia met ki ïïni.›
english: And Moses said unto the Lord, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ni näk mo yiï met ki aani møn, a kwaya ïïni ki man nyoothï acaara marï jïra, naa bëëda niï ŋääa, ni putï bëëtö ni yiï met ki aani. Ni caarï wïïï thuwø ki wï jur manøgø, ni ŋäyï gø ni beege jiy moï.»
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Aano cäädhi ki ïïni ciel, ni mooa ïïni ki jwömö.»
english: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, «Ni näk miï ba aay ki waani ciel, kär wa wëëk wääth kany.
english: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk miï ba aay ki waani, oŋääi nidïï ni yiï met ki aani ki jøøi na näk jiyï ii, ni waana jiy mo wa ena kur keerwa dï jiy moa en bäät piny bëët?»
english: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Aani gïna cäänï kipere enøgø tïïa tïïö møn; kiper yia met ki ïïni, ni ï yaa nø ŋäc cøøn.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, «Wui, Awuuö Jwøk, akwaya ïïni, nyooth ajiem marï jïra.»
english: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Aani ki dëëra kiree mara na beer tïïa tïïö nee pöödhe ki nyïmï, ni køba gïr nyeŋŋa nyïmï, a na Wuuö Jwøk; kiper met ec mara wø nyoodha nyoodhø jï ŋato kööa ni yia met ki gø, ni nyoodha bäth ec mara jï ŋato kööa ni bäth ec mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïre.»
english: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the Lord before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö, ni «Ïïni täärnyïma ba løny ki man neenï gø, kiper ŋat maa ee neenø jaak ba cäŋ bëëtö ni kwøw këët.»
english: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Neenï, da kany mo ena buuta, ni løny jïrï ki man cuŋŋï bäät kïdi kaace;
english: And the Lord said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:

anywaa: ni kany wø tïme na ajiem mara pöönhnhö ki kaagø, ïïno kïtha yi kään kïdi ni uuma ïïni ki cera këël mano pöödha ki kaagø.
english: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:

anywaa: Køøre nø, cera oläwa käl wøk, ni tïme niï neena dïŋääa; 'ba täärnyïma ba doo neenø ennø.»
