english: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Tööï ko opäp kïte ariiø mo caala moa dïkwøŋ, nee luup moa en bäät opäp kïte moa dïkwøŋ na gøøï piny na tøyø nee gööra bäät opäp kïte moøgø.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.

anywaa: Jiiŋ riï, ni ööï maal bäät Kïn Caynay diøø ka amöölla, ni koorï aani bäät kïdi kaace.
english: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee dhaanhø mo ö bäät kïdi ki ïïni, ni kär dee dhaanhø mo joot bäät kïdi kaagø bäre; këël pïïth dïëk wala dhäk, kär dee gø mo kööl tier kïdi manøgø.»
english: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tööe ko opäp kïte ariiø mo caala moa dïkwøŋ, ni päny maal ka amöölla cøøn ni ci bäät Kïn Caynay, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni, ni aae no opäp kïte di käärö ki cere.
english: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aö piny ni ena yi pöölö, ni cuŋŋe kaace buut Modhe, ni køp gïr nyeŋŋe na näk Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre eni na Wuuö Jwøk apöödhö ki nyïm Modhe, ni cäänö, ni «Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa näk yie bäth ni wø nyooth met ec mare jï jiy, ni wø ba laar wëër, ni mëëye ni wø ba jøøl päl, na adïëri mare okadhø;
english: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

anywaa: ni beeye wø gwøk mëëye ni wø ba jøøl kiper jiy ma kum kum, ni ŋat mo obääyö, ki ŋat adhala, ki ŋat mo otïïö ki gïï mo reyø di wëënnö; 'ba ŋat raay poot ba wiie ka ajäla, ni raay moa tïïc wëëe poot di coolø dëët obwöre moge ki nyïïkwaacge, këël mano pïïe dää beenhnhe wala ŋweer beenhnhe.»
english: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put cøŋŋe këël piny ni wøør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Wui Kwäärö, ennø, ni näk mo yiï met ki aani, a kwaya ïïni niï cäädhï ki waani na aciel, këël na bëët jøøgø ni gena jiy mo wïthge teek. Wëën bääyö marwa ki gïïa reyø na tïïcwa, ni käärï wa ni waana jiyï.»
english: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ennø, a tudö ki luubö ki uuni. 'Ba gïï mo rëëma ec mo poot kära tïïö bäät piny cøøn, wala dï jur mo ena bäät piny kany, tïïa tïïö nyïm jiyï bëët. Ni ö jiyi bëët moø ni bëëdï dïge yøø ni jootge tïïc mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk; kiper gïno tïïa buutï enø beeye gïn mo kännö ki lwär mo päl døc.
english: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the Lord: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.

anywaa: Gwøk gïn ni köömma ïïni ki gø dïcäŋi en. Ka adïëri møn, jø Amör, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Përec, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc riema wøk nyïmï.
english: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

anywaa: Gwøk riï ki man ba tudï ki luubö ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmo ciï yie, kiper nee ba tïme na gïn mo caala abïëp dïïu.
english: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tïïyu beeye ki man raanynyu gïï wø cïpge olämme moge bäätge, ni tøgu kïte moa näk ege cwöth piny kiper nee lamge, ni ŋødu jenni moge piny moa näk ege tieŋø ni wø lamge.
english: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

anywaa: Kär dee jwøk mør jaak mo lammu, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, na näk nyeŋŋa Këëny, aana Jwøk ma akëëyö møn.
english: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:

anywaa: «Käru tudö ki luubö ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmöce; kiper ni näk mo uuno tudö ki luubö ki geni, kanyo bëëtge ni ge tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ni cwïnyge ena køør juu moge, ni cïpge ko olämme jï juu moge, u cwølge cwølø ki man cämu ki ge ko olämme moo cïpge.
english: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk nyïïge you nywømø jï wäätu nee tïmge na määrge, kanyo bëët nyïïge moøgø ni ge tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ni cwïnyge ena køør juu moge, wäätu bwøthge bwødhø ki øtjöörögø ni tïïcge teeŋ tïïc manøgø.
english: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.

anywaa: «Kär dëëtu tïnynyu ki kït gïrpiny mo oleenyø na jwøk.
english: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

anywaa: «Ajwöm Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø dou gwøø. U doo cämö ki nïne abïriiø ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, kaawat mana köömma uuni. 'Ba møgøgø wär cammu kanya no owäŋŋö yi dwääna cwøl na Abip; kiper dwäänögø na cwøl na Abip enø, beeye dwääna ööu wøk yie ki Ijep.
english: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.

anywaa: «Kaai moa näk cwøw bëët moo lwaarø ki ge beege 'moa; këël kaai mo lääc paac mou bëët moa näk thwönhi poot na 'moa thuwø, ni beege kaai mo dhäk ki mo dïëk.
english: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

anywaa: 'Ba kaa mo mar arëën jaak dou wiilø ki nyidiel, 'ba ni näk mo ba wiillu, ŋute dou meenø. 'Ba kaai mo jiy na näk wäätu wär wïïlu wøk. Køøre thuwø, kär dee ŋat mo ö nyïma ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

anywaa: «U doo tïïö ki nïne abïciel, 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne, u doo jwöm; këël køp ni beeye kar puur wala kar kac caammi, rou dou jwömö.
english: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.

anywaa: «Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Køør Juu Abïriiø, man wø wøør ki muuce mo caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek, ka Ajwöm Thum Kac mar aŋuun cwiir, dou wøørø.
english: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.

anywaa: Kwöre adäk ki yi cwiir cooth cwøw mou bëët doo ööa nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel.
english: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper aani juurre riema wøk nyïmmu, ni nyaaa nyeŋ keee mou, ni tïïa ŋöömö maru ni päl. 'Ba kany wø ööu nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, kwöre moøgø na adäk yøø ki yi cwiir, bäŋ dhaanhø mo cädö ki man mac ŋöömö maru.
english: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.

anywaa: «Olämi man wø ŋaal ni wø remme cïpu jïra, kär cïpu na aciel ki møø mo ree da thømmø. Olämi mana jiiŋŋi kiper cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie enø, kär dee gø mo weyu ree mo këët amöölla.
english: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

anywaa: «Thwöth caammi moa beyø moo kwøŋ ciek dïkwøŋ yïth pwöth mou, dou kïtha yi øda, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. «Kär nyidiel thaallu ki caa menni.»
english: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Göör luupögø piny, kiper ki køør luupögø yøø, aana nø tudö ki luubö ki ïïni ki jø Icriel.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put bëëtö kaace buut Wuuö Jwøk ki cääŋŋe ma pïëraŋween ki wärre ma pïëraŋween; ni bäŋ gïn mo ee camø, wala pïï mo ee maadhø. Ni göör luup moa tuut, na näk ciik moa näk apaar, bäät opäp kïte.
english: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Modhe ööa piny ki bäät Kïn Caynay no opäp kïte karge riet moa näk ciik ogöör bäätge ena cere, ni eni ööa piny ki bäät kïdi, eni na Modhe enø kuue ni täärnyïme bëëdö no orieny kiper mana cääne ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Aranni ki jø Icriel bëët na jootge Modhe, aneenge møn ni täärnyïme orieny, ni putge lwäyö ki man nyänhge buute.
english: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

anywaa: Køøre gena cwøl Modhe, ni ö Aranni ki jiy bëët moa näk dïbwöthe ni duuge baŋ Modhe; ni ö eni ni put cäänö ki geni.
english: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, jø Icriel bëët anyänhnhö, ni cem geni ki man tïïcge jammi bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre bäät Kïn Caynay.
english: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na lønye ki cäänö ki ge, täärnyïme aput rïëp ka abïï.
english: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ci Modhe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk nee cääne ki gø, abïï wø käle wøk täärnyïme këël mano duu wøk. Ni kany wø duu wøk ni caana luup jï jø Icriel moa köömmi ki ge,
english: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.

anywaa: jø Icriel täärnyïm Modhe wø jootge joodø no orieny. Ni ö Modhe ni dwøk abïï täärnyïme këël mano cäŋ ci nyïm Wuuö Jwøk nee cääne ki gø.
english: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the veil upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe lwaa Icriel bäre acooŋ kanya ciel ni kööe jïge, ni «Gïï ii beege gïïa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm uuni ki ge nee tïïyu.
english: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the Lord hath commanded, that ye should do them.

anywaa: Tïïe doo tïïö ki nïne abïciel, 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne beeye cäŋ mo ena kur keere jïïu, ni beeye cäŋ jwömö man jwömmu rou yie, na cäŋ jwömö jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ŋat mo tïïö jaak ki cäŋ jwömö, ka adïëri møn, wär thøøe.
english: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the Lord: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.

anywaa: Kär dee mäc mo liel kwör bëëte mou ki cäŋ jwömö.»
english: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acäänö ki lwaa Icriel bäre, ni kööe, ni «Gïn en beeye gïna cem Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö,
english: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord commanded, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Cïpu ki muuce jï Wuuö Jwøk; ŋato yie met ki man cïpe ki muuy ki cwïnye bäre, beerra man käl gø na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni muuce moøgø beege warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël;
english: Take ye from among you an offering unto the Lord: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the Lord; gold, and silver, and brass,

anywaa: ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ki jïëc dïëk ma atëëe;
english: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,

anywaa: ki pëët nyöök rööm mo otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ki pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta;
english: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,

anywaa: ki maar lamba, ki gïï wø ŋwääi ni met kiper nee jääp ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïï wø waaŋ wø jïye ŋwääi ni met;
english: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

anywaa: ki nyeŋ kïte moa cwøl ni cöyammi na näk kïte mo perge leth, ki teeŋ nyeŋ kïte møøk thuwø mo perge leth, kiper nee kïth dëër abïïna cwøl ni ëëput ka abïï käw ni wø käär Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

anywaa: « ‹Beerra man ö jiyi bëët moa nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc dïïu ni öge, ni tïïcge jammi bëët moa cem Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc;
english: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the Lord hath commanded;

anywaa: ni beeye oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki rëëpe moe, ki nywïëny moe mo dhøkge ogønø, ko opämi moe, ki jenni moe mo caala läämme, ki cööthe moe, ki gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge moe;
english: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

anywaa: ka acanduk ki jer tëër moe, ki rëëbi mar acanduk manøgø, na näk beeye nyuudhi mar wëën raay, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø;
english: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the veil of the covering,

anywaa: ki tharabëëta ki jer tëër moe, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki muunni moa näk nyuuthe;
english: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte thuwø kiper tar man wø liel, ki jap tïïc moe, ki lambae, ki maar lamba;
english: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

anywaa: ki gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte ki jer tëër moe, ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïn wø waaŋ ni wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ka abïï mana näk mar gëëŋ kiper dho oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk;
english: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bääte, ki gïna näk otïïö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël ni keda oŋana, ki jer tëër moe, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet ki gïn wø cïbi bäät gø;
english: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

anywaa: ka abïïe mo wø lïër na kal, ki jer kal ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ka abïï mo mar gëëŋ kiper dhi kal;
english: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,

anywaa: ki dïnööy mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki dïnööy mo kal, ki thøøli moge;
english: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,

anywaa: ka abïïe moa näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ kiper tïï dïlämme kanya en kur keere, ni beege abïïe moa en kur keerge kiper Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka abïïe mo wääte, kiper tïïc marge mar dïlämme.› »
english: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa Icriel bäre aput aay buut Modhe.
english: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët moa näk cwïnyge ojïëy ni yïthge met ki man cïpge muuce ki cwïnyge bäre, ni öge ni putge cïpö ki muuce jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper tïïc mar oduŋkaany røømmø ki jap tïïe mo yie bëët, ki jap tïïe mo abïïe moa en kur keerge.
english: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the Lord's offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët moa yïthge met ki man cïpge ki muuce ki cwïnyge bäre, ni beege cwøw ki mään bëët, gena put cïpö ki jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey, ni beege warkey mo cwägi, ki gwet ïdhi, ki gwet lweedi, ko oguudi mo ceŋ; ni ö jøøgø bëët ni cïpge muuce mo warkey moøgø jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø dëët jiy bëët moa näk jïge da waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ki jïëc dïëk ma atëëe, ki pëët nyöök rööm mo otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ki pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni kälge ge.
english: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø dëët jiy moa näk yïthge met ki man cïpge ki muuce ma gwel-bïrö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni putge ge cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö ŋata näk jïre da jaadha cwøl ni cïta ni cïp gø kiper tïïe moa no omanynyø.
english: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the Lord's offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.

anywaa: Ni ö määnni bëët moa nyeŋge reegø ki tïï weny waare, ni wïnyge ki waare, ni cïpge waare moa näk ege wenyø yøø na näk kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

anywaa: Ni ö määnni bëët moa näk cwïnyge ojïëy ni nyeŋge reegø ki tïï weny waare, ni wenyge jïëc dïëk moa näk atëëe.
english: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa näk dïbwöthe ni känge ki nyeŋ kïte moa cwøl ni cöyammi na näk kïte mo perge leth, ki nyeŋ kïte møøk thuwø mo perge leth, kiper nee kïth dëër abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, ka abïï käw.
english: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;

anywaa: Ni känge ki gïï wø ŋwääi ni met, ki maaw kiper maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïï wø waaŋ wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ki maar lamba.
english: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään bëët, na näk yïthge met ki man cïpge ki muuce mo jap tïïc bëët ki cwïnyge bäre, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe nee tïïe, muuce moge aputge cïp ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the Lord, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the Lord had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Neennu, Wuuö Jwøk, Bacaliil wär Uri na näk nyikwaar Ur, na en ri tuuŋ Juuda, ajiere.
english: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the Lord hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;

anywaa: Ni mooc gø ki Jwïëc Jwøk, nee jïte ki leec wïc, ki riek waŋ man ŋäc acaara, ki riek waŋ man kwany jammi ki man ŋäc teeŋ tïïe bëët;
english: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

anywaa: ni løny jïre ki man cäde ni nyøth tïï warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël,
english: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

anywaa: ki tïï tieŋ nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth mo wø kïth yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge, ki tïï tieŋ jenni, nee lønye jïre ki man cäde ni tïïc teeŋ tïïe bëët ki riek waŋ.
english: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk thuwø Bacaliil, ko Oliyap wär Aycamak, na käl ri tuuŋ Daan, ee mooø ka acaara ki man nyøthge jïëth tïïe jï jiy møøk.
english: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

anywaa: Ni tïïc geni na jiy mo nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, ki man ŋäcge teeŋ tïïe bëët, kaamar tïï rëëmmö, ki tïï ŋat wø nyøth tïïe, ki tïï ŋat wø cwääö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ki tïï ŋat wø cwääö ka abïïe; ni gena jiy mo tïïe bëët ka acaare mo wø nyøth tïïe ki ge ŋäcge.
english: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.

anywaa: «'Ba Bacaliil ko Oliyap, ki jiy bëët moa näk nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, na näk omooc Wuuö Jwøki ki riek waŋ ka acaara ki man ŋäcge jïëdhi mo tïïe bëët moa dege tïïö kiper oduŋkaara na näk kanya en kur keere, tïïe moøgø wär putge tïïc na karge ki køør mana cemi ya Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the Lord put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the Lord had commanded.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe Bacaliil ko Oliyap, ki jiy bëët moa nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, na näk omooc Wuuö Jwøki ki riek waŋ, acwøle nee öge nee tïïc manøgø tïïcge, ni beege jiy bëët moa näk cwïnyge ojïëy.
english: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the Lord had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni lwørge jammi bëët baŋ Modhe, ni beege muuce moa cïp jø Icrielli nee oduŋkaara na näk kanya en kur keere tïïc ki ge. 'Ba jø Icriel ge poot kännö jï Modhe ki muuce mo wø cïp ki met ec ka amöölla man nø cooth.
english: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy bëët moa näk nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc, na näk tïï kanya en kur keere ege nø täk, gena öö, ni ŋati man nø käla baŋ tïïc mana tïïe;
english: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;

anywaa: ni köge jï Modhe, ni «Jiy akännö ki jammi mo thööth døc ni kaala jammi moa doo manynyø kiper tïïc mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm waani ki gø ni tïïcwa.»
english: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the Lord commanded to make.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe ajäägö ki dwøl; ni ö awaaci ni gøøi piny dï twïër bäre, ni køp, ni «Kär dee dhaanhø ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø mo känni ki muuce këët kiper tïïc mar oduŋkaara na näk kanya en kur keere.» Ni ö jiyi ni putge mänö nee ba känge ki muuce këët.
english: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.

anywaa: Kiper jammi moa no okwøŋ kälö atïmö no orømø ni kaala moa doo manynyø kiper tïïe bëët moo tïïc.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët moa nyeŋge reegø ki tïïe na en røk jø tïïc kaagø, oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge ka abïïe apaar, mo tïïc ka waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar; ni dëëtge da kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar abïï man nø beeye gööye ma pïërariiø ka abära, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye aŋween. 'Ba abïïe bëët otïïö ni gööye moge röömi.
english: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni kwøcge abïïe moa näk abïïc na abïï aciel, ni kwøcge abïïc møga na abïï aciel thuwø.
english: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.

anywaa: Køøre deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ akïthge ki waare mo odølø mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ni kïthge deŋ abïï maya thuwø ki waare mo odølø ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

anywaa: Ni waare moa no odølø na kïthge deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ beege pïërabïïc, ni moa kïthge deŋ maya thuwø beege waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc. 'Ba waare moa no odølø na kïthge deŋ abïïe moøgø atïïcge ni man nø dïët ki maya.
english: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki nywïëny mo tïïc ka warkey mo dhøkge ogønø ma pïërabïïc, ni kïthge geni yïthakic waare moa no odølø ni kuupge abïïe moa näk ariiø ki geni, ni put oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk nëënnö na gïrpiny aciel.
english: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø atïïö ka abïïe mo tïïc ka jïëc dïëk ma atëëe kiper nee rïëp bäät oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk; ni tïïcge abïïe moøgø na apaar kurciel.
english: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar abïï man nø beeye gööye ma pïëradäk, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye aŋween. 'Ba abïïe moøgø na apaar kurciel yøø otïïö ni gööye moge röömi.
english: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.

anywaa: Ni kwøcge abïïe moa näk abïïc kur keerge, ni kwøcge moa dööŋ na näk abïciel kur keerge.
english: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø deŋ abïï mana dïkwøŋ akïthge ki waare mo odølø ma pïërabïïc, ni kïthge deŋ maya thuwø ki waare ma pïërabïïc mo odølø.
english: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki nywïëny ma pïërabïïc mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo dhøkge ogønø, ni kïthge geni yïthakic waare moa no odølø, ni kuupge abïïe ni tïme na rëëbi aciel.
english: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki rëëbi kipere mo tïïc ka pëët nyöök rööm mo otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ni tïïge ki rëëbi mør thuwø mo kïth bääte maal mo tïïc ka pëët lääy mo onyøŋø.
english: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïïö ko opämi mo jaadha cwøl ni cïta kiper oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpge ge piny ni cuŋŋö.
english: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar opäm man nø beeye rumme apaar, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.

anywaa: 'Ba ro opäm man nø atïïcge ni da tiel ariiø mo løny ki man kuup opämi ki ge. Køøre opämi bëët mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge ki jöö manøgø.
english: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ko opämi ma pïërariiø kiper jï løø tier-piny mar oduŋkaara.
english: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïëraŋween mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö kiper nee opämi moa näk pïërariiø yøø cwöth yïthge, ni gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ariiø moi nø ena tier opäm man nø kiper tiete na näk ariiø.
english: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïïö ko opämi ma pïërariiø thuwø kiper jï løø wï-piny mar oduŋkaara,
english: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,

anywaa: ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïëraŋween mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ni gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ariiø moi nø ena tier opäm man nø.
english: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ko opämi abïciel kiper ŋää oduŋkaara na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ko opämi ariiø kiper gøøde moa en ŋää oduŋkaara.
english: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

anywaa: Ni ö opämi mo gøøt ni kuup geni ni tägi ka tiere piny këël mana këët røk oguudi moa en maal. Ni ö opämi mo gøøde karge riet ni tïïcge ge ki jöö manøgø.
english: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään opämi moa en ŋää oduŋkaara beege abära, no opäm man nø jïre da gïï wø cwöth tiete yïthge ariiø mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ni gïï wø cwöth tiet opämi yïthge bëët beege apaar ka abïciel.
english: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïïö ki jenni mo caala läämme ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni beege abïïc kiper opämi moa en løø oduŋkaara løøi,
english: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

anywaa: ka abïïc kiper opämi moa en løø oduŋkaara løøga, ka abïïc møøk kiper opämi moa en ŋää oduŋkaara na en jï løø kur pänhcäŋ.
english: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.

anywaa: Ni ö läämmö mana en dïër ni tïïcge gø ni di rwaagø ki teegø man këël mano këët teegø maya, no opämi maae ki dïge.
english: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

anywaa: 'Ba geni dëët opämi alëënyge ki warkey; ni tïïge ko oguudi mo warkey kiperge, ni tïmge na mäge kiper jenni moa näk caala läämme, ni leenyge warkey dëët jenni moøgø.
english: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø gena tïïö ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø, ni tïïcge ka waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni tïïcge dëër gø ni da kït nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And he made a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki cööthe aŋween ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta kiper abïï mar gëëŋ manøgø, ni lëënyge dëët cööthe moøgø ki warkey, ni da nywïëny moge mo ogøn mo tïïc ka warkey; ni tïïge ki gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge ki gwel-bïrö kiper cööthe moøgø.
english: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ka abïï mo mar gëëŋ kiper dho oduŋkaara, ni cwääcge gø ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki cööthe abïïc, ki nywïëny moge mo ogøn kiper abïï mar gëëŋ manøgø, ni lëënyge wïth cööthe moøgø ki dëët gïï omäk piny ki ge ki warkey; 'ba gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge moa näk abïïc beege gïï mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Bacaliil acanduk atïïe ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta; ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme ariiø ki thääŋö, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:

anywaa: Ni leeny warkey mana tøŋ yie ki ŋääe wøk, ni jiiŋ deŋŋe bäre ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.

anywaa: Ni thïïe ko oguudi aŋween mo warkey kiper acanduk, ni kïth ge tiete karge ŋweeri; no oguudi ariiø ena løøk aciel man, no oguudi ariiø møga ena løøk maya.
english: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki jer tëër ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni lëëny dëëtge ki warkey.
english: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

anywaa: Ni rwaak jer tëër moøgø yïth oguudi moa en ra acanduk løøi ki løøi, na acanduk bielli ki ge.
english: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

anywaa: Ni tïïc rëëbi mar acanduk manøgø ki warkey mana tøŋ, ni beeye rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay; ni bär mare beeye rumme ariiø ki thääŋö, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

anywaa: Ni thädhe ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli ni tïïc ka warkey, ni ena bäät rëëbi mar acanduk mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, na aciel man nø ena ya aŋuun rëëbi manøgø.
english: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;

anywaa: Ni tïïc ge no ogääbö na aciel ki rëëbi, ni kirubël aciel ena ya aŋuun rëëbi man, ni kirubël maya ena ya aŋuunne maya.
english: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

anywaa: Ni put kirubëlli bëëdö ni bwöpge ege tïŋ maalø ni ege peerø, ni rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay ege uumö ki bwöpge ni ge neeta nyeŋge; ni ge bëëdö ni wïthge ege kuul bäät rëëbi.
english: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil tharabëëta atïïe ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme ariiø, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumi aciel ki thääŋö, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:

anywaa: Ni leeny warkey mana tøŋ dëër gø, ni jiiŋ deŋ gø bäre ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.

anywaa: Ni tïïc tharabëëta ni da kwör mo ee wëënnö deŋŋe, ni lweedi mo cenø moa näk aŋween røma yie; ni jiiŋ deŋŋe bäre kwöra näk ee wëënnö ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ko oguudi aŋween kiper tharabëëta, ni kïth oguudi moøgø deŋŋe kwöra en tiete yïthge na näk aŋween.
english: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.

anywaa: Ni tïïc oguudi ni karge cään ki kwöra näk ee wëënnö deŋ tharabëëta, ni tïmge na gïï mak jer tëër mo wø biel tharabëëta ki ge.
english: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jer tëër moøgø ki ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni leeny warkey dëëtge, ni putge tïmö na gïï biel tharabëëta ki ge.
english: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jammi bëët mo wø bëëdö bäät tharabëëta ki warkey mana tøŋ; ni beege cäänne ka apät ko ogubääye ki kuure na näk mo thïïö ki jëëthe.
english: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte atïïe ki warkey mana tøŋ. Ni tïïc gø ni di thäädhö ni tägi ka tiere këël mana këët ri tuge; ni tïïc gïïa no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk røk tuge no ogääbö na aciel ki gø bäre.
english: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

anywaa: 'Ba tuk gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte manøgø beege abïciel, ni tuŋi adäk ena løøi, ni tuŋi adäk møga ena løøe løøga.
english: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:

anywaa: Ni ö gïïa no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö ni keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk ni tïïc ge na adäk ri tuuŋ aciel man nø røk tuŋi moa näk abïciel na en ri gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte.
english: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.

anywaa: 'Ba dëër gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte da gïï mo ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö mo keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk ma aŋween thuwø;
english: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:

anywaa: ni teeŋ gïnögø aciel ee tïïö røk tuŋi piny moa dïkwøŋ na näk okuurö na aciel, ni tïïe ki teeŋ gïnögø mør røk riet tuŋi piny, ki teeŋ gïnögø mør thuwø røk dää tuŋi piny, ni tïïe kiper tuŋi moøgø na abïciel bëët yøø na en ri gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte.
english: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.

anywaa: 'Ba tuge ki gïïa no ojiiŋŋø ni mïërö yøø keda wïth jenni mo oŋøøk, atïïe ni ee gääbö na aciel ki dëër gø bäre. Ni thääth dëër gø bäre na gïrpiny aciel, ni tïïe ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

anywaa: Ni ö lambae abïriiø moe, ki gïï wø 'näk mäc moge ki ge, ki cäänne moge, ni tïïc ge ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte ki jape bëët atïïe ki warkey mana tøŋ mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar.
english: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte atïïe ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta; ni bär mar deŋŋe beeye rumi aciel, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi aciel, ni deŋŋe karge ŋweeri röömi; ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumme ariiø, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø. Ni tïïc wïth deŋŋe maal karge ŋweeri ni da gïï mo caala tuŋi, ni ee gääbö na aciel ki dëër gø bäre.
english: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.

anywaa: 'Ba bääte maal, ki bute ki deŋŋe bäre, ki gïïa no otïïö ni caala tuŋi, alëënynye ki warkey mana tøŋ. Ni tïïc deŋ gø bäre ni mïërö ki warkey ni caala aduda.
english: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.

anywaa: Ni thïïe ko oguudi ariiø mo warkey, ni kïth ge deŋ gïna näk caala tharabëëta kwöra no otïïö ni mïërö jï piny, ni ena bute karge riet na näk dïët, na gïï mak jer tëër mo biel gïna näk caala tharabëëta ki ge.
english: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jer tëër moøgø ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni lëëny dëëtge ki warkey.
english: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.

anywaa: Ni tïïc maar rööny man wø judö ki gø mo ena kur keere; ni tïïc gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met thuwø no otïïö na kare, ni tïïc ka teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni met, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil gïn wø cïp olämme bääte atïïe ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta; ni bär mare ki deŋŋe beeye rumme abïïc, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumme abïïc, ni deŋŋe karge ŋweeri röömi, ni bär mare ki piny beeye rumme adäk, ni rumme moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki gïï mo caala tuŋi mo ena maal wïth deŋŋe karge ŋweeri, ni tuŋi moøgø ee gääbö na aciel ki dëër gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni lëëny dëër gø bäre ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jap gïn wø cïp olämme bääte bëët ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni beege dääe moe mo wø jøøp bur yïthge, ka akaape, ki cäänne, ki gïï wø lääm rïŋ wøk ki ge, ka athääk jwëëlli mo wø käär mäc ki ge.
english: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basins, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki gïn mo keda oŋana kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø, ni tïïe ka nywïënyö ma jwïël no okatø ni caala ajääp, ni ena yi gïn wø cïp olämme bääte no onyiik piny mëëth dïëre ni ena tier gïna no opööth wøk ki deŋŋe.
english: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

anywaa: Ni thïïe ko oguudi aŋween ni kïth ge dëër gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ena deŋ gïna näk keda oŋana karge ŋweeri na no otïïö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël enø, nee tïmge na gïï mak jer tëër.
english: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

anywaa: Ni jer tëër moøgø tïïe ka ri jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni lëëny dëëtge ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jer tëër moøgø ni di rwaagø ki yïth oguudi moa en buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø, kiper kany wø tïme ni di käärö nee bielli ki ge. 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø ee tïïö ko opämi, ni yi gø ee wiiø ni ŋaam.
english: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil gïr lwøk mo caala thecet ki gïre man wø cïbi bäät gø atïïe ki nywïënyö ma jwïël mana näk cïläälcae mo wø neen dëël ki ge mo määr wø tïïö dho oduŋkaany røømmø mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Køøre Bacaliil kal atïïe ka abïïe; ni tïïc abïï mar gëëŋ man wø lïër løø kal jï kuna en tier-piny ka abïï ma lïïna mo tar mo mïërö ma gööye ma dïpa.
english: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

anywaa: 'Ba jer kal beege pïërariiø, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïërariiø thuwø, ni ge tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni nywïëny moa no ogøn mo jer kal ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.
english: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

anywaa: Løø kal jï kuna en wï-piny thuwø otïïö ni da abïï mo olïërö mo bär mar deŋŋe beeye gööye ma dïpa, ki jer kal ma pïërariiø, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma pïërariiø, ni ge tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni nywïëny moa no ogøn mo jer kal ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.
english: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba løø kal ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ otïïö ni da abïï mo olïërö mo bär mare beeye gööye ma pïërabïïc, ki jer kal ma apaar, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma apaar thuwø; ni nywïëny moa no ogøn mo jer kal ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.
english: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba dööŋ yi kal ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ beeye rumme ma pïërabïïc, ni røm ka cenø.
english: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

anywaa: Buut dhi kal løøk aciel man otïïö ni da abïï mo olïërö mo bär mar deŋŋe beeye gööye apaar kurbïïc, ki jer kal moe ma adäk, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma adäk thuwø.
english: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

anywaa: Ni tïïc løøk maya ni da abïï mo olïërö ma gööye apaar kurbïïc, ki jer kal moe ma adäk, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma adäk thuwø.
english: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

anywaa: Abïïe bëët moa no olïërö na en deŋ kal bäre beege abïïe mo tïïc ka waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø cwöth tiet jer kal yïthge beege gïï mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni nywïëny moa no ogøn mo jer kal ki gïï wø maai piny ki ge beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö; ni wïth jer kal moøgø olëënynyö ki gwel-bïrö, ni jer kal moøgø bëët otïïö ni da gïï wø mäk piny ki ge moe mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö.
english: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï mar gëëŋ mana näk mar dhi kal ocwääö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø. Ni bär mar deŋ abïï mar gëëŋ manøgø beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni bär mare ki piny beeye gööye abïïc, no opäärö ka abïïe moa no olïërö ri kal manøgø.
english: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

anywaa: Jer kal moe beege aŋween, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge ma aŋween thuwø mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël; ni nywïëny mo jer kal moa no ogøn beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ni wïth jer kal moøgø olëënynyö ki gwel-bïrö, ni gïï wø mäk piny ki ge moe beege gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö thuwø.
english: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

anywaa: Dïnööy bëët moa näk mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa näk mo kal na en deŋŋe bäre, beege gïï mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwään jammi moa tïïc oduŋkaara ki ge, na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaara mar luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, na kwaan ki køør mana caan Modhe, ni kwaana jø tuuŋ Libay ni ge bwøtha Itamer wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

anywaa: 'Ba Bacaliil wär Uri na näk nyikwaar Ur, na en ri tuuŋ Juuda, jammi bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge atïïe.
english: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata tïïge ki gø beeye Oliyap wär Aycamak, na en ri tuuŋ Daan, na näk rëëmmö, na ŋat wø nyøth tïïe, na ŋat wø cwääö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

anywaa: 'Ba warkey bäre mana cïp na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk, na tïïö ki gø, ni tïïca oduŋkaara na en kur keere, beeye rumme ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween mar rumi mana cwøl ni kikar ki rumme ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëradäk mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ni røm na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Gwel-bïrö mana cïp jiyi moa näk cwøw moa kwany beeye rumme ma dïpa mar rumi mana cwøl ni kikar, ki rumme ma kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïriiø kurbïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ni røm na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna cïp ŋati man nø dëët jiy moa kwaan, beeye thääŋ gwelø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ni cïp no orømø na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere. Ni jiy moa näk cwøw na kwaan ni cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël wïthge, beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ka adäk ki dïpe abïïc ki pïërabïïc.
english: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

anywaa: 'Ba gwel-bïrö ma rumme ma dïpa mar rumi mana cwøl ni kikar beeye na thiew na gïï wø cwöth tiet opämi yïthge mo oduŋkaara na näk kanya en kur keere, ki cööthe mo abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø; ni gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge moge na dïpa yøø, tïïc ka gwel-bïrö ma rumme ma dïpa mar rumi mana cwøl ni kikar; ni rumi aciel man nø, orømø kiper gïn wø cwöth tielø yie aciel man nø.
english: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the veil; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

anywaa: Ni rumme mo gwet-bïrö moa näk kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïriiø kurbïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel beeye na tïïc nywïëny moa no ogøn ki gø kiper jer kal, ni leeny wïth jer kal ki gø, ni tïïe ki gïï wø mäk piny ki ge kiper jer kal ki gwel-bïrö manøgø.
english: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

anywaa: 'Ba nywïënyö mana näk jwïël na cïp na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk beeye rumme ma pïërabïriiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni kikar, ki rumme ma kume ariiø ki dïpe aŋween mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel.
english: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

anywaa: Nywïënyö manøgø na jwïël enø beeye na tïïc Bacaliilli na gïï wø cwöth tiet cööthe yïthge mo dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki gïre mana näk keda oŋana, ki jap tïïc bëët mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø,
english: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

anywaa: ki gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge mo jer kal na näk kal owïrö ki ge, ki gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge mo jer dhi kal, ki dïnööy bëët mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki dïnööy bëët mo kal na en deŋŋe bäre.
english: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

anywaa: Køøre gena cwääö ka abïïe kiper kanyo ö Aranni noo tïïc tïï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ kanya en kur keere, ni cwääcge abïïe moøgø ki riek waŋ ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ni beege abïïe mo ena kur keerge, ni cwääcge na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba abïïna cwøl ni ëëput acwääcge ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ki warkey.
english: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

anywaa: Ni warkey manøgø ege thäädhö ni reep døc, ni ŋørge gø ni caala waare, ni løny ki man cwääö ki gø no orwöbö ki waare moa näk kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø.
english: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï mana cwøl ni ëëput, røk gööge karge riet atïïcge ni da gïï ma ariiø mo gääba gø ki kwöra näk da gööge.
english: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

anywaa: Ni ö kaw mar abïï man wø twöö abïïna cwøl ni ëëput piny ki gø ni puti cwääc ki riek waŋ ni caala ëëput; ni cwääc ka cwääc ka teeŋ gïïa cwääc ëëput ki ge, ni beege warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, no ocwääö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre kïte moa cwøl ni cöyammi na näk kïte mo perge leth atïïcge, ni kïthge ge yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge mo tïïc ka warkey; ni kïte moøgø ni perge leth yøø, nyeŋ wäät Icriel ogöör bäätge.
english: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni kïthge kïte moøgø ni perge leth yøø kwöra näk da göök abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, ni putge bëëdö na kïte mo wïc di parø ki køørge kiper nyeŋ wäät Icriel na en dëëtge, ni ege tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïïö ka abïï käw, ni tïïya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, ni caala tïïc mana tïïc abïïna cwøl ni ëëput ki gø; ni tïïc ka warkey, ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö.
english: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï käw manøgø otïïö ni deŋŋe röömi bëët, no obanø na dïrïbi, ni bär mar deŋŋe beeye rumi mar yïthakic lweedi, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumi mar yïthakic lweedi thuwø no nø ban na dïrïbi.
english: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

anywaa: Ni kïthge dëër gø ki teeŋ kïte mo perge leth mo mïërö ni ege caanø na kwöre aŋween. Ni mana dïkwøŋ beeye mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo kwaar ni caala dha adhieŋ, ki mo piilli kaamar warkey, ki mo ŋwaŋŋi døc mo caala keenh-orwëëdhö;
english: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

anywaa: ni rietge beeye mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo ränni ni tøŋ, ki mo caala dïmuuy, ki mo piilli ni lïw;
english: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

anywaa: ni dääge beeye mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo caala abïcøle, ki mo caala otïït, ki mo caala dïmuur;
english: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

anywaa: ni ŋweerge beeye mar kïte moa perge leth, ni beege mo caala okwëër, ki kïdi mo pere leth mo cwøl ni cöyam, ki mo ŋwaŋŋi døc ni tøŋ keda wïlli. Ni kïte moøgø ni perge leth bëët yøø ena yïth gïï wø maai piny ki ge mo tïïc ka warkey kanya kïthge ge dëër abïï käw.
english: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

anywaa: Kïte moøgø ni perge leth yøø beege kïte apaar kurriiø, na aciel man nø nyeŋ dhaanhø aciel røk wäät Icriel ogöör bääte ni nyootha wïth tuŋi apaar kurriiø mo jø Icriel.
english: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

anywaa: Køøre dëër abïï käw akïthge ki tiimme mo caala thøøl mo owenyø, ni tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki gïï wø mäk piny ki ge ma ariiø ki warkey, ni tïïge ko oguudi ariiø mo thiiw ka warkey thuwø, ni gänge oguudi moøgø karge riet ra abïï käw røk deŋŋe moa en maal karge riet.
english: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

anywaa: Køøre tiimme moa näk ariiø yøø na näk caala thøøl mo owenyø aroopge ki yïth oguudi moa näk ariiø na en røk deŋ abïï käw.
english: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

anywaa: Ni ö dhøk tiimme møga ni roopge ge ki yïth gïïa näk ariiø ni wø mäk piny ki ge, na en røk göök abïïna cwøl ni ëëput, ni ena jï kun da nyïm en.
english: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge tïïö ko oguudi ariiø ni thiiw ka warkey, ni gänge ge ra abïï käw røk deŋŋe moa en piny, ni ena kuna en da ec mar abïïna cwøl ni ëëput.
english: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

anywaa: Køøre gena cäŋ tïïö ko oguudi ariiø møøk ni thiiw ka warkey, ni gänge ge røk ceŋ abïïna cwøl ni ëëput na en røk gööge karge riet jï piny mëëth, ni ena jï kun da nyïm en, ni kare cään ki kanya kuubi ki yie, ni ena jï maal mëëth ki kaw mar abïï man wø twöö ëëput piny ki gø na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ.
english: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï käw atwöcge ki røk oguudi moa en deŋŋe, ni twöge gø røk oguudi moa en dëër ëëput, ni twöcge ka waare mo owenyø mo kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni løny ki man bëëde ni teek ri kaw mar abïï man wø twöö ëëput piny ki gø na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ, kiper na abïï käw ba bëëde ni lwäägö kanyo en ri ëëput, ni ege tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre jalabiiya mana ciek man wø røø tier abïïna cwøl ni ëëput acwääcge bäre ni kïte caala kït abïcøle;
english: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

anywaa: ni wëënge dïëre maal ki kany mo ŋaam na kar wïc, ni cwääcge deŋŋe kanya no owiiø ni ŋaam enø ki waare ni teek kiper nee ba jeee.
english: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

anywaa: Ni kïthge deŋ jalabiiya piny ki gïï mo caala nyïïadikwäle mo otïïö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar.
english: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

anywaa: Køøre gena tïïö ki nyeŋ gare thuwø ni tïïcge ka warkey mana tøŋ, ni kïthge nyeŋ gare moøgø yïthakic waare moa no otïïö ni caala nyïïadikwäle na en deŋ jalabiiya piny bäre,
english: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

anywaa: ni ege kelø ni kany nø da waŋ gara mo tïïc ka warkey, køøre ki waare moa no otïïö ni caala nyaadikwala, këël mana wïrge deŋ jalabiiya manøgø ki piny bäre, kiper nee tïme na abïï man wø käär Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ kany wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk; ni tïïcge gø na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre jalabiiye moa bäyö atïïcge ni ege cwääö ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö kiper Aran ki wääte,
english: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

anywaa: ni tïïcge abïï man wø meen wïc ki lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni tïïcge abïïe no okwøø na cöörri mo mïërö ki lïïna mo tar mo mïërö, ni tïïcge libaae ki lïïna mo tar mo mïërö;
english: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

anywaa: ni cwääge ki kaw mar abïï ni cwääc ka waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ki ma dïmuur, ki mo kwaar; ni cwääya dhaanhe mo waŋe riek ki tïïc manøgø, ni tïïcge gø na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre gïn mo ŋwaŋŋi na näk nyuudhi mar ŋat mo ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge ki warkey mana tøŋ, ni göönge dëër gø ki gööre mo køp, ni «Eni ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Lord.

anywaa: Ni twöge gø ra abïï man wø meen wïc jï maal mëëth, ni twöcge ka waare moa no owenyø na näk kïte caala kït abïcøle; ni tïïcge gø na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø tïïe bëët mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaany røømmø, athum; no otïïc jø Icrielli na karge ki køør jammi bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge.
english: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

anywaa: Køøre oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk akälge baŋ Modhe, ni beege abïïe mo oduŋkaara ki jammi bëët moa no omanynyø kipere, na näk nywïëny moe moa näk dhøkge ogønø, ko opämi moe, ki jenni moe moa näk caala läämme, ki cööthe moe, ki gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge moe;
english: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

anywaa: ki rëëbi mana näk tïïc ka pëët nyöök rööm moa no otïïö ki kït mo kwayø, ki rëëbi maya thuwø mana näk tïïc ka pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø;
english: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the veil of the covering,

anywaa: ka acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ki jer tëër moe, ki rëëbi mar acanduk manøgø na näk beeye nyuudhi mar wëën raay;
english: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

anywaa: ki tharabëëta, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki muunni moa näk nyuuthe;
english: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte na no otïïö ki warkey mana tøŋ, ki lambae moe moa no ocïbö na karge, ki jap tïïc moe bëët, ki maar lamba;
english: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

anywaa: ki gïna näk caala tharabëëta ni wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte na näk dëëre olëënynyö ki warkey, ki maar rööny man wø judö ki gø, ki gïn wø waaŋ ni wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ka abïï mana näk mar gëëŋ kiper dho oduŋkaara;
english: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

anywaa: ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na no otïïö ni dëëre olëënynyö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki gïre mana no otïïö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël ni keda oŋana, ki jer tëër moe, ki jap tïïc moe bëët; ki gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet ki gïn wø cïbi bäät gø;
english: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

anywaa: ka abïïe mo wø lïër na kal, ki jer kal ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ka abïï mo mar gëëŋ kiper dhi kal, ki thøøli moe, ki dïnööy moe, ki jammi bëët moa manynyi na mo tïïc kiper yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaany røømmø;
english: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

anywaa: ka abïïe moa näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ kiper tïï dïlämme kanya en kur keere, ni beege abïïe moa en kur keerge kiper Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka abïïe mo wääte, kiper tïïc marge mar dïlämme.
english: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel jammi bëët ege tïïö na karge ki køør jammi bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge.
english: According to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni neet jammi bëët moa näk ege tïïö, ni joot ge na karge kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm geni ni tïïcge. Ni ö Modhe ni put ge gwïëth.
english: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as the Lord had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «Noo tïme na cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar dwääy mana dïkwøŋ, oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaany røømmø, wär gur piny.
english: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy wär kïth yie kaace, ni gëëŋï acanduk manøgø ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø.
english: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the veil.

anywaa: Ni kälï tharabëëta yo oduŋkaara, ni jiiŋŋï jammi moa en bääte na karge; ni kälï gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte yie thuwø ni jiiŋŋï lambae moe nee lielge bääte maal.
english: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

anywaa: Køøre gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, na näk dëëre olëënynyö ki warkey, wär cïpï ni dïët ka acanduk mar luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, ni lïërï abïï maal mana näk mar gëëŋ dho oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

anywaa: «Køøre gïn wø cïp olämme bääte wär cïp nyïm wøk ni dïët ki dho oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni cïbï gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet yïthakic oduŋkaany røømmø ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kïthï yie ki pïï.
english: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.

anywaa: 'Ba kal mana näk otïïö ka abïïe wär wïrï ki deŋŋe bäre, ni lïërï abïï maal mana näk mar gëëŋ dhi kal.
english: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

anywaa: «Køøre maar rööny ni wø judö ki gø wär lwørï ni jørï oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni gweelï jammi bëët moa en yie, niï tïïya gø ni ena kur keere ki jammi moe bëët, nee put tïmö no oduŋkaara mo ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

anywaa: Køøre gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki jammi moe bëët wär gweelï, niï tïïya gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø ni ena kur keere, nee put tïmö na gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo ena kur keere ni pere leth.
english: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

anywaa: Gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet ki gïre man wø cïbi bäät gø wär gweelï thuwø, niï tïïya gø ni ena kur keere.
english: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

anywaa: «Køøre nø, Aran ki wääte wär käl dho oduŋkaany røømmø ni lwøgï geni ki pïï.
english: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

anywaa: 'Ba abïïe moa en kur keerge wär røø dëër Aran, ni røønyï eni ki maar rööny, niï tïïya eni ni ena kur keere, naa tïnynye ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.

anywaa: Ni cwølï wääte ni røøï jalabiiye moa bäyö dëëtge;
english: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

anywaa: ni røønyï geni ki maar rööny ni caala mana røønyï wääge, naa tïnyge ni gena dïlämme; ni rööny marge manøgø puta geni tïïc ni gena dïlämme cooth këël yïth beenhnhe moge bëët moo ööi.»
english: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put gïïögø bëët tïïc; ni tïïe na karge kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: Thus did Moses: according to all that the Lord commanded him, so did he.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dwääy mana dïkwøŋ ri riet cwiiri, ni beeye cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar dwäänögø kiree, oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk aput gur piny.
english: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe oduŋkaara agur piny na kare, ni kïth gïï wø cwöth tiel yïthge kwörge, ni kïth opämi yïthge, ni rwaak jenni moa no otïïö ni caala läämme kwörge, ni tïïc cööthe ni cuŋŋö.
english: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni rïëp abïïe bäät oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni rïëp rëëpe møga bäät abïïe moøge maal; ni ee tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre opäp kïte moa näk ciik ogöör bäätge ni wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy alwøre ni kïth ge ya acanduk, ni kïth jer tëër dëër acanduk manøgø, ni kïth rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay bäät acanduk.
english: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni käl acanduk manøgø yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni lïër abïï maal man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø, ni gëëŋ acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ka abïï manøgø; ni ee tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre tharabëëta akïth yo oduŋkaany røømmø na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ena jï løø kuna näk da wïpiny yo oduŋkaara, ni ee cïp wøk ŋää abïï mana näk gëëŋi.
english: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the veil.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni cïp muunni moa näk nyuuthe bäät tharabëëta manøgø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni ee jiiŋŋø na kare, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he set the bread in order upon it before the Lord; as the Lord had commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte akïth yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni dïët ki tharabëëta, ni ena jï løø kuna näk da tier-piny yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni jiiŋ lambae nee lielge bäät gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kaagø, ni ee tïïö na karge kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he lighted the lamps before the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe gïna näk caala tharabëëta ni wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, na näk dëëre olëënynyö ki warkey, akïth yo oduŋkaany røømmø ni ee cïp wøk ŋää abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø;
english: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil:

anywaa: ni waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäät gø; ni ee tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe abïï mana näk gëëŋi mar dho oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk alïër maal dhi gø.
english: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni kïth gïn wø cïp olämme bääte nyïm wøk ni dïët ki dho oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, na näk oduŋkaany røømmø, ni cïp olämi man wø waaŋ bäre bäät gø, ni cïbe na aciel ki muuy mar møk beel; ni ee tïïö na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni cïp gïr lwøk na näk caala thecet yïthakic dho oduŋkaany røømmø ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kïth yi gø ki pïï na mo lwøk.
english: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ki wäät Aran ni lwøkge ceŋge ki tietge røk pïï moøgø.
english: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya dønyge yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ki kanya nyiikge buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, gena put löö, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tïïc kal mana no otïïö ka abïïe ni ee wïrö bäre ki deŋ oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni lïër abïï maal mana näk gëëŋi dhi kal. Ni ö Modhe ni put tïïe bëët thöör.
english: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

anywaa: Køøre pöölö aput öö ni uum oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö ajiem Wuuö Jwøki ni put tïmö ni päl yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö ni kär løny jï Modhe ki man døny yo oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper mana tïme ni pöölö ena bääte, na ajiem Wuuö Jwøk päl yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.

anywaa: 'Ba këël mana tïme na ri wääth marge bäre, kany wø ö pöölö wø tïŋi maal bäät oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, jø Icriel wø tïŋŋö;
english: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

anywaa: 'ba kany wø ö pööle wø poode ni kär tïŋ maal, jø Icriel ba tïŋŋi këël mano tïme na dïcäŋ mano tïŋ pöölö maal yie.
english: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

anywaa: Ni ö gïnögø ni put bëëdö ni nut ki yi wääth marge bäre, ni pöölö mar Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk ki dïcäŋ, ni tïm pöölö manøgø na maac ki wäär, ni nëënö jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: For the cloud of the Lord was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Modhe acwøle ki yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni cään gø ni kööe,
english: And the Lord called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Kany wø näk dhaanhø mo ena dïïu kännö ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk, olämi mano kälu wär tïme ni käla røk dhäk wala røk dïëk.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo olämi mare beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre mo käla røk dhäk, eni wär cïbe na rwaath mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, ni kanyo cïp gø yie beeye dho oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper nee eni jïëc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
