english: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi man wø waaŋ bäre manøgø, kiper nee olämi manøgø jïëc no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø.
english: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

anywaa: Køøre eni rwaath manøgø wär ŋaale nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö dïlämme, wäät Aran, ni lwørge remø ni kønyge gø dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And he shall kill the bullock before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Køøre eni olämi man wø waaŋ bäre manøgø wär jaaŋe ni bak gø na thäŋi.
english: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämme, wäät Aran, ni cïpge maac bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni kumge jenni bäät maac.
english: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, rïŋö kwöra bagi na thäŋi, këël ki wïc ki dwäälö, peethge peedhø na kare bäät jenni moa no oäbö bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

anywaa: Ŋata cïp olämi manøgø, ec ki tiel wär penye ki pïï. Køøre dïlämi olämi manøgø waaŋe waaŋø bäre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac man wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mar ŋatøgø käla røk rööm wala røk atëëe, no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, wär tïme ni cïbe na nywøk mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.

anywaa: Ni kanyo ŋaal gø yie beeye buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï løø wï-piny ni ŋaale nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, remø mar olämi manøgø kønyge dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.

anywaa: Ŋatøgø olämi wär bage na thäŋi, køøre dïlämi gïïögø ki wïc ki dwäälö peedhe peedhø na karge bäät jenni moa no oäbö bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:

anywaa: Ŋata cïp olämi manøgø, ec ki tiel wär penye ki pïï. Køøre dïlämi olämi manøgø bäre lwøre lwørø ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mar ŋatøgø mano cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre mo käla røk weny, eni olämi manøgø wär tïme ni lwøre røk atuuy wala røk akuyi.
english: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the Lord be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi olämi manøgø lwøre lwørø ni kïth gø buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; ni meen ŋut gø, ni cööt wï gø wøk ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; ni ö remø mare ni twiinyi piny buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni käl looŋ gø wøk ki cam mana en yie, ni wet ge ki buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni wete jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ jï løø wø wet bur yie.
english: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi bwöp gø maae maaø ni jeec gø, 'ba ba pääŋŋe ki dïëre bäre, ni ö eni na dïlämi ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, bäät jenni moa no oäbö. Ni manøgø beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø näk dhaanhø cïpö ki muuy mar møk beel, na muuy man wø cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk, muuy mare manøgø wär tïme na møø mana pøøth. Eni maaw wär køny bäät gø, ni ö gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ni cïp gø bäät gø.
english: And when any will offer a grain offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kïth muuy manøgø baŋ dïlämme, wäät Aran, ni ö dïlämi ni lwöte ri møgø pøøth enø, ni kuure ka maaw ki yi cere ni päŋ, ni dwal gø ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäre na no ocïp bäät møgøgø, ni waaŋ geni na gïr par wïc, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni waaŋŋa bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:

anywaa: Køøre thääŋ muuy mar møk beel mano dööŋ tïmö na mar Aran ki wääte, ni beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth røk muuce mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the remnant of the grain offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø kännï ki muuy mar møk beel mo odeelø no opamø mo deel ka athaa, wär näk mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre, ni beeye møø mana pøøth mo coot ka maaw; wala wär näk mo møø mo otïïö ni reep mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre mo bääte owïïrö ki maaw.
english: And if thou bring an oblation of a grain offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo muuy mar møk beel marï tïïc ni deel ka gïr deel, wär näk mo beeye møø mana pøøth mo coot ka maaw ni bäŋ thømmø dëëre.
english: And if thy oblation be a grain offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.

anywaa: Møgøgø wär pøtï ni thenh thenh ni kønynyï maaw bääte, ni beeye muuy mar møk beel.
english: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a grain offering.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo muuy mar møk beel marï tïïc ni deel ka täba, wär näk mo beeye møø mana pøøth ni coot ka maaw.
english: And if thy oblation be a grain offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

anywaa: Kany wø cïpï muuy mar møk beel marï jï Wuuö Jwøk mo tïïc ka uutjïëthe mo nëëna moøgø, wär kïth baŋ dïlämi, ni beeye ŋato kïth gø buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And thou shalt bring the grain offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni lwöte wïth muunni moa no odeelø, ni lwøre na gïr par wïc, ni waaŋ ge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall take from the grain offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre thääŋ muuy mar møk beel mano dööŋ tïmö na mar Aran ki wääte, ni beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth røk muuce mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And that which is left of the grain offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.

anywaa: « ‹Muuy mar møk beel man wø cïpï jï Wuuö Jwøk, wär näk mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre; kiper uuni, bäŋe gïn mo waaŋŋu mo ree da thømmø wala maar kïc røk olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: No grain offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.

anywaa: Møø mo ree da thømmø wala maar kïc wär cïpu no okwaan røk muuce mo caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek; 'ba geni ba waaŋ bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na gïï wø ŋwääi ni met.
english: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.

anywaa: Uuni muuce mo møk beel mou bëët wär buugu ka acäbö, kiper nee muuy mar møk beegu ba bëëde ni dëëre bäŋ acäbö, kiper acäbö nyootha gïna tuutu ki Jwøk maru; muuce bëët mo møk beel mou wär buugu ka acäbö.
english: And every oblation of thy grain offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy grain offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk miï kännö ki muuy mar beel mo wø kwøŋ ciek jï Wuuö Jwøk, wär näk miï käla abäy ma twiinye mo obulö ki maac, køøre ni ŋiinyi, ni beeye muuy mar beegï moa kwøŋ ciek.
english: And if thou offer a grain offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the grain offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.

anywaa: Køøre ïïni maaw wär køny bääte, ni cïbï gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, ni manøgø beeye muuy mar beel.
english: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a grain offering.

anywaa: Køøre nø, dïlämi lwötö ri nyeŋ moøgø no oŋiinyø yøø ni kuure ka maaw, ni dwal gø ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ni waaŋ geni na gïr par wïc, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mano cïp dhaanhe beeye olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ni cïbe røk dhäk, nee olämi manøgø beeye rwaath wala dhaagø, wär cïbe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk no olämi mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.

anywaa: Eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi mare manøgø, ni ŋaal gø dho oduŋkaany røømmø. Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, remø kønyge dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø gïïo lwøre dëër olämi manøgø man wø duunni ki mëër noo cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac, beeye räämmö na näk gïïa en ec bëët ee rïëbö, ki dwäle bëët moa en bäät gïïa en ec,
english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

anywaa: ki røgi karge riet na en wïth dïbule, ki maaw mana en bäätge, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree noo käl wøk ki røgi ciel.
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, gïïögø wär waaŋge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ege dwal bäät olämi man wø waaŋ bäre mana näk bëëdö ni waaŋ bäät jenni yi maac; ni manøgø beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mare man wø duunni ki mëër mano cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk käle ki røk dïëk, nee cïbe na nywøk wala dhaagø, wär näk mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the Lord be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo olämi mare mano cïbe beeye nyi røømmø, wär tïme ni cïbe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the Lord.

anywaa: Eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi mare manøgø, ni ŋaal gø nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø. Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, remø kønyge dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø gïïo lwøre dëër olämi manøgø man wø duunni ki mëër noo cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac, beeye maaw mare, ni beeye maaw bäre mana en jïbe, ni ŋøle ki ri cöön pïth, ki räämmö na näk gïïa en ec bëët ee rïëbö, ki dwäle bëët moa en bäät gïïa en ec,
english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

anywaa: ki røgi karge riet na en wïth dïbule, ki maaw mana en bäätge, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree noo käl wøk ki røgi ciel.
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi gïïögø wär waaŋe na cam bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mare mano cïbe beeye diel ma ateea, wär cïbe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the Lord.

anywaa: Eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi mare manøgø, ni ŋaal gø nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø. Køøre dïlämme, wäät Aran, remø mar gø kønyge dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø gïïo cïbe no olämi mare dëër olämi manøgø, no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk, beeye räämmö na näk gïïa en ec bëët ee rïëbö, ki dwäle bëët moa en bäät gïïa en ec,
english: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

anywaa: ki røgi karge riet na en wïth dïbule, ki maaw mana en bäätge, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree noo käl wøk ki røgi ciel.
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi gïïögø wär waaŋe na cam bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met. 'Ba maaw bäre beeye mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the Lord's.

anywaa: « ‹Manøgø tïmö na ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët ki yïth kwöro bëëdu yïthge bëët, nou ba doo cämö ki gïn ma maaw wala gïn ma remø.› »
english: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï, ni ‹Ni näk da dhaanhø mo obääyö, ni bääyö manøgø ba kame, ni eni bääya røk ciik moa cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kär tïïc, gïïo cari ii wär tïïe.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo dïlämi mana näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw obääyö, ni tïm jiyi no obääyö ki køøre, eni wär cïpe jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämi ma rwaath mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre ni beeye olämi mar wëën raay kiper raay moa baae.
english: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the Lord for a sin offering.

anywaa: Køøre eni rwaath manøgø käle dho oduŋkaany røømmø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö eni ni cïp cere bäät wï rwaath manøgø, ni ŋaal rwaadhøgø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nø, eni na dïlämi mana näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw, lwötö ri rem rwaadhøgø ni kïth gø yo oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: Ni ö eni na dïlämi ni cøt lweete yi remø ni ker remø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kwöre abïriiø, nyïm abïïna näk gëëŋi mar kanya en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the veil of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi thuwø ni naaŋ remø mør dëët tuk gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte na en nyïm Wuuö Jwøk yo oduŋkaany røømmø; ni ö rem rwaathi manøgø mano dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre na en dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni käl maaw wøk bäre mana en ri rwaadhøgø no olämi enø mar wëën raay, ni beeye räämmö na näk gïïa en ec ee rïëbö, ki dwäle bëët moa en bäät gïïa en ec,
english: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

anywaa: ki røgi karge riet na en wïth dïbule, ki maaw mana en bäätge, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree no okäl wøk ki røgi ciel,
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

anywaa: ni tïïe kaawat man wø käli wøk ki ri dhieŋ man wø cïp no olämi man wø duunni ki mëër; ni ö eni na dïlämi ni waaŋ gïïögø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

anywaa: 'Ba eni pïën rwaath ki rïŋŋe bäre, ki wïïe, ki tiete, ki gïïa en ec, ki weenynye moe,
english: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

anywaa: ni beeye løø rwaath bäre kuna dööŋ, kïthe wøk ŋää twïër kany mo waany, kany wø wet bur yie wøk, ni waaŋ gø ni ee cïp bäät jenni yi maac, ni waaŋe kany wø wet bur yie.
english: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanh Icriel bäre obääyö, ni ge bääya røk ciik moa cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kär tïïc, këël na näk mo gïna baacge ba nëëni jï jø acooŋa, geni ajäla ena bäätge.
english: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïm raayi moge ni ŋäc ni beeye gïna baacge, jø acooŋa wär lwötge røk dhäk ki rwaath, ni cïpge gø no olämi mar wëën raay, ni kïthge gø nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel ni cïpge ceŋge bäät wï rwaadhøgø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋaal rwaath nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the Lord: and the bullock shall be killed before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi mana näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw lwötö ri rem rwaadhøgø ni kïth gø yo oduŋkaany røømmø,
english: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: ni cøt lweete yi remø ni ker gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kwöre abïriiø, nyïm abïïna näk gëëŋi.
english: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, even before the veil.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø, eni na dïlämi, ni naaŋ remø mør dëët tuk gïna näk caala tharabëëta man wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte na en nyïm Wuuö Jwøk yo oduŋkaany røømmø; ni ö rem rwaathi manøgø mano dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre na en dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the Lord, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni käl maaw wøk bäre mana en ri rwaadhøgø ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

anywaa: Ni jöö mano ö dïlämi noo tïïc rwaadhøgø ki gø, tïïe kaawat mana kwøŋ rwaath tïïc ki gø mana cïbe no olämi kiper wëën raay moe, ni tïïe ni caala gøøni. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiperge; køøre ge di wëënnö.
english: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

anywaa: Køøre eni dëër rwaadhøgø kïthe wøk ŋää twïër ni waaŋ gø kaawat mana kwøŋ rwaath maya waaŋ; ni manøgø beeye olämi man wø cïp kiper wëën raay mar dhaanh Icriel bäre.
english: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dïbwödhi obääyö, ni bääyö manøgø ba kame, ni eni bääya røk ciik moa cem Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk mare, na caane ni kär tïïc, eni ajäla ena bääte.
english: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

anywaa: Kanyo tïm raayi moa baae ni ŋäc, eni olämi mare mano cïbe wär cïbe na nywø ateea mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

anywaa: Køøre eni cere wär cïp bäät wï nywø ateea manøgø, ni ŋaal gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kany wø ŋaal olämi man wø waaŋ bäre yie; ni manøgø beeye olämi mar wëën raay.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord: it is a sin offering.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi wär lwöte ri rem olämi manøgø na mar wëën raay enø, ni lwøre ka lweete ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre. Ni ö rem olämi manøgø mano dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïr olämme manøgø.
english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

anywaa: Ni ö maar olämi bäre ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni tïïe kaawat mana waaŋ maaw mar olämi man wø duunni ki mëër. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiper raay mo ŋatøgø; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø mo ena røk jiy jaak obääyö, ni bääyö manøgø ba kame, ni eni bääya røk ciik moa cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kär tïïc, eni ajäla ena bääte.
english: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

anywaa: Kanyo tïm raayi moa baae ni ŋäc, eni olämi mare mano cïbe kiper raay moa tïïe wär cïbe na ateea ma dhaagø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

anywaa: Køøre eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi manøgø na mar wëën raay enø, ni ŋaal olämi manøgø mar wëën raay kany wø ŋaal olämme yie mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi wär lwöte ri rem olämi manøgø ni lwøre ka lweete, ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre; ni ö rem olämi manøgø mano dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni käl maar olämi wøk bäre, kaawat man wø käl maaw wøk ki ro olämi man wø duunni ki mëër. Ni ö eni na dïlämi ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na gïn wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiper ŋatøgø; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the Lord; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mano cïp ŋatøgø no olämi mar wëën raay moe beeye nyi røømmø, wär cïbe na dhaagø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre.
english: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

anywaa: Køøre eni cere wär cïp bäät wï olämi manøgø na mar wëën raay enø, ni ŋaal gø no olämi mar wëën raay, ni ŋaale kany wø ŋaal olämi man wø waaŋ bäre yie.
english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi wär lwöte ri rem olämi manøgø na mar wëën raay enø, ni lwøre ka lweete ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre, ni ö rem olämi manøgø mano dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni käl maar olämi wøk bäre kaawat man wø käl maaw wøk ki ri nyi røømmø man wø cïp no olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ni waaŋ gïïögø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni ee dwal bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk ni wø bëëdö ni waaŋ ki maac. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiper raay mo ŋatøgø moa tïïe; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo obääyö, ni beeye kiper eni dwøl mana caan wïnyö jïre, kanya kööm jiy ki nyeŋ Jwøk, nee ŋati man nø mare caane, ni eni doo løny jïre ki mana dee adïëri mare lamø kiper gïna näk ee raŋø wala gïna näk ee kwanyø, 'ba eni bäŋ gïn mo caane, teeŋ ŋatøgø bääyö mare ena bääte keere.
english: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

anywaa: « ‹Wala ni näk mo dhaanhø guta gïn mo ba waany, nee lää paap mo ba waany mo othøw, wala lää paac mo ba waany mo othøw, wala gïï wø muuli ki piny mo ba waany mo othøw, këël ni näk mo gïïögø gude ni kuue, ni put tïmö ni ba waany, eni ajäla ena bääte.
english: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

anywaa: « ‹Wala ni näk mo eni guta gïn mo ogut dhaanhe mo ba waany, ni beeye teeŋ gïn mør jaak mo tïïya eni ni ba waany, ni gude ni kuue, kanyo ŋäc gø yie, eni ajäla ena bääte.
english: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.

anywaa: « ‹Wala ni näk mo dhaanhø okööŋ ki dhee ki man tïïc gïn mo raac wala gïn mo beer, ni eni kööŋ ni wïïe käre caarø bäät gø, ni beeye gïrpiny jaak man wø kööŋ dhaanhe kipere ni eni wïïe käre caarø, ni mare tïïc gø jaak ni kuue, eni kanyo ŋäc gø yie, eni ajäla ena bääte ki køør mana tïïc aciel røk gïïögø.
english: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgønø, ni näk mo dhaanhø bääyö mare ena røk gïïögø, eni raay moe wär købe ki jöö mana bääye ki gø.
english: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

anywaa: Eni wär cïpe ko olämi mar bääyö mare jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper raay moa tïïe, ni lwøre røk dïëk, ni beeye røømmø ma dhaagø wala ateea ma dhaagø, ni cïp gø no olämi mar wëën raay. Køøre tïïc dïlämi tïïö no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø kiper raay moe.
english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo eni cere orëëm ki man cïpe ki diel, eni atuuy ariiø wala akuyi ariiø wär cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi mar bääyö mare kiper raay moa tïïe, na aciel cïp no olämi mar wëën raay, ni ö maya ni cïbi no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the Lord; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kïth geni baŋ dïlämi, ni ö dïlämi ni kwøŋ aciel cïp no olämi mar wëën raay. Ni meen ŋut gø, 'ba eni ba cööt wøk.
english: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

anywaa: Køøre eni remø mør mar olämi manøgø na mar wëën raay enø jøre dëër bwöp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ö reme mano dööŋ ni twiinyi piny tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Ni manøgø beeye olämi mar wëën raay.
english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cäŋ maya jiiŋŋø no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni tïïe ka køør ciik mana no ocïp piny. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø kiper raay moa tïïe; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo cere orëëm ki man cïpe ka atuuy ariiø wala akuyi ariiø, eni muuy mare mano cïbe kiper bääyö mare wär cïbe na paac wï møø mana pøøth ni wø en yi rumi mar iipa, ni cïp gø no olämi mar wëën raay. 'Ba eni kär nee kunynya bäät gø ki maaw, ni ba cïp gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäät gø, kiper eno olämi mar wëën raay.
english: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

anywaa: Køøre eni kïthe baŋ dïlämi, ni ö dïlämi manøgø ni lwöte ri gø ki yi cere ni päŋ, ni lwøre na gïr par wïc, ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni ee dwal bäät olämme mo wø bëëdö ni waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk. Ni manøgø beeye olämi mar wëën raay.
english: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: it is a sin offering.

anywaa: Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø kiper mana bääye ki gïrpiny aciel røk gïïa no ocaanø; køøre eni di wëënnö. 'Ba thääŋ muuy mano dööŋ tïmö na mar dïlämi ni caala muuy mar møk beel.› »
english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo obääyö ni ba kame ki køør mana ruue ni gïïa en kur keerge na dee cïbö jï Wuuö Jwøk käre cïbö, eni wär cïpe ko olämi mar bääyö mare jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïbe røk dïëk na nywø røømmø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, no opäärö ki gät mano cïbï piny mar gwel-bïrö man wø røm ki rumi man wø cwøl ni cekel mar kar lam na en kur keere. No olämi manøgø cïp kaper wëën bääyö.
english: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the Lord; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cool gïïa ruu ni käre cïbö røk gïïa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni meet bïï wïthge bäät gø, ni cïp gø jï dïlämi. Køøre dïlämi manøgø nywø røømmø mana cïp kiper wëën bääyö tïïe tïïö no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø obääyö ni eni tïïya gïrpiny aciel røk gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kär tïïc, këël na näk tïïe ni kuue, eni ajäla ena bääte, ni bääyö mare ena bääte keere.
english: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the Lord; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wär lwöte røk dïëk ki nywø røømmø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, ni cïp gø jï dïlämi no olämi mar wëën bääyö, no opäärö ki gät mana näk iï cïp piny. Køøre nø, tïïc dïlämi tïïö no okïdi kiper bääyö mar ŋatøgø ki køør gïna baae ni kuue ni ba kame; køøre eni di wëënnö.
english: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: Ni manøgø beeye olämi mar wëën bääyö mare, mana bëëde møn ni eno bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ni näk da dhaanhø mo obääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk ki køør man wø mooŋ gïn mo okan watge baŋe ki ŋäädhe, wala gïn mo owii baŋe nee gwøe, wala eni kwala jap watge, wala ni näk mo eni lwøra jap watge ki teek,
english: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the Lord, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

anywaa: wala eni joota gïn mo orwäänyö ni mooŋ gø, wala eni mare kööŋ ki tööt bäät gïna tïïe røk gïïögø ni wø bääc dhaanhe rege,
english: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

anywaa: eni gïno tïïe ki køør bääyö mare, jammi moa kwale wala jammi moa lwøre ki teek, wala jammi moa no okan baŋe ki ŋäädhe, wala jammi moa joode na no orwäänyö,
english: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

anywaa: wala gïna kööŋe ki tööt bäät gø jaak, wär dwøge, ni coole na kare na teeŋ gïneca, ni meet bïï wïthge bääte, ni cïp gø jï wää gïnögø dïcäŋo cïp olämi mare yie mar wëën bääyö mare.
english: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

anywaa: Eni olämi mar bääyö mare mano cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk wär käl baŋ dïlämi, ni cïbe røk dïëk na nywø røømmø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, no opäärö ki gät mana näk ocïp piny kiper olämi mar wëën bääyö.
english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

anywaa: Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiper ŋatøgø, ni tïïe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; køøre eni di wëënnö kiper gïna tïïe røk gïïögø na wëëk eni bääyö.»
english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kööm Aran ki wääte ni kööï ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Man beeye ciik kiper olämi man wø waaŋ bäre. Olämi man wø waaŋ bäre wär put bëëdö ki wäär bäre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte këël mano këët amöölla, ni maac bëëdö ni liel bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi jalabiiya mare mana näk lïïna wär røø dëëre, ni røø libaa lïïna dëëre man wø røø tier jalabiiya, ni ö eni ni jøøp bur mar olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre na no othöör maaci bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni cïp gø buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

anywaa: Køøre eni abïïe moa en dëëre wär käl wøk, ni røø käärö ni kïth gø wøk ŋää twïër kany mo waany.
english: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

anywaa: 'Ba maac mana en bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte wär bëëde ni liel, ni ba thøw. 'Ba dïlämi wär bëëde ni dhøk jenni äbe äbö bäät gø cooth ka amöölla, ni peeth olämi man wø waaŋ bäre bäät maac, ni waaŋ thäk dwäle mar olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër bäät gø.
english: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

anywaa: Maac wär bëëde ni liel jaak bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ba wëëgi thøø.
english: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man beeye ciik kiper muuce mo møk beel. Wäät Aran beege noo cïp muuce moøgø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the Lord, before the altar.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø aciel rege lwötö ri møø mana pøøth mar muuy mar møk beel ni kuure ka maaw ki yi cere ni päŋ, ni dwal gø ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met na no ocïp bäät muuy mar møk beel manøgø, ni ö eni ni waaŋ geni bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na gïr par wïc man wø ŋwääi ni met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba mano dööŋ dëër møø wär cam Aranni ki wääte. Wär cam no otïïö na muunni mo opamø mo bäŋ thømmø rege, ni camma yi kany mo ena kur keere, ni kany wø camge gø yie beeye yi kal mar oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

anywaa: Møø manøgø kär deel ni dëëre da thømmø. Aani na Wuuö Jwøk, møø manøgø yaa nø cïp na kurge røk olämme mo wø waaŋ jïra ki maac; eni ena kur keere ni pere leth ni caala olämi mar wëën raay ko olämi mar wëën bääyö.
english: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

anywaa: Dïcwøø man nø mo käla dëër Aran løny ki man cam gø. Ni manøgø beeye kur ŋatøgø røk olämme mo wø waaŋ jïra ki maac, ni bëëde ni nut jïre cooth ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët. 'Ba ki røk jiy jaak, ŋato gut gïïögø, da gïn mo raac mo tägö dëëre.› »
english: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the Lord made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: na «Aran ki ŋato käl dëëre man wø läw kar dïlämi, muuy mano cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi dïcäŋ wø thïïm wïïe ki maaw beeye paac wï møø mana pøøth ni wø en yi rumi mar iipa, ni beeye muuy mar møk beel man wø cïp cooth, ni thääŋŋe dï cïbö ka amöölla, ni thääŋŋe maya di cïbö ka abøøya.
english: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the Lord in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

anywaa: Møø manøgø wär jiiŋŋi no okïthö ki maaw, ni deeli ki gïr deel, no ocoodø na kare døøc. Ni pøti na thäŋi ni cïbi na muuy mar møk beel na gïn mo ŋwääö ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato cïp gø beeye ŋat mo käla dëër Aran mo wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw na dïlämi kar wänni. Ni manøgø beeye ciik moa no ocïp piny nee bëëde ni nut cooth ki man bëët teeŋ olämi manøgø ni di waaŋø bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the Lord; it shall be wholly burnt.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, muuy mar møk beel man wø cïp dïlämi di waaŋø bäre, ni bäŋ kany mo di camø dëëre.»
english: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ki wääte ni kööï, ni ‹Man beeye ciik kiper olämi mar wëën raay: Olämi mar wëën raay wär tïme ni ŋaalla nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kany wø ŋaal olämi yie man wø waaŋ bäre; ni manøgø beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the Lord: it is most holy.

anywaa: Dïlämi mano cïp gø kiper wëën raay beeye noo cam gø. Eni wär tïme ni camma yi kany mo ena kur keere yi kal mar oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jiy jaak, ŋato gut rïŋ gø, da gïn mo raac mo tägö dëëre. 'Ba ni näk mo remø oniker dëër abïï, ïïni remø mana gut abïï wär pïny wøk yi kany mo ena kur keere.
english: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno thaal rïŋö ki gø nee beeye dak, wär nyath. 'Ba ni näk mo thaal ka dhiinh jwïël, wär gøøp døøc ni laai ki pïï mo tøŋ.
english: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

anywaa: Dïcwøø man nø røk dïlämme løny ki man cäme ri gø. Ni manøgø beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.

anywaa: 'Ba olämi man nø mar wëën raay man wø remme kïth yo oduŋkaany røømmø nee tïïc no okïdi yi kanya en kur keere, rïŋŋe ba cam. Eni di waaŋø ki maac bäre.
english: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man beeye ciik kiper olämi mar wëën bääyö, ni manøgø beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

anywaa: Olämi mar wëën bääyö wär tïme ni ŋaalla kany wø ŋaal olämi yie man wø waaŋ bäre, ni ö dïlämi ni køny rem gø dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïo cïp ri läänögø no olämi beeye maaw mare bäre, ni beeye maar jïp, ki räämmö na näk gïïa en ec ee rïëbö,
english: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

anywaa: ki røgi karge riet na en wïth dïbule ki maaw mana en bäätge, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree, noo käl wøk ki røgi ciel.
english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi gïïögø wär waaŋe bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk. Ni manøgø beeye olämi mar wëën bääyö.
english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a trespass offering.

anywaa: Dïcwøø man nø røk dïlämme løny ki man cäme ri rïŋ gø; eni wär tïme ni camma yi kany mo ena kur keere; ni manøgø beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

anywaa: « ‹Olämi mar wëën bääyö ko olämi mar wëën raay ge röömi. Geni ciik marge aciel. Dïlämi mano tïïc ge no okïdi, tïmö na moe.
english: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi man wø cïp olämi man wø waaŋ bäre mar ŋati man nø, dïlämi manøgø pïën olämi cøøa jïre.
english: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, muuy mar møk beel man nø man wø deel ka athaa, wala gïr deel, wala täba, tïmö na mar dïlämi mana cïp gø.
english: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar møk beel man nø mo kär deelø, nee okïthö ki maaw wala otal kare, tïmö na mar wäät Aran bëët, ni ŋati man nø mare röömi ki mar coki.
english: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man beeye ciik kiper olämme mo wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk ni wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo cïp dhaanhe no olämi mar dwøk met ec, muuce moo cïp ŋatøgø noo kuure ko olämi mar dwøk met ec manøgø beeye møø mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre mo odeelø no opamø mo okïthö ki maaw, ki møø mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre mo odeelø no opamø ni reep mo bäätge owïïrö ki maaw, ki mo opamø mo coot ka møø mana pøøth no okïthö ki maaw.
english: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

anywaa: Ni eni gïno cïbe na muuy noo meet bäät olämi mare man wø duunni ki mëër mar dwøk met ec beeye møø mo otïïö na dääpe mo ocoodø ki thømmø.
english: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

anywaa: Eni wär lwöte ri wï muuy man nø ni cïp gø na ajwäk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni manøgø beeye kiper nee tïme na mar dïlämi mana ker rem olämi man wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the Lord, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋ olämi mar ŋatøgø man wø duunni ki mëër mar dwøk met ec, wär put ŋatøgø cam dïcäŋo cïp gø yie. Eni bäŋe gïn mo wiie ri gø mo këëta amöölla.
english: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo olämi mare cïbe na mar kööŋ wala cïbe na mar met ec, wär put ŋatøgø cam dïcäŋo cïp gø yie. 'Ba ni näk mo da kany moo dhäthö ree, løny ki man cami yi cäŋ maya.
english: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋö mano dhäthi ro olämi manøgø noo pïï ri dää nïne, wär put waaŋ ki maac.
english: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo rïŋ olämi man wø duunni ki mëër mar ŋatøgø di camø ri dää nïne, ŋata cïp olämi manøgø ba jïëc, ni ba løny ki man kwaani jïre kere da gïn mo ee cïbö, ni gïnögø tïmö na gïn mo Jwøk yie raac ki gø, ni ŋato cämö ri gø, bääyö mare tïmö ni ena bääte keere.
english: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba rïŋö mo gïn mo ba waany ee gudö, kär ni camma gø; wär waaŋ ki maac. « ‹'Ba thääŋ rïŋŋögø maya, løny ki man cami ŋat mo waany.
english: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø cam rïŋ olämi man wø duunni ki mëër ni wø cïp na mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni eni ba waany, teeŋ ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da ŋat mo guta teeŋ gïn mør jaak mo ba waany, nee gïn mo ogut dhaanhe mo ba waany, wala lääy mo ba waany, wala teeŋ gïn mo ba waany mo ec raac ki gø, ni ö eni ni cam rïŋ olämi man wø duunni ki mëër man wø cïp na mar Wuuö Jwøk, teeŋ ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.› »
english: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï, ni ‹Uuni kär nou cämö ki maaw mar dhieŋ, wala mar røømmø, wala mar ateea.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

anywaa: 'Ba maar lääy mo othøw keere ki maar lääy mo onäk cwienynyi, løny ki man kunyge kiper tïïe møøk; 'ba ka adïëri møn, kär cammu.
english: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

anywaa: Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo ocämö ki maar lääy man wø tïïc no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk, teeŋ ŋata cämö enø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni kwöro bëëdu yïthge, käru cämö ki rem wenyø wala rem lääy.
english: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

anywaa: Ŋato cämö ki remø jaak, teeŋ ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.› »
english: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ŋat wø cïp olämi mare jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, thääŋ gø wär cïbe no olämi jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

anywaa: Eni olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, wär cïbe ni kääre ka ceŋŋe kiree. Ni beeye maaw ki gøŋŋø noo cïbe, ni ö gøŋŋø ni tuuŋŋi yi jamø no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni waaŋ maaw bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; 'ba gøŋŋø tïmö na mar Aran ki wääte.
english: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, gïno cïpu jï dïlämi na ajwäk beeye ääm mar cwïïc, ni lwørru ro olämi maru man wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

anywaa: Ki røk wäät Aran, ŋato cïp remø ki maaw no olämi man wø käl dëër olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ääm mar cwïïc cøøa jïre na kure.
english: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

anywaa: Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, gøŋŋø man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø no olämi, ki ääm man wø cïp na ajwäk, yaa nø lwør baŋ jø Icriel røk olämme moge mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni nø cïba ge jï dïlämi ma Aran ki wääte ni beeye kurge na bäre bäre mano jootge baŋ jø Icriel.› »
english: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

anywaa: Gïïögø beege gïïa cïp kur keerge jï Aran ki wääte dïcäŋa nyooth geni ki man tïnyge Wuuö Jwøk ni gena dïlämme, ni gïïögø lwørra røk olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest's office;

anywaa: Gïïögø beege gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki nee cïp jø Icrielli jïge dïcäŋa ö Wuuö Jwøki na wëëk wïthge thïïmmö yie ki maaw. Ni manøgø beeye kurge na bäre bäre këël ki yïth beenhnhe moge bëët.
english: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

anywaa: Moøgø nø beege ciik mar olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo møk beel, ko olämi mar wëën raay, ko olämi mar wëën bääyö, ko olämi mar rööny, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër;
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

anywaa: ni beege gïïa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge bäät Kïn Caynay dïcäŋa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm jø Icriel nee cïpge ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk dï paap mar Caynay.
english: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør Aran ki wääte na aciel, ka abïïk dïlämme, ki maar rööny, ki rwaath mano cïp no olämi mar wëën raay, ki nyöök rööm karge riet, ki gupa mo yie da muunni mo odeelø ni bäŋ thømmø rege,
english: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

anywaa: ni kïthï geni dho oduŋkaany røømmø; ni cooŋï dhaanh Icriel bäre kaace.»
english: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe gïnögø atïïe ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni ki gø. 'Ba kanya ö dhaanh Icrielli na nø cooŋi dho oduŋkaany røømmø,
english: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Modhe aköö jïge, ni «Man beeye gïna cem Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc.»
english: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe Aran ki wääte acwöl nyïm ni lwøk geni ki pïï.
english: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni røø jalabiiya mana bäär dëër Aran, ni ö kawi mar abïï ni twöö gø yi gø, ni røø jalabiiya mana ciek dëër gø, ni røø abïïna cwøl ni ëëput dëër gø, ni twöö ëëput dëër Aran, ni twöe ka kaan abïïn ëëput na näk ocwääö ki riek waŋ, ni beeye mana twöö ëëput piny ki gø dëër gø.
english: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

anywaa: Køøre eni abïïna näk abïï käw akïth kö gø, ni ö gïï wø cwøl no Urim ki Thumim ni kïth ge yi kïïny abïï käw.
english: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

anywaa: Eni thuwø abïï man wø kïth wïc akïth wï Aran, ni ö warkey mana paŋŋi, man wø nyooth gø ni Aran ocïp kur keere, ni twöö gø ri baap täärnyïm abïï manøgø, ni tïïe ka køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni na Modhe ki gø.
english: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre nø, Modhe maar rööny alwøre ni gweel oduŋkaara kar bëët Wuuö Jwøk, ki gïïa en yie bëët, ni eni cïba ge kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni ker maaw mør bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki kwöre abïriiø ni eni gweela gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki jap tïïc mo gø bëët, ki gïr pï lwøk ki gïre man wø bëëde bäät gø, ni eni cïba ge kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

anywaa: Køøre eni maar rööny mør athii wï Aran, ni cïba gø kur keere.
english: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, Modhe wäät Aran akäl nyïm, ni røø jalabiiye moa bäyö dëëtge, ni twöö kaae mo abïïe yïthge, ni kïth cöörri wïthge, ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni na Modhe ki gø.
english: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre eni rwaath mana no olämi mar wëën raay akäl nyïm, ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge bäät wï rwaath manøgø na mar wëën raay enø.
english: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe rwaadhøgø aŋaale ni lwør remø, ni lwöte ki lweete ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni eni tïïya gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni waany. Køøre eni remø mana dööŋ akøny tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni mare cïp gø kur keere na mar Jwøk ni tïïe no okïdi kiper gø.
english: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni lwør maaw bäre mana en bäät gïïa en ec, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree, ki røgi karge riet, ki maarge; ni ö eni na Modhe ni waaŋ ge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba rwaadhøgø pïëne ki rïŋŋe ki weenynye moe awaaŋe ki maac wøk ŋää twïër ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni na Modhe ki gø.
english: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe nywø røømmø mar olämi man wø waaŋ bäre akäl nyïm, ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge bäät wï nywø røømmø manøgø.
english: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni ŋaal gø, ni køny remø dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Modhe na bak gø na thäŋi, wïc ki kwöra bage na thäŋi ki dwäälö awaaŋe ki maac no olämi.
english: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Modhe na nø peny gïïa en ec ki tiel, nywø røømmø bäre awaaŋe ki maac no olämi bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre man wø ŋwääi ni met. Ni manøgø beeye olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki gø.
english: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe riet nywø røømmø acäŋ käl nyïm, ni beeye nywø røømmø mar rööny; ni ö Aranni ki wääte ni cïpge ceŋge bäät wï nywø røømmø manøgø.
english: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni ŋaal gø, ni lwöte ri rem gø ni gweel olap mar ïth cwïï Aran, ki lween dwøŋ mar cer cwïï gø, ki lween dwøŋ mar tier cwïï gø.
english: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, eni wäät Aran akäl nyïm, ni ö eni na Modhe ni lwør remø ni gweel olap ïthge mo bäät cwïcge, ki lweet døøŋŋø mo ceŋ cwïcge, ki lweet døøŋŋø mo tiet cwïcge. Køøre Modhe remø mana dööŋ akøny dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni lwør dwäälö ki maar jïp ki maaw bäre mana en bäät gïïa en ec, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree, ki røgi karge riet ki maarge, ki ääm mar cwïïc.
english: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

anywaa: Køøre ena lwötö ki møø aciel mo bäŋ thømmø dëëre, ki møø aciel mo coot ka maaw, ki møø aciel mo otïïö ni reep, ni lwøre røk muunni moa näk odeelø ni bäŋ thømmø rege na en yi gupa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïp ge bäät dwäle ki bäät ääm cwïïc.
english: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

anywaa: Køøre eni gïïögø bëët acïp cer Aran ki ceŋ wääte ni tuuŋge ge yi jamø no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the Lord.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, Modhe gïïögø akäl wøk ceŋge ni waaŋ geni bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ee dwal bäät olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni manøgø beeye olämi mar rööny man wø ŋwääi ni met ni wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø eni na Modhe gøŋŋø mar nywø røømmø mar rööny, ni beeye kuna näk kure, alwøre ni tuuŋ gø yi jamø no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni na Modhe ki gø.
english: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, Modhe alwötö ri maar rööny, ki ri remø mana en bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni jør geni bäät Aran, ki bäät abïïe moe, ki bäät wääte, ki bäät abïïe moge, ni manøgø eni cïba Aran kur keere, ka abïïe moe, ki wääte, ka abïïe moge.
english: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Aran ki wääte, ni «Rïŋö wär thaallu dho oduŋkaany røømmø ni cammu gø na aciel ki muunni moa näk odeelø moa lwør yi gupa mana en muuce mo rööny yie, ni tïïc kaawat mana cema gø na kööa, ni ‹Aran ki wääte beege noo cam gø.›
english: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

anywaa: 'Ba mano dhäthi ri rïŋö ki ri muunni wär waaŋ ki maac.
english: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u bëëdö ki nïne abïriiø nou ba døny wøk ki dho oduŋkaany røømmø, këël dïcäŋo thum nïr röönynyi mou yie; kiper rööny maru känna wøk ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

anywaa: Teeŋ gïn ni tïïc dïcäŋi ennø, beeye Wuuö Jwøk na caan gø ki man tïï no okïdi kiperu.
english: As he hath done this day, so the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u bëëdö nou ena dho oduŋkaany røømmø ki cäŋ ki wäär ki nïne abïriiø nou tïïya gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki, nou ba thøwu, kiper beeye mana kööm aani ki gø.»
english: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran ki wääte gïïögø bëët atïïcge, ni beege gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki ki ri Modhe.
english: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bäc nïne, Modhe Aran ki wääte ki jø døøk Icriel acwøle,
english: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

anywaa: ni kööe jï Aran, ni «Lwön dëërï ki nyirøøa ma rwaath no olämi mar wëën raay, ki nywø røømmø no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni geni karge riet bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge, ni cïpï geni no olämi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre ni cäännï jø Icriel ni kööï, ni ‹Lwötu ki nywø ateea no olämi mar wëën raay, ki nyirøøa ki nyi røømmø no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ni geni karge riet cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge,
english: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

anywaa: ni lwötu ki dhieŋ ki nywø røømmø no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni cïpu ge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk no okuurö ki muuy mar møk beel mo okïthö ki maaw; kiper dïcäŋi Wuuö Jwøk dëëre nyoodhe nyoodhø jïïu.› »
english: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, geni gïïa ö Modhe na kööm geni ki ge aputge lwør ni kïthge ge nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö dhaanh Icrielli bäre ni nyänhge nyïm ni cuŋge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Man beeye gïna ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm uuni ki gø nee tïïyu nee ajiem Wuuö Jwøk nyooth jïïu.»
english: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put köö jï Aran, ni «Nyänh buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni cïpï olämi marï mar wëën raay, ko olämi marï man wø waaŋ bäre, niï tïïya okïdi kiper dëërï, kiper jiy; ni cïpï olämi mana cïp jiyi niï tïïya okïdi kiperge, kaawat mana cemi ya Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, Aran aput nyänh buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni ŋaal nyirøøa kiper dëëre no olämi mar wëën raay.
english: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

anywaa: Ni ö wääte ni mëëkge remø eni, ni ö eni ni cøt lweete yi remø ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ö reme mana dööŋ ni køny gø tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

anywaa: Ni ö maawi mar olämi manø na mar wëën raay enø, ki røgi moe, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree, ni waaŋ geni bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki gø.
english: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋö ki pïën awaaŋe ki maac wøk ŋää twïër.
english: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

anywaa: Køøre Aran olämi man wø waaŋ bäre aŋaale, ni ö wääte ni mëëkge remø eni, ni køny gø dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

anywaa: Ni ö olämi manøgø man wø waaŋ bäre ni gapge gø jïre no obagø na thäŋi, ni gapge ni ege kuurö ki wïc, ni waaŋ geni bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

anywaa: Eni thuwø gïïa en ec, ki tiel apenye, ni dwal geni bäät olämi mana waaŋe bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, Aran olämi mar jiy akäl nyïm, ni lwør ateea no olämi mar wëën raac jiy, ni ŋaal gø ni cïp gø no olämi mar wëën raay ni caala mana tïïe dïkwøŋ.
english: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni käl olämi nyïm man wø waaŋ bäre, ni cïp gø no olämi ki køør ciik mana näk ocïp piny.
english: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, muuy mar møk beel akäl nyïm, ni lwöte ri gø ki yi cere ni päŋ ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni eni meeda gø bäät olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ka amöölla.
english: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

anywaa: Køøre Aran dhieŋ ki nywø røømmø aŋaale kiper jiy no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni ö wääte ni gapge remø jïre, ni køny gø dëët bööp gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

anywaa: 'Ba kuna näk maar dhieŋ ki maar nywø røømmø, ni beeye maar jïbe, ki räämmö na näk gïïa en ec ee rïëbö, ki røgi, ki maaw mana näk cwïny okuup ree,
english: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

anywaa: gïïögø na mädhi yøø acïpge bäät gøŋŋi mo olämme moøgø, ni ö Aranni ni waaŋ mädhi moøgø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

anywaa: 'Ba Aran gøŋŋi ki ääm mar cwïïc man nø atuuŋŋe yi jamø no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør mana cemi ya Modhe.
english: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, Aran ceŋŋe atïŋ maal ni ee näät bäät jiy, ni gwïëth geni. 'Ba kanya nø cïp olämi mar wëën raay, ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ena ïnh piny.
english: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ni putge ci yo oduŋkaany røømmø. 'Ba kanya duuge wøk, jiy agwïëthge, ni ö ajiemmi mar Wuuö Jwøk ni puti nyooth jï jiy bëët.
english: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.

anywaa: Kanyøgø maac aput nituc ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni thöör olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ki dwäälö bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. 'Ba kanya ö jiyi bëët na jootge gø, gena put kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ki täärnyïmge.
english: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

anywaa: 'Ba Nadap ka Abiyu, wäät Aran, athääk jwïëlli mo mäc moge alwørge ni tøøge mäc yïthge, ni kïthge gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäätge, ni cïpge maaøgø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na maac mør jaak mo geni käre köömmö ki gø.
english: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø maac aput nituc ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni waaŋ geni, ni putge thøø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni put Modhe köö jï Aran, ni «Manøgø beeye gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki na kööe, «ni ‹Jiy mo wø nyänh buuta naa tïnyge, a wär raŋge naa ena kur keera, naa bëëdö naa di wøørø nyïm jiy bëët.› » 'Ba Aran alïŋö jaak.
english: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the Lord spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe Micaël ki Eldapan, wäät Udhiel cöök wää Aranni, acwøle ni kööe jïge, ni «Ööu nyïm kany ni lwørru tuuŋu ii nyïm kany ni en kur keere en, ni kïthu geni wøk ŋää twïër.»
english: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena put ö nyïm ni lwørge geni ni jalabiiye moge poot ena dëëtge, ni kïthge geni wøk ŋää twïër ki køør mana caan Modhe.
english: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Aran ki jï wäät Aran ma Eliedhar ki Itamer, ni «Uuni, kär jïëyu weyu ni rege jwälö, ni ba jeeyu abïïe mou, kiper nou ba thøwu, nee Wuuö Jwøk ba wëëre ki dhaanh Icriel bäre. 'Ba tuuŋu ma jø dhi øt Icriel keerge jwöŋö kiper jiy moøgø moa waaŋ Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni käru døny wøk ki dho oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper nou ba thøwu; kiper maar rööny mar Wuuö Jwøk ojør dëëtu.» 'Ba geni gïnögø aputge tïïc ki køør luum Modhe.
english: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ka Aran ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ïïni ki wäätï, kär nou bëëdö ni uuno mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala køøŋø mo keec kany wø cou yo oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper nou ba thøwu. Manøgø tïmö na ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre ki yïth beenhnhe mou,
english: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

anywaa: ki man bëët gïna näk ocïp kur keere na mar Jwøk ni you pääö ki jammi møga jaak; ki man bëët gïna waanynyi ni you pääö ki gïna ba waany;
