english: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

anywaa: ki man pwönynyu jø Icriel ki ciik bëët moa caana jïge, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki ri Modhe.»
english: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï Aran ki wäät Aran moa dööŋ ni kwøw, ni beege Eliedhar ki Itamer, ni «Lwørru muuy mar møk beel mana dööŋ ro olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni cammu gø no otïïö ni bäŋ thømmø dëëre, ni cammu buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; kiper beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

anywaa: Wär tïme ni cammu yi kany mo ena kur keere; kiper beeye kuru ki wäätu røk olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper manøgø beeye gïna kööm aani ki gø.
english: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba gøŋŋø mana tuuŋŋi yi jamø no olämi ki ääm mana cïp no olämi, wär tïme ni cammu kany mo waany, ni beeye uuni ki wäätu ki nyïïu, kiper geno cïbö na kuru ki wäätu røk olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër ni wø cïp jø Icrielli.
english: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ääm mana cïp no olämi ki gøŋŋø mana tuuŋŋi yi jamø no olämi wär käli na aciel ki dwäälö man wø waaŋ ki maac no olämi, ni tuuŋŋi yi jamø no olämi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba manøgø tïmö na kuru mo bëëdö ni nut cooth jïïu ki jï jøw käl dëëtu, ki køør mana cem Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the Lord hath commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na many jöör ateea døøc mar olämi mar wëën raay, ka adïëri møn, ajoode no owaaŋø bäre. Ni ö eni ni put wëër ki Eliedhar ki Itamer, geni na wäät Aran moa dööŋ ni kwøw, ni kööe,
english: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aperŋø na ba cammu olämi mar wëën raay yi kanya en kur keere? Kiper eni ena kur keere ni pere leth; ena cïp jïïu nee bääyö mar jø Icriel tïme ni ena bääte ki mana tïï no okïdi kiperge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?

anywaa: Kiper mana näk mo remø mare kär kïth yi kanya en kur keere, ka adïëri møn, doo na mo rïŋŋe you camø yi kanya en kur keere, kaawat mana cema gø.»
english: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Aranni jï Modhe, ni «Neenï, dïcäŋi kiree, geni olämi marge mar wëën raay, ko olämi marge man wø waaŋ bäre acïpge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, kaawat man bëëde ennø ni da gïï mo opänh bääta, doo na mo aano cämö ki rïŋ olämi mar wëën raay, doo tïmö na gïn mo Wuuö Jwøk yie mïnnö ki gø?»
english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na wïny gïnögø, aput tïmö na gïn mo yie omïnnö ki gø.
english: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööe jïge,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

anywaa: ni «Caannu jï jø Icriel ni kööu, ni ‹Moi beege teeŋ lääy moo cammu røk lääy bëët moa en wï ŋöömö.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

anywaa: Lääy mano näk mo okiey moe okaaø ni rege ege pääŋŋö, ni luum man wø came ŋööe wøk ni cäŋ gø nyammø, beeye noo cammu.
english: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni, ki røk moa näk luum man wø camge ŋööge wøk ni cäŋge gø nyammø, ki røk moa näk okiey moge okaaø, dage mo kär nou cama geni. Teeŋ athïrööl, këël na bëëde ni cam ŋööe wøk dhee ni cäŋ gø nyammø, jïre bäŋ okiey mo okaaø. Ni eni beeye gïn mo ba waany kiperu.
english: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

anywaa: Teeŋ athinaak, këël na bëëde ni cam ŋööe wøk dhee ni cäŋ gø nyammø, jïre bäŋ okiey mo okaaø. Ni eni beeye gïn mo ba waany kiperu.
english: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

anywaa: Apwøø thuwø, këël na bëëde ni cam ŋööe wøk dhee ni cäŋ gø nyammø, jïre bäŋ okiey mo okaaø. Ni eni beeye gïn mo ba waany kiperu.
english: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

anywaa: Othur thuwø, këël na bëëde no okiey moe okaaø ni rege ege pääŋŋö, eni cam ba ŋöö wøk dhee ni cäŋ gø nyammø, ni eni beeye gïn mo ba waany kiperu.
english: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

anywaa: Uuni kär nou cama rïkge ni ba gutu dëëtge moa no othøw. Geni beege gïï mo ba waany kiperu.
english: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba moi beege nou cammu røk gïï wø bëëdö yïth pïï, ni beege moa näk jïge da riith ki kwönne, ni wø bëëdö yïth näpa døøŋŋø ki yïth näm, noo cammu.
english: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk gïï wø bëëdö yïth näpa døøŋŋø, ki yïth näm, moa näk bäŋ riith jïge ki kwönne, na en ri lwaa gïïa kwøw bëët yïth pïï, wala ri gïïa døøŋŋø na no ocwääö bëët na kwøw yïth pïï, wär bëëtge na gïï mo ec raac ki ge ki jïïu.
english: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo bëëdu nø ni yïthu reyø ki ge, kär nou cama geni. Ni bëët dëëtge moa no othøw ni yïthu reyø ki geni.
english: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

anywaa: Gïn mo bëëdö yïth pïï jaak mo jïre bäŋ riith ki kwönne, wär bëëde na gïn mo ec raac ki gø ki jïïu.
english: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba moi beege weny mo yïthu doo reyø ki geni; gena gïï mo ec raac ki geni, ni ge ba cam; ni beege coor, ka acuth, ko olwiith,
english: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

anywaa: ki teeŋ akän bëët,
english: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

anywaa: ki teeŋ agääe bëët,
english: Every raven after his kind;

anywaa: ki uudö, ka agïïra, ko olwiith ki teeŋge bëët,
english: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

anywaa: ki teeŋ tule bëët, ka apööra mana näk ocurruunyö,
english: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

anywaa: ka abööŋö, ki dïbëël,
english: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

anywaa: ka aliil, ko olwaarø ki teeŋge bëët, ka akwørajwöm, ka adilïga.
english: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba twöŋi bëët moa näk jïge da bwöm, mo ge cäädhö ki tietge aŋween bëët, wär bëëtge na gïï mo ec raac ki geni ki jïïu.
english: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba twöŋi moi beege moa näk løny ki man cammu geni røk moa näk jïge da bwöm bëët ni wø cäädhi ki tiel aŋween bëët, ni beege moa näk tietge okuubö ki mut ni wø päri ki piny.
english: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

anywaa: Ni geni noo cammu beege awïl ki teeŋge bëët, ki bäänyö man wø räänyö ki teeŋge bëët, ka athileem ki teeŋge bëët, ka aditwiyi ki teeŋge bëët.
english: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

anywaa: 'Ba twöŋi møga bëët moa näk jïge da bwöm ki tiel aŋween, wär bëëtge na gïï mo ec raac ki ge ki jïïu.
english: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba gïï ii beege gïïo tïïc uuni nou ba waany; ŋato gut dëëtge moa no othøw, puta tïmö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ŋato lwør dëëtge moa no othøw, abïïe moe wär penye; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni gïïögø beege lääy bëët moa näk okiei moge okaaø ni nyootha køørge, 'ba kär pääŋŋö na bäre, wala moa näk cam ba ŋööge wøk dhøkge nee ŋiithge. Geni bëëtge ni ba waany kiperu. Ŋato gut dëëtge moa no othøw tïmö ni ba waany.
english: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, røk lääy bëët moa näk cäädhi ka tietge aŋween bëët, mo wø cäädhi ko odhäp tietge wär bëëtge ni ba waany kiperu. Ŋato gut dëëtge moa no othøw tïmö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ŋato lwør dëëtge moa no othøw, abïïe moe wär penye. 'Ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi. Geni wär bëëtge ni ba waany kiperu.
english: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ki røk gïï wø muuli ki piny, moo bëëdö ni ba waany kiperu beege akatajöö, ki jïïö, ka aballathuure ki teeŋge bëët,
english: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

anywaa: ki ditwat, ki ŋweec, ki digwii-döörö ki digwii-nhaadhi, ko oŋøønnø.
english: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

anywaa: Gïïögø beege gïïo bëëdö ni ba waany kiperu røk gïïa näk muulö ki piny bëët. Kanyo näk geno thøw, ŋato gut geni tïmö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Gïno päth acielli bääte jaak røk gïïögø kany wø näk mo eno thøw, gïneca puta tïmö ni ba waany; nee beeye teeŋ gïn mo tïïc ka jaath, wala abïï dëël, wala pïën, wala keeca, nee gïn mo gïr tïïc jaak, wär mut piny yïth pïï. 'Ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi. Køøre nø, tïmö ni waany.
english: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dak mar odhöönh mano päth acielli yie røk gïïögø, gïno en yie jaak puta tïmö ni ba waany; 'ba uuni daaøgø wär putu näk.
english: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

anywaa: Ni teeŋ gïn ma cam jaak mo pï yi daaøgø oøøc bääte tïmö ni ba waany. Ni gïn mo løny ki man maadhi mo käla yi daaøgø ba waany.
english: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni teeŋ gïrpiny jaak mano päth dëëtge moa no othøw bääte, tïmö ni ba waany. Nee pätha bäät athaanh deel wala yi këënnö, ge wär put näk. Geni ge ba waany, 'ba wär putge bëëte ni ba waany ki jïïu.
english: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba pï jøøro wala aguula mo yie da pïï mo gïïögø opäth yie, poot bëëdö kare ni waany. 'Ba ŋato gut dëëtge moa no othøw tïmö ni ba waany.
english: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dëëtge moa no othøw opäth bäät köödhi moa näk di piidhø, köödhi poot bëëdö ni waany.
english: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo köödhi obïlö ki pïï, ni ö dëët gïïögø moa no othøw ni päth bäät köödhi moøgø, wär bëëtge ni ba waany ki jïïu.
english: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ki røk lääy moa näk ocïbö jïïu kiper cam, ni näk mo dagø mo othøw keere, ŋato gut dëëre mana no othøw tïmö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ŋato cämö ri rïŋ gø, abïïe moe wär penye; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi. Ni ŋato lwør rïŋ gø, abïïe moe wär penye; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba gïï wø muuli ki yïth ŋøøm, gena gïï mo ec raac ki geni, ni paa gïï mo di camø.
english: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

anywaa: Gïn mo muuli ka bäp yie jaak, ki gïn mo muuli ka tiel aŋween, ki gïn mo tiete thööth, ni beege gïïa näk muuli ka piny bëët, kär ge cammu, kiper gena gïï mo ec raac ki geni.
english: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

anywaa: Uuni kär dëëtu tïïyu ni ec raac ki uuni ki køør gïïögø ni muuli ki piny yøø, ni ba tïïyu dëëtu ni ba waany ki køørge ki man bëëdu nou ba waany.
english: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

anywaa: Kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru. Cïbu dëëtu kur keeru ni bëëdu nou ena kur keeru; kiper a ena kur keera. Ni ba tïïyu dëëtu ni ba waany ki køør gïïögø ni wø muuli ki piny yøø.
english: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

anywaa: Kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, naa bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru. Kiper manøgø nø, bëëdu nou ena kur keeru, kiper a ena kur keera.
english: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

anywaa: « ‹Moøgø beege ciik kiper lääy, ki weny, ki gïïa kwøw ni wø cäädhi ki yïth pïï, ki gïïa näk muuli ka yïth ŋøøm,
english: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

anywaa: ki man bëët gïna waanynyi ni you pääö ki gïna näk ba waany; ni bëët gïïa no ocwääö na kwøw moa näk di camø, ni you pääö ki moa no ocwääö na näk ba cam.› »
english: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï, ni ‹Kany wø ö dhaage wø jït yie ki dhaanhø, kany wø lwaare ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, eni bëëdö ki nïne abïriiø ni ba waany, kaawat nïne mo wø beede ni ba waany kany wø bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bäc nïne, nyilaal wär daŋ.
english: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø manøgø wär poode ni bëëdö ki nïne ma pïëradäk ka adäk këël kanyo dööŋe ni waany ki remø mana en dëëre, ni gïn mo ocïp kur keere na mar Jwøk ba gude, ni eni ba døny kar lam na en kur keere, këël kanyo thum nïne moo dööŋe ni waany yïthge.
english: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaaŋŋøgø lwaar ka nyilaal ma nyakøø, eni bëëdö ki juu ariiø ni ba waany, kaawat man wø bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään; eni wär poode ni bëëdö ki nïne ma pïërabïciel ka abïciel këël kanyo dööŋe ni waany ki remø mana en dëëre.
english: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo thum nïne moo dööŋe ni waany yïthge, køør mana lwaare ki dïcwøø wala nyakøø, eni wär känne ki nyi røømmø ma cwiine aciel no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ka atuuk wala nya akuuru no olämi mar wëën raay, ni cïp ge jï dïlämi dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

anywaa: Køøre cïp dïlämi cïbö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni eni tïïya geni no okïdi kiper dhaaŋŋøgø, nee dööŋe ni waany ki remø mana en dëëre. « ‹Manøgø tïmö na ciik kiper dhaagø man wø nyööti, nee nywøla dïcwøø wala nyakøø.
english: Who shall offer it before the Lord, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaaŋŋøgø cere orëëm ki man cïpe ki nyi røømmø, eni wär cïpe ka atuuy ariiø wala nyïï akuyi ariiø, na aciel olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni maya olämi mar wëën raay, nee tïïc dïlämi no okïdi kiper dhaaŋŋøgø. Køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.› »
english: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ni näk da dhaanhø mo da gïn mo opäny wøk ri buny dëëre, wala nyoonynyø, wala kany mo obuth mo løny ki man tïme na täw mo muuö, eni wär käli ni kïthi baŋ dïlämi ma Aran wala baŋ dïlämi man nø røk jø wø käl dëëre.
english: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni raŋ gïna näk opäny wøk ri buny dëël; 'ba ni näk mo jïër moa en yi waŋ ŋwellø rege ege wiilø ni tar, ni ŋwellø nëëni ni ree ee luut piny ni buny dëël ee wii maal, gïnögø beeye ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël. Ni ki køør mana ö dïlämi na raŋ gø, wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany.
english: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïna näk obuth nëëni ni tar jaak bäät buny dëëre, ni nëënnö mare ree paa ee luut piny, ni jïër moa en waŋe rege kärge wiilø ni tar, dïlämi ŋatøgø ni dëëre da ŋwellø enø wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø.
english: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär raŋe; 'ba noo nëën ŋwellø ki jïre ni dëëre käre wiilø, ni ŋwellø kär nyaay bäät buny dëëre, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø møøk.
english: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär cäŋ raŋŋø; 'ba ni näk mo ŋwellø odøø piny ni kär nyaay bäät buny dëël, dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany. Gïnögø beeye nyoonynyø jaak. Køøre ŋatøgø abïïe moe wär penye. Køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.
english: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo nyoonynyø onyaay bäät buny dëër ŋatøgø, køør mana nø nyooth dëëre jï dïlämi kanya nø caan waany mare, ŋatøgø ree wär cäŋ nyoothø nyïm dïlämi.
english: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:

anywaa: Køøre raŋ dïlämi raŋø; 'ba ni näk mo nyoonynyø onyaay bäät buny dëëre, wär caan dïlämi ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Manøgø beeye täw buny dëël.
english: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø dëëre da ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël, eni wär kïth baŋ dïlämi,
english: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

anywaa: nee raŋ dïlämi. 'Ba ni näk mo da gïn mo tar mo opäny wøk ki yi buny dëëre, ni wiil jïër ni tar moa en waŋe, ni da rïŋö mo ocwäny wøk ki yi waŋ gïna näk opäny wøk,
english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

anywaa: manøgø beeye täw buny dëël mo ba caŋŋi dëëre. Wär caan dïlämi ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Ba many gø këët nee tïïe ki man bëëde kur keere nee cäŋ raŋŋø, kiper oløny ni ba waany.
english: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo täw buny dëël obwön wøk dëëre bäre, ni täw manøgø dëër ŋatøgø ee gääbö bäre, ki mana täge wïïe këël tiete, ni beeye gïn mo nëënö jaak jï dïlämi,
english: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

anywaa: wär raŋ dïlämi. 'Ba ni näk mo ee joodø ni dëël ee gääbö bäre, no onibuuth ni tar bäre, ŋatøgø waany. Dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany.
english: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da rïŋ dëëre mo ocäŋ cwäny wøk, eni ba waany.
english: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ rïŋö mana näk ocwäny wøk, wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Rïŋö mo ocwäny wøk dëël beeye täw buny dëël, ni ŋatøgø ba waany.
english: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo rïŋö mana no ocwäny wøk dëëre odøø piny ni neebuuth ni tar, ŋatøgø wär døø baŋ dïlämi.
english: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

anywaa: Køøre dëëre raŋ dïlämi raŋø. 'Ba ni näk mo ŋwellø onibuuth ni tar møn, dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ni dëëre da ŋwelløgø enø waany.
english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo dëër dhaanhø ojïtö ki boor ni caŋŋe,
english: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

anywaa: ni ö kar boorri manøgø ni jïte ki gïn mo tar mo opäny wøk wala gïn mo kwaar, ŋatøgø dëëre wär nyoodhe jï dïlämi.
english: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

anywaa: Køøre raŋ dïlämi raŋø. 'Ba ni näk mo nëëni ni ree ee luut piny ni buny dëël ee wii maal, ni jïër moa en waŋe rege ege wiilø ni tar, dïlämi wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Manøgø beeye ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël na tuny wøk ki yi øt boor enø.
english: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kanyo raŋi ya dïlämi, bäŋ jïër mo tar mo ena yi waŋ ŋwellø, ni ree käre luut piny, 'ba eno døø piny, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø.
english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba køør nïrögø, ni näk mo ŋwellø manøgø onyaay bäät buny dëël, dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Ni manøgø beeye ŋwellø kiree.
english: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïna no opäny wøk na tar poot bëëdö kare, ni kär nyaay, manøgø poot na dhi øt boor jaak. Køøre dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany.
english: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø da kany mo owaaŋ maaci dëëre, ni ö kanya waaŋ maaci enø ni jïte ki rïŋö mo ocwäny wøk mo onibuuth ni tar wala mo kwaar,
english: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

anywaa: dïlämi gïnögø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo jïër moa en yi waŋ ŋwellø manøgø no onibuuth enø rege ege wiilø ni tar, ni ŋwellø ree ee luut piny ni buny dëël ee wii maal, manøgø beeye täw buny dëël na päny wøk enø ki yi øt maac. Kiper manøgønø, dïlämi wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Ni manøgø beeye ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël.
english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ gø, ni jïër moa en yi waŋ ŋwelløgø no onibuuth enø ba tar, ni ree käre luut piny, 'ba nëëni no odøø piny, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø.
english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi ŋatøgø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo ŋwellø onyaay bäät buny dëëre, dïlämi wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Ni manøgø beeye ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël.
english: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋwelløgø no onibuuth enø poot bëëdö kare ni kär nyaay bäät buny dëël, 'ba nëëni no odøø piny, ena wëënnö mar maac. Køøre dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany, kiper manøgø beeye øt maac jaak.
english: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø da gïï mo opäny wøk wïïe wala tïïe,
english: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

anywaa: dïlämi ŋwellø manøgø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo nëëni ni ree ee luut piny ni buny dëël ee wii maal, ni jïër moa en waŋe abäga, no obøøc ni wetø, dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany. Manøgø beeye täw mo jelli. Ni ena täw buny dëël mar wïc wala mar tïk.
english: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ ŋwellø manøgø ni jelli enø, ni nëëni ni ree käre luut piny buut buny dëël, ni bäŋ jïër mo cøl yie, dïlämi ŋatøgø ni dëëre da ŋwellø mo jelli enø, wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi ŋwellø manøgø wär raŋe. Ni näk mo kanyø ni jelli enø kär nyaay, ni bäŋ jïër ma abäga mo otuy yie, ni nëëni ni ree käre luut piny,
english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

anywaa: ŋatøgø jïëye wär liele, ni wec kanya näk jelli ni ba liele. 'Ba dïlämi ŋatøgø ni dëëre da kany mo jelli enø, wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø møøk.
english: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi kanyø ni jelli enø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo kanya jelli kär nyaay bäät buny dëël, ni eni nëëni ni ree käre luut piny ni buny dëël käre wii maal, dïlämi wär put caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany. 'Ba ŋatøgø abïïe moe wär put peny; køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.
english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kanya jelli enø onyaay bäät buny dëël, køør mana nø caan luum waany mare,
english: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

anywaa: dïlämi dëër ŋatøgø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo kanya jelli enø onyaay bäät buny dëël, ba many gø këët ki man ö dïlämi ni neet gø ki man näk mo da jïër ma abäga yi gø; ŋatøgø ba waany.
english: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï dïlämi ni näk mo kanya jelli enø poot bëëdö kare, ni ö jïër mo cøl ni tucge ki yie, ni dijel mare manøgø ocaŋŋø, ŋatøgø waany. Køøre wär caan dïlämi ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany.
english: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk dhaanhø ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø da gïï mo obuth ni tar bäät buny dëëre, ni beege gïï moo päny wøk mo tar møn,
english: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

anywaa: wär raŋ dïlämi. 'Ba ni näk mo gïïa no obuth ni tar bäät buny dëëre nëëni ni dhïïth, manøgø beeye ŋwellø mo jööt jaak na tuny wøk ki bäät buny dëëre enø. Teeŋ ŋatøgø waany.
english: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk dhaanhø ma dïcwøø jïëc lool wïïe oøc piny ni tal wïïe, teeŋ ŋatøgø waany.
english: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

anywaa: Wala ni näk mo ŋatøgø talø mar wïïe tägi ka täärnyïme, ni bëët wïïe ni da bøønnø, teeŋ ŋatøgø waany.
english: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo lool wïïe kanya näk otal wala bøønnø mare da ŋwellø mo kwaar mo opäny wøk ki yie, manøgø beeye täw buny dëël na päny wøk enø ki dï lool wïïe kanya näk otal, wala ki dï bøønnø mare.
english: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi dëër ŋatøgø wär raŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo ŋwellø mana no opäny wøk dï lool wï ŋatøgø, wala dï bøønnø mare beeye gïn mo kwaar, ni nëëni kaamar täw buny dëël,
english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

anywaa: ŋatøgø dëëre da täw buny dëël. Ni teeŋ ŋatøgø ba waany. Dïlämi wär caane ki man näk mo ŋatøgø ba waany, kiper ŋwellø mana en dï wïïe.
english: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋata näk dëëre da teeŋ ŋwel buny dëël manøgø, wär bëëde ni käära abïïe mo ojeeyø, ni bëët wïïe no ojwälö, ni uum dhee, ni kwöŋŋe, ni ‹Aani, a ba waany! a ba waany!›
english: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋatøgø bëëdö ni ba waany ki yïth nïne bëët moo beede ni dëëre da ŋwellø; eni ba waany. Eni wär bëëde kur keere, ni kar bëëtö mare beeye ŋää twïër.
english: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk ma abïï mar dëël opuunnö, nee ena abïï ma cuup wala abïï ma lïïna,
english: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

anywaa: nee abïï mo tïïc ni di cwääö mo tïïc ka waare mo lïïna wala waare mo cuup, nee pïën wala gïn mo tïïc ka pïën,
english: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

anywaa: ni näk mo puunnö manøgø kwaar wala marr na ci ra abïï wala ri pïën, wala ra abïïna näk ocwääö, wala ri gïn mo tïïc ka pïën, manøgø beeye puunnö; 'ba wär nyooth jï dïlämi.
english: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi puunnö manøgø raŋe raŋø, ni tïïc gïna ci dëër gø nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi gïnögø raŋe raŋø. 'Ba ni näk mo puunnö manøgø onyaay dëër abïï, nee dëër gïna näk ocwääö, nee dëër pïën wala dëër gïn mo tïïc ka pïën, manøgø beeye puunnö mo raac, ni gïna ci dëëre ba waany.
english: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

anywaa: Dïlämi abïï dëël manøgø wala gïna näk ocwääö, mo tïïc ka waare mo cuup wala waare mo lïïna, wala teeŋ gïrpiny jaak mo tïïc ka pïën moa dëëtge puunnö, wär waaŋ. Kiper beeye puunnö mo raac. Gïna ci dëër gø wär put waaŋ ki maac.
english: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ puunnö manøgø, ni kär nyaay dëër abïï dëël, wala dëër gïna näk ocwääö, wala dëër gïrpiny jaak mo tïïc ka pïën,
english: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

anywaa: dïlämi wär cïpe ki dwøl nee gïna puunnö peny ki pïï. Køøre eni gïnögø wär tïïe nee bëëde kur keere ki nïne abïriiø møøk.
english: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:

anywaa: 'Ba køør kanyo nø peny gïna puunnö, dïlämi gïnögø wär cäŋ raŋŋø. 'Ba ni näk mo puunnö manøgø nëëni ni ree käre wiilø, këël na näk mo kär nyaay, gïna ci dëër gø ba waany. Gïnögø wär waaŋŋu ki maac, këël doo na mo kanya cam puunnö beeye løøk aciel wala ki løøk maya.
english: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ puunnö manøgø ni dhïïth køør mana nø penyi, kanya näk mo opuunnö manøgø dëër abïï dëël wala dëër pïën, wala dëër gïna näk ocwääö, wär ŋul wøk.
english: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ocäŋ nëënö dëër abïï dëël, nee dëër gïna näk ocwääö, wala dëër gïrpiny jaak mo tïïc ka pïën, ena gïn mo nyaay; gïno en dëër gø jaak wär waaŋ ki maac.
english: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba abïï dëël wala gïna näk ocwääö, wala gïrpiny jaak mo tïïc ka pïën, ni beeye gïna ö puunnö wøk dëëre kanya penyi, wär cäŋ nwøyø ki peny. Køøre eni dööŋ ni waany.»
english: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye ciik kiper puunnö mo oci dëër abïï mo cwääc ka waare mo cuup wala waare mo lïïna, wala dëër gïna näk ocwääö, wala dëër gïrpiny jaak mo tïïc ka pïën, ki man caani ni ge waany wala ba waany.
english: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye ciik kiper dhaanhø mo obëëdö ni dëëre da täw buny dëël. Dïcäŋo tïme ni luum waany mare di caanø, dwøl wär kïth baŋ dïlämi,
english: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

anywaa: ni ö dïlämi ni ci wøk baŋ ŋatøgø ŋää twïër ni raŋ dëër gø. 'Ba ni näk mo ŋatøgø ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël ocaŋŋø dëëre,
english: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

anywaa: dïlämi wär cïpe ki dwøl nee kännö ki weny ariiø mo kwøw mo waany, ki jaath man wø cwøl ni dhigba, ki thøøli mo kwayø, ki jaath man wø cwøl ni icöp, kiper ŋato luum waany mare caan.
english: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

anywaa: Dïlämi thuwø wär cïpe ki dwøl nee wenyø aciel ŋaal no olöö bäät dak mo yie da pïï mo käla yi naam mo kwödö.
english: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi wenyø mana kwøw lwøre lwørø na aciel ki jaath man wø cwøl ni dhigba, ki thøøli moa kwayø, ki jaath man wø cwøl ni icöp, ni cøt geni yi rem wenyø mana ŋaal bäät pïïa käl yi naam.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

anywaa: Ni ö eni na dïlämi ni jut dëër ŋatøgø ki remø kwöre abïriiø, ni beeye dëër ŋato luum waany mare caan enø ki køør täw mana en dëëre. Ni ö dïlämi ni put gø caan ki man näk mo ŋatøgø waany. Køøre eni wenyø mana kwøw wär put wec nee määte jaak dï pwöla.
english: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋato luum waany mare caan, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lïël jïëye wøk bëët, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï. Køøre eni dööŋ ni waany. Køøre nø, eni ööa yi twïër. 'Ba eni wär bëëde wøk ki nïne abïriiø ni ba døny yo oduŋkaara mare.
english: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, ŋatøgø jïër moe bëët wär lïël wøk, ni beeye jïëc wïïe, ki jïëc tïïe, ki jïëc nyeŋŋe, ki jïër møga bëët. Ni ö eni thuwø ni peny abïïe moe, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï. Køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.
english: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na ri bäc nïne, ŋatøgø wär känne ki nyïï nyöök rööm ariiø mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge; ki nyi røømmø ma dhaagø ma cwiine aciel mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre; ki møø mo pøøth ma rumme adäk mo ojääbö ki maaw, ni lwørra røk rumme apaar mar rumi man wø cwøl ni iipa, ni beeye muuy mar møk beel; ki maaw mo ena yi rumi man wø cwøl ni lög.
english: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi mano caan luum waany mar ŋatøgø, ŋatøgø ko olämme moe wär käl nyïm Wuuö Jwøk dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: «Køøre dïlämi nyi nywø røømmø aciel lwøre lwørø no olämi mar wëën bääyö, ni kuure ka maaw mana en yi rumi mar lög, ni cïp ge jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø.
english: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

anywaa: Køør manøgø eni nyi nywø røømmø wär ŋaale yi kanya en kur keere, kany wø ŋaal olämi yie mar wëën raay ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre. Kiper olämi mar wëën bääyö caala olämi mar wëën raay. Ena mar dïlämi, ni beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth.
english: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi wär lwöte ri rem olämi manøgø mar wëën bääyö ni naaŋ gø ro olap ïth cwïïc mar ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar cer cwïï gø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar tier cwïï gø.
english: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi thuwø lwötö ri maaw mana en yi rumi mar lög ni thii gø yo othäny cer caame,
english: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

anywaa: ni cøt lween cwïïe yi maaw manøgø ni en yo othäny cer caame enø ni ker gø ki lweete kwöre abïriiø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:

anywaa: Køøre eni na dïlämi maaw mana dööŋ yo othäny cere, mør wär naaŋ ro olap ïth cwïï ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar cer cwïï gø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar tier cwïï gø, ni beeye bäät kwöra naaŋ ki rem olämi mar wëën bääyö manøgø.
english: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi maaw mano dööŋ yo othäny cere wär wïïr wï ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ni mare tïïc gø no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na kar ŋatøgø.
english: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord.

anywaa: «Køøre dïlämi olämi mar wëën raay manøgø wär cïbe ni tïïe no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ki køør mana bëëde ni ba waany. Køør manøgø dïlämi olämi man wø waaŋ bäre wär ŋaale,
english: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

anywaa: ni waaŋ olämi manøgø man wø waaŋ bäre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kuure ka muuy mar møk beel. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø. Køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.
english: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo ŋatøgø can ni cere orëëm ki man cïp gïïögø, eni wär cïpe ki nyi nywø røømmø aciel no olämi mar wëën bääyö man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, ni tïï no okïdi na kar ŋatøgø, ni kuure ka paac wï møø mana pøøth ni wø en yi rumi mar iipa, no ojääbö ki maaw, na muuy mar møk beel, ki maaw mana en yi rumi mar lög,
english: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

anywaa: ka atuuy ariiø, wala nyïï akuyi ariiø, ni beege moa joode, na aciel olämi mar wëën raay, ni maya olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na ri bäc nïne, eni gïïögø noo døøc dëëre mo waany yøø wär kïth baŋ dïlämi dho oduŋkaany røømmø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi nyi nywø røømmø mar olämi mar wëën bääyö wär lwøre ni kuure ka maaw mana en yi rumi mar lög, ni tuuŋ ge yi jamø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø.
english: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:

anywaa: Køøre eni nyi nywø røømmø mar olämi mar wëën bääyö wär put ŋaal, ni lwöte ri rem gø ni naaŋ gø ro olap ïth cwïïc mar ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar cer cwïï gø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar tier cwïï gø.
english: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni thii maaw yo othäny cer caame.
english: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi maaw mana en yo othäny cer caame wär kere ki lween cwïïe kwöre abïriiø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi maaw mana en yo othäny cer caame, mør wär naaŋ ro olap ïth cwïï ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar cer cwïï gø, ki bäät lween dwøŋ mar tier cwïï gø, ni beeye bäät kwöra naaŋ ki rem olämi mar wëën bääyö manøgø.
english: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

anywaa: Ni ö maawi mano dööŋ yo othäny cere ni wïïr gø wï ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø, ni mare tïïc gø no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na kar ŋatøgø.
english: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi atuuy wala nyïï akuyi moa joot ŋatøgø wär put cïp no olämi,
english: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

anywaa: na aciel cïbe no olämi mar wëën raay, ni maya olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni kuure ka muuy mar møk beel. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na kar ŋatøgø ni luum waany mare caan enø.
english: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the Lord.

anywaa: «Manøgø beeye ciik kiper ŋat mo dëëre da ŋwellø mar täw buny dëël mo cere orëëm ki mana dee cïbö ki man døøc eni mo waany.»
english: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo dønynyu yi ŋööm Keenan noo cïba jïïu na thööŋŋu, noo dee øtø mo tïïa nee yie puunne yi ŋöömmögø noo lwørru na thööŋŋu enø,
english: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

anywaa: ŋata ci øtø manøgø jïre wär ööe ni caan gø jï dïlämi, ni kööe, ni ‹Yi øtø mara da gïn mo ree ee nyoodhø na gïr puunnö.›
english: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi wär put cïpö ki dwøl nee jammi jwïër wøk yi øtø kanyo poode ni eni poot kär døny yi øtø kuna raŋ puunnö manøgø, kiper nee jammi moa en yi øtø ba caan ni ba waany. 'Ba køøre nø, dïlämi wär luuny døny kuna raŋ yi øtø.
english: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi dëër øtø wär raaŋe. 'Ba ni näk mo puunnö mana en dëër øtø otïmö ni kwaar wala marr ni øtø ee løødø, ni nëëni ni ree ee luut piny ni dëër øtø ee wii maal,
english: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

anywaa: dïlämi wär duny wøk ni dëët dhi øtø ki nïne abïriiø.
english: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bïriet nïne, dïlämi wär døø kuna raŋ øtø. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ni näk mo puunnö manøgø onyaay dëër øtø,
english: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

anywaa: dïlämi wär cïpe ki dwøl nee kïte moa en puunnö rege käl wøk ni wet geni wøk ŋää pääny kany mo ba waany.
english: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

anywaa: Eni wär tïïe nee odhöönh mana puuc yi dëër øtø ki gø gööp wøk. Ni ö odhöönhnhi manøgø ni weti wøk ŋää pääny kany mo ba waany.
english: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

anywaa: Køøre jiy wär lwötge ki kïte møøk ni laage ge kar kïte moøgø, ni öömge ko odhöönh mo nyään ni puucge øtø ki gø.
english: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo puunnö ocäŋ tägö yi dëër øtø, køør mana ö dïlämi na nø tïïc gø nee kïte käl wøk, ni gøøp dëër øtø, ni nø cäŋi puuyö,
english: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;

anywaa: dïlämi wär cøøe ni raŋ gø. 'Ba ni näk mo puunnö manøgø onyaay dëër øtø, ena puunnö mo raac mo øtø ee tïïö ni ba waany.
english: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ødøgø wär put nyaa piny, ni beeye kïte moe ki cuge moe, ko odhöönh mana puuc dëëre ki gø; ni put gïïögø lwør ni weti wøk ŋää pääny kany mo ba waany.
english: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo odøny yi ødøgø kany wø bëëde no odëëdö, ŋatøgø tïmö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Nee da dhaanhø thuwø mo obuut yi ødøgø, wala mare cam yie, eni abïïe moe wär penye.
english: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö dïlämi noo raŋ puunnö manøgø, ni näk mo kär nyaay dëër øtø køør mana nø cäŋ øtø puuyö, wär put dïlämi caan ki man näk mo øtø manøgø waany, kiper mana ö puunnö manøgø ni aae.
english: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee øtø tïme ni waany, dïlämi wär lwöte ki weny ariiø, ki jaath man wø cwøl ni dhigba, ki thøøli moa kwayø, ki jaath man wø cwøl ni icöp,
english: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

anywaa: ni ŋaal wenyø aciel no olöö bäät dak mo yie da pï jøøro.
english: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

anywaa: Køøre eni jaath mana näk dhigba, ki icöp, ki thøøli moa kwayø, wär lwøre na aciel ki wenyø mana kwøw, ni cøt geni yi rem wenyø mana ŋaal yïth pï jøøro, ni jør øtø kwöre abïriiø,
english: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

anywaa: ni eni tïïya øtø ni waany ki rem wenynyøgø, ki pï jøøro moøgø, ki wenyø mana kwøw manøgø, ki dhigba manøgø, ki icöp manøgø, ki thøøli moa kwayø moøgø.
english: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

anywaa: Køøre eni wenyø mana kwøw wär put wec nee määt wøk dï pwöla ŋää pääny. Ni manøgø bäre tïïe no okïdi kiper øtø; køøre nø, øtø dööŋ ni waany.»
english: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ciik kiper teeŋ ŋwellø mar buny dëël, ki täw mo jelli,
english: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

anywaa: ki puunnö mo ena ra abïï dëël, wala dëër øtø,
english: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

anywaa: ki gïn mo opäny wøk, ki nyoonynyø, wala gïn mo obuth ni tar,
english: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

anywaa: ni beeye ki man ŋääi ki man näk mo gïna en dëër gø waany wala ba waany. Moøgø beege ciik kiper ŋwellø mo ena ri buny dëël, ki gïn mo opuunnö.
english: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caannu jï jø Icriel ni kööu jïge, ni ‹Kanyo näk dhaanhø ma dïcwøø da tuut mo ööa wøk ki yi jaath dëël mare, tuut moøgø dhaanhø døøye mo ba waany.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

anywaa: Ŋatøgø bëëdö ni ba waany ki køør tuut moøgø; nee tuut bëëdö ni muulö ki yi jaath mare, wala ba muuli, eni bëëdö ni ba waany.
english: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

anywaa: « ‹Pïën mano but ŋatøgø yie ni dëëre da tuut enø, tïmö ni ba waany. Ni gïn mo ŋatøgø opï bääte jaak tïmö ni ba waany.
english: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni ŋato gut pïën ŋatøgø, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mo opï piny bäät gïn mo ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø obëëdö bääte, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni ŋato gut dëër ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Wala ni näk mo ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø, oŋuut bäät ŋat mo waany ki laaw, ŋatøgø thuwø abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni køøm mo ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø opï bäät gø jaak kany wø cäädhe ki bäät arëën, køømøca tïmö ni ba waany.
english: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mo ogutö ki gïrpiny jaak røk gïïa pï ŋatøgø bäätge, eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi. Ni ŋato lwør gïïögø, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø, ni näk da ŋat mo ee gudö ki ceŋŋe mo käre lwøø ki pïï, ŋatøgø abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni dak ma mar odhöönh jaak mo ogut ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø, wär put nyath. 'Ba nee gïr tïïc mo tïïc ka jaath, wär put peny ki pïï.
english: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ŋatøgø ni dëëre da tuut enø, kanyo caŋ dëëre, dëëre wär kwäänne ki nïne abïriiø moo tïme ni waany yïthge; eni abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï mo kwödö. Køøre nø, eni dööŋ ni waany.
english: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bäc nïne, eni wär lwöte ka atuuy ariiø wala nyïï akuyi ariiø ni ö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki geni dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ni cïp geni jï dïlämi.
english: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi gïïögø cïbe cïbö, na aciel beeye olämi mar wëën raay, ni maya beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na kar ŋatøgø kiper tuut moa en dëëre.
english: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk dhaanhø ma dïcwøø da pï dëël mo oö wøk ki dëëre, eni dëëre bäre wär lwøe ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn ma abïï dëël jaak mo pï dëël oci dëëre, wala cøøa dëër pïën, gïneca wär put peny ki pïï. 'Ba gïneca bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaanhø ma dïcwøø obutö ki dhaagø, ni ö pï dëëlli wøk, geni karge riet dëëtge wär lwøkge ki pïï, 'ba ge bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø näk mo dhaagø da gïr mään mo otägö dëëre, eni bëëdö ni ba waany ki nïne abïriiø. Ni ŋat mo nyijøøgø ee gudö jaak, bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Ni teeŋ gïrpiny jaak mo nyijøøgø obut yie kanya bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään, gïneca ba waany. Ni gïrpiny jaak mo nyijøøgø opï bääte, gïneca ba waany.
english: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mo pïën niine mar nyijøøgø ee gudö jaak, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mo ogutö ki gïrpiny jaak mo nyijøøgø opï bääte, abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhaanhø guta pïën niine wala gïn mo nyijøøgø opï bääte jaak, eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo da dïcwøø mo obutö ki nyijøøgø, ni ö gïr määnni ni ci dëër ŋatøgø, ŋatøgø bëëdö ki nïne abïriiø ni ba waany. Ni pïën niine mo ŋatøgø obut yie jaak, pïëneca ba waany.
english: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaagø da remø mo ööa wøk ki dëëre ki nïne mo thööth ni paa kany wø ö gïr määnni dëëre, wala ni näk mo remø mana ö wøk ki dëëre poot cäätha nyïme jaak ni kaala nïne mo gïr mään, yïth nïne bëët moo beet nyijøøgø ni dëëre da remø, eni bëëdö ni ba waany, kaawat man wø bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään.
english: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

anywaa: Ni pïën niine man wø buut nyijøøgø yie ki yïth nïne bëët moa beede ni dëëre da remø, wär bëëde ni ba waany ni caala man wø bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään. Ni gïn mo eno pï bäät gø jaak, gïneca bëëdö ni ba waany ni caala man wø bëëde ni dëëre da gïr mään.
english: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mo gïïögø ee gudö tïmö ni ba waany. Ŋatøgø abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

anywaa: « ‹Kanyo cuŋ remø dëër nyijøøgø, dëëre wär kwäänne ki nïne abïriiø. Køøre nø, eni tïmö ni waany.
english: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri bäc nïne, eni wär lwöte ka atuuy ariiø, wala nyïï akuyi ariiø ni kïth geni baŋ dïlämi dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi aciel cïbe cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay, ni cïp maya no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre. Ni manøgø tïïc dïlämi no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na kar nyijøøgø kiper mana bëëde ni ba waany ki remø mana en dëëre.›
english: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Modhe en ka Aran, bëëdu ni jø Icriel you tïïö ni karge bäär ki gïï mo døøya geni mo ba waany, kiper nee ge ba thøwge ki køør bäŋ waany marge kanyo tïïcge kar bëëtö mara na en dïge ni ba waany.»
english: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ciik kiper dhaanhø ma dïcwøø mo da tuut mo ööa wøk ki yi jaath dëël mare, ki dïcwøø mo da pï dëël mo oö wøk ki dëëre mo eno tïmö ni ba waany ki køørge,
english: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

anywaa: ki dhaagø mo dëëre da gïr mään, ki ŋat mo da gïï mo ööa wøk ki dëëre, nee dïcwøø wala dhaagø, ki dïcwøø mo obutö ki dhaagø mo ba waany.
english: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe køør mana nø thøw wäät Aranni moa na ariiø, kanya cige nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na thøwge.
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;

anywaa: Eni na Wuuö Jwøk ena köö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï coku ma Aran nee eni ba døny yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki kany wäro manynye jaak, ni beeye kanya no ogëëŋö ka abïï nyïm rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay mana näk acanduk orïëbö ki gø, kiper nee eni ba thøøe. Kiper kany wø nyoodha raa yie ki yi pöölö beeye bäät rëëbi manøgø.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

anywaa: «'Ba jöö man wø ö Aranni noo døny yi kanya en kur keere ki gø beeye en: eni käädö ki rwaath no olämi mar wëën raay, ki nywø røømmø no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

anywaa: Eni jalabiny lïïna mana ciek na näk ocïp kur keere, wär røø dëëre, ni røø libaa lïïna dëëre man wø røø tier abïï, ni twöö kaa lïïna piere, ni ö abïï man wø kïth wïc, ni kïth gø wïïe. Moøgø beege abïïe mo ocïp kur keerge. Eni dëëre wär lwøe ki pïï, køøre ge kïthe ka dëëre.
english: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

anywaa: Køøre eni kädö baŋ jø Icriel ki nyöök atëëe ariiø no olämme mo wëën raay, ki nywø røømmø aciel no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

anywaa: «Køøre Aran rwaath wär cïbe no olämi mar wëën raay moe, ni tïïe no okïdi kiper dëëre ki jø paare.
english: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

anywaa: Ni lwør nyöök atëëe moa näk ariiø ni kïth ge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö eni na Aran ni tïïe ki ŋïïce ki ri kwääk ki baw kiper atëëe moø na ariiø yøø, na aciel tïïc kaper man ci jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni maya beeye kiper man käär raay.
english: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

anywaa: Køøre Aran diel mano päth ŋïïyi bääte na mar Wuuö Jwøk, wär cïbe ni tïïc gø no olämi mar wëën raay.
english: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the Lord's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

anywaa: 'Ba diel mano päth ŋïïyi bääte na man käär raay, wär cïp ni kwøw nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni tïïca eni no okïdi ki man wii nee aa dï paap na man wø käär raay.
english: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

anywaa: «'Ba Aran rwaath wär cïbe no olämi mar wëën raay moe, ni tïïe no okïdi kiper dëëre ki jø paare, ni ŋaal rwaadhøgø no olämi mar wëën raay enø ni beeye kiper raay moe ki dëëre.
english: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

anywaa: Køøre eni wär lwöte ka athaanh jwïël mar maac mo yi gø ee pääŋö ki cuk, ni lwøre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Ni lwöte ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met mana no oguurö, ni jøøbe ka ceŋŋe karge riet, ni kïth ge yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth na näk ogëëŋö.
english: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee eni ba thøøe, gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met wär cïp bäät maac nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee jïye rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay na en bäät acanduk rïëbe, ni beeye acanduk mana en ciiki yie moa tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

anywaa: Køøre eni lwötö ki rem rwaath ki lweete, ni ker gø dëër nyïm rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, ni ker remø mør piny ki lweete kwöre abïriiø nyïm rëëbi manøgø.
english: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

anywaa: «Køøre Aran ateea mana näk olämi mar wëën raay wär ŋaale kiper jiy, ni kïth remø mar gø yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth na näk ogëëŋö, ni tïïc remø ki jöö mana kwøŋ rem rwaath tïïc ki gø, ni mare ker gø dëër nyïm rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay, ni ker mør piny nyïm rëëbi manøgø.
english: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

anywaa: Ni eni mare tïïc gø no okïdi kiper kanya en kur keere na pere leth, ki køør mana bëët jø Icrielli ni ba waany ki køør gïïa bacge, ki teeŋ raay bëët moa tïïcge. Ni manøgø tïïe kaper oduŋkaany røømmø na en dïge ni beeye yïthakicge, ge na ba waany.
english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

anywaa: Aran ki mano døny kuna tïïc okïdi yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth, këël kanyo duu wøk, bäŋe dhaanhø mo nut yo oduŋkaany røømmø. Ni beeye okïdi mano tïïe kiper dëëre, kiper jø paare, kiper dhaanh Icriel bäre.
english: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

anywaa: «Køøre eni wär duny wøk baŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na en nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïc okïdi kiper gø, ni lwöte ki rem rwaath, ki rem ateea, ni naaŋ gø dëët tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the Lord, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

anywaa: Ni ö reme mørri ni ker gø ki lweete kwöre abïriiø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni eni tïïa gø ni waany, ni cïba gø kur keere ki køør mana bëët jø Icrielli ni ba waany.
english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba Aran kanyo nø thöör tïïc mar okïdi kiper kanya en kur keere na pere leth, kiper oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, eni ateea mana kwøw wär käl nyïm.
english: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

anywaa: Ni ö eni na Aran ni peeth ceŋŋe karge riet bäät wï ateea manøgø ni kwøw enø, ni køp raay bëët mo jø Icriel bäät gø, ki gïïa bacge, ki teeŋ raay bëët moa tïïcge, ni kïtha gïïögø bäät ateea manøgø; ni wëëk gø ciin paap, ni kïtha ŋata näk ojiiŋŋø kiper tïïc manøgø.
english: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

anywaa: Køøre ateea manøgø, raac jiy bëët kääre käärö ki dëëre ni kïth ge yi ŋöömö mo ba beet. Køøre ŋatøgø ateea wär put wii dï paap.
english: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

anywaa: «'Ba Aran wär put døø yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni gööny abïïe wøk dëëre moa näk lïïne na røøe kanya døny yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth, ni wii geni yie kaace.
english: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï yi kany mo ena kur keere, ni røø abïïe moe dëëre, ni put ö wøk ni cïp olämi man wø waaŋ bäre kiper dëëre, ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre kiper jiy; ni mare tïïc okïdi kiper dëëre, kiper jiy.
english: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

anywaa: Køøre eni maaw mar olämi mar wëën raay manøgø wär waaŋe ki maac bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋata wii ateea paap na man wø wec nee aae, abïïe moe wär penye ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï. Køøre nø, eni dunynya yi twïër.
english: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

anywaa: «'Ba rwaath ka ateea moa cïp no olämme mo wëën raay, na rem moge kïth yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki man tïï no okïdi, wär kïth wøk ŋää twïër, ni waaŋ pëëne moge ki maac, ki rïŋ moge, ki weenynye moge.
english: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato waaŋ geni abïïe moe wär penye, ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï. Køøre nø, eni dunynya yi twïër.
english: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

anywaa: «'Ba man tïmö na ciik kiperu mo bëëdö na bäre bäre: kanyo tïm nïr dwää abïriiø na apaar, wäru dëëtu dwøgu piny, nou ba cämö, ni bäŋe tïïc mo tïïyu, nee ŋat Icriel wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu;
english: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

anywaa: kiper beeye dïcäŋ mano tïïc okïdi yie kiperu, ki man tïmu nou waany. Køøre uuni, u tïmö nou waany nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki køør raay mou bëët.
english: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.

anywaa: Manøgø tïmö ni beeye cäŋ jwömö mar jwöm dëël jïïu na bäre, ni dëëtu you dwøk piny, nou ba cämö. Ni manøgø tïmö na ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
