english: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

anywaa: Dïlämi mano wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw noo røøny nee tïïe na dïlämi kar wänni beeye noo tïïc okïdi. Eni abïïe moa näk ocïp kur keerge na näk lïïne, wär røø dëëre,
english: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

anywaa: ni tïïc okïdi kiper kanya en kur keere na pere leth, kiper oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Ni ö eni thuwø ni tïïc okïdi kiper dïlämme, kiper dhaanh Icriel bäre.
english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

anywaa: «'Ba manøgø bëëdö na ciik kiperu mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ki man tïïc okïdi kiper raay bëët mo jø Icriel, ni tïïc ka yi cwiir yie aciel.» 'Ba gïnögø aput tïïc ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki gø.
english: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ki wääte ki jø Icriel bëët ni kööï jïge ni gïna cem Wuuö Jwøki beeye en:
english: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, saying,

anywaa: ‹Ni näk da ŋat dhi øt Icriel mo ŋädö ki dhieŋ wala nyi røømmø wala ateea no olämi yi twïër wala ŋaale wøk ŋää twïër,
english: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

anywaa: ni käre käl dho oduŋkaany røømmø ni cïp gø no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk nyïm oduŋkaara mar Wuuö Jwøk kaagø, ajäla mar remø mana øc piny tïmö ni ena bäät ŋatøgø. Eni remø akøny piny ki jaak, ni teeŋ ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

anywaa: Manøgø beeye kiper nee jø Icriel teeŋ olämme moa wara cïpge yi pwöla kälge baŋ Wuuö Jwøk dho oduŋkaany røømmø ni cïbi jï dïlämi, ni cïp ge jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the Lord.

anywaa: Dïlämi remø wär køny bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na en dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö eni thuwø ni waaŋ maaw no olämi man wø ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ba doo poodø ni ge cïpö ko olämme jï juuga näk otïïö na kït ateea, ni marge gaan wøk kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp. Luubö manøgø put bëëte na ciik jïge na bäre bäre ki yïth beenhnhe moge.›
english: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

anywaa: «Wär caanï jïge thuwø, ‹Ni näk da ŋat dhi øt Icriel, wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïge, mo cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre wala teeŋ olämi mør,
english: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

anywaa: ni ba käl olämi manøgø dho oduŋkaany røømmø nee cïbe jï Wuuö Jwøk, ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the Lord; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk da ŋat dhi øt Icriel wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïge mo cämö ki remø, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, dëëtwa neenwa neenø ki ŋata cam remø enø, ni tïïa eni ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

anywaa: Kiper jwïëy mo dëël ena ri remø, ni beeye na cïba gø jïïu nee køny bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte no okïdi kiperu, kiper beeye ki køør jwïëy ni wø tïm remø no okïdi.
english: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, acaana jï jø Icriel, ni «Kär dee dhaanhø dïïu mo cämö ki remø; këël wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu kär cämö ki remø thuwø.»
english: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk da ŋat Icriel wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïge mo cøøa baŋ dwaar, nee dwara lääy wala weny moa näk di camø, eni rem gø wär tïïe nee øc piny ni buŋ gø ki ŋøøm.
english: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

anywaa: Kiper jwïëy man wø en dëër lääy ena ri remø mare, ni beeye ni caana gø jï jø Icriel ni kär dee rem lääy mo camge. Kiper jwïëy man wø en dëër lääy ena ri remø mare, ni ŋat wø cam remø puta tïmö ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø näk da dhaanhø, nee ŋat Icriel wala wëëllö mo path, mo ocämö ki rïŋ lääy mo othøw keere wala lääy mo onäk cwienynyi, ŋatøgø abïïge wär penye ni lwøe ki pïï; 'ba eni bëëdö ni ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi. Køøre nø, eni tïmö ni waany.
english: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋatøgø abïïge ba penye ni ba lwøk dëëre, bääyö mare ena bääte keere.› »
english: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: Käru tïïö ki gïï wø tïïc yi ŋööm Ijep na bëëdu yie, ni ba tïïyu gïï wø tïïc yi ŋööm Keenan noo kïtha u yie; käru cäädhö køør ciik moge.
english: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

anywaa: Gwøgu luup ŋøl 'moa ki ciik 'moa ni caathu køørge ni wïthu you koorø. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: Uuni ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa wär gwøgu, ni beeye gïïo bëët dhaanhe ni kwøw ki køørge ni näk mo ee kïth bäät tïïc. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dee dhaanhø dïïu mo døøa ri watge mana kälge ri remø aciel ki gø ki man ci baŋ gø na dhaagø. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kär wäru døøc mo jööt ki man ciï baŋ meru na dhaagø, kiper ena meru; ï ba doo ci baŋe na dhaagø.
english: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ cï wäru na dhaagø; kiper ï døøya wäru mo jööt.
english: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ coku na dhaagø, nee nyiwäru wala coku mana nywøl meru, nee nywølla dï kal wala kääri ka käw.
english: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ nyikwaarï na dhaagø, nee nyi wäädï wala nyi nyaarï; kiper ge käla dëërï.
english: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ nyiwäru na dhaagø, kiper eni nywøla wäru, ni ena coku.
english: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ waau cöök wäru na dhaagø, kiper eni käla ri remø aciel ki wäru.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ maru cöök meru na dhaagø, kiper eni käla ri remø aciel ki meru.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.

anywaa: « ‹Kär wäru cöök wäru døøc mo jööt ki man ciï baŋ cïïe na dhaagø, kiper ena cï wäru.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ cï nyaarï na dhaagø, kiper ena cï wäädï; ï ba doo ci baŋ gø na dhaagø.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ cï coku na dhaagø, kiper ï døøya coku mo jööt.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.

anywaa: « ‹Dhaagø ki nyaare kär rwöpï ki man ciï baŋge na mään, ni ba ciï baŋ nyikwaare na dhaagø, nee nyi wääde wala nyi nyaare, kiper ge käla ri remø aciel, ni teeŋ gïnögø beeye gïn mo raac.
english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

anywaa: « ‹Cöök cïïï kär nywømï ki man ciï baŋe na dhaagø nee tïmge na nyäge ni cïïï poot kwøw.
english: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ dhaagø na dhaagø kanyo poot dëëre ni ba waany ki gïr mään.
english: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ cï dhaanhø mør na dhaagø, niï tïïya dëërï ni ba waany ki gø.
english: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.

anywaa: « ‹Ki røk obwöre moï kär dee gø mo jïëyï jïëö nee ge cïp no olämi jï jwø wø cwøl ni Mölek, kiper tïmö niï pääta nyeŋ Jwøï; ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ci baŋ dïcwøø ni butï ki gø kaawat man wø ci baŋ dhaagø, kiper ena gïn mo ec raac ki gø.
english: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

anywaa: « ‹Ïïni thuwø, kärï ci baŋ lääy ni butï ki gø niï tïïya dëërï ni ba waany ki gø; ni kär dee dhaagø mo ci nyïm lääy nee lääy ci baŋ gø na dhaagø; ni teeŋ gïnögø beeye gïn mo ogaa wøk ki ri bëëtö.
english: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dëëtu døøyu mo ba waany ki køør gïïögø; kiper wïth juurre moo riema wøk nyïmmu, oløny ni ba waany ki køør gïïögø.
english: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïm ŋöömö marge ni ba waany, aani ŋöömö manøgø bëëdö ni yaa nø raanynyø ki køør raay moa tïïc yie, ni nø tïïa gø nee jiye kwiere.
english: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, gwøgu ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa, ni ba tïïyu teeŋ gïïögø ni ec raac ki ge yøø, ni manøgø rwöpa ŋat Icriel ki wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu.
english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

anywaa: Kiper jøøa bëëdö nyïmmu yi ŋöömö manøgø, teeŋ gïïögø ni ec raac ki ge yøø atïïcge, ni ö ŋöömmögø ni put tïmö ni ba waany.
english: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋöömmögø tïïyu tïïö ni ba waany, u tïïa tïïö nou kwiere kaawat mana kwier wïth juurre moa bëëdö yie dïkwøŋ nyïmmu.
english: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper ŋat mo tïïya teeŋ gïïögø ni ec raac ki ge yøø, wär put tïmö ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gwøgu gïïa cema yøø, ni ba tïïyu teeŋ kööŋŋe moa raac eci ki ge na tïïc yi ŋöömö nou poot kär pïï yie, ni ba døøyu dëëtu mo ba waany ki køør gïïögø; kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.› »
english: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï dhaanh Icriel bäre ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Bëëdu nou ena kur keeru, kiper aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a ena kur keera.
english: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.

anywaa: « ‹Ŋati man nø dëëtu, menni ki wänni wär wøøre, ni gwøgu cäŋ jwömö mara. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Kär nou gaa baŋ juu møøk, ni ba lëënynyu dëëtu ki juu mo lammu. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø näk mou cïpö jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, wär cïpu ki jöö mo løny ki man jïëc uuni ki gø.
english: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.

anywaa: Teeŋ olämi manøgø wär put cam dïcäŋo cïpu gø yie, këël amöölla maya, 'ba mano dööŋ noo këët ri dää nïne wär put waaŋ ki maac.
english: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dagø mo ocamø ri dää nïne, beeye gïn mo raac ni ba løny ki man jïëy.
english: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

anywaa: Ŋato cam gø ri dää nïne, ajäla mare ena bääte, kiper eni gïn mo ocïp kur keere jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, apääde, ni teeŋ ŋatøgø wär put tïmö ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wäru kayu caammi yïth pwöth mou, kär kayu këël teegi, ni ba døøu køøru ki man kwanynyu caammi moa no odööŋ piny ri kac.
english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

anywaa: Ni ba døøu køøru ki man datu nyïïomøki mou wala ki man kwanynyu moa no opäth piny. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï kwätö, ni ba cäänï ka akaade, ni ba cäänï ki tööt dëër dhaanhø mør.
english: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï kööŋ ŋëët nyeŋŋa ki gïn ma tööt, kiper tïmö niï pääta nyeŋŋa, a na Jwøk marï; beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dhaanhø mør caanni, ni ba twierï gø. Ŋat mo tïïö baŋï ki gwel, gwete kär tïïyï nee ruue baŋï ki wäär bäre këël amöölla.
english: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dhaanhø ma miiŋ janynyï, ni ba rïï gïn mo cwaanya tielø nyïm cwør, 'ba bëëdï niï lwäära aani, a na Jwøk marï. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï ŋudö ki ŋøl mo patha kare kar løøk. Kär niï cwaga ŋata can, ni ba lwäärï ŋata kare dwøŋ; 'ba wär tïme ni mar dhaanhø ŋølï na kare.
english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï wïdö yïthakic jiy ni marï waac nyeŋ, ni ba jølï luubö mo raanynya jwïëc wadu. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dee män mo magï maaø ki yi cwïnyï ki ŋat pou. Wadu wär joogï; 'ba ni näk mo ba joogï, bääyö tïmö ni marï thuwø.
english: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

anywaa: « ‹Kär kwörï coolï, ni ba bëëdï niï män ki jø pou, 'ba mëërï ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Gwøgu ciik 'moa. Lääc paac ariiø ma teeŋi kär tïïyu nee dëëtge käärge. Pwöth mou kär piithu ki teeŋ wïth köödhi ariiø. Käru rwöö ka abïïe mo ocwääö ki teeŋ wïth waare ariiø.
english: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk da dïcwøø mo oci baŋ dhaagø ma laŋŋø na dhaagø, ni dhaaŋŋøgø onø miek dïcwøø mør, 'ba dhaagø manøgø poot kär wïïl wøk cer laŋ ni poot kär wiiø nee aae, geni, ge wär jääl; 'ba ge ba näk, kiper dhaagø manøgø poot kär wiiø.
english: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcwøø manøgø wär känne ki nywø røømmø no olämi mar wëën bääyö ni cïp gø jï Wuuö Jwøk dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni tïïc nywø røømmø no okïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kiper raay moa tïïc ŋatøgø, ni ö raayi moa tïïc ŋatøgø ni wëënni.
english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: « ‹Kanyo dønynyu yi ŋööm Keenan, kanyo pïïdhu ki teeŋ nyïïjenni bëët mo wø cam, nyïëdi moge wär kwaannu kaamar gïï mo ba waany. Wär bëëtge na gïï mo ba waany kiperu ki cwiiri adäk. Kär geni cam.
english: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ŋweer cwiiri, nyïëdi moge tïmö ni ena kur keerge, no olämme mo Wuuö Jwøk di pwøø ki køørge.
english: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na bïï cwiiri, nyïëdi moge løny ki man cammu ge. Ki køør mano tïïyu manøgø bäre, nyïëdi mo ociek jïïu omeet. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Rïŋö mo remø mare poot ena dëëre kär cammu. « ‹Käru tïïö ki jap adïëda wala u tïïya tïï thïëth.
english: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

anywaa: « ‹Kär deŋ wïthu liellu, ni ba ŋatu jïëc tïgu.
english: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø näk mo dhaanhø jwöŋö kiper dhaanhø mo othøw, kär dëëre pwöde ki gïn mo beth. Uuni, kär dëëtu kätu. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kär nyïïu päätu ki man tïïyu ge na kääpe, kiper nee paac ba päth yi tïï käp, ni put paaci tïmö ni raac.
english: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

anywaa: « ‹Gwøgu cäŋ jwömö mara ni wøørru kar lam mara na en kur keere. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Käru ci kun pëënynyu jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø ki jap ajuuk, kiper u tïmö nou ba waany ki køørge. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Wøørru jøøa wïthge da lwaar ni beege jäle, ni lwäärru aani, a na Jwøk maru. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kanyo näk mo da wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö ka uuni yi ŋöömö maru, kär dee gïn mo raac mo tïïyu tïïö dëëre.
english: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

anywaa: Wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu wär raŋŋu kaamar ŋat pou, ni mëërru ki eni kaawat man wø mëërru ki dëëtu. Kiper uuna bëëdö na wëëlle yi ŋööm Ijep. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Käru ŋudö ki ŋøl mo patha kare kar løøk, ni ba mudu ki jap røm mou.
english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

anywaa: Jap røm mou wär bëëtge ni tiir, nee beeye mëëjaan wala iipa wala in.  Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgønø, ciik 'moa bëët ki luup ŋøl 'moa bëët wär gwøgu ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Ni näk da dhaanhø røk jø Icriel wala røk wëëlle moa path mo bëëdö Icriel mo nyey mo käla dëëre ee cïbö jï jwøa cwøl ni Mölek, ka adïëri møn, ŋatøgø wär put 'näk. Jø paac ŋatøgø wär putge këërö ki kïte.
english: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

anywaa: Aani thuwø dëëtwa raŋwa raŋŋø ki ŋateca ni puta eni tïïc ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge, kiper eni nyey mana käl dëëre acïbe jï Mölek, ni eni raanynya kar lam mara na en kur keere ni pääta nyeŋŋa na en kur keere.
english: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jø paac wïthge ege paany wøk kanya ö ŋatøgø na cïp nyaare jï Mölek, ni kärge ŋatøgø nääö,
english: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

anywaa: aani ki dëëra dëëtwa raŋwa raŋŋø ki ŋateca ki jø paare, ni puta eni tïïc ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge, ni beeye eni ki jiy bëët moa caath køøre na gaa baŋ Mölek, ni ki mana wøørge gø caala man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp.
english: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo ogaa baŋ jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø ki jap ajuuk, ni ci cwïnye køørge kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp, aani dëëtwa raŋwa raŋø ki ŋateca ni puta eni tïïc ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

anywaa: « ‹Cïbu dëëtu kur keeru ni bëëdu nou ena kur keeru, kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: Uuni, gwøgu ciik 'moa ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc; beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp u kur keeru.
english: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo janynya wänni wala menni, ka adïëri møn, ŋatøgø wär put 'näk, kiper wänni wala menni ajanynye. Kwör remø mare ena bääte keere.
english: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo kännö ki luk ki cï dhaanhø mør, eni na kännö ki luk enø, ki dhaagø manøgø, ka adïëri møn ge wär put 'näk.
english: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ cï wänni na dhaagø, eni døøya wänni mo jööt; ka adïëri møn ge karge riet wär put 'näk. Kwör remø marge ena bäätge keerge.
english: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ cï nyaare na dhaagø, ka adïëri møn, ge karge riet wär put 'näk, kiper gena tïïö ki gïn mo ogaa wøk ki ri bëëtö. Kwör remø marge ena bäätge keerge.
english: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ dïcwøø nee bute ki gø kaawat man wø ci baŋ dhaagø, ge karge riet gena tïïö ki gïn mo ec raac ki gø. Ka adïëri møn, ge wär put 'näk. Kwör remø marge ena bäätge keerge.
english: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo dhaagø di nywømø ni rwöp gø ki mii dhaaŋŋøgø, manøgø beeye gïn mo raac. Geni karge dääy ge wär waaŋ ki maac, nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo ena dïïu.
english: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ lääy na dhaagø, ka adïëri møn, ŋateca wär put 'näk. Uuni thuwø, lääy wär putu 'näk.
english: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaagø mo cøøa baŋ lääy na dïcwøø, dhaagø manøgø ki lääy wär putu 'näk. Ka adïëri møn ge wär put 'näk. Kwör remø marge ena bäätge keerge.
english: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo lwøra coki, nee beeye nyiwänni wala coki mana nywøl menni, nee dëër gø joode, ni ö nyaanøgø ni joot dëër nyenøgø, manøgø beeye gïn mo duunnö ki räny nyeŋ. Geni ge wär put tïïc ni tøør ni nëënö jï tuuŋge. Nyenøgø aci baŋ coki na dhaagø. Bääyö mare ena bääte.
english: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ dhaagø mo dëëre da gïr mään ni bute ki gø na dhaagø, ŋatøgø aci baŋ dhaagø ni gïr mään nut ree, ni ö dhaage manøgø ni cïp dëëre ni ree da gïr mään. Geni karge riet wär putge tïmö ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni thuwø kär dee dhaanhø mo ci baŋ mari cöök menni na dhaagø wala waai cöök wänni, kiper teeŋ ŋatøgø mare døøn ri ŋata kälge ri remø aciel ki gø. Bääyö marge ena bäätge keerge.
english: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋ cï wänni cöök wänni na dhaagø, eni døøya cöök wänni mo jööt. Geni raay moge ena bäätge keerge. Geni ge thøw ni bäŋ obwöre jïge.
english: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo lwøra cï coki na dhaagø, gïnögø beeye gïn mo raac. Ŋatøgø coki atïïe ni jööt. Geni ge ba jïti ko obwöre.
english: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni, gwøgu ciik 'moa bëët ki luup ŋøl 'moa bëët, ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc, kiper nee ŋöömmo kïtha u yie noo bëëdu yie, nou ba tïïa nou kwiere.
english: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

anywaa: Uuni, käru cäädhö køør kööŋŋe mo wø tïïc wïth juurre moo riema wøk nyïmmu, kiper geni teeŋ gïïögø bëët yøø atïïcge. Kiper manøgønø, aana männö ki geni.
english: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, anø caana jïïu ki man näk mo ŋöömö marge cøøa jïïu, ni beeye aani ki dëëra noo cïp gø jïïu nee ci jïïu, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na pää uuni ki wïth juurre.
english: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgønø, lääy mana waany wär bëëde ni you pääö ki mana ba waany, ni bëët wenyø mana waany ni you pääö ki mana ba waany. Dëëtu kär tïïyu ni ec raac ki uuni ki køør lääy wala wenyø wala gïrpiny jaak mo muuli ka piny røk gïïa pääa ki uuni na näk ba waany.
english: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

anywaa: Uuni, bëëdu nou ena kur keeru na 'moa, kiper aani na Wuuö Jwøk, a ena kur keera. Ni beeye aani na cïp uuni kur keeru ki røk wïth juurre møga, nou bëëdu ni uuna 'moa.
english: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo da dïcwøø wala dhaagø dïïu mo ree da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, wala waŋe riek ki jap ajuuk, ka adïëri møn, teeŋ jøøgø wär put 'näk. Ge wär put këërö ki kïte; kwör remø marge ena bäätge keerge.› »
english: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Caanï jï dïlämme, wäät Aran, ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kär dee dïlämi mo tïïya dëëre ni ba waany ki køør dhaanhø mo othøw yïthakic tuuŋge,
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

anywaa: ni näk mo paa tuuŋge moa kälge ri remø aciel ki gø kiree, kaamar menni, ki wänni, ki wääde, ki nyaare, ki coki ma dïcwøø,
english: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

anywaa: ki coki ma dhaagø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, mo bëëdö buute kiper eni poot bäŋ dïcwøø jïre. Ki køør coki manøgø na dhaagø enø, løny ki man tïïc dëëre ni ba waany.
english: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

anywaa: Dïlämi dëëre kär tïïe ni ba waany dï tuuŋge ki køør nywöm mare, nee ba duunne ka apääda dëëre.
english: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

anywaa: « ‹Dïlämme wïthge kär määnyge ki bøønne, ni ba ŋatge deŋ jïëc tïkge, ni ba pwötge dëëtge ki gïï mo beth kiper thøø.
english: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

anywaa: Geni, ge wär bëëtge ni ge ena kur keerge na 'moa, a na Jwøk marge, ni ba päätge nyeŋŋa, a na Jwøk marge, kiper beeye geni ni wø waaŋ olämme ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpge na cam jïra, a na Jwøk marge. Geni, ge wär bëëtge ni ge ena kur keerge.
english: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dee dïlämi mo nywøma dhaagø mo ree ee päädö ki køør tïï käp, ni ba nywøm dhaagø mo onø bødhø baŋ cwøre. Kiper dïlämi ena kur keere na mara, a na Jwøk.
english: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

anywaa: Uuni, u jø Icriel, dïlämi wär raŋŋu ni ena kur keere, kiper beeye eni ni wø cïp cam no olämi jïra, a na Jwøk maru. Dïlämi wär bëëde ni ena kur keere ki jïïu, kiper aani na Wuuö Jwøk, na cïp u kur keeru, a ena kur keera.
english: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the Lord, which sanctify you, am holy.

anywaa: « ‹Nyi dïlämi thuwø, ni näk mo ree ee päädö ki køør tïï käp, eni pääta wänni; eni wär waaŋ ki maac.
english: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïlämi mana kare dwøŋ yïthakic nyïïmenni, na näk maar rööny othii wïïe, no orøønyø ki man käär abïïk dïlämi, kär jïëye wiie ni rege jwälö ni ba jeec abïïe moe kiper thøø.
english: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

anywaa: Eni kär ci bäät dhaanhø mo othøw, ni ba tïïc dëëre ni ba waany, këël thøwa wänni wala menni;
english: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

anywaa: ni ba døny wøk ki yi kar lam mana en kur keere kiper thøø, kiper nee kar lam mara ba pääde, a na Jwøk mare, kiper rööny mana røønya eni ki gø, a na Jwøk mare, ena bääte, ki køør mana thïïm wïïe ki maaw. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba eni wär tïme ni nywøma nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue.
english: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

anywaa: Dhaagø ma cï thøø, ki dhaagø mo obøth, ki dhaagø mo ree ee päädö ki køør tïï käp, teeŋ mään moøgø kär nyöömmö rege. 'Ba eni wär tïme ni nywøma nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue røk jø poge,
english: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

anywaa: kiper nee kunhnhö mare ba tïme ni ba waany røk jø poge, kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp eni kur keere.› »
english: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the Lord do sanctify him.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ki røk jø wø käl dëërï, këël beenhnhe moge moo ööi, bäŋe ŋat mo dëëre da möönynyö mo nyänhnhö ki man cïp cam no olämi jïra, a na Jwøk mare.
english: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, kär dee dhaanhø mo nyänhnhö mo dëëre da möönynyö, nee cwør, wala ŋwøl, wala oliec, wala dhaanhø mo yi cwääc mare ba beer,
english: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

anywaa: wala dhaanhø mo tiete rege baŋø wala ceŋŋe oränynyö,
english: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

anywaa: wala dhaanhø mo kööre da cala wala mo ocwääö ni ciek døc, wala dhaanhø mo da gïn mo ogwäyö ri nyeŋŋe, wala dhaanhø mo dëëre da täw mo jelli, wala dhaanhø mo jage rege dïnö.
english: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

anywaa: Ki røk jøw okäl dëër dïlämi ma Aran, bäŋe dhaanhø mo dëëre da möönynyö mo nyänhnhö ki man cïp olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper mana näk da möönynyö dëëre, eni kär nyänhnhö ki man cïp cam no olämi jïra, a na Jwøk mare.
english: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the Lord made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

anywaa: Eni løny jïre ki man cäme ki cam man wø cïp jïra no olämi, a na Jwøk mare, ni beeye teeŋ cam mana en kur keere ki mana en kur keere na pere leth.
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, kiper mana näk dëëre da möönynyö, ba løny jïre ki man døny yi kanya en kur keere nyïm abïïna näk gëëŋi, ni ba nyänh buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, kiper nee kar lam mara na en kur keere ba pääde. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp gø kur keere.› »
english: Only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe gïïögø aput caan jï Aran ki wäät Aran ki jø Icriel bëët.
english: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ki wääte nee dëëtge gwøkge ki muuce moa en kur keerge ni wø cïp jø Icrielli kur keerge jïra, kiper nee nyeŋŋa na en kur keere ba päätge. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Caanï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ki røk jø wø käl dëëtu bëët këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou moo ööi, ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo nyänhnha buut muuce moa en kur keerge ni wø cïp jø Icrielli kur keerge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋatøgø ba waany, eni puta tïmö ni tøør nyïma. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mo da dhaanhø røk jø wø käl dëër Aran mo dëëre da täw buny dëël mo muuö, wala mo dëëre da tuut mo ööa wøk ki yi jaath dëël mare, eni kär cämö ki muuce moa en kur keerge këël mano tïme ni waany. Ni näk da dhaanhø mo guta gïn mo ba waany, na gïn mo dhaanhø mo othøw ee gudö, wala dhaanhø mo pï dëëre oö wøk,
english: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

anywaa: wala dhaanhø mo guta gïn mo muuli ki piny mo døøya eni mo ba waany, wala guta dhaanhø mo døøya eni mo ba waany ki køør gïna tïïc gø ni ba waany,
english: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

anywaa: dhaanhø mo guta teeŋ gïïögø tïmö ni ba waany këël mano päth cäŋŋi. Eni kär cämö røk muuce moa en kur keerge këël kanyo lwøk dëëre ki pïï.
english: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo päth cäŋŋi, eni tïmö ni waany. Ki køør manøgø, eni cämö ri muuce moa en kur keerge, kiper beeye cam mare.
english: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

anywaa: Eni kär cämö ki lääy mo thøwa eni keere, wala mo onäk cwienynyi, ni ba tïïc dëëre ni ba waany ki køør gø. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Dïlämme gïïa cema geni ki ge wär gwøkge, kiper nee ge ba jïtge ki raay ki køørge, nee ba thøwge ki køør mano päätge ge. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp geni kur keerge.
english: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the Lord do sanctify them.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dhaanhø jaak kär cämö ki muuce moa en kur keerge. Dhaanhø mo wëëllö mo bëëdö ki dïlämi, wala dhaanhø mo tïïö baŋe ki gwel, kär cämö ki muuce moa en kur keerge.
english: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dïlämi da laŋŋø mo ee ŋeeø ki gwete na mare, wala laaŋe mo nywølla paare, løny ki man cämge ri cam mare.
english: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk nyi dïlämi onywøm dhaanhe mørri jaak, eni kär cämö ki gïï wø cïp kur keerge na muuce.
english: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo nyi dïlämi odööŋ na cï thøø wala obøth baŋ cwøre ni bäŋ nyilaal jïre, ni duu po wänni kaawat mana bëëde ni poot thiinh, eni løny jïre ki man cäme ri cam wänni; 'ba dhaanhø jaak kär cämö ri gø.
english: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo ocämö ri muuce moa en kur keerge ni kuue, eni cam manøgø na en kur keere enø, kar gø wär dwøge ni mëën bäät gø ki bïï wï cam ni cïp gø jï dïlämi.
english: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

anywaa: Dïlämme muuce moa en kur keerge na cïp jø Icrielli jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kär päätge,
english: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the Lord;

anywaa: ni ge kïtha bäät jiy ka ajäl bääyö ki køør mano ö jiyi noo camge muuce moa en kur keerge; kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp geni kur keerge.› »
english: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the Lord do sanctify them.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ki wääte ki jø Icriel bëët, ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ‹Ni näk da ŋat dhi øt Icriel wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö Icriel mo cïpö ko olämi mare, nee beeye olämi man wø cïp na mar kööŋ, wala olämi man wø cïp na mar met ec jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre,
english: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the Lord for a burnt offering;

anywaa: kiper nee olämme moøgø jïëc jïïu, wär tïme na rwaath, wala nywø røømmø, wala nywø ateea mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

anywaa: Ni näk mo lääy da gïn mo di jøøŋŋø ree, kär cïpu, kiper ba jïëc jïïu.
english: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

anywaa: Kanyo näk dhaanhø cïpö jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämi man wø duunni ki mëër ni eni wëëga kööŋ mare thur kare, wala nee cïbe no olämi mar met ec røk dhäk moe wala røk dïëk moe, wär näk mo paya ni bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö ree, kiper nee jïëc.
english: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

anywaa: Lääy ma cwør, wala lääy mo da kare kany mo otoor wala da gïn mo oŋaal gø, wala mo dëëre da atwøda mo muulö ki tuut, wala täw mo jelli, wala nyoonynyø, teeŋ lääy moøgø kär cïpu jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the Lord, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ma dhieŋ wala diel mo cwääc mare ba beer wala da gïn mo ogwäyö ri cwääc mare, løny ki man cïpu gø no olämi mar met ec, 'ba ba jïëc no olämi man wø cïp na mar kööŋ.
english: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

anywaa: Lääy mo odïnö, nee dïn ni di kamø wala ba kam, kär cïpu no olämi jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ba tïïyu teeŋ gïnögø yi ŋöömö maru,
english: Ye shall not offer unto the Lord that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

anywaa: ni kär nou lwøra teeŋ lääy moøgø baŋ dhaanhø ma jur kiper nee cïpu na cam no olämi jïra, a na Jwøk maru, kiper gïïa raany geni poot ena dëëtge ni da gïn mo di jøøŋŋø dëëtge; geni, ge ba jïëc jïïu.› »
english: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo näk da dhieŋ, wala røømmø, wala ateea mo onywølø, wär wec nee bëëde ki nïne abïriiø ki menni, 'ba ki mano täge ri bäc nïne, løny ki man jïëy no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dhieŋ wala diel kär ŋaallu ki nyaare dïcäŋ aciel.
english: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

anywaa: «Kany wø cïpu olämi mar dwøk met ec jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, wär cïpu ki jöö mo løny ki man jïëc u ki køøre.
english: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the Lord, offer it at your own will.

anywaa: Olämi manøgø wär put cam dïcäŋögø, ni bäŋe gø mo weyu wiiø ree mo këëta amöölla. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ciik 'moa wär gwøgu ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the Lord.

anywaa: Uuni, nyeŋŋa na en kur keere kär päätu, 'ba u jø Icriel, a wär raŋŋu naa ena kur keera. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cïp u kur keeru,
english: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the Lord which hallow you,

anywaa: na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, naa bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Moi beege kwör ajwöm moa näk yaa cïp piny, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege kwör ajwöm moo luumge gøøu piny nee bëëtge na acooŋe mo ena kur keerge.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

anywaa: « ‹Ki yïth nïne abïciel tïïe løny ki man tïï; 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne beeye cäŋ jwömö man wø jwöm dëël yie, ni beeye cäŋ acooŋa mo ena kur keere. Kär dee tïïe mo tïïyu tïïö, kiper beeye cäŋ jwömö jï Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth kwöro bëëdu yïthge bëët.
english: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the Lord in all your dwellings.

anywaa: « ‹Moi beege kwör ajwöm moa näk yaa cïp piny, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege moo luumge gøøu piny nee bëëtge na acooŋe mo ena kur keerge ki køør kwöra cïïmmi yïthge.
english: These are the feasts of the Lord, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø tïm nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ na apaar kurŋween, kanyo päth cäŋŋi, beeye cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie man wøør aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the Lord's passover.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïm nïr dwäänögø na apaar kurbïïc, tïmö ni beeye cäŋ ajwöma mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø man wøør aani yie, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Ki yïth nïne abïriiø wäru bëëdu nou cama møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø.
english: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the Lord: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ wär jïtu ka acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere. Uuni kär dee tïïc mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö.
english: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne abïriiø wäru bëëdu nou cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre ri bïriet nïne wär jïtu ka acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere. Uuni kär dee tïïc mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö.› »
english: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kanyo dønynyu yi ŋöömmo cïba jïïu, kanyo kayu caammi moo ciek yie, wäru kännu ki ŋaaŋa røk caammi mo okwøŋ ciek ni cïpu gø jï dïlämi.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni tuuŋ ŋaaŋa manøgø yi jamø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nou jïëc ki køøre, ni kanyo tuuŋ gø yi jamø beeye yi cäŋ mana en køør cäŋ jwömö.
english: And he shall wave the sheaf before the Lord, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋo tuuŋŋu ŋaaŋa mano tuuŋŋi yi jamø, wäru cïpu ki nyi røømmø ma nywøk mo cwiine aciel mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, ni cïbi no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Muuy mar møk beel mano cïp ko olämi manøgø wär tïme na rumme ariiø ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mar iipa, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, ni cïbi no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kuur ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki ma thääŋ thääŋ rumi man wø cwøl ni in.
english: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the Lord for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

anywaa: Uuni, käru cämö ki møø mo odeelø, ni ba nyämu ki beel mo omuuö wala twiinye, këël dïcäŋo cïpu olämi jïra, a na Jwøk maru. Manøgø beeye ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou moo ööi, noo gwøgu ki yïth kwöro bëëdu yïthge bëët.
english: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ki mano täge ki cäŋ mano täk køør cäŋ jwömö, ni beeye dïcäŋo kälu ŋaaŋa mar beel no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, wäru kwäänu ki nïne ma kar juu abïriiø,
english: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

anywaa: këël mano këët ri dïcäŋ mano ööi køør bïriet juu, ni beege nïne ma pïërabïïc. Køøre nø, u cïpö ki muuce mo beel moa nyärö jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ki yïth kwöro bëëdu yïthge, ŋati man nø wär känne ki dääpe ariiø no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, ni dääpö man nø beeye møø ma yïth rumme ariiø røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mar iipa. Møø manøgø wär näk mo pøøth ni bul ni ree da thømmø, ni beeye møk caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek ni wø cïp jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïo kuurru ki dääpe beeye nyöök rööm abïriiø mo cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo di jøøŋŋø rege, ki rwaath, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, nee tïmge no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no okuurö ki muuy mar møk beel ki muuy mar køøŋø mo wø cïp no okuurö ki lääy man nø no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø ŋwääi ni met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the Lord, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: Uuni thuwø, wäru cïpu ki nywø ateea no olämi mar wëën raay, ki nyïï nyöök rööm ariiø mo cwiicge oceele no olämi man wø duunni ki mëër.
english: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

anywaa: Dïlämi nyïï nyöök rööm moøgø na ariiø yøø wär tuuŋŋe yi jamø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ee kuurö ki dääpe mo møk caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek no olämi man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø. Gïïögø wär bëëtge na gïï mo ena kur keerge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper dïlämi.
english: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the Lord, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the Lord for the priest.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø wär tïme na cäŋ mo luumme you gøø piny man wø jïtu yie ka acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere. Kär dee tïïe mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö. Manøgø bëëdö na ciik na bäre bäre yïth kwöro bëëdu yïthge bëët këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou moo ööi.
english: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wäro kayu caammi mo ociek yi ŋöömö maru, kär nou kaya pwöth mou këël teegi moge, ni ba døøu køøru ki man kwanynyu moa no odööŋ piny. Wär weyu kiper jøøa can ki wëëlle moa path mo wø bëëdö dïïu. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.› »
english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Kany wø tïme na bïriet dwäde, dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ, wär jïtu ki jwöm ni kooth tuŋi mo par wïc, ni jït jiyi ka acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

anywaa: Kär dee tïïe mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö. 'Ba wäru cïpu ko olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Noo tïm nïr dwää abïriiø manøgø na apaar, tïmö ni beeye Cäŋ Man Wø Tïïc Okïdi Yie. Wär tïme ni beeye cäŋ acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere kiperu, ni dwøgu dëëtu piny nou ba cämö, ni cïpu olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kär dee tïïc mo tïïyu tïïö dïcäŋögø, kiper beeye dïcäŋ okïdi man tïïc okïdi yie na karu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the Lord your God.

anywaa: Ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo dëëre ba dwøk piny ni ba kwier cam dïcäŋ manøgø, eni wär put tïmö ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo tïïya tïïc dïcäŋögø, ŋateca puta ka 'näk yïthakic tuuŋge.
english: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

anywaa: Kär dee tïïc mo tïïyu tïïö na bäre bäre. Manøgø beeye ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre këël mano këët yïth beenhnhe mou moo ööi, ki kwöru bëëdu yïthge bëët.
english: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

anywaa: Cäŋ manøgø tïmö ni beeye cäŋ jwömö mar jwöm dëël jïïu na bäre, ni dwøgu dëëtu piny nou ba cämö. Ki mano täge ni nïr dwääy abïŋween ni cäŋ pätha piny, këël mano këët cäŋ maya ni cäŋ pätha piny, wär gwøgu na cäŋ jwömö mara.»
english: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Noo tïm nïr dwää abïriiø manøgø na apaar kurbïïc, beeye kanyo täk Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ni Jøw Bëëdö Yïth Abïle ki nïne abïriiø, ni wøørra aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the Lord.

anywaa: Cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ wär dee acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere. Kär dee teeŋ tïïc mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö.
english: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïne abïriiø wäru bëëdu nou cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba ri bäc nïne, wär jïtu ka acooŋa mo ocïp kur keere ni cïpu ko olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Manøgø beeye aŋuun acooŋa. Kär dee tïïc mo teek mo tïïyu tïïö.
english: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.

anywaa: « ‹Moøgø beege kwör ajwöm moa cïba piny, a na Wuuö Jwøk, moo luumge gøøu piny nee bëëtge na kwör acooŋe mo ena kur keerge, ki man cïpu olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo møk beel, ko olämme møga, ki muuce mo kwøŋ, ni man nø cïpa dïcäŋ mare,
english: These are the feasts of the Lord, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

anywaa: ni meedu bäät mo wø cïpu yïth nïr jwöm 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki muuce mou mo wø cïpu, ko olämme mo wø cïpu na mo kööŋ, ko olämme mo wø cïpu na mo met ec ni wø cïpu jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Beside the sabbaths of the Lord, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba noo tïm nïr dwää abïriiø na apaar kurbïïc, kanyo nø kayu caammi moa en yi ŋöömö maru, ajwöma mar Wuuö Jwøk wär wøørru ki nïne abïriiø. Dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ wär jïtu ki jwöm, ni jïtu ki jwöm ri bäc nïne.
english: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme ni dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ, wär lwötu ki nyïïjenni mo mïërö, ki bäät twöe, ki bäät jenni moa bøøge moge thööth, ki bäät jera no otuy waŋ naam. Køøre nø, wäru bëëdu ni yïthu met ki nïne abïriiø nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God seven days.

anywaa: Uuni ajwöma manøgø wär wøørru ki nïne abïriiø ki yi cwiir na ajwöma man wøør aani yie, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Manøgø wär tïme na ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre këël mano këët røk beenhnhe mou moo ööi. Ajwöma manøgø wär wøørru ki dwää abïriiø cooth.
english: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the Lord seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

anywaa: Wäru bëëdu yïth abïle ki nïne abïriiø. Jø Icriel bëët wär bëëtge yïth abïle,
english: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

anywaa: kiper nee ŋäc beenhnhe mou moo ööi nou yaa tïïö nou bëëdu yïth abïle kanya käla u wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.› »
english: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe luum kwöra no ocïp Wuuö Jwøki piny aput caan jï jø Icriel.
english: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kööm jø Icriel nee känge jïrï ki maaw mana tøŋ kiper lambae, mo käla ri nyïï jenni mo wø wel na mädhi, nee lambae bëëtge ni liel cooth.
english: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

anywaa: Køøre Aran lambae wär bëëtge ni ee jiiŋŋø yo oduŋkaany røømmø, jï wøk ŋää abïïna näk gëëŋi mar kanya en kur keere na pere leth na en acanduki yie mar luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, ni tïïc ge nee bëëtge ni liel cooth nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki mano täge ki wïthïënhö këël amöölla. Manøgø tïmö na ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre këël yïth beenhnhe mou moo ööi.
english: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the Lord continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

anywaa: Aran lambae wär bëëtge ni ee jiiŋŋø na karge cooth bäät gïn wø cïp lambae bääte na näk tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ na en nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the Lord continually.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni wärï lwötï ri møø mana pøøth ni deelï gø no opamø na apaar kurriiø; ni møø man nø beeye møø ma rumme ariiø røk rumme apaar man wø en yi rumi mar iipa.
english: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

anywaa: Køøre ïïni muunni moøgø wär cïïmmï na tëëŋŋe ariiø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk bäät tharabëëta mana näk dëëre olëënynyö ki warkey mana tøŋ, na abïciel moi nø ocïïmmö na tëëŋŋö aciel.
english: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre ïïni gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met mana tøŋ wär cïïmmï bäät tëëŋŋö man nø na gïr par wïc, nee cääthge ki muunni na aciel no olämi man wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ki cäŋ jwömö cooth, Aran muunni moøgø wär cïp nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Manøgø bëëdö ni beeye gïn mo otuudö kiper jø Icriel mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the Lord continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

anywaa: Muunni moøgø bëëdö na mo Aran ki jø wø käl dëëre, ni bëëde ni camge yi kany mo ena kur keere. Kiper beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth ri kuna näk kurge røk olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the Lord made by fire by a perpetual statute.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør mo menni nyi jø Icriel, mo wänni nyï Ijep. Nyenøgø ena aa wøk dï jø Icriel, ni këëtge ki ŋat Icriel yi twïër.
english: And the son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø na o nyi jø Icriel enø, Wuuö Jwøk apääde ni jany gø. Kanyøgø ena put jiyi kïth baŋ Modhe. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Cëlömith nyi Debiray, nyen mo käla ri tuuŋ Daan.
english: And the Israelite woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

anywaa: Køøre geni nyenøgø akïthge øt twöc, këël mano ŋäcge dwøl mano cur dhi Wuuö Jwøk kiper nyenøgø.
english: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the Lord might be shewed them.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre Wuuö Jwøk aput cäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Nyena jädö kïth wøk ŋää twïër, ni ö jøøa wïny ajaany mare bëët ni peethge ceŋge wï nyenøgø. Køøre dhaanh Icriel bäre nyenøgø wär këërge ki kïte.
english: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

anywaa: Køøre ïïni wär put caan jï jø Icriel ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ni näk da ŋat mo janynya aani na Jwøk mare, bääyö mare ena bääte keere.
english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, ŋat mo pääta aani na Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, eni wär put 'näk. Dhaanh Icriel bäre, nyenøgø wär putge këërö ki kïte møn. Nee wëëllö mo path wala ŋat Icriel, ni näk maa ee päädö, eni wär put 'näk.
english: And he that blasphemeth the name of the Lord, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø nyääga jwïëc dhaanhø, ka adïëri møn, eni wär put 'näk.
english: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo nyääga jwïëc lää paac mar dhaanhø mør, kar gø wär coole. Gïn mo kwøw cool ka gïn mo kwøw.
english: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø ŋat mør ee mooø ki ŋwellø, teeŋ ŋwellø mana tïïe wär dwøk dëëre.
english: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

anywaa: Kiper toor cool ka toor, ni waŋ cool ka waŋ, ni lëëö cool ka lëëö. Ŋatøgø teeŋ ŋwellø mana tïïe dëër dhaanhø mør, wär put dwøk dëëre.
english: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

anywaa: Ŋat mo 'näga lää paac, kar gø wär coole; 'ba ŋat mo 'näga dhaanhø, eni wär 'näk.
english: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

anywaa: Uuni, ciik moøgø bëëdö na aciel kiperu, u na jø Icriel, ki wëëlle moa path. Kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.› »
english: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aput cäänö ki jø Icriel; køøre jiy ŋata jany Wuuö Jwøk aputge kïth wøk ŋää twïër, ni këërge gø ki kïte. Ni manøgø tïïc jø Icrielli ka køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki gø.
english: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe bäät Kïn Caynay ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kanyo dønynyu yi ŋöömmo cïba jïïu, kany wø tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, ŋöömö wär jïte ki jwöm nou wøøra aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the Lord.

anywaa: Pwöth mou wär bëëde ni piithu piidhø ki cwiiri abïciel, ni bëët omøki mou ni wïthge goorru goorø ki yïth cwiiri abïciel, ni bëët nyïïge ni cooŋu piny;
english: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

anywaa: 'ba noo tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, ŋöömö wär jïte ki jwöm, na jwöm mo ocïp kur keere jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Ni uuni, pwöth mou ba piithu, ni ba goorru wïth omøki mou.
english: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the Lord: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

anywaa: Uuni, caammi mo pwöth mou moa näk bär kär kayu, ni ba pønnu nyïïomøki mou moa nywøl ni wïthge kär goorø. Manøgø beeye jwöm ma yi cwiir kiper ŋöömö.
english: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiinøgø no ö pwöthi noo jwömge rege yie, bär moo ciek yïth pwöth poot bëëdö na cam kiperu bëët, ki laaŋe mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki jø wø tïny uuni ki gwel, ki wëëlle moa path ni wø bëëdö dïïu.
english: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

anywaa: Këël lääc paac mou, ki lääc paap moa en yi ŋöömö maru, gïïo ciek yi ŋöömö jaak tïmö na cam kiperge.
english: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni kwör jwöm abïriiø mo yïth cwiiri wär kwäänu wøk, na abïriiø kwöre ma cwiiri abïriiø; køøre tïmö ni da kwör jwöm abïriiø jïïu mo yïth cwiiri, ni beeye kar cwiiri ma pïëraŋween ka abïŋween.
english: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïm nïr dwää abïriiø na apaar, tuuŋ nywø røømmø wär put kooth yi ŋöömö bäre, ni beeye yi Cäŋ Man Wø Tïïc Okïdi Yie noo kooth tuuŋ yie.
english: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

anywaa: Ni manøgø u cïba pïërbïï cwiiri kur keere, ni gøøu luubö piny mar dwøk ŋøøm ki wec jiy yi ŋöömö bäre. Manøgø bëëdö jïïu ni beeye cwiir mo di cwølø ni Jubili, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø pwödhö mare baŋe, ni ö jøøa biel dëëtge na laaŋe ni døøge baŋ jø tuuŋge.
english: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

anywaa: Pïërbïï cwiiri cooth wär bëëde jïïu ni beeye kar jwöm mar Jubili; ni bëëdu nou ba pïïdhö ni ba kayu caammi moa näk bär, ni ba pønnu nyïïomøki moa nywøl ni wïthge kär goorø.
english: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

anywaa: Kiper cwiin Jubili bëëdö ni ena kur keere ki jïïu. Uuni wär bëëde nou cama bär moa ciek yïth pwöth.
english: For it is the jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

anywaa: « ‹Noo tïme na yi cwiir mar Jubili, ŋati man nø dïïu pwödhö mare wär døø baŋe.
english: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo pwödhö marï iï gadhø ki ŋat pou, wala ï ŋeewa pwödhö baŋe, kär dëëtu møønnu.
english: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

anywaa: Kanyo ŋëëï ki pwödhö baŋ ŋat pou, gäte wär cääp no opäärö ki kwään cwiiri moa no opöödhö køør cwiin jwöm mar Jubili; ni ŋato gath pwödhö mare ki ïïni, gäte wär cääp ki køør kwään cwiiri moo dööŋ mo kac caammi.
english: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

anywaa: Ni näk mo cwiiri poot thööth, gät pwödhö mano gathï wär meetï ki jöö ma kare. 'Ba ni näk mo cwiiri oløny ni nøk, gät pwödhö wär dwøk piny ki jöö ma kare, kiper pwödhö mano gath dhaanhø ki ïïni käle ka køør kwään cwiiri moo kac caammi yïthge.
english: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, kär dëëtu møønnu; 'ba bëëdu nou lwäära aani, a na Jwøk maru; kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni, bëëdu nou gwøga ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa, ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc, kiper nou bëëdu yi ŋöömö ni bäŋ gïn caarru kiper leny,
english: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

anywaa: ni ŋöömö bëëdö ni ciek ki caammi, nou cämö ni jäŋŋu, kiper nou bëëdö yi ŋöömö ni bäŋ gïn caarru kiper leny.
english: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou pëëö, na «?Agïnaŋø noo camwa kany wø tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, ni näk mo wa ba pïïdhö ni kacwa geni?»
english: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

anywaa: Aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø tïme na ri bïcier cwiiri, gwïëth mara jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätu, kiper nee ŋöömö maru jïte ki cam mo päl, ma kar cwiiri adäk.
english: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

anywaa: Ni kanyo tïme na kar pïïdhö maru ri bäc cwiiri, u poot bëëdö nou cama caammi moa dïkwøŋ, ni bëëdu nou cama geni këël mano pïïyu ri bïŋweer cwiiri mano kayu caammi møga yie.
english: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ŋöömö ba dwøk pwödhö nee put bëëtö na bäre bäre. Kiper ŋöömö beeye mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ni bëëdu ki aani en, u bëëdö kaamar wëëlle.
english: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

anywaa: Pwöth moa näk you ŋeeø na mou yi paac bäre, wär cäŋu weyø nee wiil ŋata ŋeewu ŋöömö manøgø baŋe.
english: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo ŋat pou otïmö ni can, ni gath pwödhö mare kiper can, watge mana kare cään wär cøøe, ni cäŋ pwödhö ŋeewø mana gath watge.
english: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø bäŋ watge mo cäŋa pwödhö wïïl wøk baŋ ŋata gadhi ki gø, ni näk mo eno cäŋ kwärrö, ni jït cere ki jammi mo orømø ki man cäŋ pwödhö wïïl wøk ki ge,
english: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
