anywaa: eni cwiiri wär cääbe ki mana täge ki kanya gath gø yie, ni dwøk thäk jap ŋata gath pwödhö ki gø, ni ö eni ni døø yi pwöthe.
english: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo cere ba jïti ki jammi mo rømø ki man døø pwödhö baŋe, pwödhö mana gadhe wär bëëde cer ŋata ŋeew gø këël mano këët ri cwiir mar Jubili. 'Ba noo pïïe ri cwiir mar Jubili, pwödhö di duuö; køøre, eni løny ki man døø yi pwödhö mare.
english: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø gatha øtø mo ena yi pääny mo ogeerø ki kiir, eni teek mare man wïïl øtø wøk ki gø, bëëdö no okoorø këël kanyo päŋ cwiirri, ni täk ki kanya gadhi yie. Teek mare man wïïl øtø wøk ki gø, thöödhö ki cwiir bäre.
english: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo øtø kär cäŋ wïïl wøk kipere kanyo thum cwiirri, ødøgø ni en yi pääny mo ogeerø ki kiir enø, puta bëëtö na bäre bäre jï ŋata ŋeew gø, këël mano këët yïth beenhnhe moe moo ööi. Ødøgø ba løny ki man dwøgi këët yi cwiir mar Jubili.
english: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.

anywaa: 'Ba uudi moa näk mo atude moa näk kär geerø ki kiiri, di kwaanø kaamar pwöth. Løny ki man cäŋ ge wïïl wøk, ni løny ki man duui yi cwiir mar Jubili.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay jïge da teek, ni kanyo manyge jaak, løny jïge ki man cäŋge uudi moge wïïl wøk moa en yïth päänye moa näk thöökge.
english: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

anywaa: Øtø mo ogath jø tuuŋ Libayi yi pääny mana näk thööŋge, løny ki man cäŋi wïïl wøk. 'Ba noo tïme na yi cwiir mar Jubili, dwøga baŋ wänni mana gath gø, kiper uudi moa en yïth päänye mo jø tuuŋ Libay beeye thöökge na bäre bäre dï jø Icriel.
english: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubilee: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba pwöle mo kwör kwaath mo päänye moge, ba løny ki man dwøgi pwödhö, kiper beeye thöökge na bäre bäre.
english: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo ŋat pou otïmö ni can, ni ba løny jïre ki man køny dëëre keere dïïu, eni wär kønyï kaawat mana diï wëëllö kønyø, wala ŋat mo beeta kany mo thiinh buutï; kiper nee eni bëëde ni ena dïïu.
english: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

anywaa: Ïïni, kär gïïa maae baŋï cwølï ni da wïthge; 'ba bëëdï niï lwäära Jwøk marï, nee ŋat pou lønye ki man bëëde dïïu.
english: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

anywaa: Ïïni, kär eni wëëk mäyö ki gwel baŋï nee duue ni da wïïe, wala cam marï mo duue ni ee meedø.
english: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

anywaa: Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na käl u wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, nee ŋööm Keenan cïba jïïu, naa bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru.
english: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo ŋat pou otïmö ni can dïïu, ni biel dëëre baŋï, kär eni wëëk tïïc mo caala tïï laŋ.
english: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

anywaa: Eni wär bëëde ki ïïni kaamar dhaanhø mo tïnynya ïïni ki gwel, ni caala ŋat mo path mo bëëdö buutï. Eni wär bëëde ni tïnynya ïïni këël mano ŋuude ri cwiir mar Jubili.
english: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee:

anywaa: Køøre nø, eni ki wääte wär weyï nee aacge, ni døøge baŋ jø tuuŋge, nee lønye jïre ki man døø yi ŋööm kwäcge.
english: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel na käla wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ge bëëdö na jø tïïc 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk; geni ge ba dwøk pwödhö na laaŋe.
english: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

anywaa: Uuni, kär ge magu ni you caannø, 'ba bëëdu nou lwäära aani na Jwøk maru.
english: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba cwøw ki mään moo bëëdö na laaŋe jïïu, wär tïme ni ŋeewu baŋ wïth juurre moa en deŋŋu. Løny jïïu ki man ŋëëu baŋge ki laaŋe.
english: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

anywaa: Uuni thuwø, løny jïïu ki man ŋëëu røk obwöre mo jøøa path ni wø bëëdö dïïu, ki røk wïth tuŋi moge, ni beege moa nywølge yi ŋöömö maru. Teeŋ jøøgø, ge tïmö ni gena mou.
english: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

anywaa: Uuni løny ki man weyu geni jï wäätu nee dööŋge køøru na moge, ni tïïyu geni nee bëëtge na laaŋe na bäre bäre. 'Ba uuni jø pou ma jø Icriel, kär magu ni ge you caannø.
english: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo wëëllö mo path, wala ŋat mo beeta kany mo thiinh dïïu okwär, ni ö ŋat pou ni tïme ni can ni biel dëëre baŋ wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö dïïu, wala baŋ tuuŋ wëëllö mo path,
english: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:

anywaa: eni jïre da teek ki man wïïli wøk køør mana nø biel dëëre. Dhaanhø aciel røk jø tuuŋge, kaamar coki, løny ki man wïïl gø wøk.
english: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

anywaa: Teeŋ cöök wänni, ki o cöök wänni, ki ŋat mo ge käla ri remø aciel ki gø røk tuuŋge, løny ki man wïïl gø wøk. Wala ni näk mo eni cere jïtö ki jammi, løny ki man wïïl dëëre wøk.
english: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

anywaa: Eni ki ŋata biel dëëre baŋ gø, cwiiri wär cääpge, ni täkge ki kanya ö ŋatøgø na biel dëëre yie, këël mano këët ri cwiir mar Jubili. Gät mano cool kiper nee ŋatøgø wec, wär tïïc ni dïët ki køør kwään cwiiri. Kanya beede buut ŋatøgø gäte wär tïïc ni caala man wø cool jï ŋat tïïc mo tïïö ka gwel.
english: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

anywaa: Ni näk mo poot da cwiiri mo thööth mo odööŋ, eni gät moa no orømø na karge, na mo wïïl dëëre wøk ki ge, wär coole jï ŋata biel dëëre baŋ gø.
english: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dööŋŋa cwiiri mo nøk ki man pïïö yi cwiir mar Jubili, eni wär cääpge ki ŋatøgø. Køøre eni gät moa no orømø ki køør kwään cwiiri wär coole ni eni wïïla dëëre wøk ki ge.
english: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

anywaa: Ŋata biel røk baŋe, ŋatøgø wär maae ni caala ŋat tïïc mo tïïö baŋe ki yi cwiir, mo cunne cunnö ki gwel. Ŋatøgø kär dhaanhø maae ni ee caannø ni nëënö jïrï.
english: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba këël ni näk mo eni kär wïïl wøk yïth cwiiri moøgø, eni ko obwöre moe ge poot di wiiø kanyo tïme na yi cwiir mar Jubili.
english: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, both he, and his children with him.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel gena jø tïïc 'moa. Gena jø tïïc 'moa na käla wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni, kär dëëtu tëëŋŋu ki kït gïrpiny jaak, ni ba cööthu piny ki gïï lam wala kïte mo di wøørø, ni ba määnynyu dëëtu ki kïte mo otieŋø na juu yi ŋöömö maru kiper nee cøŋŋu këëllu piny nyïmge nou wøøra ge, kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni, gwøgu cäŋ jwömö mara, ni wøørru kar lam mara na en kur keere. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Ni näk mou caatha køør ciik 'moa, ni gwøgu gïïa cema ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc,
english: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

anywaa: aani køth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö ki kanya näk kare, kiper nee caammi ciekge yi ŋöömmu, ni ö jenni mo wø piith ni nywølge ki nyïëdi.
english: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, tïïc mar dïn beel mou ba cuŋŋi këël mano këët ri pøn nyïïomøki, ni ö pøn nyïïomøki ni këët ri pïïdhö. Uuno bëëdö nou cämö ki caammi mou jaak ni jäŋŋu, ni bëëdu yi ŋöömö maru ni bäŋ gïn caarru kiper leny.
english: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

anywaa: « ‹Aani thuwø bëët mëër tïïa tïïö ni dagø yi ŋöömö, nou bëëdu ni rou you nyaaŋ piny ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëk u lwär. Aani thuwø, lääc paap moa reyø tïïa tïïö ni bäŋgø yi ŋöömö maru, ni bäŋe tøŋ mo tïŋ mo ööa baŋu yi ŋöömö maru.
english: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

anywaa: Nyïïmän mou riemmu riemmø ni päthge ceŋŋu dhi tøŋ maru.
english: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

anywaa: Jiy abïïc dïïu nyïïmän ma dïpa riemge riemmø, ni ö jiyi ma dïpa ni riemge nyïïmän ma kume apaar, ni put nyïïmänni mou päth ceŋŋu dhi tøŋ maru.
english: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba aani nyïma luua baŋu ni tïïa uuni nou nyöödu ni nyaayu, ni ö luumma na tuuda ki uuni ni wëëga gø thur kare.
english: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

anywaa: U bëëdö nou poot cämö ki caammi moa näk oruuki, ni wiillu geni ki caammi moo ciek na nyärö.
english: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

anywaa: Aani kar bëëtö mara tïïa tïïö nee bëëde ni ena dïïu, ni bëëda nou ba kwiera.
english: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, aano cäädhi dïïu, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru, ni bëëdu ni uuna jiya.
english: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

anywaa: Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, kiper nou ba bëëdu ni uuna laaŋe moge, ni paanya bëët laŋ bäätu na caal jaath puur ni wø jøøny ŋut rwaath, ni tïïa uuni nou cäädhu ni wïthu you täärö jaak.
english: I am the Lord your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dwøra ba wïnynyu ni ba kïthu gïïa cema bäät tïïc,
english: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

anywaa: ni näk mo ciik 'moa you kwierø ni bëëdu nou män ki luup ŋøl 'moa, ni ba kïthu gïïa cema bëët bäät tïïc, ni raanynyu luumma na tuuda,
english: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

anywaa: aani thuwø, gïï ii tïïa tïïö dëëtu: a känna bäätu ki lwär mo cwöba dëëtu, ki täwe mo leth, ki teeŋ adïrïgi mo tïïya nyeŋŋu ni ba nëënö, mo cama dëëtu. Caammi mou opiithu ki jaak, kiper nyïïmän mou öö ni camge caammi moøgø.
english: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

anywaa: Aani dëëtø neenø neenø ki uuni, ni ö nyïïmän mou ni böötge uuni. Jiy moa män ki uuni, uuno bëëdö tietge, ni bëëdu nou böö ni bäŋ ŋat mo oŋwiec køøru.
english: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba køør gïïögø, ni näk mou poot bëëdö ni dwøra ba wïnynyu, aani u jääla jäälö kwöre abïriiø kiper raay mou. no oränynyö ni ge tøør yie. Geni bääyö marge jïëcge jïëö, kiper geni luup ŋøl 'moa akwierge ni bëëtge ni ge män ki ciik 'moa.
english: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na tïïcge gïïögø, kanyo enge yi ŋööm nyïïmän moge, ge ba kwiera, naa ba männi ki geni ki man raanynya ge. Ni näk mo tïïa tïïö, tïmö naa raanynya luumma tuuda ki geni. 'Ba ba tïïa, kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge.
english: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the Lord their God.

anywaa: 'Ba kiperge, wïïa caara caarø ki luumma na tuuda ki kwäcge na käla wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ni nëënö jï wïth juurre, kiper naa bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the Lord.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ciik ki luup ŋøl ki gïïa cem moa cïp Wuuö Jwøki piny yïthakicge ki jø Icriel bäät Kïn Caynay ki ri Modhe.
english: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the Lord made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Ni näk mo dhaanhø okööŋ ki kööŋ mo ena kur keere, ni eni cïba jiy kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ïïni gïno cool kiperge wär cïp piny no orømø kiperge.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the Lord by thy estimation.

anywaa: Mano cïbï piny kiper dïcwøø mo cwiiye tägi ka pïërariiø këël cwiiri ma pïërabïciel, wär cïp piny na gwel-bïrö ma cekelli ma pïërabïïc mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ena dhaagø, mano cïbï piny kipere beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli ma pïëradäk.
english: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo cwiic ŋateca tägi ka cwiiri abïïc këël cwiiri ma pïërariiø, mano cïbï piny kiper dïcwøø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli ma pïërariiø, 'ba kiper dhaagø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli apaar.
english: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dwääne aciel këël cwiiri abïïc, mano cïbï piny kiper dïcwøø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli apaar, ni mano cïbï piny kiper dhaagø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli adäk.
english: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo cwiic ŋateca tägi ka pïërabïciel këël kunece, mano cïbï piny kiper dïcwøø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli apaar kurbïïc, 'ba kiper dhaagø beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli apaar.
english: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋata kööŋ can døc, ni gät mana cïbï piny kipere ba løny ki man cïp gø, ŋata cïp wär kïth baŋ dïlämi, ni ö dïlämi ni cïp piny jï ŋata kööŋ ki gät mana no orømø, ki køør mano løny jïre ki man joot gø.
english: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø kööŋ ni eni cïpa lääy man wø jïëc no olämi man wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk, teeŋ lääy mana cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk enø tïmö ni ena kur keere.
english: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the Lord, all that any man giveth of such unto the Lord shall be holy.

anywaa: Eni lääy manøgø kär wiile, ni ba kïth kar gø ki mør, ni wiila mana beer ki mana raac, wala wiila mana raac ki mana beer. 'Ba ni näk mo lääy ee wiilø ki lääy maya, lääy manøgø ki mana wiili ki gø, geni karge riedi, ge tïmö ni ena kur keerge.
english: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïna kööŋe kiper gø ki man cïp gø, beeye lääy mo ba waany, na man wø ba jïëc ki man cïbi no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni lääy manøgø wär kïth baŋ dïlämi.
english: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the Lord, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi løny ki man ŋøl mare, ki man näk mo beer wala raac, ni gät mano cïp dïlämi piny jaak, beeye mano tïmö na eni.
english: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo eni manynya gø nee wïïl wøk, eni bïï wï gät mano cïbï piny kiper läänögø wär meet bäät gø.
english: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø øde ee cïp kur keere, na man wø cïp kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk, dïlämi mare wär ŋøle ki man näk mo beer wala raac; ni gät mano cïp dïlämi piny, puta cuŋŋö kare.
english: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the Lord, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata cïp øde kur keere, ni näk mo manynya gø nee øde wïïl wøk, eni bïï wï gät mana cïbï piny kiper øtø wär meet bäät gø. Køøre øtø døøa baŋe.
english: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø cïba thääŋ ŋöömö mare kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, gät mano cïbï piny kipere, wär tïïyï ki køør köödhi moo rømi kipere, nee kööth beek wø cwøl ni gäbci, gät  rumi man wø cwøl ni kömer beeye gwel-bïrö ma cekelli ma pïërabïïc.
english: And if a man shall sanctify unto the Lord some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

anywaa: Ni näk mo eni pwödhö mano cïp kur keere tägi ki kanya thum cwiirri man wø cwøl ni Jubili, gät mano cïbï piny kipere wär put cuŋŋö kare.
english: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo eni pwödhö mano cïp kur keere tägi ni cwiir man wø cwøl ni Jubili onø pöödhö, dïlämi gät gø mana näk orømø wär cääbe ki køør kwään cwiiri moa no odööŋ këël kanyo këët ri cwiir man wø cwøl ni Jubili. 'Ba kar gät cwiiri moa pöödhö wär ŋul wøk.
english: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubilee, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata cïp pwödhö mare kur keere, ni näk mo manynya gø nee pwödhö mare wïïl wøk, eni bïï wï gät mana cïbï piny kiper pwödhö wär meet bäät gø. Køøre pwödhö døøa baŋe.
english: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo eni pwödhö käre wïïl wøk, wala ee gadhø ki ŋat mør, pwödhö manøgø ba cäŋ wïïl wøk këët.
english: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.

anywaa: 'Ba pwödhö manøgø kanyo duui yi cwiir mar Jubili, tïmö na pwödhö mo ena kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni caala pwödhö mo owëëk Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre. Eni tïmö na mar dïlämi ni beeye thööŋŋe.
english: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto the Lord, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø pwödhö mano cïp kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk beeye mo ee ŋeeø, ni paa thääŋ pwödhö mana näk thööŋŋe,
english: And if a man sanctify unto the Lord a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

anywaa: dïlämi gät gø mana näk orømø wär cääbe këël mano këët ri cwiir man wø cwøl ni Jubili; køøre gät mana näk ocïp piny wär put cool dïcäŋögø, ni tïmge na gwel mo ocïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the Lord.

anywaa: Noo tïme na cwiir man wø cwøl ni Jubili, pwödhö døøa baŋ ŋata ŋeei baŋ gø, na näk pwödhö manøgø beeye thööŋŋe.
english: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.

anywaa: Gät man wø cïp piny, wär tïme ni käl ka køør rumi man wø cwøl ni cekel mar kar lam na en kur keere, na näk yie da rumme ma pïërariiø mar rumi man wø cwøl ni gëëra.
english: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kaai mo lääc paac, bäŋe ŋat mo cïba geni kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper kaai mo lääc paac oløny na mo Wuuö Jwøk, nee ena dhieŋ wala diel, beeye mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the Lord's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the Lord's.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ena røk lääc paac moa näk ba waany, wär wïïl wøk ki køør gät mana näk iï cïp piny, ni mëën bäät gø ki bïï wï gäte. 'Ba ni näk mo kär wïïl wøk, wär dwøk pwödhö ki køør gät mana näk iï cïp piny.
english: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba gïn mo onø wëëk dhaanhe Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre røk jammi bëët moa näk thööge, nee dhaanhø wala lää paac, wala pwödhö mana näk thööŋŋe, ba løny ki man dwøgi pwödhö ni ba wïïl wøk. Gïrpiny jaak mo onø wëëk Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre beeye gïn mo ena kur keere mo pere leth na mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the Lord of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the Lord.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo onø wëëk Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre ba cäŋ wïïl wøk; ka adïëri møn, eni di nääö.
english: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba paac wïth gïï wø ciek yi ŋöömö bëët, ni beeye caammi mo pwöth, ki nyïïjenni, gena mo Wuuö Jwøk. Ge ena kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's: it is holy unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo manynya gø nee thäk paac wïth jammi moe wïïl wøk, eni bïï wï gät gø wär meet bäät gø.
english: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba paac wïth dhäk, ki paac wïth dïëk, ni beege paac wï lääy man nø mana näk okwään wøk, paacge ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.

anywaa: Bäŋe gø mo jier ni beer wala raac, ni ba wiili ki mør; 'ba ni näk mo di wiilø ki mør, lääy manøgø ki mana wiili ki gø karge riet, ge tïmö ni ge ena kur keerge, ni ba løny ki man wïïli wøk.› »
english: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ciik moa cïp Wuuö Jwøki piny jï jø Icriel, na kööm Modhe ki ge bäät Kïn Caynay.
english: These are the commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa ö jø Icrielli wøk ki Ijep, dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ ri riet dwäde, Wuuö Jwøk  acäänö ki Modhe dï paap Caynay yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwaannu jø Icriel moa näk cwøw bëët, ki køør tuŋi moge, ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni gööru nyeŋge piny na aciel aciel.
english: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

anywaa: Ïïni ka Aran, jøøgø bëët wär kwaannu na lwaae, ni beege cwøw mo Icriel moa näk cwiiri moge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny.
english: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

anywaa: 'Ba wär näk da dhaanhø mo käla yi tuuŋ man nø mo tïïö ka uuni, ni ŋati man nø røk jøøgø wär näk mo ŋata dwøŋŋa eni dhi øt wänni.
english: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jøøgøøni beege ii: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ Ruben beeye Elicuur o Cediyör;
english: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Cimien beeye Celumiel o Curicaday;
english: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda beeye Nacøn wär Aminadap;
english: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Icakar beeye Natanel o Dhuar;
english: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beeye Eliap o Këëlön;
english: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

anywaa: «ki røk wäät Jocep, ki røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem beeye Elicama wär Ammiyut, ni ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca beeye Gameeliel o Pedacur;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Abidan o Gidiöni;
english: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Daan beeye Akiedhar wär Amicaday;
english: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Acer beeye Pagiel wär Okaran;
english: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Gaat beeye Eliacap o Deeweel;
english: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

anywaa: «ki røk jø tuuŋ Naptali beeye Akira wär Enan.»
english: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

anywaa: Jøøgø beege jiy moa jier røk jø Icriel, ni gena dïbwöthe mo dhøk uut kwäcge, ni gena wïth lwaae mo jø Icriel.
english: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran jøøa nyeŋge cwøl yøø acwølge,
english: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

anywaa: ni cooŋge lwaak bäre kanya ciel ri cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ ri riet dwäde. Ni ö lwaaki bäre ni køpge røkge ki køør tuŋi moge ki dhøk uut  wëëkge, ni göör nyeŋ cwøw piny na aciel aciel moa näk cwiiri moge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø,
english: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

anywaa: ni tïïcge gïnögø na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe. Manøgø beeye kanya ö Modhe na kwaan jiy dï paap Caynay.
english: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Ruben na näk kany Icriel: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri tuuŋ Ruben beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ka abïciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Cimien: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Cimien beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc ka abïŋween ki dïpe adäk.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Gaat: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Gaat beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurbïïc ki dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Juuda: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Juuda beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø kurŋween ki dïpe abïciel.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Icakar: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Icakar beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurŋween ki dïpe aŋween.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Dhebulan: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc ka abïriiø ki dïpe aŋween.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Ipariem na käl ri Jocep: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Ipariem beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ki dïpe abïïc.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Maneeca na käl ri Jocep: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge  agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Maneeca beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurriiø ki dïpe ariiø.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Benjamen: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Benjamen beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurbïïc ki dïpe aŋween.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Daan: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Daan beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïciel kurriiø ki dïpe abïriiø.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Acer: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Acer beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïkwaac Naptali: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, nyeŋge agöör piny na aciel aciel ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

anywaa: Cwøw moa kwaan ri jø tuuŋ Naptali beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurdäk ki dïpe aŋween.
english: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: Jøøgø beege jiy moa näk okwaanø, ni kwäänö Modhe ka Aran ki dïbwöthe moa näk apaar kurriiø mo jø Icriel, ni ŋati man nø rege ööi na kar dhi øt wänni.
english: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

anywaa: Cwøw bëët mo jø Icriel moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny, akwaan ki køør dhøk uut wëëkge.
english: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

anywaa: Ni kwäänge bëët beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ka adäk ki dïpe abïïc ki pïërabïïc.
english: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay kär kwaan røk jøøgø.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ocäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kär jø tuuŋ Libay kwaanï, ni ba rwöpï kwäänge ki jø Icriel møga;
english: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

anywaa: 'ba jø tuuŋ Libay wär tïïyï na jiy mo oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ki gïïa en yie bëët ena ceŋge. Ni ö oduŋkaara ki gïïa en yie bëët ni tïme ni käära geni, ni tïnyge gø, ni tïïcge twïër marge ni ena lak gø.
english: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre kany wäro tïme na kar wääth, jø tuuŋ Libay oduŋkaara puthge wøk; ni kany wäro tïme na kar pïïn piny, cwöthge piny. 'Ba no näk da dhaanhø mør jaak mo nyänhnha buut oduŋkaara wala manynya tïïc mana en yie nee tïïe, wär eni 'näk.
english: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel geno tïïö ki twëëre ki køør lwaae moge, ni ŋati man nø ena ya atut mare tier bëëra marge.
english: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay twïër marge otïmö ni ena lak oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo pïï dëët jø Icriel ki køør wëëc Jwøk; ni ö jø tuuŋ  Libay ni koorge oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.»
english: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïïcge gïïögø bëët kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: «Jø Icriel wär tïïge ki twëëre, ni ŋati man nø bëëdö tier bëëra mar lwaak mare, ni ge ena tiet bëëre mo dhøk uut wëëkge. Twëëre moge wär tïïcge ni ege jädhö mëëth ki lak oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

anywaa: «'Ba jøw otïïc twïër marge tier bëëra marge løø oduŋkaara jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wär tïmge na lwaa nyïïkwaac Juuda. Dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Juuda beeye Nacøn wär Aminadap.
english: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø kurŋween ki dïpe abïciel.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: «Ni jøw otïïc twïër marge buute beege jø tuuŋ Icakar; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Icakar beeye Natanel o Dhuar.
english: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurŋween ki dïpe aŋween.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: «Køøre beeye jø tuuŋ Dhebulan; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Dhebulan beeye Eliap o Këëlön.
english: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc ka abïriiø ki dïpe aŋween.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: «Kwään jiy bëët moa en tier twïër Juuda ki yïth lwaae moge beege jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabära ka abïciel ki dïpe aŋween. Ni beege geni noo tïŋ wääth dïkwøŋ.
english: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

anywaa: «'Ba jøw otïïc twïër marge tier bëëra marge jï løø tier-piny ko oduŋkaara wär tïmge na lwaa nyïïkwaac Ruben; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Ruben beeye Elicuur o Cediyör.
english: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ka abïciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: «Ni jøw otïïc twïër marge buute beege jø tuuŋ Cimien; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Cimien beeye Celumiel o Curicaday.
english: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc ka abïŋween ki dïpe adäk.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

anywaa: «Køøre beege jø tuuŋ Gaat; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Gaat beeye Eliacap o Raguël.
english: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurbïïc ki dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

anywaa: «Kwään jiy bëët moa en tier twïër Ruben ki yïth lwaae moge beege jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabïïc kurciel ki dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc. Ni beege riet lwaak mano tïŋŋi køør lwaak mano bwøth maal.
english: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

anywaa: «Køøre jø otïŋŋi dïër beege jø tuuŋ Libay, ko oduŋkaany røømmø. Lwaae bëët otïŋŋi ki køør cïïmmö mana cïïm ge ki gø yïth twëëre moge, ni jøøi nø cäädhi ka tier bëëra marge.
english: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

anywaa: «'Ba jøw otïïc twïër marge tier bëëra marge løø oduŋkaara jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ wär tïmge na lwaa nyïïkwaac Ipariem. Dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Ipariem beeye Elicama wär Ammiyut.
english: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ki dïpe abïïc.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: «Ni jøw oen buute beege jø tuuŋ Maneeca; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Maneeca beeye Gameeliel o Pedacur.
english: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurriiø ki dïpe ariiø.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: «Køøre beege jø tuuŋ Benjamen; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Benjamen beeye Abidan o Gidiöni.
english: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurbïïc ki dïpe aŋween.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: «Kwään jiy bëët moa en tier twïër Ipariem ki yïth lwaae moge beege jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ka abära ki dïpa aciel. Ni beege dää lwaak mano tïŋŋi.
english: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

anywaa: «'Ba jøw otïïc twïër marge tier bëëra marge jï løø wï-piny ko oduŋkaara wär tïmge na lwaa nyïïkwaac Daan. Dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Daan beeye Akiedhar wär Amicaday.
english: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïciel kurriiø ki dïpe abïriiø.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

anywaa: «Ni jøw otïïc twïër marge buute beege jø tuuŋ Acer; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Acer beeye Pagiel wär Okaran.
english: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: «Køøre beeye jø tuuŋ Naptali; ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa nyïïkwaac Naptali beeye Akira wär Enan.
english: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

anywaa: Kwään jiy mo lwaak mare beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurdäk ki dïpe aŋween.
english: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: «Kwään jiy bëët moa en tier twïër Daan beege jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabïïc ka abïriiø ki dïpe abïciel. Ni beege aŋuun lwaak mano tïŋŋi tiet bëëre moge.»
english: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

anywaa: Jøøgø beege jø Icriel bëët moa näk okwaanø ki køør dhøk uut wëëkge. Kwään jiy bëët moa näk okwaanø ki yïth twëëre ki køør lwaae moge beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ka adäk ki dïpe abïïc ki pïërabïïc.
english: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay kär kwaan røk jø Icriel møga, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre gïïögø bëët atïïc jø Icrielli, ni cïïmge twëëre moge na kwörge tiet bëëre moge, ni tïŋge ni tuuŋi nø cäädhi ka køør dhøk uut wëëkge, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Aran ki Modhe kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na cääne ki Modhe bäät Kïn Caynay.
english: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

anywaa: Nyeŋ wäät Aran beege Nadap na näk kaa, ka Abiyu, ki Eliedhar, ki Itamer.
english: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

anywaa: Moøgø beege nyeŋ wäät Aran, moa røøny na wïïr ki maaw na dïlämme, nee tïï dïlämme tïïcge.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.

anywaa: 'Ba Nadap ka Abiyu athøw nyïm Wuuö Jwøk dï paap Caynay, kanya kïthge maac nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki jöö mo patha kare. Ni thøwge ni poot bäŋ obwöre jïge. Køøre Eliedhar ki Itamer tïï dïlämme atïïcge yïth nïr kwøw mar wääge ma Aran.
english: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Käl jø tuuŋ Libay ni cïbï geni nyïm Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ kiper nee eni tïnyge.
english: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni tïnyge Aran ki jø Icriel bëët nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ge tïïya tïïc mar oduŋkaanynyøgø na näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Jammi bëët moa en yo oduŋkaany røømmø otïmö ni ena ceŋge, ni tïïge kiper jø Icriel, ni ge tïnynya kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Libay wär cïpï jï Aran ki wääte, kiper ki røk jø Icriel gena jiy mo doo cïbö jïre na bäre.
english: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran ki wääte wär thïïŋï, ni ö geni ni gwøkge tïïc marge na näk tïï dïlämme; 'ba noo näk da dhaanhø mør jaak mo nyänhnha buut oduŋkaara wala manynya tïïc manøgø nee tïïe, wär eni 'näk.»
english: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «Neenï, aani jø tuuŋ Libay alwøra dëët jø Icriel  na kar kaai moo lwaar määr jø Icriel ki ge. Jø tuuŋ Libay geno tïmö na 'moa,
english: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

anywaa: kiper kaai bëët beege 'moa. Dïcäŋa nääa kaai bëët yi ŋööm Ijep, kaai bëët mo jø Icriel, ni beege jiy ki lääc paac, acïba kur keerge na 'moa, ni putge bëëtö na 'moa. Man beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na nut cøøn noo bëëdö.»
english: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki Modhe dï paap Caynay, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwaan jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør dhøk uut wëëkge ki tuŋi moge. Kwaan cwøw bëët moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele.»
english: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jøøgø akwaane ki køør luum Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat mana kööm eni.
english: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ wäät Libay beege Gërcön ki Kät ki Mërari.
english: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Gërcön ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege Löbeni ki Cimiy.
english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Kät ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege Amram ki Icaar ki Keeprön ki Udhiel.
english: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Mërari ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege Maali ki Muci. Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk wäät Gërcön beege dhi øt Löbeni ki dhi øt Cimiy; moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Gërcön.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

anywaa: Kwään cwøw bëët moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele beege jiy ma kume abïriiø ki dïpe abïïc.
english: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: Jø dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Gërcön twïër marge tïïcge tïïö töök oduŋkaara jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliacap wär Lael beeye dïbwödhi mar nyïïkwaac Gërcön.
english: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

anywaa: Tïïc mar nyïïkwaac Gërcön yo oduŋkaany røømmø beeye ki man gwøkge oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki rëëbi mare, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ dhee,
english: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

anywaa: ka abïïe mo kal mana en lak oduŋkaara ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ dhi karøgø, ki thøøli mo wø mäk piny ki ge bëët. Këël tïïe bëët mo wø manynyi kiper gïïögø poot ena ceŋge thuwø.
english: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

anywaa: Ki røk wäät Kät beege dhi øt Amram ki dhi øt Icaar ki dhi øt Keeprön ki dhi øt Udhiel; moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Kät.
english: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

anywaa: Kwään cwøw bëët moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele beege jiy ma kume abära ki dïpe abïciel. 'Ba tïïc mar nyïïkwaac Kät beeye koor japa en kur keerge moa en yo oduŋkaara.
english: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Jø dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Kät twïër marge tïïcge tïïö jï løø tier-piny ko oduŋkaara.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

anywaa: 'Ba Elicapan wär Udhiel beeye dïbwödhi mar nyïïkwaac Kät.
english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc marge beeye gwøk acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki tharabëëta, ki lamba, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ki gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, ki jap wø en kur keerge mo wø tïï dïlämme ki ge, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø. Këël tïïe bëët mo wø manynyi kiper gïïögø poot ena ceŋge thuwø.
english: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö Eliedhar wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni tïme na wïth jøøa näk dïbwöthe mo jø tuuŋ Libay, ni jø wø gwøk oduŋkaara mana en kur keere ena cere.
english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Ki røk wäät Mërari beege dhi øt Maali ki dhi øt Muci; moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Mërari.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

anywaa: Kwään cwøw bëët moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele beege jiy ma kume abïciel ki dïpe ariiø.
english: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: Dïbwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Mërari beeye Dhuriel wär Abikael. Twïër marge tïïcge tïïö jï løø wï-piny ko oduŋkaara.
english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mar nyïïkwaac Mërari beeye gwøk opämi mo oduŋkaara, ki cööthe, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ki läämme, ki jap wø tïïö ki ge bëët, këël tïïe bëët mo wø manynyi kiper gïïögø;
english: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

anywaa: ki jer kal ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ki dïnööy ki thøøli mo wø mäk piny ki ge bëët.
english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe ka Aran ki wäät Aran, twïër marge tïïcge tïïö nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni tïïe bëët mo wø tïïc yo oduŋkaara kiper jø Icriel  ena ceŋge. 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mør jaak mo nyänhnha buut oduŋkaara wala manynya tïïc manøgø nee tïïe, eni doo nääö.
english: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

anywaa: Ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ka Aran, geni jø tuuŋ Libay akwaange ki køør dhøk uut wëëkge; ni kwään cwøw moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø.
english: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Kwaan kaai bëët moa näk cwøw mo jø Icriel, moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele, ni göörï nyeŋge piny.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

anywaa: Ni lwørï jø tuuŋ Libay na 'moa na kar kaai bëët mo jø Icriel, ni lwørï lääc paac mo jø tuuŋ Libay thuwø na 'moa na kar kaai bëët mo lääc paac mo jø Icriel. Man beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe kaai bëët mo jø Icriel akwaane, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

anywaa: Cwøw bëët moa näk kaai moa nyeŋge göör piny, na näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele, kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïriiø kurdäk.
english: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør jø tuuŋ Libay na kar kaai mo jø Icriel, ni lwørï lääc paac mo jø tuuŋ Libay thuwø na kar kaai mo lääc paac mo jø Icriel, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ni tïmge na 'moa. Man beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïriiø kurdäk moa näk kaai mo jø Icriel moa dööŋ wøk, ni bäŋ jø tuuŋ Libay mo wiilge rege ki ge, dëëtge dege wïïla wøk ki gwel.
english: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

anywaa: Wärï kädï ki gwel abïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel bäät ŋati man nø, mo opäärö ki rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

anywaa: Gwel mo ocïp jøøgø na dööŋ wøk yøø, na wiilge rege ki ge, wär mëëk Aran ki wääte.»
english: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

anywaa: Køøre gwet wïïdö mo jø Icriel moa dööŋ wøk, ni bäŋ jø tuuŋ Libay mo wiilge rege ki ge, akäl Modhe.
english: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

anywaa: Gwel moa lwør baŋ kaai mo jø Icriel beege kuma aciel ki dïpe adäk ki pïërabïciel kurbïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ni gwetøgø opäärö ki rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni cïp gwet wïïdö jï Aran ki wääte, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Yïthakic jø tuuŋ Libay, kwaan nyïïkwaac Kät ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

anywaa: Kwaan cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw mo løny jïge ki man cige nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge.
english: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: «Tïïc mano tïïc nyïïkwaac Kät yo oduŋkaany røømmø beeye gwøk japa en kur keerge na perge leth.
english: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

anywaa: Kany wø tïme na ri tïŋŋö, Aran ki wääte doo dønynya yo oduŋkaara, ni pätge abïï man wø gëëŋ kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki gø, ni kälge gø piny, ni rïëpge gø bäät acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering veil, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

anywaa: Ni rïëpge bäät gø ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni peerge abïï bäät gø mo kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni rwaakge jer tëër ïth gøøni.
english: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

anywaa: «Køøre abïï mo kïte caala kït abïcøle opeerge bäät tharabëëta mar muunni moa näk nyuuthe, ni kïthge cäänne ka apät ki kuure bääte, ko ogubääc jëëthe mo kwøŋ; ni muunni mo en bääte cooth bëëdö karge.
english: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

anywaa: Ni rïëpge bäätge ka abïï mo kwaar, ni rïëpge bäät abïïnögø ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni rwaakge jer tëër ïth gøøni.
english: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

anywaa: «Køøre abïï mo kïte caala kït abïcøle olwørge ni uumge gïn wø bëët lambae bääte, ki lambae, ki gïï wø 'näk maa lambae ki ge, ki cäänne, ki dääk mädhi moe bëët, na näk gïï wø tïïge ki geni;
english: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

anywaa: ni kïthge gïn wø bëët lambae bääte ki jape bëët yo opïr pïën, ni cïpge gø bäät gïr käädö.
english: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

anywaa: «Køøre gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte na näk tïïc ka warkey, ouumge ka abïï mo kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni uumge gø ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni rwaakge jer tëër ïth gøøni.
english: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

anywaa: «Ni lwørge jap tïïc bëët mo wø tïïö ki geni yi kar lam na en kur keere ni bäcge geni ka abïï mo kïte caala kït abïcøle, ni uumge gø ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni cïpge gø bäät gïr käädö.
english: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:

anywaa: «Køøre bur ojøøpge wøk bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni rïëpge gø ka abïï ma dïmuur;
english: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

anywaa: ni cïpge jap tïïc moe bëët bäät gø, ni beeye athääk jwëëlli mo wø käär mäc ki ge, ki gïï wø lääm rïŋ wøk ki ge, ka akaape, ki cäänne, ni beege jap tïïc bëët mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; ni rïëpge gø ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø, ni rwaakge jer tëër ïth gøøni.
english: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Aranni ki wääte noo lønyge ki twöc japa en kur keerge mo kar lam na en kur keere, noo tïme na kany wäro tïŋ wääth, wäät Kät doo öö kiper tëër. 'Ba japa en kur keerge ba dege gudö, nee ge ba thøwge. Gïïögø beege gïï käär nyïïkwaac Käti røk japa en yo oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: «'Ba tïïc mar maar lamba, ki tïï gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ki tïï muuce mo beel mo wø cïp cooth, ki tïï maar rööny ni wø judö ki gø, otïmö ni ena cer Eliedhar wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Beeye eni noo gwøk oduŋkaara mana näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk ki japo en yie bëët, ni beeye kar lam mana en kur keere.»
english: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe ka Aran,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kär nou wëëga nyïïkwaac Kät ränynyö dï jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna dou tïïö kiperge nee ge bëëtge ni kwøw, nee bäŋe thøø mo pïï dëëtge kany wäro nyänhge buut japo en kur keerge beeye en; Aran ki wääte geno døny yo oduŋkaara ni nyoothge tïïc jï ŋati man nø ki gïno kääre.
english: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

anywaa: 'Ba kär näk wäät Kät dønynya yie ki man neenge japa en kur keerge, këël ki nyi kany mo thiinh, nee ge ba thøwge.»
english: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwaan nyïïkwaac Gërcön thuwø ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

anywaa: Kwaan cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw mo løny jïge ki man cige nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge.
english: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: «Nyïïkwaac Gërcön tïïc marge ki gïïo käärge beege
english: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

anywaa: rëëbi mana en bäät kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki rëëbi mar oduŋkaara, ki rëëbi mana en bääte, ki rëëbi mar pëët lääy mo onyøŋø na en bäät moøgø, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ dho oduŋkaara ki gø.
english: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

anywaa: Ni käärge abïïe mo kal na en lak oduŋkaara ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ka abïï man wø gëëŋ dhi karøgø, ki thøøli mo wø mäk piny ki ge bëët, këël jammi bëët mo wø manynyi kiper tïïc mar gïïögø; ni gïï wø manynyi bëët kiper tïïc japøgø dege tïïö.
english: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

anywaa: Tïïc bäre mar nyïïkwaac Gërcön, këël luup gïï wø käärge, ki tïïe moge bëët wär tïme ni caana Aran ki wääte jïge; ni nyuunhnhu ŋati man nø ki tëëre na dee käärö, ni wiiu gø cere.
english: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye tïïc mar dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Gërcön yo oduŋkaany røømmø; ni ö tïïci marge ni en cer  Itamer wär Aran, ni beeye Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

anywaa: «Kwaan nyïïkwaac Mërari thuwø ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

anywaa: Kwaan cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw mo løny jïge ki man cige nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge.
english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni tïïc mano cïp ceŋge yo oduŋkaany røømmø beeye käär opämi mo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki cööthe, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ki läämme,
english: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

anywaa: ki jer kal, ki gïï wø cwöth tietge yïthge, ki dïnööy, ki thøøli, ki jap wø tïïö ki ge bëët. Këël jammi bëët mo wø manynyi kiper tïïc mar gïïögø poot ena ceŋge thuwø. Ni cïpu jammi mo wø käär ŋati man nø ni you kwaanø ki køør nyeŋŋe.
english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye tïïc mar dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Mërari yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö tïïci marge ni en cer Itamer wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.»
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran ki dïbwöthe mo lwaae nyïïkwaac Kät akwaange ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge,
english: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

anywaa: ni beege cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw moa cøø nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge;
english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: ni kwään jøøgø ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïïc.
english: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

anywaa: Moøgø beege kwään cwøw bëët mo nyïïkwaac Kät moa tïïö yo oduŋkaany røømmø, na kwaan Modhe ka Aran ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe.
english: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac Gërcön akwaan ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge,
english: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

anywaa: ni beege cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw moa cøø nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge;
english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

anywaa: ni kwään jøøgø ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpe abïciel ki pïëradäk.
english: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

anywaa: Moøgø beege kwään cwøw bëët mo nyïïkwaac Gërcön moa tïïö yo oduŋkaany røømmø, moa kwaan Modhe ka Aran ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac Mërari akwaan ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge,
english: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

anywaa: ni beege cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc, jøw moa cøø nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge;
english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

anywaa: ni kwään jøøgø ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege jiy ma kume adäk ki dïpe ariiø.
english: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: Moøgø beege kwään cwøw bëët mo nyïïkwaac Mërari, moa kwaan Modhe ka Aran ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe.
english: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Moi beege kwään jø tuuŋ Libay, moa kwaan Modhe ka Aran ki dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel, ki køør tuŋi moge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

anywaa: Cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge pïëradäk këël pïërabïïc moa cøø kiper tïï tëër ki tïïe møøk yo oduŋkaany røømmø,
english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
