anywaa: kwäänge beege jiy ma kume abära ki dïpe abïïc ki pïërabära.
english: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø anyuunhnhi ki tïïc mana dee tïïö ki tëër mana dee käärö ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe. Jøøgø bëët akwaan Modhe, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kööm jø Icriel kiper nee jiy moa näk dëëtge da täw buny dëël, ki moa näk dëëtge da gïï mo cwëëyö, ki jiy moa näk dëëtge da läp nee kïthge wøk ŋää twïër.
english: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

anywaa: Cwøw ki mään bëët mo dëëtge da gïïögø wär kïth wøk ŋää twïër, kiper nee twïër mar lwaa Icriel ba raanyge, na näk kany wø bëëda yie yïthakicge.»
english: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïïcge gïnögø; ni kïthge jøøgø wøk ŋää twïër. Ni tïïcge gïnögø	  na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kany wø näk da dïcwøø wala dhaagø mo obääyö dëër dhaanhø mør, ni gaa wøk ri ciik Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo joot bääyö mare,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;

anywaa: eni gïna baae dee købø. Ni dwøk gïna näk ee kälö na kare, ni mëët bäät gø, ni mëëk gø ŋata bääye dëër gø.
english: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋata bääye dëër gø tøør, ni bäŋ tuuŋge mo lwør japøgø, japøgø oci jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni mëëgi dïlämi, ni dwali na aciel ki nywø røømmø mano cïp no okïdi.
english: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

anywaa: «Køøre thuwø, muuce bëët moa näk ena kur keerge ni wø cïp jø Icrielli jï dïlämi, wär tïmge na moe.
english: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

anywaa: 'Ba japo en kur keerge mo wø cïp ŋati man nø jï dïlämi wär tïmge na mo dïlämmöca.»
english: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk Modhe aköömme
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: nee luup moi caane jï jø Icriel, ni kööe, ni «Kanymør da ŋat mo cïïe ree ee paanyø ni bääye dëër cwøre,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

anywaa: ni bute ki dïcwøø mør ni kuc cwøre, ni raany ree ni kuc, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ojoot gø, ni eni kär maa ki luk.
english: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

anywaa: Kanymør cwøre dëëtö ki cwïnye ki køør päl cwïny mare ni cïïe dëëre ee raanynyø; wala da ŋat mo dëëtö ki cwïnye jaak, ki køør päl cwïny mare ki cïïe, 'ba cïïe dëëre käre raanynyø.
english: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

anywaa: Ni näk mo teeŋ acaare moøgø otägö, ŋateca cïïe wär käl baŋ dïlämi. Ni känne ki muuy man wø manynyi kipere, ni beeye møk bëëlö ma rumi aciel mo lwørra røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa. Kär nee kunynya bäät gø ki maaw, wala kïtha bäät gø ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, kiper beeye muuy mar beel mana cïp na kar päl cwïny, na gïr par wïc, nee luubö mana na adïëri joot.
english: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

anywaa: «Køøre dïlämi dhaaŋŋøgø dee kälö ni wëëk gø cuŋŋö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni lwöte ki pïï moa en kur keere yi dak, ni lwöte ki tør piny yo oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni kïth gø yi pïï.
english: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi dhaaŋŋøgø owëëk cuŋŋö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni pät jïëc gø, ni cïp muuy mar beel cer gø na gïr par wïc, ni beeye muuy mana cïp na kar päl cwïny; ni pïïögø na keec yøø ni wø duunni ka acïëni ena cer dïlämi.
english: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni wëëk dhaaŋŋøgø kööŋ, ni kööe, ni ‹Ni näk ï kär butö ki dïcwøø mør, ni riï kärï paanyø buut cwørï, ni kärï riï raanynyø keerï niï ena po cwørï, dööŋï wøk ka acïëni mano ööi ki køør pïï moi ni keec ii.
english: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo riï iï paanyø buut cwørï, ni raanynyï riï niï poot ena paare, ni butï ki dïcwøø mør mo patha cwørï, Wuuö Jwøk ïïno wëëk cien.›
english: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi dhaaŋŋøgø owëëk kööŋ nee dëëre lame; ni ö dïlämi ni kööe jïre, ni ‹Ni näk riï iï paanyø buut cwørï, ïïno tïïc Wuuö Jwøki ni ïïno cienø dï jø pou, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany kar nyöödö marï ni wëëk yiï kwöt.
english: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

anywaa: Pïï mo wø duunni ka acïëni oci yiï, ni raany kar nyöödö marï ni wëëk yiï kwöt.› «Køøre dhaagø doo köö, ni ‹Enøgønø; aana jïëy.›
english: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

anywaa: «Køøre dïlämi jap acïëni moøgø dee gööra yi wëëlö ni peny gø yi pïïa keec.
english: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

anywaa: Ni wëëk nyijøøgø maath pïïa keec mo wø duunni ka acïëni, ni ö pïïyi ni cige yie ni mooc eni ki rääm mo dwøŋ.
english: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni käl muuy mar beel mana cïp na kar päl cwïny, ni käl gø wøk cer dhaaŋŋøgø, ni tïŋ  gø maal ni tuuŋ gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni käl muuy manøgø buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:

anywaa: Ni lwöte ki yi cere ri muuy mar beegøgø na gïr par wïc, ni waaŋ gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; køøre, dhaagø dee wëëga maath pïïögø.
english: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

anywaa: Kanyo nø wëëk nyijøøgø maath pïï, ni näk nyijøøgø dëëre ee raanynyø ni bääye dëër cwøre møn, pïï mo wø duunni ka acïëni oci yie ni duunne ki rääm mo dwøŋ dëëre, ni ö yie ni kwöde ni räny kar nyöödö mare; ni tïm dhaaŋŋøgø no ocienø dï jø poge.
english: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaaŋŋøgø gïnögø käre tïïö ni dëëre käre raanynyø, eno bëëdö ni bäŋ ajäla bääte, ni jïte ko obwöre.
english: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

anywaa: «Manøgø beeye ciik kiper luum adïëda man wø tägi ki køør päl cwïny, kany wø ö dhaage ni paany ree ni raany dëëre keere ni eni ena paare,
english: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

anywaa: wala kany wø ö dïcwøø wø jït cwïnye ki gïr adïëda ki køør päl cwïny mare ki cïïe. Køøre cïïe okäl nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö dïlämi ni tïïc gïïa caan ciiki manøgø bäre dëër dhaaŋŋøgø.
english: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

anywaa: Ni ö dïcwøønnøgø ni dööŋe wøk yïth raayøgø, 'ba ni näk dhaaŋŋøgø obääyö, raaye oen wïïe.»
english: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel: Ni näk dïcwøø wala dhaagø kööŋ ki man cïp ree kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk na ŋat Nadhir,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the Lord:

anywaa: ree dee mänö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, ki teeŋ kwøŋ møøk, ni eni ba doo mädhö ki pï nyïïomøki, ni ba nhudhe ki nyïï gø wala nyama nyïï gø moa näk otal.
english: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïne bëët mo wø beede ni ree ee cïp kur keere na ŋat Nadhir, eni ba doo cämö ki gïn mo käla ri jaadhøgø, ki mana täge ri nyïëdi këël bøøge moe.
english: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

anywaa: «Ki yïth nïne bëët moa kööŋe kiperge na cïp ree kur keere na ŋat Nadhir, wïïe bäŋa doo lielø. Këël kany wø thum nïne yie moa näk ree ee cïp kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni doo bëëdö ni ena kur keere, ni piith jïëc wïïe ni bäyö.
english: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

anywaa: «Ki yïth nïne bëët mo wø beede ni ree ee cïp kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni ba doo nyänhnha kany mo cään ki dhaanhø mo othøw.
english: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.

anywaa: Këël thøwa wänni wala menni wala coki mana näk dïcwøø wala mana näk dhaagø, dëëre ba dee raanynyø ki man gut gø, kiper kööŋ mana cïp ree kur keere ki gøøni jï Wuuö Jwøk poot ena bääte.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïne bëët mo wø beede ni ena ŋat Nadhir, eni ena kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo thøw buute ni cwöba ree, ni jït ree ki läbö, ni tïm jïëc wïïe ni ba waany këët, dïcäŋo døøc ree mo waany yie ri bïriet nïne, wïïe wär liel.
english: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

anywaa: Noo tïme na bäc nïne, eni doo kännö ka atuuy ariiø wala nyïï akuyi ariiø jï dïlämi dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni cïp atuuk wala akuuru aciel no olämi mar raay, ni cïp maya no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni døøc ŋatøgø mo waany kiper mana bääye na gut dhaanhø mo othøw. Ni ö ŋatøgø ni cäŋ jïëc wïïe tïïyö ni ena kur keere dïcäŋöce.
english: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ ree cïp kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ki nïne møøk ni ena ŋat Nadhir, ni känne  ki nywø røømmø mo cwiine aciel nee cïp no olämi na kar bääyö mare. 'Ba nïne moa dïkwøŋ otïmö ni bäŋ karge këët, kiper na jït dëëre ki läbö.
english: And he shall consecrate unto the Lord the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

anywaa: «'Ba ciik kiper ŋat wø cïp ree na ŋat Nadhir, kanyo thum nïne moa cïp ree kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk ki geni, beeye en; eni doo käla dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cïp olämi mare mano waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye nyidiel ma røømmø ma nywøk mo cwiine aciel mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, ko olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ni beeye nyidiel ma røømmø ma maath mo cwiine aciel mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre,
english: And he shall offer his offering unto the Lord, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

anywaa: ki gupa mo yie da muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø, na näk muunni mo odeelø no opamø mo tïïc ka møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, ki muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø mo odeelø no opamø ni reep mo bäätge okïthö ki maaw, ni cïpe thuwø ki muuce mo muunni ki mo kwøŋ mo wø cïp na aciel ko olämme.
english: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

anywaa: «Ni ö dïlämi ni cïp ge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïc olämi mar raay ko olämi man wø waaŋ na kare bäre kiper ŋatøgø.
english: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

anywaa: Ni cïp nywø røømmø jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämi man wø duunni ki mëër, ki gupa mana näk yie da muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø; ni ö dïlämi thuwø ni cïp muuy mar møø ki muuy mar køøŋø man wø cïp na aciel ko olämi.
english: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «Ni ö ŋat Nadhir ni liel jïëc wïïe na näk ee cïp kur keere, ni liele buut dho oduŋkaany røømmø. Ni käl jïëc wïïe na en kur keere ni kïth gø yi maac, ni waaŋi na aciel ko olämi man wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

anywaa: «Ni ö dïlämi ni lwør bat nywø røømmø mana näk othaalø, ni kän wøk ki møø aciel mo kär coodø ki thømmø ki yi gupa, ki møga reep na näk kär coodø ki thømmø, ni cïp gïïögø ceŋ ŋat Nadhir na näk jïëye na en kur keere ee nø gwäär wøk;
english: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

anywaa: ni ö dïlämi ni tuuŋ geni yi jamø na muuy man wø tuuŋŋi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Gïïögø, ki gøŋŋø mano tuuŋŋi yi jamø, ki ääm mano cïp, beege moa cïp kur keerge na kur dïlämi. Køøre nø, ŋat Nadhir manøgø løny jïre ki man mäthe ki køøŋ nyïïomøki.
english: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

anywaa: «Manøgø beeye ciik kiper ŋat Nadhir mano kööŋ ni eni cïpö ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk ki køør mano cïp ree kur keere na ŋat Nadhir. 'Ba ni näk eni kööŋ ki man cïpe ko olämme møøk, mo kaala moa caan ciiki, dee puta cïp na kare ki køør kööŋ mare.»
english: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the Lord for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran ki wääte: Ni jöö mano wäro gwïëthu jø Icriel ki gø beeye en; u doo köö jïge,
english: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

anywaa: « ‹Wuuö Jwøk uuno gwïëdhe ni gwøk uuni;
english: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk täärnyïme owëëk rieny bäätu, ni nyooth met ec mare jïïu;
english: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jïïu oraŋe ni täärnyïme leer, ni cïp bëët-mëër jïïu.›
english: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

anywaa: «Køøre nyeŋŋa okïthge bäät jø Icriel na enøgønø, ni gwïëdha jø Icriel.»
english: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa løny Modhe ki gur oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk piny, eni oduŋkaara ki japa en yie bëët agweele ki maaw ni cïp ge kur keerge na mo Jwøk. Ni gweel gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki jap wø tïïö ki ge bëët thuwø, ni cïp ge kur keerge.
english: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

anywaa: Køøre kwääc lwaae mo jø Icriel, na näk wïth dhøk uudi moge, na näk dïbwöthe mo tuŋi, akännö ki muuce; ni jøøgø beege jøøa näk cuumme wïth jøøa kwaan.
english: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

anywaa: 'Ba muuce moa kälge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk beege jïëthe abïciel mo wø tut dhäki, ni jïëthe moøgø wïthge orïëbö, ki dhäk	 apaar kurriiø, ni jääy man nø käla dïbwöthe ariiø, ni ŋati man nø dëët dïbwöthe käla dhieŋ aciel; ni cïpge geni nyïm oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør japøgø ceŋge, kiper nee tïmge na jammi mo kunynyö ri tïïc mar oduŋkaany røømmø, ni mëëgï ge jø tuuŋ Libay, ni mooyï ŋati man nø ki køør tïïc mare.»
english: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jïëthe ki dhäk alwøre, ni mëëk ge jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

anywaa: Jïëthe ariiø ki dhäk aŋween amëëk wäät Gërcön, ki køør tïïc marge;
english: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

anywaa: ni ö jïëthe aŋween ki dhäk abära ni mëëk ge wäät Mërari ki køør tïïc marge, ni tïïc marge ena cer Itamer wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo ee cïbö jï wäät Kät, kiper japa en kur keerge na en ceŋge beege jammi mo kääri ni di biellø.
english: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

anywaa: Køøre dïcäŋa gweel gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki maaw, dïbwöthe akännö ki muuce kiper nee gïn wø cïp olämme bääte cïp kur keere, ni cïpge geni nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Dïbwöthe muuce moge dege cïbö ki yïth cääŋŋe, ni dïbwödhi man nø cïpö ki yi cäŋ aciel, kiper nee gïn wø cïp olämme bääte cïp kur keere.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata kwøŋ muuce moe cïp dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ beeye Nacøn wär Aminadap, na käl ri jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

anywaa: Muuce moa cïbe beege caani aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma dïpa ki pïëradäk mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, no orømø na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere; ki kuura aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö thuwø, mo peek mare beeye rumme ma pïërabïriiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel. Cäänne moøgø na ariiø yøø yïthge päŋ ki muunni mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw na muuy mar beel.
english: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

anywaa: Ni cïpe ka apaal warkey aciel mo peek mare beeye rumme apaar mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, mo yie päŋ ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met;
english: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:

anywaa: ni cïpe ki rwaath aciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyidiel aciel ma røømmø ma nywøk mo cwiine aciel no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre;
english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

anywaa: ki nywø ateea aciel no olämi mar raay.
english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

anywaa: 'Ba ena cïpö ki dhäk ariiø, ki nyöök rööm abïïc, ki nyöök atëëe abïïc, ki nyïïdïëk abïïc ma rööm mo cwiicge oceele no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër. Moøgø beege muuce moa cïp Nacøn wär Aminadap.
english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri riet nïne, Natanel o Dhuar, na näk dïbwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Icakar, acïpö ki muuce.
english: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:

anywaa: Muuce moa cïbe beege caani aciel mo tïïc ka gwelbïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma dïpa ki pïëradäk mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, no orømø na kare ki køør rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere; ki kuura aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma pïërabïriiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel. Cäänne moøgø na ariiø yøø yïthge päŋ ki muunni mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw na muuy mar beel.
english: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

anywaa: Ni cïpe ka apaal warkey aciel mo peek mare beeye rumme apaar mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, mo yie päŋ ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met;
english: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:

anywaa: ni cïpe ki rwaath aciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyidiel aciel ma røømmø ma nywøk mo cwiine aciel no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre;
english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

anywaa: ki nywø ateea aciel no olämi mar raay.
english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

anywaa: 'Ba ena cïpö ki dhäk ariiø, ki nyöök rööm abïïc, ki nyöök atëëe abïïc, ki nyïïdïëk abïïc ma rööm mo cwiicge oceele no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër. Moøgø beege muuce moa cïp Natanel o Dhuar.
english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri dää nïne, Eliap o Këëlön, na näk dïbwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, acïpö ki muuce.
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:

anywaa: Muuce moa cïbe beege caani aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma dïpa ki pïëradäk mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, no orømø na kare ki køør  kuura aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma pïërabïriiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel. Cäänne moøgø na ariiø yøø yïthge päŋ ki muunni mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw na muuy mar beel.
english: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

english: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.

anywaa: Lääc paac bëët moa cïp no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre beege rwädhe apaar kurriiø, ki nyöök rööm apaar kurriiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, ki muuce mo beel mo wø cïp na aciel ko olämme. 'Ba moa cïp no olämme kiper raay beege nyöök atëëe apaar kurriiø.
english: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

anywaa: Lääc paac bëët moa cïp no olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër beege rwädhe ma pïërariiø kurŋween, ki nyöök rööm ma pïërabïciel, ki nyöök atëëe ma pïërabïciel, ki nyïïdïëk ma pïërabïciel ma rööm mo cwiicge oceele. Moøgø beege muuce moa cïp kiper nee gïn wø cïp olämme bääte cïp kur keere, ni beege moa cïp ki køør mana gweeli ki maaw.
english: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

anywaa: Køøre kanya ö Modhe na døny yo oduŋkaany røømmø kuna cääne ki Wuuö Jwøk, dwør Wuuö Jwøk awïnynye ni cäänna eni. Ni dwøl ööi ka bäät rëëbi mana näk nyuudhi mar wëën raay na en bäät acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy; ni dwørøgø ööi ki yïthakic gïïa näk ariiø na näk otïïö ki warkey na caal nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli. Ni put Wuuö Jwøki cäänö ki eni.
english: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Aran, ni ‹Kany wäro cïbï lambae moa na abïriiø karge, däär maac marge doo meenya nyïm gïn wø bëët lambae bääte.› »
english: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ni tïïc gø. Eni lambae acïp karge, nee nyïm gïn wø bëët lambae bääte meenyge kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Tïïc mana tïïc gïn wø bëët lambae bääte ki gø beeye en; dëëre bäre thääth ka warkey, ni tägi ka tiere piny këël wïth tuge maal. Gïn wø bëët lambae bääte manøgø atïïc na kare ni caala gïna nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe.
english: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør jø tuuŋ Libay dï jø Icriel ni døøyï geni mo waany.
english: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

anywaa: Kanyo døøyï geni mo waany, gïno tïïyï dëëtge beeye en; pïï mo wø døøc dhaanhø mo waany yïth raay wär jør dëëtge, ni wëëgï geni liel jïëc dëëtge ni penyge abïïe moge, nee rege døøcge mo waany.
english: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

anywaa: Køøre ge lwötö ki rwaath ki muuy mar beel na näk møga pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, ni lwötï thuwø ki rwaath mør no olämi mar raay.
english: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

anywaa: Ni kälï jø tuuŋ Libay nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø, ni cooŋï lwaa Icriel bäre kanya ciel.
english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

anywaa: Kanyo kälï jø tuuŋ Libay nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Icriel ceŋge dege cïba bäät jø tuuŋ Libay,
english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

anywaa: ni ö Aranni ni cïp jø tuuŋ Libay jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni caala muuy man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø mo ööi ki baŋ jø Icriel, kiper nee tïïc mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, tïïcge.
english: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.

anywaa: «Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay ceŋge dege cïba wïth rwäthögø, ni cïpï aciel no olämi mar raay, ni cïpï maya no olämi man wø waaŋ jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nee tïme no okïdi kiper jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay wär wëëk cuŋŋö nyïm Aran ki wääte, ni cïpï geni jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni caala muuy man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø.
english: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye jöö mana diï jø tuuŋ Libay ki jø Icriel møga pääŋŋö ki gø, ni tïm jø tuuŋ Libay na 'moa.
english: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

anywaa: «Køøre nø, noo nø døøyï jø tuuŋ Libay mo waany, ni cïpï geni ni caala muuy man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, løny ki man cige yi tïïc mar oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

anywaa: Kiper beeye geni na cïp jïra na bäre dï jø Icriel, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Gena käla  na 'moa na kar kaai mo jø Icriel bëët.
english: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

anywaa: Kiper kaai bëët mo jø Icriel moa näk cwøw ki kaai bëët mo lääc paac moge beege 'moa. Dïcäŋa nääa kaai bëët mo Ijep, kaai mo jø Icriel acïba kur keerge na 'moa;
english: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

anywaa: ni beeye ni lwøra jø tuuŋ Libay en na kar kaai bëët mo jø Icriel.
english: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Røk jø Icriel, jø tuuŋ Libay acïba na muuy jï Aran ki wääte, nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø tïïcge kiper jø Icriel, ni tïmge kaamar okïdi, nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo pïï dëët jø Icriel, mo caala gïna doo tägö kany wø näk mo geno nyänh buut oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

anywaa: Køøre gïïögø bëët atïïc Modhe ka Aran ki lwaa jø Icriel dëët jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ni døøcge rege mo waany ki raay, ni penyge abïïe moge; ni ö Aranni ni cïp geni nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni caala muuy man wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, ni tïïe ko okïdi kiperge, nee ge døøc mo waany.
english: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay aci yi tïï oduŋkaany røømmø ni ge ena cer Aran ki wääte. 'Ba ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe, gïïögø atïïcge dëët jø tuuŋ Libay na karge.
english: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «Man beeye ciik kiper jø tuuŋ Libay; cwøw mo cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø kurbïïc këël mo kaala pïërariiø kurbïïc doo cøøa yi tïïc mar oduŋkaany røømmø;
english: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

anywaa: 'ba kany wø päŋ cwiiri moge na pïërabïïc, ge doo ööa wøk yi tïïc, ni ge ba doo tïïö ki tïïe mo teek këët.
english: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø, løny jïge ki man kønyge nyïïmëëkge ki man gwøkge oduŋkaany røømmø; 'ba geni ki dëëtge ge ba doo tïïö ki tïïe mo teek. Manøgø beeye jöö mano cïbï tïïc ceŋ jø tuuŋ Libay ki gø.»
english: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa ö jø Icrielli wøk ki Ijep, ri dwääy mana dïkwøŋ, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe dï paap Caynay, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

anywaa: ni «Jø Icriel ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wär wøørge na kare yi kanya näk owäŋŋö.
english: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

anywaa: Kanyo tïme na ri nïne apaar kurŋween yi dwääni, kanyo tïm pinynyi na wïthïënhö, ajwöma manøgø wär wøørru ki køør ciik moe ki uutjïëthe moe bëët, ni beeye kanya näk owäŋŋö.»
english: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acäänö ki jø Icriel nee ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie nee wøørge.
english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

anywaa: Køøre na tïme na ri nïne apaar kurŋween yi dwääy mana dïkwøŋ ni pinynya wïthïënhö, ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie awøørge dï paap Caynay. Gïnögø atïïc jø Icrielli na kare ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy mo dëëtge da läp kiper mana gutge dëër dhaanhø mo othøw, ni käre løny jïge ki man wøørge ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie dïcäŋeca. 'Ba ki dïcäŋeca gena put ö nyïm Modhe ka Aran.
english: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

anywaa: Ni köge jï Modhe, «?Aŋø, këël na bëëtwa ni dëëtwa da läp kiper mana gutwa dëër dhaanhø mo othøw, aperŋø ni män wa ki man cïpwa olämi mar Wuuö Jwøk ki jø Icriel na aciel yi kanya no owäŋŋö?»
english: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïge, ni «Cuŋŋu turu, nee Wuuö Jwøk pëënynya ki gïno caane kiperu.»
english: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel: Ni ni näk da dhaanhø rou wala røk nyïïkwaayu mo dëëre da läbö ki køør mana gut dëër dhaanhø mo othøw, wala dhaanhø mo ree ojïtö ki wääth kany mo bäär, eni ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie poot dee wøørø thuwø jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyo tïme na ri nïne apaar kurŋween ri riet dwäde, ajwöma manøgø wär wøørge ki wïthïënhö. Nyidiel ocamge ki muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø, ko omarø mo keec.
english: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

anywaa: Kär dee gø mo wecge mo këëta amöölla, ni bäŋe cöö mo toorge ri gø. Ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wär wøørge ki køør ciik moe bëët.
english: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mo dëëre waany mo ba en  kany mo bäär, noo kweere jaak ki man wøør ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, eni wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic tuuŋge, kiper na käre olämi mar Wuuö Jwøk cïbö yi kanya no owäŋŋö. 'Ba ŋatøgø bääyö mare oen wïïe.
english: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

anywaa: «Ni näk da jur dïïu mo manynya man wøør ajwöm cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie jï Wuuö Jwøk, wär wøøre ki køør ciik moe ki uutjïëthe moe bëët. Kiper beeye ciik aciel jïïu kiper jur ki dhaanhø ma o thwønh paayø.»
english: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

anywaa: Dïcäŋa ö oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na guri piny, pöölö aöö ni uum gø. 'Ba kanya tïme na wïthïënhö, pöölö atïmö ni nëëni kaamar maac bäät oduŋkaara, këël mana këët amöölla.
english: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

anywaa: Ni put bëëdö na enøgønø cooth, ni ö pööllögø ni uum oduŋkaara ki dïcäŋ, ni bëëde ni liel thuwø ki wäär kaamar maac.
english: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö pöölö wø tïŋi maal bäät oduŋkaara, kar kaagø jø Icriel wø tïŋŋö; 'ba kany wø ö pöölö wø duu piny yie, jø Icriel thuwø puta tïïö ki twïër kaace.
english: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

anywaa: Ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel wø tïŋŋö, ni tïïge ki twëëre thuwø ki køør dwøre. 'Ba kany wø poot pöölö ni ena bäät oduŋkaara, ge wø bëëdö yi twïër.
english: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

anywaa: Këël mano ruu pöölö bäät oduŋkaara ki nïne mo thööth, jø Icriel dwør Wuuö Jwøk wø gwøkge gwøø, ni ge ba tïŋŋi.
english: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.

anywaa: Ni näk pöölö bëëdö bäät oduŋkaara ki nïne mo nøk, ge wø bëëdö yi twïër ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk ge wø tïŋŋö.
english: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.

anywaa: Ki kwör møøk pöölö cuŋŋö ka abøøya ni put bëëtö këël amöölla; 'ba kany wø ö pöölö wø ö maal ka amöölla, ge wø tïŋŋö. Këël pöölö ö maal ki waŋcäŋ wala dï wäär, ge wø tïŋŋö.
english: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

anywaa: Ni näk pöölö bëëdö bäät oduŋkaara ki nïne ariiø, wala dwääy aciel, wala beeta kany mo yie bäär, jø Icriel wø bëëdö thuwø yi twïër marge, ni ge ba tïŋŋi; 'ba kany wø ö maal, ge wø tïŋŋö.
english: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

anywaa: Ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk ge wø tïïö ki twëëre, ni tïŋge thuwø ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Geni dwør Wuuö Jwøk agwøkge kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm geni ki ri Modhe.
english: At the commandment of the Lord they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Thädhï ki tuŋi ariiø ma gwel-bïrö kiper nee tïmge na gïï wø cwølï lwaak ki ge, nee tïmge na nyuuthe kiper daak twïër thuwø.
english: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

anywaa: Ni kany wäro kooth tuŋi karge riedi, lwaak bäre rege dige cooŋa buutï deŋ dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni näk mo kootha aciel keere, dïbwöthe moa näk wïth lwaae mo wïth tuŋi mo Icriel rege dige cooŋa buutï.
english: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro koothu tuŋi døc ni döötge ena maal, twëëre moa en løø oduŋkaara jï løø kur tuulcäŋ doo tïŋŋö.
english: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

anywaa: Ni kany wäro cäŋu tuŋi koothø ri rietge, twëëre moa en jï løø tier-piny ko oduŋkaara doo tïŋŋö. 'Ba kany wäro tïmge ni ge tïŋŋö, tuŋi doo koodhø.
english: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

anywaa: Ni kany wäro tïme ni cooŋa lwaak kanya ciel, tuŋi wär koothu; 'ba kär koothu døc ni döötge ena maal.
english: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

anywaa: «'Ba wäät Aran na näk dïlämme beege na doo kooth tuŋi. Gïnögø otïmö na ciik jïïu cooth ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët.
english: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro cou baŋ leny nou këëdu ki nyïïmännu mo wø many uuni nou dïïmge yi ŋöömmu, tuŋi doo koodhø ni di layø, kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu wïïe pare ki uuni, ni piem uuni ceŋ nyïïmännu.
english: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

anywaa: Kany wäro tïme na cääŋŋe mo met ec mou, ni beege nïr ajwöm moa no ocaanø jïïu, ki nïr wø päär dwääyi yïthge cooth, tuŋi dou koodhø bäät olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki bäät olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër; nee tuŋi moøgø tïmge na gïï parru wïthu ki ge nyïm Jwøu. Beeye a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.»
english: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïne mo riet dwäde na pïërariiø, ri riet cwiiri, pöölö atïŋ maal ki bäät oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïŋge ki dï paap Caynay, ni putge wääth ki wäädhi moa caathge. Ni ö pöölö ni cuŋŋe ni ena bäät paap Paran.
english: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye wääth mana dïkwøŋ na tïŋge ki køør mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Juuda akwøŋ tïŋŋö ki køør bëëra mar twïër marge, ni dïbwödhi marge beeye Nacøn wär Aminadap.
english: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Icakar beeye Natanel o Dhuar.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beeye Eliap o Këëlön.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya puth oduŋkaara wøk, jøøa käär oduŋkaara, ni beege nyïïkwaac Gërcön ki nyïïkwaac Mërari, gena tïŋŋö.
english: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Ruben atïŋŋö ki køør bëëra mar twïër marge, ni dïbwödhi marge beeye Elicuur o Cediyör.
english: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Cimien beeye Celumiel o Curicaday.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Gaat beeye Eliacap o Deeweel.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac Kät atïŋŋö ni ge käära japa en kur keerge; 'ba oduŋkaara agur piny kanya poode ni ge poot kär pïï.
english: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Ipariem atïŋŋö ki køør bëëra mar twïër marge, ni dïbwödhi marge beeye Elicama wär Ammiyut.
english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Maneeca beeye Gameeliel o Pedacur.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Abidan o Gidiöni.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Daan atïŋŋö na aŋuudi køør lwaae bëët, ni ge cäädhi ki køør bëëra mar twïër marge, ni dïbwödhi marge beeye Akiedhar wär Amicaday.
english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rearward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Acer beeye Pagiel wär Okaran.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

anywaa: Ni dïbwödhi mar lwaa leny mar jø tuuŋ Naptali beeye Akira wär Enan.
english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye jöör wääth mana cääth jø Icrielli ki gøøni kanya tïŋge ki køør lwaae moge.
english: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acäänö ko Obap o Raguël nyï Midien; 'ba Raguël beeye wää cï Modhe. Ni kö Modhe jï gø, ni «Wa tïŋŋö ennø ni wa cøøa kanya kö Wuuö Jwøki ni di cïbö jïwa. Ennø, ø aa na aciel, niï jïtï ki bëëtö mo beer buutwa, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel ee buŋŋö ki gïn mo beer.»
english: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Obapi jï Modhe, na «A ba cii; a døøa powa baŋ tuuŋwa.»
english: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, na «A kwaya ïïni, kär wa weyï, kiper kwör wäro pïwa piny yïthge dï paap ŋäyï, kiper ï tïmö ni ïïna waŋ jïwa.
english: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï aay ki waani, gïn wäro beer noo tïïc Wuuö Jwøki jïwa, tïïcwa tïïö jïrï thuwø.»
english: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö ki bäät Kïn Wuuö Jwøk, ni cääthge ki nïne adäk. 'Ba ki yïth nïrögø na adäk yøø, acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy wø cäädhö nyïmge, kiper nee kany wø pïge piny yie joot ki køøre.
english: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.

anywaa: Ni ö pöölö mar Wuuö Jwøk ni en bäätge ki waŋcäŋ, kany wø näk ge tïŋŋö yi twïër.
english: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø näk ma acanduk tïŋŋö, Modhe wø köö, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal, ni wëëgï nyïïmännï keethø, ni tïïyï jø wø män ki ïïni nee bwøkge nyïmï.»
english: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø cuŋŋe yie, eni wø köö, «Awuuö Jwøk, duu baŋ jø Icriel moa näk kum kum.»
english: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.

anywaa: Kar kaagø jiy atïmö ni ge dwaallø kiper teek bëëtö. 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Wuuö Jwøki, ena wëër; ni ö maaci  mar Wuuö Jwøk ni liele dïge, ni waaŋ løøk mør deŋ twïër.
english: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni jwöŋge dëër Modhe; 'ba Modhe alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö maaci ni thøøe.
english: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋ kaace aput cak ni Tabëëra, kiper mana ö maa Wuuö Jwøki na liele dïge kaace.
english: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre ma teeŋi moa en dï jø Icriel, cwïnyge atïmö ni päl kiper cam; ni ö jø Icrielli thuwø ni cäŋge jwøk, ni köge, «?Aŋa noo cïpi jïwa ki rïŋö mo camwa?
english: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

anywaa: Waani, wïthwa aparwa ki rec moa wara camwa Ijep ni ba ŋeew, ki bathiki, ki bacalli, ki bacal thum.
english: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, teek marwa anø aay, ni bäŋ gïn mør mo raŋwa; 'ba beeye cami na meena keere en.»
english: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba meena caala nyeŋ köödhi mo therø, ni kïte caala kït buudi.
english: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy wø cøø ni kwaanyge gø; køøre guurge guurö ki kïdi, wala wälge wälö ki pany; ni thaalge gø ki dak, ni tïïcge gø na dääpe. 'Ba mete caala met dääpe mo odeelø ki maaw.
english: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

anywaa: Kar kaace, kanya wara täk thööy ki wäär dï twïër, meena wø ööa piny na aciel ki gø.
english: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

anywaa: Kar kaace Modhe dööt jiy awïnynye ni ge jwöŋö yïth atude moge, ni ŋati man nø cuŋŋö dho oduŋkaara mare. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëre døc. 'Ba Modhe yie atïmö ni raac, ni goote thuwø.
english: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, na «?Aŋø na tïïyï gïn mo raac dëër laŋŋï en? ?Na agïnaŋø ni yaa baa ni leeŋï jøøi bëët bääta ni caala tëër mo peek en?
english: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jøøi bëët ii yaa käärö ki yia ni nywøla ge? ?Aperŋø nø ni kööï jïra en, ni käära geni ki kööra, kaawat man wø ö dïpïdi wø käär nyilaal mo dhøøth, ni kïtha geni yi ŋöömma buugï jï wëëkge?
english: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

anywaa: ?A känna kaa ki rïŋö mo mëëga jøøi bëët ii? Kiper ge jwöŋö dëëra ni köge, ni ‹Mooc wa ki rïŋö mo camwa.›
english: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ba løny jïra ki man käära jøøi bëët a keera, kiper geni ge caala tëër mo peek bääta.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk gïnögø poot tïïyï tïïö dëëra, beerra man putï a 'näk. 'Ba ni näk mo yiï met ki aani, put aani 'näk møn, nee can mano tägi dëëra nee ba jooda këët.»
english: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Cooŋ jiy ma pïërabïriiø jïra røk jø døøk Icriel moa ŋäyï, ni beege jø døøŋŋø moa näk dïbwöthe moge. Käl geni buut oduŋkaany røømmø, ni wëëgï geni cuŋŋö ki ïïni na aciel kaace.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

anywaa: Køøre aano ö piny ni cääna ki ïïni kaace, ni lwöta ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en bäätï ni kïtha gø bäätge; ni ö geni ni käärge jiy na aciel ki ïïni, ni ba käära ïïni keerï këët.
english: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

anywaa: «Køøre wär caanï jï jø Icriel bëët, ni ‹Døøyu dëëtu mo waany kiper diøø, nou cämu ki rïŋö. Kiper uuna jwöŋö ni wïnynyi ya Wuuö Jwøki, kanya kööu, na «?Aŋa noo mooc wa ki rïŋö mo camwa? Kiper kanya bëëtwa Ijep bëëtö marwa beer.» 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk ocïpi jïïu ki rïŋö nee cammu;
english: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

anywaa: nou ba cämö ki dïcäŋ aciel, wala nïne ariiø, wala nïne abïïc, wala nïne apaar, wala nïne ma pïërariiø keerge.
english: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

anywaa: 'Ba u cämö ki dwääy bäre, gøøc mano tuny wøk ki ummu ni tïm cwïnynyu ni cøl ki gø, kiper na kwierru Wuuö Jwøk na en dïïu, ni jwöŋu dëëre ni kööu, na «?Aperŋø na öwa wøk ki Ijep?» › »
english: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, ni «Jiy moi ni ena dïge ii beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ma cwøw tøŋ; 'ba ïïna köö, ni ‹Aano cïpi ki rïŋö nee camge ki dwääy bäre.›
english: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, lwaa pïïth dïëk ki lwaa pïïth dhäk di ŋaalø jïge ni rømge bëët? ?Wala lwaa rëëö bäre mana en yi naama dwøŋ doo cooŋa kanya ciel jïge ni rømge bëët?»
english: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, na «?Aŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, bada atïmö ni ba bäär na bëëde cøøn enø? Ojootï kawaane nø ki man näk luubö mara thura kare na adïëri kiperï wala ba thur kare.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe adøny wøk ni caan luup mo Wuuö Jwøk jï jø Icriel; ni cooŋ jiy ma pïërabïriiø røk jø døøŋŋø moge, ni wëëk geni cuŋŋö lak oduŋkaara bäre.
english: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put ö piny ni ena yi pöölö, ni cääne ki Modhe, ni lwöte ri Jwïëc Jwøk mana en bäät Modhe, ni kïth gø bäät jø døøk Icriel moa näk pïërabïriiø. 'Ba kanya ö Jwïëc Jwøki bäätge, dwør Jwøk aputge køp. 'Ba køp dwør Jwøk kärge nwøø këët.
english: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace, da jiy ariiø mo odööŋ twïër; na aciel nyeŋŋe Eldat, ni maya nyeŋŋe Mödat. 'Ba ge ena dëët jøøa näk nyeŋge ogöörö, ni ge kär ci buut oduŋkaara. Ni ö Jwïëc Jwøki ni pïïe bäätge, ni putge dwør Jwøk køp dï twïër.
english: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør mo poot na wøp areŋ baŋ Modhe ni kööe, ni «Eldat ki Mödat ni køp dwør Jwøk yi twïër ice.»
english: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua o Nun, na näk ŋat wø bëëdö ni kønya Modhe ki tïïc ki mana käl thïnhö, aköö, na «Wui Kwäärö Modhe, män geni!»
english: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Modhe jïre, na «?Aŋø ni tïme ni këëö ïïni na kara en? Kiper doo beer ki man ö jic Wuuö Jwøki bëët ni tïmge na nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kïth jwïëye bäätge.»
english: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord's people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ki jø døøk Icriel adøø twïër.
english: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, jamø akwönnö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööl ajwëëyi ki lak naama dwøŋ, ni wëëk geni määdö lak twïër, ni karge cään ki ŋøøm, na aŋuunge ki mana täkge lak twïër okëët kany mo bäye caala wääth man wø caath dhaanhe ki waŋcäŋ aciel bäre, ni bäc løø twïër maya caala gø thuwø.
english: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni thöörge waŋcäŋöca ki wäänöca ki waŋcäŋ maya ni ge maaŋŋa ajwëëyi. Ni ŋat mo maga mo nøk jïtö ki kömerri apaar. Ni määcge geni deŋ twïër bäre.
english: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni rïŋ poot tiet lakge, ni poot kärge thöörö, wëëc Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät jiy; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl täw mo leth døc bäät jiy.
english: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋ kaace acwøl ni Kibïröth-Ataba, na näk tiere beeye Bwöc-Päl-Cwïny, kiper beeye kanya koony jiy yie moa cwïnyge päl kiper cam.
english: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni tïŋge ki Kibïröth-Ataba, ni cige Adhëëröth ni bëëtge yie.
english: And the people journeyed from Kibroth–hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø, Mariyam ka Aran nyeŋ Modhe awaacge kiper cïïe mana nywøme na näk nyi jø Kuuc, kiper cïïe mana nywøme beeye dhaagø mo käla ri jø Kuuc.
english: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

anywaa: Ni köge, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk cäänö ki ri Modhe keere? ?Eni kär cäänö ki rewa thuwø?» Køøre gïnögø awïny Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe beeye dhaanhø mo mwöl døc, ni mööl mare kaala mar jiy bëët moa en bäät piny.
english: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

anywaa: Ni put Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Modhe ka Aran ki Mariyam, ni «Ööu wøk karu dääi ni ööu nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø.» Ni putge ö wøk karge dääi.
english: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aö piny ni ena yi pöölla näk ree ee wenyø, ni cuŋŋe dho oduŋkaara, ni cwøl Aran ki Mariyam, ni öge nyïm karge riedi.
english: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Wïnynyu luupa ii. Kany wø näk da nyikuŋ Jwøk dïïu, a na Wuuö Jwøk raa wø nyoodha nyoodhø jïre ki ri lääk, ni cääna ki eni ki yïth lääk.
english: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

anywaa: 'Ba a ba cäänö ki dhaanhnha ma Modhe na enøgønø, kiper beeye eni no oŋäädhö dï paara bäre.
english: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.

anywaa: A cäänö ki eni ni løøŋwa dhøkwa ki gøøni, naa caana luubö mo tiere nëënö, ni paa aŋaade; ni ö eni ni raŋ kïta, a na Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aperŋø nø na käru lwäyö ki man waayu nyeŋ dhaanhnha ma Modhe?»
english: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki geni døc, ni paany ree buutge.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö pööle na paany ree bäät oduŋkaara, Mariyam ajoot ni dëëre da dhøøbø, *11* ni ö dëëre ni neepwøth ni tar. Ni ö Aranni ni lwiith Mariyam ni joot gø ni dëëre da dhøøbø;
english: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

anywaa: ni kööe jï Modhe, «Wui Kwäärö, kär wa jäälï, kiper gïna tïïcwa, tïïcwa ni wïthwa kärwa caarø; 'ba waana bääyö.
english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

anywaa: Kär Maryam tïïyï ni caala nyilaal mo nywöli no othøw, mo dëëre olööthö kanyo ö wøk ki yi menni.»
english: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ajwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, na «A kwaya ïïni, Awuuö Jwøk, dwøk dëëre kare.»
english: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, na «?Aŋø, doo naa wänni oŋuut täärnyïm gø ki laaw jaak, eni wïïe bäŋa doo lääö ki nïne abïriiø? Kïthu eni wøk ŋää twïër, nee bëëde kaace ki nïne abïriiø; køør manøgønø, løny ki man cäŋi duu twïër.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.

anywaa: Køøre Mariyam abëëdö wøk ŋää twïër ki nïne abïriiø, ni ö jiyi ni kärge tïŋŋö këël mana duu Mariyammi twïër.
english: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre jiy atïŋŋö ki Adhëëröth, ni tïïge ki twïër dï paap Paran.
english: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Jäägï ki jiy mo liew ŋööm Keenan, ni beeye ŋöömmo cïba jï jø Icriel. Wär ge jääŋŋï na dhaanhø aciel ma dïbwödhi ri jø tuuŋ man nø røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.»
english: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jøøgø ajääŋŋe ki dï paap Paran ki køør mana köömmi ya Wuuö Jwøki, ni jøøgø bëët gena dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel.
english: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋge beege ii; ki røk jø tuuŋ Ruben beeye Cimia o Dhakur;
english: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Cimien beeye Capath wär Ori;
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda beeye Kalëp o Jöpöni;
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Icakar beeye Igal o Jocep;
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem beeye Awcë o Nun;
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Palti o Rapu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beeye Gadiel o Cödi;
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Jocep mana käl ri jø tuuŋ Maneeca beeye Gadi o Cuci;
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Daan beeye Amiel o Gemali;
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Acer beeye Cethur o Mikaël;
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Naptali beeye Nabi o Yabi;
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

anywaa: ki røk jø tuuŋ Gaat beeye Guwel o Maki.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

anywaa: Moøgø beege nyeŋ jøøa jääŋ Modhe wøk kuna liewge ŋøøm. 'Ba Modhe nyeŋ Awcë o Nun acwøle ni Jøcua.
english: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

anywaa: Kanya ö Modhe na jääŋ jøøgø nee ŋööm Keenan liewge, ena köö jïge, ni «Cou këël mano pïïyu kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp, ni pööthu mïëya en bäät kïte,
english: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

anywaa: ni neennu ŋöömö ki bëëtö mare, man näk nyïëdi, ni neennu bëët jiy thuwø moa näk bëëdö yie, ki man näk ge teek wala ge jägö, wala ge thööth wala ge nøk.
english: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

anywaa: Ni neennu ŋöömö man bëëtge yie ice, ki man näk mo beer wala raac, wala ge bëëdö yïth mïëri mo ena yi pwöla, wala mo ocielø ki kiiri.
english: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

anywaa: Ni neennu ŋöömö ki man näk caammi ciek yie wala ba ciek, wala ki man näk da jenni mo otuy yie wala bäŋgø. Uuni, magu rou, ni kännu ki nyïïjenni mo wø cam ki yi ŋöömmögø.» 'Ba kar kaaca beeye kany wø ciek nyïïomøki moa dïkwøŋ.
english: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

anywaa: Køøre gena aay ni ge liewa ŋöömö, ni täkge ka dï paap Dhïn këël mana këët Reeyöp na en buut Libö-Amath.
english: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

anywaa: 'Ba gena aay ni ge cøra Nëgëp, ni pïïcge Keeprön, paana bëët nyïïkwaac Anaki yie, ni beege Akimen ki Cëëci ki Thalmay. 'Ba kar kaaca, Keeprön onø geer ni cwiiye abïriiø kanya poode ni paana cwøl ni Dhöän poot kär geerø Ijep.
english: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

anywaa: Køøre dïlëëwe apïï yi gool mana cwøl ni Ëcköl, ni ŋutge ki bat jaath omøk mo dëëre da nyïëdi ma jwala aciel, ni lïërge gø ka athøra ni bielli ya jiyi ariiø. Ni kuunge thuwø ki nyïïjenni mo caala nyïïadikwäle, ki nyïïolämmi.
english: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

anywaa: Ni put nyeŋ kaace cwøl ni Goor Ëcköl, kiper beeye kanya ö jø Icrielli na ŋøtge jwala mar nyïïjenni yie.
english: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne ma pïëraŋween, dïlëëwe aduuö ki kuna liewge piny.
english: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

anywaa: Ni pïïcge baŋ Modhe ka Aran ki lwaa jø Icriel bäre kany mo cwøl ni Kadëc dï paap Paran; ni caange luup bëët jïge ki jï lwaak bäre, ni nyoothge nyïïjenni moa kälge ki yi ŋöömmöca.
english: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

anywaa: Ni köge jï Modhe, ni «Waana pïï yi ŋöömma jääŋŋï wa yie; 'ba beeye ŋöömö mo caak ki maar kïc päl yie møn, ni moi beege nyïëdi moa jootwa yie.
english: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moøke ni bëëdö yie yøøke beege jiy mo teek, ni päänye moøke døøŋŋø døc no ogeerø ni teek, ni jootwa nyïïkwaac Anak kaace thuwø.
english: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Amalëk ge bëëdö Nëgëp, ni ö jø Këth ki jø Jeebuc ki jø Amör ni bëëtge mïëya en bäät kïte, ni ö jø Keenan ni bëëtge deŋ naama dwøŋ ki deŋ Naam Jördan.»
english: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba Kalëp jiy ajwøe nyïm Modhe, ni kööe, «Ööø maal ennø, nee paanøgø lwørø, kiper løny jïïø ki man böötø geni.»
english: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa aay ki eni aköö, ni «Ba løny jïïø ki man cøøø baŋ jøøke, kiper teeka geni døc ki øøni.»
english: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni putge waac mo reyø køp jï jø Icriel kiper ŋöömma liewge, ni köge, ni «Ŋöömma ciwa yie kuna liewa gø beeye ŋöömö mo dïdö ki wïth jiy mo wø bëëdö yie. Ni jiy moa jootwa yie bëët beege jiy mo bäyö mo dëëtge døøŋŋø.
english: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

anywaa: Ni jootwa jø Nëpilim thuwø kaace, na käl nyïïkwaac Anak rege. Ni neenwa rewa kaamar adïtwie, ni nëën wa thuwø na enønø ki baŋge.»
english: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

anywaa: Køøre lwaak bäre ajwöŋö ni döötge ege tïŋ maal, ni ö jiyi  ni gööge ko oduuru wäänöca.
english: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni ŋurge ki nyeŋ Modhe ka Aran, ni ö lwaaøgø bäre ni köge jïge, na «?Aŋø ni ba tïme kere wa thøøa Ijep wala dï paabi en?
english: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl wa yi ŋöömmi en ki man thøøwa dhi tøŋ? Waani, mään mowa ko obwöre mowa di maaø ki tøŋ jaak. ?Aŋø, ba theemma man døøwa Ijep nø?»
english: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

anywaa: Ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni «Beerra man jëëtø ki kwääc lwaak, nøø døø Ijep.»
english: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran rege agøøge piny ni nëënö jï acooŋa mar lwaa jø Icriel bäre.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua o Nun ki Kalëp o Jöpöni, na en dëët jøøa liew ŋøøm, ni jeecge abïïe moge ki gootø.
english: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

anywaa: Ni köge jï lwaa jø Icriel bäre, ni «Ŋöömma liewa ni cääthwa dïëre beeye ŋöömö mo beer døc.
english: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

anywaa: Ni näk Wuuö Jwøk mëër ki øøni, ø kïthe yi ŋöömmögø ni caak ki maar kïc päl yie enø, ni mëëk gø øøni.
english: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

anywaa: 'Ba kär røgu thïïŋŋu dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ba lwäyu ki jø paanøgø, kiper ge böötø böötö ki jöö mo jööt jaak. Kiper gëëŋi marge onø daak, ni Wuuö Jwøk ena buutø; käru lwäyö ki geni.»
english: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaak bäre atïmö ni manynya man këërge geni ki kïte.
english: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, «?A ki kany mo nyïëdi nø noo poot jøøi ii naa poot ege taaø? ?A ki kany mo nyïëdi ni pootge naa ba ŋääthge en, këël na bëëde ni ŋïïce mo døøŋŋø yaa tïïö dïge?
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ge raanynya raanynyø ki täw mo leth, ni døøya ïïni wï paac mo dwøŋ mo teeka eni døc ki geni.»
english: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Modhe jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Jøøi akälï wøk ki dï jø Ijep ki teek marï. 'Ba ni näk da gïn mo tïïyï tïïö dëët jøøi møn, kanyo ö jø Ijepi noo wïnyge gø,
english: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

anywaa: køpge købø jï jø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en.
