'Ba ennø, Awuuö Jwøk, onø wïny jø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en niï ena dï jøøi, ni wïnyge gø thuwø ni riï iï nyoodhø niï nëënö, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni pöölö marï na näk ree ee wenyø cuŋŋö bäätge, niï cäädha nyïmge yi pööllögø ki waŋcäŋ, ni cäädhï nyïmge ki wäär thuwø yi pöölla näk ree ee wenyø ni liel kaamar maac.
english: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

anywaa: Ni näk jøøi bëët 'nägï nääø kaamar dhaanhø aciel, køøre mïëri moa näk gïrï ege nø wïnynyö, ge köö,
english: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Kiper na ba lønye jï Wuuö Jwøk ki man kïth jøøi yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere ni cïbe cïbö jïge, beeye tiere na nää geni dï paap.›
english: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, a kwaya ïïni, Awuuö Jwøk, nee teek marï na dwøŋ nyoothï kaawat mana caanï, ni kööï,
english: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹A na Wuuö Jwøk a ba laar wëër, ni mëëya ni wø ba jøøl päl, ni ŋat mo obääyö ki ŋat adhala wëënna wëënnö. 'Ba ŋat raay poot ba wiia ka ajäla, ni raay moa tïïc wëëe poot coola coolø dëët obwöre moge, këël mano pïïe dää beenhnhe wala ŋweer beenhnhe.›
english: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a kwaya ïïni nee raay mo jøøi nee wëënnï ki køør mëëyï na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl, kaawat mana wëënnï geni ki mana täge ki kanya öge wøk ki Ijep këël kawaane ennø.»
english: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Gena wëënna ki køør mana caanï.
english: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ajiem mara bäät piny bäre opääŋe.
english: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa pääny aani kwöre apaar, ni kärge dwøra wïnynyö, këël na jootge ajiem mara ki ŋïïce 'moa na tïïa Ijep ki dï paap,
english: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

anywaa: bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo neen ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jï wëëkge; ni bäŋ ŋat mo joot gø røk jøøa taak aani.
english: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhnha ma Kalëp okïtha yi ŋöömma ci yie, ni tïme na mar nyïïkwaaye na bäre bäre, kiper mana bëët jwïëye ni ena kur keere, ni caath køøra ki cwïnye bäre.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, kiper mana näk jø Amalëk ki jø Keenan ge  bëëdö yïth gøli mo ŋöömmögø, diøø røgu wär løgu ni cou dï paap nou cøra jöö mano ci Naama Kwaar.»
english: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jï Modhe ka Aran,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi noo ö lwaaki man ni raac en noo ŋure ki nyeŋŋa? Aani, ŋurö mar jø Icriel mana ŋurge ki nyeŋŋa ki gø awïnynya.
english: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, caanï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, gïïa caannu na wïnynya tïïa tïïö ni dwøga gø dëëtu.
english: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

anywaa: Uuno thøw ni dööŋ dëëtu dï paap kany. U na no okwaanø bëët, na näk cwiiri mou tägi ka pïërariiø këël moa näk kaala pïërariiø, ni beege u jøøa ŋurö ki nyeŋŋa,
english: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

anywaa: bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dëëtu mo ö yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere nou bëëdu yie; 'ba beeye Kalëp o Jöpöni ki Jøcua o Nun keerge noo ci yie.
english: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre mou, moa wäŋŋu ni di maaø ki tøŋ, geno kïtha yi ŋöömmögø, ni jootge ŋöömma kwierru.
english: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuno thøw ni dööŋ dëëtu dï paap kany.
english: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

anywaa: Ni ö obwöre mou ni tïmge na dïkwääc dïëk ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween dï paap, ni jwørge gïï mo leth kiper mana weyu aani, këël mano thummu ki thøø bëët dï paap.
english: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

anywaa: Ki køør kwään nïne moa liewu ŋøøm ki geni, nïra näk pïëraŋween, ajäl gïïa bayu jwørru jwørø ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, ni tïm cwiirri man nø na kar dïcäŋ aciel, ni jootu gootø mara.
english: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

anywaa: Ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mara anø caana; 'ba ka adïëri møn, gïnögø tïïa tïïö dëër lwaak man ni raac en na cooŋ dëëtge kanya ciel kipera. Ge thum ni thøøge dï paabi.› »
english: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jøøa jääŋ Modhe kiper nee ŋöömö liewge gena thøw, ni beege jøøa duuö na tïïc lwaak bäre ni ŋurö ki nyeŋ Modhe kiper na caange waac mo reyø kiper ŋöömö;
english: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

anywaa: ni thøwge ka ajäla mo leth nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa aay na liew ŋöömö, Jøcua o Nun ki Kalëp o Jöpöni adööŋ ni kwøw.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe gïïa caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre acaane jï jø Icriel bëët, ni ö jiyi ni kïmge døc.
english: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

anywaa: Ni møølge ka aruunnø ni ge cøø mïëya en bäät kïte, ni köge, ni «Waana bääyö. 'Ba ennø, waana öö nee wa ciwa kanya caan Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jïge, na «?Aperŋø na dhallu dwør Wuuö Jwøk en? Ennø, wääth maru ba thur kare.
english: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.

anywaa: Käru cøø, nou ba bööt nyïïmännu, kiper Wuuö Jwøk tøør dïïu.
english: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

anywaa: Jø Amalëk ki jø Keenan ena nyïmmu kaace. U pätha ceŋge ni 'näkge uuni, kiper uuna døø ŋäthu ki man caathu køør Wuuö Jwøk. Wuuö Jwøk tøør buutu këët.»
english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.

anywaa: 'Ba gena ci bäät kïdi yïth mïëya en bäät kïte ki wïthge jaak, ni Modhe ka acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy odööŋ twïër.
english: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

anywaa: Køøre jø Amalëk ki jø Keenan moa bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte, gena öö ni böötge jø Icriel ni riemge geni këël mana pïïcge Örma.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Kanyo pïïyu yi ŋöömma cïba jïïu na kany bëëdu yie,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

anywaa: u doo cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege olämme mo käla røk pïïth dhäk wala dïëk. Olämme moøgø beege mo wø waaŋ bäre wala mo waaŋŋa thääŋŋe, ni cïp kaper kööŋ mana kööŋö ki gø, wala cïp ka køør met ec, wala cïp kiper ajwöm mou moa näk nïne moge ocïp piny, nee tïme na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd, or of the flock:

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, gïno tïïyu jïra bee en, ŋat wø känni ko olämi, wär cïpe jïra ki muuy mar beel, ni beeye møø mo pøøth ma rumi aciel mo lwørra røk rumme apaar moa en yi  rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw ma rumme ariiø mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in.
english: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

anywaa: Ni jiiŋ muuy thuwø mar køøŋ nyïïomøki ma rumme ariiø mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in. Moøgø beege gïïo jiiŋŋe kiper nyidiel man wø cïp no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk olämi beeye nywø røømmø, muuy mar beel wär jiiŋŋe, ni beeye møø mo pøøth ma rumme ariiø mo lwørra røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw ma rumme adäk mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in;
english: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

anywaa: ni cïp muuy thuwø mar køøŋ nyïïomøki ma rumme adäk mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in, nee tïme na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø jiiŋ rwaath jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, wala olämi man wø thääŋŋe waaŋ kiper kööŋ, wala olämi man wø thääŋŋe waaŋ ni wø duunni ki mëër,
english: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:

anywaa: ŋatøce wär cïpe ki muuy mar beel, ni cïbe ka rwaath na aciel, ni beeye møø mo pøøth ma rumme adäk mo lwørra røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw ma rumme aŋween mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in;
english: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

anywaa: ni cïp muuy thuwø mar køøŋ nyïïomøki ma rumme aŋween mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in, ni beeye muuy man wø waaŋ ki maac, nee tïme na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Moøgø beege gïïo tïïc kiper rwaath wala nywø røømmø wala nyi røømmø wala nya ateea mano cïp no olämi.
english: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

anywaa: Kanyo jiiŋŋu olämme moøgø, rumi mar beel wär tïïyu ni röömi ki kwään lääc paac moo cïpu.
english: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

anywaa: « ‹Jøøa näk wäät thwöth paac bëët kany wäro cïpge olämme mo wø waaŋ, nee tïmge na gïï mo ŋwäänyge met jï Wuuö Jwøk, gïïögø otïïcge ki øtjöö ma enøgønø.
english: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da jur mo bëëdö dïïu, kany wø cïpe ko olämi man wø waaŋ mo ŋwäänynye met jï Wuuö Jwøk, wär tïïe kaawat man wø tïïyu.
english: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.

anywaa: 'Ba u na lwaa Icriel, otïmö ni da ciik aciel kiperu ki juurre mo wø bëëdö dïïu, ni beeye ciik mo bëëdö cooth këël yïth beenhnhe mou moo ööi. Uuni ki juurre moø ni bëëdö dïïu yøø, u poot ni uuna aciel bëët ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, otïmö ni da ciik aciel ki jöö aciel man wø ŋøl luubö ki gø kiperu këël jur mo bëëdö dïïu.› »
english: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï, ni ‹Kanyo pïïyu yi ŋöömmo kïtha u yie,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

anywaa: ni bellu cam mana no ociek yi ŋöömmögø, wäru cïpu ki muuce jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ki røk caammi mo wø tïïc ni beel poot nyärö, wäru cïpu ki dääpe oceele na muuce røk beel mo wø kwøŋ dïn.
english: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

anywaa: Ki røk caammi mo wø tïïyu røk beel moa nyärö cooth, wäru cïpu ki muuce jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk; ni bëët gïnögø ni di tïïö këël ki yïth beenhnhe mou bëët moo ööi.
english: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni kanymør ciik moa caana jï Modhe tïmö ni ba tïïyu, ni bayu ge ni ba kammu,
english: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,

anywaa: ni beege gïïa caana jïïu bëët ki dhi Modhe, ni tägi ki kanya cïba ciik dïkwøŋ, këël ki yïth beenhnhe mou.
english: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

anywaa: Ni näk mo lwaa Icriel bäre obääyö ni ba kamge, lwaak bäre wär cïpe ki rwaath aciel no olämi man wø waaŋ mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki dige cïbö thuwø ki rwaath na aciel ki køør ciik; ni cïpge nywø ateea aciel no olämi mar raay.
english: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni cïp lääyögø no okïdi kiper lwaa Icriel bäre. Køøre  geno wëënni, kiper mana bääcge ni ba kamge, ni cïpge ko olämi man wø waaŋ jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ko olämi mar raay kiper gïna baacge.
english: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:

anywaa: Køøre lwaa Icriel bäre ki juurre moa bëëdö dïge owëënni, kiper beeye gïna baac jiyi bëët ni ba kamge.
english: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk dhaanhø aciel keere obääyö ni ba kame, wär cïpe ki maath ateea mo cwiine aciel no olämi mar raay.
english: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni cïp gø no okïdi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ŋatøgø na bääyö ni ba kame enø, ni wëënni ki køør okïdi manøgø.
english: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: 'Ba ciik otïmö na aciel bäre kiper ŋat wø bääyi ni ba kame, këël doo naa ena thwønh Icriel wala jur mo bëëdö dïge.
english: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ŋat wø bääyi ni di kamø, këël doo naa ena thwønh paac wala jur, eni janynya aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Ŋatøgø wär tïme ni tøør yïthakic jø poge.
english: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

anywaa: Eni doo tïmö ni tøør yïthakic jø poge møn, kiper luubö mara ataae, ni kaal ciik 'moa; 'ba gïna baae odøø dëëre.› »
english: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

anywaa: Kanya bëët jø Icrielli ni ge ena dï paap, gena jïtö ki dhaanhø mo möödö ki jenni ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa joot gø ni möödö ki jenni, ena kälge baŋ Modhe ka Aran ki lwaak bäre.
english: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

anywaa: Ni kïthge gø kar tööc, kiper gïno tïïc ki teeŋ ŋatøgø poot kär nyoodhø na kare.
english: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ŋatøgø doo nääö møn. Eni doo këër lwaaki bäre ki kïte wøk ŋää twïër.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

anywaa: Køøre lwaak bäre ŋatøgø akïthge wøk ŋää twïër ni këërge gø ki kïte këël mana thøøe, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: «Cäänï ki jø Icriel, ni köömmï geni kiper nee tïïge ko okuri mo tïïc ka waare, ni twöge geni ceŋ abïïe moge ki waare mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle.
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

anywaa: 'Ba okuri moøgø otïmö na gïï par wïc kiper ciik 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk; ni kany wø neennu geni, wïthu oparru ki ciik 'moa ni jïëyu geni, kiper nou ba gaau wøk køør jap wø neetu, ki gïï wø manynyu ki cwïnynyu jaak, kaawat man wø tïïc kääbi.
english: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

anywaa: Køøre wïthu oparru ki man tïïyu ciik 'moa bëët, ni bëëdu nou ena kur keeru ni uuna 'moa, a na Jwøu.
english: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

anywaa: Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, kiper naa puta bëëtö ni aana Jwøu. Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.»
english: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Köra, na näk wär Icaar na käl dhi øt Kät na näk o Libay, atudö ki jiy adäk mo käla ri nyïïkwaac Ruben, ni beege Daathan ka Abiram na näk wäät Eliap, ko Ön na näk o Paalet.
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

anywaa: Jøøgø ki wäät Icriel ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc rege athïïŋge dëër Modhe, ni gena jiy mo ojierø na kwääc lwaae, ni nyeŋge owïnyö.
english: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

anywaa: 'Ba geni rege acooŋge kiper Modhe ka Aran ni köge jïge, «Wui, maru ka akadhø nø; kiper jø lwaak bëët beege jiy mo ena kur keerge ni gena mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni en dïge. ?Aperŋø nø ni tïïyu rou nou døøŋŋø bäät lwaa Wuuö Jwøk?»
english: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na wïny gïnögø, ree agøø piny.
english: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

anywaa: Køøre ena cäänö ki Köra ki jøøa cäädhe ki geni, ni kööe, ni «Diøø ka amöölla Wuuö Jwøk ŋata näk ee jierø na mare na näk ee cïp kur keere onyoodhe, ni tïïc gø nee nyänh buute. Eni ŋato jiere otïïe nee nyänh buute.
english: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni na Köra en ki jøøa cäädhu ki geni, tïïyu gïn; lwørru athääk jwëëlli mo mäc,
english: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

anywaa: ni kïthu yïthge ki mäc ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ni cïbu ge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk diøø. Køøre ŋato jier Wuuö Jwøki obëëdö ni ena kur keere na mare. Uuni, u na nyïïkwaac Libay, maru akadhø nø.»
english: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Köra, ni «Wïnynyu gïn, uuni na wäät Libay.
english: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki jïïu atïmö ni beeye gïn mo thiinh jaak ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, na jier uuni dï lwaa Icriel, ni käl uuni buute, kiper nee oduŋkaanynye tïnynyu? ?Aŋø, atïmö ni beeye gïn mo thiinh thuwø ki jïïu, ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na thïïŋ uuni nyïm lwaak kiper nee ge tïnynyu?
english: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

anywaa: Eni uuna käl buute ki nyïïmëëgu bëët moa näk nyïïkwaac Libay. ?Aŋø, u manynya gø thuwø nee tïï dïlämme en ceŋŋu?
english: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïyu en, uuni ki jøøa cäädhu ki geni, beeye thïïŋ røk dëër Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, Aran aŋa, ni ŋuru ki nyeŋŋe en?»
english: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ajääk baŋ Daathan ka Abiram na näk wäät Eliap nee cwøl. 'Ba gena köö, ni «Wa ba ööi.
english: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni beeye gïn mo thiinh ki mana kälï wa wøk ki yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie nee wa nää dï paap kany? ?Ï poot manynya man tïïyï dëërï na kwäärö bäätwa thuwø?
english: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

anywaa: Maya thuwø, wa kärï kïth yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie; këël pwöth beel ka ajïniine bäŋgø mo iï cïbö jïwa na mowa. ?Aŋø, ï manynya man tïïyï jiy na cööye? Jïwa bäyö, wa ba ööi.»
english: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe awëër døc. Køøre ena köö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Kär niï jïëy ki muuy marge. Bäŋ gïn mo yaa lwørø baŋge, këël arëën aciel, ni bäŋ gïn mo leth mo yaa tïïö dëëtge.»
english: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï Köra, ni «Ïïni ki jøøa cäädhu ki geni, wäru nutu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk diøø, ni beeye ïïni ki geni, këël Aran thuwø.
english: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtu ni lwør athaanh maac mare ni kïth yi gø ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ni ö ŋati man nø ni käl athaanh maac mare nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege athääe moa näk dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc. 'Ba ïïni, ï na Köra, ka Aran, athääe mo mäc mou wär kälu thuwø.»
english: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

anywaa: Køøre ŋati man nø athaanh maac mare alwøre, ni kïth yi gø ki maac, ni kïth gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte thuwø, ni öge ni cuŋge ki Modhe ka Aran na aciel dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Köra na cooŋ lwaak bäre, ni thïïŋge rege kiper Modhe ka Aran dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ajiem Wuuö Jwøk aput nëënne jï lwaak bäre.
english: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe ka Aran,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Paanynyu rou buut lwaaøgø, kiper nee ge thööra ennø.»
english: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe ka Aran rege agøøge piny, ni köge, ni «Wui Jwøk, ïïni na Jwø jwïëy mo jiy bëët, ?aŋø, ni näk mo bääya dhaanhø aciel, ï doo wëër ki lwaak bäre?»
english: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï lwaak, ni kööï, ni ‹Paanynyu rou buut kwör bëëte mo Köra ki Daathan ka Abiram.› »
english: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aö maal ni ci baŋ Daathan ka Abiram, ni ö jø døøk Icriel ni läpge køøre.
english: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

anywaa: Ni cääne ki lwaak, ni kööe, ni «Paanynyu rou buut oduŋkaare mo jøøi ni reyø ii, ni bäŋe gïn gutu ma marge, kiper nee u ba rwöp ajäla mano pïï bäätge ki køør raay moge.»
english: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø nø, lwaak rege aputge paany buut kwör bëëte mo Köra ki Daathan ka Abiram. Ni ö Daathanni ka Abiram ni öge wøk ki määrge ki wäätge ko obwöre moge moa therø, ni cuŋge dhøk oduŋkaare moge.
english: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Ki ri gïn en, oŋäyu ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na jääŋ aani kiper gïïögø bëët nee tïïa, ni ba tïïa ka wïïa keera.
english: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

anywaa: Ni näk jøøi thøw kaawat man wø thøw jiyi møga, ni gïïo tägi dëëtge poot caala mo wø tägi dëët jiy møga thuwø, tïmö ni paa Wuuö Jwøk këët na jääŋ aani.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo Wuuö Jwøk tïïö ki gïn mo nyään, ni ö jøøi ni thøwge ki jöö man, ni ŋøøm pääŋŋa rege ni mwøny geni ki jammi moa näk moge bëët, ni cige kanya näk kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw na cwøl ni Ciöl ni ge poot kwøw, køøre oŋäyu nø ni jøøi ii Wuuö Jwøk ege taaø møn.»
english: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lønye ki caan luupögø bëët, piny acööt ki kanya cuŋ jøøgø  yie,
english: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

anywaa: ni ö ŋøømmi ni pääe ki dïge, ni mwøny geni ki jø mïëri moge, ki jic Köra bëët, ki jammi moge bëët.
english: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ki japa en jïge bëët ni cige kanya näk kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw na cwøl ni Ciöl ni ge poot kwøw; ni ö ŋøømmi ni cïëkge rege bäätge, ni putge thøø, ni rwäänyge na bäre bäre dï lwaak.
english: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli bëët moa en buutge ni bwøkge ko oduuru mana gøøcge, ni köge, ni «Reeŋø kiper nee ø ba mwøny ŋøømmi thuwø.»
english: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.

anywaa: Ni put maaci öö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk thuwø, ni thöör jøøa näk dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc moa cïpö ki gïna näk jïye ŋwääi ni met.
english: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Eliedhar wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na athääe mo mäc kwäny wøk ki dï jiy moa waaŋ maaci, ni køny cuk wøk ni keeth ge, kiper athääe moøgø gena gïï mo ena kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

anywaa: Athääe moøgø atïmö ni ena kur keerge kanya cïp ge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper manøgønø, athääe mo jøøgø na thøw ki køør raay moge yøø, wär thääth ni reep, nee tïme na rëëbi mar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. 'Ba rëëbi manøgø otïmö na nyuudhi jï jø Icriel.»
english: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre athääk jwëëlli moa cïp jiyi moa waaŋ maaci alwør Eliedharri na näk dïlämi, ni thääth ge na rëëbi mar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte,
english: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

anywaa: nee tïme na gïr par wïc jï jø Icriel, kiper nee bäŋe dhaanhø mør jaak, mo paa nyikwaar Aran, mo maara nyänh kany mo cään ki man waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee ba tïme kaamar Köra ki jiye. Gïïögø atïïc Eliedharri kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni ki ri Modhe.
english: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, lwaa Icriel bäre aŋurö ki nyeŋ Modhe ka Aran, ni köge, «Uuni, jic Wuuö Jwøk anägu.»
english: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö lwaaki na cooŋge rege kiper Modhe ka Aran, geni bëët nyïmge aløøge baŋ oduŋkaany røømmø, ni jootge pöölö no oduŋkaara ee uumö, ni ö ajiem Wuuö Jwøki ni nëëne.
english: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran gena ö nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø,
english: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Paanynyu rou dï lwaai, kiper nee ge thööra ennø.» Ni ö Modhe ka Aran ni gøøge rege piny.
english: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jï Aran, ni «Lwør athaanh maac marï, ni kïthï yie ki maac mo käla bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kïthï bääte ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ni laarï gø kïth baŋ lwaak, ni wëëgï bääyö marge wëënnö. Kiper wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk oløny ni ena bäät jiy, na ajäla mare onø tägö.»
english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.

anywaa: Køøre Aran athaanh maac mare alwøre, kaawat mana caan Modhe jïre, ni reŋ dï lwaak, ni joot ajäl Jwøk no onø tägö dëët jiy. Ni kïth gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ya athaanh maac, ni wëëk bääyö marge wëënnö.
english: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.

anywaa: Ni cuŋŋe yïthakic jøøa no othøw ki jøøa kwøw, ni ö thøøe mana tägö ki køør ajäl Jwøk ni cuŋŋe.
english: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy moa thøw ki køør ajäl Jwøk beege kume apaar kurŋween ki dïpe abïriiø, ni jøøa kwøŋ thøø ri Köra tøør rege.
english: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.

anywaa: Køøre, kanya cuŋ thøwøgø, Aran adøø baŋ Modhe dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cäänï ki jø Icriel, ni lwötï ka athøre apaar kurriiø baŋ dïbwöthe mo dhøk uut tuŋi moge, ni dïbwödhi man nø cïpa athøra aciel kiper dhi øt tuuŋ mare. Ni göörï nyeŋ ŋati man nø ra athøra mare;
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.

anywaa: ni göörï nyeŋ Aran ra athøny jø tuuŋ Libay. Kiper doo da athøra aciel jï dïbwödhi man nø kiper dhøk uut tuŋi moge.
english: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

anywaa: Ni kïthï athøre moøgøøni yo oduŋkaany røømmø nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, ni beeye kany wø røømma yie ki ïïni.
english: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

anywaa: 'Ba athøra mar ŋato jiera, oløth.  Ki køør gïnögø nø, ŋurö man wø ŋur jø Icrielli ki nyeŋŋu, ni beeye man wø këët raa thuwø, ojwøa.»
english: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acäänö ki jø Icriel, ni ö dïbwöthe moge bëët ni cïpge ka athøre apaar kurriiø, ni dïbwödhi man nø cïpa athøra aciel na kar dhi øt tuuŋ mare, na athøra mar Aran thuwø ena dïge.
english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni kïth athøre nyïm Wuuö Jwøk yo oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, Modhe adøny yo oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, ni joot athøny Aran na näk mar jø tuuŋ Libay no oløth, no othiew, no ojïtö ki nyïëdi mo ociek.
english: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe athøre bëët akäl wøk ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni peeth ge nyïm jø Icriel bëët. 'Ba jøøgø athøre aneenge, ni ö ŋati man nø ni lwør athønynye.
english: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Dwøk athøny Aran nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, nee bëëde na nyuudhi jï jø wø gëëmö, kiper nee ŋurö marge man wø ŋurge ki nyeŋŋa nee joogï, nee ge ba thøwge.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët atïïc Modhe na karge, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so did he.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel acäänö ki Modhe, ni köge, ni «Neenï, waana thøw, waana ränynyö, ni putwa ränynyö karwa bëët.
english: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø nyänh buut oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk jaak, thøw. ?Aŋø, wa puta thumö ki thøø bëët møn ennø?»
english: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ka Aran, ni kööe, na «Ajäl gïï mo patha karge mo wø tägi yo oduŋkaany røømmø ki ri tïï japa en kur keerge oen bäätï ki wäätï ki dhi øt wäru bäre. Këël ï na Aran, ajäl gïï mo patha karge mo wø tägi bëët ki ri tïï dïlämme oen bäätï ki wäätï u keeru.
english: And the Lord said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni thuwø, käl jø tuuŋ kwaru, ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay ni poot na tuuŋ wäru, nee dwätge ki ïïni, nee ï tïnyge kany wäro näk ïïni ki wäätï u tïnynya oduŋkaany wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

anywaa: Geni, ïïno tïnyge, ni gwøkge tïïe mo oduŋkaara bëët; 'ba ge ba doo maara nyänh buut japa en kur keerge wala gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, kiper nee geni ki uuni bëët nou ba thøwu.
english: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

anywaa: Ni ge doo dwätö ki ïïni, ni tïnyge oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper tïïe mo wø many oduŋkaara bëët; 'ba doo bäŋ ŋat mør jaak mo nyänh buutu.
english: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

anywaa: «Ni ö uuni ni gwøgu tïï japa en kur keerge ki tïï gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo cäŋ pïï bäät jø Icriel ki køør wëër mara.
english: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

anywaa: Neenï, beeye aani na jier uut wäru ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay, ni lwøra geni yïthakic jø Icriel na muuy mana cïp jïïu, na näk mo ocïbö jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nee tïï oduŋkaany røømmø nee tïïcge.
english: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö ïïni ki wäätï ni tïïyu tïï dïlämme na näk tïïc maru, këël gïï wø manynyi kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ki tïï kanya en kur keere na pere leth na näk ogëëŋö ka abïï. Tïïe moøgø bëët otïïyu. Tïï dïlämme acïba jïïu na muuy; 'ba noo näk da dhaanhø mør jaak mo nyänhnha buut oduŋkaara, wala manynya tïïc mana en yie nee tïïe, wär eni 'näk.»
english: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the veil; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ka Aran, ni kööe, ni «Ennø, aani tïï muuce mo wø cïp jïra bëët, ni wø tuuŋŋi yi jamø, acïba cerï, ni beege japa en kur keerge ni wø cïp jø Icrielli. Gïïögø acïba jïrï ki wäätï na kuru, nee tïmge na mou na bäre bäre.
english: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

anywaa: Ki røk gïïa en kur keerge na perge leth bëët mo wø cïp jø Icrielli kar lam, thäŋi mo wø ba waaŋ otïmö na moï, ni beege muuce mo beel bëët, ko olämme mo raay bëët, ko olämme  bëët mo wø cïp kiper bääyö. Gïïögø bëët ni wø cïpge jïra otïmö ni ena kur keerge ni perge leth na moï ki wäätï.
english: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

anywaa: Gïïögø diï camø na gïï mo ocïp kur keerge ni perge leth. Ni ö wäätï bëët ni cämge thuwø. 'Ba gïïögø otïmö na gïï mo ena kur keerge jïrï.
english: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

anywaa: «Jammi møga mo wø cïp jø Icrielli kar lam, ni beege jëëthe mo wø tuuŋŋi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, poot na moï thuwø, ni ge yaa cïbö jïrï ki wäätï ki nyïïï na mou na bäre bäre. 'Ba jøøa näk dëëtge waany paarï bëët, løny jïge ki man cämge rege.
english: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

anywaa: «Kwøk omøki ki mädhi mo beyø døc mo käla ri nyïïjer wø kwøŋ ciek, ki thwöth beel moa näk liil mo wø cïpge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, yaa cïbö jïrï.
english: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the Lord, them have I given thee.

anywaa: Nyïïjenni bëët mo wø kwøŋ ciek yi ŋöömge, mo wø cïpge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, otïmö na moï. 'Ba jøøa näk dëëtge waany paarï bëët løny jïge ki man cämge rege.
english: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

anywaa: «Gïïo cïp jïra bëët, no owëëk aani na bäre bäre ki køør kööŋ, nee bëëtge ni ena kur keerge na 'moa dï jø Icriel, otïmö na moï.
english: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

anywaa: Kaai bëët mo jiy ki mo lääc paac mo wø cïp jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, otïmö na moï. 'Ba kaai mo jiy ki mo lääc paac mo wø ba cam diï wïïla wøk.
english: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the Lord, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

anywaa: Kany wø tïm dwäde mo kaai mo jiy no oceele, ge diï wïïla wøk ki gät wïïdö ma gwel abïïc moa cwøl ni cekel, no opäärö ki rumi mar kar lam na en kur keere.
english: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

anywaa: «'Ba kaa mar dhieŋ wala kaa mar røømmø wala kaa mar ateea ba diï wïïla wøk, kiper ge ena kur keerge na 'moa. Remø marge diï kera bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni waaŋï dwäälö marge no olämi, nee tïme na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋö otïmö na marï, kaawat man wø bëët äämmi na marï, ki rïŋ gøŋŋø man wø tuuŋŋi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

anywaa: Gïï wø en kur keerge moøgø bëët mo wø cïp jø Icrielli kar lam jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, yaa cïbö jïrï ki wäätï ki nyïïï na mou na bäre bäre. Man beeye luubö mana tuut na bäre bäre, ni tuut ki ïïni ki nyïïkwaayï nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jï Aran, ni «Ï ba jïti ki ŋøøm mo maara dööŋŋe jï nyïïkwaayï, ni bäŋ kany mo maar tïmö na kurï ri ŋööm jø Icriel. 'Ba yïthakic jø Icriel, beeye aani na kurï no odööŋ jïrï na kar ŋöömö.
english: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba gïna cïba jï jø tuuŋ Libay nee bëëde na marge beeye paac wïth jammi bëët mo jø Icriel. Moøgø acïba jïge ki køør tïïc marge man wø tïïcge yo oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Ki mano täge ennø, jø Icriel møga ba doo nyänhnha buut oduŋkaany røømmø, kiper nee ge ba thøwge ki køør bääyö marge.
english: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye jø tuuŋ Libay keerge noo tïny oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ö ajäl gïï mo patha karge mo wø tägi yie ni tïme ni ena bäätge. Manøgø obëëdö na ciik këël yïth beenhnhe mou bëët. 'Ba bäŋ ŋøøm mo cïp jïge yïthakic jø Icriel mo maara dööŋŋe jï nyïïkwaacge;
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

anywaa: kiper paac wïth jammi mo jø Icriel mo wø cïpge na muuce jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, yaa mëëk jø tuuŋ Libay na moge. Ni beeye na caana gø ni bäŋ ŋøøm mo cïp jïge yïthakic jø Icriel mo maara dööŋŋe jï nyïïkwaacge.»
english: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cäŋ cäänö ki jø tuuŋ Libay ni kööï, ni ‹Kany wø lwørru paac wïth jammi moa cïba jïïu na mou baŋ jø Icriel, u doo cïpö ki paac wïth japøgø na muuy jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.

anywaa: 'Ba muuy manøgø okwaan jïïu kaawat muuy mar beel mo wø dïn, wala muuy mar  køøŋ nyïïomøki.
english: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgøøni, uuni thuwø u doo cïpö ki muuy jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki røk paac wïth jammi mou moa jootu baŋ jø Icriel, ni cïpu muuy manøgø na mara enø jï Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord's heave offering to Aaron the priest.

anywaa: Ki røk jammi mo wø jootu baŋ jø Icriel, moa näk liil na en kur keerge dou cïbö jïra na kura, a na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

anywaa: «Ni kööï jï jø tuuŋ Libay, ni ‹Kanyo nø cïpu moa näk liil jïra, mo wø dööŋ obëëdö na mou kaawat man wø dööŋ beelli ki kwøk nyïïomøki jï ŋat puur.
english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni løny jïïu ki jø pou ki man cammu gïïögø kany wø manynyu jaak, kiper beeye gïno jootu ki køør tïïc maru yo oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø cammu ge, ni näk moa näk liil na en kur keerge you cïbö jïra, bäŋ ajäla mo pïï bäätu. 'Ba jammi moa en kur keerge mo wø cïp jø Icrielli jïïu ba dou raanynyø, kiper nou ba thøwu.› »
english: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciik man caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en; caanï jï jø Icriel nee känge jïrï ki dhieŋ ma nyakøø mo kwaar mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö ree ni poot bäŋ jaath puur mo orïï ŋute.
english: This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

anywaa: Ni cïpu dherøgø jï Eliedhar na näk dïlämi, ni kïthi wøk ŋää twïër ni ŋaali nyïme kaace.
english: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

anywaa: Køøre Eliedhar na näk dïlämi olwöti ki remø ki lweete ni ker gø kwöre abïriiø løøa näk dïët ki dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

anywaa: Ni ö dherøgø ni waaŋi nyïm Eliedhar; ni waaŋŋa pïëne ki rïŋŋe ki remme ki weenynye moe bëët.
english: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämi ni lwöte ki thääŋ jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ki jaadha cwøl ni icöp, ka abïï mo kwaar, ni leeŋ ge dï maac bäät dherøgø ni waaŋ enø.
english: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämi abïïge openye ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï. Køør manøgønø, eni doo døøa twïër. 'Ba eno bëëdö ni ba waany këël mano päth cäŋŋi.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata waaŋ dherøgø ni peny abïïge thuwø, ni lwøk dëëre, ni bëëde ni ba waany këël mano päth cäŋŋi.
english: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

anywaa: «Køøre dhaanhø mo waany, bur dherøgø ocooŋ kanya ciel ni kïth gø ŋää twïër kany mo beer mo ena kur keere. Ni ö burri manøgøøni ni kani kiper lwaa Icriel, nee pïï wø døøc dhaanhø mo waany jiiŋŋi ki gø, ni beeye gïn wø døøc dhaanhø mo waany kiper raay.
english: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata cooŋ bur dherøgø ni peny abïïge, ni bëëde ni ba waany këël mano päth cäŋŋi. 'Ba gïnögø obëëdö na ciik cooth jï jø Icriel ki jï juurre mo wø bëëdö ki geni.
english: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

anywaa: «Ŋato wäro gut dhaanhø mo othøw bëëdö ki nïne abïriiø ni ba waany, kiper mana jït dëëre ki läbö.
english: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri dää nïne ki ri bïriet nïne, dëëre odøøc mo waany ki pïïo døøc dhaanhø mo waany. Køøre eno put tïmö ni waany. 'Ba ni näk dëëre käre døøc mo waany ki ri dää nïne ki bïriet nïne, dëëre ba tïmö ni waany.
english: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro gut dhaanhø mo othøw, ni ba døøc dëëre mo waany, eni raanynya oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba eni wär tïme ni tøør dï jø Icriel, ni put bëëtö ni dëëre ba waany, kiper pïïo døøc dëër dhaanhø mo waany kär jør dëëre, ni ö ränynyö mare ni dööŋe bääte.
english: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye ciik kiper kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo othøw yo oduŋkaara man wø bëët jiyi yie. Jøw oen yo oduŋkaara, ki jøw oduny yie, obëëdö ni dëëtge ba waany ki nïne abïriiø.
english: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

anywaa: Ni ö jammi bëët moa näk wïthge ŋaam na näk kär uumö ni tïmge ni ba waany.
english: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

anywaa: «Ŋat wäro gut dhaanhø mo onääö wala mo othøw keere yi pwöla, wala ŋat wäro gut cöön dhaanhø mo othøw, wala eni guta bwörö, obëëdö ni dëëre ba waany ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

anywaa: «'Ba kiper nee ŋata näk dëëre ba waany dëëre døøc mo waany, bur dhieŋ  mana waaŋ kiper raay, nee dëët jiy døøc mo waany, doo kïtha yi dak ni kieri ki pï naam.
english: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

anywaa: Ni ö ŋat mo dëëre waany ni lwør jaadha cwøl ni icöp, ni cøt gø yi pïïögø ni jør gø bäät oduŋkaanynya thøw dhaanhe yie, ki bäät jammi moa en yie bëët, ki dëët jiy bëët moa en kaace. Këël dhaanhø mo da cöö mo ee gudö, wala guta dhaanhø mo onääö, wala dhaanhø mo thøwa e keere, wala bwörö, ŋatøgø dëëre doo jørø ki pïïögø thuwø.
english: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

anywaa: Køøre ŋata dëëre waany enø, pïïögø ojør bäät ŋata näk dëëre ba waany ki ri dää nïne ki ri bïriet nïne, ni døøc dëër gø mo waany ri bïriet nïne. Ni ö ŋata dëëre døøc mo waany ni peny abïïge ni lwøk dëëre ki pïï, ni tïm dëëre ni waany kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋata näk dëëre ba waany na näk dëëre käre døøc mo waany, wär tïme ni tøør dï lwaa Icriel, kiper mana raany oduŋkaara mana näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö ŋatøgø ni put bëëtö ni dëëre ba waany, kiper pïï mo wø døøc dëër dhaanhø mo waany kär jør dëëre.
english: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø oput bëëtö na ciik kiper jø Icriel cooth. «'Ba ŋatøgø na jør pïï mo wø døøc dëër dhaanhø mo waany enø, abïïge openye. Ni ö ŋat wø gut pïïögø jaak ni bëëde ni dëëre ba waany këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno gut ŋata näk dëëre ba waany otïmö ni ba waany, ni ö ŋato gut gïnöce ni tïm dëëre ni ba waany thuwø këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.»
english: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa Icriel bäre apïï dï paap Dhïn ki dwääy mana dïkwøŋ mar cwiir mana nyään, ni bëëtge Kadëc. 'Ba Mariyam athøw ni koonyi kaace.
english: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace atïmö ni bäŋ pïï kiper lwaak, ni ö lwaaki ni cooŋge rege ni thïïŋge dëëtge dëër Modhe ka Aran.
english: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaa Icrielli ni tïïge ko okiera dëër Modhe, ni köge, na «?Aŋø ni ba thøwa ki nyïïmëëkwa na aciel en kanya thøwge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk?
english: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na kälu lwaa Wuuö Jwøk dï paabi? ?Beeye kiper nee wa thøwa kany ki lääc paac mowa bëët?
english: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

anywaa: ?Na aperŋø na kälu waani wøk Ijep, ni kälu waani kany ni raac en, kany mo paa kar bëëlö, wala nyïïolämmi, wala jer omøki, wala adikwäle, wala da pïï mo maar ka maath?»
english: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran aay buut lwaak ni cige dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ni gøøge rege piny; ni ö ajiem Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth ree jïge.
english: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto them.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør athøra, ni cou ki coku ma Aran, ni cooŋï lwaa Icriel bäre. Ni köömmu kïdi ni nëënö jïge, nee pïï ö wøk ki yie. Køøre ï na Modhe, pïï okälï wøk ki yi kïdi kiperge ki jöö manøgø, ni wëëgï geni ki lääc paac moge mäthö ki pïï.»
english: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni lwør athøra nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord, as he commanded him.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ka Aran lwaa Icriel acooŋge nyïm kïdi, ni kö Modhe jïge, «Wïnynyu nø, u na jø ageem. ?Aŋø, känwa wøk ki pïï kiperu ki ri kïdi man?»
english: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

anywaa: Køøre Modhe cere arwiee, ni gøøc kïdi ka athøra kwöre ariiø, ni put pïïyi mo thööth kwön wøk, ni ö lwaaki ki lääc paac moge ni mäthge.
english: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe ka Aran, ni «Kiper mana käru aani ŋäädhö, ni ba tïïyu aani naa ena kur keera nyïm jø Icriel, uuni lwaa Icriel man en bäŋa dou kïth yi ŋöömma cïba jïge.»
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

anywaa: 'Ba pïïögø acwøl ni pï Meriba, kiper beeye kanya ö jø Icrielli ni pïëmge ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö eni ni nyooth ree ni ena Jwøk na en kur keere yïthakicge.
english: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.

anywaa: Kanya bëët jø Icrielli Kadëc, Modhe ajäägö ki jiy baŋ nyeny paana cwøl ni Ëdöm ni kööe,  ni «Gïïa leth bëët na pïï bäät coku ma Icriel ŋäyï.
english: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

anywaa: Kiper kar kaaca, kwäcwa aci Ijep, ni bëëtwa yi ŋööm Ijep ki kany mo bäär; ni ö jø Ijepi ni tïïge ki gïï mo reyø mo leth dëëtwa ki kwäcwa.
english: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jwöŋwa dëër Wuuö Jwøk, eni döötwa awïnynye, ni jääŋ nyïïatwiel maal mare ni käl waani wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep. «Ennø, wa ena Kadëc, pääny mana en deŋ keew mar ŋöömmï.
english: And when we cried unto the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa kwaya ïïni, nee wa wëëgï pöödhö ki dï ŋöömmï. Waani, wa ba ci yïth pwöth beel, wala ajïniine; ni wa bäŋ doo mäthö ri pï ïïdhi moï. Waano cäädhi ni wa caatha jöör jøw bëët, ni wa ba gaa bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam, gøøc mano kaalwa ŋöömmï.»
english: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Ëdöm aköö jïge, ni «Käru pöönhnhö ki dï ŋöömwa; 'ba ni näk uuno pöönhnhö, wa ööa baŋu ni këëdö ki uuni.»
english: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ jø Icrielli kö jïre, ni «Wa doo pöödhö ni wa caatha øtjöö keere. 'Ba ni näk waani ki lääc paac mowa, waano mäthö ri pïï mou, gäte ocoolwa. Wëëk waani pöödhö keere jaak, ni bäŋ gïn mør.»
english: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö, no «U ba doo pöönhnhö ki dï ŋöömwa.» Ni ö nyeny Ëdömmi wøk ki lwaak ki tøŋ mo teek døc, ni gëëŋge geni.
english: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

anywaa: Ni put nyeny Ëdömmi kweer ki man pööth jø Icrielli ki dï ŋöömme. Køøre jø Icriel rege aløkge ni ŋaatge ŋöömme.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

anywaa: Køøre lwaa Icriel bäre atïŋŋö ki Kadëc ni pïïcge tier Kïn Öör.
english: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ka Aran tier Kïn Öör na en waŋ keew ki ŋööm Ëdöm, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

anywaa: na «Aran othøw, ni läp køør jø poge, kiper eni bäŋ doo maara døny yi ŋöömma cïba jï jø Icriel, kiper uuni luubö mara adhallu kar pï Meriba.
english: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

anywaa: Lwør Aran ki wääde ma Eliedhar, ni kälï geni bäät Kïn Öör,
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

anywaa: ni kälï abïïk Aran wøk dëëre ni røøï geni dëër Eliedhar na näk wääde. Køøre Aran othøw, ni läp køør jø poge.»
english: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët atïïc Modhe kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni, ni cige bäät Kïn Öör, ni ge nëënö jï lwaa Icriel bäre.
english: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni käl abïïk Aran wøk ni røø ge dëër Eliedhar na näk wär Aran. Ni ö Aranni ni put thøø kaace wï kïdi. Køøre Modhe ki Eliedhar aö piny ki bäät kïdi.
english: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya neeni lwaa Icrielli bäre na Aran othøw, gena kïmmö kipere ki nïne ma pïëradäk.
english: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

anywaa: Kar kaace da dhaanhø ma nyï Keenan mo nyeny jø Arat, ni eni wø bëëdö kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp. 'Ba kanya wïny gø ni jø Icriel aöö ni cura jöör Atharim, ena ö wøk ni këëde ki geni, ni mak jiy møøk ni käl ge.
english: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel akööŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Ni näk mo jø Keenan moi ii cïbï ceŋwa, päänye moge dewa raanynyø na bäre.»
english: And Israel vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny mana caan jø Icrielli, ni cïp jø Keenan moøgø ceŋge, ni raanyge geni na bäre ki päänye moge; ni put nyeŋ kaace cwøl ni Örma.
english: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö ki tier Kïn Öör, ni ge cøra jöör Naama Kwaar, nee deŋ ŋööm Ëdöm wïrge. Ni ö lwaaki ni cwat yïthge døc øtjöö.
english: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

anywaa: Ni cäänge dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni cäänge dëër Modhe thuwø, ni köge, na «?Aperŋø na kälu waani wøk ki Ijep nee wa thøwa dï paap en? Kiper bäŋ cam, ni bäŋ pïï, ni waana jøøm ki cami ni raac en.»
english: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk thwöre mo reyø ajääŋŋe dï jiy, ni kaacge jiy, ni thøw jiyi mo thööth dëët jø Icriel.
english: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

anywaa: Køøre jiy aö baŋ Modhe, ni köge, ni «Waana bääyö  kiper mana cäänwa dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni cäänwa dëërï thuwø. 'Ba ennø, kwac Wuuö Jwøk jïwa, nee thwöre paanye yïthakicwa.» Ni ö Modhe ni put Wuuö Jwøk kwac kiper jiy.
english: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Tïïï ki gïn mo caala thwöl, ni lïërï gø bäät jaath mo ocwöth piny; ni ŋat wäro näk mo okaaø jaak, kany wø neen gø, eno køny.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tïïe ki thwör jwïël ni lïër gø bäät jaath mo ocwöth piny; ni ö jøøa näk okaac thwöre bëët ni jïtge ki køny kanya neenge gø.
english: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö, ni tïïge ki twïër kanya cwøl no Oböth.
english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ko Oböth ni tïïge ki twïër Iye-Abarim dï paap mana näk dïët ki Möap, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Iye–abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge tïŋŋö kaace, ni tïïcge twïër marge goor naama cwøl ni Dherëët.
english: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zered.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge tïŋŋö ki Dherëët ni tïïge ki twïër løø naam Arnön løøga na en dï paaba näk ree ee jwaaø ki keew mar jø Amör, kiper naam Arnön beeye keew mar jø Möap mana en yïthakicge ki jø Amör.
english: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na caani yi Wëël Lenye Mo Wuuö Jwøk, na køp, ni «Paana cwøl ni Wayïp ena Cuupa, ni da gool mo cwøl ni goor naam Arnön,
english: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

anywaa: ni naam Arnön wø løøya yi pääny Ëër, na en deŋ keew mar jø Möap.»
english: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba gena put wääth këël kanya cwøl ni Bëër, ni beeye iith mana cään Wuuö Jwøki ki Modhe kipere, na kööe, ni «Cooŋ jiy kanya ciel nee ge mooa ki pïï.»
english: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel awär ki duut ni köge, «Wui, ï na iith, wa kwaya ïïni ki duut ki man cwïërï.
english: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

anywaa: Ni beeye iidha koony kwääri, ni gööli ya dïbwöthe; ni göölge ka athøre moge, na näk athøc kwär.» Ni ö geni ni cäŋge tïŋŋö dï paap, ni cige kanya cwøl ni Mathena,
english: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

anywaa: ni tïŋge Mathena ni cige Naliel, ni tïŋge Naliel ni cige Bamöth.
english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

anywaa: Ni cäŋge tïŋŋö Bamöth ni cige yi pwölla en bäät Kïn Pedhega na en yi ŋööm jø Möap, ni wø nëën ŋöömma raaci ki bääte ni beeye ŋööm wø bäŋ gïn mo tuy yie.
english: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel ajääk baŋ Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, ni köge,
english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wëëk waani pöönhnhö ki dï ŋöömmï. Waani wa bäŋ doo gaa wøk ki øtjöö ni gaawa yïth pwöth beel wala pwöth omøki, ni wa ba mäthi ri pï ïïdhi moï. Waano cäädhi ki øtjöö mana dwøŋ mana tïïc nyeya, gøøc mano kaalwa ŋöömmï.»
english: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëëwön kär jïëy ki man pööth jø Icrielli ki yi ŋöömme. Ni ö Cëëwönni  ni cooŋ lwaae, ni ci baŋ jø Icriel dï paap, ni ci kanya cwøl ni Jäc, ni këëde ki jø Icriel.
english: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge jø Amör, ni macge ŋøøpge, ni tägi ka naam Arnön këël mana këët naam Jabök, na näk keew mar jø Amön, kiper keew mar jø Amön beeye keew mo okoorø ni teek.
english: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni macge päänye moøgø bëët na näk mo jø Amör, ni bëëtge yïthge, ni rwöpa Ëcbön ka atude moe moa en buute bëët.
english: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëcbön beeye pääny mar Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, ŋata këëdö ki nyeny jø Möap mana dïkwøŋ, ni mac ŋøøp gø bëët këël mana këët naam Arnön.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

anywaa: Ni beeye na put jø wø cääö ki dudi köö, ni «Ööu Ëcbön, kiper nee geer, nee pääny Cëëwön geer ni teek.
english: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

anywaa: Kiper maac aöö ki Ëcbön, ni beege dëëci mo Cëëwön. Ni raanyge Ëër na näk pääny jø Möap, ki kwääri moa teek mo wø bëëdö bäät thuuri mo naam Arnön.
english: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

anywaa: U na jø Möap, otïmö ni raac jïïu. Uuna ränynyö bëët, u ni wø lam jwøa cwøl ni Kemöc. Jwøk maru uuna wëëk ŋwïëy, u na näk wääte, ni wëëk nyïïe mak nyïm tøŋ, ni cïp ge cer nyeny Amör na näk Cëëwön.
english: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gena raanywa, ni tägi ka Ëcbön këël mana pïïe Dibön, ni raanywa geni këël Nöpa na en buut Medeba.»
english: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel abëëdö yi ŋööm jø Amör.
english: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni jääk Jadher nee liew. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni macge mïëc Jadher, ni riemge jø Amör moa bëëdö kaace.
english: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel rege aløkge ni cørge øtjöör päänya cwøl ni Baacan, ni ö Ög nyeny Baacan ki jiye ni ö wøk, nee këëde ki jø Icriel päänya cwøl ni Edaray.
english: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Kärï lwäyö ki eni, kiper eni ki jiy moe, ki ŋöömme bäre, yaa nø cïp cerï. Teeŋ gïna tïïyï dëër Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, na bëëdö Ëcbön, wär tïïyï dëëre.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge Ög ki wääte, ki jiye bëët, gøøc mana tïme ni bäŋ wïïe mo odööŋ ni kwøw, ni putge ŋöömme mac.
english: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïŋŋö, ni tïïge ki twïër pwöl Möap, løø naam Jördan løøga, na näk dïët ki Jerikö.
english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba Balak o Cëëpör gïna tïïc jø Icrielli dëët jø Amör awïnynye.
english: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Möapi ni putge bëëtö ni ge lwär døc ki jø Icriel, kiper na thööthge; ni thäŋ yïthge døc thuwø ki jø Icriel.
english: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni kö jø Möapi jï jø døøk Midien, ni «Lwaai en, gïïo en lak paac bëët kany thöörge thöörö, kaawat man wø ö dhäki wø thöörge luum man wø en kar kwaath.» Køøre Balak o Cëëpör, na näk nyeny Möap kar kaace,
english: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

anywaa: ajääk baŋ Beelam o Beeyör ki jiy paana bëëde yie na näk poge Patura, na näk kare cään ki naam Upareeti. Køøre jøøgø ajääŋ Balaki nee Beelam cwølge, ni kö Balaki, ni «Neenï, da jiy mo ö wøk ki Ijep, ni pääŋge dï piny bäre; 'ba ennø, geno pïï kany mo cään ki waani.
