english: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, laar öö ni cienï jøøi jïra, kiper mana näk teek marge opöödhö ki teek mara. 'Ba ni näk mo ge iï cienø, kanymør maara lønyø jïra ki man bööta geni ni riema ge wøk. Kiper ŋääa ni ŋat wø gwïëthï, ogwïëth; ni ŋat wø cienï, ocien.»
english: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

anywaa: 'Ba jø døøk Möap ki jø døøk Midien gena tïŋŋö, ni ge käära jammi mo cïp na gät tïïc mar acïëni; ni pïïcge baŋ Beelam, ni caange dwør Balak jïre.
english: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aköö jïge, ni «Butu kany dïwääni. 'Ba aani, dwørøgø oløøa jïïu ki køør mano caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra.» Ni ö dïbwöthe mo Möap ni bëëtge ki Beelam dïwäänögø.
english: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aö bäät Beelam, ni kööe, na «?A jøøe ni en buutï yøø?»
english: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

anywaa: Ni kö Beelammi jï Jwøk, ni «Balak o Cëëpör, nyeny jø Möap, ajääŋ baŋa ki dwøl, ni kööe,
english: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Da jiy mo ö wøk ki Ijep, mo dï piny bäre ege pääŋö. 'Ba ennø, laar öö ni cienï geni jïra; kiper ni näk mo ge iï cienø, kanymør maara lønyø jïra ki man këëda ki geni ni riema ge wøk.› »
english: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jï Beelam, ni «Kärï aay ki geni, ni kär niï ciena jøøgø, kiper gena jiy mo ogwïëdhö.»
english: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, Beelam aö maal, ni ci baŋ dïbwöthe mo Balak, ni kööe, ni «Døøu yi ŋöömmu, kiper Wuuö Jwøk akweer ki man aa ki uuni.»
english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

anywaa: Ni ö dïbwöthe mo Möap ni öge maal ni døøge baŋ Balak, ni köge, ni «Beelam akweer ki man ööe ki waani.»
english: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

anywaa: Køøre Balak dïbwöthe møøk mo thööth moa kwörge døøŋŋø mo kaala moa dïkwøŋ, acäŋ jääŋŋö.
english: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

anywaa: Ni öge baŋ Beelam ni köge jïre, ni «Balak o Cëëpör aköö, ni ‹Kär dee gïn män ïïni ki man ööï baŋa.
english: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

anywaa: Kiper kwär marï odøøya mo dwøŋ, ni gïno caanï jïra jaak tïïa tïïö. Ööï ni cienï jøøi ii jïra.› »
english: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Beelammi jï jic Balak, ni kööe, ni «Këël Balak doo cïpa øde bäre mo päŋ ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö jïra cøøn, bäŋ gïn mo thiinh wala mo dwøŋ mo daa tïïö, ni kaala ciik Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk mara.
english: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man butu kany dï wäär man thuwø, nee gïno cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki caannø jïra nee jooda.»
english: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aö bäät Beelam ki wäär, ni kööe, «Ni näk jøøgø ööa kuna cwølge ïïni, ö maal ni aayï ki geni. 'Ba wär näk miï tïïya dwøro caana jïrï keere.»
english: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, Beelam apäny maal ni jiiŋ arëën mare, ni aae na aciel ki dïbwöthe mo Möap.
english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk agootø døc kiper mana aae. Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mar Wuuö Jwøk ni cuŋŋe dï øtjöö kiper nee eni mäne. 'Ba Beelam cäädhi ka bäät arëën mare, ni jø tïïc moe na näk ariiø cäädhi ka eni na aciel.
english: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö arëënni na joot nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk ni cuŋŋa dï øtjöö no opëëlle ena cere, arëën aput gaa wøk ki øtjöö ni ci yi pwödhö; 'ba Beelam arëën agøøe kiper nee dwøk øtjöö.
english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cuŋŋö dï øtjöö kany mo diiny mo cøra yïthakic ajïniine, ni deŋŋe løøi ki løøi da kiir.
english: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö arëënni na joot nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, ree adii ri kiir, ni mii tier Beelam ri kiir. Ni ö Beelammi ni cäŋ arëën gøøyø.
english: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk anyiik nyïme, ni cuŋŋe kanya näk diiny døc, mo røk ba løny ki løø bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam.
english: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö arëënni na joot nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, ena nirumma ni but piny ni Beelam poot ena bääte. Ni ö Beelammi ni wëëre døc ni gøøy arëën ka athøye.
english: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dha arëën ajabe, ni kö arëënni jï Beelam, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïa dëërï ki man pöötï aani kwöre moi na adäk ii?»
english: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

anywaa: Ni kö Beelammi jï arëën, ni «Beeye kiper mana kwäägï bääta. Doo naa cera da opëëllö, ï daa nää ennø.»
english: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

anywaa: Ni ö arëënni ni kööe jï Beelam, na «?Aŋø, a paa arëën marï man wø cäädhï ki bääte cooth, këël dïcäŋ man en? ?Aŋø, aano ŋïyö ki man tïïa teeŋ gïnögø, na tïïa dëërï enø?» Ni kö Beelammi, «Kärï tïïö.»
english: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyeŋ Beelam ajabe, ni ö Beelammi ni joot nyïïatwiel  maal mar Wuuö Jwøk ni cuŋŋö dï øtjöö, ni cere do opëëllö. Ni ö Beelammi ni put ree leeŋ piny.
english: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli mar Wuuö Jwøk jïre, na «?Aperŋø na pöötï arëën marï kwöre adäk en? Aana ö kany kiper niï mäna, kiper gïno tïïyï enø beeye gïn mo duunnö ki ränynyö nyïma.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

anywaa: Aana joot arëënni ni paany ree nyïma kwöre adäk; 'ba dee näk mo ree käre panynyø ki aani, ka adïëri møn, doo na ï yaa nääö en, ni wiia arëën ni kwøw.»
english: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aköö jï nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Aana bääyö, kiper kuua niï cuŋŋa øtjöö niï mäna aani ki wääth. Kiper manøgø nø, ni näk mo ï ba many gø naa pöödha, aano døøk nø.»
english: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Beelam, ni «Ci pöödhï ki jøøgø; 'ba wär näk miï caana dwøro caana jïrï keere.» Køøre Beelam aput aay ki dïbwöthe mo Balak.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya Balaki ni Beelam aöö, ena cøø nee røømme ki gø yi pääny mar jø Möap mana en bäät naam Arnön, na näk waŋ keew.
english: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

anywaa: Ni kö Balaki jï Beelam, na «?Aŋø, a kär öön baŋï na bëëde kiper niï ööi? ?Aperŋø na kärï laar ö baŋa? ?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni ba maar lønyø jïra ki man wøøra ïïni?»
english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

anywaa: Ni kö Beelammi jïre, ni «Aana ö baŋï ennø. ?Aŋø, da teek jïra cøøn ki man caana gïrpiny? 'Ba aani, beeye dwøro cïp Jwøki dhaa keere noo caana.»
english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

anywaa: Køøre Balak aay ki Beelam ni cige Kiriat-Adhöt.
english: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath–huzoth.

anywaa: Ni ö Balaki ni ŋäde ki dhäk ki dïëk ma rööm, ni jääŋ geni baŋ Beelam ki kwääc lwaae moa bëëdö ki eni na aciel.
english: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya, Balak aöö ni lwør Beelam ni kïth gø bäät thuur mana cwøl ni Bamöth- Baal; ni ö Beelammi ni raŋ jø Icriel moa en deŋ twïër na karge cärö ki kaace.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aköö jï Balak, ni «Tïïï jïra ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge ma abïriiø kany, ni kälï rwädhe abïriiø ki nyöök rööm abïriiø ni jiiŋŋï geni jïra thuwø.»
english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

anywaa: 'Ba Balak gïïögø atïïe kaawat mana caani ya Beelammi jïre. Ni ö geni karge riet ni cïpge bäät gïn wø cïp olämi bääte man nø ki rwaath aciel ki nywø røømmø aciel.
english: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aköö jï Balak, ni «Cuŋŋï buut olämme moï moøgø ni waaŋ yøø. 'Ba aana aay; kanymør Wuuö Jwøk öö ni røømme ki aani; 'ba gïno nyoodhe jïra ocaana jïrï.» Køøre Beelam aput aa bäät thuur mo leer.
english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni røømme ki Beelam, ni kö Beelammi jïre, ni «Aana tïïö ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge ma abïriiø, ni cïpa bäät man nø ki rwaath aciel ki nywø røømmø aciel.»
english: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dwøre acïp dhi Beelam, ni kööe, ni «Døø baŋ Balak, ni caanï dwøra jïre.»
english: And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

anywaa: Ni ö Beelammi ni døø baŋ Balak, ni joot eni ki kwääc lwaae mo Möap bëët ni ge cuŋŋa buut olämme moe moa waaŋ.
english: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

anywaa: Ni ö Beelammi ni täge ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Balak aana käle ki ŋööm Aram; eni na nyeny Möap aana käle ki bäät kïte moa en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni kööe, ‹Ööï, ni cienï nyïïkwaac Jeekap jïra, ni kïthï bäät jø Icriel ka ajäla kipera.›
english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ŋat mo kär cien Jwøki ociena gø nidïï? ?Ni ŋat mo kär jääl Wuuö Jwøki omaara gø jääl nidïï?
english: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?

anywaa: Ennø, gena neena naa ena bäät kïdi, ni neena geni naa ena bäät thuur. Ka adïëri møn, gena lwaak mo rege kärge kwaan dëët juurre møga, ni bëëdö ge keerge.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man kwaan nyïïkwaac Jeekap ni caal tør ii? ?Wala aŋa ni maar lønyø jïre ki man kwaan ŋweer lwaak keere mar jø Icriel? Beerra man thøøa ki thøw jø wø marge beer, ni tïm aŋuun kwøw mara ni caala marge.»
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

anywaa: Køøre Balak aköö jï Beelam, na «?Agïnaŋø ni tïïyï dëëra en? Ïïna cwøla kiper nee nyïïmänna cienï jïra; 'ba ennø, bäŋ gïn mo iï tïïö; ï gwïëtha geni.»
english: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Beelammi jïre, na «?Aŋø, wïïa bäŋ daa koorø ki man caana luubö mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki dhaa?»
english: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?

anywaa: Køøre Balak acäŋ köö jï Beelam, ni «Ööï, nøø aa kany mør kanyce mo ge nëënö ki yie. 'Ba këël ø doo cøøa kaace, ge ba jootï bëët thuwø. 'Ba moa karge cärö keerge ojootï. Køøre ge wär cienï jïra niï ena kaace.»
english: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

anywaa: Ni ö Balaki ni kïth Beelam pwöl Dhöpim, na en wï kïnna cwøl ni Pedhega, ni tïme ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge ma abïriiø, ni cïp bäät man nø ki rwaath aciel ki nywø røømmø aciel.
english: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

anywaa: Ni kö Beelammi jï Balak, ni «Cuŋŋï kany buut olämme moï moøgø ni waaŋ yøø, naa cøøa naa røømma ki Wuuö Jwøk kaace.»
english: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk arøømmø ki Beelam ni cïp dwøre dhi gø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Døø baŋ Balak ni caanï dwøra jïre.»
english: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

anywaa: Ni ö Beelammi ni ö baŋ Balak, ni joot eni ki kwääc lwaae mo Möap ni ge cuŋŋa buut olämme moe moa waaŋ. Ni kö Balaki jï Beelam, na «?Agïnaŋø na caan Wuuö Jwøki?»
english: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aput tägö ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Ï na Balak, ö maal, ni wïnynyï gïn. Wïny mara, ï na o Cëëpör.
english: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

anywaa: Jwøk ba caal dhaanhø ni wø cäänö ki tööt; ni eni ba caal o dhaanhø ni wø laar acaaye wiil. ?Gïna näk ee caanø, a ba dee gø tïïö nidïï? ?Ni gïn mo ee buuö, a ba dee gø tïïö nee thur kare nidïï?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

anywaa: Ennø, ciik acïp jïra nee jø Icriel gwïëdha; ni gena nø gwïëth Jwøki, ni ba løny jïra ki man wiila gø këët.
english: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

anywaa: «Bäŋ gïï mo reyø mo ee joodø bäät nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni bäŋ rääö mo ee joodø bäät jø Icriel. Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøge ena buutge, ni ge wø kwöŋŋö ni ge pwøya eni na näk nyenyge.
english: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

anywaa: Gena käl Jwøki wøk ki Ijep, ni tïïc geni ni teek kaamar jööbi.
english: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ jap thïëth mo pïï dëët nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni bäŋe gïr jwø wø dëëdö mo tägi dëët jø Icriel. 'Ba ennø, gïno caan kiper nyïïkwaac Jeekap na näk jø Icriel, okøp, ni ‹Neennu gïna tïïc Jwøki en.›
english: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, lwaa Icriel cuŋŋö kaamar maath ŋuu, ni ö maal kaamar cïgïï ŋuu, ni bäŋ doo butö këël mano cam gïna dware, ni maath remø mar gïna nääe.»
english: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

anywaa: Køøre Balak aköö jï Beelam, ni «Kär ge cienï, ni ba gwïëthï geni këët thuwø.»
english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Beelammi jï Balak, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, kära caanø jïrï, ni ‹Gïïo caan Wuuö Jwøki beege na daa tïïö›?»
english: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?

anywaa: 'Ba Balak aköö jï Beelam, ni «Ööï nø, ïïno cäŋa kïth kany mør kanyce. Kanymør Jwøk jïëy, ni maarï geni cien jïra niï ena kaace.»
english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

anywaa: Ni ö Balaki ni kïth Beelam wï kïnna cwøl ni Pëëgör, ni wø nëën ŋöömma raaci ki bääte, ni beeye ŋööm wø bäŋ gïn mo tuy yie.
english: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

anywaa: Ni kö Beelammi jï Balak, ni «Tïïï ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge ma abïriiø jïra kany, ni kälï rwädhe abïriiø ki nyöök rööm abïriiø ni jiiŋŋï geni jïra thuwø.»
english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

anywaa: Ni ö Balaki ni tïïc gïïögø kaawat mana caan Beelammi, ni cïp bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte man nø ki rwaath aciel ki nywø røømmø aciel.
english: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya neeni ya Beelammi ni Jwøk yie met ki man gwïëth jø Icriel, eni kär aay nee määnye ki jap thïëth, kaawat mana tïïe yïth nïne møga. 'Ba nyïme aløøe ni neeta dï paap.
english: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

anywaa: Køøre wïïe atïŋ maal, ni joot jø Icriel ni rege ege cïïmmö na wïth tuŋi, ni ö Jwïëc Jwøki ni ö bäät Beelam,
english: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

anywaa: ni ö Beelammi ni täge ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, na «A caana dwør Jwøk, a na Beelam o Beeyör, naa cäänö ni aana dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋe ojabø.
english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

anywaa: Aani, a caana dwør Jwøk ni aana ŋat wø wïny luup mo Jwøk, ni aana ŋat wø neen mar Jwøa en teeki cere, ni neena gø ni pädha, ni nyeŋŋa yaa jabø.
english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

anywaa: «U na jic Jeekap, oduŋkaare mou mïërö døc; ni twëëre mou mïërö thuwø, u na jø Icriel,
english: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

anywaa: ni ge caala gøli mo rege ege lwørø, ni caalge pwöth mo wø en deŋ naam, ni caalge jenni mo mïërö mo opiith Wuuö Jwøki, ni caalge orøge mo ena lak naam.
english: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

anywaa: Paac maru otïmö ni yie da pïï mo thööth døc, ni jït nyïïkwaayu ki bëët durö, ni tïm nyeya marge ni dwøŋŋa eni ki nyenynya näk Agaak, ni tïm buye no owøørø.
english: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

anywaa: «Jø Icriel akäl Jwøki wøk ki Ijep, ni tïïc geni ni teek kaamar jööbi. Wïth juurre moa näk nyïïmänge oraanyge, ni tøcge cuuge na thäŋi, ni këërge geni ka athëëre.
english: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

anywaa: Jø Icriel caala cïgïï ŋuu mo obut piny, ni ge caala maath ŋuu. ?Aŋa no maar gø jiec? Gwïëth oen bäät ŋat wäro gwïëth geni, na acïëni oen bäät ŋat wäro cien geni.»
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

anywaa: Køøre Balak awëër døc ki Beelam, ni teeŋ ceŋŋe; ni kö Balaki jï Beelam, ni «Ïïna cwøla nee nyïïmän 'moa cienï. 'Ba ennø, ï poot gwïëtha geni kwöre moi na adäk ii.
english: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aa pou kawaane ennø. Aana köö niï daa wøørø døc cøøn na bëëde; 'ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk wöt marï amäne.»
english: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.

anywaa: 'Ba Beelam aköö jï Balak, «Kaa acaana jï jiyï moa jääŋŋï baŋa na bëëde, ni kööa,
english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Këël Balak doo cïpa øde bäre mo päŋ ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö jïra cøøn, bäŋ gïn mo raac wala mo beer mo daa tïïö ki wïïa keera ni kaala ciik Wuuö Jwøk; ni gïno caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye gïno caana.›
english: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a døøa baŋ jø powa. Ööï, nee gïno tïïc jøøi dëët jiy moï ki yïth nïne moo ööi caana jïrï.»
english: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aput tägö ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, na «A caana dwør Jwøk, a na Beelam o Beeyör, naa cäänö ni aana dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋe ojabø.
english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

anywaa: Aani, a caana dwør Jwøk ni aana ŋat wø wïny luup mo Jwøk, ni ŋäc leec wï Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni aana ŋat wø neen mar Jwøa en teeki cere, ni neena gø ni pädha, ni nyeŋŋa yaa jabø.
english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:

anywaa: «Ŋato ööi anø jooda, 'ba öönynye patha ennø; ni eni nëënö jïra, 'ba kare ba cään. Nyeya othïïŋ ri jø Icriel, ni caala cëërö mo pøn ri jic Jeekap; ni ö eni ni gøøc jø Möap ki kare bäre, ni dïïr wïthge, ge na näk jø okiera.
english: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

anywaa: Jø Ëdöm ni wø bëëdö Cëër, ni beege nyïïmän moe, odïïme ni tïmge ni ena cere; 'ba jø Icriel teek marge okadhi.
english: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

anywaa: Eni noo thïïŋ ri jic Jeekap obëëdö na kwäärö, ni raany jøøa näk odööŋ yïth päänye mo nyïïmänge bëët.»
english: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam jø Amalëk aneene ki ya acaara mare, ni täge ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Jø Amalëk beege wï jur mana kwøŋ leny ki jø Icriel, 'ba noo tïme na aŋuudi geno raanynyi.»
english: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam jø Këën aneene ki ya acaara mare, ni täge ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Kar bëëtö maru bëëdö ni teek kaamar øt wenyø mo ogeer wï kïdi,
english: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

anywaa: 'ba u na jø Këën, uuno raanynyi, kanyo ö jø Acörri noo makge uuni ki tøŋ.»
english: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Beelammi tägö ki man køp dwør Jwøk, ni kööe, «?Wui, aŋa noo maar bëëtö kanyo ö Jwøki noo tïïc gïnögø?
english: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy mo öö ki yïth baabuure ni ge käla Kitim, ni caarge jø Acör ki jø Eber. 'Ba geno ränynyi thuwø.»
english: And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

anywaa: Køøre Beelam aö maal ni døø kanya bëëde yie, ni ö Balaki thuwø ni aae ki øtjööre.
english: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët jø Icrielli Cëthim, jiy atägö ki wääth køør nyïï jø Möap, ni ge temma tïï käp ki geni.
english: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

anywaa: Kiper kar kaace jø Möap jø Icriel wø cwølge bäät olämme mo juu moge, ni ö jø Icrielli ni cämge, ni wøørge juu mo jø Möap.
english: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni løøge rege baŋ Baal-Pëëgör, na näk jwø jø Möap, ni tïm wëëc Wuuö Jwøki ni päl bäät jø Icriel døc.
english: And Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Mak dïbwöthe bëët mo jø Icriel, ni 'nägï geni, ni lïërï geni ko okaan cäŋ nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nee wëër mara paanya bäät jø Icriel.»
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï dïŋut luup mo jø Icriel, ni «Ŋati man nø dëëtu, jiye moa näk rege ege løø baŋ Baal-Pëëgör wär nääe.»
english: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge dho oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ge kïmmö, ŋat Icriel aciel aput kännö ki nyi jø Midien ni kïth gø yo oduŋkaara mare, ni nëënö jï Modhe ka acooŋ Icriel bäre.
english: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Piniac wär Eliedhar nyikwaar Aran, ni beeye Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ena put ö maal ki dï lwaak ni  aae ni lwør tøŋ,
english: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

anywaa: ni läp køør ŋat Icriel maneca yo oduŋkaara, ni put ge cwøp ki tøŋ karge riet. Ni ö ajäl Jwøki ni put aay bäät jø Icriel.
english: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa thøw ka ajäl Jwøk beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Piniac wär Eliedhar, nyikwaar Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, wëër mara apaanye bäät jø Icriel, kiper gïna keea, akeee thuwø dï jø Icriel; køøre, aani jø Icriel kära thöörö këët ki køør këëny mara.
english: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma man wø duunni ki mëër atuuda ki eni ennø,
english: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

anywaa: ni tïme na mare ki nyïïkwaaye moo ööi køøre bëët, ni beeye luubö mana tuut nee bëëde ni nut cooth kiper tïï dïlämme; kiper ena këëyö kiper Jwøk mare, ni beeye aani, ni tïïe ki gïn mo wëënna bääyö mar jø Icriel.»
english: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ ŋat Icriel mana thøw, na 'näk na aciel ki nyi jø Midien, beeye Dhimri o Caalu, ni beeye dïbwödhi mar dhi øtø aciel røk dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Cimien.
english: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ nyi jø Midien mana 'näk beeye Köcibi nyi Cuur, ni Cuur beeye dïbwödhi mar dhi øtø aciel røk jø Midien.
english: And the name of the Midianite woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Männu ki jø Midien, ni raanynyu geni,
english: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

anywaa: kiper gena männö ki uuni ni cøøkge uuni ki ri gïna tägö Pëëgör; ni cøøkge uuni thuwø ki køør nyige ma Köcibi, ni beeye nyi dïbwödhi mar jø Midien, nyaana thøw ni 'näga Piniaci dïcäŋa täk thøø mar ajäl Jwøk kiper gïna tägö Pëëgör.»
english: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør kanya thøw jiyi ka ajäl Jwøk mana pïï bäät jø Icriel, eni na Wuuö Jwøk ena cäänö ki Modhe ki Eliedhar wär Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwaannu lwaa Icriel bäre, moa näk cwiicge pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, ki køør dhøk uudi mo kwäcge, ni beege cwøw bëët moa näk løny jïge ki man cige baŋ leny.»
english: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni cäänge ki lwaa Icriel pwöl Möap na en buut Naam Jördan na dïët ki Jerikö, ni köge,
english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwaannu cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge tägi ka pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.» 'Ba jø Icriel moa ö wøk ki Ijep beege ii:
english: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Dhøk uudi mo wäät Ruben, ni beeye Ruben na näk kany Icriel, beege dhi øt Anök, ki dhi øt Pallu,
english: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Eedharan, ki dhi øt Karmi.
english: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Ruben, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurdäk ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïëradäk.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikwaar Pallu beeye Eliap,
english: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

anywaa: ni wäät Eliap beege Nemuel ki Daathan ka Abiram. 'Ba Daathan ka Abiram beege na no ojier lwaaki, ni beege na pïëmö thuwø ki Modhe ka Aran, ni geno dwätö ki Köra ki jiye kanya pïëmge ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace ŋøøm apääö ki dïge, ni put geni ki Köra mwøny karge bëët, ni thøw jøøa cääthge ki geni thuwø, ni beeye kanya ö maaci na thöör jøøa näk dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc. Ni tïm gïnögø na pwöc mo teek.
english: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Köra kär thøw.
english: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Cimien beege dhi øt Nemuel, ki dhi øt Jamin, ki dhi øt Jaakin,
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Dheera, ki dhi øt Caul.
english: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Cimien, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø ki dïpe ariiø.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Gaat beege dhi øt Dhipön, ki dhi øt Agi, ki dhi øt Cuni,
english: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Odheni, ki dhi øt Ëri,
english: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Arödi, ki dhi øt Arëli.
english: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Gaat, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ki dïpe abïïc.
english: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Juuda moa dïkwøŋ na thøø yi ŋööm Keenan beege Er ki Önan.
english: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Juuda møga  beege dhi øt Ceela, ki dhi øt Peereth, ki dhi øt Dheera.
english: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi mo wäät Peereth beege dhi øt Eedharan, ki dhi øt Amul.
english: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Juuda, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø ka abïciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Icakar beege dhi øt Töla, ki dhi øt Puwa,
english: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Puah, the family of the Punites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Jacup, ki dhi øt Cimrön.
english: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Icakar, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïciel kurŋween ki dïpe adäk.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Dhebulan beege dhi øt Cërët, ki dhi øt Ëlön, ki dhi øt Jaalël.
english: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Dhebulan, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïciel ki dïpe abïïc.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

anywaa: Wäät Jocep beege Maneeca ki Ipariem.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba dhi øtø mar o Maneeca beeye dhi øt Makir. Ni Makir beeye wää Geläti, ni beeye Gelät na käl dhi øt Geläti ree.
english: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi mo wäät Gelät beege dhi øt Iedher, ki dhi øt Këlëk,
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Aciriel, ki dhi øt Cekam,
english: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Cemida, ki dhi øt Ëpër.
english: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhilöpat wär Ëpër jïre bäŋ obwöre ma cwøw, 'ba obwöre moa en jïre beege mään keerge. Ni nyeŋ nyïï Dhilöpat beege Maala, ki Nöa, ko Okila, ki Milka, ki Tirja.
english: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy mo dhøk uudi mo wäät Maneeca beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurriiø ki dïpe abïriiø.
english: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Ipariem beege dhi øt Cuthula, ki dhi øt Bëkër, ki dhi øt Taan.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

anywaa: Ni dhi øtø mar o Cuthula beeye dhi øt Iran.
english: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Ipariem, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurriiø ki dïpe abïïc. 'Ba nyïïkwaac Jocep bëët ki køør dhøk uudi mo wäät Maneeca ki wäät Ipariem beege yøøgø.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Benjamen beege dhi øt Bëla, ki dhi øt Acbël, ki dhi øt Akiram,
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Cupam, ki dhi øt Upim.
english: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi mo wäät Bëla beege dhi øt Art ki dhi øt Neeman.
english: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Benjamen, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurbïïc ki dïpe abïciel.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhi øtø mar o Daan beeye dhi øt Cuam. Moøgø beege tuuŋ Daan ki køør dhi øtø marge.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

anywaa: Dhi øt Cuam bäre ki køør kwäänö marge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïciel kurŋween ki dïpe aŋween.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Acer beege dhi øt Yimna, ki dhi øt Yecuwi, ki dhi øt Beria.
english: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Jimnites: of Ishvi, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi mo wäät Beria beege dhi øt Eber ki dhi øt Melkiël.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ nya Acer beeye Cëëra.
english: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Acer, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïërabïïc kurdäk ki dïpe aŋween.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wäät Naptali beege dhi øt Jaadhël, ki dhi øt Guni,
english: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

anywaa: ki dhi øt Jedher, ki dhi øt Cilëm.
english: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

anywaa: Moøgø beege dhøk uudi mo wäät Naptali, ni kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurbïïc ki dïpe aŋween.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moa kwaan bëët beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ka aciel, ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïëradäk.
english: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ŋøøm opääŋŋï jï jøøi ki køør kwäänge na ŋøøpo dööŋ jïge.
english: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

anywaa: Ŋøøm wär meetï jï tuuŋ mana päl, ni cïpï ki mo thiinh jï tuuŋ mana thiinh. Tuuŋ man nø doo mooø ki ŋøøm ki køør kwäänge, nee bëëde na marge.
english: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm doo pääŋŋö ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ni tuuŋ man nø doo jïtö ki køør nyeŋ kwarge.
english: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

anywaa: Ŋöömmo dööŋ jï jø Icriel doo pääŋŋö yïthakic tuŋi moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø ki køør ŋïïce moøgø.»
english: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege dhi øt Gërcön, ki dhi øt Kät, ki dhi øt Mërari.
english: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Libay beege dhi øt Löbeni, ki dhi øt Keeprön, ki dhi øt Maali, ki dhi øt Muci, ki dhi øt Köra.  'Ba Kät beeye kwar Amram.
english: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ cï Amram beeye Jökabit, ni beeye nyi jø Libay, mana lwaarø ki gø Ijep. Ni ö eni ni nyööte ka Amram ko obwöre adäk, ni beege Aran, ki Modhe, ki cöökge ma Mariyam na näk dhaagø.
english: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

anywaa: Ni ö Aranni ni nywøl Nadap, ka Abiyu, ki Eliedhar, ki Itamer.
english: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

anywaa: 'Ba Nadap ka Abiyu athøw kanya cïpge maac nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki jöö mo patha kare.
english: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään nyïïkwaac Libay moa näk cwøw bëët moa näk jïge da dwäde oceele këël mo kaala dwäde oceele beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurdäk. 'Ba ge kär kwaan ri jø Icriel møga, kiper na bäŋe ŋøøm mo ocïbö na ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge dï jø Icriel.
english: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø beege jiy moa kwaan Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni beeye kanya kwaan jø Icriel moa näk cwøw pwöl Möap na en buut Naam Jördan na näk dïët ki Jerikö.
english: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba yïthakic jøøgø, bäŋ dïcwøø aciel mo odööŋ ni kwøw røk jøøa kwaan Modhe ka Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, kanya kwøŋge jø Icriel moa näk cwøw kwaan dï paap Caynay.
english: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

anywaa: Kiper onø caan Wuuö Jwøki jïge ni ge doo thøw dï paap. Bäŋ dïcwøø aciel mo odööŋ rege ni kwøw; 'ba beeye Kalëp o Jöpöni, ki Jøcua o Nun keerge na dööŋ.
english: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

anywaa: Køøre nyïï Dhilöpat wär Ëpër gena nyänh buut Modhe; 'ba Ëpër beeye o Gelät, ni Gelät beeye o Makir, ni Makir beeye o Maneeca, na käl dhi øt Maneeca o Jocep. 'Ba nyeŋ nyïï Dhilöpat beege Maala, ki Nöa, ko Okila, ki Milka, ki Tirja.
english: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïï Dhilöpati ni cuŋge dho oduŋkaany røømmø nyïm Modhe, ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïbwöthe, këël acooŋa bäre, ni köge,
english: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wääwa athøw dï paap, ni eni ba en yïthakic jøøa dwätö na cäädhö ki Köra na thïïŋ dëëtge dëër Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba eni thøw ka raay moe keere, ni bäŋ obwöre mo cwøw jïre.
english: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni tïme ni nyeŋ wääwa rwäänyö dï tuuŋge en? ?Beeye kiper na bäŋe obwöre ma cwøw jïre? Ŋøøm moa doo mëëk wääwa wär mëëk waani nee tïme na kurwa dï tuuŋ wääwa.»
english: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe luum nyïï Dhilöpat abwøth nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Mar nyïï Dhilöpat beeye kare. Ge diï mooø ki kurge na ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge yïthakic tuuŋ wääge, ni wëëgï ŋøøm geni moa doo cïbö jï wääge na ŋøøm mo wø dööŋ.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

anywaa: «'Ba caanï jï jø Icriel, ‹Ni näk mo dhaanhø thøw ni bäŋ wääde, ŋøøm moe doo dööŋ jï nyaare.
english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

anywaa: Ni näk mo bäŋ nyaare, ŋøøm moe doo dööŋ jï nyïïmenni moa näk cwøw.
english: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo bäŋ nyïïmenni, ŋøøm moe doo dööŋ jï nyïïmii wänni moa näk cwøw.
english: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

anywaa: Ni näk mo bäŋ nyïïmii wänni, ŋøøm moe doo dööŋ jï tuuŋge mana kare cään ki dhi øtø mare, ni tïme na mare. 'Ba gïnögø obëëdö na ciik jï jø Icriel, kaawat mana köömma ïïni, a na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Ci bäät kïdi man na cwøl na Abarim en, ni neenï ŋöömma cïba jï jø Icriel.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø neenï gø, ïïno thøw ni läpï køør jø pou, kaawat mana ö coku ma Aran na läp køørge;
english: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

anywaa: kiper kanya pïëm lwaaki ki aani dï paap Dhïn kar pï Meriba na en Kadëc, uuni luubö mara adhallu, ni käru a tïïö naa ena kur keera nyïm lwaak bäre.»
english: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, na näk Jwø jwïëy mo jiy bëët, ï doo jëëtö ki dhaanhø mo käär lwaak man,
english: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

anywaa: ŋat mo løny jïre ki  man bwödhe nyïmge, ni tïïe bëët moo tïïc lwaa Icrielli ena cere, kiper nee lwaak marï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, nee ba bëëtge kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge.»
english: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Lwør Jøcua o Nun, ni beeye dhaanhø mo Jwïëc Jwøk ena bääte, ni cïbï ceŋŋï bääte,
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

anywaa: ni thïïŋï eni nyïm Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, nyïm lwaak bäre, ni köömmï eni ni nëënö jïge bëët.
english: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

anywaa: Ni cïpï thääŋ teek marï jïre, nee dwøre wïny lwaa Icrielli bäre.
english: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Jøcua enø, wär cuŋŋe nyïm Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni ö Eliedharri ni pëëny aani kiper Jøcua, ni ŋøla luup kipere ki køør gïna cwøl no Urim. 'Ba Jøcua ki lwaa Icriel bäre jammi bëët dige tïïö ki køør dwør Eliedhar.»
english: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni tïïc gïïa caan jïre kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni, ni lwør Jøcua ni thïïŋ gø nyïm Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, nyïm lwaak bäre.
english: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ceŋŋe acïp bäät Jøcua ni kööm gø, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni.
english: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel aköömme ki køør dwøl mana caane jï Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Gwøgu rou ki man cïpu olämme jïra ki kwöra näk owäŋŋö, ni beeye caammi mo wø cïp jïra no olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac, na ŋwäänyge met.»
english: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, no «Olämme mo wø waaŋ moo cïpu jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beege nyïïdïëk ariiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele ni bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge. Olämme moøgø dou cïbö cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët, ni man nø waaŋŋa eni bäre.
english: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

anywaa: 'Ba nyidiel aciel dou cïbö ka amöölla, ni cïpu maya kany wø tïme na abøøya;
english: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

anywaa: ni cïpu muuy mar beel thuwø ma møø mo pøøth ma rumi aciel mo lwørra røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw ma rumme ariiø mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in.
english: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

anywaa: Moøgø beege olämme moo cïpu cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët no olämme mo wø waaŋ, kaawat mana caani jïïu tier Kïn Caynay, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ na ŋwäänyge met, ni waaŋŋa jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar køøŋø dou tïïö na rumme ariiø mo lwørra røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in kiper nyidiel aciel man nø, ni kønynyï køøŋŋøgø piny kar lam mana en kur keere jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.

anywaa: Køøre nyidiel maya wär cïpu kany wø päth cäŋŋi, ni cïpu muuy mar møk beel ki muuy mar køøŋø kaawat mana tïïyu ka amöölla, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ na ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ki cäŋ jwömö nyïïdïëk ariiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele ni bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö rege wär cïpu no olämme, ki møø mo pøøth ma rumme ariiø ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw, na muuy mar beel, ki muuy thuwø mar køøŋø.
english: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

anywaa: Manøgø beeye olämi man wø waaŋ bäre mano cïp kiper cäŋ jwömö, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo kwøŋ.
english: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø päär dwääyi cooth, u doo cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ bare  jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege rwädhe ariiø mo therø, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

anywaa: Ni cïpu ki møø mo pøøth thuwø ma rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, mo ojääbö ki maaw, na muuy mar beel kiper rwaath aciel man nø; ni cïpu ki møø mo pøøth ma rumme ariiø ki røk rumme apaar, mo ojääbö ki maaw na muuy mar beel kiper nywø røømmø;
english: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

anywaa: ni cïpu ki møø mo pøøth ma rumi aciel ki røk rumme apaar, mo ojääbö ki maaw na muuy mar beel kiper nyirøømmø aciel man nø. Moøgø beege olämme mo wø waaŋ na ŋwäänyge met, ni waaŋŋa jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar køøŋø dou tïïö na rumme aŋween ki røk rumme abära moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni in kiper rwaath aciel man nø, ki rumme adäk ki røk rumme abära kiper nywø røømmø, ki rumme ariiø ki røk rumme abära kiper nyirøømmø aciel man nø. Manøgø beeye olämi man wø waaŋ kany wø päär dwääyi man nø ki yi cwiir bäre.
english: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo kwøŋ.
english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø tïm nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ na apaar kurŋween, dïcäŋöce beeye ajwöm Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ni beeye cäŋ man wø wøørru jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyo tïme na nïne apaar kurbïïc mar dwäänögø, wär wø tïme ni da ajwöma; ni ki mano täge dïcäŋögø, muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø dou camø ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

anywaa: Ki yi cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ wär tïme ni da acooŋa mo ena kur keere; dïcäŋ manøgø bäre u bäŋ doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek.
english: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

anywaa: 'Ba wäru cïpu ko olämi mo di waaŋø, ni beeye olämi man wø waaŋ jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege rwädhe ariiø mo therø, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar beel thuwø, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, wär cïpu ki lääy moøgø na aciel, ni møø mano cïpu beege rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath aciel man nø, ki rumme ariiø kiper nywø røømmø,
english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

anywaa: ki rumi aciel kiper nyidiel aciel man nø røk moa na abïriiø.
english: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay, nee tïme no okïdi kiperu.
english: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

anywaa: Moøgø dou cïbö ni meedu geni bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ ni wø cïpu ka amöölla cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët.
english: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

anywaa: Wäru cïpu thuwø ko olämme mo teeŋ moøgø ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët kiper nïne abïriiø, ni beeye cam mo di waaŋø mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Moøgø doo cïbö ni meedu geni bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo kwøŋ.
english: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: Køøre ri bïriet nïne u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, nou ba doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek dïcäŋögø.
english: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋo tïïyu Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Køør Juu Abïriiø, kany wø cïpu yie ki muuy mar beel mar caammi moa nyärö jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, nou ba doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek.
english: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

anywaa: 'Ba  wäru cïpu ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre na gïn mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege rwädhe ariiø mo therø, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele.
english: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar beel, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, wär cïpu ki lääy moøgø na aciel, ni møø mano cïpu beege rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath aciel man nø, ki rumme ariiø kiper nywø røømmø,
english: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

anywaa: ki rumi aciel kiper nyidiel aciel man nø røk moa na abïriiø.
english: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö, nee tïme no okïdi kiperu.
english: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

anywaa: Moøgø wär cïpu na aciel ki muuy mar køøŋø, ni meedu geni bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel. Lääy moøgø wär näk bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

anywaa: «'Ba ki yi cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar bïriet dwäde, u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, nou ba doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek. 'Ba dïcäŋ manøgø doo tïmö ni beeye cäŋ mano køthu tuŋi yie.
english: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba u doo cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ bäre na ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye rwaath aciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

anywaa: Muuy mar beel thuwø, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, wär cïpu ki lääy moøgø na aciel, ni møø mano cïpu beege rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath, ki rumme ariiø kiper nywø røømmø,
english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

anywaa: ki rumi aciel kiper nyirøømmø aciel man nø røk moa na abïriiø.
english: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay, nee tïme no okïdi kiperu,
english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

anywaa: ni meedu olämi manøgø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ kany wø päär dwääyi cooth, ki mo wø waaŋ cooth ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët, no olämme moøgø bëët cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki muuce mo kwøŋ; ni beege mo wø cïpu ki køør mana no ocaanø kiperge, ni geno olämme mo wø waaŋ na ŋwäänyge met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri paac nïne mar bïriet dwäde, u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, ni dwøgu dëëtu piny, ni bäŋe tïïc mo tïïyu.
english: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

anywaa: 'Ba wäru cïpu ko olämi man wø waaŋ na ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye rwaath aciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

anywaa: Muuy mar beel thuwø, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, wär cïpu ki lääy moøgø na aciel, ni møø mano cïpu beege rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath, ki rumme ariiø kiper nywø røømmø,
english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

anywaa: ki rumi aciel kiper nyirøømmø aciel man nø røk moa na abïriiø.
english: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay. Moøgø dou cïbö ni meedu geni bäät olämi mar wëën raay mana no okïdi, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø tïm nïr dwääy mar bïriet dwäde na apaar kurbïïc, u doo cäŋa jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, nou ba doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek; 'ba u doo tïïö  ka ajwöma ni gwøgu gø na mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days:

anywaa: 'Ba u doo cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ, ni beeye olämi mo di waaŋø mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege rwädhe apaar kurdäk mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö rege.
english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mar beel thuwø, ni beeye møø mo pøøth mo ojääbö ki maaw, wär cïpu ki lääy moøgø na aciel, ni møø mano cïpu beege rumme adäk ki røk rumme apaar moa en yi rumi mana cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath aciel man nø røk moa na apaar kurdäk, ki rumme ariiø kiper nywø røømmø man nø,
english: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

anywaa: ki rumi aciel kiper nyirøømmø aciel man nø røk moa na apaar kurŋween.
english: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø dou cïbö no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri riet nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe apaar kurriiø mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri dää nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe apaar kurciel mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri ŋweer nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe apaar mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri bïï nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe abïŋween mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu olämi manøgø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri bïcier nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe abära mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu olämi manøgø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri bïriet nïne wäru cïpu ki rwädhe abïriiø mo therø, ki nyöök rööm ariiø, ki nyïïdïëk apaar kurŋween ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «'Ba ki ri bäc nïne u doo jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, nou ba doo tïïö ki tïïc mo teek.
english: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

anywaa: 'Ba u doo cïpö ko olämi man wø waaŋ, ni beeye olämi mo di waaŋø mo ŋwäänynye met jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye rwaath aciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïriiø ma rööm ma nyööi mo cwiicge oceele, mo bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö dëëtge.
english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

anywaa: Ni cïpu muuy mar beel ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki thuwø kiper rwaath, ki nywø røømmø, ki nyïïrööm ki køør kwäänge, kaawat mana caani.
english: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

anywaa: Køøre nø, nywø ateea aciel thuwø wär cïpu no olämi mar wëën raay, ni meedu gø bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ cooth, ni wø cïp na aciel ki muuce mo beel ki mo kwøŋ.
english: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

anywaa: «Gïïögø bëët dou cïbö jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki yïth kwör ajwöm moa näk ocaanø jïïu, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ, ki muuy mar beel, ki muuy mar køøŋ nyïïomøki, ko olämme mou mo wø duunni ki mëër; ni meedu geni bäät olämme mo kööŋ ko olämme mo wø cïpu ki met ec maru.»
english: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jammi bëët acaane jï jø Icriel kaawat mana köömmi ya Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö jï wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel, ni «Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en:
english: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.

anywaa: Kany wø näk mo dïcwøø kööŋ ki man cïpe ki gïrpiny jï Wuuö Jwøk, wala lama ree ki gïrpiny, luup moe ba dee wiiø ki man kïth gø bäät tïïc, 'ba gïnöce dee kïtha bäät tïïc kaawat mana ö wøk ki dhee.
english: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø näk mo dhaagø ma nyakøø mo poot ena po wänni kööŋ ki man cïpe ki gïrpiny jï Wuuö Jwøk, wala lama ree ki gïrpiny,
english: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;

anywaa: ni näk mo wïny wänni wïnynyö ni lïŋe jaak, gïïa kööŋe kiperge bëët wala moa lam ree ki geni ena bääte.
english: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo män wänni mänö dïcäŋo wïny gø, kööŋ mare wala gïna lam ree ki gø tïmö ni ba en bääte këët. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyakøønnøgø owëënne, kiper na mäni ya wänni.
english: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk nyakøønnøgø di nywømø ni gïïa kööŋe kiperge, wala gïïa lam ree ki geni ni wïïe käre caarø, poot ena bääte,
english: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

anywaa: ni näk mo wïny cwøre wïnynyö ni lïŋe jaak dïcäŋo wïny gø, gïïa kööŋe kiperge wala gïïa lam ree ki ge ena bääte.
english: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo män cwøre mänö dïcäŋo wïny gø, eni raanynya kööŋ mar cïïe, wala gïna lam ree ki gø ni wïïe käre caarø, ni tïme ni ba en bäät cïïe këët. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dhaaŋŋøgø di wëënnö.
english: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.

anywaa: «'Ba cï thøø wala dhaagø mo obøth, ni näk mo eni kööŋ wala lama ree ki gïrpiny, gïïa kööŋe kiperge wala gïïa lam ree ki geni bëët ena bääte.
english: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk dhaagø mo onywømø kööŋ wala lama ree ki gïrpiny,
english: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

anywaa: ni näk mo wïny cwøre wïnynyö ni lïŋe jaak, gïïa kööŋe kiperge wala gïïa lam ree ki geni bëët ena bääte.
