english: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïïögø okwier cwøre dïcäŋo wïny gø, kööŋ mare wala gïïa lam ree ki geni tïmö ni ba en bääte këët. Køøre eno wëën Wuuö Jwøki, kiper na ö cwøre na kwier gïïögø.
english: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.

anywaa: Cø dhaagø jïre da teek ki man jïëc kööŋ wala lam røk, wala ki man kwier kööŋ wala lam røk mana tïïc cïïe.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo  dïcwøø lïŋö jaak ki nïne møøk, eni døøya kööŋ mo cïïe wala gïïa lam ree ki geni bëët mo teek. Eni døøya geni mo teek bäät dhaagø mare kiper na lïŋe jaak dïcäŋa wïny gø.
english: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ee wïnynyö ni kwier geni ki køør nïne møøk, ajäla mana doo en bäät cïïe tïmö ni ena bääte.»
english: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ciik kiper kööŋ ki lam røk moa caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe kiper bëët dhaanhø ki cïïe, wala bëët nyakøø ki wänni kanyo poode po wänni.
english: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cool kwör jø Icriel dëët jø Midien; 'ba noo tïme na køøre nø, ïïno thøw, ni läpï køør jø pou.»
english: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acäänö ki jø Icriel, ni kööe, ni «Jiiŋŋu jiy kiper leny, nee maarge cøø ni këëtge ki jø Midien, ni coolge kwör Wuuö Jwøk dëët jø Midien.
english: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.

anywaa: 'Ba u doo jäägö ki jiy ma kuma aciel baŋ leny ki ri tuuŋ man nø røk tuŋi mo jø Icriel.»
english: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

anywaa: Køøre jiy ma kume apaar kurriiø moa no ojiiŋŋø kiper leny, acïp, ni beeye kuma aciel ri tuuŋ man nø na cïp røk tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët.
english: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni jääŋ geni baŋ leny, ni beeye kuma aciel ri tuuŋ man nø, ni jääŋ Piniac wär Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni ci baŋ leny ki geni na aciel, ni japa en kur keerge ki tuŋi mo wø kooth na ŋïï kiper leny di käärö.
english: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

anywaa: Køøre gena këëdö ki jø Midien, ni 'näkge cwøw bëët, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye mo Midien moa näk abïïc anäkge ki jøøgø na aciel, ni nyeŋ nyeye moøgø beege Ëwi, ki Rekem, ki Cuur, ki Ur, ki Riba; ni 'näkge Beelam o Beeyör thuwø ko opëëllö.
english: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni makge määr jø Midien ki nyïïge bëët moa therø, ni twierge dhäk ki dïëk ki jammi moge bëët.
english: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

anywaa: Ni waaŋge päänye moge kwöra bëëtge yïthge, ki twëëre moge bëët,
english: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

anywaa: ni kälge japa twierge, ki jiy ki lääc paac bëët moa makge ki tøŋ.
english: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

anywaa: Køøre japa twierge, ki jiy ki lääc paac bëët moa makge, akälge baŋ Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki lwaa Icriel bäre, na en twïër yi pwöl Möap buut Naam Jördan na näk dïët ki Jerikö.
english: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïbwöthe bëët mo lwaa Icriel, aci wøk nee ge røømge ŋää twïër.
english: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na joot geni, ena wëër døc ki kwääc lwaae moa näk dïbwöthe mo ŋati man nø käära jiy ma kuma, ki moa näk ŋati man nø käära jiy ma dïpa, ni beege moa duuö ki baŋ leny bëët.
english: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïge, na «?Aŋø, mään aweyu bëët ni kwøw?
english: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

anywaa: Neennu, moi beege mään moa caath køør pwöc Beelam, na wëëk jø Icriel bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør luubö mana tägö Pëëgör, kanya put ajäl thøø mar Wuuö Jwøk ö bäät jiye.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, 'nägu obwöc cwøw bëët moa therø, ni 'nägu mään bëët thuwø moa näk dëët cwøw ŋäcge.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöc mään bëët moa näk dëët cwøw poot kucge, wär weyu ni kwøw jïïu.
english: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

anywaa: «Køøre uuni bëët, u no onääö ki jiy, ki u na guun dëët jiy mo othøw, wäru bëëdu wøk ŋää twïër ki nïne abïriiø; ni døøyu dëëtu mo waany, u ki jøøa magu ri leny, ki ri dää nïne ki ri bïriet nïne.
english: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

anywaa: 'Ba abïïe bëët, ki jammi bëët moa näk tïïc ka pëët lääy, ki jammi bëët moa näk tïïc ka jïëc ateea, ki jammi bëët moa näk tïïc ka jaath, dou døøya mo waany.»
english: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.

anywaa: Køøre Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköö jï jø leny moa aa baŋ leny, ni «Man beeye ciik mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe, ena köö, 22-23
english: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;

anywaa: ni ‹Jammi bëët mo wø dhal maac dou kïth yi maac ni døøyu ge mo waany, kaamar warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki nywïënyö jaak, ka athääri, ki nywïënyö ma arecaac. 'Ba gïïögø thuwø doo døøya mo waany ki pï wø døøc jammi mo waany. 'Ba gïïa näk løny ki man waaŋi ya maaci doo kïtha yi pïï.
Køøre abïïe mou dou penyø ki ri bïriet nïne, ni tïmu nou waany. Køør manøgønø, uuno ö twïër.› »
english: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ïïni ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki wïth dhøk uudi mo lwaa Icriel, gïïa mak ri leny bëët wär kwaannu, ni beege jiy ki lääc paac bëët.
english: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

anywaa: Ni pääŋŋu geni yïthakic jøøa aa baŋ leny ki lwaa Icriel bäre.
english: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

anywaa: Ni jwägu jiy moa aa baŋ leny nee japøgø tïmge na 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk. U doo lwötö røk jøøa mak, ki røk dhäk ka arëëni ki dïëk, ni lwørru na aciel aciel røk dïpe abïïc moi nø, nee tïmge na 'moa.
english: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:

anywaa: Lwørru japøgø ri thääŋö mana näk kur jøøa aa baŋ leny, ni cïpu gø jï Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na muuy jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri thääŋö mana näk kur jø Icriel møga, u doo lwötö røk jøøa mak, ki røk dhäk ka arëëni ki dïëk ki lääc paac bëët, ni lwørru na aciel aciel røk pïërabïïc moi nø, ni mëëgu geni jø tuuŋ Libay, jøøa näk tïï oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk ena ceŋge.»
english: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni tïïcge gø kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk lääc paac ki jiy bëët moa mak jøøa aa baŋ leny, moa dööŋ na pïï twïër beege dïëk ma kume ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïriiø kurbïïc,
english: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

anywaa: ki dhäk ma kume ma pïërabïriiø kurriiø,
english: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

anywaa: ka arëëni ma kume ma pïërabïciel kurciel,
english: And threescore and one thousand asses,

anywaa: ki jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk kurriiø, ni beege obwöc mään moa näk dëët cwøw kucge.
english: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

anywaa: 'Ba thäk japøgø moa mëëk jøøa aa baŋ leny na kurge beege dïëk ma kume ma dïpe adäk ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø ki dïpe abïïc;
english: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

anywaa: ni dïëk moa jwäk na mo Wuuö Jwøk beege dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïriiø kurbïïc.
english: And the Lord's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

anywaa: Kwään dhäk bëët moa mëëk jøøa aa baŋ leny beege kume ma pïëradäk ka abïciel; ni ki røk moøgø pïërabïriiø kurriiø amëëk Wuuö Jwøk na mo ajwäk.
english: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord's tribute was threescore and twelve.

anywaa: Kwään arëëni moa mëëk jøøa aa baŋ leny beege kume ma pïëradäk ki dïpe abïïc; ni ki røk moøgø pïërabïciel kurciel amëëk Wuuö Jwøk na mo ajwäk.
english: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord's tribute was threescore and one.

anywaa: Kwään obwöc mään moa mëëk jøøa aa baŋ leny beege kume apaar ka abïciel; ni ki røk moøgø pïëradäk kurriiø amëëk Wuuö Jwøk na mo ajwäk.
english: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord's tribute was thirty and two persons.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jiy ki lääc paac bëët moa jwäk na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk, amëëk Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋö mana näk kur jø Icriel, na cïp Modhe kur keere ki ri thääŋö mar jøøa aa baŋ leny,
english: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

anywaa: na mëëk lwaa Icriel, beege dïëk ma kume ma dïpe adäk ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø ki dïpe abïïc,
english: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

anywaa: ki dhäk ma kume ma pïëradäk ka abïciel,
english: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

anywaa: ka arëëni ma kume ma pïëradäk ki dïpe abïïc,
english: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

anywaa: ko obwöc mään ma kume apaar ka abïciel.
english: And sixteen thousand persons;)

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri thääŋö mana mëëk jø Icriel na kurge, Modhe alwötö ka aciel aciel ri pïërabïïc, ni beege jiy ki lääc paac bëët, ni mëëk ge jø tuuŋ Libay, jøøa näk tïï oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk ena ceŋge, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Køøre kwääc lwaae moa näk dïbwöthe mo ŋati man nø käära jiy ma kuma, ki moa näk ŋati man nø käära jiy ma dïpa, aö baŋ Modhe,
english: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

anywaa: ni köge jïgø, ni «Waani, wa na jiyï, jiy bëët moa en ceŋwa moa aa baŋ leny akwaanwa, ni  bäŋ dhaanhø mo tøør dëëtwa.
english: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, waana kännö ki muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk ki røk japa joot ŋati man nø dëëtwa, ni beege jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey, ni beege oguudi mo bäädi ki mo ceŋ, ki gwet lweedi ki mo ïdhi, ki mo cwägi, nee tïme na gïn mo wëënna bääyö marwa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ japa näk tïïc ka warkey bëët alwørge ceŋge.
english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

anywaa: 'Ba warkey bäre mana cïpge na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk beeye kar gwel ma kume apaar ka abïciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel; ni japøgø käla baŋ dïbwöthe mo leny moa näk käära jiy ma kume ki ma dïpe.
english: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, jøw moa ci baŋ leny bëët, ŋati man nø onø kädö ki jammi kiper dëëre røk jammi moa twierge.
english: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni lwørge warkey ceŋ dïbwöthe mo leny moa näk käära jiy ma kume ki ma dïpe, ni kïthge gø yo oduŋkaany røømmø, nee bëëde na gïr par wïc jï jø Icriel nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace nyïïkwaac Ruben ki nyïïkwaac Gaat jïge da dhäk mo thööth døc. Køøre kanya ö nyïïkwaac Ruben ki nyïïkwaac Gaat na jootge ŋööm Jadher ki ŋööm Gelät na kany mo orømø kiper dhäk,
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

anywaa: gena ö baŋ Modhe, ki Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïbwöthe mo lwaak bäre, ni köge, 3-4
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ŋöömma dïïm Wuuö Jwøki ki ri lwaa Icriel, ni beege mïëya cøøri na Atharöt, ki Dibön, ki Jadher, ki Nemera, ki Ëcbön, ki Eliyali, ki Cëëbama, ki Nebø, ki Bayan, beege ŋøøm mo orømø kiper dhäk; ni waani, wa na jiyï, jïwa da dhäk.
'Ba ni näk mo yiï met ki waani, ŋöömmi en doo mëëga waani, wa na jiyï, nee tïme na marwa. Kär niï kïtha waani løø Naam Jördan løøga.»
english: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jï nyïïkwaac Gaat ki nyïïkwaac Ruben, na «?Aŋø, nyïïmëëgu doo aa baŋ leny, nou bëëdu kany jaak?
english: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aperŋø na raanynyu cwïny jø Icriel, nee ba cige yi ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïge en?
english: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?

anywaa: Gïnögø caala gïna tïïc wëëgu kiree, kanya jääŋŋa geni ki Kadëc-Bernia nee ŋöömö liewge.
english: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh–barnea to see the land.

anywaa: Kiper kanya cige goor Ëcköl, na nø neenge ŋöömö, cwïny jø Icriel araanyge nee ba cige yi ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïge.
english: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëre ki geni døc dïcäŋöce, ni kööŋe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, røk jøøa ö wøk ki Ijep, moa näk cwiicge pïërariiø këël mo kaala pïërariiø, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo joot ŋöömma buua jï Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, kiper køøra kärge caadhø ki cwïnyge bäre;
english: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

anywaa: 'ba jø ojoot ŋöömmögø beege Kalëp o Jöpöni nyikwaar jø Kënec, ki Jøcua o Nun keerge, kiper gena bëëdö ni ge caatha køøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki cwïnyge bäre.›
english: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Wuuö Jwøk awëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni wëëk geni thääyö dï paap ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, këël mana thum beenhnhø bäre mana tïïc gïïa reyø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Lord's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, uuna läw kar wëëgu, ni uuna jø raay møøk mo nyärö, nee wëëc Wuuö Jwøk meetu bäät jø Icriel.
english: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk mou døøa cään ni ba cäädhu køøre, eni thuwø jiy ocäŋ wii dï paap, ni thum jøøi bëët ii ki køøru.»
english: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

anywaa: Køøre gena nyänh buut Modhe, ni köge, ni «Wa doo tïïö ki lwääge kiper lääc paac mowa kany, ni gëëtwa ki päänye thuwø kiper obwöre mowa moa therø.
english: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

anywaa: 'Ba waani, tøøŋi mowa olwørwa ni rewa ewa jiiŋŋø ki man bwøthwa maal nyïm jø Icriel, këël mano kïthwa geni kanyo bëëtge yie. 'Ba nyïïwa moa therø obëëdö yïth päänye mo teek kiper nee ge ba 'näk jiyi moa bëëdö yi ŋöömmi.
english: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

anywaa: Wa ba duu mïëri mowa këël mano ö ŋati man nø ri jø Icriel noo lwør ŋöömö mana näk kure.
english: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

anywaa: Ni wa bäŋ doo jïtö ki ŋöömö mo dööŋ jïwa løø Naam Jördan løøga ki geni na aciel, kiper ŋöömö mano dööŋ na marwa anø ci ceŋwa løø Naam Jördan løøi na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.»
english: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö jïge, ni «Ni näk mo gïn tïïyu tïïö, ni jiiŋŋu dëëtu kiper leny ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,

anywaa: ni ö jiyi bëët moa näk dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny ni kaathge Jördan ni ge cäädhi ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, këël kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo riem nyïïmän moe bëët,
english: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

anywaa: ni dïïm ŋöömmögø bäre; køøre kar kaace nø, uuno duui, ni tïmu ni bäŋ gïn mo many Wuuö Jwøki manynyø bäätu këët; këël jø Icriel tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo manyge bäätu thuwø. Ni ö ŋöömmi en ni tïme na maru nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo ba tïïyu, u bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba wär ŋäyu ni raay mou keeru røma rou.
english: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.

anywaa: Geerru päänye kiper obwöre mou moa therø, ni tïïu ki lwääge thuwø kiper dïëk mou, ni tïïyu gïna buugu.»
english: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Gaat ki nyïïkwaac Ruben gena köö jï Modhe, ni «Gïnögø otïïcwa, wa na jiyï, kaawat mana caanï, ï na kwäärö marwa.
english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

anywaa: Waani, nyïïwa ki määrwa, ki dïëk, ki dhäk mowa bëët odööŋ kany yïth päänye mo Gelät.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa na jiyï, wa na näk dëëtwa ewa jiiŋŋø kiper leny, waano ŋut løøga ni cääthwa ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat mana caanï, ï na kwäärö marwa.»
english: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe acïpö ki dwøl kiper jøøgø jï Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun, ki jï wïth dhøk uudi bëët mo tuŋi moa näk apaar kurriiø mo jø Icriel.
english: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe jïge, ni «Nee jiy bëët moa näk rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny moa en ri jø tuuŋ Gaat ki jø tuuŋ Ruben ŋuta løø Naam Jördan løøga ki uuni ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, këël mano mayu ŋöömmögø; køøre nø, ŋööm Gelät wär mëëgu geni na marge.
english: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dëëtge ba jiiŋge kiper leny ni pööthge ki uuni na aciel, ge doo jïtö ki kurge ki ri ŋööm Keenan, kaamar jø tuŋi møga.»
english: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya nyïïkwaac Gaat ki nyïïkwaac Ruben, ni «Gïnögø tïïcwa tïïö kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïwa, wa na jiyï.
english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

anywaa: Waani, dëëtwa ojiiŋwa kiper leny ni ŋutwa løøga yi ŋööm Keenan ni wa cäädhi ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋöömö mana mëëk waani løø Naam Jördan løøi odööŋ na marwa.»
english: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe ŋöömö aput cïp jï nyïïkwaac Gaat ki nyïïkwaac Ruben, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca o Jocep, ni beeye ŋööm Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, ki ŋööm Ög nyeny jø Baacan, ki päänye moge moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, këël ŋøøm bëët moa en deŋ päänye moøgø.
english: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaac Gaati ni cäŋge Dibön geerrø, ka Atharöt, ka Aröör,
english: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

anywaa: ka Atharöt-Cöpan, ki Jadher, ki Jögebiya,
english: And Atroth Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Nimera, ki Bëëth-Aaren, na päänye mo ege geerø ni teek; ni tïïge ki lwääge kiper dïëk thuwø.
english: And Beth–nimrah, and Beth–haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaac Ruben ni cäŋge Ëcbön geerrø, ki Eliyali, ki Kiriatayim,
english: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,

anywaa: ki Nebø, ki Baal-Miyön, ki Cebama; ni cakge nyeŋ päänye moa geerge ki nyeŋ møøk.
english: And Nebo, and Baal–meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaac Makir o Maneeca ni cige Gelät ni macge gø, ni riemge jø Amör moa en kaace.
english: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni cïp ŋööm Gelät jï nyïïkwaac Makir o Maneeca, ni bëëtge kaace.
english: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

anywaa: 'Ba Jayer nyikwaar Maneeca aay ni mac atude mo Gelät moa therø bëët, ni cwøl ge na Mïëc Jayer.
english: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth–jair.

anywaa: Ni ö Nöba ni aae ni mac Kënat ka atude moa therø na en deŋŋe bëët, ni cwøl gø ri nyeŋŋe ni Nöba.
english: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwöra caath jø Icrielli, kanya öge wøk ki Ijep ni ge cäädhi na lwaae kaamar jiy mo rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, ni ge bwøtha Modhe ka Aran.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

anywaa: 'Ba kwöra tïŋge wäädhi ki yïthge agöör Modhe  piny thuwø ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki; ni moi beege kwöra caathge bëët ki køør kwöra tïŋge wäädhi ki yïthge.
english: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

anywaa: Kanya tïm nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ na apaar kurbïïc, jø Icriel atïŋŋö kanya cwøl ni Ramcë, ni beeye køør Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie. Dïcäŋöce jø Icriel aö wøk ki Ijep ni cwïnyge da cer, ni nëënö jï jø Ijep bëët;
english: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

anywaa: ni beeye kanya bëët jø Ijepi ni ge kunyö ki dëët kaai moge moa thøw ka ajäl Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba kar kaace thuwø Wuuö Jwøk teek mar juu mo Ijep ee nø raanynyø na bäre.
english: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïŋ jø Icrielli ki Ramcë, twïër marge atïïcge Cuköt.
english: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Cuköt, ni tïïcge twïër marge Ëtham, na en deŋ paap.
english: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Ëtham, ni løkge rege ni døøge Pii-Ayröt, na en nyïm Baal- Dhapön; ni tïïcge twïër marge nyïm Migdöl.
english: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi–hahiroth, which is before Baal–zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Pii-Ayröt, ni pööthge ki dï Naama Kwaar, ni cige dï paap, ni cääthge ki nïne adäk dï paap Ëtham, ni tïïcge twïër marge Maara.
english: And they departed from before Pi–hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge Maara, ni öge Ëlim; 'ba Ëlim yie da ïïdhi apaar kurriiø mo yïthge da pïï, ki twöe ma pïërabïriiø; ni ö geni ni tïïcge twïër marge kaace.
english: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Ëlim, ni tïïcge twïër marge deŋ Naama Kwaar.
english: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki buut Naama Kwaar, ni tïïcge twïër marge dï paap Cin.
english: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki dï paap Cin, ni tïïcge twïër marge Dapeka.
english: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge Dapeka, ni tïïcge twïër marge Aluc.
english: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Aluc, ni tïïcge twïër marge Rapidim, kanya näk bäŋ pïï mo maath yie.
english: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Rapidim, ni tïïcge twïër marge dï paap Caynay.
english: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki dï paap Caynay, ni tïïcge twïër marge kanya cwøl ni Kibïröth-Ataba.
english: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth–hattaavah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki kanya cwøl ni Kibïröth- Ataba, ni tïïcge twïër marge Adhëëröth.
english: And they departed from Kibroth–hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Adhëëröth, ni tïïcge twïër marge Ritama.
english: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Ritama, ni tïïcge twïër marge Rimön-Peereth.
english: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon–perez.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Rimön-Peereth, ni tïïcge twïër marge Libana.
english: And they departed from Rimmon–perez, and pitched in Libnah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Libana, ni tïïcge twïër marge Rica.
english: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Rica, ni tïïcge twïër marge Keyelata.
english: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Keyelata, ni tïïcge twïër marge tier Kïn Capir.
english: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki tier Kïn Capir, ni tïïcge twïër marge Arada.
english: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Arada, ni tïïcge twïër marge Mekeyelöt.
english: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Mekeyelöt, ni tïïcge twïër marge Taath.
english: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Taath, ni tïïcge twïër marge Teera.
english: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Teera, ni tïïcge twïër marge Mitaka.
english: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Mitaka, ni tïïcge twïër marge Acamöna.
english: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Acamöna, ni tïïcge twïër marge Möcëëröt.
english: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Möcëëröt, ni tïïcge twïër marge Bene-Jaakan.
english: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene–jaakan.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Bene-Jaakan, ni tïïcge twïër marge Öör-Agitgat.
english: And they removed from Bene–jaakan, and encamped at Hor–haggiggad.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Öör-Agitgat, ni tïïcge twïër marge Jöthbata.
english: And they went from Hor–haggiggad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Jöthbata, ni tïïcge twïër marge Abaröna.
english: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Abaröna, ni tïïcge twïër marge Edhiyön-Gabir.
english: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion–geber.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Edhiyön-Gabir, ni tïïcge twïër marge Kadëc, na en dï paap Dhïn.
english: And they removed from Ezion–geber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Kadëc, ni tïïcge twïër marge tier Kïn Öör, na en deŋ ŋööm jø Ëdöm.
english: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aci bäät Kïn Öör ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni thøø kaace. 'Ba kar kaace beeye kanya päŋ cwiic jø Icriel na pïëraŋween ki mana öge wøk ki Ijep, ni beeye  dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar bïï dwäde.
english: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thøw Aranni bäät Kïn Öör, cwiiri moe päŋ ni dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø kurdäk.
english: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, nyeny jø Arat nyï Keenan, na bëëdö Nëgëp yi ŋööm Keenan, ööny jø Icriel awïnynye.
english: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni cäŋge tïŋŋö tier Kïn Öör, ni tïïcge twïër marge Jaalmöna.
english: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Jaalmöna, ni tïïcge twïër marge Punön.
english: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Punön, ni tïïcge twïër marge Oböth.
english: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Oböth, ni tïïcge twïër marge Iye-Abarim, na en keew mar jø Möap.
english: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Iye–abarim, in the border of Moab.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Iye-Abarim, ni tïïcge twïër marge Dibön-Gaat.
english: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon–gad.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Dibön-Gaat, ni tïïcge twïër marge Almön-Dibalataym.
english: And they removed from Dibon–gad, and encamped in Almon–diblathaim.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki Almön-Dibalataym, ni tïïcge twïër marge bäät kïdi mana cwøl na Abarim, nyïm Kïn Nebø.
english: And they removed from Almon–diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ki bäät kïdi mana cwøl na Abarim, ni tïïcge twïër marge pwöl Möap na en deŋ Naam Jördan na näk dïët ki Jerikö.
english: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïïö ki twïër bäät Naam Jördan kaace, ni täge ki Bëëth-Jecimöt këël mana këët Abël-Cetim na en yi pwöl Möap.
english: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth–jeshimoth even unto Abel–shittim in the plains of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enge pwöl Möap deŋ Naam Jördan na näk dïët ki Jerikö, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Kanyo ŋøllu Naam Jördan nou cøøa ŋööm Keenan,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

anywaa: jiy bëët moa bëëdö kaace wär riemu wøk, ni raanynyu gïïa no otieŋø na juu, ki japa no oleenyø na no otïïö na juu bëët mo wø lamge; ni raanynyu kwör lam moge bëët moa en bäät thuuri.
english: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

anywaa: Ni mayu ŋøøm ni bëëdu yie, kiper yaa nø cïp jïïu na maru.
english: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

anywaa: Ni pääŋŋu ŋøøm nee cige jï tuŋi mou ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw. Tuuŋ mo dwøŋ wär mooyu ki ŋøøm mo thööth, ni cïpu ŋøøm mo nøk jï tuuŋ mo thiinh; ni tuuŋ man wø päth ŋïïce baŋge, ŋøømmeca doo tïmö na marge. 'Ba uuno jïti ki ŋøøm ki køør nyeŋ kwäyu.
english: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk jiy moa bëëdö kaace ba riemu wøk, jøøo dööŋ noo weyu otïmö kaamar gïï mo cööbö nyeŋŋu, ni caalge koodhi mo cööba tiet butu, ni cwaatge yïthu kaace kanyo bëëdu yi ŋöömmögø.
english: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

anywaa: Køøre gïna caara ki cwïnya nee tïïa dëëtge owiila ni tïme ni tïïa dëëtu.› »
english: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel aköömme ki køør dwøl mana caane jï Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo dønynyu yi ŋööm Keenan, ni beeye ŋöömö mano dööŋ jïïu na maru, nyeŋ keee mo ŋöömmögø beege ii.
english: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

anywaa: «Aŋuun ŋøøm mou moa en jï løø tier-piny otägi ki dï paap Dhïn na näk kïïö ka ŋööm Ëdöm. 'Ba dëër waŋkeew maru kiree tägi ka aŋuun Naam Acäbö løøa en bäät caam jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ,
english: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

anywaa: ni cør thuur Akirabim, ni pöödhe ni coonya paap Dhïn, ni pääny Kadëc- Bernia ee wii bäät cwiic. Køøre ocäŋ aay ni pöödhe ki buut Adhar-Adar ni coonya Acimön.
english: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh–barnea, and shall go on to Hazar–addar, and pass on to Azmon:

anywaa: Køøre odøø bäät cwïïc mëëth, ni päth yi waŋ Ijep, ni ŋuude yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

anywaa: «'Ba waŋkeew maru ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ otïmö na naama dwøŋ ki deŋŋe bäre. Manøgø otïmö na waŋkeew maru ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

anywaa: «'Ba waŋkeew maru ki jï løø wï-piny wär kiiwu ni tägi ka naama dwøŋ këël Kïn Öör;
english: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

anywaa: ni cäŋ tägö ki Kïn Öör këël mano pïïe jöör wø ci Amath. Køøre waŋkeew oaay këël Cidat,
english: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

anywaa: ni cør nyïm Dhiparön, ni ŋuude Adhar-Enan. Manøgø otïmö na waŋkeew maru ki jï løø wï-piny.
english: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar–enan: this shall be your north border.

anywaa: «'Ba waŋkeew maru mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wär kiiwu ni tägi ka Adhar-Enan këël Cepama.
english: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar–enan to Shepham:

anywaa: Ni ö waŋkeewi ni cäŋ aay ki Cepama ni coonya Ribala, na Ayn ee wii bäät cwiic, ni put pöödhö ki bäät thuuri mo wø en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki naam Kinërët.
english: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

anywaa: Køøre waŋkeew ocäŋ aay ni lwøra Naam Jördan cooth, këël mano päth Naam Acäbö. 'Ba ŋöömö manøgø bäre otïmö na maru ki køør nyeŋ keee moe bëët.»
english: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø Icriel aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Manøgø beeye ŋöömö mano pääŋŋu yïthakiyu ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ni beeye ŋöömma näk onø caan Wuuö Jwøki nee pääŋŋi jï tuŋi abïŋween ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca;
english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

anywaa: kiper nyïïkwaac tuuŋ Ruben ki tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca onø jïtö ki ŋøøm ki køør dhøk uudi mo kwäcge.
english: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

anywaa: Tuŋi moøgø na ariiø yøø ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca onø jïtö ki ŋøøm løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, na dïët ki Jerikö.»
english: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Nyeŋ jiy moo pääŋ ŋøøm jï jø Icriel, nee tïme na moge, beege Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun.
english: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Modhe, ï doo lwötö ki dïbwödhi aciel ri tuuŋ man nø, nee kunynye ki pääŋ ŋøøm moo pääŋŋi jï jø Icriel nee tïme na moge.
english: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jøøgø beege ii: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda beeye Kalëp o Jöpöni.
english: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Cimien beeye Cemuel wär Ammiyut.
english: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Elidat o Kicilön.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Daan, dïbwödhi beeye Buki o Jögili.
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Maneeca o Jocep, dïbwödhi beeye Aniel o Ëëput.
english: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Ipariem o Jocep, dïbwödhi beeye Këmuël o Cipitan.
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Dhebulan, dïbwödhi beeye Elicapan o Peranak.
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Icakar, dïbwödhi beeye Paltiel wär Adhan.
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Acer, dïbwödhi beeye Akiyut o Cëlömi.
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

anywaa: «Ki røk jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Naptali, dïbwödhi beeye Pedael wär Ammiyut.»
english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

anywaa: Moøgø beege jiy moa kööm Wuuö Jwøki nee ŋööm Keenan pääŋge jï jø Icriel nee dööŋe jïge na marge.
english: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en jø Icrielli pwöl Möap buut Naam Jördan, løøa dïët ki Jerikö, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kööm jø Icriel nee cïpge ki päänye jï jø tuuŋ Libay nee bëëtge yïthge røk päänye moo cïp jï jø Icriel na kurge; ni moocge jø tuuŋ Libay thuwø ki kwör kwaath buut päänye moøgø.
english: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

anywaa: Køøre päänye moøgø doo tïmö na moge, nee bëëtge yïthge, ni kwör kwaath thuwø doo tïmö na kwör kwaath jïge kiper dhäk ki dïëk ki lääc paac møga moge bëët.
english: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

anywaa: «'Ba kwöro cïpu na kwör kwaath jï jø tuuŋ Libay lak päänye, doo tägö ki røk kiiri ni cøøa wøk ŋäth päänye, ni bär mar kar kwaath man nø doo tïmö na rumme ma gööye ma kuma aciel.
english: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni ŋää kiir wøk dou rømø, ni jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wär näk rumme ma gööye ma kume ariiø, ni jï løø tier-piny ki pääny wär näk rumme ma gööye ma kume ariiø, ni løø pääny jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ wär näk rumme ma gööye ma kume ariiø, ni jï løø wï-piny ki pääny wär näk rumme ma gööye ma kume  ariiø; 'ba pääny doo ena dïër. Moøgø doo tïmö na kwör kwaath kiper lääc paac moge.
english: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

anywaa: «'Ba päänye abïciel røk päänye moo cïpu jï jø tuuŋ Libay otïmö na päänye mo gwøk røk, kiper nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø nee reŋ ya aciel røk päänye moøgø. Køøre wäru cïpu thuwø ki päänye møøk ma pïëraŋween kurriiø mo ba en røk päänye moøgø.
english: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään päänye bëët moo cïpu jï jø tuuŋ Libay doo tïmö na pïëraŋween ka abära, ni cïpu na aciel bëët ki kwör kwaath moa en lakge.
english: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye moo ci jï jø Icriel, wäru kädu ki päänye mo thööth ri tuuŋ mana dwøŋ, ni kädu ki mo nøk ri tuuŋ mana thiinh, ni cïpu ge jï jø tuuŋ Libay. Tuuŋ man nø doo cïpö røk päänye moe jï jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør kwään päänye moa en jïre.»
english: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel acäänne ki køør dwøl mana caane jï Modhe, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanyo ŋøllu Naam Jördan, ni cou yi ŋööm Keenan,
english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

anywaa: wäru jëëtu ki päänye nee bëëtge na kwör gwøk røk mou, kiper nee da ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø ni ba kame, nee reŋ ya aciel dïge.
english: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moøgø obëëdö na kwör gwøk røk jï jø wø ŋweec kwör, kiper nee dhaanhø mo ree da kwör nee ba thøøe kanyo poode ni eni kär ci kar ŋøl luup nyïm jø acooŋa.
english: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moo cïpu na abïciel yøø otïmö na päänye mo gwøk røk.
english: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

anywaa: Wär näk päänye adäk cïpu løø Naam Jördan løøi, ni cïpu adäk møøk yi ŋööm Keenan, nee tïmge na päänye mo gwøk røk.
english: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

anywaa: Päänye moøgø na abïciel yøø, otïmö na kwör gwøk røk jïïu, u na jø Icriel, ki juurre mo wø bëëdö dïïu, kiper nee ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø ni ba kame nee reŋ ya aciel dïge.
english: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk dhaanhø wati di gøø ki nywïënyö, ni ö ŋata gøøc ni thøøe, ŋata gööyö enø beeye dïnääy, ni dïnääy manøgø doo nääö.
english: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: Wala ni näk dhaanhø cere da kïdi mo løny ki man 'näk dhaanhø ki gø, ni këël wati ki gø, ni ö ŋata këël ni thøøe, ŋata këëtö enø beeye dïnääy, ni dïnääy manøgø doo nääö.
english: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: Wala ni näk cer dhaanhø da jaath mo løny ki man 'näk dhaanhø ki gø, ni gøøc wati ki gø, ni ö ŋata gøøc ni thøøe, ŋata gööyö enø beeye dïnääy, ni dïnääy manøgø doo nääö.
english: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cool kwör ki dëëre, dïnääy manøgø dee nääö; ni kany wø røømme yie ki gø jaak, dee nääö.
english: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

anywaa: Ni näk dhaanhø wati di cöörö ki køør män mana en cwïnye, wala thööra gøøni ki gïrpiny ni eno møør piny, ni thøw ŋatøce,
english: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

anywaa: wala ni näk mo dhaanhø män ki wati, ni gøøc gø ni cere ee miiø, ni thøw ŋatøce, ŋata gööyö enø doo nääö, kiper ena dïnääy. Ŋat wø cool kwör, dïnääy manøgø dee nääö kany wø røømge ki gø jaak.
english: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk dhaanhø wati di cöörö ni bäŋ män cwïnye, wala thööra gø ki gïrpiny ni kär møør piny,
english: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

anywaa: wala leeŋa kïdi bäät gø ni kuue, ni beeye kïdi mo dhaanhø thøw ki gø, ni thøw ŋatøgø; 'ba eni ba män ki gø, ni ba many man mooc dëër gø ki ŋwellø,
english: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

anywaa: jø acooŋa luum ŋatøgø ki ŋat wø cool kwör dege ŋølø ki køør ciik moøgø.
english: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

anywaa: Ni gwøkge ŋata näk ree da kwör cer ŋat wø cool kwör, ni dwøkge gø pääny mar gwøk røk kanya reŋ yie. Køøre eni doo bëëdö kaace këël mano thøw Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ŋata näk ojørø ki maara en kur keere.
english: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk ŋata näk ree da kwör cäädhö wøk ni kaal keew mar pääny gwøk røk mana näk eno reŋ yie,
english: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

anywaa: ni jooti ya ŋat wø cool kwör wøk, ni näk mo ŋat wø cool kwör ŋata näk ree da kwör ee nääö, eni bäŋ bääyö bääte.
english: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

anywaa: Kiper ŋata näk ree da kwör doo bëëdö yi pääny mar gwøk røk këël mano thøw Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba beeye køør thøw Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ keere noo døø ŋatøgø yi ŋöömma bëëde yie.
english: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

anywaa: «'Ba moøgø bëët obëëdö na ciik kiperu kwöro bëëdu yïthge këël yïth beenhnhe mou moo ööi bëët.
english: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

anywaa: «Ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø, thøø doo ŋøla bääte ki køør luup moo caan jøøa näk nutö kar kaace. 'Ba kär dee dhaanhø mo 'näk ki køør luup moo caan dhaanhø acielli.
english: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

anywaa: «Kär nou jïëy ki man lwørru jap wïïr kwör baŋ ŋat ma dïnääy mo thøø onø ŋøl bääte; ka adïëri møn, eni doo nääö.
english: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

anywaa: «Kär nou jïëy ki man lwørru jap wïïr kwör baŋ ŋata no oreŋ yi pääny gwøk røk, kiper nee døø yi ŋöömma bëëde yie ni Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ poot kär thøw.
english: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

anywaa: «'Ba ciik moøgø dou gwøø nee ŋöömö mano bëëdu yie nee ba ränynye. Kiper køny remø piny, ŋöömö di raanynyø; ni bäŋ gïn mo wëënna bääyö yi ŋöömö mo remø okøny piny yie, ni näk mo paa rem ŋata køny rem dhaanhø piny keere.
english: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

anywaa: Kär nou raanynya ŋöömö mano bëëdu yie, ni beeye kanyo bëëda yie thuwø; kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk a wø bëëdö dï jø Icriel.»
english: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø, wïth dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Gelät o Makir, ni beeye o Maneeca, jøøa käl ri dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Jocep, aöö ni cäänge nyïm Modhe ki nyïm dïbwöthe bëët moa näk wïth dhøk uudi mo Icriel,
english: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm ïïni, ï na kwääcwa en, nee ŋøøm pääŋŋï jï jø Icriel ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, nee dööŋe na moge, ïïna köömme thuwø nee kur owääwa ma Dhilöpat nee mëëgi nyïïe.
english: And they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

anywaa: Ennø, ni näk geno nywøm jiyi mo ena yi tuuŋ mør ri jø Icriel, ŋöömö mana mëëk geni na kurge okäl wøk ki ri mo wëëkwa, ni dwali ri mo tuuŋ cwøwge moa nywøm geni. Køøre thääŋ ŋöömö mana mëëk waani na marwa di kälö.
english: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

anywaa: Køøre kanyo ö cwiin wø cwøl ni Jubili ni wø gwøk jø Icrielli, ni beeye cwiin wø dwøk ŋøøm baŋ wëëkge, ŋöömö marge dwala bäät mo tuŋi mo cwøw moa nywømge. Ni ö ŋöömö marge ni käli wøk ri mana dööŋ jï tuuŋ kwäcwa.»
english: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø Icriel aköömme ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni kööe, ni «Gïna caan nyïïkwaac Jocepi beeye kare.
english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper nyïï Dhilöpat. Ena köö, ni ‹Løny jï ŋati man nø ki man nywømi ŋata manynye jaak; 'ba wär näk ge nywømma dhi øt tuuŋ wääge keere.
english: This is the thing which the Lord doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk ŋøøpo dööŋ jï jø Icriel, doo bäŋ ŋøøm mo lwør baŋ tuuŋ mør ni mëëgi tuuŋ maya, kiper ŋat Icriel man nø ŋöömö mar tuuŋ wëëkge dee gwøø.
english: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

anywaa: Dhaagø jaak mo owëënnö ki ŋøøm yïth tuŋi mo Icriel doo nywøm dïcwøø mo käla ri tuuŋ wänni, nee ŋat Icriel man nø nee ŋöömö mana wec tuuŋ wänni nee bëëde na mare.
english: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋöömö mo doo lwørø baŋ tuuŋ mør ni mëëgi tuuŋ maya, kiper tuuŋ man nø ri jø Icriel ŋöömö mana wec jïre dee gwøø.› »
english: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

anywaa: Køøre nyïï Dhilöpat gïnögø aputge tïïc, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

anywaa: Ni ö nyïï Dhilöpat, ni beege Maala, ki Tirja, ko Okila, ki Milka, ki Nöa, ni putge jïtö ki cwøw røk uut wëëkge,
english: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:

anywaa: ni ge nyöömma dhøk uudi moa käl røk nyïïkwaac Maneeca na näk o Jocep, ni ö ŋöömö mana wec jïge na marge ni put dööŋŋö na mar dhi øt tuuŋ wääge.
english: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø bëët beege ciik moa cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï jø Icriel ki ri Modhe, kanya enge pwöl Möap na en deŋ Naam Jördan na dïët ki Jerikö.
english: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege luup moa caan Modhe jï jø Icriel bëët kanya enge dï paap løø Naam Jördan, yi gool mana cwøl ni Araaba na näk dïët ki Cup, ni ge ena yïthakic kanya cwøl ni Paran ki mïëri moa cøøri ni Töpel, ki Laban, ki Adhëëröth, ki Didhaap.
english: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

anywaa: 'Ba ki man tïŋŋö ki tier Kïn Körëp, ni beeye Kïn Caynay, ni cøøa Kadëc-Bernia, ni cørra jöö mana cør tier Kïn Cëër, beeye wääth mo jïtö ki nïne apaar kurciel.
english: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh–barnea.)

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ cwiiri moa ö jø Icrielli wøk ki yi Ijep na pïëraŋween, ri dwää  apaar kurciel, yi cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ, Modhe acäänö ki jø Icriel ki køør luup bëët moa köömmi ya Wuuö Jwøki ki ge nee caane jïge.
english: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the Lord had given him in commandment unto them;

anywaa: Gïïögø acaan Modhe ni Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na bëëdö yi Ëcbön, ki Ög nyeny Baacan na bëëdö Actaröth ki Edaray, ee nø böötö.
english: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni jø Icriel ena løø Naam Jördan yi ŋööm Möap kaagø, Modhe atägö ki man pwöny geni ki ciik Jwøk, ni kööe,
english: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, acäänö ki øøni bäät Kïn Körëp, ni kööe, ni ‹Uuna nø bëëdö ki kany mo bäär lak kïdi man.
english: The Lord our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

anywaa: Ööu maal ni aayu, ni cou po jø Amör mïëya en bäät kïte, ki mïëri mo jøøa en buutge bëët moa en yi goor Naam Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, ki mïëri moa en bäät thuuri, ki moa en ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki moa en kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp, ki moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, ni ŋøøpøgø bëët beege ŋøøp jø Keenan; ni cou kanya cwøl ni Libaanø këël mano këët Upareeti na näk naam mo dwøŋ.
english: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

anywaa: Neennu, ŋöömmögø anø cïba jïïu; cou yie ni lwørru gø, ni tïme na maru, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋa kipere, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nee cïba jï kwäyu, ni beege Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, këël nyïïkwaacge moo lämmi køørge.› »
english: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aköö, na «Acaana jïïu kar kaaca, ni ‹Ba løny jïra keera ki man käära uuni.
english: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna nø tïïe nou thööth, ni dïcäŋi ennø, u thööth kaamar ceer mo maal.
english: The Lord your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu ni meet kwäännu, ni tïmu nou thööth nou kaala kwäännu ennø ki kwöre ma kuma, ni gwïëth uuni keda mana buuk gø jïïu.
english: (The Lord God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

anywaa: ?Aŋø, olønye jïra keera nidïï nø ki man käära uuni kaamar tëër, ni käära öölö maru ki pïëm maru?
english: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

anywaa: Jëëtu ki jiy mo käla wïth tuŋi mou, mo nyeŋge reegø mo wïthge leer, na jiy mo oŋïyö ki tïïc, kiper nee ge cuuma bäätu.›
english: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

anywaa: Ni løgu gø jïra ni kööu, ni ‹Gïna caanï nee tïïc enø beeye gïn mo beer.›
english: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

anywaa: «Køøre jiy moa näk dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mou, jøøa wïthge leer na näk oŋïyö ki tïïc, gena lwøra ni cuuma geni na kwääri bäätu, ni tïïa geni na kwääc lwaae mo wø käär jiy ma kuma, ki mo wø käär jiy ma dïpa, ki mo wø käär jiy ma pïërabïïc, ki mo wø käär jiy ma apaar, ni tïïa geni na kwääri kiper wïth tuŋi mou.
english: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace jøøgø ni wø ŋøl luup mou aköömma, ni kööa, ni ‹Wïnynyu luup mo wø tägi yïthakic jø pou, ni ŋøllu luup na karge mo wø tägi yïthakic dhaanhø ki nyï poge, wala jur mo bëëdö buutu.
english: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

anywaa: Käru jëëdö kany wø ŋøllu luup. Luum ŋata kare thiinh wär leŋŋu ni caala man wø leŋŋu luum ŋata kare dwøŋ. Kär näk mo u lwäära dhaanhø, kiper ŋøl luup ena baŋ Jwøk. 'Ba ni näk da luubö mo odhäthö jïïu, wär kälu baŋa. Køøre aani, luummeca wïnynya wïnynyö.›
english: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace uuna köömma ki gïïa dou tïïö bëët.
english: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

anywaa: «Køøre øøna tïŋŋö ki tier Kïn Körëp, ni aaø ki dï paaba dwøŋ na näk di lwäär ki yie, ni beeye paaba jootu, ni ø cøra jööra ci po jø Amör, na en mïëya en bäät kïte, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø na kööm øøni, ni putø pïï Kadëc-Bernia.
english: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the Lord our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh–barnea.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö jïïu, ni ‹Uuna pïï kany mo cään ki ŋööm jø Amör, na en mïëya en bäät kïte, noo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø jïïø.
english: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the Lord our God doth give unto us.

anywaa: Neennu, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ŋöömö anø cïbe jïïu. Cou yie ni lwørru gø na maru, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu jïïu. Käru lwäyö, ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu.›
english: Behold, the Lord thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

anywaa: «Køøre uuni bëët uuna ö baŋa ni kööu, ni ‹Beerra man jäägø ki jiy  nyïmmø kiper nee ŋöömö liewge jïïø, nee duuge nee luum øtjöö mana døø cør yie ki päänye moo cøø yïthge nee caange jïïø.›
english: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

anywaa: «Ni mïn yia ki gïna caannu, ni lwöta ki jiy apaar kurriiø røgu, ni ŋati man nø käla wï tuuŋ man nø.
english: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ni cige mïëya en bäät kïte ni pïïcge gool mana cwøl ni Ëcköl, ni liewge gø.
english: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

anywaa: Køøre gena lwötö ki nyïïjenni røk nyïïjenni moa no ociek yi ŋöömmece, ni kälge gø baŋø. Ni caange gïna jootge jïïø, ni köge, ni ‹Ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø jïïø beeye ŋöömö mo beer.›
english: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the Lord our God doth give us.

anywaa: «'Ba yïthu atïmö ni teek ki man cou yie, ni kwierru luum Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God:

anywaa: Ni ŋuru yïth oduŋkaare mou, ni kööu, ni ‹Kiper mana män Wuuö Jwøki ki øøni, øøna käl wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, kiper nøø cïp ceŋ jø Amör, nee wïthø dïïre.›
english: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the Lord hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

anywaa: Ni kööu, na ‹?A kaa ŋø noo cøø yie nø? Nyïïmëëgø cwïnynyø amoocge ki lwär, ni köge ni jø Amör beege jiy mo dëëtge døøŋŋø ni bäyö ni kaala øøni, ni päänye moge døøŋŋø, ni kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek ni bäyö døc. Ni köge thuwø ni wäät Anak, na näk dëëtge døøŋŋø døc, ajootge kaace.›
english: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

anywaa: «Køøre aana cäänö ki uuni ni kööa, ni ‹Kär cwïnynyu bwøk, ni ba lwäyu ki geni;
english: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni wø cäädhi nyïmmu, eni ki dëëre okëëdi kiperu, kaawat mana tïïe kiperu Ijep ki dï paap, ni nëënö jïïu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: The Lord your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enu dï paap kaace, gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ajootu, ki mana käär uuni ki kwöra caathu bëët, keda man wø ö dhaanhe wø käär wääde, ni käär uuni këël mana pïïyu kany.›
english: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the Lord thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

anywaa: «'Ba ki yïth gïïögø bëët, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu käru ŋäädhö,
english: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the Lord your God,

anywaa: ni beeye eni ni wø cäädhi nyïmmu ri wääth maru, nee kwör mo beyø manynye jïïu kiper twëëre mou. Ni beeye eni na bwøth uuni ni ena yi pöölö ki yi cäŋ bäre, ni pööllögø liel kaamar maac ki yi wäär bäre, kiper nee øtjöö mana dou cør yie nyoodhe jïïu.
english: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

anywaa: «Køøre luup moa caannu awïny Wuuö Jwøki, ni wëëre ni put kööŋ, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Bäŋ dhaanhø aciel røk jøøi ii ni en yi beenhnhø man ni raac en mo doo neen ŋöömma beer na kööŋa kipere nee cïba jï kwäyu.
english: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Kalëp o Jöpöni noo neen gø. Ni ö ŋöömma nyøøne ki tiete ni cïba gø jïre ki jï wääte, kiper mana cäädhe køør Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnye bäre.›
english: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki aani thuwø kiperu, ni kööe, ni ‹Këël ïïni, ï ba ci yi ŋöömmögø.
english: Also the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua o Nun, ni tïny ïïni enø, oci kaace. Beerra man cømï cwïnye nee bëëde ni teek, kiper eni jø Icriel otïïe nee ŋöömmögø ci jïge na marge.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

anywaa: Køøre, obwöre mou moa wäŋŋu ni di maaø ki tøŋ, ni beege wäätu moa näk poot bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge kiper gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac, geno ci kaace; ni cïba ŋöömmögø jïge, ni lwørge gø na marge.
english: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, ööu maal ni cou dï paap, nou cøra jöör wø ci Naama Kwaar.›
english: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

anywaa: «Køøre aløgu jïra ni kööu, ni ‹Waana bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba ennø, wa cøø ni këëtwa kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø na kööm øøni.› Ni ö ŋati man nø dïïu ni lwør jap leny mare, ni tïïyu gïr ciin mïëya en bäät kïte na gïn mo jööt jaak.
english: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the Lord, we will go up and fight, according to all that the Lord our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra ni caana jïïu, ni kööa, ni ‹Käru ci baŋ leny ki geni, kiper aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a ba en dïïu. Kiper ni näk mou cøø, u bööt nyïïmännu böötö.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

anywaa: Ni caana gïnögø jïïu, 'ba mara käru maar wïnynyö. Ni kwierru luum Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïm wïthu ni teek jaak, ni putu ci baŋ leny mïëya en bäät kïte.
english: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the Lord, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Amör moa bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte ni öge wøk baŋu, ni riemge uuni kaawat man wø ö kïci wø riem dhaanhø, ni nyathge uuni yïth ŋøøp Cëër këël mana këëtu paana cwøl ni Örma.
english: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

anywaa: Køøre uuna duuö ni jwöŋu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk döötu käre maar leŋ, ni  käre ïthe ciiø ki gïru.
english: And ye returned and wept before the Lord; but the Lord would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

anywaa: Køøre uuna put bëëtö yi Kadëc ki kany mo bäär, ni putu ruuö kaace jaak.
english: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.

anywaa: «Køøre øøna tïŋŋö ni cøøø dï paap ni ø cøra jöör wø ci Naama Kwaar, ni wïdø buut Kïn Cëër ki cwiiri mo thööth, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïra.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the Lord spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki aani, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Uuna nø wïdö buut kïdi man ki kany mo bäär nø. Ennø, beerra man løgu rou ni cou jï løø wï-piny,
english: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

anywaa: ni köömmï jiy ni kööï, ni «Ennø, u pöödhö ki yi ŋööm tuuŋu, ni beege nyïïkwaac Icøø na bëëdö Cëër. Geni, geno lwäyi ki uuni. 'Ba gwøgu rou døc,
english: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

anywaa: ni ba kammu geni; kiper bäŋ ŋöömö mo thiinh mo cïba jïïu røk ŋøøm moge. Këël mo thiinh mo caala kar thäny tielø bäŋgø mo cïba jïïu, kiper ŋööm Cëër, mïëya en bäät kïte, yaa nø cïp jï Icøø na mare.
english: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, løny jïïu ki man ŋëëu ki cam baŋge ki gwel, kiper nou jïtu ki gïn cammu, ni ŋëëu ki pïï thuwø baŋge ki gwel, kiper nou jïtu ki gïn maathu.» ›
english: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna gwïëdhe ki yïth tïïe mou bëët moa tïïyu. Thääyö mana thääyu ki gø dï paabi ni dwøŋ en ŋääe. 'Ba ki yïth cwiiri moi na pïëraŋween ii, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu bëëdö ka uuni, ni uuni ki dëëtu bäŋ gïn mo you canø.
english: For the Lord thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the Lord thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

anywaa: «Køøre øøna pöödhö ki buut tuuŋø, ni beege nyïïkwaac Icøø na bëëdö Cëër. Ni wiiø jöör gool mana cwøl na Araaba mana pööth Elath ki Edhiyön-Gabir, ni gaaø ni aaø ki øtjöö mana cør dï paap Möap.
english: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion–geber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Kär jø Möap miinnu, ni ba kammu geni ki leny, kiper bäŋ gïn mo cïba jïïu ri ŋöömö marge nee tïme na maru. Kiper poge na näk Ëër yaa nø cïp jï nyïïkwaac Løøt na marge.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

anywaa: «'Ba jø Ëmim bëëdö kaace dïkwøŋ, ni beege jiy mo dëëtge døøŋŋø ni kwäänge thööth, ni ge bäyö døc kaamar jø Anak.
english: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

anywaa: 'Ba ki baŋ jø Möap ge cwøl ni Ëmim, ni ki baŋ jø møøk ge cwøl ni Rapayim, ka teeŋ man wø cwøl jø Anak ki gø.
english: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

anywaa: Jø Öör beege jøøa kwøŋ bëëtö Cëër dïkwøŋ; 'ba ŋöömge akäl nyïïkwaac Icøø ceŋge, ni 'näkge ge, ni läwge karge ni pïge piny yi ŋöömge, kaawat mana tïïc jø Icrielli dëët mïëri moa ŋøøpge cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïge na moge.
english: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the Lord gave unto them.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ennø, uuni ki dëëtu ööu maal ni ŋøllu waŋ Naam Dherëët.› Køøre waŋ Naam Dherëët aŋølø.
english: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana tïŋŋø ki Kadëc-Bernia këël mana ŋølø waŋ Naam Dherëët beege cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abära ennø, këël mana thum jiyi bëët moa en yi beenhnhø manøca, ni beege jiy moa näk løny jïge ki ciin baŋ leny. Gena thum ki thøø twïër møn, kaawat mana nø kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki jïge.
english: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the Lord sware unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba cer Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni ena dëëtge ni raanynya geni twïër, këël mana thumge bëët.
english: For indeed the hand of the Lord was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya tïme ni jø leny moøgø bëët thum ki thøø yïthakic jiy,
english: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki aani, ni kööe,
english: That the Lord spake unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Dïcäŋi u pöötha wøk ki dï Ëër na näk po jø Möap.
english: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
