anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïm karu ni cään nou dïët ki ŋööm nyïïkwaac Amön, kär geni miinnu, ni ba kammu geni ki leny, kiper bäŋ gïn mo cïba jïïu røk ŋøøp nyïïkwaac Amön, kiper ŋöömmögø yaa nø cïp jï nyïïkwaac Løøt nee bëëde na marge.›
english: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

anywaa: «Ŋöömmögø beeye ŋöömö mo ŋäc ni mar juna cwøl ni Rapayim, kiper Rapayim okwøŋ bëëtö yie dïkwøŋ. 'Ba ge cwøl jø Amönni ni Jamjuma.
english: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëtge ni gena jiy mo dëëtge døøŋŋø ni kwäänge thööth, ni ge bäyö kaamar jø Anak, gena raany Wuuö  Jwøki nyïm jø Amön; ni ö jø Amönni ni kälge ŋöömge, ni läwge karge ni pïge piny yi ŋöömge.
english: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the Lord destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk gïn mo caala manøgø thuwø atïïe kiper nyïïkwaac Icøø na bëëdö Cëër, kanya raany jø Öör nyïmge. Ni ö nyïïkwaac Icøø ni kälge ŋööm jø Öör, ni läwge karge ni putge bëëtö yie këël dïcäŋi en.
english: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

anywaa: Teeŋ gïnögø thuwø atägö dëët jø Awim moa bëëdö yïth mïëri moa näk okëët Geedha. Jø Kaptör moa käl ya acuulla cwøl ni Kariit gena öö ni raanyge jø Awim, ni läwge karge ni putge bëëtö yi ŋöömge.
english: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Gaza, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ööu maal ni aayu, ni ŋøllu Naam Arnön. Ennø, Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na bëëdö Ëcbön ki paare bäre anø cïba ceŋŋu. Cou baŋe ni këëdu ki gø, ni tägu ki man lwørru ŋöömme ni tïme na maru.
english: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

anywaa: Dïcäŋi ennø, a tägö ki man kïtha cwïny jiy bëët mo bäät piny bäre ki lwär kiperu, ni tïïa geni ni ge böö ki uuni, ni kany wø wïnyge gïru, ge puta bwøk, ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi.›
english: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

anywaa: «Køøre aana jäägö ki jiy ki dï paap paana cwøl ni Kedemöth, ni jääŋŋa geni ki dwør mëër baŋ Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön, ni kööa,
english: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Beerra man wëëgï wa pöödhö ki dï ŋöömmï. Waano cäädhi ki øtjöö mana dwøŋ keere, ni wa ba doo gaa bäät cwïïcwa wala bäät cämwa.
english: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee wa jïtwa ki gïn camwa, beerra man dwøgï cam pwödhö ki waani ki gwel, ni dwøgï pïï pwödhö ki waani ki gwel kiper nee wa jïtwa ki gïn maathwa. 'Ba gïn manywa keere beeye ki man wëëgï wa pöödhö ki dï paarï,
english: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

anywaa: kaawat mana tïïc nyïïkwaac Icøø na bëëdö Cëër, ki jø Möap na bëëdö Ëër, këël mano ŋølwa Naam Jördan nee wa pïïcwa yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøwa jïwa.›
english: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God giveth us.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön kär jïëy ki man pöödhø ki dï paare, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu wï Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön adøøc mo teek, ni tïïc cwïny gø ni teek, kiper nee eni cïp ceŋŋu, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the Lord thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

anywaa: «Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni ‹Ennø, aana tägö ki man cïba Cëëwön ki paare ceŋŋu. 'Ba ennø, tägu ki man källu ŋöömme, ni putu gø lwør ni tïme na maru.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

anywaa: «Køøre Cëëwön ki jiye bëët gena put ö wøk baŋ leny ki øøni, ni røømmø ki geni kanya cwøl ni Jäc.
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø ni cïp gø ceŋŋø, ni putø eni nyath ki wääte ki jiye bëët.
english: And the Lord our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

anywaa: Kar kaace päänye moe bëët aputø mac, ni ö cwøwi ki mään ko obwöre mo päänye bëët ni nääø geni na bäre, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo obøth.
english: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa kälø keerge beege lääc paac moa maaø, ki jammi moa twierø yïth päänye moa maaø.
english: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ paac mo odhäthö jïïø, ki mana täge ka Aröör, paana en deŋ Naam Arnön, ki päänya en gool, këël mana këët ŋööm Gelät. Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø, mïëyögø bëët acïp ceŋŋø.
english: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the Lord our God delivered all unto us:

anywaa: 'Ba ø kär ci buut ŋööm nyïïkwaac Amön moa en deŋ Naam Jabök, ki päänye moge moa en mïëya en bäät kïte, këël kwöra näk ø kär kööm Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø ki man cøø yïthge.
english: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the Lord our God forbad us.

anywaa: «Køøre øøna tïŋŋö ni cørø jöör wø ci Baacan, ni ö Ög nyeny Baacan ki jiye bëët ni öge wøk baŋ leny ki øøni, ni røømmø ki geni buut päänya cwøl ni Edaray.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Kärï lwäyö ki eni, kiper eni yaa nø cïp cerï ki jiye ki ŋöömö mare bäre. Ni ö teeŋ gïna tïïyï dëër Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, na bëëdö Ëcbön, ni tïïyï gø dëëre.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø, Ög nyeny Baacan ki jiye bëët acïp ceŋŋø thuwø, ni nääø geni këël mana tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo obøth.
english: So the Lord our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace päänye moe bëët aputø mac, ni beege päänye ma pïërabïciel moa en kanya cwøl ni Argöp bäre, ni bäŋe pääny mo odööŋ mo kärø lwørø ceŋge, ni beeye ŋöömma en cer Ög nyeny Baacan.
english: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moøgø bëët beege päänye mo kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek ni bäyö, ni dhøkge ocïëgö ko odhuule, no odëëdö ki dïdëëte. Ni maaø mïëri mo thööth thuwø mo kär geerø ki kiiri.
english: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

anywaa: Ni raanynyø päänye moøgø na bäre bäre, ni nääø cwøw ki mään ko obwöre bëët moa en yïth päänye moøgø, kaawat mana tïïø dëër Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön.
english: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

anywaa: 'Ba lääc paac moge bëët, ki japa twierø yïth päänye, akälø ni tïmge na moø.
english: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaace ŋøøm alwørø ceŋ nyeye mo jø Amör moøgø na ariiø yøø, na en løø Naam Jördan løøi, ki mana täge ki Naam Arnön, këël mana këët Kïn Armön.
english: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

anywaa: 'Ba ki baŋ jø Caydan, Kïn Armön wø cwølge ni Ciriyön, ni ö jø Amör ni cwølge gø ni Canër.
english: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Senir;)

anywaa: Køøre päänye bëët moa en pwöla, ki ŋööm Gelät bäre, ki ŋööm Baacan bäre alwørø, këël mana këët Caleka ki Edaray, ni beege päänye moa bëën nyenynya cwøl ni Ög na en Baacan.
english: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba Ög nyeny Baacan, kanya poode ni eni kär thøw, beeye eni keere na no odööŋ ri juna cwøl ni Rapayim. Pëëm mare beeye pëëm nywïënyö, ni poot di joodø po nyïïkwaac Amön, päänya cwøl ni Raaba. Bäc pëëm manøgø beeye rumme abïŋween, ni dööŋ yie beeye rumme aŋween, mo røm ka cenø.
english: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaace ŋöömö alwørø, ni cïpa ki ŋøøm jï jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat. Ni ŋöömmögø tägi ka Aröör, paana en bäät Naam Arnön, na aŋuunne beeye thääŋ ŋööm Gelät, na en mïëya en bäät kïte, ki päänye moe.
english: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

anywaa: Ni ö thääŋ ŋööm Gelät mana dööŋ, ki Baacan bäre na en cer nyeya ma Ög, ni cïba gø jï thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni beeye Argöp bäre na näk ŋööm Baacan, ni wø cwøl ni ŋööm juna cwøl ni Rapayim.
english: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

anywaa: Køøre Jayer nyikwaar Maneeca ŋööm Argöp bäre akäle, këël mana këët waŋ keew mar jø Gëcur ki mar jø Maika, ni cwøl nyeŋ gø ni Mïëc Jayer ki køør nyeŋŋe, ni këël kawaane ennø Baacan poot cwøl ni Mïëc Jayer.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan–havoth–jair, unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ ŋööm Gelät mana cïba jï jø tuuŋ Maneeca, cïba jï nyïïkwaac Makir.
english: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

anywaa: Ni cïba thääŋ ŋööm Gelät maya jï jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ni beeye ki mana täge ki kaagø, këël mana këët Naam Arnön, ni keew ena dï naam. Ni keew maya mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ena tier Naam Jabök, ni beeye keew mar nyïïkwaac Amön.
english: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

anywaa: Ni keew mana en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ beeye Naam Jördan na en dï gool mana cwøl na Araaba, ni tägi ka Puur Kinërët, këël mana këët Naam Araaba, ni beeye Naam Acäbö, na en tier Kïn Pedhega.
english: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward.

anywaa: «Køøre jøøgø aköömma kar kaace, ni kööa, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ŋøøpøgø acïbe jïïu nee bëëde na mou. Ennø, u na cwøw leny bëët, beerra man ŋutu løø Naam Jördan løøga ni rou you jiiŋŋø kiper leny, ni bwøthu maal nyïm nyïïmëëgu ma jø Icriel.
english: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

anywaa: 'Ba määru ko obwöre mou ki lääc paac mou, kiper ŋääa ni jïïu da lääc paac mo thööth, geni bëët ge doo dööŋ yïth päänye mou moa cïba jïïu.
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

anywaa: 'Ba jø pou okønynyu ki leny këël mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo mooc geni ki jwöm ni tïm lenynyi ni bäŋgø, kaawat mana mooc uuni ki jwöm. 'Ba beeye këël mano kälge ŋöömö mana en løø Naam Jördan løøga noo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïge. Køøre nø, uuno døø yi ŋöömö mana cïba jïïu, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø kare.›
english: Until the Lord have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the Lord your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaaca, Jøcua aköömma ni kööa, ni ‹Gïïa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki bëët na  näk Jwøu røk nyeye moøgø na ariiø yøø, ni beege Cëëwön ki Ag, ajootï ki waŋï. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk teeŋ gïnögø otïïe dëët mïëc nyeye bëët moo cou yïthge.
english: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

anywaa: Kär nou lwäyö ki geni, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye eni kiree ni wø këëdi kiperu.›
english: Ye shall not fear them: for the Lord your God he shall fight for you.

anywaa: «'Ba aani thuwø, Wuuö Jwøk akwaaa døc kar kaaca, ni kööa,
english: And I besought the Lord at that time, saying,

anywaa: ‹Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna tägö ki man nyoothï dööŋö marï ki teek badï jïra, a na laŋŋï, kiper bäŋ teeŋ jwøk mør mo ena maal wala mo ena bäät piny mo løny jïre ki man tïïc teeŋ tïïe moøgø na døøŋŋø yøø na tïïyï ki køør teegï.
english: O Lord God, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni, wëëk a ŋut løø Naam Jördan løøga, nee ŋöömma beer na en løø Naam Jördan kaace jooda, ni beege mïëya en bäät kïte na beyø, ki kanya cwøl ni Libaanø.›
english: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki aani kiperu, ni käre mara wïnynyö. Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ‹Man rømø nø. Kärï cäŋ cäänö ki aani këët kiper luummögø.
english: But the Lord was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the Lord said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

anywaa: Ö maal ni ciï wï Kïn Pedhega, ni tïŋï wïïï maal ni neenï jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki jï løø wï-piny ki jï løø tier-piny, ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni neenï gø ki waŋï, kiper ï ba ŋut løø Naam Jördan løøga këët.
english: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kööm Jøcua, ni cømï cwïnye nee bëëde ni teek, kiper beeye eni noo ŋut løøga noo cäädhi nyïm jøøi na bwödhi, kiper nee ŋöömö mano neenï enø nee ci jïge na marge.›
english: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

anywaa: Køøre øøna dööŋ yi gool mana dïët ki päänya cwøl ni Bëëth-Pëëgör.»
english: So we abode in the valley over against Beth–peor.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aköö, ni «Ennø, u na jø Icriel, beerra man leŋŋu ciik ki luup ŋøl mo Wuuö Jwøk mo pwönynya uuni ki ge, kiper nee kïthu bäät tïïc, kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw nou cou yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu jïïu, nee lwørru na maru.
english: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers giveth you.

anywaa: Kär dee luubö mo meedu bäät luup mo köömma uuni ki geni, ni kär dee luubö mo kälu wøk røkge thuwø, ni gwøgu luup Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu mo köömma uuni ki geni.
english: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.

anywaa: Gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëët jøøa caath køør jwøa cwøl ni Baal-Pëëgör ri Kïn Baal-Pëëgör ajootu ki nyeŋŋu. Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu jøøgø anääe dïïu.
english: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal–peor: for all the men that followed Baal–peor, the Lord thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni bëët na göök dëër Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, u poot bëëdö nou kwøw këël dïcäŋi en.
english: But ye that did cleave unto the Lord your God are alive every one of you this day.

anywaa: «Ennø, uuna pwönynya ki ciik ki luup ŋøl kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøa na kööm aani, kiper nee geni kïthu bäät tïïc yi ŋöömö mano cou yie noo lwørru na maru.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the Lord my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

anywaa: Beerra man gwøgu geni ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc, kiper gïnögø tïmö na gïn mo nyootha leec wïc maru ki ŋäc acaara jï jiy bëët. Ni kanyo ö jiyi noo wïnyge gïr ciik moi, geno kööi, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, wï juni ni dwøŋ en beege jiy mo wïthge leer ni wïthge da acaara.›
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da wï jur mørø mo dwøŋ mo jïge da jwøk mo kare cään ki geni, kaamar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø ni wø kare cään ki øøni, ni wø wïny lam marø kany wø kwaaø gø?
english: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the Lord our God is in all things that we call upon him for?

anywaa: ?Wala da wï jur mør mo dwøŋ mo jïge da ciik ki luup ŋøl mo caala ciik moi ni beyø ii ni cïba jïïu dïcäŋi en?
english: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, gwøgu rou døc, ni bëëdu ni rou you koorø, kiper nee wïthu ba wïlge ki gïïa neennu ki nyeŋŋu, nee gïïge ba rwäänyge cwïnynyu ki yïth nïr kwøw mou bëët. 'Ba gïno tïïyu beeye ki man pwönynyu obwöre mou ki nyïïkwaayu ki geni nee ŋäcge.
english: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;

anywaa: Kär wïthu wïl ki dïcäŋa cuŋŋu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu tier Kïn Körëp, kanya kööe ki aani, ni ‹Cooŋ jiy kanya ciel buuta, kiper nee ge wëëga wïny luupa, kiper nee ge kwänyge ki bëët lwär mana dege a lwäärö ki gø ki yïth nïr kwøw moge bëët moo beetge bäät  piny, kiper nee obwöre moge pwönyge thuwø.›
english: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the Lord thy God in Horeb, when the Lord said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

anywaa: Køøre uuna ö buut kïdi, ni cuŋŋu tiere, ni tïm pinynyi ni cøl ni jïte ki pöölö mo odhïŋ mo cøl døc, ni put maaci liel bäät kïdi, ni ö leep maaci ni pïïe maal døc.
english: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki uuni ni eni ena dï maac. Dwøl mana caan luup ki gø awïnynyu, ni bäŋ dëël mo you neenø; 'ba beeye dwøl keere na wïnynyu.
english: And the Lord spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

anywaa: Køøre luumma tuude ki uuni na kööm uuni ki gø nee kïthu bäät tïïc acaane jïïu, ni beege ciik moa näk apaar. Ni göör geni piny bäät opäp kïte ariiø.
english: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

anywaa: Kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk aana köömme ki man pwönynya uuni ki ciik ki luup ŋøl, kiper nee kïthu bäät tïïc yi ŋöömö mano cou yie noo lwørru na maru.
english: And the Lord commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋa cään Wuuö Jwøki ki uuni bäät Kïn Körëp ni eni ena dï maac, kar kaaca bäŋ gïn mo you joodø mo caala dëël. Kiper manøgø nø, beerra man gwøgu rou døc,
english: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the Lord spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

anywaa: kiper nou ba tïïu ki gïï mo kännö ki raay, ni beeye ki man tëëŋŋu dëëtu ki kït gïrpiny jaak mo kïte caala kït dïcwøø wala kït dhaagø, nee lammu;
english: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

anywaa: ni ba tëëŋŋu dëëtu ki kït gïrpiny mo kïte caala kït lääy mo bëëdö bäät piny, wala kït wenyø ni wø määdö maal;
english: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

anywaa: wala kït gïrpiny mo muulö bäät ŋøøm, wala kït rëëö ni wø en naam.
english: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø raŋŋu maal, nou jootu cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer, ni wø en maal, gwøgu rou nee wïthu ba maaŋŋi ki man tïme nou lama geni ni tïnynyu geni. Kiper gïïögø beege gïïa cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jï jiy bëët moa en bäät piny.
english: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the Lord thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk uuna lwøre ni käl uuni wøk ki Ijep na näk caala këën thäth mo liel, kiper nou tïmu ni uuna jiy moa näk thööge, kaawat man bëëdu dïcäŋi ennø.
english: But the Lord hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki aani kiperu, ni put kööŋ ni aani Naam Jördan ba daa ŋølø na bäre bäre, naa ba løny thuwø ki man cøøa yi ŋöömma beer mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu na maru.
english: Furthermore the Lord was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

anywaa: Kiper aani, a thøøa yi ŋöömmi en, naa ba løny ki man ŋøla Naam Jördan. 'Ba uuni, uuno ŋut løøga, ni lwørru ŋöömmece ni beer ice.
english: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gwøgu rou kiper nee wïthu ba wïlge ki gïna tuut Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ki uuni, ni ba tëëŋŋu dëëtu ki kït gïrpiny mo kïte caala kït gïn mør jaak, mo uuno kööm Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu kiperge, ni kär tïïyu.
english: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the Lord thy God hath forbidden thee.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye Jwøk ma ŋat keec, ni caala maac ni wø thöör jiy.
english: For the Lord thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïme ni uuno nø bëëtö ki kany mo bäär yi ŋöömmo cou yie, ni uuno jïtö ko obwöre ki nyïïkwaayu, kär dee gïï mo kännö ki raay mo tïïyu, ni beeye ki man tëëŋŋu dëëtu ki kït gïn mør jaak nee lammu, ni beeye gïn mo nëëni ni raac ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, nou cwaata yie këël mano wëëre.
english: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the Lord thy God, to provoke him to anger:

anywaa: Dïcäŋi en maal ki piny otïmö ni beege gïïo ŋäc luummi en yïthakiyø ki uuni kiper gïno raac noo pïï dëëtu. Ni näk gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki ba leŋŋu, u laara thumö kany mo cään en wï ŋöömö mano cou yie nee lwørru na maru løø Naam Jördan løøga. U ba bëëdö ki kany mo bäär yi ŋöömö manøgø këët, 'ba u put ka thöör na bäre bäre.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk uuno keethe dï wïth juurre, ni dööŋŋu nou nøk yïthakic wïth juurre moo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo riem uuni dïge.
english: And the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the Lord shall lead you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno tïmö nou tïnynya juu møøk moa tïïc jiyi ki ceŋge kaace, ni beege jenni ki kïte mo otieŋø na juu, ni juu mo ba rääŋö, mo ba wïnyö, mo ba cämö, ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋwääi jïge.
english: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu omanynyu kanyo enu kaace, 'ba eno jootu kanyo näk mo eni you manynyø ki cwïnynyu ki jwïëyu bäre.
english: But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

anywaa: 'Ba yi nyïme, kanyo tïme ni gïïögø bëët opïï bäätu, nou ena yïth gïï mo leth, uuno døø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni leŋŋu dwøre.
english: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the Lord thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye Jwøk mo yie bäth; u ba wiie, u ba raanynye, ni wïïe  ba wïl ki luumma tuude na kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu.
english: (For the Lord thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, pëënynyu rou døøc, ni cädu kiper cwiiri moa cääŋŋe moa dïkwøŋ cøøn, ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa ö Jwøki na cwääc dhaanhø bäät piny; ni pëënynyu piny bäre, ki mano täge ki buut piny man nø këël mano këët man nø. ?Aŋø, da teeŋ gïn mo dwøŋ mo otïïö mo caala man en na tïïc Jwøki kiperu? ?Wala da teeŋ gïn mo owïnyö mo caala teeŋ gïnögø?
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?

anywaa: ?A da jiy mo owïny dwør Jwøk ni cäänö ki geni ni eni ena dï maac, ni bøthge ki thøø, kaawat maru na wïny gø nou poot bëëdö nou kwøw en?
english: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a jwøa ŋø na päär gø ki man kääde ki wï jur kiper dëëre dï wï jur mør, kaawat mana tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu kiperu Ijep, na käl u wøk ki køør päärö mo teek, ki ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec, ki køør leny ki teek bade ki teek mare na dwøŋ, ki gïïa døøŋŋø na tïïe na kännö ki lwär, na jootu ki nyeŋŋu?
english: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø anyooth jïïu kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk ŋäyu, ni beeye eni na Jwøk keere, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët.
english: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the Lord he is God; there is none else beside him.

anywaa: Ena cäänö ni eni ena maal, ni wëëk uuni wïny dwøre ni pwönynya uuni; ni nyooth maac mare na dwøŋ jïïu, ni wïnynyu luup moe ki dï maac bäät piny.
english: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na mëëre ki kwäyu, eni nyïïkwaacge ajiere, ni ö eni ki dëëre ni käl uuni wøk ki dï Ijep ki køør teek mare.
english: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wïth juurre mo døøŋŋø geni ki uuni, moa näk jïge da teek mo kaala teek maru, ariem wøk nyïmmu, kiper nee ŋöömö marge cïbe jïïu, nou kïth yie, nee ci jïïu na maru, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, gïn wär ŋäyu dïcäŋi ennø, ni kïthu gø cwïnynyu, ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk ni en maal bäre, ni en bäät piny bäre, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør.
english: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the Lord he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu ciik moe ki gïïa kööm uuni ki ge mo caana jïïu dïcäŋi en, kiper uuni ki wäätu moo ööi køøru, nou jïtu ki bëëtö mo beer, ni tïm nïr kwøw mou ni thööth yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu nee tïme na maru na bäre bäre.»
english: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, for ever.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe päänye adäk ajiere løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, nee bëëtge ni ena kur keerge,
english: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

anywaa: kiper nee ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø nee wø reŋ kaace, ni beeye ŋat mo wati ee nääö ni ba kame, ni bäŋ gïr män mo ena cwïnye ki gø dïkwøŋ. Teeŋ ŋatøgø løny jïre ki man reŋ yi pääny aciel røk päänye moøgø, kiper nee kwøe.
english: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moøgø na adäk yøø beege Böcör na en dï paap bäät thuur, yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö na näk mar jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki Ramöth na en Gelät na näk mar jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki Gölan na en yi ŋööm Baacan na näk mar jø tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace Modhe ciik Wuuö Jwøk acïp nyïm jø Icriel,
english: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

anywaa: ni beege pwöc ki ciik ki luup ŋøl moa caane jï jø Icriel kanya nø öge wøk ki Ijep.
english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca geno løny ni ge ena løø Naam Jördan yi gool mana dïët ki Bëëth-Pëëgör na en yi ŋööm Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na bëëdö yi Ëcbön. Nyenynyøgø abööt Modhe ki jø Icriel kanya nø öge wøk ki Ijep.
english: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth–peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ŋööm nyeya ma Cëëwön ki ŋööm Ög nyeny Baacan, alwørge, ni beege nyeye ariiø mo jø Amör moa en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ;
english: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

anywaa: ni ŋöömmögø tägi ka Aröör, paana en deŋ Naam Arnön, këël mana këët Kïn Ciriyön, ni beeye Armön.
english: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

anywaa: Ni kälge gool bäre mana cwøl na Araaba na en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mana këët Naam Araaba na en tier Kïn Pedhega.
english: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø Icriel bëët acwøle, ni kööe, «U na jø Icriel, cegu ïthu  ni wïnynyu ciik ki luup ŋøl moo caana jïïu dïcäŋi en. Pwönynyu rou ki geni, ni gwøgu geni døc, ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc.
english: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø atudö ki luubö ki øøni tier Kïn Körëp ni beeye Kïn Caynay.
english: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk luummögø käre tuudö ki kwäyø moa cääŋŋe, 'ba atuude ki øøni bëët, ø ni poot kwøw kany dïcäŋi en.
english: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki uuni ki dëëtu ki bäät kïdi ni dwøre cura dï maac.
english: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

anywaa: Kar kaaca aana cuŋŋö yïthakiyu ki Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nee dwør Wuuö Jwøk køba jïïu, kiper mana lwäyu ki maac, nou kär eth bäät kïdi.
english: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

anywaa: «Køøre ena köö: ni ‹Beeye a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, paana näk po laŋ.
english: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dee juu møøk jïrï këët nyïma.
english: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

anywaa: « ‹Kär dëërï tëëŋŋï ki kït gïn mør jaak, mo caala kït gïrpiny mo ena maal, wala mo ena bäät piny, wala mo ena yi naam.
english: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

anywaa: Kär geni lamï, ni ba tïnynyï geni, kiper aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï, aana Jwøk ma ŋat keec, ni jø wø män ki aani, gïïa bacge kïtha bäät obwöre moge ni jääla geni këël dää beenhnhe, ni put pïï ri ŋweer beenhnhe.
english: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø mëër ki aani ni wø gwøk ciik 'moa, mëëya ni wø ba jøøl nyoodha nyoodhø jïge këël mano pïïe ri jiy ma kum kum.
english: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

anywaa: « ‹Kär nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï cwølï jaak, kiper ŋat wø cwøl nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki jaak ba doo wec Wuuö Jwøki ka ajäla.
english: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

anywaa: « ‹Gwøk cäŋ jwömö, nee bëëde ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøï na kööm ïïni.
english: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.

anywaa: Tïïï ki nïne abïciel, ni tïïyï tïïe moa diï tïïö bëët ki yïth nïne moøgø.
english: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

anywaa: 'Ba bïriet nïne beeye cäŋ jwömö jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï. Kär dee gïn mo tïïyï dïcäŋöce, ïïni wala wäädï wala nyaarï, wala ŋat tïïc marï ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø, wala rwaath marï wala arëën marï wala lääy mør røk lääc paac moï, wala wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö ka ïïni, kiper nee ŋat tïïc marï mana näk dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø nee ree jwöme kaawat marï.
english: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

anywaa: Caar wïïï ki mana bëëdï ni ïïna laŋŋø yi ŋööm Ijep, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøï ni käl ïïni wøk kaace ki køør teek bade ki teek mare na dwøŋ. Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï ïïna köömme ki man gwøgï cäŋ jwömö.
english: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

anywaa: « ‹Wøør wäru ki meru, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøï na kööm ïïni, kiper nee nïr kwøw moï thöönhge, ni jïtï ki bëëtö mo beer thuwø yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
english: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø.
english: Thou shalt not kill.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï kännö ki luk.
english: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï kwätö.
english: Neither shalt thou steal.

anywaa: « ‹Kärï cäänö ki tööt dëër wadu.
english: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

anywaa: « ‹Kär cwïnyï pädhö kiper cï wadu, ni ba päl cwïnyï ki øt wadu, wala pwödhö mare, wala ŋat tïïc mare ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø, wala rwaath mare wala arëën mare; këël gïn mør jaak mo mar wadu, kär cwïnyï päl kipere.›
english: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk luup moøgø acaane jïïu ni dwøre ena maal, kanya bëëdu ni dëëtu you cooŋ kanya ciel bëët tier kïdi, ni eni ena dï maac, yi pöölö yi  muudhö mo cøl døc, ni bäŋe mør mo ee meet bäätge. Ni göör geni bäät opäp kïte ni mëëk gø aani.
english: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

anywaa: «Køøre kanya wïnynyu dwøl ki dï muunhnha cøl, ni maac liel bäät kïdi, dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mou bëët ki jø døøŋŋø mou gena ö baŋa.
english: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

anywaa: Ni caange döötu jïra, ni köge, ni ‹Ennø, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø ajieme ki dööŋŋe anyoodhe jïwa, ni wïnywa dwøre ki dï maac. Dïcäŋi ajootwa møn ni këël Jwøk doo cäänö ki dhaanhø, poot løny jï dhaanhø ki man bëëde ni kwøw.
english: And ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø ni pootwa ni wa manynya thøø en? Kiper maac man ni dwøŋ en wa thööre thöörö; ni näk dwør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø poot cäŋwa ka wïnynyö, wa thøw.
english: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a ŋata ŋa dëët jø bäät piny bëët na wïny dwør Jwøa kwøw ni cäänö ki dï maac, kaamar waani na wïny gø, ni poot bëëdö ni kwøw?
english: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

anywaa: Ïïni, nyiik buut Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø, ni wïnynyï gïïo caane bëët. Køøre gïïo caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø jïrï bëët ocaanï jïwa. Køøre leŋwa leŋø, ni tïïcwa geni.›
english: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk luup moa caannu awïnynye kanya cäänu ki aani. Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni ‹Luup moa caan jøøgø jïrï awïnynya. Gïïa caange bëët beege luup mo beyø.
english: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

anywaa: 'Ba doo na ge puta bëëtö ki cwïny ma enøgønø na bëëde, ni ge lwäär ki aani ni ciik 'moa gwøkge gwøø cooth, doo beer; køøre geni ko obwöre moge ge doo jïtö ki bëëtö mo beer na bäre bäre.
english: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ciï ni caanï gø jïge nee døøge kwör bëëte moge yïth oduŋkaare.
english: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, cuŋŋï buuta kany, nee ciik ki luup ŋøl ki gïïa kööm u ki ge bëët moo pwönynyï geni ki ge nee caana jïrï, kiper nee gwøkge yi ŋöömmo cïba jïge na marge.› »
english: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

anywaa: «'Ba u na jø Icriel, Gwøgu rou, ni kïthu ciik moøgø bäät tïïc kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na kööm uuni. Käru gaa wøk bäät cwïyu wala bäät cämmu.
english: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

anywaa: Cäädhu ki køør ciik bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na kööm uuni ki ge, kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw, nou jïtu ki bëëtö mo beer, ni ö cwiiri mou ni thöönhge yi ŋöömmo lwørru na maru.
english: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

anywaa: «'Ba ciik moi beege ciik ki luup ŋøl moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na kööm aani ki geni kiper nou pwönynya ki geni, nee kïthu bäät tïïc yi ŋöömmo cou yie nou lwørru na maru,
english: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

anywaa: kiper nee uuni ki wäätu ki nyïïkwaayu nee Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu nee lwääru, ni ö ciiki moe moa köömma uuni ki geni ni gwøgu geni ki yïth nïr kwøw mou bëët, kiper nee nïr kwøw mou tïmge ni thööth.
english: That thou mightest fear the Lord thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu gïï, ni gwøgu ge døc ki man kïthu geni bäät tïïc, kiper nou jïtu ki bëëtö mo beer, ni nyaayu ni tïmu nou thööth yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, kaawat mana buugi ya Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu jïïu.
english: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the Lord God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu gïn. Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø beeye eni keere na Jwøk;
english: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord:

anywaa: niï doo mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï ki cwïnyï bäre, ki jwïëyï bäre, ki teegï bäre.
english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moi ni köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en dou lääŋŋö ki cwïnynyu,
english: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

anywaa: ni pwönynyu obwöre mou ki geni døc, ni bëëdu nou cara gïrge cooth kany wø pïïu piny mïëyu, ki kany wø cäädhu jöö, ki kany wø nyaaŋŋu dëëtu piny ki kany wø päyu.
english: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

anywaa: Ni tïmge ni ge caala nyuudhi mo you twöö ceŋŋu, ni bëëtge kaamar gööre mo ena täärnyïmmu mo wïthu ba wïl ki geni.
english: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

anywaa: Ni gööru geni dhøk uudi mou ki dhøk käälle mou.
english: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

anywaa: «'Ba yi nyïme Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuno kïth yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jï kwäyu ma Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, kiper nee mëëk uuni, ni beeye ŋöömö mo yie da päänye mo døøŋŋø mo beyø mo ba geera uuni;
english: And it shall be, when the Lord thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

anywaa: ni yie  da uudi mo päŋ ki jammi mo beyø mo ba kïtha uuni yïthge, ki ïïdhi mo ba koonya uuni, ka ajïniine mo yïthge da nyïïjenni mo perge leth mo ba piitha uuni; ni cämu ni jäŋŋu.
english: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

anywaa: 'Ba noo jootu gïïögø bëët, gwøgu rou ni ba wïl wïthu ki Wuuö Jwøk na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep na näk po laŋ.
english: Then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

anywaa: «Bëëdu nou lwäära Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni tïnynyu eni, ni kööŋŋu ri nyeŋŋe keere.
english: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

anywaa: Kär dee juu møøk mo cäädhu køørge, ni beege juuk jøø en buutu yøø,
english: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ni en dïïu enø beeye Jwøk ma ŋat keec. Ni näk mou cäädhö køør juu møøk, wëëc Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu puta liel dëëtu kaamar maac, ni thöör uuni bäät ŋøøm.
english: (For the Lord thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the Lord thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

anywaa: Kär Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu päänynyu, kaawat mana päänynyu gø kanya cwøl ni Maca.
english: Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.

anywaa: 'Ba ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu dou gwøø døc, ki pwöc moe, ki luup moa kööm uuni ki geni.
english: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

anywaa: Ni tïïu ki gïn mo beer mo tiir nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nou jïtu ki bëëtö mo beer, kiper nou cou ni lwørru ŋöömma beer na kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere jï kwäyu,
english: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the Lord: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers,

anywaa: ni riemu nyïïmännu wøk bëët, kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the Lord hath spoken.

anywaa: «'Ba yi nyïme, kanyo ö obwöre mou noo pëënyge uuni ni köge, ni ‹?Pwöc ki ciik ki luup ŋøl moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø na kööm uuni ki geni, gwøkwa ge kiperŋø?›
english: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the Lord our God hath commanded you?

anywaa: køøre ocaannu jï obwöre mou ni kööu, ni ‹Waana kwøŋ bëëtö na laaŋe jï Peerø yi Ijep; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk waana käl wøk ki teek bade.
english: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec mo døøŋŋø mo leth bäät Ijep ki nyenyge ma Peerø ki paare bäre, ni nëënö jïwa ki nyeŋwa.
english: And the Lord shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk waana käl wøk ki kaace, kiper nee wa kïth yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jï kwäyø, nee cïbe jïïø.
english: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kööm waani ki man gwøkwa ciik moøgø bëët, ni kööm waani ki man lwäärwa eni na Jwøø, kiper nøø jïtø ki bëëtö mo beer ni bëëdø nøø kwøw, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: And the Lord commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the Lord our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk wïthø yøø koorø, ni gwøø ciik moi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø, kaawat mana kööm øøni, marø doo tïmö ni beer nyïme.›
english: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the Lord our God, as he hath commanded us.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu u kïthe yi ŋöömmo cou yie nou lwørru na maru, ni riem wïth juurre mo thööth wøk nyïmmu, ni beege jø Këth ki jø Gërgëca ki jø Amör ki jø Keenan ki jø Përec ki jø Ëwi ki jø Jeebuc, ni beege wïth juurre abïriiø mo thöötha geni ki uuni mo kaala uuni ki teek.
english: When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo cïp geni ceŋŋu, ni böötu geni, ge wäru putu raanynyø na bäre bäre. Kär dee gïn mo tuutu ki geni, ni ba päth cwïnynyu ki gïrge.
english: And when the Lord thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

anywaa: Kär røgu nywømmu ki geni. Kär nyïïu cïpu jïge nee nywøm wäätge, ni ba källu nyïïge nee nywøm wäätu.
english: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

anywaa: Kiper obwöre mou bwøthge wøk ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïmge ni ge tïnynya juu møøk. Køøre wëëc Wuuö Jwøk liel dëëtu kaamar maac, ni ö eni ni laar u thöör.
english: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna dou tïïö dëëtge beeye ki man raanynyu gïï wø cïpge olämme moge bäätge, ni tøgu kïte moa näk ege cwöth piny kiper nee lamge, ni ŋødu jenni moge piny moa näk ege tieŋø ni wø lamge, ni ö gïïa näk ege tieŋø na juu ni waaŋu geni ki maac.
english: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët dou tïïö kiper uuna jiy mo ena kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna jiere nou tïmu ni uuna thööge dï jiy bëët moa en bäät piny.
english: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk tier mëër mana mëëre ki uuni na jier uuni paa kiper mana thööth kwäännu ki kwään jiy møga, kiper nøka kwäännu røk with  juurre bëët.
english: The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

anywaa: 'Ba uuna jiere kiper mana mëëre ki uuni jaak, ni eni manynya man gwøk gïna kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu; ni beeye tiere gø na käl uuni wøk ki teek bade, ni pät uuni yi bëët laŋ, ni käl uuni wøk cer Peerø nyeny Ijep.
english: But because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, wär ŋäyu ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye eni na Jwøk keere, ni ena Jwøk mo maar ka ŋääth; ni luumma tuude, ki mëëye ni wø ba jøøl, bëëdö ni gwøe gwøø ki yïth beenhnhe ma kume mo ba løny ki kwaan jï jø wø mëër ki eni ni wø gwøk ciik moe.
english: Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

anywaa: 'Ba kwöre wø coole coolø dëët jø wø män ki eni, ni put wïthge dïïr. Eni ba ruu ki man cool kwöre dëër ŋat wø män ki eni.
english: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, gwøgu ciik ki luup ŋøl moi ni köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en, ki man kïthu geni bäät tïïc.
english: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

anywaa: «'Ba gïno tägi, ni näk ciik moi leŋu leŋø, ni gwøgu geni ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu luumma tuude na kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu, ki mëëye ni wø ba jøøl, gwøe gwøø kiperu.
english: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the Lord thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni mëër ki uuni ni gwïëth uuni ni wëëk uuni nyaay; obwöre mou moo nywøllu ogwïëdhe, ni gwïëth caammi moo ciek yïth ŋøøm mou, ni gwïëth dhäk mou ki dïëk mou, ni tïmge ni thööth yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jï kwäyu nee cïbe jïïu.
english: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno gwïëth ni tïmu nou kaala jiy bëët ki gwïëth; ni bäŋ dïcwøø wala dhaagø mo tïmö na bwøc dïïu, ni tïme ni bäŋ thwønh wala maath ma bwøc røk lääc paac mou.
english: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk täwe bëët paanye paanyø bäätu; ni ba kïth bäätu ki teeŋ täwe moa leth na ŋäyu Ijep. 'Ba täwe okïth bäät jiy bëët mo wø män ki uuni.
english: And the Lord will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

anywaa: Jiy bëët moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ceŋŋu wär putu thöör, ni ba päth cwïnynyu ki gïrge; ni ba tïnynyu juu moge, kiper noo tïnynyu ge, puta tïmö ni caala abïëp kiperu.
english: And thou shalt consume all the people which the Lord thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

anywaa: «'Ba kanymør u köö ki cwïnynyu, ni ‹Wïth juurre moi thöötha geni ki øøni. ?Olønye jïïø nidïï ki man böötø geni ni lwørø ŋöömö marge?›
english: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

anywaa: Käru lwäyu ki geni. 'Ba beerra man caarru wïthu døc ki gïïa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu dëër Peerø ki yi Ijep bäre,
english: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the Lord thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

anywaa: ni beege gïïa leth døc na jootu ki nyeŋŋu, ki ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec moa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ki teek bade ki teek mare na dwøŋ kanya käl uuni wøk. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu teeŋ gïïögø thuwø otïïe dëët jiy bëët moo lwäyu ki geni.
english: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the Lord thy God brought thee out: so shall the Lord thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu piini ojääŋŋe dï jøøgø, këël mano thum jiyi mo obøth no okaan dëëtge.
english: Moreover the Lord thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

anywaa: Kär dëëtu kwanynyi ni maru lwäär ki geni, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu nutö buutu, ni beeye Jwøk mo dwøŋ mo di lwäärö.
english: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the Lord thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, wïth juurre moøgø oriem wøk nyïmmu mëëth mëëth, ni ba laaru wïthge dïïr bëët, kiper nee lääc paap ba nyaacge töök mïëyu.
english: And the Lord thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu jøøgø ocïp ceŋŋu ni mooc geni ki böök ni jït wïthge ko okiera, këël mano thumge bëët.
english: But the Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nyeye moge ocïp ceŋŋu, ni putu nyeŋge tïïc ni kuc bäät ŋøøm, ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo maar lønyø jïre ki man cuŋŋe nyïmmu kany wø näk ri leny, këël mano thöörru geni na bäre.
english: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa tieŋge na juu moge dou waaŋø ki maac. 'Ba kär dee gïn manynyu ri warkey wala gwel-bïrö mana näk oleeny dëëtge, ni ba kädu rege kiper dëëtu, nee ba tïmge ni caala abïëp kiperu, kiper gïïögø beege gïï mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yie raac ki ge døc.
english: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the Lord thy God.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn mo Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki gø mo kïthu yïth uudi mou; kiper ni näk mo you tïïö, acïëni mana en bääte ööa bäätu. 'Ba u doo männö ki teeŋ gïïögø, ni bëëdu ni yïthu reyø ki ge, kiper acïën Wuuö Jwøk ena bäätge, ni beege gïï mo di raanynyø na bäre bäre.
english: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

anywaa: «'Ba ciik moi bëët ni köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en, beerra man koorru wïthu ki ge, ni kïthu ge  bäät tïïc, kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw nou nyaayu, nou cou yi ŋöömma kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere nee cïbe jï kwäyu, ni lwørru gø na maru.
english: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba wïthu wär caarru ki jöö mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na käär uuni ki gø dï paap ki yïth cwiiri moi na pïëraŋween ii. Wuuö Jwøk gïï mo leth akäl bäätu, kiper nou pwönynye, kiper nou päänynye, nee gïna en cwïnynyu nee ŋääe, ki man näk mo ciik moe gwøgu gwøø wala ba gwøgu.
english: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna pwönynye nou näk käci, ni cäŋ u caammø ki møga cwøl ni meena, ni beeye cam mo kuyu dïkwøŋ ni kuc kwäyu thuwø. Gïnögø atïïe kiper nee ŋäyu ni dhaanhø ba doo kwøw ka cam keere, 'ba eni wø kwøw ka luup bëët mo wø ööi ki dhi Jwøk.
english: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the Lord doth man live.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth cwiiri moi na pïëraŋween ii, abïïe moa en dëëtu kär ränynyö, ni tietu kär kwöt ki wääth.
english: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

anywaa: Køøre nø, dou ŋääö ki cwïnynyu ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, mare beeye pwöc ki uuni, kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø pwöny wääde.
english: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the Lord thy God chasteneth thee.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, gwøgu ciik Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni cäädhu køøre, ni lwäärru eni.
english: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu u kïthe yi ŋöömö mo beer, mo yie da näm ki jøør ki nyeŋŋi mo kwödö ki dï gøli ki yïthakic kïte.
english: For the Lord thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋöömö mo caammi ma teeŋi, ki jenni mo nyïïge di camø, ciek yie. Ni yie da maar kïc ki jenni mo nyïïge di tïïö na mädhi.
english: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋöömö mo u cämö yie ki cam mo päl, ni bäŋ gïn cannu. Ni kïte moe yïthge da nywïëny, ni løny jïïu ki man kuunyu jwëëlli wøk ki ri kïte moe.
english: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïme ni uuno nø jäŋö ki cam, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu dou pwøø kiper ŋöömma beer na cïbe jïïu.
english: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the Lord thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu dëëtu ni ba wïl wïthu ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni ba kääŋu ki man gwøgu ciik moe ki luup ŋøl moe mo köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en.
english: Beware that thou forget not the Lord thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø cämu ni jäŋŋu, ni gëëdu ki uudi mo beyø ni bëëdu yïthge,
english: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

anywaa: ni ö pïïth dhäki mou ki pïïth dïëk mou ni nyaacge, ni tïm warkeyi ki gwel-bïrö ni päl jïïu, ni tïm jammi mou bëët ni thööth,
english: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

anywaa: rou wär gwøgu, ni ba jït cwïnynyu ka atöör, ni ba wïl wïthu ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep na näk po laŋ.
english: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the Lord thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk uuna bwødhe ki dï paap mo dwøŋ mo di lwäärö ki yie, mo yie da thwöre mo reyø, ka agarapi; ni beeye kany mo yie da køø, mo pïï ba joot yie; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk pïï akäl wøk ki ri kïnna teek døc kiperu.
english: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni caam uuni dï paap ki møga cwøl ni meena, ni beeye møø mo kuc kwäyu dïkwøŋ. Wuuö Jwøk gïï mo leth akäl bäätu, kiper nou pwönynye, kiper nou päänynye, nee tïïe jïïu ki gïn mo beer ya aŋuudi.
english: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

anywaa: Kanymør u köö ki cwïnynyu, ni ‹Beeye riek waŋ marwa ki teek bäätwa na tïïc japi ni thööth ii jïwa.›
english: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

anywaa: Patha eni. Ŋata dou cädö kipere beeye Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, kiper beeye eni ni wø mooc uuni ki teek ki man jïtu ki jap kwärö, kiper nee luumma tuude na kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu nee nyoodhe jïïu na adïëri, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

anywaa: «'Ba mara caana caanø jïïu dïcäŋi ennø. Ni näk mo wïthu wïl ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni caathu køør juu møøk, ni tïnynyu geni, ni lammu geni, u puta thumö na bäre bäre.
english: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

anywaa: Kaawat mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo thöör wïth juurre mo en nyïmmu, uuni thuwø u di thöörö, kiper mana käru dwør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu leŋø.
english: As the nations which the Lord destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the Lord your God.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu gïn. Dïcäŋi karu cään ki man ŋutu løø  Naam Jördan løøga, nou cou nee wïth juurre mo døøŋŋø geni ki uuni, moa näk jïge da teek mo kaala maru, nee riemu wøk, këël na bëëde ni jïge da päänye mo døøŋŋø, ni kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek ni bäyö.
english: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø beege jiy mo dëëtge døøŋŋø mo bäyö ni beege nyïïkwaac Anak, jøøa ŋäyu na gïrge wïnynyu kanya købi, na ‹?Aŋa ni maar cuŋŋö nyïm nyïïkwaac Anak?›
english: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ŋäyu gø dïcäŋi, ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye noo ŋut løøga nyïmmu, ni eni caala maac ni wø thöör jiy. Eni jøøgø di thöörö ni bööt geni nyïmmu, ni putu geni riem wøk, ni laaru geni thöör, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïïu.
english: Understand therefore this day, that the Lord thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the Lord hath said unto thee.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu no onø riem jøøgø wøk nyïmmu, kär nou köö ki cwïnynyu ni beeye kiper beer maru na ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl uuni yi ŋöömmi en nee lwørru na maru. 'Ba beeye kiper rääö mar jøøa en yi ŋöömmögø no ö Wuuö Jwøki noo riem geni wøk nyïmmu.
english: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the Lord thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the Lord hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord doth drive them out from before thee.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, paa kiper beer maru wala thïïŋ cwïny maru noo cou yi ŋööm jøøgø nee lwørru na maru, 'ba beeye kiper rääö mar jøøgø no ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo riem geni wøk nyïmmu, kiper nee kööŋ mana kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu, ni beege Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, nee nyoodhe jïïu na adïëri.
english: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ŋäyu gø ni paa kiper beer maru no ö Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu noo cïp ŋöömmi ni beer en jïïu nee lwørru na maru, kiper uuna jiy mo wïthu teek.
english: Understand therefore, that the Lord thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

anywaa: «Ba caarru wïthu ni ba wïl wïthu ki mana cwaatu yi Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu këël mana wëëre ki uuni dï paap. Ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa ööu wøk ki yi Ijep këël mana pïïyu kany, uuna bëëdö nou gëëmö ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the Lord thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the Lord.

anywaa: Këël kanya bëëdu tier Kïn Körëp thuwø, Wuuö Jwøk yie acwaatu këël mana wëëre, ni put wëër døc ki uuni ni tïme ni manynya man thöör uuni.
english: Also in Horeb ye provoked the Lord to wrath, so that the Lord was angry with you to have destroyed you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cøøa bäät kïdi, nee opäp kïte moa näk luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki uuni ogöör bäätge lwøra, kar kaaca aana bëëdö bäät kïdi ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni beeye dïcäŋ ki wäär, ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa camø wala pïï mo yaa maadhø.
english: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the Lord made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk opäp kïte moa näk ariiø na gööre ki cere amëëk aani, ni luup moa en yïthge beege luup bëët moa caane jïïu bäät kïdi ni eni ena dï maac, dïcäŋa cooŋŋu rou na aciel bëët.
english: And the Lord delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the Lord spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya tïme na aŋuun nïne moa näk pïëraŋween, Wuuö Jwøk opäp kïte moa näk ariiø na näk luumma tuut ogöör bäätge acïbe jïra.
english: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the Lord gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

anywaa: Kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk aköö ki aani, ni ‹Ö maal ni laarï ci piny, kiper jiyï moa kälï wøk ki Ijep dëëtge araanyge keerge. Gena laar gaa wøk ki øtjöö mana köömma geni ki gø, ni tïnyge dëëtge ki kït gïn mo oleenyø kiper nee lamge.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

anywaa: «Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki cäänö ki aani, ni kööe, ‹Ka adïëri møn, jøøi ii ajooda ni gena jiy mo wïthge teek.
english: Furthermore the Lord spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wec aani kiper nee geni nääa, ni thööra geni, ni tïmge ni bäŋ nyeŋge bäät piny. 'Ba ïïni na Modhe en, ï tïïa tïïö ni ïïna wï jur mo teek mo dwøŋŋa eni ki geni.›
english: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

anywaa: «Køøre dëëra aputa løk ni ööa piny ki bäät kïdi, ni maac poot liel bäät kïdi, no opäp kïte moa näk ariiø moa näk luumma tuut ogöör bäätge käära ka ceŋŋa karge riet.
english: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

anywaa: Ni jooda uuni møn ni uuno bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. Dëëtu atïnynyu ki kït gïn mo oleenyø mo caala nyirøøa kiper nee lammu, ni laaru gaa wøk ki øtjöö mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm uuni ki gø.
english: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the Lord your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the Lord had commanded you.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, opämi moa näk ariiø agøøa piny ni thøwge nyïmmu ni nëënö jïïu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

anywaa: Køøre aani raa aleeŋa piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni kwaaa gø ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni beeye dïcäŋ  ki wäär, ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa camø wala pïï mo yaa maadhø, kaawat mana tïïa dïkwøŋ. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk akwaaa kiper gïna baayu na raac dëëre, ni cwaatu yie ki gø këël mana wëëre.
english: And I fell down before the Lord, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

anywaa: Gïnögø atïïa ni lwäya aani ki wëëc Wuuö Jwøk ki räny ec mana räny yie ki uuni, ni beeye mana wëëre ki uuni ni dee uuni nääö. 'Ba kar kaaca thuwø Wuuö Jwøk lam mara awïnynye.
english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the Lord was wroth against you to destroy you. But the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëre ki Aran døc, ni manynya man 'näk gø; 'ba aana lämö kiper Aran kar kaaca thuwø.
english: And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

anywaa: Køøre gïna raac na näk caala nyirøøa, na tïïyu kiper nee lammu, alwøra ni waaŋa gø ki maac, ni tøøa gø, ni puta gø guur na ŋiidhi këël mana tïme na tør, ni leeŋa tør mare yi naam mana löönynyö ki bäät kïdi.
english: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

anywaa: «Køøre thuwø, kanya enu Tabëëra ki Maca ki Kibïröth-Ataba, Wuuö Jwøk yie acäŋu cwaatø këël mana wëëre.
english: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth–hattaavah, ye provoked the Lord to wrath.

anywaa: «Maya thuwø, kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na jääŋ uuni ki Kadëc-Bernia, ni kööe, ni ‹Cou ni lwørru ŋöömö mana cïba jïïu,› uuna kweer ki mana caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu, ni käru mare ŋäädhö ni käru dwøre leŋø.
english: Likewise when the Lord sent you from Kadesh–barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the Lord your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna bëëdö ni maru ageem ki Wuuö Jwøk, ki mana tääa bëëtö ki uuni.
english: Ye have been rebellious against the Lord from the day that I knew you.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya leeŋa raa piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni kwaaa gø ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, kwaaa kaper mana kö Wuuö Jwøki nou nääe nääö.
english: Thus I fell down before the Lord forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

anywaa: Ni läma jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööa, ‹Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, jiyï moa näk thöögï na wïïlï wøk ki køør teegï na dwøŋ, na kälï wøk ki yi Ijep ki teek badï, kär 'nägï.
english: I prayed therefore unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

anywaa: Caar wïïï ki laagï ma Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap; kärï tïmö niï neeta teek wïc mar jøøi, ki gïïa reyø na tïïcge, ki raay moge,
english: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

anywaa: kiper nee jø paana kälï waani wøk ki yie nee ba köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk kär løny jïre ki man kïth geni yi ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jïge,» nee ba köge thuwø, ni «Ena männö ki geni, ni ge käl wøk kaper nee ge nääe dï paap.»
english: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the Lord was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, ge poot na jiyï ni beege thöögï na kälï wøk ki køør teegï na dwøŋ ki teek badï.›
english: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaace Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Tööï ko opäp kïte ariiø mo caala moa dïkwøŋ, ni tïïyï ka acandu jaath, ni ööï baŋa bäät kïdi.
english: At that time the Lord said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

anywaa: Køøre luup moa en bäät opäp kïte moa dïkwøŋ na gøøï piny, ocäŋa göör bäät opäp kïte moøgø; køøre nø, okïthï ya acanduk.›
english: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

anywaa: «Kanyøgønø, aana tïïö ka acanduk ki jaadha cwøl ni cïta, ni tööa ko opäp kïte ariiø mo caala moa dïkwøŋ, ni cøøa ni etha maal bäät kïdi, no opäp kïte karge riedi ena cera.
english: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni gööt bäät opäpögø ki gööre mo caala moa dïkwøŋ, ni beege ciik moa näk apaar na caan Wuuö Jwøki jïïu bäät kïdi, ni dwøre cura dï maac, yi cäŋa näk cäŋ acooŋa. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mëëk ge aani.
english: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the Lord spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the Lord gave them unto me.

anywaa: Køøre aana duu piny ki bäät kïdi, ni kïtha opäp kïte ya acanduk mana näk yaa nø tïïc, ni ge poot ena yie ennø, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm aani.»
english: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the Lord commanded me.

anywaa: ('Ba jø Icriel gena tïŋŋö ki kanya cwøl ni Bëëröth-Bene-Jaakan, ni pïïcge Möcëëröt. 'Ba Aran athøø kaace, ni koonyi; ni ö wääde ma Eliedhar ni läw kare ni tïïc tïï dïlämi.
english: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïŋŋö kaace, ni cige Gudgöda, ni cäŋge tïŋŋö Gudgöda ni pïïcge Jöthbata, yi ŋöömma näk yie da nyeŋ näm mo yïthge da pïï.
english: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of rivers of waters.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni ge ena lak Kïn Körëp, kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk jø tuuŋ Libay acïp kur keerge, kiper na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy nee bielge, nee  cuŋge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk nee eni tïnyge, nee ge gwëëthge ki nyeŋŋe; ni putge bëëtö ni ge tïïya tïïögø këël dïcäŋi en.
english: At that time the Lord separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, jø tuuŋ Libay ge ba jïti ki ŋøøm yïthakic nyïïmëëkge, wala kany mo maara dööŋö jï nyïïkwaacge. 'Ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk noo dööŋ jïge ni caala ŋöömma doo dööŋ na kurge, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïge.)
english: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the Lord is his inheritance, according as the Lord thy God promised him.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, aana ruu bäät kïdi ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni beeye dïcäŋ ki wäär, kaawat mana tïïa dïkwøŋ, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cäŋ kwac mara wïnynyö kar kaaca thuwø, ni käre jïëy ki man thöör uuni këët.
english: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the Lord hearkened unto me at that time also, and the Lord would not destroy thee.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Ö maal ni bwøthï maal nyïm jiy, nee cige yi ŋöömö, nee lwørge na marge, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jï kwäcge nee mëëga geni.›
english: And the Lord said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
