anywaa: «?Ennø, u na jø Icriel, agïnaŋø ni many Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu baŋu? Gïn many Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu beeye ki man lwäärru eni, ni caathu køøre, ni mëërru ki eni, ni tïnynyu eni ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre,
english: And now, Israel, what doth the Lord thy God require of thee, but to fear the Lord thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the Lord thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

anywaa: ni gwøgu ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ki gïïa kööm uuni ki ge, mo caana jïïu dïcäŋi en, kiper nou bëënynyu.
english: To keep the commandments of the Lord, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

anywaa: «Neennu, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, maal ki kare bäre, ki piny bäre ki gïïa en yie bëët, moe.
english: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the Lord's thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ni yie met ki kwäyu, ni mëër ki geni døc, ni beeye tiere gø na jier uuni, u na nyïïkwaacge, yïthakic wïth juurre bëët, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Only the Lord had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.

anywaa: Ennø, wiillu cwïnynyu ni tïmu nou bëënna eni, ni ba bëëdu ni wïthu teek këët.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye Jwøk mo dwøŋŋa eni ki juu møga, ni ena kwääc kwääri, ni ena Jwøk mo dwøŋ mo teek, mo di lwäärö, mo ba jëënyö, mo ba ŋeew ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny.
english: For the Lord your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

anywaa: Eni luubö di ŋølø na kare jï kïïc ki cï thøø, ni eni mëër ki wëëllö mo path, ni cïpö jïre ki cam ka abïï.
english: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u doo mëër ki wëëllö mo path, kiper uuna kwøŋ bëëtö na wëëlle mo path yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Lwäärru Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni tïnynyu eni, ni göögu dëëre, ni kööŋŋu ri nyeŋŋe keere.
english: Thou shalt fear the Lord thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

anywaa: Beeye eni na doo jiemø, ni beeye eni na Jwøu, na tïïc gïï ii kiperu, na näk gïï mo døøŋŋø mo di lwäärö, na neennu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

anywaa: Kanya ci kwäyu Ijep, gena jiy ma pïërabïriiø keerge; 'ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna tïïe nou thööth kaamar ceer ni wø en maal.
english: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the Lord thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

anywaa: «'Ba uuni, u doo mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni gwøgu ciik moe cooth, ki luup ŋøl moe ki gïïa kööm uuni ki ge.
english: Therefore thou shalt love the Lord thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

anywaa: 'Ba wär ŋäyu dïcäŋi, ni paa wäätu na pwöny Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu, 'ba beeye uuni ki dëëtu na pwönynyi ki køør gïïa jootu, ni beege dööŋö mare ki teek bade na dwøŋ,
english: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the Lord your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

anywaa: ki ŋïïce moe ki tïïe moe moa tïïe Ijep dëër Peerø nyeny Ijep ki yi ŋöömme bäre,
english: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

anywaa: ki gïna tïïe dëët jø leny mo Ijep ki dëët okwëënyi moge ki jïëth leny moge mo wø tut okwëënyi, kanya tïïc Naama Kwaar nee neejïk bäätge kanya ŋwiecge køøru. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put ge thöör na bäre bäre kar kaaca.
english: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the Lord hath destroyed them unto this day;

anywaa: Ni paa wäätu thuwø na joot gïïa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki jïïu dï paap këël mana pïïyu kany,
english: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

anywaa: ki gïna tïïe dëër Daathan ka Abiram wäät Eliap nyïïkwaac Ruben, na ö ŋøømmi na pääe ki dïge ni put ge mwøny, ni beege geni ki jø mïëcge, ko oduŋkaare moge, ki jø tïïc moge, ki lääc paac moge bëët. Ni gïnögø täga dï jø Icriel ni nëënö jïge bëët.
english: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni ki dëëtu, tïïe moa døøŋŋø na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki bëët aneennu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the Lord which he did.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, beerra man gwøgu ciik bëët moi ni köömma uuni ki geni  dïcäŋi en, kiper nou tïmö nou teek, ni cou yi ŋöömö ni lwørru gø na maru, ni beeye ŋöömmögø ni karu cään ki man ŋutu yie løøga enø nee lwørru na maru,
english: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

anywaa: kiper nee cwiiri moo beetu yi ŋöömmögø nee tïmge ni thööth, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere jï kwäyu nee cïbe jïge ki nyïïkwaacge, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie.
english: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

anywaa: Kiper ŋöömö manøgø nou cou yie enø nou lwørru na maru, ba caal ŋööm Ijep na kälu yie, na wara piithu, ni jwøyu gø ki pïï mo kälu ki yi naam kaawat man wø jwøc ajïniina.
english: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö manø noo cou yie løøga enø, nee lwørru na maru, beeye ŋöömö mo yie da thuuri ki gøli, ni beeye ŋöömö mo jwøya køthi.
english: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋöömö mo ogwøk Wuuö Jwøki, ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu bëëdö ni neeta gø cooth ki yi cwiir bäre.
english: A land which the Lord thy God careth for: the eyes of the Lord thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo ciik moi ni köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en you leŋø na karge, ni ciik moøgø beege ki man mëërru ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni tïnynyu gø ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre,
english: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the Lord your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

anywaa: eni køth cwiir di jääŋŋö ki kanya näk kare, ni jääŋ mar dhi køth ki kanya näk kare kiper ŋöömmu, kiper nee beel mou ki nyïïjenni mou mo wø nyïïge nywøp na kwøŋ, ki mo wø nyïïge wel na mädhi nee ciekge jïïu.
english: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

anywaa: Eni thuwø luum di cïbö yïth pwöle mou kiper lääc paac mou. 'Ba uuno bëëdö nou cämu ki caammi mou jaak ni jäŋŋu.
english: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

anywaa: «'Ba gwøgu rou nee wïthu ba maaŋŋi, nou ba gaau wøk ki man tïnynyu juu møøk ni wøørru geni.
english: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

anywaa: Kiper ni näk mo teeŋ gïnögø tïïyu tïïö, wëëc Wuuö Jwøk liel dëëtu kaamar maac, ni män køth, ni tïme ni bäŋ køth këët, ni ö pinynyi ni tïme ni bäŋ cam mo ciek yie; ni laaru thumö yi ŋöömmo beer enø noo cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïïu.
english: And then the Lord's wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the Lord giveth you.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luup mo caana jïïu ii, beerra man kïthu geni cwïnynyu ni lääŋŋu geni døc, ni tïmge ni ge caala nyuudhi mo you twöö ceŋŋu, ni bëëtge kaamar gööre mo ena täärnyïmmu mo wïthu ba wïl ki ge.
english: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

anywaa: Ni pwönynyu obwöre mou ki geni døc, ni bëëdu nou cara gïrge cooth kany wø pïïu piny mïëyu, ki kany wø cäädhu jöö, ki kany wø nyaaŋŋu dëëtu piny, ki kany wø päyu.
english: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

anywaa: Ni gööru geni dhøk uudi mou ki dhøk käälle mou,
english: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

anywaa: kiper nee nïr kwøw mou ki mo obwöre mou nee tïmge ni thööth bäät ŋöömma kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere jï kwäyu nee cïbe jïge, nou bëëdu nou nut cooth nou kwøw, kaawat man bëët maalli ni nut cooth en.
english: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

anywaa: «Kiper ni näk mo rou you maa ki man gwøgu ciik moi ni köömma uuni ki geni en, ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc, ni beeye ki man mëërru ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni caathu køøre cooth, ni göögu ree,
english: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wïth juurre moi bëët rieme wøk nyïmmu, ni lwørru ŋøøp juurre moø ni teek ni døøŋŋø geni ki uuni yøø,
english: Then will the Lord drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

anywaa: ni kany mo you gudö ki tietu jaak, tïmö na ŋöömö maru. Ni tïm päl ŋöömmu ni tägi ka dï paap mana en jï løø tier-piny, këël mano këët Libaanø na en jï løø wï-piny; ni cäŋ tägö ki Naam Upareeti na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mano këët naama dwøŋ na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo maar lønyø ki man cuŋŋe nyïmmu kany wø näk da leny. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu jiy moo en yi ŋöömmo nyøønnu ki tietu bëët, yïthge othäŋŋi ni mooc ge ki lwär mo dwøŋ kiperu, kaawat mana caan gø jïïu.
english: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the Lord your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

anywaa: «Neennu, dïcäŋi gwïëth ka acëënne cïba nyïmmu.
english: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

anywaa: Ni näk mo ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu mo köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en leŋŋu leŋø, u di gwïëdhö.
english: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you this day:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ba leŋŋu, ni gaau wøk ki øtjöö man ni köömma uuni ki gø dïcäŋi en, ni caathu køør juu møøk mo kuyu dïkwøŋ, u di cienø.
english: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the Lord your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo  ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo kïth uuni yi ŋöömmo cou yie nee lwørru na maru, kar kaace nø, luup gwïëth ocaannu bäät Kïn Geridhan, ni caannu luup acïëni bäät Kïn Gëëbal.
english: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

anywaa: 'Ba kïte moøgø ena løø Naam Jördan løøga buut jöör wø ci jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ge ena buut jera døøŋŋø na näk mo Mörë yi ŋööm jø Keenan mo wø bëëdö dï goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, ni wø neet røkge ki Gëlgela.
english: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, karu anø tïmö ni cään ki man ŋutu løø Naam Jördan løøga, ki man cou nee ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu nee lwørru na maru. Ŋöömmögø olwørru møn ni putu bëëtö yie.
english: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the Lord your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

anywaa: Køøre nø, rou wär gwøgu, ni ö ciiki ki luup ŋøl bëët mo köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en, ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc.
english: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

anywaa: «'Ba moi beege ciik ki luup ŋøl moo koorru wïthu ki ge noo gwøgu këël yïth nïr kwøw mou moo beetu bäät ŋøøm, ni beeye ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu jïïu nou lwørru na maru.
english: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the Lord God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

anywaa: Wïth juurre moo ŋøøpge lwørru, kwör wø lamge juu moge yïthge bëët moa en bäät kïte moa bäyö, ki moa en bäät thuuri, ki moa en tiet jenni moa näk onigïït piny bëët wär raanynyu na bäre bäre.
english: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

anywaa: Ni raanynyu gïï wø cïpge olämme moge bäätge, ni tøgu kïte moa näk ege cwöth piny kiper nee lamge, ni ö jera näk ege tieŋø na näk ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara ni waaŋŋu geni ki maac, ni ö gïïa näk ege tieŋø na juu ni ŋødu ge piny, ni raanynyu nyeŋge kaace ni tïmge ni kuc na bäre bäre.
english: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

anywaa: «'Ba uuni, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ba dou lamø kaawat man wø ö jøøgø wø lamge juu moge.
english: Ye shall not do so unto the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba u doo cøøa kuna wøørru Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo jiere noo caa ri nyeŋŋe nee tïme na kar bëëtö mare røk kwöro bëët wïth tuŋi mou yïthge.
english: But unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

anywaa: Ni cïpu olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme møøk, ki paac wïth japu, ko olämme mo wø cïp ki køør kööŋ, ki muuce ma teeŋi mo wø cïp ki met ec jaak, ki kaai mo dhäk mou ki mo dïëk mou kaace.
english: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

anywaa: 'Ba kaace ŋati man nø dëëtu ki jø paare ge doo cämö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni mïn yïthu ki køør tïïe mou bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na gwïëth uuni ki ge.
english: And there ye shall eat before the Lord your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the Lord thy God hath blessed thee.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo pïïyu yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïïu, u ba doo tïïö ki teeŋ gïï ni poot temmø dïcäŋi en, ni ŋati man nø Wuuö Jwøk wøøre wøørø ki jöö mana manynye jaak;
english: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

anywaa: kiper mana näk mou poot kär pïï kar jwömö, ni beeye kanyo dööŋ jïïu na maru noo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
english: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the Lord your God giveth you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u ŋuta løøga løø Naam Jördan, nou bëëdu yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu noo dööŋ jïïu na maru, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mooc uuni ki jwöm, ni bäŋ gïn mo lwäärru kiper nyïïmän mou bëët moo en lagu.
english: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the Lord your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

anywaa: 'Ba kaace, kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo caa ri nyeŋŋe, gïï köömma uuni ki ge bëët wär kïthu yie, ni beege olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme møøk, ki paac wïth jammi mou, ki muuce mou ma teeŋi, ko olämme moa no ojierø ni beyø ge mo wø cïpu jï Wuuö Jwøk ki køør kööŋ.
english: Then there shall be a place which the Lord your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba yïthu doo mïnnö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, uuni ko obwöre mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki jø tïïc mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki ŋat tuuŋ Libay man nø mo bëëdö ka uuni, jøøa näk bäŋ ŋöömö moo dööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakiyu.
english: And ye shall rejoice before the Lord your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu rou ki man ba cïpu olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre kwör wäru jootu jaak,
english: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

anywaa: 'ba olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre dou cïbö kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ aciel røk wïth tuŋi mou bëët, ni tïïyu gïïa köömma uuni ki ge bëët kaace.
english: But in the place which the Lord shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋati man nø løny jïre ki man ŋäde ri lääc paac moe ni cam rïŋ gø  paare kaawat mana manynye jaak, ki køør gwïëth mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu. Ni ŋat mo waany ki ŋat mo ba waany løny jïge ki man cämge, kaawat man wø cam rïŋ aŋer ki rïŋ purra jaak.
english: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

anywaa: 'Ba remø keere kär cammu; wär kønynyu piny kaamar pïï.
english: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa no omänö ki man cammu ge yïth mïëri mou beege caammi mou moa dou cïbö na paac wïth jammi ki mo kwøk nyïïomøki mou, ki mo mädhi mou, wala kaai mo dhäk ki mo dïëk mou, wala olämme mou mo wø cïp ki køør kööŋ, wala muuce mou ma teeŋi mo wø cïp ki met ec jaak.
english: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø ocammu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo jiere, nou cämu ko obwöre mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki jø tïïc mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki ŋat tuuŋ Libay man nø mo bëëdö ka uuni; ni mïn yïthu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ki køør tïïe mou bëët.
english: But thou must eat them before the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu rou ki man ba jarru jø tuuŋ Libay ki yïth cwiiri bëët moo beetu yi ŋöömmu.
english: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo nyaanh keew maru kaawat mana caan gø jïïu, kanyo parru rïŋö ni kööu, ni ‹Wa manynya cam ki rïŋö,› løny jïïu ki man cämu ki rïŋö kaawat mana manynyu jaak.
english: When the Lord thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk po dhaanhø bäär ki kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo caa ri nyeŋŋe, løny jïre ki man ŋäde ri dhäk moe ki ri dïëk moe moa cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïre, kaawat mana köömma uuni, ni løny ki man cäme paare kaawat mana manynye jaak.
english: If the place which the Lord thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the Lord hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

anywaa: Rïŋŋögø doo camø kaawat man wø cam rïŋ aŋer wala rïŋ purra jaak, ni ŋat mo waany wala ŋat mo ba waany løny jïre ki man cäme.
english: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu rou ki man ba cammu remø, kiper remø beeye jwïëy, ni jwïëy ba dou camø ki rïŋö na aciel.
english: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

anywaa: Remø wäru kønynyu piny kaamar pïï, ni ba cammu gø.
english: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

anywaa: 'Ba remø kär cammu, kiper ni näk mo ba cammu, tïmö ni gïn mo tiir nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïme ni beer kiperu ko obwöre mou moo ööi køøru.
english: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa näk you cïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ko olämme mou mo wø cïp ki køør kööŋ, u doo cøø ni kïthu ge kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the Lord shall choose:

anywaa: 'Ba olämme mou moøgø mo wø waaŋ bäre, rïŋ moge ki remø marge wär cïbu bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni ö olämme mou møga ni kønynyu remø marge piny bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni cammu rïŋ moge.
english: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the Lord thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the Lord thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

anywaa: 'Ba gwøgu rou ki man leŋŋu luup bëët mo köömma uuni ki ge ii, nee tïme ni beer kiperu na bäre bäre, ko obwöre mou moo ööi køøru, kiper ni näk mo luup you leŋø, tïmö ni gïn mo beer mo tiir nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the Lord thy God.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo thöör wïth juurre moo en nyïmmu, nou cou baŋge nee ŋøøpge lwørru na maru, kanyo nø lwørru ŋøøpge nø, nou bëëdu yïthge,
english: When the Lord thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

anywaa: rou wär gwøgu nee wïthu ba maaŋŋi ki man caathu køørge. 'Ba kanyo tïme ni ge di thöörö nyïmmu, kär dee gïn manynyu ri juu moge. Kanymør u köö, ni ‹?Wïth juurre moi juu moge ege tïnynyö nidïï? Waani thuwø wa tïïö ka teeŋ mana tïïcge.›
english: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

anywaa: Kär dee teeŋ gïn mo caala manøgø mo tïïyu dëër Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, kiper jøøgø jammi bëët moa näk yi Wuuö Jwøk raac ki ge, na mäne ki ge, beege ni wø tïïcge jï juu moge. Kiper geni, këël obwöre moge moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään wø waaŋge waaŋø no olämme jï juu moge.
english: Thou shalt not do so unto the Lord thy God: for every abomination to the Lord, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.

anywaa: «'Ba gïï köömma uuni ki ge bëët ii, beerra man gwøgu ge, ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc, ni ba meetu ge, ni ba kännu wøk rege.
english: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da nyikuŋ Jwøk wala ŋat mo lägö mo ree ee  thïïŋö dïïu, ni caan gø jïïu ni da ŋïï wala gïn mo rëëma ec mo tägö,
english: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni ‹Ö aa kuna caadhø køør juu møøk, ni tïnynyø geni,› ni teeŋ ŋatøgø cäänö kaper juu mo kuyu, këël na bëëde ni ŋïï wala gïn mo rëëma ec mana cääne kipere othur kare na adïëri,
english: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

anywaa: kär nou leŋa gïr nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø wala gïr ŋat lääk manøgø; kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu päänynya uuni nou joode ki man näk mou mëër ki eni ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre.
english: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the Lord your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

anywaa: 'Ba caathu køør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni lwäärru eni; gwøgu ciik moe ni leŋŋu dwøre; tïnynyu eni ni göögu ree.
english: Ye shall walk after the Lord your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø wala ŋat lääk manøgø wär eni 'näk, kiper eni pwönynya uuni ki man gëëmu ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, na pät uuni yi bëët laŋ. Ni teeŋ ŋatøgø manynya man käl uuni wøk yi øtjöö mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na kööm uuni ki gø ni cäädhu ki gø. 'Ba teeŋ ŋatøgø wär 'nägu, nou raanynya gïna raac na en dïïu.
english: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo coku wala wäädï wala nyaarï wala cïïï na mëërï ki gø, wala nyawadu na ŋäyu cwïnynyu ki gø, wïïï di maaŋŋø ki piny, ni kööe, ni ‹Ö aa cøø kuna tïnynyø juu møøk,› ni cäänö kaper juu mo kuyu wala moa kuc kwäyu,
english: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

anywaa: ni beege juu mo jøøa en buutu na karge cään ki uuni, wala moa karge bäyö ki uuni, ki mano täge ki buut piny man nø këël buut piny maya,
english: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

anywaa: teeŋ ŋat mo caana gïnögø nø, kärï jïëy ki mare, ni ba leŋï dwøre. Kär cwïnyï pädhö ki gïre, ni ba weyï eni, ni ba kanï eni.
english: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

anywaa: 'Ba eni wär put 'näk kiree. Cerï wär kwøŋ møør maal ki man 'nägï gø, køøre ceŋ jøw møga wär läwge cään.
english: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

anywaa: Eni wär këëru ki kïte nee thøøe, kiper eni manynya man tïïc uuni ni karu bäär ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep na näk po laŋ.
english: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët gïnögø owïnyge ni lwäcge, ni ba tïïge këët dïïu ki teeŋ gïnö ni raac enøgø.
english: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo bëëdu yïth päänye mou moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, ni näk mo da gïn mo you wïnynyö,
english: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the Lord thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

anywaa: ni køp ni da jiy mo wïthge reyø mo dëëtge ege thïïŋö dïïu ni maaŋge wïth jø pääny marge, ni köge, ni ‹Beerra man cøøø ni tïnynyø juu møøk,› ni ge cäänö kaper juu mo kuyu,
english: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

anywaa: uuni, tier gïnögø wär manynyu, ni neennu gø ni pëënynyu gø døøc. 'Ba ni näk mo gïnögø otïmö na adïëri, ni gïna näk Jwøk yie raac ki gø ojoodø møn no otïïö yïthakiyu,
english: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, jøøa näk bëëdö yi päänyeca wär putu 'näk kiree; ni putu päänyögø raanynyø na bäre bäre, ki gïïa en yie bëët, këël lääc paac moa en yie bëët.
english: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: Køøre gïïo twierru yie bëët wär cooŋu kanya ciel kar acooŋa mar päänyögø, ni waaŋŋu pääny ki gïïa twierru bëët, ni tïmge ni ge caala olämi man wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu; ni tïm wï päänyöca no oränynyö na bäre bäre, ni ba cäŋ geerrø këët.
english: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the Lord thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee gïn mo raac mo ocienø mo gutu ki ceŋŋu, kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk nee wëër mare na leth nee ba ö bäätu, ni nyooth mëëye jïïu, ni päth cwïnye ki gïru, ni tïïc kwäännu ni thööth, kaawat mana kööŋe jï kwäyu.
english: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

anywaa: Gïnögø tïïc Wuuö Jwøki tïïö ni näk mo dwør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu leŋŋu leŋø, ni gwøgu ciik moe bëët mo köömma uuni ki geni dïcäŋi en, nou tïïya gïn mo tiir nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the Lord thy God.

anywaa: «Uuni, uuna jic Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu; kanyo näk mo dhaanhø jwöŋö kiper dhaanhø mo othøw, kär dëëre pwöde ki gïn mo beth, ni ba gwäär wïïe wøk.
english: Ye are the children of the Lord your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

anywaa: Kiper uuna jiy mo ena kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk uuna jiere kiper nou tïmu ni uuna jiy moa näk thööge dï jiy bëët moa en bäät piny.
english: For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God, and the Lord hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

anywaa: «Kär dee gïn mo Jwøk yie raac ki gø mo cammu.
english: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

anywaa: 'Ba lääy moo cammu beege dhieŋ ki røømmø ka ateea,
english: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

anywaa: ki purra, ki muur, ka aŋer, ko omøro, ki tääŋ, ki buba, ki röönna.
english: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

anywaa: Lääy mano näk mo okiey moe okaaø, no okiey moe opääŋŋö na ariiø, ni luum man wø came ŋööe wøk ni cäŋ gø nyammø, beeye lääy mano cammu.
english: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

anywaa: 'Ba røk lääy moa näk luum man wø camge ŋööge wøk ni cäŋge gø nyammø, ki røk moa näk okiey moge okaaø, athïrööl, ka apwøø, ka athinaak kär cammu; kiper këël na bëëtge ni luum man wø camge ŋööge wøk ni cäŋge gø nyammø, okiey moge kär kaa na ariiø. Teeŋ lääy moøgø beege lääy mo ba waany kiperu.
english: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba røk lääy moa näk okiey moge okaa na ariiø, othur kär cammu. Kiper këël na bëëde no okiey moe okaa na ariiø, luum man wø came ba ŋöö wøk dhee ni cäŋ gø nyammø. Teeŋ lääy manøgø thuwø beeye lääy mo ba waany kiperu. Kär dee rïŋŋe mo cammu, wala u guta dëëre mana näk othøw.
english: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

anywaa: «'Ba gïï mo løny jïïu ki man cammu geni røk gïï wø bëëdö yïth pïï bëët beege rec mo dëëtge da riith ki kwönne.
english: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

anywaa: 'Ba gïn mo ree bäŋ riith, mo dëëre bäŋ kwönnö, kär cammu; kiper geno mänö ni kär cammu.
english: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

anywaa: «Løny jïïu ki man cammu weny bëët moa no ocaannø ni cammu.
english: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

anywaa: 'Ba weny mo ba dou camø beege coor, ka acuth, ko olwiith,
english: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

anywaa: ki teeŋ akän bëët,
english: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

anywaa: ki teeŋ agääe bëët,
english: And every raven after his kind,

anywaa: ki uudö, ka agïïra, ko olwiith ki teeŋge bëët,
english: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

anywaa: ki teeŋ tule bëët,
english: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

anywaa: ka abööŋö, ki dïbëël, ka apööra mana näk ocurruunyö,
english: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

anywaa: ka aliil, ko olwaarø ki teeŋge bëët, ka akwørajwöm, ka adilïga.
english: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

anywaa: 'Ba twöŋi bëët mo dëëtge da bwöm ba dou camø, kiper geno mänö ni kär cammu.
english: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

anywaa: Wenyø mo ocaanø ni cammu, løny ki man cammu gø.
english: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

anywaa: «'Ba gïn mo thøwa e keere kär cammu, kiper uuna jiy mo ena kur keeru jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. Løny jïïu ki man cïp gïn mo thøwa e keere jï wëëllö mo path mo bëëdö yi pääny maru kiper nee came, wala løny jïïu ki man dwøgu gø pwödhö ki jur. «Kär nyidiel thaallu ki caa menni.
english: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.

anywaa: «Wär cïpu ki paac wïth jammi røk gïï wø ciek yïth pwöth mou ni wø piithu ki yi cwiir cooth.
english: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø dou camø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo jiere noo caa ri nyeŋŋe. Ni gïïo cammu beege paac wïth jammi mou, ni beege mo beel, ki mo kwøk nyïïomøki, ki mo mädhi mou; ki kaai mo dhäk mou ki mo dïëk mou, kiper nou kwänynyu ki man lwäärru Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu cooth.
english: And thou shalt eat before the Lord thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the Lord thy God always.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo gwïëth uuni yie, ni näk mo piny bäär døc, ni ba løny jï dhaanhø ki man kïth paac wïth jammi moe kanya jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo caa ri nyeŋŋe kiper mana bäär kare,
english: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the Lord thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:

anywaa: løny jïre ki man wiil paac wïth jammi moe ki gwel, ni kwany gwel cere ni ci kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu.
english: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the Lord thy God shall choose:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pïïe kaace, løny jïre ki man ŋeew gwel ki gïïa manynye ki cwïnye jaak. Løny jïre ki man ŋëëe ki dhäk wala dïëk wala kwøk nyïïomøki wala teeŋ kwøŋ møøk, wala gïïo many cwïnye jaak, ni cam geni nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni mïn yie ki jø paare.
english: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the Lord thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

anywaa: 'Ba kär wïc wïl ki jø tuuŋ Libay mo bëëdö yïth päänye mou, kiper bäŋ ŋöömö mo odööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakiyu.
english: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø tïme na aŋuun dää cwiiri cooth, paac wïth jammi bëët moo joot ki yi cwiinøgø wär käli, ni cïbi kwör kän na en yïth päänye mou.
english: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay, kiper mana näk bäŋ ŋöömö mo odööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakiyu, ki juurre moa bëëdö dïïu,  ki kïïe ki määr thuunhnhi moa en yïth päänye mou, geno ööi ni cämge ni jäŋge, kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu nou gwïëdhe ki tïïe bëët moo tïïyu ki ceŋŋu.
english: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the Lord thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun bïriet cwiiri cooth, pïït dou wiiø.
english: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

anywaa: Ni mano tïïc kiper wec pïït beeye en: Ŋata mäyö baŋe, gïna näk omac ŋat atut mare baŋe wär wiie. Ŋata mäyö baŋe kär pïïdö ki watge wala ŋat atut mare, kiper beeye kanya caan Wuuö Jwøki ni pïït wec.
english: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the Lord's release.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna näk omac jurri, løny jï dhaanhø ki man piir gø, 'ba jammi mo ena bäät wat wär wec jïre.
english: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïnögø you tïïö, otïmö ni bäŋ ŋat pou mo can dïïu, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuno gwïëdhe yi ŋöömmo lwørru noo cïbe noo dööŋ jïïu na maru.
english: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the Lord shall greatly bless thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuno gwïëdhe møn ni näk mo luupe leŋŋu leŋø ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc, ni gwøgu ciik moi bëët mo köömma uuni ki ge dïcäŋi en.
english: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuno gwïëdhe kaawat mana caan gø jïïu. Ki køør kwär maru, japu owëëgu mac jï wïth juurre mo thööth, 'ba u ba mäyi; ni ki køør teek maru, wïth juurre mo thööth otïmö ni bëënna uuni, ni ba tïmu nou bëënna geni.
english: For the Lord thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da ŋat mo wat mo can mo bëëdö buut dhaanhø yïth päänye moa näk mou, yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, kär cwïny tëënnö ki gø, ni ba tëën cenø ki man cïpö jïre.
english: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

anywaa: 'Ba cenø wär jap jïre, ni mooc eni ni ec tar ki gïna näk orømø na manynye, ni jïte ki gïna cane.
english: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

anywaa: 'Ba røk wär gwøk, kiper nee bäŋe acaara mo raac mo ö cwïny, ki man kö dhaanhe, ni ‹Bïriet cwiiri kare acäännö, cwiino wec pïït yie,› ni tïm eci ni raac ki wat mana can, ni bäŋe gïn mëëk eni. Kanymør ŋatøce jwöŋö ki nyeŋ dhaanhø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïme na raay bäät ŋata jwöŋe ki nyeŋ gø.
english: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the Lord against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

anywaa: Gïna manynye wär cïp jïre ki met ec, ni ba cäŋ cwïnynyi lämmö kiper gïna mëëk eni. Kiper ki køør gïno tïïc dhaanhe, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu dhaanhø gwïëdhe gwïëdhö ki ri tïïe bëët moo tïïc ki cenø.
english: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa can ba thum bäät ŋøøm, ni beeye tiere gø ni köömma uuni en, ni kööa, ni ‹Cenø jap jï wat mo can man wø many køny yi ŋöömö maru.›
english: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk tuuŋu ma ŋat Ibaru  ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø ree ee bielø na ŋat tïïc jï dhaanhø, eni ŋatøgø dee tïnynyö ki cwiiri abïciel. 'Ba noo tïme na bïriet cwiiri wär eni wec nee aae.
english: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wii nee aae, kär wëëk wääth nee aae ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

anywaa: 'Ba wär mooc ki met ec ri dïëk ki ri beel ki ri kwøk nyïïomøki, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na gwïëth uuni.
english: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the Lord thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba wïthu wär caarru ki mana bëëdu ni uuna laaŋe yi ŋööm Ijep, na ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na wïïl uuni wøk. Man beeye tiere gø ni köömma uuni ki gïn dïcäŋi en.
english: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the Lord thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo ŋata biel ree enø köö ni eni ba aay buut ŋata biel ree baŋ gø, kiper mana mëëre ki ŋatøgø ki jø paare, kiper na tïm bëëtö mare ni beer kanya bëëde ki ŋatøgø,
english: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

anywaa: ŋata biel ree baŋ gø wär lwöte ki muda, ni dii ïth gø ro odhuulu mar dhi øtø, ni thuth gø; ni put ŋatøgø bëëtö na ŋat tïïc jïre na bäre bäre. 'Ba teeŋ gïnögø doo tïïö thuwø dëër dhaagø mo ree ee bielø jï dhaanhø.
english: Then thou shalt take an awl, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo ree ee bielø jï dhaanhø mo manynya man aae, kär ec teek ki man wii, kiper tïïc mana tïïe jï dhaanhø ki cwiiri moø na abïciel yøø, kaala tïïc mana doo tïïc ŋat mo mägö ki gwel. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu dhaanhø ogwïëdhe ki gïïo tïïe bëët.
english: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

anywaa: «'Ba kaai mo dhäk mou ki kaai mo dïëk mou moa näk thwönhi wär cïbu kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. Käru purö ki kaai mo dhäk mou, ni ba nyaarru jïëc kaai mo dïëk mou.
english: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

anywaa: Uuni ki jøøa en mïëyu, kaai moøgø wär cammu ki yi cwiir cooth nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo näk ee jierø.
english: Thou shalt eat it before the Lord thy God year by year in the place which the Lord shall choose, thou and thy household.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo kaa manøgø da kare kany mo ogwäyö dëëre, kaamar ŋöödö wala cöörö wala gïn mo ogwäyö dëëre, kär cïp no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the Lord thy God.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man cami paac. Ni ŋat mo waany ki ŋat mo ba waany bëët løny jïge ki man camge gø, kaawat man wø cam rïŋ aŋer ki rïŋ purra jaak.
english: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

anywaa: 'Ba kär remme cam. Wär køny piny kaamar pïï.
english: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

anywaa: «'Ba cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wär wøørru jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yi dwääy mana cwøl na Abip, ni gwøgu dwäänögø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna käl wøk ki Ijep ki dï wäär yi dwäänögø.
english: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the Lord thy God: for in the month of Abib the Lord thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wøørru cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, wäru lwötu røk dïëk mou ki dhäk mou, ni cou ni ŋaru ge no olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo jiere noo caa ri nyeŋŋe.
english: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the Lord thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the Lord shall choose to place his name there.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na ra ajwöma manøgø, käru cämö ki dääpe mo ocoodø ki thømmø. 'Ba ki nïne abïriiø wäru cämö ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, ni beeye møga näk nyootha gïna leth kanya ööu wøk ki Ijep nou läädö. Ni cammu kaper nee dïcäŋ mana ööu wøk yie ki Ijep nee bëëde ni wïthu paayu paayø ki gø ki yïth nïr kwøw mou bëët.
english: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïne moø na abïriiø yøø, kär dee thømmø mo joot dï ŋöömmu bäre. Kär dee rïŋö mo buti mo këët amöölla ri rïŋ lääy moo cïpu no olämi ka abøøya yi cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

anywaa: «Uuno mänö ki man ŋaru olämme mo cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie yi pääny mana manynyu jaak røk päänye mou moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu;
english: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the Lord thy God giveth thee:

anywaa: 'ba wäru ŋädu kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo caa ri nyeŋŋe. Olämme mo cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wär ŋaru ka abøøya ni cäŋ pätha piny, ka teeŋ mana tïïyu kanya ööu wøk ki Ijep.
english: But at the place which the Lord thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni bullu gø ni cammu gø kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu. 'Ba no tïme na amöölla, u døøa yïth oduŋkaare mou.
english: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the Lord thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

anywaa: Nïne abïciel moøgø, u doo cämö ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø, 'ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne, wär tïme na kar acooŋa mo ena kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu. 'Ba dïcäŋögø kär dee tïïc mo tïïyu.
english: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the Lord thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.

anywaa: «'Ba wäru kwäänu ki nïne ma kar juu abïriiø. Nïne moøgø na kar juu abïriiø yøø wär kwaannu nou tägi ka dïcäŋo tägu ki kac beel.
english: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

anywaa: Køøre Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Køør Juu Abïriiø wär wøørru jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni ö ŋati man nø ni cïp gïna en cere ki køør met ec mare, ni cïpu ka køør gwïëth mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na gwïëth uuni ki gø.
english: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the Lord thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the Lord thy God, according as the Lord thy God hath blessed thee:

anywaa: Ni mïn yïthu nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, yi kanyo jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo caa ri nyeŋŋe, ni beeye uuni ki wäätu ki nyïïu, ki jø tïïc mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki wëëlle moa path, ki kïïe, ki määr thuunhnhi mo bëëdö ka uuni.
english: And thou shalt rejoice before the Lord thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the Lord thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

anywaa: 'Ba wïthu wär caarru  ki bëët laŋ mana beetu Ijep, ni gwøgu rou ki man koorru ciik moi ii.
english: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo lønynyu ki dïn caammi mou ki nywøp kwøk nyïïomøki mou, Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ni Jø Bëëdö Yïth Abïle dou wøørø ki nïne abïriiø.
english: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

anywaa: Ni mïn yïthu ka ajwömmögø, ni beege uuni ki wäätu, ki nyïïu, ki jø tïïc mou moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki wëëlle moa path, ki kïïe, ki määr thuunhnhi mo wø bëëdö ki uuni.
english: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

anywaa: Ajwöma manøgø dou tïïö ki nïne abïriiø jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo näk ee jierø. Kiper uuno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ki caammi mo wø ciek jïïu bëët, ki tïïe mou bëët mo wø tïïyu ki ceŋŋu. Køøre u jïtö ki met ec møn.
english: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the Lord thy God in the place which the Lord shall choose: because the Lord thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

anywaa: «'Ba kwöre adäk ki yi cwiir, cwøw bëët doo ööa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kanyo näk ee jierø, ni beeye kany wø tïme na kar Ajwöm Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø, ki kany wø tïme na kar Ajwöm Caammi Moo Kwøŋ Ciek, ki kany wø tïme na kar Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ni Jø Bëëdö Yïth Abïle. 'Ba ge ba doo ööa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki ceŋge jaak.
english: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the Lord empty:

anywaa: Ŋati man nø doo cïpö ki gïna näk løny jïre, ki køør gwïëth mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
english: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord thy God which he hath given thee.

anywaa: «'Ba wäru röönyu ki kwääri ki jø wø ŋøl luup yïth päänye mou bëët moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, ni røønynyu ki køør wïth tuŋi mou; ni ŋøørge luup jiy na karge.
english: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, luup moa näk karge kär daaŋge; kärge jëënyö; kärge kädö ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny, kiper jammi mo wø cïp ki piny waŋ ŋata wïïe leer di cøørø, ni daaŋ luup mo jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

anywaa: 'Ba wär tïmge ni ge caatha køør ŋøl ma kare keere keere, kiper nee ge bëëtge ni ge kwøw, ni ö ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu nee put bëëtö na maru.
english: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

anywaa: «Käru cööth piny ki jaadha näk otieŋø na näk ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara kiper dëëtu buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mano tïïyu jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu,
english: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the Lord thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

anywaa: ni ba cööthu piny ki kïdi kiper dëëtu nee lammu, kiper beeye gïn mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yie raac ki gø.
english: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the Lord thy God hateth.

anywaa: «Kär dee ŋat mo cïpö ki dhieŋ wala røømmø no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu mo da gïn mo oränynyö dëëre, wala da gïn mo ogwäyö ree, kiper beeye gïn mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yie raac ki gø.
english: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the Lord thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the Lord thy God.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da dïcwøø wala dhaagø mo bëëdö dïïu, yïth päänye mou moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, mo ojoodø ni tïïö ki gïn mo raac nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni dhala luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiye,
english: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the Lord thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the Lord thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

anywaa: ni aae ni tïny juu møøk, ni lam geni, wala lama cäŋ wala dwääy wala jap maal bëët mou kära köömmö ki geni nee lammu,
english: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

anywaa: kanyo caani jïïu wala noo wïnynyu gø, wär tier gïnögø manynyu ni pëënynyu gø døøc. 'Ba ni näk mo otïmö na adïëri møn, no ojoodø ni gïna näk Jwøk yie raac ki gø ee tïïö dï Icriel,
english: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

anywaa: dïcwøønøca wala dhaaŋŋeca na tïïc gïna raac enø, wär kïthu dhi kiir maru, ni këëru gø ki kïte këël mano thøøe.
english: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋatøgø wär 'näk ki køør gïno caan jøøa tïïc gïnögø buutge, ni beege jiy ariiø wala jiy adäk. 'Ba kär dee dhaanhø mo 'näk ki køør gïn mo caana dhaanhe acielli.
english: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa tïïc gïnögø buutge, ceŋge wär kwøŋge møør  maal ki man 'näkge gø, køøre ceŋ jiy møga wär läwge cään, nou raanynya gïna raac na en dïïu.
english: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da løøk mo teek døc mo løøa nyïm dïŋut luup mou, mo ba løny jïge ki man ŋølge gø, kiper man näk di kamø wala ba kam, teeŋ ka luum kwör, ki luum gïïpinyi, ki luum gïï mo ŋwiili mo otägö yïthakic jiy, wär öge maal ni cige kanyo näk ojier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu.
english: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the Lord thy God shall choose;

anywaa: Ni cige baŋ dïlämme, ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay, ki dïŋut luup mano en tïïci cere kar kaaca, ni pëënyge geni. Køøre luupögø oŋølge jïge.
english: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

anywaa: 'Ba wär tïïcge kaawat mano ŋøli jïge ni ge ena kanyo näk ojier Wuuö Jwøki. Ni gwøkge rege ki man tïïcge gïïa pwöny geni ki ge bëët.
english: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the Lord shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

anywaa: 'Ba wär tïïcge ki køør luup moo pwöny geni ki ge, kaawat mano ŋøli jïge. Kärge gaa wøk bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam ki ri luup moo pwöny geni ki geni.
english: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wïïe tïmö ni teek, ni ba wïny dwør dïlämi man wø cuŋŋi ni wø tïïö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni ba wïny dwør dïŋut luup, ŋatøca wär 'nägu; nou raanynya gïna raac dï Icriel.
english: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the Lord thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

anywaa: Køøre nø, gïnögø owïny jiyi bëët, ni lwäcge, ni ba tïm wïthge ni teek këët.
english: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo cou yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, noo lwørru na maru nou bëëdu yie, kanymør u köö nou röönyö ki nyeya, kaamar wïth juurre moo en lagu kaace.
english: When thou art come unto the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;

anywaa: 'Ba wär näk mo nyeya mano røønynyu jiera Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu, ni beeye dhaanhø mo lwørru ri tuuŋu, ni ba röönyu ki jur mo paa tuuŋu.
english: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the Lord thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenynyøgø ba doo määnyö ko okwëënyi mo thööth kiper dëëre, wala eni tïïya jiy nee døøge Ijep nee cäŋ jïtö ko okwëënyi mo thööth. Kiper acaan Wuuö Jwøki jïïu, ni ‹Käru døøk ki jöö manøgø këët.›
english: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the Lord hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya manøgø ni ba määnye ki mään mo thööth, nee cwïnye ba gaa wøk ki Wuuö Jwøk; ni ba määnye ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö mo päl kiper dëëre.
english: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo røøny nyeya manøgø, noo cïbi bäät wälu, eni ciik wär ŋwaal piny ki yi wëëlö mana en baŋ dïlämme, ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:

anywaa: Ni ö wëëlö manøgø ni bëëde buute ni kwäänö ki gø ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët, nee kwänynye ki man bëëde ni lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøe, ki man gwøk ciik bëët, ni kïth ge bäät tïïc,
english: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

anywaa: kiper nee cwïnye ba jïte ka atöör bäät tuuŋge, nee ba gaa bäät cwïïe wala bäät caame ki ri ciik, kiper nee eni ki nyïïkwaaye nee bëëtge ki cwiiri mo thööth yi nyec marge yïthakic jø Icriel.
english: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay bëët, këël moa näk dïlämme, doo bäŋ ŋöömö mo dööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakic jø Icriel. 'Ba geno tïmö ni ge cama olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk, ki gïï møøk mo wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk na kure.
english: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and his inheritance.

anywaa: Ni ge ba doo jïtö ki ŋöömö mo dööŋ jïge dï jø poge. 'Ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk noo dööŋ jïge ni caala ŋöömma doo dööŋ na kurge, kaawat mana caan gø jïge.
english: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the Lord is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

anywaa: «'Ba gïïo joot dïlämme baŋ jø wø cïpi ko olämme mo dhäk ki mo dïëk beege bat ki lëëmme karge riet ki pwöth ec.
english: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

anywaa: Gïïo kwøŋ ciek røk beel mou ki røk nyïïjenni mou ki røk mädhi mou, ki jïër moo kwøŋ nyäär wøk røk dïëk mou wär cïpu jï dïlämme.
english: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

anywaa: Kiper beege geni ki nyïïkwaacge na jier Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu dëët wïth tuŋi mou bëët, kiper nee cuŋge ni tïïge ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre.
english: For the Lord thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the Lord, him and his sons for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da ŋat tuuŋ Libay mo öö ni käla yi pääny mana bëëde yie røk  päänye mou dï Icriel, ni ööi ka met ec mare ni ci kanyo näk ojier Wuuö Jwøki,
english: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the Lord shall choose;

anywaa: løny ki man tïïe ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøe kaace, ni caala tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø cuŋŋi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, which stand there before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba mano came na kure otïmö ni röömi ki mano cam ŋati man nø røk jø tuuŋ Libay moøgø. 'Ba ni näk mo da gïï mo ee joodø baŋ wëëkge ki køør gïï møøk mo odwøk pwödhö, gïïögø ba doo kwaana røk japøgø.
english: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo pïïyu yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu, u ba doo kwänynyö ki ŋwaal gïï mo Jwøk yie raac ki geni baŋ juurre moo en kaace.
english: When thou art come into the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

anywaa: Kär dee dhaanhø mo joot dïïu mo waaŋa wääde wala nyaare ki maac no olämi, wala ŋat adïëda, wala ŋat mo tïïö ki wäälli, wala ŋat mo thöödhö ki war, wala ŋat ma ajwøa jaak,
english: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

anywaa: wala ŋat thïëth, wala ŋat mo waŋe riek ki jap ajuuk, wala ŋat mo ree da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa näk othøw.
english: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat mo tïïya teeŋ gïïögø, Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki gø. Ni beeye kiper teeŋ gïïögø ni reyø yøø noo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo riem juurre wøk nyïmmu.
english: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the Lord: and because of these abominations the Lord thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u doo bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö maru nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: Thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God.

anywaa: «Kiper juurre moo ŋøøpge lwørru wø leŋa gïr jø wø thöödhö ki war ki gïr jø adïëda. 'Ba uuni, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuna mäne ki man tïïyu teeŋ gïïögø.
english: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the Lord thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu otïŋ maal jïïu ki nyikuŋ Jwøk mo caala aani røk jø pou. 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk manece mare dou leŋø.
english: The Lord thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

anywaa: Gïnögø otïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ki køør kwac mana kwayu eni ki gø dïcäŋa cooŋŋu rou kanya ciel tier Kïn Körëp, na kööu, ni ‹Beerra man ba wïnywa dwør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø këët, ni ba cäŋwa teeŋ maac man ni dwøŋ en neennø, kiper nee wa ba thøwa.›
english: According to all that thou desiredst of the Lord thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the Lord my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö ki aani, ni ‹Gïna caange beeye gïn mo beer.
english: And the Lord said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.

anywaa: Aano tïŋ maal ki nyikuŋ Jwøk dï jø poge mo caala ïïni, ni cïba luup 'moa dhee, ni ö eni ni caan luupo köömma eni ki ge bëët jïge.
english: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø ba leŋ luupa moo caan nyikuŋ Jwøki manøgø ki nyeŋŋa, aani ki dëëra ŋatøgø pëënynya pëënynyö.
english: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk mo caana luup ki nyeŋŋa jaak ki wïïe keere, ni eni kära köömmö ki man caan ge, wala mo cäänö ki nyeŋ juu møøk, nyikuŋ Jwøk manøca doo nääö.›
english: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

anywaa: «'Ba kanymør u köö ki cwïnynyu, ni ‹?Luubö mo ba caana Wuuö Jwøki oŋäcwa gø nidïï?›
english: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the Lord hath not spoken?

anywaa: Gïno ŋäyu gø ki gø beeye en; kany wø näk mo nyikuŋ Jwøk cäänö ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni näk mo gïna cääne kipere ba thur kare wala ba tïmö na adïëri, gïneca beeye gïna näk kär caan Wuuö Jwøki. 'Ba beeye gïn mo caana nyikuŋ Jwøki manøgø ki wïïe keere jaak. Käru lwäyu ki gïno caane.
english: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the Lord, if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo thöör wïth juurre moo ŋøøpge cïbe jïïu, kanyo lwørru ŋøøm moge, nou bëëdu yïth päänye moge, ki yïth uudi moge,
english: When the Lord thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the Lord thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

anywaa: päänye adäk wär cïbu kur keerge kiper dëëtu, ni beege päänye mo ena dïër yi ŋöömö maru mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu nou lwørru na maru.
english: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it.

anywaa: Ni pääŋŋu ŋöömmu mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu na kwöre adäk, ni tïnynyu dëëtu ki uutjïëthe mo ci yïth päänye moø na adäk yøø, kiper nee ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø nee wø reŋ yi pääny aciel dëët päänye moøgø.
english: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

anywaa: «Gïna doo bëëdö ni caala ciik kiper ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø nee reŋ yi  pääny aciel røk päänye moøgø nee kwøe beeye en: Ŋat wäro näk watge ni ba kame, ni bäŋ män yïthakicge dïkwøŋ,
english: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

anywaa: teeŋ man wø aa dhaanhe paap ki nyawatge, ni ge ŋutö ki jenni, kanyo ŋute ki jaath, ni ö leyi ni kere ri løk ni pï ri nyawatge, ni ö nyawatge ni thøøe, teeŋ ŋatøgø løny jïre ki man reŋ yi pääny aciel røk päänye moøgø, nee kwøe.
english: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

anywaa: Kiper kanymør ŋato cool kwör gootø døc, ni reŋ køør gø ni mak gø ni 'näk gø, kiper mana tïm øtjöö ni bäär, këël na bëëde ni gïna tïïe ba doo duunnö ki thøø bääte, kiper bäŋ män yïthakicge dïkwøŋ.
english: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere gø en ni köömma uuni ki man cïbu päänye adäk kur keerge kiper dëëtu.
english: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ŋöömmu nyaanhe nyaanhø, kaawat mana kööŋe ki gø jï kwäyu, ni cïp ŋøøm bëët jïïu moa caane ni cïbe cïbö jï kwäyu,
english: And if the Lord thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;

anywaa: ni koorru wïthu ki man gwøgu ciik moi ni köömma uuni ki ge dïcäŋi en, ni mëërru ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, nou caatha køøre cooth, uuni päänye adäk møøk dou meeda bäät päänye moi na adäk ii kiper dëëtu.
english: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the Lord thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:

anywaa: Gïnögø otïïyu kiper nee dhaanhø mo bäŋ ajäla bääte nee remme ba køny piny dï ŋöömö maru mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo dööŋ jïïu na maru, nee bäŋe kwör mo en bäätu.
english: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the Lord thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo män ki watge, ni møør piny nyïme, ni ö maal, ni gøøc gø, ni thøøe, ni reŋ yi pääny aciel røk päänye moi na adäk ii,
english: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

anywaa: jø døøŋŋø mo pääny mana bëëde yie doo jäägö ki jiy ni lwørge eni kaace, ni duuge gø cer ŋata doo cool kwör, kiper nee 'näk.
english: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

anywaa: 'Ba kär cwïnynyu pädhö kipere, 'ba putu kwör ŋata näk bäŋ gïn mo ee baaø cool dï pou ma Icriel, kiper nee bëëtö maru tïme ni beer.
english: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.

anywaa: «Kär dee ŋat mo daaga gïna nyooth keew mar watge kare, mana no ocwöth kwäyu piny dïkwøŋ, yi ŋöömmo dööŋ jï ŋati man nø yi ŋöömmo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu nou lwørru na maru.
english: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess it.

anywaa: «U ba doo jïëy ki luum dhaanhø aciel keere mo köö kar løøk, ni ‹Gïnögø na tïïyi ya ŋatøgø, a nutö.› 'Ba luubö doo tïmö na kare ki køør gïna caan jiyi ariiø wala adäk moa tïïc gïnögø buutge.
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

anywaa: «Ni näk da dhaanhø mo cäänö ki tööt dëër dhaanhø mør kar løøk, ni kööe ni ŋatøgø da gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö,
english: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;

anywaa: geni na ariiø yøø ni pïëmö yïthakicge enø, wär cuŋge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nyïm dïlämme ki jø wø ŋøl luup yïth nïne moøgø.
english: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø ŋøl luup ni pëënyge geni, ni tetge geni døøc. 'Ba noo jootge gø ni ŋata löö ki watge caana tööt, ni eni löö ka gïn mo patha adïëri,
english: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;

anywaa: eni gïna cooŋe ki cwïnye nee tïïc dëër watge wär tïïc dëëre, nou raanynya gïna raac na en dïïu.
english: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.

anywaa: Køøre owïny jiy møga ni lwäcge, ni ba tïïge ki teeŋ gïno ni raac enø dïïu këët.
english: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.

anywaa: 'Ba kär cwïnynyu pädhö kipere, kiper jwïëy cool ka jwïëy, ni kwör waŋ cool ka waŋ, ni kwör lëëö cool ka lëëö, ni kwör cenø cool ka cenø, ni kwör tielø cool ka tielø.
english: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo aau wøk baŋ leny baŋ nyïïmännu, noo jootu okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni jiy thööth ni ge kaala uuni, käru lwäyö ki geni, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, nut buutu.
english: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, and a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the Lord thy God is with thee, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni kanyo tïm kar lenynyi ni cään, dïlämi wär nyänh buutu, ni cään jiy,
english: And it shall be, when ye are come nigh unto the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni ‹Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu gïn. Dïcäŋi u cøøa baŋ leny baŋ nyïïmännu. Kär cwïnynyu bwøk, ni ba lwäyu; kär cwïnynyu pädhö, ni ba kwany dëëtu ki lwär nyïmge,
english: And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;

anywaa: kiper  beeye Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu noo cäädhi ki uuni na aciel, noo këëdi ki nyïïmännu kiperu, noo køny uuni.›
english: For the Lord your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

anywaa: «Køøre cuumme wär cäänge ki jiy, ni köge, na ‹?Aŋa no ogëëdö ki øtø mo nyään mo poot kär bëëdö yi gø? Ŋatøgø aae ni døø paare, kiper kanymør eni thøw kar leny, ni ö dhaanhe mørri ni bëëde yi gø.›
english: And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge köö, na ‹?Aŋa no opïïdhö ki pwöth omøki mo poot bäŋ nyïëdi mo ee camø ri gø? Ŋatøgø aae ni døø paare, kiper kanymør eni thøw kar leny, ni ö dhaanhe mørri ni täge ki man cam nyïëdi moe.›
english: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not yet eaten of it? let him also go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man eat of it.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge köö, na ‹?Aŋa no omëëgö ki dhaagø mo poot käre nywømø? Ŋatøgø aae ni døø paac, kiper kanymør eni thøw kar leny, ni ö dhaanhe mørri ni nywøm dhaaŋŋøgø.›
english: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.

anywaa: Køøre ni cäŋ cuumme cäänö ki jiy, ni köge, na ‹?Aŋa ni lwäär, ni cwïnye obwøk? Ŋatøgø aae ni døø paare, kiper nee eni cwïny nyïïmenni ba wëëk böök kaawat mare.›
english: And the officers shall speak further unto the people, and they shall say, What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted? let him go and return unto his house, lest his brethren's heart faint as well as his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö cuumme noo lønyge ki cäänö ki jiy, wär kwänyge ki kwääc lwaae mo jø leny na wïth jiy.
english: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïmu nou pïï buut pääny mano këëdu ki gø, u doo jäägö ki dwør mëër dïkwøŋ.
english: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ge duunnö ki dwør mëër jïïu, ni japge dhi kiir jïïu, jiy bëët moa en yi päänyögø wär magu ni tïmge na jø tïïc jïïu, ni putge u tïnynyö.
english: And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ge ba duunni ki dwør mëër baŋu, ni täkge leny ki uuni, pääny marge wär rumu dïër.
english: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu noo cïp päänyögø ceŋŋu, cwøw bëët wär putu näk.
english: And when the Lord thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:

anywaa: 'Ba mään keerge ko obwöre ki lääc paac, ki gïïa en yi pääny bëët na twierru, wär källu kiper dëëtu, ni kønynyu rou ki jap nyïïmännu moo cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
