english: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki na kööŋe kipere, ba tuude ka uuni keeru,
english: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

anywaa: 'Ba eni tudö ka øøni bëët ni nut ni cuŋŋi kany nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø dïcäŋi en, ni tuude ka jiy mo poot kär nywølø.
english: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the Lord our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

anywaa: «Bëëtö mana bëëdø ki gø Ijep ŋäyu, ni wääth mana cäädhø ki gø na pöödhø ki dï wïth juurre ŋäyu thuwø.
english: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;

anywaa: Gïïa raac yi Jwøki ki ge na en jï juurre moøgø, ni beege juu moa en jïge, ni beege jenni ki kïte na näk ege tieŋø, ni tïïcge ka warkey ki gwet-bïrö, ajootu thuwø.
english: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee dhaanhø dïïu dïcäŋi, ma dïcwøø wala ma dhaagø, wala jø dhi øtø aciel, wala wï tuuŋ aciel, mo cwïnye døøa cään ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø, ni cøøe ni tïny juu mo wïth juurre. Kär dee dhaanhø dïïu mo tïmö kaamar jaath mo nywøl ki nyïëdi mo reyø mo keec;
english: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the Lord our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;

anywaa: kiper kanymør teeŋ ŋatøgø luup acëënne moi wïnynye wïnynyö, ni ŋwöye ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni ‹Bëëtö  mara poot na wøp jaak, këël na bëëda naa cäädhi ka køør teek cwïny mara.› Ka adïëri møn, teeŋ ŋatøgø, paac bäre ränynyö ki køøre.
english: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ba jïëy ki man wëën teeŋ ŋat ma enøgønø na bäre bäre, 'ba ki køør këëny mare, wëër mare liel kaamar maac dëër ŋatøgø. Køøre acëënne bëët moa näk ogöörö yi wëëlö man ööa bääte, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany nyeŋ gø, ni tïme ni kuc bäät piny.
english: The Lord will not spare him, but then the anger of the Lord and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the Lord shall blot out his name from under heaven.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø okwäny Wuuö Jwøki wøk yïthakic wïth tuŋi mo Icriel, nee gïn mo leth täge dëëre ki køør acëënne moa no ogöörö kiper luumma tuut yi wëël ciik man.
english: And the Lord shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

anywaa: «'Ba beenhnhø mano ööi cään, ki juurre mo käla kany mo bäär, kanyo jootge täwe ki gïïa leth na tägö yi ŋöömmu, na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, ge köö,
english: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the Lord hath laid upon it;

anywaa: ni ‹Ŋöömö bäre awaaŋ ni ränynye, ni tïme na bur ni caala acäbö, ni bäŋ gïn mo piith yie, ni bäŋ gïn mo ciek yie, ni bäŋe luum mo tuy yie, kaawat gïna tägö dëët päänye moa cwøl ni Cødam ki Gømöra ka Adama ki Dheböym, na raany Wuuö Jwøki ki køør wëër mare.›
english: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the Lord overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

anywaa: Køøre wïth juurre bëët ge köö, ‹?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc gïn yi ŋöömö man? ?Aperŋø na wëëre ki wëëyi ni dwøŋ døc en?›
english: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

anywaa: «Køøre oløk jiyi, ni köge, ni ‹Beeye kiper mana wecge luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäcge kanya käl geni wøk ki Ijep,
english: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

anywaa: ni cige ni tïnyge juu møøk, ni wøørge geni, ni beege juu mo kucge dïkwøŋ, mo kär caan Jwøki jïge nee lamge.
english: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk aliel bäätge kaamar maac yi ŋöömmögø, ni ö acëënne bëët moa näk ogöörö yi wëëlö man ni kïthi bäätge.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cööt ge wøk ki yi ŋöömö marge ni eno gootø døc, ni cwïnye da wëër mo ba thiinh, ni riem geni yi ŋöömö mørø, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.›
english: And the Lord rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.

anywaa: «Da luup mo tietge okanø mo ŋäya Wuuö Jwøki keere, 'ba luup bëët mo ciik moi na näk tietge ee nyuth øøni ko obwöre 'moø beege 'moø na bäre bäre, kiper nøø bëëdö ni ø gwøga ge.
english: The secret things belong unto the Lord our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo nø täk gïïögø bëët dëëtu, ni beege gwïëth ka acëënne moa cïba nyïmmu, kanyo parru wïthu ki geni nou ena kwöra ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na keeth uuni yïthge dï wïth juurre bëët,
english: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath driven thee,

anywaa: ni duuu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni beege uuni ko obwöre mou, ni leŋŋu dwøre ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre ki køør luup bëët mo köömma uuni ki ge dïcäŋi en,
english: And shalt return unto the Lord thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;

anywaa: kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu cwïnye pädhö ki gïru, ni duu uuni ki kwöra näk uuno maa ki tøŋ yïthge, ni cooŋ uuni kanya ciel ki dï wïth juurre bëët moa keeth uuni yïthge.
english: That then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni uuno keethø dï piny bäre, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu u cooŋe kanya ciel ki kwörögø, ni duu uuni ki kwöreka.
english: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu ni duu uuni yi ŋöömma bëëdö na mar kwäyu, ni putu gø lwør na maru. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc bëëtö maru ni beer, ni tïïc uuni nou thööth, ni tïmu nou kaala kwäyu.
english: And the Lord thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu cwïnynyu ki cwïny nyïïkwaayu wiile wiilø nou mëërru ki eni, e na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre, kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw.
english: And the Lord thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu acëënne moøgø bëët kïthe bäät nyïïmän mou ki bäät jiy moa yïthge reyø ki uuni na caan uuni.
english: And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.

anywaa: Kar kaace uuno cäŋ tïmö ni dwør Wuuö Jwøk leŋŋu leŋø, ni gwøgu ciik moe bëët mo köömma uuni ki ge dïcäŋi en.
english: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the Lord, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu u wëëge kwärö døc ki køør tïïe bëët mo wø tïïyu ki ceŋŋu, ni tïïc obwöre moo nywøllu ni thööth, ki lääc paac mou, ki caammi moo ciek yïth ŋøøm mou. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk yie cäŋa  mïnnö ki uuni, ni tïïc bëëtö maru ni beer, kaawat mana bëëde ni yie met ki kwäyu.
english: And the Lord thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the Lord will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:

anywaa: Gïïögø tïïc Wuuö Jwøki tïïö ni näk mo dwøre leŋŋu leŋø, ni gwøgu ciik moe moa näk ogöör piny yi wëël ciik man, ni duuu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ki cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre.
english: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the Lord thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.

anywaa: «'Ba ciik man ni köömma uuni ki gø dïcäŋi en patha ciik mo teek kiperu ki man kwanynyu tiere, ni patha gïn mo kare bäär ki uuni.
english: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.

anywaa: Ciik manøgø ba caal gïn mo ena maal, mou cäänö kipere, ni kööu, na ‹?Aŋa noo ci maal kiperø, nee käle jïïø, ni caan gø jïïø nee wïnynyø, kiper nee gwøø?›
english: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

anywaa: Ni ciik manøgø ba caal gïn mo ena løø naama dwøŋ løøga, mou cäänö kipere, ni kööu, na ‹?Aŋa noo ŋut løø naama dwøŋ løøga kiperø, nee käle jïïø, ni caan gø jïïø nee wïnynyø, kiper nee gwøø?›
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø kare cään ki uuni døc, ni ena dhøgu, ni ena cwïnynyu, kiper nee gwøgu.
english: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.

anywaa: «Neennu, dïcäŋi kwøw ki bëëtö mo beer acïba nyïmmu, ni cïba thøø ki bëëtö mo teek nyïmmu.
english: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;

anywaa: 'Ba a köömma uuni dïcäŋi ki man mëërru ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ki man caathu køøre, ni gwøgu ciik moe ki luup ŋøl moe, kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw ni nyaayu, nee Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu nou gwïëdhe yi ŋöömmo cou yie nou lwørru na maru.
english: In that I command thee this day to love the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

anywaa: «'Ba mara caana caanø jïïu dïcäŋi ennø. Ni näk mo cwïnynyu gaa wøk, ni ba leŋŋu dwøre, ni ö wïthu ni maaŋŋi ni tïmu nou wøøra juu møøk, ni tïnynyu geni,
english: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, u thum ki thøø. U ba bëëdö ki kany mo bäär yi ŋöömmo ŋutu yie løø Naam Jördan løøga nou cou yie nou lwørru na maru.
english: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

anywaa: «Dïcäŋi ennø, maal ki piny atïmö ni beege gïïo ŋäc luummi en yïthakiyø ki uuni. Kwøw ki thøø acïba nyïmmu, ni cïba gwïëth ka acïëni nyïmmu. Kiper manøgønø, jierru kwøw, kiper nee uuni ki nyïïkwaayu nou bëëdu nou kwøw.
english: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna dou tïïö kiree beeye ki man mëërru ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni leŋŋu dwøre, ni göögu ree, kiper beeye gïno jïtu ki kwøw ki køøre, noo døøc nïr kwøw mou mo thööth, kiper nou bëëdu yi ŋöömma kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere ni cïbe cïbö jï kwäyu, ni beege Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap.»
english: That thou mayest love the Lord thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the Lord sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe luup moi acäŋ caannø jï jø Icriel bëët;
english: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Aani, cwiiri moa beeda aløny ni dïpa ki pïërariiø ennø, ni wääth ki tïïc ba løny jïra këët. Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki aani thuwø ni kööe, ni ‹Ï ba ŋut løø Naam Jördan løøga këët.›
english: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the Lord hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu beeye noo ŋut løøga nyïmmu, ni thöör wïth juurre nyïmmu, kiper nee ŋøøm moge lwørru na maru kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki. Jøcua beeye noo ŋut løøga nyïmmu.
english: The Lord thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the Lord hath said.

anywaa: Teeŋ gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëër Cëëwön ki Ög, nyec jø Amör, kanya thöör geni ni raany ŋøøm moge, gïnögø tïïe tïïö dëët wïth juurre moøgø thuwø.
english: And the Lord shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

anywaa: Geno cïp Wuuö Jwøki ceŋŋu, ni putu gïna tïïyu tïïc dëëtge ki køør luup bëët moa köömma uuni ki ge.
english: And the Lord shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

anywaa: Magu rou ni bëëdu nou teek, ni ba lwäyu, ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu ki geni, kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo cäädhi nyïmmu. U ba leeŋ piny, ni ba wec uuni.»
english: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe Jøcua acwøle ni cääne ki gø nyïm jø Icriel bëët ni kööe, «Mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek, kiper ïïni, ï aay ki jøøi ii ni ciï yi ŋöömma kööŋ Wuuö Jwøki kipere ni cïbe cïbö jï kwäcge, ni pääŋŋï gø jïge, nee dööŋe na marge.
english: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the Lord hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo bwøth maal nyïmï, ni eni bëëdö buutï. Ï ba  leeŋ piny, ni ba wec ïïni. Kärï lwäyö, ni ba bwøk cwïnyï.»
english: And the Lord, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe ciik moøgø agöör piny ni mëëk gø dïlämme, ni beege nyïïkwaac Libay, jøøa käär acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy. Ni cïbe kaperge bëët ki jø døøk Icriel.
english: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and unto all the elders of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jøøgø aköömme ni kööe, ni «Kany wø tïme na bïriet cwiiri cooth, ni beeye cwiin wø wec pïït yie, ciik moi dou kwaanø nyïm jø Icriel bëët ni wïnyö jïge, ni kwaanna kanyo näk kar Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ni Jø Bëëdö Yïth Abïle,
english: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

anywaa: ni beeye kany wø ö jø Icrielli bëët wø öge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yi kanya näk ee jierø.
english: When all Israel is come to appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy wär cooŋu kanya ciel ge bëët, ni beege cwøw ki mään ko obwöre ki juurre moo bëëdö dïïu, kiper nee ciik moi wïnyge, nee kwänyge ki man lwäärge Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni koorge wïthge ki man gwøkge luup ciik moi bëët.
english: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the Lord your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaacge moo kuc ciik, ciik moøgø wïnyge wïnyö, ni kwänyge ki man lwäärge Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ki yïth nïne bëët moo beetu yi ŋöömmo ŋutu yie løø Naam Jördan løøga nou lwørru na maru.»
english: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the Lord your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Neenï, kar thøø marï aløny ni cään. Cwøl Jøcua ni cou ni cuŋŋu dho oduŋkaany røømmø kiper nee eni cuuma.» Køøre Modhe ki Jøcua acøø ni cuŋge dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe yo oduŋkaany røømmø, ni ena yi pöölö mo ree ee wenyø, ni ö pööllögø ni cuŋŋe dho oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And the Lord appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe, ni «Neenï, ï thøw ni läpï køør kwäyu. 'Ba jøøi ii, kanyo pïïcge yi ŋöömö mano cige yie enø, ge gëëmö ki aani ni tïm cwïnyge no onieŋ køør juu møøk, kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp; ni wecge aani, ni kwierge luubö mana tuuda ki geni.
english: And the Lord said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

anywaa: 'Ba wëër mara puta liel dëëtge kaamar maac dïcäŋöca. Aani, ge wiia wiiø ni kana täärnyïma ki geni; ni pïïc gïï mo lethi ki gïï mo reyø bäätge, ni putge thumö ki thøø. 'Ba kar kaaca geno köö, na ‹Aŋø, paa per Wuuö Jwøk na tøøre dïïø ni pïïc gïï ni leth bäätø en?›
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, täärnyïma kana kanø ki ge dïcäŋöca ki køør gïïo reyø bëët noo tïïcge, kiper ge tïmö ni ge caatha køør juu møøk.
english: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ïïni ki Jøcua, gööru duut man piny, ni pwönynyu jø Icriel ki gø nee kwanyge, kiper nee tïme na duut mo nyootha luumma en yïthakicwa ki jø Icriel kanyo jääla geni.
english: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper kanyo kïtha geni yi ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jï kwäcge, kanyo cämge ni jäŋge ni tïmge ni geno kwär ki jammi, kar kaaca ge tïmö ni ge caatha køør juu møøk, ni tïnyge geni, ni wecge aani, ni kwierge luumma tuuda ki geni.
english: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni gïï mo leth ki gïï mo reyø pïï bäätge, duut man otïmö na gïn mo nyootha bääyö marge jïge; ni bëëde na duut mo nut dhøk nyïïkwaacge ni ge wära gø cooth, ni wïthge ba wïl ki gø. Kiper acaara mano caarge ki cwïnyge dïcäŋi enø, ŋääa cøøn këël na bëëde ni ge poot kära kïth yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jï kwäcge.»
english: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Modhe duut manøgø aput göör piny dïcäŋögø, ni put jø Icriel pwönynyö ki gø.
english: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk Jøcua o Nun acuume ni kööe, «Mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek, kiper beeye ïïni noo kïth jø Icriel yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere jïge. 'Ba aani, a bëëdö naa ena buutï.»
english: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na thöör luup ciik bëët ki göör piny yi wëëlö, ni bäŋgø mo odööŋ,
english: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

anywaa: eni na Modhe enø jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø käär acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy aköömme ni kööe,
english: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwørru wëël ciik man ni cïbu gø buut acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, kiper nee bëëde kaace na gïn mo nyootha bääyö maru.
english: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.

anywaa: Kiper aani ageem maru ki teek cwïny maru ŋääa. Neennu, uuna nø gëëmö ki Wuuö Jwøk naa poot nut naa kwøw. ?A noo thøøa nø, naa tøør dïïu, a teeŋ ageem mo nyïëdi noo tïïyu?
english: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the Lord; and how much more after my death?

anywaa: 'Ba cooŋŋu jø døøŋŋø mo wïth tuŋi mou bëët ki cuumme mou kanya ciel buuta, kiper nee luup moi caana ni wïnyö jïge; ni tïm maalli ki piny na gïïo ŋäc luummi en yïthakicwa ki geni kiper bääyö marge.
english: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ni kanyo tïme na køør thøø mara, u tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ni weyu luupa köömma uuni ki geni. 'Ba yi nyïme gïï mo reyø opäth bäätu, kiper gïïo tïïyu beege gïï mo reyø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Wuuö Jwøk yie cwaatu cwaadø këël mano wëëre ki køør gïïo reyø noo tïïyu ki ceŋŋu.»
english: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe luup moa en yi duut acaane jï jø Icriel bëët moa näk dëëtge ege cooŋ kanya ciel, këël mana thum luupi bëët.
english: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moa en yi duut na caan Modhe beege ii; ena köö, «Wui maal ki piny, beerra man cegu ïthu ki gïno caana; ni wïnynyu luup moo ö wøk ki dhaa.
english: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm luup pwöc 'moa ni caala pï køth; ni tøønge kaamar thööy mo tøøna bäät luum mo marr; ni tïme kaamar køth mo thiinhnhi bäät gïï mo opiidhø;
english: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

anywaa: kiper a køpa gïr Wuuö Jwøk. Beerra man pwøø Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø kiper dööŋö mare.
english: Because I will publish the name of the Lord: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø teek, ni tïïe moe beege karge; ni uutjïëthe moe bëët tiir. Ena Jwøk mo mare di ŋäädhö, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac jïre; eni beer ni mare thïïŋ.
english: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

anywaa: «'Ba jø Icriel gïïa tïïcge dëëre beeye gïï mo reyø. Kiper rääö marge gena tïmö ni patha obwöre moe, ni tïmge na beenhnhø mo raac mo döönni.
english: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, u ka bøøre møn, ni wïthu ba leer, uuna cäŋ tïmö nou tïïya gïï mo reyø na kar gïïa beyø na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki jïïu? ?Aŋø, eni paa wääu na cwääc uuni, na tïïc uuni ni tietu këëtge piny?
english: Do ye thus requite the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

anywaa: «Parru wïthu ki nïne mo acääŋŋe, ni caarru wïthu ki cwiiri moa beet beenhnhe mou bëët. Pëënynyu wëëgu, nee caange jïïu; ni pëënynyu jäle mou thuwø, nee caange jïïu.
english: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

anywaa: Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, kanya pääŋ ŋøøm jï wïth juurre, ni beeye kanya pääŋ jiy ki dïge, keee mo jiy aŋøre, ni cïp kur wäät Icriel kur keere ki køør kwäänge.
english: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper kure, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, beege jiye ma jø Icriel, ni beege geni na nyïïkwaac Jeekap na dööŋ jïre na moe.
english: For the Lord's portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

anywaa: «Gena joode ni bëëtö marge teek,  ni caala bëët dï paap mo otal, na kany mo dïtëën mo lääy jwöŋö yie. Ni ö eni ni ciel geni dïër ni koor ge; ni gwøk ge kaamar guu waŋ.
english: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö odhuuthi wø käl nyïïe wøk ki yi øde ni määde bäätge, ni peer bwöpe, ni käär nyïïe ki bäät bwöpe, Wuuö Jwøk thuwø jiye ma nyïïkwaac Jeekap akääre ni ee gwøø.
english: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

anywaa: Beeye Wuuö Jwøk keere na bwøth geni, ni bäŋ jwøk mør mo ena buutge.
english: So the Lord alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

anywaa: «Gena wëëk Wuuö Jwøki bëëtö kwöra perge leth bäät thuuri; ni camge cam mana ciek yïth pwöth. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni caam ge ki maar kïc man wø joot yi kïdi; ni caam ge thuwø ki mäth jenni mo wø piith yi ŋöömma näk gii.
english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

anywaa: Ni caam ge ki mäth dhäk, ki caa dïëk, ki rïŋ nyïïdïëk mo olør; ki rööm ma thwönhi mo beyø mo käla Baacan, ka atëëe ma thwönhi, ki beel mo beyø døc; ni mäthge ki kwøk nyïïomøki mo met.
english: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

anywaa: «'Ba jø Icriel na jier Wuuö Jwøki nee bëëtge ki bëëtö mo tiir, kanya nø cämge ni lørge, ni døøŋ dëëtge, ni tïm dëëtge ni beyø, gena tïmö kaamar dhieŋ mo bädö; ni wecge Jwøk na cwääc geni, ni taakge eni na Jwøa teek ni wø køny geni.
english: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge nee këëye ki køør juuga path na lamge. Ni cwaatge yi Wuuö Jwøk këël mana wëëre ki køør gïïa raac yie ki ge na tïïcge.
english: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

anywaa: Gena cïpö ko olämme jï juu mo reyø mo patha Jwøk ma adïëri, ni beege juu mo kucge dïkwøŋ, na juu mo nyärö mo jootge cään mo kär wøør kwäcge dïkwøŋ.
english: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

anywaa: U na jø Icriel, Jwøa teek na cwääc uuni aweyu, ni wïl wïthu ki eni na mooc uuni ki jwïëy.
english: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïna tïïc wääte ki nyïïe, ni beege jø Icriel, ajoode, ni männe ki geni kiper mana cwaatge yie këël mana wëëre.
english: And when the Lord saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni ‹Täärnyïma kana kanø ki geni; nee gïno tägi dëëtge yi nyïme nee jooda. Kiper gena beenhnhø mo raac, ni gena obwöre mo ba ŋääth.
english: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

anywaa: Aana tïïcge naa këëya ki køør mana lamge juu mo patha adïëri, ni cwaatge yia këël mana wëëra kiper juu moge na näk oballe jaak. 'Ba ge tïïa tïïö nee këëge kiper jiy mo bäŋ karge; ni cwaada yïthge ki ri wï jur mo bäŋ gïn ŋääe.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

anywaa: Kiper wëër mara äpö kaamar maac, ni liele këël mano këët Ciöl, kanya näk kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw; ni waaŋ piny bäre ki gïïa en yie bëët ni thöör ge; këël kïte na näk tietge okëët piny waaŋe waaŋø.
english: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

anywaa: « ‹Gïï mo leth lööra bäät jø Icriel, ni thööya geni ka athëëre 'moa.
english: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

anywaa: Ge raany käci raanynyø, ni thumge ki täwe mo leth;  ni thumge ki thumö mo raac døc. Ni jääŋŋa lääc paap baŋge nee ge cam; ni jääŋŋa thwöre mo dhøkge da cïm baŋge.
english: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

anywaa: Thøø otïmö ni dagø dï paac ki køør leny, ni tïm lwärri ni dagø yïth uudi; ni täk gïïögø dëët wøpe moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ko obwöre moa therø, këël jäle moa näk wïthge da lwaar.
english: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

anywaa: Aana köö ni ge daa thöörö na bäre nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo par gïrge këët.
english: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

anywaa: 'Ba a lwäära ŋwøc mano tïïc nyïïmän; kiper kanymør tier luubö manøgø daakge daaø, ni köge ni beeye geni ki dëëtge na bööt jø Icriel, ni patha a na Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc gïnögø dëëtge.›
english: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the Lord hath not done all this.

anywaa: «Jø Icriel beege jiy mo wïthge bäŋ acaara, ni tiet luup ba kwanyge ni beer døøc.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

anywaa: Doo na gena jiy mo wïthge leer, tier gïnögø dege kwanyø; ni caarge gïno tägi dëëtge yi nyïme.
english: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

anywaa: ?Aŋø, doo na ge kär wec Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøge na teek, na cïp geni ceŋ nyïïmänge, nyimän aciel jø Icriel ma kuma a dee gø riemmø nidïï? ?A nyïïmän ariiø thuwø jiy ma kume apaar a dege gø riemmø nidïï?
english: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the Lord had shut them up?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jwø nyïïmän ba caal Jwøk marø na teek; këël nyïïmän 'moø ki dëëtge gïnögø ŋäcge.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmän moøgø ki dëëtge, gena jiy mo reyø kaamar jø Cødam ki Gømöra; ge caala nyïïomøki mo keec mo dëëtge da cïm.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

anywaa: Ge caala køøŋ nyïïomøki mo tïïc ka cïm mar thwöl, ni beeye cïm mar thwöra no olwierø ni wø nääö.
english: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ‹?Aŋø, gïr nyïïmän moøgø patha yaa kan cwïnya cøøn, ni luumge yaa göör piny yi wëëlö mara?
english: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

anywaa: Cool kwör beeye mara, ni ŋøl luup ena cera. Yi nyïme kanya wäŋŋa ni ge pädhö yie, ge puta pädhö, kiper ränynyö marge kare cäännö, ni ö gïïa lethi na reyø ni laar päth bäätge.›
english: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo neen gø ni teek mar jiye bäŋgø këët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo odööŋ këët, këël laŋŋø, kar kaaca jiye di ŋunnö, ni päth cwïnye ki gïrge, ge na laaŋe moe.
english: For the Lord shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jiye opëënynye ni kööe, ‹?Aŋø, age juuga teek mou, moa ŋääthu na kannu rou buutge?
english: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

anywaa: ?Aŋø, juuga cam dwäle mo olämme mou, na maath køøŋ nyïïomøki mou moa cïpu na muuce, ge enge kaa? Beerra man öge maal ni kønyge uuni, ni tïmge na juu mo kanu rou buutge.
english: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ennø, wär ŋäyu ni beeye aani keera na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ jwøk mør këët.  Beeye aani ni wø wëëk dhaanhø thøø, ni beeye aani ni wø wëëk dhaanhø kwøw. Beeye aani ni wø wëëk jiy jïtö ki ŋwiili, ni beeye aani ni wø køny ŋwiili mo jiy. 'Ba bäŋ jwøk mør mo løny jïre ki man piem dhaanhø cera.
english: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn ceŋŋa ŋaaba maal, ni kööŋŋa ŋëëta keera, ni caana mara ni kööa,
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

anywaa: ni tøŋa na beth paa paaø, ni täga ki ŋøl luup, ni tøŋ ena cera. Kwöra coola coolø dëët nyïïmänna, ni jääla jiy mo wø män ki aani.
english: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

anywaa: Ni tïm dhøk tøøŋi 'moa ni thec ki remø; ni ö opëëllö mara ni thöör geni. Ni ö tøøk leny 'moa ni bïtge ki rem jiy moa näk okëërö ki tøøŋi, ki moa näk omaaø ri leny røk dïbwöthe mo nyïïmän.›
english: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

anywaa: «'Ba u na wïth juurre, beerra man mïn yïthu ki jic Wuuö Jwøk bëët, kiper Wuuö Jwøk kwör jiye di coolø, ni cool kwöre dëët nyïïmän moe, ni wëën raay moa tïïc jiyi yi ŋöömma cïbe jïge.»
english: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe aöö ki Jøcua o Nun ni caan luup mo duut manøgø ni wïnyö jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na lønye ki caan luupögø bëët jïge,
english: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

anywaa: ena köö, ni «Gwøgu luup moi bëët ni köömma uuni ki ge dïcäŋi en; ni köömmu obwöre mou ki luup ciik moøgø bëët kiper nee gwøkge ni kïthge ge bäät tïïc.
english: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

anywaa: Kiper luup moøgø patha luup mo oballe jaak kiperu; 'ba beege luup mo duunnö ki kwøw jïïu. Ni luupögø nïr kwøw mou moo beetu meetge meedø yi ŋöömmo ŋutu yie løø Naam Jördan løøga noo lwørru na maru.»
english: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni ethï wï Kïn Nebø na en bäät Kïn Abarim yi ŋööm Möap na dïët ki Jerikö; ni neenï ŋööm Keenan mano cïba jï jø Icriel na moge.
english: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

anywaa: Køøre ïïno thøw bäät kïnno ciï bääte, ni läpï køør jø pou kaamar coku ma Aran na thøø bäät Kïn Öör na läp køør jø poge.
english: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

anywaa: Gïnögø tägö dëërï kiper ïïni ki coku ma Aran uuna bääyö dëëra nyïm jø Icriel yi Kadëc na en dï paap Dhïn ri luum pï Meriba. Ni käru aani wøørø ki wödö ma kare nyïm jø Icriel.
english: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, løny jïrï ki man neenï ŋööm Keenan ni karï bäär ki gø; 'ba ba løny jïrï ki man ciï yi ŋöömmögø noo cïba jï jø Icriel enø.»
english: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye gwïëth mana ö Modhe dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na gwïëth jø Icriel ki gø kanya poode ni eni poot kär thøw, ni kööe,
english: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

anywaa: ni «Wuuö Jwøk aöö ki yi Caynay, ni ööe ki yi Cëër kaamar cäŋ mo tuulö, ni rienye ki bäät Kïn Paran; ni ööi ki dï nyïïatwiet maal ma kume apaar; ni cere mana en bäät cwïïe da ciik mo liel kaamar maac kiper jø Icriel.
english: And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk mëër ki jiy; nyïïatwieli moe bëët na en kur keerge bëëdö ni ena cere. Dëëtge ege cooŋ buute, ni ge wïnynya pwöc moe.
english: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.

anywaa: Modhe øøna köömme ki ciik,  ni beeye gïno dööŋ jïïø na marø, ø na nyïïkwaac Jeekap en.
english: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

anywaa: Ni kanya ö dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi moø, ø na jø Icriel, na bëëtge ni geno dwätö na aciel, Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya marø, ø na jiere nøø bëëdö ki bëëtö mo tiir.»
english: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe jø tuuŋ Ruben agwïëdhe ni kööe, ni «Jø tuuŋ Ruben bëëdö ni kwøw, ni wïthge ba dïdi, këël na bëëde ni kwään jø tuuŋge nøk.»
english: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Juuda beeye en, ena köö, «Awuuö Jwøk, wïny kwac mar jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni duuï geni baŋ jø tuuŋge ki jööt dëël. Geni rege amakge ki man këëtge ki nyïïmän. Beerra man kønyï geni kany wø këëtge ki nyïïmän moge.»
english: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Libay beeye en, ena köö, «Awuuö Jwøk, gïïa cwøl ni Thumim ki Urim na näk moï, ni wø nyooth man wø manynyï, ï na Jwøk, beerra man bëëtge ni ena cer dhaanhnhï man wø jierï røk jø tuuŋögø; ni da ŋata päänynyï kanya cwøl ni Maca, na pïëmï ki gø ri luum pï Meriba.
english: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Libay beege na taak wëëkge ki mëëkge kiper tïïc marï, na kwier nyïïmëëkge, na wec obwöre moge. Kiper geni luummï akïthge cwïnyge ni kïthge gø bäät tïïc, ni gwøkge luummï na tuutï.
english: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Libay nyïïkwaac Jeekap opwönyge ki luup ŋøl moï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwönyge ge na jø Icriel ki ciik moï. Ge wø cïpö ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpge ko olämme jïrï mo wø waaŋ bäre bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gwïëth jap jø tuuŋ Libay bëët, ni mïn yiï ki tïïe bëët mo wø tïïcge ki ceŋge. Beerra man raanynyï teek mar jø wø many leny ki geni, këël jø wø män ki geni, kiper nee ba lønye jïge ki man cäŋge ö maal baŋ leny këët.»
english: Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jø tuuŋ Benjamen na mëër Wuuö Jwøki ki ge, ge bëëdö ni geno gwøk Wuuö Jwøki, ni wø koor geni ki yïth nïne bëët; ni bëëtge ni ge ena cere.»
english: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Jocep beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ŋøøm moge ogwïëth Jwøki, ni jïtge ki køth ki thööy mo orømø, ki näm mo kwödö yïth ŋøøm moge.
english: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

anywaa: Ni ö cäŋŋi ni wëëk caammi mo beyø ciek na karge yïth ŋøøm moge; ni ö caammi moge ni ciekge ki dwäde moa näk karge.
english: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

anywaa: Ni tuc gïï mo beyø bäät kïte moge moa nut cøøn; ni tïme ni nuta gïïa beyø na tuy bäät thuuri moge ni wø bëëdö cooth.
english: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

anywaa: Ni jït ŋøømmi ki gïï mo beyø ni røm ŋöömö bäre; ni ö met yi Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree ki dï abuŋŋö ni tïme ni nutö kiperge. Beerra man thur gïïögø bëët karge jï jø tuuŋ Jocep, ge na kwarge ma Jocep bëëdö ni dwøŋŋa kare dï uutwänni.
english: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

anywaa: Ge jïtö ki teek ni tïmge kaamar thwønh dhieŋ ma kaa, ni tïmge ni teek kaamar jööbi ni wø cööp jiy ki tuge; ni ö geni ni riemge jiy këël mano këët cuŋ piny. Ni jøw rëëmö røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem o Jocep beege jiy mo thööth mo kaala kume apaar, ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca o Jocep mo kaala kuma.»
english: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Dhebulan ki jø tuuŋ Icakar beeye en, ena köö, ni «Beerra man mïn yïth jø tuuŋ Dhebulan ki jø tuuŋ Icakar, kiper geno bëëdö ni yïthge met ki tïïe moge, ni mïn yïthge kanyo bëëtge ni dëëtge ege jwömö mïëri moge.
english: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.

anywaa: Geni, jø møøk cwølge cwølø ni öge bäät kïnno jier Wuuö Jwøki, ni cïpge ko olämme ma karge kaace ni jøøgø nutö. Geni, geno kän wøk ki gïï mo thööth ki yi naam, ki gïï mo perge leth mo kuc ya akwöö dïkwøŋ.»
english: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Gaat beeye en, ena köö, ni «Gwïëth oen jï ŋato nyaac ŋøøp jø tuuŋ Gaat. Jø tuuŋ Gaat møøra piny kaamar ŋuu, ni wø cööt ceŋ dhaanhø wøk ki wï gø bëët.
english: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Gaat, ŋøøm moa beyø ajierge kiper dëëtge; ni ö ŋöömö mana näk mar dïbwödhi ni dööŋe jïge. Ni pööthge maal nyïm jiy, ni tïïcge gïna beer na many Wuuö Jwøki; këël luup ŋøl moa cem Wuuö Jwøki otïïcge na aciel ki jø Icriel.»
english: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord, and his judgments with Israel.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Daan, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jø tuuŋ Daan caala nyi ŋuu mo päny wøk ka yi lur Baacan.»
english: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Naptali beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jø tuuŋ Naptali onø gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki døc ki køør met yie. Ŋøøm moa en buut Puul Galili cøøa jïge.»
english: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess thou the west and the south.

anywaa: Mana caan Modhe kiper jø tuuŋ Acer beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jø tuuŋ Acer onø gwïëth ni kadha geni ki jø tuŋi møga. Beerra man bëët jø tuŋi møga ni yïthge met ki geni; beerra man tïm ŋøøm moge ni caammi ciek yie.
english: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

anywaa: U na jø tuuŋ Acer, dïdëëte mo dhøk kiiri mou otïïc ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni bëëdu nou teek ki yïth nïr kwøw mou bëët.»
english: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.

anywaa: Ni kö Modhe, ni «Bäŋ Jwøk mo caala Jwø Jecurun, ni wø mëëre ki geni.  eni öö ki maal ni öö kuna køny geni, ni cäädhi ki yïth pøøl ka ajiem mare.
english: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.

anywaa: Jwøk na nut cøøn beeye eni wø bëëdu ree ni wø gwøk uuni; ni bëëdö ni u ee jølø cooth ki ceŋŋe. Ni beeye eni na riem nyïïmännu wøk nyïmmu; ni caan gø jïïu kiper nee geni thööru.
english: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëtge; ni ö geni na nyïïkwaac Jeekap yøø ni bëëtge keerge yi ŋöömö mo yie da beel ki pï nyïïomøki, na ŋöömö mo maal cïpö ki køth ki thööy jïre cooth.
english: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.

anywaa: U na jø Icriel, uuna jiy mo dëëtu gum. ?Aŋø, da jiy mo caala uuni mo okøny Wuuö Jwøki kaamar maru? Eni caala kwöt leny maru, ni beeye eni wø køny uuni. Eni caala opëëllö mo uuno jïtö ka ajiem ki køøre. Ni tïm nyïïmännu ni lwäär ki uuni, ni putu geni böötö na bäre.»
english: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.

anywaa: Køøre Modhe aay ki yi pwöl Möap, ni eth wï Kïn Pedhega, na en bäät Kïn Nebø jï kuna dïët ki Jerikö. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth ŋööm Gelät bäre jï gø këël mana këët Daan,
english: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the Lord shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,

anywaa: ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Naptali bäre, ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda bäre këël mana këët deŋ naama dwøŋ na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

anywaa: Ni nyooth ŋöömma cwøl ni Nëgëp ki pwölla en yi goor Jerikö, päänya näk yie da twöe, këël mana këët Dhöär.
english: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Modhe, ni «Manøgø beeye ŋöömö mana kööŋa kipere jï Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap na kööa ni cïba cïbö jï nyïïkwaacge. Ennø, ŋöömö manøgø ïïna wëëga neen gø nee jootï ki waŋï; 'ba ba løny jïrï ki man ciï kaace.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk athøø yi ŋööm Möap kaace kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki.
english: So Moses the servant of the Lord died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni koonyi yi gool yi ŋööm Möap na näk dïët ki kanya cwøl ni Bëëth-Pëëgör; 'ba bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc kanya koony Modhe yie këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Beth–peor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni Modhe beeye dhaanhø mo jaal mo cwiiri moe dïpa ki pïërariiø, kanya thøøe eni nyeŋŋe poot rääŋö ni beyø jaak, ni dëëre poot teek jaak.
english: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni jwøkge Modhe ki nïne mo pïëradäk yi pwöl Möap. Køøre nïr kïmmö ki nïr jwøk moa jwøk Modhe ki gø athum.
english: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua o Nun dëëre apäŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk ni bëëde ni wïïe leer ki køør mana ö Modhe na cïp ceŋŋe bäät gø. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni leŋge dwøre ni tïïcge gïïa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge.
english: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge kar kaaca nø, bäŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk mo othïïŋö dï Icriel mo ŋäc Wuuö Jwøki kaamar Modhe;
english: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

anywaa: kiper beeye Modhe na tïïc ŋïïce ki gïïa näk rëëma ec bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na jääŋ eni ki ge nee tïïe dëër Peerø nyeny Ijep ki jø tïïc moe bëët këël ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: In all the signs and the wonders, which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,

anywaa: Ni bäŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk mo jïre da teek wala mo otïïö ki gïï mo di lwäärö kaawat mana tïïc Modhe nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø thøw Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Jøcua o Nun, ŋat tïïc mar Modhe, ni kööe,
english: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord it came to pass, that the Lord spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,

anywaa: ni «Dhaanhnha ma Modhe anø thøw; ennø, ö maal, ni ŋutï løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni beeye ïïni ki jøøi bëët ii; ni cou yi ŋöömmo wëëga geni, ge na jø Icriel.
english: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kany mo you gudö ki tietu jaak, yaa nø cïp jïïu na maru, kaawat mana nø caana gø jï Modhe.
english: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.

anywaa: Ni tïm nyeŋ keee mo ŋøøm mou ni tägi ka dï paap këël mano këët røk Kït Libaanø; ni maya tägi ka naama cwøl ni Upareeti këël mano këët naama dwøŋ jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni beeye ŋööm jø Këth bäre.
english: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo maara lønyø jïre ki man cuŋŋe nyïmï kany wø näk ri leny ki yïth nïr kwøw moï bëët moo beetï. Aano bëëdö ki ïïni kaawat mana bëëda ki Modhe; ï ba leeŋa piny ni ba wiia ïïni.
english: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

anywaa: «Mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek, kiper ïïni, jøøi ii otïïyï nee ŋöömö mana kööŋa kipere jï kwäcge ni wëëga geni na marge nee ci jïge.
english: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.

anywaa: 'Ba mana pere letha eni keere, mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek; gwøk ciik bëët na karge moa ö dhaanhnha ma Modhe na kööm ïïni ki ge; kär niï gaa wøk ki røk ciik moøgø ni ba gaaï bäät cwïï wala bäät caamï, nee gïï wø tïïyï bëët thurge karge.
english: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

anywaa: Luup moa en yi wëëlö man na mar ciik en kär nee tïmö ni tøør dhiï, 'ba bëëdï niï lääŋŋa gø ki dïcäŋ ki wäär, nee riï gwøgï ki man tïïyï jammi bëët na karge kaawat mana näk ogöörö yie; køøre nø, jöö marï obëëdö ni tiir, ni thur jammi mo wø tïïyï bëët karge.
english: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.

anywaa: Ennø, a köömma ïïni. Mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek; ni ba bwøk cwïnyï ni ba lwäyï, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marï, a ena buutï kany wø ciï yie jaak.»
english: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the Lord thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel aköömme, ni kööe,
english: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cou dï twïër ni köömmu jiy ni kööu, ni ‹Tïïu ki caammi kiper dëëtu, kiper noo tïme na ri dää nïne, naami na Jördan en ŋøllu ŋølø, ni cou yi ŋöömmo cïp jïïu na maru nee mayu. Ni ŋöömmögø cïpa Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu.› »
english: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the Lord your God giveth you to possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö jï jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca,
english: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,

anywaa: ni «Parru wïthu ki luubö mana ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Jwøk na kööm uuni ki gø, na kööe, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu uuno mooe ki jwöm, ni cïp ŋöömmi en jïïu.›
english: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, The Lord your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.

anywaa: Ennø, mään mou, ko obwöre mou, ki lääc paac mou dööŋ løø Naam Jördan løøi yi ŋöömma cïp  Modhe jïïu. 'Ba u na dëëtu teek kiper leny, u ŋuta løøga ni rou you jiiŋŋø kiper leny, ni bwøthu maal nyïm nyïïmëëgu ni kønynyu geni.
english: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;

anywaa: 'Ba u doo bëëdö nou køønynya nyïïmëëgu këël mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo mooc geni ki jwöm, kaawat mana mooc uuni ki jwöm, këël mano ö geni thuwø noo macge ŋöömö mano cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïge. Køøre nø, uuno døø yi ŋöömö mana näk maru ni bëëdu yie, ni beeye ŋöömma näk onø cïp Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk jïïu na en løø Naam Jördan løøi jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.»
english: Until the Lord have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the Lord your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord's servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø wïth tuŋi moøgø jï Jøcua, ni köge, ni «Luup bëët moa köömmï waani ki ge yøø tïïcwa tïïö, ni kany wäro jääŋŋï wa yie jaak wa cøø.
english: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.

anywaa: Ïïni dwørï oleŋwa kaawat mana bëëtwa ni dwør Modhe ewa leŋø ki røk jammi bëët. 'Ba mana pere letha eni keere, beerra man bëët Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøï ki ïïni, kaawat mana bëëde ki Modhe.
english: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the Lord thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato kwier dwørï ni ba leŋ luup moa caanï jïre, ŋatøgø doo nääö. 'Ba mana pere letha eni keere, mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek.»
english: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en jø Icrielli Cëthim, Jøcua o Nun ajääk Jerikö ki jiy ariiø na dïlëëwe ki piny ni kuc, ni kööe, ni «Cou, ni liewu ŋööm Keenan këël Jerikö.» Ni ö jøøgø ni aacge ni pïïcge paanøgø po nyaan ma kääbi mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Reeyap, ni putge but kaace.
english: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï nyeny Jerikö, ni køp, ni «Da jiy mo käla baŋ jø Icriel mo oö kuna liewge paac, mo ge ena kany yi wäär man en.»
english: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeny Jerikö ni jääk baŋ Reeyap ki dwøl, ni kööe, ni «Käl jiy wøk moa ö baŋï, na duny paarï kany, kiper gena öö ni ge ööa kuna liewge paac man bäre en.»
english: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaanøgø jøøgø na ariiø yøø ee nø kan. Køøre ena köö jï jøøa jääŋ nyeya, ni «Kare møn, jøøgø aö baŋa; 'ba kanya kälge yie kuua.
english: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kany wø cïëk dhi kiir, ni pinynya wïthïënhö, jøøgø adøny wøk; ni kanya cige yie kuua. 'Ba ni näk uuno laar läp køørge, ge putu ka mak.»
english: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyap jøøgø ee nø kïth bäät øtø maal ni kan ge tiet thiek gïna cwøl ni telba, ni wø thøøthe cwääc na abïï, moa näk ee peeth bäät øtø maal.
english: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa jääŋ nyeya ni läpge køør dïlëëwe ni ge cøra jöö mana näk coonya dhi waath Naam Jördan. 'Ba kanya nø dunyge wøk, dhi kiir aput dëët.
english: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot dïlëëwe ni poot kär butö, Reeyap aci baŋge bäät øtø maal,
english: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Ŋääa ni Wuuö Jwøk ŋöömmi en ee cïbö jïïu, ni wa bëëdö ni wa lwäär ki uuni døc, ni ö jøøi ni bëëdö kany bëët ii, ni bëëtge ni ge böö ki uuni.
english: And she said unto the men, I know that the Lord hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.

anywaa: Kiper awïnywa ni kanya ööu wøk ki Ijep, Wuuö Jwøk Naama Kwaar atïïe nee tale nyïmmu, ni wïnywa gïna tïïyu dëët nyeye mo jø Amör moa näk ariiø na en løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni beege Cëëwön ki Ög, na wïthge dïïrru na bäre.
english: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnywa gïnögø, cwïnywa abwøk, ni bäŋe dhaanhø aciel mo cwïnye ee maar mak kiperu; kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, beeye Jwøk mo maal ki piny ena cere.
english: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the Lord your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a kwaya uuni nou kööŋŋu jïra ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki man nyoothu bäth ec maru jï dhi øt wära kaawat mana nyoodha bäth ec mara jïïu en. Beerra man cïpu jïra ki ŋïï ma adïëri.
english: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the Lord, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:

anywaa: Weyu wära ki mera, ki nyïïmera moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään, ki tuuŋge bëët ni kwøw, ni gwøgu jwïëcwa cer thøø.»
english: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø aköö jï Reeyap, «Ni näk mo gïno caanwa en ba tïïcwa, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni ŋøl luubö manøgø bäätwa ni 'näk waani. Ennø, ni näk mo gïn tïïcwa en ba caanï, kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo cïp ŋöömmi jïwa, bäth ec marwa nyoothwa nyoodhø jïrï ni tïïcwa adïëri kiperï.»
english: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the Lord hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.

anywaa: Køøre Reeyap dïlëëwe atïïe nee ge løøcge piny ŋää kiir ki ri thøøl ni ge løøc piny ki dha awëërnyeŋ, kiper øtø mare ena dëër kiir mar paanøgø, ni eni bëëdö dëër kiir.
english: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot dïlëëwe ni poot kär ci piny, ena köö jïge, ni «Cou bäät kïdi kiper nou ba joot jøøa läp køøru, ni kannu dëëtu kunece ki nïne adäk, këël kanyo duuge. Køøre nø, uuno aay ki jöö mana manynyu.»
english: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlëëwe aköö jï Reeyap, «Ni näk gïn caanwa en ba tïïyï, kööŋ mana wëëgï wa kööŋ ki gø tïmö ni tøør bäätwa.
english: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.

anywaa: Ennø, kanyo öwa yi ŋöömmi, waarø man ni kwaar en wär twöö dha awëërnyeŋ mano tïïyï wa nee wa løøcwa piny ki yie, ni cooŋï tuuŋu yi øtø marï, ni beege wäru ki meru ki nyïïmeru moa näk cwøw ki dhi øt wäru bäre.
english: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace, ŋato duny wøk ki yi ødï ni ci wøk, thøø mano tägi ree ena bääte keere, ni dööŋwa wøk ka ajäl thøø mar ŋatøgø. 'Ba ni näk ma ŋat mo ena yi øtø ki ïïni ciel onääö, ajäl thøø mar ŋatøgø tïmö ni ena bäätwa.
english: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïn tïïcwa en caanï caanø, kööŋ mana wëëgï wa kööŋ ki gø tïmö ni tøør bäätwa.»
english: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

anywaa: Køøre Reeyap aköö, ni «Tïme na kare ki køør döötu moa caru yøø.» Ni put geni wëëk wääth ni aacge. Ni ö Reeyapi ni twöö waanynya kwaar dha awëërnyeŋ.
english: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlëëwe atïŋŋö ni pïïcge bäät kïdi, ni bëëtge kaace ki nïne adäk, këël mana duu jøøa läp køørge. 'Ba jøøa läp køør dïlëëwe, dïlëëwe amanyge waŋjöö bäre; ni kärge dïlëëwe joodø.
english: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

anywaa: Køøre dïlëëwe moø na ariiø yøø alööny piny ki bäät kïdi nee ge døøkge, ni ŋutge  løøga ni pïïcge baŋ Jøcua o Nun, ni parge jammi bëët jïgø, ni beege jammi moa tägö dëëtge.
english: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:

anywaa: Ni köge jï Jøcua, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ŋöömmöce bäre ee cïbö jïïø, ni ö jøøke bëët ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmöce yøøke, ni bëëtge ni ge böö døc ki øøni.»
english: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the Lord hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua apäny maal ka amöölla cøøn; ni ö eni ki jø Icriel bëët ni tïŋge ki Cëthim ni pïïcge bäät Naam Jördan, ni butge kaace kanya poode ni ge kär ŋut løøga.
english: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri dää nïne, dïbwöthe aci dï twïër;
english: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;

anywaa: ni köömge jiy, ni köge, ni «Kanyo jootu acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, ni biel dïlämme biellø na näk jø tuuŋ Libay, kar kaace nø, wäru putu ö maal ki kwöra bëëdu yïthge ni läpu køør acanduk,
english: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.

anywaa: nee jöö mano cørru yie nee ŋäyu; kiper jöö manøgø u poot kär cør yie dïkwøŋ. 'Ba kanyo cäädhu, wär yïthakiyu ka acanduk wëënnu ki rumme mo caala yïth gööye ma kume ariiø, ni ba nyiigu buute.»
english: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï jiy bëët, ni «Døøyu dëëtu mo waany, kiper diøø Wuuö Jwøk tïïö ki gïn mo rëëma ec dïïu kany.»
english: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the Lord will do wonders among you.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni cääne ki dïlämme, ni kööe, ni «Lwørru acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ni pööthu maal nyïm jiy.» Ni ö dïlämme ni lwørge acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ni pööthge maal nyïm jiy.
english: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Dïcäŋi en a tägö ki man tïïa ïïni ni ïïna dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ nyïm jø Icriel bëët, nee ŋäcge naa bëëdö ka ïïni kaawat mana bëëda ki Modhe.
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.

anywaa: Ennø, kööm dïlämme moøgø ni biel acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy yøø, ni kööï, ni ‹Kanyo pïïyu deŋ Naam Jördan, wäru putu cuŋŋö yïth pïï kaace.› »
english: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Ööu kany, ni wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.»
english: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the Lord your God.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jøcua köö, ni «Ki ri mano tal naammi en nø, oŋäyu ni Jwøa kwøw ena dïïu, ni ŋäyu gø thuwø ni eni jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Përec, ki jø Gërgëca, ki jø Amör, ki jø Jeebuc rieme wøk nyïmmu.
english: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.

anywaa: Neennu, acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk kwääc piny bäre, opööth maal nyïmmu kanyo ŋøllu Naam Jördan.
english: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kwänyu ki jiy apaar kurriiø røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel, ni ŋati man nø käla ri wï tuuŋ man nø.
english: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme moo biel acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk kwääc piny bäre, kanyo tïm tietge ni këëta yïth pï Naam Jördan, pï Naam Jördan puta niŋul, ni ö pïïyi mo wø kwönni ki kwöra en maal ni cuŋge kaamar gïï mo ocooŋ kanya ciel.»
english: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel atïŋŋö, ni puthge oduŋkaare moge wøk nee Naam Jördan ŋølge, ni dïlämme acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy bielge biellø nyïm jiy.
english: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace beeye kany wø kac caammi, ni Naam Jördan opäŋ døc kiree. 'Ba kanya ö dïlämme moa biel acanduk na pïïcge bäät Naam Jördan, kanya gutge pïï ki tietge jaak,
english: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)

anywaa: pïï mo wø kwönni ki kwöra en maal aput cuŋŋö ni makge rege kaamar gïï mo ocooŋ kanya ciel, ni pïïögø cuŋŋa kany mo bäär paana cwøl na Adam, na en buut Carthan; ni ö pïïyi mo wø lööny yi Naam Acäbö na en yi gool mana cwøl na Araaba, ni putge niŋul na bäre. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge ŋut løøga ni ge dïët ki Jerikö.
english: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zarethan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme moa biel acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk, gena cuŋŋö  kany mo otal dï Naam Jördan; ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni putge ŋut løøga ni ge cäädhi ka kany mo otal, këël mana ö wïth tuŋi bëët mo jø Icriel ni putge thum løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïme ni jø Icriel bëët onø thum løø Naam Jördan løøga, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Jøcua ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwänyu ki jiy apaar kurriiø dëët jø Icriel, ni ŋati man nø käla ri wï tuuŋ man nø,
english: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,

anywaa: ni köömmu geni, ni kööu, ni ‹Cou dï Naam Jördan kany bëët dïlämme ni ge cuŋŋö ni tietge ege këël piny yie ice; ni lwötu ki kïte apaar kurriiø ni kääru geni ni cïbu ge piny kanyo butu yie dïwääni en.› »
english: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua jøøa näk apaar kurriiø acwøle, ni beege jøøa näk ee nø jier røk jø Icriel, ni ŋati man nø käla ri wï tuuŋ man nø.
english: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:

anywaa: Ni kö Jøcua jïge, ni «Cou dï Naam Jördan kanya en acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu yie, ni ö ŋati man nø dïïu ni lwöte ki kïdi ni käär gø ki göönne, ni you päärö ki køør kwään wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the Lord your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:

anywaa: Beerra man bëët gïnögø na nyuudhi jïïu; 'ba kanyo ö wäätu noo pëënyge uuni yi nyïme, ni köge, ni ‹?Kïte moi tiere agïnaŋø ki baŋu?›
english: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?

anywaa: køøre nø, u doo köö jïge, ni ‹Tiere beeye ni pï Naam Jördan aniŋul nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk. Kanya ö acanduki manøgø na ŋøli løøga, pï Naam Jördan aput niŋul.› 'Ba kïte moøgø puta bëëtö na gïr par wïc jï jø Icriel na bäre bäre.»
english: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the Lord; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel gïnögø atïïcge kaawat mana ö Jøcua na kööm geni; ni cige ni lwötge ki kïte apaar kurriiø dï Naam Jördan, ni tïïcge gø na kare kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Jøcua ki gø, ni ege päärö ki køør kwään wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel; ni käärge kïte moøgø këël mana pïïcge kanya butge yie, ni cïpge ge piny kaace.
english: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the Lord spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua alwötö ki kïte apaar kurriiø møøk ni löör ge piny kanya ciel dï Naam Jördan, kanya cuŋ dïlämme moa biel acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy yie; 'ba kïte moøgø poot nut kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme moa biel acanduk, gena put bëëtö ni ge cuŋŋö dï Naam Jördan këël mana thum jammi bëët ki tïïc, ni beege jammi bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Jøcua ki ge nee caane jï jiy. 'Ba jammi bëët atïïcge na karge kaawat mana ö Modhe na kööm Jøcua. Køøre nø, jiy bëët aput ŋut løøga ni ge rwäänhnhö.
english: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the Lord commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø thum jiyi løøga bëët, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk ki dïlämme moa biel gø, gena put ŋut løøga thuwø ni nëënö jï jiy bëët.
english: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the Lord passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca ni pööthge maal nyïm jø Icriel ni dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, kaawat mana caani ya Modhe jïge.
english: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:

anywaa: 'Ba beege jiy mo jïtö ki kume ma pïëraŋween mo jïge da jap leny, na ŋut løøga kiper leny, na ci pwöl Jerikö ni ge cäädhi ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the Lord unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk Jøcua atïïe na dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ nyïm jø Icriel bëët; ni ö geni ni putge tïmö ni lwäär ki eni, ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët, kaawat mana bëëtge ni ge lwäär ki Modhe.
english: On that day the Lord magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua,
english: And the Lord spake unto Joshua, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kööm dïlämme moø ni käär acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy yøø, nee öge wøk ki yi Naam Jördan.»
english: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni kööm dïlämme, ni kööe, ni «Ööu wøk ki yi Naam Jördan nø.»
english: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm dïlämme moa käär acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge ööa wøk ki dï Naam Jördan, kanya tïm tietge ni këëta kanya no otal ennø, pï Naam Jördan aput døø karge, ni put døø ri kwödö ki deŋŋe manøgø bäre kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ.
english: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
