anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aö wøk ki bäät Naam Jördan kanya tïm nïr dwääyi mana dïkwøŋ na apaar; ni tïïcge twïër marge kanya cwøl ni Gëlgela na en deŋ Jerikö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.

anywaa: Ni ö kïte moa näk apaar kurriiø na kälge ki yi Naam Jördan, ni puti ya Jøcua löör piny kanya ciel Gëlgela kaace.
english: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.

anywaa: Ni kö Jøcua jï jø Icriel, ni «Kanyo ö obwöre mou noo pëënyge uuni yi nyïme, ni köge, ni ‹?Kïte moi a kïte mo ŋøøni?›
english: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?

anywaa: køøre nø, dou lamø jï obwöre mou, ni kööu, ni ‹Jø Icriel Naam Jördan man en aŋølge ni ge cäädhi ka kany mo otal.›
english: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu pï Naam Jördan ataale nyïmmu këël mana ŋutu løøga, kaawat mana tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu thuwø dëër Naama Kwaar, na taal gø nyïmmø këël mana putø ŋut løøga.
english: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:

anywaa: Manøgø beeye kiper nee ŋäc jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni Wuuö Jwøk jïre da teek, ni ö uuni ni putu bëëtö nou lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu na bäre bäre.»
english: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the Lord, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the Lord your God for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeye bëët mo jø Amör moa en løø Naam Jördan løøga jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki nyeye mo Keenan bëët moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, na wïnyge gø ni Wuuö Jwøk pï Naam Jördan ataale nyïm jø Icriel këël mana ŋutge løøga, geni cwïnyge abwøk, ni päth bäätge ki lwär kiper jø Icriel.
english: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Wärï tïïï ki kïte mo deŋge beth na gïï daŋ; ni daŋï cwøw mo jø Icriel moa näk kär kwøŋ daŋ dïkwøŋ.»
english: At that time the Lord said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua atïïö ki kïte mo deŋge beth, ni daŋ cwøw mo jø Icriel ki geni kaace, ni put kaace cwøl ni Thuur Daŋ.
english: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

anywaa: 'Ba tier gïna ö Jøcua na daŋ geni kipere beeye en; cwøw leny bëët moa ö wøk ki Ijep na no onø daŋ kanya enge Ijep, atïmö no onø thumö ki thøø dï paap kanya cääthge.
english: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba beege jiy moa lwaarø ki geni øtjöö dï paap kanya ö jøwi wøk ki Ijep na näk poot kär daŋø.
english: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel acäädhö dï paap ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, këël mana thøw cwøw lenynyi bëët moa ö wøk ki Ijep, kiper mana kärge dwør Wuuö Jwøk leŋø. Ni beege jøøgø na cään Wuuö Jwøki ki ge na kööe ni ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie ba dege joodø, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋe kipere jï kwäyø nee cïbe jï nyïïkwaacge.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: unto whom the Lord sware that he would not shew them the land, which the Lord sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre moge moa laa Wuuö Jwøki karge adaŋ Jøcua, kiper geni ge kär daŋ wëëkge kanya cääthge dï paap.
english: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö jø Icrielli na thöörge cwøw bëët ki daŋ, gena put bëëtö kwöra enge yïthge twïër këël mana caŋ dëët jiyi moa daŋ.
english: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Dïcäŋi en, gïna raac na eel jø Ijepi bäätu aŋeela wøk.» 'Ba nyeŋ kaace aput cwøl ni Gëlgela këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët jø Icrielli ni twïër marge ege tïïö Gëlgela, cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie awøørge pwöl Jerikö ni nïr dwääy apaar kurŋween ni piny a wïthïënhö.
english: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya, ni cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ege nø wøør, dïcäŋ manøgø kiree jø Icriel gena cämö ki caammi moa ciek yi ŋöömmögø, ni beege muunni mo rege bäŋ thømmø ki beel mo omuuö.
english: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.

anywaa: Ni ö meena ni neeŋul ka amöölla maya køør dïcäŋ mana nø cämge ki caammi moa ciek yi ŋöömmögø; ni tïm jø Icrielli ni bäŋ meena jïge këët. 'Ba gena bëëdö ni ge cämö ki caammi moa ciek yi ŋööm Keenan cwiinøgø.
english: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en Jøcua buut Jerikö, wïïe atïŋ maal ni lwïthe; ni joot dhaanhø  mør ni cuŋŋö nyïme no opëëllö dagø cere; ni ö Jøcua ni ci baŋe ni kööe jïgø, ni «?Ï ena løøk marwa wala ï ena løø nyïïmän?»
english: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?

anywaa: Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Patha enøgønø. Aani, a ööi ni aana kwääy lwaa leny mar Wuuö Jwøk.» Kanyøgønø, Jøcua cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny, ni kööe jïgø, ni «?Kwäärö, agïnaŋø na diï caanø jïra nee tïïa, a na laŋŋø marï?»
english: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the Lord am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk kwääy lwaa leny mar Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Käl war wøk tietï, kiper kanyo cuŋŋï yie enø beeye kany mo ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.» Ni ö Jøcua ni tïïc gïnögø.
english: And the captain of the Lord's host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgønø, dhi kiir mar pääny Jerikö aput bëëtö no odëëdö ni teek døc kiper jø Icriel; ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo odøny wøk, ni bäŋ dhaanhø thuwø mo oduny yie.
english: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Neenï, pääny Jerikö ki nyeya mare ki jø leny moa en yie na teek yaa nø cïp cerï.
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki jø leny bëët, deŋ kiir mar päänyögø wär wïrru yie aciel ki dïcäŋ aciel man nø; ni tïïyu gïnögø ki nïne abïciel.
english: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø dïlämme abïriiø wär käätge ki tuŋi abïriiø mo wø kooth, ni käärge geni nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy. 'Ba noo tïme na bïriet nïne, deŋ pääny manøgø bäre wär wïrru kwöre abïriiø, ni ö dïlämme ni koothge tuŋi.
english: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni dïlämme tuŋi køthge køthø ni ege maa ri gø jaak, kanyo wïnynyu dööt tuŋi, jiy bëët wär putge kwöŋŋö ni döötge ena maal døc. Kar kanyøgønø, kiir mar pääny manøgø puta pädhö no oninyaŋŋa, ni ö jiyi ni cige yie ni ŋati man nø cøra nyïme ni tiir jaak.»
english: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua o Nun dïlämme acwøle ni kööe jïge, ni «Lwørru acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, ni ö dïlämme abïriiø ni käätge ki tuŋi abïriiø mo wø kooth, ni käärge geni nyïm acanduk manøgø na mar Wuuö Jwøk enø.»
english: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï jiy, ni «Bwödhu maal ni wïrru deŋ kiir mar pääny Jerikö, ni ö jiyi møøk mo dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny ni cääthge nyïm acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcua na nø cään jiy, dïlämme abïriiø mo käädö ki tuŋi abïriiø mo wø kooth, gena put pööth maal nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni koothge tuŋi; ni ö acanduki man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki dïlämme moa käär gø, ni en køørge.
english: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the Lord, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa näk dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny ni pööthge maal nyïm dïlämme moa näk kudhö ki tuŋi, ni ö lwaae mo leny møga ni enge køør acanduk, ni dïlämme cäädhi ni ge poot kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rearward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua jiy aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Kär nou kwöŋŋö, ni bäŋe döötu mo wïnyi, ni bäŋe dwøl mo ö wøk ki dhøgu, këël dïcäŋo kööa yie, ni ‹Kwöŋŋu.› Køøre nø, uuno put kwöŋŋö.»
english: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye kanya ö Jøcua na tïïc deŋ kiir mar pääny Jerikö bäre nee wïr yie aciel, na acanduk na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk di käärö; køøre gena duu twïër ni butge yi gø wäänögø.
english: So the ark of the Lord compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na riet nïne ka amöölla cøøn, Jøcua apäny maal, ni ö dïlämme ni lwørge acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämme moa näk abïriiø moa käär tuŋi abïriiø mo wø kooth ni pööthge maal nyïm acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge cäädhi ni tuŋi moøgø køthge køthø; ni ö jiyi møøk moa näk dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny ni pööthge maal nyïm dïlämme moa näk kudhö ki tuŋi; ni ö lwaae mo leny møga ni putge ci køør acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni dïlämme moa näk abïriiø tuŋi poot køthge køthø.
english: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rearward came after the ark of the Lord, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye gïna tïïcge ri riet nïne, ni wïrge deŋ kiir mar pääny Jerikö bäre yie aciel, ni døøge twïër. Ni tïïcge gïnögø ki nïne abïciel.
english: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na bïriet nïne, gena päny maal ki bäc øw ni cige ni wïrge kiir mar pääny Jerikö kwöre abïriiø ki køør ciik mana näk ocaanø; ki dïcäŋögø keere deŋ kiir awïrge ki kwöre abïriiø.
english: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri bïrietge, kanya ö dïlämme na koothge tuŋi, Jøcua aput köö jï jiy, ni «Kwöŋŋu nø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk päänyi en ee nø cïp jïïu.
english: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the Lord hath given you the city.

anywaa: Ni ö päänyögø ki gïïa en yie bëët ni putu ge raanynyø na bäre bäre, ni caala man wø cïp olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk ni bäŋgø mo wec. 'Ba Reeyap nyaana näk kääbi keere ki jøøa en yi øtø ki eni na aciel obëëdö ni kwøw, kiper eni dïlëëwe moa jääŋŋø agwøe.
english: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the Lord: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, dëëtu wär gwøgu ki gïïa näk onø wëëk uuni nee raanynyu na bäre bäre, kiper ni näk mo uuno lwötö rege, tïmö nou käla aranya bäät twïër mar jø Icriel, ni kännu bääte ki gïn mo leth.
english: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.

anywaa: 'Ba warkey bäre ki gwel-bïrö, ki gïïa no otïïö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki moa no otïïö ki nywïëny møga jaak, beege gïï mo ena kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk. Gïïögø doo kïtha kanya no ojiiŋŋø na näk kar kän jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the Lord: they shall come into the treasury of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre kanya ö dïlämme na koothge tuŋi, jiy aput kwöŋŋö. 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na wïnyge dööt tuŋi møn, gena put kwöŋŋö ni döötge ena maal døc, ni ö kiirri ni put pädhö no oninyaŋŋa, ni ö jiyi ni putge ci yi kiir, ni ŋati man nø cøra nyïme ni tiir jaak, ni putge pääny manøgø mac.
english: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge gïïa en yi päänyögø bëët ko opëëlle, ni beege cwøw ki mään, ko obwöre ki jø døøŋŋø, ki dhäk ki dïëk ka arëëni.
english: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö jï jøøa näk ariiø na liew paanøgø, ni «Cou yi øt nyaana näk kääbi ni kälu nyaanøgø wøk ki jøøa en yi øtø kaace bëët, kaawat mana nø kööŋŋu jïre.»
english: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.

anywaa: Køøre jaga näk wøpe na näk dïlëëwe, gena put ci yi øtø ni kälge Reeyap wøk, ki wänni ki menni ki nyïïmenni moa näk cwøw, ki jøøa en yi øtø bëët, ni beege tuuŋ Reeyap bëët; ni moocge geni ki kany jwömge rege yie deŋ twïër mana näk mar jø Icriel.
english: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel pääny manøgø ki gïïa en yie bëët awaaŋge ki maac. 'Ba warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ki gïïa no otïïö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël ki nywïëny møga keerge, akïthge kanya no ojiiŋŋø na kar kän na en yi oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyap nyaana näk kääbi, ki dhi øt wänni bäre ki jøøa en yi øde bëët, awec Jøcua nee kwøwge; ni ö nyaanøgø ni put bëëtö dï jø Icriel na bäre, kiper eni jiy moa jääŋ Jøcua nee Jerikö liewge agwøe.
english: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgønø, Jøcua aput kööŋ, ni kööe, ni «Ŋato ö maal ni geer päänyi ni Jerikö en, acïëni oen bääte nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Kanyo täge ki geer dëër kiir mar paanøgø, nyilaal mare mana näk kanynye othøw; ni kanyo kïth odhuulu mar dhi kiir, nyilaal mare mana näk aŋuunne othøw.»
english: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the Lord, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aput bëëtö ki Jøcua, ni ö nyeŋ Jøcua ni put wïnynye yi ŋöömmögø bäre.
english: So the Lord was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.

anywaa: Køøre kanya en jø Icrielli Jerikö, Jøcua jiy ajääŋŋe paana cwøl ni Gaay, na en buut paana cwøl ni Bëëth-Awëën, na en løø Bëthël jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni liewu ŋöömmece.» Ni ö jøøgø ni cige ni liewge Gaay.
english: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth–aven, on the east side of Beth–el, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø aduu baŋ Jøcua ni köge jïgø, ni «Kär jiy bëët ci Gaay; jø leny moo cii manynya jiy mo jïtö ki kume ariiø wala kume adäk keerge. 'Ba kär niï ööla jiy bëët ki man cige kunece, kiper jø Gaay beege jiy mo nøk jaak.»
english: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi mo jïtö ki kume adäk dëët jø leny mo jø Icriel ni cige baŋ jø Gaay. 'Ba kanya tïme na ri leny, gena riem jø Gaay.
english: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Gaay ni nääge ki jiy mo jïtö ki pïëradäk ka abïciel dëët jø leny mo jø Icriel. Ni ö jø Gaay ni putge jø Icriel riemmø ki mana täkge ki dhi kiir Gaay këël mana pïïcge kanya cwøl ni Cebarim, ni 'näkge jø Icriel kanya tïme na ri lööny piny. 'Ba jø Icriel cwïnyge abwøk døc ki lwär.
english: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua abïï mare ajeee, ni gøø ree piny nyïm acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde kaace këël mana tïm pinynyi na abøøya, ni beeye eni ki jø døøk Icriel bëët; ni jørge tør wïthge ki pänh cwïny.
english: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the Lord until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö, «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, waani, wa käädhï løø Naam Jördan løøi kiper nee wa cïbï ceŋ jø Amör, nee wa 'näk møn? Kee doo beerra eni jïwa ki mana dewa bëëdö løø Naam Jördan løøga ni cwïnywa ewa cïp piny jaak.
english: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord God, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!

anywaa: Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. ?Agïnaŋø noo caana nø, kiper jø Icriel ŋäthge alukge nyïïmän moge ni reŋge?
english: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!

anywaa: Kiper gïnögø wïny jø Keenanni wïnynyö, këël jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø bëët, ni öge ni rumge wa dïër ni putge wïthwa dïïr na bäre. ?'Ba ennø, agïnaŋø noo tïïyï, nee nyeŋŋï bëëde ni poot wïnyö?»
english: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, «Ö maal. ?Aŋø, aperŋø na gøøï riï piny en?
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?

anywaa: Jø Icriel beege na bääyö; geni luumma mana tuuda na köömma geni ki gø akaalge. Gena lwötö røk gïïa näk onø wëëk geni nee raanyge na bäre, ni kwalge gïïögø, ni cäänge ki tööt. Køøre gïïögø akange dï jammi moa näk moge.
english: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jø Icriel ba løny ki man cuŋge nyïm nyïïmänge; geni ŋäthge lukge nyïïmänge ni reŋge, kiper gena nø tïmö ni ge caala gïïa näk di raanynyø na bäre yøø. 'Ba ni näk mo gïïa no onø wëëk uuni nee raanynyu na bäre, käru raanynyø dïïu, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a ba bëëdö ki uuni këët.
english: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ö maal, ni tïïyï jiy nee dëëtge døøcge mo waany ni kööï, ni ‹Døøyu dëëtu mo waany kiper gïno tägi diøø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel aköö, ni «Wui, jø Icriel, gïïa no onø wëëk uuni nee raanynyu na bäre dagø dïïu. 'Ba këël kanyo paanynyu gïïa no onø wëëk uuni nee raanynyu na bäre, uuni ba løny jïïu ki man cuŋŋu nyïm nyïïmännu.» ›
english: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the Lord God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.

anywaa: «Ni cäŋï köö jïge, ni ‹Ka amöölla wäru ööu kany mo cään ki Wuuö Jwøk, nee wï tuuŋ mano nyooth Wuuö Jwøki no obääyö nee joot. 'Ba ŋato nyooth Wuuö Jwøki dëët wïth tuŋi moøgø, jø dhøk uudi moa en tiere doo ööa kany mo cään. Køøre ŋato nyooth Wuuö Jwøki dëët jø dhøk uudi moøgø, jøøa näk wëëk mïëri na en tiere doo ööa kany mo cään. Køøre ŋato nyooth Wuuö Jwøki dëët wëëk mïëri moøgø, cwøw moa en paare doo ööa kany mo cään na aciel aciel.
english: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the Lord taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the Lord shall take shall come by households; and the household which the Lord shall take shall come man by man.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato joot ni gïïa no onø wëëk uuni nee raanynyu na bäre ena baŋe, wär eni 'näk ki gïïa en jïre bëët, ni rup maac bäätge nee putge waaŋ na bäre, kiper eni luumma tuuda ki jø Icriel akaale, ni tïïc gïn mo wïc laay ki gø dï jø Icriel.› »
english: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, Jøcua apäny maal ni käl jø Icriel kany mo cään ki Wuuö Jwøk ki køør wïth tuŋi moge, ni ö jø tuuŋ Juuda ni nyoodhi.
english: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni käl jiy moa en ri jø tuuŋ Juuda kany mo cään, ni ö Wuuö  Jwøki ni nyooth dhi øt Dheera; ni ö Jøcua ni käl jiy moa en dhi øt Dheera kany mo cään ni käle na dhaanhø aciel aciel nø, ni ö Dhabdi na näk wää paaci ni nyoodhi.
english: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua cwøw moa bëëdö po Dhabdi akäl kany mo cään na dhaanhø aciel aciel nø; ni ö Akanni o Karmi nyikwaar Dhenberi o Dheera, na käl ri jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni nyoodhi.
english: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï Akan, ni «Nyie wääda, akwaya ïïni ki man caanï adïëri marï nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel, ni wøørï eni, ni køpï raay moï jïre. Ennø, gïna näk iï tïïö caanï jïra. Kär gïna näk iï tïïö mooŋï ki aani.»
english: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Akanni jï Jøcua ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, aani aana bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel. 'Ba gïna tïïa kiree beeye en.
english: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:

anywaa: Aani, ki røk jammi moa twier bëët, kanya jooda abïï mo mïërö mo tïïca paana cwøl ni Cinaar, ki warkey ma lwøŋŋø ma rumme ma pïërabïïc mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ki gwel-bïrö ma rumme ma dïpe ariiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, cwïnya atïmö ni päl ki ge ni lwøra geni. 'Ba ennø, gïïögø okoony piny yo oduŋkaara mana näk mara, ni gwel-bïrö beeye ni en ya aŋuudi piny tiet gïïögø bëët.»
english: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aput jäägö ki jiy, ni ö jøøgø ni putge reŋ yo oduŋkaara mar Akan. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kanya cige, gïïögø ajootge no okoony piny yo oduŋkaara mare ni gwel-bïrö ena ya aŋuudi piny tiet gïïögø bëët.
english: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni kälge gïïögø wøk ki yo oduŋkaara ni kälge geni baŋ Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët, ni peethge ge piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët, Akan nyikwaar Dheera akälge ki gïïa kwale, ni beege warkey mana näk lwøŋŋø, ki gwel-bïrö, ka abïïna mïërö; ni kälge wääte, ki nyïïe, ki dhäk moe, ka arëëni moe, ki dïëk moe, ko oduŋkaara mare ki gïïa en jïre bëët, ni kïthge geni gool mana cwøl na Akör.
english: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua aköö jï Akan, na «?Aŋø nyie ni kännï bäätwa ki gïn mo leth en? 'Ba dïcäŋi nø Wuuö Jwøk okïth bäätï ki gïn mo leth thuwø.» Ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni këërge Akan ki kïte, ki jø paare, këël gïïa en jïre bëët. 'Ba na nø këërge geni ki kïte, aputge rup ki maac ni put ge waaŋ na bäre.
english: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the Lord shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge kïte mo thööth löör bäät Akan, ni kïte moøgø poot nut no olöör kanya ciel këël dïcäŋi en; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put wëëye paany. Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace aput cwøl ni Goor Akör këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the Lord turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Kärï lwäyö ni ba bwøk cwïnyï. Lwør jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët, ni cou baŋ jø Gaay. Neenï, aani nyeny Gaay, ki jiye, ki pääny mare, këël ŋöömö mana näk mare bäre, yaa nø cïp cerï.
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:

anywaa: Teeŋ gïna tïïyï ri pääny Jerikö ki nyeya mare, wär tïïyï ri pääny Gaay ki nyeya mare; 'ba jammi ki lääc paac moo twierru wär källu kiper dëëtu. 'Ba ïïni, wärï känï ki jø leny møøk ŋää paanøgø.»
english: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø leny bëët aput tïŋŋö ni ge cøøa baŋ jø Gaay; ni ö Jøcua ni kwänye ki jø leny mo teek marge okadhø, ni beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk, ni jääŋ ge wøk ki wäär.
english: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köömme ni kööe, ni «Neennu, uuni u cøøa kuna kannu dëëtu ŋää pääny manøgø. Kär karu tïïyu ni bäär ki gø. 'Ba uuni bëët, wäru bëëdu ni dëëtu you jiiŋŋø.
english: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:

anywaa: Køøre nø, aani ki jiy bëët moa en buuta, wa nyiiga buut  kiir. 'Ba kanyo tïme ni ge ööa baŋwa wøk kaawat mana tïïcge dïkwøŋ, kar kanyøgønø wa puta reeŋø ni wa ŋwieya geni.
english: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni rïŋge køørwa këël mano peewa geni kany mo bäär ki pääny marge, kiper geno köö, ni ‹Jø Icriel areeŋø ki øøni kaawat mana dïkwøŋ.› 'Ba waani, kanyo reŋwa ni wa ŋwieya geni,
english: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.

anywaa: køøre nø, u puta ö maal ki kanya näk rou you kan yie, ni cou ni magu pääny manøgø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu pääny manøgø cïbe ceŋŋu.
english: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni pääny you nø mak, wär putu nyep ki maac; ni tïïyu ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Neennu, uuna nø köömma.»
english: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the Lord shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua jøøgø aput wëëk wääth, ni cige ni putge rege kan yïthakic Bëthël ki Gaay, ni ge ena løø Gaay jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ. 'Ba dïwäänögø Jøcua aput but dï jø leny møga.
english: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Beth–el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn Jøcua apäny maal ni cooŋ jø leny kanya ciel, ni ö eni ki jø døøk Icriel ni pööthge maal nyïm jø leny moøgø ni cige Gaay.
english: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny bëët moa aay ki Jøcua, gena cøø ni pïïcge kany mo cään ni ge dïët ki pääny manøgø, ni tïïcge twïër marge jï kuna en wï-piny ki Gaay. 'Ba yïthakic jø leny mo jø Icriel ki Gaay da gool.
english: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua jø leny mo jïtö ki kume abïïc alwøre ni jääŋ geni nee rege kange yïthakic Bëthël ki Gaay, ni ge ena løø Gaay jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Beth–el and Ai, on the west side of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua ki jø døøk Icriel jiy ege nø cïïmmö, ni jø leny moa thööth ena jï løø wï-piny ki Gaay, ni lwaae mo leny møga okan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ö Jøcua ki jø leny moa en buute ni putge dï gool caath ki wäär manøgø.
english: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeny Gaay na neen gïnögø, eni ki jiye gena put päny maal ka amöölla cøøn ni ge läädö, ni cige baŋ leny ki jø Icriel kanya näk kar leny na näk dïët ki goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba. 'Ba kuc nyeny Gaay ni da jø leny mo okanø kipere ŋää pääny manøgø.
english: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua ki jø leny mo jø Icriel moa en buute bëët dëëtge atïïcge kaamar jiy mo oböötö, ni putge reeŋø ki jø Gaay ni ge reŋi ka øtjöö mana näk coonya dï paap.
english: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni ö cwøwi bëët moa en paac ni cwøli nee reŋge køør Jøcua ki jø Icriel, ni putge reŋ køørge, ni ö geni ni put geni peeø kany mo bäär ki paac.
english: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel røk jø Gaay ki jø Bëthël mo odööŋ mo kär ci kuna reŋ køør jø Icriel, ni putge dhi kiir marge wec ni ŋaam jaak, ni reŋge køør jø Icriel.
english: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Rwiec tøŋ manø ni cerï enø bäät pääny Gaay, kiper päänyögø ocïba cerï.» Ni ö Jøcua ni put tøŋ mana en cere rwiec bäät päänyögø.
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcua na rwiec cere, jø leny moa näk rege ege kanø ŋää paac apäny maal ki kanya enge yie; ni putge reeŋø ni dønyge yi pääny manøgø ni putge gø mak. Ni ö geni ni laarge pääny nyep ki maac.
english: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Gaay na lwïthge ŋäthge, pääny aputge joot ni waaŋ ni jïrö onitul, ni put nyeŋge tïmö ni rïïŋö ni bäŋ kany reŋge yie, kiper jø Icriel, na køørge ŋwiecge dï paap, nyïmge aluuge nee këëtge ki geni.
english: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcua ki jø leny mo jø Icriel moa en buute bëët na jootge gø ni pääny onø mak jiyi moa näk dëëtge ege kanø, ni jïc pääny onitul, nyïmge aputge løk ni 'näkge jø Gaay.
english: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli møga ni öge wøk ki yi päänyögø nee røømge ki jø leny mo Gaay. 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët jø Gaay atiige dïër, ni jø møøk ena løøi ni jø møga ena løøga. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge jø Gaay bëët 'näk këël mana tïme ni bäŋ aciel mo odööŋ, ni bäŋgø mo obøth wala mo oreeŋø.
english: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Gaay keere amakge ni kwøw ni kälge gø baŋ Jøcua.
english: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïme ni jø Icriel jø Gaay moa reŋ køørge ege nø thöör ki 'näk pwöla dï paap, ni ge ege nø 'näk bëët këël mana thumge na bäre, jø  Icriel bëët adøø baŋ jiy moa en pääny Gaay, ni 'näkge ge bëët.
english: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø cwøw mo Gaay ki mään bëët aput thøø, ni beege jiy ma kume apaar kurriiø.
english: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua cere mana en tøŋŋi yie na rwiee, käre dwøk piny këël mana dïïr wïth jiy bëët moa bëëdö Gaay.
english: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa käl jø Icrielli kiper dëëtge beege lääc paac ki gïïa twierge keerge; ni gïnögø tïïcge ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk na kööm Jøcua ki gø.
english: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the Lord which he commanded Joshua.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua Gaay aput waaŋ ni put gø raanynyø na bäre, ni dööŋe no onikïïl këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni 'näk nyeny Gaay ni lïër gø ri jaath këël mana tïm pinynyi na abøøya. 'Ba kanya nø päth cäŋŋi piny, Jøcua acïpö ki dwøl, ni cige ni kälge dëër gø wøk ki ri jaath, ni leeŋge gø dhi kiir mar pääny Gaay, ni putge kïte mo thööth löör bääte, ni kïte moøgø poot nut no olöör piny kanya ciel kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel, ni tïïe bäät kïnna cwøl ni Gëëbal;
english: Then Joshua built an altar unto the Lord God of Israel in mount Ebal,

anywaa: ni tïïc gø na kare kaawat mana ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm jø Icriel ki gø, kaawat mana gööri Modhe piny yi wëël ciik; ni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø tïïc ka kïte mo kär tøø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo gut kïte moøgø ki nywïënyö mar tøk. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge cïpö bääte ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: As Moses the servant of the Lord commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni göör ciik piny bäät kïte møøk mo ena kaace, ni nëënö jï jø Icriel bëët, ni ŋwaala ciik piny moa näk onø göör Modhe.
english: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel bëët ki jø døøŋŋø moge ki dïbwöthe ki dïŋut luup, gena put cuŋŋö lak acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, ki nyïm dïlämme na käl røk jø tuuŋ Libay na biel acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk; këël juurre moa path na bëëdö dï jø Icriel ki wäät thwöth Icriel bëët, ge nut ni ge cuŋŋö kaagø. Ni jø møøk dëëtge cuŋŋa løøk maya ni ge dïët ki kïnna cwøl ni Geridhan, ni jøw møga cuŋŋa løøk maya ni ge dïët ki Kïn Gëëbal, kaawat mana ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm ge dïkwøŋ, nee jø Icriel jïtge ki gwïëth.
english: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre cään, Jøcua luup bëët moa no ogöörö na ciik, ni møøk beege mo gwïëth ni møøk beege mo acïëni, akwaane ni dwøre ena maal; ni kwaane na kare ki køør moa näk ogöör piny bëët yi wëël ciik.
english: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ luubö aciel mo odööŋ røk ciik moa cem Modhe ni kär kwaan Jøcua nyïm acooŋa mar jø Icriel bäre ki mään ko obwöre moa thenh thenh ki juurre moa path na bëëdö dïge.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, gïïa tïïc jø Icrielli awïny nyeye bëët moa bëëdö løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, na näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte, ki mïëya en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki mïëya en bäät naama dwøŋ bëët, këël mana këët ri Kïn Libaanø, ni beege jø Këth, ki jø Amör, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Përec, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc.
english: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnyge gïnögø, geni rege aputge dwal ni tuutge dhøkge na aciel nee këëtge ki Jøcua ki jø Icriel.
english: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Gibien kanya wïnyge gïna tïïc Jøcua dëër pääny Jerikö ki pääny Gaay,
english: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,

anywaa: geni, gena tïïö ki riek waŋ, ni tïŋge kaamar jiy mo di jääŋŋö. 'Ba opïri mo ojeeyø, ko opïc pëëne mo wø käär kwøk nyïïomøki ki ge mo oruuö moa nø jeeyø ni cäŋi køøyø, alwørge ni kïthge ge bäät arëëni moge.
english: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;

anywaa: Ni kïthge tietge ki war mo onø ruuö no ojeeyø ni cäŋi køøyø, ni runyge dëëtge ka abïïe ma jade; 'ba caammi bëët moa käärge na cam mar øtjöö beege caammi mo otal mo onø  puunnö.
english: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.

anywaa: Ni putge ci baŋ Jøcua kanya näk jø Icriel twïër marge ege tïïö yie kanya cwøl ni Gëlgela, ni köge jïgø ki jï jø Icriel, ni «Waani, waana öö ni wa käla paac mo bäär; ennø, wa kwaya uuni nou tudu ki luubö ki waani.»
english: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aköö jï jø Ëwi, «?Aŋø, a kanymør u bëëdö kany mo kare cään ki waani; waano tutwa ki luubö ki uuni kiper ŋø?»
english: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jï Jøcua, ni «Waani, waana laaŋe moï.» Køøre Jøcua aköö jïge, «?Uuna ŋaani cøøn di? ?U kälu kaa ŋø?»
english: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jï Jøcua, ni «Waani, wa na laaŋe moï, waana öö ni wa käla paac mo bäär døc kiper wïny nyeŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marï; kiper waae mo gïïa tïïe awïnywa, ni beege gïïa tïïe bëët Ijep,
english: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the Lord thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,

anywaa: ki gïïa tïïe bëët dëët nyeye mo jø Amör moa näk ariiø na bëëdö løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni beege Cëëwön, nyeya mana näk bëëdö Ëcbön, ki Ög nyeny jø Baacan na näk bëëdö päänya cwøl na Actaröth.
english: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.

anywaa: Ni ö jø døøŋŋø mowa ki jiy bëët moa bëëdö powa ni cäänge ki waani, ni köge, ni ‹Käädu ki caammi kiper wääth øtjöö, ni cou nou røømmu ki jø Icriel, ni kööu jïge, ni «Waani, waana laaŋe mou; 'ba ennø, wa kwaya uuni nou tudu ki luubö ki waani.» ›
english: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.

anywaa: Caammi moi ni käärwa ii na gala kiper wääth øtjöö, kanya lwørwa ge mïëcwa, ni beeye dïcäŋa tïŋwa yie ni wa ööa baŋu, kar kaaca poot nyärö; 'ba ennø, neenï, anø tal ni puunge.
english: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

anywaa: Këël opïc pëëne moi ni yïthge ewa pääŋö ii, nyärö kar kaaca. Neenï, gena jeeyø, ni ö abïïe mowa ki war mowa ni ränyge kiper wääth mana caathwa ni yie bäär en.»
english: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel alwötö røk caammi moa käär jøøgø. 'Ba kanya tïïcge gïnögø, Wuuö Jwøk kärge pëënynyö kiper dwøre mano caane.
english: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni put jïëy ki man bëëtge ki bëët-mëër ki jø Gibien, ni put tudö ki luubö ki geni, nee bëëtge ni kwøw; ni ö jø døøŋŋø mo lwaa Icriel ni putge kööŋ jï jøøgø.
english: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne ni jø Icriel onø tudö ki luubö ki jø Gibien, awïny jø Icrielli ni jøøgø beege jiy mo ena buutge, ni ge bëëdö kany mo kare cään ki geni.
english: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïŋge ni pïïcge päänye mo jøøgø ri dää nïne. 'Ba nyeŋ päänye moøgø beege Gibien, ki Keepira, ki Bëëröth, ki Kiriat-Jeerim.
english: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjath–jearim.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel jøøgø kärge nääö kiper mana näk jø døøŋŋø mo lwaa Icriel onø kööŋ jïge ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel. Ni ö lwaaki bäre ni ŋurge ki nyeŋ jø døøŋŋø.
english: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.

anywaa: 'Ba jø døøŋŋø aköö jï lwaak bäre, ni «Waani, waana nø kööŋ jïge ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel; 'ba ennø, øøni jøøgø ba døø gudö.
english: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the Lord God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.

anywaa: Øøni, gïno tïïö ki geni keere beeye ki man wiiø geni ni kwøw, kiper ni näk mo ge yøø nääö, Jwøk wëëye di jääŋŋö bäätø ki køør mana nø kööŋwa jïge.»
english: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ jø døøŋŋø köö, ni «Wiiø geni nee bëëtge ni kwøw.» Køøre jøøgø aput tïmö na dïmööt jenni ki jø wøm pïï jï lwaa Icriel bäre, kaawat mana nø caani jø døøŋŋø jïge.
english: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua jøøgø acwøle nee öge baŋe, ni cääne ki geni, ni kööe, na «?Aperŋø na cøøgu waani en, ni kööu, ni ‹Waani kar powa bäär døc ki uuni,› ni uuni, karu cään ki waani kiree?
english: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?

anywaa: Ennø, uuna jiy mo ocienø møn; 'ba u puta bëëtö ni uuna laaŋe na bäre bäre, ni uuna dïmööt jenni ki jø wøm pïï kiper oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Jwøa.»
english: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jøøgø jï Jøcua ni köge, ni «Gïna caan jïwa, wa na laaŋe moï, beeye en: Akøp ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, dhaanhnhe ma Modhe ee nø köömmö nee ŋöömö man bäre en cïbe jïïu, ni  dïïr wïth jiy bëët moø bëëdö yi ŋöömö man en nyïmmu. Kiper manøgønø, waana lwäyö døc kiper jwïëy mowa kiper gïna wïnywa kiperu, ni beeye tiere gø ni tïïcwa gïn en.
english: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the Lord thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, neenï, waano løny ni wa ena cerï; gïna beerra eni na adïëri ki baŋï tïïyï jïwa.»
english: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïc Jøcua beeye en; jøøgø akønye ceŋ jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni kärge jøøgø nääö.
english: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge dïcäŋ manøgø, Jøcua jøøgø aput tïïc na dïmööt jenni ki jø wøm pïï jï lwaa Icriel këël kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk kany wø jier Wuuö Jwøki jaak. Ni put gïnögø bëëtö ni tïïcge tïïö këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the Lord, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, awïny Adöni-Dhëdek nyeny Jerucalem ni Jøcua pääny Gaay ee nø mac ni raany gø na bäre bäre, ni tïïc teeŋ gïna tïïe dëër pääny Jerikö ki nyeya mare dëër pääny Gaay ki nyeya mare; ni wïny gø thuwø ni jø Gibien, na poge en buut jø Icriel, ajïëy ki man bëëtge ki bëët-mëër ki jø Icriel.
english: Now it came to pass, when Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, Adöni-Dhëdek ki jiye, gena lwäyö døc, kiper Gibien beeye pääny mo dwøŋ ni caala päänye moa en ceŋ nyeye kaagø, ni dwøŋŋa eni ki pääny Gaay; ni jø leny moa en yie bëët teek døc.
english: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Adöni-Dhëdek nyeny Jerucalem ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ Owam nyeny Keeprön, ki Piram nyeny Jërmut, ki Japia nyeny Lakic, ki Dabëër nyeny Ëglön, ni kööe,
english: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ööu baŋa ni kønynyu aani, nøø cøø baŋ jø Gibien nøø këëdø ki geni, kiper geni gena nø jïëy ki man bëëtge ki bëët-mëër ki Jøcua ki jø Icriel.»
english: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre nyeye mo jø Amör moøgø na abïïc yøø, ni beege nyeny Jerucalem, ki nyeny Keeprön, ki nyeny Jërmut, ki nyeny Lakic, ki nyeny Ëglön, geni bëët ki jø leny moge dëëtge adwalge ni öge ni tïïcge twïër marge buut Gibien nee këëtge ki ge.
english: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.

anywaa: Køøre jø Gibien ajääk baŋ Jøcua ki dwøl kanya näk jø Icriel twïër marge ege tïïö yie Gëlgela, ni köge, ni «Kär wa weyï jaak; køny waani, wa na laaŋe moï. Ennø laar rwänh baŋwa ni gwøgï jwïëy mowa ni kønyï wa, kiper nyeye mo jø Amör bëët na näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte dëëtge adwalge nee këëtge ki waani.»
english: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni tïŋŋe Gëlgela, ni beeye eni ki jø leny bëët, ni jø leny moa näk teek marge okadhø nutö dïge thuwø.
english: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Kärï lwäyö ki geni, kiper geni ge yaa nø cïp cerï; 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo maara lønyø jïre ki man cuŋŋe nyïmï kanyo tïme na ri leny.»
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua atïŋŋö Gëlgela ni but ri wääth ni put pïï røk jø Amör ni cwöba rege.
english: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kier wïth jø Amör ni tïïc ge nee bwøkge nyïm jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni böötge jø Amör døc Gibien, ni riemge geni ki jöör BëëthÖrön ni ge iitha thuur, ni ŋwiecge køørge ni 'näkge geni këël mana pïïcge mïëri moa näk cøøri na Adhëka ki Mekëëda.
english: And the Lord discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya rïïŋ jø Amörri ni ge ŋwieya jø Icriel, Wuuö Jwøk pey mo døøŋŋø døc mo caala kïte alëëŋe ki maal, ni leeŋ ge bäät jø Amör, ni tägi ka kanya løøcge piny ki Bëëth-Örön, këël mana pïïcge Adhëka, ni putge thøø; 'ba atïmö ni thöötha jiy moa thøw ki pey moøgø na näk caala kïte yøø, ki jiy moa 'näk jø Icrielli ko opëëlle.
english: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Beth–horon, that the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïcäŋ mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na cïp jø Amör ceŋ jø Icriel, Jøcua acäänö ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni caan luup moi ii ki teek Jwøk ni nëënö jï jø Icriel, ni kööe, ni «Wui cäŋ, put bëëtö niï cuŋŋö bäät Gibien, 'ba ï na dwääy, put bëëtö niï cuŋŋö bäät goor Ayalön.»
english: Then spake Joshua to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Aijalon.

anywaa: Ni ö cäŋŋi ni put bëëtö kare ni cuŋŋö, ni ö dwääyi ni put ruuö kare thuwø, këël mana ö jø Icrielli ni putge wïth nyïïmänge dïïr. 'Ba luubö manøgø beeye luubö mana no ogöörö yi wëëlö mana cwøl ni Jacar. Kanyøgønø, cäŋ aput ruuö dhöör, ni put bëëtö ni kär laar pädhö ki kany mo yie caala dïcäŋ aciel bäre.
english: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ teeŋ dïcäŋ mo oruu mo caala manøgø dïkwøŋ, ni bäŋ teeŋ gïnögø mo otägö køøre këët, ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na wïny dwør dhaanhø; kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na këëdö kiper jø Icriel.
english: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the Lord hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the Lord fought for Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët gena duu twïër kanya bëëtge yie Gëlgela.
english: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeye moøgø na abïïc yøø geno nø reeŋø ni kange dëëtge yi øt kïdi mana en buut Mekëëda.
english: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Jøcua, ni køp, ni «Nyeye moa näk abïïc be, ajoot ni dëëtge ege kanø yi øt kïdi mana en buut Mekëëda.»
english: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö, ni «Lwötu ki kïte mo døøŋŋø ni ŋielu ge dhi øt kïdi manøgø, ni kwänyu ki jiy nee bëëtge kaagø ni ge koora nyeye moøgø.
english: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni ki dëëtu kiree käru bëëdö kaagø; cou ni läpu køør nyïïmännu, ni 'nägu moo maau waŋjöö na näk odööŋ cään. 'Ba ge kär weyu nee reŋge yïth päänye moge, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu jøøgø ee nø cïp ceŋŋu.»
english: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the Lord your God hath delivered them into your hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Jøcua ki jø Icriel jø Amör ege nø thöör ki 'näk, këël mana dïïrge wïthge, ni moa bøth dëëtge onø reŋ yïth päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek,
english: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.

anywaa: kanyøgønø, jiy bëët aput duu twïër baŋ Jøcua paana cwøl ni Mekëëda ni dëëtge jööt. 'Ba ki dëët wïth juurre moa en kaace, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo dhee ee maar tuk ki jø Icriel.
english: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö, ni «Japu dhi øt kïdi nø, ni kälu nyeye moøgø na abïïc yøø wøk baŋa.»
english: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni putge gïnögø tïïc, ni kälge nyeye moøgø na abïïc yøø wøk baŋe ki yi øt kïdi; ni nyeye moøgø beege nyeny Jerucalem, ki nyeny Keeprön, ki nyeny Jërmut, ki nyeny Lakic, ki nyeny Ëglön.
english: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö jøøgø na kälge nyeye moøgø baŋ Jøcua, Jøcua jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët acwøle, ni kööe jï kwääc lwaae mo leny moa aay ki eni, ni «Nyänhnhu kany mo cään, ni këëllu othäc tietu ŋut nyeye moøgø.» Ni ö kwääc lwaae moøgø ni öge kany mo cään ni këëlge othäc tietge ŋut nyeye moøgø.
english: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï kwääc lwaae moøgø, ni «Käru lwäyö, ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu. Magu rou ni bëëdu nou teek, kiper teeŋ gïnögø poot tïïc Wuuö Jwøki tïïö dëët nyïïmän mou bëët moo këëdu ki geni.»
english: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the Lord do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.

anywaa: Køøre nø, Jøcua nyeye moøgø aput 'näk, ni lïër geni røk jenni abïïc; ni putge bëëtö ni geno lïërö këël mana tïm pinynyi na abøøya.
english: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päth cäŋŋi piny, Jøcua acïpö ki dwøl, ni cige ni kälge dëët jøøgø wøk ki røk jenni ni leeŋge ge yi øt kïdi mana ö nyeye moøgø na kange dëëtge yie, ni putge kïte mo døøŋŋø löör dhi øt kïdi manøgø; ni kïte moøgø poot nut këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua pääny Mekëëda amaae ni poot na dïcäŋögø; ni 'näk nyeya mar gø ki jiy moa en yie bëët ko opëëllö, ni dïïr wïthge bëët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ee wiiø ni kwøw. 'Ba Jøcua teeŋ gïna tïïe dëër nyeny Jerikö atïïe dëër nyeny Mekëëda thuwø.
english: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk jø leny na cäädhö ki eni, gena pöödhö ki Mekëëda ni cige Libana, ni këëtge ki jø Libana.
english: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk pääny manøgø ki nyeya mare acïp ceŋ jø Icriel thuwø; ni ö Jøcua ni 'näk jiy bëët moa en yie ko opëëllö, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ee wiiø ni kwøw. 'Ba Jøcua teeŋ gïna tïïe dëër nyeny Jerikö atïïe dëër nyeny pääny manøgø.
english: And the Lord delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët na cäädhö ki eni, gena pöödhö ki Libana ni cige Lakic, ni tïïcge twïër marge buute ni këëtge ki jø paanøgø.
english: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp pääny Lakic ceŋ jø Icriel; ni ö Jøcua ni mac Lakic ri riet nïne, ni 'näk jiy moa en yie bëët ko opëëllö, ni tïïc gïnögø ni caala teeŋ gïïa tïïe bëët dëër päänya cwøl ni Libana.
english: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Oram nyeny Gëdher aöö nee jø Lakic kønye, ni ö Jøcua ni 'näk nyeny Gëdher ki jiye bëët këël mana tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ee wiiø ni kwøw.
english: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua ki jø Icriel moa näk jø leny na cäädhö ki eni, gena pöödhö ki Lakic ni cige Ëglön, ni tïïcge twïër marge buute ni këëtge ki jø paanøgø.
english: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:

anywaa: Ni macge paanøgø ni poot na dïcäŋ manøgø, ni 'näkge jiy moa en yie ko opëëllö, ni ö Jøcua ni dïïr wïth jiy moa en yie bëët ni poot na dïcäŋ manøgø keere, ni tïïc gïnögø ni caala teeŋ gïïa tïïe bëët dëër päänya cwøl ni Lakic.
english: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk jø leny na cäädhö ki eni thuur agamge ki Ëglön ni cige Keeprön, ni këëtge ki jø paanøgø.
english: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:

anywaa: Ni macge paanøgø, ni 'näkge nyeya mar gø ki jiy bëët moa en yie ko opëëllö, këël jiy bëët moa en yïth atude moa en deŋ paac manøgø. Ni ö Jøcua ni 'näk jiy bëët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ee wiiø ni kwøw, ni tïïc gïnögø ni caala teeŋ gïïa tïïe bëët dëër päänya cwøl ni Ëglön. 'Ba Jøcua pääny manøgø aput raanynyø na bäre bäre ni dïïr wïth jiy bëët moa en yie.
english: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk jø leny na cäädhö ki eni, gena duu paana cwøl ni Dabëër, ni këëtge ki jø paanøgø.
english: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni mac paanøgø ki nyeya mare këël päänye moa en deŋŋe bëët; ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge jiy bëët moa en mïëri moøgø ko opëëllö, ni dïïrge wïthge bëët. 'Ba Jøcua bäŋ dhaanhø mo ee wiiø ni kwøw. 'Ba teeŋ gïna tïïe dëër paana cwøl ni Keeprön ki paana cwøl ni Libana ki nyeye moge, atïïe dëër paana cwøl ni Dabëër ki nyeya mare thuwø.
english: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua mïëri moa en yi ŋöömmögø bëët amaae, ni beege mïëri moa en bäät kïte, ki moa en kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp, ki mïëri moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki mïëri moa en deŋ kïte, ni put nyeye moge bëët 'näk. 'Ba Jøcua wïth jiy bëët adïïre, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ee wiiø ni kwøw, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki Jwø Icriel na kööm eni.
english: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua mïëri moøgø amaae ni tägi ka Kadëc-Bernia këël mana këët Geedha, ki mïëri bëët moa en Göcën këël mana këët Gibien.
english: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni put nyeye moøgø bëët ki mïëri moge mac yie aciel, kiper Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel beeye eni na këëdö kiper jø Icriel.
english: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk jø leny na cäädhö ki eni gena duu twïër kanya bëëtge yie Gëlgela.
english: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jabin nyeny Adhör na wïny gïïa tïïc jø Icrielli, ena jääk baŋ Jöbap nyeny Madön, ki nyeny Cimrön, ki nyeny Akcap,
english: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,

anywaa: ni jääk baŋ nyeye moa näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte na en jï kuna en wï-piny, ki moa en mïëya en yi goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba na en jï løø tier-piny ki Puur Kinërët, ki moa en ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki moa en mïëya en bäät kïnna cwøl ni Dör na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ;
english: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,

anywaa: ni jääk baŋ jø Keenan thuwø na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki moa en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki jø Amör ki jø Këth ki jø Përec ki jø Jeebuc na näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte, ki jø Ëwi na näk bëëdö tier kïnna cwøl ni Armön yi kanya cwøl ni Micpa.
english: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeye moøgø wøk, ni beege geni ki jø leny moge bëët, ni ge thööth døc ni caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ, ni jïge da okwëënyi ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo thööth døc.
english: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.

anywaa: Køøre nyeye moøgø bëët rege adwalge, ni öge ni tïïcge twïër marge na aciel buut puura cwøl ni Marön, nee këëtge ki jø Icriel.
english: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Kär niï lwäyö ki jøøgø, kiper diøø kar kany nø, geni bëët ge cïba cïbö nee ge 'näk jø Icrielli; 'ba ïïni ojwönyi mo okwëënyi moge ŋøørï ŋøørø, ni ö jïëthe moge mo wø tut okwëënyi ni waaŋï geni ki maac.»
english: And the Lord said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki jø leny bëët mo jø Icriel na cäädhö ki eni, gena pïï dëët jøøgø ni cwöba rege kanya enge yie buut puur Marön, ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge jøøgø tuk.
english: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk jøøgø aput cïp ceŋ jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge jøøgø böötö, ni riemge ge këël mana pïïcge pääny mana dwøŋ na cwøl ni Caydan, ni pïïc møga Micerepöth- Mayim, ni pïïc møga goor Micpa na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni putge jøøgø 'näk këël mana tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ege wiiø ni kwøw.
english: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephoth–maim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni ŋøør ojwönyi mo okwëënyi, ni ö jïëthe moge mo wø tut okwëënyi ni waaŋ geni ki maac; ni tïïe na kare kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïre.
english: And Joshua did unto them as the Lord bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Jøcua ree aløøe ni duu ŋääe ni mac päänya cwøl na Adhör, ni 'näk nyeya mar paanøgø ko opëëllö; kiper Adhör beeye pääny mo dwøŋŋa eni dïkwøŋ røk päänye bëët moa bëët nyeye yïthge kaagø.
english: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge jiy bëët moa en yi päänyögø ko opëëllö, ni putge wïth jøøgø dïïr na bäre bäre; 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo owiiø ni kwøw. Ni ö Jøcua ni nyep päänya cwøl na Adhör ki maac.
english: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua päänye mo nyeye moøgø bëët aput mac, ni mak nyeye moge bëët, ni put geni 'näk ko opëëllö, ni dïïr wïthge na bäre bäre, kaawat mana ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm eni.
english: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bäŋ paac mør mo ege waaŋø këët røk mïëya en bäät thuuri kaagø; 'ba beeye Adhör keere na waaŋ Jøcua.
english: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel gïïa twierge mïëri moøgø bëët, këël lääc paac, akälge na moge; 'ba geni jiy bëët anäkge ko opëëllö, këël mana dïïrge wïthge, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ege wiiø ni kwøw.
english: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm dhaanhnhe ma Modhe, ni ö Modhe ni kööm Jøcua, eni na Jøcua enø, gïïögø bëët aput tïïc na karge, ni bäŋ gïn mo ee wiiø ni käre tïïö røk gïïa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge.
english: As the Lord commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua ŋöömmögø bäre aput mac; ni beege mïëya en bäät kïte na en jï løø tier-piny, ki mïëya en Nëgëp bëët, ki ŋööm Göcën bäre, ki mïëya en ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, ki mïëya en bäät kïte na en jï løø wïpiny, ki ŋöömma en buute na näk ree ee päärö.
english: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö manøgø tägi ka ri Kïn Alak, na en buut Cëër, këël mana këët Baal-Gaat na en goor Libaanø tier Kïn Armön. Ni ö Jøcua ni mak nyeye mo mïëri moøgø bëët ni 'näk geni.
english: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua akän wøk ki kany mo bäär ni këëdö ki nyeye moøgø bëët.
english: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca bäŋ paac mo ojïëy ki man bëëtge ki bëët-mëër ki jø Icriel, 'ba beege jø Ëwi moa bëëdö Gibien keerge. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge mïëri moøgø bëët mac ri leny.
english: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc cwïny jøøgø ni teek, nee öge baŋ leny ki jø Icriel, nee wïthge put dïïr na bäre bäre ni bäŋ bäth ec mo onyoodhø jïge; 'ba wïthge aput dïïr, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Jøcua acøø ni 'näk jø Anak na bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte, ni beege mïëri moa näk cøøri ni Keeprön, ki Dabëër, ka Anap, këël mïëri bëët moa en bäät kïte moa en buut piny man ki maya. Jøøgø wïthge aput Jøcua dïïr na  bäre bäre ni raany mïëri moge,
english: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.

anywaa: këël mana tïme ni bäŋ jø Anak mo odööŋ ni kwøw yi ŋööm jø Icriel; 'ba beege mo nøk keerge na dööŋ Geedha, ki Gëth, ka Acdöt.
english: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua ŋöömö bäre aput mac, ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe; ni ö Jøcua ni cïp ŋöömö jï jø Icriel na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge, ni pääŋ gø jïge ki køør wïth tuŋi moge. Køøre piny aput nikwöc, ni ö jiyi ni jwömge dëëtge ki leny.
english: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.

anywaa: Kar kaaca jø Icriel nyeye moa näk ariiø mo jø Amör ege nø böötö ni macge mïëri moge. 'Ba ŋöömö manøgø ena løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni tägi ka Naam Arnön këël mana këët ri Kïn Armön, ki gool mana cwøl na Araaba.
english: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya mana dïkwøŋ beeye Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na näk bëëdö pääny Ëcbön. Ŋöömö mar paare beeye thääŋ Gelät bäre, ni nyeŋ keee moe tägi ka Aröör na en deŋ goor Naam Arnön, ki paana en dï gool, këël mana këët Naam Jabök na näk keew mar jø Amön.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö manøgø rwöpa goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba na en jï løø tuul-cäŋ, ni tägi ka Puur Kinërët këël mana pïïe Bëëth-Jecimöt na en deŋ Naam Araaba, ni beeye Naam Acäbö, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni put aay ni coonya tier Kïn Pedhega.
english: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth–jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth–pisgah:

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya maya mana bööt jø Icrielli thuwø beeye Ög nyeny Baacan, na dööŋ røk juna cwøl ni Rapayim. Päänye moe moa bëëde yïthge beege Actaröth ki Edaray.
english: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

anywaa: Ni ŋöömö mar paare rwöpa Kïn Armön ki pääny mana cwøl ni Caleka ki ŋööm Baacan bäre, këël mana put pïï waŋ keew mar jø Gëcur ki jø Maika, ki thääŋ Gelät bäre, këël mana pïïe waŋ keew mar Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön.
english: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk ki jø Icriel nyeye moøgø aböötge; ni ö eni ni cïp ŋøøm moøgø jï jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, ni beege ŋøøpo dööŋ jïge na kurge.
english: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään Jøcua ki jø Icriel nyeye moa bëëdö løø Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ aböötge, ni ŋøøm moge tägi ka Baal-Gaat na en goor Libaanø këël mana këët ri Kïn Alak na en buut Cëër. Ni ö Jøcua ni cïp ŋøøm moøgø jï jø Icriel na ŋøøpo dööŋ na kurge, ni ee pääŋŋö ki køør wïth tuŋi moge;
english: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;

anywaa: ni ŋøøm moøgø beege ŋøøm mo mïëya en bäät kïte, ki mïëya en ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki mïëri moa en yi goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, ki mïëri moa en deŋ kïte, ki mïëri moa en jï kuna en dï paap, ki mïëri moa en kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp; ni jiy moa en yïth mïëyögø beege jø Këth, ki jø Amör, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Përec, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc.
english: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye moøgø beege nyeny Jerikö, ki nyeny Gaay, na en buut Bëthël,
english: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth–el, one;
