anywaa: ki nyeny Jerucalem, ki nyeny Keeprön,
english: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Jërmut, ki nyeny Lakic,
english: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Ëglön, ki nyeny Gëdher,
english: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Dabëër, ki nyeny Gëëdir,
english: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Örma, ki nyeny Arat,
english: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Libana, ki nyeny Adulam,
english: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Mekëëda, ki nyeny Bëthël,
english: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth–el, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Tapuwa, ki nyeny Ëpër,
english: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Apëk, ki nyeny Lacarön,
english: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Madön, ki nyeny Adhör,
english: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Cimrön-Mirön, ki nyeny Akcap,
english: The king of Shimron–meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Tanak, ki nyeny Megidø,
english: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Këdëc, ki nyeny Jökniam na en kanya cwøl ni Karmël,
english: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Dör, paana en bäät kïnna cwøl ni Dör, ki nyeny Göyim na en Gëlgela,
english: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;

anywaa: ki nyeny Tirja; ni kwään nyeye moøgø bëët beege pïëradäk kurciel.
english: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jøcua na jaal ni cwiiye oløny ni thööth døc, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïgø, ni «Ïïni, ïïna nø tïmö na jaal, ni cwiiri moï oløny ni thööth døc; 'ba poot da ŋøøm mo thööth mo poot kär maaø.
english: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the Lord said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.

anywaa: Ŋøøm moa näk poot no odööŋ beege ŋööm jø Pilitin bäre ki ŋööm jø Gëcur bäre,
english: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

anywaa: ni beeye ki mana täge ki Naam Ciör na en løø Ijep jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mana aae ni këët waŋ keew mar paana cwøl na Akarön na no okwaan røk mïëc jø Keenan moa en jï løø wï-piny; ni beege mïëc kwääri mo jø Pilitin moa näk abïïc. Ni kwääri moøgø beege mo jø Geedha, ki jø Acdöt, ki jø Ackelön, ki jø Gëth, ki jø Akarön, këël mïëc jø Awim na en jï løø tier-piny.
english: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm møga moa näk poot no odööŋ beege ŋööm Keenan bäre, na en jï løø wï-piny, na en yïthakic Mëëra na näk mar jø Caydan, ka Apëk, këël mana put gø këël waŋ keew mar jø Amör;
english: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:

anywaa: ki ŋööm jø Gëbal, ki ŋööm Libaanø bäre, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni tägi ka Baal-Gaat na en tier Kïn Armön këël mana këët kanya cwøl ni Libö-Amath.
english: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.

anywaa: «'Ba aani na Wuuö Jwøk, jiy bëët moa näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte ki mana täge ki Libaanø këël mana këët Micerepöth-Mayim, ki jø Caydan bëët, ge riema wøk nyïm jø Icriel; 'ba gïno tïïyï keere beeye ki man pääŋŋï ŋøøm moøgø jï jø Icriel ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, nee ci jïge na marge kaawat mana nø köömma ïïni.
english: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth–maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋøøm moøgø ni løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ enø, këël mano këët deŋ naama dwøŋ, wär pääŋŋï jï wïth tuŋi moa näk abïŋween ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, na ŋöömmo ci jïge na marge.»
english: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, ki jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ŋøøm moa cïp jïge na moge ege nø lwør kanya enge løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni beeye Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na cïp gø jïge;
english: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;

anywaa: ni ŋøøm moøgø tägi ka Aröör, na en deŋ goor Naam Arnön ki pääny mana en dï gool kaagø, ni rwöpa pwöl Medeba bäre, këël mana këët Dibön;
english: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;

anywaa: ki päänye bëët mo Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na bëëdö Ëcbön, këël mana aae ni këët waŋ keew mar jø Amön;
english: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;

anywaa: ni rwöpa Gelät bäre, ki ŋööm jø Gëcur ki jø Maika, ki Kïn Armön bäre, ki ŋööm Baacan bäre këël mana aae ni këël gø päänya cwøl ni Caleka;
english: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salecah;

anywaa: ni rwöpa mïëri moa en cer Ög nyeny Baacan, na bëëdö Actaröth ki Edaray. Kiper Modhe jiy moa en yïth mïëri moøgø, këël Ag, anääe ni mac ŋøøm moge. 'Ba dïkwøŋ Ög keere beeye na dööŋ ri juna cwøl ni Rapayim.
english: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel jø Gëcur ki jø Maika kärge riem wøk; ni jø Gëcur ki jø Maika ge poot bëëdö na aciel ki jø Icriel këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na pääŋ ŋøøm, jø tuuŋ Libay keere käre mooø ki ŋøøm na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge; kiper olämme mo wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel, beeye na cïp na tïmö ni caala ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe.
english: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Modhe ŋøøm mo dööŋ jï jø tuuŋ Ruben acïbe jïge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moa cïp jïge tägi ka Aröör na en deŋ goor Naam Arnön ki pääny mana en dï gool, ni rwöpa pwöl Medeba bäre,
english: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;

anywaa: ki Ëcbön, ki päänye moe bëët moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ni beege Dibön, ki Bamöth-Baal, ki Bëëth-Baal-Miyön,
english: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth–baal, and Beth–baal–meon,

anywaa: ki Jäc, ki Kedemöth, ki Mëpät,
english: And Jahzah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

anywaa: ki Kiriatayim, ki Cebama, ki Ceret-Caar, na en bäät kïdi mana en buut gool,
english: And Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth–shahar in the mount of the valley,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Pëëgör, ki deŋ Kïn Pedhega, ki Bëëth-Jecimöt,
english: And Beth–peor, and Ashdoth–pisgah, and Beth–jeshimoth,

anywaa: këël päänye bëët moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki mïëri bëët moa en cer Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör na näk bëëdö Ëcbön. 'Ba Modhe nyeya manøgø ki kwääri mo jø Midien ee nø 'näk, ni beege Ëwi, ki Rekem, ki Cuur, ki Ur, ki Riba, jøøa bëëdö na kwääri mo mïëri ena ceŋge yi ŋööm Cëëwön.
english: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel thuwø Beelam o Beeyör, ŋat adïëda, anäkge ko opëëllö na aciel ki jiy møga bëët.
english: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew mar jø tuuŋ Ruben beeye Naam Jördan. Moøgø beege päänye ki mïëri moa dööŋ jï jø tuuŋ Ruben ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø Modhe ŋøøm mo dööŋ jï jø tuuŋ Gaat, acïbe jï jø tuuŋ Gaat ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moa cïp jïge beege Jadher, ki päänye mo Gelät bëët, ki thäk ŋøøm mo jø Amön, ni put aay ni këët Aröör na näk neeta rege ki Raaba;
english: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;

anywaa: ni tägi ka Ëcbön këël mana këët Ramat-Micpa, ki Bethönim, ni cäŋ tägö ki Maanayim këël mana këët waŋ keew mar pääny mana cwøl ni Dabëër;
english: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;

anywaa: ni rwöpa mïëri moa en dï goor Naam Jördan, ni beege Bëëth- Aram, ki Bëëth-Nimera, ki Cuköt, ki Capön. 'Ba ŋöömö manøgø bäre beeye mar Cëëwön nyeny Ëcbön, na thääŋŋe cïp jï jø tuuŋ Ruben. Ni ŋöömö manøgø beeye ŋöömma en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni keew mare beeye Naam Jördan, ni put gø këël deŋ puul mana cwøl ni Kinërët.
english: And in the valley, Beth–haram, and Beth–nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.

anywaa: Moøgø beege päänye ki mïëri moa dööŋ jï jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø Modhe ŋøøm mo dööŋ jï thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, acïbe jïge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moa cïp jïge tägi ka Maanayim, ni rwöpa ŋööm Baacan bäre na en cer Ög nyeny Baacan, ki päänye mo Jayer bëët na en yi ŋööm Baacan, ni beege päänye ma pïërabïciel;
english: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:

anywaa: ki thääŋ Gelät thuwø, no orwöbö na aciel ki Actaröth, ki Edaray, ni beege päänye moa en cer Ög na en yi ŋööm Baacan. 'Ba ŋøøm moøgø aput tïmö na mo nyïïkwaac Makir o Maneeca, ni puti cïp jï nyïïkwaac Makir møga ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa pääŋ Modhe jï wïth tuŋi moa näk ariiø ki thääŋö na ŋøøpo dööŋ jïge, kanya enge pwöl Möap løø Naam Jördan løøga jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni ge dïët ki Jerikö.
english: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na pääŋ ŋøøm, jø tuuŋ Libay käre mooø ki ŋøøm na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge; 'ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel no odööŋ jïge ni caala ŋöömma doo dööŋ jïge na kurge, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïge.
english: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege ŋøøm moa en yi ŋööm Keenan, na en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, na pääŋŋi jï jø Icriel nee dööŋe jïge na kurge; ni jøøa pääŋ ŋøøm moøgø beege Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moøgø apääŋŋi jï wïth tuŋi moa näk abïŋween ki thääŋö na ŋøøpo dööŋ jïge na kurge, ni pääŋŋi ka køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe.
english: By lot was their inheritance, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.

anywaa: Kiper Modhe wïth tuŋi moa näk ariiø ki thääŋö, ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge ee nø cïp jïge løø Naam Jördan løøga. 'Ba eni jø tuuŋ Libay käre mooø ki ŋøøm na ŋøøpo dööŋ jïge na kurge kanya cïp ŋøøm jï wïth tuŋi moøgø.
english: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääŋ ŋøøm jï wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel, këël na bëëde ni jø tuuŋ Libay kär mooø ki ŋøøm, kwään wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel moa jïtö ki ŋøøm poot di kwaanø na apaar kurriiø kiper mana kwaan wäät  Jocep na wïth tuŋi ariiø, ni beege tuuŋ Maneeca ki tuuŋ Ipariem. 'Ba beege päänye keerge na cïp jï jø tuuŋ Libay na kwör bëëte moge, ki kwör kwaath mo kwaacge lääc paac moge yïthge.
english: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgønø, jø Icriel ŋøøm aputge pääŋŋö na kare, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe.
english: As the Lord commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni ŋøøm poot kär pääŋŋö, jø tuuŋ Juuda aö nyïm Jøcua kanya enge Gëlgela. 'Ba Kalëp o Jöpöni nyikwaar jø Kënec aköö jï gø, ni «Ïïni, dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jï Modhe na näk dhaanh Jwøk ŋäyï, ni dwørøgø caane kiperø ø riedi kanya enø Kadëc-Bernia.
english: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the Lord said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cwiiya pïëraŋween kar kaace, kanya ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na jääŋ øøni ki Kadëc-Bernia nee ŋööm Keenan lieø. 'Ba aani luup moa duua ki geni akøba jïre na adïëri ki cwïnya bäre.
english: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh–barnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmëëe moa aaø ki geni na aciel cwïny lwaa Icriel awëëkge pädhö ki lwär; 'ba aani jöör Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøa aputa caath ki cwïnya bäre.
english: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the Lord my God.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni put kööŋ jïra dïcäŋeca, ni kööe, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, ŋöömma nyøønï ki tierï enø ocïba na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïrï ki nyïïkwaayï na bäre bäre, kiper ïïni jöör Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøa acaathï ki cwïnyï bäre.›
english: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the Lord my God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, neenï, ki mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na caan luummögø jï Modhe, cwiiri apäŋ ni pïëraŋween kurbïïc, ni dwørøgø caane kanya cääth jø Icrielli dï paap; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wec aani naa poot kwøw këël kar kany ennø, kaawat mana caane. 'Ba ennø, cwiiri 'moa beege pïërabära kurbïïc.
english: And now, behold, the Lord hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the Lord spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.

anywaa: 'Ba aani dëëra poot teek ni caala kanya ö Modhe na jääŋ aani kar kaaca; ni teek mar dëëra poot caala mana dïkwøŋ, ni løny jïra ki man cøøa baŋ leny; këël tïïe bëët mo wø tïïc løny jïra thuwø.
english: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, akwaya ïïni, nee mïëyö ni en bäät kïte yøø cïpï jïra. Ni beege mïëya cään Wuuö Jwøki kiperge kar kaaca. Kiper kar kaaca thuwø ŋäyï ni jø Anak bëëdö kaace, ni päänye moge døøŋŋø, ni ege geerø ni teek døc; 'ba yaa ŋäädhö ni Wuuö Jwøk oen buuta, nee tïme ni løny jïra ki man riema ge wøk, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the Lord spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the Lord will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the Lord said.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua Kalëp o Jöpöni agwïëdhe, ni cïp pääny Keeprön jïgø na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïre na kure.
english: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, pääny Keeprön aput tïmö ni beeye ŋöömma dööŋ jï Kalëp o Jöpöni, nyikwaar jø Kënec, këël dïcäŋi en, kiper eni jöör Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel acaadhe ki cwïnye bäre.
english: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ Keeprön mana dïkwøŋ beeye Kiriat- Arba; kiper ŋata cwøl na Arba, na caa pääny manøgø ree, beeye dhaanhø mo dwøŋŋa eni døc røk jø Anak kar kaaca. Køøre piny aput nikwöc, ni ö jiyi ni jwömge dëëtge ki leny.
english: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋöömö mana ci jï jø tuuŋ Juuda ki køør dhøk uudi moge kïïö ka ŋööm Ëdöm, ni rwöpa dï paap Dhïn, na aŋuunne beeye Nëgëp na en jï løø tier-piny.
english: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew marge ki jï løø tierpiny tägi ka aŋuun weel Naam Acäbö na en jï løø tier-piny thuwø.
english: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:

anywaa: Køøre waŋ keew manøgø acør thuur Akirabim na en jï løø tier-piny, ni pöödhe ni coonya kanya cwøl ni Dhïn. Køøre acäŋ aay ni pääny Kadëc-Bernia ee wii bäät cwïïc, ni coonya Eedharan ni put pööth Adar, ni gøn ree ni coonya Karka.
english: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh–acrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh–barnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:

anywaa: Ni cäŋ pöödhö ni coonya Acimön ni päth yi waŋ Ijep, ni put ŋuudö yi naama dwøŋ. 'Ba manøgø beeye waŋ keew mar jø tuuŋ Juuda, na put tïmö na waŋ keew mar jø Icriel mana en jï løø tier-piny.
english: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ beeye deŋ Naam Acäbö bäre këël mana pïïe kanya pänh Naam Jördan ki yie. 'Ba keew ki jï løø wï-piny tägi ka weel Naam Acäbö ni beeye kanya pänh Naam Jördan ki yie.
english: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:

anywaa: Køøre keew manøgø aay ni pïïe pääny mana cwøl ni Bëëth- Ogla, ni pöödhe ni pääny mana cwøl ni Bëëth-Araaba ee wii bäät caam, ni put aay ni coonya kïdi mana no ocaa ri Böwan nyikwaar Ruben.
english: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:

anywaa: Ni ö keewi manøgø ni put aay ki Goor Akör ni coonya Dabëër, ni gøn ree jï løø wï-piny ni coonya Gëëlilöt na näk dïët ki jöör Adumim, na en løø gool bäät caam. Ni pöödhe ni coonya jøøro mana cwøl na Ayn-Camic, ni put pïï jøøro mana cwøl na Ayn-Rögëël.
english: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh, and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel:

anywaa: Køøre keew acäŋ aay ki Goor Ben-Inöm ni coonya deŋ kïdi mana bëët pääny jø Jeebuc bääte, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni keew cøra jï løø tier-piny; ni aae ni coonya wï kïdi mana en buut Goor Inöm jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, na en ya aŋuun Goor Rapayim na en jï løø wï-piny.
english: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki wï kïdi kaagø, keew akööm ni aae ni coonya jøøro mana en kanya cwøl ni Nëëptö, ni pöödhe ni coonya päänye moa en bäät kïnna cwøl ni Ëprön. Køøre keew acäŋ köömmö ni aae ni coonya pääny mana cwøl ni Baala ni wø cwøl ki kwör møøk ni Kiriat-Jeerim.
english: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjath–jearim:

anywaa: 'Ba keew ree agøn jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ki Baala ni aae ni coonya kïnna cwøl ni Cëër, ni pööth deŋ kïnna cwøl ni Jeerim ni pääny mana en bääte cwøl ni Kicalön ni keew cøra jï løø wï-piny, ni løøc piny ni coonya pääny mana cwøl ni Bëëth-Camic, ni put pööth pääny mana cwøl ni Temna.
english: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth–shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:

anywaa: Ni ö keewi ni pöödhe ni coonya deŋ kïnna en buut Akarön ni cøra jï løø wï-piny. Køøre keew akööm ni aae ni coonya pääny mana cwøl ni Cekrön, ni pöödhe ni coonya Kïn Baala ni put pööth pääny mana cwøl ni Japniël, ni ö keewi manøgø ni put ŋuudö yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba keew ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ beeye deŋ naama dwøŋ bäre. Moøgø beege nyeŋ keee moa en deŋ ŋöömö mana ci jï jø tuuŋ Juuda ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jï Jøcua, eni na Jøcua enø, pääny mana cwøl ni Kiriat-Arba acïbe jï Kalëp o Jöpöni na gïno dööŋ na kure yïthakic jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni ö nyeŋ pääny manøgø ni cwøli ni Keeprön. 'Ba ŋata cwøl na Arba, na kwøŋ pääny manøgø caa ree, beeye kwar jø Anak.
english: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba Kalëp jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Anak ariem wøk kaace; ni jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Anak moøgø beege jø tuuŋ Cëëci ki jø tuuŋ Akimen ki jø tuuŋ Thalmay.
english: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

anywaa: Køøre Kalëp aci baŋ jiy moa bëëdö Dabëër nee këëde ki ge. 'Ba nyeŋ Dabëër mana dïkwøŋ beeye Kiriat-Cëëpïr.
english: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher.

anywaa: 'Ba Kalëp aköö jï jø leny moe, ni «Ŋato këëdi ki jø Kiriat-Cëëpïr, ni mac pääny marge, nyaara ma Akca kiree cïba cïbö jïre nee nywøme.»
english: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Götönial nyikwaar jø Kënec, na näk owää Kalëp, pääny manøgø amaae; ni ö Kalëp ni cïp nyaare ma Akca jïgø nee nywøme.
english: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri nywöm kanya kïth Akca po cwøre ma Götönial, eni na Akca enø yi cwøre acoone nee wänni ma Kalëp pëënynyi ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge. Køøre Akca aput ci baŋ wänni ma Kalëp ni eth piny ki bäät arëën mare; ni kö wänni jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?»
english: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?

anywaa: 'Ba Akca aköö jïgø, ni «Mooc aani ki muuy mo yia mïnnö ki gø; ennø, kaawat mana nø cïpï ŋøøm mo Nëgëp jïra na näk bäŋ pïï yie, a kwaya ïïni naa mooyï ki jøør mo pïï.» Køøre Kalëp jøør mo pïï moa en yïth ŋøøpøgø, ni beege moa en jï maal ki moa en jï piny, aput cïp jï nyaare ma Akca.
english: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø beege ŋøøm moa ci jï jø tuuŋ Juuda na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye mo jø tuuŋ Juuda na en yi ŋöömö marge jï løøa näk kïïö ki Ëdöm ki jï løø tier-piny beege Kapcël, ka Adër, ki Jagur,
english: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,

anywaa: ki Kina, ki Dimöna, ka Adäda,
english: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,

anywaa: ki Këdëc, ka Adhör, ki Yitnan,
english: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,

anywaa: ki Dhip, ki Thëlem, ki Bealöt,
english: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,

anywaa: ka Adhör-Adata, ki Kiriöt-Adhör,
english: And Hazor Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,

anywaa: ka Amam, ki Cema, ki Mölada,
english: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,

anywaa: ka Adhar-Gada, ka Acmön, ki Bëëth-Pëlët,
english: And Hazar–gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth–pelet,

anywaa: ka Adhar- Cuwal, ki Bëërcïïba, ki Bijiyötiya,
english: And Hazar–shual, and Beer–sheba, and Bizjothjah,

anywaa: ki Baala, ki Iyim, ka Acëm,
english: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem,

anywaa: ki Eltölat, ki Kicil, ki Örma,
english: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,

anywaa: ki Ciklak, ki Matmana, ki Cancana,
english: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,

anywaa: ki Libawöt, ki Cilim, ka Ayn, ki Rimön; 'ba päänye moøgø bëët beege pïërariiø ka abïŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö beege Ëctaöl, ki Dhöra, ka Acena,
english: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah,

anywaa: ki Dhanöwa, ka Ayn-Ganim, ki Tapuwa, ki Enam,
english: And Zanoah, and En–gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,

anywaa: ki Jërmut, ka Adulam, ki Cökö, ka Adhëka,
english: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Soco, and Azekah,

anywaa: ki Caarayim, ka Adithayim, ki Gedëra, ki Gedërötayim; ni beege päänye apaar kurŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ki Cinan, ka Adaca, ki Mikdal-Gaat,
english: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal–gad,

anywaa: ki Dilän, ki Micpa, ki Jökthiël,
english: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,

anywaa: ki Lakic, ki Böckat, ki Ëglön,
english: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,

anywaa: ki Kebön, ki Laamac, ki Kitlic,
english: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,

anywaa: ki Gedëröt, ki Bëëth-Dagön, ki Nayma, ki Mekëëda; ni beege päänye apaar ka abïciel ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Gederoth, Beth–dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ki Libana, ki Ëtëër, ka Acan,
english: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,

anywaa: ki Eptay, ka Acena, ki Necip,
english: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,

anywaa: ki Kïïla, ka Akdhip, ki Marëca; ni beege päänye abïŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ka Akarön, ka atude moe moa en buute,
english: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:

anywaa: ka atude bëët moa en buut Acdöt, ni tägi ka Akarön këël mana këët deŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:

anywaa: Ka Acdöt, ka atude moe moa en buute; ki Geedha, ka atude moe moa en buute; na atude moøgø oput këët buut waŋ Ijep ki deŋ naama dwøŋ, ni beeye kwöra cør waŋ keew yïthge.
english: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye mo mïëya en bäät kïte beege Camir, ki Jatir, ki Cökö,
english: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

anywaa: ki Dana, ki Kiriat-Caana ni beeye Dabëër,
english: And Dannah, and Kirjath–sannah, which is Debir,

anywaa: ka Anap, ki Ëctemöa, ka Anim,
english: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,

anywaa: ki Göcën, ko Olön, ki Gilø; ni beege päänye apaar kurciel ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ka Arap, ki Duma, ki Ëcän,
english: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,

anywaa: ki Janim, ki Bëëth-Tapuwa, ka Apëka,
english: And Janum, and Beth–tappuah, and Aphekah,

anywaa: ki Umta, ki Kiriat-Arba ni beeye Keeprön, ki Ciør; ni beege päänye abïŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Humtah, and Kirjath–arba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ki Maøn, ki Karmël, ki Dhip, ki Jötha,
english: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,

anywaa: ki Jedhriel, ki Jökdäm, ki Dhanöwa,
english: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,

anywaa: ki Kayin, ki Giba, ki Temna; ni beege päänye apaar ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ka Alul, ki Bëëth-Cur, ki Gëdör,
english: Halhul, Beth–zur, and Gedor,

anywaa: ki Maarat, ki Bëëth-Anöt, ki Eltekön; ni beege päänye abïciel ka atude moge moa en buutge. Ki Tëköa, ki Eeparata ni beeye Bethelem, ki Pëëgör, ki Ëtam, ki Culön, ki Tatam, ki Cörec, ki Cerem, ki Galim, ki Bether, ki Manøcø; ni beege päänye apaar kurciel ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Maarath, and Beth–anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ki Kiriat-Baal ni beeye Kiriat-Jeerim, ki Raaba; ni beege päänye ariiø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: Kirjath–baal, which is Kirjath–jearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa en jï kuna en dï paap beege Bëëth-Araaba, ki Midin, ki Cekaka,
english: In the wilderness, Beth–arabah, Middin, and Secacah,

anywaa: ki Nipcan, ki Pääny Acäbö, ka Ayn-Gadi; ni beege päänye abïciel ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and En–gedi; six cities with their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Jeebuc, na bëëdö yi Jerucalem, kär løny jï jø tuuŋ Juuda ki man riemge ge wøk; ni ö jø Jeebuc ni putge bëëtö na aciel ki jø tuuŋ Juuda yi Jerucalem këël dïcäŋi en.
english: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep, ni beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, ŋøøm moa ci jïge ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, waŋ keew ki jï løø tier-piny atägö ki Naam Jördan ni dïët ki Jerikö, ni aae  ki buut jøør mo Jerikö, ni cøra jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jøør moøgø. Køøre keew ree aput gøn ki Jerikö, ni cøøa jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni aae ni cøra dï paap ni pöödhe ki dï mïëya en bäät kïte ni put pïï Bëthël.
english: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth–el,

anywaa: Ni cäŋ aay ki Bëthël ni pïïe Löja, ni pöödhe ni pïïe Atharöt na en waŋ keew mar jø Arki.
english: And goeth out from Beth–el to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,

anywaa: Ni løøc piny mëëth jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni put pïï waŋ keew mar jø Jeplëtha, ni aae ki waŋ keew mar Bëëth-Örön mana en jï piny këël mana pïïe Gëdher. Ni put ŋuudö yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa ci jï jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge, ni beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, waŋ keew mar ŋøøm moøgø ki jï løø tier-piny, atägö ka Atharöt-Adar na en jï løø kur tuulcäŋ, këël mana aae ni coonya jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni put pïï Bëëth-Örön mana en jï maal.
english: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar, unto Beth–horon the upper;

anywaa: Køøre keew aput aay ni ŋuude naama dwøŋ. 'Ba ki mana täge ki Mikmitat na en jï løø wï-piny, keew ree aput gøn jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni aae ki buut Taanat-Cëëlö na en yi ŋöömö marge, ni put pöödhö ni coonya Janöa.
english: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanath–shiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;

anywaa: Ni cäŋ aay ki Janöa jï piny mëëth ni coonya Atharöt ki Neära, ni pïïe Jerikö, ni put ŋuudö Naam Jördan.
english: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki Tapuwa, waŋ keew apöödhö ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni coonya yi waŋ Kana, ni put ŋuudö naama dwøŋ. Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa dööŋ jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye møøk ka atude moge moa en buutge na en yi ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca acïp jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem thuwø.
english: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ipariem, jø Keenan moa bëëdö Gëdher kärge riem wøk, ni ö jø Keenanni moøgø ni putge bëëtö na aciel ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem këël dïcäŋi en. 'Ba jøøgø aput tïmö na laaŋe mo tïïö ka teek jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem.
english: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri ŋöömö mana en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänhcäŋ, da ŋøøm mo oci jï thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw. 'Ba Maneeca beeye kany Jocep, ni ö Makirri ni näk kany Maneeca, ni eni da wääde mo cwøl ni Gelät. 'Ba kar kaaca, nyïïkwaac Makir, kiper mana näk gena jø leny mo teek, ŋööm Gelät ki ŋööm Baacan na en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, onø cïp jïge na mano dööŋ jïge na kurge.
english: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri ŋöömö manøgø na en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ enø, jø tuuŋ Maneeca møga ajïtö ki ŋøøm kaagø ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni beege dhi øt Abiedhar, ki dhi øt Këlëk, ki dhi øt Aciriel, ki dhi øt Cekam, ki dhi øt Ëpër, ki dhi øt Cemida. Ni moøgø beege nyïïkwaac Maneeca moa näk cwøw ki køør dhøk uudi moge; 'ba Maneeca beeye o Jocep.
english: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhilöpat wär Ëpër nyikwaar Maneeca jïre bäŋ obwöre ma cwøw; 'ba beege obwöre ma mään keerge na en jïre. Ni nyeŋ nyïïe beege Maala, ki Nöa, ko Okila, ki Milka, ki Tirja. 'Ba Opëër na näk wää Dhilöpat beeye o Gelät, ni ö Geläti ni näk o Makir, ni ö Makirri ni näk o Maneeca.
english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïgögø aö nyïm Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun, ki dïbwöthe, ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk Modhe aköömme nee wa jïtwa ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïwa na kurwa yïthakic jø tuuŋ wääwa.» Kanyøgønø, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki, Jøcua nyïï Dhilöpat aput mooc ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakic tuuŋ wääge.
english: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jø tuuŋ Maneeca ajïtö ki  ŋøøm møøk mo kwöre apaar mo tøør ri ŋööm Gelät ki ŋööm Baacan na en løø Naam Jördan løøga,
english: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;

anywaa: kiper jø tuuŋ Maneeca moa näk mään ajïtö ki ŋøøm na mo dööŋ jïge yïthakic nyïïkwaaye møga moa näk cwøw. Ni ö ŋööm Gelät ni ci jï jø tuuŋ Maneeca møga.
english: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca na en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänhcäŋ kïïö ki ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Acer, ni rwöpa ŋöömö bäre mana en yïthakicge ki pääny Mikmitat na en løø pääny Cekam jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba waŋ keew aput aay ki Mikmitat, ni coonya jï løø tier-piny ni pööth ŋöömma näk jø Ayn-Tapuwa bëëdö yie.
english: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of En–tappuah.

anywaa: 'Ba pääny mana cwøl ni Tapuwa ena waŋ keew mana en yïthakic ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca ki ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem. 'Ba pääny manøgø ena jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni ŋøøm moa en deŋŋe ena jï jø tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;

anywaa: Køøre keew aput aay ni løøc yi waŋ Kana. 'Ba päänye moa en løø waŋ manøgø jï løø tier-piny, këël na bëëtge ni kere ena yi ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca, thööth päänye moøgø atïmö ni ena jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem. 'Ba waŋ keew mar jø tuuŋ Maneeca adøøk ki løø waŋ manøgø jï løø wï-piny ni put ŋuudö yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:

anywaa: 'Ba løøa en jï løø tier-piny ena jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni ö løøa en jï løø wï-piny ni en jï jø tuuŋ Maneeca. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Maneeca kïïö ka naama dwøŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ. 'Ba ŋöömö marge ki jï løø wï-piny kïïö ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Acer, ni put aay ni tïme ni kïïö ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Icakar no onyek jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye møøk moa en yïth ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Icakar ki ŋøøm mo jø tuuŋ Acer na ci jï jø tuuŋ Maneeca beege Bëëth-Can ka atude moe moa en buute, ki Ibleäm ka atude moe moa en buute, ki Dör, paana en bäät kïdi, ka atude moe moa en buute këël jiy moa bëëdö yïthge, ki Endör ka atude moe moa en buute ki jiy moa bëëdö yïthge, ki Tanak ka atude moe moa en buute ki jiy moa bëëdö yïthge, ki Megidø ka atude moe moa en buute ki jiy moa bëëdö yïthge.
english: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Beth–shean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Maneeca kär løny jïge ki man macge päänye moøgø na bäre, kiper jø Keenan cwïnyge aputge mak ki man bëëtge yïth ŋøøm moøgø.
english: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm jø Icrielli ni ge teek, jø Keenan moøgø akïthge tietge ni kïthge bäätge ki tïïe mo teek; 'ba kärge riem wøk na bäre.
english: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac Jocep acäänö ki Jøcua ni köge, ni «Waani, waana jiy mo kwäänwa thööth, ni waano gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki këël kar kany ennø. ?Aperŋø nø ni tïme niï cïpa ŋøøm mo nøk jïwa en ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw en?»
english: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the Lord hath blessed me hitherto?

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö jïge, «Ni näk mo uuna jiy mo kwäännu thööth nø, cou ni ŋøtu lul mana en bäät kïdi maal yi ŋööm jø Përec ki jø Rapayim nee tïme na maru, kiper uuna köö ni mïëya en bäät kïte na cïp jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem atïmö ni diiny ni ba rømi kiperu.»
english: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Jocep aköö, ni «Mïëya en bäät kïte ba rømi kiperwa møn, këël jø Keenan thuwø moa en yi ŋöömma näk gool, ge ba løny böötö jïwa, kiper jïge da jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo tïïc ka nywïëny, ni beege jø Keenan moa en Bëëth-Can ka atude moe moa en buute ki moa en goor Jedhriel.»
english: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua acäänö ki dhi øt Jocep ni beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni kööe, ni «Uuni, uuna jiy mo kwäännu thööth, nou teek døc thuwø. U ba doo mooø ki ŋøøm mo nøk keerge ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.
english: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøømma en bäät kïte poot tïmö na maru. Këël na bëët kaace na lul, dou ŋødø, ni këëllu gø nyeŋ keee moe, ni ö ŋöömmöca ni  tïme na maru bäre; ni riemu jø Keenan wøk thuwø, këël na bëëtge ni ge teek ni jïge da jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo tïïc ka nywïëny.»
english: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö jø Icrielli na macge ŋööm Keenan, geni rege acooŋge Cëëlö, ni gurge oduŋkaany røømmø piny kaace.
english: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel moa näk apaar kurriiø, da wïth tuŋi abïriiø mo ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na moge poot kär pääŋŋö jïge.
english: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua aköö jï jø Icriel, na «?Aŋø, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø nou poot bëëdö nou ba døny yi ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwø kwäyu jïïu nee lwørru na maru?
english: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the Lord God of your fathers hath given you?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kwänyu ki jiy, ni kwanynyu na jiy adäk adäk ri wï tuuŋ man nø, nee ge jääŋŋa, nee cige ni caathge dï ŋöömö manøgø, ni göörge gïïo jootge ki køør ŋøøm moo dööŋ noo cïp jï wï tuuŋ man nø. 'Ba kanyo nø tïïcge gïïögø nø, geno duu baŋa.
english: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.

anywaa: 'Ba geni ŋöömö manøgø dege pääŋŋö na kwöre abïriiø. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda ŋöömö mana nø lwørge na marge na en jï løø tier-piny wär putge bëëtö yi gø. Ni ö dhi øt Jocep, ni beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni putge bëëtö yi ŋöömö mana näk marge na en jï løø wï-piny.
english: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni ŋöömö manøgø wär göörru na kwöre abïriiø, ni kälu gïna göörru baŋa. 'Ba aani, ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw oläwa jiiŋŋø kany nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marø.
english: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay ba jïti ki kurge yïthakiyu, kiper tïï dïlämme ki man tïnyge Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo tïmö ni caala ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge. Jø tuuŋ Gaat ki jø tuuŋ Ruben ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca thuwø ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge ege nø lwør løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni beeye Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na cïp ŋøøm moøgø jïge.»
english: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them.

anywaa: Køøre jiy moa kwany nee cige nee ŋøøm göörge, gena tïŋŋö ni aacge; 'ba kanya pootge ni ge poot kär aay, gena kööm Jøcua ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni caathu dï ŋöömö bäre ni göörru gïïo jootu piny, ni duuu baŋa; køøre nø aani ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw ojiiŋŋa Cëëlö kany nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the Lord in Shiloh.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni putge aay ni caathge dï ŋöömö bäre, ni pääŋge ŋöömö na kwöre abïriiø ki køør päänye moa en yie, ni göörge nyeŋ päänye piny yi warakata; køøre gena duu twïër kanya en Jøcua yie Cëëlö.
english: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw aput jiiŋŋø jïge Cëëlö kaagø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Jøcua ni put ŋøøm pääŋŋö jï jø Icriel ki køør wïth tuŋi moge.
english: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋöömö mana cïp jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki køør dhøk uudi moge ena yïthakic ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda ki ŋööm jø tuuŋ Jocep.
english: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew marge ki jï løø wï-piny atägö ki Naam Jördan, ni ö keewi ni put aay ni coonya jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni Jerikö ee wii bäät caam, ni aae ni coonya mïëya en bäät kïte; ni pöödhe ki dï paap ni pïïe Bëëth-Awëën.
english: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven.

anywaa: 'Ba keew acäŋ tägö ki kaace, ni poot cøøa jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni aae ki jï løø tier-piny ki Löja, ni beeye Bëthël; ni ö keewi ni put løøc piny ni coonya Atharöt-Adar, na en buut kïnna en jï løø tier-piny ki Bëëth-Örön mana en piny.
english: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Beth–el, southward; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki løø kïdi manøgø na en jï løø tier-piny ki Bëëth-Örön enø, waŋ keew manøgø, na aa jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ree aput gøn jï løø tierpiny, ni put aay ni coonya Kiriat-Baal, ni beeye Kiriat-Jeerim, na en yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda. 'Ba manøgø beeye waŋ keew mar jø tuuŋ Benjamen mana en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth–horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath–baal, which is Kirjath–jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.

anywaa: Køøre waŋ keew mar jï løø tier-piny atägö ki buut Kiriat-Jeerim, ni gøn ree jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni aae ni coonya jøør moa en kanya cwøl ni Nëëptö.
english: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjath–jearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew aput løøc jï piny mëëth ni cør tier kïnna näk dïët ki Goor Ben-Inöm, ni poot cøøa jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki jï løø wï-piny ki Goor Rapayim. Ni pöödhe ki dï Goor Inöm ni put døø ki deŋ kïdi mana bëët pääny jø Jeebuc bääte, ni kïdi manøgø ena yi ŋöömö marge; ni put aay ni coonya jøøro mana cwøl na Ayn-Rögëël.
english: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to En–rogel,

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew ree aput gøn bäät caam ni aae ni coonya jøøro mana cwøl na Ayn-Camic, ni put pöödhö ni coonya Gëëlilöt na näk dïët ki jöör Adumim, ni løøc piny ni aae ni coonya kïdi mana no ocaa ri Böwan nyikwaar Ruben.
english: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to En–shemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,

anywaa: Ni ö keewi ni pöödhe ki deŋ thuur mana en buut goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba ni cøra bäät caam, ni put løøc yi gool manøgø.
english: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew aput pöödhö ki deŋ thuur mana näk pääny Bëëth-Ogla ogeer bääte ni cøra jï løø wï-piny; ni ö keewi ni put ŋuudö weel Naam Acäbö, ni beeye kanya pänh Naam Jördanni ki yie. 'Ba manøgø beeye waŋ keew mar jø tuuŋ Benjamen mana en jï løø tier-piny.
english: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew marge ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ beeye Naam Jördan. Moøgø beege nyeŋ keee mo ŋöömö mana ci jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye mo tuuŋ Benjamen ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege Jerikö, ki Bëëth- Ogla, ki Emek-Këëcic,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Beth–hoglah, and the valley of Keziz,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Araaba, ki Dhemarayim, ki Bëthël,
english: And Beth–arabah, and Zemaraim, and Beth–el,

anywaa: ka Awim, ki Para, ki Opara,
english: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,

anywaa: ki Kipir-Amönay, ko Opni, ki Gëba; ni beege päänye apaar kurriiø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Chephar–ammoni, and Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages:

anywaa: Ki Gibien, ki Reema, ki Bëëröth,
english: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,

anywaa: ki Micpa, ki Keepira, ka Möja,
english: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,

anywaa: ki Rekem, ki Yirpiëël, ki Terala,
english: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,

anywaa: ki Cëëla, ki Ëëlëëp, ki pääny jø Jeebuc ni beeye Jerucalem, ki Giba, ki Kiriat; ni beege päänye apaar kurŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge. Manøgø beeye ŋöömö mana cïp jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeah, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.

anywaa: Køøre kanya tïme na ri rietge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Cimien, ni beege ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge, aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge. 'Ba ŋøøm moøgø ena dï ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge na moge beege Bëërcïïba, ki Cïïba, ki Mölada,
english: And they had in their inheritance Beer–sheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,

anywaa: ka Adhar-Cuwal, ki Bala, ka Acëm,
english: And Hazar–shual, and Balah, and Ezem,

anywaa: ki Eltölat, ki Betul, ki Örma,
english: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,

anywaa: ki Ciklak, ki Bëëth-Markaböt, ka Adhar-Cuca,
english: And Ziklag, and Beth–marcaboth, and Hazar–susah,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Libawöt, ki Caruwën, ni beege päänye apaar kurdäk ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Beth–lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:

anywaa: Ka Ayn, ki Rimön, ki Ëtëër, ka Acan, ni beege päänye aŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge;
english: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:

anywaa: ka atude bëët moa en deŋ päänye moøgø, këël mana këët pääny mana cwøl ni Baalath-Bëër, ni beeye Reema, na en jï løø tier-piny. Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Cimien na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Cimien na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge lwørra ri ŋøøm moa näk onø cïp jï jø tuuŋ Juuda, kiper ŋöömö mana cïp jï jø tuuŋ Juuda atïmö ni päl døc kiperge; ni ö jø tuuŋ Cimien ni putge jïtö ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge dï ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dääge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, ni beege ŋøøm mo  dööŋ jïge na kurge, aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni ŋøøm moøgø aput pïï pääny mana cwøl ni Carit.
english: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:

anywaa: Køøre ki mana täge ki Carit kaagø, waŋ keew marge aput aay ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni coonya Meräla, ni put pïï Debecët, ni pöödhe ni ŋuude yi waŋ mana näk dïët ki Jökniam.
english: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew acäŋ tägö ki Carit kaagø, ni cøøa jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mana put pïï waŋ keew mar kanya cwøl ni Kiclöt- Tabör, ni pööth pääny mana cwøl ni Dabirat ni pïïe Japia.
english: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, apöödhö ni aa jï løø wï-piny, ni coonya Gëth-Ëper ki Yith-Kacin, ni put pöödhö ni pïïe Rimön, ni kööm ree ni aae ni cøøa Nia.
english: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher, to Eth–kazin, and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah;

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki Nia kaace, waŋ keew ree aput gøn ki jï løø wï-piny ni coonya Anatön, ni put ŋuudö goor Yiptaël.
english: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö marge rwöpa päänye apaar kurriiø ka atude moge moa en buutge, ni nyeŋ päänye møøk dïge beege Kathat, ki Nalal, ki Cimrön, ki Yidala, ki Bethelem.
english: And Kattath, and Nahalal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Beth–lehem: twelve cities with their villages.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Dhebulan na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni rwöpa päänye moøgø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweerge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Icakar aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö marge rwöpa Jedhriel ki Keclöt, ki Cunem,
english: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,

anywaa: ka Aparayim, ki Ciön, ka Anarath,
english: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,

anywaa: ki Rebit, ki Kicön, ka Abëc,
english: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,

anywaa: ki Rëmëth, ka Ayn-Ganim, ka Ayn-Ada, ki Bëëth-Pacec.
english: And Remeth, and En–gannim, and En–haddah, and Beth–pazez;

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew marge aput aay ni pïïe Tabör, ki Cacuma, këël Bëëth-Camic, ni ö keewi ni put ŋuudö yi Naam Jördan. 'Ba päänye moøgø beege apaar ka abïciel ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Beth–shemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Icakar na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni rwöpa päänye moøgø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïïge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Acer aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö marge rwöpa Këlkath, ka Ali, ki Bëthëën, ka Akcap,
english: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,

anywaa: ka Alamëlëk, ka Amät, ki Mical; 'ba waŋ keew ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ aput pïï ri Kïn Karmël ki Ciör-Libanat.
english: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Mishal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihor–libnath;

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki kaace, waŋ keew ree aput gøn jï kur tuul-cäŋ, ni coonya Bëëth-Dagön, ni kïïö ka ŋöömö mar jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, ni cøra goor Yiptaël ki jï løø wï-piny, ni coonya Bëëth-Ëmëk ki Nïël; køøre aput døø ki bäät caam ni coonya Kabul,
english: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,

anywaa: ki Abidön, ki Reeyöp, ka Amön, ki Kana, këël mana put aay ni dïët ki Caydan na dwøŋ.
english: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;

anywaa: Ni ö waŋ keewi ni put ree gøn ni coonya Reema, ni dïët ki pääny Tayar na näk ogeerø ni teek; køøre waŋ keew ree acäŋ gønnø ni coonya Öca, ni put ŋuudö yi naama dwøŋ ki kanya näk dïët ka Akdhip.
english: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye møøk thuwø mo poot ee rwöbö beege Uma, ka Apëk, ki Reeyöp; ni beege päänye ma pïërariiø kurriiø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Acer na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni rwöpa päänye moøgø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïcierge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Naptali aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew  marge atägö ki Ëlëp ni aae ni coonya jaadha päl na en Dhaynanim, ni pööth Adami-Nëkëp, ki Japniël, ni aae ni coonya Lakum ni put ŋuudö yi Naam Jördan.
english: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:

anywaa: Køøre waŋ keew ree agøn jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni aae ni coonya Adhenöt-Tabör, ni pöödhe ki kaace ni coonya Ukök, ni kïïö ka ŋöömö mar jø tuuŋ Dhebulan ki jï løø tier-piny, ni kïïö ka ŋöömö mar jø tuuŋ Acer ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni put aay ni coonya kanya cwøl ni Jekuda na en bäät Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek na en yi ŋöömö mar jø tuuŋ Naptali beege Dhidim, ki Cëër, ka Amath, ki Rekat, ki Kinërët,
english: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

anywaa: ka Adama, ki Reema, ka Adhör,
english: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,

anywaa: ki Këdëc, ki Edaray, ka Ayn-Adhör,
english: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and En–hazor,

anywaa: ki Yirön, ki Mikdal-Ël, ki Örëm, ki Bëëth- Anat, ki Bëëth-Camic; ni beege päänye apaar ka abïŋween ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: And Iron, and Migdal–el, Horem, and Beth–anath, and Beth–shemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Naptali na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni rwöpa päänye moøgø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïrietge, ki man pääŋ ŋøøm ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Daan, ni beege ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge, aö wøk ki nyeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa en yi ŋöömö marge beege Dhöra, ki Ëctaöl, ki Ir-Camic,
english: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Ir–shemesh,

anywaa: ki Caalebin, ki Ayalön, ki Ithla,
english: And Shaalabbin, and Aijalon, and Jethlah,

anywaa: ki Ëlön, ki Temna, ka Akarön,
english: And Elon, and Timnah, and Ekron,

anywaa: ki Eltekë, ki Gibetön, ki Baalath,
english: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,

anywaa: ki Jeyut, ki Bene-Berek, ki Gëth-Rimön,
english: And Jehud, and Bene–berak, and Gath–rimmon,

anywaa: ki Më-Jarkön, ki Rakön, këël ŋøøm moa näk dïët ki Jøpa.
english: And Me–jarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään, jø tuuŋ Daan jiy moa en yïth mïëri moøgø kär løny jïge ki man riemge ge wøk. Køøre gena cøø ni këëtge ki jø Laaic ni macge paac manøgø. Ni ö jiy bëët moa en yie ni 'näkge ge ko opëëlle, ni lwørge paac manøgø ni putge bëëtö yie; ni cwølge nyeŋ Laaic ni Daan ni ge caa gø ri nyeŋ kwarge ma Daan.
english: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.

anywaa: Moøgø beege ŋøøm moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Daan na ŋöömmo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni rwöpa päänye moøgø ka atude moge moa en buutge.
english: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na thöörge tïï pääŋ ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge ki køør nyeŋ keee moa en yïthakicge, geni Jøcua o Nun amoocge ki pääny yïthakicge, nee tïme ni beeye mano dööŋ jïre na kure.
english: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki, pääny mana many Jøcua kiree, beeye na cïpge jïgø, ni beeye pääny mana cwøl ni Temna- Cëëra na en mïëya en bäät kïte, na en yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Ipariem. Ni ö Jøcua ni geer pääny manøgø ni put bëëtö yie.
english: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnath–serah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye luum ŋøøm mo dööŋ jï jø Icriel na pääŋ Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel, ni pääŋŋi ka køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïc manøgø tïïcge dho oduŋkaany røømmø kanya enge Cëëlö. Ni ö geni ni putge tïïc manøgø na tïï pääŋ ŋøøm enø thöör.
english: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Jøcua, ni kööe,
english: The Lord also spake unto Joshua, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø Icriel, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Jëëtu ki päänye mo bëëdö na mo gwøk røk, kaawat mana nø caana gø jïïu ki dhi Modhe,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:

anywaa: kiper nee ŋat mo nägö ki dhaanhø ni ba kame nee reŋ ya aciel dïge, ni ö päänye moøgø ni tïmge na kwör gwøk røk jïïu kiper jø wø cool kwöri.
english: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø doo reŋŋa yi pääny aciel røk päänye moøgø, ni ci dhi kiir kar acooŋa, ni lam luubö mare ni wïnyö jï jø døøŋŋø mo pääny manøgø; ni ö jø døøŋŋø moøgø ni jïëcge ŋatøgø nee ö yi pääny marge, ni moocge eni ki kany bëëde yie, ni put bëëtö dïge kaagø.
english: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋato cool kwör orïŋ køør ŋata 'näk dhaanhø enø, jø døøŋŋø mo pääny manøgø ŋata no onägö ki dhaanhø ba dege cïbö jï ŋato cool kwör, kiper eni wati anääe ni ba kame, ni bäŋ män yïthakicge ki gø dïkwøŋ cøøn.
english: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata no onägö ki dhaanhø ni bëëde pääny manøgø këël kanyo ci kar ŋøl luup nyïm jø acooŋa. Køøre eni puta bëëtö kaagø këël kanyo thøw Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na nut yïth cwiiri moøgø. Køøre nø, løny jïre ki man døø paare na en yi pääny mana rïŋŋe ki yie.› »
english: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jø Icriel päänye moi aputge cïp kur keerge, ni beege Këdëc na en Galili na en mïëya en bäät kïte na näk mar jø tuuŋ Naptali, ki Cekam na en mïëya en bäät kïte na näk mar jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki Kiriat-Arba, ni beeye Keeprön, na en mïëya en bäät kïte na näk mar jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjath–arba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba ki løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, løøa näk neeta rege ki Jerikö, päänye moa jierge beege Böcör na en jï kuna en dï paap bäät thuur yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö na näk mar jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki Ramöth na en Gelät na näk mar jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki Gölan na en Baacan na näk mar jø tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.

anywaa: Moøgø beege päänye moa jier kiper jø Icriel ki juurre moa path moa näk bëëdö yïthakicge, kiper ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø ni ba kame nee reŋ ya aciel dïge, nee ba 'näk ŋato cool kwör këël kanyo ci nyïm jø acooŋa.
english: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, dïbwöthe mo jø tuuŋ Libay aö nyïm Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jøcua o Nun, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;

anywaa: Ni cäänge ki geni kanya cwøl ni Cëëlö na en yi ŋööm Keenan, ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki dhi Modhe nee wa mooc ki päänye mo bëëtwa yïthge, ki kwör kwaath mo ena buut päänye moøgø kiper lääc paac mowa.»
english: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel jø tuuŋ Libay aputge mooc ki päänye ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge, ni lwørge røk päänye moa no onø wëëk geni na kurge, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their suburbs.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri pääŋ päänye ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, päänye mo ci jï dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Kät aö wøk ki nyeŋge. 'Ba ki ri dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Kät, nyïïkwaac Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, na käl ri jø tuuŋ Libay, päänye moa ci jïge ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw beege päänye apaar kurdäk, ni lwørra røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki jø tuuŋ Cimien, ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Kät moa dööŋ ajïtö ki päänye apaar ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ni lwørra røk päänye mo dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki jø tuuŋ Daan, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac Gërcön ajïtö ki päänye apaar kurdäk ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ni lwørra røk päänye mo dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Icakar, ki jø tuuŋ Acer, ki jø tuuŋ Naptali, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca mana en Baacan.
english: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaac Mërari ni jïtge ki päänye apaar kurriiø ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni päänye moøgø lwørra røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki jø tuuŋ Dhebulan.
english: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel päänye moøgø ki kwör kwaath moa en buutge acïpge jï jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe.
english: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege nyeŋ päänye moa lwør jø Icrielli røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Cimien,
english: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,

anywaa: na cïpge jï nyïïkwaac Aran, na näk dhi øtø aciel røk dhøk uudi mo Kät, na käl ri jø tuuŋ Libay. Ni beege na kwøŋ jïtö ki päänye ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.
english: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel Kiriat-Arba na näk ocaa ri kwar jø Anak, ni beeye pääny mana cwøl ni Keeprön, na en mïëya en bäät kïte løøa näk kur jø tuuŋ Juuda, acïpge jï nyïïkwaac Aran ki kwör kwaath moe na en buute kaace.
english: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.

anywaa: 'Ba pwöth mo pääny manøgø ka atude moe moa en buute onø cïp jï Kalëp o Jöpöni ni beeye kure.
english: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.

anywaa: 'Ba geni päänye moa cïpge jï nyïïkwaac Aran na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ beeye Keeprön na no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ki Libana,
english: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Jatir, ki Ëctemöa,
english: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,

anywaa: ko Olön, ki Dabëër,
english: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,

anywaa: ka Ayn, ki Jötha, ki Bëëth- Camic; ni beege päänye abïŋween, ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge, ni lwørra røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Cimien.
english: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa lwør røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Benjamen beege Gibien, ki Gëba,
english: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,

anywaa: ka Anathöth, ka Almön; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: Päänye bëët moa ci jï nyïïkwaac Aran na bëëdö na dïlämme beege päänye apaar kurdäk ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

anywaa: Køøre dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Kät møga ni poot na jø tuuŋ Libay, gena jïtö ki päänye røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.
english: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jø Icrielli jïge beege Cekam na en mïëya en bäät kïte løøa näk kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni beeye pääny mana no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ki Gëdher,
english: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Kibicayim, ki Bëëth-Örön; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Beth–horon with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Daan, beege Eltekë, ki Gebatön,
english: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,

anywaa: ka Ayalön, ki Gaat-Rimön; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath–rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, beege Tanak, ki Gëth-Rimön; ni beege päänye ariiø ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with her suburbs, and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs; two cities.

anywaa: Päänye bëët ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge moa cïp jï dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Kät moøgø beege päänye apaar.
english: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege päänye moa cïp jï nyïïkwaac Gërcön, na näk dhi øtø aciel røk dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Libay; ni lwørra røk päänye mo thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca møga. Päänye moa cïpge beege Gölan na en Baacan na no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ki Bë-Ëctëra; ni beege päänye ariiø ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beesh–terah with her suburbs; two cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Icakar, beege Kicön, ki Dabirat,
english: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishion with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Jërmut, ka Ayn-Ganim; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Jarmuth with her suburbs, En–gannim with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Acer, beege Mical, ka Abidön,
english: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Këlkath, ki Reeyöp; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Naptali, beege Këdëc na en Galili na no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ka Amöth- Dör, ki Kartan; ni beege päänye adäk ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
