anywaa: Päänye bëët moa cïp jï nyïïkwaac Gërcön ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege päänye apaar kurdäk ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege päänye moa cïp jï dhøk uudi mo nyïïkwaac Mërari, ni beeye dhi øt jø tuuŋ Libay mana no odööŋ; 'ba päänye moøgø lwørra røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Dhebulan. Päänye moa cïp jø Icrielli jïge beege Jökniam, ki Karta,
english: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Dimna, ki Nalal; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: Ki røk päänye  mo jø tuuŋ Ruben, beege Böcör na en jï kuna en dï paap bäät thuur yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, na no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ki Jäc,
english: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Kedemöth, ki Mëpät; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Gaat, beege Ramöth na en Gelät na no ocïbö na pääny gwøk røk nee ŋat mo onägö ki dhaanhø reŋ yie, ki Maanayim,
english: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Ëcbön, ki Jadher; ni beege päänye aŋween ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye bëët moa cïp jï nyïïkwaac Mërari ki køør dhøk uudi moge, ni beege dhøk uudi moa no odööŋ ri jø tuuŋ Libay, beege päänye apaar kurriiø, ni cïp jïge ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.
english: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye bëët moa cïp jï jø tuuŋ Libay na en dï ŋøøm moa no onø cïp na kur jø Icriel beege päänye ma pïëraŋween ka abära ki kwör kwaath moge na en buutge.
english: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.

anywaa: Ni pääny aciel man nø røk päänye moøgø da kwör kwaath moe mo ena buute ni beeye deŋŋe bäre; ni päänye moøgø bëët bëëdö na enøgønø.
english: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ŋöömö bäre aput cïp jï jø Icriel, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋe jï kwäcge kipere nee cïbe jïge; ni ö jø Icrielli ni macge ŋöömö manøgø ni putge bëëtö yie.
english: And the Lord gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana nø ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööŋe jï kwäcge, gena put mooc ki jwöm këël deŋ ŋöömö marge bäre, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo omaar cuŋŋö nyïmge røk nyïïmänge bëët kanya näk ri leny; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put nyïïmän moge bëët cïp ceŋge.
english: And the Lord gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, luup bëët moa beyø na caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel aput thur karge, ni bäŋ aciel mo odööŋ ni kär thur kare.
english: There failed not ought of any good thing which the Lord had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca acwøle,
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Uuni luup bëët moa ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm uuni ki ge anø gwøgu, ni leŋŋu dwøra ki røk jammi bëët moa köömma uuni ki ge.
english: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:

anywaa: Uuni thuwø nyïïmëëgu käru wiiø ki kanya beetu na yie bäär këël dïcäŋi en; 'ba ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu aputu gwøk møn.
english: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu nyïïmëëgu amooe ki jwöm kaawat mana caan gø jïge. Kiper manøgønø, u aay nø ni døøu pou, yi ŋöömma cïp Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk jïïu na kuru, na en løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And now the Lord your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tïïyu keere nø, koorru wïthu døc ni gwøgu ciik ki luup moa ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm uuni ki ge, ki man putu bëëtö nou mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu ni caathu jööre bäre, ni gwøgu ciik moe, ni göögu ree, ni tïnynyu eni ki cwïnynyu bäre ka acaayu bäre.»
english: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the Lord charged you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni gwïëth geni ni wëëk ge wääth, ni putge aa poge.
english: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö mana en løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, na näk onø cïp Modhe jï thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca na kurge, ena Baacan; 'ba ŋöömö mana cïp Jøcua jï thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca maya na kurge ena løø Naam Jördan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ yïthakic tuuŋge. 'Ba Jøcua wïth tuŋi moøgø na ariiø ki thääŋö yøø, awëëk wääth nee aage poge; ni put geni gwïëth,
english: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, no «U døøa pou ni uuna jiy mo okwär døc ni jïïu da lääc paac mo thööth døc, ki warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli, ki nywïëny møga, ka abïïe mo thööth døc; ni pääŋŋu gïïa twierru baŋ nyïïmännu yïthakiyu ki nyïïmëëgu.»
english: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca ni døøge poge ni putge jø Icriel møga wii Cëëlö na en yi ŋööm Keenan, ni aacge ni ge cøøa ŋööm Gelät, ŋöömma näk onø wëëk geni na kurge, kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi Modhe.
english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca na pïïcge bäät Naam Jördan løøa en yi ŋööm Keenan, gena put tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo dwøŋ mo nëëni ni mïërö buut Naam Jördan kaace.
english: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel møga gïnögø awïnyge, ni køp, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca gena nø tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte deŋ ŋööm Keenan buut Naam Jördan, ni beeye løøa näk mar jø Icriel.»
english: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli moøgø na wïnyge gïnögø, lwaa Icriel bäre rege aputge cooŋ Cëëlö, kiper nee cige nee këëtge ki wïth tuŋi moøgø.
english: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel moøgø Piniac wär Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ajääŋge yi ŋööm Gelät baŋ jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa jääŋŋi ki Piniac na aciel beege dïbwöthe apaar, ni dïbwödhi aciel man nø käla dhi øt tuuŋ wänni na en røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel moøgø; ni geni beege jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø dhøk uut wëëkge røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa jääŋŋi yøø, gena ci yi ŋööm Gelät baŋ jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, ni cäänge ki geni ni köge,
english: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye dwør lwaa Icriel bäre, ni beeye lwaa Wuuö Jwøk, gena köö, na ‹?Aŋø, man ateeŋ gïn mo nyïëdi, ni tïïyu bääyö man dëër Jwø Icriel, ni gaau wøk dïcäŋi en ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk na dou caadhø, ki køør mana tïïyu gïn wø cïp olämme bääte man kiper dëëtu, ni maru beeye ageem ki Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋ man en?
english: Thus saith the whole congregation of the Lord, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the Lord, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the Lord?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, bääyö mana tïïø ki køør mana løø røø baŋ juu moa cwøl ni Pëëgör atïmö ni thiinh kiperø? Këël dïcäŋi en, dëëtø kere poot ba waany ki raay moøgø, këël na bëëde ni da ajäla mo opïï bäät lwaa Icriel ni beeye lwaa Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the Lord,

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u dou cäŋa gaa wøk dïcäŋi en ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk na dou caadhø? 'Ba gïna tïïyu dïcäŋi en dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni maru ageem, diøø thuwø Wuuö Jwøk wëëye poot jääŋŋe bäät lwaa Icriel bäre.
english: But that ye must turn away this day from following the Lord? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the Lord, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ni näk mo ŋöömö mana wëëk uuni nëëni kere ocienø ki baŋu, beerra man känhnhu yi ŋööm Wuuö Jwøk na näk oduŋkaanynye ogur piny yie, nou jïtu ki kuru yïthakicwa. 'Ba käru gëëmö ki Wuuö Jwøk ni ba gëëmu ki waani ki køør mana tïnynyu dëëtu ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mør, ni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marø nutö.
english: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the Lord, wherein the Lord's tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the Lord, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the Lord our God.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Akan o Dheera kär bääyö na bëëde, kiper mana tïm cwïnye ni päl ki gïïa no onø wëëk geni nee raanyge na bäre, ni ö wëërri mar Wuuö Jwøk ni ö bäät lwaa Icriel bäre? 'Ba kar kaace paa nyenøgø keere na thøw ki køør bääyö mana tïïe.› »
english: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca aløkge, ni köge jï dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi møga mo jø Icriel,
english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,

anywaa: ni «Kare møn, Jwøk na näk Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa en teeki jïre, tier gïnögø ŋääe; 'ba beerra man ö jø Icrielli ki dëëtge kiree ni ŋäcge tier gïnögø. 'Ba ni näk mo tier gïnögø ageem, ni waano bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk møn, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni ba køny waani ceŋŋu dïcäŋ man en.
english: The Lord God of gods, the Lord God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the Lord, (save us not this day,)

anywaa: Ni näk mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte man tïïcwa kiper nee wa gaawa wøk ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk na dewa caadhø, wala ni näk kiper nee wa cïpwa bääte ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre wala muuce mo beel, wala nee kiper nee wa cïpwa bääte ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ki dëëre kiree ni jääl waani.
english: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the Lord, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the Lord himself require it;

anywaa: «'Ba ka adïëri møn, gïnögø atïïcwa na gïn mo da tiere, ni marwa lwäyö ki gïno tägi yi nyïme; kiper løny man kö nyïïkwaayu jï nyïïkwaacwa, na  ‹?Aŋø, da kuru cøøn løøa näk kur Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel?
english: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the Lord God of Israel?

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk Naam Jördan acïbe na keew mo ena yïthakicwa ki uuni, u na jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat. Uuni, bäŋ kuru løøa näk kur Wuuö Jwøk.› Kanyøgønø nyïïkwaayu nyïïkwaacwa putge ka mänö ki man ba wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For the Lord hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the Lord: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, waana cädö ni beerra man tïïwa ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni paa kiper nee wa cïpwa bääte ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre wala olämme møga;
english: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:

anywaa: 'ba beeye kiper nee tïme ni caala gïn ma nyuudhi mo ena yïthakicwa ki uuni ki beenhnhe 'moø moo ööi køørø, ni nyootha gø ni løny jïwa ki man öwa yi ŋöömö mana en oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøki yie, nee eni tïnywa møn, ni cïpwa olämme mowa jï Wuuö Jwøk ki uuni na aciel, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme møga, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër; nee ba tïme ni løny jï nyïïkwaayu ki man köge jï nyïïkwaacwa yi nyïme, ni ‹Uuni bäŋ kuru cøøn kuna näk løø Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the Lord before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, waana cädö ni kanyo tïme na kar kaaca, ni näk mo jøøgø gïnögø caange caanø jïwa wala jï beenhnhe mowa moo ööi, køøre nø, nyïïkwaacwa läwa köö, ni ‹Neennu gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana tïïc kwäcwa ni ge ŋwaala mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni paa kiper nee cïpö bääte ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre wala olämme møga; 'ba beeye kiper nee bëëde na nyuudhi mo ena yïthakicwa ki uuni.›
english: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana caan enø, na køp ni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana tïïcwa en, ni tïïcwa ni marwa ageem ki Wuuö Jwøk, nee wa cïpwa bääte ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel, ko olämme møga, ni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøwa nutö nyïm oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mare, luubö manøgø karwa tïme ni bäär ki gø.»
english: God forbid that we should rebel against the Lord, and turn this day from following the Lord, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the Lord our God that is before his tabernacle.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Piniac na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïbwöthe mo lwaa Icriel, ni beege jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø geni dhøk uut wëëkge, na wïnyge gïna caan jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, yïthge amïnnö ki luubö manøgø.
english: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.

anywaa: Ni ö Piniac wär Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni kööe jï jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ tuuŋ Maneeca, ni «Dïcäŋi ennø aŋäcwa møn ni Wuuö Jwøk nutö yïthakiyø, kiper gïnögø käru tïïö ni maru bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk møn; 'ba ennø jwïëy mo jø Icriel agwøgu cer Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the Lord is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the Lord: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Piniac wär Eliedhar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki dïbwöthe gena duuö ki yi ŋööm Gelät baŋ jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ni duuge yi ŋööm Keenan baŋ jø Icriel ni caange luup jïge.
english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moøgø yïthge amïnnö ki luubö manøgø ni pwøcge Jwøk; ni ö geni ni kärge cädö këët ki man cige nee këëtge ki jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, nee ŋöömö mana bëët wïth tuŋi moøgø yie raanyge.
english: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø aputge cwøl ni «Nyuudhi»; kiper mana köge, ni «Gïnögø beeye nyuudhi mano bëëdö yïthakiyø, ni nyootha gø ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk møn.»
english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the Lord is God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïme na køør cwiiri møøk, ni Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel ee nø mooc ki jwöm, ni bäŋ leny këët yïthakicge ki nyïïmänge bëët moa en deŋ ŋöömö marge bäre, ni Jøcua onø jalø ni cwiiye oløny ni thööth døc,
english: And it came to pass a long time after that the Lord had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

anywaa: eni na Jøcua enø, jø døøŋŋø, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi, ki jø wø ŋøl luup, ki jø kööre, ni beege mo jø Icriel bëët, acwøle ni kööe jïge, ni «Aani, aana nø jal ni cwiiya thööth døc.
english: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, gïïa tïïe bëët kiperu dëët wïth juurre moa bëëdö yi  ŋööm Keenan bëët ajootu, kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu na bëëdö ni këëdö kiperu.
english: And ye have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the Lord your God is he that hath fought for you.

anywaa: Neennu, aani ŋöömö bäre anø pääŋŋa jïïu ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw nee tïme ni beeye ŋöömmo dööŋ jï wïth tuŋi mou, ni ŋöömö manøgø tägi ka Naam Jördan na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ këël mana aae ni këët deŋ naama dwøŋ na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni wïth juurre bëët moa en yi ŋöömö manøgø, møøk dïge ŋøøm moge yøø nø mac, ni møøk dïge ŋøøm moge poot kärø maaø.
english: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, jøøgø di keethø, ni put geni riem wøk nyïmmu; ni mayu ŋøøm moge, kaawat mana nø ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na caan gø jïïu.
english: And the Lord your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the Lord your God hath promised unto you.

anywaa: «Magu rou døc ki man gwøgu ciik bëët moa no ogöör Modhe piny yi wëël ciik ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc; kär nou gaa wøk ki røk ciik moøgø ni ba gaau bäät cwïyu wala bäät cämmu.
english: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

anywaa: Käru dwätö ki wïth juurre moa no odööŋ yïthakiyu, ni ba cøøru nyeŋ juu moge, ni ba kööŋŋu røk juu moge, ni ba tïnynyu juu moge, ni ba këëllu cøŋŋu piny nou wøøra juu moge.
english: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, putu bëëtö ni uuno göök ri Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu kaawat mana tïïyu këël dïcäŋi en.
english: But cleave unto the Lord your God, as ye have done unto this day.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk wïth juurre mo døøŋŋø mo teek anø riem wøk nyïmmu, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ocuŋŋö nyïmmu kanyo näk ri leny këël dïcäŋi en.
english: For the Lord hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

anywaa: Dhaanhø aciel dëëtu jiy ma kuma di riemmø, kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu na bëëdö ni këëdö kiperu, kaawat mana nø caan gø jïïu.
english: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the Lord your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

anywaa: «'Ba uuni, gwøgu rou døc ki man bëëdu nou mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the Lord your God.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk mo uuno døø ŋäthu ni göögu røk juurre moøgø no odööŋ yïthakiyu yøø, ni nywømmu dëëtu ki geni, ni dwätu ki ge, ni ö geni ni dwätge ki uuni,
english: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

anywaa: wär putu ŋäc nø ni Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu juurre moøgø ba riem wøk nyïmmu këët; 'ba ge puta tïmö ni caala abïëp ka akupa kiperu, ni caala alaŋŋa mo u di pöötö ki gø, ni caalge koodhi mo cööba nyeŋŋu, këël mano putu thumö ki thøø ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel rou mo dööŋ yi ŋöömmi ni beer en na no onø cïp Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu jïïu.
english: Know for a certainty that the Lord your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.

anywaa: «'Ba neennu, dïcäŋi ennø, kara aløny ni cään ki man thøøa, naa cøøa jöör wø caath jø bäät pinynyi bëët; 'ba oløny ni ŋäc ŋati man nø dëëtu ki cwïnye bäre ka acaaye bäre, ni luup bëët moa beyø na caan Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu athur karge jïïu; gïïögø bëët aput thur karge jïïu ni bäŋ aciel mo odööŋ dëëtge ni kär thur kare.
english: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the Lord your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na wëëk luup bëët thur karge moa beyø na caane kiperu, eni na Wuuö Jwøk thuwø gïï mo leth di kälö bäätu ni näk uuno bääyö, këël mano dïïr wïthu yi ŋöömmi ni beer en, ni beeye ŋöömma cïbe jïïu, eni na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu.
english: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the Lord your God promised you; so shall the Lord bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the Lord your God hath given you.

anywaa: Ni näk mo luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøu na kööm uuni ki gø you kaalø, ni cou ni tïnynyu juu møøk, ni këëllu cøŋŋu piny nou wøøra geni, kanyøgønø Wuuö Jwøk wëëye pute ka jääŋŋö bäätu kaamar maac mo liel, ni laaru thumö bëët ki thøø yi ŋöömmi ni beer en, ni beeye ŋöömma cïbe jïïu.»
english: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the Lord your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët acwøle, ni cooŋge dëëtge Cekam, ni ö jø døøŋŋø, ki dïbwöthe, ki jø wø ŋøl luup, ki jø kööre, ni beege mo jø Icriel, ni cwöli wøk ki dï jøøgø; ni öge kany mo cään nyïm Jwøk.
english: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö jï jø Icriel bëët, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ki kany mo bäär kwäyu abëëdö løø Naam Upareeti løøga ni ge wøøra juu møøk, ni dhaanhø aciel røk kwäyu moøgø beeye Teera wää Eeberam ki Neeyör.
english: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor: and they served other gods.

anywaa: Køøre kwaru ma  Eeberam alwøra løø Naam Upareeti løøga, ni bwødha eni dï ŋööm Keenan nee caadhe bäre, ni cïba wääde ma Aydhak jïre, ni tïïa nyïïkwaacge nee nyaacge.
english: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Aydhak moa cïba jïre beege Jeekap ki Icøø. Kanyøgønø, Cëër, paana en mïëya en bäät kïte, acïba jï Icøø na kure; ni ö Jeekapi ki wääte ni cige Ijep.
english: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre Modhe ka Aran ajääŋŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïa gïï mo leth dëët jø Ijep ki køør gïïa jääŋŋa bäätge; 'ba na tïme na køøre cään, uuna käla wøk ki Ijep.
english: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya käla kwäyu wøk ki Ijep, kanya pïïcge bäät Naama Kwaar, jø Ijep aput läm køørge ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø okwëënyi, ni maage geni bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jwöŋ kwäyu dëëra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aani yïthakiyu ki jø Ijep atïïa ni da muudhö, ni dwøga pï Naama Kwaar bäät jø Ijep ni muda geni. 'Ba uuni gïna tïïa Ijep ajootu ki nyeŋŋu kiree. Ni putu bëëtö dï paap ki kany mo bäär døc.
english: And when they cried unto the Lord, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre uuna käla yi ŋööm jø Amör na en løø Naam Jördan løøga, jï kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö jøøgø ni këëtge ki uuni; 'ba gena cïba ceŋŋu, ni putu ŋöömö marge mac kanya dïïra wïthge nyïmmu.
english: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.

anywaa: Køøre Balak o Cëëpör, nyeny Möap, ree athïïŋe nee këëde ki uuni, ni jääk baŋ Beelam o Beeyör nee ööe nou tïïe ka ajwøa.
english: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:

anywaa: 'Ba aani a kär jïëy ki dwør Beelam. Ni ö eni ni gwïëth uuni ni puta uuni køny cere.
english: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni Naam Jördan aŋøllu ni pïïyu Jerikö; ni ö jøøa bëëdö Jerikö ni këëtge ki uuni. Këël jø Amör, ki jø Përec, ki jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Gërgëca, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc gena këëdö ki uuni thuwø. 'Ba ge bëët gena cïba ceŋŋu.
english: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.

anywaa: Køøre aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, piini ajääŋŋa nyïmmu, ni ö nyeye mo jø Amör moa na ariiø ni riemge ge wøk nyïmmu; 'ba ge ba riema u wøk ko opëëlle mou wala athëëre mou.
english: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.

anywaa: Køøre aani pwöth mo u kär ööl kiperge, ki päänye mo ba geera uuni, acïba jïïu, ni putu bëëtö yïth päänye moøgø; ni cämu røk nyïï jera perge leth, ni beege nyïïomøki ki nyïï jer wø wel na mädhi, mo ba piitha uuni.›
english: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø møn, wøørru Wuuö Jwøk ni tïnynyu eni na adïëri ni you ŋäädhö ki cwïnynyu bäre; tïïyu karu ni bäär ki juu moa wøør kwäyu kanya bëëtge løø Naam Upareeti løøga, ki kanya bëëtge Ijep, ni tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk keere.
english: Now therefore fear the Lord, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo määnö jïïu ki man tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk, dïcäŋi ennø, jëëtu ki jwøk mana dou tïnynyö; ni näk mo beeye juu moa tïny kwäyu kanya enge løø Naam Upareeti løøga, wala juu mo jø Amör ni bëëdu yi ŋöömge en, jierru; 'ba aani ki jø paara bëët, Wuuö Jwøk tïnywa tïnynyö.»
english: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre aløk jø Icrielli ni köge, ni «Ki man wecwa Wuuö Jwøk ni tïnywa juu møøk, wa ba many gø;
english: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the Lord, to serve other gods;

anywaa: kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, na käl waani wøk ki kwäcwa bëët ki yi ŋööm Ijep, paana näk po laŋ, ni beeye Jwøa tïïc ŋïïce moa døøŋŋø ni nëënö jïwa, na koor waani ki uutjïëthe bëët moa caathwa, na koor waani ki dï wïth juurre bëët moa dïge caathwa.
english: For the Lord our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni riem wïth juurre bëët wøk nyïmwa, këël jø Amör na bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en. 'Ba ennø, waani thuwø Wuuö Jwøk tïnywa tïnynyö, kiper beeye eni na Jwøk marwa.»
english: And the Lord drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the Lord; for he is our God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Uuni, ba løny jïïu ki man tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk; kiper eni, ena Jwøk mo ena kur keere, ni ena Jwøk mo këëyö. Eni gïïa bayu ki raay mou ba wëënne.
english: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the Lord: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.

anywaa: Ni näk Wuuö Jwøk weyu wiiø ni tïnynyu juuga path, eni acaara mare di wiilø ni tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëëtu ni dïïr wïthu, këël na bëëde ni gïn mo beer ee nø tïïc jïïu.»
english: If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Waani Wuuö Jwøk tïnywa tïnynyö. Eni ba doo løny jïwa ki man wecwa eni.»
english: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua aköö jï jø Icriel, ni «Uuni, luubö mana caannu ki dëëtu ki køør mana nø jierru Wuuö Jwøk ni eni tïnynyu tïnynyö, luubö manøgø en bäätu.» Ni köge, ni «Kare møn, waani luubö manøgø en bäätwa.»
english: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the Lord, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.

anywaa: Ni kö Jøcua, «'Ba ennø, tïïyu karu ni bäär ki juuga path na en dïïu, ni cïpu cwïnynyu jï Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel.»
english: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aköö jï Jøcua, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, tïnywa tïnynyö ni leŋwa dwøre.»
english: And the people said unto Joshua, The Lord our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca Jøcua atudö ki luubö ki jø Icriel, ni put kän wøk jïge ki ciik ki luup ŋøl kanya cwøl ni Cekam.
english: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøcua ni göör luup bëët moøgø piny yi wëël ciik mar Jwøk; ni lwöte ki kïdi mo dwøŋ ni cwöth gø piny tier jaadha dwøŋ na en kanya en kur keere na näk mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Jøcua jï jø Icriel bëët, ni «Neennu, kïdi man en otïmö na nyuudhi kiperø, kiper luup bëët moa caan Wuuö Jwøki kiperø anø wïnynye. Kiper manøgønø, kïdi manøgø bëëdö na nyuudhi kiperu, nee Jwøk maru ba mooŋŋu.»
english: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the Lord which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jøcua jø Icriel awëëk wääth, ni ö ŋati man nø ni put døø yi ŋöömma no onø wëëk eni na mare.
english: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør gïïögø bëët, Jøcua o Nun na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk athøw, ni cwiiye dïpa ka apaar.
english: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni koonyge eni yi ŋöömma no onø wëëk eni na kure, ni beeye Temna-Cëëra na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, na en jï løø wï-piny ki kïnna cwøl ni Geäc.
english: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–serah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel abëëdö ni ge tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth cwiiri bëët moa beet Jøcua ni kwøw, këël yïth cwiiri bëët moa beet jø døøk Icriel moa dööŋ ni kwøw køør thøw Jøcua, ni beege jø døøŋŋø moa ŋäc tïïe bëët moa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel.
english: And Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the Lord, that he had done for Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba cuu mo Jocep na kuu jø Icrielli kanya öge wøk ki Ijep aputge koony Cekam, yi thäk ŋøøpa ŋeew Jeekapi ki gwel ma dïpa baŋ wäät Eemör, ni beeye Eemör wää Cekam; ni put ŋøømmi moøgø dööŋŋe jï nyïïkwaac Jocep na kurge.
english: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliedhar wär Aran athøw, ni ö jø Icrielli ni koonyge eni pääny mana cwøl ni Giba na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni beeye pääny mana no onø cïp jï wääde ma Piniac.
english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør thøw Jøcua, jø Icriel Wuuö Jwøk apëënyge, ni köge, na «?A jø tuuŋe mane dïwa noo kwøŋ ci baŋ jø Keenan, nee këëtge ki geni?»
english: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the Lord, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jø tuuŋ Juuda beege noo cii; ka adïëri møn, ŋöömö manøgø yaa nø cïp ceŋge.»
english: And the Lord said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Juuda aköö jï nyïïmëëkge ma jø tuuŋ Cimien, ni «Ø aay na aciel nøø këëdø ki jø Keenan moa en yi ŋöömö mana cïp jïwa ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw; køøre nø, øøno cäŋ aay ki uuni nee ø këëdø ki jiy moa en yi ŋöömö mana cïp jïïu ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.» Køøre jø tuuŋ Cimien aput aay ki jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø tuuŋ Juuda na këëtge ki jø Keenan, Wuuö Jwøk jø Keenan ki jø Përec aput cïp ceŋge, ni böötge jiy ma kume apaar kanya cwøl ni Bëdhëk.
english: And Judah went up; and the Lord delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.

anywaa: Køøre gena pïï ri nyeya mo cwøl na Adöni-Bëdhëk paare ma Bëdhëk, ni këëtge ki eni, ni böötge jø Keenan ki jø Përec moa en kaace.
english: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

anywaa: 'Ba Adöni- Bëdhëk areeŋø; ni ö jø tuuŋ Juuda ni ŋwiecge køøre ni makge eni, ni ŋørge lweet ceŋŋe moa døøŋŋø ki lweet tiete moa døøŋŋø.
english: But Adoni–bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.

anywaa: Ni ö Adöni-Bëdhëk ni kööe, ni «Nyeye ma pïërabïriiø mo lweet ceŋge moa døøŋŋø ki lweet tietge moa døøŋŋø oŋøørø, ge wø kwänyö ki caammi moa no odhäthö tier tharabëëta mara; 'ba ki køør gïna tïïa dëëtge, Jwøk teeŋ gïnögø acoole dëëra thuwø ennø.» 'Ba Adöni-Bëdhëk aputge käl Jerucalem ni thøø kaace.
english: And Adoni–bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, jø tuuŋ Juuda geno nø këëdö ki jø Jerucalem ni macge pääny manøgø ni 'näkge jiy ko opëëlle, ni putge pääny manøgø nyep ki maac.
english: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, jø tuuŋ Juuda gena ci baŋ leny ki jø Keenan moa näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte ki moa näk bëëdö kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp ki moa näk bëëdö ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö.
english: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Juuda ni cige baŋ leny ki jø Keenan moa näk bëëdö Keeprön, ni böötge jø tuuŋ Cëëci ki jø tuuŋ Akimen ki jø tuuŋ Thalmay. 'Ba nyeŋ Keeprön mana dïkwøŋ beeye Kiriat-Arba.
english: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Juuda acäŋ aay ki kaace, ni cige baŋ leny ki jøøa bëëdö Dabëër. 'Ba nyeŋ Dabëër mana dïkwøŋ beeye Kiriat-Cëëpïr.
english: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher:

anywaa: 'Ba Kalëp  aköö jï jø leny moe, ni «Ŋato këëdi ki jø Kiriat-Cëëpïr ni mac pääny marge, nyaara ma Akca kiree cïba cïbö jïre nee nywøme.»
english: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Götönial nyikwaar jø Kënec, ni beeye owää Kalëp mana thiinh, pääny manøgø amaae; ni ö Kalëp ni cïp nyaare ma Akca jïgø nee nywøme.
english: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.

anywaa: Køøre na tïme na ri nywöm, kanya kïth Akca po cwøre ma Götönial, eni na Akca enø yi cwøre acoone nee wänni ma Kalëp pëënynyi ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge. Køøre Akca aput ci baŋ wänni ma Kalëp ni eth piny ki bäät arëën mare; ni kö wänni jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?»
english: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?

anywaa: 'Ba Akca aköö jïgø, ni «Mooc aani ki muuy mo yia mïnnö ki gø; ennø, kaawat mana nø cïpï ŋøøm mo Nëgëp jïra na näk bäŋ pïï yie, a kwaya ïïni naa mooyï ki jøør mo pïï.» Køøre Kalëp jøør mo pïï moa en yïth ŋøøpøgø, ni beege moa en jï maal ki moa en jï piny, aput cïp jï nyaare ma Akca.
english: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.

anywaa: 'Ba wää cï Modhe nyï Këën, nyïïkwaaye aay na aciel ki jø tuuŋ Juuda ni ge tïŋŋi ki päänya näk yie da twöe, ni cige dï paap jø tuuŋ Juuda na en jï løø tier-piny ki paana cwøl na Arat; ni aacge ni putge bëëtö ki jø Icriel na aciel.
english: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda gena aay na aciel ki nyïïmëëkge ma jø tuuŋ Cimien, ni këëtge ki jø Keenan moa bëëdö pääny mana cwøl ni Dhepath, ni 'näkge geni, ni putge päänyögø raanynyø na bäre bäre. Ni ö nyeŋ pääny manøgø ni puti cwøl ni Örma.
english: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda, Geedha, ki Ackelön, ka Akarön, ki ŋøøm moa en buutge këël mana këët
english: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Ashkelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nut dï jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni ö geni ni macge mïëya en bäät kïte. 'Ba geni, jøøa bëëdö ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö kärge riem wøk, kiper jøøgø jïge da jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo tïïc ka nywïëny.
english: And the Lord was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Juuda pääny mana cwøl ni Keeprön aputge cïp jï Kalëp, kaawat mana nø caani ya Modhe; 'ba Kalëp, jø tuuŋ nyïïkwaac Anak karge dääi aput riem wøk kaace.
english: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen, jø Jeebuc moa bëëdö yi Jerucalem kärge riem wøk; ni ö jø Jeebuc ni putge bëëtö na aciel ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen yi Jerucalem këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep gena aay nee këëtge ki jø Bëthël, ni Wuuö Jwøk nut dïge.
english: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Beth–el: and the Lord was with them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep ni jääkge ki jiy mo liew Bëthël. 'Ba nyeŋ Bëthël mana dïkwøŋ beeye Löja.
english: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Beth–el. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

anywaa: Køøre dïlëëwe ajïtö ki dhaanhø mo oö wøk ki yi kiir, ni köge jïgø, «Nyie nyawat, nyooth dhi kiir jïwa. 'Ba waani, bäth ec marwa onyoothwa jïrï.»
english: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋatøgø dhi kiir aput nyooth jïge, ni ö jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep ni 'näkge jiy moa en pääny manøgø ko opëëlle; 'ba geni, ŋata nyooth dhi kiir jïge ki jø paare bëët, awecge nee aage kanya manyge jaak.
english: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋatøgø ni ci yi ŋööm jø Këth ni gëëde ki pääny kaace, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Löja, ni beeye nyeŋ pääny manøgø këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Maneeca, jø paana cwøl ni Bëëth-Can, ki jø Tanak, ki jø Dör, ki jø Ibleäm, ki jø Megidø ki jøw moa bëëdö yïth atude moa en tiet päänye moøgø, kärge riem wøk; ni ö jø Keenanni ni putge cwïnyge mak ki man bëëtge yïth ŋøøm moøgø.
english: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm jø Icrielli ni ge teek, jø Keenan moøgø akïthge tietge ni kïthge bäätge ki tïïe mo teek; 'ba kärge riem wøk na bäre.
english: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.

anywaa: Këël jø tuuŋ Ipariem thuwø, jø Keenan moa bëëdö Gëdher kärge riem wøk; ni ö jø Keenanni moøgø ni putge bëëtö dï jø tuuŋ Ipariem.
english: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Dhebulan thuwø, jø Keenan moa bëëdö Kitrön, ki moa bëëdö Naalal kärge riem wøk; ni ö jø Keenanni moøgø ni putge bëëtö dï jø tuuŋ Dhebulan; 'ba jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, jø Keenan moøgø akïthge tietge ni kïthge bäätge ki tïïe mo teek.
english: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Acer, jiy moa bëëdö Akkö, ki jø Caydan, ki jø Alap, ki jø Akdhip, ki jø Ëlba, ki jø Apëk, ki jø Reeyöp, kärge riem wøk.
english: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Acer ni putge bëëtö dï jø Keenan moa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø, kiper mana kärge geni riem wøk.
english: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Naptali, jø Keenan moa bëëdö paana cwøl ni Bëëth-Camic ki moa bëëdö Bëëth-Anat, kärge riem wøk; 'ba gena put bëëtö dï jø Keenan moøgø ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø enø; ni ö jøøa bëëdö Bëëth-Camic, ki moa bëëdö Bëëth-Anat ni tïmge ni ena tiet jø tuuŋ Naptali, ni bäätge okïthö ki tïïe mo teek.
english: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth–anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh and of Beth–anath became tributaries unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Amör, jø tuuŋ Daan atïïcge ki teek nee bëëtge mïëya en bäät kïte, kiper jø Amör jø tuuŋ Daan amänge nee ba öge yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö.
english: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:

anywaa: 'Ba jø Amör moa en mïëya en bäät kïdi mana cwøl ni Ërë, ki mïëya cøøri ni Ayalön ki Caalbim, cwïnyge aputge mak ni putge bëëtö kwörögø. 'Ba kanya tïm jø tuuŋ wäät Jocep ni teek døc, jø Amör moøgø aputge kïth tietge ni kïthge bäätge ki tïïe mo teek.
english: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

anywaa: 'Ba waŋ keew mar jø Amör tägi ka thuur Akirabim, ni etha maal këël mana pöödhe ki kanya cwøl ni Cela.
english: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree Gëlgela, ree acäŋ nyoothø kaamar nyïïatwiel maal kanya cwøl ni Bökim, ni kööe jï jø Icriel, ni «Beeye aani na käl uuni wøk ki Ijep, ni käla uuni yi ŋöömma kööŋa kipere ni cïba cïbö jï kwäyu. Kar kaaca aana köö, ni ‹Aani, luumma mana tuuda ki uuni ba raanynya na bäre bäre;
english: And an angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.

anywaa: ni këël uuni thuwø, u ba doo tudö ki luubö  ki jiy moi ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en; 'ba gïna dou tïïö, u doo raanynya gïï wø cïpge bäätge ko olämme moge.› 'Ba ennø, uuni dwøra käru leŋø. ?Aperŋø na tïïyu teeŋ gïnögø?
english: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aani thuwø acaana gø jïïu, nyïïmännu moøgø ba riema wøk nyïmmu; 'ba geno tïmö ni caala koodhi mo cööba tiet butu, ni tïm juu moge ni caala abïëp kiperu.»
english: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal na caan luupögø jï jø Icriel bëët, jø Icriel gena put jwöŋö ni döötge ege tïŋ maal.
english: And it came to pass, when the angel of the Lord spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.

anywaa: Køøre geni nyeŋ kaace aputge cak ni Bökim, na näk tiere beeye ni jiy ajwöŋö; ni cïpge ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace.
english: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcua na wëëk jø Icriel wääth kar kaaca, jø Icriel aput aay ni jø tuuŋ man nø cøøa yïth ŋøøm mo odööŋ jïge na kurge nee macge.
english: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel abëëdö ni ge tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth cwiiri bëët moa beet Jøcua ni kwøw, këël yïth cwiiri bëët moa beet jø døøk Icriel moa dööŋ ni kwøw køør thøw Jøcua, ni beege jø døøŋŋø moa ŋäc tïïe bëët moa døøŋŋø na perge leth na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel.
english: And the people served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the Lord, that he did for Israel.

anywaa: Kar kaaca, Jøcua o Nun, na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk, athøw, ni cwiiye dïpa ka apaar.
english: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni koonyge eni yi ŋöömma no onø wëëk eni na kure, ni beeye Temna-Cëëra na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, na en jï løø wï-piny ki kïnna cwøl ni Geäc.
english: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–heres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en yi beenhnhø maneca bëët gena thøw thuwø, ni läpge køør kwäcge; ni ö jiyi moa en yi beenhnhø mana öö køør jøøgø ni døøŋge. 'Ba geni na en yi beenhnhø manøgø, Wuuö Jwøk kucge; këël gïïa tïïe kiper jø Icriel kucge thuwø.
english: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the Lord, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel atïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïnyge juuga cwøl ni Baal,
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim:

anywaa: ni wecge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge na käl geni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ni tïmge ni ge caatha køør juu møøk røk juu mo jøøa bëëtge dïge kaagø, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge juu moøgø; ni tïïcge Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: And they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the Lord to anger.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel Wuuö Jwøk awecge ni tïnyge juuga cøøri ni Baal ki Actaröth.
english: And they forsook the Lord, and served Baal and Ashtoreth.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put wëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni cïp geni ceŋ jøøa twier japge, ki nyïïmän moge moa bëëtge dïge, ni tïmge ni ge ba maar cuŋŋö nyïm nyïïmänge kany wø tïme na ri leny.
english: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aput tïmö ni kany wäro cige yie jaak, Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni tïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëëtge, kaawat mana nø caan gø na nø kööŋe jïge; ni put bëëtö marge tïmö ni teek døc.
english: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had said, and as the Lord had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jiy mo piem jø Icriel ki køørge athïïŋe, nee jø Icriel kønyge ceŋ jøøa twier japge.
english: Nevertheless the Lord raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde na enøgønø, jø Icriel ge poot bëëdö ni dööt pïëmme moge ba wïnyge, kiper ge poot bëëdö ni cwïnyge onieŋ køør juu møøk, kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp. Geni cøŋge wø këëlge piny ni ge wøøra juu moøgø. Ni ge wø laara gaa wøk ki øtjöö mana caath kwäcge kanya bëët kwäcge ni ge gwøga ciik Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba ge kär bëëdö ki bëëtö mana beet kwäcge.
english: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the Lord; but they did not so.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme ni Wuuö Jwøk pïëmi man nø di thïïŋö jïge, eni puta bëëtö ni nut buut pïëmi mano thïïŋe, ni køny jø Icriel ceŋ nyïïmän moge yïth nïr kwøw mo wø beet pïëmi manøgø; kiper Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye opädhö ki cooyø marge ki køør gïna tïïc jøøa dïïm geni na caar geni.
english: And when the Lord raised them up judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the Lord because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme ni pïëmi thøw, geni na jø Icriel yøø, ge puta døø cään, ni kwierge jöör Jwøk, ni tïïge ki gïï mo reyø ni kaala moa tïïc wëëkge; ni caathge køør juu møøk ni tïnyge geni ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni ge wøøra geni; ni gïïa temge ki teek wïc marge ba wecge.
english: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aput wëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni kööe, ni «Jøøi ii kiper mana kaalge luubö mara mana tuuda, na köömma kwäcge ki gø, ni kärge luumma leŋø,
english: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;

anywaa: aani, wïth juurre moa dööŋ ni kär dïïm Jøcua kanya thøøe, ba riema wøk nyïmge këët.
english: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:

anywaa: Gïnögø otïïa kiper nee jøøgø tïmge ni jø Icriel di päärö ki rege, ki man näk mo geni jöör Wuuö Jwøk caathge caadhø kaawat mana tïïc kwäcge, wala jïge bäyö.»
english: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the Lord to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk wïth juurre moøgø aput wii yi ŋöömmögø, ni käre cïp cer Jøcua kanya poode ni kwøw, ni ge käre laar riem wøk thuwø nyïm jø Icriel køør thøw Jøcua.
english: Therefore the Lord left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege wïth juurre moa dööŋ na wec Wuuö Jwøki nee jø Icriel pääri ki rege; ni jø Icriel moøgø noo pääri yøø beege moa näk lenye moa këël jø Icrielli ki jø Keenan kucge na bäre.
english: Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atïïc Wuuö Jwøki kiper nee beenhnhe mo jø Icriel moa näk lenye kucge dïkwøŋ nee kwänyge ki leny.
english: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre moøgø beege kwääri mo jø Pilitin moa näk abïïc ki jicge, ki jø Keenan bëët, ki jø Caydan, ki jø Ëwi moa näk bëëdö buut kïnna cwøl ni Libaanø; ni jø Ëwi moøgø poge tägi ka ri kïnna cwøl ni Baal-Armön këël mana pïïe kanya cwøl ni Libø-Amath.
english: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre moøgø awec kiper nee jø Icriel pääri ki rege, nee jø Icriel joot ki man näk mo ciik Wuuö Jwøk gwøkge gwøø, ni beege ciik moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm kwäcge ki ge ki dhi Modhe.
english: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the Lord, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel aput bëëtö dï jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Amör, ki jø Përec, ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Jeebuc;
english: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:

anywaa: ni ö jø Icrielli ni nyöömge dëët nyïï jøøgø, ni cïpge nyïïge thuwø nee nywøm wäät jøøgø, ni putge juu mo jøøgø tïnynyö.
english: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel atïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni wïl wïthge ki Wuuö Jwøk na bëëdö na Jwøk marge, ni tïnyge juuga cøøri ni Baal ki Actaröt.
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgat the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aput wëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni put ge cïp cer Kucan-Ricataym nyeny jø Aram-Naarim; ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge Kucan-Ricataym tïnynyö ki cwiiri abära.
english: Therefore the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk, Götönial nyikwaar jø Kënec, owää Kalëp mana thiinh, athïïŋe na pïëmi kiper nee jø Icriel pieme.
english: And when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jwïëc Jwøk aput ö bäät Götönial, ni put tïmö na pïëmi jï jø Icriel. 'Ba kanya ci baŋ leny, Wuuö Jwøk, Kucan-Ricataym nyeny Aram-Naarim aput cïp cer Götönial, ni put gø böötö.
english: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the Lord delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim.

anywaa: Køøre piny aput nikwöc ni bäŋ lenye ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween. 'Ba Götönial nyikwaar jø Kënec athøw.
english: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäŋ tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mooc Ëglön nyeny jø Möap ki teek mo kaala teek mar jø Icriel, kiper ge na jø Icriel yøø, gena tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëglön nyeny Möap dëëtge adwalge ki nyïïkwaac Amön ki nyïïkwaac Amalëk; ni cige baŋ leny ni böötge jø Icriel, ni putge päänya näk yie da twöe mac.
english: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïnyge Ëglön nyeny Möap ki cwiiri apaar ka abära.
english: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk Ëwut o Gëra athïïŋe na pïëmi jï jø Icriel, ni beeye nyen ma caam jwøk mo käla ri jø tuuŋ Benjamen. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni jääŋge Ëwut, nee jap ajwäk kïth baŋ Ëglön nyeny Möap.
english: But when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, the Lord raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëwut atïïö ko opëëllö ma mare, mo lage karge riet beth, ni bär mare caala rumi mar cenø ma gööyö aciel; ni ö Ëwuti ni twöö opëëllö manøgø ääme mana en bäät cwïïe tier abïïne.
english: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

anywaa: Ni aae ni cïp jap ajwäk jï Ëglön nyeny Möap. 'Ba Ëglön  beeye dhaanhø mo dëëre dwøŋ mo olør døc.
english: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ëwuti na nø thöör jap ajwäk ki cïp, eni jøøa käär jap ajwäk awëëk wääth nee døøkge.
english: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki dëëre kiree, ena duuö ki kanya näk yie da kïte mo otieŋø buut Gëlgela, ni duu baŋ Ëglön ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, aani da luubö mo pere leth mo daa caanø jïrï keerï.» Køøre nyeya aköö jï jøøa en buute, ni «Uuni, paanynyu rou di turu.» Ni ö jiyi moa en buute kaagø ni putge aay.
english: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Ëwut aput ci baŋ Ëglön øda ŋec na bëëde yi gø na e keere bäät øtø maal. Køøre Ëwut aköö, ni «Aani, da luubö mo käla baŋ Jwøk mo daa caanø jïrï.» 'Ba Ëglön aput ö maal ki bäät wälu mare.
english: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.

anywaa: Ni ö Ëwuti ni put cere mana näk caame rwaak baŋ opëëllö, ni wöth gø wøk ki kanya en yie bäät ääme mana en bäät cwïïe, ni put Ëglön cwøp ki yi gø.
english: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:

anywaa: 'Ba opëëllö aput thum yi Ëglön këël jaadhe bäre, ni ö maar yie ni put opëëllö uum, kiper Ëwut opëëllö käre wöth wøk këët; 'ba opëëllö atuny wøk ki yïthakic tiet Ëglön.
english: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

anywaa: Køøre Ëwut adøny wøk ya agööla, ni put dhøk øda en maal bäät øtø na en Ëglönni yie cïëgö, ni dëët geni ki wøk.
english: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø døny Ëwuti wøk, jø tïïc mo Ëglön aöö ni jootge dhøk øda en maal no odëëdö; køøre gena köö, ni «Kanymør ni eni ena kar laac manø ni en yi ødø ni ŋec enø.»
english: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

anywaa: Køøre gena kurö këël mana tïm wïthge ni laay; 'ba Ëglön dhøk ødøgø käre jabø. Kanyøgønø, geni muktää alwørge ni japge dhøk øtø; 'ba kwäärö marge aputge joot no opädhö dï øtø no nø thøø.
english: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëwut areeŋø kanya poode ni jøøgø ogallø, ni kaal kanya näk yie da kïte mo otieŋø, ni put pïï kanya cwøl ni Cëëra.
english: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe ennø, tuuŋ aput kooth mïëya en bäät kïte kaagø, ŋöömma näk onø cïp na kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni eni cwøla jiy kiper leny; ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge aay ki eni na aciel ni ge tïŋŋi ki mïëya en bäät kïte kaagø, ni eni bwøtha maal nyïmge.
english: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Caathu køøra, kiper Wuuö Jwøk nyïïmännu ma jø Möap ee nø cïp ceŋŋu.» Køøre jø Icriel gena put wääth køøre ni ge løøya piny, ni putge dhøk wäädhi mo Naam Jördan kanya näk dïët ki Möap mak, ni mänge jø Möap nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo kath løøga.
english: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the Lord hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca jø Icriel, jø Möap mo jïtö ki kume apaar aputge 'näk, ni beege jiy mo dëëtge døøŋŋø mo teek ki leny; ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dëëtge mo obøth.
english: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca jø Möap wïthge aput døø piny, ni putge tïmö ni ge ena tiet jø Icriel. Køøre piny aput nikwöc ni bäŋ lenye ki cwiiri ma pïërabära.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør Ëwut, Camgar wär Anath athïïŋ na pïëmi. 'Ba eni jø Pilitin ma dïpe abïciel anääe ki gïn mo caala apïïdhi, ni piem jø Icriel.
english: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäŋ tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk køør thøw Ëwut.
english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the Lord, when Ehud was dead.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp geni cer Jabin nyeny jø Keenan, ŋata bëën paana cwøl na Adhör; 'ba kwääc lwaa leny mare beeye Cicara nyen mo bëëdö paana cwøl na Aröcët-Agöyim.
english: And the Lord sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.

anywaa: 'Ba Cicara jïre da jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ma dïpe abïŋween mo tïïc ka nywïëny, ni put jø Icriel caannø døc ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Diböra cï Lapidöt, bëëdö ni luup ŋøla eni jï jø Icriel.
english: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wø pïïa piny tier tuunna cwøl ni tuun Diböra na en yïthakic Reema ki Bëthël na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem; 'ba jø Icriel wø ööa baŋe kaace nee luup moge nee wø ŋøle.
english: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Diböra  ajääk baŋ Barak wär Abiniem paana bëëde yie na cwøl ni Këdëc na en yi ŋööm Naptali nee ööe, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ennø, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ïïna nø köömme, ni kööe, ni ‹Kwänyï ki jø leny mo jïtö ki kar kume apaar, ni lwørï røk jø tuuŋ Naptali ki jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, ni cou nou cäädhi na athwöe, ni cooŋŋu rou bäät kïdi mana cwøl ni Tabör.
english: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh–naphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the Lord God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?

anywaa: Ni ö Cicara kwääc lwaa leny mar Jabin, ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny moe mo thööth døc, ni käla ge wøk baŋï, ni køøla geni bäät naama cwøl ni Kicön, ni puta eni cïp cerï.› »
english: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.

anywaa: Køøre Barak aköö jï Diböra, «Ni näk miï aay ki aani, løny ki man cøøa; 'ba ni näk miï ba aay ki aani, a ba cii.»
english: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.

anywaa: Ni kö Diböra, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, a aay ki ïïni; 'ba ajiem mano joot ri leny manøgø, ki køør jöö mana jierï enø, ba doo tïmö na marï, kiper Wuuö Jwøk Cicara cïbe cer dhaagø.» Køøre Diböra ree ajiiŋŋe nee aacge ki Barak ni ge cøøa Këdëc.
english: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the Lord shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.

anywaa: 'Ba Barak jø tuuŋ Dhebulan ki jø tuuŋ Naptali acwøle nee cige Këdëc ki eni na aciel, ni beege jø leny mo jïtö ki kar kume apaar. 'Ba Diböra thuwø aay ki eni.
english: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Eber nyï Këën ree ee nø daak buut jø Këën møga, ni beege nyïïkwaac Obap wää cï Modhe na daak ree buutge. 'Ba eni ree adaae ki jiye, ni cige kany mo bäär, ni gur oduŋkaara mare piny buut jaadha dwøŋ na en Dhaynanim na en buut Këdëc.
english: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim, which is by Kedesh.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny Cicara ni Barak wär Abiniem anø aa bäät kïnna cwøl ni Tabör.
english: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.

anywaa: Ni ö Cicara ni cwøl jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi bëët, ni beege jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ma dïpe abïŋween mo tïïc ka nywïëny, ki jø leny moe bëët moa en buute, ni öge wøk ki yi Aröcët-Agöyim ni cige bäät Naam Kicön.
english: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.

anywaa: 'Ba Diböra aköö jï Barak, «Ö maal, kiper man beeye dïcäŋ mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo cïp Cicara cerï yie; ennø, Wuuö Jwøk anø pööth maal nyïmï.» Køøre Barak aput løøc piny ki bäät kïdi mana cwøl ni Tabör, ni jø leny moe moa näk kume apaar cäädha køøre.
english: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the Lord hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the Lord gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri leny, Wuuö Jwøk Cicara ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø leny moe bëët atïïe nee bwøkge nyïm Barak, ni thøw jic Cicara mo thööth døc; ni ö Cicara ni päny piny ki bäät jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi ni put reeŋø ki tiete.
english: And the Lord discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba Barak aput reŋ køør jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø leny mo Cicara, këël mana pïïcge Aröcët-Agöyim; ni ö jø leny bëët mo Cicara ni putge thøø ri leny, ni bäŋgø mo obøth, këël aciel.
english: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.

anywaa: 'Ba Cicara aput reeŋø ki tiete këël mana put pïï ro oduŋkaany Jaël cï Eber nyï Këën. Kiper kar kaaca da bëët-mëër yïthakic Jabin nyeny Adhör ki jø dhi øt Eber nyï Këën.
english: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.

anywaa: Køøre Jaël aci wøk nee røømge ki Cicara, ni ko Jaëlli jï Cicara, ni «Gääï, kwäärö, gää baŋa; kärï lwäyö.» Ni ö Cicara ni put gaa baŋe yo oduŋkaara, ni ö Jaël ni rïëp Cicara ka abïï rïëp.
english: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.

anywaa: Køøre Cicara aköö, na «A kwaya ïïni, mooc a ki pïï mo thenh nee maadha, kiper aano näk riewi.» Kanyøgønø, Jaël dho opïr pïën mo yie da caak ajabe ni wëëk gø eni ni mäthe; køøre ena cäŋ rïëpö.
english: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.

anywaa: Køøre Cicara aköö jï Jaël, ni «Ci cuŋŋï dho oduŋkaara; 'ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo ööi ni pëënynya ïïni, ni kööe, ni ‹?Da dhaanhø mo orïŋ paarï kany?› køøre wärï kööï jï ŋatøca, ni ‹Bäŋgø.› »
english: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.

anywaa: 'Ba Jaël cï Eber alwötö ki dïnöök mar oduŋkaara, ni lwør dïgudi ki cere maya, ni ci baŋ Cicara mëëth, ni put dïnöök gur ki thääŋŋe këël mana put dïnöök këët piny yïth ŋøøm; kiper Cicara obutö døc ki niir öölö. Ni ö Cicara ni put thøø.
english: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Baraki na läp køør Cicara, Jaël aö wøk nee røømge ki gø,  ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ööï, nee ŋatøgø ni manynyï enø nee nyoodha jïrï.» Køøre Barak aput døny yo oduŋkaara ki Jaël, ni joot Cicara no othøw piny ni dïnöök poot ena thääŋŋe.
english: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, Jwøk wï Jabin nyeny jø Keenan aput dwøk piny nyïm jø Icriel.
english: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel, Jabin nyeny jø Keenan ki jiye acaarge, ni ö teeki mar jø Icriel ni tïme ni cäätha maal bäätge, këël mana raanyge geni.
english: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca Diböra ki Barak wär Abiniem duut man awärge ni köge,
english: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,

anywaa: ni «Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, kiper dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel cwïnyge ajïtö ki cer ni bwøthge jiy, ni ö jø Icrielli ni cïpge dëëtge, ni cige baŋ leny ni yïthge met.
english: Praise ye the Lord for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.

anywaa: Wui, u na nyeye, wïnynyu gïn! Wui, u na bëën mïëri, cegu ïthu! Aani, a wär ki duut jï Wuuö Jwøk; a wär ki duut naa pwøya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the Lord; I will sing praise to the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: «Awuuö Jwøk, kanya lwönnï wøk ki yi ŋööm Cëër, kanya cäädhï niï leeŋŋa bäätï niï lwönnï ka yi ŋööm jø Ëdöm, piny aput tïmö ni jäŋŋi, ni ö køthi ni lwöre, këël pøøl aløy ni tïmge na pïï.
english: Lord, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.

anywaa: Kïte atïmö ni jäŋŋi ki teegï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk; këël Kïn Caynay atïmö ni jäŋŋi ki teegï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: The mountains melted from before the Lord, even that Sinai from before the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: «Kanya bëëde na ri Camgar wär Anath, këël kanya bëëde na ri Jaël, nyeŋ jïëthe moa ŋäc athuk, ni tïm jiyi ni cäädhi ka nyeŋ jïëthe moa no oŋatø;
english: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.

anywaa: ni ö jø Icrielli moa bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en wøk ni dakge, ni dööŋ mïëri moøgø keerge, këël mana tïme naa ööa maal, a na Diböra en; naa ö maal ni aana mïïö jï jø Icriel.
english: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.

anywaa: Kanya ö jø Icrielli na jierge juu møøk kiper dëëtge, nyïïmän moge aput öö ki lenye mo teek këël dhøk kiiri moge. 'Ba dï jø leny mo jø Icriel moa näk jïtö ki kume ma pïëraŋween, bäŋ dhaanhø mo ojoodø ni cere da kwöt leny ki tøŋ.
english: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, cwïnya atïmö ni met ki u na kwääc lwaae mo jø Icriel, ki u na cïp dëëtu ki met ec, na ci baŋ leny kiper jø Icriel; beerra man pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the Lord.

anywaa: U na kwöru døøŋŋø ni wø cäädhi ki bäät arëëni moa tar, ki u na no okwär ni wø bëëdö kwör bëëte mo kwär, këël u na can ni wø cäädhi ki tietu nyeŋ jïëthe, caarru gïna tïïc Jwøki.
english: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.

anywaa: Dööt jø leny awïnyö ki kwör wø um jiyi yïthge ki pïï, ni ge cara gïr japa näk adïëri na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye gïr japa näk adïëri moa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel moa bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en wøk; ni put tïmö ni løny jï jic Wuuö Jwøk ki man døøge kwör acooŋe moge na en dhøk kiiri mo mïëri moøgø.
english: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the Lord, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the Lord go down to the gates.

anywaa: «Wui Diböra, ka ööï maal nø, ö maal, ni wärï ki duut.  Wui Barak wär Abiniem, ö maal ni ciï baŋ leny nee jiy magï.
english: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
