anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel moa no odööŋ ni kwøw, rege acooŋge buut kwääc lwaae, ni beege jic Wuuö Jwøk na ö baŋa, a na Diböra, ni gena jø leny moa teek.
english: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the Lord made me have dominion over the mighty.

anywaa: Ki røk jøøa öö, beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem na bëëdö ni tietge onø këët piny yi ŋöömma kwøŋ jø Amalëki bëëdö yie, ni beege jøøa caath køøru, u na jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Benjamen; ni ö kwääc lwaae moa käl ri dhi øt Makir ni öge; 'ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, beege kwääc lwaae moa näk käära athøre mo kwär.
english: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

anywaa: Këël kwääc lwaae mo jø tuuŋ Icakar ena kanya ciel ki Diböra; kare møn, jø tuuŋ Icakar adwätö ki Barak; ni putge rwäänhnhö køøre ni ge løøya piny yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ruben na näk bëëdö yïth atude moge, cwïnyge bëëdö ni ena dïër kiper gïna dige tïïö.
english: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø, u na jø tuuŋ Ruben, na dööŋŋu ni uuno pï piny dhøk lwääge mou, nou wïnynya dööt opele mo wø køth jø kwaathi? Jø tuuŋ Ruben na näk bëëdö yïth atude moge, cwïnyge bëëdö ni dëëdö ki gïna dige tïïö.
english: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.

anywaa: Jøøa en yi ŋööm Gelät gena put bëëtö løø Naam Jördan løøga. ?Aperŋø na dööŋ jø tuuŋ Daan dhi waath buut baabuure? Jø tuuŋ Acer thuwø geno pï piny deŋ naama dwøŋ, ni putge bëëtö dhøk wäädhi kaace.
english: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beege jiy moa cïp jwïëcge kanya enge kar leny; këël jø tuuŋ Naptali thuwø, jwïëcge acïpge ni këëtge kiper kwör lenye moa en maal nee makge.
english: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

anywaa: «Nyeye mo Keenan aö baŋ leny, ni këëtge ki jø Icriel pääny Tanak buut Naam Kicön na en buut pääny Megidø; 'ba nyeye moøgø bäŋ gïï mo ege twierø, këël gwel-bïrö mo thiinh.
english: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.

anywaa: Ceer akëëdö ki kwöra cääthge yïthge maalø, ni ge këëdi ka Cicara; gena këëdö ki Cicara møn ki køør gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki.
english: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.

anywaa: Ni ö jic Cicara ni køøli ya Naam Kicönni, ni beeye kanya bëëde ni kwödö døc, ni beeye Naam Kicön na nut cøøn. Wui jwïëya, beerra man putï riï mak niï teek.
english: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.

anywaa: Kar kaagønø, tiet okwëënyi mo leny awïnyö ni ge rïïŋö døc, ni beeye ŋwïëy mo teek na ŋweec okwëënyi mo leny moøgø na teek yøø.
english: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, na ‹Acïëni en bäät paana cwøl ni Mërödh; jøø ni bëëdö paanøgø yøø, acïëni en bäätge na bäre bäre, kiper ge kär öö ni kønyge cer Wuuö Jwøk ki leny, ni beeye ki man kønyge cer Wuuö Jwøk kanya këëde ki jø leny mo jø Keenan na teek.›
english: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the Lord, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord against the mighty.

anywaa: «'Ba gwïëth en bäät Jaël ki røk mään bëët,  ni beeye Jaël cï Eber nyï Këën; gwïëth en bäät dhaaŋŋøgø ki røk mään bëët moa bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare.
english: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.

anywaa: Cicara Jaël apëënynye nee eni mooc ki pïï, ni ö Jaëlli ni cïp caak jïgø; Jaël akännö jï Cicara ki caak ma dïïle, ni cïbe ka gïr wöt mo caala keenø.
english: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

anywaa: 'Ba Jaël cere arwaak baŋ dïnöök mar oduŋkaara, ni ö cere mana näk cwïïe ni rwaak gø baŋ dïgudi man wø tïï cwøwi ki gø. Køøre Jaël wï Cicara aput gur ki dïgudi ni put gø 'näk, ni ö thääŋŋe ni put gø tuc ni put wïïe keethø.
english: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.

anywaa: Ni ö Cicara ni put päth tiet Jaël no onibaŋŋa, kare møn, ena put päth tiet Jaël no onibaŋŋa; 'ba kanya päth yie no onibaŋŋa, aput thøø kaace na bäre bäre.
english: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.

anywaa: «'Ba mii Cicara bëëdö ni neeta wøk ki dha awëërnyeŋ ni göö ko oduuru; eni bëëdö ni neeta wøk ki dha awëërnyeŋ, ni kööe, na ‹?Aperŋø na ruu jääyi mar wääda man wø tut okweenynyi ni kär laar öö en? ?Aperŋø na ruu tiet okwëënyi mo wø tut jïëthe mo jø leny moe, na ba laarge wïnyö en?›
english: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

anywaa: 'Ba mii Cicara da luubö mør thuwø mo di carø ni di nøøyø ki cwïnye, ni ö määra näk owøørø na nyeŋge reegø na en buute ni caange luubö marge jïre, ni köge,
english: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,

anywaa: na ‹?Aŋø, ge ba poot määnyö ki jammi mo twierge, ni ge ba poot pääŋ japa twierge yïthakicge wän? ?Aŋø, ba da nyïïakuue mo ege maaø wän, ni ge poot pääŋŋa geni, nee ŋat leny man nø jïte ki nyakøø aciel wala nyïïakuue ariiø? ?Këël Cicara, ba da abïï mo kïte mïërö mo ee joodø wän, ni beeye abïï mo kïte mïërö mo ocwääö ki waare mo kïtge näga teeŋi teeŋi, ni beeye abïï mo kïte mïërö mo ocwääö na wøp døc, mano käär Cicara kanyo ööe, eni na dïtwïëdi?›
english: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man ö nyïïmännï ni thøwge bëët kaawat mana thøw Cicara ki jø leny moe; 'ba jøøa mëër ki ïïni, beerra man tïmge ni caala cäŋ kany wø tuule ki teek mare.» Køøre piny aput nikwöc ni bäŋ lenye ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: So let all thine enemies perish, O Lord: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel atïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp geni ceŋ jø Midien, ni wëëk geni caarø ki cwiiri abïriiø.
english: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord: and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

anywaa: 'Ba teek mar jø Midien aput kadhø døc bäät jø Icriel. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni jiiŋge kwör mo ŋammø mo ena bäät kïte, ki uut kïte, ki kwör gwøk røk mo otïïö ni teek mo ena bäät kïte, ni gïïögø jiiŋge kaper dëëtge.
english: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø tïme ni jø Icriel pïïdhö ki caammi, jø Midien wø puta öö ki jø Amalëk ki jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ge ööa baŋ jø Icriel.
english: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø puta tïïö ki twëëre buut jø Icriel, ni raanyge gïïa näk otuy kaagø bëët këël mano këët paana cwøl ni Geedha, ni bäŋ caammi  mo wecge jï jø Icriel, këël dïëk ki dhäk ka arëëni bäŋgø mo wecge.
english: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø öge, ge ööi ka lääc paac moge bëët ko oduŋkaare moge, ni ge thööth døc ni caala bäänyö; ni geni ka athïrööle moge bëët, ge ba løny ki kwaan. 'Ba ge wø ööi ni ge raanynya ŋöömö manøgø møn.
english: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëëtö marge adøø piny døc kiper gïna tïïc jø Midienni dëëtge, ni ö jø Icrielli ni jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk ki køør gïna tïïc jø Midienni dëëtge,
english: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the Lord because of the Midianites,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ajääk baŋ jø Icriel ki nyikuŋ Jwøk, ni kö nyikuŋ Jwøki manøgø jïge, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Beeye aani na käl uuni wøk ki Ijep, ni käla uuni wøk ki yi bëët laŋ.
english: That the Lord sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;

anywaa: Aani, uuna käla wøk ceŋ jø Ijep, ni käla uuni wøk ceŋ jøøa bëëdö ni u ege thiel piny, ni riema jøøgø wøk nyïmmu ni cïba ŋöömö marge jïïu;
english: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;

anywaa: ni caana gø jïïu, ki man näk mo beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu; ni caana gø jïïu thuwø ki man ba wøørru juu mo jø Amör ni bëëdu yi ŋöömö marge en. 'Ba uuni dwøra käru leŋø.› »
english: And I said unto you, I am the Lord your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe kaamar nyïïatwiel maal, ni ööe ni pï piny tier jaadha dwøŋ na en Opara, paana en cer Jöac na käl dhi øt Abiedhar. 'Ba kanya ö nyïïatwiel maal manøgø, Gidien o Jöac dïnö ki beel moa cwøl ni cïndë yi kany wø biic nyïïomøki yie, ni tïïe ni ee kanø kiper nee ba joot jø Midien.
english: And there came an angel of the Lord, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abi–ezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal ree anyoodhe jï Gidien, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wui, ï na ŋat leny mana teek, Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ki ïïni.»
english: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto him, and said unto him, The Lord is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien aköö jïgø, ni «Wui kwäärö, ?dee na Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ki waani cøøn, gïï bëët ii, a dige tägö dëëtwa nidïï? ?Këël gïï mo rëëma ec moa tïïe bëët, moa caan wëëkwa jïwa na köge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk øøna käl wøk ki Ijep,› gïïa näk rëëma ec moøgø enge kaa ennø? 'Ba ennø møn, Wuuö Jwøk waana nø wiie ni cïp waani ceŋ jø Midien.»
english: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the Lord be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? but now the Lord hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Wuuö Jwøk enø, jï Gidien aneene, ni kööe, ni «Ciï ki teek man cïba jïrï ennø ni piemï jø Icriel ceŋ jø Midien. Ïïna jääŋŋa ennø.»
english: And the Lord looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien aköö jïgø, «?Wui Kwäärö, jø Icriel opiema gø ceŋ jø Midien nidïï? Neenï, tuuŋwa beege jiy moa jägö geni døc ki ri jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni ki ri dhi øt wära, aana dhaanhø mo bäŋ kara.»
english: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïgø, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aano en buutï; ni putï jø Midien 'näk ni caala dhaanhø aciel jaak.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, «Ni näk mo yiï met ki aani ennø møn, nyuuthï jïra ki ŋïï nee ŋääa ki man näk mo beeye ïïni na Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö ki aani en.
english: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.

anywaa: 'Ba a kwaya ïïni niï ba aayï kany, këël kanyo duua baŋï noo känna ko olämi mo cïba jïrï.» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Aani, a bëëdö kany këël kanyo duuï.»
english: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aci paare ni jiiŋ nyidiel ki muunni mo kär coodø ki thømmø, ni møø manøgø røme ka rumi mana cwøl ni iipa; ni kïth rïŋö yi gupa ni kïth cwege ya athaa, ni käl geni baŋ gø kanya en yie tier jaadha dwøŋ, ni put gïïögø cïp.
english: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aköö jïgø, ni «Lwør rïŋö ki muunni moa näk kär coodø ki thømmø ni peedhï ge bäät kïdi man en, ni kønynyï cwege bäätge.» Ni ö Gidienni ni put gïnögø tïïc ki yi jöö manøgø.
english: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal ni rwaak athøra mana en cere, ni ö rïŋö ki muunni moa näk kär coodø ki thømmø ni gut ge ki tier athøra; ni ö maaci mo käla ri kïdi ni put liel ni waaŋ rïŋö ki muunni moa näk kär coodø ki thømmø këël mana thöör gø. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aput rwäänyö nyïm Gidien kaagø.
english: Then the angel of the Lord put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the Lord departed out of his sight.

anywaa: 'Ba  kanya ö Gidienni na joot gø ni manøgø beeye Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal, ena lwäyö døc ni kööe, «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Wuuö Jwøk ki dëërï, ?ïïna puta neen kiree møn, niï ööi kaamar nyïïatwiel maal?»
english: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the Lord, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord God! for because I have seen an angel of the Lord face to face.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Bëëdï ni yiï met, kärï lwäyö; ïïni, ï ba thøw.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aput tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace, ni cak nyeŋ gø, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø käl bëët-mëër.» 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø poot nut këël dïcäŋi en paana cwøl ni Opara na näk mar jøøa käl dhi øt Abiedhar.
english: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the Lord, and called it Jehovah–shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïwäänögø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Lwør rwaath dhieŋ mana näk cwiiye abïriiø, na näk mar wäru, ni beeye rwaadha käl køør kaa; ni raanynyï gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar wäru na näk ee tïïö kiper jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni ö jaadha näk otieŋø na näk ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara na näk ocwöth piny buute kaagø ni ŋødï gø piny.
english: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:

anywaa: Ni tïï ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marï, ni tïïyï wï kïdi maal kanya näk otïïö ni teek, ni iï jiiŋŋø na kare; ni lwørï rwaath manøgø ni cïpï gø no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ni waaŋï ki jaadhøgø no oŋødï piny enøgø.»
english: And build an altar unto the Lord thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien acwötö ki jiy apaar røk jø tïïc moe, ni tïïc gïnögø na kare kaawat mana nø caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïre. 'Ba ki man tïïc gïnögø ki dïcäŋ, atïïe ki wäär, kiper mana näk eni lwäär døc ki tuuŋ wänni këël jø paanøgø bëët.
english: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the Lord had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päc jø paanøgø ka amöölla cøøn, na lwïthge ennø, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk otïïö kiper jwøa cwøl ni Baal onø raanynyø, ni jaadha näk ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara na näk ocwöth piny buute kaagø onø ŋøt piny; ni rwaadha käl køør kaa onø cïp no olämi bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk otïïö na nyään.
english: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.

anywaa: Køøre jø paanøgø gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, na «?Aŋa na tïïc gïn?» 'Ba kanya määnyge ni ge pëëö, gena köö, ni «Beeye Gidien o Jöac na tïïc gïnögø.»
english: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.

anywaa: Køøre jø paanøgø gena ö baŋ Jöac ni köge, ni «Käl wäädï wøk nee thøøe ennø, kiper eni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk otïïö kiper jwøk, ni beeye Baal, araanynye, ni ö jaadha näk ocaa ri jwøk, ni beeye Acara, na näk ocwöth piny buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø ni ŋøt gø piny.»
english: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöac aköö jï jøøa ö baŋe na näk cuŋŋö kaagø bëët, na «?Aŋø, uuni, u ŋäbö kiper Baal? ?U manynya gø nee cwagu? Ennø, ŋato köö ni eni ŋäbö kiper Baal jaak, ka amöölla diøø eni doo nääö. Ni näk mo Baal beeye Jwøk, beerra man ŋäbe kiper dëëre keere, kiper beeye gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mare, eni na Baal enø, na raanynyi.»
english: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ Gidien aput cwøl ni Jerubaal dïcäŋögø, ni tiere beeye, ni «Beerra man ö Baalli ni ŋäbe ki eni,» kiper Gidien gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Baal araanynye.
english: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgønø, jø Midien bëët, ki jø Amalëk, ki jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ rege adwalge, ni cige ni ŋølge Naam Jördan, ni tïïcge twïër marge dï gool mana cwøl ni Jedhriel.
english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk aput ö bäät Gidien; ni ö Gidienni ni kooth tuuŋ, ni ö jø poge na käl dhi øt Abiedhar ni öge ni cooŋge rege nee cääthge køøre.
english: But the Spirit of the Lord came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him.

anywaa: Ni ö Gidienni ni jääk baŋ jø tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Maneeca bëët, ni öge thuwø, ni cooŋge rege nee cääthge køøre; ni jääk baŋ jø tuuŋ Acer, ki jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, ki jø tuuŋ Naptali, ni öge ni røømge ki geni.
english: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aköö jï Jwøk, «Ni näk mo jø Icriel piemï piemø ki raa møn, kaawat mana nø caanï gø,
english: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,

anywaa: ennø, aani, jïëc diel ma røømmø mo onyaarø cïba yi laara. 'Ba ni näk mo da thööy bäät jïëc røømmø keere, ni dööŋ pinynyi kaagø bäre no otal, oŋääa ni jø Icriel piemï piemø ki raa møn, kaawat mana nø caanï gø.»
english: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääe ka amöölla cøøn, gïnögø aput joot no otägö møn. 'Ba kanya biic jïëc røømmø, thööy moa ö wøk ki røk jïër moøgø atïmö na pïï mo päŋ yi gïn mo caala keenø.
english: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien acäŋ köö jï Jwøk, ni «Beerra man ba cwat yiï ni ba gootï ki aani, naa cäŋa cäännö yie man keere; a kwaya ïïni nee gïn cäŋa päärö yie aciel man keere ki jïëc røømmø. Ennø beerra man tïm jïëc røømmø keerge no otal, ni tïm pinynyi kaagø bäre ni da thööy.»
english: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni tïïc gïnögø dïwäänögø; ni tïm jïëc røømmø keerge no otal, ni tïm pinynyi kaagø bäre ni da thööy.
english: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.

anywaa: Køøre Jerubaal, ni beeye Gidien, ki jø leny moa en buute bëët, gena päny maal ka amöölla cøøn ni cige ni tïïcge twïër marge buut jøøro mar paana cwøl na Aaröt. 'Ba twïër mar jø Midien ena jï kuna en wï-piny ki geni; ni twïër manøgø ena buut kïdi mana cwøl ni Mörë na en dï gool mana cwøl ni Jedhriel.
english: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Jø leny moøgø ni buutï yøø, atïmö ni thööth døc ki man cïba jø Midien ceŋge, kiper kanymør jø Icriel ŋwöö jaak ni köge, ni ‹Waani, jø Midien aböötwa ki teek marwa keerwa.›
english: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gøø awaaci piny ni wïnyö jï jø leny bëët, ni kööï, ni ‹Ŋat mo olwäyö ni dëëre miel, løk ree ni døø paac, ni tïŋŋi ka bäät kïdi man na Gelät en.› » Kanyøgønø, jø leny ma kume ma pïërariiø ka ariiø aput døø paac, ni dööŋ jiyi ma kume apaar.
english: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jï Gidien, ni «Jø leny moøgø poot thööth døc. Ennø, løøc piny ki geni ni cou bäät jøøro nee ge jiera jïrï. 'Ba ŋat wäro caana jïrï, ni ‹Ŋati en doo aay ki ïïni,› wär ŋatøca aae ki ïïni; 'ba ŋat wäro caana jïrï, ni ‹Ŋati en ba doo aay ki ïïni,› ŋatøca kär aay ki ïïni.»
english: And the Lord said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gidien aput løøc piny ki jø leny ni cige bäät jøøro. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Pääŋ jø leny moo mäthi ki pïï ki ceŋge kaawat mano ö gwöki o gat pïï, ni kïthï geni kur keerge, ni iï pääŋŋö ki jø wø puthi ki pïï ni cøŋge ege këël piny.»
english: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the Lord said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy moa mäthö ki pïï ki ceŋge ni ge kïtha dhøkge, beege jiy ma dïpe adäk keerge. 'Ba lwaa dhaanhø bäre cøŋge akëëlge piny ni puthge ki pïï.
english: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Uuno piema ceŋ jø Midien ki ri jø leny moøgø na dïpe adäk yøø, na maath pïï ki ceŋge, ni cïba jø Midien ceŋŋu. 'Ba ennø, jø leny møga bëët døøkge nø, ni ŋati man nø døøa kar bëëtö mare.»
english: And the Lord said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moa näk dïpe adäk, caammi ki tuŋi moa en ceŋ jøøgø alwørge. Ni ö Gidienni ni wëëk jø Icriel moøgø bëët wääth nee ŋati man nø døø kar bëëtö mare. 'Ba ena dööŋ ki jøøa näk dïpe adäk keerge; ni twïër mar jø Midien nëënö jïre ni ena piny dï gool kaace.
english: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïwäänögø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Gidien, ni «Ööu maal, ni løøyu piny ni tugu twïër jø Midien, kiper ge yaa nø cïp ceŋŋu.
english: And it came to pass the same night, that the Lord said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï lwäär ki man løøyï piny baŋ leny, ïïni ki ŋat tïïc marï ma Pura wäru løøyu piny twïër jø Midien.
english: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:

anywaa: Køøre gïïo car jø Midienni owïnynyï; køøre cään nø, ïïno jïti ki teek nee tïme ni løny jïrï ki man løøyï piny ni tugï twïër manøgø.» Køøre Gidien ki ŋat tïïc mare ma Pura gena løøc piny ni pïïcge buut jø leny mo jø Midien moa en deŋ twïër.
english: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Midien ki jø Amalëk ki jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, dï gool manøgø bäre ege gääbö, ni kwäänge thööth døc kaamar lwaa bäänyö; këël athïrööle moge ba løny ki kwaan, kiper ge thööth døc ni kwäänge caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Gidienni na pïïe twïër mar jø Midien, ka adïëri møn, da dhaanhø mo pädö ki lääk jï nyawatge, ni kööe, ni «Neenï, aana lägö keda da dääpö mo tïïc ki møk bëëlö mana cwøl ni gäbci mo oŋïël yi twïër marø, ø na jø Midien, ni pïïe ro oduŋkaany kwääc lwaak, ni gøøc gø këël mana pädhe, ni ö oduŋkaara ni put gø jal ni luk wï gø piny, ni put pädhö no oninyaŋŋa.»
english: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya nyawatge jïre ni kööe, ni «Manøgø paa gïn mør na bäre bäre; beeye opëëllö mar Gidien o Jöac nyï Icriel, kiper Jwøk, jø Midien ki twïër marge bäre, ee nø cïp cer Gidien.»
english: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Gidienni na wïny lääk mana par ki tier gø mana løk, eni cøŋŋe aput këël piny ni pwøc Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre ena duu twïër mar jø Icriel ni kööe, ni «Ööu maal, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jø Midien këël twïër marge ee nø cïp ceŋŋu.»
english: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the Lord hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

anywaa: Ni ö Gidienni ni pääŋ jø leny moa näk dïpe adäk na dhøgi adäk, ni cïp ceŋ jøøgø bëët ki tuŋi ki dääe mo yïthge ŋammø, ni yïth dääe moøgø da ameethi.
english: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïge, ni «Neennu jïra, ni ŋwallu gïno tïïa. Ennø, kanyo pïïa deŋ twïër mar jø Midien, gïno tïïa kaace wär putu tïïc thuwø.
english: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.

anywaa: Aani ki jøw en buuta bëët kanyo koothwa tuŋi, uuni thuwø tuŋi mou wär koothu ki deŋ twïër manøgø bäre, ni kwöŋŋu ni kööu, ni ‹Beeye per Wuuö Jwøk ki Gidien.› »
english: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien ki jø leny moa näk dïpa na en buute, gena öö ni pïïcge deŋ twïër mar jø Midien kanya tïme na dï wäär ni jø wø kurö ri riet koor, ge wïïnnö. 'Ba kanya pïïcge, tuŋi aputge kooth ni putge dääe moa en ceŋge 'näk.
english: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi moø na dhøgi adäk yøø, na koothge tuŋi na 'näkge dääe; geni ameethi aputge mak ki cämge ni makge tuŋi ki cwïcge kiper nee koothge, ni putge kwöŋŋö, ni «Leny man beeye per Wuuö Jwøk ki Gidien.»
english: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the Lord, and of Gideon.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø ni put cuŋŋö kare ni twïër bäre ege wïrö; 'ba jø leny bëët moa en twïër jø Midien kaagø, gena put bwøk, ni ge göö ko oduuru kanya rïïŋge.
english: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel moa näk dïpe adäk na koothge tuŋi, Wuuö Jwøk jø leny mo jø Midien atïïe nee rege 'näkge keerge ko opëëlle moge, ni put gïnögø tägö dï twïër bäre; ni ö jø Midienni ni putge reeŋø këël mana pïïcge Bëëth-Cita na näk dïët ki Dherera, këël mana pïïcge deŋ Abël-Mööla na en buut Thabet.
english: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the Lord set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abel–meholah, unto Tabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel moa käl røk jø tuuŋ Naptali ki jø tuuŋ Acer ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, gena cwøl, ni öge ni ŋwiecge køør jø Midien.
english: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien ajääk baŋ jø Icriel moa näk bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte bëët na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni kööe, ni «Ööu piny baŋ jø Midien ni kwøŋu dhøk wäädhi mak këël mano pïïyu Bëëth-Bara ki Naam Jördan.» Køøre jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem bëët gena put öö ni putge dhøk wäädhi mak këël mana pïïcge Bëëth-Bara ki Naam Jördan.
english: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem, kwääri mo jø Midien ariiø amakge, ni beege Orëëp ki Dhëëp. Ni 'näkge Orëëp buut kïdi, ni cak nyeŋ kïnnögø no Orëëp; ni 'näkge Dhëëp buut kany wø biic nyïïomøki yie, ni cak nyeŋ kaace ni Dhëëp. Ni putge läp køør jø Midien. 'Ba køøre cään, wï Orëëp ki wï Dhëëp akälge baŋ Gidien kanya en yie løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ipariem, Gidien ajäälge ni yïthge ege keeyø døc, ni köge jïgø, na «?Aŋø, agïne ni tïïyï dëëtwa en? ?Aperŋø na ba cwølï waani, kanya aaï baŋ leny ki jø Midien en?»
english: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Gidienni jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïcwa, wa na jø dhi øt Abiedhar en, na näk rööma maru, u na jø tuuŋ Ipariem? ?Aŋø, maru na caal jeeny yi pwödhö kär tïmö ni pöödha eni ki marwa na caal kac pwödhö bäre?
english: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer?

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø na løny jïra na tïïa mo röömi ki mana tïïyu? Kiper Jwøk, kwääri mo jø Midien, ni beege Orëëp ki Dhëëp, acïp ceŋŋu.» 'Ba kanya caan gïnögø jï jø tuuŋ Ipariem, wëër mana en cwïnyge ki eni aput kwöyö.
english: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien ki jø leny moe moa näk dïpe adäk na en buute, këël na bëëtge ni geno ööl, gena ö bäät Naam Jördan, ni ŋølge gø, ni ge poot ŋwieya køør jø Midien.
english: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge pääny mana cwøl ni Cuköt, Gidien aköö jï jø Cuköt, na «Akwaya uuni, mooyu jø leny moi ni cäädhi ki aani en ki dääpe, kiper mana näk geno ööl kanya ŋwiecwa køør nyeye mo jø Midien ni beege Jeeba ki Jalmuuna.»
english: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk dïbwöthe mo Cuköt ni köge, na «?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni Jeeba ki Jalmuuna oløny ni ena ceŋŋu, ni moocwa jø leny moï ki dääpe en?»
english: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aköö, ni «Wøp nø; 'ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo cïp Jeeba ki Jalmuuna cera yie, aani u bïba bïbö ki koodhi mo paap ko oŋöön.»
english: And Gideon said, Therefore when the Lord hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ aay ki kaace ni pïïe Peniël, ni cäŋ teeŋ luumma caane jï jø Cuköt caannø jï jø päänyögø; ni ö jø Peniël ni løkge gø jïgø keda teeŋ mana løgi ya jø Cuköti jïre.
english: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäänö ki jø Peniël thuwø ni kööe, ni «Kanyo duua ni dëëra jööt, aani øt pööki man ni bäär ni you tïïö na kar gwøk røk en toora piny.»
english: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Jeeba ki Jalmuuna ki jø leny moge ma kume apaar kurbïïc moa bëëdö ki geni, ge ena kanya cwøl ni Karkar, ni beege jiy bëët moa dööŋ røk jø leny moa öö ki mïëya en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba jø leny moa thøw beege jiy ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø.
english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aci baŋge ni cøra jöör jøøa näk bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare, ni jöörögø cøra jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki kwöra cøøri ni Nöba ki Jögebiya; ni tuk twïër jø Midien, kanya bëëde ni kär dïët jø wø koor twïër.
english: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeye mo Midien moa na ariiø, ni beege Jeeba ki Jalmuuna, na reŋge, Gidien aput reŋ køørge ni mak geni; ni ö jø Midienni ni putge bwøk.
english: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien o Jöac aduuö ki baŋ leny ni cøra jöör kanya cwøl ni Ërë.
english: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,

anywaa: 'Ba eni nyen ma wøp røk jø Cuköt amaae ni tet gø. Køøre nyenøgø nyeŋ kwääc jø Cuköt ki jø døøŋŋø ma pïërabïriiø ka abïriiø agöör piny jï Gidien.
english: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aö baŋ jø Cuköt ni kööe, ni «Neennu Jeeba ki Jalmuuna nø, na buu aani kiperge na kööu, na ‹?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni Jeeba ki Jalmuuna oløny ni ena ceŋŋu, ni moocwa jø leny moï ki dääpe en, kiper mana näk geno ööl?› »
english: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gidien jø døøŋŋø mo päänyögø akäle ni bïp ge ki koodhi mo paap ko oŋöön ni pwönynya geni.
english: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.

anywaa: Køøre eni pööki mana bäär na näk kar gwøk røk mana en Peniël atoor piny, ni 'näk jøøa en yi päänyögø.
english: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien aköö jï Jeeba ki Jalmuuna, na «?Ateeŋ jiy mo nyïëdi na 'nägu bäät Kïn Tabör?» Køøre aløkge, ni «Ge caala ïïni, ni ŋati man nø ree ee caalø ki o nyeya.»
english: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Geni, gena nyïïmera moa nywøl mera kiree. 'Ba ennø, ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, doo na geni you wiiø ni ge kwøw, u ba daa nääö.»
english: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the Lord liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien aköö jï kanynye ma Jether, ni «Ö maal ni 'nägï geni.» 'Ba nyilaarøgø opëëllö mare käre wöth wøk, kiper ena lwäyö ki man 'näk geni, kiper mana näk eni poot na nyilaal.
english: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeeba ki Jalmuuna gena köö jï Gidien, ni «Ïïni ki dëërï, ö maal ni laarï wa 'näk; kiper ïïna dïcwøø ni jïrï da teek.» Kanyøgønø, Gidien aö maal ni 'näk Jeeba ki Jalmuuna, ni put jap mïërö moa en cwäk athïrööle moge käl.
english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aköö jï Gidien, ni «Tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marwa, ni beeye ïïni këël wäädï ki nyikwaarï thuwø, kiper ïïni, waana piemï ceŋ jø Midien.»
english: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien aköö jïge, ni «Aani, a ba tïmö ni aana nyeya maru, këël wääda ba tïmö na nyeya maru; 'ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk keere na nyeya maru.»
english: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the Lord shall rule over you.

anywaa: 'Ba Gidien aköö jïge, ni «Da gïrpiny aciel mo daa manynyø baŋu. Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni cïpe ki gwel ïth røk moa twiere.» Kiper jø Midien jïge da gwet ïdhi mo tïïc ka warkey; kiper geni, ge poot na jø Icmiel.
english: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aköö, ni «Cïpwa cïbö møn.» Køøre abïï aputge peer, ni ö ŋati man nø ni lëëŋ yi gø ki gwel ïth aciel røk moa twiere.
english: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.

anywaa: 'Ba gwet ïdhi moa näk tïïc ka warkey moa pëëny Gidienni atïmö na rumme ma kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø, ni røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni cekel; 'ba gwet cwägi ki gwet ïdhi ma teeŋi teeŋi, ka abïïe mo perge leth ma dïmuur moa käär nyeye mo jø Midien, ki jap mïërö moa en cwäk athïrööle moge kär kwaan rege.
english: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien warkey manøgø atïïe na ëëput, ni cïp gø pääny poge ma Opara; 'ba jø Icriel bëët ëëput manøgø atïïcge kaamar jwøk, ni cwïnyge onieŋ køøre kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paac mo rïïŋö køør käp. Ni put gïnögø tïmö ni caala abïëp kiper Gidien ki jø paare.
english: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Midien wïthge aput døø piny ni tïmge ni ge lwäär ki jø Icriel, ni kärge wïthge tïŋ maal këët. Køøre piny aput nikwöc ni bäŋ lenye ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween yïth nïr kwøw moa beet Gidienni.
english: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.

anywaa: 'Ba Jerubaal, ni beeye Gidien o Jöac, aput aa poge ni pï piny paare.
english: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk jïre da mään mo thööth, ena nyöödö ki wääte ma pïërabïriiø mo käla dëëre kiree.
english: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø mar Gidien mana näk akwanya mo bëëdö Cekam, Gidien anyöönne ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø na Abimëlëk.
english: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.

anywaa: Køøre Gidien o Jöac athøw ni eno jal ki jalø ma wøp, ni kani yi kään kïdi mar wänni ma Jöac na en Opara, pääny jø Abiedhar.
english: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør thøw Gidien, jø Icriel acäŋ tïmö ni cwïnyge onieŋ køør juuga cøøri na Baal kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paac mo rïïŋö køør käp; ni tïïcge Baal-Berith na jwøk marge.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baal–berith their god.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni wïl wïthge ki Wuuö Jwøk na bëëdö na Jwøge na piem geni ceŋ nyïïmänge ki yïth kwörögø bëët;
english: And the children of Israel remembered not the Lord their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:

anywaa: ni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo ege nyoodhø jï tuuŋ Jerubaal, mo röömi ki gïïa beyø na tïïe jï jø Icriel. 'Ba Jerubaal nyeŋŋe maya beeye Gidien.
english: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Abimëlëk o Jerubaal aci Cekam baŋ tuuŋ menni, ni cääne ki geni këël jøøa en ri dhi øt kwari wää menni ge bëët, ni kööe,
english: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caannu ennø, ni wïnyö jï jø Cekam bëët, ni ‹Jierru mana beerra eni ki baŋu. ?Aŋø, beeye gïn mo beer ki man ö wäät Jerubaal bëët na näk pïërabïriiø ki man bëëtge na kwääri mou, wala beerra dhaanhø aciel ki man bëëde na kwäärö maru?› 'Ba uuni, wïthu wär caarru thuwø ki man näk ma aana dhaanhø ma rem dëëtu naa käla dëëtu.»
english: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

anywaa: Køøre tuuŋ menni luup moøgø bëët acaange ni wïnyö jï jø Cekam bëët, ni ge caana dwøre; 'ba cwïnyge aputge løø køør Abimëlëk, kiper gena köö, ni «Eni ena tuuŋø møn.»
english: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni moocge Abimëlëk ki gwet-bïrö ma pïërabïriiø, ni gwel moøgø lwørge yi øt jwøge ma Baal-Berith; ni ö eni ni määnye ki jiy mo patha karge mo wïthge reyø ni tïmge na jø tïïc jïre, ni ö jøøgø ni caathge  køøre.
english: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk aci dhi øt wänni na en Opara, ni ö uutwänni na näk pïërabïriiø, ni beege wäät Jerubaal, ni put ge ŋarø bäät kïdi aciel mo ena kaace. 'Ba Jötham o Jerubaal na thiinh keere abøth, kiper eni ree akane.
english: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Cekam bëët këël jø wø bëëdö Bëëth- Milø bëët na en Cekam kaagø, rege adwalge ni cige ni røønyge Abimëlëk na nyeya buut gïna no ocwöth piny tier jaadha dwøŋ na en Cekam.
english: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Jötham, ena put aay ni cuŋŋe wï Kïn Geridhan, ni cääne ka aŋaade ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal; ni kööe jï jø Cekam, ni «Wui, u na jø Cekam, cegu ïthu ki luum caana en, nee tïme ni maara lønyø jï Jwøk ki man cek ïthe ki maru.
english: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ aciel jenni rege adwalge ni aacge nee röönyge ki nyeya mo käär geni, ni köge jï wädö, ni ‹Tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marwa.›
english: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.

anywaa: «'Ba jaath manøgø aköö jï jenni moøgø, na ‹?Aŋø, maaw mara man ni këël Jwøk ki jiy jïtö ki wöt ki køøre en, daa wiiø ni cøøa kuna tuuŋŋa jenni ni aana wïthge?›
english: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

anywaa: «Køøre jenni aköö jï olaam, ni ‹Ööï ni tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marwa.›
english: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.

anywaa: «'Ba olaam aköö jï jenni moøgø, na ‹?Aŋø, nyïëdi 'moa ni beyø ni ŋweeth ii, daa wiiø ni cøøa kuna tuuŋŋa jenni ni aana wïthge?›
english: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

anywaa: «Køøre jenni aköö jï omøk, ni ‹Ööï ni tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marwa.›
english: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

anywaa: «'Ba omøk aköö jïge, na ‹?Aŋø, nyïëdi 'moa ni wø nywøp na køøŋø, ni këël Jwøk ki jiy jïtö ki met ec ki køøre en, daa wiiø ni cøøa kuna tuuŋŋa jenni ni aana wïthge?›
english: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

anywaa: «'Ba na tïme na aŋuudi, jenni bëët aköö jï oŋïrö, ni ‹Ööï ni tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marwa.›
english: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.

anywaa: «Ni kö oŋïrö jï jenni moøgø, ‹Ni näk mo u caana adïëri møn naa røønynyu ni aana nyeya maru, ööu ni rïŋŋu tïpö mara; 'ba ni näk mo paa enøgønø, beerra man ö maaci wøk ki røk koodhi 'moa ni waaŋ jer lur Libaanø moa perge leth ni thöör geni.›
english: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø møn, ni näk gïna nø tïïyu enø, na røønynyu Abimëlëk na nyeya, ni näk tïïyu na adïëri ka acaara ma kare, nou cädö nou tïïya gïn mo beer kiper wära ma Jerubaal këël dhi øde bäre, nou coola gïna nø tïïe na beer møn, beerra man bëëdu ni ïthu met.
english: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

anywaa: Kiper wära akëëdö kiperu, ni cïp dëëre këël mana piem uuni ceŋ jø Midien.
english: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïyu dïcäŋi en, maru beeye ööny maal ni maru män ki dhi øt wära; kiper wääte ma pïërabïriiø anø 'nägu bäät kïdi aciel kaace, ni røønynyu Abimëlëk na nyeya maru, u na jø Cekam, ni beeye wääde na nywøl dhaaŋŋa näk ŋat tïïc jaak, kiper mana näk eni na Abimëlëk enø, ena tuuŋu.
english: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk gïna nø tïïyu enø, tïïyu na adïëri ka acaara ma kare, nou cädö nou tïïya gïn mo beer kiper wära ma Jerubaal këël dhi øde bäre dïcäŋi en, beerra man bëëdu ni yïthu met ka Abimëlëk, ni ö Abimëlëki ni bëëde ni yie met ki uuni thuwø.
english: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo paa enøgønø, beerra man ö maaci wøk ki ra Abimëlëk ni thöör uuni, u jø Cekam këël jø wø bëëdö Bëëth-Milø na en Cekam kaagø; ni ö maaci wøk thuwø ki rou, u jø Cekam ki jø Bëëth-Milø, ni thöör Abimëlëk.»
english: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

anywaa: Køøre Jötham ree akwale ni reeŋe, ni ci paana cwøl ni Bëër, ni put bëëtö kaace, kiper mana lwäye ko owänni ma Abimëlëk.
english: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba Abimëlëk abëëdö ki cwiiri adäk ni jø Icriel moa en kaace ena cere.
english: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk acaare mo reyø ajääŋŋe yïthakic Abimëlëk ki jø Cekam; ni ö jø Cekammi ni cätge ki man tïïge ki gïn mo raac dëër Abimëlëk.
english: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atïïc Jwøki ni coola kwör ki køør thøø mana raac na tïïc dëët wäät Jerubaal na näk pïërabïriiø; ni ö kwör remø marge ni tïme ni ena bäät owääge ma Abimëlëk na dïïr wïthge, ki jø Cekam moa cøk eni nee uutwänni nääe.
english: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

anywaa: Køøre  jø Cekam jiy atïïcge nee møørge piny bäät kïte moa en kaace ni marge ageem ka Abimëlëk; ni ö jøøgø ni twierge jiy bëët mo wø cør øtjöö mana en buutge kaace; 'ba luubö manøgø awïnyö baŋ Abimëlëk.
english: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gäl wär Ebet aöö ki tuuŋge ni pïïcge Cekam; ni ö jø Cekammi ni putge ŋäädhe marge kïth bäät Gäl.
english: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

anywaa: Køøre jø Cekam aci yïth pwöth ni putge kwany ki nyïïomøki, ni biicge ge, ni nywøpge gø na køøŋø, ni tïïge ka ajwöm met ec; ni dønyge yi øt jwøk marge, ni beeye jwøk man wø wøørge, ni cämge ni mäthge, ni täkge ki man jøøŋge Abimëlëk.
english: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

anywaa: Køøre Gäl wär Ebet aköö, «?Aŋø, Abimëlëk aŋa? ?Cekam thuwø tiere agïnaŋø, ni tïme ni ø bëënna Abimëlëk en? ?Aŋø, Abimëlëk paa o Jerubaal na bëëde? ?A Dhëbul, paa kar waŋ mare? Beerra man bëëdø ni ø bëënna jøøa käl ri Eemör wää Cekam. ?'Ba aperŋø nø, ni tïme ni ø bëënna Abimëlëk en?
english: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, doo na jøøi ii ena cera, eni na Abimëlëk enø daa rïëma wøk. A doo köö jïre, ni ‹Ö wøk ni lwaa leny marï iï tïïö ni päl, nee ø këëdö.› »
english: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Dhëbul, ŋata no ocïbö na kar waŋ paac manøgø, na wïny luup moa caan Gäl wär Ebet, ena put wëër ki cwïnye døc.
english: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

anywaa: Ni jääk baŋ Abimëlëk ki jiy, ni jääŋŋe ka piny mëëth, ni kööe, ni «Neenï, Gäl wär Ebet ki tuuŋge anø ö Cekam kany; ennø, geni dï paac manøgø bäre ege nø ŋeel ki nyeŋŋï.
english: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ïïni ki jø leny moøgø ni buutï yøø, pänynyu maal ki wäär, ni ööu ni butu piny yi pwöl leny ni rou you kanø.
english: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na amöölla, ni cäŋ tuulö, wäru laaru päny maal ni tugu pääny man; køøre nø, kanyo tïme ni Gäl ki jøøgø ni buute yøø, ge ööa wøk baŋu nee këëtge ki uuni, gïno løny jïïu ki man tïïyu gø dëëtge jaak, wäru putu tïïc.»
english: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk ki jø leny bëët moa en buute, gena put päny maal ki wäär, ni cige ni butge piny yi pwöl leny mana en buut Cekam kaace ni gena dhøgi aŋween.
english: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

anywaa: 'Ba Gäl wär Ebet aci dhi kiir mar pääny manøgø, ni cuŋŋe kaace; 'ba Abimëlëk ki jø leny moa en buute, gena put päny maal ki kanya näk rege ege kanø yie.
english: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Gälli na lwïthe, jø leny moa cäädhö ka Abimëlëk ajoode, ni kööe jï Dhëbul, ni «Neenï, da jiy mo cäädhö ni ge löönynya piny ki bäät kïte.» 'Ba Dhëbul aköö jïgø, ni «Bäŋgø; ï neeta tïpö mar kïte, kiper nëëni kaamar jiy.»
english: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

anywaa: 'Ba Gäl acäŋ cäänö ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da jiy mo cäädhö ni ge löönynyi ka kanya en maal na en dï ŋöömö kaace, ni dhøk aciel cäädhö ni cura jöö mana en buut jaadha dwøŋ na näk mar jø adïëda.»
english: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

anywaa: Køøre Dhëbul aköö jï Gäl, na «?Age ŋwøc marï nø, na kööï, na ‹?Abimëlëk aŋa, ni bëënnø eni en?›? ?Aŋø, paa jøøa taagï na bëëde yøø? Ci wøk baŋge ennø, ni këëdï ki geni.»
english: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

anywaa: Ni ö Gälli ni put ci wøk ni nëënö jï dïbwöthe mo jø Cekam ni këëde ka Abimëlëk.
english: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bööt Abimëlëki ni put reeŋø ni ŋwieya gø; ni ö jiye mo thööth ni put dëëtge jïtö ki ŋwiili ni päänhge ni geno këët dhi kiir.
english: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk aput bëëtö Aruma. 'Ba Dhëbul, Gäl ki tuuŋge aput riem wøk nee ba bëëtge Cekam këët.
english: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya jø Cekam aci wøk yïth pwöth, ni ö gïnögø ni wïnynyi ya Abimëlëki.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk aay ki jø leny moe ni pääŋ geni na dhøgi adäk, ni butge piny yi pwöl leny ni dëëtge ege kanø; 'ba kanya lwïthe na joot jiy ni ööa wøk ki yi pääny, gena put päny maal ni 'näkge jøøgø.
english: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

anywaa: Køøre Abimëlëk ki jø leny moa näk dhøk aciel na en buute, gena put rwädhö ni cige ni cuŋge dhi kiir mar pääny manøgø; ni ö jø lenynyi moa näk dhøgi ariiø ni rwäthge baŋ jiy moa en yïth pwöth ni putge ge 'näk.
english: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

anywaa: 'Ba  Abimëlëk aput këëdö ki jøøa en pääny manøgø ni thöör dïcäŋ manøgø bäre, ni put gø mac ni 'näk jiy moa en yie kaagø; køøre pääny manøgø araanynye ni jør acäbö yie na nyuudhi.
english: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö gïnögø na wïnynyi jiyi bëët moa näk bëëdö yi øt pööki mana dwøŋ na bäär na en Cekam, gena put reŋ dï øt jwøge ma El-Berith, kanya no otïïö ni teek na kar gwøk røk.
english: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny Abimëlëki ni jiy bëët moa näk bëëdö yi øt pööki mana dwøŋ na bäär na en Cekam wïthge anø kuurge kanya aciel.
english: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abimëlëk ki jø leny moe bëët, gena aay ni putge eth maal bäät kïnna cwøl ni Jaalmön; ni ö Abimëlëki ni lwør ley ni ŋøt bat jaath, ni tïŋ gø maal ni gøø gø göönne. Køøre ena köö jï jø leny moa en buute kaagø, ni «Gïna tïïa na nø neennu ennø, laaru tïïc nou ŋwaala gø.»
english: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø bëët ni putge ŋutö thuwø ni ŋati man nø ŋunna ree ki bat jaath, ni putge wääth køør Abimëlëk, ni cige ni jääŋge bäädi mo jenni moøgø dëër øda no otïïö na kar gwøk røk, ni putge gø nyep ki maac ni ge nyïpa bäät jøøa en yi ødøgø. Ni ö jiy bëët moa näk bëëdö yi øt pööki mana dwøŋ na bäär na en Cekam ni putge thøø, ni gena jiy mo jïtö ki kuma, ni beege cwøw ki mään bëët.
english: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Abimëlëk ki jø leny moe apööth Tëbët, ni tïïcge twïër marge buut Tëbët ni këëtge ki jø paanøgø, ni putge gø mac.
english: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

anywaa: 'Ba da øt pööki mo dwøŋ mo bäär mo ogeerø ni teek mo ena dï pääny manøgø, ni ö jø paanøgø bëët, ni beege cwøw ki mään ki dïbwöthe bëët, ni putge reŋ yie ni putge dhi ødøgø dëët bäätge, ni cige ni ethge maal wï pööki manøgø.
english: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abimëlëk aput pïï buut pööki manøgø ni këëde ki jøøa en yie, ni ö buut dhi øt pööki manøgø nee nyebe ki maac.
english: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø aciel røk jøøa en wï pööki, kïn guur alëëŋe ki maal ni leeŋ gø wï Abimëlëk, ni ö akwaan wïïe ni put ŋedhø.
english: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.

anywaa: 'Ba Abimëlëk, ŋat tïïc mare man wø käär jap leny alaar cwøl ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wöth opëëllö marï wøk ni 'nägï aani, nee ba køp, ni ‹Ena 'näk dhaagø jaak.› » Ni ö nyenøgø ni put Abimëlëk cwøp ni put Abimëlëki thøø.
english: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø jooti ya jø Icrielli na Abimëlëk athøw, jøw aput keethø ni ŋati man nø døøa kar bëëtö mare.
english: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gïna tïïc Abimëlëki na raac, ni beeye gïna tïïe dëër wänni na nyääk jwïëc uutwänni moa näk pïërabïriiø, gïnögø acool Jwøki dëëre.
english: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

anywaa: Këël gïïa reyø bëët na tïïc jø Cekammi adwøk Jwøki wïthge thuwø, ni ö luupi moa car Jöthammi o Jerubaal ni keda luup acïëni ni put pïï bäätge møn.
english: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

anywaa: 'Ba køør thøw Abimëlëk, Töla o Puwa, nyikwaar Dödö, na käl ri jø tuuŋ Icakar, athïïŋ nee jø Icriel pieme; 'ba eni bëëdö Camir na en yi mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem.
english: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

anywaa: Ni bëëde na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurdäk. Køøre ena thøw, ni puti koony Camir.
english: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør Töla, Jayer nyï Gelät athïïŋ, ni bëëde na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurriiø.
english: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.

anywaa: 'Ba Jayer jïre da wääte ma pïëradäk, ni ge wø cäädhi ka bäät arëëni ma pïëradäk; 'ba geni jïge da päänye ma pïëradäk yi ŋööm Gelät, ni päänye moøgø cøøri ni Mïëc Jayer këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth–jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

anywaa: Køøre Jayer athøw ni koonyi Kamön.
english: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäŋ tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïnyge juuga cøøri ni Baal ka Actaröth, ki juu mo jø Aram, ki juu mo jø Caydan, ki juu mo jø Möap, ki juu mo jø Amön, ki juu mo jø Pilitin; ni putge Wuuö Jwøk wec ni ba tïnyge.
english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord, and served Baalim, and Ashtoreth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the Lord, and served not him.

anywaa: Køøre wëëc Wuuö Jwøk aö  bäät jø Icriel; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put geni cïp ceŋ jø Pilitin ki jø Amön.
english: And the anger of the Lord was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni putge jø Icriel caannø, ni täkge ki man dïïmge geni yi cwiineca. Ni putge bëëtö ni ge caara jø Icriel ni dïïmge geni ki cwiiri apaar ka abära, ni beege jø Icriel bëët moa en Gelät na en yi ŋööm jø Amör løø Naam Jördan ki jï kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Amön gena aay ni ŋølge Naam Jördan nee ge këëtge ki jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem thuwø. Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel bëëtö marge aput tïmö ni teek døc.
english: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel ajwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni köge, ni «Waana bääyö dëërï, kiper waani, ïïna wecwa, ï na Jwøk marwa, ni tïmwa ni wa tïnynya Baal.»
english: And the children of Israel cried unto the Lord, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï jø Icriel, na «?Aŋø, u kära piemø ceŋ jø Ijep, ki jø Amör, ki jø Amön, ki jø Pilitin na bëëde?
english: And the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

anywaa: ?A kanya ö jø Caydan, ki jø Amalëk, ki jø Maøn, na dïïmge uuni, u kär jwöŋö dëëra, ni piema uuni ceŋge thuwø?
english: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aana nø weyu ni tïnynyu juu møøk; 'ba kiper manøgønø, u ba cäŋa piemmø këët.
english: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

anywaa: Cou ni jwöŋu dëët juu moa jierru, nee u piemge kanyo bëëdu nou ena yi bëëtö mo teek.»
english: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Waana bääyö; ennø, tïïc mana näk nëëni ni beer ki jïrï jaak dëëtwa; 'ba beerra man piemï wa yie man keere nø.»
english: And the children of Israel said unto the Lord, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, geni juuga path moa en yïthakicge aputge wec, ni tïmge ni ge tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye apädhö ki caarø manø ni teek ni caar jø Icriel ki gø enø.
english: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the Lord: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgønø, jø Amön dëëtge adwalge kiper leny, ni öge ni tïïcge twïër marge yi ŋööm Gelät, ni ö jø Icrielli ni dwalge dëëtge thuwø, ni tïïcge twïër marge kanya cwøl ni Micpa.
english: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, dïbwöthe mo jø Gelät gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, na «?Aŋa noo bwøth jiy nee jøw këëtge ki jø Amön? Ŋato bwøth leny, eni puta tïmö na kwäärö mar jøøi ni bëëdö yi Gelät bëët ii.»
english: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeptha nyï Gelät beeye ŋat leny mo teek døc; 'ba eni, ena o dhaaŋŋa näk kääbi. Ni wää Jeptha beeye dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Gelät.
english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

anywaa: 'Ba Gelät cïïe anyöödö ko obwöre ni jït Geläti ki wääte. 'Ba kanya tïm wääte moa nywøl cïïe manøgø ni døøŋŋø, geni Jeptha ariemge ni köge jïgø, ni «Ïïni, ï bäŋ doo jïtö ki gïrpiny mo dööŋ jïrï po wääwa kany, kiper ïïna o dhaagø mør jaak.»
english: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeptha aput päär wøk ni ŋwieya uutwänni, ni aae ni put bëëtö yi ŋööm Thöp; ni ö jiyi mo wïthge reyø ni cooŋge dëëtge buut Jeptha, ni putge wääth køøre.
english: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, jø Amön akëëdö ki jø Icriel.
english: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö kanya tïme ni jø Amön këëdö ki jø Icriel, jø døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel moa bëëdö Gelät, aci kuna cwølge Jeptha yi ŋööm Thöp;
english: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

anywaa: ni köge jï Jeptha, ni «Ööï, niï tïmï ni ïïna kwääc lwaa leny marwa, nee tïme ni maara lønyø jïwa ki man këëtwa ki jø Amön.»
english: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

anywaa: Køøre Jeptha aköö jï jø døøŋŋø mo jø Gelät, «?Aŋø, u kär männö ki aani na bëëde, ni riemmu aani po wära? ?Aperŋø na ööu baŋa ennø, kanya tïme nou ena yi gïn mo leth en?»
english: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?

anywaa: 'Ba jø døøŋŋø mo jø Gelät aköö jï Jeptha, ni «Kiper gïnögø møn, waana ö baŋï ennø, nee tïme ni maara lønyø jïrï ki man aaø ki ïïni ni këëdø ki jø Amön; køøre nø, ïïno tïmö na kwäärö mar jøø bëëdö Gelät bëët yøø.»
english: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeptha aköö jï jø døøŋŋø mo jø Gelät, «Ni näk mou dwøga aani paac naa këëda ki jø Amön, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp geni cera, aani a puta tïmö ni aana kwäärö maru møn.»
english: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the Lord deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

anywaa: Ni kö jø døøŋŋø mo jø Gelät jï Jeptha, «Beerra man tïm Wuuö Jwøki ni beeye ŋato ŋäc luummögø yïthakiyø ki ïïni; ka adïëri møn, gïnögø tïïcwa tïïö kaawat mana nø caanï gø.»
english: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The Lord be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.

anywaa: Køøre  Jeptha aay ki jø døøŋŋø mo jø Gelät, ni ö jø Gelät ni tïïcge eni ni ena kwäärö na kwääc lwaa leny marge; ni ö Jeptha ni put luup moøgø bëët carø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kanya cwøl ni Micpa.
english: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the Lord in Mizpah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeptha ajääk baŋ nyeny jø Amön ki dwøl, ni kööe, «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø ni en yïthakiyø ki ïïni, ni ööï baŋa niï këëdï ki jøøa en yi ŋöömö mara en?»
english: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya mar jø Amön ni kööe jï jøøa jääŋ Jeptha, ni «Tiere beeye kiper kanya ö jø Icrielli wøk ki Ijep, ŋöömö mara aputge lwør, ni beeye ki mana täge ki Naam Arnön këël mana këët Naam Jabök ki deŋ Naam Jördan bäre. Kiper manøgønø, duu ŋöömö manøgø ki mëër jaak ennø.»
english: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeptha acäŋ jääk baŋ nyeny jø Amön ki dwøl,
english: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

anywaa: ni ö jøøgø ni caange dwør Jeptha jï nyeny jø Amön, ni köge, ni «Jø Icriel ŋöömö mar jø Möap wala ŋöömö mar jø Amön bäŋgø mo ege kälö.
english: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

anywaa: Kiper kanya ö jø Icrielli wøk ki Ijep, ge cøra jööra en dï paap ni ge coonya Naama Kwaar ni pïïcge Kadëc.
english: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, jø Icriel ajääk baŋ nyeny Ëdöm ki dwøl, ni köge, ni ‹Wa kwaya ïïni nee wa pööthwa ki dï ŋöömö marï.› 'Ba nyeny Ëdöm ïthe käre kam cek. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni jääkge baŋ nyeny Möap thuwø ki dwøl, 'ba eni kär jïëy. Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel aput bëëtö Kadëc jaak.
english: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.

anywaa: «Køøre jø Icriel aay ki dï paap ni ge wïra deŋ ŋööm jø Ëdöm ki deŋ ŋööm jø Möap, ni pïïcge deŋ ŋööm jø Möap jï løøa en jï løø kur tuulcäŋ, ni tïïcge twïër marge løø Naam Arnön løøga; 'ba jø Icriel kär pööth yi ŋööm jø Möap, kiper keew mar jø Möap beeye Naam Arnön.
english: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaaca, jø Icriel ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör ni wø bëëdö Ëcbön, ni köge jïgø, ni ‹Wa kwaya ïïni nee wa pööthwa ki dï ŋöömö marï, ni wa pöötha kanya dewa ci yie.›
english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëëwön, jø Icriel käre ŋäädhö ki man pööthge ki dï ŋöömö mare. Kanyøgønø, Cëëwön lwaa leny mare bäre acooŋe ni cøøe ni tïïc twïër mare Jäc, ni këëde ki jø Icriel.
english: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahzah, and fought against Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel, Cëëwön ki lwaa leny mare bäre acïp ceŋ jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni böötge jøøgø. Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel ŋöömö bäre mana bëët jø Amörri yie aputge lwør na marge kar kaaca.
english: And the Lord God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

anywaa: Køøre nø, jø Icriel ŋöömö mar jø Amör bäre alwørge na marge, ni beeye ki mana täge ki Naam Arnön këël mana këët Naam Jabök, ni cäŋ tägö ki dï paap këël mana këët bäät Naam Jördan.
english: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel beeye na riem jø Amör wøk nyïm jiye ma jø Icriel. ?Aŋø, ennø u manynya ŋöömö manøgø nee lwørru?
english: So now the Lord God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïna cïp jwøu ma Kemöc jïïu nee lwørru, paa gïna dou put lwør cøøn? 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ŋöömö mar jøøa nø riem wøk nyïmwa beeye noo lwørwa.
english: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the Lord our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, iï caarø ni kadha ïïni ki Balak o Cëëpör, nyeny jø Möap? ?Aŋø, awïnynyï ni Balak apïëmö ki jø Icriel na bëëde ni këëde ki geni?
english: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,

anywaa: ?Aŋø, cwiiri moa näk dïpe adäk na beet jø Icrielli Ëcbön ka atude moe na en buute kaace, ka Aröör ka atude moe na en buute kaace, këël yïth päänye bëët moa en buut Naam Arnön, aŋø na ba lwørru päänye moøgø kar kaaca?
english: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aani, bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø dëërï, 'ba beeye ïïni na tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëëra ki køør man këëdï ki aani en. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wø ŋøl luup, ni ŋøl luubö manøgø dïcäŋi yïthakic jø Icriel ki jø Amön.»
english: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the Lord the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny jø Amön luubö mana jääŋ Jeptha baŋe käre kam leŋ na bäre.
english: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Jeptha, ni ö Jeptha ni put ö maal ni pöödhe ki dï Gelät ki dï Maneeca; køøre ena pöödhö ki dï Micpa na en  Gelät kaace; 'ba na pöödhe ki Micpa na en Gelät kaace, ena put pööth baŋ jø Amön.
english: Then the Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeptha akööŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «Ni näk mo jø Amön iï cïp cera na adïëri møn,
english: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
