anywaa: kanyo duua ki baŋ jø Amön ni dëëra jööt, ŋato cur dhi øtø mara kaace jaak ni jula aani, puta tïmö na marï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba aani ŋatøca puta ka cïp no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.»
english: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the Lord's, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeptha aput ŋut baŋ jø Amön nee këëde ki geni; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put jø Amön cïp cer Jeptha.
english: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the Lord delivered them into his hands.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeptha ni bööt geni këël mana 'näk geni ki thøø mo leth døc, ni beeye ki mana täge ka Aröör këël mana këët kany wø pïïö Minith, ni beege päänye ma pïërariiø, këël mana këët Abël- Keramim. Kanyøgønø, jø Amön wïthge aput døø piny nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duu Jeptha na pïïe paare na en Micpa, nyaare aput joot ni ööa baŋe kuna jul eni, ni cere da anëëdö ni cäädhi ni miel. 'Ba nyaare manøgø beeye nyaare mana na aciel keere, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mør jïre këët ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø.
english: And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jeptha na joot nyaare, abïïge aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni kööe, «Wui, nyaara, aana määnynyï ki pänh cwïny, ni tïmï ni ïïno kwaan røk jøøa bëëdö ni yia ege cwaadø; kiper aani, luubö mara anø caana jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ba løny jïra ki man wiila luubö manøgø këët.»
english: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the Lord, and I cannot go back.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyaare aköö jïgø, «Awuuö, ïïni, luubö marï anø caanï jï Wuuö Jwøk møn; tïïc gïnögø dëëra kaawat mana nø caanï gø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk ïïna tïïe nee kwör coolï dëët nyïïmännï ma jø Amön.»
english: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the Lord, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the Lord hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ köö jï wänni, ni «Beerra man tïïyï gïn keere jïra; a kwaya ïïni naa bëëda dïturu ki dwäde ariiø, nee tïme ni maara lønyø jïra ki man cøøa naa cäädha bäät kïte, naa jwöŋa, kiper aana nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuua naa kär nywømø; 'ba aani, a doo aay ki nyïïawäätwa bëët.»
english: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

anywaa: Køøre Jeptha aköö, ni «Ciï.» Kanyøgønø, nyaare aput wëëk wääth kiper dwäde ariiø; ni ci nyaare ni bëëde ki nyïïawääte, ni jwöŋe bäät kïte kaace, kiper ena nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue ni kär nywømø.
english: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum dwäde ariiø moøgø, ena duu baŋ wänni, ni ö wänni ni tïïc gïnögø dëër nyaare ki køør kööŋ mare na nø kööŋe ki gø; 'ba eni, ena nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue møn ni kär nywømø. 'Ba gïnögø aput tïmö na kööŋŋö jï jø Icriel,
english: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,

anywaa: ni kany wø tïme na yi cwiir cooth, da nïne aŋween mo nyïï jø Icriel wø puta ci kun parge wïthge ki gïna tïïc nyi Jeptha, ni beeye Jeptha nyï Gelät.
english: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Ipariem rege adwalge kiper leny, ni ŋutge løøga ni cige pääny mana cwøl ni Capön, ni köge jï Jeptha, na «?Aŋø, aperŋø na pööthï kuna këëdï ki jø Amön en, ni wa kärï cwølø, nee wa ciwa ki ïïni? 'Ba ennø, ødï waaŋwa bäätï.»
english: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.

anywaa: Køøre Jeptha aköö jïge, ni «Kar kaaca, aani ki jø leny 'moa wa ena bäät ŋaap mo teek ki jø Amön; 'ba kanya cwøla uuni, u kär öö ki man piemmu aani ceŋge.
english: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooda gø nou kär öö ki man piemmu aani, aani jwïëya aweta ni cøøa baŋ jø Amön ni këëtwa ki geni, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp ge cera. ?Aperŋø na ööu baŋa dïcäŋi en, nou këëdu ki aani?»
english: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the Lord delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeptha jø leny bëët mo jø Gelät adwale ni këëtge ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni ö jø leny mo jø Gelät ni böötge jø tuuŋ Ipariem. 'Ba tier leny beeye kiper mana kö jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni «?Wui jø Gelät, aŋø, këël na bëëdu yïthakic jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, u ba päny wøk ka ri tuuŋ Ipariem?»
english: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

anywaa: Køøre jø Gelät dhøk wäädhi mo Naam Jördan moa näk dïët ki ŋööm  jø tuuŋ Ipariem amakge. Kanyøgønø, aput tïmö ni kanyo ö ŋati man nø røk jøøa reeŋø ri jø tuuŋ Ipariem wø kööe, na «A ŋuta løøga,» jø leny mo jø Gelät wø köö jïgø, ni «?Ïïna nyï tuuŋ Ipariem?» Ni näk mo eni köö, ni «Jïra bäär,»
english: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

anywaa: jø Gelät wø köö jïre, ni «Kööï nø ni ‹Cibølät› », 'ba eni köö ni «Thibølät», kiper mana näk ba løny ki man cwøl gø na kare. Køøre jø Gelät nyï tuuŋ Ipariem makge maaø ni putge gø 'näk dhi waath Naam Jördan. 'Ba kar kaaca, jø tuuŋ Ipariem ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurriiø aput 'näk.
english: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeptha abëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri abïciel. Køøre Jeptha nyï Gelät athøw, ni koonyi yi pääny aciel røk päänye mo Gelät.
english: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba Ibïcan nyï Bethelem abëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel kanya tïme na køør Jeptha.
english: And after him Ibzan of Beth–lehem judged Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Ibïcan jïre da wääte ma pïëradäk ki nyïïe ma pïëradäk; ni tïïc nyïïe nee nywøm wøk; ni ö eni ni känne ki nyïïakuue ki wøk jï wääte. 'Ba ena bëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri abïriiø.
english: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.

anywaa: Køøre Ibïcan athøw ni koonyi yi Bethelem.
english: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth–lehem.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëlön nyï tuuŋ Dhebulan abëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel kanya tïme na køør Ibïcan; ni ö eni ni bëëde na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri apaar.
english: And after him Elon, a Zebulunite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.

anywaa: Køøre Ëlön nyï tuuŋ Dhebulan athøw ni koonyi Ayalön na en yi ŋööm Dhebulan.
english: And Elon the Zebulunite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

anywaa: 'Ba Abidön wär Ëlël nyï Pirathön abëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel kanya tïme na køør Ëlön.
english: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Abïdön jïre da wääte ma pïëraŋween ki nyïïkwaaye ma pïëradäk, ni ge wø cäädhi ka bäät arëëni ma pïërabïriiø. Ni ö eni ni bëëde na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri abära.
english: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

anywaa: Køøre Abidön wär Ëlël nyï Piratön athøw ni koonyi Pirathön yi ŋööm Ipariem na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø Amalëk.
english: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäŋ tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp geni ceŋ jø Pilitin ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the Lord; and the Lord delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør ma nyï Dhöra mo käla ri jø tuuŋ Daan mo nyeŋŋe Manöa; 'ba cïïe beeye dhaagø ma bwøc ni bäŋ obwöre mo ee nywølø.
english: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe kaamar nyïïatwiel maal jï nyijøøgø ni kööe jïgø, «Neenï, ïïni, ïïna dhaagø ma bwøc mo bäŋ obwöre mo iï nywølø; 'ba ïïno jïti ki dhaanhø ni lwaarï ki gø na dïcwøø.
english: And the angel of the Lord appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gwøk riï ni ba mädhï ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala teeŋ køøŋø mør, ni ba cämï ki gïïa no ocaanø ni ba waany.
english: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, ïïno jïti ki dhaanhø ni lwaarï ki gø na dïcwøø; 'ba eni wïïe bäŋ doo lielø, kiper nyilaal manøgø otïmö na ŋat Nadhir no ocïp kur keere jï Jwøk ki mano täge ni ena ec; 'ba eno tägi ki man piem jø Icriel ceŋ jø Pilitin.»
english: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aöö ni caan luummögø jï cwøre, ni kööe, ni «Da dhaanhø ma dhaanh Jwøk mo ree ee nyoodhø jïra, mo bëëtö mare caala nyïïatwiel maal mar Jwøk, ni di lwäyö ki eni. 'Ba kanya käl yie kära pëënynyö, këël nyeŋŋe thuwø käre caanø jïra.
english: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïra, ni ‹Neenï, ïïno jïti ki dhaanhø ni lwaarï ki gø na dïcwøø; 'ba ennø, kärï mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala teeŋ køøŋø mør, ni ba cämï ki gïïa no ocaanø ni ba waany, kiper nyilaal manøgø otïmö na ŋat Nadhir no ocïp kur keere jï Jwøk ki mano täge ni ena ec këël aŋuun thøø mare.› »
english: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.

anywaa: Køøre Manöa Wuuö Jwøk akwaae ni kööe, ni «Wui Kwäärö, a kwaya ïïni,  beerra man ö dhaanhnhï na kwøŋï jääŋŋö, ni cäŋï gø jääŋŋö baŋwa nee wa pwönynye ki gïna dewa tïïö kiper nyilaal mano jootwa noo lwaarø ki gø.»
english: Then Manoah entreated the Lord, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk dwør Manöa aleŋe; ni ö Jwøki na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal ni cäŋ ree nyoothø jï nyijøøgø kanya bëëde ni eno pï piny yi pwödhö; 'ba Manöa cø nyijøøgø poot tøørø buute.
english: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyijøøgø alaar reeŋø ni caan gø jï cwøre ni kööe jïgø, ni «Neenï, ŋata cäŋa öö na nyooth ree jïra, ree acäŋ nyoothø jïra ennø.»
english: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

anywaa: Køøre Manöa aput päny maal ni cäädhe køør cïïe; 'ba kanya pïïe baŋ ŋatøgø ena köö jïgø, ni «?Beeye ï ŋata cäänö ki nyijøøi?» Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Beeye aani.»
english: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Manöa aköö, ni «Ennø, kanyo tïm luupï moa carï ni thura karge, ?agïnaŋø noo bëëdö na ciik kiper bëëtö mar nyilaal manøgø? ?A teeŋ tïïc mo nyïëdi noo tïïe?»
english: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aköö jï Manöa, ni «Beerra man ö nyijøøgø ni këël wïïe ri luup bëët moa caana.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

anywaa: Eni ba doo mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala teeŋ køøŋø mør, ni ba cäme ki gïn mo käla ri jaadhøgø, ni ba cäme ki gïïa no ocaanø ni ba waany. 'Ba beerra man ö nyijøøgø ni gwøk jammi bëët moa köömma eni ki ge.»
english: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

anywaa: Køøre Manöa aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal, ni «Wa kwaya ïïni, beerra man bëëdï dïturu nee nyidiel jiiŋwa na cam jïrï.»
english: And Manoah said unto the angel of the Lord, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aköö jï Manöa, «A këël doo bëëdö dïturu, aani cam marï ba daa camø, 'ba ni näk miï jiiŋŋa gø, jiiŋŋï no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre, ni cïpï gø jï Wuuö Jwøk.» 'Ba kuc Manöa ni manøgø beeye Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the Lord. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Manöa aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal, ni «?Nyeŋŋï aŋa? Kiper kanyo tïm luupï moa carï ni thura karge niï wøørwa.»
english: And Manoah said unto the angel of the Lord, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø ni pëënynyï nyeŋŋa en? Kiper tiere ba maar joot.»
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Manöa nyidiel ki muuy mar beel aput lwør ni cïp geni no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk bäät kïdi mana en kaace, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal ni put tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec ni nëënö jï Manöa ki cïïe.
english: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the Lord: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

anywaa: Kiper kanya tïme ni leep maac cäätha maal ki bäät kïnna cïp olämi bääte, Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal aput tïmö ni cäätha maal ni ena dï maac manøgø. 'Ba kanya ö Manöa ki cïïe na jootge gïnögø, rege aputge leeŋ piny ni kuulge wïthge piny.
english: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the Lord ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal ree käre cäŋ nyoothø këët jï Manöa ki cïïe. Køøre Manöa aput ŋäc møn ni manøgø beeye Wuuö Jwøk na nyooth ree kaamar nyïïatwiel maal.
english: But the angel of the Lord did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Manöa aköö jï cïïe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ø thøw ennø, kiper Jwøk anø neenø.»
english: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.

anywaa: 'Ba cïïe aköö jïgø, ni «Doo na Wuuö Jwøk manynya gø nee ø nääe, eni olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ki muuy mar beel na cïbø ba dee jïëö, ni eni thuwø gïï bëët ii ba dee nyøthø jïëö, këël eni ø ba dee tïïö nee luup moi ii wïnynyö kar kany ennø.»
english: But his wife said unto him, If the Lord were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø alwaar ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Camcøn; ni ö nyilaalli manøgø ni døøŋŋe ni bëëdö ni eno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the Lord blessed him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk atägö ki man tïïe ri Camcøn yi twïër jø tuuŋ Daan, na en yïthakic mïëri moa cøøri ni Dhöra ki Ëctaöl.
english: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aci pääny mana cwøl ni Temna ni joot dhaagø mør  Timna ma nyi jø Pilitin.
english: And Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aduu paac ni caan gø jï wänni ki menni, ni kööe, ni «Aani dhaagø mør ma nyi jø Pilitin ajooda Temna; ennø, a manynya gø nee nywømmu jïra na dhaagø.»
english: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnah of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba wänni ki menni aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ dhaagø dï nyïï tuuŋu wala dï jø pøø, ni kööï niï nyöömmö ki dhaagø ri jø Pilitin moi ni kär daŋø ii?» 'Ba Camcøn aköö jï wänni, ni «Nywømï jïra, kiper dhaagø manøgø nëëni ni mïërö ki jïra.»
english: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

anywaa: 'Ba wänni ki menni kucge ni Wuuö Jwøk nut ri luummögø, ni da gïn mo manynye manynyø nee tïïe dëët jø Pilitin. Kiper kar kaaca, jø Icriel bëënna jø Pilitin.
english: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the Lord, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aci Temna ni eni aay ka wänni ki menni, ni pïïcge pwöth omøki mo jø Temna; ni ö cïgïï ŋuu ni put rïŋ baŋ gø ni märö.
english: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnah, and came to the vineyards of Timnah: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Camcøn ni teek døc, ni ö Camcønni ni put ŋuu pääö ki dï gø ni bäŋ gïrpiny cere, ka teeŋ man wø ö dhaanhe wø pää nyidiel ki dï gø. 'Ba Camcøn gïna tïïe käre caanø jï wänni ki menni.
english: And the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn acøø ni cääne ki dhaagø manøgø; 'ba dhaaŋŋøgø poot nëëni ni mïërö jïre.
english: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cäŋ Camcønni døø kuna nywøm dhaaŋŋøgø, ena gaa thääŋ jöö kuna raŋ dëër ŋuu mana nääe; 'ba kïc ajoode no otïïö ki maaw dëër ŋuu.
english: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

anywaa: Køøre ena cøø ni thööth maar kïc cere, ni cäädhe ni cämö waŋjöö. 'Ba kanya ö Camcønni na pïïe baŋ wänni ki menni, ena cïpö jïge ni camge gø; 'ba käre caanø jïge ni maar kïc thöödhe dëër ŋuu.
english: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

anywaa: Køøre wää Camcønni aci po dhaaŋŋøgø, ni ö Camcønni ni tïïe ka ajwöma kaace, kiper beeye teeŋ gïn mo tïïc wøpe tïïö cooth.
english: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na jootge Camcøn gena kännö ki jak ma tïëŋ ki eni ma pïëradäk nee bëëtge buute kaagø.
english: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aköö jï jagøgø, «Nee leer mør kany para jïïu; 'ba ni näk mo ŋeyu ŋiiø ni caannu tiere jïra na kare, ki yïth nïri na abïriiø na mo ajwöma ii, aani, a cïpö jïïu ka aleeŋŋe mo beyø ma pïëradäk, ka abïïe mo beyø ma pïëradäk mo wø røø dëël.
english: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ba løny jïïu ki man caannu tiere jïra, u cïpö jïra ka aleeŋŋe mo beyø ma pïëradäk, ka abïïe mo beyø ma pïëradäk mo wø røø dëël.» Køøre jagøgø aköö jïre, ni «Par leer marï, nee wïnywa nø.»
english: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Camcøn aköö jïge, ni «Orogwanynyaŋø, gïn mo di camø ajoot ri dïcämi, ni ö gïn mo ŋweethi ni joodi ro oteeø.» 'Ba kär løny jï jagøgø ki man ŋecge tier leer manøgø, këël mana tïm nïne na adäk.
english: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri ŋweer nïne, jagøgø gena köö jï cï Camcøn, ni «Many yi cwørï ka atade, kiper nee tier leer manøgø nee caane; ni näk ba tïïyï na enøgønø, ï waaŋwa waaŋø ki øt wäru bäre. ?Aŋø, wa cwøllu kaper nee wa twierru? ?Beeye per manøgø møn?»
english: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø cï Camcøn ajwöŋö dëër Camcøn ni kööe, ni «Ï män ki aani  cøøn, ï ba mëër ki aani; ïïni, leer anø ŋeyï jï jagøgø na jø powa yøø, ni kärï tier gø caanø jïra.» Køøre Camcøn aköö jïgø, ni «Neenï, këël wära ki mera kiree, tier leer manøgø kära caanø jïge. ?Aŋø, ocaana gø jïrï nidïï?»
english: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, dhaaŋŋøgø ajwöŋö dëër Camcøn ki nïra näk abïriiø na beet ajwöma. 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet nïne, Camcøn tier leer acaane jïgø, kiper mana ö dhaaŋŋøgø na cwaat yi gø døc. Køøre dhaaŋŋøgø tier leer aput caan jï jagøgø na jø poge yøø.
english: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet nïne ni cäŋ pätha piny, jø päänyögø aköö jï Camcøn, «?Aŋø, da gïn mo ŋweeth mo kaala maar kïc? ?A da gïn mo teek mo kaala ŋuu?» Køøre ena köö jï jagøgø, «Doo na cïïa käru tïïö kaamar nyi dhieŋ man wø purö ki gø, uuni, tier leer mara ba dou joodø.»
english: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Camcøn ni teek døc, ni put ci pääny jø Pilitin mana cwøl na Ackelön, ni nääe ki jiy ma pïëradäk røk jøøgø, ni put abïïkge gööny wøk dëëtge. Ni ööe ka abïïe moøgø, ni cïp geni jï jøøa caan tier leer. Ni put wëër døc, ni aae ni døø po wänni.
english: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.

anywaa: 'Ba cï Camcøn acïp jï lwömme aciel røk tïëŋge moa bëëdö buute kaagø.
english: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, kanya tïme ni kany wø kac beega cwøl ni cïndë, Camcøn aci kuna liim cïïe ni käädö ki nyidiel, ni kööe, ni «Aani, a cøøa baŋ dhaagø mara kar niine mare.» 'Ba wää cï Camcøn kär jïëy ki man ci Camcønni baŋ dhaagø manøgø.
english: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.

anywaa: Køøre wää dhaaŋŋøgø aköö, ni «Ki jïra cøøn ni ïïno männö ki nyaanøgø na bäre en; køøre aani, nyaanøgø acïba jï lwöbö marï nee ci jïre na dhaagø mare. ?Aŋø, coki na thiinh na käl køøre, ba pöödha eni ki mïërö ni kaala nyaanøgø? Ennø, a kwaya ïïni nee nyaana thiinh ci jïrï na kar nyaana dwøŋ.»
english: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camcøn aköö jï jøøa en kaagø, ni «Ki mano täge ennø, ni näk da gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö dëët jø Pilitin, kär dee ŋat mo jääla aani.»
english: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aput aay ni määe ko orude ma dïpe adäk, ni løøŋ orude ni jïp man nø di kuurö ki jïp maya ni tööc ge no oriewi riewi; ni tïïe ka ameethi, ni twöa ameeth aciel man nø dïër yïthakic jïpi ariiø.
english: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø nyep ameethi ki maac, orude aput wëëk ciin yïth beek jø Pilitin moa näk poot cuŋŋö, ni ö beelli moa no otööyö na ŋaaŋe, ki beel moa näk poot cuŋŋö ni put ge waaŋ bëët; këël omøki ki jer wø nyïïge wel na mädhi aput waaŋ thuwø.
english: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin aköö, na «?Aŋa na tïïc gïn en?» Ni caani jïge, ni «Beeye Camcøn cø nyi nyena käl ri jø Temna, kiper nyenøgø nyaare na no onywøm Camcønni acïbe na dhaagø jï nyen ma lwöm Camcøn.» Kanyøgønø, jø Pilitin aput ö maal ni cige, ni putge nyaanøgø ki wänni rup ki maac.
english: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aköö jï jøøgø, ni «Kiper gïnögø anø tïïyu ennø, ka adïëri møn, kwör coola coolø dëëtu; 'ba køør manøgø, bäŋ gïn mør këët nø.»
english: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.

anywaa: Ni ö Camcønni ni put jøøgø 'näk ni ee caarø, ni thøw jiyi mo thööth ki thøø mo leth døc; ni put aay ni bëëde yi øt kïdi mo ena bäät kïn päänya cwøl ni Ëtam.
english: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin aci baŋ jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni tïïcge twïër marge po jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni ö jø Pilitinni ni putge nibay dï Lëëi.
english: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda aköö jï jø Pilitin, na «?Aperŋø na ööu baŋwa nou këëdu ki waani en?»  Ni kö jø Pilitinni, ni «Waani, waana öö nee Camcøn twöcwa, nee teeŋ gïna tïïe dëëtwa tïïcwa dëëre thuwø.»
english: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Juuda ma kume adäk aay ni pïïcge øt kïdi mana en bäät kïn päänya cwøl ni Ëtam, ni köge jï Camcøn, na «?Aŋø, kuyï ni ø bëënna jø Pilitin? ?Aŋø nø na tïïyï teeŋ gïn dëëtwa en?» Ni kö Camcønni jïge, ni «Teeŋ gïna nø tïïcge dëëra beeye na tïïa dëëtge thuwø enø.»
english: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jïgø, ni «Waana öö niï twöcwa, niï cïpwa ceŋ jø Pilitin.» 'Ba Camcøn aköö jïge, ni «Kööŋŋu nee ŋääa ki man näk uuni ki dëëtu a ba 'nägu.»
english: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø aköö jïgø, ni «Jïre bäär, waani, ï twöcwa twöö døc møn, ni cïpwa ïïni ceŋ jø Pilitin; 'ba ka adïëri møn, ï ba 'näkwa.» Køøre ena putge twöc ki thøøli ariiø mo poot nyärö, ni kälge eni wøk ki yi øt kïdi.
english: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Camcønni Lëëi, jø Pilitin aput kwöŋŋö ni yïthge met, ni cääthge baŋe nee røømge ki eni. 'Ba Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Camcøn ni teek døc, ni ö thøøli moa näk ceŋŋe otwöö ki geni ni putge cöötö kaamar thøør waarø mo owaaŋ maaci, ni ö thøøli moa twöc eni ki geni ni putge päth piny ceŋŋe.
english: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the Lord came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.

anywaa: Ni jïte ki lëëm arëën, ni beeye lëëmmö mo poot nyään, ni kwany gø, ni ö jiyi mo jïtö ki kar kuma ni put geni 'näk ki lëëm arëën manøgø.
english: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aköö, «Aani jiy mo jïtö ki kar kuma, anääa ki lëëm arëën; gena nääa ki lëëm arëën møn, ni ö dëët jiy moa thøw ni tïmge na athwöe, ni beege athwöe ariiø.»
english: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø lønye ki cäänö, lëëm arëën mana en cere aput leeŋ piny, ni cak nyeŋ kaace ni Ramat-Lëëi, na näk tiere beeye thuur lëëmmö.
english: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramath–lehi.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn anäk riewi døc, ni jwöŋe dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Ïïni, pïëm man ni dwøŋ en man piema jø powa ki gø, anø cïbï cera, a na laŋŋø marï en. ?Aŋø, a thøw ki riew møn ennø, nee tïme naa pätha ceŋ jøøi ni kär daŋø ii?»
english: And he was sore athirst, and called on the Lord, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jwøk kany ma aguul kïdi mo ena Lëëi kaace aput cööt, ni ö pïïyi ni putge ö wøk ki yie kaagø. 'Ba kanya ö Camcønni na mäthe ki pïï, jwïëye aput duuö, ni døø dëëre kare ni teek. Kiper manøgønø, Camcøn nyeŋ jøøro manøgø aput cak na Ayn- Akörë, na näk tiere beeye jøøro mar ŋata cwödö, ni jøøro manøgø poot nut Lëëi kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof En–hakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camcøn abëëdö na pïëmi mar jø Icriel ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø yïth nïra bëët jø Pilitinni ni jø Icriel ena ceŋge.
english: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aci Geedha ni jïte ki dhaagø ma kääbi kaace, ni ci baŋ gø na dhaagø.
english: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï jø Geedha, na købi, ni «Camcøn anø ö kany,» geni deŋ kaagø bäre aputge mar, ni koorge eni ki dïwäänögø bäre ni geno pï piny dhi kiir mar päänyögø. Ni putge bëëtö ni geno nikïïl ki dïwäänögø bäre, ni köge, ni «Putø eni koor këël mano ö tiet øwi, køøre nø, eno putø näk.»
english: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aput but buut dhaagø manøgø këël kanya tïm pinynyi na dhöör dïwäär; 'ba ki dhöör dïwäänögø ena päny maal ni cøøe ni mak odhuulu mar dhi kiir mar päänyögø, ni ö cööthe mo odhuulu na näk ariiø ni put ge puth wøk, ni puth wøk na aciel ka dïdëët bëët; køøre aput tïŋ göönne ni käär gø këël mana kïth gø wï kïdi mana näk dïët ki Keeprön.
english: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgø, Camcøn atïmö ni mëër ki dhaagø mør mo nyeŋŋe Delila mo bëëdö goor Cörëëk.
english: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.

anywaa: Køøre kwääri mo jø Pilitin aö baŋ nyaanøgø, ni köge jïgø, ni «Many yie ka atade, ni  jootï teek mare manøgø ni dwøŋ enø ki man näk mo tiere käl kaa ŋø, këël jöö man böötwa teek mare ki gø, nee tïme ni løny jïwa ki man twöcwa eni ni caarwa gø. Køøre nø, ŋati man nø dëëtwa cïpö jïrï ki gwet-bïrö ma dïpe apaar kurciel.»
english: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Delila aköö jï Camcøn, «A kwaya ïïni, caan teek marï manøgø ni dwøŋ enø jïra, ki man näk mo tiere käl kaa ŋø, ni caanï jöö mo løny ki man twöc ïïni ki gø niï caari.»
english: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aköö jï nyaanøgø, «Ni näk maa ege twöö ki kaae abïriiø mo poot thec mo kär tal, aani, a tïmö naa jääk, ni tïma kaamar jiy møga jaak.»
english: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

anywaa: Køøre kwääri mo jø Pilitin akännö jï nyaanøgø ki kaae abïriiø mo poot thec mo kär tal, ni ö nyaanøgø ni twöc Camcøn ki kaae moøgø.
english: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaanøgø da jiy mo ee kanø thääŋ øtø maya, mo bëëdö ni ge kurö kaace. Køøre ena köö jï Camcøn, «Wui Camcøn, jø Pilitin aö baŋï.» 'Ba Camcøn kaae moøgø aput cöötö jaak, ni putge tïmö kaamar thøør waarø mo ogut maaci. Kanyøgønø, teek mare kanya käl yie kär joodø këët.
english: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.

anywaa: Køøre Delila aköö jï Camcøn, ni «Neenï, aana nø cøøgï ni cäänï ki tööt. Ennø, akwaya ïïni, caanï jïra; ?gïn mo løny ki man twöc ïïni ki gø agïnaŋø?»
english: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn aköö jï nyaanøgø, «Ni näk maa ege twöö ki thøøli mo poot nyärö mo bäŋ gïn mo otïïö ki ge, aani, a tïmö naa jääk, ni tïma kaamar jiy møga jaak.»
english: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Delila thøøli mo poot nyärö alwøre ni twöc Camcøn ki ge. Køøre ena köö jï Camcøn, «Wui Camcøn, jø Pilitin aö baŋï.» 'Ba kar kaagø, jiy opï piny ni ge kurö thääŋ øtø maya. 'Ba Camcøn thøøli moøgø aput cöötö ni jööt jaak ceŋŋe ni caala waarø.
english: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.

anywaa: Køøre Delila aköö jï Camcøn, ni «Këël kar kany ennø, ï bëëdö niï cøøga aani, niï cara tööt. Ennø, caanï jïra; ?gïn mo løny ki man twöc ïïni ki gø agïnaŋø?» 'Ba ena köö jï nyaanøgø, «Ni näk mo jïëya moi no odwøø na abïriiø ii, iï kuurö ki waare mo teek, ni cwääï jïër moøgø røk teegi mo wø cwää abïïe rege ni iï nyiiŋø ni teek, aani a tïmö naa jääk, ni tïma kaamar jiy møga jaak.»
english: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camcøn abutö, ni ö Delila ni cwääc jïëc Camcøn na näk odwøø na abïriiø ni ee kuurö ki waare mo teek, ni cwää jïër moøgø røk teegi mo wø cwää abïïe rege ni ee nyiiŋø ni teek; ni kööe jïgø, «Wui Camcøn, jø Pilitin aö baŋï.» 'Ba Camcøn aput pääö, ni ö gïn wø cwäc dëëre ka abïï, këël teegi ki gïr nyiiŋ ni put gø puth wøk na aciel.
english: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.

anywaa: Køøre Delila aköö jï Camcøn, «?Ï kööï kiper ŋø, niï mëër ki aani, ni ïïni ki dëërï kiree cwïnyï tøør baŋa? Kiper ïïni, aana nø cøøgï kwöre moi na adäk ii, ni bäŋ gïn mo iï caanø jïra ki man näk mo teek marï en kaa ŋø.»
english: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.

anywaa: 'Ba Delila yi Camcøn aput cwaat døc, ni put gø ööl ki luup mo wø care ki yïth nïne cooth, ni ööl Camcønni døc ka acaara këël mana tïme ni manynya thøø.
english: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camcøn gïïa en cwïnye bëët aput caan jï Delila, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wïïa poot kär lielø na bäre en, kiper aani, aana ŋat Nadhir ni aano cïp kur keera jï Jwøk ki mana täge naa ena yi mera. 'Ba ni näk mo wïïa olielø, teek mara puta aay dëëra, ni tïma naa jääk, ni tïma kaamar jiy møga jaak.»
english: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Delila ni Camcøn gïïa en cwïnye bëët ee nø caan jïre, ena jäägö ki dwøl nee kwääri mo jø Pilitin öge, ni kööe, ni «Ööu yie man keere nø, kiper gïïa en cwïnye bëët anø caane jïra.» Køøre kwääri mo jø Pilitin aput ö baŋ Delila, ni gwel käärge käärö ki ceŋge.
english: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Delila Camcøn atïïe nee bute kööre, ni cwöte ki dhaanhø, ni ö ŋateca ni liel jïëc wï Camcøn na näk odwøø na abïriiø; ni put Delila tägö ki man tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëër Camcøn, ni ö teeki mar Camcøn ni put aay.
english: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Delila aköö, «Wui Camcøn, jø Pilitin aö baŋï.» Køøre Camcøn apäy ni kööe, ni «Aani, thøøli cööta cöötö kaawat man wø tïïa wø bëëde, naa dønynya wøk.» 'Ba kuc Camcønni ni Wuuö Jwøk dëëre ee nø paany buute.
english: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the Lord was departed from him.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin Camcøn aputge mak ni göölge nyeŋŋe wøk; ni aacge ki gø ni peege eni Geedha, ni twöcge gø ki tiimme mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël. Køøre ena put bëëtö øt twöc kaace ni mare guur ki caammi.
english: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.

anywaa: 'Ba jïëye na näk ogwäär wøk acäŋ tägö ki man tucge.
english: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

anywaa: Køøre kwääri mo jø Pilitin rege acooŋge ni cïpge ki lääy mo thööth no olämi jï jwøge ma Dagön, ni jïtge ki met ec, ni köge, ni «Jwøk marwa, Camcøn ŋata bëëdö na nyimän marwa acïp ceŋwa.»
english: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Pilitinni na jootge Camcøn, geni jwøge aputge pwøc, ni köge, ni «Jwøk marwa, ŋata bëëdö na nyimän marwa acïp ceŋwa; ni beeye ŋata raany powa, ŋata thöör jiy mo thööth dëëtwa ki thøø.»
english: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na tïm yïthge ni met, gena köö, ni «Camcøn cwøl nee ööe, nee kwääge ni døøc yïthø mo met.» Kanyøgønø, Camcøn aputge cwøl kanya en yie øt twöc, ni ö Camcønni ni put kwääk nyïmge kaagø. Køøre ena tïïcge nee cuŋŋe yïthakic were.
english: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn aköö jï nyena näk poot na wøp na piec eni, ni «Beerra man nyoothï were moa näk øtø cuŋŋi kaperge, nee guda, nee dëëra jääŋa ki geni.»
english: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, øtø päŋ ki jiy, ni beege cwøw ki mään bëët; këël kwääri mo jø Pilitin bëët ena kaagø. 'Ba da jiy møøk ma kume adäk, ni beege cwøw ki mään, mo ena bäät øtø maal, ni ge neeta Camcøn kanya kwääge ni tïïc yïthge ni met.
english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.

anywaa: Køøre Camcøn alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, par wïïï ki aani, ni tïïyï aani naa teek yie man keere nø. Wui Jwøk, køny aani nee kwör coola dëët jø Pilitin kiper nyeŋŋa karge riet na göölge wøk.»
english: And Samson called unto the Lord, and said, O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba Camcøn were moa näk ariiø na en dï øtø na näk øtø cuŋŋi kaperge, aput mak ni jääŋ dëëre ki geni, na aciel ee maaø ki cwïïe ni maya ee maaø ki caame.
english: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camcøn aköö, ni «Beerra man thøøa ki jø Pilitin na aciel.» Ni ö Camcønni ni put were moøgø thiel ki teek mare bäre, ni put øtø päth bäät kwääri ki jø Pilitin bëët moa en yi gø kaagø. 'Ba kanyøgø, jiy moa 'näk Camcønni ri thøwe atïmö ni thöötha geni døc ki jiy moa nääe kanya bëëde ni eni kwøw.
english: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïmenni ki tuuŋ wänni bëët, gena put öö ni lwørge dëër Camcøn, ni kälge gø ni koonyge gø yïthakic Dhöra ki Ëctaöl yi kään kïdi mar wänni ma Manöa. 'Ba beeye cwiiri ma pïërariiø na beet Camcønni ni ena pïëmi mar jø Icriel.
english: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør mo bëëdö mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Mikiya.
english: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

anywaa: Nyenøgø aköö jï menni, ni «Gwet-bïrö moa näk rumme ma dïpe apaar kurciel moa no okälö baŋï, na cïënï kiperge, niï cäänö ni wïnyö jïra, ka adïëri møn, gwet-bïrö moøgø ena baŋa; beeye aani na käl ge møn.» Køøre menni aköö, ni «Nyie wääda, ennø, ïïno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the Lord, my son.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Mikiya gwet-bïrö moøgø na rumme ma dïpe apaar kurciel yøø, adwøge jï menni. Køøre menni aköö, ni «Aani, gwel-bïrö man bäre en, cïba kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper wääda, nee tïïc na kït gïn mo otieŋø ki kït gïn mo leeny ka gwel-bïrö na gïï mo di lamø. 'Ba nyie wääda, ennø møn, aani gwelbïrö man duua duuö jïrï nø.»
english: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the Lord from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Mikiya na duu gwet-bïrö jï menni, menni alwötö ki gwet-bïrö ma yïth rumme ma dïpe ariiø, ni cïp ge jï ŋat wø thädhö ki gwel-bïrö, ni ö ŋatøgø ni tïïc ge na kït gïn mo otieŋø ki kït gïn mo oleenyø ki gwel-bïrö ni tïmge ni bëëdö øt Mikiya.
english: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø na Mikiya enø, jïre da øtø mo ee tïïö kiper juu mo wø wøøre, ni eno tïïö ki gïr lam mo cwøl ni ëëput, ki juugo cøøri na terapim; ni lwør wääde aciel røk wääte, ni cïp tïïc manøgø cere, kiper nee tïme na dïlämi mare.
english: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni, jø Icriel bëëdö ni bäŋ nyeya jïge; ni ŋati man nø bëëdö ni tïïya mana manynye na beer ki jïre.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør mo poot na wøp mo bëëdö Bethelem na en Juuda, ma tuuŋ ki jø Juuda, ma tuuŋ jø Libay; 'ba eni bëëdö Bethelem na wëëllö.
english: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyï tuuŋ Libay manøgø aay ni wec Bethelem na en Juuda, kiper nee bëëde kanyo jïte yie ki kar bëëtö jaak; 'ba kanya cäädhe, ena pïï mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni gaa po Mikiya.
english: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikiya aköö jï nyenøgø, ni «Ï kälï kaa ennø?» Køøre ena köö jï Mikiya, ni «Aana nyï tuuŋ Libay; 'ba ennø, a käla Bethelem na en Juuda, ni mara wääth jaak naa jïta ki kany bëëda yie.»
english: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.

anywaa: Køøre Mikiya aköö jïgø, ni «Bëëdï buuta kany, ni tïmï ni ïïna ŋat mo owøørø ni ïïna dïlämi kipera; køøre aani, a cïpö jïrï ki gwet-bïrö ma rumme apaar ki yi cwiir, ka abïïe, këël cam marï.» Kanyøgønø, nyï tuuŋ Libay aput pï piny.
english: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni jïëe ki man bëëde buut Mikiya, ni put eni tïmö jï Mikiya ni caala wääde aciel røk wääte.
english: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Mikiya nyï tuuŋ Libay alwøre ni cïp tïï lam cer gø, ni tïme na dïlämi kipere; ni ö nyenøgø ni put bëëtö po Mikiya.
english: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.

anywaa: Køøre Mikiya aköö, ni «Ennø, ŋääa ni Wuuö Jwøk tïïö ki gïn mo beer jïra, kiper mana nø jïta ki nyï tuuŋ Libay na dïlämi.»
english: Then said Micah, Now know I that the Lord will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni, jø Icriel bëëdö ni bäŋ nyeya jïge; ni kar kaaca, jø tuuŋ Daan määnyö ki ŋøøm mo dööŋ jïge na kurge kiper nee bëëtge yie, kiper këël kar kaaca, ŋöömö mana doo dööŋ jïge na kurge yïthakic wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel poot kär ci ceŋge.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø tuuŋ Daan ajäägö ki jiy abïïc, mo jierra røk kwään jø tuuŋge bëët, ni jøøgø beege jø leny moa teek mo ge käla Dhöra ki Ëctaöl, kiper nee jïtge ki ŋøøm ni marge lïëw thuwø. Køøre jø tuuŋ Daan aköö jï jagøgø, ni «Cou määnynyu ki ŋøøm.» Køøre gena aay ni pïïcge mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni gaage po Mikiya, ni putge but kaace.
english: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïmge ni karge cään ki po Mikiya, jø tuuŋ Daan moøgø dwør nyï tuuŋ Libay manø ni poot na wøp enø aŋecge; køøre gena gaa baŋ gø kaace ni köge jïgø, na «?Aŋa na käl ï kany? ?A agïnaŋø ni tïïyï kany? ?Ï bëënnï ŋø kany?»
english: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Mikiya da gïï mo ee tïïö kipera; a ee mooø ki tïïc ni tïma na aana dïlämi kipere.»
english: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jïre, «Beerra man pëënynyï Jwøk kiper jööro caathwa, ki man näk mo da gïn mo beer mo jootwa joodø, nee ŋäcwa.»
english: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.

anywaa: Ni ö nyenøgø na dïlämi enø ni løk gø jïge, no «U cäädhö ni dëëtu jööt; jööro caathu enø, onø jiiŋ Jwøki nyïmmu.»
english: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the Lord is your way wherein ye go.

anywaa: Køøre jagøgø na abïïc yøø atïŋŋö ki kaace, ni aacge ni pïïcge pääny Laaic, ni jootge jøøa bëëdö yie ni ge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper leny, ni ge bëëdö ka teeŋ bëët jø Caydan ni wø bëëdö ki bëët-mëër ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper leny; ni kwäärö marge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö dëëtge. 'Ba ge bëëdö ni karge bäyö ki jø Caydan, ni bäŋ gïn mo gääba geni ki jø møøk.
english: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Daan moa liew ŋøøm, kanya duuge baŋ tuuŋge moa en Dhöra ki Ëctaöl, gena pëëny tuuŋge ni köge, ni «?Bëëde nidïï nø? ?Da gïn maa jootu?»
english: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïge, ni «Ö maal nø, waa cøø baŋge nøø këëdø ki geni, kiper ŋøøpge ajootwa; 'ba ka adïëri møn, beeye ŋöömö mo beer døc. ?Aŋø, u poot bëëdö ni uuno pï piny jaak? Käru ruu ki man cou yie kun mayu ŋöömmögø.
english: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo cou, u pïï baŋ jiy mo bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper leny, mo jïge da ŋöömö mo päl; 'ba Jwøk, ŋöömmögø ee nø cïp ceŋŋu, ni beeye kany mo bäŋ gïn tøør yie røk jammi bëët moa en bäät piny kany.»
english: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

anywaa: Køøre ki ri jø tuuŋ Daan, jø leny ma dïpe abïciel mo ceŋge da jap leny, gena tïŋŋö ki Dhöra ki Ëctaöl.
english: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

anywaa: Ni aacge ni tïïcge twïër marge buut Kiriat-Jeerim na en Juuda. Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaagø aput cwøl ni Twïër Jø Tuuŋ Daan këël dïcäŋi en; ni kaagø ena jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ki Kiriat-Jeerim.
english: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath–jearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh–dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath–jearim.

anywaa: Ni pööthge ki kaace ni cige mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni pïïcge po Mikiya.
english: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jøøa näk abïïc na kwøŋ ci kuna liew ŋööm Laaic aköö jï nyïïmëëkge, na «?Aŋø, ŋäyu ni røk uutögø, da øtø aciel mo yie da ëëput ki juuga cøøri na terapim, ki kït gïn mo otieŋø ki kït gïn mo oleenyø, ni beege gïï wø lam? Kiper manøgønø ennø, cädu kiper gïno tïïyu nø.»
english: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø na abïïc yøø, gena gaa kaace ni cige øt nyï tuuŋ Libay, nyena näk poot na wøp na en po Mikiya, ni määthge gø.
english: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Daan moa näk dïpe abïciel na näk ceŋge da jap leny, gena cuŋŋö dhi kal.
english: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa na abïïc na kwøŋ ci kuna liew ŋöömmögø, gena døny yi øtø ni kälge gïï wø lam, ni beege gïna no otieŋø na kït gïrpiny, ki ëëput, ki juuga cøøri na terapim, ki gïna no oleenyø na kït gïrpiny. 'Ba kar kanyøgø, dïlämi manøgø cuŋŋö dhi kal buut jø leny moa näk dïpe abïciel na näk ceŋge da jap leny.
english: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døny jøø na abïïc yøø yi øt Mikiya, na kälge gïna no otieŋø na kït gïrpiny, ki ëëput, ki juuga cøøri na terapim, ki gïna no oleenyø na kït gïrpiny, nyenø na dïlämi enø aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø ni tïïyu enø?»
english: And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?

anywaa: 'Ba jagøgø aköö jïgø, ni «Lïŋï, cïëk dhiï; ö baŋwa nøø aa na aciel, kiper niï tïmï ni ïïna ŋat mo owøørø ni ïïna dïlämi jïwa. ?Aŋø, theemma eni jïrï ki man bëëdï ni ïïna dïlämi jï dhaanhø aciel, wala ki man tïmï ni ïïna dïlämi jïwa, wa na wï tuuŋ aciel røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel ii?»
english: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, dïlämi manøgø yie aput tïmö ni met; køøre eni, ëëput ki juuga cøøri ni terapim ki kït gïna no otieŋø akäle, ni put aa dï jøøgø.
english: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Daan aput tïŋŋö ki kaace, ni mään moge ko obwöre, këël lääc paac ki gïïa perge leth bëët ege cöör nyïmge.
english: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya aacge na pïïcge kany mo bäär mëëth ki po Mikiya, jøøa en ya atut aciel ki Mikiya rege acwølge ni läpge køør jø tuuŋ Daan ni makge geni.
english: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.

anywaa: Køøre geni jø tuuŋ Daan arwaacge; ni ö jø tuuŋ Daan ni løkge nyïmge, ni köge jï Mikiya, «?Ï manynyï ŋø baŋwa, ni rïïŋu ni rou you dwalø en?»
english: And they cried unto the children of Dan. And they turned their faces, and said unto Micah, What aileth thee, that thou comest with such a company?

anywaa: Ni kö Mikiya, ni «Uuni, juu 'moa na tïïa, këël dïlämi mara, akällu ni aayu ki ge. ?Agïnaŋø nø na dööŋ jïra këët? ?Aŋø, u cäŋu köö jïra këët, ni ‹?Ï manynyï ŋø baŋwa?›?»
english: And he said, Ye have taken away my gods which I made, and the priest, and ye are gone away: and what have I more? and what is this that ye say unto me, What aileth thee?

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Daan aköö jï Mikiya, ni «Kär dwørï wïnywa këët nø; kanymør jøw mo cwïnyge keec, ïïni ki jø paarï bëët u 'näkge nääö.»
english: And the children of Dan said unto him, Let not thy voice be heard among us, lest angry fellows run upon thee, and thou lose thy life, with the lives of thy household.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø tuuŋ Daan aput aay ki wääthge na caathge; 'ba kanya ö Mikiya na joot jøøgø ni ge teek døc ni ba løny jïre, eni ree aløøe ni døø paare.
english: And the children of Dan went their way: and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him, he turned and went back unto his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö jø tuuŋ Daan na kälge gïïa no otïïc Mikiya, ki dïlämi mare mana en jïre, gena aay ni pïïcge pääny Laaic baŋ jøøa näk bëëdö ka bëët-mëër ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper leny. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Daan ni 'näkge jøøgø ko opëëlle; ni putge pääny mar jøøgø nyep.
english: And they took the things which Micah had made, and the priest which he had, and came unto Laish, unto a people that were at quiet and secure: and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and burnt the city with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo ö kuna køny jø päänyögø, kiper päänyögø kare bäär ki pääny jø Caydan, ni bäŋ gïn mo gääba geni ki jø møøk. 'Ba päänyögø na Laaic enøgø, ena piny yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö na en buut Bëëth-Reyap. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Daan ni cäŋge päänyögø geerrø ni bëëtge yi gø.
english: And there was no deliverer, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with any man; and it was in the valley that lieth by Beth–rehob. And they built a city, and dwelt therein.

anywaa: Ni cwølge nyeŋ päänyögø ni Daan ki køør nyeŋ kwarge ma Daan wär Icriel; 'ba nyeŋ päänyögø mana dïkwøŋ beeye Laaic.
english: And they called the name of the city Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born unto Israel: howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïkwaac jø tuuŋ Daan gïna no otieŋø acwöthge piny kiper dëëtge nee wø wøørge. 'Ba Jönathan nyikwaar Gërcöm, ni beeye Gërcöm o Modhe, eni, këël wääde ki nyïïkwaaye, aput bëëtö na dïlämme jï jø tuuŋ Daan këël dïcäŋa ö jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø bëët na maai ki tøŋ.
english: And the children of Dan set up the graven image: and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Manasseh, he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land.

anywaa: Køøre nø, kït gïna no otieŋø na näk tïïya Mikiya, aput bëëtö ni ege cwöth piny kiper dëëtge Daan kaagø, ki yïth nïne bëët moa bëëde ni Øt Jwøk ena Cëëlö.
english: And they set them up Micah's graven image, which he made, all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïra beet jø Icrielli ni bäŋ nyeya jïge, da nyen mør ma nyï tuuŋ Libay mo bëëdö na wëëllö paana en teegø na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem; ni nyenøgø jïre da dhaagø ma akwanya mo joode Bethelem na en Juuda.
english: And it came to pass in those days, when there was no king in Israel, that there was a certain Levite sojourning on the side of mount Ephraim, who took to him a concubine out of Beth–lehem–judah.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋøgø na akwanya enø, awëër ki nyenøgø, ni put aay ni døø po wänni yi Bethelem na en Juuda, ni put bëëtö kaace ki dwäde aŋween.
english: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Beth–lehem–judah, and was there four whole months.

anywaa: Køøre cwøre aö maal ni läp køøre nee cääne ki gø mëëth ki luup mo met, nee tïme ni løny ki man dwøk gø paare; 'ba nyenøgø cäädhi ka ŋat tïïc mare ka arëëni ariiø. 'Ba kanya pïïcge, nyaanøgø nyï tuuŋ Libay manøgø aput kïth po wänni; 'ba kanya ö wää nyaanøgø na joot nyenøgø, yie aput tïmö ni met, ni pänh gø døc.
english: And her husband arose, and went after her, to speak friendly unto her, and to bring her again, having his servant with him, and a couple of asses: and she brought him into her father's house: and when the father of the damsel saw him, he rejoiced to meet him.

anywaa: Ni ö wää cïïe ni put kar nyenøgø jiiŋŋø nee pï piny, ni put bëëtö buute kaagø ki nïne adäk, ni ge cämö ni ge mädhö, ni buude kaagø.
english: And his father in law, the damsel's father, retained him; and he abode with him three days: so they did eat and drink, and lodged there.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ŋweer nïne, gena päny maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni ö nyenøgø ni jiiŋ ree ki man tïŋŋe; ni kö wää nyaanøgø jï cø nyaare, ni «Cam mo thiinh en, camï nee dëërï neethïk; køøre nø ïïno tïŋŋi.»
english: And it came to pass on the fourth day, when they arose early in the morning, that he rose up to depart: and the damsel's father said unto his son in law, Comfort thine heart with a morsel of bread, and afterward go your way.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena pï piny karge riet, ni cämge ni mäthge. Køøre wää nyaanøgø aköö jï nyenøgø, ni «Aani, a kwaya ïïni niï cäŋï but kany dïwääni, ni bëëdï ni yiï met.»
english: And they sat down, and did eat and drink both of them together: for the damsel's father had said unto the man, Be content, I pray thee, and tarry all night, and let thine heart be merry.

anywaa: Køøre nyenøgø aö maal nee tïŋŋe, 'ba ena kwaac wää cïïe døc këël mana cäŋ but kaagø dïwäänögø.
english: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na bïï nïne, nyenøgø apäny maal nee tïŋŋe ka amöölla cøøn, ni kö wää nyaanøgø, ni «Aani, a kwaya ïïni, kïth dhiï ki gïn cam nee dëërï neethïk, ni kurï nee tïme niï tïŋŋï ki kur abøøya.» Ni ö geni karge riet ni putge cam jaak.
english: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart: and the damsel's father said, Comfort thine heart, I pray thee. And they tarried until afternoon, and they did eat both of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ wääthi, ni nyenøgø manynya tïŋŋö ki cïïe ki ŋat tïïc mare, wää cïïe aput köö jïgø, «Neenï, ennø, piny anø pöödhö; a kwaya ïïni ki man putï but kany wääni keere. Wui neenï, cäŋ oløny ni thiinh; put but kany wääni keere nø, ni bëëdï ni yiï met. Køøre nø,  diøø ïïno päny maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni aayï niï cøøa paarï.»
english: And when the man rose up to depart, he, and his concubine, and his servant, his father in law, the damsel's father, said unto him, Behold, now the day draweth toward evening, I pray you tarry all night: behold, the day groweth to an end, lodge here, that thine heart may be merry; and to morrow get you early on your way, that thou mayest go home.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø kär jïëy ki man cäŋ but kaagø, ni put ö maal ni tïŋŋe, ni pïïe kany mo dïët ki Jeebuc ni beeye Jerucalem. 'Ba arëëni moe na näk ariiø nutö ni käädö ko opïri; këël cïïe nut ni cäädhi ka eni na aciel.
english: But the man would not tarry that night, but he rose up and departed, and came over against Jebus, which is Jerusalem; and there were with him two asses saddled, his concubine also was with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm karge ni cään ki Jeebuc, piny onø pöödhö kiree; ni kö ŋat tïïc mar nyenøgø jïgø, «A kwaya ïïni, beerra man gaaø pääny jø Jeebuc nee ø butø yie kaace.»
english: And when they were by Jebus, the day was far spent; and the servant said unto his master, Come, I pray thee, and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites, and lodge in it.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø aköö jï ŋat tïïc manøgø, ni «Øøni, ø ba gaa pääny juurre møøk jaak mo paa jø Icriel. Øøni, ø puta wääth këël mano pïïø Giba.»
english: And his master said unto him, We will not turn aside hither into the city of a stranger, that is not of the children of Israel; we will pass over to Gibeah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ köö jï ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Ö maaø røø, nee ø pïïø Giba wala Reema, nøø jïtø ki paac aciel mo butø yie røk mïëri moøgø.»
english: And he said unto his servant, Come, and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night, in Gibeah, or in Ramah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena put pöödhö ni cääthge, ni ö cäŋŋi ni put pädhö bäätge kanya enge buut Giba na en kur jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And they passed on and went their way; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah, which belongeth to Benjamin.

anywaa: Ni öge ni putge gaa Giba, ni dønyge yi kiir nee butge kaagø. 'Ba kanya dønyge yi kiir, gena put pï piny bura mar pääny manøgø ni bëëtge jaak, kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo ö baŋge nee ge käle ki man butge paare.
english: And they turned aside thither, to go in and to lodge in Gibeah: and when he went in, he sat him down in a street of the city: for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging.

anywaa: Køøre nø, dhaanhø ma jaal mo käla yi pwödhö baŋ tïïc aöö ni piny oløny no ojïl. 'Ba ŋatøgø poge ena mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem; 'ba eni bëëdö na wëëllö Giba kar kaagø, ni jøøa bëëdö paanøgø beege jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And, behold, there came an old man from his work out of the field at even, which was also of mount Ephraim; and he sojourned in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jaal manøgø na lwïthe, jøøa näk käla jöö ajoode no opï piny bura mar pääny kaagø, ni kööe, «?Uuno käla kaa ŋø? ?U cou kaa ennø?»
english: And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

anywaa: Køøre nyenøgø aköö jï jaal manøgø, ni «Waani, wa käla Bethelem na en Juuda, ni wa cøøa paana en teegø na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem; kiper aani, a käla kunece; 'ba aana aay ni cøøa Bethelem na en Juuda. 'Ba ennø, mara beeye døøn paara. 'Ba kanya pïïa kany, bäŋ ŋat mo oö baŋa naa kïth paare.
english: And he said unto him, We are passing from Beth–lehem–judah toward the side of mount Ephraim; from thence am I: and I went to Beth–lehem–judah, but I am now going to the house of the Lord; and there is no man that receiveth me to house.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, jïwa da luum ki cam mar lääy mo orømø kiper arëëni mowa. Aani thuwø da cam ki køøŋø mo orømø kipera, këël kiper nyaanøgø na cïïa enø ki ŋat tïïc manøgø ni buutwa enø; waani bäŋ gïn mo canwa.»
english: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses; and there is bread and wine also for me, and for thy handmaid, and for the young man which is with thy servants: there is no want of any thing.

anywaa: Køøre jaal manøgø aköö, ni «Cïbu cwïnynyu piny. Ennø, gïno manynyu jaak tïïa tïïö jïïu. Uuni, u ba but bura kany.»
english: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jaal manøgø jøøgø aput kïth paare, ni mooc arëëni ki gïï wø cam lääyi, ni ö jøøgø ni lwøkge tietge ni cämge ni mäthge.
english: So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni jøøgø bëëdö ni yïthge met, cwøw mo päänyögø, ni beege jiy moa wïthge reyø, gena put öö ni marge øtø ni pöötge dhi øtø; ni cäänge ki jaara dwøŋ na näk wää paaci ni köge, ni «Nyena ö paarï kany käl wøk nee wa butwa ki gø.»
english: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.

anywaa: Køøre jaarøgø na wää paaci enø, aci wøk baŋge ni kööe jïge, ni «Nyie jaay nyïïmera, a kwaya uuni nee gïnø ni raac enø nee ba tïïyu. Nyenøgø anø ö paara møn; 'ba kär nou tïïya teeŋ gïnögø ni raac ni määnö ki man tïïi enø.
english: And the man, the master of the house, went out unto them, and said unto them, Nay, my brethren, nay, I pray you, do not so wickedly; seeing that this man is come into mine house, do not this folly.

anywaa: Neennu, nyaara mo dëëre poot kuc dïcwøø, ki cï nyenøgø, ge nutö. A kwaya uuni nee ge käla wøk baŋu nou cou baŋge na mään, ni tïïyu gïna manynyu ki ge jaak. 'Ba kär teeŋ gïnögø ni raac ni määnö enø tïïyu dëër nyenøgø.»
english: Behold, here is my daughter a maiden, and his concubine; them I will bring out now, and humble ye them, and do with them what seemeth good unto you: but unto this man do not so vile a thing.

anywaa: 'Ba jagøgø yïthge kärge kam cek ki dwør jaarøgø, ni ö dhaaŋŋa näk akwanya ni käli wøk ni cïbi jï jøøgø. Ni ö jagøgø ni putge nyaanøgø gøyø ki piny ni raanyge gø ki dïwäär bäre këël mana tïm pinynyi na amöölla. Køøre kanya tïm tiet øwi ni tuulö, ena wecge nee aae.
english: But the men would not hearken to him: so the man took his concubine, and brought her forth unto them; and they knew her, and abused her all the night until the morning: and when the day began to spring, they let her go.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm pinynyi na amöölla nyaanøgø aöö ni put pädhö dhi øt jaarøgø kanya en cwøre yie, ni bëëde no opädhö kaace këël mana tuul cäŋŋi.
english: Then came the woman in the dawning of the day, and fell down at the door of the man's house where her lord was, till it was light.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päny cø nyaanøgø maal ka amöölla, na jap dhi øtø nee døny wøk ni manynya man tïŋŋe nø, ka adïëri møn, cïïe aput joot dhi øtø no opädhö ni ceŋŋe ee rum bäät thudhi mana en dhi øtø.
english: And her lord rose up in the morning, and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way: and, behold, the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house, and her hands were upon the threshold.

anywaa: Køøre nyenøgø aköö jï cïïe, ni «Ö maal nøø aaø nø.» 'Ba bäŋ dwøl mo odwøk nyaanøgø, kiper eno nø thøø. Kanyøgønø, nyaanøgø aput kwany ni kïth gø bäät arëën; ni put tïŋŋö ni cøøa paare.
english: And he said unto her, Up, and let us be going. But none answered. Then the man took her up upon an ass, and the man rose up, and gat him unto his place.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe paare, ena døny yi øtø ni lwør caakïïn ni lwør dëër cïïe ni ŋøør gø na kwöre apaar kurriiø, ni ŋøøre ka nyeŋ cuu, ni ö kwöra ŋøøri yøø ni put gø jääŋŋö dï Icriel bäre.
english: And when he was come into his house, he took a knife, and laid hold on his concubine, and divided her, together with her bones, into twelve pieces, and sent her into all the coasts of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø jiy moa jääŋŋe aköömme ni kööe jïge, ni «Wäru kööu jï ŋat Icriel man nø, na ‹?Aŋø, teeŋ gïn ma ennø, dagø mo otägö cøøn, ki mana ö jø Icrielli wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep këël dïcäŋi en? Cädu bääte, ni kuurru dhøgu, ni caannu maru.› » 'Ba kar kaaca, jiy bëët moa joot gïnögø ge puta köö, ni «Bäŋ teeŋ gïn mo caala manøgø mo okwøŋ tägö na bäre bäre.»
english: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët aö wøk ki kwöra enge yïthge, ni beeye ki mana täge ki Daan na en wï-piny këël mana këët Bëërcïïba na en tier-piny, ni rwöpa ŋööm Gelät bäre na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni ö lwaaki ni dwalge rege ni tïmge kaamar dhaanhø aciel nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kanya cwøl ni Micpa.
english: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaae mo jiy bëët, moa käl wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, gena cuŋŋö nyïm lwaa jic Jwøk ma kume ma pïëraŋween, ni beege jø leny mo wø cäädhi ni këëdi ka piny, mo ceŋge da jap leny.
english: And the chief of all the people, even of all the tribes of Israel, presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamen ni wïnyge gø ni jø Icriel rege ege nø dwal Micpa. 'Ba jø Icriel dëëtge apëënyge ni köge, ni «Caannu jïwa ki man näk gïn ni raac en otägö nidïï.»
english: (Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah.) Then said the children of Israel, Tell us, how was this wickedness?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aløk nyï tuuŋ Libay, cø nyaana no onääö, ni kööe, ni «Aana öö ki cïïa nee wa butwa Giba na en kur jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And the Levite, the husband of the woman that was slain, answered and said, I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin, I and my concubine, to lodge.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Giba aö maal bääta ni putge deŋ øtø mar ki wäär kipera, ni ge manynya man 'näkge aani na bëëde; køøre cïïa aputge raanynyø, këël mana put thøø.
english: And the men of Gibeah rose against me, and beset the house round about upon me by night, and thought to have slain me: and my concubine have they forced, that she is dead.

anywaa: Køøre aani, dëër cïïa alwøra ni ŋøra gø na thäŋi, ni jääŋŋa thäŋi moøgø dï Icriel bäre kwöra bëët jø Icrielli yïthge na no odööŋ jïge na kurge, kiper mana ö jø Giba na tïïcge gïn mo raac mo määnö dï Icriel.
english: And I took my concubine, and cut her in pieces, and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel: for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel.

anywaa: Ennø, u jø Icriel, cïpu acaare mou ni cäänu bääte kany ennø.»
english: Behold, ye are all children of Israel; give here your advice and counsel.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët aput ö maal ki dhøk aciel ni köge, ni «Ennø, bäŋ ŋat mo døø poge rewa këët, këël ŋat mo døø paare, bäŋgø thuwø.
english: And all the people arose as one man, saying, We will not any of us go to his tent, neither will we any of us turn into his house.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, man beeye gïno tïïø dëët jø Giba; ø cøøa baŋge nøø këëdö ki geni ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw mano nyooth Jwøki.
english: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, ø doo kwänyö ki jiy møøk, ni kanyo kwanyø jiy moøgø, ni näk mo jiy ma dïpa, jiy apaar døø lwørø; wala ni näk jiy ma kuma, jiy ma dïpa døø lwørø; wala ni näk mo jiy ma kume apaar, jiy ma kuma døø lwørø; ni jøøgø kwanyø røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, nee tïmge ni käära caammi kiper jø leny, nee jø leny pïïcge Giba na en kur jø tuuŋ Benjamen, nee tïme ni løny jïge ki man tïïcge gïna dige tïïö dëët jø Giba, kiper gïna raac na määnö na tïïcge dï jø Icriel.»
english: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel, and an hundred of a thousand, and a thousand out of ten thousand, to fetch victual for the people, that they may do, when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin, according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët rege adwalge nee ge këëtge ki jø Giba, ni dëëtge ege kuurö ni tïmge kaamar dhaanhø aciel.
english: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.

anywaa: Køøre jø wïth tuŋi mo Icriel ajäägö ki jiy baŋ jø tuuŋ Benjamen bëët, ni köge, «?Aŋø, a teeŋ gïnaŋø ni raac na tägö dïïu en?
english: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin, saying, What wickedness is this that is done among you?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jøø ni wïthge reyø ni bëëdö Giba yøø, cïbu ceŋwa, nee ge 'näkwa, kiper gïn ni raac en nee raanywa dï Icriel.» 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen dööt nyïïmëëkge ma jø Icriel kärge kam leŋ.
english: Now therefore deliver us the men, the children of Belial, which are in Gibeah, that we may put them to death, and put away evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel:

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa en yïth päänye bëët rege acooŋge Giba, kiper nee ge aage wøk baŋ leny ki jø Icriel.
english: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah, to go out to battle against the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa öö ki yïth päänye dïcäŋeca beege jø leny ma kume ma pïërariiø ka abïciel mo ceŋge da jap leny, ni jø leny ma dïpe abïriiø moa teek døc røk jø Giba kär kwaan rege.
english: And the children of Benjamin were numbered at that time out of the cities twenty and six thousand men that drew sword, beside the inhabitants of Gibeah, which were numbered seven hundred chosen men.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø leny moøgø bëët, da jiy ma cäm juu ma dïpe abïriiø mo teek døc, ni ŋati man nø dïge ŋäc thöör, ni këël jëënnö kiree ba baae, kany wø thöödhe ki gïr leny mo tïïc ka kaw man wø thöör ni di wïrö ni kïdi ena yie.
