english: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel kwäänge beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe aŋween mo ceŋge da jap leny, ni jø tuuŋ Benjamen tøør rege; ni jøøgø beege jø leny bëët.
english: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aö maal, ni aage Bëthël kuna pëënyge Jwøk ni köge, na «?A jø tuuŋ mane noo bwøth leny jïwa nee wa këëtwa ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen?» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Beeye jø tuuŋ Juuda noo bwøth leny dïkwøŋ.»
english: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the Lord said, Judah shall go up first.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel apäny maal ka amöölla, ni cige ni tïïcge twïër marge buut Giba, nee këëtge ki jø paanøgø.
english: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning, and encamped against Gibeah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni aage baŋ leny ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ni putge rege cïïmmö na dhøgi kiper nee këëtge ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa en Giba.
english: And the men of Israel went out to battle against Benjamin; and the men of Israel put themselves in array to fight against them at Gibeah.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Benjamen aput ö wøk ki Giba, ni putge jø Icriel ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø 'näk dïcäŋeca, ni put pinynyi gääbö ki jiy moa thøw.
english: And the children of Benjamin came forth out of Gibeah, and destroyed down to the ground of the Israelites that day twenty and two thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel cwïnyge amakge ni cäŋge rege cïïmmö na dhøgi kiper leny kanya kwøŋge rege cïïmmö yie na dhøgi dïkwøŋ.
english: And the people the men of Israel encouraged themselves, and set their battle again in array in the place where they put themselves in array the first day.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aay ni jwöŋge dëër Wuuö Jwøk këël mana päth cäŋŋi, ni pëënyge Wuuö Jwøk, ni köge, ni «?Cäŋwa ci baŋ nyïïmëëkwa ma jø tuuŋ Benjamen, nee wa këëtwa ki geni?» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Cou baŋge ni këëdu ki geni.»
english: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the Lord until even, and asked counsel of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the Lord said, Go up against him.)

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel acäŋ ö baŋ leny ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen kanya tïme na ri riet nïne.
english: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø tuuŋ Benjamen aput ö wøk ki Giba thuwø kanya tïme na ri riet nïne, ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel ma kume apaar ka abära mo ceŋge da jap leny ni cäŋge ge nägö, ni put pinynyi gääbö ki jiy moa thøw.
english: And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day, and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men; all these drew the sword.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo jø Icriel, këël jiy bëët, gena aa Bëthël ni jwöŋge yie; ni bëëtge kaace nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni mänge dëëtge ki cam ki yi cäŋögø bäre këël mana päth cäŋŋi. Ni cïpge jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up, and came unto the house of God, and wept, and sat there before the Lord, and fasted that day until even, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel Wuuö Jwøk apëënyge kiper gïna dige tïïö; kiper yïth nïrögøøni acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ena kaace;
english: And the children of Israel enquired of the Lord, (for the ark of the covenant of God was there in those days,

anywaa: ni ki yïth nïrögø thuwø Piniac wär Eliedhar nyikwaar Aran bëëdö ni cuŋŋö nyïm acanduk manøgø ni tïïya tïï dïlämi kaace. 'Ba jø Icriel aköö, ni «?Cäŋwa ci baŋ nyïïmëëkwa ma jø tuuŋ Benjamen, nee wa këëtwa ki geni, wala wecwa?» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Cou baŋge, kiper diøø aani jøøgø cïba ceŋŋu.»
english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, stood before it in those days,) saying, Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother, or shall I cease? And the Lord said, Go up; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel jiy møøk aputge tïïc nee rege kange deŋ Giba.
english: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icriel ni cige baŋ leny ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen ri dää nïne, ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi kiper nee ge këëtge ki jø Giba, kaawat mana tïïcge dïkwøŋ.
english: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Benjamen aö wøk nee këëtge ki jø leny mo jø Icriel; ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel ni peege geni kany mo bäär ki pääny, ni täk jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki man këëtge, ni nääge ki jiy røk jø Icriel, kaawat mana tïïcge dïkwøŋ. Ni jiy moa 'näkge beege jiy mo jïtö ki pïëradäk, ni jiy moøgø 'näkge pwöla ki uutjïëthe; ni uutjïëthe moøgø, mana dïkwøŋ beeye jöö mano ci Bëthël ni maya beeye mano ci Giba.
english: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, and were drawn away from the city; and they began to smite of the people, and kill, as at other times, in the highways, of which one goeth up to the house of God, and the other to Gibeah in the field, about thirty men of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen aköö, ni «Wïthge dïïrø dïïrö, ka teeŋ mana  dïkwøŋ.» 'Ba jø Icriel onø köö, ni «Wärø reeŋø kiper nee ge peeø uutjïëthe kany mo bäär ki pääny.»
english: And the children of Benjamin said, They are smitten down before us, as at the first. But the children of Israel said, Let us flee, and draw them from the city unto the highways.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo jø Icriel acuŋŋö ni løkge rege ki kwöra reŋge yïthge, ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi kanya cwøl ni Baal-Tamar; ni ö jø Icrielli moa näk rege ege kanø ni pänyge maal ki kanya enge yie pwöl Giba.
english: And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place, and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar: and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places, even out of the meadows of Gibeah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi ma kume apaar moa teek døc røk jø Icriel bëët na öge baŋ leny ki jø Giba, leny aput tïmö ni teek døc; 'ba kuc jø tuuŋ Benjamen ni ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc nyänhnha bäätge.
english: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk wïth jø tuuŋ Benjamen aput dïïr nyïm jø Icriel; køøre jø Icriel jø tuuŋ Benjamen ma kume ma pïërariiø kurbïïc ki dïpa aciel aputge 'näk dïcäŋeca, ni beege jø leny moa näk ceŋge da jap leny bëët.
english: And the Lord smote Benjamin before Israel: and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men: all these drew the sword.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø tuuŋ Benjamen aputge joot ni wïthge odïdö. 'Ba kar kaaca, kanya tïme na ri leny, jø Icriel adøø ŋäthge ni wecge jø tuuŋ Benjamen, kiper ge ŋäätha jøw moa no okanø na näk ege cïp kaace nee ge këëtge ki jø Giba.
english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten: for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites, because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk rege ege kanø, gena laar reeŋø ni läätge Giba, ni nigebay dï pääny bäre, ni 'näkge jiy bëët ko opëëlle.
english: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no otïïö na ŋïï yïthakic jø leny mo jø Icriel møga ki jø leny moa näk rege ege kanø, beeye ki man ö jøøa näk rege ege kanø ni waaŋge pääny nee jïrö mo dwøŋ neetul ki dï pääny,
english: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait, that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city.

anywaa: kiper nee jø Icriel møga nee cäŋge duu baŋ leny ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen. 'Ba gïna tägö ri leny kar kaaca, jø tuuŋ Benjamen atägö ki man këëtge, ni nääge ki jiy mo jïtö ki pïëradäk røk jø Icriel, ni köge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, wïthge dïïrø dïïrö kaawat mana dïkwøŋ.»
english: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jïrö na neetul ki dï pääny, jø tuuŋ Benjamen alwïthö ŋäthge, ni jootge gø ni pääny bäre waaŋ, ni jïrö onitul.
english: But when the flame began to arise up out of the city with a pillar of smoke, the Benjamites looked behind them, and, behold, the flame of the city ascended up to heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, jø Icriel nyïmge aputge løk, ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamen ni put cwïnyge bwøk, kiper ajootge ni ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc nyänhnha bäätge.
english: And when the men of Israel turned again, the men of Benjamin were amazed: for they saw that evil was come upon them.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø tuuŋ Benjamen ŋäthge aputge luk jø Icriel ni reŋge, ni ge reŋŋa jï kuna näk da dï paap; 'ba gena maa lenynyi dïër, ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamenni moa ö wøk ki yïth päänye ni puti ya jø Icrielli nää dïër.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel unto the way of the wilderness; but the battle overtook them; and them which came out of the cities they destroyed in the midst of them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni cielge jø tuuŋ Benjamen dïër, ni ŋwiecge køørge ni rege kärge jwömö, ni putge jø tuuŋ Benjamen mak, ni 'näkge geni kanya näk dïët ki Giba na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamenni ma kume apaar ka abära ni putge thøø kaaca, ni beege jø leny moa teek bëët.
english: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba moa dööŋ, ŋäthge aløkge ni reŋge jï kuna näk da dï paap bäät kïnna cwøl ni Rimön; 'ba jiy ma kume abïïc amaa jø Icrielli uutjïëthe ni 'näkge geni. Køøre gena cäŋ läp køørge, ni maage geni Gidöm, ni cäŋge nääö ki jiy ma kume ariiø røkge.
english: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon: and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom, and slew two thousand men of them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa thøw dïcäŋeca beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni beege jø leny moa teek bëët na näk ceŋge da jap leny.
english: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword; all these were men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba dëët jøøa reŋ jï kuna näk da dï paap, jiy ma dïpe abïciel abøth ni pïïcge bäät Kïn Rimön, ni putge bëëtö kaaca ki dwäde aŋween.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon, and abode in the rock Rimmon four months.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aduu baŋ jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa no odööŋ mïëri møga, ni 'näkge geni ko opëëlle, ni beege cwøw ki mään ko obwöre bëët, ki lääc paac, këël gïïa jootge bëët. Ni putge mïëri bëët mo jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa jootge kaace waaŋ.
english: And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin, and smote them with the edge of the sword, as well the men of every city, as the beast, and all that came to hand: also they set on fire all the cities that they came to.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, jø Icriel onø kööŋ kanya enge Micpa, ni köge, ni «Kär dee dhaanhø dëëtø mo cïpa nyaare jï nyï tuuŋ Benjamen nee nywøme.»
english: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpah, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel aö Bëthël ni putge bëëtö ni geno pï piny kaace nyïm Jwøk këël mana päth cäŋŋi, ni ge jwöŋö døc ni döötge ege tïŋ maal.
english: And the people came to the house of God, and abode there till even before God, and lifted up their voices, and wept sore;

anywaa: Ni köge,  «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ?aperŋø na ö teeŋ gïnni na täge dï jø Icriel, ni tïm wï tuuŋ acielli ni tøør dï jø Icriel dïcäŋi en?»
english: And said, O Lord God of Israel, why is this come to pass in Israel, that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïcäŋ maya, jø Icriel alaar päny maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni tïïge ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace, ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people rose early, and built there an altar, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel apëëö, na «?A jø dhi øde mane røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, na näk kär ö baŋ acooŋa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk?» 'Ba gïnögø acaange kiper geno nø kööŋ døc kiper jø dhi ødo näk kär ö baŋ acooŋa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kanya enge Micpa, ni köge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jø dhi ødøgø put ka 'näk møn.»
english: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the Lord? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the Lord to Mizpah, saying, He shall surely be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel cwïnyge apädhö døc kiper nyïïmëëkge ma jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ni köge, ni «Wï tuuŋ aciel oŋul wøk røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel dïcäŋi en!
english: And the children of Israel repented them for Benjamin their brother, and said, There is one tribe cut off from Israel this day.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø nø, nee jø tuuŋ Benjamen moøgø no odööŋ yøø jïtge ki mään? Kiper øøno nø kööŋ ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni kär dee dhaanhø dëëtø mo cïpa nyaare jï nyï tuuŋ Benjamen nee nywøme.»
english: How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing we have sworn by the Lord that we will not give them of our daughters to wives?

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aköö, na «?A jø dhi øde mane røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel na näk kär ö baŋ acooŋa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kanya enø Micpa?» 'Ba ka adïëri møn, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo okam ö twïër kar acooŋa ki røk jø Jabic-Gelät.
english: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the Lord? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly.

anywaa: Kiper kanya ö jø Icrielli na kwaani kar kaace, ka adïëri møn, ki røk jøøa bëëdö Jabic-Gelät, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dëëtge mo okam joot twïër kaace.
english: For the people were numbered, and, behold, there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø acooŋa ajäägö ki jø leny mo teek døc ma kume apaar kurriiø nee cige Jabic-Gelät; ni köömge jøøa jääŋge yøø, ni köge, ni «Cou; jiy moø ni bëëdö Jabic-Gelät bëët yøø, 'nägu ko opëëlle, këël mään ko obwöre moa thenh thenh bëët.
english: And the congregation sent thither twelve thousand men of the valiantest, and commanded them, saying, Go and smite the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead with the edge of the sword, with the women and the children.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn en beeye gïno tïïyu; cwøw bëët, këël mään bëët moa ŋäc dëët cwøw, wär putu 'näk na bäre.»
english: And this is the thing that ye shall do, Ye shall utterly destroy every male, and every woman that hath lain by man.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na cige, gena jïtö ki mään ma nyïïakuue mo dëët cwøw poot kucge ma dïpe aŋween røk jøøa bëëdö Jabic-Gelät; ni kälge nyïgögø twïër mana en Cëëlö, na en yi ŋööm Keenan.
english: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins, that had known no man by lying with any male: and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

anywaa: Køøre jø acooŋa bëët ajäägö ki dwøl ni cäänge ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa en bäät Kïn Rimön, ni ge caana luum mëër jïge.
english: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon, and to call peaceably unto them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamenni ni putge duu paac kar kaagø, ni ö jø Icrielli ni cïpge nyïga mak ri leny jïge, ni beege nyïga käli na wec ni kwøw røk määra bëëdö Jabic-Gelät; 'ba nyïgögø arëëm ni kär rømø ki kwään jø tuuŋ Benjamen moøgø.
english: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel cwïnyge apädhö døc kiper jø tuuŋ Benjamen, kiper gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na lääm kar jø tuuŋ Benjamen dï wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And the people repented them for Benjamin, because that the Lord had made a breach in the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre jø døøk acooŋa aköö, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø nø, nee jø tuuŋ Benjamen moøgø no ocäŋ dööŋŋö yøø, jïtge ki mään? Kiper mään moge wïthge adïïr bëët.»
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, How shall we do for wives for them that remain, seeing the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?

anywaa: Ni cäŋge köö, ni «Beerra man ö jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa no obøth ki thøø ri leny ni duuge yi ŋöömö mana no onø cïp jïge na marge, nee nyeŋ wï tuuŋ manøgø ba rwäänye dï jø Icriel.
english: And they said, There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, nyïïø ba døø cïbö jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen nee nywømge. Kiper ø na jø Icriel, øøno nø kööŋ, ni kööø, na ‹Acïëni oen bäät ŋato cïp nyaare jï nyï tuuŋ Benjamen nee nywøme.› »
english: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters: for the children of Israel have sworn, saying, Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø døøk Icriel aköö, ni «Neennu, da ajwöma mar Wuuö Jwøk mo wø di tïïö ki yi cwiir cooth, ni tïïca Cëëlö.» 'Ba Cëëlö ena bäät cwïïc ki Bëthël, ni ena jï kur tuul-cäŋ ki øtjöö mana aay ki Bëthël ni coonya Cekam, ni ena bäät caam ki Leböna.
english: Then they said, Behold, there is a feast of the Lord in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el, on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø døøk Icrielli ni köömge jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa rëëm ni kär jïtö ki mään, ni köge, «Cou, ni kanu dëëtu yïth pwöth omøki,
english: Therefore they commanded the children of Benjamin, saying, Go and lie in wait in the vineyards;

anywaa: ni kuru ki kaace; 'ba kanyo ö nyïïakuk Cëëlö wøk baŋ meeŋ, wäru putu ö wøk ki yïth pwöth omøki, ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtu ni mäge ki dhaagø røk nyïïakuk Cëëlö nee ci jïre na dhaagø, ni putu aa yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And see, and, behold, if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances, then come ye out of the vineyards, and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh, and go to the land of Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö wëëk nyïïakuue moøgø wala nyïïmëëkge moa näk cwøw noo öge ni ge pëënynya waani kiper nyïïge, køøre nø, wa läwa köö jïge, ni ‹Bääthu yïthu kiper gïna caanwa jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ni weyu nyïïu nee putge ci jïge, kiper øøni, kanya këëdø ki jø Jabic-Gelät, mään moa kälø kär rømø ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen. 'Ba këël uuni, kiper mana näk paa u na cïp nyïïu jïge, bäŋ bääyö bäätu thuwø.› »
english: And it shall be, when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain, that we will say unto them, Be favourable unto them for our sakes: because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war: for ye did not give unto them at this time, that ye should be guilty.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen gïnögø aputge tïïc, ni kätge ki mään røk nyïga ö baŋ meeŋ, ni kälge ni ege päärö ki kwäänge, ni putge aay ki geni. Køøre gena put aay ni døøge yi ŋöömö mana no odööŋ jïge na marge, ni cäŋge päänye moa en kaace geerrø, ni putge bëëtö yïthge.
english: And the children of Benjamin did so, and took them wives, according to their number, of them that danced, whom they caught: and they went and returned unto their inheritance, and repaired the cities, and dwelt in them.

anywaa: Kar kaagø nø, jø Icriel atïŋŋö ki kanya enge yie Bëthël, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø kanya en wï tuuŋ marge yie, ni pööth poge; ni ö geni bëët ni døøge yïth ŋøøm moa no odööŋ jïge na moge.
english: And the children of Israel departed thence at that time, every man to his tribe and to his family, and they went out from thence every man to his inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni jø Icriel bëëdö ni bäŋ nyeya jïge; ni ŋati man nø bëëdö ni tïïya mana manynye na beer ki jïre.
english: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did that which was right in his own eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët jø Icrielli tiet jøøa bëëdö na pïëmme, dï paac ajïtö ki meel. Ni ö nyen mørri ma ŋat Bethelem na en yi ŋööm Juuda ni aa po jø Möap kuna bëëde yie na wëëllö, ni beeye eni ki cïïe ki wääte karge riet.
english: Now it came to pass in the days when the judges ruled, that there was a famine in the land. And a certain man of Beth–lehem–judah went to sojourn in the country of Moab, he, and his wife, and his two sons.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ nyenøgø beeye Elimëlëk, ni nyeŋ dhaagø mare beeye Naømi; 'ba nyeŋ wääte na näk ariiø beege Malön ki Këliwön. Ni gena jø paac mo cwøl ni Eeparata, ni beeye Bethelem mana en yi ŋööm Juuda. Ni cige po jø Möap ni bëëtge kaace.
english: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth–lehem–judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and continued there.

anywaa: 'Ba Elimëlëk cø Naømi athøw, ni dööŋ Naømi keere ki wääte karge riet.
english: And Elimelech Naomi's husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.

anywaa: Ni ö wääte ni nyöömge ri nyïïakuk Möap, ni nyeŋ nyïgögø beege Ørpa ki Ruuth. Ni  putge bëëtö kaace ki cwiiri mo jïtö ka apaar.
english: And they took them wives of the women of Moab; the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth: and they dwelled there about ten years.

anywaa: Køøre Malön ki Këliwön athøw bëët, ni dööŋ miige ma Naømi ki ceŋŋe køør thøw wääte karge riet ki cwøre.
english: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband.

anywaa: Køøre Naømi ki määr wääte atïŋŋö ki Möap, ni eni døøa poge, kiper awïnynye ni Wuuö Jwøk jiye ma jø Icriel akønye ni ciek caammi.
english: Then she arose with her daughters in law, that she might return from the country of Moab: for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the Lord had visited his people in giving them bread.

anywaa: Ni tïŋŋe ki kanya bëëtge yie ki määr wääte karge riet, ni aacge ki jöö ni ge aa ŋööm Juuda.
english: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was, and her two daughters in law with her; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah.

anywaa: Ni ö Naømi ni cään määr wääte karge riet, ni kööe, «Cou, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø po menni. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth bäth ec mare jïïu, kaawat mana nyoothu bäth ec jïra ki wääta na thøw.
english: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law, Go, return each to her mother's house: the Lord deal kindly with you, as ye have dealt with the dead, and with me.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk ŋati man nø pïïn piny ni jïte ki paare ni bëëde ki cwøre.» Ni ö Naømi ni nuum dhøkge ni määtha geni; ni put nyïgögø jwøk døc ni döötge ege tïŋ maal.
english: The Lord grant you that ye may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband. Then she kissed them; and they lifted up their voice, and wept.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «Ø aay na aciel ki ïïni cøøn ni cøø baŋ jø pou.»
english: And they said unto her, Surely we will return with thee unto thy people.

anywaa: 'Ba Naømi aköö, «Nyie määr nyïïa, aayu nø. ?Aŋø ni manynyu wääth ki aani en? ?A poot nyöötö ki wääta møøk këët, mo tïmö na cwøwu?
english: And Naomi said, Turn again, my daughters: why will ye go with me? are there yet any more sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands?

anywaa: Nyie määr nyïïa, cou døøgu nø, kiper aana nø jalø ni ba løny ki man jïta ki dïcwøø këët. ?Aŋø, këël a doo köö ni jïra da ŋäädhe ki man jïta ki dïcwøø dïwääni, ni nyööta ki wääta,
english: Turn again, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have an husband. If I should say, I have hope, if I should have an husband also to night, and should also bear sons;

anywaa: geni dou koorø këël mana dege døøŋŋø? ?A u doo kweer ki man nywøm uuni kiperge? Nyie määr nyïïa, ba løny, kiper bëëtö mara duua keec cwïny bääta mo kaala maru, kiper Wuuö Jwøk cere aluu raa.»
english: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown? would ye stay for them from having husbands? nay, my daughters; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the Lord is gone out against me.

anywaa: Køøre gena cäŋ jwøk døc ni döötge ege tïŋ maal, ni ö Ørpa ni nuum dhi mii cwøre ni määtha gø ni aae. 'Ba Ruuth adööŋ buut nyijøøgø.
english: And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

anywaa: Køøre Naømi aköö jï Ruuth, ni «Neenï, nyägï adøø baŋ jø poge, ni døø baŋ juu moe; ïïni thuwø, ci läp køør nyägï nø.»
english: And she said, Behold, thy sister in law is gone back unto her people, and unto her gods: return thou after thy sister in law.

anywaa: 'Ba Ruuth aköö, ni «Kärï köö jaak ni aa buutï, niï köömma aani ni køørï kär løpa; kiper kanyo ciï yie jaak a cøøa yie, ni kanyo bëëdï yie aano bëëdö yie thuwø; jiy moï geno tïmö na jiy 'moa, ni ö Jwøk marï ni tïme na Jwøk mara.
english: And Ruth said, Entreat me not to leave thee, or to return from following after thee: for whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God:

anywaa: Kanyo thøøï yie aano thøø yie, ni koony aani kanyo koony ïïni yie thuwø. 'Ba ni näk aano pääö ki ïïni, naa ba pääa thøøe kiree, Wuuö Jwøk aano jääle.»
english: Where thou diest, will I die, and there will I be buried: the Lord do so to me, and more also, if ought but death part thee and me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Naømi ni Ruuth manynya man aae ki eni møn, bäŋ gïn mør mo ee caanø këët.
english: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.

anywaa: Køøre gena aay karge riet këël mana pïïcge Bethelem. 'Ba kanya pïïcge Bethelem, paac bäre anitïŋŋa kiper pïï marge. Ni kö määnni, ni «?Man a Naømi møn?»
english: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem. And it came to pass, when they were come to Beth–lehem, that all the city was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Kär a cwøllu na ‹Naømi›. Beerra man cwøllu a na ‹Maara›, kiper Jwøk na en teeki jïre atïïö dëëra ki gïï mo døøya cwïnya mo keec.
english: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

anywaa: Aana aay ni jïra da dïcwøø ko obwöre, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni duu aani ki ceŋŋa. ?Aŋø ni cøøru aani ni Naømi en? Wuuö Jwøk na en teeki jïre aana nø jääle, ni kïth bääta ki gïï mo leth.»
english: I went out full, and the Lord hath brought me home again empty: why then call ye me Naomi, seeing the Lord hath testified against me, and the Almighty hath afflicted me?

anywaa: 'Ba Naømi aduuö ki Möap, ni eni duui ka Ruuth nyi jø Möap na näk cï nyaare. 'Ba kanya pïïcge Bethelem beeye kar kanya täk kac beega cwøl ni gäbci.
english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Beth–lehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

anywaa: 'Ba Naømi jïre da wat cwøre, ma dhaanhø mo okwär, ma tuuŋ ki Elimëlëk, mo nyeŋŋe Böeeth.
english: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband's, a mighty man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.

anywaa: 'Ba Ruuth nyi jø Möap aköö jï Naømi, na «A kwaya ïïni naa cøøa dï pwöth, naa kwänya ki wïth beel moa no odööŋ piny yi pwöth ŋato yie met ki aani.» Ni løk gø jïgø, ni «Ciï nø, cï nyaara.»
english: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi, Let me now go to the field, and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace. And she said unto her, Go, my daughter.

anywaa: Køøre ena ö maal, ni ci kuna kwänynye yïth pwöth, køør jø kac; ni cwöp ri pwöth Böeeth na näk tuuŋ ki Elimëlëk.
english: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgønø, Böeeth aöö ki Bethelem, ni määth jø kac ni kööe, ni «Met ec mar Wuuö Jwøk bëëde ki uuni.» Ni løkge gø, ni «Gwïëth mar Wuuö Jwøk bëëde ki ïïni.»
english: And, behold, Boaz came from Beth–lehem, and said unto the reapers, The Lord be with you. And they answered him, The Lord bless thee.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth ŋata näk wïth jø kac ki beel apëënynye ni kööe, ni «?Nyijøøgø ni poot na wøp enø, a nyijø kaa?»
english: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya ŋata näk wïth jø kac beel jïre, ni «Beeye nyijø Möap, na öö ki Naømi kanya duue ki Möap.
english: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

anywaa: Ena köö, na ‹A kwaya ïïni naa cøøa kun kwänynya ki wïth beel køør jø kac.› 'Ba eni ööi ka aruunnø cøøn, ni put tïïc këël kawaane ennø, ni poot na pïïnne piny tier abïla ennø.»
english: And she said, I pray you, let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves: so she came, and hath continued even from the morning until now, that she tarried a little in the house.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aköö jï Ruuth, «Nya nyaara, wïnynyï; kär pwödhö man weyï ni ciï baŋ kwany yi pwödhö mør; 'ba bëëdu na aciel kany ki mään moi na jø tïïc 'moa ii.
english: Then said Boaz unto Ruth, Hearest thou not, my daughter? Go not to glean in another field, neither go from hence, but abide here fast by my maidens:

anywaa: Raŋ pwödhö mano kacge ni ciï køørge. Jø tïïc moa näk cwøw yaa cemø niï ba gutge. 'Ba ni näk dëërï da riew, ciï ni mäthï ki pïï moa wømge na en yïth dääe.»
english: Let thine eyes be on the field that they do reap, and go thou after them: have I not charged the young men that they shall not touch thee? and when thou art athirst, go unto the vessels, and drink of that which the young men have drawn.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny, ni kööe jï Böeeth, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïc yiï ni met ki aani, ni cädï kipera en, ni ŋäyï ni aana dhaanhø ma jur mo path?»
english: Then she fell on her face, and bowed herself to the ground, and said unto him, Why have I found grace in thine eyes, that thou shouldest take knowledge of me, seeing I am a stranger?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Böeethi jïgø ni kööe, ni «Gïïa tïïyï bëët jï mii cwørï køør thøw cwørï, këël mana weyï wäru ki meru ki pou kanya nywøl ï yie, ni ööï baŋ jøw mo poot kuyï dïkwøŋ anø caan jïra bëët.
english: And Boaz answered and said unto her, It hath fully been shewed me, all that thou hast done unto thy mother in law since the death of thine husband: and how thou hast left thy father and thy mother, and the land of thy nativity, and art come unto a people which thou knewest not heretofore.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ïïno cunne kiper gïna tïïyï; ni ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø Icriel, Jwøa ööï baŋe na kanï riï buute, ni mooc ïïni ki gïn mo beer.»
english: The Lord recompense thy work, and a full reward be given thee of the Lord God of Israel, under whose wings thou art come to trust.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth aköö, ni «Wui kwäärö, aana jïtö ki met ec baŋï, kiper cwïnya acømï ni caanï luup mo met jïra, këël na näk a ba kwaan røk jø tïïc moï moa näk mään.»
english: Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kar cam, Böeeth aköö jï Ruuth, ni «Ö kany niï cämï ki møø, ni cwenyï møgï ki kadø.» Køøre Ruuth apï piny buut jø kac, ni mooyi ya Böeethi ki beel mo omuuö; ni nyäme gøøc mana jäŋe, ni dööŋ møøki.
english: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

anywaa: Kanya døø baŋ kwany, Böeeth jø tïïc moe aköömme ni kööe, ni «Weyu eni nee kwänye këël dï ŋaaŋe, ni kär nou lää wïïe.
english: And when she was risen up to glean, Boaz commanded his young men, saying, Let her glean even among the sheaves, and reproach her not:

anywaa: Ni kännu wøk thuwø røk wïth beel mo wø kayu, ni wiiu ge piny jïre nee kwanye, ni ba joogu eni.»
english: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth akwänyö yi pwöthögø këël abøøya, ni dïn beel moa kwanye, ni jïte ki beel mo ni rømi tïmö ni yi rumi ma iipa.
english: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.

anywaa: Ni kwany beegøgø ni aa paac, ni nyooth moa joode ri kwany jï mii cwøre; ni käl cam wøk mana dhäthö dhee thuwø, ni mëëk gø eni.
english: And she took it up, and went into the city: and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned: and she brought forth, and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed.

anywaa: Ni kö mii cwøre jïgø, ni «?Ïïno kwänyö kaa ki beel dïcäŋi? ?Ïïno tïïö kaa? Gwïëth oen bäät ŋata cädö kiperï enø.» Køøre ŋata tïïe baŋ gø acaane jï mii cwøre, ni kööe, ni «Nyeŋ ŋata tïïa baŋe dïcäŋi beeye Böeeth.»
english: And her mother in law said unto her, Where hast thou gleaned to day? and where wroughtest thou? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee. And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought, and said, The man's name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz.

anywaa: Ni kö Naømi jï cï nyaare, ni «Ŋatøgø ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki na näk mëëye käre paanyø bäätø, ø na kwøw, ki bäät cwøra ki wääta na näk onø thøø.» Ni cäŋ Naømi köö jï Ruuth, ni «Ŋatøgø beeye ŋat paara døc, ni ena tuuŋ ki cwøra.»
english: And Naomi said unto her daughter in law, Blessed be he of the Lord, who hath not left off his kindness to the living and to the dead. And Naomi said unto her, The man is near of kin unto us, one of our next kinsmen.

anywaa: Ni ö Ruuthi nyijø Möap ni kööe, ni «Gïn mør acaane jïra thuwø; ena köö, ni ‹Ï doo bëëdö na aciel ki jø tïïc 'moa, këël mano thum beelli 'moa ki kac bëët.› »
english: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.

anywaa: Ni kö Naømi jï cï nyaare ma Ruuth, ni «Wøp enønø, cï nyaara; beerra man cäädhï ki määrögø, ni ba gaaï pwödhö mør, nee bäŋe gïn tägi dëërï mo raac.»
english: And Naomi said unto Ruth her daughter in law, It is good, my daughter, that thou go out with his maidens, that they meet thee not in any other field.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth abëëdö na aciel ki määra tïïö pwöth Böeeth, ni kwänyö ki beega cwøl ni gäbci ki beega cwøl ni cïndë, gøøc mana thum pwödhö bäre ki kac; ni eni bëëdö ka mii cwøre.
english: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and dwelt with her mother in law.

anywaa: Køøre Naømi cï nyaare ma Ruuth apëënynye ni kööe, ni «?Nya cï nyaara, ï ba cäänynya ki paarï nø, niï pïï piny yie?
english: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her, My daughter, shall I not seek rest for thee, that it may be well with thee?

anywaa: ?A ennø, Böeeth, ni da määra bëëdï ki geni yi pwöthe, paa wat cwøra? Neenï, eni kwödö ki beel yi laara dïwääni.
english: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, lwøgï ni wïïrï dëërï ki maaw, ni kïthï dëërï ka abïï, ni ciï yi laara; 'ba kär riï nyoothï jï gø gøøc mano lønye ki cam.
english: Wash thyself therefore, and anoint thee, and put thy raiment upon thee, and get thee down to the floor: but make not thyself known unto the man, until he shall have done eating and drinking.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo but piny, kar niire wär neenï. Kanyo bute nø, wärï ciï ni tïŋï abïï maal ki jï kuna näk da tiete, ni butï piny; køøre gïno tïïyï ocaane jïrï.»
english: And it shall be, when he lieth down, that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie, and thou shalt go in, and uncover his feet, and lay thee down; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do.

anywaa: 'Ba Ruuth aköö, ni «Gïïa caanï bëët yøø tïïa tïïö.»
english: And she said unto her, All that thou sayest unto me I will do.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth aci yi laara ni tïïc gïïa caan mii cwøre bëët.
english: And she went down unto the floor, and did according to all that her mother in law bade her.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Böeethi ki cam, ni yie onø tïmö ni met, ena ci kuna but piny deŋ beel moa no ocooŋø. Ni ö Ruuthi ni tïŋ abïï maal mëëth ki jï kuna näk da tiete, ni put but piny.
english: And when Boaz had eaten and drunk, and his heart was merry, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of corn: and she came softly, and uncovered his feet, and laid her down.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dhöör dï wäär, Böeeth abwøk, ni këëmme, ni joot dhaagø no obut piny jï kuna näk da tiete.
english: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.

anywaa: Ni kööe, «?Ïïna ŋa?» 'Ba aløk Ruuthi, ni «Aana ŋat tïïc marï ma Ruuth. Rïëp abïïnï bääta, kiper ïïna ŋata daa dööŋ ki gø.»
english: And he said, Who art thou? And she answered, I am Ruth thine handmaid: spread therefore thy skirt over thine handmaid; for thou art a near kinsman.

anywaa: 'Ba Böeeth aköö, «Nya nyaara, ïïno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki; gïna tïïyï cään en na døøyï yia mo met, kaala bäth ec mana nyoothï dïkwøŋ, kiper mana kärï cäädhö køør jaga näk tïëŋu moa can wala moa näk kwääri.
english: And he said, Blessed be thou of the Lord, my daughter: for thou hast shewed more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, inasmuch as thou followedst not young men, whether poor or rich.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, nyaara, kärï lwäyö; gïn pëënynyï en tïïa tïïö jïrï møn, kiper ŋäc jø powa bëët ni ïïna dhaagø mo bëëtö mare beer.
english: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, waana tuuŋ ki Elimëlëk, ni løny ki man dööŋa ki ïïni. 'Ba da dhaanhø mør thuwø mo tuuŋge døc mo kaala aani.
english: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

anywaa: Ennø, but kany dïwääni; 'ba noo tïme na aruunnø, ni näk ŋatøgø yie met ki man dööŋe ki ïïni, wøp, eno dööŋ ki ïïni; 'ba ni näk mo yie ba met ki man dööŋe ki ïïni, ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, aani, a dööŋ ki ïïni. Butï nø këël aruunnø.»
english: Tarry this night, and it shall be in the morning, that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman, well; let him do the kinsman's part: but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee, then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee, as the Lord liveth: lie down until the morning.

anywaa: Køøre Ruuth abut piny jï kuna näk da tiet Böeeth këël aruunnø. 'Ba Ruuth apäny maal ki bäc øw kany wø poode ni dhaanhø ba løny ki ŋec. 'Ba Böeeth aköö, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo ŋäya gø ni dhaaŋŋøgø oöö yi laara.»
english: And she lay at his feet until the morning: and she rose up before one could know another. And he said, Let it not be known that a woman came into the floor.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aköö jï Ruuth, ni «Käl aleeŋŋa mana käärï ni peerï gø.» Ni peer gø, ni ö Böeethi ni rum yi gø ki beel ki gïr røm kwöre abïciel, ni jieø gø wï gø. Køøre Ruuth aci paac.
english: Also he said, Bring the veil that thou hast upon thee, and hold it. And when she held it, he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her: and she went into the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe paac ena pëëny mii cwøre, ni kööe, ni «?Cï nyaara, gïna ciï baŋe atïme nidïï?» Køøre gïna tïïc Böeethi bäre kipere acaane jïre.
english: And when she came to her mother in law, she said, Who art thou, my daughter? And she told her all that the man had done to her.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Beel moi arøme jïra ki gïr røm kwöre abïciel ni mëëk gø aani, kiper ena köö, ni ‹Ï ba doo døøa baŋ mii cwørï ki ceŋŋï jaak.› »
english: And she said, These six measures of barley gave he me; for he said to me, Go not empty unto thy mother in law.

anywaa: Køøre Naømi aköö jï Ruuth, «Nya cï nyaara, neen jïre di turu, gøøc mano jootï gïno tägi; kiper Böeeth paa dhaanhø mo lïŋö ni luummögø ba thööre dïcäŋi.»
english: Then said she, Sit still, my daughter, until thou know how the matter will fall: for the man will not be in rest, until he have finished the thing this day.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aci dhi kiir kar acooŋa, ni pï piny kaace. 'Ba ŋata doo dööŋ ki Ruuth na wäŋ Böeethi acur kaagø. Ni kö Böeethi jïgø, ni «Nyie, gääï mø, ni pïï piny kany.» Ni ö ŋatøgø ni gääe ni put pï piny.
english: Then went Boaz up to the gate, and sat him down there: and, behold, the kinsman of whom Boaz spake came by; unto whom he said, Ho, such a one! turn aside, sit down here. And he turned aside, and sat down.

anywaa: Ni ö Böeethi ni cwöte ki jiy apaar røk jø døøŋŋø mo paanøgø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Pïïu piny kany.» Ni putge pï piny.
english: And he took ten men of the elders of the city, and said, Sit ye down here. And they sat down.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aköö jï ŋata doo dööŋ ki Ruuth, ni «Naømi na duuö ki po jø Möap manynya ŋøøpa näk mo tuuŋø ma Elimëlëk nee dwøk pwödhö.
english: And he said unto the kinsman, Naomi, that is come again out of the country of Moab, selleth a parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech's:

anywaa: 'Ba aana cädö ni beerra man caana gø jïrï, nee ŋeewï nyïm jøøi no opï piny kany ii, na näk jø døøk pøø. 'Ba ennø, ni näk ŋeewï ŋeeø, ŋeewï, kiper nee ŋöömmögø put bëëtö na mar wï tuuŋ marø. 'Ba ni näk jïrï bäär, caanï jïra nee ŋääa; kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mør këët mo ŋeew gø, 'ba beeye ïïni keerï, ni ena køørï.» Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Ŋeea ŋeeø.»
english: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aköö, ni «Cäŋo ŋeewï pwödhö cer Naømi, Ruuth nyijø Möap na näk cï thøø kälï kälö thuwø, kiper nee cwøre na thøw jïte ki lwiidhø mo dööŋ ŋöömmögø jïre.»
english: Then said Boaz, What day thou buyest the field of the hand of Naomi, thou must buy it also of Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance.

anywaa: Ni kö ŋata doo dööŋ ki Ruuth, ni «Ba løny jïra ki man lwøra gø na mara; kiper ni näk lwøra lwørø, acaara mara kiper ŋøøm moa doo dööŋ jï wääta ba thur kare këët. Kar dööŋö mana daa dööŋ ki gø lwørï, kiper ba løny jïra ki man dööŋwa ki gø.»
english: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør kööŋŋö mar jø Icriel mana dïkwøŋ, dööŋŋö ki dhaagø ki lwør ŋøøm mo ŋata no othøw, gïn wø tïïc kipere beeye en: Ŋata näk wää luubö warø mare göönye wøk tiere ni mëëk gø wati maya, ni nyootha gø ni luubö mana caane beeye kare, ni gïnögø beeye nyuudhi ki baŋ jø Icriel.
english: Now this was the manner in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning changing, for to confirm all things; a man plucked off his shoe, and gave it to his neighbour: and this was a testimony in Israel.

anywaa: Køøre ŋata doo dööŋ ki Ruuth aköö jï Böeeth, ni «Ŋeew ŋöömmögø nee tïme na marï.» Ni put warø mare gööny wøk.
english: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth aköö jï jø døøŋŋø ki jï jiy bëët, «Dïcäŋi u tïmö ni uuna lïŋŋe mo luummi en; gïïa en jï Elimëlëk bëët ki gïïa en jï Këliwön ki Malön bëët oŋeea baŋ Naømi.
english: And Boaz said unto the elders, and unto all the people, Ye are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.

anywaa: Këël Ruuth thuwø, nyijø Möap, cï Malön na no othøw, okäla nee tïme na cïïa, nee Malön jïte ki lwiidhø mo dööŋ ŋöömmögø jïre, nee nyeŋŋe ba rwäänye dï tuuŋge wala dï jø poge; dïcäŋi u tïmö ni uuna lïŋŋe mo luummi en.»
english: Moreover Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead upon his inheritance, that the name of the dead be not cut off from among his brethren, and from the gate of his place: ye are witnesses this day.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa en dhi kiir kar acooŋa bëët ki jø døøŋŋø aköö, ni «Wa tïmö ni waana lïŋŋe mo luummögø møn. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc dhaagø mano ö paarï enø ni caala Reecal ki Liia, mään moa na ariiø na nyaac dhi øt Icrielli ki rege. Ïïno tïmö na dhaanhø mo okwär, ni wïny nyeŋŋï yi Eeparata na näk Bethelem.
english: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The Lord make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Beth–lehem:

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki thuwø ni nyaac dhi ødï ki ro obwöre moo jootï ki dhaagø manøgø; ni tïm dhi ødï ni caala dhi øt Peereth na nywøl menni ma Tamar ki Juuda.»
english: And let thy house be like the house of Pharez, whom Tamar bare unto Judah, of the seed which the Lord shall give thee of this young woman.

anywaa: Køøre Böeeth Ruuth alwøre ni tïme na cïïe, ni ci baŋ gø na dhaagø; ni wëëgi ya Wuuö Jwøki jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø.
english: So Boaz took Ruth, and she was his wife: and when he went in unto her, the Lord gave her conception, and she bare a son.

anywaa: Ni kö määnni jï Naømi, «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, na mooc ïïni ki ŋat dööŋ cï nyaarï ki gø, ni jïtï ki nyikwaarï dïcäŋi. Beerra man tïm nyeŋ nyilaalli mana lwaarø ki gø ni wïnyö dï Icriel.
english: And the women said unto Naomi, Blessed be the Lord, which hath not left thee this day without a kinsman, that his name may be famous in Israel.

anywaa: Eno tïmö na ŋato kwøw ïïni, na ŋato køny ïïni kanyo døøŋŋï; kiper ŋata nywøl gø beeye cï nyaarï na mëër ki ïïni, dhaaŋŋa pere letha eni jïrï ki wäätï abïriiø moa diï nywølø.»
english: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

anywaa: Køøre Naømi nyilaal alwøre ni cïp gø kööre, ni put bëëtö ni pïra gø.
english: And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

anywaa: Ni ö määnni moa en ya atut ni köge, ni «Naømi ajïtö ki nyikwaare ma dïcwøø.» Ni cakge nyeŋ gø no Obet. 'Ba Obet beeye wää Jeci, ni ö Jeci ni näk wää nyeya ma Deebit.
english: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege nyïïkwaac Peereth; Peereth beeye wää Eedharan,
english: Now these are the generations of Pharez: Pharez begat Hezron,

anywaa: ni ö Eedharanni ni näk wää Ram, ni ö Rammi ni näk wää Aminadap,
english: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,

anywaa: ni ö Aminadapi ni näk wää Nacøn, ni ö Nacønni ni näk wää Calmön,
english: And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

anywaa: ni ö Calmönni ni näk wää Böeeth, ni ö Böeethi ni näk wää Obet,
english: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,

anywaa: ni ö Obeti ni näk wää Jeci, ni ö Jeci ni näk wää Deebit na näk nyeya.
english: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør ma nyï Reema- Dhöpim na en mïëya en bäät kïte na näk kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Elkana o Jeröam nyikwaar Eliyu, Eliyu o Töwu, Töwu o Dhup.
english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephrathite:

anywaa: 'Ba Elkana jïre da mään ariiø, ni nyeŋ aciel beeye Anna, ni ö nyeŋ maya ni näk Penana. Penana jïre da obwöre; 'ba Anna jïre bäŋ obwöre.
english: And he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of the other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yi cwiir cooth, Elkana wø tïŋŋö ki yi pääny mana bëëde yie ni ci kuna wøør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni cïpe ko olämme jïgø kanya cwøl ni Cëëlö. 'Ba wäät Ëli karge riet, ni beege Apni ki Piniac, ge bëëdö na dïlämme jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace.
english: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the Lord of hosts in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ wø cïp Elkana ko olämi, kur cïïe ma Penana wø cïbe cïbö jïgø ko obwöre moe bëët moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään.
english: And when the time was that Elkanah offered, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and her daughters, portions:

anywaa: 'Ba kur Anna wø di cïbö ni ee meedø, kiper eni mëër ki Anna døc; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk Anna ee mänö ki nyöödö.
english: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion; for he loved Hannah: but the Lord had shut up her womb.

anywaa: 'Ba cooth Anna yie wø cwaat nyäge cwaadø døc këël mano räny cwïnye, kiper mana näk eno män Wuuö Jwøki ki nyöödö.
english: And her adversary also provoked her sore, for to make her fret, because the Lord had shut up her womb.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ci Anna Øt Wuuö Jwøk na en Cëëlö ki yi cwiir cooth, yie wø cwaat nyäge cwaadø døc këël mano jwöŋe ni kweere ki cam.
english: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the Lord, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.

anywaa: Køøre cwøre ma Elkana wø köö jïgø, ni «?Anna, ï jwøgï ŋø? ?Ï ba cämï aperŋø? ?Aperŋø ni bëëdï ni cwïnyï opädhö en? ?Aŋø, ba letha pera jïrï ni kaala obwöre mo thööth?»
english: Then said Elkanah her husband to her, Hannah, why weepest thou? and why eatest thou not? and why is thy heart grieved? am not I better to thee than ten sons?

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni Elkana ki määre ge ena Cëëlö, kanya nø lønyge ki cam, Anna aö maal. 'Ba Ëli na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ opï piny bäät køøm buut jaath dhi øtø mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So Hannah rose up after they had eaten in Shiloh, and after they had drunk. Now Eli the priest sat upon a seat by a post of the temple of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Anna yie akeeye ni jwöŋe døc, ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And she was in bitterness of soul, and prayed unto the Lord, and wept sore.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena kööŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, ni näk mo caannø mara raŋï raŋø møn, a na laŋŋø marï, ni lääŋŋï aani, ni ba wïl wïïï ki aani, a na laŋŋø marï, ni cïpï jïra ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, aani nyilaal maneca puta ka cïp jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, këël yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët moo beede; 'ba wïïe bäŋ doo lielø na bäre.»
english: And she vowed a vow, and said, O Lord of hosts, if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid, and remember me, and not forget thine handmaid, but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child, then I will give him unto the Lord all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come upon his head.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni Anna lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, Ëli bëëdö ni neeta dhi gø.
english: And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the Lord, that Eli marked her mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk Anna lämö ka cwïnye, ni dhee keere beeye na nemmi, ni dwøre ba wïnyi, Ëli acädö ni Anna mare beeye meerø.
english: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.

anywaa: Køøre Ëli aköö jïgø, «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëdï niï meeyø? Wec maath nø.»
english: And Eli said unto her, How long wilt thou be drunken? put away thy wine from thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Anna ni kööe, «Wui kwäärö, jïra bäär, aana dhaagø mo bëëtö mara teek; aani, a kär mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala teeŋ køøŋø mo keec. 'Ba beeye mara na en cwïnya bäre na caana jï Wuuö Jwøk enø.
english: And Hannah answered and said, No, my lord, I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit: I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink, but have poured out my soul before the Lord.

anywaa: Kärï cädö ni aana dhaagø mo raac; kiper mara beeye lam jï Jwøk kiper caannø mana näk aano caannø ki gø, ki cwat ec mana näk yia ocwaadø ki gø.»
english: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Ëli jïre ni kööe, «Nya nyaara, ciï ki met ec nø; Jwø Icriel gïna kwayï baŋe enø owëëk ïïni.»
english: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.

anywaa: Ni kö Anna, ni «Beerra man bëët yiï ni met ki aani.» Ni ö Anna ni put aay, ni cäme ni täärnyïme leer jaak.
english: And she said, Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight. So the woman went her way, and did eat, and her countenance was no more sad.

anywaa: Køøre Elkana ki määre, gena päny maal ka amöölla cøøn ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk, ni putge døø poge na en Reema. 'Ba Elkana aci baŋ cïïe ma Anna na dhaagø, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni køny Anna ki man jïte ki nyilaal.
english: And they rose up in the morning early, and worshipped before the Lord, and returned, and came to their house to Ramah: and Elkanah knew Hannah his wife; and the Lord remembered her.

anywaa: 'Ba na päŋ nïr lwaarri, ena lwaar ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø; ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Camiel, ni kööe, ni «Kiper eni kwaa baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Wherefore it came to pass, when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived, that she bare a son, and called his name Samuel, saying, Because I have asked him of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyenøgø ni Elkana enø aay ki jø paare bëët nee cïpe ko olämme mo wø cïp ki yi cwiir cooth jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpa gïna kööŋe kipere.
english: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the Lord the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.

anywaa: 'Ba Anna keere kär aay, kiper acaane jï cwøre ni kööe, ni «Aani, a ba ci kunece këël mano män nyilaal ki caak. 'Ba kanyo mäni ki caak nø, eno käla ni kïtha gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk nee put bëëtö kaace na bäre.»
english: But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the Lord, and there abide for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøre ma Elkana aköö jïgø, ni «Tïïc mana beerra eni ki jïrï. Løny ki man dööŋï këël mano män nyilaal ki caak; 'ba beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk luumme thur kare.» Kanyøgønø, Anna aput dööŋŋe ni bëëde ni dhwøtha wääde këël mana män gø ki caak.
english: And Elkanah her husband said unto her, Do what seemeth thee good; tarry until thou have weaned him; only the Lord establish his word. So the woman abode, and gave her son suck until she weaned him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Anna na män nyilaal ki caak, nyilaal aput lwør ni aae ki gø, ni kääde ki nyirøøa ma rwaath mo cwiiye adäk, ki møø mo røm ki rumi mana cwøl ni iipa, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo ena ya agwäy, ni aae ni kïth nyilaal Øt Wuuö Jwøk na en Cëëlö. 'Ba kar kaagø, nyilaal poot thiinh døc.
english: And when she had weaned him, she took him up with her, with three bullocks, and one ephah of flour, and a bottle of wine, and brought him unto the house of the Lord in Shiloh: and the child was young.

anywaa: Køøre geni nyirøønnøgø na rwaath enø aŋaalge, ni kïthge nyilaal baŋ Ëli.
english: And they slew a bullock, and brought the child to Eli.

anywaa: 'Ba Anna aköö jï Ëli, «Wui kwäärö, aani a kööŋŋa riï; kar kaaca dhaaŋŋa cuŋŋö buutï kany na lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk beeye aani.
english: And she said, Oh my lord, as thy soul liveth, my lord, I am the woman that stood by thee here, praying unto the Lord.

anywaa: Aana lämö naa jïta ki nyilaal, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cïp nyilaari en jïra.
english: For this child I prayed; and the Lord hath given me my petition which I asked of him:

anywaa: Aani thuwø nyilaal man acïba kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk; këël yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët eni puta bëëtö ni ena kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk.» Køøre Elkana Wuuö Jwøk awøøre kaace.
english: Therefore also I have lent him to the Lord; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the Lord. And he worshipped the Lord there.

anywaa: Køøre Anna Wuuö Jwøk apwøe ni kööe, «Yia atïmö ni met ki køørï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö teeki mara ni tïme ni cäätha maal ki køørï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk; aana jïtö ki teek ki man cääna ki nyïïmän 'moa, ni ö yia ni tïme ni met kiper køny marï.
english: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the Lord, mine horn is exalted in the Lord: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat mo bëëtö mare ena kur keere mo caala ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, bäŋ jwøk mør mo caala ïïni këët, ni bäŋ jwøk mo teek mo caala ïïni, ï na Jwøwa.
english: There is none holy as the Lord: for there is none beside thee: neither is there any rock like our God.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jiy, kär cäänö maau ree këët nou ŋwöö; kär dee gïn ma gïr ŋwøe mo cura dhøgu; kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk mo jammi bëët ŋäya eni, ni beeye eni wø neet bëëtö mar jiy.
english: Talk no more so exceeding proudly; let not arrogancy come out of your mouth: for the Lord is a God of knowledge, and by him actions are weighed.

anywaa: Eni, jap leny mo jøøa teek di raanynyø; 'ba jøøa jägö mooe mooø ki teek.
english: The bows of the mighty men are broken, and they that stumbled are girded with strength.

anywaa: Jøøa bëëdö ni jïge da cam mo päl, ge ööl ni määnyge ki tïïe, nee ge jïtge ki caammi; 'ba jøøa bëëdö no onäk käci, ge jäŋ. Këël dhaagø ma bwøc nyöödö ko obwöre abïriiø, 'ba dhaagø mo jïre do obwöre mo thööth cäŋa ööllö.
english: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread; and they that were hungry ceased: so that the barren hath born seven; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø wëëk dhaanhø thøø, ni beeye wø wëëk dhaanhø kwøw; beeye eni ni wø kïth dhaanhø kanya näk kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni beeye wø tïŋ dhaanhø maal.
english: The Lord killeth, and maketh alive: he bringeth down to the grave, and bringeth up.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø tïïc dhaanhø ni can, ni beeye wø tïïc dhaanhø no okwär; beeye eni wø tïïc dhaanhø ni bäŋ kare, ni beeye eni thuwø wø tïïc dhaanhø ni kare dwøŋ.
english: The Lord maketh poor, and maketh rich: he bringeth low, and lifteth up.

anywaa: Beeye eni wø tïŋ ŋata can maal ki yi bur, ni beeye eni wø mak cer ŋata can ni tïŋ gø maal ki wïthur, ni cïp ge kanya ciel ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ni pïge piny kwör jøøa no owøørø; kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye na cwääc piny ni teek, ni piny bäre ena cere.
english: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the Lord's, and he hath set the world upon them.

anywaa: Eni jøøa näk bëëtge beyø, na näk moe, di gwøø, 'ba jø raay bëëdö ni geno nikïïl jaak yi muudhö; kiper teek mar dhaanhø keere bäŋ gïn kønye.
english: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.

anywaa: Jø wø bëëdö ni ge gëëmö ki Wuuö Jwøk ge di raanynyø, ni ö wëëc Jwøki ni märe bäätge kaamar køth mo pöödö maal. Wuuö Jwøk luumme ŋøle ŋølø bäät piny bäre, këël mano këët teegi mo piny. Ni ö eni ni cïp teek mare jï ŋato cuume na nyeya, ni tïïc teek mar ŋatøgø noo røøny enø ni cäätha maal.»
english: The adversaries of the Lord shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the Lord shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.

anywaa: Køøre Elkana aay ni døø paare na en Reema. 'Ba nyilaarø na Camiel enø adööŋ buut Ëli na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni bëëde ni tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the Lord before Eli the priest.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ëli beege jiy mo wïthge reyø; geni luum Wuuö Jwøk kärge kïth cwïnyge,
english: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not the Lord.

anywaa: këël jöör tïïc mana doo tïïc dïlämme kiper jiy kärge kïth cwïnyge thuwø. Kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo cïpö ko olämi, kany wø poode ni rïŋö poot twak yi maac, ŋat tïïc mar dïlämi wø öö ni cere da gïn wø lääm rïŋ wøk ki gø mo lweete adäk.
english: And the priests' custom with the people was, that, when any man offered sacrifice, the priest's servant came, while the flesh was in seething, with a fleshhook of three teeth in his hand;

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø rwaage yi gïna thaal rïŋö ki gø, nee dhiithi, wala athaa, wala dak; 'ba rïŋö bäre mano käl gïr läämö manøgø wøk puta tïmö na mar dïlämi. Manøgø beeye gïna tïïc wäät Ëli dëët jø Icriel Cëëlö kaagø, ni beege jø Icriel bëët mo wø ööi ni wø cïpi ko olämme.
english: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

anywaa: Këël kany wø poode ni dwäälö poot kär duuŋö, ŋat tïïc mar dïlämi wø puta öö ni kööe jï ŋata näk cïpö ko olämi, ni «Cïpï ki rïŋö nee bul jï dïlämi, kiper eni ba many rïŋö baŋï mo othaalø, 'ba beeye rïŋö mana näk numö keere ni manynye.»
english: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋata cïpö ko olämi köö jï ŋat tïïc manøgø, ni «Ka adïëri møn, dwäälö doo kwøŋa duuŋ dïkwøŋ, køøre nø ïïno lwötï ki rïŋö mana manynyï jaak;» kar kaagø ŋat tïïc wø puta köö, «Ba løny, cïpï jïra ennø; 'ba ni näk mo ba cïpï, käla kälö ki teek.»
english: And if any man said unto him, Let them not fail to burn the fat presently, and then take as much as thy soul desireth; then he would answer him, Nay; but thou shalt give it me now: and if not, I will take it by force.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø bääyö mar jagøgø na dïlämme yøø aput tïmö ni dwøŋ døc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, kiper geni olämme mo Wuuö Jwøk ataakge.
english: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the Lord: for men abhorred the offering of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni Camiel poot na nyilaal, eni tïïö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk no oruyö ki ëëput mo tïïc ka waac lïïna.
english: But Samuel ministered before the Lord, being a child, girded with a linen ephod.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yi cwiir cooth menni ma Anna wø cwääö jïre ka abïï köö ni käl gø baŋ wääde kany wø öge ki cwøre ni ge ööa kuna cïpge ko olämi man wø cïp ki yi cwiir cooth.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little coat, and brought it to him from year to year, when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëli, Elkana ki cïïe ma Anna wø gwïëdhe gwïëdhö ni kööe, «Wuuö Jwøk uuno mooe ko obwöre, nee tïmge na kar nyilaal mana cïp kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk.» Køøre ge wø puta døø poge kar bëëtö marge.
english: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The Lord give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the Lord. And they went unto their own home.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Anna akønye; ni ö Anna ni nyööde ko obwöre adäk ma cwøw ko obwöre ariiø ma mään. 'Ba nyilaarø na Camiel enø abëëdö ni døøŋŋø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Lord visited Hannah, so that she conceived, and bare three sons and two daughters. And the child Samuel grew before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëli atïmö na jaal døc. Ni ö eni ni wïny jammi bëët moa reyø mo wø tïïc wääte dëët jø Icriel; këël gïn wø tïïcge kany wø cige baŋ mään mo wø tïïö dho oduŋkaany røømmø mar Wuuö Jwøk ni buutge ki ge, awïnynye thuwø.
english: Now Eli was very old, and heard all that his sons did unto all Israel; and how they lay with the women that assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëli aköö jï wääte, «?Aperŋø na tïïyu teeŋ gïï ni reyø ii ni wïnynya baŋ jøøi bëët ii?
english: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.

anywaa: Wui nyie wääta, luup moa wïnynya kiperu ni car jic Wuuö Jwøki yïthakicge keerge ii, paa wøpe na bäre.
english: Nay, my sons; for it is no good report that I hear: ye make the Lord's people to transgress.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhaanhø bääya dëër dhaanhø mør, Jwøk beeye noo tïmö na dïthääy yïthakicge. ?'Ba ni näk dhaanhø bääya dëër Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa noo tïme na dïthääy jïge?» 'Ba wäät Ëli dwør wääge kärge kam leŋ na bäre, kiper Wuuö Jwøk oløny ni manynya geni nee ge nääe.
english: If one man sin against another, the judge shall judge him: but if a man sin against the Lord, who shall entreat for him? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father, because the Lord would slay them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaarø na Camiel enø adøøŋŋø, ni Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki gø; këël jiy thuwø yïthge met ki gø.
english: And the child Samuel grew on, and was in favour both with the Lord, and also with men.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk mør aö baŋ Ëli ni kööe jïgø, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ‹?Aŋø, aani dëëra kära nyoodhø jï dhi øt kwaru kanya bëëtge Ijep po Peerø na näk kar bëët laŋ?
english: And there came a man of God unto Eli, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father, when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh's house?

anywaa: ?A aani, ge kära jierø ki røk wïth tuŋi mo Icriel nee bëëtge na dïlämme mo tïnynya aani, nee cige buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mara, nee gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met waaŋge, nee bëëtge ni ge käära ëëput nyïma? ?A aani, olämme bëët mo wø waaŋ ki maac ni wø cïp jø Icrielli, kära cïbö jï dhi øt kwaru?
english: And did I choose him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to offer upon mine altar, to burn incense, to wear an ephod before me? and did I give unto the house of thy father all the offerings made by fire of the children of Israel?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø na päätu olämme ki muuce 'moa na caana ni doo cïba kar bëëtö mara, ki man caammu rou ni lørru ki kwöra met røk gïï wø cïp jiya ma jø Icriel? ?A ï na Ëli, aperŋø na wøørï wäätï ni kaala aani?›
english: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel mare acaane ni kööe, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aana köö ni dhi øtø marï ki dhi øt kwaru doo bëëdö ni tïïö geni na dïlämme nyïma cooth;› 'ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk mare acaane ni kööe, ni ‹Gïnögø ba tïïa këët, kiper jø wø wøør aani, ge wøøra wøørø; 'ba jø wø taak aani, ge tïmö ni geno taaø thuwø.
english: Wherefore the Lord God of Israel saith, I said indeed that thy house, and the house of thy father, should walk before me for ever: but now the Lord saith, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

anywaa: Neenï, da nïne mo öö mo teek marï ki teek mar dhi øt kwaru raanynya raanynyø, këël mano tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo tïmö na jaal røk nyïïkwaayï.
english: Behold, the days come, that I will cut off thine arm, and the arm of thy father's house, that there shall not be an old man in thine house.

anywaa: Ni ö ïïni ki nyïïkwaayï ni jwørru gïï mo leth moo tägi yi øda näk kar bëëtö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba a poot tïïö ki gïï mo beyø jï jø Icriel. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo tïmö na jaal røk nyïïkwaayï na bäre bäre.
english: And thou shalt see an enemy in my habitation, in all the wealth which God shall give Israel: and there shall not be an old man in thine house for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikwaarï mano wiia ni kär thøw nee tïï dïlämi tïïe, nyeŋŋe ränynyö ki jwøk, ni bëëde ni cwïnye kïmmö; ni ö nyïïkwaayï bëët mo ööi køørï ni thøwge ni dëëtge poot teek.
english: And the man of thine, whom I shall not cut off from mine altar, shall be to consume thine eyes, and to grieve thine heart: and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba gïno tägi dëët wäätï karge riet, ni beege Apni ki Piniac, beeye noo tïmö na nyuudhi jïrï; geni, ge thøw na aciel bëët yi cäŋ aciel.
english: And this shall be a sign unto thee, that shall come upon thy two sons, on Hophni and Phinehas; in one day they shall die both of them.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, dïlämi mo di ŋäädhö thïïŋa thïïŋö kiper dëëra, ni beeye dïlämi mo tïïe bëët tïïe ka køør mana manynya ki mana caara; ni tïïa dhi øtø mare ni teek, ni bëëde ni tïïö cooth nyïm ŋat wø røønya.
english: And I will raise me up a faithful priest, that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind: and I will build him a sure house; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat moo bøth ki thøø ri dhi øtø marï öö ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm ŋato thïïŋa na dïlämi, kiper nee jïte ki gwel mo thenh wala gïn came, ni kwääe nee eni jïte ki kar tïïc kwör tïïe mo wø tïï dïlämme yïthge kiper nee jïte ki gïn came.› »
english: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread, and shall say, Put me, I pray thee, into one of the priests' offices, that I may eat a piece of bread.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaarø na Camiel enø bëëdö buut Ëli ni tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba ki yïth nïreka, bäŋ luup mo thööth mo ocaan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni bäŋ luup mo thööth mo ee nyoodhø ki ri lääk.
english: And the child Samuel ministered unto the Lord before Eli. And the word of the Lord was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

anywaa: Kar kaaca Ëli bëëdö ni nyeŋŋe rääbö, ni ba rääŋö døc. 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ki wäär ni eno butö kar niine mare,
english: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;

anywaa: ni lamba mar Wuuö Jwøk poot kär thøw, ni Camiel obut piny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye øda näk acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy bëëdö yie,
english: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the Lord, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk Camiel acwøle. Køøre Camiel aköö, ni «Aani en.»
english: That the Lord called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel areŋ baŋ Ëli ni kööe, ni «Aana öö. ?A kärï cwølø na bëëde?» 'Ba Ëli aköö, ni «Ï kära cwølø; ci døø kun butï piny.» Køøre Camiel aay ni but piny.
english: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cwötö, ni «Camiel!» Ni ö Camielli ni päny maal ni ci baŋ Ëli, ni kööe, ni «Aana öö. ?A kärï cwølø na bëëde?» 'Ba aløk Ëli jïre, ni «Ï kära cwølø, wääda; ci cäŋ but piny.»
english: And the Lord called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel kuue ni manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, kiper Wuuö Jwøk luumme poot käre nyoodhø jïre.
english: Now Samuel did not yet know the Lord, neither was the word of the Lord yet revealed unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Camiel acäŋ cwøllø ri dääge, ni ö Camielli ni päny maal ni ci baŋ Ëli, ni kööe, ni «Aana öö. ?A kärï cwølø na bëëde?» Køøre aput Ëli joot ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cøør nyilaal enø.
english: And the Lord called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the Lord had called the child.

anywaa: Ni kö Ëli jï Camiel, «Ci but piny, 'ba ni näk miï cäŋe ka cwøllø, wärï kööï, ‹Wui Wuuö Jwøk, caan marï nø, kiper a na laŋŋï, ïtha yaa ciiø.› » Køøre Camiel adøøk ni but piny kare.
english: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, Lord; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aöö ni cuŋŋe ni cwöte kaawat mana dïkwøŋ, ni «Camiel! Camiel!» Ni kö Camielli, ni «Caan marï nø, kiper a na laŋŋï, ïtha yaa ciiø.»
english: And the Lord came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Camiel, ni «Neenï, aani a tïïö dï Icriel ki gïn mo jøw owïny gø bëët cwïnyge bwøk ki gø.
english: And the Lord said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, gïna cääna kipere ni tïïa tïïö dëër dhi øt Ëli puta ka tïïc, ki mano täge ki luubö mana dïkwøŋ këël mana na aŋuudi.
english: In that day I will perform against Eli all things which I have spoken concerning his house: when I begin, I will also make an end.

anywaa: Kiper aani, yaa nø caan jï Ëli ni dhi øde jääla jäälö na bäre bäre, kiper bääyö manøgø ŋääe, kiper wääte, Jwøk apäätge, 'ba eni wääte käre jooø.
english: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth; because his sons made themselves vile, and he restrained them not.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aana kööŋ jï dhi øt Ëli ni gïna raac na baacge ba wëënna na bäre bäre, këël ge doo cïpö ko olämme wala muuce.»
english: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli, that the iniquity of Eli's house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aput bëëtö no obut piny këël amöölla. Køøre ena ö maal ni jaam dhøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba Camiel alwäyö ki man caan gïna joode jï Ëli.
english: And Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of the house of the Lord. And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëli Camiel acwøle ni kööe, «Nyie Camiel, wääda.» Ni kö Camielli, ni «Aani en.»
english: Then Eli called Samuel, and said, Samuel, my son. And he answered, Here am I.

anywaa: Ni kö Ëli, na «?Agïnaŋø na caan Wuuö Jwøki jïrï? Nyie, kär mooŋï ki aani. Ni näk mo luup moa care bëët mooŋï mooŋø ki aani, Wuuö Jwøk tïïö ki gïn mo dwøŋ mo raac dëërï.»
english: And he said, What is the thing that the Lord hath said unto thee? I pray thee hide it not from me: God do so to thee, and more also, if thou hide any thing from me of all the things that he said unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel luup bëët moa caan jïre aput caan jï Ëli, ni bäŋgø mo ee mooŋø. Køøre Ëli aköö, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk møn; beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc mana beer ki jïre.»
english: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the Lord: let him do what seemeth him good.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel adøøŋŋø ni Wuuö Jwøk nut buute, ni ö luupi bëët moa car Wuuö Jwøki jï Camiel ni thurge karge.
english: And Samuel grew, and the Lord was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët, ki mana täge ki Daan na en jï løø wï-piny këël mana këët Bëërcïïba na en jï løø tier-piny, ŋäcge ni Camiel otïïc Wuuö Jwøki na nyikugö mare.
english: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ tägö ki man nyøth ree Cëëlö, ni ree nyøthe ka køør luup mo wø care jï Camiel. Ki køør manøgønø, luup moa car Camielli aput wïnynye jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: And the Lord appeared again in Shiloh: for the Lord revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel aci baŋ jø Pilitin nee këëtge ki ge, ni tïïcge twïër marge buut kanya cwøl ni Ëbënëdhër, ni ö jø Pilitinni thuwø ni tïïcge twïër marge buut päänya cwøl na Apëk.
english: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and pitched beside Eben–ezer: and the Philistines pitched in Aphek.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin rege acïïmge na dhøgi ni täkge ki leny ki jø Icriel. 'Ba kanya këël leny, jø Icriel abööt jø Pilitinni. Ni ö jø Pilitinni ni nääge ki jiy røk jø Icriel mo jïtö ki kume aŋween pwöl leny.
english: And the Philistines put themselves in array against Israel: and when they joined battle, Israel was smitten before the Philistines: and they slew of the army in the field about four thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi mo Icriel na duuge twïër, jø døøŋŋø moge aköö, na «?Aŋø ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk ø böötö dïcäŋi en nyïm jø Pilitin? Beerra man øømmø acanduk Cëëlö, ni beeye acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, nee bëëde dïïø nee ø kønye ceŋ nyïïmän moø.»
english: And when the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Wherefore hath the Lord smitten us to day before the Philistines? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of Shiloh unto us, that, when it cometh among us, it may save us out of the hand of our enemies.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny ajääk Cëëlö ki jiy, ni ö jøøa jääŋŋi ni kälge acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni wø nyooth ajiem nyec mare ki yïthakic gïïa no otïïö ni caala nyïïatwiet maal ni wø cwøl ni kirubëlli na en bäät acanduk; 'ba wäät Ëli karge riet, ni beege Apni ki Piniac, ge bëëdö buut acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy.
english: So the people sent to Shiloh, that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth between the cherubims: and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö acanduki man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy na pïïe twïër, jø Icriel bëët aput kwöŋŋö døc ni döötge ena maal, ni ö pinynyi ni jøl döötge.
english: And when the ark of the covenant of the Lord came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Pilitinni na wïnyge dwør kwöŋŋö, gena köö, na «?Aŋø, kwöŋŋö man ni ba thiinh en ni en yi twïër mar jø Ibaru tiere aŋøøni?» 'Ba awïnyge na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy apïï twïër.
english: And when the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, What meaneth the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews? And they understood that the ark of the Lord was come into the camp.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin alwäyö ni köge, ni «Beeye Jwøk na ö twïër mar jø Ibaru.» Ni cäŋge köö, ni «Ø puta ränynyö nø, kiper bäŋ gïn mo caala man mo okwøŋ tägö cøøn.
english: And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

anywaa: Øøna ränynyö møn! ?Aŋa noo køny øøni ceŋ juu moøgø ni teek yøø? Moøgø beege juuga raany jø Ijep ki teeŋ gïï mo leth døc dï paap.
english: Woe unto us! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness.

anywaa: Wui, jø Pilitin, maaø røø ni bëëdø ni øøna cwøw, kiper nøø ba tïmø na laaŋe mo jø Ibaru kaawat man bëëtge ni gena laaŋe 'moø en; 'ba bëëdø ni øøna cwøw ni këëdø ki geni.»
english: Be strong, and quit yourselves like men, O ye Philistines, that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews, as they have been to you: quit yourselves like men, and fight.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Pilitin akëëdö ki jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni cäŋi böötö, ni ö ŋati man nø røk jø leny mo jø Icriel ni reŋ poge. 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel moa thøw thööth døc; ni beege jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki tietge ma kume ma pïëradäk.
english: And the Philistines fought, and Israel was smitten, and they fled every man into his tent: and there was a very great slaughter; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen.
