anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Cøøl cäänö ka Akiya ni beeye Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, jø leny mo jø Pilitin aput tïmö ni ge ŋurö yi twïër marge ni döötge wïnyö ni nyänhnha maal; kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni «Weyï jaak nø.»
english: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw thine hand.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl ki jø leny bëët moa en buute rege adwalge na aciel ni cige baŋ leny; 'ba ka adïëri møn, kanya pïïcge, ajootge ni jø leny mo jø Pilitin wïthge rege ege kierø døc, ni ŋati man nø cwøpa wati ko opëëllö.
english: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man's sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, jø Ibaru moa näk okwøŋ ci baŋ jø leny mo jø Pilitin nee kuutge ki ge, ni beeye kanya ö jø Pilitinni na tïïcge twïër marge nee këëtge ki jø Icriel, jø Ibaru moøgø rege aløkge ni duuge baŋ tuuŋge ma jø Icriel na en ri Cøøl ki Jönathan.
english: Moreover the Hebrews that were with the Philistines before that time, which went up with them into the camp from the country round about, even they also turned to be with the Israelites that were with Saul and Jonathan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli moa näk rege ege kan mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem na wïnyge gø ni jø Pilitin abwøk, gena put reŋ køør jø Pilitin ni 'näkge geni.
english: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel aput piem dïcäŋögø, ni ö lenynyi ni put nyaay ni kaal Bëëth-Awëën.
english: So the Lord saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø jø leny mo jø Icriel geno ööl døc, kiper Cøøl jiy awëëk kööŋ ni kööe, na «Acïëni oen bäät ŋato cämö ni cäŋ poot kär pädhö, këël kanyo coola kwöra dëët nyïïmän 'moa.» Kanyøgønø, aput tïmö ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo cam ee belø røk jø leny mo jø Icriel.
english: And the men of Israel were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening, that I may be avenged on mine enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi moøgø bëët ni pïïcge ri lul ni dønyge yie, ni jootge maar kïc ni piny manøgø bäre ogääbö ki gø.
english: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døny jiyi yi lul, ka adïëri møn, maar kïc bëëdö ni päl jaak; 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo olwötö ki maar kïc ni kïth gø dhee, kiper jiy olwäyö ki kööŋ mana nø jïëcge.
english: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan, kanya ö wänni na wëëk jiy kööŋ, gïnögø käre wïnynyö. Kiper manøgønø, Jönathan athøra mana kääre ki cere tier gø arwaak yi maar kïc, ni kïth gø dhee, ni ö dëëre ni put nithïk.
english: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø aciel røk jiy, mare acaane ni kööe, ni «Wäru, jiy anø cäänne døc ni wëëk jiy kööŋ, ni kööe, na ‹Acïëni oen bäät ŋato cämö dïcäŋi.› » 'Ba kar kaagø møn, jiy oööl døc.
english: Then answered one of the people, and said, Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day. And the people were faint.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan aköö, ni «Wära wïth jiy akiere. Neennu, ki køør mana bela maar kïc man ni thiinh en, dëëra aput nithïk.
english: Then said Jonathan, My father hath troubled the land: see, I pray you, how mine eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, doo na jiy ocämö ki gïïa twierge baŋ nyïïmän moge dïcäŋi en, jø Pilitin ba doo puta böötö døc ni kaala man? Kiper ennø, jiy moa 'näk dëët jø Pilitin ba thööth døc.»
english: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø jø leny mo jø Icriel, jø Pilitin aböötge ni 'näkge geni ki mana täge ki Mikmac këël mana këët Ayalön. 'Ba kar kaagø, jø Icriel oööl døc.
english: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were very faint.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel aput läät kuna twierge dïëk, ki dhäk, ki nyïïrøøe, ni putge lääy moøgø ŋarø piny yïth ŋøøm kaagø; ni putge rïk lääy moøgø cam ni rege ege jääbö ki rem jaak.
english: And the people flew upon the spoil, and took sheep, and oxen, and calves, and slew them on the ground: and the people did eat them with the blood.

anywaa: Køøre acaan jï Cøøl ni køp, ni «Neenï, jiy anø tägö ki man tïïge ki raay dëër Wuuö Jwøk, kiper rïŋ camge ni rege ege jääbö ki rem.» Ni kö Cøølli, ni «Uuna nø tägö ki man tïïu ki gïn mo raac døc; ennø, määnyu ki kïdi mo dwøŋ døc ni ŋïëlu gø baŋa kany.»
english: Then they told Saul, saying, Behold, the people sin against the Lord, in that they eat with the blood. And he said, Ye have transgressed: roll a great stone unto me this day.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö, ni «Cou ni caathu dï jiy ni caannu gø jïge ni Cøøl aköö, ni ‹Ŋati man nø dëëtu käl dhieŋ mare, wala diel mare, ni ŋaal gø kany bäät kïdi man, ni cäme; 'ba käru tïïö ki raay dëër Wuuö Jwøk ki man cammu rïŋ mo rege ege jääbö ki rem.› » 'Ba dïwäänögø jiy bëët aput öö ni ŋati man nø dhieŋ mare di peeyø ni ŋaal gø bäät kïdi kaagø.
english: And Saul said, Disperse yourselves among the people, and say unto them, Bring me hither every man his ox, and every man his sheep, and slay them here, and eat; and sin not against the Lord in eating with the blood. And all the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and slew them there.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace; ni manøgø beeye gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana dïkwøŋ na tïïc Cøølli jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Saul built an altar unto the Lord: the same was the first altar that he built unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï jø leny, ni «Ø aa løøyø piny ni läpø køør jø Pilitin ki wäär ennø, nee gïïa en jïge twierø këël mano tïm pinynyi na amöölla, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo wiiø dëëtge.» Ni köge, ni «Tïïc gïna caarï ni beerra eni ki jïrï jaak.» 'Ba Akiya Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköö, ni «Beerra man pëënynyø Jwøk kany dïturu.»
english: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.

anywaa: Ni ö Cøølli ni pëëny Jwøk ni kööe, ni «?Läpa køør jø Pilitin? ?A ni näk mo aano läp køørge, ge cïbï ceŋ jø Icriel?» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo ee løø jï Cøøl dïcäŋögø.
english: And Saul asked counsel of God, Shall I go down after the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel? But he answered him not that day.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö jï kwääc lwaae, ni «Uuni bëët u na kwääc lwaae, nyänhnhu kany mo cään nee bääyö man no otägö dïcäŋi en nee tiere manynyu ni jootu gø.
english: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, Jwø wø piem jø Icriel, këël bääyö manøgø tïïya wääda ma Jönathan, ka adïëri møn, eni put ka 'näk.» 'Ba ki røk jiy bëët, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo mare ee løø jï Cøøl.
english: For, as the Lord liveth, which saveth Israel, though it be in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die. But there was not a man among all the people that answered him.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl acäŋ köö jï jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët, ni «Uuni, cou løøk aciel, nee aani ki wääda ma Jönathan nee wa ciwa løøk maya.» Ni kö jiyi jï Cøøl, ni «Tïïc gïna caarï ni beerra eni ki jïrï jaak.»
english: Then said he unto all Israel, Be ye on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said unto Saul, Do what seemeth good unto thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ni «Nyooth marï na adïëri, nee ŋata bääyö joot yïthakicwa.» 'Ba Jönathan ki Cøøl aput nyooth, ni ö jø Icrielli ni dööŋge wøk.
english: Therefore Saul said unto the Lord God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö, ni «Ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw tïïyu kipera ki wääda ma Jönathan, nee ŋata bääyö joot yïthakicwa.» Ni ö Jönathanni ni nyoodhi.
english: And Saul said, Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son. And Jonathan was taken.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Jönathan, ni «Ennø, gïna näk iï tïïö caanï jïra.» Kanyøgønø, Jönathan mare acaane ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da maar kïc mo thiinh maa bela, ni lwøra ka tier athøra mana en cera. 'Ba ennø møn, a nut ennø; løny ki man 'näk aani.»
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what thou hast done. And Jonathan told him, and said, I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand, and, lo, I must die.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö, «Nyie Jönathan, ka adïëri møn, ï di nääö. Ni näk miï kär nääö, beerra man ö Jwøki ni raany aani.»
english: And Saul answered, God do so and more also: for thou shalt surely die, Jonathan.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy aköö jï Cøøl, «?Aŋø, Jönathan na tïïö døc, ni jït jø Icrielli ki køny man ni dwøŋ en ki køøre, doo nääö møn? Gïnögø ba doo tägö na bäre bäre. Ki nyeŋ Jwøa kwøw, këël jëën wï Jönathan aciel, ba doo pätha piny na bäre bäre, kiper Jönathan atïïö ki Jwøk na aciel dïcäŋi en.» Kanyøgønø, Jönathan aput jiyi køny ni käri nääö.
english: And the people said unto Saul, Shall Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel? God forbid: as the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground; for he hath wrought with God this day. So the people rescued Jonathan, that he died not.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl jø Pilitin aput wec ni käre läp køørge këët, ni ö jø Pilitinni ni putge ci poge.
english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines: and the Philistines went to their own place.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Cøølli ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel, ena këëdö ki nyïïmän moe bëët kwöra enge yïthge, ni beege jø Möap, ki jø Amön, ki jø Ëdöm, ki nyeye moa bëëdö Dhöba, ki jø Pilitin; ni put tïmö ni kany wø ci Cøølli yie jaak, kwör pute ka cool.
english: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel, and fought against all his enemies on every side, against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines: and whithersoever he turned himself, he vexed them.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl akëëdö ki leny mo teek, ni bööt jø Amalëk, ni piem jø Icriel ceŋ jø Amalëk moa ö baŋge na twier geni.
english: And he gathered an host, and smote the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ wäät Cøøl beege Jönathan, ki Yecuwi, ki Mëlkica; ni nyeŋ nyïïe na näk ariiø beege Mërap na dwøŋ ki Mikal na thiinh.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, and Ishui, and Malchi–shua: and the names of his two daughters were these; the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal:

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ cï Cøøl beeye Akinaam nya Akimaath. 'Ba nyeŋ kwääy lwaa leny mar Cøøl beeye Abinër o Nër, ni Nër beeye wää Cøølli cöök wänni.
english: And the name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz: and the name of the captain of his host was Abner, the son of Ner, Saul's uncle.

anywaa: 'Ba wää Cøølli beeye Kic, ni Nër wää Abinër beeye wär Abiël.
english: And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïra bëët Cøølli na nyeya, lenye mo teek døc atägö yïthakicge ki jø Pilitin; 'ba kar kaagø, Cøøl kany wø jïte ki dhaanhø mo cwïnye da cer wala dhaanhø mo teek ki leny, pute ka nyïï dëëre.
english: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul: and when Saul saw any strong man, or any valiant man, he took him unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Aani, aana nø jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki ni thiia maaw wïïï naa røønya ïïni na nyeya jï jiye ma jø Icriel; 'ba ennø, cek ïthï ni wïnynyï dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Samuel also said unto Saul, The Lord sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Jø Amalëk jääla jäälö kiper gïna tïïcge dëët jø Icriel, kanya møørge piny nyïm jø Icriel waŋjöö ni këëtge ki geni kanya öge wøk ki Ijep.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ciï ni tugï jø Amalëk ni dïïrï wïthge na bäre, këël gïïa en jïge bëët, ni bäŋgø mo weyï ni kwøw; cwøw ki mään, ko obwöre, ko obwöre moa näk poot dhøøth, këël dhäk ki dïëk, ka athïrööle ka arëëni, wär put 'näk ge bëët.› »
english: Now go and smite Amalek, and utterly destroy all that they have, and spare them not; but slay both man and woman, infant and suckling, ox and sheep, camel and ass.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl jø leny mo jø Icriel aput cwøl ni kwaan geni päänya cwøl ni Thëlëm, ni tïm jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel na kume ma dïpe ariiø, ni kwään tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda beege kume apaar, ni jøøgø bëët beege jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki tietge.
english: And Saul gathered the people together, and numbered them in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen, and ten thousand men of Judah.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl ki jø leny moøgø gena ci pääny mar jø Amalëk, ni kange rege yïthakic kïte moa en buut päänyögø.
english: And Saul came to a city of Amalek, and laid wait in the valley.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö jï jø Këën, ni «Ööu maal ni daagu rou buut jø Amalëk, nou ba rwöba ki geni na aciel; kiper uuni bäth ec maru anyoothu jï jø Icriel bëët kanya öge wøk ki Ijep.» Køøre jø Këën rege aputge daak buut jø Amalëk.
english: And Saul said unto the Kenites, Go, depart, get you down from among the Amalekites, lest I destroy you with them: for ye shewed kindness to all the children of Israel, when they came up out of Egypt. So the Kenites departed from among the Amalekites.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl jø Amalëk aput tuk, ni 'näk geni ki mana täge ki Ëwlath këël mana këët paap Cur, na en løø Ijep jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And Saul smote the Amalekites from Havilah until thou comest to Shur, that is over against Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl, Agaak nyeny jø Amalëk amaae, ni 'näk jø Amalëk bëët ko opëëllö.
english: And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl ki jø leny, Agaak awecge ni kwøw, ni wecge lääy moa beyø geni røk dïëk, ki dhäk, ki nyïïrøøe moa no olør, ki nyïïrööm, ni lääy moøgø beege moa beyø bëët, ni kärge jïëy ki man 'näkge geni bëët; 'ba lääy moa no otaaø na reyø aputge 'näk na bäre bäre.
english: But Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep, and of the oxen, and of the fatlings, and the lambs, and all that was good, and would not utterly destroy them: but every thing that was vile and refuse, that they destroyed utterly.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dwøre acaane jï Camiel ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto Samuel, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cwïnya apädhö kiper mana tïïa Cøøl na nyeya, kiper ena gaa wøk ki man cäädhe køøra, ni käre ciik 'moa kïth bäät tïïc.» 'Ba Camiel awëër døc kiper gïna wïnynye na tïïc Cøølli, ni jwöŋe dëër Wuuö Jwøk ki yi wäär bäre.
english: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and hath not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto the Lord all night.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, Camiel apäny maal ni aae nee røømge ki Cøøl. 'Ba acaan jï Camiel, ni «Cøøl oci pääny mana cwøl ni Karmël; 'ba ena cööth piny ki gïr par wïc kaace, ni tïïya nyeŋŋe nee wïnye; køøre ena gak ni pööth Gëlgela.»
english: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Camielli baŋ Cøøl, Cøøl Camiel amäädhe ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ïïno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki. Aani, ciik Wuuö Jwøk akïtha bäät tïïc.»
english: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the Lord: I have performed the commandment of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö, na «?Aŋø, a dööt dïëk ki dööt dhäk mo wïnynya ii a mo ŋø?»
english: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

anywaa: Ni kö Cøølli, ni «Beege moa käl jø lenynyi ki baŋ jø Amalëk, kiper geni dïëk moa beyø ki dhäk moa beyø awecge ni kwøw, kiper nee cïpge no olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï; 'ba moa dööŋ anäkwa na bäre bäre.»
english: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Lïŋï nø, nee gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra yawïtïni caana jïrï.» Ni kö Cøølli jïgø, ni «Wøp, caanï nø.»
english: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell thee what the Lord hath said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö, na «?Aŋø, këël na bëëdï ni karï thiinh ki jïrï, ï kär tïmö na bwödhi mar wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët? Wuuö Jwøk ïïna tïïe nee wïïï thïïmmi ki maaw ni røønya ïïni na nyeya bäät jø Icriel;
english: And Samuel said, When thou wast little in thine own sight, wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel, and the Lord anointed thee king over Israel?

anywaa: ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ ïïni ni kööe, ni ‹Ci baŋ jø Amalëk na tïïc gïna raac, ni dïïrï wïthge na bäre bäre, ni këëdï ki geni këël mano thöörï geni.›
english: And the Lord sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø na ba leŋï dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïme niï lääta baŋ twëër en, niï tïïya gïn mo nëëni ni raac ki jï Wuuö Jwøk?»
english: Wherefore then didst thou not obey the voice of the Lord, but didst fly upon the spoil, and didst evil in the sight of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö jï Camiel, ni «Aani dwør Wuuö Jwøk aleŋa, ni cøøa baŋ gïna ö Wuuö Jwøki na jääŋ a baŋe; 'ba Agaak nyeny jø Amalëk amaa ni käla gø, ni dïïra wïth jø Amalëk na bäre bäre.
english: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of the Lord, and have gone the way which the Lord sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny, dïëk moa beyø ki dhäk moa beyø, na no owärö ni wär 'näk bëët, atwierge ni kälge ge nee cïp no olämme Gëlgela jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï.»
english: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto the Lord thy God in Gilgal.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk yie met ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki teeŋ olämme møøk ni kaala man wïny dwøre, eni na Wuuö Jwøk? Neenï, ki man wïny dwøre pöödha eni døc ni kaala man cïpö ko olämme jïre, ni ki man leŋ mare pöödha eni ni kaala man waaŋ dwäle mo nyöök rööm no olämme.
english: And Samuel said, Hath the Lord as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of the Lord? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

anywaa: Kiper ki man gëëmö ki Wuuö Jwøk caala raay mo ŋat wø tïïc tïï ajwøa, ni ö teek wïci ni caal raac ŋat wø lam juu møøk. 'Ba ennø møn, kiper mana nø kwierï dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk thuwø ïïna kwiere ki man bëëdï na nyeya.»
english: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, he hath also rejected thee from being king.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Camiel, ni «Aana bääyö; aani møn, dwør Wuuö Jwøk ki dwørï adhala, kiper aana lwäyö ki jiy ni tïma naa leŋa döötge.
english: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and thy words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, a kwaya ïïni ki man wëënnï bääyö mara, nøø aa ki ïïni na aciel, nee Wuuö Jwøk wøøra.»
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö jï Cøøl, na «A ba aay ki ïïni; kiper ïïni, dwør Wuuö Jwøk anø kwierï, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki thuwø ni kwier ïïni ki man bëëdï na nyeya bäät jø Icriel.»
english: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with thee: for thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, and the Lord hath rejected thee from being king over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Camiel løga ree ennø nee aae, Cøøl cer abïïn Camiel aput mak, ni put jeeø cere.
english: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camiel aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Wuuö Jwøk nyec mar jø Icriel acööt wøk cerï dïcäŋi, ni caala abïïnögø na jeeø cerï enø, ni nø cïp gø jï ŋat ma nyï pou, mo beerra bëëtö mare ni kaala marï.
english: And Samuel said unto him, The Lord hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day, and hath given it to a neighbour of thine, that is better than thou.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwø Icriel ni wø bëëdö ni dwøre ba dak ba cäänö ki tööt, na acaara mare ba wiile; kiper eni ba caal dhaanhø na acaara mare di wiilø.»
english: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö, ni «Aana bääyö møn; 'ba ennø, a kwaya ïïni, tïïc aani naa wøør nyïm jø døøk powa, këël jø powa ma jø Icriel bëët, nøø aa ki ïïni na aciel, nee Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, nee wøøra.»
english: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray thee, before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and turn again with me, that I may worship the Lord thy God.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Camiel Cøøl acöör nyïme, ni aacge na aciel; ni ö Cøølli ni wøør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel aköö, ni «Kälu Agaak nyeny jø Amalëk baŋa.» Ni ö Agaaki baŋe ni yie met jaak, kiper ena cädö, ni kööe, ni «Thøø na raac, kare anø pöödhö.»
english: Then said Samuel, Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö, ni «Kaawat mana ö opëëllö marï na tïïc mään ni bäŋ obwöre, meru thuwø dööŋ ni bäŋ nyilaal jïre dï mään bëët.» Ni ö Camielli ni put Agaak ŋørø na thäŋi Gëlgela nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the Lord in Gilgal.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel adøø Reema, ni ö Cøølli ni døø paare na en Giba.
english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kanya thøw Camielli, Cøøl käre joodø këët; 'ba Camiel abëëdö ni kïmmö kiper gïna tïïc Cøølli. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni päth cwïnye kiper mana tïïc Cøøl na nyeya bäät jø Icriel.
english: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and the Lord repented that he had made Saul king over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Camiel, «?A këël yi wäne nø, noo bëëdï niï kïmmö kiper gïna tïïc Cøølli, ni këël aani ki dëëra kiree Cøøl yaa nø kwier ki man bëëde na nyeya bäät jø Icriel? Ennø, ï jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋ Jeci nyï Bethelem, kiper aano nø jëëtö ki nyeya røk wääte. Tuuŋ man wø käär maar rööny ki gø, pääŋ yie ki maaw, ni ciï baŋe.»
english: And the Lord said unto Samuel, How long wilt thou mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel? fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö, na «?A aa nidïï? Kiper ni näk mo wïny Cøølli wïnynyö, a pute ka 'näk.» Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Käädï ki nyirøøa, ni kööï, na ‹A ööi kaper nee nyirøøa man cïba no olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And the Lord said, Take an heifer with thee, and say, I am come to sacrifice to the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeci wär cwølï nee nude kanyo cïpï olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre aani, gïno tïïyï nyoodha nyoodhø jïrï; ni thïïmmï wï ŋato caana jïrï ki maaw.»
english: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew thee what thou shalt do: and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel, gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre atïïe, ni ci Bethelem. Ni ö jø døøk pääny manøgø ni öge baŋe nee ge røømge ki eni, ni ge ööi ni dëëtge rïïŋö ki lwär, ni köge, ni «?Marï beeye öö jaak?»
english: And Samuel did that which the Lord spake, and came to Beth–lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö, «Yaa, mara öö jaak; aani, a ööi kaper naa cïpa ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk. Ennø, cïbu dëëtu kur keeru ni waany, ni ööu ni bëëdu nou nut buuta kanyo cïba olämi.» Kanyøgønø Camiel, Jeci ki wääte acïp kur keerge ni waany, ni cwøl ge nee nutge kanyo cïp olämi.
english: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto the Lord: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge, Camiel, Eliap o Jeci ajoode, ni cäde ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ŋato tïïe nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw nee tïme na nyeya, beeye ni cuŋŋi nyïme en.»
english: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the Lord's anointed is before him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Camiel, ni «Kärï raŋ dëër dhaanhø jaak wala bäye, kiper eni yaa kwierø. A na Wuuö Jwøk, raŋ mara ba caal raŋ mar dhaanhø; kiper dhaanhø, raŋŋa dëër dhaanhø wøk jaak, 'ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, a raŋŋa cwïny dhaanhø.»
english: But the Lord said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.

anywaa: Køøre Jeci, wääde ma Abinadap acwøle ni tïïc gø nee pöödhe ki nyïm Camiel. 'Ba Camiel aköö, ni «Nyenøgø thuwø kär jier Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.

anywaa: Køøre Jeci, wääde ma Cimia atïïe nee pöödhe ki nyïm Camiel. 'Ba Camiel aköö, ni «Nyenøgø thuwø kär jier Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither hath the Lord chosen this.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeci wääte moa na abïriiø atïïe nee pööthge ki nyïm Camiel. 'Ba Camiel aköö jï Jeci, ni «Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ ŋat ee jierø røk wäätï moi.»
english: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, The Lord hath not chosen these.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel aköö jï Jeci, na «?Aŋø, moi beege wäätï ge bëët?» 'Ba Jeci aköö, ni «Mana thiinhnha eni døc nut; 'ba ennø, eni ena baŋ kwaac dïëk.» Køøre Camiel aköö jï Jeci, ni «Jääk baŋe ki dhaanhø nee käli; kiper këël kanyo ööe, ø ba pï piny.»
english: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all thy children? And he said, There remaineth yet the youngest, and, behold, he keepeth the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeci ajäägö ki dhaanhø, ni ö wääde ma Deebit ni käli paac. 'Ba Deebit beeye nyen mo kïte mïërö mo dëëre pulli, ni nyeŋŋe tar. Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ö maal, ni thiiï maaw wïïe; kiper beeye eni gø.»
english: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And the Lord said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

anywaa: Ni ö Camielli ni put tuuŋ mana en maar rööny yie lwør ni thïïm wï Deebit ki maaw yïthakic nyïïmenni; ni put Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøki ö bäät Deebit ni teek døc ki mana täge ki dïcäŋeca. Køøre Camiel atïŋŋö ni døø paare na en Reema.
english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput aay bäät Cøøl, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk jwïëy mo reyø ööny bäät Cøøl ni putge gø caarø.
english: But the Spirit of the Lord departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord troubled him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tïïc mo Cøøl aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Neenï, ennø Jwøk jwïëy moi ni reyø ii awëëk ööny bäätï ni caarge ïïni.
english: And Saul's servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from God troubleth thee.

anywaa: Caanï jïwa, wa na jø tïïc moï en, nee wa määnywa ki ŋat mo pwöt thoom-othïënhö ŋääe døc; nee kany wø tïme ni Jwøk jwïëy moø ni reyø yøø, wëëge ööny bäätï ni caarge ïïni, ŋatøgø thoom-othïënhö pute ka pwöt, ni put wïïï døø kare.»
english: Let our lord now command thy servants, which are before thee, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from God is upon thee, that he shall play with his hand, and thou shalt be well.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö jï jø tïïc moe, ni «Ennø, määnyu ki ŋat mo pwöt thoomothïënhö ŋääe døc, ni kälu gø baŋa.»
english: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk dhaanhe acielli dïge ni kööe, ni «Neenï, da o Jeci nyï Bethelem mo pwöt thoom-othïënhö ŋääe døc, ma dhaanhø mo teek mo cwïnye da cer, ma ŋat leny, mo waŋe riek ki luubö, ni beeye nyen mo kïte mïërö; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk nut buute.»
english: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth–lehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and the Lord is with him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aput jääk baŋ Jeci ki jiy, ni kööe, ni «Jääŋ wäädï ma Deebit baŋa, nyenø ni kwaac dïëk enø.»
english: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David thy son, which is with the sheep.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeci ni put arëën lwør, ni kïth dïŋää gø ki dääpe, ko opïr pïën mo yie da køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni lwöte ki nyidiel thuwø, ni jääŋ ge baŋ Cøøl cer wääde ma Deebit.
english: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit apïï baŋ Cøøl ni tïny gøøni, ni ö Cøølli ni tïme ni mëër ki Deebit døc; ni put Deebiti tïmö na ŋat käär jap leny jï Cøøl.
english: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl ajääk baŋ Jeci ki dwøl, ni kööe, ni «Ennø, Deebit bëëdö na ŋat tïny aani, kiper aani, yia atïmö ni met ki eni.»
english: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.

anywaa: Køøre nø, aput tïmö ni kany wø ö Jwøki wø wëëk jwïëy moa reyø ööny bäät Cøøl, Deebit thoom-othïënhö wø lwøre lwørø ni pwöt gø; ni ö jwïëy moøgø ni reyø yøø ni wecge Cøøl, ni døø wïïe kare, ni jöön dëëre.
english: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin jø leny moge acwølge kiper nee cige baŋ leny ki jø Icriel; ni cooŋge rege pääny mana cwøl ni Cökö na en yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni cige ni tïïcge twïër marge buut pääny mana cwøl ni Epec- Damim na en yïthakic Cökö ki pääny mana cwøl na Adhëka.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Soco, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Soco and Azekah, in Ephes–dammim.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl ki jø leny mo jø Icriel rege acooŋge, ni tïïcge twïër marge goor Ëla, ni öge ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi kiper nee ge këëtge ki jø Pilitin.
english: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Pilitinni ni cuŋge bäät thuur løøk maya, ni jø Icriel cuŋŋa bäät thuur løøk maya, ni naam ena yïthakicge kaagø.
english: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

anywaa: Køøre nyen mo teek døc mo oŋääth jø poge, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Göliat, aö wøk ki dï jø leny mo jø Pilitin. 'Ba ena nyï Gëth, ni eni bäär døc, ni ni rømi, jïtö ki gööye abïciel ki wïïe, ni gööye moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

anywaa: Ni wïïe ee kïthö ki cöör nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni dëëre ee runynyö ka abïï nywïënyö ma jwïël, mo peege beeye rumme ma kume abïïc mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni cekel.
english: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

anywaa: Eni thuwø otweeŋi moe ee kïthö ki gïï mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni käädö ki tøŋ mo thiinh mo ee twöö ki thøøl ni løny gø göönne.
english: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

anywaa: 'Ba tøŋ mare mana dwøŋ, thiire caala athøra. Ni tøŋ mana näk nywïënyö kiree peege beeye rumme ma dïpe abïciel mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni cekel. 'Ba kar kaagø, Göliat nyen wø käär jap leny jïre ee cöör nyïme.
english: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Göliat acuŋŋö ni rwaac jø leny mo jø Icriel moa näk rege ege cïïmmö na dhøgi, ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø, u öömu ŋø wøk baŋ leny? ?Aŋø, kuyu ni aani, aana ŋata teek døc na no oŋääth jø powa ma jø Pilitin? 'Ba uuni, uuna laak Cøøl møn. Ennø, jëëtu ki dhaanhø nee ö baŋa nee wa këëtwa ki gø.
english: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo løny jï ŋateca ki man këëde ki aani, ni 'näk aani, jø powa puta tïmö na laaŋe jïïu; 'ba ni näk mo ŋateca bööta böötö ni nääa eni, u puta tïmö ni uuna laaŋe mowa ni putu waani tïnynyö.»
english: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.

anywaa: 'Ba nyï Pilitin manøgø acäŋ köö, na «A ŋwöö bäätu dïcäŋi ennø, u na jø leny mo jø Icriel; cïpu jïra ki dhaanhø nee wa këëtwa ki gø.»
english: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli ki jø Icriel bëët na wïnyge luup moa car nyï Pilitinni manøgø, cwïnyge abwøk ni putge lwäyö døc.
english: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit beeye o Jeci nyï Eeparata, na käl Bethelem na en yi ŋööm Juuda. 'Ba Jeci jïre da wääte abära. 'Ba kanya bëët Cøølli na nyeya, Jeci oløny na jaal, mo cwiiye thöötha geni røk jø poge.
english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jeci moa näk adäk na døøŋŋø geni, onø ci baŋ leny ki Cøøl na aciel. Ni nyeŋ wääte moa näk adäk na ci baŋ leny, beege kanynye ma Eliap, ki julle ma Abinadap, ki dääge ma Cimia.
english: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit beeye ŋata thiinhnha eni døc røk nyïïmenni. 'Ba kanya bëët wäät Jeci moa näk adäk na døøŋŋø geni ni ge ena ri lwaa leny mar Cøøl,
english: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

anywaa: Deebit bëëdö ni wïdö, ni cøøa po Cøøl, ni døøa Bethelem kuna kwaac dïëk mo wänni.
english: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Beth–lehem.

anywaa: 'Ba Göliat, nyï Pilitin na teek døc na näk oŋääth jø poge, wø öö ka amöölla ka abøøya cooth, ni bëëde ni cäädhö ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni eni wø cuŋŋö ni ŋwöe.
english: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

anywaa: Køøre Jeci aköö jï wääde ma Deebit, ni «Ennø, beel moi no omuuö ii na yi rumi mar iipa en, ki dääpe apaar moi, lwørï ni reŋŋï baŋ nyïïmeru twïër leny;
english: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;

anywaa: ni kwögï mädhi apaar moi na mo dhäk ii jï kwääc lwaa leny marge man wø käär jiy ma kuma; ni neenï jööt dëël mar nyïïmeru, ni duuï niï käädö ki gïn mo nyootha jööt dëël marge.
english: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.

anywaa: Kiper ennø, Cøøl, ki nyïïmeru, ki jø leny bëët mo jø Icriel, ge ena goor Ëla, ni ge këëdö ki jø Pilitin.»
english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, Deebit apäny maal, ni wëëe ki dhaanhø mo kwaac dïëk, ni lwør caammi moøgø ni tïŋŋe kaawat mana caani ya wänni ma Jeci jïgø. 'Ba kanya pïïe twïër ennø, jø leny anwäne ni ge aa wøk ni rege ege cïïmmö na dhøgi ni ge twäädö.
english: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

anywaa: Ni öge, ge na jø Icriel, ki jø Pilitin ni cïïmge rege kiper leny ni jøw raŋŋa rege.
english: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit jammi moa kääre aput wii cer ŋat wø koor jammi, ni reŋ baŋ nyïïmenni kar leny nee ge määdhe.
english: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni Deebit cäänö ki nyïïmenni, ka adïëri møn, nyï Pilitin manøgø ni teek døc enø, na näk oŋääth jø poge, ni beeye Göliat nyï Gëth, aput ö wøk ki dï jø leny mo jø Pilitin, ni cääne ki luupe ni wø care kaagø cooth; ni ö Deebiti ni wïny luup moøgø.
english: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi bëët mo jø Icriel na jootge Göliat, gena put reeŋø ki eni ni lwäcge døc.
english: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo jø Icriel aköö, na «?Aŋø, nyenøgø ni ööi enø käru joodø? Ka adïëri møn, eni ööa kuna ŋwöe bäät jø Icriel. 'Ba ŋato 'näk nyenøgø, otïïc nyeya na dhaanhø mo okwär døc, ni cïp nyaare jïgø nee tïme na cïïe, ni tïïc dhi øt wää ŋatøgø ni ba cïpi ka ajwäk dï Icriel.»
english: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäänö ki jøøa cuŋŋö buute kaagø, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïc jï ŋato käl ajøøŋ wøk bäät jø Icriel ki køør mano 'näk nyï Pilitin manøgø? ?Aŋø, nyï Pilitin manøgø ni kär daŋø enø aŋa, ni ŋwöe bäät jø leny mo Jwøa kwøw en?»
english: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jiyi jïre kaawat mana kwøŋge gø carø yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni «Teeŋ gïïa caanwa yøø di tïïö jï ŋato 'näk nyenøgø møn.»
english: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliap, cöök Deebit mana dwøŋ, luup moa car Deebiti ki jø leny awïnynye, ni ö Eliapi ni put wëër døc ki Deebit, ni kööe, ni «?Ï öömï ŋø kany? ?Aŋø, dïëk moa thenh ni wø kwaayï dï paap, iï wiia baŋ ŋa? Aani, atöör marï ki gïïö ni reyø ni caarï ki cwïnyï yøø ŋääa; niï ööï kaper nee leny raŋï.»
english: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïa ennø? ?Aŋø, mara paa pïëc jaak?»
english: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ree aløøe ni aae buut coki, ni ci baŋ dhaanhø mør, ni cäŋ luummögø pëënynyö, ni ö jøøa nut kaagø ni løkge gø jïre ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana caan Deebiti awïny jiyi, ni caange gø jï Cøøl; ni ö Cøølli ni jääk baŋ Deebit.
english: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo cwïnye bwøk ki luupögø ni car nyï Pilitin manøgø enø; aani, a na dhaanhnhï, a cøøa kuna këëda ki nyenøgø.»
english: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ïïni, ï ba løny ki man ciï baŋ leny ki nyï Pilitin manøgø; kiper ï poot thiinh, ni eni, ena ŋat leny ki mana täge thïnhö.»
english: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit acäŋ köö jï Cøøl, ni «Aani, a na dhaanhnhï, aana bëëdö naa kwaaya dïëk mo wära. 'Ba kany wø ö ŋuuwi wala teeŋ cwieny mør kuna käde ki nyidiel dï dïëk,
english: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

anywaa: aani, a puta läp køøre ni gøøa gø, ni cööda nyidiel wøk dhee; 'ba kany wø päny baŋa, aani cwaage wø puta ka mak ni nääa gø.
english: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

anywaa: Aani, a na dhaanhnhï, aano nääö ki teeŋ lääy moøgø; 'ba nyï Pilitin manøgø ni kär daŋø enø, nääa nääö kaawat mana nääa teeŋ lääyögø, kiper mana ŋwöe bäät jø leny mo Jwøa kwøw.»
english: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Deebiti köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk na piem aani cer ŋuu ki cer teeŋ cwieny mør, eni a pieme piemø cer nyï Pilitin manøgø.» Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Wøp nø, ïïno cii; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk obëëdö ki ïïni.»
english: David said moreover, The Lord that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the Lord be with thee.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl abïïge arøø dëër Deebit, ni kïth wï gø ki cöör nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni runy dëër gø ka abïï nywïënyö.
english: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni twöö opëëllö bäät abïï nywïënyö mana røø dëëre, ni päär gø ki man cäädhe, kiper gïïögø poot käre päärö cøøn. Køøre Deebit aköö jï Cøøl, na «A ba aay ni gïï ena dëëra, kiper gïïögø poot kära päärö cøøn.» Køøre gïïögø aput Deebiti käl wøk dëëre.
english: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit athønynye aput lwør, ni jëëte ki nyeŋ kïte abïïc mo pøøth yi naam, ni kïth ge yo opïr mare, ni beeye teeŋ opïr man wø käär jø wø kwaac dïëk, ni kwany gïr leny mo tïïc ka kaw man wø thöör ni di wïrö ni kïdi ena yie; ni ci baŋ nyï Pilitin manøgø.
english: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

anywaa: Køøre nyï Pilitin manøgø aput öö ni nyänh baŋ Deebit, ni ŋat wø käär jap leny jïre cäädha nyïme.
english: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyï Pilitinni manøgø na lwïthe, eni Deebit ajoode, ni put Deebit taak døc; kiper kar kaagø, Deebit poot thiinh, ni dëëre pulli, ni nëëni ni kïte mïërö.
english: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

anywaa: 'Ba nyï Pilitin manøgø aköö jï Deebit, na «?Aŋø, aana gwök na ööï baŋa niï käära athøra en?» Ni ö nyï Pilitinni manøgø ni cääne ki luup acïëni dëër Deebit ki nyeŋ juu moge.
english: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyï Pilitinni manøgø köö jï Deebit, ni «Ö baŋa, nee rïŋ dëërï wëëga weny mo maal ki lääc paap.»
english: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï nyï Pilitin manøgø, ni «Ïïni, ï ö baŋa niï käära opëëllö, ki tøŋ mo dwøŋ, ki tøŋ mo thiinh; 'ba aani, a ööa baŋï ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, Jwø jø leny mo jø Icriel, na ŋwöï bäätge ii.
english: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋi Wuuö Jwøk ï cïbe cera, ni nääa ïïni, ni ŋula wïïï wøk. 'Ba aani, dëët jø leny mo jø Pilitin moo 'näk dïcäŋi, wëëga wec maal ki lääc paap mo bäät piny, kiper nee ŋäc jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni Jwøk mana na adïëri nut dï jø Icriel;
english: This day will the Lord deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.

anywaa: ni ö jø Icrielli moi ni rege ege cooŋ kany en, ni ŋäcge gø ni Wuuö Jwøk jiye ba kønye kiper mana dee opëëllö wala tøŋ; kiper leny bäre ena cer Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba uuni, u na jø Pilitin, u cïbe ceŋwa.»
english: And all this assembly shall know that the Lord saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the Lord's, and he will give you into our hands.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyï Pilitinni manøgø na jek ree, na ööe ni cäänhnha baŋ Deebit nee ge røømge ki gø, Deebit aput reeŋø ni läät kar leny nee ge røømge ki nyï Pilitin manøgø.
english: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni rwaak cere yo opïr mare, ni lwöte ki kïdi ni kïth gø yi gïr thöör ni put thööthö, ni këël nyï Pilitin manøgø ki täärnyïm gø; ni put kïdi døny kuya, ni ö Göliati ni put pädhö ni yie ee rïëp piny.
english: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit nyï Pilitin manøgø abööte ki gïr leny mo tïïc ka kaw man wø thöör ni di wïrö ni kïdi ena yie. Nyï Pilitin manøgø akëële ni put gø 'näk møn; 'ba Deebit cere bäŋ opëëllö.
english: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit areeŋø ni cuŋŋe bäät nyï Pilitin manøgø, ni lwør opëëllö mar gø ni wöth gø wøk ki yi køp, ni put nyï Pilitin cwøp, ni ŋul wï gø wøk. 'Ba kanya ö jø Pilitinni na jootge gø ni ŋata teek døc na näk ege ŋäädhö othøw, gena put bwøk.
english: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo jø Icriel ki jø leny mo tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda aput päny maal ni ge twäädö, ni ŋwiecge køør jø Pilitin ni ge nääö këël mana pïïcge waŋ jöör Gëth, ki dhi kiir Akarön. Ni ö jø Pilitinni moa no othøw ni dööŋ dëëtge piny waŋ jöör Caarayim, këël mana këët Gëth ka Akarön.
english: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo jø Icriel gena duuö ki kuna riemge jø leny mo jø Pilitin ni twierge twëëre moge.
english: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit wï nyï Pilitin alwøre ni kïth gø Jerucalem; 'ba jap leny mo nyï Pilitin manøgø akan kar bëëtö mare.
english: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, kanya ö Cøølli na joot Deebit ni cøøa wøk baŋ leny ki nyï Pilitin manøgø, Cøøl aköö jï Abinër kwääc lwaa leny, na «?Abinër, nyilaarøgø a o ŋa?» 'Ba Abinër aköö, «Wui nyeya, ŋëëtï keerï, aani, nyilaarøgø kuua.»
english: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Pëënynyï ki man näk mo nyilaarøgø a o ŋa.»
english: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.

anywaa: Køøre kanya ö Deebiti na duue ki kuna 'näk nyï Pilitin manøgø, ena lwør Abinërri ni käl gø nyïm Cøøl ni wï nyï Pilitin manøgø poot di käärö ki cere.
english: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Nyie nyilaal, ïïna o ŋa?» 'Ba aløk Deebiti, ni «Aana o dhaanhnhï ma Jeci nyï Bethelem.»
english: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Deebit løny ki cäänö ki Cøøl, cwïny Jönathan ki cwïny Deebit aput gääbö na aciel; ni put Jönathanni tïmö ni mëër ki Deebit døc kaawat man wø mëër dhaanhe ki dëëre.
english: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø Cøøl Deebit aput käl nee bëëde buute, ni ö Cøølli ni käre Deebit wëëk wääth ki man døø po wänni.
english: And Saul took him that day, and would let him go no more home to his father's house.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan atudö ki luubö ki Deebit, kiper eni mëër ki gø døc kaawat man wø mëër dhaanhe ki dëëre.
english: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jönathan abïï mare mana en dëëre aput gööny wøk ni cïp gø jï Deebit, ni cïbe na aciel ka abïï nywïënyö man wø røø dëël, këël opëëllö, ka atheerø, ki kaw.
english: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aput tïmö ni kany wø ö Cøølli wø jääŋ Deebit yie jaak, Deebit puta cøø, ni tïïc jammi bëët na karge ni waŋe riek. Ni ö Cøølli ni put Deebit cuum na wïth jø leny moe. 'Ba Deebit aput tïmö ni jiy bëët këël jø tïïc mo Cøøl thuwø yïthge met ki gø.
english: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul's servants.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duu jø lenynyi, ni beeye kanya duu Deebiti ki kuna 'näk Göliat nyï Pilitin, mään aput ö wøk ki yïth päänye bëët mo jø Icriel ni ge ööa kuna røømge ki nyeya ma Cøøl, ni ge wär ki dudi, ni ge miel, ni ge pöödö ka anëët ki thøme, ni yïthge met.
english: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, mään duut man awärge ni ge løøŋŋa dhøkge, ni ge miel, ni köge, ni «Cøøl anääö ki jø Pilitin ma kume, 'ba kume moa 'näk Deebiti thöötha geni døc.»
english: And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl awëër døc, kiper yie atïmö ni raac ki duut manøgø, ni kööe, ni «Beege kume mo thööth døc na caange no onäk Deebiti; 'ba beege kume keerge jaak na caange ni yaa nääö. ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na dööŋ ni käre joodø? ?Paa nyec keere nø?»
english: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki dïcäŋögø, Cøøl aput bëëtö ni Deebit neete ka waŋ mo raac døc.
english: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya, jwïëy moa reyø aput Jwøki wëëk ööny bäät Cøøl ni teek døc, ni rïïŋe dï øtø mare ni cäänö ki luup bøølø, ni tøŋ mare ena cere. 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit pöödö ki thoom-othïënhö kaawat man wø tïïe cooth.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul, and he prophesied in the midst of the house: and David played with his hand, as at other times: and there was a javelin in Saul's hand.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl Deebit athööre ki tøŋ, ni ee caarø ki cwïnye ni Deebit dee kwøø ri øtø ki tøŋ. 'Ba Deebit tøŋ agønynye kwöre ariiø nyïm Cøøl.
english: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aput lwäyö ki Deebit, kiper Wuuö Jwøk nut buut Deebit, ni ree ee nø paany buut Cøøl.
english: And Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was with him, and was departed from Saul.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Cøøl Deebit aput tïïc nee ree daae buute nee bëëde ni kare bäär ki eni, ni tïïc gø na kwääc lwaa leny mo jïre da jø leny ma kuma; ni ö Deebiti ni put bëëtö ni bwøtha eni maal nyïm jiy kany wø näk ri leny.
english: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aput bëëtö ni jammi bëët tïïe na karge ni waŋe riek, kiper Wuuö Jwøk nut buute.
english: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the Lord was with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Cøølli møn ni Deebit jammi bëët tïïe na karge ni waŋe riek, ena put lwäyö døc ki Deebit.
english: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët ki tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda ge mëër ki Deebit døc, ni ö Deebiti ni bëëde ni bwøtha eni maal nyïmge kany wø näk ri leny.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ennø, nyaara ma Mërap na dwøŋ nutö. Eni cïba cïbö jïrï nee nywømï; 'ba gïno tïïyï keere, bëëdï ni ïïna ŋat leny mo teek jïra, ni këëlï lenye moøgø ni en cer Wuuö Jwøk yøø.» 'Ba Cøøl gïnögø acaane kiper ena cädö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Ba doo beer ki man tïme ni eni 'näga aani; 'ba beerra man tïme ni eni 'näga jø Pilitinni.»
english: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give thee to wife: only be thou valiant for me, and fight the Lord's battles. For Saul said, Let not mine hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Cøøl, «?Aŋø, aana ŋa ni köö naa tïmö ni aana cø nyi nyeya en? ?A bëëtö mara wala bëëtö mar dhi øt wära, a bëëtö mo nyïëdi dï Icriel?»
english: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father's family in Israel, that I should be son in law to the king?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kanya di Mërapi nyi Cøøl cïbö jï Deebit, acäŋ tïmö ni cïpa jï Adariel nyï Meyöla nee nywøme.
english: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikal nyi Cøøl atïmö ni mëër ki Deebit døc. 'Ba kanya caani jï Cøøl, Cøøl yie aput tïmö ni met døc ki luubö manøgø.
english: And Michal Saul's daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

anywaa: Ni cät Cøølli ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Nyaara manøgø cïba cïbö jïre nee bëëde ni caala abïëp kipere, nee tïme ni eni 'näga jø Pilitinni.» Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Man beeye rietge nø ki man tïmï ni ïïna cø nyaara dïcäŋi.»
english: And Saul said, I will give him her, that she may be a snare to him, and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him. Wherefore Saul said to David, Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl jø kööre moe aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Cou ni cäänu ki Deebit ki piny mëëth, ni kööu, ni ‹Neenï, nyeya yie met ki ïïni døc, ni jiye bëët thuwø ge mëër ki ï døc; 'ba ennø, beerra man tïmï ni ïïna cø nyi nyeya.› »
english: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre mo nyeya ni putge cøø ni caange luubö manøgø jï Deebit. 'Ba Deebit aköö, «?Aŋø, beeye gïn mo jööt jaak ki baŋu ki man tïma ni aana cø nyi nyeya, a ni can ni bäŋ kara en?»
english: And Saul's servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king's son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre mo Cøøl ni døøkge ni caange luup bëët moa caan Deebiti.
english: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl acäŋ köö, ni «Døøgu ni caannu gø jï Deebit ni kööu, ni ‹Nyeya bäŋ jap kääny mo manynye baŋï; 'ba man manynye keere beeye ki man nääï ki jø Pilitin ma cwøw ma dïpa, ni coolï kwör nyeya dëët nyïïmän moe, ni daŋï geni, ni käli buyi moo daŋï baŋe.› » 'Ba luummögø acaan Cøølli kiper eno nø cädö ki man tïme ni Deebit 'näga jø Pilitinni.
english: And Saul said, Thus shall ye say to David, The king desireth not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king's enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøk jø kööre mo Cøøl na caange luubö manøgø jï Deebit, Deebit aput jïëy ki man tïme na cø nyi nyeya. 'Ba kanya poode ni nïne moa caan poot kär pöödhö,
english: And when his servants told David these words, it pleased David well to be the king's son in law: and the days were not expired.

anywaa: Deebit aö maal ni ci baŋ jø Pilitin, ni beeye eni ki jø leny moe, ni nääe ki jiy ma dïpe ariiø røk jø Pilitin, ni daŋ geni, ni käl buyi moa daaŋe; ni cïpge ge jï nyeya ni kaala kwään moa no ocaanø, nee tïme ni løny ki man tïm Deebiti na cø nyi nyeya. Kanyøgønø, Cøøl nyaare ma Mikal aput cïp jï Deebit nee nywøme.
english: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti Cøølli ni ŋäc gø ni Wuuö Jwøk nut buut Deebit, ni ŋääe thuwø ni nyaare ma Mikal mëër ki Deebit døc,
english: And Saul saw and knew that the Lord was with David, and that Michal Saul's daughter loved him.

anywaa: eni na Cøøl enø, lwär mare ki Deebit aput kadhø døc. Ni ö Cøølli ni put bëëtö na nyïïmän mar Deebit.
english: And Saul was yet the more afraid of David; and Saul became David's enemy continually.

anywaa: Køøre kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin aput bëëtö ni ge ööa baŋ leny cooth baŋ jø Icriel; 'ba kany wø tïme ni ge öö, Deebit jammi bëët wø pute ka tïïc na karge ni waŋe riek ni kaala jø tïïc mo Cøøl bëët; ni ö nyeŋ Deebiti ni put wïnynye døc.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth: and it came to pass, after they went forth, that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul; so that his name was much set by.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan Cøølli jï wääde ma Jönathan ki jø tïïc moe bëët nee Deebit 'näkge. 'Ba wääde ma Jönathan yie met ki Deebit døc.
english: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

anywaa: Køøre acaan Jönathanni jï Deebit, ni kööe, ni «Wära ma Cøøl manynya gø niï nääe. 'Ba ennø, diøø ka amöölla, beerra man gwøgï riï døc ni kanï riï kany miï ba joot yie.
english: But Jonathan Saul's son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeketh to kill thee: now therefore, I pray thee, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a cøøa kuna cuŋŋa buut wära yi pwöla mano enï yie, køøre a cäänö ki wära kiperï; 'ba gïno wïnynya, puta ka caan jïrï.»
english: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art, and I will commune with my father of thee; and what I see, that I will tell thee.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan acäänö ki luup mo beyø jï wänni ma Cøøl kiper Deebit, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ï na nyeya, beerra man ba bääyï dëër ŋat tïïc marï ma Deebit, kiper eni kär bääyö dëërï; 'ba gïï wø tïïe beege gïï mo beyø jïrï.
english: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he hath not sinned against thee, and because his works have been to thee-ward very good:

anywaa: Këël eni thuwø, ena aay ni weta jwïëye ni 'näk nyï Pilitin mana teek døc na näk oŋääth jø poge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïe ki køny mo dwøŋ døc jï jø Icriel bëët. Këël ïïni thuwø, gïnögø ajootï ni mïn yiï. ?'Ba aperŋø nø, ni cädï niï tïïö ki raay ki man kønynyï rem Deebit piny mo bäŋ gïn mo ee baaø en, ki man 'nägï eni ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak?»
english: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and the Lord wrought a great salvation for all Israel: thou sawest it, and didst rejoice: wherefore then wilt thou sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl dwør Jönathan aleŋe, ni kööŋe, ni «Ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, Deebit ba 'näk këët.»
english: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As the Lord liveth, he shall not be slain.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan, Deebit acwøle, ni ö Jönathanni ni caan luup moøgø bëët jï Deebit. 'Ba Jönathan, Deebit akäl baŋ Cøøl, ni ö Deebiti ni bëëde buut Cøøl kaawat mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And Jonathan called David, and Jonathan shewed him all those things. And Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence, as in times past.

anywaa: 'Ba leny mør acäŋ tägö, ni ö Deebiti ni cøøe ni këëde ki jø Pilitin, ni 'näk jø Pilitin mo thööth døc, ni ö jø Pilitinni ni putge bwøk nyïme.
english: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

anywaa: 'Ba jwïëy moa reyø awëëk Wuuö Jwøki ööny bäät Cøøl kanya bëëde ni eno pï piny yi øde ni tøŋ ena cere; 'ba kar kaagø, Deebit pöödö ki thoomothïënhö.
english: And the evil spirit from the Lord was upon Saul, as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand: and David played with his hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl apääre ki man këël Deebit ki tøŋ nee kwøø ri øtø; 'ba Deebit ree apaanye nyïm Cøøl, ni ö tøŋŋi mana thöör Cøølli ni put pï dëër øtø. 'Ba Deebit aput reeŋø ni päär wøk dïwäänögø.
english: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin; but he slipped away out of Saul's presence, and he smote the javelin into the wall: and David fled, and escaped that night.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl ajääk po Deebit ki jiy nee Deebit koorge ki deŋ paare, nee 'näkge ka amöölla. 'Ba Mikal cï Deebit acäänö ki Deebit ni kööe, «Ni näk miï ba päär wøk dïwääni, diøø ï put ka 'näk.»
english: Saul also sent messengers unto David's house, to watch him, and to slay him in the morning: and Michal David's wife told him, saying, If thou save not thy life to night, to morrow thou shalt be slain.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Mikal Deebit aput iith piny ki dha awëërnyeŋ, ni ö Deebiti ni put reeŋø ni päär wøk.
english: So Michal let David down through a window: and he went, and fled, and escaped.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikal gïna no otieŋø na gïn wø lam alwøre ni pïël gø bäät pëëm, ni tïïc gø no othäänh ki thänhi mo tïïc ka jïëc diel, ni rïëp gø ka aleeŋŋe.
english: And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli na jääge ki jiy nee Deebit kälge, Mikal aköö, ni «Deebit tuu.»
english: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl acäŋ jäägö ki jiy nee Deebit neenge, ni kööe, ni «Kälu Deebit baŋa ni ena bäät pëëme, kiper nee eni nääa.»
english: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David, saying, Bring him up to me in the bed, that I may slay him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøa jääŋŋi na dønyge yi øtø, ka adïëri møn, ajootge ni gïna no otieŋø na gïn wø lam opïël piny bäät pëëm no othäänhö ki thänhi mana näk tïïc ka jïëc diel.
english: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats' hair for his bolster.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Mikal, «?Aŋø, a cøøgï gø na ennø en aperŋø, ni tïïyï nyimän mara nee aae en, ni put päär wøk?» 'Ba Mikal aköö jï Cøøl, ni «Ena köö ki aani, ni ‹Wëëk aani wääth; 'ba ni näk maa mänï mänö, ï puta ka 'näk.› »
english: And Saul said unto Michal, Why hast thou deceived me so, and sent away mine enemy, that he is escaped? And Michal answered Saul, He said unto me, Let me go; why should I kill thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit apäär wøk ni reeŋe, ni ci Reema baŋ Camiel, ni caan jammi bëët moa tïïc Cøølli dëëre jï Camiel. Ni ö eni ki Camiel ni aacge ni bëëtge kany wø bëët nyïïkuk Jwøki yie na cwøl ni Newöt.
english: So David fled, and escaped, and came to Samuel to Ramah, and told him all that Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Cøøl ni køp, ni «Neenï, Deebit ena Newöt na en Reema.»
english: And it was told Saul, saying, Behold, David is at Naioth in Ramah.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl ajäägö ki jiy kiper nee Deebit kälge baŋe; 'ba kanya cige, lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk ajootge ni ge pwøya Jwøk, ni Camiel cuŋŋö na bwödhi marge. Ni put Jwïëc Jwøki ö bäätge ni pwøcge Jwøk thuwø.
english: And Saul sent messengers to take David: and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying, and Samuel standing as appointed over them, the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul, and they also prophesied.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caan luummögø jï Cøøl, Cøøl ajäägö ki jiy møøk, ni ö jøøgø ni cige ni cäŋge tïmö ni ge pwøya Jwøk. Køøre Cøøl acäŋ jäägö ki jiy ri dääge, ni ö jøøgø thuwø ni cige ni cäŋge tïmö ni ge pwøya Jwøk.
english: And when it was told Saul, he sent other messengers, and they prophesied likewise. And Saul sent messengers again the third time, and they prophesied also.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl ki dëëre aci Reema, ni aae këël mana pïïe bäät iidha dwøŋ na en Ceku; 'ba kanya pïïe kaagø, Cøøl apëëö ni kööe, na «?Age Camiel ki Deebit?» 'Ba ŋat mør aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, geni, ge ena Newöt na en Reema.»
english: Then went he also to Ramah, and came to a great well that is in Sechu: and he asked and said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, Behold, they be at Naioth in Ramah.

anywaa: Ni ö Cøølli ni pööth Newöt na en Reema; 'ba Jwïëc Jwøk aö bäät Cøøl thuwø, ni put Cøøl tïïc nee Jwøk pwøe kanya cäädhe øtjöö këël mana pïïe Newöt na en Reema.
english: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah: and the Spirit of God was upon him also, and he went on, and prophesied, until he came to Naioth in Ramah.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl abïïe moa døøŋŋø agööny wøk, ni bëëde ni pwøya Jwøk nyïm Camiel; ni put bëëtö no obut piny, ni bëëdö ka abïïe moa reep ki yi cäŋ bäre ki wäär bäre. Kanyøgønø, jiy aköö, na «?Aŋø, Cøøl thuwø atïmö ni ena dï nyïïkuk Jwøk?»
english: And he stripped off his clothes also, and prophesied before Samuel in like manner, and lay down naked all that day and all that night. Wherefore they say, Is Saul also among the prophets?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit apäny wøk ki Newöt na en Reema, ni ö baŋ Jönathan ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na näk yaa tïïö? ?Da gïn mo yaa baaø? ?Agïnaŋø na raac na tïïa dëër wäru, ni bëëde ni manynya jwïëya nee rwäänye en?»
english: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said before Jonathan, What have I done? what is mine iniquity? and what is my sin before thy father, that he seeketh my life?

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ba doo løny; ïïni, ï ba thøw. Neenï, wära bäŋ gïn mo dwøŋ wala gïn mo thiinh mo dee tïïö ni käre caanø jïra. ?Aŋø, wära tier luubö man keere dee kanø ki aani? Gïnögø ba tägi na bäre.»
english: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit akööŋ, ni cäŋ köö, ni «Ki man näk miï mëër ki aani, oløny ni ŋäc wäru døc, ni ee nø caar ki cwïnye thuwø ni kööe, ni ‹Beerra man bëët Jönathanni ni luubö manøgø kuue, kiper kanymør cwïnye pädhö jaak.› 'Ba ka adïëri møn, a kööŋŋa ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, ki ŋëëtï; beeye kany mo thiinh keere no odööŋ ki man ö wäru ni 'näk aani.»
english: And David sware moreover, and said, Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes; and he saith, Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved: but truly as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, there is but a step between me and death.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ennø, gïno pëënynyï aani ki gø jaak tïïa tïïö jïrï.»
english: Then said Jonathan unto David, Whatsoever thy soul desireth, I will even do it for thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï Jönathan, ni «Neenï, diøø beeye kany wø päär dwääyi, ni beeye kany wø pïwa piny nee wa cämwa ki nyeya na aciel. 'Ba ennø, akwaya ïïni naa aa nee raa kana yi pwöla këël mano tïme na dää nïne ki wäär.
english: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö wäru noo pëëny aani, wär caanï jïre ni kööï, ni ‹Deebit aana kwaaye døc ki man reŋ Bethelem na näk pääny marge, kiper man beeye kar kany wø cïp tuuŋge ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk ki yi cwiir cooth nee cämge na aciel.›
english: If thy father at all miss me, then say, David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city: for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo wäru köö, ni ‹Wøp,› aani, a na dhaanhnhï, puta ka ŋäc ni bëëtö mara tïmö ni beer; 'ba ni näk mo eni puta wëër døc, wär put ŋäc nø ni wäru acaara mare ee nø ŋøl ki man tïïe ki gïn mo leth dëëra.
english: If he say thus, It is well; thy servant shall have peace: but if he be very wroth, then be sure that evil is determined by him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyooth bäth ec marï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper ïïna nø tudö ki luubö ki aani ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba ni näk mo da gïn mo yaa baaø, beerra man tïme naa 'näga ïïni ki dëërï kiree. ?Aŋø, aano kïthï gø baŋ wäru kiperŋø këët?»
english: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the Lord with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan aköö, ni «Beerra man tïm acaara manøgø ni tøør cwïnyï. ?Aŋø, dee na ŋääa ni wära da gïn mo raac mo ee caarø ki man tïïc gø dëërï, ba daa caanø jïrï?»
english: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Jönathan, «?Ni näk mo da luubö mo raac mo caan wäru caanø dëërï kipera, aŋa noo ööi noo caan gø jïra?»
english: Then said David to Jonathan, Who shall tell me? or what if thy father answer thee roughly?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jönathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ööï, ø aa yi pwöla.» Ni ö geni karge riet ni putge ci yi pwöla.
english: And Jonathan said unto David, Come, and let us go out into the field. And they went out both of them into the field.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, diøø wala køør diøø teeŋ kar kany ennø, kanyo manynya yi wära, ka adïëri møn, ni näk mo da gïn mo beer mo yaa wïnynyö kiperï, ï na Deebit en, a jääga baŋï ki dwøl nee wïnynyï.
english: And Jonathan said unto David, O Lord God of Israel, when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time, or the third day, and, behold, if there be good toward David, and I then send not unto thee, and shew it thee;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo wära manynya man tïïe ki gïn mo leth dëërï møn, ni kära luubö manøgø caanø jïrï nee wïnynyï, ni ba wëëga ï wääth ki man aayï ki jööt dëël, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany aani, a na Jönathan en. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ni nut buutï kaawat mana bëëde ni nut buut wära.
english: The Lord do so and much more to Jonathan: but if it please my father to do thee evil, then I will shew it thee, and send thee away, that thou mayest go in peace: and the Lord be with thee, as he hath been with my father.

anywaa: 'Ba këël mano pooda naa poot kwøw, beerra man nyoothï bäth ec mar Wuuö Jwøk jïra, naa ba thøøa.
english: And thou shalt not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of the Lord, that I die not:

anywaa: Ni ö bäth eci marï thuwø ni ba cuuŋe na bäre bäre ki man nyoothï gø jï dhi øtø mara. 'Ba ï na Deebit en, këël kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo dïïr wïth nyïïmän moï moa en bäät piny bëët, bäth ec marï doo bëëdö ni poot nyoothï nyoodhø jï dhi øtø mara.»
english: But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever: no, not when the Lord hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jönathan aput tudö ki luubö ki Deebit, ni luubö manøgø tuude kiper dëëre, këël mana këët dhi øtø mar Deebit. 'Ba Jönathan acäŋ köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni dïïr wïth nyïïmän mo Deebit bëët.»
english: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let the Lord even require it at the hand of David's enemies.

anywaa: Ni ö Jönathanni ni cäŋ Deebit wëëk kööŋ ki køør mëër mare mana mëëre ki gøøni, kiper Jönathan mëër ki Deebit døc kaawat man wø mëër dhaanhe ki jwïëye.
english: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan acäŋ köö jï Deebit, ni «Diøø beeye kany wø päär dwääyi møn; 'ba kanyo näk ri cam, karï läämö, kiper køøm marï dööŋ ni ŋaam.
english: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï aay ni bëëdï ki nïne adäk; 'ba noo tïme na dää nïne, wärï laar ci kanya kwøŋï riï kan yie dïkwøŋ, ni bëëdï ŋää Kïn Ëdhël kaace.
english: And when thou hast stayed three days, then thou shalt go down quickly, and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shalt remain by the stone Ezel.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, athëëre adäk thööra jï kunögø, ni kee mara thöödhö ka alääwa.
english: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

anywaa: Køøre nø, nyilaaro cääthwa ki gø jääŋŋa jääŋŋö ni kööa, ni ‹Ciï ni manynyï athëëre moa thööra.› 'Ba kanyo kööa ki nyilaarøgø, ni ‹Neenï, athëëre adööŋ pööthi ni da aani en; duu baŋge,› kar kaagø nø, wärï put ö baŋa; kiper gïnögø nyootha gø ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo di tïïö dëërï; 'ba ki nyeŋ Jwøa kwøw beeye gïn mo beer keere kiperï.
english: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of thee, take them; then come thou: for there is peace to thee, and no hurt; as the Lord liveth.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo aano köö ki nyilaarøgø, ni ‹Neenï, athëëre ena nyïmï kunece,› køøre nø, wärï put aay, kiper Wuuö Jwøk ï ee nø wëëk wääth.
english: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond thee; go thy way: for the Lord hath sent thee away.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør luup moa nø carø ennø, ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk beeye eni noo nut yïthakiyø ki ïïni na bäre bäre.»
english: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of, behold, the Lord be between thee and me for ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ree aput kan yi pwöla; 'ba dïcäŋa päär dwääyi, nyeya apï piny lak cam mana no ojiiŋŋø.
english: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni pï piny bäät køøm mare na en ri øtø, kaawat man wø tïïe cooth. Køøre Abinër apï piny buut nyeya, ni ö Jönathanni ni pï piny ni dïët ki wänni. 'Ba køøm mar Deebit odööŋ ni ŋaam.
english: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, and David's place was empty.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø, Cøøl bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø, kiper ena cädö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Kanymør da gïn mo määnö mo otïïc Deebiti; ni ka adïëri møn, løny ki man tïme ni dëëre käre cïp kur keere ni waany.»
english: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something hath befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïcäŋ maya, ni beeye riet nïne ki mana päär dwääyi, kanya pï jiyi piny lak cam, køøm mar Deebit poot ŋaam. Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï wääde ma Jönathan, na «?Aperŋø na tïme ni o Jeci kär ö baŋ cam, ki mana täge ya awääre këël dïcäŋi?»
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David's place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jönathanni jï wänni ni kööe, ni «Deebit aana kwaaye døc ki man ci Bethelem,
english: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem:
