anywaa: kiper ena köö, na ‹A kwaya ïïni ki man wëëgï a wääth, kiper kar kany ennø, tuuŋwa ge cïpö ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk nee cämge na aciel, ni coka thuwø a ee köömmö døc ki man nuda kaace. 'Ba ennø, ni näk mo yiï met ki aani, a kwaya ïïni naa aa, nee tïme ni løny ki man jooda nyïïmera thuwø.› Manøgø beeye tier gïna tøør Deebiti lak cam marï, ï na nyeya en.»
english: And he said, Let me go, I pray thee; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he hath commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in thine eyes, let me get away, I pray thee, and see my brethren. Therefore he cometh not unto the king's table.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aput wëër døc ki Jönathan, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ïïni, ï na o nyaana näk ŋat ageem ni luupe ba tiir, ?aŋø, rääö marï kuua, ki mana tïme niï miega Deebit o Jeci, ni beeye eni noo tïm wïïï ni laay ki køøre, ni ö meru thuwø ni tïm wïïe ni laay?
english: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?

anywaa: Kiper këël kanyo bëëde ni Deebit o Jeci nut bäät piny kany, ï ränynyö, ni ö nyeci marï ni ba ruue. 'Ba ennø, jääk baŋe ni kälï gø baŋa, kiper nee eni 'näk.»
english: For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground, thou shalt not be established, nor thy kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan mare aløøe jï wänni ma Cøøl ni kööe jïgø, «?Aŋø, eni nääi kiperŋø? ?Da gïn mo ee baaø?»
english: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl wääde ma Jönathan aput thöör ki tøŋ nee nääe; ni ö Jönathanni ni put gø ŋäc møn ni wänni manynya man 'näk Deebit kiree.
english: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan aput ö maal ki kar cam no ogootø døc, ni put kweer ki cam dïcäŋögø, ni beeye riet nïne ki mana päär dwääyi, kiper cwïnye opädhö døc ka apääda mana ö wänni na päät Deebit ki gø.
english: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, Jönathan aci yi pwöla kiper luubö mana caange ki Deebit; ni kanya aae eni cäädhi ka nyilaal mo thiinh.
english: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï nyilaara cääthge ki gø, ni «Ennø, reŋï ni manynyï athëëre moo thööra kawaane ennø.» 'Ba kanya tïme ni nyilaarøgø reeŋø, atheerø aput thöör ni kaal nyilaarøgø.
english: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyilaarøgø na pïïe kanya coonya atheerø yie mana thöör Jönathanni, Jönathan nyilaal arwaae ni kööe, «?Aŋø, paa atheerø ni nyïmï ice?»
english: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond thee?

anywaa: Ni ö Jönathanni ni cäŋ nyilaal rwaayø ni kööe, ni «Läädï, kärï ruu.» Køøre nyilaarøgø atheerø aput kwany ni duu baŋ kwääye ma Jönathan.
english: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan's lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaarøgø bäŋ gïn mo  ŋääe kiper tier gïnögø na bäre; beeye Jönathan ki Deebit keerge na ŋäc tier gïnögø.
english: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

anywaa: Køøre Jönathan gïïa thöödhe ki ge aput wëëk nyilaarøgø ni kööe, ni «Ciï ni kïthï ge paac.»
english: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø aac nyilaarøgø, Deebit aput ö maal ki ŋää Kïn Ëdhël na näk ree ee kan yie, ni ö baŋ Jönathan, ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny kwöre adäk. Køøre dhøkge anuumge ni ge määtha rege, ni putge jwøk; 'ba jwøk mana jwöŋ Deebiti ki gø akadhø døc.
english: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jönathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ciï ki jööt dëël; øøni, kööŋ marø anø tïïø yïthakiyø keerø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni kööø, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo nut yïthakiyø ki ïïni, ki yïthakic nyïïkwaaya ki nyïïkwaayï na bäre bäre.› » Køøre Deebit aput tïŋŋö ni aae, ni ö Jönathanni ni put døø paac.
english: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord be between me and thee, and between my seed and thy seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit apïï Nöp baŋ Ayemëlëk na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Kanyøgønø, Ayemëlëk aö baŋ Deebit ni dëëre miel ki lwär. Ni kö Ayemëlëki jï Deebit, na «?Aŋø ni ööï keerï en ni bäŋ dhaanhø mou cäädhi ka gø?»
english: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Ayemëlëk na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni «Da gïn mo aano kööm nyeya ki gø, ni kööe, ni ‹Kär dee ŋat mo ŋäya gïn ni jääŋŋa ïïni baŋe en, ni beeye gïna köömma ïïni ki gø.› 'Ba jiy moa cääthwa ki geni, da kany mo yaa caanø jïge ni wa røømwa yie ki geni.
english: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

anywaa: ?'Ba ennø, a jïtö ki cam buutï? A kwaya ïïni naa mooyï ki dääpe abïïc, wala cam mana nut jaak.»
english: Now therefore what is under thine hand? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand, or what there is present.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ jï Deebit ni kööe, ni «Bäŋ dääpe moa näk dääpe jaak, 'ba beege muunni moa näk ocïp kur keerge na nyuuthe jï Wuuö Jwøk ni nut ii; 'ba ni näk jiyï dëëtge ege mänö ki ciin baŋ mään, løny ki man cïba geni.»
english: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under mine hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Deebiti jï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni kööe jïgø, «Wui Dïlämi, ka adïëri møn, kany wø dee kany mo wa cøøa yie cooth, wa bëëdö ni waano mänö ki ciin baŋ mään ni dëëtwa ewa cïp kur keere ni waany, kaamar wääth man ni caathwa dïcäŋi en. ?Aŋø, a wääth man ni pöödha eni en, jiy doo cäŋa bëëtö ni dëëtge kärge cïp kur keere ni waany këët?»
english: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aput cïpö jï Deebit røk muunni moøgø no ocïp kur keerge na nyuuthe yøø, ni beege muunni moa no onø daak karge na bëëtge yie nyïm Wuuö Jwøk nee karge kïthi ki muunni mo nyärö. Kiper bäŋ teeŋ dääpe møøk kaace, 'ba beege muunni moøgø keerge.
english: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before the Lord, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat tïïc aciel mar Cøøl ma wïth jø wø kwaac dïëk, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Döweek ma nyï Ëdöm, nut kaagø dïcäŋögø, no otïïö nee bëëde nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the Lord; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Ayemëlëk, ni «?Ennø, bäŋ tøŋ wala opëëllö buutï? Kiper aani opëëllö mara wala jap leny 'moa kära käärö, kiper luum nyeya man beeye gïn mo di layø.»
english: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king's business required haste.

anywaa: Køøre Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, opëëllö mar Göliat nyï Pilitin mana 'nägï Goor Ëla nut no ocïp piny ŋää ëëput noo bääö ka abïï; 'ba ni näk ï manynya gø nee kälï, kälï. Kiper bäŋ opëëllö mør këët.» 'Ba Deebit aköö, ni «Bäŋgø mo kaala gøøni këët nø; wëëk aani.»
english: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom thou slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if thou wilt take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäŋ tïŋŋö dïcäŋögø ni reeŋe ni poot ŋwieya Cøøl, ni aae ni ci baŋ Akïc nyeny jø Gëth.
english: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tïïc mo Akïc aköö jï Akïc, «?Aŋø, man paa Deebit nyeny jø Icriel? ?A duut mana wär jiyi ni jøw miel na køp, «ni ‹Cøøl anääö ki jø Pilitin ma kume, 'ba kume moa 'näk Deebiti thöötha geni døc,› ba wär kipere?»
english: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit luup moøgø akïth cwïnye, ni lwäye døc ka Akïc nyeny jø Gëth.
english: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni put ree tïïc kaamar bøøl nyïmge; 'ba kanya makge gø ena put tïïö ki jap bøøl, ni kew dëër odhuul dhi kiir, ni tïïc laaw nee øcge piny ki bäät jïëc tïïe.
english: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

anywaa: Køøre Akïc aköö jï jø tïïc moe, ni «?Neennu, käru joodø ni ena bøøl? ?Aŋø, kälu gø baŋa aperŋø?
english: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a cana bøøre na kälu nyenøgø na bøøl enø baŋa? ?Aŋø, bøørøgø doo cäŋa käl paara møn?»
english: Have I need of mad men, that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput tïŋŋö ki Gëth ni päär wøk ni put ci yi øt kïdi mana en ya Adulam; 'ba kanya ö nyïïmenni ki tuuŋge bëët moa en poge na wïnyge gø, gena put ci baŋe kunece.
english: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father's house heard it, they went down thither to him.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët moa näk bëëtö marge teek, ki jiy bëët moa näk rege da pïït, ki jiy bëët moa näk cwïnyge oränynyö ki bëët paac, ni putge rege cooŋ buut Deebit; ni ö Deebiti ni put tïmö na kwääc lwaa leny marge. 'Ba jiy bëët moa cooŋ rege buute atïmö na jiy ma dïpe aŋween.
english: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit atïŋŋö ki kaace ni ci Micpa na näk okäl jø Möapi; ni kööe jï nyeny jø Möap, ni «Nyeya, akwaya ïïni nee wära ki mera öge nee bëëtge buutï, këël mano ŋääa gïno tïïc Jwøki kipera.»
english: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray thee, come forth, and be with you, till I know what God will do for me.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit wänni ki menni aput wii buut nyeny Möap; ni ö wänni ki menni ni putge bëëtö buut nyeny Möap kaagø ki yïth nïne bëët moa beet Deebiti ni ree ee kanø kanya näk kar gwøk røk.
english: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk mana cwøl ni Gaat aköö jï Deebit, ni «Kärï bëëdö kar gwøk røk kany; ö maal ni ciï yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput tïŋŋö ni ci yi Lur Ërët.
english: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, awïny Cøølli ki man näk mo Deebit ki jøøa en buute karge onø joot. 'Ba kar kaagø, Cøøl opï piny tier jaadha dwøŋ na en Giba bäät thuur, ni tøŋ mare ena cere ni jø tïïc moe cuŋŋö buute kaagø.
english: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï jø tïïc moe na näk cuŋŋö buute kaagø, «Wui, jø tuuŋ Benjamen, wïnynyu nø. ?Aŋø, Deebit o Jeci, u bëët, u di mooø ki pwöth këël pwöth omøki? ?Aŋø, u di cuumö na kwääc lwaae mo ŋati man nø jïre da lwaa jiy ma kuma ki kwääc lwaae mo ŋati man nø jïre da lwaa jiy ma dïpa?
english: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, ye Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

anywaa: Kiper u bëët, dhøgu anø tuutu bääta, ni bäŋe dhaanhø maa ee wäänynyö kanya ö wääda ni tude ki luubö ki o Jeci; bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dëëtu na bäre mo cwïnye omaar pädhö kipera, ni bäŋe dhaanhø thuwø maa ee maar wäänynyö ki gïna ö wääda na coon yi ŋat tïïc mara ma Deebit nee gëëme ki aani, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en ni Deebit omøør piny nyeŋ jïëthe 'moa.»
english: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

anywaa: 'Ba Döweek nyï Ëdöm, na näk cuŋŋö buut jø tïïc mo Cøøl kaagø, mare aløøe ni kööe, ni «Deebit o Jeci ajooda kanya pïïe Nöp baŋ Ayemëlëk wär Akitöp.
english: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

anywaa: Ni ö Ayemëlëki ni pëëny Wuuö Jwøk kiper Deebit, ni mooc gø ki gïn came, ni put opëëllö mar Göliat nyï Pilitin cïp jïgø.»
english: And he enquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cøøl aput jääk baŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ma Ayemëlëk wär Akitöp, ki tuuŋge bëët moa bëëdö na dïlämme Nöp kaace; ni ö jøøgø bëët ni putge ö baŋ nyeya.
english: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father's house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö, «Nyie wär Akitöp, cek ïthï.» Ni kö Ayemëlëki, ni «Wui nyeya, caanï nø.»
english: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Ayemëlëk, «?Aŋø, ïïni ki o Jeci, u tuutu dhøgu bääta kiperŋø? ?Aŋø, Deebit aputï mooc ki muunni, ni cïpï opëëllö jïre, ni pëënynyï Jwøk kipere kiree, ni ö Deebiti ni put gëëmö ki aani, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en ni bëëdö no omøør piny nyeŋ jïëthe 'moa?»
english: And Saul said unto him, Why have ye conspired against me, thou and the son of Jesse, in that thou hast given him bread, and a sword, and hast enquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

anywaa: Køøre Ayemëlëk mare aløøe jï nyeya ni kööe, «?Aŋø, ki røk jø tïïc moï bëët, dhaanhø mo oŋäädhö mo caala Deebit dagø? Kiper beeye eni na cø nyaarï, ï na nyeya, ni beeye ni wø bëëdö na wïth jø lwaa leny mo wø koor ïïni, ni beeye eni na dhaanhø mana näk owøørø paarï.
english: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David, which is the king's son in law, and goeth at thy bidding, and is honourable in thine house?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, beeye täge eni dïcäŋi ennø ki man pëënynya Jwøk kiper Deebit? Wui nyeya, ka adïëri møn, acaara manøgø kara bäär ki gø. Ï na nyeya en, beerra man ba kïthï bääta ki luubö mo kära tïïö, a na dhaanhnhï en; këël tuuŋwa bëët thuwø kär dee luubö mo kïthï bäätge, kiper a na dhaanhnhï en, bäŋ gïn mo ŋääa na bäre bäre kiper luubö manøgø.»
english: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ï na Ayemëlëk ki dëërï enø ki tuuŋu bëët, u di nääö kiree.»
english: And the king said, Thou shalt surely die, Ahimelech, thou, and all thy father's house.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya jï jø wø koor eni moa näk cuŋŋö buute kaagø, ni «Ööu maal ni 'nägu dïlämme mo Wuuö Jwøk, kiper geni, geno dwätö ki Deebit; ni ŋäcge møn ni Deebit mare beeye päär wøk, ni kärge aani wäänynyö.» 'Ba jø tïïc mo nyeya akweer ki man 'näkge dïlämme mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of the Lord; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï Döweek, «Nyie Döweek, ö maal ni 'nägï dïlämme.» Kanyøgønø, Döweek nyï Ëdöm aput ö maal ni 'näk dïlämme; ni jiy moa nääe bëët dïcäŋögø beege jiy ma pïërabära ka abïïc, ni jøøgø bëët beege dïlämme mo wø røc abïïga cwøl ni ëëput na näk ocwääö ki waac lïïna.
english: And the king said to Doeg, Turn thou, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl jiy bëët moa bëëdö Nöp pääny mar dïlämme aput tïïc nee ge 'näk ko opëëllö, ni beege cwøw, ki mään, ko obwöre, ko obwöre moa näk poot dhøøth; këël dhäk, ka arëëni ki dïëk anääe thuwø.
english: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Ayemëlëk wär Akitöp, wääde aciel mo nyeŋŋe Abiethaar abøth, ni put päär wøk ni aae ni reŋ baŋ Deebit.
english: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abiethaar gïna tïïc Cøølli, na 'näk dïlämme mo Wuuö Jwøk, acaane jï Deebit.
english: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the Lord's priests.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Abiethaar, ni «Dïcäŋece kanya jooda Döweek nyï Ëdöm ni nut kaace, aputa ŋäc ni luubö manøgø caane caanø jï Cøøl. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, beeye aani na käl thøø manøgø bäät tuuŋ wäru bëët.
english: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father's house.

anywaa: Ennø møn, ï bëëdö buuta kany. Kär dee lwär cwïnyï, kiper Cøøl ni many jwïëyï enø, eni manynya jwïëya thuwø; 'ba ï puta bëëtö ni jwïëyï ogwøø ki aani na aciel.»
english: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Deebit, ni «Neenï, jø Pilitin ge këëdö ki jø Kïïla ni ge twiera caammi moa en yïth laare.»
english: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit Wuuö Jwøk apëënynye ni kööe, ni «?Cøøa ni tuua jø Pilitin moøgø?» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ci tuk geni, ni piemï jø Kïïla.»
english: Therefore David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And the Lord said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo Deebit aköö jï Deebit, ni «Neenï, këël ni bëëtwa dï ŋööm Juuda en, wa bëëdö ni wa lwäär. ?A ni näk mo waano ci Kïïla baŋ leny ki jø leny mo jø Pilitin, a teeŋ bëëtö mo nyïëdi nø no obëëtwa ki gø?»
english: And David's men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Judah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit, Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ pëënynyö. 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jï Deebit ni kööe, ni «Ö maal, ni løøyï piny baŋ jø Kïïla, kiper aani jø leny mo jø Pilitin cïba cerï.»
english: Then David enquired of the Lord yet again. And the Lord answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ki jø leny moe gena put ci Kïïla ni këëtge ki jø leny mo jø Pilitin, ni 'näkge jø Pilitin mo thööth døc, ni twierge dhäk moge. Ni ö Deebiti ni put jø Kïïla piem.
english: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, kanya ö Abiethaarri wär Ayemëlëk na rïŋ baŋ Deebit Kïïla, eni rïŋŋi ni ëëput kääre käärö.
english: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Cøøl ni Deebit oci Kïïla, Cøøl aköö, ni «Ena cïp Wuuö Jwøki cera møn; kare aløny ni diiny ni bäŋ kany reeŋe ki yie këët, kiper ena døny yi kiir mo odhuule moe otïïö ni teek døc mo di dëëdö ki dïdëëte.»
english: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, God hath delivered him into mine hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that hath gates and bars.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl jø leny bëët acwøle, nee ge løøcge piny Kïïla nee Deebit ki jø leny moe rumge dïër.
english: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

anywaa: 'Ba aŋäc Deebiti ni Cøøl manynya gø nee tïïe ki gïn mo leth dëëre. Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni «Käl ëëput kany.»
english: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit alämö ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, aani, a na dhaanhnhï, awïnynya møn ni Cøøl manynya man ö Kïïla nee pääny raanynye kipera.
english: Then said David, O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

anywaa: ?A ni näk mo Cøøl öö, jø Kïïla a cïpge cere møn? ?Kaawat mana wïnynya gø, a na dhaanhnhï, Cøøl ööa kany møn? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, a kwaya ïïni, caan adïëri marï jïra.» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Cøøl öö møn.»
english: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as thy servant hath heard? O Lord God of Israel, I beseech thee, tell thy servant. And the Lord said, He will come down.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäŋ köö, «?A jø Kïïla, aani ki jø leny 'moa, wa cïpge cer Cøøl møn?» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U cïpge cer Cøøl møn.»
english: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And the Lord said, They will deliver thee up.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput päny maal ki jø leny moe mo jïtö ki dïpe abïciel, ni tïŋge ki Kïïla, ni putge wääth ni ge kaanna rege, ni ge cøøa kany nø ki kany nø. 'Ba kanya caani jï Cøøl ni Deebit apäär wøk ki Kïïla, Cøøl ŋwïëy køør Deebit aput wec.
english: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput bëëtö kwör gwøk røk, ni eni bëëdö dï paap Dhip na en bäät kïte. Ni ö Cøølli ni put bëëtö ni manynya Deebit cooth; 'ba Jwøk Deebit käre cïp cer Cøøl.
english: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Deebiti ni eni ena kanya cwøl ni Örec na en dï paap Dhip, aŋääe ni Cøøl poot ööa kuna many jwïëye nee rwäänye.
english: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan o Cøøl aay ni ci baŋ Deebit Örec, ni køny gø nee jïte ki teek baŋ Jwøk,
english: And Jonathan Saul's son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in God.

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Kärï lwäyö, kiper cer wära ma Cøøl ba pïï dëërï. Ï tïmö na nyeya bäät Icriel, ni tïma naa ena køørï. Këël wära ma Cøøl gïnögø ŋääe thuwø.»
english: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee; and thou shalt be king over Israel, and I shall be next unto thee; and that also Saul my father knoweth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, geni karge riet gena put tudö ki luubö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö Deebiti ni put bëëtö Örec, 'ba Jönathan adøø paare.
english: And they two made a covenant before the Lord: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

anywaa: Køøre jø Dhip aö baŋ Cøøl Giba, ni köge, ni «Deebit ree ee kan yi ŋöömwa kwör gwøk røk moa en Örec, na en bäät Kïn Akëla, jï løø tier-piny ki løø ŋöömma näk dïtëën.
english: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

anywaa: Wui nyeya, ennø, ööï ni tïïyï mana manynyï ki cwïnyï; 'ba gïno tïïcwa beeye ki man cïpwa Deebit cerï, ï na nyeya en.»
english: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king's hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aköö, ni «Uuno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki kiper mana nø päth cwïnynyu kipera.
english: And Saul said, Blessed be ye of the Lord; for ye have compassion on me.

anywaa: Ennø, cou ni jiiŋŋu rou døc, ni manynyu gø, ni jootu kwör wø cäädhe yïthge, ni pëënynyu ŋata joot gø kaace thuwø; kiper acaan jïra ni eni waŋe riek døc kiree.
english: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, manynyu ni ŋäyu kwör wø kaan ree yïthge bëët, ni duu baŋa ki luubö ma kare; køøre a aay ki uuni. 'Ba ni näk mo eni poot ena kaace, eni manynya manynyø, këël dï jø tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda.»
english: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hideth himself, and come ye again to me with the certainty, and I will go with you: and it shall come to pass, if he be in the land, that I will search him out throughout all the thousands of Judah.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø atïŋŋö ni døøge Dhip ni wiige Cøøl piny ni poot kär tïŋŋö. 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit ki jø leny moe ge ena dï paap Maøn, na en dï goor Araaba jï løø tier-piny ki løø ŋöömma näk dïtëën.
english: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli ki jø leny moe na cige kun manyge Deebit, acaan jï Deebit; ni ö Deebiti ni løøc piny ni ci ri kïdi mana en piny, ni put bëëtö kaace dï paap Maøn. 'Ba kanya wïnynyi Cøølli, ena läp køør Deebit dï paap Maøn.
english: Saul also and his men went to seek him. And they told David: wherefore he came down into a rock, and abode in the wilderness of Maon. And when Saul heard that, he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl aay ki deŋ kïdi løøk maya, ni ö Deebiti ki jø leny moe ni aacge ki deŋ kïdi løøk maya; 'ba Deebit rwäänhnhö døc kiper nee Cøøl jööme, kiper Cøøl ki jø leny moe geno løny ni ge ruma Deebit ki jø leny moe dïër nee makge.
english: And Saul went on this side of the mountain, and David and his men on that side of the mountain: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo jääŋŋi ki paac aö baŋ Cøøl, ni kööe, ni «Laar ö paac, kiper jø Pilitin paac anø tukge.»
english: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl køør Deebit aput wec, ni døø paac nee këëtge ki jø Pilitin. 'Ba nyeŋ kïnna ö Cøølli na wec køør Deebit ki caath deŋŋe, aput cwøl ni Kïn Bødhø.
english: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David, and went against the Philistines: therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput aay kaace ni ci kuna bëëde kwör gwøk røk moa en deŋ Ayn-Gadi.
english: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli na duue ki kuna ŋwiec køør jø Pilitin, acaan jïre, ni «Neenï, Deebit ena dï paap Ayn-Gadi.»
english: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En–gedi.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl jø leny moa teek døc ma kume adäk alwøre røk jø Icriel bëët, ni ci kuna many Deebit ki jø leny moe deŋ kït wø bëët lääc paap moa näk caala atëëe bäätge.
english: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl apïï ri käädi mo dïëk moa en buut jöö, kany mo yie da øt kïdi; ni ö Cøølli ni døny yi gø ni mare ciin wøk. 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit ki jø leny moe geno pï piny yi øt kïdi manøgø kany ma gøøt.
english: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø leny mo Deebit aköö jï Deebit, ni «Neenï, dïcäŋi beeye dïcäŋa kö Wuuö Jwøki jïrï ni nyimännï cïbe cerï yie, ni tïïyï mana manynyï jaak dëëre.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput ö maal ni ŋul deŋ abïï Cøøl wøk mëëth ni kuc Cøølli.
english: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään, Deebit cwïnye apädhö kiper mana ŋul deŋ abïï nyeya wøk.
english: And it came to pass afterward, that David's heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul's skirt.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï jø leny moe, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk kiree, beerra man tïm kara ni bäär ki man tïïa ki gïn mo leth dëër nyenynya na no otïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw. Ka adïëri møn, cera ba kïtha dëëre, kiper beeye ŋata tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw.»
english: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord's anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jø leny moe ajwøe, ni män geni ki man tïïge ki gïn mo leth dëër Cøøl. Kanyøgønø, Cøøl atïŋŋö ki øt kïdi kaagø, ni aae ki wääthe na caadhe.
english: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Deebit aö maal, ni duny wøk ki øt kïdi ni rwaac Cøøl, ni kööe, «Nyie, caan jï nyeya enø.» 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli na lwïthe køøre, Deebit cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni wøøra Cøøl.
english: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Cøøl, «?Aŋø, ï wïnynyï ŋø ki luup jiy moa köö ni Deebit manynya man tïïe ki gïn mo leth dëërï?
english: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?

anywaa: Neenï nø, ajootï, dïcäŋi ïïna cïp Wuuö Jwøki cera øt kïdi, ni kö jiya møøk niï 'näk. 'Ba cwïnya apädhö kiperï, ni kööa, ni ‹Cera ba kïtha dëër nyenynya, kiper ena ŋata tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw.›
english: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the Lord had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the Lord's anointed.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Awuuö, ka adïëri møn, neen deŋ abïï marï ni en cera en; kiper deŋ abïïnï keere aŋula wøk, ni kära ïïni nääö. Ennø, wär ŋäyï ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ena cwïnya ki ïïni, ni bäŋ ageem maa gëëmö ki gø ki ïïni, ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø dëërï; 'ba ïïni, ï bëëdö ni ïïno møør piny nyïma niï manynya jwïëya nee raanynyï.
english: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni ŋøl mare yïthakiyø ki ïïni, ni tïme ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk noo cool kwöra dëërï; 'ba aani cera ba kïtha dëërï.
english: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana caani ya jø acääŋŋe, ni køp, ni ‹Gïn mo raac käla cwïny ŋata raac,› aani, teeŋ acaara manøgø bäŋgø cwïnya; cera ba kïtha dëërï.
english: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aŋa ni køøre caathï en, ï na nyeny Icriel? ?Aŋø, ï ŋwieyï køør ŋa? ?Ï ba ŋwiec køøra, a ni caal gwök mo othøw en wala twöŋö jaak?
english: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk dïŋut luup, beerra man ŋøl luummögø yïthakiyø ki ïïni; ni ö eni ni neen tier luubö, ni ŋun aani, ni piem aani cerï.»
english: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na thöör luup moa care jï Cøøl, Cøøl aköö, «Nyie Deebit wääda, beeye ïïni ni dwørï wïnynya møn enø?» Køøre Cøøl aput jwøk døc ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal.
english: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Beerra marï ki mara; kiper ïïna tïïö ki gïn mo beer kipera. 'Ba aani, mana tïïa dëërï beeye gïn mo raac.
english: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.

anywaa: 'Ba anyoothï jïra dïcäŋi ki man näk miï bëëdö niï tïïya gïn mo beer kipera; këël na bëëde ni Wuuö Jwøk a ee cïp cerï, a kärï nääö.
english: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the Lord had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk mo dhaanhø nyimänne ee joodø, a dee gø wiiø nidïï nee aae jaak? Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mooc ïïni ki gïn mo beer kiper gïna tïïyï kipera dïcäŋi en.
english: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the Lord reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ka adïëri møn, ajooda niï tïmö na nyeya møn, ni ö nyeci mar Icriel ni këët piny ni teek dhi cerï.
english: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kööŋï ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki man näk mo nyïïkwaaya ba 'nägï køøra, ki man näk mo wïïa ba dïïrï røk jø dhi øt kwara.»
english: Swear now therefore unto me by the Lord, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father's house.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit akööŋ jï Cøøl. Køøre Cøøl aput døø paare, ni ö Deebiti ki jø leny moe ni cige kar gwøk røk mana en bäät kïdi.
english: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit atïŋŋö ni ci dï paap Paran.
Køøre Camiel athøw; ni ö jø Icrielli ni cooŋge rege kanya aciel ni kïmge kipere, ni koonyge eni paare na en Reema.
english: And Samuel died; and all the Israelites were gathered together, and lamented him, and buried him in his house at Ramah. And David arose, and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mør mo bëëdö Maøn mo tïïc mare ena Karmël. 'Ba nyenøgø beeye dhaanhø mo okwär døc, ni jïre da rööm ma kume adäk ka atëëe ma kuma. Ni kar kaagø, eni nyädö ki jïëc rööm moe Karmël kaace.
english: And there was a man in Maon, whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great, and he had three thousand sheep, and a thousand goats: and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ nyenøgø beeye Nabal, ni nyeŋ cïïe beeye Abigël. Ni dhaagø manøgø beeye dhaagø mo wïïe leer ni kïte mïërö døc. 'Ba nyenøgø beeye dhaanhø ma ŋat ajage ni tïïe moe bëët reyø; ni eni, ena nyï tuuŋ jø Kalëp.
english: Now the name of the man was Nabal; and the name of his wife Abigail: and she was a woman of good understanding, and of a beautiful countenance: but the man was churlish and evil in his doings; and he was of the house of Caleb.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni Deebit bëëdö dï paap, awïnynye ni Nabal nyädö ki jïëc rööm moe.
english: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ajäägö ki jiy apaar røk jiye, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou Karmël baŋ Nabal ni caannu määdhe mara jïre.
english: And David sent out ten young men, and David said unto the young men, Get you up to Carmel, and go to Nabal, and greet him in my name:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pïïyu, wär caannu jïre ni ïïna määth Deebiti ni kööe, ni ‹Met ec bëëde bäätï; bëëdï ki jööt dëël ki jø paarï, këël gïïa en jïrï bëët.
english: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity, Peace be both to thee, and peace be to thine house, and peace be unto all that thou hast.

anywaa: 'Ba awïnynya niï nyädö ki jïëc rööm moï. Ennø møn, jø kwaath moï abëëdö ki waani ni bäŋ gïn mo cwïnyge ewa raanynyø ki gø, këël gïn mo orwäänyö baŋge bäŋgø thuwø ki yïth nïne bëët moa beetge Karmël.
english: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

anywaa: Løny ki man pëënynyï jiyï; caange caanø jïrï. 'Ba ennø møn, beerra man nyoothï bäth ec marï jï jiya, kiper waana ö baŋï ki dïcäŋ mana näk cäŋ ajwöma. A kwaya ïïni ki man cïpï gïna nut cerï jaak jï wäädï ma Deebit ki jiye.› »
english: Ask thy young men, and they will shew thee. Wherefore let the young men find favour in thine eyes: for we come in a good day: give, I pray thee, whatsoever cometh to thine hand unto thy servants, and to thy son David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jic Deebit aöö, ni caange luup moøgø jï Nabal, ni beege luup bëët moa car Deebiti; ni putge lïŋŋe ni ge koora løk pïëc mano duu Naballi.
english: And when David's young men came, they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David, and ceased.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Naballi jï jic Deebit, ni kööe, «?Aŋø, Deebit aŋa? ?Eni na o Jeci enø, ena ŋa? Dïcäŋi en da laaŋe mo thööth mo geno päär wøk ki baŋ kwääri moge.
english: And Nabal answered David's servants, and said, Who is David? and who is the son of Jesse? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jiy mo karge kuua jaak, daa mooø ki cam, ki pïï, ki rïŋ dïëk moa ŋara jï jiya mo wø nyaar jïëc rööm?»
english: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jic Deebit rege aputge løk ni døøkge; 'ba kanya pïïcge, luup moøgø bëët aputge caan jï Deebit.
english: So David's young men turned their way, and went again, and came and told him all those sayings.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï jø leny moe, ni «Ŋati man nø dëëtu twöc opëëllö mare.» Ni ö ŋati man nø ni put opëëllö mare twöc. Ni ö Deebiti thuwø ni twöc opëëllö mare, ni ö jiyi ma dïpe aŋween ni putge aay ni ge cäädha køør Deebit; 'ba jø leny møøk ma dïpe ariiø adööŋ ni ge koora jammi.
english: And David said unto his men, Gird ye on every man his sword. And they girded on every man his sword; and David also girded on his sword: and there went up after David about four hundred men; and two hundred abode by the stuff.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør røk jø tïïc mo Nabal acaane jï Abigël cï Nabal, ni kööe, «Neenï, Deebit ajääŋŋö ki jiy ki dï paap ni määtha kwäärö marwa. 'Ba eni jøøgø ajanynye.
english: But one of the young men told Abigail, Nabal's wife, saying, Behold, David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master; and he railed on them.

anywaa: 'Ba neenï, Deebit ki jiye kee gena jiy mo okunynyö kiperwa. Bäŋ gïn mo cwïnywa ege raanynyø ki gø, këël gïn mo orwäänyö bäŋgø thuwø ki yïth nïne bëët moa beetwa buutge ni wa ena kar kwaath.
english: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:

anywaa: Geni, ge caala gëëŋi kiperwa ki wäär këël dïcäŋ ki yïth nïne bëët moa beetwa buutge kaace ni wa kwaaya dïëk.
english: They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, cädï bäät luubö manøgø ni jootï gïna beerra eni ki man tïïyï gø, kiper da gïn mo raac mo tïïc Deebiti tïïö dëër kwäärö marwa, ki jøøa en paare bëët. 'Ba Nabal, ŋäcwa ni ena dhaanhø mo wïïe raac, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man cääne ki gø.»
english: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do; for evil is determined against our master, and against all his household: for he is such a son of Belial, that a man cannot speak to him.

anywaa: Køøre Abigël alaar lwötö ki dääpe ma dïpe ariiø, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo päŋ yïth opïc pëëne ariiø, ki dïëk abïïc mo onø jiiŋŋø, ki beel mo omuuö ma yïth rumme abïïc, ki nyïïomøki moa no otal mo omiiø na dhøgi ma dïpa, ki nyïï olämmi mo omiiø na dhøgi ma dïpe ariiø, ni put ge kïth bäät arëëni.
english: Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï jø tïïc moe moa näk cwøw, ni «Ennø, bwøthu maal nyïma; ka adïëri møn, aani, a cäädhö køøru.» 'Ba Abigël bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø jï cwøre ma Nabal.
english: And she said unto her servants, Go on before me; behold, I come after you. But she told not her husband Nabal.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø na cäädhe ni ena bäät arëën mare ni eni löönynya piny ki deŋ kïdi kany mo dhaanhø ba nëëni ki yie, ka adïëri møn, Deebit ki jiye ge löönynya piny ki bäät kïdi ki løøk maya ni ge cäänhnha kuna näk da eni; kanyøgønø, Abigël aput røømmø ki geni.
english: And it was so, as she rode on the ass, that she came down by the covert of the hill, and, behold, David and his men came down against her; and she met them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit onø cäänö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aana bëëdö naa koora dïëk mo nyenøgø bëët ki jaak dï paap, ni bäŋgø mo orwäänyö røk gïïa en jïre bëët; 'ba ki køør gïna beer na tïïa, acäŋ tïmö ni duua gïn mo raac jïra.
english: Now David had said, Surely in vain have I kept all that this fellow hath in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed of all that pertained unto him: and he hath requited me evil for good.

anywaa: 'Ba diøø ka amöölla ni näk mo da dïcwøø aciel mo ena paare mo yaa wiiø ni kwøw, beerra man ö Jwøki ni raany aani, a na Deebit en.»
english: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Abigël na joot Deebit, ena laar eth piny ki bäät arëën mare, ni leeŋ ree piny nyïm Deebit, ni duu maal, ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny.
english: And when Abigail saw David, she hasted, and lighted off the ass, and fell before David on her face, and bowed herself to the ground,

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abigël apäth tiet Deebit ni kwac gø ni kööe, «Wui kwäärö, bääyö manøgø tïme ni ena bääta keera. 'Ba ennø, akwaya ïïni ki man wëëgï a cäännö, a na dhaanhnhï, ni cegï ïthï ki luup moo cara jïrï.
english: And fell at his feet, and said, Upon me, my lord, upon me let this iniquity be: and let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak in thine audience, and hear the words of thine handmaid.

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni, ï na kwääya, luup moa car Naballi kär kïth cwïnyï; eni, ena dhaanhø mo wïïe raac. Nyeŋŋe beeye Nabal møn, kiper nyeŋŋe mana caai ki gø aput tïmö ni röömi ki bëëtö mare, ni bëëde ni tïïya gïï wø tïïc bøølli. 'Ba a na dhaanhnhï, ka adïëri møn, jiyï moa jääŋŋï, kanya öge, ge kära joodø na bäre.
english: Let not my lord, I pray thee, regard this man of Belial, even Nabal: for as his name is, so is he; Nabal is his name, and folly is with him: but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord, whom thou didst send.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø møn, ï na kwäärö mara, a kööŋŋa ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, ki ŋëëtï; kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na män ïïni ennø nee rem jiy ba kønynyï piny, ni ba coolï kwörï ki dëërï kiree, beerra man ö nyïïmän moï, ni beege jøøa many man tïïge ki gïn mo leth dëërï, ni tïmge kaamar Nabal.
english: Now therefore, my lord, as the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the Lord hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ö gïïa käla jïrï, ï na kwääya, ni cïba ge jï jiyï moø ni cäädhï ki ge yøø.
english: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni ki man wëënnï bääyö mara, a na dhaanhnhï. 'Ba ï na kwääya, Wuuö Jwøk dhi øtø marï tïïe tïïö nee bëëde ni teek, kiper ïïni, ï këëla lenye moøgø ni en cer Wuuö Jwøk yøø. 'Ba ï puta bëëtö ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo tïïyï ki yïth nïr kwøw moï bëët.
english: I pray thee, forgive the trespass of thine handmaid: for the Lord will certainly make my lord a sure house; because my lord fighteth the battles of the Lord, and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days.

anywaa: Këël ni näk mo da ŋat mo ööa maal ni ŋwieya køørï ni manynya man rwääny jwïëyï, ï na kwääya, jwïëy moï bëëdö no ogwøk Wuuö Jwøki Jwøk marï ni perge leth døc. 'Ba jwïëy mo nyïïmännï wet Wuuö Jwøki wetø kany mo bäär, kaawat man wø thöör waŋ kïdi mo okïth yo okwat mar gïn wø thöör ni di wïrö.
english: Yet a man is risen to pursue thee, and to seek thy soul: but the soul of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with the Lord thy God; and the souls of thine enemies, them shall he sling out, as out of the middle of a sling.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni Wuuö Jwøk luup bëët moa beyø na care kiperï wëëge thur karge, ni tïïc ï na wïth jø Icriel,
english: And it shall come to pass, when the Lord shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee, and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel;

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo riï jäälï jäälö ki gø wala gïn miï døøa cwïnyï ki gø, beerra man bäŋe remø mo kønynyï piny ki jaak niï coola kwörï, ï na kwääya. 'Ba ennø, kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo mooc ïïni ki bëëtö mo beer, beerra man parï wïïï ki aani, a na dhaanhnhï.»
english: That this shall be no grief unto thee, nor offence of heart unto my lord, either that thou hast shed blood causeless, or that my lord hath avenged himself: but when the Lord shall have dealt well with my lord, then remember thine handmaid.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Abigël, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na jääŋ ïïni dïcäŋi en, nee ø røømmø ki ïïni.
english: And David said to Abigail, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which sent thee this day to meet me:

anywaa: Ïïno gwïëth Jwøki kiper acaara marï na beer, ki køør mana mänï aani dïcäŋi ki man kønynya rem jiy piny ki jaak, ni kwöra coola aani ki dëëra kiree.
english: And blessed be thy advice, and blessed be thou, which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood, and from avenging myself with mine own hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na kwøw, na män aani ki man tïïa dëërï ki gïn mo raac, dee niï kär laar rwänhnhö ni røømmø ki ïïni, ka adïëri møn, kanya dee tïmö na bäc øw diøø doo bäŋ dïcwøø aciel mo dööŋ jï Nabal.»
english: For in very deed, as the Lord God of Israel liveth, which hath kept me back from hurting thee, except thou hadst hasted and come to meet me, surely there had not been left unto Nabal by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit caammi alwøre cer Abigël, ni beege gïïa käle jïgø. Ni kö Deebiti jï Abigël, ni «Ci døø paarï ki jööt dëël nø. Neenï, aani dwørï aleŋa ni jïëa pïëc marï.»
english: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him, and said unto her, Go up in peace to thine house; see, I have hearkened to thy voice, and have accepted thy person.

anywaa: Køøre Abigël aay ni pïïe baŋ cwøre ma Nabal; 'ba kanya pïïe, ka adïëri møn, Nabal da cam ajwöma mo ee jiiŋŋø paare, mo caala man wø jiiŋ nyeya. 'Ba kar kaagø, Nabal bëëdö ni yie met jaak, kiper eno meer døc kiree. 'Ba Abigël bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø jï Nabal na bäre këël mana tïm pinynyi na amöölla.
english: And Abigail came to Nabal; and, behold, he held a feast in his house, like the feast of a king; and Nabal's heart was merry within him, for he was very drunken: wherefore she told him nothing, less or more, until the morning light.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na amöölla, ni Nabal køøŋø onø waany wïïe, luup moøgø bëët acaan cïïe jïgø; ni ö cwïny Nabal ni put bwøk døc ni tïme kaamar dhaanhø mo othøw.
english: But it came to pass in the morning, when the wine was gone out of Nabal, and his wife had told him these things, that his heart died within him, and he became as a stone.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne mo jïtö ka apaar, Wuuö Jwøk mare aŋøle bäät Nabal, ni put Naballi thøø.
english: And it came to pass about ten days after, that the Lord smote Nabal, that he died.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na wïny gø ni Nabal athøw, ena köö, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, na ŋøl luubö na kare ki køør mana ö Naballi na jany aani. Beeye Wuuö Jwøk na koor aani, a na dhaanhnhe, ki man ba tïïa ki gïn mo raac. Wuuö Jwøk gïna raac na tïïc Naballi adwøk wï gø keere møn.» Køøre Deebit ajääk baŋ Abigël nee cäänö ki gø ki man tïme na dhaagø jïre.
english: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the Lord, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the Lord hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc jic Deebit moa jääŋŋe Karmël baŋ Abigël, gena put cäänö ka Abigël ni köge jïgø, ni «Waana jääŋ Deebiti baŋï, nee ø aaø ki ïïni niï tïmï ni ïïna dhaagø jïre.»
english: And when the servants of David were come to Abigail to Carmel, they spake unto her, saying, David sent us unto thee, to take thee to him to wife.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abigël aput ö maal ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, a na ŋat tïïc maru, yia met ki man bëëda naa lwøga tiet jic kwääya ma Deebit.»
english: And she arose, and bowed herself on her face to the earth, and said, Behold, let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord.

anywaa: Køøre Abigël alaar ö maal ni eth bäät arëën, ni put aay ni cäädhi ka nyïïakuue abïïc moa näk jø tïïc moe; ni ö Abigëlli ni put wääth køør jøøa jääŋ Deebiti. 'Ba kanya pïïcge, Abigël aput tïmö na cï Deebit.
english: And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø thuwø, Deebit Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel ee nø nywøm, ni ö nyïgögø karge riet ni putge bëëtö na määre.
english: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel; and they were also both of them his wives.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl nyaare ma Mikal, na bëëdö na cï Deebit, ee nø cïp jï Palti o Laaic nyï Gaalim.
english: But Saul had given Michal his daughter, David's wife, to Phalti the son of Laish, which was of Gallim.

anywaa: Køøre jø Dhip acäŋ ö baŋ Cøøl Giba, ni köge, ni «Deebit ree ee kan bäät Kïn Akëla, na en buut ŋöömma näk dïtëën.»
english: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah, saying, Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aput tïŋŋö ni løøc piny dï paap Dhip, ni eni cäädhi ka jø leny mo jø Icriel ma kume adäk moa teek døc, nee Deebit manynye dï paap Dhip.
english: Then Saul arose, and went down to the wilderness of Ziph, having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him, to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl twïër mare atïïe bäät Kïn Akëla, buut ŋöömma näk dïtëën, thääŋ jöö. 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit bëëdö dï paap. 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na ŋäc gø ni Cøøl ööa køøre dï paap,
english: And Saul pitched in the hill of Hachilah, which is before Jeshimon, by the way. But David abode in the wilderness, and he saw that Saul came after him into the wilderness.

anywaa: Deebit ajäägö ki dïlëëwe, ni ŋäc gø møn ni Cøøl ööa baŋe.
english: David therefore sent out spies, and understood that Saul was come in very deed.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput ö maal ni ö kanya näk Cøøl twïër mare ee tïïö yi gø. Ni ö Deebiti ni joot Cøøl ni ena kar niine mare, na Abinër o Nër, kwääy lwaa leny mare, ena buute. 'Ba Cøøl obutö dïër dï twïër, ni jiy kurö deŋŋe kaagø bäre.
english: And David arose, and came to the place where Saul had pitched: and David beheld the place where Saul lay, and Abner the son of Ner, the captain of his host: and Saul lay in the trench, and the people pitched round about him.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäänö ka Ayemëlëk nyï Këth ka Abicay o Dheruya, cöök Jöap, ni pëëny ge ni kööe, na «?Aŋa noo aay ki aani na aciel nee wa ciwa baŋ Cøøl yi twïër?» 'Ba Abicay aköö, ni «Aani, a aay ki ïïni.»
english: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ka Abicay gena put ci baŋ jø leny mo Cøøl ki dïwäär. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, Cøøl obutö dïër dï twïër ni tøŋ mare ee cwöth piny wïïe, na Abinër ki jø leny moe geno but piny deŋŋe kaagø.
english: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.

anywaa: Køøre Abicay aköö jï Deebit, ni «Dïcäŋi, Jwøk nyimännï anø cïp cerï; 'ba ennø, beerra man wëëgï eni aani, nee këëla ki tøŋ yie aciel keere nee puta rep piny, ni ba cäŋa gø nwøyø këët.»
english: Then said Abishai to David, God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day: now therefore let me smite him, I pray thee, with the spear even to the earth at once, and I will not smite him the second time.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Abicay, ni «Kär niï 'näga gø, kiper ŋato 'näk eni, eni na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw, ba kääŋi ka ajäl Jwøk.»
english: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the Lord's anointed, and be guiltless?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäŋ köö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ni wø ŋøl luup, mare oŋøle bäät Cøøl; dïcäŋo thøøe yie opäŋ, ni put thøø, wala eni cøøa baŋ leny ni puti 'näk.
english: David said furthermore, As the Lord liveth, the Lord shall smite him; or his day shall come to die; or he shall descend into battle, and perish.

anywaa: Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man tïm kara ni bäär ki man kïtha cera dëër ŋata tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw; 'ba ennø, beerra man lwørï tøŋ manøgø ni ee cwöth piny wïïe enø, ka agwäy mar pïï, nee ø aaø.»
english: The Lord forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ka Abicay tøŋ ka agwää pïï aputge lwør buut wï Cøøl, ni putge aay. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo oŋäc gø, wala ŋat mo opäy mo ojoot gø; kiper jiy bëët obutö, ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc ge nee butge døc.
english: So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul's bolster; and they gat them away, and no man saw it, nor knew it, neither awaked: for they were all asleep; because a deep sleep from the Lord was fallen upon them.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput ŋut ri kïdi maya, ni cuŋŋe wï kïdi, ni yïthakicge bäär mëëth.
english: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jø leny mo Cøøl ka Abinër o Nër, arwaae ni kööe, «?Nyie Abinër, wïnyö jïrï enø?» Køøre Abinër ajutö ni kööe, ni «?Ïïna ŋa ni cwøl nyeya en?»
english: And David cried to the people, and to Abner the son of Ner, saying, Answerest thou not, Abner? Then Abner answered and said, Who art thou that criest to the king?

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Abinër, na «?Aŋø, ï paa dïcwøø? ?Aŋa ni caal ïïni dï Icriel? ?Aŋø na ba koorï nyeya marï en? Kiper da dhaanhø ma aöö ni manynya man 'näk nyenynyï.
english: And David said to Abner, Art not thou a valiant man? and who is like to thee in Israel? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïyï en beeye gïn mo raac. Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, ka adïëri møn, u na jø leny, u bëët u rømi ka thøø, kiper uuni nyenynyu, na näk otïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw, käru koorø. ?'Ba ennø, neenï, tøŋ mar nyeya ka agwää pïï na näk ee cïp wïïe enge kaa?»
english: This thing is not good that thou hast done. As the Lord liveth, ye are worthy to die, because ye have not kept your master, the Lord's anointed. And now see where the king's spear is, and the cruse of water that was at his bolster.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl dwør Deebit aŋiie ni kööe, ni «?Nyie Deebit wääda, manøgø beeye ïïni ni dwørï wïnynya enø?» Ni kö Deebiti, ni «Beeye aani, Awuuö, ï na nyeya.»
english: And Saul knew David's voice, and said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And David said, It is my voice, my lord, O king.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Deebiti köö, na «?Aŋø, ï na nyenynya, ï cäŋï køøra ŋwieyø aperŋø? ?Agïne na tïïa? ?Da gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö?
english: And he said, Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant? for what have I done? or what evil is in mine hand?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na nyeya mara, beerra man wïnynyï luupa, a na dhaanhnhï. Ni näk mo beeye Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc ïïni niï ööï maal bääta, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jïëc olämi ni raanynya luubö manøgø yïthakiyø; 'ba ni näk mo tïïya jiyi, acïëni oen bäätge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, kiper dïcäŋi ge riema aani wøk nee kara tïme ni bäär ki jø powa ni beege jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni marge köö, ni ‹Ci tïny juu møøk.›
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, let my lord the king hear the words of his servant. If the Lord have stirred thee up against me, let him accept an offering: but if they be the children of men, cursed be they before the Lord; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the Lord, saying, Go, serve other gods.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ba køny remma piny kany mo kare bäär ki Wuuö Jwøk; kiper ïïni, ï na nyeny Icriel, ïïna ö kuna manynyï aani, a ni caal nyi twöŋö mo thiinh jaak en, ni caala mano ö dhaanhe wø ci baŋ dwaar ka ajwiero bäät kïdi.»
english: Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö, «Nyie Deebit wääda, aana bääyö. Duu paac nø. Aani, a ba tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëërï këët; kiper ajooda dïcäŋi ni per jwïëya leth jïrï møn. Neenï, aana nø tïïö ki tïï bøøl, ni nø bääya ki bääyö mo dwøŋ døc.»
english: Then said Saul, I have sinned: return, my son David: for I will no more do thee harm, because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day: behold, I have played the fool, and have erred exceedingly.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Deebiti ni kööe, ni «Neenï, ï na nyeya, tøŋ marï en; ennø, dhaanhø aciel røk jø leny moï ööe nee tøŋ lwøre.
english: And David answered and said, Behold the king's spear! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ŋati man nø ocunne ki køør beer mare, ki køør ŋäädhe mare man wø ŋäädhi ki gø. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ïïna cïp cera dïcäŋi; 'ba aana kweer ki man kïtha cera dëërï, ï na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw.
english: The Lord render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness: for the Lord delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the Lord's anointed.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, neenï, kaawat man bëëde ni jwïëyï perge leth jïra dïcäŋi en, beerra man bëët jwïëya ni perge leth ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni piem aani yïth gïïo leth bëët.»
english: And, behold, as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes, so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the Lord, and let him deliver me out of all tribulation.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï Deebit, ni «Nyie Deebit wääda, gwïëth oen bäätï; 'ba ennø møn, gïï wäro tïïyï thura karge.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput aay ki wääthe, ni ö Cøølli ni put døø paare.
english: Then Saul said to David, Blessed be thou, my son David: thou shalt both do great things, and also shalt still prevail. So David went on his way, and Saul returned to his place.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit acäänö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Ennø, a thøøa cer Cøøl dïcäŋ aciel jaak. Aani, bäŋ gïn mo bëënna bëënnö kany këët, 'ba beerra man päära wøk ni cøøa yi ŋööm jø Pilitin. Køøre nø, Cøøl yie ocwat ki many aani yi ŋööm jø Icriel, ni puta bødhø cere.»
english: And David said in his heart, I shall now perish one day by the hand of Saul: there is nothing better for me than that I should speedily escape into the land of the Philistines; and Saul shall despair of me, to seek me any more in any coast of Israel: so shall I escape out of his hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput tïŋŋö ki jø leny moe ma dïpe abïciel, ni ŋølge keew ni cige baŋ nyeny Gëth ma Akïc o Maøk.
english: And David arose, and he passed over with the six hundred men that were with him unto Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ki jø leny moe ni putge bëëtö Gëth ka Akïc; ni Deebit ki jø leny moe, ŋati man nø bëëdö ka jø paare. 'Ba Deebit bëëdö ka määre karge riet, ni beege Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel ka Abigël nyi jø Karmël, cï Nabal.
english: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Cøøl ni Deebit onø reŋ Gëth, Cøøl køør Deebit aput wec ki ŋwiec.
english: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Akïc, «Beerra man nyoothï bäth ec marï jïra, ni cïpï ki kany bëëda yie yi pääny aciel røk päänye moi mo en paarï ii, naa bëëda yie. ?Aŋø, a na dhaanhnhï, a daa bëëdö ki ïïni na aciel yi pääny mana dwøŋ nidïï?»
english: And David said unto Achish, If I have now found grace in thine eyes, let them give me a place in some town in the country, that I may dwell there: for why should thy servant dwell in the royal city with thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Akïc pääny mana cwøl ni Ciklak aput cïp jï Deebit dïcäŋögø; ni put Ciklaki bëëtö ni ena jï nyeny Juuda këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba nïne moa beet Deebiti po jø Pilitin, atïmö na cwiir aciel ki dwäde aŋween.
english: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit ki jø leny moe ge wø aay ni tukge jø Gëcur, ki jø Gerdha, ki jø Amalëk; ni beeye ki mana täge ki Cur këël mana këët ŋööm Ijep; ni jøøgø beege jøøa beet ŋöömmögø ki mana täge ki ya acääŋŋe cøøn.
english: And David and his men went up, and invaded the Geshurites, and the Gezrites, and the Amalekites: for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land, as thou goest to Shur, even unto the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø wø tuue tuuö, ni 'näk jøøgø bëët ni bäŋ dhaagø wala dïcwøø mo wiie ni kwøw; ni lwør dïëk, ki dhäk, ka arëëni, ka athïrööle, ka abïïe. Køøre eni wø duuö ni ö baŋ Akïc.
english: And David smote the land, and left neither man nor woman alive, and took away the sheep, and the oxen, and the asses, and the camels, and the apparel, and returned, and came to Achish.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø pëënynyi ya Akïci, na «?A kaa na tugï yie yïth nïne moi?» eni wø köö, na «A käla kun tuga jï løø tier-piny baŋ tuuŋwa ma jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki baŋ thääŋ jø tuuŋ Juuda moa käl ri nyïïkwaac Jeramiel, ki baŋ jø Këën.»
english: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit bäŋ dïcwøø wala dhaagø mo wiie ni kwøw. Këël mo maae nee käl Gëth bäŋgø thuwø, kiper eni wø cädö ni kööe, ni «Gïna tïïcwa caange caanø.» 'Ba Deebit bëëdö ni tïïya teeŋ gïnögø yïth nïra beede po jø Pilitin.
english: And David saved neither man nor woman alive, to bring tidings to Gath, saying, Lest they should tell on us, saying, So did David, and so will be his manner all the while he dwelleth in the country of the Philistines.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Akïc Deebit aput ŋääth ni kööe, ni «Eni jø poge ma jø Icriel akwiere møn, ni tïïc ree kaamar gïn mo ŋwäänynye raac jïge; ennø, eni puta bëëtö na ŋat tïïc mara na bäre.»
english: And Achish believed David, saying, He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him; therefore he shall be my servant for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïreka jø Pilitin jø leny moge acäŋge cooŋŋø kiper leny, nee këëtge ki jø Icriel. Køøre Akïc aköö jï Deebit, ni «Wär ŋäyï ni ïïni ki jø leny moï, u cøøa baŋ leny ki jø leny 'moa na aciel.»
english: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Akïc, ni «Wøp døc, gïno tïïa, a na dhaanhnhï, jootï joodø.» Kanyøgønø, Akïc aköö jï Deebit, ni «Wøp døc, aani, ï tïïa tïïö na wïth jø wø koor aani na bäre bäre.»
english: And David said to Achish, Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do. And Achish said to David, Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Camiel onø thøø, ni jø Icriel bëët onø jwøk kiper thøø mare, ni koonyge eni Reema na näk pääny poge. Ni kar kaagø thuwø, Cøøl jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø ki jap ajuuk, ee nø riem wøk dï Icriel.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had lamented him, and buried him in Ramah, even in his own city. And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, jø leny mo jø Pilitin rege acooŋge, ni öge ni tïïcge twïër marge buut pääny mana cwøl ni Cunem; ni ö Cøølli ni cooŋ jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët ni tïïcge twïër marge deŋ Kïn Gilböa.
english: And the Philistines gathered themselves together, and came and pitched in Shunem: and Saul gathered all Israel together, and they pitched in Gilboa.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli na joot twïër mar jø Pilitin, ena lwäyö ni bwøk cwïnye døc.
english: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart greatly trembled.

anywaa: Ni ö Cøølli ni pëëny Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo ee løø jï Cøøl ki ri lääk, wala ki ri Urim, wala ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: And when Saul enquired of the Lord, the Lord answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï jø tïïc moe, ni «Cou määnynyu jïra ki dhaagø mo ree da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, kiper naa cøøa baŋe nee eni pëënynya.» 'Ba jø tïïc moe aköö jïre, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da dhaagø mo bëëdö Endör mo ree da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw.»
english: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl dëëre arunynye ka abïïe møøk kiper nee ba ŋec, ni aae ni cäädhi ki jiy ariiø, ni pïïcge baŋ dhaaŋŋøgø ki dïwäär; køøre ena köö jï dhaaŋŋøgø, na «A kwaya ïïni, beerra man tïïyï teeŋ gïn wø tïïyï obëëde, ni ö jwïëc ŋato nyeŋŋe caana jïrï ennø, ni cwölï gø wøk.»
english: And Saul disguised himself, and put on other raiment, and he went, and two men with him, and they came to the woman by night: and he said, I pray thee, divine unto me by the familiar spirit, and bring me him up, whom I shall name unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø manøgø aköö jïre, ni «?Neenï, gïna tïïc Cøølli dëët jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø ki jap ajuuk, na 'näk geni dï Icriel, kuyï? ?Aŋø ni bïthï aani en nee jwïëya raanynyï?»
english: And the woman said unto him, Behold, thou knowest what Saul hath done, how he hath cut off those that have familiar spirits, and the wizards, out of the land: wherefore then layest thou a snare for my life, to cause me to die?

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl akööŋ jï dhaagø manøgø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk na kwøw, bäŋ gïn mo pïï bäätï kiper luummi.»
english: And Saul sware to her by the Lord, saying, As the Lord liveth, there shall no punishment happen to thee for this thing.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø manøgø aköö, na «?Aŋa ni manynyï nee jwïëye cwöla wøk jïrï?» Ni kö Cøølli, ni «Cwöl jwïëc Camiel wøk jïra.»
english: Then said the woman, Whom shall I bring up unto thee? And he said, Bring me up Samuel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dhaagø manøgø na joot Camiel, ena put köö døc ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal; ni cääne ki Cøøl, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, a cøøgï gø aperŋø? Kee ïïna nyeya ma Cøøl ki dëërï kiree.»
english: And when the woman saw Samuel, she cried with a loud voice: and the woman spake to Saul, saying, Why hast thou deceived me? for thou art Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï dhaagø manøgø, ni «Aana Cøøl møn; kärï lwäyö. ?'Ba ennø, agïne na jootï?» 'Ba aløk dhaagø manøgø jï Cøøl, na «A joota jwïëc dhaanhø mo ö wøk ka tiet ŋøøm.»
english: And the king said unto her, Be not afraid: for what sawest thou? And the woman said unto Saul, I saw gods ascending out of the earth.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aköö jï dhaagø manøgø, ni «?Ŋata jwïëye jootï enø, kïte nyïëdi?» Ni kö dhaagø manøgø, ni «Beeye dhaanhø ma jaal mo oruyö ka abïï man wø käär nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni jwïëye ö wøk ki tiet ŋøøm.» Ni puti ya Cøølli ŋäc ni beeye Camiel, ni put cøŋŋe këël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni wøøra Camiel.
english: And he said unto her, What form is he of? And she said, An old man cometh up; and he is covered with a mantle. And Saul perceived that it was Samuel, and he stooped with his face to the ground, and bowed himself.

anywaa: 'Ba Camiel aköö jï Cøøl, «?Aŋø ni tïï ko okiera dëëra en, ni cwölï aani wøk jaak en?» 'Ba aløk Cøølli jïre, ni «Aani, bëëtö mara atïmö ni teek døc kiree, kiper jø Pilitin ge manynya leny ki aani, ni Wuuö Jwøk ree ee nø daak buuta, ni bäŋ gïn løøe jïra këët ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk wala ki ri lääk; 'ba ennø, ïïna cwøla kiper nee gïno tïïa nee nyoothï jïra.»
english: And Samuel said to Saul, Why hast thou disquieted me, to bring me up? And Saul answered, I am sore distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God is departed from me, and answereth me no more, neither by prophets, nor by dreams: therefore I have called thee, that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do.

anywaa: Køøre Camiel aköö, na «?Aŋø, a pëënynyï gø këët nidïï, ni ŋäyï ni Wuuö Jwøk ree ee nø daak buutï ni nø tïme na nyimännï?
english: Then said Samuel, Wherefore then dost thou ask of me, seeing the Lord is departed from thee, and is become thine enemy?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïnögø atïïe dëërï kaawat mana caan gø ki dhaa; kiper Wuuö Jwøk nyec acööt wøk cerï ni cïp gø jï Deebit ŋat pou.
english: And the Lord hath done to him, as he spake by me: for the Lord hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand, and given it to thy neighbour, even to David:

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïnögø atïïe dëërï dïcäŋi kiper mana kärï dwør Wuuö Jwøk leŋø, ni ö gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki nee tïïyï dëët jø Amalëk ki køør wëër mare, ni kärï gø tïïö na kare.
english: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the Lord, nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore hath the Lord done this thing unto thee this day.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ïïni këël jø Icriel, u cïbe ceŋ jø Pilitin. 'Ba diøø ïïni ki wäätï u thøw ni ööu baŋa. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk lwaa leny mo jø Icriel cïbe ceŋ jø Pilitin.»
english: Moreover the Lord will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines: and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me: the Lord also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre Cøøl aput lwäyö døc ki luup moa car Camielli, ni put pädhö; 'ba eni thuwø dëëre ba teek, kiper bäŋ gïn mo ee camø ki dïcäŋ ki wäär bäre.
english: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth, and was sore afraid, because of the words of Samuel: and there was no strength in him; for he had eaten no bread all the day, nor all the night.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø manøgø aö baŋ Cøøl ni joot gø ni Cøøl obwøk døc, ni kööe jï Cøøl, ni «Neenï, a na dhaanhnhï, dwørï aleŋa, ni ööa ni weta jwïëya, ni nø wïnynya luupï moa carï jïra.
english: And the woman came unto Saul, and saw that he was sore troubled, and said unto him, Behold, thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice, and I have put my life in my hand, and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man wïnynyï dwøra thuwø, a na dhaanhnhï, nee cam mo thiinh jiiŋŋa jïrï niï cämï, kiper nee dëërï neethïk, niï cäädhi ni dëërï teek waŋjöö.»
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid, and let me set a morsel of bread before thee; and eat, that thou mayest have strength, when thou goest on thy way.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl akweer ni kööe, na «A ba cämö.» Kanyøgønø, jø tïïc moe ki dhaagø manøgø gena pïëmö ki eni; køøre döötge aleŋe. Ni put Cøølli ö maal ki kanya näk eno pädhö yie, ni put pï piny bäät køøm.
english: But he refused, and said, I will not eat. But his servants, together with the woman, compelled him; and he hearkened unto their voice. So he arose from the earth, and sat upon the bed.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, dhaagø manøgø jïre da nyirøøa mo olør. Køøre eni nyirøøa manøgø alwøre ni laar gø ŋaal; ni lwöte ki møø ni coot gø, ni käre gø coodø ki thømmø, ni bul gø na dääpe.
english: And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

anywaa: Ni käl cam manøgø nyïm Cøøl, ni ö Cøølli ki jø tïïc moe ni cämge. Køøre Cøøl ki jiye gena ö maal ni putge aay dïwäänögø.
english: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Pilitin bëët rege acooŋge buut päänya cwøl na Apëk, ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel ni tïïcge twïër marge bäät jøøro mana en buut päänya cwøl ni Jedhriel.
english: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin cäädhi ni jø møøk jïge da lwaa jiy ma dïpe, ki lwaa jiy ma kume. 'Ba Deebit ki jø leny moe ge cäädhi ka Akïc na aciel, ni ge cäädha køør jøøgø.
english: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish.

anywaa: Køøre kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin aköö, na «?Aŋø, jø Ibaru moi ge öömge ŋø kany?» 'Ba Akïc aköö jï jø poge moøgø, na «?Aŋø, man paa Deebit dhaanh Cøøl, ni beeye Cøøl nyeny Icriel? ?Aŋø, eni kär bëëdö buuta ki nïne mo kaala cwiir, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa joodø bääte ki mana päny wøk na bëëde buuta ki yïth nïne moøgø bëët?»
english: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin aput wëër ka Akïc ni köge jïgø, ni «Caanï jï nyenøgø nee døø paac kanya näk iï nø cïp jïre. Eni ba ci baŋ leny ki waani. Kanymør eni duua dëëtwa ni cwaga tuuŋge kanyo tïme na ri leny. ?Aŋø, gïno tïïc nyenøgø kiper nee jïte ki jöö man døøge kanya aciel ki nyenynye ma Cøøl, paa beeye ki man ŋøør wïth jø leny mo jø Pilitin moi ii?
english: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, man paa Deebit? ?A duut mana wär jiyi ni jøw miel na køp, «ni ‹Cøøl anääö ki jø Pilitin ma kume, 'ba kume moa 'näk Deebiti thöötha geni døc,› ba wär kapere?»
english: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

anywaa: Køøre Akïc, Deebit acwøle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï na kwøw, ïïni, ïïna dhaanhø mo bëëtï beer. Aani, yia met ki man cäädhï ki aani nee leny man këëlø na aciel. Kiper ki mana pänynyï wøk na ööï buuta këël kar kany ennø, bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa joodø bäätï na bäre. 'Ba kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin yïthge ba met ki ïïni.
english: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the Lord liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, døø paac jaak, ni cäädhï ni yiï met. Kärï kweer; kiper ni näk miï kweer, kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin yïthge tïmö ni reyø.»
english: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Akïc, «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na tïïa? ?Agïnaŋø na raac na jootï bääta, a na dhaanhnhï, ki mana rïŋŋa baŋï këël kar kany ennø? ?Aŋø, a mäni kiperŋø ki man cøøa baŋ leny naa këëda ki nyïïmän mo nyeya mara?»
english: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?

anywaa: 'Ba Akïc mare aløøe ni kööe jï Deebit, ni «Aani, ŋääa ni ïïna dhaanhø mo beer døc, niï neeta kaamar nyïïatwiel maal mar Jwøk; 'ba beege kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Pilitin na köö, ni ‹Deebit ba ci baŋ leny ki waani.›
english: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
