anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, kanyo tïme na amöölla diøø, wärï päny maal ni tïŋŋï ki jiyï ni beege jic kwääyï na ööï ki geni; wääth wär tïŋŋu kanyo tïm pinynyi na bäc øw.»
english: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit apäny maal ki jiye ka amöölla cøøn, ni tïŋŋe ni døø kanya bëëde yie yi ŋööm jø Pilitin. Ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Pilitin ni tïŋge ni cige baŋ leny ki jø Icriel moa en Jedhriel.
english: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne, Deebit ki jiye gena pïï Ciklak. 'Ba kar kaagø, jø Amalëk mïëya en jï løø tierpiny këël Ciklak ege nø tuk, ni raanyge Ciklak këël mana waaŋge gø;
english: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;

anywaa: ni makge mään ki jøøa en yi pääny manøgø bëët, ni beege obwöre ki jø døøŋŋø, ni putge aay ki geni ni bäŋ aciel mo ege nääö dëët jøøa makge.
english: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti ki jiye na pïïcge Ciklak, ka adïëri møn, pääny aputge nwänö no owaaŋ, ni mään moge ko obwöre moge moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään onø mak ki tøŋ ni puti käl.
english: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ki jiye na cäädhe ki ge, gena jwöŋö døc ni döötge ege tïŋ maal këël mana rööc cwäkge.
english: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, määr Deebit karge riet, ni beege Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel, ka Abigël cï Nabal nyï Karmël, geno maaø ki tøŋ ni put ge käl.
english: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

anywaa: Kar kaagø thuwø, Deebit dëëre ajïtö ki luubö mo teek ki køør luup moa car jiyi ni eni doo këërö ki kïte, kiper jiy bëët yïthge atïmö ni reyø døc, kiper mana mak obwöre moge. 'Ba Deebit ajïtö ki teek baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare.
english: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the Lord his God.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acäänö ka Abiethaar Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni beeye Abiethaar wär Ayemëlëk, ni kööe, na «A kwaya ïïni, käl ëëput buuta kany.» Ni ö Abiethaarri ni kïth ëëput buut Deebit.
english: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit, Wuuö Jwøk apëënynye ni kööe, «?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, läpa køør jøøa twier paani en? ?A ni näk mo aano läpö, ge maa maaø?» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Deebit, «Ci läp køørge. Ka adïëri møn, ge magï maaø; ni ö jiyi bëët moa näk omaaø ki tøŋ ni putï ge duuö.»
english: And David enquired at the Lord, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput aay ni cäädhi ka jø leny moe ma dïpe abïciel, ni pïïcge bäät Naam Bëcör; ni ö jic Deebiti moa ööl na dööŋ cään ni putge dööŋŋe ni geno pï piny kaace.
english: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aput pöödhö ni läp køør jøøa tuk paac, ni cäädhi ka jiye ma dïpe aŋween, kiper jiye ma dïpe ariiø moa näk ööl døc, na näk naam kär løny jïge ki man ŋølge gø, gena dööŋ ni geno pï piny bäät naam kaace.
english: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.

anywaa: 'Ba jic Deebit moa cäädhö ki eni, gena jïtö ki nyen ma nyï Ijep dï paap, ni kälge eni baŋ Deebit; ni moocge eni ki gïn cam ni cäme, ni mëëkge pïï eni nee mäthe.
english: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;

anywaa: Ni moocge eni ki nyïï olämmi mo omiiø na dhøk, ki nyïïomøki moa näk otal mo omiiø na dhøgi ariiø, ni ö nyï Ijepi manøgø ni cam gïïa cïp jïre, ni put jwïëye duuö. Kiper jïre da nïne adäk ki wärre moge ni bäŋ gïn mo ee camø wala pïï mo ee maadhø.
english: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï nyenøgø, «?Nyie dïcwøø, ïïna nyï kaa? ?Ïïna dhaanh ŋa?» Ni kö nyenøgø, ni «Aani, aana nyï Ijep, ni aana laŋ jø Amalëk; 'ba aana wii kwääya piny kanya täk täwi dëëra, ni beeye dää nïne ennø.
english: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa käla kuna twierwa mïëya en jï løø tier-piny, ni beege mïëc jø Kelita, ki mïëc jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki mïëya cïp na bëëdö na mo Kalëp; ni ciwa Ciklak ni putwa gø waaŋ.»
english: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï nyenøgø, «?Aŋø, løny jïrï ki man kïthï wa baŋ jø twëër moøgø ennø?» 'Ba nyenøgø aköö, ni «Wøp, kööŋï ŋëët Jwøk ki man näk maa ba 'nägï wala a ba cïbï cer kwääya; køøre nø, u kïtha baŋ jø leny moøgø.»
english: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyenøgø na kïth Deebit baŋ jø leny moøgø, ka adïëri møn, gena put nwänö ni geno ninyaŋŋa ni ŋöömö manøgø bäre ege gääbö, ni ge cämö, ni ge mädhö, ni ge miel ni yïthge met kiper gïïa twierge bëët na kälge ki yi ŋööm jø Pilitin ki yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni put jøøgø 'näk ki mana täge ki wïthïënhö këël mana päth cäŋŋi maya; ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo obøth dïge, 'ba beege jiy ma dïpe aŋween keerge mo rïïŋi ka bäät athïrööle na jöömmö.
english: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit jiy bëët moa mak ki tøŋ, këël jammi bëët moa twier jø Amalëki, aduue; ni ö Deebiti ni put määre duuö karge riet.
english: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ jiy mo orwäänyö røk jø døøŋŋø ko obwöre, ni beege obwöre moa näk cwøw ki moa näk mään. Këël jammi moa twier jø Amalëki na kälge kiper dëëtge, bäŋgø mo orwäänyö thuwø; ni ö Deebiti ni put gïïögø bëët dwøk paac.
english: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit dïëk ki dhäk bëët mo jøøgø alwøre; ni ö jic Deebiti ni køølge lääc paac moøgø nyïm dhäk moge, ni köge, ni «Moi beege gïïa twier Deebiti.»
english: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit apïï baŋ jø leny moe moa näk dïpe ariiø, na näk odööŋ bäät Naam Bëcör ki køør mana öölge, ni kär løny jïge ki man läpge køør Deebit. 'Ba kanya pïïc Deebiti, jø leny moøgø aput ci baŋ Deebit ki jø leny moa cäädhe ki geni ni ge jøla geni. Ni ö Deebiti ni put ci baŋge ni määth geni.
english: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa cïïrge cøl na wïthge reyø na en røk jø leny moa cäädhö ki Deebit, gena cäänö ni köge, ni «Kiper mana näk mo jø leny moøgø kär ci baŋ leny ki waani, bäŋ gïn mo cïpwa cïbö jïge røk gïïa twierwa na duuwa. 'Ba beege määrge ko obwöre moge keerge noo cïpwa jïge nee aacge ki geni.»
english: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö, «Nyie, jaay nyïïmera, gïnögø ba dou tïïö na bäre; kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na cïp gïïögø jïïø. Beeye eni thuwø na koor øøni, na cïp jøøa twier pøø ceŋŋø.
english: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the Lord hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo ïthe ciie ciiø ki luubö manøgø ni caru enø? Kiper ŋat wø ci baŋ leny, ki ŋat wø dööŋ ni koora jammi, ge doo jïtö ki gïï mo röömi bëët; gïïo jootge dege pääŋŋö na aciel bëët.»
english: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge dïcäŋögø, luubö manøgø aput Deebiti tïïc na ciik mo ena ri luup ŋøl jï jø Icriel këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Deebiti Ciklak, ena lwötö røk gïïa twiere, ni jääŋ ge baŋ nyïïawääte moa en røk jø døøŋŋø mo jø poge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni kööe, ni «Moi beege muuce moa jääŋŋa baŋu, ni beege gïïa twiera baŋ nyïïmän mo Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the Lord;

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø ajääŋŋe jï nyïïawääte moa en Bëthël, ki moa en Ramöth na en jï løø tier-piny, ki moa en Jatir,
english: To them which were in Beth–el, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,

anywaa: ki moa en Aröör, ki moa en Cipmöth, ki moa en Ëctemöa,
english: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,

anywaa: ki moa en Raakal, ki moa en yïth päänye mo nyïïkwaac Jeramiel, ki moa en yïth päänye mo jø Këën,
english: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,

anywaa: ki moa en Örma, ki moa en Bör-Acan, ki moa en Athak,
english: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Bor–ashan, and to them which were in Athach,

anywaa: ki moa en Keeprön, këël moa en kwöra wara cääth Deebiti ki jiye yïthge.
english: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin gena këëdö ki jø Icriel; ni ö jø Icrielli ni bwøkge nyïm jø Pilitin, ni thøw mo thööthi rege bäät Kïn Gilböa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin Cøøl ki wääte amaage jöö, ni 'näkge wäät Cøøl, ni beege Jönathan ka Abinadap ki Mëlkica.
english: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi–shua, Saul's sons.

anywaa: 'Ba leny atïmö ni teek dëër Cøøl. Køøre jø leny mo wø këëdi ka athëëre Cøøl ajootge ni këëlge gø; ni put atheerø tïmö na ŋwellø mo leth døc dëëre.
english: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï ŋat wø käär jap leny jïre, ni «Wöth opëëllö marï wøk ni cwøpï aani ki gø, nee jøøi ni kär daŋø ii nee ba tïme naa cööba geni, naa ba caarge.» 'Ba ŋata käär jap leny jïre akweer ki man 'näk gø, kiper ena lwäyö døc. Køøre Cøøl opëëllö mare aput lwør ni put dëëre cwøp ki gø.
english: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋata käär jap leny jï Cøøl na joot gø ni Cøøl onø thøø, eni thuwø ree acwøbe ko opëëllö mare, ni put thøø ki Cøøl na aciel.
english: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl ki wääte moa na adäk, ki ŋat wø käär jap leny jïre, ki jiy mo wø koor eni, gena put thøø na aciel dïcäŋögø.
english: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli moa bëëdö mïëya en løø gool, ni gool ena yïthakicge ki jø leny, ki moa bëëdö løø Naam Jördan løøga, na jootge gø ni jø leny mo jø Icriel onø bwøk, ni Cøøl ki wääte geno nø thøø, geni päänye moge aputge wec ni bwøkge; ni ö jø Pilitinni ni putge öö ni bëëtge yïth päänye moøgø.
english: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya, na ö jø Pilitinni ni ge ööa kuna twierge jap jiy moa no othøw, Cøøl ki wääte moa na adäk aputge joot no othøw bäät Kïn Gilböa.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin wï Cøøl aputge ŋul wøk, ni lwørge jap leny moe, ni putge ge jääŋŋö dï ŋööm jø Pilitin bäre, ni ge caana thøw Cøøl yïth uut juu moge ki jï jø poge.
english: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.

anywaa: Køøre jap leny mo Cøøl aputge cïp yi øt jwøge ma Actaröth, ni putge dëër Cøøl gur ri kiir mar Bëëth-Can.
english: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli moa bëëdö pääny Jabic-Gelät na wïnyge gïna nø tïïc jø Pilitinni dëër Cøøl,
english: And when the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;

anywaa: jø leny moa teek bëët gena put tïŋŋö, ni cääthge ki yi wäär bäre, ni pïïcge Bëëth-Can, ni ö dëër Cøøl ki dëët wääte na en ri kiir Bëëth-Can ni putge ge lwør, ni døøge Jabic-Gelät, ni putge geni waaŋ kaace.
english: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.

anywaa: Køøre geni cuu mo Cøøl ki mo wääte aputge kwany ni koonyge ge tier jaadha dwøŋ na en Jabic-Gelät, ni kweerge ki cam ki nïne abïriiø ni ge kïïna gïr thøwge.
english: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba ni Cøøl onø thøø ri leny, Deebit aduuö ki kuna dïïr wïth jø Amalëk, ni duu pääny mare Ciklak, ni bëëde ki nïne ariiø.
english: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dää nïne, ka adïëri møn, nyen mør aöö ki twïër mar Cøøl na abïïe moe ee jeeyø ni wïïe ee jööpö ki tør ki pänh cwïny. 'Ba kanya pïïe baŋ Deebit, cøŋŋe aput këël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø.
english: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jïgø, ni «?Ï kälï kaa?» Ni kö nyenøgø jï Deebit, ni «Aani, a rïŋŋi ki twïër mar jø Icriel.»
english: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jïgø, ni «?Leny bëëde nidïï? Caanï jïra nø.» Ni kö nyenøgø, ni «Jiy abwøk kanya tïme na ri leny, ni ö jiyi mo thööth thuwø ni thøwge; këël Cøøl ki wääde ma Jönathan gena thøw thuwø.»
english: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï nyena caan luummögø jïre, «?Aŋø, iï ŋääö nidïï ni Cøøl ki wääde ma Jönathan geno thøw?»
english: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø aköö, ni «Aana cwöp ri Kïn Gilböa; 'ba ka adïëri møn, Cøøl ajooda no oööl døc ni ree ee piemø ki thiir tøŋ mare. 'Ba kar kaagø, jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø wø rïïŋi ki bäät okwëënyi, ge ŋwieya køør Cøøl ni karge oløny ni cään ki gø døc.
english: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cøølli na lwïthe ŋääe, aana joode ni cwøl aani. 'Ba aana köö, ni ‹Aani en.›
english: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.

anywaa: «Køøre aana pëënynye ni kööe, ni ‹?Ïïna ŋa?› «Ni løøa gø jïre, ni ‹Aana nyï Amalëk.›
english: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.

anywaa: «Ni cäŋ köö ki aani, ni ‹Nyie, nyänh buuta ni 'nägï aani, kiper dëëra oløny ni da ŋwellø mo leth døc, maa ba laar 'näk.›
english: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aana put nyiik buute ni nääa gø kiper yaa nø ŋäc ni eni ba kwøw këët ki køør gïna leth na pïï dëëre. Ni ö aduda na en wïïe ko ogut na en bade ni wø nyooth nyec mare, ni lwøra ge, ni beege ni käla baŋï ennø, ï na kwäärö mara.»
english: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit abïïe moe na en dëëre aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni ö jiyi moa en buute kaagø ni putge abïïe moge jeeyø thuwø.
english: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena kïmmö ni jwöŋge ni putge kweer ki cam këël mana tïm pinynyi na wïthïënhö. Gïnögø atïïcge kiper thøw Cøøl, ki wääde ma Jönathan, këël jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jø leny mo jø Icriel, kiper mana ö jøøgø bëët na nääi ri leny.
english: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the Lord, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï nyena öö na wääny eni, ni «?Ïïna nyï kaa?» Ni løgi ya nyenøgø, ni «Aana nyï Amalëk o nyena bëëdö na jur po jø Icriel.»
english: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï nyenøgø, «?Aperŋø na kärï lwäyö ki man 'nägï nyeya na näk otïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw?»
english: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the Lord's anointed?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit nyen mør røk jiye aput cwøl ni kööe, ni «Ö maal ni 'nägï nyenøgø.» Ni ö nyenøgø ni put nyï Amalëk manøgø cwøp ni 'näk gø.
english: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï nyï Amalëk mana thøw enø, ni «Beeye ï na käl thøø manøgø bäätï keerï, kiper mana ö wøk ki dhiï beeye na käl ajäla manøgø bäätï, ki køør mana kööï, ni ‹Aani, nyeya na näk otïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw anääa.› »
english: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the Lord's anointed.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit duut man acaae ni wär gø ni jwøga Cøøl ki wääde ma Jönathan,
english: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

anywaa: ni caan gø nee jø tuuŋ Juuda rege pwönyge ki duut manøgø; 'ba ka adïëri møn, duut manøgø nut no ogöör piny yi wëëlö mana cwøl ni Jacar. 'Ba duut man awär Deebiti ni kööe,
english: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)

anywaa: «Wui, Icriel, dïbwöthe moa jiem ï ki køørge athum ki thøø kwöra en maal bäät thuuri moï. Ka adïëri møn, jø leny moa teek døc athøw ri leny.
english: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!

anywaa: «Beerra man ö luubö manøgø ni ba caani Gëth, ni ö awaaci manøgø ni ba gøøi piny nyeŋ jïëthe mo Ackelön; kiper ni näk mo wïny määr jø Pilitinni wïnynyö, ge kanynyø døc, ni tïm yïthge ni met, ge na määr jøøgø ni Jwøk kucge ni kär daŋø yøø.
english: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Kïn Gilböa, beerra man tïme ni bäŋ thööy wala køth bäätï, ni ö pwöthi moa en bäätï ni bäŋe caammi mo ciek yïthge. Kiper kööde mo leny mo jøøa teek adööŋ piny bäätï kaace no onipäät jaak, ni ö kwöt leny mar Cøøl ni käri wïïrö ki maaw këët.
english: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.

anywaa: 'Ba atheeny Jönathan ko opëël Cøøl bäŋ wø duui jaak ni bäŋ rem jiy mo ege køny piny, ni kär gutö ki rïŋ dëët jøøa teek.
english: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, Cøøl ki wääde ma Jönathan gena bëëdö ni di mëërö ki ge, ni yïth jøw met ki ge; 'ba na tïme na ri thøø, gena thøw na aciel. Gena jiy mo rïïŋö døc ni kaala olwiith mana näk agweec, ni ge teek døc ni kaala cïgïï ŋuu.
english: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

anywaa: Wui, u na määr jø Icriel, jwøgu Cøøl døc, na tïïc uuni nou ruu ka abïïe mo mïërö mo perge leth, na tïïc uuni na abïïe mou dëëtge kïthi ki jap mïërö mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.

anywaa: «Wui, ka adïëri møn, jø leny moa teek døc athøø ri leny, ni ö Jönathanni ni nääi kwöra en maal bäät thuuri moï.
english: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.

anywaa: Nyie coka ma Jönathan, a jwöŋö naa keeya yia kiperï; ïïna bëëdö ni perï leth jïra. Mëër marï ki aani, beeye mëër mo pere leth døc ni kaala mëëc mïïö.
english: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.

anywaa: Wui, ka adïëri møn, jø leny mo teek døc athøø ri leny, ni ö jap leny moge ni putge dööŋŋe piny jaak ni bäŋ gïn mo kønyge.»
english: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Deebit Wuuö Jwøk apëënynye ni kööe, ni «?Cøøa pääny aciel røk päänye mo jø tuuŋ Juuda naa bëëda yie?» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni «Ciï.» 'Ba Deebit acäŋ köö, na «?A cøøa yi mane?» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Ci Keeprön.»
english: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the Lord said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput ci kunece ki määre karge riet, ni beege Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel ka Abigël cï Nabal nyï Karmël, dhaaŋŋa näk odööŋ na cï thøø.
english: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni aae ki jø leny moe moa bëëdö ki eni, ni ŋati man nø rege aay ka jøøa en paare; ni putge pï piny, ni bëëtge yïth päänye mo Keeprön.
english: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.

anywaa: Køøre jø døøŋŋø mo jø tuuŋ Juuda gena öö ni thïïmge wï Deebit ki maaw ni ge røønya gø na nyeya bäät jø tuuŋ Juuda. 'Ba acaange jï Deebit ni köge, ni «Beege jø Jabic-Gelät na koony Cøøl.»
english: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of Jabesh–gilead were they that buried Saul.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ajääk baŋ jø Jabic-Gelät ki jiy, ni kööe jïge, ni «Uuno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki kiper mana nyoothu mëër maru jï nyenynyu ma Cøøl ki køør mana koonynyu eni.
english: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the Lord, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyooth adïëri mare ki mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl jïïu; këël aani thuwø, gïn mo beer otïïa kiperu, ki køør gïna nø tïïyu.
english: And now the Lord shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man magu rou ni bëëdu nou teek; këël na bëëde ni nyenynyu ma Cøøl othøw, jø tuuŋ Juuda aana nø røønyge na nyeya bäätge ni thïïmge wïïa ki maaw.»
english: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Abinër o Nër na näk kwääy lwaa leny mar Cøøl, Icböcëth o Cøøl ee nø käl ni kïth gø løø Naam Jördan løøga, yi pääny mana cwøl ni Maanayim.
english: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;

anywaa: Ni røøny Icböcëth na nyeya bäät jø Gelät, ki jø Acër, ki jø Jedhriel, ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, këël bäät jø Icriel bëët.
english: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Icböcëthi o Cøøl na nyeya bäät jø Icriel, cwiiye oløny na pïëraŋween, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri ariiø. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda gena bëëdö ni ge bëënna Deebit.
english: Ish–bosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Deebiti ni ena nyeya Keeprön bäät jø tuuŋ Juuda beege cwiiri abïriiø ki dwäde abïciel.
english: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër o Nër atïŋŋö ki Maanayim ni ci Gibien ki jø leny mo Icböcëth o Cøøl.
english: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

anywaa: Ni ö Jöapi o Dheruya ki jø leny mo Deebit ni tïŋge, ni røømge bäät puul mana en Gibien; ni pïge piny, ni jø leny mo Icböcëth ge ena løø puul løøk maya ni jø leny mo Deebit ge ena løøk maya.
english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

anywaa: Køøre Abinër aköö jï Jöap, ni «Beerra man ö jiyi moa dëëtge teek røk jø leny 'moø ni öge maal nee këëtge nyïmmø.» Ni put Jöapi jïëy ni kööe, «Wøp, öge maal.»
english: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy apaar kurriiø røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen aput ö maal røk jø leny mo Icböcëth o Cøøl, ni ö jiyi apaar kurriiø thuwø ni öge maal røk jø leny mo Deebit.
english: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish–bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø ni put nyimänne mak ki wï gø ni cööpge dëëtge ki caakïïne ki tiet butge, këël mana putge pädhö na aciel ni marge thøø. Kanyøgønø, pwöl Gibien manøgø aput cwøl ni Këlkath-Adhurim, na näk tiere beeye pwöl caakïïne.
english: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath–hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

anywaa: 'Ba ki dïcäŋögø, leny aput tïmö ni teek døc, ni ö jø lenynyi mo Deebit ni böötge Abinër ki jø leny mo jø Icriel møga.
english: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, wäät Dheruya karge dääi ge ena kaagø, ni beege Jöap, ka Abicay, ka Acaël; 'ba Acaël ena dhaanhø mo rïïŋö døc ni caala aŋer.
english: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

anywaa: Køøre Acaël køør Abinër aŋwiee døc ni ba gaa bäät cwïïe wala bäät caame.
english: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër alwïthö køøre ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ïïna Acaël, ni rïïŋï køøra en?» Køøre aløk Acaël, ni «Beeye aani.»
english: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër aköö jïgø, ni «Gaa bäät cwïï wala bäät caamï, ni ŋwieyï køør dhaanhø aciel røk jø leny moø ni rïïŋi yøø, ni magï gø, ni kälï jape moa en dëëre kiper dëërï.» 'Ba Acaël yie kär tïmö ni met ki man gaae ni wec køør Abinër ki ŋwiec.
english: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

anywaa: 'Ba acäŋ Abinërri nwøyø jï Acaël ni kööe, ni «Gagï. Wec køøra ki ŋwiec. ?Aŋø, ï manynya gø niï nääa? ?A ni näk miï yaa nääø, waano bëëtwa nidïï ki coku ma Jöap?»
english: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?

anywaa: 'Ba Acaël akweer ki man gaae; køøre Abinër Acaël aput cwøp ki thiir tøŋ ki yi gø, ni ö thiir tøŋŋi ni put tuny wøk ki dïŋääe. Ni put pädhö kaace ni put thøø. 'Ba jø leny bëët mo wø pïï kanya näk Acaël opädhö yie no othøw, ge wø puta cuŋŋö kaace.
english: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap ka Abicay køør Abinër aputge ŋwiec; 'ba kanya tïm cäŋŋi ni pätha piny, gena pïï bäät thuura cwøl na Amma, na en buut Giia, waŋjöör dï paap Gibien.
english: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Benjamen rege acooŋge dëër Abinër ni tïmge na dhøk aciel, ni cuŋge bäät thuur mør kaace.
english: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

anywaa: Køøre Abinër Jöap arwaae ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, dëëtø putø ka thöör na bäre bäre møn ennø? ?Aŋø, kuyï ni ya aŋuunne, luubö man tïmö ni keec? ?A këël yi wäne nø noo bëëdï ni ba caanï jï jiyï ki man døøkge ni wecge køør nyïïmëëkge?»
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap aköö, ni «Ŋëët Jwøa kwøw, doo na bäŋ gïn mo iï caanø ennø, ka adïëri møn, wa doo puta rïïŋö køøru, u na nyïïmëëkwa, këël diøø ka amöölla.»
english: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap tuuŋ aput kooth; ni ö jiye bëët ni putge cuŋŋö ni kärge køør jø Icriel møga ŋwieø këët, këël mana putge leny wec.
english: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër ki jø leny moe gena aay ni ge cøra goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, ni cääthge ki yi wäär bäre; køøre Naam Jördan aŋølge, ni cääthge ka amöölla bäre, ni pïïcge Maanayim.
english: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aduuö ki kuna ŋwiec køør Abinër; 'ba kanya cooŋ jø leny bëët kanya aciel, da jø leny mo Deebit ma apaar ka abïŋween mo tøør; 'ba Acaël kär kwaan rege.
english: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo Deebit, jiy moa 'näkge røk jø leny mo Abinër beege jiy mo thööth ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïciel, ni jøøgø käla ri jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap ki jiye dëër Acaël akälge, ni kïthge gø yi bwöc wänni na en Bethelem. 'Ba gena aay ni cääthge ki yi wäär bäre këël mana ruu øwi bäätge Keeprön.
english: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth–lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, män mana en yïthakic jøøa en ri Cøøl ki jøøa en ri Deebit akän wøk ki kany mo bäär. Ni ö teeki mar Deebit ni bëëde ni cäätha maal; 'ba jøøa en ri Cøøl, gena bëëdö ni jäk marge cäätha maal thuwø.
english: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

anywaa: Moi beege wäät Deebit moa nywøle Keeprön; kanynye beeye Amnön na nywøle ki cïïe ma Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel;
english: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

anywaa: 'ba rietge beeye Kiliap, na nywøle ki cïïe ma Abigël cï Nabal nyï Karmël, dhaaŋŋa näk odööŋ na cï thøø; ni dääge beeye Abëcëlöm, o cïïe ma Maika nyi Thalmay nyeny Gëcur;
english: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

anywaa: ni ŋweerge beeye Adöniya o cïïe ma Agith; ni bïïge beeye Cepathiya o cïïe ma Abital;
english: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

anywaa: ni bïcierge beeye Ithriam o cïïe ma Ëgla. Obwöre moøgø beege wäät Deebit moa nywøle Keeprön.
english: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni da män yïthakic jøøa en ri Cøøl ki jøøa en ri Deebit, Abinër bëëdö ni dëëre ee tïïö ni eno kadhø ki teek røk jøøa en ri Cøøl.
english: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl da cïïe mo odööŋ wï paare mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Ricpa nyi Aya; køøre Icböcëth Abinër apëënynye ni kööe, na «?Aŋø na ciï baŋ cï wära ni butï ki gø na dhaagø?»
english: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish–bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?

anywaa: Kar kaagø Abinër aput wëër døc kiper luubö mana caan Icböcëthi, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ki jïrï a bëëdö kaamar gwök, naa iï kwaan kur jø tuuŋ Juuda? Neenï, këël kar kany ennø, aana bëëdö naa nyootha mëër jï wäru ma Cøøl, ki tuuŋge, ki jiye, ni gwøa ïïni, ni kära ï cïp cer Deebit; 'ba dïcäŋi ennø, ïïna tïmö niï kïtha bääta ka ajäla kiper luum dhaagø jaak.
english: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish–bosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, ni näk mo kööŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk kiper nyec mar Deebit ba tïïa ni thur kare, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany aani.
english: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the Lord hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;

anywaa: Kiper dwør Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni nyec cööde wøk dhi øt Cøøl ni cïp gø jï Deebit nee put bëëtö na nyeya bäät jø Icriel bëët ki nyïïmëëkge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki mana täge ki Daan këël mana këët Bëërcïïba.»
english: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Icböcëth aput bëëtö ni bäŋ luubö mo ee dwøgø këët jï Abinër kiper ena lwäyö.
english: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

anywaa: Køøre Abinër ajääk baŋ Deebit ki jiy kanya bëëde yie ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ŋöömö man bäre en a mar ŋa? 'Ba ennø, tudï ki luubö ki aani; ka adïëri møn, a puta dwätö ki ïïni, ni kuura jø Icriel bëët dëërï.»
english: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö, «Beer, aani a tudö ki luubö ki ïïni møn. 'Ba da gïrpiny aciel keere maa manynya gø nee tïïyï; ni näk mo gïnögø kärï tïïö, täärnyïma ba diï joodø na bäre. 'Ba gïno tïïyï kiree beeye ki man kälï Mikal nyi Cøøl kanyo ööï baŋa.»
english: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput jääk baŋ Icböcëth o Cøøl ki jiy ni kööe, ni «Cïïa ma Mikal, dhaaŋŋa nywøma ki buyi mo jer dëët jø Pilitin ma dïpa moa daaŋa, duuï jïra.»
english: And David sent messengers to Ish–bosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre Icböcëth aput jääk baŋ Mikal kanya bëëde yie po cwøre ma Paltiel o Laaic, ni käl gø.
english: And Ish–bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

anywaa: 'Ba cø Mikal manøgø aay ki gø na aciel, ni cäädhi ni jwöŋö këël mana pïïcge paana cwøl ni Baurim. Køøre Abinër aköö jï Paltiel, «Ci døøgï.» Kanyøgønø, Paltiel aput døø paare.
english: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër ajïtö ka acooŋa ki jø døøk Icriel ni kööe, ni «Ki kany mo bäär, u manynya Deebit nee tïme na nyeya maru.
english: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, røønynyu nø. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk anø cäänö kiper Deebit ni kööe, ni ‹Jiya ma jø Icriel opiema ceŋ jø Pilitin këël nyïïmän moge bëët ki ri dhaanhnha ma Deebit.› »
english: Now then do it: for the Lord hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër thuwø luummögø acaane ni wïnyö jï jø tuuŋ Benjamen. Kanyøgønø, ena put tïŋŋö ni ci baŋ Deebit kanya bëëde yie Keeprön, nee luubö mana näk nëëni ni beer ki jï jø Icriel bëët ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen nee caane jïgø.
english: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

anywaa: Køøre Abinër ki jiy ma pïërariiø na cäädhe ki ge, gena pïï Keeprön baŋ Deebit. Ni ö Deebiti ni tïïe ki cam kiper Abinër ki jiy moa cäädhö ki eni.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Abinër aköö jï Deebit, na «A kwaya ïïni naa tïŋŋa naa cøøa kuna cooŋa jø Icriel bëët kanya aciel jïrï, ï na nyeya mara, nee tïme ni løny jïge ki man tutge ki luubö ki ïïni, niï tïmï ni ïïna nyeya marge bëët, ni gïno manynyï jaak thura kare.» Køøre Deebit, Abinër aput wëëk wääth, ni put aay ki jööt dëël.
english: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, ka adïëri møn, jø leny mo Deebit ki kwääc lwaa leny marge ma Jöap gena duuö ki baŋ twëër ni ge käädö ki jammi mo thööth døc. 'Ba kanya pïïcge, Abinër onø aay buut Deebit Keeprön kaagø, kiper ee nø wëëk wääth ni aae ki jööt dëël.
english: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi ki jø leny bëët moa cäädhö ki eni na pïïcge ennø, aput caan jï Jöap ni køp, ni «Neenï, Abinër o Nër aö baŋ nyeya, ni ö nyeya ni wëëk gø wääth, ni nø aae ki jööt dëël.»
english: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aci baŋ nyeya ni kööe, «?Wui nyeya, agïne ni iï tïïö en? Ka adïëri møn, Abinër anø ö baŋï. ?'Ba aperŋø na wëëgï eni wääth ni put aay?
english: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyï na Abinër o Nër, ö baŋï ka atade kiper nee bëëtö marï bäre këël gïï wø tïïyï bëët kwaane?»
english: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi na ö wøk ki baŋ Deebit, ena put jääk køør Abinër ki jiy, ni ö jøøa jääŋŋi ni duuge eni ki bäät iith Cira; 'ba gïnögø kuc Deebiti.
english: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Abinërri na duu Keeprön, ena put Jöapi kïth kur keere dhi kiir ni nëëni kede manynya man cääne ki gø na eni keere. Køøre Jöap Abinër aput cwøp ki yi gø ni put thøø, ni eni coola kwör rem coki ma Acaël.
english: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na wïny gïnögø cään, ena köö, ni «Aani ki jøøa bëëdö tier nyec mara, ki man näk mo karwa bäär ki kwör rem Abinër o Nër, ŋäc Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the Lord for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

anywaa: Beerra man ö ajäla manøgø ni päth bäät Jöap ki jø dhi øt wänni bëët; ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dööŋ dhi øt Jöap ni dëëre ba jïti ki teeŋ täwe mo wø leth, wala ge tïmö ni jägö ni geno kwaan kur mään, wala ge tïmö ni ge di nääŋŋö ko opëëlle, wala ge tïmö ni bäŋ cam jïge.»
english: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap ki coki ma Abicay Abinër anäkge kiper mana ö Abinërri na 'näk cokge ma Acaël ri leny mana en Gibien.
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Jöap ki jiy bëët moa nut buutge kaagø, ni «Jwøgu Abinër, ni jeeyu abïïe mou ni røøu keece dëëtu na abïïe ni nyoothu pänh cwïny maru.» Kanyøgønø, nyeya ma Deebit aput wääth køør pëëm mana käär dëër dhaanhø ki gø.
english: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

anywaa: 'Ba Abinër aputge koony Keeprön; ni ö nyeya ni jwöŋe ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal døc bäät bwöc Abinër, ni ö jiyi bëët ni jwöŋge thuwø.
english: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya duut man acaae ni wär gø ni jwøga Abinër ni kööe, «?Aŋø, Abinër doo thøw møn ni jääk jaak?
english: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?

anywaa: Wui Abinër, ceŋŋï kee kär twöö, ni tietï thuwø kär kïth yo orøgø; 'ba ïïna put 'näk kaamar dhaanhø mo 'näga jiyi mo wïthge reyø.» Kanyøgønø, jiy bëët acäŋ jwøk kiper Abinër.
english: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïcäŋögø, jiy bëët aö kuna kwaacge Deebit nee cäme; 'ba Deebit akööŋ ni kööe, «Ni näk mo da cam këël gïn mo thiinh jaak mo ya belø ni cäŋ poot kär päth piny, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany aani.»
english: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy bëët gïnögø aputge kïth cwïnyge, ni jootge gø ni beeye gïn mo beer. Këël jammi bëët mo wø tïïc nyeya obëëde, ajootge ni beege gïï mo beyø thuwø.
english: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jic Deebit bëët këël jø Icriel bëët aputge ŋäc dïcäŋeca ni nyeya ma Deebit tøør ri thøø mar Abinër o Nër.
english: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit aköö jï jiye, na «?Aŋø, kuyu ni kwäärö mo kare dwøŋ athøw dïcäŋi Icriel?
english: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba aani, këël na bëëda ni aana nyeya mo wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw, dïcäŋi aana tïmö naa jääk; ni ö Jöap ka Abicay, wäät Dheruya, ni tïmge ni teeka geni ki aani. 'Ba ennø, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cun ŋat raay ki køør raay mo wø tïïe.»
english: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the Lord shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Icböcëthi o Cøøl na wïny gø na Abinër anø thøø Keeprön, eni bääte aput pädhö, ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni jït wïthge ko okiera.
english: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

anywaa: 'Ba Icböcëth o Cøøl jïre da jiy ariiø mo gena kwääc lwaae mo dhøgi mo leny. Ni nyeŋ dhaanhø aciel beeye Baanaa ni nyeŋ dhaanhø maya beeye Rëkap. 'Ba jagøgø beege wäät Rimön nyï Bëëröth na käl ri jø tuuŋ Benjamen, kiper Bëëröth okwaan kur jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

anywaa: 'Ba jø Bëëröth geno reŋ Gitayim ni bëëtge kunece ni gena wëëlle këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Jönathan o Cøøl, da wääde ma ŋwøl. 'Ba tier ŋöödö mare beeye en. Kanya ö waac thøw Cøølli ki wääde ma Jönathan na tägö Jedhriel na wïnye, o Jönathan manøgø cwiiye oløny na abïïc. 'Ba kanya wïny waac moøgø, ŋata pïr gø, nyilaarøgø alwøre ni reŋge ki gø. 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya reŋge ni eni läädö, nyilaal manøgø apädhö ni put tïmö na ŋwøl. 'Ba nyeŋ nyilaarøgø beeye Mepiböcëth.
english: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

anywaa: 'Ba Rëkap ki Baanaa, wäät Rimön nyï Bëëröth, gena aay ni pïïcge po Icböcëth ki dhöör ni cäŋ kwaar. 'Ba kar kaagø, Icböcëth ree ee jwömö.
english: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish–bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

anywaa: Køøre gena døny dï øtø kede ge ummö ki beel, ni putge Icböcëth cwøp ki yi gø; køøre Rëkap ki coki ma Baanaa gena put reeŋø.
english: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Rëkapi ki Baanaa na dønyge yi øt Icböcëth, Icböcëth obutö bäät pëëm yi øt niine mare, ni putge Icböcëth cööbö ni 'näkge gø, ni ŋulge wï gø wøk. Køøre wï gø aputge lwør ni aacge, ni cääthge ki yi wäär bäre ni ge cøra waŋjöör dï goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba.
english: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, wï Icböcëth akälge Keeprön baŋ Deebit, ni köge jï nyeya ma Deebit, ni «Neenï, Icböcëth o Cøøl, nyimännï, ŋata many jwïëyï nee raanynye, wïïe beeye en. 'Ba dïcäŋi Wuuö Jwøk kwör marï, ï na nyeya marwa, atïïe nee cool dëër Cøøl ki nyïïkwaaye.»
english: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the Lord hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Deebiti jï Rëkap ki coki ma Baanaa, wäät Rimön nyï Bëëröth, ni kööe jïge, «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw na køny aani yïth gïïa leth bëët,
english: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the Lord liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

anywaa: neennu, kar kaaca da dhaanhø ma aöö ni wäänynya aani ni kööe, ni ‹Neenï, Cøøl athøw›, ni ki jïre ni eni käla waac mo beer. 'Ba ŋatøca amaa ni nääa gø Ciklak, ni beeye gïna ŋada gø ki gø na kar waac mare.
english: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

anywaa: Ennø møn, u na wïthu reyø, dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare beer anø 'nägu yi øde bäät pëëm mare. ?Aŋø, gïno tïïa dëëtu ba tïmö ni kadha eni ki mana tïïa dëër ŋata wääny aani? Aani kwör rem Icböcëth coola coolø dëëtu ni dïïra wïthu bäät pinyi en.»
english: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit jø leny moe aput köömmö, ni ö jagøgø ni putge Rëkap ki Baanaa 'näk ni ŋulge ceŋge ki tietge wøk, ni lïërge dëëtge buut puul na en Keeprön. 'Ba wï Icböcëth alwørge ni kïthge gø yi bwöc Abinër na en Keeprön.
english: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish–bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

anywaa: Køøre wïth tuŋi bëët mo jø Icriel aö baŋ Deebit kanya bëëde yie Keeprön ni köge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ïïna dhaanhø ma rem dëëtwa, niï käla dëëtwa.
english: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ kanya bëët Cøølli na nyeya marwa, beeye ïïni na bwøth jø Icriel kany wø näk ri leny. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïrï, ni ‹Ï doo bëëdö ni ïïna dïkwääy mar jiya ma jø Icriel, ni tïmï ni ïïna wïth jø Icriel.› »
english: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø døøk Icriel bëët gena ö baŋ nyeya ma Deebit kanya en yie Keeprön, ni ö nyeya ni tude ki luubö ki geni Keeprön kaagø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö geni ni thïïmge wï Deebit ki maaw ni ge røønya gø na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they anointed David king over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na røønyi na nyeya, cwiiye oløny na pïëradäk, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

anywaa: Ni cwiiri moa beet Deebiti ni ena nyeya mar jø tuuŋ Juuda Keeprön, beege cwiiri abïriiø ki dwäde abïciel, ni cwiiri moa beede Jerucalem ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel ki jø tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët, beege cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurdäk.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit ki jø leny moe gena ci Jerucalem baŋ leny ki jø Jeebuc, na bëëdö yi ŋöömö manøgø. 'Ba jø Jeebuc aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ba løny jïrï ki man dunynyï yi kiir kany; këël cööye ki ŋööte jïge da teek ki man riemge ïïni,» ni köge, ni «Deebit ba duny kany na bäre.»
english: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit, kanya näk kar gwøk røk mar paanøgø na en bäät Kïn Dhayan aput mak; ni beeye päänya put cwøl na Pääny Deebit.
english: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø Deebit aköö, ni «Ŋat mo yie met ki man 'näk jø Jeebuc, beerra man døny kar gwøk røk marge ki jöör pïï, ni 'näk nyïïmänna, ni beege jøøa køp ni cööye ki ŋööte.» Kiper manøgønø akøp, ni «Cwør wala ŋwøl ba doo dunynya yi øtø.»
english: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit abëëdö kanya näk kar gwøk røk, ni cwøl gø ni Pääny Deebit. Ni ö Deebiti ni put pääny manøgø bäre geer ni teek, ni tägi ki kanya no othørø ni wø cwøl ni Milø.
english: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

anywaa: 'Ba teek mar Deebit aput bëëtö ni cäätha maal, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët, bëëdö ka eni.
english: And David went on, and grew great, and the Lord God of hosts was with him.

anywaa: Køøre Kiram nyeny Tayar ajääk baŋ Deebit ki jiy ni ge käädö ki jer øtø moa perge leth, ki jiy ma dïjëëth opämi ki jø wø gëëdö ki kïte; ni ö jøøgø ni gëëtge ki øtø jï Deebit.
english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

anywaa: 'Ba aput Deebiti ŋäc ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na këël tier nyec mare piny, nee put bëëte na nyeya mar jø Icriel; ni ŋäc gø thuwø ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na tïŋ nyec mare maal kiper jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: And David perceived that the Lord had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mana ö Deebiti na nø wec Keeprön ni ö Jerucalem, ena cäŋ jïtö ki mään møøk; ni ö Deebiti ni jïte ko obwöre møøk ma cwøw ki mään.
english: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ obwöre moa nywøl Deebiti kanya bëëde Jerucalem beege Cimia, ki Cöbap, ki Nathan, ki Cølöman,
english: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

anywaa: ki Ibar, ki Elicua, ki Napëk, ki Japia,
english: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

anywaa: ki Elicama, ki Eliada, ki Elipelet.
english: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi jø Pilitinni ni Deebit onø røøny na nyeya mar jø Icriel, jø leny mo jø Pilitin bëët atïŋŋö ni cige kuna määnyge baŋ Deebit; 'ba kanya ö Deebiti na wïny gø, ena cøø ni døny kanya näk kar gwøk røk.
english: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Pilitin apïï ni putge dï Goor Rapayim gääbö.
english: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit Wuuö Jwøk apëënynye ni kööe, «?Aŋø, cøøa baŋ leny baŋ jø Pilitin? ?A ni näk mo aano ci baŋge, ge cïbï cera?» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ciï; ka adïëri møn, jø Pilitin ge cïba cerï.»
english: And David enquired of the Lord, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput ci kanya caae ni Baal-Peradhim, ni put jø Pilitin böötö kaace; ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk nyïïmän 'moa abööte nyïma, ni caala pänh jwïëö kany wø räänye.» Kiper manøgønø, Deebit nyeŋ kaace aput cak ni Baal-Peradhim.
english: And David came to Baal–perazim, and David smote them there, and said, The Lord hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin juu moge adööŋ piny kaace, ni ö Deebiti ki jø leny moe ni kälge juu moøgø.
english: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Pilitin acäŋ duuö ni cäŋge dï Goor Rapayim gääbö.
english: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na pëëny Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ïïni, ï ba doo cøøa baŋge ni tiir jaak; 'ba ge diï ŋøønya piny ni cääthï bäätge kanya enge yie, deŋ lul.
english: And when David enquired of the Lord, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni da dwøl mo caala tiet jø leny mo wïnynyï wïnynyö ki bäät lul, ge diï puta tuk, kiper nyootha gø ni Wuuö Jwøk onø ci nyïmmu ki man këëde ki jø leny mo jø Pilitin.»
english: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the Lord go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø aput Deebiti tïïc na kare, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni, ni put jø leny mo jø Pilitin 'näk ki mana täge ki Gëba këël mana këët Gëdher.
english: And David did so, as the Lord had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jiy bëët moa no ojierø røk jø Icriel acäŋ cooŋ kanya aciel, ni beege jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk.
english: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aö maal ni tïŋŋe ki jiy bëët moa en buute ni ge cøøa Baala na en Juuda na acanduk mar Jwøk nee kälge, ni beeye acanduk mana no ocaa ri nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni wø nyooth ajiem nyec mare ki yïthakic gïïa no otïïö ni caala nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubël ni wø en bäät acanduk manøgø.
english: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the Lord of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.

anywaa: 'Ba gena öö ni lwørge acanduk mar Jwøk po Abinadap na en bäät thuur, ni cïpge acanduk bäät jääy mo nyään man wø tut dhäki, nee käärge ki bääte; ni ö Udha ka Akïïö, ni beege wäät Abinadap, ni bwøthge maal nyïm jääy.
english: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzza and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

anywaa: Ni lwørge jääy manøgø ka acanduk mar Jwøk na en yie, ni aacge na Akïïö cäädhö maal nyïm acanduk manøgø.
english: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, Deebit ki jø Icriel bëët gena put miel døc ni yïthge met ni ge wär ki dudi ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk, ni jøw pöödö ki thøme mo wø pwöt ni di roodø, ni jøw pöödö ki thøp-othïënhö, ka anëët, ka adijeege, ka athiliiŋŋi.
english: And David and all the house of Israel played before the Lord on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge ri laara mar Nakön, dhäk moa käär acanduk, tietge aceec ni tïmge ni manynya pädhö; ni ö Udha ni put cere tïŋ maal baŋ acanduk mar Jwøk ni jøl gø.
english: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzza put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aput wëër døc ki Udha, ni put gø 'näk kaace kiper mana tïŋ cere maal bäät acanduk; ni ö Udha ni put thøø buut acanduk mar Jwøk kaace.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit agootø døc kiper mana ö wëëc Wuuö Jwøki na päth bäät Udha ni jääla gø. Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace aput cwøl ni Peereth-Udha këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: and he called the name of the place Perez–uzzah to this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput lwäyö ki Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋögø. Køøre ena köö, «?Aŋø, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk ö baŋa nidïï këët nø?»
english: And David was afraid of the Lord that day, and said, How shall the ark of the Lord come to me?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit alwäyö ki man kïth acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk yi Pääny Deebit; 'ba acanduk manøgø akïth Deebiti yi øt Obet-Idöm nyï Gëth.
english: So David would not remove the ark of the Lord unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk aput bëëte yi øt Obet-Idöm nyï Gëth ki dwäde adäk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put Obet-Idöm gwïëth ki jøøa en paare bëët.
english: And the ark of the Lord continued in the house of Obed–edom the Gittite three months: and the Lord blessed Obed–edom, and all his household.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï nyeya ma Deebit ni køp, ni «Wuuö Jwøk Obet-Idöm anø gwïëdhe ki jøøa en paare këël gïïa en jïre bëët, ki køør acanduk mar Jwøk.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput cøø ni lwør acanduk mar Jwøk po Obet-Idöm, ni kïth gø yi Pääny Deebit, ni yie met døc.
english: And it was told king David, saying, The Lord hath blessed the house of Obed–edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed–edom into the city of David with gladness.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö beeye en, kanya ö jøøa käär acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk na nø cääthge ki kääte abïciel, Deebit aput cïpö ki dhieŋ ma rwaath ki nyirøøa mo olør no olämi.
english: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the Lord had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit aput tägö ki meeŋ ki cwïnye bäre nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni eno ruyö ka abïïn wø cwøl ni ëëput na näk cwääc ka waac lïïna.
english: And David danced before the Lord with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ki jø Icriel bëët acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk aputge kälö ni ge kwöŋŋö ni yïthge met døc, ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the Lord with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya tïme na acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk pïï dï Pääny Deebit, Mikal nyi Cøøl, na näk cï Deebit, aräŋŋö ki dha awëërnyeŋ ni joot nyeya ma Deebit ni pärö ni miel nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; ni put nyeya taak ki cwïnye.
english: And as the ark of the Lord came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the Lord; and she despised him in her heart.

anywaa: Køøre acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk aputge kälö ni cïpge gø kare yo oduŋkaara mana no onø cwöth Deebiti piny kiper gø. Ni ö Deebiti ni cïpe ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought in the ark of the Lord, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Deebiti ki cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, jiy agwïëdhe ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Køøre, eni dääpe ki nyïïomøki mo omiinynyø na dhøgi apääŋŋe jï jø Icriel moa thööth kaagø, ni beege cwøw ki mään, ni pääŋŋe jï ŋati man nø ki ŋati man nø. Køøre jiy bëët adøø mïëcge ni ŋati man nø døøa paare.
english: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na duu paan dwøŋ kuna gwïëth jø paare, Mikal nyi Cøøl aöö nee røømge ki Deebit, ni cääne ki luum apääda ni kööe, na «Aŋø, nyeny Icriel, riï ka arunynyï ka abïï miï di wøørø kipere dïcäŋi. ?Aŋø, ï bëënnï ŋø ki dëërï dïcäŋi nyïm mään mo wø tïïö jï jø tïïc moï niï nëëni keda dhaanhø ma bøøl mo wïïe ba laay ki man cäädhe ki dëëre?»
english: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Mikal, ni «Gïna tïïa, mara beeye meeŋ nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na jier aani bäät wäru ki dhi øtø mare, na tïïc aani ni aana wïth jø Icriel ni beege jiye, eni na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba aani a poot bëëdö naa miel ni yia met naa pwøya Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And David said unto Michal, It was before the Lord, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the Lord, over Israel: therefore will I play before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a poot tïmö naa jööt ni kaala man, ni tïm kara ni nëëni ni thiinh ki jïra; 'ba ki jï mään moø ni cäänï kiperge yøø, a wøørge wøørø.»
english: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikal nyi Cøøl aput bëëtö ni bäŋ nyilaal jïre këël mana thøøe.
english: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni nyeya ma Deebit bëëdö paan dwøŋ yi øde mana geer jïre, ni eno nø mooc Wuuö Jwøki ki jwöm, ni lenye moa këële ki nyïïmän moe moa en deŋŋe bëët oløny nikwöc,
english: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the Lord had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

anywaa: ena köö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ni «Neenï, aani a bëëdö yi øtø mo geer ka jenni mo perge leth; 'ba acanduk mar Jwøk bëëdö yo oduŋkaara jaak.»
english: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.

anywaa: Køøre Nathan aköö jï nyeya, «Wui nyeya, beerra man tïïyï jammi bëët moa manynyï ki cwïnyï, kiper Wuuö Jwøk ena buutï.»
english: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the Lord is with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïwäänögø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Nathan ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the Lord came unto Nathan, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ dhaanhnha ma Deebit ni caanï luumma jïre, ni kööï ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, na ‹?Aŋø, beeye ïïni noo gëëdö ki øtø jïra mo bëëda yie?
english: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the Lord, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?

anywaa: Kiper aani, a kär bëëdö yi øtø ki mana täge ki kanya käla jø Icriel wøk ki Ijep këël dïcäŋi ennø; 'ba a bëëdö naa wïdö ni kar bëëtö mara beeye oduŋkaara.
english: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

anywaa: 'Ba kwöra caadha ki jø Icriel bëët, da gïn mo yaa maar caan jï dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel, moa köömma ni käärge jiya ma jø Icriel, mo aano köö, na «?Aperŋø, ni ba gëëdu ki øtø jïra en, mo geer ka jenni mo perge leth?»?›
english: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, caanï jï dhaanhnha ma Deebit, ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, ïïna jiera kanya enï pwöl kwaath niï kwaaya dïëk, niï tïmï ni ïïna dïbwödhi mar jiya ma jø Icriel.
english: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba aana bëëdö ki ïïni ki yïth kwöra caathï bëët ni dïïra wïth nyïïmän moï nyïmï; 'ba nyeŋŋï poot tïïa tïïö nee wïnye, ni caala nyeŋ jiy moa no owïnyö døc bäät piny.
english: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

anywaa: Aani thuwø da kany mo jiera jierø kiper jiya ma jø Icriel nee tietge këëtge piny yie, ni beeye kany bëëtge yie na poge, ni tïme ni bäŋ jiy mo kiera wïthge këët, ni bäŋe jiy mo wïthge reyø mo caara ge këët kaawat mana dïkwøŋ,
english: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

anywaa: ni beeye ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa thïïŋa pïëmme jï jiya ma jø Icriel. 'Ba aani, ï mooa mooø ki jwöm ni tïme ni bäŋ leny yïthakiyu ki nyïïmän moï bëët. 'Ba ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a caana mara jïrï ki man näk beeye a na Wuuö Jwøk noo tïïc dhi ødï ni teek.
english: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the Lord telleth thee that he will make thee an house.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo päŋ nïne moï noo thøwï noo läpï køør kwäyu, aani, da ŋat mo käla dëërï mo thïïŋa thïïŋö køørï; 'ba aani tier nyec mare këëlla piny.
english: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni gëëde ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, ni këëlla tier wälu mar nyec mare piny na bäre bäre.
english: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba aano bëëdö ni aana wuuö jïre, ni bëëde na wäädö jïra. 'Ba kanyo näk eno bääyö, pwönynya pwönynyö kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø pwöny wääde, ni jääla gø kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø jääl wääde,
english: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

anywaa: 'ba mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl, na paanya bäät Cøøl, ŋata käla wøk niï läwï kare, ba paanya bäät ŋataca.
english: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba dhi øtø marï ki nyec marï puta ruuö køørï; ni këëlla tier wälu marï piny na bäre bäre.› »
english: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

anywaa: Køøre Nathan luup bëët, këël gïïa nyooth Jwøki bëët jïre, acaane jï Deebit.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit aci kar lam ni pï piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni läme ni kööe, «?Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, aana ŋa? ?A dhi øtø mara thuwø, nyïëdi, ni tïïyï gïïögø bëët yøø kipera?
english: Then went king David in, and sat before the Lord, and he said, Who am I, O Lord God? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

anywaa: ?Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ki jïrï, gïna nø tïïyï enø beeye gïn mo thiinh jaak? 'Ba ïïna cäŋ cäänö kiper gïno tïïyï kiper dhi øtø mara yi nyïme kunece. ?Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, teeŋ gïnögø putï ka tïïc kiper dhaanhø møn en?
english: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord God; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord God?

anywaa: «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ?agïnaŋø noo caana jïrï këët nø mo kaala man, a na Deebit en? Kiper a na dhaanhnhï en, cwïnya oløny ni ŋäyï døc.
english: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord God, knowest thy servant.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper luupï bëët moa nø carï nee thurge karge, ki køør mana caarï ki cwïnyï, beeye ni tïïyï tier luubö man ni pere leth en nee bëëde ni ŋääa.
english: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.

anywaa: «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna Jwøk niï dwøŋ. Ka adïëri møn, bäŋ jwøk mør mo caala ïïni, ni bäŋ jwøk mør këët, 'ba bee ï keerï, kaa mana wïnywa gø ki ïthwa.
english: Wherefore thou art great, O Lord God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da wï jur bäät piny kany mo caala jiyï ma jø Icriel? Kiper beeye ï na Jwøk marwa na ö baŋ jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni kälï wa wøk ceŋ jø Ijep, nee wa bëëtwa na jiyï, ni tïïyï nyeŋŋï nee wïnye. Ïïna tïïö ki gïï mo døøŋŋø mo di lwäärö dëët wïth juurre ki juu moge, ni riemï ge wøk nyïmwa, wa na jiyï.
english: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ïïni na këël tiet jiyï piny ma jø Icriel, nee putge bëëtö na jiyï na bäre bäre, ni tïmï ni ïïna Jwøk marge.
english: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, Lord, art become their God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, luubö mana nø caanï kipera, a na dhaanhnhï, ki dhi øtø mara, beerra man putï gø wëëk thur kare na bäre, ni tïïyï gø kaawat mana nø caanï gø.
english: And now, O Lord God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋŋï obëëdö ni dwøŋ na bäre bäre, ni kö jiyi, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye Jwøka eni mar jø Icriel›; 'ba a na dhaanhnhï ma Deebit en, put dhi øtø mara tïïc ni teek nyïmï.
english: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

anywaa: «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk ï na wïth jammi bëët, ï na Jwø Icriel, gïnögø anø nyoothï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, ni kööï, ni ‹Aani dhi øtø marï otïïa ni teek.› Kiper manøgønø, a na dhaanhnhï, cwïnya ajïtö ki cer ki man läma jïrï.
english: For thou, O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.

anywaa: Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, bee ï na Jwøk, ni luup moï beege adïëri, ni bee ï na buuk luummi en na beer jïra, a na dhaanhnhï.
english: And now, O Lord God, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, a kwaya ïïni nee dhi øtø mara gwïëthï, a na dhaanhnhï, ni tïme ni puta bëëte ni nut na bäre bäre nyïmï. Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, gïnögø anø caanï; 'ba ki køør gwïëth mano gwïëthï dhi øtø mara ki gø, a na dhaanhnhï, gwïëth manøgø put bëëte ni nut na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.»
english: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord God, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Deebit akëëdö ki jø Pilitin ni dwøk wïthge piny; ni ö Deebiti ni lwør pääny mana dwøŋ ceŋ jø Pilitin.
english: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit jø Möap abööte thuwø, ni ö jiyi moa maae ki tøŋ ri leny ni cïïm geni na tëëŋŋe, ni wëëk geni but piny. Køøre eni tëëŋŋe ariiø moa cïïmme røk jøøgø anääe, ni wec tëëŋŋö aciel bäre ni kwøw. Køøre, jø Möap aput tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit ni ge cïpö ka ajwäk jïre.
english: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit Adadëdher o Reeyöp nyeny jø Dhöba abööte thuwø kanya ö Adadëdherri na aae ni cøøa kuna cäŋ nyec mare dwøk kare bäät Naam Upareeti.
english: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi ma kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki tietge ma kume ma pïërariiø amaae cer Adadëdher; ni ö Deebiti ni ŋøør ojwönyi mo tiet okwëënyi bëët mo wø tut jïëthe. 'Ba møøk mo orømø awiie kiper jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi ma dïpa.
