english: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Aram moa en Damacka na öge kuna kønyge Adadëdher nyeny jø Dhöba, Deebit anääö ki jø Aram ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø.
english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput tïïö ki kwör koor dï mïëc jø Aram moa en tier Damacka, ni ö jø Arammi ni putge tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit ni ge cïpö ka ajwäk jïre. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aput bëëte ni køønynya Deebit kany wø tuge yie jaak.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit kööde mo leny moa käär jø lenynyi mo Adadëdher na näk otïïö ki warkey aput lwør, ni käl ge yi Jerucalem.
english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit akädö ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli mo thööth døc ki yïth päänye mo nyeya ma Adadëdher, ni beege Bëtha ki Bëröthay.
english: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Töi nyeny jø Amath na wïny gø ni Deebit jø leny mo Adadëdher bëët ee nø böötö,
english: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

anywaa: Töi wääde ma Jöram aput jääŋŋö baŋ nyeya ma Deebit nee määdhe mare ki gwïëth mare caan jï Deebit, kiper mana ö Deebiti na këëde ka Adadëdher ni bööt gø; kiper Adadëdher bëëdö ni këëdö ki Töi. 'Ba Jöram o Töi aay ni käädö ki gïï mo tïïc ka warkey ki gwel-bïrö ki nywïënyö ma jwïël jï Deebit.
english: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit gïïögø aput cïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni dwal ge bäät warkey ki gwel-bïrö moa näk ee kwøŋ cïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege moa käle baŋ wïth juurre bëët moa näk wïthge ee dwøk piny;
english: Which also king David did dedicate unto the Lord, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

anywaa: ni wïth juurre moa käl gïïögø baŋge beege jø Ëdöm, ki jø Möap, ki jø Amön, ki jø Pilitin, ki jø Amalëk. 'Ba gïïa twier baŋ Adadëdher o Reeyöp, nyeny jø Dhöba, ee nø cïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk thuwø.
english: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit nyeŋŋe aput wïnyö kanya duue ni jø Ëdöm ma kume apaar ka abära ee nääö Goor Acäbö.
english: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit dï Ëdöm bäre aput kïthö ki kwör koor, ni ö jø Ëdömmi bëët ni putge tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aput bëëte ni køønynya Deebit kany wø tuge yie jaak.
english: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput bëëdö na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët; ni luup ŋøle na karge, ni tïïya adïëri jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap o Dheruya beeye kwääy lwaa leny, ni ö Jøcapati wär Akilut ni bëëde na nyikugö.
english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

anywaa: 'Ba Dhadök wär Akitöp ka Ayemëlëk wär Abiethaar beege dïlämme moa døøŋŋø, ni ö Ceraya ni bëëde ni beeye ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny.
english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

anywaa: 'Ba Benaya o Jööda beeye kwääy lwaak mar jø leny mo wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita. 'Ba wäät Deebit gena jø wø køny nyeya ka acaara.
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were chief rulers.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel, Deebit apëëö ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, da dhaanhø mo odööŋ ni kwøw røk nyïïkwaac Cøøl, nee mëër mara nyoodha jïre ki køør mëër mana en yïthakicwa ki Jönathan?»
english: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan's sake?

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, da dhaanhø mo bëëdö na ŋat tïïc jï jø dhi øt Cøøl mo nyeŋŋe Dhiba; ni cwøli, ni ö baŋ nyeya ma Deebit. Ni kö nyeya jïgø, na «?Aŋø, beeye ï Dhiba møn en?» Ni kö Dhiba, ni «Beeye aani, a na dhaanhnhï.»
english: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Art thou Ziba? And he said, Thy servant is he.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö, na «?Aŋø, da dhaanhø mo poot no odööŋ ni kwøw røk nyïïkwaac Cøøl nee mëër mar Jwøk nyoodha jïre?» 'Ba Dhiba aköö jï nyeya, ni «Da wär Jönathan mo tiete karge riet otøyø, mo odööŋ ni poot kwøw.»
english: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of God unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan hath yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jï Dhiba, «?Eni en kaa ennø?» Ni løgi ya Dhiba jï nyeya, «Ka adïëri møn, eni nutö po Makir wär Amiel paana cwøl ni Lödebaar.»
english: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo–debar.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aput jääk baŋe Lödebaar po Makir wär Amiel, ni put öö.
english: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo–debar.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Mepiböcëthi o Jönathan, nyikwaar Cøøl, na pïïe baŋ Deebit, cøŋŋe aput këël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø. Ni cwøli ya Deebiti, ni «Mepiböcëth.» Ni løk gø, ni «Aani en, a na dhaanhnhï.»
english: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold thy servant!

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jïgø, ni «Kärï lwäyö; ka adïëri møn, mëër mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïrï ki køør mëër mana en yïthakicwa ki wäru ma Jönathan; ni ö pwöthi bëët moa näk mo kwaru ma Cøøl ni duua ge jïrï. 'Ba ïïno put bëëtö niï cämö ki aani cooth.»
english: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father's sake, and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Mepiböcëth cøŋŋe acäŋ këël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni kööe, «?Wui nyeya, a na dhaanhnhï, a ba caal gwök mo othøw? ?A mëër man ni dwøŋ bäre en, orømø ki man nyoothï gø jïra?»
english: And he bowed himself, and said, What is thy servant, that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am?

anywaa: Køøre nyeya, Dhiba na bëëdö na ŋat tïïc mar Cøøl acwøle, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Jammi bëët moa näk mo Cøøl, këël moa näk mo jø dhi øde bëët, anø cïba jï nyikwaar ŋata bëënnï na kwäärö marï.
english: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul's servant, and said unto him, I have given unto thy master's son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki wäätï ki jø tïïc moï, u doo purö ki pwödhö jï Mepiböcëth, ni ö caammi mo ociek ni kälu ge jï nyikwaar ŋata bëënnï na kwäärö marï, nee jïte ki cam. 'Ba Mepiböcëth puta bëëtö ni cämö ki aani cooth.» 'Ba kar kaagø, Dhiba jïre da wääte ma apaar kurbïïc ki jø tïïc ma pïërariiø.
english: Thou therefore, and thy sons, and thy servants, shall till the land for him, and thou shalt bring in the fruits, that thy master's son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth thy master's son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

anywaa: Køøre Dhiba aköö jï nyeya, ni «Ki køør luup bëët moa nø carï, ï na nyeya mara, na köömmï aani, a na dhaanhnhï, tïïa tïïö na karge.» Kanyøgønø, Mepiböcëth aput bëëtö ni cämö ka nyeya ma Deebit ni caala o nyeya aciel røk wääte.
english: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant, so shall thy servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king's sons.

anywaa: 'Ba Mepiböcëth jïre da wääde mo poot thiinh mo nyeŋŋe Mika. 'Ba jiy bëët moa bëëdö po Dhiba gena put bëëtö na jø tïïc mo Mepiböcëth.
english: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Mepiböcëth aput bëëtö yi Jerucalem, ni eni cämö ka nyeya cooth. 'Ba ena ŋwøl ni tiete karge riet otøyø.
english: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king's table; and was lame on both his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään gïna tägö, nyeya mar jø Amön athøw, ni ö wääde ma Anun ni ci kar wänni na nyeya.
english: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö, ni «Aani mëër mara nyoodha nyoodhø jï Anun o Naøc, kaawat mana ö wänni na nyooth mëër mare jïra.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput jääk baŋ Anun ki jiy nee cwïny Anun cømge kiper thøø mar wänni. 'Ba kanya ö jic Deebiti na pïïcge yi ŋööm jø Amön,
english: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: jø Amön moa kwörge døøŋŋø aköö jï nyenyge ma Anun, na «?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni Deebit wøøra wäru, na jääŋ baŋï ki jiy mo cøm cwïnyï? ?Aŋø, Deebit jiye ba jääŋŋe baŋï kaper nee pääny raŋge ni marge lïëw nee tukge yi nyïme?»
english: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Anun, jic Deebit aput mak ni liel thäk jïëc tïkge, ni ö abïïe moge moa näk caala jalabiiye ni ŋøør ge ni cëëgö ni ena dhøk wödhi, ni wëëk ge wääth.
english: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø atïŋŋö ni cääthge ni wïthge olääö døc kiree. 'Ba kanya caan gïnögø jï Deebit, ena jääk baŋge ki jiy nee ge jøli, ni kööe jï jøøa jääŋŋi, ni «Caannu jïge, ni ‹Putu bëëte Jerikö këël mano tuc jïëc tïgu; køøre nø, uuno duui.› »
english: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Amönni na jootge gø ni geno nø tïmö ni caala gïn mo ŋwäänynye raac ki jï Deebit, gena jäägö ki jiy nee määnyge ki jø leny mo këëdi jïge ki gwel, ni jøøa jääkge baŋge beege jø Aram moa bëëdö Bëëth-Reyap ki moa bëëdö Dhöba, ni jïtge ki jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki tietge ma kume ma pïërariiø, ki nyeny Maika ki jø leny moe ma kuma aciel, ni jïtge ki jø leny ma kume apaar kurriiø baŋ jø Thöp.
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob, and the Syrians of Zobah, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na wïny gïnögø, eni Jöap ki jø leny moa teek bëët ajääŋŋe.
english: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Amönni ni öge wøk ni cïïmge rege kiper leny dhi kiir mar pääny marge. 'Ba jø leny mo jø Aram moa käl Dhöba ki moa käl Reeyöp, ki jø leny moa käl Thöp, ki moa käl Maika, ge ena kur keerge dï pwöla.
english: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zobah, and of Rehob, and Ish–tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi na joot gø ni leny oløny ni ööa bääte ki nyïme ki ŋääe, ena jëëdö ki jiy moa teek røk jø leny mo Icriel, ni cïïm ge na dhøgi nee këëtge ki jø Aram.
english: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moa dööŋ acïp cer coki ma Abicay, ni ö Abicay ni cïïm ge na dhøgi nee këëtge ki jø Amön.
english: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aköö jï coki ma Abicay, «Ni näk mo jø Aram tïmö ni ge teek bääta, a wär kønyï; 'ba ni näk mo jø Amön tïmö ni ge teek bäätï, ï kønya kønyø.
english: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will come and help thee.

anywaa: Mak riï nø, ni këëdø ni ø teek kiper jø pøø ki päänye mo Jwøk marø. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc mana beerra eni ki jïre.»
english: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our God: and the Lord do that which seemeth him good.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap ki jø leny moe na en buute, gena ci baŋ leny ki jø Aram, ni ö jø Arammi ni bwøkge nyïm Jöap.
english: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Amönni na jootge gø ni jø Aram obwøk, gena put bwøk thuwø nyïm Abicay, ni dønyge yi pääny. Køøre Jöap aput duuö ki baŋ leny mana këël ki jø Amön ni duu Jerucalem.
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Arammi na jootge gø ni gena nø bööt jø Icrielli, rege acooŋge kanya ciel.
english: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

anywaa: Køøre Adadëdher ajäägö ki jiy nee jø Aram moa en løø Naam Upareeti løøga öge, ni öge kanya cwøl ni Ëlam; 'ba Cöbak kwääy lwaa leny mar Adadëdher beeye eni na bwøth geni.
english: And Hadadezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadadezer went before them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö gïnögø na caani jï Deebit, Deebit jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët acooŋ kanya ciel, ni aacge ni ŋutge løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni öge Ëlam. 'Ba jø leny mo jø Aram rege acïïmge na dhøgi ni këëtge ki Deebit.
english: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Aram gena bwøk nyïm jø Icriel, ni ö Deebiti ni nääe ki jø Aram ma dïpe abïriiø mo wø këëdi ki bäät jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny ma kume ma pïëraŋween mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi, ni cwøp Cöbak kwääy lwaa leny mar jø Aram, ni put Cöbaki thøø kaace.
english: And the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeye bëët moa en tier Adadëdher na jootge gø ni geno nø bööt jø Icrielli, gena tudö ki luubö nee bëëtge ki bëët mëër ki jø Icriel, ni bëënge jø Icriel. Kanyøgønø, jø Aram gena put lwäyö ki man kønyge jø Amön këët.
english: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel, they made peace with Israel, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni piny otal ni bäŋ køth këët, ni beeye kany wø ci nyeye baŋ mäny, nyeya ma Deebit, Jöap ki kwääc lwaae mo leny møga këël jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët, ajääŋŋe baŋ leny; ni ö jøøgø ni cige ni raanyge jø Amön, ni putge päänya dwøŋ na cwøl ni Raaba tii dïër. 'Ba Deebit odööŋ paac yi Jerucalem.
english: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Israel; and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ki kur abøøya, nyeya aö maal ki bäät pëëm mare ni caath tiete yi øtø mare mana en bäät øtø maal; 'ba kanya cäädhe kaace, ena lwïthö piny ni jïte ki dhaagø mo lwøk. 'Ba dhaagø manøgø beeye dhaagø mo kïte mïërö døc.
english: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king's house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ajäägö ki dhaanhø nee bëët dhaagø manøgø pëënynye. 'Ba akøp, na «?Aŋø, dhaagø manøgø paa Bathcïba nyi Eliam, ni beeye cï Uria nyï Këth?»
english: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath–sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aput jääk baŋ dhaagø manøgø ki jiy, nee öge ki gø; ni ö dhaagø manøgø ni pïïe baŋ Deebit. Køøre Deebit aci baŋ gø ni bute ki gø na dhaagø, ni ö nyaanøgø ni put døø paare. 'Ba kar kaagø, dhaagø manøgø onø gööc wøk ki gïr mään.
english: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø manøgø yie ajïtö ki dhaanhø, ni jääk baŋ Deebit nee caan jïre, ni «Yia da dhaanhø.»
english: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit ajääk baŋ Jöap pwöl leny, ni kööe, ni «Uria nyï Këth jääŋŋï baŋa.» Kanyøgønø Jöap, Uria aput jääŋŋö baŋ Deebit.
english: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Uria baŋ Deebit, ena pëëny Deebiti ki jööt dëël mar Jöap ki jööt dëël mar jø leny, këël luum leny bäre.
english: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Uria, ni «Ci paarï, ni jwömï riï.» Kanyøgønø, Uria aput døny wøk yi øt nyeya, ni ö cam mana cïp nyeya jïre ni jääŋŋi køøre.
english: And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king's house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

anywaa: 'Ba Uria aput but dhi øt nyeya ki jø tïïc mo nyeya møga bëët, ni käre ci paare këët.
english: But Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Deebit ni køp, ni «Uria kär ci paare,» Deebit aköö jï Uria, «?Aŋø, ï ba käl jöö? ?Aperŋø na kärï ci paarï en?»
english: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Camest thou not from thy journey? why then didst thou not go down unto thine house?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Uria jï Deebit ni kööe, na «Acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki jø leny mo jø Icriel, ki tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda, ge bëëdö yïth abïle; ni këël kwääy lwaa leny mara ma Jöap ki kwääc lwaae mo leny møga, twïër marge ege tïïö pwöla jaak. ?A aani nø, a doo cøøa paara ni cäma ni mädha ni yia met, ni cøøa baŋ dhaagø mara ni buta ki gø? Aani, a kööŋŋa riï kiree, teeŋ gïnögø ba daa tïïö na bäre bäre.»
english: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Israel, and Judah, abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as thou livest, and as thy soul liveth, I will not do this thing.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Uria, ni «Wøp nø, ï bëëdö kany dïcäŋi thuwø, 'ba diøø ï wëëga wääth niï aayï.» Kanyøgønø, Uria aput bëëtö yi Jerucalem dïcäŋögø këël riet nïne.
english: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let thee depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cwøl Deebiti ni cäme ni mädhe ki eni na aciel, ni puti Deebiti tïïc nee meere. 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na wäär, Uria adøny wøk ni cäŋ ci baŋ jø tïïc mo nyeya, ni but kaace; 'ba eni kär ci paare.
english: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, Deebit agööt baŋ Jöap ki wëëlö ni cïp gø cer Uria nee kïth baŋ Jöap.
english: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana no ogöör Deebiti yi wëëlö, ena köö, ni «Uria wär tïïc nee ci nyïm, kanyo en lenynyi mana teek yie, ni døøu ŋää cään, nee tïme ni løny ki man këëli ni thøøe.»
english: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni pääny onø rum Jöapi dïër, Uria aput Jöapi tïïc nee ci kanya en jø leny moa teek mo jøøgø yie.
english: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø leny mo paanøgø aput ö wøk, ni këëtge ki Jöap, ni ö jø møøki røk jø leny mo Deebit ni thøwge ri leny kaagø; 'ba Uria nyï Këth thuwø athøw.
english: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap ajääk baŋ Deebit ni caan gïna tägö ri leny bäre.
english: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

anywaa: 'Ba acaan Jöapi jï ŋata jääŋŋe, ni kööe, ni «Kanyo nø thöörï jammi bëët moa tägö ri leny ki caan jï nyeya,
english: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

anywaa: kanymør nyeya wëër ki ïïni, ni kööe, na ‹?Aperŋø na nyiigu buut kiir nou këëdu ki geni? ?Aŋø, kuyu nou thööcge thööyö ki ri kiir?
english: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Abimëlëk o Gidien othøw nidïï na bëëde? ?Paa dhaagø jaak na lëëŋ kïn guur ki bäät kiir maal, ni päth wïïe, ni put thøø Tëbët kaace? ?Aperŋø nø na nyiigu buut kiir mar jøøgø?› Køøre nø, wärï put köö, ni ‹Dhaanhnhï ma Uria nyï Këth, athøw thuwø.› »
english: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went ye nigh the wall? then say thou, Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋata jääŋ Jöapi atïŋŋö, ni pïïe baŋ Deebit ni caan luup bëët moa jääŋŋi Jöapi kiperge.
english: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

anywaa: Ni kö ŋata jääŋŋi jï Deebit, ni «Jøøke atïmö ni teek, ni öge baŋ leny ki waani yi pwöla; 'ba gena ŋaacwa ni putwa pïï dhi kiir marge.
english: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

anywaa: Kar kaagønø, jø wø këëdi ka athëëre moa en røk jøøke, jø leny moï aputge këërö ki ri kiir; ni ö jø møøk røk jø leny ni putge thøø, këël dhaanhnhï ma Uria nyï Këth thuwø aput thøø.»
english: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon thy servants; and some of the king's servants be dead, and thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï ŋata jääŋŋi, ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Jöap, ni ‹Cwïnyï kär ränynyö kiper gïna tägö enøgø, kiper kany wø näk ri leny, thøø dagø løøk man ki løøk maya; 'ba ennø, tïïc leny marï ni teek døc ni mayï pääny manøgø.› 'Ba luubö manøgø wär caanï jïre, nee cwïnye jïte ki cer.»
english: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö cï Uria na wïny gø ni cwøre ma Uria athøw nyïm leny, ena jwöŋö ni kïmme kiper thøw cwøre.
english: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum nïr kïmmö, Deebit ajääk baŋe ni käl gø paare, ni put tïmö na cïïe. Køøre dhaagø manøgø alwaar ki dhaanhø ma dïcwøø ni beeye nyilaal mar Deebit. 'Ba gïna tïïc Deebiti beeye gïn mo nëëni ni raac døc ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Wuuö Jwøk, Nathan na näk nyikuŋ Jwøk ajääŋŋe baŋ Deebit. Ni ö Nathanni ni ci baŋ Deebit ni cääne ki eni ki luup mo keda leer, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Da jiy ariiø mo bëëdö paac aciel; dhaanhø aciel okwär, ni dhaanhø maya can.
english: And the Lord sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata no okwär jïre da pïïth dïëk ki dhäk mo thööth.
english: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata can bäŋ gïrpiny jïre, 'ba beeye nyidiel aciel keere ma røømmø ma nyakøø mo poot thiinh, mo ee ŋeeø ni piith gø; ni ö nyidierøgø ni put piith na aciel ko obwöre moe. 'Ba gïn wø cam ŋatøgø beeye wø cam nyidierøgø, ni ge mädhö ki gïrpiny aciel. 'Ba nyidierøgø bëëdö kööre,
english: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ŋat mo käla jöö apïï na wëëllö po ŋata no okwär. 'Ba ŋatøgø no okwär enø, yie kär met ki man lwöte ri pïïth dïëk wala ri dhäk moe, kiper nee jiiŋŋe na cam jï ŋata käl jöö na pïï baŋe na wëëllö. 'Ba gïna tïïe, nyidier ŋata can alwøre ni jiiŋ gø na cam jï ŋata pïï paare na wëëllö.»
english: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man's lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput wëër døc ki gïr ŋatøgø, ni kööe jï Nathan, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk kiree, ka adïëri møn, ŋata tïïc gïnögø enø, rømi ka 'näk.
english: And David's anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As the Lord liveth, the man that hath done this thing shall surely die:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø nyidier ŋata can dee coolø ki dïëk aŋween, kiper gïnögø atïïe ni cwïnye kär pädhö.»
english: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

anywaa: 'Ba Nathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Beeye ï ŋateca. Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ena köö, ni ‹Beeye aani na tïïc ïïni nee wïïï thïïmmi ki maaw naa røønya ïïni na nyeya mar jø Icriel, ni beeye aani na piem ïïni cer Cøøl.
english: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;

anywaa: Aani thuwø, po nyeya marï ma Cøøl ki määre acïba jïrï nee neetï; ni ö jø Icrielli bëët, këël tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni cïba ge cerï. 'Ba doo na moøgø nøk kiperï, daa meedø jïrï ki møøk mo perge leth mo kaala moøgø.
english: And I gave thee thy master's house, and thy master's wives into thy bosom, and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø, na taagï dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïï ki gïn mo nëëni ni raac ki jïra? Ïïni, Uria nyï Këth anø 'nägï ri leny, ni nø kälï cïïe, ni tïme na cïïï; 'ba Uria anääï ri leny møn ni jääk jaak, ni beeye leny mana këëllu ki jø Amön.
english: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the Lord, to do evil in his sight? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and hast taken his wife to be thy wife, and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, thøw tøŋ ree ba paanye dhi ødï, kiper aana taagï, ni nø kälï cï Uria nyï Këth, ni tïïyï gø na cïïï.›
english: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house; because thou hast despised me, and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife.

anywaa: «Man poot na dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, a känna bäätï ki gïn mo leth, ni ŋato tïïc gø käla ri jø dhi ødï. Këël määrï kiree, paanya paanyø buutï ni cïba ge jï dhaanhnhï mør, ni ö ŋatøgø ni ci baŋ määrï ni bute ki ge ko okaan cäŋ.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will raise up evil against thee out of thine own house, and I will take thy wives before thine eyes, and give them unto thy neighbour, and he shall lie with thy wives in the sight of this sun.

anywaa: Bääyö marï, atïïyï ni tiere ba nëëni; 'ba gïno tïïa, tïïa tïïö ko okaan cäŋ ni nëënö jï jø Icriel bëët.› »
english: For thou didst it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Nathan, ni «Aana nø bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk møn.» 'Ba Nathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Wuuö Jwøk thuwø bääyö marï anø wëënne. Ïïni, ï ba thøw.
english: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord. And Nathan said unto David, The Lord also hath put away thy sin; thou shalt not die.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper gïna baayï ni dwøŋ enø, na taagï Wuuö Jwøk, nyilaal marï kiree mana lwaar dhaagø manøgø ki gø puta thøø.»
english: Howbeit, because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the Lord to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Nathan aput døø paare.
english: And Nathan departed unto his house. And the Lord struck the child that Uriah's wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyilaal mana lwaar cï Uria ki gø jï Deebit, atïïe nee mak täwi, ni put nyilaalli tïmö ni tuu døc.
Kanyøgønø, Deebit Jwøk akwaaye kiper täw nyilaal; 'ba Deebit aput kweer ki cam, ni but piny yïth ŋøøm jaak ki dïwäär bäre.
english: David therefore besought God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jø døøŋŋø moa en paare kaagø, gena öö ni cuŋge buute nee eni tïŋge maal ki yïth ŋøøm nee cäme ki geni; 'ba ena kweer.
english: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, na tïme na bïriet nïne, nyilaal athøw. Ni ö jø tïïci mo Deebit ni lwäcge ki man caange gø jï Deebit ni nyilaal othøw, kiper gena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, kanya poot nyilaalli ni kwøw, øøna cäänö ki Deebit, ni käre döötø leŋø. ?'Ba ennø, ocaanø gø jïre nidïï ni nyilaal athøw? Kiper dëëre tïïe tïïö ki gïn mo leth.»
english: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Deebiti ni jø tïïc moe wïthge ege kuur kanya aciel ni ge muuŋö, aput ŋäc ni nyilaal othøw. Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï jø tïïc moe, «?Aŋø, nyilaal athøw?» Ni løgi ya jøøgø ni köge, ni «Yaa, athøw.»
english: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput ö maal ki yïth ŋøøm, ni lwøk dëëre, ni wïïr dëëre ki maaw, ni wiil abïïe moa en dëëre; ni put ci kar lam mar Wuuö Jwøk ni läme. Køøre ena duu paare, ni pëëe ki cam, ni ö jøøgø ni putge cam cïp nyïme, ni cäme.
english: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of the Lord, and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

anywaa: Køøre jø tïïc moe aköö jïgø, «?Wui nyeya, a teeŋ gïnaŋø na tïïyï en? Kanya bëëde ni nyilaal poot kwøw, ïïna kweer ki cam ni jwöŋï; 'ba kanya thøw nyilaalli, ïïna ö maal ni cämï.»
english: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Deebiti ni kööe, ni «Kanya bëëde ni nyilaal poot kwøw, aana kweer ki cam ni jwöŋa møn; kiper aana cädö, ni kööa, no ‹Oŋäya ŋa, kanymør Wuuö Jwøk met ec mare nyoodhe nyoodhø jïra, ni wec nyilaal nee put bëëtö ni kwøw.›
english: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether God will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, nyilaal anø thøw. ?Agïnaŋø noo kweera ki cam kipere këët nø? ?Aŋø, nyilaal løny jïra ki man tïŋa gø maal ki yi thøø? Beeye aani noo läp køøre, 'ba eni ba løny ki man duu wøk baŋa këët.»
english: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit cwïny cïïe ma Bathcïba acøme; 'ba ena ci baŋ gø ni bute ki gø; køøre Bathcïba ajïtö ki dhaanhø ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni ö Deebiti ni cak nyeŋ nyilaal ni Cølöman. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk mëër ki nyilaarøgø.
english: And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and the Lord loved him.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na mëëre ki nyilaarøgø, dwøre ajääŋŋe ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ni cak nyeŋ nyilaal ni Jididiya, ni tiere beeye ni ŋata mëër Wuuö Jwøki ki gø.
english: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet; and he called his name Jedidiah, because of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap acäŋ këëdö ki jø Amön moa en Raaba, ni mac thääŋ pääny manøgø. 'Ba Raaba beeye pääny mana dwøŋ mar jø Amön ni wø bëët nyeya marge yie.
english: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

anywaa: Ni ö Jöapi ni jääk baŋ Deebit ki jiy, ni kööe, ni «Aana nø këëdö ki jøøa bëëdö Raaba; këël kar pïï marge mana en dï pääny anø maa thuwø.
english: And Joab sent messengers to David, and said, I have fought against Rabbah, and have taken the city of waters.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, cooŋ jø leny moa no odööŋ ni ööu ki ge ni tugu pääny man, nee tïme ni maya ïïni; kiper ni näk maya aani, tïmö ni wïnya nyeŋŋa jaak.»
english: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit jø leny moa no odööŋ aput cooŋ ni ci Raaba, ni këëde ki jøøa bëëdö yie, ni put pääny manøgø mac.
english: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aduda mar nyeya mar jøøgø aput lwør wï gø. 'Ba aduda manøgø tïïc ka warkey mo peek døc ma rumi ma kikar aciel, ni yie da waŋ kïdi mo pere leth. Ni ö aduda manøgø ni puti kïth wï Deebit. 'Ba Deebit gïïa twiere pääny manøgø beege gïï mo thööth døc.
english: And he took their king's crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David's head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

anywaa: Deebit thuwø jøøa bøth yi pääny manøgø amaae, ni kïth ceŋge ki lïge ki teeŋ jap tïïc mo tïïc ka nywïëny, nee ge tïïge ki ge, ni tïïc møøk na mo wø budö ki thuube. Ni ö Deebiti ni tïïc teeŋ gïnögø dëët jøøa en yïth päänye bëët mo jø Amön. Køøre Deebit ki jø leny moe bëët gena put døø Jerucalem.
english: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Abëcëlöm o Deebit da coki ma dhaagø mo mïërö døc mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Tamar; 'ba Amnön o Deebit mëër ki nyiwänni ma Tamar døc.
english: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

anywaa: 'Ba Amnön yie ocwat acaac nyiwänni døc, ni put tïmö ni tuu. 'Ba Tamar ena nyakøø mo dëëre poot kuc dïcwøø, ni ki jï Amnön beeye gïn mo teek ki man tïïe ki gïrpiny dëër gø.
english: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.

anywaa: 'Ba Amnön do owänni mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jönadap o Cimia cöök Deebiti; 'ba Jönadap ena dhaanhø mo waŋe riek døc.
english: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

anywaa: Køøre Jönadap aköö jï Amnön, «Wui o nyeya, ?aŋø ni bëëdï niï dwada nyïme jaak en? ?Aŋø, gïnögø ni dwaat ïïni enø ba caanï jïra?» 'Ba Amnön aköö jïre, ni «Aani, a mëër ki Tamar døc, cöök owära ma Abëcëlöm.»
english: And he said unto him, Why art thou, being the king's son, lean from day to day? wilt thou not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönadap aköö jï Amnön, ni «Ci but piny bäät pëëmï ni cøøgï riï keda täw okadhø; 'ba kanyo ö wäru noo lïïm ïïni, wärï kööï jïre, na ‹Awuuö, beerra man ö nyiwära ma Tamar ni ööe nee tïïe ki cam jïra nee cama, ni cam manøgø jiiŋŋe ni nëënö jïra, naa caame.› »
english: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay thee down on thy bed, and make thyself sick: and when thy father cometh to see thee, say unto him, I pray thee, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Amnön aput but piny ni cøøk dëëre ni kere täw okadhø. 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na lïïm eni, ena köö jï nyeya, na «Awuuö, beerra man ö nyiwära ma Tamar ni ööe nee bude ki dääpe ariiø ni nëënö jïra naa caame.»
english: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray thee, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aput jääk paac baŋ Tamar, ni kööe, ni «Ci baŋ owäru ma Amnön yi øtø mare, ni tïï ki cam jïre.»
english: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon's house, and dress him meat.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Tamar aput ci baŋ owänni ma Amnön yi øtø mare. 'Ba kar kaagø, Amnön obut piny. 'Ba kanya ööe, eni käädö ki møø mo okudö, ni coot gø ni bul gø na dääpe, ni nëënö jï Amnön.
english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

anywaa: Ni ö Tamarri ni lwør dääpe yi gïna budö ki gø ni cïp gø nyïm Amnön; 'ba Amnön akweer ki cam. Køøre Amnön aköö, «Beerra man ö jøøi ni en kany en ni cige wøk.» Kanyøgønø, jiy bëët aput aa wøk buute.
english: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

anywaa: Køøre Amnön aköö jï Tamar, ni «Käl cam kar niine mara, naa caamï.» Kanyøgønø, Tamar dääpe moa bule aput lwør ni kïth ge kar niine baŋ owänni ma Amnön.
english: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of thine hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Tamarri na käl dääpe jï Amnön nee cäme, Amnön nyiwänni ma Tamar aput mak ki teek ni kööe jïgø, «Nya nyiwära, ööï naa buta ki ïïni.»
english: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Tamar jïre, «Nyie owära, ba løny. Kär a magï ki teek; kiper gïn mo caala man poot kär tïïö dï Icriel cøøn en. Kär niï tïïya gïn ni duunni ka apääda en.
english: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Israel: do not thou this folly.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, apään gïnögø ööa wøk bääta këët? Këël ïïni thuwø, ï tïmö kaamar dhaanhø ma bøøl dï bøøre mo Icriel. 'Ba ennø, nyie owära, pëëny nyeya, kiper eni a ba mäne ki man nywømï aani.»
english: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for thee, thou shalt be as one of the fools in Israel. Now therefore, I pray thee, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Amnön ïthe käre ciiø ki luum nyiwänni; 'ba kiper mana näk dëëre teeka eni ki nyiwänni, nyiwänni aput mak ki teek ni put butö ki gø na dhaagø.
english: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

anywaa: Køøre Amnön aput männö ki nyiwänni ma Tamar ki män mo dwøŋ døc; 'ba män mana männe ki nyiwänni ki gø aput tïmö ni dwøŋ døc ni kaala mëër mana mëëre ki gø. 'Ba Amnön aköö jï nyiwänni, ni «Ö maal; ci wøk.»
english: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

anywaa: 'Ba Tamar aköö jïre, ni «Jïra bäär; ki man riemmï aani, ï meeta gïna raac na nø tïïyï dëëra.» 'Ba Amnön ïthe käre ciiø ki dwør nyiwänni.
english: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

anywaa: Køøre Amnön, nyen wø bëëdö buute ni tïnynya eni acwøle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ennø, riem nyaanøgø wøk buuta, ni cïëgï dhi øtø.»
english: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyenøgø Tamar akïth wøk ni cïëk dhi øtø. 'Ba kar kaagø, Tamar oruyö ka abïï mo pere leth mo caala jalabiiya; kiper nyïï nyeya moa näk dëëtge poot kuc cwøwi, dëëtge wø runyge runynyö ki teeŋ abïïnögø.
english: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king's daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

anywaa: Køøre Tamar tør ajøøp wïïe, ni ö abïïne na näk ee røø dëëre ni jeec gø ki pänh cwïny, ni kwaa ceŋŋe wïïe ni aae, ni cäädhi ni göö ko oduuru.
english: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

anywaa: Køøre coki ma Abëcëlöm aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø, owäru ma Amnön anø tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëërï nø? 'Ba ennø, nya coka, lïŋï nø, Amnön ka owäru; luubö man kär kïth cwïnyï døc.» Køøre, Tamar aput bëëtö no owii kare po coki ma Abëcëlöm.
english: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee? but hold now thy peace, my sister: he is thy brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Deebit na wïny luummögø bäre, ena put gootø døc.
english: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm aput bëëtö ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø ka Amnön; kiper Abëcëlöm amännö døc ka Amnön kiper mana ö Amnönni na mak coki ma Tamar ki teek ni bute ki gø na dhaagø.
english: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri ariiø, ni jïëc dïëk mo Abëcëlöm di nyaarø paac mana cwøl ni Baal-Adhör buut ŋööm jø tuuŋ Ipariem, Abëcëlöm wäät nyeya bëët acwøle nee öge baŋ cam.
english: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king's sons.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm aö baŋ nyeya ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, jïëc dïëk 'moa di nyaarø; beerra man ööï ki jø kööre moï, nou cämu ki aani.»
english: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, thy servant hath sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech thee, and his servants go with thy servant.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeya jï Abëcëlöm, «Nyie wääda, ba løny, wa ba cii bëët, kiper wa tïmö ni wa thööth bäätï.» 'Ba këël na ö Abëcëlömmi na cwaat yi nyeya, nyeya kär jïëy ki man aae; 'ba Abëcëlöm agwïëdhe.
english: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto thee. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

anywaa: Køøre, Abëcëlöm aköö jï nyeya, «Ni näk miï ba ciï nø, a kwaya ïïni nee wa aacwa ko owära ma Amnön.» 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Abëcëlöm, na «?Aŋø, Amnön aae ki uuni aperŋø?»
english: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray thee, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with thee?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Abëcëlömmi na cwaat yi wänni ma nyeya, nyeya Amnön ki uutwänni bëët aput cïp nee aacge ka Abëcëlöm.
english: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.

anywaa: Køøre Abëcëlöm jiye aköömme ni kööe, ni «Ennø, kanyo ö Amnönni noo meere ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, kanyo kööa, ni ‹'Nägu eni›, eni wär putu 'näk. Kär nou lwäyö. ?Aŋø, u ba köömma aani? Magu rou, ni bëëdu nou teek.»
english: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark ye now when Amnon's heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

anywaa: Køøre jic Abëcëlöm, Amnön aputge 'näk kaawat mana ö Abëcëlömmi na kööm geni. Køøre wäät nyeya bëët aput päny maal, ni ö ŋati man nø ni eth bäät gääŋŋö mare ni putge reeŋø.
english: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king's sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge ena øtjöö, waac apïï baŋ nyeye ma Deebit ni køp, na «Abëcëlöm wäätï bëët anø nääe, ni bäŋ aciel mo dööŋ ni kwøw.»
english: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom hath slain all the king's sons, and there is not one of them left.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aput päny maal ni jeec abïïge, ni gøø ree piny ki pänh cwïny; ni ö jø kööre bëët moa en buute kaagø ni putge abïïkge jeeyø thuwø.
english: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönadap o Cimia, ni beeye Cimia cöök Deebiti, mare acaane ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, kärï cädö ni wäätï ge bëët geno nääö. Beeye Amnön keere na thøw; kiper beeye gïna en cwïny Abëcëlöm ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa ö coki ma Tamar na magi ya owänni ma Amnön ki teek ni bute ki gø na dhaagø.
english: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David's brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king's sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na nyeya, waac moa køp yøø, ni ‹Wäät nyeya ge bëët athøw,› kär kïth cwïnyï na adïëri, kiper beeye Amnön keere na thøw.»
english: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Abëcëlöm onø reeŋø. 'Ba kanya ö nyena kurö buut nyeya na tïŋ wïïe maal na lwïthe, ka adïëri møn, jiy mo thööth aput joot ni ge öö ni ge cura waŋjöö mana en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni ge lööny piny ka bäät kïdi. Ni ö ŋat koorri ni cøøe ni caan gø jï nyeya.
english: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jönadap aköö jï nyeya, ni «Neenï, ka adïëri møn, wäätï aöö; gïna caana, a na dhaanhnhï, athur kare.»
english: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king's sons come: as thy servant said, so it is.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jönadapi na leeŋ dhee piny ennø, ka adïëri møn, wäät nyeya aput nicäär, ni ge jwöŋö døc; ni ö nyeya ki jø kööre bëët ni putge jwøk døc thuwø.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king's sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm onø reeŋø ni ci baŋ Thalmay wär Ammiyut, nyeny jø Gëcur. 'Ba Deebit aput bëëtö ni kïmmö cooth kiper wääde.
english: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm aput bëëtö Gëcur ki cwiiri adäk.
english: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit atïmö ni cädö kiper wääde ma Abëcëlöm; kiper cwïnye acøme ki thøw wääde ma Amnön.
english: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

anywaa: 'Ba aŋäc Jöapi o Dheruya ni nyeya cwïnye ena køør Abëcëlöm døc.
english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king's heart was toward Absalom.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap ajääk baŋ dhaagø mo ena Tëköa mo waŋe riek, ni put dhaaŋŋøgø öö. Ni kö Jöapi jïgø, ni «Nyijøøe, tïïc riï niï kïmmö keda ï ena bäät thøø, ni kïthï dëërï ka abïïk thøø, ni ba wïïrï dëërï ki maaw; 'ba tïïc dëërï kaamar dhaagø mo oruu ni kïmmö kiper dhaanhø mo othøw.
english: And Joab sent to Tekoa, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray thee, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

anywaa: Køøre nø, wärï ci baŋ nyeya ni caanï luup jïre moo caana jïrï ennø.» Køøre Jöap luup moøgø aput cïp dhi nyijøøgø.
english: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijø Tëköa na ci baŋ nyeya, cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø, ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, køny aani.»
english: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø na tägö riï?» 'Ba aløk nyijøøgø jïre, na «Adïëri møn, aani, cwøra othøw, naa bëëdö ni aana cï thøø.
english: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and mine husband is dead.

anywaa: 'Ba a na dhaanhnhï da wääta ariiø. 'Ba obwöre moø na ariiø yøø, gena këëdö paap; 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo othääk ge. Kanyøgønø, dhaanhø aciel rege, coki agøøe ni 'näk gø.
english: And thy handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jø paara bëët gena ö maal bääta, a na dhaanhnhï, ni köge, ni ‹Cïp wäädï mana 'näk coki nee 'näkwa na kwör coki na nääe. Waani, wäädï manøgø na lwiidhø enøgø, 'näkwa nääö.› 'Ba geni, ge raanynya wïïa mana no odööŋ, nee cwøra dööŋe ni bäŋ wïïe mo dööŋ bäät piny.»
english: And, behold, the whole family is risen against thine handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï nyijøøgø, ni «Beerra man ciï paarï. Aani da gïn mo tïïa tïïö kiper luubö marï.»
english: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijø Tëköa manøgø aköö jï nyeya, «Wui nyeya, ni näk mo luummögø tïmö ni raac, ajäla mar luummögø puta tïmö ni ena bääta ki dhi øt wära; 'ba ï na nyeya këël ki nyec marï bäŋ ajäla bäätï.»
english: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father's house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö, ni «Ŋat mo poot bëëdö ni cwaata yiï kiper luummögø, wär käl baŋa, nee yiï ba cwaade këët.»
english: And the king said, Whosoever saith ought unto thee, bring him to me, and he shall not touch thee any more.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö, «Wui nyeya, beerra man kööŋï ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kiper nee jøø ni many gø nee kwör remø coolge enø nee ge ba cutge këët, ni ba raanyge jwïëc wääda.» 'Ba aløk nyeya jïre, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, bäŋ jëën wï wäädï aciel kiree mo päth piny.»
english: Then said she, I pray thee, let the king remember the Lord thy God, that thou wouldest not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As the Lord liveth, there shall not one hair of thy son fall to the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö, «Wui nyeya, naa cäänna ki luubö aciel keere.» Køøre nyeya aköö, ni «Caanï nø.»
english: Then the woman said, Let thine handmaid, I pray thee, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyijøøgø aköö, «?Wui nyeya, aŋø, teeŋ luum caana jïrï en tïmmï gø ŋø dëët jic Jwøk ni beege jø Icriel? ?A ki køør luubö mana nø caanï kawaane ennø, ï na nyeya, ï ba jääl dëërï keerï? Kiper wäädï mana reeŋø kärï wëënnö nee duu paac.
english: And the woman said, Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, øøni ø thøw kaawat man bëëde ni pïï mo oøøc piny ba løny ki jøøp këët. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk jwïëc dhaanhø ba raanynye; eni määnyö ki jöö nee dhaanhø mo oreeŋø ki køør gïna baae nee duu baŋe, ni ba bëëde ni tøør dëëre.
english: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither doth God respect any person: yet doth he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, gïna ööa kany kipere nee luummi en caana jïrï, ï na nyenynya, beeye ni jø paara aana tïïcge naa lwäya; ni beeye ni kööa ennø, ni ‹Beerra man cøøa nee luummi caana jï nyeya. Kanymør nyeya gïno pëënynya eni ki gø tïïe tïïö jïra.
english: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and thy handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

anywaa: Kiper nyeya luummi wïnynye wïnynyö ni piem aani ceŋ jøøa many jwïëcwa ki wääda, nee raanyge, nee wa tïmwa ni wa tøør bäät ŋöömma cïp Wuuö Jwøki.›
english: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

anywaa: «'Ba a na dhaanhnhï, aana köö, ni ‹Beerra man ö dwør nyenynya ni cøm cwïnya, kiper leec wïc mar nyeya caala leec wïc mar nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni løny jïre ki man ŋøl luubö mana beer ki mana raac. 'Ba ennø, ï na nyeya, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, bëëde ki ïïni na aciel.› »
english: Then thine handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore the Lord thy God will be with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeya ni kööe jï nyijøøgø, ni «Nyijøøe, gïno pëënynya ïïni ki gø en, kär mooŋï.» Ni kö nyijøøgø, «Wui nyeya, pëëï.»
english: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray thee, the thing that I shall ask thee. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya, ni «?Luubö man bäre en, cer Jöap ba en yie wän?» 'Ba aløk nyijøøgø ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, ŋëëtï keerï, mana caanï enøgø beeye kare. Ka adïëri møn, beeye dhaanhnhï ma Jöap na kööm aani, ni beeye eni na cïp luubö man bäre en dhaa, a na dhaanhnhï.
english: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this? And the woman answered and said, As thy soul liveth, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken: for thy servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid:

anywaa: Dhaanhnhï ma Jöap gïn en atïïe ni tiira luubö man. 'Ba ï na nyeya mara, wïïï leer kaamar nyïïatwiel maal mar Jwøk, ni jammi bëët mo wø en bäät piny ŋäyï.»
english: To fetch about this form of speech hath thy servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are in the earth.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya, Jöap acwøle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Neenï, ka adïëri møn, gïnögø ni manynyï enø tïïa tïïö; ennø, ci baŋ Abëcëlöm ni duuï gø paac.»
english: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap cøŋŋe aput këël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni pwøc nyeya; køøre Jöap aköö, «Wui nyeya, dïcäŋi aŋääa ni yiï met ki aani møn, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper na nø jïëyï gïna pëënynya ïïni ki gø.»
english: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight, my lord, O king, in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap aput ö maal ni ci Gëcur baŋ Abëcëlöm, ni duu gø Jerucalem.
english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Beerra man døø Abëcëlömmi paare, 'ba kär täärnyïme jooda kany.» Kanyøgønø Abëcëlöm aput døø paare; 'ba täärnyïm nyeya käre joodø.
english: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king's face.

anywaa: 'Ba ki dï Icriel bäre bäŋ ŋat mo kïte mïërö mo opwøc jiyi døc mo caala Abëcëlöm. Ki mana täge ki tiete këël mana pïïe wïïe bäŋ gïn mo di jøøŋŋø dëëre.
english: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm jïëye thööth døc; 'ba ki yi cwiir cooth wø di nyaarø kiper man wø tïmge ni thööth ni peek. 'Ba kany wø rømi, tïmö na rumme ma dïpe ariiø mar rumi mana cwøl ni cekel.
english: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year's end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king's weight.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm jïre da wääte adäk ki nyaare aciel mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Tamar; 'ba Tamar beeye nyaan mo kïte mïërö.
english: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm abëëdö Jerucalem ki cwiiri ariiø, ni täärnyïm nyeya käre joodø.
english: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king's face.

anywaa: Køøre Abëcëlöm ajääk baŋ Jöap, nee Jöap jääŋŋe baŋ nyeya; 'ba Jöap yie kär met ki man ö baŋe. Køøre ena cäŋ jääk bäŋ Jöap ri rietge; 'ba Jöap yie poot ba met ki man ööe.
english: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abëcëlöm aköö jï jiye, ni «Neennu, pwöth Jöap ena buut pwötha, ni eni jïre da gäbci yi pwöthe kaace; cou ni waaŋŋu pwöthe.» Køøre jic Abëcëlöm pwöth Jöap aputge waaŋ.
english: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap aö maal, ni ci baŋ Abëcëlöm paare ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aŋø, jiyï waaŋge pwödhö mara aperŋø?»
english: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have thy servants set my field on fire?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Abëcëlömmi jï Jöap, ni «Neenï, aana jääk baŋï ki dhaanhø kiper niï ööï, niï jääŋŋa baŋ nyeya, nee caanï jïre na Abëcëlöm aköö, ni ‹Aano ööma ŋø ki Gëcur? ?Aŋø, ba beerra mana daa poodø naa ena kunece na bëëde?› 'Ba ennø, ï na Jöap en, a manynya man jooda täärnyïm nyeya; ni näk mo da gïn mo yaa baaø, beerra man ö nyeya ni 'näk aani.»
english: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto thee, saying, Come hither, that I may send thee to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king's face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi na ö baŋ nyeya na caan luummögø jïgø, nyeya Abëcëlöm aput cwøl. Ni ö Abëcëlömmi baŋ nyeya ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm nyeya; ni ö nyeya ni nuum dha Abëcëlöm ni määtha gø.
english: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Abëcëlöm amäänyö ki jääy man wø tut okweenynyi, ko okwëënyi, ni määnye ki jiy ma pïërabïïc nee bëëtge na jiy mo wø rïïŋi nyïm jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi.
english: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm wø laara päny maal ka amöölla cøøn, ni ci waŋ jöör kar løøk ni cuŋŋe kaace. 'Ba kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo öö mo lööŋŋö baŋ nyeya, Abëcëlöm ŋateca wø pute ka cwøl, ni kööe jïgø, «?Aŋø, ïïno käla yi päänye mane?» 'Ba ŋateca wø puta köö, «Wui o nyeya, aana dhaanhø aciel røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.»
english: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city art thou? And he said, Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Abëcëlöm wø köö jï ŋateca, ni «Neenï, luubö marï beer ni tiir. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo cega ïthe ki marï røk jø wø ŋøl luup jï nyeya.»
english: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, Abëcëlöm wø köö, ni «Doo na aano tïïö na dïŋut luup yi paani en, doo beer. Ŋata wø doo öö ni jïre da luum løøk, doo na ööa baŋa. Køøre aani luum ŋateca wø daa puta ŋøl ni tiir kiree.»
english: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which hath any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø tägi, kany wø näk mo da dhaanhø mo ööa buute ni manynya man këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïme ni määtha eni, eni cere wø pute ka rwaak baŋ ŋateca ni gääm gø ni nuum dhi gø.
english: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm aput bëëtö ni tïïya teeŋ tïïc manøgø jï jø Icriel bëët mo wø ö kar ŋøl luup mar nyeya; ni ö Abëcëlömmi ni put cwïny jø Icriel løø baŋe.
english: And on this manner did Absalom to all Israel that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri aŋween, Abëcëlöm aköö jï nyeya, na «A kwaya ïïni naa cøøa Keeprön, nee kööŋ mara mana nø kööŋa kipere jï Wuuö Jwøk, nee wëëga thur kare.
english: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray thee, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto the Lord, in Hebron.

anywaa: Kiper aano kööŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk kanya bëëda Gëcur na en Aram, ni kööa, ‹Ni näk mo Wuuö Jwøk a dwøge Jerucalem ni dëëra jööt, ka adïëri møn, a puta ci Keeprön ni cïpa ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If the Lord shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï Abëcëlöm, ni «Ciï ki jööt dëël.» Kanyøgønø, Abëcëlöm aput tïŋŋö ni aae ni ci Keeprön.
english: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm jiy ajääŋŋe ki piny ni cige baŋ wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, ni kööe, ni «Kanyo wïnynyu dwør tuuŋ kiree ennø, wäru putu kwöŋŋö ni kööu, ni ‹Abëcëlöm atïmö na nyeya yi Keeprön.› »
english: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet, then ye shall say, Absalom reigneth in Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïŋ Abëcëlömmi ki yi Jerucalem, eni cäädhi ki jiy ma dïpe ariiø mo ee cwølø kiper cam kar lam, ni jøøgø cäädhi ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge, ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge na bäre kiper acaara mar Abëcëlöm.
english: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde na Abëcëlöm cïpö ko olämme, ena jääk baŋ Akithöpël poge Gilø, ni beeye nyen wø køny nyeya ma Deebit ka acaare. 'Ba ageem manøgø aput tïmö ni teek, kiper jiy moa caath køør Abëcëlöm rege ameetge ni tïmge ni ge thööth.
english: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø mør mo di jääŋŋö aö baŋ Deebit, ni kööe, ni «Jø Icriel cwïnyge anø løøge baŋ Abëcëlöm.»
english: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï jø kööre moe bëët moa bëëdö ki eni Jerucalem kaagø, ni «Laaru ö maal, ø waa reeŋø; kiper ni näk mo ø ba reŋi, bäŋ ŋat mo bøth dëëtø ki gïno tïïc Abëcëlömmi. Läädu; kanymør eni laara rïŋŋö ni maa øøni kany, ni put tïïö ki gïn mo leth dëëtø, ni put jiy mo thööth 'näk dï pääny jaak.»
english: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

anywaa: Køøre jø kööre mo nyeya aköö jï nyeya, «Neenï, wa na jiyï, dëëtwa ewa nø jek ki gïno jierï jaak, ï na nyeya marwa.»
english: And the king's servants said unto the king, Behold, thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya adøny wøk, ni jøøa en paan dwøŋ bëët cäädhi ka eni. 'Ba nyeya, määre apaar awiie nee paan dwøŋ koorge.
english: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni døny wøk, ni jiy bëët moa en buute cäädhi ka eni; 'ba kanya pïïcge buut øtø mana en deŋ kiir, gena cuŋŋö.
english: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jø kööre moe bëët atïïe nee pöönhge ki nyïme; këël jø leny bëët mo wø koor eni, ni beege jø Kelita, ki jø Pelita, ki jø leny moa näk dïpe abïciel moa cäädhe ki geni kanya ööe ki Gëth, atïïe nee pöönhge ki nyïme thuwø.
english: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï Itay nyï Gëth, «?Aŋø, ïïni thuwø, ï aay ki waani? Døøgï ni bëëdï ki nyeya ma Abëcëlöm, kiper ïïna jur ni pou iï nø wec. Døøgï nø ni pïï piny kar bëëtö marï.
english: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore goest thou also with us? return to thy place, and abide with the king: for thou art a stranger, and also an exile.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï ba ööï ka awääre jaak en? ?A aani, dïcäŋi ennø a doo köö niï wïdö ki waani na aciel, ni mara thääyö jaak? Ennø, døøgï ki jø tuuŋu ni pïïu piny paac; Jwøk mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri mare obëëdö ki ïïni.»
english: Whereas thou camest but yesterday, should I this day make thee go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return thou, and take back thy brethren: mercy and truth be with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Itay jï nyeya, ni kööe, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, ki ŋëëtï ï na nyeya; ka adïëri møn, kanyo bëëdï yie, ï na nyeya mara, niï bëëdö ki bëët kwøw wala bëët thøø, aano bëëdö yie thuwø, a na dhaanhnhï.»
english: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As the Lord liveth, and as my lord the king liveth, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will thy servant be.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Itay nyï Gëth, «Wøp, pöödhï nø.» Ni ö Itayi ni put pöödhö ni cäädhi ka jiye bëët këël mään ko obwöre moge bëët.
english: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na tïïc jiy bëët moa cäädhö ki eni nee pöönhge ki nyïme, jiy bëët moa en yi pääny kaagø ge bëëdö ni ge göö ko oduuru. 'Ba nyeya thuwø aput läp køørge ni ŋølge naam mana cwøl ni Kidaran, ni ö jiyi bëët ni putge aay ni ge cøra jööra näk coonya dï paap.
english: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Dhadök ka Abiethaar na näk Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø, ge nut kaagø ki jø tuuŋ Libay bëët; ni jø tuuŋ Libay acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy käärge käärö. 'Ba geni acanduk mar Jwøk acïpge piny, ni bëët acanduki kaagø këël mana thum jiyi bëët ki ööny wøk ki yi pääny.
english: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of God: and they set down the ark of God; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jï Dhadök, na «Acanduk mar Jwøk dwøk yi pääny. Kanymør Wuuö Jwøk met ec mare nyoodhe nyoodhø jïra, ni cäŋ aani duu kany, ni cäŋ a tïïyö na acanduk mare ki kar bëëtö mare jooda.
english: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the Lord, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo eno köö ni yie ba met ki aani, ka adïëri møn, a nutö; beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gïna manynye dëëra.»
english: But if he thus say, I have no delight in thee; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seemeth good unto him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyeya köö jï Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, na «?Aŋø, ï paa ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki? Ïïni ki wäädï ma Akimaath ki Jönathan wär Abiethaar døøu pääny ki jööt dëël.
english: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

anywaa: Neenï, aani, a kurö dï paap bäät naam kanya näk dïët ki caara këël kanyo dee dwøl mo wïnynya wïnynyö baŋï.»
english: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Dhadök ka Abiethaar, acanduk mar Jwøk aputge dwøk yi Jerucalem ni putge bëëtö kaace.
english: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of God again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aput aay ni cør jöör Kïn Ølip, ni cäädhi ni jwöŋö, ni wïïe ee loobø, ni cäädhi ka thäny tiete jaak. Køøre jiy bëët moa cäädhö ki eni, ŋati man nø wïïe aput loop, ni cääthge ni ge jwöŋö.
english: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan dhaanhe mørri jï Deebit ni kööe, na «Akithöpël, ena dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa tuut dhøkge bäätï na no odwätö ka Abëcëlöm.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput lämö jï Jwøk ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, akwaya ïïni, tïïc acaara mar Akithöpël ni bäŋ tiere.»
english: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Lord, I pray thee, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya tïme ni Deebit pïï wï kïdi, buut kany wø wøør Jwøk yie, ka adïëri møn, gena put røømmø ki Ucay nyï Arki, na abïï mare ee jeeyø, ni wïïe ee jööpö ki tør ki pänh cwïny.
english: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped God, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Ucay, «Ni näk miï cäädhö køøra ni aayï ki aani, ï tïmö niï caala tëër mo peek kipera.
english: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï døøa yi pääny, ni cäänï ka Abëcëlöm, ni kööï, ‹Wui, nyeya, aani a manynya man tïma ni aana dhaanhnhï; kaawat mana bëëda ni aana dhaanh wäru ki yïth nïra pöödhö, ennø a manynya man tïma ni aana dhaanhnhï møn;› køøre nø, otïmö ni løny jïrï ki man kønyï aani, ni tïïyï acaara mar Akithöpël nee ba thur kare.
english: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father's servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

anywaa: ?A Dhadök ka Abiethaar na näk Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø, u ba bëëdö ka geni paac kunece? Kanyo dee gïn mo wïnynyï wïnynyö jaak paan dwøŋ mar nyeya, ï doo puta cøø ni caanï gø jï Dhadök ka Abiethaar na näk Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø.
english: And hast thou not there with thee Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever thou shalt hear out of the king's house, thou shalt tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

anywaa: Neenï, wäätge karge riet nut buutge paac kunece, ni beege Akimaath o Dhadök ki Jönathan wär Abiethaar; 'ba gïno wïnynyï jaak løny jïrï ki man cïbï dwøl maneca dhøkge ni jääŋŋï geni baŋa.»
english: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Ucay nyawat Deebiti aput døø yi pääny. 'Ba kar kaagø, Abëcëlöm aput pïï paac yi Jerucalem.
english: So Hushai David's friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na løøc piny ki wï Kïn Ølip, Dhiba ŋat tïïc mar Mepiböcëth onø møør piny nee røømge ki Deebit ni eni käädö ka arëëni ariiø mo ee jiiŋŋø nee cäädhö ki bäätge, ni dïŋäthge ee töönynyö ki jammi; ni jammi moa en bäätge beege dääpe ma dïpe ariiø, ki nyïïomøki moa no otal mo omiiø na dhøgi ma dïpa, ki teeŋ nyïï jenni møøk mo otal mo omiiø na dhøgi ma dïpa, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo ena ya agwäy.
english: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jï Dhiba, «?Aŋø, gïï bëët ii kïthï ge kaa?» 'Ba Dhiba aköö, na «Arëëni beege kiper jø paarï, ï na nyeya, nee ge cääthge ki bäätge. 'Ba dääpe ki nyïï jenni beege kiper jaay moa cäädhö ki ïïni nee camge. 'Ba køøŋ nyïïomøki beeye kiper ŋato ööl waŋjöö dï paap nee mäthe.»
english: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeya jï Dhiba ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, Mepiböcëth, nyikwaar ŋata bëënnï, en kaa?» Køøre Dhiba aköö jï nyeya ma Deebit, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ena dööŋ Jerucalem, kiper ena köö, ni ‹Yïth nïri, jø Icriel nyec mar wära dwøkge kare jïra.› »
english: And the king said, And where is thy master's son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abideth at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jï Dhiba, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jammi bëët mo Mepiböcëth cøøa jïrï.» 'Ba Dhiba aköö, «Wui nyeya, aana dhaanhnhï møn; beerra man bëët iï ni met ki aani.»
english: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Deebit na pïïe buut Baurim, ka adïëri møn, nyen mør mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Cimiy o Gëra, mo käla ri jø dhi øt Cøøl, aput ö wøk ki kaace, ni cäädhi ni janynya Deebit.
english: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, Deebit ki jø kööre moe bëët athööye ki kïte; 'ba kar kaagø, jø leny bëët ge cäädhi ni nyeya ege kïth dïër, ni jøw møøk ena bäät cwïïc ni møøk ena bäät caam.
english: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moa car Cimiy kanya jany Deebit beege ii, ena köö, «Nyie dïnääy, ŋata wïïe raac, ciï, put aay nø.
english: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, thou bloody man, and thou man of Belial:

anywaa: Kwör rem jiy moa køny piny acool Wuuö Jwøki dëërï, ni beege jiy moa käl ri dhi øt Cøøl na läwï kare na tïmï ni ïïna nyeya. 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk nyec marï anø cïbe jï wäädï ma Abëcëlöm. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ï ränynyö ennø, kiper ïïna dïnääy.»
english: The Lord hath returned upon thee all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead thou hast reigned; and the Lord hath delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom thy son: and, behold, thou art taken in thy mischief, because thou art a bloody man.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abicay o Dheruya aköö jï nyeya, na «?Aŋø, nyen caal gwök mo othøw en jany ï aperŋø? Wëëk a naa cøøa baŋe kaace, nee wïïe ŋula wøk.»
english: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray thee, and take off his head.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeya jï Abicay ni kööe, «?Nyie wäät Dheruya, agïnaŋø noo tïïa ki uuni nø? Këël eni doo jädö, kanymør caana Wuuö Jwøki jïre, ni ‹Ci jany Deebit.› ?Aŋø, aŋa noo köö ki eni, ni ‹?Ï tïmmï ŋø ki gïn?› »
english: And the king said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because the Lord hath said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore hast thou done so?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit acäŋ köö jï Abicay ki jï jø kööre moe bëët, ni «Neennu, këël wääda na käl dëëra kiree manynya man raany jwïëya. ?A nyï tuuŋ Benjamen man, kääŋe ki man tïïe ki gïrpiny dëëra nidïï? Wiiu eni kare nee jäde; kanymør caana Wuuö Jwøki jïre.
english: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeketh my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for the Lord hath bidden him.

anywaa: Kanymør thuwø Wuuö Jwøk caannø man caan a ki gø en di neenø ni tïïe ki gïn mo beer jïra na kar ajaany man jany aani ki gø dïcäŋi en.»
english: It may be that the Lord will look on mine affliction, and that the Lord will requite me good for his cursing this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit ki jiye gena put aay; 'ba Cimiy aput aay ni cäädhi ka deŋ kïdi ni dïët ki Deebit. 'Ba eni cäädhi ni janynya Deebit, ni di thööyö ki kïte, ni di jørø ki ŋøøm.
