english: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ki jiy bëët moa cäädhö ki eni, gena pïï kanya cige yie ni geno ööl. Køøre Deebit dëëre ajwöme kaace.
english: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk ee käl dëëre, gena pïï Jerucalem. 'Ba kar kaagø, Akithöpël ena dï jøøgø thuwø.
english: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Israel, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyawat Deebiti ma Ucay nyï Arki na ö baŋ Abëcëlöm, ena köö jï Abëcëlöm, ni «Nyeya puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!»
english: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm aköö jï Ucay, «?Aŋø, beeye mëër man wø nyoothï jï nyawadu enø obëëde? ?Aperŋø na ba aayï ki nyawadu?»
english: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this thy kindness to thy friend? why wentest thou not with thy friend?

anywaa: 'Ba Ucay aköö jï Abëcëlöm, ni «Ba løny. Kiper ŋat mo ojier Wuuö Jwøki, ki jøøi, këël jø Icriel bëët, beeye ŋat ena løøe, ni puta bëëtö ki eni.
english: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom the Lord, and this people, and all the men of Israel, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

anywaa: ?A aani, aana da tïnynya ŋa cøøn? ?Aŋø, paa o nyeya mara cøøn na da tïnynyö? Kaawat mana tïnynya wäru, ennø, a puta bëëtö ki ïïni thuwø.»
english: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Abëcëlöm acäänö ka Akithöpël kiper bëët paac ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø ennø? Caan acaara marï.»
english: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

anywaa: 'Ba Akithöpël aköö jï Abëcëlöm, ni «Ci baŋ määr wäru, moa no odööŋ ni ge koora paac, ni buudï ki geni; køøre wïny jø Icrielli bëët wïnynyö ni ïïni riï iï nø tïïc kaamar gïn mo ŋwäänynye raac jï wäru. Køøre nø, jiy moi bëët ni bëëdö ki ïïni en, ge puta tëënnö thuwø.»
english: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto thy father's concubines, which he hath left to keep the house; and all Israel shall hear that thou art abhorred of thy father: then shall the hands of all that are with thee be strong.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, oduŋkaara aput maa piny jï Abëcëlöm wï øtø maal, ni ö Abëcëlömmi ni ci baŋ määr wänni ni buude ki geni ni nëënö jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögø, acaare mo wø cïp Akithöpëlli di jïëö ni nëëni keda luubö mo opëënynyö baŋ Jwøk. 'Ba Deebit ki wääde ma Abëcëlöm ge ŋäätha acaare mo Akithöpël.
english: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, Akithöpël aköö jï Abëcëlöm, «A jëëdö ki jø leny ma kume apaar kurriiø naa läpa køør Deebit dïwääni.
english: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pïïa ree ni eno ööl ni dëëre ba løny køny jïre, eni puta lwäyö døc, ni ö jiyi bëët moa en buute ni putge bwøk. Køøre nø, eni puta dööŋŋö keere ni puta gø 'näk;
english: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

anywaa: ni ö jiyi bëët ni puta ge duu baŋï. 'Ba kanyo nø thøw ŋata manynyï keere, jiy bëët duuö møn; ni jït paaci ki bëët mëër.»
english: And I will bring back all the people unto thee: the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abëcëlöm ki jø døøk Icriel bëët yïthge aput tïmö ni met ka acaara manøgø.
english: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Abëcëlöm aköö, ni «Ucay nyï Arki cwøl thuwø, nee dwøre mano caane nee wïnynyø.»
english: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he saith.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ucayi na ö baŋ Abëcëlöm, Abëcëlöm aköö jïgø, na «Akithöpël acaara man anø caane jïwa. ?Ennø, kïthwa acaara man bäät tïïc? Ni näk mo paa kare, caan marï.»
english: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak thou.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Ucay aköö jï Abëcëlöm, «Acaara mana cïp Akithöpëlli yie man keere, paa acaara ma wøp.»
english: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Ucayi köö, ni «Ïïni, bëët wäru ki jø leny moe ŋäyï døc, ki man näk mo gena jø leny mo teek ni cwïnyge keec kaamar ŋuu mo nyïïe okälö ki teek dï paap. Këël wäru thuwø, beeye ŋat mo oŋïyö ki leny, ni ba løny ki man but dï jiy jaak.
english: For, said Hushai, thou knowest thy father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and thy father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

anywaa: Neenï, kawaane en, kanymør wäru ree ee nø kan yi øt kïdi aciel røk uut kïte moa en kunece, wala ree ee kanø kany mør jaak mo kuc. 'Ba ni näk mo jø leny moï okwøŋ Deebiti tuk møn, jøw owïny gø bëët ge puta köö, ni ‹Jiy mo thööth athøw røk jøøa cäädhö køør Abëcëlöm.›
english: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever heareth it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba këël da ŋat leny mo teek, mo thwønh mare caala thwønh mar ŋuu, eni cwïnye puta bwøk døc; kiper ŋäc jø Icrielli bëët ni wäru beeye ŋat leny mo teek, ni jø leny moe beege jiy mo teek døc ki leny.
english: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø møn, acaara mara beeye ki man cwölï jø Icriel bëët baŋï, ki mano täge ki Daan këël mano këët Bëërcïïba, nee jiy tïmge ni thööth døc kaamar nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ, ni ö ïïni ki dëërï kiree ni ciï baŋ leny ni jøøgø bwøtha ïïni.
english: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ø puta pïï ree ni joodø eni kanyo näk ree ee kanø yie, ni putø eni tuk ni ø thööth døc kaawat man wø ö rwöci wø ö piny; 'ba eni ki jø leny moa en buute bëët, puta tïmö ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo bøth këël dhaanhø aciel.
english: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da pääny mo eni reŋŋa yie, ø na jø Icriel bëët en, pääny maneca putø ka wïr ki thøøli ni gøø gø piny, këël mano leeŋø gø ya agäm-kïdi mano en buute kaace, ni ö kar pääny manøgø ni dööŋe ni leer ni bäŋ waŋ kïdi mo joot yie këël mo thiinh.»
english: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

anywaa: Køøre Abëcëlöm ki jø Icriel bëët gena köö, na «Acaara mar Ucay nyï Arki beerra eni døc ni kaala acaara mar Akithöpël.» 'Ba gïnögø bäre tïïya Wuuö Jwøki na acaara mar Akithöpël na beer tïme ni bäŋ tiere, nee eni na Wuuö Jwøk gïn mo leth tïïe dëër Abëcëlöm.
english: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the Lord had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the Lord might bring evil upon Absalom.

anywaa: Køøre Ucay aci baŋ Dhadök ka Abiethaar na näk Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø, ni caan acaara mar Akithöpël mana caane jï Abëcëlöm ki jø døøk Icriel, ni caan acaara mare thuwø.
english: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel; and thus and thus have I counselled.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena köö, ni «Ennø, laaru jääk baŋ Deebit, ni caannu gø jïre ni kööu, ni ‹Dïwääni kärï but dï paap bäät naam kanya näk dïët ki caara, 'ba ï na nyeya, ï doo ŋuta løøga, kiper ni näk miï kär ŋut løøga, ïïni ki jø leny bëët moø en buutï yøø, wïthu dïdö.› »
english: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan ka Akimaath, ge na wäät Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø, ge bëëdö ni ge kurö bäät jøøro mana cwøl na Ayn-Rögëël, kiper ge ba many gø nee ge joot ni ge dønynya yi pääny. 'Ba da ŋat tïïc ma dhaagø mo wø cøø ni caan gïïa tägö jïge, nee tïme ni løny jï jagøgø ki man cige ni caange gø jï Deebit.
english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mo jagøgø ee joodø, ni cøøe ni waac gø jï Abëcëlöm. Kanyøgønø, jagøgø karge riet gena laar reeŋø ni cige Baurim baŋ nyen mør mo jïre da iith yi kal mare, ni putge døny yie ni ge kana rege.
english: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man's house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø mana en kaace, rëëbi alwøre ni rïëp gø bäät iith, ni määc beel yi rëëbi manøgø kiper nee bäŋe ŋat mo dïëta gø.
english: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

anywaa: Køøre jic Abëcëlöm aö baŋ dhaagø manøgø paare ni köge, «?Aŋø, Akimaath ki Jönathan enge kaa?» 'Ba dhaagø manøgø aköö jïge, ni «Gena nø kath løøga ni aacge.» 'Ba kanya ö jic Abëcëlömmi na määnyge, Jönathan ka Akimaath kärge joodø, ni putge døø paac yi Jerucalem.
english: And when Absalom's servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni jic Abëcëlöm onø aay, Jönathan ka Akimaath gena put duny wøk ki yi iith ni cige ni caange dwøl jï nyeya ma Deebit, ni köge, ni «Ö maal ni laarï ŋut løø naam løøga, kiper Akithöpël acaara mo raac anø caane kiperï.»
english: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ki jiy bëët moa cäädhe ki geni, gena put ö maal ni ŋølge Naam Jördan. 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na amöölla, bäŋ dhaanhø mo odööŋ ni Naam Jördan käre ŋølø.
english: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya Akithöpëlli ni køør acaara mare kär caadhø, arëën mare ajiiŋŋe ni tïŋŋe ni ci paare na en pääny poge, ni jiiŋ jap paare na karge, ni put ree lïër ni thøøe. Køøre ena kïth yi bwörö mar wänni.
english: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit onø pïï pääny mana cwøl ni Maanayim. Ni ö Abëcëlömmi ni put Naam Jördan ŋøl, ni beeye eni ki jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët.
english: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Israel with him.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm Amaaca acuume na kwääy lwaa leny na kar Jöap. 'Ba Amaaca wänni beeye Jëtër nyï Icmiel, ni beeye Jëtër na ci baŋ Abigël nyi Naøc na dhaagø. 'Ba Abigël beeye cöök Dheruya mana näk dhaagø, ni beeye Dheruya mii Jöapi.
english: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man's son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab's mother.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm ki jø leny mo jø Icriel twïër marge atïïcge yi ŋööm Gelät.
english: So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na pïïe Maanayim, Cööbi o Naøc, ŋat mo käla pääny jø Amön mana cwøl ni Raaba, ki Makir wär Amiel, ŋat mo käla pääny mana cwøl ni Lödebaar, ki Bardhilay nyï Gelät, mo käla pääny mana cwøl ni Rögelim,
english: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo–debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

anywaa: gena kännö ki jap niine, ka athääe, ki dääe, ki beel, ni beege cïndë ki gäbci, ki muunni, ki beel mo omuuö, ki ŋööri, ka adaci,
english: Brought beds, and basins, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

anywaa: ki maar kïc, ki caak ma dïïle, ki dïëk, ki mäth dhäk. 'Ba caammi moøgø bëët kälge jï Deebit ki jøøa cäädhe ki geni nee camge. Kiper gena köö, ni «Jiy oööl, ni geno 'näk käci ki riew dï paap.»
english: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit jø leny moa en buute kaagø akwaane ni röönye jïge ki kwääc lwaae mo wø käär jiy ma kume ki mo wø käär jiy ma dïpe.
english: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit jø leny moe apääŋŋe na dhøgi adäk. Ni mooc kwääy lwaa leny ma Jöap ki dhøk aciel, ni mooc kwääy lwaa leny ma Abicay, cöök Jöapi o Dheruya, ki dhøk aciel, ni mooc kwääy lwaa leny ma Itay nyï Gëth ki dhøk aciel. 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit aköö jï jø leny, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani ki dëëra a aa baŋ leny ki uuni na aciel.»
english: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny aköö, ni «Ïïni, ï ba ci baŋ leny; kiper ni näk mo wa reeŋø, jøw këëdø ki geni, ge ba cädö kiperwa. Këël mo ge 'näga jiy mo thööth døc dëëtwa, ge ba cädö kiperwa na bäre. 'Ba ïïni, perï leth døc ni kaala jiy ma kume apaar røkwa. 'Ba ennø, beerra man kønyï waani niï ena yi pääny kany.»
english: But the people answered, Thou shalt not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now thou art worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jïge, ni «Gïna beerra eni ki jïïu jaak, tïïa tïïö.» Køøre nyeya acuŋŋö dhi kiir, ni ö jø lenynyi bëët ni cige wøk ni ge cäädhi na lwaae ma dïpe ki ma kume.
english: And the king said unto them, What seemeth you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit, Jöap ka Abicay ki Itay aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Cädu kipera; kär nou tïïya wääda ma Abëcëlöm ki gïn mo leth.» 'Ba jø leny bëët luubö mana ö nyeya na kööm kwääc lwaae mo leny ki gø kiper Abëcëlöm wïnyö jïge.
english: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny gena aa wøk baŋ leny ki jø Icriel, ni ö lenynyi ni këëli yi lur Ipariem.
english: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel gena put jø lenynyi mo Deebit böötö. 'Ba jiy moa 'näk kaace dïcäŋeca thööth, ni beege jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø.
english: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba leny mana en kaace aput nyaa wøk, ni ö jø lenynyi mo thööth ni thøøge yi lul dïcäŋeca ni kaala jiy moa thøw ri leny.
english: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, Abëcëlöm anigäk ki jø leny mo Deebit. 'Ba kar kaagø, Abëcëlöm cäädhi ka bäät gääŋŋö mare. Køøre gääŋŋö areeŋø ni dønye ki tier jaath mo dwøŋ mo bääte onilway piny. Ni ö wï Abëcëlömmi ni puti ya bäät jaadhøgø mak, ni put dööŋŋö ni lïërö kaace. 'Ba gääŋŋö mana cäädhe ki bäät gø aput reeŋø.
english: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dhaanhø aciel na joot Abëcëlöm, acaane jï Jöap ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Abëcëlöm ajooda ni lïërö tier jaath kaace.»
english: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap aköö jï ŋata caan luummögø jïre, ni «?Ka adïëri møn, Abëcëlöm ajootï? ?Aŋø na ba putï gø 'näk kaace en? Aani, gwet-bïrö ma apaar ki kaw mar leny doo na yaa cïbö jïrï en.»
english: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, thou sawest him, and why didst thou not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given thee ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø aköö jï Jöap, ni «Këël mo gwet-bïrö ma kuma ocïp cera cøøn, aani, cera ba daa kïtha dëër o nyeya; kiper ïïni ka Abicay ki Itay uuna kööm nyeya ni wïnyö jïwa, ni kööe, ni ‹Gwøgu wääda ma Abëcëlöm jïra.›
english: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

anywaa: A ni näk mo aano tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëëre nø, ni ö nyeya ni wïny gïnögø, kiper bäŋ gïn mooŋ ki nyeya, ïïni ki dëërï, karï tïïyï tïïö ni bäär ki aani.»
english: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against mine own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and thou thyself wouldest have set thyself against me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap aköö, ni «Piny ba dhïëra ki ïïni këët.» Kanyøgønø, theri adäk aput lwør ni ci baŋ Abëcëlöm ni këër gø ki bäät wenynye na Abëcëlöm poot kwøw bäät jaath kaace.
english: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with thee. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

anywaa: 'Ba jaga na apaar ni wø käär jap leny jï Jöap rege aput cooŋ deŋ Abëcëlöm ni cööpge gø ni putge gø 'näk.
english: And ten young men that bare Joab's armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap tuuŋ aput kooth, ni ö jø lenynyi ni duuge ki kuna ŋwiecge køør jø Icriel, kiper gena män Jöapi ki man ŋwiecge køørge.
english: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.

anywaa: Køøre jø leny mo Deebit dëër Abëcëlöm alwørge ni leeŋge gø yi buur mo bäär kaace yi lul, ni löörge kïte mo thööth bääte. 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel moa cäädhö køør Abëcëlöm gena bwøk, ni ö ŋati man nø ni reŋ paare.
english: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Israel fled every one to his tent.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm, kanya poode ni kwøw, okwøŋ cööth piny ki kïdi na nyuudhi kiper dëëre yi gool mar nyeya, kiper ena köö, ni «Aani, bäŋ wääda mo cwøl nyeŋŋa ree.» Kanyøgønø, eni kïdi manøgø na nyuudhi enø aput caa ri nyeŋŋe, ni puti cwøl ni Kïn Abëcëlöm këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.

anywaa: Køøre Akimaath o Dhadök aköö, ni «Beerra man reeŋa nee waac caana jï nyeya ki man näk mo eno piem Wuuö Jwøki ceŋ nyïïmän moe.»
english: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that the Lord hath avenged him of his enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap aköö jïgø, ni «Ŋato cii nee waac man caane dïcäŋi paa ïïni; ïïno jïti ki waac mør mo waayï yi nyïme. Kär dee gïn mo waayï dïcäŋi, kiper o nyeya othøw.»
english: And Joab said unto him, Thou shalt not bear tidings this day, but thou shalt bear tidings another day: but this day thou shalt bear no tidings, because the king's son is dead.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aköö jï nyï Kuuc, ni «Ci kuna caanï gïna jootï jï nyeya.» Kanyøgønø, nyï Kuuc cøŋŋe aput këël piny nyïm Jöap, ni put ö maal ni reeŋe.
english: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

anywaa: 'Ba Akimaath o Dhadök acäŋ köö jï Jöap, na «A kwaya ïïni naa reŋŋa køør nyï Kuuc. Nee da gïn mo tägö, bäŋ gïre.» 'Ba Jöap aköö, na «?Aŋø nyie wääda, ï reŋŋï baŋ ŋø? Ï këël doo cøø, kee bäŋ gïn mo magï ree.»
english: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray thee, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore wilt thou run, my son, seeing that thou hast no tidings ready?

anywaa: 'Ba Akimaath aköö, ni «Bäŋ gïre jaak, gïno tägi täge, aani, a reeŋø.» Kanyøgønø, Jöap aköö jïgø, ni «Ci reŋï nø.» Køøre Akimaath aput reeŋø ki waŋjöör Goor Jördan, ni put nyï Kuuc kaal.
english: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Deebit opï piny dhi kiir. Køøre ŋat wø kurö aeth bäät kiir, ni tïŋ wïïe maal ni räŋŋe. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, dhaanhø mo rïïŋa eni keere aput joot ni rïŋŋö.
english: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋat koor manøgø aput cwötö ni caan gø jï nyeya. Køøre nyeya aköö, «Ni näk mo ŋatøgø rïŋŋa eni keere, beeye waac mo beer noo käle.» Kanyøgønø, ŋata rïŋŋö aput tïmö ni cäänhnha baŋge.
english: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat koor acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø mør mo rïŋŋö; 'ba ŋat koor manøgø ŋat wø koor dhi kiir acwøle ni kööe, ni «Neenï, dhaanhø mør acäŋ rïŋŋö ni rïïŋa eni keere.» 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Ŋatøgø thuwø poot käla waac mo beer.»
english: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat koor aköö, ni «Ŋata kwøŋ rïŋŋö, rïïŋi keda Akimaath o Dhadök kiree.» 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Nyenøgø beeye dhaanhø mo beer, ni waac mano käle beeye waac mo beer.»
english: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and cometh with good tidings.

anywaa: 'Ba Akimaath acwötö ni kööe jï nyeya, «Wui nyeya, jammi bëët beyø.» Køøre cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm nyeya ni määtha gø. Køøre Akimaath aköö, «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, na cïp nyimännï cerï, jøøa gëëmö ki ïïni, ï na nyeya.»
english: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the Lord thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya apëëö, «?A wääda ma Abëcëlöm, ba bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëre?» 'Ba aløk Akimaathi jïre, ni «Kanya ö Jöapi na jääŋ aani, ajooda ni jøw ŋurö døc; 'ba aani gïna ŋur jøwi kipere, tiere kära kwanyø.»
english: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king's servant, and me thy servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö, ni «Nyiik kaace ni cuŋŋï yie.» Ni ö Akimaathi ni ci kaace ni put bëëtö ni cuŋŋö yie.
english: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, nyï Kuuc aput pïï, ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, beerra man wïnynyï luummi ni beer en, kiper dïcäŋi Wuuö Jwøk ïïna pieme ceŋ jøøa ö maal bäätï.»
english: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for the Lord hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya nyï Kuuc apëënynye, «?A wääda ma Abëcëlöm, ba bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëre?» 'Ba aløk nyï Kuuc jï nyeya, «Wui nyeya, beerra man ö nyïïmännï, këël jiy bëët mo ö maal bäätï nee tïïge ki gïn mo raac dëërï, ni tïmge ni caala nyenøgø.»
english: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt, be as that young man is.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya cwïnye apädhö døc, ni put eth maal ni døny yi øtø mo ogeerø bäät kiir ni jwöŋe. 'Ba jwøk mana jwøk nyeya ni eni cäädhö yi øtø maal beeye en, ena köö, «Wui wääda ma Abëcëlöm, wääda, wääda ma Abëcëlöm. Beerra mana daa thøw na karï, wui Abëcëlöm wääda, wui wääda.»
english: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would God I had died for thee, O Absalom, my son, my son!

anywaa: Køøre acaan jï Jöap ni køp, ni «Neenï, nyeya bëëdö ni jwöŋö, ni kïmmö kiper thøw Abëcëlöm.»
english: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec mana di yïth jø leny mïnnö ki gø dïcäŋeca kiper mana kääthge, ree awiile na kïmmö jï jø leny bëët, kiper awïny jø lenynyi dïcäŋeca ni køp, ni «Nyeya kïmmö kiper wääde.»
english: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca jø leny gena put ci yi pääny ni rege kwaalge kwaalø, kaamar jiy mo ceŋge okaadhø ri leny ni reŋge ni wïthge olääö.
english: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, nyeya nyeŋŋe ee rïëbö, ni jwöŋö ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal ni kööe, «Wui wääda ma Abëcëlöm, wui Abëcëlöm, wääda, wui wääda.»
english: But the king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap aö baŋ nyeya yi øtø mana en yie, ni kööe, ni «Dïcäŋi wïth jø leny moï bëët anø lääï, ni beege jøøa piem ïïni, ki wäätï, ki nyïï, ki määrï bëët dïcäŋi en,
english: And Joab came into the house to the king, and said, Thou hast shamed this day the faces of all thy servants, which this day have saved thy life, and the lives of thy sons and of thy daughters, and the lives of thy wives, and the lives of thy concubines;

anywaa: ni tïmï niï mëër ki jøøa män ki ïïni, ni männï ki jøøa mëër ki ïïni. Kiper dïcäŋi marï anyoothï ni kwääc lwaae ki jø leny moï bäŋ karge ki jïrï. 'Ba aani, ŋääa dïcäŋi ni doo na Abëcëlöm kwøw ennø, ni waani bëët waano thøw, yiï doo met.
english: In that thou lovest thine enemies, and hatest thy friends. For thou hast declared this day, that thou regardest neither princes nor servants: for this day I perceive, that if Absalom had lived, and all we had died this day, then it had pleased thee well.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ö maal ni ciï wøk baŋ jiyï, ni cäänï ki geni ni täärnyïmï leer, kiper aana kööŋ ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, ni näk miï ba ci baŋge, ka adïëri møn, bäŋ ŋat mo dööŋ ki ïïni kany këël dïwääni. 'Ba luubö man tïmö ni leth døc kiperï ni kaala moa leth na nø pïï bäätï ki mana täge ki thïnhö marï këël kawaane ennø.»
english: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the Lord, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aput ö maal ni ci kuna pï piny dhi kiir kar acooŋa. 'Ba kanya caani jï jø leny bëët, ni køp, ni «Neennu, nyeya opï piny dhi kiir kar acooŋa», jø leny bëët gena put ö nyïm nyeya.
english: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø jø Icriel moa en dëër Abëcëlöm geno nø bwøk, ni ö ŋati man nø ni reŋ paare.

'Ba wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët geno løny ni ge jälla rege keerge, ni ge köö, ni «Nyeya ma Deebit øøna pieme ceŋ nyïïmän moø, ni køny øøni ceŋ jø Pilitin; 'ba ennø, ena nø reeŋø paac ni ŋwieya Abëcëlöm.
english: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel, saying, The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies, and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba Abëcëlöm na wïïe thïïmmø ki maaw na røønyø na nyeya bäätø, anø thøø ri leny. ?'Ba ennø, u lïŋu aperŋø ni nyeya ma Deebit ba duu paac?»
english: And Absalom, whom we anointed over us, is dead in battle. Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back?

anywaa: 'Ba luup moa car jø Icrielli awïny nyeya ma Deebit kanya bëëde yie. Køøre ena jääk baŋ Dhadök ka Abiethaar na näk Dïlämme Moa Døøŋŋø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cäänu ki jø døøk Juuda, ni kööu, na ‹?Aŋø, u ba tïmu aperŋø ni uuna jiy moo kwøŋ nyeya duu paare?
english: And king David sent to Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, saying, Speak unto the elders of Judah, saying, Why are ye the last to bring the king back to his house? seeing the speech of all Israel is come to the king, even to his house.

anywaa: Kee uuna nyïïmera, ni øøna remø aciel, ni ø käla ri dëël aciel. ?Aŋø nø, ni dööŋu cään en ki man dwøgu nyeya paare?›
english: Ye are my brethren, ye are my bones and my flesh: wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king?

anywaa: Køøre thuwø wär caannu jï Amaaca, ni kööu, ‹?Aŋø, ø paa remø aciel, ni ø käla ri dëël aciel? Ennø, beerra man ö Jwøki ni tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëëra, ni näk miï ba tïmö na kwääy lwaa leny jïra na kar Jöap ki mano täge ennø.› »
english: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, luup moa car Deebiti aput ci cwïny jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët, ni putge cwïnyge løø køør Deebit ni tïmge kaamar dhaanhø aciel. Køøre, jø tuuŋ Juuda gena put jääk baŋ nyeya ma Deebit ki dwøl, ni köge, ni «Duu paac, ni beeye ïïni ki jø kööre moï bëët.»
english: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah, even as the heart of one man; so that they sent this word unto the king, Return thou, and all thy servants.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aput duuö ni pïïe bäät Naam Jördan. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda gena put ci Gëlgela ni ge cii kaper nee nyeya jølge, nee eni ŋølge løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: So the king returned, and came to Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, to go to meet the king, to conduct the king over Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimiy o Gëra, nyï tuuŋ Benjamen mo käla Baurim, alaar öö ki jø tuuŋ Juuda nee ge røømge ki nyeya ma Deebit.
english: And Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite, which was of Bahurim, hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimiy ööi ka jø tuuŋ Benjamen ma kuma, ni Dhiba ŋat tïïc mar dhi øt Cøøl ööi ka wääte ma apaar kurbïïc ki jø tïïc moe ma pïërariiø; ni laarge reŋ bäät Naam Jördan ni nyeya poot kär pïï kaace.
english: And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him, and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul, and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him; and they went over Jordan before the king.

anywaa: Køøre naam aŋørge ni ge kaadha jø po nyeya løøga, ni ge tïïya yi nyeya ni met.
english: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king's household, and to do what he thought good. And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king, as he was come over Jordan;

anywaa: Ba kanya ö nyeya na tïme keda ŋuta løø Naam Jördan ennø, Cimiy o Gëra, ree aput gøø piny nyïm nyeya,
ni kööe jïgø, «Wui nyeya, bääyö mara kär kan cwïnyï, ni ba caarï wïïï ki jammi moa reyø na tïïa dïcäŋa ööï wøk ki Jerucalem; 'ba ennø, ï na nyeya mara, kär gïnögø kïth cwïnyï.
english: And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

anywaa: Kiper aani, a na dhaanhnhï, ŋääa ni aano bääyö; ni ka adïëri møn, beeye tiere gø na ööa dïcäŋi en, ni aana ŋata dïkwøŋ røk jø Icriel bëët na kwøŋ pïï nee røømme ki ïïni, ï na nyeya mara.»
english: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned: therefore, behold, I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king.

anywaa: 'Ba Abicay o Dheruya ajutö ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, Cimiy ba doo nääö kiper ajaany mana jany Deebit, ŋata näk otïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw nee røøny na nyeya?»
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah answered and said, Shall not Shimei be put to death for this, because he cursed the Lord's anointed?

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö, «?Wui, wäät Dheruya, a tïïa ŋø ki uuni nø? ?Aŋø, u bëëdö kaamar nyïïmän aperŋø? Kiper u bëëdö na acaara maru ki mara patha aciel. ?Aŋø, dïcäŋi doo da dhaanhø mo di nääö dï Icriel? ?Aŋø, kuua ni aana nyeya dïcäŋi bäät jø Icriel?»
english: And David said, What have I to do with you, ye sons of Zeruiah, that ye should this day be adversaries unto me? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø nyeya akööŋ jï Cimiy ni kööe, ni «Ïïni, ï ba thøw.»
english: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Mepiböcëth nyikwaar Cøøl aöö nee røømge ki nyeya; ni ööi ni tiete käre lwøø, ni jïëc dhee käre nyaarø, na abïïe moe käre penyø ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ mana ö nyeya ma Deebit na päär wøk yie këël dïcäŋ mana duu nyeya paac yie ni dëëre jööt.
english: And Mephibosheth the son of Saul came down to meet the king, and had neither dressed his feet, nor trimmed his beard, nor washed his clothes, from the day the king departed until the day he came again in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Mepiböcëthi na ööe ki Jerucalem nee røømge ki nyeya, nyeya aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø Mepiböcëth, aperŋø na kärï aay ki aani?»
english: And it came to pass, when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king, that the king said unto him, Wherefore wentest not thou with me, Mephibosheth?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Mepiböcëthi jï nyeya ni kööe, «Wui nyeya, ŋäyï ni aani, a na dhaanhnhï, aana ŋwøl. Neenï, acaana jï ŋat tïïc mara ma Dhiba na arëën mara jiiŋŋe naa aa ki ïïni naa cäädhi ka bääte na bëëde; 'ba aana cøøge.
english: And he answered, My lord, O king, my servant deceived me: for thy servant said, I will saddle me an ass, that I may ride thereon, and go to the king; because thy servant is lame.

anywaa: 'Ba eni thuwø, nyeŋŋa anø waae ki ïïni, ï na nyeya. 'Ba ennø, beerra man tïïyï mana beerra eni ki jïrï jaak dëëra; kiper ï na nyeya, leec wïc marï caala leec wïc mar nyïïatwiel maal mar Jwøk.
english: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.

anywaa: Wui nyeya, jø dhi øt wära bëët doo na rømi ka thøø nyïmï; 'ba aani, a na dhaanhnhï, aana tïïyï naa tïma naa ena røk jø wø cämö ki ïïni na aciel. ?Agïnaŋø noo dööŋ këët nø, noo cäŋa köö ni yiï cwaada cwaadø ki gø?»
english: For all of my father's house were but dead men before my lord the king: yet didst thou set thy servant among them that did eat at thine own table. What right therefore have I yet to cry any more unto the king?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya aköö jïgø, ni «Kär dee gïn caanï këët nø. Aani mara anø ŋøla, ni ïïni ki Dhiba, pääŋŋu ŋøøm.»
english: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.

anywaa: 'Ba Mepiböcëth aköö jï nyeya, ni «Beerra man ö Dhiba ni käl ŋøøm bëët; kiper ï na nyeya mara, ïïna nø duu paac ni dëërï jööt.»
english: And Mephibosheth said unto the king, Yea, let him take all, forasmuch as my lord the king is come again in peace unto his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Bardhilay nyï Gelät onø öö ki pääny mana cwøl ni Rögelim; ni ci bäät Naam Jördan ki nyeya na aciel ni eni jiedha gø løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim, and went over Jordan with the king, to conduct him over Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba Bardhilay oløny na jaal mo dwøŋ, ni cwiiye oløny na pïërabära; 'ba eni, ena bëëdö ni cïpö ki cam jï nyeya kanya bëët nyeya Maanayim, kiper Bardhilay beeye dhaanhø mo okwär døc.
english: Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Bardhilay, ni «Ï ŋuta løøga ki aani na aciel niï bëëdï buuta Jerucalem.»
english: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Bardhilay aköö jï nyeya, «?Aŋø, a poot cøøa Jerucalem ki ï na nyeya këët ennø? ?A da cwiiri mo poot beeda beedø naa kwøw?
english: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?

anywaa: Ennø, cwiiya oløny na pïërabära, ni bäŋ gïn mo beer wala gïn mo raac mo ŋääa këët. Këël cam mo met ki køøŋø mo met ba løny ŋec jïra ennø, ni dööt cwøw ki mään mo wø wär ki dudi bäŋgø mo met mo wïnyi jïra këët. ?Aŋø, a na dhaanhnhï, a cäŋï gø meet bäätï na tëër mør en kiperŋø?
english: I am this day fourscore years old: and can I discern between good and evil? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king?

anywaa: Wui nyeya, bäŋ gïn mo manynya këët baŋï mo diï cïbö jïra cøøn. A ööi naa jiedha ïïni løø Naam Jördan løøga keere.
english: Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king: and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward?

anywaa: Wui nyeya, beerra man døøa, a na dhaanhnhï, naa thøøa yi pääny mar powa buut bwöc wära ki mera. 'Ba ennø, dhaanhnhï ma Kimiam enø, beerra man aayu ki gø, ï na nyeya mara, ni tïïyï gïna beerra eni jïre.»
english: Let thy servant, I pray thee, turn back again, that I may die in mine own city, and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother. But behold thy servant Chimham; let him go over with my lord the king; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeya jï Bardhilay, ni kööe, ni «Kimiam, wa aay ki gø møn, ni tïïa jïre ki gïn mo nëëni ni beer ki jïrï. 'Ba gïno pëënynyï aani ki gø jaak ni tïïa, puta ka tïïc jïrï.»
english: And the king answered, Chimham shall go over with me, and I will do to him that which shall seem good unto thee: and whatsoever thou shalt require of me, that will I do for thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy bëët aput kath løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni ö nyeya ni kadhe thuwø. Køøre nyeya dhi Bardhilay anuume ni gwïëth gø, ni ö Bardhilay ni put døø kanya bëëde yie.
english: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aci Gëlgela, ni ge aay ki Kimiam na aciel. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët, ki jø Icriel mo nøk, ge cäädhi ki nyeya thuwø.
english: Then the king went on to Gilgal, and Chimham went on with him: and all the people of Judah conducted the king, and also half the people of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët, gena ö baŋ nyeya ni köge, «?Aŋø, nyïïmëëkwa ma jø tuuŋ Juuda ï tïïcge gø ni ïïna nyeya marge keerge en aperŋø, ni öge baŋï ni ŋulge ïïni løø Naam Jördan løøi, ni beeye ïïni ki jø paarï, ki jø leny moï bëët moa bëëdö ki ïïni?»
english: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aløk jø tuuŋ Juuda jï jø Icriel ni köge, ni «Beeye kiper mana näk mo nyeya tuuŋwa døc. ?Aŋø, u gootu kiper luubö man aperŋø? ?Aŋø, waani cam nyeya mo ewa camø wala gïn mo ewa kälö baŋe, dagø?»
english: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, Because the king is near of kin to us: wherefore then be ye angry for this matter? have we eaten at all of the king's cost? or hath he given us any gift?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø Icrielli jï jø tuuŋ Juuda ni köge, ni «Waani, da kurwa mo jïtö ki kwöre apaar dëër nyeya, kiper waana wïth tuŋi apaar, ni løny jïwa ki man köwa ni Deebit beeye nyeya marwa ni pöödha waani ki uuni. ?Aŋø, wa taagu gø aperŋø? ?Aŋø, paa wa na kwøŋ köö dïkwøŋ ni nyeya duu paac?» 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda adwögö ki luubö mo teek døc ni kaala mar jø Icriel.
english: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, and said, We have ten parts in the king, and we have also more right in David than ye: why then did ye despise us, that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mo wïïe raac mo nut Gëlgela kaace mo nyeŋŋe Cïïba o Bëkri nyï Benjamen. Eni tuuŋ akoodhe ni kööe, «U jø Icriel bëët, ŋati man nø døø paare. Kiper øøni ø ba en ri Deebit, ni øøni bäŋ kurø dëëre, eni na o Jeci enø, kiper eni paa tuuŋø.»
english: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel bëët køør Deebit aputge wec ki caath, ni tïme ni ge caatha køør Cïïba o Bëkri; 'ba jø tuuŋ Juuda keerge, gena put bëëtö ri nyeya marge ma Deebit, ki mana tïŋge ki Naam Jördan këël mana pïïcge Jerucalem.
english: So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit apïï paare Jerucalem, ni lwør määre karge paari na näk ee wiiø nee paac koorge, ni tïïc ge nee ge koor, ni ge di caamø; 'ba nyeya kär ci baŋge na mään. Kanyøgønø, gena put bëëtö ni bäŋ dïcwøø mo ci baŋge këël mana päŋ nïr thøø moge, ni ge bëëdö kaamar määr thuunhnhi.
english: And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï Amaaca, ni «Ï cøø ni cwølï jø tuuŋ Juuda jïra ki yïth nïne adäk keerge. 'Ba ïïni ki dëërï thuwø, ï doo nut kany.»
english: Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Amaaca aay nee jø tuuŋ Juuda cwøle; 'ba ena ruu ni kaal nïne moa no okwaan nyeya jïre.
english: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit aköö jï Abicay, ni «Neenï, ennø Cïïba o Bëkri manynya man tïïe ki gïn mo leth dëëtø ni kaala mana tïïc Abëcëlömmi. Lwør jø leny 'moa, a na nyeya marï, ni reŋŋï køør Cïïba, kiper nee ba jïte ki päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek ni tïme ni ba løny mak jïïø.»
english: And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord's servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Abicay aput aay ki jø leny moa käär Jöapi, ki jø leny mo wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita, këël jø leny bëët moa teek. 'Ba gena put tïŋŋö ki Jerucalem ni aacge ni ge ŋwieya køør Cïïba o Bëkri.
english: And there went out after him Joab's men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enge ri kïnna dwøŋ na en Gibien, Amaaca aputge joot ni cäänhnha baŋge. 'Ba kar kaagø, Jöap jap leny ee twöö dëëre, no opëëllö ee twöö ri kaw piere ni ena yi købe. 'Ba kanya cääth nyïme, opëëllö apäth piny ki yi køp, ni kwany gø.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab's garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap, Amaaca amäädhe, ni kööe, «?Dëël jööt nø, omara?» Ni ö Jöapi ni tïme ni keda nuuma dha Amaaca ni mak jïëc tïï gø.
english: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Amaaca bäŋ gïn ee caarø kiper opëëllö mana en cer Jöap. Ni ö Jöapi ni put Amaaca cwøp ko opëëllö ki yi gø, ni 'näga gø, ni put cïïre øc piny yïth ŋøøm. 'Ba Jöap, Amaaca käre cäŋ cwøpø këët. Køøre Jöap ki coki ma Abicay gena put pöödhö ni ge ŋwieya køør Cïïba o Bëkri.
english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab's hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen ma dhaanh Jöap mo odööŋ ni cuŋŋö bäät Amaaca ni cäänö ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal ni kööe, «Ni näk mo da ŋat mo yie met ki Jöap ni manynya man bëëde na dhaanh Deebit, beerra man caath køør Jöap.»
english: And one of Joab's men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaaca bäädö dï jöö kaagø ni dëëre ogääbö ki remø. 'Ba kanya ö nyenøgø na joot jiy ni ge poot cuŋŋö kaagø, Amaaca aput daak dï jöö, ni jwaa gø thääŋ jöö ni rïëp gø ka abïï.
english: And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø paany dëër Amaaca dï jöö, jiy bëët moa cuŋŋö kaagø aput läp køør Jöap, ni ge ŋwieya køør Cïïba o Bëkri.
english: When he was removed out of the highway, all the people went on after Joab, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

anywaa: 'Ba Cïïba onø aay ni caath bäät wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, ni pïïe Abël-Bëëth- Maika ni cøra dï jiy bëët moa bëëdö Bërët; ni ö jø paanøgø ni putge rege cooŋ ni tïmge ni ge caatha køøre thuwø.
english: And he went through all the tribes of Israel unto Abel, and to Beth–maachah, and all the Berites: and they were gathered together, and went also after him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap ki jø leny bëët, Cïïba aputge maa Abël-Bëëth-Maika, ni putge deŋ kiir wïr, ni tïïge ri kiir ki gïrpiny man ethge ki gø. Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët moa cäädhö ki Jöap ni putge tägö ki koony tier kiir nee pädhe.
english: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah, and they cast up a bank against the city, and it stood in the trench: and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø mo waŋe riek acwötö ki yi kiir, ni kööe, «Nyie, nyie, wïnynyu gïn. Akwaya uuni, caannu jï Jöap nee ö kany naa cääna ki gø.»
english: Then cried a wise woman out of the city, Hear, hear; say, I pray you, unto Joab, Come near hither, that I may speak with thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap aput nyiik buut kanya dïët ki dhaagø manøgø, ni kö dhaagø manøgø, «?Beeye ï Jöap?» Ni kö Jöapi, «Yaa, beeye aani.» Køøre ena köö jï Jöap, ni «Cek ïthï ki dwøra, a na dhaanhnhï.» Ni kö Jöapi, ni «Ïtha yaa ciiø.»
english: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø manøgø acäänö ni kööe, na «Acääŋŋe jiy wø köö, ni ‹Cou baŋ jø Abël ni pëënynyu geni ka acaara mo beer›, 'ba acaara maneca wø puta thur kare.
english: Then she spake, saying, They were wont to speak in old time, saying, They shall surely ask counsel at Abel: and so they ended the matter.

anywaa: Aani, aana dhaanhø aciel røk jø bëëdö yi pääny man en, ni wa wø manynya bëët-mëër ni waano ŋäädhö dï Icriel. 'Ba ennø, ï manynya man raanynyï pääny man ni caal mïïö dï Icriel en. ?Aŋø, jic Wuuö Jwøk putï ka thöör ennø møn?»
english: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel: thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel: why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap mare aløøe ni kööe, ni «Beerra man tïm kara ni bäär ka acaara manøgø. A ba ööi kiper nee jiy thööra, wala nee pääny raanynya.
english: And Joab answered and said, Far be it, far be it from me, that I should swallow up or destroy.

anywaa: Manøgø paa tier gïna ööa kipere. 'Ba nyen ma nyï paac aciel røk mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, mo nyeŋŋe Cïïba o Bëkri, atïmö ni gëëmö ki nyeya ma Deebit. Cïpu eni keere jïra. Køøre nø, a puta tïŋŋö ni wiia pääny man.» Kanyøgønø, dhaagø manøgø aköö jï Jöap, ni «Ka adïëri møn, wïïe lëëŋa baŋï ki bäät kiir.»
english: The matter is not so: but a man of mount Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, hath lifted up his hand against the king, even against David: deliver him only, and I will depart from the city. And the woman said unto Joab, Behold, his head shall be thrown to thee over the wall.

anywaa: Køøre dhaagø manøgø aay ni cïpe ka acaara mo beer jï jø poge bëët. 'Ba geni wï Cïïba o Bëkri aputge ŋul wøk ni leeŋge gø baŋ Jöap. Kanyøgønø, Jöap tuuŋ aput tïïc nee kooth, ni ö jø lenynyi ni putge keethø buut kiir manøgø, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø paare. Køøre Jöap thuwø adøø Jerucalem baŋ nyeya.
english: Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap beeye kwääy lwaa leny bäre mar jø leny mo jø Icriel, ni Benaya o Jööda beeye kwääy lwaak mar jø leny mo wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita.
english: Now Joab was over all the host of Israel: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and over the Pelethites:

anywaa: 'Ba Adöram beeye ŋata no ocuumö na wïth jø wø tïïö ni mak ka teek, ni Jøcapat wär Akilut beeye nyikugö.
english: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:

anywaa: 'Ba Ceraya beeye ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni Dhadök ka Abiethaar beege dïlämme moa døøŋŋø.
english: And Sheva was scribe: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

anywaa: 'Ba Ira nyï Jayer ena dïlämi thuwø mar Deebit.
english: And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Deebiti na nyeya, da käc ma atägö ni bëëde ki cwiiri adäk. Køøre Deebit alämö ni pëëny Wuuö Jwøk kiper käc manøgø. 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki ni kööe, ni «Cøøl ki dhi øde bäätge da ajäl kwör rem jiy; kiper Cøøl jø Gibien anääe.»
english: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years, year after year; and David enquired of the Lord. And the Lord answered, It is for Saul, and for his bloody house, because he slew the Gibeonites.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Gibien ge paa jø Icriel; gena jø Amör moa no odööŋ ni kwøw. 'Ba kar kaace, jø Icriel geno tudö ki luubö ki jø Gibien nee jø Gibien ba 'näkge. 'Ba Cøøl apääre ki man dïïr wïthge ki køør këëny mana en cwïnye ki geni, ni ge näänne jø Icriel ki jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: And the king called the Gibeonites, and said unto them; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but of the remnant of the Amorites; and the children of Israel had sworn unto them: and Saul sought to slay them in his zeal to the children of Israel and Judah.)

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya ma Deebit jø Gibien aput cwøl ni cääne ki geni ni kööe, na «Agïnaŋø noo tïïa jïïu ennø? ?Agïne noo wïïra kwör ki gø nø, nee tïme ni løny jïïu ki man gwïëthu jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jø Icriel?»
english: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites, What shall I do for you? and wherewith shall I make the atonement, that ye may bless the inheritance of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba jø Gibien aköö jï nyeya, ni «Waani, bäŋ gïn manywa ri warkey wala gwel-bïrö mar Cøøl wala mar jø dhi øde, ni ba løny jïwa ki man 'näkwa ki dhaanhø røk jø Icriel.» 'Ba nyeya aköö, «Caannu gïna manynyu jaak; tïïa tïïö jïïu.»
english: And the Gibeonites said unto him, We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel. And he said, What ye shall say, that will I do for you.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena köö jï nyeya, ni «Ŋata many waani nee wa thööre na dïïr wïthwa, nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo dööŋ ni kwøw røkwa dï Icriel,
english: And they answered the king, The man that consumed us, and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel,

anywaa: beerra man ö cwøw abïriiø røk jø dhi øde ni wëëgï waani, nee ge lïërwa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk yi Giba, pääny mar Cøøl, ni beeye Cøøl na näk ojier Wuuö Jwøki na nyeya.» Køøre nyeya aköö jïge, ni «Aani, ge cïba cïbö jïïu.»
english: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us, and we will hang them up unto the Lord in Gibeah of Saul, whom the Lord did choose. And the king said, I will give them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya, Mepiböcëth o Jönathan nyïkwaar Cøøl awiie ni kwøw, kiper kööŋ mana kööŋe ki gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na en yïthakicge ki Jönathan o Cøøl.
english: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the Lord's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya wäät Ricpa nyi Aya karge riet, na nywølge ki Cøøl, ni beege Armöni ki Mepiböcëth mør, ki wäät Mërap nyi Cøøl karge bïï, na nywølge ka Adariel o Bardhilay nyï Meyöla, aput lwør.
english: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, whom she bare unto Saul, Armoni and Mephibosheth; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul, whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni cïp ge ceŋ jø Gibien, ni ö jø Gibienni ni lïërge geni bäät kïdi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Kanyøgønø, jøøgø na abïriiø yøø, gena put thøø na aciel; 'ba geni, ge 'näk ka kany wø täk beek wø cwøl ni gäbci  ki kac yie.
english: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites, and they hanged them in the hill before the Lord: and they fell all seven together, and were put to death in the days of harvest, in the first days, in the beginning of barley harvest.

anywaa: 'Ba Ricpa nyi Aya keeca alwøre, ni aae ki gø ni peeth gø piny bäät kïdi kanya en dëët jiy yie, ni bëëde ni koora geni, nee bäŋe wec maal mo pï bäätge ki waŋcäŋ wala lääc paap mo ööa baŋge ki wäär. 'Ba koor tääe ka dïcäŋ mana täk kaci yie këël mana päth køthi.
english: And Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth, and spread it for her upon the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water dropped upon them out of heaven, and suffered neither the birds of the air to rest on them by day, nor the beasts of the field by night.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïc cï Cøølli ma Ricpa nyi Aya, acaan jï Deebit.
english: And it was told David what Rizpah the daughter of Aiah, the concubine of Saul, had done.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aa baŋ jø Jabic-Gelät ni lwør cuu mo Cøøl ki mo Jönathan o Cøøl na no okwøŋ jø Jabic-Geläti kwal ki piny mëëth bura mar päänya cwøl ni Bëëth-Can, ni beeye kanya ö jø Pilitinni na lïërge geni yie dïcäŋa ö jø Pilitinni na 'näkge Cøøl bäät Kïn Gilböa.
english: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead, which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan, where the Philistines had hanged them, when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa:

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit cuu mo Cøøl ki mo Jönathan o Cøøl aput kälö ki kaace; ni cooŋge cuu jiy moa na abïriiø na no olïërö, ni koonyge ge.
english: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.

anywaa: 'Ba cuu mo Cøøl ki mo Jönathan o Cøøl akïthge yi bwöc Kic wää Cøølli pääny mana cwøl ni Cëëla po jø tuuŋ Benjamen. 'Ba luup bëët moa ö nyeya na kööm geni ki ge aputge tïïc. Køøre lam mana lam jiyi kiper paac aput Jwøki løk.
english: And the bones of Saul and Jonathan his son buried they in the country of Benjamin in Zelah, in the sepulchre of Kish his father: and they performed all that the king commanded. And after that God was entreated for the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Pilitinni na cäŋge këëdö ki jø Icriel, Deebit aci baŋ leny ni cäädhi ka jø leny moe. 'Ba kanya këëtge ki jø Pilitin, Deebit aööl.
english: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel; and David went down, and his servants with him, and fought against the Philistines: and David waxed faint.

anywaa: Køøre Icbi-Banöp, nyen mo käla ri tuuŋ jøøa dëëtge døøŋŋø, mo otööyö ko opëëllö mo nyään, mo käädö ki tøŋ mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo peege beeye rumme ma dïpe adäk ki yi rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, atïmö ni manynya man 'näk Deebit.
english: And Ishbi–benob, which was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear weighed three hundred shekels of brass in weight, he being girded with a new sword, thought to have slain David.

anywaa: 'Ba Abicay o Dheruya, Deebit aput piem cer nyï Pilitin manøgø, ni gøøc gø ni put gø 'näk. Køøre jø leny mo Deebit aput kööŋ jï Deebit, ni köge, ni «Ïïni, ï na nyeya en, ï ba cäädhi baŋ leny këët ki waani, kiper niï ba thøwï, kiper ïïna tar jï jø Icriel.»
english: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, leny mør acäŋ këëllö ki jø Pilitin Gøp. Kanyøgønø, Cibekay nyï Uca, nyen mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Caap mo käla ri tuuŋ jøøa dëëtge døøŋŋø aput 'näk.
english: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

anywaa: Ni ö lenynyi mør ni cäŋi këëllö ki jø Pilitin Gøp kaace thuwø. 'Ba El-Anan o Jayer nyï Bethelem, Göliat nyï Gëth, nyen mo thiir tøŋ mare caala athøra, anääe.
english: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim, a Beth–lehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver's beam.

anywaa: Køøre leny mør acäŋ këëllö Gëth; 'ba da dhaanhø kaaca mo bäär døc ni dëëre dwøŋ, mo lweet ceŋŋe abïciel abïciel ni lweet tiete thuwø abïciel abïciel, ni lweete ge bëët beege pïërariiø kurŋween; 'ba eni thuwø nywöli ka ri tuuŋ jøøa bäyö døc ni dëëtge døøŋŋø.
english: And there was yet a battle in Gath, where was a man of great stature, that had on every hand six fingers, and on every foot six toes, four and twenty in number; and he also was born to the giant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyenøgø na ŋwöe bäät jø Icriel, Jönathan o Cimiy, ni beeye Cimiy cöök Deebiti, nyenøgø anääe.
english: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin moøgø bëët na aŋween yøø, ge nywöli ka ri tuuŋ jøøa bäyö døc ni dëëtge døøŋŋø na en Gëth, 'ba geni, gena 'näk Deebiti ki jø leny moe.
english: These four were born to the giant in Gath, and fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit duut man acaae ni wär gø jï Wuuö Jwøk ni pwøya gø, ki køør pïëm mana piemi ya Wuuö Jwøki ceŋ nyïïmänne bëët, këël cer Cøøl.
english: And David spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

anywaa: Ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna teek mara, ni ïïna kar gwøk røk kipera, ni beeye ïïni wø piem aani.
english: And he said, The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

anywaa: Ïïna Jwøk mara møn, ni teek mara wø jooda baŋï, ni beeye ï wø kana raa buutï. Ï caala kwöt leny naa gëëŋŋï gëëŋŋö ki gïï mo leth, ni beeye ï na pïëmi mara, niï caala kiir mo ogeerø ni teek kipera, ni beeye ï wø kana raa buute; ïïna pïëmi mara, ni beeye ï wø køny aani yïth gïï mo leth.
english: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na näk orømø ki pwøc, kany wø kwaa ïïni, a wø putï ka køny ceŋ nyïïmänna.
english: I will call on the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

anywaa: Kiper aana bëëdö ni aano ciel thøø dïër kaamar dhaanhø mo omaa athage dï naam, ni ö ränynyö mo päl ni pïïe bääta kaamar naam mo pänhnhö.
english: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

anywaa: Kar thøø atïmö ni cään ki aani, naa ee meenø kaamar thøøl, ni thøø bëëdö naa ee ciiø kaamar abïëp.
english: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth, aana jwöŋö dëërï; aana jwöŋö dëërï møn, ï na Jwøk mara, ni ö dwøra ni wïnynyï gø niï ena kar bëëtö marï. Aana jwöŋö kiper køny, ni putï gø wïnynyö møn.
english: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

anywaa: «'Ba ki køør teegï, piny aput tïmö ni kwanynyi ni jäŋŋi, ni ö kwöra näk maal ocwää rege ni putge rege tuk, ni putge tïmö ni jäŋŋi ki køør wëër marï.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jwïëyï ki jwïëy mo dwøŋ, jïrö mo päl aput nitul ki ummï, ni ö maaci ki cuk mo oäpö mo jiy di thöörö ni öge wøk ki dhiï.
english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, maal ajapï ni ööï piny, ni kanya cäädhï, kuna näk da tietï piny da pöölö mo cøl døc.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna put mäännö niï ena bäät nyïïatwiel maal mana cwøl ni kirubël; niï määnni ka yi jamø.
english: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋŋï bäre atïïyï na muudhö, ni ö pøølli mo nëëni na køth ni put maal gääbö.
english: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

anywaa: Ni ö agaackøthi mana mal nyïmï ni put liel na maac.
english: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dwørï awïnyö kaamar køth mo pöödö maal, ni caanï marï, ï na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: The Lord thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

anywaa: Ni tïïyï køth nee pööde bäät nyïïmän, ni caala man wø thöödhö ka athëëre, ni ö nyïïmän ni putge keethø, ni putï wïthge kier ka agaackøth.
english: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya wëërï ki nyïïmännï niï jooga geni, kanya jwïëyï ki jwïëy mo dwøŋ, tiet ŋøøm aput nëënö, ni ö pï naama dwøŋ ni pääŋge rege këël mana nëën ŋøømmi.
english: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

anywaa: «Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, cerï arwääï niï ena maal, ni lwørï aani; ni kälï aani wøk ki yi bëëtö mo leth, ni caala man wø lääm dhaanhø wøk ki tiet pïï.
english: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

anywaa: Aana piemï ceŋ nyïïmänna moa bëëdö ni teeka ge bääta, ni beege nyïïmänna moa no okadhø ki teek døc, ni beege jøøa bëëdö ni män ki aani.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda ni aano ränynyö, nyïïmänna aö maal bääta, 'ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna bëëdö niï køønynya aani;
english: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

anywaa: ni kälï aani wøk ki kany mo diiny mo jwïëya omiiø yie; ni japï jöö jïra ni dunynya wøk ki yïth gïï mo leth, ni kønyï aani kiper mana bëëdï niï mëër ki aani.
english: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

anywaa: «Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana cunnï ki køør bëëtö mara na beer; ni ŋatï aani ki køør mana waany dëëra ni bäŋ raay.
english: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

anywaa: Kiper aana bëëdö ni luupï yaa gwøø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk; ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö mo pää aani ki ïïni, ï na Jwøa;
english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

anywaa: kiper aani luup ŋøl moï bëët ena nyïma, ni kära gaa wøk ki ciik moï.
english: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö mara nyïmï, ni bëëda ni raa yaa gwøø ki raay.
english: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana cunnï ki køør bëëtö mara na beer, ki køør bëëtö mara na bëëda ni dëëra waany nyïmï, ni bääta bäŋ raay.
english: Therefore the Lord hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl wø nyoothï nyoodhø jï jø wø bëëdö ki bëët-mëër, ni nyoothï bëëtö marï na näk kare jï jø wø bëëdö ki bëëtö ma kare.
english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

anywaa: Tac cwïny marï wø nyoothï nyoodhø jï jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge tar; 'ba ï wø bëëdö ni waŋï riek bäät jø wø bëëtö marge ba tiir.
english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

anywaa: Jøøa no ocaarø wø kønyï kønyø; 'ba jø wø töödö, waŋï wø këëta rege ki man dwøgï wïthge piny.
english: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna tar mara; ni beeye ï na Wuuö Jwøk wø wiil muudhö mara na tar.
english: For thou art my lamp, O Lord: and the Lord will lighten my darkness.

anywaa: Ki køør teek marï, a wø reŋŋa baŋ jø wø ö baŋ twëër; ni beeye ï na Jwøa ni wø mooc aani ki teek mo päära yi kiir mar nyïïmän ki gø.
english: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jwøk, bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö marï, ni luubö marï adïëri; niï bëëdö niï caala kwöt leny jï jiy bëët mo wø kan rege buutï.
english: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da jwøk mør këët mo caala ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk? ?A da ŋat mo teek mo caala ïïni, ï na Jwøwa?
english: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?

anywaa: Beeye ï Jwøk na näk kar gwøk røk mara mo otïïö ni teek; ni beeye ï wø tïïc bëëtö mara ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ree.
english: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

anywaa: Tieta akwathï ni tïmge ni jööt ni caala tiet aŋer, ni tïïyï aani naa cuŋŋa naa teek kwöra perge leth na en bäät thuuri.
english: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

anywaa: Aana pwönynyï ki jïëth leny, ni tïme ni løny jïra ki man thöödha ka atheerø ma atum mare tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

anywaa: 'Ba ï caala kwöt leny jïra ni wø piem aani, ni ö kønynyi marï ni put kara tïïc ni dwøŋ.
english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

anywaa: Waŋjöö ajapï ni dwøŋ nyïma, ni kära tiera cwaanyø.
english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

anywaa: «Aani, køør nyïïmän 'moa aŋwiea ni puta wïthge dïïr, ni kära duu ŋääa këël mana ö nyïïmänna na thumge.
english: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

anywaa: Nyïïmän 'moa wïthge adïïra møn, ni puta ge nyath na bäre, ni tïme ni ba løny jïge ki man öge maal këët; ni putge bëëtö ni geno pädhö tieta.
english: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana mooyï ki teek mo këëda ki gø ri leny, ni ö jøøa ö maal bääta ni putï wïthge dwøk piny jïra.
english: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

anywaa: Ïïni, nyïïmänna atïïyï nee ŋäthge luuge baŋa ni reŋge, ni ö jøøa bëëdö ni män ki aani, ni puta ge thöör.
english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nëënge, bäŋ ŋat mo okøny geni. Këël mana kwacge ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ gïn mo iï løø jïge.
english: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.

anywaa: Køøre nø, gena puta nyath këël mana tïmge ni caala tør, ni nyøra geni kaamar odhöönh mo ena dï jöö.
english: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

anywaa: «Aana kønyï ceŋ jø powa moa bëëdö ni gëëmö ki aani; ni tïïyï aani nee wïth juurre tïmge ni ena tiera; këël wïth juurre mo kuua, ge puta bëëtö ni ge bëënna aani.
english: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me to be head of the heathen: a people which I knew not shall serve me.

anywaa: Juurre mo path, a wø wøørge wøørø ni dëëtge rïïŋö ki lwär, ni kany wø cääna ki ge, dwøra wø leŋge leŋø.
english: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, bäätge wø pädhö, ni öge wøk yïth kiiri moge moa no ogeerø ni teek ni dëëtge kwanynyi.
english: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï nut niï kwøw møn. Pwøc en jïrï, ï na teek mara; beerra man ö nyeŋŋï ni wïnye, ï na Jwøa teek ni wø piem aani.
english: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

anywaa: Beeye ï na Jwø wø cool kwöra dëët nyïïmänna, ni wø tïïc wïth juurre nee bëëtge ni ena tiera.
english: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,

anywaa: Beeye ï thuwø ni wø køny aani ceŋ nyïïmänna; ni tïïyï jøøa ö maal bääta nee bëëtge ni ena tiera; ni kälï aani wøk ceŋ jø kwöri.
english: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï pwøa pwøø dï wïth juurre kiper gïïa tïïyï bëët, ni wära ki duut naa pwøya nyeŋŋï.
english: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

anywaa: Beeye ï wø køny aani, a na tïïyï na nyeya; ni ö mëërri marï na näk ba jøøl ni putï gø nyooth jïra, a na tïïyï nee wïïa thïïmmi ki maaw niï røønya aani; ni ö mëërri manøgø ni put bëëtö ni nut kipera, a na Deebit en. 'Ba put mëër manøgø tïïc nee pïïe baŋ nyïïkwaaya ni ba cuŋ.»
english: He is the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege luup moa car Deebiti na aŋuudi, ena köö, na «A caana dwør Jwøk, a na Deebit o Jeci; a caana dwør Jwøk møn, na tïïc kara ni dwøŋ; ni beeye Jwø Jeekap na tïïc aani nee wïïa thïïmmi ki maaw ni røønya aani; 'ba beeye aani wø cääö ki dudi mo met jï jø Icriel.
english: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

anywaa: «Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni cääne ki raa, ni tïm luupe ni ena dhaa.
english: The Spirit of the Lord spake by me, and his word was in my tongue.

anywaa: Jwø Icriel mare anø caane, ni beeye Jwø Icriel na teek na cäänö ki aani ni kööe, ni ‹Ŋato bëëdö na nyeya ni käär jiy ki jöö ma kare, ni jiy kääre ni eni lwäära aani, a na Jwøk,
english: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

anywaa: eni tïmö kaamar tiet øw kany wø bëëde ni cäŋ tuulö, ni tïme ni caala maal mo bäŋ pøøl kany wø bëët pinynyi na amöölla, ni tïme ni nëëni ni mïërö ni caala luum mo pulli mo tuya piny, kany wø rieny cäŋŋi køør køth.›
english: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, nyec mar dhi øtø mara ba tïmö ni caala nyec manøgø nyïm Jwøk? Kiper eno tudö ki luubö ki aani mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni beeye luubö mana näk ee cïp piny ni ba wiil. ?A ni näk mo enøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk a ba put piem, këël dhi øtø mara, ni wëëk gïï wø mïn eci ki ge bëët thur karge?
english: Although my house be not so with God; yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure: for this is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he make it not to grow.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïthge reyø bëët, ge di wetø kaamar koodhi, kiper koodhi bäŋ wø mak ki cenø;
english: But the sons of Belial shall be all of them as thorns thrust away, because they cannot be taken with hands:

anywaa: 'ba ŋat wø cooŋ ge wø cooŋe ka thiir tøŋ, ni putge waaŋ na bäre bäre karge na enge yie.»
english: But the man that shall touch them must be fenced with iron and the staff of a spear; and they shall be utterly burned with fire in the same place.

anywaa: Moi beege nyeŋ jø leny mo Deebit moa teek. Dhaanhø mana dïkwøŋ beeye Jöcëp- Baacëbët nyï Taakmön, na bëëdö na wïth jø leny moa na adäk. Ena këëdö ki tøŋ ni nääe ki jiy ma dïpe abära ki yi leny aciel keere.
english: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

anywaa: 'Ba riet jiy beeye Eliedhar o Dödö nyï Aköki. Ena dhaanhø aciel dëët jø leny moa teek moa na adäk na en buut Deebit, ni beege na ŋwöö bäät jø Pilitin moa näk rege ege cooŋ kanya aciel kaace kiper leny. 'Ba kar kaagø, jø leny møøk mo jø Icriel geno nø døø ŋäthge.
english: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:

anywaa: Køøre Eliedhar acuŋŋö ni 'näk jø Pilitin këël mana ööl cere no opëëllö poot ee maaø ni teek. 'Ba dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk atïïö ki køny mo dwøŋ døc jï jø Icriel. Kanyøgønø, jø leny mo jø Icriel aduu baŋ nyenøgø; 'ba ge duui kiper twëër keere.
english: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the Lord wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.

anywaa: 'Ba dää jiy beeye Cimia wär Agë nyï Arar. Dïcäŋ aciel jø leny mo jø Pilitin rege acooŋge yi pwödhö ma adaci thööth yie døc. Ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Icriel ni bwøkge ki jø leny mo jø Pilitin.
english: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a piece of ground full of lentiles: and the people fled from the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimia acuŋŋö dï pwödhö ni mäna pwödhö ki jø Pilitin, ni 'näk ge. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïe ki køny mo dwøŋ jï jø Icriel.
english: But he stood in the midst of the ground, and defended it, and slew the Philistines: and the Lord wrought a great victory.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø leny adäk møøk røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk na perge leth. 'Ba jø leny moøgø na adäk yøø, gena ci baŋ Deebit yi øt kïdi mana en ya Adulam kanya tïme na kar kac ki beel. 'Ba kar kaagø, jø leny mo jø Pilitin twïër marge ege tïïö yi Goor Rapayim.
english: And three of the thirty chief went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam: and the troop of the Philistines pitched in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Deebit ena kanya näk kar gwøk røk, ni jø leny mo jø Pilitin ge ena kar koor marge Bethelem.
english: And David was then in an hold, and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth–lehem.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit pï poge apare ni kööe, «Wui, doo na da ŋat mooc aani ki pïï mo maadha mo käla yi iith mana en dhi kiir Bethelem, doo beer.»
english: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth–lehem, which is by the gate!

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø leny moa na adäk na teek, gena put aay ni dønyge dï twïër mar jø leny mo jø Pilitin ki teek, ni putge lwötö ki pïï yi iith mana en dhi kiir Bethelem, ni öge ni käärge käärö, ni kälge gø baŋ Deebit. 'Ba Deebit akweer ki man maath pïï moøgø, ni put gø køny piny jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth–lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: nevertheless he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kara tïme ni bäär ki pïïögø. Kiper pïï moøgø caala rem jiy moa cøø na cïp dëëtge.» Kiper manøgønø, Deebit akweer ki man maath pïï moøgø. 'Ba man beeye gïrpiny aciel røk jammi moa tïïc jø lenynyi moa teek na näk adäk.
english: And he said, Be it far from me, O Lord, that I should do this: is not this the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mighty men.

anywaa: 'Ba Abicay cöök Jöapi o Dheruya beeye wïth jø leny moa teek moa näk pïëradäk. Ena këëdö ki tøŋ ki jiy ma dïpe adäk ni 'näk geni, ni put tïmö na ŋat mo nyeŋŋe owïnyö ni caala nyeŋ jøøa na adäk.
english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief among three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them, and had the name among three.

anywaa: 'Ba ena dhaanhø mo owøørø døc ki røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk, ni put tïmö ni ena kwääy lwaak marge. 'Ba eni kär pïï kar jøøa na adäk.
english: Was he not most honourable of three? therefore he was their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.
