anywaa: 'Ba ŋat leny mør mo teek beeye Benaya o Jööda nyï Kapcël. 'Ba ena tïïö ki jap thwønh mo thööth døc. Eni jø Möap ariiø ma jø leny mo teek anääe. Eni thuwø, ena ci yi buur ni 'näge ki ŋuu dïcäŋ aciel ni piny da pey.
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

anywaa: Ni ö nyï Ijepi mo dëëre dwøŋ ni 'näk gø thuwø. 'Ba nyï Ijep mana nääe enø, cere da tøŋ kar kaace. 'Ba Benaya aci baŋ gø ni eni käära athøra, ni cööt tøŋ wøk cer nyï Ijep, ni put gø 'näk ki tøŋ mar gø.
english: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moøgø beege moa tïïc Benaya o Jööda, ni put tïmö ni nyeŋŋe owïnyö ni caala nyeŋ jøøa na adäk na teek døc.
english: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among three mighty men.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni ena dhaanhø mo owøørø ki røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk. 'Ba eni kär pïï kar jøøa na adäk. 'Ba ena røøny Deebiti na wïth jø koor moe.
english: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk mo ge ena røk jøøa näk pïëradäk na teek beege Acaël cöök Jöapi, ki El-Anan o Dödö nyï Bethelem,
english: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth–lehem,

anywaa: ki Cimia ki Elieka jø Aaröt,
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

anywaa: ki Këleth nyï Bëëth-Pëlët, ki Ira wär Ikëc nyï Tëköa,
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

anywaa: ka Abiedhar nyï Anathöth, ki Mabunay nyï Uca,
english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

anywaa: ki Jaalmön nyï Aköki, ki Maaray nyï Nethöpa,
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

anywaa: ki Këlëp o Baanaa nyï Nethöpa, ki Itay o Ribay nyï Giba na en kur jø tuuŋ Benjamen,
english: Heleb the son of Baanah, a Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai out of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

anywaa: ki Benaya nyï Pirathön, ki Iday nyï waŋ naam Geäc,
english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,

anywaa: ka Abi-Albön nyï Arba, ka Adhemawët nyï Baurim,
english: Abi–albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

anywaa: ki Eliaba nyï Caalbön, ki Jacen nyï Gidhön,
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, of the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

anywaa: ki Jönathan o Cimia nyï Arar, ka Akiam o Carar nyï Arar,
english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Hararite,

anywaa: ki Elipelet wär Acbay nyï Maika, ki Eliam wär Akithöpël nyï Gilö,
english: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maachathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

anywaa: ki Edharø nyï Karmël, ki Paaray nyï Araba,
english: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

anywaa: ki Igal o Nathan nyï Dhöba, ki Bani nyï Gaat,
english: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

anywaa: ki Cëlëk nyï Amön, ki Nakaray nyï Bëëröth, nyen wø käär jap leny jï Jöap o Dheruya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armourbearer to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

anywaa: ki Ira nyï Jëtër, ki Garëp nyï Jëtër,
english: Ira an Ithrite, Gareb an Ithrite,

anywaa: ko Uria nyï Këth. 'Ba ge bëët gena jiy ma pïëradäk ka abïriiø.
english: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ wëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni tïïc Deebit nee tïïe ki gïn mo duunnö ki gïn mo raac bäätge. Ni kööe jï Deebit, ni «Ciï ni kwaanï jø Icriel ki tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Juuda.»
english: And again the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he moved David against them to say, Go, number Israel and Judah.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit aköö jï Jöap, kwääy lwaa leny na en buute, ni «Ennø, ï cøø ni caathï bäät wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, ki mano täge ki Daan këël mano këët Bëërcïïba, ni kwaanï jø leny, kiper nee kwäänge ŋääa.»
english: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host, which was with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, and number ye the people, that I may know the number of the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap aköö jï nyeya, ni «Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøï ni meet jiyï kwöre ma dïpa ni kaala moi ni nut ii, ni putï gø joot ki waŋï, ï na nyeya. ?'Ba ennø, Awuuö, ï na nyeya mara, jiy manynyï gø kiper ŋø nee ge kwaan?»
english: And Joab said unto the king, Now the Lord thy God add unto the people, how many soever they be, an hundredfold, and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it: but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing?

anywaa: 'Ba luum nyeya atïmö ni teek bäät Jöap ki kwääc lwaae mo leny. Kanyøgønø, Jöap ki kwääc lwaae mo leny gena put ö wøk ki baŋ nyeya, ni putge aay ni ge cøøa kuna kwaange jø Icriel.
english: Notwithstanding the king's word prevailed against Joab, and against the captains of the host. And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king, to number the people of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïŋŋö ni ŋølge Naam Jördan, ni tïïcge twïër marge buut Aröör, pääny mana en dï gool mana en ŋööm jø tuuŋ Gaat. Køøre gena pööth Jadher.
english: And they passed over Jordan, and pitched in Aroer, on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad, and toward Jazer:

anywaa: Ni pööthge Gelät ki Kadëc na en ŋööm jø Këth, ni pööthge Daan Jaan, ni løøge rege bäät caam, ni cige Caydan jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi; and they came to Dan–jaan, and about to Zidon,

anywaa: Ni cige pääny mana cwøl ni Tayar, na näk ogeerø ni teek, ni cige yïth päänye mo jø Ëwi ki päänye mo jø Keenan bëët, këël mana putge pïï Bëërcïïba na en Juuda jï kuna näk da tier-piny.
english: And came to the strong hold of Tyre, and to all the cities of the Hivites, and of the Canaanites: and they went out to the south of Judah, even to Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø caathge dï ŋöömö bäre, gena duu Jerucalem køør dwäde abïŋween ki nïne ma pïërariiø.
english: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap kwään jiy moa kwaane acïbe jï nyeya ma Deebit; ni jiy moa teek na näk leny løny jïge dï Icriel beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abära; 'ba jø tuuŋ Juuda beege jiy ma kume ma dïpe abïïc.
english: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit cwïnye apädhö ki køør mana nø kwaan jiy. Kanyøgønø, Deebit alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana nø bääyö døc ki køør gïna tïïa. 'Ba ennø, beerra man wëënnï raay 'moa, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper aani gïnögø atïïa ni wïïa kära caarø.»
english: And David's heart smote him after that he had numbered the people. And David said unto the Lord, I have sinned greatly in that I have done: and now, I beseech thee, O Lord, take away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti maal ka amöölla, dwør Wuuö Jwøk onø ö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Gaat, ŋat wø car jammi jï Deebit ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ni kööe,
english: For when David was up in the morning, the word of the Lord came unto the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ Deebit ni caanï luumma jïre, ni kööï ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, luup adäk cïba nyïmï, niï jëëtï ki luubö aciel rege, mo tïïa tïïö dëërï.› »
english: Go and say unto David, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things; choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gaat aö baŋ Deebit ni caan luummögø jï Deebit, ni kööe jïgø, «?A luubö mane ni beer røk moi? ?Beerra man ö käci paarï ki cwiiri adäk? ?Wala beerra man ö nyïïmän moï ni ŋwiecge køøru ki dwäde adäk nou rïïŋö? ?Wala beerra man ö täwi mo leth døc ni ö bäätu yi ŋöömmu ki nïne adäk? Ennø, cädï ni jierï gïno døøa ki gø jï Jwøk na jääŋ aani.»
english: So Gad came to David, and told him, and said unto him, Shall seven years of famine come unto thee in thy land? or wilt thou flee three months before thine enemies, while they pursue thee? or that there be three days' pestilence in thy land? now advise, and see what answer I shall return to him that sent me.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aköö jï Gaat, ni «Gïïögø bëët duua bëëtö mo teek kipera. Beerra man tïmwa ni wa pätha cer Wuuö Jwøk, kiper mëër mare dwøŋ; 'ba kär wa tïmö ni wa pätha cer dhaanhø.»
english: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let us fall now into the hand of the Lord; for his mercies are great: and let me not fall into the hand of man.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk täw mo leth døc aput jääŋŋö bäät jø Icriel ki mana täge ka amöölla maneca këël mana pääŋ kanya many Wuuö Jwøki; ni ö jø Icrielli ma kume ma pïërabïriiø ni putge thøø, ki mana täge ki Daan këël mana këët Bëërcïïba.
english: So the Lord sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beer–sheba seventy thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyïïatwiel maalli na rwiec cere nee Jerucalem raanynye, Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye apädhö kiper gïna leth na tägö dëët jiy, ni kööe jï nyïïatwiel maal mana 'näk jiy, «Manøgø rømø nø. Ennø, jook cerï nø.» 'Ba kar kaagø, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk ena buut laara mar Arawna nyï Jeebuc.
english: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the Lord repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na joot nyïïatwiel maal mana 'näk jiy, ena lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, beeye aani na bääyö, na tïïc gïn mo raac. ?'Ba jiy moi ni caal rööm ii, agïnaŋø na baacge? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man tïm cerï ni ena dëëra ki jø dhi øt wära.»
english: And David spake unto the Lord when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gaat aput ö baŋ Deebit dïcäŋögø ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ciï ni tïï jï Wuuö Jwøk ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace yi laara mar Arawna nyï Jeebuc.»
english: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput aay ki køør mana caan Gaati jïre, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the Lord commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba Arawna alwïthö piny ni joot nyeya ma Deebit ki jø kööre moe ni ge ŋunna jï kuna näk da eni; ni ö Arawna ni aa wøk baŋ nyeya ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø.
english: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.

anywaa: Køøre Arawna aköö, «?Wui nyeya, u öömu ŋø baŋa?» 'Ba aløk Deebiti, na «A ööi kaper nee laara marï ŋeea, kiper naa tïïa jï Wuuö Jwøk ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, kiper nee täwa leth na nø tägö ki køør ajäl Jwøk nee aae bäät jiy.»
english: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the Lord, that the plague may be stayed from the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Arawna aköö jï Deebit, «Wui Awuuö, ï na nyeya, beerra man kälï gïna manynyï jaak, ni cïpï gø jï Wuuö Jwøk. Neenï, dhäk mo løny jïrï ki man cïpï ge no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre nut yøø. Këël jer dïn ki jer puur mo wø rïï ŋut dhäk yøøgø thuwø. Løny jïrï ki man wääŋï ki geni.
english: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.

anywaa: Wui nyeya, jammi bëët yøønø, acïba jïrï.» 'Ba Arawna acäŋ köö jï nyeya, ni «Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk gïna manynyï thur kare.»
english: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The Lord thy God accept thee.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Arawna, ni «Ba løny; japï ba käla ki wat jaak. Ka adïëri møn, gïïögø ŋeea ŋeeø baŋï ki gwel, kiper aani a ba cïpi jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo bäŋ gïn mo yaa coolø kiperge.» Kanyøgønø, Deebit laara ki dhäk aput ŋeew ki gwet-bïrö ma pïërabïïc.
english: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the Lord my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Deebit aput tïïö jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni put cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër. Køøre nø, Wuuö Jwøk lam mar Deebit, mana läme ki gø kiper paac, aløøe, ni ö täwa leth na tägö bäät jø Icriel ki køør ajäl Jwøk ni put cuŋŋö.
english: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the Lord was entreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nyeya ma Deebit na jaal ni cwiiye oløny ni thööth, eni dëëre atïmö ni da köö, ni tïm dëëre ni ba murri, këël na bëëde ni dëëre rïëp jiyi rïëbö ka aleeŋŋa.
english: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.

anywaa: Køøre jø tïïc moe gena köö jïre, ni «Ï na nyeya marwa, beerra man määnywa jïrï ki nyakøø jïrï mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, nee bëëde ki ïïni niï tïnynye, nee buude nyïmï, kiper nee dëërï murre.»
english: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, gena määnyö ki nyakøø mo kïte mïërö dï ŋööm Icriel bäre, ni jootge Abicak nyi jø Cunem ni kälge gø baŋ nyeya.
english: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

anywaa: 'Ba nyakøø manøgø mïërö døc; ni ö eni ni put bëëtö ni tïnynya nyeya; 'ba nyeya kär buut ki eni na dhaagø.
english: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit wääde ma Adöniya mana nywøle ki cïïe ma Agith ree athïïŋe ni kööe, ni «Aani, a tïmö ni aana nyeya.» Kanyøgønø, eni jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi, ki jiy ma pïërabïïc mo rïïŋi nyïme ajiiŋŋe.
english: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.

anywaa: 'Ba wänni bäŋ kany mo wääde ee jooø yi gø ni pëëny gø, na «?Aŋø, ï tïmmï ŋø ki gïnögø?» 'Ba Adöniya, ena dhaanhø mo kïte mïërö; ni eni käla køør Abëcëlöm.
english: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.

anywaa: 'Ba Adöniya acäänö ki Jöap o Dheruya ka Abiethaar na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni ö geni ni jïëcge eni ni tïmge ni ge ena løøe.
english: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ maya, ki Benaya o Jööda, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Cimiy, ki Rëi, ki jø leny moa teek mo Deebit, ge ba en løø Adöniya.
english: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Adöniya dïëk ki dhäk ki nyïïrøøe moa no olør acïbe no olämme deŋ Kïn Dhöëlët, na en buut jøøro mana cwøl ni Ayn-Rögëël; ni cwøl uut wänni bëët, ni beege wäät nyeya, ki jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët mo wø tïny nyeya.
english: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En–rogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Benaya, ki jø leny moa teek, ko owänni ma Cølöman käre cwølø.
english: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Nathan acäänö ki Bathcïba mii Cølöman, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, kärï wïnynyö na ö Adöniya wär Agith na nø tïme na nyeya, ni wänni ma nyeya marø ma Deebit bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe kiper gø?
english: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ööï, niï cäänna ki luubö mo kwøwa ïïni ki wäädï ma Cølöman.
english: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man laarï ci baŋ nyeya ma Deebit ni kööï jïre, ‹?Wui nyeya mara, aŋø, ï kär kööŋ jïra na bëëde, ni kööï ni wääda ma Cølöman läwa karï na nyeya, nee pï piny bäät wälu marï? ?Aŋø, aperŋø nø na ö Adöniya na tïme na nyeya?›
english: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kanyo poode niï poot cäänö kaace ki nyeya, aani a puta ö køørï ni meeda dhi luummï.»
english: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Bathcïba aput ci baŋ nyeya kar niine mar gø. 'Ba kar kaagø nyeya oløny na jaal døc, na Abicak nyi jø Cunem bëëdö ni tïnynya eni.
english: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.

anywaa: Køøre Bathcïba cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm nyeya ni määtha gø. Ni kö nyeya jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?»
english: And Bath–sheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jï nyeya, ni «Ï na nyeya mara, ïïna kööŋ jïra ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni beeye Jwøk marï, ni kööï ni wääda ma Cølöman läwa karï na nyeya, nee pï piny bäät wälu marï.
english: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the Lord thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, neenï, Adöniya anø tïmö na nyeya; ni ï na nyeya mara, bäŋ gïn mo ŋäyï kiper gø.
english: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni nø cïpe ki dhäk mo thööth, ki nyïïrøøe moa no olør mo thööth ki dïëk mo thööth no olämme, ni nø cwøl wäätï bëët, ka Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jöap kwääy lwaa leny; 'ba eni wäädï ma Cølöman ni wø tïny ïïni käre cwølø.
english: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na nyeya mara en, jø Icriel bëët raŋŋa jïrï, ki ŋato caanï jïge nee pï piny bäät wälu marï noo läw karï na nyeya.
english: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na nyeya, ni näk mo ŋato dööŋ karï ba caanï, kanyo näk mo ïïno thøw, ni läpï køør kwäyu, aani ki wääda ma Cølöman wa put ka tïïc kaamar jiy mo obääyö.»
english: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni nyijøøgø poot cäänö ki nyeya, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan aput öö.
english: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï nyeya, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan nut kany.» 'Ba kanya ö nyïm nyeya, eni cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø.
english: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.

anywaa: Køøre Nathan aköö, ni «?Ï na nyeya mara, aŋø, iï caanø cøøn na Adöniya läwa karï na nyeya, nee pï piny bäät wälu marï?
english: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋi ena løøc piny kunece ni cïpe ki dhäk mo thööth, ki nyïïrøøe moa no olør mo thööth, ki dïëk mo thööth no olämme; ni nø cwøl wäätï bëët, ki kwääc lwaae mo leny, ka Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ; ni ennø, ge cämö ni ge mädhö nyïme, ni ge köö, ni ‹Nyeya ma Adöniya puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!›
english: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.

anywaa: 'Ba këël aani na dhaanhnhï kiree en, ki Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ maya, ki Benaya o Jööda, ki wäädï ma Cølöman ni wø tïny ïïni, kär cwøl Adöniya.
english: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na nyeya mara, gïn tïïya ïïni kiree, ni ba nyoothï ŋato läw karï na nyeya noo pï piny bäät wälu marï jï jø tïïc moï?»
english: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aløk nyeya ma Deebit ni kööe, ni «Cwøllu Bathcïba jïra.» Køøre Bathcïba aput ö baŋ nyeya ni cuŋŋe nyïm nyeya.
english: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bath–sheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya akööŋ ni kööe, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, eni na wïïl aani wøk ki yïth gïïa leth bëët,
english: And the king sware, and said, As the Lord liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, kaawat mana kööŋa jïrï ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel, na kööa, ni ‹Wäädï ma Cølöman läwa kara na nyeya, ni pï piny kara bäät wälu›, aani gïnögø tïïa tïïö na enøgønø dïcäŋi.»
english: Even as I sware unto thee by the Lord God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Bathcïba cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm nyeya ni kööe, ni «Beerra man bëët nyeya mara ma Deebit na bäre bäre!»
english: Then Bath–sheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit aköö, ni «Cwøllu Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Benaya o Jööda jïra.» Ni put jøøgø ö nyïm nyeya.
english: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya jïge, ni «Aayu ki jø kööre 'moa, ni tïïyu wääda ma Cølöman nee cäädhe ki bäät gääŋŋö mara, ni kïthu gø piny bäät Giyön.
english: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, wär wï gø thïïmmu ki maaw ni røønynyu gø na nyeya bäät jø Icriel, ni koothu tuuŋ ni kööu, ni ‹Nyeya  ma Cølöman puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!›
english: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.

anywaa: Køøre u cäädhö køøre, ni ööe ni pï piny bäät wälu mara ni läw kara na nyeya; kiper eni, ena nø tïïa na nyeya bäät jø Icriel ki jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët.»
english: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø Benaya o Jööda ajutö jï nyeya ni kööe, ni «Kare. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye Jwøk marï, ï na nyeya mara, ni wëëk gïnögø thur kare.
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the Lord God of my lord the king say so too.

anywaa: Kaawat mana nø bëët Wuuö Jwøki ki ï na nyeya mara, beerra man ö eni ni bëëde ki Cølöman thuwø, ni tïïc nyec mar gø ni dwøŋ ni kaala nyec marï, ï na nyeya mara ma Deebit.»
english: As the Lord hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Benaya o Jööda, ki jø leny mo wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita, gena ci piny kunece ni Cølöman ege tïïö ni cäädhi ka bäät gääŋŋö mar nyeya ma Deebit, ni kïthge eni bäät Giyön.
english: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, tuuŋ mana en maar röönynyi yie alwøre yo oduŋkaara mar Jwøk, ni thii maaw wï Cølöman ni røønya gø na nyeya. Køøre geni tuuŋ aputge kooth, ni ö jiyi bëët ni köge, ni «Nyeya ma Cølöman puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!»
english: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaanhø bäre ni put ci køør Cølöman, ni jøw kudhö ko opele ni yïth jøw met ki met ec mo dwøŋ døc, ni ö pinynyi ni tïme ni jääŋŋi ki dööt jiy.
english: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Adöniya ki jiy moa cwøle na en buute bëët gïnögø awïnyge, kanya lønyge ki cam. 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi na wïny dwør tuuŋ, ena köö, «?Aŋø, jø pääny, ge kwöŋge na enøgønø aperŋø?»
english: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni eni poot cäänö, Jönathan wär Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aput pïï. Køøre Adöniya aköö, ni «Ööï nø, bee ï dhaanhø mana na adïëri noo käl waac mo beer.»
english: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.

anywaa: 'Ba aput Jönathanni løk jï Adöniya ni kööe, ni «Jïre bäär! Nyeya marø ma Deebit, Cølöman anø tïïe na nyeya.
english: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya thuwø ni nø jääŋ Dhadök na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Benaya o Jööda, ki jø wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita; ni ö geni ni nø tïïcge Cølöman nee cäädhe ki bäät gääŋŋö mar nyeya.
english: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:

anywaa: Ni ö Dhadöki na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan ni nø thïïmge wï Cølöman ki maaw ni ge røønya gø na nyeya bäät Giyön, ni jøw ööi ki kunece ennø ni yïth jøw met; ni beeye ni bëët jø päänynyi ni kwöŋŋö en. Ni beeye döötge na wïnynyu enø.
english: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø Cølöman anø pï piny bäät wälu mar paac bäre.
english: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, jø kööre mo nyeya gena ö kuna gwïëthge nyeya marø ma Deebit ni ge köö, ni ‹Beerra man ö Jwøki marï ni tïïc nyeŋ Cølöman nee wïnye ni kaala wïny nyeŋ marï, ni ö nyec mare ni tïme ni dwøŋ ni kaala nyec marï.› Køøre nyeya cøŋŋe akëël piny bäät pëëm mare ni pwøya Jwøk.
english: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni ‹Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na cïpö ki wääda mo pï piny bäät wälu mara dïcäŋi ni jooda gø ki waŋa.› »
english: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy moa en buut Adöniya na cwøle bëët, dëëtge aput tïmö ni kwanynyi; ni öge maal ni putge keethø.
english: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

anywaa: 'Ba Adöniya aput lwäyö ki Cølöman, ni ö maal ni aae ni put tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mak.
english: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Cølöman, ni købi, ni «Neenï, Adöniya alwäyö ki ï na nyeya; ni ennø, tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ee maaø, ni kööe, ni ‹Beerra man kööŋ nyeya ma Cølömanni jïra dïcäŋi, ni aani na dhaanhnhe, naa ba nääe.› »
english: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman aköö, «Ni näk mo eni bëëdö ki bëëtö mo beer, këël jëën wïïe aciel kiree bäŋgø mo päth piny; 'ba ni näk mo da gïn mo raac mo tïïe tïïö, eni  thøw.»
english: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cølöman ajääk baŋe ki jiy, ni kälge gø wøk ki buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Ni ööe ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm nyeya ma Cølöman, ni kö Cølömanni jïre, ni «Ci paarï.»
english: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm kar thøw Deebiti ni cään, wääde ma Cølöman acäänne ni kööe,
english: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ennø, kara aløny ni cään ki man thøøa, naa cøøa jöör wø caath jø bäät pinynyi bëët. 'Ba ïïni, bëëdï niï teek, ni nyoothï cwøw marï.
english: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;

anywaa: Gwøk gïï wø many Wuuö Jwøki Jwøk marï, ni caathï jööre, ni gwøgï ciik moe, ki luup moa ceme, ki luup ŋøl moe, ki pwöc moe, kaawat mana no ogöörö yi wëël ciik Modhe, nee jammi bëët mo wø tïïyï nee wø thurge karge kwör wø bëëdï yïthge bëët,
english: And keep the charge of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:

anywaa: kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk luumme mana caane kipera nee wëëk thur kare, na kööe, ni ‹Ni näk mo jiy moo käl dëërï wïthge koorge koorø ki bëëtö marge, ni bëëtge ni ge tïïya adïëri nyïma ki cwïnyge bäre, otïmö niï ba can ki ŋat pï piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.›
english: That the Lord may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø thuwø, gïna tïïc Jöapi o Dheruya dëëra ŋäyï, ni beeye gïna tïïe dëët kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø Icriel moa na ariiø, ni beege Abinër o Nër ka Amaaca o Jether, na nääe jaak ni bäŋ leny, ni ö remø marge ni neeker dëër kaw mare ki war moe moa en tiete.
english: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, tïïyï ki køør leec wïc marï; këël na bëëde ni wïïe da lwaar, kär weyï nee thøøe keere; wär 'nägï.
english: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.

anywaa: «'Ba mëër marï wär nyoothï jï wäät Bardhilay nyï Gelät, ni tïïyï geni nee cämge na aciel ki jø wø cämö bäät tharabëëta marï; kiper aana kønyge kanya päära wøk naa ŋwieya owäru ma Abëcëlöm.
english: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.

anywaa: «'Ba Cimiy o Gëra nyï Benjamen na käl Baurim, ni en buutï enø, beeye eni na jany aani ka ajaany mo leth døc dïcäŋa cøøa Maanayim. 'Ba kanya ööe na jul aani bäät Naam Jördan, aana kööŋ jïre ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni kööa, ni ‹Aani, ï ba nääa.›
english: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the Lord, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kär raŋï kaamar dhaanhø mo kär bääyö; kee ïïna dhaanhø mo wïïï leer, mo gïno tïïyï dëëre ŋäyï. 'Ba eni, këël na bëëde ni wïïe da lwaar enø, wär 'nägï.»
english: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi pääny mare ni wø cwøl ni Pääny Deebit.
english: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Deebiti ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel beege cwiiri ma pïëraŋween; ni cwiiri abïriiø beede Keeprön ni ena nyeya, ni cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurdäk beede Jerucalem ni ena nyeya.
english: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö Cølömanni ni bëëde bäät wälu mar wänni ma Deebit, ni ö tier nyec mare ni këëlli piny ni teek.
english: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.

anywaa: 'Ba Adöniya wär Agith aö baŋ Bathcïba mii Cølöman. Ni kö nyijøøgø jïre, ni «?Marï öö jaak?» Køøre ena köö, «Yaa, mara öö jaak.»
english: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö, ni «Aani da gïn mo daa caanø jïrï.» Ni kö nyijøøgø, ni «Caanï.»
english: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø ena köö, ni «Ŋäyï ni nyec beeye mara na dee bëëdö, ni jø Icriel bëët ge raŋŋa aani naa tïmö na nyeya; 'ba nyec akäl wøk cera ni mëëgi owära, kiper beeye mare cøøn ni cïpa Wuuö Jwøki jïre.
english: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, da gïrpiny aciel miï pëënynya pëënynyö ki gø; 'ba kär luumma kwierï.» 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö jïre, ni «Caanï.»
english: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

anywaa: Ni kö Adöniya, na «A kwaya ïïni niï cäänï ki nyeya ma Cølöman, kiper na Abicak nyi jø Cunem nee cïbe jïra na dhaagø, kiper eni luummï ba kwiere.»
english: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Bathcïba aköö, ni «Beer, aani, a cäänö ki nyeya kiperï.»
english: And Bath–sheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Bathcïba aput ci baŋ nyeya ma Cølöman nee cääne ki gø  kiper Adöniya. 'Ba kanya ö menni ma Bathcïba, nyeya aput ö maal, ni kuul wïïe piny ni määtha gø, ni pï piny bäät wälu mare, ni cwöte ki wälu jï menni, nee menni pï piny bääte bäät cwïïc.
english: Bath–sheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, menni aköö, ni «Aani da luubö aciel mo thiinh miï pëënynya pëënynyö ki gø; kär luubö mara kwierï.» 'Ba nyeya aköö jïre, ni «Pëëï, ayaŋ; a ba kweer ki luummï.»
english: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.

anywaa: Ni kö menni, ni «Beerra man ö Abicak nyi jø Cunem ni cïbi jï owäru ma Adöniya na dhaagø jïre.»
english: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeye ma Cølöman jï menni ni kööe, na «?Aŋø ni pëënynyï Abicak nyi jø Cunem nee cïp jï Adöniya en? ?Aŋø, manøgønø, ï ba pëëny nyec nee wëëk eni thuwø, eni ki jiye, ni beege Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki Jöap o Dheruya? Kiper beeye eni no owära mana dwøŋ.»
english: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyeya ma Cølöman akööŋ ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Ni näk mo luubö mana caan Adöniya en ba duunni ki thøø bääte, aani, a raany Jwøki raanynyø.
english: Then king Solomon sware by the Lord, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.

anywaa: Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw, na këël tier nyec mara piny na cïp aani bäät wälu mar wära ma Deebit, na tïïc dhi øtø mara ni teek ki køør mana caane, ka adïëri møn, dïcäŋi Adöniya di nääö.»
english: Now therefore, as the Lord liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya ma Cølöman, Benaya o Jööda aput jääŋŋö, ni ö Benaya ni cøøe ni put Adöniya 'näk ni put thøø.
english: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Abiethaar na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni «Ci ya Anathöth kanya en pwöthi moï yie. Doo na ï rømi ka thøø cøøn. 'Ba ennø, ï ba nääa, kiper ïïni acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy atïïyï nee kääri nyïm wära ma Deebit, ni caan ïïni na aciel ki wära bëët.»
english: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø Cølöman, Abiethaar aput mänö ki man bëëde ni ena dïlämi jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni put luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki Cëëlö kiper dhi øt Ëli  thur kare.
english: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the Lord; that he might fulfil the word of the Lord, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moøgø awïnyö baŋ Jöap. Ni ö Jöapi ni reŋ yi kal mana en oduŋkaara mar Wuuö Jwøk yie, ni mak tuk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte; kiper Jöap, këël na bëëde ni eni kär dwätö ka Abëcëlöm ra ageem, ennø ena dwätö ka Adöniya.
english: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï nyeya ma Cølöman ni Jöap onø reŋ yi kal mana en oduŋkaara mar Wuuö Jwøk yie, ni eni ena deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Køøre Cølöman, Benaya o Jööda aput jääŋŋö ni kööe, ni «Ciï ni 'nägï gø.»
english: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the Lord; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Benaya aput ci baŋ Jöap kanya en oduŋkaara mar Wuuö Jwøk yie, ni kööe jïre, ni «Nyeya aköö, ni ‹Ö wøk.› » 'Ba ena köö, ni «Jïra bäär; aani, a puta thøø kany.» Køøre Benaya luubö acäŋ dwøk baŋ nyeya, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye luubö mana caan Jöapi jïra.»
english: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Benaya, ni «Tïïyï kaawat mana caane. 'Nägï ni koonyï gø, na ajäl kwör rem jiy moa køny Jöapi piny ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak nee kälï wøk bääta ki dhi øt wära.
english: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni dwøk kwör rem jiy moa køny piny wïïe, kiper eni jiy ariiø mo beerra bëëtö marge ki mare anääe ko opëëllö, ni beege Abinër o Nër, kwääy lwaa leny mar jø Icriel, ka Amaaca o Jether, kwääy lwaa leny mo jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni wära ma Deebit bäŋ gïn ŋääe kipere.
english: And the Lord shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man bëët kwör remø marge ni ena wï Jöap ki nyïïkwaaye na bäre bäre; 'ba Deebit ki nyïïkwaaye, ki jø dhi øde, ki jøw oläw kare bäät wälu mare, geno mooc Wuuö Jwøki ki bëët-mëër mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Benaya o Jööda aput cøø ni 'näk Jöap, ni ö eni ni koonyi  yi øtø mare na en dï paap.
english: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya Benaya o Jööda akïth kar Jöap na kwääy lwaa leny, ni kïth Dhadök kar Abiethaar na dïlämi mana dwøŋ.
english: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ajäägö nee Cimiy cwøl, ni ööe, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Gëëdï ki øtø kiper dëërï Jerucalem kany, ni bëëdï yie; 'ba kär dee kany miï cøøa yie.
english: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋo aayï wøk kany noo ŋølï waŋ Naam Kidaran, wär put ŋäc na adïëri niï puta thøø; ni ö kwör remø marï ni døø wïïï keerï.»
english: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimiy aköö jï nyeya, ni «Luubö mana caanï enø beeye kare. Kaawat mana caanï gø, ï na nyeya mara, aani, a na dhaanhnhï, gïnögø tïïa tïïö.» Kanyøgønø, Cimiy aput bëëtö Jerucalem ki kany mo bäär.
english: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri adäk, laaŋe ariiø mo Cimiy apäär wøk ni reŋge baŋ Akïc o Maika, nyeny jø Gëth. 'Ba acaan jï Cimiy, ni købi, ni «Neenï, laaŋe moï ge ena Gëth.»
english: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cimiy aput ö maal ni jiiŋ arëën mare, ni ci Gëth baŋ Akïc kuna many laaŋe moe, ni käl geni.
english: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Cølöman ni Cimiy anø aay Jerucalem ni nø ci Gëth, ni nø duue.
english: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyeya ajäägö nee Cimiy cwøl, ni ööe, ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aŋø, ï kära tïïö niï kööŋï ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, ni köömma ïïni døøc ni kööa, ni ‹Wär ŋäyï na adïëri ni dïcäŋo aayï noo ciï kanymør, ï puta thøø›? Ni kööï jïra, ni ‹Luubö mana caanï jïra beeye kare.›
english: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the Lord, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kööŋ mana kööŋï ki gø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki köömmö mana köömma ïïni ki gø, ba gwøgï gø aperŋø?»
english: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the Lord, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?

anywaa: Ni cäŋ nyeya köö jï Cimiy, ni «Ïïni jammi bëët moa reyø na tïïyï dëër wära ma Deebit ŋäyï ki cwïnyï. Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk raay moï dwøge wïïï.
english: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the Lord shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;

anywaa: 'Ba aani na nyeya ma Cølöman en, a di gwïëdhö, ni ö nyec mar Deebit ni bëëde ni tiere okëët piny ni teek nyïm Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre.»
english: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord for ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Benaya o Jööda aput nyeya köömmö, ni ci Benaya ni put Cimiy 'näk ni put thøø. Køøre tier nyec aput këët piny ni teek jï Cølöman.
english: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman adwätö ki Peerø  nyeny jø Ijep ki køør mana nywøm nyi Peerø, ni lwør gø ni käl gø yi Pääny Deebit, këël mana thöör øtø mare ki geer, ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki kiir mar Jerucalem.
english: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, jiy olämme poot cïpge kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri, kiper poot bäŋ øtø mo ogeerø jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the Lord, until those days.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni eni cäädhi ka køør luup moa caan wänni ma Deebit jïre. 'Ba gïïa tïïe ni ba caana wänni beege olämme ki gïn wø waaŋ ni wø jïye ŋwääi ni met na cïbe kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri.
english: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman aci Gibien kuna cïpe ko olämme yie, kiper kaace beeye kar lam mana dwøŋ na en bäät thuur. Ni ö Cølömanni ni cïpe ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ma kuma bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en kaace.
english: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en Cølömanni Gibien, Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jïre ki yïth lääk ki wäär; ni kööe jïre, ni «Pëëny gïna manynyï nee cïba jïrï.»
english: In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Cølöman aköö, ni «Ïïni, ïïna bëëdö niï nyøtha mëër marï na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit ki køør mana bëëde ni tïïya adïëri nyïmï, ni bëëdö ki bëëtö mo beer, ni cwïnye thïïŋ ki ïïni. 'Ba dïcäŋi ennø, ïïna cïpö ki wääde mo pï piny bäät wälu mare, niï poot nyootha mëër marï na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl jïre.
english: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bee ï na Jwøk mara, a na dhaanhnhï, aana tïïyï na nyeya kar wära ma Deebit; 'ba  aani, a caala nyilaal mo poot thiinh, ni käär jiy kuua.
english: And now, O Lord my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.

anywaa: 'Ba a na dhaanhnhï en, a ena dï jiyï moa näk iï jierø, ni beege jøøa thööth døc na näk ba løny kwaan.
english: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.

anywaa: Ennø, a na dhaanhnhï en, mooc aani ki wïc mo leer, nee luup jiyï ŋøla, nee luubö mo beer ki mo raac nee ŋääa. ?Aŋø, aŋa ni løny jïre ki man käär jiyï moi ni thööth ii?»
english: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö na gïn mo nëëni ni beer ki jï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk kanya ö Cølömanni na pëëny leec wïc.
english: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwøki jïre, ni «Kiper mana pëënynyï leec wïc, niï ba pëëö kaper man bëëdï ki cwiiri mo thööth, niï ba pëëö kaper man bëëdï ni ïïno kwär, niï ba pëëö kaper man thøw nyïïmän moï, 'ba ïïna tïmö ni ï pëënynya man jïtï ki leec wïc man ŋølï luup jiy ki gø,
english: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, aani gïnögø tïïa tïïö ki køør luummï. Neenï, aani, a cïpö jïrï ki leec wïc, nee gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac tïme ni ŋäyï, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo rööma ïïni ki leec wïc ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe, këël yi nyïme.
english: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïï mo kärï pëënynyö cïba cïbö jïrï thuwø, ni beege kwärö ki wödö, kiper nee bäŋe nyeya mo tïmö ni rööma ïïni yïth nïne moo beetï.
english: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï bëëdö niï cäädha køøra, ni gwøgï ciik 'moa ki luup moa cema, kaawat mana bëëde ni wäru ma Deebit caatha køøra, aani, nïne moï tïïa tïïö ni thööth.»
english: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na pääe, gïnögø aput ŋäc ni beeye lääk mo käla baŋ Jwøk. Ni ö eni ni ö Jerucalem ni cuŋŋe nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, ni cïpe ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni tïïe ka ajwöma jï jø kööre moe bëët.
english: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.

anywaa: 'Ba da mään ariiø ma kääpe ma aö nyïm nyeya.
english: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.

anywaa: Ni kö dhaagø acielli, «Wui, ï na nyeya mara, aani ki dhaagø man, wa bëëdö yi øtø aciel; køøre aana lwaar ki nyilaal ni eni nut yi øtø.
english: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, na tïme na køør nïne adäk ni aano nø lwaar, dhaagø man thuwø ena lwaar ki nyilaal, ni bëëtwa na aciel. 'Ba bäŋ dïcwøø mo öö baŋwa yi øtø, 'ba beeye wa keerwa na ariiø ii ni bëëdö yi øtø.
english: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.

anywaa: Køøre, nyaani wääde athøw ki wäär, kiper ena but bääte.
english: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.

anywaa: Køøre ena ö maal ki dhöör dï wäär ni lwør wääda nyïma ni aano butö, ni pïël nyilaal nyïme, ni lwør wääde mana no othøw ni pïël gø nyïma.
english: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääa ka amöölla kiper nee wääda dhwødha, nyilaal aputa joot no othøw; 'ba kanya neena nyilaal døøc ka amöölla, aputa joot ni paa wääda mana nywøla.»
english: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø maya aköö, ni «Jïre bäär; nyilaal mana kwøw beeye wääda, ni nyilaal mana no othøw beeye wäädï.» 'Ba dhaagø mana kwøŋ cäänö aköö, ni «Jïre bäär, nyilaal mana no othøw beeye wäädï, 'ba nyilaal mana kwøw beeye wääda.» 'Ba luup moi beege moa carge nyïm nyeya.
english: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö, ni «Dhaagø man aköö, ni ‹Nyilaal man ni kwøw en beeye wääda, ni nyilaal mana no othøw beeye o nyaanøgø;› ni kö maye, ni ‹Jïre bäär, nyilaal mana no othøw beeye wäädï, 'ba nyilaal man ni kwøw en beeye wääda.› »
english: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö, ni «Kännu ko opëëllö jïra.» Køøre gena kännö ko opëëllö.
english: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya, ni «Pääŋŋu nyilaal manøgø ni kwøw enøgø ki dïëre, ni cïpu thääŋö jï dhaagø aciel, ni cïpu thääŋö maya jï dhaagø maya.»
english: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø mana näk nyilaal mana kwøw beeye mare, cwïnye apädhö døc kiper wääde, ni cääne ki nyeya ni kööe, «Wui, ï na nyeya mara, cïp nyilaal mano ni kwøw enø jï nyaanøgø; kär nyilaal 'nägï.» 'Ba dhaagø maya aköö, ni «Nyilaal man ba tïmö na mara, ni ba tïmö na marï; di pääŋŋö ki dïëre.»
english: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö, ni «Cïpu nyilaal mano ni kwøw enø jï dhaagø mana kwøŋ cäänö; kär nou 'näga nyilaal. Nyijøøgø beeye menni.»
english: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na wïnyge luum ŋøl mana ŋøl nyeya, gena put tïmö ni ge lwäär ki eni; kiper ajootge ni eno nø mooc Jwøki ki leec wïc nee luup wø ŋøle na karge.
english: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman aput bëëtö na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët.
english: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ jiy moe moa kwörge døøŋŋø beege ii: Adhariya o Dhadök beeye Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,

anywaa: 'Ba Eliörëp ka Akiya wäät Cica beege jø wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni Jøcapat wär Akilut beeye nyikugö.
english: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.

anywaa: 'Ba Benaya o Jööda beeye kwääy lwaa leny, ni Dhadök ka Abiethaar beege dïlämme moa døøŋŋø.
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya o Nathan beeye wïth jøøa no ocuumö na kwääri yïth mïëc jø Icriel bëët, ni dïlämi ma Dhabut o Nathan beeye nyawat nyeya.
english: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:

anywaa: 'Ba Aycar beeye wïth jø wø tïïö paan dwøŋ, na Adöniram wär Abda beeye wïth jø tïïc moa näk mak ka teek.
english: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jïre da jiy apaar kurriiø mo ee cuumö yïth mïëc jø Icriel bëët, ni beege jø wø känni ki cam jïre, eni ki jiy mo wø bëëdö paare; ni ŋati man nø dëët jøøgø kännö ki cam ma kar dwääy aciel ki yi cwiir.
english: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jøøka beege ii: Ben-Ur beeye na bëën mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem;
english: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

anywaa: ni Ben-Deker beeye na bëën päänye moa cwøl ni Maakac ki Caalbim ki Bëëth-Camic ki Ëlön-Bëëth-Anan;
english: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beth–shemesh, and Elon–beth–hanan:

anywaa: ni Ben-Ëcëd beeye na bëën päänye moa cwøl ni Aruböth, ki Cökö, ki mïëri moa en ŋøøp Ëpër ge bëët;
english: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Soco, and all the land of Hepher:

anywaa: ni Ben-Abinadap, na nywøm Thapath nyi Cølöman, beeye na bëën mïëri moa en bäät kïnna cwøl ni Dör;
english: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

anywaa: ni Baana wär Akilut beeye na bëën päänye moa cwøl ni Tanak ki Megidø ki Bëëth-Can, ki mïëri bëët moa en buute na en buut pääny Carthan jï løø tier-piny ki pääny Jedhriel, ni tägi ka Bëëth-Can këël mana këët Abël-Mööla ni pïïe løø mïëri moa en buut Jökimiam;
english: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth–shean, which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel, from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam:

anywaa: ni Ben-Gëbër beeye na bëën päänya cwøl ni Ramöth-Gelät, ki päänye moa therø mo Jayer o Maneeca moa en Gelät, ki päänye moa en kanya cwøl na Argöp na en Baacan, ni beege päänye moa näk pïërabïciel na døøŋŋø na näk ogeerø ki kiiri mo dhøkge da dïdëëte mo tïïc ka nywïëny;
english: The son of Geber, in Ramoth–gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:

anywaa: na Akinadap wär Idö beeye na bëën kanya cwøl ni Maanayim;
english: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:

anywaa: na Akimaath, na nywøm Bacimat nyi Cølöman, beeye na bëën jø tuuŋ Naptali;
english: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

anywaa: ni Baana wär Ucay beeye na bëën jø tuuŋ Acer ki päänya cwøl ni Bealöt;
english: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:

anywaa: ni Jøcapat o Paruy beeye na bëën jø tuuŋ Icakar;
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:

anywaa: ni Cimiy wär Ëla beeye na bëën jø tuuŋ Benjamen;
english: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:

anywaa: ni Gëbër wär Uri beeye na bëën jøøa en yi ŋööm Gelät, ni beeye ŋøøpa kwøŋ bëëtö na mo Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör ki Ög nyeny jø Baacan. 'Ba Gëbër keere beeye ŋata bëëdö no ocuumö yïth ŋøøpøgø.
english: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda ki jø Icriel ge thööth døc ni ge caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ; ni ge bëëdö ni ge cämö ni ge mädhö ni yïthge met.
english: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman abëëdö na nyeya, ni wïth juurre bëët ena cere ki mana täge ki Naam Upareeti, këël mana këët yi ŋööm jø Pilitin, ni pïïe waŋ keew ki jø Ijep. Ni ö wïth juurre moøgø ni cïpge ka ajwäk jï Cølöman ni tïnyge eni ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët.
english: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.

anywaa: 'Ba caammi mo wø jiiŋŋi jï Cølöman ki jiye ki dïcäŋ aciel beege møø mo otiit ma rumme ma pïëradäk mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kör, ka auya ma rumme ma pïërabïciel mo røm ka rumi manøgø,
english: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

anywaa: ki dhäk apaar mo olør, ki dhäk ma pïërariiø mo caamma yi pwöla, ki dïëk ma dïpa; ni röönne ki bup ka aŋeri ki gwïën mo olør kär kwaan rege.
english: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jïre da teek bäät jiy bëët ki nyeye moge, ki mana täge ki bäät Naam Upareeti päänya cwøl ni Tipca, këël mana këët päänya cwøl ni Geedha; ni eni bëëdö ki bëët-mëër ki mïëri moa en deŋŋe bëët.
english: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth cwiiri moa beet Cølömanni ni ena nyeya, jø Juuda ki jø Icriel gena put bëëtö ni bäŋ gïn mo lääŋge, ni jøw opï piny jaak ni cam päl, ki mana täge ki Daan, paana en jï løø wï-piny, këël mana këët Bëërcïïba na en jï løø tier-piny.
english: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer–sheba, all the days of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Cølöman jïre da lwääge ma kume aŋween mo wø bëët okwëënyi mo wø tut jïëth leny yïthge, ko okwëënyi mo leny ma kume apaar kurriiø.
english: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa no ocuumö bäät mïëc jø Icriel, ge wø kännö ki caammi jï nyeya ma Cølöman ki jï jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö paare, ni ŋati man nø känni ki kany wø päŋ dwääyi man wø känne yie, ni bëëde ni bäŋ gïn cange.
english: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

anywaa: Ni känge thuwø ki beel ki luum kiper okwëënyi mo wø tut jïëth leny, ko okwëënyi møga, ni kïthge ge kanya wäŋŋi ni kïth yie. Ni ŋati man nø känni ka køør mana caan jïre.
english: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk Cølöman amooe ki leec wïc mo dwøŋ døc, ni tïme ni gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac ŋääe, ni ŋäc jammi mo thööth mo ba løny ki kwaan.
english: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

anywaa: 'Ba leec wïc mar Cølöman aput tïmö ni kaala leec wïc mar jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki leec wïc mar jø Ijep bëët.
english: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.

anywaa: Eni wïïe leer ni kaala leec wïc mar jiy bëët, këël leec wïc mar Ëtan nyï Edhera, ki leec wïc mar wäät Mööl, ni beege Ëman ki Kalköl ki Darda; ni ö nyeŋŋe ni wïnye dï wïth juurre bëët moa en deŋŋe.
english: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.

anywaa: Eni thuwø, ena kän wøk ka aŋaade ma kume adäk mo pwöc leec wïc, ni cääe ki dudi mo kaala kuma.
english: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

anywaa: Ena cäänö thuwø kiper bëët jenni, ni tägi ka jenni moa døøŋŋø na en yi lur Libaanø këël mana këët ri moa thenh thenh ni wø tuy ri kiir; ni cääne kiper bëët lääy ki weny ki gïï wø muuli ki piny, ki rec bëët.
english: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ki røk wïth juurre bëët kuna wïnyge luup mo wø caan Cølömanni ki køør leec wïc mare, ni ge jääŋŋa nyeye bëët mo bäät piny moa wïny leec wïc mare.
english: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Kiram nyeny Tayar na wïny gø ni Cølöman wïïe anø thïïmmi ki maaw ni røønyi na nyeya kar wänni, jø kööre moe ajääŋŋe baŋ Cølöman, kiper eni na Kiram, ge wø bëëdö ni gena nyïïawäädi ki Deebit.
english: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman ajääk baŋ Kiram ki dwøl, ni kööe,
english: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ŋäyï ni wära ma Deebit kär løny jïre ki man gëëde ki øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, kiper lenye moa näk eni ege ciel dïër, këël mana ö  Wuuö Jwøki na kïth nyïïmän moe tiete.
english: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the Lord his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, aana nø mooe ki jwöm, ni tïme ni bäŋ lenye kun ki kun; ni ennø, bäŋ nyïïmän jïra, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac.
english: But now the Lord my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, aani, a manynya man gëëda ki øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jï wära ma Deebit na kööe, ni ‹Wäädï mano tïïa nee pï piny bäät wälu marï noo läw karï, eno gëëdö ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa.›
english: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, caanï jï jiyï nee ge ŋutge ki jenni moa perge leth jïra yi lur Libaanø, ni ge tïïö ka jø tïïc 'moa na aciel; 'ba aani a cïpö ki jammi jï jø tïïc moï ki køør mano caanï; kiper ŋäyï ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋøt jaath ŋääe røkwa mo caala jiyï ma jø Caydan.»
english: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Kiram na wïny luum Cølöman, eni yie aput mïnnö døc, ni kööe, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋi, na mooc Deebit ki wääde mo wïïe leer ki man käär jøøi ni thööth ii.»
english: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.

anywaa: Køøre Kiram aput jäägö ki dwøl jï Cølöman ni kööe, ni «Dwøl mana jääŋŋï baŋa awïnynya; aani, jenni moa manynyï, ni beege dhigba ki thït, jääŋŋa jääŋŋö jïrï.
english: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tïïc 'moa ni kälge geni ki yi lur Libaanø këël bäät naama dwøŋ; ni tïïa geni nee twöc na wïdhi ni käli ki yi naama dwøŋ nee ge kïth kanyo caanï jïra. Køøre ge tïïa tïïö nee ge pät kaace, ni ööu ni lwørru geni. 'Ba ïïni, gïno manynya baŋï beeye ki man mooyï jø wø bëëdö paara ki cam.»
english: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø Kiram, Cølöman aput mooc ki jer dhigba ki thït moa manynye jaak.
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman, Kiram amooe ki beel ma rumme ma kume ma pïërariiø mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kör,  nee cam jø wø bëëdö paare, ki maaw mana tøŋ ma rumme ma pïërariiø mo røm ka rumi manøgø; ni gïïögø cïp Cølömanni cïbö jï Kiram ki yi cwiir cooth.
english: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk leec wïc acïbe jï Cølöman ki køør mana caan gø jïgø, ni ö Kirammi ki Cølöman ni jït yïthakicge ki bëët-mëër, ni ö geni na ariiø yøø ni tutge ki luubö yïthakicge.
english: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cølöman acwötö ki jø tïïc mo maae ka teek ki dï Icriel bäre, ni ö kwään jø tïïci moøgø na mak ki teek yøø ni tïmge na jiy ma kume ma pïëradäk.
english: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni jääŋ geni yi lur Libaanø, ni jääŋŋe na jiy ma kume apaar ni rege welge wellø ki yi dwääy cooth; ni moi nø bëëdö yi lur Libaanø ki dwääy aciel, ni bëëtge paac ki dwäde ariiø. 'Ba Adöniram bëëdö na wïth jø tïïc moø no omaaø ki teek yøø.
english: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jïre da jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø ma jø tëër, ki jiy ma kume ma pïërabära ma jø tøk ki kïte bäät kïte,
english: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;

anywaa: ni da jic Cølöman møøk ma kume adäk ki dïpe adäk mo geno cuum Cølömanni na kwääri mo käär tïïc manøgø.
english: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre nyeya ma Cølöman acïpö ki dwøl, ni ö jø tïïci ni tööge ki kïte mo døøŋŋø, ni beege kïte moa perge leth, ni kïte moøgø tøkge ni tiir na mo täk tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki geni.
english: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba jø geer mo Cølöman ki jø geer mo Kiram ki jø Gëbal, kïte ki jenni mo geerge Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki ge ajiiŋge.
english: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabära ni jø Icriel onø ö wøk ki Ijep, ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Cølömanni ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel, yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Jïp, ni beeye dwää ariiø, Cølöman atägö ki man geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø manøgø na geer nyeya ma Cølömanni jï Wuuö Jwøk enø, bär mare  mar piny beeye gööye ma pïërabïciel, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye ma pïëradäk, mo røm ka cenø.
english: And the house which king Solomon built for the Lord, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba agööl Øt Jwøk, na dïët ki thääŋ øtø mana cwøl ni thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere, bär mare mar piny caala rumi mar dööŋ yi Øt Jwøk, ni beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye apaar.
english: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø manøgø dëër gø amooe ka awëërnyeŋŋi mo ni neeni ki wøk, dhøkge thenh thenh, 'ba cäätha yie ni døøŋŋø.
english: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ gëëdö ki uudi ni ee dwödö, ni maya ee geer bäät maya, ni maya ee cäŋ geer bäät maya; ni uudi moøgø ee rep ri øtø mana dwøŋ ni deŋŋe man ki deŋŋe man ki ŋää gø ee wïrö ki ge, ni beeye deŋ thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere ki deŋ thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:

anywaa: 'Ba uudi moøgø na geere yøø ni ee rep dëër øtø mana dwøŋ, cööthe moge atïïe ni ee rep dëër ødøgø wøk, kiper nee peedhe moa rïï bäätge nee dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana dwøŋ ba thuthge. 'Ba dööŋ yi øtø mana en piny beeye gööye abïïc, ni dööŋ yi øtø mana näk riet uudi maal beeye gööye abïciel, ni dööŋ yi øtø mana näk dää uudi maal beeye gööye abïriiø, ni gööye moøgø røm ka cenø.
english: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba Øt Wuuö Jwøk kanya geeri, geer ka kïte moa käli no onø jiiŋŋø ki kanya tøk ge yie, ni bäŋe dwør guduum ki ley ki nywïënyö man wø töö ki gø ki kïte mo owïnynyö kanya geer øtø.
english: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.

anywaa: 'Ba dhi øtø mar øtø mana en piny, na näk orep dëër øtø mana dwøŋ, ena jï løø tier-piny. 'Ba kany wø cige maal yi øtø mana en dïër ki mana en maal, ge dønyi ka dhi øtø mana en piny ni ge edhi ka bäät ogat.
english: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na thöör dëër øtø ki geer, wï gø akïthe ki dhigba mo otieŋø no opämi.
english: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.

anywaa: 'Ba uudi moa geere ni ee dwödö, ni maya ena bäät maya, no orep dëër øtø mana dwøŋ, bär mar øtø man nø ki maal beeye gööye abïïc, ni tïïc no odii ri øtø mana dwøŋ ki dhigba mo otieŋø no opämi.
english: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Cølöman ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,

anywaa: ni «Øtø man ni geerï en, ni näk mo ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa ki gïïa cema bëët gwøgï gwøø, ni tïïyï ge na karge, aani luumma caana jï wäru ma Deebit puta ka tïïc nee thur kare jïrï.
english: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:

anywaa: Ni puta bëëtö dï jiya ma jø Icriel ni ge ba wiia.»
english: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na thöör øtø ki geer,
english: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

anywaa: dëër øtø ki yie akïthe ki dhigba mo otieŋø no opämi, ni tägi ka piny këël mana këët nyeŋ øtø, ni kïth dï øtø ki thït mo otieŋø no opämi.
english: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï kuna näk da tääŋtiel, øtø aŋøle ki dï gø, ni kanya ŋøle beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni ŋøle ka dhigba mo otieŋø no opämi, ni tägi ka piny këël mana këët nyeŋ øtø maal, ni tïïc thääŋ øtø manøgø ni beeye kanya en kur keere na pere leth, ni puti cwøl ni thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na en nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, bär mare mar piny beeye gööye ma pïëraŋween.
english: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.

anywaa: 'Ba yi øtø bäre dëëre okïthö ki dhigba mo otieŋø no opämi mo dëëtge otëëŋŋö ki gïï mo mïërö mo lømløme, ki jenni mo oŋøøk. 'Ba opämi moøgø otïïö no onyääyö, ni kïte moa geer øtø ki ge ba nëëni.
english: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth ajiiŋŋe kiper nee acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy nee tïme ni bëëdö yie.
english: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, bär mare mar piny beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye ma pïërariiø. Ni puuc dëër gø bäre ki warkey mo tøŋ. Ni kïth dëër gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte ko opämi mo dhigba.
english: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman yi øtø bäre apuue ki warkey mana tøŋ. Ni tïïe ki  tiimme mo tïïc ka warkey, ni twöc gø ni ee rïïö nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth. Ni ö opämi moa näk øtø oŋølø ki ge ki dï gø, ni lëëny dëëtge bäre ki warkey.
english: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman Øt Jwøk apuue ki warkey këël mana put yie gääbö bäre. 'Ba eni thuwø gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte mana en buut thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, dëër gø bäre alëënynye ki warkey.
english: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
