anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman thuwø atïïö ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli, mo tïïc ka jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, nee bëëtge thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth. 'Ba bär mar aciel man nø ki maal beeye gööye apaar.
english: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

anywaa: Ni bööm kirubël aciel man nø beeye gööye abïïc; ki mana täge ko olwenh böömmö maya këël mana pïïe yo olwenh böömmö maya beeye gööye apaar.
english: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubël maya bär mar bwöpe poot na gööye apaar, ni kirubëlli moøgø na ariiø yøø, rumme moge ki kïdö marge aciel.
english: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar kirubël man nø ki maal beeye gööye apaar.
english: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

anywaa: Køøre kirubëlli moøgø akïth dï thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth ni bwöpge opeerø, ni maya dëër øtø ee gudö ki böömme, ni ö maya ni gut dëër øtø maya ki böömme maya, ni ö bwöpge moa no odööŋ ni gutge rege dï øtø.
english: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.

anywaa: Eni thuwø dëët kirubëlli moøgø bäre alëënynye ki warkey.
english: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman dëët uudi moa en yi øtø bäre, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere ki thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, atëëŋŋe ki kirubëlli ki tuue ki jenni mo oŋøøk.
english: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.

anywaa: Ni puuc yi øtø ki warkey, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere ki thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth.
english: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïïö ko odhuule, mo tïïe ka jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, kiper dhi øtø mar thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth. 'Ba jenni moa no ocwöth dhi øtø kiper nee odhuulu gur dëëtge, ki mana no orïï wïïe, otieŋø na bare abïïc.
english: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba odhuule moa na ariiø na tïïe kiper dhi øtø, ni tïïe ka jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, dëëtge atëëŋŋe ki kirubëlli ki twöe ki jenni mo oŋøøk; ni lëëny dëëtge bäre ki warkey.
english: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø ena tïïö ki jenni mo cwöth dhi thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere, mo otieŋø na bare aŋween, mo tïïc ka jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw.
english: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ko odhuule kiper dhi øtø manøgø mo tïïc ka thït mo otieŋø no opämi, ni beege odhuule aŋween, na ariiø moi nø okuubö na aciel, ni kany wø jabi, ariiø rege bange løøk aciel, ni ö ariiwi møga ni bange rege løøk maya.
english: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.

anywaa: Ni tëëŋ dëët odhuule moøgø ki kït kirubëlli ki tuue ki jenni mo oŋøøk; ni lëëny dëëtge bäre ki warkey.
english: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman kal mar Øt Jwøk ageere ki kïte mo otieŋø; ni kany wø cäämmö nø ki kïte ma tëëŋŋe adäk, bäät gø di pëënhnhö ki dhigba mo otieŋø no opäm.
english: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

anywaa: 'Ba Øt Wuuö Jwøk kanya tääi ki geer, täk ka ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Cølömanni ni ena nyeya, yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Jïp.
english: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the Lord laid, in the month Zif:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na cwiiri apaar kurciel moa beet Cølömanni ni ena nyeya, yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Bul, ni beeye dwää abära, Øt Jwøk ki gïïa kïth dëëre bëët aløny ki geer ki jöö mana caan ni tïïc ki gø. 'Ba Cølöman, cwiiri moa beede ni eni gëëdö ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk beege cwiiri abïriiø.
english: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman abëëdö ni gëëdö ki øt nyec mare ki cwiiri apaar kurdäk; køøre øtø manøgø athööre ki geer.
english: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø mana geere ki jer lur Libaanø enø, na put cwøl ni Lur Libaanø, bär mare mar piny beeye gööye ma dïpa, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye ma pïëradäk, ni wïth were moe moa no ocaanø na tëëŋŋe aŋween, bäätge okïthö ki rïwe ma dhigbae.
english: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.

anywaa: Ni bäät were moøgø okïthö ki rïwe ma pïëraŋween kurbïïc ma tëëŋŋe apaar kurbïïc, mo bäätge ogunnö ko opämi ma dhigbae.
english: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.

anywaa: Ni deŋ øtø løøi ki løøi da dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi mo raŋŋa rege ma tëëŋŋe adäk adäk.
english: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

anywaa: Ni dhøk uudi moe ki dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi moe otïïö na bøømi, ni dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi ge bëëdö ni ge raŋŋa rege ki moa en løøga, ni gena tëëŋŋe adäk adäk.
english: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø man wø cwøl ni Øt Were, bär mare beeye gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye ma pïëradäk, ni dhee da agööla mo okïthö ki jøøde mo bäätge ogunnö ko opämi.
english: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø mana geer na kany bëët wälu yie, ni wø cwøl ni Kar Løøk, ni beeye kany wø ŋøl luup yie, dëëre ogunnö ko opämi ma dhigbae ki mana täge ki maal këël mana këët piny.
english: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.

anywaa: 'Ba ki töök øt nyec, ŋää thääŋ øtø man wø ŋøl luup yie, da kal mo øt Cølöman ogeer yie, no ogeerø ni caala thäk uudi møga mo øt nyec. Eni thuwø eno gëëdö ki øtø mo caala øde jï nyi Peerø na näk ee nywømø.
english: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.

anywaa: 'Ba uudi moøgø bëët geer ka kïte moa perge leth, ni beege kïte moa no otøø no orømø, ni dïŋäthge ki yïthge oŋørø ki mukcäär, ni ge geer ka kïte moøgø ki mana täge ki tier øtø këël mana këët maal. Këël kal mana dwøŋ thuwø poot geer ka kïte mo perge leth.
english: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.

anywaa: 'Ba tier øtø tïïc ka kïte mo døøŋŋø mo perge leth, ni kïte moøgø bär marge beeye gööye apaar ni møøk beege gööye abära.
english: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

anywaa: Ni bäät kïte moøgø da kïte mo perge leth mo otøø no orømø, ko opämi ma dhigbae.
english: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.

anywaa: 'Ba kal mana dwøŋ geer ki kïte mo otieŋø, ni kany wø cäämmö nø ki kïte ma tëëŋŋe adäk, bäätge di pëënhnhö ko opäm mar dhigba, ni geer ni caala kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk ka agööla mare.
english: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the Lord, and for the porch of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman ajääk baŋ nyen mo cwøl ni Kuram, nee ööe ki Tayar.
english: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.

anywaa: 'Ba Kuram, ena o nyijø ma ci thøø ma nyi jø tuuŋ Naptali, ni wänni beeye dhaanhø ma nyï Tayar, ma rëëm nywïënyö mana cwøl ni jwïël. 'Ba Kuram jïre da leec wïc ka acaara ki riek waŋ mar tïï nywïënyö ma jwïël. Køøre Kuram aput ö baŋ nyeya ma Cølöman ni bëëde ni tïïya tïïe moe bëët.
english: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.

anywaa: Ni ö Kurammi ni tïïe ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala dïkweeye, mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni bär mar aciel man nø beeye gööye apaar ka abära, ni dööŋ dëëtge beeye gööye apaar kurriiø.
english: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki gïï ma ariiø mo mïërö mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo oleenyø, nee cïp wïth gïïögø ni caal dïkweeye yøø; ni bär mar gïnögø aciel beeye gööye abïïc, ni bär mar maya beeye gööye abïïc thuwø.
english: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø dëëtge akïthi ki jap mïërö mo odwøø mo caala tiimme, na abïriiø okïth dëër maya, ni ö abïriiø møga ni kïthi dëër maya, nee cïp wïth dïkweeye.
english: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

anywaa: Ni buut tiimme moi nø okïthö ki gïï mo caala nyïïadïkwäle ma tëëŋŋe ariiø ariiø.
english: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø ni mïërö no ocïp bäät gïïögø ni caal dïkweeye yøø moa en nyïm agööla, otïïö ni caala apiite, ni bär marge beeye gööye aŋween.
english: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa näk mïërö na en wïth gïïa näk caala dïkweeye moa na ariiø, bäätge maal buut kanya näk ogul na en buut tiimme, da nyïïadïkwäle ma dïpe ariiø mo ocaanø na tëëŋŋe ariiø ariiø mo ena bäät man nø.
english: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gïïa näk caala dïkweeye na en gïïa mïërö wïthge, acïp nyïm agööla mana en dhi Øt Jwøk, ni cïp aciel bäät cwïïc, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Jaakin, ni cïp maya bäät caam, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Böeeth.
english: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.

anywaa: Ni gïïa mïërö na en bäätge otïïö ni caala apiitu mo oŋøøk. Køøre tïïc mar gïïa näk caala dïkweeye athum.
english: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.

anywaa: Køøre Kuram atïïö ki gïr pïï mo dwøŋ mo ogul, mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo othiiø, ma gööye apaar ki mana täge deŋŋe man këël deŋŋe  maya, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye abïïc, ni dööŋ dëëre beeye gööye ma pïëradäk.
english: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

anywaa: 'Ba nyäär gïr pïï manøgø owïrö ki gïï mo caala nyïï arööt ni geno mun deŋŋe bäre, ni yi gööyö aciel da nyïï arööt apaar, ni deŋ gïr pïï ege wïrö na tëëŋŋe ariiø.
english: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

anywaa: 'Ba gïr pïï manøgø ocïp bäät gïï mo caala dhäk ma apaar kurriiø, ni dhäk adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø wï-piny, ni dhäk adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni dhäk adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø tierpiny, ni dhäk adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba gïr pïï manøgø ocïp bäätge, ni ŋäthge oløø baŋ gø.
english: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

anywaa: 'Ba odhïŋ gïr pïï beeye rumi aciel mo røm ka lweedi moa na aŋween mo cenø, ni deŋŋe caala deŋ ogubayu ki deŋ apiito mo oŋøøk; 'ba yie kädö ki pïï ma yïth caapiie ma kume ariiø.
english: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïïö ki jïëthe apaar mo wø käär pïï ki ge mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni bär mar man nø mar piny beeye gööye aŋween, ni dööŋ yi man nø beeye gööye aŋween, ni bär mar man nø mar maal beeye gööye adäk.
english: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mana tïïc jïëthe moøgø ki gø beeye en, ki bööpge deŋŋe cooth oroodhø ki gïn mo wiit.
english: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

anywaa: 'Ba bööpge moø ni en yïthakic gïïa no oroodhø ki deŋge enø, da ŋuuwe, ki dhäk, ki nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli mo ogöör dëëtge, ni gïïa no oroodhø ki deŋge dëëtge ogöönnö ki jap mïërö mo tïïc ni di tieŋø.
english: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

anywaa: 'Ba jïëthe moøgø, man nø da tiete ma aŋween mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki nywïëny mo wø bëët tielli bäätge, ni jääy man nø bääte da gïï ma aŋween mo jøla gïn mo caala areba. 'Ba dëët gïïögø ogöönnö ki jap mïërö mo ena løøi ki løøi.
english: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

anywaa: 'Ba areba manøgø ni en bäät gïïögø na aŋween yøø, ni wø bëët gïr pïïyi bääte, bär mare mar maal beeye gööyö aciel, ni tier gïr pïï opööth piny ki tier areba manøgø ki thääŋ gööyö, ni dëër areba manøgø ogöörö ki gïï mo mïërö. 'Ba gïïögø na aŋween yøø na en areba bäätge, otïïö na bøøm, ni paa ogul.
english: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet jääy moa na aŋween, bär marge mar maal beeye gööyö aciel ki thääŋö, ni gïï wø bëët tielli bäätge omaa dëër jääy.
english: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

anywaa: 'Ba tiel moøgø otïïö ni caala tiel mo jääy man wø tut okweenynyi, ni dëët tiel moøgø bëët tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo oleenyø.
english: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa na aŋween, na näk areba ege jølø, omaa dëër jääy.
english: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

anywaa: 'Ba areba mana en bäät jääy, da areba mør mo ocwää dëëre, mo bär mare mar maal beeye thääŋ gööyö. 'Ba gïïa jøl areba manøgø ni en bäät jääy enø, ocwää dëër areba.
english: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

anywaa: 'Ba dëët gïïa jøl areba, ki dëër jääy, kany mo ŋaam jaak ogöönnö ki kirubëlli, ki ŋuuwe, ki twöe, ki jap mïërö, ni beeye deŋŋe manø bäre.
english: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye jöö mana tïïc jïëthe moa na apaar mo wø käär pïï ki ge. Ge bëët geno tïïö ni röömi, ni rumme moge ki kïtge aciel.
english: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

anywaa: Køøre Kuram atïïö ki jap peny ma apaar mo caala athääe, mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni man nø käädö ki pïï ma caapiie ma pïëraŋween, ni bär mar man nø, ki mana täge ki deŋŋe man këël deŋŋe maya, beeye gööye aŋween; ni jääy man nø bääte da gïr pïï aciel nø.
english: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jïëth pïï abïïc acïp deŋ Øt Jwøk jï løø tier-piny, ni cïp abïïc møga deŋ Øt Jwøk jï løø wï-piny, ni cïp gïr pïï mana dwøŋ na näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël nyïm Øt Jwøk yïthakic jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø tier-piny.
english: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

anywaa: 'Ba Kuram atïïö thuwø ki dääe, ka akaape, ki cäänne. Kanyøgønø, Kuram tïïe bëët moa tïïe kiper nyeya ma Cølöman yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk aput thöör ki tïïc,
english: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the Lord:

anywaa: ni beege gïïa näk caala dïkweeye na näk ariiø, ki gïï mïërö moa na ariiø na en bäätge, ki tiimme moa no odwøø ma ariiø na mo rïëp gïïa näk mïërö moa na ariiø ki ge;
english: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

anywaa: ki gïïa näk caala nyïïadïkwäle ma dïpe aŋween na kïth bäät tiimme  moa no odwøø, na aciel man nø dëëre da nyïïadïkwäle ma tëëŋŋe ariiø, na mo rïëp gïïa näk ogul na näk ariiø na mïërö na en wïth gïïa caal dïkweeye;
english: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

anywaa: ki jïëthe apaar mo wø käär jap peny ki ge, ki jap peny ma apaar mo ena bäätge;
english: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

anywaa: ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, mo tiere da gïï pinyi apaar kurriiø mo otïïö ni caala dhäk;
english: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

anywaa: ki dääe, ka akaape, ki cäänne. 'Ba jammi moøgø bëët na tïïc Kurammi jï nyeya ma Cølöman kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ge tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo othoodhø.
english: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basins: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of bright brass.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman japøgø bëët atïïe nee tïïc ni thiia yïth odhöönhe mo yïthge okølø yi Goor Jördan yïthakic Cuköt ki Carthan.
english: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jammi moøgø bëët peek marge käre rømø, kiper gena tïmö ni thööth døc; ni ö peek mar nywïënyö mana näk jwïël moa tïïc japøgø ki ge ni käri ŋääö këët.
english: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jammi bëët moa en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk atïïe, ni beege tharabëëta man wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, mo dëëre bäre olëënynyö ki warkey, ki tharabëëta mo dëëre bäre olëënynyö ki warkey man wø bëët muunni moa näk nyuuthe bääte;
english: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the Lord: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

anywaa: ki gïï wø bëët lambae bäätge mo tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ, mo dëëtge otëëŋŋö ki jenni mo oŋøøk, ni gïïögø abïïc ena bäät cwïïc na abïïc møga ena bäät caam nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth; ki lambae mo tïïc ka warkey, ki dïkwänynye mo maac mo tïïc ka warkey;
english: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

anywaa: ko ogubääye, ki jap wø 'näk lambae ki ge, ki kuure, ka apät, ka athääe mo wø käär mäc ki ge; ni gïïögø bëët tïïc ka warkey mo tøŋ. Ni tïïe ki gïï wø gur odhuulu dëër dhi øtø ki geni mo tïïc ka warkey, mo dhi thääŋ øtø mana en dïër, ni beeye øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, ki dhi Øt Jwøk man wø døny yie ki gø, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere.
english: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moa tïïc nyeya ma Cølöman kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk athum ki tïïc. Ni ö Cølömanni ni käl jammi bëët moa näk ocïp wänni ma Deebit kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk yi øtø, ni beege gwet-bïrö, ki warkey, ki jammi bëët, ni kïth geni yïth uut kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the Lord. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cølöman jø døøk Icriel, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi bëët, ki dïbwöthe mo dhøk uudi mo jø Icriel acooŋ yi Jerucalem, kiper na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy nee øømge yi Pääny Deebit, ni beeye Dhayan.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni cooŋge rege buut nyeya ma Cølöman, ni beeye yïth nïne mo ajwöma man wø tïïc yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Itanim, ni beeye dwää abïriiø.
english: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jø døøk Icriel bëët gena öö, ni ö dïlämme ni lwørge acanduk;
english: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.

anywaa: ni kälge acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk ko oduŋkaara man wø røøm Wuuö Jwøki yie ki jiy, ki jammi bëët moa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk, na en yo oduŋkaara; ni ö dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay ni kälge gïïögø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought up the ark of the Lord, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman ki lwaa Icriel bäre, moa näk rege ege cooŋ nyïm acanduk, gena cïpö ko olämme, ni beege dïëk ki dhäk mo thööth mo ba løny ki kwaan.
english: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, dïlämme acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy akälge kare, yi thääŋ Øt Jwøk mana en tääŋtiel, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, ni cïpge gø tiet bwöp gïïa no otïïö ni caala nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli.
english: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

anywaa: Kiper kirubëlli bwöpge otïïö no opeerø bäät kanya en acanduki yie, ni ö bwöp kirubëlli ni bëëtge maal, na acanduk ki jenni moa kääri ki geni ege rïëbö.
english: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

anywaa: 'Ba jenni moøgø bäyö døc, ni  wïthge løny ki man neeni ni dhaanhø cuŋŋa thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na en nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, 'ba ba løny joot ki wøk; 'ba ge poot nut kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ya acanduk bäŋ gïrpiny yie, 'ba beege opäp kïte moa na ariiø keerge na no ocïp Modhe yie kanya en tier Kïn Körëp, kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na tude yie ki luubö ki jø Icriel, kanya öge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni dïlämme ööa wøk ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ødøgø aput pöölö pääŋ.
english: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the Lord,

anywaa: Køøre atïmö ni ba løny jï dïlämme ki man tïïcge tïïc marge, kiper pöölö mana en yie, kiper ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk apääŋe.
english: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk onø köö ni eni bëëdö yi pöölö mo odhïŋ.
english: Then spake Solomon, The Lord said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana gëëdö ki øt ajiem na kar bëëtö jïrï na bäre bäre.»
english: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni lwaa Icriel bäre cuŋŋö kaagø, nyeya ma Cølöman nyïme aløø baŋge ni gwïëth geni bëët.
english: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na cäänö ki dhee jï wära ma Deebit, ni put gïna caane wëëk thur kare, ni kööe,
english: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ mana käla jiya ma jø Icriel wøk ki Ijep, aani, bäŋ pääny mo yaa jierø røk päänye mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët naa gëënni yie ki øtø nee nyeŋŋa cwøl ree; 'ba Deebit beeye na jiera nee bëëde na wïth jiya ma jø Icriel.›
english: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba wära ma Deebit, gïnögø nut cwïnye cøøn ki man gëëde ki øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï wära ma Deebit, ni ‹Kiper mana bëët cwïnyï ni manynya man gëëde ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, beeye gïn mo beer na caarï ki cwïnyï.
english: And the Lord said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.

anywaa: 'Ba paa ïïni noo geer øtø manøgø; 'ba beeye wäädï mano nywølï, noo geer gø kiper nyeŋŋa.›
english: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk luubö mare mana caane anø wëëk thur kare; kiper aana nø ci kar wära ma Deebit ni pïïa bäät wälu mar jø Icriel, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki, ni nø gëëda ki øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel,
english: And the Lord hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: ni nø jiiŋŋa kar acanduk kaace, ni beeye acanduk mana en luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy yie, ni beeye luumma tuude ki kwäyø kanya käl geni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.»
english: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Cølöman acuŋŋö nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe maal, ni lwaa Icriel bäre nut.
english: And Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

anywaa: Ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, bäŋ Jwøk mo caala ïïni maalø wala bäät piny, mo luumma tuude ki jiy ee gwøø, ni nyooth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl jï jiye mo wø tïïö ka adïëri nyïme ki cwïnyge bäre.
english: And he said, Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:

anywaa: Luumma caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit agwøgï, ni beeye mana caanï ki dhiï na wëëgï thur kare, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, luumma caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit put gwøk, na kööï, ni ‹Ni näk mo jiy moo käl dëërï wïthge koorge koorø ki bëëtö marge, ni bëëtge ni ge tïïya adïëri nyïma, kaawat mana tïïyï, ï ba can ki dhaanhø mo pï piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.›
english: Therefore now, Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui, Jwø Icriel, beerra man ö luummï mana caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit ni wëëgï gø thur kare.
english: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, Jwøk bëëdö bäät piny møn? Ka adïëri møn, ï na Jwøk, maal këël maal kuya kunece, ï ba røm yie. ?A øtø man ni yaa geerø  en, ïïno rømï yie nidïï?
english: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, wïny lam mara, a na dhaanhnhï, ni cegï ïthï ki kwac mara ki lam mara man kwaa ïïni ki gø dïcäŋi en.
english: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:

anywaa: Raŋ Øt Jwøk man ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär, øda kööï ni nyeŋŋï doo wøørø yie, kiper nee lam mara wïnynyï kany wø läma, a na dhaanhnhï, ni nyïma yaa luu Øt Jwøk kany.
english: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.

anywaa: Beerra man wïnynyï kwac mara, a na dhaanhnhï, ki kwac mar jiyï ma jø Icriel, kany wø lämge ni nyïmge ege luu Øt Jwøk kany. Beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø; beerra man wïnynyï gø møn, ni wëënnï waani.
english: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dhaanhø obääyö dëër ŋat atut mare, ni tïïi nee kööŋe, ni näk mo öö ni kööŋe nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï yi Øt Jwøk man,
english: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø ki maal ni ŋølï mar jiyï, ni jäälï ŋata mare raac, ni dwøgï gïna raac wïïe keere na tïïe, ni ŋunnï ŋata mare beer, ni duunnï jïre ki køør mare na beer.
english: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo näk mo jiy moï ma jø Icriel bööt nyïïmänni böötö, kiper mana tïïge ki raay dëërï, ni näk mo ge cäŋa duu baŋï ni cøørge nyeŋŋï, ni lämge ni kwacge ïïni yi øtø man,
english: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø ki maal, ni wëënnï raay mo jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni duuï ge yi ŋöömma cïpï jï kwäcge.
english: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø näk mo maal ocuŋŋö ni tïme ni bäŋ køth, kiper mana tïï jiyï ki raay dëërï, ni näk mo ge lämö ni nyïmge ege luu Øt Jwøk kany, ni cøørge nyeŋŋï, ni løkge rege ni wecge raay moge kanyo caannï geni,
english: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø ki maal ni wëënnï raay mo jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni pwönynyï geni ki jöö mana beer man cääthge ki gø, ni jääŋŋï køth bäät ŋøøm moï moa cïpï jï jiyï na mo dööŋ jïge na moge.
english: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo da käc paac, wala täw mo leth, wala cäŋ wala twöŋi mo raanynya beel, wala bäänyö, wala adïtwie, wala ni näk mo ge ciel nyïïmänni ciel dïër yïth päänye moge, këël ööa gïï mo leth ki täwe mo nyïëdi cøøn,
english: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

anywaa: ni näk mo dhaanhø aciel wala jiyï ma jø Icriel bëët lämö ni kwacge ïïni, ni ŋati man nø gïna leth na tägö dëëre ŋääe ki cwïnye, ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe jï kuna en Øt Jwøki man yie,
english: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni wëënnï ŋati man nø, ni cunnï gø ki køør moa tïïe bëët, ni beege jøøa cwïnyge ŋäyï, kiper bee ï keerï ni ŋäc cwïny jiy bëët,
english: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)

anywaa: nee ge lwäcge ki ïïni ki yïth nïne bëët moo beetge yïth ŋøøm moa cïpï jï kwäcwa.
english: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

anywaa: «Këël jur thuwø mo ba käl røk jiyï ma jø Icriel, kany wø ööe ki paac mo bäär døc kiper nyeŋŋï,
english: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;

anywaa: kiper man wø wïny dööŋö mar nyeŋŋï ki teek badï; kany wø ööe ni läme ni nyïme ee luu Øt Jwøk kany,
english: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni tïïyï gø ki køør gïïa pëënynye bëët, nee nyeŋŋï ŋäc jø bäät pinynyi bëët, niï lwäärge kaawat man wø tïïc jiyï ma jø Icriel, nee ŋäcge møn ni øtø man ni yaa geerø en, cwøla ri nyeŋŋï.
english: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø ö jiyï wø cige baŋ leny baŋ nyïïmän moge, ni këël ge jääŋŋï ka waŋjööra ŋø cøøn, kany wø lämge jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni nyïmge ege luu yi pääny mana näk iï jierø ki øtø mana näk yaa geerø kiper nyeŋŋï,
english: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the Lord toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï lam marge ki maal ki kwac marge, ni kønyï geni.
english: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø bääcge dëërï, kiper mana näk mo bäŋ dhaanhø cøøn mo ba bääyi, ni wëërï ki geni ni cïbï geni ceŋ nyïïmän, ni ö geni ni magi ya nyïïmänni ki tøŋ ni kïthge geni yïth ŋøøpge, kany mo bäär wala kany mo cään,
english: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

anywaa: ni näk mo ge cätö yi ŋöömö mana kïth ge yie ni ge mak ka tøŋ, ni løkge cwïnyge ni kwacge ïïni yi  ŋööm jøøa mak ge ki tøŋ, ni köge, ni ‹Waana bääyö, ni nø tïïwa ki gïï mo reyø døc,›
english: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

anywaa: ni näk mo ge duua baŋï ki cwïnyge bäre ka acaacge bäre yïth ŋøøp nyïïmän moge na mak geni ki tøŋ, ni lämge jïrï ni nyïmge ege luu yi ŋöömö marge na cïpï jï kwäcge, ki pääny mana jierï, ki øtø mana geera kiper nyeŋŋï,
english: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï lam marge ki kwac marge kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni kønyï geni,
english: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

anywaa: ni wëënnï jiyï moa no obääyö dëërï, ni weyï gïïa näk ege baaø dëërï, ni tïïyï ge nee jøøa mak geni ki tøŋ mëërge ki geni,
english: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

anywaa: kiper gena jiyï ni beege moa näk moï, na kälï wøk ki Ijep na caal këën thäth mo liel.
english: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man raŋï kwac mara, a na dhaanhnhï, ki kwac mar jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni wïnynyï marge kany wø kwacge ïïni,
english: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.

anywaa: kiper gena jierï na moi røk jø bäät piny bëët, kaawat mana caanï gø ki dhi dhaanhnhï ma Modhe, kanya kälï eni ki kwäcwa wøk ki Ijep.»
english: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na lønye ki lam manøgø bäre ki kwac mana kwac Wuuö Jwøk ki gø, ena ö maal ki nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk, kanya näk cøŋŋe ee këël piny yie, ni ceŋŋe ee thaaŋ maal;
english: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the Lord, he arose from before the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

anywaa: ni cuŋŋe ni gwïëth lwaa jø Icriel bäre ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal, ni kööe,
english: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

anywaa: «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, na mooc jiye ma jø Icriel ki jwömö, ki køør gïïa caane bëët, ni bäŋ luubö aciel mo odööŋ ni kär thur kare røk gïïa beyø bëët na caane ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma Modhe.
english: Blessed be the Lord, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marø, ni bëëde ki øøni, kaawat mana bëëde ki kwäyø; ni ba wec øøni ni ba kwier øøni.
english: The Lord our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

anywaa: Beerra man ö eni ni løø cwïnynyø baŋe, nee ø cäädhö ki jööre ni gwøø luup moa ceme, ki ciik moe, ki luup ŋøl moe, na kööm kwäyø ki geni.
english: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

anywaa: Beerra man ö luupi 'moa bëët moa kwaaya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ki geni, ni bëëtge ni lääŋ Wuuö Jwøki lääŋŋö ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär, ni ö eni ni køny aani, a na dhaanhnhe, ki jiye ma jø Icriel, ki køør man wø manyge ki yi cäŋ cooth,
english: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the Lord, be nigh unto the Lord our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:

anywaa: kiper nee ŋäc jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët.
english: That all the people of the earth may know that the Lord is God, and that there is none else.

anywaa: Beerra man ö cwïnynyu ni cïbu gø køør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ni caathu køør ciik moe ni gwøgu gïïa ceme, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.»
english: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the Lord our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya ma Cølöman ki jø Icriel bëët moa en buute, gena put cïpö ko olämme nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Cølömanni ni cïpe ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër jï Wuuö Jwøk, no olämme moa cïbe beege dhäk ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø, ki dïëk ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø; ni ö nyeya ki jø Icriel bëët ni putge Øt Wuuö Jwøk cïp kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the Lord, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïcäŋögø, nyeya thääŋ dïkal mana en dïër na en nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk, acïp kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni cïp yi gø ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo beel, ki dwäälö mar olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na en nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk atïmö ni thiinh ki man cïp olämme moøgø bëët bääte, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo beel, ki dwäälö mar olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the Lord was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Cølöman dïcäŋa cïp Øt Jwøk kur keere na mar Jwøk awøøre ki jø Icriel bëët, ni beeye lwaak mana dwøŋ na öö ki Libö-Amath na en jï løø wï-piny, këël mana këët waŋ  Naam Ijep na en jï løø tier-piny, ni wøørge dïcäŋögø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ki nïne abïriiø, ni wøørge Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ni Jøw Bëëdö Yïth Abïle ki nïne abïriiø, ni päŋ nïne na apaar kurŋween.
english: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri bäc nïne, nyeya jiy awëëk wääth, ni ö jiyi ni gwïëthge eni. Køøre gena aa mïëri moge ki kanynyø ki met cwïny mo dwøŋ kiper jammi moa beyø bëët na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki jï dhaanhnhe ma Deebit, ki jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the Lord had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na thöör Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare ki geer, ki gïïa met yie ki ge bëët nee tïïc,
english: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ree acäŋ nyoothø jï Cølöman kaawat mana kwøŋ ree nyooth jï gø Gibien.
english: That the Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïre, ni «Lam marï ki kwac mana kwayï aani ki gø awïnynya; 'ba Øt Jwøk mana geerï enø, anø cïba kur keere na mara, naa tïïya nyeŋŋa nee bëëde ni ŋäc kaace na bäre bäre, ni bëëda naa raŋŋa øtø manøgø cooth ki cwïnya bäre.
english: And the Lord said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, ni näk miï bëëdö niï tïïya adïëri nyïma, kaawat mana tïïc wäru ma Deebit, ni cwïnyï thïïŋ, ni tïïyï jammi bëët moa köömma ïïni ki ge, ni gwøgï ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa,
english: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:

anywaa: aani tier nyec marï këëlla piny bäät jø Icriel na bäre bäre, kaawat mana caana gø jï wäru ma Deebit ni kööa, ni ‹Ï ba cännï ki dhaanhø mo pï piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.›
english: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk miï gaa wøk, wala jø okäl dëërï gaa wøk, ni køøra ba caathu, ni ba gwøgu gïïa cema ki ciik 'moa na köömma uuni ki ge, ni cou ni tïnynyu juu møøk ni lammu geni,
english: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

anywaa: aani jø Icriel käla wøk ki yïth ŋøøm moa cïba jïge, ni ö øtø mana näk yaa nø cïp kur keere kiper nyeŋŋa ni leeŋa gø wøk nyïma. Køøre nø, jø Icriel ge tïmö ni gena jø wø ŋäät dëëtge, ni bëëtge ni gena gïr waac yïthakic wïth juurre bëët.
english: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

anywaa: 'Ba øtø manøgø oniruuth ni ränynye; ni ö jiyi moo cør deŋŋe ni thäŋ yïthge ni buuge gø ni köge, na ‹?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc gïn dëër ŋöömö man ki øtø man?›
english: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and to this house?

anywaa: Køøre oløk jiyi ni köge, ni ‹Beeye kiper mana kweerge ki Jwøge ma Wuuö Jwøk, na käl kwäcge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ni cïpge cwïnyge køør juu møøk, ni lamge geni, ni tïnyge geni. Kiper manøgønø, beeye tiere na ö Wuuö Jwøki na kïth gïnögø ni leth enø bäre bäätge.› »
english: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the Lord brought upon them all this evil.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa thöör Cølömanni kanya bëëde ni gëëdö ki uudi moa na ariiø, ni beege Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare, beege cwiiri ma pïërariiø.
english: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord, and the king's house,

anywaa: 'Ba Kiram nyeny jø Tayar beeye na cïpö jï Cølöman ki dhigba ki thït na jer geer, ki warkey, ki køør gïïa many Cølömanni bëët; køøre nyeya ma Cølöman acïpö jï Kiram ki päänye ma pïërariiø røk päänye moa en yïth ŋøøp Galili.
english: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

anywaa: Køøre Kiram aö wøk ki Tayar ni ci kuna raŋ päänye moa cïp Cølömanni jïre; 'ba eni yie kär mïnnö ki geni.
english: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

anywaa: Ni kööe, «?Nyie coka, a teeŋ päänye mo nyïëdi na cïpï jïra ii?» Køøre eni ŋøøpa bëët päänye moøgø yïthge aput cwøl ni Kabul, na näk tiere beeye ŋøøm mo bäŋ gïn mo duuge, këël ni poode ni di cøørø na enønø këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba Kiram onø jääk baŋ nyeya ma Cølöman ki warkey ma kikarri ma dïpa ki pïërariiø.
english: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare, ki kanya no  othørø ni wø cwøl na Milø, ki kiir mar Jerucalem, ki päänye moa cøøri na Adhör, ki Megidø, ki Gëdher, tïïe ka jø tïïc moa mak ki teek.
english: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the Lord, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø nyeny jø Ijep, eno kwøŋ ci Gëdher ni mak gø ni waaŋ gø, ni 'näk jø Keenan moa bëëdö yi päänyögø, ni cïp päänyögø na muuy jï nyaare kanya nywømi ya Cølömanni.
english: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman Gëdher acäŋ geerrø, ni geer Bëëth-Örön mana en jï piny,
english: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth–horon the nether,

anywaa: ki Baalath, ki Tamar na en dï paap Juuda,
english: And Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land,

anywaa: ki päänye moe bëët mo cuŋ yïthge ki caammi, ki päänye mo bëët jïëth leny moe yïthge mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki päänye mo bëët jø okwëënyi moe yïthge, ki gïïa manynye bëët nee geere yi Jerucalem, ki yi Libaanø, ki yi ŋöömö mana en tiere bäre.
english: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa näk patha jø Icriel na bøth ki thøø røk jø Amör, ki røk jø Këth, ki røk jø Përec, ki røk jø Ëwi, ki røk jø Jeebuc,
english: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,

anywaa: ni beege jøøa näk kär løny jï jø Icriel ki man dïïrge wïthge bëët, nyïïkwaacge moa dööŋ yïth ŋøøpøgø, Cølöman wø cwötö røkge ki jø tïïc moa näk maae ka teek kiper tïïc, këël man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman, bäŋ jø Icriel mo ee tïïö na laaŋe; 'ba gena tïïe na jø leny, na jø kööre moe, na cuumme mo wïth kwääc leny, na kwääc leny, na kwääc jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, na jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi.
english: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø Icriel møøk mo ocuumö na jø wø käär tïïe mo Cølöman, ni beege jiy ma dïpe abïïc ki pïërabïïc mo wø raŋ jø tïïc.
english: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyi Peerø ki yi Pääny Deebit, ni eni ööa paare mana no ogeer Cølömanni jïre, Cølöman kanya no othørø ni wø cwøl na Milø atïïe.
english: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme na yi cwiir cooth, Cølöman wø cïpö ko olämme kwöre adäk bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana tïïe jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ni waaŋe ka gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met na aciel bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre gïna geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk kipere athur kare.
english: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the Lord, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the Lord. So he finished the house.

anywaa: Nyeya ma Cølöman thuwø athädhö ki baabuure Edhiyön-Gabir na en buut päänya cwøl ni Ëlath, na en yi ŋööm Ëdöm bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Kiram jø tïïc moe, ni beege jø wø käär baabuure, na ŋäc bëët naam, ajääŋŋe ki jø tïïc mo Cølöman na aciel.
english: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

anywaa: Ni cige Öpïr ni känge ki warkey mo peek mare beeye rumme ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërariiø mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar, ni kälge gø baŋ nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøa no orøønyø na nyeya mar Cïïba na wïny gïr wïny nyeŋ mar Cølöman mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïre, ena ö kuna pëëny Cølöman ki pïëc mo teek.
english: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to prove him with hard questions.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aö yi Jerucalem ni käädö ki lwaak mo päl døc, ka athïrööle mo tïëdö ki gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met, ki warkey mo päl døc, ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth. 'Ba kanya pïïe baŋ Cølöman, Cølöman apëënynye ki luup bëët moa en cwïnye.
english: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman pïëc mo nyijøøgø bëët adwøge jïgø; ni bäŋe aciel mo odhäthö jïre mo käre løø jïgø.
english: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø na joot leec wïc mar Cølöman, ki øt nyec mana geere,
english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,

anywaa: ki cam man wø cïp nyïme kar cam mare, ki kwör bëëte mo jøøa näk ee cuumö, ki yi jöö man wø tïï jø tïïci moe ki gø, ki ruyö marge, ki jiy moe mo wø gap kwøk nyïïomøki jïre, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo wø cïbe Øt Jwøk, doo thøw ki thäŋ ec.
english: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aköö jï nyeya, ni «Luup moa wïnynya naa ena yi ŋöömö mara kiper tïïe moï ki leec wïc marï beege karge.
english: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a kär jïëy ki luup moa wïnynya, këël mana ööa en  ni jooda gø ki waŋa. 'Ba neenï, këël moa caan jïra, kär päŋ na thääŋ moa jooda ki waŋa. 'Ba leec wïc marï ki kwärö marï kaala mana waac jïra.
english: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

anywaa: A met ec mo nyïëdi ni en jï jiy moï ki jiy moa näk iï cuumö ni wø en buutï cooth, ni wø wïny luup mo wø caanï ki køør leec wïc marï!
english: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, na yie mïnnö ki ïïni na cïp ïïni bäät wäl jø Icriel. 'Ba kiper mana mëër Wuuö Jwøki ki jø Icriel na bäre bäre, ïïna tïïe na nyeya, kiper nee luup wø ŋølï na karge niï tïïya adïëri.»
english: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the Lord loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aput cïpö jï nyeya ki warkey ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa ki pïërariiø, ki teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met mo thööth døc, ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth mo thööth. 'Ba bäŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met mo ocäŋ käl po nyeya këët mo caala moa käl nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø jï nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba baabuure mo Kiram thuwø moa wara kännö ki warkey ki yo Öpïr, gena kännö jï nyeya ki jer wø cwøl ni almuk mo thööth døc, ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth ki yo Öpïr.
english: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya jerøgø atïïe na jenni mo wø maaŋŋi kany wø eth maal yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare, ni tïïe thuwø ki thøpothïënhö ma teeŋi ki røk jerøgø kiper jø wär dudi; ni jerøgø bäŋ teeŋge mo ocäŋ käl po nyeya këët, ni bäŋ teeŋge mo ojoodø këët këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman gïïa many nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø na pëënynye bëët acïbe jïgø, ni meede bäät mo wø cïp cøøn ki nyeŋ nyec. Køøre nyijøøgø adøø yi ŋöömö mare ki jiy moe.
english: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

anywaa: 'Ba warkie mo wø käli jï Cølöman ki yi cwiir cooth, peek marge beege rumme ma kikarri ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïciel ka abïciel,
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

anywaa: ni moa jwäk baŋ jø gath, ki mo wø jwäk nyec Arabe, ki jiy moa no ocuumö yïth ŋøøp jø Icriel kär kwaan rege.
english: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman atïïö ki gïï ma dïpe ariiø mo døøŋŋø mo caala kööt leny mo tïïc ka warkey, ni warkey mana tïïc man nø ki gø, peek mare beeye rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe abïciel.
english: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø ki mo therø ma dïpe adäk, mo poot tïïc ka warkey, ni warkey mana tïïc man nø ki gø, peek mare beeye rumme ma cekelli ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc; ni ö nyeya ni cïp geni yi øtø mana cwøl ni Øt Lur Libaanø.
english: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, nyeya atïïö ki wälu mo dwøŋ døc mo tïïc ka lak liec, ni lëëny dëër gø bäre ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

anywaa: 'Ba wälu manøgø nyïme okïthö ko ogat mo da kwör tiel abïciel. Ni gïn wø jääŋ røk ki gø mare ki kuna näk da ŋääe, wïïe maal otïïö ni ree ee döölö, ni deŋ wälu løøi ki løøi okïthö ki gïï cïp ceŋ bäätge, ni gïï ma ariiø mo caala ŋuuwe otïïö ni cuŋŋö buute løøi ki løøi.
english: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïï ma apaar kurriiø mo caala ŋuuwe mo otïïö ni cuŋŋö bäät kwör tiel moa na abïciel, ni bäät kar tielø man nø løøi ki løøi da ŋuu mo cuŋŋö bääte. 'Ba bäŋ teeŋ wälu manøgø mo okwøŋ tïïc cøøn yi buc nyec mør.
english: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø mäth nyeya ma Cølöman ki ge bëët tïïc ka warkey, ni jap paac bëët moa en yi øtø mana cwøl ni Øt Lur Libaanø tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ. Ni bäŋgø mo otïïö ki gwel-bïrö, kiper gwel-bïrö okwaanø na gïn mo bäŋ kare ki yïth nïne moa beet Cølömanni.
english: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya jïre da baabuure mo gath, mo ena yi naam ki baabuure mo Kiram na aciel; ni kany wø tïme na køør cwiiri adäk nø, baabuure moøgø wø kännö ki warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki lak lïëy, ka apøønnanyare, ki bïme.
english: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman atïmö ni kare dwøŋ døc ni kaala nyeye bëët mo bäät piny ki kwärö ki leec wïc.
english: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

anywaa: Ni ö jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni tïmge ni ge manynya man öge baŋ Cølöman kuna  wïnyge luup mo wø caane ki køør leec wïc mare mana cïp Jwøki jïre.
english: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø ööi ki yi cwiir cooth, ge käädö ki muuce, ni beege jammi moa näk tïïc ka gwet-bïrö, ki jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey, ka abïïe, ki jap leny, ki teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met, ko okwëënyi, ki gääŋŋe.
english: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman amäänyö ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ko okwëëc leny; ni jïte ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi ma kuma ki dïpe aŋween, ko okwëëc leny ma kume apaar kurriiø; ni kïth møøk yïth päänye mo wø bëët jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi yïthge, ni käl møga buute yi Jerucalem.
english: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman gwet-bïrö atïïe ni thööth døc yi Jerucalem ni caala kïte, ni tïïc jenni moa perge leth ni thööth kaamar olämmi mo tuya yi gool.
english: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jø wø gädhö jïre wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö Ijep ki Kue kuna ŋëëwge ko okwëënyi, ni kälge ge.
english: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

anywaa: 'Ba jää leny man nø man wø tut okweenynyi, kany wø käli ki Ijep, gäte beeye gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe abïciel, ni ö gät okweeny man nø ni näk gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma cekelli ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc; køøre, cäŋge ka gath wøk baŋ nyeye bëët mo jø Këth ki nyeye mo jø Aram.
english: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman acäŋ tïmö ni mëër ka määr wïth juurre møøk mo thööth bäät nyi Peerø, ni beege nyïï jø Möap, ki nyïï jø Amön, ki nyïï jø Ëdöm, ki nyïï jø Caydan, ki nyïï jø Këth,
english: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

anywaa: ni beege wïth juurre moa cään Wuuö Jwøki kiperge na kööe jï jø Icriel, ni «Kär dëëtu nywømmu ki geni wala ge nywøma dëëtge ki uuni, kiper ka adïëri møn, geni cwïnynyu løøge baŋ juu moge.» 'Ba Cølöman atïmö ni cwïnye ena køør mään moøgø døc.
english: Of the nations concerning which the Lord said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

anywaa: 'Ba ena nyöömö ki mään ma dïpe abïriiø ma nyïï nyeye, ki mään møøk ma dïpe adäk, ni ö määre moøgøøni ni løøge cwïny gø wøk ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Cølömanni na jaal, cwïnye aløø määre wøk baŋ juu møøk; ni ö cwïnye bäre ni tïme ni ba en køør Jwøe ma Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat mana bëët cwïny wänni ma Deebit ni ena køør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.

anywaa: Kiper Cølöman atïmö ni caatha køør Actaröth, jwø jø Caydan, ki Milköm, gïna no otieŋø ni wø lam jø Amönni, ni wø raac yi Wuuö Jwøki ki gø.
english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman atïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïme ni ba cäädhi køør Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnye bäre, kaawat mana bëët wänni ma Deebit ni cäädha køør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and went not fully after the Lord, as did David his father.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman atïïö ki kar lam bäät thuur mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Jerucalem jï Kemöc, gïna no otieŋø ni wø lam jø Möapi, ni wø raac yi Wuuö Jwøki ki gø; ni cäŋ tïïö ki kar lam jï Mölek, gïna no otieŋø ni wø lam jø Amönni, ni wø raac yi Wuuö Jwøki ki gø.
english: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø ki kwör lam jï juu mo wø lam määre bëët moa näk juurre, ni ö määrögø ni bëëtge ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met ni ge cïpö ko olämme jï juu moge.
english: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki Cølöman kiper mana ö Cølömanni na løø cwïnye wøk ki jööre, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na nyooth ree jïre kwöre ariiø,
english: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the Lord God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,

anywaa: na kööm eni ni eni ba doo cäädhö køør juu møøk; 'ba eni luubö mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni ki gø käre gwøø.
english: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the Lord commanded.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Cølöman, ni «Kiper mana nø tïïyï gïn, ni kärï luumma tuuda gwøø, ki ciik moa köömma ïïni ki ge, ka adïëri møn, nyec cööda wøk cerï, ni wëëga gø ŋat mo tïïö tierï.
english: Wherefore the Lord said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper wäru ma Deebit, gïnögø ba tïïa kanyo poode niï kwøw; 'ba aani, nyec manøgø cööda wøk cer wäädï.
english: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.

anywaa: 'Ba nyec bäre ba cööda wøk cere, 'ba wï tuuŋ aciel ocïba jïre kiper dhaanhnha ma Deebit ki Jerucalem na näk yaa jierø.»
english: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Adat nyï Ëdöm, nyen mo ena dhi øt nyec mar jø Ëdöm, athïïŋe na nyimän mar Cølöman.
english: And the Lord stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba ya awaŋca, kanya këët Deebiti ki jø Ëdöm, Jöap kwääc lwaa leny mar Deebit aci kuna koony jiy moa no othøw, ni put jø Ëdöm bëët moa näk cwøw 'näk.
english: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

anywaa: Ni ö Jöapi ki jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët ni bëëtge Ëdöm ki dwäde abïciel, këël mana 'näkge cwøw Ëdöm bëët.
english: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

anywaa: Kanyøgø beeye kanya ö Adati na reŋ Ijep, ni eni reŋi na aciel ki jø Ëdöm møøk mo tïïö tier wänni. 'Ba kar kaace, Adat poot na nyilaal mo thiinh.
english: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïŋŋö ki Midien ni öge Paran; ni lwötge ki jiy Paran nee cääthge ki geni, ni öge Ijep baŋ Peerø nyeny jø Ijep. Ni ö Peerø ni mooc Adat ki øtø ki cam ki ŋøøm.
english: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø atïmö ni mëër ki Adat døc, ni ö eni ni cïp nyi menni cöök cïïe na dhaagø jï Adat, ni beeye nyi menni cöök gwanynyø man na cïïe en ma Thapana.
english: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

anywaa: Ni ö cöök Thapana ni nyöön Adat ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Genöbat, ni piithi ya Thapana po Peerø. Ni ö Genöbati ni put bëëtö po Peerø ki wäät Peerø na aciel.
english: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya Adati Ijep ni Deebit anø thøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni wïny gø ni Jöap kwääc lwaa leny athøw thuwø, Adat aköö jï Peerø, ni «Beerra man wëëgï aani wääth naa døøa powa.»
english: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø aköö jïre, na «?Aŋø, agïne na canï ki gø baŋa, ni kööï niï manynya man døøï pou en?» 'Ba aløøe, ni «Bäŋgø; 'ba wec aani naa aa.»
english: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk thuwø nyimän mør athïïŋe dëër Cølöman, ni beeye Redhön wär Eliada, na näk opäär wøk ki baŋ nyenynye ma Adadëdher nyeny jø Dhöba.
english: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

anywaa: 'Ba køør mana ö Deebiti na nø 'näk jø Dhöba, Redhön ree acuŋŋe ki dïtwïëte ni tïme na kwäärö marge. Ni ö geni ni cige Damacka ni bëëtge kunece, ni put Damacka tïmö ni ena cere.
english: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

anywaa: 'Ba Redhön abëëdö na nyimän mar jø Icriel ki yïth nïne bëët moa beet Cølömanni, ni meet gïïa reyø na tïïc Adati; ni ö eni ni bëëde na nyeya bäät jø Aram, ni bëëde ni män ki jø Icriel.
english: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm o Nebat, nyen ma nyï tuuŋ Ipariem mo bëëdö Jereda, ma ŋat mo tïïö tier Cølöman, mo nyeŋ menni beeye Dherua, nyijø ma cï thøø, ena gëëmö ki nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zeredah, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

anywaa: 'Ba ageem na täge, tägi na ennønø. Cølöman kanya no othørø ni wø cwøl na Milø atïïe, ni cïëk kanya ŋaam ri kiir mar pääny wänni ma Deebit.
english: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Jeröbäm beeye ŋat mo teek mo kare dagø dï jø poge. 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na joot gø ni nyenøgø ni poot na wøp enø, tïïc tïïe tïïö døc, ena tïïe na wïth jø tïïc mo wø tïïc tïïe moa teek bëët na käl yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Maneeca ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem.
english: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel, ni Jeröbäm tïŋŋa Jerucalem, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Akiya nyï Cëëlö arøømmø ki eni waŋjöö. 'Ba Akiya dëëre ee runynyö ka abïï mo nyään; 'ba beege keerge na ariiø yøø na en yi pwöla.
english: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Akiya abïï manøgø ni nyään ni ee røø dëëre enø, agööny wøk, ni jeec gø kwöre apaar kurriiø.
english: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï Jeröbäm, ni «Lwötï jïrï ki thäk abïïe apaar; kiper Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, nyec cööda wøk cer Cølöman, ni mooa ïïni ki wïth tuŋi apaar;
english: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:

anywaa: 'ba Cølöman dööŋ ki wï tuuŋ aciel, ni beeye kiper dhaanhnha ma Deebit ki Jerucalem, pääny mana näk yaa nø jier røk päänye mo wïth tuŋi bëët mo jø Icriel.
english: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)

anywaa: 'Ba nyec okäla wøk cer Cølöman, kiper geni aana nø wecge, ni nø wøørge Actaröth jwø jø Caydan, ki Kemöc jwø jø Möap, ki Milköm jwø jø Amön; ni kärge køøra caadhø, ni kärge  tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jïra, ni kärge ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa gwøø, kaawat mana ö Deebiti wää Cølömanni na gwøk gïïögø.
english: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aani, nyec bäre ba käla wøk cere, 'ba eni tïïa tïïö nee put bëëtö na wïth jiy ki yïth nïne moo beede bëët, kiper dhaanhnha ma Deebit na jiera, na gwøk gïïa cema ki ciik 'moa.
english: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

anywaa: 'Ba aani nyec lwøra lwørø cer wääde, ni cïba gø jïrï, këël wïth tuŋi moa na apaar.
english: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.

anywaa: 'Ba wï tuuŋ aciel ocïba jï wääde, kiper nee dhaanhnha ma Deebit nee bëëde ni da wïïe nyïma yi Jerucalem, pääny mana jiera kiper dëëra nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie.
english: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jeröbäm en, ï käla kälö ni tïmï ni ïïna nyeya bäät jø Icriel kanya manynyï jaak.
english: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo luup bëët mo wø caana jïrï wïnynyï wïnynyö, ni cäädhi køøra, ni tïïyï gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jïra, niï gwøga ciik 'moa ki luup moa cema, kaawat mana tïïc dhaanhnha ma Deebit, aani, a puta bëëtö ki ïïni ni këëlla tier nyec marï piny kaawat mana tïïa jï Deebit, ni cïba jø Icriel jïrï.
english: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Deebit caanna caannø kiper raay moa tïïc Cølömanni, 'ba paa na bäre bäre.› »
english: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Cølöman atïmö ni manynya man näk Jeröbäm; 'ba Jeröbäm aö maal ni reŋ Ijep baŋ Cicak nyeny jø Ijep, ni bëëde Ijep këël mana thøw Cølömanni.
english: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi møga bëët moa tïïc Cølömanni, ki luum leec wïc mare, ogöör piny yi Wëël Tïïe Mo Cølöman.
english: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri bëët moa beet Cølömanni Jerucalem ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel beege cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman athøw, ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi pääny wänni ma Deebit, ni ö wääde ma Reeyöböm ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm aci Cekam, kiper jø Icriel bëët onø ci Cekam nee eni tïïcge na nyeya.
