english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm o Nebat na wïny gïnögø, ena duuö ki Ijep, ni beeye kanya reŋ yie ni eni ŋwieya nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

anywaa: Køøre gena jääk baŋ Jeröbäm nee ööe; ni ö Jeröbämmi ki lwaa Icriel bäre ni öge ni cäänge ki Reeyöböm ni köge,
english: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wäru bëëtö marwa atïïe ni caala tëër mo peek bäätwa. 'Ba ennø, bëëtö mana teek na caal tëër mo peek na wara tïïc wäru bäätwa, tïïyï ni jööt; køøre nø, ï tïnywa tïnynyö.»
english: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm aköö jïge, ni «Døøgu nø, ni bëëdu ki nïne adäk; køøre uuno duu baŋa.» Køøre jøøgø gena døøk.
english: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya ma Reeyöböm acaara mar jø døøŋŋø apëënynye, ni beege jøøa wara tïny wänni ma Cølöman kanya bëët wänni ni poot kwøw, ni kööe, na «?Acaara mo nyïëdi noo cïpu jïra naa jïta ki øtjöö man dwøga luum jøøi ki gø?»
english: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?

anywaa: Køøre adwøk jøøgø jïre ni köge, ni «Ni näk mo luum jøøgø wïnynyï wïnynyö dïcäŋi, ni jïëyï ki man tïnynyï geni, ni dwøgï luubö marge niï cara luup mo beyø jïge, ge tïmö ni gena jiy mo tïnynya ïïni na bäre bäre.»
english: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba acaara mana cïp jø døøŋŋø jïre awiie, ni tïme ni pëënynya acaara mar obwöre moa piith ki eni na aciel, na tïny eni.
english: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Acaara mo nyïëdi noo cïpu jïra kiper nee luubö dwøgø jï jøøi ii na cäänö ki aani na köö, ni ‹Bëëtö marwa na caal tëër mo peek na wara tïïc wäru bäätwa, tïïyï ni jööt›?»
english: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre moa piith ki eni na aciel adwøkge jïre ni köge, ni «?Köö  jøøgø ni bëëtö marge mana tïïc wäru ni teek bäätge, tïïyï jïge ni jööt? Ennø, caanï jïge, ni ‹Lweeta man ni thiinh en otïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni ki pier wära.
english: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana ö wära na tïïc bëëtö maru ni teek ni caala tëër mo peek, aani bëëtö maru cäŋa ka tïïyö ni teek døc ni kaala mana tïïc wära. Wära u pwönynye ka alaŋŋe, 'ba aani u pwönynya pwönynyö ka alaŋŋe mo lethe caala leth dha agarap.› »
english: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää nïne, Jeröbäm ki jiy bëët gena duu baŋ nyeya ma Reeyöböm kaawat mana caane na kööe, ni «Uuno duu baŋa ri dää nïne.»
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya luummögø aput dwøk baŋ jøøgø ni teek, kiper ena kweer ka acaara mana cïp jø døøŋŋø jïre,
english: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;

anywaa: ni caan gø jïge ki køør acaara mana cïp obwöre jïre, ni kööe, ni «Wära bëëtö maru atïïe ni teek ni caala tëër mo peek bäätu; 'ba aani bëëtö maru cäŋa ka tïïyö ni teek døc ni kaala mana tïïc wära. Wära u pwönynye ka alaŋŋe; 'ba aani u pwönynya pwönynyö ka alaŋŋe mo lethe caala leth dha agarap.»
english: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya luum jøøgø käre wïnynyö, kiper gïnögø beeye gïn mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, nee luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Jeröbäm o Nebat ki dha Akiya nyï Cëëlö thur kare.
english: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the Lord, that he might perform his saying, which the Lord spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli bëët na jootge gø ni marge kär wïny nyeya, adwøkge jï nyeya, ni köge, «?Aŋø, waani, da kurwa ri Deebit? Waani, kee bäŋ gïn mo dooŋ na kurwa ki røk jap o Jeci. Wui jø Icriel, ŋati man nø døø paare. 'Ba ï na nyikwaar Deebit, dööŋï keerï ki jø dhi ødï.» Kanyøgø jø Icriel gena put døø mïëcge.
english: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm abëëdö na nyeya mar jø Icriel moa bëëdö yïth päänye mo Juuda.
english: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Reeyöböm, Adöram na bëëdö na wïth jø tïïc mo wø mak ki teek ajääŋŋe baŋ jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni këërge gø ki kïte, ni put thøø. Køøre nyeya ma Reeyöböm alaar eth yi jääne man wø tut okweenynyi ni reŋ Jerucalem.
english: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel gena put tïmö ni ge gëëmö ki jø dhi øt Deebit këël dïcäŋi.
english: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na wïnyge gø ni Jeröbäm aduuö ki Ijep, gena jäägö ni cwølge eni nee ö kar acooŋa, ni tïïcge eni na nyeya bäät jø Icriel. 'Ba bäŋ wï tuuŋ mør mo odwätö ki dhi øt Deebit, 'ba beege jø tuuŋ Juuda keere na dwätö ki dhi øt Deebit.
english: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Reeyöbömmi na pïïe yi Jerucalem, jø leny moa teek døc mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen acooŋe, ni beege jø leny ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërabära, nee këëtge ki jø Icriel, kiper nee buc nyec duu baŋ Reeyöböm o Cølöman.
english: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Cemaya ni kööe,
english: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï nyeny Juuda ma Reeyöböm o Cølöman, ki jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki jø møga,
english: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

anywaa: ni mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Käru cøø nou këëdu ki nyïïmëëgu ma jø Icriel. Ŋati man nø døø paare, kiper gïnögø käla baŋa.› » Køøre luum Wuuö Jwøk aputge wïnynyö, ni døøge mïëcge, kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the Lord, and returned to depart, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Jeröbäm, Cekam, na en yïth mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, acäŋ geerrø ni teek, ni bëëde kaace. Ni cøøe ni cäŋ Peniël geerrø ni teek.
english: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm acädö ki cwïnye, ni «Ennø, nyec duua dhi øt Deebit;
english: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

anywaa: kiper ni näk mo jøøi ge cøø cooth ni cïpge ko olämme yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk Jerucalem, cwïnyge døøa baŋ nyenyge ma Reeyöböm nyeny Juuda; ni ö geni ni 'näkge aani, ni døøge baŋ Reeyöböm nyeny Juuda.»
english: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya acädö bäät luummögø. Køøre ena tïïö ki nyïïrøøe ariiø mo tïïc ka warkey, ni kööe jï jiy, ni «U na jø Icriel, ciin Jerucalem atïmö ni teek jïïu. Neennu, juu mou beege ii, na käl u wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.»
english: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre eni røk juugögø aciel acwöth Bëthël, ni cwöth maya Daan.
english: And he set the one in Beth–el, and the other put he in Dan.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø aput tïmö na raay jï jø wø wøør ge, ni wø aay këël Daan.
english: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

anywaa: Køøre ena gëëdö ki uut lam bäät thuuri, ni röönye ki dïlämme røk jiy bëët jaak, këël na bëëtge ni ge patha jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeröbämmi ni cïp piny ki dïcäŋ ajwöma mo di wøørø ni nïr dwää abära apaar kurbïïc, kaawat dïcäŋ ajwöma man wø wøør jø Juuda. Ni ö eni ni cïpe ko olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte Bëthël jï nyïïrøøe moa näk ee tïïö. Ni cïp Bëthël ki dïlämme yïth uut lam moa näk ee geer bäät thuuri.
english: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth–el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth–el the priests of the high places which he had made.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni nïr dwää abära apaar kurbïïc, ni beeye dwääy mana näk ee jierø ki cwïnye keere, ena cïpö ko olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana tïïe Bëthël, ni eni tïïya dïcäŋ manøgø nee wøør jø Icrielli.
english: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth–el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyikuŋ Jwøk ma aöö ki Juuda ni ööa Bëthël ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre, kanya bëët Jeröbämmi ni cuŋŋö buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni cïpö ko olämme.
english: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the Lord unto Beth–el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

anywaa: Køøre ena köök bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni caana dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, «Wui, ï na gïn wø cïp olämme bääte! Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, nyilaal ma dïcwøø olwaarø ki gø dhi øt Deebit, ni cak nyeŋŋe ni Jöcaya. 'Ba eni dïlämme mo kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri, ni wø cïpi ko olämme bäätï, oŋare bäätï, ni ö cuu mo jiy ni waaŋi bäätï.› »
english: And he cried against the altar in the word of the Lord, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the Lord; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.

anywaa: Køøre ena cïpö ki ŋïï dïcäŋeca, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye ŋïï mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ‹Neennu, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte opääi ki dïëre, ni ö burri mana en yie ni øc piny.› »
english: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the Lord hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Jeröbäm na wïny gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki, na kööe bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en Bëthël, Jeröbäm put nyuuthö ki buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kööe, ni «Magu nyenøgø.» 'Ba cere mana nyooth ŋatøgø ki gø aput talø, ni käre løny jïre këët ki man døl gø.
english: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Beth–el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

anywaa: Këël gïn wø cïp olämme bääte thuwø aput pääö ki dïëre, ni ö burri ni put øc piny ki yi gø, ki køør ŋïï mana cïp nyikuŋ Jwøki ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyeya ma Jeröbäm acäänö ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ni kööe, ni «Beerra man kwayï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni lämï kipera nee cera døø kare.» Kanyøgø, nyikuŋ Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk akwaae, ni ö cer nyeya ni døø kare kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ.
english: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Entreat now the face of the Lord thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the Lord, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jeröbäm aköö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk, ni «Waa cøø paac na aciel niï jïtï ki gïn camï, niï mooa ki gïrpiny.»
english: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aköö jï nyeya, ni «Këël miï cïpa thääŋ japï cøøn, a ba aay ki ïïni, naa ba cämö naa ba mäthi ki pïï kany.
english: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

anywaa: Kiper aano cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kööe, ni ‹Ïïni, ï ba doo cämö niï ba doo mäthö ki pïï, niï ba doo duuö ki jöö mana cørï yie.› »
english: For so was it charged me by the word of the Lord, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, ena put døø ki jöö mør, ni käre døøk ki jöö mana ö Bëthël ki gø.
english: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth–el.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyikuŋ Jwøk ma jaal mo bëëdö Bëthël. Køøre wääte aö baŋe ni caange jammi bëët moa tïïc nyikuŋ Jwøki Bëthël dïcäŋögø jïre; këël luup moa caan nyikuŋ Jwøki jï nyeya ma Jeröbäm acaange jï wääge.
english: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth–el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Beth–el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

anywaa: Køøre wääge aköö jïge, ni «?Eno cøra jööre?» 'Ba wääte jööra cør nyikuŋ Jwøki mana käl Juuda ŋäcge.
english: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jï wääte, ni «Jiiŋŋu arëën jïra.» Køøre wääte arëën ajiiŋge jïre, ni aae ni cäädhi ka bäät arëën.
english: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

anywaa: Ni aae ni läpa køør nyikuŋ Jwøk ni joot gø no opï piny tier jaath;  ni kööe jïgø, ni «?Beeye ï nyikuŋ Jwøk mana käl Juuda?» Ni løk gø, ni «Beeye aani.»
english: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïgø, ni «Waa cøø paac na aciel, niï jïtï gïn camï.»
english: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe, ni «Aani, a ba døøk ki ïïni, naa ba cäädhi ki ïïni thuwø. Aani, a ba cämö naa ba mäthi ki pïï ki ïïni kany.
english: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:

anywaa: Kiper aano cem Wuuö Jwøki ni kööe, ni ‹Ï ba doo cämö niï ba doo mäthö ki pïï kaace; niï ba doo duuö ki jöö mana cørï yie.› »
english: For it was said to me by the word of the Lord, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk mana näk jaal acäänö ki wïïe keere ni kööe jïgø, ni «Aani, aana nyikuŋ Jwøk mo caala ïïni thuwø, ni da luum Wuuö Jwøk mo ocaan nyïïatwiel maalli jïra, ni kööe, ni ‹Ciï ni duuï eni paarï, nee cäme nee mäthe ki pïï.› » 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø, mare cwøk.
english: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena put døø ki nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø, ni cäme paare ni mäthe ki pïï.
english: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëtge ni geno pï piny lak cam, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk mana duu nyikuŋ Jwøk paac.
english: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came unto the prophet that brought him back:

anywaa: Køøre ena köök bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk mana öö ki Juuda, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö ni luumma caane akwierï, ni kärï luumme mana cem ïïni ki gø gwøø, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï,
english: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the Lord, and hast not kept the commandment which the Lord thy God commanded thee,

anywaa: ni cäŋï duuö ni cämï ni mäthï ki pïï kanya caane jïrï niï ba doo cämö niï ba doo mäthö ki pïï yie. Kiper manøgønø, ï di nääö, ni ba koony ïïni buut kwäyu.»
english: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the Lord did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø løny nyikuŋ Jwøki ki cam ni nø mäthe ki pïï, nyikuŋ Jwøk mana duu eni paac, arëën ajiiŋŋe jïgø.
english: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïŋ nyikuŋ Jwøki, ena røømmø ki ŋuu øtjöö, ni ö eni ni cami ya ŋuuwi ni thøøe, ni leeŋ rïŋ dëëre thääŋ jöö, ni cuŋ arëënni buute; ni ö ŋuuwi thuwø ni cuŋŋe buute.
english: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa pöödhö ki buute, rïŋ dëëre ajootge no oleeŋ thääŋ jöö ni ŋuu cuŋŋö buute; køøre gena aay ni caange gø yi pääny mana en nyikuŋ Jwøki mana näk jaal yie.
english: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyikuŋ Jwøki mana duu eni ki jöö na wïny gø, ena köö, ni «Beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk mana kwier luumma cem Wuuö Jwøki. Ena cïp Wuuö Jwøki dhi ŋuu, ni jeeyi, ni thøøe ki køør luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jïre ni eni di nääö.»
english: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord: therefore the Lord hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake unto him.

anywaa: Køøre, nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø acäänö ki wääte ni kööe, ni «Jiiŋŋu arëën jïra.» Ni ö wääte ni jiiŋge gø jïre.
english: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.

anywaa: Køøre ena aay ki bäät gø ni joot dëër ŋatøgø no oleeŋ thääŋ jöö, na arëën ki ŋuu cuŋŋö buute. 'Ba ŋuu dëër dhaanhø käre camø, këël arëën käre gudö ki dhee.
english: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk rïŋ dëër gø alwøre ni cïp gø bäät arëën, ni duu gø paac yi pääny mana näk mare, nee jwöŋe kiper gø nee koonye.
english: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

anywaa: Ni pïël dëër gø yi bwörö mare, ni jwöŋge kiper gø, ni köge, ni «Wui, coka!»
english: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø lønye ki koony nyikuŋ Jwøk, ena cäänö ki wääte ni kööe, ni «Kanyo thøøa, wär a koonynyu yi bwörö mana koony nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø yie, nou cïba cuu 'moa buut cuu moe.
english: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

anywaa: Kiper gïna caane bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en Bëthël ki bäät uut lam bëët moa en bäät thuuri na en yïth päänye mo Cameria, na cïp Wuuö Jwøki dhee ni caane, thur kare møn.»
english: For the saying which he cried by the word of the Lord against the altar in Beth–el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

anywaa: 'Ba këël køør gïnögø, Jeröbäm jöör raay käre wiiø, 'ba ena cäŋ röönyö ki dïlämme kiper kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri røk jiy bëët, ni beege jø wø many gø jaak noo røønye nee tïmge na dïlämme mo kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri.
english: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø aput tïmö na raay jï dhi øt Jeröbäm, këël mana put tïmö ni beeye pädhö mare, ni dït wïthge bäät piny.
english: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Abaaja wär Jeröbäm atïmö ni tuu.
english: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

anywaa: Køøre Jeröbäm aköö jï cïïe, ni «Ö maal ni runynyï dëërï ka abïïe miï ba ŋec ki ge ni ïïna cïïa, ni ciï Cëëlö. Neenï, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Akiya ena kunece, ŋata cäänö  kipera naa tïma ni aana nyeya bäät jiyi.
english: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

anywaa: 'Ba wärï käädï ki dääpe apaar, ki muunni mo omiinynyø, ka agwäy mo yie da maar kïc, ni ciï baŋe. Eni gïno tägi dëër nyilaal caane caanø jïrï.»
english: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.

anywaa: Køøre cï Jeröbäm gïnögø aput tïïc, ni ö maal ni aa Cëëlö, ni ci po Akiya. 'Ba Akiya oløny na cwør, ni nyeŋŋe ba rääŋö këët, kiper eno løny na jaal.
english: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

anywaa: 'Ba onø caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Akiya, ni «Neenï, cï Jeröbäm ööa baŋï kuna pëëny ïïni kiper nyilaal mare, kiper nyilaal mare tuu. 'Ba ïïni, gïn ki gïn wär caanï jïre, kiper kanyo ööe, eni ööi ni ree ee cøøgø keda ena dhaagø mør.»
english: And the Lord said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akiya na wïny tiet nyijøøgø ni nyijøøgø cäänhnha dhi øtø, ena köö, ni «Dunynyï, cï Jeröbäm. ?Aŋø, riï cøøgï gø keda ïïna dhaagø mør en aperŋø? Aani, da luum ajäla mo teek mo ocaanø jïra nee caana jïrï.
english: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ciï ni caanï gø jï Jeröbäm ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, aköö, ni ‹Ïïna thïïŋa yïthakic jiya ma jø Icriel, ni tïïa ïïni na bwödhi bäätge,
english: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,

anywaa: ni cööda nyec wøk ki dhi øt Deebit ni cïba gø jïrï. 'Ba ïïni, ï kär tïmö kaamar dhaanhnha ma Deebit, na gwøk gïïa cema na cäädhö køøra ki cwïnye bäre, na bëëdö ni tïïya gïïa näk nëëni ni beyø ki jïra cooth.
english: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;

anywaa: Ïïni thuwø, ïïna tïmö niï tïïya raay mo thööth ni kaala moa tïïc jiy moa dïkwøŋ na bwøth maal nyïmï, ni ciï ni tïï ki juu møøk kiper dëërï, ni tïï ki kït gïï mo oleenyø na gïï lam, niï tïïya aani naa goota, ni kwierï aani.
english: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, aani, a känna bäät jø dhi ødï, ï na Jeröbäm, ki gïn mo leth, ni nääa cwøw bëët moa käl dhi ødï moa en dï Icriel, këël laaŋe, ni jwiea jø dhi ødï wøk, kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø jwieø juu wøk, këël man wø thumge wøk bëët.
english: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jeröbäm, dhaanhnhï mano thøø yi pääny, eni cam guuwi camø. 'Ba man wäro thøø yi pwöla, cam wenynyi camø; kiper onø caan Wuuö Jwøki.›
english: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na cï Jeröbäm, ö maal ni døøï paarï. 'Ba kanyo nyøønï pääny ennø, nyilaal puta thøø.
english: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli bëët ni jwöŋge kipere ni koonyge eni. 'Ba beeye eni keere noo koony yi bwörö røk jø dhi øt Jeröbäm, kiper beeye eni na jït Wuuö Jwøki Jwø Icriel baŋe ki gïn mo beer røk jø dhi øt Jeröbäm.
english: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk otïŋ maal ki nyeya kiper dëëre bäät jø Icriel, ni ö eni ni 'näk jø dhi øt Jeröbäm ki mano täge dïcäŋi ennø, këël yi nyïme.
english: Moreover the Lord shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk otïïö dëët jø Icriel ki gïï mo leth, ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi, kaawat man wø ö otööki wø tuuŋŋi ya pïïyi; ni ö eni ni cööt jø Icriel wøk ki yi ŋöömmi ni beer en na näk ee cïbö jï kwäcge, ni keeth geni ni leeŋ ge ŋää Naam Upareeti, kiper mana cööthge piny ki jenni moa no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara, ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: For the Lord shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the Lord to anger.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel kwiere kwierø kiper gïïa reyø na tïïc Jeröbämmi na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay.»
english: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: Køøre cï Jeröbäm aö maal ni tïŋŋe ni døø Tirja. 'Ba kanya pïïe dhi øtø bäät thudhi ennø, nyilaal aput thøø.
english: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel bëët nyilaal akoonyge ni jwöŋge kipere, kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Akiya.
english: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jeröbämmi, ki lenye moa këële, ki jöö mana käär jiy ki gø ni ena nyeya, ka adïëri møn, gïïögø bëët ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Jeröbämmi ni ena nyeya beege cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka ariiø. Køøre ena thøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni ö wääde ma Nadap ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm o Cølöman abëëdö na nyeya Juuda. 'Ba Reeyöböm cwiiye  pïëraŋween kurciel kanya tïme na nyeya, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïriiø ni ena nyeya Jerucalem, pääny mana jier Wuuö Jwøki røk päänye bëët mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel nee nyeŋŋe bëëde ni ŋäc yie. 'Ba nyeŋ mii Reeyöbömmi beeye Nayma nyi jø Amön.
english: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda gena tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni këëye ki køør gïïa reyø na tïïcge ni kaala moa tïïc kwäcge bëët.
english: And Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

anywaa: 'Ba geni thuwø, gena gëëdö ki kwör lam bäät thuuri kiper dëëtge, ni cööthge piny ki kïte ki jenni moa no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara na gïï lamge bäät thuuri moa bäyö bëët ki tiet jen bëët moa no onigïït piny.
english: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

anywaa: Këël yi ŋöömmögø thuwø da cwøw ma kääpe mo ge tïïö kwör lam. 'Ba jø Juuda, gena tïmö ni ge temma jammi moa näk Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki ge kaawat moa tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïï cwiiri moa beet nyeya ma Reeyöbömmi ni ena nyeya, Cicak nyeny Ijep aöö ni këëde ki jø Jerucalem.
english: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

anywaa: Ni twier jammi moa no okanø yi øt kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki moa no okanø yi øt kän jammi mo øt nyec, ni käl jammi bëët. Këël kööt leny moa no otïïö ki warkey na tïïc Cølömanni akäle bëët thuwø.
english: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Reeyöböm atïïö ki kööt leny møøk mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na kar moøgø, ni cïp ge ceŋ kwääc jø koor mo wø koor dhi øt nyec.
english: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö nyeya wø døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, jø koor kööt leny moøgø käärge käärö, ni kany wø duuge wøk, duuge yi øt jø koor.
english: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the Lord, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Reeyöbömmi bëët, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm ki Jeröbäm ge bëëdö ni da leny yïthakicge cooth.
english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Nayma nyi jø Amön. Køøre wääde ma Abaaja aläw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abära moa beet Jeröbämmi o Nebat ni ena nyeny Icriel, Abaaja atïmö na nyeya Juuda yi Jerucalem,
english: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.

anywaa: ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri adäk. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Maika nya Abicalöm.
english: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

anywaa: 'Ba Abaaja abëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa reyø bëët moa tïïc wänni, ni bëëde ni cwïnye bäre käre cïp køør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, kaawat mana bëët cwïny kwari ma Deebit ni ena køør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper Deebit, ena mooc Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk mare, ki wïïe mo dööŋ Jerucalem, ni jïte ki wääde mo läw kar gø na nyeya køøre, nee Jerucalem bëëde ni teek.
english: Nevertheless for David's sake did the Lord his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

anywaa: Kiper Deebit abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni käre gaa wøk ki gïïa köömmi ya Wuuö Jwøki ki geni bëët, yïth nïne moa beede bëët; 'ba beeye luum Uria nyï Këth keere na gaa wøk ki gø.
english: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne moa beet Abaaja bëët, Reeyöböm ki Jeröbäm ge bëëdö ni ge këëdö ki dëëtge cooth.
english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Abaaja ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda. 'Ba yïthakic Abaaja ki Jeröbäm aput bëëtö ni da leny.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

anywaa: Køøre Abaaja athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Aca ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø moa beet Jeröbämmi ni ena nyeny Icriel, Aca atïmö na nyeya Juuda yi Jerucalem.
english: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween ka aciel. 'Ba nyeŋ waŋi beeye Maika nya Abicalöm.
english: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc kwari ma Deebit.
english: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the Lord, as did David his father.

anywaa: Eni kääpe moa näk mään ki cwøw mo wø tïïö kwör wø lam juu møøk yïthge ariemme yïth ŋøøm moe, ni wet gïï wø lam bëët moa tïïc kwäye.
english: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

anywaa: 'Ba eni teek gwac mar waŋi ma Maika akäl wøk cer gø, kiper waŋi atëëŋö ki jaath mo di lamø mo ec raac ki gø, mo ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara; ni ö eni ni käl jaath waŋi manøgø no otieŋø enø wøk, ni waaŋ gø waŋ Naam Kidaran.
english: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

anywaa: 'Ba kwör lam moa no otïïö maal bäät thuuri käre raanynyø, 'ba Aca abëëdö ni cwïnye bäre ee cïp køør Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth nïne bëët moa beede.
english: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the Lord all his days.

anywaa: Ni käl jammi mo wänni ki moe moa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni beege gwel-bïrö ki warkey ki jap paac, ni kïth geni yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the Lord, silver, and gold, and vessels.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne bëët moa beet Aca nyeny Juuda ki Baaca nyeny Icriel, ge bëëdö ni ge këëdö ki dëëtge cooth.
english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

anywaa: 'Ba Baaca nyeny Icriel acøø ni këëde ki jø Juuda, ni ö päänya cwøl ni Reema ni geer gø ni teek, ni gëëŋa jöö, kiper nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo pöötha baŋ Aca nyeny Juuda, nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo duny wøk ki Juuda.
english: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca gwel-bïrö ki warkey moa dööŋ yi øt kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa dööŋ yi øt kän jammi mar øt nyec, akäle ni cïp ge ceŋ jø kööre moe, ni jääŋ ge baŋ Ben-Adat o Thabrimön nyïkwaar Ëdhyön nyeny jø Aram na bëëdö Damacka, ni kööe,
english: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben–hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beerra man ö ïïni ki aani ni tudø ki luubö yïthakiyø, kaawat mana en yïthakic wära ki wäru. 'Ba ennø, aana jääk baŋï ki muuy, ni beeye gwel-bïrö ki warkey; ciï ni raanynyï luubö mana näk iï tuudö ki Baaca nyeny Icriel, kiper nee eni ö wøk paara.»
english: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

anywaa: Køøre Ben-Adat luum nyeya ma Aca awïnynye, ni jääŋ kwääc lwaae mo leny moe, ni cige ni tukge päänye mo jø Icriel, ni makge Ijöön, ki Daan, ka Abël-Bëëth-Maika, ki mïëya en buut puur Kinërët, këël ŋøøp Naptali bäre.
english: So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel–beth–maachah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Baaca na wïny gïnögø, Reema aput wec ki man geer gø, ni døø Tirja.
english: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Aca acïpö ki dwøl jï tiet mïëc Juuda bëët, ni bäŋgø mo ee wiiø. Køøre gena aay ni jwïëkge kïte ki jer geer moa ö Baaca na dee Reema geerø ki ge. Ni ö nyeya ma Aca ni geer Gëba na en yi ŋööm Benjamen, ki Micpa ki ge.
english: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc nyeya ma Aca, ki luum teek mare, ki luum päänye moa geere, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda. 'Ba kanya jale, ena tïmö ni eni tuu ki tiete.
english: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

anywaa: Køøre Aca athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Jøcapat ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa beet Aca na nyeny Juuda, Nadap wär Jeröbäm atïmö na nyeya Icriel, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri ariiø bäät jø Icriel.
english: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc wänni na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay.
english: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba Baaca wär Akiya, na käl røk jø tuuŋ Icakar, agëëmö ki Nadap, ni 'näk gø Gibetön, pääny mar jø Pilitin, kanya bëëde ni Nadap ki jø leny mo Icriel bëët Gibetön ege ciel dïër.
english: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.

anywaa: 'Ba Nadap anäk Baaca ni läw kar gø na nyeya ri dää cwiiri moa beet Aca na nyeny Juuda.
english: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Baaca na nyeya ennø, jø dhi øt Jeröbäm bëët aput 'näk, ni bäŋ jiy mo ee wiiø mo kwøw dhi øt Jeröbäm. Gena put 'näk bëët, ki køør luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Akiya nyï Cëëlö.
english: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

anywaa: Gïnögø atägö kiper raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi, na wëëk jø  Icriel tïïc ki raay, këël tïïe moa tïïe ni tïïya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee goote.
english: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Nadapi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne bëët moa beet Aca nyeny Juuda ki Baaca nyeny Icriel, ge bëëdö ni ge këëdö ki dëëtge cooth.
english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moa beet Aca na nyeya Juuda, Baaca wär Akiya atïmö na nyeya Icriel yi Tirja, ni käär paac ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc Jeröbäm, na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay.
english: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jiyu wär Anani kiper nee cääne ki Baaca, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö,
english: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Ï na Baaca en, ïïna tïŋa maal ki yi tør, ni tïïa ïïni ni ïïna wïth jiya ma jø Icriel. 'Ba køøre ïïna tïmö niï caatha køør Jeröbäm ni tïïyï jiya ma jø Icriel nee tïïge ki raay, ni ge tïïya aani naa goota kiper raay moa tïïcge.
english: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni na Baaca en, ki jø dhi ødï, u raanynya raanynyø, ni tïïa jø dhi ødï kaamar jø dhi øt Jeröbäm o Nebat.
english: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat dhi ødï mano thøø yi pääny, cam guuwi camø, ni mano thøø yi pwöla, cam wenynyi camø.› »
english: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Baaca, këël luum teek mare, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Baaca athøw ni läp køør kwäcge ni koonyi Tirja, ni ö wääde ma Ëla ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk na caane ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jiyu wär Anani aput tägö dëër Baaca ki jø dhi øde, kiper mana tïïe ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, na tïïc Wuuö Jwøk nee goote ki køør tïïe moøgø na caal moa tïïc jø dhi øt Jeröbäm. Ni paa manøgø keere, beeye kiper mana 'näk jø dhi øt Jeröbäm thuwø.
english: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the Lord against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Aca ni ena nyeny Juuda, kanya tïmge na pïërariiø ka abïciel, Ëla o Baaca atïmö na nyeya Icriel yi Tirja, ni käär paac ki cwiiri ariiø.
english: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhimri, ni wø tïïö tier Ëla na kwääy thääŋ lwaa leny man wø këëdi ki bäät jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, agëëmö ki Ëla. 'Ba kar kaagø, Ëla ena Tirja, ni mädhö no oløny ni manynya meerø yi øt Ardha, nyen ma kwääy paan dwøŋ mar Tirja.
english: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Dhimri aput öö ni døny yi øtø ni gøøc Ëla ni put gø 'näk, ni läw kar gø na nyeya. 'Ba kar kaagø beeye kanya päŋ cwiiri moa beet Aca ni ena nyeny Juuda na pïërariiø ka abïriiø.
english: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Dhimri na nyeya, ni beeye kanya pï piny bäät wälu ennø, eni jø dhi øt Baaca bëët aput 'näk; ni bäŋe dïcwøø aciel mo odööŋ ri tuuŋ Baaca, këël røk nyïïawääte.
english: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhimri jø dhi øt Baaca anääe bëët, ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Baaca ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jiyu.
english: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atägö ki køør raay bëët moa tïïc Baaca ki moa tïïc wääde ma Ëla, ni beege moa tïïcge na wëëkge jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel nee goote ki geni ki køør juu moge moa tieŋge.
english: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Ëla ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïriiø moa beet Aca ni ena nyeny Juuda, Dhimri abëëdö na nyeya ki nïne abïriiø Tirja. 'Ba jø leny mo Icriel onø tïïö ki twïër töök Gibetön na en yïth ŋøøp jø Pilitin kiper nee tukge.
english: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny jø lenynyi moa en yi twïër manøgø ni køp, ni «Dhimri anø gëëmö ki nyeya ni 'näk gø.» Kanyøgønø, jø leny bëët mo Icriel, Ømri kwääy lwaa leny aputge tïïc na nyeya mar Icriel twïër dïcäŋeca.
english: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.

anywaa: Køøre Ømri ki jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët moa bëëdö ki eni, gena tïŋŋö ki Gibetön, ni cige ni cielge Tirja dïër.
english: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Dhimri na joot gø ni pääny onø mak, ena døny kar gwøk  røk mana teek na en øt nyec, ni waaŋ øtø bääte, ni thøøe.
english: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atägö ki køør gïïa reyø na tïïe, na näk nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør mana bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc Jeröbäm na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay.
english: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Dhimri, këël luum ageem mana tïïe, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel dëëtge apääŋge kwöre ariiø; ni ö thääŋö acielli ni ci køør Tibini o Ginat, kiper nee tïïcge na nyeya, ni ö thääŋö maya ni ci køør Ømri.
english: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa ci køør Ømri atïmö ni teeka geni ki jiy moa ci køør Tibini o Ginat. Køøre Tibini anäk, ni ö Ømri ni tïme na nyeya.
english: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka aciel moa beet Aca ni ena nyeny Juuda, beeye kanya tïm Ømri na nyeya Icriel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø; ni cwiiri abïciel beede Tirja ni ena nyeya.
english: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

anywaa: Køøre thuur Cameria aŋee baŋ Cëmër ki gwet-bïrö mo jïtö ki kar kume abïciel; ni gëëde bäät gø ki pääny, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Cameria, ni caae ri nyeŋ Cëmër wää thuurri manøgø.
english: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba Ømri abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni raay moa tïïe kaala moa tïïc nyeye bëët moa bwøth maal nyïme.
english: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all that were before him.

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee goote ki geni ki køør juu moge moa tieŋge.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger with their vanities.

anywaa: 'Ba luup tïïe møga moa tïïc Ømri, këël luum teek mare, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Ømri athøw, ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi Cameria; ni ö wääde ma Akap ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abära moa beet Aca ni ena nyeny Juuda, Akap wär Ømri atïmö na nyeya mar Icriel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya Icriel yi Cameria ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurriiø.
english: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap wär Ømri abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk mo kaala moa tïïc nyeye bëët moa bwøth maal nyïme.
english: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord above all that were before him.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, mana bëëde ni eni caatha køør tïïe moa reyø na tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat, aneene na gïn mo thiinh, ni cäŋ Jedhebel nyi Ëtbaal nyeny jø Caydan nywømø, ni cøøe ni tïny jwøa cwøl ni Baal ni wøør gø.
english: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Baal yi øtø mana geere jï Baal Cameria.
english: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap thuwø acööth piny ki jaath mo otieŋø mo ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara. Ni ö Akapi ni tïïc Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee goote, ni kaala moa tïïc nyeye bëët mo Icriel moa bwøth maal nyïme.
english: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne moa beet Akapi ni ena nyeya, Kiël nyï Bëthël, Jerikö acäŋ geerrø. 'Ba kanya täge ki geer tier kiir, kanynye ma Abiram aput thøø, 'ba kanya kïth odhuulu mar dhi kiir, wääde ma Cegup, na näk aŋuunne, acäŋ thøwø, ni beeye ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ki dhi Jøcua o Nun.
english: In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaja nyï Ticbi na en yïth ŋøøp Gelät, aköö jï Akap, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na kwøw, ni wø tïnynya en, ka adïëri møn, ki yïth cwiiri moi ii, tïmö ni bäŋ thööy ki køth, ni näk mo ba caana aani ni køth pädhö.»
english: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the Lord God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Ilaaja ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Aayï kany ni ciï jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni kanï riï bäät waŋ Naam Kerit, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ  ki Naam Jördan.
english: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno mädhö ki pïï yi waŋ naamøgø. Aani, agääe yaa nø köömmö nee känge jïrï ki cam kaace.»
english: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.

anywaa: Køøre ena cøø ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde bäät waŋ Naam Kerit na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Naam Jördan.
english: So he went and did according unto the word of the Lord: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

anywaa: Ni ö agääe ni putge tïmö ni kännö jïre cooth ki møø ki rïŋö ka amöölla ka abøøya; 'ba eni mädhö yi waŋ naamøgø ki pïï.
english: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør nïne møøk, waŋ naam atal, kiper na bäŋe køth mo opädhö yi ŋöömmögø.
english: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Ilaaja ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni ciï Dherepeth na en tier Caydan, ni bëëdï kaace. Neenï, da nyijø ma cï thøø mo yaa nø köömmö kaace kiper niï wø mooe ki cam.»
english: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.

anywaa: Køøre ena ö maal ni ci Dherepeth. 'Ba kanya pïïe dhi kiir ennø, nyijø ma cï thøø anwäne kaace ni möödö ki jenni; ni cwøl gø ni kööe, ni «Nyijøøe, mooc aani ki pïï mo thenh nee maadha.»
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nyijøøgø ni aa kuna öömme ki pïï ennø, nyijøøgø acäŋ cwøllø ni kööe, ni «Nyijøøe, wär aani kuunnï thuwø ki thääŋ dääpö ki cerï nee cama.»
english: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï na kwøw, aani bäŋ dääpö jïra, 'ba beeye nyi møø ma yi cenø keere mo ena yi nya awal, ki nyi maaw mo thiinh mo ena tier agwäy. Ennø, beeye ni möönna ki jenni mo thenh en, naa døøa paac kiper nee thaala kipera ki wääda, nee camwa, nee wa putwa thøø køøre.»
english: And she said, As the Lord thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö jïre, ni «Kärï lwäyö. Ciï ni tïïyï gø kaawat mana caanï. 'Ba wärï kwøŋ tëëdö dëëre jïra ki dääpö mo thiinh ni kälï gø baŋa. Køøre nø, ïïno tëëdö kiperï ki wäädï.
english: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, aköö na ennønø, ni ‹Nya awar møø manøgø, tiere ba tal ki møø, ni ö agwää maawi manøgø ni ba tal tiere ki maaw, këël dïcäŋo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo jääŋ køth bäät piny.› »
english: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the Lord sendeth rain upon the earth.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø acøø ni tïïc gø ki køør dwør Ilaaja. Ni ö nyijøøgø, ki Ilaaja, ki jøøa en paare, ni putge bëëtö ni ge cämö ki nïne mo thööth.
english: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

anywaa: 'Ba nya awar møø manøgø aput bëëtö ni tiere kär tal, ni ö agwää maawi manøgø thuwø ni put bëëtö ni tiere kär tal, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ki dhi Ilaaja.
english: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by Elijah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, o nyijøøgø na wää paanøgø enø, atïmö ni tuu, ni tïm täwi mare ni leth këël mana tïme ni ba jwïëy këët.
english: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aköö jï Ilaaja, na «?Agïnaŋø ni en yïthakiyø ki ïïni, ï na nyikuŋ Jwøk en? ?Aŋø, ï ö baŋa niï tïïya raay 'moa nee wïïa para ki geni, niï tïïya wääda nee thøøe?»
english: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aköö jï nyijøøgø, ni «Käl wäädï baŋa.» Ni lwør gø kö menni, ni  käär gø ni eth yi øtø mana en maal na bëëde yie, ni pïël gø bäät pëëm mare.
english: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk apëënynye ni kööe, «?Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, aŋø, bee ïïni na käl gïn ni leth en dëër nyijøøi na cï thøø ni bëëda buute en, ni tïïyï wääde nee thøøe?»
english: And he cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

anywaa: Køøre yie arïëp bäät nyilaal kwöre adägö ni kwaaya Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, a kwaya ïïni, beerra man dwøgï jwïëy mo nyilaari dëëre.»
english: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the Lord, and said, O Lord my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dwør Ilaaja awïnynye, ni ö jwïëc nyilaalli ni duue, ni cäŋ kwøwø.
english: And the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja nyilaal alwøre, ni käl gø piny ki yi øtø mana en maal, ni mëëk gø menni. Ni kö Ilaaja, ni «Raŋï, nyilaal marï akwøw.»
english: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aköö jï Ilaaja, ni «Ennø, aputa ŋäc ni ïïna nyikuŋ Jwøk møn, ni dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caanï ki dhiï beeye adïëri.»
english: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in thy mouth is truth.

anywaa: 'Ba ni jøw onø bëëdö ki nïne mo thööth, kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Ilaaja ni kööe, ni «Ci nyooth dëërï jï nyeya ma Akap; aani køth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö piny.»
english: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Ilaaja aput ci kuna nyooth dëëre jï Akap. 'Ba kar kaagø, käc oløny ni raac døc Cameria pääny Akap.
english: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

anywaa: Køøre Akap, Øbadiya kwääy paan dwøŋ acwøle. 'Ba Øbadiya bëëdö ni Wuuö Jwøk ee wøørø døc;
english: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly:

anywaa: kiper kanya ö Jedhebelli na 'näk nyïïkuk Jwøk mo Wuuö Jwøk, Øbadiya nyïïkuk Jwøk ma dïpa akäle ni kan ge yïth uut kïte na pïërabïïc pïërabïïc, ni bëëde ni møya geni ki cam ki pïï.
english: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

anywaa: 'Ba Akap aköö jï Øbadiya, «Waa cøø dï paap kuna määnynyö ki jøør ki nyeŋ näm. Kanymør ø jïtö ki luum mo kwøø okwëënyi ki gääŋŋe ki gø. Køøre nø, lääc paac ba nääø këët.»
english: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, paap aputge pääŋŋö yïthakicge nee cige baŋ määnyö. 'Ba Akap acør jöö mør kur keere, ni ö Øbadiya ni cør jöö mør kur keere.
english: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääth Øbadiya waŋjöö, ena put røømmø ki Ilaaja, ni put Ilaaja ŋec, ni gøø ree piny ni kööe, ni «?Man beeye ï kwäärö mara ma Ilaaja?»
english: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö jïre, ni «Beeye aani. Ciï, ni caanï gø jï nyeya marï, ni ‹Neenï, Ilaaja nut kany.› »
english: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

anywaa: 'Ba Øbadiya aköö, na «?Agïnaŋø ni yaa baaø ni cïbï aani, a na dhaanhnhï, cer Akap, naa nääe en?
english: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

anywaa: Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøï na kwøw, bäŋ tier paac mo odööŋ ni nyeya mara kär jääk yie kuna many ïïni. 'Ba kany wø köge, ni ‹Ilaaja tøør kany,› eni jø paaneca wø pute ka tïïc nee kööŋge niï kärge joodø.
english: As the Lord thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.

anywaa: Ni ennø, köö ïïni ni cøøa ni caana gø jï nyeya mara ni Ilaaja nut kany.
english: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

anywaa: A kanymør kanyo daa raa buutï, Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk puta öö ni käl ïïni, ni kïth ïïni kany mo kuua. 'Ba kanyo cøøa noo caana gø jï Akap, no ööe noo ba joot ïïni, eni a pute ka 'näk. Kee ŋäyï ni aani, a na dhaanhnhï en, a bëëdö naa lwär ki Wuuö Jwøk ki mana täga naa poot thiinh.
english: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the Lord shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the Lord from my youth.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïna tïïa kär caanø jïrï? Kanya ö Jedhebelli na 'näk nyïïkuk Jwøk mo Wuuö Jwøk, aani nyïïkuk Jwøk mo Wuuö Jwøk ma dïpa akana yïth uut kïte na pïërabïïc pïërabïïc, ni bëëda ni ge møya møyø ki cam ki pïï.
english: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the Lord, how I hid an hundred men of the Lord's prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

anywaa: Ennø, köö ïïni ni cøøa ni caana gø jï nyeya mara ni Ilaaja nutö. 'Ba kanyo ööe noo ba joot ïïni, a pute ka 'näk.»
english: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, eni na wïth jammi bëët ni wø tïnynya, ka adïëri møn, aani dëëra nyoodha nyoodhø jïre dïcäŋi.»
english: And Elijah said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Øbadiya aput cøø ni røømge ka Akap, ni caan gø jïgø; ni ö Akapi ni ööe nee røømge ki Ilaaja.
english: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akapi na joot Ilaaja, Akap aköö jïre, ni «?Man beeye ïïni, ï na kier wïth jø Icriel?»
english: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö, ni «Paa aani na kier wïth jø Icriel, 'ba beeye ïïni ki jø dhi  øt wäru, kiper luup moa cem Wuuö Jwøki aweyu, ni caathu køør juuga cøøri ni Baal.
english: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the Lord, and thou hast followed Baalim.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jäägï, nee jø Icriel bëët öge nee rege cooŋge buuta bäät Kïn Karmël, ge ki nyïïkuk Baal moa näk dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc, ki nyïïkuk jwøa cwøl na Acara moa näk dïpe aŋween ni wø caam Jedhebelli.»
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.

anywaa: Køøre Akap aput jäägö ki dwøl baŋ jø Icriel bëët, ni käl nyïïkuk juu moøgø kanya ciel bäät Kïn Karmël.
english: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aö baŋ jiy ni kööe, na «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëdu nou wïdö yïthakic acaare ariiø? Ni näk Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøka eni, caathu køøre; 'ba ni näk Baal beeye Jwøka eni, putu køøre caath.» 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo odwögö jïgø ki luubö.
english: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the Lord be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö jïge, ni «Beeye aani keera na dööŋ na nyikuŋ Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba nyïïkuk Baal gena jiy ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc.
english: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, mooyu waani ki rwädhe ariiø. Køøre ge jëëtö ki rwaath aciel kiper dëëtge, ni ŋørge gø, ni cïpge gø bäät jen mo waaŋi ki gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. 'Ba bäŋ maac mo äpge tier gø. 'Ba aani thuwø rwaath maya jiiŋŋa jiiŋŋø, ni peedha gø bäät jen, ni tiere ba ämma ki maac.
english: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

anywaa: 'Ba u na nyïïkuk Baal, kwayu jwøk maru. Aani, Wuuö Jwøk kwaa kwaaø. Køøre Jwøk mano cïpi ki maac, beeye eni na Jwøk.» Kanyøgø, aløk jiyi bëët ni köge, ni «Manøgø beeye acaara mo beer.»
english: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aköö jï nyïïkuk Baal, ni «Kwøŋu jëëtö ki rwaath kiper dëëtu, ni jiiŋŋu gø, kiper u thööth; ni kwayu jwøk maru. 'Ba tier rïŋö maru kär ämmu ki maac.»
english: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.

anywaa: Køøre, geni rwaath mana no ocïbö jïge alwørge ni jiiŋge gø; ni kwaacge Baal ki mana täge ka amöölla këël mana këët dhöör, ni ge köö, «Wui Baal, løk kwac marwa.» 'Ba bäŋ dwøl mo owïnyö ni bäŋ gïn mo oløø jïge. 'Ba ge bëëdö ni ge miel deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana tïïcge.
english: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dhöör, gena buu Ilaaja ni kööe, ni «Kwayu ni döötu ena maal. ?Aŋø, eni paa jwøk maru? Kanymør wïïe ena baŋ luubö mør, wala eno aa wøk ŋää kiir, wala eni cäädhö jöö, wala kanymør eno butö ni manynya man jiec eni.»
english: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, gena kwöŋŋö ni döötge ege tïŋ maal, ni cööpge dëëtge ko opëëlle ki tøøŋi kaawat man wø tïïcge cøøn ki køør kööŋŋö marge, këël mana cwëëc dëëtge ki rem.
english: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni kur dhöör opöödhö, gena göö ko oduuru këël mana këët abøøya yi caan wø cïp olämi yie mar abøøya; 'ba bäŋ dwøl mo owïnyö, ni bäŋ gïn mo oløø jïge, ni bäŋe ŋat mo ïthe ee ciiø ki gïrge.
english: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aköö jï jiy bëët, ni «Ööu buuta.» Kanyøgø jiy bëët aö buute. Ni cäŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk mana no oraanynyø dwøk kare.
english: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord that was broken down.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja alwötö ki kïte apaar kurriiø ki køør kwään wïth tuŋi mo wäät Jeekap, ŋata ö dwør Wuuö Jwøki bääte na kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Nyeŋŋï ocwøl ni Icriel.»
english: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the Lord came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni tïïc gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki kïte moøgø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kunye ki øøl mo deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ee wïrö ki gø, mo løny ki man røm köödhi ma yïth opïri ariiø yie.
english: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

anywaa: Køøre eni jen acïp bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ŋør rwaath na thäŋi ni cïp ge bäät jen. Ni kööe jïge, ni «Pääŋŋu yïth dääe aŋween ki pïï ni kønynyu gø bäät olämi ki bäät jen.»
english: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Cäŋu öömmö ki pïï.» Ni cäŋge öömmö ri rietge. Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Cäŋu öömmö ri dääge.» Ni cige ni öömge gø.
english: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, pïï aput tïmö ni muulö deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni pääŋge yi øøl.
english: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na yi caan wø cïp olämi yie mar abøøya, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaja anyänh buut gïn wø cïp olämme  bääte, ni läme ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Icriel, dïcäŋi beerra man ö jiyi ni ŋäcge ïïni ni ïïna Jwøk Icriel, ni ŋäcge gø ni aana dhaanhnhï, ni gïï bëët ii tïïa ka køør dwørï.
english: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, løk kwac mara, nee ŋäc jøøi ni ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna Jwøk møn, ni cäŋï cwïnyge luu baŋï.»
english: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the Lord God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk maac aput jääŋŋö, ni put olämi, ki jen, ki kïte, ki ŋøøm waaŋ, ni put pïï moa en yi øøl taal.
english: Then the fire of the Lord fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi bëët na jootge gø, dëëtge aputge gøø piny, ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk møn! Wuuö Jwøk, ena Jwøk møn!»
english: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The Lord, he is the God; the Lord, he is the God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Ilaaja aköö jïge, ni «Magu nyïïkuk Baal. Kär dee gø mo weyu nee päär wøk.» Køøre gena makge. Ni ö Ilaaja ni käl geni bäät waŋ Naam Kicön, ni 'näk geni kaace.
english: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö jï Akap, ni «Ciï ni cämï; kiper da dwør køth mo dwøŋ mo wïnyö.»
english: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Akap aput cøø ni cäme. 'Ba Ilaaja aci wï Kïn Karmël, ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kuul wïïe piny.
english: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Ciï ni neenï jï kuna näk da naama dwøŋ.» Kanyøgø, ena cøø ni neen jï kunece, ni kööe, ni «Bäŋ gïrpiny.» Køøre ena jääŋ Ilaaja kwöre abïriiø.
english: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet jääk, ŋat tïïc mare aköö, ni «Neenï, nyi pöölö mo thiinh mo caala cera dagø mo ööa maal ki yi naama dwøŋ.» Ni kö Ilaaja, ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Akap, ni ‹Jiiŋ jääy marï man wø tut okweenynyi ni ciï piny kunece, kiper niï ba mak køthi man ööi ni dwøŋ en.› »
english: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.

anywaa: 'Ba ki kany mo thiinh, maal aput tïmö ni cøl ki pöölö, ni ö jame, ni päth køthi mo dwøŋ døc. 'Ba Akap aput aay ni ci Jedhriel.
english: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, teek Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Ilaaja, ni ö Ilaaja ni twöö abïïne piere, ni put reŋ maal nyïm Akap ni reŋ Jedhriel.
english: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap jammi moa tïïc Ilaaja bëët acaane jï cïïe ma Jedhebel, ni beeye jöö mana ö Ilaaja na 'näk nyïïkuk Baal bëët ko opëëllö ki gø.
english: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Jedhebel ajääk baŋ Ilaaja ki dhaanhø ni kööe, ni «Teeŋ kar kany nø diøø, ni näk jwïëy moï kära raanynyø kaamar jwïëc nyïïkuk Baal moa raanynyï, aani, a raany juuwi 'moa raanynyø.»
english: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aput lwäyö, ni ö maal ni reeŋe ni ŋwieya thøø, ni ci Bëërcïïba, paana en yïth ŋøøp Juuda, ni wii ŋat tïïc mare kaace.
english: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer–sheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, ena aa dï paap ni cäädhe ki dïcäŋ bäre; ni cøøe ni pï piny tier abuŋŋö ni päc dëëre thøø, ni kööe, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aløny nø. Käl jwïëy 'moa, kiper ba beerra bëëtö mara ni kaala mar kwäcwa.»
english: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Lord, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

anywaa: Køøre ree anyaaŋ piny ni bute tier abuŋŋö. Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli ni gut eni, ni pääe; ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli jïgø, ni «Ö maal, ni cämï.»
english: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

anywaa: Køøre ena put lwïthö, ni joot møø mo omiiø no ocïp wïïe, mo thaalla bäät kïdi mo lïëth, ki pïï mo ena ya agwäy. Ni put cämö, ni mäthe ki pïï, ni cäŋ ree nyaaŋ piny.
english: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ öö ri rietge, ni gut gø, ni pääe; ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli jïre, ni «Ö maal, ni cämï, kiper wääth mano caathï poot päl.»
