english: And the angel of the Lord came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.

anywaa: Køøre ena ö maal ni cäme ni mäthe ki pïï, ni tïm dëëre ni teek ki cam mana came, ni cäädhe ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni beege cääŋŋe ki wärre, këël mana pïïe ri Kïn Körëp, kïnna näk Kïn Jwøk.
english: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.

anywaa: Køøre ena døny øt kïdi ni bëëde yie. Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääte ni kööe jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni tïïyï kany, Ilaaja?»
english: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the Lord came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?

anywaa: Ni kö Ilaaja, ni «Aani, aana këëyö døc kiperï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø with  jammi bëët; kiper jø Icriel luumma tuutï ki geni awecge, ni raanyge gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge moï, ni 'näkge nyïïkuk Jwøk moï ko opëëllö. 'Ba beeye aani keera na dööŋ, ni ge poot manynya jwïëy 'moa nee raanyge.»
english: And he said, I have been very zealous for the Lord God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ö wøk ni cuŋŋï wï kïdi nyïma, a na Wuuö Jwøk; køøre aani, a pöödhö ki buutï.» Ni ö atuunna mo päl mo kwödö ni teek ni pääŋ kïte ki dïge, ni ö kïte moa therø ni tøcge na thäŋi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ba en ya atuunna manøgø. 'Ba køør atuunna, dïjäŋ piny aput tägö; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk ba en yi dïjäŋ piny manøgø.
english: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the Lord. And, behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the Lord was not in the earthquake:

anywaa: 'Ba køør dïjäŋ piny, maac aput öö; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk ba en yi maaøgø. 'Ba køør maac, nyi dwøl mo thiinh døc aput wïnyö.
english: And after the earthquake a fire; but the Lord was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ilaaja na wïny dwørøgø, täärnyïme aput uum ka aleeŋŋa mare, ni cøøe ni døny wøk ni cuŋŋe dhi øt kïdi. Køøre dwøl aput ö bääte ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni tïïyï kany, Ilaaja?»
english: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö, ni «Aani, aana këëyö døc kiperï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët; kiper jø Icriel luumma tuutï ki geni awecge, ni raanyge gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge moï, ni 'näkge nyïïkuk Jwøk moï ko opëëllö. 'Ba beeye aani keera na dööŋ, ni ge poot manynya jwïëy 'moa nee raanyge.»
english: And he said, I have been very zealous for the Lord God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni «Ciï, ni døøgï ki jöörï na curï yie, ni ciï paap Damacka. 'Ba kanyo nø pïïyï nø, wï Adhaël wär thïïmmï ki maaw nee tïme na nyeya bäät jø Aram,
english: And the Lord said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

anywaa: ni thïïmmï wï Jiyu o Nimci ki maaw nee tïme na nyeya bäät Icriel, ni thïïmmï wï Ilaaca o Capath nyï Abël-Mööla ki maaw, nee ci karï na nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel–meholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo bøth ki thøø cer Adhaël, eni 'näk Jiyuwi nääö. 'Ba ŋato bøth ki thøø cer Jiyu, eni 'näk Ilaaca nääö.
english: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

anywaa: 'Ba poot da jø Icriel ma kume abïriiø mo cøŋge kärge këël piny nyïm Baal, ni dhøk gïïa no otieŋø no ocaa ri Baal kärge nuumö; geni, ge wiia wiiø bëët.»
english: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja atïŋŋö kaace, ni joot Ilaaca o Capath ni purö ki dhäk mo orööpö na ariiø ariiø kwöre apaar kurriiø; 'ba eni purö ka mana näk aŋuudi. 'Ba Ilaaja aci baŋ gø, ni ö aleeŋŋa mare ni leeŋ gø bäät gø.
english: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

anywaa: Køøre eni dhäk aput wii piny, ni reŋ køør Ilaaja ni kööe, na «A cøø kuna määdha wära ki mera. Køøre nø, aano läm køørï.» Ni kö Ilaaja jïgø, ni «Døøgï; 'ba wïïï kär wïl ki gïna tïïa jïrï.»
english: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?

anywaa: Køøre ena duuö ki baŋ Ilaaja; ni lwør dhäk moa na ariiø na näk orwöbö na pure ki geni, ni 'näk geni ni thaal rïŋge ki jer puur, ni cïp gø jï jiy, ni camge gø. Køøre ena ö maal ni caath køør Ilaaja, ni tïny gø.
english: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Ben-Adat nyeny jø Aram jø leny moe bëët acooŋe, ni cøøe ni cäädhi ka nyeye ma pïëradäk kurriiø, ko okwëënyi, ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni ciel Cameria dïër, nee tuue.
english: And Ben–hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

anywaa: 'Ba ena jääk yi pääny ki jiy baŋ Akap nyeny Icriel, ni köge jïre, ni «Ben-Adat aköö,
english: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Ben–hadad,

anywaa: ni ‹Gwel-bïrö ki warkey marï, oløny na mara; ni mään moï moa mïërö døc ko obwöre moï, oløny na 'moa thuwø.› »
english: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeny Icrielli ni kööe, «Wui nyenynya, tïme kaawat mana caanï. Aani, ki jammi 'moa bëët, waana moï.»
english: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään, jøøa jääŋ Ben-Adati acäŋ duu baŋ Akap ni köge, ni «Ben-Adat aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aana jääŋ baŋï ki jiy nee gwel-bïrö ki warkey ki mään moï ko obwöre moï cïpï jïra.
english: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Ben–hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;

anywaa: 'Ba diøø  kar kany nø, aani, jiya jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋï, ni dønyge ødï ki uut jø kööre moï. 'Ba gïïo perge leth jïrï jaak, kälge kälö ni aacge ki ge.› »
english: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel jø døøŋŋe bëët moa en paac bäre acwøle ni kööe, ni «Nyie, neennu nyenynyøgø ni many gïn mo raac en. Ena jääŋ baŋa kiper nee määra ko obwöre 'moa, ki gwet-bïrö 'moa ki warkey mara cïba jïre; 'ba a kär kweer ki luumme.»
english: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

anywaa: 'Ba jø døøŋŋe bëët ki jiy bëët aköö jïre, ni «Luumme kär wïnynyï, ni ba jïëyï mare.»
english: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï jøøa jääŋ Ben- Adati, ni «Caannu jï nyeya mara, ni ‹Jammi bëët moa kwøŋï jääŋ baŋge baŋa, a na dhaanhnhï, cïba cïbö jïrï; 'ba man keere ba løny jïra.› » Køøre jøøa jääŋŋi adøøk ni cige ni caange luubö jï Ben-Adat.
english: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

anywaa: 'Ba Ben-Adat acäŋ jääk baŋ Akap ki dwøl ni kööe, ni «Ni näk mo Cameria bäre ba raany jø lenynyi 'moa, a raany juuwi 'moa raanynyø, ni këël jø leny 'moa bur päänyögø dege jøøbø nee käärge ki ceŋge, ge ba rømi bëët.»
english: And Ben–hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyeny Icrielli ni kööe, ni «Caannu jïre, ni ‹Ŋat mo poot lwøra jap leny ba doo ŋwöö kaamar dhaanhø mo onø käädhö.› »
english: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ben-Adati na wïny luummögø kanya bëëde ni eni mädhö ki nyeye møga ya abïla, jiye aköömme ni kööe, ni «Jegu rou.» Ni ö jiye ni jekge rege kiper nee pääny tukge.
english: And it came to pass, when Ben–hadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions, that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyikuŋ Jwøk ma aö baŋ Akap nyeny Icriel ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹?Jiy moøgø ni thööth yøø nëënö jïrï? Ka adïëri møn, aani, ge cïba cerï dïcäŋi, nee putï ŋäc ni aana Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap aköö, ni «?Geno cïbï gø ceŋ jøøe?» 'Ba aløk nyikuŋ Jwøki ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Beege jø leny moa dëëtge teek moa jääŋ kwääri moa en yïth mïëri.› » Køøre Akap acäŋ köö, na «?Aŋa noo täk leny?» Ni kö nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni «Beeye ïïni.»
english: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.

anywaa: Køøre Akap jø leny moa dëëtge teek moa jääŋ kwääri moa en yïth mïëri akwaane, ni tïmge na jiy ma dïpe ariiø ki pïëradäk kurriiø. Køør jøøgø, jø leny mo jø Icriel akwaane, ni tïmge na kume abïriiø.
english: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø leny bëët gena aa wøk kanya tïme na dhöör dïcäŋ, ni Ben-Adat mädhö ya abïla ni eno meer, ge ki nyeye møga moa näk pïëradäk kurriiø na ci baŋ leny ki eni na aciel.
english: And they went out at noon. But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa bwøth leny beege jø leny moa näk dëëtge teek na jääŋ kwääri moa en yïth mïëri. 'Ba Ben-Adat dïlëëwe moa näk ee jääŋö wøk aöö ni caange gø jïre, ni köge, ni «Da jø leny ma aö wøk ki Cameria.»
english: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben–hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba Ben-Adat aköö, ni «Ni näk mo ge ööi ka mëër, ge wär magu ni kwøw. 'Ba ni näk mo ge ööi ka leny, ge wär magu thuwø ni kwøw.»
english: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moa dëëtge teek na jääŋ kwääri moa en yïth mïëri, kanya aage wøk baŋ leny, jø leny møga caatha køørge.
english: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø rege ni 'näk ŋata en nyïme; ni ö jø Arammi ni bwøkge, ni ö jø Icrielli ni ŋwiecge køørge. 'Ba Ben-Adat nyeny jø Aram apäär wøk ki bäät okweeny ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi.
english: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Ben–hadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel aci wøk ni mak okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni 'näk jø leny mo jø Aram mo thööth døc.
english: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk aö baŋ nyeny Icriel ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ciï ni cäŋï riï jiiŋŋø, ni cädï kiper gïno tïïyï; kiper kanyo tal pinynyi ni bäŋ køth këët, nyeny jø Aram cäŋa duu baŋ leny ki ïïni.»
english: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre mo nyeny jø Aram aköö jï nyeya marge, ni «Juuk jø Icriel beege juuk bäät kïte; beeye tiere gø na böötge øøni en. 'Ba ennø, beerra man  këëdø ki geni kany ma pwöla, nee ge böötø.
english: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, tïïc gïn. Käl nyeye wøk moø ni cäädhï ki ge yøø, ni kïthï kwörge ki kwääc leny,
english: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:

anywaa: ni kwänyï ki jø leny mo kwäänge caala moa thøw, ni määnyï ko okwëënyi ki jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi mo kwäänge caala kwään moa käl. Køøre ø këëdö ki geni yi pwöla, ni böötø geni.» 'Ba Ben-Adat aput jïëy ka acaara marge, ni put gïïa caange tïïc.
english: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tal pinynyi ni bäŋ køth këët, Ben-Adat jø leny mo jø Aram acooŋe ni cige këël kanya cwøl na Apëk kuna këëtge ki jø Icriel.
english: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Ben–hadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Icriel acooŋ ni mooc ge ki cam ki jap leny, ni cige nee rømge ki jø Aram. 'Ba jø Icriel twïër marge atïïcge ni dïët ki mar jø Aram, ni ge nëëni kaamar pïïth dïëk ariiø mo thenh thenh nyïm jø Aram na näk dï paac bäre ege pääŋö.
english: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk aöö ni cääne ka Akap nyeny Icriel ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kiper mana kö jø Arammi ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwø bäät kïte, ni eni paa Jwø gøli, aani lwaak manøgø bäre ni dwøŋ enø, cïba ceŋŋu, nee putu ŋäc ni aana Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the Lord, Because the Syrians have said, The Lord is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Aram ki jø leny mo jø Icriel gena bëëdö yïth twëëre moge ki nïne abïriiø ni ge køya dëëtge. 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet nïne, leny atägö; ni ö jø Icrielli ni 'näkge jø leny mo jø Aram ma kume ma dïpa acielø dïcäŋögø.
english: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.

anywaa: 'Ba moa bøth gena reŋ yi pääny Apëk. Ni ö kiirri ni päth bäät jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø ka abïriiø moa no odööŋ. Ni ö Ben-Adati thuwø ni rïŋ yi päänyögø, ni døny yi thääŋ øtø mo ena dïër.
english: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Ben–hadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre moe aköö jïre, ni «Neenï, awïnywa ni nyeye mo jø Icriel gena nyeye mo yïthge bäth. Ennø, kïthø dëëtø ki keece, ni tööyø cwägø ki thøøli, ni cøø wøk baŋ nyeny Icriel. Kanymør ï wiie wiiø niï ba nääe.»
english: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, geni keece aputge kïth dëëtge, ni twöge thøøli cwäkge, ni öge baŋ Akap nyeny Icriel ni köge, ni «Dhaanhnhï ma Ben-Adat aköö, ‹Naa kwaya ïïni, kär aani 'nägï.› » 'Ba Akap aköö, «?Na aŋø, eni poot kwøw? Kee ena coka.»
english: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Ben–hadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø luubö manøgø akälge na nyuudhi mar gïn mo beer, ni laarge luubö mar Akap jøl dhi gø, ni köge, ni «Ben-Adat coku møn.» 'Ba Akap aköö, ni «Cou ni kälu eni.» Køøre Ben-Adat aput ö wøk baŋe, ni ö Akapi ni kïth eni buute yi jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi.
english: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Ben–hadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Ben–hadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.

anywaa: Køøre Ben-Adat aköö jïre, ni «Päänye moa käl wära baŋ wäru duua duuö jïrï, ni tïï ki kwör gath kiper dëërï Damacka, kaawat mana tïïc wära Cameria.» Kanyøgø Akap aköö, ni «Aani ï wiia wiiø ki køør luubö man tuutï ki aani en.» Køøre Akap aput tudö ki luubö ki Ben-Adat, ni put gø wec nee aae.
english: And Ben–hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aciel røk nyïïkuk Jwøk aköö jï watge ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Gøøc aani.» 'Ba watge akweer ki man gøøc eni.
english: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the Lord, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø aköö jï watge, ni «Kiper mana kärï dwør Wuuö Jwøk wïnynyö, ka adïëri møn, kanyo tïŋŋï buuta ennø, ï put ŋuuwi ka cam ni thøwï.» 'Ba kanya tïŋŋe buute ennø, ena put ŋuuwi joot, ni puti cam ni thøøe.
english: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the Lord, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø mør ni kööe jïgø, ni «Gøøc aani.» 'Ba ena put ŋatøgø gøøc, ni jït dëëre ki ŋwellø.
english: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.

anywaa: Køøre, nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø aput tïŋŋö. Køøre, waŋe abääe ka abïï ni cøøga dëëre nee ba ŋec, ni bëëde ni koora nyeny Icriel waŋjöö.
english: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni nyeya pöödhö ki buute ennø, ena köök ni kööe jï nyeya, ni «A na dhaanhnhï, aana ci baŋ leny. 'Ba neenï, ŋat mør agää baŋa ni käla dhaanhø mo ee maaø ki tøŋ baŋa ni kööe, ni ‹Koor ŋati. 'Ba ni näk mo eno  rwäänyö, ï di nääö na kare, wala ï cudö ki gwet-bïrö ma kume adäk.›
english: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda ni tïïc päl cera, a na dhaanhnhï en, naa cøøa kun ki kun, ŋatøgø aay.» Køøre nyeny Icriel aköö jïre, ni «Luummï anø ŋølï bäätï keerï, ni gïnögø di tïïö dëërï.»
english: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, abïï aput käl wøk waŋe, ni ö nyeny Icrielli ni ŋec eni ni ena dhaanhø aciel røk nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aköö jï nyeya, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kiper mana wëëgï dhaanhø wääth mo ocïp cerï nee 'näk, ïïni, ï di nääö na kare, ni ö jiyï ni 'näk geni na kar jiye.› »
english: And he said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeny Icriel aput ci paare Cameria no ogootø ni yie raac døc.
english: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, gïn mør atägö ki ri pwöth omøki mar Naböth nyï Jedhriel, ni beeye pwöthe mana en Jedhriel buut paan dwøŋ mar Akap nyeny Cameria.
english: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap acäänö ki Naböth ni kööe, ni «Cïp pwöth omøki marï jïra nee tïïa na pwöth omarø, kiper eni kare cään ki paac mara. Køøre aani a cïpö jïrï ki pwöth omøki mo beerra eni na kar pwödhö manøgø. 'Ba ni näk miï manynya gø, gäte daa cïbö na gwel.»
english: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.

anywaa: 'Ba Naböth aköö jï Akap, ni «Ki køør ciik Wuuö Jwøk, pwödhö mana no odööŋ na mar kwäcwa, ba løny jïra na bäre ki man cïba gø jïrï.»
english: And Naboth said to Ahab, The Lord forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Akap adøø paare no ogootø ni yie raac døc kiper luubö mana caan Naböthi nyï Jedhriel jïre na kööe, ni «Pwödhö mana no odööŋ na mar kwäcwa ba cïba jïrï.» Køøre ree anyaaŋ piny bäät pëëm mare no ogootø, ni nyïme ee løø ri øtø, ni bëëde ni ba cämö.
english: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

anywaa: 'Ba cïïe ma Jedhebel aö baŋe ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aperŋø ni bëëdï ni ïïno gootø en, niï bëëdö niï ba cämö?»
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jï cïïe, ni «Aana cäänö ki Naböth nyï Jedhriel ni kööa, ni ‹Cïp pwöth omøki marï jïra nee ŋeea ki gwel. 'Ba ni näk mo yiï met, aani a cïpö jïrï ki pwöth omøki mør na kar pwödhö manøgø.› 'Ba Naböth aköö, ni ‹Pwöth omøki mara ba cïba jïrï.› »
english: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.

anywaa: 'Ba cïïe ma Jedhebel aköö jïre, na «?Aŋø, man beeye jöö man käärï jø Icriel ki gø? Ö maal ni cämï, ni bëëdï ni yiï met. Aani pwöth omøki mar Naböth nyï Jedhriel cïba cïbö jïrï.»
english: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø agöödö ki weeli ki nyeŋ Akap, ni gøø ŋïï mar nyeya bäätge, ni jääŋ geni baŋ jø døøŋŋø ki kwääri mo wø bëëdö pääny na aciel ki Naböth.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no ogöör nyijøøgø yïth weeli moøgø beeye en, ena köö, ni «Køpu jï jiy ni dïcäŋi beeye cäŋ wödö yie ki cam, ni cïbu Naböth bäät køøm wöt yïthakic jiy,
english: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:

anywaa: ni kännu ki jiy ariiø mo wïthge reyø, ni cïbu ge nyïme, nee ge cäänge ki luup dëëre, ni ge köö, ni ‹Ïïni Jwøk ki nyeya ajanynyï.› Køøre wär kïthu wøk ni këëru eni ki kïte nee thøøe.»
english: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo wø bëëdö pääny mana bëët Naböthi yie, ni beege jø døøŋŋø ki kwääri, gïnögø atïïcge ki køør luubö mana jääŋ Jedhebelli baŋge na caane ki yïth weeli moøgø moa jääŋŋe baŋge.
english: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.

anywaa: Geni cäŋ man wödö yie ni jøw ba cämö akøpge jï jiy, ni cïpge Naböth bäät køøm wöt yïthakic jiy.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

anywaa: Køøre jiy ariiø mo wïthge reyø gena öö ni pïge piny nyïme. Ni ö jøøgø ni wïthge reyø yøø ni cäänge ki luup dëër Naböth nyïm jiy ni köge, ni «Naböth Jwøk ki nyeya ajanynye.» Køøre ena put jiyi kïth wøk ŋää pääny, ni këërge gø ki kïte, ni put thøø.
english: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.

anywaa: Køøre gena jääk baŋ Jedhebel ki dwøl ni köge, ni «Naböth anø këëri ki kïte ni thøøe.»
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jedhebelli na wïny gø ni Naböth anø këëri ki kïte ni thøøe, Jedhebel aköö jï Akap, ni «Ö maal ni lwørï pwöth omøki mar Naböth nyï Jedhriel na marï, na mäne ki ïïni ki man ŋeewï gø, kiper eni ba nut këët ni kwøw. Ena  thøw.»
english: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akapi na wïny gø ni Naböth athøw, ena ö maal nee løøc piny yi pwöth omøki mar Naböth nyï Jedhriel kiper nee lwøre na mare.
english: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Ilaaja nyï Ticbi ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni løøyï piny kuna røømmï ka Akap nyeny Icriel ni wø bëëdö Cameria. Neenï, eni ena ci yi pwöth omøki mar Naböth kiper nee lwøre na mare.
english: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba wärï cäänï ki eni ni kööï ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Dhaanhø anø 'nägï. ?Aŋø, ï cäŋa duu kuna kälï jape?› Ni cäŋï cäänö ki eni ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kanya ö guuwi na naaŋge rem Naböth yie, ïïni thuwø remmï naaŋ guuwi naaŋø yie.› »
english: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the Lord, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the Lord, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap aköö jï Ilaaja, «Wui, nyimän mara, aana nø jootï.» Køøre aput Ilaaja dwøgø, ni «Ïïna nø jooda møn, kiper dëërï agathï niï tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ï na Akap, ka adïëri møn, aani a känna bäätï ki gïn mo leth, ni nääa cwøw bëët moa käl dhi ødï moa en dï Icriel, këël laaŋe, ni puta ge jwiec bëët.
english: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,

anywaa: Ni tïïa dhi øtø marï kaamar dhi øt Jeröbäm o Nebat, ki dhi øt Baaca wär Akiya, kiper tïïe moa tïïyï niï raanynya cwïnya naa goota, kiper na wëëgï jø Icriel tïïc ki raay thuwø.›
english: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk acäänö thuwø kiper Jedhebel ni kööe ni Jedhebel rïŋ dëëre cam guuwi camø yïth ŋøøp Jedhriel.
english: And of Jezebel also spake the Lord, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanh Akap man wø thøø yi pääny, eni cam guuwi camø. 'Ba man wø thøø yi pwöla, cam wenynyi camø.»
english: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, bäŋ dhaanhø mo nëëna Akap, mo dëëre ee gadhø ki man tïïe ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni yie coona cïïe ma Jedhebel.
english: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

anywaa: Eni, ena tïïö ki gïï mo ec raac ki ge døc, ni beeye gïna tïïe na caath køør gïïa no otieŋø na juu, kaawat mana tïïc jø Amörri bëët, jøøa riem Wuuö Jwøki nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akapi na wïny luupögø, abïï mare aput jeec ki pänh cwïny, ni røø keeca dëëre na abïï, ni bëëde ni eni wödö ni ba cämö, ni eni buuta yi keeca, ni put bëëtö ni cwïnye opädhö.
english: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Ilaaja nyï Ticbi ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, ajootï na ö Akapi na dwøk dëëre piny nyïma? Kiper mana dwøk dëëre piny nyïma, aani gïn mo leth ba käla bääte ennø ni eni poot kwøw, 'ba gïn mo leth okäla bäät jø dhi øde yïth nïne moo beet wääde.»
english: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri adäk apöödhö ni bäŋ leny yïthakic jø Aram ki jø Icriel.
english: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri, Jøcapat nyeny Juuda aløøc piny baŋ Akap nyeny Icriel.
english: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel onø köö jï jø kööre moe, na «?Aŋø, kuyu ni Ramöth-Gelät marø, ni poodø ni bäŋ gïn tïïø en ki man kälø gø wøk cer nyeny Aram?»
english: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?

anywaa: Ni kööe jï Jøcapat, ni «?Løny man ciï baŋ leny ki aani, nøø këëdø Ramöth-Gelät?» 'Ba Jøcapat aköö jï nyeny Icriel, ni «Aani a caala ïïni, ni jiya poot na jiy moï, no okwëënyi 'moa poot na moï.»
english: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aköö jï nyeny Icriel, ni «Beerra man kwøŋï dwør Wuuö Jwøk pëënynyö.»
english: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to day.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel jiy moa tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk acooŋ kanya ciel, ni beege jiy mo jïtö ki dïpe aŋweenø, ni kööe jïge, ni «?Cøøa baŋ leny Ramöth- Gelät, wala kära cøø?» 'Ba gena köö, ni «Ciï, ocïp Wuuö Jwøki cerï, ï na nyeya.»
english: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aköö, ni «?Bäŋ nyikuŋ Wuuö Jwøk mo ena kany mo pëënynyø këët?»
english: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «Poot da dhaanhø aciel mo dwør Wuuö Jwøk døø pëënynyö ki eni, 'ba a män ki gø, kiper poot bäŋ gïn mo beer mo  ee nø caan en kipera, 'ba cooth beeye gïn mo raac. 'Ba ŋatøgø beeye Mikaya wär Imla.» 'Ba Jøcapat aköö, ni «Nyeya, luummögø kär caanï.»
english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the Lord: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel ŋat koor aciel acwøle ni kööe, ni «Ciï, laar Mikaya wär Imla cwøl.»
english: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, nyeny Icriel ki Jøcapat nyeny Juuda, ge bëëdö ni geno pï piny, ni ŋati man nø opï piny bäät wälu mare yi laara dhi kiir Cameria, na abïïk nyec moge ege røø dëëtge, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki bëët ni bëëtge ni ge cäänö nyïmge kiper jammi moo tägi yi nyïm.
english: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøgø, Cëdëkiya o Kinana dëëre ee tïnynyö ki tuŋi mo tïïc ka nywïënyö, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Jø Aram cööbï cööbö ki tuŋi moi, këël mano dïïrï wïthge.› »
english: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the Lord, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët luubö man acaange thuwø ni köge, ni «Ci baŋ leny Ramöth- Gelät, ni böödï; geno cïp Wuuö Jwøki cerï, ï na nyeya.»
english: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth–gilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the king's hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata jääŋŋi nee Mikaya cwøle, Mikaya acäänne ni kööe, ni «Neenï, nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët, gena cäänö ki dwøl aciel mo met kiper nyeya. Ennø, beerra man ö dwølli mano caanï ni tïme ni met na aciel ki mana caange.»
english: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, gïno caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra beeye gïno caana.»
english: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, what the Lord saith unto me, that will I speak.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Mikaya baŋ nyeya, nyeya aköö jïre, «?Mikaya, ciwa baŋ leny Ramöth-Gelät, wala kärwa cøø?» 'Ba aløøe jïgø, «Cou ni böödu. Ocïp Wuuö Jwøki cerï, ï na nyeya.»
english: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jïre, na «?A kwöre adïï niï cäänna cäännö, ni ‹Kany wø cäänï ki aani, cäänï ka adïëri ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk›?»
english: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the Lord?

anywaa: Kanyøgø Mikaya aköö, ni «Aani jø Icriel bëët ajooda ni geno keethø bäät kïte, kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Jøøi bäŋ wääge; beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni døø paare ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëre.› »
english: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «?Kära caanø jïrï ni eni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo caane kipera, 'ba beeye gïn mo raac keere?»
english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, «'Ba ennø, wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Aani Wuuö Jwøk ajooda no opï piny bäät wälu mare, ni lwaak mare bäre mana en maal cuŋŋö buute, ni møøk ena bäät cwïïe, møøk ki bäät caame.
english: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, na ‹?Aŋa noo maaŋ wï Akap ni wëëk gø ciin Ramöth-Gelät nee 'näk?› Ni ö ŋati man nø ni caan man nø.
english: And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.

anywaa: 'Ba da jwïëy ma aöö, mo käla ri lwaak manøgø, ni cuŋŋe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni ‹Aani wïïe maaŋŋa maaŋŋø.›
english: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni ‹?Wïïe omaaŋŋï gø nidïï?› Ni kööe, ni ‹Aani a cøø ni tïma ni aana dïcuuy ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk moe bëët.› Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ba dhäthi jïrï ki man maaŋŋï wïïe. Ciï ni tïïyï gø.›
english: And the Lord said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Akap, ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk jwïëy anø cïp dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk moi bëët na moï ii, niï cøøkge; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni caan gø ni gïn mo leth pïï bäätï.»
english: Now therefore, behold, the Lord hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the Lord hath spoken evil concerning thee.

anywaa: Køøre Cëdëkiya o Kinana aput ö baŋ Mikaya ni dhööŋ gø ki thääŋ gø ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk a ee wiiø nidïï ni tïme ni cäänö ka dëërï en?»
english: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak unto thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ojootï dïcäŋeca kanyo dønynyï thääŋ øtø mo ena dïër niï kana dëërï.»
english: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel aköö, ni «Lwørru Mikaya ni dwøgu gø baŋ Amön kwääc pääny ki Jöac o nyeya;
english: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

anywaa: ni kööu, ni ‹Nyeya aköö ni kïthu nyeni øt twöc, ni mooyu eni ki cam mo thiinh ki pïï mo thenh këël kanyo duua ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëra.› »
english: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, «Ni näk miï duuö møn ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëërï, Wuuö  Jwøk bäŋ gïn ee caanø ki dhaa.» Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Dïbwör bäre, wïnynyu gïra ni caana enø.»
english: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the Lord hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap nyeny Icriel ki Jøcapat nyeny Juuda gena ci baŋ leny Ramöth- Gelät.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «Aani a cøøa baŋ leny ni dëëra yaa tïïö keda aana ŋat mør. 'Ba ïïni, røø abïïk nyec moï dëërï.» Kanyøgønø, nyeny Icriel aput ci baŋ leny ni dëëre ee tïïö keda ena ŋat mør.
english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny jø Aram, kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi moe moa näk pïëradäk kurriiø ee nø köömmö ni kööe, ni «Kär dee jø leny mo u këëdö ki ge, nee ŋat mo kare dwøŋ wala ŋat mo kare thiinh; 'ba tïme ni beeye nyeny Icriel keere.»
english: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi na jootge Jøcapat, gena köö, ni «Beeye nyeny Icriel enø.» Ni gaage baŋ gø nee këëtge ki gø; ni ö Jøcapati ni put köö.
english: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi na jootge gø ni eni paa nyeny Icriel, ena wecge ki man ŋwiecge køør gø.
english: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.

anywaa: 'Ba da ŋat ma athööthö ka atheerø ni mare päätö, ni këël Akap nyeny Icriel ki kanya ŋaam ri kwöt leny mana näk ee røø dëëre. Køøre Akap aköö jï ŋat wø kiiw jää leny mare man wø tut okweenynyi, ni «Wiir jääy, ni kïthï aani wøk ki dï leny, kiper dëëra anø jïtö ki ŋwellø.»
english: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

anywaa: 'Ba leny aput tïmö ni teek døc dïcäŋeca, ni ö nyeya ni bëëde ni ree ee jäŋö ki jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi nyïm jø leny mo jø Aram, ni put thøø kanya tïm pinynyi na abøøya. Ni ö reme mana ö wøk ki kanya näk eno këëlö ki yie ni møl yi jääy.
english: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni cäŋ manynya man pädhe, dwøl ajääŋŋi baŋ jø leny, ni købi, ni «Ŋati man nø døø yi pääny mare ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø poge.»
english: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya athøw ni käli Cameria, ni koonyi yie.
english: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

anywaa: Køøre jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi apeny yi puur Cameria, kany wø ö kääpe wø lwøkge dëëtge yie, ni ö guuwi ni naaŋge rem nyeya, ki køør mana no ocaan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the Lord which he spake.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Akapi, ki luum øtø mana geere na no oŋwaŋŋø ki tuk lïëy, ki luum päänye bëët moa geere, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Akap athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni ö wääde ma Akadhiya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Akapi ni ena nyeya, beeye kanya tïm Jøcapat wär Aca na nyeya Juuda yi Jerucalem.
english: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat cwiiye pïëradäk kurbïïc kanya tïme na nyeya, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya Jerucalem ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurbïïc. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Adhuba nyi Cili.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat abëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa tïïc wänni ma Aca, ni käre gaa wøk ki yïthge, 'ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri kär raanynyø. 'Ba jiy poot bëëdö ni cïpö ko olämme ni ge wääŋö ki gïï wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäätge.
english: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the Lord: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat atudö ki luum mëër ki nyeny Icriel.
english: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jøcapati, ki luum teek mare mana nyoodhe, ki luum lenye moa këële, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba kääpe moa no odööŋ ni tïïö kwör lam, ni kär riem wøk yïth nïne moa beet wänni ma Aca, ariem wøk paare.
english: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø bäŋ nyeya Ëdöm; 'ba Ëdöm bëënna ŋat mo ocuumö.
english: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat atïïö ki baabuure mo gath, nee cige Öpïr kuna öömge ki warkey. 'Ba ge kär cøø, kiper baabuure atøyø yi Edhiyön-Gabir.
english: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya wär Akap aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «Beerra man  ö jiya ni aacge ki jiy moï ki baabuure.» 'Ba Jøcapat kär jïëy.
english: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge pääny kwari ma Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Jöram ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Jøcapati ni ena nyeny Juuda, kanya tïmge na apaar ka abïriiø, Akadhiya wär Akap atïmö na nyeya Icriel yi Cameria, ni käär paac ki cwiiri ariiø.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc wänni ki menni, këël moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat, na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay.
english: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni tïnynya jwøa cwøl ni Baal ni wøøra gø, ni eni tïïya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee goote kaawat mana tïïc wänni.
english: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the Lord God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør thøw Akap nyeny Icriel, jø Möap gena këëyö ni öge maal bäät jø Icriel.
english: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyeya ma Akadhiya wär Akap apänh piny ki dha awëërnyeŋ mar øtø mana en maal na en Cameria, ni put dëëre jïtö ki ŋwellø. Køøre ena jäägö ki jiy ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni pëënynyu dwør Baal-dhabul, jwø jø Akarön, ki man näk mo dëëra pïïa piny ki ŋwellø man.»
english: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Ilaaja nyï Ticbi, ni «Ö maal ni ciï kuna røømmi ki jiy moa jääŋ Akadhiya nyeny Cameria, ni kööï jïge, na ‹?Aŋø, bäŋ Jwøk Icriel, ni tïme nou cøøa kun pëënynyu dwør Baal-dhabul, jwø jø Akarön en?›
english: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Ïïni, ï ba ö maal ki bäät pëëm; 'ba ka adïëri møn, ï thøw.› » Ni ö Ilaaja ni put aay.
english: Now therefore thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi moa jääŋ Akadhiya na duuge baŋe, ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋø, u duu kiperŋø?»
english: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jï Akadhiya, ni «Da dhaanhø ma aöö ni røømme ki waani ni caan gø jïwa, ni ‹Cou døøu baŋ nyeya mana jääŋ uuni, ni caannu gø jïre, ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ Jwøk Icriel, ni tïme niï jäägö ki jiy kuna pëënynyï dwør Baal-dhabul, jwø jø Akarön en? Kiper manøgønø, ï ba ö maal ki bäät pëëm; 'ba ka adïëri møn, ï thøw.» › »
english: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya aköö jïge, na «A teeŋ dhaanhø mo nyïëdi cøøn na ö kuna røømme ki uuni na car luupögø yøø jïïu?»
english: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

anywaa: Køøre aløkge jïgø, ni «Beeye dhaanhø mo käära gälla mo ree da jïër, mo piere ee töönynyö ki kaw.» Køøre nyeya aköö, ni «Beeye Ilaaja nyï Ticbi.»
english: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kwääy jø leny ma pïërabïïc ki jiye moa näk pïërabïïc aput nyeya jääŋŋö baŋ Ilaaja. Køøre kwääc jø leny manøgø aci baŋ Ilaaja, ni Ilaaja opï piny bäät thuur; ni kööe jï Ilaaja, «Wui, nyikuŋ Jwøk, nyeya aköö ni ööï.»
english: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Ilaaja ni kööe jï kwääy jø leny manøgø, ni «Ni näk mo aana nyikuŋ Jwøk møn, beerra man ö maaci ki maal ni dïïr wïïï ki jiyï moø na pïërabïïc yøø.» Kanyøgønø, maac aput öö ki maal ni dïïr wï kwääyögø ki jiye moa näk pïërabïïc.
english: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

anywaa: Køøre kwäärö mør mar jø leny ma pïërabïïc ki jiye moa näk pïërabïïc acäŋ nyeya jääŋŋö baŋ Ilaaja. Køøre kwääy jø leny manøgø aköö jï Ilaaja, ni «Wui, nyikuŋ Jwøk, nyeya aköö ni laar öö.»
english: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Ilaaja ni kööe jï kwääy jø leny manøgø, ni «Ni näk mo aana nyikuŋ Jwøk møn, beerra man ö maaci ki maal ni dïïr wïïï ki jiyï moø na pïërabïïc yøø.» Køøre maac mar Jwøk aput öö ki maal ni dïïr wïthge.
english: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya acäŋ jäägö ri dääge ki kwäärö mør mar jø leny ma pïërabïïc ge ki jiye moa näk pïërabïïc. 'Ba kanya ö kwääy jø leny manøgø ni ci maal bäät thuur baŋ Ilaaja, eni cøŋŋe akëël piny ni kuul wïïe piny nyïm Ilaaja, ni kwac gø ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wui, nyikuŋ Jwøk, beerra man ö jwïëya ki jwïëc jiyï moi ii ni tïm perge ni leth jïrï.
english: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.

anywaa: Neenï, maac aöö ki maal ni dïïr wïth kwääc jø leny moa dïkwøŋ na näk ariiø ni wø käär jiy ma pïërabïïc, ki jicge moa  näk pïërabïïc pïërabïïc; 'ba ennø, beerra man tïm jwïëya ni perge leth jïrï.»
english: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Ilaaja, ni «Ci piny kunece ki eni; kär niï lwäyö ki eni.» Kanyøgø, Ilaaja aput ö maal ni ci piny baŋ nyeya ki eni na aciel.
english: And the angel of the Lord said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aköö jï nyeya ma Akadhiya, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, na ‹?Aŋø, bäŋ Jwøk Icriel mo luumme pëënynyï pëënynyö, ni tïmï niï jäägö ki jiy kuna pëënynyï dwør Baal-dhebul, jwø jø Akarön en? Kiper manøgønø, ïïni, ï ba ö maal ki bäät pëëm; 'ba ka adïëri møn, ï thøw.› »
english: And he said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Akadhiya aput thøø ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ki dhi Ilaaja. 'Ba kiper mana näk ma Akadhiya bäŋ wääde, Jeyöram wär Akap aläw kar gø na nyeya, ni beeye kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa beet Jöram o Jøcapat ni ena nyeya Juuda.
english: So he died according to the word of the Lord which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Akadhiya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Wuuö Jwøki ni manynya man kïth Ilaaja maal ki ya apwøyaweerø, Ilaaja ki Ilaaca gena tïŋŋö ki Gëlgela.
english: And it came to pass, when the Lord would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Beerra man dööŋï kany, kiper Wuuö Jwøk a ee jääŋŋö Bëthël.» 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw, ki ŋëëtï thuwø, ï ba wiia.» Køøre gena put ci Bëthël.
english: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Beth–el. And Elisha said unto him, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Beth–el.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø moa en Bëthël gena ö wøk baŋ Ilaaca ni köge jïgø, ni «?Ŋäyï ni Wuuö Jwøk kwäärö marï käle kälö buutï dïcäŋi?» Køøre ena köö, ni «Yaa, ŋääa; bëëdu mëëth jaak.»
english: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth–el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaja aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Beerra man dööŋï kany, kiper Wuuö Jwøk a ee jääŋŋö Jerikö.» 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw, ki ŋëëtï thuwø, ï ba wiia.» Køøre gena put aa Jerikö.
english: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the Lord hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø moa en Jerikö gena nyänh buut Ilaaca ni köge jïgø, ni «?Ŋäyï ni Wuuö Jwøk kwäärö marï käle kälö buutï dïcäŋi?» Køøre ena köö, ni «Yaa, ŋääa; bëëdu mëëth jaak.»
english: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Lord will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre Ilaaja aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Beerra man dööŋï kany, kiper Wuuö Jwøk a ee jääŋŋö bäät Naam Jördan.» 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw, ki ŋëëtï thuwø, ï ba wiia.» Køøre ge na ariiø yøø gena pöödhö.
english: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the Lord hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy ma pïërabïïc dëët lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø gena läp køørge ni cuŋge ni ge dïët ki Ilaaja ki Ilaaca kany mo bäär mëëth, ni geni karge riet ge cuŋŋa bäät Naam Jördan.
english: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Ilaaja aleeŋŋa mare akäl wøk, ni ban gø ni gøøc pïï ki gø, ni ö pïïyi ni pääŋge dëëtge ni cige løøi ki løøi. Køøre ge na ariiø yøø gena put ŋut løøga ki kany mo otal.
english: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ŋutge løøga, Ilaaja aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Pëëny gïn manynyï en nee tïïa jïrï kany poode naa kär kälö buutï en.» Ni kö Ilaaca, ni «Beerra man ö teek Jwøki manø ni bäätï enø ni ö bääta, naa läwa karï.»
english: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja aköö, ni «Ïïna pëëö ki gïn mo teek. 'Ba ni näk maa jootï joodø kanyo käl aani buutï, gïnögø thura kare jïrï; 'ba ni näk maa ba jootï kanyo käl aani, gïnögø ba thur kare jïrï.»
english: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya aacge ni ge cäädhi na aciel ni ge wääö, jääy mo liel, mo tuta okwëënyi mo liel aput öö yïthakicge ni pää geni karge riet. Ni ö Ilaaja ni put aa maal ki ya apwøyaweerø.
english: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba ajoot Ilaaca, ni ö eni ni gööe ko oduuru, na «Awuuö, Awuuö, bee ï ni wø piem jø Icriel kaamar jïëth leny mo wø tut  okwëënyi ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi!» Kanyøgønø, Ilaaja käre joodø këët. Ni ö eni ni jeey abïï mare na thäŋi ariiø ki pänh cwïny.
english: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aleeŋŋa mar Ilaaja mana no opänh piny ki bääte akwanye, ni døøe ni cuŋŋe bäät ageel Naam Jördan.
english: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

anywaa: 'Ba aleeŋ Ilaaja mana pänh piny ki bääte alwør Ilaaca, ni gøøc pïï ki gø ni kööe, ni «?Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Ilaaja, age ïïni?» 'Ba kanya gøøc pïï, pïï rege aputge pääŋŋö ki dïëre ni cige løøi ki løøi; ni ö Ilaaca ni put ŋut løøga.
english: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the Lord God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø moa käl Jerikö na jootge gïïa tïïc Ilaaca, gena köö, ni «Teek Jwøk mana en bäät Ilaaja anø ö bäät Ilaaca.» Køøre gena öö ni røømge ki eni ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïme.
english: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, ni «Ennø neenï, wa na jiyï ii, jïwa da jiy ma pïërabïïc mo teek. Beerra man cige kuna manyge kwäärö marï ma Ilaaja; kanymør eno kïth Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøki maal ni leeŋ gø bäät kïdi mør wala ee leeŋ ya agäm-kïdi mør.» 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Käru jäägö.»
english: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the Lord hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø areeth ree këël mana tïm wïïe ni laay ki man kweere; ni kööe, ni «Jäägu.» Køøre geni jiy ma pïërabïïc aputge jääŋŋö, ni määnyge ki nïne adäk; 'ba Ilaaja kärge joodø.
english: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

anywaa: Køøre gena duu baŋ Ilaaca, kanya bëëde yie Jerikö, ni kö Ilaaca jïge, na «?Aŋø, kära caanø jïïu ni käru cøø?»
english: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

anywaa: Køøre, jø päänyögø aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Ennø neenï, kany ni en päänynyi man yie en beer, kaawat man nëëne jïrï enø, ï na kwäärö marwa; 'ba pïï keerge reyø, ni tïïcge caammi ni ba ciek.»
english: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Kännu jïra ki dak mo nyään, ni kïthu yie ka acäbö.» Kanyøgø dak manøgø akälge baŋe.
english: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aci bäät jøøro ni køny acäbö yi gø ni kööe, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Pïï moi anø tïïa ni beyø; bäŋ thøø mo kälge këët, këël caammi bäŋgø mo tïïcge ni ba ciek këët.› »
english: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the Lord, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, pïï aput bëëtö ni beyø këël dïcäŋi en, ki køør luubö mana caan Ilaaca.
english: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aay kaace ni cøøa Bëthël. 'Ba kanya cäädhe waŋjöö, obwöc cwøw gena ö wøk ki yi pääny ni buuge eni ni köge jïgø, ni «Aayï nyie obøønni! Aayï nyie obøønni!»
english: And he went up from thence unto Beth–el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ilaaca na lwïthe ŋääe na joot obwöyögø, eni obwöyögø aciene ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre, teeŋ cwëënyi møøk ma mädhi ma ariiø gena put ö wøk ki yi lul ni baaŋge jiy ma pïëraŋween kurriiø røkge.
english: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca atïŋŋö kaace ni ci bäät Kïn Karmël, ni aae kaace ni døø Cameria.
english: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abära moa beet Jøcapat ni ena nyeny Juuda, Jeyöram wär Akap atïmö na nyeya bäät jø Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø ni ena nyeya.
english: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöram abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba eni rääö mare ba caal rääö mar wänni ki menni, kiper eni kïdi mana cwöth wänni piny jï jwø wø cwøl ni Baal araanynye.
english: And he wrought evil in the sight of the Lord; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni cwïnye onieŋ køør raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ni käre raayøgø wiiø.
english: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

anywaa: 'Ba Mëca nyeny Möap beeye ŋat ma dïpïïth dïëk, ni eni wø cïpö jï nyeny Icriel ki nyïï rööm ma kume ma dïpa, ki jïëc nyöök rööm ma kume ma dïpa.
english: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akapi na thøøe, nyeny Möap ena këëyö ni ö maal bäät nyeny Icriel.
english: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, nyeya ma Jeyöram aci wøk ki yi Cameria ni cooŋ jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët.
english: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cøøe, ena jäägö ki dwøl jï Jøcapat nyeny Juuda ni kööe, ni «Nyeny Möap anø gëëmö ki aani. Waa cøø baŋ leny nøø këëdø ki jø Möap.» 'Ba Jøcapat aköö jï nyeny Icriel, ni «Wøp; aani ki jiya ko okwëënyi 'moa wa cøø kaawat mano ciï ki jiyï ko okwëënyi moï.»
english: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat apëëö, na «?A øtjöö mane noo cørø yie kanyo cøø baŋ leny?» Ni løgi ya Jeyörammi, ni «Beeye waŋjöö man wø cør dï paap Ëdöm.»
english: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel gena aay ki nyeny Juuda ki nyeny Ëdöm. Ni cääthge ni ge wïra piny ki nïne abïriiø; ni tïme ni bäŋ pïï kiper jø leny ki lääc paac moa cäädhö ki geni.
english: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö, ni «Wui, aŋø! Wuuö Jwøk ø na nyeye moi na adäk ii ø cwøle kaper nee ø cïp ceŋ jø Möap!»
english: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aköö, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ nyikuŋ Wuuö Jwøk mo ena kany mo pëënynyø dwør Wuuö Jwøk ki gø?» 'Ba aløk dhaanhø acielli røk jø kööre mo nyeny Icriel ni kööe, ni «Ilaaca o Capath ena kany, ŋata wara bëëdö buut Ilaaja ni tïnynya gø.»
english: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord, that we may enquire of the Lord by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

anywaa: Ni put Jøcapati köö, ni «Dwør Wuuö Jwøk ena bääte.» Ni ö nyeny Icriel ki Jøcapat ki nyeny Ëdöm ni løøcge piny baŋe.
english: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the Lord is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö jï nyeny Icriel, ni «?Ï manynyï ŋø baŋa? Ci baŋ nyïïkuk jwøk mo jwø wäru ki nyïïkuk jwøk mo jwø meru.» 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jïre, ni «Jïre bäär; kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na cwøl waani, wa na nyeye moi na adäk ii, nee wa cïp ceŋ jø Möap.»
english: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the Lord hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, eni na wïth jammi bëët ni wø tïnynya, doo na paa per Jøcapat nyeny Juuda, aani jïrï ba daa raŋø. Jïrï ba daa neenø na bäre bäre.
english: And Elisha said, As the Lord of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kännu jïra ki ŋat mo pöödö ki thoom othïënhö.» 'Ba kanya ö ŋatøgø na ööe na pwöt thoom, teek mar Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Ilaaca.
english: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the Lord came upon him.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Pääŋ yi gool man ka aguule.›
english: And he said, Thus saith the Lord, Make this valley full of ditches.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Bäŋ jamø ki køth mo jootu, 'ba yi gool man tïmö ni päŋ ki pïï; ni mädhu yïthge, u ki dhäk mou ki lääc paac mou.›
english: For thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye gïn mo jööt jaak ki jï Wuuö Jwøk ki man tïïc gø. 'Ba eni thuwø, jø Möap cïbe ceŋŋu.
english: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the Lord: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

anywaa: Ni nyagu päänye bëët moa no ogeerø ni teek, ki päänye bëët moa beyø; ni ŋødu jenni piny bëët moa beyø, ni dïïrru dhøk jøør bëët, ni lëëŋŋu yïth pwöth bëët moa beyø ki kïte, nou raanynya ge.»
english: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, yi caan wø cïp olämi yie, ka adïëri møn, pïï aput mullö ki waŋjöör Ëdöm, ni ö pinynyi ni put nimata ki pïï.
english: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny jø Möapi bëët ni nyeye moøgø na adäk yøø, gena ö baŋ leny nee këëtge ki geni. Ni ö jø Möapi ni cwølge jiy bëët moa näk løny jïge ki man käärge jap leny, ki mana täge ko obwöre këël mana këët ri jø døøŋŋø, ni kïth geni waŋkeew.
english: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Möapi na pänyge maal ka amöölla cøøn, däär cäŋ ajootge no orieny bäät pïï. Ni jootge pïï nyïmge ni nëëni ni kwaar kaamar remø.
english: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Manece beeye remø; ka adïëri møn, nyeye moa na adäk gena nø këëdö ki dëëtge keerge, ni nø ö ŋati man nø ni 'näk watge. 'Ba ennø, ø na jø Möap en, waa cøø kuna twierø japge!»
english: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge twïër mar jø Icriel, jø Icriel gena put ö maal ni 'näkge jø Möap, ni ö jø Möapi ni putge bwøk nyïmge. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni riemge jø Möap këël mana pïïcge yïth ŋøøp jø Möap ni jø Möap nääŋge nääŋŋö.
english: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

anywaa: Ni putge päänye nyak; ni ö ŋati man nø ni lëëŋ yi pwödhö mana beer man nø ki kïdi, ni putge pwöth pääŋ ki kïte. Ni dïïrge dhøk jøør bëët, ni ŋøtge jenni piny bëët moa beyø. 'Ba kiir mar pääny Kir-Ërë na no ogeerø ki kïte beeye na dhäthö jïge keere. 'Ba jiy mo wø thöödhö ki kïte, ni ge thöödhö ko ojøye mo kaae, gena cøø ni cielge päänyögø dïër ni tukge gø.
english: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeny Möapi na joot gø ni leny teek ni ba løny jïre, ena lwötö ki jø leny ma dïpe abïriiø mo wø këëdi ko opëëlle nee jäpge ki jöö kiper nee pïïcge jï løøa en nyeny Ëdömmi yie; 'ba kär løny jïge.
english: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, eni wääde mana dwøŋ na doo läw kar gø na nyeya alwøre ni cïp gø no olämi bäät kiir. Køøre jø Icriel gena lwäyö døc ki gïna tïïe, ni aacge buute ni døøge poge.
english: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

anywaa: 'Ba da dhaagø røk mään mo lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø ma ajwöŋö dëër Ilaaca ni kööe, ni «Dhaanhnhï ma cwøra athøw, ni ŋäyï ni eni bëëdö ni lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba ennø, ŋat pïïdö aöö nee obwöre 'moa moa na ariiø käle nee tïmge na laaŋe moe.»
english: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the Lord: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö jï nyijøøgø, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa jïrï nø? ?Agïnaŋø ni dagø jïrï yi øtø? Caanï jïra.» 'Ba aløk nyijøøgø ni kööe, ni «A na dhaanhnhï en, bäŋ gïrpiny jïra yi øtø, 'ba beeye dak mo yie da maaw keere.»
english: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ciï, ni kwäyï ki dääe mo yïthge ŋaam dï paac bäre baŋ jø atut moï bëët; kärï kännö ki mo nøk.
english: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

anywaa: Køøre wär døny yi øtø marï ni cïëgï dhi øtø bäätï, ï ki wäätï, ni thiiï maaw yïth dääe moøgø bëët, ni cïbï dääe mo opäŋ kur keerge.»
english: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyijøøgø aput aay buut Ilaaca. Køøre dhi øtø acïëk bääte ki wääte; ni ö wääte ni kälge dääe jïre, ni bëëde ni pääŋa yïthge ki maaw.
english: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ dääe, ena köö jï wääde, ni «Kännï jïra ki dak mør.» Ni kö wääde jïre, ni «Bäŋ dak mør këët.» Ni put maawi cuŋŋö.
english: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aöö ni caan gø jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca. Ni kö nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni «Ciï ni dwøgï maaw pwödhö ni coolï pïïdö marï, ni ö ïïni ki wäätï ni bëëdu nou cama mano dööŋ.»
english: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel, Ilaaca aci Cunem. 'Ba kanya cøøe, da nyijø mo okwär maa joode kaace. Køøre ena kwac nyijøøgø nee cäme; ni cäme. Ni put tïmö ni kany wø cør Cunem jaak, eni puta gaa kaace wø cäme yie.
english: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö jï cwøre, ni «Ennø neenï, ajooda ni ŋati en ni wø cur buutø kany cooth en, ena nyikuŋ Jwøk mo ena kur keere.
english: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.

anywaa: Beerra man tïïø ki øtø mo thiinh bäät øtø man maal, ni kïthø yi gø ki pëëm jïre kaace, ki tharabëëta, ki køøm, ki gïn wø bëët lamba bääte, nee kany wäro ö baŋø, nee eni wø ci yie kaace.»
english: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Ilaaca aöö ni ci yi thääŋ øtø manøgø ni en maal enø, ni jwöm dëëre yi gø.
english: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï Gaadhi ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Cwøl nyijø Cunem.» 'Ba kanya nø cwøl gø, nyijøøgø aöö ni cuŋŋe nyïme.
english: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö jï Gaadhi, ni «Ennø, caanï jï nyijøøgø, ni ‹Neenï, ïïna bëëdö niï gwøga waani ki göök man en bäre. ?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa jïrï nø? ?Ï manynya gø naa cääna ki nyeya wala ki kwääy jø leny kiperï?› » 'Ba aløk nyijøøgø, ni «Bäŋ gïn maa can ki gø; aani a bëëdö ka jø powa.»
english: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Ilaaca aköö, na «?Agïnaŋø nø noo tïïc jïre?» 'Ba aløk Gaadhi, ni «Ka adïëri møn, nyijøøgø bäŋ nyilaal jïre; cwøre oløny na jaal.»
english: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö, ni «Cwøl nyijøøgø.» 'Ba kanya ö Gaadhi na cwøl gø, ena öö ni cuŋŋe dhi øtø.
english: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

anywaa: Ni kö Ilaaca, ni «Yi kar kany nø cwiino ööi, ï jïtö ki nyilaal mo iï cïp köörï.» Ni kö nyijøøgø, «Wui nyikuŋ Jwøk, ba løny; kär a cøøgï, a na dhaanhnhï en.»
english: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø yie aput jïtö ki dhaanhø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø yi kar kanya caan Ilaaca jïre.
english: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyilaalli na døøŋŋe, dïcäŋ aciel ena ci baŋ wänni dï jø wø kac pwödhö.
english: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
