anywaa: 'Ba nyilaarøgø aköö jï wänni, ni «Wui wïïa öy! Wui wïïa öy!» Køøre wänni aköö jï ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Kïth eni baŋ menni.»
english: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋatøgø na käl nyilaal na kïth gø baŋ menni, ena pï köör menni këël mana këët cäŋŋi dhöör; køøre ena thøw.
english: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aeth maal ni pïël nyilaal bäät pëëm mar nyikuŋ Jwøk, ni cïëk dhi øtø bäät gø, ni ci wøk.
english: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

anywaa: Køøre cwøre acwøle ni kööe, ni «Beerra man jääŋŋï baŋa ki ŋat tïïc aciel ka arëën, naa reŋŋa baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk naa duua.»
english: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøre aköö, na «?Aŋø ni ciï baŋe dïcäŋi en? Kee paa kany wø päär dwääyi yie dïcäŋi wala cäŋ jwömö.» 'Ba ena köö, ni «Bäŋ gïre.»
english: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

anywaa: Køøre arëën ajiiŋ nyijøøgø, ni kööe jï ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Kwørï døc nee rïïŋe; kär kwørï mëëth kipera këël kanyo caana gø jïrï.»
english: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena aay ni pïïe baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk bäät Kïn Karmël. 'Ba kanya ö nyikuŋ Jwøki na joot nyijøøgø ni kare poot bäär, ena köö jï Gaadhi ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Neenï, nyijø Cunem ni ööi ice.
english: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man reŋŋï baŋe nou røømmu ki gø ni kööï jïre, ni ‹?Ï ööï ka jööt dëël? ?Cwørï dëëre jööt? ?Nyilaal dëëre jööt?› » 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö, ni «Dëëtge jööt.»
english: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø na pïïe baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk bäät thuur, eni tiet nyikuŋ Jwøk agääme. Køøre Gaadhi aö buute nee nyijøøgø cöör wøk; 'ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aköö, ni «Wec eni, kiper eni da gïn mo cwïnye oränynyö ki gø døc, mo tiere okan Wuuö Jwøki ki aani, ni käre caanø jïra.»
english: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the Lord hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aköö, na «?Aŋø, ï na kwäärö mara, aana pëëö baŋï ki nyilaal na bëëde? ?A kär köö, ni ‹Kär aani cøøgï›?»
english: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö jï Gaadhi, ni «Twöö abïïnï pierï ni lwørï athøra mara, ni aayï. 'Ba ni näk miï røømmø ki dhaanhø mør, kär eni määthï; ni näk mo da ŋat mo määtha ïïni, kär niï dwøga gø jïre. 'Ba athøra mara wär cïp täärnyïm nyilaal.»
english: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

anywaa: 'Ba mii nyilaarøgø aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw ki ŋëëtï thuwø, aani ï ba wiia piny.» Køøre Ilaaca aö maal ni ci køør nyijøøgø.
english: And the mother of the child said, As the Lord liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Gaadhi aput bwøth maal nyïmge ni cïp athøra täärnyïm nyilaal; 'ba bäŋ dwøl, ni bäŋ gïr cärö mo ee joodø. Køøre ena duuö ni røømge ki Ilaaca, ni caan gø jïre, ni «Nyilaal kär päy.»
english: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ilaaca na døny yi øtø, ka adïëri møn, nyilaal othøw no opïël piny bäät pëëm.
english: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Ilaaca adøny øtø ni cïëk dhi øtø bäätge karge riet, ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre ena eth bäät pëëm ni but bäät nyilaal, ni cøm dhee dhi nyilaal ni nyeŋŋe dïët ki nyeŋ nyilaal, ni cïp ceŋŋe bäät ceŋ nyilaal, ni rïëp yie bäät nyilaal; ni ö dëër nyilaalli ni put murrö.
english: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Ilaaca aö maal ni ci deŋ øtø ni duue, ni cäŋ eth bäät pëëm ni rïëp yie bäät nyilaal; ni ö nyilaalli ni put kweer ki  tham kwöre abïriiø, ni ö nyilaalli ni put nyeŋŋe jap.
english: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca, Gaadhi acwøle ni kööe, ni «Cwøl nyijø Cunem manøgø.» Køøre Gaadhi nyijøøgø acwøle. 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø baŋ Ilaaca, Ilaaca aköö, ni «Lwør wäädï.»
english: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyijøøgø adøny øtø ni päth tiet Ilaaca ni kuul wïïe piny; ni lwør wääde ni døny wøk.
english: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ilaaca na duu Gëlgela, käc dagø kaace. 'Ba kanya bëëde ni lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø opï piny nyïme, ena köö jï ŋat tïïc mare, ni «Cïp dak mana dwøŋ maac ni tëëdï ki kadø jï nyïïkuk Jwøk.»
english: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel aci wøk yi pwöla kuna ŋwëëte ko omarø; 'ba ena tïmö ni joota jaath mør ni pune ri gø ni pääŋ ya abïïne ki nyïï gø, ni ööe ni ŋør ge ni kïth geni yi daa kadø. 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge man näk mo gïïögø aŋøøni.
english: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

anywaa: Køøre kadø atøøkge kiper nee cam jiyi. 'Ba kanya täkge ki cam ennø, gena put jwöŋö ni köge, «Wui nyikuŋ Jwøk, da gïn mo nääö yi kadø!» Ni putge tïmö ni ge ba løny ki cam këët.
english: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Ennø, kännu ki møø.» Ni ö eni ni kïth møø yi daa kadø, ni kööe, ni «Tøøgu jï jiy nee ge cämge.» Kanyøgø aput tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo nääö yi kadø këët.
english: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør aöö ki Baal-Calica, ni kännö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca ki dääpe mo møk beel moa kwøŋ ciek, ni beege dääpe ma pïërariiø mo tïïc ka møk beel mo wø cwøl ni gäbci, ka abäy ma twiinye mo ena yi keeca. Køøre Ilaaca aköö, ni «Cïpï jï jiy nee camge.»
english: And there came a man from Baal–shalishah, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat tïïc mare aköö, na «?Aŋø, cïba cam man nyïm jøøi na dïpa ii?» 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Cïpï jïge nee camge, kiper man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Geno cämö, ni ö møøki ni dhäthge.› »
english: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the Lord, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

anywaa: Køøre ŋat tïïc, cam acïp nyïmge, ni cämge ni dhäth møøki, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Neeman mana bëëdö na kwääy lwaa leny mar nyeny Aram beeye ŋat mo kare dwøŋ døc nyïm nyeya mare, ni eno wøørø døc, kiper beeye eni na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc jø Aram nee kääthge ki køøre; ni eni thuwø beeye ŋat leny mo teek. 'Ba eni dëëre da dhøøbø.
english: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the Lord had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø leny mo jø Aram gena aa wøk baŋ twëër, ni cige yïth ŋøøp jø Icriel ni peecge nyilaar dhaagø ma nyakøø, ni ö nyakøønnøgø ni bëëde ni tïnynya cï Neeman.
english: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba nyakøønnøgø aköö jï nyijøøa tïnynye, ni «Doo na kwäärö mara ma Neeman oci ban nyikuŋ Jwøk mana en Cameria, eni dëëre doo dwøk nyikuŋ Jwøki kare ki dhøøbø manø ni en dëëre enø.»
english: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

anywaa: Køøre Neeman aci baŋ nyeny Aram na bëënne, ni caan gïna caan nyakøønna käli ki yïth ŋøøp jø Icriel jïre.
english: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Aram aköö, ni «Wøp, cii nø; 'ba aani a jääga cerï ki wëëlö nee kïthï baŋ nyeny Icriel.» Køøre Neeman aay ni käädö ki gwet-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme apaar mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar, ki warkey mo peek mare beeye rumme ma kume  abïciel mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, ka abïïe apaar mo beyø mo wø røø dëël.
english: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

anywaa: Køøre Neeman wëëlö akïth baŋ nyeny Icriel. 'Ba luubö mana no ogöörö yi wëëlö beeye en: «Wëëlö man ajääŋŋa baŋï kiper nee dhaanhnha ma Neeman dëëre dwøgi kare ki dhøøbø manø ni en dëëre enø.»
english: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeny Icrielli na kwaan wëëlö, abïïe moe aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, aana Jwøk? ?Løny jïra ki man nääa dhaanhø ni cäŋa gø tïïyö nee kwøe, na ö nyeni na jääŋ baŋa ki dwøl nee dhaanhø mo dëëre da dhøøbø dwøga kare en? Neennu, nyenøgø kämö.»
english: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Ilaaca na wïny gø ni nyeny Icriel abïïe moe ajeeye, ena jääk baŋ gø ki dwøl ni kööe, na «?Aperŋø na jeeyï abïïe moï? Ennø, wec eni nee ö baŋa, nee put ŋäc ni da nyikuŋ Jwøk Icriel.»
english: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Neeman aput öö ko okwëënyi moe ki jïëthe moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni cuŋŋe deŋ dhi øtø mar Ilaaca.
english: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

anywaa: Ni ö Ilaaca ni jääk baŋe ki dhaanhø ni kööe, ni «Ciï ni lwøgï dëërï yi Naam Jördan kwöre abïriiø; køøre dëërï odøø kare ni tïm dëërï ni waany.»
english: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.

anywaa: 'Ba Neeman agootø døc, ni put aay ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aana cädö cøøn ni eni ki dëëre kiree doo ööa wøk baŋa, ni dee cuŋŋö ni dee nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk cwølø, na näk Jwøk mare, ni dee kwöra leth kwadhø ki cere ni dwøga dëëra kare ki täw dhøøbø.
english: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the Lord his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba beyø pï Abana ki Parpar, näp Damacka, ni kaala pï näp Icriel bëët? ?Aŋø, ba doo løny jïra ki mana daa lwøk yïthge ni di dëëra døø kare ni waany?» Kanyøgø ree aput løk ni aae ni eno gootø døc.
english: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

anywaa: Køøre jø tïïc moe aö buute ni cäänge ki eni ni köge, na «?Awuuö, doo na nyikuŋ Jwøk caana gïn mo dwøŋ jïrï kiper nee tïïyï, ba diï tïïö cøøn? Tugi ki nyi man ni caane jïrï en, ni ‹Ci lwøgï nee dëërï døø kare ni waany.› »
english: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena put ci yi Naam Jördan ni rønye kwöre abïriiø kaawat mana caan nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni ö dëëre ni put døø kare, ni tïm dëëre kaamar dëër nyilaal mo poot thiinh, ni ö dëëre ni put tïmö ni waany.
english: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Neemanni ki jiye bëët na duuge baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk, Neeman acøø ni cuŋŋe nyïm gø ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ennø, aputa ŋäc ni bäŋ Jwøk bäät piny bäre, 'ba beeye Jwø Icriel keere. 'Ba ennø, beerra man lwørï muuce moo cïba jïrï, a na dhaanhnhï en.»
english: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw ni wø tïnynya, aani, bäŋ gïrpiny mo lwøra.» Ni ö eni ni kwaac gø døc nee lwøre, 'ba ena kweer.
english: But he said, As the Lord liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

anywaa: Køøre Neeman aköö, ni «Ni näk mo bäŋ gïn lwørï baŋa nø, beerra man mooc aani, a na dhaanhnhï en, ki ŋøøm mo käära gääŋŋe ariiø, kiper a na dhaanhnhï en, a ba cïpi ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme møga jï juu møøk këët; 'ba beeye jï Wuuö Jwøk keere noo cïpa jïre.
english: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëën aani, a na dhaanhnhï en, kiper gïrpiny aciel man; ni beeye ni kany wø cääthwa ki nyenynya na aciel ni eni cøøa baŋ lam yi øt Rimön, jwø jø Aram, kany wø kuul wïïe piny ni eni yaa maaø naa jøla gø, wø putwa wïthwa kuul piny na aciel, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëën aani, a na dhaanhnhï en.»
english: In this thing the Lord pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the Lord pardon thy servant in this thing.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö jï gø, ni «Ciï nø ki jööt dëël.» 'Ba kanya tïŋ Neemanni buute, na cääthe ki kany mo bäär mëëth,
english: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

anywaa: Gaadhi ŋat tïïc mar nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca acätö ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, kwäärö mara, Neeman nyï Aram awiie jaak ni aae, ni bäŋ gïn mo ee kälö baŋ gø røk gïïa ööe ki ge. Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk Jwøa kwøw, aani a reŋŋa køøre naa käda baŋe ki gïrpiny.»
english: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the Lord liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Gaadhi aput läp køør Neeman. 'Ba kanya ö Neemanni na joot ŋat mo rïïŋö køøre, ena ïnh piny ki yi jääy man wø tut okwëënyi nee røømge ki Gaadhi, ni kööe, ni «?Da gïn mo otägö?»
english: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo otägö. 'Ba kwäärö mara aana jääŋŋe baŋï ni kööe, ni ‹Kawaane waane en, jiy ariiø mo poot na wøpe mo ena røk lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø gena nø ö baŋa ni ge käla paana en bäät kïte na näk kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem. Ennø, beerra man cïpï jïge ki gwel-bïrö ma kikar aciel ka abïïe ariiø mo beyø mo wø røø dëël.› »
english: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

anywaa: 'Ba Neeman aköö, ni «Ba løny. Beerra man kädï ki gwel-bïrö ma kikarri ariiø.» Ni kwaac Gaadhi kiper nee lwøre, ni kïth gwet-bïrö moøgø na kikarri ariiø yøø yïth opïri ariiø ka abïïe ariiø, ni cïp ge jï jiy ariiø røk jø tïïc moe, ni käärge ge nyïme.
english: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe bäät thuur, gïïögø alwøre ceŋ jø tïïc moøgø ni kïth ge yi øtø, ni wëëk jøøgø wääth ni aacge.
english: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre ena ci baŋ kwäärö mare ma Ilaaca ni cuŋŋe nyïme. 'Ba Ilaaca aköö jïre, ni «?Gaadhi, ïïno cøøa kaa ŋø?» Ni løk gø, ni «A na dhaanhnhï en, bäŋ kany mo aano ci yie.»
english: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.

anywaa: Ni kö Ilaaca jïre, na «?Aŋø, kuua kanya ïnh ŋatece piny ki yi jääy mare man wø tut okwëënyi nee røømme ki ïïni? ?Aŋø, kar kany ennø beeye kany mo løny ki man kädï ki gwel, ka abïïe, ki pwöth jenni mo wø nyïïe wel na maaw, ki pwöth omøki, ki dïëk, ki dhäk, ki laaŋe ma cwøw ki ma mään?
english: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, dhøøbø mana en dëër Neeman ööa dëërï ni neegän dëërï ki dëët jiy moo käl dëërï na bäre bäre.» Køøre Gaadhi aput aay buut Ilaaca, ni ö dëëre ni put jïtö ki dhøøbø, ni neepwøth ni tar.
english: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø aköö jï Ilaaca, ni «Neenï, ennø, kany ni bëëtwa yie buutï en atïmö ni thiinh kiperwa.
english: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.

anywaa: Beerra man ciwa bäät Naam Jördan nee ŋati man nø dëëtwa ŋute ki jaath, nee wa gëëtwa ki kany bëëtwa yie kaace.» Køøre ena köö, ni «Cou.»
english: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel aköö, ni «Beerra man aayï ki waani na jiyï ii.» Ni løk gø, ni «Aani, a cøø.»
english: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena aay ki geni; 'ba kanya pïïcge bäät Naam Jördan, gena ŋudö ki jenni.
english: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ŋut dhaanhe acielli ki jaath, ley aker ni päth yi naam. 'Ba ena köök ni kööe, «Wui kwäärö mara, ley man di kwaaø!»
english: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aköö, no «?Opätha kaa?» 'Ba kanya ö ŋatøgø na nyooth kanya päth leyi yie jïre, ena ŋutö ki bat jaath, ni leeŋ gø yi naam, ni tïïya ley nee neethar.
english: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Lwørï.» Køøre ŋatøgø cere aput rwaak baŋ gø ni lwør gø.
english: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Aram ena bäät leny ki jø Icriel; ni ö eni ni cääne ki jø kööre moe ni kööe, ni «Kaace doo kïthö ki twïër leny mara.»
english: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ nyeny Icriel ni kööe, ni «Gwøk riï, kärï cør kaace, kiper jø leny mo jø Aram ge ööa piny kaace.»
english: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel ajääk kanya caan nyikuŋ Jwøki jïre ki jiy; ni ö eni ni kööm jiy nee rege gwøkge kaagø. 'Ba gïnögø atägö kwöre mo thööth.
english: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny jø Aram yie atïmö ni raac døc ki luubö manøgø; ni ö eni ni cwøl jø kööre moe ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋa dëëtø ni en løø nyeny Icriel? Caannu jïra.»
english: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dëëtge aköö, ni «Wui nyeya, bäŋgø; 'ba beeye Ilaaca, nyikuŋ Jwøk man wø bëëdö Icriel, ni wø caan dwørï jï nyeny Icriel man wø caanï niï ena øt niine marï.»
english: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Ciï ni neenï gø kany wø bëëde yie, naa jääga baŋe nee eni mak.» 'Ba acaan jïre ni købi, ni «Neenï, eni ena Döthan.»
english: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

anywaa: Køøre ena jääk kaace ko okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø leny mo thööth døc, ni ö jøøgø ni cige ki wäär ni cielge pääny manøgø dïër.
english: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋat tïïci mar nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø na ö maal ka amöölla na ci wøk, ka adïëri møn, jø leny, ko okwëënyi, ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi aput joot ni pääny ege ciel dïër. Kanyøgø, ena put köö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø, ni «?Wui, kwäärö mara, agïnaŋø noo tïïø?»
english: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni «Kärï lwäyö, kiper jiy mo en løø en thööth døc ni kaala jiy mo en løøge enø.»
english: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca alämö ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, jap nyeŋ dhaanhnha nee neene.» Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jap nyeŋ gø; 'ba ka adïëri møn, bäät kïdi aput joot ni päŋ ko okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi mo liel ki mäc mo ena deŋ Ilaaca bäre.
english: And Elisha prayed, and said, Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Arammi piny baŋ Ilaaca, Ilaaca alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, na «A kwaya ïïni, tïïc ge na cööye.» Køøre gena put tïïc na cööye ki køør dwør Ilaaca.
english: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the Lord, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö jïge, ni «Jöö man ki pääny man paa mana manynyu; caathu køøra nou kïtha baŋ ŋata manynyu.» Ni kïth ge Cameria.
english: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø pïïcge Cameria, Ilaaca aköö, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, jap nyeŋ jøøi ii nee ge nëënge.» Kanyøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk nyeŋge aput jap, ni nëënge; 'ba ka adïëri møn, aputge joot ni ge ena dï Cameria.
english: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, Lord, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the Lord opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeny Icrielli na joot geni, ena köö jï Ilaaca, «?Awuuö, nääa geni? ?Nääa geni?»
english: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe, ni «Jïre bäär, kär ge 'nägï. ?Aŋø, jiy mo iï maaø ki tøŋ 'nägï nääö? Cïp cam nyïmge, ki pïï, nee ge cämge nee døøge baŋ nyeya marge.»
english: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena tïïö ki cam mo dwøŋ døc jïge; 'ba kanya nø cämge gena wëëk wääth, ni døøge baŋ nyeya marge. 'Ba geni na jø leny mo jø Aram moa ö wøk baŋ twëër, ge kär laar duu yi ŋööm Icriel këët.
english: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Ben-Adat nyeny Aram jø leny moe bëët acooŋe ni cøøe ni ciel Cameria dïër.
english: And it came to pass after this, that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cielge Cameria dïër, käc mo dwøŋ aput tägö Cameria, ni wï arëën ŋeew ka gwet-bïrö ma pïërabära, ni cam mo raac mo røm ka gïn mo thiinh ŋeew ka gwet-bïrö ma abïïc.
english: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeny Icrielli na cør bäät kiir päänyögø, da dhaagø maa rwääyö ni kööe, «Wui, nyeya, køny aani!»
english: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya nyeya, «?Ni näk mo Wuuö Jwøk ï käre kønyø, ïïno kønya gø ki ŋø? ?Aŋø, jïra da beel wala jïra da køøŋ nyïïomøki?»
english: And he said, If the Lord do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

anywaa: Køøre, nyeya aköö jï dhaagø manøgø, na «?Agïnaŋø cøøn?» Ni løgi ya nyijøøgø, ni «Dhaagø man aköö jïra, ni ‹Cïp wäädï nee camø dïcäŋi; køøre nee wääda camø diøø.›
english: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

anywaa: Køøre nø, waani wääda athaalwa ni camwa gø; 'ba na tïme na amöölla maya aana köö jïre, ni ‹Cïp wäädï nee camø.› 'Ba eni wääde akane.»
english: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na wïny luup mo nyijøøgø, eni abïïe moe ajeeye ki pänh cwïny. 'Ba kanya cäädhe ki bäät kiir kaagø ajoot jiyi ni keeca ee røø tier abïïne.
english: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya, ni «Ni näk mo wï Ilaaca o Capath kära ŋul wøk dïcäŋi, aani, a raany Jwøki raanynyø.»
english: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

anywaa: Køøre eni na nyeya ajääk baŋ Ilaaca ki dhaanhø. 'Ba Ilaaca bëëdö no opï piny yi øtø mare, ni jø døøŋŋø opï piny buute. 'Ba kanya poode ni ŋata jääŋ nyeya poot kär pïï, Ilaaca aköö jï jø døøŋŋø, ni «?Ŋäyu ni o dïnääy manøgø ojääŋ baŋa ki dhaanhø nee wïïa ŋul wøk? 'Ba ennø, kanyo ö ŋata jääŋŋi noo pïïe, dhi øtø wär cïëgu, ni jøllu gø. Kiper nyeya mare cäädhö køøre.»
english: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni eni poot cäänö ki geni, ka adïëri møn, nyeya ki ŋata jääŋŋi aput pïï baŋe; ni kö nyeya, ni «Ka adïëri møn, käc man ni raac en käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk. ?Poode naa køya Wuuö Jwøk aperŋø?»
english: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the Lord; what should I wait for the Lord any longer?

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö, ni «Wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk; Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Diøø kar kany nø, yi rumi aciel mar møø mo pøøth gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel keere, ni møk gäbci ma yïth rumme ariiø gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel thuwø, dhi kiir Cameria.› »
english: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk ŋat wø cäädhi ki nyeya jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca ni kööe, ni «?Gïnögø ba tägi na bäre. ?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk, da dha awëërnyeŋ mo jabe jabø maal mo cam öö ki yi gø?» Ni løgi ya Ilaaca ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jootï joodø ki waŋï, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo camï camø ri gø.»
english: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the Lord would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba da jak ma aŋween mo dëëtge da dhøøbø mo ge bëëdö dhi kiir; køøre gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «?Ø bëënnø ŋø kany? ?Ø koora thøø?
english: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

anywaa: Ni näk mo ø köö ni ø cøøa yi kiir, da käc yie; ø puta thøø kaace. Ni näk mo ø bëëdö kany, ø thøw thuwø. 'Ba ennø, ööu waa cøø kuna cïbø ceŋŋø twïër mar jø Aram. Ni näk mo ø ba 'näkge, ø bëëdö ni ø kwøw; ni näk ø 'näkge nääö, ø poot doo thøw cøøn thuwø.»
english: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

anywaa: 'Ba jagøgø gena tïŋŋö kanya tïme na wïthïënhö ni cige twïër mar jø Aram. 'Ba kanya pïïcge deŋ twïër, ka adïëri møn, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel kaace.
english: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.

anywaa: Kiper jø Aram onø tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee dööt tiet okwëënyi ki mo jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi wïnyge, ni beege dööt tiet jø lwaa leny mo päl; ni ö geni ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, nyeny Icriel, nyeny Këth ki nyeny Ijep ee nø ŋeew nee öge baŋø baŋ leny.»
english: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

anywaa: Ni putge ö maal ki wïthïënhö ni reŋge, ni wiige oduŋkaare moge piny, ko okwëënyi, ka arëëni; këël jammi moa en yi twïër aputge wii piny na karge, ni reŋge ni ge gwøga jwïëcge.
english: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jaga näk dëëtge da dhøøbø na pïïcge deŋ twïër, gena put døny yo oduŋkaara mana cwöpge ki gø, ni cämge ni mäthge, ni kätge yi gø ki gwel-bïrö ki warkey ka abïïe, ni aacge ni kange geni; ni duuge ni dønyge yo oduŋkaara mør ni kätge kaace thuwø, ni aacge ni kange geni.
english: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni «Gïn ni tïïø en patha kare. Dïcäŋi beeye dïcäŋ caan waac mo met yie, 'ba ø bëëdö ni ø lïŋö jaak. Ni näk mo ø bëëdö jaak këël diøø ka amöölla, da ajäla mo pïï bäätø. 'Ba ennø, beerra man cøø ni caanø gïna tägö jï jø paan dwøŋ.»
english: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena öö ni cwølge jø wø koor dhi kiir mar pääny, ni caange gø jï jøøgø, ni köge, ni «Waana ci yi twïër mar jø Aram. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ena kaace, këël dwør dhaanhø kiree bäŋgø mo wïnyi; 'ba beege okwëënyi ka arëëni mo otwöö piny keerge, no oduŋkaare bëëdö karge.»
english: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.

anywaa: Køøre jø wø koor dhi kiir gena rwääyö ni caani jï jø paan dwøŋ.
english: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aö maal ki dï wäär ni caan gø jï jø kööre moe ni kööe, ni «Ennø, gïn tïïc jø Arammi dëëtø en caana caanø jïïu. Geni ŋäcge ni øøno 'näk käci; kiper manøgø nø, gena aay twïër marge ni kange dëëtge yi pwöla, ni köge, ni ‹Kanyo ö jø Icrielli wøk ki yi pääny, ge putø ka mak ni dønynyø yi pääny marge.› »
english: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat köör mare aciel aköö, ni «Beerra man ö jiyi møøk røø ni lwötge ko okwëënyi abïïc røk moa no odööŋ yi pääny. ?Aŋø, thøø marge ba caal mar jø Icriel moi ni thööth ii no odööŋ kany ni ge koora thøø en? Beerra man jäägø ki jiy nee gïnögø joot.»
english: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.

anywaa: Køøre gena jëëdö ki jiy, ni ö nyeya ni jääŋ geni ki jïëth leny ariiø mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni ge jääŋŋe køør jø leny mo jø Aram, ni caan gø jïge, ni «Cou ni neennu gïna näk mo otägö.»
english: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.

anywaa: Køøre gena ci køør jø Aram këël mana pïïcge bäät Naam Jördan; 'ba ka adïëri møn, waŋjöö bäre bëëdö ni päŋ ka abïïe ki jap leny moa leeŋ jø Arammi piny kanya reŋge. Køøre jøøa jääŋŋi gena duuö ni caange gïna jootge jï nyeya.
english: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy aput cøø ni twierge twïër mar jø Aram. Ni ö yi rumi aciel mar møø mana pøøth ni put gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel, ni ö yïth rumme ariiø mar møk gäbci ni put gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel thuwø, ki køør dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø cäädhi ki nyeya atïïc nyeya nee dhi kiir koore; 'ba ŋatøgø aput jiyi nyørø dhi kiir, ni put thøø kaawat mana caani ya nyikuŋ Jwøki kanya ö nyeya na ö baŋe.
english: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atägö kaawat mana caani ya nyikuŋ Jwøki jï nyeya na kööe, ni «Diøø kar kany nø, yi rumi aciel mar møø mo pøøth gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel, ni møk gäbci ma yïth rumme ariiø gäte tïmö na gwel-bïrö aciel thuwø dhi kiir Cameria.»
english: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:

anywaa: Kar kaaca ŋata cäädhö ki nyeya aköö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca, ni «Gïnögø ba tägi na bäre. ?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk, da dha awëërnyeŋ mo jabe jabø maal mo cam öö ki yi gø?» Ni løgi ya Ilaaca, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jooti joodø ki waŋï, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo camï camø ri gø.»
english: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the Lord should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.

anywaa: Gïnögø aput tägö dëëre møn, ena put jiyi nyørø dhi kiir, ni ö eni ni put thøø.
english: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca acäänö ki nyijøøa wääde tïŋ maal ki yi thøø ni kööe, ni «Ö maal ni aayï ki wäädï ki jiy mo bëëdö buutï yøø, ni ciï kany mo løny ki man bëëdï yie ni ïïna wëëllö; kiper Wuuö Jwøk kännö ki meel. 'Ba meel manøgø bëëdö ki cwiiri abïriiø.»
english: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the Lord hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aput ö maal ki køør dwør nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca, ni aae ki wääde ki jiy moa bëëdö buute, ni bëëde na wëëllö yïth ŋøøp jø Pilitin ki cwiiri abïriiø.
english: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na aŋuun bïriet cwiiri, nyijøøgø aduuö ki yïth ŋøøp jø Pilitin, ni cøøe ni kwac nyeya kiper øtø mare ki pwödhö mare.
english: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, nyeya cäänö ki Gaadhi na näk ŋat tïïc mar nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca, ni kööe, ni «Beerra man caanï jammi bëët jïra moa døøŋŋø na tïïc Ilaaca.»
english: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët nyenøgø ni caana jöö mana tïŋ nyilaara no othøw maal ki gø jï nyeya, nyijøøa wääde tïŋ maal ki yi thøø aput öö ni kwac nyeya kiper øtø mare ki pwödhö mare. Ni put Gaadhi köö, ni «Wui, ï na nyeya mara, man beeye nyijøøa cääna kipere, ni man beeye wääde na tïŋ Ilaaca maal ki yi thøø.»
english: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na pëëny nyijøøgø, aput nyijøøgø caan jïre. Køøre nyeya aput cïpö ki ŋat köör aciel kiper luum nyijøøgø, ni kööe, ni «Jap nyijøøgø bëët, ki caammi moe bëët moa ciek yi pwödhö mare ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa tïŋŋe yie na wec paac këël ennø, dwøgï jïre.»
english: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aci Damacka. 'Ba kar kaaca, Ben-Adat nyeny Aram tuu; ni caani jïre ni køp, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca onø ö kany.»
english: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Ben–hadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jï Adhaël, ni «Kädï ki muuy ni ciï kuna røømmï ki nyikuŋ Jwøk, ni pëënynyï dwør Wuuö Jwøk ki eni man näk mo dëëra pïïa piny ki täw man en ni dëëra en.»
english: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the Lord by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

anywaa: Køøre Adhaël aci kuna røømme ki nyikuŋ Jwøk, ni käädö ki muuce, ni beege wïth jammi moa beyø bëët moa en Damacka mo käära athïröölli ma pïëraŋween; ni cøøe ni cuŋŋe nyïm Ilaaca ni kööe, ni «Dhaanhnhï ma Ben-Adat nyeny Aram aana jääŋ baŋï ni kööe, ni ‹?Aani, dëëra pïïa piny ki täw man en ni dëëra en?› »
english: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Ilaaca jïre, ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jïre, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, ïïni, dëërï døøa kare.› 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ee nø nyooth jïra ni ka adïëri møn, eni thøw.»
english: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the Lord hath shewed me that he shall surely die.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca jï Adhaël araŋe døc ka agäät këël mana ö Adhaëlli ni kwät waŋe. Ni ö nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Ilaaca ni put jwöŋö.
english: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhaël aköö, na «?Awuuö, ï jwöŋï kiper ŋø?» Ni løgi ya Ilaaca jïre, ni «Beeye kiper mana ŋääa gïïo reyø noo tïïyï dëët jø Icriel, noo waaŋï kwör gwøk røk moge moa teek, noo 'nägï jiy moge moa näk poot na wøpe ko opëëllö, noo gøyï obwöre moge ki piny, noo rietï yïth mään moge moa näk yïthge da jiy.»
english: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhaël aköö, ni «?A na dhaanhnhï, ni caal gwök en, gïnögø ni päl enø olønye jïra nidïï ki man tïïa gø?» Ni løgi ya Ilaaca jïre, ni «Onø nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jïra niï tïmö ni ïïna nyeya bäät jø Aram.»
english: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The Lord hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.

anywaa: Køøre ena aay buut Ilaaca ni døø baŋ nyeya mare ma Ben-Adad. 'Ba kanya ö eni na pëënynyi ya Ben-Adadi, na «?Agïnaŋø na caan Ilaaca jïrï?», ena köö, na «Acaane jïra ni ka adïëri møn, dëërï døøa kare.»
english: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, Adhaël abïï köö alwøre ni cøt gø yïth pïï, ni rïëp wï nyeya ki gø ni thøŋe, ni put nyeya thøø. Ni ö eni ni put läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïï cwiiri moa beet Jeyörammi wär Akap ni ena nyeny Icriel, ni Jøcapat beeye nyeny Juuda, Jöram o Jøcapat aläw kar wänni na nyeya.
english: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni ena nyeya, cwiiri moe pïëradäk kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri abära yi Jerucalem.
english: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc nyeye mo Icriel, kaawat moa tïïc jø dhi øt Akap, kiper nya Akap ee nywømø. Ni ö eni ni tïïe ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ba many man raany Juuda kiper dhaanhnhe ma Deebit, na kööŋe kiper gø ni eni cïpö ki dhaanhø mo dööŋ na wïc jïre røk nyïïkwaaye cooth.
english: Yet the Lord would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet Jörammi ni ena nyeya, jø Ëdöm gena gëëmö ki jø Juuda ni öge wøk tietge, ni röönyge ki nyeya kiper dëëtge keerge.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

anywaa: Køøre Jöram aci Dhair ki jïëth leny moe bëët mo wø tut okwëënyi. Ni ö jø Ëdömmi ni cielge eni dïër ki kwääc lwaae mo jïëth leny moe mo wø tut okwëënyi. 'Ba kanya tïme na dï wäär, ena ö maal ni päär wøk ki yïthakic jø Ëdöm moa näk rege ege ciel deŋge, ni ö jø lenynyi moe ni reŋge mïëcge.
english: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Ëdöm gena put bëëtö ni ge gëëmö ki jø Juuda këël dïcäŋi en. Këël jø Libana thuwø ge täga kar kaagø ka ageem.
english: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jörammi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Jöram athøw, ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit; ni ö wääde ma Akadhiya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar kurriiø moa beet Jeyörammi wär Akap nyeny Icriel ni ena nyeya, Akadhiya o Jöram nyeny Juuda atïmö na nyeya.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiiri moe beeye pïërariiø kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem ki cwiir aciel. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Athaliya nyikwaar Ømri nyeny Icriel.
english: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya abëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc jø dhi øt Akapi, ni beege gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat gïïa reyø na tïïc jø dhi øt Akapi, kiper ena cø nyey ki dhi øt Akap.
english: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the Lord, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya ena aa Ramöth-Gelät ni eni cäädhi ka Jeyöram wär Akap kiper nee këëtge ka Adhaël nyeny Aram, ni ö jø Arammi ni moocge dëër Jeyöram ki ŋwellø.
english: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramoth–gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya ma Jeyöram adøø Jedhriel kuna tuu eni ki ŋwellø mana tïïc jø Arammi dëëre Ramöth-Gelät kanya këëde ka Adhaël nyeny Aram. Ni ö Akadhiya o Jöram nyeny Juuda ni løøc piny Jedhriel kuna lïïmme baŋ Jeyöram wär Akap kiper ŋwellø mana en dëëre.
english: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca acwötö ki dhaanhø aciel røk lwaa nyïïkuk Jwøk moa therø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Lwør wïl maaw en, ni twöï abïïnï pierï, ni ciï Ramöth-Gelät.
english: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramoth–gilead:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pïïyï kaace, Jiyu o Jøcapat nyikwaar Nimci wär manynyï, ni ciï ni kälï eni wøk ki yïthakic nyïïawääte, ni kïthï gø yi thääŋ øtø mana en kuya.
english: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;

anywaa: Køøre maaw wär thii wïïe ni kööï ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Ïïna røønya na nyeya bäät jø Icriel.› Køøre nø, ïïni dhi øtø wär put jap ni reŋï; 'ba kärï ruu.»
english: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyenøgø na nyikuŋ Jwøk mo poot thiinh enø, aput ci Ramöth- Gelät.
english: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramoth–gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe, ka adïëri møn, kwääy jø leny anwäne no opï piny kanya ciel; ni kööe, «Wui, kwääy lwaa leny, aani da dwøl mo caana caanø jïrï.» 'Ba Jiyu aköö, na «?Aŋa ni cäännï rewa?» Ni kööe, «Wui, kwääy lwaa leny, beeye ïïni.»
english: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu aö maal ni ci øtø, ni ö nyikuŋ Jwøki manøgø ni thii maaw wï gø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ena köö, ni ‹Ïïna røønya ni ïïna nyeya bäät jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jø Icriel.
english: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the Lord, even over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, jø dhi øt nyeya marï ma Akap wär raanynyï, nee kwör rem jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk coola, ki kwör rem jiy 'moa bëët, a na Wuuö Jwøk, na remge køny Jedhebelli piny.
english: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the Lord, at the hand of Jezebel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø dhi øt Akap ge thøw bëët; aani cwøw bëët moa en dhi øt Akap na en dï Icriel nääa nääö, këël laaŋe.
english: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

anywaa: Ni tïïa jø dhi øt Akap ni caala jø dhi øt Jeröbäm o Nebat, ki jø dhi øt Baaca wär Akiya.
english: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:

anywaa: Ni ö guuwi ni camge Jedhebel yi ŋööm Jedhriel, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat koony eni.› » Kanyøgønø, nyikuŋ Jwøk mana thiinh dhi øtø aput jap ni put reeŋø.
english: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.

anywaa: 'Ba Jiyu aduu wøk baŋ kwääc jø leny mo nyeya mare; ni köge jïre, ni «?Bëëde nidïï? ?Aŋø, bøørøgø ööm ŋø baŋï?» 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Bäŋgø nyie. ?Teeŋ jøøgø wø caange ŋø cøøn?»
english: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, «Nyie, ïïna twöt. Caanï jïwa.» Køøre Jiyu aköö, ni «Eni gïn acaane jïra ni kööe ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Ïïna røønya na nyeya bäät jø Icriel.› »
english: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I have anointed thee king over Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, geni abïïe moge aputge gööny wøk ni laarge ge peeth bäät thudhi mar dhi øtø, nee cuŋŋe bäätge; ni koothge tuuŋ, ni kwöŋge, ni «Jiyu beeye nyeya.»
english: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jiyu o Jøcapat nyikwaar Nimci agëëmö ki Jeyöram. 'Ba kar kaaca, Jeyöram ki jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët onø ci kuna gwøkge Ramöth-Gelät cer Adhaël nyeny Aram,
english: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramoth–gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.

anywaa: ni Jeyöram onø døø Jedhriel kuna tuu eni ki ŋwellø mana kïth jø Arammi dëëre kanya këëtge ka Adhaël nyeny Aram. 'Ba Jiyu aköö jï kwääc jø leny møga, «Ni näk mou ena kura, kär dee dhaanhø mo weyu nee ree kwale ni wec pääny man ni ci kuna caan luum ageem Jedhriel.»
english: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jiyu aput aay ki jääy man wø tut okwëënyi ni ci Jedhriel, kiper Jeyöram obut piny kaace ni tuu. 'Ba Akadhiya nyeny Juuda onø ci piny kuna liim Jeyöram.
english: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat koor mana en bäät gïr koor mana en maal yi Jedhriel, eni lwaa leny mar Jiyu ajoode ni ge öö, ni rwääye, ni «Aana jïtö ki lwaa leny!» Køøre Jeyöram aköö, ni «Lwötï ki ŋat wø cäädhi ki bäät okweeny ni jääŋŋï gøøni nee røømme ki geni nee kööe, ni ‹?U ööi ka mëër?› »
english: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋat wø cäädhi ki bäät okweeny aput aay ni røømme ki geni ni kööe, ni «Nyeya aköö, ni ‹?U ööi ka mëër?› » 'Ba Jiyu aköö, ni «?Ï kïthï ŋø yie? Ö køøra.» 'Ba acaan ŋat koorri jï nyeya, ni «Ŋata jääŋŋi apïï baŋge, 'ba eni kär duuö.»
english: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya acäŋ jäägö ki dhaanhø mør ki bäät okweeny, ni ci baŋge ni kööe, ni «Nyeya aköö, ni ‹?U ööi ka mëër?› » Ni løgi ya Jiyu, ni «?Ï kïthï ŋø yie? Ö køøra.»
english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan ŋat koorri jï nyeya, ni «Ŋata jääŋŋi apïï baŋge, 'ba eni kär duuö; 'ba ŋatøce ni rïïŋi ki bäät jääy manø ni tut okweenynyi ice, rïïŋi kaamar Jiyu o Nimci, kiper eni rïïŋi ka ŋwïëc bøøl.»
english: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeyöram aköö, ni «Jiiŋŋu rou.» Køøre geni jää leny mare man wø tut okweenynyi aputge jiiŋŋø. Ni ö Jeyörammi nyeny Icriel ka Akadhiya nyeny Juuda ni tïŋge, ni ŋati man nø ena yi jääne man wø tut okweenynyi, ni cige wøk kuna røømge ki Jiyu. Ni røømge ki eni yi pwöth Naböth nyï Jedhriel.
english: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jeyörammi na joot Jiyu, ena köö, ni «?Ï ööï ka mëër, Jiyu?» 'Ba aløk Jiyu, ni «?Mëër aŋøøni, noo poode ni juu mo meru ma Jedhebel ka ajuuk moe poot thööth døc?»
english: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jeyöram jääy mare awiire ni reeŋe ni rwääye ni dwøre ena maal, ni «Wui Akadhiya, man beeye cwøk!»
english: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu atum mare aput teel døc ni këël Jeyöram ki bäät jaae; ni ö atheerø ni pööth bäät wenynye; ni ö eni ni put ninoot yi jääy mare ni thøøe.
english: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu aköö jï Bedekar ŋat köör mare, ni «Lwør eni ni leeŋï gø piny yi pwöth Naböth nyï Jedhriel. Par wïïï ki luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper wänni ma Akap kanya ö aani ki ïïni na cäädhö ki bäät okwëënyi køør Akap.
english: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the Lord laid this burden upon him;

anywaa: Kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk acäänö kiper Akap ni kööe, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, ya awääre rem Naböth ki rem wääte ajooda; 'ba aani kwör remge coola coolø dëërï yi pwöthögø.› 'Ba ennø, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, lwørï ni leeŋï eni piny yi pwödhö.»
english: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the Lord; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the Lord. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Akadhiya nyeny Juuda na joot gïna tägö, ena reeŋø ki jöör Bëëth-Agen. Ni ö Jiyu ni ŋwiec køør gø ni rwääye, ni «Këëllu eni thuwø!» Ni putge eni këël yi jääy mare waŋjöör Guur, na en buut Ibleäm. 'Ba Akadhiya areŋ Megidø ni put thøø kaace.
english: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

anywaa: Køøre ena käär jø kööre moe ki yi jääy ni kïthi Jerucalem, ni koony eni yi bwörö mare buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit.
english: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Akadhiya na nyeny Juuda, beeye kanya tïm cwiic Jeyörammi wär Akap na apaar kurciel moa beede ni ena nyeny Icriel.
english: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Jiyu Jedhriel, gïre awïny Jedhebelli, ni ö Jedhebelli ni rwøth nyeŋŋe ki gïn wø rwøth nyeŋ ki gø, ni tïïc wïïe ni mïërö, ni räŋŋe ki dha awëërnyeŋ.
english: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Jiyu dunynyö ki dhi kal, Jedhebel aput köö, «?Nyie Dhimri, ï na dïnääy na 'näk nyeya mare, dëërï jööt?»
english: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Jiyu alwïthö maal dha awëërnyeŋ ni rwääye, na «?Aŋa ni en løøa? ?Aŋa?» 'Ba jø kööre ma ariiø wala adäk gena lwïthö piny baŋe.
english: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu aköö, ni «Lëëŋu nyijøøgø piny!» Kanyøgønø, geni nyijøøgø aputge lëëŋ piny; ni ö remme ni neeker dëër øtø ki dëët okwëënyi. Ni ö Jiyu ni nyør nyijøøgø ko okwëënyi.
english: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

anywaa: 'Ba ena døny yi øt nyec ni cäme ni mädhe; køøre ena köö, ni «Cou baŋ nyijøøgø no ocienø enø ni koonynyu eni, kiper ena nyi nyeya.»
english: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cige nee eni koonyge, dëër gø kärge joodø; 'ba beeye cöön wïïe ki cuu cääthe ki cuu thäny ceŋŋe keerge na jootge.
english: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gena duuö ni caange gø jï Jiyu. Ni kö Jiyu, ni «Manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk na caane ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma Ilaaja nyï Ticbi, na kööe, ni ‹Rïŋ dëër Jedhebel ocam guuwi yi ŋööm Jedhriel;
english: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:

anywaa: ni ö rïŋ dëër Jedhebelli ni tïme kaamar wär mo oleeŋ piny yi ŋööm Jedhriel, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋec gø ni man beeye Jedhebel.› »
english: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø da jiy ma pïërabïriiø mo käla dëër Akap mo ge bëëdö Cameria. 'Ba Jiyu agöödö ki weeli ni jääŋ ge Cameria baŋ dïbwöthe mo Jedhriel, ki jø døøŋŋø, ki jiy mo wø piith jiy moa käl dëër Akap, ni kööe,
english: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ennø, kanyo pïïc wëëlö man baŋu, gøøc ni jiy moa käl dëër nyeya maru ena baŋu, ni jïïu da jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ko okwëënyi, ki pääny mana näk ogeerø ni teek, ki jap leny,
english: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;

anywaa: wäru jëëtu ki dhaanhø aciel mo beer mo orømø røk jiy moa käl dëër nyeya maru, ni cïbu gø bäät wälu, ni këëdu kiper dhi øt nyeya maru.»
english: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena lwäyö døc ni köge, ni «?Ka adïëri møn, ŋat mo kär løny jï nyeye moa na ariiø, ni beege Jeyöram nyeny Icriel ka Akadhiya nyeny Juuda, olønye jïwa nidïï?»
english: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?

anywaa: Køøre ŋata bëën paan dwøŋ, ki ŋata bëën pääny, ki jø døøŋŋø, ki jiy mo wø piith jøøa käl dëër nyeya, gena jääk baŋ Jiyu ki dwøl ni köge, ni «Waani waana jiy moï, ni gïïo caanï jïwa bëët tïïcwa tïïö; 'ba waani bäŋ dhaanhø mo røønywa na nyeya. Beerra man tïïyï mana manynyï jaak.»
english: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu acäŋ göödö ki wëëlö ni kööe, ni «Ni näk mou ena kura, ni dwøra wïnynyu wïnynyö, uuni jiy moa käl dëër nyeya maru, ŋulu wïthge wøk ni ööu baŋa ki ge yi Jedhriel diøø kar kany nø.» 'Ba jøøgø na pïërabïriiø na käl dëër nyeya yøø, ge bëëdö buut jøøa døøŋŋø na bëën pääny, na piith geni.
english: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc wëëlö manøgø baŋge, geni jøøgø na pïërabïriiø na käl dëër nyeya yøø aputge lwør ni 'näkge ge, ni  kïthge wïthge yïth gupe, ni jääŋge ge Jedhriel baŋ Jiyu.
english: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï Jiyu ni købi, ni «Geni wïth jøøa käl dëër nyeya anø kälge.» Ni kö Jiyu, ni «Lööru geni kanya ciel dhi kiir na athwöe ariiø, nee bëëtge kaace këël amöölla.»
english: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, ena ö wøk ni cuŋŋe nyïm jiy bëët ni kööe, ni «Uuni, u tøør yi thøø man. Ka adïëri møn, beeye aani na gëëmö ki nyeya mara ma Jeyöram ni nääa gø. ?'Ba jøøi ii bëët onäga ŋa?
english: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man putu gø ŋäc ni luum Wuuö Jwøk mana caane kiper jø dhi øt Akap ba maayi, kiper Wuuö Jwøk gïna näk ee nø caan ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma Ilaaja atïïe.»
english: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the Lord, which the Lord spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the Lord hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jiyu jø dhi øt Akap bëët moa no odööŋ na en Jedhriel ki jøøa døøŋŋø moe, ki jøøa näk eno ŋïyö ki geni, ki dïlämme moe, aput 'näk ge bëët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ee wiiø jïgø ni kwøw.
english: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu aö maal ni aae ni cøøa Cameria. 'Ba kanya cäädhe waŋjöö, na pïïe Bëëth-Ikid, kany wø røøm dïkwääc dïëki yie,
english: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,

anywaa: ena røømmø ki jø tuuŋ Akadhiya nyeny Juuda ni pëëny geni, ni «?Uuna jøøe?» Ni dwøkge gø, ni «Waana jø tuuŋ Akadhiya. Wa løøya piny kiper nee jööt dëël mar wäät nyeya ma Jeyöram ki jööt dëël mar wäät gwanynyø ma Jedhebel nee neenwa.»
english: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jiyu aput köö jï jiye, ni «Magu geni.» Køøre jøøgø aputge mak ni 'näkge ge bäät buur mana en Bëëth-Ikid. 'Ba kwään jøøgø beege jiy ma pïëraŋween kurriiø; ni bäŋe gø mo ee wiiø dëëtge.
english: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïŋ Jiyu kaace, ena røømmø ki Jönadap o Rëkap, ni Jönadap ööa kuna jøl eni. Ni ö Jiyu ni määth gø ni kööe jï gø, ni «?Ïïni cwïnyï aciel ki cwïnya kaawat man bëët cwïnya na aciel ki cwïnyï en?» Ni løgi ya Jönadapi, ni «Yaa, beeye kare.» Ni köö Jiyu, «Ni näk cwïnyï aciel ki cwïnya, rwää cerï baŋa.» Ni ö Jönadapi ni put cere rwaak baŋ gø, ni ö Jiyu ni put gø käl baŋe yi jääy man wø tut okweenynyi.
english: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

anywaa: Ni kö Jiyu, ni «Øøni ø aay na aciel nee gïno tïïa ki cwïnya bäre kiper Wuuö Jwøk nee neenï.» Køøre ena put aay ki eni na aciel ki yi jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi.
english: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the Lord. So they made him ride in his chariot.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe Cameria, jø dhi øt Akap bëët moa no odööŋ na en Cameria aput näk, këël mana dïïr wï Akap bäre, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaja.
english: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the Lord, which he spake to Elijah.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu jiy bëët acooŋ kanya ciel ni kööe jïge, na «Akap jwøa cwøl ni Baal atïnynye mëëth, 'ba aani Baal tïnynya tïnynyö døc ni kaala mar Akap.
english: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, cwøllu nyïïkuk Baal ge bëët, ki jø wø tïny eni bëët, ki dïlämme moe bëët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo kääŋi, kiper aani jïra da olämi mo dwøŋ mo cïba cïbö jï Baal; ni ŋato kääŋi ba kwøw.» 'Ba Jiyu gïnögø tïïe ni mare cwøk, kiper nee jø wø tïny Baal nääe.
english: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.

anywaa: Ni kö Jiyu, ni «Cwötu ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere kiper Baal.» Ni ö geni ni gøøge awaaci piny.
english: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jiyu ajääk dï Icriel bäre, ni ö jø wø tïny Baal bëët ni putge öö, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo odööŋ ni kär öö. 'Ba kanya dønyge yi øt lam mar Baal, yi øtø aput pääŋö ki mana täge ki deŋ øtø man këël mana këët deŋŋe maya.
english: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu aköö jï ŋat wø koor kar kän mar abïïk lam, ni «Kän wøk ka abïïe jï jiy mo wø tïny Baal bëët.» Ni ö ŋatøgø ni kän wøk ka abïïe jïge.
english: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu adøny yi øt Baal ge ki Jönadap o Rëkap, ni kööe jï jø wø tïny Baal, ni «Rääŋu døc, ni manynyu dëëtu, ki man näk mo bäŋ jic Wuuö Jwøk mo ena dëëtu kany, 'ba beeye uuni ni wø tïny Baal keeru na en kany.»
english: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the Lord, but the worshippers of Baal only.

anywaa: Kanyøgø  gena tägö ki man cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme møga. 'Ba Jiyu da jiy ma pïërabära mo ee nø cïp wøk ni nø caan gø jïge, ni «Ŋat wäro wec dhaanhø røk jøøi ni cïba ceŋŋu ii nee bødhe ki thøø, eni di nääö na kar ŋatøca.»
english: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni Jiyu løny ennø ki cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ena köö jï jø koor moe ki jï jø leny moe moa teek, ni «Dønynyu yi øtø, ni 'nägu geni; kär dee gø mo weyu nee duny wøk.» Kanyøgø jø koor ki jø leny moøgø jøøa tïny Baal aputge 'näk ko opëëllö, ni leeŋge dëëtge wøk, ni putge pööth thääŋ øt Baal mana en kuya.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.

anywaa: Ni kälge jenni wøk moa no ocwöth piny yi øt Baal na gïï lam, ni waaŋge ge.
english: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, gïna no otieŋø na no ocaa ri Baal atøcge, ni nyaage øt Baal piny, ni putge kar gø tïïc na øt laac këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye jöö mana ö Jiyu na raany lam mar Baal ki gø dï Icriel.
english: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jiyu raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay käre wiiø, ni beeye mana bëëde ni jiy lama nyïïrøøe moa no otïïö ki warkey na en Bëthël ki Daan.
english: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Beth–el, and that were in Dan.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jiyu, ni «Kiper mana nø tïïyï gïn mo nëëni ni beer ki jïra, ni tïïyï mana manynya ki cwïnya dëët jø dhi øt Akap, jiy moo käl dëërï, ki mano täge ki wäädï këël mano pïïe ri nyikwaar nyikwaarï, ge pïïa piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.»
english: And the Lord said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jiyu wïïe käre koorø døc ki man cäädhe ki cwïnye bäre køør ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel; eni raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, käre wiiø.
english: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the Lord God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröka beeye kanya täk Wuuö Jwøki ki man ŋun wøk ki thäk ŋøøm dëër Icriel. Ni ö Adhaëlli nyeny Aram ni bööt jø Icriel dï ŋööm Icriel bäre,
english: In those days the Lord began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;

anywaa: mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Naam Jördan, ni beeye ŋööm Gelät bäre, man wø bëët jø tuuŋ Gaati yie, ki jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca. 'Ba ŋøøpøgø tägi ka Aröör, paana en bäät waaŋ Naam Arnön, ni rwöpa ŋööm Gelät ki ŋööm Baacan bäre.
english: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jiyu bëët, këël luum teek mare, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Jiyu athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koony eni Cameria. Ni ö wääde ma Jeyöakac ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Jiyu ni ena nyeya bäät jø Icriel yi Cameria beege cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abära.
english: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Athaliya mii Akadhiya na joot gø ni wääde othøw, ena ö maal ni 'näk jiy bëët moa en dhi øt nyec.
english: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöcaba, nyi nyeya ma Jöram, cöök Akadhiya, Jöac wär Akadhiya akwäl wøk ki yïthakic wäät nyeya moa näk di nääö, ni kïth gø yi øt niine mana en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ge ki ŋata pïr gø, ni eni kana gø nee ba joot Athaliya; ni ö eni ni käri nääö këët.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaal manøgø ki ŋat pïr aput bëëtö no okanø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki cwiiri abïciel, kanya bëët Athaliya ni paac ena cere.
english: And he was with her hid in the house of the Lord six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, Jööda na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ajäägö ki jiy nee kwääc lwaa dïpe mo wø koor nyeya ki mo wø koor paan dwøŋ nee cwöl baŋe yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö eni ni tude ki luubö ki geni ni tïïc geni nee ge kööŋge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre nø, eni Jöac o nyeya ma Akadhiya anyoodhe jïge;
english: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the Lord, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the Lord, and shewed them the king's son.

anywaa: ni kööm geni ni kööe, ni «Man beeye gïno tïïyu; ki ri lwaae adäk mo wø ci baŋ koor ki cäŋ jwömö, aciel rege doo bëëdö ni koora øt nyeya,
english: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;

anywaa: ni ö acielli maya ni bëëde ni koora dhi kiir Cuur, ni ö acielli maya ni bëëde ni koora dhi kiir mana en töök jø koor, ni koora Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaae ariiø mo wø ö wøk ki bäät koor ki cäŋ jwömö, geni thuwø Øt Wuuö Jwøk dege koorø jï nyeya.
english: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the Lord about the king.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, nyeya wär cielu dïër, ni ŋati man nø jap leny moe ena cere; 'ba ŋat onyänh buutu jaak wär putu 'näk. Ni bëëdu nou cäädhi ka nyeya kany wø ci yie jaak.»
english: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gïïögø bëët aput kwääc lwaae tïïc ki køør mana ö Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na kööm geni ki ge. Ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtge ni lwør jiye moa doo ö baŋ koor ki cäŋ jwömö ki moa doo ö wøk ki bäät koor ki cäŋ jwömö, ni öge baŋ Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

anywaa: Ni ö Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni mooc kwääc lwaa dïpe ki tøøŋi ki kööt leny moa näk mo nyeya ma Deebit, na en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David's spears and shields, that were in the temple of the Lord.
