anywaa: Ni ö jø koorri ni cuŋge ni ŋati man nø jap leny moe ena cere, ni rege ege caanø ki ri Øt Jwøk ki mana täge ki jï løø bäät cwïïc këël mana këët løø bäät caam, ki deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki deŋ øtø cooth, ni nyeya ege ciel dïër.
english: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jööda, Jöac o nyeya akäl wøk, ni cïp adun nyec wï gø, ni cïp wëël ciik Jwøk jïgø; ni thïïm wï gø ki maaw ni røøny gø na nyeya. Ni ö jiyi ni paŋge ceŋge ni kwöŋge, ni «Nyeya puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!»
english: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Athaliya na wïny dööt jø koor ki dööt jiy bëët, ena put ci baŋge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba na lwïthe, ka adïëri møn, nyeya mana nyään aput joot ni cuŋŋö buut gïna näk caala dïkweeri mana en dhi Øt Jwøk, ki køør kööŋŋö marge, ni kwääc lwaae ki jø wø kooth tuŋi ena deŋŋe; ni jø paac bëët yïthge omïnnö ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi. Køøre Athaliya abïï mare aput jeec ki pänh cwïny, ni jwöŋe, ni «Wui, maru ageem öy! Maru ageem öy!»
english: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

anywaa: 'Ba Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, kwääc lwaa dïpe na näk ojierø bäät jø leny aköömme ni kööe jïge, ni «Kälu nyijøøgø wøk ki yïthakic jiy moa näk rege ege caanø; 'ba ŋato läp køør gø jaak wär putu 'näk ko opëëllö.» Kiper onø caan Dïlämi, ni «Eni kär nää yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyijøøgø aputge mak; 'ba kanya tïme ni eni pïï dhi kal man wø døny okwëënyi ki yie deŋ øt nyeya, ena put 'näk kaace.
english: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jööda aput tudö ki luubö yïthakic Wuuö Jwøk ki nyeya ki jiy, nee ge bëëtge ni gena jic Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö eni ni tude ki luubö thuwø yïthakic nyeya ki jiy.
english: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the Lord and the king and the people, that they should be the Lord's people; between the king also and the people.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët gena ci øt jwøk mar Baal, ni nyaage gø piny; ni ö gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo Baal ki gïïa no otieŋø ni ŋwaalla kïte ni tøcge ge na thäŋi; ni 'näkge Matan na näk dïlämi mar Baal nyïm gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge. 'Ba Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ acïp Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki jø gwøk gø.
english: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Jööda ni lwør kwääc lwaa dïpe, ki jø wø koor nyeya, ki jø wø koor paan dwøŋ, ki jø paac bëët; ni öge ni kälge nyeya piny ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge cura waŋjöör dhi kiir jø wø koor øt nyeya. Ni ö nyeya ni pï piny bäät wälu mar nyec.
english: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the Lord, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø paac bëët yïthge aput mïnnö, ni ö päänynyi ni neebäc, kiper mana 'näkge Athaliya ko opëëllö deŋ øt nyeya.
english: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jöaci na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe abïriiø.
english: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri moa beet Jiyu ni ena nyeny Icriel, Jöac atïmö na nyeny Juuda, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Dhibiya nyijø Bëërcïïba.
english: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zibiah of Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöac abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth nïne moa beede bëët kanya bëëde ni Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ pwönynya eni.
english: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no odööŋ keere ni käre tïïö, kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri käre raanynyø. 'Ba jiy poot bëëdö ni ge cïpö ko olämme ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met yïth kwörögø.
english: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöac aköö jï dïlämme, ni «Teeŋ gwelø man wø gäth jø gathi ki gø mo wø cïp jiyi yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk na muuce moa en kur keerge, ni beege mo wø jwäk baŋ jiy ki mo wø cïp jiyi ki met ec,
english: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the Lord, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the Lord,

anywaa: beerra man ö dïlämme ni lwørge gwel moøgø, ni ŋati man nø lwöta baŋ jøøa tïnynye; ni ö geni ni cäŋge kwöra no oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk dwøk kare ki gwetøgø, ni beeye kany wäro jootge jaak no oränynyö dëër øtø.»
english: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya tïm cwiiri na pïërariiø kurdäk moa beet Jöaci ni ena nyeya, dïlämme kwöra näk oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk poot kärge geerø.
english: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jöac, Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki dïlämme møøk acwøle, ni kööe jïge, na «?Aperŋø ni poode ni kwöra no oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk poot käru dwøk kare en? 'Ba ennø, käru kädö këët ki gwel baŋ jø wø tïnynyu; 'ba gwel moa en ceŋŋu wär putu cïp kiper nee kwöra no oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk dwøk kare ki ge.»
english: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme ajïëy ki man ba kätge ki gwel baŋ jiy, ni jïëcge ki man ba en luum dwøk kar kwöra no oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk ceŋge.
english: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ alwötö ka acanduk ni køl dhi gø, ni cïp gø buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, bäät cwïïc jï løø wø døny dhaanhe yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki yie; 'ba dïlämme mo wø koor dhi Øt Jwøk, gwel bëët mo wø cïp yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk putge ka kïth ya acanduk.
english: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the Lord: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø jootge gø ni gwel otïmö ni thööth ya acanduk, ŋat wø göör luup nyeya piny, ki Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ge wø öö ni kwaange gwel mo wø jootge Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni kïthge ge yïth opïri.
english: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lønyge ki göör kwään gwel piny, gwel moøgø acïpge ceŋ jø wø raŋ tïï Øt Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö jøøgø ni coolge ge jï dïjëëth opämi, ki jï jø geer mo wø tïïö dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the Lord: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the Lord,

anywaa: ki jï jø wø ŋäc geer ki kïte, ki jï jø wø tøk kïte; ni ö gwelli møøk ni ŋeei ki jen ki kïte mo otøø nee kwöra no oränynyö dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk cäŋ dwøk kare, këël jammi bëët moa näk omanynyø kiper man cäŋ øtø dwøk kare ki geni.
english: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the Lord, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ ogubääye mo tïïc ka gwelbïrö, ki gïï wø thooth thøøth lambae ki ge, ki kuure, ki tuŋi, ki jap paac mo tïïc ka warkey, wala mo tïïc ka gwetbïrö, mo otïïö kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki gwel moa käl yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk;
english: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the Lord bowls of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the Lord:

anywaa: kiper geni gwetøge acïpge jï jø tïïc, ni ö geni ni cäŋge Øt Wuuö Jwøk dwøk kare ki gwetøge.
english: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba geni bäŋ gïn mo ege pëënynyö baŋ jøøa cïpge gwel ceŋge kiper jöö mana coolge gwel jï jø tïïc ki gø, kiper mana tïïcge tïïc na kare.
english: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.

anywaa: 'Ba gwel mo wø joot ki ro olämme mo wø cïp kiper bääyö ki mo wø joot ki ro olämme mo wø cïp kiper raay, kär käl yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk; kiper gena mo dïlämme.
english: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the Lord: it was the priests'.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Adhaël nyeny Aram acøø ni këëde ki jø Gëth ni mak pääny manøgø; ni ö Adhaëlli ni løø nyïme Jerucalem.
english: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöac nyeny Juuda jammi bëët moa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege moa cïp kwari ma Jøcapat, ki kwari ma Jöram, ki wänni ma Akadhiya, nyec Juuda, alwøre, këël jammi moe moa näk ee cïp kur keerge, ki warkie bëët moa joot yïth kwör kän moa en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec, ni jääŋ geni baŋ Adhaël nyeny Aram. Køøre Adhaël wääth mana dee aa Jerucalem aput wec.
english: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the Lord, and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba luup tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jöaci ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba jø moa tïïö tiere aö maal ni gëëmge ki eni, ni 'näkge eni yi øtø mana no ogeerø bäät kanya no othørø ni wø cwøl na Milø, na en waŋjöör Cila.
english: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.

anywaa: Ni beege Jödhakar o Cimät ki Jödhabat o Cömär na tïïö tiere na näk eni, ni ö eni ni put thøø; ni koony eni buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit, ni ö wääde ma Amaciya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurdäk moa beet Jöaci wär Akadhiya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Jeyöakac wär Jiyu atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar ka abïriiø.
english: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ni bëëde ni tïï raay moøgø ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk awëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni cïp ge cer Adhaël nyeny Aram ki wääde ma Ben-Adat, nee wø böötge cooth cooth.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael, all their days.

anywaa: Køøre Jeyöakac Wuuö Jwøk akwaae, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny kwac mare, kiper Wuuö Jwøk caannø mana ö nyeny Aram na caan jø Icriel ki gø ajoode.
english: And Jehoahaz besought the Lord, and the Lord hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk jø Icriel amooe ki ŋat mo piem geni; ni ö geni ni öge wøk ceŋ jø Aram, ni bëëtge yïth mïëri moge kaawat mana dïkwøŋ.
english: (And the Lord gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.

anywaa: 'Ba geni raay moa tïïc jø dhi øt Jeröbämmi na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, kärge wiiø; 'ba gena bëëdö ni ge caatha køør raay moøgø. Ni ö jaadha näk otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara thuwø ni put bëëtö no ocwöth piny Cameria.
english: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi moa dööŋ jï Jeyöakac, kwäänge ba pöödhi ki kwään jiy ma pïërabïïc, ni kwään jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi ba pöödhi ka apaar, ni kwään jø leny mo wø këëdi ki piny ba pöödhi ki kume apaar, kiper gena 'näk nyeny Arammi, ni nyør geni ni ŋethge kaamar tør.
english: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jeyöakaci, këël luum teek mare, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakac athøw, ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koony eni Cameria; ni ö wääde ma Jeyöac ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abïriiø moa beet Jöaci ni ena nyeny Juuda, Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel.
english: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni raay bëët moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat, na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ba wiie, ni bëëde ni caatha køør raay moøgø.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jeyöaci, ki luum teek mare mana këëde ka Amaciya nyeny Juuda ki gø, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöac athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi Cameria buut nyec Icriel, ni ö wääde ma Jeröbäm ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Ilaaca ni tuu ki täw mana put thøø ki gø, Jeyöac nyeny Icriel aløøc piny baŋe kuna liim gø, ni jwöŋe bäät gø ni kööe, na «Awuuö, Awuuö, bee ï ni wø piem jø Icriel kaamar jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi!»
english: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaca aköö jïre, ni «Kwany atum ka athëëre.» Kanyøgø, eni atum ka athëëre akwanye.
english: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö jïre, ni «Teel atum.» Ni teel gø. Køøre Ilaaca ceŋŋe acïp bäät ceŋ nyeya.
english: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Jap dha awëërnyeŋ mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.» Ni jap gø. Køøre Ilaaca aköö, ni «Thööthï!» Ni put thööthö. Ni ö Ilaaca ni kööe, na «Atheerø manøgø nyootha gø ni jø Aram moa en ya Apëk böötï böötö ki teek Wuuö Jwøk këël mano dïïrï wïthge.»
english: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the Lord's deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca aköö, ni «Cäŋ athëëre kwanynyø.» Ni kwany ge. Ni kö Ilaaca jïre, ni «Cööp piny.» Ni cööp gø kwöre adäk ni put gø wec.
english: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaca aput wëër ki eni, ni kööe, ni «Ïïni, piny doo na iï cööbö kwöre abïïc wala abïciel; køøre nø, jø Aram diï nääö këël kanya diï wïthge dïïrö yie. 'Ba ennø, jø Aram 'nägï nääö kwöre adäk keerge.»
english: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.

anywaa: Køøre Ilaaca athøw, ni koonyi. 'Ba kar kaaca, dïtwïëte mo jø Möap ge wø ööa yi ŋööm Icriel baŋ twëër ki yi cwiir cooth.
english: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni jø Icriel kunyö ki dhaanhø, dïtwïëte ajootge, ni putge dëër dhaanhø kïth yi bwörö mar Ilaaca. 'Ba kanya ö ŋata näk othøw na gut cuu mo Ilaaca, ena put kwøw ni put cuŋŋö ki tiete.
english: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhaël nyeny Aram bëëdö ni jø Icriel ee caarø ki yïth nïne bëët moa beet Jeyöakaci ni ena nyeya.
english: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk met ec ki bäth ec mare anyoodhe jï jø Icriel, ni løø cwïnye baŋge, kiper luumma näk ee tuudö ki Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap, ni eni ba many man raany jø Icriel, wala ki man riem ge buute, këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the Lord was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Adhaëlli nyeny Aram na thøøe, wääde ma Ben-Adat aläw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben–hadad his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac päänye moa käl cer wänni ma Jeyöakac, na käl Adhaëlli ri leny, acäŋ lwørrø cer Ben- Adat wär Adhaël. Ni ö Ben-Adati ni bööti ya Jeyöaci kwöre adäk, ni ö Jeyöaci ni cäŋ päänye mo jø Icriel dwøk karge.
english: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Ben–hadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa beet Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac ni ena nyeny Icriel, Amaciya o Jöac atïmö na nyeny Juuda.
english: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiiye pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jöadan nyijø Jerucalem.
english: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Jöac bëët; 'ba ba caal moa tïïc kwari ma Deebit.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no odööŋ keere ni käre tïïö, kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri käre raanynyø. 'Ba jiy poot bëëdö ni ge cïpö ko olämme ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met yïth kwörögø.
english: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö tier nyeci mare na këët piny ennø, eni jøøa tïïö tiere na 'näk wänni kanya bëët wänni na nyeya aput 'näk.
english: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät jøøgø na dïnäge yøø käre nääö, ki køør luubö mana no ogöörö yi wëël ciik Modhe, na cem Wuuö Jwøki na kööe, ni «Wëëe ba doo nääö kiper gïïa tïïc obwöre moge, no obwöre ba doo nääö kiper gïïa tïïc wëëkge. 'Ba ŋati man nø doo thøw ni thuunhnha raaye keere.»
english: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya jø leny mo jø Ëdöm mo jïtö ki kume apaar anääe yi goor Acäbö, ni mak Cela ki leny, ni put nyeŋ gø cak ni Jökthiël, këël man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Sela by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.

anywaa: Køøre Amaciya ajäägö ki dwøl jï nyeny Icriel ma Jeyöac o Jeyöakac nyikwaar Jiyu, ni kööe, ni «Ööï nee dëëtø raŋø.»
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöac nyeny Icriel aput jääk baŋ Amaciya nyeny Juuda ki dwøl mo köö, ni «Ïïni, ï caala oŋöönö jaak mana en yi lur Libaanø, na jääk baŋ jaath mana pere leth na en yi lur Libaanø, ni kööe, ni ‹Cïp nyaarï jï wääda nee nywøme.› 'Ba kar kaagø, lää paap mo bëëdö yi lur Libaanø aput cør kaace ni put oŋöönö nyøøn piny.
english: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, jø Ëdöm anø böötï ni jït cwïnyï ka atöör. Beerra man mïn yiï ka ajiem mana jootï ni bëëdï paarï. ?Aŋø ni manynyï gïn mo  raac en, mo ïïni ki jiyï ma jø Juuda u thum ki gø?»
english: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya akweer ki man cek ïthe. Køøre Jeyöac nyeny Icriel aci baŋe; ni put wïthge nigäk ka Amaciya nyeny Juuda, ni putge këëdö kanya cwøl ni Bëëth-Camic, na en løø kur jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuda ni bööti ya jø Icrielli, ni reŋge ni ŋati man nø reŋŋa paare.
english: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.

anywaa: Køøre Jeyöac nyeny Icriel, nyeny Juuda ma Amaciya o Jöac nyikwaar Akadhiya aput mak ki tøŋ yi Bëëth-Camic, ni ci Jerucalem ni toor kiir Jerucalem piny ki mana täge ki dhi kiir mana cwøl ni Ipariem këël mana këët dhi kiir mana en gøøt; ni kanya toor piny, bär mare beeye gööye ma dïpe aŋween.
english: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth–shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeyöaci ni lwør warkie bëët, ki gwet-bïrö bëët, ki jap paac bëët moa joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa joot kwör kän moa en yi øt nyec, ni käl jiy moa maae ki tøŋ thuwø ni døø Cameria.
english: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jeyöaci, ki luum teek mare, ki luum lenye moa këële ka Amaciya nyeny Juuda, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöac athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäye ma nyec Icriel Cameria; ni ö wääde ma Jeröbämmi ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya o Jöac nyeny Juuda abëëdö ki cwiiri apaar kurbïïc køør thøw Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac nyeny Icriel.
english: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Amaciya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba da ageem maa tïïc dëër Amaciya yi Jerucalem, ni ö eni ni reŋ Lakic; 'ba gena jääk køøre Lakic ni put gø 'näk kunece.
english: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.

anywaa: Køøre rïŋ dëëre akäli ki bäät okweeny ni koonyi yi Jerucalem buut kwäye Pääny Deebit.
english: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø Juuda bëët Adhariya wär Amaciya alwørge, ni røønyge eni na nyeya kar wänni. 'Ba kar kaace Adhariya cwiiye apaar ka abïciel.
english: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.

anywaa: Ni ö Adhariya ni geer Elath ni dwøk gø tier Juuda, køør thøw wänni.
english: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar kurbïïc moa beet Amaciya o Jöac ni ena nyeny Juuda, Jeröbäm o Jeyöac atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween kurciel.
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni raay bëët moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat, na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba eni waŋkeew mar jø Icriel adwøk kare ki mana täge ki Libø-Amath këël mana këët bäät Naam Araaba, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na caane ki dhi dhaanhnhe ma nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Joona wär Amitay, nyï GëthËper.
english: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the Lord God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gath–hepher.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk caannø mar jø Icriel bëët mana leth na caan geni ki gø, ni beege jiy bëët këël laaŋe, ajoode, ni bäŋe ŋat mo kønya ge.
english: For the Lord saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk mo Wuuö Jwøk ba many gø nee wïth jø Icriel dïïre bäät piny, gena kønye ki ri Jeröbäm o Jeyöac.
english: And the Lord said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jeröbämmi, ki luum teek mare, ki luum lenye moa këële, ki luum dwøk thäk ŋøøp Damacka ka Amath, na kwøŋ bëëdö tiet nyec Juuda ki Icriel, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm athøw ni läp køør kwäcge ma nyec Icriel, ni ö wääde ma Dhekaraya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïriiø moa beet Jeröbämmi ni ena nyeny Icriel, Adhariya wär Amaciya atïmö na nyeny Juuda.
english: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar ka abïciel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërabïïc kurriiø yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jeköliya nyijø Jerucalem.
english: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Amaciya.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no odööŋ keere ni käre tïïö, kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri käre raanynyø. 'Ba jiy poot bëëdö ni ge cïpö ko olämme ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met yïth kwörögø.
english: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nyeya ajääle ni kïth dëër gø ki dhøøbø, këël aŋuun kwøw mare. Ni bëëde yi øtø kur keere, ni ö wääde ma Jötham ni put tïmö ni paandwøŋ ki paac bäre ena cere.
english: And the Lord smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Adhariya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge yi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Jötham ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abära moa beet Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Dhekaraya wär Jeröbäm atïmö na nyeny Icriel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwäde abïciel Cameria.
english: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc kwäye, ni bëëde ni raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba Calum wär Jabëc agëëmö ki Dhekaraya, ni tuk gø piny ni 'näk gø dï jiy, ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Dhekaraya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Jiyu aput thur kare na kööe, ni «Jiy moo käl dëërï, ki mano täge ki wäädï këël mano pïïe ri nyikwaar nyikwaarï, ge pïïa piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.»
english: This was the word of the Lord which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abïŋween moa beet Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Calum wär Jabëc atïmö na nyeny Icriel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwääy aciel Cameria.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

anywaa: Køøre Menaëm o Gadi atïŋŋö Tirja ni ci Cameria, ni tuk Calum wär Jabëc piny ni 'näk gø kaace, ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Calummi, këël ki luum ageem mana tïïe, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Menaëm acäŋ tïŋŋö ki Tirja, ni tuk Tipca ni raany gø ki jiy moa en yie bëët, ki mïëri moa en deŋŋe, kiper mana ö jøøgø na kweerge ki man cïpge ceŋge jïre. Ni ö eni ni riet yïth mään bëët moa näk yïthge da jiy.
english: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abïŋween moa beet Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Menaëm o Gadi atïmö na nyeny Icriel, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ni ena nyeya Cameria.
english: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beede bëët, ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba Puul nyeny Aciria aöö nee këëde ki jø Icriel, ni ö Menaëmmi ni cïpe jï Puul ki gwet-bïrö mo peek mare beeye rumme ma kuma aciel mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar kiper nee eni køny Puulli nee tier nyec mare këët piny ni teek.
english: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Menaëm gwel moøgø jwääe baŋ jø Icriel bëët moa no okwär, ni ŋati man nø jwääe ka gwet-bïrö ma pïërabïïc pïërabïïc, kiper nee cïbe jï nyeny Aciria. Køøre nyeny Aciria kär ruu këët yïth ŋøøpøgø; ena put døø.
english: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Menaëmmi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba Menaëm athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni ö wääde ma Pekaya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërabïïc moa beet Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Pekaya o Menaëm atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde ki cwiiri ariiø ni ena nyeya.
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø leny mare ma Peka o Remaliya adwätö ki jø Gelät ma pïërabïïc, ni gëëmge ki eni, ni tukge gø piny Cameria, ge ki Argøp ki Ariie, ni eni ena kar gwøk røk mana no ogeerø ni teek paan dwøŋ, ni puti ya Peka 'näk, ni ö Peka ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Pekaya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërabïïc kurriiø moa bëët Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda, Peka o Remaliya atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ni ena nyeya.
english: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni raay moa tïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay ba wiie.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa bëët Peka ni ena nyeny Icriel, Tiglat-Pilëëcër nyeny Aciria aöö ni mak päänye moa cwøl ni Ijöön, ki Abël-Bëëth-Maika, ki Janöa, ki Këdëc, ka Adhör, ki ŋööm Gelät ki ŋööm Galili, ni beeye ŋööm jø tuuŋ Naptali bäre; ni mak jiy ki tøŋ ni kïth ge ya Aciria.
english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel–beth–maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba Awcë wär Ëla agëëmö ki Peka o Remaliya, ni tuk gø piny ni 'näk gø, ni put läw kar gø na nyeya. 'Ba gïnögø atägö kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø moa bëët Jötham wär Adhariya ni ena nyeny Juuda.
english: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Peka ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri moa bëët Peka o Remaliya ni ena nyeny Icriel, beeye kanya tïm Jötham wär Adhariya ni ena nyeya Juuda.
english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kanya tïme ni ena nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jeruca nyi Dhadök.
english: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Adhariya.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna no odööŋ keere ni käre tïïö, kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri käre raanynyø. 'Ba jiy poot bëëdö ni ge cïpö ko olämme ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met yïth kwörögø. 'Ba eni dhi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana en jï maal acäŋ geerrø.
english: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jöthammi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröka beeye kanya täk Wuuö Jwøki ki man jääŋ Recin nyeny Aram, ki Peka o Remaliya nee këëtge ki jø Juuda.
english: In those days the Lord began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jötham athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge yi pääny kwari ma Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Eeyeth ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abïriiø moa beet Peka o Remaliya ni ena nyeny Icriel, beeye kanya tïm Eeyethi o Jötham na nyeny Juuda.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Eeyethi na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem. 'Ba eni kär bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, kaawat mana bëët kwari ma Deebit ni tïïya gïï mo beyø.
english: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord his God, like David his father.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni caatha køør tïïe moa tïïc nyeye mo Icriel, këël mana waaŋ wääde no olämi jï juu møøk ni eni caatha køør gïïa raac yi Wuuö Jwøki ki ge na tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïm jø Icriel.
english: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni bëëde ni cïpö ko olämme ni wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ki bäät kïte ki moa en tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny bëët.
english: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

anywaa: 'Ba Recin nyeny Aram ki Peka o Remaliya nyeny Icriel, gena ö Jerucalem nee këëtge ki Eeyeth, ni cielge gø dïër; 'ba kär løny jïge ki man tukge gø.
english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø beeye kanya ö nyeny Ëdömmi na duu Elath tier Ëdöm, ni riem jø Juuda wøk bëët moa bëëdö kaace; ni ö jø Ëdömmi ni öge Elath, ni putge bëëtö kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Eeyeth ajääk baŋ Tiglat- Pilëëcër nyeny Aciria, ni kööe, ni «Aani, aana dhaanhnhï ni näga wäädï; ö kuna kønyï aani cer nyeny Aram ki cer nyeny Icriel, ge ni këëdi ki aani en.»
english: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.

anywaa: Køøre, Eeyeth gwel-bïrö ki warkey moa joot Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki moa joot kwör kän moa en øt nyec, alwøre ni jääŋ ge baŋ nyeny Aciria na muuy.
english: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeny Aciria luum Eeyeth aput wïnynyö; ni ö eni ni put ci Damacka baŋ leny ni mac gø, ni mak jiy moa en yie ki tøŋ ni kïth ge pääny mana cwøl ni Kir; ni put Recin nyeny Aram 'näk.
english: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Eeyeth aci Damacka nee røømme ki Tiglat-Pilëëcër nyeny Aciria. 'Ba da gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo ena Damacka maa joode; ni ö eni ni jääk baŋ Uria na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki teeŋ nyi gïn mo caala gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø, ki jöö mana tïï ki gø bäre.
english: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Uriah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, dïlämi ma Uria gïn wø cïp olämme bääte aput tïïc, ki køør teeŋ nyi gïnögø mana jääŋ nyeya ma Eeyethi baŋe ki Damacka, ni put gø thöör ki tïïc kanya poode ni nyeya ma Eeyeth poot kär öö ki Damacka.
english: And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ki Damacka, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø aput joot; ni ö eni ni nyiik buut gø ni cïpe ko olämme bäät gø,
english: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

anywaa: ni waaŋ olämi mare man wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuy mare mar beel, ni thii muuy mare mar køøŋø bäät gø, ni jør remø mar olämi man wø duunni ki mëër bäät gø.
english: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na en nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk, akäl wøk ki nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk kanya en yie yïthakic gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mare mana nyään ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïp gø jï kuna en buut piny mana en bäät cwïïc ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mare mana nyään.
english: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the Lord, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the Lord, and put it on the north side of the altar.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Eeyeth, Uria na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköömme ni kööe jïgø, ni «Waaŋ olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ka amöölla, ki muuce mo beel mo abøøya, ko olämme mo nyeya mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel moe, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo jiy bëët, ki muuce mo beel moge, ki muuce mo kwøŋ moge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana dwøŋ na nyään, ni jørï remø bäre mar olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki mar olämme møga bääte. 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, tïmö ni beeye gïn pëënynya Wuuö Jwøk ki ree.»
english: And king Ahaz commanded Uriah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.

anywaa: Køøre, Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ma Uria jammi bëët moa ö nyeya ma Eeyeth na kööm eni ki ge aput tïïc.
english: Thus did Uriah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Eeyeth bööp jïëthe moa en Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni wø käär pïï ki ge akäl wøk, ni käl gïï pïï wøk bäät jïëthe, ni käl gïr pïï wøk mana dwøŋ na en bäät dhäk moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni cïp gø bäät kïte mo ocaamø.
english: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee yi nyeny Aciria tïme ni met, Eeyeth thudhi man wø bëët wälu mar nyeya bääte akäl wøk ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïëk dhi kal man wø døny nyeya yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki gø.
english: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the Lord for the king of Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Eeyethi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Eeyeth athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi buut kwäcge Pääny Deebit; ni ö wääde ma Edhekaya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar kurriiø moa beet Eeyethi ni ena nyeny Juuda, Awcë wär Ëla atïmö na nyeny Icriel Cameria, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri abïŋween.
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba moa tïïe ba caal moa tïïc nyeye mo Icriel moa kwøŋ bwödhö nyïme.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.

anywaa: 'Ba Calmanëcër nyeny Aciria aöö ni këëde ka Awcë, ni ö Awcë ni put tïmö ni ena tiere ni cïpö ka ajwäk jïgø.
english: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

anywaa: 'Ba ajoot nyeny Aciria na Awcë gëëmö, kiper Awcë ajääk baŋ Cööe nyeny Ijep ki jiy nee eni køny, ni kweere ki man cïpe ka ajwäk jï nyeny Aciria, kaawat man wø cïbe ki yi cwiir cooth. Kanyøgønø, ena mak nyeny Aciria ni kïth gø yi øt twöc.
english: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Aciria, Icriel bäre amaae, ni ci Cameria ni ciel gø dïër ki cwiiri adäk.
english: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïŋweer cwiiri moa beet Awcë ni ena nyeya, nyeny Aciria Cameria amaae, ni mak jø Icriel ki tøŋ ni kïth ge ya Aciria, ni cïp ge piny nee bëëtge ya Alay ka Abör bäät Naam Gödhan, ki yïth päänye mo jø Mëdön.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø tägi kaper mana ö jø Icrielli na tïïge ki raay dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, na käl geni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep cer Peerø nyeny Ijep. Gena bëëdö ni ge wøøra juu møøk,
english: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

anywaa: ni ge caatha køør kööŋŋe mo wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïmge, ni ge caatha køør kööŋŋe moa tïïc nyec Icrielli na pwönyge jiy ki ge.
english: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïïö ki gïï mo patha karge ki piny dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge. Ni gëëtge ki kwör lam mo ena bäät thuuri yïth päänye moge bëët kiper dëëtge, ki mana täge ki mïëri moa therø këël päänye moa døøŋŋø.
english: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the Lord their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni cööthge piny ki kïte ki jenni moa no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara kiper dëëtge na gïï lamge bäät thuuri ki tiet jen bëët moa no onigïït piny.
english: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni wääŋge ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri bëët kaawat mana wara tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïmge; ni tïïge ki gïï mo reyø ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the Lord carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the Lord to anger:

anywaa: Ni tïnyge juu møøk, ni Wuuö Jwøk oköö jïge, ni «Gïnögø kär tïïyu.»
english: For they served idols, whereof the Lord had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ki jø Juuda ge wø kööm Wuuö Jwøki köömmö ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët ki dhøk jø wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïge, ni kööe, ni «Weyu uutjïëth raay mou ni gwøgu gïïa cema ki ciik 'moa na en ri pwöc 'moa bëët moa köömma kwäyu ki gø, ni beege na jääŋŋa baŋu ki dhøk jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk.»
english: Yet the Lord testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ki jø Juuda luummögø kärge wïnynyö, ni bëëtge ni wïthge teek kaamar kwäcge, na kär Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ŋäädhö.
english: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the Lord their God.

anywaa: Ni kwierge ciik moe, ki luubö mana tuude ki kwäcge, ki luup moa cem geni ki ge. Ni tïmge ni ge caatha køør juu mo oballe jaak, ni tïmge ni bäŋ karge, ni caathge køør kööŋŋe mo wïth juurre møøk moa en deŋge, ni beege jøøa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm geni kiperge ni gïrge kär ŋwalge.
english: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the Lord had charged them, that they should not do like them.

anywaa: Ni wecge gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marge, ni leenyge warkey ni tïïcge ge na nyïïrøøe ariiø na gïï lamge kiper dëëtge, ni cööthge piny ki jaath mana no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara, na gïï lamge; ni wøørge jap maal bëët, ni tïnyge jwøa cwøl ni Baal.
english: And they left all the commandments of the Lord their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

anywaa: Ni waaŋge wäätge ki nyïïge no olämme jï juu møøk, ni tïïge ki jap adïëda, ni thööthge ki war, ni gathge dëëtge ki man tïïge ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

anywaa: Køøre, Wuuö Jwøk awëër døc ki jø Icriel, ni riem ge wøk buute, ni bäŋgø mo odööŋ; 'ba beege jø tuuŋ Juuda keerge.
english: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda thuwø, gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marge, kärge gwøø; 'ba ge bëëdö ni ge caatha køør kööŋŋe moa tïïc jø Icrielli na pwönyge jiy ki ge.
english: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the Lord their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

anywaa: Køøre, Wuuö Jwøk akweer ki nyïïkwaac Icriel bëët ni caan geni, ni cïp ge ceŋ dïtwïëte, këël mana riem ge wøk buute.
english: And the Lord rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö eni na nø cööt jø Icriel wøk ki tier nyec mar jø dhi øt Deebit, geni Jeröbäm o Nebat arøønyge na nyeya. Ni ö Jeröbämmi ni män jø Icriel ki man cääthge køør Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïc ge nee ge tïïge ki raay mo døøŋŋø døc.
english: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the Lord, and made them sin a great sin.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Icrielli ni bëëtge ni ge caatha køør raay bëët moa tïïc Jeröbämmi, ni bëëtge ni ba wecge,
english: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

anywaa: këël mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na riem ge wøk buute, kaawat mana caan gø ki dhøk jiye bëët ma nyïïkuk Jwøk. Kanyøgønø, jø Icriel aput käl ki yi ŋöömö marge ni kïth ge ya Aciria, ni putge bëëtö kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Until the Lord removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Aciria akännö ki jiy ki Babiløn ki Kuta, ka Awi, ka Amath, ki Cepar-Waym, ni kïth ge yïth päänye mo Cameria nee bëëtge kwöra wara bëët jø Icrielli yïthge; ni put Cameria tïmö na marge, ni putge bëëtö yïth päänye moe.
english: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täkge ki bëëtö kaace, gena bëëdö ni Wuuö Jwøk ba wøørge. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put ŋuuwe jääŋŋö dïge, ni ö ŋuuwe ni putge møøk dïge cam ni putge thøø.
english: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the Lord: therefore the Lord sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan jï nyeny Aciria, ni købi, ni «Juurre moa kïthï yïth päänye mo Cameria nee bëëtge yïthge, jöö man bëëtge ki gø ki Jwøk mar ŋöömmece kucge; køøre nø, Jwøk manøgø ŋuuwe ajääŋŋe dïge, ni ö ŋuuwe ni putge geni 'näk, kiper jöö man bëëtge ki gø ki Jwøk mar ŋöömmece kucge.»
english: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Aciria acïpö ki dwøl ni kööe, ni «Lwötu ki dïlämi aciel røk dïlämme moa magu ki tøŋ Cameria, nee cøøe nee bëëde kaace, nee jiy pwönynye ki jöö man bëëtge ki gø ki Jwøk mar ŋöömmece.»
english: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, dïlämi aciel røk dïlämme moa mak ki tøŋ kaace, aöö ni bëëde Bëthël kaace, ni pwöny geni ki jöö man wøørge Wuuö Jwøk ki gø.
english: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth–el, and taught them how they should fear the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre moøgø bëët ge poot tëëŋö ki juu moge yïth päänye moa bëëtge yïthge, ni cïpge geni yïth uudi kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri moa no otïïc jø Cameria.
english: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

anywaa: Ni ö jiy moa käl Babiløn ni tëëŋge ki jwøk marge ni caage gø ri jwøge ma Cuköt-Benöt, ni ö jø Kuta ni caage mana tieŋge ri Nergal, ni ö jø Amath ni caage marge ra Acima,
english: And the men of Babylon made Succoth–benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

anywaa: ni ö jø Awi ni caage moge ri Nibaath ki Tartak. Ni ö jø Cepar-Waym ni waaŋge obwöre moge no olämme jï juu moge mo wø cøøri na Adramëlëk ka Anamëlëk.
english: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø, gena tïmö ni Wuuö Jwøk wøørge wøørø thuwø, ni röönyge ki dïlämme yïthakicge mo tïïö jïge yïth uudi kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri.
english: So they feared the Lord, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, gena tïmö ni Wuuö Jwøk wøørge wøørø, ni wø cäŋge juu moge tïnynyö ki køør kööŋŋe mo wïth juurre moa kälge rege.
english: They feared the Lord, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

anywaa: 'Ba këël dïcäŋi en, jø mo bëëdö Cameria ge poot bëëdö ni ge caatha køør kööŋŋe moa dïkwøŋ, ni Wuuö Jwøk ba wøørge na adïëri, ni ge ba cäädhi køør ciik moe, ki luup ŋøl moe, ki pwöc moe, ki gïïa ceme, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, na kööm nyïïkwaac Jeekap ki ge, ŋata caae ni Icriel,
english: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the Lord, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the Lord commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

anywaa: ni beege jøøa ö Wuuö Jwøki na tude ki ge ki luubö ni kööm geni ni kööe, ni «Juu møøk kär wøørru, ni ba këëllu cøŋŋu piny jïge, ni ba tïnynyu geni, ni ba cïpu ko olämme jïge.
english: With whom the Lord had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, na käl u wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ki teek mo dwøŋ ki køør teek bada, beeye aani noo wøørru, ni beeye aani noo këëllu cøŋŋu piny jïre, ni beeye aani noo cïpu jïre ko olämme.
english: But the Lord, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.

anywaa: 'Ba ciik, ki luup ŋøl, ki pwöc, ki gïïa cema, na göör piny jïïu, beerra man magu rou ki geni, ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc cooth; ni ba wøørru juu møøk.
english: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.

anywaa: Ni ö luubö mana tuuda ki uuni, ni ba wïl wïthu ki gø, ni ba wøørru juu møøk.
english: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøu, beeye aani noo wøørru; ni beeye aani noo piem uuni ceŋ nyïïmän mou bëët.»
english: But the Lord your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa bëëdö Cameria luummögø kärge wïnynyö; 'ba gena bëëdö ni ge tïïö ki raay ki køør kööŋŋe moge moa dïkwøŋ.
english: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët wïth juurre moøgø ni Wuuö Jwøk wøørge wøørø, ge poot bëëdö ni ge tïnynya juu moge, këël mana këët ri wäätge ki nyïïkwaacge, këël dïcäŋi en.
english: So these nations feared the Lord, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moa beet Awcë wär Ëla ni ena nyeny Icriel, Edhekaya wär Eeyeth atïmö na nyeny Juuda.
english: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Abiya nyi Dhekaraya.
english: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc kwari ma Deebit.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father did.

anywaa: Eni kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri araanynye, ni tøk kïte moa no ocwöth piny na gïï lam, ni ŋøt jenni piny moa no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara. Eni thuwø thwör jwïël mana tïïc Modhe atøye ni thenh thenh, kiper atïmö ni këël ki yïth nïröka, jø Icriel ge poot wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jïgø; 'ba thwör jwïël manøgø cøøri ni Nëuctan.
english: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya abëëdö ni ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ni put bëëtö ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo caala eni røk nyec Juuda bëët moa en køøre, këël ki nyeye moa kwøŋ en nyïme.
english: He trusted in the Lord God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.

anywaa: Kiper ena bëëdö ni eno göök ri Wuuö Jwøk, ni køør Wuuö Jwøk ba wiie ki caath, ni bëëde ni gwøga ciik Wuuö Jwøk moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm Modhe ki ge.
english: For he clave to the Lord, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the Lord commanded Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ki eni, ni gïn wø tïïe cooth thura kare. Ni ö eni ni gëëme ki nyeny Aciria, ni kweere ki man tïny gø.
english: And the Lord was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni bööt jø Pilitin këël mana pïïe Geedha ki mïëri moa en deŋŋe, ni beege mïëri moa therø këël päänye moa døøŋŋø.
english: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Edhekaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, ni beeye ri bïriet cwiiri moa beet Awcë wär Ëla ni ena nyeny Icriel, Calmanëcër nyeny Aciria acøø nee këëde ki jø Icriel Cameria, ni ciel Cameria dïër.
english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na aŋuun dää cwiiri, jø Aciria Cameria amacge, ni beeye ri bïcier cwiiri moa beet Edhekaya yi nyec, ni beeye ri bïŋweer cwiiri moa beet Awcë ni ena nyeny Icriel.
english: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Aciria jø Icriel amaae ki tøŋ ni kïth ge ya Aciria, ni cïp ge piny nee bëëtge ya Alay ka Abör bäät Naam Gödhan, ki yïth päänye mo jø Mëdön.
english: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

anywaa: Gïnögø atägö kiper jø Icriel dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, kärge leŋø, ni dhalge luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki geni. Këël luup bëët moa cem Modhe, dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk, kärge leŋø, ni kärge gø kïth bäät tïïc.
english: Because they obeyed not the voice of the Lord their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Edhekaya na apaar kurŋween bäät nyec, Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria acøø ni tuk päänye mo Juuda bëët moa näk kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek, ni mak geni.
english: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya nyeny Juuda ajääk Lakic ki dwøl baŋ nyeny Aciria ni kööe, ni «Aana bääyö; beerra man aayï paara. 'Ba gïno manynyï baŋa jaak, cïba cïbö jïrï.» Kanyøgø nyeny Aciria aput cwötö bäät Edhekaya nyeny Juuda ki gwel-bïrö ma rumme ma dïpe adäk, ki warkey ma rumme ma pïëradäk mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar.
english: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

anywaa: Ni ö Edhekaya ni cïp gwel-bïrö bäre mana joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa joot kwör kän moa en yi øt nyec.
english: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the Lord, and in the treasures of the king's house.

anywaa: Kar kaaca, Edhekaya nyeny Juuda, warkey mana näk ee leeny røk odhuule mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki warkey mana näk ee leeny røk jenni mo wø gur odhuule dëëtge, akäl wøk ni cïp ge jï nyeny Aciria.
english: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the Lord, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Aciria, kwääc jø tøŋ moa cøøri ni Tartan ki Rapcaric ki Rapcakë, ki lwaa jø tøŋ mo päl, ajääŋŋe ki Lakic, nee ge cige Jerucalem baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya; ni aacge ni pïïcge deŋ Jerucalem. 'Ba kanya pïïcge, gena cuŋŋö bäät øøl pïï mana käl yi puul mana en jï maal, waŋjööra dwøŋ man wø cør pwöla mar jø peny ka abïïe.
english: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab–shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na cwølge nyeya ma Edhekaya, Eliekim wär Kilkiya na en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki Jöa wär Acaap ŋat wø par wïc ki luup, gena ö wøk baŋ jøøgø.
english: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

anywaa: Køøre Rapcakë aköö jïge, ni «Caannu jï Edhekaya ni nyeny Aciria na dwøŋ aköö, ni ‹?Ïïni, ï ŋääthï ŋø?
english: And Rab–shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ïïni, waŋï riek ki leny døc, ni jïrï da jø leny mo teek? Marï kaa waac jaak. ?Ennø, ï ŋääthï ŋa ni gëëmï ki aani en?
english: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ïïni, ï ŋäätha Ijep ni wø bëëdö kaamar abaarø ni wø laar toor ni cwøp cer dhaanhø kany wø näk mo dhaanhø kwömö ki gø. 'Ba Peerø nyeny Ijep caala abaarø manøgø ki jï jø wø ŋääth gø bëët.
english: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mo u köö jïra nou ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, aŋø, paa eni na kwör lam moe mo wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri, ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge moe, raany Edhekaya, na kööm uuni, u na jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ni lämu nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en Jerucalem keere?› »
english: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the Lord our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Rapcakë köö, ni «Ennø, beerra man gääbu dhøgu ki nyeya mara ma nyeny Aciria, naa cïpa jïïu ko okwëënyi ma kume ariiø ni näk mo løny jïïu ki man cïpu ki jiy mo cäädhi ki bäätge.
english: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, këël na näk mo u ŋäätha jø Ijep kiper jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi, olønye jïïu nidïï ki man riemmu kwääy leny aciel mana kare thiinh mar nyeya mara?
english: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni ööa kany en baŋ leny nee kany raanynya, ki jïïu naa ba ööi ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk? Beeye Wuuö Jwøk na köö jïra ni ööa paani naa këëda ki gø nee raanynya.»
english: Am I now come up without the Lord against this place to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliekim wär Kilkiya, ki Cëpna, ki Jöa gena köö jï Rapcakë, ni «Beerra man ba caanï luummögø jïwa ki dhi Ibaru, na näk dhøk marwa, ni wïnyö jï jøøi no opï piny bäät kiir ii; 'ba caanï jïwa ki dhi jø Aram, kiper wïnyö jïwa.»
english: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab–shakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba Rapcakë aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, nyeya mara na jääŋ aani, a jääŋŋe kaper nee luupi ii cara jï nyeya maru ki jïïu keeru, ni paa kiper nee wïny jøøgø no opï piny bäät kiir yøø, jø ojwør gïï mo leth ki uuni na aciel, noo cam laacdøøŋŋø moge, noo maath laac moge moa therø ki uuni na aciel?»
english: But Rab–shakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

anywaa: Kanyøgø Rapcakë aput ö maal ni rwääye ki dhi Ibaru ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal ni kööe, ni «Uuni, wïnynyu dwør nyeny Aciria na dwøŋ.
english: Then Rab–shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

anywaa: Nyeya aköö, ni ‹Uuni, kär u cøøk Edhekaya, kiper ba løny jïre ki man piem uuni cera.
english: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

anywaa: Kär nee Edhekaya tïïya uuni nee Wuuö Jwøk ŋääthu, ki køør man wø kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ø pieme piemø; ni pääny man ba ci cer nyeny Aciria.» ›
english: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

anywaa: «Kär dwør Edhekaya wïnynyu; wïnynyu dwør nyeny Aciria na köö, ni ‹Tïïyu bëëtmëër ki aani, ni ööu wøk baŋa. Køøre uuno bëëdö ni ŋati man nø opï piny paare ni cama caammi mo pwöthe ni maatha pïï moa näk ee cooŋø,
english: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:

anywaa: këël kanyo ööa noo käla uuni noo kïtha uuni yi ŋöömö mo caala ŋöömö maru, ni beeye ŋöömö mo beel ki nyïïomøki ciek yie; mo yie da caammi, ki pwöth nyïïomøki, ki jenni mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ki maar kïc; kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw, nou ba thøw.› 'Ba kany wø kö Edhekaya, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk ø pieme piemø,› kär luumme wïnynyu, kiper eni løøa wïthu wøk.
english: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The Lord will deliver us.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da jwøk røk juu mo wïth juurre, mo jiy moa bëëdö yi ŋöömme ee piemø cer nyeny Aciria?
english: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

anywaa: ?Age juuk jø Amath ki juuk jø Arpat? ?Age juuk jø Cepar-Waym ki juuk jø Ëna ki juuk jø Iwa? ?Aŋø, geni jø Cameria apiemge cera?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?

anywaa: ?A juuge moe røk juu bëët mo tiet mïëri mo jø wø bëëdö yïth ŋøøpge ege piemø cera, ni tïme ni Wuuö Jwøk jø Jerucalem pieme piemø cera en?»
english: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en bäät kiir gena bëëdö ni dhøkge ba tukge, ni bäŋ luubö mo dwøkge, kiper geno nø kööm nyeya ma Edhekaya, ni «Kär dee gïn mo dwøgu jïre.»
english: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

anywaa: Køøre Eliekim wär Kilkiya na en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ni wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki nyikugö ma Jöa wär Acaap, gena duu baŋ Edhekaya na abïïe moge ege jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni caange luup moa caan Rapcakë jïre.
english: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab–shakeh.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Edhekaya na wïny gïnögø, eni abïïe moe aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni dwøl keeca dëëre, ni døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya, Eliekim ŋata en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki jø døøŋŋø moa näk dïlämme, mo dëëtge ege döönnö ki keece ki pänh cwïny, ajääŋŋe baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth.
english: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

anywaa: Ni kö jøøgø jï Aydheea, ni «Edhekaya aköö, ni ‹Dïcäŋ man beeye dïcäŋ jwør gïï mo leth, ni beeye cäŋ ajäla, ni beeye cäŋ ataa; kiper ø caala dhaagø mo lwaar ki nyilaal, mo cøøl odhäthö jïre kiper mana näk mo dëëre jääk.
english: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

anywaa: Kanymør ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, luup bëët moa caan Rapcakë, ŋata jääŋ nyeny Aciria nee eni na Jwøa kwøw pääde, wïnynye wïnynyö, ni ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk ni jook ŋata wïny luup moøgø dhi gø. 'Ba kiper manøgønø, beerra man lämï jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper jiy moa no odööŋ ni kwøw.› »
english: It may be the Lord thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jic nyeya ma Edhekaya gena put ö baŋ Aydheea.
english: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
