anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea aköö jïge, ni «Wär caannu jï nyeya maru, ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Käru lwäyö kiper luubö mana wïnynyu, na ö jic nyeny Aciria na janyge aani ki gø.
english: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani bääte kïtha kïthö ki jwïëy, ni ö eni ni wïnye ka akøpi ni døø yi ŋöömö mare. Ni tïïa eni nee 'näk ko opëëllö yi ŋöömö mare.› »
english: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Rapcakë na wïny gø ni nyeny Aciria onø aay Lakic, ena cøø ni nwän nyeny Aciria ni këëdö ki jø Libana.
english: So Rab–shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria ni Tiraka nyeny Kuuc aö baŋ leny ki eni. Ni ö Cenakerëpi ni cäŋ jääk baŋ Edhekaya ki jiy ni kööe,
english: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär caannu jï Edhekaya nyeny Juuda, ni ‹Kär u cøøk Jwøki maru manø ni ŋääthu enø kany wø kööe ni Jerucalem ba ci cer nyeny Aciria.
english: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïna tïïc nyec Aciria yïth mïëri bëët, na raanyge ge na bäre bäre, käru wïnynyö? ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo piema uuni?
english: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïth juurre moa wïthge dïïr kwäcwa, gena piem juu moge na bëëde? ?A këël jø Gödhan, ki jø Aaren, ki jø Rëdhep, ki jø Ëden moa bëëdö Tëlacer, gena piem juu moge?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

anywaa: ?Age nyeny Amath, ki nyeny Arpat, ki nyeny Cepar-Waym, ki nyeny Ëna, ki nyeny Iwa?› »
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Edhekaya wëëlö alwøre ceŋ jiy moa jääŋŋi ni kwaan gø. Ni ö eni ni ci yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni peer gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Edhekaya ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ï ni wø nyooth ajiem-nyec marï ki yïthakic nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli, bee ï keerï na Jwø wïth buc nyeye bëët mo bäät piny, ni bee ï na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: And Hezekiah prayed before the Lord, and said, O Lord God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï, ni wïnynyï lam mara. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jap nyeŋŋï ni räŋŋï; ni wïnynyï luup Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria, na jääŋ jiy nee ï pääde, ï na Jwøa kwøw.
english: Lord, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, Lord, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.

anywaa: «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, nyeye mo Aciria wïth juurre anø thöörge ki 'näk, ni nø raanyge ŋøøp jøøgø,
english: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

anywaa: ni nø leeŋge juu mo jøøgø yi maac, kiper ge paa juu cøøn, 'ba gena gïï mo tïïc jiyi ka ceŋge, ni beege jen ki kïte jaak. 'Ba gena put nyeye mo Aciria raanynyø møn.
english: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, a kwaya ïïni, piem waani cer nyeny Aciria, nee ŋäc buc nyeye bëët mo bäät piny ni Jwøk bee ï keerï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Now therefore, O Lord our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord God, even thou only.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Aydheea wär Amöth ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ Edhekaya ni caan gø ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ena köö: Lam mana lämï kiper Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria awïnynya.»
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

anywaa: Ni dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria beeye en, ena köö, ni «Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem, na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, ïïna taae ni päät ïïni, ni keny wïïe ni buua ïïni kanya reŋï.
english: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋa nø na päätï na janynyï? ?Aŋa na kwöŋŋï bääte, na ŋuuï nyeŋŋï wøk bääte niï töödö? ?Paa bääta, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere?
english: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Ïïna ŋwöö bääta, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ki dhøk jiy moa jääŋŋï, ni kööï, ni ‹Aana ci wïth kïte maal ki jïëth leny 'moa mo thööth mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni cøøa yi lur Libaanø kuya; ni ŋøda jen moe piny moa bäyö na perge leth, ni dønynya yi lul mana cøl kuya.
english: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

anywaa: Aana kunyö ki ïïdhi yïth ŋøøp wïth juurre, ni mädha ki pïï yïthge kaace. Ni wëëga pïï talø ki tiet jø leny 'moa, ni beege pïï mo näp Ijep bëët.›
english: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, kärï wïnynyö cøøn? Gïnögø yaa nø caar ki kany mo bäär, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni caara ka ya acääŋŋe cøøn. 'Ba ennø, a wëëga gø thur kare, nee päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek nee wëëgï niruuth.
english: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa bëëdö yïthge ni tïmge ni jägö, ni ge lwäär ni wïthge laay; ni tïmge kaamar gïï mo otuy yi pwöla, kaamar luum mo mar mo otuy yi kaŋ, ki luum mo otuy wïth uudi ni wø laar waaŋ ni poot kär døøŋŋø.
english: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, bëëtö marï bäre ŋääa, ki mano täge ki ööny maal marï këël pïïn piny marï; ki døny wøk marï, ki duuö marï; këël wëër marï man wø wëërï ki aani ŋääa thuwø.
english: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper wëër mana wëërï ki aani, ka atöör marï mana jooda, aani umï gäna gänö ko obïth, ni kïtha dhiï ki nywïëny dho okweeny, ni wiira wïïï ki gø, ni dwøga ïïni ki jöö mana ööï ki yie.»
english: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Edhekaya en, man otïmö na nyuudhi jïrï; yi cwiir man u cämö ki caammi moa näk bär, ni cwiino ööi u poot cämö ki caammi moa näk bär. 'Ba ri dää cwiiri u pïïdhö ni kääu; ni pïïdhu ki jer omøki ni cammu nyïïge.
english: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw røk jø dhi øt Juuda, tietge cäŋa këët piny ni nyaacge.
english: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

anywaa: Kiper da jiy mo dööŋ mo tuula wøk ki yi Jerucalem ki bäät Kïn Dhayan. 'Ba gïnögø otïïc Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ki køør këëyö mare.
english: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk na caane kiper nyeny Aciria, ena köö, ni ‹Eni ba duny yi pääny man, ni bäŋ atheerø mo thöör yi gø kany; këël eni ba nyänh deŋ gø ni käädö ki kwöt leny, ni bäŋ ŋøøm mo di thørø deŋ kiir ki man ethge bäät kiir ki gø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

anywaa: Eni døøk ki jööra cur yi gø ni ba duny yi pääny man.
english: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, pääny man gwøa gwøø ni piema gø kiper nyeŋŋa ki nyeŋ dhaanhnha ma Deebit.› »
english: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dïwäänögø, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aci twïër mar jø Aciria, ni 'näk jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabära kurbïïc. 'Ba na päc jiyi ka amöölla cøøn, ka adïëri møn, jiy bëët aputge joot no othøw.
english: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the Lord went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria aput tïŋŋö ni døø paare Nineba, ni bëëde yie.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni eni lämö øt Nicrøk, jwøk mare, ena put wääde ma Adramëlëk ki wääde ma Carëdher 'näk ko opëëllö; ni ö geni ni reŋge yi ŋööm Ararat. Ni ö wääde ma Ëcaradön ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni, Edhekaya atïmö ni tuu ni ena um thøø. Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth aö baŋe ni kööe jïgø, ni «Man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Caan dwørï, kiper ï thøw; ï ba kwøw.› »
english: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Edhekaya nyïme aput løø ri øtø, ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööe,
english: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, par wïïï ki mana bëëda naa caatha køørï na adïëri ki cwïnya bäre, ni tïïa ki gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jïrï.» Ni ö Edhekaya ni put jwöŋö døc ni yie ee keeyø.
english: I beseech thee, O Lord, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni Aydheea poot kär døny wøk ki yi kal mana en dïër, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bääte, ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the Lord came to him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Døøgï ni caanï gø jï Edhekaya nyeny jiya, ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwaru ma Deebit, ena köö, ni ‹Lam marï awïnynya, ni jooda pï nyeŋŋï. 'Ba ennø, dëërï døøya mo jööt. 'Ba noo tïme na ri dää nïne, ï cøøa Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, bäät cwiiri moï mëënna mëënnö ki cwiiri apaar kurbïïc. 'Ba ïïni ki pääny man, u piema piemø cer nyeny Aciria; ni gwøa pääny man kiper nyeŋŋa ki nyeŋ dhaanhnha ma Deebit.› »
english: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

anywaa: Køøre Aydheea aköö, ni «Lwötu ki nyïï olämmi mo omiiø na dhøk, ni twöu gø bäät boor, nee dëëre jöönne.»
english: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya aköö jï Aydheea, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïmö na nyuudhi ki man näk mo Wuuö Jwøk dëëra dwøge kare, naa cøøa Øt Wuuö Jwøk ri dää nïne?»
english: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the Lord will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the Lord the third day?

anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea aköö, ni «Man beeye nyuudhi mano nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, mo nyootha gø ni Wuuö Jwøk gïna caane tïïe tïïö. ?A mane ni beer ki jïrï? ?Beerra man ö tïpö man wø nyooth caa ni cääth nyïm ki rumme apaar, wala døø ŋääe ki rumme apaar?»
english: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the Lord, that the Lord will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Edhekaya, ni «Jööt jï tïpö ki man cääth nyïme ki rumme apaar; 'ba beerra man døø ŋääe ki rumme apaar.»
english: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea Wuuö Jwøk akwaae, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni dwøk tïpö ŋääe ki rumme apaar ki bäät gïn wø nyooth caa mana no otïïc nyeya ma Eeyeth.
english: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the Lord: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, nyeny Babiløn ma Merödak-Baladan o Baladan ajääk baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya ki weeli ki muuy, kiper ee wïnynyö ni nyeya ma Edhekaya otuu.
english: At that time Berodach–baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya jiy moa jääŋŋi apänhnhe ki met ec, ni nyooth jammi bëët jïge moa en yi øt kän mare, ni beege gwel-bïrö, ki warkey, ki gïï wø ŋwääi wø tïïc kadø ni met, ki maaw mo pere leth, ki jap leny moe bëët, ki jammi moe bëët moa perge leth; ni bäŋ gïrpiny mo ena yi øde wala mo ena tier nyec mare mo odööŋ mo käre nyoodhø jïge.
english: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea aö baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aŋø, jøøgø ge carge ŋø? ?Ge kälge kaa?» Ni løgi ya Edhekaya, ni «Ge käla paac mo bäär døc; ge käla Babiløn.»
english: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

anywaa: Køøre Aydheea aköö, na «?Agïïaŋø na neenge yi øtø marï?» 'Ba aløk Edhekaya, ni «Jammi bëët moa en yi øda ajootge; ni bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ røk jammi 'moa moa perge leth mo kära nyoodhø jïge.»
english: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea aköö jï Edhekaya, ni «Wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö mo jammi bëët moa en yi øtø marï, ki moa no okan kwäre moï yïth uut kän ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe këël dïcäŋi en, ge jwïëa Babiløn, ni bäŋgø mo wec.
english: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaayï møøk moo käl dëërï kiree ge di maaø ki tøŋ ni dïn geni, ni tïmge na jø tïïc yi paan dwøŋ mar nyeny Babiløn.› »
english: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya aköö jï Aydheea, ni «Dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caanï beer,» kiper acaare, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni raac ree, ni näk mo da bëët-mëër ki bëëtö mo beer yïth nïne 'moa?»
english: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Edhekaya, ki luum teek mare bäre, ki jöö mana tïïc puul ki øøl mana käl pïï yi pääny ki gø, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni ö wääde ma Maneeca ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Maneeca kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërabïïc kurbïïc yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Ëpciba.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzi–bah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni caatha køør gïïa näk ec raac ki ge døc na tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïm jø Icriel.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord cast out before the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper eni kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri na raany wänni ma Edhekaya acäŋ geerrø, ni tïïe ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge jï juuk wø cwøl ni Baal, ni tëëŋe ki jenni ni caa ge ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara, kaawat mana tïïc Akapi nyeny Icriel, ni wøør jap maal ni tïny geni.
english: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïïö ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge jï juu møøk yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye øtø mana kö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyeŋŋe doo wøørø yie yi Jerucalem.
english: And he built altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

anywaa: Eni gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge atïïe yïth käälle mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk moa na ariiø jï japa en maal bëët.
english: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni waaŋ wääde no olämi, ni tïïe ki wäälli, ki jap adïëda, ni pëëny ajuuk, ki jiy mo rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ki jiy mo cäänö ki juuk piny. 'Ba ena tïïö ki gïï mo thööth døc mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

anywaa: Køøre eni jaadha näk ee tieŋø na näk ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara acwöth piny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye øda kö Wuuö Jwøki jï Deebit ki wääde ma Cølöman, ni «Jerucalem ki øtø man ni en yie en, yaa jierø ki røk kwör wø bëët wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel yïthge bëët, nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie na bäre bäre.
english: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the Lord said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jø Icriel rege gwøkge gwøø ki man kïthge luup moa cema bëët bäät tïïc, ni beege ciik bëët moa caan dhaanhnha ma Modhe jïge, aani ge ba daaa këët yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï kwäcge.»
english: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda luum Wuuö Jwøk kärge wïnynyö. Geni wïthge amaaŋ Maneeca, ni tïïge ki raay mo thööth mo kaala moa tïïc wïth juurre moa wïthge dïïr Wuuö Jwøki nyïm jø Icriel.
english: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the Lord destroyed before the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki dhøk jiye ma nyïïkuk Jwøk ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kiper mana ö Maneeca nyeny Juuda na nø tïïe ki gïï mo ec raac ki ge døc, ni tïïe ki gïï mo reyø mo kaala moa tïïc jø Amör na kwøŋ bwödhö maal nyïme, ni nø wëëk jø Juuda tïïc ki raay, ni ge lama juu moe moa no otieŋø,
english: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel en, a känna bäät jø Jerucalem ki jø Juuda ki gïn mo leth, ni ŋat wø wïny gïr gø, cwïnye bwøk.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

anywaa: Aani jø Jerucalem jääla jäälö ni tïïa ki gïn mo leth dëëtge kaawat mana tïïa dëët jø Cameria ki jø dhi øt Akap, ni cweera Jerucalem døøc kaawat man wø ö dhaanhnhe ni wø cweer athaa, ni rïëp gø piny.
english: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy 'moa moo dööŋ, ge wiia wiiø ni cïba geni ceŋ nyïïmän moge, ni mak geni ki tøŋ, ni tïmge kaamar jammi mo di twierø jï nyïïmän moge bëët,
english: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

anywaa: kiper gena bëëdö ni ge tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jïra, ni bëëtge ni ge tïïya aani naa goota ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa ö kwäcge wøk ki Ijep këël dïcäŋi en.»
english: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, Maneeca rem jiy mo thööth mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø akøny piny, këël mana ö eni ni pääŋ dï Jerucalem ki remø ki mana täge ki deŋŋe man këël mana pïïe deŋŋe maya; ni gïnögø tïïe ni meede bäät raay moe moa tïïe na wëëk jø Juuda tïïc ki raay, ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Maneeca bëët, ki raay moa tïïe, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Maneeca athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi ya ajïniina mana en buut paare, ni beeye ya ajïniina mar Udha. Ni ö wääde ma Amön ni läw kare na nyeya.
english: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Amön kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ariiø Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Meculëmët nya Arut nyï Jöthba.
english: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Maneeca.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as his father Manasseh did.

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni caatha uutjïëthe bëët moa caath wänni, ni eni tïnynya gïïa no otieŋø na gïï lam moa tïny wänni, ni wøør geni.
english: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

anywaa: 'Ba eni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, awiie, ni bëëde ni eni ba caath køør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he forsook the Lord God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre moe atudö ki luubö kipere, ni putge gø 'näk yi øtø mare.
english: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët moa tudö ki luubö bäät Amön, gena put jø paaci 'näk, ni røønyge wääde ma Jöcaya na nyeya kar gø.
english: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Amönni, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Amön akoony yi bwörö mare, ya ajïniina mar Udha, ni ö wääde ma Jöcaya ni läw kare na nyeya.
english: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöcaya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe abära, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jedida nya Adaya nyï Böckat.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöcaya abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni caatha uutjïëthe bëët moa caath kwari ma Deebit, ni käre gaa bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Jöcaya na apaar ka abära bäät nyec, eni Capan wär Adhaliya nyikwaar Meculam, ni wø göör luup akwöma piny, ajääŋŋe yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ nee gwel moa no ocïbö yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, na näk ocooŋ jø wø koor dhi Øt Jwøk baŋ jiy, nee kwaane.
english: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

anywaa: Ni ö gwetøgø ni cïbi ceŋ jø wø raŋ tïïc mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö jøøgø ni cïpge gwetøgø jï jø otïïc Øt Wuuö Jwøk, noo cäŋ kwöra no oränynyö ri Øt Wuuö Jwøk dwøk kare,
english: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the Lord, to repair the breaches of the house,

anywaa: ni beege dïjëëth opämi, ki jø geer uudi, ki jø wø ŋäc geer ki kïte. Ni ö gwelli møøk ni ŋeei ki jen ki kïte moa no otøø, nee øtø dwøk kare.
english: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋe gïn manynyu baŋ jøøa cïp gwel ceŋge kiper jöö mana coolge gwel ki gø, kiper tïïc tïïcge tïïö na kare.»
english: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

anywaa: 'Ba Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköö jï Capan ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni «Aani wëël ciik Modhe ajooda yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.» Ni ö eni ni cïp wëël ciik jï Capan, ni ö Capanni ni kwaan gø.
english: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

anywaa: Køøre Capan, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, aduu baŋ nyeya ni caan dwøl jï nyeya ni kööe, ni «Jiy moï gwel moa joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk akälge wøk ni cïpge ge jï jø wø raŋ tïï øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Luubö maya thuwø mo ocaan Capanni, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, jï nyeya beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kilkiya acïpö jïra ki wëëlö.» Ni ö eni ni kwaan wëëllögø jï nyeya.
english: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na wïny luup moa no ogöörö yi wëëllögø na wëël ciik Modhe enø, abïïe moe aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny.
english: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya, Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka Akikam o Capan, ki Akbör o Mikaya, ki Capan ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ka Acaaya ŋat köör mare, aput köömmö ni kööe,
english: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cou pëënynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk kipera ki jø Juuda bëët kiper luup moa no ogöörö yi wëël ciik man na joot en. Kiper wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk, mano liel bäätø kaamar maac, dwøŋ; kiper kwäyø luup moa en yi wëël ciik man, na no ogöör piny kiperø, kärge wïnynyö, ni kärge kïth bäät tïïc.»
english: Go ye, enquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka Akikam, ki Akbör, ki Capan, ka Acaaya, gena ci ni cäänge ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ulda, nyijø mo bëëdö thääŋ Jerucalem mana nyään. 'Ba Ulda beeye cï Calum o Tikwa nyikwaar Arac, ŋat wø koor abïïk lam.
english: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö jïge, ni «Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, ena köö ni caannu jï ŋata jääŋ uuni baŋa,
english: And she said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,

anywaa: ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, gïn mo raac kïtha bäät Jerucalem ki bäät jiy mo wø bëëdö yie, ki køør luup bëët moa no ogöörö yi wëëlö mana kwaane, eni na nyeny Juuda.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:

anywaa: Kiper aana kwierge, ni wääŋge ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï juu møøk ni ge tïïya aani naa goota ki køør tïïe bëët moa temge ki ceŋge. Kiper manøgønø, wëër mara liel bäät paani kaamar maac, ni bëëde ni ba cuŋ.›
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.

anywaa: 'Ba wär caannu jï nyeny Juuda na jääŋ uuni kuna pëënynyu Wuuö Jwøk, ni man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, kiper luupa wïnynyï, ena köö,
english: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the Lord, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;

anywaa: ni ‹Kiper mana päth cwïnyï ni dwøgï dëërï piny nyïma kanya wïnynyï luup 'moa mo jääla Jerucalem ki ge ki jø wø bëëdö yie, ni ge tïmö ni gena jøw mo cwïny pädhö ki gïrge ni geno nipäät, ni jeeyï abïïgï ki pänh cwïny, ni jwöŋï nyïma, ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, oduuru marï awïnynya.
english: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper manøgønø, ï thøw ni läpï køør kwäyu ni paac poot beer, ni koony ïïni yi bwörö marï. Japa reyø bëët moo käla bäät paani ba jootï ki waŋï.› » Køøre, jøøa jääŋŋi gena døøk ni caange luubö manøgø jï nyeya.
english: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ajääk baŋ jø døøŋŋø bëët moa en yi Jerucalem ki moa en yi ŋööm Juuda bäre, ni öge ni cooŋge rege buute.
english: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni ci yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki jø Juuda bëët ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem, ki dïlämme, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni beege jiy bëët moa kwörge therø ki moa kwörge døøŋŋø; ni ö nyeya ni kwaan luup bëët ni wïnyö jïge moa en yi wëël luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiye na joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyeya acuŋŋö buut werø mana en dhi øt Jwøk, ni tude ki luubö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee eni bëëde ni caatha køør Wuuö Jwøk, nee gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki, ki pwöc moe, ki ciik moe gwøe ki cwïnye bäre ka acaaye bäre, nee bëëde ni cäädhi ka køør luup moa no otuudö na no ogöör piny yi wëëlö manøgø. Ni ö jiyi bëët ni putge jïëy ki tut manøgø.
english: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jöcaya acïpö ki dwøl jï Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïlämme mo wø en køøre, ki jø wø koor dhi øt Wuuö Jwøk, nee jammi moa no otïïö jï juuga cøøri na Baal ka Acara, ki moa no otïïö jï jap maal, nee kälge wøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Ni kälge ge wøk, ni ö eni ni waaŋ geni töök Jerucalem yi pwöl Kidaran, ni kïth bur marge Bëthël.
english: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the Lord all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el.

anywaa: Ni riem dïlämme wøk mo wø wøør juu møøk moa no orøøny nyec Juuda nee wø wääŋge ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri yïth päänye mo Juuda ki deŋ Jerucalem. Këël dïlämme mo wø wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï Baal, ki jï cäŋ, ki dwääy, ki ceer, këël jap maal bëët, ariemme thuwø.
english: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni käl gïna no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara wøk ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni kïth gø wøk töök Jerucalem bäät waŋ Naam Kidaran, ni waaŋ gø kaace, ni guur gø na tør, ni ö tørøgø ni jøør gø bäät bwör.
english: And he brought out the grove from the house of the Lord, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni raany kwör bëëte mo cwøw mo wø tïïc tïï käp na en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø cwää määnni yie ka abïïe jï jwøa cwøl na Acara.
english: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the Lord, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

anywaa: Køøre, dïlämme bëët mo Wuuö Jwøk akäl Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda, ni raany kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ni wø wääŋ dïlämme yïthge ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, ki mana täge ki Gëba këël mana këët Bëërcïïba, ni beeye yi ŋööm Juuda bäre. Ni raany kwör lam moa en dhøk kiiri mo Jerucalem, ni beeye mana en dhi kiir Jøcua, ŋata bëën pääny manøgø, ki mana en bäät caam ki dhi kiir mana dwøŋ.
english: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beer–sheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme moa wara tïïö kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri gena mäni ki man cïpge ko olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk mana en Jerucalem; 'ba gena tïïc nee cämge ki muunni mo kär coodø ki thømmø baŋ nyïïmëëkge.
english: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.

anywaa: Jöcaya thuwø, Töpeth, kanya raac ni wø waaŋ olämme yie na en yi goor Ben-Inöm atïïe ni ba waany, nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo waaŋ wääde wala nyaare no olämi jï Mölek këët.
english: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni 'näk okwëënyi moa en dhi kiir mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk, buut øt Nathan-Mëlëk, moa no ocïp nyec Juuda jï jwøge ma cäŋ; ni ö eni ni waaŋ jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi moa no ocïbö jï jwøge ma cäŋ.
english: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the Lord, by the chamber of Nathan–melech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge moa tïïc nyeye mo Juuda wï thääŋ øtø mana geer Eeyethi wï øtø maal, ki moa tïïc Maneeca yïth käälle moa na ariiø mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, akäl nyeya ma Jöcaya wøk ni tøc ge na thäŋi, ni leeŋ thäŋi moge yi waŋ Naam Kidaran.
english: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the Lord, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni raany kwör lam moa en bäät Kïn Aranya na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Jerucalem, na näk ogeer Cølömanni nyeny Icriel jï jwøa cwøl na Actaröth, na näk yi Wuuö Jwøk raac ki gø mar jø Caydan, ki jwøa cwøl ni Kemöc, na näk yi Wuuö Jwøk raac ki gø mar jø Möap, ki jwøa cwøl ni Milköm, na näk yi Wuuö Jwøk raac ki gø mar nyïïkwaac jø Amön.
english: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

anywaa: Køøre eni kïte moa no ocwöth piny na gïï lam atøye ni thenh thenh, ni ŋøt jenni piny moa no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara, ni kïth kwörge ki cuu mo jiy.
english: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.

anywaa: Këël gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en Bëthël, ki kar lam mana en bäät thuur na no otïïc Jeröbämmi o Nebat, na wëëk jø Icriel tïïc ki raay, atoor piny. Ni waaŋ kar lam ni guur gø na tør, ni waaŋ Acara thuwø.
english: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöcaya na lwïthe, bwör moa en bäät kïdi aput joot, ni jääge ki dhaanhø ni käl cuu wøk ki yïth bwör ni waaŋ ge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni tïïya gø ni ba waany, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk na caan nyikuŋ Jwøki cøøn, kanya bëëde ni nyeya ma Jeröbäm cuŋŋö buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø dïcäŋ man wø wøør na jwøk. Køøre ena cäŋ lwïthö ni joot kïdi mana no ocwöth bäät bwörö mar nyikuŋ Jwøk mana car gïïögø dïkwøŋ.
english: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the Lord which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Manece a bwöc ŋa ni nëëni jïra ice?» 'Ba acaan jø päänynyi jïre, ni «Beeye bwöc nyikuŋ Jwøk mana ö ki Juuda na caan gïï ii ni tïïyï dëër gïn wø cïp olämme bääte man ni en Bëthël en.»
english: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Beth–el.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Wiiu eni kare; kär dee ŋat dak cuu moe.» Køøre geni cuu moe ki mo nyikuŋ Jwøk ma nyï Cameria aputge wii karge ni bäŋ ŋat mo odak ge.
english: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.

anywaa: Køøre, Jöcaya thuwø uut lam bëët moa en bäät thuuri na en yïth päänye mo Cameria, na tïïc nyeye mo Icriel ni ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote, araanynye kaamar mana raanynye Bëthël.
english: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the Lord to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beth–el.

anywaa: Ni ŋar dïlämme bëët mo wø lämö kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri na en kaace bäät gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge, ni waaŋ cuu jiy bäätge. Køøre ena døø Jerucalem.
english: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya jøw bëët aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Beerra man wøørru cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, kaawat mana gööri yi wëëlö man na mar luumma tuut en.»
english: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the Lord your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wøøri, ka adïëri møn, teeŋ cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie manøgø poot bäŋgø mo owøørø cøøn ki mana täge ki ri nïr pïëmme moa piem jø Icriel këël mana këët ri nïr nyeye bëët mo Icriel ki mo Juuda.
english: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm cwiic Jöcaya na apaar ka abära bäät nyec, beeye kanya ö cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie manøgø na wøøri jï Wuuö Jwøk Jerucalem.
english: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the Lord in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Jöcaya, ajuuk, ki jiy mo rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ki gïïa no otieŋø na gïï lam ki juu møøk, ki gïïa näk yi Wuuö Jwøk raac ki ge bëët na en yi Jerucalem ki ŋööm Juuda bäre araanynye, ni dwøga luup ciik wïïe moa no ogöör yi wëëlö mana joot Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ nyeya mo caala Jöcaya dïkwøŋ, wala mo ö køøre, mo ree ee løø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnye bäre ki jwïëye bäre ki teek mare bäre, ki køør ciik Modhe.
english: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the Lord with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye kär duuö ki wëër mare na dwøŋ na liel kaamar maac bäät jø Juuda, kiper gïïa tïïc nyeya ma Maneeca bëët na wëëk Wuuö Jwøk gootø.
english: Notwithstanding the Lord turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani jø Juuda daaa daaø buuta thuwø, kaawat mana daaa jø Icriel. Ni kwiera Jerucalem, pääny man ni yaa nø jier en, ki øt Jwøk man ni aano köö ni nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie.»
english: And the Lord said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Jöcaya ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet Jöcaya, Peerø ma Nekø nyeny Ijep aci baŋ nyeny Aciria nee këëde ki gø bäät Naam Upareeti. 'Ba nyeya ma Jöcaya aci baŋ nyeny Ijep nee këëde ki gø; 'ba kanya ö eni na jooti ya Peerø ma Nekø, ena put Peerø ma Nekø 'näk Megidø.
english: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre moe ni kälge rïŋ dëëre ki Megidø ki yi jääy man wø tut okwëënyi, ni kïthge gø Jerucalem ni koonyge gø yi bwörö mare. Køøre jø paac bëët Jeyöakac o Jöcaya alwørge, ni thïïmge wïïe ki maaw ni røønyge gø na nyeya kar wänni.
english: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakac kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurdäk, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwäde adäk yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Amutal nyi Jeremaya nyï Libana.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakac abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc kwäye bëët.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

anywaa: Ni ö Peerø Nekø ni kïth Jeyöakac øt twöc Ribala na en yi ŋööm Amath, kiper nee ba bëëde na nyeya Jerucalem; ni put cwötö ka ajwäk bäät paac, ni beege gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa, ki warkey ma rumi ma kikar aciel.
english: And Pharaoh–neco put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø Nekø, Eliekim o Jöcaya arøønye na nyeya kar wänni ma Jöcaya, ni wiil nyeŋ gø ni Jeyöakëm. 'Ba Jeyöakac akäle ni kïth gø Ijep, ni thøø kaace.
english: And Pharaoh–neco made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakëm gwel-bïrö ki warkey mana cwøl Peerø ma Nekø bääte acïbe jïgø, ni gwel-bïrö ki warkey manøgø jwääe baŋ jiy, ni ŋati man nø jwääe ka køør jammi moa en jïre.
english: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaoh–neco.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakëm kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar kurciel ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Dhebida nyi Pedaya nyï Ruma.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc kwäye.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his fathers had done.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet Jeyöakëmmi ni ena nyeya, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn amäänynyö baŋe; ni ö Jeyöakëmmi ni tïme ni bëënna eni ki cwiiri adäk. Køøre Jeyöakëm acaara mare awiile, ni gëëme ki Nabukedenecör.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk dïtwïëte mo jø Babiløn, ki mo jø Aram, ki mo jø Möap, ki mo jø Amön, ajääŋŋe baŋ Jeyöakëm, ni ge jääŋŋe kaper nee mïëc Juuda raanyge, ki køør dwøre mana caane ki dhøk jiye ma nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the Lord, which he spake by his servants the prophets.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, nee ge daae buute, gïïögø aput tägö dëët jø Juuda ki køør dwøre, e na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper raay bëët moa tïïc nyeya ma Maneeca,
english: Surely at the commandment of the Lord came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;

anywaa: këël rep jiy thuwø moa näk bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø na køny piny, na pääŋ dï Jerucalem ki remge. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk yie käre warø.
english: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jeyöakëmmi ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakëm athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni ö wääde ma Jöakin ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Ijep kär cäŋ määnynyö wøk këët ki yïth ŋøøpe, kiper nyeny Babiløn ŋøøm moa no omak nyeny Ijep bëët ee nø mak, ki mana täge ki bäät waŋ Naam Ijep këël mana këët bäät Naam Upareeti.
english: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöakin kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar ka abära, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwäde adäk yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Neucta nyi Elnathan nyï Jerucalem.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca beeye kanya ö kwääc jø leny mo Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn na cige Jerucalem na cielge gø dïër.
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

anywaa: Køøre Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn aö Jerucalem kanya bëët kwääc jø leny moe ni ge ciela pääny dïër.
english: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.

anywaa: Ni ö Jöakin nyeny Juuda ni cïp cere jï nyeny Babiløn, eni ki menni, ki jø kööre moe, ki kwääc jø leny moe, ki jiy moe moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ni puti ya nyeny Babiløn mak ki tøŋ ri bäc cwiiri moa beet nyeny Babiløn ni ena nyeya.
english: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeny Babilønni ni käl jammi moa perge leth bëët kaace moa no okanø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa no okanø yi øt nyeya, ni ŋør jap paac bëët moa näk tïïc ka warkey na tïïc Cølömanni nyeny Icriel yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba gïïögø atägö kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the Lord, as the Lord had said.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni käl jø Jerucalem bëët, ni beege kwääc jø leny bëët, ki jø mo kwörge døøŋŋø bëët, ki rëëmme bëët, ni bäŋe jiy mo ee wiiø; ni jøøgø bëët jïtö ki kar kume apaar; 'ba beege jøøa can døc keerge na bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø na wiie.
english: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöakin käle ka menni na aciel, ki määre, ki jiy moe moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki dïbwöthe mo wø käär paac, ni ge käle Jerucalem ni kïth ge Babiløn.
english: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët moa teek ma kume abïriiø, ki rëëmme ma kuma aciel, ki jiy bëët moa teek na näk orømø ki leny ni kïth ge Babiløn.
english: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn Mataniya cöök wää Jöakin arøønye na nyeya kar Jöakin, ni wiil nyeŋ gø ni Cëdëkiya.
english: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëdëkiya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurciel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar kurciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Amutal nyi Jeremaya nyï Libana.
english: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc Jeyöakëmmi.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ki køør gïïa reyø moa tïïc jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki geni ni riem geni wøk nyïme.
english: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëdëkiya agëëmö ki nyeny Babiløn. 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïŋweer cwiiri moa beede ni ena nyeya, kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar na apaar, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn ki jø leny moe bëët aö töök Jerucalem, ni tïïe ki twïër töök gø, ni tïïc kwör koor töök gø bäre.
english: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.

anywaa: Ni bëët päänynyi no ociel dïër këël mana këët ri cwiiri apaar kurciel moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeya.
english: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiinøgø, kanya tïm nïr dwää aŋweenni na abïŋween, käc atïmö ni dwøŋ døc yi pääny, ni tïme ni bäŋ cam jï jiy.
english: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.

anywaa: Køøre, kiir mar pääny atuc jø Babilønni. Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët mo Juuda ni bwøkge ki wäär ni ge cøra dhi kiir mana en yïthakic kiiri moa na ariiø na en buut ajïniin nyeya, këël na bëëde ni jø Babiløn pääny ege ciel dïër bäre. Ni aacge ni ge coonya goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba.
english: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldeans were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Babiløn aläp køør nyeya ma Cëdëkiya, ni maage gø pwöl Jerikö, ni keeth jø lenynyi moe bëët buute.
english: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.

anywaa: Køøre ena makge ni kälge eni Ribala baŋ nyeny Babiløn, ni ö nyeny Babilønni ni ŋut bäät gø ki luubö.
english: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.

anywaa: Ni ŋarge wäät Cëdëkiya ni nëënö jï Cëdëkiya; ni tuunyge nyeŋ Cëdëkiya, ni twöcge gø ko oguudi ma jwëëlli, ni kïthge gø Babiløn.
english: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abïŋween moa beet Nabukedenecörri ni ena nyeny Babiløn, kanya tïm nïr dwää abïïc na abïriiø, Nabucaradan kwääy jø koor, mo tïïö tier nyeny Babiløn, aö Jerucalem.
english: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar–adan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:

anywaa: Ni waaŋ Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki paan dwøŋ mar nyeya, ki uudi moa en Jerucalem bëët; këël uudi moa døøŋŋø bëët awaaŋe thuwø.
english: And he burnt the house of the Lord, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët mo jø Babiløn moa käär kwääy jø koorri ni toorge kiir Jerucalem piny.
english: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa no odööŋ yi pääny, ki jiy moa cïp ceŋge jï nyeny Babiløn, ki jiy moa thööth na en yi ŋöömmögø bëët ni käli ya Nabucaradan kwääy jø koor ni maae ka tøŋ.
english: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carry away.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø koor, jiy møøk moa can døc na en yi ŋöömmögø awiie na jø piith omøki na jø puur pwöth.
english: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na en yi øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege gïïa näk caala dïkweeye, ki jïëthe mo wø käär pïï ki geni, ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, atøc jø lenynyi mo Babiløn na thäŋi ni kïthge nywïëny moøgø na jwëëlli yøø Babiløn.
english: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.

anywaa: Ni kälge jammi moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni beege athääe, ka akaape, ki gïï wø näk mäc lambae ki geni, ka apät, ki jap paac møga bëët mo wø tïïö ki geni Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø koor thuwø, athääe mo wø käär mäc ki geni ki kuure moa näk tïïc ka warkey mo tøŋ ki moa näk tïïc ki gwel-bïrö mo tøŋ akäle.
english: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa na ariiø na näk caala dïkweeye, ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, ki jïëthe mo wø käär pïï ki geni moa tïïc Cølömanni kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk, peek nywïënyö mana näk jwïël mana tïïc geni bëët ki gø ba løny ki røm.
english: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar gïïögø ni caal dïkweeye yøø, man nø beeye gööye apaar ka abära, ni gïr mïërö mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël ocïp bääte. 'Ba bär mar gïr mïërö manøgø beeye gööye adäk, ni gïna näk caala tiimme ki nyïïadïkwäle mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël owïr deŋ gïr mïërö manøgø bäre. 'Ba riet gïr mïërö mana näk caala dïkweeri otïïö ni caala manøgø thuwø.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø koor, Ceraya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jepaniya dïlämi mana en køøre, ki jiy adäk moa koor dhi Øt Wuuö Jwøk amaae ki tøŋ.
english: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni mak ŋat köör aciel man wø raŋ jø leny, ki jiy abïïc mo wø køny nyeya ka acaare moa joot yi pääny, ki ŋat wø gööt piny ki luup jï kwääy jø tøŋ man wø kïth jiy yi dëëc paanøgø, ki jø paanøgø ma pïërabïciel moa joot yi päänyögø.
english: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

anywaa: Ni ö Nabucaradanni kwääy jø koor ni lwør jøøgø ni kïth geni Ribala baŋ nyeny Babiløn.
english: And Nebuzar–adan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn jøøgø anääe Ribala, päänya en yi ŋööm Amath. Manøgø beeye jöö mana ö jø Juuda ni käl ge yi ŋöömö marge ni ge mak ki tøŋ.
english: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, Gedaliya wär Akikam nyikwaar Capan atïïe na wïth jiy moa wiie yi ŋööm jø Juuda.
english: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc jø tøŋ mo jø Juuda moa näk ceŋge kärge cïbö, ki jiy moge, na wïnyge gø ni Gedaliya anø røøny nyeny Babilønni na wïth jiy, gena ö Micpa baŋ Gedaliya, ni kwääc jø tøŋ moa öö beege Icmiel o Nethaniya, ki Jöanan o Karëa, ki Ceraya o Tanumët nyï Nethöpa, ki Jaadhania o nyï Maika.
english: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

anywaa: Køøre Gedaliya akööŋ jïge ki jicge ni kööe jïge, ni «Käru lwäyö ki jø kööre mo jø Babiløn. 'Ba bëëdu yi ŋöömö man, ni tïnynyu nyeny Babiløn; køøre bëëtö maru tïmö ni beer.»
english: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dwää abïriiø, Icmiel o Nethaniya nyikwaar Elicama na käl ri jø dhi øt nyec, aöö ki jiy apaar ni cwøp Gedaliya piny ni 'näk gø ki jø Juuda ki jø Babiløn moa bëëdö ki eni Micpa.
english: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

anywaa: Køøre jø Juuda bëët moa kwörge therø ki moa kwörge døøŋŋø ki kwääc jø leny aö maal ni cige Ijep, kiper gena lwäyö ki jø Babiløn.
english: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiiri na pïëradäk ka abïriiø moa mak Jöakin nyeny Juuda ki tøŋ yie na kïthi Babiløn, kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar kurriiø ni pïërariiø ka abïriiø, Ëwil-Merödak nyeny Babiløn Jöakin nyeny Juuda apäde. 'Ba gïnögø atïïe yi cwiina tïme yie ni ena nyeya.
english: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evil–merodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;

anywaa: Ni cääne ki luubö mo beer ki gø, ni tïïc wälu mare ni pöödha eni ki mo nyeye møga moa bëëdö ki eni Babiløn.
english: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;

anywaa: 'Ba Jöakin abïïe moa en dëëre øt twöc awiile, ni bëëde ni cämö buut nyeya cooth ki ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët,
english: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.

anywaa: ni bëët cammi mare mar yi cäŋ cooth ni cïpa nyeya jïre ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët.
english: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.

anywaa: Adam beeye wää Cëth, ni ö Cëthi ni näk wää Ënöc, ni ö Ënöci ni näk wää Keenan, ni ö Keenanni ni näk wää Maalalel, ni ö Maalalelli ni näk wää Jaret, ni ö Jareti ni näk wää Inøk, ni ö Inøki ni näk wää Mathucala, ni ö Mathucala ni näk wää Lamek, ni ö Lameki ni näk wää Nöa.
Ni ö Nöa ni näk wää Cëm ki Kaam ki Jaapeth.
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jaapeth beege Gömër, ki Magöök, ki Madë, ki Jawan, ki Tubal, ki Möcak, ki Tëra.
english: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

anywaa: Ni wäät Gömër beege Ackena, ki Ripath, ki Tögarma.
english: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Jawanni ni näkge beege Elica, ki Tarcëc, ki Kitim, ki Rödanim.
english: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Kaam beege Kuuc, ki Micram, ki Put, ki Keenan.
english: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

anywaa: Ni wäät Kuuc beege Ceba, ki Ëwlath, ki Cabta, ki Raama, ki Cabteka; ni ö wäät Raama ni näkge beege Cïïba ki Didan.
english: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.

anywaa: Køøre Kuuc Namrut anywøle, ni ö Namruti ni tïme ni beeye ŋata kwøŋ bëëtö no oteeø bäät piny.
english: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba Micram beeye na kwar jø Ludim, ki jø Anamim, ki jø Laabim, ki jø Neptalëm,
english: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

anywaa: ki jø Petruc, ki jø Kaclu, ki jø Kaptör, na näk jøøa käl jø Pilitinni dëëtge.
english: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphtorim.

anywaa: Keenan wääde ma Caydan na näk kanynye anywøle, ni nywøl Këth thuwø.
english: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

anywaa: 'Ba jø Jeebuc ki jø Amör, ki jø Gërgëca,
english: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

anywaa: ki jø Ëwi, ki jø Aruk, ki jø Cini,
english: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

anywaa: ki jø Arbat,  ki jø Dhemari, ki jø Amath, jøøgø bëët käla dëër Keenan.
english: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cëm beege Ilam, ki Acör, ki Arpakat, ki Lut, ka Aram, ki Uc, ki Uul, ki Gëthër, ki Möcak.
english: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.

anywaa: Ni ö Arpakat ni nywøl Ceela, ni ö Ceela ni nywøl Eber.
english: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.

anywaa: Ni ö Eberri ni nyööte ki wääte ariiø, ni nyeŋ wääde maya cwøl ni Pelek, kiper na tïme na ree kar kaaca jiy akeethø dï piny; ni ö nyeŋ coki ni cwøli ni Jöktan.
english: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.

anywaa: Ni ö Jöktanni ni nywøl Almödat, ki Calëp, ki Acremöt, ki Jerak,
english: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

anywaa: ka Adöram, ki Udhal, ki Dekla,
english: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,

anywaa: ki Ëbal, ka Abimaal, ki Cïïba,
english: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

anywaa: ko Öpïr, ki Ëwlath, ki Jöbap. Jøøgø bëët beege wäät Jöktan.
english: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëm beeye wää Arpakat. Ni ö Arpakati ni näk wää Ceela,
english: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

anywaa: ni ö Ceela ni näk wää Eber, ni ö Eberri ni näk wää Pelek, ni ö Peleki ni näk wää Reew,
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

anywaa: ni ö Reewi ni näk wää Ceeruk, ni ö Ceeruki ni näk wää Neeyör, ni ö Neeyörri ni näk wää Teera,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

anywaa: ni ö Teera ni näk wää Abram, ni beeye Abram mana cwøl ni Eeberam. Luum Nyïïkwaac Eeberam
english: Abram; the same is Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Eeberam beege Aydhak ki Icmiel.
english: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa käl dëër Icmiel beege: Nebayöt na näk kanynye, ki Këdar, ka Adebiel, ki Mepcam,
english: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

anywaa: ki Macma, ki Duma, ki Maca, ka Adat, ki Tëma,
english: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

anywaa: ki Jetur, ki Napëc, ki Këdema; moøgø beege nyeŋ wäät Icmiel.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Eeberam moa nywøle ki Këthura, cïïe mana näk akwanya, beege: Dhemran, ki Jökcan, ki Mëdan, ki Midien, ki Ecbök ki Cuwëk. Ni wäät Jökcanni beege Cïïba ki Didan.
english: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Midienni ni näkge beege Gëpër, ki Ëpër, ki Anök, ki Abida, ki Eldaa. Jøøgø bëët beege jiy moa käl dëër Këthura.
english: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam beeye wää Aydhak; ni wäät Aydhak beege Icøø ki Icriel.
english: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Icøø ni näkge beege Elipath, ki Raguël, ki Jeuc, ki Jalam, ki Köra.
english: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Elipath beege Tëman, ki Omar, ki Dhepø, ki Götöm, ki Kënec, ki wääde ma Amalëk mana nywøle ki cïïe ma Timna.
english: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Raguëlli ni näkge beege Naath, ki Dheera, ki Cimia, ki Midha.
english: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cëër beege Löthan, ki Cöbal, ki Dhibøn, ki Ana, ki Dicön, ki Ëdhör, ki Dican.
english: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Löthan beege Ori ki Ëmam. 'Ba cöök Löthanni mana näk dhaagø nyeŋŋe beeye Timna.
english: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cöbal beege Alwan, ki Manëat, ki Ëbal, ki Cipø, ki Önam. 'Ba wäät Dhibøn beege Aya ki Ana.
english: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.

anywaa: 'Ba wär Ana beeye Dicön. Ni wäät Dicön beege Ëmdan, ki Ëcban, ki Ithran, ki Kiran.
english: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ëdhör beege Bilaan ki Dhaawan, ka Akan. Ni wäät Dican beege Uc ka Aran.
english: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye moa en teeki ceŋge yi ŋööm Ëdöm kanya poode ni poot bäŋ nyeya mo bëën jø Icrielli beege ii: Nyeŋ nyeya mana dïkwøŋ beeye Bëla o Beeyör, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl ni Dinaaba.
english: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

anywaa: Køøre Bëla athøw; ni ö Jöbap o Dheera nyï Bödhra ni tïme na nyeya kar gø.
english: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Jöbap athøw; ni ö Ëcam nyï po jø Tëman ni tïme na nyeya kar Jöbap.
english: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Ëcam athøw; ni ö Adati o Badat, ŋata dïïm jø Midien yïth ŋøøp jø Möap, ni tïme na nyeya kar Ëcam, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl na Awit.
english: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

anywaa: Køøre Adat athøw; ni ö Camla nyï Mecrëka ni tïme na nyeya kar Adat.
english: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Camla athøw; ni ö Caulli nyï Rööböth, paana en bäät Naam Upareeti, ni tïme na nyeya kar Camla.
english: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Caul athøw; ni ö Baal-Anan wär Akbör ni tïme na nyeya kar Caul.
english: And when Shaul was dead, Baal–hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Baal-Anan wär Akbör athøw; ni ö Adati ni tïme na nyeya kar Baal- Anan, ni nyeŋ pääny mare cwøl ni Pai; ni nyeŋ cïïe beeye Meethabël, nyi Methrët na näk nyi Mëdhaap.
english: And when Baal–hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

anywaa: Køøre Adat athøw. 'Ba nyeŋ kwääri mo Ëdöm beege Timna, ka Alia, ki Jethëth,
english: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

anywaa: ka Aalibama, ki Ëla, ki Pinön,
english: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

anywaa: ki Kënec, ki Tëman, ki Mibcar,
english: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

anywaa: ki Magdiel, ki Iram. Jøøgø beege kwääri mo Ëdöm.
english: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.

anywaa: Wäät Icriel beege Ruben, ki Cimien, ki Libay, ki Juuda, ki Icakar, ki Dhebulan,
english: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

anywaa: ki Daan, ki Jocep, ki Benjamen, ki Naptali, ki Gaat, ka Acer.
english: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Juuda ni näkge beege Er, ki Önan, ki Ceela. 'Ba wäät Juuda moø na adäk yøø nywøle ka cïïe ma nyi jø Keenan mo nyeŋŋe Bath- Cëwa. 'Ba Er na näk kany Juuda, ena ŋat raay ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; køøre ena wëëk Wuuö Jwøki thøø.
english: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.

anywaa: Ni ö Juuda ni cäŋ nyöötö ki cï nyaare ma Tamar ko obwöre ariiø, ni beege Peereth ki Dheera. Køøre obwöre moe bëët atïmö na abïïc.
english: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Peerethi ni näkge beege Eedharan ka Amul.
english: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.

anywaa: 'Ba Dheera jïre da wääte abïïc, ni beege Dhimri, ki Ëtan, ki Ëman, ki Kalköl, ki Dara.
english: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.

anywaa: 'Ba Karmi wääde beeye Akar, ni beeye Akar mana jääl jø Icriel ki køøre kiper mana lwöte røk gïïa wëëk geni nee raanyge na bäre.
english: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

anywaa: 'Ba Ëtan wääde beeye Adhariya.
english: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Eedharan moa nywøle beege Jeramiel, ki Ram ki Kalëp.
english: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

anywaa: Ram beeye wää Aminadap, ni ö Aminadapi ni näk wää Nacøn, ni beeye Nacøn mana bëëdö na bwödhi mar wäät Juuda.
english: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

anywaa: Ni ö Nacønni manøgø ni näk wää Calma, ni ö Calma ni näk wää Böeeth,
english: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,

anywaa: ni ö Böeethi ni näk wää Obet, ni ö Obeti ni näk wää Jeci.
english: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

anywaa: Ni ö Jeci ni näk wää Eliap, ni Eliap beeye kanynye, ni rietge beeye Abinadap, ni dääge beeye Cimia,
english: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

anywaa: ni ŋweerge beeye Natanel, ni bïïge beeye Raday,
english: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

anywaa: ni bïcierge beeye Ojem, ni bïrietge beeye Deebit.
english: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmenni moa näk mään beege Dheruya ka Abigël. 'Ba wäät Dheruya moa na adäk beege Abicay, ki Jöap, ka Acaël.
english: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.

anywaa: Abigël Amaaca anywøle. Wää Amaaca cø Abigël beeye Jether na käl ri tuuŋ Icmiel.
english: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kalëp wär Eedharan nyaare ma Jerøt anywøle ki cïïe ma Adhuba. Ni ö Jerøti ni nywøl Jecer, ki Cöbap, ka Ardøn.
english: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thøw Adhuba, Kalëp Eperath anywøme, ni nywøl wääde ma Ur ki gø.
english: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.

anywaa: Ur beeye wää Uri, ni ö Uri ni näk wää Bacaliil.
english: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
