anywaa: Kanyøgø Eedharan aci baŋ nyi Makir wää Gelät, ni nywøm gø ni cwiic dööŋö moe oløny na pïërabïciel, ni nywøl wääde ma Cegup ki nyaanøgø.
english: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.

anywaa: Cegup beeye wää Jayer, ni beeye Jayer mana käär päänye moa näk pïërariiø ka adäk yi ŋööm Gelät.
english: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba Gëcur ka Aram, Mïëc Jayer ki Kënat ka atude moa en tiere amacge. Ni beege päänye ma pïërabïciel bëët moa bëët nyïïkwaac Makir wää Gelät yïthge.
english: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thøw Eedharanni yi paana cwøl ni Kalëp-Eeparata, cïïe ma Abaaja yie da dhaanhø, ni nywøl gø na dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø na Acuur, ni beeye Acuur mana näk wää Tëköa.
english: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb–ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jeramiel na näk kany Eedharan beeye Ram na näk kanynye, køøre ki Buna, ko Oren, ko Ojem ka Akiya.
english: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeramiel da cïïe mør thuwø mo nyeŋŋe Atara, dhaaŋŋa näk mii wääde ma Önam.
english: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ram na näk kany Jeramiel beege Maac, ki Jamin, ki Eker.
english: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Önam beege Camaay ki Jada. Ni wäät Camaay beege Nadap ka Abicur.
english: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.

anywaa: Nyeŋ cï Abicur beeye Abikael, ni beeye dhaaŋŋa nywøl wääde ma Akban ki gø, ki wääde ma Mölet.
english: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Nadap beege Cëlët ka Apayim. 'Ba Cëlët athøw ni bäŋ obwöre mo ee nywølø.
english: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.

anywaa: Apayim wääde beeye Ici, ni ö Ici ni näk wää Cëcan, ni ö Cëcanni ni näk wää Akilay.
english: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jada na näk cöök Camaay beege Jether ki Jönathan. 'Ba Jether athøw ni bäŋ obwöre mo ee nywølø.
english: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jönathan beege Paalet ki Jaja. Moøgøøni beege nyïïkwaac Jeramiel.
english: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

anywaa: Cëcan obwöre moe beege mään keerge ni bäŋ cwøw. 'Ba eni jïre da ŋat tïïc ma dïcwøø ma nyï Ijep mo nyeŋŋe Jaara.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëcan nyaare aciel awëëk ŋat tïïc mare manøgø ni nywøm gø. Ni ö nyaare ni jïte ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø ki nyenøgø; ni cak nyeŋŋe na Attay.
english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.

anywaa: Attay beeye wää Nathan, ni ö Nathanni ni näk wää Dhabat,
english: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

anywaa: ni ö Dhabati ni näk wää Eplal, ni ö Eplalli ni näk wää Obet,
english: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

anywaa: ni ö Obeti ni näk wää Jiyu, ni ö Jiyu ni näk wää Adhariya,
english: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

anywaa: ni ö Adhariya ni näk wää Këleth, ni ö Këlethi ni näk wää Eliaca,
english: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

anywaa: ni ö Eliaca ni näk wää Cicmaay, ni ö Cicmaay ni näk wää Calum,
english: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,

anywaa: ni ö Calummi ni näk wää Jekamiya, ni ö Jekamiya ni näk wää Elicama.
english: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

anywaa: 'Ba Kalëp cöök Jeramiel, wääde mana näk kaa beeye Macë, ni Macë beeye wää Dhip, ni Dhip beeye wää Marëca, ni Marëca beeye wää Keeprön.
english: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Keeprön beege Köra, ki Tapuwa, ki Rekem ki Cema.
english: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

anywaa: Cema beeye wää Rakam, ni Rakam beeye wää Jørkem; 'ba Rekem beeye wää Camaay.
english: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.

anywaa: Camaay wääde beeye Maøn, ni Maøn beeye wää Bëëth-Cur.
english: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth–zur.

anywaa: Wäät Kalëp moa nywøle ki cïïe ma Gëpër mana na akwanya beege Aaren, ki Möja, ki Gajec. Aaren beeye wää Gajec.
english: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.

anywaa: Wäät Jaday beege Regem, ki Jötham, ki Gëcan, ki Pelet, ki Gëpër, ki Caap.
english: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

anywaa: Wäät Kalëp moa nywøle ki cïïe ma Maika mana na akwanya beege Ceber ki Tirana.
english: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.

anywaa: Maika manøgø beeye nyaana nywøl Caap ki Cewa. Caap beeye wää Matmana; ni ö Cewa thuwø ni näk wää Makbena ki Gibia. 'Ba Kalëp da nyaare ma dhaagø thuwø mo cwøl ni Akca.
english: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

anywaa: Jøøgøøni beege nyïïkwaac Kalëp. 'Ba Ur kany Eeparata wääte bee Cöbal wää Kiriat-Jeerim,
english: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim,

anywaa: ki Calma wää Bethelem, ka Arëp wää Bëëth-Gader.
english: Salma the father of Beth–lehem, Hareph the father of Beth–gader.

anywaa: 'Ba Cöbal wää Kiriat-Jeerim beeye kwar jø Arøe ki thääŋ jø Manëat.
english: And Shobal the father of Kirjath–jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl ri Kiriat-Jeerim beege jø tuuŋ Jëtër, ki jø tuuŋ Putha, ki jø tuuŋ Cuma, ki jø tuuŋ Micra; ni jø tuuŋ Dhöra ki jø tuuŋ Ëctaöl ge poot käla rege.
english: And the families of Kirjath–jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites, and the Eshtaulites.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa käl ri Calma beege jø Bethelem, ki jø tuuŋ Nethöpa, ki jø Atharöt-Bëëth-Jöap, ki thääŋ jø Manëat, ki jø Dhöra.
english: The sons of Salma; Beth–lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.

anywaa: Wïth tuŋi mo wø tïïc tïï göör beege jø wø bëëdö paano cwøl ni Jabec, ni beege jø tuuŋ Tiret, ki jø tuuŋ Cimät, ki jø tuuŋ Cukath. Ge bëët gena jø Këën moa käl ri tuuŋ Amath na näk wää dhi øt Rëkap.
english: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

anywaa: Moi beege nyeŋ wäät Deebit moa nywøle Keeprön: kanynye beeye Amnön na nywøle ki cïïe ma Akinaam nyi jø Jedhriel; ni rietge beeye Daniel na nywøle ki cïïe ma Abigël nyi jø Karmël;
english: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:

anywaa: ni dääge beeye Abëcëlöm o cïïe ma Maika nyi Thalmay nyeny Gëcur; ni ŋweerge beeye Adöniya o cïïe ma Agith;
english: The third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:

anywaa: ni bïïge beeye Cepathiya o cïïe ma Abital; ni bïcierge beeye Ithriam o cïïe ma Ëgla.
english: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.

anywaa: Obwöre moøgø na abïciel yøø beege wäät Deebit moa nywøle Keeprön. 'Ba cwiiri moa beet Deebiti ni ena nyeya Keeprön beege cwiiri abïriiø ki dwäde abïciel. Ni cwiiri thuwø moa bëëde yi Jerucalem ni ena nyeya beege cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurdäk.
english: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.

anywaa: 'Ba wääte moa nywøle yi Jerucalem beege: Cimia, ki Cöbap, ki Nathan, ki Cølöman. Wääte moøgø na aŋween yøø beege moa nywøle ki cïïe ma Bathcïba nya Amiel.
english: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath–shua the daughter of Ammiel:

anywaa: 'Ba wääte møga beege Ibar, ki Elicama, ki Elipelet,
english: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

anywaa: ki Nöga, ki Napëk, ki Japia,
english: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

anywaa: ki Elicama, ki Eliada, ki Elipelet. Moøgø gena abïŋween.
english: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

anywaa: Obwöre moøgø bëët beege wäät Deebit, ni moa nywøle ki määre moa na akwanye kär kwaanø; 'ba Tamar beeye nyi wääge.
english: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.

anywaa: Cølöman wääde beeye Reeyöböm, ni Reeyöböm wääde beeye Abaaja, na Abaaja wääde beeye Aca, ni Eeca wääde beeye Jøcapat,
english: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

anywaa: ni Jøcapat wääde beeye Jöram, ni Jöram wääde beeye Akadhiya, na Akadhiya wääde beeye Jöac,
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

anywaa: ni Jöac wääde beeye Amaciya, na Amaciya wääde beeye Adhariya, na Adhariya wääde beeye Jötham,
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

anywaa: ni Jötham wääde beeye Eeyeth, ni Eeyath wääde beeye Edhekaya, ni Edhekaya wääde beeye Maneeca,
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

anywaa: ni Maneeca wääde beeye Amön, na Amön wääde beeye Jöcaya;
english: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

anywaa: ni Jöcaya wääde mana näk kaa beeye Jöanan, ni rietge beeye Jeyöakëm, ni dääge beeye Cëdëkiya, ni ŋweerge beeye Calum.
english: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakëm wääde beeye Jekönaya, ni Jekönaya wääde beeye Cëdëkiya.
english: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.

anywaa: Jø moa käl dëër Jekönaya kanya maai ki tøŋ beege: wääde ma Celatiyal,
english: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,

anywaa: ki Mëlkiram, ki Pedaya, ki Cenacar, ki Jekamiya, ko Ocama, ki Nadabiya.
english: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

anywaa: Wäät Pedaya beege Dherubabel ki Cimiy. 'Ba wäät Dherubabel beege Meculam ka Ananiya, ki cöökge ma Cëlömith na näk dhaagø.
english: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:

anywaa: 'Ba da wääte møøk ma abïïc thuwø, ni beege Acuba, ki Öël, ki Berekiya, ki Acadiya, ki Jöcabecet.
english: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab–hesed, five.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Ananiya beege Pelathiya, ki Jicaya, ki wäät Rëpaya, ki wäät Arnan, ki wäät Øbadiya, ki wäät Cekaniya.
english: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.

anywaa: 'Ba Cekaniya wääde beeye Cemaya, ni wäät Cemaya moa na abïciel beege Atuc, ki Igal, ki Bariya, ki Neärya, ki Capath.
english: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Neärya moa na adäk beege Eliyönay, ki Idhkiya, ka Adhirikam.
english: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.

anywaa: Wäät Eliyönay moa na abïriiø beege Odawïya, ki Eliyacip, ki Pelaya, ka Akup, ki Jöanan, ki Delaya, ka Anani.
english: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.

anywaa: Jøøa käl dëër Juuda beege: Peereth, ki Eedharan, ki Karmi, ki Ur, ki Cöbal.
english: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.

anywaa: 'Ba Reaya o Cöbal beeye wää Jakath; ni Jakath beeye wää Ayumay ki Laad. Jøøgø beege jøøa käl jø Dhöra rege.
english: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ëtam beege: Jedhriel, ki Icma, ki Idbac; ni nyeŋ cöökge mana näk dhaagø beeye Ëcelelpöni.
english: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:

anywaa: 'Ba Peniël beeye wää Gëdör, ni Ëdhör beeye wää Uca. Ni jøøgø beege jøøa käl dëër Ur, ni beeye Ur mana näk kany Eeparata wää Bethelem.
english: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth–lehem.

anywaa: 'Ba Acuur wää Tëköa jïre da määre ariiø, ni beege Ëëla ki Neära.
english: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

anywaa: Obwöre moa nywølge ki cïïe ma Neära beege Ayujam, ki Ëpër, ki Temeni, ki Ëcthari. Moøgøøni beege wäät Neära.
english: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

anywaa: 'Ba Acuur obwöre moa nywøle ki cïïe ma Ëëla beege Jeret, ki Icaar, ki Ethnan.
english: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.

anywaa: Köc beeye wää Anup ki Jöbëba, ni beeye kwar jøøa käl dëër Aarël wär Arum.
english: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

anywaa: 'Ba da dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jabec, mo owøørø døc no opöödhö ki yïthakic nyïïmenni. Nyeŋŋe acak menni ni Jabec, kiper ena köö, ni «Eni nywøla yi rääm mo leth døc.»
english: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.

anywaa: 'Ba Jabec alämö jï Jwø Icriel, ni kööe, «Gwïëth aani, Wuuö Jwøk, ni mooyï aani ki ŋøøm mo thööth; gwøk aani, ni koorï aani ceŋ gïï mo leth, nee bäŋe gïn mo leth mo pïï dëëra.» Køøre gïïa pëënynye atïïc Jwøki jïre.
english: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.

anywaa: Kelub cöök Cua beeye wää Mekir, ni Mekir beeye wää Ectön.
english: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ectön beege Bëëth-Rapa, ki Pacëa, ki Tëëna wää Ir-Naøc. Jøøgø beege jø Reka.
english: And Eshton begat Beth–rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir–nahash. These are the men of Rechah.

anywaa: Wäät Kënec beege Götönial ki Ceraya. 'Ba wäät Götönial beege Athath ki Meönöthay.
english: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.

anywaa: Meönöthay beeye wää Opara. Ceraya beeye wää Jöap, ni Jöap beeye wää Ge-Aracim, kiper gena jø wø tïïö ki jammi ki ceŋge.
english: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.

anywaa: Wäät Kalëp o Jöpöni beege Iru, ki Ëla, ki Naam. Ëla wääde beeye Kënec.
english: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.

anywaa: Wäät Jëlelel beege Dhip, ki Jipa, ki Tiria, ki Acarel.
english: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

anywaa: Wäät Icra beege Jether, ki Meret, ki Ëpër, ki Jalön. 'Ba wäät Meret moa nywøle ki cïïe ma Bithia nyi Peerø beege Mariyam, ki Camaay, ki Icba wää Ëctemöa.
english: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre moa nywøle ki cïïe mana näk nyi jø Juuth beege Jered wää Gëdör, ki Eber wää Cökö, ki Jekuthiel wää Dhanöwa.
english: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Odiya moa nywøle ki cïïe mana näk cöök Nakam beege wää Kïïla na näk ŋat Garmi, ki Ëctemöa na näk ŋat Maika.
english: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cimön beege Amnön, ki Rinna, ki Ben-Anan, ki Tilön. Ni wäät Ici beege Jöith ki Benjöith.
english: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben–hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben–zoheth.

anywaa: Jiy moa käl dëër Ceela o Juuda beege Er wää Leka, ki Laada wää Marëca, ki wï tuuŋ mano cwääö ka abïïe yi Bëëth-Acbiya,
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,

anywaa: ki Jökim, ki jø Cöjëba, ki Jöac, ki Carap, jøøa nywøm määr Möap, ni duuge Lëkëm. 'Ba kanya göör luupögø piny yie bäär døc.
english: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi–lehem. And these are ancient things.

anywaa: Jøøgø beege dïcwäc dääe mo ge bëëdö Netaim ki Gedëra; ge bëëdö ka nyeya kunece ni ge tïnynya gø.
english: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.

anywaa: Wäät Cimien beege: Nemuel, ki Jamin, ki Jarip, ki Dheera, ki Caul;
english: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:

anywaa: ni Caul wääde beeye Calum, ni Calum wääde beeye Mepcam, ni Mepcam wääde beeye Macma,
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

anywaa: ni Macma wääde beeye Amuël, na Amuël wääde beeye Dhakur, ni Dhakur wääde beeye Cimiy.
english: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Cimiy jïre da wääte apaar ka abïciel ki nyïïe abïciel. 'Ba nyïïmenni bäŋ wäätge mo thööth; dhi øtø marge kär nyaay kaamar wäät Juuda.
english: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.

anywaa: Kar bëëtö marge beeye Bëërcïïba, ki Mölada, ki Adhar-Cuwal,
english: And they dwelt at Beer–sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar–shual,

anywaa: ki Bila, ka Acëm, ki Tölad,
english: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

anywaa: ki Batuël, ki Örma, ki Ciklak,
english: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Markaböt, ki Adhar-Cucim, ki Bëëth-Biri, ki Caarayim. Moøgøøni beege päänye moge këël mana pïïcge ri nyeya ma Deebit.
english: And at Beth–marcaboth, and Hazar–susim, and at Beth–biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.

anywaa: Atude moge beege Ëtam, ki Ayn, ki Rimön, ki Tökin, ka Acan. Ge bëët beege päänye abïïc.
english: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:

anywaa: Atude moge bëët ena deŋ päänye moøgøøni këël mana këët päänya cwøl ni Baal. Moøgøøni beege kwör bëëte moge, ki kanya täk tier tuuŋ marge yie.
english: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

anywaa: Jiy moi no ocøøri ki nyeŋge ii beege bwöthe mo dhøk uudi moge: Mecöbap, ki Jamlek, ki Jöca wär Amaciya,
english: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,

anywaa: ki Jool, ki Jiyu o Jöcibiya. Jöcibiya beeye o Ceraya, Ceraya beeye wär Aciël;
english: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

anywaa: ki Eliyönay, ki Jaaköba, ki Jecöya, ka Acaaya, ka Adiel, ki Jecimiel, ki Benaya,
english: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

anywaa: ki Jija o Cipi, Cipi wär Allön, Allön o Jidaya, Jidaya o Cimri, Cimri o Cemaya.
english: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi mo wëëkge anyaay ni thööth døc,
english: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.

anywaa: ni tïŋge ni cige Gëdör, këël mana pïïcge deŋ gooro en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni ge manynya kar kwaath kiper dhäk moge.
english: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

anywaa: Ni jïtge ki ŋöömö mo lem mo beer kiper kwaath, kany mo ŋöömö mare päl mo onikïïl ni bäŋ gïn mo caar kiper leny yie. Jiy moa beet ŋöömmögø dïkwøŋ beege jøøa käl dëër Kaam.
english: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri nïr Edhekaya nyeny Juuda, jøøa cøøri maal kaagø yøø ki nyeŋge, gena ci baŋ jøøgø ni tukge jøøgø kwöra bëëtge yïthge yi ŋöömmögø, ni rwöpge ka jø tuuŋ Meunim moa en kaace, ni putge wïth jøøgø dïïr na bäre, ni läwge kar jøøgø, kiper da kar kwaath kaace kiper dhäk moge.
english: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røkge, ge na nyïïkwaac Cimien, jiy ma dïpe abïïc aci bäät Kïn Cëër ni ge bwøtha wäät Ici, ni beege Pelathiya, ki Neärya, ki Rëpaya, ki Udhiel.
english: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

anywaa: Ni dïïrge wïth jø Amalëk moa dööŋ na näk opäär wøk, ni putge bëëte kaace këël dïcäŋi.
english: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.

anywaa: Man beeye luum wäät Ruben na näk kany Icriel, ni beeye eni ŋata kwøŋ nywøl; 'ba kiper mana ci baŋ cï wänni ni bute ki gø, dööŋö mare aput wëëk wäät Jocep, ni ö beenhnhe moe ni käri göörö yi wëël nyeŋ ki køør dööŋö mare.
english: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.

anywaa: 'Ba Juuda atïmö no oteeø døc ki røk uutwänni, ni joot bwödhi ki ree; 'ba dööŋ kar poot ena baŋ wäät Jocep.
english: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)

anywaa: 'Ba Ruben na näk kany Icriel, wääte beege: Anök, ki Pallu, ki Eedharan, ki Karmi.
english: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl ri Jool beeye: wääde ma Cemaya, ni Cemaya wääde beeye Göök, ni Göök wääde beeye Cimiy,
english: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

anywaa: ni Cimiy wääde beeye Mikiya, ni Mikiya wääde beeye Reaya, ni Reaya wääde beeye Baal,
english: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,

anywaa: ni Baal wääde beeye Bëëra, ni beeye Bëëra mana no oteeø na käl ri tuuŋ Ruben, na mak Tiglat-Pilëëcër nyeny Aciria ki tøŋ.
english: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth dhøk uudi mo tuuŋ Ruben moa näk nyeŋge ogöör piny yi wëël nyeŋ beeye dhi øt Jïël na käl ri Dhekaraya,
english: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

anywaa: ki Bëla wär Acac, Acac o Cema, Cema o Jool. Ni ŋøøm moa beetge beeye ki mana täge pääny Aröör këël mana këët Nebø ki Baal-Miyön.
english: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal–meon:

anywaa: Ni makge ŋöömma en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ thuwø këël mana këët yi ŋöömma näk otal na en bäät Naam Upareeti, kiper mana näk lääc paac otïmö ni thööth jïge yi ŋööm Gelät.
english: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Cøølli na nyeya, jø tuuŋ Ruben atïïö ki leny bäät jø tuuŋ Agri ni böötge ge, ni bëëtge kwöra bëët jøøgø yïthge jï løø kur tuulcäŋ ki ŋööm Gelät.
english: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Gaat ge bëëdö yi ŋööm Baacan, ni ge kïëö ka jø tuuŋ Ruben, këël mana këëtge Caleka.
english: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salecah:

anywaa: 'Ba Jool beeye ŋata bëëdö na bwödhi yi Baacan, ni ŋata caath køøre beeye Capam, køøre ki Janay ki Capath.
english: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth dhøk uudi moa näk abïriiø mo jø tuuŋge beege Mikaël, ki Meculam, ki Cïïba, ki Jööray, ki Jakan, ki Dhia, ki Eber.
english: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.

anywaa: Moøgø beege wäät Abikael wär Ori, Ori wär Jaröa, Jaröa wär Gelät, Gelät wär Mikaël, Mikaël wär Jecicay, Jecicay wär Jaadö, Jaadö wär Buc.
english: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk kwar dhøk uudi moøgø beeye Aki wär Abdiël na näk beeye o Guni.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Gaat ni bëëtge yi ŋööm Gelät, ki yi ŋööm Baacan ki yïth atude moa en yie, ki yïth pwöle mo kwaath mo Carön, këël mana këët nyeŋ keee moge.
english: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.

anywaa: Nyeŋ jiy moøgø bëët ogöör piny yïth weet nyeŋ yïth nïra beet Jöthammi nyeny Juuda ki Jeröbäm nyeny Icriel.
english: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca jïge da jø leny ma kume ma pïëraŋween kurŋween ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïciel mo rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, ni gena atïëte mo leny, ni beege jø wø käär kööt leny ko opëëlle, ki jø wø thöödhö ka athëëre, ni beege jø wø ŋäc jöör leny.
english: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.

anywaa: Ni këëtge ki wïth juurre mo jø Agri, ni beege jø Jetur, ki jø Napëc, ki jø Nödap.
english: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya këëtge ki jø Agri, gena køny Jwøki ri leny kiper mana jwöŋge dëër Jwøk ni ŋääthge gø, ni ö Jwøki ni køny geni ki leny, ni cïp jø Agri ceŋge ki jøøa en løøge.
english: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was entreated of them; because they put their trust in him.

anywaa: Ni kälge lääc paac mo jøøgø, ni beege athïrööle ma kume ma pïërabïïc, ki rööm ma kume ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc, ka arëënni ma kume ariiø; ni makge jiy thuwø ki tøŋ ma kume ma dïpa.
english: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.

anywaa: Ni nääge ki jiy mo thööth ri leny, kiper mana näk Jwøk ena kurge. Ni bëëtge ŋøøp jøøgø këël kanya mak paac ki tøŋ.
english: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca anyaay ni thööth, ni bëëtge yi ŋööm Baacan këël mana këët pääny Baal-Armön ki Kïn Canër ki Kïn Armön.
english: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal–hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.

anywaa: Moi beege wïth dhøk uudi mo wëëkge, ni beege Ëpër, ki Ici, ki Eliel, ki Adhiriel, ki Jeremaya, ki Odawïya, ki Jadiël. Jøøgø beege otëëe moa näk nyeŋge ŋäc, ni beege wïth dhøk uudi mo wëëkge.
english: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, gena tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëër Jwø wëëkge, ni cääthge køør juu mo patha adïëri moa lam jø paanøgø na raany Jwøki nyïmge, ni marge gaan wøk kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp.
english: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Jwø Icriel atïïö cwïny Puul nyeny Aciria, ni beeye Tiglat-Pilëëcër, ni mak ge ki tøŋ ni käl geni, ni beege jø tuuŋ Ruben ki jø tuuŋ Gaat ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni kïth geni ya Alay ka Abör ka Ara ki bäät Naam Gödhan, ni putge bëëte yie këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.

anywaa: Wäät Libay beege Gërcön ki Kät ki Mërari.
english: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Kät beege Amram, ki Icaar, ki Keeprön, ki Udhiel.
english: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

anywaa: Ni ö obwöre mo Amram ni näkge beege Aran, ki Modhe, ki Mariyam. Ni wäät Aran beege Nadap, ka Abiyu, ki Eliedhar, ki Itamer.
english: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

anywaa: Eliedhar beeye wää Piniac, Piniac beeye wää Abicua,
english: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,

anywaa: Abicua beeye wää Buki, Buki beeye wää Udhi,
english: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,

anywaa: Udhi beeye wää Dheraya, Dheraya beeye wää Merayöt,
english: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,

anywaa: Merayöt beeye wää Amariya, Amariya beeye wää Akitöp,
english: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

anywaa: Akitöp beeye wää Dhadök, Dhadök beeye wää Akimaath,
english: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,

anywaa: Akimaath beeye wää Adhariya, Adhariya beeye wää Jöanan,
english: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,

anywaa: Jöanan beeye wää Adhariya mana tïïö na dïlämi yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana geer Cølömanni yi Jerucalem.
english: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)

anywaa: Adhariya manøgø beeye wää Amariya, Amariya beeye wää Akitöp,
english: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,

anywaa: Akitöp beeye wää Dhadök, Dhadök beeye wää Calum,
english: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,

anywaa: Calum beeye wää Kilkiya, Kilkiya beeye wää Adhariya,
english: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,

anywaa: Adhariya beeye wää Ceraya, Ceraya beeye wää Jöcëdëk,
english: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,

anywaa: ni beeye Jöcëdëk mana käl kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na cïp jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem cer nyeya ma Nabukedenecör ni mak geni ki tøŋ.
english: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Libay beege Gërcön ki Kät ki Mërari.
english: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wäät Gërcön beege Löbeni ki Cimiy.
english: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.

anywaa: Ni ö wäät Kät ni näkge beege Amram, ki Icaar, ki Keeprön, ki Udhiel.
english: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Mërari beege Maali ki Muci. 'Ba jiy moa käl dëër Libay ki køør dhøk uudi mo wëëkge beege ii:
english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.

anywaa: Ki ri dhi øtø mar Gërcön beeye wääde ma Löbeni. Ni Löbeni wääde beeye Jakath, Jakath wääde beeye Jimma,
english: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

anywaa: Jimma wääde beeye Jöa, Jöa wääde beeye Idö, Idö wääde beeye Dheera, Dheera wääde beeye Jeetheray.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri dhi øtø mar Kät beeye wääde ma Aminadap. Na Aminadap wääde beeye Köra, Köra wääde beeye Acër,
english: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

anywaa: Acër wääde beeye Elkana, Elkana wääde beeye Ebiacap, Ebiacap wääde beeye Acër,
english: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,

anywaa: Acër wääde beeye Taath, Taath wääde beeye Uriel, Uriel wääde beeye Udhaya, Udhaya wääde beeye Caul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Elkana wääte beege Amacay ka Akimöth.
english: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

anywaa: Na Akimöt wääde beeye Elkana, Elkana wääde beeye Jöpäy, Jöpäy wääde beeye Naath,
english: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,

anywaa: Naath wääde beeye Eliap, Eliap wääde beeye Jeröam, Jeröam wääde beeye Elkana.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Camiel beege Jool na näk kanynye, ki julle ma Abaaja.
english: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri dhi øtø mar Mërari beeye wääde ma Maali. Ni Maali wääde beeye Löbeni, Löbeni wääde beeye Cimiy, Cimiy wääde beeye Udha,
english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,

anywaa: Udha wääde beeye Cimia, Cimia wääde beeye Agïya, Agïya wääde beeye Acaaya.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit ajëëdö ki jiy kiper tïï wär ki dudi yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk kanya tïm acanduki man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy ni ena kaace Jerucalem.
english: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.

anywaa: Ni bëët jøøgø ni ge tïïya tïï wär ki dudi nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø këël kanya ö Cølömanni na geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk yi Jerucalem. Gena bëëdö ni ge tïïya tïïc manøgø ki køør ciik mana no ocïp piny kipere.
english: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.

anywaa: Moi beege nyeŋge ki dhøk uudi moge, ge na tïïc tïï wär ki dudi. Ki røk nyïïkwaac Kät, ŋata bëëdö na lööŋö beeye Ëman. Ëman beeye o Jool, Jool beeye o Camiel,
english: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

anywaa: Camiel beeye wär Elkana, Elkana beeye wär Jeröam, Jeröam beeye wär Eliel, Eliel beeye o Töa,
english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

anywaa: Töa beeye o Dhup, Dhup beeye wär Elkana, Elkana beeye o Maath, Maath beeye wär Amacay,
english: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

anywaa: Amacay beeye wär Elkana, Elkana beeye o Jool, Jool beeye wär Adhariya, Adhariya beeye o Jepaniya,
english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

anywaa: Jepaniya beeye o Taath, Taath beeye wär Acër, Acër beeye wär Ebiacap, Ebiacap beeye o Köra,
english: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

anywaa: Köra beeye wär Icaar, Icaar beeye o Kät, Kät beeye o Libay, Libay beeye wär Icriel.
english: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba lööŋö maya beeye Acaap, ŋat wø cuŋŋi bäät cwïï Ëman. Acaap beeye o Berekiya, Berekiya beeye o Cimia,
english: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

anywaa: Cimia beeye o Mikaël, Mikaël beeye o Baaciya, Baaciya beeye o Malkiya,
english: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

anywaa: Malkiya beeye wär Ethni, Ethni beeye o Dheera, Dheera beeye wär Adaya,
english: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

anywaa: Adaya beeye wär Ëtan, Ëtan beeye o Jimma, Jimma beeye o Cimiy,
english: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

anywaa: Cimiy beeye o Jakath, Jakath beeye o Gërcön, Gërcön beeye o Libay.
english: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

anywaa: 'Ba lööŋö maya thuwø mana en bäät caam Ëman beeye Ëtan na en røk jøøa käl dëër Mërari. Ëtan beeye o Kici, Kici beeye wär Abdi, Abdi beeye o Maluk,
english: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

anywaa: Maluk beeye wär Acabiya, Acabiya beeye wär Amaciya, Amaciya beeye o Kilkiya,
english: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

anywaa: Kilkiya beeye wär Amci, Amci beeye o Bani, Bani beeye o Cëmër,
english: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

anywaa: Cëmër beeye o Maali, Maali beeye o Muci, Muci beeye o Mërari, Mërari beeye o Libay.
english: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay møga, tïïe møga bëët mo wø tïïc Øt Wuuö Jwøk acïp ceŋge.
english: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Aran ki wääte cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met acïp ceŋge, kiper tïïe bëët mo wø tïïc thääŋ Øt Jwøk mana en kur keere na pere leth, ni tïïe moøgø tïïc no okïdi kiper wëën raay mo jø Icriel, kaa mana ö Modhe na näk dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na kööm geni.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa käl dëër Aran beege ii: Wääde beeye Eliedhar. Ni Eliedhar wääde beeye Piniac, Piniac wääde beeye Abicua,
english: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

anywaa: Abicua wääde beeye Buki, Buki wääde beeye Udhi, Udhi wääde beeye Dheraya,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

anywaa: Dheraya wääde beeye Merayöt, Merayöt wääde beeye Amariya, Amariya wääde beeye Akitöp,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

anywaa: Akitöp wääde beeye Dhadök, Dhadök wääde beeye Akimaath.
english: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwör bëëte mo jiy moa käl dëër Aran ki køør twëëre moa enge yïthge nyeŋ kee moge. Ki dëët wäät Aran, dhi øtø mar Kät kar bëëtö mana dïkwøŋ apäth ceŋge ki køør gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe;
english: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.

anywaa: ni cïp pääny Keeprön jïge na en yi ŋööm Juuda, ki kwör kwaath moe moa en deŋŋe.
english: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.

anywaa: 'Ba pwöth mo päänyögø ka atude moe acïpge jï Kalëp wär Jöpöni.
english: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jï jiy moa käl dëër Aran bee pääny mar gwøk røk na näk Keeprön, ki Libana ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Jatir, ki Ëctemöa ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,

anywaa: ki Olön ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Dabëër ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Ayn ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Bëëth-Camic ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Benjamen bee Gëba ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Alemeth ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Anathöth ki kwör kwaath moe. Päänye bëët moa ci jï nyïïkwaac Aran beege päänye apaar kurdäk.
english: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Kät møga, gena jïtö ki päänye apaar ki køør gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe. Ni päänye moøgøøni lwørra røk päänye mo dhøk uudi mo thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca.
english: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jï nyïïkwaac Gërcön ki køør dhøk uudi moge, beege päänye apaar kurdäk, ni päänye moøgø lwørra baŋ jø tuuŋ Icakar, ki jø tuuŋ Acer, ki jø tuuŋ Naptali, ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca mana en yi ŋööm Baacan.
english: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

anywaa: Päänye moa cïp thuwø jï nyïïkwaac Mërari ki køør dhøk uudi moge na cïp ki køør gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe, beege päänye apaar kurriiø. Päänye moøgø lwørra baŋ jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Dhebulan.
english: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye gïna tïïc jø Icrielli kanya cïpge päänye jï jø tuuŋ Libay ni rwöpge ka kwör kwaath moa näk mo päänye moøgø bëët.
english: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.

anywaa: Päänye moøgø cïpge ka køør gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe. Ni lwørge baŋ nyïïkwaac jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki nyïïkwaac jø tuuŋ Cimien, ki nyïïkwaac jø tuuŋ Benjamen; ni beege päänye moa nyeŋge kwøŋ caan maal kaagø.
english: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk uudi møga mo nyïïkwaac Kät gena jïtö ki päänye baŋ jø tuuŋ Ipariem.
english: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.

anywaa: Päänye moa cïp jøøgø jïge bee Cekam na näk pääny mar gwøk røk na en mïëya en bäät kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Gëdher ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Jökimiam ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Bëëth-Örön ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth–horon with her suburbs,

anywaa: ka Ayalön ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Gëth-Rimön ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba ki baŋ thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca thuwø da päänye mo ege cïbö jï dhøk uudi møga mo nyïïkwaac Kät. Päänye moøgø bee Anër ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Biliam ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jï nyïïkwaac Gërcön ki baŋ thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca beeye Gölan na en Baacan ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Actaröth ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Icakar bee Këdëc ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Dabirat ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Ramöth ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Anem ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge thuwø ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Acer bee Macal ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Abidön ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Ukök ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Reeyöp ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Naptali bee Këdëc na en Galili ki kwör kwaath moe, ka Amön ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Kiriatayim ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa dööŋ, na näk nyïïkwaac Mërari, päänye moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beeye Rimönö ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Tabör ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Ruben løø Naam Jördan løøga jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ na dïët ki Jerikö bee Böcör na en wøk ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Jaca ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Kedemöth ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Mëpät ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:

anywaa: Ni moa cïp jïge ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Gaat bee Ramöth na en Gelät ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Maanayim ki kwör kwaath moe,
english: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,

anywaa: ki Ëcbön ki kwör kwaath moe, ki Jadher ki kwör kwaath moe.
english: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Icakar moa na aŋween beege Töla, ki Puwa, ki Jacup, ki Cimrön.
english: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

anywaa: Ni wäät Töla moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi moge beege Udhi, ki Rëpaya, ki Jeriël, ki Jaamay, ki Ibacam, ki Cemuel. 'Ba kanya bëët Deebiti na nyeya, jøøa käl ri Töla na näk nyeŋge ogöör piny yi wëël nyeŋ, gena cwøw leny mo teek mo kwäänge beege kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø ki dïpe abïciel.
english: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhi wääde beeye Idhariya, ni wäät Idhariya beege Mikaël, ki Øbadiya, ki Jool, ki Iciya. Jøøi bëët na abïïc ii gena wïth dhøk uudi moge.
english: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa käl dëëtge, ki køør dhøk uudi moge, atïmö ni thööth kiper obwöre moge thööth ki køør määrge na thööth, ni jïtge ki cwøw ma kume ma pïëradäk ka abïciel mo rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, mo nyeŋge ogöörö yi wëël nyeŋ.
english: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøw leny moa teek mo dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Icakar na näk nyeŋge ogöörö yi wëël nyeŋ, kwäänge beege kume ma pïërabära ka abïriiø.
english: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Benjamen moa na adäk beege Bëla ki Bëkër ki Jediel.
english: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.

anywaa: Ni wäät Bëla moa na abïïc beege Ëdhbön, ki Udhi, ki Udhiel, ki Jerimöth, ki Iri, ni beege jøøa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi moge ni gena cwøw leny mo teek mo nyeŋge ogöör yi wëël nyeŋ, ni kwäänge beege kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø ki pïëradäk kurŋween.
english: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Bëkër beege Jemira, ki Jöac, ki Eliëdher, ki Eliyönay, ki Ømri, ki Jerëmöth, ka Abaaja, ka Anathöth, ka Alemeth. Moøgø bëët beege wäät Bëkër,
english: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.

anywaa: na näk nyeŋge ogöörö yi wëël nyeŋ ki køør beenhnhe moge ki wïth dhøk uudi moge, ni gena cwøw leny mo teek mo kwäänge beege kume ma pïërariiø ki dïpe ariiø.
english: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba Jediel wääde beeye Bilaan. Ni wäät Bilaan beege Jeuc, ki Benjamen, ki Ëwut, ki Kinana, ki Jethan, ki Tarcëc, ka Akicaar.
english: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

anywaa: Moøgø bëët beege wäät Jediel, na bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi moge, ni gena cwøw leny mo teek mo kwäänge beege kume apaar ka abïriiø ki dïpe ariiø mo rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper ciin baŋ leny.
english: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Cupim ki jø tuuŋ Upim, ge käla ri Ir, ni jø tuuŋ Ucim ge käla ra Aker.
english: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.

anywaa: Wäät Naptali beege Jaadhël, ki Guni, ki Jedher, ki Calum. 'Ba Bila beeye mii Naptali.
english: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Maneeca beege: Aciriel ki Makir na nywøle ki dhaaŋŋa na akwanya, nyi jø Aram. 'Ba Makir beeye na wää Gelät.
english: The sons of Manasseh; Asriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:

anywaa: Ni ö Makirri ni nyöömme ki dhaagø jï Upim ni nyöömme thuwø ki dhaagø jï Cupim; 'ba nyeŋ coki mana näk dhaagø beeye Maika. Ŋata käl dëëre thuwø beeye Dhilöpat, na näk nyïïe mään.
english: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.

anywaa: Maika ci Makir anywøl ki wääde ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Përec, ni nyeŋ coki beeye Cerec. Ni wäät Përec beege Ulam ki Rakim.
english: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

anywaa: Ni wär Ulam beeye Bedan. Moøgø beege jøøa käl dëër Gelät o Makir, ni beeye Makir o Maneeca.
english: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ cöök Gelät mana näk dhaagø beeye Amöleketh, ni wäät Amöleketh moa nywøle beege Icöd, ka Abiedhar, ki Maala.
english: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cemida beege Akian, ki Cekam, ki Liki, ka Aniam.
english: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Ipariem beege Cuthula. Cuthula wääde beeye Berët, ni Berët wääde beeye Taath, Taath wääde beeye Eliada, Eliada wääde beeye Taath,
english: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,

anywaa: Taath wääde beeye Dhabat, Dhabat wääde beeye Cuthula. 'Ba wäät Ipariem møga beege Ëdhör ki Eliat, jøøa 'näk jø Gëthi kiper mana cige kuna kwalge lääc paac mo jø Gëth.
english: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.

anywaa: 'Ba Ipariem gïr wääte akïïne ki nïne mo thööth, ni ö tuuŋge baŋe kuna cømge cwïnye.
english: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ ci baŋ cïïe, ni jït yi cïïe ki dhaanhø ni nywøli na dïcwøø, ni ö Ipariem ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Beria kiper gïna leth na pänh bäät paare.
english: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaare mana näk dhaagø beeye Cëëra na geer Bëëth-Örön mana en maal ki mana en piny, na geer Udhën-Cëëra thuwø.
english: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth–horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen–sheerah.)

anywaa: 'Ba wär Ipariem beeye Ripa, ni Ripa wääde beeye Rëcep, Rëcep wääde beeye Tëla, Tëla wääde beeye Taan,
english: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,

anywaa: Taan wääde beeye Ladan, Ladan wääde beeye Ammiyut, Ammiyut wääde beeye Elicama,
english: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

anywaa: Elicama wääde beeye Nun, Nun wääde beeye Jøcua.
english: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm moge ki kar bëëtge beeye Bëthël ka atude moe moa en deŋŋe, ki Neäran na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki Gëdher ka atude moe na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki Cekam ka atude moe këël mana këët Ayya ka atude moe.
english: And their possessions and habitations were, Beth–el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:

anywaa: 'Ba päänye moge moa en waŋ keew ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca beege Bëëth-Can, ki Tanak, ki Megidø, ki Dör ka atude moa en deŋge. 'Ba jøøa käl ri Jocep wär Icriel ge bëëdö yïth päänye moøgø.
english: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth–shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.

anywaa: Wäät Acer beege Yimna, ki Yecuwa, ki Yecuwi, ki Beria, ki coki ma Cëëra na näk dhaagø.
english: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Ishuah, and Ishvi, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.

anywaa: Ni wäät Beria beege Eber ki Melkiël na näk wää Bërjeth.
english: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

anywaa: Eber beeye wää Jeplëtha ki Cömär, ki Kötham, ki cöökge ma Cuwëk mana näk dhaagø.
english: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.

anywaa: Ni wäät Jeplëtha beege Pacëk, ki Beemal, ka Acebeth. Moøgø beege wäät Jeplëtha.
english: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Cömär beege Aki, ki Rööga, ki Jeuba, ka Aram.
english: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

anywaa: Ni wäät coki ma Këlem beege Jöpa, ki Yimna, ki Celec, ka Amal.
english: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.

anywaa: Ni wäät Jöpa beege Cuwa, ka Arnëpër, ki Cögal, ki Bëri, ki Yimara,
english: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,

anywaa: ki Böcör, ki Öd, ki Cimia, ki Cilca, ki Ithran, ki Bëëra.
english: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

anywaa: Wäät Jether beege Jöpöni, ki Picpa, ka Ara.
english: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.

anywaa: Wäät Ula beege Araa, ka Aniel, ki Ridhiya.
english: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.

anywaa: Moøgø bëët beege jø tuuŋ Acer na näk wïth dhøk uudi moge, ni gena cwøw leny mo teek moa no ojierø, ni beege bwöthe moa perge leth. Ni kwään nyeŋ cwøw moa näk orømø ki ciin baŋ leny na näk nyeŋge ogöör yi wëël nyeŋ beege kume ma pïërariiø ka abïciel.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba Benjamen wääde mana näk kanynye beeye Bëla, ni rietge beeye Acbël, ni dääge beeye Aara,
english: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

anywaa: ni ŋweerge beeye Nöa, ni bïïge beeye Rapa.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Bëla beege Adar, ki Gëra, ka Abiyud,
english: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

anywaa: ka Abicua, ki Neeman, ka Aköki,
english: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

anywaa: ki Gëra, ki Cepupan, ki Kuram. 6-7
english: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ëwut beege Neeman, ka Akiya, ki Gëra, ni beege wïth dhøk uudi moa bëëdö Gëba; na käl ki teek na kïth Manëat. 'Ba ŋata käl geni beeye Gëra manøgø na näk wää Udha ka Akiyut.
'Ba Caarayam ajïtö ko obwöre paana cwøl ni Möap køør kanya riem määre, ni beege Ucim ki Baara.
english: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre moøka nywøle ka cïïe ma Odec, ni beege Jöbap, ki Jibia, ki Mëca, ki Malkam,
english: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

anywaa: ki Jeuc, ki Cakia, ki Mirma; ni ö wääte moøgøøni ni putge tïmö na wïth dhøk uudi.
english: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba wääte moa kwøŋ joot ki cïïe ma Ucim beege Abitub ki Elpaal.
english: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

anywaa: Ni wäät Elpaal beege Eber, ki Micam, ki Cemed na geer paana cwøl ni Onö ki paana cwøl ni Löt ka atude moge;
english: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

anywaa: ni wäät Elpaal møøk beege Beria ki Cema, jøøa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi paana cwøl ni Ayalön. 'Ba geni jø Gëth ariemge.
english: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

anywaa: 'Ba Akïïö, ki Cacak, ki Jerëmöth,
english: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

anywaa: ki Dhebadiya, ka Arat, ka Adër,
english: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

anywaa: ki Mikaël, ki Icpa, ki Jöa, beege jøøa käl dëër Beria.
english: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

anywaa: 'Ba Dhebadiya, ki Meculam, ki Ëjiki, ki Eber,
english: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

anywaa: ki Icmeray, ki Ijiliya, ki Jöbap, beege jøøa käl dëër Elpaal.
english: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

anywaa: 'Ba Jakim, ki Dhikri, ki Dhabdi,
english: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

anywaa: ki Elienay, ki Jilethay, ki Eliel,
english: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

anywaa: ka Adaya, ki Beraya, ki Cimrath, beege jøøa käl dëër Cimiy.
english: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

anywaa: 'Ba Icpan, ki Eber, ki Eliel,
english: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

anywaa: ka Abidön, ki Dhikri, ka Anan,
english: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

anywaa: ka Ananiya, ki Ilam, ki Anthöthiya,
english: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

anywaa: ki Ipdiya, ki Peniël, beege jøøa käl dëër Cacak.
english: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

anywaa: 'Ba Camceray, ki Ceriya, ka Athaliya,
english: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

anywaa: ki Jareciya, ki Ilaaja, ki Dhikri, beege jøøa käl dëër Jeröam.
english: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

anywaa: Jøøgøøni beege wïth dhøk uudi, ni gena dïbwöthe ki køør beenhnhe mo tuŋi moge, ni ge bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Jïël wää Gibien bëëdö yi Gibien; ni nyeŋ cïïe beeye Maika.
english: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wääde mana näk kanynye beeye Abidön, køøre ki Cuur, ki Kic, ki Baal, ki Nadap,
english: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

anywaa: ki Gëdör, ka Akïïö, ki Jekër,
english: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

anywaa: ki Miklöth wää Cimia. 'Ba geni, gena bëëdö ki tuuŋge thuwø yi Jerucalem buut tuuŋge møga. Luum Jø Tuuŋ Cøøl
english: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

anywaa: 'Ba Nër beeye wää Kic, ni Kic beeye wää Cøøl, ni Cøøl beeye wää Jönathan, ki Mëlkica, ka Abinadap, ki Icbaal.
english: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan wääde beeye Merib- Baal, ni Merib-Baal beeye wää Mikiya.
english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal; and Merib–baal begat Micah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Mikiya beege Pithön, ki Mëlëk, ki Taria, ki Eeyeth.
english: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

anywaa: Eeyeth beeye wää Jöada, ni Jöada beeye wää Alemeth, ka Adhemawët, ki Dhimri; ni Dhimri beeye wää Möja.
english: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

anywaa: Möja beeye wää Binia, ni Binia wääde beeye Rapa, ni Rapa wääde beeye Eliaca, ni Eliaca wääde beeye Ajel.
english: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

anywaa: 'Ba Ajel jïre da wääte abïciel, ni beege Adhirikam, ki Bökru, ki Icmiel, ki Ceriya, ki Øbadiya, ka Anan. Moøgø beege wäät Ajel.
english: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät coki ma Icek beeye Ulam na näk kaa, ni rietge beeye Jeuc, ni dääge beeye Elipelet.
english: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ulam gena cwøw leny mo teek mo thöör ka athëëre ŋäcge døc. 'Ba jïge da wäätge mo thööth ki nyïïkwaacge mo thööth, ni kwäänge bëët beege dïpa ki pïërabïïc. Jøøgø bëët ge käla dëër Benjamen.
english: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët nyeŋge ogöörö ki køør dhøk uudi moge yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel. 'Ba jø Juuda gena mak ki tøŋ ni kïth geni yi Babiløn kiper mana tïïge ki raay dëër Jwøk.
english: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ duuö na duu yïth mïëri moge ki yïth päänye moge beege dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jiy mo wø tïïc tïïe moa therø yi Øt Jwøk, ki jø Icriel møøk.
english: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk røk jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca, gena ci Jerucalem nee bëëtge yie. 4-6
english: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda moa bëëdö Jerucalem beege dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïŋween. Ni bwödhi mar dhi øt Peereth o Juuda beeye Uthay wär Ammiyut, Ammiyut wär Ømri, Ømri wär Imeri, Imeri wär Bani. Bwödhi mar dhi øt Ceela o Juuda beeye Acaaya na näk kaa, ki wääte. Bwödhi mar dhi øt Dheera o Juuda beeye Juël. 7-9

'Ba jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa bëëdö Jerucalem na näk nyeŋge ogöör piny ki køør dhøk uudi moge beege dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïïc ka abïciel. Ni dïbwöthe moge bee Caallu o Meculam, Meculam wär Odawïya, Odawïya wär Acenua; ki Ibania wär Jeröam; ki Ëla wär Udhi, Udhi o Mikiri; ki Meculam o Cepathiya, Cepathiya o Raguël, Raguël wär Yebaniya. Jøøgø bëët beege wïth dhøk uudi moge.
'Ba jø tuuŋ dïlämme moa bëëdö Jerucalem beege: Jidaya, ki Jöyarip, ki Jaakin,
english: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

anywaa: ka Adhariya, na en Øt Jwøki cere, na näk wär Kilkiya, Kilkiya wär Meculam, Meculam wär Dhadök, Dhadök wär Merayöt, Merayöt wär Akitöp;
english: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;

anywaa: ka Adaya wär Jeröam, Jeröam o Pacuur, Pacuur o Malkiya; ki Maïca wär Adiel, Adiel o Jadhëra, Jadhëra o Meculam, Meculam o Mecilemith, Mecilemith wär Imër.
english: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme mo wïth dhøk uudi moge kwäänge beege kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïciel, ni gena jiy mo teek ki tïïe mo wø tïïc yi Øt Jwøk.
english: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa bëëdö Jerucalem beeye: Cemaya wär Acub, Acub wär Adhirikam, Adhirikam wär Acabiya, na käl dëër Mërari;
english: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

anywaa: ki Bakbakar ki Ërëc ki Galal ki Mataniya o Mika, Mika o Dhikri, Dhikri wär Acaap;
english: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

anywaa: ki Øbadiya o Cemaya, Cemaya o Galal, Galal wär Jeduthun; ki Berekiya wär Aca, Aca wär Elkana. Moøgø beege jøøa bëëdö yïth atude mo tuuŋ Nethöpa.
english: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.

anywaa: Jø wø koor dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Jwøk moa bëëdö Jerucalem beege: Calum, ka Akup, ki Thalmön, ka Akimen ki tuuŋge; 'ba Calum beeye bwödhi marge.
english: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;

anywaa: Ni tïïc marge këël dïcäŋi en, ge koora dhi kal man wø en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni wø duny nyeya yi Øt Jwøk ki yie. Ni beege jøøa kwäcge kwøŋ bëëdö ni twïër mar jø tuuŋ Libay koora geni.
english: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.

anywaa: Calum beeye wär Körë, Körë beeye wär Ebiacap, Ebiacap beeye wär Köra, ni beeye Calum ki tuuŋge na käl dhi øt Köra ni wø koor dhi Øt Jwøk, kaawat mana bëët kwäcge na koorge dhi øt oduŋkaara na näk kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Piniac wär Eliedhar jø wø koor dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Jwøk ena cere, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ki eni.
english: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.

anywaa: Ni Dhekaraya wär Mecelemiya beeye eni na wara koor dhi øt oduŋkaany røømmø.
english: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

anywaa: Jøøgø bëët beege jøøa no ojierø ki man koorge dhøgi bëët mo kal ki mo oduŋkaara, ni kwäänge beege dïpe ariiø ka apaar kurriiø, ni nyeŋge ogöör piny yi wëël nyeŋ ki køør dhøk uudi moge ki yïth atude moge; ni beeye nyeya ma Deebit ki nyïkuŋ Jwøk ma Camiel na cuum jøøgø bäät tïïc ni gena jiy mo oŋäädhö.
english: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.

anywaa: 'Ba bee geni ki jøøa käl dëëtge ni wø koor dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø koor dhøgi mo kal, ge ena dhøge moa na aŋween, ni beege jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki jï løø wï-piny, ki jï løø tier-piny.
english: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

anywaa: Ni ö tuuŋge moa en yïth atude ni öge ni nywaakge tïïe moge ki geni ki nïne abïriiø ni ge wella dëëtge.
english: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moøgø na aŋween yøø na cuum na wïth jø koor, gena jiy mo oŋäädhö, ni thäk uudi moa therø na en deŋ Øt Jwøk ena ceŋge, ki kwör kän jammi mo Øt Jwøk.
english: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba geni ge bëëdö deŋ Øt Jwøk ki wäär bäre, kiper bee geni ni wø koor gø, ni japge dhøk gø ka amöölla cooth.
english: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay møøk jap tïïc mo Øt Jwøk ocïp ceŋge, ni kwaange kwaanø kany wø kïthge ge yi øtø ki kany wø kälge ge wøk.
english: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk tïïc marge beeye man gwøkge jammi moa en Øt Jwøk, ki muunni, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, ki mädhi, ki teeŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.
english: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk dïlämme da jiy mo tïïc marge beeye jääp teeŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.
english: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.

anywaa: Ni ö Matitiya nyï tuuŋ Libay na näk kany Calum na käl dëër Köra ni bëëde ni bul muunni ena cere.
english: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø jiiŋ muunni mo cïp bäät tharabëëta ki cäŋ jwömö cooth beege tuuŋge moa käl dëër Kät.
english: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø wär ki dudi beege jø tuuŋ Libay na näk wïth dhøk uudi moge, ni ge bëëdö thäk uudi moa therø na en deŋ Øt Jwøk, ni bäŋ tïïc mør mo tïïcge kiper mana näk ge tïïö ki wäär ki cäŋ.
english: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.

anywaa: Jøøgø bëët beege wïth dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Libay moa bëëdö Jerucalem, ni gena dïbwöthe mo nyeŋge ogöör piny yi Wëël Nyeŋ ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Jïël wää Gibien bëëdö yi Gibien; ni nyeŋ cïïe beeye Maika.
english: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:

anywaa: Ni nyeŋ wääde mana näk kanynye beeye Abidön; køøre ki Cuur, ki Kic, ki Baal, ki Nër, ki Nadap,
english: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

anywaa: ki Gëdör, ka Akïïö, ki Dhekaraya, ki Miklöth;
english: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

anywaa: 'ba Miklöth beeye wää Cimiam. 'Ba geni, gena bëëdö ki tuuŋge thuwø yi Jerucalem buut tuuŋge møga.
english: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba Nër beeye wää Kic, ni Kic beeye wää Cøøl, ni Cøøl beeye wää Jönathan ki Mëlkica ka Abinadap ki Icbaal.
english: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan wääde beeye Merib- Baal, ni Merib-Baal beeye wää Mikiya.
english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal: and Merib–baal begat Micah.

anywaa: Wäät Mikiya beege: Pithön, ki Mëlëk, ki Tarëa, ki Eeyeth.
english: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.

anywaa: Eeyeth beeye wää Jaara, ni Jaara beeye wää Alemeth, ka Adhemawët, ki Dhimri, ni Dhimri beeye wää Möja.
english: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

anywaa: 'Ba Möja beeye wää Binia, ni Binia wääde beeye Rëpaya, ni Rëpaya wääde beeye Eliaca, ni Eliaca wääde beeye Ajel.
english: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Ajel jïre da wääte abïciel, ni beege Adhirikam, ki Bökru, ki Icmiel, ki Ceriya, ki Øbadiya, ka Anan. Moøgø beege wäät Ajel.
english: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin gena këëdö ki jø Icriel; ni ö jø Icrielli ni bwøkge nyïm jø Pilitin, ni thøw mo thööthi rege bäät Kïn Gilböa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin Cøøl ki wääte amaage jöö, ni 'näkge wäät Cøøl, ni beege Jönathan, ka Abinadap, ki Mëlkica.
english: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi–shua, the sons of Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba leny atïmö ni teek dëër Cøøl. Køøre jø leny mo wø këëdi ka athëëre, Cøøl ajootge ni këëlge gø, ni put atheerø tïmö na ŋwellø mo leth døc dëëre.
english: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Cøøl aköö jï ŋat wø käär jap leny jïre, ni «Wöth opëëllö marï wøk ni cwøpï aani ki gø, nee jøøi ni kär daŋø ii nee ba öge baŋa ni caarge aani.» 'Ba ŋata käär jap leny jïre akweer ki man 'näk gø, kiper ena lwäyö døc. Køøre Cøøl opëëllö mare aput lwør ni put dëëre cwøp ki gø.
english: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋata käär jap leny jï Cøøl na joot gø ni Cøøl onø thøø, eni thuwø ree acwøbe ko opëëllö mare, ni put thøø.
english: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Cøøl ki wääte moa na adäk, ge na jø dhi øtø aciel, gena put thøø bëët.
english: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli bëët moa bëëdö mïëya en gool na jootge gø ni jø leny mo jø Icriel onø bwøk, ni Cøøl ki wääte geno nø thøø, geni päänye moge aputge wec ni bwøkge; ni ö jø Pilitinni ni putge öö ni bëëtge yïth päänye moøgø.
english: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya, na ö jø Pilitinni ni ge ööa kuna twierge jap jiy moa no othøw, Cøøl ki wääte aputge joot no othøw bäät Kïn Gilböa.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.

anywaa: Køøre jø Pilitin jap Cøøl aputge twier, ni ŋulge wï gø wøk, ni kälge gø ki jap leny moe, ni putge ge jääŋŋö dï ŋööm jø Pilitin bäre, ni ge caana thøw Cøøl yïth uut juu moge ki jï jø poge.
english: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jap leny mo Cøøl aputge kïth yi øt juu moge, ni lïërge wïïe yi øt jwøge man wø cwøl ni Dagön.
english: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli moa bëëdö pääny Jabic-Gelät na wïnyge jammi bëët moa tïïc jø Pilitinni dëër Cøøl,
english: And when all Jabesh–gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

anywaa: jø leny moa teek bëët gena put tïŋŋö ni pïïcge kunece ni lwørge dëër Cøøl ki dëët wääte ni døøge Iyabic-Gelät, ni koonyge ge tier jaadha dwøŋ na en Jabic-Gelät; ni kweerge ki cam ki nïne abïriiø ni ge kïïna gïr thøwge.
english: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl thøw kaper bääyö mare mana tïïe dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni käre luum Wuuö Jwøk gwøø. Ni beeye kiper mana pëëe thuwø na pëëny ŋata näk ree da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw,
english: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;

anywaa: ni käre Wuuö Jwøk pëënynyö. Kiper manøgønø, ena wëëk Wuuö Jwøki thøø, ni cïp bura mar gø jï Deebit o Jeci.
english: And enquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel bëët dëëtge acooŋge nyïm Deebit kanya bëëde yie Keeprön, ni köge jïgø, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ïïna dhaanhø ma rem dëëtwa, niï käla dëëtwa.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ këël na bëët Cøølli na nyeya, bee ïïni na bwøth jø Icriel kany wø näk ri leny. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marï aköö jïrï, ni ‹Ï doo bëëdö ni ïïna dïkwääy mar jiya ma jø Icriel, ni tïmï ni ïïna wïth jø Icriel.› »
english: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø døøk Icriel bëët gena ö baŋ nyeya ma Deebit kanya en yie Keeprön, ni ö nyeya ma Deebit ni tude ki luubö ki geni Keeprön kaagø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö geni ni thïïmge wï Deebit ki maaw ni ge røønya gø na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët, ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ki ri Camiel.
english: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ki jø Icriel bëët gena ci Jerucalem, ni beeye Jeebuc, paana bëët jø Jeebuc yie.
english: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Jeebuc gena köö jï Deebit, ni «Ba løny jïrï ki man dunynyï yi kiir kany.» 'Ba Deebit adønyø ni mak kar gwøk røk mana teek man wø cwøl ni Dhayan; ni beeye päänya put cwøl na Pääny Deebit.
english: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
