anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit onø köö jï jiye, ni «Ŋat wø kwøŋ ci baŋ jø Jeebuc ni 'näk geni, tïmö na kwääc lwaa leny.» Kanyøgø Jöap o Dheruya ena put cøø dïkwøŋ, ni puti tïïc na kwääc lwaa leny.
english: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit ena put bëëte kar gwøk røk mar jøøgø, ni put kaagø cwøl ni Pääny Deebit.
english: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ pääny manøgø geerrø bäre ki mana täge kanya no othørø ni wø cwøl ni Milø këël deŋŋe manøgø bäre. 'Ba Jöap thääŋ pääny mana dööŋ adwøk kare ni nyään.
english: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba teek mar Deebit aput bëëtö ni cäätha maal, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bëëdö ka eni.
english: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth jø leny moa teek døc mo Deebit, na bëëdö ni Deebit ege jølø ni teek yi bura mare, ge ki jø Icriel bëët, na røøny Deebit na nyeya ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane kiper jø Icriel,
english: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.

anywaa: nyeŋge beege ii: Ŋata dïkwøŋ beeye Jacöbiam nyï Akimöni, na bëëdö na wïth jø leny moa na adäk; ena këëdö ki tøŋ ni nääe ki jiy ma dïpe adäk ki yi leny aciel keere.
english: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata caath køøre na en røk jø leny moa na adäk na teek beeye Eliedhar o Dödö nyï Aköki.
english: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

anywaa: Eni kanya en Pacdamim buut Deebit, jø leny mo jø Pilitin aöö ni cooŋge rege bëët kaace kiper leny, yi kanya näk da pwöth beek wø cwøl ni gäbci. 'Ba kar kaaca jø leny mo jø Icriel gena bwøk nyïm jø leny mo jø Pilitin.
english: He was with David at Pas–dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki Deebit, gena cuŋŋö dï pwödhö ni ge mäna pwödhö ki jø Pilitin, ni putge jø Pilitin 'näk. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïe ki køny mo dwøŋ døc jï jø Icriel.
english: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny adäk moa en røk jø leny moa teek moa näk pïëradäk mo Deebit, gena aay ni løøcge piny ki kanya näk da kïte ni cige baŋ Deebit yi øt kïdi mana en ya Adulam, kanya bëëde ni jø leny mo jø Pilitin twïër marge ege tïïö yi Goor Rapayim.
english: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Deebit ena kanya näk kar gwøk røk; ni jø leny mo jø Pilitin ge ena kar koor marge Bethelem.
english: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Beth–lehem.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit pï poge apare ni kööe, «Wui, doo na da ŋat mooc aani ki pïï mo maadha mo käla yi iith mana en dhi kiir Bethelem, doo beer!»
english: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth–lehem, that is at the gate!

anywaa: Kanyøgø, jø leny moa na adäk na teek, gena put aay ni dønyge dï twïër mar jø leny mo jø Pilitin ki teek, ni putge lwötö ki pïï yi iith mana en dhi kiir Bethelem, ni öge ni käärge käärö, ni kälge gø baŋ Deebit. 'Ba Deebit akweer ki man maath pïï moøgø, ni put gø køny piny jï Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth–lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Ŋëët Jwøk mara, kara bääre ki pïïögø. ?Løny man tïïa gïnögø nyïm Jwøk mara? ?Løny man maadha rem jiy moi na cøø na wet jwïëcge? Kiper pïï moøgø caala rem jiy moa cøø na cïp dëëtge.» Kiper manøgø Deebit akweer ki man maath pïï moøgø. 'Ba man beeye gïrpiny aciel røk jammi moa tïïc jø lenynyi moa teek na näk adäk.
english: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.

anywaa: 'Ba Abicay cöök Jöap beeye wïth jø leny moa teek moa näk pïëradäk. Ena këëdö ki tøŋ ki jiy ma dïpe adäk ni 'näk geni. Ni put nyeŋŋe wïnyö ki røk jøøa näk pïëradäk.
english: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni ena dhaanhø mo owøørø døc ki røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk; ni put tïmö na kwääy lwaak marge. 'Ba eni kär pïï kar jøøa na adäk.
english: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat leny mør mo teek beeye Benaya o Jööda nyï Kapcël. Ena tïïö ki jap thwønh mo thööth døc. Eni jø Möap ariiø ma jø leny mo teek anääe. Eni thuwø, ena ci yi buur ni 'näge ki ŋuu dïcäŋ aciel ni piny da pey.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

anywaa: Ni ö nyï Ijepi mo dëëre dwøŋ, mo bär mare jïtö ki gööye abïïc, ni 'näk gø thuwø. 'Ba nyï Ijep mana nääe enø, cere da tøŋ mo thiire caala athøra. 'Ba Benaya aci baŋ gø ni eni käära athøra, ni cööt tøŋ wøk cer nyï Ijep, ni put gø näk ki tøŋ mar gø.
english: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moøgø beege moa tïïc Benaya o Jööda, ni put tïmö ni nyeŋŋe owïnyö ni caala nyeŋ jøøa na adäk na teek døc.
english: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni ena dhaanhø mo owøørø ki røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk. 'Ba eni kär pïï kar jøøa na adäk. 'Ba ena røøny Deebiti na wïth jø koor moe.
english: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jø leny moa teek beege: Acaël cöök Jöapi, ki El-Anan o Dödö nyï Bethelem,
english: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth–lehem,

anywaa: ki Caamöth nyï Aaröt, ki Këleth nyï Pelön,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

anywaa: ki Ira wär Ikëc nyï Tëköa, ka Abiedhar nyï Anathöth,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi–ezer the Anathothite,

anywaa: ki Cibekay nyï Uca, ki Ilay nyï Aköki,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

anywaa: ki Maaray nyï Nethöpa, ki Këlet o Baanaa nyï Nethöpa,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

anywaa: ki Itay o Ribay nyï Giba, ŋat tuuŋ jø Benjamen, ki Benaya nyï Pirathön,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

anywaa: ki Uray nyï waŋ Geäc, ka Abiël nyï Arba,
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

anywaa: ka Adhemawët nyï Barum, ki Eliaba nyï Caalbön,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

anywaa: ki wäät Acëm nyï Gidhön, ki Jönathan o Cage nyï Arar,
english: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,

anywaa: ka Akiam o Cakar nyï Arar, ki Elipal wär Ur,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

anywaa: ki Ëpër nyï Mekërath, ka Akiya nyï Pelön,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

anywaa: ki Edharø nyï Karmël, ki Naaray wär Idhbay,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

anywaa: ki Jool cöök Nathan, ki Mibar wär Agri,
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,

anywaa: ki Cëlëk nyï Amön, ki Nakaray nyï Bëëröth, nyen wø käär jap leny jï Jöap o Dheruya,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,

anywaa: ki Ira nyï Jëtër, ki Garëp nyï Jëtër,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

anywaa: ko Uria nyï Këth, ki Dhabat wär Akilay,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

anywaa: ka Adina o Cica nyï tuuŋ Ruben, ŋata näk wïth jø tuuŋ Ruben na bëëdö ni buute da jiy mo pïëradäk,
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

anywaa: ka Anan o Maika, ki Jøcapat nyï Mithan,
english: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,

anywaa: ki Ucia nyï Acterath, ki Caama ki Jïël, wäät Kötham nyï Aröör,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

anywaa: ki Jediel o Cimri ki coki ma Jöa, jø wø bëëdö Ticit,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

anywaa: ki Eliel nyï Mawïth, ki Jeribai ki Jöcabia na näk beege wäät Elnaam, ki Ithma nyï Möap,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

anywaa: ki Eliel, ki Obet, ki Jaciel, jø wø bëëdö Mecöba.
english: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

anywaa: Moi beege jøøa ci baŋ Deebit kanya en Ciklak ni kana ree kiper Cøøl o Kic, ni beege jøøa en røk jø leny moa teek mo wø køny eni ki leny.
english: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø ge käla ri jø tuuŋ Benjamen kaamar Cøøl, ni gena jiy mo thöör ka athëëre ŋäcge, ki thöör kïte mo wø thöör ki gïr thöör man wø tïïc ki kaw ni di wïrö ni kïdi okïth yie, ni løny jïge ki man thööthge bäät caam wala bäät cwïïc.
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwöthe moge beege Akiedhar ki Jöac, ni beege wäät Cimia; 'ba gena jø Giba. Ni jø leny møga beege Jedhiël ki Pelet na näk wäät Adhemawët; ki Beraka ki Jiyu jø Anathöth;
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Anathothite,

anywaa: ki Yicmaya nyï Gibien, ŋat leny mo teek ki røk jø leny moa näk pïëradäk, na bëëdö na bwödhi marge. Ki røk jø Gedëra beege Jeremaya, ki Jadhiël, ki Jöanan, ki Jödhabat.
english: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

anywaa: Ki røk jø Arup beege Eludhay, ki Jerimöth, ki Bealiya, ki Cemariya, ki Cepathiya.
english: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,

anywaa: Ki røk jøøa käl dëër Köra beege Elkana, ki Iciya, ki Adharël, ki Jöëdhër, ki Jacöbiam.
english: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,

anywaa: Ki røk jø Gëdör beege wäät Jeröam, ni beege Jöëla ki Dhebadiya.
english: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Deebiti ni eni ena kar gwøk røk mana en di paap, jø tuuŋ Gaat møøk ma jø leny gena öö ni dwätge ki jø leny moe. 'Ba gena jø leny mo teek, mo leny tøŋ man wø gëëŋ røk ki kööt leny ŋäcge, ni cwïnyge da cer kaamar ŋuuwe, ni ŋwïëy marge caala aŋeri mo wø bëëdö bäät kïte.
english: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;

anywaa: Ni mana dïkwøŋ beeye Ëdhör, ni rietge beeye Øbadiya, ni dääge beeye Eliap,
english: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

anywaa: ni ŋweerge beeye Micmana, ni bïïge beeye Jeremaya,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

anywaa: ni bïcierge beeye Attay, ni bïrietge beeye Eliel,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

anywaa: ni bäcge beeye Jöanan, ni bïŋweerge beeye Eldhabat,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

anywaa: ni paacge beeye Jeremaya, ni paac kurcierge beeye Makbanay.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

anywaa: Jøøgø beege jø tuuŋ Gaat moa bëëdö na kwääc lwaae mo leny, ni ŋat mo teek mare ena piny röömi ka jø leny ma dïpa, ni ŋat mo teek mare ena maal röömi ka jø leny ma kuma.
english: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm pinynyi na cwiir ki dwääy mana dïkwøŋ, ni Naam Jördan opäŋ døc ni kwönna wøk bäät ageela, jøøgø gena ŋut løøga, ni riemge jø wø bëëdö yïth gøli moa en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen ki jø tuuŋ Juuda gena ci kar gwøk røk baŋ Deebit.
english: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit aput cøø nee røømme ki geni, ni kööe, «Ni näk mou ö baŋa ka mëër kuna kønynyu aani, cwïnya gääbö ki uuni; 'ba ni näk kiper naa cïbu cer nyïïmän 'moa, keda man bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö en, beerra man ö Jwøki, eni na Jwø kwäyø, ni raŋ luummögø ni ŋøl gø.»
english: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ci bäät dhaanhø aciel røk jøøgø mo nyeŋŋe Amacay, ni beeye ŋato tïmö na kwääc jø leny moa näk pïëradäk, ni kööe, «Wui, Deebit o Jeci, waana moï, ni waana aciel ki ïïni bëët. Bëët-mëër kiree en bäätï ki jø wø køny ïïni. Jwøk marï ena buutï ki man køny ïïni.» Kanyøgø Deebit jøøgø aput pänhnhö ni tïïc geni na kwääri bäät jø lwaa leny moe.
english: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk thuwø ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca gena ci baŋ Deebit ni dwätge ki gø, ni beeye kanya aac Deebiti ki jø Pilitin nee ge këëtge ki nyeya ma Cøøl. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, Deebit ki jiye jø Pilitin kärge kønyø, kiper kwääri mo jø Pilitin, kanya cäänge bääte, Deebit ariemge, kiper gena köö, ni «Kanymør ø nääe nääö ni dwätge ki nyenynye ma Cøøl.»
english: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døø Deebiti Ciklak, jø leny mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca moa dwätö ki eni beege Adina, ki Jödhabat, ki Jediel, ki Mikaël, ki Jödhabat, ki Eliyu, ki Jilethay. Moøgø bëët beege kwääc lwaae mo leny mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni ŋati man nø käära jø leny ma kuma.
english: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø Deebit akønyge ni riemge dïtwïëte, kiper gena atïëte mo leny. Ni bëëtge ni gena kwääc lwaae mo leny mo Deebit.
english: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yi cäŋ cooth, da jiy mo öö ni dwätge ki jø leny mo Deebit, këël mana tïm jø lenynyi ni thööth døc.
english: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Deebiti Keeprön, jø leny mo thööth mo dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, gena dwätö ki jø leny mo Deebit kiper nee Deebit tïïcge na nyeya kar Cøøl ki køør mana caan Jwøki. 'Ba nyeŋ jøøgø beege ii:
english: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda, jø wø ŋäc leny tøŋ man wø gëëŋ røk ki kööt leny, na näk rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, beege kume abïciel ki dïpe abära.
english: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Cimien, jø leny moa näk atïëte na näk rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny beege kume abïriiø ki dïpa aciel.
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay beege jø leny ma kume aŋween ki dïpe abïciel.
english: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø cäädhi køør Jööda na näk bwödhi mar dhi øt Aran beege kume adäk ki dïpe abïriiø;
english: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

anywaa: ki Dhadök thuwø, ŋata teek ki leny, ki kwääc lwaae mo leny ma pïërariiø ka ariiø mo käla dhi øt wänni.
english: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ni beege jø tuuŋ Cøøl thuwø, gena kume adäk, 'ba thööthge akwøŋ bëëdö ni ge caatha køør dhi øt Cøøl.
english: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem, gena kume ma pïërariiø ki dïpe abära moa näk atïëte mo leny, ni ŋati man nø nyeŋŋe owïnyö ki dhi øt wänni.
english: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

anywaa: Ki røk thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca mo obëëdö jï kun wø päth cäŋŋi yie beege kume apaar ka abära na cwøl ki nyeŋge ki man öge kuna tïïcge Deebit na nyeya.
english: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Icakar, bwöthe beege dïpe ariiø, ni geno dwalø ki jø tuuŋge mo wø bëëdö ni ena tietge. 'Ba dïbwöthe moøgø gena jiy mo wïthge leer ki man ŋäcge gïïa doo tïïc jø Icrielli, ki cääŋŋe mo tïïi yïthge.
english: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan moa ci baŋ Deebit nee kønyge ni cwïnyge paa ege pääŋŋö, na näk opwönynyö ki jöör leny, ni løny jïge ki man këëtge ki teeŋ jap leny bëët, beege kume ma pïërabïïc.
english: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Naptali, kwääc lwaae mo leny beege kuma aciel, ki jø leny ma kume ma pïëradäk ka abïriiø mo wø käär tøøŋi ki kööt leny.
english: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Daan, jø leny moa näk opwönynyö ki jöör leny beege kume ma pïërariiø ka abära ki dïpe abïciel.
english: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Acer, jø leny moa näk opwönynyö na näk rege ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny beege kume ma pïëraŋween.
english: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

anywaa: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca mo wø bëëdö løø Naam Jördan løøga, moa näk opwönynyö ki jap leny bëët beege kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø.
english: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moøgø bëët na näk opwönynyö kiper leny, gena ö Keeprön ni ege ŋølø ki cwïnyge nee Deebit tïïc na nyeya bäät Icriel bäre. 'Ba jø Icriel moa dööŋ ge poot ni geno jïëy ki luummögø thuwø.
english: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena bëëdö ki nïne adäk ki Deebit ni ge mädhö ni ge cämö ki caammi moa jiiŋ tuuŋge kiperge.
english: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

anywaa: Køøre jø atude moge, këël moa karge bäyö mo wø bëëdö po jø tuuŋ Icakar, ki jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, ki jø tuuŋ Naptali, gena öö ni ge käädö ka arëëni, ka athïrööle, ki gääŋŋe, ki dhäk mo käädö ki muunni, ki nyïïolämmi mo omiinynyø na dhøgi, ki nyïïomøki mo otal, ki kwøk nyïïomøki, ki mädhi. 'Ba gena kännö thuwø ki dhäk ki dïëk nee 'näkge kiper cam. Gïïögø atïïc ni nyootha met ec mana tägö Icriel bäre.
english: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit dïbwöthe bëët, ni beege kwääc lwaa kume, ki kwääc lwaa dïpe, acooŋe ni pëëny acaara marge.
english: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï jø Icriel bëët, ni «Ni näk mo beeye gïn mo beer ki jïïu, ni beeye mana many Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøk marø, beerra man jäägø baŋ tuuŋø moa no odööŋ yi ŋööm Icriel kwörögø bëët. Ni jäägø baŋ dïlämme thuwø ki jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø bëëdö ki geni yïth päänye moge moa näk da kwör kwaath, nee dwätge ki øøni,
english: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

anywaa: kiper nee ø cøø ni duuø acanduk mar Jwøk marø, na näk kärø manynyø yïth nïr Cøøl.»
english: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët gena jïëy ni tïïcge tïïö, kiper luubö manøgø atïmö ni beer ki baŋ jiy bëët.
english: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Deebit jø Icriel aput cooŋ bëët ki mana täge jï løø tier-piny ki bäät naam wø cwøl ni Ciör na en waŋ keew ki Ijep, këël kany wø cwøl ni Libö-Amath na en jï løø wïpiny, na acanduk mar Jwøk nee øømge Kiriat-Jeerim.
english: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit ki jø Icriel bëët gena put ci Baala, ni beeye Kiriat-Jeerim, na en kur jø Juuda, na acanduk mar Jwøk nee kälge, ni beeye acanduk mana no ocaa ri nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni wø bëëdö yïthakic nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli.
english: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath–jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

anywaa: Køøre acanduk aputge lwør po Abinadap ni cïpge gø bäät jääy mo nyään man wø tut dhäki nee käärge ki bääte. Ni ö Udha ka Akïïö ni bwøthge maal nyïm gø.
english: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, Deebit ki jø Icriel bëët gena put miel døc ni ge wär ki dudi ni yïthge met nyïm Jwøk ki teek marge bäre, ni jøw pöödö ki thøme mo wø pwöt ni di roodø, ki thøp-othïënhö, ka anëët; na adijeege tuuŋge tuuŋŋö, ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge ri laara mar Kidön, dhäk moa käär acanduk tietge aceec ni tïmge ni manynya pädhö; ni ö Udha ni put cere tïŋ maal baŋ acanduk nee jøle.
english: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Wuuö Jwøk aput wëër døc ki Udha, ni put gø näk kiper mana tïŋ cere maal bäät acanduk, ni ö Udha ni put thøø kaace nyïm Jwøk.
english: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit agootø døc kiper mana ö wëëc Wuuö Jwøki na päth bäät Udha ni jääla gø. Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace aput cwøl ni Peereth-Udha këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit aput lwäyö ki Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋögø, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk okïtha gø paac baŋa nidïï këët nø?»
english: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Deebit acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk käre kälö këët ki man kïth gø yi Pääny Deebit. 'Ba acanduk manøgø akïth Deebiti yi øt Obet-Idöm nyï Gëth.
english: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk aput bëëte yi øt Obet-Idöm nyï Gëth ki dwäde adäk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni gwïëth po Obet-Idöm ki gïïa en jïre bëët.
english: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed–edom, and all that he had.

anywaa: 'Ba Kiram nyeny Tayar ajääk baŋ Deebit ki jiy ni ge käädö ki jer øtø moa perge leth, ki jø wø gëëdö ki kïte, ki jiy ma dïjëëth opämi, kiper nee gëëtge ki øtø jï Deebit.
english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

anywaa: 'Ba aput Deebiti ŋäc ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na këël tier nyec mare piny, nee put bëëte na nyeya mar jø Icriel; ni ŋäc gø thuwø ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk na tïŋ nyec mare maal kiper jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput nyöömö ki mään møøk yi Jerucalem, ni put jïtö ki wääte ki nyïïe møøk.
english: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ obwöre moe moa nywøle kanya en Jerucalem beege Cimia, ki Cöbap, ki Nathan, ki Cølöman,
english: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

anywaa: ki Ibar, ki Elicua, ki Elpelet,
english: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

anywaa: ki Nöga, ki Napëk, ki Japia,
english: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

anywaa: ki Elicama, ki Beeliada, ki Elipelet.
english: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya jø Pilitinni ni Deebit onø røøny na nyeya mar jø Icriel, jø leny mo jø Pilitin bëët atïŋŋö ni cige kuna määnyge baŋ Deebit; 'ba gïnögø awïny Deebiti ni ci wøk baŋge.
english: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Pilitin apïï ni putge goor Rapayim tuk.
english: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit Jwøk apëënynye, ni kööe, ni «?Løny man cøøa baŋ leny baŋ jø Pilitin? ?A ni näk mo aano ci baŋge, ge cïbï cera?» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Deebit, ni «Ciï; ge cïba cerï.»
english: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, gena put ci kanya cakge ni Baal-Peradhim, ni ö Deebiti ni put jø Pilitin böötö kaace; ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk nyïïmän 'moa abööte ki raa ni caala pänh jwïëö kany wø räänye.» Kiper manøgønø, nyeŋ kaace aputge cak ni Baal-Peradhim.
english: So they came up to Baal–perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal–perazim.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin juu moge mo wø lamge adööŋ piny kaace; ni ö Deebiti ni cïpe ki dwøl nee juu mo jø Pilitin waaŋ; ni puti waaŋ ki maac.
english: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Pilitin acäŋ duuö ni cäŋge gool manøgø tugö.
english: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit Jwøk acäŋ pëënynyö, ni kö Jwøki jïre, «Ï ba doo cøøa baŋge ni tiir jaak; 'ba ge diï ŋøønya piny ni cääthï bäätge kanya enge yie deŋ lul.
english: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme ni da dwøl mo caala tiet jø leny mo wïnynyï wïnynyö ki bäät lul, ï doo puta døny wøk baŋ leny; kiper nyootha gø ni Jwøk onø ci nyïmmu ki man këëde ki jø leny mo jø Pilitin.»
english: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø aput Deebiti tïïc na kare, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni, ni putge jø leny mo jø Pilitin 'näk ki mana täge ki Gibien këël mana këët Gëdher.
english: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

anywaa: 'Ba gïr Deebit awïnyö tiet mïëri bëët; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl lwär mo dwøŋ bäät wïth juurre bëët ni ge lwäära Deebit.
english: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit ena gëëdö ki uudi kipere yi pääny mana caa ri nyeŋŋe ni Pääny Deebit; ni jiiŋ kar acanduk mar Jwøk, ni cööth piny ko oduŋkaara kiper gø.
english: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Ba løny jï dhaanhø jaak ki man käär acanduk mar Jwøk, 'ba beeye jø tuuŋ Libay keerge noo käär gø. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk jø tuuŋ Libay ee jierø kiper na acanduk mar Jwøk nee wø käärge, ni jier geni thuwø ki man tïnyge eni na bäre bäre.»
english: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit jø Icriel bëët acooŋ yi Jerucalem, na acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk nee øømge, nee kïth kanya jiiŋŋe kiper gø.
english: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni cooŋ jøøa käl dëër Aran ki jø tuuŋ Libay bëët.
english: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

anywaa: Ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Kät, bwödhi marge beeye Uriel; ni kwäänge beege dïpa ki pïërariiø;
english: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

anywaa: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Mërari, bwödhi marge beeye Acaaya; ni kwäänge beege dïpe ariiø ki pïërariiø;
english: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

anywaa: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Gërcön, bwödhi marge beeye Jool; ni kwäänge beege dïpa ki pïëradäk;
english: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

anywaa: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Elicapan, bwödhi marge beeye Cemaya; ni kwäänge beege dïpe ariiø;
english: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

anywaa: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Keeprön, bwödhi marge beeye Eliel; ni kwäänge beege pïërabära;
english: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

anywaa: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Udhiel, bwödhi marge beeye Aminadap; ni kwäänge beege dïpa ka apaar kurriiø;
english: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit Dhadök ka Abiethaar na bëëdö na dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege Uriel, ka Acaaya, ki Jool, ki Cemaya, ki Eliel, ka Aminadap, acwøle,
english: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Bee u na bwöthe mo dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Libay; cïbu dëëtu kur keeru na mo Jwøk, uuni bëët ki jø tuŋi mou, ni øømmu acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee cïp kanya jiiŋŋa kipere.
english: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.

anywaa: Acanduk manøgø, kiper mana näk mo käru käärö kar kanyøca, Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marø awëër ki øøni kiper mana kärø eni manynyø ki køør ciik.»
english: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay, dëëtge aputge cïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk ki man øømge acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät jø tuuŋ Libay acanduk mar Jwøk aputge biellø ki göökge ki jer tëër moe ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ceme ki ri Modhe.
english: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit bwöthe mo jø tuuŋ Libay acäänne nee jëëtge røk jø tuuŋge ki jiy mo wär ki dudi ki wïth thøme ma teeŋi, ka athaliiŋŋi moo jwöŋi ni döötge ena maal, nee döötge tïŋge maal ni wärge ki met ec.
english: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tuuŋ Libay, Ëman o Jool ajierge, ka Acaap o Berekiya, na en røk jø tuuŋ Ëman, ki Ëtan o Kucaya, na en ri tuuŋ jøøa käl dëër Mërari.
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa jier na mo caath køør jøøgø ki røk jø tuŋi moge beege Dhekaraya, ki Jaajiel, ki Cemiramöth, ki Jikiël, ki Oni, ki Eliap, ki Benaya, ki Maycëya, ki Matitiya, ki Elipelu, ki Mikneya; ki jø wø koor dhi kal, ni beege Obet-Idöm ki Jïël.
english: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

anywaa: Ki røk jø wär ki dudi moøgø, Ëman, ka Acaap, ki Ëtan, gena jier bäät athaliiŋŋi moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël nee tuuŋge døc.
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

anywaa: 'Ba Dhekaraya, ka Ajiel, ki Cemiramöth, ki Jikiël, ki Oni, ki Eliap, ki Maycëya, ki Benaya, gena cïp bäät pwöt thøp-othïënhö moa döötge wetø.
english: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

anywaa: 'Ba Matitiya, ki Elipelu, ki Mikneya, ki Obet-Idöm, ki Jïël, ka Acaciya, gena cïp bäät pwöt thøp-othïënhö moa döötge døøŋŋø.
english: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed–edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

anywaa: 'Ba Kenaniya na bëëdö na bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Libay, ena jier bäät jø wär ki dudi na ŋat neet geni; ni beeye ŋat wø pwöny geni ki jöör wär dudi, kiper ena dhaanhø mo waŋe riek ki wär dudi.
english: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

anywaa: 'Ba Berekiya ki Elkana beege jø koor dhi øtø mana en acanduki yie.
english: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

anywaa: 'Ba Cebaniya, ki Jøcapat, ki Natanel, ka Amacay, ki Dhekaraya, ki Benaya, ki Eliëdher, na bëëdö na dïlämme, gena jier na jø kooth tuŋi nyïm acanduk mar Jwøk. 'Ba Obet-Idöm ki Jekiya gena jier thuwø na jø koor dhi øtø mana en acanduki yie.
english: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed–edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Deebit ki jø døøk Icriel, ki kwääc lwaa kume, na cøø ki met ec kuna øømge acanduk po Obet-Idöm, ni beeye acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy.
english: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obed–edom with joy.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö Jwøki na køny jø tuuŋ Libay moa käär acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, gena cïpö ki rwädhe abïriiø, ki nyöök rööm abïriiø no olämi jï Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit oruyö ka abïï mo cwääc ka waac lïïna mo piilli, ge ki jø tuuŋ Libay bëët moa käär acanduk, ki jø wär ki dudi, ge ki bwödhi marge ma Kenaniya. 'Ba Deebit thuwø eno ruyö ka abïïn wø cwøl ni ëëput, na näk cwääc ka waac lïïna.
english: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel bëët acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy aputge kälö ni ge kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni ge kudhö ki tuk lääy, ki tuŋi moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö, na athaliiŋŋi moo jwöŋi ni döötge ena maal tuuŋge tuuŋŋö, ni ge pöödö ki wïth thøme ma teeŋi.
english: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya time na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy pïï dï Pääny Deebit, Mikal nyi Cøøl, na näk cï Deebit, aräŋŋö ki dha awëërnyeŋ ni joot nyeya ma Deebit ni pärö ni miel; ni put nyeya taak ki cwïnye.
english: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø acanduk mar Jwøk akälge ni cïpge gø yo oduŋkaara mana no onø cwöth Deebiti piny kiper gø. Køøre gena cïpö ko olämme jï Jwøk, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Deebiti ki cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, jiy agwïëdhe ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre eni dääpe, ka aleye mo rïŋ, ki nyïïomøki mo omiinynyø na dhøgi apääŋŋe jï jø Icriel bëët, ni beege cwøw ki mään, ni pääŋŋe jï ŋati man nø.
english: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit jø møøk acuume ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay nee tïïge nyïm acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk ni ge dwøga pwøc ka ajiem ki wödö jï Wuuö Jwøk Jwø Icriel.
english: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba Acaap beeye na bwödhi marge, ni ŋata caath køøre beeye Dhekaraya. 'Ba jiy mo pöödö ki thøp-othïënhö beege Jïël, ki Cemiramöth, ki Jikiël, ki Matitiya, ki Eliap, ki Benaya, ki Obet-Idöm, ki Jïël; na Acaap beeye ŋat wø tuuŋ athaliiŋŋi mo wø jwöŋi ni döötge ena maal.
english: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed–edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

anywaa: 'Ba Benaya ki Jadhiël, na bëëdö na dïlämme, beege ni wø kudhö ki tuŋi cooth nyïm acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöce kiree, Acaap ki tuuŋge aput Deebiti jier dïkwøŋ nee met ec dwøkge jï Wuuö Jwøk ki duut man:
english: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋe, ni caannu tïïe moe nee wïny wïth juurre.
english: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

anywaa: Wärru jïre, wärru duut pwøc jïre, ni caannu tïïe moe bëët na näk rëëma ec.
english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.

anywaa: Jiemmu nyeŋŋe na en kur keere; beerra man mïn yïth jø wø cac Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

anywaa: Cayu Wuuö Jwøk ki teek mare, ni manynyu eni cooth. 12-13
english: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.

anywaa: U na nyïïkwaac dhaanhnhe ma Icriel, ni bee u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap na näk ee jierø, caarru wïthu ki gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïe, këël ŋïïce moe ki luup ŋøl moa caane ki dhee.
Eni na Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk marø; ŋøl mare ena bäät piny bäre.
english: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

anywaa: Eni luumma tuude di lääŋŋö na bäre bäre, ni bëëde ni luumma caane di lääŋŋö këël yïth beenhnhe ma kume,
english: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

anywaa: ni beeye luumma tuude ki Eeberam, na kööŋe kiper gø jï Aydhak,
english: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

anywaa: ni cäŋ gø tuutö ki Jeekap, ni beeye Icriel, nee bëëde na bäre bäre;
english: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Ŋööm Keenan omëëga ïïni, ni tïme na kur nyïïkwaayu.»
english: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

anywaa: Kanya bëëtge ni kwäänge nøk, ni ge nøk døc ni gena wëëlle yi ŋöömmögø,
english: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

anywaa: ni ge wïïrö tiet mïëri, ni ge cøøa paac man nø ki baŋ jøøi nø,
english: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

anywaa: ge käre wëëk dhaanhø mør nee ge thiel piny; nyeye aköömme kiperge, ni kööe,
english: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

anywaa: ni «Jiya na näk yaa jierø kär gutu, ni ba tïïu dëëtge ki gïï mo leth, ge na nyïïkuk 'moa.»
english: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk, u na jø bäät piny bëët, ni caannu luumma met mar køny mare ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

anywaa: Køpu ajieme jï wïth juurre bëët, ni køpu tïïe moe moa näk rëëma ec jï jiy bëët.
english: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ no orømø ki pwøc døc; eni di lwäärö ni kaala juu bëët.
english: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

anywaa: Kiper juu bëët mo wïth juurre beege juu mo oballe jaak, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk bee eni na cwääc maal.
english: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

anywaa: Wödö ka ajiem joota baŋe; ni ö teeki ki met ec ni joodi yi øt lam mare.
english: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, u na wïth tuŋi bëët mo bäät piny bäre; jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ki køør ajiem mare ki teek mare.
english: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ka ajiem mo orømø ki nyeŋŋe; kännu ki muuce ni ööu baŋe; wøørru Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni ena kur keere.
english: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

anywaa: U jø bäät piny bëët, ööu nyïme ni dëëtu kwanynyi. Piny acïp kare ni teek ni ba løny ki daak.
english: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

anywaa: Beerra man mïn yïth gïïa en maalli, ni ö gïïa en bäät pinynyi ni kanyge. Beerra man caange luumme yïthakic wïth juurre, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye kwäärö.»
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.

anywaa: Beerra man lwör naama dwøŋŋi ni kanynye ki gïïa en yie bëët; beerra man ö pwöthi ni kanyge ki gïïa en yïthge bëët.
english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace thuwø jer paap bëët yïthge omïnni ni wärge ki dudi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni cäädha jöö, ni ööa kuna ŋøl luup mo piny.
english: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Kööu, ni «Wui Jwøk, ï na pïëmi marwa, piem waani; ni lemï wa ni piemï wa yïthakic wïth juurre, kiper nee nyeŋŋï na en kur keere pwøcwa, ni jiemwa ïïni kany wø pwøcwa ïïni.
english: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ki mana täge cøøn, këël bäre bäre.» Køøre jiy bëët aköö, ni «Beeye kare!» ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø Acaap ki jø tuuŋge acuum Deebiti ki man tïïge nyïm oduŋkaara kany wø bëët acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy yie, nee tïïge cooth ki køør jöör tïïc mana no ocïp piny kiper yi cäŋ man nø.
english: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

anywaa: 'Ba Obet-Idöm ki jø tuuŋge ma pïërabïciel ka abära, jøøgø akønyge ki tïïc. Ni ö Obet-Idöm wär Jeduthun ki Öca ni näkge beege jø koor dhi kal.
english: And Obed–edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed–edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

anywaa: 'Ba Dhadök na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ, ki jø tuuŋge møøk ma dïlämme, gena cuum ki man raŋge oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk na en bäät thuur mana en Gibien.
english: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,

anywaa: Ni kany wø tïme na amöölla ka abøøya cooth, olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre wø waaŋge waaŋø jï Wuuö Jwøk bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Ni manøgø tïïcge ka køør luup bëët moa no ogöör piny yi wëël ciik Wuuö Jwøk na kööm jø Icriel ki ge.
english: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;

anywaa: 'Ba Ëman, ki Jeduthun, ki jø møøk mo ojierø no ocøørø ki nyeŋge, gena tïïö na aciel ki dïlämme moøgø, ki man dwøkge pwøc jï Jwøk, kiper mëër mare bëëdö na bäre bäre ni ba jøøl.
english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;

anywaa: Ni ö Ëmanni ki Jeduthun ni cäŋge cuummö kiper nee tuŋi koothge, ni tuuŋge athaliiŋŋi ki jammi møøk mo wø cïpi ki dwøl mo wär dut Jwøk ki ge; ni ö wäät Jeduthun ni bëëtge ni ge koora dhi kal.
english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët adøø mïëcge, ni ŋati man nø aa paare; ni ö Deebiti thuwø ni døø paan dwøŋ kuna gwïëth jø paare.
english: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Deebiti ni bëëdö paan dwøŋ yi øde mana geer jïre, ena köö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ni «Neenï, aani a bëëdö yi øtø mo geer ka jenni mo perge leth; 'ba acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, bëëdö yo oduŋkaara jaak.»
english: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.

anywaa: Køøre Nathan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Beerra man tïïyï jammi bëët moa manynyï ki cwïnyï, kiper Jwøk ena buutï.»
english: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïwäänögø, dwør Jwøk aö bäät Nathan ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ dhaanhnha ma Deebit ni caanï luumma jïre, ni kööï ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Paa ïïni noo gëëdö ki øtø jïra mo bëëda yie;
english: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

anywaa: kiper aani, a kär bëëdö yi øtø ki mana täge ki kanya käla jø Icriel wøk ki Ijep këël dïcäŋ man; 'ba aana bëëdö ni kar bëëtö mara beeye oduŋkaara.
english: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

anywaa: ?'Ba kwöra caadha ki jø Icriel bëët, da gïn mo yaa maar caan jï dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel, moa köömma ni käärge jiya, mo aano köö, na «?Aperŋø, ni ba gëëdu ki øtø jïra en, mo geer ka jenni mo perge leth?»?›
english: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, caanï jï dhaanhnha ma Deebit, ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, ïïna jiera kanya enï pwöl kwaath niï kwaaya dïëk, niï tïmï ni ïïna dïbwödhi mar jiya ma jø Icriel.
english: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba aana bëëdö ki ïïni ki yïth kwöra caathï bëët, ni dïïra wïth nyïïmän moï nyïmï; 'ba nyeŋŋï poot tïïa tïïö nee wïnye, ni caala nyeŋ jiy moa no owïnyö døc bäät piny.
english: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba aani thuwø da kany mo jiera jierø kiper jiya ma jø Icriel, nee tietge këëtge piny yie, ni beeye kany bëëtge yie na poge, ni tïme ni bäŋ jiy mo kiera wïthge këët, ni bäŋe jiy mo wïthge reyø mo caara ge këët kaawat mana dïkwøŋ,
english: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

anywaa: ni beeye ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa thïïŋa pïëmme jï jiya ma jø Icriel. 'Ba aani nyïïmän moï bëët bööta böötö. 'Ba ennø, a caana gø jïrï, ni beeye a Wuuö Jwøk noo tïïc dhi ødï ni teek.
english: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo päŋ nïne moï noo thøwï noo läpï køør kwäyu, aani da ŋat mo käla dëërï mo thïïŋa thïïŋö køørï ki røk wäätï; 'ba aani tier buc nyec mare këëlla piny;
english: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

anywaa: ni ö eni ni gëëde jïra ki øtø, ni këëlla tier wälu mare piny na bäre bäre.
english: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba aano bëëdö ni aana wuuö jïre, ni bëëde na wäädö jïra. 'Ba mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl, na paanya bäät ŋata läwï kare, ba paanya bäät ŋataca.
english: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:

anywaa: 'Ba eni wëëga käär øtø mara ki bura mara na bäre bäre. Ni ö tier wälu mare ni këët piny na bäre bäre.› »
english: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

anywaa: Køøre Nathan luup bëët, ki gïïa nyooth Jwøki jïre bëët, acaane jï Deebit.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit aci kar lam ni pï piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni läme na ennønø, «?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana ŋa? ?A dhi øtø mara thuwø nyïëdi, ni tïïyï gïïögø bëët yøø kipera?
english: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

anywaa: ?Wui, Jwøk, ki jïrï gïna nø tïïyï enø beeye gïn mo thiinh jaak? 'Ba ïïna cäŋ cäänö kiper gïno tïïyï yi nyïme kunece kiper dhi øtø mara, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni neenï aani kaamar dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ.
english: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.

anywaa: «?Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, agïnaŋø noo caana jïrï këët nø, ki køør wödö man bäre en na cïpï jïra? Kiper a na dhaanhnhï en, cwïnya oløny ni ŋäyï døc.
english: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør mana caarï ki cwïnyï, ïïna tïïö ki gïn mo dwøŋ kipera, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni wëëgï luupögø bëët ni døøŋŋø yøø tïïc nee bëëtge ni ŋäc.
english: O Lord, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï ena kur keerï, ni bäŋ jwøk mør këët, 'ba bee ï keerï, kaa mana wïnywa gø ki ïthwa.
english: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

anywaa: Bäŋ wï jur bäät piny kany mo caala jiyï ma jø Icriel, jøøa wïïlï wøk na tïïyï na jiyï, ni tïïyï nyeŋŋï nee wïnye ki køør jammi moa døøŋŋø mo di lwäärö na tïïyï, ni riemï wïth juurre wøk nyïmge, kanya kälï ge wøk ki Ijep.
english: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jiyï ma jø Icriel atïïyï na thöögï na bäre bäre, ni tïmï ni ïïna Jwøk marge.
english: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, luubö mana caanï kipera, a na dhaanhnhï, ki dhi øtø mara, beerra man putï gø wëëk thur kare na bäre, ni tïïyï gø kaawat mana nø caanï gø.
english: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋŋï obëëdö ni dwøŋ no okëët piny ni teek na bäre bäre, ni kö jiyi, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye Jwøka eni mar jø Icriel, ni beeye Jwø Icriel møn.› 'Ba a na dhaanhnhï ma Deebit en, put dhi øtø mara tïïc ni teek nyïmï.
english: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, gïnögø anø nyoothï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, ni kööï ni dhi øtø mara tïïyï tïïö ni teek. Kiper manøgønø, a na dhaanhnhï en, cwïnya ajïtö ki cer ki man läma nyïmï.
english: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bee ï na Jwøk møn; ni bee ï na buuk luummi en na beer jïra, a na dhaanhnhï.
english: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, iï anø mïnnö ni nø gwïëthï dhi øtø mara, a na dhaanhnhï en, nee tïme ni puta bëëte ni nut na bäre bäre nyïmï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dhi øtø mara anø gwïëthï, ni put gwïëthi manøgø bëëte ni nut na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.»
english: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, Deebit akëëdö ki jø Pilitin ni dwøk wïthge piny, ni mac päänya cwøl ni Gëth ceŋ jø Pilitin ki mïëri moe moa en buute.
english: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

anywaa: Køøre eni jø Möap abööte thuwø, ni put jø Möapi tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit ni ge cïpö ka ajwäk jï gø.
english: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti thuwø ni bööt Adadëdher nyeny Dhöba ki leny deŋ kanya cwøl na Amath, kanya aae ni cøøa kuna cäŋ nyec mare dwøk kare bäät Naam Upareeti;
english: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

anywaa: ni ö Deebiti ni mak jïëth leny ma kuma aciel mo wø tut okwëënyi cer nyeya ma Adadëdher, ki jø leny ma kume abïriiø mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi, ki jø leny ma kume ma pïërariiø mo wø cäädhi ki tietge. Ni ö Deebiti ni ŋøør ojwönyi mo tiet okwëënyi bëët mo wø tut jïëthe. 'Ba møøk mo orømø awiie kiper jïëth leny ma dïpa.
english: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Aram moa en Damacka na öge kuna kønyge Adadëdher nyeny Dhöba, Deebit anääö ki jø Aram ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø.
english: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit aput cïp piny ki jø leny mo koor mïëc jø Aram moa en tier Damacka, ni ö jø Arammi ni putge tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit ni ge cïpö ka ajwäk jïre. 'Ba Deebit kany wø tuge yie jaak, Wuuö Jwøk puta bëëte ni køønynya gø.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit kööde mo leny moa käär jø lenynyi mo Adadëdher na näk otïïö ki warkey aput lwør ni käl ge yi Jerucalem.
english: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yi pääny man wø cwøl ni Tibath ki man wø cwøl ni Kun moa näk mo Adadëdher, Deebit akädö yïthge ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli mo thööth døc. Ni beege japa ö Cølömanni ni tïïc jap Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki ge, ni bee gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, ki gïïa näk caala dïkweeye, ki jap paac.
english: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Töu nyeny jø Amath na wïny gø ni Deebit jø leny mo Adadëdher bëët ee nø böötö,
english: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

anywaa: Töu wääde ma Adöram aput jääŋŋö baŋ nyeya ma Deebit nee määdhe mare ki gwïëth mare caan jï Deebit, kiper mana ö Deebiti na këëde ka Adadëdher ni bööt gø; kiper Adadëdher bëëdö ni këëdö ki Töu. 'Ba Adöram o Töu aay ni käädö jï Deebit ki gïï mo tïïc ka warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit gïïögø aput cïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni dwal ge bäät warkie ki gwet-bïrö moa näk ee kälö baŋ wïth juurre bëët, ni beege jø Ëdöm, ki jø Möap, ki jø Amön, ki jø Pilitin, ki jø Amalëk.
english: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

anywaa: 'Ba Abicay o Dheruya jø Ëdöm ma kume apaar ka abära anääe yi Goor Acäbö;
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

anywaa: ni put dï Ëdöm kïthö ki jø leny mo koor, ni ö jø Ëdömmi bëët ni putge tïmö ni ge bëënna Deebit. 'Ba Deebit kany wø tuge yie jaak Wuuö Jwøk puta bëëte ni køønynya gø.
english: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput bëëdö na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët, ni luup ŋøle na karge, ni bëëde ni tïïya adïëri jï jiye bëët.
english: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap o Dheruya beeye kwääy lwaa leny, ni ö Jøcapati wär Akilut ni bëëde na nyikugö.
english: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhadök wär Akitöp ka Ayemëlëk wär Abiethaar beege dïlämme moa døøŋŋø, ni ö Cabca ni bëëde ni beeye ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny.
english: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

anywaa: 'Ba Benaya o Jööda beeye kwääy lwaak mar jø leny mo wø koor nyeya, ni beege jø Kelita ki jø Pelita. 'Ba wäät Deebit beege jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø na en buut nyeya.
english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, Naøc nyeny jø Amön athøw, ni ö wääde ma Anun ni ci kar wänni na nyeya.
english: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö, ni «Aani mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl nyoodha nyoodhø jï Anun o Naøc, kiper mana ö wänni na nyooth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl jïra.» Kanyøgø Deebit aput jääk baŋ Anun ki jiy nee cwïny Anun cømge kiper thøø mar wänni. 'Ba kanya ö jic Deebiti na pïïcge yi ŋööm jø Amön nee cwïny gø cømge,
english: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

anywaa: jø Amön moa kwörge døøŋŋø aköö jï nyenyge ma Anun, na «?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni Deebit wøøra wäru, na jääŋ baŋï ki jiy mo cøm cwïnyï? ?Aŋø, Deebit jiye ba jääŋŋe baŋï ni marge liew paac nee tukge yi nyïme?»
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Anun jic Deebit aput mak, ni liel jïëc tïkge, ni ö abïïe moge moa näk caala jalabiiye ni ŋøør ge ni cëëgö ni ena dhøk wödhi, ni wëëk ge wääth.
english: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

anywaa: Køøre jø møøk aöö ni caange gïna tägö dëët jøøgø jï Deebit, ni put Deebiti jääk baŋge ki jiy nee ge jøli kiper laac wïc mana dwøŋ na en dëëtge, ni kööe jï jøøa jääŋŋi, ni «Caannu jïge, ni ‹Putu bëëte Jerikö këël mano tuc jïëc tïgu, køøre nø, uuno duui.› »
english: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Amönni na jootge gø ni dëëtge ege nø tïïc ni caala gïn mo ŋwäänynye raac ki jï Deebit, geni ki nyenyge ma Anun gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma kuma aciel ajääŋge baŋ jø Mecöpatemia, ki baŋ jø Aram-Maika, ki baŋ jø Dhöba, nee määnyge ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi.
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria–maacah, and out of Zobah.

anywaa: 'Ba ki gwetøge gena jïtö ki jïëth leny ma kume ma pïëradäk ka ariiø mo wø tut okwëënyi, këël ki nyeny Maika ki jø leny moe; ni ö jøøgø ni tïïcge twïër marge nyïm Medeba. Kanyøgø ge na jø Amön gena öö ki yïth päänye moge ni cooŋge rege ni öge baŋ leny.
english: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na wïny gïnögø, eni Jöap ki jø leny moa teek bëët ajääŋŋe.
english: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Amönni ni öge wøk ni cïïmge rege kiper leny dhi kiir mar pääny marge. Ni ö nyeye moa ö kuna kunyge ni cïïmge rege kur keerge dï pwöla.
english: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöapi na joot gø ni leny oløny ni ööa bääte ki nyïme ki ŋääe, ena jëëdö ki jiy moa teek røk jø leny mo Icriel, ni cïïm ge na dhøgi nee këëtge ki jø Aram.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moa dööŋ acïp cer coki ma Abicay, ni ö geni ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi nee këëtge ki jø Amön.
english: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aköö jï coki ma Abicay, «Ni näk mo jø Aram tïmö ni ge teek bääta, a wär kønyï; 'ba ni näk mo jø Amön tïmö ni ge teek bäätï, ï kønya kønyø.
english: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.

anywaa: 'Ba mak riï nø ni këëdø ni ø teek kiper jø pøø ki päänye mo Jwøk marø. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc mana beerra eni ki jïre.»
english: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jöap ki jø leny moe na en buute, gena ci baŋ leny ki jø Aram, ni ö jø Arammi ni bwøkge nyïme.
english: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Amönni na jootge gø ni jø Aram obwøk, gena put bwøk thuwø nyïm Abicay cöök Jöapi, ni dønyge yi pääny. Køøre Jöap aput duu Jerucalem.
english: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Arammi na jootge gø ni gena nø bööt jø Icrielli, gena jäägö ki jiy nee jø Aram moa en løø Naam Upareeti løøga öge, ki Cöpak na näk kwääy lwaa leny mar Adadëdher na näk bwödhi marge.
english: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö gïnögø na caani jï Deebit, jø leny mo jø Icriel bëët acooŋ kanya ciel ni aacge ni ŋutge løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni cääthge bäät jø Aram; ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi nee këëtge ki geni. 'Ba kanya ö jø leny mo Deebit na cïïmge rege ni këëtge ki jø Aram, jø Aram thuwø gena këëdö ki Deebit.
english: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Aram gena bwøk nyïm jø Icriel, ni ö Deebiti ni nääe ki jø Aram ma kume abïriiø mo wø këëdi ki bäät jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny ma kume ma pïëraŋween mo wø këëdi ki piny. Ni 'näkge Cöpak na näk kwääy lwaa leny.
english: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti jic Adadëdher ni geno bööt jø Icrielli, gena tudö ki luubö nee bëëtge ki bëët mëër ki Deebit ni bëënge gø. 'Ba ki mana täge kar kaaca, jø Aram gena put kweer ki man kønyge jø Amön këët.
english: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni piny otal ni bäŋ køth këët, ni beeye kany wø ci nyeye baŋ mäny, Jöap jø leny mo jø Icriel abwøth wøk, ni ö jøøgø ni cige ni raanyge po jø Amön ni putge päänya dwøŋ na cwøl ni Raaba tieø dïër. 'Ba Deebit odööŋ yi Jerucalem. Ni ö Jöapi ni nyak Raaba ni raany gø.
english: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aduda mar nyeya mar jøøgø aput lwør wï gø. 'Ba aduda manøgø tïïc ka warkey mo peek døc ma rumi ma kikar aciel, ni yie da waŋ kïdi mo pere leth; ni ö aduda manøgø ni puti kïth wï Deebit. 'Ba Deebit gïïa twiere pääny manøgø beege gïï mo thööth døc.
english: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit thuwø, jøøa bøth yi pääny manøgø amaae ni käl ge wøk, ni kïth ceŋge ki lïge, ki teeŋ jap tïïc mo tïïc ka nywïëny, nee ge tïïge ki ge. Ni ö Deebiti ni tïïc teeŋ gïnögø dëët jøøa en yïth päänye bëët mo jø Amön. Køøre Deebit ki jø leny moe bëët gena put døø Jerucalem.
english: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, leny mør acäŋ këëllö ki jø Pilitin yi Gëdher. Kanyøgønø, Cibekay nyï Uca, nyen mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Cipay mo käla ri tuuŋ jøøa bäyö døc ni dëëtge døøŋŋø aput 'näk, ni ö jø Pilitin ni bööt geni.
english: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

anywaa: Ni ö lenynyi mør ni cäŋi këëllö ki jø Pilitin kaace thuwø. 'Ba El-Anan o Jayer, Laami anääe, ni beeye Laami cöök Göliati nyï Gëth, nyen mo thiir tøŋ mare caala athøra.
english: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.

anywaa: Køøre leny mør acäŋ këëllö Gëth; 'ba da dhaanhø kaaca mo bäär døc ni  dëëre dwøŋ, mo lweet ceŋŋe abïciel abïciel, ni lweet tiete thuwø abïciel abïciel, ni lweete ge bëët beege pïërariiø kurŋween. 'Ba eni thuwø nywöli ka ri tuuŋ jøøa bäyö døc ni dëëtge døøŋŋø.
english: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyenøgø na ŋwöe bäät jø Icriel, Jönathan o Cimia, ni beeye Cimia cöök Deebiti, nyenøgø anääe.
english: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët ge nywöli ka ri tuuŋ jøøa bäyö døc ni dëëtge døøŋŋø na en Gëth; 'ba geni gena 'näk Deebiti ki jø leny moe.
english: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

anywaa: 'Ba Ceethan aö maal bäät jø Icriel ki man raany geni, ni tïïc Deebit nee jø Icriel kwaane.
english: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput köö jï Jöap ki kwääc lwaae mo leny, ni «Cou ni kwaannu jø Icriel bëët, ki mano täge ki Bëërcïïba na en tier-piny këël mano këët Daan na en wï-piny; ni kännu ki dwøl jïra nee kwäänge ŋääa.»
english: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

anywaa: Køøre Jöap aköö, ni «Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni meet jiyï kwöre ma dïpa ni kaala moi ni nut ii. 'Ba ennø, Awuuö, ï na nyeya mara, ?jø Icriel bëët patha jiyï? ?Aperŋø ni tïïyï riï na jöö man käl bääyö bäät jø Icriel en?»
english: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba luum nyeya atïmö ni teek bäät Jöap. Kanyøgø Jöap aput tïŋŋö ni ci dï Icriel bäre kuna kwaan jø Icriel, ni duu Jerucalem.
english: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre kwään jiy moa kwaane bëët aput cïp jï Deebit. 'Ba kwään jø Icriel bëët mo wø këëdi ko opëëlle beege cwøw ma miilïën aciel ki kume ma dïpa. 'Ba kwään jø tuuŋ Juuda mo wø këëdi ko opëëlle gena cwøw ma kume ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïriiø.
english: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöap jø tuuŋ Libay ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen awii wøk ni käre kwaanø, kiper yie raac ki dwør nyeya.
english: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø mar kwaan jiy atïmö ni raac ki jï Jwøk, ni ö Jwøki ni jääl jø Icriel.
english: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit aköö jï Jwøk, ni «Aana nø bääyö døc ki køør gïna tïïa. 'Ba ennø, beerra man wëënnï raay 'moa, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper aani gïnögø atïïa ni wïïa kära caarø.»
english: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Gaat acäänne, ŋat wø car jammi jï Deebit ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ni kööe,
english: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ Deebit ni caanï luumma jïre, ni kööï ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Aani luup adäk cïba nyïmï, niï jëëtï ki luubö aciel rege mo tïïa tïïö dëërï.› »
english: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Gaat aci baŋ Deebit ni kööe jïgø, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Jëëtï røk luup moi:
english: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee

anywaa: ?Beerra man ö käci paarï ki cwiiri adäk? ?Wala beerra man ö nyïïmän moï ni ŋwiecge køøru ki dwäde adäk nou rïïŋö? ?Wala beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ opëëllö mare cer nyïïatwiel maal ni raany Icriel bäre ki man kïth täw mo leth døc bäätu ki nïne adäk yi ŋöömö maru?› 'Ba ennø, cädï ni jierï gïno døøa ki gø jï Jwøk na jääŋ aani.»
english: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit aköö jï Gaat, ni «Gïïögø bëët duua bëëtö mo teek kipera. Beerra man tïma naa pätha cer Wuuö Jwøk, kiper mëër mare dwøŋ; 'ba kära tïmö naa pätha cer dhaanhø.»
english: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk täw mo leth døc aput jääŋŋö bäät jø Icriel, ni thøw jø Icrielli ma kume ma pïërabïriiø.
english: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nyïïatwiel maal aput jääŋŋö nee Jerucalem raanynye. 'Ba kanya tïm nyïïatwiel maalli ni ena bäät man raany Jerucalem, ena joot Wuuö Jwøki, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni päth cwïnye kiper gïna leth na tägö dëët jiy, ni kööe jï nyïïatwiel maal manøgø man wø räänyö, ni «Manøgø rømø nø. Ennø, jook cerï nø.» 'Ba kar kaagø, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk cuŋŋö buut laara mar Örnan nyï Jeebuc.
english: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Deebiti na tïŋ wïïe maal ni räŋŋe, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aput joot ni cuŋŋö yïthakic maal ki piny, no opëëllö ee maa ni ee löö bäät Jerucalem.
