Kanyøgø, Deebit ki jø døøk Icriel, cøŋge aputge këël piny ni kuulge wïthge piny yïth ŋøøm, ni dëëtge ege runynyö ka abïïk keece ni ge nyootha pänh cwïny marge.
english: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Jwøk, «?Aŋø, patha aani na cïp dwøl ni jiy kwaan? Ka adïëri møn, bee aani na bääyö na tïïc gïn mo raac døc. ?'Ba jiy moi ni caal rööm ii, agïnaŋø na tïïcge? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, beerra man tïm cerï ni ena dëëra ki jø dhi øt wära keere, ni ba jääli jiyï ki täwögø ni leth enø këët.»
english: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk Gaat aköömme nee ci baŋ Deebit nee Deebit tïïe jï Wuuö Jwøk ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kaace yi laara mar Örnan nyï Jeebuc.
english: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput cøø ki køør dwør Gaat mana caane ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, Örnan bëëdö ni dïnö ki beel; 'ba na lwïthe ŋääe, nyïïatwiel maal ajoode, ni ö wääte moa na aŋween na en buute ni kange dëëtge.
english: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ci Deebiti baŋ Örnan, Örnan alwïthö ni joot Deebit, ni put ö wøk ki yi laara ni ci baŋ gø, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm gø ni kuul wïïe piny yïth ŋøøm.
english: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï Örnan, ni «Wëëk laara man aani, kiper naa tïïa yie ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk, nee cïpï jïra ki man ŋeea gø ki gäte mo rømø ki gø, kiper nee täwa leth na nø tägö ki køør ajäl Jwøk nee aae bäät jiy.»
english: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Örnan aköö jï Deebit, ni «Kälï jïrï; wui Awuuö, ï na nyeya, beerra man tïïyï gïno manynyï ki gø. Aani thuwø a cïpö jïrï ki dhäk kiper olämi mano waaŋ bäre, ni cïba jer dïn thuwø, kiper nee tïmge na jenni mo wääŋö ki ge, ni cïpa ki beel, kiper nee tïmge ni beeye muuy mano cïpï. Aani japøgø bëët cïba cïbö.»
english: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Deebit aköö jï Örnan, «Ba løny; japï ba käla ki wat jaak. Ŋeea ŋeeø baŋï ki gäte mo rømø ki gø. Kiper aani jammi moï ba käla jaak nee wëëga Wuuö Jwøk wala nee cïba no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa coolø kiperge.»
english: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Deebit aput cïpö jï Örnan ki warkey ma rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe abïciel ni ŋeew laara manøgø ki ge.
english: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aput tïïö jï Wuuö Jwøk kaace ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni put cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër. Kanyøgø ena put lam jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ maac ki maal bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni løga lam mar Deebit ki gø.
english: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyïïatwiel maal aput köömmö, ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli ni put opëëllö mare dwøk yi køp.
english: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø, kanya jootï ya Deebiti ni lam mare oduu Wuuö Jwøki ki yi laara mar Örnan nyï Jeebuc, ena put bëëte ni cïpö ko olämme kaace.
english: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

anywaa: Kiper oduŋkaara mar Wuuö Jwøk mana tïïc Modhe dï paap, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre, poot ena kar lam mana en bäät thuur yi Gibien kar kaaca.
english: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit kär løny ki man ci baŋ gø ki man pëëny Jwøk, kiper eni lwäär ko opëëllö mar nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö, ni «Øt Wuuö Jwøk tïmö ni ena kany, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre kiper jø Icriel.»
english: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit aöötö ki dwøl kiper nee jiy moa näk juurre na path ni wø bëëdö Icriel nee cooŋ; ni tïïc møøk røkge na jø tieŋ kïte, ni jiiŋge kïte ni tïïcge ge ni mïërö kiper øtø mano geer jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebit ni cuŋ piny ki nywïëny mo thööth kiper nee tïïö ki mucumääre ki gïï wø maa dhøk kiir piny ki ge kiper odhuule mo dhøk kiir; ni cuŋ piny thuwø ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli mo thööth mo ba løny ki kwaan.
english: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

anywaa: Ni cuŋ piny thuwø ki jenni moa perge leth mo ba løny ki kwaan, moa käl jø Caydan ki jø Tayar jïre.
english: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit aköö, ni «Wääda ma Cølöman poot thiinh, ni kär ŋïyö ki tïïc; 'ba øtø mano geer jï Wuuö Jwøk tïmö ni mïërö døc ni ŋäc ki baŋ wïth juurre bëët. Kiper manøgønø, aani jammi mo tïïi ki gø jiiŋŋa jiiŋŋø kipere.» 'Ba Deebit jammi mo thööth ajiiŋŋe ni eni poot kär thøw.
english: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit wääde ma Cølöman acwøle ni kööm gø nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, geere.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: Ni kö Deebiti jï Cølöman, ni «Nyie wääda, geer øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara beeye gïn mo yaa cooŋø ki cwïnya cøøn.
english: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö baŋa ni kööe, ni ‹Ïïna kuny piny ki remø mo päl ni këëdï ki lenye mo døøŋŋø. Ba løny ki man gëëdï ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, kiper ïïna kuny piny ki remø mo päl nyïma bäät piny.
english: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno jïtï ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni beeye ŋato bëëdö no ojwöm, ni mooa eni ki jwöm kun ki kun ki baŋ nyïïmän moe bëët. 'Ba aani a cïpö ki bëët mëër ni tïïa Icriel no onikwöc ki yïth nïr nyec mare.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.

anywaa: 'Ba bee eni noo gëëdö ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, ni tïme na wääda ni tïma ni aana wänni. 'Ba tier buc nyec mare këëlla piny nee bëëde na bäre bäre bäät jø Icriel.›
english: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø wääda, Wuuö Jwøk obëëdö ki ïïni, ni wëëk geer man thur kare man geerï øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kaawat mana caane kiperï.
english: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ïïno mooe ka acaare ki ŋäc tiet luup ki man gwøgï ciik moe, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kanyo tïïc ïïni na bwödhi mar jø Icriel.
english: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moo tïïyï othur karge jïrï ni näk mo ciik moa cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe kiper jø Icriel iï gwøø. Mak riï nø, ni bëëdï niï teek; ni ba bwøk cwïnyï ni ba lwäyï.
english: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, aana tïïö ki tïïc mo dwøŋ mo leth naa jiiŋŋa jammi kiper tïïc mar øt Wuuö Jwøk. Ni jammi moa jiiŋŋa beege warkey ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume ma dïpa, ki gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma miilïën, ki nywïëny mo wø cwøl ni ayrön, ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli mo ba løny ki kwaan, kiper ge thööth døc, ki jenni, ki kïte. Køøre nø, ïïno mëët bäätge.
english: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni jïrï da jø tïïc mo thööth mo nyeŋge reegø ki man tïïcge tïïe ma teeŋi, ni beege jø tieŋ kïte, ki jø caam kïte, ki dïjëëth opämi.
english: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, täk tïïc nø ki jammi moøgø, ni beege warkey, ki gwet-bïrö, ki nywïëny mo wø cwøl ni ayrön, ki nywïëny moa näk jwëëlli mo ba løny ki kwaan. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk bëëde ki ïïni.»
english: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit dïbwöthe mo Icriel bëët aput köömmö nee wääde ma Cølöman kønyge.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «?Aŋø, paa Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na en buutu? ?Aŋø, patha eni na cïpö jïïu ki jwöm kun ki kun? Kiper beeye eni na cïp wïth juurre cera moa en yi ŋöömmi, ni tïmge ni ge ena tier Wuuö Jwøk ki jiye.
english: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, cïpu cwïnynyu bäre ki jwïëyu bäre ni manynyu Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ni tägu geer øtø mana en kur keere mar Wuuö Jwøk, kiper na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, ki jammi moa perge leth mo Jwøk moa en kur keerge, nee käli ni kïthi yi øtø mano geer kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Deebiti na jaal ni cwiiye oløny ni thööth, wääde ma Cølöman arøønye na nyeya mar jø Icriel.
english: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit bwöthe mo jø Icriel bëët, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, acooŋe.
english: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, jø tuuŋ Libay moa näk cwøw moa näk cwiicge opäŋ na pïëradäk këël kunece, aput kwaan, ni tïm kwäänge na kume ma pïëradäk ka abära.
english: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøgø, jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø ka aŋween akwany ni beege jø wø raŋ tïï øt Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö jiyi ma kume abïciel ni kwanyi na kwääri ki dïŋut luup;
english: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:

anywaa: ni ö jiyi ma kume aŋween ni kwanyi na jø wø koor dhi kal; ni ö jiyi ma kume aŋween thuwø ni kwanyi na jø pwøc Wuuö Jwøk ki wïth jap dööti ma teeŋi moa tïïc Deebiti kiper pwøc.
english: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni cïïm jøøgø na dhøgi ki køør wäät Libay, ni beege Gërcön, ki Kät, ki Mërari.
english: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

anywaa: Ki ri dhi øt Gërcön beege: Ladan ki Cimiy.
english: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Ladan gena adäk, ni bee Jikiël na näk kanynye, ki Jetham, ki Jool,
english: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

anywaa: jøøa put tïmö na wïth dhøk uudi mo jøøa käl dëër Ladan. 'Ba wäät Cimiy gena adäk thuwø, ni beege Cëlömöth, ki Ëjiel, ka Aaren.
english: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.

anywaa: Køøre Cimiy acäŋ jïtö ki wääte aŋween møøk, ni beege Jakath, ki Jina, ki Jeuc, ki Beria.
english: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

anywaa: Jakath beeye wääde mana dïkwøŋ, ni rietge beeye Jija. 'Ba Jeuc ki Beria bäŋ wäätge mo thööth mo ege nywølø. Kiper manøgønø, gena dwal ri dhi øtø aciel.
english: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Kät moa na aŋween beege: Amram, ki Icaar, ki Keeprön, ki Udhiel.
english: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Amram beege Aran ki Modhe. 'Ba Aran acïp kur keere kiper tïï jammi moa en kur keerge, ni bee eni ki wääte, ki nyïïkwaaye, nee gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met nee wø waaŋe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee bëëde ni tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk, ni gwëëdhö ka nyeŋ gø na bäre bäre.
english: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Modhe na näk dhaanh Jwøk akwaan dëët jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.

anywaa: Wäät Modhe beege Gërcöm ki Eliëdher.
english: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.

anywaa: 'Ba Gërcöm wääde mana bëëdö na bwödhi beeye Cebuël.
english: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliëdher wääde mana bëëdö na bwödhi beeye Rebiya. Eliëdher bäŋ wääte møøk. 'Ba wäät Rebiya thööth døc.
english: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

anywaa: 'Ba Icaar wääde mana bëëdö na bwödhi beeye Cëlömith.
english: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Keeprön beeye kanynye ma Jeriya, ni rietge beeye Amariya, ni dääge beeye Jadhiël, ni ŋweerge beeye Jekamem.
english: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Udhiel beeye kanynye ma Mikiya, ni rietge beeye Iciya.
english: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Isshiah the second.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Mërari beege: Maali ki Muci. Ni wäät Maali beege Eliedhar ki Kic.
english: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliedhar athøw ni bäŋ obwöre ma cwøw mo ee nywølø; 'ba beege mään keerge na nywøle. Kiper manøgønø, nyïïe anywøm wäät coki ma Kic ni tïmge na mään jïge.
english: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Muci moa näk adäk beege Maali, ka Adër, ki Jerëmöth.
english: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

anywaa: Moøgø beege jø tuuŋ Libay ki køør dhøk uudi moge ki bwöthe mo dhøk uudi moge. 'Ba nyïïkwaacge moa näk cwiicge opäŋ na pïërariiø këël kunece akwaan ki køør nyeŋge kiper nee bëëtge ni ge tïïya tïïe mo øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.

anywaa: Kiper Deebit aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, acïpö ki jwöm  jï jiye. Eni bëëdö yi Jerucalem na bäre bäre.
english: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø, jø tuuŋ Libay oduŋkaany røømmø ki jap paac mo wø tïïö yie ki ge bëët ba käärge këët.»
english: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

anywaa: Køøre ki ra aŋuun luup mo Deebit ena köö ni jø tuuŋ Libay ki mano täge ri moa näk cwiicge pïërariiø këël kunece ge di kwaanø.
english: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mar jø tuuŋ Libay aput tïmö ni ge køønynya nyïïkwaac Aran ki tïïe mo øt Wuuö Jwøk, mo wø en yi kal, ki mo wø en yi øtø, ki tïïc jammi bëët ni waany mo wø en kur keerge, këël ki tïïc tïïe møøk thuwø mo wø tïïc yi øt Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;

anywaa: ki tïï jiiŋ muunni moa näk ocwøbø na näk nyuuthe, ki tïï muunni moa pøøth moa cïp na muuce mo beel, ki muunni moa näk odeelø, ki teeŋ muunni mo wø cwøp ka athaa wala mo wø coot, ki tïï jap røm bëët.
english: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme na amöölla ka abøøya cooth, ge bëëdö ni ge cuŋŋö ni ge dwøga met ec ki pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;

anywaa: këël kany wø cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk ki cäŋ jwömö, ki kany wø päär dwääyi, ki kwör ajwöm moa näk ocïp piny cooth. 'Ba kwään jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø tïïö cooth nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ocïp piny na ciik.
english: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay ge bëëdö ni ge gwøga oduŋkaany røømmø ki kar lam mana en kur keere, ni gwøkge tuuŋge ma nyïïkwaac Aran kiper tïïe mo øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye luum nyïïkwaac Aran kanya cïïm ge na dhøgi. Ni wääte beege Nadap, ka Abiyu, ki Eliedhar, ki Itamer.
english: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

anywaa: 'Ba Nadap ka Abiyu gena thøw ni wääge poot nutö, ni bäŋ wäätge mo ege nywølø. 'Ba Eliedhar ki Itamer gena tïmö na dïlämme.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni cïïm nyïïkwaac Aran na dhøgi ki køør tïïe moa cïp jïge, ni jøøa køny gø ki tïïc manøgø beeye Dhadök na käl dhi øt Eliedhar, ka Ayemëlëk na käl dhi øt Itamer.
english: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään dïbwöthe moa thööth mo kaala mo Itamer joota røk nyïïkwaac Eliedhar; kiper ki røk nyïïkwaac Eliedhar da dïbwöthe apaar ka abïciel mo dhøk uudi. 'Ba ki røk nyïïkwaac Itamer da dïbwöthe abära mo dhøk uudi.
english: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cïïmmi ni dïët bëët ki køør gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe, kiper da dïlämme mo kwörge døøŋŋø mo øt Jwøk ki dïlämme mo kwörge døøŋŋø mo lam dëët nyïïkwaac Eliedhar ki nyïïkwaac Itamer bëët.
english: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

anywaa: 'Ba Cemaya, ŋat wø gööt piny ki luup, na näk o Natanel na käl ri jø tuuŋ Libay, nyeŋ jøøgø agöör piny nyïm nyeya, ki dïbwöthe, ki Dhadök na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ka Ayemëlëk wär Abiethaar, ki wïth dhøk uudi mo dïlämme, ki wïth dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Libay, ni nyuuthe tïïcge ni ge lwötö røk nyïïkwaac Eliedhar ki røk nyïïkwaac Itamer ni welge wellø.
english: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi mana dïkwøŋ aö wøk ki nyeŋ Jöyarip; ni ö riet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jidaya;
english: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

anywaa: ni ö dää nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Arim; ni ö ŋweer nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Cöörim;
english: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

anywaa: ni ö bïï nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Malkiya; ni ö bïcier nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Miyamin;
english: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

anywaa: ni ö bïriet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Aködh; ni ö bäc nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Abaaja;
english: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

anywaa: ni ö bïŋweer nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jëcua; ni ö paac nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Cekaniya;
english: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

anywaa: ni ö paac kurcier nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Eliyacip; ni ö paac kurriet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jakim;
english: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

anywaa: ni ö paac kurdää nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Upa; ni ö paac kurŋweer nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jecebeap;
english: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

anywaa: ni ö paac kurbïï nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Bilga; ni ö paac kurbïcier nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Imër;
english: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

anywaa: ni ö paac kurbïriet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Ëdhir; ni ö paac kurbäc nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Apijej;
english: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

anywaa: ni ö paac kurbïŋweer nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Petaya; ni ö pïërriet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jedhekël;
english: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

anywaa: ni ö pïërriet kurcier nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Jaakin; ni ö pïërriet kurriet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Gamul;
english: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

anywaa: ni ö pïërriet kurdää nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Delaya; ni ö pïërriet kurŋweer nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Maadhiya.
english: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.

anywaa: Moøgø beege kwääri mo dïlämme kany wø öge øt Wuuö Jwøk kiper tïïc marge mana no ocïp piny kiper dïlämme ki ri kwarge ma Aran, kaawat mana ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, na kööm Aran.
english: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwääri møga moa käl dëër Libay. Ki røk jøøa käl dëër Amram beeye Cuubaël; ki røk jøøa käl dëër Cuubaël beeye Jekdiya;
english: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.

anywaa: ki røk jøøa käl dëër Rebiya, ŋata dïkwøŋ beeye Iciya;
english: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.

anywaa: ki røk jøøa käl dëër Icaar beeye Cëlömöth; ki røk jøøa käl dëër Cëlömöth beeye Jakath.
english: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Keeprön, mana dïkwøŋ beeye Jeriya, ni rietge beeye Amariya, ni dääge beeye Jadhiël, ni ŋweerge beeye Jekamem.
english: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Udhiel beeye Mikiya; ki røk jøøa käl dëër Mikiya beeye Camir.
english: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.

anywaa: 'Ba cöök Mikiya beeye Iciya. 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Iciya beeye Dhekaraya.
english: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Mërari beege Maali ki Muci; 'ba Bëno beeye wär Jaadhia.
english: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Mërari ki ri Jaadhia beege Bëno ki Cööm ki Dhakur ki Ëbari.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk bäŋ wääte na käl ri Maali beeye Eliedhar.
english: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata käl dëër Kic beeye wääde ma Jeramiel.
english: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Muci beeye Maali ka Adër ki Jerimöth. Moøgø bëët beege jøøa käl dëër Libay ki køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba geni thuwø gena tïïö ki gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe keda mana tïïc tuuŋge na käl ri Aran, kaawat mana tïïcge gø nyïm nyeya ma Deebit ki Dhadök ka Ayemëlëk ki bwöthe mo dhøk uudi moge, ki dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay. 'Ba dhøk uudi moa døøŋŋø atïïc ni röömi ki dhøk uudi moa therø.
english: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit ki bwöthe mo leny, gena jëëdö ki jiy røk wäät Acaap, ki røk wäät Ëman, ki røk wäät Jeduthun kiper tïï lam; ni beege jiy mo wø køp dwør Jwøk ki dudi mo wø wär ki thøp-othïënhö ka athaliiŋŋi. 'Ba ge na jier kiper tïïc manøgø, nyeŋge beege ii:
english: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

anywaa: Ki røk wäät Acaap beege Dhakur, ki Jocep, ki Nethaniya, ka Acarela. 'Ba wäät Acaap moøgøøni ge ena tier wääge ma Acaap, ŋat wø bëëdö tier nyeya ni køpa dwør Jwøk.
english: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk wäät Jeduthun beege Gedaliya, ki Jeri, ki Jicaya, ki Cimiy, ka Acabiya, ki Matitiya. Ge na abïciel yøø, ge ena tier wääge ma Jeduthun, ŋat wø  køp dwør Jwøk kany wø dwøk met ec ni pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki thøp-othïënhö.
english: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk wäät Ëman beege Bukiya, ki Mataniya, ki Udhiel, ki Cebuël, ki Jerimöth, ka Ananiya, ka Anani, ki Eliatha, ki Gidalti, ki Römamtijer, ki Jöcbekaca, ki Malöthi, ko Ötir, ki Makajöth.
english: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti–ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:

anywaa: Moøgø bëët beege wäät Ëman, ŋat wø car luup jï nyeya ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre. 'Ba wäät Ëman moøgøøni acïp Jwøki jïre ki køør luumma caan Jwøki nee nyeŋ Ëman tïŋge maal. Kiper Jwøk acïpö jï Ëman ko obwöc cwøw apaar kurŋween ko obwöc mään adäk.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët ge bëëdö tiet wëëkge ni ge wär ki dudi yi øt Wuuö Jwøk ni ge pwøya Jwøk ka athaliiŋŋi ki thøpothïënhö, kany wø läm jøwi øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba Acaap ki Jeduthun ki Ëman, ge bëëdö tier nyeya.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

anywaa: 'Ba ge na jø wär, moa näk geno pwönynyö ki wär dudi jï Wuuö Jwøk na näk okwänynyö døc, kwäänge ki jø tuuŋge bëët beege dïpe ariiø ki pïërabära ka abära.
english: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe aleeŋge yïthakicge kiper tïïc marge, ni beege jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki jøøa kwörge therø bëët, ki dïpööye këël jø wø pwönynyi.
english: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi mana dïkwøŋ aö wøk ki røk wäät Acaap ki nyeŋ Jocep; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø; ni ö riet nyuudhi ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Gedaliya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:

anywaa: dää nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Dhakur; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: ŋweer nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Ijeri; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: bïï nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Nethaniya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: bïcier nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Bukiya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: bïriet nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Jecarela; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: bäc nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Jicaya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: bïŋweer nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Mataniya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Cimiy; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurcier nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Adharël; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurriet nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Acabiya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurdää nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Cuubaël; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurŋweer nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Matitiya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurbïï nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Jerëmöth; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurbïcier nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Ananiya; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurbïriet nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Jöcbekaca; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurbäc nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Anani; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: paac kurbïŋweer nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Malöthi; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: pïërriet nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Eliatha; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: pïërriet kurcier nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Ötir; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: pïërriet kurriet nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Gidalti; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: pïërriet kurdää nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Makajöth; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø;
english: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

anywaa: pïërriet kurŋweer nyuudhi aö wøk ki nyeŋ Römamtijer; eni ki jø tuuŋge ki wääte, gena apaar kurriiø.
english: The four and twentieth to Romamti–ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jiy moa näk ocïïmmö na jø koor dhi kal mar Øt Jwøk beege ii: ki røk jiy moa käl dëër Köra, ki ri dhi øt Acaap, beeye Mecelemiya o Körë.
english: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

anywaa: 'Ba Mecelemiya wääte dagø, ni kanynye beeye Dhekaraya, ni rietge beeye Jediel, ni dääge beeye Dhebadiya, ni ŋweerge beeye Jatniel,
english: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

anywaa: ni bïïge beeye Ilam, ni bïcierge beeye Jöanan, ni bïrietge beeye Eliyönay.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø maya bee Obet-Idöm ki wääte, ni nyeŋ kanynye beeye Cemaya, ni rietge beeye Jödhabat, ni dääge beeye Jöa, ni ŋweerge beeye Cakar, ni bïïge beeye Natanel,
english: Moreover the sons of Obed–edom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

anywaa: ni bïcierge beeye Amiel, ni bïrietge beeye Icakar, ni bäcge beeye Pelethay. 'Ba obwöre moøgø acïp Jwøki jïre ka køør gwïëth.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø maya thuwø bee Cemaya wär Obet-Idöm manøgø, ni beeye Cemaya mana nywøl obwöre moa käär dhi øt wääge, kiper gena jiy mo teek mo tïïc løny jïge.
english: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba Cemaya manøgø, wääte beege Øthni, ki Repaël, ki Obet, ki Eldhabat, ki uut wääge, ni beege Eliyu ki Cemakiya, jøøa bëëdö na jiy mo teek ni tïïc løny jïge.
english: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

anywaa: Moøgø bëët beege jøøa käl dëër Obet-Idöm; geni ki wäätge ki jø tuuŋge gena jiy mo ge teek, ni tïïc løny jïge. Kwäänge bëët, ge na käl dëër Obet-Idöm, gena pïërabïciel ka ariiø.
english: All these of the sons of Obed–edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed–edom.

anywaa: 'Ba Mecelemiya jïre da wääte ki jø tuuŋge ma apaar ka abära, ni beege jiy mo teek ni tïïc løny jïge.
english: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.

anywaa: Dhaanhø aciel maya thuwø ki røk jøøa käl dëër Mërari beeye Öca. Öca wääte dagø. Wääde mana dïkwøŋ beeye Cimri; 'ba Cimri patha eni na kwøŋ nywøl, tïïya wänni jaak ni mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)

anywaa: Rietge beeye Kilkiya, ni dääge beeye Tebaliya, ni ŋweerge beeye Dhekaraya. Kwään wäät Öca ki jø tuuŋge bëët, gena apaar kurdäk.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.

anywaa: Jøøgø no ocïïmmö yøø na jø koor dhi kal, tïïc apääŋŋi jïge ki køør bwöthe moge kaamar tuuŋge ki man tïïge yi øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre geni bëët, jøøa kwörge therø ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, gïï wø tïïc na nyuuthe aleeŋge ki køør dhøk uudi moge kiper jø koor dhi kal man nø nee joot.
english: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyuudhi mana näk nyootha dhi kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, aö wøk ki nyeŋ Celemiya, ni ö nyuudhi maya mana leeŋge ni nyooth dhi kal mana en jï løø wï piny, ni ö wøk ki nyeŋ Dhekaraya, o Celemiya man wø ŋäc tiet luup ni wø cïpi ka acaare.
english: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi mana ö wøk ki nyeŋ Obet- Idöm, beeye mana näk nyootha dhi kal mana en jï løø tier-piny. Køøre wääte akïth øt kän jammi nee koorge.
english: To Obed–edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi mana ö wøk ki nyeŋ Cupim ki Öca, beeye mana näk nyootha dhi kal mana en jï løø kun wø päth cäŋŋi yie, dhi kal man wø cwøl ni Caleketh, ni wø en yi waŋjöör wø eth maal ki yie. Ba ge na jø koor gena cïïmmi ri koor na ennø nø:
english: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.

anywaa: Cooth ki yi cäŋ ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, da jø tuuŋ Libay abïciel, ki jiy aŋween kiper jï løø wï piny, ki jiy aŋween thuwø kiper jï løø tier piny mo cïba kwörögø nee koorge; ki jiy ariiø ariiø mo koor øt kän jammi.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.

anywaa: 'Ba buut kany wø gääp jiyi yie ki jï løø kun wø päth cäŋŋi yie, yi waŋjööra dwøŋ, da jiy aŋween. 'Ba kany wø gääp jiyi yie kiree da jiy ariiø yie thuwø.
english: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

anywaa: Moøge beege jøøa käl dëër Köra ki jøøa käl dëër Mërari na bëëdö na jø koor dhøk kal, ki yi jöö mana cïïm geni ki gø ri koor.
english: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay møøk gena jier na jø raŋ uut kän jammi mo Øt Jwøk ki uut kän jammi moa näk ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Gërcön, Ladan abëëdö na kwar dhøk uudi mo thööth, ni kuure ka dhi øt wääde ma Jikiëli.
english: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Jikiëli, ni beege Jetham ki coki ma Jool, gena jier na jø raŋ uut kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø møøk mo ojierø na jø koor ki røk nyïïkwaac Amram, ki røk nyïïkwaac Icaar, ki røk nyïïkwaac Keeprön, ki røk nyïïkwaac Udhiel.
english: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

anywaa: 'Ba Cebuël, na käl dëër Gërcöm o Modhe, ena jier na kwäärö man raŋ uut kän jammi.
english: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋge moa käl dëër Eliëdher, bee Rebiya, køøre ki Jicaya, køøre ki Jöram, køøre ki Dhikri, køøre ki Cëlömöth.
english: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëlömöth manøgø ki jø tuuŋge gena jier na jø raŋ jammi bëët moa näk ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni beege jammi moa cïp nyeya ma Deebit, ki bwöthe mo dhøk uudi, ki kwääc lwaa kume ki kwääc lwaa dïpe, ki kwääc lwaae møøk mo leny.
english: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.

anywaa: Gena cïpö røk jammi moa twierge ri leny kiper nee kwöra näk oränynyö ri Øt Wuuö Jwøk dwøkge kare ki gø.
english: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa cïp Camielli, ŋat wø car luup ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ki Cøøl o Kic, ka Abinër o Nër, ki Jöap o Dheruya, ki moa cïp jiyi møga bëët, japøgø bëët ni en kur keerge yøø na mo Jwøk, acïp cer Cëlömöth ki jø tuuŋge.
english: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Icaar, Kenaniya ki wääte, gena jier ni møøk a kwääri, ni møøk a dïŋut luup kiper jø Icriel, ni tïïc marge ena wøk ki Øt Jwøk.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Keeprön, Acabiya ki jø tuuŋge, gena jier na jø en luupi ceŋge mo jø Icriel mo wø en jï kun wø päth cäŋŋi yie jï løø Naam Jördan løøga, kiper tïïe bëët mo Wuuö Jwøk ki tïïe mo nyeya. 'Ba gena jiy mo teek ni tïïc løny jïge, ni kwäänge beege kuma aciel ki dïpe abïriiø,
english: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.

anywaa: ni bwödhi mar jø dhi øt Keeprön beeye Jeriya. 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Deebit  na pïëraŋween bäät nyec, yi jöör tuuŋ mar jø dhi øt Keeprön amanynyi, ni joot jiy mo teek mo tïïc løny jïge yïthakicge kany mo cwøl ni Jadher mo ena Gelät.
english: Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeriya ki jø tuuŋge, jøøa teek na näk tïïc løny jïge na bëëdö na bwöthe mo wïth dhøk uudi, gena tïïc nyeya ma Deebit na kwääri mo wø raŋ bëët jiy bäät jø tuuŋ Ruben, ki bäät jø tuuŋ Gaat, ki bäät thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, kiper luup bëët mo Jwøk ki mo nyeya; ni kwäänge beege kume ariiø ki dïpe abïriiø.
english: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege jø Icriel moa näk okwaanø, ni beege dïbwöthe mo dhøk uudi, ki kwääc lwaa kume mo leny, ki kwääc lwaa dïpe mo leny, ki dïbwöthe moge mo wø tïny nyeya ni ge raŋŋa tïïe ki luup bëët mo dhøgi mo leny mo wø tïïö ki yi dwääy man nø ki dwääy man nø yi cwiir bäre, ni dhøk man nø yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba Jacöbiam o Dhabdïël, dhøk mar lwaa leny mana dïkwøŋ kiper dwääy mana dïkwøŋ ena cere, ni dhøk mar lwaa leny mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba eni käla ri Peereth, ni ena bwödhi mar kwääc lwaae bëët mo leny kiper dwääy mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

anywaa: 'Ba Döday nyï Aköki, dhøk mar lwaa leny kiper riet dwäde ena cere. 'Ba ŋata en tiere na bwödhi mar dhøk mare beeye Miklöth; ni dhøk manøgø yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper dää dwäde beeye Benaya o Jööda na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba Benaya manøgø beeye ŋata teek na bëëdö na wïth jø leny moa näk pïëradäk; 'ba ŋata bëëdö na bwödhi bäät dhøk mare beeye wääde ma Amidhabad.
english: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper ŋweer dwäde beeye Acaël cöök Jöap, ni ŋata caath køøre beeye wääde ma Dhebadiya; 'ba dhøk manøgø yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper bïï dwäde beeye Camut nyï Idhar; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper bïcier dwäde beeye Ira wär Ikëc nyï Tëköa; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper bïriet dwäde beeye Këleth nyï Pelön na käl ri Ipariem; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper bäc dwäde beeye Cibekay nyï Uca na käl ri Dheera; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper bïŋweer dwäde beeye Abiedhar nyï Anathöth na käl ri Benjamen; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi–ezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper paac dwäde beeye Maaray nyï Nethöpa, na käl ri Dheera; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy  ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper paac kurcier dwäde beeye Benaya nyï Pirathön, na käl ri Ipariem; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny kiper paac kurriet dwäde beeye Kelday nyï Nethöpa, na käl ri Götönial; ni dhøk mare yie da jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa bëëdö na wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel beege ii: Bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Ruben beeye Eliëdher o Dhikri. 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Cimien beeye Cepathiya o Maika.
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Libay beeye Acabiya o Këmuël. 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Aran beeye Dhadök.
english: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Juuda beeye Eliyu cöök Deebit. 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Icakar beeye Ømri o Mikaël.
english: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Dhebulan beeye Yicmaya wär Øbadiya. 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Naptali beeye Jerëmöth wär Adhiriel.
english: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Ipariem beeye Awcë wär Acaciya. 'Ba bwödhi mar thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca beeye Jool o Pedaya.
english: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar thääŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca moa en Gelät beeye Idö o Dhekaraya. 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Jaciel wär Abinër.
english: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

anywaa: 'Ba bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Daan beeye Adharël o Jeröam. Jøøgø bëët beege kwääri mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit cwøw moa näk cwiic dööŋö moge pïërariiø ki moa näk ena piny ki pïërariiø käre kwaanø, kiper luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ni jø Icriel tïïe tïïö ni thööth kaamar ceer mo maal.
english: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jöap o Dheruya ena tägö ki man kwaan cwøw, 'ba käre thöörö. 'Ba wëëc Jwøk aö bäät jø Icriel kiper luummögø, ni ö kwäänö mana tïïc ni käri göör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyeya ma Deebit.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhemawët wär Adiel, uut kän jammi mo nyeya acïp cere. 'Ba Jönathan wär Udhaya, uut kän jammi moa en wøk, ki moa en yïth päänye, ki moa en yïth atude, ki moa en yïth uut koor mo ogeerø ni bäyö, acïp cere.
english: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah:

anywaa: 'Ba Idhiri o Kelub, jø wø tïïö yïth pwöth, ni beege jø puur, acïp cere.
english: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

anywaa: 'Ba Cimiy nyï Reema, pwöth jer omøki acïp cere. 'Ba Dhabdi nyï Cipam, uudi moa en tiet ŋøøm mo wø kan kwøk nyïïomøki yïthge, acïp cere.
english: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

anywaa: 'Ba Baal-Anan nyï Gëëdir, jenni mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw ko olämmi moa en yïth ŋøøpa näk rege ege päärö, acïp cere. 'Ba Jöac, kany wø bëët mädhi yie acïp cere.
english: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal–hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

anywaa: 'Ba Citari nyï Carön, dhäk moa en kwör kwaath moa en Carön acïp cere. 'Ba Capath wär Adali dhäk moa en kwör kwaath moa en yïth gøli acïp cere.
english: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

anywaa: 'Ba Öbil nyï Icmiel, athïrööle acïp cere. 'Ba Jekdiya nyï Mërönöt, arëëni acïp cere.
english: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

anywaa: 'Ba Jajij nyï Agri, pïïth dïëk acïp cere.  'Ba jøøgø bëët beege kwääri mo wø neet jammi moa näk mo nyeya ma Deebit.
english: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagarite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata wïïe leer ni wø cïpi ka acaare, ni wø gööt piny, beeye Jönathan näär Deebit. Ni ö Jikiëlli wär Akimöni ni tïme na ŋat wø pwöny wäät nyeya.
english: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:

anywaa: 'Ba Akithöpël thuwø beeye ŋat wø cïpi ka acaare jï nyeya. 'Ba Ucay nyï Arki beeye nyawat nyeya.
english: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:

anywaa: 'Ba Akithöpël jiy moa läw kare beege Jööda o Benaya, ka Abiethaar. 'Ba Jöap beeye kwääc lwaa leny mar nyeya.
english: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit kwääri mo Icriel bëët acooŋ yi Jerucalem, ni beege kwääri mo wïth tuŋi mo Icriel, ki kwääc lwaae mo jiy moa näk ocïïmmö na dhøgi na jø tïny nyeya, ki kwääc lwaa kume mo leny ki kwääc lwaa dïpe mo leny, ki jiy mo wø raŋ jammi bëët ki lääc paac moa näk mo nyeya ki mo wääte, ki jaae mo paan dwøŋ, ko otëëe mo leny, këël otëëe moa teek ki leny døc.
english: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit acuŋŋö ni kööe, ni «U na nyïïmëëga, ni bee u jiy 'moa, cegu ïthu ni wïnynyu mara! Aani, aana cädö ki man gëëda ki øtø mo bëëdö ki kany mo bäär kiper acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy, nee tïme thuwø ni beeye køøm tiet Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba dëëra yaa nø jiiŋŋø ki man geera gø.
english: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Paa ïïni noo gëëdö ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, kiper ïïna dhaanhø ma ŋat leny mo rem jiy iï køny piny.›
english: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.

anywaa: «'Ba eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, aana jiere ki røk jø dhi øt wära bëët naa tïma ni aana nyeya mar jø Icriel na bäre bäre. Kiper eni tuuŋ Juuda ajiere na bwödhi. 'Ba ki røk dhøk uudi mo jø tuuŋ Juuda, dhi øt wära beeye na jiere, ni kwäny a wøk ki yïthakic wäät wära bëët, ni tïïc aani na nyeya bäät jø Icriel bëët ki køør met ec mare.
english: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk wääta bëët moa thööth na cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïra, eni wääda ma Cølöman ajiere nee pï piny bäät wäl bura mar Wuuö Jwøk na nyeya mar jø Icriel.
english: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.

anywaa: Køøre eni na Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni ‹Wäädï ma Cølöman bee eni noo geer øtø mara ki cwöt mara, kiper eni yaa jierø nee tïme na wääda, naa tïma ni aana wuuö jïre.
english: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

anywaa: 'Ba aani tier bura mare këëlla piny, nee bëëde na bäre bäre, ni näk mo eni puta bëëtö ni gwøga ciik 'moa ki luup 'moa, kaawat man tïïi en.›
english: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, a köömma uuni nyïm jø Icriel bëët, ka acooŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki nyïm Jwøk marø, gwøgu ciik Wuuö Jwøk eni na Jwøk maru, ni manynyu gø døc, kiper nee ŋøøpi ni beyø ii put bëëtö na mou, ni dööŋe jï wäätu ki jiy moo ööi køøru na bäre bäre.
english: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba kiperï, ï na wääda ma Cølöman en, bëëdï ni Jwøk ŋäyï, ni beeye Jwøa näk Jwø wäru, ni tïnynyï gø ki cwïnyï bäre ka acaayï bäre; kiper Wuuö Jwøk cwïny jiy nëënö jïre bëët, ni jammi bëët mo wø caar jiyi ŋääe. Ni näk mo iï manynyø, ree nyoodhe nyoodhø jïrï; 'ba ni näk mo iï wiiø, ï kwiere kwierø na bäre bäre.
english: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.

anywaa: Raŋï ennø, Wuuö Jwøk ïïna jiere niï gëëdï ki øtø mo ena kur keere ma øt lam; mak riï ni teek nø, ni tïïyï gø.»
english: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Deebit yi jöö mana näk ee käl wøk mana dee Øt Jwøk geerø ki gø bäre aput wëëk wääde ma Cølöman, ni bee Øt Jwøk mana dwøŋ, ka agööla mare, ki uudi moe mo bëët jammi yïthge, ki uudi moe mo en maal, ki uudi moe mo en yie kuya, ki øtø mana en kur keere man wø bëët acanduki yie mana näk bääte da rëëbi man wø nyooth wëën raay;
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

anywaa: ki yi jöör geer øtø bäre mana näk ee käl wøk ki wïïe, kiper käälle mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki uudi mo en jï wøk ki deŋ dëër øtø bäre, ki uudi mo kan jammi yïthge mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk,  ki uudi mo kan jammi yïthge moa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

anywaa: Ni cïp yi jöör tïïc thuwø kiper dïlämme moa näk ocïïmmö na dhøgi, ge ki jø tuuŋ Libay, kiper tïïe mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk mo tïïc bëët, ki tïïc jap paac mo tïïö ki ge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni caan rumme mo warkey kiper jap paac moo tïïc ki warkey kiper wïth tïïe ma teeŋi. Ni caan rumme mo gwet-bïrö kiper jap paac moo tïïc ki gwet-bïrö kiper wïth tïïe ma teeŋi.
english: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

anywaa: Ni caan rumme mo warkey kiper gïï wø cuŋ lambae bäätge mo tïïc ki warkey, ki lambae moge; ni caan rumme mo gwet-bïrö kiper gïï wø cuŋ lambae bäätge mo tïïc ki gwetbïrö, ki lambae moge, ki køør yi tïïc mar gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte man nø.
english: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

anywaa: Ni caan rumme mo warkey moo tïïc tharabëëte ki ge mo jiiŋ muunni bäätge moa näk ocwøbø na näk nyuuthe, ni ee rømø kiper tharabëëta man nø. Ni caan rumme mo gwet-bïrö kiper tharabëëte moo tïïc ki gwet-bïrö.
english: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

anywaa: Ni caan rumme mo warkey moo tïïc cäänne ki ge, ko ogubaye, ka apät nywïëny moo tïïc ni dhøkge okaaŋŋø. Ni caan rumme mo warkey kiper kuure moo tïïc ki warkey, ki rumme mo gwet-bïrö kiper kuure moo tïïc ki gwet-bïrö. 'Ba warkey ki gwet-bïrö ee rømø kiper man wø rømi ki kuura man nø.
english: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver:

anywaa: Ni caan rumme mo warkey mana tøŋ kiper tïï gïn wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte, ki rumme mo warkey kiper tïï gïna näk otïïö ni caala jääy, ni beege gïïa näk otïïö kaamar nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli ni wø bëëdö ni bwöpge ege peerø bäät acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy.
english: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö, ni «Jammi moøgø bëët beege jammi moa gööra na nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ki køør mana køny aani nee jöör tïïc manøgø bäre nee ŋääa.»
english: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï wääde ma Cølöman, ni «Mak riï ni bëëdï niï teek, ni tïïyï gïïögø bëët; kärï lwäyö ni ba bwøk cwïnyï; kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwøk mara, ena buutï. Eni ï ba wiie këël kanyo thum tïï jammi bëët mo wø tïïc Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Raŋï ennø, dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay ocïïmmö na dhøgi kiper tïïe bëët mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk; ni da jiy mo nyeŋge reegø ki tïïc mo yïthge met ki man dwätge ki ïïni ki yïth tïïe moøgø bëët. Këël kwääri thuwø ki jiy bëët ge tïmö ni ge ena tierï ni ge wïnynya luummï.»
english: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Deebit jø acooŋa bëët acäänne ni kööe, ni «Wääda ma Cølöman bee eni keere na jier Jwøki; 'ba ena nyilaal mo poot thiinh mo kär ŋïyö ki tïïc. 'Ba tïïc man dwøŋ, kiper øtø man ni dwøŋ en patha per dhaanhø; 'ba beeye per Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ki køør mana no oløny jïra bäre aana cïpö ki jammi kiper Øt Jwøa. Aana cïpö ki warkey kiper jammi moo tïïc ki warkey; ni cïpa ki gwet-bïrö kiper jammi moo tïïc ki gwet-bïrö; ni cïpa ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli kiper jammi moo tïïc ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli; ni cïpa ki teeŋ nywïënyö mano cwøl ni ayrön kiper jammi moo tïïc ki gø; ni cïpa ki jenni kiper jammi moo tïïc ki jenni; ni cïpa thuwø ki kïte mo perge leth, ki teeŋ kïte mo caami ki gø, ki teeŋ kïte mo ŋwaŋŋi ki gø, ki kïte ma kït ma teeŋi, ki wïth kïte bëët moa perge leth, ki wïth kïte møøk mo mïërö mo thööth.
english: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba maya thuwø, ki køør met ec mara kiper Øt Jwøa, jammi moa en jïra, ni beege warkey ki gwet-bïrö, acïba no opöödhö ni ena maal ki jammi moa kwøŋa cïp kipere, eni na Øt Jwøa, ni beeye øt lam mana en kur keere.
english: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

anywaa: Ni jammi moøka beege warkie moa käl  kanya cwøl ni Öpïr, ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume adäk, ki gwet-bïrö mo oleenyø ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume abïriiø, kiper nee dëër øtø bäre jør ki ge,
english: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

anywaa: nee jammi moo tïïc rëëmme nee tïïc ki ge thuwø; ni warkey beeye kiper jammi moo tïïc ki warkey, ni gwet-bïrö beeye kiper jammi moo tïïc ki gwet-bïrö. ?'Ba ennø, ŋat mør aŋa ni many gø dïcäŋi nee dëëre cïbe bäre ki man jap cere jï Wuuö Jwøk?»
english: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the Lord?

anywaa: Køøre dïbwöthe mo wïth dhøk uudi, ki kwääri mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel, ki kwääc lwaa kume mo leny, ki kwääc lwaa dïpe mo leny, ge ki jiy mo wø raŋ tïïe mo nyeya, gena put cïpö ki muuce ki met ec marge.
english: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,

anywaa: Ni jammi moa cïpge na muuce kiper tïï Øt Jwøk beege warkie ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume abïïc, ki warkie ma rumme ma dariki ma kume apaar, ki gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume apaar, ki nywïëny ma jwëëlli ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume apaar ka abära, ki teeŋ nywïënyö mano cwøl ni ayrön ma rumme ma kikarri ma kume ma dïpa.
english: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa näk jïge da kïte mo perge leth acïpge na muuce ni kïthi kar kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk cer Jikiël na käl ri dhi øt Gërcön.
english: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the Lord, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

anywaa: Køøre jiy yïthge aput mïnnö kiper muuce moa cïpge ki met ec, kiper muuce acïpge ki cwïnyge bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk. Kanyøgø nyeya ma Deebit thuwø yie aput mïnnö døc.
english: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the Lord: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit Wuuö Jwøk aput pwøc nyïm jiy ya acooŋa, ni kööe, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwarwa ma Icriel, pwøc en jïrï na bäre bäre.
english: Wherefore David blessed the Lord before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, Lord God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, teek, ki dööŋö, ka ajiem, ki böödö, ki wödö en jïrï, kiper jammi bëët moa en maalø ki moa en piny beege moï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bura beeye marï, ni bee ï na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Thine, O Lord, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O Lord, and thou art exalted as head above all.

anywaa: Kwärö ki wödö käla baŋï, ni bee ï na wïth jammi bëët. Teek ki dööŋö ena baŋï, ni bee ï wø tïŋ nyeŋ jiy maal ni wø cïp teek jï jiy bëët.
english: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Jwøwa, wa dwøga met ec jïrï, ni wa pwøya nyeŋŋï na näk nyeŋ ajiem.
english: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, aani ki jiya, waana ŋaani nee lønye jïwa ki man cïpwa teeŋ japøgøøni ni thööth yøø? Kiper jammi bëët käla baŋï, ni beege moa jootwa baŋï ni cïpwa jïrï ii.
english: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.

anywaa: Kiper waani, wa bëëdö ni waana wëëlle nyïmï ni waana jiy mo path, kaawat mana bëët kwäcwa. Nïr kwøw mowa bäät piny man caala tïpö, ni bëët kwøw man ba ŋääthwa.
english: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøwa, jammi moi ni thööth bëët ii na cïpwa nee øtø geer kiper nyeŋŋï na en kur keere, käla baŋï, ni beege moï bëët.
english: O Lord our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jwøk mara, ï ŋääa ni cwïny jiy nëënö jïrï, ni mëëyï wø nyoothï nyoodhø jï jøøa cwïnyge thïïŋ. 'Ba aani ki køør leec cwïny mara, gïïögø bëët acïba ki met ec mara. 'Ba ennø, jiyï moi ni kany ii ajooda ni ge cïpö jïrï ki muuce ki met ec.
english: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcwa ma Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Icriel, put acaara man wëëk bëëtö na bäre bäre cwïny jiyï; ni luuï cwïnyge baŋï;
english: O Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:

anywaa: ni mooyï wääda ma Cølöman ki cwïny ma kare, nee ciik ki jammi bëët moa köömmï gø ki ge, nee gwøe na karge ni tïïc ge bëët, ni geer øt lam manøgø ki jammi moa näk yaa nø jiiŋŋø.»
english: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

anywaa: Køøre Deebit aköö jï jø acooŋa bëët, ni «Ennø, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwøk maru.» Kanyøgø jø acooŋa bëët  Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, aputge pwøc, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk ki nyeya.
english: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the Lord your God. And all the congregation blessed the Lord God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the Lord, and the king.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ maya, jø Icriel aput cïpö jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämme ki teeŋ olämme møga mo wø waaŋ bäre, ni beege dhäk ma kuma, ki nyöök rööm ma kuma, ki nyïïrööm ma kuma, ni cïpge ka muuce mo kwøŋ na aciel; ni cïpge thuwø ko olämme mo thööth kiper jø Icriel bëët.
english: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings unto the Lord, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena put cämö ni mäthge yi cäŋ manøgø ki met ec mo dwøŋ døc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Ni cäŋge Cølöman o Deebit røønynyø na nyeya ni thïïmge wï gø ki maaw nee tïme na bwödhi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö Dhadök thuwø ni røønyge gø na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And did eat and drink before the Lord on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the Lord to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman aput pï bäät wälu na nyeya kar wänni ma Deebit, ni beeye wälu mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï wänni. Ni ö Cølömanni ni käär tïïc na wøp ni eno jïëc jø Icrielli bëët.
english: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the Lord as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.

anywaa: Køøre bwöthe bëët, ki jiy moa teek, këël wäät nyeya ma Deebit bëët, gena put jïëy ki man bëënge nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïŋ nyeŋ Cølöman maal døc nyïm jø Icriel bëët, ni mooc gø ka ajiem nyec mo poot bäŋ nyeya mo ee gø cïbö jïgø cøøn Icriel kanya poot Cølömanni.
english: And the Lord magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Deebit o Jeci ena bëëdö na nyeya mar jø Icriel bëët.
english: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.

anywaa: Ena bëëdö ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri abïriiø yi Keeprön, ni bëëde thuwø ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka adäk yi Jerucalem. 'Ba cwiiri moa beede bëët ni ena nyeya mar jø Icriel beege cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre ena thøw ni cwiiye thööth, ni jalø mare poot beer, ni bëëdö no okwär no owøørø. Ni ö wääde ma Cølöman ni dööŋe na nyeya kar gø.
english: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa tïïc nyeya ma Deebit bëët ki mana täge këël aŋuunge mare ogöörö yïth luup moa göör Camielli, ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ki yïth luup moa göör nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Nathan, ki yïth luup moa göör Gaati, na näk ŋat wø joot jammi thuwø ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre.
english: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

anywaa: Luup moøgøøni cäänö kiper bëët nyec mare bäre, ki luum teek mare, ki jammi bëët moa tägö dëëre, ki moa tägö dëër paare ma Icriel, ki moa tägö yïth mïëri møga bëët.
english: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman o Deebit tier buc nyec mare aput këël piny ni teek, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk mare, ni bëëde ki eni, ni ö nyeŋŋe ni tïŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki maal døc.
english: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

anywaa: Kanyøgø eni jø Icriel bëët acäänne, ni beege kwääc lwaa kume ki kwääc lwaa dïpe, ki dïŋut luup, ki dïbwöthe bëët moa en dï Icriel bäre, ni beege jiy moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi.
english: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.

anywaa: Køøre eni na Cølöman ki jø acooŋŋøgø bäre, gena put ci kar lam mana en bäät thuur yi Gibien, kiper oduŋkaany røømmø mar Jwøk ena kaace, oduŋkaanynya tïïc dhaanh Wuuö Jwøki ma Modhe dï paap.
english: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the Lord had made in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba acanduk mar Jwøk onø øøm Deebiti ki yi Kiriat-Jeerim ni nø käl gø Jerucalem, ni kïth gø kanya näk ee jiiŋŋø kiper gø. Kiper da oduŋkaara mo ee nø cwöth piny kaagøøni kiper gø.
english: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na tïïc Bacaliil wär Uri na näk nyikwaar Ur, ena yi Gibien nyïm oduŋkaany Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Cølömanni ki jø acooŋa moa cäädhö ki eni ni wøørge  Wuuö Jwøk kaace.
english: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the Lord: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cølöman aput eth maal kaace nyïm Wuuö Jwøk baŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na en nyïm oduŋkaany røømmø, ni put cïpö bäät gø ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ma kuma.
english: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the Lord, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na yi wäär manøgø, Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Cølöman ni kööe jï gø, ni «Pëëny gïna manynyï nee cïba jïrï.»
english: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman aköö jï Jwøk, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna bëëdö niï nyøtha mëër marï na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl jï wära ma Deebit, ni tïïyï aani na nyeya kar gø.
english: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, luumma caanï jï wära ma Deebit beerra man wëëgï gø thur kare; kiper aana tïïyï na nyeya bäät jiy mo kwäänge caala tør mar piny.
english: Now, O Lord God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

anywaa: Ennø, mooc aani ki leec wïc ki kwänynyö, nee lønye jïra ki man bwødha jiy moi. ?Kiper aŋa ni løny jïre ki man käär jiyï moi ni thööth ii?»
english: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jï Cølöman, ni «Kiper mana näk mo gïnögø nut cwïnyï, niï ba pëëö kaper man bëëdï ni ïïno okwär ki jammi, niï ba pëëö kaper ajiem, niï ba pëëö kaper man 'näk jø wø män ki ïïni, niï ba pëëö kaper man bëëdï ki cwiiri mo thööth; 'ba ïïna tïmö niï pëënynya leec wïc ki kwänynyö man käärï jiya ki gø moa tïïa ïïni bäätge na nyeya,
english: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
