anywaa: leec wïc ki kwänynyö acïba jïrï. 'Ba aani, ï mooa mooø thuwø ki jap kwärö mo thööth, ka ajiem, mo poot bäŋgø cøøn jï nyeye moa kwøŋ nut niï poodi, këël nyeye mo oööi køørï.»
english: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman atïŋŋö ki kar lam mana en bäät thuur yi Gibien na en oduŋkaany røømmø yie, ni døø Jerucalem, ni put bëëte ni ena nyeya bäät jø Icriel bëët.
english: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman amäänyö ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ko okwëëc leny, ni jïte ki jïëth leny moøgø ma kuma ki dïpe aŋween, ko okwëëc leny ma kume apaar kurriiø; ni kïth møøk yïth päänye mo wø bëët jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi yïthge, ni käl møga buute yi Jerucalem.
english: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na nyeya ma Cølöman gwet-bïrö ki warkey atïïe ni thööth døc yi Jerucalem ni caala kïte; ni tïïc jenni moa perge leth ni thööth jaak kaamar olämmi mo tuya yi gool.
english: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba okwëënyi mo Cølöman käla Ijep ki Kue, kiper eni jø wø gädhö jïre wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö Kue kuna ŋëëwge ko okwëënyi ni kälge ge.
english: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

anywaa: 'Ba jää leny man nø man wø tut okweenynyi, kany wø käli ki Ijep gäte beeye gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe abïciel, ni ö gät okweeny man nø ni näk gwetbïrö ma rumme ma cekelli ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc; køøre cäŋge ka gath wøk baŋ nyeye bëët mo jø Këth ki nyeye mo jø Aram.
english: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cølöman acïpö ki dwøl kiper geer øtø mano geer kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mano geer kipere.
english: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

anywaa: Køøre ena kwänyö ki jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø ma jø tëër, ni kwänye ki jiy ma kume ma pïërabära ma jø tøk ki kïte bäät kïte maal, ni ö jiyi ma kume adäk ki dïpe abïciel ni cuum ge bäät jøøgø nee bëëtge na jø raŋ jøøgøøni ki tïïc.
english: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ Kiram nyeny Tayar ni kööe, ni «Kaawat mana wara tïïyï jï wära ma Deebit niï jäägö jïre ki jenni moa perge leth na mo geer øtø ki ge man bëëde yie, tïïyï jïra thuwø.
english: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

anywaa: Ennø, a ena bäät man gëëda ki øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, nee cïba kur keere na mare, nee wääŋö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni  met, nee muunni moa näk ocwøbø na näk nyuuthe nee wø cïp nyïme cooth, nee wø cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ka amöölla ka abøøya, ki yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm, ki kany wø päär dwääyi, ki kwör ajwöm moa näk ocïp piny kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ni beege jap wø bëëdö ni di tïïö cooth Icriel na bäre bäre.
english: Behold, I build an house to the name of the Lord my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the Lord our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba øtø mano geera en bee øtø mo dwøŋ; kiper Jwøk marwa dwøŋ ni kaala juu bëët.
english: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.

anywaa: ?'Ba aŋa ni løny jïre ki man gëëde ki øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk? Kiper maal këël maal kunece, Jwøk ba røm yie. ?A aani, aana ŋa nø, no ogëëdö ki øtø jïgø, ni näk mo patha man waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met keere nyïme?
english: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kwääny baŋa ki dhaanhø mo waŋe riek ki tïï warkey, ki tïï gwel-bïrö, ki tïï nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki tïï nywïënyö mano cwøl ni ayrön, ki tïï cwääy abïïe mo wø cwääc ki waare ma kït ma dïmuur, ki kït mo kwaar, ki kït ma abïcøle, ki tïï tieŋ kït jammi, nee ŋatøca tïïge na aciel ki jiya moa nyeŋge reegø ki tïï japøge na en buuta yi Juuda ki Jerucalem, jøøa jier wära ma Deebit.
english: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

anywaa: «Ni kwäänynyï jïra thuwø ki wïth jenni moa perge leth yi lur Libaanø, kiper ŋääa ni jiyï yi jöö man ŋøt jer lur Libaanø ki gø ŋäcge. 'Ba jiya ki jiyï geno tïïö na aciel,
english: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,

anywaa: ni ŋunge aani ki jenni moa perge leth mo thööth; kiper øtø mano geera en beeye øtø mo dwøŋ mo rëëma ec.
english: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

anywaa: 'Ba aani a cïpö ki jammi jï jiyï moo ŋøt jenni; ni jammi moo cïba beege beek wø cwøl ni cïndë mo oŋaaø ma yïth rumme ma kume ma pïërariiø, mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kör,  ki beek wø cwøl ni gäbci ma yïth rumme ma kume ma pïërariiø thuwø mo poot røm ka rumi manøgø, ki kwøk nyïïomøki ma rumme ma kume ma pïërariiø mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni baath, ki mädhi ma rumme ma kume ma pïërariiø thuwø mo røm ka rumi manøgø.»
english: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

anywaa: Køøre Kiram nyeny Tayar dwøl mare adwøge ki yi wëëlö ni jääŋ gø baŋ Cølöman ni ee göörö na ennønø, ni «Kiper mana näk mo Wuuö Jwøk mëër ki jiye, ïïna tïïe ni ïïna nyeya bäät jiye.»
english: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the Lord hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.

anywaa: Køøre Kiram acäŋ köö, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na cwääc maal ki piny, ŋata mooc nyeya ma Deebit ki wääde mo wïïe leer, na cïp riek waŋ ki ŋäc tiet luup jïgø, eni no ogeer øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare.
english: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the Lord, and an house for his kingdom.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, a jääŋŋö ki dhaanhø mo waŋe riek ki tïï jammi, mo tiet jammi ŋääe døc, ŋat mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Kuram-abi,
english: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,

anywaa: mo menni nyijø Daan, ni wänni ŋat Tayar. Ŋatøgø tïï warkey ŋääe, ki tïï gwel-bïrö, ki tïï nywïënyö ma jwïël, ki tïï nywïënyö mano cwøl ni ayrön, ki tïï kïte ki jenni, ki tïï cwääy abïïe mo wø cwääc ki waare ma kït ma dïmuur, ki kït ma abïcøle, ki kït mo kwaar, ki mo wø cwääc ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ŋat mo yi jöör tieŋ kït jammi bëët ŋääe, mo løny jïre ki man käl kït gïrpiny wøk ki yi jöö mano manynye jaak; nee eni tïïe na aciel ki jiyï moa nyeŋge reegø ki jic kwääya ma Deebit na näk wäru.
english: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na kwääya, beerra man jääŋŋï japa caanï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, ni beege beek wø cwøl ni cïndë, ki beek wø cwøl ni gäbci, ki mädhi ki kwøk nyïïomøki.
english: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

anywaa: Køøre nø, waani, jenni moa perge leth na manynyï oŋøtwa yi lur Libaanø, ni kälwa ge baŋï ki yi naama dwøŋ no otwöö na wïdhi këël Jøpa. Kanyøgønø, olwørï kaace ni kïthï ge Jerucalem.»
english: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in floats by sea to Joppa; and thou shalt carry it up to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Cølöman juurre bëët moa bëëdö yi ŋööm Icriel aput kwaan ki køør kwäänge moa dïkwøŋ na kwaan wänni ma Deebit, ni ö jiyi ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc ka adäk ki dïpe abïciel ni joodi.
english: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: Køøre ena kwänyö røk jøøgø ki jiy ma kume ma pïërabïriiø ma jø tëër, ni kwänye ki jiy ma kume ma pïërabära ma jø tøk ki kïte bäät kïte maal, ni ö jiyi ma kume adäk ki dïpe abïciel ni cuum ge bäät jøøgø nee bëëtge na jø raŋ jøøgø ki tïïc.
english: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cølöman aput tägö ki man geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk yi Jerucalem bäät Kïn Möria, kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na nyooth ree yie jï wänni ma Deebit, ni beeye kanya jiiŋ Deebiti yi laara mar Örnan nyï Jeebuc.
english: Then Solomon began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the Lord appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tägö ki geer ni nïr dwää ariiø, ariiø, ri ŋweer cwiic nyec moe.
english: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

anywaa: 'Ba Øt Jwøk manøgø na geeri ya Cølömanni rumme moe beege ii: Bär mare mar piny ki køør røm mana dïkwøŋ beege gööye ma pïërabïciel mo cenø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø.
english: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba agööla mana en nyïm øtø, bär mare caala rumi mar dööŋ yi øtø, ni beege gööye ma pïërariiø. 'Ba bär mare mar maal beege gööye ma dïpa ki pïërariiø; ni puuc yi gø ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

anywaa: 'Ba thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere arämme ki teeŋ jenni moa perge leth, ni puuc bäätge ki warkey mana tøŋ. Ni kïth dëër øtø ki jenni mo otieŋø mo caala kït tuue ki gïï mo otieŋø ni mïërö mo odöölö.
english: And the greater house he ceiled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø aŋwaŋŋe ki nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth. 'Ba warkey mana tïïc øtø ki gø käla kanya cwøl ni Parbiem.
english: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

anywaa: Ni puuc øtø ki warkey, ni beege nyeŋ øtø, ki kwöra no othørø dhi øtø, ki dëër øtø, ki dhøk øtø; ni tëëŋ dëër øtø ki kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli.
english: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

anywaa: Køøre eni thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth atïïe. Ni bär mar thääŋ øtø manøgø röömi ki dööŋ yi øtø bäre, ni beege gööye ma pïërariiø, ni ö dööŋ yie thuwø ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø. Ni puuc yi gø ki warkey mana tøŋ ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpe abïciel.
english: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

anywaa: 'Ba mucumääre moa tïïö ki ge otïïö ki warkey mo peek marge beege rumme ma cekelli ma pïërabïïc. Ni ö eni thuwø ni puuc uudi moa en maal ki warkey.
english: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

anywaa: Køøre ena tëëŋö ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli yi øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, ni lëëny dëët gïïögø ki warkey.
english: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubëlli moøgø bär mar bwöpge no opeerø beege gööye ma pïërariiø. Ni böömmö aciel bär mare beege gööye abïïc, ni bëëdö ni dëër øtø ee gudö. Ni ö böömmö maya ni näk gööye abïïc thuwø, ni bëëdö ni rege gudö ki bööm kirubël maya.
english: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

anywaa: 'Ba bööm kirubël manøgø thuwø poot na gööye abïïc, ni poot bëëdö ni dëër øtø ee gudö ki løøk maya. Ni ö böömme maya ni näk gööye abïïc thuwø, ni beeye böömmö mana näk ree gudö ki bööm kirubël mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubëlli moøgø bwöpge otïïö no opeerø, ni rumme mo bwöpge bëët beege gööye ma pïërariiø. Ni ge bëëdö no othïïŋö ni ge cuŋŋö ki tietge ni ge raŋŋa thääŋ øda en kur keere.
english: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ka abïï gëëŋi mo cwääc ka waare ma kït ma abïcøle, ki kït ma dïmuur, ki kït mo kwaar, ki waac lïïna mo tar mo mïërö; ni göör kït kirubëlli bäät abïï gëëŋi manøgø, ni tïïe ni kwøe kwøø ki waare.
english: And he made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø nyïm øtø ki gïï ma ariiø mo caala dïkweeye, mo bär marge beege gööye ma pïëradäk ka abïïc. Ni kïth wïth gïïögø ki jap mïërö mo bär mar man nø gööye abïïc.
english: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki tiimme mo odwøø, ni kïth ge wïth gïïa näk caala dïkweeye. Ni tïïe ki gïï  ma lømløme ma dïpa aciel mo caala nyïïadïkwäle, ni cïp ge bäät tiimme maal na en bäät gïïa caal dïkweeye.
english: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa näk caala dïkweeye acïp nyïm Øt Jwøk, na aciel ee cïp bäät cwïïc, ni cïp maya bäät caam. Ni cak nyeŋ mana en bäät cwïïc ni Jaakin,  ni ö mana en bäät caam ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Böeeth.
english: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman atïïö ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo tïïe ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, mo bär mare beeye gööye ma pïërariiø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø thuwø. 'Ba bär mar gääŋe ki maal beege gööye apaar.
english: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø ki gïr pïï mo dwøŋ mo ogul, mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo othiiø, ma gööye apaar ki mana täge deŋŋe man këël deŋŋe maya, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye abïïc, ni dööŋ dëëre beeye gööye ma pïëradäk.
english: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

anywaa: 'Ba nyäär gïr pïï manøgø othïïmmö ki gïï mo caala dhäk, no owïrö ki deŋŋe bäre, ni yi gööyö aciel da dhäk apaar, ni deŋ gïr pïï ege wïrö na tëëŋŋe ariiø.
english: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

anywaa: 'Ba gïr pïï manøgø ocïp bäät gïï ma apaar kurriiø mo poot caala dhäk. 'Ba dhäk moøgø adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø wï-piny, na adäk nyïmge oløø jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, na adäk møga nyïmge oløø jï løø tier-piny, na adäk møga nyïmge oløø jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba gïr pïï manøgø ocïp bäätge, ni ŋäthge oløø baŋ gø.
english: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

anywaa: 'Ba gïr pïï manøgø odhïŋe beeye rumi aciel mo røm ka lweedi moa na aŋween mo cenø; ni deŋŋe caala deŋ ogubayu ki deŋ apiito mo oŋøøk; 'ba yie kädö ki pïï ma yïth caapiie ma kume adäk.
english: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïïö thuwø ki jap peny ma apaar mo caala athääe; ni cïp abïïc bäät cwïïc, ni ö abïïci møga ni cïp ge bäät caam, nee gïï wø cïp no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre nee wø peny yïthge. 'Ba gïr pïï mana dwøŋ bee per dïlämme nee wø lööge yie.
english: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïïö ki gïï wø cuŋ lambae bäätge ma apaar mo tïïc ka warkey, ni tïïe ka køør jöö mana näk okäl wøk; ni cïp ge yi Øt Jwøk, na abïïc ee cïp bäät cwïïc, ni ö abïïci møga ni cïp ge bäät caam.
english: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø ki tharabëëte apaar; ni cïp ge yi Øt Jwøk, na abïïc ee cïp bäät cwïïc ni ö abïïci møga ni cïp ge bäät caam. Ni tïïe ki kuure ma dïpa mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basins of gold.

anywaa: Køøre kal mar dïlämme, ki kal mana dwøŋ, ko odhuule mo dhøk käälle, atïïe; ni ö odhuule moøgø ni lëëny ge ki nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gïr pïï mana dwøŋ acïp bäät cwïïc jï kuna en Øt Jwøki yie yïthakic jï løø tier-piny ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

anywaa: 'Ba Kuram atïïö thuwø ki dääe, ka akaape, ki cäänne. Kanyøgø, eni tïïe moa tïïe kiper nyeya ma Cølöman yi Øt Jwøk aput thöör ki tïïc,
english: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basins. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;

anywaa: ni beege: gïïa na ariiø na näk caala dïkweeye, ki gïïa näk ariiø na näk ogul mo jap mïërö moa na ariiø na näk ocïp wïth gïïa caal dïkweeye, ki tiimme moa no odwøø ma ariiø na mo rïëp gïïa na ariiø na mïërö na en wïth gïïa caal dïkweeye,
english: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

anywaa: ki gïïa näk caala nyïïadïkwäle ma dïpe aŋween na kïth bäät tiimme moa no odwøø, na aciel man nø dëëre da nyïïadïkwäle ma tëëŋŋe ariiø, na mo rïëp gïïa näk ogul na näk ariiø na mïërö na en wïth gïïa caal dïkweeye.
english: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

anywaa: Ena tïïö thuwø ki jïëthe mo wø käär jap peny ki ge, ki jap peny mo ena bäätge,
english: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

anywaa: ki gïr pïï aciel mana dwøŋ mo tiere da gïï pinyi apaar kurriiø mo otïïö ni caala dhäk.
english: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

anywaa: ki dääe, ka akaape, ki gïï wø lääm rïŋ wøk ki ge, ki wïth jap tïïc bëët mo paac. 'Ba Kuram-abi gïïögø bëët atïïe ki nywïënyö ma jwïël mo othoodhø jï nyeya ma Cølöman kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the Lord of bright brass.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman japøgø bëët atïïe nee tïïc ni thiia yïth odhöönhe mo yïthge okølø yi Goor Jördan yïthakic Cuköt ki Jereda.
english: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jap paac moøgøøni atïïe ni thööth døc, ni ö kwään rumme mo peek mar nywïënyö mana näk jwïël moa tïïc japøgø ki ge ni käri ŋääö këët.
english: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman thuwø jammi bëët moa en yi Øt Jwøk atïïe, ni beege: tharabëëta man wø waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bääte mo dëëre bäre olëënynyö ki warkey, ki tharabëëte mo cïp muunni bäätge moa näk ocwøbø na näk nyuuthe,
english: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

anywaa: ki gïï wø cuŋ lambae bäätge moa näk tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ, ge ki lambae moge, kiper nee bëëtge ni liel nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth ki yi jöö mana näk okäl wøk kiperge,
english: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

anywaa: ki gïï mo caala wïth jenni mo oŋøøk, ki lambae, ki dïkwänynye mo maac mo tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ døc;
english: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

anywaa: ki jap wø 'näk lambae ki ge, ki kuure, ka apät, ka athääe mo wø käär mäc ki ge, ni gïïögø bëët tïïc ka warkey mo tøŋ; ko odhuule mo Øt Jwøk, ni beege odhuulu mar thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, ko odhuul dhi Øt Jwøk man wø døny yie ki gø na en thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere. 'Ba odhuule moøgø bëët tïïe ka warkey.
english: And the snuffers, and the basins, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moa tïïc Cølömanni kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk athum ki tïïc. Ni ö Cølömanni ni käl jammi moa näk ocïp wänni ma Deebit kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni beege gwet-bïrö, ki warkie, ki jammi møga bëët moa perge leth, ni kïth geni yïth uut kän jammi mo Øt Jwøk.
english: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the Lord was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman jø døøk Icriel, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi bëët, ki dïbwöthe mo dhøk uudi mo jø Icriel acooŋ yi Jerucalem, kiper na acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy nee øømge yi Pääny Deebit, ni beeye Dhayan.
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët rege acooŋge buut nyeya ma Cølöman, ni beeye yïth nïne mo ajwöma man wø tïïc ki dwää abïriiø.
english: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jø døøk Icriel bëët gena öö, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ni lwørge acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.

anywaa: ni kälge acanduk manøgø, ko oduŋkaara man wø røøm Wuuö Jwøki yie ki jiy, ki jammi bëët moa no ocïp kur keerge na en yo oduŋkaara; ni ö dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay ni kälge gïïögø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman ki lwaa Icriel bäre moa näk rege ege cooŋ buute nyïm acanduk, gena cïpö ko olämme, ni beege dïëk ki dhäk mo thööth mo ba løny ki kwaan.
english: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dïlämme acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy akälge kare yi thääŋ Øt Jwøk mana en tääŋtiel, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth; ni cïpge gø tiet bwöp gïïa no otïïö ni caala nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli.
english: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

anywaa: 'Ba kirubëlli bwöpge otïïö no opeerø bäät kanya en acanduki yie, ni ö bwöp kirubëlli ni bëëtge maal, na acanduk ki jenni moa kääri ki geni ege rïëbö.
english: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

anywaa: 'Ba jenni moøgø bäyö døc, ni wïthge løny ki man neeni ni dhaanhø cuŋŋa  thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na en nyïm thääŋ øtø mana en kur keere na pere leth, 'ba ge ba løny joot ki wøk; 'ba ge poot nut kaace këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ya acanduk manøgø bäŋ gïrpiny yie, 'ba beege opäp kïte moa na ariiø keerge moa cïp Modhe yie kanya en tier Kïn Körëp, ni beeye kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na tude yie ki luubö ki jø Icriel kanya öge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the Lord made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme aö wøk ki kanya en kur keere na pere leth. 'Ba dïlämme bëët moa en kaace dëëtge ege nø cïp kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo cädö kiper dhøk mana en yie.
english: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

anywaa: 'Ba jø wär dudi bëët mo jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege Acaap, ki Ëman, ki Jeduthun, ki wäätge, ki jø tuuŋge, gena cuŋŋö buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni geno ruyö ka abïïk lïïne mo tar mo mïërö, ni ge pöödö ki thøp-othïënhö ki thøme mo wø pwöt ni di roodø, ka athiliiŋŋi, ni dïlämme ma dïpa ki pïërariiø ge kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø kooth tuŋi ki jø wär dudi ni tïŋge döötge maal na yie aciel ni ge dwøga pwøc ka ajiem jï Wuuö Jwøk, kanya wärge ni tuŋi ka athiliiŋŋi ki jap dööti ma teeŋi di pwödö ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ni köge, ni «Bee eni ni beer, kiper mëër mare bëëdö na bäre bäre ni ba jøøl,» Øt Wuuö Jwøk aput pääŋö ki pöölö.
english: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the Lord;

anywaa: Kanyøgø kär løny jï dïlämme këët ki man cuŋge nee tïïc marge tïïcge kiper pöölö mana en yi øtø, kiper ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk Øt Jwøk ee pääŋö bäre.
english: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cølöman aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk anø köö ni eni bëëdö yi pöölö mo odhïŋ.
english: Then said Solomon, The Lord hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana gëëdö ki øda ajiem jïrï na kar bëëtö marï na bäre bäre.»
english: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni lwaa Icriel bäre cuŋŋö kaagø, nyeya ma Cølöman nyïme aløø baŋge ni gwïëth geni bëët.
english: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na cäänö ki dhee jï wära ma Deebit, ni put gïna caane wëëk thur kare, ni kööe,
english: And he said, Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ mana käla jiya ma jø Icriel wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, aani bäŋ pääny mo yaa jierø ki røk päänye mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët naa gëënni yie ki øtø nee nyeŋŋa cwøl ree; ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo yaa jierø nee tïme na dïbwödhi mar jiya ma jø Icriel.
english: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba Jerucalem yaa nø jier nee nyeŋŋa bëëde yie, ni jiera Deebit nee bëëde na wïth jiya ma jø Icriel.›
english: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba wära ma Deebit gïnögø nut cwïnye cøøn ki man gëëde ki øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï wära ma Deebit, ni ‹Kiper mana bëët cwïnyï ni manynya man gëëde ki øtø kiper nyeŋŋa, beeye gïn mo beer na caarï ki cwïnyï.
english: But the Lord said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

anywaa: 'Ba paa ïïni noo geer øtø manøgø; 'ba beeye wäädï mano nywølï noo geer gø kiper nyeŋŋa.›
english: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk luubö mare mana caane anø wëëk thur kare; kiper aana nø ci kar wära ma Deebit ni pïïa bäät wälu mar jø Icriel, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki, ni nø gëëda ki øtø kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel,
english: The Lord therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and have built the house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: ni nø cïba acanduk kaace, ni beeye acanduk mana en luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy yie, ni beeye luumma tuude ki jø Icriel.»
english: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the Lord, that he made with the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Cølöman acuŋŋö nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe maal nyïm lwaa Icriel bäre.
english: And he stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

anywaa: 'Ba eno nø tïïö ki thudhi mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, mo bär mare beeye gööye abïïc, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye abïïc, ni bär mare mar maal beeye gööye adäk, ni ee tïï dï kal. 'Ba ena cuŋŋö bäät gø, ni put cøŋŋe këël piny yie nyïm acooŋ jø Icriel bäre ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe maal.
english: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

anywaa: Ni läme ni kööe,  «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, bäŋ Jwøk mo caala ïïni maalø wala bäät piny, mo luumma tuude ki jiy ee gwøø, ni nyooth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl jï jiye mo wø tïïö ka adïëri nyïme ki cwïnyge bäre.
english: And said, O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

anywaa: Ïïni, luumma caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit agwøgï, ni beeye mana caanï ki dhiï na wëëgï thur kare, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, luumma caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit put gwøk, na kööï, ni ‹Ni näk mo jiy moo käl dëërï wïthge koorge koorø ki bëëtö marge, ni bëëtge ni ge cäädhi ka køør ciik 'moa kaawat mana tïïyï, ï ba can ki dhaanhø mo pï piny bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.›
english: Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, beerra man ö luummï mana caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma wära ma Deebit ni wëëgï gø thur kare.
english: Now then, O Lord God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, Jwøk bëëdö ki jiy bäät piny møn? Ka adïëri møn, ï na Jwøk, maal këël maal kuya kunece ï ba røm yie. ?A øtø man ni yaa geerø en, ïïno rømï yie nidïï?
english: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, wïny lam mara, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni cegï ïthï ki kwac mara ki lam mara man kwaa ïïni ki gø en.
english: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O Lord my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

anywaa: Beerra man raŋŋï Øt Jwøk man ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär, øda kööï ni nyeŋŋï doo wøørø yie, kiper nee lam mara wïnynyï kany wø läma, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni nyïma yaa luu Øt Jwøk kany.
english: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

anywaa: Beerra man wïnynyï kwac mara, a na dhaanhnhï, ki kwac mar jiyï ma jø Icriel, kany wø lämge ni nyïmge ege luu Øt Jwøk kany. Beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø; beerra man wïnynyï gø møn ni wëënnï waani.
english: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø obääyö dëër ŋat atut mare, ni tïïi nee kööŋe, ni ööe ni kööŋe nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï yi Øt Jwøk man,
english: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø ki maal ni ŋølï mar jiyï, ni jäälï ŋata mare raac, ni dwøgï gïna raac wïïe keere na tïïe, ni ŋunnï ŋata mare beer, ni duunnï jïre ki køør mare na beer.
english: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo näk mo jiyï ma jø Icriel bööt nyïïmänni böötö, kiper mana tïïge ki raay dëërï, ni cäŋge duu baŋï ni cøørge nyeŋŋï, ni lämge ni kwacge ïïni yi øtø man,
english: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø maal, ni wëënnï raay mo jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni duuï ge yi ŋöömma cïpï jïge ki kwäcge.
english: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø näk mo maal ocuŋŋö, ni tïme ni bäŋ køth, kiper mana tïï jiyï ki raay dëërï, ni lämge ni nyïmge ege luu Øt Jwøk kany, ni cøørge nyeŋŋï, ni løkge rege ni wecge raay moge kanyo caannï geni,
english: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø maal, ni wëënnï raay mo jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni pwönynyï geni ki jöö mana beer man cääthge ki gø, ni jääŋŋï køth bäät ŋøøm moï moa cïpï jï jiyï na mo dööŋ jïge na moge.
english: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo da käc paac, wala täw mo leth, wala twöŋi mo raanynya beel, wala bäänyö, wala adïtwie, wala ni näk ge ciel nyïïmänni ciel dïër yïth päänye moge; këël ööa gïï mo leth ki täwe mo nyïëdi cøøn,
english: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

anywaa: ni näk mo dhaanhø aciel wala jiyï ma jø Icriel bëët lämö ni kwacge ïïni, ni ŋati man nø gïna leth na tägö dëëre ŋääe ki cwïnye, ni thaaŋ ceŋŋe jï kuna en Øt Jwøki man yie,
english: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni wëënnï ŋati man nø ni cunnï gø ki køør moa tïïe bëët, ni beege jøøa cwïnyge ŋäyï, kiper bee ï keerï ni ŋäc cwïny jiy bëët,
english: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)

anywaa: nee ge lwäcge ki ïïni, ni cääthge ki jöörï ki yïth nïne bëët moo beetge yïth ŋøøm moa cïpï jï kwäcwa.
english: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.

anywaa: «Këël jur thuwø mo ba käl røk jiyï ma jø Icriel, kany wø ööe ki paac mo bäär kiper mano wïny dööŋö mar nyeŋŋï ki teek badï, ni ööe ni läme ni nyïme ee luu Øt Jwøk kany,
english: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï gø kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni tïïyï gø ki køør gïïa pëënynye bëët, nee nyeŋŋï ŋäc jø bäät pinynyi bëët, niï lwäärge kaawat man wø tïïc jiyï ma jø Icriel, nee ŋäcge møn ni øtø man ni yaa geerø en cwøla ri nyeŋŋï.
english: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø ö jiyï wø cige baŋ leny baŋ nyïïmän moge, ni këël ge jääŋŋï ka waŋjööra ŋø cøøn, ni lämge jïrï ni nyïmge ege luu yi pääny man na näk iï jierø ki øtø mana näk yaa geerø kiper nyeŋŋï,
english: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï lam marge maal ki kwac marge, ni kønyï geni.
english: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø bääcge dëërï, kiper mana näk mo bäŋ dhaanhø cøøn mo ba bääyi, ni wëërï ki geni ni cïbï geni ceŋ nyïïmän, ni ö geni ni magi ya nyïïmänni ki tøŋ, ni kïthge geni yïth ŋøøpge, kany mo bäär wala kany mo cään,
english: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

anywaa: ni näk mo ge cätö ni løkge cwïnyge yi ŋöömö mana kïth ge yie ni ge mak ka tøŋ, ni kwacge ïïni yi ŋööm jøøa mak geni ki tøŋ, ni köge, ni ‹Waana bääyö, ni nø tïïwa ki gïï mo reyø døc;›
english: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

anywaa: ni näk mo ge duua baŋï ki cwïnyge bäre ka acaacge bäre ki kanya kïth geni yie yïth ŋøøp nyïïmän moge na mak geni ki tøŋ, ni lämge jïrï ni nyïmge ege luu yi ŋöömö marge na cïpï jï kwäcge, ki pääny mana jierï, ki øtø mana geera kiper nyeŋŋï,
english: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:

anywaa: beerra man wïnynyï lam marge ki kwac marge kany wø bëëdï yie maalø, ni kønyï geni, ni wëënnï jiyï moa no obääyö dëërï.
english: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Jwøk mara, a kwaya ïïni, beerra man räŋŋï ni cegï ïthï ki lam man wø lam kany.
english: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal, ni ööï kar bëëtö marï, ïïni ka acanduk man wø nyooth teek marï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man ö dïlämme moï ni røøge bëënynyö dëëtge, ni ö jiyï mo wø cwïnyge en køørï ni mïn yïthge ki beenynyï.
english: Now therefore arise, O Lord God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär täärnyïmï kanï ki aani na røønyï, ni parï wïïï ki mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl na nyoothï jï dhaanhnhï ma Deebit.»
english: O Lord God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na lønye ki lam, maac aput öö ki maal ni thöör olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ki teeŋ olämme møga; ni ö ajiemmi mar Wuuö Jwøk ni pääŋ yi øtø.
english: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kär løny jï dïlämme këët ki man dønyge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk, Øt Wuuö Jwøk ee päŋö.
english: And the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord, because the glory of the Lord had filled the Lord's house.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët, kanya jootge maac ni öö ki maal na ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk dudö bäät øtø, cøŋge akëëlge piny dï kal nyïm øtø, ni kuulge wïthge piny yïth ŋøøm, ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk ni pwøcge gø ni ge köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cølöman ki jiy bëët gena put cïpö ko olämme nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the Lord.

anywaa: Nyeya ma Cølöman acïpö ko olämme mo dhäk ma kume ma pïërariiø kurriiø, ki dïëk ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø; ni ö nyeya ki jiy bëët ni putge Øt Jwøk cïp kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme cuŋŋö kwörge, ni jø tuuŋ Libay ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki jap dööti moa tïïc nyeya ma Deebit kiper dwøk pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaa wara pwøc Wuuö Jwøk ki ge ni eni köö, ni «Mëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.» 'Ba ki løøk maya dïlämme møga ge bëëdö ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi, ni dhaanh Icriel bäre bëëdö ni cuŋŋö.
english: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the Lord, which David the king had made to praise the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Cølöman thääŋ dïkal mana en dïër na en nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk acïp kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni cïp yi  gø ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki dwäälö mar olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, kiper gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na tïïe atïmö ni thiinh ki man cïp olämme moøgø bëët bääte, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo beel, ki dwäälö mar olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër.
english: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Cølöman Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ki Yïth Abïle aputge wøør ki nïne abïriiø ki jø Icriel bëët, ni beeye acooŋ lwaa dhaanhø mo päl mana no oöö bäre ki Libö-Amath na en jï løø wï-piny këël mana këët waŋ Naam Ijep na en jï løø tier-piny.
english: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cïpge gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kur keere na mar Jwøk ege nø wøør ki nïne abïriiø, ni cäŋge Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ki Yïth Abïle wøørrø ki nïne abïriiø møøk. 'Ba na tïme na ri bäc nïne mar ajwöma, gena jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere.
english: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm nïr dwää abïriiø na pïërariiø kurdäk, Cølöman jiy awëëk døøn mïëcge ki kanynyø ki met cwïny mo dwøŋ, kiper jammi moa beyø bëët na tïïc Wuuö Jwøki jï Deebit ki Cølöman ki jï jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the Lord had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cølömanni na thöör Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare ki geer, ni jammi bëët moa näk ee caarø ki cwïnye ni di tïïö yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare ee thöörö bëët ki tïïc na karge,
english: Thus Solomon finished the house of the Lord, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the Lord, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jï Cølöman ki wäär, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Aani, lam marï awïnynya; ni kany yaa jierø kipera nee bëëde na øtø man wø cïp olämme yie.
english: And the Lord appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo maal yaa cïëgö ni tïm køthi ni bäŋgø, wala ni näk mo bäänyö yaa köömmö ni öge ni raanyge ŋöömö, wala a jääŋŋa täw mo raac bäät jiya,
english: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

anywaa: jiya mo wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa ni näk mo dëëtge dwøkge piny ni mwöl, ni lämge, ni manyge aani, ni wecge jïëdhi moge na reyø, aani döötge wïnynya wïnynyö ki maal, ni wëënna raay moge, ni dwøga paac marge kare.
english: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

anywaa: Ennø, a bëëdö ni nyeŋŋa yaa jabø ni ö ïdhi 'moa ni bëëtge ni yaa ciiø kiper lam man wø lam kany.
english: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

anywaa: Kiper ennø, øtø man yaa jierø ni nø cïba gø kur keere na mara nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ree na bäre bäre, naa raŋŋa gø cooth ni cwïnya ena baŋe.
english: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, ni näk miï bëëdö niï tïïya adïëri nyïma kaawat mana tïïc wäru ma Deebit, ni tïïyï jammi bëët moa köömma ïïni ki ge, ni gwøgï ciik 'moa ki luup ŋøl 'moa,
english: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;

anywaa: aani, tier nyec marï këëlla piny ni teek, kaawat mana caana gø jï wäru ma Deebit, ni kööa, ni ‹Ï ba cännï ki dhaanhø mo tïmö na nyeya man käär Icriel.›
english: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo ïïni ki jø Icriel nyïmmu you løø wøk ni weyu luup 'moa ki ciik 'moa na köömma uuni ki ge, ni cou ni tïnynyu juu møøk ni lammu geni,
english: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

anywaa: aani, u cööda wøk yïth ŋøøm 'moa moa cïba jïïu, ni ö øtø man ni yaa cïp kur keere kiper nyeŋŋa en, ni leeŋa gø wøk nyïma, ni tïïa gø na gïn ŋäät ree, na gïr waac yïthakic wïth juurre bëët.
english: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

anywaa: Øtø man ni nyeŋŋe owïnyö en, jiy bëët moo cør deŋŋe yïthge othäŋŋi ni köge, na ‹?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc gïn dëër ŋöömö man ki øtø man?›
english: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

anywaa: Køøre oløk jiyi ni köge, ni ‹Beeye kiper mana wecge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, na käl geni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ni cige ni ŋiicge rege ki juu møøk ni lamge geni, ni tïnyge geni. Kiper manøgønø, beeye tiere na ö Wuuö Jwøki ni kïth gïnögø ni leth enø bäre bäätge.› »
english: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the Lord God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba cwiiri moa thöör Cølömanni kanya bëëde ni gëëdö ki Øt Wuuö  Jwøk ki øtø mare beege cwiiri ma pïërariiø.
english: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the Lord, and his own house,

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aŋuun cwiiri moøgø, päänye moa cïp Kirammi jïre acäŋ geerrø ni wëëk jø Icriel bëëtö yïthge.
english: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman aci Amath- Jöba ni mac gø;
english: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah, and prevailed against it.

anywaa: ni geer kanya cwøl ni Tatmör dï paap Amath ki päänye bëët moa näk yïthge da uut kän na en Amath.
english: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

anywaa: 'Ba eni Bëëth-Örön mana en maal ki mana en piny ageere thuwø; ni tïïc kiiri ki dhøk kiiri mo päänye moøgøøni ni teek døc, këël ki dïdëëdi mo odhuule moge.
english: Also he built Beth–horon the upper, and Beth–horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman päänya cwøl ni Baalath ageere thuwø, ki päänye moe bëët mo cuŋ yïthge ki caammi, ki päänye mo bëët jïëth leny moe yïthge mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki päänye mo bëët jø okwëënyi moe yïthge, ki gïïa manynye bëët nee geere yi Jerucalem, ki yi Libaanø, ki yi ŋöömö mana en tiere bäre.
english: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa näk patha jø Icriel na bøth ki thøø røk jø Këth, ki røk jø Amör, ki røk jø Përec, ki røk jø Ëwi, ki røk jø Jeebuc,
english: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,

anywaa: na näk kär raany jø Icrielli, nyïïkwaacge moa dööŋ amak Cølömanni ki teek kiper tïïc, këël man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman bäŋ jiy mo ee tïïö na laaŋe ki røk jø Icriel kiper tïïc mare. 'Ba jø Icriel atïïe na jø leny, na kwääc lwaae moe mo leny, na kwääc lwaae mo jïëth leny moe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi.
english: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø Icriel møøk mo ocuumö na jø wø käär tïïe mo Cølöman mo kwäänge dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc, mo ocïïmmö bäät jiy na mo käär jiy.
english: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman, nyi Peerø akäl wøk ki yi Pääny Deebit ni kïth gø yi øda geere kiper gø; kiper ena köö, ni «Cïïa ba bëëdö këët yi øt Deebit nyeny Icriel, kiper kwöra cïp acanduk yïthge beege kwör mo ena kur keerge na mo Jwøk.»
english: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the Lord hath come.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman acïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye mana tïïe nyïm agööl Øt Jwøk.
english: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the Lord on the altar of the Lord, which he had built before the porch,

anywaa: 'Ba olämme moøgøøni na cïpi ya Cølömanni, tïïe ka køør ciik Modhe moa näk ocïp piny kiper yi cïp olämme mo wø cïp ki yi cäŋ cooth, ki yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm, ki kany wø päär dwääyi, ki kwör ajwöm moa na adäk mo wø wøør ki yi cwiir cooth, ni beege Ajwöm Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø, ka Ajwöm Caammi Mo Wø Kwøŋ Ciek, ka Ajwöma Man Wø Wøør Ki Yïth Abïle.
english: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman ki køør ciik mo wänni ma Deebit, dïlämme acïïmme na dhøgi bäät tïïe moge; ni cïïm jø tuuŋ Libay na dhøgi kiper tïï dwøk pwøc ki køny dïlämme ki tïïc ki køør ciik moa näk ocïp piny kiper yi cäŋ cooth; ni cïïm jø koor dhøk kal na dhøgi bäät dhøk kal bëët, ki køør mana caan Deebiti na näk dhaanh Jwøk.
english: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.

anywaa: 'Ba geni bäŋ gïn mo ege gwäyö røk ciik nyeya moa caane kiper dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay, këël nyi gïn mo thiinh, wala gïn mo guta uut kän.
english: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïe mo Cølöman bëët acäädhö ni beer ki mana täge ki kanya cak tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki geer këël mana thöör øtø bäre. Kanyøgønø, Øt Wuuö Jwøk athum bäre ki tïïc.
english: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the Lord, and until it was finished. So the house of the Lord was perfected.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman aci Edhiyön-Gabir ki Ëlath, mïëya en bäät Naama Kwaar ŋööm Ëdöm.
english: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

anywaa: 'Ba Kiram ena jääk baŋ Cølöman ki baabuure ki ceŋ jiy moe, ki jiy mo da gïn mo ŋäcge kiper bëët naam. Kanyøgø jøøgøøni ki jic Cølöman gena ci kanya cwøl ni Öpïr kuna määnyge ki warkey, ni jïtge ki warkey mo rumme ma kikarri ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc, ni kälge gø jï nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøa no orøønyø na nyeya mar Cïïba na wïny gïr wïny nyeŋ mar Cølöman, ena ö yi Jerucalem kuna pëëny Cølöman ki pïëc mo teek. 'Ba ena öö ni käädö ki lwaak mo päl  ka athïrööle mo tïëdö ki teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met, ki warkey mo päl døc, ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth. 'Ba eni kanya pïïe baŋ Cølöman, luup bëët moa en cwïnye acaane jï gø.
english: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman pïëc mo nyijøøgø bëët adwøge jïgø, ni bäŋe aciel mo odhäthö jïre mo käre løø jïgø.
english: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø na joot leec wïc mar Cølöman, ki øt nyec mana geere,
english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

anywaa: ki cam man wø cïp nyïme kar cam mare, ki kwör bëëte mo jøøa näk ee cuumö, ki yi jöö man wø tïï jø tïïci moe ki gø ki ruyö marge, ki jiy moe mo wø gap kwøk nyïïomøki jïre ki ruyö marge, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo wø cïbe Øt Jwøk, doo thøw ki thäŋ ec.
english: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the Lord; there was no more spirit in her.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aköö jï nyeya ma Cølöman, ni «Luup moa wïnynya naa ena yi ŋöömö mara kiper tïïe moï ki leec wïc marï beege karge.
english: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a kär jïëy ki luup moa wïnynya këël mana ööa en ni jooda gø ki waŋa. Raŋï, leec wïc marï man bäre ni dwøŋ en, këël thääŋŋe kär caanø jïra. 'Ba ïïno pöödhö døc ni kaala mana wïnynya kiperï.
english: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.

anywaa: A met ec mo nyïëdi ni en jï jiy moï ki jiy moa näk iï cuumö ni wø en buutï cooth, ni wø wïny luup mo wø caanï ki køør leec wïc marï!
english: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, na yie mïnnö ki ïïni na cïp ïïni bäät wälu mare na nyeya kiper nee eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, nee tïnynyï. 'Ba Jwøk marï, kiper mana näk eni mëër ki jø Icriel ni manynya man këël tietge piny na bäre bäre, ïïna tïïe na nyeya bäät jø Icriel nee luup wø ŋølï na karge niï tïïya adïëri.»
english: Blessed be the Lord thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.

anywaa: Køøre nyijøøgø aput cïpö jï nyeya ma Cølöman ki warkey ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa ki pïërariiø, ki teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met mo thööth døc, ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth mo thööth. 'Ba bäŋ teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met mo okwøŋ käl po nyeya ma Cølöman cøøn mo caala moa käl nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø jïgø.
english: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba jic Kiram ki jic Cølöman moa wara kännö ki warkey ki kanya cwøl ni Öpïr, gena kännö thuwø ki jero cwøl ni algum ki nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö mo perge leth.
english: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jerøgø ni cwøl ni algum yøø, nyeya ma Cølöman atïïö rege ko ogadi mo eth maal ki ge kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki øt nyec mare, ni tïïe thuwø ki thøp-othïënhö ma teeŋi ki røk jerøgø kiper jø wär dudi. 'Ba japa tïïe yøø, bäŋ teeŋge mo okwøŋ joot cøøn yi ŋööm Juuda.
english: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the Lord, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman gïïa many nyijøøgø na nyeny Cïïba enø na pëënynye bëët acïbe jïgø ni thööth ni kaala japa käl nyijøøgøøni jïre. Køøre nyijøøgø adøø yi ŋöömö mare ki jiy moe.
english: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

anywaa: 'Ba warkie mo wø käli jï Cølöman ki yi cwiir cooth, peek marge beege rumme ma kikarri ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïciel ka abïciel,
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

anywaa: ni moa jwäk baŋ jø gath kär kwaan rege. 'Ba nyeye mo Arabe bëët, ki kwääri mo paayø, gena kännö thuwø ki warkie ki gwetbïrö jï Cølöman.
english: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman atïïö ki gïï ma dïpe ariiø mo døøŋŋø mo caala kööt leny mo tïïc ka warkey, ni warkey mana tïïc man nø ki gø, peek mare beeye rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe abïciel.
english: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

anywaa: Ni tïïe thuwø ki mo therø ma dïpe adäk, mo poot tïïc ka warkey, ni warkey mana tïïc man nø ki gø, peek mare beeye rumme ma cekelli ma dïpe adäk; ni ö nyeya ma Cølöman ni cïp geni yi øtø mana cwøl ni Øt Lur Libaanø.
english: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø nyeya atïïö ki wälu mo dwøŋ døc mo tïïc ka lak liec, ni lëëny dëër gø ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

anywaa: 'Ba wälu manøgø nyïme okïthö ko ogat mo da kwör tiel abïciel; 'ba da køøm tiel mo ogur ree mo tïïc ka warkey, ni deŋ wälu løøi ki løøi okïthö ki gïï cïp ceŋ bäätge, ni gïï ma ariiø mo caala ŋuuwe otïïö ni cuŋŋö buute løøi ki løøi.
english: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

anywaa: 'Ba da gïï ma apaar kurriiø mo caala ŋuuwe mo otïïö ni cuŋŋö bäät kwör tiel moa na abïciel, ni bäät kar tielø man nø løøi ki løøi da ŋuu mo cuŋŋö bääte. 'Ba bäŋ teeŋ wälu mo caala manøgø cøøn mo otïïö yi buc nyec mør.
english: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø mäth nyeya ma Cølöman ki ge bëët tïïc ka warkey, ni jap paac bëët moa en yi øtø mana cwøl ni Øt Lur Libaanø tïïc ka warkey mana tøŋ; kiper gwel-bïrö okwaanø na gïn mo bäŋ kare ki yïth nïne moa beet Cølömanni.
english: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya jïre da baabuure mo naam mo gath mo wø cøøa Tarcëc ki jic Kiram; ni kany wø tïme na køør cwiiri adäk nø, baabuure moøgø wø kännö ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ki lak lïëy, ka apøønnanyare, ki bïme.
english: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman atïmö ni kare dwøŋ døc ni kaala nyeye bëët mo bäät piny ki kwärö ki leec wïc.
english: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeye bëët mo bäät piny ni tïmge ni ge manynya man öge baŋ Cølöman kuna wïnyge luup mo wø caane ki køør leec wïc mare mana cïp Jwøki jïre.
english: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø ööi ki yi cwiir cooth, ge käädö ki muuce, ni beege jammi moa näk tïïc ka gwet-bïrö, ki jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey, ka abïïe, ki jap leny, ki teeŋ gïï wø ŋwääi ni wø tïïc kadø ni met, ko okwëënyi, ki gääŋŋe.
english: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman jïre da lwääge mo yïthge oŋørø na kume aŋween kiper okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okweenynyi, ni jïre da okwëëc leny thuwø ma kume apaar kurriiø; ni kïth møøk yïth päänye mo wø bëët jïëth lenynyi mo wø tut okwëënyi yïthge, ni käl møga buute yi Jerucalem.
english: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre ena put bëëte ni nyeye bëët ena tiere ki mana täge ki Naam Upareeti këël mana këët yi ŋööm jø Pilitin, ni pïïe waŋ keew ki jø Ijep.
english: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cølöman gwet-bïrö atïïe ni thööth døc yi Jerucalem ni caala kïte, ni tïïc jenni moa perge leth ni thööth jaak kaamar olämmi mo tuya yi gool.
english: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy wø kännö ko okwëënyi jï Cølöman ki Ijep ki yïth mïëri bëët.
english: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi møga bëët moa tïïc Cølömanni ki mana täge këël aŋuudi marge, ogöörö yïth luup mo nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki yïth luup moa göör nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Akiya nyï Cëëlö, ki yïth luup mo Idö ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre na wara cäänö kiper Jeröbäm o Nebat.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

anywaa: 'Ba Cølöman abëëdö na nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween yi Jerucalem bäät Icriel bäre.
english: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

anywaa: Køøre Cølöman athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi pääny wänni ma Deebit; ni ö wääde ma Reeyöböm ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm aci Cekam, kiper jø Icriel bëët onø ci Cekam nee eni tïïcge na nyeya.
english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm o Nebat na wïny gïnögø, ena duuö ki Ijep, ni beeye kanya reŋ yie ni eni ŋwieya nyeya ma Cølöman.
english: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre jø Icriel gena jääk baŋ Jeröbäm nee ööe, ni ö Jeröbämmi ki lwaa Icriel bäre ni öge ni cäänge ki Reeyöböm ni köge,
english: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wäru bëëtö marwa atïïe ni caala tëër mo peek bäätwa. 'Ba ennø, bëëtö  mana teek na caal tëër mo peek na wara tïïc wäru bäätwa, tïïyï ni jööt; køøre nø, ï tïnywa tïnynyö.»
english: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm aköö jïge, ni «Døøgu nø, ni bëëdu ki nïne adäk; køøre uuno duu baŋa.» Køøre jøøgø gena døøk.
english: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya ma Reeyöböm acaara mar jø døøŋŋø apëënynye, ni beege jøøa wara tïny wänni ma Cølöman kanya bëët wänni ni poot kwøw, ni kööe, na «?Acaara mo nyïëdi noo cïpu jïra naa jïta ki øtjöö man dwøga luum jøøi ki gø?»
english: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?

anywaa: Køøre adwøk jøøgø jïre ni köge, ni «Ni näk mo bäth ec marï ki mëër marï iï nyoodhø jï jøøgø niï cara luup mo beyø jïge, ge tïmö ni gena jiy mo tïnynya ïïni na bäre bäre.»
english: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm acaara mana cïp jø døøŋŋø jïre akwiere, ni tïme ni pëënynya acaara mar obwöre moa piith ki eni na aciel, na tïny eni.
english: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Acaara mo nyïëdi noo cïpu jïra kiper nee luubö dwøgø jï jøøi ii na cäänö ki aani na köö, ni ‹Bëëtö marwa na caal tëër mo peek na wara tïïc wäru bäätwa, tïïyï ni jööt›?»
english: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?

anywaa: 'Ba obwöre moa piith ki eni na aciel adwøkge jïre ni köge, ni «?Köö jøøgø ni bëëtö marge mana wara tïïc wäru ni teek bäätge tïïyï jïge ni jööt? Ennø, caanï jïge, ni ‹Lweeta man ni thiinh en otïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni ki pier wära.
english: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat mana ö wära na tïïc bëëtö maru ni teek ni caala tëër mo peek, aani bëëtö maru cäŋa ka tïïyö ni teek døc ni kaala mana tïïc wära. Wära u pwönynye ka alaŋŋe, 'ba aani, u pwönynya pwönynyö ka alaŋŋe mo lethe caala leth dha agarap.› »
english: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää nïne, Jeröbäm ki jiy bëët gena duu baŋ nyeya ma Reeyöböm kaawat mana caane na kööe, ni «Uuno duu baŋa ri dää nïne.»
english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Reeyöböm luubö mare aput dwøgø ni teek jï jøøgø, kiper ena kweer ka acaara mana cïp jø døøŋŋø jïre,
english: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

anywaa: ni caan gø jïge ki køør acaara mana cïp obwöre jïre, ni kööe, ni «Wära bëëtö maru atïïe ni teek ni caala tëër mo peek bäätu; 'ba aani bëëtö maru cäŋa ka tïïyö ni teek døc ni kaala mana tïïc wära. Wära u pwönynye ka alaŋŋe; 'ba aani, u pwönynya pwönynyö ka alaŋŋe mo lethe caala leth dha agarap.»
english: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya luum jø Icriel käre wïnynyö, kiper gïnögø beeye gïn mo käla baŋ Jwøk kiper nee luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Jeröbäm o Nebat ki dha Akiya nyï Cëëlö thur kare.
english: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the Lord might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli bëët na jootge gø ni marge kär wïny nyeya, adwøkge jï nyeya, ni köge, «?Aŋø, waani, da kurwa ri Deebit? Waani, kee bäŋ gïn mo dooŋ na kurwa ki røk jap o Jeci. Wui jø Icriel, ŋati man nø døø paare. 'Ba ï na nyikwaar Deebit, dööŋï keerï ki jø dhi ødï.» Kanyøgø jø Icriel gena put døø mïëcge.
english: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm abëëdö na nyeya mar jø Icriel moa bëëdö yïth päänye mo Juuda.
english: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Reeyöböm Adöram na bëëdö na wïth jø tïïc mo wø mak ki teek ajääŋŋe baŋ jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni këërge gø ki kïte ni put thøø. Køøre, nyeya ma Reeyöböm alaar eth yi jääne man wø tut okweenynyi ni reŋ Jerucalem.
english: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel gena put tïmö ni ge gëëmö ki jø dhi øt Deebit këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Reeyöbömmi na pïïe yi Jerucalem, jø leny moa teek døc ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërabära mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen acooŋe, nee këëtge ki jø Icriel, kiper nee buc nyec duu baŋ Reeyöböm.
english: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Cemaya ni kööe,
english: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï nyeny Juuda ma Reeyöböm o Cølöman, ki jï jø Icriel bëët mo wø bëëdö yi ŋööm Juuda ki yi ŋööm Benjamen, ni kööï,
english: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,

anywaa: ni mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Käru cøø nou këëdu ki nyïïmëëgu. Ŋati man nø døø paare, kiper gïnögø käla baŋa.› » Køøre luum Wuuö Jwøk aputge wïnynyö, ni døøge mïëcge ni bäŋ ŋat mo oci baŋ leny këët ki Jeröbäm.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the Lord, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Reeyöböm Jerucalem, eni päänye møøk mo Juuda acäŋ geerrø ni teek,
english: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.

anywaa: ni beege Bethelem, ki Ëtam, ki Tëköa,
english: He built even Beth–lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

anywaa: ki Bëëth-Cur, ki Cökö, ka Adulam,
english: And Beth–zur, and Soco, and Adullam,

anywaa: ki Gëth, ki Marëca, ki Dhip,
english: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

anywaa: ka Adöram, ki Lakic, ka Adhëka,
english: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

anywaa: ki Dhöra, ka Ayalön, ki Keeprön. Moøgø bëët beege päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek na en yïth ŋøøp jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

anywaa: 'Ba eni thuwø kwör gwøk røk mo päänye moøgø atïïe ni teek ni kïth yïthge ki kwääc lwaae mo leny, ki wïth caammi, ki mädhi mo thaal, ki kwøk nyïïomøki.
english: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

anywaa: Køøre ena kïth yïth päänye moøgø bëët thuwø ki kööt leny ki tøøŋi, ni tïïc ge ni teek døc. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen ni putge bëëte tiere.
english: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay moa en yïth mïëri mo Icriel bëët gena put dwät tier Reeyöböm.
english: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay moøgø ni wecge kwör kwaath moge ki kwör bëëte moge ni öge Juuda ki Jerucalem, kiper Jeröbäm ki wääte ge ege mänö ki man bëëtge na dïlämme mo tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm da dïlämme moe mo ee kwanyø kiper kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri, kiper kït gïïa tïïe na näk caala atëëe ki nyïïrøøe.
english: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
