anywaa: 'Ba ki røk wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëët, jøøa bëëdö ni cwïnyge ege cïbö ki man manyge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, gena läm køør jø tuuŋ Libay yi Jerucalem, kiper nee cïpge ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk Jwø kwäcge.
english: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the Lord God of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba geni tier buc nyec mar jø Juuda akëëlge piny ni teek, ni bëëtge ki cwiiri adäk ni Reeyöböm o Cølöman ege jølø, ni ge bëëdö ki køør bëëtö mana bëët Deebiti ki Cølöman ki gø ki cwiiri moøgø na adäk yøø.
english: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm Maalët nyi Jerimöth anywøme, ni beeye Jerimöth o Deebit. 'Ba nyeŋ mii Maalët beeye Abikael nyi Eliap, ni beeye Eliap o Jeci.
english: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

anywaa: 'Ba Maalët anyöödö ko obwöre ma cwøw ki Reeyöböm, ni beege Jeuc, ki Cemariya, ki Dhaam.
english: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.

anywaa: Køøre Reeyöböm Maika nya Abëcëlöm anywøme thuwø, ni nyööde ko obwöre ki gø, ni beege Abaaja, ka Attay, ki Jija, ki Cëlömith.
english: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm mëër ki Maika nya Abëcëlöm døc ni kaala määre møga bëët, ki määre moa na akwanye bëët. 'Ba määre bëët moa cøøde gena apaar ka abära, ni mään moa na akwanye gena pïërabïciel. 'Ba obwöre moa nywøl Reeyöbömmi beege cwøw ma pïërariiø ka abära ki nyïïakuue ma pïërabïciel.
english: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm wääde ma Abaaja mana nywøle ki cïïe ma Maika atïïe na wïth wääte, kiper mana näk ee gø cooŋø ni røønye røønyø na nyeya.
english: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki køør leec wïc mare, wääte møøk apääŋŋe yïth mïëc jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen bëët, ni beege päänye bëët moa no ogeerø ni teek. Ni cïpe ki cam mo päl jïge, ni nyööme jïge ki mään mo thööth.
english: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Reeyöbömmi ni këël tier buc nyec mare piny ni teek, eni ki jø Icriel bëët ciik Wuuö Jwøk awecge.
english: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana wecge Wuuö Jwøk, kanya tïme na ri bïï cwiiri moa beet nyeya ma Reeyöbömmi ni ena nyeya, Cicak nyeny Ijep aöö ni këëde ki jø Jerucalem,
english: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the Lord,

anywaa: ni ööe ki jïëth leny ma  kuma ki dïpe ariiø mo wø tuut okwëënyi, ki cwøw leny ma kume ma pïërabïciel mo këëdi ka bäät okwëënyi. 'Ba jø leny moa öö ki eni ki Ijep ba løny ki kwaan, ni jø leny moøgøøni beege jø Libya, ki jø Cuka, ki jø Kuuc.
english: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Libyans, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

anywaa: Ni mak päänye mo Juuda moa no ogeerø ni teek, ni ööe këël mana pïïe buut Jerucalem.
english: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Cemaya aö baŋ Reeyöböm ki kwääri mo Juuda moa näk rege ege cooŋ yi Jerucalem ni ge lwäära Cicak, ni kööe jïge, ni «Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana weyu aani, aani thuwø, uuna wiia cer Cicak.› »
english: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

anywaa: Køøre kwääri mo jø Icriel ki nyeya dëëtge aputge dwøk piny ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk mare beeye adïëri.»
english: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The Lord is righteous.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na neen gø ni rege ege dwøk piny, dwøre acäŋ ö bäät Cemaya ni kööe, ni «Kiper mana nø dwøkge dëëtge piny, ge ba raanynya këët. 'Ba ki kany mo cään køny mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïge, ni ö wëërri mara ni ba kïtha gø bäät Jerucalem këët ki ri Cicak.
english: And when the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

anywaa: 'Ba ge tïmö ni gena laaŋe jï Cicak, nee kwänyge ki man ŋäcge apääk mana en yïthakic man tïnyge aani ki man tïnyge nyeye mo bäät piny.»
english: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cicak nyeny Ijep aöö ni tuk Jerucalem, ni twier jammi moa no okanø yi øt kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki moa no okanø yi øt kän jammi mo øt nyec, ni käl jammi bëët. Këël kööt leny moa no otïïö ki warkey na tïïc Cølömanni akäle thuwø.
english: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Reeyöböm atïïö ki kööt leny møøk mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na kar moøgø, ni cïp ge ceŋ kwääc jø koor mo wø koor dhi øt nyec.
english: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö nyeya wø døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ge wø cøø ki eni na aciel ni kööt leny moøgø käärge käärö, ni kany wø duuge wøk, duuge yi øt jø koor.
english: And when the king entered into the house of the Lord, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö Reeyöbömmi na dwøk ree piny, wëëc Wuuö Jwøk ree apaanye bääte, ni käri ya Wuuö Jwøki raanynyø na bäre këët. 'Ba da jammi møøk mo poot beyø thuwø yi ŋööm Juuda.
english: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the Lord turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Reeyöböm tier nyec mare akëël piny ni teek yi Jerucalem, ni put bëëte na nyeya. 'Ba eni, kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïëraŋween kurciel, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïriiø ni ena nyeya Jerucalem, ni beeye päänya jier Wuuö Jwøki ki røk päänye bëët mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel nee nyeŋŋe bëëde ni ŋäc yie. 'Ba Reeyöböm nyeŋ menni beeye Nayma nyi jø Amön.
english: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo reyø kiper mana näk cwïnye käre cïbö ki man many Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa tïïc Reeyöbömmi ki mana täge këël aŋuunge ogöörö yïth luup mo nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Cemaya, ki yïth luup mo Idö, ŋata wara joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ni beege luup moa no ogöörö kiper tier tuuŋ nyec marge. 'Ba Reeyöböm ki Jeröbäm ge bëëdö ni da leny yïthakicge cooth.
english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

anywaa: 'Ba Reeyöböm athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Abaaja ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abära moa beet Jeröbämmi ni ena nyeny Icriel, Abaaja atïmö na nyeya Juuda yi Jerucalem,
english: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.

anywaa: ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri adäk. 'Ba Abaaja nyeŋ menni beeye Mikaya nyi Uriel nyï Giba. 'Ba kar kaagøøni yïthakic Abaaja ki Jeröbäm aput jïtö ki leny.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

anywaa: Ni ö Abaaja ni ci wøk baŋ leny baŋ Jeröbäm ki jø leny moe moa teek døc mo kwäänge  beege kume ma dïpe aŋween, ni gääpge ki jø leny mo Jeröbäm mo teek døc thuwø mo kwäänge beege kume ma dïpe abära.
english: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Abaaja aput cuŋŋö bäät Kïn Dhemarayim na en mïëya en bäät kïte kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni rwaac Jeröbäm ki jø Icriel bëët, ni kööe, ni «Cegu ïthu baŋa!
english: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, buc nyec mar Icriel ee wëëk Deebit ki nyïïkwaaye ki man käärge gø na bäre bäre ki køør luumma tuude na näk ba pät?
english: Ought ye not to know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm o Nebat na wara tïïö tier Cølöman o Deebit aput ö maal ni gëëme ki kwääye,
english: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.

anywaa: ni jiy mo wïthge reyø mo bëëtö marge patha kare ee gwaar dëëre, ni gëëme ki Reeyöböm o Cølöman kanya poot Reeyöbömmi ni poot thiinh ni jïre bäŋ teek ki man tïïc mana manynye dëëtge.
english: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, uuna cädö ki man ŋäbu ki buc nyec mar Wuuö Jwøk man ni en ceŋ nyïïkwaac Deebit en, ni uuna lwaak mo päl mo buutu da nyïïrøøe mo tïïc ka warkey, nyïïrøøga tïïc Jeröbämmi kiper nee bëëtge na juu mou.
english: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the Lord in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

anywaa: Dïlämme mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege nyïïkwaac Aran, ariemu wøk, ge ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ni määnynyu dëëtu keeru ki dïlämme mou kaawat man wø tïïc juurre møga. Ni ŋat wø ööi jaak kuna cïp dëëre kur keere ni käädö ki nyirøøa mo thiinh ki nyöök rööm abïriiø, putu ka tïïc na dïlämi jaak mar gïï mo patha Jwøk.
english: Have ye not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

anywaa: «'Ba ki baŋwa, Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk marwa, ni eni kärwa wiiø; ni nyïïkwaac Aran beege ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk na dïlämme, ni jø tuuŋ Libay beege ni wø køny geni.
english: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the Lord, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

anywaa: Ni kany wø tïme na amöölla ka abøøya cooth ge wø wääŋö jï Wuuö Jwøk ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, ni muunni moa näk ocwøbø na näk nyuuthe wø cïpge bäät tharabëëta mana no ocïp kur keere ni waany, ni gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte mana näk tïïc ka warkey, lambae moe wø nyepge nyebø cooth ka abøøya; kiper waani, gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøk marwa ewa gwøø; 'ba uuni, Wuuö Jwøk you wiiø.
english: And they burn unto the Lord every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the Lord our God; but ye have forsaken him.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, Jwøk bëëdö ka waani, ni ena wïc marwa, ni dïlämme moe tuŋi oløny ni ena ceŋge ki man koothge ge nee wa öwa baŋ leny baŋu. Wui, jø Icriel, käru këëdö ki Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäyu, kiper mana manynyu ba thur kare.»
english: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the Lord God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm jø leny moe møøk ee kan töök jø leny mo jø Juuda, nee ge öge ki ŋäth jø Juuda, ni thööth jø leny mo Icriel ena nyïm jø Juuda, kanya bëët jø lenynyi moøgøøni ni ena ŋäth jø Juuda.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Juuda na lwïthge, aputge joot ni jøøgø tuga geni ki nyïmge ki ŋäthge. Kanyøgø gena put jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö dïlämme ni koothge tuŋi.
english: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the Lord, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

anywaa: Køøre jø Juuda gena put reŋ bäätge ni ge twäädö. 'Ba kanya reŋ jø Juuda bäätge ni ge twäädö, Wuuö Jwøk Jeröbäm ki jø Icriel bëët aput wëëk böötö nyïm Abaaja ki jø Juuda.
english: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel gena put bwøk nyïm jø Juuda, kiper geno cïp Jwøki ceŋ jø Juuda.
english: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Abaaja ki jiye, jø Icriel aböötge ki böötö mo raac døc, ni put jø lenynyi moa teek mo jø Icriel ma kume ma dïpe abïïc thøø.
english: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace jø Icriel wïthge aput døø piny, ni ö jø Juuda ni öge maal bäätge, kiper jø Juuda ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the Lord God of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba Abaaja aläp køør Jeröbäm ni mac mïëri møøk cer gøøni, ni beege Bëthël ka atude moe, ki Jecana ka atude moe, ki Ëprön ka atude moe.
english: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth–el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeröbäm kär jïtö ki teek këët yïth nïra beet Abaaja. 'Ba ena jääl Wuuö Jwøki ni put thøø.
english: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the Lord struck him, and he died.

anywaa: 'Ba Abaaja, ena tïmö ni teek. Kanyøgø ena nyöömmö ki mään apaar kurŋween, ni put jïtö ki wääte ma pïërariiø kurriiø, ki nyïïe ma apaar ka abïciel.
english: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi møga moa tïïc Abaaja, ki uutjïëthe moe moa caadhe, ki luup moe moa care, ogöörö yïth luup moa göör nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Idö.
english: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

anywaa: 'Ba Abaaja athøw ni läp køør kwäye, ni koonyi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Aca ni läw kare na nyeya. Ni put paaci jïtö ki jwöm ki cwiiri apaar ki yïth nïne moa beede.
english: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare,
english: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God:

anywaa: ni raany gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo juu moa path, ki kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri, ni tøø kïte piny moa no otïïö na gïï lam, ni ŋøt jenni piny moa no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara.
english: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

anywaa: Ni kööm jø Juuda ki man manyge Wuuö Jwøk Jwø kwäcge, ni gwøkge ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk ki gïïa ceme.
english: And commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni raany kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ki gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge moa en yïth päänye bëët mo Juuda. Ni ö buc nyeci mare ni put jïtö ki bëët mëër ki ree.
english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø päänye mo Juuda acäŋ geerrø ni teek ki køør mana bëët paaci ki bëët mëër, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo many man këëde ki eni yïth cwiiyaka, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jwöm ee cïbö jïgø.
english: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the Lord had given him rest.

anywaa: Kiper ena köö jï jø Juuda, ni «Beerra man geerø päänye moi ni teek, ni gëënnø deŋge ki kiiri, ki kwör koor mo ogeerø ni ena maal, ki dhøk kiir, ki dïdëëdi moge. Ŋöömmi en poot na marø kiper Wuuö Jwøk Jwøk marø amanynyø, ni manynyø gø møn, ni put cïpö jïïø ki jwöm kun ki kun.» Ni ö luum geerri manøgø ni kïthge gø bäät tïïc, ni put thur kare ni beer.
english: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the Lord our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca jïre da jø leny ma kume ma dïpe adäk mo wø käär kööt leny moa døøŋŋø ki tøøŋi ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda. 'Ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen jïre da jø leny ma kume ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabära mo wø käär kööt leny moa therø ka athëëre. 'Ba jøøgø bëët beege jø leny moa teek.
english: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba Dheera nyï Kuuc aö wøk ki jø leny mo kwäänge kume køøye ma kuma, ki jïëth leny ma dïpe adäk mo wø tut okwëënyi, nee këëde ki jø leny mo Aca, ni put pïï Marëca.
english: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca aput ci wøk kuna røømge ki gø, ni cïïmge rege kiper leny yi gool mar Dhepatha na en buut Marëca.
english: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

anywaa: Køøre Aca Wuuö Jwøk Jwøk mare akwaae, ni kööe, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ ŋat mør këët mo køny jøøa jïge bäŋ teek kany wø këëtge ki jøøa jïge da teek, 'ba bee ïïni keerï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk Jwøk marwa, køny waani, kiper wa ŋäätha ïïni. 'Ba ki køør mana ŋääthwa nyeŋŋï, waana ö baŋ leny ki jøøi ni thööth ii. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bee ï na Jwøk marwa; beerra man ba ö jiyi ni böötge ïïni.»
english: And Asa cried unto the Lord his God, and said, Lord, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O Lord our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O Lord, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk jø leny mo jø Kuuc awëëk böötö nyïm Aca ki jø Juuda, ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Kuuc ni putge bwøk.
english: So the Lord smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

anywaa: Køøre Aca ki jø leny moe, køør jø leny mo jø Kuuc aputge ŋwiec këël mana pïïcge Gërar; ni ö jø lenynyi mo jø Kuuc mo thööth ni thøwge, ni käre løny jï jø Kuuc ki man makge rege këët, kiper gena ränynyö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki nyïm jø leny mo Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö jø lenynyi mo Juuda ni twierge jammi mo thööth mo jø Kuuc.
english: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the Lord, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

anywaa: Ni raanyge päänye bëët moa en deŋ Gërar, kiper lwär mo päl mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk aö bäätge. Ni ö jø leny mo Aca ni twierge päänye moøgø bëët, kiper da jammi mo thööth yïthge.
english: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the Lord came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

anywaa: Ni raanyge lwääge thuwø mo jøøgø, ni putge dïëk ka athïrööle mo thööth døc käl, ni døøge Jerucalem.
english: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk aö bäät Adhariya wär Ödet,
english: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

anywaa: ni ci wøk kuna røømge ki nyeya ma Aca, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Cek ïthï baŋa, ï na nyeya ma Aca, ki uuni bëët, u na jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen. Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø bëëdu dëëre, bëëdö ki uuni. Ni näk  mo eni manynyu manynyø, eni jootu joodø; 'Ba ni näk eni you wiiø, u wiie wiiø thuwø.
english: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The Lord is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïne moa pöödhö, jø Icriel abëëdö jaak ni ge tøør ri Jwøk mana na adïëri, ni bäŋ dïlämme mo pwöny geni, ni bäŋ ciik mo ŋäcge.
english: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø täk gïï mo lethi bäätge, nyïmge løøge baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ni manyge eni, ni jootge gø.
english: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the Lord God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.

anywaa: Yïth nïne moøka, teek jï dhaanhø jaak mo cäädhö ni mare døny wøk ki yi paayø wala dunynya yi paac, kiper da dïŋaŋ mo päl ki bëëtö mo patha kare tiet mïëri bëët.
english: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

anywaa: Paac man nø këëdö ki paac mør, ni ö päänynyi man nø ni këëde ki pääny mør, kiper gena wëëk Jwøki jwør gïï mo leth ma teeŋi.
english: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, bëëdu nou teek ni ba wëëgu bäätu pädhö, kiper da gïn mo u di ŋadø ki gø ki køør tïïc maru.»
english: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Aca na wïny luup moøgøøni na mo Jwøk yøø na caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Adhariya wär Ödet, cwïnye aput jïtö ki cer, ni käl gïï wø lam wøk ni wø raac yi Jwøki ki ge na en yïth mïëri bëët mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki mo wø lam yïth päänye moa näk ee maa na en po kïte kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem. Ni ö gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk na en nyïm agööl Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni dwøk gø kare ni nyään.
english: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the Lord, that was before the porch of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cooŋ jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki jiy moa dää buutge na käl røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki røk jø tuuŋ Cimien; kiper jiy mo thööth aci dëëre ki yi Icriel kanya jootge gø ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, bëëdö ka eni.
english: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø rege aputge cooŋ yi Jerucalem ri dää dwäde, kanya tïm cwiic nyec mo Aca na apaar kurbïïc.
english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

anywaa: Ni putge cïpö yi cäŋ manøgø ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk ki røk lääy moa twierge. 'Ba olämme moa cïpge beege dhäk ma dïpe abïriiø ki dïëk ma kume abïriiø.
english: And they offered unto the Lord the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

anywaa: Ni tutge ki luubö ki man manyge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, ki cwïnyge bäre ki jwïëcge bäre;
english: And they entered into a covenant to seek the Lord God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

anywaa: ni köge ni dhaanhø jaak mano ba many Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, put ka 'näk, këël eni thiinh wala dwøŋ, nee ena dïcwøø wala dhaagø.
english: That whosoever would not seek the Lord God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

anywaa: Ni putge kööŋ ri Wuuö Jwøk ni döötge ena maal, ni ge kwöŋŋö ki met ec ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi ma teeŋi.
english: And they sware unto the Lord with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda bëët yïthge amïnnö ki køør kööŋ mana kööŋge ki gø, kiper gena kööŋ ki cwïnyge bäre; ni manyge Wuuö Jwøk døc, ni jootge gø. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mooc geni ki jwöm kun ki kun.
english: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the Lord gave them rest round about.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Aca teek gwac mar menni ma Maika akäl wøk cer gø, kiper menni atëëŋö ki kït gïn mo määnö mo di lamø mo ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara. 'Ba Aca kït gïna määnö na näk di lamø mar menni akäl wøk, ni kaaŋ gø na thäŋi, ni waaŋ gø waŋ Naam Kidaran.
english: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri käre raanynyø dï Icriel. 'Ba këël na käre gø raanynyø, ena bëëdö ni cwïnye waany ki yïth nïne moa beede bëët.
english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

anywaa: 'Ba jap wänni moa näk ocïp wänni kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ki jammi moa näk thööge na näk ee cïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk, akäl yi Øt Jwøk. 'Ba japaka beege gwet-bïrö, ki warkey, ki jap tïïc mo paac.
english: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ lenye mo otägö këët këël mana thum cwiiya näk pïëradäk ka abïïc na beet Aca ni ena nyeya.
english: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Aca na pïëradäk ka abïciel bäät nyec, Baaca nyeny Icriel acøø ni këëde ki jø Juuda, ni ö päänya cwøl ni Reema ni geer gø ni teek, ni gëëŋa jöö, nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo ci yi ŋööm Aca nyeny Juuda, wala dhaanhø mo öö ki yie.
english: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca gwel-bïrö ki warkey moa en yi øt kän jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki moa en øt kän jammi mar øt nyec akäl wøk ni jääŋ ge baŋ Ben-Adat nyeny  jø Aram na bëëdö Damacka, ni kööe,
english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the Lord and of the king's house, and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beerra man ö ïïni ki aani ni tudø ki luubö yïthakiyø, kaawat mana en yïthakic wära ki wäru. 'Ba ennø, aana jääk baŋï ki gwel-bïrö ki warkey; ciï ni raanynyï luubö mana näk iï tuudö ki Baaca nyeny Icriel, kiper nee eni ö wøk paara.»
english: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.

anywaa: Køøre Ben-Adat luum nyeya ma Aca awïnynye, ni jääŋ kwääc lwaae mo leny moe, ni cige ni tukge päänye mo Icriel, ni makge Ijöön, ki Daan, ka Abël-Maim, ki päänye bëët moa näk yïthge da uut kän jammi moa en yi ŋööm Naptali.
english: And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel–maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

anywaa: 'Ba Baaca na wïny gïnögø, Reema aput wec ki man geer gø, ni put tïïc mar gø cuŋŋö.
english: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Aca jø Juuda bëët aput cwøl, ni aacge ni jwïëkge kïte ki jer geer moa ö Baaca na dee Reema geerø ki ge. Ni ö nyeya ma Aca ni geer Gëba ki Micpa ni teek ki ge.
english: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

anywaa: 'Ba yi kar kaaca, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Anani, ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, aö baŋ Aca nyeny Juuda ni kööe jïgø, ni «Kiper mana tïme niï ŋäätha nyeny jø Aram niï ba ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, jø leny mo Aram apäär wøk cerï.
english: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the Lord thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba thöötha jø leny mo jø Kuuc ki jø Libya, ki jïëth leny moge na thööth mo wø tut okwëënyi ki jø leny moge mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi? 'Ba kiper mana bëëdï niï ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, gena cïp Wuuö Jwøki cerï.
english: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the Lord, he delivered them into thine hand.

anywaa: Kiper waŋ Wuuö Jwøk wïdö bäät piny bäre ni neeta gø kiper nee cïpe ki teek jï jø wø many eni ki cwïnyge bäre. 'Ba ïïni kiper mana tïïï ki gïn mo wïïï kärï caarø ki gø, ki mano täge ennø, ï bëëdö ni da lenye yïthakiyu ki jø møøk cooth.»
english: For the eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.

anywaa: Køøre Aca agootø ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Anani, ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, ni put gø kïth øt twöc, kiper cwïnye akëënynyö ki gø døc kiper luummögø. 'Ba yi kar kaaca, Aca aput tïmö ni jiy møøk di caannø thuwø.
english: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa tïïc Aca ki mana täge këël aŋuunge ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda ki mo Icriel.
english: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Aca kanya tïm cwiic nyec moe na pïëradäk ka abïŋween, ena tïmö ni tuu ki tiete ki täw mo teek døc; 'ba këël na bëët täwi manøgø na ennønø, eni Wuuö Jwøk käre manynyø kiper køny, 'ba ena bëëdö ni manynya akïïme.
english: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the Lord, but to the physicians.

anywaa: Køøre Aca athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni cwiic nyec moe beege pïëraŋween ka aciel.
english: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

anywaa: 'Ba ena koonyge yi bwörö mare mana tïïe kiper dëëre yi Pääny Deebit, ni pïëlge gø yi bwörö bäät pëëm mana näk ee kïthö ki gïï wø ŋwääi ni met ki wïth mäth riie ma teeŋi, ni äpge ki maac mo dwøŋ døc ni ge wøøra gø.
english: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat adööŋ na nyeya kar wänni ma Aca, ni tïïc tier nyec mare ni teek ni kaala jø Icriel.
english: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.

anywaa: Eni yïth päänye bëët mo Juuda moa näk ogeerø ni teek akïthe ki jø leny, ni kïth jø leny møøk yïth mïëri møga mo Juuda ki yïth päänye moa en yi ŋööm Ipariem na mak wänni ma Aca.
english: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ki Jøcapat, kiper eni cäädhi ka køør bëëtö mana kwøŋ kwari ma Deebit bëëdö ki gø, ni käre jwø wø cwøl ni Baal manynyø.
english: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

anywaa: 'Ba eni manynya Jwøk, Jwø kwari, ni cäädhi ka køør ciik mo gø, ni tïïe moa wara tïïc jø Icrielli käre tïïö.
english: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba tier buc nyec mare aput Wuuö Jwøki këël piny ni teek jïre, ni ö jø Juuda bëët ni cïpge ka ajwäk jïre, ni put tïmö no okwär døc no owøørø.
english: Therefore the Lord stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni cwïnye da cer ki jöör Wuuö Jwøk, ni raany kwör lam thuwø moa en bäät thuuri yi Juuda, ki jera no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara.
english: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moe bäät nyec, Ben-Ayel, ki  Øbadiya, ki Dhekaraya, ki Natanel, ki Mikaya na bëëdö na jø kööre moe, gena jääŋŋe baŋ pwöc nee pööge yïth päänye mo Juuda;
english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben–hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.

anywaa: ni ge jääŋŋe na aciel ka jø tuuŋ Libay møøk, ni beege Cemaya, ki Nethaniya, ki Dhebadiya, ka Acaël, ki Cemiramöth, ki Jönathan, ka Adöniya, ki Thöbiya, ki Töbadöniya; ge ki Elicama ki Jeyöram na bëëdö na dïlämme.
english: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob–adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena aay ni wëël ciik mar Wuuö Jwøk käärge käärö, ni pööge yi ŋööm Juuda, këël mana thöörge päänye bëët mo Juuda ni ge pöö dï jiy.
english: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the Lord with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk lwär mo päl akäl bäät mïëri bëët moa en deŋ Juuda, ni tïmge ni ge ba këëdi ki Jøcapat.
english: And the fear of the Lord fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin møøk gena kännö ki muuce ki gwet-bïrö ni cïpge ge na ajwäk jï Jøcapat. Ni ö mïëya Arabe thuwø ni cïpge jïgø ki pïïth dïëk, ni beege nyöök rööm ma kume abïriiø ki dïpe abïriiø, ki nyöök atëëe ma kume abïriiø ki dïpe abïriiø thuwø.
english: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat dööŋ kar mare aput cääth maal døc, ni tïïe ki kwör gwøk røk ki päänye mo kan jammi yïthge yi Juuda.
english: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.

anywaa: Ni eni bëëdö ni jïre da jammi mo thööth yïth päänye mo Juuda, ki jø leny mo teek mo ŋäc leny døc mo ee cïp Jerucalem.
english: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwään jø leny moe ki køør dhøk uudi moge: Ki røk jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki dëët kwääc lwaa kume, kwääc lwaak mana dïkwøŋ beeye Adina. Eni tiere da jø leny mo teek mo kwäänge kume ma dïpe adäk.
english: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

anywaa: Ni ö riet kwääc lwaa leny mana caath køøre ni näk beeye Jöanan. Eni tiere da jø leny mo teek mo kwäänge kume ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërabära.
english: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

anywaa: Ni ŋata caath køøre beeye Amaciya o Dhikri, ŋata näk dëëre ee cïbö ki man tïny Wuuö Jwøk. Eni tiere da jø leny mo teek mo kwäänge kume ma dïpe ariiø.
english: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the Lord; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Eliada, ŋat leny mo teek. Eni tiere da jø leny mo kwäänge kume ma dïpe ariiø, jø leny mo wø këëdi ka athëëre ki kööt leny.
english: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

anywaa: Ni ö riet kwääc lwaa leny mana caath køøre ni näk beeye Jödhabat. Eni tiere da jø leny mo dëëtge ege jiiŋŋø kiper leny mo kwäänge kume ma dïpa ki pïërabära.
english: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny moøgøøni bëët beege ni wø tïny nyeya ma Jøcapat, ni moa cïp nyeya yïth päänye moa näk ogeerø ni teek dï Juuda bäre kär kwaan rege.
english: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Jøcapat no okwär døc no owøørø, ena dwätö ka Akap nyeny Icriel ki køør nywöm.
english: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri møøk, Jøcapat aløøc piny kuna lïïmme baŋ Akap yi Cameria. 'Ba Akap anääö ki dïëk ki dhäk mo thööth jïgø ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni, ni coon yi gø nee ci kuna tuk Ramöth-Gelät.
english: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead.

anywaa: Ni kö Akapi nyeny Icriel jï Jøcapat nyeny Juuda, ni «?Løny man ciï ki aani Ramöth-Gelät?» Ni dwøk gø jïgø, ni «Aani a caala ïïni, ni jiya poot na jiy moï; waani wa dwätö ki ïïni ri leny.»
english: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramoth–gilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aköö jï nyeny Icriel, ni «Beerra man kwøŋï dwør Wuuö Jwøk pëënynyö.»
english: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the Lord to day.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel jiy ma dïpe aŋween moa tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk acooŋe ni kööe jïge, ni «?Ciwa baŋ leny Ramöth-Gelät, wala kära cøø?» 'Ba gena köö, ni «Ciï; ocïp Jwøki cerï, ï na nyeya.»
english: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aköö, ni «?Bäŋ nyikuŋ Wuuö Jwøk mo ena kany mo pëënynyø këët?»
english: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the Lord besides, that we might enquire of him?

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «Poot da dhaanhø aciel mo dwør Wuuö Jwøk døø pëënynyö ki eni, 'ba a män ki gø, kiper poot bäŋ gïn mo beer mo ee nø caan en kipera, 'ba cooth beeye gïn mo raac. 'Ba ŋatøgø beeye Mikaya wär Imla.» 'Ba Jøcapat aköö, ni «Nyeya, luummögø kär caanï.»
english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the Lord: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Icriel ŋat koor aciel acwøle ni kööe, ni «Ciï, laar Mikaya wär Imla cwøl.»
english: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, nyeny Icriel ki Jøcapat nyeny Juuda, ge bëëdö ni geno pï piny ni ŋati man nø opï piny bäät wälu mare yi laara dhi kiir Cameria, na abïïk nyec moge ege røø dëëtge, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki bëët ni bëëtge ni ge cäänö nyïmge kiper jammi moo tägi yi nyïm.
english: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøgø, Cëdëkiya o Kinana dëëre ee tïnynyö ki tuŋi mo tïïc ka nywïënyö, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Jø Aram cööbï cööbö ki tuŋi moi, këël mano dïïrï wïthge.› »
english: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the Lord, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët, luubö man acaange thuwø ni köge, ni «Ci baŋ leny Ramöth-Gelät, ni böödï; geno cïp Wuuö Jwøki cerï, ï na nyeya.»
english: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth–gilead, and prosper: for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata jääŋŋi nee Mikaya cwøle, Mikaya acäänne ni kööe, ni «Neenï, nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët, gena cäänö ki dwøl aciel mo met kiper nyeya. Ennø, beerra man ö dwølli mano caanï ni tïme ni met na aciel ki mana caange.»
english: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, gïno caan Jwøki, Jwøk mara, beeye gïno caana.»
english: And Micaiah said, As the Lord liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Mikaya baŋ nyeya, nyeya aköö jïre, «?Mikaya, ciwa baŋ leny Ramöth-Gelät, wala kära cøø?» 'Ba aløøe jïgø, «Cou ni böödu; geno cïp ceŋŋu.»
english: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jïre, na «?A kwöre adïï niï cäänna cäännö, ni ‹Kany wø cäänï ki aani, cäänï ka adïëri ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk›?»
english: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the Lord?

anywaa: Kanyøgø Mikaya aköö, ni «Aani, jø Icriel bëët ajooda ni geno keethø bäät kïte, kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Jøøi bäŋ wääge; beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni døø paare ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëre.› »
english: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the Lord said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «?Kära caanø jïrï ni eni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo caane kipera, 'ba beeye gïn mo raac keere?»
english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, «'Ba ennø, wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Aani Wuuö Jwøk ajooda no opï piny bäät wälu mare, ni lwaak mare bäre mana en maal cuŋŋö buute, ni møøk ena bäät cwïïe, møøk ki bäät caame.
english: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the Lord; I saw the Lord sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, na ‹?Aŋa noo maaŋ wï Akap nyeny Icriel ni wëëk gø ciin Ramöth-Gelät nee 'näk?› Ni ö ŋati man nø ni caan man nø.
english: And the Lord said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

anywaa: Køøre da jwïëy ma aöö mo käla ri lwaak manøgø, ni cuŋŋe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, ni ‹Aani wïïe maaŋŋa maaŋŋø.› 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni ‹?Wïïe omaaŋŋï gø nidïï?›
english: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will entice him. And the Lord said unto him, Wherewith?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni ‹Aani, a cøø ni tïma ni aana dïcuuy ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk moe bëët.› Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ba dhäthi jïrï ki man maaŋŋï wïïe. Ciï ni tïïyï gø.›
english: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the Lord said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Akap, ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk jwïëy anø cïp dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk moi bëët na moï ii, niï cøøkge; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni caan gø ni gïn mo leth pïï bäätï.»
english: Now therefore, behold, the Lord hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the Lord hath spoken evil against thee.

anywaa: Køøre Cëdëkiya o Kinana aput ö baŋ Mikaya ni dhööŋ gø ki thääŋ gø, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk a ee wiiø nidïï ni tïme ni cäänö ka dëërï en?»
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the Lord from me to speak unto thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ojootï dïcäŋeca kanyo dønynyï thääŋ øtø mo ena dïër niï kana dëërï.»
english: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeny Icriel aköö, ni «Lwørru Mikaya ni dwøgu gø baŋ Amön kwääc pääny, ki baŋ Jöac o nyeya,
english: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;

anywaa: ni kööu, ni ‹Nyeya aköö ni kïthu nyeni øt twöc, ni mooyu eni ki cam mo thiinh ki pïï mo thenh këël kanyo duua ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëra.› »
english: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba Mikaya aköö, «Ni näk miï duuö møn ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëërï, Wuuö  Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø ki dhaa.» Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Dïbwör bäre, wïnynyu gïra ni caana enø.»
english: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the Lord spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.

anywaa: 'Ba Akap nyeny Icriel ki Jøcapat nyeny Juuda gena ci baŋ leny Ramöth- Gelät.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Icriel aköö jï Jøcapat, ni «Aani a cøøa baŋ leny ni dëëra yaa tïïö keda aana ŋat mør. 'Ba ïïni, røø abïïk nyec moï dëërï.» Kanyøgønø, nyeny Icriel dëëre aput tïïc keda ena ŋat mør, ni putge ci baŋ leny.
english: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny jø Aram, kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi moe ee nø köömmö ni kööe, ni «Kär dee jø leny mo u këëdö ki ge, nee ŋat mo kare dwøŋ wala ŋat mo kare thiinh; 'ba tïme ni beeye nyeny Icriel keere.»
english: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi na jootge Jøcapat gena köö, ni «Nyeny Icriel enø.» Ni gaage baŋ gø nee këëtge ki gø; ni ö Jøcapati ni put köö. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni køny gø, ni tïïc jøøgø nee aacge buute.
english: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc lwaae mo jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi na jootge gø ni eni paa nyeny Icriel, ena wecge ki man ŋwiecge køør gø.
english: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.

anywaa: 'Ba da ŋat ma athööthö ka atheerø ni mare päätö, ni këël Akap nyeny Icriel ki kanya ŋaam ri kwöt leny mana näk ee røø dëëre. Køøre Akap aköö jï ŋat wø kiiw jää leny mare man wø tut okweenynyi, ni «Wiir jääy ni kïthï aani wøk ki dï leny, kiper dëëra anø jïtö ki ŋwellø.»
english: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

anywaa: 'Ba leny aput tïmö ni teek døc dïcäŋeca, ni ö nyeny Icrielli ni bëëde ni ree ee jäŋö ki jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi nyïm jø leny mo jø Aram këël abøøya. 'Ba na tïm cäŋŋi ni pätha piny, ena thøw.
english: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcapat nyeny Juuda ena duuö ki jööt dëël ni duu paandwøŋ mare yi Jerucalem.
english: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Jiyu wär Anani, ŋat wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre, aci wøk kuna røømge ki nyeya ma Jøcapat ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aŋø, ï kønya jøøa reyø ni mëërï ki jø wø män ki Wuuö Jwøk, niï käla wëëc Wuuö Jwøk bäätï keerï?
english: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the Lord? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, poot da gïrpiny mo beer jïrï, kiper jenni moa näk otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara akälï wøk yi ŋööm Juuda, ni cïbï cwïnyï køør many Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat bëëdö Jerucalem; 'ba ena cäŋ ci wøk dï jiy ni tägi ka Bëërcïïba na en jï løø tier-piny këël mana këët mïëya en po kïte na en kur jø tuuŋ Ipariem na en jï løø wï-piny, ni cäŋ jiy duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the Lord God of their fathers.

anywaa: Ni röönye ki jø ŋøl luup yi pääny man nø ki man nø, ni beege yïth päänye bëët moa näk ogeerø ni teek yi ŋööm Juuda.
english: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,

anywaa: Ni kööe jï jø ŋøl luup, ni «Gwøgu rou ki tïï ŋøl luup mano tïïyu, kiper u ba ŋudö ka køør man wø many jiyi, 'ba beeye ki køør man wø many Wuuö Jwøki ni wø bëëdö ki uuni kanyo ŋøllu luup.
english: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the Lord, who is with you in the judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man lwäärru Wuuö Jwøk ni gwøgu rou ki ŋøl mano tïïyu, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwøk marø, kare bäär ki gïn mo patha adïëri, wala ajeeny, ni eni ba jïëy ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny ni ŋeewa røk.»
english: Wherefore now let the fear of the Lord be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the Lord our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat aröönyö ki jø ŋøl luup yi Jerucalem thuwø ki røk dïlämme ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay, ki røk dïbwöthe mo dhøk uudi mo Icriel, kiper nee luup ŋølge ki køør ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk, nee bëëtge ni luup mo wø känni ki pïëm mo wø tägi yi Jerucalem ŋølge ŋølø.
english: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the Lord, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni kööm geni, ni kööe jïge, ni «Tïïyu tïïc man na kare ki cwïnynyu bäre nou lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the Lord, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

anywaa: Ni näk da løøk mo løøa nyïmmu, mo käla baŋ nyïïmëëgu mo wø bëëdö yïth päänye moge, ni näk  mo løøk mo guta luum remø, ki luum ciik, ki luup moa no ocemø, ki luup ŋøl ki luup pwöc, ge wär köömmu nee ba bääcge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee wëëc Jwøk nee ba ö bäätu ki nyïïmëëgu. Ni näk mo gïnögø tïïyu tïïö, u ba bääyi.
english: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the Lord, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.

anywaa: «Raŋŋu, Amariya, eni na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, tïmö na wïc maru ki yïth jammi bëët mo guta luup Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö Dhebadiya wär Icmiel, na bëëdö na bwödhi mar jø tuuŋ Juuda, ni tïme na wïc maru thuwø ki yïth jammi bëët mo guta luup nyeya. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay thuwø moa no ocuumö ni kønyge uuni ki tïïc. Bëëdu nou teek ki yïth jammi bëët moo tïïyu. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ki jø wø marge beer.»
english: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the Lord; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the Lord shall be with the good.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, jø Möap ki jø Amön ge ki jø møøk røk jø Meunim gena ö kuna këëtge ki Jøcapat.
english: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk aöö ni waacge gø jï Jøcapat, ni köge, ni «Lwaak mo päl mo käla Ëdöm aöö ki løø Naam Acäbö kuna këëtge ki ïïni. Raŋï, geno løny ni ge ena ya Acëcön-Tamar kany wø cwøl ni Ayn-Gadi.»
english: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon–tamar, which is En–gedi.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jøcapat aput lwäyö, ni løø nyïme baŋ many Wuuö Jwøk; ni gööc piny ka awaaci dï Juuda bäre nee jøw wötge ni bäŋ cam mo bel.
english: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the Lord, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuda ni cooŋge dëëtge kuna manyge køny mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge ööi ka yïth päänye bëët moa näk mo Juuda.
english: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the Lord: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jøcapat acuŋŋö dhi Øt Wuuö Jwøk nyïm kal mana nyään dï acooŋ Juuda ki Jerucalem bäre,
english: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord, before the new court,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcwa, ?aŋø, ï patha Jwø wø en maal bäre? ?Patha ï wø käär bure bëët mo wïth juurre? Dööŋ kar ki teek ena cerï, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo cuŋŋö nyïmï.
english: And said, O Lord God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk marwa, ?aŋø, patha ï na riem jiy wøk moa bëëdö yi ŋöömö man nyïm jiyï ma jø Icriel, ni cïpï ŋöömö man jï nyïïkwaac Eeberam na näk nyawadu, nee bëëde na marge na bäre bäre?
english: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?

anywaa: 'Ba gena bëëdö yie ni tïïge yi gø ki øt lam mana en kur keere kiper nyeŋŋï, ni lämge na ennønø, ni köge,
english: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Ni näk da gïn mo raac mo ö bäätwa, teeŋ ka leny man wø tägi ki køør ajäl Jwøk, wala täw, wala käc, wa cuŋŋö nyïmï nyïm øtø man, kiper nyeŋŋï ena ri øtø man; ni jwøwa ränynyö marwa dëërï; køøre ïïni döötwa wïnynyï wïnynyö ni piemï waani.›
english: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.

anywaa: «Raŋï, ennø jø Amön, ki jø Möap, ki jø Ëdöm, gena ö kuna tukge waani. Ni kanya ö kwäcwa wøk ki Ijep, kwäcwa kärï jïëö ki man dønyge mïëyögø, 'ba gena pöödhö ki deŋ mïëyögøøni ni kärge raanynyø.
english: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, raŋ gïn cäŋge tïïyö dëëtwa en ki man öge nee wa kälge wøk yi ŋöömö marï mana cïpï jïwa na marwa.
english: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.

anywaa: ?Wui, ï na Jwøk marwa, ge ba jäälï? Kiper waani bäŋ teek jïwa ki man këëtwa ki lwaak man ni päl bäre en ni ööi en kun tukge waani. Waani bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcwa mo løny tïïc jïwa; 'ba wa neeta jïrï.»
english: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda bëët ge cuŋŋö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ge ko obwöre moge moa therø, ki määrge, ko obwöre moge moa reegø.
english: And all Judah stood before the Lord, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

anywaa: 'Ba dï acooŋŋøgø Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Jadhiël wär Dhekaraya na käl røk jø tuuŋ Libay moa käl dëër Acaap, ki ri Benaya, ki Jïël, ki Mataniya.
english: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the Lord in the midst of the congregation;

anywaa: Ni kö Jadhiëlli, ni «U bëët, u na jø Juuda ki jø wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem, ki nyeya ma Jøcapat, cegu ïthu! Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö jïïu, ni ‹Käru lwäyö ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu kiper lwaak man ni päl en; kiper patha u noo këëdi, 'ba beeye Jwøk noo këëdi kiperu.
english: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the Lord unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

anywaa: Diøø wäru løøyu piny baŋge; ka adïëri møn, ge puta öö ki ri thuur Dhic, ni putu ge joot dhi gool nyïm paap Juriel.
english: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

anywaa: U na jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ba many u nou këëdu ri leny man; 'ba cïïmmu dëëtu, ni cuŋŋu karu ni neennu køny mar Wuuö Jwøk mano tïïe kiperu. Käru lwäyö ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu. Diøø dønynyu wøk baŋge, kiper Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ka uuni.› »
english: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the Lord with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the Lord will be with you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jøcapat wïïe aput kuul piny ni täärnyïme ee këël yïth ŋøøm, ni ö jø Juuda bëët ki jø wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem ni päthge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the Lord, worshipping the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay moa käl dëër Kät ki moa käl dëër Köra ni öge maal ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ni döötge ena maal døc.
english: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the Lord God of Israel with a loud voice on high.

anywaa: Køøre kanya tïme na amöölla døc jø Juuda apäny maal ni cige paap Tëköa. 'Ba kanya cige wøk, Jøcapat acuŋŋö nyïmge ni kööe, «Wui, u na jø Juuda ki jø wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem, cegu ïthu baŋa. Ŋääthu Wuuö Jwøk na adïëri, eni na Jwøk maru, nee tietu këëtge piny ni teek. Ni ŋääthu nyïïkuk moe, nou käädhu.»
english: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the Lord your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat kanya nø cäänge ki jiy, ena kwänyö ki jø wär ki dudi jï Wuuö Jwøk na jø pwøc Wuuö Jwøk ni geno ruyö ka abïïk wöt. Ni aac jø wär dudi moøgø ni ge cäädhi ka nyïm jø leny ni ge köö, ni «Dwøgø met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the Lord, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the Lord; for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täkge ki wär dudi ni pwøcge Jwøk, jø Amön, ki jø Möap, ki jø Ëdöm moa ö kuna këëtge ki jø Juuda, wïthge aput Wuuö Jwøki kier ki man 'näkge rege keerge.
english: And when they began to sing and to praise, the Lord set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.

anywaa: Kiper jø Amön ki jø Möap gena ö maal kuna këëtge ki jø Ëdöm, ni dïïrge wïth jø Ëdöm bëët. 'Ba kanya nø thöörge jø Ëdöm bëët ki 'näk, gena ö maal ni këëtge ki rege keerge, ni putge wïthge dïïr.
english: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Juuda na pïïcge kany wø neen dï paap ki yie ni ge raŋa lwaa leny, ka adïëri møn, dhaanhø bäre aputge joot no othøw, ni geno nibaŋŋa yïth ŋøøm ni bäŋ gø mo obøth.
english: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøcapati ki jiye kuna twierge jap jøøgø, gena jïtö ki jammi mo thööth dïge; ni beege jap tïïc, ka abïïe, ki jammi mo perge leth ma teeŋi. Ni kälge japøge kiper dëëtge ni thööth ni kaala tëër marge. 'Ba Jøcapat ki jiye gena kän wøk ki nïne adäk kanya twierge japøgøøni, kiper thööth døc.
english: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri ŋweer nïne gena jïtö ka acooŋa yi gool mana cakge na Goor Gwïëth, ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk yi gø. Køøre nyeŋ kaace aputge cak ni Goor Gwïëth këël dïcäŋi.
english: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the Lord: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem bëët gena duuö ni ge bwøtha Jøcapati, ni duuge Jerucalem ki met ec, kiper gena tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee yïthge mïnge bäät nyïïmän moge.
english: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the Lord had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba na öge Jerucalem ge pöödö ki wïth thøme ma teeŋi ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi këël mana pïïcge Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø mïëri bëët moa en wï ŋöömö na wïnyge gø ni Wuuö Jwøk akëëdö ki nyïïmän mo jø Icriel, lwär mo dwøŋ døc mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk aput tägö bäätge.
english: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø buc nyec mar Jøcapat aput bëëtö ki bëët mëër, kiper Jwøk mare acïpö jïre ki jwöm kun ki kun.
english: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat ena bëëdö na nyeya Juuda yi Jerucalem ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø kurbïïc. 'Ba kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïeradäk kurbïïc. Eni nyeŋ menni beeye Adhuba nyi Cili.
english: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa tïïc wänni ma Aca, ni käre gaa wøk ki yïthge; 'ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri kär raanynyø, kiper jiy cwïnyge poot kärge løø baŋ Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïe møga moa tïïc Jøcapati, ki mana täge këël aŋuunge, ogöörö yïth  luup mo Jiyu wär Anani, moa näk ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Jøcapat nyeny Juuda ena dwätö ka Akadhiya nyeny Icriel. 'Ba kanya dwäte ka Akadhiya, atïmö na bääyö jïre.
english: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:

anywaa: Ena dwätö ki gø nee tïïge ki baabuure nee cige Tarcëc; ni tïïcge baabuure moøgø yi Edhiyön-Gabir.
english: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion–geber.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Eliëdher wär Dödaba na käl dëër Marëca, ajäla mano käl Jwøki bäät Jøcapat acaane jïgø, ni kööe, ni «Kiper mana dwätï ka Akadhiya, Wuuö Jwøk japa tïïyï raanynye raanynyø.» 'Ba baabuure aput tøyø ni kärge løny këët ki man cige Tarcëc.
english: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the Lord hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcapat athøw ni läp køør kwäye, ni koonyi buut kwäye yi Pääny Deebit; ni ö wääde ma Jöram ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöram jïre da uutwänni, ni beege Adhariya, ki Jikiël, ki Dhekaraya, ka Adhariya, ki Mikaël, ki Cepathiya. 'Ba moøge bëët beege wäät Jøcapat nyeny Icriel.
english: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba wääge acïpö jïge ki muuce mo thööth, ni beege gwet-bïrö, ki warkey, ki jap kwär, këël ki päänye mo Juuda moa no ogeerø ni teek. 'Ba buc nyec mare acïbe jï wääde ma Jöram kiper beeye wääde mana kwøŋ nywøl.
english: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöram na mak kare ni teek ni këël tier buc nyec mar wänni piny, eni uutwänni bëët anääe ko opëëllö, ki dïbwöthe møøk thuwø mo mïëri mo Icriel.
english: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöram kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïëradäk kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri abära yi Jerucalem.
english: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc nyeye mo Icriel, kaawat moa tïïc jø dhi øt Akap, kiper nya Akap ee nywømø. Ni ö eni ni tïïe ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ba many man raany dhi øt Deebit, kiper luubö mana näk ee tuudö ki Deebit, na kööŋe kiper gø ni eni cïpö ki dhaanhø mo dööŋ na wïc jïre røk nyïïkwaaye cooth.
english: Howbeit the Lord would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet Jörammi ni ena nyeya, jø Ëdöm gena gëëmö ki jø Juuda ni öge wøk tietge, ni röönyge ki nyeya kiper dëëtge keerge.
english: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.

anywaa: Køøre Jöram ki kwääc lwaae moe mo leny ki jïëth leny moe bëët mo wø tut okwëënyi, gena cøø ni ŋutge baŋ jø Ëdöm. Ni ö jø Ëdömmi ni cielge eni dïër. 'Ba na tïme na dï wäär, gena ö maal ni päärge wøk ki yïthakic jø Ëdöm moa näk rege ege ciel deŋge, ki kwääc lwaae mo jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi.
english: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Ëdöm gena put bëëtö ni ge gëëmö ki jø Juuda këël dïcäŋi en. 'Ba kar kaagø thuwø beeye kanya ö jø Libana na gëëmge ki Jöram, kiper na ö Jörammi na wec Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäye.
english: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the Lord God of his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöram ena tïïö thuwø ki kwör lam bäät thuuri mo Juuda, ni bwøth jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem ki man gaage wøk køør juu møøk kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp.
english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.

anywaa: Køøre da wëëlö ma aö baŋe mo käla baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ilaaja, ni kööe, ni «Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø kwaru ma Deebit, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ïïni, ï kär cäädhö ki yi jöö mana caath wäru ma Jøcapat ki kwaru ma Aca nyeny Juuda.
english: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,

anywaa: 'Ba ï cäädhi ka jöö mana cääth nyeye mo Icriel ki gøøni, ni bwøthï jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem ki man gaage wøk kaawat man wø tïïc dhaaŋ paaci mo rïïŋö køør käp, keda mana tïïc jø dhi øt Akapi. Ni 'nägï wäät wäru thuwø, ni beege dhi ødï kiree, jøøa theemma geni ki ïïni.
english: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk kännö ki gïn mo leth bäät jiyï ki wäätï ki määrï, ki jammi bëët moa en jïrï.
english: Behold, with a great plague will the Lord smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:

anywaa: 'Ba ï tïmö ni tuu døc ki täw mo teek, ni beeye täw mar cïïn, këël mano tïme ni cïïrï ööa wøk cooth ki täwögø.› »
english: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk yïth jø Pilitin ki jø Arabe mo wø bëëdö keew ki jø Kuuc atheŋe kiper nee këëtge ki Jöram,
english: Moreover the Lord stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

anywaa: ni öge ni tukge Juuda, ni kälge jammi bëët moa jootge po nyeya, ni kuurge ka wääte ki määre. 'Ba bäŋ o nyeya mo odööŋ jïre, ni näk mo patha Akadhiya keere na thiinhnha eni ki røk wääte.
english: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør gïïögø bëët, ena mooc Wuuö Jwøki ki täw cïïn mo ba løny ki køny.
english: And after all this the Lord smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

anywaa: 'Ba na bëëde ni tuu na ennø, na tïme ni ra aŋuun riet cwiiri, cïïn moe aö wøk ki täwögø, ni put thøø yi rääm mo leth døc. 'Ba eni kär äm jiyi moe ki maac ki køør wödö kaawat mana äm kwäye ki maac ni wøøra geni.
english: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïëradäk kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya Jerucalem ki cwiiri abära. 'Ba kanya thøøe, bäŋ ŋat mo okïïn gïre. 'Ba ena koonyge yi Pääny Deebit, ni patha kany wø koony nyeye yie.
english: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

anywaa: Køøre jø Jerucalem Akadhiya na thiinh o Jöram atïïcge na nyeya kar wänni, kiper wäät Jöram moa døøŋŋø bëët anäk dïtwïëte moa ö ki jø Arabe na ö twïër. Kanyøgø Akadhiya o Jöram nyeny Juuda aput tägö ki man käär paac.
english: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiir aciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Athaliya nyikwaar Ømri.
english: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

anywaa: 'Ba eni thuwø, ena bëëdö ni caatha køør gïïa reyø na tïïc jø dhi øt Akap, kiper mana bëët menni ni pwönynya gø ki tïï gïï mo reyø.
english: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

anywaa: Ni put bëëte ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat mana tïïc dhi øt Akapi, kiper dhi øt Akap beege na cïpö jïre ka acaare køør thøw wänni, këël mana cööp ri ränynyö mare.
english: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the Lord like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

anywaa: 'Ba Akadhiya abëëdö ni cäädhi ka køør acaare mo jøøgø, ni cøøe ki Jeyöram wär Akap nyeny Icriel ni këëtge ki Adhaël nyeny Aram yi Ramöth-Gelät, ni ö jø Arammi ni moocge dëër Jeyöram ki ŋwellø.
english: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya ma Jeyöram adøø Jedhriel kuna tuu eni ki ŋwellø mana tïïc jø Arammi dëëre Ramöth kanya këëtge ka Adhaël nyeny Aram. Ni ö Akadhiya o Jöram nyeny Juuda ni løøc piny kuna lïïmme baŋ Jeyöram wär Akap yi Jedhriel, kiper mana näk eni tuu.
english: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

anywaa: 'Ba ränynyö mar Akadhiya käla baŋ Jwøk kanya ci baŋ Jeyöram. Kiper kanya pïïe ena put ci wøk ki Jeyöram baŋ Jiyu wär Nimci, ŋata tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw kiper nee dhi øt Akap raanynye.
english: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the Lord had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jiyu na wëëk ajäla thur kare bäät dhi øt Akap, ena jïtö ki jø paan dwøŋ mo Juuda ki wäät uut wää Akadhiya moa wara tïny Akadhiya, ni put ge 'näk.
english: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

anywaa: Køøre Jiyu Akadhiya amanynye thuwø, ni makge gø kanya kan ree yie yi Cameria. Ni kälge gø baŋ Jïyu ni 'näkge gø. Køøre ena koonyge, kiper gena köö, ni «Ena nyikwaar Jøcapat, ŋata bëëdö ni manynya Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnye bäre.» Kanyøgø aput tïmö ni bäŋ dhaanhø këët mo odööŋ mo mak buc nyec ki røk jø dhi øt Akadhiya.
english: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Athaliya mii Akadhiya na joot gø ni wääde othøw, ena ö maal ni 'näk jiy bëët moa en dhi øt nyec mar Juuda.
english: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöcaba nyi nyeya ma Jöram, Jöac wär Akadhiya akwäl wøk ki yïthakic wäät nyeya moa näk di nääö, ni kïth gø yi øt niine mana en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ge ki ŋata pïr gø. Køøre Jeyöcaba nyi nyeya ma Jöram, na näk beeye cï Jööda na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ, Jöac akane ni bødhe ki thøø mana tïïc Athaliya,  kiper Jeyöcaba beeye cöök Akadhiya.
english: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaal manøgø aput bëëte ki geni no okanø ki cwiiri abïciel yi øt Jwøk, kanya bëët Athaliya ni paac ena cere.
english: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
