anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na bïriet cwiiri, Jööda tiere akëël piny ni teek, ni lwør kwääc lwaa dïpe ni tude ki luubö ki geni. 'Ba kwääc lwaae moøka beege Adhariya wär Jeröam, ki Icmiel wär Jöanan, ka Adhariya wär Obet, ki Maycëya wär Adaya, ki Elicapat wär Dhikri.
english: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

anywaa: Køøre gena aa dï Juuda bäre ni cooŋge jø tuuŋ Libay ki bwöthe mo dhøk uudi mo Icriel ki yïth päänye bëët moa näk mo Juuda, ni öge Jerucalem.
english: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre jø acooŋŋøgø bëët gena put tudö ki luubö ki nyeya yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Ni kö Jööda jïge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, o nyeya cøøa bäät wälu ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper nyïïkwaac Deebit.
english: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the Lord hath said of the sons of David.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tïïyu beeye en: U na dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø ö baŋ tïïc ki cäŋ jwömö, ki røk dhøgi adäk mou moa näk ocïïmmö, dhøk aciel rege wär tïme na jø koor dhøk kal mo Øt Jwøk,
english: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;

anywaa: ni ö dhøk acielli ni tïme na jø koor øt nyeya, ni ö dhøk acielli maya thuwø ni tïme na jø koor dhi kiir Cuur. 'Ba jiy bëët wär enge yïth käälle mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee ŋat mo døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni näk mo patha dïlämme keerge ki jø tuuŋ Libay ni wø kunynyi ki tïïc. Jøøgøøni keerge løny ki man dønyge yi gø, kiper dëëtge ege cïp kur keerge ni waany. 'Ba jiy bëët wär bëëtge ni ge gwøga luup moa caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But let none come into the house of the Lord, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay wär bëëtge ni deŋ nyeya ege cielø, ni ŋati man nø jap leny moe ena cere. 'Ba dhaanhø jaak mano døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, wär eni put 'näk. 'Ba bëëdu nou cäädhi ka nyeya kany wø ci yie jaak.»
english: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tuuŋ Libay ki jø Juuda bëët gïïögø bëët aputge tïïc ki køør mana ö Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na kööm geni ki ge. Ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtge ni lwør jiye moa doo ö baŋ koor ki cäŋ jwömö ki moa doo ö wøk ki bäät koor ki cäŋ jwömö. Kiper Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, bäŋ dhøk aciel ki røk dhøgi moa näk ocïïmmö mo jøøgøøni mo ee wiiø nee ö wøk ki bäät koor.
english: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

anywaa: 'Ba eni tøøŋi ki kööt leny moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø na en Øt Jwøk na näk mo nyeya ma Deebit acïbe jï kwääc lwaa dïpe.
english: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cïïm jiy bëët kwörge, ni ŋati man nø jap leny moe ena cere, ki mana täge ki jï løø bäät cwïïc mar Øt Jwøk këël mana këët løø bäät caam mar Øt Jwøk, ki deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ki deŋ øtø bäre, ni ge ciela nyeya dïër.
english: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

anywaa: Køøre o nyeya akälge wøk ni cïpge adun nyec wï gø, ni cïpge wëël ciik Jwøk jïgø, ni ge røønya gø na nyeya. Ni ö Jööda ki wääte ni thïïmge wï gø ki maaw, ni kwöŋge, ni «Nyeya puta bëëtö na bäre bäre!»
english: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Athaliya na wïny dööt jiy ni jiy rïïŋö ni ge pwøya nyeya, ena put ci baŋge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba na lwïthe, ka adïëri møn, nyeya mana nyään aput joot dhi øtø ni cuŋŋö buut gïna näk caala dïkweeri, ni kwääc lwaae ki jø wø kooth tuŋi ena deŋŋe; ni jø paac bëët yïthge omïnnö ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi; ni jø wø wär ki dudi, ge wär ni ge pöödö ki jap dööti moge ma teeŋi, ni ge bwøtha ajwöma manøgø. Kanyøgø Athaliya abïï mare aput jeec ki pänh cwïny, ni jwöŋe ni «Wui, maru ageem öy! Maru ageem öy!»
english: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, kwääc lwaa dïpe na näk ojierø bäät jø leny aput cwöl wøk ni kööe jïge, ni «Kälu nyijøøgø wøk ki yïthakic jiy moa näk rege ege caanø; 'ba ŋato läp køør gø jaak wär putu 'näk  ko opëëllö.» Kiper onø caan Dïlämi, ni «Eni kär nää yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyijøøgø aputge mak; 'ba kanya tïme ni eni pïï dhi kal man wø døny okwëënyi ki yie deŋ øt nyeya, ena putge 'näk kaace.
english: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.

anywaa: Køøre Jööda aput tudö ki luubö yïthakicge ki jiy bëët ki nyeya, nee ge bëëtge ni gena jic Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the Lord's people.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët gena ci øt jwøk mar Baal, ni nyaage gø piny, ni ö gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo Baal ki kït gïïa näk otieŋø ni ŋwaalla kïte, ni tøcge ge na thäŋi; ni 'näkge Matan na näk dïlämi mar Baal nyïm gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge.
english: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

anywaa: 'Ba Jööda tïïe mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk aput cïp ceŋ dïlämme na näk jø tuuŋ Libay, jøøa jier Deebiti bäät tïïe mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, nee wø cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk ki køør mana no ogöör piny yïth ciik Modhe, ni mïn yïthge ni wärge ki dudi ki køør dwør Deebit.
english: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the Lord by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the Lord, to offer the burnt offerings of the Lord, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.

anywaa: 'Ba Jööda jø koor dhøk kal mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk acïïmme kwörge, nee bäŋe dhaanhø jaak mo døny yi gø ni ba waany.
english: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the Lord, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kwääc lwaa dïpe, ki kwääri, ki dïbwöthe mo jiy, ki jø paac bëët, gena öö ni kälge nyeya piny ki Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni kïthge gø paan-dwøŋ ni ge cøra dhi kal mana en jï maal, ni wëëkge nyeya pïïn piny bäät wäl nyec.
english: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the Lord: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø paac bëët yïthge aput mïnnö, ni ö päänynyi ni neebäc kiper mana 'näkge Athaliya ko opëëllö.
english: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jöaci na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe abïriiø, ni bëëde na nyeya yi Jerucalem ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Dhibiya nyijø Bëërcïïba.
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beer–sheba.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöac abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth nïne bëët moa beet Jööda na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the Lord all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

anywaa: Ni ö Jööda ni nyöömme jï gø ki mään ariiø, ni ö eni ni put jïtö ki wääte ki nyïïe.
english: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, Jöac acädö nee kwöra näk oränynyö dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk nee dwøk karge.
english: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay acooŋe ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou wøk yïth päänye mo Juuda ni cooŋŋu gwel ki baŋ jø Icriel bëët kiper nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk cäŋ tïïyö ni nyään kany wø tïme na yi cwiir cooth. 'Ba ennø, tïïc manøgø wär laaru tïïc.» 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay tïïc manøgø kärge laar tïïc.
english: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya, Jööda na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ acwøle ni kööe jï gø, na «?Aperŋø ni ba cäännï jø tuuŋ Libay en ki man kälge gwet ajwäk ki baŋ jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ni beeye ajwäk mana caan Modhe dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk ya acooŋ jø Icriel kiper oduŋkaany røømmø man wø nyooth luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy?»
english: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the Lord, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?

anywaa: 'Ba wäät Athaliya, dhaaŋŋa raac, Øt Jwøk atoorge ni dønyge yi gø, ni tïïcge jammi moa en kur keerge na en Øt Wuuö Jwøk na mo juuk wø cwøl ni Baal.
english: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the Lord did they bestow upon Baalim.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya dïlämme aköömme ki man tïïge ka acanduk, ni cïpge gø wøk buut dhi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre gena gööc piny ka awaaci yi Juuda ki yi Jerucalem ki man cïpge ka ajwäk jï Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana caan Modhe na näk dhaanh Jwøk dï paap jï jø Icriel.
english: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the Lord the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dïbwöthe bëët ki jiy bëët yïthge amïnnö ni kälge gwel moa jwäkge ni kïthge ge ya acanduk, këël mana päŋ acanduki.
english: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö jø tuuŋ Libay wø kïthge acanduk baŋ jø wø tïny nyeya, kany wø jootge gø ni gwel thööth, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki ŋat wø tïny dïlämi mana dwøŋ, ge wø ö ni lwørge gwel moa en ya acanduk, ni dwøkge acanduk kare. Ni bëëtge ni ge tïïya gïnögø ki  yi cäŋ cooth, ni putge jïtö ki gwel mo thööth.
english: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ki Jööda gwel moøgø acïpge ceŋ jø wø raŋ tïïe mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö jøøgø ni cwötge ki jø tïïc, ni beege jø wø gëëdö ki kïte, ki dïjëëth opämi, këël ki jø wø tïïc tïïe mo nywïënyö man wø cwøl na ayrön, ki nywïënyö mana näk jwïël, kiper nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk dwøkge kare.
english: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the Lord, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tïïc moøgø kwöra näk oränynyö dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk aputge tïïc, ni dwøkge Øt Jwøk kare ni teek kaawat mana bëëde.
english: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø thöörge tïïc manøgø, gwel moa dööŋ wøk ri tïïc aduuge baŋ nyeya ki Jööda, ni tïïcge ge na jap tïïc mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jap tïïe ki jap olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki cäänne, ki jap tïïc møøk mo tïïc ka warkey ki gwet-bïrö. 'Ba gena bëëdö ni ge cïpö cooth ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth nïne bëët moa beet Jööda.
english: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the Lord, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the Lord continually all the days of Jehoiada.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jööda na jaal ni cwiiye oløny ni thööth, ena thøw. 'Ba kanya thøøe, cwiiri moe beege dïpa ki pïëradäk.
english: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.

anywaa: 'Ba ena koonyge yi Pääny Deebit buut bwör mo nyeye, kiper gïïa beyø na tïïe jï jø Icriel ki jï Jwøk ki øtø mar Jwøk.
english: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør thøw Jööda, dïbwöthe mo Juuda gena ö baŋ nyeya ma Jöac, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge gø, ni cäänge ki gø, ni ö nyeya ni jïëc luumge.
english: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, awecge, ni tïmge ni ge tïnynya jera no otieŋø na no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara, ki kït gïï wø lam. Kiper manøgønø, wëër mar Jwøk aput ö bäät jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem kiper bääyö manøgø na tïïcge.
english: And they left the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk nyïïkuk moe ajääŋŋe baŋ jiy nee ge duuge baŋe, eni na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba këël na bëët nyïïkuk Jwøki ni cäänna geni kiper gïïa reyø na tïïcge, ïthge kärge ciiø.
english: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the Lord; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jwïëc Jwøk aö bäät Dhekaraya wär Jööda, na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ, ni cuŋŋe nyïm jiy ni kööe jïge, ni «Jwøk aköö, na ‹?Aperŋø na weyu gïïa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm uuni ki ge? Kiper manøgønø, bäŋ gïn mo tïïyu mo thur kare jïïu. 'Ba uuni, kiper mana weyu Wuuö Jwøk, uuna wiie thuwø.› »
english: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the Lord, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the Lord, he hath also forsaken you.

anywaa: Køøre gena put tudö ki luubö bäät Dhekaraya, ni këërge Dhekaraya ki kïte ki køør dwør nyeya, ni putge gø 'näk yi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Jöac, Dhekaraya anääe ni wïïe käre caarø ki Jööda wää Dhekaraya na nyooth mëër mare jïgø. 'Ba kanya tïm Dhekaraya ni manynya thøø, ena köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk ïïno neene ni cool kwör dëërï.»
english: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The Lord look upon it, and require it.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiir manøgø, jø leny mo jø Aram gena ö kuna këëtge ki Jöac, ni öge Juuda ki Jerucalem, ni 'näkge dïbwöthe bëët mo jøøgø yïthakic jiy, ni jääŋge jammi bëët moa twierge jï nyeya mar Damacka.
english: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na ö jø lenynyi mo jø Aram na öge ni kwäänge nøk, Wuuö Jwøk jø leny mo Juuda na thööth døc acïp ceŋge, kiper mana ö jø Juuda na wecge Wuuö Jwøk Jwø kwäcge; ni ö jøøgø ni putge ajäla wëëk thur kare bäät Jöac.
english: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the Lord delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø lenynyi mo jø Aram na aacge, Jöac wecge ni tuu ki ŋwellø mo leth døc. 'Ba jiye atudö bääte ki luubö man 'näkge gø ki gø kiper kwör rem Dhekaraya wär Jööda, na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ, ni putge gø nää bäät pëëm mare. 'Ba ena koonyge yi Pääny Deebit, ni patha buut bwör mo nyeye.
english: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa tudö bääte ki luubö na 'näk gø bee Dhabat o Cimät, nyï Amön, ki Jödhabat o Cimrïth nyï Möap.
english: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

anywaa: 'Ba luum wääte, ki luup ajäla moa caan nyïïkuk Jwøki kipere, ki luum dwøk kwöra näk oränynyö dëër Øt Jwøk karge, ogöörö yïth luup moa no ogöör piny yi Wëël Nyeye. Ni ö wääde ma Amaciya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Amaciya na nyeya, cwiiye pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jöadan nyijø Jerucalem.
english: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba këël na bëëde na ennønø, eni poot ba tïïö ka cwïnye bäre na adïëri.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, but not with a perfect heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö tier nyeci mare na këët piny ennø, eni jøøa tïïö tiere na 'näk wänni kanya bëët wänni na nyeya aput 'näk.
english: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wäät jøøa 'näk wänni käre nääö. Kiper atïïe ki køør luubö mana no ogöörö yi wëël ciik Modhe, na cem Wuuö Jwøki na kööe, ni «Wëëe ba doo nääö kiper gïïa tïïc obwöre moge, no obwöre thuwø ba doo nääö kiper gïïa tïïc wëëkge. 'Ba ŋati man nø doo thøw ni thuunhnha raaye keere.»
english: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the Lord commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

anywaa: Køøre Amaciya jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen acooŋe, ni cïïm geni ki køør dhøk uudi moge tiet kwääc lwaa kume ki kwääc lwaa dïpe; ni kwaan cwøw bëët moa näk cwiicge opäŋ na pïërariiø këël kunece, ni jïte ki jø leny mo teek ma kume ma dïpe adäk mo løny man cige baŋ leny man wø këël ki tøøŋi ni røk di gëëŋŋö ki kööde.
english: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

anywaa: Ni jïte thuwø baŋ jø Icriel ki jø leny mo teek mo kwäänge kume ma dïpa mo këëdi ki gwel. Ni cun ge ki gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa.
english: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk aö baŋe ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wui nyeya ma Amaciya, kär jø leny mo Icriel tïïyï nee cige baŋ leny ki ïïni na aciel. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk tøør buut jø Icriel; eni tøør buut nyïïkwaac Ipariem moøgø bëët.
english: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the Lord is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï cøø ki ge, wärï ciï, ni magï riï ni teek ki leny; 'ba Jwøk ï poot wëëge böötö nyïm nyïïmän. Kiper Jwøk jïre da teek ki man køny dhaanhø, wala man wëëk dhaanhø böötö.»
english: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya aköö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø, na «?Agïnaŋø nø noo tïïcwa kiper gwet-bïrö moa näk rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa na nø cïba jï jø leny mo Icriel?» Ni løgi ya nyikuŋ Jwøki, ni «Wuuö Jwøk cïpö jïrï ki mo thööth mo opöödhö ni kaala moøgø.»
english: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The Lord is able to give thee much more than this.

anywaa: Køøre Amaciya jø leny moa joode ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Ipariem na ö baŋe aput wec nee døøge paac. Ni ö jø lenynyi moøgø ni put cwïnyge waaŋ ki gootø mo dwøŋ døc ki jø Juuda, ni døøge paac ni cwïnyge owaaŋ ki gootø.
english: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya dëëre amaae ni teek ni bwøth jiye ma jø Juuda ni cige Pwöl Acäbö ni 'näkge jø Ëdöm ma kume apaar.
english: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

anywaa: Ni makge jiy ma kume apaar, ni kälge ge ni kärge nää, ni kïthge ge wï kïdi, ni lëëŋge ge piny ki wï kïdi ni putge tøyø bëët.
english: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo Icriel moa dwøk Amaciya paac nee ba cige baŋ leny ki eni, päänye mo Juuda atukge, ki mana täge ki Cameria këël BëëthÖrön, ni nääge ki jiy ma kume adäk yïth päänye moøgø, ni twierge jammi mo thööth døc.
english: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Beth–horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duu Amaciya ki kuna 'näk jø Ëdöm, ena kuunnö ki juu mo jø Ëdöm, ni cwöth ge piny jïre na juu moe, ni bëëde ni cøŋŋe këëlle piny nyïmge ni wøøra ge, ni wääŋö nyïmge ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.
english: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk aput liel kaamar maac bäät Amaciya, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ nyikugö mare baŋ gø mo cäänna gø, na «?Aperŋø ni manynyï juu mo jiy en, juu mo jicge kärge piemø cerï?»
english: Wherefore the anger of the Lord was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot nyikuŋ Jwøki manøgø ni cäänna gø, eni na nyeya ma Amaciya  aput köö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk, na «?Aŋø, ïïna jierwa na ŋat cïp acaare jï nyeya? Lïŋï! ?Ï manynya thøø?» Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk alïŋö ni kööe, na «Aŋääa møn ni Jwøk da gïn mo ee nø cïp piny ki man raany ïïni, kiper gïn ni tïïyï en, ni kweerï ki man wïnynyï luumma caana.»
english: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.

anywaa: Køøre Amaciya nyeny Juuda ajäägö ki dwøl jï nyeny Icriel ma Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac, nyikwaar Jiyu, ni kööe, ni «Ööï nee dëëtø raŋø.»
english: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöac nyeny Icriel aput jääk baŋ Amaciya nyeny Juuda ki dwøl mo köö, ni «Ïïni, ï caala oŋöönö jaak mana en yi lur Libaanø, na jääk baŋ jaath mana pere leth na en yi lur Libaanø, ni kööe, ni ‹Cïp nyaarï jï wääda nee nywøme.› 'Ba kar kaagø, lää paap mo bëëdö yi lur Libaanø aput cør kaace, ni put oŋöönö nyøøn piny.
english: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø møn, ïïna köö ni jø Ëdöm anø böötï ni jït cwïnyï ka atöör. Ennø, bëëdï paarï. ?Aŋø ni manynyï gïn mo raac en, mo ïïni ki jiyï ma jø Juuda u thum ki gø?»
english: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya akweer ki man cek ïthe, kiper luubö manøgø bäre käla baŋ Jwøk; kiper Jwøk manynya geni na jø Juuda nee ge cïp cer Jeyöac, kiper mana bëëtge ni ge manynya juuk jø Ëdöm.
english: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeyöac nyeny Icriel aci baŋe, ni put wïthge nigäk ka Amaciya nyeny Juuda, ni putge këëdö kanya cwøl ni Bëëth-Camic, na en løø kur jø tuuŋ Juuda.
english: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth–shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuda ni bööti ya jø Icrielli, ni reŋge ni ŋati man nø reŋŋa paare.
english: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.

anywaa: Køøre Jeyöac nyeny Icriel nyeny Juuda ma Amaciya o Jöac, nyikwaar Akadhiya, aput mak ki tøŋ yi Bëëth-Camic, ni kïth gø Jerucalem, ni toor kiir Jerucalem piny, ki mana täge ki dhi kiir mana cwøl ni Ipariem këël mana këët dhi kiir mana en gøøt; ni kanya toor piny bär mare beeye gööye ma dïpe aŋween.
english: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth–shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeyöaci ni lwør warkie bëët ki gwet-bïrö bëët, ki jap paac bëët moa joot yi Øt Jwøk buut Obet-Idöm, ki moa en kwör kän mo øt nyec, ni käl jiy moa maae ki tøŋ thuwø ni døø Cameria.
english: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaciya o Jöac nyeny Juuda, abëëdö ki cwiiri apaar kurbïïc køør thøw Jeyöac wär Jeyöakac nyeny Icriel.
english: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Amaciya ki mana täge këël aŋuunge, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Juuda Ki Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Amaciya na wec wääth køør Wuuö Jwøk, jiy atudö ki luubö bääte yi Jerucalem, ni ö eni ni put reŋ Lakic. 'Ba gena jääk køøre ki jiy Lakic ni putge gø 'näk kunece.
english: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the Lord they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

anywaa: Køøre rïŋ dëëre akälge ki bäät okwëënyi ni koonyge gø buut kwäye yi Pääny Juuda.
english: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda bëët Udhaya na näk cwiiye apaar ka abïciel alwørge ni tïïcge gø na nyeya kar wänni ma Amaciya.
english: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

anywaa: Ni ö Udhaya ni cäŋ paana cwøl ni Ëlath geerrø ni dwøk gø tier Juuda køør thøw wänni kanya läp køør kwäye.
english: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Udhaya na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar ka abïciel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërabïïc kurriiø yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jeköliya nyijø Jerucalem.
english: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Amaciya.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

anywaa: Ni put bëëte ni manynya Jwøk ki yïth nïne moa beet Dhekaraya, ŋata pwöny gø ki køør jammi moa nyooth Jwøki. 'Ba kanya bëëde ni eni manynya Wuuö Jwøk, jammi atïïc Jwøki jïre ni beyø.
english: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the Lord, God made him to prosper.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya aci wøk baŋ leny ni tuk jø Pilitin, ni toor kiir Gëth piny,  ki kiir Jabne, ki kiir Acdöt; ni gëëde ki päänye yi ŋööm Acdöt, ki kwör møøk thuwø yïthakic jø Pilitin.
english: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

anywaa: 'Ba ena køny Jwøki ki leny mana këële ki jø Pilitin, ki mana këële ka Arabe mo wø bëëdö Guur-Baal, ki mana këële ki jø Meunim.
english: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal, and the Mehunims.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Amön gena cïpö jï Udhaya ka ajwäk. Ni ö Udhaya ni wïny nyeŋŋe këël mana këët keew ki Ijep, kiper ena tïmö ni teek døc.
english: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya ena gëëdö thuwø yi Jerucalem ki uut koor moa näk ogeerø ni ena maal. Ni kwöra gëët yïthge beege dhi kiir mana en gøøt, ki dhi kiir Agäm Kïdi, ki kanya gun kiirri ki yie. 'Ba uut koor moøgøøni ageere ni teek døc.
english: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

anywaa: 'Ba ena gëëdö thuwø dï paap ki uut koor moa no ogeerø ni ena maal, ni kunye ka aguule mo thööth mo cuŋ pïïyi yïthge, kiper jïre da lääc paac mo thööth yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö. Eni thuwø jïre da jø wø puur pwöth ki jø wø piith omøki yïth mïëya en bäät thuuri ki yïth ŋøøpa beyø ni wø ciek caammi yïthge, kiper eni yie met ki puur.
english: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya jïre da jø leny thuwø mo rege jiiŋŋø kiper leny, mo geno pääŋŋö na dhøgi ki køør nyeŋge moa näk ogöör Jïëlli piny na bëëdö na dïgöödi, ki Maycëya na bëëdö na kwääc lwaak. 'Ba ge ena tier kwäärö aciel mo cwøl na Ananiya ki røk kwääri moa en tier nyeya.
english: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään dïbwöthe mo dhøk uudi moge moa bëëdö na jø leny moa teek, beege kume ariiø ki dïpe abïciel.
english: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet jøøgø da jø leny mo teek mo kwäänge kume ma dïpe adäk ka abïriiø ki dïpe abïïc mo løny man këëtge ki teek mo dwøŋ ki nyïïmän kiper nyeya.
english: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya ena tïïö thuwø jï jø leny bëët ki kööt leny mo gëëŋ dëël ki ge, ki tøøŋi, ki cööc nywïëny, ki kööt leny mo røø dëël, ka athëëre, ki kaae mo thöör kïte ki ge ni di wïrö.
english: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïïö yi Jerucalem thuwø ki jap leny mo nyärö ki køør acaare mo jiy moa nyeŋge reegø, nee jap leny moøgø bëëtge kwör koor moa näk ogeerø ni ena maal ki yïth gøøde mo kiir, kiper thöör athëëre ki thöör ki nyeŋ kïte moa døøŋŋø. 'Ba Udhaya nyeŋŋe aput wïnyö døc kwör mo bäyö, ni tïme ni teek døc ki køør gïïa rëëm ec na tïïc Jwøki kipere.
english: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya kanya nø tëënne, cwïnye ajïtö ka atöör, ni päth yïth raay, ni bääye dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare. Kiper ena døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk kuna waaŋ jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäät gïn wø waaŋ jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte.
english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the Lord his God, and went into the temple of the Lord to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ adøny køøre, eni ki dïlämme møøk mo Wuuö Jwøk, dïlämme mo teek mo kwäänge pïërabära.
english: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the Lord, that were valiant men:

anywaa: Ni mänge nyeya ma Udhaya, ni köge jïgø, ni «Udhaya, patha ïïni na doo wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba beege dïlämme na näk beege wäät Aran na no ocïp kur keerge kiper waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met. Døny wøk ki yi kanya en kur keere, kiper ïïna bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ wödö mo jootï baŋe këët.»
english: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the Lord, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya aput wëër na athaanh maac ena cere man wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met yi gø. 'Ba kanya wëëre ki dïlämme, dhøøbø aput päny wøk ki täärnyïme nyïm dïlämme yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk kanya en yie deŋ gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte.
english: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the Lord, from beside the incense altar.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya na bëëdö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki dïlämme moøgø bëët, Udhaya aputge neen ni jootge gø na adïëri møn ni dhøøbø opäny wøk ki täärnyïme. Kanyøgø ena putge layø ki man laar døny wøk ki yi Øt Wuuö  Jwøk, ni ö eni thuwø ni lääde ki man laar pïï wøk, kiper ena jääl Wuuö Jwøki ki täw mo leth.
english: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the Lord had smitten him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Udhaya aput bëëtö ni dhøøbø manøgø ena dëëre këël aŋuun kwøw mare. Ni bëëdö yi øtø kur keere, mo kare ree jädhö ki jiy, ni tuu ki dhøøbø, ni mäni ki yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba wääde ma Jötham aput tïmö ni paan-dwøŋ ki paac bäre ena cere.
english: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the Lord: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga bëët moa tïïc Udhaya ki mana täge këël aŋuunge, ogöör nyikuŋ Jwøki piny mana cwøl na Aydheea wär Amöth.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

anywaa: 'Ba Udhaya athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyge gø kur keere buut bwör mo kwäcge kar bwör mo nyeye, kiper mana näk mo dëëre da dhøøbø. Ni ö wääde ma Jötham ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jöthammi na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Jeruca nyi Dhadök.
english: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Udhaya. 'Ba eni kär bääyö kaawat mana bääc wänni yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba jiy abëëdö ni ge poot tïïö ki raay.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the Lord. And the people did yet corruptly.

anywaa: 'Ba Jötham dhi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana en jï maal acäŋ geerrø, ni geer kiir mana en buut Thuur Öpël ki tïïc mo teek døc.
english: He built the high gate of the house of the Lord, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

anywaa: Ni gëëde thuwø ki päänye bäät thuuri mo Juuda, ki kwör gwøk røk, ki uut koor mo ogeerø ni ena maal bäät thuuri moa näk bäätge da atøge.
english: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena këëdö thuwø ki nyeny jø Amön ni bööt gø, ni put jø Amönni cïpö jïre ka ajwäk cwiina këëtge yie, ni beege gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa, ki beek wø cwøl ni cïndë ma yïth rumme ma kume apaar mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni kör, ki beek wø cwøl ni gäbci ma yïth rumme ma kume apaar mo poot røm ka rumi manøgø. Ni ö jø Amönni ni cäŋge cïpö thuwø jï gø ri riet cwiiri ki ri dää cwiiri ki jammi mo caala moøgø.
english: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

anywaa: 'Ba Jötham aput tëënnö kiper mana tiir bëëtö mare nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare.
english: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the Lord his God.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jöthammi, këël ki lenye moa këële bëët, ki tïïe moa tïïe, ogöör piny yi Wëël Nyeye Mo Juuda Ki Mo Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jötham kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem.
english: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Jötham athøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyi yi Pääny Deebit. Ni ö wääde ma Eeyeth ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Eeyethi na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø, ni bëëde ki cwiiri apaar ka abïciel ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem. 'Ba eni kär bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana bëët kwari ma Deebit ni tïïya gïï mo beyø.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the Lord, like David his father:

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni caatha køør tïïe moa tïïc nyeye mo Icriel, ni lëënye ki kït gïï wø lam kiper juu mo wø cøøri ni Baal.
english: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.

anywaa: Ni eni wääŋö thuwø ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met ya agäm-kïn Ben Inöm, ni waaŋ wääte ki maac, ni cïpa ge no olämme, ni eni caatha køør gïïa raac yi Jwøki ki ge na tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïm jø Icriel.
english: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni bëëde ni cïpö ko olämme ni wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ki bäät kïte, ki moa en tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny bëët.
english: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Eeyeth acïp Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk mare, cer nyeny jø Aram,  ni ö jø Arammi ni böötge eni, ni put jiye mo thööth mak ki tøŋ ni kïthge ge yi Damacka. 'Ba ena cäŋ cïp cer Peka nyeny Icriel thuwø; ni ö Peka ni 'näk jic Eeyeth ki 'näk mo raac døc.
english: Wherefore the Lord his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.

anywaa: Kiper Peka o Remaliya jø leny moa teek ma kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø anääe yi Juuda ki dïcäŋ aciel, kiper mana ö jø Juuda na wecge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers.

anywaa: Ni ö Dhikri nyï tuuŋ Ipariem na bëëdö na ŋat leny mo teek, ni 'näk Maycëya o nyeya, ka Adhirikam ŋata en paan-dwøŋŋi cere, ki Elkana ŋata caath køør nyeya.
english: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel jø tuuŋge ma jø Juuda ma kume ma dïpe ariiø amakge ki tøŋ, ni beege mään, ko obwöc cwøw, ko obwöc mään; ni twierge jammi mo thööth thuwø baŋ jøøgø ni kïthge ge yi Cameria.
english: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Wuuö Jwøk mana en kaagø na näk nyeŋŋe Ödet, ena ci wøk nee røømme ki jø leny mo oduu yi Cameria. 'Ba kanya røømme ki ge, ena köö jïge, ni «Neennu, Wuuö Jwøk Jwø kwäyø agootø ki jø Juuda, ni cïp geni ceŋŋu, ni 'nägu geni ki 'näk mo raac, këël mana jooti ya Jwøki.
english: But a prophet of the Lord was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the Lord God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u cädö ni jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem moø na mään ki cwøw yøø, ni tïïyu tïïö na laaŋe mou. ?A uuni, u kär bääyö thuwø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru?
english: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the Lord your God?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man wïnynyu mara, ni dwøgu tuuŋu ma jø Juuda moa magu, kiper wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø liel kaamar maac ena bäätu.»
english: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the Lord is upon you.

anywaa: Køøre dïbwöthe mo jø Ipariem, ni beege Adhariya wär Jöanan, ki Berekiya o Mecilemöth, ki Jidhikiya o Calum, ka Amaaca wär Adali, gena pïëmö ki jøøa duuö ki kar leny,
english: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,

anywaa: ni köge jï jøøgøøni, ni «Jiy moa magu ki tøŋ ba beer jïïu ki man kälu ge kany. ?Aŋø, u manynya man cäŋu bääyö mør käl bäätø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nou meeta bääyö mana en bäätø dïkwøŋ? Kiper bääyö marø oløny ni dwøŋ, ni wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø liel kaamar maac ena bäätø, ø na jø Icriel.»
english: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the Lord already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø leny jiy moa näk ege maa ki tøŋ ki jammi moa twierge aputge wii piny nyïm dïbwöthe ki jø acooŋa bëët.
english: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa cøøri ki nyeŋge kaagø, jiy moa no omaaø ki tøŋ alwørge, ni runyge dëët moa näk cäädhi ka dëëtge ka abïïe ki røk abïïe moa twier, ni moocge jøøgø ka aleeŋŋe ki war, ni moocge ge ki gïn cam ki pïï, ni wïïrge dëët jøøgø ki maaw, ni ö moa näk ba løny ki wääth ni kïthge ge bäät arëëni. Ni dwøkge jøøgø bëët baŋ jø tuuŋge Jerikö, päänya näk da twöe; ni duuge poge Cameria.
english: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na kaagø, nyeya ma Eeyeth ajääk baŋ nyeny Aciria kiper køny.
english: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.

anywaa: Kiper jø Ëdöm geno cäŋ öö ni tukge Juuda, ni makge jiy ki tøŋ.
english: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Pilitin thuwø päänye mo Juuda moa en yïth ŋøøpa näk rege päärö atwierge, ki kany wø cwøl ni Nëgëp; ni makge Bëëth-Camic, ka Ayalön, ki Gedëröt, ki Cökö ka atude moe, ki Temna ka atude moe, ki Gimjö ka atude moe, ni putge bëëte yïthge.
english: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Beth–shemesh, and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Soco with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Juuda adwøk piny kiper bëët Eeyeth nyeny Icriel, kiper mana wëëk jø Juuda bëëte ki wïthge ni mare bääö døc dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For the Lord brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Tiglat- Pilëëcër nyeny Aciria aöö ni tïme ni tïïya gïn mo raac dëër Eeyeth ni ba køny gø.
english: And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeyeth akän wøk røk jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki røk jap øt nyec, ki røk jap kwääri, ni cïp ge jï nyeny Aciria. 'Ba këël na cïp japøgø, bäŋ køny mo ee joodø.
english: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the Lord, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet nyeya ma Eeyeth ni gïï mo leth tägö dëëre, eni poot bëëdö ni meeta bääyö mare nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the Lord: this is that king Ahaz.

anywaa: Kiper ena cïpö ko olämme jï juu mo jø Damacka na bööt  eni, ni kööe, ni «Kiper juu mo nyeye mo Aram jicge akønyge, aani beerra man cïpa ko olämme jïge kiper naa kønyge.» 'Ba aput tïmö ni käla ränynyö mo päl bääte ki jø Icriel bëët.
english: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeyeth jap paac mo Øt Jwøk acooŋe ni ŋøør ge na thäŋi, ni cïëk odhuule mo dhøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïe ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge kiper dëëre yïth kwöra näk agääk jïëthe mo Jerucalem bëët.
english: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the Lord, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni tïïe yïth päänye bëët mo Juuda ki kwör lam mo ena maal bäät thuuri, nee wääŋe ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï juu møøk, ni tïïya Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäye, nee goote.
english: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the Lord God of his fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Eeyethi, ki bëëtö mare bäre, ki mana täge këël aŋuunge, ogöör piny yi Wëël Nyeye mo Juuda ki mo Icriel.
english: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Eeyeth athøw, ni läp køør kwäcge. Ni koonyge gø yi pääny Jerucalem, ni kärge kïth kany wø koony nyeye mo Icriel yie. Ni ö wääde ma Edhekaya ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Edhekaya na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe beege pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ki cwiiri ma pïërariiø ka abïŋween ni ena nyeya yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Abaaja nyi Dhekaraya.
english: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk kaawat moa tïïc kwari ma Deebit.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that David his father had done.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiir mana ci bäät nyec yie, yi dwäänaca, odhuule mo dhøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk aput jap ni tïïc ge ni nyärö.
english: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the Lord, and repaired them.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay acwøle ni cooŋ ge kanya laac nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Wui, jø tuuŋ Libay, cegu ïthu baŋa. Cïbu dëëtu kur keeru ennø, ni cïbu Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäyu, kur keere, ni kälu gïïa ba waany bëët wøk ki yi øtø manøgø ni en kur keere enø.
english: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.

anywaa: Kiper kwäyø gena bääö dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni tïïge ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ni wecge gø, ni løøge nyïmge wøk ki kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni løøge ŋäthge baŋ gø.
english: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the Lord, and turned their backs.

anywaa: Geni thuwø odhuule mo dhøk Øt Wuuö Jwøk acïëkge, ni 'näkge mäc mo lambae, ni wecge wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met ki cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre kanya en kur keere jï Jwø Icriel.
english: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ni jääl ge, ni tïïc ge na gïn böö cwïny jiyi ki gïrge, na gïr thäŋ ec, na gïr abuua, kaawat mana jootu gø ki nyeŋŋu.
english: Wherefore the wrath of the Lord was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, kwäyø anääŋŋi ko opëëlle ri leny, ni ö wäätø ki nyïïø ki määrø ni mak ge ki tøŋ ki køør gïnögø.
english: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, mana en cwïnya, a manynya gø naa tuda ki luubö ki Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, nee wëër mare na liel kaamar maac nee daae bäätø.
english: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u na jiya, käru bëëdö jaak, kiper Wuuö Jwøk uuna jiere nou cuŋŋu nyïme, nee eni tïnynyu, nou tïmu ni uuna jø tïïc moe ni wääŋu ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.»
english: My sons, be not now negligent: for the Lord hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tuuŋ Libay aput ö maal baŋ tïïc. 'Ba ki røkge, jøøa käl dëër Kät bee Maath wär Amacay, ki Jool wär Adhariya. 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Mërari bee Kic wär Abdi, ka Adhariya wär Jëlelel. 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Gërcön bee Jöa wär Jimma, ki Ëden wär Jöa.
english: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Elicapan beege Cimri ki Jikiël. 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Acaap beege Dhekaraya ki Mataniya.
english: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Ëman beege Jikiël ki Cimiy. 'Ba jøøa käl dëër Jeduthun beege Cemaya ki Udhiel.
english: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø geni jø tuuŋge aputge cooŋ ni cïpge dëëtge kur keerge ni waany,  ni cige kuna tïïcge Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni waany ki køør luup moa cem nyeya ki ri dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the Lord, to cleanse the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme adøny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk kuya kuna tïïcge gø ni waany, ni ö japa reyø bëët na jootge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni kälge ge wøk dï kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay japøge akwanyge ni kïthge ge wøk, ni leeŋge ge yi waŋ Naam Kidaran.
english: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the Lord into the court of the house of the Lord. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mar cïp Øt Wuuö Jwøk kur keere manøgø täkge ni nïr dwää aciel aciel; 'ba na tïme na ri bäc nïne mo dwäänögø, gena pïï ra agööl Øt Wuuö Jwøk. Ni cïpge øtø kur keere ki nïne abära møøk; ni thöörge tïïc manøgø bäre ri paac bïcier nïne mo dwäänögø.
english: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the Lord: so they sanctified the house of the Lord in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

anywaa: Køøre gena ci baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya ni köge, ni «Waani Øt Wuuö Jwøk bäre, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo wø waaŋ bäre ki jap tïïe moe bëët, ki tharabëëta man wø cïp muuga näk ocwøbø na nyuuthe bääte ki jap tïïe moe bëët, atïïcwa ni waany.
english: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the Lord, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.

anywaa: Waani thuwø, jap tïïe bëët mo Øt Jwøk moa leeŋ nyeya wøk ma Eeyeth kanya en paaci cere ki køør mana bëëde ni eni bääö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ajiiŋwa ni tïïcwa ge ni waany. Raŋï, ge ewa cïp nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Edhekaya aput päny maal ka amöölla døc ni cooŋ kwääri mo pääny, ni cige Øt Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the Lord.

anywaa: ni ge käädö ko olämme mo wëën raay na mo cïp kiper buc nyec, kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk, kiper jø Juuda. 'Ba olämme moøka beege rwäth dhäk abïriiø, ki nyöök rööm abïriiø, ki nyïï rööm abïriiø, ki nyöök atëëe abïriiø. Ni kööm dïlämme, ni beege nyïïkwaac Aran, ki man cïpge olämme moøgø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø rwäth dhäk anäkge, ni ö dïlämme ni lwørge rem ni kerge ge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Køøre nyöök rööm anäkge, ni ö dïlämme ni kerge rem bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Køøre nyïï rööm anäkge, ni ö dïlämme ni kerge rem bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.

anywaa: Køøre nyöök atëëe mo olämme mo wëën raay akälge ni cïpge ge nyïm nyeya ki jø acooŋa; ni ö jøøgøøni ni cïpge ceŋge bäätge.
english: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme nyöök atëëe moøgøøni anäkge ni kønyge rem moge bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte no okïdi kiper raac jø Icriel bëët, kiper ocaan nyeya no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø cïp kiper wëën raay doo tïïö kiper jø Icriel bëët.
english: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya jø tuuŋ Libay acïp kwörge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni ceŋge da athaliiŋŋi ki wïth thøme ma teeŋi ki køør luumma cem Deebiti, ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Nathan, ki Gaat, ŋat wø car jammi jï nyeya ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre; kiper luummögøøni cema Wuuö Jwøki ki dëët nyïïkuk moe moøgøøni.
english: And he set the Levites in the house of the Lord with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the Lord by his prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø tuuŋ Libay aput cuŋŋö ni jap dööti ma teeŋi moa näk mo Deebit ena ceŋge, ni ö dïlämme thuwø ni cuŋge ni tuŋi ena ceŋge.
english: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya acïpö ki dwøl nee olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre cïp bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. 'Ba kanya täk cïp olämme, jøw aput tägö thuwø ki wär dudi jï Wuuö Jwøk ni jøw kudhö ki tuŋi, ni jøw pöödö ki jap dööti ma teeŋi moa näk mo Deebit nyeny Icriel.
english: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the Lord began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø acooŋŋøgø bëët na wøørge Wuuö Jwøk, jø wär dudi thuwø gena put wär ki dudi ni jøw kudhö ki tuŋi. Ni ö japøgø bëët ni bëëtge ni di tïïö këël mana thum olämme bëët ki waaŋ.
english: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum olämme bëët ki waaŋ, nyeya ki jiy bëët moa en buute cøŋge akëëlge piny ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Edhekaya ki kwääri moa en tiere jø tuuŋ Libay aköömge thuwø nee wärge ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki dut Deebit ka Acaap, ni beeye Acaap ŋata wara joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre. Ni ö jøøgøøni ni wärge ki dut pwøc jï Wuuö  Jwøk ki met ec, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the Lord with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya aköö, ni «Ennø, dëëtu anø cïbu kur keeru ni waany jï Wuuö Jwøk; ööu kany ni cïpu olämme ki muuce mo dwøk met ec yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.» Ni ö jø acooŋŋøgø ni cïpge olämme ki muuce mo dwøk met ec; ni ö jiyi bëët moa yïthge met ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the Lord, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the Lord. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään olämme moa cïp jø acooŋŋøgø na mo waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk beege rwäth dhäk ma pïërabïriiø, ki nyöök rööm ma dïpa, ki nyïï rööm ma dïpe ariiø. Ni moøgø bëët beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cïpge thuwø ki rwäth dhäk ma dïpe abïciel ki dïëk ma rööm ma kume adäk, ni cïpge ge kur keerge no olämme.
english: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme atïmö ni nøk døc ni tïme ni ba løny jïge ki man jaaŋge lääy bëët moa 'näk no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre. Ni ö nyïïmëëkge ma jø tuuŋ Libay ni kønyge geni këël mana thum tïïci bäre, këël mano ö dïlämme møga noo cïpge dëëtge kur keerge ni waany. Kiper jø tuuŋ Libay gena bëëdö ni cwïnyge thïïŋ ki man cïpge dëëtge kur keerge ni waany ni ge kaala dïlämme.
english: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre moøgø na thööth yøø na cïpge, poot da dwäle mo olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ki muuce mo kwøŋ kiper olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo ocïbö thuwø. Ni ö tïïci mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni dwøkge gø kare.
english: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the Lord was set in order.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya ki jiy bëët yïthge amïnnö ki gïna tïïc Jwøki kiperge, kiper tïïc manøgø alaar thumö ki kany mo yie cään.
english: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ jø Juuda ki jø Icriel bëët, ni gööte ki weeli thuwø baŋ jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ni cwøla ge nee öge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk Jerucalem, nee cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wøørge jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper nyeya ki kwääri moa en tiere ki jø acooŋa bëët moa en Jerucalem geno nø cään bääte nee cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wøørge kanyo tïme na ri riet dwäde,
english: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

anywaa: kiper mana käre løny jïge ki man wøørge gø kanya dii wøørø yie, kiper mana tïme kar kaace ni kwään dïlämme nøk moa näk dëëtge ege cïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni jiy rege poot kärge cooŋ Jerucalem.
english: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø atïmö ni beer ki jï nyeya ki jø acooŋa bëët.
english: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

anywaa: Ni jïëcge ki man gøøge gø piny dï ŋööm Icriel bäre, ki mana täge Bëërcïïba këël Daan, ni ge cwøla jiy nee öge yi Jerucalem kuna wøørge cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, kiper mana kärge gø wøørø ni jiy thööth kaawat mana no ogöör piny.
english: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beer–sheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the Lord God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa jääŋŋi gena aay ni ge rwäänhnhö, ni cige mïëc Juuda ki Icriel bäre, ni weeli käärge käärö moa kälge baŋ nyeya ki kwääri moa en tiere, ki køør mana ö nyeya na kööm ge ki gø, na kööe, ni «Wui, u na jø Icriel, beerra man duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Icriel, nee eni duu baŋu, u na bøth na dööŋ ni kär mak nyeny Aciria.
english: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba käru tïmö kaamar wëëgu ki nyïïmëëgu na bëëdö ni ge bääö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, ni tïïc geni na gïn böö cwïny jiyi ki gïrge, kaawat man nëëne jïïu en.
english: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the Lord God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kär wïthu døøyu mo teek kaawat mana tïïc kwäyu, 'ba beerra man wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk, ni dønynyu kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, na näk ee cïp kur keere na bäre bäre, ni tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, nee wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac nee paanye bäätu.
english: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the Lord, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the Lord your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo uuno duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, tuuŋu ki wäätu ge jïtö ki mëër  ki baŋ jøøa mak geni ki tøŋ, ni duuge yi ŋöömö man. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, beeye Jwø wø nyooth met ec ni beeye Jwø mëër. 'Ba eni täärnyïme ba løø wøk ki uuni ni näk mou duua baŋe.»
english: For if ye turn again unto the Lord, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the Lord your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa jääŋŋi ni wø rwäänhnhi gena ci pääny man nø ki man nø po jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, këël mana pïïcge po jø tuuŋ Dhebulan. 'Ba wïth tuŋi moøgø gena ŋeethø bäätge ni buuge geni.
english: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na tïïcge gïnögø, jø møøk ki røk jø tuuŋ Acer, ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, rege adwøkge piny ni cige Jerucalem.
english: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba cer Jwøk ena bäät jø Juuda thuwø ki man tïïc cwïnyge na aciel, nee luumma ö nyeya ki kwääri na köömge ge ki gø ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk nee tïïcge.
english: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dwää ariiø, lwaa dhaanhø mo päl døc rege acooŋge yi Jerucalem na Ajwöma Mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø wøørge.
english: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena ö maal ni daakge gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo juuga reyø, ki gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge bëët moa en yi Jerucalem, ni putge ge leeŋ yi waŋ Naam Kidaran.
english: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.

anywaa: Køøre gena nääö ki nyïï dïëk moa therø mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ni nïr dwää ariiø apaar kurŋween. 'Ba dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay wïthge alääö keerge, ni cïpge dëëtge kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni känge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cuŋge kwörge kaawat mana no ocïp piny kiperge ki køør ciik Modhe na näk dhaanh Jwøk. Ni ö dïlämme ni jørge remø mana cïp jø tuuŋ Libay ceŋge.
english: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.

anywaa: Kiper mana näk da jiy mo thööth mo dëëtge kärge cïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk dï acooŋŋøgø, jø tuuŋ Libay nyïï dïëk moa therø mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie anäkge kiper jiy bëët moa näk ba waany, ni cïba dïëk moøgø kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper lwaa dhaanhø mana öö bäre, këël moa öö ki røk jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki moa öö ki røk jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki moa öö ki røk jø tuuŋ Icakar, ki moa öö ki røk jø tuuŋ Dhebulan, thööthge dëëtge kärge tïïö ni waany; 'ba gena cämö jaak ki cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, këël na bëëde ni kärge tïïö ki køør mana no ogöör piny. 'Ba Edhekaya alämö kiperge ni kööe, ni «Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki na mare beer ni wëën ŋati man nø,
english: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good Lord pardon every one

anywaa: ŋat mo cwïnye ee jiiŋŋø ki man many Jwøk, ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäye, këël na bëëde ni dëëre käre tïïö ni waany ki køør ciik mo Øt Jwøk.»
english: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the Lord God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk lam mar Edhekaya awïnynye ni køny jøøgø.
english: And the Lord hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moa dwät Jerucalem Ajwöma Mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø awøørge ki met ec mo dwøŋ døc ki nïne abïriiø. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ki dïlämme ni bëëtge ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki yi cäŋ cooth ki teek marge bäre.
english: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the Lord day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya ena cäänö ni pwøya jø tuuŋ Libay bëët, jøøa kwany tiet luup mo Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba gena bëëdö ni ge cämö ki cam mar ajwöma manøgø ki nïne abïriiø, ni ge cïpö ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër ni ge dwögö ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the Lord: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the Lord God of their fathers.

anywaa: Køøre jø acooŋa bëët gena jïëy ki man cäŋge ajwöma manøgø wøørrø ki nïne abïriiø møøk. Ni putge gø wøør ki nïne abïriiø moøgø ki met ec mo dwøŋ.
english: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.

anywaa: Kiper Edhekaya nyeny Juuda akän wøk jï jø acooŋa ki dhäk ma kuma aciel ki dïëk ma kume abïriiø; 'ba kwääri gena kän wøk thuwø jï jø acooŋa ki dhäk ma kuma aciel ki dïëk ma kume apaar; ni ö dïlämme mo thööth ni cïpge dëëtge kur keerge na mo Jwøk.
english: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba jø acooŋa bëët mo Juuda yïthge atïmö ni met, ge ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø acooŋa bëët moa öö ki yi ŋööm Icriel, këël ki juurre moa öö ki yi ŋööm Icriel ki mo wø bëëdö yi ŋööm Juuda.
english: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec mo dwøŋ atägö Jerucalem,  kiper poot bäŋ gïn mo otägö mo caala teeŋ man yi Jerucalem køør nïne moa beet Cølömanni o Deebit nyeny Icriel.
english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay moa näk dïlämme gena ö maal ni gwïëthge jiy, ni ö döötge ni wïnynyi ya Jwøki, ni ö lammi marge ni pïïe kanya en kur keere na näk kar bëët Jwøk maalø.
english: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum wøør ajwöma bäre, jø Icriel bëët moa nut kaagø gena ci wøk yïth päänye mo Juuda, ni tøcge kïte moa no ocwöth piny na gïï lam, ni ŋøtge jenni piny moa no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara, ni raanyge kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri mo wø lam juuga reyø yïthge, ki gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge. Gïïögø tïïcge yïth mïëc jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki yïth mïëc jø tuuŋ Ipariem ki jø tuuŋ Maneeca, këël mana thöörge japøgø bëët ki raanynyø. Køøre ge na jø Icriel bëët, gena duu yïth päänye moge, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø yïth ŋøøpe.
english: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay acïïmme na dhøgi, ni cïp tïïc mar ŋati man nø jïgø ki yi dhøk mana en yie. 'Ba tïïe moa cïbe jï jøøgø bëët na mo tïïge rege, beege cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, ki tïny Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki dwøk met ec ki pwøc dï kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba eni thuwø ena cïpö ki 'lääy na kur nyeya, nee tïmge no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre na mo cïp ka amöölla ka abøøya, ki yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm, ki kany wø päär dwääyi, ki kwör ajwöm moa no ocaanø, ki køør mana no ogöörö yïth ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the Lord.

anywaa: Eni thuwø jiy mo wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem aköömme nee muuce ko olämme moa näk kur dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay cïpge, nee dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay nee cwïnyge cïpge bäre ki man gwøkge ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø kanya wïnye jaak, jø Icriel gena put kännö ki wïth jammi mo thööth, ni beege thwöth beel moa kwøŋ ciek, ki kwøk nyïïomøki mo nyärö, ki mädhi, ki mäth kïïnynye, ki wïth caammi bëët moa ciek yïth pwöth moge. Japøgøøni akälge ni thööth na paac wïth jammi moge bëët moa en jïge.
english: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ki jø Juuda mo wø bëëdö yïth päänye mo Juuda, gena kännö thuwø ki paac wïth jammi mo dhäk ki mo dïëk, ki paac wïth jammi mo jammi moa näk ege cïp kur keerge kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ni cïpge ge piny na athwöe.
english: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the Lord their God, and laid them by heaps.

anywaa: 'Ba tïï cïp jammi piny moøgø na athwöe, täkge ka dwää adäk, ni thöörge ge ki dwää abïriiø.
english: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Edhekaya ki kwääri moa en tiere na jootge athwöe mo jammi moøgø, Wuuö Jwøk apwøcge ki jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the Lord, and his people Israel.
