anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay apëënynye kiper jammi moa näk ocïp piny na athwöe.
english: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

anywaa: 'Ba Adhariya na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ, na käl dhi øt Dhadök, aköö jïgø, ni «Ki kanya täk jammi moøgø ki cïp na käli Øt Wuuö Jwøk, waana bëëdö ni wa cämö ni rømwa, ni dööŋ thäk møøki wøk, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jiye agwïëdhe, ni ö jammi moi ni thööth ii ni dööŋge wøk.»
english: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the Lord, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the Lord hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

anywaa: 'Ba gena kööm Edhekaya nee uut kän jammi moa en yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk jiiŋge, ni putge ge jiiŋŋø.
english: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the Lord; and they prepared them,

anywaa: Køøre geni muuce moøgøøni ki paac wïth jammi ki jammi moa näk ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk akïthge yïth uudi moøgø ki tïïc ma kare. Ni ö Könaniya nyïï tuuŋ Libay ni cïbi bäät jammi moøgø na ŋat raŋ ge; 'ba coki ma Cimiy beeye ŋata caath køøre.
english: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

anywaa: 'Ba Könaniya ki coki ma Cimiy, jøøa bëëdö tietge na jø raŋ tïïc na jier nyeya ma Edhekaya beege Jikiël, ka Acaciya, ki Naath, ka Acaël,  ki Jerimöth, ki Jödhabat, ki Eliel, ki Icmakiya, ki Maath, ki Benaya. 'Ba Adhariya beeye ŋata bëëdö na ŋat raŋ Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Körë wär Yimna nyïï tuuŋ Libay, na bëëdö na ŋat koor dhi kal mar Øt Jwøk mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ena cïp bäät muuce moa cïp ki met ec jï Jwøk, kiper nee muuce moa no ocaanø ni cïp, ki caammi moa en kur keerge, nee wø pääŋŋe jï jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the Lord, and the most holy things.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en tiere ki yïth päänye mo dïlämme beege Ëden, ki Miniamin, ki Jëcua, ki Cemaya, ka Amariya, ki Cekaniya. Jøøgøøni tïïc atïïcge na kare ki man pääŋge jammi jï tuuŋge ki køør dhøgi moa näk ocïïmmö, ni jø døøŋŋø ko obwöre ena yie,
english: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

anywaa: ni bäŋ apääk kiper tier tuuŋ marge; ni cïpge jï obwöc cwøw moa näk cwiicge adäk ki moa näk cwiicge kaala adäk, ni beege jï jiy bëët mo oö Øt Wuuö Jwøk baŋ tïïc ki yïth nïne bëët ki køør mana no ocaanø kiper tïïe moge moo tïïcge yïth dhøgi moge moa näk ocïïmmö.
english: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the Lord, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

anywaa: Ni pääŋge ge thuwø jï dïlämme moa näk nyeŋge ogöör piny ki køør tuuŋ marge ki dhøk uudi moge, ki jï jø tuuŋ Libay moa näk cwiicge opäŋ na pïërariiø këël kunece ki køør tïïe moge ki dhøgi moge moa näk ocïïmmö.
english: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

anywaa: 'Ba ge na nyeŋge göör piny ki køør tuuŋ marge, dwala ge bëët, ni beege ko obwöre moge bëët moa therø, ki määrge, ki wäätge, ki nyïïge; kiper dëëtge acïpge kur keerge na kare na mo Jwøk.
english: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme na näk nyïïkwaac Aran moa en yïth päänye moge, ki moa en kwör kwaath deŋ päänye moge, da jiy mo ojierø røkge ki nyeŋge ki man pääŋge muuce jï cwøw bëët moa näk dïlämme, ki jï jø tuuŋ Libay bëët moa näk nyeŋge ogöör piny ki køør tuuŋ marge.
english: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya gïnögø atïïe dï Juuda bäre, ni bëëde ni tïïya gïn mo beer ma kare ma adïëri nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare.
english: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the Lord his God.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moa tïïe kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk, atïïe ki cwïnye bäre ni manynya mana many Wuuö Jwøki, ni ciik Jwøk ki luup moa ceme ee gwøø; ni ö jammi moa tïïe bëët ni thurge karge jïre.
english: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

anywaa: 'Ba køør tïïe moøgø na näk karge yøø na tïïc Edhekaya, Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria aöö ki jø leny moe ni tuk Juuda, ni ciel päänye mo Juuda dïër moa näk kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek, ni cäde ki man døny yïthge ki teek nee maae na moe.
english: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Edhekaya na joot gø ni Cenakerëp oöö ki man këëde ki jø Jerucalem,
english: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

anywaa: kwääri moe ki jø leny moe acooŋe ki man dïïrge dhøk jøør moa en töök pääny, ni ö jøøgøøni ni kønyge eni.
english: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth, dëëtge aputge cooŋ ni dïïrge dhøk jøør bëët ki dhi waŋ naam mana näk dï paac ee ŋølø, ni ge köö, ni «Ba beer ki man ö nyeny Aciria ni jïte ki pïï mo thööth.»
english: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya cwïnye amaae ni teek ni cäŋ kwöra no opädhö ri kiir bäre geerrø, ni gëën bäätge ki uut koor moa näk ogeerø ni ena maal, ni gëëde ki kiir mør thuwø töök kiir, ni ö kany wø cwøl ni Milø na en yi Pääny Deebit ni mak gø ni teek, ni tïïe ki jap leny mo thööth ki kööt leny mo thööth.
english: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

anywaa: Ni jëëde ki kwääc lwaae mo leny mo käär jiy, ni cooŋ ge nyïme yi kanya laac dhi kiir pääny, ni cään geni ni cøma cwïnyge, ni kööe,
english: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

anywaa: ni «Bëëdu nou teek ni magu cwïnynyu; käru lwäyö ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu ki nyeny Aciria, wala kiper lwaaece bäre ni en buute ice, kiper teek man ni en baŋø en, kaala mar nyeny Aciria.
english: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

anywaa: Jø leny moøke ni en buut nyeny Aciria yøøke beege jø leny mo ŋäätha teek mar dhaanhø; 'ba ŋat en buutø en beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, noo køny øøni noo këël leny marø.» Køøre jiy cwïnyge aputge cøm ki luup Edhekaya nyeny Juuda.
english: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the Lord our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre nyeny Aciria ma Cenakerëp, kanya bëëde ni deŋ Lakic ee cielø ki jø leny moe bëët na en buute, ena jääk yi Jerucalem ki dwøl ki ceŋ jø kööre moe baŋ Edhekaya nyeny Juuda ki jø Juuda bëët mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem; ni ö jøøa jääŋŋi ni köge,
english: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye dwøl mana caan Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria, ena köö, na ‹?Agïnaŋø ni ŋääthu, ki man bëëdu jaak yi Jerucalem ni uuno ciel dëëci dïër?
english: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Edhekaya ba maaŋ wïthu ki man cïpu dëëtu nou thøwu ki käc ki riew, na kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ø pieme piemø cer nyeny Aciria»?
english: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The Lord our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

anywaa: ?Patha Edhekaya manøgø na raany kwör lam mo Wuuö Jwøk moa en bäät thuuri, ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge, ni kööe jï jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ni «Wøørru Wuuö Jwøk nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ma aciel, ni wääŋu bääte ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.»?
english: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

anywaa: « ‹?Aani ki kwäya gïna tïïcwa dëët jiy bëët mo mïëri møga kuyu? ?Da juu mo juurre mo mïëri moøka mo omaar lønyø jïge ki man piemge jiy moa bëëdö yïth ŋøøm moge cera?
english: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

anywaa: ?A jwøe mane ki røk juu bëët mo juurre moa raany kwäya na bäre na løny jïre ki man piem jiye cera? ?A ni näk ma ennø nø, olønye nidïï jï Jwøk maru ki man piem uuni cera?
english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Edhekaya kär wëëgu man cøøk uuni wala man maaŋ wïthu ki gïnögø, ni ba ŋääthu eni, kiper ki røk juu mo wïth juurre bëët wala mo buc nyeye, bäŋ jwøk mo oløny jïre ki man piem jiye cera wala ceŋ kwäya. ?A Jwøk maru nø, olønye jïre nidïï ki man piem uuni cera?› »
english: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre mo Cenakerëp gena cäänö ki luup møøk thuwø ni ge raanynya nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ki nyeŋ dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk ma Edhekaya.
english: And his servants spake yet more against the Lord God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

anywaa: Ni ö Cenakerëp thuwø ni gööde ki weeli ni pääta Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ni cääne ni raanynya nyeŋ gø, ni kööe, «Kaa mana bëët juuwi mo juurre mo tiet mïëri ni kär løny jïge ki man piemge jicge cera, kaawat manøgø thuwø, Jwøk mar Edhekaya ba løny jïre ki man piem jiye cera.»
english: He wrote also letters to rail on the Lord God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø aputge rwaac ki dhøk mar jø Juuda ni döötge ena maal, ni ge cäänna jø Jerucalem moa en bäät kiir. Gïnögø atïïcge ni ge wëëga cwïny jø Jerucalem bwøk ki man lwäcge, kiper nee pääny makge.
english: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

anywaa: Gena cäänö ni Jwøk mar jø Jerucalem ege päärö ki juu mo jø bäät piny ni wø tïïc jiyi ki ceŋge.
english: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Edhekaya ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth gena lämö kiper gïnögø ni jwöŋge dëër Jwøge na en maal.
english: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk nyïïatwiel maal aput jääŋŋö, ni ö nyïïatwielli manøgø ni 'näk jø leny moa teek bëët mo Aciria, ki kwääc lwaae mo leny bëët moa kwörge døøŋŋø ki kwääc lwaae mo leny bëët moa caath køørge yi twïër mar nyeny Aciria. Ni ö nyeny Aciria ni put døø yi ŋöömö mare ni wïïe olääö. 'Ba kanya døny øt jwøk mare kunece, ena put wääte møøk 'näk kaace ko opëëllö.
english: And the Lord sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk Edhekaya ki jø Jerucalem aput piem cer Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria ki ceŋ jiy møga bëët, ni mooc geni ki jwöm kun ki kun.
english: Thus the Lord saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni öge yi Jerucalem ni ge kännö ki muuce jï Wuuö Jwøk, ki jammi mo perge leth jï Edhekaya nyeny Juuda. Ni ö Edhekaya ni put tïmö ni kare dwøŋ døc ki yïthakic juurre bëët yïth nïne moøka.
english: And many brought gifts unto the Lord to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögøøni, Edhekaya atïmö ni tuu ni ena um thøø; ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cääne ki eni, ni nyuunhnhi ya Wuuö Jwøki ki ŋïï.
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the Lord: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya bäŋ pwøc mo ee dwøgø jï Wuuö Jwøk na kar gïna beer na joode, kiper cwïnye ajïtö ka atöör.  Kiper manøgønø, wëëc Jwøk aö bääte ki bäät jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem.
english: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya dëëre adwøk piny, eni ki jø Jerucalem, ni ö wëëc Wuuö Jwøki ni käre ö bäätge ki yïth nïne moa näk moe.
english: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the Lord came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya atïmö no okwär døc no owøørø; ni tïïe ki uut kän jïre kiper gwet-bïrö, ki warkie, ki nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth, ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, ki kööt leny, ki wïth jammi ma teeŋi mo perge leth.
english: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

anywaa: Ni tïïe ki uut kän thuwø kiper beel, ki kwøk nyïïomøki, ki mädhi; ni gëëde ki lwääge kiper wïth lääc paac moe bëët, ki ciel man bëët pïïth dïëki moe yïthge.
english: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

anywaa: Ni gëëde ki päänye jïre, ni jïte ki pïïth dïëk ki wïth lääc paac ma teeŋi mo thööth, kiper Jwøk ocïpö jïre ki jammi mo thööth døc.
english: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya bee eni na dïïr jöör pï jøøro mana en maal na cwøl ni Giyön, ni tïïc pï gø nee døøkge ki jï løø wø päth cäŋŋi yie ki yi Pääny Deebit. 'Ba Edhekaya jammi moa tïïe bëët athur karge ni beyø.
english: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kanya ö jiyi ki røk kwääri mo Babiløn, na jääŋŋi baŋe ni pëënynya eni ki ŋïï mana rëëm ec na tägö yi ŋöömö mare, ena wec Jwøki keere ni Jwøk päänynya eni kiper nee luup moa en cwïnye bëët nee ŋäc Jwøki.
english: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Edhekaya, këël luum tïïe moe moa beyø na tïïe bëët, ogöörö yïth luup moa nyooth jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth, ki yi Wëël Nyec Juuda ki mo Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya ena thøw ni läp køør kwäcge, ni koonyge gø kar bwör moa en maal mo nyïïkwaac Deebit; ni ö jø Juuda bëët ki jø Jerucalem ni wøørge thøø mar gø. Ni ö wääde ma Maneeca ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Maneeca na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïërabïïc kurbïïc yi Jerucalem.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni caatha køør gïïa näk ec raac ki ge døc na tïïc wïth juurre moa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk nyïm jø Icriel.
english: But did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper eni kwör wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri, na raany wänni ma Edhekaya, acäŋ geerrø, ni tïïe ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge jï juuk wø cwøl ni Baal, ni tëëŋe ki jenni ni caa ge ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara, ni wøør jap maal ni tïny geni.
english: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

anywaa: Køøre ena tïïö ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge jï juu møøk yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye øtø mana kö Wuuö Jwøki ni nyeŋŋe doo wøørø yie yi Jerucalem na bäre bäre.
english: Also he built altars in the house of the Lord, whereof the Lord had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

anywaa: Eni gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge atïïe yïth käälle moa na ariiø mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk jï japa en maal bëët.
english: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba wääde awaaŋe ki maac no olämi ya agäm-kïn Ben Inöm, ni tïïe ki jap thïëth, ki jap adïëda, ki jap ajuuk, ni pëëny jiy mo rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ki jiy mo cäänö ki juuk piny. 'Ba ena tïïö ki gïï mo thööth døc mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïya Wuuö Jwøk nee goote.
english: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

anywaa: Køøre eni kït gïn wø lam na näk ee tieŋø acwöth piny yi Øt Jwøk, ni beeye øda kö Jwøki jï Deebit ki wääde ma Cølöman, ni «Jerucalem ki øtø man ni en yie en, yaa jierø ki røk kwör wø bëët wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel yïthge bëët, nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie na bäre bäre.
english: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jø Icriel rege gwøkge gwøø ki man kïthge ciik 'moa bëët bäät tïïc, ki luup moa cema, ki luup ŋøl 'moa, moa caan dhaanhnha ma Modhe jïge, aani, ge ba daaa këët yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï kwäcge.»
english: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba Maneeca jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem abwødhe ki man gaage wøk ni tïïge ki raay mo thööth mo kaala moa tïïc wïth juurre moa wïthge dïïr Wuuö Jwøki nyïm jø Icriel.
english: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Maneeca ki jiye acäänne, 'ba ïthge kärge ciiø ki luum gø.
english: And the Lord spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø, Wuuö Jwøk kwääc lwaae mo leny mo nyeny Aciria akäl bäätge, ni makge Maneeca, ni gänge um gø ki gïn mo caala obïth, ni twöcge gø ki tiimme mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni kïthge gø Babiløn.
english: Wherefore the Lord brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni eni ena yïth gïï mo leth, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, akwaae, ni dwøk dëëre piny døc nyïm Jwøk, Jwø kwäye.
english: And when he was in affliction, he besought the Lord his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

anywaa: 'Ba kanya läme jï Jwøk, kwac mare awïny Jwøki, ni cäŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki dwøk Jerucalem yi buc nyec mare. Køøre Maneeca aput ŋäc møn ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk møn.
english: And prayed unto him: and he was entreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the Lord he was God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør gïïögø, eni kiir mana en wøk ŋää Pääny Deebit na en jï kun wø päth cäŋŋi yie buut jøøro man wø cwøl ni Giyön na en ya agäm-kïdi ageere ni ena maal døc, këël mana këët Dhi Kiir Rec, ni ee wïrö ki deŋ thuur Öpël. Ni cïp yïth päänye bëët mo Juuda moa no ogeerø ni teek ki kwääri mo jø leny.
english: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø eni, juu moa path, ki kït gïn wø lam na näk ee tieŋø akäl wøk yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, këël ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge bëët moa näk ee tïïö bäät thuur Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki yi Jerucalem, ni put ge leeŋ wøk ŋää pääny.
english: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the Lord, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

anywaa: Køøre eni gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk adwøk kare, ni cïpe bäät gø ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër ko olämme mo dwøk met ec, ni kööm jø Juuda ki man tïnyge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: And he repaired the altar of the Lord, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy gena bëëdö ni ge poot cïpö ko olämme bäät thuuri, 'ba beeye jï Wuuö Jwøk keere, Jwøk marge.
english: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the Lord their God only.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Maneeca, këël lam mana läme jï Jwøk mare ki gø, ki luup moa caan jïre na caan jø wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïge ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyeye mo Icriel.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the Lord God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba lam mar Maneeca, ki kanya ö Jwøki na wïny kwac mare, ki raay moa tïïe bëët, ki mana bëëde ni bääö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ki kwör lam moa tïïe bäät thuuri, ki jenni moa no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara na tïïe, ki gïï wø lam moa no otieŋø moa cwöth piny yïth kwör lam moøgø, kanya poode ni dëëre poot käre dwøk piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ogöör piny yïth luup jø wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïge.
english: His prayer also, and how God was entreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

anywaa: Køøre Maneeca athøw ni läp køør kwäye, ni koonyi paare. Ni ö wääde ma Amön ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Amönni na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurriiø, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ariiø Jerucalem.
english: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Amön abëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc wänni ma Maneeca, ni cïpe ko olämme jï kït gïï wø lam bëët moa näk otieŋø na tïïc wänni ma Maneeca, ni tïny geni.
english: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

anywaa: 'Ba Amön dëëre käre dwøk piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana tïïc wänni ma Maneeca na dwøk dëëre piny, 'ba aput bëëte ni 'meeta raay moe.
english: And humbled not himself before the Lord, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre moe ni tutge ki luubö kipere, ni putge gø 'näk yi øtø mare.
english: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët moa tudö ki luubö bäät Amön, gena put jø paaci 'näk, ni røønyge wääde ma Jöcaya na nyeya kar gø.
english: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jöcaya na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe abära, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurciel yi Jerucalem.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni eni cäädhi ka uutjïëthe moa caath kwari ma Deebit, ni käre gaa bäät caam wala bäät cwïïc.
english: And he did that which was right in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

anywaa: Kiper kanya tïm cwiiri moe na abära bäät nyec ni eni poot thiinh, ena tägö ki man many Jwøk, Jwø kwari ma Deebit; 'ba na tïm cwiiri moe na apaar kurriiø bäät nyec, jap juuga reyø na en yi Juuda ki yi Jerucalem atääe ki man raany ge, ni beege kwör lam moa no otïïö bäät thuuri, ki jera no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara, ki kït gïï wø lam moa näk otieŋø ki moa näk oleenyø.
english: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

anywaa: Ni ö gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo juuk wø cwøl ni Baal ni toorge ge piny ni nëënö jï nyeya; ni ö gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge moa näk ocwöth piny buutge ni tøya nyeya piny. 'Ba eni jera no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara ki kït gïï wø lam moa näk otieŋø ki moa näk oleenyø atøye na thäŋi thuwø ni guur ge na tør, ni køny tør marge bäät bwöc jøøa wara cïpö jïge ko olämme.
english: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

anywaa: Køøre cuu mo dïlämme mo juuga reyø awaaŋe bäät gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge, ni tïïc Juuda ki yi Jerucalem ni waany.
english: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth päänye thuwø mo jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki jø tuuŋ Cimien, këël mana këët baŋ jø tuuŋ Naptali, ki kwöra no oränynyö deŋge bëët,
english: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

anywaa: gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo juuga reyø atoor piny, ni ö jera no ocaa ri jwø wø cwøl na Acara ki kït gïï wø lam moa näk otieŋø ni ŋøør ge na thäŋi ni guur ge na tør, ni ö gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge bëët ni toor ge piny dï ŋööm Icriel bäre. Køøre ena duu Jerucalem.
english: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Jöcaya na apaar ka abära bäät nyec, ni ŋööm paare ki yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ee nø tïïc ni waany, eni Capan wär Adhaliya, ki Maycëya na bëëdö na kwääc pääny, ki Jöa wär Jeyöakac ni wø göör luup akwöma piny, gena jääŋŋe kuna cäŋge Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, tïïyö ni nyään.
english: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena ci baŋ Kilkiya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni cïpge gwel jïgø moa no okäl yi Øt Jwøk, ni beege gwel moa cooŋ jø tuuŋ Libay mo wø koor dhi kal mar Øt Jwøk ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Maneeca, ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki baŋ jiy bëët moa no odööŋ Icriel, ki baŋ jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen, ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre gwel moøgø acïpge ceŋ jø wø raŋ tïïc mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö jøøgø ni cïpge gwel ceŋ jø tïïc mo tïïc Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni ge dwøga gø kare ni nyään.
english: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the Lord, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the Lord, to repair and amend the house:

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø thuwø ni cïpge ki gwel jï dïjëëth opämi ki jø wø caam øtø ki kïte kiper nee ŋeewge ki kïte moa no otøø ki jenni moa näk rïwe ki moa näk cuge mo wø tïïc wïth uudi ki ge, uuta wëëk nyeye mo Juuda ränynyö.
english: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tïïc, tïïc atïïcge na kare ki jiy moa bwøth geni ki tïïc. 'Ba jøøa bwøth geni ki tïïc, ki røk jøøa käl dëër Mërari beege Jakath ki Øbadiya; 'ba ki røk jøøa käl dëër Kät beege Dhekaraya ki Meculam. 'Ba ge bëët beege jø tuuŋ Libay moa nyeŋge reegø ki pwöt jap dööti ma teeŋi.
english: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

anywaa: 'Ba geni thuwø gena tïïc ni gena jø raŋ jø tëër ki jø tïïc mo wø tïïc wïth tïïe ma teeŋi. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay, møøk beege dïgööte, ni møøk a kwääri, ni ö møøki ni näkge beege jø koor dhøk kal.
english: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya käl gwel wøk moa no ocïbö na muuce yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Kilkiya na bëëdö na dïlämi mana dwøŋ wëël ciik mar Wuuö Jwøk mana cïp ki ri Modhe ajoode.
english: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the Lord, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the Lord given by Moses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kilkiya aköö jï Capan, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni «Aani, wëël ciik Modhe ajooda yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.» Køøre eni wëël ciik aput cïp jï Capan.
english: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

anywaa: Køøre Capan wëël ciik alwøre ni kïth gø baŋ nyeya, ni caan gø jï nyeya thuwø ni kööe, ni «Jiy moï jammi bëët moa no ocaanø jïge ni tïïcge, ge tïïö rege.
english: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.

anywaa: Geni thuwø, gwel moa joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk akälge wøk ni cïpge  ge jï jø wø raŋ tïïc ki jø tïïc.»
english: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

anywaa: Køøre eni na Capan ni wø göör luup akwöma piny, nyeya acäŋ cäännö ni kööe, ni «Kilkiya, eni na dïlämi, wëël ciik acïbe jïra.» Kanyøgø Capan wëël ciik manøgø aput kwaan nyïm nyeya.
english: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na wïny luup ciik moøgø, abïïge aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny.
english: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, nyeya, Kilkiya, ka Akikam o Capan, ka Abidön o Mikiya, ki Capan ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki dhaanh nyeya ma Acaaya, aput köömmö ni kööe,
english: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cou pëënynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk kipera, kiper jiy bëët moa dööŋ Icriel ki Juuda, kiper luup mo wëël ciik man na joot en; kiper wëër mo dwøŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk aö bäätø kiper mana ö kwäyø ni kärge dwør Wuuö Jwøk jïëö ki køør luup moi bëët no ogöör yi wëël ciik man en.»
english: Go, enquire of the Lord for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to do after all that is written in this book.

anywaa: 'Ba Kilkiya ki jiy møga moa kööm nyeya gena ci ni cäänge ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ulda, nyijø mo bëëdö thääŋ Jerucalem mana nyään. 'Ba Ulda beeye cï Calum o Tikwa, nyikwaar Arac, ŋat wø koor abïïk lam.
english: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö jïge, ni «Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, ena köö ni caannu jï ŋata jääŋ uuni baŋa,
english: And she answered them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

anywaa: ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, gïn mo raac kïtha bäät Jerucalem ki bäät jiy mo wø bëëdö yie; këël acëënne bëët moa näk ogöörö yi wëël ciik mana kwaan nyïm nyeny Juuda kïtha bäätge.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

anywaa: Kiper aana wecge ni wääŋge ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï juu møøk, ni ge tïïya aani naa goota ki køør tïïe bëët moa temge ki ceŋge. Kiper manøgønø, wëër mara kïtha bäät Jerucalem, ni bëëde ni ba cuŋ.›
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

anywaa: 'Ba wär caannu jï nyeny Juuda na jääŋ uuni kuna pëënynyu Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööu jïre ni man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel kiper luupa wïnynyï,
english: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the Lord, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

anywaa: ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana päth cwïnyï ni dwøgï dëërï piny nyïma kanya wïnynyï luup 'moa mo jääla Jerucalem ki ge ki jø wø bëëdö yie, ni jeeyï abïïgï ki pänh cwïny, ni jwöŋï nyïma, ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, oduuru marï awïnynya.
english: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ï thøw ni läpï køør kwäyu, ni koony ïïni yi bwörö marï ni paac poot beer. Japa reyø bëët moo käla bäät paani ki bäät jø wø bëëdö yie, ba jootï ki waŋï.› » Køøre jøøa jääŋŋi gena døøk ni caange luubö manøgø jï nyeya.
english: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jöcaya ena jäägö ki dwøl ni cooŋ jø døøŋŋø bëët moa en yi Jerucalem ki moa en yi ŋööm Juuda bäre.
english: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni ci Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki jø Juuda bëët, ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege jiy bëët, ki mana täge ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø këël moa kwörge therø; ni ö nyeya ni kwaan luup bëët ni wïnyö jïge moa en yi wëël luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiye na joot yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the king went up into the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya acuŋŋö kare ni tude ki luubö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, nee eni bëëde ni caatha køør Wuuö Jwøk, nee gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki, ki pwöc moe, ki ciik moe gwøe ki cwïnye bäre ka acaaye bäre, nee bëëde ni cäädhi ka køør luup moa no otuudö na no ogöör piny yi wëëlö manøgø.
english: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni tïïc jø Jerucalem ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen moa nut kaagø bëët nee luummögø jïëcge. 'Ba jø Jerucalem gena put jïëy ni tïïcge gø ki køør luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiye, Jwø kwäcge.
english: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Jöcaya gïïa näk yi Jwøk raac ki ge bëët akäl wøk yïth ŋøøm bëët moa näk mo jø Icriel, ni tïïc jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö Icriel nee Wuuö Jwøk tïnyge, Jwøk marge. 'Ba yïth nïne moa beet nyeya ma Jöcaya, jø Icriel wääth kärge wiiø køør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge.
english: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the Lord their God. And all his days they departed not from following the Lord, the God of their fathers.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jöcaya cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie awøøre  jï Wuuö Jwøk yi Jerucalem, ni ö geni ni 'näkge nyïïdïëk moa therø mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ni nïr dwää aciel apaar kurŋween.
english: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the Lord in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöcaya dïlämme acïp bäät tïïe moge, ni cøm cwïnyge nee cuŋge ni teek ri tïïe mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the Lord,

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö thuwø jï jø tuuŋ Libay mo obëëdö ni dëëtge ege cïp kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø pwöny jø Icriel bëët, ni «Kälu acanduk mana en kur keere yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk na geer Cølömanni o Deebit nyeny Icriel, nee ba kääru këët. 'Ba ennø, tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ki jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the Lord, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the Lord your God, and his people Israel,

anywaa: 'Ba jiiŋŋu dëëtu ki køør dhøk uudi mou ki yïth dhøgi mou kaawat mana no ogöör Deebiti piny nyeny Icriel ki wääde ma Cølöman.
english: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

anywaa: «Ni cuŋŋu kanya en kur keere ni pääŋŋu dëëtu dhi øtø man nø ki man nø mo jø pou.
english: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

anywaa: Ni 'nägu nyïïdïëk mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ni cïbu dëëtu kur keeru na mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni jiiŋŋu nyïïdïëk kiper jø pou ki køør luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki ri Modhe.»
english: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.

anywaa: Køøre Jöcaya akän wøk jï jø paac bëët moa nut kaagø ki nyïïdïëk ma kume ma pïëradäk ki dhäk ma kume adäk, kiper Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, 'ba moøgø bëët käl wøk ka røk lääy moe.
english: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre mo nyeya thuwø gena kän wøk ko olämme ki met ec marge jï jø paac ki jï dïlämme ki jï jø tuuŋ Libay. Ni ö Kilkiya ki Dhekaraya ki Jikiël, ge na dïbwöthe mo Øt Jwøk, ni cïpge ki nyïïdïëk ma kume ariiø ki dïpe abïciel ki dhäk ma dïpe adäk jï dïlämme no olämme kiper Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.

anywaa: 'Ba Könaniya thuwø ki nyïïmenni, ni beege Cemaya ki Natanel, ki dïbwöthe møøk mo jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege Acabiya ki Jïël ki Jödhabat, gena kän wøk thuwø jï jø tuuŋ Libay ki nyïïdïëk ma kume abïïc ki dhäk ma dïpe abïïc no olämme mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö tïïe moøgø na nø jiiŋŋi, dïlämme gena cuŋŋö kwörge, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ni cïïmge rege ki køør dhøgi moge ki køør mana ö nyeya na kööm ge ki gø.
english: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

anywaa: Ni 'näkge nyïïdïëk mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ni ö dïlämme ni lwørge remø ceŋ jø tuuŋ Libay ni jørge gø bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay ni jaaŋge nyïïdïëk.
english: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.

anywaa: Køøre gena kän wøk ki røk nyïïdïëk moøgø ko olämme moo waaŋ bäre nee cïpge jï jø dhøk uudi mo jø paac moa no ocïïmmö na dhøgi, nee cïpge jï Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mana no ogöör piny yi wëël Modhe. Ni tïïcge tïïc manøgø ki dhäk thuwø.
english: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.

anywaa: 'Ba rïŋ mo dïëk mo Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie abulge ki maac ki køør mana no ogöör piny; ni ö rïŋö mana no ocïp kur keere ni thaalge gø ki dääe ka athääe ki thäwe, ni laarge gø cïp jï jø paac bëët.
english: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

anywaa: Køøre gena tëëdö kiper dëëtge ki dïlämme, kiper dïlämme na näk nyïïkwaac Aran gena bëëdö këël wäär ni ge cïpa olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki dwäle mo wø waaŋ. Kiper manøgønø, jø tuuŋ Libay atëëdö kiper dëëtge ki dïlämme na näk nyïïkwaac Aran.
english: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wär dudi moa käl dëër Acaap, ge bëëdö kwörge kaawat mana ö geni na köömmi ya Deebiti, ka Acaap, ki Ëman, ki Jeduthun, ŋat wø car jammi jï nyeya ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïre. 'Ba jø wø koor dhi kal man nø, kwör koor moge kärge wiiø, kiper tuuŋge ma jø tuuŋ Libay atëëdö kiperge.
english: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïe bëët mo tïïc kiper Wuuö Jwøk ajiiŋŋi yi cäŋögø nee cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wøør, nee olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre cïp bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk ki køør mana ö nyeya ma Jöcaya na kööm ge ki gø.
english: So all the service of the Lord was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel bëët moa nut kar kaace, cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie awøørge, ni wøørge Ajwöm Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ wödö mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie mo caala teeŋ man mo otïïö Icriel, 'ba ŋuuda yïth nïr Camiel na näk nyikuŋ Jwøk; ni bäŋ ŋat mo owøør cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ki røk nyeye mo Icriel ki wödö mo röömi ki man na tïïc Jöcaya, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø Juuda ki jø Icriel moa en kaagø bëët, ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie manøgø wøør ki kanya tïm cwiic Jöcaya na apaar ka abära bäät nyec.
english: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre japøgø bëët, ni Jöcaya tïïe mo Øt Jwøk ee nø thöör, Nekø nyeny Ijep aci baŋ leny Karkëmec bäät Naam Upareeti, ni ö Jöcaya ni ci baŋ gø wøk nee këëde ki gø.
english: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

anywaa: 'Ba Nekø aöön baŋ gø ki jiy ni kööe, «?Wui, nyeny Juuda, agïnaŋø ni en yïthakiyø ki ïïni? A ba ö baŋ leny ki ïïni dïcäŋi, 'ba beeye baŋ paac man wø mäna ki gø, kiper Jwøk a ee köömmö ni laara leny man këël. Jwøk ni en buuta en kär yie cwaatï; kiper nee ï ba raanynye.»
english: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöcaya, Nekø käre wiiø ki man ci baŋ gø, 'ba abïïk nyec aput wiil, ni ci baŋ leny baŋ gø, ni mare kweer ki luubö mana caan Jwøki ki dhi Nekø. Ni put ci baŋ leny yi pwöl Megidø.
english: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø wø këëdi ka athëëre nyeya ma Jöcaya akëëlge, ni kö nyeya jï jø kööre moe, ni «Kïthu aani wøk ki dï leny, kiper dëëra anø jïtö ki ŋwellø mo leth døc.»
english: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

anywaa: Ni ö jø kööre moe ni kälge eni wøk ki yi jää leny man wø tuut okweenynyi mana këëli yie, ni kïthge gø yi jääy mare maya, ni kïthge gø Jerucalem; ni put thøø. 'Ba akoonyge buut bwör mo kwäye. Ni ö jø Juuda bëët ki jø Jerucalem ni kïïnge gïr gø.
english: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya acääö ki duut man jwøk Jöcaya ki gø; 'ba këël yïth nïne moi jø wär ki dudi moa näk cwøw ki mään bëët, kany wø wärge ki dudi mo wø wär kiper thøø, wïthge wø parge parø ki Jöcaya. 'Ba gïnögø aput tïmö na kööŋŋö ki Icriel, ni gööri piny yi wëël dudi mo wø jwøk jiy ki ge kany wø thøwge.
english: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi møga moa tïïc Jöcaya, ki tïïe moe na beyø na tïïe ki køør mana no ogöör piny yi wëël ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the Lord,

anywaa: ki gïïa tïïe bëët ki mana täge këël aŋuunge, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyeye Mo Juuda ki Icriel.
english: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø paac bëët Jeyöakac o Jöcaya alwørge ni røønyge gø na nyeya kar wänni yi Jerucalem.
english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jeyöakaci na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurdäk, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwäde adäk yi Jerucalem.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Ijep aöö ni käl teek nyec wøk cer Jeyöakac yi Jerucalem, ni put cwötö ka ajwäk bäät paac, ni beege gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri ma dïpa, ki warkey ma rumi ma kikar aciel.
english: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeny Ijepi ni put Eliekim cöök Jeyöakac røøny na nyeya bäät Juuda ki Jerucalem, ni wiil nyeŋ gø ni Jeyöakëm. 'Ba Nekø nyeny Ijep, Jeyöakac cöök Jeyöakëm alwøre ni kïth gø Ijep.
english: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Neco took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeyöakëm kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar kurciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba Jeyöakëm ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn aö maal bäät Jeyöakëm, ni mak gø ni twöc gø ki tiimme mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni kïth gø Babiløn.
english: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabukedenecör thuwø jammi møøk mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk akïth Babiløn ni kïth ge yi øt lam mare yi Babiløn.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the Lord to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba luum tïïe møga moa tïïc Jeyöakëmmi, ki gïïa raac eci ki ge na tïïe, ki jammi moa tägö dëëre, ogöör piny yi Wëël Luup Nyec Icriel ki Juuda. 'Ba Jeyöakëm wääde ma Jöakin aläw kar gø na nyeya.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jöakinni na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe apaar ka abära, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki dwäde adäk ki nïne apaar yi Jerucalem. 'Ba Jöakin ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni piny arïïa, nyeya ma Nabukedenecör aöönnö ki jiy ni käl Jöakin ki jammi moa perge leth mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni kïth ge baŋe Babiløn, ni tïïc Cëdëkiya cöök wää Jöakinni na nyeya bäät Juuda ki Jerucalem.
english: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Cëdëkiya na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurciel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar kurciel yi Jerucalem.
english: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, ni eni bëëdö ni dëëre käre dwøk piny nyïm nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, ŋat wø car luup Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni gëëme thuwø ki nyeya ma Nabukedenecör, ŋata tïïc gø nee kööŋe nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. Ni tïïc wïïe ki cwïnye ni teek ki man løø nyïme baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, dïlämme bëët moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jiy bëët, gena bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper gena tïmö ni ge caatha køør japa raac eci ki ge bëët ni wø tïïc wïth juurre, ni tïïcge Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni ba waany, øda cïp Wuuö Jwøki kur keere yi Jerucalem.
english: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the Lord which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcge, dwøl mare jääŋŋe jääŋŋö baŋge cooth ki dhøk nyïïkuk moe, kiper pänh cwïny mare kiper jiye ki kar bëëtö mare.
english: And the Lord God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

anywaa: 'Ba ge poot bëëdö ni ge buua nyïïkuk Jwøk ni luup Jwøk ege taaø, ni ge ŋeethø bäät nyïïkuk Jwøk, këël kanya ö wëëc Jwøki na ö bäätge ni tïme ni bäŋ køny mo ojoodø ki man døø paaci kare.
english: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the Lord arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk nyeya mar jø Kaldia ma Nabukedenecör atïŋ maal bäät jø Juuda, ni ŋøør obwöre moge moa näk wøpe ko opëëlle këël mana këët baŋ moa en yi Øt Jwøk marge na en kur keere; ni cwïnye ba pädhi kiper dhaanhø, nee ena nyilaar dïcwøø wala ena nyakøø, nee ena dhaanhø mo onø jalø wala tuu; 'ba gena cïp Wuuö Jwøki bëët cer nyeny Kaldia.
english: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldeans, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

anywaa: Ni ö jammi bëët mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jammi moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, ki jammi moa perge leth mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki jammi moa perge leth mo nyeya ki jø kööre moe, ni käli ya nyenynyøgø bëët ni kïth ge Babiløn.
english: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the Lord, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

anywaa: Køøre Øt Jwøk awaaŋge, ni nyaage kiir Jerucalem piny, ni ö uudi bëët mo Jerucalem moa no ogeerø ni teek ni waaŋge ge ki maac, ni raanyge jammi bëët moa perge leth na en yi Jerucalem.
english: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa bøth ki thøø dho opëëllö amak nyenynyøgø ki tøŋ ni kïth ge Babiløn, ni putge bëëte ni gena laaŋe mo nyenynyøgø ki wääte këël kanya täk buc nyeci mar jø Parca.
english: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

anywaa: Gïnögø atägö ni wëëga luum Wuuö Jwøk thur kare mana caane ki dhi Jeremaya, këël mana ö ŋöömö ni mïn yie ki yïth cwiic jwöm moe. Kiper cwiic ränynyö moe moa näk pïërabïriiø acäŋ beetø na mo jwöm.
english: To fulfil the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana beet Kiröci nyeny Parca yi Babiløn, Wuuö Jwøk, kiper nee luubö mana caane ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya thur kare, eni yi Kiröc nyeny Parca atheŋe nee jääk dï paac mare bäre ki dwøl, ni dwøl manøgø thuwø, ogöör piny na ennønø:
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye dwør Kiröc nyeny Parca, ena köö, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal, mïëri moa en bäät piny bëët anø cïbe jïra, ni nø tïïc aani nee eni gëënna ki øtø yi Jerucalem na en Juuda. 'Ba ennø, ŋat ma dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk mo ena dïïu kaagø, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki Jwøk mare ni bëëde ki eni, ni ö eni ni ci Jerucalem.› »
english: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the Lord God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The Lord his God be with him, and let him go up.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana beet Kiröci nyeny Parca yi Babiløn, Wuuö Jwøk kiper nee luubö mana caane ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya thur kare, eni yi Kiröc nyeny Parca atheŋe, nee jääk dï paac mare bäre ki dwøl, ni dwøl manøgø thuwø, ogöör piny na ennønø:
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye dwør Kiröc nyeny Parca, ena köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal, mïëri moa en bäät piny bëët anø cïbe jïra, ni nø tïïc aani nee eni gëënna ki øtø yi Jerucalem, na en  Juuda.
english: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋat ma dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk mo ena dïïu kaagø, beerra man ö Jwøki mare ni bëëde ki eni, ni ö eni ni ci Jerucalem na en Juuda, ni cäŋ Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, geerrø, eni na Jwøk ni wø bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo en dhaanh Wuuö Jwøki yie jaak, beerra man ö jø kaace ni kønyge eni ki warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki jammi, ki lääc paac; ni mëëtge bäät japøgø ki muuce møøk mo cïpge ka met ec kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni en Jerucalem.› »
english: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo tuuŋ Juuda ki mo tuuŋ Benjamen, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ge na yïthge theŋ Jwøki nee cige nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni en Jerucalem cäŋge geerrø, rege ajiiŋge kiper wääth.
english: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa enge buutge ni kønyge geni ki warkey, ki gïï mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, ki teeŋ jammi møøk, ki dhäk, ki jammi mo perge leth; ni cïpge thuwø ki muuce møøk mo cïp ka met ec.
english: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

anywaa: 'Ba Kiröc nyeny Parca jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, moa twier Nabukedenecörri Jerucalem na kïth yi øt juu moe, akäl wøk.
english: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moøgø käl wøk ni jääŋŋa Mithiredat, ŋat wø kan jammi; ni ö Mithiredati ni kwaan geni jï Cëëcabacar ŋat ma wïth jø Juuda.
english: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba japøgø ki kwäänge beege ii: Athääe ma pïëradäk mo tïïc ka warkey; ka athääe ma kuma aciel mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö; ki teeŋ athääe møøk mo kwäänge pïërariiø ka abïŋween;
english: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

anywaa: ki kuure ma pïëradäk mo tïïc ka warkey; ki teeŋ kuure møøk ma dïpe aŋween ka apaar mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö; ki teeŋ jammi møøk mo kwäänge kuma aciel.
english: Thirty basins of gold, silver basins of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moa näk tïïc ka warkey ki gwel-bïrö, kwäänge beege kume abïïc ki dïpe aŋween. 'Ba Cëëcabacar japøgø bëët akäle ki Babiløn ni kïth ge Jerucalem, ni eni aay ka jiy moa näk geno maaø ki tøŋ ki gø na aciel.
english: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege jø Juuda moa duuö ki Babiløn, na duu Jerucalem ki mïëc Juuda møga, ni ŋati man nø duua yi pääny poge. Ni jøøgø beege thäk jiy moa no omaaø ki tøŋ na bëëdö na wëëlle Babiløn, ni beege jøøa mak Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn ni kïth geni Babiløn.
english: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

anywaa: Ni jøøgø ge cäädhi ka dïbwöthe moge, ni beege Dherubabel, ki Jøcua, ki Neemiya, ki Ceraya, ki Rilaya, ki Mördekay, ki Bilcan, ki Mïcpar, ki Bigway, ki Reum, ki Baanaa. 'Ba moi beege kwään cwøw mo jø Icriel moa öge ki ge:
english: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Paröc beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpa aciel ki pïërabïriiø ka ariiø;
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Cepathiya beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïriiø ka ariiø;
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Araa beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïriiø ka abïïc;
english: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Paath-Möap na käl ri Jëcua ki Jöap beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpe abära ka apaar kurriiø;
english: The children of Pahath–moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Ilam beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc ka aŋween;
english: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Dhatu beege jiy ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc;
english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Dhakay beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïciel;
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Bani beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïëraŋween ka ariiø;
english: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Bëbay beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërariiø ka adäk;
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Adhigad beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërariiø ka ariiø;
english: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Adönikam beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïciel ka abïciel;
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Bigway beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki pïërabïïc ka abïciel;
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Adin beege jiy ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc ka aŋween;
english: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Ather na käl ri Edhekaya beege jiy ma pïërabïŋween ka abära;
english: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Bëdhay beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø ka adäk;
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Jöra beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ka apaar kurriiø;
english: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Acum beege jiy ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërariiø ka adäk;
english: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Gibar beege jiy ma pïërabïŋween ka abïïc;
english: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

anywaa: jø Bethelem beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka adäk;
english: The children of Beth–lehem, an hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: jø Nethöpa beege jiy ma pïërabïïc ka abïciel;
english: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

anywaa: jø Anathöth beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka abära;
english: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: jø Adhemawët beege jiy ma pïëraŋween ka ariiø;
english: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

anywaa: jø Kiriat-Jeerim, ki jø Keepira, ki jø Bëëröth beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëraŋween ka adäk;
english: The children of Kirjath–arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

anywaa: jø Reema ki jø Gëba beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërariiø ka aciel;
english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

anywaa: jø Mikmac beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka ariiø;
english: The men of Michmash, an hundred twenty and two.

anywaa: jø Bëthël ki jø Gaay beege jiy ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërariiø ka adäk;
english: The men of Beth–el and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: jø Nebø beege jiy ma pïërabïïc ka ariiø;
english: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Magbic beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabïïc ka abïciel;
english: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Ilam maya beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc ka aŋween;
english: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Arim beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø;
english: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

anywaa: jø Löt, ki jø Adid, ki jø Onö beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërariiø ka abïïc;
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.

anywaa: jø Jerikö beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc;
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

anywaa: jø Cënaa beege jiy ma kume adäk ki dïpe abïciel ki pïëradäk.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.

anywaa: Moi beege kwään dïlämme moa duuö: Nyïïkwaac Jidaya na käl Jëcua dëëre beege jiy ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïriiø ka adäk;
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Imër beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki pïërabïïc ka ariiø;
english: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Pacuur beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka abïriiø;
english: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

anywaa: nyïïkwaac Arim beege jiy ma kuma aciel ka apaar ka abïriiø.
english: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

anywaa: Moi beege kwään cwøw mo jø tuuŋ Libay moa duuö: Nyïïkwaac Jëcua na käl dhi øt Kadmiël, Kadmiël na käl røk nyïïkwaac Odawïya, beege jiy ma pïërabïriiø ka aŋween;
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

anywaa: jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ni beege nyïïkwaac Acaap, beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka abära;
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ni beege nyïïkwaac Calum, ki nyïïkwaac Ather, ki nyïïkwaac Thalmön, ki nyïïkwaac Akup, ki nyïïkwaac Athitha, ki nyïïkwaac Cöbay, kwäänge bëët beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïëradäk ka abïŋween.
english: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa duuö mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk beege: Nyïïkwaac Dhia, ki nyïïkwaac Acupa, ki nyïïkwaac Thabaøt,
english: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Këröc, ki nyïïkwaac Ciya, ki nyïïkwaac Padön,
english: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Lebana, ki nyïïkwaac Agaba, ki nyïïkwaac Akup,
english: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Agap, ki nyïïkwaac Calmay, ki nyïïkwaac Anan,
english: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Gidël, ki nyïïkwaac Gaar, ki nyïïkwaac Reaya,
english: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Recin, ki nyïïkwaac Neköda, ki nyïïkwaac Gadham,
english: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Udha, ki nyïïkwaac Pacëa, ki nyïïkwaac Bëcay,
english: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Acena, ki nyïïkwaac Meunim, ki nyïïkwaac Nepicim,
english: The children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephusim,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Bakbuk, ki nyïïkwaac Akupa, ki nyïïkwaac Aruur,
english: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Bathlut, ki nyïïkwaac Meida, ki nyïïkwaac Arca,
english: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Barköc, ki nyïïkwaac Cicara, ki nyïïkwaac Tëma,
english: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Nedhiya, ki nyïïkwaac Athipa.
english: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa duuö mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk, ni beege jøøa cwøl ni laak Cølöman, beege: nyïïkwaac Cöthay, ki nyïïkwaac Acöpërët, ki nyïïkwaac Përuda,
english: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Jaala, ki nyïïkwaac Darkön, ki nyïïkwaac Gidël,
english: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Cepathiya, ki nyïïkwaac Athil, ki nyïïkwaac Pökëret-Adhëbaym, ki nyïïkwaac Ami.
english: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy mo wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk bëët ki kwään nyïïkwaac laak Cølöman beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïŋween ka ariiø.
english: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy maa öö ki yïth mïëc Babiløn moa cøøri ni Tël-Mëla, ki Tël-Arca, ki Kerup, ka Adan ki Imër. 'Ba kär løny jïge ki man caange wïth tuŋi moge wala dhøk uudi moge man näk mo gena jø Icriel;
english: And these were they which went up from Tel–melah, Tel–harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

anywaa: ni jøøgø beege nyïïkwaac Delaya ki nyïïkwaac Thöbiya, ki nyïïkwaac Neköda; ni kwäänge beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc ka ariiø.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø tuuŋ dïlämme mo omänö ki tïïc mar dïlämme, ni beege nyïïkwaac Abaya, ki nyïïkwaac Aködh, ki nyïïkwaac Bardhilay. Bardhilay manøgø beeye na nywøm nyi Bardhilay nyï Gelät, ni put nyeŋŋe caa ri nyeŋ wää cïïe ma Bardhilay.
english: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø nyeŋ kwäcge amanyge yi wëël nyeŋ, 'ba kiper mana näk mo kär joodø, gena kwaan kaamar jiy mo ba en ri tuuŋ dïlämme, ni män geni ki tïïc mar dïlämme.
english: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

anywaa: Køøre kwäärö mar paac aköö jïge ni ge ba løny ki man cämge ki cam man wø en kur keere wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk  këël kanyo dee dïlämi mo luup ŋøle ka køør Urim ki Thumim.
english: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy moa cooŋ rege kanya ciel kanya duuge ki Babiløn beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ka ariiø ki dïpe adäk ki pïërabïciel,
english: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

anywaa: ni laaŋe moge, ma mään ki cwøw mo kwäänge kume abïriiø ki dïpe adäk ki pïëradäk  ka abïriiø, kär kwaan rege. 'Ba geni jïge da jiy mo wär ki dudi ma dïpe ariiø, ni beege cwøw ki mään.
english: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

anywaa: Ni jïge da okwëënyi ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëradäk ka abïciel, ki gääŋŋe ma dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc,
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

anywaa: ka athïrööle ma dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk ka abïïc, ka arëëni ma kume abïciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërariiø.
english: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc jøwi kanya en wï Øt Wuuö Jwøki yie Jerucalem, jø møøk røk dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi gena cïpö ki jammi ki met ec kiper Øt Jwøk nee cäŋ geer kare,
english: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the Lord which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

anywaa: ni ge cïpi ka køør mana løny jïge kiper tïïc manøgø, ni beege gwet warkey mo cwøl ni darik ma kume ma pïërabïciel ka aciel, ki gwet-bïrö mo peek marge beege rumme ma kume abïïc mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni miina, ka abïïe ma dïpa aciel mo dïlämme, ni kïthge ge kar kän.
english: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, gena pï piny yïth päänye moge; ni ö jø Icrielli møga ni pïge piny yïth päänye moge.
english: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dwää abïriiø na tääi, ni jø Icriel moøgø geno nø pï piny yïth päänye moge, geni rege acooŋge Jerucalem ni ge cii kaamar dhaanhø aciel.
english: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk ki dïlämme mo wø tïïö ki eni na aciel, ki Dherubabel o Celatiyal ki tuuŋge, gena ö maal ni tïïcge gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Jwø Icriel, kiper nee cïpge bäät gø ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, kaawat mana no ogöörö yi wëël ciik dhaanh Jwøk ma Modhe.
english: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

anywaa: Ni putge gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø cïp kar gø, ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre bäät gø jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpge ka amöölla ka abøøya, ni ge wøøra Jwøk, kiper ge lwär ki juurre moa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø.
english: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the Lord, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mana no ogöörö, geni Ajwöm Yïth Abïle awøørge, ni cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo kwäänge ŋäc ki yi cäŋ cooth ki køør ciik, ni beege moa no ocïp piny kiper yi cäŋ man nø.
english: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

anywaa: Køøre aput tïmö ni di cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre cooth, ni di cïpö thuwø kany wø päär dwääyi, ni di cïpö kiper ajwöm mo Wuuö Jwøk moa no ocaanø ni di wøørø na no onø cïp kur keerge. 'Ba ŋat mo yie met thuwø cïpö ko olämi ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the Lord that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the Lord.
