anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar dwää abïriiø, geni gena tägö ki man cïpge ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba kar kaagø, tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk poot kär tääö ki caam ki kïte.
english: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the Lord. But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.

anywaa: Køøre gena cïpö ki gwel jï jø wø ŋäc geer ki kïte, ki jï dïjëëth opämi; ni cïpge ki cam, ki jap wø maath, ki maaw jï jø Caydan ki jï jø Tayar, kiper nee ge känge ki jenni moa perge leth ki yi lur Libaanø ni kälge geni Jøpa ki yi naama dwøŋ, ki køør mana ö Kiröci nyeny Parca ni cïp gø jïge ni ŋutge ki jen.
english: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri mana öge kanya en wï Øt Jwøki yie yi Jerucalem, ri dwää ariiø, Dherubabel o Celatiyal ki Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk, ki jø poge møga, ni beege dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jiy bëët moa mak ki tøŋ na duu Jerucalem, gena tägö ki man tïïcge Øt Jwøk; ni kwany jø tuuŋ Libay ni gena jø raŋ tïï Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki mana täge ki ŋat mo cwiiye pïërariiø këël kunece.
english: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Jøcua ki wääte ki tuuŋge, ki Kadmiël ki wääte, ni beege nyïïkwaac Odawïya, gena dwätö na aciel nee tïï øt Jwøk en ceŋge. 'Ba ge  tïïö ka jø tuuŋ Libay moa käl ri dhi øt Ënadat.
english: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø geerri na thöörge tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki caam ki kïte, dïlämme gena cuŋŋö na abïïe moge ena dëëtge ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi, ni ö nyïïkwaac Acaap na käl ri jø tuuŋ Libay ni tuuŋge athiliiŋŋi, ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki køør dwøl mana caan Deebiti nyeny Icriel.
english: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the Lord, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the Lord, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

anywaa: Ni wärge ki dudi, ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge dwøga met ec jïre, ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö bäät jø Icriel na bäre bäre.» Ni ö jiyi bëët ni kwöŋge ni döötge ena maal døc kanya pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk kiper mana ö tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk na thume ki caam ki kïte.
english: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the Lord; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the Lord, because the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth røk dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi, ni beege jø døøŋŋe moa näk Øt Jwøk mana dïkwøŋ ege joodø, gena jwöŋö døc ni döötge ena maal kanya jootge tier Øt Jwøk no othum ki caam; 'ba jiy møga gena kwöŋŋö ki met ec.
english: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo oløny jïre ki man ŋec dööt jiy moa kwöŋŋö ki met ec ki dööt jiy moa jwöŋö, kiper jiy kwöŋŋö døc, ni dööt jiy wïnyö kany mo bäär.
english: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøa män ki jø Juuda ki jø Benjamen na wïnyge gø ni jø Juuda ki jø Benjamen, moa no omaa ki tøŋ na duuö, ge gëëdö ki øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel,
english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the Lord God of Israel;

anywaa: gena ö baŋ Dherubabel ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi ni köge, ni «Beerra man gëëdø ki uuni na aciel, kiper waani, wa manynya Jwøk maru ni wa caala uuni; ni wa bëëdö ni wa cïpö ko olämme jïre ki mana täge ki ri nïne moa beet Ëcaradön nyeny jø Aciria na käl waani kany.»
english: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar–haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

anywaa: 'Ba Dherubabel, ki Jøcua, ki dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel gena köö jïge, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo ø rööpa ree ki uuni ki gø ri geer øtø jï Jwøk marwa; 'ba wa ki dëëtwa keerwa wa gëëdö ki øtø jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, kaawat mana ö Kiröci nyeny Parca na nø kööm waani.»
english: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the Lord God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

anywaa: Køøre juurre moa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø cwïny jø Juuda araanyge, ni tïïcge geni nee lwäcge ki man geerge øtø,
english: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

anywaa: ni cïpge ki gwel ki piny jï jø wø cïpi ka acaara jï kwäärö kiper nee acaac thöör tïï Øt Jwøk mar jø Juuda ba thur kare, ni gïnögø wø bëëdö ni tïïcge tïïö cooth ki mana täge ki ri nïne bëët moa beet Kiröci ni ena nyeny jø Parca, këël mana pïïe ri rööny mar Dariöc nyeny Parca.
english: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ayacewëëröc na røønyi na nyeya, kanya täge ki tïïc ennø, da jiy maa göön baŋe ki wëël løøk kiper jø Juuth moa bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre.
english: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri nïr Arthëkcic nyeny Parca, Biclam, ki Mithiredat, ki Thabël, ki jø wø tïïge ki geni na aciel, gena göön baŋ Arthëkcic ki wëëlö, ni wëëlö manøgø göör ka dha Aram ni kwaan ni cäŋ ka løgø.
english: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mo cwøl ni Reum mo jïre da köör, ki Cimcay, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, gena göödö thuwø ki wëëlö bäät jø Jerucalem jï nyeya ma Arthëkcic ma ennønø:
english: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

anywaa: «Wëëlö man gööra aani, a na kwäärö ma Reum, ki Cimcay ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki jø wø tïïwa ki geni na aciel, ni beege dïŋut luup, ki kwääri moa kwörge therø, ki jø kööre, ki jø wø gööt piny, ni beege jøøa kwøŋ bëëdö Ërëk, ki Babiløn, ki Cuca na en yi ŋööm Ilam,
english: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

anywaa: ki wïth juurre møga bëët moa käl Acnaperri,  nyenynya teek na no owøørø, wïth juuya käle ki mïëcge ni kïth ge yïth päänye mo Cameria, ki yi paac bäre mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga.»
english: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana göörge yi wëëlö mana jääŋge baŋe beeye en, gena köö, ni «Ï na nyeya ma Arthëkcic, wëëlö man käla baŋwa, wa na jiyï na en paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga.
english: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

anywaa: «Ennø, beerra man ŋäyï gø, ï na nyeya, ni jø Juuth moa öö ki baŋï kunögø gena ö baŋwa Jerucalem; ni ennø, ge cäŋa Jerucalem geerrø, päänya raac ni wø gëëmö. Ge cäŋa kiir mar gø geerrø ennø, ni ge laya gø nee thume.
english: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ŋäyï gø, ï na nyeya, ni ni näk mo pääny man ocäŋ geerrø, ni ö kiirri mare ni thume ki geer, geni ge ba cudö ka ajwäk këët, ni ö ajwäki ni ränynye, ni tïm jap akwöma ni nøk.
english: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kiper mana näk mo wa tïnynya bura marï, ni ba løny jïwa ki man jootwa nyeya no opäädö, waana jääŋ baŋï ni wa caana gø jïrï, ï na nyeya en,
english: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

anywaa: nee yïth weeli moa no ogöör kwäyï manynyi. Køøre jootï joodø yïth weeli moa no ogöörö, ni ŋäyï gø ni päänyögø beeye pääny ma pääny ageem mo räänyö ki nyeye ki mïëri, ni beeye kanya wara ö ageeme wø tuudi yie yïth nïne moa pöödhö; ni beeye tiere gø na raany pääny manøgø.
english: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.

anywaa: Ennø, wa caana gø jïrï, ï na nyeya en, nee ŋäyï ni ni näk mo pääny man ocäŋ geerrø, ni ö kiirri mare ni thume ki geer, gïno tägi, ï puta tïmö ni bäŋ kurï yi paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga.»
english: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.

anywaa: Køøre aløk nyeya ki yi wëëlö ni kööe, na «A määtha ïïni, ï na kwäärö ma Reum, u ki Cimcay ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki jø wø tïïu ki geni na aciel mo wø bëëdö Cameria ki moa en yïth mïëri møga moa en paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga.
english: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.

anywaa: «Ennø, wëëlö mana jääŋŋu baŋa anø løk ni kwaani jïra.
english: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

anywaa: Ni nø cïba dwøl nee tier luummögø manynyi, ni nø joodi ni pääny manøgø obëëdö ni gëëmö ki nyeye moa kwøŋ bëëdö yïth nïne moa pöödhö, na ageeme ki ööny maal bäät nyeye tïïca yie.
english: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.

anywaa: Ni da nyeye mo teek kar kaace mo Jerucalem obëëdö ceŋge, këël paac bäre mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga, ni bëët ajwäki ni jwäka jïge.
english: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kännu wøk ki ciik nee jøøgø tïïc wecge, nee pääny ba cäŋ geerrø këët, këël kanyo dee dwøl mo caana.
english: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.

anywaa: Putu luummi kïth bäät tïïc, nee bäŋe gïn mo raany akwöma.»
english: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö wëëlö mar nyeya ma Arthëkcic na kwaani jï Reum, ki Cimcay ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki jø wø tïïge ki geni na aciel, gena put ci Jerucalem baŋ jø Juuth, ni mänge geni ki teek mar jø leny nee pääny ba geerge.
english: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mar geer Øt Jwøk na en Jerucalem acuŋŋö, ni bëëde no ocuŋŋö këël mana pïïe ri riet cwiiri moa beet Dariöci ni ena nyeya Parca.
english: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Dhekaraya nyikwaar Idö dwør Jwøk akøpge jï jø Juuth moa en Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, ki nyeŋ Jwø Icriel na bëënge.
english: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.

anywaa: Køøre Dherubabel o Celatiyal ki Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk gena ö maal ni täkge ki man cäŋge Øt Jwøk geerrø Jerucalem; ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki moøgø ni bëëtge ni køønynya geni ka acaare.
english: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Tatenay na bëëdö na kwäärö mana dwøŋ mar paac mana cwøl  ni Løø Naam Løøga, ki Cetar-Bödhnay, ki jø wø tïïge ki geni na aciel, gena ö baŋge ni pëënyge geni, na «?Aŋa na cïpö ki dwøl jïïu ni cäŋu Øt Jwøk man geerrø ni thööru dëëre ki tïïc en?»
english: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar–bozenai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?

anywaa: Ni pëëge thuwø, ni «?Nyeŋ jiy mo geer øtø man en aŋaani?»
english: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk mar jø Juuth waŋe atïmö ni ena bäät jø døøŋŋø mo jø Juuth, ni ö jøøgø ni kärge øtø mänö ki geer këël mana jääkge baŋ Dariöc ki dwøl, nee dee wëëlö mo duuö mo cäänö kaper ødøgø.
english: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye wëëlö mana jääŋŋi baŋ nyeya ma Dariöc, ni jääŋŋa Tatenay na bëëdö na kwäärö mana dwøŋ mar paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga, ki Cetar-Bödhnay, ki jø kööre mo wø tïïge ki geni na aciel, na en paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga.
english: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar–bozenai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:

anywaa: 'Ba wëëlö mana jääŋge baŋe ogöörö na ennønø, ni «Ï na nyeya ma Dariöc, bëëdï ki bëët-mëër ki paarï bäre.
english: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.

anywaa: «Ennø, beerra man ŋäyï gø, ï na nyeya, ni waana ci Juuda kuna ciwa øt Jwøa dwøŋ, man geer en ki kïte moa døøŋŋø, ni dëër øtø tïïc ni bäät kïte di pëënhnhö ko opämi; ni tïïcge ni ege gwøø døc, ni thura kare jïge.
english: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.

anywaa: «Køøre jø døøŋŋø moøke apëënywa ni köwa jïge, na ‹?Aŋa na cïpö ki dwøl jïïu ni cäŋu Øt Jwøk man geerrø ni thööru dëëre ki tïïc en?›
english: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?

anywaa: Waani thuwø nyeŋ jøøa näk wïthge apëënywa nee göörwa piny, kiper nee caanwa jïrï.
english: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.

anywaa: «'Ba aløkge jïwa ni köge, «ni ‹Waani, waana jic Jwø maal ki piny, ni ennø, wa cäŋa Øt Jwøk geerrø mana kwøŋ geer cøøn køør cwiiri mo thööth mo opöödhö, ni beeye Øt Jwøk mana geer nyeny Icriel marwa na dwøŋ, na thööre ki geer.
english: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ö kwäcwa na tïïcge Jwø maal nee goote, eni gena cïp cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn nyï Kaldia. Køøre Nabukedenecör Øt Jwøk man araanynye ni kïth jiy Babiløn.
english: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanya tïme na cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana ö Kiröci na tïme na nyeny Babiløn yie, eni na nyeya ma Kiröc ena cïpö ki dwøl nee Øt Jwøk man cäŋ geerrø.
english: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.

anywaa: Eni thuwø jap paac moa no otïïö ki warkey ki gwelbïrö na näk mo Øt Jwøk na no 'okäl Nabukedenecörri wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Jerucalem, ni kïth ge øt jwøe Babiløn, japøgø alwør nyeya ma Kiröc øt jwø Nabukedenecör na en Babiløn, ni cïp ge jï dhaanhø mo cwøl ni Cëëcabacar mo ee røønyø na kwääc tïïc.
english: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;

anywaa: Ni caan gø jïgø, ni «Lwør japi, ni ciï ni kanï ge yi Øt Jwøk Jerucalem, ni ö Øt Jwøki ni cäŋi geer wïïe.»
english: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.

anywaa: Køøre Cëëcabacar aöö ni täk tier Øt Jwøk ki caam ki kïte yi Jerucalem; 'ba ki mana täge kar kaaca nø këël ennø, øtø bëëdö ni di geerø, ni poot kär thum ki geer en.›
english: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ni näk beeye mana manynyï, ï na nyeya, beerra man many yïth weeli kar kän marï man ni en Babiløn kaagø enø, ki man näk mo da dwøl mo ocïp nyeya ma Kiröci ni Øt Jwøk man cäŋ geerrø Jerucalem. Køøre luubö mano ŋølï kiper luubö man wär jääŋŋï baŋwa.»
english: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Dariöc acïpö ki dwøl, ni many yïth weeli kar kän mana en Babiløn.
english: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba wëël luubö manøgø aput joot kar gwøk røk yi pääny mana cwøl ni Ekbatana na en Mëdön; ni luubö mana no ogöör piny yie beeye en:
english: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:

anywaa: «Kanya tïme na cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana beet Kiröci nyeny Parca Babiløn, eni na Kiröc ena cïpö ki dwøl ni kööe, ni ‹Øt Jwøk man ni en Jerucalem en, beerra man cäŋi geerrø na kany wø cïp olämme yie; ni caam tiere ni teek, ni tïïc bär mare mar maal na gööye ma pïërabïciel, ni tïïc dööŋ yie  na gööye ma pïërabïciel.
english: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;

anywaa: Ni geer ka kïte mo døøŋŋø, ni kany wø cäämmö ki kïte ma tëëŋŋe adäk, bäät gø di pëënhnhö ko opämi. 'Ba gwel moo geer øtø ki ge tïme ni käl wøk ka ri gwet nyeya.
english: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expenses be given out of the king's house:

anywaa: Ni ö jap paac moa no otïïö ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö, na näk mo Øt Jwøk, ni dwøgi ni kïthi kwöra bëëtge yïthge Øt Jwøk Jerucalem, nee tïme ni ge bëëdö Øt Jwøk, ni beege jap paac moa no okäl Nabukedenecörri wøk ki Øt Jwøk Jerucalem, ni kïth ge Babiløn.›
english: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Tatenay en, ï na ŋat köör mana dwøŋ mar paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga, ki ï na Cetar-Bödhnay, ki jø kööre mo wø tïïu ki geni na aciel, na en paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga, tïïyu karu ni bäär ki Øt Jwøk manøgø.
english: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar–bozenai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:

anywaa: Wiiu tïï Øt Jwøk kare, nee kwääc tïïc ki jø døøŋŋø mo jø Juuth nee Øt Jwøk cäŋge geer wï gø.
english: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, dwøl man cïba kiper gïno tïïyu jï jø døøŋŋø mo jø Juuth moøgø moo cäŋ Øt Jwøk manøgø geerrø beeye en: Gwel bëët moo tïïc Øt Jwøk ki ge wär tïme ni coolla jï jø døøŋŋø moøgø, nee tïïc ba cuŋŋe, ni käl wøk ka ri gwet akwöma moa jwäk baŋ jø wø bëëdö paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga.
english: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expenses be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moo manynyi, ni beege nyïï rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïï rööm moo cïp no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Jwø maal, ki beel, ka acäbö, ki køøŋø, ki maar rööny, moo many dïlämme moa en Jerucalem, wär cïp jïge ki yïth nïne bëët ni ba kääŋi,
english: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:

anywaa: nee tïme ni ge cïpa olämme mo yi Jwø maal met ki ge, nee ge lämge kiper kwøw mara, a na nyeya, ki wääta.
english: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

anywaa: «Aani, a cäŋa dwøl man cïpö, ni ŋato kaal dwøl man, jaath cugö käla wøk ki ri øde ni cwøbi ki gø, ni tïŋi maal ni lïëri, ni nyaa øde piny ni tïïi na wïthur kiper gïna tïïe.
english: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki, eni na tïïc nyeŋŋe nee bëëde ni ŋäc kaace, ni raany ŋat ma nyeya wala wï jur mo päära gø ki man wiil dwøl man, nee Øt Jwøk manø en Jerucalem enø raanynye. «Beeye aani ni Dariöc en na cïp dwøl man. Beerra man kïthi bäät tïïc ki kare bäre.»
english: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.

anywaa: 'Ba Tatenay ŋat köör mana dwøŋ mar paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga, ki Cetar-Bödhnay, ki jø wø tïïge ki geni na aciel, dwøl mana cem nyeya ma Dariöc akïthge bäät tïïc ki kare bäre.
english: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar–bozenai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø døøŋŋø mo jø Juuth geer marge aput thur kare ki køør dwør Jwøk mana køp nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Agëë ki nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Dhekaraya nyikwaar Idö. 'Ba øtø athöörge ki geer ki køør dwør Jwø Icriel, ki dööt nyec Parca, ni beeye Kiröc ki Dariöc ki Arthëkcic.
english: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.

anywaa: 'Ba Øt Jwøk manøgø athum ki geer ni nïr dwääy adäk, ni beeye dwääna cwøl na Adar, ri bïcier cwiiri moa beet nyeya ma Dariöc bäät nyec.
english: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel, ni beege dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jiy møga moa mak ki tøŋ moa duuö, Øt Jwøk manøgø acïpge kur keere na mar Jwøk ni yïthge met.
english: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,

anywaa: 'Ba olämme moa cïpge kiper nee Øt Jwøk manøgø cïp kur keere na mar Jwøk, beege rwädhe ma dïpa, ki nyöök rööm ma dïpe ariiø, ki nyïï rööm ma dïpe aŋween. Ni cïpge ki nyöök atëëe apaar kurriiø no olämme mo wø cïp kiper raay mo jø Icriel bëët, ni kwäänge opäärö ki kwään wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre geni dïlämme apääŋge na dhøgi, ni pääŋge jø tuuŋ Libay na dhøgi kiper tïï Øt Jwøk na en Jerucalem, ki køør mana no ogöörö yi wëël Modhe.
english: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ na apaar kurŋween, jøøa mak  ki tøŋ moa duuö, cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie awøørge.
english: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.

anywaa: Kiper dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay dëëtge ege nø døøc mo waany na aciel, ni ge bëët, ge bëëdö ni ge waany. Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay nyïï dïëk mo cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie aŋaalge kiper jøøa mak ki tøŋ bëët moa duuö, kiper tuuŋge ma dïlämme, këël kiper dëëtge.
english: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moa mak ki tøŋ moa duuö, cam manøgø acamge na aciel ki jiy bëët moa løø rege baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na näk dëëtge ege käl wøk ki røk wïth juurre, jøøa dëëtge ba waany na en yi paac.
english: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the Lord God of Israel, did eat,

anywaa: Ni wøørge Ajwöma Mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø ki nïne abïriiø ni yïthge met, kiper yïthge anø døøc Wuuö Jwøki mo met, ni nø løø cwïny nyeny Aciria baŋge, nee dëëtge tïïe nee nigereem ki man tïïcge tïïe mo Øt Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør cwiiri mo thööth, kanya bëët Arthëkcic ni ena nyeny Parca, da dhaanhø mo cwøl ni Edhera, Edhera o Ceraya, Ceraya wär Adhariya, Adhariya o Kilkiya,
english: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

anywaa: Kilkiya o Calum, Calum o Dhadök, Dhadök wär Akitöp,
english: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

anywaa: Akithöp wär Amariya, Amariya wär Adhariya, Adhariya nyikwaar Merayöt,
english: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

anywaa: Merayöt o Dheraya, Dheraya wär Udhi, Udhi o Buki,
english: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

anywaa: Buki wär Abicua, Abicua o Piniac, Piniac wär Eliedhar, Eliedhar wär Aran, ni bee eni na dïlämi mana dïkwøŋ na dwøŋ.
english: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

anywaa: Edhera manøgø atïŋŋö Babiløn ni cøøa Jerucalem. Eni, ena dïpööy, mo ciik Modhe na cïp Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, ee kwanyø døc. Køøre nyeya jammi moa many Edhera bëët acïbe jïre, kiper Edhera cer Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, ena bääte.
english: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the Lord God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the Lord his God upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk røk jø Icriel, ki dïlämme møøk, ki jø dhi øt Libay møøk, ki jø møøk røk jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø møøk røk jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki jø møøk røk jø wø tïïc tïïe moa therø Øt Jwøk, gena ci Jerucalem ki Edhera na aciel kanya tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri moa beet Arthëkcic ni ena nyeya.
english: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

anywaa: Køøre Edhera apïï Jerucalem ri bïï dwäde, kanya tïme na bïriet cwiiri moa beet Arthëkcic ni ena nyeya.
english: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

anywaa: Kiper ena tïŋŋö Babiløn ni nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ aciel, ni pïïe Jerucalem ni nïr dwää abïïc aciel, kiper cer Jwøk mare na beer ena bääte.
english: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

anywaa: Kiper Edhera cwïnye ee nø cïp køør ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk nee kwanye nee kïth bäät tïïc, nee ciik Wuuö Jwøk ki luup ŋøl moe nee pööe ki ge dï Icriel.
english: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the Lord, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mar nyeya ma Arthëkcic mana gööre na cïbe jï dïlämi ma Edhera, ni beeye dïpööy mana näk ciik Wuuö Jwøk ki gïïa ceme na cïbe jï jø Icriel ee kwanyø døc. Ena köö,
english: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the Lord, and of his statutes to Israel.

anywaa: ni «A na nyeya ma Arthëkcic, a na wïth nyeye bëët, a göönna baŋï, ï na dïlämi ma Edhera, ï na dïpööy mar ciik Jwø maal; bëëdï ki bëëtmëër ma kare.
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, aana kän wøk ki dwøl, nee jø Icriel ki dïlämme moge ki jø tuuŋ Libay moa en paara mo yïthge met ki man cige Jerucalem, nee aacge ki ïïni.
english: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.

anywaa: Aani ki jiy moi na abïriiø ii ni wø køny aani ka acaara, ï jääŋwa kaper nee bëët jiy moa en Jerucalem ki moa en dï Juuda bäre neenï ki køør ciik mo Jwøk marï, moø en cerï yøø,
english: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;

anywaa: nee warkey ki gwel-bïrö kälï, mana cïba ki met ec, wa ki jø wø køny aani ka acaara, jï Jwø Icriel ni wø bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

anywaa: Ni kälï warkie ki gwet-bïrö bëët moo jootï yïth mïëri mo jø Babiløn, ki muuce moa cïp jiyi ki dïlämme ki met ec marge, na cïpge ni yïthge met kiper øt Jwøge ni en Jerucalem.
english: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:

anywaa: 'Ba gwel moøgø, ni beege warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ŋeewï ŋeeø na kare ki  rwädhe, ki nyöök rööm, ki nyïï rööm, ki beel ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wø cïp na aciel ki lääy moøgø; ni cïpï geni bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Øt Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ni en Jerucalem.
english: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni gïno beer ki jïrï ki jï nyïïmëëgu ma jø Juuth wär tïïyï ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö mano dööŋ, ni tïïyï ka køør mano many Jwøki maru.
english: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

anywaa: Ni ö jap paaci moa cïp jïïu kiper tïïc mar Øt Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni kälu ge yi øtø bëët nyïme, eni na Jwø Jerucalem.
english: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni jammi moo dööŋ noo manynyi kiper Øt Jwøk, Jwøk marï, wär käl wøk ki røk gwet akwöma.
english: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, a na nyeya ma Arthëkcic en, dwøl man cïba jï jø wø kan gwel moa bëëdö paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga beeye en: Uuni, gïno many dïlämi ma Edhera baŋu, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwø maal, wär cïp jïre na kare,
english: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

anywaa: ni beege gwel-bïrö mo peek mare pïï ri rumme ma dïpa mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kikar,  ki beel mo pïï ri rumme ma dïpa mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni kör, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo pïï ri rumme ma dïpa mo røm ka rumi mana cwøl ni baath, ki maaw mo pïï ri rumme ma dïpa mo røm ka rumi manøgø, ka acäbö mano manynyi jaak.
english: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

anywaa: Ni gïn wø caan Jwø maalli jaak kiper Øt Jwøk, wär put tïïc ni cwïny owëëk eni, kiper nee wëëc Jwøk ba pïïe bäät paac mara bäre, ki ri wääta, a na nyeya.
english: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

anywaa: Waani thuwø wa caana gø jïïu ni kär dee ajwäk mo di cwølø bäät dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø tïïö Øt Jwøk, ki jø tïïc møøk mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk.
english: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Edhera en, ki køør leec wïc manø ni en baŋï enø, na cïp Jwøki marï jïrï, kwänyï ki jiy mo käär paac, ki dïŋut luup, kiper nee luup jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga ŋølge, ni beege jiy bëët moa ŋäc ciik mo Jwøk marï. 'Ba jø wø kuc ciik moøgø wär pwönynyï.
english: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato ba gwøk ciik mo Jwøk marï, ki ciik 'moa, a na nyeya, eni di jäälö ka ajäla ma kare, nee ŋøla thøø bääte, wala eni di riemmø paac, wala jape di camø, wala eni di twöö.»
english: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhera aköö, ni «Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäcwa, na cïp luummögø cwïny nyeya, nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni en Jerucalem jïte ka ajiem,
english: Blessed be the Lord God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem:

anywaa: ni ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk na meet mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl ni päl bääta nyïm nyeya ki nyïm jø wø køny nyeya ka acaara, ki nyïm jø kööre moe moa teek. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, aana mooe ki teek ni bëët cere ni ena bääta; ni cooŋa dïbwöthe røk jø Icriel nee aacge ki aani.»
english: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the Lord my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege nyeŋ dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi, ki nyeŋ kwäcge moa kälge dëëtge, jøøa tïŋŋö Babiløn ni ge cäädhi ka aani na aciel, a na Edhera, ri nïne moa beet Arthëkcic ni ena nyeya.
english: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

anywaa: Ki ri nyïïkwaac Piniac, beeye Gërcöm; ki ri nyïïkwaac Itamer, beeye Daniel; ki ri nyïïkwaac nyeya ma Deebit, beeye Atuc nyikwaar Cekaniya;
english: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Paröc, beeye Dhekaraya ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpa ki pïërabïïc mo nyeŋge ogöör piny;
english: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Parosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Paath-Möap, beeye Eliyönay o Dheraya ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpe ariiø;
english: Of the sons of Pahath–moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Dhatu, beeye Cekaniya o Jadhiël ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpe adäk;
english: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Adin, beeye Ebet o Jönathan ki jiye ma cwøw ma pïërabïïc;
english: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Ilam, beeye Jicaya wär Athaliya ki jiye ma cwøw ma pïërabïriiø;
english: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Cepathiya, beeye Dhebadiya o Mikaël ki jiye ma cwøw ma pïërabära;
english: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Jöap, beeye Øbadiya o Jikiël ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpe ariiø ka apaar ka abära;
english: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Bani, beeye Cëlömith o Jöcipiya ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpa ki pïërabïciel;
english: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Bëbay, beeye Dhekaraya o Bëbay ki jiye ma cwøw ma pïërariiø ka abära;
english: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Adhigad, beeye Jöanan wär Akathan ki jiye ma cwøw ma dïpa ka apaar;
english: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

anywaa: ki ri nyïïkwaac Adönikam, beege Elipelet, ki Juël, ki Cemaya, ki jicge ma cwøw ma pïërabïciel. 'Ba jøøgø beege nyïïkwaac Adönikam moa öö na aŋuudi.
english: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

anywaa: Ki ri nyïïkwaac Bigway, beege Uthay ki Dhakur, ki jicge ma cwøw ma pïërabïriiø.
english: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Edhera, jøøgø acooŋa kanya ciel bäät naama näk kwöta kanya cwøl na Awaa, ni bëëtwa kaace ki nïne adäk. 'Ba kanya raŋŋa dëët jøøgø døøc ki dëët dïlämme, bäŋ jø tuuŋ Libay mo yaa joodø kaace.
english: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

anywaa: Køøre aana jääk baŋ dïbwöthe, ni beege Eliëdher, ka Ariël, ki Cemaya, ki Elnathan, ki Jarip, ki Elnathan, ki Nathan, ki Dhekaraya, ki Meculam; ki baŋ dïpööye moa wïthge leer, ni beege Jöyarip ki Elnathan.
english: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

anywaa: Ni jääŋŋa geni baŋ Idö dïbwödhi mana bëëdö kanya cwøl ni Kacipiya; ni caana gïno caange jï Idö ki tuuŋge ki jiy mo otïïc tïïe moa therø Øt Jwøk ni wø bëëdö Kacipiya, kiper nee känge baŋwa ki jø tïïc moo tïïö Øt Jwøk, Jwøk marwa.
english: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana bëët cer Jwøki marwa na beer bäätwa, jøøgø akän baŋwa ki dhaanhø mo wïïe leer mo cwøl ni Cërëbiya, mo käla ri nyïïkwaac Maali nyikwaar Libay wär Icriel, ni eni ööi ka wääte ki tuuŋge, ni kwäänge bëët beege jiy apaar ka abära.
english: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

anywaa: Geni thuwø Acabiya ki Jicaya mo käla ri nyïïkwaac Mërari akälge ki tuuŋge ki wäätge, ni kwäänge bëët beege jiy ma pïërariiø;
english: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

anywaa: ki jiy ma dïpe ariiø ki pïërariiø moo tïïc tïïe moa therø Øt Jwøk, jøøa kwäcge kwany Deebiti ki jø kööre moe nee jø tuuŋ Libay kønyge ki tïïc, ni jøøgø bëët nyeŋge ogöör piny.
english: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kanya enwa bäät naam Awaa, aana cïpö ki dwøl kiper nee jøw ba cämge, nee rewa dwøkwa piny nyïm Jwøk marwa ni wa kwaya eni kiper nee waani ko obwöre mowa ki jammi mowa bëët gwøe waŋjöö.
english: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

anywaa: Kiper aani wïïa laay ki man kwaa nyeya nee cïpe ki dëëci ki jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi nee wa gwøkge øtjöö cer nyïïmän, kiper waano nø köö jï nyeya, ni «Cer Jwøk marwa ena bäät jiy bëët mo wø many eni; 'ba teek mare ki wëër mare nyoodhe nyoodhø bäät jiy bëët mo wø wec eni.»
english: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø waana bëëdö ni wa kär cämö ni wa kwaaya Jwøk marwa kiper luummögø, ni ö eni ni wïny kwac marwa.
english: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was entreated of us.

anywaa: Køøre aani, jiy apaar kurriiø røk dïlämme moa kwörge døøŋŋø acïba kur keere, ni beege Cërëbiya ka Acabiya ki  jiy apaar ma tuuŋge.
english: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

anywaa: Ni røma warkey ki gwel-bïrö ki jap paac jïge, ni beege muuce moa cïp nyeya, ki jø wø køny eni ka acaara, ki jø kööre moe, ki jø Icriel bëët moa en kaace kiper tïï Øt Jwøk.
english: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:

anywaa: Ni peek gwel-bïrö mana røma jïge beeye rumme ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc, ni peek jap paac moa näk tïïc ka gwel-bïrö beeye rumme ma dïpa, ni peek warkey beeye rumme ma dïpa,
english: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;

anywaa: ki kuure ma pïërariiø mo tïïc ka warkey mo kar gwel ma kuma, ki jap paac ariiø mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël mo tøŋ mo paŋŋi, mo pere leth ni caala warkey.
english: Also twenty basins of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö jïge, ni «Uuni, uuna cïp kur keeru jï Wuuö Jwøk, këël jap paac moi thuwø. Ni warkie ki gwetbïrö moi thuwø beege muuce moa cïp ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäyu.
english: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the Lord; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the Lord God of your fathers.

anywaa: Uuni, raŋŋu geni døøc, ni gwøgu geni këël kanyo pïïyu Jerucalem nou rømmu geni nyïm dïlämme moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki nyïm jø tuuŋ Libay, ki nyïm dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel yïth uudi moa therø moa no orep dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay warkey ki gwel-bïrö ki jap paac moa røm jïge alwørge nee kïthge Jerucalem yi øt Jwøk, Jwøk marwa.
english: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää acielli na apaar kurriiø, waana tïŋŋö bäät Naam Awaa, ni wa døøa Jerucalem. 'Ba cer Jwøk marwa ena bäätwa, ni ö eni ni piem waani cer nyïïmän ki ceŋ jø wø møør piny øtjöö.
english: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcwa Jerucalem, rewa ajwömwa ki nïne adäk.
english: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweer nïne, warkie ki gwet-bïrö ki jap paac arøm yi Øt Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ni cïbi cer dïlämi ma Merëmöt wär Uria, ni Eliedhar o Piniac nutö buute, ni jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege Jödhabat o Jëcua, ki Nöadiya o Binuy nutö buutge thuwø.
english: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

anywaa: Ni ö jammi moøgø bëët ni kwaani ni rømi, ni put peek moge göör piny.
english: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

anywaa: Kar kaagø, jø Juuth moa duuö ki Babiløn, na mak ki tøŋ, gena cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Jwøge na näk Jwø Icriel, ni beege rwädhe apaar kurriiø kiper jø Icriel bëët, ki nyöök rööm ma pïërabïŋween ka abïciel, ki nyïï rööm ma pïërabïriiø ka abïriiø, ni cïpge ki nyöök atëëe apaar kurriiø ni beege olämme mo wø cïp kiper raay, ni moøgø bëët cïpa jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø dwør nyeya mana no ogöör piny acïpge jï kwääri moa bëën nyeya, ki jï jøøa en tiet kwääri moøgø ni wø käär mïëri moa en paac mana cwøl ni Løø Naam Løøga; ni ö kwääri moøgø ni kønyge jiy ki tïï Øt Jwøk.
english: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïïögø bëët, dïbwöthe mo jø Icriel aö baŋa ni köge, ni «Jø Icriel, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, dëëtge kärge pääŋŋö ki juurre moa bëëdö yi ŋöömmi, mo wø tem gïïa näk ec raac ki ge, ni beege jø Keenan, ki jø Këth, ki jø Përec, ki jø Jeebuc, ki jø Amön, ki jø Möap, ki jø Ijep, ki jø Amör.
english: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

anywaa: Kiper geni, nyïï juurre møøk akälge ni nywømge ge na mään jïge ki jï wäätge, ni ö kunhnhö marge na en kur keere na mar Jwøk ni put ree jääp ki kunhnhö mar juurre. 'Ba beege dïbwöthe ki jø kööre na no opöödhö ki tïïc manøgø ni raac enø.»
english: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynya gïnögø, aani abïïna ka aleeŋŋa mara ajeeya, ni ö jïëc wïïa ki jïëc tïïa ni nywaada ge piny, ni pïïa piny ni yia othäŋŋö.
english: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonished.

anywaa: 'Ba aana bëëdö ni aano pï piny ni yia othäŋŋö këël kanya tïme na kany wø cïp olämi mar abøøya yie. Ni ö jiyi møøk ni cooŋge rege buuta, ni beege jøøa dëëtge tïmö ni kwanynyi ki luubö mana caan Jwøki marwa, eni na Jwø Icriel, kanya jootge gïna raac na tïïc nyïïkwaac jøøa mak ki tøŋ na kwøŋ duuö.
english: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonished until the evening sacrifice.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kany wø cïp olämi mar abøøya yie, aana ö maal ki kanya bëëda yie ni cwïnya opädhö, na abïï mara ka aleeŋŋa mara na jeeya poot ena dëëra, ni këëlla cøŋŋa piny ni thaaŋa ceŋŋa maal baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara,
english: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the Lord my God,

anywaa: ni kööa, «Wui Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, aani wïïa laay ki man tïŋa wïïa maal baŋï, ï na Jwøk mara, kiper gïïa bacwa atïmö ni thööth ni kaala wïthwa, ni ö raayi mowa ni thöönhge no okëët maal.
english: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.

anywaa: Ki mana täge ki røk nïra beet kwäcwa këël dïcäŋi en, wa bëëdö ni wa tïïö ki raay mo døøŋŋø, 'ba ki køør raay mowa, waani ki nyeye mowa ki dïlämme mowa, waana cïp ceŋ nyeye mo wïth juurre, ni ŋar waani, ni mak waani ki tøŋ, ni twier waani, ni tïm wïthwa ni laay këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ki kany mo thiinh, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, mëër marï anyoothï, ni weyï waani na mo dööŋ ni kwøw, ni këëllï tietwa piny ki køør øtø marï man ni en kur keere en, nee ï na Jwøk marwa, dëëtwa tïïyï nee nigethïk, ni mooyï waani ki nyi kwøw mo thiinh yi laŋ man bëëtwa yie en.
english: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the Lord our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

anywaa: Kiper waana laaŋe; 'ba këël na bëëtwa yi laŋ, ï na Jwøk marwa, wa kärï wiiø. Mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl anyoothï jïwa ni nëënö jï nyec Parca, ni cäŋï wa mooyø ki kwøw mo nyään, nee øtø marï, ï na Jwøk marwa, cäŋwa geerrø ni dwøkwa kwöra no oränynyö karge, ni mooyï wa ki kany bëëtwa yie ni waano gwøø, ni beeye Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre.
english: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

anywaa: «?'Ba ennø, ï na Jwøk marwa en, agïnaŋø noo caanwa køør gïn? Kiper waani ciik moï awecwa,
english: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,

anywaa: ni beege ciik moa caanï ki dhøk jiyï ma nyïïkuk Jwøk na köge, ni ‹Ŋöömmögø ni dønynyu yie enø noo lwørru na maru, beeye ŋöömö mo ba waany, mo oraany juurre moa bëëdö yie ki køør gïïa reyø na raac eci ki ge na temge, na pääŋge yi ŋöömö ki ge bäre, ki bëëtö marge na raac.
english: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, kär nyïïu cïpu jï wäätge nee nywømge, ni ba källu nyïïge nee nywømmu jï wäätu, ni ba cädu kiperge ki man jïtge ki bëëtö mo beer ki bëët kwär. Køøre uuno bëëdö nou teek nou cama caammi mo beyø moo jootu yi ŋöömmögø, ni weyu gø jï jøw käl dëëtu na man bëëtge yie na bäre bäre.›
english: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba gïïa ö bäätwa bëët ö bäätwa kaper gïïa reyø na temwa, ki raay mowa na døøŋŋø. 'Ba ï na Jwøk marwa, gïïa leth na jäälï wa ki ge ba rømi ki gïïa reyø na temwa; 'ba waana gwøgï, ni weyï waani na mo dööŋ ni kwøw kaawat man bëëde en.
english: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;

anywaa: ?A ennø, ciik moï cäŋwa ka kaallø, ni nywømwa dëëtwa ki juurre moøgø ni wø tïïö ki gïïögø ni raac eci ki ge yøø? ?A ïïni, ï ba wëër ki waani ni raanynyï wa këël mano tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dööŋ wala mo bøth?
english: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ïïni, ï beer; kiper waani, waana wec na mo dööŋ ni kwøw, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en. Ennø, raay mowa ena nyïmï; ni bäŋ dhaanhø rewa mo maar cuŋŋö nyïmï ki køør raay mowa.»
english: O Lord God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Edhera ni poot lämö ni eni køpa raay, ni eni jwöŋö ni dëëre ee leeŋ piny nyïm Øt Jwøk, jiy mo thööth, ni beege cwøw ki mään ko obwöre mo käla røk jø Icriel, dëëtge acooŋge buute, ni jwöŋge døc ni yïthge ege keeyø.
english: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.

anywaa: 'Ba Cekaniya wär Jikiël, mo käla ri nyïïkwaac Ilam, aköö jï Edhera, ni «Waani, waana tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëër Jwøk marø, ni beeye mana nywømwa nyïï juurre; 'ba wa na jø Icriel,  këël na bëëtwa ki bëëtö manøgø, poot da ŋäädhe kiperwa.
english: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man kööŋwa nyïm Jwøk marø ki man kwierwa mään moøgø bëët ko obwöre moge, ki køør luummï, ï na kwääya, ki luum jøøa dëëtge tïmö ni kwanynyi ki køør ciik mana no ocaan Jwøki marø; ni kïth luummögø bäät tïïc ki køør ciik Jwøk.
english: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

anywaa: Ö maal nø! Kiper luummögø ena cerï; 'ba waani, wa cuŋŋö ki ïïni na aciel. Mak riï ni kïthï gø bäät tïïc.»
english: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.

anywaa: Køøre Edhera aö maal, ni ö jøøa näk kwörge døøŋŋø røk dïlämme, ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay, ki røk jø Icriel bëët ni tïïc ge nee kööŋge ki man kïthge luubö mana caan bäät tïïc; ni ö geni ni putge kööŋ.
english: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Edhera aput ö maal ki nyïm Øt Jwøk ni ci yi øtø mana no orep dëër Øt Jwøk, ni beeye øt Jöanan wär Eliyacip. 'Ba këël na ci kaace, eni kär cämö ki cam, ni eni kär mädhö ki pïï; kiper eni bëëdö ni kïmmö kiper bëëtö mana raac na beet nyïïkwaac jøøa mak ki tøŋ moa kwøŋ duuö.
english: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.

anywaa: Køøre gena gööc piny ki luubö yi Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre kiper nyïïkwaac jøøa mak ki tøŋ bëët moa kwøŋ duuö, nee rege cooŋge Jerucalem.
english: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato ba ööi ki yïth nïne moø na adäk yøø, ki køør luum dïbwöthe ki jø døøŋŋø, eni jape di camø bëët, ni wii eni wøk ki ya acooŋ nyïïkwaac jøøa mak ki tøŋ moa duuö.
english: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tuuŋ Juuda bëët ki jø tuuŋ Benjamen bëët rege acooŋge Jerucalem ki yïth nïne adäk. 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää abïŋweenni na pïërariiø, jiy bëët apï piny kanya leer nyïm Øt Jwøk. 'Ba kiper teek mar acooŋa manøgø, ki køth mana päth bäätge, dëëtge atïmö ni kwanynyi.
english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi ma Edhera aö maal ni kööe jïge, ni «Uuna bëëdö nou tïïya gïn mo raac, ki mana nywømmu nyïï juurre, nou meeda gø bäät raayu, u na jø Icriel.
english: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, køpu raayu jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwäyu, ni tïïyu mana manynye, ni kälu dëëtu wøk ki røk juurre mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi, ni kwierru nyïï juurre moa nywømmu.»
english: Now therefore make confession unto the Lord God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.

anywaa: Køøre aløk jø acooŋa bëët ni döötge ena maal, ni köge, ni «Gïnögø beeye kare! Gïna caanï enø putwa ka kïth bäät tïïc.
english: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jiy thööth kany, ni pinynya cwiir, ni ba løny jïwa ki man cuŋwa wøk; ni tïïc manøgø ba løny ki tïïc ki dïcäŋ aciel wala ki nïne ariiø, kiper waano bääyö døc ki mana tïïcwa gïnögø.
english: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man ö dïbwöthe mowa ni tïïcge tïïögø na kar jø acooŋa bëët, ni ö jiyi moa nyöömmö ki nyïï juurre na en yïth päänye mowa ni öge yi kany mo ocaanø, ni ge ööi na aciel ki jø døøŋŋø ki dïŋut luup moa en yi pääny man nø, nee Jwøk marø wëër mare na liel kaamar maac paanye bäätwa kiper gïnögø na tïïcwa enø.»
english: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.

anywaa: 'Ba Jönathan wär Acaël ki Jadheya o Tikwa keerge luummögø apiemge, ni ö Meculammi ki nyï tuuŋ Libay ma Cabetay ni cige kur jøøgø.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac jøøa mak ki tøŋ moa duuö, luumma caan jø acooŋa akïthge bäät tïïc. Ni ö dïlämi ma Edhera ni jier jøøa bëëdö na dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi ki køør wïth tuŋi mo kwäcge, ni jøøgø bëët nyeŋge ogöör piny. Køøre kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar na aciel, jøøgø gena pï piny nee tier gïnögø raŋge døøc.
english: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa tïm nïr dwää aciel na aciel, luup jøøa nywøm nyïï juurre bëët athöörge ki neen.
english: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk nyïïkwaac dïlämme, jøøa joot ni geno nyöömö ki nyïï juurre joota røk nyïïkwaac Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk ki røk nyïïkwaac nyïïmenni, ni jøøgø beege Maycëya ki Eliëdher ki Jarip ki Gedaliya.
english: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena jïëy ki man kwierge määrge ma nyïï juurre, ni ö ŋati man nø rege ni kän wøk ki nywø røømmø ri pïïth ni cïp gø no olämi kiper gïna raac na tïïe.
english: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa joot røk nyïïkwaac Imër beege Anani ki Dhebadiya;
english: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.

anywaa: ni jøøa joot røk nyïïkwaac Arim beege Maycëya, ki Ilaaja, ki Cemaya, ki Jikiël, ki Udhaya;
english: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.

anywaa: ni jøøa joot røk nyïïkwaac Pacuur beege: Eliyönay, ki Maycëya, ki Icmiel, ki Natanel, ki Jödhabat, ki Elaca.
english: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay, beege: Jödhabat, ki Cimiy, ki Këlaya ni wø cwøl ni Kelitha, ki Petaya, ki Juuda, ki Eliëdher.
english: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, beeye Eliyacip. 'Ba ki røk jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, beege Calum ki Tëlem ki Uri.
english: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa joot røk jø Icriel møga beege ii: ki røk nyïïkwaac Paröc, beege Ramaya, ki Idhiya, ki Malkiya, ki Miyamin, ki Eliedhar, ki Malkiya, ki Benaya;
english: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Ilam, beege Mataniya, ki Dhekaraya, ki Jikiël, ka Abdi, ki Jerëmöth, ki Ilaaja;
english: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Elijah.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Dhatu, beege Eliyönay, ki Eliyacip, ki Mataniya, ki Jerëmöth, ki Dhabat, ka Adhidha;
english: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Bëbay, beege Jöanan, ka Ananiya, ki Dhabay, ka Athlay;
english: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Bani, beege Meculam, ki Maluk, ka Adaya, ki Jacup, ki Ceal, ki Jerëmöth;
english: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Paath-Möap, beege Adina, ki Kelal, ki Benaya, ki Maycëya, ki Mataniya, ki Bacaliil, ki Binuy, ki Maneeca;
english: And of the sons of Pahath–moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Arim, beege Eliëdher, ki Iciya, ki Malkiya, ki Cemaya, ki Cimøn,
english: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

anywaa: ki Benjamen, ki Maluk, ki Cemariya;
english: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Acum, beege Mathanay, ki Matata, ki Dhabat, ki Elipelet, ki Jerëmay, ki Maneeca, ki Cimiy;
english: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Bani, beege Mayday, ka Amram, ki Uël,
english: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

anywaa: ki Benaya, ki Bëdiya, ki Kelui,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,

anywaa: ki Waniya, ki Merëmöt, ki Eliyacip,
english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

anywaa: ki Mataniya, ki Mathanay, ki Jaacu;
english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Binuy, beege Cimiy,
english: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,

anywaa: ki Celemiya, ki Nathan, ka Adaya,
english: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,

anywaa: ki Maknadebay, ki Cacay, ki Caray,
english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

anywaa: ka Adharël, ki Celemiya, ki Cemariya,
english: Azareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

anywaa: ki Calum, ka Amariya, ki Jocep;
english: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.

anywaa: ki røk nyïïkwaac Nebø, beege Jïël, ki Matitiya, ki Dhabat, ki Dhebina, ki Jaday, ki Jööl, ki Benaya.
english: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.

anywaa: Jøøi bëët beege jøøa nyöömmö ki nyïï juurre, ni jø møøk rege jïge da obwöre moa nywølge ki mään moøgø.
english: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege luup Neemiya wär Akaliya. Kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø moa beet Arthëkcici ni ena nyeny Parca, yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Kiclep, ni aani na Neemiya, a ena paan dwøŋ yi pääny mana cwøl ni Cuca,
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

anywaa: coka ma Anani, na dhaanhø aciel røk nyïïmera, ki jiy møøk mo cäädhi ka eni, gena öö ni ge käla Juuda; ni pëënynya geni  kiper Jerucalem ki jø Juuth moa näk kär maaø ki tøŋ na no odööŋ ni kwøw.
english: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni köge jïra, ni «Jiy moa näk kär maaø ki tøŋ na no odööŋ ni kwøw yïth mïëc Juuda, ge ena yi bëëtö mo leth, ni ge di jøøŋŋø. Kiir mar Jerucalem bëëdö no opädhö, ni dhøgi mo kiir mare bëëdö no owaaŋø ki maac.»
english: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba aani kanya wïnynya luupögø, aana put pï piny ni jwöŋa, ni bëëda ki nïne naa kïmmö, naa wödö ki cam, naa lämö nyïm Jwø maal.
english: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,

anywaa: Ni kööa, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal, a kwaya ïïni, ï na Jwøa dwøŋ ni wø kwany dëëlli ki eni, ï ni wø gwøk luumma tuutï ki jø wø mëër ki ïïni, ï ni wø nyooth mëër man wø ba jøøl jïge, ge ni wø gwøk ciik moï.
english: And said, I beseech thee, O Lord God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man raŋï aani, ni cegï ïthï ki lam mara, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni beeye lam mara man läma ki gø nyïmï en ki dïcäŋ ki wäär, kiper jiyï ma jø Icriel, naa køpa raay moge moa bacwa dëërï; aani ki jø dhi øt kwäya waana bääyö dëërï.
english: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.

anywaa: Waani, waana tïïö ki gïï mo reyø døc dëërï, ni waani ciik moï, ki gïïa cemï, ki luup ŋøl moï, moa cïpï ki ri dhaanhnhï ma Modhe, kärwa gwøø.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.

anywaa: «Beerra man lääŋŋï luubö mana köömmï dhaanhnhï ma Modhe ki gø na kööï, ni ‹Ni näk mou bëëdö ni cwïnynyu ogaa wøk, u keetha keethø dï wïth juurre.
english: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou duua baŋa, ni gwøgu ciik 'moa ni kïthu geni bäät tïïc, këël noo bëëdu ni kwöra näk mo u yaa keethø yïthge beeye kwör mo bäyö, u lema lemø yïth kwörögø ni duua uuni kany, kanya näk yaa jierø nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie.›
english: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, jøøgø beege jiyï, ni gena jiy moï na piemï ki køør teek badï na dwøŋ.
english: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.

anywaa: Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, beerra man cegï ïthï ki lam mara, a na dhaanhnhï en, ki lam mar jiyï mo wø bëëdö ni yïthge met ki man wøørge nyeŋŋï; ni wëëgï gïna many dhaanhnhï thur kare dïcäŋi ki køør mano nyoothï mëër jïre nyïm nyeya ma Arthëkcic.» 'Ba aani, a bëëdö ni aana kwääy mar nyeya.
english: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør dwäde aŋween, ni poot na ri cwiiri moø ni pïërariiø yøø, moa beet Arthëkcici ni ena nyeya, yi dwääy mana cwøl ni Nican, kanya käl køøŋø jï nyeya, aani køøŋø alwøra ni gaba gø jï nyeya. 'Ba ki mana bëëda cøøn, a käre joodø nyïme ni cwïnya opädhö.
english: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aana pëënynye, na «Aperŋø ni bëët täärnyïmï no oniduk en, këël na bëëdï niï ba tuu? Manøgø bäŋ gïn mør, 'ba beeye pänh cwïny.» Køøre aana lwäyö døc,
english: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,

anywaa: ni kööa, ni «Wui Nyeya, ïïno bëëdö na bäre bäre! ?Aani, cwïnya ba pädhe nidïï këët ni pääny kanya en bwöc kwäcwa yie oränynyö, ni dhøgi mo kiir mare othöör maaci?»
english: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya aköö jïra, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?» Køøre aana lämö jï Jwø maal.
english: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lønya ki lam, aana köö jï nyeya, ni «Nyeya, ni näk mo beeye gïn mo beer ki jïrï, ni a na dhaanhnhï, a bëëdö ni mara beer nyïmï, beerra man weyï aani naa døøa Juuda naa cøøa pääny mana en bwöc kwäcwa yie nee cäŋa geerrø.»
english: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.

anywaa: 'Ba mana løk nyeya jïra, ni gwanynyø opï piny buute, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Wääth marï ïïno bëëdï ki kany mo nyïëdi? Na yi wäne noo duuï?» 'Ba nyeya yie amïnnö ki man wec aani naa aa. Kanyøgø aani, nïne akwaana jï nyeya.
english: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

anywaa: Køøre aana cäŋ köö, ni «Nyeya, ni näk mo beeye gïn mo beer ki jïrï thuwø, beerra man göönnï aani ki weeli nee cïba jï kwääri mo wø bëëdö paac man wø cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga, naa wecge ki man cøra dï poge këël mano pïïa Juuda.
english: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;

anywaa: Aani, a wär göönnï  thuwø ki wëëlö nee cïba jï Acaap, ŋat wø koor lul mar nyeya, kiper nee eni cïpe jïra ki jenni mo dhøgi mo kiir mo kar gwøk røk na en buut Øt Jwøk, ki jenni mo kiir mar pääny, ki jenni mo øtø mano bëëda yie.» 'Ba nyeya gïïa pëënynya acïbe jïra, kiper Jwøk mara cere na beer ena bääta.
english: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana put aay ni cøøa baŋ kwääri mo wø bëëdö paac man wø cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga, ni cïba weeli jïge moa göör nyeya. 'Ba kar kaagø nyeya da kwääc leny ki jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi mo ee cïbö nee cääthge ki aani ciel.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cenbalati nyen ma nyï Örönaim, ki Thöbiya nyen ma ŋat köör ma nyï Amön, na wïnyge gø ni da ŋat mo oöö mo manynya bëënynyö mar jø Icriel, geni, cwïnyge aput tïmö ni raac.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre aana ö Jerucalem; 'ba kanya nø jwöma raa ki nïne adäk,
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

anywaa: aana ö maal ki wäär, aani ki jiy mo nøk. Ni aani, gïna näk onø cïp Jwøki mara cwïnya nee tïïa kiper Jerucalem bäŋ ŋat mo yaa gø caanø jïre. 'Ba kanyøgø bäŋ lääy mo wø cäädhö ki bäätge mo nut, 'ba beeye mana cäädha ki bääte keere na nut.
english: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø ki dï wäär aana ci wøk naa cøra dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Agäm Kïdi, jï løøa en iithi yie man wø cwøl ni Iith Thwöl, jï kuna en dhi kiirri yie man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Wï Thur, kiper nee kiir mana näk oränynyö mar Jerucalem raŋa ki dhøgi mo kiir mare moa näk othöör maaci.
english: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

anywaa: Køøre aana aay ni pöötha dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jøøro, ki bäät puul man wø cwøl ni Puul Mar Nyeya; 'ba bäŋ kany mo pööth lääyi ki yie mana cäädha ki bääte.
english: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, aana aay ki wäär naa cøra waŋ Naam Kidaran naa raŋŋa kiir. Køøre ka aŋuudi raa aløøa ni duua ni cäŋa cur dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Agäm Kïdi.
english: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.

anywaa: 'Ba jø kööre bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge kiper kanya cøøa yie wala gïna tïïa; kiper aani, poot bäŋ gïn mo yaa caanø jï jø Juuth ki jï dïlämme moge, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moge, ki jø kööre moge, ki jï jiy møga bëët moo tïïc tïïc.
english: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.

anywaa: Køøre aana cäänö ki geni ni kööa, ni «Uuni, bëëtö man ni raac ni enø yie en nëënö jïïu, ni Jerucalem bëëdö no oränynyö, ni dhøgi mo kiir mare owaaŋø ki maac. Uuni, beerra man ööu ni cäŋø kiir mar Jerucalem geerrø, kiper nee ø ba bëëdø këët ni ø di jøøŋŋø.»
english: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.

anywaa: Køøre aani jöö mana bëët Jwøki mara ni cere na beer ena bääta acaana jïge, ki luup nyeya moa caane jïra. Ni putge köö, ni «Beerra man ööø maal ni tägø ki geer.» Køøre gena put tägö ki man kïthge ceŋge ri tïïögø na beer.
english: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cenbalati nyï Örönaim, ki Thöbiya ŋat köör ma nyï Amön, ki Gëcam nyen ma Araba, na wïnyge luum gïno tïïcwa, waana putge buuö ni ŋeethge bäätwa ni köge, ni «?Gïnö ni tïïyu enø agïnaŋø? ?Aŋø, uuni, maru ageem ki nyeya?»
