english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?

anywaa: 'Ba aløøa jïge ni kööa, ni «Jwø maal tïïc marwa wëëge thur kare; kiper manøgø nø, wa na jiye, wa ööa maal ni putwa gëëdö møn. 'Ba uuni, bäŋ karu kany, ni bäŋ gïn mou cäänö kipere; uuni, bäŋ gïn mo ŋäc kiperu Jerucalem kany.»
english: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Eliyacip na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ena ö maal ki dïlämme mo wø tïïö ki eni ciel, ni geerge dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Dïëk, ni cïp gø kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni moocge dhi gø ko odhuule. Ni  ö geni ni cïpge kiir kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni beeye kiir mana no okëël ri øt koor man wø cwøl ni Dïpa, ki ri Øt Koor Mar Ananel.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Jerikö ni gëëtge ni ge tägi ka kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie. Ni ö Dhakurri wär Imeri ni gëëde ni tääe ka dhøk ceŋ jø Jerikö.
english: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Acena dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Rec ageerge, ni cöönhge dhi gø ki jenni, ni kïthge dhi gø ko odhuule, ki gïï wø dëëdi ki geni, ki dïdëëdi.
english: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba Merëmöt wär Uria nyikwaar Aködh dëër kiir kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie adwøk kare. Ni ö Meculammi o Berekiya nyikwaar Mecëdhabël ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Merëmöti yie. Ni ö Dhadöki o Baana ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Meculammi yie.
english: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Tëköa ni dwøkge dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Dhadöki yie; 'ba jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moge, gena bëëdö jaak ni ge ba kunynyi ki tïïc mana caan kwääri moge jïge.
english: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöyada o Pacëa ki Meculam o Bëcödëya, dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jecana ageerge, ni cöönhge dhi gø ki jenni, ni kïthge dhi gø ko odhuule, ki gïï wø dëëdi ki geni, ki dïdëëdi.
english: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö Melathaya nyï Gibien, ki Jadön nyï Mërönöt, ki jø Gibien, ki jø Micpa, jøøa en tier kwäärö mar paac man wø cwøl ni Løø Naam Upareeti Løøga, ni dwøkge dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie.
english: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.

anywaa: Ni ö Udhielli wär Araya, ŋat mo ena røk rëëmme mo warkie, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie. Ni ö Ananiya, ŋat mo ena røk jø wø tïïc mäth wïïr mo wø ŋwääi ni met, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Udhielli yie. Jøøgø bëët kiir Jerucalem adwøkge kare këël mana këët ri kiir kanya näk odhïŋ.
english: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.

anywaa: Ni ö Rëpaya wär Ur, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar thääŋ Jerucalem, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie.
english: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö Jidaya wär Arumap ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Rëpaya yie, buut øtø mare. Ni ö Atuci wär Acabeniya ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Jidaya yie.
english: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.

anywaa: Ni ö Malkiya wär Arim ka Acub o Paath- Möap ni dwøkge thääŋ kiir løøk maya kare, ki dëër øt koor man wø cwøl ni Øt Koor Mar Jø Bul Ki Dääpe.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.

anywaa: Ni ö Calummi wär Alöec, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar thääŋ Jerucalem, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare, eni ki nyïïe, ni beeye kanya ŋuut dhi cer Malkiya yie.
english: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba Anun ki jø wø bëëdö Dhanöwa, dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Agäm Kïdi adwøkge kare. Ageerge ni kïthge dhi gø ko odhuule ki gïï wø dëëdi ki geni, ki dïdëëdi. Ni dëër kiir mana dwøkge kare këël ki mana këët ri dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Wï Thur, bär mare ki buudö beeye gööye ma kuma.
english: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.

anywaa: Ni ö Malkiya o Rëkap, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar Bëëth-Akarim, ni dwøk dhi kiir kare man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Wï Thur. Ageere ni kïth dhi gø ko odhuule, ki gïï wø dëëdi ki geni, ki dïdëëdi.
english: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth–haccerem; he built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö Calummi o Köl-Ödhë, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar Micpa, ni dwøk dhi kiir kare man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jøøro. Eni dhi kiir ageere, ni mooc dhi kiir maal ka apäära, ni kïth dhi gø ko odhuule, ki gïï wø dëëdi ki geni, ki dïdëëdi. Ni ö eni thuwø ni dwøk dëër kiir kare mana en buut puul man wø cwøl ni Ceela na en buut ajïniin nyeya, këël mana pïïe ri kanya näk okïthö ki kwör tiel kany wø ïnh piny ki yie ni jøw käla thääŋ Jerucalem man wø cwøl ni Pääny Deebit.
english: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.

anywaa: Ni ö Neemiya wär Adhbuk, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar thääŋ Bëëth-Cur, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Calummi yie, ni këël gø buut dwöl mar nyeya ma Deebit, këël mana pïïe ri puul mana koony, ni pïïe ri øtø man wø cwøl ni Øt Jø Leny.
english: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moi ni nyeŋge en piny kany ii, dëër kiir kanya ŋuut  dhi cer Neemiya yie adwøkge kwörge. Reum o Bani dëër kiir kanya ŋuut dhi cer Neemiya yie adwøk kare. Acabiya, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar thääŋ Kïïla, dëër kiir kanya ŋuut dhi cer Reummi yie adwøk kare, ni tïïe ki nyeŋ paac mare.
english: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.

anywaa: Baway wär Ënadat, eni na bëëdö na kwäärö mar løø thääŋ Kïïla ki jiye, dëër kiir kanya ŋuut dhi cer Acabiya yie adwøk kare.
english: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.

anywaa: Ëdhör o Jëcua, eni na bëëdö na kwäärö mar Micpa, dëër thääŋ kiir løøk maya kanya ŋuut dhi cer Ënadati yie adwøk kare, ni beeye kanya en buut kany wø eth jøwi maal ki yie ni jøw cøøa kar kän mo jap leny na en kanya gun kiirri ki yie.
english: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.

anywaa: Baruk o Dhabay, eni na bëëdö ni cwïnye lïëth ki tïïc, dëër thääŋ kiir løøk maya kanya ŋuut dhi cer Ëdhöri yie adwøk kare, ki mana täge ki kanya gun kiirri ki yie këël mana pïïe kany wø cør yie ni jøw cøøa po Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ma Eliyacip.
english: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

anywaa: Merëmöt wär Uria nyikwaar Aködh dëër thääŋ kiir løøk maya kanya ŋuut dhi cer Baruki yie adwøk kare, ki mana täge ki dhi jöör øt Eliyacip këël mana pïïe ya aŋuun paac mar Eliyacip.
english: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ dïlämme moa bëëdö deŋ Jerucalem, dëër kiir kanya ŋuut dhi cer Merëmöti yie adwøkge kare.
english: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.

anywaa: Ni ö Benjamenni ka Acub ni dwøkge dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ dïlämme yie, ni beeye kanya en buut øtø marge. Ni ö Adhariya o Maycëya nyikwaar Ananaya ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya en buut paac mare na ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie.
english: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.

anywaa: Ni ö Binuy wär Ënadat ni dwøk thääŋ dëër kiir løøk maya kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Adhariya yie, ki mana täge ki ri øt Adhariya këël mana pïïe ri kanya gun kiirri ki yie, ni put gø këël kanya gun kiirri ki yie.
english: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.

anywaa: Ni ö Palalli wär Odhay ni tïïc tïïc mare buut kanya gun kiirri ki yie buut øt koor mana näk okëël ri paan dwøŋ mar nyeya løøa en jï maal buut kal mar jø koor. Ni ö Pedaya o Paröc ni tïïc tïïc mare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Palalli yie.
english: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk ni wø bëëdö bäät thuur Öpël, ni tïïcge tïïc marge këël mana këët buut dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Pïï, ni ge cäätha jï kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï kanya näk okëël ri øt koor.
english: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Tëköa ni dwøkge thääŋ dëër kiir løøk maya kare kanya en buut øt koor mana dwøŋ këël mana këët ri kiir mar thuur Öpël.
english: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme møga, dëër kiir jï løøa en maal løø dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Okweeny adwøkge kare, ni ŋati man nø tïïö ni dïët ki nyïm øde.
english: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.

anywaa: Ni ö Dhadöki wär Imër ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya en buut øde na ŋuut dhøk ceŋ dïlämme yie. Ni ö Cemaya o Cekaniya, ŋat wø koor dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jï Kur Tuul-Cäŋ, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Dhadöki yie.
english: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.

anywaa: Ni ö Ananiya o Celemiya ka Anun na näk bïcier wäät Dhalap ni dwøkge dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Cemaya yie. Ni ö Meculammi o Berekiya ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhøk ceŋ jøøgø yie, ni beeye kanya en buut kany wø bëëde yie.
english: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.

anywaa: Ni ö Malkiya, ŋat mo ena røk rëëmme mo warkie, ni dwøk dëër kiir kare kanya ŋuut dhi cer Meculammi yie, këël mana këët ri øt jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, ni këël gø ri øt jø gath na en buut dhi kiir man wø cooŋ lwaae yie, këël mana këët ri øtø mana näk ogeer maal bäät kiir kanya gun kiirri ki yie.
english: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.

anywaa: Ni ö rëëmme mo warkie ki jø gath ni dwøkge dëër kiir kare kanya näk okëël ri øtø manøgø kanya gun kiirri ki yie, ni këëlge gø ri dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Dïëk.
english: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cenbalati na wïny gø 'ni wa gëëdö ki kiir, ena put gootø ni wëëre døc ni jøøŋ jø Juuth.
english: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cääne, ni jøøa näk odwätö ki eni  ki jø leny mo Cameria nutö buute, ni kööe, ni «?Jø Juuth moø no onø päth bäät upge yøø, ge tïïcge ŋø? ?Aŋø, geni, ge cäŋa kiir marge dwøk kare jïge? ?Aŋø, løny jïge ki man cïpge ko olämme? ?Ni løny jïge ki man thöörge kiir ki dïcäŋ aciel? ?Aŋø, geni, kïte moa gëëdö ki geni moa näk oniruuth na no oraany maaci, løny jïge ki man cäŋge gëëdö ki ge?»
english: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø Thöbiya nyï Amön ena buut Cenbalat, ni kööe, ni «Kiir manøgø ni geerge enø, këël etha othöö bääte, kïte mo kiir marge manøgø puta øc piny.»
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Neemiya, aana lämö ni kööa, ni «Wui ï na Jwøk marwa, wïny marwa, kiper wa bëëdö ni waano taak jiyi. Beerra man dwøgï ajøøŋ marge dï wïthge, ni wëëgï geni twier, ni kïth geni yi ŋöömö mør ni ge mak ka tøŋ.
english: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:

anywaa: Ïïni, kär bääyö marge uumï, ni ba gööbï raay moge wøk nyïmï, kiper jø geer ajøøŋge täärnyïm jø geer kiree.»
english: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.

anywaa: 'Ba waani kiir ageerwa, ni ö kiiri bäre ni dööte, no opïï maal thääŋ köör kiir, kiper jiy cwïnyge päl døc ki tïïc.
english: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cenbalati ki Thöbiya, ka Arabe, ki jø Amön, ki jø Acdöt na wïnyge gø ni kiir mar Jerucalem tïïc mare ki man dwøgi kare cäädhö ni beer, ni kwöra ŋammø onø dïïr, geni, gena put wëër døc.
english: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,

anywaa: Ni ö geni bëët ni putge tudö ki luubö nee öge nee këëtge ki jø Jerucalem, ni ge tïïya gø nee Jerucalem bëëde ni yie do okiera.
english: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, waana lämö jï Jwøk marwa, ni cïïmwa jiy mo kurö mo neeta geni ki yïth cääŋŋe ki wärre.
english: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye mana car jø Juuda, na tïmö kaamar duut, ni «Teek dëël marwa mar tïïc athum, ni kïte moa näk oniruuth poot thööth døc, ni waani, ba løny jïwa ki man geerwa kiir.»
english: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmän mowa, gïna näk mo ege caanø beeye en, gena köö, ni «Geni, kanyø poode ni poot kucge, ni ø ba nëëni jïge, ø cøø këël kanyø dønynyø dïge ni nääø geni, nee tïïc marge cuŋŋe.»
english: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth moa bëëdö kany mo cään ki geni, gena öö, ni caange gø jïwa kwöre mo jïtö ka apaar ni köge, ni «Nyïïmän, ge öö ni tukge øøni yïth kwöro neetu bëët.»
english: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aani, jiy aputa cïïmmö ki jï løøa en jï piny deŋ kiir kwöra näk ŋammø ki kwöra leer; ni jiy cïïmma ka køør dhøk uudi moge, ni ceŋge do opëëlle, ki tøøŋi, ka athëëre.
english: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø raŋa bëëtö, aana ö maal ni cääna ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki jø kööre, ki jiy møga bëët, ni kööa, ni «Käru lwäyö ki geni, 'ba bëëdu nou lääŋŋa Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na dwøŋ ni wø kwany dëëlli ki eni, ni këëdu kiper jø pou, kiper wäätu, ki nyïïu, ki määru, kiper uudi mou.»
english: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyïïmänni mowa na wïnyge gø 'ni gïna tuutge oløny ni ŋäcwa, na acaara marge onø raany Jwøki ni kär thur kare, wa bëët, waana put døø ri tïï kiir, ni ŋati man nø tïïya kuna näk kure.
english: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki dïcäŋece nø, thäk jiy 'moa gena bëëdö ni ge tïïya tïï kiir, ni ö thäk jiya møga ni bëëtge ni ceŋge da tøøŋi, ki kööt leny, ka athëëre, ni dëëtge ege runynyö ka abïïk nywïëny; ni ö kwääri mo leny ni bëëtge ni rege ege cïïmmö ŋäth jø Juuda bëët
english: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

anywaa: moa näk gëëdö ki kiir. 'Ba jiy moa jwïëk jap tïïc, tïïc marge tïïcge ka ceŋge oceele, ni ceŋge møga da jap leny.
english: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.

anywaa: Ni ŋat geer man nø gëëdö no opëëllö mare ee twöö piere, ni ö ŋat wø kooth tuuŋ ni bëëde ni ena buuta.
english: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö jï jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jø kööre, ki jiy møga bëët, ni «Ennø, tïïc apëëtö ni dwøŋ, ni øøni,  ø bëëdö ni røgø yøø larø dëër kiir, ni jiy moi nø karge bäyö ki jiy møga.
english: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.

anywaa: Uuni, kanyo enu yie jaak, noo wïnynyu dwør tuuŋ mar leny, uuno put öö ni dwätu ki waani. 'Ba Jwøk marø okëëdi kiperø.»
english: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø, waana put bëëdö ni wa tïïö ki mano täge ki kany wø kwäär tiet øwi këël mano nëën ceerri, ni thäk jiy møga ge bëëdö ni ceŋge da tøøŋi.
english: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.

anywaa: Kar kaagø aana cäänö thuwø ki jiy, ni «Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ki ŋat tïïc mare ni tïme ni ge buuta yi Jerucalem ki wäär kiper nee ge bëëtge ni gena jø koor ki wäär, ni gena jø tïïc ki waŋcäŋ.»
english: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ki jø wø käärwa tïïc ki geni, ki jø tïïc 'moa, ki jø koor mo wø bëëdö ki aani, bäŋ ŋat mo obëëdö rewa na abïïe moe ee gööny wøk; ŋati man nø bëëdö ni jap leny moe nut cere, këël noo umme ki pïï.
english: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jiy ki määrge gena bëëdö ni ge jwöŋö døc ni döötge ege tïŋ maal dëët nyïïmëëkge ma jø Juuth.
english: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.

anywaa: Jø møøk aköö, ni «Waani ki wäätwa ki nyïïwa wa thööth; beerra man jïtwa ki beel mo camwa nee wa bëëtwa ni wa kwøw.»
english: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.

anywaa: Jø møøk aköö, ni «Waani, pwöth beel mowa ki pwöth omøki mowa, ki uudi mowa, wa määö ki geni ki beel na dïgïti, nee wa jïtwa ki beel kiper käc.»
english: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

anywaa: Jø møøk aköö thuwø, ni «Waani da gwel mo ewa maaø kiper ajwäk mar nyeya man wø jwäk waani ki gø kiper pwöth beel mowa ki pwöth omøki mowa.
english: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni dëëtwa caala dëët jø pøø, no obwöre mowa caala obwöre moge, waani wäätwa ki nyïïwa wa tïïya geni nee bëëtge na laaŋe, ni nyïïwa møøk ennø onø cam na laaŋe; ni jïwa bäŋ teek, kiper pwöth beel mowa ki pwöth omøki mowa, ge bëëdö na mo jø møøk.»
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, kanya wïnynya jwøk marge mana jwöŋge ki gø, ki luupögø bëët na carge yøø, aana put wëër døc.
english: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

anywaa: Ni bëëda naa cädö ki yi ŋedha. Køøre aani, jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki jø kööre ajääla ni kööa jïge, ni «Uuni, u bëëdö ni ŋati man nø dïïu møta ŋat poge ki man cool jammi jïïu moa näk ee maaø, ni coole ni da wïthge.» Kiper manøgønø, aana cwötö ka acooŋa mo dwøŋ kiper nee jøw cäänge ki geni.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö jïge, ni «Waani, ki køør mana løny jïwa, nyïïmëëgø ma jø Juuth moa biel dëëtge na laaŋe baŋ wïth juurre, gena wïïlwa wøk. ?'Ba ennø, u cäŋa nyïïmëëgu ma jø Juuth tïïyö nee dëëtge bielge, nee cäŋwa wïïl wøk?» 'Ba geni, gena lïŋö kiper bäŋ luubö mo ege joodø nee caange.
english: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.

anywaa: Køøre aana cäŋ köö, ni «Gïna tïïyu enø patha gïn mo beer. ?Aŋø, uuni, ba løny ki man bëëdu nou lwäär ki Jwøk marø kiper nee ajøøŋ mar nyïïmän 'moø ma wïth juurre tïme ni bäŋgø bäätø?
english: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?

anywaa: Aani thuwø ki jøøa käärwa tïïc ki geni, ki jø tïïc 'moa, jø pøø gena wëëkwa mäyö ki gwel ki beel baŋwa nee duuge. 'Ba beerra man wec cwøl jammi moøgø ni cwøl ni da wïthge yøø.
english: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.

anywaa: Ennø, dïcäŋi kiree, uuni, dwøgu pwöth beel moge jïge, ki pwöth omøki moge, ki pwöth jenni moge mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ki uudi moge, këël dïm wïth gwel ki dïm wïth beel, ki dïm wï køøŋ nyïïomøki moa nyärö, ki dïm wï maaw ni wø cwøllu bäätge yøø.»
english: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö, ni «Gïïögø dwøkwa dwøgø, ni bäŋ gïn manywa baŋge këët. Waani, tïïcwa tïïö kiree kaawat manø caanï enø.» Kanyøgø aani, dïlämme acwøla, ni wëëga jøøgø kööŋ nyïma nee tïme ni ge tïïö ka køør luubö man mana näk ocaanø.
english: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, aleeŋŋa mara abäänya wøk dëëra ni teeŋa gø ni kööa, ni «Ŋato ba jïëc luubö man mana näk ocaanø, eno tëëŋ Jwøki wøk øde, ni tëëŋ jape wøk cere kaawat aleeŋŋa mara man na teeŋa en; eno tëëŋ wøk møn, ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïn mo ena jïre.»  'Ba acooŋa bäre gïnögø aputge jøl, ni «Beeye kare.» Ni ö geni ni putge Wuuö Jwøk pwøc. Ni ö jiyi ni putge gïnögø tïïc ki køør luubö mana näk ocaanø.
english: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa kwany aani yie ni aana kwäärö mar jøøgø yi ŋööm Juuda, kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïërariiø këël mana këët ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk kurriiø moa beet Arthëkcic ni ena nyeya, yïth cwiiri moø na apaar kurriiø yøø, aani ki jøøa käärwa tïïc ki geni wa kär cwötö ki cam man wø cïp jï kwäärö cooth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri moa kwøŋ bwödhö nyïma dïkwøŋ, ajwäk mo teek akïthge bäät jiy, ni jwäkge caammi mo jiy ki kwøk nyïïomøki moge, ni ge meeda ge bäät gwet-bïrö ma pïëraŋween. Këël jicge, bëët jiy atïïcge ni teek. 'Ba aani teeŋ gïnögø kära tïïö, kiper aani, a lwäär ki Jwøk.
english: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.

anywaa: Këël aani ki dëëra thuwø, dëëra acïba kiper tïïc mar kiir man; waani bäŋ ŋøøm mo ewa ŋeeø. 'Ba jiya bëët gena bëëdö ni ge ena kanya ciel kaace kiper tïïc.
english: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, jiy mo wø cämwa ki geni ya akaaŋ beege jø Juuth ki jø kööre, ni kwäänge beeye dïpa ki pïërabïïc; ni jiy mo wø ö baŋwa ni ge käla tiet mïëc wïth juurre moa en deŋwa kär kwaanø.
english: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø jiiŋŋi kiper cäŋ man nø beeye rwaath aciel, ki rööm abïciel mo ojierø; ni weny thuwø poot di jiiŋŋø jïra. 'Ba kany wø tïme na køør nïne apaar, teeŋ wïth kwøŋ bëët di kälö ni thööth. 'Ba këël na bëëde na enøgønø, aani, a kär cwötö ki cam man wø cïp jï kwäärö, kiper ajwäk mana teek bäätge.
english: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jwøk mara, lääŋ aani ni beer ki køør gïïa tïïa bëët kiper jøøi ii.
english: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï Cenbalat, ki Thöbiya, ki Gëcam nyen ma Araba, ki jï nyïïmän mowa bëët, 'ni aani kiir yaa cäŋ geerrø, ni bäŋ kany mo ŋaam këët dëëre, këël na bëëde kar kaaca ni aani odhuule poot kära kïth dhøk kiir,
english: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)

anywaa: Cenbalat ki Gëcam, gena jääŋ baŋa ki dwøl ni köge, ni «Ööï nee ø røømmø na aciel kanya cwøl ni Kepirim yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö na cwøl no Onö.» 'Ba geni marge määnyö ki jöö nee tïïge ki gïn mo leth dëëra.
english: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.

anywaa: 'Ba aana jääk baŋge ki jiy ni kööa, ni «Aani, bääta da tïïc mo dwøŋ, ni ba løny ki man ööa kunögø. ?Aŋø, aperŋø noo ö tïïci noo cäŋ cuŋŋö këët en kanyo wiia gø noo ööa baŋu kunögø?»
english: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?

anywaa: 'Ba geni, gena bëëdö ni ge jääga baŋa ki dwøl kwöre aŋween ni poot na dwørøgø na aciel enø, ni bëëda naa poot dwøga dwøl aciel jïge thuwø.
english: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïïge, Cenbalat dhaanhnhe ajääŋŋe baŋa ni poot jääŋŋe ka dwørøgø, ni cer gø ee mooø ki wëëlö mo kär mwönö,
english: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;

anywaa: mo ogöörö na ennø nø: «Man beeye gïn mo owïnyö dï wïth juurre, ni caani ni Gëcammi thuwø, 'ni ïïni ki jø Juuth, maru määnyö ki jöö kiper nou gëëmmu; ni beeye ni tïme ni kiir geerru geerø en. Maya thuwø, ki køør luup moi moa wïnyö, ïïni, ï manynya gø niï tïmï na nyeya marge.
english: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.

anywaa: Ni ïïno nø kwänyö ki nyïïkuk Jwøk kiper nee luum nyec marï gøøge piny yi Jerucalem, ni ‹Da nyeya Juuda.› 'Ba dwøl man di caanø jï nyeya ki køør dööti moi ii. Ennø, beerra man ööï nøø jïtø ka acooŋa na aciel.»
english: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.

anywaa: 'Ba aana jäägö ki dwøl baŋe ni kööa, ni «Teeŋ gïïa carï yøø bäŋgø mo otägö; 'ba gïïögø beege gïïa cøøŋŋï yiï ki ge jaak.»
english: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët ge päära waani nee wa lwäcwa, ni ge cäänö ki cwïnyge, ni «Geni, ceŋge boo nilwak ri tïïc cøøn nee tïïc ba thume.» 'Ba aana lämö ni kööa, ni «Wui Jwøk, wëëk bääta tëënnö.»
english: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel, aana ci øt Cemaya o Delaya nyikwaar Meethabël, kanya  bëëde ni eno cïëk yi øde. Køøre ena köö, ni «Beerra man cøø nee ø dwätø yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni cïëgø odhuule mo Øt Jwøk bäätø, kiper geni, ge ööa kuna 'näkge ïïni, ni kanyo öge kuna 'näkge ïïni yie beeye wäär.»
english: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö, na «?Aŋø, ŋat wø reŋi beeye dhaanhø mo caala aani ennø? ?Teeŋ ŋat mo caala aani ennø, beeye ŋat mo doo cøøa Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni eni gwøga jwïëy moe? Aani, a ba døny yie.»
english: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïnögø ajooda man näk mo eni ba jääŋŋa Jwøki baŋa; 'ba luup moa købe, købe ni eni maaŋŋa wïïa ki geni, kiper eni, eno ŋeeø ki piny, ni eni ŋeewa Thöbiya ki Cenbalati.
english: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

anywaa: Ena ŋeew ki piny kiper naa cøøge naa lwäya, nee mana manyge tïïa kiper naa bääya, nee nyeŋŋa raanyge naa päätge.
english: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, kär wïïï wïl ki gïï ii na tïïc Thöbiya ki Cenbalati, ni ba wïl wïïï thuwø ki gïïa tïïc Nöadiya, dhaaŋŋa näk nyikuŋ Jwøk ni wø køp luup ki wïïe, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk møøk na caal dhaaŋŋøgø, jøøa päär aani naa lwäya.
english: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.

anywaa: 'Ba kiir bäre athum ki geer ki nïne ma pïërabïïc kurriiø, ni nïr dwää abïciel ni wø cwøl ni Ëlul pïërariiø ka abïïc.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyïïmänni mowa bëët na wïnyge gø, ni ö wïth juurre bëët moa en deŋwa na jootge gø, geni bäätge aput pädhö døc ni nyeŋge okwätö, kiper ajootge ni tïïc manøgø beeye Jwøk na wëëk gø thur kare.
english: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröke thuwø, jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo Juuda gena bëëdö ni ge jäägö ki weeli baŋ Thöbiya, ni bëët weeli mo Thöbiya thuwø ni ööa baŋge.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo thööth yi Juuda okööŋ ki man dwätge ki eni, kiper ena cø nyi Cekaniya wär Araa, ni wääde ma Jöanan beeye na nywøm nyi Meculam o Berekiya.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, jiy bëëdö ni ge cara gïr tïïe moe moa beyø jïra, ni carge luup 'moa jïre. 'Ba Thöbiya ajääŋ baŋa ki weeli kiper naa lwäya.
english: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum kiiri bäre ki mana cäŋi geerrø, ni nø kïtha odhuule kwörge, ni jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø tuuŋ Libay onø kwany,
english: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

anywaa: aani coka ma Anani, ka Ananiya, ŋat wø en kwör gwøk røk cere, gena kwanya nee Jerucalem bëëde ni ena ceŋge; kiper Ananiya beeye dhaanhø mo oŋäädhö, na ŋat mo lwäär ki Jwøk ni kaala jiy mo thööth.
english: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

anywaa: Ni kööa jïge, ni «Uuni, dhøgi mo kiir mar Jerucalem kär laaru jap këël kanyo lëënh cäŋŋi; 'ba kanyo bëët jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir ni ge kurö, wär bëëtge no odhuule ege cïëgö ni ege dëëdö ki dïdëëdi. Uuni thuwø, kwänyu ki jø koor røk jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem nee jø møøk bëëtge kwör koor moge, ni jø møøk kurö deŋ uudi moge.»
english: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø Jerucalem dwøŋ jaak ni yie laac; 'ba beege jiy mo nøk keerge na en yie, ni poot bäŋ uudi mo ogeerø.
english: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk mara gïnögø akïth cwïnya nee jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jø kööre, ki jiy bëët cooŋa kanya ciel, nee nyeŋge göör piny ki køør wïth tuŋi moge. Køøre aani wëëlö ajooda, ni beeye wëëlö mana näk nyeŋ jøøa kwøŋ duu Jerucalem ogöör piny yie, ni luubö mana jooda no ogöör piny yie bee en:
english: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,

anywaa: Moi beege jø Juuda moa duuö ki Babiløn, na duu Jerucalem ki mïëc Juuda møga, ni ŋati man nø duua yi pääny poge. Ni jøøgø beege thäk jiy moa no omaaø ki tøŋ na bëëdö na wëëlle Babiløn, ni beege jøøa mak Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn ni kïth  geni Babiløn.
english: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;

anywaa: Ni jøøgø ge cäädhi ka dïbwöthe moge ni beege Dherubabel, ki Jøcua, ki Neemiya, ka Adhariya, ki Raamiya, ki Naamani, ki Mördekay, ki Bilcan, ki Micpëret, ki Bigway, ki Neum, ki Baanaa. 'Ba moi beege kwään cwøw mo jø Icriel moa öge ki ge:
english: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Paröc beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpa aciel ki pïërabïriiø ka ariiø.
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Cepathiya beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïriiø ka ariiø.
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Araa beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc ka ariiø.
english: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Paath-Möap na käl ri Jëcua ki Jöap beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpe abära ka apaar ka abära.
english: The children of Pahath–moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Ilam beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc ka aŋween.
english: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Dhatu beege jiy ma dïpe abära ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc.
english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Dhakay beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërabïciel.
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Binuy beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïëraŋween ka abära.
english: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Bëbay beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërariiø ka abära.
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Adhigad beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø ka ariiø.
english: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Adönikam beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïciel ka abïriiø.
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Bigway beege jiy ma kume ariiø ki pïërabïciel ka abïriiø.
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Adin beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïïc ka abïïc.
english: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Ather na käl ri Edhekaya beege jiy ma pïërabïŋween ka abära.
english: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Acum beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø ka abära.
english: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Bëdhay beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø ka aŋween.
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Arip beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ka apaar kurriiø.
english: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Gibien beege jiy ma pïërabïŋween ka abïïc.
english: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

anywaa: Jø Bethelem ki jø Nethöpa beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabära ka abära.
english: The men of Beth–lehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

anywaa: Jø Anathöth beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka abära.
english: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: Jø Bëëth-Adhemawët beege jiy ma pïëraŋween ka ariiø.
english: The men of Beth–azmaveth, forty and two.

anywaa: Jø Kiriat-Jeerim ki jø Keepira ki jø Bëëröth beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëraŋween ka adäk.
english: The men of Kirjath–jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.

anywaa: Jø Reema ki jø Gëba beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïërariiø ka aciel.
english: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty and one.

anywaa: Jø Mikmac beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka ariiø.
english: The men of Michmash, an hundred and twenty and two.

anywaa: Jø Bëthël ki jø Gaay beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø ka adäk.
english: The men of Beth–el and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.

anywaa: Jø Nebø maya beege jiy ma pïërabïïc ka ariiø.
english: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Ilam maya beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïïc ka aŋween.
english: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Arim beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërariiø.
english: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

anywaa: Jø Jerikö beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc.
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

anywaa: Jø Löt ki jø Adid, ki jø Onö beege jiy ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïërariiø ka aciel.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.

anywaa: Jø Cënaa beege jiy ma kume adäk ki dïpe abïŋween ki pïëradäk.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.

anywaa: Moi beege kwään dïlämme moa duuö:  Nyïïkwaac Jidaya na käl Jëcua dëëre beege jiy ma dïpe abïŋween ki pïërabïriiø ka adäk.
english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Imër beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki pïërabïïc ka ariiø.
english: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Pacuur beege jiy ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka abïriiø.
english: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Arim beege jiy ma kuma aciel ka apaar ka abïriiø.
english: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

anywaa: Moi beege kwään cwøw mo jø tuuŋ Libay moa duuö: Nyïïkwaac Jëcua na käl dhi øt Kadmiël, Kadmiël na käl røk nyïïkwaac Odawïya beege jiy ma pïërabïriiø ka aŋween.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.

anywaa: Jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ni beege nyïïkwaac Acaap, beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïëraŋween ka abära.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.

anywaa: Jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ni beege nyïïkwaac Calum, ki nyïïkwaac Ather, ki nyïïkwaac Thalmön, ki nyïïkwaac Akup, ki nyïïkwaac Athitha, ki nyïïkwaac Cöbay, kwäänge bëët beege jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïëradäk ka abära.
english: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa duuö mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk beege: Nyïïkwaac Dhia, ki nyïïkwaac Acupa, ki nyïïkwaac Thabaøt,
english: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Këröc, ki nyïïkwaac Ciya, ki nyïïkwaac Padön,
english: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Lebana, ki nyïïkwaac Agaba, ki nyïïkwaac Calmay,
english: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Shalmai,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Anan, ki nyïïkwaac Gidël, ki nyïïkwaac Gaar,
english: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Reaya, ki nyïïkwaac Recin, ki nyïïkwaac Neköda,
english: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Gadham, ki nyïïkwaac Udha, ki nyïïkwaac Pacëa,
english: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Bëcay, ki nyïïkwaac Meunim, ki nyïïkwaac Nepicim,
english: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Bakbuk, ki nyïïkwaac Akupa, ki nyïïkwaac Aruur,
english: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Bathlut, ki nyïïkwaac Meida, ki nyïïkwaac Arca,
english: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Barköc, ki nyïïkwaac Cicara, ki nyïïkwaac Tëma,
english: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Nedhiya, ki nyïïkwaac Athipa.
english: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa duuö mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk, ni beege jøøa cwøl ni laak Cølöman, beege: Nyïïkwaac Cöthay, ki nyïïkwaac Cöpërët, ki nyïïkwaac Përida,
english: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Jaala, ki nyïïkwaac Darkön, ki nyïïkwaac Gidël,
english: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

anywaa: ki nyïïkwaac Cepathiya, ki nyïïkwaac Athil, ki nyïïkwaac Pökëret-Adhëbaym, ki nyïïkwaac Amön.
english: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy mo wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk bëët, ki kwään nyïïkwaac laak Cølöman beege jiy ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïŋween ka ariiø.
english: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy maa öö ki yïth mïëc Babiløn, mïëri moa cøøri ni Tël-Mëla, ki Tël-Arca, ki Kerup, ka Adan, ki Imër. 'Ba kär løny jïge ki man caange wïth tuŋi moge wala dhøk uudi moge man näk mo gena jø Icriel;
english: And these were they which went up also from Tel–melah, Tel–harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.

anywaa: ni jøøgø beege nyïïkwaac Delaya, ki nyïïkwaac Thöbiya, ki nyïïkwaac Neköda; ni kwäänge beege jiy ma dïpe abïciel ki pïëraŋween ka ariiø.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø tuuŋ dïlämme mo omänö ki tïïc mar dïlämme, ni beege nyïïkwaac Obaya, ki nyïïkwaac Aködh, ki nyïïkwaac Bardhilay. Bardhilay manøgø beeye na nywøm nyi Bardhilay nyï Gelät, ni put nyeŋŋe caa ri nyeŋ wää cïïe ma Bardhilay.
english: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø nyeŋ kwäcge amanyge yi wëël nyeŋ; 'ba kiper mana näk mo kär joodø, gena kwaan kaamar jiy mo ba en ri tuuŋ dïlämme, ni män geni ki tïïc mar dïlämme.
english: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

anywaa: Køøre kwäärö mar paac aköö jïge ni ge ba løny ki man cämge ki cam man wø en kur keere wø cïp jï Wuuö Jwøk, këël kanyo dee dïlämi mo luup ŋøle ka køør Urim ki Thumim.
english: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy moa cooŋ rege kanya ciel kanya duuge ki Babiløn beege jiy ma kume ma pïëraŋween ka ariiø ki dïpe adäk ki pïërabïciel,
english: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

anywaa: ni kwään laaŋe moge, ni beege cwøw ki mään ma kume abïriiø ki dïpe adäk ki pïëradäk ka abïriiø, kär kwaan rege. 'Ba geni, jïge da jiy mo wø wär ki dudi ma dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc, ni beege cwøw ki mään.
english: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.

anywaa: Ni jïge do okwëënyi ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëradäk ka abïciel, ki gääŋŋe ma dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka abïïc,
english: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:

anywaa: ni jïge da athïrööle ma dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk ka abïïc, ka arëëni ma kume abïciel ki dïpe abïriiø ki pïërariiø.
english: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møøk røk dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi, gena cïpö ki jammi kiper tïï Øt Jwøk nee cäŋ geer kare. Ni ö kwäärö mar paaci ni cïpe ki gwet warkey mo darik ma kuma, ki kuure ma pïërabïïc, ka abïïe mo dïlämme ma dïpe abïïc ki pïëradäk, ni kïth geni kar kän.
english: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basins, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.

anywaa: Ni ö jø møøki røk dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi ni cïpge ki gwet warkey mo darik ma kume ma pïërariiø kiper tïï Øt Jwøk, ki gwetbïrö mo miina ma kume ariiø ki dïpe ariiø, ni kïth geni kar kän.
english: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møga, moa cïpge beeye gwet warkey mo darik ma kume ma pïërariiø, ki gwet-bïrö mo miina ma kume ariiø, ka abïïe mo dïlämme ma pïërabïciel ka abïriiø.
english: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø koor dhøk kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jiy møga, ki jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, ki jø Icriel bëët, gena pï piny yïth päänye moge.
english: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dwää abïriiø na tääi, ni jø Icriel onø pï piny yïth päänye moge, geni ge bëët rege acooŋge kanya ciel kar acooŋa kanya leer nyïm dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Pïï, ni ge bëëdö kaamar dhaanhø aciel. Køøre geni, acaange jï Edhera, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, nee wëël ciik na cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï jø Icriel ki ri Modhe käl wøk.
english: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord had commanded to Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mana täk nïr dwää abïriiø yie, dïlämi ma Edhera wëël ciik Jwøk akäl wøk nyïm jø acooŋa, ni beege cwøw ki mään, këël ko obwöre bëët moa näk tier luubö cøøa wïthge.
english: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.

anywaa: Ni kwaan wëëlö ki mana täge ka amöölla këël dhöör dïcäŋ, ni jiy ee løø nyïme kar acooŋa kanya leer na en nyïm dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Pïï, ni kwaane nyïm cwøw ki mään, këël obwöre moa näk tier luubö cøøa wïthge. 'Ba jiy bëët ïthge acekge døc ki luup moa en yi wëël ciik Jwøk.
english: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø Edhera, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, cuŋŋa bäät jenni maal mo otieŋø mo ogeer jiyi nee eni cuŋŋe bääte kiper acooŋa manøgø. 'Ba jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moa cuŋŋö bäät cwïïe beege Matitiya, ki Cema, ka Anaya, ki Uria, ki Kilkiya, ki Maycëya; ni jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moa cuŋŋö bäät caame beege Pedaya, ki Micaël, ki Malkiya, ka Acum, ki Acbedana, ki Dhekaraya, ki Meculam.
english: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchijah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

anywaa: Ni kanya ö Edhera na jap wëëlö, nëënö nyeŋ jiy bëët, kiper eni cuŋŋö ni wïth jiy bëët ee thiel piny. Ni kanya jap wëëlö jiy bëët gena put ö maal.
english: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

anywaa: Køøre Edhera Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa dwøŋ, apwøe. Kanyøgø jiy bëët ceŋge aputge tïŋ maal ni jølge gø, ni «Beeye kare, beeye kare;» ni putge cøŋge këël piny, ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk ni täärnyïmge ege këël piny.
english: And Ezra blessed the Lord, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the Lord with their faces to the ground.

anywaa: Køøre thuwø, jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beeye Jëcua, ki Bani, ki Cërëbiya, ki Jamin, ka Akup, ki Cabetay, ko Odiya, ki Maycëya, ki Kelitha, ka Adhariya, ki Jödhabat, ka Anan, ki Pelaya, tiet ciik acaange døøc jï jiy, ni jiy poot bëëdö ni cuŋŋö karge,
english: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.

anywaa: ni marge kwaan wëël ciik Jwøk, ni ge løga tier gø kiper nee tiere ci cwïny jiy kany wø kwaani.
english: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Neemiya, ŋata bëëdö na kwäärö mar paac, ki dïlämi ma Edhera, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, jøøa caan tiet ciik Jwøk jï jiy, gena köö jï jiy bëët, ni «Dïcäŋ man en atïmö ni ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru; uuni, käru jwöŋö ni ba kïmmu.» Kiper jiy bëët gena bëëdö ni ge jwöŋö kanya wïnyge luup moa en yi wëël ciik Jwøk.
english: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the Lord your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

anywaa: Ni kö Neemiya jïge, ni «Uuni, cou ni cammu cam mana met døc, ni maathu køøŋø mana met døc, ni cïpu thäkge møøk jï jøøa näk bäŋgø jïge mo ege jiiŋŋø; kiper dïcäŋ man en atïmö ni ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk ma Kwäärö marø. Uuni, käru kïmmö, kiper met ec mar Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek maru.»
english: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libay thuwø ni wëëkge jiy bëët lïŋŋö ni köge, ni «Uuni, noukïïl, kiper dïcäŋ man en ena kur keere; uuni, käru kïmmö.»
english: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy bëët gena put aa baŋ cam, ki baŋ maath, ni pääŋge caammi jï jiy, ni wøørge dïcäŋ manøgø ki met ec mo dwøŋ, kiper geni tiet luup moa caan jïge yi wëël ciik Jwøk aci cwïnyge.
english: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri riet nïr dwää abïriiø, dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi mo jiy bëët ki dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay, rege acooŋge kanya ciel buut Edhera eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, kiper nee ïthge cekge døøc ki luup moa en yi wëël ciik Jwøk.
english: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.

anywaa: Køøre geni luubö mana näk ogöör piny yi wëël ciik Jwøk ajootge, ni beeye luubö mana näk ocaan Wuuö Jwøki ki ri Modhe 'ni jø Icriel ge doo bëëdö ni ge wödö yïth abïle kany wø tïme ni ra ajwöma mar dwää abïriiø.
english: And they found written in the law which the Lord had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:

anywaa: Kanyøgø geni luubö aputge gøø piny ni keethge gø yïth mïëri moge bëët ki dï Jerucalem ni köge, ni «Uuni, cou wøk bäät thuuri ni jaaŋŋu bäät jenni mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ki bäät jer paap mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ki bøøk kääc, ki bøøk ïth tuue, ki bäät jenni moa näk onigïït piny, ni kälu geni nee ø gëëdø ka abïle ki køør mana näk ogöör piny.»
english: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy gena put aa wøk, ni kälge bäät jenni, ni gëënge dëëtge ka abïle, ni ö ŋati man nø ni gëëde bäät øde maal, ki yïth käälle moge, ki yïth käälle mo Øt Jwøk, ki kanya leer na en nyïm dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Pïï, ki kanya leer na en nyïm dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Ipariem.
english: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët moa duuö na mak ki tøŋ ni gëëtge ka abïle ni bëëtge yïthge. Ka adïëri møn, teeŋ ajwöma manøgø poot kär wøør jø Icrielli cøøn ki mana täge ki ri nïr Jøcua o Nun këël dïcäŋ manøgø. Ni met ec marge manøgø beeye met ec mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhera abëëdö ni wëël ciik Jwøk kwaane kwaanø ki yïth nïne bëët ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ këël mana këët yi cäŋ mana näk aŋuudi. Gena bëëdö ni ge wøøra ajwöma ki nïne abïriiø; 'ba na tïme na ri bäc nïne, gena jïtö ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere ki køør luubö mana näk ocïp piny.
english: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää abïriiø ni pïërariiø ka aŋween, jø Icriel dëëtge acooŋge kanya ciel, ni bëëtge ni ge ba cämö, ni keece ege røø dëëtge na abïïe, ni bäätge ege kunynyö ki tør ni ge jwönna dëëtge.
english: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Icriel dëëtge akälge wøk ki røk juurre, ni öge maal ni køpge raay moge, ki gïïa reyø na tïïc kwäcge.
english: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni jiy poot cuŋŋö karge, geni wëël ciik mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, akwaange ki kany mo thääŋ cäŋ ee ŋwömmö; ni cäŋge bëëdö ki kany mo thääŋ cäŋ ee ŋwömmö ni ge køpa raay moge, ni ge wøøra Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge.
english: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the Lord their God.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa näk cuŋŋö bäät thudhi beeye Jëcua, ki Bani, ki Kadmiël, ki Cebaniya, ki Buni, ki Cërëbiya, ki Bani, ki Kenani, ni geni, ge cøøra Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ni döötge ena maal døc.
english: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the Lord their God.

anywaa: Køøre jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege Jëcua, ki Kadmiël, ki Bani, ka Acabeniya, ki Cërëbiya, ko Odiya, ki Cebaniya, ki Petaya, gena köö, ni «Ööu maal ni pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, eni na nut cøøn ni bëëdö na bäre bäre.» Køøre jiy abwøthge ki lam ni köge, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwøc en ri nyeŋŋï na näk nyeŋ ajiem na bëëdö ni ena maal ni kaala nyeŋŋi bëët moa näk opwøø.
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the Lord your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

anywaa: Bee ï keerï na Wuuö Jwøk. Ni bee ï na cwääc maal, këël maal kuya, ki gïïa en yie bëët, ni bee ï na cwääc piny ki gïïa en yie bëët, ni bee ï na cwääc näpa døøŋŋø ki gïïa en yïthge bëët, ni bee ï ni wø cïp kwøw jï gïïa kwøw bëët, ni ö gïïa en maalli ni wøørge ïïni.
english: Thou, even thou, art Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.

anywaa: «Ïïni, bee ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa jier Abram, ni kälï eni wøk ki yi paana cwøl ni Ur, yi ŋööm jø Kaldia, ni cagï nyeŋŋe ni Eeberam.
english: Thou art the Lord the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and gavest him the name of Abraham;

anywaa: Ni jootï eni na dhaanhø mo cwïnye ena baŋï, ni tudï ki luubö ki eni ki man cïpï ŋøøm jï jøw käl dëëre, ni beeye ŋööm jø Keenan, ki mar jø Këth, ki mar jø Amör, ki mar jø Përec, ki mar jø Jeebuc, ki mar jø Gërgëca, ni putï luumma caanï wëëk thur kare, kiper marï adïëri.
english: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:

anywaa: «Ïïni, caarø mar kwäcwa ajootï kanya bëëtge Ijep, ni wïnynyï oduuru marge kanya enge bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;

anywaa: Ïïna tïïö ki nyuuthe ki gïï mo rëëma ec dëër Peerø ki dëët jiye moa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët, ki dëët jiy bëët moa en yi ŋöömö mare, kiper ïïni, gïna tïïcge ni bëëtge ni ge töödö bäät jiyï ki gø ŋäyï. Ïïni, nyeŋŋï atïïyï nee wïnye kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.

anywaa: Ïïni, Naama Kwaar apääŋŋï ki dïëre nyïm jiyï, ni putge cør dï naam ni ge cäädhi ka kany mo otal; 'ba jøøa ŋwiec køørge, gena leeŋï yi naam kanya päŋ døc kaamar kïdi mo oleeŋa yïth pïï mo kwödö døc.
english: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.

anywaa: Ïïni, jiyï abwøthï ki dïcäŋ, ni ge bwøthï ki pöölö mo ree ee wenyø, ni bwøthï geni ki wäär ki pöölö mo ree ee wenyø mo liel kaamar maac, nee jöörge meenye kany cørge yie.
english: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.

anywaa: «Ïïni, ïïna ö piny bäät Kïn Caynay ni cäänï ki jiyï niï ena maal, ni cïpï luup ŋøl moï na thïïŋ jïge, ki ciik moï na näk adïëri, ki pwöc moï ki gïïa cemï na beyø.
english: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:

anywaa: Ïïni, cäŋ jwömö marï na en kur keere acaanï jïge nee ŋäcge, ni cïpï pwöc moï, ki gïïa cemï, ki ciik moï jïge ki ri dhaanhnhï ma Modhe.
english: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:

anywaa: Ïïni, ïïna cïpö ki cam jïge mo ööi ki maal kiper käc marge, ni wëëgï pïï kwön wøk ki yi kïdi jïge kiper riew marge. Ïïni, acaanï jïge nee dønyge yi ŋöömö nee lwørge na marge, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋï kipere ni cïpï cïbö jïge.
english: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.

anywaa: «'Ba geni na kwäcwa gena tïmö ni marge atöör, ni døøcge wïthge mo teek, ni kärge ciik moï wïnynyö.
english: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

anywaa: Geni, gena kweer ki man cekge ïthge, ni kärge tïïe moï lääŋŋö moa näk rëëma ec na tïïyï yïthakicge. Gena tïmö ni wïthge teek, ni kwänyge ki dïbwödhi mo dwøga geni yi bëët laŋ Ijep. 'Ba ïïni, ïïna Jwø wø wëën jiy, ni wø nyooth met ec mare, ki mëër mare, ni wø ba laar wëër, ni mëëye ni wø ba jøøl päl. Ïïni, jiyï kärï wiiø.
english: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.

anywaa: Këël kanya lëënyge rege ki warkey, ni tïïcge gø na nyirøøa man lamge, ni köge, ni ‹Man beeye Jwøk maru na käl u wøk ki Ijep,› ni marge beeye ajaany mo dwøŋ kiree,
english: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

anywaa: ïïni, ki køør mëër marï na päl, ge kärï wii dï paap; 'ba pöölö mo ree ee wenyø poot bëëdö ni bwøtha geni ki øtjöö marge ki dïcäŋ; ni pöölö mo ree ee wenyø mo liel kaamar maac poot bwøtha geni ki wäär, ni meenya jöörge kany cørge yie.
english: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.

anywaa: Ni ö jwïëy moï na beyø ni bëëde bäätge ni pwönynya geni, ni ö møø marï mana cwøl ni meena ni kärï gø paanyø dhøkge, ni mooyï geni ki pïï kiper riew marge.
english: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.

anywaa: Ïïni, gena gwøgï dï paap ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, ni bäŋ gïn mo geno can ki gø; geni abïïe moa en dëëtge kär ränynyö, ni tietge kär kwöt ki wääth.
english: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

anywaa: «Ïïni, mïëc akwöm mo nyeye, ki mïëc wïth juurre acïpï jïge, ni beege mïëri moa kïïge ki geni; ni ö geni ni lwørge ŋööm Cëëwön nyeny jø Ëcbön, ki ŋööm Ög nyeny jø Baacan.
english: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

anywaa: Ïïni, kwään nyïïkwaacge atïïyï ni thööth ni caala ceec maal, ni 'kälï geni yi ŋöömö mana caanï jï kwäcge 'ni ge cøøa yie nee lwørge na marge.
english: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïkwaacge ni dønyge yi ŋöömö ni lwørge gø na marge. Ni dïïmï jiy mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø, ni beege jø Keenan; ni cïbï geni ceŋ jiyï, geni ki nyeye moge, ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø, nee käärge ki jöö mana manyge jaak.
english: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyï ni macge päänye moa näk ogeerø ni teek ki ŋöömma beer. Ni lwørge uudi mo yïthge päŋ ki jammi moa beyø, ka aguule mo okoonyø mo wø cuŋ pïïyi yïthge, ki pwöth omøki, ki jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, ki jenni mo wø nyïïge cam, thööth jaak. Ni cämge ni jäŋge, ni lørge, ni bëëtge ni yïthge met ki jammi moa beyø na thööth na cïpï jïge.
english: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

anywaa: «'Ba geni, luummï kärge wïnynyö; gena gëëmö ki ïïni, ni løøge ciik moï ŋäthge. Geni nyïïkuk Jwøk moï anäkge, jøøa kööm geni ki man luuge rege baŋï, ni ö geni ni bëëtge ni marge beeye ajaany mo dwøŋ kiree.
english: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena cïbï ceŋ nyïïmän moge, jøøa caar geni; 'ba kanya jwöŋge dëërï ni ge ena yïth gïï mo leth, marge awïnynyï niï ena maal. Køøre ïïni, ki køør mëër marï na päl, ïïna cïpö jïge ki jiy mo käla geni wøk ceŋ nyïïmän moge.
english: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya jïtge ki jwöm ennø, gena cäŋ tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø nyïmï, ni cïbï geni ceŋ nyïïmän moge, ni bëëtge ni ge ena tietge. 'Ba kanya cäŋge jwöŋö dëërï, marge awïnynyï niï ena maal; køøre ïïni ki køør mëër marï, gena køønynyï ki kwöre mo thööth.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;

anywaa: «Ni köömmï geni ki man cäŋge rege luu baŋ ciik moï. 'Ba gena tïmö ni marge atöör, ni luup moa cemï ba wïnyge, ni bëëtge ni ge baya luup ŋøl moï moa caanï 'ni ni näk mo ogwøk dhaanhe, dhaanhø kwøw ki køørge. 'Ba geni, ki køør teek wïc marge, gena bëëdö ni wïthge ege cwiidø, ni ïthge ba cekge.
english: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

anywaa: Ba këël na bëëtge na enøgønø, ïïna bëëdö ki geni ki cwiiri mo thööth ni cwïnyï iï cïp piny, niï köömma geni ki ri Jwïëyï na en kur keere, ki ri nyïïkuk Jwøk moï. 'Ba geni ïthge kärge ciiø; køøre gena cïbï ceŋ wïth juurre.
english: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mëër marï na  päl, ge kärï wiiø, ni ge kärï raanynyø na bäre; kiper ïïna Jwø wø nyooth met ec, ni ïïna Jwø mëër.
english: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Jwøk marwa en, ï na Jwøa dwøŋ na teek, ni wø kwany dëëlli nyïme, ni wø gwøk luum mëër mana näk ba jøøl na tuude, gïï ni wø tägi ni leth ii, kär nëënö jïrï kaamar nyi gïn mo thiinh jaak, ni beege gïïa tägö dëëtwa, ki dëët nyeye mowa, ki dïbwöthe mowa, ki dïlämme mowa, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk mowa, ki kwäcwa, ki jiyï bëët, ni beeye ki mana täge ki ri nïr nyeye mo jø Aciria këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, marï adïëri ki røk gïïa tägö dëëtwa bëët, kiper ï bëëdö niï tïïya adïëri; ba waani, waana bëëdö ni wa tïïya gïï mo reyø.
english: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:

anywaa: Kiper nyeye mowa, ki dïbwöthe mowa, ki dïlämme mowa, ki kwäcwa, ciik moï kärge gwøø, ni ïthge kärge ciiø ki gïïa cemï, ki köömmö mana köömmï geni ki gø.
english: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëtge ni ge ena ya akwöm nyec marge, ni gïïa beyø na thööth na cïpï jïge nut yi ŋöömma päl na beer na cïpï jïge, geni, ï kärge tïnynyö, ni tïïe moge na reyø kärge wiiø.
english: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ka adïëri møn, waana laaŋe dïcäŋi ennø; waana laaŋe møn yi ŋöömma cïpï jï kwäcwa nee bëëtge ni ge cama caammi mo wø ciek yie ki gïïa beyø mo wø ciek yie.
english: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør raay moa tïïcwa, caammi mo wø ciek yie na thööth atïmö ni cøøa baŋ nyeye moa røønyï bäätwa; ni wa ki dëëtwa ki dhäk mowa, wa käärge kaawat man wø manyge jaak. Ni ennø, wa ena yi bëëtö mo leth døc.
english: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

anywaa: «'Ba kiper gïïögø bëët, waani wa kööŋ ki luubö mo wa rööpa ree bëët mo gööra piny, ni mwöni, mo nyeŋ dïbwöthe mowa ki jø tuuŋ Libay mowa, ki dïlämme mowa ogöör bääte.»
english: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk nyeŋge ogöör piny bäät wëëlö manøgø no omwönö enø, beeye kwäärö mar paac ma Neemiya wär Akaliya, ki Cëdëkiya.
english: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ dïlämme beege Ceraya, ka Adhariya, ki Jeremaya,
english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

anywaa: ki Pacuur, ka Amariya, ki Malkiya,
english: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,

anywaa: ka Atuc, ki Cebaniya, ki Maluk,
english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

anywaa: ka Arim, ki Merëmöt, ko Øbadiya,
english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

anywaa: ki Daniel, ki Ginetön, ki Baruk,
english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

anywaa: ki Meculam, ka Abija, ki Miyamin,
english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

anywaa: ki Maadhiya, ki Bilgay, ki Cemaya.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jø tuuŋ Libay beeye Jëcua wär Adhaniya, ki Binuy na käl røk nyïïkwaac Ënadat, ki Kadmiël,
english: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

anywaa: ki jø wø tïïge ki geni ciel, ni beege Cebaniya, ko Odiya, ki Kelitha, ki Pelaya, ka Anan,
english: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

anywaa: ki Mika ki Reeyöp, ka Acabiya,
english: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,

anywaa: ki Dhakur, ki Cërëbiya, ki Cebaniya,
english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

anywaa: ko Odiya, ki Bani, ki Beninu.
english: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ dïbwöthe moa käär jiy beege Paröc, ki Paath-Möap, ki Ilam, ki Dhatu, ki Bani,
english: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath–moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

anywaa: ki Buni, ka Adhigad, ki Bëbay,
english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

anywaa: ka Adöniya, ki Bigway, ka Adin,
english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

anywaa: ka Ather, ki Edhekaya, ka Adhur,
english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

anywaa: ko Odiya, ka Acum, ki Bëdhay,
english: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

anywaa: ka Arip, ka Anathöth, ki Nëbay,
english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

anywaa: ki Magpic, ki Meculam, ki Ëdhir,
english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

anywaa: ki Mecëdhabël, ki Dhadök, ki Jadua,
english: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

anywaa: ki Pelathiya, ka Anan, ka Anaya,
english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

anywaa: ka Awcë, ka Ananiya, ka Acub,
english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,

anywaa: ka Alöec, ki Pilaa, ki Cöbëk,
english: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

anywaa: ki Reum, ka Acabna, ki Maycëya,
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

anywaa: ka Akiya, ka Anan, ka Anen,
english: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

anywaa: ki Maluk, ka Arim, ki Baanaa.
english: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møga bëët, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø koor dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, ki jiy bëët moa käl dëëtge wøk ki røk wïth juurre ki man cïpge dëëtge jï ciik Jwøk, geni ki määrge ki wäätge, ki nyïïge, ni beege jøøa näk tier luubö cøøa wïthge,
english: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;

anywaa: gena dwätö ki nyïïmëëkge, ni beege dïbwöthe moge, ni lamge dëëtge ni kööŋge ki man cääthge køør ciik Jwøk na cïp Jwøki ki ri dhaanhnhe ma Modhe,  ki man gwøkge gïïa cem kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bëët, Jwøk marø, ki luup ŋøl moe, ki pwöc moe, ni köge,
english: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the Lord our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;

anywaa: ni «Nyïïø ba cïbø jï juurre nee nywømge, ni ba lwørø nyïïge nee nywømø jï wäätø.
english: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:

anywaa: «Ni kanyo ö wïth juurre noo känge ki beel ki jammi mo di gadhø ki Cäŋ Jwömö, øøni, ø ba ŋëëö baŋge ki Cäŋ Jwömö, ki cäŋ mo ena kur keere na mar Jwøk. Øøni, kany wø tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri, ø ba purö, ni wiiø pïït bëët bäät jiy, ni ba piirø këët.
