english: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

anywaa: «Øøni, ki køør ciik moa näk ocïp piny, ajwäk tïmö ni ena bäätø ki man cïpø ka ajwää cwiir, ni ŋati man nø cïpö ki thääŋ gwelø man wø cwøl ni cekel, ni beeye kiper tïïc mar Øt Jwøk marø,
english: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

anywaa: kiper muunni moa näk nyuuthe na en kur keerge, kiper muuce mo beel mo wø cïp cooth, kiper olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo wø cïp cooth, kiper olämme mo wø cïp ki Cäŋ Jwömö, ki cäŋ ajwöma man wø en dïcäŋo päär dwääyi yie, ki cääŋŋe mo ajwöm moa näk ocaanø, kiper muuce moa en kur keerge na mo Jwøk, kiper olämme mo wø cïp kiper raay, ni cïp kaper jø Icriel, kiper tïïe bëët mo Øt Jwøk marø.
english: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

anywaa: «Øøni, nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ni pätha baŋ jøøi nø atïïø kiper dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jiy møga, kiper nee jøøi nø ki yi cwiir kany wø pïïc karge yie, nee ge wø känge ki jenni mo otal jï Øt Jwøk marø, kiper nee wø waaŋ bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, kaawat mana näk ogöörö yi wëël ciik Jwøk. Ni jøøi nø ge känni ka køør dhøk uudi moge.
english: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law:

anywaa: «'Ba øøni, ki yi cwiir cooth ø kännö ki wïth caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek yi ŋöömö marø, ki wïth nyïïjenni bëët mo wø kwøŋ ciek, ni kälø geni yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the Lord:

anywaa: «Øøni, ki køør mana näk ogöörö yi wëël ciik Jwøk, wäätø moa näk kaai, ki nyïï lääc paac 'moø moa näk kaai, ki nyïï dhäk 'moø moa näk kaai, ki nyïï dïëk 'moø moa näk kaai kälø yi Øt Jwøk marø jï dïlämme 'moø ni tïïö yi Øt Jwøk marø yøø.
english: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:

anywaa: «Øøni thuwø, muk beel 'moø moa nyärö, ki muuce mo thwöth beel 'moø, ki nyïïjenni ma teeŋi mo wø kwøŋ ciek, ki kwøk nyïïomøki moa nyärö, ki maaw man wø kwøŋ wel, cïbø cïbö jï dïlämme yi øt kän mar Øt Jwøk marø, ni cïbø paac wïth jammi 'moø mo wø joodø yi ŋöömö marø jï jø tuuŋ Libay, kiper beeye jø tuuŋ Libay ni wø jwäk paac wïth jammi yïth mïëri bëët moa en jø puuri yïthge.
english: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi man nø, ni beege jøøa käl dëër Aran, bëëdö ki jø tuuŋ Libay moi nø na aciel kany wø ö jø tuuŋ Libayi ni wø jwäkge paac wïth jammi. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Libayi ni cïpge aciel ki ra apaar ni kïthge gø yïth uut kän mo Øt Jwøk marø.
english: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.

anywaa: Jø Icriel thuwø ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ajwäk mar beel moge, ki mar køøŋ nyïïomøki moa nyärö, ki maaw, wø kälge ka yïth uut kän kwöra bëët jap Øt Jwøki yïthge, kwöra bëët dïlämme yïthge moa en tïïci ceŋge, ki jø wø koor dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Jwøk ki jø wø wär ki dudi yi Øt Jwøk. «Øøni Øt Jwøk marø ba raŋø na gïn mo jööt jaak.»
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwöthe gena bëëdö ni ge bëëdö Jerucalem. 'Ba jiy bëët møga nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ni pätha bäät ŋati man nø atïïcge, ni ŋato päth bääte nø røk jiy apaar nee kälge nee bëëde Jerucalem, päänya en kur keere na mar Jwøk, nee jiy abïŋween moi nø mo odööŋ ki ra apaar nee bëëtge ni ge bëëdö yïth päänye møga.
english: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa jïëy keerge ki met ec ki man bëëtge Jerucalem, gena pwøc jiyi.  'Ba da dïbwöthe mo paac mo bëëdö Jerucalem. 'Ba jø Icriel møøk, ki dïlämme, ki jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, ki nyïïkwaac laak Cølöman, moa bëëdö yïth päänye mo Juuda, ge bëëdö ni ŋati man nø bëëdö yïth ŋøøpe, yi pääny mare mana bëëde yie.
english: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy møøk røk jø tuuŋ Juuda, ki røk jø tuuŋ Benjamen mo bëëdö Jerucalem. Ni jøøa käl ri tuuŋ Juuda beeye Athaya wär Udhaya, nyikwaar Dhekaraya, nyikwaar Amariya, nyikwaar Cepathiya nyikwaar Maalalel, ni jøøgø ge käla røk nyïïkwaac Peereth;
english: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;

anywaa: ki Maycëya o Baruk, nyikwaar Köl-Ödhë, nyikwaar Adhaya, nyikwaar Adaya, nyikwaar Jöyarip, nyikwaar Dhekaraya, ni jøøgø ge käla røk nyïïkwaac Ceela.
english: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col–hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jøøa käl dëër Peereth bëët, jøøa teek ki leny, na bëëdö Jerucalem, beege jiy ma dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïciel ka abära.
english: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl ri tuuŋ Benjamen beeye Caallu o Meculam, nyikwaar Jöed, nyikwaar Pedaya, nyikwaar Kölaya, nyikwaar Maycëya, nyikwaar Itiel, nyikwaar Jicaya;
english: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

anywaa: ki Gabay ki Calay, geni na dwätö ki Calu. Ni kwään jø tuuŋ Benjamen bëët beege dïpe abïŋween ki pïërariiø ka abära.
english: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.

anywaa: 'Ba Jool o Dhikri beeye ŋata bëëdö na wïth jøøgø yi pääny, ni ö Juuda wär Acenua ni bëëde ni ena ŋat wø caath køør kwäärö mar pääny.
english: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk dïlämme, beeye Jidaya, ki Jöyarip, ki Jaakin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.

anywaa: ki Ceraya o Kilkiya, nyikwaar Meculam, nyikwaar Dhadök, nyikwaar Merayöt, nyikwaar Akitöp, na bëëdö ni øt Jwøk ena cere.
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba geni ki jiy mo wø tïïge ki geni ciel Øt Jwøk, kwäänge beege dïpe abära ki pïërariiø ka ariiø. 'Ba Adaya wär Jeröam, nyikwaar Pelaliya, nyikwaar Amci, nyikwaar Dhekaraya, nyikwaar Pacuur, nyikwaar Malkiya,
english: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah,

anywaa: ki jiy mo wø tïïö ki eni ciel, ni beege jø wïth dhøk uudi, kwäänge beege dïpe ariiø ki pïëraŋween ka ariiø. 'Ba Amacicay wär Adharël, nyikwaar Aydhay, nyikwaar Mecilemöth, nyikwaar Imër,
english: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

anywaa: ki jø leny moa teek moa bëëdö ki eni ciel, kwäänge beege dïpa ki pïërariiø ka abära. Ni ŋata bëëdö na wïthge beeye Dhabdïël wär Agedölim.
english: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø tuuŋ Libay beeye Cemaya wär Acub, nyikwaar Adhirikam, nyikwaar Acabiya, nyikwaar Buni;
english: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

anywaa: ki Cabetay, ki Jödhabat, jøøa bëëdö na wïth jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege jø wø raŋ tïïe mo wø tïïc wøk kiper øt Jwøk;
english: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.

anywaa: ki Mataniya o Mika, nyikwaar Dhabdi, nyikwaar Acaap. Ni Mataniya beeye ni wø bwøth jiy ki lam, ri pwøc mar dwøk met ec jï Jwøk, ki Bakbukiya, na caath køør Mataniya dï jø wø tïïge ki geni ciel, ka Abda o Cimia nyikwaar Galal, nyikwaar Jeduthun.
english: And Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay bëët moa en yi Jerucalem, päänya en kur keere na mar Jwøk, kwäänge beeye dïpe ariiø ki pïërabära ka aŋween.
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir beege Akup, ki Thalmön, ki jiy mo wø tïïge ki geni ciel mo wø koor dhøgi mo kiir, ni kwäänge beeye dïpa ki pïërabïriiø ka ariiø.
english: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel møga, ki jø tuuŋ dïlämme møga, ki jø tuuŋ Libay møga, ge bëëdö yïth mïëri mo Juuda møga bëët, ni ŋati man nø bëëdö yïth ŋøøpe.
english: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, ge bëëdö bäät thuur Öpël; ni ö Dhia ki Gicpa ni bëëtge na jø wø raŋ jøøgø ni wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk yøø.
english: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata bëëdö Jerucalem ni wø raŋ jø tuuŋ Libay, beeye Udhi o Bani, nyikwaar Acabiya, nyikwaar Mataniya, nyikwaar Mika. Ni Udhi beeye na käl røk nyïïkwaac Acaap, jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk.
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.

anywaa: Kiper geni ni wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, geno kööm nyeye ki man bëëtge ni ge tïïya tïïc marge cooth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.

anywaa: 'Ba Petaya o Mecëdhabël, na käl røk nyïïkwaac Dheera o Juuda, bëëdö na kar waŋ mar nyeya, ni luup jiy bëët ena cere.
english: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuda møøk gena bëëdö yïth mïëri moi ni nyeŋge en piny kany ii, ni ge bëëdö ni kar pwöth moge cärö ki geni. Jø møøk gena bëëdö yi Kiriat-Arba, ka atude moa en deŋŋe; jø møøk gena bëëdö Dibön ka atude moa en deŋŋe; ni bëët jø møøki yi Jekapdheel ka atude moa en deŋŋe;
english: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjath–arba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,

anywaa: ni bëëtge Jëcua, ki Mölada, ki Bëëth-Pëlët,
english: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth–pelet,

anywaa: ka Adhar-Cuwal, ki Bëërcïïba, ka atude moa en deŋŋe;
english: And at Hazar–shual, and at Beer–sheba, and in the villages thereof,

anywaa: ki Ciklak, ki Meköna, ka atude moa en deŋŋe;
english: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,

anywaa: ki ya Ayn Rimön, ki Dhöra, ki Jërmut;
english: And at En–rimmon, and at Zorah, and at Jarmuth,

anywaa: ki Dhanöwa, ka Adulam, ki yïth mïëri moa en deŋge; ki Lakic, ki yïth pwöth moe; ka Adhëka ka atude moa en deŋŋe. Ni kwöra bëëtge yïthge atägö ki Bëërcïïba këël mana këët goor Inöm.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beer–sheba unto the valley of Hinnom.

anywaa: 'Ba mïëri moa bëët jø tuuŋ Benjamenni yïthge beege Gëba, ki Mikmac, ki Gaay; ki Bëthël ka atude moa en deŋŋe,
english: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Beth–el, and in their villages,

anywaa: ka Anathöth, ki Nöp, ka Ananaya,
english: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

anywaa: ka Adhör, ki Reema, ki Gitayim,
english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

anywaa: ka Adid, ki Dheböym, ki Nebalat,
english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

anywaa: ki Löt, ko Onö, ki yi Gool Mar Rëëmme.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

anywaa: 'Ba thäk jø tuuŋ Libay møøk moa kwøŋ bëëdö yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Juuda, gena bëëdö yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege nyeŋ dïlämme ki nyeŋ jø tuuŋ Libay moa kwøŋ duuö ki Babiløn ni ge cäädhi ka Dherubabel o Celatiyal, ki Jøcua na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Ni nyeŋ dïlämme beeye Ceraya, ki Jeremaya, ki Edhera,
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

anywaa: ka Amariya, ki Maluk, ka Atuc,
english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

anywaa: ki Cekaniya, ki Reum, ki Merëmöt,
english: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

anywaa: ki Idö, ki Ginetön, ka Abaaja,
english: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

anywaa: ki Miyamin, ki Maadiya, ki Bilga,
english: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

anywaa: ki Cemaya, ki Jöyarip, ki Jidaya,
english: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,

anywaa: ki Caallu, ka Amök, ki Kilkiya, ki Jidaya. Moøgø beege nyeŋ dïlämme moa näk dïbwöthe, ki dïlämme mo wø tïïge ki geni ciel yïth nïra beet Jøcua ni ena dïlämi mana dwøŋ.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ jø tuuŋ Libay beeye Jëcua, ki Binuy, ki Kadmiël, ki Cërëbiya, ki Juuda, ki Mataniya, ŋat wø bwøth jiy ki dudi ri pwøc mar dwøk met ec jï Jwøk, eni ki jiy mo wø tïïö ki eni ciel.
english: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.

anywaa: Ni kany wø wärge, Bakbukiya ko Oni, jø wø tïïge ki geni ciel, nut kany wø päth tïïci marge ceŋge yie. Ni ge cuŋŋö ni dïët ki nyïmge ni ge wär thuwø.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ beeye wää Jöyakim, ni Jöyakim beeye wää Eliyacip, ni Eliyacip beeye wää Jöyada,
english: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,

anywaa: ni Jöyada beeye wää Jönathan, ni Jönathan beeye wää Jadua.
english: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøi ii ni nyeŋge en piny kany ii beege dïlämme moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi yïth nïra beet Jöyakimmi ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ: Ki røk jø dhi øt Ceraya beeye Meraya, ki røk jø dhi øt Jeremaya beeye Ananiya,
english: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Edhera beeye Meculam, ki røk jø dhi øt Amariya beeye Jöanan,
english: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Maluk beeye Jönathan, ki røk jø dhi øt Cebaniya beeye Jocep,
english: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Arim beeye Adina, ki røk jø dhi øt Merayöt beeye Ëlkay,
english: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Idö beeye Dhekaraya, ki røk jø dhi øt Ginetön beeye Meculam,
english: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Abaaja beeye Dhikri, ki røk jø dhi øt Miniamin, ki dhi øt Möadiya beeye Pilthay,
english: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Bilga beeye Cimia, ki røk jø dhi øt Cemaya beeye Jönathan,
english: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jonathan;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Jöyarip beeye Mathanay, ki røk jø dhi øt Jidaya beeye Udhi,
english: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Calay beeye Kalay, ki røk jø dhi øt Amök beeye Eber,
english: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

anywaa: ki røk jø dhi øt Kilkiya beeye Acabiya, ki røk jø dhi øt Jidaya beeye Natanel.
english: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi na nut yïth nïra beet dïlämme moa døøŋŋø ma Eliyacip, ki Jöyada, ki Jöanan, ki Jadua, nyeŋge agöör piny, ki nyeŋ dïlämme moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi, këël mana këët yïth nïra beet Dariöc ni ena nyeny Parca.
english: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa bëëdö na wïth dhøk uudi, gena bëëdö ni nyeŋge gööra piny yi wëël nyeŋ jiy moa perge leth këël mana këët yïth nïra beet dïlämi ma Jöananni nyikwaar Eliyacip.
english: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa bëëdö na wïth jø tuuŋ Libay beeye Acabiya, ki Cërëbiya, ki Jëcua o Kadmiël, ki jiy mo wø tïïge ki geni ciel ni ge pwøya Jwøk ni ge dwøga met ec jï Jwøk; ni jøøgø ge cuŋŋö ni ge dïët ki nyïmge kany wø päth tïïci marge ceŋge yie ki køør mana näk ocaan dhaanh Jwøki ma Deebit.
english: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.

anywaa: Ni ö Mataniya, ki Bakbukiya ko Øbadiya, ki Meculam, ki Thalmön, ka Akup, jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir, ni bëëtge ni ge koora uut kän moa en dhøgi mo kiir.
english: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët beege jiy moa tïïö yïth nïra beet Jöyakimmi o Jøcua nyikwaar Jöcëdëk ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki yïth nïra beet Neemiya ni ena kwäärö mar paac, ki yïth nïra beet dïlämi ma Edhera, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk.
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na cäŋa cïp kiir mar Jerucalem kur keere yie na mar Jwøk, jø tuuŋ Libay amanynyi yïth kwöra bëëtge yïthge bëët, ni käl geni Jerucalem nee cäŋ manøgø mana cïp kiir yie kur keere na mar Jwøk wøørge ki met ec, ki dudi mo dwøk met ec, ki dudi mo wär ka athiliiŋŋi, ki mo pwöt ki thøme ki thøp-othïënhö.
english: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø wär ki dudi yi Øt Jwøk ni öge kanya ciel ni ge käli ka yïth mïëri moa en deŋ Jerucalem, ki yïth mïëri mo jø Nethöpa,
english: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;

anywaa: ki moa en Bëëth-Gëlgëla, ki moa bëëdö yïth kwöra en deŋ pääny Gëba, ki deŋ pääny Adhemawët. Kiper jø wø wär ki dudi yi Øt Jwøk dëëtge ege gëënnö ka atude deŋ Jerucalem.
english: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay na nø cïpge dëëtge kur keerge ni ge waany, geni, jiy ki dhøgi mo kiir ki kiir acïpge kur keerge ni ge tïïya geni ni waany.
english: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

anywaa: Køøre a na Neemiya, dïbwöthe mo jø Juuda, gena tïïa nee ethge wï kiir maal, ni ö jiyi mo thööth døc, jø wø wär ki dut dwøk met ec jï Jwøk, ni cïïmma geni na dhøgi ariiø, nee mana dïkwøŋ cør bäät kiir løøa en bäät cwïïc jï kuna en dhi kiiri yie man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Wï Thur ni ge tïïö ki thaabuur.
english: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:

anywaa: Ni ö Ocaya ki thäk dïbwöthe mo Juuda, ni caathge køør jøøgø,
english: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

anywaa: geni ka Adhariya, ki Edhera, ki Meculam,
english: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,

anywaa: ki Juuda, ki Benjamen, ki Cemaya, ki Jeremaya;
english: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

anywaa: ki dïlämme møøk mo ceŋge da tuŋi, ki Dhekaraya wär Jönathan, nyikwaar Cemaya, nyikwaar Mataniya, nyikwaar Mikaya, nyikwaar Dhakur, nyikwaar Acaap;
english: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:

anywaa: ki jø wø tïï Dhekaraya ki geni ciel, ni beeye Cemaya, ka Adharël, ki Milëlay, ki Gilëlay, ki Maay, ki Natanel, ki Juuda, ka Anani, ni geni ceŋge da teeŋ jammi mo wø wär dudi ki geni ki køør mana caan dhaanh Jwøki ma Deebit. Ni ö Edhera, eni na dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, ni cäädhe nyïmge.
english: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

anywaa: Ni ŋutge ki dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jøøro, ni ge etha maal ki øtjöö mana näk okïthö ki kwör tiel thääŋ Jerucalem man wø cwøl ni Pääny Deebit, ni pööthge ki bäät kiir mana näk wï øt Deebit ee kaalø, ni ge cøøa dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Pïï na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.

anywaa: 'Ba riet jø wø wär ki dut dwøk met ec, gena cør løøk maya ni ge cäädhi ka bäät kiir ni jøw tïïö ki thaabuur, ni aani ki thäk jiy møga wa cäädha køørge, ni cige ni kaalge øt koor man wø cwøl ni Øt Koor Mar Jø Bul Ki Dääpe, ni ge cøøa ri kiir kanya näk odhïŋ,
english: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;

anywaa: ni pööthge ki bäät dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Ipariem, ki bäät dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jecana, ki bäät dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Rec, ki buut Øt Koor Mar Ananel, ki buut øt koor man wø cwøl ni Dïpa, këël mana pïïcge ri dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Dïëk. Ni ö geni ni ŋuutge dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Jø Koor.
english: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc jøw bëëti Øt Jwøk, jøøgø na dhøgi ariiø yøø, na wär ki dut dwøk met ec jï Jwøk, kwörge amaaŋge, ni ööa thuwø ni maa kara ki thäk jø kööre na aciel;
english: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:

anywaa: waani ki dïlämme, ni beeye Eliekim, ki Maycëya, ki Miniamin, ki Mikaya, ki Eliyönay, ki Dhekaraya, ka Ananiya, ni geni ceŋge da tuŋi;
english: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

anywaa: ki jøøa caath køørge, ni beeye Maycëya, ki Cemaya, ki Eliedhar, ko Udhi, ki Jöanan, ki Malkiya, ki Ilam, ki Ëdhör. Ni jø wø wär ki dudi, ge wär ni ge bwøtha Jedheriya.
english: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø jiy acïpö ko olämme mo thööth døc, ni bëëtge ni yïthge met kiper Jwøk acïpö jïge ki met ec mo dwøŋ; ni ö määnni ko obwöre ni mïn yïthge. Ni ö dwør mïn eci mana tägö Jerucalem ni put wïnyö kany mo bäär.
english: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø da jiy maa kwany mo en uut känni ceŋge mo kïth jammi yïthge, ni beege muuce mo beel, ki caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek, ki paac wïth jammi, ki caammi mo wø käli ki yïth pwöth mo mïëri moge, ni beege jammi moa näk ocaanø yi ciik Jwøk kiper nee wø cïp jï dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay. Kiper jø Juuda yïthge amïnnö ki dïlämme ki jø tuuŋ Libay kiper tïïc mana tïïcge.
english: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.

anywaa: Kiper geni tïïc akäärge na kare, ni beeye tïïc mana wøørge Jwøk marge ki gø, ki tïïc mana tïïcge na cïpge jammi kur keerge ki gø na mo Jwøk. Ni geni ki jø wär ki dudi, ki jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir, jøøi nø ge tïïö ka køør mana näk ocaan Deebiti ki wääde ma Cølöman.
english: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

anywaa: Kiper ya acääŋŋe yïth nïra beet Deebiti ka Acaapi, da jiy mo bëëdö na jø wø bwøth jø wø wär ki dudi, na jø wø bwøth jiy ki dut pwøc ki dut dwøk met ec jï Jwøk.
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moa beet Dherubabelli ki yïth nïne moa beet Neemiya, jø Icriel bëët gena bëëdö ni ceŋge jwäkge jwääö ni cïpge cam cooth mar yi cäŋ man nø jï jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk ki jï jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir. Ni ö geni thuwø ni cïpge jammi moa no ocïp kur keerge na mo Jwøk jï jø tuuŋ Libay, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libayi ni cïpge thääŋŋe mør kur keere jï dïlämme ma nyïïkwaac Aran.
english: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace wëël ciik mana cïp Jwøki ki ri Modhe abëëdö ni di kwaanø ni dwøl ena maal ni wïnyö jï jiy; ni mana näk ogöör piny yie na joot yie beeye ni juurre ma jø Amön ki juurre ma jø Möap kärge jïëc ki man nutge ya acooŋ Jwøk na bäre bäre.
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;

anywaa: Kiper geni jø Icriel kärge jølø ki cam ki pïï; 'ba gena tïmö ni marge cïpö ki jammi jï Beelam kiper nee acïëni käl bäät jø Icriel. 'Ba Jwøk marø acïëni manøgø awiile dëëtø ki gwïëth.
english: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi na wïnyge luup moa en yi wëël ciik Jwøk, geni juurre bëët aputge käl wøk ki røk jø Icriel.
english: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode dïkwøŋ, dïlämi ma Eliyacip, na no okwanyø nee uut kän mo Øt Jwøk marø bëëtge ni ena cere, ena nyïïawäädi døc ki Thöbiya.
english: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

anywaa: Ni ö Eliyacipi ni cïpe ki thääŋ øtø mo yie laac jï Thöbiya, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana bëëdö dïkwøŋ ni muuce mo beel  kana yie, ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ki jap Øt Jwøk, ki beel mo wø cïp na paac wïth jammi, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki moa nyärö, ki maaw; ni gïïögø beege gïïa näk ocaanø ni cïp jï jø tuuŋ Libay, ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, ki jø wø koor dhøgi mo kiir; ni poot na øtø man wø kïth jammi yie mo wø jwäk jï dïlämme.
english: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täk gïnögø, a na Neemiya, a tøør Jerucalem; kiper kanya tïme na ri cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka ariiø, moa beet Arthëkcici ni ena nyeny Babiløn, aani, aana døø baŋe, e na nyeya. 'Ba kanya nø bëëda, luum duuö mara akwaaa ki nyeya, ni cïp gø jïra.
english: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïa Jerucalem, gïna raac na tïïc Eliyacipi ajooda, ni beeye gïna tïïe na cïpe ki øtø jï Thöbiya mo ena yi kal mar Øt Jwøk.
english: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.

anywaa: 'Ba aani gïnögø, yia atïmö ni raac ki gø døc, ni puta jap Thöbiya bëët käl wøk ki yi øtø ni beege jap paac moe, ni weta geni.
english: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.

anywaa: Køøre aani, aana cïpö ki dwøl, ni ö jiyi ni thoothge yïth uudi ni cïpge geni kur keerge na mo Jwøk, ni cäŋa jammi dwøk yïthge, ni beege jap Øt Jwøk, ki muuce mo beel, ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, ajooda ni jammi mo wø cïp jï jø tuuŋ Libay kär cïbö jïge, ni ö jø tuuŋ Libayi ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk ni wø tïny Jwøk ni putge aay, ni ŋati man nø døøa baŋ puur yi pwödhö mare.
english: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre aani jø kööre ajääla ni kööa, na «?Aperŋø ni wec Øt Jwøk en?» Køøre aani jø tuuŋ Libay ki jø wø wär ki dudi Øt Jwøk, gena cooŋa kanya ciel ni cïïmma geni kwörge.
english: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuda bëët ni känge ki beel mo wø cïp na paac wïth jammi, ki kwøk nyïïomøki moa nyärö, ki maaw, ni kälge geni yïth uut kän.
english: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

anywaa: Køøre aani, dïlämi ma Celemiya, ki Dhadök dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk, ki ŋat tuuŋ Libay mo nyeŋŋe Pedaya, gena kwanya nee bëëtge ni uut kän ena ceŋge; ni meeda Anan bäätge na ŋat køny geni, ni beeye Anan o Dhakur nyikwaar Mataniya. Kiper jøøgø geno caarø ni geno ŋääth jiyi ki man bëët tïï pääŋ jammi ni ena ceŋge ki man pääŋge jammi jï jø wø tïïge ki geni ciel.
english: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jwøk mara en, lääŋ aani ni ba rwääny tïïe 'moa jïrï ni beege tïïe 'moa na beyø na tïïa kiper øtø marï, ki mana cïïmma jiy yie mo tïny ïïni.
english: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïröka, aana jïtö ki jiy dï Juuda mo cöödhö ki nyïïomøki ki tietge ki cäŋ jwömö, ni marge biic gø na køøŋø; ni jø møøk ge kännö ki beel mo ena yïth keece mo käärge ka bäät arëëni, ki jammi møga ni beege kwøŋ, ki nyïïomøki, ki nyïïolämmi, ki teeŋ wïth tëër møga bëët, ni kälge geni Jerucalem ki cäŋ jwömö. 'Ba aani, jøøgø aköömma ki man ba gäthge ki caammi ki dïcäŋ manøgø.
english: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

anywaa: Jø Tayar thuwø mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem gena bëëdö ni ge kännö ki rec, ki wïth jammi møga bëët mo di gadhø ni gathge geni ki jø Juuda ki cäŋ jwömö Jerucalem.
english: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba aani jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo Juuda ajääla ni kööa jïge, ni «?Uuni, aperŋø ni tïïyu gïn ni raac en, nou tïïya cäŋ jwömö ni ba en kur keere?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, manøgø paa teeŋ gïna kwøŋ kwäyu tïïc, ni ö Jwøki marø ni käl gïï ni leth bëët ii bäätø ki bäät pääny man? 'Ba ennø uuni, u cäŋa wëër mør meet bäät jø Icriel, ki køør mana tïïyu cäŋ jwömö ni ba en kur keere.»
english: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tïïa kany wø tïm pinynyi ni najïïm ennø, ni dhøgi mo kiir mar Jerucalem cøl, ni jøw bunna cäŋ jwömö, aani, a wø cïpö ki dwøl nee dhøgi mo kiir dëët nee bëëtge ni ba jap këël kanyo pööth cäŋ jwömö yie. Køøre aani, jiya møøk acïïmma dhøgi mo kiir kiper  nee bäŋe tëër mo duny yi kiir ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.

anywaa: Ki køør manøgø, dïgäthe, ki jø wø gath wïth teeŋ jammi bëët mo wø gath, geni, ki yie aciel wala kwöre ariiø, gena tïmö ni wäär bäre thöörge thöörö wøk deŋ kiir mar Jerucalem.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gena köömma ni kööa jïge, ni «?Uuni, aperŋø ni wø thöörru wäär bäre nou ena deŋ kiir en? Uuni, ni näk mo cäŋu ka nwøyø, putu ka joot ni cera yaa kïth dëëtu.» Ki mana täge kar kaace nø, geni, ge kär duuö këët ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.

anywaa: Køøre aani, jø tuuŋ Libay aköömma nee dëëtge cïpge kur keerge ki man bëëtge ni ge waany, nee cige nee dhøgi mo kiir koorge ki man bëët cäŋ jwömö ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk. 'Ba ï na Jwøk mara en, lääŋ aani kiper gïn thuwø na tïïa, ni nyoothï met ec marï jïra ki køør mëër marï na päl ni wø ba jøøl.
english: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, ki yïth nïröka, aani, aana jïtö ki jø Juuda mo onyöömmö ki mään mo käla ya Acdöt, ka Amön, ki Möap.
english: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

anywaa: 'Ba thäk obwöre moge, ge cäänö ka dhøk mar jø Acdöt, ki dhøgi mo wïth juurre møga, ni geni dhøk mar jø Juuda kucge ki man cäänge ki gø.
english: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.

anywaa: Køøre aani, gena jääla ni cwöla acïëni bäätge ni pwöda jiy møøk rege, ni nywaada jïëc wïthge, ni wëëga geni kööŋ ki nyeŋ Jwøk nee geni nyïïge ba cïpge këët jï wäät juurre nee nywømge, ni ba kälge nyïï juurre nee nywøm wäätge wala geni.
english: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, na «?Aŋø, paa kiper teeŋ nywöm mo nëëna manøgø nø ni tïm Cølöman na näk nyeny Icriel ni pätha yi bääyö ki gø? Ni ki røk mïëc wïth juurre bëët, bäŋ nyeya mo nëëna Cølöman. Eni Jwøk mare mëër ki eni døc, ni ö Jwøki ni røøny eni na nyeya bäät jø Icriel bëët. 'Ba määr juurre moa nywøme, ena kïthge yi bääyö.
english: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa ba many man wïnywa gø man näk mo gïn ni dwøŋ ni raac en you tïïö, ni tïïyu dëër Jwøk marø, ki køør mana nywømmu määr juurre.»
english: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?

anywaa: Këël dhaanhø aciel røk wäät Jööda o Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ma Eliyacip, ena cø nyi Cenbalat nyï Örönaim. Køøre ena riemma.
english: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jwøk mara en, kär wïïï wïl ki geni kiper gïna tïïcge na jääpge kunhnhö mar dïlämme ki kunhnhö mo ba waany, ni raanyge luubö mana tuut kiper tïï dïlämme, ki mana tuut kiper tïï jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gena kïtha kur keerge ki røk juurre, ni cïïmma tïïe mo dïlämme jïge, ki mo jø tuuŋ Libay, ni ŋati man nø tïïya tïïc mare.
english: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;

anywaa: Aani thuwø jöö man käl jenni moa näk otal ki gø, ki caammi mo wø kwøŋ ciek, atïïa, ni jøøi nø moge kälge ka yi kanya näk ocaanø jïge. 'Ba ï na Jwøk mara en, lääŋ aani ni beer.
english: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

anywaa: Luubö man täga ïth nïr Ayacewëëröc mana bëëdö na nyeya bäät mïëri ma dïpa ki pïërariiø ka abïriiø ki mana täge India këël Ithiöpia,
english: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

anywaa: ni eni ena bäät wälu mare paan dwøŋ yi pääny Cuca, na näk pääny mana dwøŋ mar ŋööm Parca.
english: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moe bäät nyec, ena tïïö ka ajwöm-cam jï jø kööre ki jø tïïc moe; ni kwääri mo tøŋ mo Parca ki mo Mëdön ee cwølø, ki kwääri mo mïëri moa en tiere, ki jiy moa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët.
english: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

anywaa: Ni bëëde ni nyøtha jap kwär mar øt nyec mare, ka ajieme ki dööŋö mare ki nïne mo thööth mo dïpa ki pïërabära.
english: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum nïne moøgø, nyeya acäŋ tïïö ka ajwöm-cam jï jiy bëët moa en yi pääny Cuca paan dwøŋ, moa kwörge døøŋŋø këël moa kwörge therø. Ajwöma manøgø tïïca ya ajïniina mana en yi kal mar nyeya ki nïne abïriiø.
english: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;

anywaa: Ni yi kal mar nyeya oŋwaŋŋø ka abïïk gëëŋŋe mo tar ki mo kïtge caala kït dïmuuy, ni ge bëëdö no olïërö dëët thøøli mo tïïc ka waac lïïna mo mïërö ni kwör møøk näga dïmuur, no otwöö røk oguudi mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö dëët were mo tïïc ka kïte mo mïërö. Ni köömmi mo tïïc ka warkey ki gwel-bïrö ocïp piny bäät kanya näk ocaamø no oŋwaŋŋø ki wïth kïte ma teeŋi mo piilli ni mïrri.
english: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

anywaa: Ni kwøŋ gap ka gïï mo tïïc ka warkey, ni beege gïï mo caala athööthe, mo otïïö na teeŋi. Ni kwøk nyïïomøki ocïp nyeya ni thööth jaak ni cwïnye tar ki ge.
english: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

anywaa: Ni maath maath ki køør luubö mana caan nyeya, ni bäŋ ŋat mo mak ki teek. Kiper nyeya jø tïïc moe ee köömmö nee jiy wëëkge maath keda mano many ŋati man nø.
english: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.

anywaa: 'Ba gwanynyø ma Bacti thuwø atïïö ka ajwöm-cam kiper mään yi paan dwøŋ mar nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc.
english: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni ri bïriet nïne, kanya bëëde ni nyeya omäthö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki ni cwïnye omïnnö, jøøa näk abïriiø na näk odïnö ni wø tïny eni, ni beege Meyuman, ki Bictha, ki Arböna, ki Biktha, ka Abaktha, ki Jëthar, ki Karkac, ajääŋŋe
english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,

anywaa: nee gwanynyø ma Bacti øømmi ni cïbi nyïme na aduda ena wïïe. Manøgø tïïc nyeya kaper nee wøp mar gø nyoodhe jï jiy moa en kar ajwöma, ki kwääri moa öö ki tiet mïëri moe, kiper ena dhaagø mo kïte mïërö døc.
english: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.

anywaa: 'Ba gwanynyø ma Bacti dwøl mana jääŋ nyeya ki dhøk jøøa näk odïnö akwiere. Køøre nyeya agootø døc ni tïm wëërri mare ni liel cwïnye kaamar maac.
english: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya jiy moa wïthge leer mo wø ŋäc gïno tïïc kiper teeŋ luummögø acooŋe; kiper beeye kööŋŋö ki baŋ nyeya ki man cääne nyïm jiy mo wø ŋäc tiet ciik ki ŋøl luup.
english: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:

anywaa: Jaae moa pï piny bäät acooŋa ki nyeya beege Karcëna, ki Cëthar, ka Admatha, ki Tarcëc, ki Mërëc, ki Marcëna, ki Memukan. Jøøgø na abïriiø yøø beege jø kööre mo Parca ki Mëdön moa karge cään ki nyeya ni løny ki man dønyge baŋ gø kany wø manyge, ni beege jø wø pï piny nyïm dïkwøŋ cwöt.
english: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king's face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø ki gwanynyø ma Bacti ki køør ciik? Kiper ena kweer ki man wïny dwøl mara na jääŋŋa baŋe ki dhøk jiya moa näk odïnö.»
english: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law, because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains?

anywaa: Køøre adwøk Memukanni jï nyeya ki jø kööre bëët, ni kööe, ni «Gwanynyø ma Bacti patha nyeya keere na bääye dëër gø. Këël jø kööre bëët ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa bëën nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc, eno bääyö dëëtge.
english: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes, Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only, but also to all the princes, and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus.

anywaa: Gïna tïïc gwanynyø man en løny ki man wïnynyi ya määnni bëët, ni tïïc mään nee cwøw moge neenge ni ege taaø, ni köge, ni ‹Këëlla nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc kiree gwanynyø ma Bacti ka aköömme ki man ö baŋe, ni kweere ki ciin baŋ gø.›
english: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women, so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes, when it shall be reported, The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him, but she came not.

anywaa: Këël määr jø kööre bëët mo Parca ki mo Mëdön,  moa wïny gïna tïïc gwanynyø manøgø dïcäŋi, ge puta tägö ki man ŋwaalge gø dëët cwøwge ni put kännö ka ataa ki gootø mo okadhø.
english: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ni näk beeye gïn mo beer ki jï nyeya, beerra man gööc piny ka awaaci mo caana gø ni gwanynyø ma Bacti ba ci nyïm nyeya këët. Luummögø doo puta göör piny yïth ciik mo Parca ki Mëdön ni put bëëtö na bäre bäre ni ba wiil. Ni ö nyeya ni kïth kar Bacti ki dhaagø mo beer mo tïmö na gwanynyø ni kaala gø.
english: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wïny awaaci mar nyeya tiet mïëri moa thööth bëët moa näk moe, mään bëët ge gööga dëët cwøwge ni wøørge ge ki wödö ma kare, këël cwøre kare thiinh wala kare dwøŋ.»
english: And when the king's decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire, (for it is great,) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour, both to great and small.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø ajïëc nyeya ki jø kööre moe ni beer. Ni ö nyeya ni put gø tïïc kaawat mana caan Memukanni.
english: And the saying pleased the king and the princes; and the king did according to the word of Memucan:

anywaa: Ni put weeli jääŋŋö tiet mïëri moe bëët, ni weeli gööre ka køør dhøk mar paac man nø ki yi jöör göör marge, ni caan luummögø ki dhøk mar paac man nø; ni caana gø ni dïcwøø man nø bëëde ni ena kwäärö ni jïre da teek bäät paac mare.
english: For he sent letters into all the king's provinces, into every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language, that every man should bear rule in his own house, and that it should be published according to the language of every people.

anywaa: Køør gïïögøøni, ni nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc wëër mare odøø piny, wïïe apare ki Bacti, ki gïna tïïc Bacti, ka awaaci mana gøø piny na jääl gø ki gø.
english: After these things, when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and what was decreed against her.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa karge cään ki nyeya mo wø tïny eni ni köge, ni «Beerra man määnyö ki nyïïakuue kiper nyeya, ni beege nyïïakuue mo mïërö mo dëët cwøw poot kucge.
english: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:

anywaa: Ni ööt nyeya ki dwøl tiet mïëri moa en tiere nee jiy cuum kiper tïïc mar cooŋ nyïïakuue moa mïërö mo dëët cwøw poot kucge; ni cooŋ geni yi pääny Cuca paan dwøŋ yi kal mar nyeya kar bëëtö mar mään, ni cïp geni cer Ëgay dhaanh nyeya na näk odïnö, ŋat wø gwøk mään, ni ö mädhi mo wïïrge ni cïbi jïge,
english: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:

anywaa: nee nyeya jëëte ka aciel mo yie met ki gø røkge nee tïme na gwanynyø na kar Bacti.» Køøre nyeya ajïëy ki marge, ni tïïc gø ki køør mana caange.
english: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti. And the thing pleased the king; and he did so.

anywaa: 'Ba yi kar kaaca da dhaanhø mo bëëdö pääny Cuca paan dwøŋ ma ŋat Juuth mo nyeŋŋe Mördekay o Jayer o Cimiy na näk o Kic, na käl ri tuuŋ Benjamen.
english: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew, whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;

anywaa: 'Ba Mördekay beeye dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa mak Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn ki tøŋ yi Jerucalem, ni beeye kanya mak nyeny Juuda ma Jeyöakin ki tøŋ.
english: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away.

anywaa: 'Ba Mördekay jïre da nyiwänni ma Acther, mo nyeŋŋe ki dhi Ibaru beeye Adaca, ni menni ki wänni othøw. 'Ba ena nyakøø ma wøp mo kïte mïërö døc. Ni ö Mördekay ni piith gø jïre na nyaare.
english: And he brought up Hadassah, that is, Esther, his uncle's daughter: for she had neither father nor mother, and the maid was fair and beautiful; whom Mordecai, when her father and mother were dead, took for his own daughter.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö dwør nyeya ka awaaci mare na pïïe yïth päänye bëët, ni nyïïakuue mo thööth gena cooŋ kanya ciel yi pääny Cuca paan dwøŋ ni cïp geni cer Ëgay, Acther thuwø akïth po nyeya ni cïbi cer Ëgay ŋat wø gwøk mään.
english: So it came to pass, when the king's commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king's house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

anywaa: Ni ö Ëgay ni mïn yie ki Acther ni nyooth mëër mare jï gø, ni laar mäth wïïr ki wïth caammi kälö jïre. Ni känne ki nyïïakuue abïriiø mo ojierø ki po nyeya mo tïny eni. Ni ö Actherri ki nyïïakuue moøgø ni daa gø kany mo beerra eni ki kany wø bëët määnni yie.
english: And the maiden pleased him, and she obtained kindness of him; and he speedily gave her her things for purification, with such things as belonged to her, and seven maidens, which were meet to be given her, out of the king's house: and he preferred her and her maids unto the best place of the house of the women.

anywaa: 'Ba Acther kanya en kaace, ena bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø kiper wï jur mare ki tuuŋ mare, kiper ocem Mördekay jïre nee bäŋe gïn caane.
english: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it.

anywaa: Køøre Mördekay bëëdö ni jöödö cooth deŋ kal man wø bëët määnni yie ni kwaana bëëtö mar Acther kiper jööt dëël mare ki bëëtö mare man bëëde nidïï nee ŋääe.
english: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women's house, to know how Esther did, and what should become of her.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør ciik mana caan kiper nyïïakuue, dëëtge ajiiŋge ki dwäde apaar kurriiø ki man cige baŋ nyeya. Ni ö dwäde moøgø ni pääŋŋi na kwöre ariiø; dwäde abïciel ge wïïra mädhi kiper nee rïŋ dëëtge tïme ni pøøth, ni dwäde abïciel møga ge wïïra mädhi møøk mo ŋweeth mo caala riia mo  ŋwääö ni met. 'Ba kanyo thum tïïe moøgø bëët, nyakøø man nø kïtha baŋ nyeya.
english: Now when every maid's turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus, after that she had been twelve months, according to the manner of the women, (for so were the days of their purifications accomplished, to wit, six months with oil of myrrh, and six months with sweet odours, and with other things for the purifying of the women;)

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ci baŋ nyeya, dëëre di røønyø kaawat mana manynye, ni ö wøk ki kanya bëët määnni yie ni døny yi øtø mar nyeya.
english: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme na kar nyakøø man nø, eni cøø ka abøøya ni duu wøk ka amöölla, ni ci yi riet øtø mar mään baŋ Caacgac, dhaanh nyeya na näk odïnö, ŋat wø koor mään moa näk dëëtge ege nø joot ki nyeya. Ni eni ba døø baŋ nyeya këët ni näk mo nyeya yie kär cäŋ mïnnö ki eni ni cwøl gø ki nyeŋŋe.
english: In the evening she went, and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women, to the custody of Shaashgaz, the king's chamberlain, which kept the concubines: she came in unto the king no more, except the king delighted in her, and that she were called by name.

anywaa: 'Ba Acther nya Abikael, cöök wää Mördekay, ni beeye Mördekay mana piith Acther, kanya pïïc kare ki man døny baŋ nyeya, eni bäŋ gïn mo ee pëënynyö, 'ba aŋuudö ki jammi moa caan Ëgay keere, ŋata näk odïnö ni wø gwøk mään. 'Ba jiy bëët abëëdö ni yïthge met ka Acther.
english: Now when the turn of Esther, the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai, who had taken her for his daughter, was come to go in unto the king, she required nothing but what Hegai the king's chamberlain, the keeper of the women, appointed. And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri moa beet Ayacewëëröc ni ena nyeya, ri paac dwäde ni beeye dwääy man wø cwøl ni Tebet, Acther akïth baŋ nyeya yi øtø mare.
english: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni mïn yie ki Acther ni mëëye ki gø døc ni kaala nyïïakuue moøgø bëët na näk dëët cwøw poot kucge, ni kïth adun gwac wïïe ni cuum gøøni kar Bacti na gwanynyø.
english: And the king loved Esther above all the women, and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins; so that he set the royal crown upon her head, and made her queen instead of Vashti.

anywaa: Køør manøgøøni nø, nyeya atïïö ka ajwöm-cam mo dwøŋ mar wödö kiper Acther, ni cwøl jø kööre moe ki bwöthe bëët, ni gööc piny ka awaaci yïth mïëri moa en tiere bëët kiper nee cäŋeca tïïc na cäŋ jwöm røk, ni cïpe ki muuce ni cwïnye tar.
english: Then the king made a great feast unto all his princes and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he made a release to the provinces, and gave gifts, according to the state of the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyïïakuue moa näk dëët cwøw kucge ni cäŋge cooŋŋø ri rietge, Mördekay eno pï piny dhi kal mar nyeya.
english: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time, then Mordecai sat in the king's gate.

anywaa: Ni bëët Acther ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø kiper wï jur mare ki tuuŋ mare, kaawat mana cem Mördekay jïre, kiper Acther bëëdö ni luum Mördekay ee gwøø kaawat mana gwøk gø ni eni poot ena cer gø.
english: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni ni Mördekay opï piny dhi kal paan dwøŋ mar nyeya, da jiy ariiø mo nyeŋge Bikthan ki Terec, mo ge ena røk jø wø koor dhi øt nyeya mana en yie kuya. Jøøgø gena gootø ni tutge ki luubö mo raac kiper nee nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc 'näkge.
english: In those days, while Mordecai sat in the king's gate, two of the king's chamberlains, Bigthan and Teresh, of those which kept the door, were wroth, and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

anywaa: Ni ö luubö mana tuutge ni wïnynyi ya Mördekay, ni caan gøøni jï gwanynyø ma Acther, ni ö Actherri ni cøøe ni caan dwør Mördekay jï nyeya.
english: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai's name.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö luubö manøgø na many tiere døc, ni joodi na adïëri, jøøgø aput 'näk ni geno lïërö. Ni ö luummögø ni gööri piny nyïm nyeya nee bëëde yi Wëël Waac Nyeye.
english: And when inquisition was made of the matter, it was found out; therefore they were both hanged on a tree: and it was written in the book of the chronicles before the king.

anywaa: Køør gïïögø, nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc, Amaan wär Amëdatha na käl ri tuuŋ Agaak, acuume na wïth jø kööre moe bëët.
english: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni kööm jaae moe bëët mo wø en dhi kal mare nee cøŋge këëlge piny nyïm Amaan ni ge nyootha wödö marge. Ni tïïcge gø bëët kaawat mana caan nyeya; 'ba beeye Mördekay keere na kweer ki këël cøŋ piny ki man wøør gø.
english: And all the king's servants, that were in the king's gate, bowed, and reverenced Haman: for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

anywaa: 'Ba jaae mo nyeya mo wø en dhi kal mare gena köö jï Mördekay, na «?Aperŋø ni kwierï dwør nyeya en?»
english: Then the king's servants, which were in the king's gate, said unto Mordecai, Why transgressest thou the king's commandment?

anywaa: Ni bëëtge ni ge cäänna Mördekay ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët, 'ba ena kweer ki man cek ïthe jïge. Kiper ena köö, ni «Aana ŋat Juuth; a ba løny ki man këëlla cøŋŋa piny ni wøøra Amaan.» Ni caange luummögø jï Amaan nee joot ki man näk mo eni jïëy ki luum gø.
english: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya Amaanni ni Mördekay okweer ki këël cøŋ piny man wøør eni, cwïnye apäŋ ki wëër;
english: And when Haman saw that Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence, then was Haman full of wrath.

anywaa: ni määny Mördekay ki jöö man 'näk gø ki gø. 'Ba na wïny gø ni Mördekay bee ŋat Juuth, yie kär mïnnö ki man 'näk Mördekay keere. Køøre ena put määnyö ki jöö man  'näk jø Juuth bëët ki gø, ni beege tuuŋ Mördekay, moa en tiet mïëri bëët moa bëën nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc.
english: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai: wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc na apaar kurriiø bäät nyec, ri dwääy mana dïkwøŋ man wø cwøl ni Nican, gïn mo cwøl ni pur, mo caala thöör war, aleeŋge nyïm Amaan, nee cäŋ mano raany jø Juuth yie ki dwääy manøca nyoodhe. Ni päth bäät dwää apaar kurriiø man wø cwøl na Adar.
english: In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Amaan aput cäänö ki nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc ni kööe, ni «Da jiy mo okeethø yi paac marï, ni ge bëëdö kur keerge yïth mïëri moï bëët, ni ciik moge opää ki mo jiy møga bëët, ni ge bëëdö thuwø ni ciik nyeya ba wøørge. Kiper manøgønø, teeŋ jiy mo caala moøgøøni ba many gø niï bëëdï ni cwïnyï bäth ki geni.
english: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus, There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king's laws: therefore it is not for the king's profit to suffer them.

anywaa: Ni näk beeye gïn mo beer ki jïrï, beerra man kännï wøk ka awaaci nee wïthge dïïr. Køøre a cïpö ki gwet-bïrö ma rumme ma kikarri mo kume apaar nee kïth kwör kän jammi moï, kiper nee tïïc mar paac marï kääri ki gø.»
english: If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed: and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business, to bring it into the king's treasuries.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni käl gwel lweedø mare wøk man wø näk ree da ŋïï man wø gøø dëër wëëlö, ni wëëk gø Amaan wär Amëdatha, na käl ri tuuŋ Agaak, ŋata män ki jø Juuth.
english: And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews' enemy.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya jïre, ni «Gwet-bïrö moøgø bëëtge na moï, ni jøøgø ena cerï ki man tïïyï mana manynyï dëëtge jaak.»
english: And the king said unto Haman, The silver is given to thee, the people also, to do with them as it seemeth good to thee.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm nïr dwää aciel na apaar kurdäk, Amaan jø wø gööt piny mo nyeya acwøle, ni göörge weeli ki køør mana caan Amaanni, ni løøge gø baŋ wïth dhøgi bëët, ki yi jöör göör mar wï jur man nø yïth mïëri moøgø bëët, ni jääŋ weeli moøgø baŋ kwääri mo mïëri, ki jø kööre, ki bwöthe mo wïth juurre mo nyeya bëët. Weeli moøgø göör ka nyeŋ nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc ni ŋïï mar ogut lweedø mare ogøø dëëtge.
english: Then were the king's scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month, and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors that were over every province, and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof, and to every people after their language; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king's ring.

anywaa: Weeli moøgø ajääŋŋi tiet mïëri bëët moa näk mo nyeya ki ceŋ jiy mo rwäänhnhö, ni caana gø ni kanyo tïm nïr dwää apaar kurriiø man wø cwøl na Adar na apaar kurdäk, yi cäŋ manø na aciel enø, jø Juuth bëët moa näk wøpe, ki jäle, ka apoole ko obwöre, wär raanynyi, ni 'näk geni, ni dïïr wïthge bëët, ni japge put ka twier.
english: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king's provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to take the spoil of them for a prey.

anywaa: Luubö manøgø doo gøø piny na awaaci yïth mïëri bëët ni caana gø jï jiy bëët nee dëëtge jiiŋge kiper cäŋ manøgø.
english: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, that they should be ready against that day.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mana caan nyeya, jø wø rwäänhnhi weeli moøgø akälge ni keethge ge tiet mïëri bëët. Ni ö awaaci manøgø ni tïï ni ŋäc bäre yi pääny Cuca paan dwøŋ. Ni nyeya ka Amaan gena pï piny jaak ni ge mädhö; 'ba jø pääny Cuca bëëdö ni wïthge rege noodø ni ŋëëtge ogäŋ.
english: The posts went out, being hastened by the king's commandment, and the decree was given in Shushan the palace. And the king and Haman sat down to drink; but the city Shushan was perplexed.

anywaa: 'Ba Mördekay kanya wïny japa tïïc bëët, abïïge ajeeye ki pänh cwïny, ni runy dëëre ka abïïn keeca, ni jøøp bur wïïe, ni wïr dï pääny bäre ni jwöŋi ni guyö ki dwøl mo päl ni cwïnye opädhö døc,
english: When Mordecai perceived all that was done, Mordecai rent his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the midst of the city, and cried with a loud and a bitter cry;

anywaa: këël mana pïïe dhi kal mar nyeya. 'Ba kär døny yi gø, kiper dhaanhø mo oruyö ka abïïn keeca ba døny yi kal mar nyeya.
english: And came even before the king's gate: for none might enter into the king's gate clothed with sackcloth.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø kwöra näk dwøl mar nyeya ka awaaci mare opïï yie yïth mïëri moøgø bëët, kïmmö mo dwøŋ døc dagø ma atägö baŋ jø Juuth. Ni bëëtge ni ge wödö, ni ge jwöŋö, ni ge guyö; ni thööthge bëët ge buuta bäät abïïk keece yi bur.
english: And in every province, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, there was great mourning among the Jews, and fasting, and weeping, and wailing; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø tïïci mo Acther moa näk nyïïakuue ki jøøa näk odïnö na caange gïna tïïc Mördekay jï Acther, Acther cwïnye apädhö døc, ni put kwääyö ka abïïe jï Mördekay nee røøe na kar abïïn keeca, 'ba ena kweer ki  man jïëc ge.
english: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø aciel mana cïp nyeya nee Acther tïnynye ki røk jiye moa näk odïnö mo cwøl na Athak, acwøl Actherri ni kööm gø nee ci baŋ Mördekay kiper gïna tägö dëër Mördekay nee tier gø kwanye.
english: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Athak aput ci wøk baŋ Mördekay kany wø cuŋ jiyi yie dï pääny, nyïm dhi kal mar nyeya.
english: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.

anywaa: Ni ö Mördekay ni lam gïïa tägö dëëre bëët jïgø, ki kwään jammi moa kööŋ Amaanni ki ge ni cïbe cïbö nee kïth kwör kän jammi mo nyeya kiper raany jø Juuth.
english: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

anywaa: Ni cïp wëël awaaci thuwø jï Athak mana gøø piny kiper raany jø Juuth, na käl wøk yi Cuca, nee nyoodhe jï Acther ni lam tier gø jïgø, ni kööm Acther ki man ci baŋ nyeya ni kwac gø nee jø poge jïtge ki køny.
english: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Athak aput døø baŋ Acther ni lam gïïa caan Mördekay bëët.
english: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

anywaa: Køøre Acther acäänö ka Athak, ni kööm gø nee dwøl man cäŋ caannø jï Mördekay,
english: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

anywaa: ni «Dhaanhø jaak, dïcwøø wala dhaagø, ni näk mo eno døny yi kal mar øt wälu mar nyeya nee nyeya neene ni kär cwølø, eni put ka 'näk. Manøgø beeye ciik mo ŋäc jaae mo nyeya bëët ki jiy mo wø bëëdö tiet mïëri moe. 'Ba jöö aciel keere mo løny man pïïö kaace ki gø ni dhaanhø ba 'näk beeye kanyo näk mo nyeya athøny warkey mare ee tïŋ maal baŋ dhaanhø. 'Ba dïcäŋi jïra da nïne mo pïëradäk naa kär cwølø ki man cøøa baŋ nyeya.»
english: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl mar Acther kanya caani jï Mördekay,
english: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

anywaa: Mördekay acäŋ dwögö ki luubö ni caan jï Acther, ni «Kärï cädö niï bøth ki gïno pïï bäät jø Juuth bëët kiper mana enï paan dwøŋ po nyeya.
english: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï bëëdö ni ïïno nikïïl ki yi cäŋ mo caala teeŋ man, køny öö ki kanymør kiper jø Juuth ni piem geni; 'ba ïïni ki dhi øt wäru othøw ni thum aŋuun bëëtö maru. Aŋa na ŋäc gø thuwø; kanymør na tïïc ïïni na gwanynyø beeye kiper cäŋ mo caala teeŋ man.»
english: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

anywaa: Køøre Acther acäŋ dwögö ki luubö ni caan jï Mördekay,
english: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni cooŋï jø Juuth bëët moa en Cuca, ni wödu kipera. Ni bëëdu ki nïne adäk, ki wärre ki cääŋŋe moge, nou ba cämö wala maath. 'Ba aani ki jø tïïc 'moa moa näk nyïïakuue wa wödö thuwø kaawat mano tïïyu. Køøre nø, aano ci baŋ nyeya, këël ni näk maa gwäya ciik. Ni näk maa thøw, aano thøw.»
english: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Mördekay aput cøø ni tïïc japøgø bëët kaawat mana köömmi na Actherri.
english: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri dää nïne, Acther abïïe mo gwac arøø dëëre ni døny yi kal mar øt nyeya ni cuŋŋe ni dïët ki dhi øtø man wø bëët wälu yie. 'Ba nyeya opï piny bäät wälu mare ni dïët ki dhi øtø.
english: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya na joot Acther ni cuŋŋö yi kal, yie amïnnö ki gø, ni put athøny warkey mana en cere tïŋ maal baŋ gø. Ni ö Actherri ni nyiik buut gø ni gut wï athøny warkey.
english: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

anywaa: Ni kö nyeya jïre, na «?Agïnaŋøøni, gwanynyø ma Acther? ?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï nee tïïc jïrï? Këël miï pëënynya thääŋ ŋøøm 'moa, owëëk ïïni.»
english: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Acther aköö, «Wui nyeya, ni näk beeye gïn mo beer ki jïrï, beerra man ööu ka Amaan dïcäŋi baŋ atïya mana jiiŋŋa kiperï.»
english: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö, ni «Laaru Amaan cwøl kiper nee mana many Actherri tïïcwa.» Ni ö nyeya ka Amaan ni cige baŋ atïya mana jiiŋ Actherri.
english: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enge bäät maath ki kwøk nyïïomøki, nyeya aköö jï Acther, ni «?Gïn manynyï agïnaŋøøni? Di cïbö jïrï. ?Ni pïëc marï agïnaŋø? Këël miï pëënynya thääŋ ŋøøm 'moa, owëëk ïïni.»
english: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi na Actherri jïre, ni «Pïëc mara ki gïn manynya beeye en.
english: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

anywaa: Wui nyeya, ni näk aano jïtö ki met ec baŋï,  ni beeye gïn mo beer ki jïrï ki man tïïyï gïno pëënynya ki gïno manynya, beerra man ööu ka Amaan baŋ atïya mano jiiŋŋa kiperu diøø. Køøre nø, gïna manynya caana caanø kaawat mana caanï.»
english: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

anywaa: Køøre Amaan aput døny wøk dïcäŋöca ni cwïnye omïnnö ni kanynyø døc. 'Ba kanya joot Mördekay no opï piny dhi kal mar nyeya ni Mördekay kär ö maal ki man wøør gø, ni eni ba lwäär, Amaan aput gootø ki Mördekay ki gootø mo dwøŋ døc.
english: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

anywaa: 'Ba Amaan dëëre akoore ni cïp cwïnye piny, ni aa paare. Ni ööte ki dwøl baŋ nyïïawääte ki cïïe ma Jëërëc kiper nee öge baŋe.
english: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

anywaa: Ni caan luum ajiem kwär mare jïge, ki kwään wääte, ki wödö mana tïïc nyeya kipere, ki mana cuum eni ni ena maal bäät jø kööre bëët ki kwääc mïëri moa bëën nyeya.
english: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Këël gwanynyø ma Acther bäŋ ŋat mør mo ee cwølø ki man cøøe ki nyeya baŋ atïya mana jiiŋŋe, 'ba beeye aani keera. Këël aana cäŋ cwøllø ki man cøøa ki nyeya kiper mar diøø thuwø.
english: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ööa noo jooda Mördekay ŋat Juuth manøgø no opï piny dhi kal mar nyeya, met ec mana jooda ki køør gïïögø bëët puta ränynyö.»
english: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

anywaa: Køøre cïïe ma Jëërëc ki nyïïawääte bëët, gena köö jïre, ni «Beerra man tïïö ki jaath man wø lïër dhaanhø bääte mo bär mare jïtö ki gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ciï ka amöölla ni caanï gø jï nyeya nee Mördekay lïër bääte. Køøre ïïno ci baŋ atïya ki nyeya ki met ec.» Ni ö Amaanni ni jïëc luummögø ni beeye gïn mo beer, ni ö jaathi manøgø ni jiiŋŋi.
english: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

anywaa: 'Ba yi wäär manøgø, nyeya nyeŋŋe kär gämmö; køøre ena put jääk baŋ Wëël Waac Nyeye man wø maa luup yie; ni käli ni kwaani jïre.
english: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

anywaa: Køøre ena jïtö ki kany mo ogöörö ki man näk Mördekay da gïn mo ee caanø kiper Bikthana ki Terec, jø tïïc ariiø mo odïnö mo wø koor dhi øtø mar nyeya, man näk mo ge manynya nyeya ma Ayacewëëröc nee 'näkge.
english: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya apëëö, na «?Agïnaŋø na tïïc kiper Mördekay ni wøørra gø ni tïïca kare ni dwøŋ kiper gïna tïïe?» Ni dwøgi ya jaae mo nyeya mo wø tïny eni, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo otïïö kipere.»
english: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya apëëö, na «?Aŋa ni en cwöt?» Kar kanyøgø Amaan onø duny yi kal mar cwöt mana en wøk nee cääne ki nyeya kiper nee Mördekay lïër bäät jaadha näk ee nø jiiŋŋø kiper gø.
english: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya jaae moe jïre, na «Amaan ena kaace ni cuŋŋö cwöt.» Ni kö nyeya, «Cwøl nee dunynye.»
english: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

anywaa: Køøre Amaan aput dønyø. Ni kö nyeya jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïc kiper dhaanhø mo nyeya yie met ki gø nee wøør?» Kanyøgø Amaan aput cäännö ki cwïnye, na «?Aŋa ni met yi nyeya ki gø en nee wøør ni kaala aani?»
english: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï nyeya, ni «Kiper ŋatøgø ni met yiï ki gø nee wøør enø,
english: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

anywaa: abïï nyec man wø røc nyeya, doo käl jiyi wøk kipere, ko okweeny lääy man wø cääth nyeya ki bääte, ni nyuudhi mar nyeya okïth wï okweeny manøgø.
english: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

anywaa: Køøre abïï nyec ko okweeny manøgø dige cïba cer dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ døc ki baŋ nyeya, ni røøge abïï dëër ŋata met yi nyeya ki gø nee wøør, ni cïpge ŋatøgø bäät okweeny, ni piecge gø kany wø cuŋ jiyi yie dï pääny, ni ge rwääö nyïm ŋatøgø ni döötge ege tïŋ maal, ni ‹Man beeye gïn wø tïïc jï ŋat mo nyeya yie met ki gø nee wøør.› »
english: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya aput köö jï Amaan, ni «Laar abïï øømmø ko okweeny lääy kaawat mana caanï, ni tïïyï gø jï Mördekay ŋat Juuth, no opï piny dhi kal mar nyeya ice; ni bäŋe gïn mo  gwäyï mo thiinh ki røk jammi moa caanï yøø bëët.»
english: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

anywaa: Køøre Amaan abïï ko okweeny aput käl, ni røø abïïe dëër Mördekay, ni cïp Mördekay bäät okweeny, ni piec gø kany wø cuŋ jiyi yie dï pääny, ni rwääö nyïm gø ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal, ni «Man beeye gïn wø tïïc jï ŋat mo nyeya yie met ki gø nee wøør.»
english: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

anywaa: Køøre Mördekay aduu dhi kal mar nyeya. 'Ba Amaan aput läät paac ni wïïe ee uumö ni kïmmö.
english: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

anywaa: Ni caan jammi moa tägö dëëre bëët jï cïïe ma Jëërëc ki nyïïawääte. Køøre nyïïawääte moa wïthge leer, ki cïïe ma Jëërëc, gena köö jïre, «Ennø, ïïna tägö ki man pädhï nyïm Mördekay. Mördekay kiper mana näk beeye ŋat Juuth, ba løny jïrï ki man kaalï gø këët. Ka adïëri møn, ï bööte böötö.»
english: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
