english: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

anywaa: Ïïno bëëdö niï cuŋŋa ra adïëri kiper ŋäädhe dagø,  ni lwïthï deŋŋï ni jwömï riï ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋï.
english: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

anywaa: Dëërï onyaaŋŋï piny ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëga ïïni lwär, ni ö jiy mo thööth ni pëënyge køny marï.
english: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa reyø nyeŋge otal jöö, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany päärge wøk ki yie; ni put tïmö ni ge ŋäätha thøø keere.»
english: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: And Job answered and said,

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, beeye u keeru na jiy, 'ba nou thøwu, leec wïc thøw ki uuni na aciel!
english: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, jïra da ŋeth kaamar maru; aani kara ba en piny ki uuni. ?Aŋø, aŋa ni kuc gïïögø bëët?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

anywaa: «Aana tïmö na gïr ŋeethø jï nyïïawääta, ni beeye aani ni wø pëëny Jwøk ni duunne jïra, ŋata bëëtö mare tiir na näk ba bääö atïmö na gïr ŋeethø.
english: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

anywaa: Jiy moa näk ge ena yi bëëtö mo beer ge ŋeethø bäät dhaanhø mo ena yi bëëtö mo leth, mo cäätha bäät pädhö.
english: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

anywaa: Kwör bëëte mo dïräänynye wø bëëdö ni beyø, ni ö jø wø raany cwïny Jwøk ni bëëtge ni geno gwøø, ni beege jø wø käär jwøk marge ki ceŋge.
english: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, pëëny 'lääy niï pwönyge, ni pëënynyï wec maal nee caange jïrï,
english: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

anywaa: wala cään ŋøøm niï pwönyge, wala rec mo naama dwøŋ nee parge jïrï.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

anywaa: ?Amane ni kuc gø dï gïïögø, ki man näk mo gïn tïïya Wuuö Jwøki?
english: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?

anywaa: Jwïëc gïïa kwøw bëët ena cere, ni bee eni na tïïc jiy bëët nee jwïëcge.
english: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, patha ïth ni wø jier luup ki gø, kaawat man wø ö leepi wø bel cam ki gø?
english: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

anywaa: Leec wïc wø ena baŋ jøøa døøŋŋø, ni cwiic kwøw mo thööth, dhaanhø wø wëëge kwany tiet luup.
english: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

anywaa: «'Ba leec wïc ki teek beege mo Jwøk; ni luup pwöc ki kwany tiet luup käla baŋe.
english: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, eni gïn mo ee toor piny, ba løny ki man cäŋi geerrø; ni dhaanhø mo ee twöö, bäŋ ŋat mo päta gø.
english: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, eni, kany wø wëëk køth cuŋŋö, piny tal; ni kany wø wëëk køth pädhö, piny nithar.
english: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

anywaa: Eni, teek ki leec wïc beege moe, ni ö ŋat wø cøøgi, ki ŋat wø cwöö, ni näkge moe bëët.
english: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

anywaa: Eni, jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø wø wëëge wääth ki tietge jaak ni bäŋ war, ni tïïc dïŋut luup kaamar bøøre.
english: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

anywaa: Oguudi moa ö nyeye na twöcge jiy ki ge wø päde pädö, ni wëëk teek mar nyeye ränynyö.
english: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

anywaa: Eni, kwääc laam wø wëëge wääth ki tietge jaak ni bäŋ war, ni raany teek mar jøøa näk nyeŋge ŋäc ki kany mo yie bäär.
english: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

anywaa: Eni jiy moa näk oŋäädhö wø wëëge lïŋŋö,  ni ö leec wïci mar jø døøŋŋø ni raany gø.
english: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

anywaa: Eni ataa mo dwøŋ wø wëëge ööny bäät dïbwöthe, ni raany teek mar jøøa teek.
english: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

anywaa: Eni, gïïa näk tietge okan piny yi muudhö wø wëëge nëënne, ni wëëk tar ööny bäät muudhö mo cøl døc.
english: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

anywaa: Eni, wïth juurre wø tïŋe maal ni cäŋ ge raanynyø, ni wëëk wïth juurre nyaay ni cäŋ ge keethø.
english: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

anywaa: Eni, leec wïc mar dïbwöthe mo jø bäät piny wø di raanynyø, ni tïïc ge nee thääcge dï ŋöömö mo oränynyö mo bäŋ jöö yie.
english: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

anywaa: Ge wø wëëge thäämmö yi muudhö mo bäŋ tar yie, ni tïïc ge ni ge bøømmø kaamar jiy mo omeer.
english: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, gïïögø bëët ajooda ki waŋa, ni wïnynya ge ki ïtha, ni kwanya tietge,
english: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

anywaa: ni gïna näk ŋäyu, ŋääa thuwø; aani, kara ba en piny ki uuni.
english: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna manynya beeye ki man cääna ki Jwøk na en teeki jïre, naa pëënynya luup 'moa ki gø.
english: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, adïëri aummu ki luup tööt; uuni bëët, u caala akïïme mo bäŋ gïn kønyge.
english: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni ba bëëdu nou lïŋö jaak en? Køøre doo tïmö na leec wïc jïïu.
english: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

anywaa: Ennø, beerra man wïnynyu luubö mara, ni cegu ïdhi mou ki cäänö mara man ni ö wøk ki dhaa en.
english: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u cäänö ki luup mo patha adïëri ki nyeŋ Jwøk? ?Aŋø, u wääö ki luup cwøk ki nyeŋ Jwøk?
english: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki baŋu, u ena kur Jwøk? ?Aŋø, løny ki man pïëmu kiper Jwøk?
english: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk mo eni u di tetø, tïmö na gïn mo beer kiperu? ?Aŋø, løny ki man cøøgu Jwøk kaawat man wø cøøgu dhaanhø?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, eni u di jooø kanyo tïïu ka ajeeny ki piny.
english: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u ba lwäär ki dööŋö mar Jwøk? ?Aŋø, dëëtu ba tïmö ni kwanynyi ki eni?
english: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

anywaa: Luupu ni wø caru kaamar leere bëëdö kaamar bur, ni caala kwör gwøk røk mo tïïc ko odhöönh.
english: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

anywaa: «Lïŋu nø mø, naa läwa cäännö; nee da gïn mo manynya ö bääta, wär ööe.
english: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni cïba dëëra cer gïn mo leth en, naa weta jwïëy 'moa?
english: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

anywaa: 'Ba këël maa nääe nääö, a poot bëëdö naa ŋäätha eni; 'ba ka adïëri møn, luup 'moa poot caana caanø nyïme.
english: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

anywaa: Kanymør gïnögø løny ki man piem aani, kiper ba løny jï ŋat raay ki man cuŋŋe nyïm Jwøk.
english: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

anywaa: Cegu ïthu døøc ki luup 'moa; beerra man ö ïdhi mou ni leŋge luup 'moa.
english: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

anywaa: Ennø, raa yaa nø jiiŋŋø ki luup 'moa, ni ŋääa naa di ŋunnö ni mara beer.
english: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man pïëme ki aani? 'Ba ni näk mo dagø, a lïŋö naa puta thøø.
english: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

anywaa: «Wui Jwøk! Gïï na ariiø ii wär tïïyï kipera, kiper nee dëëra ba kana ki ïïni.
english: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

anywaa: Daak cerï bääta, ni ba wëëgï aani bwøk ki køør mana lwäära ki ïïni.
english: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

anywaa: Køøre nø, beerra man cwølï aani, naa duunna jïrï, wala wëëk a cäänö, niï duunnï jïra.
english: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïïa tïïa na reyø ki raay moa tïïa, ge nyïëdi røk? Nyuth a gïïa baaa ki raay moa tïïa.
english: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni kanï täärnyïmï ki aani en, naa iï kwaanø na nyimän marï?
english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni wëëgï aani kïmmö en, a ni caal bøøŋ jaath mo okwør jame? ?Aŋø ni rïïŋï køøra, a ni caal lethø jaak en?
english: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

anywaa: Kiper ïïna gööt piny bääta ki jammi mo teek, niï dwøga raay 'moa wïïa moa tïïa naa poot thiinh.
english: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

anywaa: Tieta akïthï yïth orøge, ni koorï uutjïëthe 'moa bëët mo wø caadha, niï neeta kwör cääthe mo tieta.
english: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, dëër dhaanhø ränynyö kaamar gïn mo okwäk, ni caala abïï mo ocam alweela.
english: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

anywaa: «Dhaanhø man no onywøl dhaage bäät piny en nïre nøk ni ena yi bëëtö mo leth døc.
english: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

anywaa: Eni caala wï jaath man wø ŋøøk ni wø laar talø; ni eni laara pöödhö ni ba ruu kare kaamar tïpö.
english: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Jwøk, løny ki man këëllï waŋï dëër ŋatøgø, ni cwölï gø nyïmï nee luumme ŋølï?
english: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man tïïc gïn mo ba waany ni waany? Bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

anywaa: Ïïni, kwään cwiic kwøw mo dhaanhø iï nø cïp piny, ni kwään dwäde mo beede oløny ni ŋäyï; ni kanya näk iï cïp piny kipere ba løny ki man kaal gø.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, løø nyïmï wøk ki eni ni weyï gø nee jïte ki jwöm, këël kanyo päŋ caae moe kaamar ŋat tïïc man wø tïïö ni di cunnö ki gwel.
english: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

anywaa: «Kiper këël jaath da ŋäädhe kipere, kany wø näk mo eno ŋøt piny, eni cäŋa løthø, ni ö bäädi moe ni ba wec pïth marge.
english: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

anywaa: Këël lweedi moe odøøŋŋø ni ränyge tiet ŋøøm,  ni ö gutö mare ni ränynye bäät ŋøøm moa no otal,
english: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

anywaa: ni näk mo tiere ojïtö ki pïï, løth ni jïte ki bäädi ni døø kare na jaath.
english: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø thøw ni koonyi piny; eni aŋuun jwïëy mare cuŋ ni ba bëëde këët.
english: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

anywaa: Kaawat man wø døø pï naama dwøŋ piny, wala kaawat man wø bëët nämmi ni dwön ni talge,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

anywaa: dhaanhø thuwø thøw ni koonyi piny ni ba duu wøk; eni ba päy wala ki man duu maal ki yi thøø këël kanyo ö jap maalli noo ränyge noo tïmge ni bäŋgø këët.
english: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

anywaa: «Wui, doo beerra man kanï aani yi bwörö, ni cïëgï gø bääta këël kanyo pööth wëërri marï. Doo beerra man cïbï nïne 'moa piny, ni parï wïïï ki aani.
english: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk mo dhaanhø othøw, eni cäŋa kwøw këët? Aani, a kurö ki yïth nïne bëët mo bëëtö mara man ni leth en, këël kanyo dee wïïtö mo tägö ri bëëtö mara.
english: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

anywaa: 'Ba aano cwølï, ni løøa gø jïrï; ïïno tïmö niï lääŋŋa aani, ni bee a gïna tïïyï ki cerï.
english: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

anywaa: Køøre ïïno bëëdö niï kwara kwör tieta, ni ba parï wïïï ki raay 'moa.
english: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

anywaa: Raay 'moa obëëdö no okan yo opïr. Ïïni, japa reyø moa tïïa ouumï.
english: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

anywaa: «'Ba kïdi man wø bëëdö na thuur wø pädhö ni tøye na thäŋi, ni nyi kïdi ree wø daae daaø kare.
english: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

anywaa: Pïï, nyeŋ kïte wø køøle køølø, ni ö tørri mar bäät ŋøøm ni käli ya jwïïö. Kaawat manøgønø thuwø, ïïni ŋäädhe mar dhaanhø wø raanynyï raanynyø.
english: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï wø ööa maal bääte ki teek, ni put rwäänyö; ni ö kïdö mare ni wiili ya thøøe.
english: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

anywaa: Ennø, ki man näk mo wääte ojïtö ki wödö, eni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe kiper gø, wala wääte otïmö ni geno taaø, eni ba løny ki man joot gø.
english: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

anywaa: Eni dëëre bëëdö ni rämö, ni eni kïmmö kiper dëëre keere.»
english: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Elipathi nyï Tëman ni kööe,
english: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

anywaa: «?Aŋø, dhaanhø mo wïïe leer løny ki man løk luubö ki yi jöö mo bäŋ tiere, wala piema ree ki luup mo bäŋ tietge mo caala jamø?
english: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jïre ki man piem ree ki luup mo oballe jaak, ki cäänö mo bäŋ gïn duue?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ïïna cäänö ki luup mo raanynya bëët lwär ki Jwøk, mo gëëŋa jöör lam mana näk kare man lam Jwøk ki gø.
english: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

anywaa: Kiper raay moï ajoot ki køør luup moa carï, ni päärï gø ki man buŋï gø ki luup riek waŋ.
english: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

anywaa: Ïïna jääl luup moï keerï moa ö wøk ki dhiï, ni patha aani; ïïna jääl dhiï keerï.
english: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, bee ï dhaanhø mana kwøŋ nywøl dïkwøŋ? ?Aŋø, bee ï na kwøŋ cwääc dïkwøŋ ni kïte poodi?
english: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, leec wï Jwøk na näk tiere okanø wïnynyï wïnynyö,  ni ki baŋï ni leerra wïïï keerï?
english: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø ni ŋäyï ni kucwa? ?Agïnaŋø na tiere kwanyï na dhäthö jïwa?
english: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

anywaa: Waani, waano kwänynyö baŋ jøøa näk wïthge da lwaar na näk ojal, ni beege jøøa døøŋŋø geni kiree ki wäru.
english: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, luup cøm cwïny na car Jwøki jïrï mëëth, ni beeye luupa care ni cwïnye ee cïp piny, ba rømi kiperï?
english: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni ö acaare moï ni bwøth ïïni wøk en? ?Aperŋø ni ŋuuï nyeŋŋï wøk,
english: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

anywaa: ni tïmï niï wëër ka Jwøk, ni ö teeŋ luupögø bëët ni öge wøk ki dhiï?
english: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

anywaa: «?Aŋø, da dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare waany? ?Wala a dhaanhnhe mane dï jøøi no onywøl määnni ii mo bëëtö mare tiir?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

anywaa: Ni näk Jwøk nyïïatwiet maal moe na en kur keerge käre ŋäädhö, ni këël jap maal kiree ba nëëni ni waany ki nyïme,
english: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

anywaa: a tugi ki dhaanhø man nø ni raac ni tem gïï mo reyø, ni raay maadhe kaamar pïï en, ba kadha rääö mare døc!
english: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

anywaa: «Ennø, cek ïthï jïra døc ki luummo caana jïrï en; aani, gïna jooda lama lamø jïrï,
english: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

anywaa: ni beeye gïna wïnynya baŋ jøøa wïthge leer na kwanyge baŋ wëëkge. Geni, bäŋ gïn mo ege mooŋø jïra.
english: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

anywaa: Geni, beege jøøa cïp ŋøøm jïge, ni bäŋ wëëllö mo ŋuti ki dïge.
english: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

anywaa: Ŋat mo raac wø bëëdö ni rämö ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët. Eni, japa reyø na tïïe ki yïth cwiiri moe bëët wø dwøga wïïe.
english: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

anywaa: Eni wø bëëdö ni wïnynya dööt jap wø käl lwär, ni kany wø jïte ki jwöm mo thiinh, dïtwïëte wø laara öö ni laar eni twier.
english: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

anywaa: Eni bäŋ ŋäädhe jïre ki man näk mo eni ööa wøk ki yi muudhö, kiper opëëllö bëëdö no onø jek kipere nee 'näk.
english: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

anywaa: Eni wø bëëdö ni thääyö ni caya cam, ni köö, ni ‹?Cam en kaa?› Ni eni bëëdö ni ŋääe ki man näk nïr muudhö karge cään.
english: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

anywaa: Ni eni bëëdö ni lwäär døc ki køør jwør gïï mo leth ki rääm na en bääte. Gïïögø teek marge anyoothge bäät gø kaawat man wø ö nyeya wø jiiŋ ree kiper leny,
english: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

anywaa: kiper mana tïŋ cere maal bäät Jwøk, ni tööde bäät Jwøa en teeki jïre,
english: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

anywaa: ni runy dëëre ki kwöt leny mo odhïŋ mo teek, ni tööde bäät Jwøk.
english: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

anywaa: «'Ba këël na bëëde ni eno olør, ni täärnyïme lem ni ämme peek ki rïŋö,
english: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

anywaa: eno bëëdö yïth päänye mo oränynyö, yïth uudi mo bäŋ jiy yïthge, ni beege uudi moo raanynyi.
english: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

anywaa: Eni ba bëëdö këët no okwär; jap kwärö moe ba ruu, ni bäŋe jape këët mo di jääŋŋö dï ŋööm paac.
english: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

anywaa: Eni ba bøth ki muudhö; eni ki bäädi moe, taal leep maaci taalø, ni ö eni ni puti ya jam jwïëy køøl mar dhi Jwøk.
english: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

anywaa: Beerra man ba cøøk dëëre keere ki man ŋääth gïn mo bäŋ tiere, kiper bäŋ gïn mo duue jïre.
english: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

anywaa: Kanyo poot kare ni poodi, eno laar ränynyö, ni ö bäädi moe ni ba løthge këët.
english: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

anywaa: Eni tïmö kaamar jaath omøk mo nyïïe opäth piny ni kar ciek marge poodi; ni tïme thuwø kaamar jaath mo obøøc mo kär thiiw.
english: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø dwäti ki jøøa kwier Jwøk, ge ba jïti ki gïn mo beer; kwör bëëte mo jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø di raanynyø ki maac.
english: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

anywaa: Geni, acaare mo reyø otïmö ni ena yïthge kaamar dhaanhø mo ena ec, ni puti nywøl na gïn mo raac. Geni, ge caara jap cwøk.»
english: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: Then Job answered and said,

anywaa: ni «Luup mo thööth mo caala moøgø yaa nø wïnynyö; aŋø, u bëët, kee uuna jø cøm cwïny mou meeta rääm.
english: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, cäänö maru manø ni bäŋ tiere enø, aŋuunne bäŋgø? ?Agïnaŋø na tïïc uuni nou bëëdu nou pïëmö ki aani?
english: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

anywaa: Aani thuwø, doo na u ena teeŋ kany ni bëëda yie en, doo løny jïra ki man cääna kaamar uuni; doo løny jïra ki man cääna ki luup maa jälla uuni ki ge, ni wïïa ŋøølla ŋøøllø bäätu.
english: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moa doo ö wøk ki dhaa u dee mooø ki teek, ni ö luup cøm cwïny mo wø ö wøk ki dhaa ni dwøk rääm maru piny.
english: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief.

anywaa: «'Ba këël a doo cäänö jaak, rääm mara ba døø piny; këël a doo lïŋö, ba ö wøk dëëra.
english: Though I speak, my grief is not assuaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, bääta awëëgï pädhö, ni raanynyï jap paara bëët.
english: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

anywaa: Aana wëëgï dööŋŋe na cöö keere, ni tïm dwadø mara na nyuudhi mar bääyö mara.
english: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

anywaa: Jwøk amännö ki aani, ni wëëk rïŋ dëëra jeeyø ki wëër mare. Eni lage akaaye bääta, ni raŋ aani ni waŋe owiil bääta.
english: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

anywaa: Jiy aana buuge, ni dhööŋge aani ki thäga, ni rege ege cooŋ deŋŋa ni geno ö maal bääta.
english: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

anywaa: Jwøk aana cïp ceŋ jø raay møn, ni leeŋ aani ceŋ jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø.
english: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

anywaa: Jammi bëët beyø ki baŋa na bëëde, 'ba ennø, aana tøye; aana maae ki ŋuta ni gøc aani ki piny ni peta; ni eni bëëdö naa ee niidø.
english: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

anywaa: Jø leny moe mo wø thöödhö ka athëëre aana cielge, ni ŋarge røgi 'moa ni bäŋ bäth ec mo ege nyoodhø jïra, ni ö keenhnhø mara ni øc piny.
english: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö ni meeta ŋwiili 'moa, ni eni bëëdö ni ŋwieya køøra kaamar ŋat leny.
english: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, dëëra akwönynya ka abïïn keeca ni uuma dëëra ki gø, ni buta piny yi bur ni aano ränynyö.
english: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

anywaa: Aani, nyeŋŋa awer ko oduuru, ni tïm nyeŋŋa ni jïrri.
english: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

anywaa: 'Ba ceŋŋa poot bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo tïïcge, ni lam mara poot bëëdö na kare.
english: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na ŋøøm! Remø mara kär uumï; beerra man ö oduuru mara ni ba jïte ki jwöm.
english: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, lïŋi mara ena maal, ni bee eni ni wø ŋøl luumma.
english: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

anywaa: Jøøa päät aani beege nyïïawääta, 'ba a bëëdö ni pï nyeŋŋa øya piny nyïm Jwøk.
english: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø dwøk dhaanhø kanya ciel ki ŋat mør, ?aŋø ni bäŋe ŋat dwøk wa kanya ciel ki Jwøk en?
english: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

anywaa: Kiper kanyo poot cwiiri moi ni nøk ii ni kär pöödhö, aano ci kanya näk bäŋ duuö yie.
english: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

anywaa: «Aani cwïnya aränynyö, ni ö nïr kwøw 'moa ni nø ŋøli ni nøk,ni bwörö oløny ni koora aani.
english: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jø abuua a ege cielø, naa raŋŋa apääda marge man ni tïïcge dëëra en.
english: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

anywaa: «Wui Jwøk, kööŋï ki man wïnynyï luubö mara! ?Aŋø, da ŋat mør këët nø mo cwaga aani?
english: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

anywaa: Kiper ïïni ŋeth marge acïëgï nee tiet luup ba kwanyge; kiper manøgønø, ge ba tïïyï këët nee ge wøør.
english: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

anywaa: Ŋat wø waac nyeŋ nyïïawääte ki piny nee jïte ki gwel, nyeŋ nyïïe otïmö ni rääbö ki køør ajäla.
english: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

anywaa: «Jwøk aana tïïe na gïr aŋaada jï jiy, ni tïma ni aana ŋat ŋuut jiyi bääte ki laaw.
english: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋa atïmö ni rääbö ki kïmmö; ni tïm dëëra ni cäätha piny kaamar tïpö.
english: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

anywaa: Jiy moa näk bëëtö marge thïïŋ na beyø, yïthge othäŋŋi ni lwäcge ki gïn, ni ö dhaanhø mo bäŋ gïn mo ee baa ni ö maal bäät ŋat raay ni jääl gø.
english: Upright men shall be astonished at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare tiir nyïm Jwøk, bëëtö mare oput mak; ni ö ŋat mo ceŋŋe waany ni put cääth nyïm ni teek.
english: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ööu bëët, ni cäŋu gø päänynyö. Aani, a ba jïti ki dhaanhø mo wïïe leer dïïu.
english: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

anywaa: Aani, nïne 'moa anø pöödhö, ni ö japa näk yaa cïp piny nee tïïa yi nyïm, ge ki jammi bëët mo wø manynya ki cwïnya, ni nø ränyge.
english: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

anywaa: Nyïïawääta moi, wäär awiilge na dïcäŋ; ni köge, ni ‹Tar kare cään,› naa poot ena yi muudhö.
english: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

anywaa: Ni näk mo kany ŋäädha keere beeye kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni kar niine mara ena yi muudhö,
english: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

anywaa: ni kööa jï bwörö, ni ‹Ïïna wära,› ni kööa jï twöŋi ni ‹Beege mera ki coka,›
english: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

anywaa: ?tier ŋäädhe mara age nø? ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo cädö këët ni da ŋäädhe kipera?
english: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, puta ci piny ki aani na aciel kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw? ?Aŋø, wa puta lööp piny na aciel bëët yi tør?»
english: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Bildati nyï Cuua ni kööe,
english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø ni bëëdï ni cäänö ba weyï en? Beerra man jïtï ka acaara, nee wa läwa cäännö.
english: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni bëëtwa kaamar lääy ki baŋï en, ni wa iï raŋø kere bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcwa?
english: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

anywaa: Wui, ï ni wø cööt iï ki gootø marï en, ?aŋø, iï caarø ni piny tïmö ni ba beet këët kiperï, wala kïte rege daakge daa kwörge kiper nyeŋŋï?
english: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

anywaa: «'Ba ka adïëri møn, lamba mar ŋat raay wø di bïbö, ni ö maaci mar lamba mare ni ba liele.
english: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

anywaa: Lamba man wø en deŋŋe thøw bääte; ni ö kar bëëtö mare ni dööŋe na muudhö.
english: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

anywaa: Teek mar dëëre wø cäätha piny, ni pädhe ki køør acaare moe moa näk ee cïp piny.
english: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

anywaa: Kiper eni dëëre wø leeŋe ya ajääp ni tïïya eni ki tiete keere, ni magi ya ajääpi.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

anywaa: Eni wø mak thøølli maa ki tiete, ni twöyi ya thøølli.
english: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

anywaa: Akupa bëëdö no obuŋ piny kipere; na abïëp bëëdö no ocieø waŋjööre.
english: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

anywaa: Deŋŋe bäre bëëdö no owïr gïï wø käl lwär; eni bëëdö ni køør tiere di løpø.
english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

anywaa: Teek mare aränynyö; ni bëët gïï mo lethi ni køya pädhö mare.
english: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

anywaa: Buny dëëre bäre araany täwi; ni ö tiete ki ceŋŋe ni raanynyi ya täwi mo leth.
english: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

anywaa: Ena tuut wøk ki kar bëëtö mare mana näk ree gwøø yie, ni maai ni kïthi kar thøø.
english: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

anywaa: Jammi bëët moa en kar bëëtö mare awaaŋ maaci; ni ö gïn mo liel mo caala tør ni keethe kar bëëtö mare.
english: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

anywaa: Lweedi moe atal piny yïth ŋøøm, ni ö bäädi moe na en maal ni ŋødi piny.
english: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

anywaa: Eni bäŋ ŋat mo par wïïe ki gø bäät piny; ni ö nyeŋŋe ni put bëëtö ni kuc wï ŋöömö.
english: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

anywaa: Ena tuut wøk ki yi tar ni leeŋi yi muudhö, ni riem eni wøk ki yïthakic jiy.
english: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

anywaa: Eni bäŋ obwöre jïre wala nyïïkwaaye yïthakic jø tuuŋge mo odööŋ wï paare.
english: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

anywaa: Jiy moa en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ yïthge athäŋŋö ki gïna tägö dëëre; ni ö jiyi moa en jï løø kur tuulcäŋ ni bwøkge ki gø døc.
english: They that come after him shall be astonished at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, manøgø beeye teeŋ bëëtö man wø tägi dëër ŋat raay; ni beeye bëët ŋat mo Jwøk kuue.»
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: Then Job answered and said,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, a kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëdu nou cwaata yia, naa ööllu öölö ki luup mou en?
english: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

anywaa: Ennø, kwöre aløny na apaar nou jälla aani, ni wïthu ba laay ki man caru gïï mo reyø dëëra.
english: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

anywaa: Aani, këël mo aano bääyö na adïëri, bääyö manaca doo na cuŋŋa dëëra a keera.
english: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, dëëtu atïŋu maal bääta, ni tïïyu gïna leth na en bääta ni beeye nyuudhi mar bääyö mara.
english: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ŋäyu gø ki man näk mo beeye Jwøk na kïth gïn bääta; ni bee eni na boony aani ka ajääp.
english: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, aana jwöŋö ni cwïnya oränynyö døc, 'ba bäŋ ŋat mo oduunnö jïra, ni rëëda døc kiper køny, 'ba bäŋ ŋøl luup mo otïïö.
english: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

anywaa: Eni jöö mara ee gëëŋö ni bäŋ kany mo pöödha ki yie. Eni nyeŋ jïëthe 'moa ee wïrö ki muudhö.
english: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

anywaa: Eni wödö mara akäl wøk bääta, ni ö aduda ni käl gø wøk wïïa.
english: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

anywaa: Aana wëëk raanynyø ki yïth jammi 'moa bëët ni put bëëtö mara ränynyö.  Eni ŋäädhe mara aputh wøk kaamar jaath.
english: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

anywaa: Wëër mare awëëk liel bääta kaamar maac; ni kwaan aani kaamar nyimän mare.
english: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

anywaa: Jø leny moe bëët gena öö kuna tukge aani; ni kunyge ki buri mo leny deŋ kar bëëtö mara, ni rumge kar bëëtö mara dïër ki twëëre moge.
english: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

anywaa: «Eni nyïïmera atïïe ni karge bäär ki aani, ni ö nyïïawääta bëët ni putge aani wec.
english: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

anywaa: Tuuŋwa gena aay buuta; ni ö nyïïawääta moa näk aano ŋïyö ki ge døc ni wïl wïthge ki aani.
english: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø bëëdö paara ki mään mo wø tïny aani, aana kwaange kaamar wëëllö; geni, a raŋge kaamar ŋat mo path.
english: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

anywaa: Ŋat tïïc mara wø cwøla cwølø, 'ba eni ba laar jïëy, këël na bëëda naa kwaaya gø ki dhaa kiree.
english: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I entreated him with my mouth.

anywaa: Jam dhaa atïmö ni ŋwääi ni raac jï dhaagø mara; ni tïm nyïïmera kiree ni män ki aani.
english: My breath is strange to my wife, though I entreated for the children's sake of mine own body.

anywaa: Këël obwöre moa therø gena männö ki aani; kany wø tïŋa raa jaak ge puta cäänö dëëra ki luup mo reyø.
english: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

anywaa: Nyïïawääta bëët moa näk aano ŋïyö ki ge døc, gena männö ki aani; jøøa mëëra ki geni bëët gena døø dëëra.
english: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

anywaa: Aana dööŋ na cöö keere, ni bødha dhi thøø ki kany mo thiinh.
english: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

anywaa: «Wui nyïïawääta, cwïnynyu päthge ki gïra; kiper cer Jwøk ena dëëra ni pwöta aani.
english: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni caannu aani en kaawat mana tïïc Jwøki dëëra? ?Aŋø, yïthu kär thum nø ki gïna tägö ri dëël mara?
english: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

anywaa: «Wui, doo beerra man göör luup 'moa piny! Wui, doo beerra man göör ge piny yi wëëlö,
english: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

anywaa: ni göör ge ri kïdi thuwø ni tïïc ni di tieŋø ki twöŋi mar nywïëny wø cwøl ni ayrön, ki göör man wø göör ni tïïc ka nywïëny mo oleenyø, nee bëëde na bäre bäre.
english: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ŋääa ni pïëmi mara nut ni kwøw, ni noo tïme na aŋuun nïne, eni öö ni cuŋŋe dï piny.
english: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

anywaa: 'Ba këël køør ränynyö mar buny dëëra man, aani, Jwøk poot jooda joodø ki rïŋ dëëra man.
english: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

anywaa: Aani ki dëëra, eni jooda joodø; eni jooda joodø ki waŋa kiree, ni beeye aani møn ni patha ŋat mør. Wui! cwïnya lääŋŋa gø døc!
english: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo u köö, ni ‹?Caannø gø nidïï nø? Kee tier gïna leth na tägö dëëre käla baŋe keere,›
english: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

anywaa: ennø, beerra man lwäyu ko opëëllö, kiper wëëc Jwøk kännö ka ajäla mar opëëllö; kanyøgønø, putu ka ŋäc ni da ŋøl luup.»
english: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Cöparri nyï Nayma ni kööe,
english: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

anywaa: na «Acaare moa pär cwïnya ki ge aana tïïcge naa duunna, kiper cwïnya opädhö døc.
english: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

anywaa: Aana wïnyö ki luup mo jääla aani, ni ö jwïëc leec wïc mara ni bwøth aani ki man dwöga.
english: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, kuyï ki mana käl ya acääŋŋe, na täk dhaanhe ki bëëtö bäät piny,
english: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

anywaa: ki man näk mo met ec mar ŋat raay ba ruu, ni kanynyø mare ba bëëdö ki kany mo bäär?
english: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

anywaa: Këël atöör mare okëët maal, ni eni wïïe ogutö ki pøøl,
english: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

anywaa: eni ränynyö na bäre bäre kaamar laac-døøŋŋø mare. Køøre jiy moa wara ŋäc gø ge pëëö, ni ‹Nyeni en kaa?›
english: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

anywaa: Eni rwäänyö na bäre bäre kaamar lääk, ni ba joot këët; ni put tïmö ni tøør wïc na bäre kaamar lääk møøk mo wø lägi ki wäär.
english: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

anywaa: Nyeŋ moa wara neen gø ba jootge këët; ni ö kar bëëtö mare ni dööŋe jaak ni eni tøør yie.
english: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

anywaa: 'Ba wääte, can mar jøøa can oneenge; ni ö jap kwärö moe ni muu ge ki cere keere.
english: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

anywaa: Eni cuu moe teek kaamar cuu wøp; 'ba teek mare poot thøw na aciel ki eni ni cige yïth ŋøøm.
english: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

anywaa: «Këël na bëëde ni raay ŋweeth dhee, ni ee kan tier leebe,
english: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

anywaa: ni eni bëëdö ni raay ee kut dhee, ni ba many gø nee wiie,
english: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

anywaa: eni cam mare mano came poot wïïtö yie na cïm mar olwierø.
english: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

anywaa: Eni jap kwärö moa näk ee cam yie ŋööe wøk; eni cwïnye tïïc Jwøki tïïö nee lääme ni ŋöö geni wøk.
english: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

anywaa: Eni cïm mar thwöl mana näk cäri maadhe maadhø, ni puti ya leep thwölli manøgø 'näk.
english: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.

anywaa: Eni nyeŋ näm ba neene këët, ni beege näm mo wø kwönni ki maar kïc ki caak.
english: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

anywaa: Eni jammi moa joode ki køør tïïc mare muue muuö ni ba came; ni eni yie ba mïnni ki japa joode ki køør gath mare.
english: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

anywaa: Kiper eni jøøa can acaare ni wëëk ge dööŋŋe jaak ki ceŋge, ni ö uudi mo ba geera eni ni tïïc ge na thööge.
english: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, eni ba jäŋ ki jape, ni bäŋ gïrpiny aciel mo wëëga eni mïn ec ki røk jap wø manynye.
english: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

anywaa: Eni bäŋ gïn mo but wïïe ni ba came. Kiper manøgønø, jape ba ruu ki thumö.
english: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

anywaa: Eni këël na bëëde ni jap kwärö thööth jïre, gïï mo leth wø poot jwøre jwørø; jiy mo wø en yïth gïï mo leth wø ööa maal bääte ni tïïge ree ki gïï mo leth.
english: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo en bäät cam ni cämö nee jääŋe, Jwøk wëëye owëëk lwör bäät gø kaamar køth ni eni ena bäät cam.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

anywaa: Këël mo eni bøth ki tøŋ mar nywïënyö mana teek, eno wëëk këël ka atheerø mar nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

anywaa: Eno këël ki yie ni put tuc wøk ki dïŋääe, ni ö leep atheerø mana paŋŋi ni put cwïny gø kuu wøk. 'Ba lwär mo dwøŋ oput ö bääte.
english: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

anywaa: Muudhö mana cøl bäre ööa bäät jap kwärö moe, ni ö eni ni waaŋi ya maaci mo ba løny ki bïp, ni ö jape moa dööŋ kar bëëtö mare ni puti ya maaci thöör.
english: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

anywaa: Raay moe owëëk jap maalli nyooth; ni ö pinynyi ni ö maal kuna jääl gø.
english: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

anywaa: Jammi moa en kar bëëtö mare otwier; geno käl dïcäŋ wëër mar Jwøk.
english: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

anywaa: Gïnögø beeye gïno kïth Jwøki bäät jø raay na kurge, ni beeye gïna jier Jwøki kiperge nee cïp jïge.»
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: But Job answered and said,

anywaa: ni «Beerra man cegu ïthu na kare ki luup 'moa nee tïme ni beeye jöö jïïu man cømmu cwïnya ki gø.
english: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

anywaa: Cegu ïthu jïra ki luup moo caana jïïu ii; køøre kanyo lønya ki cäänö, aano buu.
english: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, aani, a dwaalli ka nyeŋ dhaanhø cøøn? ?Aŋø, cwïnya a ba dee pädhö kiper ŋø?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

anywaa: Raŋŋu jïra ni thäŋ yïthu; ni wëëgu dhøgu mak ki ceŋŋu.
english: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

anywaa: Aani, kany wø cäda kiper gïn, cwïnya wø puta bwøk; ni ö dëëra bäre ni put tïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär.
english: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni poot jø raayi ni kwøw en, ni bëët kwøw marge cäätha nyïm, ni kwörge thuwø tïmö ni døøŋŋø døc?
english: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

anywaa: Geni obwöre moge wø døøŋŋø nyïmge, ni jootge nyïïkwaacge ki nyeŋge.
english: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

anywaa: Mïëri moge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge kiper lwär; ni ge bëëdö ni bäŋ ajäl Jwøk mo ö bäätge.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

anywaa: Rwädhe moge bäŋgø ma bwöy, ni dhäk moge moa näk mädhi ge nywøl ni beer jaak, ni bäŋgø mo bwön wøk.
english: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

anywaa: Geni, nyïïge cöörge nyïmge kaamar pïïth dïëk, ni ö nyïïge moa therø ni bëëtge ni ge pärö deŋge.
english: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

anywaa: Geni, ge wär ki dudi ni buul ki thoom pwötge pwödö; ni yïthge putge ka wëëk mïnnö ki dwør opelø.
english: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

anywaa: Nïr kwøw moge wø thöörge ni bëëtö marge orømø, ni cige yi bwörö ni yïthge met.
english: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

anywaa: 'Ba ge poot köö jï Jwøk, ni ‹Wec wa keerwa! Wa ba many man ŋäcwa uutjïëthe moï këët.
english: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Jwøa en teeki jïre aŋa, mo løny ki man tïnywa eni? ?Na agïnaŋø noo jootwa ni näk mo wa bëëdö ni wa lama eni?›
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jöö mana bëënyge ki gø ba käl ceŋge; ni aani kara bäär ki pwöc mar jø raay.
english: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

anywaa: «?A kwöre adïï ni lamba mar jø raay bïp Jwøki bïbö, ni gïï mo leth ööa bäätge? ?A kwöre adïï ni gïï mo leth jääŋ Jwøki jääŋŋö bäätge ki gootø mare?
english: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge caala lethø ni wø kwør jamø, wala tør ni wø køøl apwøyaweerø?
english: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

anywaa: Akøp ni ‹Jwøk ajäla mar ŋat raay wø kane kanø nee kïth bäät obwöre moe.› Wøp, beerra man cool kwör dëëre kiree nee røm dëëre.
english: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

anywaa: Beerra man joot ajäla mare ki waŋe kiree; beerra man mäthe ka ajäla mar wëëc Jwøk na en teeki jïre.
english: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, eni, kanyo nø thum dwäde mo ruut kwøw moe, da gïn mo caare këët kiper jø paare moa wii køøre?
english: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

anywaa: «?Aŋø, Jwøk ni wø ŋøl luup jiy moa kwörge døøŋŋø, da ŋat mo mooya gø ka acaara?
english: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mør thøw ni dëëre poot teek, ni bëëtö mare beer no ojäŋ,
english: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

anywaa: ni dëëre poot pulli ki cam, ni cuuwe poot teek ni beyø.
english: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mør thøøa yi bëëtö mo leth, ni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo yie omïnnö ki gø.
english: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ jøøgø bëët, ge poot cøøa yïth ŋøøm na aciel, ni cami ya twöŋi.
english: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, aani acaare mou ŋääa, ki luup moa näk you tuudö kipera naa raanynyu ki ge.
english: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

anywaa: Kiper uuna köö, ni ‹?Po nyena kare dwøŋ en kaa, kanya wara bëët jø raayi yie?›
english: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jiy mo wø wïdi dï mïëri käru pëënynyö, ni cegu ïthu ki luupge?
english: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

anywaa: Kiper jø wø tïïc gïïa reyø, ge wø bøth cäŋ jwør gïï mo leth, ni piem geni yi cäŋ wëër mar Jwøk.
english: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo jooga ŋat raay kiper bëëtö mar gø? ?Da ŋat mo jääla gø kiper gïna tïïe?
english: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

anywaa: Kanyo kïth eni kar koony, jiy obëëdö ni ge raŋŋa bwörö mare ni kïïnna gïre.
english: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

anywaa: 'Ba eni køøre oløp jiyi bëët, ni jiy moo cäädhi nyïme ba thum ki kwaan, ni ö ŋøøp pwöla ni put nikwöc bäät rïŋ dëëre.
english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø ni cømmu cwïnya ki luup mo bäŋ tietge ii, ni luup mo wø løgu jïra bëët beege luup tööt?»
english: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

anywaa: Køøre aløk Elipathi nyï Tëman ni kööe,
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, dhaanhø da gïn mo di kønyø dëër Jwøk? ?Këël dhaanhø mo wïïe leer, løny jïre ki man køny Jwøk?
english: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

anywaa: ?Këël mo bëëtö marï tiir, agïnaŋø noo døøyï yi Jwøa en teeki jïre ni met ki gø? ?Agïnaŋø noo duue jïre ni näk uutjïëthe moï tiir?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

anywaa: «?Aŋø, beeye kiper mana lwäärï Jwøk na ö Jwøki na jook ïïni, ni känne ka ajäla bäätï en?
english: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, paa per gïïa bayï na thööth døc, ki raay moï na näk ba thum ki kwaan?
english: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

anywaa: Kiper nyïïmeru gena tïïyï nee cïpge ki dïgïti ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere, ni kälï abïïe wøk dëët jiy ni dööŋge ki dëëtge.
english: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

anywaa: Ni kärï moa no onäk riewi mooø ki pïï, ni mänï jøøa no onäk käci ki cam.
english: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï bëëdö ni ïïna dhaanhø mo jïre da teek yi ŋöömö bäre, ni wïïï iï tïŋ maal ni ïïno wøørø yie.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

anywaa: Määr thuunhnhi gena cöörï wøk ki ceŋge jaak, ni tïïyï bëët kïïe ni teek.
english: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

anywaa: Ni bee tiere ni bëët deŋŋï bäre no owïrö ka abëëbe en,  ni ïïno boony lwärri mo cwöba riï,
english: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

anywaa: ni tïme na muudhö mo ba løny jïrï ki man nëënï, ni caala jwïïö miï ee mwønyø.
english: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, Jwøk ba bëëdö ni ena maal døc kuya? Neen ceer mø, ge ena maal døc kany mo bäär.
english: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

anywaa: Kiper ï wø köö, na ‹?Aŋø, Jwøk agïnaŋø ni ŋääe? ?Aŋø, Jwøk løny jïre ki man ŋøl luup ki yi muunhnha cøl?
english: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

anywaa: Kee eno gëëŋ pöölö mo odhïŋ, ni ba løny jïre ki man joot øøni, ni eni cäädha kar bëëtö mare maalø.›
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Jööp, ï poot bëëdö niï caatha øtjööra no oruuö en, ni beeye øtjöör wø cääth jøøa reyø ki yie?
english: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

anywaa: 'Ba gena laar thøø ni karge poodi, ni tïmge kaamar øtø mo okøøl jwïïö.
english: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

anywaa: Kiper gena köö jï Jwøk, ni ‹Wec wa keerwa! ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø ni løny jï Jwøa en teeki jïre ki man tïïc gø dëëtwa?›
english: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

anywaa: 'Ba bee eni na pääŋ mïëri moge ki gïï mo beyø; kiper manøgønø, aani a cuŋŋö ni kara bäär ki jøø ni reyø yøø.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

anywaa: «'Ba jøøa beyø, ränynyö mar jøøa reyø oneenge ni mïn yïthge, ni ö jøøa bëëtge tiir ni buuge ge ni ge köö,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

anywaa: ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, nyïïmän 'moø gena ränynyö, ni ö jap kwär moge ni waaŋi ya maaci.›
english: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, beerra man dwätï ki Jwøk, ni tïïyï bëët mëër ki gø, 'ba noo tïïyï gïnögø, ïïno jïtï ki bëëtö mo beer.
english: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

anywaa: Beerra man jïëyï ciik moa käl dhee, ni kanï luup moe yi cwïnyï.
english: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ïïno duu baŋ Jwøa en teeki jïre, ïïno døø karï. Ni näk japa reyø karge iï tïïö ni bäär ki kar bëëtö marï,
english: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

anywaa: ni leeŋï japï moa mïërö yi tør jaak, ni ö warkie moï moa tøŋ døc moa käl kanya cwøl ni Öpïr ni leeŋŋï ge yïth nyeŋ kïte,
english: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

anywaa: køøre nø, Jwøa en teeki jïre otïmö na warkey jïrï, ni tïme na gwel-bïrö mana no ojierø kiperï.
english: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, yiï omïnni ki eni na en teeki jïre, ni wëëgï täärnyïmï løø maal baŋe, eni na Jwøk.
english: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno lämö jïre, ni ö eni ni wïny lam marï, ni ö japa kööŋï kiperge ni cïpï ge jïre.
english: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

anywaa: Gïï wø caarï nee tïïyï thura karge, ni bëët tarri no orieny nyeŋ jïëthe moï.
english: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

anywaa: Ni näk da jiy mo geno dwøk piny, ïïno köö, ni ‹Ge tïŋ maal,› køøre Jwøk jøøa no odwøk piny opieme.
english: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

anywaa: Eni këël jiy moa näk ba waany løny jïre ki man køny geni, ni køny geni ki køør ceŋŋï mo wø bëëdö ni waany.»
english: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: Then Job answered and said,

anywaa: ni «Këël ennø a bëëdö naa dwaallø ni cwïnya okëënynyö, ni cere poot peek bääta këël na bëëda naa ŋurö.
english: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

anywaa: Wui, doo na kany en yie en ŋääa, eni da manynyø,  ni daa ci kar bëëtö mare!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

anywaa: Aani, luupa daa caanø nyïme, ni dhaa päŋ ki man caana luup moa en cwïnya.
english: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

anywaa: Ni daa luup leŋø moa dee løø jïra, ni daa tiet luup kwanyø moa caane.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a dee thiela piny ki teege na dwøŋ døc ri løøk? Ba doo løny, 'ba ïthe dee ciiø ki mara.
english: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare tiir løny ki man cïp luup moe nyïm Jwøk kaace; 'ba aani a doo jïtö ki køny na bäre bäre baŋ dïŋut luup mara.
english: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

anywaa: «Këël maa doo cøøa jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, eni tøør yie; ni këël maa doo cøøa jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, eni ba jooda yie.
english: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

anywaa: Këël mo eni ena bäät tïïc jï løø wï-piny, eni ba jooda yie; wala këël mo eno døø jï løø tierpiny, eni ba nëëni jïra.
english: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

anywaa: 'Ba eni uutjïëthe mo wø caadha bëët ŋääe, ni kany wø pääny aani, a tïmö naa paŋŋi kaamar warkey mo okïth yi maac.
english: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

anywaa: Tieta bëëdö ni løpa kwör cääthe mo tiet Jwøk, naa bëëdö naa caatha jööre keere naa ba gak.
english: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

anywaa: Aani ciik moe kära wiiø; aani, luup mo wø ö wøk ki dhee yaa kan cwïnya, ni perge leth jïra ni kaala cam man wø cama ki yi cäŋ.
english: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

anywaa: «'Ba Jwøk bee eni keere, ?aŋa ni løny jïre ki man mak gø ki teek ki man wiil acaara mare? 'Ba eni tïïya man wø manynye keere.
english: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

anywaa: Eni japa näk ee cïp piny kipera wëëge thur karge, ni moa näk poot ee cïp piny kipera thööth kar kän mare.
english: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere ni bëëda ni aano bwøk nyïme en, ni kany wø caara gïïögø bëët, a puta lwäyö døc ki eni.
english: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

anywaa: Jwøk, cwïnya awëëk pädhö; Jwøa en teeki jïre aana tïïe naa bwøa døc.
english: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

anywaa: 'Ba a ba lïŋi yi muudhö man, ni beeye yi muunhnhi no odhïŋ ni täärnyïma ee uumö bäre en.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

anywaa: «?A yi wäne nø noo ö Jwøa en teeki jïre noo cïp cääŋŋe piny mo ŋøl luup? ?A yi wäne nø noo ö jø wø ŋäc eni noo raŋge cääŋŋe moøgø?
english: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

anywaa: «Jiy møøk kïte moa näk ocïp nyeŋ kee na nyuuthe wø nyiikge nyiigø ni ge nyaaya pwöth moge; ni kwaalge dïëk mo jø møøk ni dwalge ge ri pïïth dïëk moge.
english: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

anywaa: Arëën mar kïïc wø kälge kälö, ni kälge dhieŋ mar cï thøø na dïgïti.
english: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

anywaa: Jøøa can wø cöörge wøk ki nyeŋ jïëthe, ni tïm jøøa canni bëët moa en yi ŋööm paac ni dëëtge kaange kaannø.
english: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, jøøa can, ge wø aa wøk dï tëën kaamar arëën paap kuna määnyge ki cam kiper nyïïge.
english: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

anywaa: Ge wø cuuŋö ki caammi yïth pwöth mo patha moge, ni jeenyge gïïa näk odööŋ piny yïth pwöth omøki mo jøøa reyø.
english: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

anywaa: Wäär wø thöörge ni bäŋ abïïe dëëtge, ni bëëtge ni bäŋ gïn umge dëëtge ki gø kiper köö.
english: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

anywaa: Dëëtge wø bëëdö ni thec ki kuunhnhi mo bäät kïte, ni ge bëëdö ni dëëtge ege dii ri kïte kiper bäŋ kar bëëtö.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jøøa reyø, møøk thunh wø cöötge wøk dhøk obwöre moa näk wëëkge othøw, ni käl geni ki nyeŋ pïït kööth mëëkge na can.
english: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

anywaa: Jøøa can ge wø bëëdö ni ge cäädhi ka dëëtge kiper na bäŋ abïï, ni ge tïëdö ki ŋaak beel ni geno buup käci.
english: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

anywaa: Geni, mädhi wø welge welø tiet jenni, ni nywøpge nyïïomøki na kwøŋ, ni ge ki dëëtge geno 'näk riewi.
english: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

anywaa: Cooyø mar jiy moa näk manynya thøø wø wïnyö dï pääny, ni ö jiyi moa näk dëëtge da ŋwiili ni jwöŋge kiper køny; 'ba Jwøk ïthe käre ciiø ki lam marge.
english: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

anywaa: «Da jiy mo wø gëëmö ki tar, mo ge ba many man ŋäcge uutjïëthe mo gø, wala ki man ruuge waŋjööre.
english: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

anywaa: Kany wø pööth tarri mar dïcäŋ, dïnäge wø puta ö maal kuna 'näkge jøøa can ki jøøa näk ocaarø; ni ge kwädö ki wäär thuwø ni dëëtge ege døøc kuuwe.
english: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

anywaa: Ni dïcwøø ma kääbi thuwø wø bëëdö ni køya muudhö, ni wø köö, ni ‹Bäŋ ŋat mo joot aani,› ni eni bëëdö ni täärnyïme ee kanø.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

anywaa: Kany wø tïme ni piny a muudhö, kuuwe uudi wø tøcge tøyø, ni kany wø tïme na dïcäŋ, dëëtge wø kange yïth uudi, ni geni bäŋ gïn manyge ri tar.
english: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

anywaa: Kiper ki baŋge, muudhö mana cøl døc ege døøy amöölla marge; ni ö jap wø känni ki lwär yi muudhö ni tïïcge ge na nyïïawäädi moge.
english: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

anywaa: «'Ba ge wø køøl pïïyi køølø ni tharge, ni ö ŋöömö mana näk kurge ni cieni, ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø dïge mo ci yïth pwöth jenni.
english: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö meelli ki lïëth piny wø løcge pïï moa näk otïmö na pey, kaawat manøgø thuwø kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw jø wø tïïc gïïa reyø wø käle kälö.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

anywaa: Geni, mëëkge wïthge oput wïlö ki ge, ni ö dëëtge ni cami ya twöŋi. Jøøa reyø wïc ba par ki ge këët; 'ba ge ränynyö kaamar jaath mo otøp.
english: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

anywaa: Geni, ge wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëët mään moa näk bwöy, ni bäŋ bäth ec mo nyoothge jï määr thuunhnhi.
english: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk jøøa teek wø raanynye raanynyø ki køør teek mare, ni këël na bëëtge ni tietge ege këël piny, bäŋ ŋäädhe jïge mar bëëtö.
english: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

anywaa: Eni ge wëëge jwöm ni bëëtge no ogwøø, 'ba waŋe ena uutjïëthe moge.
english: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

anywaa: Geni, ge tïŋa maal ki kany mo thiinh, køøre ge tïmö ni ge tøør; geni, ge dwøga piny ni cooŋ geni kaamar jiy møga bëët. Geni, ge di jelø kaamar wïth beel.
english: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo gïnögø ba tägi, aŋa noo kööp aani tööt, noo wëëk luup 'moa tïïc ni bäŋ tietge?»
english: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

anywaa: Køøre aløk Bildati nyï Cuua ni kööe,
english: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

anywaa: ni «Ŋata näk wää teeki na doo lwäärö beeye Jwøk. Eni tier bëët-mëër ee këël piny ni teek kar bëëtö mare maal.
english: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jø leny moe thum ki kwaan? ?Aŋø, aŋa ni wø dööŋ wøk ni tar mar Jwøk ba rieny bääte?
english: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, bëët dhaanhø tïme ni tiir nidïï nyïm Jwøk? ?Dhaanhø man no onywøl dhaage en, bëëtö mare tïme ni waany nidïï?
english: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

anywaa: Raŋŋu, ni näk mo tac dwääy ki tøŋ mar ceer ee taaø ki waŋe,
english: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

anywaa: ?a dhaanhø man nø, ni bäŋ kare ni caal twöŋö en, ni beeye wär dhaanhø man ni caal adïpïra jaak en, ba kadha mare?»
english: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jööpi ni kööe,
english: But Job answered and said,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni ŋata jääk iï cwaa? ?Aŋø, ki jïrï ni ŋata näk bääte opädhö iï piemø?
english: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

anywaa: ?A pwöya ŋø na cïpï jï ŋat mo bäŋ leec wïc jïre? ?Aŋø, da luup leec wïc mo thööth mo iï nyoodhø?
english: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aŋa na mooc ïïni ki leec wïc ki man caanï luupögø? ?A jwïëy moe na bwøth ïïni ki man cäänï?
english: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

anywaa: «Jwïëc jøøa no othøw kwanynyi ki lwär døc tiet pïï moa en yïth ŋøøm, ge ki jø wø bëëdö na aciel ki geni.
english: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

anywaa: Kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, na näk kar ränynyö, kär kanø ki nyïm Jwøk, ni bäŋ gïn uum gø ki man ba nëëne jïre.
english: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

anywaa: Eni maal apeere yi bääru jaak mo bäŋ gïrpiny yie; ni wëëk piny cuŋŋö bäät gïn mo bäŋgø.
english: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

anywaa: Eni pïï wëëge bëëtö yïth pøøl moe, ni ö pøølli ni bëëtge ni ba cööti ki peek mar pïï.
english: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

anywaa: Eni dwääy mo ena tar uume uumö; eni pøøl moe wëëge peer waŋ gø ni rïëp gø.
english: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

anywaa: Ena kïïö ki waŋkeew bäät naama dwøŋ, ni beeye keew man pääŋ tar ki muudhö.
english: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

anywaa: Were mo maal, dëëtge wø tïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär nyïme, ni thäŋ yïthge ki dwør juuk mare.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

anywaa: Eni naama dwøŋ awëëk nikïïl ki teek mare; ni ö lään wø cwøl ni Reeyap ni wëëk gø petø ki køør leec wïc mare.
english: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

anywaa: Jam dhøk mare, maal ajwiee ki gø, ni wëëk thwör wø rïïŋi døc 'näk ki cere.
english: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, moøgø beege japa nøk jaak røk moa tïïe. Øøni, ø wïnynya moa cari kipere ni di mooŋø mëëth jaak. ?Aŋø, dwøre manø ni teek ni caal dwør odäru enø tiere kwanyi ŋa?»
english: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

anywaa: 'Ba Jööp ena bëëdö ni poot cäänö ni kööe,
english: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

anywaa: ni «Aani, a kööŋŋa ri Jwøa kwøw na en teeki jïre, Jwøa kweer ki man tïïc ŋøl luup ma kare bääta, na wëëk aani jwør gïï mo leth ki yi cwïnya.
english: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

anywaa: Aani, këël kanyo bëëda naa poot kwøw, ni jam dhøk mar Jwøk bëëdö uma,
english: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

anywaa: dhaa ba cäänö ki luup mo reyø,  ni leeba ba cäänö ki luup cwøk.
english: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

anywaa: Aani, ba løny ki man kööa ni luummu beeye kare; aani, këël kanyo thøøa, bëëtadïëri mara ba wiia.
english: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

anywaa: Aani, bëëtö mara na tiir puta ka mak naa ba ö wøk yie na bäre. Cwïnya a ba jääle, këël kanyo bëëda naa poot kwøw.
english: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

anywaa: «Beerra man ö nyïïmänna ni tïmge kaamar jøøa reyø, ni ö jø wø ŋäbö ki aani ni tïmge ni caala jøøa näk bëëtö marge ba tiir.
english: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dhaanhø mo tøør ri Jwøk, da ŋäädhe jïre kanyo thøøe, noo ö jwïëye noo käli ya Jwøki?
english: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Jwøk ïthe ciie ciiø ko oduuru mare kanyo ö gïïa lethi bääte?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

anywaa: ?A eni, yie wø mïnnö ki Jwøa en teeki jïre, wala løny ki man ö eni ni cøør Jwøk ki yïth nïne bëët?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

anywaa: «Aani, u pwönynya pwönynyö ki jöör teek mar Jwøk; uutjïëthe mo Jwøa en teeki jïre ba kana ki uuni.
english: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, uuni bëët gïnögø ajootu ki nyeŋŋu. ?Aperŋø nø ni cäänu ki luup bøøl en?
english: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye gïn wø cïp Jwøki jï ŋat raay; ni beeye muuy man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøa en teeki jïre ni wø cïp jï ŋat wø caar jø møøk.
english: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

anywaa: Eni këël mo wääte thööth, ge thöör opëëllö thöörö ki 'näk, ni ö nyïïkwaaye ni bëëtge ni ge ba jïti ki cam mo orømø kiperge.
english: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

anywaa: 'Ba moo bøth jïre ni kwøw, ge cäŋ täwi ka nägö, ni ö määrge moo dööŋ wøk na määr thuunhnhi ni ba jwöŋge kiperge.
english: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

anywaa: Eni këël mo gwet-bïrö ee cooŋ piny kaamar tør, na abïïe ee löör piny kaamar pøl,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

anywaa: abïïe moa jiiŋŋe dööŋ wøk jï jøøa bëëtö marge tiir, ni røcge ge, ni ö gwet-bïrö moe ni pääŋŋi ya jøøa bëëtge beer.
english: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

anywaa: Øtø man wø geere tïmö kaamar øt wenyø, ni caala abïla man wø geer ŋat koorri.
english: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

anywaa: Eni cøøa baŋ niine na aŋuudi ni ŋääe ni eno kwär, 'ba kanyo pääe, jape oløny ni tøør.
english: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

anywaa: Lwär ööa bääte kaamar jwïëö, ni ö eni ni køøli ya atuunna ki wäär.
english: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

anywaa: Jamø man wø ööi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ eno køøle, ni ö eni ni put rwäänyö na bäre; eni di judhö kar bëëtö mare.
english: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

anywaa: Jamø manøgø okwöt bääte ni bäŋ bäth ec mo nyoodhe jïgø; 'ba opääre ki man päär wøk ki yi teek jamø manøgø.
english: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba jammøgø poot bëëdö ni jwöŋö bääte, ni riem eni wøk kar bëëtö mare ni di buuö.
english: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, da kany mo gwet-bïrö di joodø yie tiet ŋøøm, ki kany wø leeny warkey yie.
english: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

anywaa: Nywïënyö man wø cwøl ni bääŋ käla yïth ŋøøm, ni nywïënyö mana näk jwïël lëëny wøk ka ri kïdi.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

anywaa: Dhaanhø dønynya piny kany mo cøl yi muudhö; eni wø dønynya piny tiet ŋøøm kuya yi muudhö mo cøl  kuna määnynye ki nyeŋ kïte.
english: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

anywaa: Dhaanhø kunyö yïth ŋøøm ki kany mo ŋaam mo bäär, mo kare bäär ki kar bëëtö mar jiy, mo ba joot jiyi mo wø cäädhi. 'Ba kanyo enge yi buur kaace, buur wø løøtge løødø ki deŋŋe, ni dønyge kany mo bäär ki kar bëëtö mar jiy.
english: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm ni wø joot cam yie, tiere piny ree wiilø ni keda oraany maaci.
english: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

anywaa: Nyeŋ kïte moa paŋŋi joota yïth kïte moa en tiet ŋøøm, ni tør mare yie da warkey.
english: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

anywaa: Weny mo wø cämö ki rïŋö bäŋgø mo joot jöör gø; këël dïbëël ba løny ki man joot gø ki waŋe.
english: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

anywaa: Lääy mo wø koorri, bäŋgø mo këël tiere bäät gø, ni këël ŋuu mo teek bäŋgø mo pöödhi ki bääte.
english: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

anywaa: Dhaanhø kïdi mo teek wø tøøe tøø ki cere, ni ö eni ni kaaŋ tier kïdi.
english: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

anywaa: Eni wø tïïö ki jöö ki yïth kïte, ni jïte ki gïï mo perge leth yie.
english: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

anywaa: Eni nyeŋ näm wø gëëŋe gëëŋö nee ba kwötge, ni ö gïïa no okanø ni käl ge wøk yi tar.
english: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

anywaa: «?'Ba a kaa ŋø ni wø joot leec wïc yie? ?Kany wø kwany tiet luup yie en kaa?
english: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

anywaa: Eni, leth pere kuc dhaanhe, ni eni ba joot bäät ŋøøm kar bëët gïïa kwøw.
english: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

anywaa: Kut aköö ni ‹Eni tøør yia,› ni kö naama dwøŋŋi, ni ‹Eni tøør baŋa.›
english: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

anywaa: Leec wïc ba løny ki man wiili ki warkey mo tøŋ, ni bäŋ rumi mar gwet-bïrö mo gäte tïmö ni röömi ki gø.
english: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

anywaa: Eni ba pääri ki warkey mar kanya cwøl ni Öpïr, wala teeŋ nyeŋ kïte mo mïërö ma teeŋi.
english: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

anywaa: Eni ba dïët ki warkey wala wïlli mo tøŋ, ni eni ba løny ki man wiili ki jammi moa näk otïïö ki warkey mo tøŋ.
english: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

anywaa: Këël teeŋ nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth ba pääri ki gø, kiper gät leec wïc kaala nyeŋ kïte moøgø.
english: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

anywaa: Këël kïdi mana näk abäga na käl kanya bäär yi ŋööm jø Kuuc ba pääri ki gø, ni eni ba dïët ki warkey mana tøŋ.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

anywaa: «?A ennø, leec wïc oööe ki kaa? ?Kar bëëtö mar ŋäc tiet jammi en kaa ŋø?
english: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

anywaa: Beeye gïn mo okanø ki man neeni ya gïïa kwøwi bëët ki nyeŋge, no omwönö ki man ŋäyi ya wec maalli.
english: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

anywaa: Kar ränynyö ki kar thøø aköö, ni ‹Luumme keere awïnywa ki ïthwa.›
english: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jwøk keere ni ŋäc yi jöör bëëtö mare, ni bee eni keere ni ŋäc kar bëëtö mar gø;
english: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

anywaa: kiper eni wø lwïthö bäät piny bäre, ni joot jammi bëët moa en tier maal.
english: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

anywaa: Kiper eni kanya cïp teek jï jamø, ki kwään rumme mo pïï moo en yïth näm;
english: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

anywaa: ki kanya røm pï køth moo pänh piny, ki kanya jiiŋ jöö mar agaackøth,
