Ni ö geni ni cømge cwïny gø ni nyoothge mëër marge jïgø ki køør japa leth bëët na käl Wuuö Jwøki bääte, ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtge ni cïpe jïgø ki gwet-bïrö ki gwet ïth mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Jööp agwïëdhe yïth nïr gø moa en cään ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ. Ena jïtö ki rööm ma kume apaar kurŋween, ka athïrööle ma kume abïciel, ki dhää puur ma kume ariiø, ka arëëni ma mädhi ma kuma.
english: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

anywaa: Eni thuwø ena nyöödö ki wääte abïriiø møøk ki nyïïe ma adäk møøk.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

anywaa: Nyaare mana dïkwøŋ acaae ni Jemima, ni cak rietge ni Kejia, ni cak dääge ni Keren-Apuk.
english: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren–happuch.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ nyïïakuue mo di joodø tiet mïëri bëët mo mïërö kaamar nyïï Jööp. Ni ö wääge ni mooc geni ki kurge røk jammi moe, ni beege na aciel ki nyïïmëëkge moa näk cwøw.
english: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïnögø, Jööp abëëdö ki cwiiri ma dïpa ki pïëraŋween; ni joot wääte ki nyïïkwaaye këël mana pïïe ri ŋweer beenhnhe.
english: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.

anywaa: Køøre ena thøw no ojal no ojäŋ ki cwiiri.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋat wø ba cäädhi køør pwöc jøøa reyø, ni wø ba cäädhi jöör jø adhala, ni wø ba bëëdö buut jø abuua.
english: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec mare wø joode ka ri luup moa no ogöörö yi wëël Jwøk, ni eni cädö ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär cooth kiper luup moøgø.
english: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

anywaa: Eni caala jaath mo opiith deŋ naam, ni wø nyïïe ciek kany wø näk ma kare, ni bøøge moe ba när. Teeŋ ŋatøgø, gïï wø tïïe bëët thura karge.
english: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

anywaa: 'Ba bëëtö mar jøøa reyø patha enøgønø; ge caala lethø ni wø køøl jame.
english: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jøøa reyø ba cuŋŋi kar løøk mar Jwøk ni nyeŋge teek, ni ge na jø adhala, ge ba cuŋŋi ya acooŋ jøøa beyø,
english: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk bëët jøøa beyø ŋääe, 'ba bëët jøøa reyø cäätha baŋ ränynyö.
english: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

anywaa: ?Aŋø na ö wïth juurre ni cooŋge dëëtge kiper ageem en, ni cätge ki gïï mo oballe jaak?
english: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

anywaa: Nyeye mo bäät piny aö maal, ni ö kwääri ni dwätge ki geni na aciel, nee Wuuö Jwøk, ki dhaanhnhe na näk ee røønyø na nyeya nee nywaakge;
english: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the Lord, and against his anointed, saying,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Beerra man kälø luumge wøk bäätø na näk øøno twöö ki gø, ni wetø ciik moge na caal thøøth twöc.»
english: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ni wø bëëdö maal ŋeethø bäätge, ni put bëëtö ni gïrge ee taaø.
english: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.

anywaa: Køøre eni cäänö ki geni ni mare wëër, ni tïïc ge nee bëëtge ni lwäär ki wëëye,
english: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Aani, ŋata nø røønya na nyeya arøønya nee bëëde bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni beeye kïnna na en kur keere.»
english: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya mana røøny aköö, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki caana caanø. Ena köö jïra, ni ‹Dïcäŋi ennø, ïïna wääda, ni tïma ni aana wäru.
english: I will declare the decree: the Lord hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.

anywaa: Pëëny aani, nee wïth juurre bëët mëëga ïïni na moï, ni ö pinynyi bäre ni ci jïrï.
english: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

anywaa: Ge dïïmï dïïmö ka athøny nywïënyö, ni raanynyï geni kaamar dak mo ogøø piny.› »
english: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, u na nyeye, caarru wïthu, ni wïnynyu ŋwøc man ŋwöny uuni ki gø, u na kwääri mo piny.
english: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

anywaa: Tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk nou lwäär, ni mïn yïthu ni dëëtu kwanynyi.
english: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

anywaa: Wøørru wäädö, nee ba wëëre, nee bëëtö maru ba cääth baŋ ränynyö, kiper wëëye wø laara tägö. 'Ba gwïëth en jï jø wø kan dëëtge buute.
english: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyïïmänna atïmö ni thööth døc. Gena ö maal bääta ni tïmge ni gëëmö ki aani.
english: Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth wø cäänö kipera, ni köge, ni «Eni, bäŋ køny mo di joodø baŋ Jwøk.»
english: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï caala kwöt leny man wø gëëŋa dëëra ki gø; ni bee ï, ni wø jooda ajiem ki køørï, ni bee ï, ni wø tïïc aani nee wïïa tïŋa maal.
english: But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa kwaaya Wuuö Jwøk, ni løk kwac mara jïra ki bäät kïnne na en kur keere.
english: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

anywaa: Dëëra wø nyaaŋa piny ni gäm nyeŋŋa, ni pääa ni dëëra jööt, kiper jwïëya ena cer Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.

anywaa: A ba lwäyi ki jiy ma kume apaar, mo rege ege ciel laga.
english: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal, ni kønyï aani, ï na Jwøa; kiper nyïïmänna bëët adhööŋŋï ki thäkge, ni tøyï lakge, ge na jøøa reyø.
english: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

anywaa: Bee ï na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø piem jiy. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man gwïëthï jiyï.
english: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wïny dwøra kany wø kwaa ïïni, kiper beeye ï wø ŋun aani. Aana kønyï kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth; nyooth met ec marï jïra, ni wïnynyï lam mara.
english: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

anywaa: ?'Ba u na jiy, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdu nou jøøŋŋa aani? ?Naa këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdu nou poot mëër ki luup mo oballe jaak, nou cara tööt?
english: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man ŋäyu gø ni Wuuö Jwøk jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge ena køøre ee cïp kur keerge na moe. Këël aani, kany wø kwaa Wuuö Jwøk, dwøra wø wïnynye wïnynyö.
english: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.

anywaa: Këël dëëtu doo tïmö ni miel ki wëër, käru bääyö; cädu ki cwïnynyu kany wø enu kwör niine mou, ni döötu ba wïnyi.
english: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

anywaa: Cïpu ko olämme ma karge nou bëëdö ni bëëtö maru beer, ni ŋääthu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth wø köö, na «?Aŋa noo nyooth gïn mo beer jïwa?» 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, wëëk tac täärnyïmï rieny bäätwa.
english: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

anywaa: Met ec mo dwøŋ akïthï cwïnya, ni kaala met ec mar jø wø bëëdö ni yïthge met kany wø tïm beelli ki kwøk nyïïjenni moge ni thööth.
english: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

anywaa: A buta piny ni yia met, ni laar nyeŋŋa gämmö, kiper beeye ï keerï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø tïïc aani naa bëëda ni bäŋ gïn tägi dëëra.
english: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny kwac mara kany wø läma, ni wïnynyï cooyø mara.
english: Give ear to my words, O Lord, consider my meditation.

anywaa: Ï na nyeya mara ni bee ï Jwøa, wïny oduuru mara, kiper a wø kwaaya ïïni.
english: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka amöölla dwøra wø wïnynyï wïnynyö, kany wø läma naa køya man wø løgï jïra.
english: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.

anywaa: Kiper ï patha Jwøk mo yie met ki gïï mo reyø, niï bëëdö ni bäŋ raay mo nyänh buutï.
english: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

anywaa: Ŋat ma ŋat ŋwøc ba cuŋŋi nyïmï; niï bëëdö niï män ki jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

anywaa: Jø wø cäänö ki tööt wø raanynyï raanynyø, niï män ki ŋat cwøk ki ŋat wø rem jiy met jïre.
english: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a wø dunynya yi ødï ki køør mëër marï na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl. A wø lämö ni cøŋŋa yaa këël piny yi øt lam marï na en kur keere naa wøøra ïïni.
english: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bwøth aani ki jöör adïëri marï, kiper jïra da nyïïmän; ni tïïyï jöörï ni thïïŋ nyïma.
english: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

anywaa: Kiper jøøgø ki dëëtge bäŋ adïëri dhøkge,  ni cwïnyge päŋ ka aranya, ni lwöcge bëëdö kaamar bwör mo ŋammø, ni ge cäänö ki lëëpge ni marge cwøk.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ŋøl luubö marge ni jäälï ge; beerra man ränyge ki køør luup moa tuutge keerge; ni riemï geni wøk kiper gïïa tïïcge na thööth na reyø, kiper ge bëëdö ni ge gëëmö ki ïïni.
english: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ö jø wø kan dëëtge buutï bëët ni mïn yïthge, ni bëëtge ni ge wär ki dudi cooth ni yïthge met; niï bëëdö niï koora geni, ni ö geni na mëër ki ïïni ni jiemge ïïni ni yïthge met.
english: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

anywaa: Kiper bee ï na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø gwïëth ŋat wø bëëdö ki bëëtö ma adïëri, ni ö mëërri marï ni bëëde na gëëŋi kaamar kwöt leny.
english: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär a joogï ni marï wëër ki aani, ni ba wëërï kany wø pwönynyï aani.
english: O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cïp cwïnyï piny ki aani, kiper aana tïmö naa jääk døc. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny aani, kiper dëëra atïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär.
english: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: O Lord, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cwïnya abwøk døc. ?Aŋø, a yi wäne nø noo kønyï aani?
english: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, duu baŋa ni piemï jwïëya, køny aani ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ ŋat mo caar wïïe ki ïïni køør thøø. ?Aŋa noo maar ïïni pwøc kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw?
english: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

anywaa: Aana ööl ki kïmmö mara; ki wäär cooth pï nyeŋŋa wø øya yi pïën mara, ni ö pïënni ni neethar ki pï nyeŋŋa.
english: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋa aränynyö ki jwøk; ni wer nyeŋŋa ni kwayø ki jwøk ki køør gïïa tïïc nyïïmänna.
english: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba u bëët ni wø tïïc gïï mo reyø, daagu rou buuta, kiper Wuuö Jwøk dwøra awïnynye kanya jwöŋa.
english: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kwac mara awïnynye, ni jïëc lam mara.
english: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna bëët wïthge olääy ni bwøk cwïnyge; wïthge olääy møn, ni putge døø ŋäthge.
english: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, a bëëdö ni raa yaa kan buutï; gwøk aani ceŋ jø wø cwaat yia ni putï a køny,
english: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

anywaa: kiper naa ba tïïcge ki gïn mo leth kaawat man wø ö ŋuuwi wø cööt lääy ni di tutö, ni bäŋ ŋat køny läänögø.
english: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøa, ni näk mo da gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö, ni da gïn mo obøth jïra,
english: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

anywaa: wala aano dwök baŋ nyawatwa ki gïn mo raac, wala a twiera nyïïmänna ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere,
english: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

anywaa: beerra man ö nyïïmänna ni riemge aani ni makge aani, ni gøøge aani piny ni 'näkge aani, ni putge ajiem mara raanynyø na bäre bäre.
english: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal ni wëërï; jek riï kiper wëëc nyïïmänna; jek riï, ï na Jwøa, kiper bee ï ni wø ŋøl luup.
english: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

anywaa: Beerra man ö wïth juurre bëët ni cooŋge dëëtge kanya ciel nyïmï, ni bëëdï niï ŋøla luup moge ni ïïna kwäärö marge.
english: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk luup jiy wø di ŋølø na kare. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋøl luumma ki køør bëëtö mara na näk kare, ni ŋølï luumma ki køør bëëtö mara na beer.
english: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

anywaa: Ï na Jwøk mana näk adïëri ni wø raŋ acaac dhaanhø ki gïna en cwïnye, män gïïa reyø ni wø tïïc jø raayi, ni tïïyï jø wø bëëdö ni marge adïëri nee cuŋge ni teek.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

anywaa: Jwøk bëëdö ni caala kwöt leny jïra, ni beeye wø piem jøøa näk cwïnyge thïïŋ.
english: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

anywaa: Jwøk bee eni ni wø ŋøl luup na adïëri, ni bee eni ni wø wëër ki jø raay ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.

anywaa: Ni näk mo dhaanhø cwïnye ba løøe, Jwøk opëëllö mare di paaø, ni jiiŋ atheerø mare ka atum mare.
english: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

anywaa: Jap wø nääe ki ge ee nø jiiŋŋø, ni dhøk athëëre moe ee tïïö ni wääŋö.
english: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ŋat raay acaare mo reyø piith yi cwïnye, ni duunge ki gïï mo reyø ki tööt.
english: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

anywaa: Eni kunyö ki buur mo bäär, ni cäŋ päth yi buura koonye keere.
english: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

anywaa: Raaye døøa wïïe keere, ni ö gïïa reyø na tïïe ni døøge wïïe.
english: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki køør adïëri mare, ni wära ki duut naa pwøya Wuuö Jwøk na dwøŋ ni en maal. Manøgø beeye duut Deebit mana caae jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper Kuuc nyï Benjamen.
english: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Kwääcwa, bäät piny bäre wøøra nyeŋŋï, ni maal bäre iï pääŋö ka ajiemï.
english: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

anywaa: Teegï anyoothï jï nyïïmännï ki køør luup mo wø car obwöre moa therø këël moa näk poot dhøøth, kiper nee nyimän ki ŋat wø many cool kwör nee joogï.
english: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø raŋa maal na tïïyï ki cerï, ki dwääy ki ceer na näk iï cïp kwörge,
english: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

anywaa: a wø cädö ki cwïnya, ni kööa, ni «?Dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni lääŋŋï gø en, ni o dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni gwøgï gø en?»
english: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

anywaa: 'Ba kare atïïyï ni dwøŋ, ni caatha køør nyïïatwiet maal ki kany mo thiinh, ni røønyï gø ka ajiem ki wödö.
english: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

anywaa: Ena røønyï bäät gïïa tïïyï bëët ki cerï, ni cïbï jammi bëët cere,
english: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

anywaa: ni beege dïëk ki dhäk bëët, ki lääc paap thuwø,
english: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

anywaa: ki weny ki rec, ki gïï wø bëëdö yi naama dwøŋ bëët.
english: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Kwääcwa, bäät piny bäre wøøra nyeŋŋï.
english: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni caana tïïe moï bëët ni wø rëëm ec.
english: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

anywaa: Aani yia tïmö ni met døc ni kanynya ki køørï; a wär ki duut naa pwøya ïïni, ï na dwøŋ ni en maal.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

anywaa: Kany wø nyoothï riï, nyïïmänna wø døøa køørge, ni cwanyge tietge ni thøwge.
english: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

anywaa: Kiper luubö mara na näk adïëri aŋølï na kare, ni ïïno pï bäät wälu niï ŋøla ŋøl ma adïëri.
english: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

anywaa: Wïth juurre ni wø wøør juu møøk ajoogï, ni dïïrï wïthge, ge na jø raay, ni putï nyeŋge rwäänyö na bäre bäre.
english: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

anywaa: Wïth nyïïmän adïïrï na bäre bäre møn, ni nyaaï päänye moge piny, ni put wïci wïlö ki geni na bäre bäre.
english: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk puta bëëtö bäät wälu na bäre bäre, ni tier wälu mare ee këël piny ni teek kiper ŋøl luup.
english: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

anywaa: Eni luup jø bäät piny di ŋølø na adïëri, ni ŋøl luup jiy ki jöö mo thïïŋ.
english: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø cuŋ jøøa no ocaannø dëëre, ni bëëde na kar gwøk røk jïge kany wø näk ri gïï mo leth.
english: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

anywaa: Jø wø ŋäc ïïni, ï ŋääthge ŋäädhö; wui Wuuö Jwøk, jø wø many ïïni ba weyï.
english: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jiy, wärru duut pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk ni wø bëëdö Dhayan. Beerra man ö gïïa tïïe ni køpu ge jï wïth juurre.
english: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

anywaa: Kiper eni ni wø cool kwör remø cädö kiper jøøa no ocaannø, ni wïïe ba wïl ko oduuru marge.
english: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny aani; raŋ gïïa leth ni wø jwøra ceŋ nyïïmänna, ni kälï aani wøk cer thøø,
english: Have mercy upon me, O Lord; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

anywaa: nee gïï wø pwøc ï ki ge bëët caana jï jø Dhayan, naa bëëda ni yia met ki køør pïëm marï.
english: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

anywaa: Wïth juurre apäth yi buura koonyge keerge, ni ö tietge ni magi ya abïëba cekge.
english: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk nyeŋŋe ee tïïö nee wïnye ki køør ŋøl mare. 'Ba ŋat raay dëëre ee twöö keere ki gïïa tïïe ki cere.
english: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

anywaa: Jø raay, jwïëcge cøøa kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, këël wïth juurre bëët mo wø bëëdö ni wïthge owïl ki Jwøk.
english: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wïïe ba wïl ki ŋat mo can, ni ŋäädhe mar jøøa no ocaannø ba ränynyi na bäre bäre.
english: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal, kär dhaanhø jïtö ki teek bäätï. Beerra man bëët luum wïth juurre ni ŋøla nyïmï.
english: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, døøc wïth juurre mo lwäär, nee ŋäcge ni gena jiy jaak.
english: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø ni bëëdï ni karï bäär en? ?Na aperŋø wø kanï dëërï kany wø näk ri gïï mo leth en?
english: Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

anywaa: Jøøa reyø töödö ni caange jøøa can; beerra man ö luup moa tuutge ni døøge dëëtge.
english: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

anywaa: Ŋat raay wø ŋwöö keere ki køør mana manynye ki cwïnye, ni ö ŋat mo cwïnye päl ni jany Wuuö Jwøk ni kwier gø.
english: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.

anywaa: Ŋat raay bëëdö ni töödö, ni eni ba many Jwøk; ki yïth acaare moe bëët, eni cädö ni bäŋ Jwøk.
english: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

anywaa: Eni gïï wø manynye joode joodø cooth, 'ba eni ba cädö kiper ŋøl mar Jwøk. Eni bëëdö ni nyïïmän moe bëët ee taaø.
english: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

anywaa: Eni wø cädö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo pïï dëëra; a puta bëëtö ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo tägi dëëra na bäre bäre.»
english: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö ni dhee bëënna acïëni ki cwøk ki ŋwöny jiy, eni wø laara cäänö ki gïï mo leth ki jap rääö.
english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

anywaa: Eni wø møøra piny töök paac, ni kan ree kiper nee jøøa beyø nääe, ni eni raŋŋa jøøa näk rege ba løny køny, ki man tïïc gïn mo raac dëëtge.
english: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

anywaa: Eni dëëre wø di kanø kaamar ŋuu ni wø møør piny, ni eni kurö kiper ŋata no ocaannø nee maae. Ŋata no ocaannø wø di cøøgø ni mak gø kaawat man wø cek lääy ka abïëp.
english: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

anywaa: Ŋat mo ree ba løny køny wø gøøe piny ni pädhe, ni eni pädhi ka køør teek mar ŋat raay.
english: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

anywaa: Ŋat raay cädö ki cwïnye ni kööe, ni «Jwøk bëëdö ni wïïe owïl, ni nyeŋŋe ee miiø. Eni gïï wø tïïa ba joode na bäre bäre.»
english: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk, ö maal ni tïŋï cerï maal niï nyootha teegï; kär wïïï wïl ki jøøa no ocaannø.
english: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ŋat raay kwier Jwøk aperŋø, ni cäde ki cwïnye en ni kööe, ni «Aani, a ba pëëny Jwøki.»?
english: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, gïïögø bëët ŋäyï møn, kiper ïïni gïïa reyø ki caan jiy nëënö jïrï, ni løny jïrï ki man tïïyï mana manynyï. Ŋat mo ree ba løny køny, dëëre cïbe cïbö jïrï, ni beeye ï ni wø køny ŋat ma kïïc.
english: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.

anywaa: Raany teek mar ŋat raay ki ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø; kwaan raay moe bëët bääte, ni bäŋe aciel mo dööŋ.
english: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya na bäre bäre, ni ö wïth juurre ni wø wøør juu møøk ni thumge bäät ŋøøpe.
english: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, lam mar jøøa can wïnynyï wïnynyö.  Cwïnyge cømï cømø, ni cegï ïthï ki kwac marge,
english: Lord, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:

anywaa: nee gïn mo beer nee tïïyï kiper jøøa näk kïïe ki jøøa näk ocaannø, ni ö dhaanhø ni bëën thøø en ni ba døøc jiy mo lwäär këët.
english: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

anywaa: Aani raa wø kana buut Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, u kööu ki aani nidïï, ni «Ciï ni reŋŋï bäät kïte kaawat man wø määt wenyø;
english: In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

anywaa: kiper adïëri møn, jø raay atume moge ajiiŋge; athëëre moge ege nø cïp bäät thøøth atume moge, kiper nee ge thööthge ki yi muudhö, ni ge thööya jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo piny bëëdö ni ränynyö, agïnaŋø noo løny ki man tïïyi ya jøøa marge thïïŋ?»
english: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk nut kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni wälu mar Wuuö Jwøk ena maal. Eni bëëdö ni raŋŋa bëët jiy bëët.
english: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord's throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jøøa beyø ki jø raay wø raŋŋe raŋŋø, ni ö eni ni männe ki ŋat wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø.
english: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

anywaa: Eni cuk mo liel ki maac mo päl døc oleeŋ bäät jø raay, ni jääl geni ki jamø mo lïëth mo wääŋö.
english: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk mare beer bäre, ni yie met ki tïïc gïï mo beyø; jøøa marge thïïŋ täärnyïm Wuuö Jwøk jootge joodø.
english: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny waani, kiper atïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo cwïnye ena køørï, ï na Jwøk, ni bäŋ ŋat mo maar ka ŋääth mo di joodø këët.
english: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

anywaa: Ŋati man nø cara tööt jï watge, ni ge cäänö ka dhøkge jaak, ni cwïnyge oriewi.
english: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mec dhøgi mo wø car cwøk bëët, ni ŋør lëëpi mo wø ŋwöö døc,
english: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

anywaa: ni beege jø wø köö, ni «Løny ki man jootwa mana manywa ki køør cäänö marwa. Wa cäänö jaak ni wa ŋäätha lëëpwa. ?Aŋø, kwääywa aŋa?»
english: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «A ööa maal ennø, ni cøøa kuna kønya jøøa no ocaannø na näk bëëtö marge oränynyö, ni ge bëëdö ni ge cooyø ni bäŋ ŋat køny ge, ni kïtha ge kany mo ge gwøa gwøø yie ni beeye mana manyge.»
english: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

anywaa: Luup mo Wuuö Jwøk beege luup mo tøŋ ma karge, ni caala warkey mo oleenyø kwöre abïriiø kar thäth.
english: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wa gwøe gwøø, ni koor waani ki teeŋ jøøi ni reyø ii,
english: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

anywaa: ni beeye kany wø tïme ni jiy pwøya gïï mo reyø, ni jøøa reyø bëëdö ni ge cäädhö jaak dï paac bäre.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdï ni wïïï owïl ki aani? ?Aŋø, wïïï wïl ki aani na bäre bäre møn? ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo kanï täärnyïmï ki aani?
english: How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

anywaa: ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëda naa cädö ki cwïnya, ni cwïnya kïmmö cooth ki yïth nïne bëët? ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët nyimänna ni wïïe ee tïŋ maal bääta?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøa, cädï kipera ni løgï mara, kwøw aani, naa ba buta ni mara thøø,
english: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

anywaa: kiper nee nyimän mara ba kööe, ni «Ena bööta,» nee yïth nyïïmän 'moa ba mïnge kiper ränynyö mara.
english: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a bëëdö naa ŋäätha mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl; yia wø mïnnö kany wø piemï aani.
english: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

anywaa: Aani, a wär ki duut jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper bëëtö mara atïïyï ni beer.
english: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø cäänö ki cwïnyge, ni «Bäŋ Jwøk», gena bøøre. Gena jiy mo oränynyö, ni ge temma gïï mo reyø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïïö ki gïn mo beer.
english: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aräŋŋö ki maal ni raaŋa bëët jø bäät piny, ni ge raaŋe kaper nee jïte ki mo wïïe leer, mo manynya eni, eni na Jwøk.
english: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.

anywaa: 'Ba ge bëët, geno nø gaa wøk, ni geno nø tïmö ni ge reyø bëët, ni bäŋgø mo tïïö ki gïn mo beer, këël dhaanhø aciel kiree, bäŋgø na bäre bäre.
english: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jøø ni tïïö ki gïï mo reyø yøø bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge, ni camge jap jiya kaawat man wø cam møø jaak en, ni nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ba cwølge?
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kaaca ge tïmö ni ge lwäär døc, kiper Jwøk ena buut jøøa beyø.
english: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø manynya man kierge wïth jøøa no ocaannø, nee gïïa caarge nee ränyge. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo tïmö na kar gwøk røk marge.
english: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wø bëëdö Dhayan ni piem jiye ma jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icriel, ni beege nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni mïn yïthge ni kanyge kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo dwøk bëëtö marge kare.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa noo maar bëëtö yi ødï? ?Aŋa noo maar bëëtö bäät kïnnï na en kur keere?
english: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

anywaa: Beeye ŋat wø bëëdö ki bëëtö ma kare, ni wø tïïc mana beer, ni wø caar adïëri ki yi cwïnye;
english: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

anywaa: ni beeye ŋat wø ba wääö ki nyeŋ, ni wø ba tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëër ŋat atut mare, ni wø ba jøøŋ watge;
english: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

anywaa: ni wø män ki ŋat mo cwïnye ena køør raay, ni wø wøør jø wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk; ŋat wø ba døø ŋääe ki gïna kööŋe kipere, këël gïï mo leth doo pïï bääte;
english: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

anywaa: ŋat wø jape mac ni duui ni bäŋ mëëdi bäätge, ni wø ba ŋeew ki piny nee luubö kïth bäät jøøa beyø. 'Ba ŋat wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø bëët bëëdö kare ni teek.
english: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk, gwøk aani, kiper raa yaa kan buutï.
english: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

anywaa: Aana köö jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Beeye ïïni na Kwääya, jammi bëët moa beyø na en jïra käla baŋï.»
english: O my soul, thou hast said unto the Lord, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;

anywaa: Jøøa bëëdö na jic Jwøk yi ŋöömmi, gena jiy mo owøørø, ni beege jøøa met yia ki geni døc.
english: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø jier juu møøk ge meeta kïmmö bäätge. Aani a ba cïpi ko olämme jï juu moge, ni ba kïtha nyeŋ juu moge dhaa.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïna pere leth na tïïyï jïra beeye ki man bëëdï ni ïïna Jwøk mara, ni gum dëël mara ena cerï.
english: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, bëëtö mara bäre atïïyï ni beer, ni caala dhaanhø mo ojïtö ki ŋøøm mo beyø mo duunnö ki met ec jïre.
english: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

anywaa: Aani Wuuö Jwøk wø pwøa pwøø, eni ni wø pwöny aani; ki wäär thuwø, acaare moe na näk yaa kan cwïnya wø cäŋa cïpö ki pwöc jïra.
english: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

anywaa: Aani a wø bëëdö naa lääŋŋa Wuuö Jwøk cooth; a ba pädhi kiper mana bëëde ni eni nut buuta.
english: I have set the Lord always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, yia atïmö ni met, ni kanynya, ni puta bëëtö ni aano gwøø.
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

anywaa: Kiper jwïëya ba wiiï kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni ö dëër dhaanhnhï na en kur keere ni ba wëëgï gø bëëtö yi bwörö.
english: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

anywaa: Øtjöör kwøw wø nyuunhnhï aani, ni døøyï yia mo met døc kiper man wø nudï buuta; 'ba gïï wø cïpi ki met ec nutö buutï cooth.
english: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny luumma ni beer, ni cegï ïthï ko oduuya, wïny lam mara man lama ni bäŋ cwøk yie en.
english: Hear the right, O Lord, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

anywaa: Beerra man ŋølï mara na kare, ni raŋï gïna na adïëri.
english: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

anywaa: Ni näk miï lïïmmö baŋa ki wäär, ni neenï cwïnya, ni raŋŋï aani døc, bäŋ gïn mo raac mo jootï ri bëëtö mara. A bëëdö ni dhaa yaa gwøø kiper naa ba bääya kany wø cääna.
english: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

anywaa: Ki køør luummï, dëëra yaa gwøø ki tïïe mo wø tïïc jiyi; ni dëëra yaa mänö ki uutjïëth dïwït.
english: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

anywaa: A wø caatha jöörï cooth, ni bäŋ gïn mo cwanynya tieta.
english: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, kiper ŋääa ni gïno kwaa tïïyï tïïö jïra; cek ïthï ni wïnynyï luumma.
english: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

anywaa: Ï na dïkunyi mar jø wø kan rege buutï kiper nyïïmän moge; nyooth mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ki jöö mo rëëma ec.
english: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

anywaa: Gwøk aani kaamar guu waŋ, ni kanï aani tiet bwöpï,
english: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

anywaa: kiper jø raay ni wø many man raanyge aani, ni beege nyïïmänna moa näk a ege tii dïër wø many aani naa 'näkge.
english: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

anywaa: Wïthge ege cïëgö ki gïï wø jwør jø møøki, ni ge cäänö ni ge töödö.
english: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

anywaa: Gena nø lään bääta, ni ennø, a ege tii dïër; ni ge manynya jöö man raanyge aani ki gø.
english: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

anywaa: Ge caala ŋuu mo manynya gïn jaae nee came, ni caalge nyi ŋuu mo omøør piny.
english: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal, ni päärï yïthakicwa ni böötï geni. Køny aani ceŋ jøøa reyø ki køør mano tïïyï ko opëëllö marï.
english: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør teegï, køny aani ceŋ jiy, ni beege jøøa näk ojäŋ ki jap bäät piny. Yïthge opääŋï ki gïïa näk iï kanø kiperge, ni jïtge ko obwöre mo thööth ki køør mana manyge, ni wecge japge jï obwöre moge.
english: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra, täärnyïmï oneena ni bäŋ ajäla bääta këët. Kanyo pääa, a puta bëëtö ni yia met ki køør mano bëëda buutï.
english: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na teek mara, a mëër ki ïïni.
english: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna teek mara, ni ïïna kar gwøk røk kipera, ni beeye ïïni wø piem aani. Ïïna Jwøk mara møn, ni teek mara wø jooda baŋï, ni beeye ï wø kana raa buute. Ï caala kwöt leny naa gëëŋŋï gëëŋŋö ki gïï mo leth, ni beeye ï na pïëmi mara, niï caala kiir kipera mo ogeerø ni teek.
english: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na näk orømø ki pwøc, kany wø kwaa ïïni, a wø putï ka køny ceŋ nyïïmänna.
english: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni aano ciel thøø dïër kaamar dhaanhø mo omeenø ki thøøl, ni ö ränynyö mo päl ni pïïe bääta kaamar naam mo pänhnhö.
english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

anywaa: Kar thøø atïmö ni cään ki aani, naa ee meenø kaamar thøøl møn, ni thøø bëëdö naa ee ciiø kaamar abïëp.
english: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth, aana jwöŋö dëërï; aana jwöŋö dëërï møn kiper køny, ï na Jwøk mara,  ni ö dwøra ni wïnynyï gø niï ena kar bëëtö marï. Aana jwöŋö kiper køny, ni putï gø wïnynyö møn.
english: In my distress I called upon the Lord, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør teegï, piny aput tïmö ni kwanynyi ni jäŋŋi, ni ö tiet kïte ni putge rege tuk, ni putge tïmö ni jäŋŋi ki køør wëër marï.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jwïëyï ki jwïëy mo dwøŋ, jïrö mo päl aput nitul ki ummï, ni ö maaci ki cuk mo oäpö mo jiy di thöörö ni öge wøk ki dhiï.
english: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, maal ajapï ni ööï piny, ni kanya cäädhï, kuna näk da tietï piny da pöölö mo cøl døc.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna put mäännö niï ena bäät nyïïatwiel maal mana cwøl ni kirubël; niï määnni ka yi jamø.
english: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋŋï bäre atïïyï na muudhö, ni tïme na gïn gëëŋ ïïni, ni ö pøølli mo nëëni na køth ni put maal gääbö.
english: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

anywaa: Ni tar mo dwøŋ cäädhö nyïmï, ni ö peyi ka agaackøth mo malla yi pöölö mo odhïŋ ni putge pöödhö ki nyïmï.
english: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dwørï awïnyö kaamar køth mo pöödö maal, ni caanï marï, ï na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

anywaa: Ni tïïyï køth ni pöödö bäät nyïïmän, ni caala man wø thöödhö ka athëëre, ni ö nyïïmänni ni putge keethø, ni putï wïthge kier ka agaackøth mo mal døc.
english: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya wëërï ki nyïïmännï niï jooga geni, kanya jwïëyï ki jwïëy mo dwøŋ, tiet ŋøøm aput nëënö, ni ö pï naama dwøŋ ni pääŋge rege këël mana nëën ŋøømmi.
english: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, cerï arwääï niï ena maal, ni lwørï aani; ni kälï aani wøk ki yi bëëtö mo leth, ni caala man wø lääm dhaanhø wøk ki tiet pïï.
english: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

anywaa: Aana piemï ceŋ nyïïmänna moa bëëdö ni teeka ge bääta, ni beege nyïïmänna moa teek døc ni kaala aani, ni beege jøøa bëëdö ni män ki aani.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda ni aano ränynyö, nyïïmänna aö maal bääta, 'ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna bëëdö niï køønynya aani;
english: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

anywaa: ni kälï aani wøk ki kany mo diiny mo jwïëya omiiø yie; ni japï jöö jïra ni dunynya wøk ki yïth gïï mo leth, ni kønyï aani kiper mana bëëdï niï mëër ki aani.
english: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana cunnï ki køør bëëtö mara na beer; ni ŋatï aani ki køør mana waany dëëra ni bäŋ raay.
english: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

anywaa: Kiper aana bëëdö ni luupï yaa gwøø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk; ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö mo pää aani ki ïïni, ï na Jwøa;
english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

anywaa: kiper aani luup ŋøl moï bëët ena nyïma, ni kära gaa wøk ki ciik moï.
english: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö mara nyïmï, ni bëëda ni raa yaa gwøø ki raay.
english: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana cunnï ki køør bëëtö mara na beer, ki køør bëëtö mara na bëëda ni dëëra waany nyïmï, ni bääta bäŋ raay.
english: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl wø nyoothï nyoodhø jï jø wø bëëdö ki bëët-mëër, ni nyoothï bëëtö marï na näk kare jï jø wø bëëdö ki bëëtö ma kare.
english: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

anywaa: Tac cwïny marï wø nyoothï nyoodhø jï jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge tar; 'ba ï wø bëëdö ni waŋï riek bäät jø wø bëëtö marge ba tiir.
english: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

anywaa: Jøøa no ocaarø wø kønyï kønyø; 'ba jø wø töödö, wïthge wø dwøgï piny.
english: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ï ni wø cïpi ki tar jïra; ni beeye ï na Jwøa ni wø wiil muudhö mara na tar.
english: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

anywaa: Ki køør teek marï, a wø reŋŋa baŋ jø wø ö baŋ twëër; ni beeye ï na Jwøa ni wø mooc aani ki teek mo päära yi kiir mar nyïïmän ki gø.
english: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jwøk, bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö marï, ni luubö marï adïëri; niï bëëdö niï caala kwöt leny jï jiy bëët mo wø kan rege buutï.
english: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da jwøk mør këët mo caala ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk? ?A da ŋat mo teek mo caala ïïni, ï na Jwøwa?
english: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?

anywaa: Beeye ï Jwøk ni wø tïïc aani ni teek; ni beeye ï wø tïïc bëëtö mara ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ree.
english: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

anywaa: Tieta akwathï ni tïmge ni jööt ni caala tiet aŋer, ni tïïyï aani naa cuŋŋa naa teek kwöra perge leth na en bäät thuuri.
english: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

anywaa: Aana pwönynyï ki uutjïëth leny, ni tïme ni løny jïra ki man thöödha ka atheerø ma atum mare tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

anywaa: 'Ba ï caala kwöt leny jïra ni wø piem aani, ni beeye ï wø jøl aani ki cer cwïïï, ni ö kønynyi marï ni put kara tïïc ni dwøŋ.
english: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

anywaa: Waŋjöö ajapï ni dwøŋ nyïma, ni kära tiera cwaanyø.
english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

anywaa: Aani, køør nyïïmän 'moa aŋwiea ni puta ge mak, ni kära duu ŋääa këël mana ö nyïïmänna na thumge.
english: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

anywaa: Nyïïmän 'moa wïthge adïïra møn, ni puta ge nyath na bäre, ni tïme ni ba løny jïge ki man öge maal këët; ni putge bëëtö ni geno pädhö tieta.
english: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana mooyï ki teek mo këëda ki gø ri leny, ni ö jøøa ö maal bääta ni putï wïthge dwøk piny jïra.
english: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

anywaa: Ïïni, nyïïmänna atïïyï nee ŋäthge luuge baŋa ni reŋge, ni ö jøøa bëëdö ni män ki aani, ni puta ge thöör.
english: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jwöŋge nee ge køny, bäŋ ŋat mo okøny geni; këël mana kwacge ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ gïn mo iï løø jïge.
english: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the Lord, but he answered them not.

anywaa: Køøre nø, gena puta nyath këël mana tïmge ni caala tør mo okwør jamø, ni nyøra geni kaamar odhöönh mo ena dï jöö.
english: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

anywaa: Aana kønyï ceŋ jø powa moa bëëdö ni gëëmö ki aani; ni tïïyï aani nee wïth juurre tïmge ni ena tiera; këël wïth juurre mo kuua, ge puta bëëtö ni ge bëënna aani.
english: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

anywaa: Juurre mo path, a wø wøørge wøørø ni dëëtge rïïŋö ki lwär, ni kany wø cäänna geni, dwøra wø wïnyge wïnynyö.
english: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, bäätge opädhö,  ni öge wøk yïth kiiri moge moa no ogeerø ni teek ni dëëtge kwanynyi.
english: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï nut niï kwøw møn. Pwøc en jïrï, ï na teek mara; beerra man ö nyeŋŋï ni wïnye, ï na Jwøk ni wø piem aani.
english: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

anywaa: Beeye ï na Jwø wø cool kwöra dëët nyïïmänna, ni wø tïïc wïth juurre nee bëëtge ni ena tiera.
english: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

anywaa: Beeye ï thuwø ni wø køny aani ceŋ nyïïmänna; ni tïïyï jøøa ö maal bääta nee bëëtge ni ena tiera; ni kälï aani wøk ceŋ jø kwöri.
english: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï pwøa pwøø dï wïth juurre, ni wära ki duut naa pwøya nyeŋŋï.
english: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

anywaa: Beeye ï wø køny aani, a na tïïyï na nyeya; ni ö mëërri marï na näk ba jøøl ni putï gø nyooth jïra, a na tïïyï nee wïïa thïïmmi ki maaw niï røønya aani; ni ö mëërri manøgø ni put bëëtö ni nut kipera, a na Deebit en, ni pïïe baŋ nyïïkwaaya ni ba cuŋ.
english: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

anywaa: Maal cara ajiem Jwøk, ni bëëdö ni nyøtha tïïe mo cere.
english: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ man nø bëëdö ni køpa ajiem Jwøk jï dïcäŋ maya, ni wäär man nø bëëdö ni nyøtha tier ajiem manøgø jï wäär maya.
english: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

anywaa: Geni, ge bäŋ dhøkge mo ge cäänö ki ge, ni bäŋ luup mo caange mo wïnyö;
english: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

anywaa: 'ba döötge poot pïï dï piny bäre, ni ö luupge ni këët teegi mo piny bäre. Jwøk atïïö ki kar bëëtö maal kiper cäŋ,
english: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

anywaa: ni tuul cäŋŋi wøk ki yie kaamar ŋat nywöm mo ö wøk ka yi øde, ni ö wøk ni caala ŋat ŋwïëy mo teek mo rïïŋi ni yie met.
english: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

anywaa: Eni tuulö ki kare ni wø tuule ki yie, ni caath maal bäre këël kanyo pïïe kany wø päth yie, ni bäŋe gïn mo bøth ni ba lëënhnhi.
english: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

anywaa: Ciik Wuuö Jwøk tiir, ni jwïëc dhaanhø wø døøye mo nyään. Luum Wuuö Jwøk di ŋäädhö, ni ŋat wø poot bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe wø di mooø ki leec wïc.
english: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

anywaa: Ciik Wuuö Jwøk beege karge, ni cwïny dhaanhø wø døøcge mo met. Gïïa cem Wuuö Jwøki bäŋ gïn mo raac rege, ni nyeŋ dhaanhø di jabø ni døøcge ge mo tøŋ.
english: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye gïn mo beer, ni beeye gïn mo bëëdö na bäre bäre. Luup ŋøl mo Wuuö Jwøk beege adïëri, ni ge bëëdö ni beyø karge bëët.
english: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët di manynyø døc ni kaala man wø many warkey; di manynyø møn ni kaala warkey mana tøŋ døc. Gïïögø bëët met døc ni kaala maar kïc,  ni met marge kaala ŋweeth maar kïc ma tëëma.
english: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ciik moï beege ni wø kööm aani, a na laŋŋï; ni näk mo geno gwøø, da gïn mo dwøŋ mo duuge duuö.
english: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

anywaa: ?'Ba aŋa ni maar bääyö mare caar e keere? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wec gïïa baaa ni kuua, ni wëënnï aani.
english: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

anywaa: Män aani thuwø ki gïïa reyø nee ba kama ki teek wïc mara; kära tïmö ni aana laŋŋø mar gïïa reyø. Køøre nø, a bëëdö ni bäŋ ajäla bääta, ni dööŋa wøk ki bëët adhala kare bäre.
english: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï ni wø kana raa buutï, ni bee ï ni wø piem aani, beerra man ö luupa ka acaare 'moa ni tïmge ni mïërö nyïmï.
english: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny kwac marï kany wø näk miï ena yïth gïï mo leth; beerra man ö eni na Jwø Jeekap ni koor ïïni.
english: The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki baŋï ki kar bëëtö mare na en bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni køny ïïni ni mooc ï ki teek.
english: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni par wïïe ki muuce moï bëët, ni put bëëtö ni yie met ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre mo wø cïpï.
english: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gïï wø caarï bëët nee thurge karge, ni tïïe ka køør mana manynyï ki cwïnyï.
english: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

anywaa: Waani wa wär ki duut ni yïthwa met kiper mano böötï nyïïmännï, ni tïŋwa bëëre mowa maal ki nyeŋ Jwøø. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk gïï wø pëënynyï baŋe bëët thur karge.
english: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋääa ni Wuuö Jwøk dhaanhnhe na wï gø thïïmme ki maaw ni røønya gø na nyeya kønye kønyø, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny kwac mare ki maal kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni køny eni ki køny mo dwøŋ ki køør teek mare.
english: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

anywaa: Jø møøk ŋäätha jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni ö møga ni ŋääthge okwëënyi mo leny; 'ba øøni, ø ŋäätha teek Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.

anywaa: Geni tietge ocwanyge ni päthge, 'ba øøni ø ööa maal ni cuŋŋö ni ø teek.
english: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny nyeya nee nyïïmän bööte; wïny marwa kany wø kwacwa ïïni.
english: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyeya yie atïmö ni met ki køør teegï, ni yie mïnni ka køør mana kønyï eni.
english: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

anywaa: Gïna manynye døc ki cwïnye atïïyï jïre; gïna kwaae kärï mänö ki eni.
english: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

anywaa: Ïïna ö baŋe ni tïïï ki gïï mo beyø jïre, ni kïthï wïïe ka aduda mo tïïc ka warkey.
english: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

anywaa: Ïïna kwaae kiper nee bëëde ni kwøw, ni cïpï gø jïre, ni mooyï eni ki nïr kwøw mo puta bëëtö na bäre bäre.
english: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ajiem mare atïmö ni dwøŋ døc ki køør køny marï; ena mooyï ka ajiem ki wödö møn.
english: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

anywaa: Ena tïïyï nee bëëde no ogwïëdhö na bäre bäre, ni døøyï yie mo met kiper man wø nudï buute.
english: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

anywaa: Nyeya bëëdö ni ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk; 'ba kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni mëëre ki nyeya ki mëër mo ba jøøl, eni na nyeya puta bëëtö kare ni teek.
english: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

anywaa: Ï na nyeya, nyïïmännï bëët magï maaø; jø wø män ki ïïni magï maaø møn ki køør teek marï.
english: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

anywaa: Kanyo nyoothï dëërï, geno raanynyï kaawat man wø ö maaci wø räänye; ge raany Wuuö Jwøki raanynyø ni thumge ki køør wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac.
english: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

anywaa: Nyïïge oraanynyï bäät piny na bäre bäre; këël nyïïkwaacge thuwø wïthge odïïrï yïthakic jiy.
english: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

anywaa: Këël nyïïmän moï doo cädö ki gïï mo reyø kiperï, ni tutge ki luubö, luummeca ba thur kare jïge.
english: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

anywaa: Geno thööyï ka athëëre, ni døøge køørge.
english: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bëëdï ni karï dwøŋ ki køør teegï. Waano wär ki dudi ni pwøcwa ïïni kiper teek marï.
english: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, Jwøa, aŋø ni weyï aani en? ?Aŋø ni tïïyï karï ni bäär ni ba kønyï aani en? ?Na aŋø ni ba kønyï aani kany wø jwöŋa dëërï?
english: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøa, a jwöŋö dëërï ki dïcäŋ cooth, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo løgï jïra, ni jwöŋa dëërï ki wäär thuwø, ni dëëra ba jwöma ki jwøk.
english: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ïïna Jwøk miï ena kur keerï, niï bëëdö ni jø Icriel pwøya ïïni.
english: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

anywaa: Wëëkwa abëëdö ni ge ŋäätha ïïni; ïïna ŋääthge møn, ni piemï geni.
english: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

anywaa: Gena jwöŋö dëërï ni piemï geni; ïïna ŋääthge, 'ba ŋäädhe marge kär aay jaak.
english: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a paa dhaanhø; a röömi ka twöŋö. Aano taak jiyi, naa bëëdö naa ege päädö.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

anywaa: Jø wø joot aani bëët a wø buuge buuö, ni lëëpge wø rwääge wøk ni wïthge tuuŋge tuuŋŋö, ni köge,
english: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

anywaa: «Eni kee Wuuö Jwøk ee ŋäädhö. ?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ba køny eni ŋø? ?Aŋø, ni näk mo Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki eni, eni ba kønyi Wuuö Jwøki aperŋø?»
english: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ïïni na tïïc aani nee lwaarø ki aani, ni gwøgï aani kanya ena köör mera.
english: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.

anywaa: Ki mana ö mera ni lwaare ki aani, a ena cerï, ni beeye ïïni na Jwøa ki mana täge naa ena yi mera.
english: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär karï tïmö ni bäär ki aani, kiper gïï mo leth karge cään, ni bäŋ ŋat mo køny aani.
english: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna moa thööth aana cielge dïër, ni caala man wø tïïc rwäth dhäki moa teek mo jø Baacan.
english: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna atïmö ni caala ŋuu mo dhee ee ŋaamø, ni märö ni manynya man cam dhaanhø.
english: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

anywaa: Aana tïmö naa jääk døc, ni ö nyeŋ cuuwa bëët ni panyge rege, ni puta lwäyö døc.
english: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

anywaa: Cwaaga atal na bäre, ni ö leeba ni neebøønhnha wøk, ni tïïyï a kaamar dhaanhø mo othøw.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.

anywaa: Jiy mo tïïö ki gïï mo reyø aana cielge dïër kaawat man wø tïïc guuwi; ceŋŋa ki tieta agurge.
english: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

anywaa: Cuuwa bëët atïmö ni løny ki kwaan jïra. 'Ba nyïïmänna bëëdö ni neeta aani ni ge buua aani.
english: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

anywaa: Abïïe moa en dëëra apääŋge yïthakicge ki køør nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ni pätha baŋ ŋati man nø.
english: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, kär karï tïmö ni bäär ki aani; ï na pïëmi mara, laar rwänh kuna kønyï aani.
english: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

anywaa: Gwøk jwïëya naa ba 'näk ko opëëllö, ni gwøgï jwïëya ceŋ nyïïmänna.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

anywaa: Piem aani ceŋ nyïïmänna moøgø ni caal ŋuuwe yøø; piem aani møn ceŋ nyïïmänna moøgø ni caal jööpe yøø mo tukge beth.
english: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

anywaa: Aani, nyeŋŋï caana caanø jï nyïïmera ma jø Icriel, ni pwøa ïïni kany wø dee acooŋ lam.
english: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

anywaa: Uuni ni wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk; uuni na nyïïkwaac Jeekap bëët, jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, ni wøørru eni, u na nyïïkwaac Icriel bëët.
english: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper eni ŋat mo ocaannø ba taae wala ba kwiere, ni täärnyïme ba kane ki gø, 'ba kany wø ö ŋatøgø wø kwac eni, dwør gø di wïnynyö.
english: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a wø mooyï mooø ki teek man pwøa ïïni ki gø dï acooŋ lam mo dwøŋ, ni cïba gïïa kööŋa ki ge jïrï ni nëënö jï jø wø lwäär ki ïïni.
english: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

anywaa: Jøøa no ocaannø cämö ni jäŋge; jø wø many Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk opwøcge. 'Ba ennø, u bëëdö nou kwøw.
english: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

anywaa: Jø bäät piny bëët wïthge ocaarge, ni duuge baŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö wïth tuŋi mo juurre bëët ni wøørge eni.
english: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye nyeya, ni wïth juurre bëët ena cere.
english: For the kingdom is the Lord's: and he is the governor among the nations.

anywaa: Jøøa no okwär bäät piny bëët geno cämö ni wøørge eni; këël jøøa can bëët thuwø ni wø karge cään ki thøø cøŋge këëlge piny ni kuulge wïthge piny nyïme, ni beege jø wø rege ba løny køny keerge ki teek marge.
english: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

anywaa: Jiy moo nywøl yi nyïme obëëdö ni tïnynya Wuuö Jwøk,  ni ö jiyi ni caange gïre jï beenhnhe moo ööi;
english: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

anywaa: ni öge ni caange adïëri mare jï jiy moa näk poot kär nywølø, ni ge caana gïna tïïe kiree.
english: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye dïkwääy mara; bäŋ gïn maa can ki gø.
english: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

anywaa: A wø mooe mooø ki cam ni jäŋa, naa bëëdö kaawat man wø bëët dielli mo obut piny yi luum mo pulli; ni bwøth aani ki buut pïï mo tøŋ.
english: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

anywaa: Jwïëya wø døøye mo nyään, ni bwøth aani ki øtjöö mo beer kiper nee nyeŋŋe pwøc.
english: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, këël a doo cäädhö kany mo cøl ma kar thøø, bäŋ gïn mo lwäära lwäärö, kiper ï nut buuta; cwïnya wø cømï cømø kany wø koorï aani, kaawat man wø ö dïkwääy wø koor dïëk ni cere da tøŋ ki waragööy.
english: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cam wø jiiŋŋï jiiŋŋø jïra kaamar dhaanhø mo pänhnha wëëllö, ni wïïrï dëëra ki maaw, ni ö awalli mara man wø mädha ki gø ni tïme ni päŋ ni manynya øc piny. 'Ba nyïïmänna, ge neeta aani, naa ba løny ki kam jïge.
english: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, beenynyï ki mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö ni løpa køøra yïth nïr kwøw 'moa bëët, ni puta bëëtö yi ødï na bäre bäre.
english: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

anywaa: Piny bäre ki jammi bëët moa en yie beege mo Wuuö Jwøk, këël jiy bëët mo bëëdö yie en.
english: The earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

anywaa: Kiper eni piny acwää bäät näpa døøŋŋø, ni këël tier gø piny ni teek.
english: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man eth bäät Kïn Wuuö Jwøk? ?Na aŋa ni løny jïre ki man cuŋŋe kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk na en kur keere?
english: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

anywaa: Beeye ŋat mo bëëdö ni tïïe moe ka acaare moe beyø, na ŋat mo cwïnye ba en køør gïn mo patha adïëri, ni ba kööŋ ni mare cwøk.
english: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋatøgø gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki gwïëdhö, ni jïëyi ya Jwøki ni mare beer, ni beeye Jwø wø piem eni.
english: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

anywaa: Jiy mo caala teeŋ ŋatøgø beege jø wø bëëdö ni manynya Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø many eni, eni na Jwø Jeekap.
english: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

anywaa: Wui dhøk kiiri, japu rou; japu rou, u na dhøk kiiri moa cääŋŋe, kiper nee nyenynya näk ajiem mare päl nee dunynye.
english: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, nyenynya näk ajiem mare päl aŋa? Beeye Wuuö Jwøk na teek na dwøŋ, ni bee eni na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø nyooth teek mare kany wø näk ri leny.
english: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

anywaa: Wui dhøk kiiri, japu rou; japu rou, u na dhøk kiiri moa cääŋŋe, kiper nee nyenynya näk ajiem mare päl nee dunynye.
english: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, nyenynya näk ajiem mare päl aŋa? Beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee eni na nyenynya näk ajiem mare päl.
english: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö na acaara mara bäre ena baŋï,
english: Unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

anywaa: naa bëëdö naa ŋäätha ïïni, ï na Jwøk mara; kär wïïa wëëk lääö, ni ba wëëgï nyïïmänna ŋeethø bääta.
english: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jø wø raŋ jïrï wïthge ba lääi, 'ba jø wø bëëdö ni kämö jaak wïthge olääi.
english: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyooth jöörï jïra, ni pwönynyï aani ki man cäädha jöörï.
english: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.

anywaa: Bwøth aani ki jöörï na näk adïëri ni pwönynyï aani, kiper bee ï na Jwø wø piem aani, naa bëëdö naa raŋŋa jïrï cooth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, par wïïï ki met ec marï, ki mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, kiper beeye bëëtö marï cøøn ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe cøøn.
english: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

anywaa: Kär wïïï parï ki raay moa tïïa naa poot thiinh, këël gïïa baaa; Wui Wuuö Jwøk, lääŋ aani ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ki beer marï.
english: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beer ni mare thïïŋ; kiper manøgønø, jø raay wø di pwönynyö ki jöö mo beer.
english: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

anywaa: Eni jøøa mwöl wø di bwødhø ki jöö ma kare, ni pwöny geni ki jööre.
english: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

anywaa: Jöör Wuuö Jwøk beeye jöö ma adïëri ni yie da mëër mo ba jøøl jï jø wø gwøk luumma tuude ki gïïa caane.
english: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wëën gïïa baaa ki køør nyeŋŋï, kiper raay 'moa thööth.
english: For thy name's sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk onyuunh Wuuö Jwøki ki jöö man caadhe.
english: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

anywaa: Eno bëëdö ni bëëtö mare bäre beer, ni tïm ŋøømmi ni ena ceŋ nyïïkwaaye.
english: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk gïïa en cwïnye caane caanø jï jø wø lwäär ki eni, ni lam tier gïna näk ee tuudö jïge.
english: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

anywaa: Aani, a wø raŋŋa jï Wuuö Jwøk cooth, kiper eni tieta käle wøk ki ya abïëp.
english: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, luu nyïmï baŋa ni kønyï aani ki køør met ec marï, kiper aano dööŋ keera ni aano caarø.
english: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

anywaa: Gïï wø raany cwïnya athöönhnhö; beerra man kälï aani wøk ki yïth gïïa leth ni wø jwøra.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

anywaa: Raŋ caarø ki teek bëëtö mara, ni wëënnï raay 'moa bëët.
english: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

anywaa: Aŋø ni ba raŋï nyïïmän 'moa nø, kiper gena tïmö ni ge thööth,  ni mänge ki aani ki män mo dwøŋ døc.
english: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

anywaa: Koor aani ni kønyï aani; kär wïïa wëëk lääö, kiper raa yaa kan buutï.
english: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

anywaa: Beerra man ö bëëtö mara na beer na thïïŋ ni gwøk aani, kiper a bëëdö naa raŋŋa jïrï.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

anywaa: Ï na Jwøk, køny jø Icriel yïth gïïa leth bëët ni en bäätge.
english: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋun aani, kiper a bëëdö ka bëëtö mo tiir, naa bëëda naa ŋäätha ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni cwïnya ba wiila.
english: Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, many yia ni raŋï aani døc; ni raŋï cwïnya ka acaara mara bäre.
english: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

anywaa: Kiper a bëëdö naa lääŋŋa mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, naa cäädhi ka køør adïëri marï.
english: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

anywaa: A bäŋ wø pï piny kanya ciel ki jiy mo cara oballe, naa ba cäädhi ki jø cwøk;
english: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

anywaa: a män ka acooŋ jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, naa bäŋ wø pï piny kanya ciel ki jø raay.
english: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

anywaa: Aani, ceŋŋa lwøa lwøø naa nyootha gø ni bäŋ raay cwïnya, ni wïra deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk,
english: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O Lord:

anywaa: nee gïrï køba naa dwøga met ec, naa cara tïïe moï bëët ni wø rëëm ec.
english: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, yia met ki øtø marï na näk kar bëëtö marï, ni beeye kany wø joot ajiem marï yie.
english: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

anywaa: Kär a 'nägï ki jø raay na aciel, ni ba raanynyï aani na aciel ki jø wø nääö ki jiy,
english: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

anywaa: ni beege jø wø tudö ki gïï mo reyø, ni wø kädi ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny.
english: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a poot cäädhi ka jöö mana na adïëri; put aani køny ki køør met ec marï.
english: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

anywaa: Ennø, aana nø pïï kany mo leer; ni bëëda naa pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ki jø acooŋa na aciel.
english: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye tar mara ni beeye dïkunyi mara; ?aŋø, da ŋat mo daa lwäärö këët nø? Wuuö Jwøk bee eni ni wø gwøk jwïëya; ?aŋø, da ŋat maa böö ki gø?
english: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

anywaa: Kany wø ö jøøa reyø ni wø öge baŋa, ni beege nyïïmänna ki jø wø caan aani, kiper nee remma kønyge piny, tietge wø cwanyge cwanynyø ni päänhge.
english: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

anywaa: Këël jø leny mo thööth a dege ciel dïër, a ba lwäyi; këël leny doo tägö ni ööa baŋa, a poot bëëdö ni jïra da ŋäädhe.
english: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

anywaa: Da gïrpiny aciel mo yaa kwaaø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye gïnögø keere ni manynya; ni gïn manynya en beeye ki man bëëda Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth nïr kwøw 'moa bëët, kiper nee beeny Wuuö Jwøk jooda, naa bëëda naa lääŋŋa eni yi øt lam mare.
english: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø näk da gïï mo leth mo tägö, a wø kane kanø kar kän mare; a wø di kanø kar kän mare møn yi øt lam mare. A wø kïthe maal kar gwøk røk kany mo ena bäät kïdi.
english: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
