anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïïa tïŋa maal bäät nyïïmänna moa ciel aani dïër; køøre aano cïpi ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk yi øt lam mare, naa kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni wära ki dudi naa pwøya Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny dwøra kany wø kwaa ïïni; køny aani ni wïnynyï dwøra.
english: Hear, O Lord, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

anywaa: Kanya kööï, «Ni cayu aani,» aana köö ki yi cwïnya, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï wø manynya manynyø.»
english: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Lord, will I seek.

anywaa: Kär täärnyïmï kanï ki aani. Kärï wëër ni riemmï aani, a na laŋŋï, kiper beeye ï na dïkunyi mara. Wui Jwøk, ï ni wø piem aani, kär a wetï, ni ba weyï aani.
english: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

anywaa: Këël wära ki mera a dege wiiø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, a lwørï lwørø.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the Lord will take me up.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwöny aani ki man caadha jöörï, ni bwøthï aani ki jöö mo tiir, kiper da jiy mo män ki aani.
english: Teach me thy way, O Lord, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

anywaa: Kär a cïp ceŋ jø wø caan aani, kiper da tööte mo oö maal bääta, ni ge manynya man tïïge ki gïn mo raac dëëra.
english: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

anywaa: Ennø, cwïnya da ŋäädhe ni beeny Wuuö Jwøk daa neenø kanyo pooda naa poot kwøw.
english: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na dhaanh Jwøk, beerra man bëëdï niï koora Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëdï niï teek ni cwïnyï iï maaø. Adïëri møn, bëëdï niï koora Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a cøøra nyeŋŋï; ï na teek mara, kär ïthï dhïŋï ki dwøra. 'Ba ni näk miï lïŋö niï ba cäänö ki aani, a tïmö kaamar jø wø ci yi bwörö.
english: Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

anywaa: Wïny kwac mara kany wø jwöŋa dëërï kiper køny, kany wø thaaŋa ceŋŋa maal kuna näk da kar bëëtï na en kur keere.
english: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

anywaa: Kär a ŋøl wøk na aciel ki jø raay, ni beege jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ni wø cäänö kere ge cäänö ka mëër, 'ba yïthge da gïï mo reyø.
english: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

anywaa: Beerra man cunnï geni ki køør tïïe moge, ki køør raay moa tïïcge. Cun geni ki køør gïïa tïïcge ki ceŋge, ni coolï ka køør mana no orømø ki geni.
english: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

anywaa: Geno raanynyï møn, ni ba dwøgï bëëtö marge kare këët, kiper mana näk ge ba cädö kiper tïïe moï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, moa näk iï tïïö ki cerï.
english: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk,  kiper kwac mara awïnynye.
english: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mara, ni eni caala kwöt leny jïra; eni wø ŋäädha ŋäädhö, ni køny aani. Kiper manøgønø, cwïnya wø tïmö ni met, ni pwøa eni ki duuda.
english: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mar jiye, ni eni bëëdö na dïkunyi mo teek jï ŋat wø wï gø thïïmme ki maaw ni wø røønye na nyeya.
english: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, piem jiy moï ni gwïëthï geni; bëëdï ni ïïna dïkwääy marge, ni käärï geni cooth.
english: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, uuni ni bëëdö maal; jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ki køør ajiem mare ki teek mare.
english: Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ka ajiem mana näk orømø ki nyeŋŋe; wøørru Wuuö Jwøk kiper eni ena kur keere.
english: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk wïnyö bäät näpa døøŋŋø, ni ö dwøre, eni na Jwø ajiem, ni märe, ni tïm dwøre, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wïnyö bäät näm bëët.
english: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk teek døc; dwør Wuuö Jwøk wïnyö ni yie da ajiem mo päl.
english: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk jenni moa døøŋŋø di tøyø; kare møn, Wuuö Jwøk jer lur Libaanø moa døøŋŋø di tøyø.
english: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

anywaa: Eni kïte mo Libaanø di jäŋö, ni tïmge kaamar nyïïrøøe mo bïëdö, ni tïïc Kïn Ciriyön ni jäŋŋi kaawat man wø bïët nyi jööbi.
english: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk daaŋ kaamar agaackøth.
english: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk paap di jäŋö, Wuuö Jwøk paap Kadëc di jäŋö.
english: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

anywaa: Dwør Wuuö Jwøk jenni moa døøŋŋø di jäŋö, ni jaaŋ bäätge, ni put jiyi bëët moa en yi øt lam mare kwöŋŋö, ni köge, na «Ajiem en jï Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

anywaa: Ööny jwïïnynya dwøŋ ena cer Wuuö Jwøk, Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö bäät wälu na nyeya na bäre bäre.
english: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wø cïpö ki teek jï jiye. Wuuö Jwøk jiye wø gwïëdhe gwïëdhö, ni jïtge ki bëët-mëër.
english: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyeŋŋï tïŋa maal, kiper aana kønyï, ni kärï yïth nyïïmänna wëëk mïnnö bääta.
english: I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøa, aana jwöŋö dëërï kiper køny, ni døøyï dëëra mo jööt.
english: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jwïëya amänï ki mana dee ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw. Doo na aano ci yi bwörö cøøn, 'ba aana kwøwï.
english: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

anywaa: U na cwïnynyu en køør Wuuö Jwøk, wärru ki duut pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu eni na en kur keere.
english: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

anywaa: Kiper wëër mare beeye kany mo thiinh keere, 'ba met yie bëëdö këël yïth nïr kwøw bëët. Ni näk mo da kïmmö, beeye wäär aciel keere, 'ba noo tïme na amöölla, kanynyø wø put ka joot.
english: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda ni bëëtö mara beer, aana cädö, «Ni bäŋ gïn tägi dëëra na bäre bäre.»
english: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør met yiï, aana tïïyï naa teek kaamar kïdi. 'Ba kanya kanï täärnyïmï ki aani, cwïnya apädhö.
english: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana jwöŋö dëërï, ni kwaa ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööa,
english: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

anywaa: «?Ni näk mo aano thøw ni cøøa yi bwörö, agïnaŋø noo duue jïrï? ?Aŋø, løny ki man ö ŋøømmi ni pwøcge ïïni? ?A løny ki man caange adïëri marï?
english: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny kwac mara, ni kønyï aani ki køør met ec marï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bëëdï ni ïïna dïkunyi mara.»
english: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

anywaa: Kïmmö mara adøøyï meeŋ mar met ec; kïmmö akälï wøk bääta, ni døøyï yia mo met.
english: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï pwøa pwøø ni ba lïŋa. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøa, ï pwøa pwøø cooth.
english: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö ni raa yaa kan buutï; kär wïïa wëëk lääö na bäre bäre. Køny aani ki køør adïëri marï.
english: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

anywaa: Wïny dwøra, ni laarï aani køny. Bëëdï niï caala kïdi mo røk kana yie, niï caala kiir mo teek mo gëëŋa aani,
english: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

anywaa: Kiper ïïna teek mara, ni ïïna kar gwøk røk mara. Beerra man cäädhï maal ni bwøthï aani kiper nee nyeŋŋï pwøc.
english: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.

anywaa: Käl aani wøk ki ya abïëba cek jiyi kipera, kiper beeye ï na teek mara.
english: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jwïëya acïba cerï; aana wïïlï wøk, ï na Jwø adïëri.
english: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a män ki jø wø wøør juu mo bäŋ gïn duuge, 'ba aani, a bëëdö naa ŋäätha ïïni.
english: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

anywaa: Yia wø mïnnö ni kanynya ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, kiper mana jootï caannø mara, ni ŋäyï gïïa leth na pïï dëëra.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

anywaa: A kärï cïp ceŋ nyïïmänna, 'ba jöö ajapï jïra.
english: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny aani, kiper bääta da gïï mo leth. Nyeŋŋa awer ni ränyge ki jwøk, ni ö dëëra ki jwïëya ni ränyge thuwø.
english: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

anywaa: Kiper nïr kwøw 'moa bëët thööra naa kïmmö, ni cwiiri 'moa thööra naa cooyø. Teek mara aränynyö ki køør gïïa reyø na tïïa, ni ö rïŋ dëëra ni ränynye.
english: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

anywaa: Aana tïmö naa di jøøŋŋø ki køør nyïïmänna na thööth, na ajøøŋ kaatha jø atuti mara døc. Jøøa ŋäc aani gena tïmö ni lwäär ki aani ki køør ränynyö mara,  ni tïm jiyi bëët mo wø joot aani øtjöö ni rïŋö ki aani.
english: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

anywaa: Wïth jiy awïl ki aani kaamar dhaanhø mo othøw, ni wø bäŋ gïn mo caar kipere këët; aana tïmö kaamar dak mo othøw.
english: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

anywaa: Gïïa reyø na møŋ jiy mo thööthi awïnynya, ni bëët lwärri mo dwøŋ naa ee ciel dïër. Kanya bëëtge ni ge cuuŋö kipera, gena tudö naa 'näkge nääö.
english: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a ŋäätha ïïni, naa wø köö, «Ni ïïna Jwøa.»
english: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

anywaa: Gïï wø tägi dëëra bëët ena cerï; køny aani ceŋ nyïïmänna ki ceŋ jø wø caan aani.
english: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

anywaa: Wëëk tac täärnyïmï rieny bääta, a na dhaanhnhï, ni piemï aani ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär wïïa wëëk lääö, kiper a bëëdö naa cøøra nyeŋŋï. Beerra man tïme ni lää wïth jøøa reyø, ni thøwge, ni bëët jwïëcge no onikïïl kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

anywaa: Beerra man twöc lëëp jø wø cäänö ki tööt, ni beege jø wø car atade dëët jøøa beyø, ni wø bëëdö ni ŋwöö ni ge jööŋö.
english: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, da gïï mo beyø mo thööth mo iï cïp piny kiper jø wø lwäär ki ïïni, ni beege jø wø kan dëëtge buutï, ni gïïögø tïïyï ni nëënö jï jiy bëët.
english: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

anywaa: Jøøgø wø kanï kanø buutï kany mo ba joot, nee gïïa tuut jiyi kiperge nee ba pïïcge dëëtge. Ge wø gwøgï gwøø kar kän marï, niï mäna geni ki gïï mo reyø mo wø käl lëëp jiy.
english: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper kanya bëëda päänya näk ociel dïër, mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl anyoodhe jïra ki jöö mo rëëma ec.
english: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ cwïnya abwøk, ni kööa, «Ni kara atïmö ni bäär ki ïïni.» 'Ba kwac mara awïnynyï kanya jwöŋa dëërï kiper køny.
english: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

anywaa: Uuni bëët, u na cwïnynyu en køør Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man bëëdu nou mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk. Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni gwøga jøøa näk marge adïëri; 'ba gïn wø rømi ki jø atöör tïïe tïïö dëëtge.
english: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

anywaa: U bëët ni wø ŋääth køny mar Wuuö Jwøk, bëëdu nou teek, ni cwïnynyu you maaø.
english: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat mo raay moe owiiø, ni moa baae orïëbö.
english: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat mo bääyö mare ba kwaan Wuuö Jwøki bääte, ni bëëdö ni bäŋ cwøk cwïnye.
english: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya bëëda ni bääyö mara kära caanø, dëëra aput ränynyö ki køør kïmmö mana bëëda naa kïmmö ki gø cooth.
english: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

anywaa: Kiper waŋcäŋ ki wäär cerï atïmö ni ena dëëra; ni ö teek mara ni ränynye kaamar luum man wø raany cäŋ öörö.
english: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

anywaa: Køøre bääyö mara acaana jïrï, ni kära gïna raac na tïïa kanø; aana köö, «Ni gïïa baaa caana caanø jï Wuuö Jwøk.» 'Ba ki køør mana nø caana gø, bääyö mara na dwøŋ aputï wec.
english: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ö jiyi bëët moa cwïnyge en køørï ni kwacge ïïni kany bëëdï niï nut en; køøre, këël gïï mo leth doo öö kaamar jwïïö mo raanynya piny, bäŋ gïn mo pïï bäätge.
english: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

anywaa: Beeye ïïni ni wø kana raa buute, ni bee ï ni wø koor aani yïth gïï mo leth; ni laga wø cielï cielø ki jø wø wär ki dut køny.
english: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

anywaa: Ï wø köö, ni «Ï pwönynya pwönynyö ni nyuunhnha ïïni ki jöö mana diï cäädhö ki yie, ni pwönynya ïïni thuwø ni waŋa ena bäätï.
english: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

anywaa: Kärï tïmö kaamar okweeny wala gääŋŋö ni wø bäŋ gïn ŋääe, ni wø tïïc ni maa piny ka kaw mar dhee kiper nee bëëde buutï.»
english: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

anywaa: Ŋat ma ŋat adhala wø jïtö ki gïï mo leth mo thööth, 'ba ŋat wø ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, mëër mo ba jøøl ena bääte.
english: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

anywaa: U ni bëëtö maru beer, bëëdu ni yïthu met ni kanynyu ki køør Wuuö Jwøk. U ni cwïnynyu thïïŋ bëët, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk ni döötu ena maal ni yïthu met.
english: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

anywaa: Wui, u ni maru beer, wärru ni yïthu met jï Wuuö Jwøk; pwøc mïërö ka ŋat mo mare thïïŋ.
english: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk ki thoom-othïënhö; wärru ki dut pwøc jïre nou pöödö ki thoom mo thøøli moe apaar.
english: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

anywaa: Wärru jïre ki duut mo nyään, pwötu thøme ni nyeŋŋu reegø, ni döötu ena maal.
english: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

anywaa: Kiper luum Wuuö Jwøk thïïŋ, ni tïïc mare bäre tïïe no oŋäädhö.
english: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki bëëtö mo beer ki ŋøl ma kare, ni piny bäre päŋ ki mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl.
english: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk maal acwääe ki køør dwøre, ni cwääc gïïa en yie bëët ki jam dhee.
english: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

anywaa: Pï naama dwøŋ acooŋe kaamar acooŋ beel, ni cooŋ ge yïth kudi kaamar beel mo ocooŋ yïth odïï.
english: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

anywaa: Beerra man ö pinynyi bäre ni lwäär Wuuö Jwøk; beerra man ö jø bäät piny bëët ni bëëtge ni yïthge othäŋŋö ki eni.
english: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

anywaa: Kiper ena cäänö ki dwøre, ni put piny cwääc ki gïïa en yie bëët, ni ö mana caane ni thur kare.
english: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acaara mar wïth juurre di raanynyø; eni acaac jiy wø tïïe tïïö nee ba thurge karge.
english: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

anywaa: 'Ba acaara mar Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö acaare mo wø caare ni bëëtge ni nut këël yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät jø wø Jwøge beeye Wuuö Jwøk, jøøa näk ee jierø na moe.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wø räŋŋö ki maal ni raŋ piny, ni joot jiy bëët,
english: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

anywaa: ni raŋ jøøa bëëdö bäät piny bëët ni räŋŋi ka kar bëëtö mare.
english: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

anywaa: Bee eni na cwääc cwïnyge bëët, ni tïïe moge bëët ŋääe.
english: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

anywaa: Nyeya bäŋ wø bøth ki thøø kiper jø leny moe na thööth, ni ŋat leny bäŋ wø bøth ki thøø kiper teek mare.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

anywaa: Køny mar okweeny leny ba ŋääth, ni eni bäŋ wø kunynyi kaper teek mare na dwøŋ.
english: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, waŋ Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät jø wø lwäär ki eni, jø wø ŋääth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl,
english: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

anywaa: nee ge kønye cer thøø, ni gwøk geni nee kwøwge kany wø dee käc.
english: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

anywaa: Øøni, ø bëëdö nøø raŋŋa jï Wuuö Jwøk; bee eni na dïkunyi marø, ni ena kwöt leny jïïø.
english: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, met ec marø joodø baŋe, kiper ø ŋäätha nyeŋŋe na en kur keere.
english: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man ö mëërri marï ni wø ba jøøl ni bëëde bäätwa, kaawat man bëëde niï ewa ŋäädhö en.
english: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wø pwøa pwøø cooth, ni bëët pwøci dhaa man wø pwøa eni ki gø.
english: I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

anywaa: Aani, Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø kiper gïïa tïïe; beerra man ö jøøa canni ni wïnyge gø ni mïn yïthge.
english: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

anywaa: Beerra man jiemø Wuuö Jwøk na aciel, ni tïŋø nyeŋŋe maal ø bëët.
english: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk akwaaa, ni løk kwac mara, ni køny aani dhøk gïïa lwäära bëët.
english: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

anywaa: Jø wø raŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk, täärnyïmge tïmö ni waany ni ba lää wïthge këët.
english: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

anywaa: Aani, kanya bëëda yïth gïï mo leth, aana jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny dwøra, ni køny aani yïth gïïa leth bëët na en dëëra.
english: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

anywaa: Nyïïatwiet maal mo Wuuö Jwøk rege wø cielge cielø lak jø wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni piemge geni.
english: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

anywaa: Bel bëët Wuuö Jwøk, nee jootï møn ni eni beer; gwïëth en bäät ŋat wø kan ree buute.
english: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

anywaa: U na jic Wuuö Jwøk, lwäärru Wuuö Jwøk, kiper jø wø lwäär ki eni bäŋ gïn cange.
english: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

anywaa: Këël nyïï ŋuuwe ge wø cännö ni 'nägi ya käci, 'ba jø wø cac Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo cange ri moa beyø bëët.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

anywaa: Ööu, u na nyïïa, ni wïnynyu mara, u pwönynya pwönynyö ki jöö man lwäärru Wuuö Jwøk ki gø.
english: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

anywaa: ?Aŋa dïïu ni cac kwøw, na aŋa dïïu ni yie met ki man bëëde ni kwøw ki cwiiri mo thööth nee gïï mo beyø joode?
english: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋatøgø ni gwøk leebe ki raay, ni män dhee ki luup cwøk.
english: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋatøgø ni tïïc kare ni bäär ki raay, ni tïïc gïna beer, ni many bëët-mëër, ni caath køør gø døc.
english: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

anywaa: Nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät jøøa beyø, ni ïthe ee ciiø ki kwac marge.
english: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

anywaa: Täärnyïm Wuuö Jwøk cøl ki jø wø tïïc raay, ni tïïc ge nee wïc ba par ki geni bäät piny këët.
english: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

anywaa: Kany wø ö jøøa beyø wø jwöŋge kiper køny, wïny Wuuö Jwøki wïnynyö, ni køny geni yïth gïïa leth bëët na pïï dëëtge.
english: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kare cään ki jø wø näk cwïnyge opädhö, ni bëëdö ni køønynya geni.
english: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

anywaa: Gïï mo leth mo thööth wø tägö dëër ŋata beer, 'ba eni wø køny Wuuö Jwøki kønyø yïth gïïögø bëët.
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ŋatøgø wø gwøe gwøø, ni bäŋe cöönne aciel mo toor.
english: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

anywaa: Jø wø tïïc raay 'näk raayi nääö, ni ö jø wø män ki jøøa beyø ni jääli.
english: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jiye wø wïïle wøk, ni bäŋe aciel mo di jäälö dëët jø wø kan rege buute.
english: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋäbï ki jø wø ŋäbö ki aani, ni këëdï ki jø wø këëdi ki aani.
english: Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

anywaa: Kwany kwöt leny marï, ni ööï maal ni kønyï aani.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.

anywaa: Lwør tøŋ marï ni këëdï ki jø wø ŋwiec køøra, niï nyootha gø jïra ni beeye ïïni na dïkunyi mara.
english: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.

anywaa: Beerra man lää wïth jø wø many man 'näkge aani, ni räny nyeŋge; beerra man kier wïth jø wø cädö ki gïï mo reyø nee tïïcge dëëra, ni riem ge.
english: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

anywaa: Beerra man køøl ge kaamar lethø mo okøøl jame, ni beeye nyïïatwiel maal marï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, noo køøl geni.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the Lord chase them.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm jöörge na muudhö ni da adipøødha, ni ö nyïïatwiel maal marï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋwiec køørge.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the Lord persecute them.

anywaa: Kiper geni akupa acekge kipera jaak, ni kunyge ki buur kipera ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere.
english: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

anywaa: Beerra man räny ge ni cwöba dëëtge, ni päth akumma cekge keerge bäätge, ni päthge yi ränynyö.
english: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

anywaa: Køøre nø, yia omïnni ki ïïni, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kanynya kiper mana kønyï aani.
english: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

anywaa: Ni kööa ki cwïnya bäre, ni «?Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa ni pääri ki ïïni? Beeye ïïni ni wø køny ŋata no ocaannø cer ŋata teek døc ni kaala eni, ni køny ŋata no ocaannø na can cer ŋat wø twier gø.»
english: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

anywaa: Jiy mo caana luup mo patha adïëri aö maal, ni pëënyge aani ki luup mo kuua.
english: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

anywaa: A wø duunge duunnö ki gïn mo raac na kar mana beer, ni thøøa ki pänh cwïny.
english: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, kanya bëëtge ni ge tuu, aana tïmö naa käära keeca na abïï ki køør kïmmö mara kiperge, ni dwøga dëëra piny ni bëëda ni aano kweer ki cam, naa lämö ni wïïa yaa kuul piny.
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

anywaa: Aana jwöŋö kaawat mana daa jwöŋö kiper nyawatwa wala coka, naa bëëdö kaamar dhaanhø mo jwøga menni, ni wïïa yaa kuul piny naa kïmmö.
english: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jootge aani naa ena yïth gïï mo leth, yïthge amïnnö ni cooŋge røkge kanya ciel; jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø dëëtge adwalge kipera ni kuua, ni bëëtge ni ge waya nyeŋŋa, ni ba wecge.
english: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

anywaa: Gena kwääk bääta ni ge ŋeethø, ni kaacge lakge bääta.
english: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdï niï rääŋö jaak? Køny aani yïth gïïö ni leth ni wø temge yøø, ni gwøgï jwïëya ceŋ jiy moi ni caal ŋuuwe ii.
english: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

anywaa: Ï pwøa pwøø dï acooŋ jøøa thööth, ni pwøa nyeŋŋi dï lwaak.
english: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

anywaa: Kär yïth nyïïmänna wëëk mïnnö bääta, jø wø män ki aani jaak. Kär nyïïmänna tïïyï nee nyeŋge niiŋge bääta, jø wø män ki aani ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere.
english: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

anywaa: Kiper ge ba cäänö ki luum mëër, 'ba ge wø caana luum cwøk dëët jø wø bëëdö jaak paac.
english: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

anywaa: Gena kwöŋŋö bääta, ni köge, ni «Wui, wui, ïïna jootwa ki nyeŋwa kiree.»
english: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, gïnögø ajootï; kärï lïŋö. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, karï kär tïïyï ni bäär ki aani.
english: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

anywaa: Ö maal ni cwagï aani, ni cäänï kipera, ï na Jwøk mara ni bee ï na kwääya.
english: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, ŋun aani, ki køør adïëri marï, ni tïïyï ge nee yïthge ba mïnge bääta.
english: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

anywaa: Ge kär tïïyï nee cäänge ki cwïnyge ni köge, ni «Gïna manywa ajootwa.» Ni ba tïïyï ge nee köge, ni «Ena raanywa.»
english: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

anywaa: Jøøa näk yïthge met ki gïna tägö dëëra, wïthge olääi ni räny nyeŋge bëët; jøøa tïïc dëëtge ni døøŋŋø bääta, lään wïc bëëde bäätge kaamar abïï.
english: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

anywaa: Jø wø yïthge met ki man ŋun aani, wär kwöŋge ki met ec, ni cäänge ni nøøcge nøøyø ni ge köö, ni «Dwøŋŋa Wuuö Jwøk, eni ni wø yie mïnni kany wø tïm bëët dhaanhnhe ni beer.»
english: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

anywaa: Køøre nø, adïëri marï køba købø, ni bëëda naa pwøya ïïni cooth.
english: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

anywaa: Raay cäänö cwïny ŋat raay, ni Jwøk ba lwääre na bäre bäre.
english: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

anywaa: Dëëre wø jieme jiemø keere ni eni beer,  'ba raay moe ba neete, ni eni ba män ki geni.
english: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

anywaa: Luup mo wø cur dhee reyø, ni beege luup cwøk keerge, ni wïïe oløny ni ba leer, ni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo tïïe.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

anywaa: Kanyo en kar niine mare, eni caara gïï mo reyø, ni dëëre wø cïbe uutjïëthe mo patha karge, ni gïï mo reyø ba kwiere.
english: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl dwøŋ døc no okëët maal, na adïëri marï okëët nyeŋ pøøl.
english: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

anywaa: Bëëtö marï na beer ruu kaamar kïte moa døøŋŋø, ni ŋøl marï ŋølï ni tiet luup iï neenø døc ni caala man wø many gïn mo ena yi kut. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ïïni ni wø køny dhaanhø ki lääy.
english: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O Lord, thou preservest man and beast.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl pere leth døc. Jiy rege wø kange tiet bwöpï.
english: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.

anywaa: Ge wø jäŋŋa yi ødï døc ki luup moï, ni cïpï met yiï na päl jïge kaamar pï naam.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

anywaa: Jøøro mar pï kwøw ena baŋï, ni tar jootwa ka køør tar marï.
english: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

anywaa: Put mëëyï ni wø ba jøøl cïp jï jøøa ŋäc ïïni, ni nyoothï adïëri marï jï jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

anywaa: Kär jø atöör wëëk atöör bääta, ni ba tïïyï jø raay naa riemge wøk.
english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

anywaa: Jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø pädhö; ge pädhö ni dhäthe jïge ki man öge maal.
english: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

anywaa: Kär wïïï kierï ka acaara kiper bëët jøøa reyø; ni ba keeyï per bëët jø raay.
english: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

anywaa: Kiper ge laara ränynyö kaamar luum mo otal, ni närge kaamar omarø mo obäp.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

anywaa: Bëëdï niï ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïyï gïï mo beyø, ni bëëdï yïth ŋøøpu ni ïïna ŋat mo oŋäädhö.
english: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

anywaa: Bëëdï ni yiï met ki Wuuö Jwøk, køøre ïïno mooe ki gïïo manynyï ki cwïnyï.
english: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

anywaa: Cïp dëërï jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni ŋääthï eni, køøre mare otïïe.
english: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

anywaa: Eni bëëtö marï na beer otïïe ni nëënö kaamar tar, ni tïm bëëtö marï na näk kare ni nëënö kaa man wø neen gïrpiny ki dhöör.
english: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

anywaa: Bëëdï ni ïïno göök ri Wuuö Jwøk, ni raŋŋï jïre ni cwïnyï iï cïp piny; kär wïïï kierï ka acaara kiper ŋat wø jape thöönhnhi ki køør tïïe moe, ŋat wø tïïc gïï wø caare na reyø.
english: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

anywaa: Män riï ki gootø ni kwierï wëër, kär wïïï kierï ka acaara, kiper acaara duua gïï mo reyø.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ŋøla wøk, 'ba jø wø raŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk, ŋøøm cøøa jïge.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

anywaa: Ki kany mo thiinh ŋat raay tïmö ni ba joot këët; ni këël kare diï manynyø døc, eni ba jootï.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa mwöl ŋøøm cøøa jïge, ni mïn yïthge ki køør bëëtö marge na beer.
english: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

anywaa: Ŋat raay cädö ki jöö man tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëër ŋata beer, ni kaac lage bäät gø.
english: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ŋeethø bäät ŋat raay, kiper ŋääe ni cäŋ ränynyö mar ŋat raay kare cään.
english: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

anywaa: Jø raay opëëlle moge wø wöthge wøk, ni niitge athëëre moge, kiper nee jøøa no ocaannø ki jøøa can nee 'näkge, ki jøøa näk bëëtö marge thïïŋ.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

anywaa: 'Ba opëëlle moge døøa dëëtge keerge, ni ö atummi moge ni tøcge.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

anywaa: Beerra bëët ŋata mare beer ni jape nøk, ni kaala bëët kwärö mar jøøa thööth ni wø tem raay.
english: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk teek mar jø raay raanynye raanynyø, 'ba jøøa beyø gwøe gwøø.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëët jøøa marge thïïŋ ŋääe, ni ö ŋøømmi ni bëëtge na moge na bäre bäre.
english: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

anywaa: Kany wø näk mo piny raac, öölö ba pïï bäätge, ni kany wø näk mo da käc, cam dagø jïge mo rømø.
english: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

anywaa: 'Ba jø raay ränynyö, ni tïm nyïïmänni mo Wuuö Jwøk kaamar luum pwöla ni wø laar talø, ni rwäänyge kaamar jïrö ni wø maayi.
english: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

anywaa: Ŋat raay wø mäyö, 'ba eni ba cudö, 'ba ŋata beer wø cïpö ki køør bäth ec mare.
english: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

anywaa: Jøøa no ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki, ŋøøm cøøa jïge, 'ba moa näk ee cienø, ŋøle wøk.
english: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

anywaa: Bëët dhaanhø wø wëëga Wuuö Jwøki thur kare, ni tïm yi Wuuö Jwøki ni met ki bëët gø.
english: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

anywaa: Këël eni doo pädhö, ba pädhi ki pänh ränynyö, kiper cere mak Wuuö Jwøki maaø.
english: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

anywaa: Ki mana täga thïnhö, këël mana jala ennø, a kär jïtö ki ŋat mo beer mo owiiø; këël obwöre moe mo kwääö ki caammi, bäŋgø thuwø.
english: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö ni cwïnye bäth, ni jape wø wëëge mac cooth, ni ö jiyi ni gwïëdhi ki køør nyïïkwaaye.
english: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

anywaa: Tïïc karï ni bäär ki raay, ni tïïyï gïna beer, køøre nø, ïïno bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki ŋøl ma kare. Jøøa näk cwïnyge ena køøre ba wiie; ge gwøe gwøø na bäre bäre, 'ba wäät jøøa reyø ŋøle wøk.
english: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

anywaa: Jøøa beyø ŋøøm cøøa jïge, ni bëëtge yie na bäre bäre.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

anywaa: Ŋata beer cara luup leec wïc, ni luup mo wø ŋøle ni wø cur dhee beege karge.
english: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

anywaa: Eni ciik Jwøk bëëdö cwïnye, ni bëëde ni tiere ba cwanynye.
english: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

anywaa: Ŋata raac bëëdö ni lepa ŋata beer,  ni caya man 'näk gø.
english: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ŋata beer ba wii cer ŋatøgø, ni eni ba wëëk jääl kanyo ŋøl luumme.
english: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

anywaa: Bëëdï niï raŋŋa jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni caathï jööre. Karï otïïe ni dwøŋ, ni ö ŋøømmi ni cige jïrï, ni jootï jø raay ni geno ŋøl wøk.
english: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

anywaa: Ŋat raay dagø mo yaa joodø mo ogäy mo jiy ee dïïmö, ni caala jaath mo dwøŋ mo piny ee maaø.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, ena rwäänyö, ni tïme ni tøør kaace këët; 'ba kanya manynya gø, eni kära joodø.
english: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

anywaa: Raŋ ŋat mo bäŋ ajäla bääte, ni neenï ŋata näk bëëtö mare thïïŋ, kiper ŋat wø bëëdö ki bëët-mëër jïtö ki nyïïkwaaye.
english: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø tïïc raay, wïthge di dïïrö na bäre bäre, ni ö nyïïkwaacge ni ŋøli wøk.
english: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni wø piem jøøa beyø, ni teek marge wø jootge baŋe kany wø dee gïï mo leth mo pïï bäätge.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

anywaa: Ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni wø køny geni ni wø piem geni, ni käl geni wøk ceŋ jø raay, ni kwøw geni, kiper mana kange dëëtge buute.
english: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär a joogï ni marï wëër ki aani, ni ba wëërï kanyo pwönynyï aani.
english: O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

anywaa: Kiper athëëre moï anø pï dëëra, ni thielï aani piny ki cerï.
english: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

anywaa: Dëëra ajïtö ki täw ki køør wëër marï, ni tïm dëëra ni ba jööt ki køør raay 'moa.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

anywaa: Kiper raay 'moa wïïa akaalge; ni tïmge ni peek døc ni caala tëër mo ba løny ki tïëtö.
english: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

anywaa: Ŋwiili 'moa, na jooda ki køør gïïa tïïa ki bøøl mara, ajïtö ki tuut ni ŋwääge.
english: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

anywaa: A cäädhi ni aano gääŋ, naa bëëdö naa kïmmö cooth.
english: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

anywaa: Kiper dëëra waŋŋi bäre, ni dëëra man bäre da täw.
english: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

anywaa: Dëëra atïmö ni bäth bäre ni ränynye, ni bëëda naa cooyø ni cwïnya opädhö.
english: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, gïn manynya en ŋäyï, ni cooyø mara wïnyö jïrï.
english: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

anywaa: Wenynya atïmö ni pärö, ni ö teeki mara ni aae dëëra, ni ö nyeŋŋa ni tïmge ni ba nëënö këët.
english: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

anywaa: Nyïïawääta ki jø wø mëër ki aani karge atïïcge ni bäär ki aani kiper ŋwiili moa en dëëra, këël tuuŋwa kiree karge atïïcge ni bäär ki aani thuwø.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

anywaa: Jø wø cac man 'näkge aani abëëbe moge wø cekge ciiø kipera, ni ö jø wø many man tïïcge gïï mo leth dëëra ni cäänge kiper naa raanyge, ni ge tudö ki luup ki piny cooth.
english: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, raa atïïa naa caala dhaanhø ma miiŋ, naa ba wïnyö,  ni tïma naa caala dhaanhø mo bäŋ dhee mo ba cäänö.
english: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aana tïmö naa caala dhaanhø mo ba wïnyö, mo bëëdö ni ba pïëmö kiper dëëre.
english: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

anywaa: 'Ba bee ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø jïre raŋŋa, ni bee ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, noo løk mara.
english: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

anywaa: Kiper aana lämö ni kööa, ni «Jø wø tïïc dëëtge ni døøŋŋø bääta, kär yïthge mïnnö kany wø cwaanya tiera.»
english: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

anywaa: Ennø, kara atïmö ni cään ki man pädha, naa bëëdö naa rämö cooth.
english: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

anywaa: Aani, raay 'moa køba købø; aana tïmö naa kïmmö kiper gïïa baaa.
english: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

anywaa: Nyïïmän 'moa dëëtge jööt ni ge teek, ni jø wø män ki aani ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere thööth.
english: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

anywaa: Jø wø duu gïn mo raac na kar gïna beer, ge män ki aani kiper mana caadha køør bëëtö mo beer.
english: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär a weyï; wui ï na Jwøk mara, kär karï tïïyï ni bäär ki aani.
english: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na dïkunyi mara, laar rwänh baŋa kuna kønyï aani.
english: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

anywaa: Aana cädö ni kööa, ni «Dëëra gwøa gwøø ki gïno caana, kiper nee leeba ba bääye. A bëëdö ni dhaa yaa gwøø, kany wø nut jø raayi buuta.»
english: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö naa lïŋö jaak naa ba luubö; 'ba lïŋŋö mara bäŋ gïn mo ee kønyø, ni ö pänh cwïnynyi mara ni cääth nyïme.
english: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

anywaa: Yia acwat døc, ni cwat ec mara kadhi ka kanya cäda. Køøre aana lämö ni kööa,
english: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man pwönynyï aani kiper aŋuun kwøw mara, ki kwään nïne moo beeda, nee ŋääa ni nïr kwøw 'moa ba kän wøk ki kany mo bäär.
english: Lord, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

anywaa: Neenï, nïr kwøw 'moa atïïyï ni nøk, ni tïm nïne moo beeda ni bäŋ karge ki baŋï. Adïëri møn, dhaanhø ni bëëdö ni kwøw en caala jamø jaak.
english: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, bëët dhaanhø caala tïpö, ni dijal mar jiy bäŋ gïn duue møn; dhaanhø jammi wø cooŋe cooŋø kiper dëëre, 'ba ŋato käl ge kuue.
english: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

anywaa: «?'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, agïnaŋø noo dööŋ këët nø? Aani, a ŋäätha ïïni.
english: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

anywaa: Køny aani yïth raay 'moa bëët; kär a wëëk jøøa näk bäŋ wïthge naa jøøŋge.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa ba luubö, ni dhaa ba jaala, kiper bee ïïni na tïïc gïïögø bëët.
english: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

anywaa: Kär a jäälï këët, kiper aana tïmö naa manynya thøø ki køør pöödö marï.
english: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø joogï jooø niï pwönynya gø kiper raay moe,  ni raanynyï gïï wø mëëre ki geni kaawat man wø tïïc alweela; ka adïëri møn, dhaanhø caala jamø jaak.
english: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny lam mara, ni cegï ïthï ko oduuru mara; kär ïthï dhïŋï ki jwøk mara. Kiper a bëëdö buutï naa caala dhaanhø mo path, naa bëëdö ni aana wëëllö kaawat mana bëët kwäya bëët.
english: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

anywaa: Wec a turu, kiper nee yia mïnne kany poode naa poot kär thøw en.»
english: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö naa raŋŋa jï Wuuö Jwøk; køøre ïthe aciie ni wïny oduuru mara.
english: I waited patiently for the Lord; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

anywaa: Ni tuut aani wøk ki yi buur mo raac, ni käl aani wøk ki yo odhöönh; ni cïp a bäät kïdi, ni kïth aani kany mo bäŋ gïn mo pïï dëëra yie.
english: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

anywaa: Dhaa acäŋŋe ki duut mo nyään, na man wø pwøa eni ki gø, eni na Jwøk marø. Gïïa tïïe oneen jiy mo thööthi ni lwäcge, ni tïmge ni ge ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat wø ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, ŋat wø ba raŋ jï jø atöör, jø wø gaa wøk køør luup mo patha adïëri.
english: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, ïïna tïïö ki gïï mo thööth mo rëëma ec, niï lääŋŋa waani cooth. Bäŋ ŋat mo röömi ki ïïni. Këël a doo köö ni gïr gïïa tïïyï caana caanø, tïmö ni thööth døc ni ba løny ki caan.
english: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, yiï ba met ki muuce mo beel ko olämme mo wø cïp; këël olämi man wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme mo wø cïp kiper raay, ï kär pëëö kiperge; 'ba aana mooyï ki ïdhi nee marï wïnynya.
english: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, na «A nut ennø, kaawat mana no ogöörö yi Wëël Jwøk kipera.
english: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

anywaa: Ïïni na Jwøk mara, yia met ki man tïïa mana manynyï; ciik moï ena cwïnya.»
english: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

anywaa: Luup moa met kiper køny marï akøba dï acooŋ lam mana dwøŋ. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋäyï naa kär lïŋö ki car luupögø.
english: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

anywaa: Aani luum køny marï kära mooŋø, 'ba adïëri marï ki pïëm man wø piemï jiy ki gø akøba. Aani mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri marï kära kanø ya acooŋ lam mana dwøŋ.
english: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär bäth ec marï mänï ki aani, beerra man ö mëërri marï ni wø ba jøøl, ka adïëri marï ni bëëtge ni gwøga aani.
english: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa reyø mo ba løny ki kwaan, aana cielge dïër; gïïa baya aana makge, ni tïïcge aani naa ba räŋö; gena tïmö ni thööth døc ni kaala jïëc wïïa,  ni ö cwïnya ni pädhe.
english: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man piemï aani. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, laar rwänh kuna kønyï aani.
english: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

anywaa: Jøøa many man 'näkge aani, beerra man lää wïthge ni kier wïthge bëët. Jøøa yïthge met ki caannø mara beerra man riem geni ni räny nyeŋge.
english: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jø wø buu aani ni bwøk cwïnyge ki køør lään wïc marge.
english: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø cac ïïni bëët beerra man mïn yïthge ki ïïni ni kanyge, ni ö jø wø yïthge met ki køny marï ni cäänge ni nøøcge nøøyø ni ge köö, ni «Dwøŋŋa Wuuö Jwøk!»
english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano caannø naa bëëdö naa can; 'ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man lääŋŋï aani. Bee ï ni wø køny aani, ni bee ï ni wø piem aani; Wui ï na Jwøk mara, kärï ruu.
english: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat wø cädö kiper ŋata can. Eno køny Jwøki kany wø näk da gïï mo leth mo tägö.
english: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.

anywaa: Eno gwøk Wuuö Jwøki, nee bëëde ni kwøw, ni tïme no ogwïëdhö dï poge, ni eni ba cïp ceŋ nyïïmän moe.
english: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö buute kany wø näk mo eni tuu, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni riem täw, ni døøc dëër gø mo jööt.
english: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aana köö, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana bääyö dëërï; 'ba bääth yiï ki aani ni kønyï täw mara.»
english: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna wø cäänö ki gïï mo reyø kipera, ni köge, ni «?Thøøe wäne nø, nee nyeŋŋe rwäänye?»
english: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

anywaa: Kany wø dee ŋat mo lïïmmö baŋa, eni wø caana luup cwøk, ni cwïnye cooŋa raay kipera; 'ba kany wø ci wøk, nyeŋŋa wø waae waaø.
english: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

anywaa: Jø wø män ki aani bëët, ge wø møŋŋa gïra, ni ge caara gïn mo raac kipera, ni köge,
english: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

anywaa: «Ena mak täwi mo raac døc ki køør rääö mare, ni eni ba ö maal këët.»
english: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

anywaa: Këël nyawatwa kiree na näk yaa ŋäädhö, ŋat wø cam kwöna, aana cääbe ki tiere.
english: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bääth yiï ki aani, ni dwøgï teek dëëra kare kiper nee kwöra coola.
english: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö nyïïmänna na kärge aani böötö ennø, aŋääa ni yiï omïnnö ki aani.
english: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a wø kønyï kønyø kiper adïëri mara, ni cïbï aani buutï na bäre bäre.
english: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na bëëdö kanya poode ni piny poot kär cwääö, këël na bäre bäre. Kare møn, enøgønø.
english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö röönna mo onäk riewi wø many pïï, aani thuwø a wø bëëdö naa manynya ïïni, ï na Jwøk.
english: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

anywaa: Aani, dëëra da riew kiper Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw. ?A yi wäne nø noo ööa naa cuŋŋa nyïm Jwøk?
english: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

anywaa: A bëëdö naa jwöŋö cooth waŋcäŋ ki wäär, ni tïm pï nyeŋŋa na cam mara, kany wø bëët jiyi ni jøøŋŋa aani cooth, ni ge köö, ni «?Jwøk marï age?»
english: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

anywaa: Cwïnya wø pädhö kany wø para wïïa ki gïïa wara tïïa, ni beeye kanya wara cøøa ki lwaak mo päl ni bwødha geni Øt Jwøk, ni wa kwöŋŋö ki met ec ni wa wär ki dut pwøc, ni wa cämö ka ajwöma ni waana lwaak mo päl.
english: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø ni bëëda ni cwïnya opädhö? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëda ni wïïa ree ee kierø en? Beerra man raŋŋa jï Jwøk, ni bëëda naa pwøya eni, eni na dïkunyi mara.
english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jwøk mara, cwïnya apädhö kany, tier Naam Jördan, kany bëëda ni aana wëëllö yie en, ni para wïïa ki ïïni. Aana mooyï ki pänh cwïny møn, ni ö gïï mo lethi ni päthge bääta kaamar naam mo pänhnhö, ni lwör kaamar pïï mo wø löönynyi ki bäät Kïn Armön ki Kïn Midhaar, ni löönyge yi Naam Jördan.
'Ba Wuuö Jwøk mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl wø nyoodhe nyoodhø jïra ki waŋcäŋ, ni wära ki duut jïre ki wäär, naa lama Jwøk ni wø kwøw aani.
english: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

anywaa: A lämö jï Jwøk eni na teek mara, ni kööa, na «?Aperŋø na wïl wïïï ki aani? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëda naa kïmmö en kiper gïïa leth na tïïc nyimän?»
english: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

anywaa: Ajøøŋ mana tïïc nyïïmänni 'moa dëëra atïmö ni caala ŋwellø mo onieŋ døc dëëra, kany wø bëëtge ni ge jøøŋŋa aani cooth, ni ge köö, ni «?Jwøk marï age?»
english: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø ni bëëda ni cwïnya opädhö? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëda ni wïïa ree ee kierø en? Beerra man raŋŋa jï Jwøk, ni bëëda naa pwøya eni, eni na dïkunyi mara ni beeye Jwøk mara.
english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ŋun aani, ni cwagï aani ceŋ jø wø ba wøør ïïni, ni kälï aani wøk ceŋ jø cwøk ki ceŋ jø wø wïthge reyø;
english: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

anywaa: kiper beeye ïïni na Jwøk ni wø kana raa buute. ?Aperŋø ni kwierï aani en? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëda naa kïmmö en kiper gïïa leth na tïïc nyimän?
english: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

anywaa: Beerra man jääŋŋï tar marï ka adïëri marï, kiper naa bwøthge, ni kïthge aani bäät kïnnï na en kur keere na näk kar bëëtö marï.
english: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

anywaa: Køøre nø, aano ci kany wø en gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï yie, ï na Jwøk, ni ööa baŋï, ï ni wø mooc aani ki met ec mo päl døc, ni pwøa ïïni ki thoom, ï na Jwøk mara.
english: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø nø ni bëëda ni cwïnya opädhö? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëda ni wïïa ree ee kierø en? Beerra man raŋŋa jï Jwøk, ni bëëda naa pwøya eni, eni na dïkunyi mara ni beeye Jwøk mara.
english: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, luup moa caan kwäcwa jïwa awïnywa ni beege gïïa tïïyï yïth nïra beetge ya acääŋŋe cøøn.
english: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

anywaa: Ïïni ki dëërï kiree wïth juurre ariemï wøk, ni këëllï tiet kwäcwa piny; ni tïïï dëët wïth juurre ki gïï mo leth, ni tïïyï kwäcwa nee ge nyaacge.
english: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

anywaa: Geni, piny kär ci jïge kiper jap leny moa en ceŋge, ni ge kär käädhö kiper teek marge, 'ba beeye kiper teek marï ki leec nyïmï, kiper ï mëër ki geni.
english: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

anywaa: Ïïna nyeya mara, ni bee ï na Jwøk mara, dïïm wø cïpa ïïni jïwa, wa jø dhi øt Jeekap.
english: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

anywaa: Nyïïmän mowa riemwa riemmø ki køørï, ni böötwa jø wø ö maal bäätwa ki nyeŋŋï.
english: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

anywaa: Kiper a ba ŋäädhö ko opëëllö mara, ni jap leny 'moa ba ŋäädha naa dege kønyø.
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ïïni na køny waani ceŋ nyïïmän mowa, ni lääï wïth jø wø män ki waani.
english: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wa bëëdö ni wa jïëmö ki nyeŋŋï cooth, ni wa bëëdö ni wa pwøya nyeŋŋï na bäre bäre.
english: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane waana kwierï ni lääï wïthwa, niï ba cii ki jø leny mowa baŋ leny.
english: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

anywaa: Waana tïïyï nee wa reŋwa ŋäthwa ki nyïïmän mowa, ni twierge jammi mowa.
english: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

anywaa: Waana cïpï nee wa ŋarge kaamar dïëk, ni keethï waani dï wïth juurre.
english: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

anywaa: Jiyï agathï ni gätge jööt jaak, ni kanya dwøgï ge pwödhö bäŋ gïn ege duuö.
english: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

anywaa: Waana tïïyï ni waana jø jøøŋ jø atuti mowa, ni tïïyï wa na gïr ŋeethø na gïr tuuk jï jøøa en buutwa.
english: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

anywaa: Waana tïïyï na gïr aŋaada dï wïth juurre, ni tïmwa ni waana gïr abuua jïge.
english: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

anywaa: Cooth a bëëdö ni aano päädö, naa bëëdö ni wïïa olääö
english: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

anywaa: ki luup jø wø jøøŋ waani ki jø wø jany waani, ki jø wø män ki waani, ki jø wø raŋ waani ka agääde.
english: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët apïï bäätwa, 'ba wïthwa kär wïl ki ïïni, ni luumma tuutï ki waani kärwa kaalø.
english: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

anywaa: Cwïnywa kär døø cään, ni wa kär gaa wøk jöörï.
english: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

anywaa: 'Ba waana raanynyï kany mo raac, ni kïthï waani kany mo cøl ma kar thøø.
english: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na Jwøk marwa, doo na wïthwa owïl ki ïïni, ni thaaŋwa ceŋwa baŋ jwøk mør mo path,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

anywaa: ba diï ŋääö? Kiper jap wø en cwïny bëët ŋäyï.
english: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye kiperï ni bëëtwa ni wa di nääŋŋö cooth, ni waano tïmö kaamar dïëk mo di ŋarø en.
english: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

anywaa: Päyï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk. ?Ï butï kiper ŋø? Ö maal, kär wa kwierï na bäre bäre.
english: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni kanï täärnyïmï en? ?Na aperŋø ni wïl wïïï ki caannø marwa ki bëëtö marwa ni teek en?
english: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

anywaa: Waana nø ränynyö ni nø päthwa yi tør, ni yïthwa ogääbö ki ŋøøm.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

anywaa: Ö maal ni kønyï waani, ni wïïlï waani wøk ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

anywaa: Aana cääö ki duut mo beer ki cwïnya bäre, naa cäŋŋa nyeya; ni tïm leeba ni caala peen mar ŋat göör mo waŋe riek døc.
english: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

anywaa: Ï na nyeya, wøp mar kïdö marï kaala mar jiy bëët, ni luup mo wø ö wøk ki dhiï met, kiper mana näk ïïno gwïëth Jwøki na bäre bäre.
english: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

anywaa: Ïïni na teek, twöö opëëllö marï pierï, niï nyootha ajiem marï ki wödö marï.
english: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

anywaa: Beerra man cäädhï niï aa kuna böötï jiy ni ïïna nyeya mo owøørø, nee adïëri ki bëët mööl ki bëëtö mo beer nee nyaacge, ni tïïï ki tïïe mo rëëma ec ki køør teek marï.
english: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

anywaa: Dhøk athëëre moï opaaø ni beth, ni ge wø pïïa bäät weny mo nyïïmän moï, ni ö wïth juurre ni päthge tietï.
english: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

anywaa: Ï na Jwøk, wälu marï bëëdö na bäre bäre, na athøra mar kwär ena cerï, niï bëëdö niï ŋøla luup ki ŋøl ma kare.
english: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

anywaa: Ï mëër ki bëëtö mo beer niï män ki raay; kiper manøgønø, Jwøk ni beeye Jwøk marï ïïna mooe ki met ec ni mïn yiï niï kaala nyeye møga bëët.
english: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

anywaa: Abïïe moï bëët ŋwääö ni met ki riia; ni jø wø pöödö ki thøme yiï wø tïïcge tïïö ni met yi øt nyec mo oŋwaŋŋø ki tuk lïëy.
english: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

anywaa: Nyïï nyeye dagø dï mään moa näk owøørø ni wø en buutï, ni bäät cwïïï gwanynyø cuŋŋö yie ni dëëre päŋ ki warkey mo käla Öpïr.
english: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

anywaa: Ï na gwanynyø, wïny mara, ni cegï ïthï, ni lääŋŋï gø; beerra man wïl wïïï ki jø pou ki tuuŋ wäru,
english: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;

anywaa: køøre nyeya yie omïnni ki mïërö marï. Wøør eni, kiper ena kwäärö marï.
english: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.

anywaa: Jic Tayar ïïno jeethge,  ni ö jøøa näk okwär ni mwøthge ïïni.
english: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall entreat thy favour.

anywaa: Nyi nyeya mano tïmö ni gwanynyø ennø mïërö døc, ni dëëre da abïï mo ree da warkey.
english: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.

anywaa: Ni kïthi baŋ nyeya ni dëëre da abïï kït, ni ö nyïïakuue moa näk lwöp moe na caath køøre ni kïthi baŋ nyeya thuwø;
english: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.

anywaa: ni ge bwøth ka met ec ki kanynyø, ni dønyge øt nyec.
english: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.

anywaa: Ïïni na nyeya, wäätï oläw kar kwäcge, ni røønyï geni na kwääri mo bäät piny bäre.
english: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋï otïïa ni ŋäc ki yïth beenhnhe bëët; kiper manøgønø, jiy obëëdö ni pwøya ïïni na bäre bäre.
english: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.

anywaa: Jwøk beeye kar kan røk marø ni ena teek marø, ni eni kare cään ni wø laara kunynyö kany wø näk da gïï mo leth.
english: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, këël piny doo tïmö ni jäŋŋi, ni ö kïte ni leeŋge rege dï naama dwøŋ; ni ö pïïe ni lwörge ni neekum ki bööyö, ni ö kïte ni jäŋge rege ka athaga mare, ø ba doo lwäyö.
Da naam mo døøya yïth jiy mo met yi pääny mar Jwøk, ni beeye kar bëëtö mana en kur keere mar Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ena dï päänyögø, ni bëët päänyögø ni ba ränynyi, ni päänyögø wø laar Jwøki ka køny.
english: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

anywaa: Wïth juurre atïïö ko okiera, ni ö akwömmi ni päthge; køøre Jwøk mare acaane, ni tïm dëëtge ni rïïŋö.
english: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena buutø, eni na Jwø Jeekap bee eni ni wø kanø røø buute.
english: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

anywaa: Ööu ni neennu tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk, eni na tïïc gïï mo rëëma ec bäät piny.
english: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

anywaa: Lenye wø jooe jooø bäät piny bäre, ni tøy athëëre ni ŋør tøøŋi, ni waaŋ jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi.
english: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö, ni «Lïŋu nø, ni ŋäyu gø ni aana Jwøk. Kara tïmö ni dwøŋ dï wïth juurre, ni tïm kara ni dwøŋ bäät piny bäre.»
english: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena buutø, eni na Jwø Jeekap, bee eni ni wø kanø røø buute.
english: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

anywaa: Wui u na jiy bëët, paŋŋu ceŋŋu, ni kwöŋŋu ni yïthu met jï Jwøk.
english: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk na dwøŋ ni en maal, di lwäärö; ena nyeya mana dwøŋŋa eni bäät piny bäre.
english: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

anywaa: Wïth juurre abööte jïwa, ni tïïc geni ni ge ena thäc tietwa.
english: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

anywaa: Waana jëënne ki paac mo bëëtwa yie, ni tïme na gïr ajiem jïwa, wa na nyïïkwaac Jeekap na mëëre ki geni.
english: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aci maal bäät wälle, ni jiy kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

anywaa: Wärru ki dut pwøc jï Jwøk, wärru ki dut pwøc; Wärru dut pwøc jï nyeya marø, wärru dut pwøc;
english: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

anywaa: kiper Jwøk beeye nyeny bäät piny bäre; wärru dut pwøc mo ocaaø ni beyø.
english: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

anywaa: Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya bäät wïth juurre bëët; Jwøk bëëdö bäät wälu mare na en kur keere.
english: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

anywaa: Kwääri mo wïth juurre dëëtge acooŋge kanya ciel, ni tïmge na jic Jwø Eeberam; kiper kwääri mo bäät piny bäre, gena mo Jwøk, ni eni na Jwøk, kare dwøŋ døc.
english: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ, no orømø ki pwøc døc, yi pääny mare na en bäät kïnne ma Dhayan na en kur keere.
english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

anywaa: Kïn Dhayan bäär ni mïërö, ni piny bäre yie met ki gø, ni beeye na geer pääny mar nyenynya dwøŋ bääte.
english: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.

anywaa: Jwøk bëëdö dï kiir na no ogeerø ni teek mar päänyögø, ni ree ee nyoodhø ni bee eni na kar gwøk røk.
english: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, nyeye rege adwalge kanya ciel, ni cäänhge na aciel nee Kïn Dhayan tukge.
english: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya neenge gø, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni lwäcge, ni bwøkge,
english: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

anywaa: ni miel dëëtge kaace, ni pïïc gïn mo leth dëëtge, ni tïmge kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri.
english: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

anywaa: Gena raanynyï kaamar baabuure mo Tarcëc, na raany atuunna mana dwøŋ.
english: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

anywaa: Ka teeŋ mana wïnynyø gïna tïïc Jwøki, aputø joot ennø no otägö yi pääny mare, eni na Jwøk marø, eni na wïth jammi bëët. 'Ba päänyögø gwøk Jwøki gwøø na bäre bäre.
english: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jwøk, waana cädö kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ni wa ena øt lam marï.
english: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ka teeŋ mana ŋäc nyeŋŋï bäät piny bäre, jø bäät piny bëët pwøya ïïni thuwø, kiper bëëtö marï na beer.
english: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

anywaa: Jøøa bëëdö bäät Kïn Dhayan beerra man mïn yïthge, ni mïn yïth mïëc Juuda thuwø ki ŋøl marï.
english: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

anywaa: U na jic Jwøk, caathu deŋ Dhayan ni wïrru lage, ni kwaannu uut koor moe;
english: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

anywaa: raŋŋu kiire døøc, ni neennu kwör lenye moa teek, kiper nee caannu jï beenhnhø mano ööi.
english: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.

anywaa: Man beeye Jwøk, ni beeye Jwøk marø na bäre bäre, ni bëëdö ni bwøtha øøni na bäre bäre.
english: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

anywaa: Dïbwör bäre, beerra man wïnynyu gïn. Cegu ïthu, u bëët, u ni bëëdö bäät pinyi en,
english: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

anywaa: u na kwöru døøŋŋø ki u na kwöru bäŋgø, ki jiy moa can ki moa näk okwär bëët.
english: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

anywaa: A cäänö naa caana luup leec wïc, na acaare 'moa tiet luup nyoothge nyoodhø.
english: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

anywaa: Aani, ïtha ciia ciiø ki pwöc leec wïc, kiper nee tier gø caana ki yi duut mano wära ki thoom.
english: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a lwäya kiper ŋø kany wø dee gïï mo leth, kany wø ö raayi mo jø wø gëëmö ki aani wø cielge aani dïër?
english: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

anywaa: Jøøgø, ge ŋäätha kwär marge, ni ge wø töödö kiper jap kwär moge na thööth.
english: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man wïïl jwïëye wøk, wala cïpa gät jwïëye jï Jwøk,
english: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

anywaa: kiper nee bëëde ni kwøw na bäre bäre, ni ba thøw; kiper gät jwïëy teek døc, ni bäŋ gïn rømi ki gø.
Kiper ŋäc jøwi bëët ni këël jøøa näk wïthge leer, ge thøw, ni jøøa näk wïthge ba leer ki moa näk wïthge bäŋ acaara bëët ge poot thøw thuwø, ni dööŋ jap kwär moge jï jø møøk.
english: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

anywaa: Bwör moge bëëdö na uudi moge na bäre bäre, ni bëëtge na kwör bëëte moge këël yïth beenhnhe moo ööi bëët; ni ö pwöthi moa näk nyeŋge ege caa rege ni dööŋge wøk.
english: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

anywaa: Këël dhaanhø okwär, eni ba ruu; eni caala lääy mo thøw jaak.
english: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

anywaa: 'Ba aŋuun bëët jøøa näk ŋäätha oballe, ki jøøa caath køørge ni wø jïëc luupge beeye en:
english: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

anywaa: ge thøw kaamar dïëk jaak, na aŋuun bëëtö marge beeye yi bwörö, ni tïm thøøe na dïkwääy marge; ni tïmge ni ge ena tiet jøøa näk marge thïïŋ kanyo ruu øwi, ni tïmge ni bäŋ kar bëëtö jïge këët, ni ö dëëtge ni ränyge yi bwörö.
english: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
