anywaa: 'Ba aani, jwïëya wïïl Jwøki wøk cer teek thøø, ni kïth aani baŋe.
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

anywaa: Käru lwäyö ki dhaanhø kany wø kwäre, kany wø tïm jap paare ni thööth.
english: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

anywaa: Kiper kanyo thøøe, bäŋ gïn mo kääre noo aae; eni ba ci piny ki jap paare na aciel.
english: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

anywaa: Këël eni doo bëëdö ni pwøya dëëre keere kany bëëde ni kwøw en, ni jiy pwøya eni kiper kwär mare,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

anywaa: eni poot cøøa kanya ci kwäye yie, jøøa näk tar ba jootge këët.
english: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo okwär mo ba cädö, caala lääy mo thøw jaak.
english: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa teek, acäänö, ni cwøl jø bäät piny bëët, ni tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni pïïe jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

anywaa: Jwøk ree wø nyoodhe ka bäät Dhayan, paana näk wøp ni mïërö døc.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.

anywaa: Eni na Jwøk marø öö, ni ba nikïïl, ni ööi ni nyïme da maac mo räänyö, ni buute da atuunna mo dwøŋ.
english: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

anywaa: Ni cwøl maal, ni cwøl piny, kiper nee luup jiye ŋøle buutge.
english: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Cuuŋu jiy 'moa buuta kany moa näk cwïnyge ena køøra, jøøa jïëy ki man tutge ki luubö ki aani, na twöc luummögø ki køør olämi.»
english: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

anywaa: Maal gïr beeny Jwøk caane caanø, kiper Jwøk ki dëëre beeye dïŋut luup.
english: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

anywaa: Jwøk aköö, ni «Uuni na jiya, wïnynyu gïn caana en; uuni na jø Icriel, mara caana caanø dëëtu; aana Jwøk, ni beeye aani na Jwøk maru.
english: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

anywaa: U ba jääla kiper olämme mou mo wø cïpu; olämme mou mo wø waaŋ mo wø cïpu nut nyïma cooth.
english: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a ba jïëy ki man käda ki rwädhe mo wø käl baŋu, wala nywø ateea mo wø kälu ki dï pïïth.
english: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

anywaa: Kiper lääc paap bëët beege 'moa, ki dhäk ki dïëk moa en yïth pwöle mo ba kwaan.
english: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

anywaa: Weny moa en paap bëët ŋääa, këël lääy moø ni en yi pwöla bëët yøø beege 'moa.
english: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

anywaa: 'Ba doo na aano 'näk käci, ba daa caana jïïu, kiper piny beeye mara ki gïïö ni en yie bëët yøø.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a wø cämö ki rïŋ rwädhe, naa wø mädhö ki rem atëëe?
english: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

anywaa: Cïpu pwøc no olämi jïra, a na Jwøk, ni cïpu gïïa kööŋŋu ki ge jïra, a na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

anywaa: Ni cwøllu aani kany wø näk mo u ena yïth gïï mo leth; u kønya kønyø ni wøørru aani.»
english: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jï ŋat raay, na «?A teega ŋø ni en jïrï ni wø caanï ciik 'moa en, naa teega ŋø ni en jïrï ni maaï luumma tuuda ki jiya dhiï en?
english: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

anywaa: Kiper ï män ki man pwöny ïïni, ni luupa iï leeŋ ŋääï.
english: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

anywaa: Ni kany wø jootï kuu, tïïyï tïïö na nyawadu, niï wø dwätö ki jø luuy.
english: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

anywaa: Dhiï atïmö ni kwel ki caan gïï mo reyø, ni tïm leebï ni cara cwøk.
english: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

anywaa: Ï wø bëëdö ni ïïno pï piny niï jøøŋŋa coku, niï wø waya nyeŋ ŋata lwaar meru ki gø kiree.
english: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët atïïyï, 'ba aana lïŋö jaak; ki jïrï naa caala ïïni. 'Ba ennø, ï jääla jäälö, ni caana gïïa tïïyï na aciel aciel ni nyeŋŋø yøø kemø.
english: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, wïnynyu gïn, uuni ni taak Jwøk en; 'ba ni näk mo ba wïnynyu, u raanynya raanynyø, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat køny uuni.
english: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cïp pwøc no olämi jïra wøøra aani, ni ööa ni nyoodha køny mara jïre, eni ni wø jiiŋ bëëtö mare na kare.»
english: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wëën aani ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl. Wec moa baaa ni raanynyï geni ki køør mëër marï na päl.
english: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

anywaa: Pïny gïna baaa wøk cwïnya, ni døøyï dëëra mo waany ki gïna baaa.
english: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa baaa ŋääa, naa lääŋŋa bääyö mara cooth.
english: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

anywaa: Beeye ïïni keerï na bääya dëëre, ni tïïa gïna raac nyïmï, kiper manøgønø, luummï na caanï beeye adïëri, ni bäŋ ajäla bäätï ki køør luummï na ŋølï.
english: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, aana ŋat bääö ki mana nywøl a cøøn, ni tägi ka kanya ŋiiny aani yi mera.
english: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, ï mëër ki ŋat mo cwïnye thïïŋ; ni bee ï ni wø pwöny aani nee tiet luup cige cwïnya.
english: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

anywaa: Wec gïna baaa, naa tïma naa waany, ni pïnyï bääyö mara wøk yi cwïnya, nee dööŋe ni waany.
english: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

anywaa: Køny aani naa jïta ki met ec ki kanynyø, ni døøyï pänh cwïny mara met ec.
english: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

anywaa: Cïp cwïnyï piny ki gïïa baaa, ni raanynyï geni bëët.
english: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man tïïyï cwïnya ni tøŋ, ni døøyï jwïëya mo nyään, nee cwïnya bëëde ni ena køørï cooth.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

anywaa: Kär a riem wøk buutï, ni ba lwørï jwïëyï na en kur keere bääta.
english: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

anywaa: Dwøk met ec mara kare, man wø ööi ki køør køny marï; ni døøyï wïïa mo jööt, naa tïma naa tïïya mana manynyï.
english: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

anywaa: Køøre aani, jø wø dhal ciigï pwönynya pwönynyö ki jöörï, ni ö jø wø bääö ni luuge rege baŋï.
english: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï na pïëmi mara, wëën aani kiper ajäl rem dhaanhø mana kønynya piny; køøre aano wär ki duut ni yia met naa pwøya beenynyï.
english: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man japï dhaa, naa cääna naa pwøya ïïni.
english: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, yiï ba mïnni ko olämi man wø waaŋ; doo na yiï met ko olämi, a doo cïpö.
english: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

anywaa: Kiper olämi man wø manynyï beeye cwïny mo opädhö. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dhaanhø mo cwïnye pädhö kiper bääyö mare, ba taagï.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

anywaa: Ki køør met ec marï, beerra man tïïï ki gïï mo beyø jï Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni cäŋï kiir mare geerrø.
english: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre nø, yiï otïmö ni met ko olämme moa näk karge, ni mïn yiï ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre; kar kaace nø, rwädhe otïmö ni di cïbö bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï.
english: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

anywaa: Nyie, ï ni wø köö niï teek! ?Aŋø ni ŋwöï kiper gïna raac na tïïyï dëët jic Jwøk en?
english: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

anywaa: Cooth ï caara luup aranya. Leebï beth ni caala muuc, ïïni ni wø tïïc cwøk.
english: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

anywaa: Ï mëër ki gïn mo raac ni kaala mana beer, niï mëër ki tööt ni kaala adïëri.
english: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

anywaa: Yiï met ki luup aranya bëët, ni ïïna ŋat cwøk.
english: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ïïno raanynye na bäre bäre, ï di maaø ni tuut ïïni wøk ki yi ødï, ni puth ï wøk kar bëët jøøa kwøw.
english: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

anywaa: Gïïögø ojoot jøøa bëëtö marge beer, ni putge lwäyö, ni ŋeethge bäätï ni köge,
english: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

anywaa: ni «Raŋ ŋat mo Jwøk käre tïïö na kany kan dëëre yi gø, ni eni bëëdö ni ŋäätha jap kwär moa thööth na en jïre, ni ö teek mare ni cääth maal ki køør gïna raac na tïïe.»
english: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

anywaa: 'Ba aani a caala jaath mo oløth mo ena Øt Jwøk, naa bëëdö cooth naa ŋäätha mëër mar Jwøk ni wø ba jøøl.
english: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï pwøa pwøø na bäre bäre, kiper gïna tïïyï. Aani, man näk maa ŋäätha ïïni caana caanø nyïm jiy mo cwïnyge ena køørï, kiper ïïna Jwøk mo beer.
english: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø cäänö ki cwïnyge, ni «Bäŋ Jwøk», gena bøøre. Gena jiy mo oränynyö, ni ge temma gïï mo reyø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïïö ki gïn mo beer.
english: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

anywaa: Jwøk aräŋŋö ki maal ni raaŋa bëët jø bäät piny, ni ge raaŋe kaper nee jïte ki mo wïïe leer, mo manynya eni, eni na Jwøk.
english: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

anywaa: 'Ba ge bëët, geno nø gaa wøk, ni geno nø tïmö ni ge reyø bëët, ni bäŋgø mo tïïö ki gïn mo beer, këël dhaanhø aciel kiree, bäŋgø na bäre bäre.
english: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jøø ni tïïö ki gïï mo reyø yøø bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge, ni camge jap jiya kaawat man wø cam møø jaak en, ni nyeŋ Jwøk ba cwølge?
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace ge tïmö ni ge lwäär døc ki lwär mo ge poot kär lwäyö ki gø cøøn, kiper Jwøk nyïïmän mou cuu moge keethe keethø, Ni lääu wïthge, kiper geno kwier Jwøki.
english: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki ni wø bëëdö Dhayan ni piem jiye ma jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli, ni beege nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni mïn yïthge kanyo ö Jwøki noo dwøk bëëtö marge kare.
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, køny aani ki køør nyeŋŋï, ni ŋunnï aani ki køør teek marï.
english: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wïny lam mara, ni cegï ïthï ki luup mo wø cara.
english: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Kiper juurre rege anø thïïŋge dëëra, ni ö jøøa no ogäy ni cacge man raanyge jwïëya, jø wø bäŋ gïn caarge kiperï, ï na Jwøk.
english: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, Jwøk beeye dïkunyi mara, ni bee eni ni wø en jwïëya cere.
english: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna ocunne kiper gïïa reyø na tïïcge, ni raany geni, kiper mare adïëri.
english: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, olämi cïba cïbö jïrï ki met ec, ni pwøa nyeŋŋï, kiper ï beer.
english: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

anywaa: Kiper aana kønyï yïth gïïa leth bëët, ni jooda nyïïmänna ni geno böötö.
english: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wïny lam mara, ni ba taagï kwac mara.
english: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.

anywaa: Cek ïthï ni wïnynyï mara. Wïïa ree ee cwödhö ka acaara, ni ö wïïa ni kier ree,
english: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;

anywaa: ki dööt nyïïmänna, ki jøøa reyø ni wø thiel aani piny; kiper gena kän bääta ki gïï mo leth, ni gootge ni mänge ki aani.
english: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.

anywaa: Cwïnya apädhö ki pädhö mo dwøŋ døc, ni lwäya ki lwäc thøø.
english: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa lwäär ni dëëra kwanynyi, ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ døc ni bööt aani.
english: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

anywaa: Ni kööa ki cwïnya, ni «Doo na jïra da bwöm kaamar akuuru ennø, a doo määta kanymør naa jïta ki jwöm.
english: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a doo reŋŋa kany mo bäär, ni bëëda dï paap jaak.
english: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

anywaa: A doo laar läät kany kana raa yie, nee kara tïme ni bäär ki geni ni wø räänyö kaawat man wø tïïc jamø ka atuunna.»
english: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, raany acaare moge, ni pääï dhøkge, kiper gïï mo leth ki lenye ajooda ni tägö dï pääny.
english: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

anywaa: Waŋcäŋ ki wäär ge bëëdö ni ge wïdö dï kiir mar pääny, ni beeye kany wø bëëdö ni temma gïï mo leth ki jap rääö yie,
english: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

anywaa: na aranya ena yie kiree, këël ŋwöny jiy ki cwøk, ba aay dï uutjïëthe moe.
english: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

anywaa: Doo na beeye nyimänna na jøøŋ aani, doo løny jïra ki man jïënya luumme; doo na beeye ŋat mo män ki aani na tïïc dëëre ni dwøŋ bääta, doo løny jïra ki man kana raa ki gøøni.
english: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ï na näk röömi ki aani kiree, ŋato näk aano dwätö ki gøøni, na nyawatwa mana ŋäcwa cwïnywa ki gø,
english: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.

anywaa: ni wara wääwa ki waac mo met ki gø na aciel, ni wara cääthwa Øt Jwøk ki gø na aciel ni wa ena dï lwaak mo dwøŋ.
english: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.

anywaa: Beerra man cwöp thøøe dëët nyïïmänna, ni leeŋ ge yi bwörö ni ge poot kwøw; kiper raay atïmö ni bëëdö kany wø bëëtge yie.
english: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, Wuuö Jwøk cwøla cwølø, ni ö eni ni køny aani.
english: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

anywaa: A wø lämö naa jwöŋö ka abøøya ka amöölla ki dhöör, ni ö eni ni wïny dwøra.
english: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.

anywaa: Këël na bëëde ni da jiy mo thööth mo män ki aani, eni, a käle wøk ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëra ki yi leny mano këël ki aani.
english: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

anywaa: Jwøk, ni beeye na wää pinynyi cøøn, lam mara di wïnynyö ni jääl geni; kiper gena jiy mo bëëtö marge ba wiilge, ni ge ba lwäär ki Jwøk.
english: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

anywaa: Nyawatwa aöö maal bäät jøøa bëëdö ki bëët-mëër ki eni, ni raany gïna tuude ki geni.
english: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

anywaa: Luumme jööm ni kaala maar dhieŋ, 'ba cwïnye poot caara leny. Luupe pøøth ni kaala maaw, 'ba bëëdö ni beth kaamar opëëllö.
english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

anywaa: Gïna peek na en bäätï cïp cer Wuuö Jwøk, køøre ï kønye kønyø; eni, ba løny jïre ki man wëëk ŋat mo mare adïëri pädhö.
english: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni na Jwøk, jiy mo wø nääö ki jiy, ki jø cwøk, geno tïïyï nee laarge thøø ni nïne moge poot kär päŋ. 'Ba aani, a bëëdö naa ŋäätha ïïni.
english: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, køny aani ki køør mëër marï, kiper da jiy mo caanna aani, naa ege öölö cooth ki leny.
english: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna atïmö ni thööth, ni ge bëëdö ni ge caanna aani cooth, ni ge manynya leny ki aani ni ge töödö.
english: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø lwäya, a wø bëëdö naa ŋäätha ïïni.
english: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

anywaa: Bee ï Jwøk ni wø luumme pwøa, ni bee ï Jwøk ni wø ŋäädha naa ba lwäyi. ?Aŋø, dhaanhø jaak, agïnaŋø noo tïïe dëëra?
english: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

anywaa: Cooth dhaa kat jiyi katø, ni gïï wø caarge bëët kipera beege gïï mo reyø.
english: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

anywaa: Dhøkge wø tuutge tuudö, ni lepge aani; køør tieta wø raŋge raŋŋø, ni ge koora aani naa 'näkge.
english: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jääl jøøgø ki køør gïna baacge, ni raanynyï geni ki wëër marï.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

anywaa: Kwöra wïïra yïthge bëët ŋäyï; beerra man kanï pï nyeŋŋa yi wïlli marï, niï caara kïmmö mara.  ?Aŋø, gïïa tägö dëëra bëët paa iï göörö yi wëëlö marï?
english: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ wø kwaa ïïni, nyïïmänna wø puta døø ŋäthge. Ŋääa møn ni ï na Jwøk, ï ena kura.
english: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.

anywaa: Bee ï Jwøk ni wø luumme pwøa; bee ï Wuuö Jwøk ni wø luumme pwøa møn;
english: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.

anywaa: bee ï Jwøk ni wø ŋäädha naa ba lwäyi. ?Aŋø, dhaanhø jaak, agïnaŋø noo tïïe dëëra?
english: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa kööŋa ki geni bëët na en bääta otïïa jïrï, ni cïpa jïrï ko olämme mo dwøk met ec.
english: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

anywaa: Kiper aana piemï cer thøø, ni cømï tieta naa ba pädha, naa cäädha nyïmï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, yi tar mar kwøw.
english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, køny aani, køny canna, kiper raa yaa kan buutï. Dëëra kana tiet bwöpï këël mano ö gïna lethi noo pöödhe.
english: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.

anywaa: A jwöŋö dëër Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, Jwø wø tïïc jammi bëët nee thurge karge jïra.
english: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

anywaa: Eni køny di jääŋŋö ki maal ni køny aani, ni jook jø wø thiel aani piny. Jwøk mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri mare di jääŋŋö.
english: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

anywaa: Aani, a caala dhaanhø mo ena dï ŋuuwe, naa bëëdö dï jiy mo owär kaamar cwëënyi, ni beege nyïïmänna ni wø lakge beth ni caala tøøŋi ka athëëre, ni lëëpge beth ni caala opëëllö.
english: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni karï dwøŋ døc, na ajiem marï ena bäät piny bäre.
english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmänna, abïëp anø cekge kipera, ni ö cwïnya ni pädhe. Gena kunyö ki buur mo dwøŋ øtjööra, ni ö geni ki dëëtge ni päthge yie.
english: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, a bëëdö ni cwïnya ena køørï; cwïnya bëëdö ni ena køørï møn, naa wär ki dudi naa pwøya ïïni.
english: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

anywaa: Päyï, ïïni na jwïëya, ni päyu, u na thøme 'moa; aani, øw nyïïa nyïïö nee laar ruuö ki duuda.
english: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, met ec duua duuö jïrï dï jiy bëët, ni wära ki dut pwøc jïrï dï wïth juurre.
english: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

anywaa: Kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl dwøŋ døc no okëët maal, na adïëri marï okëët nyeŋ pøøl.
english: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni karï dwøŋ døc, na ajiem marï ena bäät piny bäre.
english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, uuni na kwääri, u ŋudö møn ki ŋøl mana näk adïëri?  ?A luup jiy ŋøllu ŋølø na karge?
english: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

anywaa: Jïre bäär, kiper u caara gïï mo reyø ki yïth cwïnynyu, nou tïïö ki ceŋŋu ki gïï mo reyø bäät piny.
english: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø, ki mana nywøl ge cøøn, ge bëëdö ni geno gaa wøk, ni ge cara tööt; geno bääyö cøøn ki mana öge wøk ki yïth mëëkge.
english: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.

anywaa: Dhøkge reyø ni caala cïm mar thwöl, ni ge caala olwierø ni wø dhïŋ ïthe, ni tïïc dëëre na miiŋ,
english: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

anywaa: kiper nee dööt jø wø tuuk ki thwöre nee ba wïnynye, këël jøøgø nyeŋge doo reegø nidïï, döötge ba wïnyge.
english: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, tøc lak jøøa reyø. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, tëëŋ lwönni moge wøk, ge ni caal ŋuuwe yøø.
english: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man rwäänyge kaamar pïï mo oøyø, ni tïm athëëre moge ni bäŋ tøøŋi wïthge kany wø thööthge.
english: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

anywaa: Beerra man tïmge kaamar nyilaal mo onimany ec, ni tïmge kaamar nyilaal mo obwön wøk, mo cäŋ käre joodø.
english: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

anywaa: Jwøk jøøgø pudhe wøk kaamar acïrra kany mo kärge dïëdö, ni raany geni ki køør wëër mare.
english: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

anywaa: Ŋata beer yie omïnni kanyo joot gø ni kwör di coolø, ni lwøk tiete ki rem jøøa reyø.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

anywaa: Køøre jiy oköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jøøa beyø da gïn mo beer mo jootge joodø møn; kare møn, Jwøk nutö ni ŋudö bäät piny.»
english: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, piem aani ceŋ nyïïmänna; gwøk aani ceŋ jø wø ö maal bääta.
english: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

anywaa: Piem aani ceŋ jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ni gwøgï aani ceŋ jø wø many 'näk ki jiy.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, jøøa bäätge teek, geno nø mør piny jööra; ni ge manynya man tïïge ki gïï mo leth dëëra, ni paa kiper ni da gïn mo yaa baaø wala raay mo yaa tïïö.
english: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

anywaa: Aani bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø, 'ba ge wø laara reŋ kuna jiiŋge dëëtge kipera. Ï na Jwøk, ö maal ni raŋï gïna tägö dëëra, ni kønyï aani.
english: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ï na wïth jammi bëët, päyï ni jäälï wïth juurre bëët; jø wø kaam gïï mo reyø kär wëënnï.
english: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

anywaa: Jøøgø, wø tïme na abøøya, ge wø duuö, ni ge ŋärö kaamar guu, ni wïrge dï pääny.
english: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

anywaa: Luup mo reyø wø dhääge wøk jaak, ni dhøkge beth kaamar opëëllö, kiper ge köö ki cwïnyge, na «?Aŋa ni wïny gø?»
english: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni na Wuuö Jwøk, ï ŋeethø bäätge, ni taagï gïr wïth juurre bëët.
english: But thou, O Lord, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.

anywaa: Ï na teek mara, a bëëdö naa raŋŋa jïrï,  kiper bee ïïni na kar gwøk røk jïra.
english: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

anywaa: Jwøk ni wø mëër mare ba jøøl obwödhö nyïma, ni tïïc aani nee nyïïmänna jooda ni geno böötö.
english: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bee ï na kwöt leny marwa, kär ge 'nägï, kiper kanymør wïth jiya wïl; tïïc ge nee ge thääcge ki køør teek marï, ni dwøgï wïthge piny.
english: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

anywaa: Beerra man cegï ge ka atöör marge, ki raay mo dhøkge ki luup mo wø cur dhøkge, ki luup tööt mo wø carge, ka acïëni marge.
english: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

anywaa: Beerra man thöörï geni ki wëër, nee bäŋe gøøni mo dööŋ këët, kiper nee ŋäc bäät pinynyi bäre ni Jwøk beeye kwäärö bäät nyïïkwaac Jeekap.
english: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

anywaa: Jøøgø, wø tïme na abøøya, ge wø duuö, ni ge ŋärö kaamar guu, ni wïrge dï pääny.
english: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

anywaa: Ge wø wïïrö ni ge caya cam, ni ŋurge kany wø näk mo ge kär jäŋ.
english: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano wär ki duut kiper teek marï, ni yia met ka amöölla ni dwøra ena maal, naa wär kaper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, kiper ïïna bëëdö na kar gwøk røk jïra, na kar kan røk kany wø dee gïï mo leth dëëra.
english: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

anywaa: Wui ï na teek mara, a wär ki duut jïrï naa pwøya ïïni, kiper ï bëëdö na kar gwøk røk jïra, ï na Jwøk, ni wø nyooth mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl jïra.
english: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, waana kwierï, ni raanynyï waani; ïïna bëëdö ni ïïno gootø ki waani; 'ba ennø, dwøk bëëtö marwa kare.
english: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

anywaa: Dïjäŋ piny atïïyï møn, ni ö pinynyi ni kaaŋŋe; 'ba cäŋ kwöra kaaŋŋø mwönnö, kiper piny atïmö ni muuŋŋö.
english: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

anywaa: Wa na jiyï, waana mooyï ki bëëtö mo teek, ni mooyï wa ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo na maathwa gø waana put bøømmø.
english: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna cïpö ki bëëra na nyuudhi jï jø wø lwäär ki ïïni, kiper nee dëëtge cooŋge na aciel lage kiper adïëri marï.
english: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

anywaa: Wïny marwa ni piemï waani ki køør teek badï, kiper nee waani na mëërï ki geni nee wa piem.
english: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

anywaa: Jwøk acäänö ni ena kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni kööe, «Ŋøøp Cekam pääŋŋa pääŋŋö ni mïn yia, ni pääŋŋa ŋøøp Goor Cuköt thuwø.
english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

anywaa: Ŋøøp Gelät beege 'moa, ni ö ŋøøp Maneeca ni näkge 'moa thuwø; jø tuuŋ Ipariem perge leth ni caala cöör nywïënyö mara, ni jø tuuŋ Juuda beege jø wø kïth ciik 'moa bäät tïïc.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

anywaa: 'Ba jø Möap caala gïn wø lööga yie, ni ö warø mara ni leeŋa gø yi po jø Ëdöm, ni kwöŋŋa bäät jø Pilitin ni dwøra ena maal kanyo bööta geni.»
english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, aŋa noo mooc aani ki teek naa dønynya yi pääny mana teek, noo bwøth aani naa këëda ki jø Ëdöm?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, aŋø, waana kwierï møn ennø, niï ba ci baŋ leny këët ki jø leny mowa?
english: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

anywaa: Køny waani ceŋ nyïïmän, kiper køny mar dhaanhø bäŋ gïn mo duue
english: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

anywaa: Teek dïïm ojootwa baŋ Jwøk, ni bee eni noo bööt nyïïmän mowa.
english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wïny oduuru mara, ni cegï ïthï ki lam mara.
english: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.

anywaa: Aani, a cøøra ïïni kany bëëda ni kara bäär ki paac en, ni cwïnya opädhö. Kan aani buutï, ï na teek,
english: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

anywaa: kiper ï wø bëëdö na kar kan røk jïra, ni nägï kar gwøk røk jïra kiper nyïïmänna.
english: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

anywaa: Tïïc aani naa bëëda kar bëëtö marï na bäre bäre, ni kana raa tiet bwöpï.
english: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

anywaa: Ï na Jwøk, gïïa kööŋa ki ge ri lam awïnynyï, ni gïï wø cïpï jï jø wø lwäär ki ïïni acïpï jïra.
english: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

anywaa: Meet nïr kwøw mo nyeya, ni këët cwiiri moe ri beenhnhe moo ööi.
english: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët nyeya na bäre bäre nyïmï, ï na Jwøk, ni gwøgï eni ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri marï.
english: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

anywaa: Køøre aano wär ki duut naa pwøya nyeŋŋï cooth, nee gïïa kööŋa ki geni tïïa ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

anywaa: Aani, a bëëdö naa raŋŋa jï Jwøk keere naa lïŋö, kiper køny mara ööi ka baŋe.
english: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

anywaa: Bee eni keere na teek mara na dïkunyi mara, ni ena kar gwøk røk jïra, ni tïm cwïnya ni ba bööi këët.
english: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u bëët, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdu nou tuuŋŋa dhaanhø, ki man raanynyu gø, kaamar kiir mo dëëre ee nyaaŋø wala kal mo nhønhnhi?
english: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

anywaa: Man wø caarru keere beeye ki man gøøu dhaanhø piny kare na näk eno wøørø yie, ni yïthu wø met ka caan tööt, ni u wø gwëëdhö ka dhøgu, 'ba u cïënö ki cwïnynyu.
english: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

anywaa: Aani, a doo bëëdö naa raŋŋa jï Jwøk keere naa lïŋö, kiper a bëëdö naa ŋäätha eni.
english: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

anywaa: Bee eni keere na teek mara na dïkunyi mara, ni ena kar gwøk røk jïra, ni tïm cwïnya ni ba bööi këët.
english: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

anywaa: Køny mara ka ajiem mara jooda baŋ Jwøk, ni teek mara ki kar kan røk mara beeye Jwøk.
english: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

anywaa: Dïbwör bäre, bëëdu nou ŋäätha eni cooth, ni kälu gïïa en cwïnynyu wøk jïre; kiper Jwøk beeye kar kan røk marø.
english: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.

anywaa: Jø bäät piny bëët caala jam dhøk jaak; këël jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki moa kwörge bäŋgø bëët, bäŋ karge. Ni näk mo ge kïtha bäät gïr røm, ge ba peek; këël mo rwöpa ge bëët cøøn, jööt marge kaala jööt mar jam dhøk.
english: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

anywaa: Kär jöör møt ŋääthu, ni ba ŋääthu jammi mo jootu ka køør kwal. Ni näk jap kwär otïmö ni thööth jïïu, kär cwïnynyu këëllu køørge.
english: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

anywaa: Jwøk acäänö yie aciel, ni luup moa wïnynya beege luup ariiø mo perge leth, ni beege ni teek ena cer Jwøk,
english: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

anywaa: ni mëër man wø ba jøøl käla baŋe. Kiper ïïni na Wuuö Jwøk, ŋati man nø wø cunnï cunnö ki køør tïïe moe.
english: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, beeye ïïni na Jwøk mara; a wø manynya køørï. A bëëdö naa manynya ïïni kaawat man wø manynya pïï ni aano 'näk riewi. A bëëdö naa lääŋŋa ïïni paap, kany ni bëëdö no otal ni bäŋ pïï yie en.
english: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

anywaa: Jïrï araŋa kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere, kiper nee teek marï ka ajiem marï jooda.
english: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.

anywaa: Ï pwøa pwøø ki dhaa, kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl letha pere ki kwøw;
english: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

anywaa: a bëëdö naa pwøya ïïni ki yïth nïr kwøwa bëët, ni thaaŋa ceŋŋa maal naa lama ïïni.
english: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

anywaa: Yia atïmö ni met kaamar dhaanhø mo ojäŋ ki cam mo met, ni wära ni yia met naa pwøya ïïni.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

anywaa: Kany wø para ïïni naa ena kar niine mara, ï lääŋŋa lääŋŋö ki dï wäär bäre.
english: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

anywaa: A wär ki dudi ni yia met tiet bwöpï, kiper ï bëëdö na dïkunyi mara,
english: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

anywaa: A bëëdö ni aano göök dëërï, naa iï jølø ki cer cwïïï.
english: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø many man raanyge jwïëya, ge cøøa piny tiet ŋøøm.
english: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

anywaa: Geno cïp ceŋ jøw 'näk geni ko opëëlle, ni tïmge na cam jï odïï.
english: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya yie omïnni ki Jwøk, ni ö jø wø kööŋ ŋëët Jwøk bëët ni kanyge; 'ba jø wø cäänö ki tööt, dhøkge omec.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wïny dwøra ki gïï cäda kiperge ii;  køny aani naa ba lwäya ki nyïïmänna.
english: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

anywaa: Gwøk aani ki gïï wø tuut jøøa reyø kipera, ni gwøgï aani ceŋ jø wø tïïö ko okiera,
english: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

anywaa: jø wø lëëpge ege paa ni beth ni caala opëëllö, ni wø lëëpge coony baŋ dhaanhø kaamar athëëre.
english: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

anywaa: Ge caala jiy mo omøør piny mo ge thööya ŋat mo mare adïëri, jø wø laar dhaanhø thööyö ni ge ba lwäär.
english: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

anywaa: Dhøkge wø tuutge tuudö nee gïï mo reyø tïïcge na aciel, ni cäänge ki man cïïge ka abïëp, ni ge cädö ki cwïnyge ni bäŋ ŋat joot geni.
english: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

anywaa: Ge cädö ki man tïïge ki gïn mo raac, ni tïïcge ka køør riek waŋ marge, kiper acaara mar dhaanhø ki gïïa en cwïnye ba joot.
english: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

anywaa: 'Ba geno këër Jwøki ka atheerø mare, ni put dëëtge jïtö ki ŋwiili.
english: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

anywaa: Luup moge odwøk Jwøki wïthge, ni kïth ge yi ränynyö, ni ö jø wø joot geni bëët ni buuge geni.
english: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët otïmö ni lwäär; ni ö gïna tïïc Jwøki ni køpge gø, ni cätge kiper tïïe moe.
english: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer yie omïnni ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni kan dëëre buute, ni ö jøøa cwïnyge thïïŋ bëët ni kanyge.
english: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, jiy wø bëëdö ni ge pwøya ïïni Dhayan,  ni ö gïïa kööŋge ki ge ni cïpge ge jïrï.
english: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Zion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

anywaa: Ïïni ni wø wïny lam, dhaanhø bäre ööa baŋï.
english: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

anywaa: Raay atïmö ni manynya man böötge waani, 'ba ïïni gïïa bacwa awëënnï.
english: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋat wø jierï ni wø kälï buutï kiper nee bëëde kar bëëtö marï. Wa puta jäŋö ki japa beyø na en yi ødï, ni beeye kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere.
english: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï na dïkunyi marwa, lam marwa wø løgï løø jïwa ki køør adïëri marï, ki køør tïïe moï ni wø rëëm ec. Beeye ïïni ni wø ŋääth jø bäät pinyi bëët, këël moa en kwör mo bäyö løø näpa døøŋŋø løøga.
english: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

anywaa: Beeye ïïni na cwääc kïte ki teek marï, niï nyootha teek marï.
english: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

anywaa: Beeye ïïni ni wø jook lwör mar näpa døøŋŋø, ni wø jook athage moge, ni nigebäc; këël okiera mar jiy wø joogï jooø.
english: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø bëëdö kwör mo bäyö, ge lwäyö ki nyuuthe moï moa näk rëëma ec. Jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, geno tïïyï niï pwøcge ni döötge ena maal.
english: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

anywaa: Piny wø liimï liimø ni jääŋŋï køth, ni tïïyï ŋøøm ni beyø ni jammi ciek yie. Näm moï wø pääŋï pääŋö ki pïï; ni cïpï caammi jï jiy,  moa näk iï nø jiiŋŋø kiperge.
english: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

anywaa: Kwöra näk opuurö wø jwøyï jwøø, ni päärï wïth ŋøøm ni röömi, ni døøŋï gø ki køth ni tïme ni jööm, ni gwïëthï gïï wø tuy yie.
english: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

anywaa: Ki yi cwiir cooth ï wø cïpö ki caammi mo beyø mo wø ciek, ni ö orööge ni päŋge ki caammi ni tïmge ni ge øya piny jöö jaak.
english: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

anywaa: Pwöla otuy ki luum mo pulli, ni tïm thuuri ni mïërö ni ec met ki ge.
english: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

anywaa: Ni tïm pwöla ni päŋ ki dïëk, ni røm gøli bëët ki beel, ni ö jiyi ni kwöŋge ni ge wär ki dudi ni yïthge met.
english: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

anywaa: U ni en bäät piny bäre, pwøyu Jwøk ni döötu ena maal ni mïn yïthu.
english: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

anywaa: Wärru ki dudi nou jiema nyeŋŋe, ni cïpu pwøc jïre ni wøørru eni.
english: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

anywaa: Caannu jï Jwøk, ni «Tïïe moï rëëma yïth jiy. Ki køør teek marï na dwøŋ døc, nyïïmän moï dëëtge atïmö ni kwanynyi nyïmï.
english: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

anywaa: Jø bäät piny bëët ï wøørge wøørø, ni wärge ki dut pwøc jïrï, ni ge pwøya nyeŋŋï.»
english: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

anywaa: Ööu ni neennu gïïa tïïc Jwøki, ni beege tïïe mo rëëma ec moa tïïe dï jiy.
english: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

anywaa: Naama dwøŋ apääŋŋe ki dï gø, ni dööŋe no otal, ni put jiyi ŋut løøga ki piny jaak. Kiper manøgønø, beerra man mïn yïthø ki eni.
english: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö na wïth jiy na bäre bäre ki køør teek mare, ni nyeŋŋe ena bäät wïth juurre; 'ba ennø, kär dee jø ageem mo tïŋa wïthge maal bääte.
english: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

anywaa: Dïbwör bäre, pwøyu Jwøk marø, nee pwøc man wø pwøyu eni ki gø wïnynyi.
english: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø gwøk øøni nøø bëëdö ni ø kwøw, ni bee eni ni wø ba wëëk tietø ceec.
english: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, waana päärï, kaawat man wø twøn gwel-bïrö kany wø leenyi, nee mana beer joot.
english: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

anywaa: Waana kïthï kar twöc, ni kïthï bäätwa ki tëër mo peek.
english: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

anywaa: Jiy awëëgï wääth bäätwa, ni cørwa dï maac ni cääthwa yïth pïï; 'ba waana kälï wøk ni cïbï wa kar bëëtö mo beer.
english: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

anywaa: Aani, a ööa yi øtø marï naa käädö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ni cïba gïïa kööŋa ki ge jïrï,
english: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

anywaa: ni beege moa näk yaa caanø ki dhaa kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth.
english: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

anywaa: Lääy moa no olør ocïba jïrï no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, mo noo waaŋi, jïrö puta nitul, ni beege nyöök rööm, ki rwädhe, ki nyöök atëëe.
english: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

anywaa: U wø lwäär Jwøk bëët, ööu, wïnynyu gïn, kiper nee gïna tïïc Jwøki jïra caana jïïu.
english: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

anywaa: Aana jwöŋö dëëre, ni pwøa eni ki dhaa.
english: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

anywaa: Doo na raay 'moa poot bëëdö ni yaa maa cwïnya,  Wuuö Jwøk lam mara bäŋa dee wïnynyö;
english: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:

anywaa: 'ba ka adïëri møn, Jwøk kwac mara awïnynye, ni leŋ dwøra kanya läma.
english: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Jwøk, eni na kär kwier man wïny lam mara, ni käre mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl paanyø bääta.
english: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki ni nyooth met ec mare jïwa ni gwïëth waani, ni wëëk tac täärnyïme rieny bäätwa,
english: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

anywaa: ni ö jööre ni tïme ni ŋäc bäät piny, ni tïm kønynyi mare ni ŋäc dï wïth juurre bëët.
english: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, beerra man ö jiyi ni pwøcge ïïni; beerra man ö jiyi bëët ni pwøcge ïïni.
english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

anywaa: Beerra man mïn yïth juurre ni wärge ni yïthge met, kiper luup jiy wø ŋølï na adïëri, ni bwøthï wïth juurre moa en bäät piny.
english: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, beerra man ö jiyi ni pwøcge ïïni; beerra man ö jiyi bëët ni pwøcge ïïni.
english: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

anywaa: Ŋøøm aduunnö ki caammi; Jwøk, ni beeye Jwøk marø, bëëdö ni gwïëtha øøni.
english: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

anywaa: Jwøk ø gwïëdhe gwïëdhö, ni ö jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni lwäcge ki eni.
english: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Jwøki maal, ni keeth nyïïmänne, ni ö jø wø män ki eni ni bwøkge nyïme.
english: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, keeth geni kaawat man wø ö jame wø keeth jïrö. Beerra man räny jøøa reyø nyïmï, kaawat man wø ö gage wø leenyi maaci.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ö jøøa bëëtö marge beer ni mïn yïthge, ni kanyge nyïm Jwøk, ni bëëtge ni met ec marge okadhø.
english: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

anywaa: Wärru jï Jwøk, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋe ki dudi; wärru jïre ni döötu ena maal, eni ni wø cäädhi ki bäät pøøl, ni kanynyu nyïme, eni na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.

anywaa: Jwøk ni wø bëëdö kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere bee eni na wää kïïe, ni bee eni ni wø gwøk määr thuunhnhi.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

anywaa: Jwøk dhaanhø mo owii kur keere wø di mooø ki paac. Jø twöc wø käle wøk ni mooc geni ki bëëtö mo beer; 'ba jø ageem bëëdö yi ŋöömö mo raac.
english: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, kanya bwödhï nyïm jiyï, niï cäädha dï paap, kanya pïïyï bäät Kïn Caynay, piny ajïtö ki dïjäŋ piny, ni ö køthi ni pädhe.
Wui Jwøk, køth mo dwøŋ ajääŋŋï, ni dwøgï ŋøøpï na näk oränynyö karge,
english: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

anywaa: ni ö jiy moï ni jïtge ki kar bëëtö. Wui Jwøk, jøøa can amooyï ki køør beer marï.
english: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk mare acaane, ni put nyïïmänni bwøk; ni ö apoole mo thööth ni køpge dwørøgø ni met enøgø,
english: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Nyeye ki jø leny moge abwøk ni reŋge.» Ni ö määnni moa dööŋ paac ni pääŋge jammi moa twier.
english: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

anywaa: Këël na bëët määrögø ni ge bëëdö dhi lwaaga, gena tïmö ni ge mïërö ni ge caala akuuru mo bwöpe orïëbö ki gïn mo ŋwaŋŋi, mo okwöre moe orwødhø ki warkey.
english: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøa en teeki cere ni keeth nyeye kaace, bäät Kïn Jaalmön agääbö bäre ki jammi moa dööŋ piny.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Zalmon.

anywaa: Kïdi mana teek beeye Kïn Baacan, kïnna näk wïthe thööth.
english: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na kïnna wïthe thööth, aperŋø ni räŋï ka agääde en, niï raŋŋa kïnna jier Jwøki na kar bëëtö mare? Adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre bëëdö kaace na bäre bäre.
english: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

anywaa: Jïëth leny mo Jwøk mo wø tut okwëënyi thööth døc ni ba thum ki kwaan, ni Wuuö Jwøk ena dïge kaawat mana bëëde kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere bäät Kïn Caynay.
english: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna aa maal bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni jiy moa no omaaø ri leny pieyï pieyø, ni lwørï gïïa cïp jïrï yïthakic jiy, këël moa cïp jø ageemmi thuwø, ni putï bëëtö kaace.
english: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni ni wø käär øøni ki yïth nïne bëët, ni bee eni na pïëmi marø.
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

anywaa: Jwøk marø beeye Jwøk mo kunyö, ni bee eni na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø wëëk dhaanhø bødhø cer thøø.
english: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wï nyimän mare di gøø ni keethe, këël wï ŋat wø bëëdö ni nøøya raay moe.
english: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ge duua duuö ki yi Baacan, ni duua geni ki yïth kudi mo naama dwøŋ,
english: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

anywaa: kiper nee tietu lwøgu ki rem nyïïmän mou, ni ö guuwi mou thuwø ni jïtge ki remø mo gatge gadø.»
english: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, thaabuur marï ajoot jiyi, ni beeye thaabuur marï, ï na Jwøk mara, ï na nyeya mara, ni jiy cøøa kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere.
english: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

anywaa: Jø wø wär, bwödhö nyïm, ni ö jø wø pöödö ki thøme ni enge køørge, ni ö nyïïakugo pöödö ka anëët ni enge lakge.
english: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

anywaa: Pwøyu Jwøk dï acooŋa mo dwøŋ; pwøyu eni na Wuuö Jwøk, uuni na nyïïkwaac jø Icriel.
english: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

anywaa: Tuuŋ Benjamen na thiinh nutö kaace ni bwödhö eni; ni kwääri mo jø tuuŋ Juuda ki jiy moge, ki kwääri mo jø tuuŋ Dhebulan ki mo jø tuuŋ Naptali, ge nut kaace thuwø.
english: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, jääŋ teek marï, ni nyoothï teek marï kaawat mana tïïyï kiperwa dïkwøŋ.
english: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

anywaa: Nyeye oböönh baŋï ki jammi Øt Jwøk marï na dwøŋ na en Jerucalem.
english: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

anywaa: Jook Ijep ni caal lääy mo bëëdö yïth oböödhi enø, ni joogï nyeye mo wïth juurre ki jiy moge ni wø caal rwädhe ki nyïïrøøe yøø, këël kanyo leeŋge dëëtge piny nyïmï ni cïpge gwet ajwäk;  keeth wïth juurre mo wø yïthge met ki leny.
english: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

anywaa: Cuumme oööi ki Ijep, ni ö Ithiöpia ni laar cere thaaŋ baŋ Jwøk.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

anywaa: Uuni na mïëc bäät piny, wärru jï Jwøk; wärru ki dut pwøc jïre, eni na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

anywaa: Wärru jïre, eni ni wø cäädhi ki maal, ni beeye maal na nut cøøn. Ennø, eni cäänö ni jïre da teek.
english: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

anywaa: Jiemmu Jwøk kiper teek mare, eni na en ajiemmi mare bäät jø Icriel, na näk teek mare okëët maal.
english: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï di lwäärö kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere; eni na Jwø Icriel ki dëëre, teek wø cïbe cïbö jï jiye. Pwøc en jï Jwøk.
english: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, køny aani, kiper a caala dhaanhø mo pïï onø këët cwaage.
english: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

anywaa: Aana niŋac yo odhöönh, ni bäŋ kany këëla tiera yie. Aana pïï dï naam kanya päŋ, ni ö naammi ni mwøny aani.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

anywaa: A bëëdö ni aano ööl naa jwöŋö cooth, ni cwaaga orööy. Ni ö nyeŋŋa ni talge jöö naa raŋŋa jïrï, ï na Jwøk mara.
english: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

anywaa: Jiy mo män ki aani ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak thööth døc, ni kwäänge kaala jïëc wïïa, ni jø wø many aani naa 'näkge jaak beege jiy mo teek; aana wëëkge cool jammi mo kära kwalø.
english: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, beeye ï ni ŋäc rääö mara, ni gïïa baya bëët paa okanø ki ïïni.
english: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, kär wïth jø wø raŋ jïrï lääi ki køøra; Wui Jwø Icriel, kär nyeŋ jøøa many ïïni ränynyö ki køøra.
english: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

anywaa: Aani, ajøøŋ mana jøøŋ a ki gø, ajïënya kiperï, ni tïm wïïa ni laay døc.
english: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.

anywaa: Aana tïmö ni aana jur jï tuuŋwa, ni tïma naa path jï nyïïmera;
english: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.

anywaa: kiper mana bëëda ni remø mara otwak kiper øtø marï, ni ö ajøøŋ mar jø wø jøøŋ ïïni ni pänh bääta.
english: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda naa jwöŋö naa wödö ki cam, gïnögø atïmö na ajøøŋ dëëra.
english: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

anywaa: Kanya røøa keeca dëëra na abïï kiper pänh cwïny mara, aana tïmö na gïr abuua jïge.
english: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

anywaa: Jø wø pï piny bura wø cäänö ka nyeŋŋa, ni ö jø meerø ni jalge aani ki duut.
english: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a wø lämö jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø näk ma kare ni wø manynyï. Wui Jwøk, wïny lam mara ki køør mëër marï na päl ni wø ba jøøl, ni kønyï aani ki køør adïëri marï.
english: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

anywaa: Käl aani wøk ki yo odhöönhi ni ena yie en, naa ba naŋac yie; køny aani ceŋ nyïïmänna, ni kälï aani wøk ki yi naama päŋ.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

anywaa: Køny aani naa ba mwøny naammi, ni kønyï aani naa ba käl jwïëe, ni ba wëëgï dhi buur dïïr bääta.
english: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny lam mara ki køør mëër marï na beer ni wø ba jøøl, ni luuï nyïmï baŋa ki køør bäth ec marï na dwøŋ.
english: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

anywaa: Kär täärnyïmï kanï ki aani, a na laŋŋø marï, kiper a ena yïth gïï mo leth; beerra man laarï lam mara wïnynyö.
english: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

anywaa: Nyänh buuta ni wïïlï aani wøk, naa wïïlï wøk ka ceŋ nyïïmänna.
english: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

anywaa: Gïï wø jøøŋ aani ki ge bëët ŋäyï, këël lään wïc mara ki räny nyeŋ mara ŋäyï thuwø, ni nyïïmänna bëët nëënö jïrï.
english: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

anywaa: Ajøøŋ cwïnya araanynye, ni tïma kaamar dhaanhø mo tuu; ni rääŋa ki dhaanhø mo cwïnye pädhi kipera, 'ba bäŋgø mo yaa joodø, ni rääŋa ki jiy mo cøma cwïnya, 'ba bäŋgø thuwø.
english: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.

anywaa: Aana moocge ki gïn mo keec ni beeye cam jïra; Kanya ö riewi na 'näk aani, aana moocge ki køøŋ nyïïjenni mo wac nee maadha.
english: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man tïm cam marge na abïëp mo maga geni, ni tïm bëët-mëër marge ni caala akupa mo duua ränynyö bäätge.
english: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm nyeŋge no onijïïm ni bäŋ gïn nëëni jïge, ni tïm cuu pïth moge ni nhønhnhi na bäre bäre.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

anywaa: Kïth ajäla marï bäätge, ni ö wëërri marï na dwøŋ døc ni pïïe bäätge.
english: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm twïër marge ni ba beet, ni bäŋe dhaanhø mo bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare moge.
english: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

anywaa: Kiper dhaanhnhï na näk iï pwödö acäŋge caannø, ni ö eni na dëëre mooyï ki gïn mo leth ni cäŋge dëër gø mooyø ki rääm.
english: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

anywaa: Cäŋ bäät ajäla marge meetø ka ajäla mør; ge kär jïëyï ni marge beer.
english: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

anywaa: Beerra man gööp nyeŋge wøk yi wëël kwøw; ni ö nyeŋge ni ba göörï kanya aciel ki jøøa beyø.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano caannø naa bëëdö naa rämö; wui Jwøk, beerra man kønyï aani ni gwøgï aani.
english: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.

anywaa: Nyeŋ Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki duut, ni tïŋa nyeŋŋe maal ki køør man wø dwøga met ec jïre.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïn wø tïïc yi Wuuö Jwøk ni met ni kaala dhieŋ man wø cïp no olämi, wala rwaath mo dwøŋ.
english: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

anywaa: Kanyo jooti ya jøøa canni, yïthge omïnni; 'ba uuni ni wø cac Jwøk, beerra man jïtu ki cøm cwïny.
english: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk luum jøøa can di wïnynyö, ni luum jiye moa näk otwöö ba taae.
english: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

anywaa: Beerra man ö maalli ki piny ni pwøcge eni, ki näpa døøŋŋø këël ki gïï wø bëëdö yïthge bëët.
english: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk jø Dhayan di kønyø, ni cäŋ päänye mo Juuda tïïyö nee geer, ni ö jiyi ni bëëtge kaace ni bëët ŋøøpøgø na moge.
english: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

anywaa: Ni dööŋ ŋøøpøgø jï nyïïkwaacge, ni ö geni ni wø mëër ki eni ni bëëtge yie.
english: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, beerra man piemï aani, Wui Wuuö Jwøk, laar rwänh kuna kønyï aani.
english: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

anywaa: Jøøa many man 'näkge aani, beerra man lää wïthge ni kier wïthge. Jøøa yïthge met ki caannø mara, beerra man riem geni ni räny nyeŋge.
english: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jø wø buu aani ni bwøk cwïnyge ki køør lään wïc marge.
english: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø cac ïïni bëët, beerra man mïn yïthge ki ïïni ni kanyge, ni ö jø wø yïthge met ki køny marï ni cäänge ni nøøcge nøøyø, ni ge köö, ni «Dwøŋŋa Jwøk; dwøŋŋa Jwøk!»
english: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano caannø naa can; 'ba ï na Jwøk, laar rwänh baŋa. Bee ï ni wø køny aani, ni bee ï ni wø piem aani; Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kärï ruu.
english: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö ni raa yaa kan buutï; kär wïïa wëëk lääö na bäre bäre.
english: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

anywaa: Køny aani ki køør adïëri marï, ni piemï aani. Wïny dwøra ni piemï aani.
english: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

anywaa: Bëëdï ni ïïna kïn gwøk røk man wø reŋŋa bääte cooth; ni cïpï ki dwøl kiper naa køny, kiper ïïna teek mara, ni ïïna kar gwøk røk mara.
english: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, køny aani ceŋ jø raay, ceŋ jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ni wø bëëdö no ogäy.
english: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ï ni wø ŋäädha, ni bee ï na ŋäädha ki mana täga thïnhö.
english: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

anywaa: Bee ï ni wø käär aani ki mana täge ki kanya nywøl aani, ni beeye ïïni na tïïc aani nee lwaarø ki aani. Aani, a bëëdö naa pwøya ïïni cooth.
english: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

anywaa: Aana tïmö ni aana nyuudhi jï jiy mo thööth, 'ba beeye ïïni ni teek ni wø gwøk aani.
english: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

anywaa: Ï pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni bëëda naa jiema ïïni ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

anywaa: A kär jarï këël ni bëëda ni aana jaal en, ni ba wiiï aani kur keera këël ni bëëda ni bäŋ teek dëëra en.
english: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïmänna aløny ni ge cäänö kipera, ni ö jø wø many aani naa 'näkge ni tuutge dhøkge,
english: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

anywaa: ni köge, «Kee ena nø wec Jwøki; reŋŋu køøre ni magu gø, kiper bäŋ ŋat mo piem eni këët.»
english: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, kär karï tïïyï ni bäär ki aani; wui, ï na Jwøk mara, laar rwänh kuna kønyï aani.
english: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

anywaa: Beerra man lää wïth nyïïmänna ni dïïr wïthge, ni ö jø wø many tïïö ki gïn mo leth dëëra ni jøøŋ geni ni räny nyeŋge.
english: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a bëëdö naa raŋŋa jïrï cooth, ni ö pwøci man wø pwøa ïïni ki gø ni meet ree.
english: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

anywaa: Aani, a bëëdö naa cara gïr adïëri marï, naa cara gïr pïëm man wø piemï jiy ki gø ki yïth nïne bëët, këël na bëëtge ni thööth ni kaala moa ŋääa.
english: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a tägö ki man caana gïïa tïïyï ki køør teek marï, ni bëëda naa cara gïr adïëri marï keerï.
english: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, aana tägï ki pwönynyö naa poot thiinh, ni bëëda naa poot køpa gïïa tïïyï na näk rëëma ec këël dïcäŋi en.
english: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, kär a weyï, këël ni bëëde ni aana jaal ni wïïa da lwaar en, kiper nee gïr teek marï køba jï beenhnhø man ki moo ööi bëët.
english: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, adïëri marï dwøŋ døc no okëët maal, ïïni na tïïc gïïa døøŋŋø. ?Wui Jwøk, aŋa ni röömi ki ïïni?
english: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

anywaa: Ïïni na tïïc aani nee gïï mo thööth mo leth pïïcge bääta, aano cäŋï mooyø ki kwøw, ni duuï aani wøk ki dhi bwörö.
english: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

anywaa: Wödö man wøør aani ki gø omeetï, ni cäŋï cwïnya cømmø.
english: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a pöödö ki thoomothïënhö jïrï, ï na Jwøk mara, naa pwøya ïïni kiper adïëri marï, ni wära ki dut pwøc jïrï ki yi thoom-othïënhö, ï na en kur keere na Jwø Icriel.
english: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Aano wär ni yia met ni dwøra ena maal, naa pwøya ïïni, naa wär ka cwïnya bäre kiper mana piemï aani.
english: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

anywaa: Tïïe moï moa na adïëri ocaana ki yïth nïne bëët, kiper jøøa many gïn mo leth nee tïïcge dëëra wïthge alääö ni räny nyeŋge.
english: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, nyooth ŋøl marï na beer jï nyeya, ni nyoothï adïëri marï jïre, eni na o nyeya.
english: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.

anywaa: Beerra man ö eni ni ŋøl luup jiyï na adïëri, ni ŋøl luup jiyï moa no ocaannø ki ŋøl mo beer.
english: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

anywaa: Beerra man jït jiyi ki bëët-mëër, ni ciek ŋøømmi, ni kwär jiyi, ni jït paaci ki bëëtö mo beer.
english: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

anywaa: Beerra man ö nyeya ni ŋun jøøa no ocaannø, ni piem obwöre mo jøøa can, ni raany ŋat wø many man thiel jiy piny.
english: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jiyi ni lwäärge ïïni këël kanyo poot cäŋŋi ki dwääy ni nut bäät piny, këël mano këët røk beenhnhe bëët moo ööi.
english: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm ööny nyeya ni caala ööny køth mo jwøya piny, ni tïïc luum ni pulli, ni caala køth mo dwøŋ mo jwøya piny bäre.
english: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

anywaa: Beerra man ö adïëri ni nyaae yïth nïro beede ni ena nyeya,  ni ö bëët-mëër ni nyaae këël kanyo poot dwääyi ni nut bäät piny.
english: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët pinynyi ni ena cere, ni tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni cäŋ tägö ki Naam Upareeti këël cuŋ piny.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jø wø bëëdö paap ni dwøkge kööthge piny nyïme, ni ö nyïïmänni moe ni këëlge cøŋge yi tør.
english: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

anywaa: Beerra man ö nyec Tarcëc ki nyec jø wø bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ ni cïpge ka ajwäk jïre, ni ö nyec Cïïba ki nyec Ceba ni böönhge baŋe.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

anywaa: Beerra man ö nyeye bëët ni dwøkge kööthge piny nyïme, ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni tïnyge eni.
english: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

anywaa: Kiper eni ŋata can di piemø kany wø jwöŋe dëëre, këël ŋata no ocaannø ki ŋata näk bäŋ dïkunyi jïre.
english: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

anywaa: Ni cwïnye wø pädhö kiper ŋata jïre bäŋ teek ki ŋata can, ni kwøw geni.
english: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

anywaa: Eni jøøgø wø pieme piemø ceŋ jø wø thiel geni piny ki ceŋ jøøa no ogäy, ni bëëde ni per jwïëcge leth jïre.
english: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëde ni eni kwøw cooth, ni ö warkeyi mar Cïïba ni mëëgi eni. Beerra man läm jiyi kipere cooth, ni bëëde ni ge gwïëtha eni ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

anywaa: Beerra man jït ŋøømmi ki bëëlö mo päl këël wïth kïte, ni ö wïth beelli ni bëëtge ni tuuŋ jame tuuŋŋö kaamar jer bäät Kïn Libaanø, ni nyaac jiyi yïth päänye bëët kaamar luum mo ena yi pwöla.
english: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët nyeŋ nyeya ni ŋäc na bäre bäre, ni wïny nyeŋŋe dï jiy kanyo poode ni cäŋ poot nut ni rieny. Beerra man ö jiyi ni gwïëdhi ki køøre, ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni köge ni eno gwïëdhö.
english: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel; na näk bee eni keere ni wø tïïc gïï mo rëëma ec.
english: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

anywaa: Pwøc en jïre, ni put nyeŋŋe bëëdö no ojiemø na bäre bäre; ni ö ajiemmi mare ni pääŋ piny bäre. Kare møn, enøgønø.
english: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

anywaa: Man beeye aŋuun dut lam mo Deebit o Jeci.
english: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Jwøk mëër ki jø Icriel, ni beege jøøa cwïnyge thïïŋ.
english: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, kara acäännö ki man pädha, ni tïma naa caala dhaanhø mo cäädha yo othwørø.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

anywaa: Kiper aana tïmö naa këëö kiper bëët jø atöör, kanya jooda geni, ge na jøøa reyø, ni geno kwär.
english: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

anywaa: Kiper geni bäŋ gïn mo jwørge; ge bëëdö ni dëëtge jööt jaak ni ge teek.
english: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

anywaa: Ge kär ööl kaamar jiy møga, ni bäŋ gïn mo leth mo pïï dëëtge.
english: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, atöör atïïcge na gïr ajiem kaamar tii mo otwöö cwaak, ni tïm dïwïti kaamar abïï mo ege røø dëëtge.
english: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.

anywaa: Nyeŋge okwöt ki lørø, ni gïï wø reyø wø caarge ki cwïnyge thööth.
english: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

anywaa: Ge bëënna abuua ni ge cara luup mo reyø, ni ge töödö ni ge manynya gø nee jiy møga thielge piny.
english: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

anywaa: Dhøkge cara luup mo reyø dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni en maal, ni ö lëëpge ni carge luup atöör dï piny bäre.
english: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Jwøki ni døøge cään baŋge ni putge jïëy ki marge.
english: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

anywaa: Ni kö jø atöörri, na «?Aŋø, Jwøk da gïn mo ŋääe kiper bëëtö marwa? ?Aŋø, da leec wïc jï Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal?»
english: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?

anywaa: Neennu nø mø, jø raay beege yøø nø; cooth bëëtö marge jööt jaak, ni kwärö marge cäätha nyïme.
english: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ka adïëri møn, cwïnya adøøya mo waany ki gïn mo oballe jaak, ni bëëda ki bëëtö mo beer kiper gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak.
english: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

anywaa: Kiper gïï mo leth atïmö ni pïï dëëra cooth, ni bëëda naa jøøya gïï mo leth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïnögø kära caanø. Wui Jwøk, doo na yaa caanø, mara doo tïmö naa dwøga ŋäädhe mar jiyï cään.
