english: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pooda naa poot kär ci Øt Jwøk, naa cädö kiper nee tier luummögø jooda, atïmö ni teek jïra ki man jooda gø;
english: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

anywaa: 'ba na cøøa Øt Jwøk, aŋuun bëëtö marge ajooda.
english: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ge cïbï kwör mo cëëö, ni leeŋï ge yi ränynyö.
english: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.

anywaa: Ge laara ränynyö ki kany mo thiinh, ni thumge na bäre bäre ki køør gïï mo leth mo opïï dëëtge.
english: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø taak lääk kanyo pääe, ïïni thuwø ge taagï taaø kanyo ööï maal bäätge.
english: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.

anywaa: Kanya bëët cwïnya ni keec, ni yia raac,
english: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

anywaa: aana bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääa ni wïïa bäŋgø, ni tïma naa caala lääy nyïmï.
english: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ajooda naa poot bëëdö ka ïïni, ni cer cwïïa iï maaø,
english: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.

anywaa: naa bwøthï ka ri pwöc moï; køøre nø, aano pänhnhï ni jïta buutï ka ajiem.
english: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa ni ŋäädha maal këët? ?Patha ïïni? Bäŋ gïn mør mo manynya bäät piny, 'ba beeye ïïni keerï.
english: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.

anywaa: Løny ki man ö rïŋ dëëra ni ränynye, ni päth cwïnya, 'ba ï na Jwøk, ï poot bëëdö ni ïïna teek mara, ni bëëdï ni ïïna kura na bäre bäre.
english: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, jø wø jäth karge ki ïïni, ränynyö,  ni dïïrï wïth jø wø dhal luummï.
english: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, bëëtö mo beer wø jooda buut Jwøk, ni dëëra wø kana buute, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, nee luum tïïe moe bëët caana.
english: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord God, that I may declare all thy works.

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, aperŋø ni putï wa kwier na bäre bäre en? ?Aperŋø ni gootï ki waani na dïëgï en?
english: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?

anywaa: Par wïïï ki jiyï moa piemï cøøn, jøøa wïïlï wøk nee tïmge na jiyï. Par wïïï ki Kïn Dhayan kanya bëëdï yie.
english: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

anywaa: Ööï ni cäädhï niï raŋŋa øtø marï na näk oränynyö na bäre; nyïïmän gïïa en øtø marï na en kur keere araanyge bëët.
english: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

anywaa: Nyïïmännï akwöŋŋö ki met ec kar ødï kanya wara røømmï yie ki jiyï, ni cwöthge bëëre moge piny na nyuuthe.
english: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

anywaa: Ni tïmge kaamar jiy mo ŋøda jen piny yi lul,
english: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

anywaa: ni ö jenni moa näk otieŋø yi øtø marï ni kaaŋge ge ki lïge ki guduume.
english: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

anywaa: Øtø marï na en kur keere awaaŋge na bäre, ni tïïcge kar bëëtö marï na ŋäc nyeŋŋï yie ni ba waany.
english: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

anywaa: Gena cäänö ki cwïnyge ni köge, ni «Dïïmø geni na bäre bäre.» Ni öge ni waaŋge uut acook Jwøk bëët moa en dï paac bäre.
english: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

anywaa: Nyuuthe moa cïp Jwøki jïwa ba jootwa nïri, ni tïme ni bäŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk dïwa këët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø dïwa mo ŋäc ruuö mar gïïa leth na tägö.
english: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët nyïïmänni ni buuö? ?Aŋø, ge puta bëëtö ni ge jøøŋŋa ïïni na bäre bäre?
english: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni bëëdï ni cerï na teek iï kut köörï jaak en? Beerra man kerï riï ni raanynyï geni.
english: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni ïïna nyeya mara cøøn, niï wø bëëdö ni marï køny bäät piny bäre.
english: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

anywaa: Ïïni, pï naama dwøŋ apääŋŋï ki teek marï, ni nyathï wïth lääc naama dwøŋ tiet pïï.
english: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

anywaa: Ïïni, Lëëwatan, lääna wïthe thööth, anyathï, ni wëëgï gø lääc paap nee camge.
english: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

anywaa: Ïïni, jøør ki näm awëëgï kwödö, ni taalï näpa wara bëëdö ni kwödö cooth.
english: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

anywaa: Ïïni, waŋcäŋ beeye marï, ni wäär poot na marï thuwø, ni beeye ïïni na cïp cäŋ ki dwääy kwörge.
english: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

anywaa: Nyeŋ kee mo bäät piny bëët tïïya ïïni, ni öörö ki cwiir tïïya ïïni thuwø.
english: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, par wïïï ka abuua mar nyïïmän, ka ajøøŋ mar bøøre ni wø taak ïïni.
english: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O Lord, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.

anywaa: Kär jwïëc jiyï na jägö kaamar akuyi wëëk nyïïmän moge, ni ba bëëdï ki kany mo bäär ni wïïï owïl ki jwïëc jiyï na no ocaarø.
english: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

anywaa: Cäŋ wïïï caarrø kiper luubö mana tuutï ki waani, kiper kwöra näk muudhö dï paac päŋ ki jiy mo tïïö ki gïï mo reyø.
english: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

anywaa: Kär jøøa näk odïïmö duuö ni wïthge olääö, 'ba beerra man ö jøøa no ocaarø ki moa näk oööl ni pwøcge nyeŋŋï.
english: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ö maal ni caanï luummï, ni parï wïïï ki gïn ö bøøre ni bëëtge ni ge jøøŋŋa ïïni cooth en.
english: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

anywaa: Kär luup nyïïmännï taagï, kiper dïŋaŋ mar jø wø ö maal bäätï wïnyö cooth.
english: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, wa pwøya ïïni; wa pwøya ïïni møn, kiper karï cään ki waani; ni ö jiyi ni køpge tïïe moï na näk rëëma ec.
english: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

anywaa: Jwøk aköö, ni «Kanyo tïme na kanya näk yaa jierø, luup ŋøla ŋølø na karge.
english: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

anywaa: Kanyo leeny pinynyi ki jiy moa en yie bëët, beeye aani noo tïïc gø nee cuŋŋe ni teek.
english: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

anywaa: Aana köö jï jø ŋwøc, ni ‹Käru ŋwöö›, ni kööa jï jøøa reyø, ni ‹Kär wïthu tïŋu maal.
english: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

anywaa: Kär wïthu tïŋu maal, ni ba cäänu nou ŋaya ŋutu.› »
english: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

anywaa: Kiper dööŋ-kar dhaanhø ba käl jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wala jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ba käl paap thuwø.
english: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jwøk keere ni wø ŋøl luup, ni wø dwøk maya piny ni tïŋ maya maal.
english: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

anywaa: Kiper cer Wuuö Jwøk da athöönh ajäla, ni yie da køøŋø mo keec mo onø twaaø, ni cïp gø nee maath jøøa reyø mo bäät piny bäre, këël alage moe bëët.
english: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïr Jwø Jeekap okøba cooth, ni wära ki duut pwøc jïre.
english: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

anywaa: Jwøk teek mar jøøa reyø bëët raanynye raanynyø, 'ba teek mar jøøa beyø meede meedø.
english: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

anywaa: Jwøk ŋäc dï Juuda, ni nyeŋŋe bëëdö ni dwøŋ dï Icriel.
english: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.

anywaa: Øtø mare ena Calem,  ni beeye kar bëëtö mare bäät Kïn Dhayan.
english: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

anywaa: Kaace athëëre mo nyïïmän atøye, ni tøc kööt leny, ko opëëlle, ki jap leny bëët.
english: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

anywaa: Ï na Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni ïïno rieny, na ajiem marï kaala ajiem kïte mo wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

anywaa: Jø wø bëëdö ni teeka geni nyïm leny, japge akäl, ni putge thøø, ni bäŋe gïn mo oløny jïge ki tïïc këët.
english: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

anywaa: Wui Jwø Jeekap, ki køør mana mänï geni,  okwëënyi ki jïëth leny mo wø tutge adööŋ ni cuŋŋö jaak.
english: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

anywaa: Beeye ï keerï, ï na Jwøk, na doo lwäärö. ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man cuŋŋe nyïmï kany wø wëërï?
english: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?

anywaa: Luum ŋøl acaanï niï ena maal, ni ö jø bäät pinynyi bäre ni lwäcge ni lïŋge.
english: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ööï maal niï ŋøla luup, jøøa can moa en bäät piny apiemï.
english: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, këël wëër mar jiy tïmö ni duua pwøc jïrï, ni tïm aŋuun wëërri ni ena cerï.
english: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.

anywaa: Kööŋŋu jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwøk maru, ni tïïyu gïïa kööŋŋu kiperge jïre. Beerra man ö wïth juurre moa karge cään ki eni ni böönhge nyïme, eni na doo lwäärö.
english: Vow, and pay unto the Lord your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

anywaa: Eni bäät kwääri di bäädhö, ni ö nyec bäät pinynyi ni lwäärge eni.
english: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

anywaa: A jwöŋö dëër Jwøk kiper køny, ni dwøra yaa tïŋ maal, ni wïny mara.
english: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

anywaa: Kany wø ena yïth gïï mo leth, a bëëdö naa kwaaya Wuuö Jwøk, ni ki wäär ceŋŋa thaaŋa baŋe naa ba jwöm; 'ba cwïnya adhäthö ki cøm.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

anywaa: Wïïa apara ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni puta guyö; ni cäda, ni ö bääta ni pädhe.
english: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋa amäne ki niine, ni ö cwïnya ni pädhe, ni tïm cäänö ni ba løny jïra.
english: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

anywaa: A cädö kiper nïne moa cääŋŋe, këël kiper cwiiri moa no opöödhö cøøn.
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

anywaa: Ki wäär bäre a bëëdö naa cädö, ni cäda ki yi cwïnya ni pëënynya dëëra keera;
english: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

anywaa: ni kööa, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ø kwiere kwierø na bäre bäre? ?Eni yie ba mïnni ki øøni këët?
english: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

anywaa: ?Mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl rwäänyö na bäre bäre? ?A luumma kööŋe ki gø wiie wiiø na bäre bäre?
english: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

anywaa: ?Wïïe wïl ki tïï met ec mare? ?A mëër mare awiile ki wëër?»
english: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

anywaa: Ni kööa, ni «Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal teek mare akane ki aani, ni beeye ni bëëda naa kïmmö en.»
english: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïïa opara ki gïïa tïïyï; ka adïëri møn, wïïa opara ki gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïyï cøøn.
english: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

anywaa: A cädö kiper gïïa tïïyï bëët, ni cäda kiper tïïe moï na døøŋŋø.
english: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, jöör bëëtö marï ena kur keere; ?a Jwøe mane ni dwøŋ ni caal ïïni na Jwøwa?
english: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

anywaa: Ïïna Jwø wø tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec, ni wø nyooth teek mare dï jiy.
english: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

anywaa: Jiyï awïïlï wøk ki teek badï, ni beege nyïïkwaac Jeekap ki nyïïkwaac Jocep.
english: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ïïna joot pï naama dwøŋŋi; ïïna joot pï naama dwøŋŋi, ni tïmge ni dhulli ki lwär, ni tïm kudi moe ni wälli.
english: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

anywaa: Pøøl apädhö na køth mo dwøŋ, ni ö maalli ni märe, ni ö agaackøthi ni keethge kaamar athëëre.
english: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

anywaa: Dwør määc køth marï awïnyö ki ya atuunna,  ni ö malø mare ni meeny bäät piny, ni tïm pinynyi ni kwanynyi ni jäŋŋi.
english: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

anywaa: Øtjöö marï cøra dï naama dwøŋ, niï cäädhi ka kwöra päŋ, ni kwör tietï ba joot.
english: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

anywaa: Jiyï abwøthï kaamar pïïth dïëk, ni ge ena cer Modhe ka Aran.
english: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

anywaa: Wui jø powa, cegu ïthu, ni wïnynyu pwöc mara, ni këëllu ïthu piny ki luumma.
english: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Aani, gïïa tägö lama lamø jïïu, ni beege gïïa näk tietge okanø cøøn,
english: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

anywaa: gïïa näk yøø wïnynyö na ŋääø, na no ocaan kwäyø jïïø.
english: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

anywaa: Gïïögø ba døø mooŋø ki nyïïkwaayø; 'ba pwøc man wø pwøc Wuuö Jwøk ki gø døø caanø jï beenhnhe moo ööi, këël gïr teek mare ki tïïe moe na näk rëëma ec.
english: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk luumme acaane, ni cïp ciik moe jï jø Icriel, ni beege nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni kööm kwäyø ki ge nee obwöre moge pwönyge ki ge,
english: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

anywaa: nee ŋäc beenhnhe moo ööi, ni beege obwöre moo nywøl cään, nee läwge caan jï obwöre moge thuwø;
english: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

anywaa: kiper nee ge bëëtge ni ge ŋäätha Jwøk, ni ge gwøga ciik moe, ni ba wïl wïthge ki tïïe moe;
english: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

anywaa: nee ge ba tïmge kaamar kwäcge na wïnni na näk gena jø ageem, na näk cwïnyge ba en køør adïëri, na näk cwïnyge kär nieŋ køør Jwøk.
english: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

anywaa: Jø Ipariem, na wara bëëde, gena jiy mo ŋäc leny ka athëëre, 'ba dïcäŋa këëtge gena riemmi.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

anywaa: Luumma tuut Jwøki ki geni kärge gwøø, ni kweerge ki man cääthge ki køør ciik moe,
english: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;

anywaa: ni wïl wïthge ki tïïe moe, ki gïïa näk rëëma ec na nyoodhe jïge.
english: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

anywaa: Ena tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec nyïm kwäcge, yi pwöl Dhöän na en yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

anywaa: Pï naama dwøŋ apääŋŋe, ni wëëk jiy pöödhö ki yie, ni tïïc pïï nee cuŋge ni tïmge kaamar ageela.
english: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

anywaa: Gena bwødhe ki pöölö ki dïcäŋ, ni bwøth geni ki tac maac ki wäär.
english: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

anywaa: Kïte moa en paap akaaŋŋe, nee jiye mooe ki pïï mo thööth mo caala pï naama dwøŋ.
english: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

anywaa: Pïï atïïe nee kwönge wøk ki yi kïdi, ni wëëk ge kwödö kaamar pï naam.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

anywaa: 'Ba gena bëëdö ni ge poot tïïö ki raay dëëre, ni ge poot gëëmö dï paap ki eni na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.
english: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

anywaa: Jwøk apäänyge ki cwïnyge bäre, ni ge pëënynya cam mana lääŋge keere.
english: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

anywaa: Gena cäänö dëër Jwøk, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, løny jï Jwøk ki man cïpe ki cam dï paap kany?
english: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, kïdi agøøe, ni ö pïïyi wøk, ni tïm pïïyi ni kwödö; ?a møø nø, løny jïre thuwø ki man cïp gø, ni løny jïre thuwø ki man cïpe ki rïŋö jï jiye?»
english: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na wïny gïnögø, ena wëër døc; ena wëër ki wëër mo dwøŋ ki jø Icriel, ni tïm wëërri mare ni liel kaamar maac dëëtge, ge na nyïïkwaac Jeekap,
english: Therefore the Lord heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;

anywaa: kiper Jwøk kärge ŋäädhö, ni kärge pïëm man piem geni ki gø ŋäädhö.
english: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

anywaa: 'Ba eni maal aköömme, ni jap dhøk uudi mo gø,
english: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

anywaa: ni jääŋ møø mana cwøl ni meena bäätge kaamar køth nee camge, ni mooc ge ki cam mo käla maal.
english: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni camge muunni mo nyïïatwiet maal, ni beeye cam mana päl na jääŋ Jwøki jïge.
english: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.

anywaa: Jam jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ atïïe nee kwönne ki maal, ni bwøth jam jï løø tier-piny ki teek mare,
english: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

anywaa: ni kööla lwaa wenyø bäätge na cam, ni päl kaamar tør, ni kwäänge caala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ näpa døøŋŋø,
english: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

anywaa: ni wëëk geni pänh dï twïër marge, kwör bëëte moge, këël deŋŋe bäre.
english: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni cämge ni jäŋge døc, kiper gïna lääŋge acïp Jwøki jïge.
english: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni ge poot kär jøøm ki cam, ni ceŋge poot ena dhøkge,
english: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

anywaa: wëëc Jwøk aput ö bäätge, ni 'näk jø møøk moa dëëtge teek rege, ni beege wøpe moa no ojierø dï Icriel.
english: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni gïïögø bëët otïïö, ge poot tïïö ki raay, ni kärge jïëy ki Jwøk, këël na bëëde ni gïïa näk rëëma ec moa tïïe ege joodø.
english: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nïr kwøw moge atïïe nee laarge pöödhö kaamar jam dhøk, ni tïm aŋuun cwiiri moge na ränynyö.
english: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki na 'näk geni, gena tïmö ni ge manynya eni, ni duuge baŋe ni ge caya eni døc,
english: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

anywaa: ni parge wïthge ni Jwøk beeye teek marge, ni bee eni na dwøŋ ni en maal na pïëmi marge.
english: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cøøkge ki dhøkge jaak, ni ö lëëpge ni bëëtge ni cara tööt dëëre,
english: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

anywaa: ni bëëtge ni cwïnyge ba en køøre, ni kärge luubö mana tuude ki geni gwøø.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gïïa bacge awëënne ki køør bäth yie, ni käre geni raanynyø, ni kwier wëër ki kwöre mo thööth, ni käre wëër mare nyoodhø ki pälle bäre;
english: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

anywaa: kiper wïïe acaare ki man näk mo gena jiy jaak, ni ge caala jamø man wø pöödhi ni ba duui këët.
english: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

anywaa: A kwöre adïï na bëëtge ni ge gëëmö ki eni, ni moocge eni ki kïmmö dï paap!
english: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

anywaa: Jwøk apäänyge kwöre mo thööth, ni cwaatge yi gø, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Wïthge awïl ki teek mare mana tïïe dïcäŋ mana käl geni wøk yie ceŋ jøøa thiel geni piny,
english: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

anywaa: kanya ööe na tïïc nyuuthe moe ki gïï mo rëëma ec yi pwöl Dhöän na en yi ŋööm Ijep;
english: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

anywaa: ni tïïc pï näm moge na remø, ni tïme ni bäŋ pïï mo maathge.
english: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

anywaa: Ena jääk bäätge ki lwaa lwaŋŋø mo cama geni, ko ogwäle mo raanynya poge.
english: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

anywaa: Ni wëëk beekge adïtwie nee camge, ni cïp gïïa puurge jï bäänyö.
english: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

anywaa: Ni raany omøki moge ki pey, ni raany olämmi moge ki köö.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

anywaa: Pey awëëk päth bäät dhäk moge nee thøwge, ni ö pïïth lääc paac moge ni gøøyi ya køthi.
english: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

anywaa: Wëër mare na liel kaamar maac, ka ajäla mare, ki gïï mo leth ajääŋŋe bäätge ki ri nyïïatwiet maal mo wø räänyö.
english: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

anywaa: Øtjöör wëër mare ajabe, ni käre thøø mänö ki man pïïe bäätge, ni 'näk geni ki täw mo leth,
english: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

anywaa: ni beege kaai bëët moa näk cwøw na en Ijep, na kwøŋ jø Ijepi nywøl yïth mïëc nyïïkwaac Kaam, na täkge nyöödö ki ge.
english: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

anywaa: 'Ba eni jiye abwøth wøk kaamar rööm, ni gwøk geni dï paap kaamar pïïth rööm.
english: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

anywaa: Gena bwødhe ni ee gwøø ni tïmge ni ge ba lwäär, 'ba nyïïmän moge acam naama dwøŋŋi.
english: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

anywaa: Køøre jiye akäl yi ŋöömme na en kur keere, paana en bäät kïte na maae ki teek bade.
english: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

anywaa: Wïth juurre ariem wøk nyïm jiye, ni røm ŋøøpge ni pääŋ ge jïge ni tïme na moge, ni wëëk jiye ma wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel bëëtö kwöra bëët jøøgø yïthge.
english: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, gena gëëmö ki Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni ge päänynya gø, ni kärge ciik moe gwøø,
english: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:

anywaa: ni ge bëëdö ni cwïnyge ba en køøre ni marge cwøk kaamar wëëkge, ni tïm bëëtö marge no okööm, ni caala atheerø mo ree ee täpö.
english: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

anywaa: Jwøk atïïcge nee goote ki køør kwör lam moa tïïcge bäät thuuri, ni wëëkge eni këëyö ki køør gïï lam moge moa tieŋge.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

anywaa: Kanya ö Jwøki na joot gïïögø, ena put wëër, ni kwier jø Icriel,
english: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

anywaa: ni wec kar bëëtö mare na en Cëëlö, ni beeye oduŋkaara mana bëëde yie dï jiy.
english: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

anywaa: Ni tïïc acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuude ki jiy nee käl nyïïmänni, na näk beeye nyuudhi mar teek mare ka ajiem mare.
english: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.

anywaa: Ena wëër ki jiy moe, ni wëëk geni nyïïmän moge ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö.
english: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

anywaa: Wøpe moge athum ri leny, ni tïme ni bäŋ duut nywöm mo løøa bäät nyïïakuue moge.
english: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämme moge ni nääi ko opëëllö, ni dhäth määr thuunhnhi ki kïmmö.
english: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aö maal kaamar dhaanhø mo päya yïth niine, ni tïme kaamar dhaanhø mo teek mo twäädö ri køøŋø.
english: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

anywaa: Ni riem nyïïmän moe, ni lää wïthge na bäre bäre.
english: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni beege nyïïkwaac Jocep, akwiere, ni käre poge jierø na kar bëëtö mare.
english: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

anywaa: 'Ba beeye jø tuuŋ Juuda na jiere, ki Kïn Dhayan na mëëre ki gø na en poge;
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

anywaa: ni geer øt lam mare na en kur keere bäät gø na kany mo ojiemø, ni geer gø ni teek kaamar piny ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

anywaa: Eni dhaanhnhe ma Deebit ajiere, ni käl wøk ka yi lwaaŋ dïëk.
english: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

anywaa: Ena cwøl Jwøki kanya bëëde ni kwaaya rööm ki nyïïge moa näk dhøøth, nee tïme ni ena dïkwääy jï jiye ma jic Jeekap, ni beege jiye ma jø Icriel.
english: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

anywaa: Ni ö Deebiti ni kwaac geni ki cwïny mo thïïŋ, ni bwøth geni ki køør leec wïïe.
english: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, juurre paarï atukge, ni raanyge øt lam marï na en kur keere, ni tïïcge gø ni ba waany, ni tøkge Jerucalem.
english: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

anywaa: Rïk dëët jiyï acïpge jï wec maal na cam, ni cïpge rïk dëët jiyï na cwïnyge en køørï jï lääc paap.
english: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

anywaa: Rem moge akønyge piny kaamar pïï dï Jerucalem bäre, ni bäŋ ŋat mo koony geni.
english: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

anywaa: Waana tïmö na gïr ajøøŋ jï wïth juurre moa en deŋwa, ni ŋeethge bäätwa ni buuge wa.
english: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi noo poodï niï wëër? ?Naa këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët cwïnyï ni keec no oäpö kaamar maac?
english: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

anywaa: Kïth wëër marï bäät wïth juurre moa näk ï kucge, ni beege mïëri moa näk nyeŋŋï ba cøørge;
english: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

anywaa: kiper geni waana thöörge, wa na jø po Jeekap, ni raanyge kar bëëtö marwa.
english: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

anywaa: Kär gïïa reyø na tïïc kwäcwa kïth bäätwa; 'ba beerra man laarï mëër marï nyooth jïwa, kiper waano dwøk piny døc.
english: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

anywaa: Køny waani, ï na Jwø wø piem waani, ni piemï waani ni wëënnï raay mowa, kiper nee nyeŋŋï jïte ka ajiem.
english: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, juurre doo köö møn na age Jwøge? Beerra man coolï kwör rem jiyï na øc piny, nee ŋäc wïth juurre, ni jootwa gø thuwø.
english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

anywaa: Beerra man wïnynyï cooyø mar jø twöc; ni gwøgï jøøa näk thøø oŋøl bäätge ki køør teek badï na dwøŋ.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dwøk ajøøŋ mar wïth juurre moa en deŋwa bäätge kwöre abïriiø, ni beeye ajøøŋ mana jøøŋge ïïni ki gø.
english: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

anywaa: Køøre waani na jiyï, ni wø kwaayï kaamar pïïth dïëk moï, ï pwøcwa pwøø cooth, ni caanwa gïr pwøc marï jï beenhnhe bëët.
english: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, cek ïthï, ï na dïkwääy mar jø Icriel, ï ni wø bwøth jiyï ma nyïïkwaac Jocep kaamar pïïth dïëk. Rienyï ni nyoothï riï, ïïni ni wø nyooth ajiem nyec marï ki yïthakic nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli.
english: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

anywaa: Nyooth teek marï jï jiyï ma tuuŋ Ipariem ki tuuŋ Benjamen ki tuuŋ Maneeca, ni ööï ni piemï waani bëët!
english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, dwøk bëëtö marwa kare, ni wëëgï tac täärnyïmï rieny bäätwa, nee wa jïtwa ki køny.
english: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, ?a këël kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëdï ni ïïno gootø, ni lam marwa, wa na jiyï, ba wïnynyï?
english: O Lord God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

anywaa: Waana tïïyï nee wa jwöŋwa, ni tïm pï nyeŋwa na cam jïwa, ni maathï waani ki pï nyeŋ mo thööth døc.
english: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.

anywaa: Waana tïïyï na gïn läär wïth juurre moa en deŋwa, ni ö nyïïmänni mowa ni ŋïërge bäätwa.
english: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, dwøk bëëtö marwa kare, ni wëëgï tac täärnyïmï rieny bäätwa, nee wa jïtwa ki køny.
english: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

anywaa: Omøk apudhï wøk ki yi Ijep, ni tøøï gø yi ŋöömma riemï wïth juurre wøk yie.
english: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

anywaa: Kare apuurï ni jiiŋŋï gø, ni ö lweete ni këët piny døc ni mac piny bäre.
english: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

anywaa: Mïëya en bäät kïte atïmö ni ena tier tïpö mare; këël jenni moa døøŋŋø aume.
english: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

anywaa: Bääte alaak këël mana pïïe bäät naama dwøŋ, jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ö bääte møga ni pïïcge bäät Naam Upareeti, jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

anywaa: ?A ennø, aperŋø nø na nyaaï kal mare piny, ni tïme ni jø wø cur kaace bëët pøna nyïïe en?
english: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

anywaa: Këël kule bëëdö ni raanynya gø, ni bëët lääc paapi ni cama gø.
english: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët,  wa kwaya ïïni, cäŋ täärnyïmï luu baŋwa; räŋŋï ki maal ni raŋï piny, ni neenï jï omøk man,
english: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

anywaa: ni beeye omøk mana piithï ki teek badï, na caal wäädï na jierï na marï.
english: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

anywaa: Ena waaŋ nyïïmänni ki maac ni ŋøtge gø piny. 'Ba ennø, raany geni ki køør wëër marï.
english: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man bëët cerï bäät jiyï na jierï, na mooyï ki teek niï tïnyge.
english: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

anywaa: Køøre nø, wa ba døø ŋäthwa këët. Beerra man cäŋ wa mooyø ki kwøw, nee nyeŋŋï cøørwa.
english: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, dwøk bëëtö marwa kare, ni wëëgï tac täärnyïmï rieny bäätwa, nee wa jïtwa ki køny.
english: Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.

anywaa: Wärru ki dudi ki met ec jï Jwøk na näk teek marø, ni kwöŋŋu ni yïthu met jïre, eni na Jwø Jeekap.
english: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

anywaa: Jøllu duut døc, ni pwötu odööla ki thøpothïënhö mo döötge met.
english: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

anywaa: Tuuŋ wär koothu kany wø päär dwääyi, ni koothu gø kanyo en dwääyi tar, dïcäŋ man wø wøørø na jwøk.
english: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye ciik kiper jø Icriel, ni beeye mana ŋøl Jwø Jeekapi.
english: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

anywaa: Gïnögø atïïe na ciik kiper jø Icriel kanya tïïc gïn mo leth dëët jø Ijep. 'Ba aani, dwøl mo poot kuua cøøn awïnynya, mo köö,
english: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

anywaa: ni «Tëër akäla wøk bäätu, ni käla u wøk ki yi tïïc mo teek.
english: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

anywaa: Kanya enu yïth gïïa leth, uuna cwötö ni kønya uuni, ni løøa mara jïïu ki yi pöölö mo märö, ni päänynya uuni buut pï Meriba.
english: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jiya, wïnynyu mara nou köömma. ?Wui, u na jø Icriel, luubö mara owïnynyu gø wäne nø?
english: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

anywaa: Kär dee jwøk mo path mo bëëdö yïthakiyu, ni bäŋe jwø jur mo wøørru.
english: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

anywaa: Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na Jwøk maru na käl uuni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep. 'Ba ennø, ŋaammu dhøgu nou caama.
english: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

anywaa: «'Ba jiya ma jø Icriel dwøra kärge wïnynyö; gena kweer ki luumma.
english: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

anywaa: Køøre gena wiia ki teek wïc marge, nee ge cääthge ki uutjïëthe moa manyge jaak.
english: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

anywaa: «Jiya ma jø Icriel, doo na ge wïnynya mara cøøn, ni dege køøra caadhø,
english: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!

anywaa: nyïïmänge daa laara dïïm, ni daa jøøa thiel geni piny raanynyø.
english: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa män ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni dege kööthge dwøk piny ki lwär nyïma, ni ö ajäla marge ni put bëëtö bäätge na bäre bäre.
english: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u na jiya, u daa caamø ki beel ma liil, ni wëëga uuni jäŋö ki maar kïc man wø käl yi kïdi.»
english: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

anywaa: Jwøk aöö ni pï piny dï acooŋa mare, ni ŋøl luup yïthakic dïŋut luup, ni kööe,
english: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

anywaa: na «?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo ŋudu ki ŋøl mo patha kare, nou bëëdö nou jëënyö nou ena kur jøøa reyø?
english: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋunnu jøøa jïge bäŋ teek ki moa näk kïïe, ni tïïyu mana beer jï jøøa no ocaannø ki moa näk bäŋ jammi jïge.
english: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

anywaa: Kønynyu jøøa jïge bäŋ teek ki moa can, ni piemmu geni ceŋ jøøa reyø.»
english: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

anywaa: Bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge ni tier luubö ba kwanyge, ni ge bëëdö ni ge cäädha yi muudhö jaak; ni tïm pinynyi ni raac.
english: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

anywaa: Jwøk aköö, ni «U bëët uuna wääta, a na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni uuni thuwø, uuna juu.
english: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

anywaa: 'Ba u thøw kaawat man wø thøw jiyi, ni thøwu kaawat man wø thøw kwääri.»
english: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ö maal ni ŋølï luup piny, kiper wïth juurre bëët beege moï.
english: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, kärï lïŋö këët, ni ba bëëdï ni ïïno nidut; wui Jwøk, kärï bëëdö jaak!
english: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

anywaa: Kiper ennø, nyïïmännï atïïö ko okiera, ni tïŋge wïthge maal.
english: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

anywaa: Ki køør riek waŋ marge, ge cädö ki jöö man raanyge jiyï ki gø, ni tutge ki luup kiper jiyï moa näk iï gwøø.
english: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Ööu nee poge raanynyø, nee bäŋe nyeŋ Icriel mo di cwølø këët.»
english: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

anywaa: Kiper dhøkge adwalge na aciel bëët, ni tutge ki luubö kiperï;
english: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

anywaa: ni jøøgø beege jø Ëdöm ki jø Icmiel, ki jø Möap ki jø Agri,
english: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarites;

anywaa: ki jø Gëbal ki jø Amön ki jø Amalëk, ki jø Pilitin ki jø wø bëëdö Tayar;
english: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

anywaa: këël jø Aciria thuwø adwätö ki geni, ni tïmge na køny mo dwøŋ jï nyïïkwaac Løøt.
english: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

anywaa: Ennø, tïïc teeŋ gïna tïïyï dëët jø Midien dëëtge, ni tïïyï gø kaawat mana tïïyï dëër Cicara ki Jabin bäät naam Kicön,
english: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kishon:

anywaa: jøøa raanynyi Endör, na tïmö kaamar wëëyö mo oker piny.
english: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

anywaa: Tïïc kwääri moge ni caala Orëëp ki Dhëëp, ni tïïyï nyeye moge ni caala Jeeba ki Jalmuuna,
english: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

anywaa: jøøa köö, ni «Kälø ŋöömma näk mar Jwøk, nee tïme na marø.»
english: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, tïïc geni kaamar tør mo käära apwøyaweerø, ni tïïyï geni kaamar lethø mo kwør jame kwørø.
english: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

anywaa: Thöör geni kaawat man wø ö maaci wø thöör paap, kaawat man wø ö maaci wø waaŋ bäät kïte.
english: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

anywaa: Riem geni ka atuunna marï mano jääŋŋï bäätge, ni døøyï geni mo lwäär ki jamø marï na teek.
english: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, lää wïthge, kiper niï cacge.
english: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man lää wïthge ni lwäcge na bäre bäre, ni dwøk wïthge piny ni ränyge.
english: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

anywaa: Beerra man ŋäcge gø ni beeye ï keerï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, na näk Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal bäät piny bäre.
english: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, yia met ki kar bëëtö marï!
english: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

anywaa: Cwïnya lääŋŋa gø døc ki man cøøa yi kal marï, naa kwöŋŋö ki met ec ki cwïnya bäre jïrï, ï na Jwøa kwøw.
english: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, këël adiit thuwø jïtö ki kany gëët yie, ni ö agweeci ni gëën ree ki øtø mo nyööt yi gø mo kare cään ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte marï, ï na nyeya mara ni nägï Jwøk mara.
english: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï jø wø bëëdö ødï, ni ge bëëdö ni ge pwøya ïïni cooth.
english: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï jø wø joot teek marge baŋï, jø wø cwïnyge caar ciin bäät Kïn Dhayan.
english: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

anywaa: Kany wø pööth jøøgø ki yie ya agäm Baka na näk otal, kaace wø puta jïtö ki pïï, ni ö køthi ni put kaace mooc ka aguule.
english: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

anywaa: Ni ö teek marge ni cääth nyïme, këël mano joot geni nyïm Jwøk bäät Kïn Dhayan.
english: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, wïny lam mara, ni cegï ïthï ki mara, ï na Jwø Jeekap.
english: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, neen jï ŋat wø caal kwöt leny marwa, ŋata näk iï jierø na tïïyï nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw.
english: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

anywaa: Beerra eni jïra ki man bëëda dï kal marï ki dïcäŋ aciel, ni kaala man bëëda kany mør ki nïne ma kuma. Ni theemma man cuŋŋa dhi kal marï, ki man bëëda yïth uudi mo jøøa reyø.
english: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk caala tac cäŋ, ni caala kwöt leny jï jiye. Wuuö Jwøk cïpö ki met ec ka ajiem; bäŋ gïn mo beer mo mäne ki jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: For the Lord God is a sun and shield: the Lord will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, gwïëth en jï ŋat wø bëëdö ni ŋäätha ïïni.
english: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, met ec anyoothï yi ŋöömmï, ni dwøgï bëët jic Jeekap kare.
english: Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

anywaa: Gïïa bac jiyï awëënnï, ni buŋï raay moge.
english: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

anywaa: Wëër mana wëërï ki gø aweyï, ni kwierï wëër marï ni wø liel kaamar maac.
english: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï na pïëmi marwa, dwøk bëëtö marwa kare, ni weyï gootø marï ki waani.
english: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï puta bëëtö ni ïïno wëër ki waani na bäre bäre? ?A wëër marï, poot bëëdö na bäre bäre këël yïth beenhnhe bëët moo ööi?
english: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wa ba cäŋï mooyø ki kwøw, nee wa na jiyï, yïthwa mïnge ki ïïni?
english: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyooth mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl jïwa, ni piemï wa.
english: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

anywaa: Aani, ïtha ciia ciiø ki mano caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye luum bëët-mëër mano caane jï jiye, jøøa cwïnyge en køøre; 'ba beerra man ba døøge øtjöör bøøl.
english: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, eni jøøa lwäär ki eni pute ka piem, ni ö ajiemmi mare ni bëëde yi ŋöömö marø.
english: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

anywaa: Mëër man wø ba jøøl ki bëët adïëri rööpö na aciel, ni ö bëët bëënynyö ki bëët-mëër ni dwätge.
english: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

anywaa: Bëët adïëri tägö bäät piny, ni ö bëënynyö ni ööe ki maal ni ö piny.
english: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk gïïa beyø di cïbö, ni ö ŋöömö marø ni ciee ki caammi.
english: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

anywaa: Bëënynyö mare bwödhö nyïme, ni tïm køør tiete na jöö.
english: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï ki kwac mara ni løgï gø, kiper aano caannø naa bëëdö naa can.
english: Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

anywaa: Gwøk jwïëya, kiper cwïnya ena køørï. Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, køny dhaanhnhï ni wø ŋääth ïïni.
english: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bëëdï ni cwïnyï bäth ki aani, a ni wø kwac ïïni cooth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, døøc cwïny dhaanhnhï mo met, kiper a bëëdö na acaara mara bäre ena baŋï.
english: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna Jwøk mo beer, ni jiy wëënnï wëënnö; Mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl päl jï jø wø cøør nyeŋŋï.
english: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï ki lam mara, ni wïnynyï kwac man wø kwääa ki gø.
english: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

anywaa: Kany wø ena yïth gïï mo leth, bee ï wø cwøla, kiper bee ï wø løk mara.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ Jwøk mo caala ïïni røk juu, ni bäŋ tïïe mo caala tïïe moa tïïyï.
english: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïth juurre moa cwääyï bëët oööi, ni wøørge ïïni, ni jiemge nyeŋŋï.
english: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

anywaa: Kiper ï dwøŋ niï tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec, ni beeye ï na Jwøk keerï.
english: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwöny aani ki jöör bëëtö marï, naa cäädha ki køør adïëri marï. Mooc aani ki cwïny aciel naa bëëda naa lwäära ïïni.
english: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, ï pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni bëëda naa jiema nyeŋŋï na bäre bäre.
english: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

anywaa: Kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl na nyoothï jïra dwøŋ; jwïëya amänï ki mana dee ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, jø okiera aö maal bääta, ni ö jø kwöri ni cacge jwïëya nee raanyge, jøøa näk bäŋ gïn caarge kiperï.
english: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna Jwø wø yie bäth wø nyooth met ec mare jï jiy; ï ba laar wëër, ni mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri marï päl.
english: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

anywaa: Luu riï baŋa ni nyoothï met ec marï jïra; cïp teek marï jï dhaanhnhï ni piemï aani, a na o dhaaŋ wø tïny ïïni.
english: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

anywaa: Mooc a ki nyuudhi mo nyootha beenynyï, nee jøøa män ki aani nee wïthge lääge kanyo jootge gø naa iï kønyø, ni jïta ki cøm cwïny baŋï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pääny mare ageer bäät Kïn Dhayan na en kur keere.
english: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

anywaa: Eni mëër ki Jerucalem, na no ogeer bäät kïnnögø, ni kaala kwör bëëte mo wø bëët nyïïkwaac Jeekapi yïthge bëët.
english: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

anywaa: Wui, ï na pääny Jwøk, gïï mo duua ajiem di carø kiperï.
english: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ki røk wïth juurre moa ŋäc aani, Reeyap na näk Ijep ki Babiløn beege noo kwaana. Ni ö jø Pilitin ki jø Tayar ki jø Ithiöpia ni købi ni ge nywølla Jerucalem.»
english: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

anywaa: Luubö mano caan jiyi kiper Dhayan beeye ni ŋati en ki ŋatøce nywølla yie; ni ö Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal ki dëëre ni këël tier gø piny ni teek.
english: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

anywaa: Kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo göör nyeŋ wïth juurre piny, eni köö, ni «Jø paani nø ki jø paani nø nywølla Dhayan.»
english: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø wär ki dudi ki jø wø kudhö ko opele bëët ni köge, ni «Ï na pääny Jwøk, gïï wø manywa bëët jootwa baŋï.»
english: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wø piem aani, a bëëdö naa jwöŋö dëërï ki dïcäŋ ki wäär.
english: O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:

anywaa: Beerra man wïnynyï lam mara, ni cegï ïthï ko oduuru mara,
english: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

anywaa: kiper gïïa leth na nø jwøra atïmö ni thööth, ni tïm kar jwïëya ni cään ki ciin kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

anywaa: A caala dhaanhø mo okwaan dëët jøw mo okoony yi bwörö, ni tïma kaamar dhaanhø mo bäŋ teek jïre.
english: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

anywaa: Aana tïmö naa caala dhaanhø mo owii dï jøøa no othøw, ni tïma naa caala jøøa no onääö na no okoony yi bwörö, na näk ge ba lääŋŋï këët, jøøa näk ïïno pääö ki geni.
english: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

anywaa: A caala dhaanhø mo iï leeŋ yi buur mo bäär mo raac, kanya cøl tiet ŋøøm.
english: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

anywaa: Wëër marï atïmö ni dwøŋ bääta, ni ö athaŋ wëër marï ni muun aani.
english: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

anywaa: Jøøa näk waano ŋïyö ki geni karge atïïyï ni bäär ki aani, ni tïïyï aani na gïn mo yïthge raac ki gø. A caala dhaanhø mo otwöö, ni bäŋ gïn mo løny ki tïïc jïra.
english: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

anywaa: Aana cøør ki køør gïïa leth na pïï dëëra. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a cøøra ïïni ki yïth nïne bëët, ni ceŋŋa yaa thaaŋø jïrï.
english: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï poot tïïö këët ki gïï mo rëëma ec jï jøøa no othøw? ?A jwïëc jøøgø ööa maal ni pwøcge ïïni?
english: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl gïre di caanø yi bwörö? ?A gïr adïëri marï, di købø kar ränynyö?
english: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïïa näk mo rëëma ec ni wø tïïyï di ŋääö yi muudhö? ?A beer marï di ŋääö kar wïl wïc?
english: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a wø bëëdö naa jwöŋö dëërï kiper køny, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni lam mara wø pïï baŋï ka aruunnø cooth.
english: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aperŋø na kwierï aani, ni kanï täärnyïmï ki aani en?
english: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

anywaa: Ki mana täga thïnhö, a bëëdö ni aano caannø ni kara cään ki thøø. Aana ööl døc ki køør gïïa leth na näk duua lwär na jwøra cerï, ni puta ränynyö ki køørge.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

anywaa: Wëër marï aliel bääta kaamar maac, ni ö gïïa leth na näk duua lwär na kälï bääta ni raanyge aani.
english: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

anywaa: A ege ciel dïër cooth kaamar jwïïö, ni mwønyge aani na bäre bäre.
english: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëëra ki gø jaak ki ŋat ma nyawatwa karge atïïyï ni bäär ki aani, ni dööŋ muudhö keere ni beeye ŋata näk waano ŋïyö ki gø.
english: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö naa wär ki dudi na bäre bare kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, ni caana gïr adïëri marï ki dhaa nee ŋäc beenhnhe bëët.
english: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ni mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö adïëri marï ni bëëde na bäre bäre kaamar maal.
english: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna köö, ni «Aana tudö ki luubö ki ŋata näk yaa jierø, ni beeye dhaanhnha ma Deebit na kööŋa jïre.»
english: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

anywaa: Ni kööï jïre, ni «Tier nyec mar nyïïkwaayï këëlla piny na bäre bäre, ni bëët wälu marï ni nut këël yïth beenhnhe bëët.»
english: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïno pwøc maalli kiper gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïyï, ni pwøc ïïni ki køør adïëri marï ya acooŋa mar nyïïatwiet maal.
english: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni pääri ki Wuuö Jwøk maal, na aŋa ni teek ni röömi ki Wuuö Jwøk dï nyïïatwiet maal?
english: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?

anywaa: Jwøk di lwäärö ya acooŋ nyïïatwiet maal; eni di lwäärö døc ni kaala geni, ge na en buute bëët.
english: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, aŋa ni teek ni caal ïïni? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni marï adïëri cooth.
english: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

anywaa: Teek athaŋ naama dwøŋ ena cerï, ni kany wø kwöt athaga mare, joogï jooø, ni cuŋŋe.
english: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

anywaa: Ïïni, Reeyap ni beeye Ijep araanynyï, ni raanynyï kaamar gïn mo di nääö, ni keethï nyïïmän moï ki teek badï.
english: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

anywaa: Maal beeye marï, ni bëët pinynyi na marï thuwø; bäät piny bäre ki gïïa en yie bëët cwääya ïïni.
english: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

anywaa: Wï-piny ki tier-piny cwääya ïïni, ni ö Kïn Tabör ki Kïn Armön ni kwöŋge ki nyeŋŋï ni yïthge met.
english: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

anywaa: Badï bëëdö ni teek, ni teek badï dwøŋ døc.
english: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

anywaa: Bura marï cuŋŋa ri bëënynyö ki ŋøl ma kare, ni mëër man wø ba jøøl ka adïëri bwödhö nyïmï.
english: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gwïëth en jï jø wø ŋäc kwöŋŋö jïrï ki met ec, jø wø cäädhi ni tar marï ena bäätge!
english: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

anywaa: Ge bëëdö ni ge kanynyø cooth ki nyeŋŋï, ni tïm kwörge ni døøŋŋø ki køør beer marï.
english: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

anywaa: Kiper ajiem marge ki teek marge wø jootge baŋï, ni teek marge wø meeta ïïni ki køør met ec marï.
english: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

anywaa: Kiper nyeya marwa ni wø gwøk waani ena cerï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, dïcäŋ aciel ïïna cäänö ki yïth lääk jï nyïïkuk Jwøk moï moa näk cwïnyge ena køørï, ni kööï, ni «Ŋat leny mo teek mo yaa jierø dï jiy, akønya ni tïŋa gø maal;
english: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

anywaa: ni beeye dhaanhnha ma Deebit na manynya na jooda, na tïïa nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw mara na en kur keere.
english: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

anywaa: Teek mara obëëdö bääte, ni tëënne ki køør teek bada.
english: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

anywaa: Bäŋ nyimän mo cwöti ka ajwäk bääte, ni eni ba thiel jøøa reyø piny.
english: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

anywaa: Jø wø män ki eni dïïma dïïmö nyïme, ni puta ge raanynyø.
english: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

anywaa: Adïëri mara ki mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl oen bääte, ni jïte ki teek ki køør nyeŋŋa.
english: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

anywaa: Teek nyec mare tägö ki bäät naama dwøŋ, ni këët bäät Naam Upareeti.
english: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

anywaa: Aano cøøre ni kööe, ni ‹Ïïna wära, ni nägï Jwøk mara na teek ni wø piem aani.›
english: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

anywaa: Eno tïïa na lwiidhø, ni tïme na nyeya mana dwøŋŋa eni bäät piny.
english: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

anywaa: Mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl otïïa nee bëëde bääte na bäre bäre, ni ö luumma tuutwa ki gø ni bëëde ni ba cuŋ.
english: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

anywaa: Tier nyec mar nyïïkwaaye këëlla piny na bäre, ni ö wälu mare ni bëëde na bäre bäre kaamar maal.
english: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo jøw käl dëëre pwöc 'moa wecge wiiø, ni ba cääthge køør luup ŋøl 'moa,
english: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

anywaa: ni bacge ciik 'moa, ni ba gwøkge luup moa cema geni ki ge,
english: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

anywaa: aani, a ööa baŋge ka ajäla mo teek, ni jääla geni ki køør raay moa tïïcge, naa dwøga gïïa bacge wïthge.
english: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

anywaa: 'Ba mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl ba paanya bääte, ni ba wiia gïna kööŋa kipere.
english: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

anywaa: A ba gaa wøk ki ri luumma tuuda, ni ba wiila luubö mo yaa nø caan.
english: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

anywaa: Kiper aano nø kööŋ ri bëëtö mara na en kur keere, naa ba cäänö ki tööt jï Deebit.
english: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

anywaa: Nyec mar nyïïkwaaye bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö wälu mare ni bëëde nyïma na bäre bäre kaamar cäŋ,
english: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

anywaa: ni put bëëtö na bäre bäre kaamar dwääy na no oŋäädhö na nyuudhi maal.»
english: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ŋata jierï na tïïyï nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw aleeŋï wøk ni kwierï gø, ni tïm wëërri marï ni dwøŋ bääte.
english: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

anywaa: Luumma tuutï ki dhaanhnhï araanynyï, ni leeŋï aduda mare yi tør.
english: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

anywaa: Kiir mare bäre anyaaï piny, ni raanynyï kwör gwøk røk moe moa teek.
english: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø pöödhi ki jöö bëët ni twierge jammi moe, ni tïm wïth juurre moa en deŋŋe ni buua eni.
english: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

anywaa: Jø wø män ki eni awëëgï tëënnö, ni tïïyï nyïïmän moe bëët nee yïthge mïnge.
english: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

anywaa: Dho opëëllö mare adøøyï mo pööl, ni kärï eni wëëk cuŋŋö ri leny.
english: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

anywaa: Ajiem mare awëëgï ränynyö, ni leeŋï wälu mare yi tør.
english: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

anywaa: Ena laarï wëëk jalø jaak, ni døøyï wïïe mo laay døc.
english: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø? ?Aŋø, ï bëëdö ni riï iï kanø na bäre bäre? ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët wëërri marï ni liel kaamar maac?
english: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

anywaa: Caar wïïï kiper nïr kwøw 'moa moo beeda. ?Aŋø, jiy cwääyï jaak kaper gïn mo bäŋ tiere?
english: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo bëëdö ni kwøw cooth ni thøø ba joode? ?A da ŋat mo løny jïre ki man käl dëëre wøk cer teek thøø?
english: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, age mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl na nut cøøn, na kööŋï ki gø jï Deebit ki køør adïëri marï?
english: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, caar wïïï ka ajøøŋ mana pïï bääta, a na dhaanhnhï, ki jwør mana jwøra ajøøŋ bäre mar wïth juurre ki yi cwïnya,
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

anywaa: ni beeye ajøøŋ mana ö nyïïmänni moï na jööŋge ki gø, ni ge jøøŋŋa ŋata jierï na tïïyï nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw, ni eni jøøŋge kwör wø cäädhe yïthge bëët.
english: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre. Kare møn, enøgønø.
english: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö na kar bëëtö marwa cøøn ki yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

anywaa: Kanya poode ni kïte poot kärï cwääö, ni piny thuwø ki gïïa en yie poot kärï tïïö, ï nut cøøn ni ïïna Jwøk, ni bëëdï ni ïïna Jwøk na bäre bäre.
english: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

anywaa: Jiy wø dwøgï yi ŋöömö, kany wø kööï, ni «Uuni na wäät jiy, døøu yi ŋöömö.»
english: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.

anywaa: Kiper ki baŋï, cwiiri ma kuma laara pöödhö kaamar dïcäŋa wääre na pöödhö, ni caala yïth caae mo nøk mo wø koor dhaanhe ki wäär.
english: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

anywaa: Jiy wø laarï ka käl, ni thøwge, ni ge caala luum ni wø tuy ni ba ruu.
english: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

anywaa: Luum këël doo tuy ni ŋøøe ni mïërö, laara närö ni tale.
english: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

anywaa: Kiper waana thum ki thøø ki køør wëër marï, ni ö wëërri marï ni känne ki lwär mo päl bäätwa.
english: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

anywaa: Gïïa bacwa apeedhï nyïmï, ni ö moa tïïcwa ni kuc jiyi ni joodi ki yi tar marï.
english: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

anywaa: Kiper nïr kwøw mowa bëët pöödhö ni wëër marï poot ena bäätwa, ni laar cwiiri mowa thumö kaamar jamø man wø kuuth wøk ki dhøk.
english: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

anywaa: Kanymør cwiic kwøw mowa jïtö ki pïërabïriiø, 'ba ni näk dëël poot teek, kanymør pïï ri pïërabära, 'ba gïï wø joot dhaanhe ni wø tööde kiperge yïth cwiiyøgø yøø, duua öölö ki bëëtö mo leth jaak, kiper cwiiri mowa laara pöödhö, ni ö jwïëcwa ni rwäänyge.
english: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni ŋäc teek wëër marï, ni lwäär ïïni ka teeŋ mana di wëërri marï lwäärö?
english: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.

anywaa: Pwöny waani nee nïr kwøw mowa kwaanwa, nee wa jïtwa ki leec wïc.
english: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdï niï wëër ki waani? Dwøk cwïnyï piny ni päth cwïnyï ki gïrwa, wa na laaŋe moï.
english: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

anywaa: Kany wø päcwa ka amöölla, wëëk wa jäŋö ki mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, kiper nee yïthwa mïnge ni kanywa ki yïth nïr kwøw moo beetwa bëët.
english: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

anywaa: Tïïc yïthwa ni met ki nïne mo thööth mo röömi ki nïne moa mooyï wa ki rääm yïthge, ni wëëgï yïthwa mïnnö ki cwiiri mo thööth mo röömi ki cwiiri moa jootwa gïïa leth yïthge.
english: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

anywaa: Beerra man nyoothï tïïe moï jïwa, wa na laaŋe moï, ni nyoothï ajiemï jï obwöre mowa.
english: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man ö met yiï ni bëëde bäätwa, ni wëëgï gïï wø tïïcwa ki ceŋwa thur karge jïwa. Adïëri møn, jap wø tïïcwa ki ceŋwa, tïïyï nee thurge karge.
english: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kan ree buut Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal obëëdö tïm Wuuö Jwøk na en teeki jïre.
english: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

anywaa: A wø cäänö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööa, ni «Bee ï ni wø kana raa buutï, ni bee ï na kar gwøk røk kipera, ni bee ï na Jwøa ni wø ŋäädha.»
english: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na dhaanh Jwøk, beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni wø käl ïïni wøk ki ya abïëp mo ocek ŋat mørri, ni køny ïïni yi teeŋ täw mo leth mo kännö ki thøø.
english: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

anywaa: Ïïno gwøe tiet bwöpe, ni tïmge na kar kan røk jïrï, ni ö adïëri mare ni tïme ni caala kwöt leny mo gëëŋa ïïni.
english: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

anywaa: Ïïno tïmö niï ba lwäär ki gïï mo di lwäärö ki ge ki wäär, këël tøŋ miï di thöörö ki gø ki dïcäŋ.
english: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

anywaa: Niï ba lwäär ki täw mo tägö dëët jiy ki wäär, këël täw mo leth mo nyaga paac bäre ki dïcäŋ, ï ba lwäyi ki gø.
english: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

anywaa: Këël jiy ma kuma doo thøw buutï, ni ö kume apaar ni thøøge bäät cwïïï, bäŋ gïn mo guta ïïni na bäre.
english: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

anywaa: Ïïno rääŋö ki waŋï jaak, ni jootï gïno tïïc dëët jøøa reyø.
english: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, na näk kar kan røk jïra, kiper mana bëëde ni iï nø tïïc na kar bëëtö jïrï,
english: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

anywaa: bäŋ gïn mo raac mo pïï bäätï, ni bäŋe gïn mo leth mo ö paarï.
english: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïatwiet maal moe oköömme kiperï, nee ï koorge ki uutjïëthe mo wø caathï bëët.
english: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

anywaa: Ïïno jølge maal ki ceŋge, kiper nee tierï ba cwaanyï ri kïdi.
english: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

anywaa: Ïïno cäädhi ni ethï bäät ŋuu ni nyøønï olwierø, këël ŋuu mo dwøŋ wala onyaaŋ onyørï ki tietï jaak.
english: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Teeŋ ŋatøgø, kiper mana mëëre ki aani, eno käla wøk yi gïna raac, ni gwøa eni kiper mana ŋäc aani.
english: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

anywaa: Ni kany wø kwac aani, mare løøa løø jïre, ni bëëda ki eni kany wø näk da gïï mo leth. Eni kønya kønyø ni jiema gøøni.
english: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

anywaa: Eni wëëga bëëtö ki cwiiri mo thööth ni mïn yie, ni nyoodha køny mara jïre.»
english: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye gïn mo beer ki man pwøc ïïni, ni beeye gïn mo beer thuwø ki man pwøc nyeŋŋï ki dudi, ï na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal,
english: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

anywaa: ni caan gïr mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka amöölla cooth, ni køp gïr adïëri marï ki wäär,
english: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

anywaa: ni wär na duut mo pwöt ka thøp-othïënhö, ki thøme moa näk thøøthge opaarri na näk döötge met.
english: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

anywaa: Kiper ï na Wuuö Jwøk, yia adøøyï mo met ki køør tïïe moï, ni wära ki dudi ni yia met kiper tïïe moa tïïyï ki cerï.
english: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, tïïe moï døøŋŋø, na acaare moï døøŋŋø døc!
english: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn mo tiere ba kwany ŋat mo bäŋ wïc, mo tiere ba joot bøølli, beeye en:
english: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø, këël ge doo løth kaamar luum ni kwärge, ge poot ränynyö na bäre bäre;
english: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

anywaa: 'ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï puta bëëtö ni karï dwøŋ na bäre bäre.
english: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, nyïïmännï ränynyö; nyïïmännï ränynyö na bäre bäre, ni ö jø wø tïïö ki raay bëët ni keethge.
english: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aana mooyï ki teek mo caala teek jööbi; aana wïïrï ki maaw mo nyään.
english: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

anywaa: Räny nyïïmänna ajooda ki waŋa, ni wïnynya gïr pädhö mar jøøa reyø na ö maal bääta.
english: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

anywaa: Jøøa beyø løth kaamar twöö, ni tïmge ni døøŋŋø kaamar jaath mana dwøŋ na en yi lur Libaanø.
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

anywaa: Ge wø piith yi kar Wuuö Jwøk, ni løthge dï kal mare, eni na Jwøk marø.
english: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

anywaa: Jøøgø, këël cwiiri moge doo tïmö ni thööth, ge poot bëëdö ni ge kännö ki nyïëdi, ni bëëtge ni ge løth cooth ni ge ba tal;
english: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

anywaa: gïïögø nyootha gø ni Wuuö Jwøk mare thïïŋ. Bee eni na teek mara, ni bäŋ gïn lääŋ ri bëëtö mare na bäre bäre.
english: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya, na ajiem ee røø dëëre kaamar abïï, ni teek mo dwøŋ ena cere. Adïëri møn, piny acïp kare ni teek ni ba dak.
english: The Lord reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wälu marï ocïp kare ni teek ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe cøøn, niï nut dïkwøŋ cøøn.
english: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, athage mo näpa døøŋŋø atïmö ni päl,  ni lwörge ni döötge ena maal.
english: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
