anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ni en maal teeka eni, teeka eni ki näpa døøŋŋø moø ni lwör yøø, ni teek mare kaala teek athage moge.
english: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ciik moï bëëdö karge ni ba dak, ni bëëtö mana en kur keere rømi ka ødï na bäre bäre.
english: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwø wø cool kwöri, ï na Jwø wø cool kwöri, rienyï.
english: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

anywaa: Ö maal, ï ni wø ŋøl luup mo bäät piny; ni cunnï jø atöör ki moo rømø ki gïïa bacge.
english: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët jøøa reyø ni yïthge met jaak?
english: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

anywaa: Geni luumge päl, ni ge cara luup atöör, ni bëëtge ni ge jeemma dëëtge keerge, ge na jø raay bëët.
english: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jiyï athielge piny, ni caange geni, ge na näk thöögï.
english: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

anywaa: Määr thuunhnhi ki jøøa path wø 'näkge nääö; këël kïïe thuwø 'näkge nääö.
english: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

anywaa: Ni ge wø köö, ni «Gïn ba nëëni jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ gïn mo caare kipere, eni na Jwø Jeekap.»
english: Yet they say, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.

anywaa: U ni bäŋ wïdhi en, beerra man wïnynyu gø. ?Aŋø, tiet luup okwanynyu gø wäne, u na bøøre en?
english: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, eni na cïp ïdhi, eni ba wïnyö? ?A eni na cwääc nyeŋ, eni ba nëënö?
english: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

anywaa: ?A eni ni wø kööm wïth juurre, u ba jooe? Bee eni ni wø pwöny jiy nee jïtge ki leec wïc.
english: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk acaac dhaanhø ŋääe, ni ŋääe na acaac dhaanhø caala jam dhøk jaak.
english: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gwïëth en jï ŋat wø köömmï, ni wø pwönynyï ki ciik moï,
english: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

anywaa: niï cïba cwïnye piny yïth gïïa leth, këël kanyo koony buur ni ceka jøøa reyø.
english: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk jiye ba wiie; ni ba wete, ge na näk thööge.
english: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

anywaa: Kiper luum ŋøl ocäŋ tïmö ni thïïŋ, ni ö jøøa cwïnyge thïïŋ bëët ni jïëcge gø.
english: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo ö maal noo cwak aani ki jøøa reyø? ?Na aŋa noo cuŋŋi løøa noo gëëŋ aani ki jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø?
english: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

anywaa: Doo na Wuuö Jwøk kär bëëdö na dïkunyi mara, jwïëya doo laar tïmö ni ena kany mo bäŋ dwøl yie.
english: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kanya cäda naa manynya pädhö, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl aana jøle.
english: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

anywaa: Kany wø tïm acaare 'moa ni thöönhnhö cwïnya, cwïnya wø døøyï mo met ki køør man wø cømï cwïnya.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï dïŋut luup moa reyø ki man dwätge ki ïïni, jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki køør ciik mo wø kälge wøk?
english: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

anywaa: Geni dhøkge wø dwalge dwalø bäät ŋat mo mare beer, ni ŋølge thøø bäät ŋat mo bäŋ gïn mo ee baaø.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na kar gwøk røk mara, ni bee eni na Jwøk mara na teek ni wø kana raa buute.
english: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

anywaa: Eni gïïa bacge odwøk wïthge, ni raany geni kiper gïïa reyø na tïïcge; Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ge di raanynyø.
english: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.

anywaa: Ööu nøø wärø ki dudi jï Wuuö Jwøk ni yïthø met, ni kwöŋŋø ni yïthø met jïre, eni na teek ni wø piem øøni.
english: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

anywaa: Beerra man cøø nyïme ni ø pwøya eni, ni wärø dut pwøc jïre ni döötø ena maal.
english: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk mana dwøŋ, ni ena nyeya mana dwøŋ mo kaala juu bëët.
english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

anywaa: Ki mana täge ki tiet ŋøøm kuya, këël mana këët wïth kïte, ena cere.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

anywaa: Naama dwøŋ beeye mare, kiper bee eni na cwääc gø, ni kwöra no otal tïïya eni ki cere.
english: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

anywaa: Ööu ni kuullø wïthø piny ni wøørø eni, ni këëlø cøŋŋø piny nyïme, eni na Wuuö Jwøk na cwääc øøni.
english: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

anywaa: Kiper bee eni na Jwøk marø, ni øøna jiye ni wø kwaaye kaamar pïïth dïëk moe; øøna dïëk moe møn, ni ø ena cere. Dïcäŋi, beerra man wïnynyu dwøre mana caane na kööe,
english: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

anywaa: ni «Kär cwïnynyu døøyu mo teek kaawat mana tïïc kwäyu Meriba, ni beeye gïna tïïcge dïcäŋöca Maca dï paap,
english: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

anywaa: kanya ö kwäyu na päänyge aani. Aana päänyge, këël na bëëtge ni tïïe 'moa ege joodø.
english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni cwïnya oränynyö ki beenhnhøce ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, ni kööa, ni ‹Gena jiy mo cwïnyge bëënna bääö jaak, ni jöör bëëtö mara poot ba kwanyge.›
english: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aana kööŋ kanya wëëra, ni kööa, ni ‹Jwöm mana daa cïbö jïge ba jootge na bäre bäre.› »
english: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk ki duut mo nyään; wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk, u na jø bäät piny bëët.
english: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu eni, ni caannu luumma met mar køny mare ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

anywaa: Køpu ajieme jï wïth juurre bëët, ni køpu tïïe moe moa näk rëëma ec jï jiy bëët.
english: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ, no orømø ki pwøc døc, eni di lwäärö ni kaala juu bëët.
english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

anywaa: Kiper juu bëët mo wïth juurre beege juu mo oballe jaak, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk bee eni na cwääc maal.
english: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

anywaa: Wödö ka ajiem joota baŋe; ni ö teeki mare ki beenynye ni joodi øt lam mare.
english: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, u na wïth tuŋi bëët mo bäät piny bäre; jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ki køør ajiem mare ki teek mare.
english: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk ka ajiem mo orømø ki nyeŋŋe; kännu ki muuce, ni ööu dï kal mar øt lam mare.
english: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

anywaa: U jø bäät piny bëët, wøørru Wuuö Jwøk kiper eni ena kur keere, ni ööu nyïme ni dëëtu kwanynyi.
english: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

anywaa: Caannu jï wïth juurre bëët, ni kööu, ni «Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na wïth jammi bëët. Piny acïp kare ni teek, ni ba løny ki daak. Wuuö Jwøk luup mo jiy bëët di ŋølø ni tiir.»
english: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

anywaa: Beerra man mïn yïth gïïa en maalli, ni ö gïïa en bäät pinynyi ni kanyge; beerra man lwör naama dwøŋŋi ni kanynye, ki gïïa en yie bëët.
english: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

anywaa: Beerra man ö pwöthi ni kanyge, ki gïïa en yïthge bëët. 'Ba kar kaace thuwø, jer paap bëët yïthge omïnni ni wärge ki dudi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

anywaa: kiper eni cäädha jöö, ni ööa kuna ŋøl luup mo piny. Eni luup jø piny di ŋølø na kare, ni ŋøl mo jiy bëët ki køør adïëri mare.
english: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya; beerra man ö jø pinynyi ni mïn yïthge, ni ö mïëri moa en kwöra bäyö ni kanyge.
english: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

anywaa: Pøøl ki muudhö mo cøl ena cielge dïër; bura mare cuŋŋa ri bëënynyö ki ŋøl ma kare.
english: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

anywaa: Maac mo liel bwödhö nyïme, ni thöör nyïïmän moe kwöra enge yïthge bëët.
english: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

anywaa: Malø mare piny di meenyø bäre, ni ö pinynyi ni tïme ni kwanynyi.
english: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

anywaa: Kïte leeny kaamar gaga nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wää pinynyi bäre.
english: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

anywaa: Gïr beenynye caan maalli caanø, ni ö ajieme ni neeni wïth juurre bëët.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

anywaa: Jøw bëët mo wø wøør gïï lam moa näk otieŋø, wïthge olääi, ni beege jø wø töödö kiper juu mo oballe; 'ba nyïïatwiet maal bëët, ge wø bëëdö ni ge wøøra eni.
english: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïr ŋøl marï awïny jø Dhayan ni mïn yïthge, ni ö mïëc Juuda ni kanyge.
english: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.

anywaa: Kiper beeye ïïni na Wuuö Jwøk na karï dwøŋ bäät piny bäre, ni karï dwøŋ døc niï kaala juu bëët.
english: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

anywaa: Uuni ni wø mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk, männu ki gïï mo reyø; eni jø wø cwïnyge en køøre jwïëcge di gwøø, ni piem geni ceŋ jøøa reyø.
english: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

anywaa: Tar di meenyø jöör jøøa beyø, ni mooc jø wø cwïnyge thïïŋ ki met ec.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

anywaa: U na maru beer, bëëdu ni yïthu met ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋe na en kur keere.
english: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk ki duut mo nyään, kiper ena tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec; ki køør teek bade na en kur keere, ena käädhö.
english: O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pïëm mare man wø piem jiy ki gø anyoodhe nee ŋäc, ni nyooth bëënynyö mare jï wïth juurre.
english: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

anywaa: Wïïe kär wïl ki man nyooth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri mare jï jø dhi øt Icriel; ni ö pinynyi bäre ni joot pïëm mar Jwøk marø.
english: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

anywaa: U na jø bäät piny bëët, kwöŋŋu jï Wuuö Jwøk ki met ec; putu dut pwøc jøl døc ni wärru ni yïthu met.
english: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

anywaa: Wärru ki dut pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk nou pöödö ki thøme, ni wärru ni pwötu ni you jiiŋŋø ni met.
english: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

anywaa: Kwöŋŋu ki met ec nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, eni na nyeya, ni koothu dipiire ki tuk lääy.
english: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.

anywaa: Beerra man lwör naama dwøŋŋi ni kanynye, ki gïïa en yie bëët, këël piny ki jø wø bëëdö yie bëët.
english: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

anywaa: Beerra man ö nämmi ni mïn yïthge, ni ö kïte ni wärge na aciel ki dut met ec nyïm Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

anywaa: kiper eni cäädhö jöö ni ööa kuna ŋøl luup mo piny. Eni luup jø piny di ŋølø na kare, ni ŋøl luup jiy ni tiir.
english: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na nyeya; beerra man tïm jiyi bëët ni dëëtge kwanynyi. Eni ajiem nyec mare wø nyoodhe nyoodhø ki yïthakic nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli; beerra man ö pinynyi ni tïme ni jäŋŋi.
english: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kare dwøŋ Dhayan, ni dwøŋŋa kare bäät wïth juurre bëët.
english: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

anywaa: Beerra man pwøcge nyeŋŋe na dwøŋ ni wø lwäärö ki gø; bee eni na en kur keere.
english: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na nyenynya teek, ï mëër ki ŋøl luup ma kare; ŋøl luup mo thïïŋ atïïyï nee bëëde ni nut, ni nyoothï adïëri ki ŋøl luup ma kare po nyïïkwaac Jeekap.
english: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

anywaa: Tïŋu nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk maal, eni na Jwøk marø, ni wøørru eni kanya näk køøm tiete; bee eni na en kur keere.
english: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

anywaa: Modhe ka Aran, këël Camiel thuwø, ge ena dëët dïlämme moe, ni ö geni ni cøørge nyeŋŋe. 'Ba kanya cøørge nyeŋŋe, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, eni marge aløøe jïge.
english: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he answered them.

anywaa: Ena cäänö ki geni ni eni ena yi pöölö mo ree ee wenyø; gïïa ceme jïge agwøkge, këël ciik moa cïbe jïge.
english: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk marwa, marge aløgï jïge, ni bëëdï ni ïïna Jwøk miï wëënna geni, 'ba gïïa bacge adwøgï wïthge.
english: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

anywaa: Tïŋu nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk maal, eni na Jwøk marø, ni wøørru eni bäät kïnne na en kur keere,  kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ena kur keere.
english: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

anywaa: U ni en bäät piny bäre, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk ni döötu ena maal ni mïn yïthu.
english: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.

anywaa: Tïnynyu Wuuö Jwøk ni yïthu met, ni ööu nyïme nou wär ki dudi ni döötu ena maal.
english: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

anywaa: Wär ŋäyu ni Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre beeye Jwøk. Bee eni na cwääc øøni, ni øøna moe; øøna thööge, ni ø caala pïïth dïëk moe ni wø kwaaye.
english: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

anywaa: Dønyu ki dhi kal mar øt lam mare nou dwøga met ec jïre, ni pwøyu eni dï kal mare. Dwøgu met ec jïre, ni pwøyu eni.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre, na adïëri mare nut cooth ki yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï pwøa pwøø ki duut, naa wär kiper mëër mo ba jøøl ki ŋøl luup ma kare.
english: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.

anywaa: Aani, a poot bëëdö ni cwïnya ena jöör adïëri. ?A yi wäne nø noo ööï baŋa? A poot bëëdö ni bëëtö mara thïïŋ ki jø paara.
english: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

anywaa: A ba jïëy ki gïn mo raac, naa män ki tïï jø wø gaa wøk, ni tïïe moge a ba gutge.
english: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

anywaa: Bëëtö mo ba tiir kwiera kwierø, ni bëëda ni kara bäär ki raay.
english: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

anywaa: Ŋat wø waac nyeŋ watge ki piny raanynya raanynyø, naa ba jïëy ki ŋat mo cwïnye da atöör mo jiy ee taaø ki waŋe.
english: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa jïëya jøøa näk marge adïëri dï paac, kiper nee ge bëëtge ki aani. Eni ni wø cäädhi ki jöö mo thïïŋ otïmö na ŋat mo tïnynya aani.
english: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

anywaa: Ŋat wø tïïö ki tïï cwøk ba bëëdö paara, ni ŋat wø car tööt ba bëëdö buuta.
english: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

anywaa: Ka amöölla cooth jøøa reyø moa en dï paac wø raanynya raanynyø, kiper nee jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø bëët käla wøk dï pääny Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny lam mara; beerra man pïïc kwaci mara baŋï.
english: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.

anywaa: Kär täärnyïmï kanï ki aani kany wø ena yïth gïï mo leth. Cek ïthï ki mara, ni laarï mara løk kany wø cwøla ïïni.
english: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

anywaa: Kiper nïr kwøw 'moa wø laara maayø kaamar jïrö, ni tïm dëëra bäre ni waŋŋi.
english: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

anywaa: Bääta apädhö ni tïma naa caala luum mo obäp, ni gïr cam ba lääŋŋa.
english: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

anywaa: Ki køør cooyø mara na päl, aana dwat ni tïma na cöö keere.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

anywaa: Aana tïmö kaamar wenyø mo onoorø dï paap, ni tïma naa caala tula mo bëëdö wï paac.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa juudö, naa caala wenyø mo bëëdö ee keere wï øtø.
english: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

anywaa: Nyïïmänna bëëdö ni jøøŋŋa aani cooth ki yïth nïne bëët, ni ö jø wø päät aani ni tïïcge nyeŋŋa na gïr acïëni. 9-10
english: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

anywaa: Ki køør wëëyï na pällö bääta, aana kwanyï ni wetï aani wøk, ni tïma naa cama bur, ni ö pï nyeŋŋa ni bëëde ni øøya yi gïn wø maadha.
Nïr kwøw 'moa aløny ni maayø kaamar tïm abøøya, ni tïma kaamar luum mo obäp.
english: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö na nyeya na bäre bäre, ni bëët nyeŋŋï ni ŋäc këël yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

anywaa: Ïïno ö maal ni päth cwïnyï ki gïr Dhayan, kiper ennø beeye kany mo orømø ki man nyoothï met iï jïre, kiper kanya wäŋŋi apäŋ.
english: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, jiyï poot mëër ki Dhayan, pääny mana no oränynyö, ni cwïnyge opädhö ki gïr ŋøøm moa dööŋ wï paac manøgø.
english: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

anywaa: Wïth juurre bëët otïmö ni lwäär ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö nyec bäät piny bëët ni lwäcge ka ajiem mare.
english: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan cäŋe ka geerrø, ni ööe ka ajiem mare.
english: When the Lord shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

anywaa: Eni lam mar jøøa can di wïnynyö, ni kwac marge ba taae.
english: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

anywaa: Beerra man göör luummi piny kiper beenhnhe moo ööi, kiper nee geni na näk poot kär nywølø nee Wuuö Jwøk pwøcge;
english: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.

anywaa: ni luummeca beeye en: Wuuö Jwøk alwïthö piny ni eni ena maal kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni raŋ bäät piny ni eni ena maal,
english: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

anywaa: kiper nee cooyø mar jø twöc wïnynye, nee jøøa näk thøø onø ŋøl bäätge päde.
english: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk okøp jiyi Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni ö pwøci mare ni caani yie,
english: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

anywaa: kanyo ö tiet mïëri ki wïth juurre noo cooŋge rege na aciel ni ge wøøra Wuuö Jwøk.
english: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, Wuuö Jwøk aana tïïe naa jääk naa poot thiinh, ni døøc nïr kwøw 'moa mo nøk.
english: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, ni «Wui, ï na Jwøk mara, kär jwïëya laar käl ni cwiiya poot nøk; ïïni, ï bëëdö niï kwøw ki yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ cøøn piny acwääyï, ni tïïyï maal ki cerï.
english: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët ränynyö, 'ba ïïni, ï dööŋ karï. Ge ränynyö bëët kaamar abïï, ni wiilï geni kaawat man wø wiil abïï dëël, ni wet ge.
english: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï poot bëëdö na karï karï, ni cwiiri moï ba thum.
english: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

anywaa: Wäät jiyï obëëdö ni kwøw, ni ö nyïïkwaacge ni këët tietge piny nyïmï.»
english: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

anywaa: Aani Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni pwøa eni na en kur keere ni dëëra yaa cïbö jïre bäre.
english: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni ba wïl wïïa ki tïïe moe bëët na beyø.
english: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

anywaa: Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni wø wec gïïa baaa bëët, ni wø køny täwe moa en dëëra bëët.
english: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø käl aani wøk cer thøø, ni wø nyooth bäth ec ki mëër mo ba jøøl jïra.
english: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø tïïc aani nee gïï mo beyø tïmge ni dagø jïra ki yïth nïr kwøw 'moa bëët, ni tïïc teek mara ni nyään ni tïma naa teek kaamar odhuuth.
english: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wø tïïya tïïc ma adïëri, ni ŋun jøøa näk othiel piny bëët.
english: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

anywaa: Acaare moe anyoodhe jï Modhe, ni nyooth tïïe moe jï jø Icriel.
english: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie bäth ni mëër ki jiy; eni ba laar wëër, ni mëër mare päl ni ba jøøl.
english: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

anywaa: Eni ba bëëdö ni jääla øøni cooth, ni wëër mare thuwø ba bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

anywaa: Eni kär kännö bäätø ka ajäla mo orømø ki raay moø, ni käre øøni cunnö ki gïn mo orømø kiper moa baaø.
english: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

anywaa: Kaawat man bëët maalli ki piny ni dwøŋ en, Wuuö Jwøk mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl dwøŋ døc bäät jø wø lwäär ki eni.
english: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

anywaa: Ka teeŋ man bëëde en ni yïthakic kur tuul-cäŋ ki kur pänh-cäŋ bäär, Wuuö Jwøk gïïa baaø akäl wøk ni tïïc karge ni bäyö ki øøni.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

anywaa: Ka teeŋ man wø bëët wää obwöre ni yie ee bäädhö ko obwöre moe, Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni yie ee bäädhö ki jø wø lwäär ki eni.
english: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.

anywaa: Kiper eni cwääc marø ŋääe, ni wïïe wø di caarø ki man näk mo øøna tør jaak.
english: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

anywaa: Nïr kwøw mo dhaanhø caala nïr luum; dëër dhaanhø wø døøŋŋø ni mïërö kaamar luum mo oløth yi pwöla.
english: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

anywaa: 'Ba luum, kany wø kwön jame bääte, puta ränynyö, ni put kare rwäänyö na bäre bäre.
english: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre bäät jø wø lwäär ki eni, ni ö adïëri mare ni bëëde ni nut bäät nyïïkwaacge,
english: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;

anywaa: ni beege jø wø gwøk gïna tuude ki geni, ni wïthge ba wïl ki man kïthge gïïa ceme bäät tïïc.
english: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk tier wäl nyec mare ee nø këël piny maalø, ni eni bëëdö na wïth jammi bëët.
english: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, u na nyïïatwiet maal moe, uuni na teek ni wø kïth luumme bäät tïïc, ni wø wïny dwøre man wø caane.
english: Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, u na lwaae moe bëët ni en maal, uuni ni wø tïny eni nou tïïya mo wø manynye.
english: Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

anywaa: Beerra man ö gïïa cwääc Wuuö Jwøki bëët ni pwøcge eni kwöra enge yïthge bëët, ni beeye bäät piny bäre na en cere.  'Ba aani, Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre.
english: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.

anywaa: Aani Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, karï dwøŋ døc; wödö ka ajiem na en jïrï iï røø dëërï kaamar abïï.
english: Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

anywaa: Tar iï rïëp dëërï kaamar aleeŋŋa, ni maal iï peerø kaamar oduŋkaara.
english: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk paare ee geer maal, ni tïïc pøøl na jääy mare, ni cäädhi ka bäät jamø.
english: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

anywaa: eni jamø wø di jääŋŋö na nyïïatwiel mare, ni tïïc agaackøth na gïr tïïc mare.
english: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

anywaa: Piny acwääe ni këël tiet gø piny ni teek, nee bëëde na bäre bäre ni ba nëëŋŋi.
english: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, naama dwøŋ apeedhï bäät piny kaamar abïï, ni ö pïïyi ni macge wïth kïte.
english: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

anywaa: Kanya joogï geni, gena døøk, ni putge mølø kanya määr dwørï.
english: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

anywaa: Wïth kïte anyänh maal, ni dööŋ agäm-kïte piny, ni dööŋ pïïyi kwöra näk iï jiiŋŋø kiperge.
english: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

anywaa: Ïïna tïïö ki kee mo ba løny ki man kaali ya nämmi, nee piny ba cäŋge mayø këët.
english: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pï jøøro wø wëëge kwödö ki yïth agäm-kïte, ni muulge ki yïthakic kïte.
english: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

anywaa: Ni ö lääyi bëët ni jïtge ki pïï mo maathge, ni jït ogwari ki pïï mo riemma riew marge.
english: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

anywaa: Wec maal wø bëëdö bäät pïïögø, ni bëëtge ni ge lweelli bäät jenni.
english: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk køth wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö bäät kïte ni eni ena maalø, ni ö gïïa en bäät piny ni jäŋge ki cam ki køør man wø tïïe.
english: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk luum wø wëëge twöö kiper lääy, ni gïï wø duunni ki cam wø wëëge twöö jï dhaanhø, nee dhaanhø jïte ki cam ri gïï wø ciek yïth ŋøøm;
english: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

anywaa: ni jïte ki køøŋø mo døøya yie mo met, ki maaw mo tïïya täärnyïme ni lem, ki cam ni wø cïpi ki teek dëël.
english: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.

anywaa: Jer lur Libaanø na piith Wuuö Jwøki wø di jwøø ki pïï na karge.
english: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

anywaa: Weny wø gëëdö ki uudi bäätge, ni ö ajaae ni jïtge ki kwör bëëte bäät jera døøŋŋø.
english: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

anywaa: Kïte moa bäyö bëëdö na kar bëëtö jï adëëlli, ni ö kwöra no okaaŋŋø røk kïte ni tïmge na kar kan røk jï athinaaki.
english: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dwääy atïïe nee cwiir pääŋŋe, ni ö cäŋŋi ni ŋäc kany wø pädhe yie.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

anywaa: Muudhö wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö, ni tïm pinynyi na wäär, ni ö lääc paapi bëët ni täkge ki ööny wøk;
english: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

anywaa: ni ö ŋuuwe ni märge ni ge manynya gïï camge, ni cam marge man wø cacge käla baŋ Jwøk.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tuul cäŋŋi ge tägö ki døøn kwörge,  ni butge piny kwör bëëte moge.
english: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø wø aa baŋ tïïc mare, ni tïïc tïïe moe këël kanyo päth cäŋŋi.
english: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa tïïyï thööth døc kiree. Gïïögø bëët tïïyï ka køør leec wïc marï, ni ö gïïa cwääyï bëët ni pääŋge piny bäre.
english: O Lord, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

anywaa: Naama dwøŋ nut, ni bëëdö ni dwøŋ ni kany mo päl ee maaø, ni yie da gïï mo kwøw mo døøŋŋø ki mo therø mo kwäänge ba thum.
english: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

anywaa: Ni baabuure wø cäädha yie, ni Lëëwatan, lääna dwøŋ na cwääyï, nut yi naam kaace ni tuuk yie.
english: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët raŋŋa jïrï, kiper nee caapge cïpï jïge ki yïth kwöra näk karge.
english: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

anywaa: Kany wø cïpï cam jïge, lwørge lwørø, ni jäŋge ki caammi mo met kany wø japï cerï jïge.
english: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

anywaa: Kany wø paanyï täärnyïmï, dëëtge wø puta tïmö ni kwanynyi; ni kany wø lwørï jwïëcge, ge thøw, ni putge døø yi ŋöömö.
english: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

anywaa: Møøk wø cäŋ ka cwääyö kany wø jääŋŋï jwïëyï bäätge, ni cäŋï bäät piny tïïyö ni nyään.
english: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk ni bëëde na bäre bäre. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni mïn yie ki tïïe moe.
english: The glory of the Lord shall endure for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bäät piny di raŋø, ni tïm pinynyi ni jäŋŋi, ni gut kïte, ni putge duuŋ ki jïrö.
english: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

anywaa: Aani, a wär ki duut jï Wuuö Jwøk kany pooda naa poot kwøw en, ni wära thuwø ki dut pwøc jï Jwøa kany pooda naa nut bäät piny.
english: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm acaare 'moa ni kännö ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk; aani thuwø a bëëdö ni yia met ki eni.
english: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man thum jø raayi bäät piny, ni bäŋe jø wø tem gïï mo reyø mo joot këët. Aani Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋe, ni caannu tïïe moe nee wïny wïth juurre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

anywaa: Wärru jïre, wärru dut pwøc jïre, ni caannu tïïe moe bëët na näk rëëma ec.
english: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

anywaa: Jiemmu nyeŋŋe na en kur keere; beerra man mïn yïth jø wø cac Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

anywaa: Cayu Wuuö Jwøk ki teek mare, ni manynyu eni cooth. 5-6
english: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

anywaa: U na nyïïkwaac dhaanhnhe ma Eeberam, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap na näk ee jierø, caarru wïthu ki gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïe, këël ŋïïce moe ki luup ŋøl moa caane ki dhee.
Eni na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye Jwøk marø; ŋøl luup mare ena bäät piny bäre.
english: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

anywaa: Eni luumma tuude di lääŋŋö na bäre bäre, ni bëëde ni luumma caane di lääŋŋö këël yïth beenhnhe ma kume,
english: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

anywaa: ni beeye luumma tuude ki Eeberam, na kööŋe kiper gø jï Aydhak.
english: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

anywaa: Ni cäŋ gø tuutö ki Jeekap, ni beeye Icriel, nee bëëde na bäre bäre,
english: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

anywaa: na kööe, ni «Ŋööm Keenan omëëga ïïni, ni tïme na kur nyïïkwaayu.»
english: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

anywaa: Kanya bëëtge ni kwäänge nøk, ni ge nøk døc ni gena wëëlle yi ŋöömmögø,
english: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

anywaa: ni ge wïïrö tiet mïëri, ni ge cøøa paac man nø ki baŋ jøøi nø,
english: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

anywaa: ge käre wëëk dhaanhø mør nee ge thiel piny; nyeye aköömme kiperge, ni kööe,
english: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

anywaa: ni «Jiya na näk yaa jierø kär gutu, ni ba tïïu dëëtge ki gïï mo leth, ge na nyïïkuk 'moa.»
english: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

anywaa: Kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na käl käc paac mana bëëtge yie, ni wëëk caammi moge thumö bëët,
english: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

anywaa: eno nø jääk Ijep ki dhaanhø nyïmge dïkwøŋ, ni beeye Jocep, na kwøŋ dwøk pwödhö na laŋŋø.
english: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

anywaa: Eni tiete atwöc ko oguudi, ni maai piny ki nywïëny.
english: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

anywaa: 'Ba eni, kanya poode ni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki poot kär thur kare, luummögø abëëdö na gïr päärö dëëre.
english: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny Ijep ajäägö ni käl eni wøk øt twöc, ni bee eni na wïth jiy na pät Jocep.
english: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

anywaa: Eni Jöcep atïïe na ŋat käär akwöma, ni tïïc eni na wïth jammi moe bëët,
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

anywaa: nee cuumme moe köömme kaawat man wø manynye, nee jø døøŋŋø moe pwönynye nee jïtge ki leec wïc.
english: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

anywaa: Køøre Icriel thuwø, ni wø cwøl ni Jeekap, aö Ijep, ni bëëde na wëëllö kaace yi ŋööm Kaam.
english: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk jiye ma jø Icriel nyaay, ni tïïc geni ni teek ni kaala nyïïmän moge.
english: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

anywaa: Eni cwïny jø Ijep awiile ni tïmge ni ge män ki jiye, ni tïïge ka atade dëët jiye.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

anywaa: Eni dhaanhnhe ma Modhe ajääŋŋe, ni jääŋ Aran thuwø na näk ee jierø.
english: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

anywaa: Geni nyuuthe moe atïïcge dï jø Ijep, ni tïïcge gïï mo rëëma ec kaace yi ŋööm Kaam.
english: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

anywaa: Eni muudhö ajääŋŋe ni tïm pinynyi ni cøl, ni kärge luumme kwierø.
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

anywaa: Eni pïï mo jø Ijep awiile ni tïme na remø, ni wëëk rec moge thøø.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

anywaa: Dï paac marge agääbö ko ogwaal bäre, këël kwör niine moa en paan dwøŋ.
english: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

anywaa: Ena cäännö, ni ö nyuuwi dï poge bäre, ni cäŋ cäännö, ni put lwaa lwaŋŋø öö ni päl.
english: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

anywaa: Pey ajääŋŋe bäätge na kar køth, ni ö maalli ni male dï poge bäre.
english: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

anywaa: Ni raany omøki ko olämmi moge moa piithge, ni kaaŋ jenni moa en dï poge.
english: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

anywaa: Ena cäännö, ni put bäänyö öö,  ni beeye bäänyö mo kwäänge ba thum.
english: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

anywaa: Ni camge gïïa no otuy bëët poge, ni thöörge gïïa no ociek yi ŋöömö marge.
english: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

anywaa: Eni kaai bëët moa näk cwøw dï poge ma Ijep anääe, ni beege moa kwøŋ jø Ijepi nywøl na nyooth gø ni ge nyöödö.
english: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

anywaa: Køøre eni jø Icriel abwøth wøk ni ge käädö ki warkie ki gwet-bïrö; 'ba kanya cääthge, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo obøømmø.
english: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

anywaa: Kanya aac jø Icrielli, jø Ijep yïthge amïnnö, kiper mana bëëtge ni geno lwäyö ki gïïa tïïc Jwøki dëëtge ki køørge.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

anywaa: Eni pöölö apeere na tïpö bäätge, ni tïïc maac nee liele jïge ki wäär.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

anywaa: Gena pëëö, ni känne jïge ka ajwëëyi, ni wëëk ge jäŋö ki møø mo käla maal.
english: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

anywaa: Eni kïdi akaae ni mul pïïyi wøk, ni kwöt kwöra no otal kaamar naam.
english: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

anywaa: Eni wïïe kär wïl ki luumma en kur keere na tuude, ni beeye luumma tuude ki dhaanhnhe ma Eeberam.
english: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

anywaa: Eni jiye abwøth wøk ni yïthge met, ni kwöŋge ki met ec, geni na näk ee jierø.
english: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

anywaa: Eni ŋøøp wïth juurre amëëk geni, ni lwørge gïïa tïïc jøøgø ki öölö marge ni tïmge na moge,
english: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

anywaa: kiper nee ciik moe gwøkge, ni kïthge gïïa ceme bäät tïïc. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk! Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man caan gïïa tïïc Wuuö Jwøki ki teek mare? ?Na aŋa ni løny jïre ki man pwøc eni ki pwøc mana dii pwøø ki gø?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï jø wø many ŋøl ma adïëri, jø wø tïïc mana näk kare cooth.
english: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär wïïï wïl ki aani kanyo nyoothï met iï jï jiyï; ö baŋa ni piemï aani,
english: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

anywaa: kiper nee kwärö mar jiyï na näk iï jierø neena, nee yia mïnne ki jiyï na aciel, nee ï jiemwa na aciel ki jiyï na näk thöögï.
english: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

anywaa: Waani, waana tïïö ki raay, kaawat mana tïïc kwäcwa, ni bëëtwa ki bëëtö mo paa kare, ni tïïwa ki gïï mo reyø.
english: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

anywaa: Kanya bëët kwäcwa Ijep, tïïe moï ni wø rëëm ec kärge lääŋŋö, ni mëër marï na päl ni wø ba jøøl, ge kär cädö kiper gø; 'ba gena gëëmö ki ïïni, ï na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, kanya enge bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk gena pieme kiper nyeŋŋe, ni nyootha teek mare,
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

anywaa: kanya kööm Naama Kwaar ni tale, ni bwøth geni ki kanya päŋ dïkwøŋ, ni cääthge kere ge caatha paap mo otal.
english: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena pieme ceŋ jøøa män ki geni, ni käl geni wøk ceŋge.
english: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

anywaa: Ni ö naammi ni cam jøøgø, ni bäŋe aciel mo odööŋ.
english: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

anywaa: Køøre ge na jiye, luup moe aŋääthge, ni wärge ki duut ni ge pwøya eni.
english: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

anywaa: 'Ba wïthge alaar wïlö ki tïïe moe, ni kärge pwöc mare koorø.
english: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

anywaa: Ni tïmge ni ge lääŋŋa yïthge dï paap, ni päärge Jwøk.
english: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

anywaa: Gïna pëënyge acïbe jïge, 'ba dëëtge amooe ki täw mo leth.
english: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

anywaa: Kanya enge twïër dï paap, gena bëëdö ni yïthge keec ki Modhe ka Aran, Aran ŋata no ocïp kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö pinynyi ni jap ree ni mwøny dïbwöthe moge ma Daathan ka Abiram, ni dïïr ree bäätge ki jø mïëcge bëët.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

anywaa: Ni ö maaci ni waaŋ jøøa dwal dëëtge ki jøøgø, ni put jøøgø ni reyø yøø thöör.
english: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

anywaa: Jø Icriel gena lëënyö ki warkey ni tïïcge gø na nyirøøa tier Kïn Körëp, ni wøørge gïnögø ni ege leenyø na gïn lam enø.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

anywaa: Geni Jwøk na näk ajiem marge awiilge ki gïna tïïcge ni caala dhieŋ ni wø cam luum jaak.
english: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

anywaa: Geni wïthge awïl ki Jwøk na piem geni, na tïïc gïï mo døøŋŋø Ijep,
english: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

anywaa: ni beege gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïe kaace yi ŋööm Kaam, ki gïïa thääŋ ec na tïïe bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

anywaa: Køøre Jwøk aköö ni ge di raanynyø; 'ba Modhe, na näk ee jierø, aci yïthakicge ki Jwøk, nee wëër mar Jwøk paanye bäätge, nee ge ba raanynye.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

anywaa: Geni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kärge ŋäädhö, ni taakge rege ki jøøa en yi ŋöömma mïërö.
english: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

anywaa: Gena bëëdö ni ge ŋurö yïth oduŋkaare moge, ni kärge dwør Wuuö Jwøk wïnynyö.
english: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre ena kööŋ jïge, ni ge wëëge thumö ki thøø dï paap,
english: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

anywaa: ni wëëk nyïïkwaacge keethø dï wïth juurre, ni thumge ki thøø tiet mïëri.
english: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

anywaa: Geni cwïnyge aløøge baŋ jwøa cwøl ni Baal-Pëëgör, ni camge olämme moa cïp jï juu mo bäŋ jwïëy dëëtge,
english: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

anywaa: ni tïïcge Wuuö Jwøk nee goote ki køør gïïa tïïcge, ni ö Jwøki ni jääl geni ki täw mo leth.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba Piniac aö maal ni dier luummögø, ni put täwi cuŋŋö.
english: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

anywaa: Ni jïëc eni ni mare beer këël yïth beenhnhe bëët moo ööi ki køør gïna tïïe.
english: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

anywaa: Geni Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge nee wëëre bäät pï Meriba, ni ö Modhe ni jïte ka ajäla ki køørge;
english: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

anywaa: kiper cwïny Modhe adøøcge mo keec, ni cääne ki luup mo käre caarø.
english: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

anywaa: Geni wïth juurre moa bëëdö Keenan kärge nääö, këël na bëëde ni geno kööm Wuuö Jwøki ni jøøgø 'näkge.
english: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:

anywaa: 'Ba røkge ajääpge ki wïth juurre moøgø, ni kwanyge bëëtö marge.
english: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

anywaa: Ni wøørge gïïa no otieŋø ni wø lam jøøgø, ni tïm lammi manøgø na abïëp kiperge.
english: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

anywaa: Wäätge ki nyïïge aŋaalge no olämme jï juu mo piny,
english: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

anywaa: ni kønyge rem jiy piny mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø, ni beege rem wäätge ki nyïïge, na ŋaalge no olämme jï gïïa no otieŋø ni wø lam jø Keenanni, ni tïm ŋöömö marge ni ba waany ki køør remø.
english: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

anywaa: Ni tïm dëëtge ni ba waany ki køør tïïe moge, ni tïmge kaamar kääpe ki køør gïïa tïïcge.
english: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

anywaa: Wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk aliel kaamar maac bäätge, ge na jiye, ni männe ki geni, ge na näk thööge.
english: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

anywaa: Ni cïp geni ceŋ wïth juurre, ni tïmge ni ge ena tietge, ge na jøøa män ki geni.
english: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

anywaa: Gena thiel nyïïmänni moge piny, ni tïmge ni ge ena tietge.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

anywaa: Geni, gena køny Wuuö Jwøki kwöre mo thööth, 'ba gena tïmö ni marge ageem ki køør gïï wø carge, ni nigeŋac yïth raay moge.
english: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na wïny oduuru marge, leth bëëtö marge aneene,
english: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

anywaa: ni par wïïe ki luumma tuude kiperge, ni dwøk cwïnye piny ki køør mëër mare na päl ni wø ba jøøl;
english: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

anywaa: ni tïïc cwïny jøøa mak geni ki tøŋ ni bäth ki geni.
english: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk marwa, piem waani, ni lemï waani yïthakic wïth juurre, kiper nee nyeŋŋï na en kur keere pwøcwa, ni jiemwa ïïni kany wø pwøcwa ïïni.
english: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ki mana täge cøøn, këël bäre bäre. Beerra man kö jiyi bëët, ni «Beeye kare!» Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøa wïïl Wuuö Jwøki wøk yïth gïïa leth ni caange met ec marge na enøgønø,
english: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

anywaa: ni beege jøøa cooŋe ki tiet mïëri bëët, na käl jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki moa käl wï-piny ki tier-piny.
english: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

anywaa: Møøk dïge atïmö ni thääyö dï paap kany mo bäŋ pïï yie, ni kärge jöör pääny mana dege bëëdö yie joodø.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

anywaa: Käc ki riew bäre atïmö ni päl dëëtge, ni ö dëëtge ni ŋiir piny.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

anywaa: Kanya cwat yïthge ki öölö, Wuuö Jwøk akwacge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl geni wøk yïth gïïa leth na enge yïthge.
english: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

anywaa: Gena bwøth Wuuö Jwøki ki jöö mo tiir, kiper nee ge cige pääny mana dege bëëdö yie.
english: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøgø ni dwøkge met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl, ki gïïa näk rëëma ec ni wø tïïe jï jiy.
english: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

anywaa: Kiper ŋata no onäk riewi amaadhe ki pïï ni røme, ni wëëk ŋata no onäk käci jäŋö ki cam mo met.
english: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

anywaa: Møøk dïge abëëdö yi muudhö mo cøl ma kar thøø, ni geno twöö ko oguudi ni bëëtö marge leth,
english: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

anywaa: kiper mana kwierge luupa caan Jwøki, ni taakge pwöc moe, eni na dwøŋ ni en maal.
english: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

anywaa: Wïthge adwøk Wuuö Jwøki piny ki tïïc mo teek, ni tïm dëëtge ni dhønhnhi ni bäŋ ŋat mo køny geni.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

anywaa: Kanya cwat yïthge ki öölö, Wuuö Jwøk akwacge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl geni wøk yïth gïïa leth na enge yïthge.
english: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

anywaa: Gena käl Wuuö Jwøki wøk ki yi muunhnha cøl na näk kar thøø, ni cööt oguudi moa näk geno twöö ki ge.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøgø ni dwøkge met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl, ki gïïa näk rëëma ec ni wø tïïe jï jiy.
english: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

anywaa: Kiper eni dhøk uut twöc moa näk tïïc ka nywïëny atoor piny, ni tøc dïdëëte mo nywïëny na thäŋi.
english: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

anywaa: Møøk dïge moa wïthge teek, bëëtö marge atïmö ni leth kiper mana dhalge luum Jwøk ni tïïge ki gïï mo reyø.
english: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

anywaa: Cwïnyge atïmö ni cøl ki caammi bëët, ni tïm karge ni cään ki thøø.
english: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

anywaa: Kanya cwat yïthge ki öölö, Wuuö Jwøk akwacge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl geni wøk yïth gïïa leth na enge yïthge.
english: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dwøre acaane ni dwøk dëëtge karge, ni køny geni yi ränynyö marge.
english: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøgø ni dwøkge met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl, ki gïïa näk rëëma ec ni wø tïïe jï jiy.
english: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

anywaa: Beerra man cïpge ko olämme thuwø ni ge dwøga met ec, ni caange tïïe moe ni döötge ena maal.
english: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

anywaa: Møøk dïge mo wø cäädhi dï naama dwøŋ ki baabuure, ni wø bëëdö ni marge tïïc bäät naama dwøŋ,
english: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

anywaa: tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk na näk rëëma ec ni wø tïïe bäät naamøgø ajootge døc.
english: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

anywaa: Kiper dwøre acaane, ni put atuunna mo dwøŋ kwönnö, ni ö athaga ni tïme ni päl.
english: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

anywaa: Gena leeŋ athaga maal ni cäŋ geni duu piny, ni päth cwïnyge na bäre bäre ki køør gïna raac na tägö.
english: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

anywaa: Gena tïmö ni ge bøømmø kaamar dhaanhø mo omeer, ni tïm riek waŋ marge ni bäŋ kare.
english: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

anywaa: Kanya cwat yïthge ki öölö, Wuuö Jwøk akwacge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni käl geni wøk yïth gïïa leth na enge yïthge.
english: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

anywaa: Atuunna ajooe ni cuŋŋe, ni ö athaga ni lïŋe.
english: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

anywaa: Yïthge amïnnö kanya ö naammi na neekïïl, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bwøth geni këël mana pïïcge dhi waath mana manyge.
english: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøgø ni dwøkge met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl, ki gïïa näk rëëma ec ni wø tïïe jï jiy.
english: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

anywaa: Beerra man tïŋge nyeŋŋe maal dï acooŋ paac bäre, ni pwøcge eni kany wø ö jø døøŋŋø wø cooŋge dëëtge yie.
english: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk näm ataale ni tïm kwörge na tëën, ni taal kwör wø kwön pïïyi ki yïthge;
english: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

anywaa: ni tïïc ŋøøp wø cïpi ki cam na ŋøøp acäbö mo bäŋ gïn mo tuy yie. Gïïögø atïïe ki køør rääö mar jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø.
english: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

anywaa: Kany ma tëën atïïe na kany mo yie da näm, ni tïïc ŋøøpa näk otal na kwör wø kwöt pïïyi ki yïthge.
english: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

anywaa: Jøøa no onäk käci awëëk bëëtö kaace, ni gëëtge ki pääny mo bëëtge yie.
english: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

anywaa: Ni purge ki pwöth, ki pwöth omøki, ni jïtge ki caammi mo thööth.
english: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

anywaa: Gena gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki, ni tïmge ni thööth, ni tïïc dhäk moge ni thööth.
english: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jiy wø tïmö ni nøk ni døø wïthge piny ki køør caannø ki bëëtö mo leth ki kïmmö man wø kïmge ki gø.
english: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ni kwääri ee taaø jaak, ni wëëk geni thääyö dï paap mo bäŋ øtjöö mo joot yie.
english: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa can wø poot käle wøk ki yi ränynyö marge, ni meet geni ni tïmge ni thööth kaamar pïïth dïëk.
english: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.

anywaa: Gïïögø neen jøøa beyø neenø ni mïn yïthge, ni ö jøøa reyø ni bëëtge ni dhøkge ege miiø.
english: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

anywaa: Ŋata näk wïïe leer, beerra man kïth gïïögø cwïnye, ni bëëde ni lääŋŋa mëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, a bëëdö ni cwïnya ena køørï; naa wär ki dudi naa pwøya ïïni ki cwïnya bäre.
english: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

anywaa: Päyu, u na thøme 'moa! Aani, øw nyïïa nyïïö nee laar ruuö ki duuda.
english: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, met ec duua duuö jïrï dï jiy bëët, ni wära ki dut pwøc jïrï dï wïth juurre.
english: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

anywaa: Kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl dwøŋ døc no okëët maal, na adïëri marï okëët nyeŋ pøøl.
english: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni karï dwøŋ døc, na ajiem marï ena bäät piny bäre.
english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;

anywaa: Wïny mara ni piemï aani ki køør teek badï, kiper nee aani na mëërï ki gø naa piem.
english: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.

anywaa: Jwøk acäänö ni ena kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni kööe, «Ŋøøp Cekam pääŋŋa pääŋŋö ni mïn yia, ni pääŋŋa ŋøøp Goor Cuköt thuwø.
english: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

anywaa: Ŋøøp Gelät beege 'moa, ni ö ŋøøp Maneeca ni näkge 'moa thuwø; jø tuuŋ Ipariem perge leth ni caala cöör nywïënyö mara, ni jø tuuŋ Juuda beege jø wø kïth ciik 'moa bäät tïïc.
english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

anywaa: 'Ba jø Möap caala gïn wø lööga yie, ni ö warø mara ni leeŋa gø yi po jø Ëdöm, ni kwöŋŋa bäät jø Pilitin ni dwøra ena maal kanyo bööta geni.»
english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, aŋa noo mooc aani ki teek naa dønynya yi pääny mana teek, noo bwøth aani naa këëda ki jø Ëdöm?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

anywaa: ?Wui Jwøk, aŋø, waana kwierï møn ennø, niï ba ci baŋ leny këët ki jø leny mowa?
english: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

anywaa: Køny waani ceŋ nyïïmän, kiper køny mar dhaanhø bäŋ gïn mo duue
english: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

anywaa: Teek dïïm wø jootwa baŋ Jwøk, ni bee eni noo bööt nyïïmän mowa.
english: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï ni wø pwøa, kärï lïŋö,
english: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

anywaa: kiper jøøa reyø ki jø cwøk dhøkge ena raa, ni ge kïtha bääta ki luup tööt.
english: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

anywaa: Aana cielge dïër ki luup män, ni bëëtge ni dhøkge ena dëëra ki luup mo bäŋ tietge.
english: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

anywaa: Këël na bëëda naa mëër ki geni, gena duu raa ni kïthge bääta ki luup; 'ba aani, a bëëdö naa lämö.
english: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

anywaa: Gena tïmö ni ge duua gïn mo raac baŋa na kar gïna beer, ni duuge män na kar mëër mana mëëra ki geni.
english: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cuumï ki dïŋut luup mo raac bäät ŋata kïth bääta ki luup, ni ö nyimän mar ŋata kïth bääta ki luup ni kïth bäät gø ki luup kar løøk.
english: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

anywaa: Kanyo ŋøl luumme, beerra man jääl eni, ni tïm lammi mare ni duua raay bääte.
english: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm nïr kwøwi moe ni nøk, ni ö kare ni lwøri ya ŋat mørri.
english: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm obwöre moe ni bäŋ wääge, ni tïm cïïe na cï thøø.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

anywaa: Beerra man thääy obwöre moe ni ge kwääö, ni bëëtge ni ge määnyö ni tïm karge ni bäär ki wï poge.
english: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋat pïïdö ni käl japa en jï gø bëët, ni ö jøøa pathi ni twierge japa joode ki køør öölö mare.
english: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

anywaa: Beerra man ba jïte ki ŋat mo nyootha mëër jïre, ni bäŋe ŋat mo cwïnye pädhi kiper obwöre moe kanyo dööŋge ni bäŋ wääge.
english: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

anywaa: Beerra man dït wïïe, ni put nyeŋŋe rwäänyö yi beenhnhø mano ööi.
english: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni paac wïïe ki raay moa tïïc kwäye, ni ö bääyö mar menni ni ba wëënni.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët Wuuö Jwøki ni raŋŋa raay mo gø cooth, ni rwääny nyeŋŋe bäät piny, ni bäŋe ŋat mo par wïïe ki eni.
english: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

anywaa: Kiper eni wïïe käre caarø ki man nyooth mëër; 'ba ena tïmö ni caanna jøøa no ocaarø ki moa can, ki moa näk cwïnyge opädhö, këël mano thøwge.
english: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö ni yie met ki man cien dhaanhø, 'ba acïëni ööa bääte; ni eni bëëdö ni yie ba met ki man gwïëth dhaanhø, 'ba gwïëth otïmö ni kare bäär ki eni.
english: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

anywaa: Eni acïëni ee røø dëëre kaamar abïï, ni ci dëëre kaamar pïï, ni twaa yi cöönne kaamar maaw.
english: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

anywaa: Beerra man ö acïëni ni bëëde dëëre kaamar aleeŋŋa man wø kääre, ni tïme kaamar kaw man wø twöö piere cooth.
english: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm gïïögø bëët na gïïo tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëët jøøa kïth bääta ki luup, jøøa car gïï mo reyø dëëra.
english: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïni na kwäärö mara, beerra man tïïï ki gïn mo beer kipera nee nyeŋŋï pwøc; ni piemï aani ki køør mëër marï na beer ni wø ba jøøl.
english: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

anywaa: Kiper aano caannø naa bëëdö naa can, naa bëëdö ni cwïnya opädhö na bäre bäre.
english: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

anywaa: Aani, a rwäänyö kaamar tïm abøøya, ni jar aani wøk kaamar twöŋö.
english: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

anywaa: Wïth cøŋŋa atïmö ni nhønhnhi ki køør mana kweera ki cam, ni dwada ni tïma ni aana cöö.
english: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

anywaa: Aana tïmö na gïr ajøøŋ jï nyïïmän 'moa, ni kany wø neenge aani, wïthge wø putge ka kiinynyø.
english: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøk mara, køny aani; piem aani ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

anywaa: Beerra man ö pïëmmi manøgø ni ŋäyi ya nyïïmänni 'moa ni käla baŋï, ni beeye ïïni ki dëërï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, na tïïc gø.
english: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.

anywaa: Geni, marge acïëni, 'ba ïïni, marï gwïëth; kanyo öge maal bääta, wïthge olääi, 'ba a na dhaanhnhï, aano bëëdö ni yia met.
english: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

anywaa: Beerra man räny nyeŋ jø wø kïth bääta ki luup, ni bëët lään wïci dëëtge kaamar abïï.
english: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

anywaa: Aani Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre, ni pwøa eni dï acooŋ jøøa thööth.
english: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

anywaa: Kiper eni cuŋŋa kur ŋata can, nee jwïëc gø pieme ceŋ jø wø ŋøl thøø bääte.
english: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Kwäärö mara, ni «Pï bäät cwïïa, këël mano tïïa nyïïmän moï na køøm tietï.»
english: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk teek kwär marï otïïe nee nyaae ni tägi ka yi Dhayan, ni bëëdï ni nyïïmän moï ena tierï.
english: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ wø këëdï ki nyïïmän moï, jiyï wø puta ö maal ki met ec; ni ö wøpe moï ni öge baŋï ka ajiem mo dwøŋ, ni ge thööth ni ge caala thööy mo amöölla.
english: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk anø kööŋ, ni mana caane ba wiile këët, na kööe, ni «Ï bëëdö ni ïïna dïlämi na bäre bäre, niï caala Melkidhedek.»
english: The Lord hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kwäärö ena bäät cwïïï, eni, dïcäŋo wëëre, wïth nyeye di nyadhø.
english: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

anywaa: Eni luup wïth juurre di ŋølø, ni tïïc piny ni päŋ ki dëët jiy mo othøw, ni nyath wïth kwääri mo tiet mïëri mo thööth.
english: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

anywaa: Eno mäthi ki pïï yi waŋ mo ena deŋ jöö; køøre nø, dïïm otïmö ni ena jïre.
english: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Aani Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre dï jøøa marge thïïŋ ni wø dwäti na aciel, ni pwøa eni thuwø dï acooŋa bäre.
english: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

anywaa: Tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk døøŋŋø døc, ni ö jøøa yïthge met ki tïïe moøgø ni lääŋge geni.
english: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

anywaa: Tïïe moe duua wödö ka ajiem jïre, ni ö adïëri mare ni bëëde na bäre bäre.
english: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

anywaa: Eni wïth jiy apare ki tïïe moe ni wø rëëm ec. Wuuö Jwøk yie bäth ni mëër ki jiy.
english: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

anywaa: Jø wø lwäär ki eni wø di caamø, ni ö luumme na näk ee tuudö cøøn ni bëëde ni lääŋŋa gø na bäre bäre.
english: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

anywaa: Teek mare anyoodhe jï jiye ki ri tïïe moe, kanya cïp ŋøøp juurre jï jiye.
english: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

anywaa: Gïï wø tïïe bëët beege adïëri ni näkge karge, ni ciik moe bëët beege gïï mo oŋäädhö.
english: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

anywaa: Ni ge bëëdö karge na bäre bäre, no otïïc Wuuö Jwøki ki jöö ma adïëri mo thïïŋ.
english: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jiye akønye ni wïïl geni wøk; ena tudö ki luubö ki geni mo bëëdö na bäre bäre. Wuuö Jwøk nyeŋŋe ena kur keere ni di lwäärö.
english: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

anywaa: 'Ba tier leec wïc mana dïkwøŋ beeye ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk, ni jø wø caath køør ciik moe, tier gïna beer ŋäcge. Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre.
english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk! Gwïëth en jï ŋat wø bëëdö ni lwäära Wuuö Jwøk, ŋat wø bëëdö ni yie met ki ciik moe.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

anywaa: Eni kunhnhe otïmö ni teeka eni dï piny, ni ö beenh jøøa marge thïïŋ ni gwïëdhi.
english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

anywaa: Eni paare jïtö ki jammi ni kwäre, ni ö bëëtö mare na beer ni bëëde na bäre bäre.
english: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

anywaa: Eni bëëdö na tar mo meenya muudhö jï jøøa marge thïïŋ; ni bëëde ni mëër ki jiy, ni mare beer.
english: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

anywaa: Otïmö ni beer jï ŋat wø mëër ki jiy ni wø wëëk jape mac; ni wø tïïc tïïe moe ki jöö ma kare.
english: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

anywaa: Eni ba pädhi na bäre bäre; eni na beer gïre di lääŋŋö cooth.
english: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

anywaa: Eni cwïnye ba bwøk kany wø wïny gïï mo leth mo otägö; cwïnye ee maaø ni bëëdö ni ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

anywaa: Eni cwïnye maae maaø ni ba lwäyi, këël mano joot gïna manynye dëët nyïïmän moe no othur kare.
english: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

anywaa: Eni wø cïpö ni yie met jï jøøa can, ni ö bëëtö mare na beer ni bëëde na bäre bäre; eno jïti ki teek ni wøør eni.
english: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

anywaa: Bëët ŋatøgø ojoot ŋata raaci ni goote, ni kaac lage ni put bääte pädhö; ni ö gïï wø many jø raayi ni ränyge.
english: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk! Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, u na jiye; pwøyu nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man pwøc nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki man bëëde ennø, këël bäre bäre.
english: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

anywaa: Beerra man pwøc nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki mano täge ki jï løø kur tuulcäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord's name is to be praised.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kare dwøŋ bäät wïth juurre bëët, na ajiem mare dwøŋ no okëët maal.
english: The Lord is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni pääri ki Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwøk marø? Bee eni ni wø bëëdö maalø,
english: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

anywaa: ni bee eni ni wø dwøk dëëre piny nee japa en maal ki moa en piny raŋŋe.
english: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

anywaa: Eni jøøa can wø tïŋe maal ki yi tør, ni tïŋ jøøa näk oööl maal ki wï bur,
english: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

anywaa: ni cïp geni kanya ciel ki kwääri, jøøa no ocuumö na wïth jiye.
english: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

anywaa: Eni dhaagø ma bwøc wø mooe mooø ki paare, ni tïme na mii obwöre ni bëëde ni yie met. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Jø Icriel, ni beege jø dhi øt Jeekap, kanya öge wøk Ijep po jøøa dhøkge path,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

anywaa: Juuda atïmö na kar bëëtö mo ena kur keere jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëët jø Icrielli bëët ni ena cere.
english: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Icrielli na jooti ya Naama Kwaarri, Naama Kwaar areeŋø, ni ö Naam Jördan ni døø ŋääe.
english: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

anywaa: Thuuri atïmö ni pärö kaamar nyïïrööm, ni ö kïte ni tïmge ni pärö kaamar nyöök rööm.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

anywaa: ?Wui Naama Kwaar, aŋø, ïïno tïmö nidïï, ni reŋï en? ?Wui Naam Jördan, aŋø ni døøï ŋääï en?
english: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

anywaa: ?Wui, u na thuuri, aŋø ni päru kaamar nyïïrööm en? ?Wui, u na kïte, aŋø ni päru kaamar nyöök rööm en?
english: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

anywaa: Wui, ï na piny, tïmï niï jäŋŋi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwø Jeekap,
english: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

anywaa: na wëëk pïï kwön wøk ki yi kïdi, ni tïme na puul, na tïïc kïnna teek na kany wø kwön pïïyi wøk ki yie.
english: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär tïmö ni jiemma waani; kär tïmö ni jiemma waani, 'ba beerra man tïme ni jiemma nyeŋŋï kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri marï.
english: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.

anywaa: Aperŋø ni kö wïth juurre en, ni «?Jwøk marge en kaa?»
english: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk marø møn, ena maal, ni eni tïïya man wø met yie ki gø.
english: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø lam wïth juurre wø tïïc ka warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ni beege gïï mo tïïya jiyi ki ceŋge.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

anywaa: Gïïögø jïge da dhøgi, 'ba ge ba luubö; ni jïge da nyeŋŋi, 'ba ge ba nëënö.
