english: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

anywaa: Jïge da ïdhi, 'ba ge ba wïnyö; ni jïge da ummi, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo ŋwääcge.
english: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

anywaa: Jïge da ceŋ, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo mulge; ni jïge da tiel, 'ba ge ba cäädhi; ni bäŋ dwøl mo tuny wøk ki cwäkge.
english: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

anywaa: Jøøa tïïc geni otïmö ni bäŋ teek jïge ni caala geni, këël jøw bëët mo wø ŋääth geni.
english: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, ŋääthu Wuuö Jwøk; bee eni na dïkunyi maru ni ena kwöt leny jïïu.
english: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø dhi øt Aran,  ŋääthu Wuuö Jwøk; bee eni na dïkunyi maru ni ena kwöt leny jïïu.
english: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

anywaa: Uuni ni wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, ŋääthu Wuuö Jwøk; bee eni na dïkunyi maru ni ena kwöt leny jïïu.
english: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk lääŋŋa øøni; ø di gwïëdhö; ø di gwïëdhö, ø na jø Icriel, ni gwïëth jø dhi øt Aran.
english: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jø wø lwäär ki eni di gwïëdhö, ni beege moa kwörge bäŋgø ki moa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët.
english: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk uuni nyaay, uuni ko obwöre mou bëët.
english: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni gwïëth uuni, eni na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

anywaa: Maal beeye mar Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba piny ee cïbö jï jiy.
english: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord's: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

anywaa: Jøøa no othøw Wuuö Jwøk ba pwøcge, ni beege jøøa no oci kany mo bäŋ dwøl yie.
english: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, Wuuö Jwøk pwøø pwøø, ki man bëëde ennø, këël bäre bäre. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, a mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk kiper dwøra wø wïnynye wïnynyö kany wø kwaa eni.
english: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.

anywaa: Eni cøøra cøørø ki yïth nïr kwøw 'moa bëët, kiper mana cek ïthe ki mara.
english: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni aano ciel thøø dïër kaamar dhaanhø mo omeenø ki thøøl, ni ö räämmi mana caal mana en kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw ni ö bääta, ni lwäya, ni päth cwïnya.
english: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk acwøla, ni kööa, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, kwøw aani!»
english: Then called I upon the name of the Lord; O Lord, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni mëër ki jiy ni mare beer, ni eni na Jwøk marø met ec mare wø nyoodhe nyoodhø.
english: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jøøa näk gïn tïïcge kucge di gwøø; kanya bëëda ni aano dwøk piny, aana kønye.
english: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

anywaa: Wui, cwïnya, døø piny, kärï pärö, kiper Wuuö Jwøk atïïö ki gïï mo beyø jïra.
english: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, jwïëya akälï wøk cer thøø, ni pooyï pï nyeŋŋa, ni tïïyï tieta nee nigethïk naa ba pädha.
english: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

anywaa: Aano bëëdö naa caatha køør Wuuö Jwøk kanyo pooda naa poot kwøw.
english: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni cwïnya da ŋäädhe, këël na bëëda ni aano köö ni aano caannø døc.
english: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

anywaa: Aani, cwïnya abwøk, ni kööa ni jiy bëët tööte.
english: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa jï Wuuö Jwøk na kar gïïa beyø bëët na tïïe jïra?
english: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

anywaa: Aani, køøŋ nyïïomøki ocïba ki ya athöödhi na muuy jï Wuuö Jwøk naa pwøya eni kiper mana piem aani.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Gïïa kööŋa kiperge jï Wuuö Jwøk ocïba ni jiye bëët nutö.
english: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk thøø mar jiye jwøre jwørø.
english: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, aana dhaanhnhï; aana dhaanhnhï møn, ni aana o dhaaŋ wø tïny ïïni; aana pädï wøk ki yi thøø.
english: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

anywaa: Olämi mar dwøk met ec ocïba jïrï, ni cwøla nyeŋŋï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Gïïa kööŋa kiperge jï Wuuö Jwøk ocïba ni jiye bëët nutö,
english: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people,

anywaa: ni wa ena dï kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk, na en dï Jerucalem. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: In the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: U na wïth juurre bëët, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk; u na dïbwör bäre, pwøyu eni;
english: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk mëër ki øøni ki mëër mo dwøŋ mo ba jøøl, ni ö adïëri mare ni bëëde na bäre bäre. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Beerra man kö jø Icrielli, ni «Mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Beerra man kö jø dhi øt Aranni, ni «Mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Beerra man kö jø wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Aana jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth, ni wïny mara ni mooc a ki bëëtö mo beer.
english: I called upon the Lord in distress: the Lord answered me, and set me in a large place.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ena kura naa ba lwäyi. ?Aŋø, dhaanhø jaak, agïnaŋø noo tïïe dëëra?
english: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ena kura, ni beeye dïkunyi mara; kiper manøgønø, nyïïmänna jooda joodø ni geno böötö.
english: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man bëët dhaanhe ni ree ee kan buut Wuuö Jwøk, ki man bëëde ni eni ŋäätha dhaanhø.
english: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man bëët dhaanhe ni ree ee kan buut Wuuö Jwøk, ki man bëëde ni eni ŋäätha kwääri.
english: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

anywaa: Wïth juurre bëët aana cielge dïër, 'ba ki køør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk gena raanynya.
english: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

anywaa: Aana cielge dïër, aana cielge dïër møn; 'ba ki køør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk gena raanynya.
english: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

anywaa: Aana cielge dïër kaawat man wø tïïc kïci, 'ba gena nibäc kaamar maa koodhi, ni raanynya geni ki køør nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

anywaa: Gena nyänh bääta døc ni tïma naa many ka böötö, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk aana kønye.
english: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mara, ni bee eni na cäŋŋa ki duut, ni tïme na pïëmi mara.
english: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

anywaa: Kwöŋŋö man wø kwöŋŋö ki met ec kiper pïëm man wø piem jiy ki gø en, wïnyö yïth oduŋkaare mo jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni jøw köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk bade teek ni këëdö ki leny mo teek;
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk teek bade dwøŋ døc; Wuuö Jwøk bade teek ni këëdö ki leny mo teek.»
english: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

anywaa: Aani, a ba thøw, 'ba a bëëdö naa kwøw, ni cara tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aana pwönynye døc ki pwöc mo leth, 'ba a käre wëëk thøø.
english: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

anywaa: Japu dhøk käälle jïra mo wø døny jic Wuuö Jwøki ki yïthge, kiper naa dønya ki yïthge, nee met ec dwøga jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:

anywaa: Man beeye dhi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk, man wø døny jic Wuuö Jwøki ki yie.
english: This gate of the Lord, into which the righteous shall enter.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, met ec duua duuö jïrï kiper mana wïnynyï mara, ni tïmï ni ïïna pïëmi mara.
english: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.

anywaa: Kïdi mana kwier dïgëëte atïmö na kïn gøøt mana pere letha eni na mak øtø;
english: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

anywaa: gïnögø beeye gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, na tïmö na gïn mo rëëma ec ki nyeŋŋø.
english: This is the Lord's doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

anywaa: Dïcäŋi beeye dïcäŋ mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki kur keere; beerra man kanynyø ni mïn yïthø ki gø.
english: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wa kwaya ïïni, piem waani; wui Wuuö Jwøk, wa kwaya ïïni, nee gïï wø tïïcwa thurge karge.
english: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋato ööi ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk! Wa gwïëtha uuni ki yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk møn, ni bee eni na mooc øøni ki tar. Olämme moo cïp dïcäŋ man wø wøør Jwøk yie wär twöyu ki thøøli, ni kälu geni buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

anywaa: Beeye ï na Jwøk mara, met ec duua duuö jïrï; beeye ï na Jwøk mara, nyeŋŋï tïŋa maal.
english: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät jø wø bëëtö marge thïïŋ, jø wø cäädhi ki køør ciik mo Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät jø wø gwøk ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø many eni ki cwïnyge bäre.
english: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

anywaa: Jøøgø bäŋ gïn mo raac mo tïïcge, 'ba ge caatha jööre.
english: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwöc moi acïpï nee gwøkwa na karge.
english: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.

anywaa: Gïna manynya keere beeye ki man bëëda naa gwøga ciik moï cooth.
english: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

anywaa: Kany wø cäda kiper ciik moï, wïïa ba lääy.
english: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

anywaa: Kanyo kwanya luup ŋøl moï na näk adïëri, ïïno pwøa ki cwïny mo thïïŋ.
english: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

anywaa: Aani, ciik moï gwøa gwøø; kär a weyï na bäre bäre.
english: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wøpe bëëtö marge ogwøkge gø nidïï? Bëëtö marge ogwøkge ki køør luummï.
english: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

anywaa: Ï yaa manynyø ki cwïnya bäre; kär a wëëk gaan wøk ki ri ciik moï.
english: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

anywaa: Luummï yaa kan cwïnya, kiper naa ba bääya dëërï.
english: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwøc en jïrï; pwöny aani ki ciik moï.
english: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Luup ŋøl moï bëët wø køba købø ki dhaa.
english: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

anywaa: A wø bëëdö ni yia met ki man cäädha køør ciik moï, naa caala dhaanhø mo yie omïnnö ki jap kwärö.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

anywaa: A wø cädö bäät pwöc moï, ni bëëda naa lääŋŋa jöörï.
english: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

anywaa: A bëëdö ni yia met ki ciik moï, ni wïïa ba wïl ki luummï.
english: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

anywaa: Tïïï ki gïï mo beyø jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, naa bëëda naa kwøw ni gwøa luummï.
english: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

anywaa: Jap nyeŋŋa, nee gïïa näk rëëma ec ri pwöc moï nee jooda.
english: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

anywaa: Aani, a bëëdö ni aana wëëllö bäät pinyi en; kär ciik moï kanï ki aani.
english: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

anywaa: Cwïnya bëëdö ni ena køør luup ŋøl moï, naa bëëdö naa lääŋŋa geni ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

anywaa: Jø okiera, na no ocienø, wø joogï jooø, jø wø gaa wøk ki ri ciik moï.
english: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

anywaa: Daak ajøøŋ ka ataa bääta, kiper ciik moï yaa gwøø.
english: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

anywaa: Këël ni näk kwääri bëëdö ni ge waya nyeŋŋa, a na dhaanhnhï, a poot bëëdö naa cädö bäät ciik moï.
english: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

anywaa: Met ec wø jooda ka ri ciik moï, ni beeye geni ni wø pwöny aani.
english: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

anywaa: Aano ränynyö naa bëëdö yi tør; 'ba cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør luummï.
english: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

anywaa: Gïïa tïïa bëët acaana, ni løgï mara jïra; pwöny aani ki ciik moï.
english: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Mooc aani ki leec wïc, nee tiet pwöc moï kwanya, naa cäda kiper tïïe moï na näk rëëma ec.
english: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

anywaa: Aani bääta apädhö ki kïmmö; døøc a mo teek ki køør luummï.
english: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

anywaa: Tïïc aani ni kara bäär ki bëët tööt, ni pwönynyï aani ki ciik moï ki køør mëër marï.
english: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

anywaa: Aani jöör adïëri yaa jierø, ni cwïnya yaa cïp køør luup ŋøl moï.
english: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö ni aano göök ri ciik moï; kär dee ŋat lää wïïa.
english: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

anywaa: Aano cäädhi køør ciik moï kiper mana tïïyï cwïnya ni leer.
english: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwöny aani ki man cäädha køør ciik moï, nee gwøa na bäre bäre.
english: Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

anywaa: Mooc aani ki leec wïc, nee ciik moï gwøa, ni bëëtge ni yaa gwøø ki cwïnya bäre.
english: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

anywaa: Bwøth aani ki jöör ciik moï, kiper a bëëdö ni yia met ki ge.
english: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

anywaa: Løø cwïnya køør ciik moï, ni paa køør jap kwär.
english: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

anywaa: Män nyeŋŋa ki raŋ gïï mo oballe jaak, ni cäŋï a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør luummï.
english: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

anywaa: Wëëk luummï thur kare jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper niï lwäär.
english: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

anywaa: Daak ajøøŋ bääta mana lwäära ki gø, kiper luup ŋøl moï beege karge.
english: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a bëëdö naa lääŋŋa pwöc moï; cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør adïëri marï.
english: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man nyoothï mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl jïra, ni piemï aani ki køør luummï.
english: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

anywaa: Køøre nø, a jïtö ki gïn mo løøa løø jï jø wø jøøŋ aani, kiper luummï yaa gum cwïnya.
english: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

anywaa: Kär luum adïëri daagï dhaa, kiper a ŋäätha luup ŋøl moï.
english: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

anywaa: Ni ö ciiki moï ni bëëde naa gwøga geni, ni gwøa geni na bäre bäre;
english: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

anywaa: ni bëëda naa cäädhi ka kany mo leer, kiper man wø bëëda naa manynya pwöc moï.
english: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

anywaa: Ciik moï ocaana jï nyeye, ni wïïa ba laay.
english: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

anywaa: Aani, a bëëdö ni yia met ki ciik moï, na mëëra ki geni.
english: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa wøøra ciik moï na mëëra ki ge, ni bëëda naa cädö bäätge.
english: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

anywaa: Par wïïï ki luumma caanï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, ni beeye luumma mooyï aani ki ŋäädhe ki køøre.
english: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

anywaa: Gïn wø cøm cwïnya kany wø ena yïth gïï mo leth beeye en: a wø mooyï mooø ki kwøw ki køør luummï.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

anywaa: Jø atöör bëëdö ni buua aani døc kiree, 'ba a bäŋ wø gaa wøk ki ri ciik moï.
english: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö naa lääŋŋa luup moa ŋølï ya acääŋŋe cøøn, ni bëëtge ni ge cøma cwïnya.
english: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

anywaa: Yia aliel døc kaamar maac ki jø raay, ge na kwier ciik moï.
english: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

anywaa: Ciik moï bëëdö na dudi jïra, kany bëëda yie en ni aana wëëllö.
english: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a wø bëëdö naa lääŋŋa nyeŋŋï ki dï wäär, ni bëëda naa gwøga ciik moï.
english: I have remembered thy name, O Lord, in the night, and have kept thy law.

anywaa: Bëëtö mara beeye en: a bëëdö naa gwøga pwöc moï.
english: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ï na kura; aana kööŋ ki man gwøa luupï.
english: Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni ki cwïnya bäre; nyooth mëër marï jïra ki køør luummï.
english: I entreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.

anywaa: Aana cädö kiper bëëtö mara; køøre raa aløøa ki man cäädha køør ciik moï.
english: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

anywaa: Aana laar läät bäät ciik moï, naa kär ruu ki man gwøa ge.
english: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø aana cekge ka abïëp, 'ba wïïa kär wïl ki ciik moï.
english: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

anywaa: Ki dhöör wäär a wø ööa maal naa dwøga met ec jïrï kiper luup ŋøl moï na näk adïëri.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

anywaa: Aana nyawat jø wø lwäär ki ïïni bëët, jø wø caath køør pwöc moï.
english: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, piny päŋ ki gø bäre; pwöny aani ki ciik moï.
english: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna bëëdö niï tïïya gïï mo beyø jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, ki køør luummï.
english: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

anywaa: Pwöny aani nee wïïa tïme ni leer, nee gïna beer ki gïna raac jiera, kiper a bëëdö naa ŋäätha ciik moï.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

anywaa: Kanya pooda ni gïïa leth kära jwørø, aano gaa wøk; 'ba ennø, a bëëdö ni luummï yaa gwøø.
english: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï beer ni tïïe moï beyø; pwöny aani ki ciik moï.
english: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Jø atöör aana rwøthge jaak ki luup tööt, 'ba a bëëdö naa gwøga pwöc moï ki cwïnya bäre.
english: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

anywaa: Ge bëëdö ni cwïnyge teek, 'ba aani, a bëëdö ni yia met ki ciik moï.
english: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

anywaa: Mana jwøra gïï mo leth atïmö na gïn mo beer kipera, kiper nee ciik moï kwanya.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

anywaa: Ciik moa caanï ki dhiï perge leth jïra, ni kaala warkey ki gwet-bïrö mo ba kwaan.
english: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

anywaa: Aana cwääyï ki cerï ni këëllï tiera piny; mooc a ki leec wïc nee ciik moï kwanya.
english: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

anywaa: Jø wø lwäär ki ïïni, bëëtö mara ojootge ni mïn yïthge, kiper a ŋäätha luummï.
english: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋääa ni luup ŋøl moï beege karge, ni ŋääa ni marï beeye adïëri na wëëgï aani jwør gïï mo leth.
english: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

anywaa: Beerra man ö mëërri marï ni wø ba jøøl ni cøm cwïnya, ki køør luummï na caanï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï.
english: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.

anywaa: Beerra man nyoothï mëër marï jïra, kiper naa kwøa, kiper yia mïnni ka ciik moï.
english: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

anywaa: Beerra man lää wïth jø atöör, kiper na katge dhaa ki jap tööt; 'ba aani, a bëëdö naa cädö bäät pwöc moï.
english: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jø wø lwäär ki ïïni ni duuge baŋa, jø wø ŋäc ciik moï.
english: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

anywaa: Beerra man gwøa ciik moï ki cwïnya bäre, nee wïïa ba lääe.
english: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

anywaa: Aana ööl naa koora man piemï aani; 'ba a poot bëëdö naa ŋäätha luummï.
english: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

anywaa: Waŋa atal jöö køør luummï, ni kööa, na «?A yi wäne noo cømï cwïnya?»
english: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

anywaa: Këël na tïma kaamar opïr pïën mo oraany jïrö, wïïa kär wïl ki ciik moï.
english: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

anywaa: ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëda, a na dhaanhnhï, naa kurö? ?Na yi wäne noo ŋølï luup bäät jø wø caan aani?
english: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

anywaa: Jø atöör gena kunyö ki buri kipera, jø wø ba caath køør ciik moï.
english: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

anywaa: Ciik moï bëët beege adïëri; køny aani, kiper aana caange ki luup tööt.
english: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

anywaa: Dööŋŋa kany mo thiinh ki man 'näkge aani bäät piny, 'ba aani pwöc moï kära wiiø.
english: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

anywaa: Cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl; køøre ciik moï gwøa gwøø.
english: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, luummï tiere okëët piny maal, ni bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

anywaa: Adïëri marï bëëdö ni nut yïth beenhnhe bëët; piny acïbï kare ni teek, ni put bëëtö kare.
english: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

anywaa: Ki køør luup ŋøl moï, jammi bëët bëëdö kwörge këël dïcäŋi ennø, kiper jammi bëët bëënna ïïni.
english: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

anywaa: Doo na a kär bëëdö ni yia met ki ciik moï, a doo ränynyö ki gïïa jwøra na leth.
english: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

anywaa: Aani wïïa ba wïl ki pwöc moï na bäre bäre, kiper aana cäŋï mooyø ki kwøw ki køørge.
english: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

anywaa: Aana dhaanhnhï; piem aani, kiper man wø bëëda naa manynya pwöc moï.
english: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø koora aani nee jwïëya raanyge, 'ba a bëëdö naa cädö bäät ciik moï.
english: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

anywaa: Ajooda ni jammi bëët da cuŋge, 'ba ciik moï bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, yia met ki ciik moï døc, naa bëëdö naa cädö bäätge ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

anywaa: Ciik moï a wø moocge mooø ki leec wïc mo kaala mar nyïïmänna, kiper ciik moøgø nutö buuta cooth.
english: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

anywaa: Aana tïmö ni wïïa leer naa kaala dïpööye 'moa bëët, kiper mana bëëda naa lääŋŋa gïïa caanï.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

anywaa: Wïïa atïmö ni leer ni kaala wïth jøøa døøŋŋø, kiper pwöc moï yaa gwøø.
english: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

anywaa: Raa yaa mänö ki jïëth bëëtö moa reyø bëët, kiper nee luummï gwøa.
english: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

anywaa: A kär gaa wøk ki ri luup ŋøl moï, kiper beeye ïïni ki dëërï na pwöny aani.
english: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

anywaa: Luummï bëëdö ni met jïra døc, ni bëëde ni ŋweeth dhaa ni kaala maar kïc.
english: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

anywaa: Leec wïc wø jooda joodø ki køør ciik moï; kiper manøgønø, a män ki jïëth tööt bëët.
english: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, luummï caala lamba mo meenya nyïma, ni bëëde ni caala tar mo meenya jööra.
english: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

anywaa: Aano nø kööŋ kiper naa cäädha køør luup ŋøl moï na näk adïëri, naa puta bëëtö naa tïïya geni cooth.
english: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana cännö døc; 'ba cøm cwïnya ki køør luummï.
english: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny luumma man wø pwøa ïïni ki gø, ni pwönynyï aani ki køør luup ŋøl moï.
english: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

anywaa: A bëëdö yïthakic kwøw ki thøø cooth, 'ba wïïa bäŋ wø wïl ki ciik moï.
english: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø aana cekge ka abïëp, 'ba a kär gaa wøk ri pwöc moï.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

anywaa: Gïïa caanï atïmö na 'moa na bäre bäre, kiper beeye geni ni wø døøc cwïnya mo met.
english: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

anywaa: Cwïnya acïba køør ciik moï, kiper nee gwøa na bäre bäre këël aŋuun kwøw mara.
english: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

anywaa: A män ki jiy mo wïdö yïthakic acaare ariiø, 'ba a mëër ki ciik moï.
english: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

anywaa: Beeye ïïni ni wø kana raa buute, ni beeye ï na kwöt leny mara; naa bëëdö naa ŋäätha luummï.
english: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

anywaa: U jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø, daagu rou buuta, kiper nee ciik mo Jwøk mara nee gwøa.
english: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

anywaa: Jøl aani ki køør luummï, kiper naa kwøa, ni kär niï wëëga ŋäädhe mara duunnö ki lään wïc bääta.
english: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

anywaa: Jøl aani, kiper naa piem, nee ciik moï wøøra cooth.
english: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

anywaa: Jø wø gaa wøk bëët ri ciik moï kwierï kwierø, kiper cwøk moge bäŋ gïn duue.
english: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø bäät piny bëët wø wetï wøk kaamar juu; kiper manøgønø, a mëër ki ciik moï.
english: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

anywaa: Dëëra atïmö ni kwanynyi kiper mana lwäya ki ïïni, naa bëëdö naa lwäär ki luup ŋøl moï.
english: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

anywaa: Aani luup wø ŋøla ŋølø na karge, naa tïïya adïëri; kär a wiiï ceŋ jø wø thiel aani piny.
english: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

anywaa: Gwøk aani, a na dhaanhnhï, naa jïta ki bëëtö mo beer; män jø atöör naa ba thielge piny.
english: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

anywaa: Waŋa atal jöö naa koora pïëm marï, ki luummï na beer.
english: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

anywaa: Gïïo tïïyï jïra, a na dhaanhnhï, tïïyï ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, ni pwönynyï aani ki ciik moï.
english: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Aana dhaanhnhï; mooc aani ki leec wïc, kiper nee tiet ciik moï nee ŋääa.
english: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beeye kar tïïc marï gø ennø, kiper jiy ciik moï aŋølge.
english: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, aani a mëër ki ciik moï, ni kaala warkey, këël warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a bëëdö ni aano jïëy ni pwöc moï bëët beege karge, ni bëëda naa män ki jïëth tööt bëët.
english: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

anywaa: Ciik moï rëëma ec; kiper manøgønø, geni gwøa gwøø.
english: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

anywaa: Ki man kwany tiet luupï cïpö ki tar, ni cïpö ki leec wïc jï jøøa näk poot bäŋ gïn ŋäcge.
english: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

anywaa: A bëëdö ni aano wär ni dhaa yaa ŋaamø, naa lääŋŋa ciik moï.
english: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

anywaa: Luu wïïï baŋa ni nyoothï mëër marï jïra, kaawat man wø tïïyï jï jø wø mëër ki ïïni.
english: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

anywaa: Bwøth aani ki køør luummï, naa ba bööt raayi.
english: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

anywaa: Käl aani wøk ceŋ jø wø thiel jiy piny, kiper nee pwöc moï gwøa.
english: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

anywaa: Wëëk tac täärnyïmï rieny bääta, a na dhaanhnhï en, ni pwönynyï aani ki ciik moï.
english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

anywaa: Pï nyeŋŋa bëëdö ni lwöra piny kaamar pï naam, kiper jiy bëëdö ni ciik moï ba gwøkge.
english: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni marï beer, ni luup ŋøl moï thïïŋ.
english: Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

anywaa: Ciik moa cïpï beyø, ni beege ciik ma adïëri døc.
english: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

anywaa: Aana këëyö na bäre bäre, kiper mana ö nyïïmänna na wecge luummï.
english: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

anywaa: Luummï tøŋ ni caala gïn mo otwønø, ni bëëda, a na dhaanhnhï, naa mëër ki gø.
english: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

anywaa: A bëëdö ni kara thiinh ni aano taaø, 'ba wïïa ba wïl ki pwöc moï.
english: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

anywaa: Bëënynyö marï beeye bëënynyö mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ciik moï beege adïëri.
english: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

anywaa: Gïï mo leth aö bääta, ni bëëda naa rämö, 'ba a poot bëëdö ni yia met ki ciik moï.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

anywaa: Ciik moï bëëdö na adïëri na bäre bäre; mooc aani ki leec wïc naa bëëda naa kwøw.
english: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a jwöŋö dëërï ki cwïnya bäre; wïny mara; aani ciik moï gwøa gwøø.
english: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Lord: I will keep thy statutes.

anywaa: A jwöŋö dëërï; piem aani; aani ciik moï gwøa gwøø.
english: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

anywaa: A wø ööa maal ni øw poodi ni kwaa ïïni, naa ŋäätha luup moï.
english: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋa lwieny ki wäär bäre, naa bëëdö naa cädö bäät luup moï.
english: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny dwøra ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, ni cäŋï a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør luup ŋøl moï.
english: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

anywaa: Jø wø caath køør gïï mo reyø, gena nyänhnhö; geni karge bäyö ki ciik moï.
english: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni karï cään, ni ciik moï bëët beege adïëri.
english: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

anywaa: Kanya kwanya ciik moï kany mo bäär, aŋääa ni tietge okëët piny na bäre bäre.
english: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

anywaa: Neen caannø mara ni kønyï aani, kiper wïïa bäŋ wø wïl ki ciik moï.
english: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

anywaa: Ŋun aani ni piemï aani, ni cäŋï a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør luummï.
english: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø karge bäär ki pïëm man wø piem jiy ki gø, kiper ciik moï ba manyge.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï dwøŋ; cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør luup ŋøl moï.
english: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

anywaa: Jø wø caan aani ki jø wø män ki aani thööth, 'ba a bäŋ wø gaa wøk ki ri ciik moï.
english: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

anywaa: Jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ki piny raŋŋa naa ba many dëëtge, kiper luummï bäŋ wø gwøkge.
english: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, raŋ mëër man mëëra ki pwöc moï ki gø en; cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

anywaa: Luup moï bëët beege adïëri; luup ŋøl moï na beyø bëët bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

anywaa: Kwääri a caange caannø ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere, 'ba a bëëdö naa wøøra luupï ki yi cwïnya.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

anywaa: Yia wø mïnni ka luummï kaawat man wø mïn yi ŋat mo o ojïtö ki jap twëër mo thööth.
english: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

anywaa: A män ki tööt, ni yia raac ki gø døc; 'ba a mëër ki ciik moï.
english: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

anywaa: Ï wø pwøa pwøø ki kwöre abïriiø ki yi cäŋ kiper luup ŋøl moï na beyø.
english: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

anywaa: Jø wø mëër ki ciik moï, jïge da jwöm mo päl ki cwïnyge, ni ge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn mo cwaany tietge.
english: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö naa koora ïïni naa piemï, naa bëëdö naa kïtha ciik moï bäät tïïc.
english: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa gwøga ciik moï, naa mëër ki geni døc.
english: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa gwøga pwöc moï ki ciik moï, kiper bëëtö mara bäre ŋäyï.
english: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man wïnynyï oduuc kwac mara; mooc aani ki leec wïc ki køør luummï.
english: Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

anywaa: Beerra man wïnynyï kwac mara, ni piemï aani ki køør luummï.
english: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

anywaa: Beerra man ö dhaa ni pwøc ïïni, kiper man wø pwönynyï aani ki ciik moï.
english: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

anywaa: Beerra man wära ki duut kiper luummï, kiper ciik moï bëët beyø.
english: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëdï ni riï iï jiiŋŋø ki man kønyï aani, kiper pwöc moï yaa jierø.
english: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a bëëdö naa lääŋŋa ïïni naa piemï; met ec wø jooda ka ri ciik moï.
english: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëda naa kwøw kiper nee ï wø pwøa, ni bëët luup ŋøl moï ni køønynya aani.
english: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö naa thääyö kaamar diel mo orwäänyö, many aani, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper wïïa bäŋ wø wïl ki ciik moï.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

anywaa: Aana jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk kanya ena yïth gïï mo leth, ni ö eni ni wïny mara.
english: In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, piem aani ceŋ jø wø car tööt, ki ceŋ jø wø car cwøk.
english: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

anywaa: ?Uuni ni wø car cwøk, gïno tägi dëëtu ŋäyu? Gïno tägi dëëtu beeye en:
english: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

anywaa: Athëëre mo ŋat leny mo dhøkge beth ki cuk mo wärri mo ba laar thøø opïï dëëtu.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

anywaa: Bëëtö mara atïmö ni leth, ni tïme keda a bëëdö dï jø Möcak ki jø Këdar.
english: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ki kany mo bäär dï jø wø män ki bëët-mëër.
english: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

anywaa: Aani a manynya bëët-mëër, 'ba kany wø cääna kiper bëëtmëër, ge manynya leny.
english: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

anywaa: A wø lwïthö ni neena kïte; ?aŋø, køny mara wø käl kaa ŋø?
english: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

anywaa: Køny mara wø käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

anywaa: Eni tierï ba wëëk ceec; eni ni wø koor ïïni ba nanni.
english: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

anywaa: Eni ni wø koor jø Icriel ba nanni, ni eni bäŋ wø buti.
english: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni wø koor ïïni; Wuuö Jwøk beeye na gëëŋi marï.
english: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

anywaa: Ï ba 'näk cäŋŋi ki dïcäŋ, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo tägi dëërï ki dï wäär.
english: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ï di koorø dhøk gïï mo reyø bëët; eni jwïëy moï di koorø.
english: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ï di koorø kany wø aaï wøk paarï ki kany wø duuï paarï, kaa man bëëde ennø, këël bäre bäre.
english: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

anywaa: Yia atïmö ni met kanya kö jiyi ki aani, ni «Waa cøø Øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, wa nut ennø, ni wa cuŋŋö dhi kiir marï.
english: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.

anywaa: Jerucalem ogeerø na pääny mo dwala jiy na aciel,
english: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

anywaa: ni beeye kany wø ci wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel yie, ni beege wïth tuŋi mo Wuuö Jwøk, nee met ec dwøkge jï Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør ciik mana no ocaanø jïge.
english: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni beeye kanya en wälu mar dhi øt Deebit yie, ni nyeya bëëdö bääte ni ŋøla luup.
english: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

anywaa: Lämu kiper Jerucalem nee bëëde ki bëët-mëër. Ï na Jerucalem, jø wø mëër ki ïïni, ge jïtö ki bëëtö mo beer.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

anywaa: Jø wø bëëdö yi kiir marï, ge jïtö ki bëët-mëër, ni bëët jiyi no ogwøø yi kiir marï na teek.
english: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

anywaa: A cädö kiper nyïïmëëga ki nyïïawäätwa, ni kööa, ni «Ï na Jerucalem, bëëtmëër en jïrï.»
english: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

anywaa: Bëënynyö marï manynya manynyø, kiper nee Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, nee bëëde.
english: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

anywaa: Ïïni ni wø bëëdö maal, nyeŋŋa ataa maal baŋï.
english: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö jø tïïci wø neetge cer kwäärö marge, kaawat man wø ö dhaaŋ tïïci wø neet cer nyijø wø tïnynye, waani thuwø, wa neeta jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, këël mano nyoothï mëër marï jïwa.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

anywaa: Nyooth mëër marï jïwa, wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyooth mëër marï jïwa, kiper ajøøŋ mar jiy atïmö ni päl bäätwa.
english: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

anywaa: Waano ööl døc ka abuua mar jøøa no ojäŋ, ka ajøøŋ mar jø atöör.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

anywaa: Doo na paa Wuuö Jwøk na en kurø, u jø Icriel, u doo köö na ennø,
english: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

anywaa: ni «Doo na paa Wuuö Jwøk na en kurø, kar kaace jøøa määnynyö baŋø,
english: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

anywaa: na näk yïthge oliel kaamar maac ki øøni, ø dige løønyø ni ø nëënö.
english: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

anywaa: Kar kaace ø doo tïmö kaamar jiy mo okøøl jwïïe, ni di wïthø dïdö kaamar jiy mo omwøny naammi,
english: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

anywaa: ni døø tïmö kaamar jiy mo okøøl odhänynyi.»
english: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, na kär ø wëëk geni nee ø jeecge ki lakge.
english: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

anywaa: Øøna päär wøk ceŋge kaamar wenyø mo pär wøk ka ya abïëp mo ocek ŋat dwaarri; abïëp atoor, ni päärø wøk.
english: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

anywaa: Køny marø wø käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

anywaa: Jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge ege gum Wuuö Jwøk, ge bëëdö ni ge caala Kïn Dhayan, ni wø bëëdö kare na bäre bäre ni ba dak.
english: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

anywaa: Kaawat man bëët kïte ni Jerucalem ege ciel dïër en, Wuuö Jwøk jiye ee ciel dïër, kaa man bëëde ennø, këël bäre bäre.
english: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

anywaa: Akwöma mo ena ceŋ jøøa reyø ba ruu yïth ŋøøpa cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï jøøa beyø, kiper nee jøøa beyø tïïe mo reyø ba kwanyge.
english: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, tïïï ki gïn mo beer jï jøøa beyø, jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge thïïŋ.
english: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø gaa uutjïëthe moa reyø, geno riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk na aciel ki jø wø tïïc gïïa reyø. Bëët-mëër oen bäät jø Icriel.
english: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the Lord shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.

anywaa: Kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na duu jø Dhayan moa no omaaø ki tøŋ, waana tïmö kede marwa lääk.
english: When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

anywaa: Kar kaace waana ŋeethø ki ŋeethø mo dwøŋ døc, ni kwöŋwa ki met ec. 'Ba kar kaace wïth juurre aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk atïïö ki gïn mo dwøŋ kiper jø Dhayan.»
english: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk atïïö ki gïn mo dwøŋ kiperwa møn, ni tïm yïthwa ni met.
english: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cäŋ bëëtö marwa dwøk kare, kaawat man wø ö køthi wø pääŋ yïth näpa no otal.
english: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

anywaa: Jø wø pïïdhö ni pï nyeŋge øya piny, geno kääö ni yïthge met.
english: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ci wøk baŋ pïïdhö ni jwöŋö ni käära köödhi mo piidhe, oduu paayø ni yie met, ni käära ŋaaŋe.
english: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

anywaa: Ni näk mo øtø ba geera Wuuö Jwøki, jø geer ööla dëëtge jaak; ni näk mo pääny ba koora Wuuö Jwøki, ŋat koor ööla dëëre jaak.
english: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

anywaa: U këël dou mööla wøk ka amöölla cøøn, ni tïïu këël dhöör wäär kiper nou jïtu ki jammi, u ööla rou jaak, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jø wø mëëre ki geni wø di mooø ki niine.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk bee eni ni wø mooc jiy ko obwöre, mo nywøl ka ec, ni cïbe na gwïëth.
english: Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

anywaa: Obwöre mo wø nywøl dhaanhe ni eni poot thiinh laara kunynyö dëëre, ni caala athëëre mo ena cer ŋat leny.
english: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

anywaa: Meta yi ŋat mo jïre da obwöre mo thööth. Teeŋ ŋatøgø nø, eni ba bööti kany wø cääne ki nyïïmän moe kar løøk.
english: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö ni ge lwäära Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jø wø caath jööre.
english: Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

anywaa: Ki køør tïïc mano tïïyï, ïïno jïti ki cam, ni mïn yiï, ni tïm bëëtö marï ni beer.
english: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

anywaa: Cïïï otïmö kaamar jaath mo duunnö ki nyïëdi paarï, ni tïm obwöre moï ni thööth ya akaaŋ.
english: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, manøgø beeye gwïëth, beeye gwïëth man wø joot ŋat wø bëëdö ni lwäära Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ïïno gwïëdhe ki yi Dhayan, ni jootï bëëny Dhayan, eni na Jerucalem, ki yïth nïr kwøw moï bëët.
english: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

anywaa: Obwöre moo nywøl nyïïï jootï joodø. Bëët-mëër oen bäät jø Icriel.
english: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.

anywaa: Ø jø Icriel, ø doo köö na ennø, ni «Øøna caanni døc ki mana täk paaci cøøn.»
english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, øøna caanni døc ki mana täk paaci cøøn, 'ba ø kär böötö.
english: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

anywaa: Øøna tïmö kaamar jiy mo opwödö, mo dïŋäthge ocöötö, kaamar pwödhö mo okwuö.
english: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk beer; øøna päde ceŋ jøøa reyø.
english: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

anywaa: Jø wø män ki Dhayan, beerra man døøge ŋäthge ni wïthge olääö.
english: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

anywaa: Beerra man tïmge ni caala luum mo otuy wïth uudi, ni wø laar talø ni poot kär døøŋŋø;
english: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

anywaa: ni wø ba løny ki nyaar, ni wø ba twöc na wïc.
english: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø cør buutge, kär nee ge köö, ni «Gwïëth Wuuö Jwøk en bäätu.» Ni ba köge thuwø, ni «Wa gwïëtha uuni ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, kiper a ena yïth gïï mo leth døc.
english: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny dwøra, ni cegï ïthï ki kwac mara.
english: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, doo na ï bëëdö niï kwara gïïa näk obøth, aŋa na doo maar cuŋŋö nyïmï ni ree bäŋ ajäla?
english: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

anywaa: 'Ba ï wø bëëdö niï wëënna jiy, kiper nee bëëtge ni ge wøøra ïïni.
english: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa koora Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnya bäre, ni luumme yaa ŋäädhö.
english: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

anywaa: A bëëdö naa koora Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnya bäre, ni kaala man wø ö jø koorri wø manyge øw nee laar ruuö; adïëri møn, dïkuye moøgø yaa kaalø ki koor.
english: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Icriel, bëëdu nou ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, kiper mëër mo ba jøøl joota baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni køny mo dwøŋ ena baŋe.
english: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

anywaa: Eni jø Icriel owïïl wøk yïth gïïa bacge bëët.
english: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ atöör cwïnya, ni jiy kära raŋ piny; ni aani, wïïa kära kierø ki tïï gïï mo døøŋŋø mo teek mo kaala acaara mara.
english: Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

anywaa: 'Ba cwïnya yaa cïp piny ni aano nikïïl, naa caala nyilaal mo omänö ki caak, mo bëëdö kö menni ni cwïnye ee cïp piny.
english: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, bëëdu nou ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, kaa man bëëde ennø, këël bäre bäre.
english: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär wïïï wïl ki Deebit, ki gïïa leth bëët na pïï dëëre,
english: Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

anywaa: ki gïna kööŋe ki gø jïrï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwø Jeekap na teek, na kööe,
english: How he sware unto the Lord, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

anywaa: na «A ba døny yi øtø mara, naa ba ci kar niine mara;
english: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

anywaa: nyeŋŋa ba wëëga niine, ni ba nanna,
english: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

anywaa: këël mano jïta ki kar bëëtö jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwø Jeekap na teek.»
english: Until I find out a place for the Lord, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, acanduk mar Wuuö Jwøk gïr gø awïny kwäyø ni ge ena Eeparata, ni jootge gø yi ŋööm jø Kiriat- Jeerim, ni kälge gø Jerucalem.
english: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man cøø kar bëëtö mare, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wøørø eni kanya näk køøm tiete.
english: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal ni ciï kar bëëtö marï, ïïni, ka acanduk ni wø nyooth teek marï.
english: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

anywaa: Beerra man ö dïlämme moï ni røøge bëënynyö dëëtge, ni ö jiyï mo wø cwïnyge en køørï ni kwöŋge ki met ec.
english: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør luumma caanï jï dhaanhnhï ma Deebit, kär täärnyïmï kanï ki nyeya mana røønyï.
english: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

anywaa: Ïïna kööŋ jï Deebit ki kööŋ ma adïëri, miï ba døø ŋääï ki gø, na kööï, ni «Nyec ocïba jï ŋat mo käla dëërï.
english: The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

anywaa: Ni näk jøw okäl dëërï luumma tuuda gwøkge gwøø, ki ciik 'moa moo pwönynya geni ki ge, jøw okäl dëëtge thuwø nyec cøøa jïge na bäre bäre.»
english: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan ee jierø; ni eni manynya gø na kar bëëtö mare, ni kööe,
english: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

anywaa: ni «Man beeye kar bëëtö mara na bäre bäre; a bëëdö kany, kiper a manynya gø.
english: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

anywaa: Dhayan gwïëdha gwïëdhö ni tïm cammi ni päl yie, ni wëëga jøøa can moa en yie jäŋö.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

anywaa: Dïlämme moe owëëga ŋäc pïëm man wø piem jiy ki gø, ni ö jiye mo wø cwïnyge en køøra ni kwöŋge ki met ec.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

anywaa: Kaace a röönyö ki dhaanhø mo teek mo käla ri Deebit, aani, a tïŋŋa maal ki nyikwaare mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

anywaa: Nyïïmän moe lään wïc orøøa dëëtge kaamar abïï, 'ba eni, aduda mare obëëdö ni paŋŋi.»
english: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, beeye gïn mo beer mo duunnö ki met ec ki man bëët nyïïmëëe ki cwïny aciel.
english: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

anywaa: Ni teeŋ gïnögø caala maar rööny mana pere leth na thii wï Aran, na øc piny ki bäät jïëc dhee, na tøøn bäät abïï mare.
english: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

anywaa: Ni teeŋ gïnögø caala man ö thööyi moa thööth na en bäät Kïn Armön ni joodi bäät Kïn Dhayan. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk gwëëdhö ka kaace, ni gwïëth manøgø beeye kwøw mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

anywaa: Uuni bëët ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk ki wäär yi øtø mare, ööu ni pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Thaaŋu ceŋŋu maal yi øtø mare na en kur keere, ni pwøyu eni na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk uuno gwïëdhe ki yi Dhayan, eni na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Pwøyu nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk; pwøyu eni, u na jic Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.

anywaa: uuni ni en Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni en dï kal mare, eni na Jwøk marø.
english: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, kiper Wuuö Jwøk beer, pwøyu nyeŋŋe ki dudi, kiper beeye gïn mo mïërö.
english: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk nyïïkwaac Jeekap ee jierø kiper dëëre, ni beege jø Icriel na näk thööge.
english: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

anywaa: Aani ŋääa ni Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ, ni eni na Jwøk marø kaala juu bëët.
english: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk gïn wø met yie ki gø di tïïö maalø ki piny, ki yïth näpa døøŋŋø ki yïth kudi bëët.
english: Whatsoever the Lord pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

anywaa: Maal wø mooe mooø ki pøøl bäät piny bäre; ni tïïc køth nee pädhe ni mal, ni wëëk jamø kwön wøk ki yi kany wø kan gø yi gø.
english: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

anywaa: Eni kaai moa nywøl Ijep bëët anääe, ni beege jiy ki lääc paac bëët.
english: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

anywaa: Ena tïïö ki nyuuthe ki gïï mo rëëma ec dï Ijep, ni tïïe bäät Peerø ki jiye bëët.
english: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

anywaa: Eni tiet mïëri mo thööth araanynye, ni 'näk nyeye moa teek,
english: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

anywaa: ni beege Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, ki Ög nyeny Baacan, ki nyeye mo mïëc Keenan bëët;
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

anywaa: ni cïp ŋøøm moge jï jiye ma jø Icriel nee tïmge na moge.
english: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyeŋŋï bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni bëëdï niï ŋäc ki yïth beenhnhe bëët, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jiye di ŋunnö, ni eni cwïnye wø pädhö ki gïrge.
english: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

anywaa: Gïï wø lam wïth juurre wø tïïc ka warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ni beege gïï mo tïïya jiyi ki ceŋge.
english: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

anywaa: Gïïögø jïge da dhøgi, 'ba ge ba luubö; ni jïge da nyeŋŋi, 'ba ge ba nëënö.
english: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

anywaa: Jïge da ïdhi, 'ba ge ba wïnyö; ni ge ba jwïëy.
english: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

anywaa: Jøøa tïïc geni otïmö ni bäŋ teek jïge ni caala geni, këël jøw bëët mo wø ŋääth geni.
english: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk. Wui, u na jø dhi øt Aran,  pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

anywaa: Wui, u na jø dhi øt Libay,  pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk. Uuni ni wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem na näk kar bëëtö mare. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni beer, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Jwøk, eni na wïth juu bëët, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jïre, eni na kwääc kwääri bëët, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni, kiper bee eni keere ni wø tïïc gïï mo rëëma ec, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na cwääc maal ki køør leec wïïe, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na cwää piny bäät pïï, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na cwääc gïïa døøŋŋø ni wø cïpi ki tar, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: Cäŋ acïbe nee rienye ki waŋcäŋ, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni cïp dwääy ki ceer nee rienyge ki wäär, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na dïïr wïth kaai mo jø Ijep, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: Eni jø Icriel akäl wøk ki dï jø Ijep, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni ge käl wøk ka køør teek bade na dwøŋ, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na pääŋ pï Naama Kwaar ki dïëre, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni tïïc jø Icriel nee pööthge ki dïëre, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: 'ba Peerø ki jø leny moe aleeŋ yi Naama Kwaar, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na bwøth jiye ki dï paap, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni na dïïr wïth nyeye moa døøŋŋø, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: Eni nyeye moa teek anääe, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni beeye Cëëwön nyeny jø Amör, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ki Ög nyeny Baacan, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni cïp ŋøøm moge jï jiye nee tïmge na moge, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre;
english: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: ni put ŋøøpøgø dööŋŋe jïge, ge na jø Icriel, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Bee eni na cädö kiperø kanya bëëdø ni øøno dwøk piny, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

anywaa: Ni bee eni na käl øøni wøk ceŋ nyïïmän moø, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Eni cam wø cïbe cïbö jï gïïa kwøw bëët, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Dwøgu met ec jï Jwø maal, kiper mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

anywaa: Waana pï piny bäät näp Babiløn ni jwöŋwa kanya caarwa gïr Dhayan.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

anywaa: Thøme mowa alïërwa maal røk jenni paanøgø.
english: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa mak waani ki tøŋ, ge manynya man wärwa ki dudi jïge kaace, ni ö geni na caan waani ni manyge dut met ec baŋwa, ni köge, ni «Wärru jïwa ki duut pou ma Dhayan.»
english: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, duut mar Wuuö Jwøk owärwa gø nidïï ni wa ena po juurre?
english: How shall we sing the Lord's song in a strange land?

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jerucalem, ni näk mo wïïa owïl ki ïïni, wär cer cwïïa bäbe.
english: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jerucalem, ni näk mo aano tïmö naa ba lääŋ ïïni, ni ba guma ïïni cwïnya ni kaala jap wø met yia ki ge bëët, leeba wär tal maal.
english: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, par wïïï ki gïna tïïc jø Ëdömmi dïcäŋa päth Jerucalemmi; kiper gena kwöŋŋö ni köge, ni «Nyaau paanøgø piny, nyaau paanøgø piny, këël mano ränynye na bäre bäre.»
english: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

anywaa: U na jø Babiløn, u ni wø räänyö, gwïëth en jï ŋato cool kwör dëëtu, noo tïïö dëëtu ki teeŋ gïna tïïyu dëëtwa.
english: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋato jaaŋ obwöre mou moa therø, ni gøc geni ki ri kïte.
english: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, met ec duua duuö jïrï ki cwïnya bäre, ni wära ki dut pwøc jïrï nyïm juu mo juurre.
english: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

anywaa: Cøŋŋa këëlla piny ni nyïma yaa løø baŋ øtø marï na en kur keere, ni pwøa nyeŋŋï kiper mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ka adïëri marï; kiper nyeŋŋï ki luummï atïŋï maal bäät jammi bëët.
english: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

anywaa: Dïcäŋa kwaa ïïni, mara aløgï jïra, ni mooyï aani ki teek ni jït cwïnya ki cer.
english: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyeye mo bäät piny bëët met ec duuge duuö jïrï, ki køør mano wïnyge luummo caanï ki dhiï,
english: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

anywaa: ni wärge ki dudi kiper gïïa tïïyï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ajiem marï dwøŋ.
english: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord.

anywaa: Këël na bëët Wuuö Jwøki ni kare dwøŋ, eni poot bëëdö ni raŋŋa jøøa kwörge bäŋgø; 'ba mar jø atöör ŋääe këël na bëëtge ni kwörge bäyö.
english: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

anywaa: Këël a doo bëëdö naa ena yïth gïï mo leth, jwïëya poot gwøgï gwøø; cerï wø rwieyï rwieø ni joogï wëër mar nyïïmänna, ni piemï aani ki teek badï.
english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk gïïo manynye kipera tïïe tïïö ni thurge karge. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre; Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär gïna tägï ki tïïc wiiï piny.
english: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cwïnya adarï ni ŋäyï bëëtö mara.
english: O Lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

anywaa: Pïïnna piny ki öönynya maal ŋäyï, na acaara mara ŋäyï kany wø poode ni poot kär tägö.
english: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

anywaa: Wääth mara ki nyaaŋ dëëra piny wø neetï neetø, ni jöör bëëtö mara bäre ŋäyï.
english: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, këël kany wø poode ni luubö poot kär tuny wøk ki dhaa, luummögø ŋäyï na bäre.
english: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.

anywaa: A iï ciel dïër, ni cerï iï peeth bääta.
english: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋäc mana ŋäyï aani, yia rëëm ki gø; ni tiere teek døc, ni ba løny jïra ki man kwanya gø.
english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a kaa ŋø nø noo cøøa yie ni jwïëy moï tøør yie? ?Naa kaa nø noo reŋŋa yie naa ŋwieya ïïni?
english: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

anywaa: Ni näk maa cøøa maal, ï nut yie. Ni näk maa cøøa kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ï poot nut kaace thuwø.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

anywaa: Këël a doo määtö kaamar wenyø naa tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, naa cøøa jï kur pänh-cäŋ,
english: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

anywaa: a poot bwøthï bwødhø kaace, ni jølï aani ki teek marï.
english: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

anywaa: Ni näk maa köö, na «A gëëŋ muudhe gëëŋö, ni tïm tarri mana en buuta na muudhö,»
english: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

anywaa: ki baŋï muudhö ba cøl, ni wäär tar ni caala waŋcäŋ, kiper muudhö ki tar bëët röömi ki baŋï.
english: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, thäk dëëra bëët tïïya ïïni, ni cwääyï aani ni tïma ni aana dhaanhø yi mera.
english: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

anywaa: Ï pwøa pwøø, kiper aana cwääc ki cwääc mo rëëma ec miï di lwäärö ki køøre. Tïïe moï thääŋa ec møn, ni beeye gïna ŋääa døc na adïëri.
english: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

anywaa: Kanya cwääc aani yi mera kany mo kuc, ni cwääc aani ki cwääc mo beer, cuu dëëra nëënö jïrï, ni patha okanø ki ïïni,
english: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

anywaa: naa nëënö jïrï kanya pooda naa poot kär tïmö ni aana dhaanhø; ni ö nïne moa no okwaanø kipera bëët ni gööri piny yi wëëlö marï, kanya pootge ni ge poot kär tägö.
english: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, acaare moï perge leth jïra, ni kwäänge thööth døc;
english: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

anywaa: ni näk mo kwaana kwaanø, kwäänge tïmö ni kaala nyeŋ akwöö. Kany wø pääa, a poot bëëdö ka ïïni.
english: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, ni näk mo jøøa reyø 'nägï nääö, doo beer. U na jø wø many rem jiy, daagu rou buuta.
english: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, nyïïmännï cäänö dëërï ki gïï mo reyø, ni ge raanynya nyeŋŋï ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere.
english: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø, jøøa män ki ïïni, a kär männö ki geni thuwø? ?A kär bëëdö naa ba many dëët jøøa thïïŋ dëëtge kiperï?
english: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

anywaa: Aana männö ki geni na bäre bäre, ni tïmge na nyïïmän 'moa.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

anywaa: Wui Jwøk, dar yia ni ŋäyï mar cwïnya; pääny aani ni jootï gïï wø pär cwïnya ki ge;
english: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

anywaa: ni näk da gïn mo kännö ki pänh cwïny jïrï ri bëëtö mara, neenï, ni putï bëëtö na bäre bäre naa bwøthï ki jöö mo beer.
english: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, käl aani wøk ceŋ jøøa reyø, ni gwøgï aani ceŋ jø kwöri,
english: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

anywaa: jø wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø ki cwïnyge, ni ge bëëdö ni ge cøønna yïth jiy kiper leny.
english: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

anywaa: Lëëpge ege tïïö ni beth kaamar leep thwöl, ni luup mo wø cur dhøkge caala cïm mar olwierø.
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gwøk aani ceŋ jøøa reyø, ni gwøgï aani ceŋ jø kwöri, jø wø määnyö ki jöö ki man raanyge aani ki gø.
english: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

anywaa: Jø atöör abïëp ege ciiø kipera, ni cekge thøøli øtjööra, ni cekge akupe kipera.
english: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

anywaa: Aana lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööa, ni «Beeye ïïni na Jwøk mara; Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï ki kwac mara.
english: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na kwäärö mara, ï na teek ni wø piem aani, aana gëëŋï dïcäŋ leny.
english: O God the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa many jø raayi kär tïïyï jïge, ni ba wëëgï gïïa tuutge thur kare, nee wïthge ba tïŋge maal.
english: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

anywaa: «Jø wø ciel aani dïër, beerra man ö luup mo wø carge ki lëëpge ni døøge wïthge.
english: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

anywaa: Beerra man päth cuki mo wärri bäätge; ni leeŋ geni yi maac, ni leeŋ geni yïth buri mo bäyö, nee ge ba duuge wøk këët.
english: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

anywaa: Kär dee dïwääc nyeŋ mo jïti ki kare dï paac; beerra man ö gïïa reyø ni dwarge jø kwöri.»
english: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

anywaa: Ŋääa ni Wuuö Jwøk cwaga jøøa no ocaannø, ni luup jøøa can ŋøle na karge.
english: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, jøøa beyø nyeŋŋï pwøcge pwøø, ni ö geni na cwïnyge thïïŋ ni bëëtge ki ïïni na aciel.
english: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni; laar rwänh baŋa! Cek ïthï ki kwac mara.
