english: Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

anywaa: Beerra man ö lammi mara ni pïïe baŋï kaamar jïrö mar gïn wø waaŋ ni wø ŋwääi ni met, ni ö thaaŋ cenø man wø thaaŋa ceŋŋa baŋï ki gø ni jïëyï gø kaamar olämi man wø cïp ka abøøya.
english: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gwøk dhaa, ni koorï luup mo wø cur yie.
english: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

anywaa: Kär cwïnya wëëk ciin køør raay, naa ba tïma naa tïïya gïï mo reyø, ni ba dwäta ki jø wø tïïc gïïögø, ni ba cämwa ki geni kany wø wøørge juu moge.
english: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋata beerri ni pwöt aani ni mare pwöc ki køør mëër mare, 'ba kär wïïa wïïr ki maaw mar jøøa reyø, kiper a poot lämö nee gïï wø tïïcge na reyø nee ränyge.
english: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

anywaa: Kanyo leeŋ kwääri moge piny ki bäät kïte, nyeŋ jøøa reyø bany ni putge gø ŋäc ni luumma met.
english: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

anywaa: Cuu moge okeethi dhøk kääk, kaamar jenni mo opetø piny.
english: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na kwäärö mara, a poot neeta jïrï; raa yaa kan buutï; kär jwïëya wëëk ränynyö.
english: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

anywaa: Gwøk aani naa ba pätha ya abïëp mana no ocek jøøa reyø kipera, ni mänï aani ki ciin ya akupa marge.
english: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøøa reyø ni magi ya thøøli moa cekge, ni pöödha ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëra.
english: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

anywaa: A jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni kwaaya eni ni dwøra yaa tïŋ maal.
english: I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.

anywaa: Ni gwäära yia wøk bäre jïre, naa cara gïïa näk aano ööl ki geni jïre.
english: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

anywaa: Kany wø bëëda ni bääta opädhö, gïn tïïa ŋäya ïïni. Jöö man wø cäädha ki yie, ocïŋ jiyi ka abïëp.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

anywaa: Kanya raŋa bäät cwïïa ni neena gø døøc, bäŋ dhaanhø mo caar gïra, ni bäŋ kany kana raa yie, ni bäŋ ŋat cädö kiper jwïëya.
english: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a jwöŋö dëërï, naa köö, ni «Beeye ïïni ni wø kana raa buute, ni beeye ï keerï na kura bäät pinyi en.
english: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

anywaa: Cek ïthï ko oduuru mara, kiper aano dwøk piny døc. Käl aani wøk ceŋ jø wø caan aani, kiper ge teek døc ni kaala aani.
english: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

anywaa: Käl aani wøk ki yïth gïïa twöc aani, kiper nee nyeŋŋï pwøa. Køøre jøøa beyø oööi ni cooŋge rege buuta kiper gïïa beyø na tïïyï kipera.»
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wïny lam mara, ni cegï ïthï ki kwac mara, ni løgï mara ki køør beenynyï ka adïëri marï.
english: Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

anywaa: Kärï kän bääta ka ajäla, a na dhaanhnhï, kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo mare beer nyïmï.
english: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïmänna aana caange, ni raanyge aani, ni wëëkge aani bëëtö yi muudhö kaamar jiy moa thøw cøøn.
english: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, bääta apädhö, ni ö yia ni neethay.
english: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a caara gïr nïne moa cääŋŋe, naa cädö bäät tïïe moï bëët, naa caara gïïa tïïyï bëët ki cerï.
english: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

anywaa: Ceŋŋa wø thaaŋa maal baŋï, ni bëëda naa lääŋŋa ïïni kaawat man wø ö ŋøømmi mo otal wø manyge pïï.
english: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, laar mara løk, kiper bääta opädhö. Kär täärnyïmï kanï ki aani, naa ba tïma kaamar jø wø koony yi bwörö.
english: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

anywaa: Beerra man wëëgï aani wïny luum mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl kany wø pääa ka amöölla, kiper a bëëdö niï yaa gum cwïnya. Pwöny aani ki jöör bëëtö mana daa bëëdö ki gø, kiper acaara mara bäre ena baŋï.
english: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, käl aani wøk ceŋ nyïïmänna, kiper raa yaa kan buutï.
english: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

anywaa: Pwöny aani naa bëëda naa tïïya mana manynyï, kiper beeye ïïni na Jwøk mara. Beerra man ö jwïëyï na beyø ni bwøthge aani ki jöö mo beer.
english: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cäŋ a mooyø ki kwøw ki køør nyeŋŋï, ni kälï aani wøk yïth gïïa leth ki køør beenynyï.
english: Quicken me, O Lord, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

anywaa: Raany nyïïmänna ki køør mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl, ni dïïrï wïth jø wø caan aani, kiper aana dhaanhnhï.
english: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na teek mara, eni ni wø pwöny aani ki leny, ni wø døøc ceŋŋa mo teek naa këëda.
english: Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø mëër ki aani ki mëër mo ba jøøl, ni bee eni na kar gwøk røk jïra; ni eni bëëdö kaamar kiir mo teek jïra, ni ena pïëmi mara. Bee eni na kwöt leny mara, ni bee eni ni wø kana raa buute, ni bee eni ni wø dïïm jiy ni tïmge ni ge ena tiera.
english: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni lääŋŋï gø en? ?Ni o dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni cädï kipere en?
english: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

anywaa: Dhaanhø caala jam dhøk jaak, ni nïr kwøw moe maayø kaamar tïpö.
english: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jap maal ni ööï piny, ni gutï kïte nee duuŋge ki jïrö.
english: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

anywaa: Jääŋ agaackøth ni keethï nyïïmänna, ni thööyï ge ka athëëre moï ni riemmï geni.
english: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

anywaa: Rwää cerï piny ki maal, ni piemï aani ni kälï aani wøk ki yïth gïïa leth na caal naama päŋ, naa kälï wøk ka ceŋ jøøa path,
english: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

anywaa: ni wø car cwøk, ni wø kööŋ ki tööt.
english: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a wär ki duut mo nyään jïrï, naa pöödö ki thoom mo thøøli moe apaar.
english: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

anywaa: Beeye ïïni ni wø wëëk nyec Icriel käädhö, ni beeye ïïni ni wø piem dhaanhnhï ma Deebit.
english: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

anywaa: Piem aani dho opëëlla raac, ni kälï aani wøk ceŋ jøøa path, ni wø car cwøk, ni wø kööŋ ki tööt.
english: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

anywaa: Beerra man ö wäätwa, kany wø pootge ni ge poot therø, ni døøŋge kaamar jaath mo oløth; ni tïm nyïïwa ni mïërö ni rege ege kørø, ni caala jer gøøt mo øt nyeya.
english: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

anywaa: Beerra man ö odïï mowa ni päŋge ki wïth caammi ma teeŋi, ni ö dïëki mowa ni nyöötge ni meetge rege ni ba løny ki kwaan dï pwöla.
english: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

anywaa: Beerra man ö dhäki mowa ni tïmge ni jayø bëët, ni bäŋe gø mo bwön wøk, ni bäŋe ya aciel mo rwäänyi. Ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo göö ko oduuru dï paac.
english: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï jø paan wø bëëdö ki teeŋ bëëtö manøgø; gwïëth en jï jø paan wø Jwøge beeye Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na nyeya mara, nyeŋŋï tïŋa maal, ni pwøa ïïni na bäre bäre.
english: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ïïno pwøa ki yïth nïne bëët, ni pwøa ïïni na bäre bäre.
english: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï dwøŋ, ni ïïno rømø døc ki man pwøi, ni dööŋö marï ba løny ki man ŋääi bäre.
english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beenhnhø man nø tïïe moï opwøcge, ni caange gø jï beenhnhø maya, ni køpge gïr tïïe moï na døøŋŋø.
english: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

anywaa: Ïïno wøør jiyi ni køpge ajiem marï na dwøŋ;	 'ba aani thuwø, a wø cädö kiper tïïe moï ni wø rëëm ec.
english: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.

anywaa: Tïïe moï na døøŋŋø ni wø thäŋ eci ki ge ocaan jiyi; 'ba aani thuwø, dööŋö marï køba købø.
english: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

anywaa: Kany wø cät jiyi kiper beer marï na dwøŋ, gïr gø køpge købø, ni wärge ni yïthge met kiper adïëri marï.
english: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie bäth ni mëër ki jiy; eni ba laar wëër, ni mëër mare päl ni ba jøøl.
english: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk täärnyïme leer ki jiy bëët, ni bäth ec mare wø nyoodhe nyoodhø jï gïïa cwääe bëët.
english: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa cwääyï bëët ï pwøcge pwøø, ni ö jiyi moï ni wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge ena køørï ni pwøcge ïïni.
english: All thy works shall praise thee, O Lord; and thy saints shall bless thee.

anywaa: Ajiem mar bura marï køpge købø, ni caange gïr teek marï,
english: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;

anywaa: kiper nee tïïe moï na døøŋŋø nee ŋäc jiyi bëët, këël ajiem buyï na dwøŋ.
english: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

anywaa: Bura marï bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö teek nyec marï ni bëëde ni nut yïth beenhnhe bëët. Gïïa caan Wuuö Jwøki bëët di ŋäädhö, ni tïïe moe bëët wø tïïe ka køør mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jøøa näk manynya pädhö bëët di jølø, ni tïŋ jøøa en yïth gïïa leth maalø.
english: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa kwøw bëët nyeŋge ena baŋï, ni cam marge cïpï cïbö jïge kanya näk kare.
english: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.

anywaa: Cerï wø peerï peerø jï gïïa kwøw bëët, ni mooyï geni ki gïn cam ni jäŋge kaawat man wø manyge.
english: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

anywaa: Jöör bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk beer bäre, ni tïïe moe bëët wø tïïe ka køør mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl.
english: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni kare cään ki jø wø cøør nyeŋŋe bëët, ni beege jø wø cøør nyeŋŋe ki cwïny ma adïëri.
english: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

anywaa: Jø wø lwäär ki eni, gïï wø manyge wø cïbe cïbö jïge, ni wïny kwac marge, ni køny geni.
english: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jø wø mëër ki eni bëët di gwøø, 'ba jøøa reyø bëët raanynye raanynyø.
english: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø cooth, ni ö jiyi bëët ni pwøcge eni na en kur keere na bäre bäre.
english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Aani, Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki cwïnya bäre.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk pwøa pwøø ki yïth nïr kwøw 'moa bëët, ni wära ki dut pwøc jï Jwøk mara kany pooda naa kwøw bäät pinyi en.
english: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

anywaa: Käru bëëdö nou ŋäätha kwäärö, kiper ena dhaanhø jaak mo bäŋ gïn mo kønye rou.
english: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

anywaa: Jwïëy moe aay, ni ö rïŋ dëëre ni døø yi ŋöömö, ni put acaare moe rwäänyö dïcäŋöce.
english: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat wø køny mare joode baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Jeekap, ni wø bëëdö ni ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøa cwääc maal ki piny, ki naama dwøŋ, këël jammi bëët moa en yïthge. Eni luumme bëëdö ni di ŋäädhö na bäre bäre.
english: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:

anywaa: Eni jøøa no othiel piny di ŋunnö ki ŋøl ma kare, ni mooc jøøa näk dëëtge da käc ki cam. Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø pät jøøa näk otwöö.
english: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø jap nyeŋ cööye; Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø tïŋ jiy maal mo wø bëëdö no opädhö; Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni mëër ki jø wø bëëdö ni marge adïëri.
english: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø gwøk juurre mo wø bëëdö na wëëlle paac, ni wø køny kïïe ki määr thuunhnhi; 'ba gïï wø tuut jøøa reyø raanynye raanynyø.
english: The Lord preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na wïth jammi bëët na bäre bäre; u na jø Dhayan, Jwøk maru bëëdö ni nut yïth beenhnhe bëët. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk! Beeye gïn mo beer ki man wärø ki dut pwøc jï Jwøk marø, kiper beeye gïn mo beer mo duunnö ki met ec.
english: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk Jerucalem cäŋe ka geerø, ni duu jø Icriel yie moa no omaaø ki tøŋ.
english: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

anywaa: Eni jøøa näk cwïnyge opädhö, cwïnyge di cømø, ni køny jøøa no oööl.
english: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

anywaa: Eni kwään ceer ŋääe, ni nyeŋge ee caaø bëët.
english: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

anywaa: Jwøk marø dwøŋ, ni teek mare päl, ni leec wïïe bäre ba løny joot.
english: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk cuŋŋa kur jøøa no ocaannø, 'ba jøøa reyø dwøge piny.
english: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk ki duut nou dwøga met ec, wärru ki dut pwøc jïre, eni na Jwøk marø, nou pöödö ki thoom.
english: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø mooc maal ki pøøl, ni wø jääŋ køth bäät piny, ni wø wëëk luum tuuö bäät kïte.
english: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

anywaa: Eni lääy wø di mooø ki cam, ni mooc nyïï agääe thuwø kany wø jwöŋge.
english: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

anywaa: Patha teek mar okweeny noo døøc yi Wuuö Jwøk mo met, ni patha teek mar dhaanhø noo døøc yi gø mo met;
english: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

anywaa: 'ba Wuuö Jwøk yie wø mïnni ka jø wø lwäär ki eni, jø wø ŋääth mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl.
english: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Jerucalem, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk! Pwøyu eni na Jwøk maru, u na jø Dhayan!
english: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

anywaa: Kiper dïdëëdi mo dhøk kiiri mou ee tïïö ni teek,  ni jiy mou mo oen pou ee gwïëdhö.
english: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

anywaa: Eni pou bäre di mooø ki bëët-mëër, ni caam uuni ki beel ma liil ni jäŋŋu.
english: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

anywaa: Eni dwøre wø di jääŋŋö piny, ni ö luumme ni laar thur kare.
english: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

anywaa: Rwöc wø käle piny ni rïëp piny kaamar aleeŋŋa, ni wëëk thööy ööny bäät piny.
english: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

anywaa: Pey wø gwääre gwäärö kaamar gii; ?'ba aŋa ni løny jïre ki man cuŋŋe yi köö mare?
english: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

anywaa: Eni luumme wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö ni løc peyi, ni kööl jamø ni tïm pïïyi ni kwödö.
english: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

anywaa: Luup moe wø caane caanø jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni caan ciik moe ki luup ŋøl moe jïge, ge na jø Icriel.
english: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba eni luumme käre caanø jï wïth juurre, ni geni ciik moe kucge. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!
english: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk, u ni en maal, ni pwøyu eni ki kwöra enu yïthge maal.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni, u na nyïïatwiet maal moe; pwøyu eni, u na lwaae moe ni en maal.
english: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.

anywaa: Cäŋ ki dwääy, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk; ceer bëët ni wø cïpi ki tar maal, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk;
english: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

anywaa: Maal ki pøøl bëët, pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

anywaa: Beerra man ö gïïögø bëët ni pwøcge nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, kiper kanya cwääc ge, caana dwøre jaak, ni putge thur karge.
english: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.

anywaa: Ni cïp geni kwörge nee bëëtge na bäre bäre, ni mooc geni ki ciik mo ba dak.
english: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

anywaa: Pwøyu Wuuö Jwøk ki kwöra enu yïthge bäät piny, ni beeye u lääc naama dwøŋ, ki kwöra päŋ bëët,
english: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

anywaa: ka agaackøth, ki pey, ki køth, ki pøøl, ka atuunna ni wø kwödö ki køør ciige.
english: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

anywaa: Beerra man ö thuuri ki kïte bëët ni pwøcge eni, ki jenni mo wø nyïïge cam ki jer geer bëët,
english: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

anywaa: ki lääc paap ki mo paac bëët, ki gïï wø muuli ki piny ki weny bëët.
english: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

anywaa: Pwøyu eni, u na nyec bäät piny ki jiy bëët, ki kwääri ki dïŋut luup mo bäät piny bëët,
english: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

anywaa: ki wøpe ki nyïïakuue bëët, ki jäle ko obwöre bëët.
english: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

anywaa: Beerra man ö gïïögø bëët ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk, kiper dwøŋŋa nyeŋŋe keere, na ajiem mare kaala ajiem maal ki piny.
english: Let them praise the name of the Lord: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

anywaa: Eni teek mar jiye atïïe nee bëëde ni cäätha maal, ni ö jiye bëët moa cwïnyge en køøre ni jïtge ki pwøc, ni beege jø Icriel na bëëde dïge. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk ki duut mo nyään, ni pwøyu eni dï acooŋ jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge ena køøre.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

anywaa: Beerra man mïn yïth jø Icrielli ki Jwøa cwääc geni, ni ö geni na jø Dhayan ni kwöŋge ki met ec kipere, eni na nyeya marge.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

anywaa: Beerra man pwøcge eni ki meeŋ, ni wärge ki dut pwøc jïre ni ge pöödö ki thøme ka anëët.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk yie wø mïnnö ki jiye, ni piem jøøa en yïth gïï mo leth, ni mooc geni ka ajiem.
english: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jø wø bëëdö ni cwïnyge ena køør Wuuö Jwøk ni kanyge ni yïthge met ki køør ajiem mana jootge, ni wärge ki dudi ni yïthge met kwör niine moge.
english: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

anywaa: Beerra man pwøcge Jwøk ki pwøc mo dwøŋ, ni ceŋge da opëëlle mo deŋge karge riet beth,
english: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

anywaa: kiper nee kwöri coolge dëët wïth juurre, ni jäälge jøøgø ni tïïge ki gïï mo leth dëëtge;
english: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

anywaa: kiper nee nyeye mo jøøgø twöcge ki tiimme, ni twöcge kwääri moge ko oguudi;
english: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

anywaa: na ajäla mana no ogöörö kiper jøøgø nee tïïcge; ni tïm gïïögø na ajiem kiper jiye na näk cwïnyge ena køøre. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk. Pwøyu Jwøk kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni pwøyu eni maal kanya en teeki mare yie.
english: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni kiper tïïe moa tïïe ki køør teek mare, ni pwøyu eni ki køør dööŋö mare na dwøŋ døc.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni ki dööt tuŋi, ni pwøyu eni ki thøme ma teeŋi.
english: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni nou pöödö ki bulli ka anëët nou miel, ni pwøyu eni ki thøp-othïënhö ko opele.
english: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

anywaa: Pwøyu eni ka adijeege, ni pwøyu eni ki gare.
english: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

anywaa: Beerra man ö gïïa näk røkge da jwïëy bëët ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk. Alëluya, pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.

anywaa: Moi beege pwöc leec wïc mo Cølöman o Deebit nyeny Icriel,
english: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

anywaa: na caan kiper man ŋäc leec wïc ki pwöc, ki man joot tiet luup.
english: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

anywaa: Na caan ki man joot pwöc bëëtö mo beer, ki man tïïc mana beer, ka adïëri, ki bäŋ ajeeny.
english: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

anywaa: Na caan ki man cïpge ki riek waŋ jï jøøa näk acaara marge thiinh, ki man cïpge ki kwänynyö jï wøpe, ni ŋäcge gïna beer ki gïna raac.
english: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋata wïïe leerri ni cek ïthe ki geni, ni meet geni bäät mana kwanye, ni ö eni ni wø joot tiet luup ni kwänynye ki pwöc.
english: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

anywaa: Na caan ki man ŋäc pwöc leec wïc ki tiet leere, ki man ŋäc tiet luup jøøa wïthge leer ki luupge moa näk tietge okanø.
english: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye täk kwänynyö, 'ba jøøa wïthge känni, ge män ki leec wïc ki pwöc.
english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, wïny pwöc wäru, ni ba weyï pwöc meru;
english: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

anywaa: kiper ge tïmö ni caala adun ajiem mo ena wïïï, ni tïmge ni caala jap mïërö mo ena jedhï.
english: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, ni näk mo jøøa reyø wïïï maaŋge maaŋŋø, kär näk miï jïëy ki marge.
english: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ge köö, ni «Waa cøø, nøø møørø piny øtjöö, nøø nääø ki jiy mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø,
english: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

anywaa: ni thöörø geni kaamar gïï mo oløønynyø ni nëënö, ni thumge bëët kaamar jiy mo oci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni tïmge kaamar jiy mo oci yi bwörö;
english: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

anywaa: ø doo jïtö ki jammi mo thööth mo perge leth, ni pääŋø uudi 'moø ki jap twëër;
english: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

anywaa: ööï ni dwätï ki waani; otïmö ni da opïr aciel kiperø bëët;»
english: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:

anywaa: nyie wääda, kär niï cäädhö ki jöör jøøgø; män tierï ki jöörge.
english: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:

anywaa: Kiper tietge wø ŋwieya køør gïïa reyø, ni ge wø lääta baŋ køny rem jiy piny.
english: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

anywaa: Ki man cek abïëp ni nëënö jï weny, bäŋ gïn mo kønye.
english: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø, ge wø kønynya rem moge piny keerge, ni ge wø møør piny kaper jwïëy moge keerge.
english: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

anywaa: Man beeye gïno tägi dëët jø wø cwïnyge päl ni wø joot jammi ki jöö mo paa adïëri, ni teeŋ bëëtö manøgønø, jwïëc jøøgø käle kälö.
english: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.

anywaa: Leec wïc bëëdö ni cwödö øtjöö, ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal kwör acooŋe;
english: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:

anywaa: ni eni wø cwödö yïth agääk jïëthe kwör dïlweel, ni caan mare dhøk kiir, ni kööe,
english: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,

anywaa: ni «?U na näk acaara maru thiinh, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdu nou mëër ki bëët thïnh acaara? ?Naa këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët jø abuua ni yïthge met ka abuua, ni bëët jøøa wïthge känni ni ge kweeyø ki kwänynyö?
english: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

anywaa: Doo na mo uuno jïëy ki juuk mara, ka adïëri møn, cwïnya daa käla wøk jïïu, ni daa acaare 'moa wëëk uuni.
english: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana cøøra uuni ni kweeru, ni rwääa ceŋŋa baŋu, ni bäŋe ŋat mo oneen gø,
english: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

anywaa: ni taagu pwöc 'moa bëët, ni käru juuk mara jïëö,
english: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

anywaa: aani, a bëëdö naa ŋeethø kanyo enu yïth gïï mo leth, ni bëëda ni mara abuua kanyo pïïc gïï mo lethi bäätu,
english: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;

anywaa: ni beeye gïï mo leth mo raanynya uuni kaamar jwïïö, na gïï mo leth mo køøla uuni kaamar atuunna, na gïï mo duunnö ki rääm ki pänh cwïny dëëtu.
english: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace jøøgø aano cøørge, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo løøa jïge,  ni manyge aani døc, 'ba a ba jootge,
english: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

anywaa: kiper mana bëëtge ni ge män ki kwänynyö, ni kärge jöö man lwäärge Wuuö Jwøk ki gø jierø.
english: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the Lord:

anywaa: Geni, pwöc mara kärge jïëö, ni kwierge juuk mara na bäre;
english: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

anywaa: kiper manøgø nø, gïïo duu uutjïëth tïïe moge obelge, ni jäŋge ki gïïo jootge ki køør riek waŋ marge.
english: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa näk acaara marge thiinh geno 'näk gaan wøki marge, ni ö jøøa wïthge känni ni 'nägi ya ataa marge.
english: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wïny mara obëëdö no ogwøø, ni bëëde ni yie met ni ba lwäär ki gïï wø leth ni wø tägi.»
english: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, ni näk mo luupa wïnynyï wïnynyö, ni kanï ciik 'moa cwïnyï,
english: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

anywaa: ni luuï ïthï baŋ pwöc leec wïc, ni cïbï cwïnyï køør ŋäc tiet luup,
english: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

anywaa: ni jwöŋï kiper nee tiet luup jootï, ni dwørï iï tïŋ maal kiper ŋäc tiet luup,
english: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

anywaa: ni manynyï gø kaawat man wø many gwel-bïrö, ni cayï gø kaawat man wø cac jammi mo perge leth mo okanø,
english: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

anywaa: ïïni, tier lwär ki Wuuö Jwøk otïmö ni ŋäyï, ni jootï leec wï Jwøk.
english: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni wø cïp leec wïc, ni luup kwänynyö ki ŋäc tiet luup wø ö wøk ka dhee.
english: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

anywaa: Eni pwöc leec wïc wø meede meedø jï jøøa marge thiiŋ, ni bëëde na kwöt leny jï jøøa marge tiir.
english: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

anywaa: Eni jöör jø wø many adïëri wø di koorø, ni gwøk jöör jiye moa cwïnyge en køøre.
english: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

anywaa: Ïïni, tïïc gïn mo beer, ka adïëri, ki bäŋ ajeeny, ki many uutjïëthe moa beyø otïmö ni ŋäyï.
english: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

anywaa: Kiper leec wïc oci cwïnyï, ni tïm yiï ni met ki kwänynyö.
english: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

anywaa: Ŋäc gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac ïïno koore, ni ö ŋäc tiet luupi ni gwøkge ïïni,
english: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

anywaa: ni käl ïïni wøk ki yïth uutjïëth jøøa reyø, ki ceŋ jø wø wel luup,
english: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

anywaa: jø wø wec jööra thïïŋ nee cääthge jöör muudhö,
english: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

anywaa: jø wø yïthge mïnni ki tïïc gïï wø reyø, ni wø yïthge met ki jøøa reyø ni wø wel luup,
english: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

anywaa: jøøa näk uutjïëth tïïe moge oköömmö, ni wø caath jöör luup cwøk.
english: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

anywaa: Leec wïc ïïno wëëk bødhø cer dhaagø ma kääbi, mo leebe pøøth,
english: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

anywaa: dhaaŋ wø kwier omëëc thïnhö mare, ni wø taak luumma tuude nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

anywaa: Kiper eni ki paare bäre løøya baŋ thøø, ni uutjïëth tïïe moe cäätha baŋ thøø.
english: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

anywaa: Jiy mo ci baŋ dhaaŋŋøgø ba døø karge këët, ni bäŋgø mo pïï jöör kwøw.
english: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï doo cäädhö ki jöör jøøa beyø, ni këëllï wïïï jöör jøøa näk marge adïëri.
english: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa marge thïïŋ obëëdö wïth ŋøøm,  ni ö geni na bëëtö marge tiir ni dööŋge yie.
english: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa reyø wïthge odïdi wïth ŋøøm, ni ö dïcuunne ni cöödi wøk yïth ŋøøm.
english: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, kär wïïï wïl ki pwöc 'moa, 'ba beerra man kïthï ciik 'moa cwïnyï;
english: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:

anywaa: kiper nïr kwøw moï meetge meedø, ni cïpge jïrï ki bëët bëënynyö.
english: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

anywaa: Mëër man wø ba jøøl ka adïëri kär lwäänhnhï; twöö geni jedhï, ni göörï ge piny yi cwïnyï.
english: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:

anywaa: Køøre ïïno jïti ki pwøc ki nyeŋ mo beer nyïm Jwøk ki nyïm jiy.
english: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

anywaa: Bëëdï niï ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnyï bäre, ni ba bëëdï niï ŋäätha acaara marï keerï.
english: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

anywaa: Bëëdï niï ŋäya eni ki yïth uutjïëth tïïe moï bëët, køøre eni uutjïëth tïïe moï odøøc mo thïïŋ.
english: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

anywaa: Kär niï cädö ni leerra wïïï keerï ki jïrï; lwäär Wuuö Jwøk, ni luuï riï niï kwiera gïïa reyø.
english: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

anywaa: Bëëtö manøgø ïïno mooe ki jööt dëël, ni wëëk cuu moï tëënnö.
english: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.

anywaa: Jiem Wuuö Jwøk ki jap kwärö moï, ki thwöth caammi moï bëët mo wø kwøŋ ciek;
english: Honour the Lord with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:

anywaa: køøre odïï moï obëëdö ni päŋ ki caammi mo thööth ni bëët dääk nyööbö moï ni päŋ ki kwøk nyïïomøki.
english: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, kär pwöc Wuuö Jwøk taagï, ni ba gootï ki juuk mare,
english: My son, despise not the chastening of the Lord; neither be weary of his correction:

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk wø jooga jø wø mëëre ki geni, kaawat man wø ö wuuö wø jook wääde man wø mëëre ki gø.
english: For whom the Lord loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋat wø joot leec wïc, ŋat wø ŋäc tiet luup;
english: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

anywaa: kiper gïn wø duu leec wïci beerra eni ni kaala man wø duu gwet-bïrö, ni beerra eni ni kaala man wø duu warkeyi.
english: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

anywaa: Eni pere leth døc ni kaala tiik jëëthi, ni ba maar päärö ki jammi mo wø en cwïnyï køørge bëët.
english: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.

anywaa: Ruut kwøw mo thööth wø joota baŋe, ni bëët kwärö ki wödö wø joota baŋe.
english: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

anywaa: Uutjïëthe moe beege ni wø cïpi ki met ec, ni uutjïëthe moe bëët beege ni wø duunni ki bëët bëënynyö.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

anywaa: Ena jaath kwøw jï jø wø göök ree, ni jø wø mak gø di gwïëdhö.
english: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk piny acwääe ki køør leec wïc, ni cïp maal kare ki køør acaara mare.
english: The Lord by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.

anywaa: Ki køør leec wïc mare näm adøøc mo kwödö, ni ö pøølli ni pädhe na køth.
english: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, leec wïc ki ŋäc gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac kär lwäänhnhï, ni ba wëëgï ge rwäänyö waŋï.
english: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

anywaa: Ge tïmö na jap kwøw jïrï, ni tïmge na jap mïërö jedhï.
english: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.

anywaa: Køøre ïïno cäädhi ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëërï,  ni bäŋ gïï cwany tietï.
english: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.

anywaa: Ni kany wø nyaaŋï riï piny, ï ba lwäyï, ni kany wø butï, ï jïtö ki niine mo met.
english: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

anywaa: Kär niï lwäyö ki gïï wø leth ni wø cwöp røk, ki ränynyö man wø ööi bäät jøøa reyø,
english: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.

anywaa: kiper Wuuö Jwøk obëëdö ni beeye tier ŋäädhe marï, ni koor tietï ki dha abïëp.
english: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

anywaa: Kär gïn mo beer mänï ki jøøa no orømø ki man cïbi jïge, kany wø näk mo løny jïrï ki man tïïyï gø.
english: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

anywaa: Ni näk gïnögø nut buutï, kär niï köö jï wadu, ni «Ciï, ïïno duui; ocïba jïrï diøø.»
english: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.

anywaa: Kärï cädö ki man tïïyï gïn mo leth dëër wadu, ŋat wø bëëdö buutï niï ee ŋäädhö.
english: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

anywaa: Kärï pïëmö ki dhaanhø jaak kiper gïn mo bäŋ tiere, ni näk mo bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö dëërï.
english: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

anywaa: Kär per bëët ŋat kwörri keeyï, ni bäŋe øtjööre mo jierï.
english: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki ŋat wø wel luup, 'ba jøøa marge thïïŋ beege ni wø ŋäädhe.
english: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.

anywaa: Acïëni mar Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät mïëc jøøa reyø, 'ba gwïëth mare ena bäät mïëc jøøa marge beer.
english: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.

anywaa: Eni, jø abuua, marge wø dwøge wïthge, 'ba mëër mare wø nyoodhe nyoodhø jï jøøa mwöl.
english: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

anywaa: Jøøa wïthge leer wödö oci jïge, 'ba jøøa wïthge känni, geno bëëdö ki lään wïc.
english: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

anywaa: U no obwöre, wïnynyu pwöc wääu, ni cegu ïthu nee tiet luup jootu;
english: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

anywaa: kiper a wø cïpa pwöc mo beer jïïu; uuni, kär ciik 'moa weyu.
english: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda ki wära ni aana nyilaal, naa thiinh, ni waŋ mera ena bääta keera,
english: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

anywaa: wära aana pwönynye, ni kööe, ni «Mak luup 'moa ki cwïnyï bäre, ni gwøgï ciik 'moa, niï bëëdï niï kwøw.
english: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

anywaa: Lwør leec wïc, ni lwørï ŋäc tiet luup. Kär wïïï wïl ki luup mo wø cur dhaa, ni ba gaaï wøk rege.
english: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Kär leec wïc weyï, eni, ï gwøe gwøø; bëëdï niï mëër ki gø, eni, ï koore koorø.
english: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.

anywaa: Many leec wïc nee ci jïrï, kiper leec wïc beeye gïn mo letha pere døc, ni manynyï ŋäc tiet luup nee ci jïrï røk jammi moa perge leth bëët.
english: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

anywaa: Tïïc kare ni dwøŋ, eni karï odøøc mo dwøŋ; ni näk iï gäämö, ï mooe mooø ki wödö.
english: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

anywaa: Eno tïmö jïrï kaamar adun ajiem mo ena wïïï, ni tïme jïrï na adun mïërö.»
english: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, wïny mara ni jïëyï moa cara, køøre ruut kwøw moï tïmö ni thööth.
english: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.

anywaa: Ïïna pwönynya ki øtjöör leec wïc, ni bwødha ïïni ki uutjïëthe moa thïïŋ.
english: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.

anywaa: Kany wø cäädhï, bäŋ gïï mo galla ïïni,  ni kany wø rïïŋï, tietï ba cwanynyï.
english: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.

anywaa: Mak pwöc, ni ba lwäänhnhï gø; gwøk eni, kiper ena tier kwøw marï.
english: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.

anywaa: Kärï cør øtjöör jø raay, ni ba bëëdï ki bëët jøøa reyø.
english: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

anywaa: Män riï ki jöörge ni ba cørï yie; ni kwierï gø ni cørï jöörï.
english: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

anywaa: Kiper ge bäŋ wø buti ni näk bäŋ gïn raac mo ege tïïö, ni nyeŋge ba gämmi kany wø bäŋe dhaanhø mo ege wëëk päth yïth raay.
english: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

anywaa: Kiper rääö ege tïïö na cam marge, ni dïwït ege tïïö na maath marge.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

anywaa: 'Ba jöör bëët jøøa beyø caala man wø ö tiet øwi, ni wø rïënyi ni tar mare cäänhnha maal këël mano pïïe ya aŋuun tar mar dïcäŋ.
english: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

anywaa: 'Ba jöör bëëtö mar jøøa reyø caala bëët muudhö, ni gïï wø cwany tietge ba jootge.
english: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, cek ïthï ki luup 'moa, ni këëllï ïthï piny ki gïïa cara.
english: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.

anywaa: Kär ge lwäänhnhï nyïmï; kan geni yi cwïnyï.
english: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.

anywaa: Kiper beege kwøw jï jø wø joot geni, ni wëëk dëëtge bäre jöönnö.
english: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

anywaa: Ki røk jammi bëët, koor wïïï, kiper beeye jøøro mar kwøw.
english: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

anywaa: Luup tööt kär dee gø dhiï; ni bëët leebï ni kare bäär ki luup atade.
english: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët waŋï ni raŋŋa nyïmï keere, ni teeï waŋï nyïmï ni tiir.
english: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.

anywaa: Tïïc øtjöörï ni pøøth kiper tietï, køøre uutjïëth tïïe moï bëët othur karge.
english: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

anywaa: Kärï gaa wøk bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam; män tierï ki jöör raay.
english: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, cek ïthï ki pwöc leec wïc mara, ni këëllï ïthï piny døc baŋ acaare 'moa;
english: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:

anywaa: kiper gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac nee ŋäyï, ni ö luup kwänynyö ni bëëtge dhiï.
english: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø ma kääbi dhee ŋweeth kaawat maar kïc, ni luup moe pøøth ni kaala maaw;
english: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

anywaa: 'ba aŋuunne, luupe këënynyö kaamar tier keenø, ni bïnhnhe kaamar opëëllö mo dhøge ariiø.
english: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

anywaa: Teeŋ dhaaŋŋøgø, tiete cäätha baŋ thøø, ni kwör tiete cäätha kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

anywaa: Jöör kwøw bäŋ wø caare; eni wø wïdö jaak ki uutjïëthe mo reyø, ni mo nyïm kuue.
english: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u na wääta, wïnynyu mara, ni ba gaau wøk ki røk luup mo wø cara.
english: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Døøc karï mo bäär ki dhaaŋŋøgø, ni ba nyiigï buut dhi øtø mare;
english: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

anywaa: nee ajiem marï ba wëëgï ränynyö, ni ba nyäägï jwïëyï ceŋ jøøa reyø;
english: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:

anywaa: kiper nee jiy mo path ba jäŋge ki jammi moï, nee øt dhaanhø mør jaak ba pääŋe ki jap köörï;
english: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

anywaa: niï ba cooyï ra aŋuun kwøw marï, kanyo thum rïŋ dëërï bäre,
english: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,

anywaa: ni kööï, ni «Pwöc yaa kwierø kaperŋø, ni bëët cwïnya no okweer ki köömmö!
english: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

anywaa: Aani, ïtha kära ciiø ki dööt dïpööye 'moa, ni kära ïtha løø baŋge.
english: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!

anywaa: Ennø, aano løny naa pätha yi ränynyö naa nëënö jï jiy bëët.»
english: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëdï niï ŋäya cïïï keere kaamar dhaanhø mo ŋäya pï aguula mare keere mo wø maadhe, ki pïï mo wø lwanynyi yi iith mare.
english: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø noo nyöödï wøk jaak, nee obwöre moï bëëtge ni bäŋ gïn kønyge, kaamar pï jøøro mo øøya wøk jaak uutjïëthe?
english: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

anywaa: Beerra man bëët obwöre moï na moï keerï, niï ba rööp rege ki jøøa path.
english: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëdï ki cïïï ni uuno gwïëdhö, ni mïn iï ki eni na näk cï thïnhö marï,
english: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

anywaa: ni bëëde ni mïërö jïrï kaamar mwök, no opwøø kaamar aŋer; ni päŋ cwïnyï ki mëër mare cooth, ni pär cwïnyï cooth ki gïre.
english: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.

anywaa: ?Wääda, aperŋø ni pär cwïnyï kiper kääbi, na aperŋø ni gäämmï dhaagø mør jaak en?
english: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

anywaa: Kiper uutjïëth tïïe mo dhaanhø nëënö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni jïëth tïïe mo dhaanhø bëët wø di neetø.
english: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the Lord, and he pondereth all his goings.

anywaa: Ŋata raac okïth raayi moe ya abïëp, ni ö eni ni twöyi raayi moe ki thøøli.
english: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

anywaa: Eno thøw kiper mana bäŋe pwöc mo ee kwanyø, ni rwäänye ki køør teek wïc mare na dwøŋ.
english: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, ni näk mo riï iï cïbö yi waŋ luubö mar dhaanhø mør, ni cïpï riï na dïgïti kar ŋatøce, eni na path,
english: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,

anywaa: ni näk ïïno päth yi luubö ki køør gïna käl dhiï, ni päthï ya abïëp ki køør luup dhiï,
english: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.

anywaa: gïno tïïyï niï käla riï wøk beeye en, kiper mana näk mo ïïno nø päth cer dhaanhø mør: wärï laar cøø ni kwaayï ŋatøce, ni riï iï døøc mo mwöl.
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.

anywaa: Män nyeŋŋï ki niine, ni ö nyeŋŋï ni ba nigemääw.
english: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.

anywaa: Keet riï kaamar röönna mo oreeŋø cer ŋat dwaar, kaamar wenyø mo omäätö cer wää abïëpi.
english: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

anywaa: Wui ï na ŋat leth dëël, ci baŋ ŋiinynyø; ni raŋï jöör tïïc mare, ni lëëny wïïï.
english: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

anywaa: Eni wø bëëdö ni bäŋ kwäärö jïre, wala kwääc lwaak wala dïbwödhi,
english: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

anywaa: 'ba eni cam mare wø jiiŋŋe jiiŋŋø ka arïïa, ni cooŋ cam mare piny kany wø tïme na kar kac.
english: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

anywaa: ?Wui ï na ŋat leth dëël, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëënnï niine? ?Ïïno ööï maal yïth niine wäne?
english: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?

anywaa: Ï ni wø laar butö ki nyi kany mo thiinh, ni wø laarï närö ki nyi kany mo thiinh, ï ni wø laar thäänhö ki ceŋŋï nee riï jwömï ki nyi kany mo thiinh,
english: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

anywaa: bëët can ööa bäätï kaamar kuu, ni pïïc ränynyö bäätï kaamar ŋat twëër.
english: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo wïïe raac ma ŋat okiera wø wïdö jaak, dhee ki tööt;
english: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

anywaa: eni wø niiŋŋa waŋe, ni mun dhaanhø ki tiere, ni nyuudhe ki lweete;
english: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;

anywaa: eni wø cädö ki gïï mo reyø ni cwïnye da cwøk, ni ŋeela män cooth.
english: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, gïï mo leth opïï bääte ki kany mo thiinh, ni ö ränynyö ni cwöp dëëre, ni bäŋe gïn køny gø.
english: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

anywaa: Da gïï pinyi abïciel mo Wuuö Jwøk män ki ge, ni da bïrietge mo yie raac ki gø døc;
english: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

anywaa: beege nyeŋ mo raŋa jiy piny, ki leep ma twöt, ki ceŋ mo wø køny rem jøøa beyø piny,
english: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

anywaa: ki cwïny man wø cädö ki gïï mo reyø, ki tiel mo wø läät baŋ raay,
english: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

anywaa: ki ŋat wø kaat luubö ni wø car tööt, ki ŋat wø ŋeel män yïthakic nyïïmëëe.
english: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, gwøk ciik wäru, ni ba lwäänhnhï pwöc meru.
english: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:

anywaa: Kan geni cwïnyï cooth, ni twöyï geni jedhï.
english: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.

anywaa: Kany wø cäädhï, ï bwøthge bwødhø; kany wø butï, ï koorge koorø, ni kany wø päyï, ï pwönyge pwönynyö.
english: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.

anywaa: Kiper ciik caala lamba, ni ö pwöci ni caal tar, ni ö juuki mo ree da pwöc ni caal jöör kwøw;
english: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

anywaa: ni koorge ïïni cer dhaagø mo raac, ni beeye dhaagø ma kääbi mo luupe pøøth.
english: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

anywaa: Kär cwïnyï lämmö ki wøp mare, ni ba tuut ïïni ki waŋe;
english: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.

anywaa: kiper dhaagø ma kääbi ï wëëge can, ni døøï ri cam mo thiinh, ni ö eni na ŋat lugi ni gaam wenynyï.
english: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï dhaanhø ki man jøøp maac kööre, na abïïe moe ba waaŋ?
english: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

anywaa: ?A løny ki man cääth dhaanhe bäät cuk, ni tiete ba waaŋ?
english: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mo døøa ri cï watge caala manøgø, ni ŋat wø gut teeŋ dhaaŋŋøgø bäŋ wø kääŋi ka ajäla.
english: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.

anywaa: Kuu kany wø kwäte kiper na näk mo obup, eni gïre wø taak jiyi taaø,
english: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

anywaa: 'ba ni näk mo eno maaø, eni cudö ki kwöre abïriiø, këël doo naa thööra jap øde bëët.
english: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø käl lugi ba cädö, ni eni wø raanynya dëëre keere.
english: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.

anywaa: Ŋwiili ki räny nyeŋ beege noo joode, na ajøøŋ mare ba aay bääte;
english: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

anywaa: kiper keec cwïny beeye ni wø dhäc wëër mar cø dhaagø, ni ŋato ci baŋ cïïe ba wëënne kanyo cool kwöre.
english: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

anywaa: Eni ba jïëy ki jap cuut, ni këël jammi doo meedø, cwïnye ba nijwöm.
english: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, gwøk luupa, ni kanï ciik 'moa cwïnyï.
english: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

anywaa: Gwøk ciik 'moa niï bëëdï niï kwøw, ni gwøgï pwöc 'moa kaamar guu waŋï.
english: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

anywaa: Twöö geni lweetï, ni göörï ge piny yi cwïnyï.
english: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

anywaa: Kööï jï leec wïc, ni «Ïïna coka,» ni cwølï ŋäc tiet luup na nyawadu mana pere leth;
english: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:

anywaa: kiper niï gwøkge cer kääbi, ni beeye dhaagø mo luupe pøøth.
english: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

anywaa: Aani, aana räŋŋö wøk ki dha awëërnyeŋ mar øda,
english: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

anywaa: ni jooda ŋat mør dï jøøa näk acaara marge thiinh, ni beeye nyilaal mo ba cädö dï wøpe.
english: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

anywaa: Ni jooda eni ni pöödhö ki øtjöör wø cør lak po kääbi, ni lwør jöör wø coony øt dhaaŋŋøgø,
english: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

anywaa: kanya päth cäŋŋi ni piny jïrri, ni tïm pinynyi na wäär.
english: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

anywaa: Ni jooda dhaagø ni öö ni røømme ki eni, ni eno ruyö ka abïïk käp, ni cwïnye päŋ ki cwøk,
english: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

anywaa: dhaaŋ wø näk ŋat dïlweel, ni näk apwødha, ni tiere bäŋ wø mägi paare.
english: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

anywaa: Ennø, bëëdö øtjöö, ni ki kany mo thiinh eni ena thwørø, ni ree wø di kaannø yïth agääk jïëthe ni kurö.
english: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

anywaa: Køøre cer nyilaarøgø amaae ni nuum dhi gø, ni cääne ki gøøni ni waŋe teek, ni kööe,
english: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

anywaa: ni «Thääŋ rïŋ olämi mana cïba nut paac, ni dïcäŋi nïr kööŋ 'moa yaa thöörö.
english: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

anywaa: Køøre ennø, aana öö naa røømma ki ïïni, ni manynya ïïni døc ni cwïnya lïëth, ni jooda ïïni ennø.
english: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

anywaa: Kar niine mara yaa døøc mo mïërö ka abïïe mo beyø, ka abïïk kït ma lïïna mo käla Ijep.
english: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

anywaa: Ni jøra kar niine mara ki riia mo ŋwäänynye met, ni pøra tør apøk jenni mo ŋwäänyge met thuwø.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

anywaa: Ööï, ni mïn yïthø dïwääni këël amöölla, ni døøyø yïthø mo met ki mëër marø.
english: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

anywaa: Kiper cwøra tøør paac; ena aa kany mo bäär døc.
english: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

anywaa: ena aay no opïr gwel di käärö, ni kanyo pïïc dwääyi tar beeye no duue.»
english: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

anywaa: Dhaaŋŋøgø nyilaal acøøge ki dhøk mo beer, ni tuut gø ki leep mo pøøth.
english: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

anywaa: Køøre ki kany mo thiinh nyilaal aläp køøre, kaawat man wø ö dhieŋŋi wø kïthi baŋ ŋaal, kaawat man wø ö purra wø cääth ya ataw,
english: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

anywaa: gøøc mano ö tøŋŋi noo tuc yi cwïnye. Kaawat man wø ö wenye wø läät ya abïëp, kuue ni jwïëye di raanynyø.
english: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, nyie wääta, wïnynyu mara, ni cegu ïthu ki luup wø cara.
english: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

anywaa: Kär cwïnynyu løøu øtjöör dhaaŋŋøgø, ni ba gaau uutjïëthe moe.
english: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

anywaa: Kiper jiy moa päth cere na raanynye thööth, ni jiy moa thøw ki køøre thööth døc.
english: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

anywaa: Øt dhaaŋŋøgø beeye jöör kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni wø løøya kwör thuunhnhi.
english: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, leec wïc käru wïnynyö ni cwödö? ?Na acaara thuwø, dwøre ee tïŋ maal?
english: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

anywaa: Eni cwödö ni ena bäät thuur thääŋ jöö, ni eni cuŋŋa yïth agääk jïëthe;
english: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

anywaa: eni cwödö buut dhøgi mo kiir mar pääny, kwör wø døny jiyi yi kiir ki yïthge, ni kööe,
english: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

anywaa: ni «Wui jiy, a cøøra uuni, ni dwøra yaa luu baŋu.
english: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

anywaa: U na acaara maru thiinh, kwänynyu ki riek waŋ; ni u na wïthu känni, kwänynyu ki leec wïc.
english: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.

anywaa: Wïnynyu mara, kiper a cara gïï mo perge leth, ni gïï wø cur leeba beege gïïa näk karge.
english: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

anywaa: Kiper leeba wø cara gïï ma adïëri, ni dhaa män ki gïï mo reyø.
english: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

anywaa: Luup mo wø cur dhaa bëët beege moa beyø, ni bäŋ adøønne ki cwøk rege.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

anywaa: Ge tiir bëët jï jø wø cädö, ni ge thïïŋ jï jø wø joot kwänynyö.
english: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.

anywaa: Jierru pwöc 'moa ni kaala gwel-bïrö, ni jierru kwänynyö ni kaala warkey mana tøŋ.
english: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

anywaa: Kiper leec wïc beer ni kaala tii mo perge leth, ni jammi bëët mo wø en cwïnynyi køørge ba pääri ki gø.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

anywaa: Aani na leec wïc, a wø bëëdö na aciel ka riek waŋ, ni ö kwänynyö ki ŋäc gïn mo beer ki gïn mo raac ni bëëtge na 'moa.
english: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye ki man mänö ki raay. Aani na leec wïc, a män ki koorø ka atöör, ki bëët jöör raay ki wel luup.
english: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

anywaa: Pwöc moa beyø ki leec wïc mana näk kare beege 'moa, ni ŋäc tiet luup ki teek ena baŋa.
english: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

anywaa: Nyeye mïëri wø käärge ka køøra, ni ö kwääri ni kälge ciik wøk moa näk adïëri.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, piny wø käärge ka køøra, këël jiy bëët mo wø ŋøl luup na adïëri.
english: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

anywaa: A mëër ki jø wø mëër ki aani, ni jø wø many aani ki cwïnyge bäre a wø jootge joodø.
english: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

anywaa: Bëët jap kwärö ki wödö ena baŋa, ni ö bëët kwärö manøgø ki bëënynyö ni bëëtge na bäre bäre.
english: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

anywaa: Nyïëdi mo wø duu pwöci 'moa beyø ni kaala warkey mana tøŋ, ni gïn wø cïba kaala gwel-bïrö mana tøŋ.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

anywaa: Aani na leec wïc, a wø cäädha øtjöör bëënynyö, naa ena dï jöör adïëri,
english: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

anywaa: naa cïpö ko olaawi jï jø wø mëër ki aani, ni pääŋa uut kän moge.
english: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

anywaa: «Ki mana täge wïlöölö, aani na leec wïc, a bëëdö na mar Wuuö Jwøk, kanya poode dïkwøŋ ni jammi bëët poot käre cwääö.
english: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

anywaa: Aani, aana cuume cøøn dïkwøŋ, kanya poode wïlöölö ni piny poot kär cwääö.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

anywaa: Ni käl a nyïm kanya poode ni poot bäŋ näpa døøŋŋø, kanya poode ni bäŋ jøør mo kwödö ki pïï.
english: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

anywaa: Kanya poode ni kïte poot kär cwääö, ki kanya poot thuuri, aana käl nyïm;
english: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

anywaa: ni beeye kanya poode ni piny ki pwöle poot käre cwääö,  ki ŋøøm moa en bäät piny.
english: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

anywaa: Kanya ö eni na cwääc maal, a nutö, këël ki kanya kiiw nyeŋ kee mo näpa døøŋŋø.
english: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

anywaa: Kanya ö eni na cïp pøøl maal, ki kanya pääŋ näpa døøŋŋø ki pïï,
english: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

anywaa: ki kanya ö eni na gëëŋ näpa døøŋŋø, nee ciik moe ba kaal pïïyi, ki kanya täk tier piny ki cwääc,
english: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

anywaa: kar kaace a nut buute, ni aana kwääc tïïc; ni yie wø døøya mo met cooth ki yïth nïne bëët, naa bëëdö naa kanynyø nyïme cooth,
english: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

anywaa: ni yia met ki piny mare bäre, naa kanynyø kiper jiy bëët.
english: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, obwöre, wïnynyu mara; gwïëth en jï jø wø gwøk uutjïëth tïïe 'moa.
english: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

anywaa: Wïnynyu pwöc ni lëëny wïthu; kär nou taaga gø.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋat wø cek ïthe ki mara, ni wø raŋ dhi kal mara ki yïth nïne bëët, ni wø kurö dhi øtø mara.
english: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato joot aani, kwøw joode joodø, ni jïte ki met ec baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato ba joot aani raanynya dëëre keere, ni jø wø män ki aani bëët, mëër ka thøø.»
english: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

anywaa: Leec wïc ogëëdö ki øtø mare, mo ee cöönhnhö ki were abïriiø.
english: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:

anywaa: Ni ŋäde ki dhieŋ, ni nyööbe ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni ö eni ni jiiŋ akaaŋ.
english: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.

anywaa: Køøre jø tïïc moe ajääŋŋe wøk, ni ö eni ni cwöde ni ena bäät thuur kanya en maal dï pääny, ni kööe,
english: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,

anywaa: ni «Ŋat ma acaara mare thiinh, beerra man gää kany.» Ni kööe thuwø jï ŋata näk ba cädö,
english: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

anywaa: ni «Ööï, ni cämï ki cam mara, ni mädhï ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mana nywøba.
english: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

anywaa: Wec bëët thïnh acaara, niï bëëdï niï kwøw, ni cäädhï øtjöör ŋäc tiet luup.»
english: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kööm ŋat abuua wø käla lään wïc bääte, ni ŋat wø jook dhaanhø mo raac wø joota ajaany.
english: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.

anywaa: Kär ŋat abuua joogï, nee ba männe ki ïïni; jook dhaanhø mo wïïe leer, eni mëëyö ki ïïni.
english: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

anywaa: Cïp pwöc jï dhaanhø mo wïïe leer, eni leec wïïe okadhi; pwöny dhaanhø mo mare beer, eni kwänynyö mare meede meedø.
english: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye täk leec wïc, ni ki man ŋäc eni na en kur keere beeye ŋäc tiet luup.
english: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

anywaa: Kiper leec wïc beeye noo tïïc nïr kwøw moï ni thööth, ni meet ruun møøk bäät ruut kwøw moï.
english: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.

anywaa: Ni näk mo wïïï leer, leec wïc marï oduunni jïrï, 'ba ni näk mo ïïna ŋat abuua, rääö marï okäärï keerï.
english: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.

anywaa: Dhaagø mo wïïe känni bëënna dïlweel, na acaara mare thiinh, ni bäŋ gïn ŋääe.
english: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.

anywaa: Eni wø pïïa piny dhi øde, ni pï piny bäät køøm bäät thuur kanya en maal dï pääny,
english: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

anywaa: ni bëëde ni cøøra jø wø pöödhi ki øtjöö, jø wø cäädhi ki uutjïëthe moge na thïïŋ, ni kööe,
english: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

anywaa: ni «Ŋat ma acaara mare thiinh, beerra man gää kany.» Ni kööe thuwø jï ŋata näk ba cädö,
english: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,

anywaa: ni «Ciin baŋ dhaagø mør ŋweeth kaamar pïï mo di kwalø, ni met kaamar møø mo cam no okanø.»
english: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na acaara mare thiinh kuue ni jøøa no othøw ena kaace, ni kuue thuwø ni wëëlle mo dhaaŋŋøgø ena kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

anywaa: Moi beege pwöc leec wïc mo Cølöman. Nyilaal mo wïïe leer duua met ec jï wänni, 'ba nyilaal mo wïïe känni duua pänh cwïny jï menni.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

anywaa: Jammi mo joot ki køør tïïe mo reyø bäŋ gïn duuge, 'ba bëët bëënynyö beeye ni wø käl dhaanhø wøk cer thøø.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jøøa marge beer ba wëëk käc, 'ba par mar jø raay wø di raanynyø.
english: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

anywaa: Ceŋ mo okut käw wø duua bëët can, 'ba ceŋ mo rweenhnhi ri tïïc wø duua bëët kwär.
english: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cooŋ caape ka arïïa wïïe leer, 'ba ŋat wø bëën niine kany wø tïme na kar kac duua lään wïc.
english: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat wø mare beer, 'ba dïwït mar dhi ŋat raay wø døøa dëëre keere.
english: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

anywaa: Par wïc ki gïr jøøa marge beer beeye gwïëth, 'ba nyeŋ jøøa reyø rwäänyö.
english: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe leer, ciik wø jïëe jïëö, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe känni ni wø car oballe pätha yi ränynyö.
english: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cäädhi ki jöö mo thïïŋ wø cäädhö no ogwøø, 'ba ŋat wø cäädhi ki uutjïëthe mo oköömmö, eni wø di joodø.
english: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

anywaa: Eni ni wø niiŋ waŋe wø duua gïï mo reyø, ni ŋat mo wïïe känni ni wø car oballe pätha yi ränynyö.
english: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

anywaa: Dhøk mar ŋata mare beer beeye jøøro mar kwøw, 'ba dïwït mar dhi ŋat raay wø døøa dëëre keere.
english: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

anywaa: Män cïïmma wëëye yïthakic jiy, 'ba mëër wø rïëpa gïï wø bayi bëët.
english: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.

anywaa: Luup leec wïc wø joota dhi ŋat wø ŋäc gïna beer ki gïna raac, 'ba ŋat wø ba cädö wø rømi ka acwäät keere.
english: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

anywaa: Jø wø wïthge leer, kwänynyö wø kange cwïnyge, 'ba dhi ŋat mo wïïe känni kare cään ki ränynyö.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo dhaanhø caala kiir mo teek jïre,  'ba bëët can duua ränynyö bäät ŋata can.
english: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

anywaa: Öölö mar jøøa marge beer duua bëëtö mo beer, 'ba gïn wø duu tïïe mo jøøa reyø beeye ajäla.
english: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

anywaa: Ŋat wø gwøk pwöc cäädha øtjöör kwøw, 'ba ŋat wø kwier juuk, eno gaa wøk.
english: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kaan män, dhee da tööt, ni ŋat wø ŋeel waac nyeŋ wïïe ba leer.
english: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

anywaa: Kany wø cään dhaanhe ki luup mo thööth, bääyö ba kääŋi, 'ba ŋat wø gwøk leebe, wïïe leer.
english: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.

anywaa: Luup dhaanhø mo mare beer perge leth ni caala gwel-bïrö mana tøŋ, 'ba acaara mar ŋat raay bäŋ gïn kønye.
english: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

anywaa: Cäänö mar jøøa marge beer jiy mo thööth kønye kønyø, 'ba jøøa wïthge känni othøw kiper bäŋ acaara.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

anywaa: Gwïëth mar Wuuö Jwøk beeye wø duunni ki kwärö, ni kïmmö bäŋ wø meet bääte.
english: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe känni, gïï mo reyø tïïe kaamar gïr kwääk jaak, 'ba ŋat wø ŋäc tiet luup, yie wø mïnni ka bëët leec wïc.
english: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.

anywaa: Gïn wø lwäär ŋata raaci ki gø opïï bääte, 'ba gïn wø many ŋata beerri oci jïre.
english: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

anywaa: Kany wø pööth atuunne, ŋata raac ba joot këët, 'ba ŋata beer bëëdö ni tiere okëët piny na bäre bäre.
english: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø bëët gïn mo waci ki lak, ki man wø bëët jïrö ki waŋ, gïnögø thuwø caala ŋat mo dëëre leth jï ŋat wø jääŋ gø.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk nïr kwøw di meedø, 'ba cwiic kwøw mo jøøa reyø oŋuudi ni nøk.
english: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

anywaa: Aŋuun ŋäädhe mar jøøa beyø beeye met ec, 'ba ŋäädhe mar jøøa reyø beeye ränynyö.
english: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

anywaa: Jöör Wuuö Jwøk beeye kar gwøk røk jï jøøa marge thïïŋ, 'ba beeye jöör ränynyö jï jø wø tïïc gïï wø reyø.
english: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

anywaa: Jøøa marge beer tietge ba cööt wøk na bäre bäre, 'ba jø raay ba ruu wïth ŋøøm.
english: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

anywaa: Dhi ŋata mare beer wø cïpa leec wïc, 'ba leep mo wella luup ŋula wøk.
english: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer wø ŋäya caan gïn mo beer, 'ba dhøk jøøa reyø wø ŋäya wel luup.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki rumi mar møt, 'ba yie wø met ka rumi ma kare.
english: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.

anywaa: Bëët atöör duua lään wïc, 'ba bëët mööl duua leec wïc.
english: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

anywaa: Bëëtö mo tiir mar jøøa marge thïïŋ beeye ni wø bwøth geni, 'ba jø cwøk wø raany cwøki marge raanynyø.  Jap kwärö dhaanhø ba kønyge cäŋ ajäla, 'ba bëët bëënynyö dhaanhø wø käle wøk cer thøø.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

anywaa: Bëët bëënynyö mar ŋata mare tiir, øtjööre wø døøye mo thïïŋ, 'ba ŋata raac wø pädhö ki køør rääö mare.
english: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

anywaa: Bëët bëënynyö mar jøøa marge thïïŋ beeye ni wø piem geni, 'ba jø cwøk wø pätha ya abïëp ki køør gïï wø en cwïnyge køørge.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

anywaa: Ŋata raac kanyo thøøe, gïïa ŋäädhe puta ränynyö, ni ö gïïa lääŋŋe ni joode joodø ki køør teek mare ni ränyge.
english: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer wø käla wøk yïth gïïa leth, ni ö ŋata raaci ni läw yïth gïïögø.
