english: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.

anywaa: Ŋata raac watge wø di raanynyø ki gïn wø cur dhee, 'ba jøøa beyø wø di piemø ki køør kwänynyö marge.
english: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

anywaa: Kany wø bëët jøøa marge beer ni bëëtö marge cäädhö ni beer, jø pääny yïthge wø mïnnö, 'ba kany wø räny jøøa reyø, jiy wø kwöŋŋö ki met ec.
english: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

anywaa: Pääny nyeŋŋe wø wïnyö ki køør man wø ö jøøa marge thïïŋ ni wø gwïëthge gø, 'ba ränynyö ki køør dhøk jøøa reyø.
english: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

anywaa: Ŋat wø jøøŋ watge beeye ŋat mo ba cädö, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe da acaara wø bëëdö ni lïŋö.
english: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

anywaa: Ŋat wø wïdi jaak ni waya nyeŋ, wø dhäänynya luup mo okanø, 'ba ŋat mo oŋäädhö, luup wø di kanø.
english: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

anywaa: Kany mo bäŋ pwöc yie mo beer, bëët jiy ränynyö, 'ba kany mo yie da jiy mo thööth mo pöö, jiy di piemø.
english: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cïp ree yi waŋ luubö mar dhaanhø mør gïï mo leth ojwøre, 'ba ŋat wø ba cïp ree na dïgïti kar dhaanhø mør, bäŋ gïn mo pïï dëëre.
english: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

anywaa: Dhaagø mo pänhnha jiy wø jïtö ki wödö, 'ba jøøa wïnni wø joota jap kwärö keerge.
english: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëër ki jiy tïïya gïn mo beer kiper dëëre, 'ba ŋat kwöri raanynya dëëre keere.
english: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.

anywaa: Ŋata raac jammi mo wø joode beeye jammi mo kiera wïïe, 'ba ŋat wø piith gïïa beyø wø joota gïna näk kare.
english: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.

anywaa: Ŋat wø bëëdö ri bëënynyö mana näk adïëri, jïtö ki kwøw, 'ba ŋat wø caath køør raay wø käla thøø bääte keere.
english: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki jø wø bëën cwøk, 'ba yie wø mïnni ka jø wø caath jöör adïëri.
english: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ŋata raac bäŋ wø kääŋi ka ajäla, 'ba nyïïkwaac jøøa marge beer di piemø.
english: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

anywaa: Dhaagø mo mïërö ni näk mo gïna beer ki gïna raac kuue,  caala ogut warkey mo okïth um kul.
english: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

anywaa: Gïn wø en cwïny jøøa beyø køøre wø thum na wøp, 'ba aŋuun ŋäädhe mar jøøa reyø beeye ajäla.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

anywaa: Da dhaanhø mo jape muue muuö jaak, 'ba wø poot jïtö ki mo thööth; ni da dhaanhø mo mäna gïna no orømø ki man cïp gø, 'ba wø poot cännö bääte.
english: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo yie tar bëëtö mare bëënynyö, ni ŋat wø kunynyi di kønyø thuwø.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

anywaa: Ŋat wø män beel ni ba laar ŋeew, ocien jiyi, 'ba gwïëth oen bäät ŋat wø laar moe dwøk pwödhö.
english: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

anywaa: Ŋat wø many bëënynyö ki cwïnye bäre, jïtö ki met ec baŋ jiy, 'ba ŋat wø many gïn mo raac, ränynyö pïï bääte.
english: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ŋääth jap kwärö moe, pätha yi ränynyö, 'ba ŋata mare beer bëëdö no oløth kaamar jaath.
english: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cwöth paare, beeye jamø keere noo dööŋ jïre, ni ö ŋata wïïe känni ni tïme ni bëënna ŋata wïïe leer.
english: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

anywaa: Nyïëdi mo wø joot jøøa marge beer ki køør tïïe moge, beeye jaath kwøw, ni ŋat mo wïïe leer wø jïtö ki jiy mo thööth.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo ŋata mare beer di cunnö bäät piny kany, a ŋat raay ki ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø okääŋge nidïï?
english: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëër ki pwöc, mëër ka kwänynyö, 'ba ŋat wø män ki juuk, wïïe bäŋgø.
english: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo beer jïtö ki met ec baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba ŋat wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø jääle jäälö.
english: A good man obtaineth favour of the Lord: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

anywaa: Rääö, kar dhaanhø ba tïïe ni teek, 'ba ŋata mare beer tiere ba cööt wøk.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

anywaa: Dhaagø mo bëëtö mare beer caala aduda jï cwøre, 'ba dhaagø mo kännö ki lään wïc caala atwøda mo odheeth dëër cwøre.
english: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

anywaa: Acaare mo jøøa marge beer beege adïëri, 'ba pwöc mo jøøa reyø beege cwøk.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

anywaa: Luup mo jøøa reyø beege luup mo kønynya rem jiy piny, 'ba luup mo jøøa marge thïïŋ, jiy wø piemge piemø.
english: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø di raanynyø ni tïmge ni bäŋgø këët, 'ba mïëc jøøa marge beer bëëdö karge ni teek.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

anywaa: Dhaanhø di pwøø ki køør leec wïc mare, 'ba mar jø adøønne wø di taaø.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

anywaa: Beerra dhaanhø mo kare thiinh ni da ŋat mo tïnynya gø; eni kaala dhaanhø mo døøya kare mo dwøŋ ni bäŋ gïn came.
english: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo mare beer, wø cädö kiper bëët lääy mare, 'ba pänh cwïny mar ŋata raac beeye ki man tïïc gïn mo raac dëër lääy.
english: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

anywaa: Ŋat wø puur ŋöömö mare, wø jïtö ki cam mo päl, 'ba ŋat wø rïïŋi køør gïï mo oballe, eni ba cädö.
english: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

anywaa: Ŋat raay cwïnye wø ena køør jap wø twier jø raayi, 'ba ŋata mare beer tiere wø këëta piny ni jïte ki nyïëdi.
english: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

anywaa: Ŋat mo raac wø pätha ya abïëp ki køør raay mo dhee, 'ba ŋata mare beer wø käla wøk yïth gïïa leth.
english: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø jäŋ ki gïï mo beyø ki køør luupe ni wø cur dhee, ni ö tïïe mo wø tïïc dhaanhe ki cere ni duunge jïre.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe känni wø cädö ni beerra mare keere, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe leer, ïthe wø di ciiø ki pwöc.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe känni, gootø mare wø laar ka ŋäc, 'ba ŋat mo waŋe riek, lään wïc mare wø di buŋö.
english: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lam luubö na adïëri, caana mana näk kare, 'ba ŋat wø kat luup wø cara cwøk.
english: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

anywaa: Luup mo laar ka caan ni wïc kär caarø, cööbö kaamar opëëllö, 'ba lëëp jøøa wïthge leer käla køny.
english: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

anywaa: Dhøk mo cara adïëri ruu na bäre bäre, 'ba leep mo cara tööt beeta kany mo thiinh.
english: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

anywaa: Cwøk ena cwïny jø wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø, 'ba jø wø pöö ki pwöc bëët-mëër, jïge da met ec.
english: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

anywaa: Bäŋ gïn mo leth mo päth bäät jøøa marge beer, 'ba jø raay wø bëëdö yïth gïïa reyø.
english: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki dhøk mo cara tööt, 'ba yie wø met ka jø wø tïïya adïëri.
english: Lying lips are abomination to the Lord: but they that deal truly are his delight.

anywaa: Ŋat mo waŋe riek, leec wïc mare wø di kanø, 'ba jøøa wïthge känni wø cara bøøl jaak.
english: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

anywaa: Ŋat mo cere rweenhnhi ri tïïc, tïmö ni jiy bëënna eni, 'ba ŋata jääk tïmö na laŋ dhaanhø mør.
english: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

anywaa: Kïmmö cwïny dhaanhø wø døøye mo peek, 'ba luubö mo beer yi dhaanhø wø døøye mo met.
english: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo mare beer bëëtö ma kare wø di nyoodhø jï watge, 'ba jöör ŋata raac jiy wø bwødhe wøk kwöra reyø.
english: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël ba kän paac ki rïŋö, 'ba ŋat mo rweenhnhi ri tïïc beeye dhaanhø mo pere leth.
english: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

anywaa: Jöör bëënynyö nuta kwøw yie, ni bäŋe thøø øtjööre.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

anywaa: Nyilaal mo wïïe leer pwöc wänni wø di wïnynyö, 'ba ŋat abuua juuk bäŋ wø wïnynye.
english: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø jïtö ki bëëtö mo beer ki køør luupe ni wø cur dhee, 'ba jø cwøk wø manynya bëët okiera.
english: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

anywaa: Ŋat wø koor dhee gwøga jwïëy moe, 'ba ŋat wø ŋaam dhee ki gïï mo oballe jaak wø pätha yi ränynyö.
english: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël gïï wø pare ni wø en cwïnye køørge ba joode, 'ba ŋat mo rweenhnhi ri tïïc bëëtö mare bëënynyö.
english: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer wø män ki tööt, 'ba ŋata raac wø tïïya jap lään wïc ki jap räny nyeŋ.
english: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

anywaa: Bëënynyö jöör bëëtö mar ŋata mare thïïŋ di koorø, 'ba bëët rääö wø duua ränynyö dëër ŋat raay.
english: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mør ree wø di cøøgø ni eno kwär, 'ba bäŋ gïrpiny jïre; ni dhaanhø mør ree wø di cøøgø ni eni can, 'ba eno kwär.
english: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

anywaa: Ŋat mo okwär løny ki man cïp jape ni wïïla jwïëye wøk, 'ba ŋata can bäŋ ŋat mo mak gø ki teek.
english: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

anywaa: Jøøa marge beer bëëdö na tar mo kännö ki met ec, 'ba jøøa reyø tïmö ni caala lamba mo cäätha baŋ thøø.
english: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

anywaa: Bëët koorrø wø duua lenye keerge, 'ba leec wïc wø ena baŋ jø wø jïëc pwöc.
english: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo laar ka joot wø laara ränynyö, 'ba ŋat wø joot jap kwärö ki køør tïïc mare, nyaay jïre.
english: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

anywaa: Gïn mo oŋäädhö ni ruue, duunnö ki pänh cwïny, 'ba gïn mo olääŋŋö mo othur kare tïmö na jaath kwøw.
english: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

anywaa: Ŋat wø taak pwöc, pïïn pwöc ena bääte, 'ba ŋat wø lwäär ki ciik di cunnö ki gïn mo beer.
english: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

anywaa: Pwöc mar ŋat mo wïïe leer beeye jøøro mar kwøw, ni dhaanhø wø paanyge paanyø ki dha abïëp thøø.
english: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

anywaa: Acaara mo beer duunnö ki pwøc, 'ba jöör bëëtö mar jø cwøk duua ränynyö.
english: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

anywaa: Ŋat mo waŋe riek wø tïïö ka køør kwänynyö, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe känni wø nyøtha bøøl mare.
english: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

anywaa: Ŋat mo raac, noo jääŋŋi, pätha yïth gïï mo reyø, 'ba ŋat mo oŋäädhö wø duua køny.
english: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

anywaa: Ŋat wø taak pwöc, bëët can ki lään wïc ööa bääte, 'ba ŋat wø jïëc juuk wø jïtö ki wödö.
english: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

anywaa: Gïn mo olääŋŋö mo othur kare wø duunnö ki met ec jï dhaanhø, 'ba jøøa wïthge känni yïthge wø raac ki wec gïïa reyø.
english: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cäädhi ki jøøa wïthge leer, wïïe tïmö ni leer, 'ba nyawat jøøa wïthge känni wø joota gïï mo reyø.
english: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

anywaa: Gïï mo reyø wø løpa køør jø raay, 'ba jøøa marge beer wø di cunnö ki gïï mo beyø.
english: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo beer wø wëëö ki gïï wø dööŋ jï nyïïkwaaye, 'ba jammi mo jø raay wø dööŋ jï jøøa marge beer.
english: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo can, këël pwöthe doo ciek ki cam mo päl, caammi moe wø poot di camø ki køør bäŋ ŋøl luup ma adïëri.
english: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

anywaa: Ŋat mo weya acwäät ki wääde, män ki gø, 'ba ŋat wø mëër ki wääde wø pöö ni ba jøøm.
english: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer caammi mo orømø wø dagø jïre, 'ba ŋata raac wø bëëdö no obup cooth.
english: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

anywaa: Dhaagø mo wïïe leer paare wø këëlle piny, 'ba dhaagø mo wïïe känni paare wø di raanynyø ki cere.
english: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cäädhi ki jöö mo thïïŋ lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba ŋat wø bëën cwøk, Wuuö Jwøk ee taaø.
english: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the Lord: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

anywaa: Dhi ŋat mo wïïe känni wø cara luup mo nyootha koorø, 'ba lëëpi mo jøøa wïthge leer wø gwøga geni.
english: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

anywaa: Kany mo bäŋ rwäth puur, yïth odïï bëëdö ni ŋaam, 'ba ki køør teek mar rwaath puur, cam mo päl di joodø.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lam luubö na adïëri bäŋ wø cäänö ki tööt, 'ba ŋat wø kat luup wø cara tööt.
english: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

anywaa: Ŋat abuua leec wïc wø di manynyø ni ba joode, 'ba joot kwänynyö jööt jï ŋat wø ŋäc tiet luup.
english: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

anywaa: Tïïc karï ni bäär ki ŋat mo wïïe känni, kiper ï ba jïti ki luup kwänynyö dhee.
english: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

anywaa: Leec wï ŋat mo waŋe riek wø nyootha jïëth tïïe moe jïre, 'ba bøølø mar jøøa wïthge känni cøøga geni.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

anywaa: Jøøa wïthge känni raay ege tïïö na gïr kwääk jaak, 'ba yïthakic jøøa marge thïïŋ wø da met ec.
english: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

anywaa: Cwïny ŋati man nø wø ŋäya kïmmö mare keere, ni mïn ec mar dhaanhø ba joot dhaanhe mørri bäre.
english: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

anywaa: Mïëc jøøa reyø ränynyö, 'ba mïëc jøøa marge thïïŋ løth.
english: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

anywaa: Da jöö mo wø nëënö ni mïërö jï dhaanhø, 'ba aŋuunne coonya baŋ thøø.
english: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

anywaa: Dhaanhø løny ki man bëëde ni ŋeethø jaak, 'ba cwïnye løny ki man bëëde no opädhö, ni ö aŋuun met eci mare ni näk kïmmö.
english: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

anywaa: Ŋat mo cwïnye odøø cään ojäŋ ki jap uutjïëth tïïe moe na reyø, ni ö ŋata beerri ni jääŋe ki jap tïïe moe na beyø.
english: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

anywaa: Ŋat ma acaara mare thiinh jammi bëët wø di jïëö,  'ba ŋat mo waŋe riek kany wø ci yie wø di caarø.
english: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe leer wø lwäär, ni ree wø di paanyø ki raay, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe känni wø laara päär bäät luubö ni wïïe ba caare.
english: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

anywaa: Ŋat mo laara wëër, jammi wø di tïïö ki bäŋ acaara, ni ŋat wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø, jiy män ki gø.
english: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

anywaa: Jøøa näk acaara marge thiinh wø joota bëët bøølø, 'ba jøøa nyeŋge reegø, kwänynyö bëëdö na aduda jïge.
english: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

anywaa: Jø raay cøŋge okëëlge piny nyïm jøøa beyø, ni ö jøøa reyø ni këëlge cøŋge piny dhøk käälle mo jøøa marge beer.
english: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo can këël watge männö ki gø, 'ba dhaanhø mo okwär, jiy mo thööth wø mëër ki eni.
english: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

anywaa: Ŋat wø taak watge obääyö, 'ba gwïëth en jï ŋat wø nyooth mëër jï jøøa can.
english: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jø wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø, ge patha ogaa wøk? 'Ba jø wø caar tïï gïï mo beyø, mëër ka adïëri wø jootge joodø.
english: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

anywaa: Ki ri tïï öölö bäre, da gïn mo di joodø ree, 'ba waac jaak wø bwødha jiy yi can.
english: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo jøøa wïthge leer beeye aduda jïge, 'ba bëët bøølø mar jøøa wïthge känni beeye bøøl møn.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lam luubö na adïëri, jwïëy wø di piemø, 'ba ŋat wø car tööt, mare cwøk.
english: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk jïre da kare mo teek, no obwöre moe jïge da kar gwøk røk.
english: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye jøøro mar kwøw, ni dhaanhø wø paanye paanyø ki dha abïëp thøø.
english: The fear of the Lord is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

anywaa: Ajiem nyeya beeye thööth jiy moe, 'ba ni näk bäŋ jiy beeye ränynyö mare.
english: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ba laar wëër, wïïe da acaara mo dwøŋ, 'ba ŋat wø laar wëër tïŋa bøøl mare maal.
english: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

anywaa: Bëëtö ni cwïny beer jaak duunnö ki jööt dëël, 'ba keec cwïny, jööt dëël di raanynyø.
english: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

anywaa: Ŋat wø tïïc gïn mo raac dëër dhaanhø mo can, janynya Jwøk na cwääc ŋatøgø, 'ba ŋat wø nyooth mëër jï ŋata can wøøra Jwøk na cwääc ŋatøgø.
english: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

anywaa: Ŋata raac wø ränynyö ki køør tïïe moe na reyø, 'ba ŋata mare beer kanyo thøøe, da kare mo di ŋäädhö mo cøøa yie.
english: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

anywaa: Leec wïc wø bëëdö cwïny ŋat wø ŋäc tiet luup,  'ba kare kuc ki baŋ jøøa wïthge känni.
english: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

anywaa: Bëët bëënynyö nyeŋ paac wø tïŋe maal, 'ba raay wø duua räny nyeŋ bäät paac.
english: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

anywaa: Pwøc mar nyeya wø ena jï ŋat tïïc mo wïïe leer, 'ba wëër mare wø ena bäät ŋat wø tïïc gïï lään wïc.
english: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

anywaa: Løk luubö mëëth ni beer wëër wø di paanyø, 'ba luup mo leth wø dhäya wëër.
english: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

anywaa: Lëëpi mo jøøa wïthge leer, beeny kwänynyö wø di ŋääö ki køørge, 'ba dhøk jøøa wïthge känni wø gwäära luup bøøl wøk.
english: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

anywaa: Waŋ Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät piny bäre, ni eni neeta moa reyø ki moa beyø bëët.
english: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

anywaa: Leep mo duua køny beeye jaath kwøw, 'ba leep mo wella luup, cwïny dhaanhø wø wëëge pädhö.
english: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe känni, pwöc wänni wø di kwierø, 'ba ŋat wø wïny juuk waŋe riek.
english: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo thööth wø joota yi øt ŋata mare beer, 'ba jammi mo wø joot ŋata raaci duua bëëtö mo leth dëëre.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

anywaa: Lëëpi mo jøøa wïthge leer wø nyaaya kwänynyö, 'ba jøøa näk wïthge känni, manøgø ba tïïcge.
english: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ko olämme mo jøøa reyø, 'ba yie wø mïnni ka lam mar jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the Lord: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki jöör bëëtö mar jøøa reyø, 'ba eni wø mëër ka ŋat wø løp køør bëënynyö.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the Lord: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

anywaa: Pwöc mo leth oen bäät ŋat wø kwier jöör adïëri, ni ŋat wø män ki juuk, thøw.
english: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo kar ränynyö, kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, nëënö jï Wuuö Jwøk, a cwïny jiy, a ba dee nëënö jïre nidïï?
english: Hell and destruction are before the Lord: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

anywaa: Ŋat abuua ba many man jooi, ni eni bäŋ wø ci baŋ ŋata wïïe leer.
english: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

anywaa: Cwïny mo leer täärnyïm dhaanhø wø døøye mo waany, 'ba cwïny mo kïmmö wø duua pänh cwïny.
english: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe da acaara wø manynya kwänynyö, ba jøøa näk wïthge känni, jap bøølø ege tïïö na cam marge.
english: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

anywaa: Cääŋŋe bëët wø bëëdö ni reyø jï ŋata no ocaarø, 'ba cwïny mo leer caala man wø bëëde ni piny da ajwöma cooth.
english: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

anywaa: Bëët dhaanhø mo jape nøk mo lwäära Wuuö Jwøk beerra eni ni kaala bëët ŋat mo jap kwärö moe thööth mo duunnö ki kier wïc.
english: Better is little with the fear of the Lord than great treasure and trouble therewith.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man cam kat omarø kany mo yie da mëër, ni kaala kany mo camma rïŋö yie mo olør, mo yie da mäne.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

anywaa: Ŋat wëëye, pïëm wø di tääö, 'ba ŋat mo ba laar wëër wø mäna pïëm.
english: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

anywaa: Jöör ŋat leth dëël caala jöö mo orïëp koodhi, 'ba jöör jøøa marge thïïŋ dwøŋ jaak.
english: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

anywaa: Nyilaal mo wïïe leer duua met ec jï wänni, 'ba dhaanhø mo wïïe känni, menni wø di taaø.
english: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

anywaa: Bëët bøølø beeye gïr met ec jï ŋat mo ba cädö, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe da acaara wø cäädhi ka jöö mana thïïŋ.
english: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

anywaa: Ni näk bäŋ jiy mo cïpi ka acaare, gïï wø caar dhaanhe ba thur karge, 'ba ni näk jø wø cïpi ka acaare thööth, gïïögø thura karge.
english: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

anywaa: Løk pïëc ma kare yi dhaanhø wø døøye mo met, ni caan luubö kanya näk ma kare, a teeŋ beer mo nyïëdi!
english: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

anywaa: Jöör ŋat mo wïïe leer wø cäätha maal baŋ kwøw, ni mäna eni ki man ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk øt ŋat atöör wø nyaae piny, 'ba keew mar pwöth cï thøø wø wëëge bëëtö kare.
english: The Lord will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

anywaa: Acaare mo reyø, Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki ge, 'ba luup mo tøŋ, ec met ki ge.
english: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the Lord: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

anywaa: Ŋat mo cwïnye päl ni wø joot jammi ki jöö mo paa adïëri wø kïtha paare yi ränynyö, 'ba ŋat wø män ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny, eni bëëdö ni kwøw.
english: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

anywaa: Ŋat mo mare beer wø kwøŋa cädö bäät luubö man wø løøe, 'ba dhi ŋata raac wø gwäära gïï mo reyø wøk.
english: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kare bäär ki jø raay, 'ba eni lam mar jøøa marge beer wø di wïnynyö.
english: The Lord is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

anywaa: Räŋŋö ki waŋ mo beer, cwïny wø døøye mo met, ni ö luubö mo nyään mo met ni cïpe ki jööt dëël.
english: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

anywaa: Ŋat wø wïny juuk man wø duunni ki kwøw wø bëëdö dï jøøa wïthge leer.
english: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

anywaa: Ŋat wø taak pwöc raanynya dëëre keere, 'ba ŋat wø wïny juuk wø jïtö ka acaara.
english: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk duunnö ki pwöc leec wïc, ni dhaanhø mo mwöl jïtö ki wödö.
english: The fear of the Lord is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø cädö ki yi cwïnye kiper luubö mano caane, 'ba gïno beer ni wø dwøk leebe käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

anywaa: Uutjïëth tïïe bëët mo dhaanhø beyø ki jïre, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni wø raŋ cwïny dhaanhø.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.

anywaa: Cïp tïïe moï cer Wuuö Jwøk, køøre acaare moï othur karge ni këëtge piny.
english: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jammi bëët ee cwääö kiper tïïe moge,  ni ŋata raac cøøa yi ränynyö cäŋ gïïa leth.
english: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki jiy bëët moa näk cwïnyge da atöör; ka adïëri møn, geni, ge ba bøth ka ajäla.
english: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

anywaa: Ki køør bëët-mëër ki bëët adïëri, gïï wø bayi di wiiø, ni ki køør man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk, dhaanhø ree wø di løø ni kwiera gïïa reyø.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

anywaa: Kany wø näk mo jïëth tïïe mo dhaanhø duua met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk cïpö ki bëët-mëër, këël yïthakic dhaanhø ki nyïïmän moe.
english: When a man's ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

anywaa: Bëët dhaanhø mo jape nøk ni mare adïëri beerra eni ni kaala bëët ŋat mo jape thööth mo joot ka jöö mo patha kare.
english: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø cädö kiper øtjöör tïïc mare, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk beeye ni wø bwøth eni ki jööre.
english: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

anywaa: Jwøk ŋøl mana näk kare wø cïbe dhi nyeya, nee dhee ba gaa wøk kany wø ŋøl luup.
english: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

anywaa: Rumi ma adïëri ena baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, këël jap røm bëët mo wø tïï jiyi ki ge.
english: A just weight and balance are the Lord's: all the weights of the bag are his work.

anywaa: Ki man tïï nyeye ki gïï mo reyø beeye gïn mo ec raac ki gø, kiper wälu marge wø këët piny ka køør bëët adïëri.
english: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

anywaa: Nyeye yïthge wø mïnni ka jø wø caan adïëri, ni ge wø mëër ka jø wø caan luup mo thïïŋ.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

anywaa: Wëër mar nyeya caala thøø mo ööa bäät dhaanhø, 'ba dhaanhø mo wïïe leer, cwïny nyeya wø dwøge piny.
english: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

anywaa: Leec täärnyïm mar nyeya beeye kwøw jï jiy, ni met ec mare caala man wø ö pøølli ni wø käl køth mar dhi køth.
english: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

anywaa: A teeŋ beer mo nyïëdi ki man joot leec wïc ni kaala warkey! Naa teeŋ beer mo nyïëdi ki man jier ŋäc tiet luup ni kaala gwel-bïrö!
english: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

anywaa: Jöör jøøa marge thïïŋ wø ŋäätö ki buut gïïa reyø, ni ŋat wø koor jööre gwøga jwïëye.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

anywaa: Atöör wø bwøtha maal, køøre ki ränynyö, ni ö koorrø ni bwøth maal, køøre ki pädhö.
english: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

anywaa: Ki man dwøk røk piny ni bëëdö ki jøøa can beerra eni ni kaala man nywaak jap twëër ki jø atöör.
english: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cek ïthe ki pwöc jïtö ki bëëtö mo beer, ni gwïëth wø ena jï ŋat wø bëëdö ni ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe leer di cwølø ni ŋat mo wïïe da acaara, ni luubö mo met wø wëëga pwöc ciin cwïny jiy.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

anywaa: Ŋäc tiet luup beeye jøøro mar kwøw jï ŋata en jï gø, 'ba pwöny jiy mo wïthge känni beeye bøøl jaak.
english: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

anywaa: Acaac dhaanhø mo wïïe leer wø bëëdö ni pwönynya leebe, ni wëëga pwöc man wø caane ciin cwïny jiy.
english: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

anywaa: Luup mo ec met ki ge caala maar kïc ma tëëma, ni ŋweeth marge duunnö ki met ec jï dhaanhø ki jööt dëël.
english: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

anywaa: Da jöö mo wø nëënö ni mïërö jï dhaanhø, 'ba aŋuunne coonya baŋ thøø.
english: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

anywaa: Käc, dhaanhø wø di pwönynyö ki tïïc, ni dhaanhø wø pee baŋ puur.
english: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo wïïe raac cädö kiper tïï gïï mo reyø, ni dhee caala maac ni wø raany piny.
english: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

anywaa: Ŋat wø wel luup ŋeela mäne, ni dïwääc nyeŋŋi wø pää nyïïawäädi mo oŋïyö døc.
english: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

anywaa: Ŋat okiera wï watge wø di maaŋŋø, ni watge wø di bwødhø ki øtjöö mo ba beer.
english: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

anywaa: Ŋat wø niiŋ waŋe wø caara luup cwøk, ni ŋat wø cuul dhee wø nyootha raay mo ee nø caar ki cwïnye.
english: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

anywaa: Jïër ma lwaar beeye adun ajiem jï dhaanhø mo dwøŋ, ni wø joot ki køør bëët adïëri.
english: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ba laar wëër beerra eni ni kaala ŋat mo oteeø, ni ŋat wø mak cwïnye beerra eni ni kaala ŋat wø mak pääny ki tøŋ.
english: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

anywaa: Nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ni nyootha gïrpiny wø di tïïö, 'ba ŋøl luup mana näk adïëri käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man bääl thääŋ kwön mo obutö kany mo da bëët-mëër yie, ni kaala paac mo camma rïŋ yie mo yie da pïëm.
english: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

anywaa: Ŋat tïïc mo jammi tïïe ka leec wïc, tïmö na kwääc nyilaal man wø känni ki lään wïc jï wänni, ni eni jïtö ki gïï wø dööŋ na moe kaamar wäädö aciel dï nyïïmëëe.
english: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

anywaa: Gwel-bïrö ki warkey beeye maa thäth ni wø raŋi ki gø, 'ba cwïny dhaanhø, beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni wø raŋ gø.
english: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.

anywaa: Ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø wø wïnynya luup dhøk jøøa reyø, ni ö twöti ni cek ïthe ki luup dhøgi mo räänyö.
english: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

anywaa: Ŋat wø buu ŋat mo can janynya Jwøk na cwääc ŋatøgø, ni ŋat wø yie mïnni ki gïï wø leth ni wø tägi ba kääŋi ka ajäla.
english: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

anywaa: Aduda mar jäle beeye nyïïkwaacge, ni ö ajiemmi mar obwöre ni näk wëëe moge.
english: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

anywaa: Luup ŋat mo cäänö døc jaak mo wïïe raac ba mïërö, ni luum tööt ba mïërö ki man cur dhi kwäärö.
english: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

anywaa: Jammi mo wø cïp ki piny beege ni wø ŋääth ŋat wø cïp gø, ni ki jïre kany wø ci yie, gïïa manynye di joodø.
english: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

anywaa: Ŋat wø uum gïn mo obaa dëëre, tïïya mëër, 'ba ŋat wø nøøc luubö pää nyïïawäädi.
english: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

anywaa: Juuk wø dønynya yi cwïny ŋat mo cädö, ni kaala kwör pöödö ma dïpa mo opïï dëër ŋat mo wïïe känni.
english: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo raac wø manynya ageem keere; 'ba ŋat mo ogäy di jääŋŋö baŋe.
english: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man røømmø ki maath kwac mo nyïïe okälö, ni kaala man røømmø ki ŋat mo wïïe känni mo tïïya tïï bøøl.
english: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

anywaa: Ŋat wø duu gïn mo raac na kar gïna beer, gïn mo raac ba doo aay paare.
english: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

anywaa: Täk wëër caala kany wø tuc adïïra, kiper manøgø nø, pïëm wär laar jook kanyo poode ni kär kadhø.
english: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ŋun ŋat mo raac, ki ŋat wø ŋøl ŋat mo mare beer wøk, Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki geni bëët.
english: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ŋat mo wïïe känni, ki man ŋeew leec wïc ki gwel moe, agïnaŋø ni kønye, ni eni wïïe bäŋ acaara?
english: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?

anywaa: Nyawat wø bëënna mëër cooth, ni ö cöögö ni nywøli kiper køny cäŋ gïï mo leth.
english: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

anywaa: Ŋat mo ba cädö, ree wø di cïbö na dïgïti, ni cïp ree waŋ luubö mar dhaanhø mør.
english: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

anywaa: Ŋat mo mëër ki bääö, mëër ka leny, ni ŋat wø tïŋ ree maal ni dwøŋŋa kare cwöla ränynyö bääte.
english: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

anywaa: Ŋat ma acaaye wella luup ba jïti ki bëëtö mo beer, ni ŋat mo dhee bëënna cwøk pätha yïth gïï mo reyø.
english: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

anywaa: Ŋat wø nywøl nyilaal mo wïïe känni wø bëëdö ni cwïnye opädhö, ni wää nyilaalli mo wïïe raac bäŋ met ec jïre.
english: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

anywaa: Cwïny mo leer beeye kïïna mo beer, 'ba pänh cwïny wø duua dwadø dëër dhaanhø.
english: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

anywaa: Ŋat mo raac wø jïëy ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny ni kuc, nee jïëth ŋøl luup ma adïëri welle.
english: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

anywaa: Ŋat mo cädö, nyïme wø løøe baŋ leec wïc, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe känni, waŋe täägö jaak.
english: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

anywaa: Nyilaal mo wïïe känni duua kïmmö jï wänni, ni duunne ki keec cwïny jï menni na nywøl gø.
english: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

anywaa: Cam jammi jaak bäät ŋat mo mare beer paa gïn mo beer, ni pwöt dhaanhø mo kare dwøŋ kiper bëëtö mare na thïïŋ poot paa gïn mo beer.
english: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

anywaa: Ŋat mo okwänynyö, ree wø di gwøø ki luup moe, ni ŋat mo wïïe da acaara ba laar wëër.
english: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

anywaa: Këël ŋat mo wïïe känni, ni näk bëëdö ni lïŋö, di kwaanø ni wïïe leer, ni kany wø näk mo dhee ee cïëgö, wø di købø ni wïïe da acaara.
english: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kul dëëre wø manynya mare keere, ni eni wø jøøŋŋa luup leec wïc bëët.
english: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

anywaa: Ŋat mo wïïe känni, yie ba met ki ŋäc tiet luup, 'ba eni wø nyøtha acaara mare keere.
english: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

anywaa: Kany wø ö rääö, ajøøŋ wø cäädhö køøre, ni ö räny nyeŋŋi ni cäädhe ka ajaany ciel.
english: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

anywaa: Luup mo wø cur dhi dhaanhø wø nyootha acaac yie na caal kut, ni ena jøøro mar leec wïc.
english: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

anywaa: Ajeeny paa gïn mo beer ki man ci løø ŋat mo raac, wala ki man daaŋ luup ŋat mo mare adïëri kar løøk.
english: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

anywaa: Leep ŋat mo wïïe känni wø kännö ki pïëm, ni dhee wø cøøra pöödö keere.
english: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

anywaa: Dhi ŋat mo wïïe känni beeye ränynyö mare keere, ni leebe beeye abïëp jwïëy moe keere.
english: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

anywaa: Luup dïwääc nyeŋ caala cam mo met, ni wø dønynya yi cwïny dhaanhø bäre.
english: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

anywaa: Ŋat mo nweenna ceŋŋe ki tïïc, ena nyawat ŋat mo mare aranya.
english: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye kiir mo teek, ni ŋata mare beer wø reŋŋa yie ni bëëde no ogwøø.
english: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo dhaanhø caala pääny mo ogeerø ni teek ki jïre, ni ee caarø ni beeye kiir mo bäär mo gwøga eni.
english: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

anywaa: Kany wø poot dhaanhe ni kär ränynyö, cwïnye wø da atöör, 'ba kany wø bëët dhaanhe ni mwöl, wø jïtö ki wödö.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

anywaa: Ŋat wø dwøk luubö ni tier luubö poot käre wïnynyö, nyootha dïkät wïc mare, ni duunnö ki lään wïc bääte.
english: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo cwïnye ee maaø, täw wø di jïënyö, ?'ba dhaanhø mo cwïnye opädhö, ree omak gø nidïï?
english: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

anywaa: Ŋat mo cwïnye da acaara jïtö ki kwänynyö, ni ŋat mo wïïe leer, ïthe wø di ciiø ki kwänynyö.
english: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

anywaa: Gïn wø cïp dhaanhe, jöör dhaanhø wø di jabø, ni dhaanhø wø käle nyïm jiy mo døøŋŋø.
english: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kwøŋ mare caan, mare wø nëënö kee adïëri, kanyo poode ni poot bäŋ ŋato pëëny gø.
english: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

anywaa: Nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ni nyootha gïrpiny, pïëm wø di jooø, ni ŋøl luubö yïthakic jiy mo teek.
english: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

anywaa: Døøn kanya ciel ki cöögö mo da gïn mo obaa dëëre teek døc ni kaala mac kiir mo teek, ni män mo tägö yïthakic jiy teek døc kaamar nywïëny wø dëët dhi kiir ki gø.
english: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

anywaa: Dhaanhø wø jäŋ ki køør luupe mo wø cur dhee, ni jääŋe ki gïï wø cur leebe.
english: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

anywaa: Kwøw ki thøø ena cer leep, ni jø wø mëër ki cäänö ojäŋ ki gïï wø duu leepi.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

anywaa: Ŋat wø nyöömmi ki dhaagø, wø joota gïn mo beer, ni jïte ki met ec baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the Lord.

anywaa: Ŋat mo can wø cäänö ni kwaaya ree, 'ba ŋat mo okwär wø dwögö ni teek.
english: The poor useth entreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

anywaa: Da jiy mo manynya køør nyïïawäädi mo thööth, ni ge wø pätha yi ränynyö, 'ba da teeŋ nyawat mo gööga ri dhaanhø døc ni kaala cöögö.
english: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

anywaa: Beerra eni ki man bëët dhaanhe ni can mo caatha jöö mo thïïŋ, ni kaala ŋat mo wella luup mo wïïe känni.
english: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

anywaa: Paa gïn mo beer ki man many gïrpiny døc ni bäŋ kwänynyö, ni ŋat wø jalli, jööre wø di baaø.
english: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

anywaa: Kanyo ö bëët dïkät wïci noo kïth dhaanhø jöör ränynyö, dhaanhø cwïnye wø di keeyø ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the Lord.

anywaa: Jap kwärö wø kännö ki nyïïawäädi mo thööth, 'ba ŋat mo can wø wec nyawati wiiø.
english: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kat luup ba kääŋi ka ajäla, ni eni ni wø car tööt ba bøth.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth ŋat mo kare dwøŋ wø mwøthge mwødhø, ni jiy bëët manynya nyawat ki ŋat mo cere jööt ki cïp jammi.
english: Many will entreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

anywaa: ?Ni näk ŋat mo can, nyïïmenni omännö ki eni, a nyïïawäädi moe nø, a bäc kar mo nyïëdi nø ki eni? Këël eni doo rïïŋö køørge ni kwaaya geni, ge bäŋ dee joodø.
english: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

anywaa: Ŋat wø jïti ki leec wïc wø bëëdö ni mëër ki dëëre, ni ŋat wø gwøk acaara mare jïtö ki gïn mo beer.
english: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

anywaa: Ŋat wø lam luubö ni paa kare ba kääŋi ka ajäla, ni eni ni wø car tööt ränynyö.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

anywaa: Patha orømø ki man bëët ŋat mo wïïe känni kar ŋedhø, ni patha orømø ki man bëët laŋŋø ni kwääri ena tiere.
english: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

anywaa: Leec wïc dhaanhø wø di kønyø nee ba laar päth ri wëër, ni tïme na gïr ajiem jïre kany wø wec gïna baac dëëre.
english: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

anywaa: Wëër mar nyeya caala man wø wëër ŋuuwi, 'ba met ec mare caala man wø ö thööyi ni wø øc tiet beel.
english: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

anywaa: Nyilaal mo wïïe känni duua ränynyö dëër wänni, ni ö dhaage ma ŋat pïëm ni känne ki öölö kaamar gïn mo cwïër cooth.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

anywaa: Paac ki jap kwärö wø joot dhaanhe baŋ wänni, 'ba dhaagø mo wïïe da acaara wø cïpa Wuuö Jwøki.
english: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the Lord.

anywaa: Leth dëël duua niine mo thööth jï dhaanhø, ni dhaanhø mo ceŋŋe ee kut kööre wø bup cooth.
english: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

anywaa: Ŋat wø gwøk ciik Jwøk, gwøga jwïëy moe, 'ba ŋat wø ba cädö kiper jïëth tïïe moe thøw.
english: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

anywaa: Ŋat wø nyooth mëër ni wø cïpi jï jøøa can mooya Wuuö Jwøk; eni cun Wuuö Jwøki cunnö kiper gïna beer na tïïe.
english: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the Lord; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

anywaa: Pwöny wäädï kanyo poode ni da ŋäädhe kipere, ni kär niï päya eni thøø.
english: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

anywaa: Dhaanhø ma ŋat wëëye jap wø ŋøl bääte dee coolø e keere, kiper ni näk mo iï kønyø, ï meeta bëëtö mare na raac.
english: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.

anywaa: Wïny köömmö ni jïëyï pwöc, niï bëëdï ni wïïï leer yïth nïr kwøw moï.
english: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

anywaa: Da acaare mo thööth cwïny dhaanhø, 'ba pwöc mar Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö kare.
english: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

anywaa: Gïn mo cwïny dhaanhø doo ena køøre beeye bëët mëër man wø ba jøøl, ni beerra eni ki man bëët dhaanhe ki can ni kaala man bëëde ni ena twöt.
english: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

anywaa: Ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk bwødha jiy baŋ kwøw, ni dhaanhø bëëdö ni yie met jaak, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo gut gø.
english: The fear of the Lord tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël cere wø rwaage ya awal baŋ kwön, 'ba këël ki man duu cere wøk nee kïth dhee dhäthö.
english: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

anywaa: Noo pwötï ŋat abuua, ŋata näk acaara mare thiinh waŋe tïmö ni riek; noo joogï ŋat mo cädö, eni jïtö ki kwänynyö.
english: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

anywaa: Ŋat mo caara wänni ni riem menni beeye ŋat mo käla lään wïc ki räny nyeŋ.
english: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, ki man wïnynyï pwöc ni cäŋï gø weyø, beeye gaan wøk keere ki ri luup kwänynyö.
english: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kat luup mo wïïe raac, ŋøl ma adïëri ee tïïö na gïr kwääk jaak, ni ö dhi ŋat mo raaci ni jïëc gïï mo reyø.
english: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

anywaa: Ajäla onø jiiŋŋø kiper jø abuua, ni ö acwääti ni jiiŋŋi kiper jøøa wïthge känni.
english: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

anywaa: Køøŋ omøki dhaanhø wø døøye ŋat abuua, ni ö køøŋe mo keec ni døøc dhaanhø ŋat dïtat, ni ŋat wø gaa wøk ki køørge wïïe ba leer.
english: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

anywaa: Lwär man wø ööi ki køør wëër mar nyeya caala lwär man wø ööi ki køør wëëc ŋuu, ni ŋat wø raany cwïny nyeya nyääga jwïëye keere.
english: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

anywaa: Beeye gïn mo duua wödö jï dhaanhø ki man døøc kare mo bäär ki pïëm, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe känni, cwïnye wø piew ki wëër.
english: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël bäŋ wø purö ki dhi køth, 'ba kany wø tïme na kar kac, bäŋ gïn mo joode.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

anywaa: Acaare moa en cwïny dhaanhø wø ena yie na caal kut, 'ba ŋat mo wïïe da acaara tiet luup wø käle wøk.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth wø köö ni ge mëër ki jiy ki mëër mo ba jøøl, ?'ba aŋa no jïti ki ŋat mo oŋäädhö?
english: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

anywaa: Ŋata mare beer ni wø bëëdö ni mare adïëri, obwöre moe ogwïëth ki køøre.
english: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

anywaa: Nyeya kany wø pï bäät wälu ni ŋudö ki luup, gïïa reyø bëët wø di piedhø ki waŋe.
english: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni maar köö, ni «Aani, cwïnya bëëdö ni tøŋ, naa bëëdö naa waany, ni bäŋ raay dëëra»?
english: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

anywaa: Gïï røm ma teeŋi ki rumme ma teeŋi, Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki geni bëët.
english: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the Lord.

anywaa: Këëlla nyilaal wø di ŋääö ki køør tïïe moe, ki man näk mo bëëtö mare beer na kare.
english: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

anywaa: Ïth mo wïnyö ki waŋ mo räŋö ge tïïya Wuuö Jwøki karge riet.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the Lord hath made even both of them.

anywaa: Kärï bëëdö niï mëër ki niine, niï ba cännï; nyeŋŋï bëëtge ni lwieny, niï bëëdï ni jïrï da cam.
english: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

anywaa: Ŋat ŋïëw wø pïëmö, ni «Gät gïrpiny raac raac,» 'ba no nø ŋeew gø, eni wø aay ni ŋwöö.
english: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

anywaa: Wø da warkey ki jap mïërö mo thööth mo perge leth, 'ba dhøk man wø car luup kwänynyö caala jammi moa perge leth døc.
english: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

anywaa: Ŋat mo ojïëy na kar ŋat pïïdö marï ma wëëllö, abïïne wär lwørï, ni magï eni na dïgïti kanyo cïp ree na kar dhaanhø mo path.
english: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

anywaa: Cam mo joot ka jöör cwøk ŋweeth jï dhaanhø, 'ba aŋuunne dhee otïmö ni päŋ ka gii.
english: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

anywaa: Acaac tïïe wø bëëdö karge ni teek ki køør mano joot ki ri pwöc; ni leny wø di bwødhø ki køør acaara mo beer.
english: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

anywaa: Ŋat wø wïdi jaak ni waya nyeŋ, wø dhäänynya luup mo okanø; kiper manøgø nø, kärï dwätö ki ŋat mo waya luup jaak.
english: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

anywaa: Ŋat mo janynya wänni ki menni, tïmö kaamar lamba mo othøw yi muudhö.
english: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

anywaa: Jap wø dööŋ mo wø laar lwør ni karge poodi, bäŋ gwïëth mo pïï bäätge.
english: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

anywaa: Kärï niï köö, ni «Kwör gïna raac na tïïc dëëra coola coolø;» 'ba bëëdï niï koora Wuuö Jwøk; ïïno pieme.
english: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the Lord, and he shall save thee.

anywaa: Gïï røm ma teeŋi, Wuuö Jwøk yie raac ki ge, ni rumi mo mudö ba beer.
english: Divers weights are an abomination unto the Lord; and a false balance is not good.

anywaa: Jöör bëët dhaanhø ena cer Wuuö Jwøk; ?a dhaanhø, øtjööre a dee gø ŋääö keere nidïï?
english: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

anywaa: Ki man laar dhaanhe kööŋ jï Jwøk ni wïïe käre caarø, otïmö na abïëp jïre kanyo caar wïïe kiper na kööŋe jaak.
english: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

anywaa: Nyeya mo wïïe leer jøøa reyø wø piedhe wøk kaamar lethø, ni tïïc gïï mo leth dëëtge.
english: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

anywaa: Cwïny beeye lamba mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki jï dhaanhø, man wø meeny yi dhaanhø bäre.
english: The spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

anywaa: Mëër man wø ba jøøl ka adïëri nyeya wø gwøkge gwøø, ni ö wälu mare ni këët piny ni teek ki køør bëët-mëër.
english: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

anywaa: Ajiem mar wøpe wø ööi ka ri teek dëël marge, ni ö wödö mar jø døøŋŋø ni käl ri lwaar moge.
english: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

anywaa: Acwäät mo duunnö ka atwøt gïïa reyø wø puue wøk, ni ö pöödö ni peny cwïny dhaanhø.
english: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

anywaa: Acaare mo wø en cwïny nyeya ena cer Wuuö Jwøk, ni løny jï Wuuö Jwøk ki man bwøth geni ni caala man wø bwøth pïï ki jöörge.
english: The king's heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

anywaa: Ŋati man nø øtjöör tïïc mare wø nëënö ni thïïŋ ki jïre, 'ba Wuuö Jwøk wø neeta cwïny jiy.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the Lord pondereth the hearts.

anywaa: Ki man tïïc gïn mo beer ki gïn ma adïëri beeye mana met yi Wuuö Jwøki ki gø ni kaala olämi.
english: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.

anywaa: Nyeŋ mo raŋa jiy piny, ki cwïny mo töödö, ki gïï wø tïïcge bëët beeye raay.
english: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

anywaa: Acaac dhaanhø mo rweenhnhi ri tïïc duua rudø, 'ba ŋat wø lac tïïc jaak wø pätha yi can.
english: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mo wø joot ki køør tööt caala rwöc ni wø laar aay, ni caala abïëp mo duunnö ki thøø.
english: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

anywaa: Jøøa reyø otuut dïwïti marge wøk, kiper man wø kwierge tïïc gïn ma adïëri.
english: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

anywaa: Jïëth tïïe mo dïbääc luup oköömmö, 'ba jøøa waany, bëëtö marge thïïŋ.
english: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

anywaa: Ki man bëët dhaanhe thaŋ agööla beerra eni ni kaala man bëëdö yi øtø aciel ki dhaagø ma ŋat pïëm.
english: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

anywaa: Ŋata raac, cwïnye wø ena køør gïï mo reyø, ni nyawatge bäŋ wø raŋe ki waŋ mo beer.
english: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

anywaa: Kany wø jääl ŋat abuua, ŋata näk acaara mare thiinh wïïe lëënynyö, 'ba kany wø pwöny ŋata wïïe leer, eni wø jïtö ki kwänynyö.
english: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

anywaa: Jwøk na näk mare adïëri wø neeta gïï wø tïïc po ŋata raac, ni kïth ŋatøgø ni raac enø yi ränynyö.
english: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

anywaa: Ŋat wø dhïŋ ïthe ki jwøk dhaanhø mo can, eni ki dëëre ojwöŋi ni mare ba wïnynyi.
english: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

anywaa: Muuy mo cïp no okanø, wëër wø di raanynyø, ni jammi mo cïp ka piny wëër mo teek wø di jooø.
english: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

anywaa: Kany wø ŋøl luup na karge, yïth jøøa marge beer wø mïnnö, 'ba wø duua kwany dëël jï jø wø tïïc gïïa reyø.
english: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

anywaa: Ŋat wø gaa wøk ni wec jöör leec wïc, ree ojwöme kar jøøa no othøw.
english: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëër ki bëët ŋedhø cännö, ni ŋat wø mëër ki køøŋø ki maaw ba kwär.
english: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

anywaa: Ŋata raac beeye noo wiil ŋata mare beer ki gø, ni ö ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny ni läw kar ŋata mare thïïŋ.
english: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

anywaa: Ki man bëët dhaanhe paap beerra eni ni kaala man bëëdö ki dhaagø ma ŋat pïëm ma aguni.
english: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

anywaa: Maaw ki jap kwärö mo perge leth wø ena po dhaanhø mo wïïe leer, 'ba dhaanhø mo wïïe känni jape wø laare ka thöör.
english: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

anywaa: Ŋat wø løp køør adïëri ki mëër man wø ba jøøl, jïtö ki kwøw ki bëënynyö ki wödö.
english: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo wïïe leer wø päära yi pääny jøøa teek, ni tøk kwöra teek ni wø ŋääthge.
english: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

anywaa: Ŋat wø gwøk dhee ki leebe, gwøga jwïëye yïth gïï wø leth.
english: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

anywaa: Ŋat mo töödö mo taaga jiy wø cwøl ni ŋat abuua, ni eni jammi wø tïïe ka atöör mo dwøŋ.
english: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël onäk parri mare keere, kiper mana wec ceŋŋe ni ba tïïö.
english: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

anywaa: Eni wø bëënna par keere ki yi cäŋ bäre, 'ba ŋata mare beer wø cïpö ni cere ba jøør ŋääe.
english: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo Jwøk yie raac ko olämi mar ŋata raac, a rääye onäk nyïëdi nø kanyo cïp gø ki cwïny mo raac?
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

anywaa: Ŋat wø kat luup ränynyö, 'ba ŋat wø wïny luubö ni beer, luup wø di lamø ni ba jook.
english: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

anywaa: Ŋat mo raac, waŋe wø døøye mo teek, 'ba dhaanhø mo mare thïïŋ, uutjïëth tïïe moe wø di caarø keere.
english: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

anywaa: Leec wïc ki ŋäc tiet luup ki pwöc, bäŋgø mo kaala Wuuö Jwøk.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the Lord.

anywaa: Okweeny wø di jiiŋŋø kiper cäŋ leny, 'ba böödö wø ena baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra wïny nyeŋ mo beer ni kaala man bëët dhaanhe no okwär, ni beerra pwøc mo beer ni kaala man bëët dhaanhe ni jïre da warkey ki gwel-bïrö.
english: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

anywaa: Gïn mo rwöpa ŋata can ki ŋat mo okwär beeye en: geni bëët cwääya Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all.

anywaa: Ŋat mo waŋe riek gïna raac wø di joodø ni kan ree, 'ba ŋat ma acaara mare thiinh wø pätha yi gø, ni jwør gïï mo leth.
english: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

anywaa: Mööl ki lwär man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk duunnö ki kwärö ki wödö ki kwøw.
english: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

anywaa: Koodhi ka abëëbe wø ena jöör ŋat wø wel luup, 'ba ŋat wø gwøk dëëre obëëdö ni kare bäär ki geni.
english: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

anywaa: Pwöny nyilaal ki jöör bëëtö mano put wääth ki gø, ni kanyo døøŋŋe, eni ba gaa wøk ki yie.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

anywaa: Jøøa no okwär, jøøa can wø ena tietge, ni ö ŋat wø mäyi ni en tier ŋat wø mäye baŋ gø.
english: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

anywaa: Ŋat wø piith raay, gïï mo leth okaae, ni ö teek mar wëërri mare ni ränynye.
english: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

anywaa: Ŋat wø nyooth mëër jï jiy wø di gwïëdhö, kiper man wø cïpe ri cam mare jï ŋat mo can.
english: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

anywaa: Noo riemï ŋat abuua wøk, pïëm ränynyö, ni ö wëërri ki räny nyeŋ ni cuŋge.
english: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëër ki cwïny mo waany, ni luup mo wø cur dhee met, teeŋ ŋatøgø tïmö na nyawat nyeya.
english: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

anywaa: Waŋ Wuuö Jwøk wø bëëdö ni gwøga luup kwänynyö, 'ba luup ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny wø di raanynyø.
english: The eyes of the Lord preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

anywaa: Ŋat leth dëël cwïnye wø di thwølø, ni kööe, ni «Da ŋuu wøk kaace. A di camø no cøøa wøk øtjöö.»
english: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

anywaa: Dhi dhaagø ma kääbi caala buur mo bäär, mo ŋata näk wëëc Jwøk ena bääte pätha yie.
english: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.

anywaa: Bëët dïkät wïc onieŋ cwïny nyilaal, 'ba beeye acwäät pwöc noo riem gø wøk cwïnye.
english: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

anywaa: Ŋat wø møt dhaanhø mo can nee jap kwärö moe meede, ki ŋat wø cïpi jï jøøa näk okwär, wø pätha yi can.
english: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

anywaa: Cek ïthï, ni wïnynyï luup jøøa wïthge leer, ni këëllï wïïï ri pwöc 'moa;
english: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

anywaa: kiper duunnö ki met ec jïrï ni näk mo ge iï kan cwïnyï, ni ge bëëdö ni nut dhiï ge bëët.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

anywaa: Ïïni ki dëërï ïïna pwönynya dïcäŋ man en, nee ŋäädhe marï bëëde ni ena ri Wuuö Jwøk.
english: That thy trust may be in the Lord, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.

anywaa: Aani, da luup mo perge leth mo yaa göörö jïrï, mo yïthge da pwöc ki luup kwänynyö,
english: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

anywaa: niï pwönyge ki gïna beer ki luup ma adïëri, nee lønye jïrï ki man dwøgï luubö ma adïëri jï ŋata jääŋ ïïni.
english: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

anywaa: Kär niï twiera ŋata can kiper na cane, ni ba thielï luubö piny mar ŋata näk jïre bäŋ teek kar løøk;
english: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

anywaa: kiper ge ŋun Wuuö Jwøki ŋunnö, ni käl jwïëc jø wø twier geni.
english: For the Lord will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

anywaa: Kärï dwätö ki dhaanhø mo laara wëër, ni ba cäädhï ki dhaanhø ma ŋat wëëye,
english: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

anywaa: nee uutjïëth tïïe moe ba kwanyï, niï määnynya dëërï keerï ka abïëp.
english: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

anywaa: Kärï tïmö niï ena dï jø wø cïp dëëtge na dïgïti, jø wø cïp rege nyeŋ pïït jø møøk.
english: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

anywaa: ?Ni näk bäŋ gïn cudï ki gø, pëët niine moï owëëgï gø käl jaak kiper ŋø?
english: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

anywaa: Kär niï daaga gïr waŋ keew mana nut cøøn, mana tïïc kwäyu.
english: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

anywaa: ?Dhaanhø mo rëëm tïïc ajootï? Eni wø bëëdö ni tïnynya nyeye, ni eni jiy jaak ba tïnynye.
english: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.

anywaa: Kany wø pïï piny kar cam niï cämï ki ŋat mo kare dwøŋ paare, caar wïïï ki eni ni en nyïmï;
english: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

anywaa: 'ba ni näk mo cwïnyï iï daadø kiper cam, riï wär joogï.
english: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

anywaa: Kär cam mare na met parï, kiper gena caap cwøk.
english: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

anywaa: Kär niï ööla riï niï jïtï ki jap kwärö; bëëdï ni wïïï leer ni weyï acaara manøgø.
english: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

anywaa: Kany wø näk mo waŋï këëta bääte, puta aay; kiper kwärö wø laara jïtö ki bwöm, ni tïme kaamar odhuuth ni wø määt maal.
english: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

anywaa: Kär cam dhaanhø mo cere teek camï, ni ba parï cam mare na met;
english: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

anywaa: kiper ena ŋat wø cädö kiper cam man wø lwørï, ni eni wø köö, ni «Cämï ni mädhï,» 'ba ba käl cwïnye.
english: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö niï para man ŋööï cam wøk mana thiinh na camï, ni ö waaci moï na met ni cami ya paapi jaak.
english: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

anywaa: Kär niï cäänna dhaanhø mo wïïe känni, kiper luup leec wïc moï taae taaø.
english: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

anywaa: Kär niï daaga gïr waŋ keew mana nut cøøn, ni ba nyiigï gø yi pwöth ŋat mo bäŋ wänni;
english: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

anywaa: kiper Dïkunyi mare teek, ni pïëme ki ïïni kipere.
english: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

anywaa: Cïp cwïnyï køør pwöc, ni cegï ïthï ki luup kwänynyö.
english: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

anywaa: Kär pwöc joogï ki nyilaal; këël eni diï pwödö ka acwäät, eni ba thøw.
english: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

anywaa: Ni näk mo eni iï pwödö ka acwäät, ï gwøga jwïëy moe ki man ba ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, ni näk miï bëëdö ni wïïï leer, aani, cwïnya tïmö ni met;
english: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

anywaa: ni ö yia ni mïnne kany wø ö dhiï ni caan gïna näk kare.
english: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

anywaa: Kär per bëët jø raay keeyï, 'ba bëëdï niï lwäära Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët.
english: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the Lord all the day long.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aŋuun bëëtö marï gööya piny ni beer, ni gïna ŋääthï ba ränynyi.
english: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, wïny pwöc ni lëëny wïïï, ni cïbï cwïnyï øtjööra thïïŋ.
english: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

anywaa: Kärï dwätö ki jø meeye, ki jøøa no owär ki cam rïŋö,
english: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

anywaa: kiper jø meeye ki jø wärö cännö, ni bëët niine marge duua käär nywate jïge.
english: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

anywaa: Wïny mar wäru na nywøl ïïni, ni ba taagï meru kany wø jale.
english: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

anywaa: Adïëri manynyï, ni ba dwøgï gø pwödhö, ni manynyï leec wïc ki pwöc ki ŋäc tiet luup.
english: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

anywaa: Wää ŋata mare beer yie wø mïnnö døc, ni ö ŋat wø nywøl nyilaal mo wïïe leer ni mïn yie ki gø.
english: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

anywaa: Beerra man døøyï yi wäru ki meru mo met, ni mïn yi meru na nywøl ïïni.
english: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

anywaa: Nyie wääda, cïp cwïnyï køøra, ni këëllï waŋï jöör bëëtö mara.
english: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø ma kääbi caala buur mo bäär, ni ö dhaage ma ŋat lugi ni caal buur mo diiny.
english: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

anywaa: Eni wø møøra jöö ni kurö kaamar ŋat twëër, ni meet kwään jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny.
english: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni wø guyi? ?Na aŋa ni wø kïmmi? ?Aŋa ni wø pïëmö? ?Na aŋa ni wø ŋuri? ?Aŋa ni wø dëëre jïti ki ŋwiili ki køør gïn mo bäŋ tiere? ?Aŋa ni wø bëëdö ni nyeŋŋe omäthö ni kwaar?
english: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

anywaa: ?Patha jø wø ruu ni ge mädhö ki kwøŋ? ?Patha jø wø lägi ni ge manynya køør kwøŋ moa keec?
english: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

anywaa: Kär waŋï këël køør køøŋø kany wø nëëne ni mïërö, ki kany wø nëëne ni paŋŋi ya awal, kany wø løøye ki yi lwöyï ni pøøth.
english: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

anywaa: Kiper aŋuunne eni kääö kaamar thwöl, ni dhee da cïm kaamar olwierø.
english: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋï kar ni neeta gïï mo patha adïëri, ni ö cwïnyï ni caar wel luup.
english: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

anywaa: Ï tïmö kaamar dhaanhø mo leeŋ athaga leeŋŋø dï naama dwøŋ, ni tïmï kaamar dhaanhø mo ena wï lwinh jaath.
english: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

anywaa: Køøre ïïno köö, ni «Aana pwötge, 'ba bäŋ ŋwellø mo onieŋ dëëra; ni buthge aani, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo yaa jwørø. ?Aano pääa yi wäne nø, naa määnynya ki køøŋø mør?»
english: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

anywaa: Kär per bëët jøøa reyø keeyï, ni ba päl cwïnyï ki man bëëdï ki geni;
english: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

anywaa: kiper cwïnyge wø caara bëët dïwït, ni dhøkge wø cara luup gïï mo reyø.
english: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

anywaa: Dhaanhø paare wø di käärö ki køør leec wïc, ni këël gø piny ki køør acaara;
english: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

anywaa: ki køør kwänynyö yïth uudi moe wø päŋ ki jammi mo perge leth mo duunnö ki met ec.
english: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo wïïe leer wø bëëdö ni teek, ni dhaanhø mo wïïe da kwänynyö, teek mare wø di meedø;
english: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

anywaa: kiper ki køør pwöc mo beer, leny marï thura kare, ni kany mo da jiy mo thööth mo pöö, jiy böödö.
english: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

anywaa: Leec wïc kare bäär døc no opöödhö ki wï ŋat mo wïïe känni, ni teeŋ ŋatøgøøni dhee bäŋ wø jaale kar acooŋa.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cädö nee tïïe ki gïï mo reyø wø cwøl ni ŋat riek waŋ mo raac.
english: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

anywaa: Gïï wø caar ŋat mo wïïe känni beege raay, ni ö jiyi ni raac yïthge døc ki ŋat abuua.
english: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ceŋŋï nilwak kany wø enï yïth gïï mo leth, nyootha gø ni teek marï thiinh.
english: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

anywaa: Jø wø käl ni kïtha baŋ thøø, piem geni, ni piemï jiy mo cäädhi ni ge näännö mo kïtha baŋ 'näk.
english: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

anywaa: Ni näk miï köö, ni «Neenï, bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcwa kiper gïnögø,» ?aŋø, Jwøk na ŋäc cwïny jiy, ba løny jïre ki man caar gø? ?A eni ni wø gwøk jwïëy moï, gïnögø kuue? ?Eni ba løny jïre ki man cun ŋati man nø ki køør gïna tïïe?
english: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

anywaa: Nyie wääda, beeye gïn mo beer ki man camï maar kïc, ni dhiï oŋwëënhnhi ki maar kïc mana näk tëëma.
english: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

anywaa: Wär ŋäyï thuwø ni leec wïc bëëdö na enøgønø ni ŋweeth jïrï; ni näk mo iï joodø, aŋuun bëëtö marï gööya piny ni beer, ni gïna ŋääthï ba ränynyi.
english: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

anywaa: Wui ï na ŋat raay, kär niï ööa töök paac mar ŋata mare beer ki man tïïyï gïn mo raac, kär niï raanynya kar bëëtö mare;
english: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

anywaa: kiper ŋata mare beer këël doo pädhö kwöre abïriiø, eni wø cäŋa duu maal, 'ba ŋata raac wø puta pädhö na bäre bäre yïth gïï wø leth ni wø pïï bääte.
english: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
