anywaa: Kiper Jerucalem onø bøømø, ni ö Juuda ni nø pädhe, kiper luup mo wø carge ki tïïe moge ge raanynya cwïny Wuuö Jwøk ki ge, ni marge ageem ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwø ajiem.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

anywaa: Gïïa reyø na tïïcge nëënö täärnyïmge, ni ge bëëdö ni ge nyøtha raay moge kaamar Cødam, ni raay moge ba maarge kan. Wui, otïmö ni leth jïge, kiper gïïa reyø na kälge bäätge!
english: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

anywaa: Caannu jï jøøa bëëtö marge beer ki man näk mo tïmö ni beer jïge, kiper yïthge omïnni ki køør tïïe moge na beyø.
english: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï jø raay! Ränynyö ööa bäätge! Kiper gïïa reyø na tïïcge ki ceŋge døøa wïthge.
english: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

anywaa: Wui, obwöre beege na thiel jiya piny, ni tïm määnni na kwääri bäätge. Wui, u na jiya! Dïbwöthe mou uuna tïïcge nou gaau wøk; uuna kälge wøk øtjöör bëënynyö.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aö maal baŋ løøk, ni cuŋŋe nee luup jiy ŋøle.
english: The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni täge ki løøk ki jø døøŋŋø ki dïbwöthe mo jiy moe, ni kööe, ni «Bee u ki dëëtu na raany pwöth omøki,  ni jammi moa twierru baŋ jøøa can ena yïth mïëri mou.
english: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

anywaa: ?Tiere ŋø cøøn ni thielu jiy 'moa piny en, ni røtu täärnyïm jiy moa can ki yïth ŋøøm?» Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord God of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Mään mo Dhayan gena tïmö ni ge töödö, ni ge cäädhi ni ge ŋaya ŋutge, ni mïëdö marge di joodø nyeŋge, ni ge cäädhi ni ge kiinynya tietge, ni ge tïïya dööt oguudi moa en tietge nee wïnye.
english: Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk wïth mään mo Dhayan mooe mooø ki täw gwøny, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk jïëcge pøtø.»
english: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋece, Wuuö Jwøk jap mïërö moge di raanynyø, ni beege gïï wø twöge käät-oguudi moge, ki mo wø meen wïdhi, ki jap mïërö mo wø twöö cwaak,
english: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

anywaa: ki gwet ïdhi, ko oguudi mo ceŋ, ka abïïe mo wø rïëp täärnyïm,
english: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

anywaa: ka abïïe mo wø loop wïdhi, ki tiimme mo wø twöö käät-oguudi, ki gïï wø twöö pier, ki wïlle mo riie, ko opïri mo gwïëth,
english: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

anywaa: ki gwet lweedi mo ceŋ, ki gwel mo wø kïth um,
english: The rings, and nose jewels,

anywaa: ka abïïe mo wø wödö ki ge ka ajwöm, ka abïïe moa no ocwääö ki waac lïïna, ki tare, ko opïri mo gwel,
english: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

anywaa: ki cïläälcae mo raŋ, ka abïïe mo wø kääri ki tiet abïïe, ka abïïe mo wø meen wïc, ki waare mo ocwääö.
english: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the veils.

anywaa: Ni ö mädhi moa wara wïïrge ni ŋwääö ni met ni wiilge rege ni ŋwääö no okwäk, ni ö käär kaae ni wiil ree baŋ käär thøøli, ni ö jïër moge na beyø ni tïmge na jïër mo øya piny, ni ö käär abïïe moa beyø ni wiil ree baŋ käär keece, ni ö dëëtge na mïërö na pøøth ni tïmge ni da pööc mäc.
english: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

anywaa: Cwøw moge ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni ö jø lenynyi moge moa teek ni thøwge ri leny.
english: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

anywaa: Dhøk kiir mo Dhayan ge göö ko oduuru ni kïmge, ni ö Dhayan ni pï piny yïth ŋøøm jaak ni eno dööŋ keere.
english: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, mään abïriiø dïcwøø aciel ogamge ni köge jïgø, ni «Beerra man tïmï ni ïïna cøwa, nee laac wïc marwa nee aae bäätwa; 'ba cam mano camwa ka abïïe moo käärwa ojootwa baŋwa keerwa.»
english: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, lwinh Wuuö Jwøk onëëni ni mïërö ni ree da ajiem, ni ö nyeyi mano joot yi ŋöömö ni tïme na gïr ajiem na gïr atöör jï jø Icriel moo dööŋ ni kwøw.
english: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ yi Dhayan noo bëëdö Jerucalem, ge di cwølø na jiy mo ena kur keerge na mo Jwøk mo nyeŋge ogöör piny kiper kwøw yi Jerucalem.
english: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk raay mo määr Dhayan penye penyø, ni peny remø mana køny piny dï Jerucalem ki køør teek ajäla mare ka ajäl maac mano käle ki ri Jwïëye.
english: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk pöölö mo näga jïrö wëëge nirwöc ki dïcäŋ bäät Kïn Dhayan bäre ki jiy moa näk rege ege cooŋ bääte, ni ö tarri mar leep maac ni wëëk gø rieny bäät gø ki wäär; ni ö ajiem mana en bäät Dhayan bäre ni bëëde no ouumö ki gïn mo caala rëëbi.
english: And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.

anywaa: Ni tïme kaamar abïla man wø cïp tïpö ni wø gëëŋ jiy ki lïëth piny mar dïcäŋ, ni bëëde na kar kan røk man wø gwøk jiy ka atuunna ki køth.
english: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

anywaa: Aani a wär ki duut jï ŋata mëëra ki gø, ni bee duut mo cäänö kaper omëëya ki pwöth jer omøki mare. Ŋata mëëra ki gø jïre da pwöth jer omøki yïth ŋøøpa beyø nyäär thuur.
english: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

anywaa: Eni pwödhö manøgø apuure ni kwäny kïte wøk, ni tøøk jer omøki moa beyø yie. Ni gëëde ka abïl koor dïëre, ni kunye ki buur man bii pï nyïïjenni yie. Køøre ena bëëdö ni koora nyïëdi mo beyø moo nywøl jer omøki mo pwöthögø, 'Ba atïmö ni nywøla nyïëdi mo reyø.
english: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋata mëëra ki gø aköö, ni «U ni wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem ki jø Juuda, ŋøllu luubö man yïthakicwa ki pwöth jer omøki mara.
english: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø mør këët nø, noo tïïa mo odööŋ ni kära tïïö kiper pwöth jer omøki mara? ?Kanya bëëda naa koora nyïëdi mo beyø ki man nywøl gø, aperŋø ni tïme ni nywøla nyïëdi mo reyø?
english: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gïno tïïa kiper pwöth jer omøki mara caana caanø jïïu: jenni moa näk yaa piidhø na ciel deŋŋe käla wøk, ni wëëga gø raanynyø, ni ö cielli mana no otïïö ki kïte ni nyaa gø piny ni dööŋe na kar adhwøla.
english: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

anywaa: Tïïa tïïö ni tïme na pwödhö mo oränynyö.  Jer omøki moe wïthge ba goor, ni tietge ba puur; 'ba otwel ki koodhi oput tuuö yie. Ni köömma pöölö nee ba pädhe na køth bääte.»
english: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba pwöth jer omøki mar Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye dhi øt Icriel, ni jenni moa tøøe na mëëre ki ge, beege jø Juuda. Ena bëëdö ni räŋö ni koora ŋøl ma kare, 'ba atïmö ni nuta køny remø piny; ni bëëde ni räŋö ni koora bëënynyö, ni tïme ni wïnynya oduuru mar pänh cwïny.
english: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth jïïu, u ni wø meet uudi mou ki uudi møøk, ni wø mëën bäät pwöth mou ki pwöth møøk, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany mo dööŋ jï jiy møga, ni dööŋŋa u keeru yi ŋöömö manøgø.
english: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, akööŋ ni wïnyö jïra ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, uudi mo thööth odööŋ keerge, këël uudi moa døøŋŋø na mïërö, odööŋ ni bäŋ jiy yïthge.
english: In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.

anywaa: Pwödhö ma böölle apaar mo jer omøki otïmö ni duua nyïëdi mo rømi ka nywøp køøŋø ma yi caapiia aciel keere, ni ö köödhi mo päŋ yi baarmïïl ni tïme ni duua beel ma caapiia keere.»
english: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï jø wø päny maal ka amöölla døc, ni wø läät bäät kwøŋ moa keec, jø wø këët dïwäär ni ge mädhö ni wø meeyi døc.
english: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

anywaa: Ni ge bëëdö ni ge pöödö ki wïth thøme ma teeŋi kwör maath moge, ni ge pöödö ka anëët ni ge kudhö ko opele; 'ba ïthge ba cekge ki tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper japa tïïc Jwøki.
english: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ge na jiya geno käl ni geno maa ki tøŋ, ni bäŋ gïn ŋäcge. Jiy moge moa kwörge døøŋŋø ge thøw ni ge 'näga käci, ni ö lwaae moge ni tal kööthge ki riew.
english: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, yie di tïïö ni laac, ni jap dhee døc ni päl, ni ö jø Jerucalemmi moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jiy moe bëët mo wø lweelli kwör maath, ki mo wø bëëdö ni yïthge met jaak ni wïthge owïl, ni päthge yie.
english: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø wïth jiy døøa piny, ni ö jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ni dwøk wïthge piny, ni ö bëëtö mar jø wø tïŋ dëëtge maal ni dwøgi piny.
english: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, nyeŋŋe obëëdö ni ena maal ki ri ŋøl mare; ni ö eni na Jwøk na en kur keere ni nyooth ree ni eni ena kur keere ki køør bëënynyö mare.
english: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïdïëk ocämö dï paac kaamar kar kwaath marge, ni ö wëëlle ni caamge gïïa jootge wïth mïëri moa no oränynyö mo jøøa no okwär.
english: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth jï jø wø tuut raay bäätge ki jöör tööt, kaawat man wø tuut gïrpiny bäädi ki thøøl, ni wø tuut rääö bäätge kaawat man wø tuut jää okweeny,
english: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

anywaa: ni beege jø wø cäänö ni ge jaŋa Jwøk ni wø köö, ni «Beerra man ö Jwøki ni lääde, beerra man ö eni ni lac tïïc mare, nee neenø. Beerra man ö eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere ni laar tïïe moe wëëk thur karge nee ŋääø.»
english: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth jï jø wø köö ni gïn mo raac beeye gïn mo beer, ni wø köö ni gïn mo beer beeye gïn mo raac; jø wø köö ni muudhö beeye tar, ni tar beeye muudhö, jø wø köö ni gïn mo keec ŋweeth, ni gïn mo ŋweeth keec.
english: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï jø wø köö ni leerra wïthge keerge, ni wø car riek waŋ marge keerge.
english: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï jø wø nyeŋge ŋäc ki maath kwøŋ, ni wø teek ki maath wïth kwøŋ mo ojääbö;
english: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

anywaa: jø wø jïëc luum dhaanhø mo mare raac ki køør gïn wø cïp ki piny, ni wø kwier luum ŋata beer na mare thïïŋ.
english: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat man wø ö leep maaci wø gam lethø, ni ö luummi mo otal ni thööri ya maaci, geni thuwø ge tïmö kaamar jenni mo lweetge otøp, mo bøøkge køøl jame køølø kaamar tør; kiper ciik Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, akwierge, ni taakge luum gø, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wëëc Wuuö Jwøk ni wø liel kaamar maac, kïthe bäät jiye, ni tïŋ cere maal bäätge ni 'näk geni. Thuuri di jäŋö, ni ö dëët jiy moa no othøw ni tïmge kaamar wär mo oker piny nyeŋ jïëthe. 'Ba këël køør japøgø bëët, eni wëër mare poot ba paanye; cere poot bëëdö ni ee rwieø.
english: Therefore is the anger of the Lord kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

anywaa: Eni ŋïï mare tïŋe maal nee joot wïth juurre moa kwörge bäyö, ni cwøl nyïïmän moa en teegi mo piny ki dwør lwiyø, nee laarge ö ni ge rwäänhnhö,
english: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

anywaa: ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ööl wala mo cwaanya tiere, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo nanni wala mo butö; ni bäŋ kaw mo nilwak pëëtge wala thøøth war mo cööt.
english: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

anywaa: Athëëre moge beth, na atume moge bëët ege niidø; tiet okwëënyi moge teek kaamar kïte, ni jïëth okwëënyi moge kany wø rïïŋge, tietge lwör kaamar atuunna.
english: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

anywaa: Ni ge löörö kaamar ŋuu ma maath, ni löörö marge thuwø caala dööt cïgïïc ŋuuwe, kany wø ŋärge bäät caammi moge ni ge jwaa ge wøk, ni bäŋ ŋat käl gø wøk ceŋge.
english: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca ge löörö bäätge kaawat man wø lwör athaŋ naama dwøŋ. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo raŋa bäät ŋöömö manøgø, eni muudhö ki bëëtö mo leth pute ka joot,  kiper tar ree løøe baŋ muudhö ki køør pöölö.
english: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiina thøw nyeya ma Udhaya yie, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ajooda no opï piny bäät wälu, ni ena maal ni kare dwøŋ, na abïï mare onijääp piny ni Øt Jwøk ee pääŋö bäre.
english: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

anywaa: Ni nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni cerapim ge cuŋŋö maal bääte, na aciel man nø jïre da bwöm abïciel; bwöm ariiø beege mo wø uumge täärnyïmge ki ge, na ariiø møga beege mo wø uumge tietge ki ge, ni ö ariiø møga ni bëëtge na mo wø määtge ki ge.
english: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhøkge aløøŋge ni ge köö, «Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena kur keere, ena kur keere, ena kur keere; ni piny bäre päŋ ka ajiem mare.»
english: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

anywaa: Ni ö tier dhi Øt Jwøk ni put tïmö ni jäŋŋi ki döötge, ni ö Øt Jwøki thuwø ni put päŋö ki jïrö.
english: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, «Wui, a kare kaa këët nø; aana nø ränynyö! Kiper aana dhaanhø mo dhee ba waany, naa bëëdö dï jiy mo dhøkge ba waany; kiper aani nyeya ma Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aneena ki waŋa.»
english: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Køøre ki røk nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni cerapim, aciel dïge amään baŋa ni käädö ki cugö mo wärri mo lwøre bäät gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte, ni lwøre ka kwäny maac.
english: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

anywaa: Ni ööe ni gut dhaa ki cugö manøgø ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, dhiï anø gut gïnögø; ni ö gïïa näk iï baa bëët ni paanyi bäätï, ni ö raayi moï bëët ni wëënni.»
english: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk awïnynya ni köö, na «?Aŋa noo jääŋŋa nø? ?Aŋa no cii kiperwa?» Køøre aana köö, «A nutö. Jääŋ aani!»
english: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, «Ciï, ni caanï gø jï jøøgø ni kööï, «ni ‹Bëëdu ni ïthu you ciiø, 'ba tiere ba kwanynyu; bëëdu nou räŋö, 'ba tiere ba ci cwïnynyu.›
english: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

anywaa: Tïïc cwïny jøøgø ni teek, ni cïëgï ïthge, ni meyï nyeŋge, nee tïme ni ba løny ki man nëënge ki nyeŋge, ni ba wïnyge ki ïthge, ni ba ci luupi cwïnyge, ni ba duuge baŋ Jwøk ki man jïtge ki køny.»
english: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëtge na ennø nø?» Ni løk gø, ni «Këël kanyo raany päänye noo dööŋge ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge, ni bëëdö uudi keerge ni bäŋ jiy, ni dööŋŋa ŋöömö keere;
english: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

anywaa: këël kanyo ööa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, noo riema jiy kany mo bäär, ni ö ŋøømmi mo odööŋ keerge ni tïmge ni thöötha geni dï ŋöömö manøgø.
english: And the Lord have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ni näk mo dööŋŋa dhaanhø aciel ki ra apaar yi ŋöömmögø, poot cäŋa waaŋ; ni tïmge kaamar jaath mo teek  kanyo ŋødi piny ni dööŋ gutö mare. 'Ba gutö manøgø beeye noo tïmö na kunhnhö mana näk ena kur keere.»
english: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïra bëët Eeyeth o Jötham, wär Udhaya, na nyeny Juuda, Recin nyeny Aram ki Peka o Remaliya, nyeny Icriel, gena ci Jerucalem baŋ leny, 'ba kär løny ki man tukge gø.
english: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caani jï dhi øt Deebit, ni køp, ni «Jø Aram twïër marge anø tïïcge yi ŋööm Ipariem,» nyeya ma Eeyeth ki jiye cwïnyge abwøk døc, ni tïme kaawat man wø ö jer lulli wø jäŋi ya jamø.
english: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Aydheea, ni «Ennø, ci døny wøk ki wäädï ma Cier- Jacup, nou røømmu ki Eeyeth dhi waŋ mar puul mana en jï maal, nou cøra yi jöör pwöth nyen wø pïnyö ka abïïe.
english: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear–jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;

anywaa: Ni caanï gø jïre, ni ‹Gwøk riï, ni cïbï cwïnyï piny, ni ba lwäyï, ni ö cwïnyï ni ba pädhe kiper wëër mar Recin ki jiye ma jø Aram, ki wëër mar o Remaliya, jøøgø na ariiø yøø ni caal dhøk ameethi ariiø mo marge duuŋ jaak.
english: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

anywaa: Kiper jø Aram, ki jø Ipariem ki nyenyge ma o Remaliya, gena nø cädö ki gïn mo raac kiperu, ni köge,
english: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beerra man cøø baŋ leny ki jø Juuda, ni tïïø ge nee lwäcge døc, ni ö kiir pääny marge ni putø gø tuc, ni røønyø o Thabël nee bëëde na nyeye yie.»
english: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

anywaa: « ‹'Ba Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, « ‹ni «Gïnögø ba thur kare, ni ba tägi na bäre bäre.
english: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

anywaa: Kiper pääny mana dwøŋ mar Aram beeye Damacka, ni bwödhi mar Damacka beeye Recin. 'Ba noo tïme na cwiiri ma pïërabïciel ka abïïc, jø Ipariem keethø ni tïmge ni paa wï jur këët.
english: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

anywaa: Pääny mana dwøŋ mar Ipariem beeye Cameria, ni bwödhi mar Cameria beeye o Remaliya. Ni näk mo gïnögø ba ŋääthu, ka adïëri møn, u ba ruu.» › »
english: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki Eeyeth, ni kööe,
english: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

anywaa: ni «Pëëï ki nyuudhi kiper dëërï baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï; pëënynyï na nyuudhi mo løny ki man joodi tiet ŋøøm kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, wala yi maal kuya.»
english: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeyeth aköö, «Aani, a ba pëëö; Wuuö Jwøk ba päänynya!»
english: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Aydheea aköö, «Wui, u na dhi Øt Deebit, cegu ïthu ennø. ?Aŋø, ki man cwaatu yïth jiy atïmö ni thiinh kiperu, ni tïmu nou daa baŋ Jwøk mara nou cwaata yie en?
english: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre cïpö jïïu ki nyuudhi; ka adïëri møn, nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue ojïti ki nyilaal ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø, ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Imanuwel.
english: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

anywaa: Eno tïmö ni cama caak mo opuuö ki maar kïc kanyo rïën waŋe ni løny ki man kwier gïna raac ni jier mana beer.
english: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

anywaa: Kiper kanyo poot nyilaarøgø ni waŋe poot kär rïënnö, ki man kwier gïna raac ni jier mana beer, ŋøøp nyeye moø na ariiø ni lwääru ki ge yøø dööŋ keerge.
english: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk känna bäätï ki bäät jiyï, ki bäät dhi øt wäru ki teeŋ nïr bëëtö mo leth mo poot kär kwøŋ joot ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa ö jø Ipariemmi na pääge ki jø Juuda, ni bëëtö manøgø käle ki ri nyeny Aciria.»
english: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, Wuuö Jwøk olwiyi ni cwøla lwaŋŋi moa en ya aŋuun näm mo Ijep, ki lwaa kïc mana en yi ŋööm Aciria.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

anywaa: Ni öge bëët ni pïge piny ni pääŋge kwöra näk agäp-kïte, ki yïth gøøde mo kïte, ki yïth abuŋŋe mo koodhi, ki kwör wø kwaac lääc paac yïthge.
english: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk wïthu oliele ki muuc mo käla løø  Naam Upareeti løøga, ni liel jïëc tietu, ki jïëc tïgu thuwø; ni manøgø beeye nyeny Aciria.
english: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, otïmö ni dööŋŋa dhieŋ aciel ki dïëk ariiø jï dhaanhø;
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

anywaa: ni bëët dhaanhe ni cämö ki caak mo opuuö, kiper mana bëëde ni caak thööth, kiper jiy bëët moo dööŋ yi ŋöömö manøgø tïmö ni ge cama caak mo opuuö, ki maar kïc.
english: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, kany ma kar jer omøki ma kuma, mo duunnö ki gwet-bïrö ma kuma, odööŋ ni tuya otwel ki koodhi yie.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

anywaa: Ni put jiy tïmö ni ge cøøa yie baŋ dwaar ni ge käära atume ka athëëre, kiper ŋöömö manøgø bäre onø dööŋö no otuy ko otwel ki koodhi.
english: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

anywaa: 'Ba kwöra näk thuuri bëët na wara puur ki cääle, u ba pïï yïthge kiper mano lwäyu ko otwel ki koodhi; 'ba otïmö na kwör kwaac dhäk yïthge ni rïïŋa dïëk yïthge.
english: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Lwötï ko opäm mo dwøŋ ni göörï luummi yie ni nyeŋge døøŋŋø, ni ‹Kar mak jiy ki tøŋ acäännö; kar twier jammi arwänhnhö.›
english: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, a jëëdö ki jiy mo oŋäädhö mo tïmö na lïŋŋe kipera, ni bee Uria na näk dïlämi, ki Dhekaraya o Jeberekiya.»
english: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

anywaa: Køøre a na Aydheea, aana ci baŋ cïïa, ni jït yie ki dhaanhø, ni nyööte ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø. Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Cak nyeŋŋe ni Maër-Caalal- Ac-Bac,
english: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Maher–shalal–hash–baz.

anywaa: kiper kanyo poot nyilaalli manøgø ni wänni ki menni poot ba cwøle na Awuuö wala Ayaŋ, jap kwärö moa en Damacka ki jammi moa twier Cameria olwør nyeny Aciria ni aae ki geni.»
english: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ cäänö ki aani ni kööe,
english: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kiper mana ö jø Juuda ni kwierge pïï moi ni muuli mëëth ii na käl Naam Cilöa, ni tïme ni yïthge mïnni ka Recin ki o Remaliya,
english: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;

anywaa: ennø, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, pï Naam Upareeti na thööth ni wø kwönni ni teek jääŋŋa jääŋŋö Juuda, ni beeye nyeya mar Aciria ka ajiem mare bäre; ni tïme kaamar pïï mo onithar yïth nyeŋŋi mo Juuda bëët, këël mano mut ageele moge bëët.
english: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

anywaa: Køøre pïï kwönna dï Juuda bäre ni muulö ki dïëre bäre na jwïëö, këël mano päŋe noo këët cwaak, këël mano ö were moe noo gaaŋge na løle ni put ŋööm Juuda bäre thaar, ni beeye ŋöömö marï, ï na Imanuwel.»
english: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

anywaa: Wui, u na wïth juurre, cooŋu rou kanya ciel, 'ba bäätu poot pädhö; uuni ni wø en kwör mo bäyö bäät piny bäre enø, cegu ïthu. Jegu dëëtu, 'ba bäätu poot pädhö; jegu dëëtu jaak, 'ba bäätu poot pädhö.
english: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

anywaa: Tïïyu uutjïëth tïïe mou, 'ba bäŋ gïn duuge; cïbu uutjïëth tïïe mou piny, 'ba ba løny tïïc jïïu, kiper Jwøk ena buutwa.
english: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki aani ni cere na teek ee cïp bääta, ni kööm aani ki man ba cäädha ki jöör jø Juuda, ni kööe,
english: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

anywaa: ni «Gïn wø kö jøøgø na ageem, kär jïëyu na ageem, ni ba lwäärru ki gïn wø lwäärge, wala u wëëga cwïnynyu bwøk ki gø.
english: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk wïth jammi bëët beeye a ŋata dou wøørø ni ena kur keere,  ni beeye a ŋata dou lwäärö, ni beeye a ŋata di cwïnynyu böö ki gø.
english: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

anywaa: 'Ba aano tïmö na kar bëëtö mana en kur keere kiperu; 'ba kiper dhi øt Icriel bäre beeye a kïnno cwany tiel noo wëëk ge pädhö, noo tïmö thuwø na akupa ka abïëp kiper jø Jerucalem.
english: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba mo thööth tietge ocwanyge ri kïnnögø, ni päthge ni tøcge; ni ö møøki ni mak geni ka abïëp.
english: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, wëëk luup 'moa kan cwïny bääga, ni dëëdï ge cwïnyge nee gwøkge.»
english: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, Wuuö Jwøk na kan täärnyïme ki dhi øt Jeekap koora koorø; ni bëëda naa ŋäätha gø.
english: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

anywaa: Raŋï, Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët ni wø bëëdö bäät Kïn Dhayan, aani ko obwöre moa cïbe jïra, wa ee cïbö na ŋïïce na nyuuthe kiper jø Icriel.
english: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

anywaa: Kanyo cään jiyi ki uuni, ni «Pëënynyu jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, jø wø ŋuri ni muuŋö,» käru jïëy. ?Aŋø, jiy ba doo na ge pëënynya Jwøk marge? ?Aŋø, jøøa no othøw doo pëënynyö kiper bëët jøøa kwøw?
english: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

anywaa: Beerra man cïpge ŋäädhe marge ri pwöc Wuuö Jwøk ki ciik moe. 'Ba ni näk luummögø ba tïïcge, nyootha gø ni bäŋ tar bäätge.
english: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

anywaa: 'Ba geno bëëdö ni ge thääyö dï ŋöömö ni bëëtö marge leth ni geno 'näk käci. 'Ba kanyo ö käci noo 'näk geni, geno gooti ni cienge nyeya marge ki Jwøk marge ni ge raŋŋa maal.
english: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

anywaa: Køøre bäät piny oraŋge, ni tïme ni ge joota bëëtö mo leth ki muudhö ki lwøc mo di lwäärö; ni put geni køøl yi muudhö mo cøl døc.
english: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba køør man ennø, muudhö tïmö ni bäŋgø këët kiper jøøa bëëdö ni ge ena yi bëëtö mo leth. 'Ba yïth nïne moa pöödhö, Jwøk ŋööm jø Dhebulan ki ŋööm jø Naptali awëëk nipäät, 'ba noo tïme na yïth nïne moo en nyïm, eni ŋööm Galili kun bëët juurre yie, na en øtjöör naama dwøŋ løø Naam Jördan, wëëge jiem.
english: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø cäädhi yi muudhö, tar mo dwøŋ oneenge, ni ö jø wø bëëdö yi ŋöömma näk muudhö ni rieny tarri bäätge.
english: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, wï jur marï otïïyï nee nyaacge ni tïmge ni thööth, ni tïïyï met ec marge ni dwøŋ, ni mïn yïthge nyïmï, kaamar man wø mïn yïth jiy ri kac ki beel, wala man wø mïn yïth jiy mo ge pääŋŋa jap twëër.
english: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa leth na jwørge na caal jaath puur man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ, ka athøra man wø caar geni ki gø, otoorï, kaawat gïna tïïc ri leny dëët jø Midien.
english: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

anywaa: Kiper war bëët mo wø ŋooŋ jø lenynyi ki ge, ka abïïe moge moa näk ogääbö ki remø, di waaŋø ni thööri ya maaci.
english: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

anywaa: Kiper nyilaal onywöli jïïø, nyilaal ma dïcwøø ocïp jïïø, ni tïm teeki ni ena cere, ni cwøli ni beeye ŋat wø rëëm ec ni wø bwøth jiy ka acaare mo beyø, ni beeye Jwøa teeka eni, ni beeye Wuuö mano bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni beeye Kwääc bëët-mëër.
english: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

anywaa: 'Ba bura mare ki bëët-mëër mare cäätha maal ni ba cuŋ, ni pï piny bäät wäl Deebit ki buc nyec mar gø, ni mak gø ni ee jølø ni teek ki ŋøl ma adïëri ki bëët bëënynyö, ki mano täge ennø këël bäre bäre. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, gïnögø tïïe tïïö nee thur kare ki këëyö mare.
english: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk dwøre ojääŋŋe baŋ Jeekap ni jääla gø, ni ö ajäla manøgø ni päth bäätge, ge na jø Icriel.
english: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni ŋäc jiyi bëët, ni beege jø Ipariem ki jø wø bëëdö Cameria, jø wø cäänö ni ge koorrø ni wø töödö ki yïth cwïnyge, ni ge köö,
english: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

anywaa: «Thuube moa no ogeerø apäänhnhö piny, 'ba cäŋwa ka geerrø ki kïte mo otieŋø; olämmi bëëdö no oŋøt piny, 'ba karge cäŋwa ka pïïnhnhö ki jenni moa perge leth.»
english: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk nyïïmän mo Recin atïïe nee öge bäätge, ni lac geni ki man laarge ö bäätge,
english: Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

anywaa: ni beege jø Aram moa en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki jø Pilitin mo wø bëëdö jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni thöörge jø Icriel kaamar lääy mo dhee ee ŋaamø ni mare løøny. 'Ba këël køør japøgø bëët, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ree poot ba paanye; cere poot bëëdö ni ee rwieø.
english: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy kär duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ŋata jääl geni, ni kärge eni manynyø, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk wïc ki jïp mar Icriel, ki bøøge moe ki bäädi moe di raanynyø ki dïcäŋ aciel keere.
english: Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

anywaa: 'Ba wïc beege jø døøŋŋø ki jøøa no owøørø, ni jïp beege nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø cäänö ki luup tööt.
english: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.

anywaa: Kiper dïbwöthe mo jøøi, jiy atïïcge nee gaage wøk, ni ö jiyi moa bwøth ni ränyge.
english: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk yie ba mïnni ki wøpe moge, ni cwïnye ba pädhi ki gïr kïïe moge ki määr thuunhnhi moge, kiper mana tïmge bëët ni Jwøk ege kwierø ni ge temma raay, ni dhøkge bëëdö ni cara luup mo reyø. 'Ba këël køør japøgø bëët, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ree poot ba paanye, cere poot bëëdö ni ee rwieø.
english: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, bëët rääö wääŋö kaamar maac, ni wø thöör otwel ki koodhi, ni tïme ni caala maa dwaar kany wø waaŋ lul, ni ö jïrö mare ni neetul maal.
english: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

anywaa: Piny waaŋ ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni tïm jiyi na jer maac mo liel maaci ki ge, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo cwïnye pädhi ki gïr watge.
english: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

anywaa: Gïïa en bäät cwïïcge okälge ni camge ge, 'ba käc marge ba riemme, ni kälge moa en bäät cämge thuwø ni camge ge, ni ba jäŋge.  Ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø ro obwöre moe ni cam ge.
english: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

anywaa: Jø Maneeca ge ööa maal bäät jø Ipariem, ni ö jø Ipariemmi ni öge maal bäät jø Maneeca, ni marge døø rege. 'Ba rege ocäŋge dwallø ni nywääkge dëër Juuda. 'Ba këël køør japøgø bëët, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ree poot ba paanye, cere poot bëëdö ni ee rwieø.
english: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï jø wø kän wøk ki ciik mo reyø, ki jø wø ŋudö ki luup mo ba tiir,
english: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;

anywaa: nee luup jøøa näk jïge bäŋ teek na can nee ba ŋølge na kare, ni teek bëëtö mar jiya moa can ba gwøkge; nee bëëtge ni ge møønna määr thuunhnhi, ni jap kïïe twierge twierø.
english: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo tïïyu noo tïme na dïcäŋ ajäla, kanyo ö ränynyö no ööe ki kany mo bäär ni ööa bäätu? ?Aŋa noo reŋŋu baŋe kiper køny? ?Jap kwärö mou, owiiu ge kaa?
english: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

anywaa: 'Ba mano dööŋ keere nø, beeye ki man boothu nyeŋŋu yïthakic jø omak ki tøŋ, ni 'näk uuni yïthakic jiy mo othøw. 'Ba këël køør japøgø bëët, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ree poot ba paanye, cere poot bëëdö ni ee rwieø.
english: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï Aciria, na näk yaa tïïö na athøra mar wëër mara, na athøra mano en cer Aciria beeye mano nyoodha wëër mara ki gø.
english: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

anywaa: Aciria jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋ wï jur mana kwier Jwøk, ni köömma gø nee ci baŋ jiy moa tïïc aani naa wëëra ki ge, nee japge twier ni käli, ni thiel ge piny ni nyør geni kaamar odhöönh mar øtjöö.
english: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

anywaa: 'Ba Aciria, acaara mare paa manøgø, ni manøgø paa mana en wïïe. 'Ba mana en cwïnye kiree beeye dïïr wïc, ni beeye ki man thöör wïth juurre mo thööth.
english: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

anywaa: Kiper ena köö, na «?Aŋø, kwääc lwaae mo leny 'moa, paa nyeye bëët?
english: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, pääny Kaalnö ba caal pääny Karkëmec, na Amath ba caal Arpat, ni Cameria ba caal Damacka?
english: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

anywaa: Kaawat mana nø pïïc cera baŋ mïëc nyeye mo wø wøør kït gïï wø lam, ni beege jøøa näk kït gïï wø lam moge moa no otieŋø pöödha geni ki moa en Jerucalem ki Cameria,
english: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

anywaa: ?aŋø, ba lønye nidïï ki man tïïa ki gïn mo raac dëët jø Jerucalem ki kït gïï wø lamge, ni caala mana nø tïïa dëët jø Cameria ki kït gïï wø lamge?»
english: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø ö Wuuö Jwøki noo nø thöör tïïe moe bëët bäät Kïn Dhayan dëër pääny Jerucalem, eni köö, «Aani, nyeny Aciria jääla jäälö kiper ŋwøc mare na raac na en cwïnye, ka atöör mare na näk nëënö waŋe.»
english: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

anywaa: Kiper nyeny Aciria onø köö, ni «Ki køør teek bada ki riek waŋ mara gïnögø atïïa, kiper aani gïnögø tiere yaa nø kwany. Aani, nyeŋ kee mo wïth juurre yaa nø raanynyø,  ni twiera jammi moa en jïge. Aani, mïëc nyeye moge adïïma ki teek mara.
english: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:

anywaa: Aani cera apïï baŋ jap kwärö mo jiy kaawat man wø pïïc cenø baŋ øt wenyø; kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø cooŋ tøk wenyø mo odööŋ keerge, aani jø bäät piny bëët acooŋa kanya ciel, ni bäŋ aciel mo gööge ee tïŋ maal wala mo dhee ee ŋaamø, wala mo oköök.»
english: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ley ŋwöö kiper dëëre bäät ŋat wø ŋudö ki gø? ?A gïr ŋøl ko opämi, dëëre wø jieme jiemø bäät ŋat wø ŋudö ki gø? Manøgø patha gïn mo tägö; tïmö ni caala man ö athøra ni kwany dhaanhø ni wø kwany gø, wala caala man ö athøra ni tïŋ dhaanhø maal na näk patha jaath.
english: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ojäägi ki täw mo leth dï jø leny moa no olør mo nyeny Aciria, ni ö ajiemmi mar nyeny Aciria ni nyebi ki maac mo liel døc.
english: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

anywaa: Eni na näk tar mar Icriel otïmö na maac, ni ö eni na en kur keere ni tïme na leep maac. Ni ö maaøgø ni put koodhi ko otwel mo Aciria thöör ki dïcäŋ aciel keere.
english: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

anywaa: Ajiem lul mar Aciria ka ajiem pwöth moe mo wø ciek ki caammi døc raany Wuuö Jwøki raanynyø, ni rwöbe ka jwïëy ki dëël bëët, kaawat man wø ö dëër dhaanhø wø dwade ki täw mo leth.
english: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jenni moo dööŋ yi lure manøgø otïmö ni nøk, ni løny jï nyilaal jaak ki man kwaan geni.
english: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, jø Icriel moo dööŋ ni kwøw, na bøth ri dhi øt Jeekap, otïmö ni ge ba göök ri jiy moa thöör geni këët, 'ba ge puta göök ri Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na en kur keere na adïëri møn.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

anywaa: Jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw oduui møn, ni beege moo dööŋ ri dhi øt Jeekap, ni ge duua baŋ Jwøa teek.
english: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

anywaa: Wui Icriel, këël na bëët jiyï ni kwäänge caala akwöny naama dwøŋ, mo nøk keerge moo dööŋ ni kwøw dëëtge beege noo duui. 'Ba ränynyö onø cïp piny, no onø ŋøl kiree na kare.
english: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

anywaa: Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ränynyö bäre mana näk ee nø cïp piny kïthe bäät jiy moa en yi ŋöömö manøgø bäre.
english: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, «Wui, u na jiya ni wø bëëdö Dhayan, käru lwäyö ki jø Aciria kanyo öge noo pwötge uuni ka athøra, noo tïŋge athøra marge maal bäätu, kaawat mana tïïc jø Ijepi.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

anywaa: Kiper ki kany mo thiinh, wëër mara ki uuni thum, ni ö wëërri mara ni coony baŋge kuna raanynya geni.»
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, alaŋŋa tïŋe maal bäätge kaawat mana tïïe na dïïr wïth jø Midien buut Kïn Orëëp, ni ö athøra mare ni tïŋ gø maal bäät naama dwøŋ, kaawat mana tïïe Ijep.
english: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, tëër mana peek mar nyeny Aciria otïŋ maal göögu, ni ö jaath puurri mare man wø rïï ŋut, ni käli wøk ŋutu, ni ö jaath puurri manøgø ni toore kiper lørø maru.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

anywaa: Nyimän onø ci kuna tuk paac mana cwøl na Ayath, ni eni cøra dï Migarön, ni jammi moe ee cïp piny Mikmac.
english: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:

anywaa: 'Ba eno nø pöödhö, ni kööe, «Gëba otïmö na kar jwöm røk man buta yie.» Jø Reema onø lwäyö døc, ni ö Giba, pääny Cøøl, ni nø bwøk jiye.
english: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Gaalim, gööu ko oduuru døc ni döötu ena maal! Wui, u na jø Laaica, ceku ïthu. Wui, u na jø Anathöth, jøllu oduuru manøgø.
english: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

anywaa: Jø Matmëna anø bwøk, ni ö jøøa bëëdö Gëëbïm ni nø kaange rege.
english: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋi kiree nyimän apïï Nöp, ni tuuŋ cere ni mare ŋwøc kiper gïno tïïe dëët jø Kïn Dhayan ni beeye Kïn Jerucalem.
english: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bäät jenni oŋøt piny ki teek mo dwøŋ døc mo di lwäärö, ni ö jenni moa døøŋŋø dïge ni bami piny, ni ö mo wø bëëdö ni bäyö ni dwøgi piny.
english: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, lul mana no odhïŋ døc oŋøt piny ki ley, ni ö eni na teek ni gøø lur Libaanø piny, ni pädhe.
english: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

anywaa: 'Ba lwiidhø ojoot ki ri Jeci; ni ö bati mano ööi ki ree ni nywøle ki nyey.
english: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

anywaa: Ni ö Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøki ni ö bääte, ni bee jwïëyo cïp leec wïc ki ŋäc tiet luup, jwïëyo bwøth dhaanhø ka acaara mo beer ni wø cïpi ki teek, jwïëyo cïp kwänynyö ki lwär ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;

anywaa: 'Ba eni yie omïnni ki man bëëde ni lwäära Wuuö Jwøk; ni bëëde ni luup ba ŋøle ki køør jammi mo wø joode ki waŋe, wala mo wø wïnynye ki ïthe.
english: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

anywaa: 'Ba eni luup jøøa can oŋøle ki køør adïëri; luup jøøa no othiel piny moa en bäät piny oŋøle na kare. Eni piny ojääle ki luup moo ööi ki dhee, ni 'näk jøøa reyø ki jam dhee.
english: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

anywaa: Bëënynyö mare otïmö kaamar kaw mo ee twöö ŋääe, ni ö adïëri mare thuwø ni tïme kaamar kaw piere.
english: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

anywaa: 'Ba orudö obëëdö na aciel ki nyirøømmø, ni ö kwaci ki nya ateea ni butge na aciel, ni ö nyirøøa ki nyi ŋuu ni cämge na aciel,  ni ge kwaaya nyilaalli mo thiinh.
english: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

anywaa: Dhieŋ ocämö na aciel ki cwieny; ni ö nyïïge ni buutge na aciel. Ni ö ŋuuwi ni cäme ki luum kaamar dhieŋ.
english: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

anywaa: Nyilaal mo poot dhøøth okwääk dhi buur olwierø, ni ö nyilaalli mo oŋøl ki caak ni rwaak cere baŋ thwöl mana näk uu kar bëëtö mar gø.
english: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät kïdi bäre na en kur keere mar Wuuö Jwøk, tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïïö ki gïn mo raac yie wala mo räänyö; kiper piny opäŋ ki kwänynyö man ŋäc Wuuö Jwøk kaawat mano ö pïïyi wø thaar naama dwøŋ.
english: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca lwinh Jeci ocuŋŋi na ŋïï kiper wïth juurre; ni ö wïth juurre ni kuutge ree, ni ö kar bëëtö mare ni pääŋe ka ajiem.
english: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk cere cäŋe ka tïŋ maal ri rietge ki man duu jiye baŋe moa no odööŋ ni kwøw ya Aciria, ki Ijep, ki thääŋ ŋööm Ijep mana cwøl ni Patröc, ki moa no odööŋ Kuuc, ki Ilam, ki Babiløn, ka Amath, ki deŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

anywaa: Eni ŋïï mare tïŋe maal baŋ wïth juurre, ni cooŋ jø Icriel moa no omaa ki tøŋ; ni cooŋ jø Juuda moa no okeethø ki yïth tuk piny moa na aŋween.
english: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bëët keec mar Ipariem orwäänyi, ni ö nyïïmänni mo Juuda ni tïmge ni bäŋgø. Ipariem otïmö ni ba këëö kiper Juuda, ni ö Juuda ni ba cwaat yi Ipariem këët.
english: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba geni bëët geno løøc piny baŋ jø Pilitin, ni läätge bäätge jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ. Dëëtge odwalge ni twierge jiy mo wø en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni tïm jø Ëdömmi ki jø Möap ni ena tietge, ni tïm jø Amönni ni bëënna geni.
english: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk weel naama dwøŋ mar Ijep taale taalø; cere tïŋe maal bäät Naam Upareeti ki jamø mo lïëth, ni put gø ŋørø na nyeŋŋi abïriiø, ni put tïmö ni ŋøl jiyi ŋølø ki war jaak.
english: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

anywaa: Kanyøgø otïmö ni da jöö mo dwøŋ man ŋun jiyi moe ki yie moa no odööŋ ni kwøw ya Aciria, kaawat mana tïïe kiper jø Icriel kanya öge wøk ki Ijep.
english: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca ŋati man nø dïïu oköö, «Wui ï na Wuuö Jwøk, nyeŋŋï pwøa pwøø; kiper wëër marï apaanyï bääta, ni cømï cwïnya, këël na bëëdï ni ïïno wëër ki aani.
english: And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk beeye na pïëmi mara, naa bëëdö naa ŋäätha gø naa ba lwäyi. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mara, ni bee eni ni wø nyeŋŋe pwøa ki duut, ni tïme na pïëmi mara.»
english: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord Jehovah is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, yïthu omïnni kanyo jootu pïëm ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat man wø mïn yi dhaanhø ki pïï mo wø kwönni ki yi jøøro.
english: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca uuno köö jï jiy, ni «Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋe, ni caannu tïïe moe jï wïth juurre nee ŋäcge, ni parru wïthge ki nyeŋŋe ki man näk mo eni kare dwøŋ.»
english: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

anywaa: Wärru ki dut pwøc jï Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ena tïïö ki tïïe mo nyeŋŋe di jiemø ki rege; beerra man tïm tïïe moøgø ni ŋäc ki bäät piny bäre.
english: Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

anywaa: Wärru ki dudi ki met ec ni döötu you tïŋ maal, u na jø Dhayan, kiper Jwø Icriel na en kur keere na en yïthakiyu dwøŋŋa eni.
english: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana nyooth Wuuö Jwøki na joot Aydheea wär Amöth kiper Babiløn bee en:
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

anywaa: «Tïŋŋu maal ki ŋïï mar leny bäät kïnna näk bäŋ gïrpiny bääte, ni tïŋu döötu maal nee wïny jø lenynyi, ni tuuŋŋu ceŋŋu na nyuudhi nee jø leny dønyge ki dhøk uudi mo jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø.
english: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

anywaa: Aani jiya moa näk yaa cïp kur keerge anø köömma, ni nø cwøla jø leny 'moa na teek kiper nee wëër mara kïthge bäät tïïc, ni beege jiya mo wø ŋwöö ni ge töödö.
english: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

anywaa: «Cegu ïthu ki dïlweel bäät kïte, ni beeye dööt jiy mo thööth! Cegu ïthu ki dwøl manø ni märi ni dwøŋ enø yïth mïëc nyeye, ni beeye dööt wïth juurre moa näk dëëtge ege cooŋø! Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, jiiŋŋa lwaak kiper leny.
english: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

anywaa: Lwaak manøgø käla paac mo bäär, ni käla ya aŋuun piny mana bäär døc. Wuuö Jwøk ŋöömö manøgø bäre di raanynyø ki gïr tïïc mar ajäla mare.
english: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

anywaa: «Gööu ko oduuru, kiper cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk kare acäännö. Cäŋögø öö na cäŋ aranya ni käla baŋ Jwøa en teeki jïre.
english: Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, bäät jiy bëët oput niläp, ni ö cwïny jiy bëët ni put bwøk døc.
english: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:

anywaa: 'Ba geno lwäyi døc, ni ö räämmi mo teek ki bëëtö mo leth ni put tägö dëëtge. Geni, dëëtge døøcge døøyø kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri. Ŋati man nø rege watge oneene ni yie othäŋŋö, ni täärnyïme owïïtö ki lwär.
english: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.

anywaa: Neennu, cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk öö, ni beeye cäŋ mo raac døc ma mar bëët rääm, ki wëër mo liel kaamar maac, ni tïïya ŋöömö manøgø nee dööŋe keere. Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni thöör jø raay mo ŋöömmögø ki 'näk.
english: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

anywaa: 'Ba ceer mo maal ki moa näk dëëtge ege cøŋŋø otïmö ni ba cïpi ki tar. Cäŋ otïmö ni cøl kanyo tuule, ni ö dwääyi ni ba cïp tar mare.
english: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, piny jääla jäälö kiper rääö mare, ni jääla jø raay kiper raay moge. Aani thuwø, jø atöör, atöör marge raanynya raanynyø, ni ö bëët koorrø mar jøøa no ogäy ni dwøga gø piny.
english: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

anywaa: Aani, jiy mo obøth otïïa ni nøk ni ba joot caar ni kaala warkey mo tøŋ, ni joot na alïm ni kaala warkey mar kanya cwøl no Öpïr.
english: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, maal bäre tïïa tïïö ni jäŋŋi, ni ö pinynyi ni tïme ni kwanynyi, kanyo ö wëërri mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk na näk wïth jammi bëët, ni beeye dïcäŋo ö wëërri mara noo liele kaamar maac.
english: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

anywaa: «Ni tïm jiyi kaamar röönne mo di dwarø, ni tïmge kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge, ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtge ni døø baŋ jø poge, ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø yi ŋöömö marge.
english: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

anywaa: ŋato joot jaak put ka cwøp ki tøŋ, ni ö ŋato mak ni nääi ko opëëllö.
english: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.

anywaa: Obwöre moge moa therø di gøyø ki ri kïte ni petge ni nëënö jïge; ni ö gïïa en yïth uudi moge ni twieri, ni buudö ki määrge ki teek.
english: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

anywaa: «Neennu, jø Mëdön tïïa tïïö nee öge maal bäätge, ni beege jøøa näk ba løny ki cøøgø ki man ŋeei ki gwel-bïrö, wala di nøønø ki warkey.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

anywaa: Athëëre moge, obwöc cwøw moa näk wøpe thöörge thöörö. Geni cwïnyge ba pädhi ki man 'näkge obwöre moa marr, ni yïthge ba warge ki 'näk obwöre moa therø.
english: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

anywaa: 'Ba Babiløn, na näk mïërö mar mïëc nyeye, na näk gïr ajiem mar atöör mar jø Kaldia, otïmö kaamar Cødam ki Gømöra kanya raanynyi ya Jwøki.
english: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

anywaa: Otïmö ni bäŋ jiy yie, ni ba beet, ki mano täge ri beenhnhø maneca këël mano këët røk beenhnhe moo ööi. Ni bäŋ jø Araba mo cwödha oduŋkaare moge yie, ni bäŋ dïkwääye mo tïïc lääc paac moge nee butge piny yie.
english: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

anywaa: 'Ba lääc paap obëëdö yie, ni ö uudi moe ni tïmge na kwör bëëte mo tule. Ude thuwø obëëdö ni ena kaace, ni ö adëële ni kwääkge yie kaace.
english: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

anywaa: Odïï obëëdö ni jwöŋö kwör koor moe moa no ogeerø ni teek, ni ö orude ni jwöŋge yïth uudi moe moa døøŋŋø na mïërö. 'Ba caa mare kare cään, ni bäŋ nïne jïre këët.»
english: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye pädhö ki gïr dhi øt Jeekap, ni cäŋ jø Icriel jierrø, ni tïïc ge nee pïge piny yi ŋöömö marge, ni ö jøøa pathi ni dwätge ki geni ni kuurge dëëtge dhi øt Jeekap.
english: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø wïth juurre öö ni jiethge jø Icriel, ni kïthge geni yi ŋöömö marge, ni ö jø Icrielli ni tïïcge wïth juurre moøgø na moge yi ŋööm Wuuö Jwøk; ni ö cwøwi ki mään mo jøøgø ni bëëtge ni gena jø tïïc jïge. Jø Icriel, jiy moa mak geni ki tøŋ makge maaø ki tøŋ, ni tïmge na kwääri bäät jøøa dïïm geni.
english: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo mooc uuni ki jwöm yi bëët rääm mana rämu ki gø, ki yi caarø mana caar uuni ki gø, ki yïth tïïe moa teek na wara tïïyu nou ena tier laŋ,
english: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

anywaa: uuni, duut mar aŋaada man wärru wärö kiper nyeny Babiløn, ni kööu, «Neennu, ŋata caar jiy apädhö, ni ö dïwïti mare ni ŋøle.
english: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk athøra mar jø raay anø toore, ni beeye athøny kwär mar cuumme,
english: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.

anywaa: na wara dïïmge wïth juurre ki gø  kanya wara wëërge ni ge dïmö ka adïma mo ba cuŋ; ni beeye athønynya wara dwøkge wïth juurre piny ki gø kanya wara wëërge ni ge caara jiy ki caarø mo ba cuŋ.
english: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.

anywaa: Bäät piny bäre ajïtö ki jwöm ni put nikïïl, ni ö jiyi ni kwöŋge ki met ec.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

anywaa: Këël jenni moa bäyö ki moa perge leth mo lur Libaanø, yïthge mïnnö bäätï, ï na nyeny Babiløn, ni köge, ni ‹Ennø, kiper mana dwøk wïïï piny, bäŋ dïŋut jenni këët mo ööa baŋwa nee wa ŋøt piny.›
english: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

anywaa: «Kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw na en piny kuya kanynyø ni pänh ïïni kanyo ööï; ni ö jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, ni beege cuumme mo bäät piny bëët, ni tïŋ ge maal kiperï niï määthge; ni wëëk nyeye bëët mo wïth juurre ööny maal ki bäät wäl moge.
english: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ge bëët, ge cäänö ki ïïni ni köge, ‹?Aŋø, këël ï thuwø, ïïna tïïc niï jääk kaamar marwa? ?Ïïna tïmö niï caala waani ennø?
english: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

anywaa: Atöör marï ki dööt thøme moï anø käl kany kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw. Bïëy beeye pëëm marï mano butï bääte, ni twöŋi beege aleeŋŋa marï mano uumï ki gø.›
english: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na cëëc øw, ni wø nëëni ki bäc øw, kee ïïna nø pänhnhö ki maal! Ï na tïïc wïth juurre ni jägö, kee ïïna nø leeŋ piny!
english: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ïïna köö ki yi cwïnyï, ni ‹Aani, a etha maal, ni tïïa wälu mara ni ena ŋäth ceer mo Jwøk, ni pïïa piny bäät kïn wø cooŋ røk bääte, naa ena kanya en maal kuya wï-piny.
english: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

anywaa: Aani, a etha maal ŋäth pøøl kuya, ni tïïa raa na a caala Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal.›
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno nø kïth piny kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, yi buur mana bäär døc na en kuya.
english: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

anywaa: «Jiy moo joot ïïni nyeŋge teege riï, ni pëënyge dëëtge ni köge, na ‹?Aŋø, man beeye ŋata tïïc bäät piny ni ïïgö, na nëëk mïëc nyeye,
english: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

anywaa: na tïïc bäät piny ni caala dï paap, na raany päänye mo gø, na wara bëëdö ni ba jïëy ki man wec jiy moa näk ee maa ki tøŋ ki man døøge poge?›
english: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?

anywaa: «Nyeye mo wïth juurre bëët butö no ojiemø, ni ŋati man nø ena yi bwörö mare.
english: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ïïno nø lëëŋ wøk ki yi bwörö marï kaamar bat jaath mo owetø; niï rëëbö ka jiy moa no othøø, na 'näk ko opëëllö, jøøa no onø ci piny tier buur kuya yïth kïte, kaamar dëër dhaanhø mo othøw mo onyørø.
english: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï ba koony kaamar nyeye møga, kiper paac marï araanynyï, ni 'nägï jiy moï. Beerra man ö nyïïkwaac jiy mo wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø  ni rwääny nyeŋge na bäre bäre ni ba cwøl.
english: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

anywaa: Jiiŋŋu kany ŋar wäät jø Babiløn yie kiper gïïa reyø na tïïc kwäcge; ba beer ki man öge maal ki man ci pinynyi ceŋge, ni pääŋge piny bäre ki päänye.»
english: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, «Aani, a ööa maal bäät jø Babiløn, ni ŋula nyeŋ Babiløn wøk, ki jiye moa bøth, ki nyikwaaye, ki jø tuuŋge bëët.» Manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Aani thuwø, paanøgø tïïa tïïö na kar bëëtö mar thëëwe, ni pïï omägö yie, ni puta gø jwiec ki jwïëc mar aranya.» Manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, anø kööŋ ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, kaawat mana nø cïba acaara mara piny, puta tägö; kaawat mana nø caara gø, puta bëëtö kare.
english: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

anywaa: Aciria nyøra nyørø ni raanynya gø yi ŋöömö mara bäät kïte 'moa. Gïïa leth na tïïe na caal jaath puur man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ di paanyø bäät jiya, ni ö tëërri mare na peek ni tïŋi maal göök jiya.
english: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

anywaa: «Manøgø beeye acaara mana no ocïp piny kiper ränynyö mar bäät piny bäre, ni manøgø beeye cer ajäla mana no orwieø nee wïth juurre bëët raanynye.
english: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, acaara mare anø cïp piny. ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo raanynya acaara manøgø? Eni cere ee nø rwiec. ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo tïïc gø nee cere duue?»
english: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiina thøw nyeya ma Eeyeth, luubö man anyooth Wuuö Jwøki na ennø nø,
english: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Pilitin u bëët, kär yïthu mïnnö kiper mana toor athøra mana pwöt uuni ki gø, kiper athøra manøgø otïmö na thwöl mo olwierø mo wïnni døc, ni ö nyi thwör olwierø manøgø ni tïme na thwöl mo määdö.
english: Rejoice not thou, whole Philistia, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa näk dëëtge ba løny ki køny jïge, ge jïtö ki cam. Ni ö jiyi moa can ni bëëtge piny ni geno gwøø. 'Ba uuni, wïthu dïïra dïïrö ki käc, ni ö jiyu moa no obøth ki thøø ni thööri ya käci manøgø.
english: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

anywaa: «Wui, dhi kiir, gööï ko oduuru! Wui, pääny, jwöŋï! Wui, u na jø Pilitin bëët, dëëtu kwanynye ki lwär! Kiper jïrö aöö ki wï-piny, ni beege jø leny mo dëëtge ege nø jek.
english: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Philistia, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø noo løk jï jiy moa öö ni ge jääŋŋa wï jurri mør? Gïno løk beeye ni Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan anø tïïe ni teek, 'ba jiye moa no ocaarø, rege ogwøkge yie.»
english: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Möap beeye en:  Ëër na näk pääny Möap aränynyö, araanynyi ki wäär aciel! Kir na näk pääny Möap aränynyö, araanynyi ki wäär aciel!
english: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

anywaa: Ni ö jø Möapi mo wø bëëdö pääny Dibön ni cige kuna jwöŋge yïth uut jwøk marge bäät thuuri; ni ö geni ni gööge ko oduuru bäät päänye moge møga, ni beege Nebø ki Medeba. Ni ö jïëc wïthge bëët ni gwäärge ge wøk, ni lielge jïëc tïkge bëët.
english: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.

anywaa: Ni bëëtge nyeŋ jïëthe moge ni keece ege dwøl dëëtge; ni ge bëët, ge bëëdö ni ge göö ko oduuru ni pï nyeŋge lwöra piny, ni ge bëëdö bäät uudi moge ki kwöra laac dï pääny.
english: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Ëcbön ki jø Eliyali gena göö ko oduuru thuwø, këël mana wïny döötge jöör Jäc bäre. Kiper manøgønø, jø leny mo Möap gena put jwöŋö døc ni cwïnyge opädhö.
english: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cwïnya atïmö ni kïmmö kiper jø Möap, kiper jiye moa bwøk gena reeŋø këël mana pïïcge Dhöär ki Ëglat-Celicia, ni iithge thuur Lukith ni ge cäädhi ni ge göö ko oduuru. Ka adïëri møn, jöör Örönaim acaathge ni ge göö ko oduuc kïmmö kiper ränynyö marge.
english: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

anywaa: 'Ba pïï mo Aguul Nimrim onø talø, ni luum mana en kaace otal. Ni gïïa no otuy bëët oränynyö, ni bäŋ gïn mo marr.
english: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
