anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena aay ni jammi moa en jïge na thööth na näk ege kaannø käärge käärö këël mana ŋølge waŋ Naam Erabim.
english: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

anywaa: Ni ö oduuru marge ni gääp dï ŋööm Möap bäre, këël mana pïïe Eglam ki Bëër-Elim.
english: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer–elim.

anywaa: Kiper pï Naam Dimön agääbö ki remø bäre. 'Ba aano cäŋ kïth bäät Dimön ki gïn mør mo leth. Ŋuu ojääŋŋa yïthakic jø Möap moa no obwøk ki moa no odööŋ yi ŋöömö marge.
english: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

anywaa: U na jø Möap, jäägu ki nyïïdïëk na ajwäk jï ŋata en paaci cere na en bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni ööu ki pääny Cela nou cura jöör wø cør dï paap.
english: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

anywaa: 'Ba mään mo Möap kanya pïïcge jwïëy mar Naam Arnön, gena bëëdö ni ge rïmma yïthge, ni tïmge kaamar weny mo obwøk mo tuuŋŋa bwöpge yi jamø jaak.
english: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

anywaa: Ni köge jï jø Juuda, ni «Mooyu wa ka acaara mo beer, ni ŋøllu luumwa na kare. Kaa man bëëde ni piny a dhöör cäŋ en, jääŋŋu tïpö maru bäätwa nee tïme kaamar wäär. Kannu waani, wa no oriemmø en, ni ba waayu waani, wa na jiy mo obwøk en.
english: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëtwa yi ŋöömö maru, wa na no oriemmø en, ni tïmu ni uuna kar kan røk jïwa kiper ŋat mo raanynya wa.» 'Ba kanyo tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo caanna jiy këët, na aranya ocuŋŋö, ni bäŋ dïtwïëte këët yi ŋöömö,
english: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

anywaa: wälu okëël piny ni teek ki mëër; ni ö dïŋut luup mo tïïö na kare ni pï bääte, ni beeye ŋato ööi ki dhi øt Deebit, ni wø many ŋøl ma kare, ŋat wø laar luup ŋøl na adïëri.
english: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, atöör mar jø Möap awïnywa, ki koorrø marge, ki bëëtö marge ni dëëtge ege tïŋ maal, ki gootø marge; 'ba ŋwøc marge bäŋ tiere.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jø Möap geno göö ko oduuru, geno göö ko oduuru ge bëët kiper poge. Cwïnyge opädhi ni kïmge kiper nyïïomøki moa näk omiinynyø na dhøgi mo pääny Kir-Ërë.
english: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.

anywaa: Pwöth mo Ëcbön atal, ni ö nyïïomøki mo Cebama ni talge thuwø. Kwääri mo wïth juurre, jer omøki moa beyø araanyge, ni beege jera thööth na näk opïï Jadher këël dï paap, na näk bëëdö no oløth no olaak no onigïït piny bäät naama dwøŋ.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a jwöŋö ni yia yaa keeyø døc kiper Jadher ki pwöth omøki mo Cebama. Wui, ï na Ëcbön ki ï na Eliyali! Pï nyeŋŋa wëëga nathar bäätu. Kiper kwöŋŋö mar met ec mana wara wïnyö yïth pwöth nyïïjenni mo wø ciek ki cwiir, ki mana wara wïnyö kwör kac mou, aŋøl.
english: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

anywaa: Met ec ki kanynyø mana wara en yïth pwöth nyïïjenni mou aŋøl, ni tïme ni bäŋ kwöŋŋö mar met ec, wala duut mo di wärö yïth pwöth nyïïomøki, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo nyööbö këët ki køøŋ nyïïomøki; kiper kwöŋŋö mar met ec yaa nø ŋøl.
english: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aana bëëdö naa kïïna gïr Möap ki cwïnya kaamar ŋat wø jwøk jwøkthøø ki thoom; ni bëëda naa kïmmö kiper Kir-Ërë.
english: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir–heres.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ci jø Möapi kwör lam moge moa en bäät thuuri, ki kanyo cige øt jwøge baŋ lam, geno tïmö ni ge ööla dëëtge jaak ni bäŋ køny mo jootge.
english: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki dïkwøŋ kiper jø Möap.
english: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ni kööe, «Ni ki yïth cwiiri adäk, kaawat man wø kwaan ŋat tïïci, ajiem mar Möap na dwøŋ, ki jiye na thööth, ränynyö; ni ö jiye moo dööŋ ni kwøw ni dööŋge ni nøk døc ni jägö.»
english: But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper Damacka bee en: «Neennu, Damacka kare aløny ni cään ki man tïme ni paa pääny, eno pädhi ni neeruuth.
english: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

anywaa: Päänye mo Aröör wïc owïl ki geni, ni tïmge na kwöro bëët pïïth dïëki yïthge, ni ge butö jaak ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïïya geni nee lwäcge.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

anywaa: Päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek tïmö ni bäŋgø yi ŋööm Ipariem, ni bäŋ teek nyec Damacka; ni ö jiyi moo dööŋ ni kwøw dëët jø Aram ni räny ajiemmi marge kaamar ajiem mar jø Icriel.» Manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, ajiem mar nyïïkwaac Jeekap ränynyö, ni ö lørø marge ni tïme na dwadø.
english: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

anywaa: Ni ö gïnögø ni tïme kaawat man wø ö ŋat kaci wø kac caammi mo poot cuŋŋö yi pwödhö, ni kuk abäy baaŋŋe baaŋŋø ki cere kiree; wala tïmö kaawat mar ŋat mo data wïth beel moa en yi goor Rapayim.
english: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk poot bøth yie, ni caala man wø diem nyïï jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw piny, ni tïme ni nyïëdi ariiø wala adäk obøth maal lwinh jaadhøgø, ni nyïëdi aŋween wala abïïc obøth ri bäät jaath manøgø mana no onywøl døc. Manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel.
english: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.

anywaa: Noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, jiy døøa baŋ Jwøa cwääc geni, ni ö nyeŋge ni teege gø ree, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba døø baŋ gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge na tïïcge ki ceŋge jï juuga reyø, ni ba lwïthge këët baŋ gïïa tïïcge ki lweetge, ni beege jenni moa näk ege tieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara, ki gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge.
english: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

anywaa: Noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, päänye moge moa teek otïmö ni caala kwör mo owiiø mo otïmö na paap, ni beege kwöra wec jøøa dïkwøŋ kanya reŋge ni ge ŋwieya jø Icriel; ni ö ŋöömö manøgø ni put dööŋŋö ni bäŋ jiy yie.
english: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

anywaa: Kiper u na jø Icriel, wïthu awïl ki Jwøk na näk pïëmi maru, ni käru wïthu parø ki eni na kïn gwøk røk maru. Kiper manøgønø, këël u doo pïïdhö ki jenni mo mïërö, ni tøøgu jenni mo käla mïëri mo path,
english: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

anywaa: ni ciellu gø ki kal dïcäŋo piithu gø yie, ni noo tïme na amöölla, gïïa piithu puta døøŋŋø ni ŋøøkge, kanyo kaay bäŋ gïn mo joot, ni ö dïcäŋeca ni tïme na cäŋ täwe ki rääm mo leth.
english: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

anywaa: Wui, wïnynyu ŋurö mar wïth juurre mo thööth, ni wïnyi en kaamar lwör mar athaŋ naama dwøŋ. Wïnynyu ŋurö mar wïth juurre na näk lwör kaamar pïï mo kwödö ni teek.
english: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

anywaa: Wïth juurre döötge märö kaamar lwör mar pïï mo thööth; 'ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo jook geni, ge puta bwøk ni reŋge kany mo bäär. Ni put ge riemmø ni køøl ge kaamar luum mo ena bäät kïte kanyo køøli ya jamø, wala tør kanyo køøli ya apwøyaweerø.
english: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, noo tïme na wïthïënhö, jiy tïïcge tïïö nee lwäcge døc; 'ba kanyo tïme na kur øw, ge tøør këët. Manøgø otïmö na kur jiy moa twier øøni, ni beeye gïno tägi dëëtge, ge na twier japø.
english: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï paana näk jïre da baabuure mo rege da bwöm, na en løø näm mo paana cwøl ni Kuuc løøga,
english: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

anywaa: ni wø jääŋ jiy ki jïëthe mo cäädhi ki yïth näm, ni beege jïëthe mo ocwääö ko otöök. U na jiy mo wø jääŋŋi ni wø rwäänhnhi, cou baŋ jøøa bäyö na dëëtge pøøth, ni beeye wï jur mo jiy moa kwörge cärö ki moa kwörge bäyö lwäär ki gø, ni beeye wï jur mo teek mo dïmö, mo ŋøøm moge oŋør nämmi.
english: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

anywaa: 'Ba uuni bëët, u ni en bäät piny, ni bee u ki dëëtu ni wø bëëdö yie, kanyo ö ŋïï noo tïŋi maal ki paana en bäät kïte, oneennu, kanyo ö tuuŋŋi noo koodhi, dwøre owïnynyu.
english: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, na kööe, ni «Aani a bëëdö naa lïŋö naa rääŋö ki kanya ena yie kar bëëtö mara, kaamar däär cäŋ man wø rieny ni lïëth, ni tïme kaamar pöölö mo ŋec kany wø näk ri kac beel ni cäŋ kwaar.»
english: For so the Lord said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

anywaa: Kiper kanyo tïme ni kar kac poodi, ni wï jaath onø ŋøø, ni wïïe opäth piny, ni nyïïe manynya ciek, eni lweth jenni moa no oløth ŋøre ŋørø ki caakïïn mar goor jenni, ni ö bäädi moa no olaak ni ŋødi piny ni weti.
english: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

anywaa: Ni putge dööŋŋe jï weny mo wø cämö ni ge cwëëdhö ni wø bëëdö bäät kïte, ki jï lääc paap, ni tïmge na cam jï weny moøgø ki öörö bäre, ni tïmge thuwø na cam jï lääc paap ki cwiir bäre.
english: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na kar kaaca, muuy di kälö jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ki baŋ jøøa bäyö na dëëtge pøøth, ni beeye wï jur mo jiy moa kwörge cärö ki moa kwörge bäyö lwäär ki gø, ni beege wï jur mo teek mo dïmö, mo ŋøøm moge oŋør nämmi. Muuy di kälö ni kïthi bäät Kïn Dhayan na näk kar bëët nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: In that time shall the present be brought unto the Lord of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Zion.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Ijep beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk öö ni ena bäät pöölö mo rïïŋö døc, ni ööa Ijep. Ni ö kït gïï wø lam mo jø Ijep ni put dëëtge tïmö ni kwanynyi nyïme, ni ö cwïny jø Ijepi ni bwøkge ki gø.
english: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jø Ijep tïïa tïïö nee døøge rege keerge; ni tïm ŋati man nø ni këëdö ki coki, ni ö ŋat atut man nø ni tïme ni këëdö ki ŋat atut mare, ni ö päänye moe ni tïmge ni këëdö ki rege, ni kwääri moe thuwø këëdö ki rege keerge.
english: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jø Ijep cwïnyge obëëdö no opädhö, ni ö jammi moa näk ege cïp piny na dige tïïö, ni tïïa ge ni bäŋ tietge. 'Ba geno ci baŋ kït gïï wø lam moge, ki baŋ jwïëc jøøa no othøw, kuna pëënyge geni kiper køny, ni cige baŋ jøøa näk rege da juu mo cøøra jwïëc jøøa no othøw nee ge mooc ka acaara.
english: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ge poot cïba cer nyeya mo raac, ni tïŋŋa maal bäätge ki nyeya mo teek mo wïnni.» Manøgø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba pïï mo Naam Nail tal, pïï moe dwön ni talge.
english: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

anywaa: Näm moa koony jiyi oŋwääi no okwäk, ni ö nyeŋ näm mo Ijep ni decge ni talge; ni ö otöök ki lumme moa en deŋge ni kwäkge.
english: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

anywaa: Luum mana no otuy ki bäät Naam Nail ki deŋŋe, ki jammi bëët moa no opiidhø bäät Naam Nail tal, ni køøli ya jame, ni tïmge ni bäŋgø.
english: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø dïbïth rec mo Naam Nail geno kïmmi; jiy bëët mo wø bïdhö ko obïïdhi cwïnyge opädhi, ni ö jiyi mo wø bïdhö ka ajääpi mo wø leeŋ ni dwatge.
english: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø biith waac jaath wø cwøl ni telba, ki jø wø cwääö ka abïïk lïïna mo tar, nyeŋge otïmö ni law.
english: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

anywaa: Jø wø cwääö ka abïïe, bäätge opädhi, ni ö jø wø tïïö bëët ni ge di cunnö ni kïmge.
english: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri mo Dhöän gena bøøre døc. Jiy moa wïthge leer ni wø cïpi ka acaare jï Peerø gena tïmö ni ge cïpa acaare mo reyø. Nyie jaay, kee uuna köö jï Peerø na bëëde, ni «Waana nyïïkwaac jøøa wïthge leer, ni kwäcwa beege nyeye moa dïkwøŋ.»
english: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

anywaa: Ï na Peerø! ?Age jiyï moa wïthge leer? Beerra man ŋäcge ränynyö mar Ijep mana no ocïp Wuuö Jwøki piny, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni caange gø jïrï.
english: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

anywaa: Kwääri mo Dhöän gena tïïö ki jap bøøl, ni ö kwääri mo Mempic ni maaŋ wïthge; ni ö dïbwöthe mo wïth tuŋi moge na caal kïn gøøt ni bwøthge Ijep ki jöö mo ba thïïŋ.
english: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Memphis are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

anywaa: Wïthge akier Wuuö Jwøki ki jwïëy mo wø cwöth wïc, ni bwøthge Ijep ki jöö mo ba thïïŋ ki yïth tïïe mo gø bëët, ni tïm Ijepi kaamar dhaanhø mo omeer mo bøømmø ni ena yïth ŋwøk moe.
english: The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

anywaa: 'Ba Ijep otïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo løny tïïc jïre, ki mano täge ki wïïe këël jïbe, ki bäädi moe ki bøøge.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, jø Ijep otïmö kaamar mään; dëëtge otïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, noo tuuŋ cere bäätge.
english: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋööm Juuda okänni ki lwär mo dwøŋ døc bäät jø Ijep; kany wø ö ŋat Ijepi noo wïny nyeŋ Juuda jaak, puta  lwäyö døc kiper gïna no ocïp Wuuö Jwøki piny noo tïïe dëëtge, ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, päänye abïïc yi ŋööm Ijep ocäänö ki dhi Keenan, ni kööŋge ki man cääthge køør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët; ni ö acielli dëëtge ni cwøli ni Pääny Cäŋ.
english: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, otïmö ni da gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jï Wuuö Jwøk dï ŋööm Ijep, ni ö waŋ keew mare ni cöönhnhi ki kïdi na nyuudhi jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.

anywaa: Manøgø otïmö na nyuudhi na gïr lïŋ dï ŋööm Ijep kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët; nee kanyo wäro jwöŋ jø Ijepi jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper jø wø caar geni, nee eni wø jääŋ baŋge ki pïëmi na kunyi mo wïïl geni wøk.
english: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dëëre onyoodhe jï jø Ijep, ni ö jø Ijepi ni ŋäcge Wuuö Jwøk dïcäŋeca, ni putge tïmö ni Jwøk lamge ni ge cïpö ko olämme ki muuce, ni ge kööŋ nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni gwøkge japa kööŋge kiperge.
english: And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk Ijep ojääle; geno jääle møn, 'ba ge cäŋe ka kønynyø; ni ö geni ni duuge baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wïny kwac marge ni køny geni.
english: And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be entreated of them, and shall heal them.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, otïmö ni da waŋjöö mo dwøŋ yïthakic Ijep ka Aciria, ni tïm jø Aciria ni ge cøøa Ijep, ni ö jø Ijepi thuwø ni cige ya Aciria, ni tïm jø Ijepi ni ge lämö na aciel ki jø Aciria.
english: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, Icriel otïmö ni dää mïëri kanyo dwäte ki Ijep ka Aciria, ni putge tïmö na mïëri mo gwïëth jø bäät piny ki køørge.
english: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, geno gwïëdhe ni kööe, ni «Gwïëth en jï jø Ijep, ge na jiya, ki jï jø Aciria na tïïa ki cera, ki jï jø Icriel na näk yaa jierø na 'moa.»
english: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiina ö Caargøn nyeny Aciria na jääŋ kwääc lwaa leny mana cwøl ni Tartan yi paana cwøl na Acdöt, ni këëde ki jø paanøgø ni mak gø,
english: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

anywaa: kar kaaca Wuuö Jwøk onø cäänö ki Aydheea wär Amöth ni kööe, ni «Pät keeca wøk mana näk iï dwøl dëërï ni kälï war wøk moa en tietï.» Ni ö Aydheea ni put gïnögø tïïc, ni cäädhe ki dëëre, ni bäŋ war tiete.
english: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Kaawat mana ö dhaanhnha ma Aydheea na bëëde ni cäädhi ka dëëre, ni bäŋ war tiete ki cwiiri adäk, manøgø beeye nyuudhi kiper gïno tägi dëët jø Ijep ki jø Kuuc.
english: And the Lord said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

anywaa: Kiper nyeny Aciria jø Ijep ki jø Kuuc moa näk ee maa ki tøŋ 'okäle ni aae ki geni, ni beege obwöre ki jø døøŋŋø, ni ge käl ni ge cäädhi ka dëëtge ni thääthge ena wøk, ni bäŋ war tietge, ni put tïmö na lään wïc mo dwøŋ døc jï jø Ijep.
english: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët puta lwäyö døc ni lää wïthge kanyo täk gïnögø dëët jø Kuuc na näk ege ŋäädhö, ki dëët jø Ijep na wara ŋwöge kiperge.
english: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jiy mo wø bëëdö mïëc jø Pilitin na en deŋ naama dwøŋ ge köö, ni ‹Neennu, jiy moøgø beege jiy moa wara ŋäädhø na wara reŋŋø baŋge kiper køny, nee ø piemge cer nyeny Aciria. ?'Ba ennø, øøni, øøno bødhø nidïï?› »
english: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper paaba näk tëën na en buut naama dwøŋ bee en: Kaawat man wø ö atuunna wø jwiec paana en jï løø tier-piny, da gïn mo räänyö mo öö ki dï paaba näk tëën, ni beeye yi ŋöömma näk di lwäärö.
english: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

anywaa: Luubö mo teek anyooth jïra ki yi wïïa na ennø nø: Ni ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny poot bëëdö ni tïïya ge,  ni ö dïräänyi ni bëëde ni poot räänyö. Wui, u na jø Ilam ki jø Mëdön, ööu maal ni cou ni cielu Babiløn dïër; Wuuö Jwøk gïïa tïïc jø Babilønni na wëëk jø møøk cooyø otïïe nee cuŋge.
english: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

anywaa: Kanya jooda gïnögø, rääm mo leth aput tägö dëëra, kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri; Aani wïïa ree akiere døc, ni tïme ni tiet luup ba kwanya, ni lwäya døc, ni tiet luup ba jooda.
english: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.

anywaa: Wïïa atïmö ni wïïrö, ni tïm dëëra ni kwanynyi ki lwär, ni ö kar jwöm røk mana ŋäädha ni løk ree na lwär mo dwøŋ bääta.
english: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri mo Babiløn, kar cam ajiiŋge, ni peethge gø, ni cämge, ni mäthge. Ni put dwølli öö, mo köö, «Wui, kwääri mo jø leny, ööu maal ni jiiŋŋu kööt leny!»
english: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ena köö, ni «Ciï ni tïïyï ŋat koor nee cuŋŋe kare, nee gïïo joode nee caane.
english: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö eni noo joot jiy mo cäädhi na ariiø ariiø ki bäät okwëënyi mo lääy, ki mo cäädhi ka bäät arëëni, ki mo cäädhi ka bäät athïrööle, beerra man neen gø ni cek ïthe døøc.»
english: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

anywaa: Køøre ŋat koor acwötö ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal, ni kööe, «Wui kwäärö mara, ki yi cäŋ cooth a bëëdö naa cuŋŋö kar koor mara, ki yïth wärre cooth thuwø, a bëëdö kar koor mara.
english: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, raŋï, jiy mo cäädhi na ariiø ariiø ki bäät okwëënyi mo lääy gena öö; 'ba da dwøl ma akøp, ni ‹Babiløn apädhö! Wui, ena pädhö møn, ni ö kït gïï wø lam na juu moe ni tøyi ni petge yïth ŋøøm!› »
english: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

anywaa: Wui u na jiya ma jø Icriel, u na pïïc gïï mo lethi bäätu, kaamar man wø dïn beel yi laara, gïna wïnynya na caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye na caana jïïu enø.
english: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Duma bee en: Dhaanhø mør cwödö ki Cëër,  ni kööe, ni «?Ŋat koor, a kany mo nyïëdi noo dööŋ kiper wäär? ?A pëënynya ïïni, naa kany mo nyïëdi noo dööŋ kiper wäär?»
english: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya ŋat koorri, ni kööe, ni «Øw ba kääŋi ki man ööe, 'ba poot da wäär mo öö thuwø. 'Ba ni näk miï poot manynya pïëc, wärï cäŋ duuö ni pëëï.»
english: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper Areebia bee en: U na jø Didan, ni wø cäädhi ki bäät athïrööle, ni wø tïïc twïër marge ki wäär yïth abuŋŋe mo Areebia,
english: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.

anywaa: kännu ki pïï jï jøøa no onäk riewi.  U ni bëëdö Tëma, kännu ki cam jï jøøa no obwøk ki leny,
english: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

anywaa: ni beege jøøa ŋwiec thøw opëëllö ka atheerø yi lenya teek.
english: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ki køør cwiir aciel, kaawat man wø ö ŋat tïïci wø kwaan nïr tïïc moe ma kar cwiir aciel, ajiem mar paana cwøl ni Këdar ränynyö na bäre bäre;
english: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

anywaa: ni ö kwään cwøw mo wø këëdi ka athëëre moo bøth ri leny dëët jø Këdar moa teek ni tïmge ni nøk.» Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na Jwø Icriel.
english: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper jøøa bëëdö goor wø nyooth luup yie bee en: «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na tägö rou ennø, ni tïme ni u bëët, u puta eth wïth uudi maal en?
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

anywaa: Wui, ï na pääny mo yie päŋ ki dïlweel, ni kwöŋŋö ki met ec dwøŋ yie en! Jiy moï moa thøw, ba thøw ni ge 'näk ko opëëllö, ni ge ba thøwa ri leny.
english: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

anywaa: Cuumme moï bëët anø bwøk na aciel, ni nø mak geni ki tøŋ ni bäŋ leny. Jiy moï bëët moa joot, amak ki tøŋ ni käl geni ni geno twöö ge bëët, këël na bëëtge ni geno bwøk ni geno nø reŋ kany mo bäär.»
english: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø aana köö, ni «Paanynyu nyeŋŋu dëëra. Weyu aani naa jwöŋa naa keeya yia. Kär pääru ki man cømmu cwïnya kiper ränynyö mana pïï dëët jø powa.»
english: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

anywaa: Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, da dïcäŋ ma mar böök mo dwøŋ døc, ka adïma, ko okiera, mo ee cïp piny nee täge yi goor wø nyooth luup yie. Ni beeye cäŋ mo kiiri nyaa piny yie, no oduuru jwøa baŋ kïte.
english: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

anywaa: Jø Ilam jap leny alwørge, ni jiiŋge jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi; ni ö jø paana cwøl ni Kir ni lwørge kööde mo leny moge.
english: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

anywaa: Køøre, gøli mou moa perge leth apäŋ ki jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni ö jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi ni cïïmge rege dhøk kiir kwöra perge leth.
english: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk gïn wø gwøk jø Juuda apaanye bäätge. 'Ba dïcäŋeca, uuna göök ri jap leny moa en yi øda cwøl ni øt Lur Libaanø.
english: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni kwöra ŋammø ri kiir Pääny Deebit ajootu, ni cooŋŋu pïï mo puul mana en jï piny.
english: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

anywaa: Køøre uudi mo Jerucalem akwaannu, ni nyaau uudi møøk piny nee kiir tïïyu ni teek ki geni.
english: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna tïïö ki kany cooŋ pïï yie yïthakic kiir mana näk ogeerø na ariiø kiper pï puul mana no oruuö. 'Ba uuni u kär göök ri Jwøk na tïïc gø, ni käru göök ree, eni na caar gø dïkwøŋ kany mo bäär.
english: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, dïcäŋeca, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, uuna cwøle nou jwöŋu nou gööu ko oduuru,  nee wïthu gwääru wøk, ni dwølu keece dëëtu kiper pänh cwïny maru.
english: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

anywaa: 'Ba neennu, gïna tïïyu, maru atïmö na kanynyø ni yïthu met, nou cööbö ki dhäk ni ŋädu ki dïëk, ni cämu ki rïŋ ni mädhu ki kwøk nyïïomøki, ni kööu, ni «Cämø ni mädhø nø, kiper kanymør ø thøw diøø.»
english: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ree anyoodhe jïra ni kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, raay moa tïïyu, u ba wëënni ki geni këël mano thøwu.» Manøgø beeye dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Ö maal ni ciï baŋ Cebna manøgø na no orøønyø na kare dwøŋ bäät paan dwøŋ, ni kööï jïre,
english: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,

anywaa: «na ‹?Aŋø, da teek jïrï kany? ?Da tuuŋu kany, ni tïme ni bwörö marï iï jiiŋŋø kany en, ni iï tïïö kany mo ena maal, ni iï tieŋø yi kïdi na kar jwöm røk jïrï?
english: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

anywaa: « ‹Neenï, Wuuö Jwøk oløny ni leeŋa ïïni wøk, ï na teek. Eni, ï di maaø ni teek,
english: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.

anywaa: ni loom ïïni kaamar kuura, ni leeŋ ïïni wøk, ni päthï yi ŋöömö mo yie dwøŋ, ni putï thøø kaace, ni ö jïëth okwëënyi moï moa mïërö ni dööŋge wøk kaace, wui, ï na käl lään wïc bäät jø po kwäärö marï!›
english: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.

anywaa: «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ‹Aani, ï käla wøk ki bäät kwär marï, ni rïëma ï wøk ki bäät køøm marï.
english: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïcäŋeca, dhaanhnha ma Eliekim o Kilkiya ocwøla,
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

anywaa: ni røøa abïï kwär marï dëëre, ni twöa kaw marï piere, ni puta teek kwär marï bäre cïp jïre, ni ö eni ni put tïmö na wää jiy mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dhi øt Juuda.
english: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

anywaa: Køøre aani, kulpïï mar dhi øt Deebit cïba cere, ni tïm teeki ni ena jïre, ni kany wø jap dhøk uudi, bäŋ ŋat mo cïëga ge, ni kany wø cïëk ge bäŋ ŋat mo japa ge.
english: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

anywaa: Eni tïïa tïïö ni teek kaamar jaath mo orääö dëër øtø ni teek kany mo oŋäädhö, ni tïme na wälu mar ajiem jï dhi øt wänni.
english: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre ajiem mar dhi øt wänni bäre, ko obwöre moge, ki nyïïkwaacge, okuut dëëre, kaawat man wø lïër jap tïïc mo paac moa thenh thenh dëër jaath, teeŋ ka cäänne ki wïlle bëët.› »
english: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, mare acaane, ni kööe, «Dïcäŋeca, jaath mana no orääö ni teek kanya no oŋäädhö tïmö ni lwäägö, ni toore ni pädhe, ni ö gïïa no olïër dëëre bëët ni ränyge.» Kiper eni na Wuuö Jwøk mare ee nø caan.
english: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper Tayar bee en: Wui, baabuure mo gath mo jø Tarcëc, gööu ko oduuru! Kiper Tayar araanynyi ni bäŋ øtø mo odööŋ wala kany wø maa baabuure yie; ni ö luum ränynyö mare ni wïnye yi ŋööm Caypara.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Tayar ki jø Caydan, u na jø gath, ni wø bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ, kïmmu! Uuna jäägö ki jiy ni ŋølge naama dwøŋ,
english: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

anywaa: ni pïïcge Ijep. Ni ö caammi moa ciek deŋ Naam Ciör,  ki moa ciek deŋ Naam Nail ni duunge ki jammi jïïu, ni tïm mïëri mou na kar gath jï wïth juurre.
english: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Caydan, wïïï wär lääe, ï na paana teek na en bäät naama dwøŋ. Kiper naama dwøŋ aköö jïrï, «Aana tïmö kaamar dhaagø mo lwaar kuue mo mäc lwaar kuue, mo kär pïïdhö ko obwöc cwøw wala obwöc mään.»
english: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö luummögø noo wïnye Ijep, cwïny jø Ijep pädhö døc kiper ränynyö mar Tayar.
english: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

anywaa: Wui, u ni bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ en, gööu ko oduuru, ni bwøgu ni pööthu Tarcëc, paana bäär.
english: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, man beeye pääny maru møn, na päŋ ki met ec, päänya no oruuö na käl ya acääŋŋe, na wara ci jiye mïëri mo kwörge bäyö baŋ gath?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

anywaa: ?Aŋa na ŋøl gïn bäät Tayar, paana cïp kwär, na näk jø gath moe kwääri ni geno wøørø ki bäät piny?
english: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

anywaa: Beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na ŋøl gïnögø bäät gø, ni lää wï gø, ni raany japa mïërö bëët na tööde kiperge, ni tïïc jic gø bëët moa no owøørø nee taak bäät piny.
english: The Lord of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

anywaa: Wui, jø Tarcëc, pöödhu ki dï ŋöömö maru kaamar jwïïö mar Naam Nail; kiper bäŋ gïn mo män uuni këët.
english: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk cere atïŋ maal bäät naama dwøŋ, ni tïïc buc nyeye mo wø bëëdö bäät gø ni jäŋŋi, ni cïpe ki dwøl ki man raany kwör gwøk røk mo Keenan.
english: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Wui, jø Caydan, uuna thiel piny; yïthu ba mïnni këët. Ööu maal ni bwøgu løøga Caypara; 'ba këël noo pïïyu yie thuwø, u ba jïti ki jwöm.»
english: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Kittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

anywaa: Wui jø Tayar, raŋŋu ŋööm jø Babiløn, jøøa dööŋ ni bäŋ kwäänge. Jø Aciria jöör leny man døny yi kiir ki gø ageerge, ni nyaage uut paan dwøŋ piny, ni raanyge gø na bäre, ni tïïcge gø nee dööŋe jï lääc paap.
english: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.

anywaa: Wui, jïëth naam mo jø Tarcëc, gööu ko oduuru, kiper päänya teek na ŋääthu araanynyi.
english: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mano täge dïcäŋeca, wïc wïl ki Tayar ki cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø, ni beege cwiiri mo röömi ki nïr nyeya. 'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun cwiiyøgø na pïërabïriiø yøø, gïn mør otägi kiper Tayar, mo caala gïna caan yi duuda cak kiper dhaaŋŋa bëëdö na kääbi, na køp,
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

anywaa: ni «Kwany thoom marï ni wïri dï pääny, wui, ï na dhaaŋŋa bëëdö na kääbi, na näk wïc owïl ki gø; pwöt thoom ni tøøtï tøøtø, ni wärï ki dudi mo thööth, nee wïc cäŋ parrø ki ïïni.»
english: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, kanyo tïme na aŋuun cwiiyøgø na pïërabïriiø yøø, Wuuö Jwøk Tayar oliimme. Kanyøgø Tayar odøø ri gath ki wïth juurre bëët mo mïëc piny, kaamar dhaagø ma kääbi mo gatha dëëre.
english: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moo joode ki køør gath mare ocïp kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba jammi moøgø ba kan wala ba cïp piny ki man mëët bäätge;  'ba owëëk jiy mo wø bëëdö ni wøøra Wuuö Jwøk, nee tïmge na mo ŋeewge ki caammi mo orømø kiper dëëtge ka abïïga beyø.
english: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, Wuuö Jwøk piny jale jalø ni raany gø; ni wëëk gø niruuth, ni keeth jiy mo wø bëëdö yie.
english: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö ränynyö mano tägi ni tïme ni rwöpa jiy bëët, ni tïm dïlämi ni röömi ki dhaanhø jaak, ni tïm kwäärö ni röömi ki laŋŋø, ni tïm dhaagø man wø tïnynyi ni röömi ki dhaaŋ wø tïny gø, ni tïm ŋat gathi ni röömi ki ŋat ŋïëw, ni tïm ŋat wø määö baŋe ki jammi ni röömi ki ŋat wø mäyi, ni tïm ŋat wø cunni ki gwel ni da wïthge ni röömi ki ŋat wø cun gø.
english: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

anywaa: Piny niruuth bäre ni dööŋe keere, kiper luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.

anywaa: Piny 'otal kaamar bøøk jaath, ni tïme ni kïmmö. Eno tal ni kïmme ki jiy bëët moa kwörge døøŋŋø mo wø bëëdö yie.
english: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

anywaa: Piny atïïc jiyi ni ba waany, kiper jiy akweer ki man cääthge ki køør ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ni kärge luup moe gwøø, ni ö luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki nee bëëde na bäre bäre ni raanyge gø.
english: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, piny aränynyö ki køør acïën Jwøk, ni ö jø wø bëëdö bäät piny ni rømge ka ajäla manøgø. Geno thöör ajäle mo leth, ni tïme ni dööŋŋa jiy mo nøk.
english: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

anywaa: 'Ba jer omøki 'otal, ni ö kwøk nyïïomøki ni tïme ni bäŋgø, ni ö jøøa bëëdö ni yïthge met bëët ni tïmge ni ge cooyø.
english: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

anywaa: Dööt anëët olïŋi, ni ö dööt jøøa cwïnyge päŋ ki met ec ni nigekïïl, ni ö dööt thøme moa met ni nigebäc.
english: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

anywaa: Jiy ba wär ki dudi këët bäät kwøŋ; kwøga keec otïmö ni raac ki dhøk jø omaath ge.
english: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

anywaa: Päänya no oränynyö otoor piny, ni ö jøøa dööŋ yie ni dëëtge uudi bäätge kiper jiy mo dønynya baŋge.
english: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

anywaa: Ni bëët jiyi ni ge jwöŋö nyeŋ jïëthe ki cwaak køøŋø; ni ö met eci bäre ni løk ree na pänh cwïny. Met ec mar bäät piny oränynyi.
english: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

anywaa: Päänyögø oränynyi ni dööŋe keere, ni ö dhøk odhuule mo kiir mare ni bëëtge no otøyø piny jaak.
english: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

anywaa: Gïnögø tägö bäät piny dëët wïth juurre, kaawat man wø bëëde ni nyïï jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw diema piny ri kac, ni tïme ni dööŋŋa mo nøk; ni caala nyïïomøki mo nøk mo wø bøth ri kac.
english: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ, döötge otïŋge maal, ni kwöŋge ki met ec. Geno kwöŋŋi ki jï løø kur pänhcäŋ kiper dööŋö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u ni en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö uuni ni en bäät naama dwøŋ ni tïŋu nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk maal, eni na Jwø Icriel.
english: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, dudi owïnynyø bäät piny bäre, mo köö, na «Ajiem en jï Jwøa beer.» 'Ba aani, aana köö, «Otïmö ni leth jïra! Otïmö ni leth jïra møn! Aana ränynyö! Jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny, ge poot bëëdö ni ge tïïya gïï mo reyø; ni ge bëëdö ni ge cäätha maal ki tïï gïï mo reyø.»
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

anywaa: Wui, u jø bäät piny, gïï mo di lwäärö, ki buur mo bäär, ka abïëp ena nyïmmu.
english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

anywaa: Ŋato reŋi ni ŋwieya waac gïïa leth, pätha yi buura bäär, 'ba ŋato päny wøk ki yi buura bäär omak abïëpi; kiper awëërnyeŋŋi mo maal di jabø, ni ö pinynyi ni jäŋi.
english: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

anywaa: Piny kaaŋŋø ni tïme na thäŋi, ni puti jäŋ døc.
english: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

anywaa: Ni tïm pinynyi ni bøømmø kaamar dhaanhø mo omeer, ni tïme ni jäŋŋi kaamar abïla, kiper raay moe na peek bääte, ni pädhe ni ba løny ki ööny maal këët.
english: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

anywaa: Dïcäŋeca, Wuuö Jwøk gïïa jïge da teek maalø jääle jäälö kwöra enge yïthge maal, ni jääl nyeye mo piny bäät piny.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

anywaa: Geno cooŋ kanya ciel, kaamar jø tööc mo otwöö yi buur. Geno twöc, ni cïëk geni øt twöc ki kany mo yie bäär; køøre ge di jäälö ka ajäla mana dwøŋ.
english: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

anywaa: Køøre dwääy wïïe olääi, ni ö cäŋŋi ni tïm waŋe ni law, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, obëëdö na nyeya bäät Kïn Dhayan yi Jerucalem, ni ö ajiemmi mare ni nëëne jï dïbwöthe mo jiye.
english: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna Jwøk mara, nyeŋŋï tïŋa maal, ni pwøa nyeŋŋï; kiper ïïna tïïö ki gïï mo rëëma ec, ni beege japa caarï ya acääŋŋe na wëëgï tïïc na karge.
english: O Lord, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

anywaa: Päänye araanynyï ni tïïyï ge na wïthur, ni wëëgï päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek ränynyö; ni ö mïëc juurre moa no ogeerø ni beyø ni tïmge ni bäŋgø, ni ge ba cäŋ geerrø këët na bäre bäre.
english: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wïth juurre moa teek ïïno jiemge; ni ö päänye mo wïth juurre moa no ogäy ni lwäcge ki ïïni.
english: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

anywaa: Kiper ïïna ŋat wø gwøk jiy moa näk bäŋ jø køny ge, ki jøøa can ni wø bëëdö ki bëëtö mo leth, ni bee ï ŋat wø gwøk dhaanhø ki gïï mo caala atuunna, ni ïïna tïpö kiper lïëth piny; kiper jam dhøk mar jøøa no ogäy caala atuunna man wø kwöt dëër kiir,
english: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

anywaa: ni caala lïëth piny man wø en dïtëën. Dïlweel mar wïth juurre wø wëëgï nibäc, kaaman wø ö lïëth pinynyi oŋïnynye ki tïm pøøl, ni ö dööt jøøa no ogäy ni wø wär ki dudi ni put nikïïl.
english: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, tïïö ka atïya bäät kïdi man jï wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny; 'ba atïya mano tïïe beeye køøŋ nyïïomøki mo met, ki rïŋ mo lääy mo cuu moge päŋ ki mädhi, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mana luy na met.
english: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät kïdi man, eni na Wuuö Jwøk gïna leth na näk jiy bëët ee rïëbö, na bëëdö ni ree ee peerø bäät wïth juurre bëët, wääre wøk bäät jiy.
english: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk thøø raanynye raanynyø na bäre, ni pooc pï nyeŋ jiy bëët, ni ö eni ni käl lään wïc wøk bäät jiye moa en bäät piny bäre; kiper luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca, jiy oköö, «Raŋŋu, man beeye Jwøk marø mana koorø nee ø pieme. Man beeye Wuuö Jwøk mana koorø; beerra man kanynyø ni mïn yïthø ki pïëm mare mana piem øøni ki gø.»
english: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk cere ocïp bäät kïdi man, 'ba jø Möap onyøri kar bëëtö marge, kaaman wø nyør wär mo ojääbö ki juu ki pïï.
english: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

anywaa: Ceŋge opeerge yi gø, kaamar ŋat kwaaŋ kany wø peer ceŋŋe kiper kwaaŋ. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk atöör marge dwøge piny ki japa reyø bëët na tïïcge ki ceŋge.
english: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

anywaa: Kiiri moge moa no ogeerø ni bäyö onyaa Wuuö Jwøki piny, ni wëëk ge niruuth yïth ŋøøm, këël mano gääpge ki tør.
english: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca duut man di wärö yi ŋööm Juuda, na ennø nø: Waani, jïwa da pääny mo teek, kiper Jwøk waana mooe ki kiir mo teek mo piema waani.
english: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.

anywaa: Japu dhøk kiir nee wï jur mana mare beer nee døny yie, ni beeye wï jur man wø bëëdö ni gwøga ŋäädhe mare.
english: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋat wø bëëdö ni cwïnye ee maa dëërï, mooyï mooø ki jwöm ki yi cwïnye, kiper eni bëëdö ni ŋäätha ïïni.
english: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

anywaa: Bëëdu nou ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre, kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye kïn gwøk røk mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength:

anywaa: Kiper eni jø wø bëëdö ni rege ege tïŋ maal dwøge piny, ni raany pääny marge na näk ogeerø ni teek. Pääny marge raanynye raanynyø møn, ni put tïmö na tør,
english: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

anywaa: ni puti ya jøøa canni nyørø ki tietge, ni ö jøøa no othiel piny ni cuŋge bääte.
english: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

anywaa: Jøøa marge beer, øtjöörge tiir. 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï na marï adïëri, tïïc øtjöör jøøa marge beer ni pøøth ni ba gwalli.
english: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, wa raŋŋa jïrï, ni wa bëëdö ni wa caatha køør ŋøl luup marï, ni wa manynya man jiemwa nyeŋŋï ki cwïnywa bäre.
english: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

anywaa: Cwïnya bëëdö ni lääŋŋa ïïni ki wärre bëët, ni ö jwïëya ni bëëde ni manynya ïïni døc. Kiper ŋøl marï na näk adïëri kanyo ö bäät piny, jø bäät piny ge kwänynyö ki bëët adïëri.
english: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

anywaa: Këël na bëëdï niï nyøtha mëër marï jï jøøa reyø, jöör adïëri poot ba kwanyge. Ge poot bëëdö ni ge temma gïï mo reyø po jøøa marge thïïŋ, ni bäŋ gïn caarge kiper dööŋö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cerï atïŋï maal ni kärge gø joodø. Nyooth këëyö marï jïge kiper jiyï, ni wëëgï ge lään wïc. Wui, beerra man ö maaci ni thöör nyïïmän moï.
english: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bëët-mëër wø cïpa ïïni jïwa; ni tïïe mowa bëët thur karge ka køør køny marï man wø tïïyï jïwa.
english: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, waana bëëdö ni wa käära kwääri møøk mo patha ïïni, 'ba beeye ïïni keerï ni wø nyeŋŋï wøørwa.
english: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena thøw, ni ge ba kwøw këët, ni jwïëcge ba duu maal këët! Kiper gena jäälï ni dïïrï wïthge, ni tïïyï ge nee wïc ba par ki geni këët na bäre bäre.
english: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wï jur marwa ameetï, wï jur marwa ameetï møn, ni nyaayï nyeŋ kee mowa bëët, ni jït nyeŋŋï ka ajiem ki køøre.
english: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jiy moï kanya enge yïth gïï mo leth, ïïna manyge, ni lämge ni ge muuŋö, kanya bëët ajäla marï bäätge.
english: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

anywaa: Bëëtö marwa nyïmï atïmö kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri, mo jwöŋö ni ree døøye døøyø ki rääm kanyo tïm kar lwaarri ni cään.
english: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.

anywaa: Waana bëëdö ni wa cooyø ki rääm mo keda mäc lwaar, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo oduu cooyø marwa, ni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo ewa tïïö kiper piny, ni jø bäät piny kär jïtö ki kwøw ki køørwa.
english: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

anywaa: Jiy moï moa thøw geno cäŋ kwøwø, ni ö rïŋ dëëtge ni cäŋge ö maal. Wui, u na näk obutö yïth bwör, päyu ni ööu maal ni kwöŋŋu ki met ec. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk jiy moa no othøw wëëge kwøw, kaa man wø ö thööy wø jwøc bäät piny ka amöölla.
english: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

anywaa: U na jiya, dønynyu yïth uudi mou, ni cïëgu dhøk odhuule mou bäätu, ni kannu dëëtu ki kany mo thiinh, këël kanyo ö wëëc Wuuö Jwøki noo pöödhe.
english: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk öö ki maal kar bëëtö mare, ni ö piny kuna jääl jiy moa en bäät piny kiper raay moa tïïcge. Ni ö rem jiy moa no okøny piny no okanø ni nëëne, ni ba løny këët ki man ö ŋøømmi ni kan jiy moa no onääö.
english: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk thwöl man wø rïïŋi døc ni wø cwøl ni Lëëwatan, ni beeye thwör wø bëëdö ni dëëre di meennø, di jäälö ko opëëllö mare na beth na dwøŋ na teek. Eni thwörögø na dwøŋ enø ni wø bëëdö yi naama dwøŋ di nääö.
english: In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca da duut mo di wärö na ennø, «Wärru ki duut kiper pwöth jer omøki moa no onywøl.
english: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

anywaa: Aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye noo gwøk gø. Aani, a bëëdö naa jøøya gø ki pïï cooth. Aani, a bëëdö naa koora gø ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär, nee bäŋe ŋat mo raanynya gø.
english: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

anywaa: Aani, a ba wëër ki gø këët. 'Ba ni näk mo da ŋat mo känna bääta ko otwel ki koodhi ni mare leny, aani, ge nyøøna piny ni puta ge waaŋ na bäre bäre.
english: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

anywaa: 'Ba mana beerra eni, beeye ki man ö eni ni bëëde ri göök mara. Beerra man ö eni ni tïïc bëëtmëër ki aani, ni wëëk bëët-mëër manøgø bëëtö yïthakicwa ki eni.»
english: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na yïth nïrögø, Jeekap tiere okëët piny kaamar jaath mo lweete okëët piny, ni ö eni na Icriel ni lødhe, ni ŋøøe, ni ŋweele, ni pääŋ bäät piny bäre ki nyïëdi.
english: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk jiye ajääle na bëëde, kaawat mana jääl nyïïmän moge? Wala jiye ma jø Icriel anääe na bëëde, ka teeŋ mana 'näk nyïïmän moge?
english: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

anywaa: 'Ba ajäla mana tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, atïïe ni ee rømø kiper jø Icriel, ni cöör ge wøk kaawat man wø tïïc apwøyaweerø man wø kwönni ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïnögø otïmö na jöö man wëën bääyö mar Jeekap ki gø; ni gïno duu wëën raay manøgø beeye kanyo ö eni noo raany kïte mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ni tïïc ge kaamar tør mar kïn booya; ni beeye kanyo ö jenni moa näk ege tieŋø na no ocaa ri jwøa cwøl na Acara, ki gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge noo tïmge ni bäŋgø mo cuŋŋi këët.
english: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

anywaa: Kiper pääny mana no ogeerø ni teek adööŋ keere ni ba beet, ni wïl wïci ki gø, ni tïme kaamar dï paap, ni ö nyïïrøøe ni bëëtge ni ge cämö ki luum yie kaace, ni butge piny yie, ni camge bäät jenni moa en yie.
english: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tal bäädi moøgø, ge di tøyø, ni ö määnni ni møøtge ge na jer maac. Kiper jiy moøgø paa jiy mo wïnyö ki luup. Kiper manøgønø, ŋata tïïc geni na jiy, cwïnye ba ware ki geni; ŋata cwääc geni, cwïnye ba cïp piny ki geni.
english: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, Wuuö Jwøk tägö ka ajäla mare kaawat man wø dïn beel, ni tägi ka Naam Upareeti këël mano pïïe waŋ naam mar Ijep. Wui, jø Icriel, uuno cäŋ cooŋ kanya ciel, nou käli na aciel aciel.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

anywaa: Noo time  na dïcäŋeca thuwø, tuuŋ di koodhø ni dwøre ena maal døc, ni ö jiyi moa no orwäänyö yi ŋööm Aciria, ki moa no okeethø yi ŋööm Ijep, ni öge ni wøørge Wuuö Jwøk bäät kïnna en kur keere yi Jerucalem.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï Cameria, päänya näk caala adun atöör mar jø Ipariem na näk jø meerø, päänya näk ajiem mïërö mare caala wï jaath mo oŋøøk ni manynya närö, na näk ogeer bäät thuur buut gool mana ŋöömme beer na näk mar jøøa no oŋääö ki maath.
english: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

anywaa: Raŋŋu, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk jïre da ŋat mo dwøŋ mo teek, mo caala køth mo ree da pey ka atuunna man wø räänyö, mo caala athaga mo teek mar naam mo pänhnhö; eni wï pääny Cameria thiele piny ki cere yïth ŋøøm.
english: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

anywaa: Adun atöör mar jø meerø mo Ipariem nyøre nyørø ki tiete,
english: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

anywaa: ni ö ajiem mïërö mare na caal wï jaath mo oŋøøk ni manynya närö, na kïth bäät thuura en buut goora näk ŋöömme beer, ni tïme kaamar nyo olaam man wø ciek ni cwiir poodi, ni jooti ya dhaanhe ni lwør gø ni laar gø cam.
english: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋeca Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, otïmö ni beeye aduda mana mïërö, na adun ajiem kiper jiye moa dööŋ ni kwøw.
english: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

anywaa: Eno tïmö ni ena jwïëy man wø cïp ŋøl luup ma adïëri jï jø wø en ŋøl luupi ceŋge, ni tïme ni ena teek jï jø wø dwøk jø leny wøk ki dhi kiir.
english: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

anywaa: 'Ba këël nyikuk Jwøk ki dïlämme, ge mädhö ki kwøŋ mo keec, ni cääthge ni ge näännö ni ge bøømmø ki meerø. Ge bëëdö ni wïthge ocwöth køøŋe, ni ge cäädhi ni ge bøømmø kany wø mäthge ki kwøga keec. Ge bëëdö ni ge näännö ki meerø kany wø nyuunh geni ki luup, ni tïmge ni ge bääö ni luup ba ŋølge na adïëri.
english: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

anywaa: Bäät tharabëëte moge bëët bëëdö ni päŋ ki ŋwøk, ni bäŋ kany mo tøŋ.
english: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.

anywaa: Ge cäänö, na «?Aŋa noo pwönynye ki leec wïc? ?Luumme ocaan gø jï ŋa? ?'Ba tiirra obwöre moa no omänö ki caak na näk thunh ege wiiø?
english: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.

anywaa: Kiper pwöc moe köö, ‹Tïïyu gïn, ni tïïyu gïn, gwøgu ciik man ki ciik man, nyi luubö mo thiinh en, maya ice.› »
english: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:

anywaa: 'Ba wøp nø, Jwøk jøøi poot cäänne cäännö ki dhøk jiy mo path ki dhøk juurre.
english: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

anywaa: Kiper eno kwøŋ köö jïge, ni «Jwöm en; beerra man ö jiyi moa no oööl ni jïtge ki jwöm;» ni kööe, ni «Kar jwöm bee en,» 'ba gena kweer.
english: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk mano caane kiperge otïmö ni bee en,  «Tïïyu gïn, ni tïïyu gïn, gwøgu ciik man, ki ciik man; nyi luubö mo thiinh en, maya ice.» Kanyøgø geno aay, ni päänhge no otaare, ni tøcge, ni päthge ya abïëp, ni mak geni ki tøŋ.
english: But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u na jø abuua, ni wø käär jøøi ni en yi Jerucalem en, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk!
english: Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kiper uuna köö, ni «Waana nø tudö ki luubö ki thøø, nee wa ba gude, ni nø tutwa ki luubö ki kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, nee wa ba ciwa yie; këël jwïïö man wø räänyö ocur bäätwa, wa ba gude. Kiper tööt ewa nø tïïc ni beeye gïn gwøk waani, ni nø tïïcwa gø ni beeye kany kanwa dëëtwa yie.»
english: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Raŋŋu, aani a kïtha yi Dhayan ki kïdi, ni beeye kïdi mo onø päänynyö, kïnna pere leth na näk kïn gøøt, na näk ocwöth piny ni teek. 'Ba ŋato jïëc gøøni, wïïe ree ba kiere.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøl mana na adïëri otïïa ni caala thøøl man wø røm tiir mar øtø ki gø, ni tïïa bëënynyö ni caala thøøl man wø røm tiir mar dëër øtø ki gø. Køøre pey opänhnhi ni raany tööt mana gwøk uuni, ni kwön jwïïe ni raany kwöra kanu dëëtu yïthge.
english: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana tuutu ki thøø nou ba gude oraanynyi, ni ö luubö mana tuutu ki kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni ba thur kare; kany wø ö jwïïö man wø räänyö noo kwön bäätu, uuno raanynye.
english: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

anywaa: Cooth kany wø kwönne, uuno køøle, kiper mano bëëde ni kwönna bäätu cooth ki yïth caae bëët, amöölla ki waŋcäŋ ki wäär.» 'Ba kanyo kwany tier luummögø, okänni ki lwär mo dwøŋ.
english: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

anywaa: Uuno tïmö kaamar dhaanhø mo obut bäät pëëm mo ciek døc ni ba løny ki man rwiec tiete yie, mo dïmalïïcu mare thiinh døc ni ba løny ki man uum dëëre bäre.
english: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ööa maal bäätu kaawat mana tïïe bäät Kïn Peradhim; eni wëër kaawat mana tïïe yi goor Gibien; ni ööe ni tïïe ki gïn mo kär dïëdö, ni beeye gïn mo nyään mo kär kwøŋ tïïc.
english: For the Lord shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, weyu abuua maru. 'Ba ni näk mo ba weyu, oguudi cäŋ ka methø døc tietu. Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, da gïn mo yaa wïnynyö baŋe mo ee nø cïp piny, ki man raany piny bäre.
english: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord God of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

anywaa: Cegu ïthu ni wïnynyu dwøra; cegu ïthu ni wïnynyu luup 'moa.
english: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ŋat puur wø bëëdö ni tïïya tïï puur keere ni ba pïïdhö?  ?Aŋø, eni 'bëëdö ni kuga ŋøøm cooth ni jaalla ge jaak?
english: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

anywaa: ?Eni ŋøøp pwödhö bäŋ wø jiiŋŋe na karge, ni pïïdhe ki teeŋ jer wø ŋwääi ni met, ni piith cïndë na laany? ?Kaagø thuwø bäŋ wø pïïnhnhe ki beek wø cwøl ni gäbci,  ki man wø cwøl na aja kwöra näk orømø kiperge?
english: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

anywaa: Kiper beeye Jwøk mare na nyuunh gø na pwöny gø ki jöö mana beer.
english: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.

anywaa: Eni teeŋ jer wø ŋwääi ni met, nyïï gø ba dïne ka abaya, wala gïr dïn man wø tut dhäki; 'ba teeŋ nyïï jerøgø wø dïne ka thiir.
english: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

anywaa: Beel mo wø cam na kwön wø di wälö, ni dhaanhø ba bëëdö cooth ni mare dïn keere jaak. 'Ba eni këël wø dïn beel ki gïr dïn mare, okweeny mare beel ba raanynye.
english: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ŋata näk acaara mare rëëma ec, ni leec wïc mare dwøŋ.
english: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jïrï, ï na Ariël,  ï na päänya tïïc Deebiti na kar bëëtö mare. Mëëtï ki cwiir bäät cwiir mør, ni ö nïne mo ajwöm moï ni bëëtge ni nut karge.
english: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Ariël, ï wëëga jwør gïï mo leth, ni wëëga ïïni kïmmö ko oduuru, ni tïmï kaamar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mo ogääbö ki remø.
english: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

anywaa: Aani a tïïö ki twïër deŋŋï bäre, ni tïïa ki kwör mo othørø kiper leny, ni wïra deŋŋï ki uut koor mo ogeerø ni ena maal.
english: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï dwøga piny, ni tïm cäänö marï ni ö wøk ka yïth ŋøøm; dwørï ööa wøk ki yi tør, ni tïm dwørï ni ö wøk ka yïth ŋøøm kaamar dwør jwïëc dhaanhø mo othøw, ni ö cäänö marï ni tïme ni wïnyi ni muuŋö ki yi tør.
english: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

anywaa: Nyïïmän moï na thööth ge twäät kaamar tør, ni ö jøøa no ogäy ni tïmge kaamar lethø mo okøøl jamø. 'Ba gïnögø otägi dëëtge ni cwöba røkge.
english: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, oööi ni cwöba røk, ni jääl ïïni ki køth mo märö, ki dïjäŋ piny, ki dwøl mo löörö, ka atuunna, ki køth mo ree da atuunna, ki maac mo räänyö.
english: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaak mana käl røk wïth juurre bëët na këëdö ka Ariël, na raany kwör gwøk røk moe, na ciel gø dïër, ge rwäänyö kaamar lääk, kaamar gïn wø nyooth ki yi wïc ki wäär.
english: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe mo ree da käc oläge ki wäär kee eni cämö, 'ba noo pääe, käc poot nut dëëre; wala kany wø läk dhaanhe mo onäk riewi  kee eno mäthö ki pïï, 'ba noo pääe, cwaage poot no otal, ni riew kär aay dëëre; lwaak thuwø mana käl røk wïth juurre, ni wø many leny ki jø Dhayan, otïmö na ennø nø.
english: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

anywaa: Bëëdu ni uuno bwøk, ni yïthu othäŋŋö, tïmu ni uuna cööye nou ba nëënö, bëëdu ni uuno meer, ni paa ki køøŋø, bëëdu nou bøømmø, 'ba maru patha meerø ki køøŋø.
english: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk akän bäätu ki jwïëc niine mo thööth, ni wëëk nyeŋŋu nijïïm, u na nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni cïëk wïthu, u na jø wø joot jammi ki køør man wø nyooth Jwøki jïïu.
english: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

anywaa: Ni tïm luupi bëët mo wø nyooth ki yi wïc ni caala luup mo ena yi wëëlö mo dhee omwönö; këël wëëllögø doo wëëga ŋat mo ŋäc kwäänö ni købi jïre, ni «Kwaan gïn,» eno köö, ni «Ba løny kwaan jïra, kiper omwönö.»
english: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:

anywaa: Wala këël wëëllögø doo cïbö jï dhaanhø mo kwäänö kuue thuwø, ni købi jïre, ni «Kwaan gïn,» eno köö, ni «Kwäänö ba løny jïra.»
english: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jøøi ii, gena ö kany mo cään ki aani ki dhøkge jaak, naa wøørge ka lëëpge, 'ba cwïnyge karge bäär ki aani, ni jöör lam marge tïïcge ka køør ciik moa tïïc jiyi.
english: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a cäŋa tïïö ki gïn mør mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø dëët jøøgø, ni beeye gïn mo rëëma ec mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø møn. Leec wïc mar jøøa wïthge leer wëëga ränynyö, ni ö jø wø laar tiet jammi joot ni tïmge ni tiet jammi ba kwanyge.»
english: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï jø wø kaan jïëth tïïe moge ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jø wø tïïc tïïe moge yi muudhö, ni wø köö, na «?Aŋa noo joot øøni?» wala «?Aŋa noo ŋäc øøni?»
english: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
