anywaa: Uuni luup wø wellu wellø. ?Aŋø, dïcwäc dääe doo päärö ni röömi ko odhöönh? ?Gïna cwääc doo köö jï ŋata cwääc gø, na «A ba cwääya ïïni»? ?Aŋø, dak doo köö jï dïcwäc dääe, ni «Bäŋ gïn ŋäyï»?
english: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

anywaa: Ki nyi kany mo thiinh, paap mar Libaanø otïmö na pwödhö mo ŋøøm moe beyø; 'ba pwödhö mo ŋøøpe beyø kadhø ni tïme kaamar lul mo oløth.
english: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋece, miiŋŋe luup moa no ogöörö yi wëëlö wïnyge wïnynyö, ni ö jøøa en yi muudhö, na näk nyeŋge onijïïm ki cöörö, ni nëënge.
english: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

anywaa: Jøøa no othiel piny, met ec marge okadhi ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö jøøa canni ni mïn yïthge ki Jwø Icriel, eni na en kur keere.
english: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa no ogäy tïmö ni bäŋgø, ni ö jø abuua ni thumge, ni ö jø wø cwïnyge piew ki tïïc gïï mo reyø ni thøwge,
english: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

anywaa: ni beege jø wø kïth luup bäät jiy ni wø kat luup kar løøk, ni ge cara luup tööt, kiper nee jøøa marge tiir nee ba ŋunni kar løøk.
english: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk na wïïl Eeberam wøk acäänö kiper dhi øt Jeekap, ni kööe, «Jø dhi øt Jeekap ba bëëdö këët ki kany mo bäär ni wïthge olääö, ge ba bëëdö këët ni täärnyïmge oniduk ki laac wïc.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo jootge obwöre moge moa tïïa ki cera ni nut yïthakicge, nyeŋŋa na en kur keere ojiemge, ni wøørge aani na Jwø Jeekap na en kur keere, ni cuŋge nyïma ni ge lwäär ki aani, a na Jwø Icriel.
english: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk wïthge rege cwödhö, tiet luup okwanyge, ni ö jøøa bëëdö ni ŋurö ni jïëcge pwöc.»
english: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, no «Otïmö ni leth jï obwöre moa wïthge teek, jø wø cïp piny ka acaare ni tïïcge gø, ni patha ki køør mana manynya, ni wø tudö ki luup, ni patha ki køør Jwïëy 'moa, ni ge meeda raay bäät raay moge møga.
english: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

anywaa: Gena kweer ki man pëënyge aani, ni cige Ijep nee göökge ri Peerø nyeny Ijep nee ge køny, nee Ijep tïme na tïpö bäätge man gwøk geni.
english: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, køny mar Peerø otïmö na lään wïc bäätge, ni ö gööki mana di Ijepi tïmö na tïpö bäätge ni tïme ni beeye ränynyö marge.
english: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

anywaa: Këël na bëëtge ni kwääri moge onø ci yi Dhöän, ni jøøa jääŋge onø pïï Anec,
english: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

anywaa: ge bëët wïthge olääy kiper mano tïme ni bäŋ køny wala bëënynyö mo jootge joodø baŋ jøøa ŋääthge; 'ba otïmö ni beeye lään wïc keere ka ajøøŋ noo pïï bäätge.»
english: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyooth Wuuö Jwøki kiper 'lääy mo wø en kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp bee en: Jøøa jääŋŋi gena aay ni ge cøra yi ŋöömma raac ni wø jwør gïï mo leth yie, kanya näk yie da ŋuuwe, ki thwöre mo reyø, ki teeŋ thwöre møøk mo määdö; ni ge aay ni jap kwärö moge käärge ka bäät arëëni, ni japa näk ege kaannø na perge leth käärge ka bäät athïrööle, ni ge cøøa baŋ jiy mo bäŋ køny mo tïïcge,
english: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.

anywaa: kiper køny mar Ijep bäŋ tiere. Kiper manøgønø, ena cwøla ni «Reeyap na näk bäŋ gïn mo løny ki tïïc jïre.»
english: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ciï ni göörï luummögø piny nyïm jø Icriel bäät opäm ni nëënö jïge, ni göörï gø piny yi wëëlö thuwø, nee bëëde ni nut yïth nïne moo ööi, nee tïme na lïŋi na bäre bäre.
english: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

anywaa: Kiper jøøgø beege jø ageem, ni geno obwöre ma tööte, ni beege obwöre mo wïthge teek ki man wïnyge ciik Wuuö Jwøk;
english: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord:

anywaa: jø wø köö jï jø wø nyuunh Wuuö Jwøki ki luup mo wø nyooth ki yi wïc, ni ‹Kär dee gïï mo neennu;› ni wø köö jï nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni ‹Kär luup ma adïëri mo wø nyooth jïïu caannu jïwa;  'ba caru luup mo cwïnywa mïnnö ki ge, këël doo na cwøk jaak.
english: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

anywaa: Weyu jöör adïëri manøgø, ni daagu rou yie; wa ba many gø këët nee dee gïn mo wïnywa wïnynyö kiper Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.› »
english: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye gïna caan Jwø Icrielli na en kur keere, ena köö, ni «Kiper mana kwierru luubö mara, ni tïme nou ŋäätha teek maru ki man caaru jiy, nou cuŋŋa ri cwøk,
english: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

anywaa: raay moøgø duua bäätu, kaawat man wø muk kiirri mo bäär, ni päth piny na thäŋi yie aciel.
english: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

anywaa: Ni pädhe kaawat man wø päth daki ni wø peti na thäŋi, ni bäŋ abat mare mo dööŋ mo rømø ki man käär maac ki gø, wala man twøm pïï ki gø yi iith.»
english: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, ena köö, ni «Ki man løgu cwïnynyu ni jïtu ki jwöm, beeye jöör pïëm man piem uuni ki gø, ni ö bëëtö man bëëdu nou lïŋö nou ŋäätha aani, ni näk beeye teek maru; 'ba gïnögø käru jïëö.
english: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

anywaa: Uuna köö, ni ‹Ba løny, wa päära wøk ko okwëëc lääy, wa päära wøk ko okwëëc lääy mo rïïŋö døc.› Wøp nø, uuno päär wøk! 'Ba jiy moo rïŋ køøru ge rïïŋö døc ni kaala uuni.
english: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

anywaa: Jiy ma kuma dëëtu, oriem dhaanhe acielli keere, ni rïïŋu nou ŋwieya jiy abïïc keerge, këël mano noubay bäät kïte, ni tïmu kaamar jaath mo bäär mo ocwöth wï kïdi, nou caala gïn ma ŋïï mo ena bäät thuur.»
english: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk poot manynya uuni ki man cäŋ mëër mare nyoothø jïïu, ni poot koora uuni ki maal ki man nyooth bäth ec mare jïïu. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwø adïëri. Gwïëth en bäät jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö ni koora eni.
english: And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Dhayan, ni wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem, u ba jwöŋi këët. Kiper ka adïëri møn, eni na Wuuö Jwøk mëër mare nyoodhe nyoodhø jïïu kany wø jwöŋu nyïme kiper køny; ni kany wø wïny oduuru maru jaak, pïëc maru pute ka løk.
english: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni Wuuö Jwøk, caannø ki jwør gïï mo leth ee nø nøøyø dëëtu kaamar cam kwön ki maath pïï, eni na dïpööy maru dëëre ba kane këët ki uuni, 'ba eni jootu joodø na adïëri ki nyeŋŋu.
english: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

anywaa: Kanyo wäru cäädhu nou gaa bäät cwïïc wala bäät caam, dwøl wïnynyu wïnynyö ŋäthu mo köö, ni «Jöö en, cäädhu ki yie.»
english: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

anywaa: Køøre kït gïï wø lammu moa no olëënynyö ki gwel-bïrö ki moa no olëënynyö ki warkey ba wøørru këët; geni ge putu ka wetø kaamar abïï mo ree da gïn mo raac, ni kööu jïge, «Waana pää ki uuni!»
english: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

anywaa: Køøre nø, Wuuö Jwøk køth ojääŋŋe jïïu kiper köödhi moo piithu yi ŋöömö, ni ö jammi moo ciek yi ŋöömö ni duunne jïïu ki cam mo päl. 'Ba dïcäŋece, lääc paac mou geno cämö kar kwaath mo laac.
english: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

anywaa: Dhäk ka arëëni mo wø puur ŋöömö, geno cämö ki cam mo ojiiŋŋø ni met  ka acäbö, ni beeye cam mo opiedhø ki gïï wø kwödö ki ge.
english: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na ri cäŋ man tïïc 'näk mana dwøŋ yie, kanyo päth uut koorri moa no ogeerø ni ena maal, wïth kïte moa bäyö bëët ki wïth thuuri moa bäyö bëët ocööt ki nyeŋ näm mo muulö ki pïï.
english: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

anywaa: Kanyøgø tar mar dwääy otïmö ni caala tar mar cäŋ, ni ö tarri mar cäŋ ni rienye døc no omëëtö ki kwöre abïriiø, ki tar mo röömi ki tar mar nïne abïriiø. 'Ba yi cäŋ manøgø beeye cäŋ mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo 'käl gïïa leth wøk bäät jiye, ni beeye kanyo wëëk atwøt caŋŋø yie moa kïth dëët jiye.
english: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk öö ki kany mo bäär; ni wëër mare liel kaamar maac mo jïye onitul ni cøl; eni wëër døc, ni dwøre bëëdö ni caala maac man wø thöör jammi.
english: Behold, the name of the Lord cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

anywaa: Dwør jwïëy mar jam dhee lwör kaamar naam mo pänhnhö, mo päŋ ni ena cwaak. Eni wïth juurre di jierø kaawat man wø pëëdhö ki luul, ni kïth dhøkge ki nywïëny dho okweeny man pee geni kar ränynyö ki gø.
english: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuno wär ki dudi kaawat man wø wärru ki wäär kany wø wøørru ajwömma en kur keere. Cwïnynyu omïnni kaamar jiy mo cøøa baŋ lam ni ge kudhö ko opele, ni ge cøøa bäät Kïn Wuuö Jwøk baŋ Jwø Icriel na näk kïn gwøk røk.
english: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the Lord, to the mighty One of Israel.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dwøre na teek tïïe tïïö nee wïnye, ni wëëk teek bade ööny piny ni nëënö jï jiy, ki yi maac mo liel man wø thöör jammi bëët, ki yi køth ma ruuga, ki yïth pey.
english: And the Lord shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Aciria 'obwøk ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo pwöt geni ka athøra.
english: For through the voice of the Lord shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo pwöt jø Aciria ka athøra ni jääla geni, noo wëëk teek bade ööny piny noo tïïc leny bäät Aciria, otïmö ni wïnynya dööt anëët ki dööt thøme mo meeŋ ki baŋ jø Icriel.
english: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the Lord shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

anywaa: Kiper kar maac onø jiiŋŋø ki kany mo bäär; ka adïëri møn, onø jiiŋŋø kiper nyeny Aciria. Ojiiŋŋø na buur mo bäär mo yie dwøŋ, no oämmö ki maac mo wärri mo orubö ki jenni mo thööth. 'Ba jam dhi Wuuö Jwøk beeye na wëëk maac manøgø liel ni wärri.
english: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï jø oci Ijep kiper køny, ni beege jø wø kïth ŋäädhe marge bäät okwëënyi, ni wø ŋääth thööth mar jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni wø ŋääth teek mar jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi; 'ba geni, ge kär göök ri Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, ni kärge eni manynyø, eni na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk thuwø, wïïe leer; eni ba døø ŋääe ki luumme mo ee caanø. Eno känni ki gïï mo leth. Eni ööa maal ni tïïc gïn mo raac dëët jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ki dëët jø wø køny geni.
english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

anywaa: Kiper jø Ijep gena jiy, ni ge paa Jwøk, no okwëënyi moge beege lääy jaak, ni teek marge ba bëëdö na bäre bäre. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cere orwiee, ni ö ŋata cïp køny ni cwaany tiere, ni ö ŋata køny ni pädhe, ni ö geni bëët ni putge ränynyö na aciel.
english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö ki aani, ni «Kaawat man wø bëëde ni ŋuu mo teek märö bäät cam mare, ni kany wø ö jø kwaathi wø cøørge dëëtge ki man cige baŋ gø na aciel, ba lwäyi ki döötge, ni ba bwøk ki dïlweel marge, aani na Wuuö Jwøk, a na wïth jammi bëët, a öö naa këëda ki jø wø bëëdö bäät Kïn Dhayan jï kuna en bäät thuur.»
english: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö wenyø wø bëëde ni määdö maal bäät øde ni koora nyïïe, Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, Jerucalem ogwøe. Ogwøe møn, ni piem gø, ni køny gø.
english: As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper uuna gaa wøk ni weyu eni.
english: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

anywaa: Kiper noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, ŋati man nø dïïu kït gïï wø lam moe moa no otïïö ki gwel-bïrö ki warkey leeŋe piny, ni beege gïïa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu ni beege raay.
english: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Aciria di nääö ko opëëllö mo paa mar dhaanhø, ni ö opëëllö manøgø ni paa mar dhaanhø enø ni thöör geni. Geni ge ba bøth ki thøw opëëllö manøgø, ni ö cwøw moge moa näk wøpe ni tïmge na jø tïïc mo wø mak ki teek.
english: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, na näk maac mare ena Dhayan, ni këën maac mare man wø liel døc ena Jerucalem, ena köö, ni «Kïn gwøk røk mana teek mar jø Aciria pädhö ki køør böök, ni ö kwääri mo lwaa leny moge ni lwäcge døc kanyo neenge ŋïï mar leny.»
english: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

anywaa: Neennu, nyeya mo käära jiy ki jöör adïëri oööi, ni ö kwääri ni käärge paac ki jöör ŋøl luup ma kare.
english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

anywaa: ŋati man nø rege otïmö ni caala gëëŋi kiper jamø, ni caala kar gwøk røk kiper apwøyaweerø, ni caala pï jøøro mo ena dïtëën, ni caala tïm kïdi mo ena yi ŋöömö ma pwöla.
english: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

anywaa: Kar kaace nyeŋ jiy moa näk nëënö ba nijïïm këët, ni ö jiyi moa näk ïthge wïnyö ni putge ïthge cek.
english: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

anywaa: Jiy moa näk wïthge ba cädö, adïëri otïmö ni ŋäcge, ni ö jiyi mo wø cäänö ni lëëpge ba tiir ni tïmge ni ge cäänö ni lëëpge tiir.
english: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo wïïe ba leer ba cwøl këët ni bëëtö mare beer, ni ö ŋat mo bëëtö mare ba tiir ni ba købi ni bëëtö mare tiir.
english: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat mo wïïe ba leer cara luup mo oballe jaak, ni rääö man wø en cwïnye okadhø, ni bëëdö ni temma raay, ni Jwøk ee kwierø, ni cara gïï mo reyø dëër Wuuö Jwøk; ni tïïya dhaanhø mo onäk käci nee ba jääŋe,  ni judha pïï wøk dhi dhaanhø mo onäk riewi.
english: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo bëëtö mare ba tiir, tïïe moe reyø; eni cïpa piny ka acaare mo reyø, nee ŋata no ocaarø raanynye ki luup tööt, këël doo caana luubö ma adïëri.
english: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo bëëtö mare beer, acaare moe beyø, ni cuŋŋe ni teek ki køør acaare moe na beyø.
english: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

anywaa: Wui, u na määr wø bëëdö ki bëëtö mo jööt jaak, ööu maal ni wïnynyu dwøra; u na mään moa therø, u ni wø cädö ni karu beer, cegu ïthu ki luubö mara.
english: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

anywaa: Ki køør cwiir aciel ki nïne møøk wïïe, u ni wø cädö ni karu beer, dëëtu otïmö ni kwanynyi, kiper jer omøki ränynyö, ni tïme ni bäŋ nyïïomøki mo di cooŋø këët.
english: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

anywaa: U na määr wø bëëdö ki bëëtö mo jööt jaak, dëëtu tïme ni kwanynyi. U na mään moa therø, u ni wø cädö ni karu beer, dëëtu tïme ni rïïŋö. Göönyu abïïe wøk dëëtu, ni dööŋŋu ki dëëtu, ni dwølu keece dëëtu.
english: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.

anywaa: Pöötu kööthu kiper gïna tägö dëët pwöth jer omøki, ki jer omøki mo wø nywøl døc,
english: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

anywaa: ki ŋööm jiya na näk yie otuy ko otwel ki koodhi. Kare møn, kïmmu kiper mïëri moa näk bëëdö ni yïthge da met ec, ki päänya näk yie päŋ ki met ec.
english: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

anywaa: Kiper paan dwøŋ dööŋ keere, ni ö paana näk jiy thööth yie ni tïme ni bäŋ jiy yie. Thuuri ki uut koor tïmö na kwör bëëte jï lääc paap na bäre bäre, ni tïme na kar kwääk jï arëëni mo paap, ni bëëde na kar kwaath mar dïëk;
english: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

anywaa: këël kanyo ö Jwïëc Jwøki noo ööe ki maal noo ö bäätø, noo tïm dï paapi na pwödhö mo ŋöömme beer, ni ö pwödhö mo ŋöömme beer ni kadhe ni tïme kaamar lul mo oløth.
english: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

anywaa: Køøre jöör ŋøl luup ma kare tïmö ni dagø yi ŋöömö manøgø, ni ö bëët adïëri ni tïme no ogääbö yi pwötha ŋöömme beer.
english: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïc mar bëët adïëri tïmö na bëët-mëër, ni gïno duu bëët adïëri beeye bëëtö mëëth ki ŋääth røk mo bëëdö ni nut na bäre bäre.
english: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

anywaa: Køøre nø, jiya obëëdö kany mo nuta bëët-mëër yie, ni beeye kany mo jiy bëëdö no ogwøø yie, mo jiy jïtö ki jwöm yie ni bäŋ okiera.
english: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

anywaa: 'Ba pey opänhnhi, ni ö lulli ni gøøi piny, ni put pääny dwøk piny na bäre.
english: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

anywaa: 'Ba këël gïïögø doo tägö, gwïëth oen bäätu, u ni wø piith caammi mou deŋ pïï, ni wø wec dhäk ka arëëni nee cääthge jaak ni ge cämö ki luum.
english: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jïrï, ï ni wø räänyö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo raany ïïni. Wui, otïmö ni leth jïrï, ï ni wø tïïc gïï mo reyø ki piny,  ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo otïïö dëërï. 'Ba kanyo weyï räänyö, ï put ka raanynyø, ni kanyo weyï gïï mo reyø mo wø tïïyï ki piny, gïï mo reyø put ka tïïc dëërï thuwø.
english: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, nyooth met ec marï jïwa, kiper wa bëëdö ni wa raŋŋa jïrï. Tïmï ni ïïna teek marwa cooth ka amöölla, ni bëëdï ni ïïna pïëmi marwa kanyo enwa yïth gïï mo leth.
english: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kany wø määr dwørï, jiy puta bwøk, ni kany wø ööï maal, wïth juurre puta keethø.
english: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

anywaa: Wui, u na wïth juurre, jammi mou otwier jø møøki, kaamar man wø ö bäänyö wø nigerääc bäät beel, ni putge gø thöör.
english: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk kare dwøŋ, ni eni bëëdö maal; eni ŋøl mana na adïëri ki bëët adïëri otïïe ni dwøŋ yi Dhayan.
english: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

anywaa: Eno tïmö ni beeye tier bëëtö maru ki yïth nïne mou, ni bee eni na tier kwärö man wø joot køny ki leec wïc ki kwänynyö baŋe. 'Ba ki man lwäär Wuuö Jwøk beeye kwärö eni.
english: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, jicge moa teek døc ge jwöŋö nyeŋ jïëthe, ni ö jø wø jääŋŋi ni wø tïïc mëër ni jwöŋge ni keeya yïthge.
english: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

anywaa: Uutjïëthe moa døøŋŋø adööŋ ni ŋaam, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cäädhi ki yïthge. Ni ö luumma no otuudö ni raanynyi, ni ö päänye ni nigepäät, ni bäŋ ŋat cädö kiper jiy.
english: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

anywaa: Ŋöömö jwöŋö ni kïmme; ni ö lur Libaanø ni lää wïïe ni tale; goor Carön tïmö kaamar paap ma tëën; ni ö jenni mo ŋööm Baacan ki mo Kïn Karmël ni øc bøøge moge piny.
english: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ennø, a ööa maal, ni wëëga nyeŋŋa jiem, ni tïŋa nyeŋŋa maal.
english: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

anywaa: Lethø anø ci iï kaamar dhaanhø, 'ba onywølï na luum mo otal, ni ö jam jwïëy marï ni tïme na maac ni cam ïïni.
english: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.

anywaa: Wïth juurre owaaŋ ni tïmge na bur, kaamar man wø waaŋ koodhi mo oŋøt piny.
english: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

anywaa: «Wui, u na kwöru bäyö, wïnynyu gïna tïïa; wui, u na kwöru cärö, kwanynyu tier teek mara.»
english: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

anywaa: Jø raay moa en Dhayan, gena lwäyö, ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi, ge na bëëdö ni Jwøk ege wiiø, ni köge, na «?Aŋa dëëtø ni løny jïre ki man bëëde buut maac man wø räänyö; aŋa dëëtø ni løny jïre ki man bëëde buut maac man wø wääŋö na bäre bäre?»
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

anywaa: Beeye ŋat wø bëëdö ki bëëtö ma kare, ni wø cäänö ki luup ma adïëri, ni beeye ŋat wø kweer ki käl jammi ki jöö mo raac, ni wø bëëdö ni ba jïëy ki jammi mo wø cïp ki piny, ni wø ïthe ba ciie ki luup jiy mo nääö ki piny,  ni wø män ree ki raŋ gïï mo reyø.
english: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋatøgø, kar bëëtö mare otïmö ni ena maal bäät kïdi, ni tïm kïdi na kar gwøk røk mare, ni tïm cam mare ni di cïbö jïre, ni pïï moe moo maadhe ba cöök.
english: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni nyeya oneennu ki nyeŋŋu ka ajiem mare, ni jootu paana näk ree ee jwaa ni bäär.
english: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, wïthu oparru ki gïna wara bëëdu nou lwäär ki gø, ni kööu, na «?Aŋø, age ŋata wara bëëdö ni kwaana jammi? ?Aŋø, age ŋata wara bëëdö ni røma jammi? ?Aŋø, age ŋata wara bëëdö ni kwaana uut koor moa no ogeerø ni ena maal?»
english: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

anywaa: Uuni, jø atöör moøgø ba jootu këët, ni beege jø wø cäänö ni dhøk marge kuc, ni wø car luup mo tietge ba kwany, ni wø cäänö ni keda ge gwøŋ, ni tiet luup moge ba ci cwïny.
english: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.

anywaa: Neennu Dhayan, pääny man wø wøørwa ajwöm mowa yie; Jerucalem ojootu ki nyeŋŋu na kar bëëtö mo päŋ ki bëët-mëër, ni tïme kaamar oduŋkaara mo bäŋ ŋat daak gø, wala ŋat mo pudha teegi moe wøk, wala ŋat mo cööta thøøli moe.
english: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Wuuö Jwøk otïmö ni bee teek marwa ni tïme kaamar kany mo da näm, ki nyeŋ näm mo okønynyø ni døøŋŋø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cør yïthge ki jää leny man wø kiiw ko opääli, ni bäŋ jïëth leny mo teek mo pöödhi ki yïthge.
english: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk bee dïŋut luup marwa, ni bee eni na cïp ciik jïwa, ni ena nyeya marwa, ni bee eni noo piem waani.
english: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.

anywaa: Thøøli mo wø tïïc jääy nee cäädhe, nilwak, ni ö abïïna no otwöö wï ogeella ni ba peer ree. Køøre, japa thööth na näk jap twëër opääŋŋi, ni këël ŋwøl jïtö rege.
english: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, bäŋ ŋat mo ena Dhayan mo köö, ni «Aani dëëra da täw.» 'Ba jiy mo wø bëëdö yie raay moge di wëënnö.
english: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

anywaa: Wui, u na wïth juurre, ööu ni nyänhnhu kuna wïnynyu gïn; cegu ïthu, u na jiy! Beerra man ö pinynyi ki japa en yie bëët ni wïnyge gïn; beerra man ö bäät ŋøømmi ki japa en yie bëët ni cekge ïthge.
english: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

anywaa: Kiper gootø mar Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät wïth juurre bëët, ni wëër mare ena bäät jø leny bëët mo wïth juurre. Eni wïth jø bäät piny dïïre dïïrö na bäre; eni jø bäät piny wëëge 'näk.
english: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

anywaa: Ni ö dëëtge moa no othøw ni leeŋi wøk; ni ö bäät kïte ni putge nikwaar ki remge; ni ö rïŋ dëëtge moa no othøw ni ŋwääge no okwäk.
english: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa en maal bëët oraanynyi,  ni ö maalø ni bani kaamar warakata; ni ö jap maalli bëët thuwø ni øcge piny kaaman wø øc bøøk jer omøki piny, wala man wø øc bøøk olaammi piny.
english: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo thöör tïïc mare maalø, ka adïëri møn, opëëllö mare owëëk ööny piny bäät ŋööm Ëdöm ni jääl gø, ni beege jøøa näk ee nø jiiŋŋø ki man raany ge bëët.
english: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

anywaa: Opëëllö mare ogääbi ki remø bäre. Ree orwødhe ki dwäle, ni rwøth ree ki rem mo caala rem mo nyïï rööm ka atëëe, ki dwäle mo caala dwäle mo røgi mo nyöök rööm. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk jiy onääe yi Bödhra, kaawat man wø 'näk lääy mo wø cïp no olämme, ni tïïc 'näk mana dwøŋ døc yi ŋööm Ëdöm bäre.
english: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

anywaa: Jø wø caal oluuy mo jööpe moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø onäk, ni ö ŋöömö marge ni pääŋe ki remø, ni tïm tørri bäre mar ŋöömö marge ni nwaaŋ ki dwäle.
english: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

anywaa: Kiper da cäŋ ajäla mar Wuuö Jwøk, ki cwiir man cool kwör mar jø Dhayan yie ni kønya geni.
english: For it is the day of the Lord's vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

anywaa: Nyeŋ näm mo ŋööm Ëdöm otïmö na maaw mo nwaaŋ, ni tïm ŋøøm moge na teeŋ tør man wø liel; ni paac marge bäre bëëdö na maaw mo liel.
english: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

anywaa: 'Ba maac manøgø obëëdö ni liel ki wäär ki dïcäŋ, ni ba løny ki bïp; ni bëët jïye ni cøøa maal ni ba cuŋ. Maac manøgø bëëdö ni ba thøw këël mano këët ri beenhnhe moo ööi bëët, ni bäŋ ŋat mo pöödhö ki yi ŋöömmögø na bäre bäre.
english: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

anywaa: 'Ba poge oput dööŋŋe jï olwedhe ki thëëwe, ni tïme na kar bëëtö mar tule ka agääe; ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni put gø wëëk ränynyö, ni dööŋe na ŋöömö mo bäŋ gïrpiny yie.
english: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe mo këëlla buc nyec piny otïmö ni bäŋgø yie, ni ö jiyi bëët moa kwörge døøŋŋø ni rwäänyge.
english: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba koodhi otuy yïth uut koor moge moa no ogeerø ni ena maal, ni ö otwelli ko odhäŋŋe ni tucge yïth päänye moge moa no ogeerø ni teek; ni put tïmö na kar bëëtö jï othööe, na kany noor tule yie.
english: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.

anywaa: 'Ba lääc paap geno røømmi yie ko orude, ni tïme ni beeye kany wø bëët adëële yie ni cøøra rege. Ka adïëri møn, tïmö na kar bëëtö jï lääy mo wø cäädhi ki wäär na kany rïïge yie.
english: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

anywaa: Tule otïïö ki kwör bëëte moge yie, ni nywølge yie ki tøŋ, ni tøkge tøŋ moge, ni cooŋge nyïïge tier tïpö mar gø. Kanyøgø cøre dëëtge oputge cooŋ yi gø, ni man nø ki watge.
english: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

anywaa: Wëël Wuuö Jwøk japï ni kwaanï luup moa no ogöörö yie.  Bäŋ gïrpiny aciel dëët gïïögø mo rwäänyi, ni bäŋ aciel mo bëëdö keere ni bäŋ watge. Kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na kööm ge, ni beeye Jwïëye na cooŋ ge.
english: Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye na pääŋ ŋøøm jïge, ni mooc man nø ki kare, ni put tïmö na moge na bäre bäre; këël beenhnhe moge moo ööi køørge poot bëëdö yie.
english: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

anywaa: 'Ba paaba näk tëën ki ŋöömma näk otal yïthge omïnni; paaba näk tëën oløth ni tïme ni lanhnhi kaamar wï jaath mo oŋøøk.
english: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

anywaa: Geno løth ni tïmge ni pulli, ni tïm yïthge ni met døc, ni kwöŋge ki met ec. 'Ba teeŋ ajiem mar lur Libaanø di cïbö jïge, ni ö teeŋ wödö mar thuur Karmël ki pwöl Carön ni mëëgi geni. Geni ajiem ki wödö mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, oneenge.
english: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.

anywaa: Wëëgu ceŋ moa no oniläp tëënnö, ni wëëgu cøŋŋi moa no ojöönyö nithïk.
english: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

anywaa: Caannu jï jøø ni cwïnyge olwäyö yøø, ni kööu, ni «Magu cwïnynyu ni ba lwäyu. Ka adïëri møn, Jwøk maru ööa baŋ ajäla, eni öö kuna cool kwöri mou, ni piem uuni.»
english: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø cööye nyeŋge ojap, ni ö meŋŋe ni wïnyge luup.
english: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

anywaa: Kar kaagø, ŋööte geno päri kaamar aŋeri, ni ö dhøk jøøa näk ba cäänö ni japge rege ni kwöŋge ki met ec. Kiper dïtëën otuc ki pïï, ni ö paaba näk tëën ni cööde ki nyeŋ näm.
english: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

anywaa: ŋöömma bëëdö no owaaŋ otïmö na puul, ni ö ŋöömma no otal ni neethar ki pï jøør. Kanya bëëdö na kar rïc mar othööe, otuy ko obøw ka athära.
english: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

anywaa: 'Ba jöö mo dwøŋ otïmö ni dagø yie, ni cwøli ni «Jöö mo ena kur keere na mar Jwøk.» Ni jiy moa näk ba waany ge ba cäädhi ki yie, këël jøøa jägö na näk wïthge ba leer bäŋgø mo cøra yie. 'Ba bee jøøa marge beer keerge noo cäädhi ki yie.
english: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

anywaa: ŋuu tïmö ni bäŋgø yie, ni bäŋ cwieny mo di joodø ni cäädhö yie. Lääy moøgø tïmö ni bäŋgø kaace, 'ba beege jøøa no owïïl wøk keerge noo cäädhi ki yie.
english: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïïl Wuuö Jwøki wøk, geno duui, ni öge yi Dhayan ni ge wär ki dudi ni yïthge met, ni ö met eci marge ni bëëde na bäre bäre, kaamar aduda mo okïth wïc; ni bëëtge ni ge kanynyø ni yïthge met, ni ö kïmmö ki cooyø ni aae bäätge.
english: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Edhekaya na apaar kurŋween bäät nyec,  Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria acøø ni tuk päänye mo Juuda bëët moa näk kiiri moge ogeerø ni teek ni mak geni.
english: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Aciria, kwääy lwaa leny mana cwøl ni Rapcakë, ki lwaa leny mo päl, ajääŋŋe ki Lakic nee cige Jerucalem baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya. Kanyøgønø gena cuŋŋö bäät øøl pïï mana käl yi puul mana en jï maal, waŋjööra dwøŋ man wø cør pwöla mar jø peny ka abïïe.
english: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.

anywaa: Køøre Eliekim wär Kilkiya na en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki Jöa wär Acaap ŋat wø par wïc ki luup, gena ö wøk baŋ jøøgø.
english: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø kwääy lwaa leny aköö jïge, ni «Caannu jï Edhekaya ni nyeny Aciria na dwøŋ aköö, «ni ‹?Ïïni, ï ŋääthï ŋø?
english: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ïïni, waŋï riek ki leny døc, ni jïrï da jø leny mo teek? Marï kaa waac jaak. ?Ennø, ï ŋääthï ŋa ni gëëmï ki aani en?
english: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ïïni, ï ŋäätha Ijep ni wø bëëdö kaamar abaarø ni wø laar toor ni cwøp cer dhaanhø kany wø näk mo dhaanhø kwömö ki gø. 'Ba Peerø nyeny Ijep caala abaarø manøgø ki jï jø wø ŋääth gø bëët.
english: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mo u köö jïra nou ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, aŋø, paa eni na kwör lam moe mo wø läm jiyi yïthge bäät thuuri, ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge moe, raany Edhekaya, na kööm uuni, u na jø Juuda ki jø Jerucalem, ni lämu nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana en Jerucalem keere?› »
english: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

anywaa: Ni cäŋ kwääy lwaa leny köö, ni «Ennø, beerra man gääbu dhøgu ki nyeya mara ma nyeny Aciria, naa cïpa jïïu ko okwëënyi ma kume ariiø ni näk mo løny jïïu ki man cïpu ki jiy mo cäädhi ki bäätge.
english: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, këël na näk mo u ŋäätha jø Ijep kiper jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi, olønye jïïu nidïï ki man riemmu kwääy leny aciel mana kare thiinh mar nyeya mara?
english: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni ööa kany en baŋ leny nee kany raanynya, ki jïïu naa ba ööi ka køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk? Beeye Wuuö Jwøk na köö jïra ni ööa paani naa këëda ki gø nee raanynya.»
english: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

anywaa: 'Ba Eliekim, ki Cëpna, ki Jöa gena köö jï kwääy lwaa leny, ni «Beerra man ba caanï luummögø jïwa ki dhi Ibaru, na näk dhøk marwa, ni wïnyö jï jøøi no opï piny bäät kiir ii; 'ba caanï jïwa ki dhi jø Aram, kiper wïnyö jïwa.»
english: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy lwaa leny aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, nyeya mara na jääŋ aani, a jääŋŋe kaper nee luupi ii cara jï nyeya maru ki jïïu keeru, ni paa kiper nee wïny jøøgø no opï piny bäät kiir yøø, jø ojwør gïï mo leth ki uuni na aciel, noo cam laac-døøŋŋø moge noo maath laac moge moa therø ki uuni na aciel?»
english: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

anywaa: Kanyøgø kwääy lwaa leny aput ö maal ni rwääye ki dhi Ibaru ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal ni kööe, ni «Uuni, wïnynyu dwør nyeny Aciria na dwøŋ.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

anywaa: Nyeya aköö, ni ‹Uuni, kär u cøøk Edhekaya, kiper ba løny jïre ki man piem uuni cera.
english: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

anywaa: Kär nee Edhekaya tïïya uuni nee Wuuö Jwøk ŋääthu, ki køør man wø kööe, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk ø pieme piemø; ni pääny man ba ci cer nyeny Aciria.» ›
english: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

anywaa: «Kär dwør Edhekaya wïnynyu; wïnynyu dwør nyeny Aciria na köö, ni ‹Tïïyu bëët-mëër ki aani, ni ööu wøk baŋa. Køøre uuno bëëdö ni ŋati man nø opï piny paare ni cama caammi mo pwöthe ni maatha pïï moa näk ee cooŋø,
english: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

anywaa: këël kanyo ööa noo käla uuni noo kïtha uuni yi ŋöömö mo caala ŋöömö maru, ni beeye ŋöömö mo beel ki nyïïomøki ciek yie, mo yie da caammi, ki pwöth nyïïomøki.
english: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

anywaa: « ‹Gwøgu rou nee Edhekaya wïthu ba maaŋŋe ki køør man wø kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk ø pieme piemø.» ?Aŋø, da jwøk røk juu mo wïth juurre, mo jiy moa bëëdö yi ŋöömme ee piemø cer nyeny Aciria?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

anywaa: ?Age juuk jø Amath  ki juuk jø Arpat? ?Age juuk jø Cepar- Waym? ?Aŋø, geni jø Cameria apiemge cera?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

anywaa: ?A juuge moe røk juu bëët mo tiet mïëri moøgø mo jø wø bëëdö yïth ŋøøpge ege piemø cera, ni tïme ni Wuuö Jwøk jø Jerucalem pieme piemø cera en?› »
english: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en bäät kiir gena bëëdö ni geno nikïïl ni bäŋ luubö mo ege dwøgø jïgø, kiper geno nø kööm nyeya ma Edhekaya, ni «Kär dee gïn mo dwøgu jïre.»
english: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

anywaa: Køøre Eliekim wär Kilkiya na en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ni wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki Jöa wär Acaap ni wø par wïc ki luup, gena duu baŋ Edhekaya na abïïe moge ege jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni caange luup moa caan kwääy lwaa leny jïre.
english: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Edhekaya na wïny gïnögø, eni abïïe moe aput jeeyø ki pänh cwïny, ni dwøl keeca dëëre, ni døny yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya, Eliekim ŋata en paan dwøŋŋi cere, ki Cëpna ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki jø døøŋŋø moa näk dïlämme, mo dëëtge ege döönnö ki keece ki pänh cwïny, ajääŋŋe baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth.
english: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

anywaa: Ni kö jøøgø jï Aydheea, ni «Edhekaya aköö, ni ‹Dïcäŋ man beeye dïcäŋ jwør gïï mo leth, ni beeye cäŋ ajäla, ni beeye cäŋ ataa; kiper ø caala dhaagø mo lwaar ki nyilaal, mo cøøl odhäthö jïre kiper mana näk mo dëëre jääk.
english: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper manøgønø, beerra man lämï jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kiper jiy moa no odööŋ ni kwøw. Kanymør ni Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, luup bëët moa caan kwääy lwaa leny wïnynye wïnynyö, ni beeye ŋata jääŋ nyeny Aciria nee eni na Jwøa kwøw pääde, ni ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk ni jook luupa wïnynye na car ŋatøgø.› »
english: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jic nyeya ma Edhekaya gena put ö baŋ Aydheea.
english: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea aköö jïge, ni «Wär caannu jï nyeya maru ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Käru lwäyö kiper luubö mana wïnynyu, na ö jic nyeny Aciria na janyge aani ki gø.
english: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani bääte kïtha kïthö ki jwïëy, ni ö eni ni wïnye ka akøpi ni døø yi ŋöömö mare. Ni tïïa eni nee 'näk ko opëëllö yi ŋöömö mare.› »
english: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääy lwaa leny na wïny gø ni nyeny Aciria onø aay Lakic, ena cøø ni nwän nyeny Aciria ni këëdö ki jø Libana.
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria ni Tiraka nyeny Kuuc aö baŋ leny ki eni. 'Ba kanya wïny gïnögø kiree ena put jääk baŋ Edhekaya ki jiy ni kööe,
english: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär caannu jï Edhekaya nyeny Juuda, ni ‹Kär u cøøk Jwøki maru manø ni ŋääthu enø kany wø kööe, ni «Jerucalem ba ci cer nyeny Aciria.»
english: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïna tïïc nyec Aciria yïth mïëri bëët, na raanyge ge na bäre bäre, käru wïnynyö? ?Aŋø, da ŋat mo piema uuni?
english: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïth juurre moa wïthge dïïr kwäcwa, gena piem juu moge na bëëde? ?A këël jø Gödhan, ki jø Aaren, ki jø Rëdhep, ki jø Ëden moa bëëdö Tëlacer, gena piem juu moge na bëëde?
english: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?

anywaa: ?Age nyeny Amath, ki nyeny Arpat, ki nyeny Cepar-Waym, ki nyeny Ëna, ki nyeny Iwa?› »
english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø Edhekaya wëëlö alwøre ceŋ jiy moa jääŋŋi, ni kwaan gø. Ni ö eni ni ci yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni peer gø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Edhekaya ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe,
english: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,

anywaa: «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, na  näk Jwø Icriel, ï ni wø nyooth ajiemnyec marï ki yïthakic nyïïatwiet maal moa cwøl ni kirubëlli, bee ï keerï na Jwø wïth buc nyeye bëët mo bäät piny, ni bee ï na cwääc maal ki piny.
english: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï, ni wïnynyï lam mara. Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, jap nyeŋŋï ni räŋŋï; ni wïnynyï luup bëët mo Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria, na jääŋ jiy nee ï pääde, ï na Jwøa kwøw.
english: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

anywaa: «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, nyeye mo Aciria wïth juurre bëët anø thöörge ki 'näk, ni nø raanyge ŋøøp jøøgø,
english: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

anywaa: ni nø leeŋge juu mo jøøgø yi maac, kiper ge paa juu cøøn, 'ba gena gïï mo tïïc jiyi ka ceŋge, ni beege jen ki kïte jaak. 'Ba gena put nyeye mo Aciria raanynyø møn.
english: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, piem waani cer nyeny Aciria, nee ŋäc buc nyeye bëët mo bäät piny ni bee ï keerï na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord, even thou only.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Aydheea wär Amöth ajäägö ki dwøl baŋ Edhekaya, ni caan gø ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, ena köö: Kiper mana lämï kiper Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria,
english: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

anywaa: dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper nyeny Aciria beeye en, ena köö, «ni ‹Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem, na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, ïïna taae ni päät ïïni, ï na nyeny Aciria, ni keny wïïe ni buua ïïni kanya reŋï.
english: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋa nø na päätï na janynyï? ?Aŋa na kwöŋŋï bääte, na ŋuuï nyeŋŋï wøk bääte niï töödö? ?Paa bääta, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere?
english: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Ïïna ŋwöö bääta, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ki dhøk jiy moa jääŋŋï, ni kööï, ni «Aana ci wïth kïte maal ki jïëth leny 'moa mo thööth mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni cøøa yi lur Libaanø kuya; ni ŋøda jen moe piny moa bäyö na perge leth, ni dønynya yi lul mana cøl kuya.
english: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.

anywaa: Aana kunyö ki ïïdhi ni mädha ki pïï yïthge kaace. Ni wëëga pïï talø ki tiet jø leny 'moa, ni beege pïï mo näp Ijep bëët.»
english: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

anywaa: « ‹?Aŋø, kärï wïnynyö cøøn? Gïnögø yaa nø caar ki kany mo bäär, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni caara ka ya acääŋŋe cøøn. 'Ba ennø, a wëëga gø thur kare, nee päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek nee wëëgï niruuth.
english: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa bëëdö yïthge ni tïmge ni jägö, ni ge lwäär ni wïthge laay, ni tïmge kaamar gïï mo otuy yi pwöla, kaamar luum mo mar mo otuy yi kaŋ, ki luum mo otuy wïth uudi ni wø laar waaŋ ni poot kär døøŋŋø.
english: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba aani, bëëtö marï bäre ŋääa, ki mano täge ki ööny maal marï këël pïïn piny marï, ki døny wøk marï, ki duuö marï, këël wëër marï man wø wëërï ki aani, ŋääa thuwø.
english: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper wëër mana wëërï ki aani, ka atöör marï mana jooda, aani umï gäna gänö ko obïth mara,  ni kïtha dhiï ki nywïëny dho okweeny, ni wiira wïïï ki gø, ni dwøga ïïni ki jöö mana ööï ki yie.›
english: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Edhekaya en, man otïmö na nyuudhi jïrï; yi cwiir man u cämö ki caammi moa näk bär, ni cwiino ööi u poot cämö ki caammi moa näk bär. 'Ba ri dää cwiiri u pïïdhö ni kääu; ni pïïdhu ki jer omøki ni cammu nyïïge.
english: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw røk jø dhi øt Juuda, tietge cäŋa këët piny ni nyaacge.
english: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

anywaa: Kiper da jiy mo dööŋ mo tuula wøk ki yi Jerucalem ki bäät Kïn Dhayan. 'Ba gïnögø otïïc Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ki køør këëyö mare.»
english: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk na caane kiper nyeny Aciria, ena köö, ni «Eni ba duny yi pääny man, ni bäŋ atheerø mo thöör yi gø kany; këël eni ba nyänh deŋ gø ni käädö ki kwöt leny, ni bäŋ ŋøøm mo di thørø deŋ kiir ki man ethge bäät kiir ki gø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

anywaa: Eni døøk ki jööra cur yi gø ni ba duny yi pääny man.
english: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, pääny man gwøa gwøø ni piema gø kiper nyeŋŋa ki nyeŋ dhaanhnha ma Deebit.»
english: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aci twïër mar jø Aciria, ni 'näk jiy ma kume ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabära kurbïïc. 'Ba na päc jiyi ka amöölla cøøn, ka adïëri møn, jiy bëët aputge joot no othøw.
english: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cenakerëp nyeny Aciria aput tïŋŋö ni døø paare Nineba, ni bëëde yie.
english: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni eni lämö øt Nicrøk, jwøk mare, ena put wääde ma Adramëlëk ki wääde ma Carëdher 'näk ko opëëllö; ni ö geni ni reŋge yi ŋööm Ararat. Ni ö wääde ma Ëcaradön ni läw kar gø na nyeya.
english: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar–haddon his son reigned in his stead.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni, Edhekaya atïmö ni tuu ni ena um thøø. Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea wär Amöth aö baŋe ni kööe jïgø, ni «Man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Caan dwørï, kiper ï thøw; ï ba kwøw.› »
english: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Edhekaya nyïme aput løø ri øtø, ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,

anywaa: ni kööe, «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, par wïïï ki mana bëëda naa caatha køørï na adïëri ki cwïnya bäre, ni tïïa ki gïï mo nëëni ni beyø ki jïrï.» Ni ö Edhekaya ni put jwöŋö døc ni yie ee keeyø.
english: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bäät Aydheea, ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Edhekaya ni man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø kwaru ma Deebit, ena köö, ni ‹Lam marï awïnynya, ni jooda pï nyeŋŋï. 'Ba aani, bäät cwiiri moï mëënna mëënnö ki cwiiri apaar kurbïïc.
english: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki pääny man, u piema piemø cer nyeny Aciria, ni gwøa pääny man.›
english: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man otïmö na nyuudhi mano nyoodha kiperï, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mo nyootha gø ni gïna caana tïïa tïïö.
english: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, tïpö man wø nyooth pöödhö mar caa ki bäät gïna no otïïc nyeya ma Eeyeth, tïïa tïïö nee døø ŋääe ki rumme apaar.› » Kanyøgø tïpö man wø nyooth pöödhö mar caa aput døø ŋääe ki rumme apaar.
english: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

anywaa: Luubö mana göör Edhekaya nyeny Juuda kanya nø jöön dëëre køør täw, beeye en:
english: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

anywaa: Aani, aana köö, ni «Kara atïmö ni cään ki thøø ni cwiiri 'moa poot nøk. Aani, aana nø mäni ki cwiic kwøw moa daa beedø.»
english: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

anywaa: Aani, aana köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk ba jooda këët møn, ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk mana ŋääa kanya bëëda naa kwøw; ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo neena këët møn røk jiy moa en bäät piny.
english: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

anywaa: Dëëra na näk kar bëët jwïëy 'moa, akäl, kaawat man wø ö oduŋkaara mar dïkwääc dïëk wø pudhi wøk. Jwïëy 'moa, aban kaawat man wø tïïc ŋat wø cwääö ka abïïe. Wuuö Jwøk aana ŋul wøk kaamar aŋuun waarø man wø ŋul wøk ri gïr cwääc ka abïïe. Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ këël wäär, aŋuun kwøw mara atïïyï nee cuŋŋe.
english: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni cwïnya yaa cïp piny këël amöölla; cuu 'moa bëët atøyï kaawat man wø tïïc ŋuuwi; ki mana täge ki dïcäŋ këël wäär, aŋuun kwøw mara atïïyï nee cuŋŋe.
english: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

anywaa: Aana jwöŋö kaamar ojwaak ko olwaarø, ni ö ŋurö mara ni wïnye kaamar dwør akuuru. Nyeŋŋa atal ki mana bëëda naa neeta maal. Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a ena yi bëëtö mo leth; tïmï ni ïïna kunyi mara.
english: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

anywaa: «?'Ba agïne noo caana nø? Kiper Wuuö Jwøk anø cäänö ki aani, ni ö eni ki dëëre kiree ni nø tïïc mare. Aano bëëdö ni dëëra yaa dwøk piny ki yïth cwiiri 'moa bëët, kiper gïna leth na jwøra ki cwïnya.
english: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

anywaa: Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, jiy wø bëëdö ni kwøw ki køør køny marï, ni beeye tiere thuwø ni kwøw jwïëy 'moa en. Wui, jööt dëël mara adwøgï kare ni wëëgï a kwøw.
english: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, leth bëëtö mana tägö dëëra beeye kiper naa bëënynya. Aana gwøgï ki køør mëër marï, ni kära päth yi buur ränynyö, ni ö raay 'moa bëët ni jarï ge ŋääï.
english: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

anywaa: Kiper jwïëc jiy moa en kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw ï ba jiemge, ni jøøa no othøw ï ba pwøcge. Jiy mo wø ci yi buur piny, adïëri marï ba ŋääthge.
english: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

anywaa: Jiy moa kwøw beege ni wø pwøc ïïni, kaawat man tïïa dïcäŋi en. Adïëri marï caan wëëe caanø jï obwöre moge.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk a pieme piemø. Kiper manøgønø, ø wär ki dudi ni ø pöödö ki thøme mo thøøli moge onetø ki yïth nïr kwøw 'moø bëët yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, Aydheea onø köö, ni «Beerra man lwørge nyïï olämmi moa no omiiø na dhøk, ni twöge gø bäät boor, kiper nee dëëre jöönne.»
english: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaster upon the boil, and he shall recover.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya thuwø onø pëëö, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïmö na nyuudhi ki man näk maa cøøa maal yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk?»
english: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca nyeny Babiløn ma Merödak-Baladan o Baladan ajääk baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya ki weeli ki muuy, kiper ee wïnynyö ni nyeya ma Edhekaya otuu ni nø jöön dëëre.
english: At that time Merodach–baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhekaya jiy moa jääŋŋi apänhnhe ki met ec, ni nyooth jammi bëët jïge moa en yi øt kän mare, ni beege gwel-bïrö, ki warkey, ki gïï wø ŋwääi wø tïïc kadø ni met, ki maaw mo pere leth, ki jap  leny moe bëët, ki jammi moe bëët moa perge leth. Bäŋ gïrpiny mo ena yi øde wala mo ena tier buc nyec mare mo odööŋ mo käre nyoodhø jïge.
english: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea aö baŋ nyeya ma Edhekaya ni kööe jïgø, na «?Aŋø, jøøgø ge carge ŋø? ?Ge kälge kaa?» Ni løgi ya Edhekaya, ni «Gena ö baŋa ni ge käla paac mo bäär døc; ge käla Babiløn.»
english: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ pëëö, na «?Agïïaŋø na neenge yi øtø marï?» 'Ba aløk Edhekaya, ni «Jammi bëët moa en yi øda ajootge; ni bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ røk jammi moa en kwör kän 'moa mo kära nyoodhø jïge.»
english: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea aköö jï Edhekaya, ni «Wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët,
english: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö mo jammi bëët moa en yi øtø marï, ki moa no okan kwäre moï yïth uut kän ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe këël dïcäŋi en, ge jwïëa Babiløn, ni bäŋgø mo wec.
english: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaayï møøk moo käl dëërï kiree, ge di maaø ki tøŋ ni dïn geni, ni tïmge na jø tïïc yi paan dwøŋ mar nyeny Babiløn.› »
english: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: Køøre Edhekaya aköö jï Aydheea, ni «Dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caanï beer.» Kiper Edhekaya acaare ni kööe, ni «Da bëët-mëër ki bëëtö mo beer yïth nïne 'moa.»
english: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk maru aköö, ni «Cømmu cwïny jiya; cømmu cwïnyge.
english: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

anywaa: Cäännu jø Jerucalem ni mëër you nyoodhø jïge; caannu jïge ni rwaayu rwaaø ki man näk mo bëët laŋ na teek na en bäätge othum, ni kwör raay moge onø cool, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk gena nø jääla ka ajäla mo orømø ki raay moge bëët.»
english: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord's hand double for all her sins.

anywaa: Da dwøl mo wïnyö mo cwödö, ni «Jiiŋŋu jöör Wuuö Jwøk dï paap, tïïu ki øtjöö dïtëën mo thïïŋ mo dwøŋ kiper Jwøk marø.
english: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

anywaa: Beerra man ö aguule bëët ni thøri, ni ö kïte bëët ki thuuri ni dwøgi piny. Beerra man ö kwöra gwalli ni tïï ni pøøth, ni ö kwöra no opäny maal ni tïï ni ree ee päärö.
english: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

anywaa: Køøre nø, ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk onyooth, ni ö jiyi bëët ni putge gø raŋ ge bëët. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki ki dhee kiree.»
english: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: Dwøl aköö jïra, ni «Gööc piny ki luubö.» Køøre aana köö, na «?A luumma ŋø noo gøøa piny?» Jiy bëët caala luum, na ajiem marge caala wï luum mo oŋøøk yi pwödhö.
english: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

anywaa: 'Ba luum wø tal, ni päth wïïe piny, kany wø ö jam dhi Wuuö Jwøk wø kwöt dëër gø; kiper ka adïëri møn, jiy caala luum.
english: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.

anywaa: Luum tal ni päth wïïe piny, 'ba dwør Jwøk marø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Dhayan na öö ki luubö mo nyään mo met, eth maal bäät kïdi mo bäär ni køpï gø! Wui, ï na Jerucalem na öö ki luubö mo nyään mo met, tïŋ dwørï maal døc ni køpï gø; tïŋ dwørï maal ni ba lwäyï; caanï jï päänye mo Juuda, «Ka adïëri møn, Jwøk maru en!»
english: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

anywaa: Raŋŋu, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk öö ki teek mo dwøŋ, ni teek bade beeye noo käär piny ki gø. Raŋŋu, eni öö ni käära jøøa ööle kiperge, ni beege jiy moa joode ni wø cäädhi nyïme.
english: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jiye gwøe gwøø, kaawat man wø ö dïkwääyi wø gwøk dïëk moe, kaawat man wø ö eni wø cooŋ nyïïdïëk ki cere, ni käär ge ki kööre, ni bwøth moa näk nyoori ni kääre mëëth.
english: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aŋa na cøt pï naama dwøŋ ki thäny cere ni røma gø? ?Aŋa na røm maalø ki rumi mar yïthakic lweedi mo cenø? ?Aŋa na cooŋ tør mar bäät ŋøøm ni røm gø ki gïr røm? ?Aŋa na røm kïte ki thuuri ki gïr røm?
english: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

anywaa: ?Aŋa na kööm Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk, ni nyuunhnha gø ki luup?
english: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?

anywaa: ?Aŋa na mooc gø ka acaara, na wëëk gø kwany tiet jammi? ?Aŋa na pwöny gø ki jöör ŋøl luup ma kare? ?Aŋa na pwöny gø ki leec wïc, na nyooth jöör kwany tiet luup jïgø?
english: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, wïth juurre caala ŋïnh pïï mo töön piny ka tier agwäy, ni ge bëëdö kaamar tør mo thiinh mo ena bäät gïr røm. Raŋŋu, Wuuö Jwøk wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ tïŋe maal ni jööt jaak kaamar tør mo otwäät.
english: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

anywaa: 'Ba këël jer lur Libaanø ba rømi na jer wääŋö ko olämme, ni lääy moa en yie thuwø ba rømi ki man cïbi no olämme mo wø waaŋ.
english: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

anywaa: Ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, wïth juurre bëët nëëni kaamar gïn mo bäŋ kwäänne, ni raaŋe kaamar gïn mo thiinh døc mo bäŋ tiere.
english: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

anywaa: ?A ennø, Jwøk pääru gø ki ŋa? ?A kït gïnaŋø nou pääru eni ki gø?
english: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

anywaa: Kït gïn wø lam wø tïïc rëëmmö tïïö, ni ö ŋat wø lëënyö ki warkey ni lëëny dëër gø ki warkey, ni ö ŋat wø tïïö ki gwel-bïrö ni kïth dëër gø ki tiimme mo gwel-bïrö.
english: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø mo can mo ba løny ki man cïpe ki teeŋ muuy manøgø, jëëtö ki jaath mo teek mo ba laar tøbø, ni määnye ki rëëmmö man tieŋ gø na kït gïn wø lam ni cwöth gø piny ni teek nee ba pädhe.
english: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïn kuyu? ?Käru wïnynyö? ?Kär caanø jïïu dïkwøŋ ya acääŋŋe? ?Aŋø, tiere poot käru kwanyø en ki mana cak piny ya acääŋŋe?
english: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø pï piny maal, ni piny ee luuŋ piny, ni jø piny bëëdö ni nëëni kaamar aditwie; ni maal ee peerø kaamar abïï ma gëëŋi, ni ee peerø kaamar oduŋkaara na kar bëëtö.
english: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

anywaa: Bee eni ni wø dwøk kwääri piny ni tïïc ge kaamar gïn mo bäŋgø; ni bee eni ni wø tïïc dïŋut luup mo bäät piny kaamar gïn mo bäŋ tiere.
english: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pootge ni ge poot kär tïmö kaamar nyijaath mo onø piith,  ni ge poot kär tïmö kaamar nyijaath mo onø tøøk, mo lweete onø këët piny yïth ŋøøm, Wuuö Jwøk jamø wëëge kwöt bäätge ni talge, ni ö geni ni køøli ya apwøyaweerø kaamar lethø.
english: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk na en kur keere aköö, ni «?Aano päänynyu gø ki ŋa? ?Aŋa ni röömwa ki gø?»
english: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

anywaa: Lwïthu ni raŋŋu maal mø. ?Japøge bëët ocwääya ŋa? Bee eni ni wø bëëdö na wïc bäätge ni wø ŋäc kwäänge, ni ge cwøle cwølø bëët ni man nø cwøle ka nyeŋ gø. 'Ba kiper mana näk mo dööŋö mare ki teek mare opöödhö, bäŋ aciel dëët japøge mo rwäänyi.
english: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.

anywaa: Wui, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni bee u na jø Icriel, ?aŋø ni ŋuru ni kööu, ni «Waŋjöö marwa arwäänyö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö luup gïïa leth na en bäätwa ni pöödhe ki bäät Jwøk marwa ni käre ŋølø»?
english: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïn kuyu? ?Käru wïnynyö? Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk man wø bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni bee eni na cwääc piny bäre; eni dëëre ba øc piny ni eni ba ööl. Ena Jwøk mo tier leec wïc mare ba løny ki kwany.
english: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

anywaa: Eni cïpö ki teek jï jiy moa no ööl, ni ö ŋata bäŋ teek jïre ni mooc gø ki teek mo opöödhö.
english: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

anywaa: Këël wøpe kiree wø tïmö ni jägö ni dëëtge øya piny, ni ö obwöc cwøwi moa teek ni tïm tietge ni cwänyö ni ge päänhnhö.
english: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo wø bëëdö ni ge ŋäätha Wuuö Jwøk ge jïtö ki teek mo nyään; ni määtge ki bwöm kaamar odhuuth, ni rïïŋge ni ge ba ööl, ni cääthge ni tietge ba øc piny.
