english: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «U na wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, noukïïl nyïma ni cegu ïthu baŋa. Beerra man ö wïth juurre ni jïtge ki teek mo nyään, ni öge kany mo cään ni cäänge. Beerra man öge nee wa røømwa ki ge kar løøk.
english: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo tïŋ maal ki ŋat mo käla kur tuul-cäŋ, ni cwøla gø ki køør adïëri mare kiper tïïc mare, nee wïth juurre cïp cere, ni tïïc nyeye ni ena tiere, nee ge tïïe kaamar tør ko opëëllö mare, ni tïïc geni ka atheerø mare kaamar lethø mo okøøl apwøyaweerø?
english: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.

anywaa: Eni køørge orieme ni pöödhe ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëre, ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn mo gal wääth mare.
english: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.

anywaa: ?Aŋa na tïïc gïnögø na wëëk gø thur kare, na cwøl beenhnhe ki mana täge dïkwøŋ? Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na nut wïlöölö noo nut ya aŋuudi, ni bee aani na eni.
english: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.

anywaa: «'Ba wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ noo neenge gïnögø, geno put lwäyö, ni ö jøøa en teegi mo piny ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi,  ni cooŋge rege ni öge kany mo cään.
english: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋat atut man nø ni køny ŋat atut mare, ni kö ŋati man nø ki watge, ni ‹Mak cwïnyï!›
english: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

anywaa: 'Ba rëëmmö cwïny ŋat wø leeny warkey ocøme, ni ö ŋat wø den nywïëny ki guduum nee tïmge ni pøøth ni cøm cwïny ŋat thääth, ni ge köö jï ŋat wø kup nywïëny, ni ‹Tïïc marï beer;› ni ö ŋat gur ni put kït gïn wø lam cwöth piny ni teek, ni gur gø ki mucumääre nee ba pädhe.
english: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na dhaanhnha ma Icriel ni bee ï Jeekap na näk yaa jierø, ni bee ï na nyikwaar nyawatwa ma Eeberam,
english: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

anywaa: ïïna käla ki teegi mo piny, niï cwöla ka kany mo bäär døc, ni kööa, ni ‹Ïïna dhaanhnha;› aani, ï yaa nø jier niï ba kwiera këët.
english: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

anywaa: Kärï lwäyö, kiper a nut buutï, ni ba bwøk cwïnyï, kiper aana Jwøk marï. Ï tïïa tïïö niï teek, ni kønya ïïni, ni jøla ïïni ki cer cwïïa ni wø tïïya adïëri.
english: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, jø wø bëëdö ni manynya wëër ki ïïni bëët wïthge olääy ni putge nipäät, ni ö jøøa bëëdö ni gëëmö ki ïïni bëët ni rwäänyge ni tïmge ni bäŋgø.
english: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

anywaa: Jøøa män ki ïïni geno manynyï ni ba jootï geni, ni ö jøøa many leny ki ïïni ni tïmge ni bäŋgø na bäre bäre.
english: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

anywaa: Kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni wø jøl cer cwïïï, ni wø köö ki ïïni, ni ‹Kärï lwäyö, ï kønya kønyø.›
english: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

anywaa: Wui, Jeekap, ï na rööm twöŋö, ni bee ï na Icriel na thiinh, kärï lwäyö, kiper aani ki dëëra ï kønya kønyø. Manøgø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, na wïïl ïïni wøk, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ï tïïa tïïö niï caala gïr dïn man wø tut dhäki, na teeŋ gïr dïn mo nyään mo beth mo lage thööth, nee wïth kïte dwøgï piny ki gø, ni nyaaï thuuri piny ki gø ni tïmge kaamar lethø.
english: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

anywaa: Geno kwørï ni køøli ya jamø, ni puti ya apwøyaweerø keethø. 'Ba ïïni, yiï omïnni ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni jiemï aani, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: «Jøøa can ki jøøa no oööl ge bëëdö ni ge manynya pïï, ni ge ba jïti, ni ö lëëpge ni bëëtge no otal ki riew. 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, döötge wïnynya wïnynyö, ni kønya geni, ni ba wiia geni, a na Jwø Icriel.
english: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

anywaa: Aani näm wëëga kwödö ki bäät thuuri moa leer, ni wëëga pïï kwön wøk ki yïth gøli. Dïtëën tïïa tïïö na puul mo päŋ ki pïï, ni ö ŋöömma no otal ni wëëga gø cöödö ki jøør.
english: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

anywaa: Aani wïth jenni ma teeŋi wëëga tuuö dïtëën,  ni beege jenni mo perge leth, ki thëëbe, ki jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, ni ö ŋöömma no otal ni wëëga gø tuuö ki jenni mo bëëdö ni mar, mo bøøge moge ba øc piny,
english: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

anywaa: nee joot jiyi, ni ŋäcge gø, nee caarge ni kwanyge tier gø, ki man näk mo bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëra kiree na tïïc gø, ni bee aani na cwääc gø, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.»
english: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na nyeny nyïïkwaac Jeekap, aköö, ni «Caannu luubö maru, ni kälu gïïa näk cwïnynyu päŋ ki ge nyïm.
english: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.

anywaa: Kälu juu mou mo wø lammu, nee gïïo tägi yi nyïm caange jïwa, caannu gïïa no opöödhö, nee tietge kwanywa, nee wa cätwa kiperge na aŋuunge ŋäcwa, wala caannu gïïo tägi yi nyïm jïwa.
english: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

anywaa: Caannu gïïo en yi nyïm jïwa, nee ŋäcwa ni uuna juu møn; tïïu ki gïn mo beer wala mo raac, nee cwïnywa bwøkge ni lwäcwa.
english: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuna gïï mo bäŋ karu, ni tïïe mou bäŋ gïn duuge, ni ŋat wø jier uuni, ec raac ki gø.
english: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a tïŋŋa maal ki dhaanhø ki jï løø wï-piny, 'ba eno ööi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni cøøra nyeŋŋa, ni ööe ni nyør kwääri, kaaman wø ö dïcwäc dääe wø nyør odhöönh.
english: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar, and as the potter treadeth clay.

anywaa: ?Aŋa na cäänö kiper gïn ki mana täge dïkwøŋ, kiper nee ŋäcwa, wala caana gø ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe, nee wa köwa, ni ‹Mare beeye adïëri›? Ka adïëri møn, bäŋ ŋat mo ocaan gø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo okøp gø wala ŋat mo owïny luup mou.
english: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.

anywaa: Bee a na kwøŋ Dhayan na näk Jerucalem cäännö dïkwøŋ, ni kööa, ni ‹Neenï, gïïo tägi beege ii,› ni jääga baŋe ki dhaanhø mo køp luubö mo nyään mo met.
english: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

anywaa: Aana rääŋö, 'ba bäŋ aciel mo jaal dhee. Bäŋ aciel dï juu moøgø mo cïpi ka acaara, ni bäŋ aciel mo oløk pïëc jïra kany wø pëënynya geni.
english: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ge patha adïëri, ge bëët, ni tïïe moge bäŋ tietge, ni kïtge moa no otïïö bäŋ tietge, 'ba ge caala jamø jaak.»
english: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, man beeye dhaanhnha, na näk yaa jølø, ni beeye na jiera na met yia ki gø; jwïëy 'moa okïtha bääte, ni ö eni ni tïïc ŋøl luup mana näk kare bäät wïth juurre.
english: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

anywaa: Eni ba lweelli, ni dwøre ba tïŋ maal, ni dwøre ba wïnynyi nyeŋ jïëthe.
english: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

anywaa: Eni otöök mo onyøc, ba toore, ni lamba mo manynya thøø ba nääe; 'ba ŋøl luup mana näk kare beeye noo tïïe.
english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

anywaa: 'Ba eni këël kanyo tïïc ŋøl luup mana näk kare bäät piny, eni ba ööl, ni ba døø ŋääe. 'Ba wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, ge bëëdö ki ŋäädhe ni ge køya ciik mo gø.»
english: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na cwääc maal ni ee peerø, na cwääc piny ki japa no otuy na en yie, eni na tïïc jiy nee bëëtge ni ge jwïëy bäät piny, na cïp kwøw jï jiy mo wø cäädhi bäät piny, ena köö,
english: Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

anywaa: ni «Aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna cwøla ki køør adïëri mara; ï maa maaø ki cerï ni koora ïïni, ni tïïa ïïni ni ïïna ŋato wëëk luumma tuuda ki jiy thur kare, ni ïïna tar kiper wïth juurre,
english: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

anywaa: nee nyeŋ cööye japï, nee jiy moa no otwöö uut tööc nee ge pätï, ni beege jø wø bëëdö kwör tööc moa cøl yi muudhö.
english: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

anywaa: «Aani, aana Wuuö Jwøk, ni manøgø beeye nyeŋŋa; ajiem mara ba wëëga ŋat mør, ni pwøc mara ba wëëga kït gïï wø lam.
english: I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jammi moa caana dïkwøŋ anø tägö; 'ba ennø, u cäänna cäännö ki jammi møøk mo nyärö. 'Ba kanyo pootge ni kär tägö, caana caanø jïïu.»
english: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

anywaa: Wärru ki duut mo nyään jï Wuuö Jwøk, wärru nou pwøya nyeŋŋe, u ni en teegi mo piny! Pwøyu nyeŋŋe, u ni wø cäädhi dï naama dwøŋ, ki gïï wø en yi naama dwøŋ bëët. Pwøyu nyeŋŋe, u na wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, ki u jø wø en yïthge bëët.
english: Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

anywaa: Beerra man ö paana näk dïtëën ki päänye moa en yie ni tïŋge döötge maal ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk; beerra man ö atude mo wø bëët jø Këdar yïthge ni mïn yïthge. Beerra man ö jø wø bëëdö Cela ni wärge ni döötge ena maal; beerra man kwöŋge ki met ec ni ge ena wïth kïte.
english: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

anywaa: Beerra man ö geni ni pwøcge Wuuö Jwøk, ni caange ajiem mar gø jï wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ.
english: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dønynya wøk kaamar oteen leny, eni këëyö mare nyoodhe nyoodhø kaamar ŋat leny; eni twäätö ri leny, twäätö møn ni dwøre ena maal. Eni ööa maal bäät nyïïmän moe ni bööt geni.
english: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aana bëëdö ki kany mo bäär naa lïŋö, aana bëëdö ni aano nikïïl ni dëëra yaa juunynyö. 'Ba ennø, kaaman wø tïïc dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri, aani, a köök ni jwëëya døc ni laba ree.
english: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

anywaa: Kïte ki thuuri wëëga pädhö, ni ö japa no otuy bäätge bëët ni talge; näm wëëga dwön ni ŋørge ni tïmge na acuul, ni taala pulli.
english: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

anywaa: Cööye bwødha bwødhø ki waŋjöö mo kucge, ge pieya pieyø ki nyeŋ jïëthe mo kucge. Muudhö tïïa tïïö na tar nyïmge,  ni ö kwöra gwalli øtjöö ni tïïa ge ni pøøth. Gïïögøøni beege noo tïïa, ni ge ba wïïa jaak ni kära tïïö.
english: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø ŋääth juu mo wø tïïc ki ceŋ, ni wø köö jï kït gïï wø lam, ni ‹Uuna juu mowa,› ge dwøga ŋäthge ki lään wïc mo dwøŋ.»
english: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Wïnynyu, u na meŋŋe ii! Raŋŋu, u na cööye ii, nee jootu.
english: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

anywaa: ?Aŋa na cwør ni kaala dhaanhnha, wala na miiŋ ni caala eni na jääŋŋa? ?Aŋa na cwør ni caal eni na bëëdö ki bëët-mëër ki aani en, wala mo caala eni na dhaanhnha, a na Wuuö Jwøk?
english: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the Lord's servant?

anywaa: «Uuna rääŋö ki jammi mo thööth, 'ba tietge käru kwanyø; ïthu bëëdö ni ŋammø, 'ba bäŋ gïï mo wïnynyu.»
english: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk yie amïnnö ki køør adïëri mare ki man tïïc ciik moe ni pere leth, ni ee jiemø.
english: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø, gena wï jur mo omaa ki tøŋ ni twier geni, ge bëët, gena leeŋ yïth buri, ni kaan geni uut tööc; gena mak ki tøŋ ni bäŋ ŋat mo owïïl geni wøk, ni käl geni ni bäŋ ŋat mo oköö, ni «Duu geni.»
english: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

anywaa: ?Aŋa dïïu noo wïny gïn, wala cega ïthe ki luup moo en yi nyïm?
english: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

anywaa: ?Aŋa na tïïc Jeekap nee mak ki tøŋ? ?Aŋa na tïïc eni na Icriel nee twier? ?Aŋø, patha Wuuö Jwøk na bääyø dëëre, na kweerø ki man cäädhø ki uutjïëthe moe, na kweerø ki man jïëø ciik moe?
english: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac, na caal mäc leny, akøny bäätø, ø na jø Icriel, ni wëëk maac liel ki deŋ Icriel bäre; 'ba øøna bëëdö ni tier gø poot ba kwanyø. Øøna waaŋ Wuuö Jwøki ki maac, ni bëëdø ni bäŋ gïn mo caarø kiper gïna tägö.
english: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Jeekap, Wuuö Jwøk na cwääc ïïni, na tïïc ïïni, ï na Icriel, ena köö, ni «Kärï lwäyö, kiper ïïna nø wïïla wøk, ïïna nø cwøla ki nyeŋŋï, ni ïïna thööŋŋa!
english: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

anywaa: Kany wø cäädhï yïth pïï, aano bëëdö naa nut buutï; ni kany wø cäädhï yïth näm, ï ba køøl pïïyi. Kany wø cørï yi maac, ï ba waaŋ, niï ba gut leep maaci.
english: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

anywaa: Kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere bee aani na pïëmï marï. Ijep anø coola karï, ni ö Kuuci ki Ceba ni nø wiila ge ki ïïni.
english: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

anywaa: Kiper mana näk mo perï leth jïra, ni ïïno wøørø, naa mëër ki ïïni, jiy møøk laa karï, naa coola wïth juurre kar jwïëy moï.
english: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

anywaa: Kärï lwäyö, kiper a nut buutï; jiy moo käl riï tïïa tïïö nee öge ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni cuuŋa uuni ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

anywaa: Caana caanø jï wï-piny, ni kööa, ni ‹Cïp geni!› Ni caana gø jï tier-piny, ni kööa, ni ‹Ge kär mänï. Duu wääta ki kwöra enge yie na bäär, ni duuï nyïïa ki yïth teegi mo piny,
english: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

anywaa: ni beege jiy bëët moa näk cwøla ri nyeŋŋa, na cwääa kiper ajiem mara, ni beege moa tïïa ki cera kiree.› »
english: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

anywaa: Käl jiy wøk moa näk nyeŋge dagø, 'ba gena cööye; ni kälï jiy wøk moa näk da ïdhi jïge, 'ba gena meŋŋe.
english: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

anywaa: Wïth juurre bëët dëëtge anø dwalge, ni cooŋge dëëtge kanya ciel. ?Aŋa dëëtge noo caan tier gïn en, noo køp gïïa dïkwøŋ jïïø? Beerra man känge ki jiy mo tier gïnögø ŋäcge naa adïëri marge ŋäc, nee wïny jiyi ni köge, ni «Bee kare.»
english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Uuni, uuna jiya moa ŋäc tier gïnögø ni wø caan gø. Ni bee u na jiya moa näk yaa nø jier, ki man ŋäyu aani ni ŋääthu aani, ki man kwanynyu tiere ni bee aani na eni. Bäŋ Jwøk mør mo onut dïkwøŋ, ni bäŋ gø këët mo öö køøra.
english: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

anywaa: Aani, bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk; ni bäŋ pïëmi mør këët ni näk mo paa aani.
english: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.

anywaa: Bee aani na nø køp gïno tïïa, ni piema uuni, ni caana tier gø, ni bäŋ jwøk mo path mo obëëdö yïthakiyu. Kiper manøgønø, uuna jøøa ŋäc tier gïnögø ni wø caan gø. Manøgø beeye dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Bee aani na Jwøk.
english: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.

anywaa: Ki mana täge cøøn bee aani na eni, ni bäŋ ŋat mør mo piema dhaanhø cera. Aani, mara wø tïïa tïïö, ?'ba aŋa ni wø wiil gø?»
english: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

anywaa: Man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere na wïïl u wøk, ena köö, na «A jääga Babiløn ki jø leny kiperu, ni ö jø Kaldia bëët ni päärge wøk, ni ge aay ka baabuure mo wø töötge kiperge.
english: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

anywaa: Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru na en kur keere, ni bee aani na nyeya maru na cwääc Icriel.»
english: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

anywaa: Man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na tïïö ki jöö mo cøra dï naama dwøŋ, ni beeye jöö mo cøra dï pïï mo kwödö ni teek,
english: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

anywaa: na tïïc jïëth okwëënyi mo leny, ko okwëënyi, ki jø leny ko otëëk leny nee öge; 'ba geni, gena put päänhnhö ni ge kär duu maal këët, ni putge thøø kaamar maac mo obïbö;
english: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Kär wïthu parru ki gïïa dïkwøŋ, ni ba lääŋŋu jammi moa no opöödhö.
english: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani, da gïn mo tïïa tïïö mo nyään, gïneca tägö ennø. ?Aŋø, 'ba nëëni jïïu? Aani da jöö mo tïïa tïïö mo cøra paaba näk tëën, ni tïïa ki näm mo cøra paaba no otal.
english: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

anywaa: 'Ba lääc paap aano jiemge, ni beege orude ki ude, kiper pïï moa cïba paaba näk tëën, ki näm moa tïïa paaba no otal, naa mooya jiya moa näk yaa jierø ki gïn maathge.
english: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

anywaa: Jiya moa tïïa kiper dëëra ajiem mara caange caanø.
english: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jeekap, nyeŋŋa kärï cwølø. Wui, ï na Icriel, ïïna jøøm ki aani.
english: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

anywaa: Bäŋ dïëk mo iï cïbö jïra no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, naa kärï wøørø ko olämme moï møga. Yiï kära cwaadø ki man cïpï ki muuce mo beel, niï kära öölö ki man cïpï ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.
english: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

anywaa: Bäŋ teeŋ thieŋ mo wø ŋwääi ni met mo iï ŋeeø ki gwel jïra, ni bäŋ dwäle mo olämme moï mo yia iï tïïö ni met ki ge. 'Ba yia acwaatï ki raay moï, ni öölï a ki gïïa bayï.
english: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

anywaa: «'Ba bee aani ki dëëra kiree ni wø wëën raay moï bëët kiper nyeŋŋa; ni wïïa ba para ki raay moï këët.
english: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

anywaa: Par wïïa ki japa no opöödhö, ni carø luup 'moø na aciel. Caan luubö marï nee ŋäc ni marï adïëri.
english: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

anywaa: Kwaru mana dïkwøŋ atïïö ki raay, ni ö jøøa cäänö na karï ni bääcge dëëra.
english: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, dïlämme moa kwörge døøŋŋø mo wø tïïö kanya en kur keere, otïïa nee bëëtge ni ba waany. Nyïïkwaac Jeekap ocïba nee ge 'näk, ni tïïa geni na jø Icriel nee ge jøøŋŋi.
english: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, cek ïthï, ï na dhaanhnha ma Jeekap,  ni bee ï Icriel na näk yaa nø jier.
english: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na tïïc ïïni, na cwääc ïïni ec, eni noo køny ïïni, ena köö, ‹Wui, dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, ni bee ï Jecurun na näk yaa nø jier, kärï lwäyö.
english: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

anywaa: Kiper aani pïï otïïa nee kwötge ki yi ŋöömma no onäk riewi, ni tïïa nyeŋ näm ni kwödö ki yi ŋöömma no otal. Jwïëy 'moa ojääŋŋa bäät jø okäl dëërï, ni bëët gwïëthi mara ni ena bäät nyïïkwaayï;
english: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

anywaa: ni ö geni ni tïmge kaamar gïï mo tuul wøk ka yïthakic luum, ni caala jenni mo ena deŋ naam.›
english: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

anywaa: 'Ba ki dï jøøgø, ŋat mør köö, ni ‹Aana mar Wuuö Jwøk;› ni ö maya ni cwøl nyeŋŋe ri Jeekap; ni ö mørri ni gööt cere, ni ‹Manna mar Wuuö Jwøk,› ni cak nyeŋ Icriel na nyeŋ mo owøørø.»
english: One shall say, I am the Lord's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na nyeny Icriel, na wïïl jø Icriel wøk, ni bee eni na Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, «Bee aani na wïlöölö ni näga aŋuudi, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa aani.
english: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni caal aani? Beerra man ö ŋateca ni køp mare ni caan gø; beerra man peeth gø nyïma na kare, ni caan gïïa tägö bëët ki mana täge ki kanya këëlla tier wï jur piny ki kany mo bäär cøøn. Ni put gïno tägi yi nyïm caan jïge thuwø.
english: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

anywaa: Käru bwøk ni ba lwäyu. ?Aŋø, kära caanø jïïu ni køba gø ki mana täge kany mo bäär cøøn? 'Ba uuni bee u na ŋäc tiet jammi 'moa ni wø caan gø! ?Aŋø, da jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa aani? Ka adïëri møn, bäŋ Kïdi mør këët; bäŋ aciel mo ŋääa.»
english: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.

anywaa: Jø wø tëëŋö ki kït gïï wø lam, ge bëët bäŋ karge, ni jap wø perge leth jïge bäŋ gïn duuge, ni këël jiy moa køp ni tiet gïïögø ŋäcge, tïmö ni gïïögø kucge, ni kärge neenø, ni put tïmö na lään wïc jïge.
english: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni wø tïïö ki kït jwøk, ni wø tieŋ kït gïn wø lam mo bäŋ gïn duue dëëre?
english: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, geni ki jø wø wøør kït gïïögø, wïthge olääy, kiper jø wø tëëŋö, gena jiy jaak. Beerra man cooŋge dëëtge, beerra man öge maal, beerra man tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi ki lwär, beerra man wëëk geni bëët lään wïc.
english: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

anywaa: Rëëmmö man wø thädhö ki nywïëny, nywïënyö wø di thäädhö ni tïïe ka maac, ni thääth gø ki nyööl na kït gïn wø lam, ni tïïe ka cere na teek. 'Ba eni thuwø wø näk käci nääö ni tïm dëëre ni jääk; ni nägi ya riewi kiper mana käre mäthö ki pïï.
english: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

anywaa: Ŋat mør tieŋa jaath, ni røm gø ki thøør røm, ni kiiw gø ki belø, ni tieŋ gø ki dïnöök, ni røm gø ki gïr røm, ni tïïc gø na kït dhaanhø, ni mïërö ni caala dhaanhø, nee tïme ni bëëdö yi øtø.
english: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, teeŋ ŋatøgø jer lur Libaanø mo bäyö wø ŋøde piny kipere, ni jier teeŋ jenni moa teek møga nee bëëtge dï lul jïre kaace. Ni ö eni ni piith jaath lur Libaanø, ni tïïyi ya køthi nee døøŋŋe.
english: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

anywaa: Køøre nø, tïmö na jer maac jï dhaanhø. Møøk wø lwøre lwørø ni juŋe ki ge, ni äp møga ni thaal cam ki ge; ni tieŋ mør na kït gïn wø lam, ni wøør gø. Eni kït gïn wø lam wø di tieŋø møn, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm gø.
english: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

anywaa: Thäk jenni møga wø kïthe maac; ni bul rïŋö ki ge ni cam gø ni jääŋe. Eni thuwø wø juŋö ki maac ni kööe, ni «Yaa, dëëra amurrö, maac apwøa møn.»
english: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

anywaa: 'Ba thäk møga wø di tïïö na kït gïn wø lam ni ee tieŋø na jwøk mare, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm gø ni wøør gø,  ni läme jï gø ni kööe, ni «Piem aani, kiper bee ï na jwøk mara.»
english: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

anywaa: 'Ba geni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge ni tier gø ba kwanyge, kiper nyeŋge omiiø nee ba nëënge, ni cwïnyge otïïö ni teek kiper nee tiere ba ci cwïnyge.
english: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo para wïïe, wala ŋat mo da gïn ŋääe, wala ŋat mo kwanya tier gø mo köö, ni «Aani, thäk jenni anø kïtha yi maac ni nø thaala cam ki cuk moe, ni bula rïŋö ki ge ni cama gø. ?A ennø, maya daa tïïö na gïn mo Jwøk yie raac ki gø, ni këëlla cøŋŋa piny nyïm gïn ma jaath jaak?»
english: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

anywaa: Teeŋ ŋatøgø tïmö ni cama bur, ni bee cwïny man wø cøøk dhaanhø na tïïc eni nee gaa wøk. Ni ba løny jïre ki man piem dëëre, ni dëëre ba pëënynye, na «?Aŋø, man paa tööt ni cer cwïïa en?»
english: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Jeekap, ni bee yi na Icriel, par wïïï ki gïïögø, kiper ïïna dhaanhnha; ïïna nø cwääa ni ïïna dhaanhnha. Wui, ï na Icriel, wïïa ba wïl ki ïïni.
english: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

anywaa: Gïïa reyø bëët na bayï anø paanya bäätï kaamar pöölö mo odhïŋ, ni nø paanya raay moï kaamar rwöc. Duu baŋa, kiper ï ya nø wïïl wøk.»
english: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

anywaa: Wui maal, kwöŋŋï ki met ec, kiper gïnögø tïïya Wuuö Jwøki! Wui, u na kwöra en piny kuya, beerra man kanynyu; wui, u na kïte, ki ï na lul ki jenni moa en yiï bëët, beerra man jøllu gø ni kwöŋŋu ki met ec; kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jeekap anø wïïl wøk, ni nyooth ajiem mare dï Icriel.
english: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

anywaa: Man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïïl ï wøk, na cwääc ïïni ec, ena köö, ni «Aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, bee aani na tïïc jammi bëët; maal apeera, ni tïïya a keera, ni peera piny a keera.
english: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

anywaa: Jø wø ŋwöö kiper ŋïïce moge, tiet ŋïïce moge tïïa tïïö ni bäŋ karge, ni ö adïëda mar jø wø dëëdö ki jap nyïm ni tïme na jap bøølø, ni tïïa jøøa nyeŋge reegø nee wïthge rege nootge, ni tïïa kwänynyö marge na bøølø.
english: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

anywaa: Luum dhaanhnha wëëga thur kare, ni ö luup jiy mo wø jääŋŋa ni tïmge na adïëri. Bee aani na caan luum Jerucalem, ni kööa, ni ‹Paanøgø jiy obëëdö yie!› Ni caana luum päänye mo Juuda, ni kööa, ni ‹Päänye moøgø di geerø!› Ni tïŋa ge maal ki yi ränynyö marge.
english: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

anywaa: Bee aani ni wø köö ki naama dwøŋ na päŋ, ni ‹Talï!› ni puta nyeŋŋi moe taal.
english: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

anywaa: Bee aani ni wø cäänö kiper nyeya ma Kiröc, ni kööa, ni ‹Ena dïkwääy mo tïnynya aani! Gïï wø manynya bëët tïïe tïïö.› Ni ö Kiröci ni caan luum Jerucalem ni kööe, ni ‹Pääny manøgø di geerø,› ni caan luum øtø mar Jwøk ni kööe, ni ‹Tierï mano geer ïïni bääte di caamø.› »
english: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï nyeya ma Kiröc, na näk ee røønyø na ŋat tïïc mare, na näk ee maaø ki cer cwïï gø, nee wïth juurre dïïme ki ree, nee teek mar nyeye lwøre, nee dhøk kiiri jap jïre ni ba cïëge këët; ena köö,
english: Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

anywaa: ni «Aano cäädhi nyïmï ni tïïa kwöra no opäny maal bëët ni rege päärö; aani dhøk kiiri moa no otïïö ki nywïëny moa näk jwëëlli tøya tøyø, ni ö nywïënynyi moa no orïïö ki dïge ni ŋøra ge.
english: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

anywaa: Aani jap kwärö moa no okan yi muudhö ki moa no okanø kwör mo kuc cïba cïbö jïrï, nee ŋäyï ni bee aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, na cwøl ïïni ki nyeŋŋï kiree.
english: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Kiröc, ïïna cwøla ki nyeŋŋï kiree, kiper dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, ni beeye Icriel na näk ya jierø, ni mooa ïïni ki nyeŋ wödö, këël na bëëdï naa kuyï.
english: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

anywaa: Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët. Bäŋ Jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa aani keera. Aani, ï mooa mooø ki teek, këël na bëëdï naa kuyï;
english: I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

anywaa: nee tïme ni løny ki man ö jiyi ni ŋäcge gø, ki mano täge ki jï løø kur tuulcäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa aani keera. Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët.
english: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.

anywaa: Bee a na tïïc tar na tïïc muudhö, ni bee a ni wø känni ki bëëtö mo beer, ni wø wëëk bëëtö mo raac tägö, bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø tïïc gïïögø bëët.
english: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.

anywaa: «Wui maalø, beerra man wëëgï bëënynyö ööny piny kaamar køth, ni ö pøølli ni jääŋ bëënynyö manøgø piny, beerra man ö ŋøømmi ni jap ree, ni ö pïëmmi man wø piem jiy ki gø ni tuul wøk ki bëënynyö na aciel, ni døøŋge ni jïtge ki nyïëdi. 'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, bee a na cïp gïïögø piny.
english: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni leth jï ŋat wø pïëmö ki ŋata cwääc gø. Eni caala dak aciel røk dääe mo bäät piny! ?Aŋø, dak doo köö jï dïcwäc dääe, na ‹Agïnaŋø ni tïïyï enø?› ?Wala gïn mo otïïö doo köö jï ŋata tïïc gø, ni ‹Bäŋ ceŋ jïrï›?
english: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

anywaa: Wui, otïmö ni leth jï ŋat wø köö jï wänni, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na mooyï ki jwïëy?› Wala köö jï menni, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na lwaarï ki gø?› »
english: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, na cwääc Icriel, ena köö, na «?Aŋø, a dou pëënynyö kiper gïïo tägi yi nyïm kiper obwöre 'moa, naa dou köömmö kiper gïïa tïïa ki cera?
english: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

anywaa: Bee aani na tïïc piny ni cwääa dhaanhø bääte. Maal apeera ki ceŋŋa, ni cïïmma gïïa en yie bëët.
english: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

anywaa: Aani Kiröc anø tïŋa maal ki køør adïëri mara, 'ba nyeŋ jïëthe moe bëët otïïa ni tiir, ni ö eni ni geer pääny mara, ni tïïc jiya moa no omaaø ki tøŋ nee wec, ni bäŋ gwel mo di coolø wala muuy mo dï cïbö.» Manøgø bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni «Jap kwärö mo jø Ijep, ki gïïa perge leth mo jø Kuuc, otïmö na moï, ni ö jø Caaba moøgø ni bäyö yøø ni öge baŋï. Geno cäädhi køørï ni geno twöö ki tiimme, ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïmï; ni cäänge ni köge, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, Jwøk bëëdö ka ïïni, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa eni.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Jwø Icriel, ï na pïëmi! Ka adïëri møn, ïïna Jwøk mo dëërï kanï kanø.
english: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø tïïö ki kït gïï wø lam, wïthge olääy ni tïm nyeŋge ni law. Ni ö geni bëët ni putge aay ni wïthge olääö.
english: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

anywaa: 'Ba Icriel onø piem Wuuö Jwøki, ki pïëm mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. Eni wïïe ba lääy ni waŋe ba tïmö ni law këët ki yïth cwiiri bëët na bäre bäre.
english: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, na cwääc maal, ni bee eni na Jwøk na cwääc piny na tïïc gø. Eni, piny akëël piny, ni käre cwääö nee bëëde ni ŋaam jaak, 'ba acwääe kiper nee beet. Ena köö, ni «Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bäŋ jwøk mør këët.
english: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.

anywaa: Aani a kär cäänö ni tiet luup 'moa yaa kanø, naa kär cäänö yi ŋöömö mør ma muudhö; a kär köö jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni ‹Manynyu aani kiper gïn mo bäŋ tiere;› aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a wø caana adïëri, naa wø køpa luup mo tiir.
english: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

anywaa: «Dwallu rou na aciel ni ööu! Nyänhnhu kany mo cään na aciel, u na wïth juurre moa no obøth. Jiy mo wø käär jenni na juu mo wø lam, ni wø lam juu moøgø ni ba kunyö yøø, bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge.
english: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

anywaa: Køpu maru, ni caannu gø, beerra man cäännu bääte na aciel. ?Aŋa na caan gïnögø ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe ki kany mo bäär? ?Aŋa na car gïnögø cøøn? ?Aŋø, paa aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk? Bäŋ Jwøk mør këët ni näk mo paa aani keera, ni bee a na Jwøk na näk mare adïëri, na näk pïëmi. Bäŋ Jwøk mør këët, 'ba bee a keera.
english: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

anywaa: «U na jiy moa en teegi mo piny bëët, ööu baŋa nou piem, kiper bee aani na Jwøk, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët.
english: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.

anywaa: Aana kööŋ ŋëëta keera; luubö manøgø anø duny wøk ki dhaa na adïëri, ni ba løny ki man døøe këët. Cøŋŋi bëët këëlla piny nyïma, ni ö lëëpi bëët ni kööŋge nyïma.
english: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

anywaa: Gïra caange caanø ni köge, na ‹Adïëri ki tëënnö joot ka ri Wuuö Jwøk keere.› Jiy ööa baŋe, ni ö jiyi bëët moa no owëër ki eni ni wëëk geni lään wïc.
english: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

anywaa: Ki ri Wuuö Jwøk nyïïkwaac Icriel bëët di ŋunnö, ni putge eni jiem.»
english: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

anywaa: Jwøa cwøl ni Bël cøŋŋe akëël piny, ni ö jwøa cwøl ni Nebø ni dwøk kööre piny. Kïtge moa no otieŋø akïth bäät dhäk ki lääc paac møøk, ni tïmge na tëër mo peek døc, ni duunne ki öölö mo dwøŋ bäätge.
english: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.

anywaa: Geni, kööthge adwøkge piny ni këëlge cøŋge piny ge bëët. Ni tïme ni kär løny ki man kønyge dëëtge, 'ba ge ki dëëtge kiree gena käl ki tøŋ.
english: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

anywaa: «Wui, jø dhi øt Jeekap, cegu ïthu ki mara, u na jø dhi øt Icriel moa no odööŋ, u na käära ki mana täge nou ena ec, naa poot bëëdö naa käära uuni ennø ki mana täge ki kanya nywøl uuni;
english: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

anywaa: këël mano pïïe ri cwiic dööŋö maru, aani, a poot na kara. Ni këël kanyo døøŋŋu ni wïthu da lwaar, u poot käära käärö. Bee aani na tïïc uuni; 'ba u puta ka käärö. U käära käärö møn, ni piema uuni.
english: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

anywaa: «?Aŋa nø ni pääru a ki gø, naa tïïyu naa röömi ki eni? ?Aŋa ni tïïyu aani naa röömi ki gø nou päära aani ki eni?
english: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

anywaa: Da jiy mo warkey wø kunyge wøk ki yïth opïri moge, ni rømge gwel-bïrö bäät gïr røm, ni cwötge ki ŋat mo waŋe riek ki tïï warkey, ni ö ŋatøgø ni tïïc gø na kït gïn wø lam. Kanyøgønø, cøŋge këëlge piny nyïme ni wøørge gø.
english: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

anywaa: Geni, gïnögø wø jiege göökge, ni käärge gø; ni cïpge gø kare ni put bëëtö ni cuŋŋö kare kanya en yie. Eni dëëre ba tuue kare kaace. Këël dhaanhø doo jwöga baŋe, bäŋ gïn løøe, ni ba løny ki man piem ŋatøgø cer gïna leth na näk ee jwørø.
english: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

anywaa: «Lääŋŋu gïn ni maau gø wïthu, ni putu gø kan cwïnynyu, u na jø raay.
english: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

anywaa: Parru wïthu ki gïïa no opöödhö na kwøŋ tägö cøøn, kiper bee aani na Jwøk, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët. Aana Jwøk, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør këët mo caala aani.
english: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,

anywaa: Gïno tägi ya aŋuudi wø kwøŋa ka caan, ni caana gïïa näk poot kär tïïö, ki kany mo bäär cøøn, ni kööa, ni ‹Luubö mara cuŋŋö kare na adïëri, ni wëëga gïïa met yia ki ge thur karge.›
english: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, da ŋat mo cwøla cwølø ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, mo käla paac mør mo bäär, ni ööe kaamar wenyø man wø cämö ni cwëëdhö, nee gïno manynya nee tïïe. Ka adïëri møn, luubö manøgø anø caana, ni ka adïëri møn, puta ka wëëk thur kare. Luubö manøgø ya nø cooŋ; ka adïëri møn, tïïa tïïö.
english: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.

anywaa: «Cegu ïthu ki mara, u ni wïthu teek en, ni karu bäär ka adïëri.
english: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:

anywaa: Adïëri mara nyïïa kany mo cään, ni kare ba bäär këët. Pïëm man piema jiy ki gø ba ruu. Pïëm man piema jiy ki gø kïtha yi Dhayan, ni nyoodha ajiem mara jï jø Icriel.
english: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Babiløn, päänya caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, dää piny ni pïï piny yi tør. Wui, ï na Babiløn, pï piny yïth ŋøøm jaak ni patha bäät wälu. Kiper ï ba cwøl këët niï mïërö niï jwøny.
english: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

anywaa: Lwør kïn guur ni gudï ki møø. Abïï man wø loop wïc käl wøk, ni jaarï thïnuura marï maal, ni wïïï tietï wøk, ni ŋørï nyeŋ näm.
english: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

anywaa: Dööŋŋö marï ki dëërï otïmö ni bäŋ gïn gëëŋ gø, ni ö lään wïci marï ni bëëde ni nëënö jaak. Kwör coola coolø ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëënna.»
english: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.

anywaa: Eni na wïïl øøni wøk, nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni beeye Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Babiløn na caal nyakøø, pï piny ni niïkïïl, ni ciï yi muudhö, kiper ï ba cwøl këët ni ïïna cuumi mar buc nyeye.
english: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö naa wëëyö ki jiya; wï jur mana näk ya jierø atïïa ni ba waany, ni cïba gø cerï; 'ba bäŋ bäth ec mo iï nyoodhø jïge. 'Ba gïna tïïyï beeye caarø mo teek mo caala tëër mo peek na kïthï bäät jäle.
english: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

anywaa: 'Ba ï poot köö, ni ‹Aani, a bëëdö ni aana cuumi na bäre bäre.› Gïïögø kärï maar caar, ni gïno duue dëërï kärï lääŋŋö.
english: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, wïny mara, ï ni wø mëër ki jammi mo dëël, ï ni wø bëëdö ni ba lwäär ki gïn mo raac. Ï wø cäänö ki cwïnyï ni kööï, ni ‹Bee aani keera, ni bäŋ ŋat mør këët mo kaala aani. Aani, a ba tïmö ni aana cï thøø, ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëët obwöre 'moa.›
english: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø na ariiø yøø puta tägö dëërï ni cwöba rïï ki dïcäŋ aciel keere. Obwöre moï thøw, ni dööŋï ni ïïna cï thøø. Gïïögø bëët tägö dëërï na kare kiree, këël na bëëdï ni jïrï da jap ajuuk mo thööth, ki teek mo dwøŋ man wø tïïyï ki køør thïëth marï.
english: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

anywaa: Ïïna bëëdö ni ïïno göök ri gïïa reyø ni wø tïïyï, ni kööï, ni ‹Bäŋ ŋat maa di joodø.›  Leec wïc marï ki kwänynyö marï, ïïna tïïcge niï gaaï wøk. Kiper ïïna nø köö ki yi cwïnyï, ni ‹Bee aani keera, ni bäŋ ŋat mør këët mo kaala aani.›
english: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï mo reyø otägi dëërï, ni tïme ni ba løny jïrï ki man kälï riï wøk ki køør jap ajuuk; ni ö gïï mo leth ni päthge bäätï, ni tïme ni ba løny ki man paanyï ge, ni ö ränynyö mo kanya käl yie kuyï ni ö bäätï ni cwöba riï.
english: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, put bëëtö niï poot tïïya tïïe mo wø tïïyï ki thïëth marï, ki jap ajuuk moï na thööth, na bëëdï niï tïïya ge ki mana kälï thïnhö; kanymør niï köö ni duunnö riï, ni kanymør jiy tïïyï tïïö nee lwäcge.
english: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna ööl jaak ka acaare moa thööth na kwanyï. Beerra man ö jø wø kwaan ceer, ni wø caan gïï mo poot ena nyïm ki køør ceer ki päär mar dwääy, ni öge maal kuna piemge ïïni cer gïno leth mano ö bäätï.
english: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

anywaa: Neenï, jøøgø, ge tïmö kaamar luum mo otal, ni waaŋi ya maaci. Geni, ge ba løny ki man piemge dëëtge cer teek leep maac. 'Ba manøgø paa maac mo di juŋö ki gø, ni paa maac mo pïïa piny deŋŋe.
english: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ gïnögø bee gïno tïïcge kiperï, ge na tïïï ki geni na öölï, ni marï gath ki geni ki mana tägï ki thïnhö. ŋati man nø dëëtge aay ni thääyö ki jööre keere. Ni tïme ni bäŋ aciel dëëtge mo piema ïïni.
english: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

anywaa: «Wui, jø dhi øt Jeekap, wïnynyu gïn, u na no ocaaø ri Icriel, na käl ri tuuŋ Juuda, ni wø kööŋ ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø cwøl nyeŋ Jwø Icriel, 'ba wø cwøllu ka jöö mo patha adïëri mo ba tiir.
english: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

anywaa: Uuni, dëëtu wø cwøllu cwølø na jø päänya en kur keere, ni göögu raa, a na Jwø Icriel, na näk nyeŋŋe bee Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.

anywaa: Aani, ki kany mo bäär cøøn, jammi moa tägö bëët ni poot ena nyïm, akøba. Gena cur wøk ki dhaa, ni tïïa geni nee ŋäc jiyi. Køøre gïïögø atïïa ni putge tägö ni cwöba røk.
english: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ni cwïnynyu teek, ni wïthu teek kaamar nywïënyö, ni teek wïc maru caala nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïïögø acaana jïïu ki kany mo bäär; kanya pootge ni ge poot kär tägö, akøba jïïu, nee ŋati man nø ba kööe, ni ‹Kït gïn wø lama bee na tïïc gïïögø; jaath mana tieŋa na kït gïn wø lam ki gïna leenya na kït gïn wø lam beege na tïïc gïïögø nee täkge.›
english: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

anywaa: Ennø, gïïögø anø wïnynyu. Neennu ge bëët. ?Aŋø, poot ba jïëyu ni bee adïëri møn? 'Ba da gïï mo nyärö mo caana caanø jïïu ki mano täge ennø, ni beege gïïa näk tietge okanø na näk kuyu.
english: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

anywaa: Gïïögø tägi ka kar kany ennø ni paa kany mo bäär; ni käru kwøŋ wïnynyö ya awääre, ni ba løny ki man kööu, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, gïïögø ŋäcwa.›
english: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø käru wïnynyö, ni tietge kuyu. Ki kany mo bäär cøøn, ïthu poot kär jäpö, kiper ŋääa møn nou doo tïïö ki riek waŋ mo raac døc. Uuni, u ŋäc ki man näk mo uuna jø ageem ki mana nywöl uuni.
english: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nyeŋŋa nø, wëër mara jooa jooø, ni cïba cwïnya piny kiper ajiem mara, nou ba ŋula wøk.
english: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, bëëtö mo leth akäla bäätu naa päära uuni, kaawat man wø leeny gwel-bïrö ki maac, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo beer mo yaa joodø baŋu.
english: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nyeŋŋa, a ki dëëra kiree, gïnögø tïïa tïïö. ?Aŋø, olønye nidïï ki man wëëga nyeŋŋa päät? Aani, ajiem mara ba cïba jï gïn mør.
english: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

anywaa: «Wui, nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni bee u jø Icriel na näk yaa jierø, cegu ïthu ki dwøra. Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na näk wïlöölö, ni näga aŋuudi.
english: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, piny acwääa ki cera, ni peera maal ki cer cwïïa, ni kany wø cwøla geni, ge puta cuŋŋö na aciel.
english: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

anywaa: «Uuni bëët, cooŋŋu rou ni cegu ïthu. ?A kït gïn wø lam mane na caan tiet luup moi ii? Eni na jier Wuuö Jwøki, mana many Wuuö Jwøki tïïe tïïö dëër Babiløn, ni ö teek bade ni bëëde ni ena dëëtge, ge na jø Kaldia, ni jääla ge.
english: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

anywaa: Aani, a ki dëëra, aana nø cäänö. Ka adïëri møn, eno cwøla ni tïïa eni nee ööe. Ni ö eni ni tïïc uutjïëthe moe nee thurge karge.
english: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

anywaa: Ööu ni nyänhnhu buuta, ni cegu ïthu ki luubö man. Ki mana täga cøøn, a kär cäänö ki luup mo tietge okanø. Kany wø täk gïrpinynyi, aani, a nutö kaace.» 'Ba ennø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aana jääŋŋe ni Jwïëy moe ena bääta.
english: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïïl uuni wøk, eni na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, ena köö, ni «Aani, aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ni wø pwöny uuni nou bëënynyu, ni wø bwøth uuni ki jöö mano cøru yie.
english: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

anywaa: 'Ba doo na gïïa köömma uuni ki geni you gwøø, bëët-mëër maru doo tïmö kaamar naam mo kwödö ni ba cuŋ, ni ö bëënynyö maru ni dee tïmö ni päl kaamar athaŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

anywaa: Jø oööi ki rou kwäänge doo tïmö ni thööth kaamar akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ, ni tïm kwään nyïïkwaayu ni thööth kaamar nyeŋ akwöö. Nyeŋge ba doo kïï wøk, ni ge ba doo raanynyø nyïma.»
english: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

anywaa: Ööu wøk ki yi Babiløn! Rïŋŋu wøk ki yïthakicge, ge na jø Kaldia! Gøøu luubö man piny nou kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni køpu gø, ni jääŋŋu gø nee pïïe bäät piny bäre, ni kööu, «Wuuö Jwøk jiye ma nyïïkwaac Jeekap awïïl wøk.»
english: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

anywaa: Geni, ge kär 'näk riewi kanya bwøth geni ki dï paap. Eni pïï atïïe nee kwönge wøk ki ri kïdi kiper nee maathge. Eni, kïdi akaae, ni put pïïyï ö wøk ni kwödö.
english: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Bëët-mëër bäŋgø jï jø raay.»
english: There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, wïnynyu mara, ni cegu ïthu, u na wïth juurre moa kwörge bäyö. Wuuö Jwøk aana cwøle kanya pooda naa ena ec, ni cak nyeŋŋa kanya pooda naa ena yi mera.
english: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk luup mo wø ö wøk ki dhaa atïïe kaamar opëëllö mo beth, ni ö eni ni kan aani tïm cere. Ni tïïc aani kaamar atheerø mo ojiedhø, ni put aani kan yi køp mar athëëre.
english: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

anywaa: Ni kööe ki aani, ni «Ï na Icriel, ïïna dhaanhnha, ni wø nyoodha ajiem mara ki dëëre.»
english: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö, ni «Aana ööl ki jaak, ni ö kwää dëëra ni øc piny ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, luubö mara ena cer Wuuö Jwøk, ni gïno cool jïra ena baŋe, eni na Jwøk mara.»
english: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na cwääc aani ec, naa tïma ni aana dhaanhnhe, nee nyïïkwaac Jeekap duua baŋe, nee ge na jø Icriel dëëtge cooŋge ree; kiper mana näk mo aano wøørø ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni eni na Jwøk mara bee teek mara.
english: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.

anywaa: Ena köö, ni «Bee gïn mo thiinh jaak kipera ki man tïïa ïïni na dhaanhnha, nee wïth tuŋi mo Jeekap tïŋï maal, ni duuï jø Icriel moa no odööŋ ni kwøw. Aani thuwø ï tïïa tïïö ni ïïna tar mar wïth juurre, nee pïëm mara man wø piema jiy ki gø nee pïïe teegi mo piny bäre.»
english: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïïl jø Icriel wøk, eni na Jwøa en kur keere; ni luubö manøgø caane jï ŋata no otaaø, na no okwier wïth juurre, na laŋŋø mar dïbwöthe, ena köö, ni «Nyeye ïïno neenge ni öge maal, ni ö kwääri ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni ge wøøra ïïni, kipera, a na Wuuö Jwøk na no oŋäädhö,  a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere na jier ïïni.»
english: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Ki kanyo näk ma kare, løk pïëc marï løøa løø jïrï, ni kønya ïïni dïcäŋo näk cäŋ pïëm man piem jiy yie. Ïïno gwøa ni tïïa ïïni ni ïïna ŋato wëëk luumma tuuda ki jiy thur kare jïge, ni cäŋï ŋöömö manøgø dwøk kare, ni tïïyï kwöra no odööŋ keerge nee cäŋ beetø;
english: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

anywaa: ni kööï jï jiy moa no omaaø ki tøŋ, ni ‹Dunynyu wøk,› ni kööï jï jiy moa en yi muudhö, ni ‹Nyoothu rou.› Geno bëëdö kaamar dïëk mo cämö ni yïthge met jaak thäk nyeŋ jïëthe, mo cam marge jootge bäät thuuri moa leer.
english: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba 'näk käci ki riew, ni ge ba gut lïëth pinynyi ki kwaac cäŋ. Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø cwïnye pädhi ki gïrge bee aani noo bwøth geni, noo nyooth geni baŋ pï jøør.
english: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

anywaa: Kwöra näk kïte bëët tïïa tïïö na nyeŋ jïëthe, ni ö nyeŋ jïëthe 'moa moa døøŋŋø ni thøri.
english: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jiya öö ki kany mo bäär, ni møøk käla jï løø wï-piny ni møga käla jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ö møøki ni kälge paana cwøl ni Cinim.»
english: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

anywaa: Wui, maalø, kwöŋŋï ki met ec! Wui, ï na piny, yiï mïnne! Wui, u na kïte, jøllu kwöŋŋö mar met ec manøgø! Kiper Wuuö Jwøk cwïny jiye ocøme, ni päth cwïnye ki gïr jiye moa no ocaarø.
english: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Dhayan aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk waana wiie; eni na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk wïïe awïl ki waani.»
english: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «?Aŋø, dhaagø wïïe wïl ki nyilaal mare mo dhøøth, ni cwïnye ba pädhi ki gïr wääde mana käl yie kiree? Këël dhaagø wïïe doo wïl, aani wïïa ba wïl ki uuni.
english: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, nyeŋŋu agööra thäc ceŋŋa, ni kiir pou ena nyïma cooth.
english: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

anywaa: Jø geer mou ge gëëdö ni ge läädö; ni ö jøøa raany uuni na dïïr wïthu ni wecge uuni ni aacge.
english: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

anywaa: Tïŋu wïthu maal ni lwïthu; jø pou bëët rege acooŋge ni ge ööa baŋu.» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Ka teeŋ man bëëda naa kwøw en, geni ge kïthu dëëtu kaamar jap mïërö, ni meenu ge dëëtu kaamar jap nywöm.
english: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.

anywaa: «Kiper kwöra no owiiø na no odööŋ keerge, ki ŋöömö maru na no oraanynyø, ka adïëri møn, otïmö ni thiinh kiper jø obëëdö yie, ni ö jøøa caar uuni ni tïm karge ni bäär døc.
english: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

anywaa: Obwöre moa nywøl køør jiy moa thøw, ge poot cäänö ni wïnyö jïïu ni ge köö, ni ‹Kany, thiinh døc kiperwa; wa mooc ki kany mo laac nee wa bëëtwa yie.›
english: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

anywaa: Køøre pääny tïmö kaamar dhaagø mo cäänö ki yi cwïnye, na ‹?Aŋa na nywøl obwöre moi jïra? Aana dhaanhø mo obwöre moe othum ki thøø, naa ba nywøl këët, ni aano kälö ni aano maa ki tøŋ, naa thääyö jaak. ?Aŋa nø na piith obwöre moi? Ka adïëri møn, aana dööŋ a keera. ?'Ba moi nø ge kälge kaa?› »
english: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, cera tïŋa maal bäät wïth juurre, ni tïŋa nyuudhi mara maal jï wïth juurre; ni öge ki wäätu ni käärge ka tiet jööthge, ni nyïïu käärge ka göökge.
english: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

anywaa: Nyeye otïmö na wëëe moo piith uuni, ni tïm gwaae moge na mëëe moo dhwøth uuni. Geni, cøŋge këëlge piny nyïmmu ni kuulge wïthge piny, ni täärnyïmge okëët piny yïth ŋøøm, ni naaŋge tør mana en tietu; ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk; ni jiy mo wø bëëdö ni ŋäätha aani, wïthge ba lääy.
english: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, jap twëër løny ki man lwøri baŋ oteeø, wala jiy mo omaa ki tøŋ løny ki man piemi cer ŋat mo wïnni?»
english: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni «Këël jiy mo omaaø ki tøŋ di lwørø cer oteeø, ni ö jap twëër ni lwøri cer ŋat mo wïnni. 'Ba aani, a ŋäbö ki ŋat wø ŋäbö ki uuni, ni piema obwöre mou.
english: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

anywaa: Aani, jøøa caar uuni caama caamø ki rïŋ dëëtge keerge, ni wëëga ge meerø ki remø marge keerge ni caala man wø meerø ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo keec døc. Ni puti ya jiyi bëët ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na pïëmi maru, na wïïl uuni wøk, a na Jwøa teek mar Jeekap.»
english: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, na «?Age wëël apääk mana riemma miiu ki gø? ?Aŋa na coola u baŋe kiper mana mäya baŋe? Uuni, u gath kaper raay mou, ni miiu riemmi kaper japa reyø na tïïyu.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni tïme ni kede bäŋ dhaanhø kanya ööa? ?Ni kanya cwöta, aperŋø ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ojïëy? ?Aŋø, you caarø ni bada ciek ki man cool kwöri mou, ni bäŋ teek jïra ki man käla uuni wøk ki yïth japa leth? Raŋŋu, aani naama dwøŋ taala taalø ki køør mano köömma gø ki dhaa; ni tïïa näm na dïtëën, ni ö reci moa en yïthge ni thøwge ki riew, ni ŋwääge no okwäk kiper bäŋ pïï.
english: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

anywaa: Maal tïïa tïïö na muudhö, keda dhaanhø mo oruyö ka abïï mo cøl kiper thøø.»
english: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aana mooe ki leep mo tiir ma mar pwöc, nee tïme ni løny jïra ki man wëëga dhaanhø mo oööl tëënnö ki køør luup mo wø caana. Eni, a jiee jieø cooth ka amöölla, ni jap ïtha nee ïtha ciia kaamar dhaanhø mo opwönynyö.
english: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ïtha ajabe, ni kära kweer ki man wïnynya luumme, naa kär døø ŋääa.
english: The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, dïŋääa acïba jï jøøa pwöt aani, ni cïba thäga jï jøøa cööt jïëc tïïa wøk. Aani, täärnyïma kära kanø ka abuua mana buu aani ki gø, ki laaw moa ŋool bääta.
english: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

anywaa: Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk a wø kønye kønyø, kiper manøgønø, wïïa ba lääy. Cwïnya amaa ki man jïënya gïïögø, ni puta gø ŋäc møn ni wïïa ba lääy.
english: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ni wø ŋun aani nut buuta. ?Aŋa nø noo pïëmö ki aani? Beerra man ö ŋateca ni ööe nee dëëtwa raŋwa ki gø! ?Aŋa ni many løøk ki aani? Beerra man ö ŋateca baŋa!
english: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

anywaa: Raŋŋu, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk a wø kønye kønyø. ?Aŋa nø noo jääl aani? Ka adïëri møn, jøøka ge ränynyö bëët kaamar abïï, ni ö geni ni cami ya alweela.
english: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

anywaa: ?Aŋa dïïu ni lwäär ki Wuuö Jwøk, na jïëc luum dhaanhnhe mana näk ee jierø, ni cäädhi ka yi muudhö ni bäŋ tar jïre? Beerra man ö eni ni ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde no ogöök ri Jwøk mare.
english: Who is among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u ni wø äp mäc, ni you wïrö ki deŋŋu, ni you rubö ni liel, cäädhu ki yi tar mar mäc mou, ki yïthakic mäc moa näk you rubö ki jenni. 'Ba gïno magu cera bee en, uuni, u pätha yïth gïï mo leth.
english: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

anywaa: U ni wø caath køør bëënynyö, ni wø many Wuuö Jwøk, wïnynyu mara. Neennu kïdi mana kälu ree, ni neennu kïdi mana kuuny uuni wøk ki dëëre.
english: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the Lord: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.

anywaa: Raŋŋu kwaru ma Eeberam, ki waŋu ma Ceera na lwaar ki uuni ki rääm mo leth. Kanya cwøla Eeberam bee eni keere; 'ba ena gwïëdha ni tïïa nyïïkwaaye ni thööth.
english: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk cwïny jø Dhayan di cømø; eni ränynyö mar Dhayan di neenø ni cøm cwïny jiy moa en yie. Eni kwöra näk otal di tïïö ni caala ajïniina mar Ëden, ni tïïc kwöra näk dïtëën ni caala ajïniina mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Dhayan ni jït yie ki met ec ki kanynyø, ki dwøk pwøc ki wär dudi.
english: For the Lord shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

anywaa: U na jiya, wïnynyu mara;  u na wï jur mara, cegu ïthu, kiper ciik ööa wøk ki baŋa, ni ö ŋølli mara na näk adïëri ni tïme na tar jï wïth juurre;
english: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

anywaa: Bëënynyö mara kare cään, ni køny mara cäädhö jöö, ni ö teek bada ni ŋøl luup wïth juurre; ni beege wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, ni wø neet jïra, ni ge koora teek bada ni cwïnyge da ŋäädhe.
english: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

anywaa: Tïŋŋu wïthu ni raŋŋu maal, ni raŋŋu piny thuwø; kiper maal rwäänyö kaamar jïrö ni wø maayi, ni räny pinynyi kaamar man wø räny abïï, ni ö jø wø bëëdö yie ni thøwge kaamar twöŋi. 'Ba køny mara bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö bëënynyö mara ni bëëde na bäre ni ba ränynyi.
english: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

anywaa: Wïnynyu mara, u ni wø caath køør bëënynyö, ni bee u jiy mo wø bëët ciiki 'moa cwïnynyu; kär nou lwäyö ki jø wø jøøŋ uuni, ni ba päth cwïnynyu kany wø janyge uuni.
english: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

anywaa: Kiper geni, ge tïmö kaamar abïï mo ocam alweela, ni tïmge kaamar jïëc rööm mo ocam twöŋi. 'Ba bëënynyö mara poot bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö kønynyi mara ni këët yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ö maal ni nyoothï teek mar badï! Ö maal kaawat mana kwøŋï tïïc yïth beenhnhe moa no opöödhö ya acääŋŋe! ?Aŋø, paa ïïni na këël Reeyap ki tøŋ, ni bee Ijep, na caal thwöra dwøŋ, ni ŋørï gø na thäŋi?
english: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, patha ïïni na taal naama dwøŋ, kuda näk päŋ døc, na tïïö ki jöö yi naamøgø, kiper nee jøøa wïïlï wøk nee ŋutge løøga ki yie?
english: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

anywaa: 'Ba jic Wuuö Jwøk na näk ee wïïl wøk geno duui, ni dønyge yi Dhayan ni ge wär ki dudi, ni ö met eci marge ni bëëde wïthge kaamar aduda na bäre bäre. Geno bëëdö ki met ec ki kanynyø, ni ö kïmmö ki cooyø ni daakge rege buutge.
