english: Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Bee aani ki dëëra ni wø cøm cwïnynyu. ?Aŋø, uuna jøøe, u ni lwäär ki dhaanhø man ni wø thøw jaak en, ni bee dhaanhø man no ocwääö kaamar luum jaak en?
english: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na wïl wïthu ki a na Wuuö Jwøk na cwääc uuni, ni bee aani na peer maal, na wëëk tier piny këët piny ni teek? ?Aperŋø ni bëëdu nou lwäär cooth ki wëër mar jø wø caar jiy, ni wø bëën aranya? ?'Ba age wëër mar jø wø caar jiy?
english: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

anywaa: Ki kany mo cään jiy moa no omaaø ki tøŋ, ge di pädö, ni ge ba thøø kwöra näk geno twöö yïthge, ni ge ba bööli këët ki gïn camge.
english: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

anywaa: Kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru,  ni wø jäŋ naama dwøŋ ni wø wëëk athaga lwör, ni nyeŋŋa bee Wuuö Jwøk, aani na wïth jammi bëët.
english: But I am the Lord thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The Lord of hosts is his name.

anywaa: Aani, luup 'moa akïtha dhøgu, ni rïëba uuni ki tïpö mar cera. Bee aani na cïp maal kare, na wëëk tier piny këët piny ni teek, na köö ki jø Dhayan, ni ‹Uuna jiy 'moa.› »
english: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, päyï! Päyï nø, ni ööï maal, ï na no omäthö ya athöönh wëër cer Wuuö Jwøk. Amaathï møn ni thöörï gø, ni put ïïni wëëk bøømmø.
english: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

anywaa: Ki røk jiy moa nywølï bëët, tïmö ni bäŋgø mo piec ïïni, ni tïmge bëët, ge na piithï, ni bäŋgø mo mak cerï.
english: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.

anywaa: Gïï na ariiø bëët ii, ööa bäätï, ni beege ränynyö mano raany pou ri leny, ki thøø mano näk jiy ki gø ko opëëllö, ki thøw käc. ?Aŋa nø, noo kïmmi kiperï? ?Na aŋa noo cøm cwïnyï?
english: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

anywaa: Kiper dëët jiy moï aööl, ni bëëtge ni geno päänhnhö nyeŋ jïëthe, kaamar aŋer mo omaa ki thøøl, ni ge bëëdö ni geno omeer ki wëëc Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye juuk mar Jwøk marï.
english: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u na jø Jerucalem na no ocaarø, ni bee u na no omeer, ni paa ki køøŋø, cegu ïthu ki gïn.
english: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

anywaa: Man bee gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, eni ni wø bëëdö ni pïëmö kiper jiye, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, athöönh wëër mana cïba jïïu, na tïïc uuni nou bøømmø, akäla wøk ceŋŋu, nou ba cäŋ mäthö ki gø këët na bäre bäre.
english: Thus saith thy Lord the Lord, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, athöönh wëër manøgø lwøra lwørø baŋu ni cïba gø ceŋ jø wø tïïc bëëtö maru ni teek, ni beege jø wø köö ki uuni, ni ‹Butu piny, nee wa cääthwa ki bäätu.› Ni tïïyu dïŋäthu kaamar piny, nee tïme kaamar øtjöö nee cäädhö ki bäätu.»
english: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

anywaa: Wui Dhayan, päyï, päyï nø, ni røøï teek marï dëërï! Wui Jerucalem, ï na päänya en kur keere, røø abïïgï dëërï moa beyø; kiper jøøa näk kär daŋø ki jøøa näk ba waany, ge ba duny yiï këët.
english: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jerucalem, ï na näk omaa ki tøŋ, teeŋ tør wøk dëërï nø, ni ööï maal! Wui ï na Dhayan na caal nyakøø, ï na näk omaa ki tøŋ, pät oguudi wøk nø moa no otwöö cwaagï.
english: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

anywaa: Kiper gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni «Uuna gath kaamar gïn mo bäŋ gäte, 'ba u wïïla wøk ni bäŋ gwel mo cïp.»
english: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

anywaa: Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jiya akwøŋ ci Ijep dïkwøŋ ni bëëtge yie; 'ba køøre gena caar jø Aciria ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere.»
english: For thus saith the Lord God, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö,  ni «?Ennø, agïne noo tïïa kany? Kiper jiya akäl jaak ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere, ni ö jiyi moa käär geni ni bëëtge ni ge kwöŋŋö bäätge, ni nyeŋŋa bëëdö ni di janynyø cooth ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jiya nyeŋŋa otïmö ni ŋäcge; kiper noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, oŋäcge ni bee aani noo cäänö; ka adïëri møn, bee aani.»
english: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.

anywaa: A teeŋ met ec mo nyïëdi ki man joot dhaanhø mo ööi ka bäät kïte ni käla luubö mo nyään mo met, ŋat mo køpa luum bëët-mëër, mo käla luubö mo nyään mo met mo beer, ŋat mo gøøa luum pïëm piny man piem jiy ki gø, ni kööe jï jø Dhayan, ni «Jwøk maru beeye ni wø käär piny na nyeya!»
english: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

anywaa: Cegu ïthu! Dïkuye mou ge kwöŋŋö; ge kwöŋŋö ki met ec ge bëët, kiper jootge joodø ki nyeŋge kiree kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo duu yi Dhayan.
english: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.

anywaa: Pänynyu maal, ni kwöŋŋu ki met ec, u bëët, u na en kwöra no oränynyö yi Jerucalem, kiper Wuuö Jwøk cwïny jiye acøme, ni wïïl jø Jerucalem wøk.
english: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk teek bade na en kur keere di nyoodhø, ni nëënö jï wïth juurre bëët, ni ö jø wø en teegi bëët bäät piny ni raŋge pïëm mare man piem jiy ki gø, eni na Jwøk marø.
english: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

anywaa: 'Ba u ni wø käär jap Wuuö Jwøk na en kur keerge, aayu, aayu, daagu rou kaagø! Kär dee gïn mo gutu mo ba waany! Dønynyu wøk ki yi paanøgø, ni døøyu dëëtu mo waany.
english: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba u ba aay nou rwäänhnhö døc, kaamar jiy mo kwala rege; kiper Wuuö Jwøk obwödhö nyïmmu, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, oen buutu ni koora uuni.
english: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the Lord will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rearward.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, dhaanhnha na näk yaa jierø, jammi otïïe na karge, eno tïmö ni ena maal wïth jammi bëët, no owøørø ni kare dwøŋ døc.
english: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth yïthge othäŋŋi kanyo jootge gø, kiper kïdö mare oraanynyø ni put tïmö ni ba caal kït dhaanhø; ni dëëre bäre ogwayø ni ba caal dëër dhaanhø.
english: As many were astonished at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

anywaa: 'Ba eni, wïth juurre mo thööth yïthge othääŋe, ni ö nyeye ni bëëtge ni dhøkge ege miiø ki luumme; kiper geni jammi moa näk kär caanø jïge jootge joodø, ni kwanyge tiet jammi moa näk kärge wïnynyö.»
english: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aŋa na ŋääth luumma køpwa? ?Na a jï ŋa na nyuth bat Wuuö Jwøk eni?
english: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?

anywaa: Kiper dhaanh Wuuö Jwøk na näk ee jierø adøøŋŋø nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kaaman wø løth bat jaathi ri gutö, ni caala lweet jaath mo tuya yïth ŋøøm mo otal.  'Ba eni ba nëëni ni kare dwøŋ, ni bäŋ kït mïërö jïre ki man mäk nyeŋ jiyi dëëre, ni kïdö mare, jiy ba tuude ki man raŋi.
english: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö no otaaø no okwier jiyi, ni bëëdö ni kïmmö ni ena yi bëëtö mo leth. Jiy bëëdö ni täärnyïmge løøge wøk ki eni, kaamar dhaanhø mo dëëre da täw mo raac. Ena bëëdö no otaaø, ni kärø cädö døc kipere.
english: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ŋwiili 'moø alwøre, ni ö gïïa rämö ki ge ni käär ge. 'Ba ø ki dëëtø, ø poot köö ni gïïa leth na tägö dëëre tïïya Jwøki, no oraany Jwøki, no ocaar Jwøki.
english: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, dëëre ajïtö ki ŋwiili ki køør japa reyø na tïïø, eni gïï mo leth apïï dëëre kiper raay moø. Gïïa tägö dëëre beeye na jïtø ki bëët-mëër ki køørge; ni bee ŋwiili moa pïï dëëre na jöön dëëtø en.
english: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

anywaa: Øøni bëët, øøna tïmö kaamar rööm mo orwäänyö, ŋati man nø dëëtø ena gak ki waŋjööre keere. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk raay 'moø bëët akïth bäät gø.
english: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

anywaa: Ena caari ni wëëgi jwør gïï mo leth, 'ba eni dhee käre tuuö; ena lïŋö kaamar nyidiel mo køøla baŋ ŋaal, ni neekïïl kaamar røømmø mo ena nyïm jø wø nyaar jïëye, ni dhee käre tuuö.
english: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

anywaa: Ena käl ni di caarø ni kïtha baŋ ajäla. 'Ba yi beenhnhø maneca, bäŋ ŋat mo ocädö kiper gïno tägi yi nyïm, kiper ena ŋul wøk yi ŋöömö mana näk mar kwøw, ni jwør gïï mo leth kiper raay mo jø pøø.
english: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

anywaa: Ena koony kanya koony jøøa reyø yie, ni bee kanya koony jøøa no okwär yie, këël na bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö, ni bäŋ cwøk mo owïnyö dhee.
english: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye mana many Wuuö Jwøki ki man wëëk gø caarø ni jwør gïï mo leth, ni cïp jwïëc gø no olämi man wëën bääyö mar jiy ki gø. 'Ba cwiiye otïmö ni thööth, ni neen beenhnhø mano en yi nyïm. Gïïa met yi Jwøki ki ge otïïe ni wëëk ge thur karge.
english: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Køør gïïa jwøre ki cwïnye, yie omïnni kanyo joot gïno beer. Eni na dhaanhnha na mare beer, ki køør leec wïc mare, jiy mo thööth ojïëe ni marge beer ki køør mana käär raay moge.
english: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, eno mooa ki kure dï moa teek, ni putge gø pääŋŋö na aciel ki ge na teek, kiper eni dëëre akïth yi thøø, ni kwaani røk jø adhala. 'Ba eni ki dëëre beeye na käär raay mo jiy mo thööth, na lämö kiper jø adhala.»
english: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Wui, ï na Jerucalem ni caal dhaagø ma bwøc  mo kär nyöötö ko obwöre, kwöŋŋï ki met ec! Kwöŋŋï døc niï wär ki met ec ni dwørï iï tïŋ maal, ï na näk mäc lwaar kuyï; kiper ïïni, këël na bëëdï ni ïïno dööŋ keerï, ïïno jïti ko obwöre mo thööth, niï kaala dhaagø mo bëëdö ka cwøre.
english: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Tïïc kar oduŋkaara marï ni laac, ni ö abïïe moa näk gëëŋŋe mo kwör bëëte moï ni twöï ge piny ni yïthge iï peerø ni døøŋŋø, ni ba lwagï ge; ni tïïyï thøøth oduŋkaara marï ni bäyö, ni cwödhï teegi moe piny ni teek.
english: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

anywaa: Kiper piny omayï ni këëtï bäät cwïïc ki bäät caam, ni ö ŋøøp wïth juurre ni dööŋe jï nyïïkwaayï, ni bëëtge yïth päänye moa no odööŋ keerge.
english: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

anywaa: «Kärï lwäyö, kiper wïïï ba wëëk lääö këët; kär wïïï laay, kiper wïïï ba lääy. 'Ba wïïï owïl ki laac wïc mar thïnhö marï, ni ba parï wïïï këët ka ajøøŋ mana pïï dëërï ki køør mana bëëdï kaamar cï thøø.
english: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

anywaa: Kiper aani na cwääc ïïni, a bëëdö kaamar cwørï, ni nyeŋŋa beeye Wuuö Jwøk, a na wïth jammi bëët. A na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, bee aani na wïïl ïïni wøk, ni bee a ni wø cwøl ni Jwø Bäät Piny Bäre.
english: For thy Maker is thine husband; the Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

anywaa: Ï na Jerucalem, ïïna duua baŋa kaamar dhaagø mo okwierø mo ena yi pänh cwïny, mo okwier cwøre ni poot thiinh.
english: For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

anywaa: Kiper aani, ïïna kwiera ki kany mo thiinh, 'Ba ki køør bäth ec mara na dwøŋ, ï cäŋa ka duu baŋa.
english: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

anywaa: Aana gootø ki gootø mo dwøŋ, ni kana täärnyïma ki ïïni ki kany mo thiinh. 'Ba ki køør mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl na bäre bäre, cwïnya cäŋa ka bääthö ki ïïni. Manøgø caana a, a na Wuuö Jwøk na wïïl ïïni wøk.
english: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø, gïno tïïa otïmö ni caala nïr Nöa, kanya kööŋa ni pïï kär ö piny këët na jwïïö. Kaawat manøgø thuwø, ennø, aana kööŋ naa ba gooti këët ki ïïni, wala man cäänna ïïni ki luubö mo teek.
english: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

anywaa: Kiper këël kïte doo dak, ni ö thuuri ni jäŋi, mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl ba dak bäätï, ni ö luum bëët-mëër mara mana tuuda ki ïïni ni ba ŋøle. Manøgø caana a, a na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø nyooth bäth ec mare jïrï.
english: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na päänya no ocaarø, na näk wïïï okier gïï mo lethi, kaawat man wø tïïc atuunna, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ocøm cwïnyï, raŋï, aani ï geera geerø ki kïte mo mïërö, ni ö tier kiir marï ni kïtha gø ki kïte mo ŋwaŋŋi.
english: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

anywaa: Uut koor moï geera geerø ki kïte mo kïtge kwayø, ni ö dhøk kiiri moï ni geera ge ki kïte mo paŋŋi, ni ö dëër kiirri bäre ni geera gø ki kïte mo perge leth.
english: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

anywaa: Wäätï bëët geno kwänynyi baŋ Wuuö Jwøk; ni jït obwöre moï ki bëët-mëër mo dwøŋ.
english: And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

anywaa: Tierï okëët piny yi bëëtö mo tiir, ni tïm karï ni bäär ki caannø; kiper ï tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo lwäärï, ni ö adigööŋ lwär ni daak ree buutï, ni tïme ni ba løny ki man nyänh buutï.
english: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

anywaa: Ni näk da ŋat mo tuga ïïni ki leny, patha a na tïïc gø; dhaanhø jaak mano tuk ïïni, pädhö nyïmï ni böötï gø.
english: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, bee a ki dëëra na tïïc rëëmmö man wø thääth jap leny, ni wø wëëk nywïëny ciek ki maac mo kwadhe ko opïri; ni bee a na tïïc ŋat wø räänyö, nee räänye.
english: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

anywaa: Bäŋ gïr leny mo di thäädhö kiper ränynyö marï mo thura kare. Jiy bëët moo kïth luup bäätï kar løøk böötï böötö. Manøgø beeye muuy mana cïp jï jic Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye na tïmö ni bëënynyö marge mana cïba jïge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Wui, u na no onäk riewi bëët, ööu kuna mäthu ki pïï! Wui, u na jïïu bäŋ gwel bëët, ööu ni lwötu ki caammi ni cämu! Ööu ni källu kwøk nyïïomøki ki caak ni bäŋ gwel mo pëënynyi ki uuni, wala gätge.
english: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni raanynyu gwetu jaak en ki ŋïëw gïï mo patha caammi? ?Aŋø ni wø kälu gwetu wøk moa jootu ki køør kwäk maru nou ŋeewa gïï mo u ba jäŋ ki ge en? Ennø, cegu ïthu na kare ki dwøra, ni cammu cam mana beer, ni mïn yïthu ki cam mana beer na kaal caammi bëët.
english: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

anywaa: Wïnynyu mara, ni ööu baŋa; cegu ïthu nou bëëdu nou kwøw. Aani a tudö ki luubö ki uuni mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ki køør mëër mara na näk adïëri na nyoodha jï Deebit.
english: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ŋatøgø atïïa na ŋat ŋäc tiet jammi 'moa, ni wø caan gø jï jiy, ni tïïa eni na bwödhi na ŋat kööm jiy.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wïth juurre mo kuue ocwøle, ni ö wïth juurre moa kuc eni ni rïŋge baŋ gø, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, a na Jwø Icriel na en kur keere, eni mooa mooø ka ajiem.»
english: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

anywaa: Manynyu Wuuö Jwøk kany poode ni nut en; cwøllu eni kany poode ni kare cään en.
english: Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋata raaci ni wec jöö mare, ni ö ŋata näk bëëtö mare ba tiir ni tiir acaara mare; beerra man ö eni ni duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Wuuö Jwøk bäth ec mare onyoodhe jïgø; beerra man ö eni ni duu baŋ Jwøk marø, kiper Wuuö Jwøk wëënnö mare dwøŋ.
english: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «Acaare 'moa ba caal acaare mou, ni uutjïëthe 'moa ba caal uutjïëthe mou.
english: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kaa teeŋ man bëëde ni maal kare bäär ki piny en, uutjïëthe 'moa thuwø karge bäär ki mou, na acaare 'moa kadha geni ki mou.
english: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö køthi wø pänhnhe ki maal, ni ba døøk jaak ni piny käre jwøø, ni ba døøk jaak ni jap piny käre wëëk tuuö ni ciekge, ni ba døøk jaak ni kär cïpö ki köödhi jï jø wø pïïdhö ni cïpe ki cam jï jiy,
english: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

anywaa: aani thuwø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luubö man wø ö wøk ki dhaa ba duu baŋa jaak ni gïna manynya nee tïïe käre thöörö, ni gïna jääŋŋa gø kipere käre wëëk thur kare.
english: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

anywaa: Kiper uuno døny wøk ki met ec, ni bwøth uuni ki bëët-mëër; kïte ki thuuri geno kwöŋŋi ki met ec nyïmmu, ni ö jenni bëët ni paŋge ceŋge.
english: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, otïmö ni tuya jenni mo marr mo bøøge moge ba øc piny, ni patha koodhi, ni tuc jenni moa perge leth ni patha otwel. 'Ba oput tïmö na gïn par wïc ki gø ki Wuuö Jwøk, na ŋïï mo bëëdö na bäre bäre ni ba ränynyi.»
english: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the Lord for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Tïïyu ŋøl ma kare, ni tïïyu gïn ma adïëri, kiper pïëm mara man piema jiy ki gø aløny ni öö, ni bëënynyö mara oløny ni kare cään ki man nyoodhi.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

anywaa: Gwïëth oen bäät ŋat wø tïïc japøge, ni wø laar ge mak, ni wø gwøk cäŋ jwömö ni ba pääde, ni wø män cere ki tïïc gïn mo raac.»
english: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

anywaa: Beerra man ba kö wëëllö mo odwätö ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk a ŋule wøk ki ri jiye.» Ni ö ŋat mo odïnö ni ba ŋure ni kööe, ni «Raŋŋu, aani a caala jaath mo otal.»
english: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the Lord, speak, saying, The Lord hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Jøøa no odïnö mo wø gwøk cäŋ jwömö, ni wø jier jap wø met yia ki ge, ni wø laar göök ri luumma tuuda ki jiy,
english: For thus saith the Lord unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

anywaa: a cïpö jïge ki nyeŋ ajiem yi øtø mara ki yi kiir mara, na nyeŋ mo wïc di paayø ki gø; ni beeye nyeŋ mo kaala obwöc cwøw ko obwöc mään moa dige nywølø. Aani, nyeŋ man wø bëëdö na bäre bäre ni ba ränynyi, cïba cïbö jïge.
english: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

anywaa: 'Ba wëëlle thuwø mo wø bëëdö no odwätö ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø mëër ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø wøør Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege jiy bëët mo wø gwøk cäŋ jwömö ni ba päätge, ni wø laar göök ri luumma tuuda ki jiy,
english: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

anywaa: ge tïïa tïïö nee öge bäät kïdi mara na en kur keere, ni mooa geni ki met ec yi øt lam mara. Olämme moge mo wø waaŋ, ki muuce moge, di jïëö ki man cïbi bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mara; kiper øtø mara ocwøl ni Øt Lam kiper wïth juurre bëët.»
english: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni ni wø cooŋ jø Icriel moa no okeethø, aköö, ni «Poot da jiy møøk mo cooŋa bäät jiy moa no onø cooŋ.»
english: The Lord God which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

anywaa: U bëët, u na lääc paap ni wø bëëdö yi lul, ööu ni cammu jiya!
english: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

anywaa: Jø koor mo Icriel gena cööye; bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge ge bëët. Ge bëët, ge caala guu mo dhøkge orïpö, mo ba løny ki man gucge, ge bëëdö ni geno butö jaak ni marge lääk, ni gena jiy mo yïthge met ka niine,
english: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

anywaa: ni ge caala guu mo owär mo ge ba jäŋ, ni ge caala dïkwääc dïëk mo tiet luup ba kwanyge. Ge bëët, gena gaa wøk ni aacge ki øtjöö marge keerge, ni ŋati man nø dëëtge manynya gïn mo joode kiper dëëre keere.
english: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

anywaa: Geni, røkge cøørge cøørø keerge ni ge köö, ni «Ööu, ö aa baŋ maath ki køøŋø, cøø mäthö døc ki køøŋø mo keec; diøø thuwø cäŋø ka tïïyö na ennønø, ni kaala mar dïcäŋi.»
english: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

anywaa: Dhaanhø mo beer thøw ni bäŋ ŋat mo kwany tier thøø mare. Jiy mo bëëtge beyø di kälö ni bäŋ ŋat mo kwany tier gø ki man näk mo ge käl kaper nee ge pääge ki raay.
english: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø caath jöör adïëri, ge dønynya yi bëëtö mo beer; ge jïtö ki jwöm kany wø bëëtge ni geno pïël piny ni geno thøw.
english: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «'Ba uuni, u na wäät jø thïëth, na wäät kääpe, u na wäät jø wø gath dëëtge ki käp, ööu kany!
english: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u buu ŋa? ?U ŋeethu bäät ŋa ni lëëpu you rwääö wøk? ?U patha wäät jø ageem, ni uuna wäät tööte?
english: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

anywaa: Juu mou na näk patha adïëri lammu nou døøa dëëtu ki käp tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny, ni nyïïu ŋallu ŋallø ni cïpu ge jïge no olämme deŋ nyeŋ näm ki tiet agäp-kïte.
english: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

anywaa: 'Ba uuni nø, japa wøørru na en yïthakic kïte moa pøøth deŋ nyeŋ näm, beege noo tïmö na mou, na kuru; ka adïëri møn, uuna cïpö jïge ki muuce mo kwøŋ mo wø køny piny, ni mooyu geni ki muuce mo beel. ?'Ba you caarø ni cwïnya daa warø ki japøge?
english: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

anywaa: Kwör niine mou you tïïö maal wï kïdi mo bäär døc, nou etha maal bääte kaace thuwø kuna cïpu ko olämme.
english: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

anywaa: Kït gïï wø lammu you cwöth piny deŋ dhøk uudi mou, ni manøgø tïïyu nou kwiera aani; ni bëëdu nou bëëdö ka dëëtu kwör niine mou. Kany wø cou kwör niine mou, putu ka peeth ni laac jaak, ni dëëtu putu ka raanynyø ki jø wø mëërru ki niine ki ge, nou raŋŋa dëëtge na näk bäŋ abïïe.
english: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

anywaa: Uuna ci baŋ jwøa cwøl ni Mölek, ni cïpu jïre ki mädhi ki riie mo thööth; jiy mou ajääŋŋu kany mo bäär døc baŋ juu møøk, këël mana pïïcge piny kuya kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

anywaa: Uuna ööl kiper waŋjöö maru na bäär døc, 'ba u kär köö, ni ‹Bäŋ gïn ŋääthwa këët nø.› 'Ba uuna jïtö ki teek mo nyään, ni bäŋ öölö mo you joodø këët.
english: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, aŋa na bwøgu ki gø na lwäyu ki gø, ni tïme nou cara tööt jïra en ni wïthu ba parru ki aani, ni bäŋ gïn caarru døøc kipera en? ?Aŋø, bee kiper mana bëëda ki kany mo bäär naa lïŋö, ni tïme naa ba lwäärru en?
english: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

anywaa: Aani, bëënynyö maru manø ni ŋääthu enø, ki tïïe mou, tïïa tïïö nee ŋäc, ki man näk mo bäŋ gïn mo kønyge dëëtu.
english: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

anywaa: Kït gïï wø lammu na näk you cooŋø, beerra man piemge uuni kany wø jwöŋu kiper køny. 'Ba ge poot käl jame kälö ge bëët; këël jam dhøk, ge køøle køølø bëët. 'Ba ŋato bëëdö ni ŋäätha göök mara, ŋöömö oci jïre, ni ö kïnna na en kur keere ni dööŋe jïre na mare.»
english: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk oköö, ni «Thørru jöö, thørru, ni jiiŋŋu gø, daagu jammi bëët mo wø cwany tiel øtjöör jiya.»
english: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na en maal na kare dwøŋ, ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni wø nyeŋŋe en kur keere, ena köö, ni «Aani, a bëëdö maal kany mo ena kur keere, naa bëëdö thuwø ni kara cään ki jiy moa näk cwïnyge opädhö kiper raay moge, ki jiy moa näk cwïnyge opädhö ki køør japa leth na pïï bäätge, nee jiy moa näk cwïnyge opädhö nee cwïnyge cøma, ni mooa jiy moa no ocaarø ki jwöm ki yïth cwïnyge.
english: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

anywaa: Kiper a ba bëëdö naa jälla geni cooth, naa ba gooti ki geni cooth; kiper noo nøøya ge, jwïëcge ränynyö nyïma, ni beege jwïëy moa cïba jïge, ge na cwääa.
english: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

anywaa: Aana gootø ki geni ni jääla geni kiper päl cwïny marge na raac, ni kana täärnyïma ki geni ni mara gootø. 'Ba këël na jääla ge, gena cäŋ bëëdö ni ge gaa wøk, ni bëëtge ni ge cäädhi ka køør jap wø many cwïnyge.
english: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

anywaa: Aani uutjïëthe moge ajooda, 'ba ge kønya kønyø; geno bwødha ni cäŋa cwïnyge cømmø, ge ni wø bëëdö ni ge kïmmö,
english: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

anywaa: ni tïïa ge naa pwøcge ki dhøkge, a na Jwøk. 'Ba bëët-mëër en jï jø wø kwörge bäyö ki jï jø wø kwörge cärö! Aani ge kønya kønyø.»  Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa reyø bëëdö ni caala pï naama dwøŋ mo leeŋ athaga leeŋŋø, ni ba nikïïl, ni bëëtö marge caala gïï wø reyø ko odhöönh ni wø leeŋ athaga wøk.
english: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk mara aköö, ni «Bëëtmëër bäŋgø jï jø raay.»
english: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Kwöŋŋu døc ni ba wëëgu döötu jook; tïŋu döötu maal kaamar dwør tuuŋ, nou cara bääyö mar jiya ki raay moge, ge na nyïïkwaac Jeekap.
english: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

anywaa: Kiper a manyge manynyø ki yi cäŋ cooth, keda gena jiy mo yïthge met ki man ŋäcge uutjïëthe 'moa. Dëëtge ege tïïö kaamar jiy mo caatha køør bëënynyö, ni ge bëëdö ni caala jiy mo ciik Jwøk marge kärge wiiø. A pëënyge pëënynyö ki man ŋunna geni, keda gena jiy mo ge mëër ki man ena buutge.
english: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

anywaa: Ge köö, na ‹?Aŋø ni wø ba neenï wödö marwa en kany wø kwierwa cam ni marwa wödö? ?Na aŋø ni wø ba raŋï gø en kany wø dwøkwa dëëtwa piny ni wa mwöl?› «'Ba ka adïëri møn, uuni, kany wø wödu, u tïïya man wø manynyu keeru, nou bëëdö ni jø tïïc mou bëët you thiel piny.
english: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, këël na bëëdu nou wödö, u poot pïëmu nou këëdö, ni dëëtu pöötu pöötö ka alööŋŋe mo reyø døc. Teeŋ wödö man wø wödu ki gø manøgø, döötu ba tïïe nee pïïe maal baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, teeŋ wödö manøgø beeye mana manynya, ni tïme ni beeye cäŋ man ö dhaanhø ni dwøk dëëre piny ni mwöl keere yie? ?Aŋø, beeye ki man ö dhaanhe ni kuul wïïe piny kaamar otöök, ni but piny yïth keece ki yi bur? ?Aŋø, manøgø beeye man wø cwøllu ni wödö, ni beeye cäŋ man wø jïëa, a na Wuuö Jwøk?
english: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?

anywaa: «'Ba wödö mana manynya beeye en: Beeye ki man pätu jøøa no otwöö yi bëëtö mo leth, ni kälu tëëra peek wøk bäätge ni wø caal jaath man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ ri puur. Beeye ki man pätu jiy moa no ocaannø, ni ö japa peek bëët na en bäätge, na caal jaath puur manøgø, ni kälu ge wøk.
english: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

anywaa: Beeye ki man pääŋŋu caammi mou ki jiy moa no onäk käci, ni ö jøøa canni moa näk thääyö jaak ni määnynyu ge ki kwör bëëte, ni ö jøøa näk cäädhi ka dëëtge ni runynyu dëëtge ka abïïe, ni ba løøu nyïmmu wøk ki tuŋi mou na näk rem dëëtu.
english: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïïögø tïïyu tïïö, tar maru rieny kaawat man wø kwäär øwi, ni ö kønynyi maru ni laar nicäär. Bëënynyö maru bwödhö nyïmmu, ni ö ajiemmi mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni en køøru ni koora uuni.
english: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy rearward.

anywaa: Køøre noo cwøllu aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aani döötu wïnynya wïnynyö, ni kany wø jwöŋu kiper køny, løøa løø, ni ‹Aani en.› Ni näk mo tëëra peek ni wø caal jaath man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ ri puur you käl wøk göök jiy; ni weyu jiy ki nyøthø ki lweetu nou jøøŋŋa ge;
english: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

anywaa: ni näk mo dëëtu you cïbö jï jøøa no onäk käci ki man mooyu geni ki cam, ni wëëgu jøøa näk ocaannø jääŋö kaawat man wø manyge, tar maru orieny yi muudhö, ni ö wäärri ni tïme kaamar dïcäŋ jïïu.
english: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, u bwødha bwødhø cooth, ni mooa uuni ki cam yi cäŋa kwaar døc dïtëën kaawat man wø manynyu, ni wëëga cuu mou tëënnö. Bëëtö maru tïïa tïïö kaamar ajïniina mo di jøøyø ki pïï, ni tïme kaamar jøøro mo pïïe ba tal.
english: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

anywaa: Jiy moo ööi ki rou, mïëri mo acääŋŋe moa no oränynyö odwøkge karge, ni ö kwöra no opädhö ri kiir mana no ojal ni tïŋge ge maal ni ge geera ge. Køøre u di cwølø ni jøøa cäŋ kiir mana no opädhö geerrø, na jøøa dwøk uutjïëthe ki uudi karge.»
english: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

anywaa: «Ni näk mo dëëtu mänu mänö ki man tïïyu jap wø mïn yïthu ki ge yi cäŋ jwömö mara na en kur keere, ni cwøllu gø na cäŋ met ec na cäŋa en kur keere na näk owøørø na mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wøørru gø nou ba cäädhi ka jöö maru keeru, nou ba tïïc jap wø mïn yïthu ki ge keerge, nou ba cäänö ki luup mo oballe,
english: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

anywaa: køør japøgøøni, u jïtö ki met ec baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk. U tïŋa maal bäät piny, ni wëëga u cam gïïa beyø yi ŋöömma ci jï kwaru ma Jeekap.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki ki dhee kiree.
english: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, cer Wuuö Jwøk ba ciek ki man kunye, eni wïnyö ni patha miiŋ;
english: Behold, the Lord's hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

anywaa: 'Ba bee gïïa bayu na wëëk uuni apääk ki Jwøk maru, ni kan täärnyïme ki uuni kiper raay mou, ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn wïnyi jïre.
english: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.

anywaa: Kiper ceŋŋu atïmö ni ba waany ki rem jiy moa kønynyu piny, ni lweetu bëëdö ni temma gïï mo reyø. Dhøgu päŋ ki luup tööt, ni lëëpu cara luup mo reyø.
english: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat mo caath køør ŋøl luup ma kare, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cäänö ka adïëri kar ŋøl luup. Uuna tïmö nou ŋäätha luup mo bäŋ tietge, nou cara luup tööt. Ni ö gïïa reyø na tïïyu ni tïme ni ena yïthu kaamar dhaanhø mo ena ec, ni puti nywøl na gïn mo raac.
english: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

anywaa: U tudö ki luup mo reyø ni caala man wø tøk tøŋø mar olwierø, 'ba ni näk da ŋat mo cama tøŋø manøgø, eni thøw; 'ba noo tøk tøŋø, ööa wøk no olwierø.  Ni päärru thøøth othïënhö ki man wenynyu ge,
english: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

anywaa: 'ba thøøth othïënhö moa wenynyu ba tïmö na abïï, ni ba løny ki man rïëpu dëëtu ki gø. Tïïe mou reyø, ni ceŋŋu temma gïï mo reyø.
english: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

anywaa: Tietu ŋwieya køør gïïa reyø, ni u wø lääta baŋ køny rem jøøa beyø piny. Acaare mou beege acaare mo reyø, ni uutjïëthe mo wø caathu bëët, u temma gïï mo leth ka aranya.
english: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

anywaa: Uuni øtjöör bëët-mëër kuyu, ni bäŋ ŋøl luup ma kare uutjïëthe mou. Uutjïëthe mou you tïïö no oköömmö, ni ŋat wø cør yïthge bäŋ bëëtmëër mo ŋääe.
english: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋøl luup mana näk adïëri kare atïmö ni bäär ki øøni, ni ö bëënynyö ni ba pïïe baŋø. Øøni tar amanynyø, 'ba jammi bëët atïmö na muudhö, ni manynyø tac øw, 'ba øøna tïmö ni ø cäädha yi muudhö.
english: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

anywaa: Øøna tïmö kaamar cööye mo thäämmö dëër øtø, ni thäämmø kaamar jiy mo bäŋ nyeŋ jïge; ni cwanynyø tietø ki dhöör cäŋ keda pinynya wäär, ni putø tïmö kaamar jiy mo othøw yïthakic jøøa teek.
english: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.

anywaa: Øøni bëët øøna jwöŋö kaawat man wø jwöŋ cwienynyi, ni tïmø ni ø ŋurö kaamar akuyi. Øøna bëëdö ni ø koora ŋøl luup ma kare, 'ba atïmö ni bäŋgø, ni manynyø man piem øøni, 'ba kare atïmö ni bäär ki øøni.
english: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa reyø na tïïø atïmö ni thööth døc nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö raayi moa tïïø ni jäälge øøni; bëëtö marø na raac nëënö jïïø, ni gïïa näk yøø bayø ŋääø;
english: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;

anywaa: ni beege tïïc gïïa reyø, ki mooŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ki løø nyïm wøk ki Jwøk marø; ka acoona mar caar jiy, ka ageem, ki car luup tööt mo wø cooŋø ki yïth cwïnynyø.
english: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

anywaa: Køøre ŋøl luup ma adïëri adwøk ŋäc, ni ö bëënynyö ni cuŋŋe ni kare bäär; bëët adïëri apäth piny nyeŋ jïëthe, ni ö bëëtö mana thïïŋ ni dööŋe wøk.
english: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

anywaa: Kare møn, adïëri arwäänyö, ni ö ŋat wø kwier bëët raay ni tïme ni di caannø.
english: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na joot gø ni bäŋ ŋøl luup ma kare,yie atïmö ni raac.
Ajoode møn ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo jooga jiy, ni thäŋ yie. Kiper manøgønø, bade na teek, køny atïïe keere, ni ö bëënynyö mare ni cwak eni.
english: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

anywaa: Bëënynyö arøø dëëre kaamar kwöt leny, ni ö pïëm man wø piem jiy ki gø ni kïth gø wïïe kaamar cöör; cool kwöri arøø dëëre kaamar abïï, ni rïëp këëyö dëëre kaamar aleeŋŋa.
english: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloak.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wëër, ni cool kwör dëët jøøa gëëmö ki eni, ki nyïïmän moe ki køør gïïa tïïcge; eni kwör di coolø dëët wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ.
english: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur pänhcäŋ ki jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni putge lwäyö ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ka ajiem mare; kiper Wuuö Jwøk öö kaamar jwïïö mo pänhnhö, mo køøle ka jam dhee.
english: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni «Da ŋat mo wïïla jiy wøk mo ööa yi Dhayan ni ööa baŋu, u na jø dhi øt Jeekap moa køp raacge.
english: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luubö mano tuuda ki uuni beeye en: Jwïëy 'moa na kïtha bäätu, ki luup 'moa na kïtha dhøgu, bëëdö ni ge ba ö wøk dhøgu, ki dhøk obwöre mou, ki dhøk nyïïkwaayu ki mano täge ennø, këël bäre bäre. Manøgø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, päny maal ni rienyï, kiper tar marï aöö; ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk apïï dëërï.
english: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, muudhö bäät piny aume, muudhö mo cøl ena bäät wïth juurre; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk ööa baŋï, ni ö ajiemmi mare ni nëëne bäätï.
english: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre oö yi tar marï, ni ö nyeye ni öge yi däär tar marï mano rieny.
english: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

anywaa: Tïŋ wïïï maal ni lwïthï, jiy moï bëët rege acooŋge ni ge ööa baŋï; wäätï gena cäänhnhö ki kany mo bäär, ni nyïï di käärö ki tiet jööthi.
english: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.

anywaa: 'Ba oraŋï ni mïn yiï, cwïnyï omïnni ni pääŋe ki met ec; kiper mano ö jap kwärö mo naama dwøŋ noo käli jïrï, ni ö kwärö mar wïth juurre ni ö baŋï.
english: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba athïrööle mo thööth ŋöömö marï opääŋge, ni beege athïrööle moa therø mo jø Midien ki jø Gëpër. 'Ba jø wø en Cïïba bëët geno ööi ni ge käädö ki warkey ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, ni ge pwøya Wuuö Jwøk ni ge køpa luubö mo nyään mo met.
english: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba pïïth dïëk bëët mo jø Këdar ogwäär baŋï, ni ö nyöök rööm mo jø Nebayöt ni kønyï riï ki ge; geno jïëc ki man cïp geni no olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ööa ni jiema øtø mara na näk øt ajiem.
english: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, moi aŋaani ni määdö kaamar pøøl ii, ni caal akuyi mo lääta yïth uudi moge ii?
english: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, wïth juurre mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, jïra oneetge, ni ö baabuure mo Tarcëc ni kwøŋge pïï, ni ge käla wäätï ki kanya bäär, ni wäätï gwet-bïrö moge ki warkie moge käärge käärö, ni ge ööa kuna wøørge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni beeye Jwø Icriel na en kur keere;  kiper eni ajiem mo dwøŋ acïbe jïrï.
english: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Jerucalem, ni «Jøøa path, kiir marï ocäŋge geerrø, ni ö nyeye moge ni tïnyge ïïni. Këël na bëëdï niï yaa raanynyø ki gootø mara, mëër mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïrï ki køør bäth ec mara.
english: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

anywaa: Dhøk kiir marï bëëdö no ojabø cooth, ni ba cïëgi ki dïcäŋ ki wäär, kiper nee wïth juurre jap kwär moge kälge jïrï, ni öge ki nyeye moge ni jøl geni.
english: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

anywaa: 'Ba wï jur ki buc nyec mano ba tïny ïïni, ge ränynyö; wïth juurre moo ba tïny ïïni wïthge dïdö na bäre.
english: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

anywaa: Ajiem mar Lur Libaanø di kälö jïrï, ni beege teeŋ jenni moa perge leth, nee øt lam mara nee tïïc ni mïërö ki ge, ni wëëga kar bëët tieta jiem.
english: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

anywaa: 'Ba wäät jøøa dïïm ïïni geno ööi ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïmï; jiy bëët moa taak ïïni, wïthge okuulge piny ni nuumge tietï ni ge wøøra ïïni, ni cwølge ïïni ni Pääny Wuuö Jwøk, ni bee ï Dhayan na näk mar Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: «Këël na bëëdï ni ïïno kwierø ni jiy omännö ki ïïni, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cur dïërï, ï na Jerucalem, nyeŋŋï tïŋa maal ka ajiem mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni tïmï ni ïïna kar met ec jï beenhnhe moo ööi cään bëët.
english: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

anywaa: Ïïni, jap kwärö marï ojootï baŋ wïth juurre ki nyeye, kaawat man wø dhøøth nyilaalli ki caak kö menni. Køøre, putï ka ŋäc ni bee a na Wuuö Jwøk, a na pïëmi marï, ni bee a na wïïl ïïni wøk, a na Jwøa teek mar Jeekap.
english: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

anywaa: Aani, a känna baŋï ki warkey, na kar nywïënyö ma jwïël, a känna baŋï ki gwel-bïrö, na kar nywïënyö jaak, a känna baŋï ki nywïënyö ma jwïël, na kar jaath, ni känna baŋï ki nywïënyö, na kar kïte. Bëët-mëër tïïa tïïö na gïn käär akwöma marï ki gø, ni tïïa bëënynyö na gïn bwøth ïïni.
english: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bëët aranya otïmö ni bäŋgø mo wïnynyi yi ŋöömö marï këët, ni bäŋ aranya wala dïïr wïc mo wïnyö dïërï, ï na Jerucalem; 'ba kiir marï oputï cwøl ni Pïëmi, ni ö dhøgi moe ni cwølï ge ni Pwøc.
english: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, otïmö ni patha cäŋ këët noo cïp tar jïrï, ni patha tar mar dwääy noo rieny bäätï; 'ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, aano tïmö na tar marï mano bëëdö na bäre bäre; a na Jwøk marï, aano tïmö ni aana ajiem marï.
english: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

anywaa: Cäŋ obëëdö ni ba pädhi bäätï, ni bëët dwääyi ni ba ci muudhö; kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, a tïmö na tar marï mano bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö nïr kïmmö moï ni thumge.
english: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

anywaa: Køøre jiy moï bëët otïmö ni beyø, ni ö geni ni ci ŋöömö jïge na bäre bäre, ni beege gïïa tïïa ki ceŋŋa, na caal jenni mo otøø ni løthge, nee nyeŋŋa jiem rege.
english: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

anywaa: Dhaanhø aciel onyaay na wï tuuŋ mo dwøŋ, ni ö wï tuuŋ mo thiinh ni nyaae ni tïme na wï jur mo teek. Aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, gïnögø laya layø, ni wëëga gø thur kare yi caanne.»
english: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.

anywaa: Jwïëc Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ena bääta, kiper Wuuö Jwøk aana jiere nee luubö mo nyään mo met caana jï jøøa can. Ni jääŋ aani nee jiy moa näk cwïnyge opädhö nee cwïnyge cøma, nee luum pät mar jøøa no omaa ki tøŋ ki jøøa no otwöö nee køba jïge,
english: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

anywaa: nee cwiino ö eni noo nyooth met ec mare yie, ki cäŋ ajäla mare, eni na Jwøk marø, nee køba, nee jiy bëët moa näk kïmmö nee cwïnyge cøma,
english: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

anywaa: nee jøøa näk cwïnyge opädhö na en yi Dhayan, nee ge ŋada ka aduda mar ajiem na kar mana bëëtge yi bur, ki met ec na kar kïmmö, ki pwøc na kar pänh cwïny. 'Ba ki køør bëënynyö marge geno cwøl ni jenni mo teek moa tøøk Wuuö Jwøki, nee nyeŋŋe jiem ki rege.
english: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.

anywaa: Køøre mïëri moa no oränynyö ya acääŋŋe odwøkge karge, ni ö japa no oniruuth piny no oränynyö ni tïŋge ge maal; ni ö päänye moa no oruuki na beet beenhnhe moa pöödhö ni cäŋge ge geerrø.
english: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

anywaa: Wëëlle otïmö na dïkwääc dïëk moge, ni ö jøøa pathi ni tïmge na jø puur jïge, na jø koor pwöth omøki moge.
english: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

anywaa: 'Ba ge na jiya geno cwøl na dïlämme mo Wuuö Jwøk, ni cøøri ya jiyi ni jø wø tïny Jwøk marø. Geno cämö ki jap kwär mo wïth juurre, ni jïëmge ki køør jammi moøgø.
english: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

anywaa: Geno jïti ki kurge mo opöödhö ri jap kwärö na kar lään wïc marge, ni jïtge ki met ec bäät japøge na kar pänh cwïny marge; ge jïtö ki kurge mo opöödhö ri jap kwärö yi ŋöömö marge, ni ö met eci marge ni bëëde na bäre bäre.
english: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Kiper aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a mëër ki ŋøl luup ma adïëri, naa män ki kwal, ni mäna ki gïï mo reyø. 'Ba ki køør adïëri mara, aani jiya ŋada ŋadø, ni tuda ki luubö ki geni mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaacge otïmö ni ŋäc ki yïthakic wïth juurre, ni ö obwöre moge ni ŋääi ki dï jiy. Jiy bëët moo joot geni putge ka ŋec ni beege jøøa näk yaa gwïëdhö, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.

anywaa: Aani yia amïnnö døc ki ri Wuuö Jwøk, jwïëya ajïtö ki met ec ri Jwøk mara; kiper pïëm man wø piem jiy ki gø, ki bëënynyö arøø dëëra kaamar abïï, ni tïma kaamar cø dhaagø thiinh mo wïïe ee kïthö ki jap mïërö, naa caala dhaagø thiinh mo dëëre ee jiiŋŋø ni mïërö ki nyeŋ tii mo perge leth.
english: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

anywaa: Kaa teeŋ man wø ö pinynyi wø wëëk jammi tuuö, ni ö ajïniina ni wëëk köödhi moa piith yie tuuö, Wuuö Jwøk bëënynyö ki pwøc wëëge tuuö nyïm wïth juurre.
english: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nyeŋ Dhayan a ba nikïïl; kiper nyeŋŋe, eni na Jerucalem, a ba bëëdö naa lïŋö, këël kanyo ö bëënynyö mare noo kwääre kaamar tiet cäŋ mo tuulö, noo ö pïëmmi man piem eni ki gø noo liele kaamar ameeth.
english: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, bëënynyö marï ojoot wïth juurre, ni ö ajiemmi marï ni jooti ya nyeye bëët; ïïno cwøl ki nyeŋ mo nyään, ni beeye nyeŋ mano cur dhi Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.

anywaa: Ïïno tïmö ni ïïna aduda mar ajiem cer Wuuö Jwøk, ni ïïna aduda mar nyec cere, eni na Jwøk marï.
english: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

anywaa: Køør man ï ba cwøl këët ni ïïna pääny mo okwierø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo köö këët ni ŋöömö marï bäŋ gïrpiny yie. 'Ba ïïno cwøl Wuuö Jwøki ni Dhaaŋŋa Met Yia Ki Gø, ni ö eni ni cwøl nyeŋ ŋöömö marï ni Dhaaŋŋa Nywøma; kiper Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki ïïni; eno mëëyi ki ŋöömö marï kaawat man wø nywøm dhaagø.
english: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi–bah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö dïcwøø wø nywøm nyakøø, ï na Jerucalem thuwø wäätï omëëyi ki ïïni; kaawat man wø ö dïcwøø wø mïn yie kany wø tïŋ cïïe na dhaagø thiinh, Jwøk marï thuwø yie mïnnö ki ïïni.
english: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, Wuuö Jwøk acïpö ki dïkuye bäät kiir marï, mo ge bëëdö ni ge rwääö ki yi cäŋ ki wäär bäre ni ge ba lïŋi. 'Ba uuni ni wø par wï Wuuö Jwøk, kär dee jwöm mo tïïyu kiper dëëtu,
english: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,

anywaa: ni ba wëëgu eni jwöm thuwø këël kanyo këël tier Jerucalem piny ni teek, ni mooc gø ka ajiem bäät piny.
english: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk akööŋ bäät cer cwïïe, ni beeye bäät bade na teek, ni kööe, ni «Beel mou ba cïba na cam jï nyïïmän mou këët; ni bäŋ juurre mo path mo mädhö ki kwøk nyïïomøki mo nyään këët moa jootu ki køør tïïa leth na tïïyu.
english: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo cooŋ beel, beel camge camø, ni pwøcge aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni jiy moo cooŋ nyïïomøki, kwøk nyïïomøki omaathge yi kal mara na en kur keere.»
english: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

anywaa: U na jø Jerucalem, cou dønynyu wøk ki dhøk kiir, ni tïïyu øtjöö ni leer kiper jiy; thørru jöö nee tïme na øtjöö mo dwøŋ, ni daagu kïte yie, ni mooyu gø ki ŋïï nee ŋäc jiyi bëët.
english: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk rwääö ni cäänna teegi mo piny bäre, ni kööe ni caannu jï jø Dhayan, ni «Neennu, pïëmi maru öö, ni käära jøøa ööle kiperge, ni beege jiy moa joode ni wø cäädhi nyïme.»
english: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø, ge di cwølø ni gena jiy mo ena kur keerge, ni beege jøøa wïïl Wuuö Jwøki wøk, ni cwøl Jerucalem ni Pääny Mana Manynyi, na Pääny Mo Kär Wiiø.
english: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, man aŋa ni ööi ki Ëdöm, ni ööi ki yi Bödhra ni eno ruyö ka abïï mo kwaar en? ?Man aŋa no oruyö ni mïërö ni cäädhi ni dwøŋ ki teek mare en? Ni løk gø, ni «Bee aani ni wø car luup ni thïïŋ, ni wø jïre da teek ki man piem jiy.»
english: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

anywaa: Ni pëënynyi, na «?Aŋø, abïïnï tïïyi ŋø ni kwaar kaamar abïïn ŋat mo nyïïomøki ee nyørø yi buur wø bii nyïïomøki yie?»
english: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

anywaa: Ni løk gø, ni «Aani, wïth juurre anyøra kaawat man wø nyør nyïïomøki yi buur-biic; ni bee a keera ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo okøny aani. Gena nyøra ki gootø mara, ni cwödha ge ki tieta ki wëër mara; ni ö remø marge ni neeker ra abïïna, ni put dëër abïïna bäre gääbö ki gø.
english: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

anywaa: Kiper cäŋ mara mar cuut kwör nut cwïnya, ni cwiino wïïla jiya wøk yie anø öö.
english: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

anywaa: Aana rääŋö, 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo oö kuna kunynye, ni thäŋ yia kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo oö kuna køny kööra; kiper manøgønø, bada na teek aana pieme, ni ö wëërri mara ni cwak aani.
english: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

anywaa: Wïth juurre anyøra ki gootø mara, ni wëëga ge meerø ki køør wëër mara, ni kønynya remge piny yïth ŋøøm.»
english: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

anywaa: Aani, mëër man wø ba jøøl mar Wuuö Jwøk caana caanø, ni caana tïïe moe mo nyeŋŋe doo pwøø kiperge ki køør gïïa tïïe bëët kiperø, ki japa beyø na thööth na tïïe kiper dhi øt Icriel ki køør bäth ec mare ki mëër mare na dwøŋ ni wø ba jøøl.
english: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, gena jiy 'moa, ni beege obwöre mo ba løny ki man cäänge ki tööt jïra.» Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk atïmö na pïëmi marge.
english: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

anywaa: Ki yïth japa leth bëët na jwørge, Wuuö Jwøk ajwötö thuwø; ni ö nyïïatwiel maal mana en nyïme ni piem geni, ni wïïl geni wøk ki køør mëër mare ki bäth ec mare, ni tïŋ geni maal ni käär ge ki yïth nïne bëët moa pöödhö.
english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

anywaa: 'Ba gena tïmö ni ge tïïya ageem,  ni raanyge cwïny Jwïëy moe na en kur keere. Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk ŋääe aløøe ni tïme na nyimän marge, ni ö eni ki dëëre ni këëde ki geni.
english: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.

anywaa: Køøre geni, ge na jic Wuuö Jwøk, wïthge aparge ki nïne moa pöödhö mo Modhe, ni köge, na «?Age Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc jiye nee pööthge ki yi naama dwøŋ, ge ki dïbwödhi marge? ?Age eni na cïp Jwïëy moe na en kur keere bäätge?
english: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

anywaa: ?Age eni na jääŋ bade na teek na näk bada ajiem bäät cer cwïï Modhe? ?Age eni na pääŋ pïï ki dïëre nyïmge, na tïïc nyeŋŋe nee bëëde ni ŋäc na bäre bäre?
english: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

anywaa: ?Age eni na bwøth geni ki kanya päŋ? Gena tïmö kaamar okwëënyi mo ena yi pwöla, ni bäŋe gø mo ocwaany tiere.
english: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?

anywaa: Gena mooc Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøki ki jwöm kaamar lääc paac mo cøøa yi gool.» Wui Wuuö Jwøk, manøgø beeye jöö mana bwøthï jiyï ki gø, na tïïyï nyeŋŋï nee bëëde ni di jiemø.
english: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, lwïthï piny ni räŋŋï niï ena maal kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere na näk mar ajiem. ?Age këëyö marï ki teek marï? Mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl ki bäth ec marï akanï ki waani.
english: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ïïna wääwa, këël na bëëde ni Eeberam wa kuue, ni kwarwa ma Icriel wa käre ŋiiø; ï na Wuuö Jwøk bee ï na wääwa, ni bee ï ni wø wïïl wa wøk ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe ki køør nyeŋŋï.
english: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø na tïïyï wa nee wa gaawa wøk ki uutjïëthe moï, ni døøyï cwïnywa mo teek nee wa ba lwäärwa ki ïïni? Luu nyïmï baŋwa, wa na jiyï, wa na wï tuuŋa näk thööŋŋï.
english: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

anywaa: Kiper kar bëëtö marï na en kur keere abëëdö ni ena ceŋ jiyï na en kur keere ki kany mo thiinh, 'ba ennø, nyïïmänwa aöö ni raanyge gø, ni nyørge gø ki tietge.
english: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

anywaa: Waana tïmö kaamar jiy mo ge kär bëëdö tierï, mo ge kär cwøl ri nyeŋŋï.
english: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï jeeyï maal wäne nø ni ööï piny, nee kïte tïmge ni jäŋŋi nyïmï!
english: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö maaci wø waaŋ moonni, ni wëëk pïï twaaø, ö piny ki maal ni tïïyï nyeŋŋï nee ŋäc nyïïmänni moï, ni tïïyï wïth juurre nee dëëtge tïmge ni kwanynyi nyïmï!
english: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

anywaa: Kanya ööï piny ki maal na tïïyï japa døøŋŋø na näk kärwa dïëdö ni tägö, kïte atïmö ni jäŋŋi nyïmï.
english: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

anywaa: Ki mana käl ya acääŋŋe cøøn, bäŋ Jwøk mo owïnynyö wala mo ïth ocieø kipere wala mo oneenø, 'ba bee ï keerï, ï ni wø tïny jø wø koor ïïni.
english: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï ööa kuna kønyï jø wø yïthge met ki tïï jammi ma karge, ki jø wø paac wïthge ki uutjïëthe moï. Ka adïëri møn, ïïna gootø, kiper waana bääyö; waana bëëdö ni wa temma raay jaak. ?Aŋø, løny ki man piem wa këët ennø?
english: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

anywaa: Kiper waani bëët, waana tïmö kaamar dhaanhø mo ba waany, ni ö japa beyø bëët na tïïcwa ni tïmge kaamar nywan abïï mo ree da gïn mo raac; waani bëët, waana tïmö kaamar bøøŋ jaath mo otal, ni ö raayi mowa ni køølge wa kaawat man wø tïïc jamø.
english: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo cwøl nyeŋŋï, wala mo ree ee cøgø ki man göök riï; kiper täärnyïmï akanï ki waani, ni tïïyï wa nee wa ränywa ki køør raay mowa.
english: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï poot ni ïïna wääwa. Waana odhöönh, ni bee ï dïcwääy; ni waani bëët, wa tïïya ïïni ki cerï.
english: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kär wëër marï wëëk pöödhö døc bäätwa; kär japa reyø na tïïcwa lääŋŋï këël aŋuudi. Wui, beerra man raŋï wa, kiper waani bëët, waana jiy moï.
english: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

anywaa: Päänye moï na en kur keerge atïmö na dïtëën, këël Dhayan na näk Jerucalem atïmö na paap, ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie.
english: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

anywaa: Øt Jwøk marwa na en kur keere na näk øtø mar ajiem, na wara ö kwäcwa ni pwøcge ïïni yie, awaaŋ ki maac; ni ö japa perge leth bëët na en yie ni ränyge.
english: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ?aŋø, ki køør japøge bëët, ï poot bëëdö niï lïŋö niï poot meeta ajäla bäätwa?
english: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

anywaa: «Aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, dëëra anyoodha jï jøøa näk a kärge pëënynyö, ni ö jøøa näk a kärge manynyø ni jootge aani, ni kööa jï wï jur mo nyeŋŋa käre cwølø, ni ‹Aani en, aani en.›
english: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

anywaa: Cääŋŋe bëët, a bëëdö ni ceŋŋa yaa thaaŋø baŋ jiy moa wïthge teek, jø wø caath uutjïëthe mo ba beyø, ni wø bëëdö ni ge cäädhi ka køør acaare moge keerge.
english: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;

anywaa: Ni beege jø wø tïïc aani cooth naa goota, ni wø cïp olämme moge jï juu møøk yïth ajïniine, ni wø wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäät thuube,
english: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

anywaa: ni wø thöör wäär yïthakic bwör kwör mo ge ba joot yïthge, ni ge wödö ki juu møøk; ni ge wø cämö ki rïŋ othuri, ni yïth dääe moge da cwek rïŋ mo ba waany;
english: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

anywaa: ni ge wø köö, ni ‹Bëëdu kur keeru; käru nyänh buutwa, kiper waani, wa waany ni wa ba caal uuni!› Teeŋ jøøgø nø, wëër mara liel dëëtge kaamar maac mo jïye onirwöc ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, gïïögø bëëdö no ogöör piny nyïma, naa ba lïŋi, 'ba gïïa tïïcge coola coolø. Aani, gïïa tïïcge dwøga bäätge,
english: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

anywaa: ni beege raay moa tïïcge ki moa tïïc kwäcge. Manøgø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba kiper mana bëëtge ni ge wääŋö ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäät kïte, ni ge janynya aani bäät thuuri, gïïa tïïcge coola coolø ni yaa rømø ki køør tïïe moge moa dïkwøŋ na reyø.»
english: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the Lord, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni «Kaawat man wø jïtö ki pï nyïïjenni ki ri jwala mar nyïïomøki, ni kö jiyi møøk, ni ‹Kär raanynyi; poot di jïtö ki mo beyø røkge›, aani thuwø gïnögø tïïa tïïö yïthakic jiya, ni ö geni ni ba raanynya ge bëët.
english: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a kännö ki jiy ki røk nyïïkwaac Jeekap ki røk nyïïkwaac Juuda, nee ŋöömö mara na en bäät kïte nee cïba jïge na marge, nee ge na jiya na näk yaa jierø nee ge bëëtge yie, ni tïm kaace na kar bëëtö marge.
english: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

anywaa: 'Ba kiperge, ge na jiya moo bëëdö ni manynya aani, Goor Carön otïmö na kar kwaath mar pïïth dïëk moge, ni ö Goor Akör ni tïme na kar rïc jï pïïth dhäk moge.
english: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

anywaa: «'Ba u na wec aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, u na wïthu wïl ki Dhayan na näk kïdi mara na en kur keere, ni wø nywaak caammi mou ki juu møøk, ni wø tïïc athööthe ni päŋ ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo ojääbö nee cïpu jï juu møøk,
english: But ye are they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

anywaa: aani, u wëëga thøw opëëllö, ni kuullu wïthu piny bëët kiper nou ŋalli; kiper kanya cwöta, u kär jïëy, ni kanya cääna, ïthu käru ciiø. Uuna tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ni jierru gïïa näk yia ba met ki ge.»
english: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk bee en, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jiya geno bëëdö ni ge cämö, 'ba uuni, uuno bëëdö ki käc; jiya geno bëëdö ni ge mädhö, 'ba uuni, uuno bëëdö ki riew; jiya geno bëëdö ki met ec, 'ba uuni, uuno bëëdö ki lään wïc.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
