anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jiya geno bëëdö ni ge wär ki dudi ki met ec ki cwïnyge bäre, 'ba uuni, uuno bëëdö nou jwöŋö ki gootø mana en cwïnynyu, ni gööu ko oduuru ni cwïnynyu opädhö.
english: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋu odööŋ na gïr acïëni yïthakic jiya na näk yaa jierø, ni ööa, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ni wëëga u thøø; 'ba aani, a cïpö ki nyeŋ mo nyään jï jiya.
english: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø gwëëdhö yi ŋöömö, wø gwëëdhö ka nyeŋŋa, a na Jwø adïëri, ni ö ŋat wø kööŋ yi ŋöömö, ni kööŋ raa, a na Jwø adïëri. Kiper gïïa leth na no opöödhö, wïc wïl ki geni, ni putge rwäänyö nyïma.
english: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

anywaa: «Adïëri møn, aani, a cwääö ki maal mo nyään ki piny mo nyään,  'ba gïïa no opöödhö dïkwøŋ, wïc ba par ki geni këët, ni ge ba duu ya acaara këët.
english: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, yïthu mïnge ni kanynyu na bäre bäre ki gïno cwääa, kiper Jerucalem cwääa cwääö na pääny met ec, ni tïm jiye na mo met ec.
english: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

anywaa: Aani yia omïnni ki Jerucalem, ni tïm yia ni met ki jiy 'moa; ni tïm jwøk thøø ko oduuru ni ba wïnynyi yie këët na bäre bäre.
english: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

anywaa: «Kar kaace otïmö ni bäŋ nyilaal mo thøw ni thiinh këët, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo thøw ni kär jäŋ ki cwiiri. 'Ba ni näk dhaanhø thøw ni cwiiye dïpa, poot nëëni ni thiinh jaak; 'ba ni näk da ŋat mo ba pïï ri dïpa, di købø no ocienø.
english: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

anywaa: Geni, ge gëëdö ki uudi, ni bëëtge yïthge, ni pïïthge ki jer omøki, ni camge nyïïge.
english: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

anywaa: 'Ba uudi moo geerge ba beet jø møøki, ni nyïïjenni moo piithge ba cam jø møøki. Kiper cwiiri mo jiya otïmö ni thööth kaamar cwiic jaath, ni ö jiya na näk yaa jierø ni mïn yïthge ki gïïa tïïcge ki ceŋge.
english: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba ööl këët ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere, no obwöre moo nywølge bäŋ gïï mo leth mo pïï dëëtge këët, kiper geno tïmö na jiy mo ogwïëth Wuuö Jwøki, ge ki nyïïkwaacge bëët.
english: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø pootge ni ge poot kär pëëö, løøa løø jïge, ni kany wø pootge ni ge poot cäänö, döötge puta ka wïnynyö.
english: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

anywaa: Orudö ki nyi røømmø geno cämö na aciel, ni ö ŋuuwi ni cäme ki luum kaamar dhieŋ, ni tïm tørri na cam mar thwöl. Ni put tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo raac wala mo räänyö bäät kïnna na en kur keere.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Maal beeye wälu mara, ni piny beeye køøm tieta. ?A øda ŋø nø, na dou geerø jïra? ?A kanya ŋø na daa jwöm raa yie?
english: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?

anywaa: Kiper beeye cera na tïïc japøgø bëët, ni ö japøgø bëët ni putge tïmö ni nut. Luummögø caana a, a na Wuuö Jwøk. «'Ba aani, ŋato jïre raŋa beeye dhaanhø mo dëëre ee dwøk piny, mo cwïnye opädhö kiper raay moe, ni dëëre kwanynyi ki lwär ki dwøra.
english: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the Lord: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø 'näk dhieŋ nee cïbe no olämi, caala ŋat mo 'näga dhaanhø; ni ŋat wø 'näk nyidiel caala ŋat mo toora ŋut gwök, ni ŋat wø cïp beel na muuy caala ŋat mo cïpa rem othur; ni ö ŋat wø waaŋ jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met ni caal ŋat mo wøøra kït gïï wø lam. Gena tïmö ni ge jiera uutjïëthe moge, ni yïthge mïnni ka japge ni wø raac yia ki ge.
english: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ge jëënna jëënnö ka ajäla, a kïtha bäätge ki gïn mo ge lwäär ki gø. Kiper aana cwödö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ojïëy, ni cääna, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ïthe ee ciiø. Gena tïïö ki gïï mo reyø nyïma, ni jierge jammi mo cwïnya ba mïnni ki ge.»
english: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

anywaa: 'Ba u ni wø dëëtu kwanynyi ki lwär ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk! Ena köö, ni «Uuni, nyïïmëëgu amännö ki uuni, ni køøge uuni wøk kiper nyeŋŋa, ni köge jïïu, ni ‹Beerra man jiem Wuuö Jwøk, nee met ec maru jootwa.› 'Ba geni, wïthge poot lääö.
english: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

anywaa: Wïnynyu dwøl man ni märi yi pääny en, cegu ïthu ki dwøl man ni wïnyi ki yi Øt Jwøk en! Manøgø beeye dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk; mara cool kwör dëët nyïïmän 'moa.
english: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

anywaa: «Dhayan caala dhaagø mo lwaar ni kär gøøc mäc lwaarri, kanya poot räämmi ni kär tägö dëëre, ena lwaar ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.
english: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, teeŋ gïnögø da ŋat mo owïny gø cøøn? ?Da ŋat mo ojoot teeŋ gïnögø cøøn? ?Da jic paac mo di lwaarø ki ge ki dïcäŋ aciel keere? ?Aŋø, da wï jur mo ge put ka nywøl yie aciel? 'Ba Dhayan atïmö kaamar dhaagø mo mäc lwaar kär ruu dëëre, ni put lwaar ko obwöre.»
english: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, aköö, na «?Aŋø, løny man wëëga mäc lwaar tägö, ni nyilaal ba tïïa nee lwaarø ki gø? ?Na aŋø, aani ni wø wëëk dhaanhø lwaar, kar lwaar daa dëëdö?
english: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.

anywaa: Bëëdu ni yïthu met ki Jerucalem nou kanynyø kipere, u bëët, u ni wø mëër ki gø; yïthu mïnge døc ki gø, u ni wø kïmmi kipere.
english: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

anywaa: Kiper Jerucalem tïmö ni caala miiu; uuno dhøøth kööre ni jäŋŋu ki thunhnhe na beer; uuno mäthi ki caak moe ni mïn yïthu ki caage ni wø muuli ni thööth.»
english: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, «Ka adïëri møn, bëët-mëër pääŋa pääŋö yi Jerucalem kaamar naam, ni wëëga ajiem mar wïth juurre ööny yie kaamar pï waŋ naam mo kwönnö; uuno dhøøth kööre, ni käär uuni ki tierjwöthe, ni cïp uuni kööre.
english: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö mïïö wø cøm cwïny nyaare, uuni thuwø cwïnynyu cøma cømø; ni putu bëëtö ni cwïnynyu ocømø yi Jerucalem.»
english: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo jootu gïnögø, cwïnynyu omïnni, ni tïm dëëtu ni pulli kaamar luum mo oløth. Ni ö teek bat Wuuö Jwøki ni puti ya jiye ŋäc;  'ba wëër mare onyoodhe jï nyïïmän moe.
english: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk öö ki yi maac, ki jïëth okwëëc leny moe mo caala apwøyaweerø; eni wëër mare lëëŋe piny ni liel kaamar maac, ni jook jiy ki leep maac.
english: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk jiy bëët jääle jäälö ki maac ko opëëllö mare, ni ö jiyi moo nääe ni tïmge ni thööth.
english: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jiy mo wø cïp dëëtge kur keerge ni wø tïïc dëëtge ni waany kiper man cige ya ajïniina, ni gena aciel ki jø wø cämö ko othuri, ki jïëy, ki gïïa näk ba waany, kwøw marge ocuŋ ni ränyge bëët.
english: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba kiper mana ŋääa tïïe moge ka acaare moge, aani a öö ni cooŋa wïth juurre ki teeŋ dhøgi bëët; ni öge ni putge ajiem mara joot.
english: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

anywaa: Ni kïtha yïthakicge ki ŋïï, ni ö moo dööŋ ni kwøw rege ni jääŋŋa ge baŋ wïth juurre; ni beege baŋ jø Tarcëc, ki jø Put, ki jø Lidiya ni wø thöödhö ka athëëre, ki jø Tubal, ki jø Jawan, ni beege jøøa en mïëya kwörge bäyö na en bäät naama dwøŋ, na näk dööŋ kar mar nyeŋŋa kärge wïnynyö na ajiem mara kärge neenø. Geni ajiem mara okøpge jï wïth juurre.
english: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët moa bëëdö kaamar nyïïmëëgu ki køør ŋäädhe, okälge ki baŋ wïth juurre bëët, ni kälge ge jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kaamar muuce mo beel. Geno ööi ki ge ni käärge ka bäät okwëënyi, ki yïth jïëth okwëënyi, ki yïth pëëmme, ki bäät gääŋŋe, ki bäät athïrööle, ni kïthge ge bäät kïdi mara na en kur keere na näk Jerucalem, ni caala man wø ö jø Icrielli wø kälge muuce moge mo beel ni käärge ka yïth jammi mo tøŋ ni ge kïtha ge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, a jëëdö røkge thuwø ki mo tïïö na dïlämme ki mo tïïya teeŋ tïïc mar jø tuuŋ Libay.
english: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Kaawat man wø bëët maalli mana nyään na cwääa, ki piny mana nyään na cwääa, ni ge nut cooth nyïma en, nyïïkwaayu thuwø obëëdö ni nut cooth, ni bëët nyeŋŋu ni ŋäc.
english: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.

anywaa: Kany wø päär dwääyi man nø, ki kany wø ö cäŋ jwömö man nø, jiy bëët geno wäro ö nyïma ni wøørge aani.
english: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre geno ci wøk ni raŋge dëët jiy moa no othøw na gëëmö ki aani. Kiper twöŋi moo cam dëëtge ba thøw, ni ö maaci mana jääl ge ki gø ni bëëde ni ba bïp, ni putge tïmö na gïn mo raac døc ki baŋ jiy bëët.»
english: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

anywaa: Moi beege luup Jeremaya o Kilkiya, na en røk dïlämme moa bëëdö Anathöth yi ŋööm Benjamen.
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

anywaa: Jeremaya beeye ŋata ö dwør Wuuö Jwøki bääte yïth nïra beet nyeya ma Jöcaya wär Amön na nyeny Juuda, ni beeye kanya päŋ cwiic nyeci moe na apaar kurdäk.
english: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

anywaa: Ni dwør Wuuö Jwøk poot ööa bääte yïth nïra beet nyeya ma Jeyöakëm o Jöcaya na nyeny Juuda, këël mana pïïe ra aŋuun cwiic nyec moa na apaar kurciel na beet nyeya ma Cëdëkiya o Jöcaya na nyeny Juuda, ni beeye cwiina mak jø Jerucalem yie ki tøŋ ri bïï dwäde ni kïth geni paac mør.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bääta, a na Jeremaya, beeye en, ena köö,
english: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanya poodï niï poot kära cwääö ec, ï yaa jierø; ni kanya poodï niï poot kär nywølø, ï yaa cïp kur keere na mara, ni tïïa ïïni na nyikuŋ Jwøk kiper tiet mïëri.»
english: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk! Neenï, aani cäänö kuua, kiper a poot thiinh.»
english: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Kärï köö, na ‹A poot thiinh,› kiper ï cøøa kany wäro jääŋŋa ïïni yie, ni gïïo köömma ïïni ki ge bëët caanï caanø.
english: But the Lord said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

anywaa: Kärï lwäyö ki geni, kiper a ena buutï, naa peemma ïïni.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk cere arwiee ni gut dhaa, ni kööe jïra, ni «Ennø, luup 'moa acïba dhiï.
english: Then the Lord put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the Lord said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

anywaa: Ni dïcäŋi, ïïna mooa ki teek ki man køpï luumma dëët akwöm mo wïth juurre, ki dëët akwöm mo nyeye, man näk mo geni cööda wøk, ni keeth geni, ni raany geni, ni nyak geni; ni cäŋ ge tïïyö ni teek, ni këël tietge piny.»
english: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta, ni pëëny aani, ni «?Jeremaya, agïnaŋø ni nëëni jïrï enø?» Ni kööa, na «A neeta bat jaath wø cwøl ni dïkuri.»
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, na «Ajootï na wøp, kiper a bëëdö ni aana dïkuri, naa koora luubö mara nee thur kare.»
english: Then said the Lord unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta ri rietge, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni nëëni jïrï enø?» Ni kööa, na «A neeta dak mo twak, mo dhee ee løø wøk ki jï løø wï-piny ni luu baŋwa.»
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Gïn mo raac oööi ki wï-piny, ni pïïe bäät jiy bëët mo bëëdö paani en.
english: Then the Lord said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

anywaa: Ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, jiy mo tiet mïëri moa en wï-piny bëët cwøla cwølø. «Ni ö nyeye moge ni öge ni cïpge wäle moge  dhøk kiir mar Jerucalem, ni tukge gø ki deŋ kiir mare bäre, ki päänye mo Juuda bëët,
english: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the Lord; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

anywaa: naa jääla geni kiper rääö marge na wecge aani ni cïpge ko olämme jï juu møøk, ni wøørge gïïa tïïcge ki ceŋge.
english: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Jeremaya en, jiiŋ riï ni ööï maal, ni caanï gïïo caana jïrï bëët jïge. Kärï lwäyö ki geni, niï ba døøya mo lwäär nyïmge.
english: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, aani, ïïna tïïa kaamar pääny mo ogeerø ni teek, kaamar werø mar nywïënyö, kaamar kiir mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, niï ba løny ki böötö jï jø paani bëët, ni beege nyeye mo Juuda, ki jøøa døøŋŋø, ki dïlämme moe, ki jø paac bëët.
english: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

anywaa: Geni, ge këëdö ki ïïni, 'ba ï ba böötge, kiper a ena buutï, naa peemma ïïni.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the Lord, to deliver thee.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, a na Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni køpï luummi ni wïnyö jï jø Jerucalem, ni kööï ni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, «ni ‹Ï na Icriel ï poot lääŋŋa lääŋŋö ki mana cïpï cwïnyï jïra niï poot thiinh, ki mëër mana mëërï ki aani kaamar dhaagø thiinh, ki mana caathï køøra dï paap bäre, yi ŋöömma näk kär puurö.
english: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

anywaa: Kar kaaca ïïno cïp kur keerï na mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kaamar thwønh bëëlö mara. Ni jøøa cam ïïni bëët akwaan no obääyö, ni pïïc gïï mo lethi bäätge.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Israel was holiness unto the Lord, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wui, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni beeye u jø dhøk uudi mo jø Icriel bëët, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Hear ye the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, na «?Agïnaŋø na raac na joot kwäyu baŋa, ni tïïcge karge ni bäär ki aani, ni putge cäädhö køør juu mo oballe jaak, ni tïmge ni bäŋ karge en?
english: Thus saith the Lord, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

anywaa: Geni, ge kär pëëö, ni ‹?Wuuö Jwøk en kaa, na käl øøni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, na bwøth øøni ki dï paap, yïth pwöle mo otal mo ocöötö ki kääk, yi ŋöömma näk yie da meel na kany mo cøl ma kar thøø, yi ŋöömma näk bäŋ ŋat mo cør yie, na näk bäŋ ŋat mo bëëde yie?›
english: Neither said they, Where is the Lord that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

anywaa: 'Ba aani, uuna käla yi ŋöömma beer, nee caammi ki gïïa beyø na en yie bëët nee cammu. 'Ba uuna öö, ni raanynyu ŋöömma, ni tïïyu ŋöömma näk mara na kany mo ec raac ki gø.
english: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

anywaa: Këël dïlämme thuwø, ge kär pëëö, ni ‹?Wuuö Jwøk en kaa?› Jø wø caan tiet ciik a kärge ŋääö, ni ö dïbwöthe ni bääcge dëëra, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki ni køpge luup ki nyeŋ jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni caathge køør juu mo bäŋ gïn duuge.
english: The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, a löö ki uuni, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni lööa ki nyïïkwaayu.
english: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the Lord, and with your children's children will I plead.

anywaa: Ennø, kathu løøga ya acuul Caypara, na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ,  ni neennu bëëtö marge, ni jäägu Këdar, na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni raŋŋu bëëtö marge døøc. Neennu geni døøc, man näk da teeŋ gïn tïïyu en mo ege tïïö.
english: For pass over the isles of Kittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da tier paac mo juu moe ee wiilø, këël na bëët juuwi moe ni patha adïëri? 'Ba jiy 'moa, a na näk ajiem marge, aana wiilge kiper juu mo bäŋ gïn duuge.
english: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

anywaa: Wui, ï na maal, beerra man ö yiï ni neethay ki gïnögø, ni thäŋ yiï, ni tïm dëërï ni kwanynyi.
english: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper jiya atïïö ki teeŋ raay ariiø; aana wecge, a na näk jøøro mar pï kwøw, ni kunyge ka aguule kiper dëëtge, na aguule mo laara cöötö ki kääk, mo bäŋ pïï mo mägi yïthge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, Icriel a laŋŋø? ?Aŋø, eni nywöli na laŋŋø cøøn? ?Aperŋø nø ni tïm nyïïmänni moe ni manynya eni keda gïn mo di camø en?
english: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?

anywaa: Nyïïmänne amärö bääte kaamar ŋuuwe, ni märge døc ni döötge ena maal. Paac mare atïïcge ni bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ yie, ni ö päänye moe ni ränyge, ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge.
english: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Mempic ki jø Thapinac ni loonyge eni, ni gwäärge wïïe wøk.
english: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na Icriel, gïnögø ba käla ï bäätï keerï ki køør mana weyï aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kanya bwødha ïïni øtjöö?
english: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, when he led thee by the way?

anywaa: ?'Ba ennø, ciin Ijep agïnaŋø noo duue dëërï, per niï mädhï ki pï naama pïïe cøl? ?A ciin Aciria agïnaŋø noo duue dëërï, per niï mädhï ki pï Naam Upareeti?
english: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

anywaa: Rääö marï otïmö ni pwöc jïrï, ni gaan wøk marï ïïno jooe. 'Ba ennø, neenï døøc, ni ŋäyï gø, ni ki man weyï aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni bëëdï niï ba lwär ki aani beeye gïn mo raac, mo duunnö ki räny cwïny.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the Lord thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord God of hosts.

anywaa: «Ïïni, ki kany mo bäär ïïna kweer ki man bëënnï aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kweerï ki man jïëyï ciik 'moa; ni kööï, ni ‹Ï ba daa tïnynyö.› 'Ba ïïni, ïïna bëëdö na kääbi kanya wøørï juu møøk kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri moa bäyö, ki tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny bëët.
english: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ïïna piidha kaamar omøk mo ojierø, mo käla røk köödhi ma liil. ?Aperŋø nø na wiilï bëëtö marï mana bëëdï ki aani ki gø, ni tïmï niï raac kaamar omøk mar paap en?
english: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

anywaa: Ennø, këël dëërï diï lwøø ko olew, ni røtï dëërï ki caabuun, bääyö marï poot nëënö jïra kaamar kïdö.
english: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ïïna diï köö nidïï ni dëërï kärï raanynyø, ni kööï niï kär ci køør juu mo wø cøøri ni Baal? Caar wïïï døøc ki jööra caathï ya agäm-kïdi,  ni ŋäyï gïna tïïyï. Ï caala nya athïrööl mo wïïe känni ni wø jøøc piny jaak;
english: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

anywaa: ni ï caala arëën paap mo oŋïyö ki bëët paap, wø ŋwäc jam thwønh kany wø näk dëëre da tïk. ?Aŋa ni maar lønyø jïre ki man män gø ki ciin baŋ thwønh? Ni thwönhi mo wø many gø bäŋ wø ööl; eni wø jootge joodø kany wø päŋ dwääy mare.
english: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

anywaa: Ï na Icriel, kär dëërï öölï ki wääth køør juu mo oballe, ni ba 'nägï dëërï ki riew. 'Ba ïïna köö, ni ‹Bäŋ gïn løny jïra këët na bäre bäre, kiper a bëëdö naa mëër ki juu mo path, naa poot caatha køørge.›
english: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

anywaa: «'Ba kaawat man wø tïm wï kuuwi ni laay kany wø maai, wïth jø Icriel olääi, ni beeye geni, ki nyeye moge, ki jø kööre moge, ki dïlämme moge, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk moge,
english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

anywaa: jø wø köö jï jaath, ni ‹Ïïna wära,› ni köge jï kïdi, ni ‹Beeye ï na nywøl aani.› Kiper geni ŋäthge aluuge baŋa, ni patha nyïmge. 'Ba kany wø enge yïth gïï mo leth, ge wø köö ki aani, ni ‹Ö maal ni piemï waani!›
english: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

anywaa: ?'Ba u na jø Juuda, age juu mou moa tïïyu kiper dëëtu? Beerra man öge maal, ni näk mo løny jïge ki man piemge uuni kany wø enu yïth gïï mo leth; kiper juu mou thööth ni röömi ki kwään päänye mou.
english: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

anywaa: «?Aperŋø ni lööu ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk en? U bëët, uuna gëëmö ki aani.
english: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Aana tïïö ki gïï mo leth dëëtu, 'ba bäŋ pwöc mo you wïnynyö; opëëlle mou nyïïkuk Jwøk mou athöörge kaamar ŋuu mo owär.
english: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu luumma, a na Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, aana bëëdö kaamar paap ki jïïu? ?A aana bëëdö kaamar ŋöömö mo yie da muudhö mo cøl ki jïïu? ?Aperŋø ni kööu, u na jiya, ni ‹Waani, wa bëëdö ki wïthwa jaak, ni wa ba ö baŋï këët›?
english: O generation, see ye the word of the Lord. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, nyakøø wïïe wø wïl ki jap mïërö moe? ?A dhaagø thiinh wïïe wø wïl ka abïïk nywöm moe? 'Ba jiya wïthge awïl ki aani ki nïne mo thööth mo ba kwaan.
english: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

anywaa: «Ï na Icriel en, wääth køør juu møøk akwanyï kiree, kaamar kääbi mo ŋwieya køør cwøw, niï caala dhaagø mo mään moa reyø kwänynyö baŋe.
english: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, rem jiy moa can na näk bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø akønynyï piny, ni joot remø marge ra abïï marï, ni jøøgø kärï joodø ni ge turö ki øtø. 'Ba këël na näk mo gïïögø bëët iï tïïö,
english: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

anywaa: ï wø poot köö, ni ‹Bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø;› ni kööï, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk wëër mare ee paanyø bääta.› 'Ba ennø, ï jääla jäälö kar løøk, kiper na kööï, na ‹A kär bääyö.›
english: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni wïïrï yïthakic jiy en, ni wellï uutjïëthe moï en?  Wïïï olää jø Ijepi, kaawat mana ö jø Aciria na lääge wïïï.
english: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

anywaa: Ïïno ö wøk ki Ijep ni ceŋŋï iï kwaa wïïï; kiper Wuuö Jwøk jøøa ŋääthï anø kwiere, niï ba jïti ki bëëtö mo beer baŋge këët.»
english: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the Lord hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «?Ni näk mo dhaanhø cïïe ee kwierø, ni ö dhaaŋŋøgø ni aae, ni ci jï dhaanhø mør, dïcwøønnøgø doo cäŋa døø baŋ dhaaŋŋøgø? ?Aŋø, ŋöömmo tïïc teeŋ gïnögø yie ba raanynyi na bäre bäre? 'Ba ï na Icriel, ï bëëdö kaamar kääbi ni wø mëër ki cwøw mo thööth. ?A ennø, ï doo duua baŋa?
english: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Tïŋ wïïï maal, ni raŋï kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri moa leer yøøke. ?Aŋø, a kaa na kärï tïïö yie ki tïï käp? Ïïna bëëdö kaamar dhaagø mo opï piny thääŋ jöö ni koora cwøw, ni bëëdï kaamar ŋat paap mo omøør piny nee jiy twiere. Paac araanynyï ki køør käp ki rääö marï.
english: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, køth amäni, ni bäŋe køth mo opädhö ki cwiir. 'Ba ï poot bëëdö kaamar dhaagø mo waŋe nëëni na waŋ kääbi, ni wïïï ba laay na bäre bäre.
english: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

anywaa: ?'Ba ennø, a kärï cwølø na bëëde, ni kööï, na ‹?Awuuö, paa ï ni wø mëër ki aani ki mana täga thïnhö?
english: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø ni poot bëëdï niï wëëyö cooth, niï poot bëëdö ni ïïno gootø na bäre bäre?›? Neenï, këël na caanï luupögø, ï poot tïïö ki gïïa reyø mo wø løny jïrï jaak.»
english: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïra beet nyeya ma Jöcaya, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki aani, a na Jeremaya, ni kööe, ni «?Gïna tïïc Icrielli na caal dhaagø mo cwïnye ogaa wøk ajootï? Ena ci kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri moa bäyö ki tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny bëët, ni bëëde ni tïïya tïï käp kwöreke.
english: The Lord said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

anywaa: 'Ba aana cädö ni kanyo nø tïïc gïïögø bëët, eni duua baŋa na bëëde, 'ba eni kär duuö; ni ö bääyö mare ni jooti ya coki ma Juuda na raac.
english: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør bëët käp mar Icriel, eni na caal dhaagø mo cwïnye ogaa wøk, ena riemma, kaawat man wø ö dhaanhe wø göön cïïe ki wëël apääk; 'ba ajooda ni coki ma Juuda na raac kär lwäyö, ni ö eni thuwø ni bëëde ni tïïya tïï käp.
english: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

anywaa: 'Ba Icriel bääyö mare atïïe na gïn mo jööt ki jïre, ni put paac raanynyø ki køør mana tïïe, ni beeye gïn mo caala luk, kany wø wøør kïte ki jenni.
english: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët coki ma Juuda na raac ni gïïögø bëët ŋääe, eni na Juuda kär duu baŋa ki cwïnye bäre, 'ba mare beeye cwøk keere.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Theemma Icriel na caal dhaagø mo cwïnye ogaa wøk ki Juuda na raac.
english: And the Lord said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

anywaa: Ciï ni caanï dwøl man en ni nyïmï iï løø jï løø wï-piny, ni kööï ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «ni ‹Ï na Icriel na caal dhaagø mo cwïnye ogaa wøk en, duu baŋa. Ï ba raŋa ka agäät, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, a mëër ki ïïni,  ni gootø mara ba ruu cwïnya na bäre bäre.
english: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the Lord; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the Lord, and I will not keep anger for ever.

anywaa: Mano tïïyï keere beeye ki man jïëyï raay moï, man näk mo ïïno gëëmö ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ki mana caathï køør juu moa path tiet jenni bëët moa no onigïït piny, ni dwøra kärï wïnynyö.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the Lord thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na jiya na näk cwïnynyu ogaa wøk, duu baŋa, kiper beeye aani na kwäärö maru. Aani, a lwötö ki dhaanhø aciel yi pääny man nø, ni lwöta ki jiy ariiø yi tuuŋ man nø, ni käla u na jiera ni duua uuni yi pääny maru ma Dhayan.
english: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the Lord; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

anywaa: Køøre uuno mooa ki dïkwääye mo cwïnyge ena køøra, ni bwøthge uuni ki leec wïc ki ŋäc tiet luup.»
english: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ki yïth nïröke, ni beeye kanyo nyaayu nou thöönhnhu dï paac, jiy bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn caange këët kiper acanduk man wø nyooth luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki jiy; ni bäŋ gïn caarge kipere, ni ba lääŋge, ni kare ba läämi jïge, ni bäŋ teeŋ gø mo tïïcge këët.
english: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the Lord, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the Lord: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace Jerucalem ocwølge ni kar bëëtö mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni cooŋge rege yie kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö geni na jø Icriel ni ba cääthge këët køør teek wïc marge mana öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnyge.
english: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the Lord, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröke jø Juuda odwäti ki jø Icriel, ni öge wøk na aciel ki yi ŋöömma en wïpiny, ni öge yi ŋöömma cïba jï kwäyu na man dööŋ jïge.
english: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

anywaa: «'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, aana köö ni u daa tïïö ni uuna wääta na bëëde, ni mooa uuni ki ŋöömö mo beer, na mano dööŋ jïïu mo beer døc mo kaala mo wïth juurre bëët. Ni cäda naa dou cwølø ni aana wääu, nou ba gaa wøk ki man cäädhu køøra.
english: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kaawat man wø ö dhaage mo cwïnye ogaa wøk ki cwøre ni wec cwøre, uuni, u na jø Icriel, uuna bëëdö ni cwïnynyu ogaa wøk ki aani.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Da dwøl mo wïnyö ki yïth kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri moa leer, ni beeye oduuru ki kwac mar jø Icriel, kiper bëëtö marge adøøcge mo ba thïïŋ, ni wïl wïthge ki Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge.
english: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the Lord their God.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na jiya na näk cwïnynyu ogaa wøk, duu baŋa, uuno tïïa nee cwïnynyu ba gaage wøk këët.» Ni köge, ni «Ka adïëri møn, waani, wa duua baŋï, kiper beeye ïïni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa.
english: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the Lord our God.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, wa cøøga rewa jaak ki mana tïïwa ki kwör lam bäät thuuri, ni 'näkwa rewa ki dïlweel bäät kïte. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, beeye ïïni noo piem waani, wa jø Icriel.
english: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täk paaci marwa cøøn, Baal, jwøk mo duua lään wïc, gïïa joot kwäcwa ki køør kwäk marge athööre, ni beege dïëk ki dhäk moge,  këël wäätge ki nyïïge thuwø.
english: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beerra man räpwa piny ki lään wïc marwa, ni ö lään wïci marwa ni pälle bäätwa, kiper waana bääyö dëërï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ni beeye waani ki kwäcwa bëët, ki mana täk paaci marwa këël dïcäŋi en; ni bëëtwa ni dwørï ba wïnywa, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa.»
english: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na jø Icriel, ni näk mou manynya duuö, duu baŋa; ni raanynyu gïï wø lammu na näk ec raac ki ge, nou ba gaa wøk këët,
english: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the Lord, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.

anywaa: ni kööŋŋu ki kööŋ ma adïëri ma kare mo thïïŋ, nou kööŋŋa ŋëëta, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, wïth juurre rege ogwïëthge ki nyeŋŋa, ni putge jïëmö ki nyeŋŋa.»
english: And thou shalt swear, The Lord liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre beeye en, ena köö, ni «Døøyu bëëtö maru mo nyään, kaamar pwödhö ma akamma mo opuur dhaanhe, mo ba pïïth dï koodhi.
english: For thus saith the Lord to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

anywaa: U na cwøw Jerucalem ki mo dï Juuda bäre, wëëgu cwïnynyu daŋ nou cïpa dëëtu jïra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kälu dupa mana raac wøk cwïnynyu, kiper nee wëër mara na liel na wääŋö kaamar maac mo bäŋ ŋat lønye jïgø ki bïp ba käla bäätu kiper gïïa reyø na tïïyu.
english: Circumcise yourselves to the Lord, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

anywaa: «Caannu yi Jerucalem, ni køpu gø dï ŋööm Juuda bäre, ni kööu, ni ‹Koothu tuŋi dï paac bäre.› Tïŋu döötu maal ni kööu, ni ‹Cooŋŋu rou kanya aciel nøø reŋŋø yïth päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek.›
english: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

anywaa: Tïŋu ŋïï maal mo nyootha ciin Dhayan, ni manynyu kar gwøk røk, kär nou dwiil. Kiper a kännö ki gïn mo leth ki wï-piny, ni beeye ränynyö mo päl.
english: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

anywaa: «Ŋat wø raany wïth juurre anø tïŋŋö, kaamar ŋuu mo ööa wøk ki ya abuŋŋö; ni eni tïŋŋi ka kar bëëtö mare kiper nee wï pou dïïre. Päänye mou ränynyö, ni dööŋge ni bäŋ jiy yïthge.
english: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, røøu keece dëëtu, ni jwöŋu ni gøøyu oduuru; kiper wëër mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni wø liel kaamar maac kära paanyø bäätu.
english: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the Lord is not turned back from us.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöce nyeya ki jø kööre bäätge opädhi, ni thäŋ yïth dïlämme, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki ni bwøk cwïnyge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the Lord, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, ni «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ka adïëri møn, jøøi ii ki jø Jerucalem acøøgï, kiper mana  kööï, no ‹U bëëdö ki bëët-mëër,› kaa manø opëëllö oløny ni ena cwäkge.»
english: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace ocaan Wuuö Jwøki jï jøøi ki jø Jerucalem, na «Ajäla mara ööa bäätu, u na jiya, kaamar jamø mo teek mo lïëth mo kwönni ka bäät thuuri moa leer na en dï tëën, mo ba caal jamø man wø kwør beel ki gø,
english: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

anywaa: 'ba beeye jamø mo käla baŋa mo teek mo kaala cer jamø manøgø. 'Ba ennø, aani, a caana luum ajäla manøgø jïïu.»
english: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, dëëc öö bäre kaamar pøøl mo mäännö, ni ö jïëth lenynyi moge mo wø tut okwëënyi ni öge kaamar atuunna; okwëënyi moge rïïŋö døc ni kaala olwiith. 'Ba otïmö ni raac jïïø, kiper beeye ränynyö marø.
english: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

anywaa: Wui, u jø Jerucalem, pïnyu raay wøk cwïnynyu, kiper nou piem. ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët acaare mou na reyø cwïnynyu?
english: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

anywaa: Kiper da dwøl mo wïnyö ki Daan, ni wïnyö ki bäät Kïn Ipariem ni køpa gïr gïïo reyø moo ööi.
english: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Ennø, caannu jï wïth juurre, ni køpu gø dï Jerucalem, ni jøw mo tiega paac oööi ki paac mo kare bäär, ni kwöŋge bäät päänye mo Juuda.
english: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

anywaa: Ni bëëtge ni Jerucalem ege ciel dïër kaawat man wø koor pwödhö, kiper mana gëëmge ki aani.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba bëëtö maru ki tïïe mou beeye na käl gïïögø bäätu. Gïïo na leth yøø aöö ki køør rääö maru, ni jwørru ge ki yïth cwïnynyu.
english: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.

anywaa: Wui ayaŋ øøy! Wui ayaŋ øøy! Aŋø ni ö pänh cwïnynyi ni kaath cera en, ni tïm dëëra ni kwanynyi! Wenynya atïmö ni pärö døc, ni tïme ni ba løny ki man lïŋa; kiper dwør tuuŋ awïnynya ni beeye tuuŋ man wø kooth na mar leny.
english: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

anywaa: Gïï mo leth tïmö ni ööa bääte, ni ö pinynyi bäre ni ränynye. Kwör bëëte 'moø laar ka raanynyø, ni ö uudi 'moø ni ränyge ki nyi kany mo thiinh.
english: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.

anywaa: ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëda naa neeta ŋïï mar leny, naa bëëdö naa wïnynya dwør tuuŋ?
english: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jiya bëëdö ni wïthge teek, ni ge bëëdö naa kucge, ni ge caala obwöre ma bøøre, ni wïthge bäŋ acaara. Nyeŋge reegø ka tïïc gïï mo reyø, 'ba tïïc gïn mo beer kucge.»
english: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

anywaa: Kanya raŋa bäät piny, ka adïëri møn, ajooda keda oränynyö ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie; ni raŋa maal, ni bäŋe tar mo yaa joodø.
english: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

anywaa: Kanya raŋa kïte, ka adïëri møn, gena jooda ni ge jäŋŋi, ni jooda thuuri bëët ni dëëtge kwanynyi.
english: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

anywaa: Kanya rääŋa, ka adïëri møn, bäŋ dhaanhø mo yaa joodø, ni jooda wec maal bëët no obwøk.
english: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

anywaa: Kanya rääŋa, ka adïëri møn, ŋöömma beer ni wø ciek ki cam mo päl ajooda no otïmö na dïtëën,  ni jooda päänye moe bëët no onyaa piny ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø liel kaamar maac.
english: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the Lord, and by his fierce anger.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, na kööe, ni «Ŋöömö bäre oränynyi; 'ba ba raanynya bäre.
english: For thus hath the Lord said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

anywaa: Ki køør gïïögø bëët, piny bäre okïmmi, ni ö maalli ni tïme na muudhö, kiper ni caana gø en, yaa nø caar, ni cwïnya ba wara, naa ba døøa ŋääa ki man tïïa gø.»
english: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

anywaa: Ki køør dööt tiet okwëënyi ki tiet jø wø këëdi ka athëëre, jø päänye bëët bwøk; ni dønyge yïth abuŋŋe, ni kaange rege yïthakic kïte; ni wec päänye bëët, ni dööŋge ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge.
english: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

anywaa: ?A ïïni nø, ï na Jerucalem na no oränynyö, agïnaŋø noo tïïyï? Këël na røyï abïï kït, ni døøyï dëërï mo mïërö ki warkey, ni rwøthï buny nyeŋŋï, ï døøya dëërï mo mïërö ki jaak. Cwøw moa many ïïni, ïïna kwierge, ni tïmge ni ge manynya man 'näkge ïïni.
english: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

anywaa: Da dwøl maa wïnynya mo keda dwør dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar, ki cooyø mo caala mar dhaagø mo lwaar ka kanynye, ni beeye Jerucalem na jwöŋö ni ŋëëte gäŋŋö, ni ceŋŋe ee thaaŋø, ni köö, «Wui, aano ränynyö; aana thøø ceŋ dïnäk jiy.»
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na jø Jerucalem, jøøyu dï pääny maru bäre; ni neetu bëët jiy moe døøc nee jootu, ni manynyu kwör acooŋe moe. Ni näk mou jïtö ki dhaanhø mo tïïö na kare, ni manynya adïëri, aani Jerucalem wëënna wëënnö ki køøre.
english: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.

anywaa: 'Ba këël jø Jerucalem doo kööŋ ni köge, ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw,› ka adïëri møn, kööŋ marge poot na tööt jaak.»
english: And though they say, The Lord liveth; surely they swear falsely.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï manynya gïn ma adïëri. Ïïna tïïö ki gïï mo leth dëëtge, 'ba kärge lääŋŋö; gena thöörï, 'ba gena dhäthö ki man tiirge rege. Cwïnyge atïïcge ni teek ni kaala kïdi, ni kweerge ki man løkge cwïnyge.
english: O Lord, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, ni «Moi beege jiy mo can jaak mo wïthge bäŋ acaara, kiper geni, jöör Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ki ciik moe kucge.
english: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the Lord, nor the judgment of their God.

anywaa: Aani, a cøøa baŋ jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ni cääna ki geni, kiper geni, jöör Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ki ciik moe ŋäcge.» 'Ba geni thuwø, gena kweer ki man bëënge Wuuö Jwøk, ni kweerge ki man jïëcge pwöc moe.
english: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the Lord, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, geno 'näk ŋuuwi mo ööi ki yi lul, ni ö orudö mo ööi ki dï paap ni cam geni. Kwac obëëdö ni kurö dhøk kiiri mo päänye moge, ni ŋato ö wøk jaak pute ka jeeyø na thäŋi;  kiper raay moge atïmö ni thööth, ni gïïa gaage wøk ki ge thööth døc.
english: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «?Ï na Jerucalem, ïïno wëënna gø nidïï nø? Jiy moï aana wecge, ni kööŋge røk juu mo patha adïëri. Kanya nø caama geni ni jäŋge, rege agwaarge uut kääpe, ni känge ki lugi.
english: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.

anywaa: Ŋati man nø atïmö ni manynya køør cï wati, kaamar thwønh okweeny mo dëëre da tïk mo rïïŋö køør maath.
english: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge ba jääla gø nidïï kiper teeŋ gïïögø? ?Aŋø, gïnögø ba coola gø nidïï dëër paac mo temma teeŋ gïïögø?» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Cou yi pwöth omøki, ni beeye po jø Juuda, ni raanynyu gø, 'ba kär raanynyu bäre. Jäu bäätge wøk, kiper ge patha 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk;
english: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the Lord's.

anywaa: kiper jø Icriel ki jø Juuda gena tïïö ki gïï mo reyø døc dëëra.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Geni, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aana taakge, ni köge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo tïïe; bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ö bäätø, ni leny ki käc bäŋgø mo pïï dëëtø.
english: They have belied the Lord, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

anywaa: Luup nyïïkuk Jwøk caala jamø jaak, ni luup mo wø køpge ba käl baŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Ni gïn wø caange døøa wïthge keerge.› »
english: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøl Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kiper mana caange luummögø, ennø, ï na Jeremaya en, luupa moo caanï otïïa ni liel kaamar maac dhiï, ni tïïa jøøi ii kaamar jenni, ni ö maaci ni thöör geni.»
english: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö, ni «Ennø, u na jø Icriel, jiy mo käla paac mo bäär okäla baŋu ki man tukge uuni, ni beege jiy mo teek mo paac marge käla cøøn, mo dhøk marge kuyu, ni gïn wø caange ba wïnynyu.
english: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the Lord: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

anywaa: Geni, gena jiy mo 'näk jiy ka athëëre ŋäcge; ni gena jiy mo teek ki leny døc.
english: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

anywaa: Beel ki caammi mou otwierge ni thöörge geni; wäätu ki nyïïu onäkge ni thöörge geni; dïëk mou ki dhäk mou oŋaalge ni thöörge geni; omøki mou ko olämmi mou oraanyge ni thöörge geni; ni raanyge päänye mou moa no ogeerø ni teek ni wø ŋääthu yøø.
english: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

anywaa: «'Ba kar kaace, a na Wuuö Jwøk, u ba raanynya bëët.
english: Nevertheless in those days, saith the Lord, I will not make a full end with you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo kö jø pou, na ‹?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marø, ni tïïc gïïø ni leth bëët yøø dëëtø?›, ï na Jeremaya en, wärï kööï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kaawat mana weyu aani ni tïnynyu juu moa path yi ŋöömö maru, jiy mo path otïnynyu thuwø yi ŋöömö mo patha maru.› »
english: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the Lord our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Caannu gïn en jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni køpu yi Juuda, ni kööu,
english: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Wïnynyu gïn, u na bøøre na wïthu bäŋ acaara,  u na jïïu da nyeŋŋi, 'ba u ba nëënö; u na jïïu da ïdhi, 'ba u ba wïnyö.
english: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u ba lwäär ki aani? ?Aŋø, dëëtu ba kwanynyi nyïma? Aani, akwöö atïïa na keew mar naama dwøŋ, ni tïm akwöö na gëëŋi na bäre bäre, ni ba løny ki man kaali ya naammi. Këël athaga doo kwödö døc, keew manøgø ba dee raanynyø, ni këël doo öö ni lwör, ba løny ki man pääre ki bäät gø.
english: Fear ye not me? saith the Lord: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, wïthu teek ni cwïnynyu da ageem; uuna gaa wøk jööra ni weyu aani.
english: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

anywaa: Uuni, u ba köö ki cwïnynyu, ni «Beerra man lwäärø ki Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, eni ni wø cïp køth mar arïïa ki mar dhi køth kany wø näk ma kare; ni bee eni ni wø gwøk nïne mo dwät kac kiperø.»
english: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the Lord our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

anywaa: 'Ba bääyö maru kar gïïögø adøøc mo bäär, ni ö raayi mou ni mänge gïna beer ki uuni.
english: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo reyø dage yïthakiyu, u na jiya; ge wø kurö kaawat man wø ö dïcek wenynyi ni koorge abëëbe moge. Abëëbe moge wø cekge ciiø, ni ge maaŋŋa jiy.
english: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

anywaa: Uudi moge päŋ ki jammi moa jootge ki køør cwøk, kaamar oröögö mo päŋ ki weny. Kiper manøgø nø, gena kwär ni tïm kwörge ni døøŋŋø.
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

anywaa: Geno lør ni dëëtge pulli, ni geno pöödhö ki tïïc gïïa reyø. Luum kïïc bäŋ wø ŋølge na adïëri, nee bëëtö mare tïme na wøp, ni ge ba pïëmö kiper adïëri mar jøøa can.
english: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge ba jääla gø nidïï kiper teeŋ gïïögø? ?Aŋø, gïnögø ba coola gø nidïï dëër paac mo temma teeŋ gïïögø?› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Gïn mo thäŋa ec mo duunnö ki lwär onø tägö yi ŋöömmi en.
english: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

anywaa: Nyïïkuk Jwøk atïmö ni køpa luup ki wïthge, ni beege luup tööt, ni ö dïlämme ni bwøthge jiy ki wïthge keerge; ni tïm yïth jiya ni met ka teeŋ gïï mo caala moøgø. ?'Ba u na jiya, agïnaŋø noo tägi dëëtu kanyo tïme na aŋuun japøgø?
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Benjamen, reŋŋu wøk ki dï Jerucalem, nou kwøwu! Koothu tuŋi Tëköa, ni tïŋu ŋïï maal yi Bëëth-Akarim, kiper gïn mo leth öö ki wï-piny, ni beeye ränynyö mo päl.
english: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth–haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.

anywaa: Jerucalem ni wø bëëdö kaamar nyakøø mo mïërö, mo bëëdö ni jwøny, oraanynya.
english: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.

anywaa: Kwääc lwaae mo leny ki lwaae moge oööi kaamar dïkwääc dïëk mo käära pïïth dïëk, ni cielge Jerucalem dïër, ni gurge oduŋkaare moge piny lak gø bäre, ni cïïmge lwaae moge nee ŋati man nø tuge ki kare.
english: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

anywaa: Ni köge, ni ‹Jiiŋŋø røø nøø këëdø ki paanøgø; öö maal ni tuuø paanøgø ki dhöör dïcäŋ.›  'Ba køøre ge köö, ni ‹Leny aränynyö, kiper cäŋ anø tïmö ni thiinh ni kwaara piny.
english: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, öö maal ni tuuø paanøgø ki wäär, ni raanynyø kwör leny moe moa no ogeerø ni teek.› »
english: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ŋøtu jenni moa en lak Jerucalem na mo thør, ni thørru bäätge ki ŋøøm man eth bäät kiir ki gø. Pääny man beeye pääny mo di raanynyø, kiper jiy bëëdö ni di caannø dïëre bäre.
english: For thus hath the Lord of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

anywaa: Jerucalem bëëdö ni gïï mo reyø nøøye nøøyø ki tïïc, kaawat man wø bëët iithi ni cwïër ki pïï cooth; ni caan jiy ka aranya joota yie, ni gïï wø nëëni jïra yie cooth beege täwe ki ŋwiili.
english: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

anywaa: Ï na Jerucalem, ï köömmi; 'ba ni näk miï ba köömmi, ø pääö ki ïïni, ni tïïa ïïni na paac mo owii kur keere, na ŋöömö mo ba beet.»
english: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Dëëci ööi ni lemge jø Icriel moa dööŋ, kaawat man wø lem nyïïomøki moa no obøth ki pøn; kaawat man wø ö dïpun nyïïomøki wø dat bäät bat jaath man nø.»
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö, na «?Aŋa noo luumma noo köömma, nee luumma wïnynye? Ka adïëri møn, ïthge ege cïëgö, ni ba løny jïge ki man cekge ïthge. Ennø, luum Wuuö Jwøk atïmö ni jääla geni, ni tïm yïthge ni ba met ki gøøni.
english: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the Lord is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk na liel bäätge kaamar maac, atïmö ni dagø cwïnya thuwø, ni tïme ni ba løny ki kan.» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Kïth wëër mara bäät obwöre moo en dï paac, ki bäät wøpe moo en wïth mäc. Dïcwøø ki cïïe karge riet omak ki tøŋ, ni käl jäle, këël jäle moa døøŋŋø døc thuwø.
english: Therefore I am full of the fury of the Lord; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

anywaa: Uudi moge ki pwöth moge ki mään moge omëëk jø møøk, ni manøgø beeye ajäla mano käla bäätge ni wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper ki mana täge ki jiy moa kwörge bäŋgø, këël mana pïïe ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ŋati man nø atïmö ni cwïnye päl ki jammi mo joot ki jïëth atade. Këël nyïïkuk Jwøk ki dïlämme bëët, ŋati man nø atïmö ni tïïya tïï cwøk.
english: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

anywaa: Gïï wø raany paac ataakge na gïï mo jööt jaak, kaawat man wø taak ŋwellø dëër dhaanhø, ni ge wø köö, ni ‹Paac beer jaak,› këël na bëëde ni bëët paac raac.
english: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïthge alääö ki gïna tïïcge na raac eci ki gø? Jïre bäär, wïthge kär lääö na bäre, ni nyeŋge kär tïmö ni law. Kiper manøgønø, kanyo jääla geni, ge puta ränynyö, ni thøwge ki jiy na aciel.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jï jiye beeye en, ena köö, ni «Cuŋŋu ya agääk jïëthe, ni raŋŋu gø døøc, ni pëënynyu uutjïëtha cääŋŋe, man näk mo jööra beer a mane, ni putu wääth ki yie; køøre uuno jïti ki jwömö ki yïth cwïnynyu. 'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹Jïwa bäyö, wa ba cäädhi ki yie.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Aana cïpö ki dïkuye jïïu mo koora uuni, ni kööa, ni ‹Cegu ïthu kanyo koothge tuuŋ!› 'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹Jïwa bäyö, ïthwa ba cekwa.› »
english: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na wïth juurre, cegu ïthu, ni ŋäyu gïno tägi dëët jiya.
english: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

anywaa: Wui, ï na piny, wïny gïn: Ka adïëri møn, a känna bäät jøøi ii ki gïn mo leth, ni beeye gïno duu acaare moge na reyø, kiper ïthge kärge ciiø ki luup 'moa, ni kweerge ki ciik 'moa thuwø.
english: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

anywaa: ?U na jiya, aperŋø nø ni wø kännu baŋa ki dwøø man wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ki yi Cïïba en? ?Na aperŋø thuwø ni wø kännu baŋa ki luum wø maare ŋwääi ni met ki paac mo kare bäär en? Olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre a ba jïëy ki geni, ni yia ba mïnni thuwø ko olämme møøk mo wø cïpu.»
english: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ennø, nyïm jøøi ii okïtha ki gïï mo cwanynya tietge, ni ö wëëe ko obwöre, ki jø atut ki nyïïawäädi, ni cwanyge tietge dëët gïïögø, ni putge ränynyö.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da wï jur mo öö ki yi paana en wï-piny, ni beeye wï jur mo teek mo ööa maal mo käla paac mo bäär.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba ceŋge da athëëre ki tøøŋi. Gena jiy mo 'näk marge raac døc, ni cwïnyge ba pädhi ki 'näk dhaanhø, ni döötge lwör ni caala pï naama dwøŋ. Ge cäädhi ka bäät okwëënyi, ni dëëtge ege täärö kiper leny, ni ge ööa kuna tukge uuni, u na jø Dhayan!»
english: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.

anywaa: Waani gïna caan kiper jø leny moøgø awïnywa, ni ö bäätwa ni päthge, ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ ni mak waani, ki rääm mo caala rääm dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.
english: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

anywaa: Käru ci yïth pwöth, ni ba cäädhu uutjïëthe, kiper nyïïmän 'moø ceŋge da tøøŋi, ni lwär mo dwøŋ piny ee pääŋö bäre.
english: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.

anywaa: Wui jø pøø, røøu keeca dëëtu, ni buugu dëëtu ki bur. Jwöŋu døc kaamar dhaanhø mo jwøga wääde ma aciel; jwöŋu ni cwïnynyu you keeyø døc, kiper ŋato raany øøni laara ö bäätø.
english: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ï na Jeremaya en, ïïna cïba dï jiya nee röökge raŋï  kaamar ŋat wø päär nywïënyö ki maac, kiper nee jöör bëëtö marge ŋäyï.
english: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

anywaa: Geni, gena jø ageem moa no opöödhö døc, ni ge wø wïdö jaak ni ge waya nyeŋ jiy. Ge caala jwïël ki nywïëny mo wø wet ŋat wø leeny gwel-bïrö, ni gena jiy mo reyø bëët.
english: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

anywaa: Opïc thäth akwath døc, ni ö arecaaci ni leenyi ya maaci ni thume, ni këël na bëëde ni nywïënyö poot di nøøyø ki leeny jaak, gwel-bïrö dëëre käre pääö ki nywïënyö. 'Ba jiya thuwø bëëdö na enøgønø, kiper dïge da jiy mo reyø mo ba løny jïër wøk.
english: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

anywaa: 'Ba geno cwøl na gwel-bïrö mo okwierø, kiper gena nø kwiera, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the Lord hath rejected them.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana ö baŋa, a na Jeremaya, na käl baŋ Wuuö Jwøk,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: na kööm aani kiper naa cuŋŋa dhi kal mar øtø mare, e na Wuuö Jwøk, ni køba luummi en kaace, ni kööa, ni «Wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk, u na jø Juuda bëët mo wø dønyi ki dhøk kal moi nee Wuuö Jwøk wøørru.
english: Stand in the gate of the Lord's house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the Lord, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the Lord.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, eni na Jwø Icriel, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Tiirru jöör bëëtö maru ki tïïe mou; køøre aani, u wëëga bëëtö kany.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

anywaa: Käru ŋäädhö ki luup cwøk nou cäänö, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëtø, kiper kany beeye kanya en Øt Wuuö Jwøki yie.»
english: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, The temple of the Lord, are these.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk jöör bëëtö maru ki tïïe mou you tiirø møn, ni ŋøllu luup na karge yïthakic jiy,
english: For if ye thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye thoroughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

anywaa: ni juurre mo wø bëëdö dïïu ki kïïe ki määr thuunhnhi ba caaru, ni rem jiy mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø ba kønynyu piny kany jaak, ni ba cäädhu køør juu møøk mo käla ränynyö bäätu,
english: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

anywaa: aani, u wëëga bëëtö kany yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï kwäyu cøøn nee bëëde na marge na bäre bäre.
english: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ennø, u poot bëëdö nou ŋäätha luup cwøk mo bäŋ gïn kønyge dëëtu.
english: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

anywaa: Uuni, u wø kwädö, ni nääu ki jiy, ni kännu ki lugi, ni kööŋŋu ki tööt, ni waaŋŋu gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni cäädhu køør juu møøk mo käru kwøŋ ŋäc dïkwøŋ.
english: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;

anywaa: 'Ba u wø öö ni cuŋŋu nyïma yi øtø man ni wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa en, ni kööu, ni «Waani, wa piem Jwøki piemø.» ?Aŋø, u piem kaper nou bëëdö nou tïïya gïï mo yia raac ki ge?
english: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, øtø man ni wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa en bëëdö na kar dïmute ki jïïu? Ennø, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö en, gïïa tïïyu ajooda.
english: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ennø, cou kar lam na en Cëëlö, na näk yaa kwøŋ jier nee nyeŋŋa bëëde ni ŋäc yie, ni neennu gïna tïïa kaace ki køør rääö mar jiya ma jø Icriel.
english: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, gïïögø bëët atïïyu, ni käru dwøra wïnynyö kanya köömma uuni kwöre mo thööth, ni bäŋe dwøl mo you løø jïra kanya cøøra uuni.
english: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the Lord, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, teeŋ gïna tïïa dëër Cëëlö otïïa dëër øtø man ni wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa, ni ŋääthu en, ki dëër paani en na cïba jïïu ki jï kwäyu.
english: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

anywaa: Ni riemma uuni buuta kaawat mana riemma nyïïmëëgu ma nyïïkwaac Ipariem.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ï na Jeremaya en, kärï lämö kiper jøøi ii, ni ba tïŋï dwørï maal niï jwöŋö niï lämö kiperge; kär a kwaayï kiperge, kiper lam marï ba wïnynya.
english: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïï wø tïïcge dï päänye mo Juuda ki dï uutjïëthe mo Jerucalem kärï joodø?
english: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

anywaa: Obwöre wø möödö ki jenni, ni ö wëëe ni äpge mäc, ni ö määnni ni cuutge ki muunni nee tïïge ki dääpe jï jwøa cwøl ni  Gwanynyø Mar Maal, ni kunyge piny ki køøŋø jï juu møøk, ni ge raanynya cwïnya.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki jïge ni ge raanynya cwïnya? ?Aŋø, ge ba raany dëëtge keerge ni ge käla lään wïc bäätge?
english: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the Lord: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøla, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en: Wëër mara ki räny cwïny mara öö bäät paani en, ki bäät jiy ki lääy, ki bäät jer paap ki caammi mo wø ciek yi ŋöömö; ni tïm wëërri mara ni wääŋö ni liel bäätge kaamar maac mo ba løny ki bïp këët.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, eni na Jwø Icriel, na caane ki räny cwïny, beeye en, ena köö, ni «U na jiya, rïk olämme mou moa dou waaŋø bäre jïra, dwallu gø ko olämme møga wäne, ni cammu geni jaak!
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

anywaa: Aani, kanya käla kwäyu wøk ki Ijep, a kär laar cäänö ki geni ki man köömma geni kiper luum olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki luum olämme møga.
english: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna köömma geni ki gø beeye en, aana köö, ni ‹Wïnynyu dwøra, 'ba aani, aano bëëdö ni aana Jwøk maru, ni bëëdu ni uuna jiya, ni cäädhu ki uutjïëthe bëët moa köömma uuni ki ge, nee bëëtö maru tïme ni beer.›
english: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba mara kärge wïnynyö, ni ïthge kärge ciiø ki dwøra, 'ba gena tïmö ni ge cäädhi ka køør acaare moge, ki køør teek wïc marge na öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnyge; ni bëëtö marge ba cääth maal, 'ba døøa piny.
english: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki kanya ö kwäyu wøk ki Ijep këël mana këët dïcäŋi en, aana bëëdö ni jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk 'moa bëët, jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋu cooth.
english: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, mara käru wïnynyö, ni ïthu käru ciiø ki dwøra, 'ba wïthu adøøyu mo teek, ni tïïu ki gïï mo reyø mo kaala moa tïïc kwäyu.
english: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jeremaya en, luupögø bëët caanï caanø jïge, 'ba marï ba wïnyge. Ge cwølï cwølø, 'ba bäŋ dwøl mo duuge baŋï.
english: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

anywaa: Køøre ï köö jïge, ni ‹Paac man beeye paac mo luum Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, ba wïnynye, ni käre pwöc mare na leth wïnynyö thuwø; ni ö adïëri ni rwäänye, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo cäänö ka adïëri.
english: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the Lord their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
