anywaa: U na jø Jerucalem, gwääru jïëyu wøk ni wetu ge, ni jwöŋu bäät thuuri moa leer, kiper Wuuö Jwøk beenhnhø maru man na wëëre ki gø anø kwiere ni wec gø.› »
english: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the Lord hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Jø Juuda atïïö ki gïï mo neeni ni reyø ki jïra; gïïa näk ec raac ki ge acïpge yi øtø mana cwøl ri nyeŋŋa, ni ge tïïya gø ni ba waany.
english: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the Lord: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

anywaa: Gena gëëdö ki kwör lam kanya cwøl ni Töpeth, na en ya agäm-kïdi mana cwøl ni Ben-Inöm, kiper nee wäätge ki nyïïge waaŋge no olämme kaace, ni gïnögø beeye gïn mo ge kära köömmö ki man tïïcge gø, na acaac gïnögø bäŋgø mo oö wïïa thuwø.
english: And they have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, da cääŋŋe mo öö, mo kaace ba cwøl këët ni Töpeth wala Agäm Kïn Ben-Inöm; 'ba ocwøl na Agäm Kïn Kar Ŋaal Jiy, kiper jiy okoony Töpeth këël kanyo pääŋe ni bäŋ kany kuny yie.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Topheth, till there be no place.

anywaa: Ni tïm dëët jøw othøw na cam jï wec maal ki lääc paap, ni bäŋ ŋat mo riem geni.
english: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace dïlweel mar met ec, ki dwør met ec, ki kanynyø mar nywöm oraanynya dï Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda møga bëët, kiper paac bäre oränynyi.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Kar kaace cuu nyeye mo Juuda, ki cuu jø kööre moge, ki cuu dïlämme, ki cuu nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki cuu jø Jerucalem okuuny nyïïmänni moge wøk ki yïth bwör moa näk geno koony yïthge.
english: At that time, saith the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

anywaa: Ni keethge cuu piny, ni nëënö jï cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer, ni beege gïïa en cwïnyge køørge na lamge, na caathge køørge, na manyge, na wøørge. Cuu moøgø ba cooŋ kanya ciel ni ba koony piny; 'ba geno tïmö kaamar wär mo oker piny jaak.
english: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

anywaa: Jiy mo odööŋ røk jøøi na reyø ii, ni beege mo odööŋ kwöro riema geni yïthge bëët, otïmö ni ge para thøø  buut kwøw.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ï na Jeremaya en, caanï jïge ni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, «na ‹?Aŋø, kany wø päth jiyi, ge bäŋ wø duu maal? ?A ni näk mo dhaanhø ogaa wøk, eni bäŋ wø duu diër?
english: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

anywaa: ?'Ba aperŋø nø na ö jøøi na jø Jerucalem ii ni gaage wøk ki gaan wøk mo bäŋ cuŋŋe en? Geni cwïnyge onieŋ køør cwøk døc, ni kweerge ki man duuge baŋa.
english: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

anywaa: Aani, ïtha aciia ni wïnynya luup moge, 'ba ge cara luup mo patha adïëri. Bäŋ ŋat mo cwïnye opädhö ki bääyö mare, mo wïïe ee parø ki gïna raac na tïïe. ŋati man nø atïmö ni lääta køør gïï wø manynye kaamar okweeny mo lääta baŋ leny.
english: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

anywaa: Këël ajaak ni wø määdö maal kany wø duue yie ki yi cwiir ŋääe, ni ö oluua ka agwëëi ko ojwägi ni gwøkge kar wääth marge; 'ba jiya ciik 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ba gwøkge.
english: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹?Aŋø, u kööu nidïï ni wïthu leer, ni ciik Wuuö Jwøk nut jïïu? Kiper ennø, luup moa göör jø wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk, ciik awiilge ni tïïcge gø na luum tööt.
english: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.

anywaa: Jøøa köö ni wïthge leer, wïthge olääy; cwïnyge obwøk ni mak geni. Neenï, gena kweer ki luum Wuuö Jwøk. ?'Ba a teeŋ leec wïc mo nyïëdi nø ni en jïge?
english: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the Lord; and what wisdom is in them?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, määrge omëëga jø møøk, ni cïba pwöth moge jï jøw oööi noo mac paac. Kiper ki mana täge ki jiy moa kwörge bäŋgø, këël mana pïïe ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ŋati man nø cwïnye atïmö ni päl ki jammi mo wø joot ki jïëth atade. Këël nyïïkuk Jwøk ki dïlämme bëët, ŋati man nø atïmö ni tïïya tïï cwøk.
english: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

anywaa: Gïï wø raany paac ataakge na gïï mo jööt jaak, kaawat man wø taak ŋwellø dëër dhaanhø, ni ge wø köö, ni «Paac beer jaak,» këël na bëëde ni bëët paac raac.
english: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïthge alääö ki gïna tïïcge na raac eci ki gø? Jïre bäär, wïthge kär lääö na bäre, ni nyeŋge kär tïmö ni law. Kiper manøgønø, kanyo jääla geni, ge puta ränynyö, ni thøwge ki jiy na aciel.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Geni, ge raanynya raanynyø na bäre, ni tïmge kaamar omøk mo bäŋ nyïëdi bääte, ni tïmge thuwø kaamar olaam mo bäŋ nyïëdi bääte, mo bøøkge onär, ni ö gïna cïba jïge ni käli wøk ceŋge.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: I will surely consume them, saith the Lord: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø paac aköö, na «?Aperŋø ni poodø ni ø bëëdö jaak en? Cooŋø røø kanya ciel, nee ø cøø yïth päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek, nøø thøø kaace. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, marø anø ŋøl yi thøø,  ni eni cïpa pïï mo rege da cïm jïïø nee maadhø, kiper mana bääyø dëëre.
english: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the Lord our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the Lord.

anywaa: Øøna bëëdö ni ø koora bëët-mëër, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo beer mo oöö; ni koorø døøn paac kare, 'ba ennø, atïmö ni nuta lwär keere.
english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!

anywaa: Da dööt okwëënyi mo jø leny mo nyïïmän mo wïnyö ki Daan; ni piny bëëdö ni miel ki dööt okwëënyi moge. Ni ö nyïïmänni ni raanyge piny ki japa en yie bëët, këël päänye ki jø wø bëëdö yïthge bëët.»
english: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, dëëci jääŋŋa jääŋŋö dïïu kaamar thwöre, ni ge caala thwöre mo cïm marge raac døc mo ba løny ki geeŋ, ni öge baŋu kaamar thwöre mo kääö.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, kïmmö mara ba løny ki jook, ni cwïnya bëëdö ni peek bäre!
english: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

anywaa: Ennø, kwac mar jø powa awïnyö ki paac mo kare bäär, ni ge köö, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ba en pøø Dhayan? ?Aŋø, eni na nyeny Dhayan tøør paare?» 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki, na «?Aŋø, aperŋø ni bëëtge ni ge raanynya cwïnya ki køør juuga näk otieŋø na näk oballe na kälge ki baŋ juurre?»
english: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the Lord in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?

anywaa: Ni ŋur jiyi, ni «Kar kac ki beel anø pöödhö, këël ki kar caammi møga bëët, 'ba wa kär piemø.»
english: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

anywaa: Aani, cwïnya aränynyö kiper ränynyö mar jø powa. Aana tïmö naa kïmmö, ni bëëda ni yia othäŋŋö.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, bäŋ jaath yi Gelät man wø rwøth ŋwellø ki gø? ?Aŋø, bäŋ rëëm ŋwellø kaace? ?Aperŋø nø ni bëët jø powa ni ŋwiili moge ba caŋŋi en?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

anywaa: Wui, aperŋø ni ba tïm wïïa na iith en, na aperŋø ni ba tïm pï nyeŋŋa na jøøro en, naa jwöŋa ki yi cäŋ ki yi wäär bäre kiper jø powa na ŋalli!
english: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

anywaa: Wui, aŋø ni ba tïme ni da abïla jïra mo bëëda yie dï paap en, mo caala kany wø but jø wääthi yie, naa paanya raa buut jø powa ni wiia geni! Kiper gena jø lugi bëët, ni gena lwaa jiy mo tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ki piny.
english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Jiya rege ege jiiŋŋø ki man caange luup tööt, ni paac marge käärge ka jöör cwøk, ni patha jöör adïëri. Kiper ge wø løøŋŋa bäät gïïa reyø, ni kweerge ki man ŋäcge aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni gwøk ree ki wati; kär dee ŋat mo ŋääth coki, kiper cöögö man nø bëëdö ni cøøga coki, ni wat man nø wïïrö jaak ni waya nyeŋ wati.
english: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø ni bëëde ni cøøga wati, ni bäŋe ŋat mo cäänö ka adïëri. Lëëpge aŋiicge ki car tööt, ni öölge dëëtge ki tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jeremaya, kar bëëtö marï ena dï jø cwøk, ni geno kweer ki man ŋäcge aani ki køør cwøk moge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ennø, ge päära päärö ki gïï mo leth kaamar ŋat wø päär nywïënyö ki maac, ?kiper gïn mør mo daa tïïö kiper jiya agïnaŋø?
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

anywaa: Lëëpge caala atheerø mo 'näk mare raac døc, ni ge wø cara cwøk. ŋati man nø wø cäänö ki dhee ki wati kee cäänö ka mëër, 'ba ki yi cwïnye eni wø cädö ki gïï mo reyø mo tïïe dëër gø.
english: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge ba jääla gø nidïï kiper teeŋ gïïögø? ?Aŋø, gïnögø ba coola gø nidïï dëër paac mo temma teeŋ gïïögø?» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the Lord: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

anywaa: Aani, a jwöŋö ni kïmma kiper powa bäre, këël kïte moa en yie, ni gööa ko oduuru kiper kwör kwaath na en dï paap, kiper gena ränynyö, ni bäŋe ŋat mo ci yïthge, ni bäŋe dwør dhieŋ mo wïnyi. Ni ö wenynyi ki lääy bëët ni bwøkge ni aacge.
english: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Jerucalem otïïa nee neeruuth, ni tïme na kar bëëtö mar othööe; ni tïïa päänye mo Juuda nee ränyge, nee bäŋe jiy mo bëëdö yïthge.»
english: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

anywaa: ?Aŋa nø ni wïïe leer, ni ŋäc tier gïnögø? ?Na aŋa nø na cään Wuuö Jwøki ki gø, nee luum Wuuö Jwøk købe? ?Na aperŋø na räny ŋöömö ni tïme kaamar paap mo bäŋ dhaanhø mo ci yie en?
english: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the Lord hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Beeye kiper mana wecge ciik 'moa na cïba jïge, ni kärge dwøra wïnynyö, ni kärge cäädhö ki køør ciik 'moa,
english: And the Lord saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

anywaa: 'ba ge caatha køør teek wïc marge, ni caathge køør juuga cøøri ni Baalli thuwø, na ö wëëkge na pwönyge geni ki ge.»
english: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, eni na Jwø Icriel, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ennø, jøøi tïïa tïïö nee gïï mo leth mo caala lweet jenni mo keec, ki pïï mo rege da cïm belge.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

anywaa: Ni keetha geni dï wïth juurre mo kucge, mo kuc wëëkge thuwø. Ni jääŋŋa tøŋ køørge këël mano thööra geni.»
english: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Cädu kiper gïno tägi, ni cwøllu mään moa näk ŋäc jwøk thøø, ni beege määra nyeŋge reegø ki jwøk thøø, nee öge.»
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:

anywaa: Ni kö jiyi, ni «Beerra man laarge rwänhnhö, ni jwöŋge kiperø, ni ø jwöŋö thuwø ni pï nyeŋŋø øya piny.
english: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

anywaa: Kiper dööt jiy mo göö ko oduuru wïnyö ki Dhayan, ni ge köö, ni ‹Øøna ränynyö na bäre, ni lää wïthø døc; kiper ŋöömö marø awiiø, ki køør mana nyaage kwör bëëte 'moø piny.› »
english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.

anywaa: Wui, u na mään en, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ni cegu ïthu ki luubö man wø ö wøk ki dhee.  Pwönynyu nyïïu ki jwøk thøø, ni ö ŋati man nø ni pwöny wati ko oduuc thøø.
english: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

anywaa: Kiper thøø kare anø cäännö, ni nø pïïe dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi moø, ni døny kwöra näk ogeerø ni teek, ni thöör obwöre dï paac, ni thöör cwøw moa teek kwör acooŋe.
english: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki nee caana beeye en, ena köö, ni «Rïk dëët jiy moa näk othøw obëëdö kaamar wär piny jaak dï pwöla, ni bëëtge kaamar oraae mo odööŋ piny køør ŋat kac, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cooŋa geni.»
english: Speak, Thus saith the Lord, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ŋat mo wïïe leer kär töödö kiper leec wïc mare, ni ŋat mo oteeø kär töödö kiper teek mare, ni ŋat mo okwär kär töödö kiper kwär mare;
english: Thus saith the Lord, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:

anywaa: 'ba ŋat mo töödö, wär tööde kiper mana näk mo wïïe da acaara ki man ŋäc aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋäc gø ni beeye aani ni wø nyooth mëër man wø ba jøøl, ka adïëri ki bëënynyö bäät piny, kiper yia wø met ka teeŋ gïïögø.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ennø, da cääŋŋe mo öö kanyo jääla jøøa näk odaŋø, na näk cwïnyge kärge cïbö jïra,
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

anywaa: ni beege jø Ijep, ki jø Juuda, ki jø Ëdöm, ki jø Amön, ki jø Möap, ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö dï paap ni wø køc jïëc wïthge kiper juu moge. Kiper wïth juurre moøgø bëët bëëdö kaamar jiy mo kär daŋø, ni jø Icriel thuwø bëëdö kaamar jiy mo kär daŋø, kiper cwïnyge kärge cïbö jïra.»
english: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu dwøl man caan Wuuö Jwøki jïïu en.
english: Hear ye the word which the Lord speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kär bëët wïth juurre kwanynyu, ni ba lwäyu ki ŋïïce mo wø tägi maal, këël na bëët wïth juurre ni lwäär ki geni.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

anywaa: Kiper gïï wø lam juurre ki køør kööŋŋe moge beege oballe jaak. Kiper geni jaath wø ŋøtge ŋødø paap, ni tieŋi ya rëëmme ki kweey dïnöök.
english: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

anywaa: Ni ŋwagi ya jiyi ni mïërö ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö, ni gurge gø piny ki mucumääre nee tïme ni ba nëëŋŋi.
english: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

anywaa: Juu moge beege jenni mo otieŋø ni goori, ni ge ba løny ki luubö. Ge di käärö, kiper ge ba løny ki wääth. Käru lwäyö ki geni, kiper ba løny jïge ki man tïïcge gïn mo raac dëëtu, ni ba løny jïge ki man tïïcge gïn mo beer.»
english: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, bäŋ Jwøk mo caala ïïni; dwøŋŋa ïïni, ni teek marï dwøŋ døc, ni nyeŋŋï owïnyö.
english: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O Lord; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

anywaa: ?Wui, ï na Nyeny wïth juurre bëët, aŋa ni ba lwäyi ki ïïni? Ka adïëri møn, ïïno rømø ki man lwäär ïïni! Kiper ki røk jiy bëët moa wïthge leer dï wïth juurre,  këël ki moa en dï mïëri moge bëët moa døøŋŋø, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo caal ïïni.
english: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.

anywaa: Geni bëët wïthge bäŋ acaara ni gena bøøre, ni dïpööye moge beege juu ma jenni na gïï mo oballe jaak.
english: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

anywaa: Dëët juu moge wø kïthge kïthö ki gwel-bïrö mo othäädhö mo käli ki Tarcëc, ki warkey mo käli ki yo Upath, ni kïtha rëëm nywïënynyi ki rëëm warkie. Dëët juu moøgø orunynyö ka abïïe mo rege da kït mo mïërö, mo tïïya jøøa nyeŋge reegø ki cwääc abïïe.
english: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk mana näk adïëri; ena Jwøa kwøw, ni eni bëëdö na nyeya na bäre bäre. Piny wø tïmö ni kwanynyi kany wø wëëre, ni wëër mare bäŋ wø løny ki jïëny jï wïth juurre.
english: But the Lord is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u na jø Icriel, caannu jïge na ennø nø, ni «Juu moa näk maal ki piny ba cwääya geni, ge ränynyö bäät piny bäre.»
english: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Wuuö Jwøk na cwääc piny ki teek mare, ni tïïc gø ni teek ki køør leec wïc mare, ni peer maal ki køør acaara mare.
english: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

anywaa: Kany wø tuk dhee, maal puta märö kaamar køth. Pøøl wø kööle köölö ki ya aŋuun piny, ni käl køth ni mal, ni wëëk jamø kwön wøk ki yïth kwöra kan ge yïthge.
english: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët bëëdö ni wïthge bäŋ acaara, ni bäŋ gïn ŋäcge. Rëëm warkie, wïthge olää juuwi moa thiiwge, kiper juu moa thiiwge beege jap cwøk jaak, ni rege bäŋ jwïëy.
english: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

anywaa: Geno oballe jaak, ni gena gïï mo di päädö; kanyo tïme na cäŋ ajäla mana wäŋŋi kiperge, ge ränynyö.
english: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Jwø Jeekap ba caal gïïögø, kiper bee eni na tïïc jammi bëët, ni cwääc jiye ni beege thööge ma jø Icriel. Eni nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The Lord of hosts is his name.

anywaa: U ni bëëdö kany mo ociel dïër en, cooŋŋu japu kanya ciel nou aayu!
english: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, «Ka adïëri møn, beeye kar kany keetha jiy yie ennø, mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi, ni kïtha bäätge ki gïï mo leth mo bäŋ ŋat mo bøth ki gø.»
english: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.

anywaa: Wui, atïmö ni leth jïra kiper ŋwiili moa jwøra! Atwøt 'moa bëëdö ni ba caŋŋi. Køøre aana köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, täw man apïï dëëra, 'ba käära käärö jaak.»
english: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.

anywaa: Powa ma Jerucalem oränynyi kaamar oduŋkaara mo opädhö, mo thøøli moe ocöötö bëët; ni ö jø powa ni aacge yie, ni ge ba joot këët. Bäŋ dhaanhø mo powa cäŋe dwøk kare, ni bäŋe ŋat mo geer gø.
english: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

anywaa: Kiper dïbwöthe atïmö ni wïthge bäŋ acaara, ni Wuuö Jwøk ba pëënyge.  Kiper manøgønø, bëëtö marge kär bëënynyö, ni ö jiyi moge bëët ni keethge.
english: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the Lord: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

anywaa: Wïnynyu dwøri na pïï en; ennø, tiet dëëci wïnyö ni dïmmi ni öö ki wï-piny, nee päänye mo Juuda raanyge ni tïmge na kwör bëëte jï othööe.
english: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ŋääa ni bëët dhaanhø ba en cere keere, ni patha dhaanhø ki dëëre ni wø neet kwör wø caadhe.
english: O Lord, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, pwöny aani ka ajäla mana näk kare, mo ree bäŋ wëër, naa ba ränynya.
english: O Lord, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

anywaa: Kïth wëër marï bäät wïth juurre moa näk ï kucge, ni beege jiy moa näk nyeŋŋï ba cøørge, kiper geni, wa jø po Jeekap, waana thöörge; waana thöörge møn, ni raanyge kar bëëtö marwa.
english: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jïra, a na Jeremaya, ena köö,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wïny luummi en na tuuda ki kwäyu, ni caanï gø jï jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre,
english: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

anywaa: ni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en, ena köö, na ‹Acïëni oen bäät ŋato ba wïny luummi en na tuuda,
english: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

anywaa: na köömma kwäyu ki gø kanya käla geni wøk ki Ijep, na caal këën thäth mo liel.› Ni kööe jïge, ni ‹Cegu ïthu ki dwøra, ni kïthu ciik moa cïba jïïu bëët bäät tïïc; 'ba uuno bëëdö ni uuna jiya, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru;
english: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:

anywaa: nee kööŋ mana kööŋa ki gø jï kwäyu wëëga thur kare, ni beeye ki man cïba ŋöömö jïge, mana näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, ni beeye ŋöömmo en jïïu enø.› » Ni puta gø løk, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man put thur kare.»
english: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Caan luup moi ii bëët Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda møga bëët, ni kööï ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Wïnynyu luummi en na tuuda ki kwäyu, ni kïthu gø bäät tïïc.
english: Then the Lord said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

anywaa: Kiper kwäyu aköömma døc kanya käla geni wøk ki Ijep, ni bëëda naa köömma geni cooth këël dïcäŋi en, naa wø köö, ni «Wïnynyu dwøra.»
english: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøra kärge wïnynyö, ni ïthge kärge ciiø ki mara, ni ŋati man nø bëëdö ni caatha køør teek wïc mare mana öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnye. Kiper manøgønø, luummi en na tuuda ki geni atïïa na ajäla bäätge, ni beeye luumma caana jïge nee kïthge bäät tïïc, 'ba kärge kïth bäät tïïc.› »
english: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jïra, ni «Da gïrpiny yïth jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki yïth jø wø bëëdö dï Juuda bëët.
english: And the Lord said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Jø Icriel ki jø Juuda bëët, gena døø baŋ gïïa reyø na tïïc kwäcge, jøøa kweer ki man wïnyge luup 'moa, na cäädhö køør juu møøk nee tïnyge, na kaal luumma tuuda ki kwäcge.
english: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ni ennø, a känna bäätge ki gïï mo leth mo ge ba maar bødhø yïthge. Ni këël ge doo jwöŋö dëëra, marge ba wïnynya.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

anywaa: Køøre geni ni wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda bëët, geno cii ni jwöŋge dëët juuga path ni wø wääŋge jïge ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met; 'ba ka adïëri møn, ge ba piem juugögø kanyo enge yïth gïï mo leth.
english: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

anywaa: Kiper u na jø Juuda, juu mou atïmö ni thööth ni röömi ki kwään päänye mou, ni gïï wø waaŋŋu gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bäätge jï Baal, jwøk mo duua lään wïc, thööth ni röömi ki kwään uutjïëthe mo Jerucalem.
english: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na Jeremaya en, kärï lämö kiper jøøi ii, ni ba tïŋï  dwørï maal niï jwöŋö niï lämö kiperge, kiper ïtha ba ciia kanyo cøørge aani kiper gïïo leth noo pïï dëëtge.
english: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

anywaa: Jiy 'moa moa mëëra ki geni atïmö ni tïïö ki raay mo thööth. ?Aŋø, a teega ŋø ni en jïge ki man cääthge yi øtø mara? ?Aŋø, olämme moge mo wø cïpge, ränynyö marge dege paanya piny bäätge, nee bëëtge ni ge kanynyø?»
english: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk uuna cwøle na jaath mo oløth mo mïërö mo nyïïe beyø; 'ba uuno ränynyi kaamar jaadhøgø noo waaŋe ki maac mo teek mo lwör kaamar atuunna, ni waaŋ bäädi moe ni thumge.
english: The Lord called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na këël tietu piny, aköö ni gïn mo leth käle ka bäätu, u na jø Icriel ki jø Juuda, kiper raay moa tïïyu ni u raanynya cwïnye ki køør mana waaŋŋu gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï Baal.
english: For the Lord of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïna caar jø Anathöthi bääta acaane jïra ni jooda gø, ni nyooth tïïe moge na reyø jïra na caarge kipera.
english: And the Lord hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pooda, aana bëëdö kaamar nyidiel mo mwöl mo kïtha kuna ŋaali, ni kuua ni da acaare mo reyø mo ege caarø kipera, ni ge köö, ni «Raanynyø ŋatøgø ki kare bäre; dïïrø wïïe dï jøøa kwøw bäät piny, nee nyeŋŋe put rwäänyö na bäre bäre.»
english: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, ni wø ŋøl luup na adïëri, ï ni wø raŋ cwïny jiy ka acaacge bëët, wëëk a neen cool kwör marï mano tïïyï dëëtge, kiper luubö mara yaa cïp cerï.
english: But, O Lord of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk mare aŋøle kiper jø Anathöth, jøøa many man 'näkge aani, na köö, ni «Kär luum Wuuö Jwøk køpï, niï ba 'näkwa.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the Lord, that thou die not by our hand:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøl Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, kiper jøøgø beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ennø, ge jääla jäälö. Cwøw moge moa teek onäk ri leny; ni ö wäätge ki nyïïge ni thøwge ki käc,
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

anywaa: ni bäŋe dhaanhø aciel rege mo dööŋ ni kwøw. Kiper gïï mo leth okäla bäätge, ge na jø Anathöth, yi cwiir mano jääla geni yie.»
english: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ï bëëdö ni marï adïëri kany wø lööa nyïmï; 'ba ï poot pëënynya pëënynyö kiper ŋøl marï. ?Aŋø, aperŋø ni ö gïï wø tïïc jø raayi ni thurge karge jïge en? ?Na aperŋø ni ö jiyi bëët mo wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø ki piny ni bëëtge ni bëëtö marge jööt jaak?
english: Righteous art thou, O Lord, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

anywaa: Beeye ïïni na piith geni kaamar jaath, ni këëlge tietge piny; ni døøŋge ni jïtge ki nyïëdi. Gïrï wø carge carø ki dhøkge jaak, 'ba ki cwïnyge, karge bäär ki ïïni.
english: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, a ŋäyï; na a wø nëënö jïrï cooth, ni raŋï cwïnya man näk a bëëda nidïï ki baŋï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, peec jøøgø niï kïtha ge baŋ ŋaal kaamar dïëk; kïth geni kur keerge kiper dïcäŋo ŋaal ge yie.
english: But thou, O Lord, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

anywaa: ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët ŋøømmi no otal, noo bëët luummi bäre no onär? Këël lääy ki weny bëët athum ki thøø, ki køør rääö mar jø wø bëëdö yie, kiper ge wø köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aŋuun bëëtö marø ba nëëni jïre.»
english: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «?Ni näk mo ïïno läätö ki jø ŋwïëy, ni öölï køørge, ïïno läätï nidïï ki jø wø rïïŋi ki bäät okwëënyi? ?A ni näk mo bëëtö marï otïmö ni teek yi paac mo nuta bëët mëër yie, ïïno bëëdï nidïï yi lura cøl bäät Naam Jördan?
english: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

anywaa: Kiper këël nyïïmeru ki dhi øt wäru kiree atïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëërï ki piny, ni ge poot kwöŋŋö køørï døc ki nyeŋŋï. Ïïni, kär niï ŋäätha geni, këël ge doo cäänö ki luup mo beyø jïrï.»
english: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö jïra, ni «Aani jiy 'moa awiia, ni kwiera geni, ge na näk thööga. Geni na mëëra ki geni ki cwïnya bäre, gena cïba ceŋ nyïïmän moge.
english: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

anywaa: Jiya atïmö kaamar ŋuu mo bëëdö paap, ni öge ni märge bääta kaamar ŋuu. Kiper manøgønø, aana tïmö naa män ki geni.
english: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

anywaa: Jiya atïmö kaamar wenyø mo path ki jï weny, mo ociel wenynyi bëët dïër. Cou ni cooŋu lääc paap bëët kanya ciel, ni kälu geni nee jiya ni caal wenynyøgø enø camge.
english: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

anywaa: Kwääc tiet mïëri mo thööth paac mara na beer kaamar pwöth omøki oraanyge, ni nyørge gø ki tietge; ŋöömmögø na mara enø, na mëëra ki gø, oraanyge ni tïme kaamar paap.
english: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

anywaa: Geni ŋöömö mara oraanyge møn, ni bëët ŋöömö ni jwöŋö dëëra; ŋöömö bäre otïïcge na kany mo oränynyö, ni bäŋe ŋat mo caar gïr gø.
english: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.

anywaa: Jøøgø no raany paac yøø, kanyo öge, ge öö ki dï paap, ni ge cura bäät thuuri bëët moa leer, kiper beeye tøŋ mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, no dïïrge wïth jiy ki gø, ki mano täge ka aŋuun paac maya këël aŋuunne maya, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo bëëdö ki bëët-mëër.
english: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the Lord shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

anywaa: Jiya, geno piidhø ki beel, 'ba gïïo jootge beege koodhi keerge. Dëëtge oöölge døc, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo jootge. 'Ba wïthge olää gïno jootge, ki køør wëër mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, noo liel kaamar maac bäätge.»
english: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the Lord.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, mïëc wïth juurre moa reyø na kïïö ki jiya, na tuk paac mana cïba jï jiya ma jø Icriel, ge cööda wøk yïth ŋøøpge, ni cööda jø Juuda wøk thuwø yïthakicge.
english: Thus saith the Lord against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø bëët juurre moøgø nø ni ge yaa cööt wøk, cwïnya ocäŋ pädhö kiperge, ni dwøga geni yïth ŋøøpge, ni jøøi nø døøa yi ŋöömö marge.
english: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jöör bëëtö mar jiya kwanyge kwanyø møn, ni bëëtge ni ge kööŋŋa ri nyeŋŋa, ni ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw,› kaawat mana kwøŋge jiya pwönynyø ki man kööŋge ri Baal, aani tietge këëlla piny yïthakic jiya.
english: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The Lord liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

anywaa: 'Ba  ni näk mo da paac mo ba wïny mara, paanøca cööda wøk ni raanynya gø.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, a na Jeremaya, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ciï ni ŋëëmmï dëërï ka abïï ma lïïna, ni dwølï gø dëërï; 'ba kär niï cøta gø yïth pïï.»
english: Thus saith the Lord unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana put ŋëëö ka abïï ma lïïna ki køør mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni dwøla gø dëëra.
english: So I got a girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put it on my loins.

anywaa: Ni ö dwør Wuuö Jwøki ni cäŋ ö bääta ri rietge, ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me the second time, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni ciï bäät Naam Upareeti ka abïï mana ŋeewï ni iï dwølø enø, ni kanï gø kaace yi kïdi mo okak.»
english: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

anywaa: Køøre aana aay ni kana gø lak Naam Upareeti, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïra.
english: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør nïne mo thööth, Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ö maal ni ciï bäät Naam Upareeti ni lwørï abïï mana caana jïrï na kanï kaace.»
english: And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

anywaa: Køøre aana ci bäät Naam Upareeti ni gööla abïï wøk, ni lwøra gø kanya kana gø yie kaace. 'Ba abïïnögø ajooda no oränynyö, ni bäŋ gïn mo kønye këët.
english: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en, aana köö, na ‹Atöör mana dwøŋ mar jø Jerucalem ka atöör mar jø Juuda møga bëët raanynya raanynyø kaawat mana räny abïïnögø.
english: Thus saith the Lord, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Geni na jøøa reyø, ni wø kweer ki man wïnyge luup 'moa, ni wø bëëdö ni ge caatha køør teek wïc marge, ni wø caath køør juu møøk nee tïnyge ni wøørge geni, ge tïmö ni ge caala abïïnögø ni bäŋ gïn kønye këët enø.
english: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, kaawat man wø bëët abïï no okïth dhaanhe dëëre ni teek, jø Icriel bëët ki jø Juuda bëët akäla raa, nee bëëtge na jiya, nee nyeŋŋa wïnye, ni jïta ki pwøc ka ajiem ki køørge; 'ba luumma kärge wïnynyö.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the Lord; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jeremaya en, caan luummi jïge, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye ni dääe bëët doo pääŋö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki.› 'Ba geno kööi, na ‹?Aŋø, kucwa cøøn ni dääe bëët doo pääŋö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki?›
english: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

anywaa: Køøre caanï caanø jïge ni mana ŋøl Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ennø, aani jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en jääla jäälö, ni tïïa geni kaamar jiy mo ojäŋ ki kwøŋ ni ge meeyø, ni beege nyeye mo wø läw bäät wäl Deebit, ki dïlämme, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem.
english: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

anywaa: Ni tïïa geni nee dëëtge nyathge keerge, ni beege jø døøŋŋø ko obwöre bëët. 'Ba aani, cwïnya ba doo pädhö ki gïrge, ni cwïnya ba daa bäädhö ki geni, ni yia ba daa warø ki geni, ni ge ba wiia ki man raanynya geni.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the Lord: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

anywaa: U na jø Juuda, wïnynyu gïn ni kïthu gø cwïnynyu; käru nou töödö, kiper Wuuö Jwøk mare anø ŋøle.
english: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the Lord hath spoken.

anywaa: Jiemmu Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, kanyo poode ni muudhö poot käre kälö, kanyo poot tietu ni poot käru cwanynyø bäät kïte moa en yi muudhö; ni kanyo lääŋŋu tar, eni tar wiile wiilø na muudhö mo cøl, ni tïïc gø na muudhö mo cøl døc.
english: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk luumma ba wïnynyu, aani, a jwöŋö ni kuyu kiper atöör maru. Ni jwöŋa ni yia yaa keeyø døc, ni nyeŋŋa lwanynyi ki pïï, kiper jic Wuuö Jwøk omak ki tøŋ ni käli.
english: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the Lord's flock is carried away captive.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Kööï jï nyeya ki menni ma gwanynyø, ni ‹Weyu wälu ni tïmu ni uuna jiy mo ena piny, kiper adun ajiem maru akäl wøk wïthu.›
english: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

anywaa: Dhøk kiiri mo päänye mo Nëgëp ocïëgi, ni bäŋe ŋat mo jap ge. Jø Juuda bëët omak ki tøŋ, ni käl ge bëët.
english: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Jerucalem, tïŋ wïïï maal ni raŋï nyïïmän ni ööi ki wï-piny yøø. ?Aŋø, jiyï na cïp jïrï na mïërö na caal pïïth dïëk ocøøa kaa?
english: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø no caanï kanyo ö jiyi moa dwätï ki ge noo mooa ge ki teek bäätï? ?Aŋø, ï ba rämö kaamar dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar?
english: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï köö ki cwïnyï, na ‹?Aperŋø na ö gïnni ni leth en bääta?› beeye kiper raay moï na thööth na tïmï kaamar dhaagø ma abïïne okäl wøk dëëre, ni dööŋe ki dëëre.
english: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï dhaanhø mo cøl ki man wiil kït dëëre? ?A løny jï kwac ki man wiil kït moe? Ni näk moøgø løny, løny jïïu thuwø ki man tïïyu gïn mo beer, u na no oŋïyö ki tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na Jerucalem, jiy moï okeetha kaamar lethø ni wø køøl jame paap.
english: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni man beeye kurï, gïno tïïa dëërï, kiper wïïï awïl ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëdï niï ŋäätha luup tööt.
english: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the Lord; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aani, ï tïïa tïïö kaamar dhaagø ma abïïne okäl wøk dëëre, ni dööŋe ki dëëre, ni ö laac wïci mare ni joodi.
english: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

anywaa: Tïïe moï moa näk ec raac ki ge døc na tïïyï kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ajooda, ni beege luui moï, ki tïk mana en riï, ki käp marï. Wui, ï na Jerucalem, otïmö ni raac jïrï! ?A këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdï niï ba waany?»
english: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jïra, a na Jeremaya, kiper luum meel, ena köö,
english: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

anywaa: ni «Ŋööm Juuda bëëdö ni jwöŋö, ni ö päänye moe ni öölge, ni bëët jiyi ni jwöŋö kiper ŋöömö, ni ö oduuc Jerucalemmi ni tïme ni päl.
english: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

anywaa: Jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø jø tïïc moge wø jääŋge jääŋŋö baŋ pïï; 'ba kany wø pïïcge yïth aguule, bäŋ pïï mo jootge, ni duuge ni bäŋ pïï yïth agwäye moge. Ni bëët wïthge ni laay, ni tïm nyeŋge ni law, ni kwaage ceŋge wïthge.
english: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

anywaa: Piny akaaŋŋø kiper na bäŋe køth; ni ö jø puurri ni tïm wïthge ni laay, ni kwaage ceŋge wïthge.
english: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

anywaa: Këël buba ni wø bëëdö paap, kany wø nywøle, nyaare wiie piny, kiper na bäŋe luum.
english: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.

anywaa: Na arëëni mo paap cuŋŋö jaak bäät thuuri moa leer,  ni ge jwëëyö ni lëëpge onøbøønhnha kaamar guu; ni nyeŋge otal jaak kiper na bäŋe luum.»
english: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, këël na bëët raayi mowa ni nyootha bääyö marwa, køny waani ki køør nyeŋŋï. Waani møn, gïïa gaawa wøk ki ge thööth, ni wa bääö dëërï.
english: O Lord, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

anywaa: Wui, ï ni wø ŋääth jø Icrielli, ï ni wø piem waani cäŋ gïïa leth, ?aperŋø ni bëëdï kaamar wëëllö yi ŋöömmi en? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëdï kaamar ŋat mo tiere ena jöö mo gää baŋ niine keere en?
english: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni bëëdï kaamar dhaanhø mo wïïe ocuŋŋö en? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëdï kaamar oteen leny mo ba løny ki man kunynye en? 'Ba ŋäcwa, ni ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï poot ena yïthakicwa, ni wa cwøla ri nyeŋŋï; kär wa weyï.
english: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O Lord, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

anywaa: 'Ba mana løk Wuuö Jwøki kiper jøøi ii beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jøøi ii, ge mëër ka wïïrö køør juu møøk, ni dëëtge kärge mänö ki wääth køørge. Kiper manøgønø, ge ba jïëa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ennø, bääyö marge bëëdö ni ŋääa, ni jääla geni kiper raay moge.»
english: Thus saith the Lord unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the Lord doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Kär niï lämö kiper jööt dëël mar jøøi ii.
english: Then said the Lord unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.

anywaa: Këël ge doo wödö ki cam, oduuc kwac marge ba daa wïnynyö, ni këël ge doo cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel, ge ba daa jïëö; 'ba beeye ki man dïïra wïthge ri leny, ki käc, ki täwe mo leth.»
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

anywaa: 'Ba aløøa ni kööa, ni «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, neenï, nyïïkuk Jwøk moge wø köö jïge ni ïïna köö, ni ‹Bäŋ leny ki käc mo pïï dëëtu, 'ba u mooa mooø ki bëët-mëër ma adïëri kany.› »
english: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø, luup mo wø køpge ki nyeŋŋa, køpge ka wïthge, ni beege luup tööt. Geni, ge ba jääŋŋa aani, ni ge ba köömma aani, naa kär cäänö ki geni. 'Ba ge køpa luup tööt ki køør lääk moge, ki luup adïëda mo bäŋ gïn kønyge, ki cwøk mo käla wïthge keerge.
english: Then the Lord said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en: Nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø ni wø køp luup ki wïthge yøø ki nyeŋŋa, këël na bëëde ni ge ba jääŋŋa aani, ni ge köö, ni ‹Leny ki käc ba doo pïï yi ŋöömmi en,› nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø wïthge dïdö ri leny ki käc.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø køpge luup jïge ni thøwge ri leny ki käc, ni leeŋ dëëtge wøk dï uutjïëthe mo Jerucalem, ni beege geni ki dëëtge, ki määrge, ki wäätge, ki nyïïge bëët, ni bäŋe ŋat mo koony geni, naa dwøga raay moge wïthge.
english: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jeremaya en, caan pänh cwïny marï jïge, ni kööï, «ni ‹Beerra man lwör pï nyeŋŋa piny ki wärre ki cääŋŋe, ni ba cöök, kiper jø powa na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue ajïtö ki ŋwellø mo leth, kaamar dhaanhø mo opwödö døc.
english: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

anywaa: Ni kany wø cøøa yie jaak töök paac, a joota jiy mo onääö ri leny! Ni kany wø cøøa pääny, a joota jiy mo onäk käci! Ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki ki dïlämme ni bëëtge ni ge wïïrö kwör mo kucge.› »
english: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø, jø Juuda akwierï møn na bäre bäre?  ?Aŋø, ïïna put männö ki pääny marge ma Dhayan møn? ?Aperŋø ni caannï waani en, ni tïme ni ba løny ki man døø bëëtö marwa kare en? Waana bëëdö ni wa koora bëëtmëër, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo beer mo oöö; ni koorwa døøn paac kare, 'ba ennø, atïmö ni nuta lwär keere.
english: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, rääö marwa ajïëcwa, këël raay moa tïïc wëëkwa, kiper waana bääyö dëërï, wa bëët.
english: We acknowledge, O Lord, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

anywaa: Kär wa jarï, kiper nee nyeŋŋï ba ränynye; kär niï tïïya kar ajiem wälu marï nee jøøŋŋi; 'ba beerra man lääŋŋï luumma tuutï ki waani, ni ba raanynyï gø.
english: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki røk juu mo oballe jaak mo wïth juurre, dagø dïge mo løny ki man jääŋ køth? ?A løny ki man ö maalli keere ni pädhe ki køth? Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, aŋø, paa ï keerï ni wø jääŋ køth? Kiper manøgønø, waani, wa bëëdö ni wa ŋäätha ïïni, kiper beeye ïïni na tïïc japøgø bëët.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O Lord our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, a na Jeremaya, ni «Këël Modhe ki Camiel doo cuŋŋö nyïma ni kwaacge aani kiper jøøi ii, cwïnya ba daa løøa baŋge. Riem geni wøk nyïma, nee aacge.
english: Then said the Lord unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pëënyge ïïni, ni ‹?Wa ciwa kaa ŋø?› wär caanï jïge ni mana ŋøl Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, «ni ‹Jøøa näk marge thøø, othøw; ni jøøa näk marge ŋaal, oŋaal; ni jøøa näk marge käc, onäk käci; ni jøøa näk marge mäk ki tøŋ, omak ki tøŋ.›
english: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the Lord; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.

anywaa: «Ni mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye naa kännö ki teeŋ gïïpinyi aŋween mo raanynya geni, ni beege opëëlle mo ŋaal ge ki ge, ki guu mo tuuda dëëtge wøk ni cama geni, ki wec maal ki lääc paap mo cam geni ni raanyge geni.
english: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the Lord: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

anywaa: Geno tïïa nee tiet mïëri bëët mo bäät piny tïmge ni cwïnyge böö ki gïïo tägi dëëtge, ni beeye kiper gïna raac na tïïc Maneeca wär Edhekaya yi Jerucalem kanya bëëde na nyeny Juuda.
english: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

anywaa: «?Wui, u na jø Jerucalem ii, aŋa noo cwïnye pädhi ki gïru? ?Na aŋa noo kïmmi kiperu? ?Na aŋa noo gää baŋu nee jööt dëël maru pëënynye?
english: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

anywaa: Uuni, aana weyu, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëdu nou døøa ŋäthu. Kiper manøgønø, u jääla jäälö ni raanynya uuni; aana jøøm ni cwïnya ba wara ki uuni këët.
english: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the Lord, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

anywaa: Uuni, u kwøra kwørø kaamar lethø, ni cööra u wøk ki dhøk kiiri; thøø okäla bäätu, ni raanynya uuni, u na jiya; kiper cwïnynyu käru løø ki jöör bëëtö maru na raac.
english: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.

anywaa: Määr thuunhnhi otïïa ni thööth ni kaala nyeŋ akwöny deŋ näpa døøŋŋø; aani, a känna bäät mëëk wøpe ki jiy mo raanynya geni ki dhöör dïcäŋ. Ki nyi kany mo thiinh, kïmmö ki lwär okäla bäätge.
english: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

anywaa: Dhaaŋŋa näk onyöötö ki wääte abïriiø odwat ki dööŋ can,  ni tïme ni jwïëy mare teek; ni bëët cäŋŋi no opädhö ki baŋe kanyo poode na dïcäŋ. eno bëëdö ni wïïe laay ni bëët waŋe ni law. 'Ba aani, jiy mo obøth ki thøø cïba ceŋ nyïïmän moge nee 'näk.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the Lord.

anywaa: ?Wui, aŋø ni ö mera ni nywøl aani yi pinyi en, ni tïma ni aana ŋat pïëm yi paani bäre en? Bäŋ ŋat mo omäyö baŋa ki jammi maa pïïdö ki gø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo aano mäyö baŋe ki jammi mo pïïdö ki aani, 'ba jiy bëët, ge bëëdö ni ceenna aani.
english: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Ka adïëri møn, ïïni, ï mooa mooø ki teek kiper tïïe mo perge leth; ka adïëri møn, aani, nyïïmän moï otïïa ni kwaacge ïïni kanyo täk gïï mo lethi dëëtge.
english: The Lord said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, da ŋat mo løny jïre ki man toor nywïënyö mo teek mo käli ki jï løø wï-piny?
english: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

anywaa: U na jiya, jap kwärö mou ki jammi moa perge leth ocïba jï nyïïmän nee twier kaamar jammi mo bäŋ gätge, ni beeye kiper raay mou na thööth na tïïyu yi paani en bäre.
english: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

anywaa: Aani, u cïba ceŋ nyïïmän mou, ni tïnynyu geni paac mo kuyu, kiper wëër mara na liel na wääŋö kaamar maac käla bäätu.»
english: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï ni wø ŋäc jammi bëët, lääŋ aani ni luuï wïïï baŋa; cool kwöra dëët jø wø caan aani. Ki køør cïp cwïny marï piny, kär a weyï naa käl; beerra man ŋäyï gø na ajaany wø jwøra jwørø ki køørï.
english: O Lord, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

anywaa: Kanya ö luupï baŋa, amwønya yia, ni cïpge ki met cwïny jïra, ni mïn yia, kiper a wø cwøla ri nyeŋŋï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët.
english: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O Lord God of hosts.

anywaa: Aani, a kär dwätö ki jø wø bëën kwääk jaak, naa kär bëëdö ni yia met kaawat marge; 'ba kiper cerï ena bääta, aani, aana bëëdö a keera, kiper aana tïïyï nee cwïnya ränynye kiper gïïa tïïcge.
english: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni ba cuŋ pänh cwïnynyi mara en? ?Na aŋø ni bëët pänh cwïnynyi mara ni ba døø piny ni bëëdö kaamar atwøda mo ba caŋŋi en? ?Aŋø, ïïna tïmö kaamar waŋ naam mo nëëni kee yie da pïï, mo noo cøø, bäŋ pïï yie?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?

anywaa: 'Ba mana løk Wuuö Jwøki jïra beeye en, ena köö, «Ni näk ma acaara manøgø wiilï wiilø, aani, ï dwøga bäät tïïc marï, ni tïnynyï aani. Ni näk miï jiera moa perge leth ni weyï moa no oballe, ïïni, ï bëëdö na kar dhøk mara. Ni ö jiyi ni luuge rege baŋï, 'ba ï ba doo luga baŋge.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ï tïïa tïïö kaamar kiir mo teek mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël ki jï jøøgø.  Ni këël ge doo këëdö ki ïïni, ï ba böötge, kiper a ena buutï naa peemma ïïni, ni käla ï wøk ceŋge.
english: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, ï käla wøk ceŋ jøøa reyø møn, naa piema ïïni ceŋge, ge ni wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëët jiy.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jïra, a na Jeremaya, ena köö,
english: The word of the Lord came also unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kärï nyöömmö ki dhaagø na bäre bäre, ni ba nyöötï ko obwöre ma cwøw ki mään paani en.
english: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.

anywaa: Kiper mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper obwöc cwøw ko obwöc mään mo wø nyøølli yi ŋöömmi en, ki mëëkge ki wëëkge ni wø nywøl geni, beeye en:
english: For thus saith the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

anywaa: Geni, ge thøw ki täwe mo leth døc, ni bäŋe jiy mo jwøk geni këël mo koony geni. Dëëtge tïmö kaamar wär mo oker piny. Geno 'näk käci, ni 'näk geni ri leny, ni tïm dëëtge na cam jï wec maal ki lääc paap.
english: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

anywaa: «Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Kärï døny yi øtø mo yie da jwøk thøø; kärï ci kuna kïmmi ki geni, ni ba ciï kuna cømï cwïnyge, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl, ki met ec mara, ki bëët-mëër yaa paanyø bäätge.
english: For thus saith the Lord, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the Lord, even lovingkindness and mercies.

anywaa: Jiy moa kwörge døøŋŋø ki moa kwörge bäŋgø ge thøøa yi ŋöömmi en, ni ge ba koony, ni bäŋ jiy mo jwøk geni, ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïïc dëëre ki gïn mo leth kiperge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo gwäära wïïe wøk.
english: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo cïpi ki cam jï jø wø kïmmi ni cøma cwïnyge kiper thøø, ni bäŋ gïn mo di maadhø mo cïbe cïbö jïge ni cøma cwïnyge, ge na wëëkge ki mëëkge thøw.
english: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

anywaa: «Ïïni thuwø, kärï døny yi øtø mo yie da ajwöma ki man pïï piny ki geni, niï cämï ni mädhï ki geni na aciel.
english: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

anywaa: Kiper mana ŋøl Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Dïlweel mar met ec, ki dwør met ec, ki kanynyø mar nywöm, oraanynya ni nëënö jïïu yïth nïne moo beetu.
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo caanï luupi ii jï jøøi, noo pëënyge ïïni, na ‹?Aŋø, aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na caan gïïögø ni døøŋŋø ni leth yøø ni tägö dëëtwa en? ?Agïnaŋø na baacwa, na agïnaŋø na raac na tïïcwa dëër Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø?›
english: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the Lord pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the Lord our God?

anywaa: køøre oløgï jïge ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Beeye kiper mana ö kwäyu na wecge aani, ni caathge køør juu møøk, ni tïnyge geni ni wøørge geni; ni wecge aani møn, ni kärge ciik 'moa gwøø.
english: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the Lord, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø, uuna tïïö ki gïï mo reyø døc mo kaala moa tïïc kwäyu, kiper ŋati man nø dïïu bëëdö ni caatha køør teek wïc mare na öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnye, ni mara ba wïnynyu.
english: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u riema wøk yi ŋöömö man, ni cou yi ŋöömö mør mo kuyu, mo kuc kwäyu thuwø, ni tïmu nou tïnynya juu møøk ki cääŋŋe ki wärre kaace; kiper bäŋ met ec mo nyoodha jïïu.›
english: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Da nïne mo öö, mo jøw ba kööŋ këët, ni ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, na käl jø Icriel wøk ki Ijep.›
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

anywaa: 'Ba geno kööŋ, ni ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, na käl jø Icriel wøk ki paana en jï løø wï-piny, ki yïth mïëri bëët moa riem geni yïthge,› kiper ge duua yi ŋöömö marge na cïba jï kwäcge.
english: But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

anywaa: «Ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a jääga baŋ jø maay mo thööth, ni maacge jiya kaawat man wø maac rec. Køøre a jääga baŋ jø dwaar mo thööth, ni dwarge jiya bäät kïte ki bäät thuuri ki kwöra näk gøøde yïth kïte.
english: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

anywaa: Kiper aani, waŋa bëëdö ni neeta uutjïëth bëëtö moge bëët, ni patha okanø ki jïra, ni raay moge kär rwäänyö jïra.
english: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

anywaa: Aani, pïïn raay moa tïïcge ki gïïa bacge coola coolø dëëtge na kwöre ariiø, kiper ŋöömma araanyge, ni pääŋge gø  ki juu moge na reyø døc na näk dëëtge bäŋ jwïëy, gïïa näk yia raac ki ge døc.»
english: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na teek mara, ï na kar gwøk røk jïra, na kar kan røk kany wø pïïc gïï mo lethi bääta, wïth juurre ööa baŋï ki kwör mo bäyö, ni köge, ni «Kwäcwa bäŋ Jwøk jïge, 'ba beege juu mo oballe jaak mo bäŋ gïn duuge.»
english: O Lord, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï dhaanhø ki man tïny dëëre ki juu? 'Ba këël dee tïïö, ge patha juu ma adïëri.
english: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Kiper manøgønø, yie man teek mara otïïa nee ŋäcge, ni nyoodha teek bada jïge nee ŋäcge. Køøre nø, nyeŋŋa putge ka ŋäc ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Raay mo jø Juuda onieŋ cwïnyge kaamar gööre mo ogöör bäät kïdi mo göör ka peen nywïënyö mo dhee beth, ni raacge onieŋ bäät tuk gïï wø cïpge olämme moge bäätge.
english: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

anywaa: Geni, gïï wø cïpge olämme moge bäätge, ka arïëki moge mo wø cwøl na Acara, na en tiet jenni moa näk onigïït piny bäät thuuri, wø lääŋge lääŋŋö, ni caala man wø lääŋge obwöre moge.
english: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Juuda, aani, kïnna na en dï pwöla, ki jap kwärö mou, ki jammi mou bëët moa perge leth, ki kwör lam mou moa en bäät thuuri otïïa nee twier kiper raay moa tïïyu dï paac bäre.
english: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

anywaa: Ki køør raay moa tïïyu, ŋöömö mana näk thööŋŋu na cïba jïïu, uuno käl wøk yie, ni tïïa uuni nee nyïïmän mou tïnynyu yi ŋöömö mo kuyu, kiper wëër mara na näk wääŋö kaamar maac atugu, nee bëëde ni liel na bäre bäre.»
english: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, na «Acïëni ena bäät ŋat wø ŋääth dhaanhø, ni tïïc dhaanhø na teek mare, ni cwïnye ogaa wøk køør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper eni tïmö ni caala abuŋŋö mo ena dïtëën, ni kanyo ö gïna beerri, ba joode. 'Ba eno bëëdö dïtëën kany ma cäŋ keere, yi ŋöömö mo yie da acäbö mo ba løny ki beet.
english: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

anywaa: «'Ba gwïëth ena bäät ŋat wø ŋääth Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋäädhe mare ena dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.

anywaa: Kiper eni tïmö ni caala jaath mo opiith lak naam, ni wø lweete këët piny, ni bäŋ gïn mo lwääre kany wø lëënh pinynyi; 'ba bøøge moe bëëdö ni marr jaak, ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋe kiper yïth cwiiri mo meel, ni eni ba kääŋi ki man nyööte ki nyïëdi.»
english: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

anywaa: Cwïny dhaanhø yie da cwøk mo kaala jammi bëët, ni rääye okadhø døc; ?Aŋa noo ŋäc acaac gø?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

anywaa: «Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø neen cwïny dhaanhø, ni wø raŋ acaac dhaanhø thuwø, ni ŋati man nø cunna cunnö ki køør uutjïëth bëëtö moe, ki køør tïïe moe ni wø tïïe.»
english: I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

anywaa: Ŋat wø jïti ki jap kwärö ki øtjöö mo patha kare, eni caala ajwiero mo buta bäät tøŋ møøk mo patha moe na leeŋ piny. 'Ba kanyo tïme na thäk nïr cwiiri moe, kwärö manøgø aay cere; 'ba noo tïme na aŋuudi, put ka ŋäc ni tïïc mana tïïe beeye tïï bøøl jaak.
english: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

anywaa: Kar wäl ajiem na kare dwøŋ cøøn wïlöölö, beeye kar lam marø na en kur keere.
english: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï ni wø ŋääth jø Icrielli, jiy bëët mo wø wec ïïni wïthge olääy. Ni jiy mo wø gaa wøk ki øtjöörï nyeŋge ogöör piny yi tør, kiper na wecge ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï na näk jøøro mar pï kwøw.
english: O Lord, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, dwøk dëëra kare, nee dëëra jöönne; ni piemï aani, naa jïta ki køny; kiper bee ï ni wø pøøya.
english: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

anywaa: Neenï, ge wø köö ki aani, ni «?Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki otäge wäne? Beerra man täge ennø.»
english: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the Lord? let it come now.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a kär kweer ki man tïïa tïï dïkwääc jiy mana cïpï jïra, naa kär bëëdö ni ge yaa päc gïï mo leth cäŋ gïïo leth; kiper ï ki dëërï, luup moa ö wøk ki dhaa nyïmï ŋäyï.
english: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.

anywaa: Kär dëëra wëëk kwanynyi nyïmï, kiper beeye ïïni na kar kan røk jïra kany wø pïïc gïï mo lethi bääta.
english: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.

anywaa: Beerra man lää wïth jø wø 'caan aani, 'ba beerra man ba lää wïïa; beerra man tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi ki lwär, 'ba beerra man ba tïm dëëra ni kwanynyi. Beerra man kälï cäŋ gïï mo leth bäätge, ni raanynyï geni ka aranya mo raac døc.
english: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ciï ni cuŋŋï dhi kiir mana näk mar jøw bëët, man wø cääth nyeye mo Juuda ki yie; ni cuŋŋï thuwø dhøgi bëët mo kiir mar Jerucalem.
english: Thus said the Lord unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

anywaa: Ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk, u na nyeye mo Juuda ki jø Juuda bëët, ki jiy mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem bëët, mo wø cäädhi ki dhøgi mo kiir man.
english: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the Lord, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Gwøgu dëëtu, ni ba käädu ki tëër ki cäŋ jwömö; ni ba kännu ki tëër nou cura dhøk kiir mar Jerucalem.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

anywaa: Ni ba kïthu wøk ki tëër ki yïth uudi mou cäŋ jwömö, ni bäŋe tïïc mo tïïyu; 'ba gwøgu cäŋ jwömö nee bëëde ni ena kur keere, kaawat mana köömma kwäyu.
