english: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kwäyu, mara kärge wïnynyö, ni kärge ïthge ciiø ki dwøra. 'Ba wïthge adøøcge mo teek, ni kärge pwöc mara wïnynyö ni kärge gø jïëö.
english: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, ni näk mo mara wïnynyu wïnynyö na kare, ni ba käädu ki tëër nou cura dhøk kiir man ki cäŋ jwömö, 'ba u gwøga cäŋ jwömö nee bëëde ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk,  ni bäŋe tïïc mo tïïyu dïcäŋögø,
english: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the Lord, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

anywaa: nyeye mo opï piny bäät wäl Deebit dunynyö ki dhøk kiir mar pääny man, geni ki jø kööre moge, ni ge cäädhi ka bäät okwëënyi, ni møøk cäädhi ka jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ni ge cäädhi ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre. Ni ö päänynyi man ni tïme na kar bëëtö na bäre bäre.
english: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ki yïth päänye mo Juuda, ki yïth mïëri moa en deŋ Jerucalem, ki yi ŋööm Benjamen, ni ge ööi ka yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki yïth mïëri moa en bäät kïte, ki kanya cwøl ni Nëgëp, ni ge käädö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki teeŋ olämme møga, ki muuce mo beel, ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ni känge thuwø ko olämme mo dwøk met ec yi øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mara ba wïnynyu ki man gwøgu cäŋ jwömö nee bëëde ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni curu dhøk kiir mar Jerucalem nou käädö ki tëër ki cäŋ jwömö, aani dhøk kiir mar Jerucalem nyeba nyebø ki maac mo ba løny ki bïp, ni put kwöra no ogeerø ni teek bëët dï Jerucalem waaŋ.› »
english: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jïra, a na Jeremaya, ena köö,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni ciï po ŋat wø cwääö ki dääe; køøre dwøra ocaana jïrï kaace.»
english: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

anywaa: Køøre aana ci po ŋat wø cwääö ki dääe, ni jooda gø ni cwääö ki dak ni ee cïp bäät thaac.
english: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

anywaa: 'Ba dak mana cwääe ko odhöönh aränynyö cere; ni cäŋ gø cwääyö na dak mør mana met yie ki gø.
english: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni kööe,
english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, ba løny jïra ki man tïïa uuni kaa teeŋ gïna tïïc dïcwäc dääe manøgø? Ka adïëri møn, u na jø Icriel, u ena cera ni caala manø ni bëët odhöönhnhi cer dïcwäc dääe enø.
english: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the Lord. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

anywaa: Ki nyi kany mo thiinh løny jïra ki man cääna kiper wï jur ka akwöm nyeya ki man cööda geni wøk ni nyaa geni piny ni raanynya geni.
english: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jøøa cääna dëëtge ki luubö, cwïnyge løkge løø ni wecge gïïa reyø, aani, cwïnya dwøga piny ki gïna leth na caara ni daa tïïö dëëtge.
english: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

anywaa: Ni aani, ki nyi kany mo thiinh thuwø, løny jïra ki man cääna kiper wï jur ka akwöm nyeya ki man tïïa geni ni teek ni këëlla tietge piny.
english: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ge tïïö ki gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jïra, ni dwøra ba wïnyge, aani, gïna beer na caana ni daa tïïö jïge ba tïïa këët.
english: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Jeremaya en, caan gïn jï jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem, ki jï jø wø bëëdö dï Juuda bäre, ni kööï, ni ‹Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, a kännö bäätu ki gïn mo leth døc, ni beeye acaay ajäla mo teek døc kiperu. 'Ba ennø, ŋati man nø dïïu luu ree ni wec jöör bëëtö mare na raac, ni tïïyu uutjïëth bëëtö mou ki tïïe mou ni beyø.›
english: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

anywaa: 'Ba geno köö, ni ‹Bäŋ gïn løny jïwa këët na bäre bäre; waani, wa poot cäädhö køør acaare mowa, ni ö ŋati man nø dïwa ni tïïe ki køør teek wïc mare na öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnye.› »
english: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Pëënynyu wïth juurre, man näk da ŋat mo teeŋ gïn ee wïnynyö. Jø Icriel na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue atïïö ki gïn mo raac døc mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, pey wø aay dëët kïte moa en wï Kïn Libaanø? ?A pïï moa ŋec mo wø löönynyi ki bäät kïdi manøgø wø tal?
english: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

anywaa: 'Ba jiya aana wecge, ni tïmge ni ge wääŋö ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï juu mo oballe; ni ö juugögø ni wëëk tietge cwanynyø  yïth uutjïëtha cääŋŋe na cørge yïthge, ni wëëkge ge wääth yïth uutjïëthe moa näk kär ŋeth.
english: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö marge oränynyi, ni tïme na gïr abuua na bäre bäre. Ni ö jiyi bëët mo opöödhi ki buute ni thäŋ yïthge, ni putge wïthge keny.
english: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

anywaa: Geni, ge keetha keethø nyïm nyïïmänge kaawat man wø tïïc jam wø kwönni ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Aani, ŋääa løøa baŋge, ni mäna täärnyïma ki geni, kanyo tïme na cäŋ gïna leth na wäŋŋi kiperge.»
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk aköö, ni «Ööu, nøø määnyö ki jöö man raanynyø Jeremaya ki gø. Kiper dïlämme mo wø caan ciik kee nut cøøn, ki jøøa wïthge leer ni wø cïpi ki pwöc, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø køp luum Jwøk. Ööu nø, nee eni raanynyø ki lëëpø, ni ba ciiø ïthø ki gïn wø caane.»
english: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï ki mara; wïny gïn wø caan jøøa män ki aani.
english: Give heed to me, O Lord, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïn mo beer doo coolø ki gïn mo raac? Par wïïï ki mana cuŋŋa nyïmï kiperge, na cääna ki gïn mo beer na kar dhøkge, kiper nee wëër marï paanyï bäätge. 'Ba ennø, gena kunyö ki buur kipera.
english: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cïp geni dho opëëllö, ni wëëgï obwöre moge thøø ki käc. Beerra man tïm määrge na määr thuunhnhi, ni bëëtge ni bäŋ obwöre jïge. Beerra man 'näk cwøwge ni thøwge, ni ö wøpe moge moa teek ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö ri leny.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.

anywaa: Kanyo jääŋŋï jøw oraany paac baŋge ki nyi kany mo thiinh, beerra man put tïmö ni da oduuru mo wïnyö mïëcge, kiper gena kunyö ki buur naa makge, ni cekge abïëp kipera.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, gïï mo pïï ri thøø na tut jøøgø kipera bëët ŋäyï. Kär bääyö marge uumï, ni ba gööbï raay moge wøk nyïmï. 'Ba beerra man ränyge nyïmï, ni kanyo kööï niï wëër yie, wärï tïïï ki gïn mo leth dëëtge!
english: Yet, Lord, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, a na Jeremaya, ni «Ciï ni ŋëëï ki dak baŋ ŋat wø cwääö ki dääe. Ni kädï ki jiy røk jø døøŋŋø ki røk dïlämme moa kwörge døøŋŋø.
english: Thus saith the Lord, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

anywaa: Ni ciï ya agäm-kïdi mana cwøl ni Ben Inöm, na en buut dhi kiir man wø leeŋ abänni yie, ni caanï luummi ni caana jïrï en kaace,
english: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

anywaa: ni caanï gø nee wïny nyec Juuda, ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem, ni kööï, ni ‹Wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk. Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, a känna bäät paani ki gïn mo leth, ni ŋat wø wïny gø, cwïnye puta bwøk.
english: And say, Hear ye the word of the Lord, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

anywaa: Kiper jiy 'moa aana wecge, ni tïïcge kany na kany wø lamge juu mo wïth juurre yie, ni waaŋge gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï juu moøgø mo kucge, mo kuc kwäcge, këël nyeye mo Juuda; ni pääŋge kany ki rem jiy mo bäŋ gïn  mo ege baaø.
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

anywaa: Ni tïïge ki kwör lam jï jwøa cwøl ni Baal, kiper nee wäätge waaŋge no olämme jï Baal, ni beeye gïn mo ge kära köömmö ki man tïïcge gø, na gïn mo kära caanø, na acaac gïnögø bäŋgø mo ö wïïa thuwø.
english: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, da cääŋŋe mo öö, mo kany ba cwøl këët ni Töpeth wala Agäm Kïn Ben Inöm, 'ba ocwøl na Agäm Kïn Kar Ŋaal Jiy.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

anywaa: « ‹Aani, acaare mo jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre raanynya raanynyø yi paani, ni cïba geni dho opëëllö nyïm nyïïmän moge, jø wø many jwïëcge. Ni cïba rïŋ dëëtge na cam jï wec maal ki jï lääc paap.
english: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, pääny man tïïa tïïö nee ränynye, ni tïme na gïr abuua. Ni ö jiy bëët mo wø pöödhi ki buute ni buuge gø ni thäŋ yïthge kiper gïïo leth noo pïï dëër paani.
english: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

anywaa: Jiya otïïa nee ge ciel nyïïmänge dïër, ni ö nyïïmänge, ni beege jø wø many jwïëcge, ni tïïcge bëëtö marge ni leth; ni ö jiya ni camge rïk wäätge ki rïk nyïïge, ni ö geni ni døøge dëëtge keerge ni ö ŋati man nø ni cam rïŋ wati.›
english: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

anywaa: «Kanyøgønø, dak wär put gøø piny ni nëënö jï jiy moa aay ki ïïni,
english: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

anywaa: ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Aani, jøøi ii ki pääny man raanynya raanynyø kaamar dak man na gøø piny en ni ba løny ki man dwøgi kare këët. Køøre geno koony Töpeth kany këël kanyo pääŋe ni bäŋ kany kuny yie.
english: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Topheth, till there be no place to bury.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye gïno tïïa dëër paani en ki dëët jiy mo wø bëëdö yie, ni tïïa pääny man na Jerucalem en kaamar Töpeth.
english: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the Lord, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Topheth:

anywaa: Uudi mo Jerucalem, ki mo nyeye mo Juuda, otïmö ni ba waany kaamar Töpeth, ni beege uudi bëët moa näk jiy wääŋö bäätge ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ni ge lama cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer, ni kunyge piny bäätge ki muuy mar køøŋø jï juu møøk.› »
english: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Topheth, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya aduuö ki Töpeth kanya jääŋŋi ya Wuuö Jwøki yie nee luum Jwøk købe, ni cuŋŋe dï kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe jï jiy bëët,
english: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord's house; and said to all the people,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, gïïa leth bëët na nø caana käla bäät pääny man ki bäät mïëri bëët moa en deŋŋe, kiper wïthge adøøcge mo teek ni kweerge ki man cekge ïthge ki luup 'moa.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dïlämi ma Pacuur wär Imër, ŋata bëëdö na wïth jø tïïc mo wø tïïö øt Wuuö Jwøk, na wïny Jeremaya ni køpa luum Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

anywaa: eni na Pacuur nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya awëëk pöödö, ni wëëk tiet gø kïth yo orøgø na en deŋ dhi kal mar Øt Jwøk mana cwøl ni Benjamen.
english: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, kanya ö Pacuurri na käl tiet Jeremaya wøk ki yo orøgø, Jeremaya aköö jïre, ni «Nyeŋŋï mana cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïrï patha Pacuur këët, 'ba beeye Magör-Micabip, na näk tiere beeye ni lwär mo dwøŋ piny opääŋe bäre.
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The Lord hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor–missabib.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani lwär mo dwøŋ jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätï ki bäät nyïïawäätï bëët. Geni, geno 'näk nyïïmänni moge ko opëëllö ni nëënö jïrï. Aani, jø Juuda bëët cïba cer nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni ni 'näk møøk ko opëëllö, ni mak møøk ki tøŋ ni kïth ge Babiløn.
english: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, jap kwärö mo päänyi en bëët cïba ceŋ nyïïmän moge, ni beege jammi moa jootge ki ri tïïc marge, ki jammi moa perge leth, ki jammi bëët moa perge leth mo nyec Juuda; ni ö nyïïmänni ni twierge japøgø, ni lwørge ge, ni kïthge geni Babiløn.
english: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Pacuur en, ïïni ki jø wø bëëdö paarï bëët, u di maa ki  tøŋ ni kïth uuni Babiløn. Køøre ï thøøa kaace, ni koony ï yie, ni beeye ïïni ki nyïïawäätï bëët moa køpï luum tööt jïge ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana cøøgï, aana cøøgï møn. Aana magï ki teek, ni böötï aani. 'Ba ennø, aana tïmö ni jøw ŋeethø bääta ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët, ni jiy bëët buua aani.
english: O Lord, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø cääna, a cäänö ni dwøra ena maal døc naa køpa gïr caannø mar jiy ki ränynyö mano tägi. 'Ba luum Wuuö Jwøk akännö bääta ka ajøøŋ ka abuua ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët.
english: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the Lord was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa köö, ni «Nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ba mula ki dhaa, ni bäŋ gïn mo caana ki nyeŋŋe këët,» gïno tägi, luumme gwenni cwïnya ni caala maac mo liel, ni aano ööl ki man jwøa gø, ni ba løny jïra ki man kana gø cwïnya.
english: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

anywaa: Aani, jiy mo thööth awïnynya ni ge muuŋu ki nyeŋŋa, ni «Kee ena köö, ni ‹Lwär mo dwøŋ, piny opääŋe bäre.› Jäällu eni! Beerra man jäälø eni kiree!» Këël nyïïawääta bëët moa näk yaa ŋäädhö kiree, ge manynya ränynyö mara, ni köge, ni «Kanymør wïïe di maaŋŋø, nee ø jïtö ki jöö man böötø eni ki gø, ni marø cool kwör dëëre.»
english: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ena buuta kaamar oteen tøŋ. Kiper manøgønø, jø wø 'caan aani a ba böötge; 'ba tietge ocwanyge, ni tïm wïthge ni laay døc kiper no ba thur gïna manyge kare, ni wïc ba wïl ki lään wïc marge na bäre bäre.
english: But the Lord is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, ï ni wø raŋ jøøa marge beer, ni wø neet cwïny ka acaare, wëëk a neen cool kwör marï mano tïïyï dëëtge, kiper luubö mara yaa cïp cerï.
english: But, O Lord of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.

anywaa: Wärru jï Wuuö Jwøk nou pwøya eni! Kiper jøøa can wø pieme piemø ceŋ jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: Sing unto the Lord, praise ye the Lord: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

anywaa: Wui, acïëni en bäät cäŋa nywøl aani yie! Beerra man ö cäŋögø na ö mera na nywøl aani yie ni ba gwïëdhi!
english: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

anywaa: Acïëni en bäät ŋata caan dwøl jï wära, na tïïc yi wära ni met, ni kööe, ni «Ïïna nyöönni ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø.»
english: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm ŋatøgø kaamar päänye moa raany Wuuö Jwøki, na näk cwïnye käre dwøk piny ki gïrge. Beerra man ö ŋatøgø ni täk gïn mo lethi poge, ni wïny oduuru ka amöölla, ni wïny dwør tuuŋ mar leny ki dhöör cäŋ,
english: And let that man be as the cities which the Lord overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

anywaa: kiper a käre nääö yi mera; ni kär yi mera tïmö na bwörö mara ni di yi mera bëëdö ni dwøŋ cooth ki aani.
english: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na ööa wøk yi mera,  naa jïta ki gïï mo leth ki kïmmö, ni thum cääŋŋe 'moa bëët ni wïïa laay en?
english: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, kanya ö nyeya ma Cëdëkiya na jääŋ Pacuur o Malkiya ki dïlämi ma Jepaniya o Maycëya baŋe. Ni köge jïre,
english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beerra man pëënynyï Wuuö Jwøk kiperwa, kiper Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn amäänynyö baŋwa. Kanymør Wuuö Jwøk ø pieme piemø ki køør tïïe moe na näk rëëma ec, kiper nee nyïïmän døøge ŋäthge.»
english: Enquire, I pray thee, of the Lord for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the Lord will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Jeremaya acaane jïge, ni kööe, ni «Caannu jï Cëdëkiya, ni kööu,
english: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

anywaa: ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en: Ennø, aani, tøøŋi moø ni en ceŋŋu yøø 'dwøga dëëtu, ni beege tøøŋi moøgø ni këëdu ki nyeny Babiløn ki ge yøø ki jø leny moe, ni bëëdö ni kiir maru ege ciel dïër yøø; aani, ge käla yi pääny man.
english: Thus saith the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

anywaa: Ni ööa ki dëëra ni rwiea cera bäätu ki køør teek bada, ni këëda ki uuni ni aano wëër ki wëër mo dwøŋ mo liel kaamar maac.
english: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, jiy ki lääy mo wø bëëdö yi pääny man nääa nääö, ni thøwge ki täw mo leth døc.
english: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

anywaa: Køør manøgønø, gïno tïïa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda, ki jø kööre moe, ki jiy mo odööŋ ni kwøw yi pääny man, no obøth ki täw ki leny ki käc, cïba cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ki ceŋ nyïïmän moge, jø wø many jwïëcge. Ni ö Nabukedenecörri ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö. Eni cwïnye ba dee bäädhö ki geni, ni cwïnye ba doo pädhö ki gïrge, ni yie ba dee warø ki geni.› »
english: And afterward, saith the Lord, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

anywaa: Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cäŋ köö jïra, ni «Caanï jï jø päänyi en, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ennø, jöör kwøw ki jöör thøø acïba nyïmmu.
english: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

anywaa: Ŋato bëëdö yi pääny man thøw ki käc ki täw mo leth, ni nääi ko opëëllö. 'Ba ŋato aa wøk ni cïp cere jï jø Kaldia moø ni u ege ciel dïër yøø, eni kwøw, ni bøth jwïëyi moe.
english: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

anywaa: Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, wïïa yaa nø këël ri päänyi ki man tïïa ki gïn mo leth dëëre, ni patha gïn mo beer. Päänyi en 'cïba cer nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni ni waaŋ gø.› 11-12
english: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the Lord: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

anywaa: «Ni kööï jï jø dhi øt nyeny Juuda, « ‹Wui, u na jø dhi øt Deebit, wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk. Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ŋøllu luup cooth na karge, ni kønynyu jiy mo wø japge møt ceŋ jø wø caan geni. 'Ba ni näk mo ba tïïyu, nou tïïya tïïe mo reyø, wëër mara ni wø liel ni wääŋö kaamar maac mo ba løny ki bïp 'käla bäätu.› »

Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki luubö dëët jø Jerucalem, ni kööe, «U ni wø bëëdö kany mo ociel kïdi dïër ya apany thuur, aani, mara caana caanø dëëtu, u ni wø köö, na ‹?Aŋa noo ö baŋwa kany nee këëde ki waani, na aŋa noo duny kar bëëtö marwa?›
english: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the Lord; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, u jääla jäälö ki køør tïïe mou na reyø, ni waaŋa paan dwøŋ maru ki maac ni ö gïïo en lage bëët ni thööri ya maaci.»
english: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the Lord: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Ci paan dwøŋ po nyeny Juuda ni caanï luummi en kaace,
english: Thus saith the Lord; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

anywaa: ni kööï, ‹Wui, ï na  nyeny Juuda, ï na läw bäät wäl Deebit, wïny luum Wuuö Jwøk, ïïni ki jø kööre moï bëët, ki jiy moï mo wø cäädhi ki dhøk kal man.
english: And say, Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ŋøllu luup na karge ki jöö ma adïëri, ni kønynyu jiy mo wø japge møt ceŋ jø wø caan geni. Käru bääyö dëër jur mo bëëdö dïïu, ki kïïc, ki cï thøø, ni ba tïïu ki gïï mo reyø dëëtge, ni ba kønynyu rem jiy piny kany, mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gïï ii tïïyu tïïö na adïëri, nyeye moo läw bäät wäl Deebit paan dwøŋ kany, ocäädhi ki dhøk kal man, ni ge cäädhi ka jïëthe mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki bäät okwëënyi, ni nyeya man nø cäädhi ka jø kööre moe ki jiy moe.
english: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo luumma ba wïnynyu, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a puta kööŋ ŋëëta keera, ki man räny paan dwøŋŋi man na bäre.›
english: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation.

anywaa: «Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper paan dwøŋ man mar nyeny Juuda beeye en: «Ï na paan dwøŋ en, këël na bëëdï jïra niï beer kaamar ŋööm Gelät, niï mïërö kaamar wï Kïn Libaanø, ka adïëri man, aani, ï tïïa tïïö kaamar paap ma tëën, ni tïïa ïïni kaamar päänye mo ba beet.
english: For thus saith the Lord unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.

anywaa: Aani, jøw oraany ïïni jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋï, ni ŋati man nø cere da jap leny moe; ni öörge jer geer moï wøk moa beyø, ni leeŋge geni yi maac.
english: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

anywaa: «'Ba wïth juurre mo thööth moo pöödhi ki buut pääny man, ŋati man nø oköö jï wati, na ‹?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc gïn na leth dëër päänyi ni dwøŋ en?›
english: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the Lord done thus unto this great city?

anywaa: Køøre oløkge, ni ‹Beeye kiper mana ö jø päänynyi man na wecge luumma tuut Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marge, ni wøørge juu møøk ni tïnyge geni.› »
english: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

anywaa: Kär nou jwöŋö kiper Jöcaya, nyeya mana thøw, ni ba kïmmu kipere; 'ba jwöŋu ni yïthu you keeyø kiper Jeyöakac, nyeya mana mak ki tøŋ na käl, kiper eni ba duui këët, ni ŋööm poge ba neene.
english: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Calum o Jöcaya nyeny Juuda, ŋata läw kar wänni ma Jöcaya na nyeya, na mak ki tøŋ na käl, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Calum ba duu kany këët na bäre bäre.
english: For thus saith the Lord touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

anywaa: 'Ba eno thøø kanyo kïth eni yie ni eni mak ki tøŋ, ni ŋöömmi en ba cäŋ neennø këët.»
english: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, no «Otïmö ni raac jï ŋat wø geer øt nyec mare ni jø tïïc ee mødø, ni gëët bäät ødøgø ki øtø mør ni jø tïïc ee caarø, ŋat wø wëëk jiy tïïc jaak, ni bäŋ gïn coole jïge kiper tïïc marge;
english: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

anywaa: ŋat wø köö, ni ‹Dëëra gëënna gëënnö ki øt nyec mo dwøŋ døc, mo bääte yaa gëënnö ki øtø mo yïthe døøŋŋø, ni kïtha dëëre ki uut awëërnyeŋŋi mo thööth, ni tïïa gø ni mïërö ko opämi mo beyø, ni rwødha gø ki booya mo kwaar.›
english: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, iï caarø ni nyec marï beeye kiper mana geerï øt nyec marï ko opämi mo beyø mo thööth niï kaatha ceŋ jø møøk?  Aŋø, wäru kera abëëdö ni cämö ni mädhö, ni tïïc tïïc mana näk kare na näk adïëri, ni bëët jammi bëët ni beyø jïre.
english: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?

anywaa: Eni kee luup jøøa no ocaarø ki luup jøøa can aŋøle na karge, ni bëët paaci bäre na wøp. ?Aŋø, ki man ŋäc aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, paa beeye ki man tïïc teeŋ tïïe moøgø nø?
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, waŋï ki cwïnyï wø ena køør jammi mo wø jöötï ki jïëth atade, ki køny rem jiy piny mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø, ki 'caar jiy ki thiel jiy piny.»
english: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Jeyöakëm o Jöcaya nyeny Juuda beeye en, ena köö, ni «Jiy ba doo jwöŋö kipere kanyo thøøe, ni ge köö yïthakicge keerge, ni ‹Wui coka! Wui coka!› Ni jiy ba doo jwöŋö kipere, ni ‹Wui nyenywa öy! Wui nyenywa, ï na nyeny ajiem marwa!›
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

anywaa: 'Ba eno kïth wøk kaamar arëën mo othøw, ni tïïc ni di tuudö ni leeŋi wøk ŋää kiir Jerucalem.»
english: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

anywaa: «U na jø Jerucalem, u cøøa bäät Kïn Libaanø ni gööu ko oduuru, ni cou Baacan ni jwöŋu ni döötu ena maal, ni cou bäät Kïn Abarim thuwø ni gööu ko oduuru, kiper wïth juurre moa mëërru ki geni na dwätu ki geni bëët ge di raanynyø.
english: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

anywaa: Uuna köömma kanya bëëdu ni bëëtö maru jööt jaak, 'ba uuna köö, ni ‹Marï ba wïnywa!› Manøgø beeye bëëtö maru cøøn ki mana täge ki kanya täk paac yie, ni dwøra ba wïnynyu.
english: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe mou bëët onikeet kaawat man wø tïïc jame, ni ö wïth juurre moa mëërru ki geni na dwätu ki geni ni maai ki tøŋ. Køøre wïthu otïmö ni laay, ni tïm nyeŋŋu ni law, kiper gïïa reyø bëët na tïïyu.
english: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

anywaa: U na jø Jerucalem, u ni wø bëëdö yïth uudi mo beyø, mo geer ka jer lur Libaanø, a teeŋ cooyø mo nyïëdi nou cooyu ki gø kanyo ö räämmi bäätu, ni beeye rääm mo caala mar dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.»
english: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk akööŋ ŋëëte keere, ni kööe jï Jekönaya wär Jeyöakëm, nyeny Juuda, ni «Këël doo na ï bëëdö kaamar ogut lweedø man ni pere leth ni cer cwïïa en, ï daa käla wøk.
english: As I live, saith the Lord, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

anywaa: Ïïni, ï cïba ceŋ jø wø many jwïëy moï, jø wø lwäärï ki geni, ni beeye Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn ki jiye ma jø Kaldia.
english: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: Ïïni ki meru na nywøl ïïni, u leeŋa paac mør, kany mou ba nywølla yie, ni thøwu kaace.
english: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

anywaa: 'Ba yi ŋöömö mano manynyu ki cwïnynyu, u ba duu yie këët.»
english: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

anywaa: Ennø, nyenøgø na Jekönaya enø, atïmö ni caala dak mo othøw mo pere ba leth, na dak mo bäŋ ŋat mo many gø këët, ni beeye na wet eni ki wääte en, ni leeŋ geni yi ŋöömö mo kucge.
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

anywaa: Wui ŋöömmi en, wui ŋöömmi en, wui ŋöömmi en!  Wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk!
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, «Göör nyeŋ Jekönaya piny na dhaanhø mo kee bäŋ wïïe mo ee nywølø, na dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare ba bëënynyi ki yïth nïr kwøw moe; kiper ki røk jiy moo käl dëëre, bäŋ dhaanhø mo bëënynyi, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo pï piny bäät wäl Deebit, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo käär jø Juuda.»
english: Thus saith the Lord, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, no «Otïmö ni raac jï dïkwääye mo wø raany jiy 'moa ni keethge geni, ni beege jiy mo wø kwaaya kaamar pïïth dïëk 'moa.»
english: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, kiper dïkwääye mo wø käär jiye beeye en, ena köö, ni «Uuni, jiya na caal pïïth dïëk 'moa akeethu, ni riemu geni wøk, ni ge käru gwøø. Ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a känna bäätu ka ajäla kiper tïïe mou na reyø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra, jiya moa näk odööŋ ni kwøw ni caal pïïth dïëk 'moa, lema lemø yïth mïëri bëët moa riema geni yïthge, ni duua geni kar bëëtö marge, ni ö geni ni nyöötge ni nyaacge.
english: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

anywaa: Ni mooa geni ki dïkwääye mo käär geni, ni ge ba lwäyi këët, ni ge ba bööi, ni bäŋ aciel mo rwäänyi rege.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, maa tïŋŋa maal ki ŋat mo mare beeye adïëri, na ŋat mo tïmö na lwiidhø mo käla ri dhi øt Deebit, ni ö ŋatøgø ni bëëde ni nyeya, ni käär paac ni wïïe leer, ni luup ŋøle na karge ni tïïya adïëri yi paac.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïr nyec moe jø Juuda di piemø, ni ö geni na jø Icriel ni bëëtge ni geno nikwak. 'Ba man beeye nyeŋŋe mano cwøl eni ki gø, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk beeye tier bëënynyö marø.›
english: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE Lord OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye ni da nïne mo öö, mo jiy ba kööŋ këët, ni ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, na käl jø Icriel wøk ki Ijep,›
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that they shall no more say, The Lord liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

anywaa: 'ba geno kööŋ, ni ‹Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, na käl jø Icriel wøk ki paana en jï løø wï-piny, ni duu geni ki mïëri bëët moa riem geni yïthge.› Køøre geno bëëdö yi ŋöömö marge.»
english: But, The Lord liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø caara bëët nyïïkuk Jwøk, cwïnya puta pädhö døc, ni tïm dëëra ni kwanynyi. Aana tïmö naa caala dhaanhø mo omeer mo obööt køøŋe, kany wø cäda kiper Wuuö Jwøk, ki luup moe na en kur keerge.
english: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the Lord, and because of the words of his holiness.

anywaa: Kiper paac päŋ ki jø luui, ni tïm ŋøømmi ni kïmmö ki køør acïëni mana pïï bääte, ni ö kwör kwaathi bëët moa en paap ni talge. Nyïïkuk Jwøk jöör bëëtö marge raac, ni teek marge tïïcge ka jöö mo patha kare.
english: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Nyïïkuk Jwøk ki dïlämme bëët bëëtö marge araanyge; këël ki yi øtø mara kiree, gena jooda ni ge tïïö yie ki gïï mo reyø.
english: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, jöörge otïmö ni da adipøødha yie mo ceeya tietge, ni cöör geni wøk yi muudhö, ni päthge yie; kiper a kännö bäätge ki gïn mo leth yi cwiino jääla geni yie.» Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Mør thuwø, gïn mo raac ajooda baŋ nyïïkuk jwøk mo Cameria; luup akøpge ki nyeŋ jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni ge løøa wïth jiya wøk ma jø Icriel.
english: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïn mo raac døc mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø ajooda baŋ nyïïkuk Jwøk mo Jerucalem; ni ge tïïya tïï luui, ni ge bëëdö ni ge caatha køør luup tööt; ge bëëdö ni ge wëëga bäät jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø tëënnö, nee bäŋe ŋat mo wec tïïe moe na reyø. Ni put jø Jerucalemmi bëët tïmö kaamar jø Cødam ki jïra, ni tïmge thuwø kaamar jø Gømöra.
english: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, mana caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët, kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø beeye en: «Ka adïëri møn, aani, ge caama caamø ki lweet jaath mo keec, ni maadha geni ki pïï mo ree da cïm; kiper bëëtö mo raac anyaay paac bäre, ni tägi ka baŋ nyïïkuk Jwøk mo Jerucalem.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Kär nou wïnynya luup nyïïkuk Jwøk moø ni køp luup yøø jïïu. Geni, ge pääŋa cwïnynyu jaak ki luup ŋäädhe mo oballe; luup moøgø ni carge yøø käla wïthge keerge, ni patha moa cur dhi Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.

anywaa: Ge wø köö cooth jï jø wø kwier dëëra, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye nou jïtö ki bëëtö mo beer;› ni köge jï jø wø cäädhi ki køør teek wïc mana öö ki køør rääö mana en cwïnyge, ni ‹Bäŋ gïn mo leth mo pïï bäätu.›
english: They say still unto them that despise me, The Lord hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

anywaa: «?'Ba aŋa nø na bëëdö wï maac mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nee luum Wuuö Jwøk raŋe døøc ni wïny gø? ?Na aŋa na cek ïthe na wïny luumma?
english: For who hath stood in the counsel of the Lord, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk öö bäät jøøa reyø kaamar atuunna, ni beeye atuunna mo teek døc mo raanynya geni.
english: Behold, a whirlwind of the Lord is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ba døø ŋääe ki wëër mare këël mano tïïc mana en cwïnye ni wëëk gø thur kare. 'Ba kanyo täk gïïögø ya aŋuun nïne, tiere ojootu na kare.
english: The anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø, ge kära jääŋŋö, 'ba gena aay ki wïthge keerge jaak; naa kär cäänö ki geni, 'ba luup køpge ka wïthge keerge.
english: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

anywaa: 'Ba doo na geno bëëdö wï maac mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luup 'moa dege købø jï jiya, ni dege jiya duu wøk ki yïth uutjïëth raay moge, ki tïïe moge na reyø.
english: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aana Jwøk mo kara cään ka u keeru, naa patha Jwøk mo ena bäät piny bäre?
english: Am I a God at hand, saith the Lord, and not a God afar off?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï dhaanhø ki man kan ree kwör mo kuc, nee eni ba jooda, a na Wuuö Jwøk? ?Aŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, maal ki piny patha yaa pääŋö bäre?
english: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the Lord. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Aani, gïïa car nyïïkuk Jwøki mo wø køp luup tööt ki nyeŋŋa awïnynya ni ge köö, ni ‹Aana lägö, aana lägö.›
english: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëët gïïögø ni poot ena cwïny nyïïkuk Jwøk moi na tööte ii, jø wø car jap cwøk moa en cwïnyge keerge?
english: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

anywaa: Ki jïge ege caarø ni ki køør lääk mo wø carge yïthakicge ni wïth jiya wïl ki nyeŋŋa, kaa mana wïl wïth kwäcge ki nyeŋŋa ki køør mana wøørge Baal.
english: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

anywaa: Beerra man ö nyikuŋ Jwøki mana lägö ni caan gø ni beeye lääk mare keere, 'ba beerra man ö nyikuŋ Jwøki mano wïny luumma ni caan gø na kare. ?Aŋø, lethø pere wø leth kaamar beel?
english: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the Lord.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luumma ba caal maac, ni caal guduum man wø tøk kïdi na thäŋi?
english: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the Lord; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mara caana caanø dëët nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø kwaal luup yïthakicge keerge, ni tïïcge ge ni beege luup 'moa.
english: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mara caana caanø møn dëët nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø mo wø car luup ki lëëpge jaak, ni wø köö, ni ‹Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki.›
english: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the Lord, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mara caana caanø dëët nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø car lääk jaak mo bäŋ tietge jï jiya, ni løøge wïth jiya wøk ki køør tööt ki diwaŋ marge; 'ba ge kära jääŋŋö, ni ge kära köömmö, ni bäŋ gïn mo thiinh mo ege kønyø ri jiy moi.
english: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the Lord, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö dhaanhe acielli røk jøøi ii, wala nyikuŋ Jwøk, wala dïlämi noo pëëny ïïni, ni ‹?Da dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër mo iï wïnynyö?› køøre wär put løk jïge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni u ki dëëtu, beeye u na tëër bääta; 'ba aani, u 'leeŋa piny.›
english: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the Lord? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da nyikuŋ Jwøk wala dïlämi wala dhaanhø mør mo cäänö jaak kiper dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër, ŋatøca jääla jäälö ki paare bäre.
english: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even punish that man and his house.

anywaa: 'Ba man tïmö ni beeye gïno caan ŋati man nø jï wati ki jï tuuŋge, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na løk Wuuö Jwøki? ?Agïne na caan Wuuö Jwøki?›
english: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the Lord answered? and, What hath the Lord spoken?

anywaa: 'Ba u tïmö nou ba cäänö këët kiper dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër, kiper ŋato cäänö, luubö mare otïmö na tëër bääte, kiper mana daaŋŋu luup Jwøa kwøw, Jwøk maru, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And the burden of the Lord shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the Lord of hosts our God.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye mano caannu jï nyikuŋ Jwøk, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na løk Wuuö Jwøki jïrï? ?Agïne na caan Wuuö Jwøki?›
english: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the Lord answered thee? and, What hath the Lord spoken?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou cäänö jaak kiper dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër, këël na bëëde ni aano jääk baŋu ki dwøl ni käru cäänö kiper dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër,
english: But since ye say, The burden of the Lord; therefore thus saith the Lord; Because ye say this word, The burden of the Lord, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the Lord;

anywaa: ennø, u tïŋa maal ni riema uuni wøk nyïma, ni raanynya pääny mana cïba jïïu ki kwäyu.
english: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:

anywaa: Ni känna bäätu ka ajøøŋ mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ki law waŋ mo wïc ba wïl ki gø na bäre bäre.»
english: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø ö Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn na nø mak Jekönaya wär Jeyöakëm nyeny Juuda, ki jø kööre mo Juuda, ki rëëmme, ni maae Jerucalem ki tøŋ ni nø kïth geni Babiløn, Wuuö Jwøk anyuuthö jïra ko orööge ariiø mo päŋ ki nyïïolämmi mo ocïp piny nyïm Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The Lord shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the Lord, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

anywaa: Oröögö aciel yie da nyïïolämmi mo beyø døc, mo caala mo wø kwøŋ ciek. No oröögö maya yie da nyïïolämmi mo reyø døc mo ba løny ki cam kiper mana näk mo geno kwäk.
english: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aana pëënynye, ni kööe, ni «?Jeremaya, agïnaŋø ni neetï enø?» Ni dwøga gø jïre, ni «Beege nyïïolämmi, nyïïolämmi moa beyø, beyø døc; 'ba nyïïolämmi moa reyø, reyø døc, ni ba løny ki cam kiper mana näk mo geno kwäk.»
english: Then said the Lord unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man caana, a na Wuuö  Jwøk, Jwø Icriel beeye en: Aani, jø Juuda moa riema wøk ki yi ŋöömmi en na mak ki tøŋ na kïth yi ŋööm jø Babiløn, ge raŋa raŋø ni beyø ni caala nyïïolämmi moi ni beyø ii.
english: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.

anywaa: Ni neeta geni ki waŋ mo beer, ni duua geni yi ŋöömmi en, ni tïïa geni ni teek, ni ba nyaaa geni piny këët. 'Ba tietge okëëlla piny, ni ba cööda geni wøk këët.
english: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

anywaa: Aani, ge mooa mooø ki cwïny mo løny ki man ŋäcge aani ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk; ni bëëtge ni gena jiya, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøge, kiper ge duua baŋa ki cwïnyge bäre.
english: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

anywaa: «'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda, ki jø kööre moe, ki jø Jerucalem moa no odööŋ ni kwøw yi ŋöömmi en, ki mo wø bëëdö Ijep, kwiera kwierø kaamar nyïïolämmi moi ni reyø ii, na kwier ki cam kiper mana näk mo geno kwäk.
english: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the Lord, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

anywaa: Ni tïïa geni nee tiet mïëri bëët mo bäät piny tïmge ni cwïnyge böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, ni tïmge na jiy mo reyø ki jïge, ni tïmge na gïr ajøøŋ, na gïr aŋaada, na gïr abuua, na gïr acïëni kwöro riema geni yïthge bëët.
english: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

anywaa: Aani, mänye ki käc ki täw mo leth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätge, këël mano thumge ki thøø yi ŋöömma cïba jïge ki kwäcge.»
english: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ na beet Nabukedenecörri ni ena nyeny Babiløn, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, a na Jeremaya, kiper jø Juuda bëët;
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;

anywaa: ni beeye dwøl mana caana, a na nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, jï jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki jø Juuda bëët, ni kööa,
english: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ki yïth cwiiri moi na pïërariiø kurdäk ii, ki mana täge ki ra aŋuun cwiiri apaar kurdäk moa beet Jöcaya wär Amön ni ena nyeny Juuda, këël dïcäŋi en, dwør Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ni ööa bääta, ni cara gø jïïu cooth, 'ba dwøre käru wïnynyö.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the Lord hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.

anywaa: «Ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ni jääŋŋa jiy moe ma nyïïkuk Jwøk baŋu cooth, 'ba dwøre käru wïnynyö ni ïthu käru ciiø.
english: And the Lord hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

anywaa: Ni mana køpge beeye, ni ‹Løgu rou ennø, ni weyu uutjïëth raay mou ki tïïe mou na reyø; køøre u bëëdö yi ŋöömö man na cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïïu ki kwäyu na bäre bäre.
english: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

anywaa: Ni ba cäädhu køør juu møøk nee geni tïnynyu ni wøørru geni. Ni ba tïïu ki juu møøk ki ceŋŋu nee cwïnya ba raanynyu; køøre a ba tïïö dëëtu ki gïn mo leth.›
english: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

anywaa: «'Ba luumma käru wïnynyö, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni putu cwïnya raanynyø ki køør juu moa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu, nou käla gïï mo leth bäätu.»
english: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the Lord; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kiper mana käru luupa wïnynyö,
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, a jääga baŋ jø tiet mïëri bëët moa en jï løø wï-piny, ki baŋ Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, eni na en cera, ni käla geni nee këëtge yi ŋöömmi en ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yie, këël ki wïth juurre mo wø kïïö ki ŋöömmi en. Ni puta geni raanynyø na bäre bäre, ni tïïa geni ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, na gïr abuua, ni päthge yi ränynyö mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

anywaa: Aani, dïlweel mar met ec, ki dwør met ec, ki kanynyø mar nywöm, ki dwør leek, ki maac mo liel raanynya raanynyø.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋöömmi en bäre ni ränynye, ni tïme na ŋöömö mo cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëre; ni ö wïth juurre moøgø ni tïnyge nyeny Babiløn ki cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø.
english: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo thum cwiiri moøgø na pïërabïriiø yøø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nyeny Babiløn, ki jiye bëët, ki ŋöömme ma Kaldia bäre jääla jäälö kiper bääyö marge, ni tïïa paac nee bëëde no oränynyö na bäre bäre.
english: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the Lord, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

anywaa: Ni ö luup moa cara bëët kiper ŋöömmögø ni käla ge bääte, ni beege luup moa no ogöör piny yi wëëlli  en na car Jeremaya dëët wïth juurre bëët.
english: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.

anywaa: Ni ö wïth juurre mo thööth ki nyeye mo døøŋŋø ni tïïcge jø Babiløn na laaŋe; ni coola pïïn gïïa reyø dëëtge na tïïcge, ni beege gïïa reyø na tïïcge ki ceŋge.»
english: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, eni na Jwø Icriel, ena köö, ni «Lwør athöönh ajäla man ni yie da køøŋø ni en cera en, ni nyootha wëër mara, ni cïpï gø jï wïth juurre moo jääŋŋa ïïni baŋge bëët nee maathge.
english: For thus saith the Lord God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo maathge gø, ge bøømmø ni tïmge na bøøre ki køør mäny mano jääŋŋa baŋge.»
english: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø athöönh ajäla aputa lwør cer Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïba gø jï wïth juurre bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jääŋ aani baŋge nee maa dëëtge ki man maathge gø,
english: Then took I the cup at the Lord's hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the Lord had sent me:

anywaa: ni beege jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda, ki nyeye moge ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moge, nee putge ränynyö, ni tïmge ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, na gïr abuua, na gïr acïëni, kaawat man bëëde yïth nïne moi ii.
english: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk moo maath gø beege Peerø nyeny Ijep, ki jø kööre moe, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moe, ki jiye bëët,
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

anywaa: ki wïth juurre ma teeŋi moa en kaace; ki nyeye bëët mo wø bëëdö yi ŋööm Uc; ki nyeye bëët mo wø bëëdö yïth mïëc jø Pilitin, ni mïëyögø beege Ackelön, ki Geedha, ka Akarön, ka Acdöt ki jøøa no odööŋ yie na kwøw;
english: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,

anywaa: ki jø Ëdöm, ki jø Möap, ki jø Amön;
english: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,

anywaa: ki nyeye bëët mo Tayar, ki nyeye bëët mo Caydan; ki nyeye mo wø bëëdö løøga bäät naama dwøŋ;
english: And all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,

anywaa: ki jø Didan, ki jø Tëma, ki jø Buc, ki jø wø køc jïëc wïthge;
english: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,

anywaa: ki nyeye bëët mo jø Arabe; ki nyeye bëët mo wïth juurre ma teeŋi mo wø bëëdö dï tëën;
english: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,

anywaa: ki nyeye bëët mo jø Dhimri; ki nyeye bëët mo jø Ilam; ki nyeye bëët mo jø Mëdön;
english: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

anywaa: ki nyeye bëët mo wø bëëdö jï løø wï-piny, moa kwörge cärö ki moa kwörge bäyö, ni man nø mätha køør maya; ki tiet mïëri moa en bäät piny bëët na nut bäät piny bäre. Køøre kanyo nø mäth jøøgø bëët, nyeny Cëcak  omäthi nø na aŋuudi.
english: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Caanï jïge, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Mäthu ni meerru, ni ŋwøgu, ni päänhnhu, ni ba duu maal këët, ki køør mäny mano jääŋŋa baŋu.›
english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ge kweer ki man lwørge athöönh ajäla mara cerï nee maathge, wär caanï jïge, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: «Uuni, mäthu kiree!
english: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.

anywaa: Kiper ennø, aana nø tägö ki man jääŋŋa gïn mo leth bäät pääny mana näk cwøla ri nyeŋŋa. ?A uuni, uuno bøthu nidïï nø nou ba jääla? Uuni, u ba bøth ka ajäla. Kiper mäny 'käla bäät jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö bäät piny.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.›
english: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Jeremaya en, luupi bëët ii wär køpï ni caanï geni dëëtge, ni kööï jïge, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk omäri ni eni ena maal, ni nyootha wëër mare, ni dwøre ee tïŋ maal ni eni ena kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere; ni märe døc bäät jiye. Ni ö eni ni tïŋ dwøre maal bäät jø wø bëëdö bäät piny bëët, ni dwøre ena maal kaamar dööt jø wø cwöth nyïïomøki ki tietge.
english: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The Lord shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

anywaa: Dïŋaŋ okëët ya aŋuun piny bäre, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jïre da løøk ki wïth juurre bëët. eni mar jiy bëët ŋøle ŋølø, ni cïp jøøa reyø dho opëëllö. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.› »
english: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the Lord hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö,  ni «Ennø, gïï mo leth onyaay, ni tägi ka baŋ wï jur man nø, ni pïïe baŋ wï jur man nø. Mäny mo teek oööi kaamar atuunna, ni tägi ka ya aŋuun piny.»
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø jiy moo 'näk ri leny ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk, rïŋ dëëtge, bäät piny opääŋge bäre, ni tägi ka ya aŋuun piny këël aŋuunne maya. Bäŋ ŋat mo jwöŋi kiperge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cooŋ rïŋ dëëtge kanya ciel, ni bäŋ ŋat mo koony geni; 'ba rïŋ dëëtge otïmö kaamar wär mo oker piny.
english: And the slain of the Lord shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.

anywaa: U na dïkwääye, jwöŋu ni kïmmu; u na jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, buugu dëëtu ki bur; kiper cäŋ man ŋaal u yie aöö, ni ö uuni ni päänhnhu ni petu kaamar dak mo pere leth mo reep.
english: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

anywaa: Dïkwääye bäŋ kany mo reŋge yie nee bøthge, ni bäŋ kany mo päär jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø wøk ki yie.
english: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

anywaa: Wui, dïkwääye, gööu ko oduuru, ni ö dïbwöthe mo wø bwøth pïïth ni jwöŋge ni döötge ena maal, kiper Wuuö Jwøk räänyö ki kar bëëtö marge.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the Lord hath spoiled their pasture.

anywaa: Mïëri moa bëët jiyi yïthge ni yïthge met onikïïl ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk noo liel kaamar maac.
english: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk otïŋŋi ki kar bëëtö mare kaamar ŋuu mo ö wøk ki ya abuŋŋö, ni ö mïëri moge ni tïmge ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, ki køør jøw caan geni ko opëëllö, ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk noo liel kaamar maac.
english: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kanya täk Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ki man bëëde ni ena nyeny Juuda,
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Cuŋŋï dï kal mar øtø mara, ni caanï luummi en jï jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yïth päänye mo Juuda, mo wø ö baŋ lam yi øtø mara, ni beege luup moa caana jïrï bëët nee caanï jïge, ni bäŋ luubö aciel mo weyï.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the Lord's house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:

anywaa: Kanymør ni wïnyge wïnynyö, ni ö ŋati man nø ni wec uutjïëth tïïe moe na reyø; køøre cwïnya dwøga piny ki man ba tïïa gïna leth na caara ni daa tïïö dëëtge kiper raay moa tïïcge.
english: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.

anywaa: Ni man beeye mano caanï jïge, ni ‹Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ni näk mo dwøra ba wïnynyu, ni ba caathu køør ciik 'moa, moa cïba jïïu,
english: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

anywaa: ni ba wïnynyu luup mo jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø jääŋŋa baŋu cooth, kaawat man wø bëëdu ni luupge ba wïnynyu cooth,
english: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;

anywaa: aani, øtø man na mara en raanynya raanynyø kaamar øtø mara mana raanynya Cëëlö, ni tïïa pääny man en na gïr abuua ki jï wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny.› »
english: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme ki nyïïkuk Jwøk ki jiy bëët dwør Jeremaya awïnyge ni cara luupögø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jeremaya ki caan luupögø jï jiy bëët, ni beege luup bëët moa ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm eni ki gø nee caane, ena mak dïlämme ki nyïïkuk Jwøk ki jiy bëët, ni köge, ni «Ï thøw kiree!
english: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the Lord had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni køpï luupi ii ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööï, ni ‹Øt Wuuö Jwøk man ränynyö kaamar Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana ränynyö Cëëlö, ni ö päänynyi man en ni ränynye ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie këët›?» 'Ba kanyøgø jiy bëët rege acooŋge lak Jeremaya yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Juuda moa kwörge døøŋŋø na wïnyge gïïa tägö yøø, gena öö ki paan dwøŋ ni cige Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni pïge piny kar acooŋa dhi kal mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk mana cwøl ni Dhi Kal Mana Nyään.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the Lord, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the Lord's house.

anywaa: Ni ö dïlämme ki nyïïkuk Jwøk ni köge jï jøøa kwörge  døøŋŋø ki jiy bëët, ni «Nyeni en, mare ŋøl yi thøø, kiper gïï mo reyø akøbe dëër pääny man, kaawat mana wïnynyu gø ki ïthu.»
english: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya acäänö ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët ki jiy bëët, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aana jääŋŋe nee luup moa wïnynyu bëët yøø køba dëër Øt Wuuö Jwøk man en ki päänyi en.
english: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, tiirru jöör bëëtö maru ki tïïe mou, ni wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru; køøre Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye odwøk piny, ni ba tïïc gïna leth na caane ni dee tïïö dëëtu.
english: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the Lord your God; and the Lord will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a ena ceŋŋu; gïna caarru ni beer na näk beeye adïëri ki jïïu, tïïyu dëëra.
english: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ni näk maa you nääö, wär ŋäyu nou käla kwör dhaanhø mo bäŋ gïn mo ee baaø bäätu, u ki dëëtu, ki bäät päänyi en, ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yie. Kiper ka adïëri møn, aana jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki baŋu nee luupi bëët ii caana jïïu nee wïnynyu.»
english: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the Lord hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki jiy bëët aköö jï dïlämme ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni «Ŋati en mare ba doo ŋøla yi thøø, kiper ena cäänö jïïø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø.»
english: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møøk røk jø døøŋŋø mo paac aö maal ni cäänge jiy moa en ya acooŋa bëët, ni köge,
english: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,

anywaa: ni «Mikiya nyï Mörëcëth dwør Jwøk akøbe yïth nïra beet Edhekaya ni ena nyeny Juuda; ena cäänö ki jø Juuda bëët ni kööe, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët beeye en: « ‹Dhayan na näk Jerucalem oränynyi, ni puuri na pwöth jaak, ni ö thuurri mana näk Øt Jwøk ogeer bääte ni tuue ka abuŋŋe.›
english: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, Edhekaya nyeny Juuda ki jø Juuda bëët Mikiya anäkge na bëëde? ?Aŋø, Edhekaya kär lwäyö ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëde ni kwaaya Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni dwøk cwïnye piny ki man ba tïïc gïna leth na caane ni dee tïïö dëëtge? 'Ba ennø, ø käla gïn mo raac døc bäätø.»
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the Lord, and besought the Lord, and the Lord repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.

anywaa: Da dhaanhø mør thuwø mo luup ee købø ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni ŋatøce beeye Uria o Cemaya nyï Kiriat-Jeerim. Eni luup gïïo tägi dëër päänyi ki dëër ŋöömmi en akøbe, ni beege luup mo caala moa køp Jeremaya yøø.
english: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the Lord, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath–jearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Jeyöakëmmi ki jø leny moe bëët moa teek, ki jiy moe bëët moa kwörge døøŋŋø na wïnyge luup moa køp Uria, nyeya acädö ki man 'näk Uria. 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya Uria, ena lwäyö ni päär wøk ni reŋ Ijep.
english: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Jeyöakëm ajääk Ijep ki jiy, ni beege Elnathan wär Akbör ki jiy møøk.
english: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.

anywaa: Ni øømge Uria Ijep, ni kälge eni baŋ nyeya ma Jeyöakëm, ni ö Jeyöakëmmi ni 'näk gø ko opëëllö, ni leeŋ dëër gø kany wø koony jiy møga jaak yie.
english: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö kiper Jeremaya, Akikam o Capan odwätö ki Jeremaya; køøre Jeremaya kär cïp ceŋ jiy nee 'näk.
english: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, a na Jeremaya, kanya täk Cëdëkiya ö Jöcaya ki man bëëde ni ena nyeny Juuda.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Tïïï ki jaath mo caala jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath ki kaae, ni kïthï gø ŋutï.
english: Thus saith the Lord to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,

anywaa: Ni jääŋŋï dwøl baŋ nyeny Ëdöm, ki nyeny Möap, ki nyeny Amön, ki nyeny Tayar, ki nyeny Caydan, ni jääŋŋï ka jøøa jääŋŋi na ö Jerucalem baŋ Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda.
english: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;

anywaa: Ni köömmï geni nee cige baŋ nyeye moge, ni köge, ni ‹Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, nee caannu jï nyeye mou beeye en:
english: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;

anywaa: Aani, piny ki jiy ki lääy moa en bäät piny acwääa ki køør teek bada na dwøŋ, ni løny jïra ki man cïba gø jï ŋata met yia ki gø jaak.
english: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, mïëri mou bëët anø cïba cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, eni na en cera, ni mëëga  lääc paap eni thuwø ni bëëtge ni ge ena cere.
english: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.

anywaa: Ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni bëëtge ni gena laaŋe moe, eni ki wääde, ki nyikwaare, këël mano päŋ cwiiri moa kwaan kiper akwöma mare. Køøre wïth juurre mo thööth ki nyeye mo døøŋŋø eno tïïcge na laŋŋø marge.
english: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo da wï jur wala akwöm nyeya mo kweer ki man bëëde ni ena laŋŋø mar Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ni ba jïëy ki man bëëde tier teek mare na caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath, a na Wuuö Jwøk, wï jur manøce jääla jäälö, ni thøwge ko opëëllö ki käc ki täw mo leth, këël mano thööra geni ki cere.
english: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the Lord, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, luup nyïïkuk Jwøk mou mo wø køp luup ki wïthge kär wïnynyu, ki luup jø adïëda mou, ki jiy mou mo wø car lääk, ka ajuuk mou, ki jiy mou mo wø thöödhö ki war, jø wø cäänö ki uuni, ni «Käru bëëdö ni uuna laaŋe mo nyeny Babiløn.»
english: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
