anywaa: Kiper ge køpa luup tööt jïïu; ki køør luupögø u di daa ni cou kany mo kare bäär ki ŋöömö maru, ni beeye aani noo riem u wøk, ni thøwu kaace.
english: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.

anywaa: 'Ba wï jur mano jïëy ki man bëëde tier teek mar nyeny Babiløn na caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath, ni bëëde ni ena laŋŋø mare, geni, ge wëëga bëëtö yi ŋöömö marge, ni puurge gø ni bëëtge yie.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the Lord; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ luupögø bëët acaana jï Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda, ni kööa, ni «Jïëyu ki man bëëdu tier teek mar nyeny Babiløn na caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath, ni bëëdu ni uuna laaŋe moe ki jiye; køøre u bëëdö nou kwøw.
english: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ïïni ki jiyï, aperŋø ni manynyu thøø jaak en, nou thøwu ko opëëllö ki käc ki täw mo leth, kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper wï jur mano kweer ki man bëëde na laŋŋø mar nyeny Babiløn?
english: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the Lord hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

anywaa: Kär luup nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø køp luup ki wïthge wïnynyu, jø wø cäänö ki uuni, ni ‹Käru bëëdö na laaŋe mo nyeny Babiløn,› kiper ge køpa luup tööt jïïu.
english: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, ge kära jääŋŋö, 'ba luup tööt køpge ka nyeŋŋa; 'ba ki køør luupögø, u riema wøk, ni thøwu ki nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët mo wø køp luup jïïu.»
english: For I have not sent them, saith the Lord, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.

anywaa: Køøre aana cäänö thuwø ki dïlämme ki jøøi ii bëët, ni kööa, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Kär luup nyïïkuk Jwøk mou mo wø køp luup ki wïthge wïnynyu, jø wø cäänö ki uuni, ni «Neennu, jap Øt Wuuö Jwøk laar ka duuö kany mo cään ki Babiløn.» Geni, ge køpa luup tööt jïïu.
english: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.

anywaa: Kär luupge wïnynyu, 'ba bëëdu nou tïnynya nyeny Babiløn, køøre u bëëdu nou kwøw. ?Aperŋø no ö päänyi man no wëëgi ränynyö en?›
english: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo gena nyïïkuk Jwøk møn, ni luum Wuuö Jwøk nut dhøkge, beerra man öge ennø ni kwacge Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, nee jammi moa näk odööŋ yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa näk odööŋ yi øt nyeny Juuda ki yi Jerucalem bäre, nee ba kïth Babiløn këët.
english: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the Lord be with them, let them now make intercession to the Lord of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, acäänö kiper gïïa näk caala dïkweeye mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, ki jïëthe mo wø käär pïï ki ge, ki jammi møga moa näk odööŋ yi pääny man,
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,

anywaa: na näk kär käl Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn, kanya käl Jekönaya wär Jeyöakëm nyeny Juuda ni maae ki tøŋ Jerucalem ni kïth gø Babiløn, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre.
english: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, kiper jammi moa näk odööŋ yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ki moa näk odööŋ yi øt nyeny Juuda, ki yi Jerucalem bäre, beeye en, ena köö,
english: Yea, thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;

anywaa: ni ‹Japøgø 'kïtha Babiløn, ni bëëtge kaace këël dïcäŋo cøøa baŋge, ni käla geni ni duua geni karge kany.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the Lord; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køøre cään, ni poot na yi cwiinøgø, ri ŋweer  cwiiri moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeny Juuda, kanya tïme na dwää abïïc, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ananiya wär Adhur, na käl Gibien, acäänö ki aani, a na Jeremaya, yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, nyïm dïlämme ki jiy bëët, ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the Lord, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Teek mar nyeny Babiløn na en bäätu ni caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath araanynya.
english: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: Ki yïth cwiiri ariiø kiree, aani, jammi mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk moa käl Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn, ni kïth geni Babiløn, 'duua kany.
english: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the Lord's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:

anywaa: Ni duua Jekönaya wär Jeyöakëm nyeny Juuda kany ki jø Juuda bëët moa mak ki tøŋ na kïth Babiløn, kiper teek mar nyeny Babiløn na en bäätu ni caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath raanynya raanynyø.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the Lord: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya luummögø ajøle jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ananiya nyïm dïlämme ki jiy bëët moa näk cuŋŋö yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the Lord,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Beerra man thur luummï kare. Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni tïïc gø, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni wëëk luup moi bëët thur karge, ni beege luup moa køpï ni jap Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki jiy bëët moa mak ki tøŋ na kïth Babiløn di duuö kany.
english: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the Lord do so: the Lord perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the Lord's house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïny luubö mano caana jïrï nø, ni wïnyö jïrï, ni wïnyö jï jøøi ii bëët.
english: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;

anywaa: Nyïïkuk Jwøk moa kwøŋ nut nyïmmø cøøn, da gïï maa køpge, ni beege gïï lenye ki gïr gïï mo leth ki gïr täwe mo reyø moo tägi dëët tiet mïëri mo thööth ki dëët akwöm moa døøŋŋø mo nyeye.
english: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk mo køpa gïr bëët-mëër, kanyo tïm luumma købe noo thur kare, put ka ŋäc ni nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø jääŋŋa Wuuö Jwøki møn.»
english: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ananiya jaath puur mana en ŋut nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya akäl wøk ni toor gø.
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.

anywaa: Ni ö Ananiya ni cääne ni jiy bëët nutö, ni kööe, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Kaawat mana räny jaath puurri manøgø, aani, teek mar Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn na en bäät wïth juurre bëët ni caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath raanynya raanynyø ki yïth cwiiri ariiø.› » Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya aput aay jaak ki jööre.
english: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Ananiya na nø raany jaath puur mana en ŋut nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Then the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Ananiya, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ïïni jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut mana raanynyï enø beeye jaath jaak, 'ba mano läw kar manøgø beeye gïr puur ma nywïënyö.
english: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Aani, gïr puur ma nywïënyö man wø twöö ŋut yaa nø twöö ŋut wïth juurre moøgø bëët nee bëëtge ni ge ena tier Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ni tïnyge eni. Këël lääc paap yaa nø cïp jïre.› »
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya aköö jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ananiya, ni «Ï na Ananiya en, wïny gïn! Wuuö Jwøk ï käre jääŋŋö, 'ba jiy moi atïïyï nee jïëcge ki luum tööt.
english: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The Lord hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ennø, ï tïïa tïïö niï tøør bäät piny. Yi cwiir man kiree ï puta thøø, kiper ïïni, jiy apwönynyï nee gëëmge ki Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiinøgø kiree, kanya tïme na dwää abïriiø, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Ananiya aput thøø.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya agöödö ki wëëlö Jerucalem, ni jääŋ gø baŋ jø døøŋŋø moa näk odööŋ ni kwøw ri moa mak ki tøŋ, ki baŋ dïlämme, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki jiy  bëët moa mak Nabukedenecörri ki tøŋ Jerucalem ni kïth geni Babiløn.
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;

anywaa: Wëëlö manøgø ajääŋŋe ni nyeya ma Jekönaya ki menni ma gwanynyø onø mak ki tøŋ Jerucalem ni nø kïth geni Babiløn, ni bee geni ki jø kööre ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, ki rëëmme.
english: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)

anywaa: Wëëlö manøgø acïp Jeremaya cer Elaca o Capan ki cer Gemariya o Kilkiya, jøøa jääŋ Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda Babiløn baŋ Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn. 'Ba luubö mana en yi wëëlö ogöörö na ennø:
english: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, jï jøøa riem Wuuö Jwøki wøk, na mak ki tøŋ Jerucalem na kïth Babiløn:
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;

anywaa: ni «Gëëdu ki uudi ni bëëdu yïthge, ni puru ki pwöth ni cammu gïï wø ciek yïthge.
english: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;

anywaa: Ni nyöömu ki mään, ni nyöötu ki wäätu ki nyïïu; ni nyöömmu wäätu ki mään, ni wëëgu nyïïu nywøm, nee ge nyöötge ki wäätge ki nyïïge; ni tïmu nou thööth, ni kwäännu ba døø piny.
english: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.

anywaa: Ni bëëdu nou manynya bëët-mëër yi pääny mana riema u yie nou mak ki tøŋ; ni lämu jï Wuuö Jwøk kiper bëët päänyögø, kiper bëëtmëër mano en yie oen jïïu thuwø.»
english: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the Lord for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Uuni, nyïïkuk Jwøk mou moø ni en dïïu yøø ka ajuuk mou käru cøøkge, ni kär nou wïnynya lääk moge moa met yïthu ki ge nee ge läkge ki ge,
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.

anywaa: kiper luup tööt køpge ka nyeŋŋa jïïu; geni, ge ba jääŋŋa aani.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kanyo thum cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø kiper Babiløn, aani, u lïïma lïïmö, ni ö luumma caana jïïu na beer ni wëëga gø thur kare, ni beeye ki man duua uuni kany paana kwøŋu bëëdö yie.
english: For thus saith the Lord, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

anywaa: Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, acaare moa näk yaa nø caar kiperu ŋääa, ni beege acaare mo duunnö ki bëët mëër jïïu, ni patha acaare mo duunnö ki ränynyö dëëtu, 'ba beeye acaare mo wëëga ŋäädhe maru thur kare yi nyïme.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the Lord, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋŋa ocøøru, ni ööu ni kwayu aani ki lam, ni ööa ni wïnynya maru.
english: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

anywaa: Aano manynyu ni jootu aani, kanyo näk maa manynyu manynyø ki cwïnynyu bäre.
english: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

anywaa: Aano jootu møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni duua uuni wøk ki yi bëët laŋ, ni lema uuni yïth mïëc wïth juurre bëët kwöra riema u yïthge bëët, ni duua uuni paana riema u wøk yie nou mak ki tøŋ.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will be found of you, saith the Lord: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the Lord; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

anywaa: Uuna köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk waana mooe ki nyïïkuk Jwøk Babiløn kany.»
english: Because ye have said, The Lord hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïnynyu luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper nyeya mana läw bäät wäl Deebit, ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö pääny Jerucalem kany, ni beege tuuŋu moa näk kär kälö ki uuni kanya mak uuni ki tøŋ.
english: Know that thus saith the Lord of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ennø, leny ki käc ki täw mo leth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätge, ni wëëga geni ränynyö kaamar nyïïolämmi mo odheeth mo ba løny ki cam kiper mana näk mo geno kwäk.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

anywaa: Ni løpa køørge ki tøŋ ki käc ki täw mo leth, ni tïïa geni nee akwöm mo nyeye bëët mo bäät piny yïthge thäŋge ki gïïo tägi dëëtge, ni tïïa geni na gïr acïëni, ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, na gïr abuua, ni ge di jøøŋŋø yïth mïëc wïth juurre bëët kwöro riema geni yïthge.
english: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:

anywaa: Kiper geni, luup 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kärge wïnynyö, ni beege luup moa cara jïge cooth ki dhøk jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk. Ni uuni thuwø, u na mak ki tøŋ, dwøra käru wïnynyö.
english: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the Lord, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, u bëët, u na riema wøk Jerucalem nou mak ka tøŋ, ni kïth u Babiløn, wïnynyu dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Hear ye therefore the word of the Lord, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët,  kiper Akap o Kölaya ki Cëdëkiya o Maycëya, jøøa køp luup tööt jïïu ki nyeŋŋa, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, ge 'cïba cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni ni 'näk geni ni nëënö jïïu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;

anywaa: Ki køør mano tägi dëët jøøgø, jø Juuda bëët moa näk omaaø ki tøŋ na kïth Babiløn, geno bëëdö ni ge cïënö ni ge köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk ïïno raanynye kaamar Cëdëkiya ka Akap na waaŋ nyeny Babilønni ki maac,›
english: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The Lord make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

anywaa: kiper mana tïïge ki gïï mo määnö dï Icriel; gena kännö ki luui ki määr nyïïawäätge, ni cäänge ki luup tööt ki nyeŋŋa, mo ge kära köömmö ki geni; 'ba aani, gïïögø ŋääa, kiper ge nëënö jïra.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, dwøl acaane jïra nee jääŋŋa baŋ Cemaya nyï Nëyëlam, kiper mana jääge ki weeli ki nyeŋŋe baŋ jøøa en Jerucalem bëët ki baŋ dïlämi ma Jepaniya o Maycëya, ki baŋ dïlämme bëët, ni kööe,

ni «Ï na Jepaniya en, Wuuö Jwøk ïïna røønye na dïlämi kar dïlämi ma Jööda, kiper niï tïmï ni ïïna ŋat wø raŋ Øt Wuuö Jwøk, nee dhaanhø ma bøøl mo døøya ree nyikuŋ Jwøk nee tiete rwaagï yïth orøge, ni twöyï cwaage ko oguudi.
english: The Lord hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the Lord, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.

anywaa: ?'Ba ennø, aperŋø nø na ba joogï Jeremaya nyï Anathöth ni køp luup jïïu enø?
english: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?

anywaa: Kiper ena jääk baŋwa ki dwøl Babiløn, ni kööe, ni ‹Bëët laŋ maru känna wøk ki kany mo bäär; beerra man gëëdu ki uudi ni bëëdu yïthge, ni piithu pwöth, ni cammu gïï wø ciek yïthge.› »
english: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi ma Jepaniya wëëlö manøgø akwaane jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya.
english: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

anywaa: Ni ö dwør Wuuö Jwøki ni put ö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Jääk Babiløn baŋ jøøa näk omaaø ki tøŋ bëët, ni kööï, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Cemaya nyï Nëyëlam beeye en: Cemaya luup akøbe jïïu këël na bëëde ni eni kära jääŋŋö, ni tïïc uuni nou ŋäätha luup tööt.
english: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the Lord concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana ŋøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ni Cemaya nyï Nëyëlam ki nyïïkwaaye bëët ge jääla jäälö; eni bäŋ nyikwaare mo bëëdö ni kwøw dï jiy moi, ni eni gïïö beyø noo tïïa kiper jiya ba neene ki waŋe, kiper jiy apwönynye nee gëëmge ki Wuuö Jwøk.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the Lord; because he hath taught rebellion against the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, mana caane jï Jeremaya, ena köö,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luup moa caana jïrï bëët göör piny yi wëëlö;
english: Thus speaketh the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.

anywaa: kiper ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo jiya ma jø Icriel ki jiya ma jø Juuda ge duua ka wøk ki yi bëët laŋ, ni duua geni yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï kwäcge, ni bëëde na marge. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the Lord: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege luup moa caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Icriel ki jø Juuda, ena köö,
english: And these are the words that the Lord spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Da dööt jiy mo wïnyö, mo dëëtge kwanynyi ki lwär mo dwøŋ, ni bäŋ bëët-mëër poge.
english: For thus saith the Lord; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

anywaa: Pëënynyu dëëtu mø, ni raŋŋu gø døøc, nee da dïcwøø mo olwaar ki nyilaal. ?A ennø, aperŋø ni jooda cwøw bëët ni ŋati man nø piere ee maa ki ceŋŋe kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri en? ?Na aperŋø ni nëën täärnyïm ŋati man nø no oniduk ki lwär en?
english: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

anywaa: Wui! Dïcäŋo täk gïïögø yie otïmö na cäŋ mo raac døc, mo bäŋ cäŋ mo pääri ki gø; ni beeye cäŋo pïïc gïï mo lethi yie dëët nyïïkwaac Jeekap,  'ba geno piem yïth gïïögø.
english: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni ‹Kanyo tïme na dïcäŋöce, teek dïïm mana en bäätge na caal jaath puur man wø twöö ŋut rwaath raanynya raanynyø, ni päda geni, ni bëëtge ni ge patha laaŋe këët jï jiy mo path.
english: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:

anywaa: 'Ba geno bëëdö ni ge tïnynya aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ki nyeya marge ma Deebit, ŋato thïïŋa jïge.
english: But they shall serve the Lord their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.

anywaa: « ‹Wui, jø Icriel, u na nyïïkwaac dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, « ‹käru lwäyö, ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu; kiper ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, uuni ki jøw käl dëëtu, u piema piemø paanøgø ni kare bäär ki pou enø, na kïth uuni yie ki tøŋ. Ni ööu, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni duu pou ni bëëdu mëëth ni uuno nikwak, ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëk uuni lwär.
english: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the Lord; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.

anywaa: Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, a ena buutu naa peemma uuni. Aani, tiet mïëc wïth juurre bëët moa keetha uuni yïthge, raanynya raanynyø na bäre. 'Ba uuni, u ba raanynya bäre. U pwönynya pwönynyö ka ajäla mana näk kare, nou ba wiia ka ajäla.›
english: For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.

anywaa: «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Bëëtö maru na raac atïmö kaamar ŋwellø mo ba caŋŋi, ni bëëdö kaamar atwøda mo raac døc.
english: For thus saith the Lord, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat mo køny uuni ki rääö maru, ni bäŋ gïn mo dwøk bëëtö maru kare, ni bäŋ køny mo joot kiperu.
english: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

anywaa: Wïth juurre moa mëërru ki geni na dwätu ki geni bëët wïthge awïl ki uuni; ni ge ba many uuni këët; kiper dëëtu amooa ki gïï mo leth mo caala man wø tïïc nyïïmänni, ni jääla uuni kaawat man wø tïïc ŋat mo cwïnye ba pädhi ki tïïc gïn mo leth. Gïnögø atïïa dëëtu kiper bääyö maru dwøŋ døc, ni raay mou thööth døc.
english: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø ni kwöŋŋu kiper gïïø ni leth yøø ni caal atwøda mo raac enø, mo rääm mare ba døø piny? Gïnögø atïïa dëëtu kiper bääyö maru dwøŋ døc, ni raay mou thööth døc.
english: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jøw raany uuni bëët di raanynyø, ni ö nyïïmännu bëët ni maai ki tøŋ; ni ö jøw käl japu ki teek ni käl japge thuwø, ni ö jøw twier uuni bëët ni wëëga geni twier.
english: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø ni bëëtö maru na raac dwøga kare ni beer, ni beeye bëëtö maru ni caal atwøda, kiper uuna cwøl jiyi ni u ege jarø jaak, ni köge, ni «Jø Dhayan, bäŋ ŋat many geni.» ›
english: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the Lord; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.

anywaa: «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, mïëc jiya ma nyïïkwaac Jeekap 'dwøga kwörge, ni nyoodha mëër mara jïge kwör bëëte moge. Jerucalem cäŋ ka geer wïïe mana no oränynyö, ni ö paan dwøŋŋi ni cäŋi dwøk kare mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö dudi mo dwøk met ec ki dwør meeŋ ni wïny ge yïthge. Ni meeda geni ni thööth, ni kwäänge ba døø piny; ni wëëga geni wøør, ni ba bëëtge na jiy mo bäŋ karge.
english: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Jeekap obëëdö ki bëëtö mo caala mana dïkwøŋ, ni tïmge na lwaak mo tietge yaa këël piny nyïma; ni jääla jø wø caan geni bëët.
english: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.

anywaa: Dïbwödhi marge otïmö na ŋat mo ena rege, ni beeye kwäärö mo käla dëëtge. eno nyïïa buuta, ni ö baŋa. ?Kiper aŋa ni løny jïre keere ki man ö baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk?
english: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the Lord.

anywaa: Uuni, u bëëdö ni uuna jiya, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru.› »
english: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk öa bäät jøøa reyø kaamar atuunna, ni beeye atuunna mo teek døc mo raanynya geni.
english: Behold, the whirlwind of the Lord goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ba døø ŋääe ki wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac, këël mano tïïc mana en cwïnye ni wëëk gø thur kare. 'Ba kanyo täk gïïögø yie ya aŋuun nïne, tiere ojootu na kare.
english: The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Yi kar kaace aano bëëdö ni aana Jwøk mar wïth tuŋi bëët mo jø Icriel, ni bëëtge ni gena jiya.»
english: At the same time, saith the Lord, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Jø Icriel moa bøth ni kwøw dhi tøŋ, gena jïtö ki køny baŋa dï paap, kanya cääthge ni ge manynya kar jwöm.»
english: Thus saith the Lord, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ree anyoodhe jïge cøøn kany mo bäär, ni kööe, ni «Aana bëëdö naa mëër ki uuni ki mëër mo bäŋ cuŋŋe; kiper manøgønø, uuna nyïïa buuta ki køør mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl.
english: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

anywaa: Wui, jø Icriel, u na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, aani, bëëtö maru cäŋa dwøk kare, ni døø kare møn. Ni cäŋu nyïïanëët mou kwanynyø, ni cou baŋ meeŋ ki jø wø miel ni yïthge met.
english: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.

anywaa: Uuno cäŋ pïïdhö ko omøki bäät thuuri mo Cameria; ni jøw pïïdhö, nyïï gïïa piithge ocamge.
english: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

anywaa: Kiper da nïne mo öö, mo jø wø kurö bäät kït Ipariem, ge cwötö ni köge, ni ‹Ööø maal, ni cøø maal Dhayan baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø.› »
english: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the Lord our God.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Wärru ni yïthu met ni döötu ena maal kiper nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni kwöŋŋu ki met ec kiperge, ge na karge dwøŋ dï wïth juurre, ni køpu pwøc maru ni kwayu Jwøk, nou köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, piem jiyï ma jø Icriel moa näk odööŋ ni kwøw.›
english: For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ge 'duua kany ki yi paana en jï løø wï-piny, ni lema geni yïth kwöra bäyö bäät piny bäre, ki jiy moa näk cööye ki moa näk ŋööte moa en dïge, ki mään moa näk yïthge da jiy, ki mään moa näk dëëtge da mäc lwaar bëët;  ni duuge kany ni gena lwaak mo päl.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.

anywaa: Geno duui ni ge jwöŋö, ni bwødha geni ni ge lämö; ni wëëga geni wääth ni ge lwøra lak näm, ki øtjöö mo thïïŋ mo bäŋ gïn mo cwanyge tietge ree; kiper beeye aani na wää jø Icrielli, geni na jø Ipariem na caal kanynya.
english: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

anywaa: «U na wïth juurre, wïnynyu luum Wuuö Jwøk, ni caannu gø jï mïëri moa kwörge bäyö, ni kööu, ni ‹Eni na keeth jø Icriel, ge cäŋe ka cooŋŋø, ni gwøk geni kaawat man wø ö dïkwääyi wø gwøk pïïth dïëk moe.›
english: Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk nyïïkwaac Jeekap wïïle wøk, ni piem geni cer ŋata näk teek mare opöödhö ni kaala geni.
english: For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.

anywaa: Ni öge ni kwöŋge ki met ec bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni mïn yïthge ki gïïo beyø noo cïp Wuuö Jwøki jïge, ni beege beel, ki køøŋ nyïïomøki, ki maaw, ki nyïïdïëk ki nyïïrøøe. Ni ö bëëtö marge ni lødhe ni caala ajïniina mo di jøøyø ki pïï, ni bëëtge ni bäŋ öölö bäätge këët na bäre bäre.
english: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the Lord, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

anywaa: Kar kaace, nyïïakuue yïthge omïnni ni mielge, ni mïn yïth wøpe ki jø døøŋŋø bëët, kiper kïmmö marge odøøya met ec, ni cøma cwïnyge, ni wëëga yïthge mïnnö na kar pänh cwïny.
english: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

anywaa: Aani, dïlämme caama caamø døc ki cam mo päl, ni ö jiya ni jäŋge ki gïïo beyø noo cïba jïge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Da dwøl mo wïnyö yi Reema, ni jiy göö ko oduuru ni yïthge ege keeyø, ni beeye Reecal ni jwöŋi kiper obwöre moe, ni kweere ki man cïp cwïnye piny kiper obwöre moe, kiper na bäŋe nyilaal mo odööŋ.»
english: Thus saith the Lord; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Weyu gøøc ko oduuru, ni pooyu pï nyeŋŋu, kiper öölö maru ba cam paapi; jø pou duuö ki yi ŋöömö mar nyïïmän.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the Lord; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋäädhe maru ni thur kare yi nyïme, kiper jø pou oduu yi ŋöömö mana näk thööŋge.
english: And there is hope in thine end, saith the Lord, that thy children shall come again to their own border.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, dööt jø Ipariem wïnyö jïra ni ge jwöŋö, ni ge köö, ni ‹Waana pwötï kaamar nyirøøa mo wïïe känni, ni wïnywa pwöc manøgø; duu waani baŋï, nee bëëtö marwa døø kare, kiper ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bee ï na Jwøk marwa.
english: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the Lord my God.

anywaa: Kiper ki køør mana gaawa wøk, rewa acäŋwa løgø; ki køør mana pwöny waani, kööthwa agøøcwa; nyeŋwa atïmö ni law ni lää wïthwa, kiper ajøøŋ mar gïïa tïïcwa dïkwøŋ ena bäätwa.› »
english: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «?Aŋø, Ipariem paa wääda mana pere leth jïra? ?Aŋø, eni paa nyilaal mana met yia ki gø? Ka adïëri møn, këël na bëëda naa cäänö dëëre ki gïï mo leth, eni poot lääŋŋa lääŋŋö. Kiper manøgønø, cwïnya ena baŋe; ka adïëri møn, mëër mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïre.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wui Icriel, ï na caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, Määny øtjöö marï ki nyuuthe; cööth piny ki jenni mo nyootha jöö; ni cïbï acaayï øtjööra kwøŋï cør yie. ööï ni duuï yïth päänye moï.
english: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

anywaa: ?Wui, nyaara ma Icriel, ï ni cwïnyï ogaa wøk en, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdï niï wïdö jaak? Kiper Wuuö Jwøk tïïö ki gïn mo nyään bäät piny, ni beeye ni dhaagø dïcwøø gwøe gwøø.»
english: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the Lord hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Kanyo dwøga bëëtö mar jiya kare, luummi en ocäŋge caannø yi ŋööm Juuda ki yïth päänye moe, ni köge, «ni ‹Ï na paac man wø joot adïëri yie, paana en bäät kïnna en kur keere, ïïno gwïëth Wuuö Jwøki.›
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The Lord bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.

anywaa: Jiy geno bëëdö na aciel Juuda ki yïth päänye moe bëët, këël ki jø puur ki jø wø kwaac dïëk.
english: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.

anywaa: Ni tïïa dëët jøøa näk oööl nee nigethïk, ni caama jøøa näk obup ni jäŋge.»
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.

anywaa: Kar kaagø aana päy, ni peera nyeŋŋa, ni bëëda ni yia met ki køør luubö mana jooda naa ena yïth niine.
english: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo dï ŋööm Icriel ki dï ŋööm Juuda jøra jørø ki kunhnhö mar dhaanhø ki kunhnhö mar lääy.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.

anywaa: Kaa mana bëëda naa neeta geni ki man cööda geni wøk, ni nyaaa geni piny, ni raanynya geni, ni tïïa gïï mo leth dëëtge, aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ge cäŋa ka neetø, ni tïïa geni ni teek, ni këëlla tietge piny.
english: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröke jiy ba cäŋ köö këët, «ni ‹Wëëe acämö ki nyïïomøki mo wac, ni ö liiri mar lak ni pïïe baŋ obwöre.›
english: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø otïmö ni thøw kaper raaye keere; ŋato cam nyïïjerø wac yøø, eni ki dëëre lage tïmö ni liir.»
english: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, maa tudö ki luubö mo nyään ki jø Icriel ki jø Juuda,
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

anywaa: mo ba caal luubö mana kwøŋa tuut ki kwäcge kanya maa ceŋge ni käla geni wøk ki Ijep, ni beeye luumma tuuda ki geni na dhalge, këël na bëëda jïge naa bëëdö kaamar dïcwøø ki cïïe.
english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mano tuuda ki jø Icriel yïth nïröke beeye en: Aani, ciik 'moa okïtha wïthge, ni gööra geni yïth cwïnyge. Ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge, ni bëëtge ni gena jiya.
english: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the Lord, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.

anywaa: Ni këël doo bëëdö ni bäŋ ŋat pwöny watge ki coki, ni ‹Bëëdï niï ŋäya Wuuö Jwøk,›  geno bëëdö naa ŋäcge bëët, ni tägi ka jiy moa kwörge therø këël jiy moa kwörge døøŋŋø; kiper gïïa bacge wiia wiiø, ni ba para wïïa ki raay moge këët.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the Lord: for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na tïïc cäŋ nee rienye ki waŋcäŋ, na cïp dwääy ki ceer kwörge nee rienyge ki wäär, eni ni wø dhäy naama dwøŋ, ni bëët odhänynyi mare ni lwör, eni na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët,
english: Thus saith the Lord, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The Lord of hosts is his name:

anywaa: ena köö, ni «Ni näk mo cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer tïïc mana cïba jïge ba tïïcge këët, kar kaace nyïïkwaac jø Icriel ge puta tïmö ni ge patha wï jur këët mana en cera.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the Lord, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «Ni näk mo løny ki man røm cuŋ maal kuya, ni løny ki man joot tiet ŋøøm kuya ki gïïa en yie bëët, kar kaace, nyïïkwaac jø Icriel kwiera kwierø kiper gïïa reyø bëët na tïïcge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Thus saith the Lord; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo pääny Jerucalem cäŋ ka geerrø jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni tägi ka ri Øt Koor Mar Ananel këël mano këët dhi kiir mana cwøl ni Gøøt.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.

anywaa: Ni ö keewi ni aae ni thïïŋ ni coonya ri thuur Garëp, ni cäŋ bännö ni pööth Göath.
english: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

anywaa: Ni ö ya agäm-kïdi bäre kany wø leeŋ jiy yie moa no othøw, kany wø wet bur yie, ki pwöth bëët moa en deŋ waŋ Naam Kidaran løø paac jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mano pïïe kanya gun kiirri ki yie buut dhi kiir mana cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Okwëënyi, ni tïmge ni ge ena kur keerge jï Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba päänyögø obëëdö ni ba daak ni ba nyaa piny këët na bäre bäre.»
english: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the Lord; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya ri paac cwiiri moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeny Juuda, kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abära moa beet Nabukedenecörri ni ena nyeny Babiløn.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace beeye kanya bëët jø lenynyi mo nyeny Babiløn ni Jerucalem ege ciel dïër, ni nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya odëët yi kal mar jø koor mana en paan dwøŋ mar nyeny Juuda.
english: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.

anywaa: Kiper beeye Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda na dëët Jeremaya yi kal, ni kööe jïre, na «?Aperŋø na køpï luupi ii? Ïïna köö ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, pääny man en 'cïba cer nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni ni mac gø.
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

anywaa: Ni Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda ba bøth ceŋ jø Babiløn, 'ba ka adïëri møn, eno cïp cer nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni na Cëdëkiya ni cääne ki nyeny Babiløn ni ge løøŋŋa dhøkge, ni joot gø møn ni ge neeta nyeŋge.
english: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;

anywaa: Nyeny Babiløn Cëdëkiya okïth Babiløn, ni ö Cëdëkiya ni bëëde kaace këël kanyo cøøa baŋe.› Ni cäŋï köö ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹U ni jø paani en, këël u doo këëdö ki jø Babiløn, leny maru ba thur kare.› »
english: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the Lord: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bääta, a na Jeremaya, beeye en, ena köö,
english: And Jeremiah said, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ennø, Anamel o Calum cöök wäru ööa baŋï ni kööe jïrï, ni ‹Ŋeew pwödhö mara mana en ya Anathöth, kiper øøna tuuŋ ni løny jïrï ki man tïme ni ŋeewa ïïni.› »
english: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.

anywaa: Køøre Anamel o cöök wära aö baŋa yi kal mar jø koor, kaawat mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ni kööe jïra, ni «Ïïni, beerra man ŋeewï pwödhö mara  mana en ya Anathöth na en yi ŋööm Benjamen, kiper øøna tuuŋ ni løny jïrï ki man tïme ni ŋeewa ïïni nee dööŋe jïrï. Ŋeewï nee tïme na marï.» Køøre, aani, aputa ŋäc ni dwørøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk møn.
english: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the Lord, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø pwödhö manøgø na en ya Anathöth enø aputa ŋeew baŋ Anamel o cöök wära, ni røma gwet-bïrö apaar ka abïriiø jïre.
english: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋŋa agööra yi wëëlö tier luubö mana jïëcwa bääte, ni mwöna gø ni jøøa cwøla nutö, ni cïba gwel bäät rumi ni røma geni.
english: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.

anywaa: Køøre wëël ŋïëw mana näk omwönö ki mana näk kär mwönö, moa näk luubö mana jïëcwa bääte ogöörö yïthge, alwøra,
english: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:

anywaa: ni cïba weetøgø jï Baruk o Neriya nyikwaar Maciya nyïm Anamel o cöök wära, ki nyïm jiy moa nut na göör nyeŋge yïth weet ŋïëw moøgø, ki nyïm jø Juuth bëët moa näk opï piny yi kal mar jø koor.
english: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.

anywaa: Ni köömma Baruk nyïm jøøa nut bëët, ni kööa,
english: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Lwør weet ŋïëw moi, mana näk omwönö ki mana näk kär mwönö, ni kanï geni yi dak, kiper nee ruuge ki kany mo bäär.›
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Uudi ki pwöth beel ki pwöth omøki ocäŋ ŋeewø yi ŋöömmi en.› »
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø cïba wëël ŋïëw jï Baruk o Neriya, aana lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööa,
english: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the Lord, saying,

anywaa: «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, beeye ï na cwääc maal ki piny ki køør teek badï na dwøŋ! Bäŋ gïn dhäthi jïrï!
english: Ah Lord God! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:

anywaa: Beeye ïïni ni wø nyooth mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl jï jiy ma kum kum, 'ba ïïni, gïïa reyø ni wø bac wëëe wø coolï coolø dëët obwöre moge mo wø ööi køørge. Bee ï na Jwøa dwøŋ na teek, ni nyeŋŋï beeye Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth jammi bëët.
english: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the Lord of hosts, is his name,

anywaa: Acaara marï dwøŋ, ni tïïe moï wø tïïyï ka teek mo dwøŋ, ni waŋï iï peerø bäät uutjïëth tïïe mo jiy bëët, ni ŋati man nø wø cunnï cunnö ki køør bëëtö mare ki tïïe moe.
english: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

anywaa: Ïïna tïïö ki nyuuthe ki gïï mo rëëma ec yi ŋööm Ijep, ni ï wø poot tïïö ki nyuuthe yi ŋööm Icriel ki dï jiy ma teeŋi këël dïcäŋi en, ni tïïyï nyeŋŋï nee wïnye kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;

anywaa: Ïïni, jiyï ma jø Icriel akälï wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ki køør ŋïïce ki gïïa näk rëëma ec, na tïïyï ki køør teek badï na dwøŋ, ki gïïa døøŋŋø na tïïyï na kännö ki lwär.
english: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;

anywaa: Ni cïpï ŋöömmi en jïge, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋï kipere jï kwäcge ni cïpï cïbö jïge, ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie.
english: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

anywaa: Ni öge yie ni macge gø, 'ba dwørï kärge wïnynyö, ni kärge cäädhö køør ciik moï. Ni bäŋ gïn mo ege tïïö kiper gïïa köömmï geni ki ge bëët nee kïthge bäät tïïc, ni beeye tiere gø na jääŋŋï gïï na leth bëët ii bäätge.
english: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:

anywaa: «Ennø, ŋøøm moø ni thør jø Babilønni deŋ kiir pääny enø, anø pïï maal kiper nee pääny macge; 'ba kiper mäny ki käc ki täw mo leth, pääny aløny ni cïba ceŋ jø Babiløn, jøø ni këëdi ki gø yøø. 'Ba kawaane, gïna caanï kiper päänyi en anø tägö, ni nëënö jïrï.
english: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.

anywaa: Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna cäänö ki aani ni kööï, ni ‹Ŋeew pwödhö jïrï ki gwel nyïm jiy mo iï cwølø,› 'ba pääny onø cïp ceŋ jø Babiløn.»
english: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord God, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, a na Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Neenï, beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø wïth gïïa kwøw bëët. ?Aŋø, da gïn mo dhäthö jïra?
english: Behold, I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïn caana en, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, päänyi en 'cïba ceŋ jø Babiløn, cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ni mac gø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

anywaa: Ni ö jø Babilønni moø ni këëdi ki päänyi en, ni dønyge yie, ni nyepge gø ki maac ni waaŋge gø. Ni waaŋge uudi bëët mo wø wääŋ jiyi bäätge ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni wø kunyge piny bäätge ki muuy mar køøŋø jï juu møøk, ni raanyge cwïnya.
english: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, jø Icriel ki jø Juuda bëëdö ni ge tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø keerge ki jïra, ni tägi ki kanya täkge bëëtö cøøn; kiper geni, ge bëëdö ni ge raanynya cwïnya keere ki køør gïï wø tïïcge.
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, päänyi en atïmö na gïn mo raanynya cwïnya mo käla wëër mara bääte, ni tägi ki kanya geeri, këël dïcäŋi en. Kiper manøgønø, raanynya raanynyø nyïma,
english: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

anywaa: kiper gïïa reyø bëët na tïïc jø Icrielli ki jø Juuda ni raanyge cwïnya, ni beeye geni ki nyeye moge, ki jø kööre moge, ki dïlämme moge, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk moge, ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre.
english: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni öge bëët ni luuge ŋäthge baŋa ni patha nyïmge; ni këël na bëëda naa pwönynya geni cooth, ïthge kärge ciiø nee pwöc wïnyge.
english: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa näk ec raac ki ge døc ni wø lamge akïthge yi øtø man wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa, ni ge tïïya gø ni ba waany.
english: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.

anywaa: Ni gëëtge ki kwör lam jï Baal ya agäm-kïdi mana cwøl ni Ben Inöm, nee wäätge ki nyïïge waaŋge no olämme kaace jï Mölek, ni beeye gïn mo ge kära köömmö ki man tïïcge gø, na acaac gïnögø bäŋgø mo ö wïïa thuwø ki man tïïcge gïïögø ni ec raac ki ge døc yøø, ni wëëkge jø Juuda bääyö.
english: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

anywaa: «'Ba këël na bëët jø Jerucalemmi ni ge köö, ni ‹Päänyi onø cïp cer nyeny Babiløn ki køør leny ki käc ki täw mo leth,› a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, gïn caana en kiper päänyi beeye en:
english: And now therefore thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani, jiya lema lemø yïth kwöra riema geni yïthge bëët kanya räny cwïnya ni wëëra ki geni ki wëër mo liel kaamar maac; ni duua geni kany en, ni bëëtge ni geno nikwak.
english: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

anywaa: Ni bëëtge ni gena jiya, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge.
english: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

anywaa: Ni mooa geni ki cwïny aciel ni cääthge ki jöö aciel, nee bëëtge ni ge lwäär ki aani cooth, nee bëëtö marge ki bëëtö mar obwöre moge moo ööi køørge tïme ni beer.
english: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:

anywaa: Ni ööa ni tuda ki luubö ki geni mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni beeye ni gïn mo beer ba wiia ki man tïïa gø jïge. Ni mooa cwïnyge ki lwär, ni bëëtge ni ge lwäär ki aani cooth, naa ba wecge.
english: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.

anywaa: Aani, a bëëdö ni yia met ki geni naa tïïya gïn mo beer jïge, ni këëlla tietge piny døøc yi ŋöömmi en, ni tïïa ki cwïnya bäre ki jwïëya bäre.
english: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

anywaa: «Kiper gïn caana en, a na Wuuö Jwøk, beeye en: Kaawat mana tïïa gïï na leth bëët ii dëët jøøi, aani, gïïa beyø bëët na caana kiperge tïïa tïïö jïge.
english: For thus saith the Lord; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.

anywaa: Pwöth ocäŋ ŋeewø yi ŋöömmi en, ŋööm wø cään jiyi kipere no oränynyö, ni bäŋ dhaanhø ni bäŋ lääy mo bëëdö yie, ni eno nø cïp ceŋ jø Babiløn.
english: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: Jiy pwöth oŋeewge ki gwel, ni göörge luum ŋïëw piny yïth weet ŋïëw, ni mwönge geni nyïm jiy mo ege cwølø. Gïnögø otïïcge yi ŋööm Benjamen, ki mïëri moa en deŋ Jerucalem, ki yïth mïëc Juuda, ki yïth mïëri moa en bäät thuuri, ki yïth mïëri moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki yïth mïëri mo Nëgëp. Kiper bëëtö marge 'cäŋa dwøk kare ni beer.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bäät Jeremaya ri rietge, kanya bëët Jeremaya ni poot noo dëët yi kal mar jø koor, ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na cwääc piny ni tïïc gø nee bëëde kare, eni na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö,
english: Thus saith the Lord the maker thereof, the Lord that formed it, to establish it; the Lord is his name;

anywaa: ni ‹Cwøl aani, løøa løø jïrï, ni cara gïï mo døøŋŋø jïrï mo tietge ba løny joot jïrï, mo kuyï.›
english: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

anywaa: Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, aana cäänö kiper luum uudi mo pääny Jerucalem man, ki luum uudi mo nyec Juuda moa nyaa piny nee kiir thør ki geni kiper leny mano këël ki jø Babiløn, nee ba ïnhge yi kiir ki bäät ŋøøm moa thørge deŋ kiir.
english: For thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo këëtge ki jø Babiløn, uudi moøgø opäŋ ki rïŋ dëët jiy moo  'näk ki køør räny cwïny ki wëër mara. Aani, täärnyïma kana kanø ki pääny man kiper gïïa temge na reyø.
english: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.

anywaa: «'Ba yi nyïme, pääny man odwøga kare, ni døø kare ni beer, ni dwøga bëët jiy kare, ni nyoodha bëët mëër ki bëët adïëri jïge ni päl.
english: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuda ki jø Icriel bëët ni dwøga bëëtö marge kare, ni cäŋa tietge këël piny ni teek kaawat mana bëëtge dïkwøŋ.
english: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

anywaa: Ni pïnya raay moge wøk, ni beege raay bëët moa bacge dëëra; ni wëënna raay moge bëët, ni beege raay moa bacge dëëra, ka ageem mana tïïcge dëëra.
english: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.

anywaa: Køøre nyeŋŋa tïmö ni wïnyö, ni jïta ki met ec ki pwøc, ka ajiem ki køør pääny man nyïm wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny, moo wïny gïïa beyø bëët moo tïïa kiper jø pääny man, ni thäŋ yïthge ni rïïŋ dëëtge kiper bëët bëënynyö ki bëët mëër mano tïïa kiper pääny man.
english: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.

anywaa: «Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Këël na bëëdu nou köö, ni «Paani oränynyö, ni bäŋ jiy ni bäŋ lääy mo bëëdö yie,» yïth mïëc Juuda ki dï Jerucalem ni bëëdö jaak ni bäŋ jiy ni bäŋ lääy mo bëëdö yïthge enø, dwøl ocäŋ wïnyö yïthge,
english: Thus saith the Lord; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,

anywaa: ni beeye dïlweel mar met ec ki dwør met ec, ki kanynyø mar nywöm, ki dööt jø wø cïpi ko olämme mo dwøk met ec yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge köö, « ‹ni «Dwøgu met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, kiper Wuuö Jwøk beer, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl bëëdö na bäre bäre.» Kiper aani, paac 'dwøga kare ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the Lord of hosts: for the Lord is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the Lord. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Dï paani ni bëëdö no oränynyö en, ki yïth mïëri moa en deŋŋe bëët, ni bëëdö ni bäŋ jiy ni bäŋ lääy mo bëëdö yïthge enø, otïmö ni da kwör kwaath mo løny jï dïkwääye ki man wëëkge dïëk moge jwömö yïthge,
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

anywaa: ni beege yïth mïëri moa en bäät thuuri, ki yïth mïëri moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ki yïth mïëri mo Nëgëp, ki yi ŋööm Benjamen, ki yïth mïëri moa en deŋ Jerucalem, ki yïth mïëri mo Juuda, noo cäŋ tïmö ni da pïïth dïëk mo kwaan dïkwääye kwaanø.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo luumma beer na caana kiper jø Icriel ki jø Juuda wëëga thur kare.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

anywaa: « ‹Noo tïme na yïth nïröke yi kar kaace, ŋat mo mare beeye adïëri owëëga twöö na lwiidhø, na ŋat mo käla ri dhi øt Deebit, ni ö ŋatøgø ni bëëde ni luup ŋøle na karge ni tïïya adïëri yi paac.
english: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïröke, jø Juuda di piemø, ni ö jø Jerucalemmi ni bëëtge ni geno nikwak. 'Ba man beeye nyeŋ mano cwøl Jerucalem ki gø: ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye tier bëënynyö marø.» ›
english: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The Lord our righteousness.

anywaa: Kiper mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni ‹Deebit bäŋ doo can na bäre bäre ki dhaanhø mo läw kare bäät wälu mar jø Icriel.
english: For thus saith the Lord; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;

anywaa: Ni tuuŋ dïlämme ma jø dhi øt Libay ba doo can ki dhaanhø mo ööa nyïma na ŋat wø cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel, na ŋat mo jiiŋŋa olämme møga cooth.› »
english: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ni näk mo løny jïïu ki man raanynyu gïna tuuda kiper waŋcäŋ ki gïna tuuda kiper wäär, nee waŋcäŋ ki wäär ba bëëtge kwörge kanya näk owäŋŋö,
english: Thus saith the Lord; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;

anywaa: løny ki man räny gïna tuuda ki dhaanhnha ma Deebit, ni eni ba jïti ki wääde mo  läw bäät wälu mare nee paac kääre. Ni gïna tuuda ki tuuŋ dïlämme ma jø dhi øt Libay, jø wø tïny aani, løny ki man ränynye thuwø.
english: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac dhaanhnha ma Deebit, ki jø dhi øt Libay, jø wø tïny aani, kwäänge meeda meedø ni tïmge ni thööth ni ba løny ki kwaan, kaawat man wø bëët ceerri ni ba løny ki kwaan, kaawat man wø bëët akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋŋi ni ba løny ki røm.»
english: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, gïna caan jøøi ii kärï wïnynyö, kanya köge, ni ‹Icriel ki Juuda, wïth tuŋi moa näk ariiø moa jier Wuuö Jwøki, gena nø kwiere›? Kanya caange teeŋ luummögø, ge taaga jiya, ni ge patha paac ki jïge këët.
english: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the Lord hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

anywaa: 'Ba man caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk en, beeye ni näk mo gïna tuuda kiper waŋcäŋ ki wäär kära tïïö nee bëëde kare, ni ciik moa cïba kiper maal ki piny kära tïïö nee bëëde kare,
english: Thus saith the Lord; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

anywaa: løny jïra ki man kwiera nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ki dhaanhnha ma Deebit, ni bäŋe ŋat mo kwanya këët røk nyïïkwaaye mo käär jiya ma nyïïkwaac Eeberam ka Aydhak ki Jeekap. 'Ba ge ba kwiera; bëëtö marge odwøga kare, ni nyoodha mëër mara jïge.»
english: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn ki jø leny moe, ki jø leny mo käla tiet akwöm mo nyeye bëët mo bäät piny, ni beege wïth juurre bëët moa näk ee dïïmö, ni ge këëdö ki Jerucalem ki mïëri moa en deŋŋe, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya,
english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,

anywaa: ni kööm Jeremaya nee ci baŋ Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda, ni caan gø jïre, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en: ni ‹Ennø, pääny man 'cïba cer nyeny Babiløn, ni ööe ni waaŋ gø.
english: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï ba bøth cere, kiper ka adïëri møn, ï di maaø ki tøŋ, ni cïp ïïni cere. Ni jootï nyeny Babiløn, ni put nyeŋŋe kem dëërï, ni cääne ki ïïni nou neeta täärnyïmmu, ni putï ci Babiløn.›
english: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ï na Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda, wïny luum Wuuö Jwøk. Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiperï beeye en, ena köö: Ï ba thøw ri leny,
english: Yet hear the word of the Lord, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:

anywaa: 'ba ïïno thøw ki thøø mo beer jaak; ni waaŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met kiperï ni jiemma ïïni kaawat mana wara waaŋi ni jiemma kwäyu ki gø, moa kwøŋ bëëdö na nyeye dïkwøŋ niï poodi, ni jwöŋ jiyi kiperï, ni köge, ni «Wui nyenywa öy!» kiper luummögø yaa nø caan.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya luupögø bëët acaane jï Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda Jerucalem,
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

anywaa: kanya bëët jø lenynyi mo nyeny Babiløn ni ge këëdö Jerucalem ki päänye bëët moa näk poot no odööŋ yi Juuda, ni beege Lakic ka Adhëka, kiper bee geni keerge moa näk odööŋ røk päänye bëët moa näk ogeerø ni teek yi Juuda.
english: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kanyøgø nyeya ma Cëdëkiya onø tudö ki luubö ki jiy bëët moa en Jerucalem, nee luum jøøa biel dëëtge na laaŋe gøø piny nee ge pät yi bëët laŋ,
english: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;

anywaa: nee ŋati man nø laŋŋø mare ma dïcwøø ma ŋat Ibaru wala dhaagø ma nyi jø Ibaru, nee päde yi bëët laŋ, kiper nee bäŋe ŋat mo poot bëëdö ni coki ma ŋat Juuth ee døøc laŋŋø.
english: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët ki jiy bëët moa tuut luummögø, gena jïëy nee ŋati man nø rege, laŋŋø mare ma dïcwøø wala dhaagø nee päde yi bëët laŋ, nee ba bëëtge na laaŋe moge këët. Ni manøgø beeye luubö mana jïëcge, ni pätge geni yi bëët laŋ.
english: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään, acaare moge acäŋge wiillø, ni døøge baŋ laaŋe moa näk ege pädö yi bëët laŋ, ni kälge geni, ni cäŋge cwøw moøgø ki mään tïïyö na laaŋe moge.
english: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Jeremaya acaane, ni kööe,
english: Therefore the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni  «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en: Aana tudö ki luubö ki kwäyu, dïcäŋa käla geni wøk yie ki yi ŋööm Ijep, na näk po laŋ, ni kööa,
english: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Kany wø tïme na aŋuun bïriet cwiiri, ŋati man nø dïïu coki ma ŋat Ibaru mo dëëre ee biel baŋ gø, mo otïïö jïre ki cwiiri abïciel, dee wiiø nee aae.› 'Ba kwäyu, mara kärge wïnynyö, ni ïthge kärge ciiø ki mara.
english: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde na acaare mou you wiilø kany mo cään, ni tïïyu gïna beer ki jïra, ni ŋati man nø caana gïr pät wati yi bëët laŋ, ni luummögø tuutu nyïma yi øtø man ni wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋa en,
english: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

anywaa: acaare mou acäŋu wiillø ni raanynyu nyeŋŋa, ki køør mana ö ŋati man nø dïïu ni døø baŋ laŋŋe mana näk dïcwøø ki mana näk dhaagø, ni beege jøøa pätu yi bëët laŋ na weyu nee aacge kaa mana manyge, ni cäŋu cwøw moøgø ki mään tïïyö na laaŋe mou.
english: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Uuni, mara käru wïnynyö, këël na gøøu luum laaŋe piny, ni ŋati man nø coki ki wati dee wiiø ni pät gø yi bëët laŋ. 'Ba ennø, luubö mano gøøa piny kiperu beeye en: Uuni, u wiia wiiø nou thøwu ri leny, ki täw mo leth, ki käc. Ni tïïa uuni na jiy mo tiet akwöm mo nyeye mo bäät piny bëët yïthge thäŋŋö ki gïno tägi dëëtu. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the Lord, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a tïïö ki gïn mo leth dëët jiy moa kaal gïna tuuda ki geni, na näk luumma tuutge nyïma kärge gwøø, ni beeye luumma tuutge kanya kakge nyirøøa ki dïëre ni pööthge ki dïëre ni ge laamma røkge;
english: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,

anywaa: ni beege jø Juuda moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jø Jerucalem moa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki jø kööre, ki dïlämme, ki jø paac bëët moa pöödhö ki dï nyirøøa mana kak ki dïëre.
english: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;

anywaa: Aani, ge 'cïba ceŋ nyïïmän moge, jø wø many jwïëcge. Ni tïm rïŋ dëëtge na cam jï wec maal ki lääc paap.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.

anywaa: «Ni ö Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moe ni cïba geni ceŋ nyïïmän moge, jø wø many jwïëcge, ni cïba geni ceŋ jø leny mo nyeny Babiløn, jøøa daak rege buutu.
english: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ge köömma köömmö ni duua geni päänyi, ni këëtge ki päänyi ni macge gø ni waaŋge gø. Ni tïïa mïëri mo Juuda na kwör mo oränynyö mo bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge.»
english: Behold, I will command, saith the Lord, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bääta, a na Jeremaya, yïth nïra beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, ena köö,
english: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ci baŋ jø dhi øt Rëkap, ni cäänï ki geni, ni kälï geni yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni kïthï geni yi thääŋ øtø aciel, ni mooyï geni ki køøŋø nee maathge.»
english: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.

anywaa: Køøre aani, Jaadhania o Jeremaya nyikwaar Kabadhiniya, ki nyïïmenni ki wääte bëët ki jø dhi øt Rëkap bëët akäla,
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
