anywaa: ni kïtha geni yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, yi thääŋ øtø mar wäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Anan wär Igdaliya, ni beeye thääŋ øtø mana en buut thääŋ øt jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ni ødøgø ena maal bäät thääŋ øtø mar Maycëya o Calum ŋat wø koor dhi øt Jwøk.
english: And I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:

anywaa: Køøre dääe mo päŋ ki køøŋø, ka athööthe, acïba nyïm jø dhi øt Rëkap, ni kööa jïge, ni «Mädhu ki køøŋø nø.»
english: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, ni «Wa ba mädhö ki køøŋø, kiper kwarwa ma Jönadap o Rëkap waana köömme, ni kööe, ni ‹Uuni ki wäätu, käru mädhö ki køøŋø na bäre bäre;
english: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:

anywaa: ni uuni thuwø, käru gëëdö ki uudi, ni ba puru ki pwöth beel, ni bäŋe pwöth omøki jïïu; gïïögø kär dee gø jïïu na bäre bäre. 'Ba ki yïth nïr kwøw mou bëët, uuno bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare, nou ruuwu ki nïne mo thööth yi paano bëëdu yie ni uuna wëëlle.›
english: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.

anywaa: Køøre waani, dwør kwarwa ma Jönadap o Rëkap awïnywa, ni tïïcwa gïïa kööm waani ki geni bëët, ni wa  kär mädhö ki køøŋø ki yïth nïr kwøw mowa bëët, ni beege waani ki määrwa ki wäätwa ki nyïïwa;
english: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

anywaa: ni wa kär gëëdö ki uudi thuwø mo bëëtwa yïthge. Ni bëëtwa ni bäŋ pwöth omøki jïwa, ki pwöth beel, ki köödhi.
english: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

anywaa: 'Ba waani, gïïa ö kwarwa ma Jönadap na kööm waani ki geni bëët awïnywa, ni tïïcwa geni ki køør mana caane, ni bëëtwa ni wa bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare keerge.
english: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn na ö kuna tuk paac, waana köö, ni ‹Ööu, waa reŋŋø Jerucalem, kany poode ni jø leny mo Babiløn ki jø leny mo Aram poot kär pïï.› Køøre waana öö ni bëëtwa Jerucalem.»
english: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre luum Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ciï ni caanï gø jï jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na ‹?Aŋø, luup 'moa ba wïnynyu nee pwöc kwanynyu?
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba luup Jönadap o Rëkap na kööm wääte ki geni, nee geni ba mäthge ki køøŋø, agwøkge; ni ge kär mädhö ki køøŋø këël dïcäŋi en, kiper gïna ö kwarge na kööm geni ki gø atïïcge na kare. 'Ba aani, aana cäänö ki uuni kwöre mo thööth, 'ba uuni, mara käru wïnynyö.
english: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët ajääŋŋa baŋu kwöre mo thööth, ni kööa, ni «Ŋati man nø dïïu luu ree ni wec jöör bëëtö mare na raac, ni tïïyu tïïe moa beyø, ni ba cäädhu køør juu møøk nou lama geni; køøre u bëëdö yi ŋöömö mana cïba jïïu ki jï kwäyu.» 'Ba ïthu käru ciiø ki dwøra, ni mara käru wïnynyö.
english: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, nyïïkwaac Jönadap o Rëkap, luum kwarge mana kööm geni ki gø agwøkge, 'ba jøøi ii mara kärge wïnynyö.›
english: Because the sons of Jehonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: ‹Ka adïëri møn, a känna bäät jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem bëët ki dï Juuda bäre ki gïn mo leth, ni beeye gïna näk yaa nø caan ni 'käla bäätge, kiper aana cäänö ki geni, ni kärge mara wïnynyö, ni cwøla geni, ni kärge mara løø.› »
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya acäänö ki jø dhi øt Rëkap, ni kööe, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: ‹Kiper mana wïnynyu gïna caan kwaru ma Jönadap, ni gwøgu gïïa kööm uuni ki geni bëët, ni tïïyu geni bëët na karge kaawat mana kööm uuni ki gø,
english: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye ni dhi øt Jönadap o Rëkap ba cänni na bäre ki dhaanhø mo tïnynya aani.› »
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwötï ki warakata ni göörï luup yie bëët moa caana jïrï kiper jø Icriel ki jø Juuda, ki wïth juurre bëët, ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa kwøŋa cäänö ki ïïni, kanya bëët Jöcaya na nyeya, këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day.

anywaa: Kiper kanymør ni jø Juuda gïna leth na caara kiperge ni 'käla bäätge wïnyge wïnynyö, ni ö ŋati man nø dïge ni luu ree ni wec jöör bëëtö mare na raac; køøre nø, gïïa bacge ki raay moge wëënna wëënnö.»
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeremaya Baruk o Neriya acwøle, ni ö Baruki ni göör luup piny bëët yi warakata dhi Jeremaya, ni beege luup moa caan Wuuö Jwøki jï Jeremaya.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the Lord, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya acäänö ki Baruk ni kööe, ni «Aano mänö, ni ba løny jïra ki man cøøa øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, wärï ci øt Wuuö Jwøk kanyo tïme na cäŋ wödö ki cam, ni kwaanï luup mo Wuuö Jwøk jï jiy, moa caana jïrï na göörï piny yi wëëlö, ni kwaanï ni jø Juuda bëët nut moo ööi ki yïth  mïëri moge.
english: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the Lord in the ears of the people in the Lord's house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.

anywaa: Kanymør ni Wuuö Jwøk kwacge kwaaø, ni ö ŋati man nø dïge ni luu ree ni wec jöör bëëtö mare na raac; kiper wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk, ka ajäla mana caane dëët jøøi ii dwøŋ døc.»
english: It may be they will present their supplication before the Lord, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the Lord hath pronounced against this people.

anywaa: Ni ö Baruki o Neriya ni tïïc gïnögø na kare ki køør moa caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Jeremaya bëët jïre, nee luup Wuuö Jwøk kwaane yi wëëlö yi øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the Lord in the Lord's house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na bïï cwiiri moa beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, ri dwää abïŋween, jiy bëët moa en Jerucalem, ki jiy bëët moa öö ki dï mïëri mo Juuda na ö Jerucalem, luum wödö ki cam mana näk ege gøø piny atïïcge nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the Lord to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Baruk luup mo Jeremaya akwaane yi wëëlö jï jiy bëët yi øt Wuuö Jwøk, yi thääŋ øtø mana näk mar Gemariya o Capan ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny. Ni ødøgø ena yi kal mana en jï maal buut dhi kal mar øt Wuuö Jwøk mana cwøl ni Dhi Kal Mana Nyään.
english: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the Lord, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the Lord's house, in the ears of all the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Mikaya o Gemariya o Capan na wïny luup bëët mo Wuuö Jwøk moa en yi wëëlö,
english: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the Lord,

anywaa: ena put ci paan dwøŋ yi thääŋ øtø mar ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët opï piny kaace, ni beege Elicama, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ki Delaya o Cemaya, ki Elnathan wär Akbör, ki Gemariya o Capan, ki Cëdëkiya wär Ananiya, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø møga bëët.
english: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

anywaa: Ni ö Mikaya ni caan luup bëët jïge moa wïnynye dhi Baruk kanya ö Baruki na kwaan wëëlö jï jiy.
english: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët, Jïyudi o Nethaniya o Celemiya o Kuuci ajääŋge baŋ Baruk ni köge, ni «Wëëlö mana kwaanï luup yie jï jiy kwany cerï ni ööï ki gø.» Køøre Baruk o Neriya wëëlö aput kwany cere ni ci baŋge.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, ni «Beerra man pïï piny ni kwaanï wëëlö jïwa.» Køøre wëëlö akwaan Baruki jïge.
english: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø wïnyge luupögø bëët, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni ge lwäär, ni köge jï Baruk, ni «Ka adïëri møn, waani, luupögø bëët caanwa caanø jï nyeya.»
english: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge Baruk ni köge, ni «?Luup moi bëët, iï göör piny nidïï? ?Agöörï ki køør mana caan Jeremaya ki dhee? Beerra man caanï gø jïwa.»
english: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?

anywaa: Ni kö Baruki jïge, ni «Luupögø bëët acaan Jeremaya jïra ki dhee, ni gööra geni piny yi wëëlö ki peen.»
english: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø aköö jï Baruk, ni «Ïïni ki Jeremaya, cou ni kannu rou, ni bëëdu ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ŋäc kanyo enu yie.»
english: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø gena aay ni cige cwöt baŋ nyeya, ni caange luupögø bëët jïre. 'Ba wëëlö ege nø kan yi thääŋ øtø mar Elicama ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny.
english: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya, Jïyudi ajääŋŋe baŋ wëëlö nee käle. Ni ö Jïyudi ni käl wëëlö wøk ki yi thääŋ øtø mar Elicama ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny. Ni ö Jïyudi ni kwaan wëëlö jï nyeya ki jï jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët moa näk cuŋŋö buut nyeya.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe's chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.

anywaa: Ni kar kaagø beeye dwää abïŋween, ni nyeya opï piny yi øtø man wø bëëde yie ka arïïa, ni maac bëëdö ni liel nyïme ya athaa.
english: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Jïyudi ni tiel mo jïtö ka adäk wala aŋween thööre thöörö ki kwaan, nyeya tiel moøgø aput ŋul wøk ki caakïïn mar ŋat wø göör luup piny, ni leeŋ gø yi maac mana en ya athaa nyïme, këël mana ö wëëlö bäre ni thööri ya maaci mana en ya athaa.
english: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ki jø kööre moe bëët moa wïny luupögø bëët ge kär lwäyö, na abïïe moge kärge jeeyø.
english: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.

anywaa: Këël na bëëde ni Elnathan ki Delaya ki Gemariya ge kwaaya nyeya nee wëëlö ba waaŋe, eni marge käre wïnynyö.
english: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya, o nyeya ma Jeramiel, ki Ceraya wär Adhiriel, ki Celemiya wär Abadël, aköömme nee cige baŋ Baruk ŋat wø göör luup piny, ki baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, kiper nee makge, 'ba Jeremaya ki Baruk geno nø kan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the Lord hid them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na nø waaŋ wëëlö mana en luupi yie moa göör Baruki piny dhi Jeremaya, dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bäät Jeremaya ni kööe,
english: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Cäŋ kädö ki warakata mør, ni göörï luup piny bëët moa en yi wëëlö mana dïkwøŋ na waaŋ Jeyöakëmmi nyeny Juuda.
english: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.

anywaa: 'Ba mano caanï kiper Jeyöakëm nyeny Juuda, wärï kööï ni mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ïïni, wëëlö man awaaŋï ni kööï, na ‹?Aperŋø na göörï gø ni nyeny Babiløn öö møn ni raany paac man ni tïïc gø ni bäŋ dhaanhø ki lääy mo bëëdö yie?›
english: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim king of Judah, Thus saith the Lord; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Jeyöakëm nyeny Juuda beeye en: Eni ba jïti ki ŋat mo läw bäät wäl Deebit; ni kanyo thøøe, rïŋ dëëre leeŋa wøk yi cäŋ ni bëëde yi köö ki dï wäär.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

anywaa: Aani, eni ki jø wø käl dëëre ki jø kööre moe jääla jäälö kiper raay moge, ni ö gïïa lethi bëët na caana kiperge ni kïtha geni bäätge, ki bäät jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, kiper mara kärge wïnynyö.»
english: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya akädö ki warakata mør, ni mëëk gø Baruk o Neriya ŋat wø göör luup piny. Ni ö Baruki ni göör luup piny yie dhi Jeremaya, ni beege luup bëët moa en yi wëëlö mana waaŋ Jeyöakëmmi nyeny Juuda. Ni ö luupi mo thööth mo röömi ki moa dïkwøŋ ni meedi bäätge.
english: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëdëkiya o Jöcaya arøøny Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn na nyeya yi ŋööm Juuda kar Jekönaya wär Jeyöakëm, ni bëëde na nyeya ni paac ena cere.
english: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki jø kööre moe ki jø paac, luup Wuuö Jwøk moa caane ki dhi Jeremaya kärge wïnynyö.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the Lord, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na nyeya ma Cëdëkiya, Jïyukal o Celemiya ki dïlämi ma Jepaniya o Maycëya ajääŋŋe baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, ni kööe, ni «Beerra man lämï jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, kiperwa.»
english: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the Lord our God for us.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø Jeremaya poot cäädhö jaak dï jiy, kiper eni poot kär kïth øt twöc.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.

anywaa: Ni jø leny mo Peerø nyeny Ijep onø tïŋŋö Ijep; 'ba kanya ö jø Babilønni moa näk Jerucalem ege ciel dïër na wïnyge luum ööny jø Ijep, Jerucalem aputge wec.
english: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, beeye en: Wär caannu jï nyeny Juuda, ŋata jääŋ uuni baŋa naa pëënynye, ni kööu jïre, ni ‹Neenï, jø leny mo Peerø moa nø tïŋŋö, ni ge ööa kuna kønyge ïïni, ge døøa poge Ijep.
english: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Babilønni ni cäŋge duuö ni këëtge ki pääny man, ni makge gø ni waaŋge gø.›
english: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: ‹Kär rou cøøgu ni kööu, ni «Jø Babiløn wa wecge wiiø møn,» 'ba u ba wecge!
english: Thus saith the Lord; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.

anywaa: Këël doo naa jø leny bëët mo jø Babiløn moa këëdö ki uuni you böötö, ni tïme ni dööŋŋa jiy moa näk dëëtge da ŋwiili keerge, ŋati man nø dïge doo ööa wøk ki yo oduŋkaara mare ni öge maal ni waaŋge paac man.› »
english: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya ö jø lenynyi mo jø Babiløn na wecge Jerucalem, na näk ege ciel dïër, kiper ööny jø leny mo Peerø,
english: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,

anywaa: Jeremaya atïŋŋö Jerucalem ni eni cøøa yi ŋööm jø tuuŋ Benjamen, kiper nee ŋöömö mana näk kure lwøre ni jiy nutö.
english: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Benjamen, ŋata bëëdö na wïth jø koor, mo nyeŋŋe Iriya o Celemiya wär Ananiya ena kaace. Ni ö eni ni mak nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, ni kööe, ni «Ïïni, ï kwala riï nee riï cïpï jï jø Babiløn.»
english: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya aköö, ni «Manøgø patha kare. Aani, mara paa cïp raa jï jø Babiløn.» 'Ba mana caan Jeremaya käre leŋø. Køøre Iriya Jeremaya aput mak, ni käl gø baŋ jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø.
english: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ni räny cwïnyge  ki Jeremaya ni pwötge gø, ni putge gø kïth kar twöc yi øt Jönathan, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, ni beeye øda näk ege tïïö na kar twöc.
english: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.

anywaa: Jeremaya akïth yi øt buur mana näk otïïö na kar twöc, ni bëëde kaace ki nïne mo thööth.
english: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cëdëkiya ajääk baŋ gø ni käl gø wøk. Ni ö nyeya ni pëëny Jeremaya mëëth ki piny paare paan dwøŋ, ni kööe, ni «?Da dwøl mo oöö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk?» Ni kö Jeremaya, ni «Dagø.» Ni ö Jeremaya ni put köö, ni «Ïïni, ï cïba cer nyeny Babiløn.»
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the Lord? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeremaya ni pëëny nyeya ma Cëdëkiya, na «?Agïnaŋø ni raac ni yaa tïïö dëërï en, ki dëët jø kööre moï, ki dëët jøøi ii, na kïthu aani øt twöc kipere en?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, nyïïkuk Jwøk mou moa cäänö ki uuni na köö, ni ‹Nyeny Babiløn ba ö baŋu baŋ leny, ni ba ö baŋ leny paani,› geni, ge enge kaa ennø?
english: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø Awuuö, ï na nyenynya, beerra man wïnynyï kwac mara, ni ba dwøgï aani yi øt Jönathan, ŋat wø göör luup akwöma piny, kiper naa ba thøøa kaace.»
english: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cëdëkiya acïpö ki dwøl, ni ö jiyi ni kïthge Jeremaya yi kal mar øt jø koor, ni bëëtge ni ge cïpö jïre ki dääpö cooth ki yïth nïne bëët, mo käla baŋ jø wø budö ki dääpe, këël mana thum dääpe bëët dï paac. 'Ba Jeremaya aput bëëte kaace yi kal mar øt jø koor.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers' street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

anywaa: 'Ba Cepathiya o Matan, ki Gedaliya o Pacuur, ki Jïyukal o Celemiya, ki Pacuur o Malkiya, luup moa car Jeremaya jï jiy bëët awïnyge, kanya kööe,
english: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: Ŋato bëëdö yi pääny man thøw ki käc ki täw mo leth, ni nääi ko opëëllö, 'ba ŋato aa wøk ni cïp cere jï jø Babiløn, eni kwøw; ni bøth jwïëyi moe, ni bëëde ni kwøw.
english: Thus saith the Lord, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye ni pääny man ocïp ceŋ jø leny mo nyeny Babiløn møn, ni ö eni ni put pääny mak.»
english: Thus saith the Lord, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which shall take it.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø gena köö jï nyeya, ni «Ennø, beerra man 'näk nyenøgø, kiper eni bäätha bäät jø leny ki jiy bëët moa näk odööŋ yi pääny man ki køør luup moa care jïge. Kiper nyenøgø ba many bëënynyö mar jiy moi, 'ba eni manynya ränynyö marge.»
english: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cëdëkiya aköö, ni «Neennu, eni ena ceŋŋu, kiper nyeya bäŋ gïn mo løny ki tïïc jïre ni näk patha mana manynyu.»
english: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya akälge, ni kïthge gø yi buur man wø cuŋ pïïyi yie mar o nyeya ma Malkiya, ni lwarge gø piny ki thøøli. 'Ba buurögø ena yi kal mar øt jø koor, ni yie bäŋ pïï, 'ba nuta onøt yie keere. Ni ö Jeremaya ni neemwøny piny yo onødøgø.
english: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.

anywaa: 'Ba Ebet-Melek, nyï Ithiöpia ma ŋat köör mo ena paan dwøŋ, awïnynye ni Jeremaya okïth yi buur. 'Ba kar kaagø nyeya opï piny dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Benjamen.
english: Now when Ebed–melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;

anywaa: Køøre Ebet-Melek aö wøk ki paan dwøŋ ni cääne ki nyeya, ni kööe,
english: Ebed–melech went forth out of the king's house, and spake to the king, saying,

anywaa: na «Awuuö, ï na nyenynya, gïïa tïïc jøøi ii bëët dëër nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya beege gïï mo reyø. Ena leeŋge yi buur, kany mo eni thøw yie ki käc, kiper bäŋ cam dï pääny këët.»
english: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya Ebet-Melek nyï Ithiöpia aköömme, ni kööe, ni «Kädï ki jiy ma pïëradäk kany, mo ge ena cerï, ni cou ni kälu nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya wøk ki yi buur, kany poode ni eni kär thøw.»
english: Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Ebet-Melek jøøa cïp cere akäle, ni ci paan dwøŋ, ni døny piny tier øtø kany wø kan jammi yie, ni lwöte ka abïïe mo ojeeyø ka abïïe ma nywate, ni twöö geni ri thøøl, ni lwar ge piny yi buur baŋ Jeremaya.
english: So Ebed–melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

anywaa: Ni kö Ebet-Meleki nyï Ithiöpia jï Jeremaya, na «Abïïe moi no ojeeyø ki moi na nywate ii cïp tiet jööthï, ni riidï  thøøli bäätge.» Ni ö Jeremaya ni tïïc gø ki køør mana caan.
english: And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya atuutge wøk ki thøøli ni kälge gø wøk ki yi buur. Ni ö Jeremaya ni put bëëte yi kal mar øt jø koor.
english: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cëdëkiya ajääk baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, ni käli baŋe buut dää dhøgi man wø døny øt Wuuö Jwøk ki gø. Ni kö nyeya jï Jeremaya, ni «Da gïn miï pëënynya pëënynyö ki gø; kär dee gïn mo mooŋï ki aani.»
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the Lord: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeremaya jï Cëdëkiya, na «?Aŋø, ni näk mo yaa caanø jïrï, ka adïëri møn, a ba 'nägï? Këël a doo cïpö ki pwöc jïrï thuwø, mara ba wïnynyï.»
english: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya ma Cëdëkiya akööŋ mëëth ki piny jï Jeremaya, ni kööe, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw, eni na cïp jwïëy moø, ï ba nääa, niï ba cïba ceŋ jøøi ni many jwïëy moï ii.»
english: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the Lord liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya aköö jï Cëdëkiya, ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ni näk cerï cïpï cïbö møn jï jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo nyeny Babiløn, ï bëëdö niï kwøw, ni pääny man ba waaŋ, ni ö ïïni ki jø paarï ni bëëdu nou kwøw.
english: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon's princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cerï ba cïpï jï jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo nyeny Babiløn, pääny man cïba ceŋ jø Babiløn, ni waaŋge gø, ni ïïni ki dëërï, ï ba bøth ceŋge.»
english: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Cëdëkiya aköö jï Jeremaya, na «A lwäär ki jø Juuth moa näk ceŋge ege cïbö jï jø Babiløn, kiper kanymør jø Babiløn a 'cïpge ceŋ jøøgø, ni caarge aani.»
english: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya aköö, ni «Ï ba cïpge ceŋ jøøgø. Beerra man wïnynyï luum Wuuö Jwøk man caana jïrï en; køøre tïmö ni beer kiperï, ni bëëdï niï kwøw.
english: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the Lord, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ï poot bëëdö niï kweeyø ki man cïpï cerï, luubö mana nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jïra beeye en:
english: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that the Lord hath shewed me:

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, mään bëët moa näk odööŋ paan dwøŋ mar nyeny Juuda okäl wøk ni kïthi baŋ jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mo nyeny Babiløn. Ni ö määnni moøgø ni cäänge ni köge, «ni ‹Nyïïawäätï moa näk iï ŋäädhö ïïna cøøkge ni böötge ïïni ki luubö; 'ba ennø, kanya tïme ni tietï omwøny onøti, ïïna wecge.›
english: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah's house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon's princes, and those women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away back.

anywaa: «Mään moï ko obwöre moï bëët okäl wøk ni mëëgi jø Babiløn, ni ïïni ki dëërï ï ba bøth ceŋge. 'Ba ïïno mak nyeny Babilønni, ni ö päänynyi man ni waaŋe.»
english: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.

anywaa: Køøre Cëdëkiya aköö jï Jeremaya, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo ŋäc luup moi na caanø ii, niï ba thøwï.
english: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo wïny jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø wïnynyö ni aano cäänö ki ïïni, ni öge baŋï ni köge, ni ‹Gïna caanï jï nyeya ki gïna caan nyeya jïrï caanï jïwa; kär dee gïn mooŋï ki waani, niï ba 'näkwa,›
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:

anywaa: køøre wärï kööï jïge, ni ‹Mara beeye kwac nyïm nyeya kiper naa ba dwøk øt twöc øt Jönathan, naa ba thøøa kaace.› »
english: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët aö baŋ Jeremaya ni pëënyge gø; 'ba luup moa caane jïge acaane ki køør luup bëët moa caan nyeya jïre. Køøre bäŋ gïn mo ege caanø ki gø këët, kiper gïna caan Jeremaya ki nyeya kär wïnyö.
english: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya aput bëëte yi kal mar øt jø koor këël dïcäŋa ö Jerucalemmi na maai yie ki tøŋ.
english: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye jöö mana räny Jerucalemmi ki gø: Kanya tïme na ri bïŋweer cwiiri moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeny Juuda, yi dwää apaar, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn ki jø leny moe bëët aöö ni cielge Jerucalem dïër.
english: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiiri na apaar kurciel moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeya, ni nïr dwää aŋween abïŋween, kiir mar pääny atucge.
english: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa kwörge  døøŋŋø bëët mo nyeny Babiløn ni öge ni pïge piny dhi kiir man wø cwøl ni Dhi Kiir Dïër, ni beege Nergal-Carëcër, ki Camgar-Nebø, ki Car-Cekim wïth jø kööre, ki Nergal-Carëcër cuumi mana dwøŋ, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø møga bëët mo nyeny Babiløn.
english: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, even Nergal–sharezer, Samgar–nebo, Sarsechim, Rab–saris, Nergal–sharezer, Rab–mag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda ki jø leny moe na jootge jøøgø, gena put bwøk wøk ki yi pääny ki dï wäär, ni aacge ni ge cøra øtjöö man wø cør ya ajïniin nyeya, ni ge dønyi ka dhi kiir mana en yïthakic kiiri moa na ariiø, ni aacge ki øtjöö ni ge coonya goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba.
english: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Babiløn aläp køørge, ni maage Cëdëkiya yi pwöl Jerikö Paap Araaba; ni makge gø ni kälge gø Ribala, päänya en yi ŋööm Amath, baŋ Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn. Ni ö Nabukedenecörri ni ŋut bäät gø ki luubö.
english: But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn wäät Cëdëkiya aŋare nyïm gø Ribala ni nëënö jïre, ni ö eni thuwø ni 'näk jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët mo Juuda.
english: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.

anywaa: Køøre eni nyeŋ Cëdëkiya atuunynye, ni twöc gø ko oguut jwëëlli nee kïth Babiløn.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.

anywaa: Jø Babiløn thuwø paan dwøŋ mar nyeya ki uudi mo jiy awaaŋge, ni nyaage kiir piny mar Jerucalem.
english: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni ö Nabucaradanni kwääc jø koor ni käl jiy moa dööŋ dï pääny, ki jiy moa cïp ceŋge jïre, ki jiy møga moa dööŋ, ni kïth geni Babiløn ni maae ka tøŋ.
english: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabucaradan kwääc jø koor, jø møøk moa can døc na näk jïge bäŋ jammi awii yi ŋööm Juuda, ni put geni møyø ki pwöth omøki ki pwöth beel kar kaace.
english: But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn acïpö ki dwøl kiper Jeremaya ki bäät Nabucaradan kwääc jø koor, ni kööe,
english: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard, saying,

anywaa: ni «Lwør Jeremaya ni gwøgï gø, ni bäŋe gïn mo raac mo tïïyï dëëre; 'ba gïn wø manynye wär tïïyï jïre.»
english: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.

anywaa: Køøre Nabucaradan kwääc jø koor, ki Nabucacban wïth jø kööre, ki Nergal- Carëcër cuumi mana dwøŋ, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët mo nyeny Babiløn,
english: So Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab–saris, and Nergal–sharezer, Rab–mag, and all the king of Babylon's princes;

anywaa: gena jäägö ki jiy ni kälge Jeremaya wøk ki yi kal mar øt jø koor. Ni cïpge gø cer Gedaliya wär Akikam o Capan, kiper nee kïth paare. Ni ö Jeremaya ni bëëde ki jiy.
english: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Jeremaya noo twöö yi kal mar øt jø koor, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya, ni kööe,
english: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni caanï gø jï Ebet-Melek nyï Ithiöpia ni luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, luup moa caana kiper pääny man 'käla bääte, ni beege gïï mo leth ni patha gïï mo beyø, ni gïïögø, dïcäŋo täkge yie, tägö ni nëënö jïrï.
english: Go and speak to Ebed–melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, ï piema piemø dïcäŋöca, niï ba cïp ceŋ jøøa lwäärï ki geni.
english: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the Lord: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, ï piema piemø, niï ba 'näk. 'Ba jwïëy moï bøth, kiper ï bëëdö niï ŋäätha aani. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ni ööa bäät Jeremaya kanya nø ö Nabucaradanni kwääc jø koor na nø pät Jeremaya yi paac mana cwøl ni Reema. Kiper Nabucaradan Jeremaya akäle no otwöö ki tiimme ki jiy moa näk omaaø ki tøŋ Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre nee kïth Babiløn.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord, after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.

anywaa: Kanyøgø eni na kwääc jø koor Jeremaya akäle ni kööe jïgø, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, gïn ni leth en acaane ni 'käle bäät paac man.
english: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The Lord thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Wuuö Jwøk gïnögø akäl bäät paani en, ni tïïc gø kaawat mana caane. Gïn atägö dëëtu kiper mana tïïu ki raay dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni käru dwøre wïnynyö.
english: Now the Lord hath brought it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋi ennø,  ka adïëri møn, aani, ï päda pädö yïth tiimme moø ni en ceŋŋï yøø. Ni näk miï jiera man ciï Babiløn ki aani, ø aay na aciel, ni gwøa ïïni; 'ba ni näk miï jiera man ba ciï Babiløn ki aani, løny ki man bëëdï. Neenï, yi paac man bäre løny ki man jierï kanya manynyï jaak; løny jïrï ki man ciï kanya näk wøp ni iï caarø ni beer ki jïrï.»
english: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni Jeremaya poot kär døøk, Nabucaradan aköö, ni «Beerra man ciï baŋ Gedaliya wär Akikam nyikwaar Capan, ŋata røøny nyeny Babilønni bäät mïëri mo Juuda, ni bëëdï buute ki jiy na aciel. Wala ci kanya näk iï caarø ni beer ki jïrï ki man ciï yie.» Køøre eni na kwääc jø koor Jeremaya amooe ki caammi ki muuy, ni wec gø nee aae.
english: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya aci Micpa baŋ Gedaliya wär Akikam, ni bëëde buute ki jiy na aciel moa näk odööŋ paac.
english: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri mo jø leny mo Juuda moa reŋ paap ki jø leny moge awïnyge ni Gedaliya wär Akikam anø røøny nyeny Babilønni bäät paac, ni nø tïïc gø ni cwøw ki mään ko obwöre ena cere, ni beege jiy moa can moa näk kär kïth Babiløn.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;

anywaa: Køøre gena ö Micpa baŋ Gedaliya, ni beege Icmiel o Nethaniya, ki Jöanan ki Jönathan wäät Karëa, ki Ceraya o Tanumët, ki wäät Ëpay nyï Nethöpa, ki Jaadhania ŋat mo wänni beeye nyï Maika, ni ge ööi ka jø leny moge bëët.
english: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.

anywaa: Køøre Gedaliya wär Akikam o Capan akööŋ jï jøøgø ki jø leny moge, ni kööe, ni «Käru lwäyö ki man tïnynyu jø Babiløn. 'Ba bëëdu yi ŋöömö man, ni tïnynyu nyeny Babiløn; køøre bëëtö maru tïmö ni beer.
english: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra, a bëëdö kany Micpa, naa cuŋŋi kaperu nyïm jø Babiløn moo ö baŋø. 'Ba uuni, beerra man cou ni lemmu nyïïomøki ki teeŋ nyïïjenni møga, ki nyïïjenni mo wø wel na maaw, ni kïthu geni yïth dääe mou, ni bëëdu yïth mïëri moo pïïu piny yïthge.»
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth bëët moa en Möap ki moa en po jø Amön ki moa en Ëdöm ki moa en yïth mïëri møga bëët awïnyge thuwø ni nyeny Babiløn awëëö ki jiy møøk nee dööŋge yi Juuda, ni nø røøny Gedaliya wär Akikam o Capan bäät jøøgø.
english: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;

anywaa: Køøre jø Juuth bëët gena put duuö ki kwöra riem geni yïthge bëët, ni duuge Juuda ni öge Micpa baŋ Gedaliya, ni aacge ni lïmge ki nyïïomøki ki teeŋ nyïïjenni møga mo thööth døc.
english: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääc jø leny bëët moa en paap gena ö Micpa baŋ Gedaliya,
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

anywaa: ni köge jïre, na «?Aŋø, kuyï ni Baalic nyeny jø Amön Icmiel o Nethaniya ajääŋŋe baŋï niï nääe?» 'Ba Gedaliya wär Akikam marge käre ŋäädhö.
english: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.

anywaa: Køøre Jöanan o Karëa acäänö mëëth ki piny ki Gedaliya Micpa, ni kööe, ni «Beerra man cøøa nee Icmiel o Nethaniya nääa, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ŋäc gø. ?Aŋø, aperŋø noo 'näk ïïni jaak en, nee jø Juuth bëët moø ni rege ege cooŋ buutï yøø keethge, ni ö jø Juuda moøgø noo dööŋ yøø ni ränyge?»
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?

anywaa: 'Ba Gedaliya wär Akikam aköö jï Jöanan o Karëa, ni «Kär gïnögø tïïyï, kiper gïna caanï kiper Icmiel paa kare.»
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dwää abïriiø, Icmiel o Nethaniya nyikwaar Elicama na käl ri jø dhi øt nyec, na näk dhaanhø aciel røk kwääc jø koor mo nyeya, aöö ki jiy apaar, ni öge Micpa baŋ Gedaliya wär Akikam. 'Ba kanya cämge na aciel Micpa,
english: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.

anywaa: Icmiel o Nethaniya ki jøøa na apaar na öö ki eni, gena ö maal ni cwøpge Gedaliya wär Akikam o Capan piny ko opëëlle ni 'näkge gø, ni beeye ŋata røøny nyeny Babilønni yi ŋöömö.
english: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

anywaa: Ni ö Icmielli thuwø ni 'näk jø Juuth bëët Micpa moa bëëdö  ki Gedaliya, ki jø leny mo jø Babiløn moa nut kaace.
english: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna tägö, kanya tïme na aruunnø man ni Gedaliya onø 'näk, ni poot bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc gø,
english: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

anywaa: jiy ma pïërabära aöö ni ge käla Cekam ki Cëëlö ki Cameria, ni jïëc tïkge ege lielø na abïïe moge ege jeeyø ni dëëtge ege ŋarø ki gïï mo beth, ni ge käädö ki muuce mo beel ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, kiper nee cïpge yi øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Icmielli o Nethaniya ni tïŋŋe Micpa, ni cøøa kuna røømme ki jøøgø, ni cäädhi ni jwöŋö. 'Ba kanya røømme ki geni, ena köö jïge, ni «Ööu ni cou baŋ Gedaliya wär Akikam.»
english: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm jøøgø ni ge pïï dï paac ennø, Icmiel o Nethaniya ki jiye, jøøgø anäkge, ni leeŋge geni yi buur man wø cuŋ pïïyi yie.
english: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy apaar røk jøøgø mo oköö jï Icmiel, ni «Kär wa 'nägï, kiper da beel ka abäy ki mädhi ki kïïnynye mo ewa cooŋ piny mo ewa kanø yïth pwöth.» Køøre jøøgø awiie ni käre nääö kanya 'näk jøøa cäädhö ki geni.
english: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba buur manøgø mana ö Icmielli na leeŋ dëët jiy yie moa nääe beeye buur mo dwøŋ mana koony nyeya ma Aca kanya bëëde ni eni lääŋŋa ööny Baaca nyeny Icriel baŋ leny. Buurögø apääŋ Icmielli o Nethaniya ki jiy moa nääe.
english: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.

anywaa: Køøre Icmiel jiy bëët moa näk odööŋ Micpa amaae ki tøŋ, ni beege nyïï nyeya ki jiy møga bëët moa en Micpa, na cïp Nabucaradanni kwääc jø koor cer Gedaliya wär Akikam. Icmiel o Nethaniya jøøgø 'akäle ki tøŋ, ni tïŋŋe kiper nee ŋut po jø Amön.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jöananni o Karëa ki kwääri bëët mo jø leny moa en buute na wïnyge gïïa reyø bëët na tïïc Icmielli o Nethaniya,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

anywaa: cwøw bëët 'akälge ni aacge kiper nee këëtge ki Icmiel o Nethaniya. Ni maage gø buut puul mana dwøŋ na en Gibien.
english: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jiyi moa mak Icmielli ki tøŋ na jootge Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääri mo jø leny moa öö ki eni, yïthge aput mïnnö.
english: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët moa mak Icmielli ki tøŋ Micpa ni putge rege løk ni duuge ni cige baŋ Jöanan o Karëa.
english: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.

anywaa: 'Ba Icmiel o Nethaniya ki jiy abära gena päär wøk ki cer Jöanan, ni reŋge po jø Amön.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.

anywaa: Køøre Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääri bëët mo jø leny moa öö ki eni, jiy bëët moa näk odööŋ Micpa, moa lwørge cer Icmiel o Nethaniya, 'akälge. Jøøgø beege jiy moa mak Icmielli ki tøŋ kanya nø 'näk Gedaliya wär Akikam, ni beege jø leny ki mään ko obwöre ki jø kööre, jøøa duu Jöananni kanya maa geni yie Gibien.
english: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ni ge cøøa Ijep, ni pïge piny Gëröt-Kimiam, na en buut Bethelem, ni ruuge kaace mëëth.
english: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Beth–lehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

anywaa: 'Ba tier wääth mana cige Ijep kipere beeye kiper mana lwäcge ki jø Babiløn, kiper Gedaliya wär Akikam, na røøny nyeny Babilønni yi ŋöömö, anäk Icmielli o Nethaniya.
english: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääri mo jø leny, ni beege Jöanan o Karëa ki Jaadhania wär Ocaya, ki kwääc jø leny møga bëët, ki jiy bëët, ki mana täge ki jiy moa kwörge therø këël mana pïïe ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, gena ö baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya,
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,

anywaa: ni köge jïre, ni «Beerra man wïnynyï kwac marwa, ni lämï kiperwa jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, ni beeye kiper jøøi ii bëët moa dööŋ, kiper beeye waani keerwa na nøk ii na dööŋ røk jøøa thööth, kaawat man nëënwa jïrï ki waŋï ennø.
english: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the Lord thy God, even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)

anywaa: Lämï kiper nee Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, kanyo ciwa yie ki gïno tïïcwa nee nyoodhe jïwa.»
english: That the Lord thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.

anywaa: Køøre nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya aköö jïge, ni «Gïna caannu awïnynya. Ennø, a lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru ki køør luup moa caannu. Gïno løk Wuuö Jwøki kiperu ocaana jïïu. Aani bäŋ luubö mo mooŋa ki uuni na bäre.»
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto the Lord your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing the Lord shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jï Jeremaya, «Ni näk mo luubö bäre mar Wuuö Jwøk,  Jwøk marï, mano caane jïrï kiperwa ba tïïcwa, beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki, eni na ŋäc luummögø na adïëri, ni ŋøl mare na kare bäätwa.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, The Lord be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the Lord thy God shall send thee to us.

anywaa: Waani Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, na jääŋwa ïïni baŋe, dwøre wïnywa wïnynyö, na gïn mo ec met ki gø wala ec raac ki gø, kiper nee tïme ni beer jïwa. Ka adïëri møn, waani, dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, wïnywa wïnynyö.»
english: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of the Lord our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the Lord our God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør nïne apaar, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya.
english: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the Lord came unto Jeremiah.

anywaa: Ni ö Jeremaya ni cwøl Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääri bëët mo jø leny moa öö ki Jöanan, ki jiy bëët, ki mana täge ki jiy moa kwörge therø këël mana pïïe ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø,
english: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na jääŋŋu aani baŋe nee kwac maru caana jïre, beeye en:
english: And said unto them, Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ni näk mou bëëdö yi ŋöömö man, u tïïa tïïö nou teek, ni ba nyaa uuni. 'Ba tietu këëla piny, ni ba cööda uuni wøk; kiper cwïnya apädhö ki gïna leth na tïïa dëëtu.
english: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.

anywaa: Uuni, käru bëëdö nou lwäär ki nyeny Babiløn, manø ni lwäärru ki gø enø. Käru lwäyö ki eni, kiper a ena buutu, naa peemma uuni ni käla uuni wøk cere.
english: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the Lord: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

anywaa: Aani thuwø, mëër mara nyoodha nyoodhø jïïu, nee eni na nyeny Babiløn mëër mare nyoodhe jïïu, ni dwøk uuni yi ŋöömö maru.
english: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mou köö, ni ‹Wa ba bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en,› nou kwiera dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru,
english: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the Lord your God,

anywaa: ni kööu, ni ‹Jïwa bäyö, wa cøøa yi ŋööm Ijep, kany mo gïr leny ki dwør tuuŋ leny ba wïnywa yie, na kany mo wa ba 'näk käci yie; wa cøø ni bëëtwa yie,›
english: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

anywaa: ka adïëri møn, u na jø Juuda moa näk odööŋ, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ni näk mo wïthu you këël ri wääth Ijep, ni aayu kiper nou bëëdu kaace,
english: And now therefore hear the word of the Lord, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;

anywaa: leny mana lwäärru ki gø ööa bäätu yi ŋööm Ijep, ni ö käci mana lwäärru ki gø ni läm køøru kaace Ijep, ni putu thøø kaace.
english: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.

anywaa: Ni jiy bëët moo këël wïthge ri wääth Ijep nee bëëtge kaace, ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni thøwge ki käc ki täw mo leth, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo dööŋ ni kwøw, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo bøth ki gïna leth noo käla bäätge.
english: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Aani, räny cwïny mara ki wëër mara 'käla bäätu kanyo pïïyu Ijep, kaawat mana käla wëër mara bäät jøøa bëëdö Jerucalem; ni tïmu ni uuna gïr acïëni, ni jiy cwïnyge böö ki gïno tägi dëëtu, ni tïmu na gïr ajøøŋ na gïr abuua; ni kany ba jootu këët.
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Juuda moa dööŋ, Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki uuni ni kööe, ni ‹Käru ci Ijep.› Beerra man ŋäyu gø ni dïcäŋi gïn caana naa köömma uuni.
english: The Lord hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.

anywaa: Kiper uuni dëëtu acøøgu keeru; beeye uuni na jääŋ aani baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ni kööu, ni ‹Lämï kiperwa jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, 'ba gïno caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marø, wär caanï jïwa; køøre tïïcwa tïïö.›
english: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the Lord your God, saying, Pray for us unto the Lord our God; and according unto all that the Lord our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïnögø na caana jïïu dïcäŋi en. 'Ba mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, käru wïnynyö, ni beege gïïa caane jïra bëët kiper nee caana jïïu.
english: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the Lord your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wär putu ŋäc ennø nou di nääö ko opëëllö, ni thøwu ki käc ki täw mo leth, kanyo manynyu nou cøøa yie enø nou bëëdu yie.»
english: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go and to sojourn.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya luupögø bëët acaane jï jøøgø bëët, ni beege luup moa ö Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marge, na jääŋ eni ki geni nee caane. 'Ba kanya lønye ki caan luupögø,
english: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the Lord their God, for which the Lord their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

anywaa: Adhiriya wär Ocaya ki Jöanan o Karëa ki jøw okiera bëët aköö jï Jeremaya, ni «Ïïni, ï caana tööt jaak! Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, ï käre jääŋŋö baŋwa niï kööï ki waani, ni ‹Käru ci Ijep baŋ bëëtö kaace.›
english: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the Lord our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:

anywaa: 'Ba Baruk o Neriya yiï acoone kiper nee  wa cïbï ceŋ jø Babiløn nee wa 'näkge ni makge wa ki tøŋ ni kïthge waani Babiløn.»
english: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääc jø leny bëët, ki jiy møga bëët, dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane ni bëëtge yi ŋööm Juuda kärge wïnynyö.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the Lord, to dwell in the land of Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba Jöanan o Karëa ki kwääc jø leny bëët, jø Juuda bëët moa dööŋ akälge, ni beege jøøa duuö ki tiet mïëri bëët moa riem geni yïthge na duu yi ŋööm Juuda,
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;

anywaa: ni beege cwøw, ki mään, ko obwöre, ki nyïï nyeya, ki jiy bëët moa wii Nabucaradanni kwääc jø koor cer Gedaliya wär Akikam o Capan, ni kälge nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya ki Baruk o Neriya thuwø.
english: Even men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.

anywaa: Jøøgø gena ci Ijep ni dwør Wuuö Jwøk kärge wïnynyö, ni aacge këël mana pïïcge Thapinac.
english: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the Lord: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Jeremaya ni eni ena Thapinac ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwäny cerï ki kïte mo døøŋŋø ni mwönï geni piny ko odhöönh kanya näk ocaamø ki thuube na en dhi kal mar paan dwøŋ mar Peerø mana en Thapinac, ni gïnögø tïïyï ni da jø Juuth mo neeta ïïni;
english: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

anywaa: ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, a jääga baŋ Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, eni na en cera, kiper nee ööe, ni cïba wälu mare bäät kïte moi moa mwön piny kany, ni ö eni ni cwöth oduŋkaany nyec mare piny bäätge.
english: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

anywaa: Eni öö ni tuk Ijep, ni ö jøøa näk marge thøø ni thøwge, ni ö jøøa näk marge mäk ki tøŋ ni mak geni ki tøŋ, ni ö jøøa näk marge 'näk ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö.
english: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni nyep uut juu mo jø Ijep ni waaŋ geni, ni käl juu moge. Eni ŋööm Ijep olwøre ni jööt jaak, kaawat man wø ö dïkwääc dïëki wø rïëba aleeŋŋa dëëre ni jööt jaak, ni ö eni na Nabukedenecör ni døøe ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëre.
english: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.

anywaa: Eni thuwø kïte moa näk ocwää maal na bäyö Ijep, na en kany wø wøørge cäŋ yie, tøøe piny, ni waaŋ uut juu mo jø Ijep.› »
english: He shall break also the images of Beth–shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl man aö bäät Jeremaya kiper jø Juuth bëët moa bëëdö Ijep, na bëëdö Migdöl ki Thapinac ki Mempic ki thääŋ ŋööm Ijep ma Patröc, ni kööe,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Uuni, gïïa leth bëët na kïtha bäät Jerucalem ki bäät mïëri bëët mo Juuda ajootu, ni dïcäŋi ennø ge bëëdö ni geno ränynyö ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge,
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,

anywaa: kiper gïïa reyø na tïïc jiyi ni raanyge cwïnya ki køør mana bëëtge ni ge cïpö ko olämme mo wø waaŋ jï juu møøk ni ge tïnynya geni, ni beege juu mo kucge dïkwøŋ, ni uuni ki kwäyu juugögø kuyu thuwø.
english: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, ye, nor your fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba aana bëëdö ni jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋu cooth, naa köö, ni ‹Gïn ni raac yia ki gø døc enø, na mäna ki gø, kär tïïyu.›
english: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, mara kärge wïnynyö, ni yïthge kärge ciiø ki mara, ki man luuge rege ni wecge gïïa reyø na tïïcge, ni beeye ki man ba cïpge ko olämme jï juu møøk.
english: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, räny cwïny mara ki wëër mara ni wø wääŋö kaamar maac akïtha bäät Jerucalem ki bäät päänye mo Juuda, ni putge niruuth ni ränyge kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: ?Aŋø, aperŋø nø ni tïïyu gïn ni raac en, nou käla gïn mo leth bäätu keeru, nou thööra cwøw Juuda, ki mään, ko obwöre, ki moa en kööthi, ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo weyu mo dööŋ dïïu en?
english: Therefore now thus saith the Lord, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na raanynyu cwïnya ki køør gïïa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu en, ni cïpu ko olämme mo wø waaŋ jï juu moa path Ijep, paana ööu yie kiper bëëtö? Manøgø, u thööra rou, nou  tïmu ni uuna gïr acïëni, na gïr ajøøŋ dï wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny.
english: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïthu awïl ki gïïa reyø na tïïc kwäyu, ki gïïa reyø na tïïc nyeye mo Juuda ki määrge, ki gïïa reyø na tïïyu ki määru dï Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre?
english: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

anywaa: 'Ba cwïnyge kär maar pädhö kiper gïna tïïcge, këël dïcäŋi en, ni ge kär lwäyö, ni ge kär cäädhö køør ciik 'moa ki gïïa cema na cïba jïïu ki jï kwäyu.
english: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, wïïa këëlla rou ni tïïa dëëtu ki gïn mo leth naa thööra jø Juuda bëët.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.

anywaa: Aani, jø Juuda moa dööŋ thööra thöörö møn, moa näk wïthge ege këël ri ööny Ijep nee bëëtge yie, ni thumge Ijep bëët ki thøø, ni ge 'näk ko opëëllö ni thøwge ki käc. Ki mano täge ki jiy moa kwörge therø këël mano pïïe ri jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, geno 'näk ko opëëllö, ni thøwge ki käc, ni tïmge na gïr acïëni, ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, ni tïmge na gïr ajøøŋ, na gïr abuua.
english: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

anywaa: Ni jääla jøw bëëdö Ijep kaawat mana jääla jø Jerucalem, ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö, ni thøwge ki käc ki täw mo leth.
english: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø Juuda moa dööŋ na aay nee bëëtge Ijep, bäŋgø mo bøth, ni bäŋgø mo dööŋ ni kwøw mo døøa yi ŋööm Juuda mana manyge ki cwïnyge ni ge døøa yie nee bëëtge yie. Geni, bäŋgø mo døøk, 'ba beege mo nøk keerge noo døøk.»
english: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøw bëët moa ŋäc gø ni määrge ocïpö ko olämme jï juu møøk, ki mään bëët moa näk cuŋŋö kaace na näk rege ege cooŋ kanya ciel ni ge thööth, ki jiy bëët moa näk bëëdö Patröc thääŋ ŋööm Ijep, marge aløkge jï Jeremaya ni köge,
english: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Luubö mana caanï enø jïwa ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk ba wïnywa.
english: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the Lord, we will not hearken unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, waani, gïna nø ö wøk ki dhøkwa tïïcwa tïïö, ni beeye ki man cïpwa ko olämme jï jwøa cwøl ni Gwanynyø Mar Maal, ni kunywa piny ki køøŋø jïre, ni caala mana wara tïïcwa, ki mana wara tïïc kwäcwa ki nyeye mowa ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mowa dï Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda bëët; ni kar kaace jïwa da cam mo päl, ni bëëtö marwa beer, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo otägö dëëtwa.
english: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana cuŋwa ni wa ba cïpi ko olämme jï Gwanynyø Mar Maal, ni wa ba kuny piny ki køøŋø jïre, waana put tïmö ni wa can ki jammi bëët, ni putwa thumö ko opëëllö ni thøwa ki käc.»
english: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

anywaa: Køøre mään ajutö, na «?Aŋø, kanya bëëtwa ni wa cïpö ko olämme jï Gwanynyø Mar Maal, ni kunywa piny ki køøŋø jïre, ni tïïwa ki muunni ni caala kït dëëre, kuc cwøwi mowa?»
english: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?

anywaa: 'Ba Jeremaya luummögø adwøk baŋ jiy bëët moa dwök baŋe ki luubö, ni beege cwøw ki mään bëët, ni kööe,
english: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk kär bëëdö ni caara gïru kanya bëëdu nou cïpö ko olämme jï juu møøk dï Jerucalem ki yïth päänye mo Juuda bëët? ?Aŋø, patha uuni ki dëëtu, ki kwäyu, ki nyeye mou, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø mou, ki jø paac bëët na tïïc gïïögø?
english: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the Lord remember them, and came it not into his mind?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, atïmö ni ba løny jï Wuuö Jwøk këët ki man jïëny gïïa reyø na tïïyu na näk ec raac ki geni døc; ni beeye na räny paaci maru, ni tïme na gïn mo cwïny jiy böö ki gïna tägö dëëre, na gïr acïëni, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo bëëdö yie kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en.
english: So that the Lord could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

anywaa: Gïn ni leth en atägö dëëtu kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en kiper mana cïpu ko olämme jï juu møøk, ni tïïu ki raay dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni käru dwøre wïnynyö, ni käru cäädhö ki jöör ciik moe ki gïïa ceme ki pwöc moe.»
english: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the Lord, and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.

anywaa: Køøre Jeremaya aköö jï jiy bëët, ki mään bëët, ni «U na jø Juuda bëët, u ni en Ijep en, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the Lord, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Uuni ki määru, gïna caannu ki dhøgu awëëgu thur kare ki køør mana  tïïyu gø ki ceŋŋu, ni beeye luubö mana caannu na kööu, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, waani, gïna kööŋwa kipere tïïcwa tïïö, ni beeye ki man cïpwa ko olämme jï Gwanynyø Mar Maal ni kunywa piny ki køøŋø jïre.› 'Ba putu tïïc nø, nou wëëga kööŋ maru thur kare.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.

anywaa: «'Ba u na jø Juuda bëët, u ni bëëdö Ijep en, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ennø, aana kööŋ ŋëët nyeŋŋa na dwøŋ nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋa cura dhee këët røk jø Juuda bëët moi ni en Ijep ii, ni mare kööŋ ri nyeŋŋa, ni «Ŋëët Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøa kwøw.»
english: Therefore hear ye the word of the Lord, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the Lord, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord God liveth.

anywaa: Ennø, waŋa yaa këël rege nee gïn mo leth kïtha bäätge ni patha gïn mo beer, ni ö jø Juuda bëët moi ni en Ijep ii ni thøwge ko opëëllö ki käc, këël mano thumge bëët.
english: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

anywaa: 'Ba mo nøk keerge moo bøth dho opëëllö, geno aa wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ni døøge yi ŋööm Juuda. Køøre jø Juuda bëët moo dööŋ moa ö Ijep baŋ bëëtö, kar kaace oŋäcge ki man näk mo thura luumma kare wala marge.
english: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.

anywaa: « ‹A na Wuuö Jwøk, a cïpö jïïu ki ŋïï mo nyootha gø nou jääla jäälö kany, nee ŋäyu ni luup moa caana dëëtu kännö ki gïn mo leth bäätu møn.
