english: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the Lord, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Peerø-Öpira nyeny Ijep 'cïba ceŋ nyïïmän moe, jø wø many jwïëye, kaawat mana cïba Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda cer nyimän mare ma Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ŋata many jwïëc gø.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will give Pharaoh–hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Jeremaya jï Baruk o Neriya, kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, ni Baruk luup moa caan Jeremaya ee nø göör piny yi wëëlö. Ena köö,
english: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

anywaa: «Ï na Baruk en, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki Jwø Icriel kiperï beeye en:
english: Thus saith the Lord, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;

anywaa: Ïïna köö, ‹Wui, aana ränynyö, kiper Wuuö Jwøk aana cäŋ mooyø ki kïmmö ni meet gø bäät rääm mara; aana ööl ki cooyø, naa bëëdö ni bäŋ jwöm mo jooda.›
english: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the Lord hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni ‹Ï na Jeremaya en, caanï jï Baruk ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ennø, gïna näk yaa tïïö ni teek raanynya raanynyø, ni gïna näk tiere yaa këël piny 'cööda wøk; ni gïnögø tägö yi ŋöömö bäre.
english: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The Lord saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

anywaa: ?'Ba ï na Baruk, aŋø, ï manynya gø niï bëëdï ni karï dwøŋ? Kär manynyï. Kiper ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, da gïn mo leth mo 'käla bäät jiy bëët; 'ba ï wëëga bødhø ki thøø kwöro cäädhï yïthge bëët.» › Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the Lord: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane kiper wïth juurre acaane jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya,
english: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;

anywaa: ni tägi ka Ijep. Ni mana caane kiper jø leny mo Peerø-Nekø nyeny Ijep, ŋata bööti bäät Naam Upareeti päänya cwøl ni Karkëmec, na bööt Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn kanya tïme na ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Jeyöakëmmi o Jöcaya ni ena nyeny Juuda, beeye en:
english: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.

anywaa: «Jiiŋŋu kööde mo leny moa therø ki moa døøŋŋø, ni cou wøk baŋ leny.
english: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

anywaa: Jiiŋŋu okwëënyi ni ethu bäätge. Kïthu cööc nywïëny wïthu, ni maaŋŋu kwöru. Paagu tøøŋi mou, ni røøu abïïk nywïëny mo leny dëëtu.
english: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na tägö ni nëëni jïra enø? Jø Ijep, dëëtge atïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär, ni døøge ŋäthge. Otëëe mo leny moge abööti, ni bwøkge ni reŋge;  ni bäŋ ŋat mo olwïthö ŋääe, ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ ni pääŋ piny bäre.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Ŋata tiere piew ba jöömmi, ni ŋata näk oteeø ba bøth; kanyo enge yie jï løø wï-piny bäät Naam Upareeti, tietge cwanyge cwanynyø ni päänhge.
english: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

anywaa: «?A jøøe ni bwön wøk kaamar pï Naam Ijep ma Nail en, ni ge rïïŋi kaawat man wø rïïŋ pï nämmi mo kwödö ko odhäny?
english: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?

anywaa: Jø leny mo Ijep bwönna wøk kaamar pï naam poge ma Nail, ni ge rïïŋi kaawat man wø rïïŋ pï nämmi mo kwödö ko odhäny. Ni köge, ni ‹Wa bwönna wøk, ni pääŋwa piny bäre; ka adïëri møn, päänye bëët ki jø wø bëëdö yïthge raanywa raanynyø.›
english: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Ijep mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi, ki u ni wø cäädhi ki yïth jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, pööthu maal ni rïïŋu ki geni døc kaamar ŋwïëc bøøl. Ni ö jø lenynyi mou moa teek, ni beege jø Ithiöpia ki jø Put ni wø käär kööt leny, ki jø Lidiya ni wø thöödhö ka athëëre ni pööthge nyïm.
english: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Ludim, that handle and bend the bow.

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋöce beeye cäŋ mar Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni beeye cäŋ mano cool kwöri yie dëët nyïïmän moe. Opëëllö ocämö rege gøøc mano jääŋe, ni mädhe ki rem moge këël mano røme. Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ge wëëge ŋaal kaamar olämme yi paano enge yie jï løø wï-piny bäät Naam Upareeti.
english: For this is the day of the Lord God of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord God of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Ijep ni wø caal nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue, cou yi ŋööm Gelät ni lwötu ki jaath man wø rwøth ŋwellø ki gø. Jenni mo thööth apääru ki jaak, 'ba bäŋ køny mo jootu.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.

anywaa: Wïth juurre lään wïc maru owïnyge, ni ö pinynyi bäre ni gääbe ko oduuru maru. Kiper oteen leny, oteen leny maya odhïëre, ni päthge bëët karge riet.»
english: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya kiper ööny Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn nee ŋööm Ijep raanynye beeye en:
english: The word that the Lord spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.

anywaa: «Gøøu piny Ijep, ni gøøu gø piny Migdöl, ki Mempic ki Thapinac, ni kööu, ni ‹Maaŋŋu kwöru, ni jegu rou, kiper jø mïëri moa karge cään ki uuni bëët athöör opëëllö.›
english: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aperŋø noo ö rwaathi maru man wø lammu noo pädhe en? Eni ba cuŋŋi kare, kiper eno cöör Wuuö Jwøki piny ni pädhe.
english: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the Lord did drive them.

anywaa: Jø leny mou tietge ocwanyge, ni ö ŋati man nø ni päth bäät wati, ni köge, ni ‹Ööø maal, waa døø baŋ jø pøø yi ŋöömma nywøl øøni yie, ni ø ŋwieya opëëllö mar nyimän.›
english: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

anywaa: Kaace geno jwöŋi ki nyeŋ Peerø nyeny Ijep, ni köge,  ni ‹Peerø ŋat ŋwøc jaak, eni cäŋa dee tïïö yie ki gïn mo dwøŋ awëëk pöödhö jaak.› »
english: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.

anywaa: 'Ba Nyeya na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena kööŋ, ni «Ŋëëta keera, a na Wuuö Jwøk, da ŋat mo öö mo tuga Ijep mo kare dwøŋ, mo caala Kïn Tabör ni wø dwøŋ døc yïthakic kïte, ki Kïn Karmël ni wø en deŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö Ijep, japu wär twöyu, kiper u di maaø ki tøŋ ni kïth uuni paac mør. Kiper Mempic ränynyö ni neeruuth, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie.
english: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

anywaa: «Ijep caala dhieŋ ma nyakøø mo poot mïërö, 'ba lwaa jø leny ööi ki paana en jï løø wï-piny, ni tïïge dëëre ki teeŋ gïn wø tïïc lwaa rumö dëër dhieŋ.
english: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi mo wø cun jø Ijepi ki gwel nee këëtge kiperge, na caal nyïïrwädhe mo pulli, ni løkge rege ni reŋge na aciel, ni geni ba cuŋŋi karge. Kiper cäŋ gïï mo leth opïï bäätge, ni beeye cäŋ ajäla mana wäŋŋi kiperge.
english: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.

anywaa: «Jø Ijep oreŋi kaawat man wø reŋ thwölli ni kudhö, kiper nyïïmän moge ocäänh bäätge ki teek. Geno ööi kaamar jiy mo käädö ki lïge mo cøøa baŋ ŋøt ka aŋøta.
english: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

anywaa: Ni raanyge Ijep kaawat man wø ŋøt lul piny, këël na bëët jiyi moe ni thööth ni caala lul mo odhïŋ. Jøøi thööth døc ni kaala lwaa bäänyö, ni geni ba løny ki kwaan.
english: They shall cut down her forest, saith the Lord, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.

anywaa: Jø Ijep wïthge otïmö ni laay, kanyo cïp geni ceŋ jøw ööi ki jï løø wï-piny.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, a kännö ka ajäla bäät jwøa cwøl na Amön ni wø en Tëbic, ki bäät Peerø nyeny Ijep ki jø Ijep, ki bäät juu moe ki nyeye moe, ki jø wø ŋääth Peerø bëët.
english: The Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:

anywaa: Aani, ge 'cïba ceŋ jø wø many jwïëcge, ni beeye cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ki jø kööre moe. 'Ba køør manøce nø, Ijep obeet kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wui, jø Icriel, u na nyïïkwaac dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, käru lwäyö, ni ba bwøk cwïnynyu; kiper ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, uuni ki jøw käl dëëtu, u piema piemø paanøgø ni kare bäär ki pou enø, na kïth uuni yie ki tøŋ. Ni ööu, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni duu pou ni bëëdu mëëth ni uuno nikwak, ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëk uuni lwär.
english: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

anywaa: Wui, u na nyïïkwaac dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, käru lwäyö, kiper a nut buutu. Aani, tiet wïth juurre moo riema uuni yïthge bëët raanynya raanynyø na bäre. 'Ba uuni, u ba raanynya bäre. U pwönynya pwönynyö ka ajäla mana näk kare, nou ba wiia ka ajäla.»
english: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the Lord: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma  Jeremaya kiper jø Pilitin, kanya poot Geedha ni kär nyak Peerø.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: ni «Ka adïëri møn, jø leny ööi ki jï løø wï-piny, ni piny ege baabø kaamar jwïëö; ni macge paac bäre, ki japa en yie bëët, këël päänye ki jiy mo wø bëëdö yïthge. Jø paanøgø ogöö ko oduuru, ni ö jiyi bëët ni jwöŋge.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør dööt tiet okwëënyi mo nyïïmän moo rïŋŋi, ki dööt jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki dööt tiet jïëth leny moøgø moo wïnyi, wëëe ba lwïthi køørge baŋ nyïïge, kiper geni bäätge opädhi.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

anywaa: Gïï ii otägi yi cäŋ mano ööi ni raanynya jø Pilitin, ni raanynya jøøa bøth ri leny moa doo køny jø Tayar ki jø Caydan. Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Pilitin raanynya raanynyø, ni beege jøøa dööŋ røk nyïïkwaac jiy moa öö ki ya acuul Kaptör.
english: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the Lord will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

anywaa: Geedha odööŋ ni leer kaamar ŋat mo wïïe otal, ni ö jø Ackelönni ni dït wïthge. ?Wui, u na näk odööŋ ni wø bëëdö yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö mar jø Pilitin, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo bëëdu nou kïmmö ni dëëtu ŋaru ŋarø ki gïï mo beth?
english: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?

anywaa: «Uuno jwöŋi ni kööu, ni ‹?Wui, opëël Wuuö Jwøk, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo jwömï riï ki 'näk? Døø yi køp marï! Ni jwömï riï ki 'näk ni bëëdï niï lïŋö.›
english: O thou sword of the Lord, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

anywaa: ?'Ba opëëllö olïŋe nidïï, ni eni yaa nø köömmö, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ki man raany jø Ackelön ki jø tiet mïëri moa bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ?»
english: How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, kiper Möap, ena köö, «Otïmö ni raac jï Nebø, kiper eno nyak. Ni ö Kiriatayimmi ni maai ki tøŋ, ni lää wïth jiy moa en yie; ni ö jø wø bëëdö kwöra näk ogeerø ni teek ni bwøk cwïnyge, ni tïm wïthge ni laay.
english: Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

anywaa: Möap otïmö ni bäŋ ajiem jïre këët. Jø Ëcbön ogëëmö ki eni, ni köge, ni ‹Ööø maal ni raanynyø gø nee bëëde ni patha paac këët.› U ni wø bëëdö Matmën, wïthu odïïr, ni bëët opëëllö ni caatha køøru.
english: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.

anywaa: Oduuru owïnyi ki Örönaim, ni beeye oduuc ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

anywaa: Jø Möap oränynyi, ni ö nyïïge moa therø ni gööge ko oduuru.
english: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

anywaa: Geno jwöŋi døc ni cwïnyge keecge keeyø kanyo aacge ni ge etha thuur Lukith, ni kanyo løøcge piny yi Örönaim ge poot göö ko oduuc ränynyö.
english: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

anywaa: U na jø Möap, u reeŋø nou ŋwieya jwïëyu, ni bëëdu dï tëën kaamar abuŋŋö.
english: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

anywaa: Uuni ki dëëtu, uuno mak ki tøŋ ni käl uuni, kiper uuna bëëdö nou ŋäätha tïïe mou ki jap kwärö mou. Jwøu ma Kemöc okïth paac mør ni mak ki tøŋ, eni ki dïlämme moe ki jø wø tïny gø.
english: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.

anywaa: Jø aranya ööa bäät päänye bëët, ni bäŋe pääny mo bøth. Mïëri moa en ya agäm-kïdi oränynyi, ni ö moa en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö ni ränyge thuwø, kaawat mana caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the Lord hath spoken.

anywaa: «Cïpu jï jø Möap ki bwöm kiper nee ge määtge; päänye moge oränynyi, ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yïthge.
english: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

anywaa: «Acïëni oen bäät ŋato ba tïïc tïïc mar Wuuö Jwøk ki cwïnye bäre dëët jø Möap; acïëni oen bäät ŋato ba køny rem jøøgø piny ko opëëllö mare.
english: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the Lord deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.

anywaa: «Jø Möap gena bëëdö ni geno nikwak poge ki mana täk paaci, ni ge bëëdö kaamar køøŋø mo onïër piny, mo kär daa yi dak maya; kiper geni, ge kär kïth paac mør ni ge mak ki tøŋ. Kiper manøgønø, ge caala køøŋø mo mete bëëdö kare, ni ŋwäänynye kär wïïtö.
english: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

anywaa: 'Ba da nïne mo öö maa jääga baŋge ki jiy, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mo daa geni paac mør kaawat man wø daa køøŋø yi dak mør, ni dööŋ yie ni ŋaam ni nyadhi.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

anywaa: Jø Möap wïthge olää jwøge ma Kemöc kaawat mana ö wïth jø Icrielli ni lääi ya jwøki mana ŋääthge na lamge Bëthël.
english: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence.

anywaa: «?U na jø Möap, aŋø ni wø kööu, ni ‹Waano otëëe, ni waana jiy mo këëdö ki leny mo teek.›?»
english: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Nyeya na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Möap oränynyi; kiper jø aranya oci yïth päänye moe ni raanyge geni, ni ö wøpe moa teek ki leny ni nääi.
english: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Kar ränynyö mar Möap acäännö, ni beeye kanyo pïïc gïï mo lethi bääte.
english: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

anywaa: U ni karu cään ki Möap, u bëët ni wø ŋäc nyeŋŋe, uuno jwöŋi kiper Möap, ni kööu, na ‹Aŋø, teek Möap na caal athøya teek oränynyö nidïï, teega näk caala athøny ajiem jïre.›
english: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

anywaa: «Wui, u ni wø bëëdö Dibön, u ööa wøk ki kwör ajiem mou, ni bëëdu yi ŋöömö mo lïëth mo yie da riew. Kiper jøw raany pou ma Möap ööa kuna tukge uuni, ni raanyge kwör gwøk røk mou moa näk ogeerø ni teek.
english: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö ya Aröör, cuŋŋu deŋ jöö nou rääŋö, ni pëënynyu cwøw ki mään mo wø rïŋŋi, mo wø bøth ri leny, ni kööu, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na tägö?›
english: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?

anywaa: 'Ba mano løkge, ge köö, ni ‹Möap anyak, ni ö jiyi ni lää wïthge. Uuno jwöŋi ni gööu ko oduuru, ni gøøu gø piny bäät Naam Arnön bare ni Möap araanynyi.›
english: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

anywaa: «Ajäla öö bäät mïëya en yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, ni beege Olön, ki Jaca, ki Mëpät,
english: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath,

anywaa: ki Dibön, ki Nebø, ki Bëëth-Dibilatayim,
english: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth–diblathaim,

anywaa: ki Kiriatayim, ki Bëëth-Gamul, ki Bëëth-Miyön,
english: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth–gamul, and upon Beth–meon,

anywaa: ki Kiriöt, ki Bödhra, ki päänye bëët moa en yi ŋööm Möap, moa kwörge bäyö ki moa kwörge cärö.
english: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

anywaa: Möap tuge ocääny wøk, ni ö bääte ni tøyi.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Möap wär maathu ki køøŋø ni meere, kiper eni dëëre atïïe ni dwøŋ bääta, a na Wuuö Jwøk; Möap oŋïëli yïth ŋwøk moe, ni ö jiyi ni ŋïërge bääte.
english: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na Möap en, ï kär bëëdö niï ŋïërö bäät Icriel? ?Aŋø, ena mak dï kuuwe, ni tïme ni gïn wø caanï kipere, wïïï putï ka keny en?
english: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.

anywaa: «Wui, u ni jø Möap, päänye mou weyu wiiø ni cou ni bëëdu yïthakic kïte, ni bëëdu kaamar akuuru man wø geer øde deŋ dhi øt kïdi.
english: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.

anywaa: Gïr atöör mar Möap ŋäcwa; eni koorrø døc. Ni eni ŋäya dëëre keere ni eni töödö, ni dëëre ee tïŋ maal.
english: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, atöör mare ŋääa, 'ba bäŋ gïn mo duue, ni ŋwøc mare bäŋ gïn mo tïïe.
english: I know his wrath, saith the Lord; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper gïïögø bëët, cwïnya opädhi kiper Möap, ni jwöŋa kiperge bëët, ni kïmma kiper jøøa en Kir-Ërë.
english: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir–heres.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Cebama, aani, a jwöŋö kiperu, ni kaala mano jwöŋö kiper jø Jadher. Uuna bëëdö kaamar jaath mo olaak, mo bäädi moe opïï løø naam løøga, ni aacge ni pïïcge Jadhar. 'Ba jø wø raany paac uuno lemge, kaawat man wø lem nyïïjenni.
english: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.

anywaa: Otïmö ni bäŋ dïlweel mar met ec ki dwør met ec yïth pwöth Möap mo wø ciek ki cam mo päl; kwøŋ otïïa ni bäŋgø yïth dääk nyööbö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo nyööbö këët ki køøŋø mo kwöŋŋö ni yie met. 'Ba këël ge doo kwöŋŋö, kwöŋŋö marge patha mar met ec.
english: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.

anywaa: «Jø wø bëëdö Ëcbön ki jø wø bëëdö Eliyali ge göö ko oduuru ni döötge ena maal døc këël mano wïnye Jäc, ni täge ki Dhöär këël mano pïïe Örönaim ki Ëglat-Celicia, kiper pïï moa en yi waŋ Nimrim otal.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Möap mo wø cïpi ko olämme jï juu moge kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri, ni wø wääŋge jïge ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, raanynya raanynyø.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the Lord, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.

anywaa: «'Ba gïr jø wø bëëdö Kir-Ërë, ki dï Möap bäre, okïïna ki cwïnya kaamar ŋat wø jwøk jwøk thøø ko opelø, kiper jap kwärö moa jootge oränynyi.
english: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët obëëdö ni wïthge ogwäär wøk, ni jïëc tïkge olielø, ni ceŋge oŋarø ki gïï mo beth, ni keece ege kïth dëëtge na abïïe.
english: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

anywaa: Yïth uudi mo Möap bëët, ki kwör acooŋe moe, tïmö ni beeye oduuru keere noo wïnynyi, kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Möap nyadha nyadhø kaawat man wø nyath dak mo bäŋ ŋat mo many gø.
english: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «A teeŋ nyath mo nyïëdi nø noo nyath jø Möap ki gø! Na ateeŋ jwøk mo nyïëdi noo jwöŋ jiyi kipere! Jø Möap ŋäthge oløkge ki køør mano tïm wïthge ni laay, ni tïmge na gïr abuua, ni ö jiyi bëët mo wø bëëdö buutge ni tïm cwïnyge ni böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge.»
english: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, da jø leny mo öö mo läänna kuna tukge Möap, kaamar odhuuth mo bwöpe ee peerø mo läänna baŋ lääy.
english: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

anywaa: Päänye mo Möap omak ki tøŋ, ni mak kwör leny moe moa näk ogeerø ni teek. Dïcäŋöca cwïny otëëe mo Möap otïmö kaamar cwïny dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

anywaa: Möap oränynyi ni bëëde ni patha paac këët, kiper dëëre atïïe ni dwøŋ bääta, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Möap, gïï lwär, ki buur, ka abïëp ena nyïmmu.
english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Ŋato reŋi ni ŋwieya gïï lwär, pätha yi buur, noo ïnh wøk ki yi buur, omak abïëpi. Kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, gïï ii okäla bäät jø Möap yi cwiino jääla geni yie.
english: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Jø Möap moo reŋ Ëcbön, bäätge opädhi, kiper maac otägi ki Ëcbön, paana kwøŋ nyeya ma Cëëwönni bëëdö yie, ni thöör jø Möap, jø wø tïïc okiera.
english: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

anywaa: U na jø Möap, otïmö ni raac jïïu. Uuni ni wø lam Kemöc, uuno ränynyi, kiper wäätu ki nyïïu okïth paac mør ni mak ka tøŋ.
english: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne, bëët jø Möap ocäŋa dwøk kare.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki. Ajäla manøgø beeye mana ŋøl bäät Möap.
english: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the Lord. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Amön, ena köö, na «?Aŋø, Icriel bäŋ nyïïkwaaye? ?Aŋø, Icriel jïre bäŋ lwiidhi? ?Aperŋø nø na ö jø wø lam Milköm ni macge ŋööm Icriel mar jø tuuŋ Gaat en, ni bëëtge yïth päänye moe?
english: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the Lord; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö mo a na Wuuö Jwøk, a kännö ki jø leny mo ge ööi ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi, ni ge ööa kuna tukge Raaba, pääny mar jø Amön. Ni ö päänyögø ni ränynye ni needwöt, ni ö mïëri moa en deŋŋe ni waaŋi. Køøre Icriel ŋöömme olwøre ceŋ jøøa käl gø cere.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö Ëcbön, jwöŋu kiper Gaay aränynyö. Wui, u ni wø bëëdö Raaba, jwöŋu, ni kïthu keece dëëtu na abïïe, ni gööu ko oduuru, ni rïïŋu nou duda yi kiir; kiper jwøu ma Milköm okïth paac mør ni mak ka tøŋ, eni ki dïlämme moe ki jø wø tïny gø.
english: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.

anywaa: Wui, u na cwïnynyu ogaa wøk en, ni wø ŋääth jap kwärö mou ni kööu, na ‹?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man thunh baŋwa?› ?Aperŋø ni töödu kiper teek maru en, ni beeye teek mo døøa piny?
english: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a na wïth jammi bëët, a känna bäätu ki gïr lwär mo dwøŋ, mo öö ki løøi ki løøi. Uuno riem wøk ni bäŋ ŋat mo lwïthi ŋääe,  ni kanyo reŋu, bäŋ ŋat mo rwöp uuni kanya ciel.
english: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord God of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

anywaa: «'Ba køør manøce nø, jø Amön bëëtö marge ocäŋa dwøk kare.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, kiper Ëdöm, ena köö, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ jiy mo wïthge leer këët Tëman? ?Aŋø, pwöc atïmö ni bäŋgø baŋ jøøa nyeŋge reegø? ?A leec wïc marge aränynyö?
english: Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö Didan, u døøa ŋäthu, ni reŋu, ni kanu rou yïth uut kïte, kiper gïn mo leth mano käla bäätu, u na nyïïkwaac Icøø kanyo jääla nyïïkwaac Icøø bëët.
english: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

anywaa: Kany wø ö jiyi wø pønge nyïïjenni, ge wëëö ki mo thenh. Ni kany wø ö kuuwe ki wäär baŋ kwal, ge kwala mo wø manyge keerge.
english: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, nyïïkwaac Icøø loonya loonyø na bäre ni jaamma kwöro kange rege yïthge, nee ba lønye jïge ki man kange rege. Jøøa käl dëëre ki tuuŋge ki jiy moa en buutge oraanynyi, ni bäŋe wïïe mo kwøw këët.
english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

anywaa: Obwöre mou moo dööŋ piny na kïïe, gwøa gwøø ni bëëtge ni ge kwøw; ni ö määr thuunhnhi mou ni bëënge aani.»
english: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.

anywaa: Kiper man caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en: «?Ni näk mo jøøa näk athöönh ajäla ba dege maadhø, maathge maadhø, uuno kääŋu nidïï ni ba maathu? U mäthö, ni ba kääŋu ka ajäla.
english: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, aana kööŋ ŋëëta keera, ni Bödhra, pääny Ëdöm, oränynyi ni tïme na gïn mo cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëre, na gïr ajøøŋ, na gïr acïëni, ni ö päänye moe bëët ni nigeruuth na bäre bäre.»
english: For I have sworn by myself, saith the Lord, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

anywaa: Aani, da dwøl mo yaa wïnynyö baŋ Wuuö Jwøk; nyïïatwiel dagø mo ojääŋŋö baŋ wïth juurre, nee kööe, ni «Ööu maal baŋ leny, ni dwalu rou kanya ciel ni cou kuna tugu Ëdöm.»
english: I have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jï jø Ëdöm, ni «Ka adïëri møn, karu tïïa tïïö ni bäŋgø dï wïth juurre, ni ö jiyi ni taakge uuni.
english: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö yïthakic kïte, ni bäät thuuri moa bäyö you maaø, lwär mana lwäär uuni ki gø, ka atöör mana en cwïnynyu, wïthu amaaŋge. Këël kwör bëëte mou doo ena maal kaamar øt odhuuth, u 'duua pinyi en ki kaace.
english: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Ëdöm otïmö na gïn mo cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëre; ni ö jiyi bëët moo pöödhi ki buute ni thäŋ yïthge ni buuge gø kiper gïïa leth bëët noo pïï bääte.
english: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

anywaa: Teeŋ gïna tägö dëër Cødam ki Gømöra, ni ränyge ki mïëri moa kwörge cärö ki geni, tägö dëër Ëdöm, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie, ni bäŋ ŋat mo joot kaace.
english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, da jø leny mo öö kaamar ŋuu mo ö wøk ka yi lur Jördan, mo ööa yi ciel mo teek baŋ dïëk, ni ge ööa kuna tukge Ëdöm. Ki nyi kany mo thiinh, jø Ëdöm 'riema wøk ki køør gïno tïïc jøøgø, ni jëëta ki ŋato manynya jaak ni røønya gø kaace. ?Kiper aŋa ni röömi ki aani? ?Na aŋa ni kïth aani kar løøk? ?Na a kwääye mane ni løny jïre ki man pïëme  ki aani?
english: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wïnynyu gïno tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye acaara mare kiper gïno tïïe dëët jø wø bëëdö Tëman ki dï Ëdöm bäre: Ka adïëri møn, obwöre moa therø na en dïge otuut wøk, ni tïm cwïny jiy ni böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

anywaa: Kanyo päth Ëdömmi, piny puta tïmö ni kwanynyi ki dööt jiye. Oduuru mano gøøcge puta wïnyö bäät Naama Kwaar.
english: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jø leny öö ni läänna kuna tukge Bödhra kaamar odhuuth mo bwöpe ee peerø mo läänna baŋ lääy; ni dïcäŋöca cwïny otëëe mo Ëdöm otïmö kaamar cwïny dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.»
english: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Damacka, ena köö, ni «Jø Amath ki jø Arpat wïthge otïmö ni laay, kiper noo wïnyge waac mo reyø. Cwïnyge opädhi ni bëët cwïnyge ni ba pï piny kaamar naam mo yie da athaga.
english: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

anywaa: Jø Damacka bäätge opädhi, ni løkge ŋäthge ni reŋge. Cwïnyge obwøk, ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ ni mak geni, ki rääm mo caala rääm dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.
english: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

anywaa: Päänyögø, këël na bëëde ni nyeŋŋe owïnyö, ni ec met ki gø, ränynyö.
english: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wøpe moe opäänhnhi dï uutjïëthe moe, ni dït wïth jø lenynyi moe bëët dïcäŋöce;
english: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: ni nyeba kiir mar Damacka ki maac, ni ö uut paan dwøŋŋi mo Ben- Adat ni thööri ya maaci.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper Këdar ki mïëri moa en ya Adhör moa dïïm Nabukedenecörri nyeny Babiløn, ena köö, ni «U ööa maal, ni cou kuna tugu Këdar, nou raanynya jø wø bëëdö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the Lord; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

anywaa: Oduŋkaare ki dïëk moge okäl, ni käl gïïa en yïth oduŋkaare moge, ki jammi, ka athïrööle moge. Jiy okwöŋŋi bäätge ni köge, ni ‹Lwär mo dwøŋ piny apääŋe bäre.›
english: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

anywaa: «Wui, u ni jø Adhör, uuni, u bwøk, ni reŋŋu kany mo bäär, ni bëëdu yïth buri, kiper Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn anø cädö nee tïïe dëëtu ki gïn mo leth, ni beeye acaay aranya kiperu.
english: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na Nabukedenecör en, ï ööa maal, ni ciï baŋ jø wø bëëdö noo nikwak karge, jø wø bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn tägi rege. Geni, bäŋ kiir jïge mo dhøkge da dïdëëdi, ni ge bëëdö kur keerge.
english: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the Lord, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

anywaa: Athïrööle moge otwier, ni käl pïïth dhäk moge. 'Ba aani na Wuuö Jwøk, geni ni wø køc jïëc wïthge, ge keetha keethø kwör mo bäyö, ni känna bäätge ki gïï mo leth ki løøi ki løøi.
english: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Adhör otïmö na kar bëëtö mar othööe, ni bëëde noo ränynyö na bäre bäre, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie, ni bäŋ ŋat mo joot kaace.»
english: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Cëdëkiya na täge ki man bëëde ni ena nyeny Juuda, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma  Jeremaya kiper Ilam.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

anywaa: Ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, jø Ilam ni wø këëdi ka athëëre oraanynya, jø wø teek dï jø leny moge.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

anywaa: Aani, a kännö ki jø leny ma dhøgi aŋween mo tuga Ilam, mo ge öö kaamar atuunna, ni ge käla yïth akïï piny karge ŋweeni, ni keetha geni yïth kwörögø bëët. Ni tïme ni bäŋ po wï jur mo jøøa riem wøk ki Ilam ba ci yie.
english: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

anywaa: Aani na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Ilam cwïnyge owëëga bwøk nyïm nyïïmän moge, nyïm jø wø many jwïëcge; aano kän bäätge ki gïn mo leth ki køør wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac. Tøŋ ojääŋŋa køørge këël mano thööra geni.
english: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, saith the Lord; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

anywaa: Køøre aani na Wuuö Jwøk, wälu mara okëëlla piny Ilam, ni raanynya nyeya mare ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moe.
english: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne, bëët jø Ilam ocäŋa dwøk kare.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya kiper Babiløn, ni beeye ŋööm jø Kaldia, ena köö,
english: The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

anywaa: ni «Gøøu piny ni køpu gø jï wïth juurre bëët; køpu, ni tïŋu ŋïï maal; kär dee gïn kannu, kööu, ni ‹Babiløn omak ki tøŋ; jwøge ma Bël ni wø cwøl ni Merödak oränynyi ni tïme na gïn mo duua lään wïc, ni ö gïïa tieŋge ni wø lamge ni ränyge ni tïmge na gïï mo duua lään wïc.›
english: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

anywaa: Kiper wï jur mo käla jï løø wïpiny öö ni tuk Babiløn, ni raany ŋöömö mare bäre, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie. Jiy ki lääy bëët obwøk ni aacge.
english: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na yïth nïröke, yi kar kaace, jø Icriel oööi, geni ki jø Juuda bëët, ni ge cäädhi ni ge jwöŋö, ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, noo manyge.
english: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the Lord their God.

anywaa: Geni, jöör Dhayan opëënyge, ni løøge nyïmge yie, ni öge ni cïpge dëëtge jï Wuuö Jwøk ki køør luubö mano tuutge mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, mo wïc ba wïl ki gø.
english: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the Lord in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

anywaa: «Jiya atïmö kaamar dïëk mo orwäänyö. Gena bwøth dïkwääye moge ki jöö mo ogaa wøk, ni tïïcge geni nee wïïrge bäät kïte; ni thääcge bäät kïte ki bäät thuuri, ni wïl wïthge ki kar jwöm marge.
english: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

anywaa: Geni, gena thöör nyïïmänni moge bëët moa joot geni, ni kö nyïïmänni, ni ‹Wa kär bääyö kanya raanywa geni, kiper gena bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni wø joot adïëri baŋe, eni na Wuuö Jwøk na ŋääth kwäcge.›
english: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.

anywaa: «Uuni, u reŋŋa wøk dï Babiløn, ni weyu ŋöömmögø mar jø Kaldia; ni bwödhu maal kaamar nyöök atëëe ni wø kwøŋ bwödhö nyïm dïëk.
english: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, lwaa wïth juurre mo teek døc moa en wï-piny, yïthge otheŋa ni käla geni nee Babiløn tukge.  Ni cïïmge rege na dhøgi nee këëtge ki paanøgø, ni makge jiy kaace ki tøŋ ni kälge geni. Gena jiy mo nyeŋge reegø ki thöör ka athëëre, ni ge ba duui ki ceŋge jaak.
english: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

anywaa: ŋööm jø Kaldia otwier, ni ö jøw twier gø bëët ni rømge ki jammi. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jø Babiløn na twier jap jiya, u bëëdö ni yïthu met nou kanynyø; nou pärö kaamar nyirøøa mo bïëdö yi pwöla, nou kwöŋŋö kaamar thwønh okweeny mo teek.
english: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

anywaa: 'Ba kiper gïïa tïïyu yøø, pou ma Babiløn ni caal miiu na nywøl uuni, eno bëëdö ni wïïe laay ni bëët waŋe ni law. Ka adïëri møn, kare otïmö ni thiinh døc dï wïth juurre, ni tïme na paap ma tëën mo bäŋ gïn mo tuy yie.
english: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

anywaa: Ki køør wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk eni ba beet këët, 'ba eni ränynyö na bäre. Ni ö jø wø pöödhi ki buute ni thäŋ yïthge, ni buuge gø kiper gïïa leth bëët noo pïï bääte.
english: Because of the wrath of the Lord it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

anywaa: «U bëët ni wø thöödhö ka athëëre, dëëtu wär cïïmmu na dhøgi deŋ Babiløn bäre; ni thööyu jiye ka athëëre, ni bäŋe athëëre mo wiiyu, kiper jø Babiløn, gena bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.

anywaa: Uuno twäädu bääte kiper leny ni deŋŋe you wïrö bäre. Babiløn cere ocïbe, ni ö kwör koorri moe ni päthge, ni ö kiirri mare ni nyaai piny. Kiper manøgø beeye cuut kwör mar Wuuö Jwøk. Kwör wär coollu dëëre, ni tïïyu kaawat mana tïïe dëët jiy møøk.
english: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.

anywaa: Jø Babiløn wär raanynyu, nee bäŋe ŋat mo pïïdhö ki beel, ni bäŋ ŋat mo kääö ki beel. Jøøa path moo bëëdö kaace odøø baŋ jø poge, ni ŋati man nø reŋŋa yi ŋöömme, ni ge ŋwieya jø leny mo wø caan jiy.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

anywaa: «Jø Icriel akeeth nyïïmänni, kaamar dïëk mo okeeth ŋuuwi. Ŋata kwøŋ geni raanynyø beeye nyeny Aciria, ni ŋata näk aŋuudi na tøc cuuge beeye Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn.
english: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Ka adïëri møn, aani, nyeny Babiløn ki paac mare bäre jääla jäälö, kaawat mana jääla nyeny Aciria.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, jø Icriel oduua yi ŋöömö marge, ni bëëtge ni ge cama cam mano ciek bäät Kïn Karmël ki bäät Kïn Baacan, ki caammi moo ciek yi ŋööm Ipariem ki Gelät, mïëya en bäät thuuri.
english: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme ni yïth nïröke, yi kar kaace, gïïa bac jø Icrielli ki raay mo jø Juuda omanynyi, 'ba bäŋgø mo joot; kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk, geni noo wiia na moo dööŋ wëënna wëënnö.
english: In those days, and in that time, saith the Lord, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

anywaa: «U cøø ni tugu jø wø bëëdö Merathayim, ni cou ni tugu jø wø bëëdö Peköt. Geni wär 'nägu ni raanynyu geni na bäre, ni tïïyu ka køør gïïa köömma uuni ki ge bëët.
english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the Lord, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.

anywaa: Oduuc leny owïnyi dï paac bäre, ki ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

anywaa: Babiløn na bëëdö kaamar guduum na raany piny bäre, a teeŋ keethø mo nyïëdi nø noo keethe ki gø! Na a teeŋ ränynyö mo nyïëdi nø mano böö cwïny wïth juurre ki gø!
english: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

anywaa: Wui, ï na Babiløn, kanya bëëdï ni kuyï, a na Wuuö Jwøk, abïëp aciia kiperï, ni put ï mak. Ïïna joot ni mak ïïni, kiper ïïna bëëdö niï këëdö ki aani.
english: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk øt tøøk leny mare ajabe, ni käl tøøŋi wøk ni beeye wëër mare, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, da gïn mo tïïe tïïö dëët jø Babiløn.
english: The Lord hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord God of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

anywaa: U ni wø bëëdö kwöra bäyö, u cøøa kuna tugu Babiløn; odïï moe wär jaammu, ni cooŋŋu jape na athwöe, ni raanynyu eni na bäre. Kär dee gïn mo weyu jïre.
english: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

anywaa: Jø leny moe bëët wär 'nägu; geni wär 'nägu kiree! Otïmö ni raac jïge, kiper cäŋ marge aöö, ni beeye cäŋ ajäla mana wäŋŋi kiperge.»
english: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

anywaa: Dwøl owïnyi, ni beeye dööt jiy moo rïŋŋi noo päny wøk ki Babiløn, ni caange cuut kwör mar Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marø, yi Dhayan, ni beeye cuut kwör mar øtø mare.
english: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the Lord our God, the vengeance of his temple.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jø wø këëdi ka athëëre bëët wär cwøllu, nee öge ni ge thööth kuna tukge Babiløn. Twëëre mou wär tïïyu deŋ kiir mare bäre; kär dee ŋat mo päär wøk. Teeŋ gïna tïïe, coollu dëëre, ni tïïyu ka køør gïïa tïïe bëët; kiper dëëre atïïe ni dwøŋ bäät Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wøpe moe opäänhnhi dï uutjïëthe moe, ni dït wïth jø lenynyi moe bëët dïcäŋöce.
english: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wui, Babiløn, ï na paana bëëdö niï töödö, Ka adïëri møn, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, mare caane caanø dëërï, kiper cäŋ marï aöö, ni beeye kanya wäŋŋi noo jääl ïïni yie.
english: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord God of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.

anywaa: Ï na paac mo töödö en, tierï ocwanyï ni pädhï, ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïŋ ïïni maal; aani, päänye moï nyeba nyebø ki maac, ni ö maaci ni thöör gïïa en deŋge bëët thuwø.»
english: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, «Jø Icriel ki jø Juuda, gena bëëdö ni geno caarø, ni ge bëëdö ni geno koor jøøa mak geni ki tøŋ, ni kweer jøøgø ki man wecge geni nee aacge.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

anywaa: 'Ba dïkunyi marge teek, ni nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët. eno pïëmö døc kiperge, nee piny mooe ki jwöm; 'ba wïth jø Babiløn omooe ko okiera.
english: Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name: he shall thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

anywaa: «Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät jø Babiløn,  jø wø bëëdö dï Kaldia bäre, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø moe bëët!
english: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.

anywaa: Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät ajuuk mo wø køp luup tööt, ojoot møn ni gena bøøre! Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät jø leny moe moa teek, geni, cwïnyge obwøk!
english: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

anywaa: Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät okwëëc leny moe, ni räny jïëth lenynyi moe mo wø tut okwëënyi! Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät jø leny moa path moa en yie, geno tïmö kaamar mään! Ajäl thøw tøŋ oen bäät jape moa perge leth, ge di twierø!
english: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

anywaa: Ajäl meel opïï yi ŋöömö mare bäre, pï näm moe otal! Kiper beeye paac mo bëënna juu mo otieŋø, ni wø bøøl ri juu mo otieŋø ni wø duu lwär.
english: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, cwëënyi ko odïï bëët obëëdö kaace, ni ö ude thuwø ni bëëtge yie. Ni eni ba beet këët na bäre bäre, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie këël yïth beenhnhe bëët.
english: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

anywaa: Teeŋ gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëër Cødam ki Gømöra, ni ränyge ki mïëri moa kwörge cärö ki geni, tägö dëër Babiløn; ni bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie, ni bäŋ ŋat mo joot kaace. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, da wï jur mo öö ki wï-piny, ni beeye wï jur mo teek ki nyeye mo thööth mo yïthge otheŋø mo käla kany mo bäär.
english: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba ceŋge da athëëre ki tøøŋi. Gena jiy mo 'näk marge raac døc, ni cwïnyge ba pädhi ki 'näk dhaanhø, ni döötge lwör ni caala pï naama dwøŋ. Ge cäädhi ka bäät okwëënyi, ni dëëtge ege täärö kiper leny, ni ge ööa kuna tukge ïïni, ï na Babiløn.
english: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

anywaa: Nyeny Babiløn gïna caan kiper jø leny moøgø awïnynye, ni ö bääte ni pädhe; ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ ni mak eni, ki rääm mo caala rääm dhaagø mo ree da mäc lwaar.
english: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, da jø leny mo öö kaamar ŋuu mo ö wøk ka yi lur Jördan, mo ööa yi ciel mo teek baŋ dïëk, ni ge ööa kuna tukge Babiløn. Ki nyi kany mo thiinh, jø Babiløn 'riema wøk ki køør gïno tïïc jøøgø, ni jëëta ki ŋato manynya jaak, ni røønya gø kaace. ?Kiper aŋa ni röömi ki aani? ?Na aŋa ni kïth aani kar løøk? ?Na a kwääye mane ni løny jïre ki man pïëme ki aani?
english: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wïnynyu gïno tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye acaara mare kiper gïno tïïe dëët jø Babiløn, yi ŋööm Kaldia bäre. Ka adïëri møn, obwöre moa therø na en dïge otuut wøk, ni tïm cwïny jiy ni böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge.
english: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

anywaa: Kanyo kwöŋ jiyi, ni ‹Babiløn amak ki tøŋ,› piny puta tïmö ni kwanynyi, no oduuru mano gøøcge puta wïnyö yïth mïëc wïth juurre.»
english: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, jø wø räänyö yïthge otheŋa, ni öge kaamar atuunna ni raanyge Babiløn, po jø Kaldia.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

anywaa: Aani, jiy mo path ojääŋŋa Babiløn, nee jø Babiløn køølge wøk, ni raanyge ŋöömge. Geni, Babiløn otukge ki løøi ki løøi, kanyo tïme na cäŋ gïna leth na wäŋŋi kipere.
english: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

anywaa: Jiye mo wø thöödhö ka athëëre wär riigu nee ba thööthge, nee abïïk nywïëny mo leny moge ba røøge dëëtge. Kär nou weya wøpe moe moa teek ki leny; dïïrru wïth jø leny moe bëët.
english: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.

anywaa: Geno nääŋŋi ni päänhge yi ŋööm Kaldia, ni cööp geni ki tøøŋi dï uutjïëthe moe.
english: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel ki jø Juuda kär kwier Jwøge ma Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, këël na bëët ŋööm Babilønni man bëëtge yie en ni päŋ ki raay mo di temmø nyïm Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.

anywaa: «U na jø Icriel, uuno reŋŋu wøk yi Babiløn, ni ŋati man nø gwøga jwïëye. Kär wïthu wëëgu dïdö ki køør ajäla mare, kiper manøgø beeye kar cuut kwör mar Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa bac jø Babilønni dwøge dëëtge.
english: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the Lord's vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

anywaa: Babiløn abëëdö ni ena cer Wuuö Jwøk kaamar ogubany warkey mar ajäla, na wëëk bäät piny bäre meerø. Eni, wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny amaadhe ki køøŋ ogubanynyøgø ni meerge, ni putge bëëdö kaamar bøøre.
english: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

anywaa: Ki nyi kany mo thiinh, Babiløn opädhi ni ränynye; uuni, uuno jwöŋu kipere! Ni kännu ki jaath kiper ŋwiili moe; kanymør ŋwiili moe caŋŋø.
english: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

anywaa: «'Ba jiy okööi, na ‹Apäärø ki man kønyø Babiløn, 'ba ŋwiili moa pïï dëëre ba løny ki køny këët. Wiiø eni, ni ö ŋati man nø dïïø ni aa poge, kiper ajäla mar Babiløn dwøŋ døc noo këët maal, noo këët maal nyeŋ pøøl.
english: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

anywaa: « ‹Anyooth Wuuö Jwøki ni bäŋ ajäla bäätø; ööu, waa døø pøø ma Dhayan ni caanø gïna tïïc Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marø.›
english: The Lord hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.

anywaa: «Athëëre mou wär paagu, ni pääŋŋu yïth købe ki geni. Wuuö Jwøk yïth nyeye mo Mëdön anø theŋe, kiper acaara mare beeye ki man raany Babiløn. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk cudö ki kwör, ni beeye cuut kwör mar øtø mare.
english: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the Lord hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the Lord, the vengeance of his temple.

anywaa: Ŋïï wär tïŋu maal nou tugu kiir Babiløn; koor wär tïïyu ni teek døc; ni cïïmmu jiy mo rääŋö, ni ö jiyi møøk ni møørge piny. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk acaara mare wëëge thur kare, ni beeye gïna näk ee nø ŋøl ni tïïe tïïö dëër Babiløn.
english: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the Lord hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

anywaa: «Wui, Babiløn, ï na en bäät näm mo thööth, ï na näk jïrï da jap kwärö mo thööth, aŋuudi marï aöö, ni beeye cuŋ bëëtö marï.
english: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena nø kööŋ ŋëëte keere,    ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, jø leny mo thööth mo caala lwaa bäänyö ojääŋŋa bäätï, ni kwöŋge bäätï kanyo böötge ïïni.› »
english: The Lord of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.

anywaa: Beeye Wuuö Jwøk na cwääc piny ki teek mare, ni tïïc gø ni teek ki køør leec wïc mare, ni peer maal ki køør acaara mare.
english: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

anywaa: Kany wø tuk dhee, maal puta märö kaamar køth. Pøøl wø kööle köölö ki ya aŋuun piny, ni käl køth ni mal, ni wëëk jamø kwön wøk ki yïth kwöra kan geni yïthge.
english: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët bëëdö ni wïthge bäŋ acaare, ni bäŋ gïn ŋäcge. Rëëm warkie, wïthge olää juuwi moa thiiwge, kiper juu moa thiiwge beege jap cwøk jaak, ni rege bäŋ jwïëy.
english: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

anywaa: Geno oballe jaak, ni gena gïï mo di päädö; kanyo tïme na cäŋ ajäla mana wäŋŋi kiperge, ge ränynyö.
english: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Jwø Jeekap ba caal gïïögø, kiper bee eni na tïïc jammi bëët, na cwääc jiye, ni beege thööge ma jø Icriel. Eni nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the Lord of hosts is his name.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ï na Babiløn en, ïïna tïïa ni ïïna guduum mara na gïr leny mara; beeye ïïni na raanynya wïth juurre ki riï, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya akwöm mo nyeye ki riï.
english: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;

anywaa: Beeye ïïni na raanynya okwëënyi ki riï, ki jø wø cäädhi ki bäätge, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi ki riï, ki jø wø cäädhi ki yïthge.
english: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

anywaa: Beeye ïïni na raanynya cwøw ki mään ki riï, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya jäle ko obwöre ki riï, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya wøpe ki nyïïakuue ki riï.
english: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

anywaa: Beeye ïïni na raanynya dïkwääc dïëk ki riï, ki pïïth dïëk moge, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya jø puur ki riï, ki dhää puur moge, ni beeye ïïni na raanynya kwääri ki riï, ki jø kööre moge.
english: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

anywaa: «'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, jø Babiløn, ni beege jø Kaldia, gïïa reyø na tïïcge dëëtu, u na jø Dhayan, 'dwøga dëëtge ni nëënö jïïu ki nyeŋŋu.
english: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Wui, Babiløn, ï na teek kaamar kïdi, na raany piny bäre; ka adïëri møn, a na Wuuö Jwøk, mara caana caanø dëërï, ni bëët cera ni ena dëërï, ni ŋïëla ï piny ki bäät kïdi, ni wëëga ï waaŋ ni tïmï na bur.
english: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.

anywaa: Kanyo ränynyï, bäŋ kïdi mo dööŋ mo jiy cäŋa gëëdö ki gø, kiper ï ränynyö na bäre bäre. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Ŋïï mar leny wär tïŋu maal dï paac, ni koothu tuuŋ nee wïny wïth juurre; wïth juurre wär jiiŋŋu kiper leny nee Babiløn tukge, ni cwøllu akwöm mo nyeye ni beege Ararat ki Minni ka Ackena, nee këëtge ki Babiløn. Uuno röönyö ki kwääc leny mo këëdi ki Babiløn,  ni kännu ko okwëënyi mo leny mo thööth mo caala lwaa bäänyö.
english: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

anywaa: Wïth juurre wär jiiŋŋu kiper leny nee Babiløn tukge, ni beege nyeye mo jø Mëdön, ki kwääri ki jø kööre moge, ki mïëri bëët moa en tietge.
english: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

anywaa: Piny otïmö ni kwanynyi ni jäŋŋi, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, gïna näk ee caarø ni tïïe tïïö dëër Babiløn bëëdö kare, ni beeye ki man raany ŋööm Babiløn, nee bäŋe jiy mo bëëdö yie.
english: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the Lord shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

anywaa: Jø leny moa teek mo Babiløn leny owecge, ni bëëtge ni ge kaanna rege kwör gwøk røk moa teek; teek marge othum, ni tïmge kaamar mään; kwör bëëte moge onyep ki maac, ni ö dïdëëdi mo dhøk kiir mare ni tøyi.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

anywaa: Ŋat wø rïïŋi nee gïna tägö købe, oreŋi ni caan gø jï ŋat ŋwïëy maya, ni ö nyïïatwielli ni reeŋe ni caan gø jï nyïïatwiel maya, nee lunyge caan jï nyeny Babiløn, ni ‹Pääny marï amak bäre.
english: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

anywaa: Dhøk wäädhi mo wø kaath ki piny amak, ni nyepge luum man wø kan røk yie, ni bëët jø lenynyi ni cwïnyge böö.›
english: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

anywaa: Kiper luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en: Babiløn otïmö kaamar laara mo opuuö; ki kany mo thiinh, eno kaa piny kaamar beel.»
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

anywaa: Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn powa ma Jerucalem acame, ni raany gø; ni wec gø ni bäŋ gïn mo odööŋ yie, ni bëëde kaamar dak mo yie ŋaam. Jerucalem aløønye kaawat man wø tïïc nyäällö, ni pääŋ yie ki jap gø moa perge leth, ni gøøp yi gø døøc.
english: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.

anywaa: Jø powa ma Dhayan, ni beege jø Jerucalem, ge cäänö, ni «Beerra man ö gïna lethi na tïïc dëëtwa ni tïï dëër Babiløn, ni beerra man ö kwör remø marwa ni en bäätge, geni na jø Kaldia.»
english: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, u cwaa cwaaø, ni coola kwör maru na kare. Aani, naam mar Babiløn otaala, ni bäŋe kany jïtge yie ki pïï.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

anywaa: Babiløn oränynyi ni needwöt, ni tïme na kar bëëtö mar othööe, na gïr abuua, ni tïm cwïny jiy ni böö ki gïno tägi dëëre, ni bäŋ jiy mo bëëdö yie.
english: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

anywaa: Jø Babiløn olööri kaamar ŋuuwe, ni ŋärge kaamar nyïï ŋuuwe.
english: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.

anywaa: 'Ba noo daatge cwïnyge kiper cam, ge nyöömma nyöömmö ki køøŋø, ni maadha geni ni meerge ni mïn yïthge, ni butge ki niine mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni geni ba päy këët.
english: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Ge peea baŋ ŋaal kaamar nyïïdïëk, kaamar nyöök rööm ki nyöök atëëe.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

anywaa: «Cëcak, ni beeye Babiløn, a teeŋ mäk mo nyïëdi nø noo maai ki gø ki tøŋ,  paana pwøc pinynyi bäre! Na a teeŋ böö mo nyïëdi nø noo böö cwïny wïth juurre ki gø ki gïno tägi dëëre!
english: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

anywaa: Jø leny öö bäät Babiløn kaamar naam mo kwödö døc, ni macge gø kaamar jwïëö.
english: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

anywaa: Päänye moe otïmö ni cwïny jiy böö ki gïno tägi dëëtge, ni tïm ŋöömö mare na paap ma tëën, na ŋöömö mo bäŋ ŋat mo bëëdö yie, na kany mo bäŋ dhaanhø mo cør yie.
english: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.

anywaa: Ni jääla jwøge ma Bël Babiløn, ni tïïa eni nee gïïa løønye ŋöö wøk. Ni tïme ni bäŋ wïth juurre mo cøøa baŋe këët. Këëlla kiir Babiløn na teek døc opädhi.
english: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

anywaa: «U na jiya, uuno aa wøk dï Babiløn, ni ŋati man nø gwøga jwïëye, ni ŋwieya wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk noo liel kaamar maac.
english: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.

anywaa: Uuni, kär cwïnynyu bwøk, ni ba lwäyu ka akøpi mo wø cari yi ŋöömmi en, ni beeye akøpi mo wø cari ni da gïn mo tägö yi cwiir man, ni cwiino ööi, poot da akøpi mo di carø. Ni ö ŋöömmi bäre ni jïte ko okiera, ni kwäärö man nø këëdö ki kwäärö maya.
english: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

anywaa: «'Ba ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo juu moa näk otieŋø Babiløn raanynya raanynyø, ni ö paaci bäre ni lää wïïe, ni bëët jiyi moo 'näk no opäänhnhö dïëre.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

anywaa: 'Ba maal ki piny ki gïïa en yïthge bëët okwöŋŋi bäät Babiløn ni yïthge met; kiper jø aranya öö ki jï løø wïpiny ni tukge gø. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, Babiløn na 'näk jø bäät piny, oränynyi thuwø kiper jø Icriel moa nääe.
english: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

anywaa: U na jiya, u na bøth dhi tøŋ, u aay! Kär nou bëëdö Babiløn! 'Ba bëëdu nou lääŋŋa aani na Wuuö Jwøk këël na enu kany mo bäär ki Jerucalem, ni bëëdu nou caara gïre.
english: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the Lord afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

anywaa: «U wø köö, ni ‹Wïthwa alääö kiper ajøøŋ man wø wïnywa, ni tïm nyeŋwa ni law, kiper jiy mo path adøny kwöra en kur keerge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the Lord's house.

anywaa: «'Ba ka adïëri møn, da nïne mo öö, mo juu moa näk otieŋø Babiløn raanynya raanynyø, ni ö jiyi bëët moa näk dëëtge da ŋwiit tøŋ yi ŋöömö bäre ni bëëtge ni ge cooyø.
english: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

anywaa: Kiir Babiløn, këël na bëëde no ogeerø no opïï maal kuya, ni tïïc kwör leny moe ni teek døc, jø wø räänyö ge poot jääŋŋa jääŋŋö ni cige baŋe.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Oduuru owïnyi ki Babiløn, yi ŋööm Kaldia, ni beeye oduuc ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk räänyö ki Babiløn, ni ö dïlweelli mare ni neebäc; jø leny oööi kaamar naam mo kwödö døc, ni ge ööi ni döötge wïnyö kany mo bäär.
english: Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:

anywaa: Kiper geni ni wø räänyö ööa kuna tukge Babiløn, ni ö jø lenynyi moe moa teek ni maai ki tøŋ, ni ö athëëre moge ni tøyi; kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk mo cudö ki kwöri, ni kwöri di coolø na kare.
english: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.

anywaa: Nyeya na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Aani, jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø moe ki jøøa nyeŋge reegø moe omaadha ki køøŋø ni meerge, ni bee geni ki kwääri ki jø kööre ki jø leny moa teek, ni butge ki niine mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni geni ba päy këët.»
english: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye en, ena köö, ni «Kiir Babiløn na näk odhïŋ onyaa piny na bäre, ni ö odhuule mo dhøk kiirri moe na bäyö ni nyebi ki maac. Ni ö öölö mar jiy ni cami ya paapi, ni ö öölö mar wïth juurre ni pwøyi ya maaci.»
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ceraya o Neriya nyikwaar Maciya na aacge ki Cëdëkiya nyeny Juuda ni ge cøøa Babiløn ri ŋweer cwiiri moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeya, nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya acïpö ki dwøl jï Ceraya. Kar kaace Ceraya beeye nyikugö.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl manøgø beeye luum gïïo leth bëët noo tägi dëër Babiløn na näk ogöör Jeremaya piny yi wëëlö, ni beege luupa gööre bëët kiper Babiløn.
english: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.

anywaa: Ni kö Jeremaya jï Ceraya, ni «Kanyo pïïyï Babiløn, luupi bëët ii wär kwaanï nyïm jiy nee wïnyge,
english: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;

anywaa: ni kööï, ni ‹Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, ïïna cäänö kiper paani en ni raanynyï raanynyø, ni tïme ni bäŋ gïn mo bëëdö yie, dhaanhø wala lääy, 'ba otïmö na paac mo oränynyö na bäre bäre.›
english: Then shalt thou say, O Lord, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo lønyï ki kwaan wëëlö nø, dëëre wär töönynyï ki kïdi, ni leeŋï gø dï Naam Upareeti,
english: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:

anywaa: ni kööï, ni ‹Babiløn odøny piny kaamar wëëlö manøgø na nilïŋ enø, ni ö eni ni ba duu maal këët, ki køør gïïo leth moo kïtha bääte.› » Man beeye aŋuun luup Jeremaya.
