english: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

anywaa: 'Ba Cëdëkiya kanya tïme na nyeya, cwiic dööŋö moe pïërariiø kurciel, ni bëëde ni ena nyeya ki cwiiri apaar kurciel yi Jerucalem. 'Ba nyeŋ menni beeye Amutal nyi Jeremaya nyï Libana.
english: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

anywaa: 'Ba ena bëëdö ni tïïya gïï mo nëëni ni reyø ki jï Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat moa tïïc Jeyöakëmmi.
english: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the Lord, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ki køør gïïa reyø moa tïïc jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre, Wuuö Jwøk awëër ki geni ni riem geni wøk nyïme. 'Ba Cëdëkiya agëëmö ki nyeny Babiløn.
english: For through the anger of the Lord it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïŋweer cwiiri moa beede ni ena nyeya, kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar na apaar, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn ki jø leny moe bëët aö töök Jerucalem, ni tïïe ki twïër töök gø, ni tïïc kwör koor töök gø bäre.
english: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.

anywaa: Ni bëët päänynyi no ociel dïër këël mana këët ri cwiiri apaar kurciel moa beet Cëdëkiya ni ena nyeya.
english: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

anywaa: 'Ba yi cwiinøgø, kanya tïm nïr dwää aŋweenni na abïŋween, käc atïmö ni dwøŋ døc yi pääny, ni tïme ni bäŋ cam jï jiy.
english: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

anywaa: Køøre kiir mar pääny atuc jø  Babilønni. Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët mo Juuda ni bwøkge ki wäär ni putge døny wøk ni ge cøra dhi kiir mana en yïthakic kiiri moa na ariiø na en buut ajïniin nyeya, këël na bëëde ni jø Babiløn pääny ege ciel dïër bäre; ni aacge ni ge coonya goor Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba.
english: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.

anywaa: 'Ba jø leny mo jø Babiløn aläp køør nyeya ma Cëdëkiya, ni maage gø pwöl Jerikö, ni keeth jø lenynyi moe bëët buute.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

anywaa: Køøre ena makge ni kälge eni Ribala päänya en yi ŋööm Amath, baŋ nyeny Babiløn, ni ö nyeny Babilønni ni ŋut bäät gø ki luubö.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn wäät Cëdëkiya anääe nyïm gø ni nëënö jïre, ni ö eni thuwø ni 'näk jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø bëët mo Juuda kaace Ribala.
english: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn nyeŋ Cëdëkiya atuunynye, ni twöc gø ko oguut jwëëlli, ni kïth gø Babiløn ni kïth gø øt twöc, ni bëëde kaace këël aŋuun thøø mare.
english: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri cwiiri apaar ka abïŋween moa beet Nabukedenecörri ni ena nyeny Babiløn, kanya tïm nïr dwää abïïc na apaar, Nabucaradan kwääy jø koor, mo tïïö tier nyeny Babiløn, aö Jerucalem.
english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzar–adan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,

anywaa: Ni waaŋ Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki paan dwøŋ mar nyeya, ki uudi moa en Jerucalem bëët, këël uudi moa døøŋŋø bëët awaaŋe thuwø.
english: And burned the house of the Lord, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:

anywaa: Ni ö jø lenynyi bëët mo jø Babiløn moa käär kwääy jø koorri ni toorge kiir piny bäre mar Jerucalem.
english: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.

anywaa: Ni ö Nabucaradanni kwääy jø koor ni käl jø møøk moa can døc, ki jiy møøk moa dööŋ dï pääny, ki jiy moa cïp ceŋge jï nyeny Babiløn, ki rëëmme moa näk odööŋ, ni ge maae ka tøŋ.
english: Then Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabucaradan kwääy jø koor, jiy møøk moa can døc na en yi ŋöömmögø awiie na jø piith omøki na jø puur pwöth.
english: But Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël na en yi øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni beege gïïa näk caala dïkweeye, ki jïëthe mo wø käär pïï ki geni, ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, atøc jø lenynyi mo Babiløn na thäŋi, ni kïthge nywïëny moøgø bëët na jwëëlli yøø Babiløn.
english: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the Lord, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the Lord, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.

anywaa: Ni kälge jammi møga moa näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni beege athääe, ka akaape, ki gïï wø 'näk mäc lambae ki geni, ki kuure, ka apät, ki jap paac møga bëët mo wø tïïö ki geni Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø koor, jammi moa näk tïïc ka warkey mo tøŋ ki gwel-bïrö mo tøŋ 'akäle, ni beege cäänne, ka athääe mo wø käär mäc ki geni, ki kuure, ki dhiithe, ki gïï wø cïp lambae bäätge, ka apät, kö ogubääye mo wø thii køøŋø piny ki geni.
english: And the basins, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa na ariiø na näk caala dïkweeye, ki gïr pïï mana dwøŋ, ki gïï ma apaar kurriiø mo otïïö na dhäk ma rwädhe mo tïïc ka jwïël, mo gïr pïï mana dwøŋ ocïp bäätge, ki jïëthe mo wø käär pïï ki geni moa tïïc nyeya ma Cølöman kiper Øt Wuuö Jwøk, peek nywïënyö mana näk jwïël mana tïïc geni bëët ki gø ba løny ki røm.
english: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø ni caal dïkweeye yøø, bär mar man nø beeye gööye apaar ka abära, ni mar dööŋ dëëre beeye gööye apaar kurriiø, no odhïŋ mare beeye lweedi aŋween, ni yie ŋaam.
english: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï mïërö mo tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël moa kïth wïth gïïögø ni caal dïkweeye yøø, bär mar man nø beeye gööye abïïc. Ni dëëtge okïthö ki tiimme mo odwøø na jap mïërö, ni gïï mo caala nyïïadikwäle omun dëët gïï mïërö moøgø na jwëëlli yøø, no ocaanø ki deŋŋe bäre.
english: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïadikwäle moøgø moa näk nëënö bäät gïï mïërö man nø beege pïërabïŋween ka abïciel, 'ba kwään nyïïadikwäle bëët moa näk ocaanø bäät gïï mïërö man nø beege dïpa.
english: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.

anywaa: 'Ba Nabucaradan kwääy jø koor, Ceraya na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Jepaniya dïlämi mana en køøre, ki jiy adäk moa koor dhi Øt Wuuö Jwøk amaae ki tøŋ.
english: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni mak ŋat köör aciel man wø raŋ jø leny, ki jiy abïriiø mo wø køny nyeya ka acaare  moa joot yi pääny, ki ŋat wø gööt piny ki luup jï kwääy lwaa leny man wø kïth jiy yi dëëc paanøgø, ki jø paanøgø ma pïërabïciel moa joot yi päänyögø.
english: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.

anywaa: Ni ö Nabucaradanni kwääy jø koor ni lwør jøøgø ni kïth geni Ribala baŋ nyeny Babiløn.
english: So Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny Babiløn jøøgø anääe Ribala, päänya en yi ŋööm Amath. Manøgø beeye jöö mana ö jø Juuda ni käl ge yi ŋöömö marge ni ge mak ki tøŋ.
english: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

anywaa: 'Ba moi beege kwään jø Juuth moa mak Nabukedenecörri ki tøŋ: Jiy moa käle ri bïriet cwiiri moa beede ni ena nyeya beege kume adäk ki pïërariiø kurdäk.
english: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:

anywaa: Ni jiy moa käle Jerucalem kanya tïm cwiic nyeci moe na apaar ka abära beege dïpe abära ki pïëradäk kurriiø.
english: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:

anywaa: Ni kanya tïm cwiic nyeci moe na pïërariiø kurdäk, Nabucaradan kwääc jø koor akädö ki jø Juuth ma dïpe abïriiø ki pïëraŋween kurbïïc. 'Ba kwään jiy bëët moa käl beege kume aŋween ki dïpe abïciel.
english: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiiri na pïëradäk ka abïriiø moa mak Jöakin nyeny Juuda ki tøŋ yie na kïthi Babiløn, kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar kurriiø ni pïërariiø kurbïïc, Ëwil-Merödak nyeny Babiløn mëër mare anyoodhe jï Jöakin nyeny Juuda ni pät gø øt twöc. 'Ba gïnögø atïïe yi cwiina tïme yie ni ena nyeya.
english: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evil–merodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,

anywaa: Ni cääne ki luubö mo beer ki gø, ni tïïc wälu mare ni pöödha eni ki mo nyeye møga moa bëëdö ki eni Babiløn.
english: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

anywaa: 'Ba Jöakin abïïe moa en dëëre øt twöc awiile, ni bëëde ni cämö buut nyeya cooth ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët,
english: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.

anywaa: ni bëët cammi mare mar yi cäŋ cooth ni cïpa nyeny Babiløn jïre ki yïth nïr kwøw moe bëët këël dïcäŋa thøøe yie.
english: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

anywaa: Wui, pääny Jerucalem adööŋ keere nø, eni na bëëdö ni yie päŋ ki jiy! Ena dööŋ keere kaamar cï thøø, eni na bëëdö na pääny mo dwøŋŋa eni dï wïth juurre! Eni na bëëdö ni kare dwøŋ dï mïëri, ena tïmö na laŋ tïïc!
english: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

anywaa: Eni jwöŋi ni keeya yie ki wäär cooth, ni bëët pï nyeŋŋe ni muulö ki pïte. Eni bäŋ cøm cwïny mo joode baŋ mïëri moa mëëre ki ge, ena nøøn mïëri bëët moa näk ee døøc nyïïawääte, ni tïmge na nyïïmän moe.
english: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

anywaa: Juuda amak ki tøŋ ni bëëde ki bëëtö mo leth ki tïïc mo teek, ni bëëde yïthakic wïth juurre, ni bäŋ kany jwöm ree yie. Ena mak jøøa ŋwiec køøre bëët, kanya bëëde ni bäŋ jöö mo cøre.
english: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

anywaa: Nyeŋ jïëthe mo Dhayan bëëdö ni kïmmö, kiper bäŋ jiy mo cur yïthge mo wönnö ka ajwöm. Dhøk kiir moe bëët oränynyö, ni bëët dïlämme moe ni ge jwöŋö, ni ö nyïïakuue moe ni bëëtge ni ge kïmmö, ni ö eni ni bëëde ni keeya yie.
english: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

anywaa: Nyïïmän moe atïmö na kwääri bääte, ni tïm nyïïmänni moøgø ni bëëtö marge jööt jaak. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk beeye na tïïc caarø mar gø kiper raay moe na thööth. Obwöre moe amak ki tøŋ, ni bëëtge na laaŋe jï nyïïmän.
english: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the Lord hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

anywaa: Ajiem kwär mar Dhayan bäre aränynyö. Kwääri moe atïmö kaamar röönne mo kär jïtö ki kany cämge yie ki luum. Gena rïïŋö ni bäŋ teek dëëtge nyïm jøøa ŋwiec køørge.
english: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

anywaa: Jerucalem yïth nïr beede na nïr caarø ii ki nïr thääyö wïïe di parø ki bëëtö mare na beer na beede yïth nïra dïkwøŋ. Kanya päth jiye cer nyimän, bäŋ ŋat mo køny eni. Ena raŋ nyïïmänni moe, ni ŋeethge ki gïr ränynyö mare.
english: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

anywaa: Jerucalem atïïö ki raay mo døøŋŋø døc ni put tïmö ni ba waany. Ena jar jøøa wøør eni bëët, kiper mana jootge gø ni bëëdö ka dëëre. Këël eni ki dëëre, ena cooyø ni wïïe ee løø wøk.
english: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

anywaa: Gïna tïïc gø ni ba waany nëënö dëër abïïne, 'ba eni kär cädö kiper yi nyïme. Ena pädhö ki pädhö mo thääŋa ec, ni bäŋ ŋat moo cøm cwïnye. Ni kööe, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, neen caarø mara, kiper nyimän mara böödö eni.»
english: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.

anywaa: Nyimän cere akïth baŋ jammi mo Jerucalem moa perge leth. Eni na Jerucalem wïth juurre ajoode ni dønynya kuna tukge øt lam mare na en kur keere, jøøa kööm Wuuö Jwøki ni kärge døny ya acooŋ jiye.
english: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

anywaa: Jiy moe bëët cooyø ni ge manynya cam, ni wiilge japge moa perge leth ki cam, nee bëëtge ni ge kwøw. Ni köge, ni «Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, neenï, ni raŋï gø, kiper waano jarø jaak.»
english: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Lord, and consider; for I am become vile.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, u ni wø pöödhi ki buuta en, ki jïïu ni man beeye gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak? Neennu, ni raŋŋu gø, ?aŋø, da teeŋ caarø mo otïïö mo caala mara man no otïïö dëëra en, ni beeye mana tïïc Wuuö Jwøki dëëra yi cäŋ wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac?
english: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

anywaa: «Eni maac ajääŋŋe ki maal, ni jääŋ gø yïth cuu 'moa. Eni thøøl aciie kwör tieta, ni tïïc aani naa duua ŋääa, ni tïïc aani naa ränynya, naa tuu ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

anywaa: «Raay 'moa na peek kaamar jaath Puur  man wø jøøny ŋut rwaath ee kut piny, ni ee twöö na aciel. Ge bëëdö ni geno pïï ŋuta, ni ö eni ni raany teek dëël mara. Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aana cïp ceŋ jiy maa a ba løny ki cuŋŋö nyïmge.
english: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

anywaa: «Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, jø leny moa teek yi paac man akwiere; ni cwøl jø leny møøk kipera, nee jø leny 'moa moa dëëtge teek nyathge. Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk jø Juuda atïïe nee cwöth kaawat man wø cwöth nyïïomøki kar biic.
english: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

anywaa: «Kiper gïïögø bëët, a bëëdö naa jwöŋö, ni nyeŋŋa kwödö ki pïï, kiper bäŋ ŋat mo cøma cwïnya mo kare cään, mo dwøga jwïëy 'moa kare. Obwöre 'moa ŋäädhe marge aränynyö, kiper nyïïmän gena böödö.»
english: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

anywaa: Dhayan ceŋŋe athaaŋ maal, 'ba bäŋ ŋat moo cøm cwïnye. Wuuö Jwøk dwøre acïbe kipere, eni na po Jeekap, ki man tïm jøøa en deŋŋe na nyïïmän moe. Jerucalem atïmö na pääny mo ba waany yïthakicge.
english: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

anywaa: «Wuuö Jwøk mare beeye adïëri, kiper aana bëëdö naa gëëmö ki ciik moe. U na wïth jiy bëët, ennø, wïnynyu, ni neennu gïïa leth na jwøra. Jø leny 'moa moa dëëtge teek ki nyïïakuue 'moa, amak ki tøŋ.
english: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

anywaa: «Aani, mïëri moa mëëra ki ge acwøla, 'ba gena tïmö ni marge nøøn aani. Dïlämme 'moa ki jäle 'moa gena thum yi pääny, kanya bëëtge ni ge määnyö ki cam man bëëtge ni ge kwøw ki gø.
english: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

anywaa: «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, neenï, a ena yïth gïï mo leth. Jwïëya bëëdö ni kïmmö døc, ni bëët cwïnya no opädhö, kiper aana bëëdö naa gëëmö døc. Opëëllö bëëdö ni nääö wøk nyeŋ jïëthe, ni bëët yïth uudi na thøø keere.
english: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

anywaa: «Jiy awïnyge naa cooyø, 'ba bäŋ ŋat moo cøm cwïnya. Nyïïmän 'moa bëët gïr gïïa leth na jwøra awïnyge, ni kanyge kiper mana tïïyï gø. Wui, beerra man kälï cäŋ gïïa leth na näk iï caanø, nee ge tïmge kaamar mara.
english: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

anywaa: «Beerra man ö raayi moge bëët ni ö nyïmï, ni tïïï dëëtge ki gïrpiny kaawat mana tïïyï dëëra ki køør raay bëët moa tïïa. Gïï mo thööth cara naa ŋurö, ni cwïnya bëëdö no opädhö.»
english: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

anywaa: Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan abuŋ piny ki pöölö ki køør wëër mare! Ajiem mar Icriel alëëŋe ki maal ni leeŋ gø yïth ŋøøm. Ni eni kanya tïme na cäŋ wëër mare, bäŋ gïn mo ee caarø kiper kanya bëëdö na køøm tiete.
english: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk kwör bëëte bëët mo jic Jeekap araanynye, ni cwïnye käre warø. Kwör gwøk røk moa no ogeerø ni teek yïth päänye mo jø Juuda anyaa piny ki køør wëër mare. Eni buc nyec marge ki kwääri moge aleeŋ yïth ŋøøm ni pääta geni.
english: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

anywaa: Eni teek mar jø Icriel bäre araanynye ki køør wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac. Eni cer cwïïe adøle ki geni nyïm nyïïmän moge. Eni mïëri mo Jeekap awaaŋe ki maac, ni dïïr wïth jammi bëët këël ki moa en deŋge.
english: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

anywaa: Atheerø mare aniit baŋwa kaawat man wø tïïc nyimänni, ni niide ka cer cwïïe. Jiy bëët moa mïërö ki waŋ anääe kaawat man wø tïïc nyimänni. Wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac akïth bäät uudi mo jø Dhayan.
english: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk atïmö kaamar nyimän. Eni Icriel bäre araanynye, ni raany kwör gwøk røk bëët mo gø. Eni kiiri mo päänye mo Icriel moa no ogeerø ni teek araanynye, ni ö eni ni meet kïmmö ko oduuru mar jø Juuda.
english: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

anywaa: Eni, kar bëëtö mare atoor piny kaamar abïl koor, ni raany kany wø røømme yie ki jiy. Wuuö Jwøk Dhayan atïïe nee wïïe wïle ki kwör ajwöm moe, ki nïr jwöm moe. Eni nyeya ki dïlämme akwiere ki køør wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac.
english: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk gïn wø cïp olämme bääte jïre akwiere, ni jar øt lam mare na en kur keere. Eni kwör gwøk røk mo pääny acïp ceŋ nyïïmän, ni ö geni ni kwöŋge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk kaawat man wø tïïc yi cäŋ ajwöma.
english: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.

anywaa: Aŋøl Wuuö Jwøki ki man nyaa kiir Dhayan piny. Eni paac arøme, ni røm dhi cere, ni käre cere dwøk ŋääe këët ki man raany gø. Eni kiiri atïïe ni kïmmö, ni ränyge bëët.
english: The Lord hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

anywaa: Dhøk kiir apäänhnhö piny ni buŋi ya ŋøømmi, ni ö dïdëëdi moe ni tøc ge ni raany ge. Nyeya mare ki kwääri moe ge bëëdö dï wïth juurre ni ge mak ka tøŋ. Ciik atïmö ni bäŋgø këët, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki ni tïme ni bäŋ gïï wø nyooth ki yi wïc mo jootge baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.

anywaa: Jäle mo Dhayan gena pï piny yïth ŋøøm jaak ni geno nikïïl. Geni bur ajørge wïthge, ni røøge keece dëëtge na abïïe. Nyïïakuue mo Jerucalem ge bëëdö ni cøŋge ege këël piny ni wïthge ege këël yïth ŋøøm.
english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

anywaa: Aani nyeŋŋa awer ki jwøk, ni jwïëya bëëdö ni kïmmö døc. Aani cwïnya apädhö døc ki Kïmmö  kiper ränynyö mar jø powa, ki man wø bëët obwöre moa therø ki moa mar na en kööthi ni geno räp piny nyeŋ jïëthe mo pääny.
english: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

anywaa: Ni ge bëëdö ni geno räp piny nyeŋ jïëthe mo pääny kaamar ŋat ŋwellø, ni ge jwöŋö dëët mëëkge, na «?Age cam ki køøŋ nyïïomøki?» ni bëëtge ni ge thøwø kööth mëëkge.
english: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.

anywaa: ?Wui, jø Jerucalem, agïnaŋø noo caana kiperu? ?Uuni, u päära gø ki gïnaŋø? ?Wui, jø Dhayan, gïna jwørru päära gø ki ŋø nee lønye ki man cøma cwïnynyu? Kiper ränynyö maru caala ŋwellø mo ree ee luut piny kaamar naama dwøŋ. ?Aŋa ni dwøk bëëtö maru kare?
english: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

anywaa: Nyïïkuk Jwøk mou, gïï wø nyooth ki yi wïc ni wø køpge jïïu beeye tööt ki cwøk. Geni raay mou kärge thaaŋø jïïu, ki man dwøk bëëtö maru kare dhi cer bëët laŋ. 'Ba marge atïmö ni ge bwødha u wøk ki luup tööt ni ge köö ni caana Jwøki.
english: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø pöödhi ki waŋjöö ceŋge paŋge paŋø bäätu ni ge buua uuni, ni ge tuuŋŋa wïthge bäät Jerucalem, ni ge köö, na «?Aŋø, man paa beeye pääny mana cäänge kipere, na näk wøp na mïërö døc, ni piny bäre yie met ki gø?»
english: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

anywaa: Nyïïmän mou bëët dhøkge ajapge bäätu, ni buuge ni ge kaaya lakge, ni köge, ni «Wïthge dïïrwa dïïrö ennø. Ka adïëri møn, man beeye cäŋa koorwa kiperge; waana pïï yie ennø, ni jootwa gø.»
english: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïna manynye atïïe, ni wëëk luumme thur kare, na näk ee nø ŋøl yïth nïra cääŋŋe. Eni uuna raanynye ni cwïnye käre warø, ni tïïc nyimän nee kanynye bäätu. Eni teek mar nyimän ameede.
english: The Lord hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

anywaa: Jiy ajwöŋö ki cwïnyge bäre jï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. Wui, jø kiir Dhayan, beerra man bëët pï nyeŋŋu ni muulö waŋcäŋ ki wäär kaamar naam. Kär dëëtu jwömmu ko oduuru, ni ba wëëgu pï nyeŋŋu cuŋŋö.
english: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

anywaa: Pänynyu maal kany wø ö jø koorri mo wäär noo täkge ki koor, ni jwöŋu ni döötu ena maal. Gwääru cwïnynyu wøk bäre kaamar pänh jwïïö nyïm Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. Thaaŋu ceŋŋu maal baŋe kiper kwøw mar obwöre mou moa therø na näk oräp piny ki käc nyeŋ jïëthe.
english: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

anywaa: Wui, Wuuö Jwøk, neenï ni raŋï gø. ?Teeŋ gïn aŋa na kwøŋï gø tïïc dëëre? ?Aŋø, mään obwöre moa käl dëëtge na gwøkge dege camø?  ?Aŋø, dïlämme ki nyïïkuk Jwøk doo nääö yi Øt Lam mar Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk?
english: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

anywaa: Obwöre ki jäle, ge bëëdö ni geno päänhnhö yïth ŋøøm nyeŋ jïëthe ni geno thøw, ni ö nyïïakuue ki wøpe ni nääi ko opëëllö. Ïïni, gena 'nägï yi cäŋ mar wëër marï, ni 'nägï geni ni cwïnyï kärï warø.
english: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

anywaa: Ïïni jiy acwølï kipera kaawat man wø cwøl jiy cäŋ ajwöma, ni ö lwärri mo dwøŋ ni ciel aani dïër. Yi cäŋ wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ ŋat mo obøth wala mo okwøw. Jiy moa gwøa na piidha, wïthge adïïr nyimänni mara.
english: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

anywaa: Beeye aani na joot gïna leth, ki køør ajäl wëër mar Jwøk.
english: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

anywaa: Eni, aana køøle, ni tïïc aani naa cäädha yi muudhö ni patha yi tar.
english: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, cer ajäl Jwøk abëëdö ni ena bääta, ni nøøya aani ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

anywaa: Eni rïŋ dëëra ki buny dëëra awëëk ränynyö, ni tøc cuu 'moa.
english: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

anywaa: Eni, aana ciele ki gïï mo tïïya bëëtö mara ni teek, ni rum a dïër ki gïï mo tïïya bëëtö mara ni leth.
english: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

anywaa: Eni kany mo cøl atïïe na kar bëëtö mara, ni tïma naa caala jøøa thøw kany mo bäär.
english: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

anywaa: Eni aana cïëk yi øtø mo ogeerø ni teek naa ba løny ki man päära wøk, naa ee twöö ki tiimme mo peek.
english: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kany wø jwöŋa ni dwøra yaa tïŋ maal kiper køny, eni kweer ki man wïny lam mara.
english: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

anywaa: Eni uutjïëthe 'moa acïëge ki kïte mo døøŋŋø, ni tïïc waŋjöö mara no oköömmö.
english: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

anywaa: Ena tïmö kaamar cwieny mo omøør piny kipera, ni tïme kaamar ŋuu mo ree ee kanø kany mo ba joot.
english: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

anywaa: Aana cöör wøk uutjïëthe 'moa, ni ŋør aani na thäŋi ni leeŋ a piny, ni tïme ni bäŋ køny kipera këët.
english: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

anywaa: Eni atheerø mare aniit baŋa, ni tïïc aani na gïr alääwa mare.
english: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

anywaa: Eni athëëre moe moa en yi køp athöör dëëra, ni dønyge yi dëëra kuya.
english: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

anywaa: Aana tïmö na gïr ŋeethø ki jï jø powa bëët, ni bëëtge ni ge jala aani ki dudi yïth nïne bëët.
english: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

anywaa: Aana maadhe ki jaath mo keec, ni wëëk a jäŋö ki gø.
english: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

anywaa: Eni laga acääny wøk ki kïdi, ni gøø aani piny yi tør.
english: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

anywaa: Kara atïmö ni bäär ki bëët-mëër, ni wïl wïïa ki met ec.
english: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, na «Ajiem mara aränynyö, ki gïïa ŋäädha bëët baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:

anywaa: Wïïa apara ki caarø mara ki thääyö mara na caal cïm ki jaadha keec.
english: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

anywaa: Kany wø para wïïa ki geni, cwïnya puta pädhö.
english: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïn mo kany wø caara wïïa ki gø,  ŋäädhe mara puta duuö,
english: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

anywaa: ni beeye mëër mar Wuuö Jwøk ni wø ba jøøl na kärø ränynyö en, kiper bäth ec mare bëëdö na bäre bäre ni ba ränynyi.
english: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

anywaa: Ni ge bëëdö ni ge nyärö cooth ka amöölla, na adïëri mare päl.
english: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

anywaa: 'Ba jwïëya aköö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye na kura; kiper manøgønø, a bëëdö naa ŋäätha gø.»
english: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beer ki jï jø wø bëëdö ni koora gø, ni eni beer jï ŋat wø bëëdö ni manynya eni.
english: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

anywaa: Beeye gïn mo beer jï dhaanhø ki man koor pïëm mar Wuuö Jwøk man piem jiy ki gø, ni cwïnye ee cïp piny.
english: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni beerra eni jï dhaanhø ki man jïëny gïï mo leth ni eni poot thiinh.
english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

anywaa: Beerra man ö eni ni bëëde keere ni lïŋö, kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na kïth gïïögø bääte.
english: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

anywaa: Beerra man bëëde ni täärnyïme ee këël yi tør; kanymør poot da ŋäädhe mo joode joodø.
english: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

anywaa: Beerra man cïp thääŋŋe jï ŋat wø many man dhööŋ eni, ni bëëde no orøm ka ajøøŋ.
english: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk jiye ba kwiere na bäre bäre.
english: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

anywaa: Këël doo kännö ki pänh cwïny bäät dhaanhø, cwïnye poot di bäädhö ki køør mëër mare na päl ni wø ba jøøl.
english: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

anywaa: Kiper eni yie ba met ki man tïïc gïn mo leth dëër dhaanhø, wala ki man wëëk jiy kïmmö.
english: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïm jø paaci bëët moa en øt twöc ni geno nyøøn piny,
english: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

anywaa: ki kany wø tïm bëët dhaanhø ni kär koorø ki nyïm Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal,
english: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

anywaa: ki kany wø kaat luup bäät dhaanhø kar løøk, ?iï caarø ni Jwøk gïïögø ba neete?
english: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man cääne, ni thur gïna caane kare, ni näk mo kär caan Wuuö Jwøki?
english: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

anywaa: ?Paa dhi Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal ni wø ö gïn mo beerri ki gïn mo raac ki yie?
english: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

anywaa: ?Na aperŋø ni ö dhaanhe man ni kwøw en ni bëëde ni ŋurö kiper ajäla mana ö bääte ki køør raay moe?
english: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

anywaa: Beerra man neenø bëëtö marø ki uutjïëthe moa caadhø, ni duuø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

anywaa: Beerra man løø cwïnynyø ni tïŋø ceŋŋø maal jï Jwøa en maal, ni lämø ni kööø,
english: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

anywaa: ni «Waana tïïö ki raay ni gëëmwa, 'ba wa kärï wëënnö.
english: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

anywaa: «Ïïni, ïïna gootø døc, ni bëëdï niï løpa køørwa, ni 'nägï wa ni cwïnyï kärï warø.
english: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

anywaa: Ïïni dëërï agëëŋï ki pøøl, nee bäŋe lam mo pöönh baŋï.
english: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

anywaa: Waana tïïyï kaamar gïï mo owetø mo reyø yïthakic wïth juurre.
english: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

anywaa: «Nyïïmän mowa bëët dhøkge aŋaamge bäätwa, ni ge buua wa.
english: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

anywaa: Ni ö bööki ki buri mo pätha yïthge ki ränynyö mo dwøŋ døc  ni put ö bäätwa.»
english: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

anywaa: Pï nyeŋŋa acwïër piny ni tïme kaamar jwïïö mo pänhnhö, kiper ränynyö mar jø powa.
english: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

anywaa: Pï nyeŋŋa puta bëëtö ni cwïëra piny ni ba cöök,
english: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

anywaa: këël kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki no nëënne ki maal noo raŋ gø.
english: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

anywaa: Gïna neena ki waŋa akännö ki pänh cwïny jïra, ni beeye gïna ö bäät nyïïakuue mo pääny mara.
english: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa männö ki aani ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere, aana cekge ka akupa kaamar wenyø.
english: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

anywaa: Aana leeŋge yi buur naa kwøw, ni cïëkge dhi buur ki kïdi.
english: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

anywaa: Pïï aana mwønyge, ni kööa, ni «Aana thøw nø.»
english: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

anywaa: Wui ï na Wuuö Jwøk, nyeŋŋï acwøla naa ena yi buur mo bäär.
english: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

anywaa: Kwac mara awïnynyï kanya kööa, ni «Kär ïthï cïëgï ko oduuru mara kiper køny.»
english: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cwøla ïïni, ïïna nyänh kany mo cään, ni kööï, ni «Kärï lwäyö!»
english: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aana cwagï, ni piemï jwïëya.
english: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, gïïa leth na tïïc dëëra ajootï; beerra man ŋølï luumma.
english: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

anywaa: Män mana mänge ki aani ki gø, ki gïïa tuutge bëët na kïthge bääta ajootï.
english: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ajøøŋ marge awïnynyï, ki gïïa tuutge bëët na kïthge bääta.
english: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

anywaa: Nyïïmän 'moa ge bëëdö ni ge cøŋŋa gïra, ki man raanyge aani ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

anywaa: Neenï, kany wø pïge piny ki kany wø öge maal, ge bëëdö ni ge jaalla aani ki dudi.
english: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cool kwör dëëtge ki køør gïïa tïïcge.
english: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

anywaa: Døøc cwïnyge mo teek, ni ö acïëni marï ni en bäätge.
english: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

anywaa: Jøn wëër marï bäätge ni raanynyï geni bäät ŋøøm moï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.

anywaa: Aŋø, warkey otïmö ni cøl nidïï; Aŋø, warkey mana tøŋ ree ee wiilø nidïï! Gïïa beyø na geer Øt Jwøk ki ge, aøc piny këël mana pïïcge nyeŋ jïëthe.
english: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

anywaa: Wäät Dhayan na beer marge pääri ka warkey mana tøŋ, geno tïmö ni caala dääe nidïï mo wø tïïc dïcwäc dääe ki ceŋge!
english: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

anywaa: Këël othööe na näk lääc paap thurge cïpge cïbö jï nyïïge, ni dhwøthge nyïïge; 'ba jø powa gena tïmö ni ge reyø døc kaamar uudö mano en paap.
english: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

anywaa: Lëëp obwöre moa mar aninäŋ yïth aŋarkwange ki riew, ni ö obwöre moa reegø ni bëëtge ni ge kwääö ki caammi; 'ba bäŋ ŋat mooc geni ki cam.
english: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

anywaa: Jiy moa wara cam caammi moa beyø,  gena 'näk käci nyeŋ jïëthe, ni ö jøøa piith yi käär abïïe mo beyø ni tïmge ni ge bëëdö wïthur.
english: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

anywaa: Kiper bääyö mar jø powa atïmö ni kadha eni ki bääyö mar jø Cødam, paana raanynyi na bäre bäre ki kany mo thiinh,  ni bäŋ køny mo otïïö kipere.
english: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

anywaa: Kwääri moe gena bëëdö ni dëëtge tøŋ ni kaala piiø, ni ge tar ni kaala caak, ni ge beyø døc ni kaala nyeŋ kïte moa mïërö, ni mïërö marge caala nyeŋ kïte moa ŋwaŋŋi.
english: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ge cøl ni kaala belø, ni ge ba løny ki ŋec nyeŋ jïëthe; kööt dëëtge otal røk cuu moge, ni talge ni tïmge kaamar jenni.
english: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

anywaa: Jiy moa thøw ni 'näk ko opëëllö theemma thøø marge ki jiy moa thøw ni 'näga käci; kiper jiy moa 'näk käci ge thøw ni geno caar käci, kiper na bäŋe caammi mo ociek yïth pwöth.
english: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

anywaa: Këël mään moa bëëdö ni mëër ki nyïïge døc, nyïïge athaalge, nee tïmge na cam jïge, ki køør ränynyö mana raany jø powa ki gø.
english: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk wëër mare akäle ni dwøŋ døc; wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac ajääŋŋe; ni leeŋ maac yi Dhayan, ni ö maaci ni put tier kiir Dhayan thöör ki waaŋ bäre.
english: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye mo bäät piny, këël ki jø wø bëëdö bäät ŋøøm bëët, kärge ŋäädhö ni løny jï nyïïmän ki man tukge kiir Jerucalem ni dønyge yi gø.
english: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø tägi kaper raay moa tïïc nyïïkuk Jwøki moe, ki raay moa tïïc dïlämme moe, ki køør mana kønyge rem jiy moa beyø piny.
english: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane ge thäämmö nyeŋ jïëthe kaamar jiy ma cööye, ni tïmge ni ge ba waany ki køør rem jiy moa kønyge piny, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo løny jïre ki man gut abïïkge.
english: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

anywaa: Ni tïm jiyi ni kwöŋŋö bäätge, ni «Daagu rou! U ba waany! Aayu! Aayu! Kär wa gutu!» 'Ba kany wø aacge ni ge thääyö jaak dï juurre, jiy møga yïthakic juurre ge köö, ni «Ge ba bëëdö ki waani këët.»
english: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre beeye na keeth geni, ni bäŋ gïn manynye këët kiperge. Dïlämme atïmö ni ba wøør, ni bäŋ ŋat lwäär ki jø døøŋŋø.
english: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni nyeŋŋø aööl ki raŋ, ni ø raŋŋa køny mo ba tägi. Ni koor mana kurø ki gø, ø koora jiy mo ø ba kønyge.
english: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

anywaa: Gena tïmö ni ge baya tietø kany wø cäädhø, ni dhäth wääthi jïïø ki uutjïëthe moø; aŋuun bëëtö marø kare acäännö,  nïne 'moø athum, kiper aŋuun bëëtö marø aöö.
english: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

anywaa: Jiy moa ŋwiec køørø ge rïïŋö døc ni kaala olwiith mana na agweec. Køørø aŋwiecge bäät kïte, ni møørge piny nyïmmø dï paap.
english: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

anywaa: Ŋata tïïc Wuuö Jwøki nee wïïe thïïmmi ki maaw, na bëëdö ni caala jwïëy moø, amakge ka abïëp marge, ni beeye ŋata cäänø kipere, ni «Ø doo bëëdö tïpö mare yïthakic wïth juurre.»
english: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

anywaa: Wui, jø Ëdöm, yïthu mïnge ni kanynyu nø, u ni wø bëëdö yi ŋööm Uc; 'ba uuni athöönh ajäla di jääŋŋö baŋu thuwø, ni mäthu ni meerru ni dööŋŋu ki dëëtu.
english: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

anywaa: Wui jø Dhayan, ajäl raay mou athum nø; Wuuö Jwøk u ba wëëk bëëtö këët ni uuno maa ki tøŋ. 'Ba u na jø Ëdöm, Wuuö Jwøk u jääle jäälö kiper raay mou, ni wëëk japa reyø na tïïyu nëënne.
english: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, par wïïï ki gïna pänh bäätwa; raŋï, ni neenï ajøøŋ mana jøøŋ wa ki gø!
english: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

anywaa: Ŋøøm moa cïpï jïwa akäl jø møøki, ni ö mïëri mowa ni tïmge na mo wëëlle.
english: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

anywaa: Waana tïmö kaamar kïïe mo bäŋ wääge, ni ö mëëkwa ni tïmge kaamar määr thuunhnhi.
english: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

anywaa: Pïï mo maathwa atïmö ni ŋeewa ŋeeø, ni tïm jer thaalli ni jootwa ka ŋïëw.
english: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

anywaa: Jiy moa ŋwiec køørwa gena pïï røk opuny tietwa; waana ööl døc, ni bäŋ jwöm mo ewa joodø.
english: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

anywaa: Ceŋwa acïpwa jï jø Ijep ki jï jø Aciria, nee wa jïtwa ki cam man koorwa jwïëcwa ki gø.
english: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

anywaa: Kwäcwa atïïö ki raay ni pööthge, ni dööŋwa karge ni wa jøøya ajäl raay moa tïïcge.
english: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

anywaa: Laaŋe waana dïïmge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo käl wa wøk ceŋge.
english: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

anywaa: Cam marwa jootwa ni wa wiila jwïëcwa, kiper dïnäge moa en dï paap.
english: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

anywaa: Dëëtwa atïmö ni lïëth kaamar këënnö, ki køør diwaŋ dëël mar käc mana tägö dëëtwa.
english: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

anywaa: Mään moa en yi Dhayan, ki nyïïakuue moa näk dëët cwøw poot kucge na en yïth päänye mo Juuda, gena gøyi ki piny.
english: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

anywaa: Kwääri gena lïër ki ceŋge, ni jø døøŋŋø bëëdö ni ba wøør.
english: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

anywaa: Obwöc cwøw atïïc na jø guur caammi, ni ö obwöre moa therø ni tïï na jø møøt jenni ki tëër mo leth døc ni ge bøømmø.
english: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

anywaa: Jø døøŋŋø gena tïmö ni ge tøør dhi kiir pääny kar acooŋa, ni ö dööt jap meeŋ mo obwöre ni lïŋge.
english: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

anywaa: Met cwïny marwa aränynyö, ni ö meeŋŋi marwa ni løø ree baŋ kïmmö.
english: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

anywaa: Aduda apäth piny ki wïthwa. Wui, atïmö ni leth jïwa, kiper raay moa tïïcwa!
english: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cwïnywa apädhö, ni ö nyeŋwa ni nigejïïm,
english: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

anywaa: kiper Dhayan na näk Jerucalem aniruuth piny, ni tïme na kar bëëtö mar othööe.
english: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, bura marï bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö wälu marï ni këët røk beenhnhe moo ööi bëët.
english: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni wïl wïïï ki waani cooth en? ?Aŋø ni weyï waani ki kany mo bäär en?
english: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, duu waani baŋï, nee wa døøwa karwa; dwøk bëëtö marwa kare ni caala mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, waana kwierï, ni gootï ki wa døc.
english: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cwiiri ma pïëradäk, ni dwää aŋween nïre abïïc, naa ena bäät naam Kebar yïthakic jø Juuth moa no omaa ki tøŋ, maal ree ajabe, ni ö Jwøki ni nyuunh aani ki ŋïï ki yi wïïa.
english: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø ri bïï nïne mo dwäänögø, ni beeye kanya ö cwiic nyeya ma Jöakin thuwø na pääŋe na abïïc ki mana maai ki tøŋ,
english: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,

anywaa: dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, a na dïlämi, ni bee a Edhikiel o Buci, bäät naam Kebar manøgø na en yi ŋööm jø Kaldia. Ni ö cer Wuuö Jwøki ni ö bääta kaace.
english: The word of the Lord came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was there upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ni nëënna, atuunna aputa joot ni kwönnö ki wï piny, mo nëëni kaamar pöölö mo dwøŋ mo maac nigaaŋ yie, ni tar orieny deŋŋe, ni maac mana en ya atuunna manøgø, dïëre wärri kaamar nywïënyö mo di leenyø.
english: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

anywaa: Ni yi maaøgø da gïï ma aŋween mo caala gïï mo kwøw. 'Ba gïïögø kït moge nëëni na ennø nø: Geni, geno cwääö kaamar jiy.
english: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.

anywaa: 'Ba man nø jïre da täärnyïmmi aŋween ki bwöm aŋween.
english: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.

anywaa: Ni tietge bëëdö ni thïïŋ, ni cääthe mo tietge otïïö kaamar cääthe mo tiet nyirøøa, ni ge bëëdö ni paŋŋi kaamar nywïënyö ma jwïël mo othoodhø.
english: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet bwöpge moø na aŋween yøø ki jï piny da ceŋ mo kede ceŋ dhaanhø. 'Ba gïïö na aŋween bëët yøø, man nø jïre da täärnyïmmi aŋween ki bwöm aŋween,
english: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.

anywaa: ni bwöpge bëëdö ni man nø rege gudö ki mo watge maya. 'Ba geni, ge bëëdö ni man nø cäätha nyïme ni dëëtge ba løkge kany wø aacge.
english: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïö na aŋween yøø yi cwääc mana cwääc täärnyïmge ki gø bee en: Täärnyïm mana en løø nyïm otïïö kaamar täärnyïm dhaanhø, ni ö mana en bäät cwïïc ni tïï kaamar täärnyïm ŋuu, ni ö mana en bäät caam ni tïï kaamar täärnyïm rwaath, ni ö mana en ŋäc ni tïï kaamar täärnyïm olwiith mana näk agweec.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye bëëtö mar täärnyïmmi moge. 'Ba bwöpge bëëdö ni ege peerø; ni man nø bwöpe ariiø bëëdö ni rege gudö ki mo wati maya. Ni ö bwöpge ariiø møga ni bëëtge ni dëëtge ege uumö ki ge.
english: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø man nø bëëdö ni cäätha nyïme; ni kany wø ci jwïëyi yie jaak, ge puta ci yie, ni kany wø näk mo geno aay, dëëtge ba løkge.
english: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.

anywaa: 'Ba dï gïïögø ni kwøw yøø, da gïï mo nëëni kaamar cuk mo wärri, mo bëëdö kaamar ameethi mo ge jöödö yïthakic gïïögø, ni ge cøøa ŋäc ki nyïm. 'Ba beege gïï mo orieny ni tar ni maac nigaaŋ dïge.
english: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø ni kwøw yøø ge bëëdö ni ge rïïŋö døc ni ge jööta cään ki maal kaawat man wø ö agaackøthi wø neegaaŋ.
english: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.

anywaa: 'Ba aani kanya lwïtha baŋ gïïö ni kwøw yøø, ka adïëri møn, aana put jïtö piny deŋ man nø ki gïn mo caala tier jääy.
english: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïö ni caal tiet jïëthe yøø yi cwääc mana cwääc ge ki gø otïïö na ennø nø: Ge bëëdö ni ge ŋwaŋŋi kaamar waŋ kïdi, ni ge na aŋween bëët yøø, geno cwääö na teeŋ aciel. Ni geno tïïö ni man nø nëëni kede da tier jääy mør mo ena yie ni rege gänö.
english: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø aacge, ge puta aay ki løøk aciel ki røk løøk mo nyïmge moa na aŋween, ni dëëtge ba løkge këët kany wø näk mo geno aay.
english: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet jïëthe moøgø bäyö ni di lwäyö ki ge; ni ge na aŋween bëët yøø bëëdö ni dëëtge ogääbö ki nyeŋ mo raŋ ki deŋge bäre.
english: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïö ni kwøw yøø kany wø cääthge, gïïa caal tiet jïëthe na en buutge ge puta cääthö na aciel ki geni; ni kany wø määt gïïögø ni kwøw yøø, ge määtö thuwø.
english: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.

anywaa: Kany wø ci jwïëyi yie jaak, gïïö ni kwøw yøø ge puta aay ki løøk maneca, ni ö tiet jïëthe  ni putge aa maal ki geni na aciel, kiper jwïëc gïïögø ni kwøw yøø ena yïth gïïö ni caal tiet jïëthe yøø.
english: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

anywaa: Kany wø ö gïïa kwøwi noo cääthge, ge cääthö thuwø; ni kany wø ö gïïa kwøwi noo cuŋge, ge cuŋŋö thuwø; ni kany wø ö gïïa kwøwi noo määtge, ge määtö na aciel ki geni thuwø; kiper jwïëc gïïö ni kwøw yøø ena yïth gïïögø ni caal tiet jïëthe yøø.
english: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät gïïö ni kwøw yøø da gïrpiny mo ree ee peerø bäätge mo nëëni kaamar maal, ni tøŋ ni caala piiø.
english: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïö ni kwøw yøø bwöpge ege peerø tier gïnögø ni caal maal enø, ni man nø bwöpe ogääbö ki mo wati maya, ni man nø bwöpe ariiø møga bëëdö ni dëëre ee uumö ki ge.
english: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïö ni kwøw yøø kanya määtge, dööt bwöm moge awïnynya ni lwör kaamar naam mo pänhnhö, ni caala dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na en teeki jïre, ni wïnyi kaamar dööt jø leny. 'Ba kany wø cuŋge, bwöpge dwøkge piny.
english: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl wïnyi ka maal bäät gïna näk ree ee peerø bäätge kaamar maal. 'Ba kany wø cuŋge, bwöpge dwøkge piny.
english: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät gïna näk ree ee peerø bäätge kaamar maal, da gïrpiny yie mo nëëni kaamar wälu mo otïïö ki kïdi mo kïte caala caaro. 'Ba bäät wälu manøgø da gïrpiny mo nëëni kaamar dhaanhø mo opï piny bääte maal.
english: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba na raŋa gø, ki mana täge ki kun da piere këël wïïe aputa joot ni caala nywïënyö ma jwïël mo wärri kaamar maac. 'Ba ki mana täge ki piere këël piny, ajooda na gïn mo caala maac, ni tar bëëdö no orieny ki deŋŋe manø bäre.
english: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.

anywaa: 'Ba tar mana no orieny deŋŋe, nëëni kaamar daanø kany wø cööde maal ri køth. Ni manøgø beeye bëëtö mar ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba kanya jooda gø, aana pädhö ki bäp yia, ni puta dwøl wïnynyö ni cäänö.
english: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, cuŋŋï ki tietï niï cäänna!»
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääne ki aani, Jwïëc Jwøk adøny dëëra ni wëëk a cuŋŋö ki tieta; ni wïnynya dwøl ni cäänna aani.
english: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, a jääŋŋa ïïni baŋ jø Icriel, ge na jø ageem na gëëmö ki aani; geni ki kwäcge gena bëëdö ni ge bääö dëëra këël dïcäŋ man.
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.

anywaa: A jääŋŋa ï baŋge, ge na jøøa wïthge teek na näk cwïnyge teek. Wär caanï jïge ni kööï, ni ‹Man beeye dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, këël mo ge kweer wala ïthge cekge ciiø, kiper mana näk mo gena jø ageem, oŋäcge ki man näk mo nyikuŋ Jwøk nut dïge.
english: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø, kärï lwäyö ki geni, ni ba lwäyï ki luup moo carge, këël ïïno kïth yïthakic odhäŋ ki koodhi, ni cïp ïïni yïth agarapi, kärï lwäyö ki luup moo carge, ni ba bwøk cwïnyï ki geni kanyo enï nyïmge; kiper gena jø ageem.
english: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

anywaa: 'Ba luup 'moa wär caanï jïge, kiper gena jø ageem, këël mo ge kweer wala ïthge cekge ciiø.
english: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, cek ïthï ki luup moo caana jïrï en; kärï gëëmö kaamar jø dhi ødøgø na jø ageem yøø. Jap dhiï ni camï gïn ni cïba jïrï en.»
english: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na lwïtha, ka adïëri møn, cenø aputa joot no orwieø nyïma ni wëëlö mo odølø ena yie.
english: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;

anywaa: 'Ba na peer gø nyïma, aputa joot no ogöörö ki yie ki ŋääe; ni luup moa no ogöörö bääte beege luup kïmmö, ko oduuru, ki cooyø.
english: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, cam gïnö ni nëëni jïrï enø, ni beeye wëëlö manøgø, ni aayï ni caanï luumma jï jø Icriel.»
english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhaa aŋaama, ni ö eni ni caam aani ki wëëlö manøgø.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, cam wëëlö man ni cïba jïrï en ni jäŋï ki gø.» Ni puta gø cam ni ŋweeth dhaa ni caala maar kïc.
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, ci baŋ jø Icriel nø ni caanï luup 'moa jïge.
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba ï ba jääŋŋi kaper niï ciï baŋ jiy mo dhøk marge kuc wala dhøk marge  teek, 'ba beeye baŋ jø Icriel;
english: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;

anywaa: niï ba jääŋŋi kaper niï ciï baŋ wïth juurre moa thööth ni wø cäänö ni dhøgi moge kuc wala teek, ni dhøgi moge ba ci wïïï; 'ba doo na ï yaa jääŋŋö baŋge, dwørï dege leŋø.
english: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel ge poot kweer ki man wïnyge luummï, kiper geno nø kweer ki man wïnyge luumma. Ka adïëri møn, jø Icriel bëët gena jiy mo wïthge teek ni cwïnyge teek.
english: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, aani, wïïï tïïa tïïö ni teek kaamar wïthge, ni tïïa cwïnyï ni teek ni caala cwïnyge.
english: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.

anywaa: Aani, cwïnyï tïïa tïïö ni teek ni caala kïdi mo teek døc. Kärï lwäyö ki geni, ni ba bwøk cwïnyï kanyo enï nyïmge, këël na bëëtge ni gena jø ageem.»
english: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena cäŋ köö, ni «Wär dhaanhø, luup bëët moo caana jïrï en, wïnynyï na karge, ni kïthï ge cwïnyï.
english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.

anywaa: Ennø, ci baŋ jø pou moa no omaa ki tøŋ, ni cäännï geni; këël mo ge kweer wala ïthge cekge ciiø, wär kööï jïge, ni ‹Man beeye dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord God; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Jwøk aana wëëk päny maal, ni puta dwøl mo dwøŋ wïnynyö mo märö kaamar køth deŋŋa mo köö, ni «Pwøc en jï ajiem Wuuö Jwøk na en kar bëëtö mare!»
english: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the Lord from his place.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dööt bwöm mo gïïa kwøw ni pööta rege, ki dööti mo tiet jïëthe moa en deŋge, ni dööti moøgø märö døc.
english: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jwïëc Jwøk aana put tïŋ maal ni 'käl aani, ni puta aay ni cwïnya okëënynyö ni aano gootø, ni cer Wuuö Jwøk ena bääta naa ee maa ni teek.
english: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the Lord was strong upon me.

anywaa: Køøre aana pïï yïthakic jø Juuth moa no omaa ki tøŋ na en kanya cwøl ni Tel-Abiib bäät naam Kebar, ni puta bëëtö buutge ki nïne abïriiø ni cwïnya obwøk døc.
english: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na aŋuun nïne moa na abïriiø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, ïïna jiera niï tïmï ni ïïna ŋat koor kiper jø Icriel; luubö mano wïnynyï dhaa jaak, ge wär köömmï ki gø ki nyeŋŋa.
english: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø kööa jï ŋat raay, ni ‹Ï thøw møn kiper raay moï,› niï ba ci kuna köömmï gø ki man wec raay moe nee jwïëye piem, ŋat raay manøgø thøøa yïth raay moe, 'ba remø mare pëënynya pëënynyö ki ïïni.
english: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋat raay köömmï köömmö, ni kweere ki man løk cwïnye yïth raay moe ki uutjïëthe moe na reyø, eni thøøa yïth raay moe, 'ba ïïni, ï dööŋ wøk ra ajäla manøgø.
english: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

anywaa: «'Ba maya thuwø, ni näk ŋat mo bëëte tiir, bëëtö mare na tiir wiie wiiø ni tïïe ki raay, ni cïpa nyïme ki gïn mo cwaanya tiere, eni thøw. Eni thøw yïth raay moe, ki køør mana kärï gø köömmö, ni ö japa beyø na tïïe ni ba par wïc ki geni; 'ba aani, remø mare pëënynya pëënynyö ki ïïni.
english: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

anywaa: Kany wø näk ŋat mo bëëte tiir köömmï köömmö ki man ba tïïe ki raay, ni put bëëtö møn ni ba tïïö ki raay, eni bëëdö ni kwøw kiper mana jïëc köömmö; 'ba ïïni thuwø, ï bëëdö ni bäŋ ajäla bäätï.»
english: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.

anywaa: 'Ba cer Wuuö Jwøk abëëdö ni ena bääta kaace, ni kööe jïra, ni «Ö maal ni ciï yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö, naa cääna ki ïïni yie.»
english: And the hand of the Lord was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana put ö maal ni cøøa yi ŋöömma näk ree ee päärö. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kanya pïïa, ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk oløny ni cuŋŋö yie kaace, ni beeye teeŋ ajiem mana jooda bäät naam Kebar. Kanyøgø aana put pädhö ki bäp yia.
english: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the Lord stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk aput døny dëëra ni tïïc aani naa cuŋŋa ki tieta, ni cääne ki aani ni kööe jïra, ni «Ciï ni dëëdï ødï bäätï.
english: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø, ïïno twöc ki thøøli ni tïmï niï ba løny ki man ööï wøk niï ci yïthakic jiy.
english: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:

anywaa: Leebï owëëga ninäŋ ya aŋarkwannï, ni tïmï niï ba cäänö, kiper nee jø Icriel nee ge ba köömmï, kiper gena jø ageem.
english: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wäro cääna ki ïïni, dhiï ojaba, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Man beeye dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› 'Ba ŋato jïëy, wär jïëe, ni  ö ŋato kweer, ni kweere. Kiper gena jiy mo gena jø ageem.
english: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, määnyï ka athaa ni cïbï gø buutï ni göörï kït pääny Jerucalem bääte.
english: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and portray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

anywaa: Ni määnynyï deŋŋe ki kwör leny mo tuk eni ki yie, ni thørï deŋŋe ki ŋøøm mo eth bäät kiir ki gø, ni määnynyï deŋŋe ki twëëre mo jø leny mo këëdi ki gø, ni ŋudï ki jenni mo thiel kiir ki ge nee pädhe.
english: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.

anywaa: Køøre wär määnyï ki nywïënyö mo caala dööga ni cïbï gø yïthakiyu ki pääny kaamar kiir mar nywïënyö, ni løøï nyïmï baŋe, ni cielï pääny dïër, nee put bëëte no ocielø. 'Ba manøgø otïmö ni beeye nyuudhi kiper jø dhi øt Icriel.
english: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, wärï but bäät caamï, ni ö raayi mo jø dhi øt Icriel ni kïthï ge bäätï. 'Ba raay moge okäärï ki yïth nïne bëët ki mano täge ki kanya butï piny bäät caamï.
english: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.

anywaa: Aani, bäätï kwäänna kwäännö ki nïne mo caala kwään cwiiri mo raay moge. Ïïno bëëdö ki nïne ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïŋween niï käära raay mo jø dhi øt Icriel.
english: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba noo thöörï nïne moøgø, wärï cäŋ butö niï buta bäät cwïïï, ni kïthï raay mo jø dhi øt Juuda bäätï. 'Ba aani, bäätï kwäänna kwäännö ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni dïcäŋ aciel man nø beeye kar cwiir aciel mo raay moge.
english: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.

anywaa: Køøre nyïmï oløøï baŋ Jerucalem na näk ociel dïër, ni køpï luum ajäla mare jïre ni cäännï gø ni iï nyoodhø ki lweetï.
english: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ï twöa twöö ki thøøli ni tïme ni ba løny jïrï ki man løgï riï këël kanyo thum nïne yie moo cielï Jerucalem dïër.
english: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, kädï ki cïndë, ki gäbci, ki ŋööri, ki beel, ka aja, ni kanï ge yi dak, ni tïïyï ge na cam kiperï yïth nïne moo beetï ni ïïno but bäät caamï, ni beege nïne ma dïpe adäk ki pïërabïŋween.
english: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba cam mano camï otïmö ni beeye ya athöödhi aciel ki yi cäŋ, ni camï ka yïth caae.
english: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.

anywaa: 'Ba pïï moo maathï ki yi cäŋ, otïmö ni røm ka yi cuŋguth, ni maathï ka yïth caae.
english: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

anywaa: 'Ba cam manøgø ocamï kaawat man wø cam acøøpa mar gäbci, ni thaalï ni nëënö jï jiy, ni thaalï ka maa cieth jiy mo otal.»
english: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Kaawat manøgøøni, jø Icriel ge cämö ki cam mo ba waany kanyo riema ge yie yïthakic wïth juurre.»
english: And the Lord said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, aani, dëëra poot kära tïïö ni ba waany na bäre bäre. Kiper ki mana käla thïnhö këël ennø, a poot kär cämö ki gïn mo thøwa eni keere en wala baga lääyi mør. Poot bäŋ rïŋö mo ba waany mo onø ci dhaa en.»
english: Then said I, Ah Lord God! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, «Wøp nø, ï tïïa tïïö nee tïme ni møø thaalï ka maac mar wär mo dhäk ni patha maac mar cieth mo jiy.»
english: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, aani, cam man wø ö yi Jerucalem ŋøla ŋølø. Jø Jerucalem geno tïmö ni ge cama cam mo di rømø ni ge bëëdö ni geno lwäyö, ni tïmge ni ge maatha pïï mo di rømø ni ge bëëdö ni nyeŋge okwätö,
english: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:

anywaa: kiper mano tïme ni bäŋ cam ki pïï mo ge rømø ki gø. 'Ba ŋati man nø obëëdö ni raŋŋa jï wati no olwäyö, ni putge dwaalø yïth raay moge.
english: That they may want bread and water, and be astonished one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, lwötï ko opëëllö mo beth ni lielï jïëc tïïï ki jïëc wïïï ki gø kaawat man wø tïïc ŋat nyaar jïër. Køøre nø, jïër wär kïth bäät gïr røm ni pääŋŋï ge na kwöre adäk.
english: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo thum nïne yie mo ciel Jerucalem dïër, dää thäk jïër wär waaŋï dï pääny. Ni lwørï dää thäk møøk ni ŋørï ge ko opëëllö deŋ pääny bäre. Ni ö thäk dääge moa no odööŋ ni kerï ge yi jamø. 'Ba aani, køørge ŋwiea ŋwieø ko opëëllö.
english: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, wärï lwötï ki mo  nøk røk moøgø ni twöï ge cer abïïnï.
english: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋï lwötö ki mo nøk rege ni leeŋï ge yi maac ni waaŋï ge. Køøre nø, maac manøgø oput keethø dï Icriel bäre.»
english: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba man bee gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Man bee Jerucalem, na tïïa ni ena dïër yïthakic wïth juurre, ni eno rum mïëri dïër.
