english: Thus saith the Lord God; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør rääö mare, ciik 'moa ki gïïa köömma eni ki ge akwiere, ni kaala wïth juurre ki mïëri moa en deŋŋe. Eni ciik 'moa akwiere, ni käre cäädhö ki køør gïïa köömma eni ki ge.»
english: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ï na Jerucalem, ïïna bëëdö niï tïïya okiera niï kaala wïth juurre moa en deŋŋï, ni kwierï gïïa köömma ïïni ki ge, ki ciik 'moa; këël ciik mo wïth juurre moa en deŋŋï ï kär jïëy ki geni.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luumma caana beeye en: Aani, a ööa maal bäätï, ï na Jerucalem, ni ö ajäla mara ni kïtha gø bäätï ni nëënö jï wïth juurre.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper kït gïï wø lamï bëët na näk yia raac ki ge, gïn mo poot kära tïïö cøøn mo ba cäŋa tïïyö këët tïïa tïïö dëërï.
english: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jøøa nyöödö ko obwöre, obwöre moge ocamge dïërï, ni ö obwöre ni camge jøøa nywøl ge thuwø. Ajäla mo leth okïtha bäätï, ni ö jiyi moï moo dööŋ ni kwøw ni keetha ge yïth tuk piny.»
english: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, kiper mana päätï øtø mara na en kur keere ki kït gïï wø lamï na reyø døc, ki gïïa näk ec raac ki ge, aani ki dëëra raa paanya paanyø buutï, ni ba nyoodha bäth ec mara jïrï wala ki man wara cwïnya ki ïïni.
english: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord God; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.

anywaa: Dää thäk jiy moï geno thøw dïërï ki täw mo raac ki käc, ni ö dää thäk jiyï møga ni näk geni ko opëëllö ŋää kiir marï, ni keetha dää thäk jiyï møga yïth tuk piny, ni puta køørge ŋwiec døc ko opëëllö.
english: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.

anywaa: «Køøre wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac nijook, ni ö wëërri mara ni døø piny ki geni, ni ö yia ni thume. 'Ba kanyo poot wëërri mara ni ena bäätge, oputge ŋäc ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cäänö ki geni ni aano këëyö.
english: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the Lord have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.

anywaa: Uuni, u raanynya raanynyø ni putu tïmö ni uuna gïr ajøøŋ yïthakic wïth juurre moa en deŋŋu, ki mo wø pöödhi ki buutu.
english: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo jääla uuni ki køør wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac, ki juuk mo teek, uuno tïmö na gïr ajøøŋ na gïr ajaany, na gïr ŋwøc, ni tïmu ni uuna gïn böö wïth juurre ki ge moa en deŋŋu. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: Aani, käc mo dwøŋ døc mo u thøw ki gø jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätu ni raany uuni. Käc tïïa tïïö nee puuthe bäätu, ni cuŋ jïëth caammi mou bëët.
english: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:

anywaa: Käc ki lääc paap moa reyø ojääŋŋa baŋu, ni putge uuni tïïc ni bäŋ obwöre jïïu. Täw ki køny remø piny ööa bäätu, ni käla thøw opëëllö bäätu. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe jïra,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ kïte mo Icriel, ni cäännï geni,
english: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,

anywaa: ni kööï, ‹Wui, u na kïte mo Icriel, wïnynyu dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk! Luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïïu, u na kïte, ki thuuri, ka agäp-kïte, ki gøli, bee en, ena köö: Ni ka adïëri møn, aani ki dëëra, a ööa baŋu ko opëëllö, ni jääla uuni, ni raanynya kwör lam mou moa en bäät thuuri.
english: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïï wø cïp olämme mou bäätge oränynyi, ni ö gïï wø waaŋ jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge ni tøc geni. Aani, u nääa nääö deŋ kït gïï wø lammu.
english: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.

anywaa: Aani, rïŋ dëëtu moa no othøw, u na jø Icriel, peedha piny deŋ kït gïï wø lammu, ni kera cuu mou piny deŋ gïï wø cïp olämme mou bäätge.
english: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.

anywaa: Päänye moa bëëdu yïthge bëët oränynyi, ni ö kwör lam mou moa en bäät thuuri ni ränyge, kiper nee gïï wø cïp olämme mou bäätge nee ränyge ni  tïmge ni bäŋgø; ni ö kït gïï wø lammu ni tøyi ni ränyge na bäre, ni ö gïï wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bäätge moa näk mou ni ŋødi piny, ni ö jammi moa tïïyu ni putge tïmö ni bäŋgø.
english: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.

anywaa: Jiy mou othøw ni nigenaaŋ yïthakiyu, ni ö uuni ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba aani, jiy møøk dëëtu owiia ni kwøw, kiper jiy møøk dëëtu geno bøth dho opëëllö, ni keethge dï wïth juurre ki yïth mïëri.
english: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo bøth, wïthge oparge ki aani kanyo enge yïthakic wïth juurre moa mak geni ki tøŋ. Geni wïthge oparge ki kanya bëëda ni cwïnya ege raanynyø ki køør mana bëëtge ni cwïnyge lääŋŋa käp, na pää geni ki aani, ki køør mana bëëtge ni nyeŋge ege peerø køør käp mana wara tïïcge ki kït gïï wø lamge. 'Ba geno männi ki dëëtge keerge ki køør japa reyø na bacge, ki japa näk yia raac ki ge bëët na tïïcge.
english: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.

anywaa: Køøre oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, ni luup moa cara patha oballe jaak kanya kööa ni bäätge kïtha kïthö ki gïn mo leth.›
english: And they shall know that I am the Lord, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Paŋ ceŋŋï ni tietï gøyï gøyø ki piny niï jwöŋö ni «Wui, wui,» kiper japa reyø na raac eci ki ge na tïïc jø dhi øt Icrielli. Geni, geno 'näk ko opëëllö, ki käc, ki täw.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.

anywaa: Ŋato en kany mo bäär onäk täwi, ni ö ŋato kare cään ni nääi ko opëëllö, ni ö ŋato dööŋ dï pääny no ociel dïër ni 'nägi ya käci. Kanyøgø nø, wëër mara owëëga thöör bäätge.
english: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.

anywaa: Køøre nø, oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk kanyo jootge jiy moge no othøw yïthakic kït gïï wø lamge, deŋ gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge, ki bäät thuuri moa bäyö, ki wïth kïte bëët, ki tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny, ki tiet jera teek bëët na bäyö, ni beege kwöra wara wääŋge yie ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï kït gïï wø lamge bëët.
english: Then shall ye know that I am the Lord, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, cera orwiea ni jääla geni, ni wëëga ŋöömö marge ränynyö døc, ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie ni kaala dïtëën mana cwøl ni Dïbila; køøre nø oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiper ŋööm Icriel bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Man beeye aŋuudi! Aŋuun nïne aö bäät wïth tuk piny karge ŋweeri mo ŋööm Icriel.
english: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.

anywaa: Ennø, aŋuun bëëtö maru aløny ni öö. Aani, wëër mara jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätu; luup mou ŋøla ŋølø ki køør uutjïëthe mou, ni ö gïïa raac eci ki ge na tïïyu bëët ni dwøga ge wïthu.
english: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.

anywaa: Aani, cwïnya ba pädhi ki gïru, ni ba wara cwïnya ki uuni; 'ba aani, u jääla jäälö ki køør bëëtö maru ki japa raac yia ki ge na en dïïu. Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö: Gïn mo leth aöö! Gïn mo leth mo poot kär wïnyö cøøn aöö!
english: Thus saith the Lord God; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.

anywaa: Aŋuun nïne aöö! Aŋuun nïne anø öö! Aløny ni tägö ki man käl ränynyö bäätu; anø öö!
english: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.

anywaa: Ajäla maru aö baŋu, u ni bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en! Kanya wäŋŋi aløny ni öö; cäŋa wäŋŋi kare cään. 'Ba otïmö ni nuta oduuru bäät kïte ni patha kwöŋŋö ki met ec.
english: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.

anywaa: Aani, ki kany mo cään, wëër mara kønynya bäätu, ni liel cwïnya ki uuni døc; ni ŋøla luup mou ki køør bëëtö maru, ni ö gïïa raac eci ki ge na tïïyu ni dwøga ge wïthu.
english: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.

anywaa: Aani, cwïnya ba pädhi ki gïru, ni ba wara cwïnya ki uuni; 'ba aani, u jääla jäälö ki køør bëëtö maru ki japa raac eci ki ge na en dïïu. Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ki man näk mo beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk na jääl uuni.
english: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the Lord that smiteth.

anywaa: « Ka adïëri møn, cäŋöca beeye en! Ena nø öö! Cäŋ man jääl uuni yie aløny ni öö; wëër mano ö bäätu anø tägö ki man nyooth ree; atöör anø  døøŋŋø bäätu.
english: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.

anywaa: Okiera anø døøŋŋø ni døøa røk jøøa reyø kaamar athøra mo pwöta ge ki gø. Bäŋ dhaanhø mo wec rege, wala røk lwaae moge, ni bäŋ jap kwär moge mo wec wala gïn mo pere leth jaak mo ena dïge.
english: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.

anywaa: Kanyaca anø öö, cäŋöca anø pïï. Jø wø ŋëëö ki jammi kär yïthge mïnnö, ni ö jø wø gädhö ni ba kïmge, kiper wëër mano ööi ööa bäät lwaak bäre.
english: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dïgädhi këët mo døø baŋ japa näk ee dwøk pwödhö këël aŋuun kwøw mare, kiper luum ajäla mana nyooth ööa bäät lwaak bäre ni ba kääŋi; 'ba kiper raay moge, bäŋ aciel dïge mo jwïëye di piemø.
english: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.

anywaa: 'Ba këël tuŋi dege koodhø ni jiiŋge jammi bëët, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo ci baŋ leny, kiper wëër mara ena bäätge bëët.
english: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

anywaa: «Opëëllö otïmö ni ena wøk töök kiir, ni ö täwi ki käc ni en yi kiir. Ŋato en yi pwödhö onäk ko opëëllö, ni ö jø wø en yi kiir ni thööri ya täwi ki käc.
english: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.

anywaa: 'Ba moo bøth ki thøø noo reŋi, geno tïmö ni ge bëëdö bäät kïte, ni ge jwöŋö kaamar akuyi yïth aleye, ni ŋati man nø jwøga raay moe.
english: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.

anywaa: Ceŋge oniläp bëët, ni ö nyeŋ cøkge ni øcge piny kaamar pïï.
english: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

anywaa: Geni, keece orøcge na abïïe ni bëët dëëtge ni kwanynyi ki lwär; wïthge otïmö ni laay bëët, ni ö wïthge ni gwääri wøk bëët.
english: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.

anywaa: Gwet-bïrö moge oleeŋge nyeŋ jïëthe, ni ö warkie moge ni tïmge kaamar gïn mo ba waany. Gwet-bïrö moge ki warkie moge otïmö ni bäŋ køny mo tïïcge kiperge kanyo tïme na ri cäŋ wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk. Japøge ba cïpi ki jäŋ jïge wala yïthge päŋ ki ge, kiper beege japa wëëk geni päth yïth raay.
english: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

anywaa: Gena töödö kiper jap mïërö moge, ni dëëtge kønyge kønyø ki ge ki man tïïcge kït gïï wø lamge na näk yia raac ki ge. Kiper manøgønø, aani japøge tïïa tïïö jïge kaamar gïn mo ba waany.
english: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.

anywaa: Japøge cïba ceŋ jøøa path ki jø piny moa reyø nee twierge, ni ö geni ni päätge ge.
english: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

anywaa: Aani täärnyïma oløøa wøk bäät jø Icriel, ni ö jøøa pathi ni päätge kar bëëtö mara na pere leth, ni put kuuwe døny yi gø thuwø ni päätge gø.
english: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.

anywaa: «Jiiŋ tiimme, kiper piny apäŋ ki jø wø køny rem jiy piny, ni ö päänynyi ni pääŋe ki jø okiera.
english: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

anywaa: Aani, a kännö ki wï jur mana näk raac døc, nee öge kuna lwørge mïëri mo jøøgø; aani, a ööa kuna raanynya atöör mar jøøa teek, ni ö kwör lam moge na en kur keerge ni wëëga ge nipäät.
english: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö lwärri bäätge, bëët mëër omanyge, 'ba otïmö ni bäŋgø.
english: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.

anywaa: Jammi mo leth otägi ni rege döötge döötö, ki waae mo ööi ni rege lwöbö, ni ö geni ni manyge luup mo wø nyooth ki baŋ nyikuk Jwøk; 'ba otïmö ni bäŋ ciik ki baŋ dïlämme, ni bäŋe pwöc ki baŋ jø døøŋŋø.
english: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.

anywaa: Nyeya okïmmi, ni ö jø kööre moe ni rïïŋ dëëtge ki lwär; 'ba jø paac bëët bäätge opädhi. Aani luup moge oŋøla ki køør bëëtö marge, ni jääla geni ki køør mana tïïcge. Kanyøgø nø oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïcier cwiiri, ni nïr dwää abïciel abïïc, ni beege cwiiya beetwa ni waano maa ki tøŋ, kanya ena yi øtø mara ni aano pï piny ni jø døøŋŋø mo Juuda geno pï piny nyïma, cer Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta kaace.
english: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord God fell there upon me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lwïtha, gïn mo kede dhaanhø aputa joot. 'Ba eni ki mana täge ki piere këël piny nëëni kaamar maac. 'Ba ki mana täge ki piere këël wïïe nëëni ni wärri kaamar nywïënyö mo ena yi maac.
english: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gïn mo bëëdö kede cere arwiee ni mak aani ki gø ki jïëc wïïa; ni ö Jwïëc Jwøki ni put a tïŋ maal yïthakic piny ki maal; ni kïth a Jerucalem ki ri gïï wø nyooth Jwøki ki yi wïc, ni kïth a dhi kal mana en jï løø wï-piny mar kal mana en dïër, kanya näk ocöönhnhö ki kït gïn wø lam na  käl këëny cwïny jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, ajiem Jwø Icriel aputa joot nyïma kaace, ni beeye teeŋ ajiem mo caala mana kwøŋ nyooth jïra bäät naam Kebar.
english: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, lwïthï jï løø wï-piny.» Kanyøgø na lwïtha jï løø wï-piny, kït gïn wø lam manøgø na käl këëny cwïny jï Wuuö Jwøk aputa joot dhi kal man wø døny baŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ köö jïra, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, japi ni raac eci døc ki ge ii na tïïc jø dhi øt Icrielli kany en, ni beege japo tïïc aani naa tïma ni kara bäär ki øtø mara na en kur keere, nëënö jïrï? 'Ba ïïni, ï cäŋa jïtö ki jammi mo ec raac ki ge døc mo kaala moi.»
english: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.

anywaa: Køøre aana käle ni kïth a dhi kal. 'Ba kanya lwïtha, aana jïtö ki kany mo ŋaam dëër kal.
english: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, cäŋ kanya ŋaam dëër kal koonynyø.» 'Ba kanya koonya gø, aana tuc wøk ni jïta ki dhi øtø mør.
english: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö, ni «Ciï ni raŋï japø ni reyø na näk ec raac ki ge ni ege tïïö kaa enø.»
english: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana dønyø ni puta dëër øtø manø bäre joot no ogöörö ki kït gïï wø muuli ki piny, ki kït lääy mo reyø, ki kït gïï mo määnö, ki kït gïï wø lam bëët mo jø dhi øt Icriel.
english: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed upon the wall round about.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïm gïïögø da jø døøk dhi øt Icriel ma pïërabïriiø mo cuŋŋö yie. 'Ba Jaadhania o Capan ena dï jø døøgøgø ni cuŋŋö thuwø; ni ŋati man nø dëëtge cere da gïn wø duuŋ gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met yie; ni gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met bëëdö ni duuŋ ceŋge yïth gïïögøøni.
english: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, gïn ni tïïc jø døøk dhi øt Icriel yi muudhö en, ni ŋati man nø ena øt kït gïï wø lame, nëënö jïrï? Kiper gena köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk wa ba nëëni jïre; Wuuö Jwøk ŋöömö marwa awiie.› »
english: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The Lord seeth us not; the Lord hath forsaken the earth.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö jïra, ni «Ge cäŋï ka jootø ni ge tïïö ki gïï wø raac eci ki ge døc mo kaala man.»
english: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aana kïth dhi kal mana en jï løø wï-piny ki øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni puta jïtö ka apoole mo jwöŋö kiper jwøk mo othøw mo cwøl ni Tamudh.
english: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the Lord's house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, gïn nëënö jïrï? Ï poot jïtö ki gïï wø raac eci ki ge døc mo kaala man.»
english: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi kal mana en dïër mar øt Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba dhi øt Wuuö Jwøk kaace yïthakic agööla ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, da cwøw mo jïtö ki pïërariiø ka abïïc mo ŋäthge ege løø baŋ øt Wuuö Jwøk ni nyïmge ege løø jï kur tuul-cäŋ, ni cøŋge ege këël piny ni rege kemø ki cäŋ ni ge lama gø.
english: And he brought me into the inner court of the Lord's house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the Lord, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the Lord, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, gïn ee, nëënö jïrï? ?Aŋø, bee gïn mo jööt jaak ki baŋ jø dhi øt Juuda ki man tïïge ki gïï wø raac yia ki ge kany, ni piny ege pääŋö ki tïïe mo raay ni ge wëëga aani gootø cooth? Raŋ ge mø, ge tïïö ki jap abuua!
english: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a wëër ki geni. Cwïnya ba pädhi ki gïrge këët, ni ba wara cwïnya ki geni. Ge këël doo jwöŋö deŋ ïtha ni döötge ena maal, aani ïtha ba ciia ko oduuru marge.»
english: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk awïnynya ni cwötö ki dwøl mo dwøŋ ni kööe, ni «Käl jiy kany moa näk ajäla mar pääny ocïp ceŋge, ni ŋati man nø gïr leny mare ena cere.»
english: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.

anywaa: Køøre aani, jiy abïciel ma cwøw aputa joot ni ge cäänhnhö ki dhi kiir mana en jï maal na en jï løø wï-piny ki øt Jwøk, ni ŋati man nø cere da gïr leny mar 'näk. 'Ba buut jøøgø da dhaanhø mør mo oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna mo käädö ki jap göör. Ni öge ni cuŋge deŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na näk tïïc ka nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.

anywaa: Køøre ajiem mar Jwø Icriel aö maal ki kanya en yie bäät kirubëlli, ni ci bäät thudhi mana en dhi øt Jwøk. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk, ŋata näk oruyö ka abïïk lïïna ni wø käär jap göör ni ee twöö piere acwøle.
english: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïre, ni «Ciï ni wïrï dï pääny Jerucalem bäre, ni kïthï täärnyïm jiy ki ŋïï, ni beege jøøa näk cwïnyge opädhö ni wø bëëdö ni ge cooyø ki jammi moø ni reyø ni tïïc yie yøø.»
english: And the Lord said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jøø na abïciel acäänne thuwø ni wïnyö jïra, ni «Cou køør ŋatøgø na jääŋŋa en dï pääny, ni 'nägu jiy; 'ba cwïnynyu kär pädhö ki gïrge, ni ba warru cwïnynyu ki geni.
english: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:

anywaa: 'Nägu geni ni bäŋgø mo dööŋ, ki mano täge ki jäle, ko obwöre moa näk wøpe, ki nyïïakuue, ko obwöre moa therø, ki mään; 'ba jøøa näk täärnyïmge da ŋïï kär gutu. 'Ba wär tägu ki øt lam mara.» Køøre aputge täk ki jø døøŋŋø moa en nyïm Øt Jwøk.
english: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïge, ni «Tïïyu Øt Jwøk ni ba waany ki rïŋ dëët jiy moa no othøw, ni pääŋŋu dï kal ki ge. Tägu nø!» Kanyøgø gena put aay ni cige wøk ni putge jiy 'näk moa en dï pääny.
english: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëtge ni ge nääö ki jiy, ni aano dööŋ keera buut Wuuö Jwøk, dëëra aleeŋa piny ni jwöŋa, ni kööa, «?Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør wëër marï mana kïthï bäät Jerucalem, jø Icriel moa bøth dhøk gïï mo leth raanynyï raanynyø bëët?»
english: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord God! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

anywaa: Køøre aløøe jïra ni kööe, ni «Raay atïmö ni thööth døc kiree dhi øt Icriel ki dhi øt Juuda, ni ŋøøm päŋ ki rem jiy, ni ö dï päänynyi ni pääŋe ki gïï mo reyø; ni ge köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk ŋøøm awiie, ni eni ba nëënö thuwø!›
english: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The Lord hath forsaken the earth, and the Lord seeth not.

anywaa: 'Ba aani cwïnya ba pädhi ki gïna tägö dëëtge, ni ba wiia geni, 'ba tïïe moge na reyø dwøga wïthge.»
english: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.

anywaa: Køøre ŋata näk oruyö ka abïïk lïïna ni wø käär jap göör ni ee twöö piere aduuö ni kööe, ni «Gïna köömmï aani ki gø anø tïïa.»
english: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

anywaa: Køøre aana lwïthö ni jooda gïna dwøŋ na näk ree ee peerø bäät nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli, ki gïn mo kede kïdi mo kïte caala caaro mo nëëni kaamar wälu mo ena wïth kirubëlli moøgø.
english: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï ŋata no oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna, ni «Ci yïthakic tiet jïëthe na en tiet kirubëlli, ni pääŋï ceŋŋï ki cuk maac na en yïthakic kirubëlli, ni ciï ni kerï ge dï pääny.» 'Ba ŋatøgø aput cøø naa raŋŋa gø.
english: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ci ŋatøgø, kirubëlli ge bëëdö ni ge cuŋŋö ki jï løø tier-piny ki øt Jwøk, ni yi kal mana en dïër bëëdö ni päŋ ki pöölö.
english: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

anywaa: Køøre ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk aput nirwöc bäät kirubëlli ni put pïï bäät thudhi mar dhi øt Jwøk. Ni ö øt Jwøki ni put pääŋö ki pöölö, ni yi kal päŋ ki tar mar ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then the glory of the Lord went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the Lord's glory.

anywaa: 'Ba dööt bwöm mo kirubëlli lwör ni wïnyö yi kal mana en wøk, ni wïnyi kaamar dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na en teeki jïre, kany wø cääne.
english: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na kööm ŋata näk oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna, ni «Kädï ki maac yïthakic kirubëlli tiet jïëthe,» ŋatøgø aput aay ni cuŋŋe deŋ tier jääy.
english: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kirubël aciel cere arwaak baŋ maac mana en yïthakicge ni lwöte ki maac ni cïp gø cer ŋata näk oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna; ni ö ŋatøgø ni lwør gø ni put aay ki gø.
english: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet bwöp kirubëlli moøgø da gïn mo nëëni kede cer dhaanhø.
english: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.

anywaa: 'Ba na lwïtha, aana put jïtö ki tiet jïëthe aŋween deŋ kirubëlli, ni tier jääy man nø ena deŋ kirubël man nø; 'ba tiet jïëthe moøgø ŋwaŋŋi kaamar waŋ kïdi.
english: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.

anywaa: 'Ba tiet jïëthe moø na aŋween yøø rege caalø, ni man nø nëëni kede da tier jääy mør mo ena yie ni rege gänö.
english: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø näk mo ge aay, ge puta aay ki løøk aciel mo nyïm moa na aŋween, ni ge puta aay ni ge caatha nyïmge ni rege ba løkge kany wø näk mo geno tïŋŋö.
english: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubëlli dëëtge bäre, ni beege dïŋäthge, ki ceŋge, ki  bwöpge, këël tiet jïëthe moa na aŋween na en buutge, bëëdö no ogääbö ki nyeŋ mo raŋ bëët.
english: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.

anywaa: 'Ba da dwøl ma awïnynya mo cwøla nyeŋ tiet jïëthe, ni «Tiet jïëthe mo wø løøŋ rege.»
english: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubël man nø jïre da täärnyïmmi ma aŋween. Täärnyïm mana dïkwøŋ nëëni na täärnyïm kirubël; 'ba rietge caala täärnyïm dhaanhø, ni dääge caala täärnyïm ŋuu, ni ö ŋweerge ni caal täärnyïm olwiith mana näk agweec.
english: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

anywaa: 'Ba kirubëlli moøgø gena määt maal. 'Ba geni beege gïïa kwøw moa nyooth jïra bäät naam Kebar.
english: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø cääth kirubëlli, tiet jïëthe moa en deŋge ge puta cääthö thuwø; ni kany wø ö kirubëlli noo peerge bwöpge ni marge määtö, tiet jïëthe moøgø thuwø deŋ kirubëlli ba wecge.
english: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö kirubëlli noo cuŋge, ge cuŋŋö thuwø; ni kany wø määt kirubëlli, ge määtö ki ge bëët, kiper tiet jïëthe ge bwøtha jwïëc gïïa kwøw na näk beege kirubëlli.
english: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

anywaa: Køøre ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk bäät thudhi mar dhi øt Jwøk awiie ni cuŋŋe bäät kirubëlli.
english: Then the glory of the Lord departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lwïtha, kirubëlli aputa joot ni bwöpge ege peerø ni marge määtö. 'Ba kanya määtge, gena put määtö na aciel ki tiet jïëthe. 'Ba na aacge, gena cuŋŋö dhi kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Øt Jwøk, na ajiem Jwø Icriel ena bäätge.
english: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the Lord's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögøøni beege gïïa kwøw na jooda tiet Jwø Icriel bäät Naam Kebar, ni puta ge ŋec ni beege kirubëlli.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögøøni man nø jïre da täärnyïmmi aŋween, ki bwöm aŋween, ni tiet bwöpge ki jï piny da gïï mo nëëni kede ceŋ dhaanhø.
english: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

anywaa: 'Ba täärnyïmge nëëni keda mana jooda ge bäät naam Kebar; ni man nø cäätha nyïme ni tiir.
english: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Jwøk aana tïŋ maal ni kïth aani dhi kal mana dïët ki dhi øt Wuuö Jwøk mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba dhi kal kaace da jiy yie ma pïërariiø ka abïïc. 'Ba Jaadhania wär Adhur ki Pelathiya o Benaya, ge na bëëdö na dïbwöthe mo jiy, gena jooda dï jøøgø.
english: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the Lord's house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, moøgø beege jøøa tudö ki luup mo reyø na cïpö ka acaare mo reyø yi pääny man,
english: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:

anywaa: na köö, na ‹?Aŋø, man paa caa man geer uudi yie nø? Pääny man wa di gwøø kaamar athaa wø gwøk rïŋö ki maac.›
english: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, cään geni niï jääla ge, cään geni!»
english: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe jïra, ni «Caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki jïïu, ena köö, ni ‹U na jø dhi øt Icriel, moøgø beege gïï wø caru, 'ba aani, acaara maru ŋääa.
english: And the Spirit of the Lord fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the Lord; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.

anywaa: Uuni jiy mo thööth anägu yi pääny man, ni pääŋŋu nyeŋ jïëthe moe ki dëët jiy moa 'nägu.›
english: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Jiy moa 'nägu na dëëtge leeŋu piny dï pääny beege rïŋö, ni ö päänynyi man ni näk athaa mar thaal. 'Ba uuni, u käla wøk yie.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.

anywaa: Uuni, u lwäär ko opëëllö; kiper manøgønø, opëëllö 'käla bäätu ni jääla u ki gø.› Manøgø beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki. Ni cäŋ köö,
english: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: no ‹U käla wøk yi pääny man, ni cïba u ceŋ jøøa path ni wëëga u jääl ki rege.
english: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.

anywaa: Uuni, u di nääö ko opëëllö; aani u jääla jäälö dï ŋööm Icriel bäre. Kanyøgønø ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Pääny man u ba gwøe kaamar athaa wø gwøk rïŋö ki maac, 'ba aani u jäälä jäälö dï ŋööm Icriel bäre.
english: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:

anywaa: Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk; kiper u ba cäädhi ka køør ciik 'moa; ciik 'moa käru kïth bäät tïïc; 'ba u cäädhi ka køør ciik mo wïth juurre moa en buutu.› »
english: And ye shall know that I am the Lord: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda naa cara luupögøøni, Pelathiya o Benaya aput thøø. Kanyøgø dëëra aputa gøø piny ki bäp yia ni puta köö ki dwøl mo dwøŋ døc, ni «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk! ?Jø Icriel moa no odööŋ ni kwøw wïthge poot dïïrï dïïrö na bäre møn?»
english: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord God! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, nyïïmeru, ni beege tuuŋu moa näk rem dëërï, na mak u ki tøŋ ki ge na aciel, ki jø dhi øt Icriel bëët, beege jøøa cään jø Jerucalemmi kiperge na köge, ni ‹Gena jiy mo karge bäär ki Wuuö Jwøk; ŋöömö man cïpa jïwa na marwa.›
english: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the Lord: unto us is this land given in possession.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiper jøøa mak ki tøŋ, ena köö, ni ‹Këël na bëëtge ni ge yaa riem kwör mo bäyö dï wïth juurre, ni ge yaa keethø dï mïëri, a poot bëëdö ki geni ki kany mo orømø yïth mïëri moa cige yïthge.›
english: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Ge lïma wøk dï wïth juurre, ni käla geni wøk ki yïth mïëri moa näk geno keethø yïthge, ni cäŋa ŋööm Icriel cïpö jïge.
english: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord God; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba noo duuge yi gø, kït gïï wø lam bëët na määnö na näk yia raac ki ge raanyge raanynyø.
english: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.

anywaa: Aani ge mooa mooø ki cwïny aciel ni mooa dëëtge ki jwïëy mo nyään; cwïnynyi moge na caal kïte käla wøk dëëtge ni mooa geni ki cwïnynyi mo jööm kaamar rïŋö.
english: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:

anywaa: Køøre nø, geno cäädhi køør ciik 'moa ni gwøkge luup 'moa, ni kïthge gø bäät tïïc. Geno bëëdö na jiy 'moa, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge.
english: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk cwïnyge onieŋ køør kït gïï wø lam na määnö na näk yia raac ki ge, japøgøøni dwøga wïthge.› » Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre kirubëlli bwöpge apeerge ni tiet jïëthe ena deŋge, na ajiem mar Jwø Icriel bëëdö ni ena bäätge.
english: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

anywaa: 'Ba ajiem Wuuö Jwøk aput ö maal ki dï pääny ni put cuŋŋö bäät kïdi na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki pääny.
english: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk aana tïŋ maal ni kïth aani yi Babiløn baŋ jiy moa no omaa ki tøŋ; ni manøgø tïïc ni di nyoodhø jïra ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk. Køøre gïna nyooth jïra na neena, aay bääta,
english: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.

anywaa: ni puta luup bëët moa nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jïra caan jï jiy moa no omaa ki tøŋ.
english: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the Lord had shewed me.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord also came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, ï ena dï jiy ma jø ageem. Gena jiy mo da nyeŋ jïge mo raŋ, 'ba ge ba rääŋö; ni da ïdhi jïge mo wïnynyö, 'ba ge ba wïnyö; kiper gena jø ageem.
english: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, twöc jammi moï kede man wø täk bööki paac; ni putï tïŋŋö ki dïcäŋ ni nëënö jïge ni kede täga böök. Beerra man tïŋŋï paac marï ni ciï paac mør niï nëënö jïge. Kanymør tier gïnögø kwanyge kwanyø, këël na bëëtge ni gena jø ageem.
english: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.

anywaa: 'Käl jammi moï wøk ki dïcäŋ ni nëënö jïge kede man wø täk bööki paac; ni putï tïŋŋö ka abøøya ni nëënö jïge ni kede täga böök ni jøw reŋŋa paac mør.
english: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.

anywaa: Ni koonyï kiir ni nëënö jïge ni tuyï gø ni dønynyï wøk ki yie.
english: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.

anywaa: Ni putï jammi moï tïŋ göönnï ni nëënö jïge, ni putï aay ki wäär ni käärï käärö. 'Ba täärnyïmï wär uumï nee ŋöömö ba jootï, kiper a tïïya ïïni na nyuudhi kiper jø dhi øt Icriel.»
english: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba aani japøgø atïïa kaawat mana kööm aani. Aani jammi 'moa akäla wøk ki dïcäŋ ni twöa ge kaaman wø tïïc cäŋ böök. Køøre ka abøøya kiir akoonya ki ceŋŋa ni tuya wøk; ni puta aay ki wäär ni jammi 'moa käära käärö ki göönna ni nëënö jïge.
english: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And in the morning came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «?Wär  dhaanhø, jø dhi øt Icriel moø na jø ageem yøø, ï kärge pëënynyö, na ‹?Agïne ni tïïyï en?›
english: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?

anywaa: Wär caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Tier gïn beeye kiper dïbwödhi mar Jerucalem ki jø dhi øt Icriel bëët mo wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem.›
english: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.

anywaa: Caanï jïge, ni ‹Aana nyuudhi kiperu, ni gïna tïïa enø beeye gïno tägi dëët jø Jerucalem. Geno kïth paac mør ni geno maa ki tøŋ.›
english: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.

anywaa: «Dïbwödhi marge jammi moe jiee göönne ki wäär ni døny wøk. Kiir di koonyø kipere ni pööth wøk ki kany mo ŋaam. Eni wïïe uume uumö nee ŋööm poge ba joode.
english: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ajääp mara peera peerø bääte ni puta eni mak ka ajääp mara. Eni kïtha yi Babiløn, yi ŋööm jø Kaldia, 'ba ŋöömmögø ba joode. 'Ba eno put thøø kunece.
english: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.

anywaa: Eni ki jiy mo wø en buute bëët, ki jø kööre moe, ki jø leny moe bëët, ge keetha keethø yïth tuk piny; ni puta køørge ŋwiec no opëëllö mara yaa wöth wøk.
english: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.

anywaa: «Kanyøgønø ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ki køør mano keetha geni dï wïth juurre ki yïth mïëri.
english: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.

anywaa: 'Ba aani jiy mo nøk dëëtge wiia wiiø ni kwøw ni ba nääa ko opëëllö, ki käc, ki täw. Kanyøgø nø, japa näk yia raac ki ge bëët na tïïcge caange caanø jï wïth juurre kwöra kïth geni yïthge, ni putge gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, wärï lwäyï kanyo enï bäät cam ki kwön, ni tïm dëërï ni kwanynyi ki lwär kanyo mäthï ki pïï.
english: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;

anywaa: Caanï jï jiy moa en yi ŋöömö maru ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem na en yi ŋööm Icriel bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Kwatge camge camø ni ge ena yi lwär, ni maathge pïï moge ni dëëtge kwanynyi ki lwär, kiper ŋöömö marge ränynyö ki jammi moa en yie bëët ki køør ageem man wø tïïc jiyi bëët mo wø en yie.
english: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord God of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.

anywaa: Päänye moa näk jiy thööth yïthge ränynyö, ni ö ŋöömö ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie. Køøre nø ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, ?Aperŋø ni ö jø Icrielli ni wara carge luubö man na leer, ni ‹Nïne apöödhö jaak ni luup moa nyooth bëët kär thur karge.›?
english: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?

anywaa: Ennø, caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Nïne mo wëëk luup moa nyooth bëët thur karge aløny ni öö. 'Ba luum leer manøgø oputa raanynyø nee ba cari këët dï Icriel.
english: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord God; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.

anywaa: Kiper otïmö ni bäŋ luup tööt këët mo di nyoodhø wala luup adïëda mo tïïca ec ni met ki ge mo di nyoodhø dï jø Icriel.
english: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, aano cäänö, ni ö luupi moo cara ni laarge thur karge ni ba ruu. Wui, u na jø ageem! Yïth nïne mou moo beetu nou kwøw, a cäänö ki uuni, ni ö luupi moo cara ni wëëga ge thur karge.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: For I am the Lord: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, jø Icriel aköö, ni ‹Jammi mo wø nyooth jïrï ruu ki cwiiri mo thööth ni ba laar thur karge, ni luup mo wø carï beege luup mo kwörge poot bäyö.›
english: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïge ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Bäŋ luup 'moa mo ruu këët ni ba laar thur karge; gïno wäro caana jaak thura kare.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö baŋa ni kööe jïra,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, kööm jø Icriel moa tïïc rege  na nyïïkuk Jwøk ni wø køp luup moge keerge. Caanï jïge, ni ‹Cegu ïthu ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk!
english: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the Lord;

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö: Noo tïmö ni raac jï jøøa bäŋ wïdhi, jøøa tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk ni wø caath køør acaare moge keerge, jø wø köö ni da gïï mo ege neenø, 'ba bäŋgø.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!

anywaa: Wui, Icriel, jiyï moa tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk ge bëëdö kaamar othööe mo bëëdö wï paac mo oränynyö.
english: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

anywaa: Ge kär ci kuna koorge kwöra ŋaam dëër kiir, ni bäŋe gïn mo ege tïïö ki man cäŋge kiir geerrø deŋ Icriel, nee jø Icriel cuŋge ri leny mar cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the Lord.

anywaa: Ge cäänö ki luup tööt ni da gïï mo onyoodhø jïge, ni marge adïëda jaak, ni ge köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø nø,» ni ge kär jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki. 'Ba ge poot ŋäädhö jaak ni luup moge thura karge.
english: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The Lord saith: and the Lord hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïge: ?Na aŋø, patha u ni wø cäänö ki luup tööt ni da gïï mo onyoodhø jïïu, ni maru adïëda jaak kany wø kööu, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø nø», ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa caanø?›
english: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The Lord saith it; albeit I have not spoken?

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgø nø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö: Kiper mana cäänu ki gïï mo patha adïëri nou cara luup tööt ni da gïï mo onyoodhø jïïu, u jääla jäälö. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Aani cera tïŋa maal bäät jø wø tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk ni jääla geni, jø wø cäänö ki luup tööt ni da gïï mo onyoodhø jïge, ni marge adïëda jaak. Geni, ge tïïa tïïö ni bäŋ karge yïthakic jaae 'moa, ni ba göör nyeŋge piny yi wëël nyeŋ mar jø dhi øt Icriel, ni ba døøge yi ŋööm Icriel na bäre bäre. Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni beeye aani na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper geni wïth jiya wø maaŋge maaŋŋø ni ge köö, ni «Paac beer jaak,» këël na bëëde ni bëët paac raac. Kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo tïïö ki kiir mo ba teek, rwøthge rwødhø ki booya.
english: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered mortar:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, caanï jï jøøa röödhö ki booya manøgø ki man näk mo kiir manøgø pädhö. Kiper køth mo dwøŋ mo muta piny mo ree da pey pätha bääte, ka atuunna mo kwödö ni teek døc.
english: Say unto them which daub it with untempered mortar, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kanyo päth kiirri, u ba pëënynyi, ni «Booya mana rwøthu kiir ki gø age?»
english: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?

anywaa: « ‹Kiper manøgø nø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö: Na atuunna mo kwödö ni teek døc tïïa tïïö nee kwönne ki køør wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac. Aani, a wëër ni jääŋŋa køth mo dwøŋ mo muta piny mo ree da pey, ni raanynya kiir manøgø na bäre ki wëër mara.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.

anywaa: Kiir mana rwøthu ki booya manøgø raanynya raanynyø ni neeruuth piny, ni tïm tiere ni nëënö wøk. 'Ba kanyo pädhe, uuno maae yie ni put ränynyö na aciel ki uuni bëët. Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Kar kanyøgø nø, aani wëër mara othööra bäät kiir ki bäät jøøa rwøth gø ki booya; ni caana gø jïïu, ni «Kiir ki jøøa rwøth gø aränynyö,
english: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;

anywaa: ni beege jø Icriel moa tïïc rege na nyïïkuk Jwøk, mo wø cään Jerucalem ni wø köö ni da jammi mo onyoodhø jïge ni paac beer jaak, këël na bëëde ni bëët paac raac.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.›
english: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, këël wïïï ri nyïïakuue mo jø pou moø ni wø cäänö ni da luup mo onyoodhø jïge yøø ki køør adïëda marge keerge. Cään geni,
english: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,

anywaa: ni kööï ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, no ‹Otïmö ni leth jï määr wø kwöny ceŋge bëët ki jap ajuuk, ni wø kwöö ka abïïk wø loop wïc mo ceŋge owiiø ni bäyö kiper nee loopge wïthge na jap maaŋge wïth jiy ki ge. ?Aŋø, løny ki man maaŋŋu wïth jiya ni wëëgu jwïëyu kwøw?
english: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?

anywaa: Uuni, aana päätu yïthakic jiya kiper beek wø cwøl ni gäbci mo ena yi thäny cenø ki thääŋ kwön. Ki køør mana cäänu ki luup tööt jï jiya mo wø cek ïthge ki jap tööt, jiy moa ba doo  rømø ki thøø anägu, ni ö jiyi moa ba doo rømø ki man bëëtge ni kwøw ni wëëgu ge kwøw.› »
english: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Aani, a män ki jap ajuuk mou mo wø maaŋŋu wïth jiy ki ge kaaman wø cek weny. Aani gïïöge cööda wøk ceŋŋu ni päda jiy mo wø cegu kaamar weny.
english: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.

anywaa: Abïïe mou mo wø loop wïc cööda wøk wïthu ni piema jiya ceŋŋu, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ teek maru bäätge këët ki man päthge ceŋŋu. Køøre nø ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper cwïny jøøa beyø awëëgu pädhö ki luup tööt mou; ni beege jøøa näk kära tïïö nee kïmge. 'Ba uuna tïmö nou cøømma cwïny jøøa reyø ki man ba wecge uutjïëthe moge na reyø, nee ge ba jïtge ki pïëm mana dege piemø ki gø.
english: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jap tööt mou mo wø caru no onyoodhø jïïu, ba jootu këët, ni bäŋ jap adïëde mo tïïyu këët. 'Ba aani jiya piema piemø ceŋŋu, ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre jø døøk Icriel møøk gena ö baŋa ni pïge piny nyïma.
english: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, jiy moi cwïnyge acïpge køør kït gïï wø lam ni cïpge nyïmge ki gïï mo reyø mo cwanynya tiel mo wëëga ge pädhö. ?Aŋø, pïëc moge mo wø pëënyge aani ki ge løny ki man dwøga gø jïge këët?
english: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cään geni, ni kööï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kany wø näk da ŋat Icriel mo cwïnye ee cïp køør kït gïï wø lam, ni cïp nyïme ki gïn mo raac mo cwanynya tiel mo wëëga gø pädhö, ni ö baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk kiper gïn mo di pëënynyö, aani ki dëëra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luumme dwøga dwøgø ki yi jöö mo puta rømø ki kït gïïa thööth ni wø lame.
english: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;

anywaa: Gïnögø tïïa tïïö naa duua cwïny jø Icriel baŋa, ni beege jø Icriel na wec aani kiper kït gïï wø lamge.›
english: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Løgu cwïnynyu ni weyu kït gïï wø lammu, ni kälu wïthu wøk ki bäät gïïa näk yia raac ki ge bëët ni wø tïïyu.
english: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø näk da ŋat Icriel wala ŋat ma wëëllö mo ena Icriel mo dëëre ee jädhö ki aani ni këël cwïnye køør kït gïï wø lam, ni cïp nyïme ki gïï mo reyø mo cwanynya tiel mo wëëga gø pädhö, ni ci baŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk kuna pëëny aani, aani ki dëëra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, luumme løøa løø jïre.
english: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him by myself:

anywaa: Aani wïïa këëlla ri teeŋ ŋatøgø ni tïïa gø na ŋïï mo jøw ŋääta ree, ni ŋula gø wøk dï jiy 'moa. Køøre nø ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ni näk mo nyikuŋ Jwøk ocøøgø ni tïme ni cara luup tööt, bee a na Wuuö Jwøk na wëëk gø cøøgø. Aani cera tïŋa maal bääte ni jääla gø ni raanynya gø yïthakic jiya ma jø Icriel.
english: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the Lord have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.

anywaa: Geni, ge jïtö ka ajäla ki køør raay moge, ni beeye ŋata cäänö ki nyeŋŋa ni ena nyikuŋ Jwøk ge ki ŋata pëëny gø bëët,
english: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;

anywaa: kiper nee jø Icriel tïmge ni wïthge ba løøge wøk ki aani këët, ni dëëtge ba raanyge keerge këët ki raay moge bëët. 'Ba geno bëëdö na jiy 'moa ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge.› » Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again to me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, ni näk mo da paac mo tïïö ki raay dëëra ki køør mano bëët jiye ki bëëtö mo patha kare, ni tïŋa cera maal bäätge ni jääla ge, ni ŋøla jöör cam marge, ni jääŋŋa käc bäätge ni nääa geni ki lääc paac moge,
english: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:

anywaa: këël jøøi na adäk ii doo nut rege, ni beege Nöa, ki Daniel, ki Jööp, bee jøøgø keerge noo piem ki køør bëëtö marge na beer.» Manøgø beeye dwøl mana caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo lääc paap yaa jääŋŋö yi ŋöömö marge, ni ö obwöre moge ni thööri ya lääyi moøgø, ni dööŋ ŋöömö keere ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat ŋuti ki yie kiper lääy,
english: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

anywaa: a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø, ni kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, këël jøø na adäk yøø doo nut dïge, ba løny jïge ki man piemge wäätge wala nyïïge; 'ba beege keerge noo piem. 'Ba ŋöömö marge dööŋ ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie.
english: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo opëëllö yaa jääŋŋö yi ŋöömö marge ni kööa, ni ‹Beerra man ö opëëllö ni wïr dï ŋöömö marge bäre,› ni ööa ni nääa geni ki lääy moge,
english: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

anywaa: a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø, ni kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, këël jøø na adäk yøø doo nut dïge, ba løny jïge ki man piemge wäätge wala nyïïge. 'Ba beege keerge noo piem.
english: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo täw yaa jääŋŋö yi ŋöömö marge, ni kønynya remø marge piny ki køør wëër mara mano jääŋŋa bäätge, ni nääa geni ki lääy moge,
english: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

anywaa: a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø, ni kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, këël Nöa, ki Daniel, ki Jööp doo nut dïge, ba løny jï ŋati man nø dëëtge ki man piem wääde wala nyaare. 'Ba beege ki dëëtge keerge noo piem ki køør bëëtö marge na beer.»
english: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord God, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, na «A teeŋ ränynyö mo nyïëdi noo tägi kanyo jääŋŋa ajäle aŋween 'moa mo reyø bäät jø Jerucalem, ni beege opëëllö, ki käc, ki lääc paap, ki täw, nee ge nääa ki lääc paac moge!
english: For thus saith the Lord God; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?

anywaa: 'Ba poot da obwöc cwøw ko obwöc mään mo dööŋ ni kwøw mo käla wøk ki yie. Geni, geno ö baŋu; 'ba kanyo jootu bëëtö marge, ki tïïe moge, uuno jïti ki cïp cwïny piny kiper gïïa leth bëët na kïtha bäätge, ge na jø Jerucalem.
english: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.

anywaa: Uuni, cwïnynyu cïbu piny ka ajäla mana pïï bäätge kanyo jootu bëëtö marge ki tïïe moge, kiper ŋäyu ŋääö ni gïna tïïa dëëtge paa gïrpiny jaak mo bäŋ tiere. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «?Wär dhaanhø, jaath mar omøk beere nidïï ni kaala bäädi mo jenni bëët mo wø en dï jenni mo paap?
english: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

anywaa: ?Jaath mare løny ki man kunynye ki man tïïc gïrpiny ki gø? ?Wala jaath mare løny ki man tïï na jaath man rääö nyeŋ øtø nee jammi lïër dëëre?
english: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?

anywaa: 'Ba kunynyö mare keere beeye ki man äp maac ki gø; 'ba kanyo waaŋ dhi jaathi, ni dëëre bäre ogut maaci, ?køøre nø, eni cäŋa kunynyö këët kiper gïn mør?
english: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?

anywaa: Ni näk mo kanya poode na paya ba løny ki man tïï na gïrpiny, ?a kanyo nø waaŋe nø, no onø tïmö na belø, olønye nidïï këët ki man tïï na gïrpiny mo kunynyö?»
english: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma cäŋ Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki caannø, ena köö, ni «Kaawat mana cïba jaath mar omøk dï jenni mo paap na gïn äp maac ki gø, aani thuwø jø Jerucalem tïïa tïïö na ennø nø.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Wïïa këëlla rege ni jääla geni. Këël mo geno ö wøk ki yi maac, ge poot thöör maaci thöörö. 'Ba kanyo këëlla wïïa rege noo jääla geni, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I set my face against them.

anywaa: Aani ŋöömö marge tïïa tïïö ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie. Kiper gena jiy mo bëëtö marge patha kare.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, japa näk yia raac ki ge na tïïc Jerucalemmi caanï jïre nee ŋääe.
english: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,

anywaa: Caanï jïre ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jï Jerucalem, ena köö, ni ‹Kanya kälï yie ki kanya nywøl ïïni yie beeye ŋööm jø Keenan; ni wäru beeye ŋat Amör, ni meru beeye nyijø Këth.
english: And say, Thus saith the Lord God unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.

anywaa: Kanya  lwaarø ki ïïni, peellï kär ŋølø, niï kär lwøø ki pïï niï tïmï niï waany, ni dëërï kär buuö ka acäbö, ni dëërï kär bääö ka abïï.
english: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo oraŋ ïïni ni mëër ee nyoodhø jïrï wala mo cwïnye opädhö kiperï ki man tïïc gïrpiny aciel kiperï dëët japøge. 'Ba mana tïïc, ïïna leeŋ wøk yi pwödhö mo laac, kiper jøw män ki ïïni.
english: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre aana cur buutï ni jooda ïïni niï ŋïëlö yi rem nyööt marï. 'Ba kanya bëëdï niï ena yi rem nyööt marï, aana köö jïrï, ni «Kwøwï!» Aana köö jïrï, ni «Kwøwï!», kanya bëëdï niï ena yi rem nyööt marï.
english: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.

anywaa: Ni puta ïïni piith kaamar jaath mar pwödhö, ni piidhï ni døøŋŋï, ni tïmï niï mïërö døc, ni ö thunhnhï moï ni døøŋge, ni ö jïërri mo nyooth dööŋö marï ni tucge dëërï; 'ba ï poot bëëdö ka dëërï ni bäŋ abïï.
english: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre na cäŋa cur buutï na raŋa ïïni, ïïno nø pïï ri cwiic nywöm. Kanyøgø abïï mara aputa peer bäätï ni buŋa dëërï ki gø kiper wääth dëël marï; ni kööŋa ki man nywøma ïïni ni tuda ki luubö ki ïïni, ni putï tïmö ni ïïna thööŋŋa. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord God, and thou becamest mine.

anywaa: Aani ïïna lwøa ki pïï ni pïnya remø wøk dëërï ni wïïra dëërï ki maaw.
english: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.

anywaa: Aani, dëërï arunynya ka abïï mo okwøø ni mïërö døc ni kïtha tietï ki war mo tïïc ka pïën. Dëërï arunynya ka abïï ma lïïna ka abïï mo gäte teek.
english: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.

anywaa: Aani, ïïna tïïa niï mïërö ki jap mïërö, ni kïtha ceŋŋï ko oguudi, ni kïtha cwaagï ki tii,
english: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.

anywaa: ni kïtha umï ki gwelø, ni kïtha ïdhi moï ki gwet ïdhi, ni kïtha wïïï ka aduda mo mïërö.
english: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø dëërï abëëdö ni mïërö ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö, niï käära abïïk lïïna mo pøøth ki teeŋ abïïe møøk mo beyø. Ni cam marï beeye møø mo pøøth, ki maar kïc, ki maar nyïïjenni; ni tïmï niï mïërö døc ni putï tïmö ni ïïna gwanynyø.
english: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.

anywaa: Ni put nyeŋŋï wïnyö dï wïth juurre ki køør mïërö marï; kiper ajiem mana cïba jïrï, mïërö marï awëëk thur kare. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ïïna tïmö niï ŋäätha mïërö marï, ni tïïyï wïny nyeŋ marï ni beeye jöö man gathï dëërï ki gø ki käp. Ïïna tïmö ni marï buut ki ŋat wø ö baŋï jaak, ni tïm mïërö marï ni beeye kiper käp.
english: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

anywaa: Ïïna lwötö røk abïïe moï moa näk rege da kït ma teeŋi ni tïïyï kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri ni mïërö ki ge, ni tïïyï ge ni beege mo käbï bäätge; ni gïnögø paa gïn mo løny ki man täge wala ki man tïï.
english: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.

anywaa: Ïïni thuwø, jap mïërö moa beyø na cïba jïrï, na näk tïïc ka warkey mara ki gwel-bïrö mara, akälï ni tïïyï ge na kït gïï wø lam ma cwøw, ni tïïyï ge na cwøwï mo buudï ki geni.
english: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,

anywaa: Ni ö abïïga beyø moï ni kälï ge ni rïëbï ge dëëtge, ni ö maawi mara ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met 'moa ni cïbï ge nyïmge na muuy.
english: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

anywaa: Caammi thuwø moa cïba jïrï nee camï, ni beege møø mana pøøth, ki maar nyïïjenni, ki maar kïc, acïpï jïge na muuce mo ŋwääi ni met. Moøgø beege japa tägö na tïïyï. 'Ba luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹Obwöc cwøw moï ko obwöc mään moï moa nywøla ki ïïni acïpï no olämme jï kït gïï wø lam ni tïmge na cam kiperge. ?Aŋø, bëët käp marï man wø gathï dëërï poot ba rømi nø?
english: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,

anywaa: Obwöre 'moa aŋarï ni cïpï ge no olämme jï kït gïï wø lam.
english: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

anywaa: Ki yïth japa reyø na tïïyï bëët ki mana bëëdï niï gatha dëërï ki käp marï, wïïï kärï parø ki nïr thïnhö marï, kanya bëëdï niï bëëdö ka dëërï ni bäŋ abïï, niï ŋïëla yi rem nyööt marï.
english: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
