anywaa: « ‹'Ba a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a cäänna ïïni, «Otïmö ni leth kiperï! Otïmö ni leth jïrï!» Japa reyø bëët na tïïyï, bäätge acäŋï mëënnö ki møøk.
english: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord God;)

anywaa: Kwöra laac bëët na en dï kiir agëënnï ki kwör lam mo juuga reyø kiper dëërï, ni iï geerø ni ena maal.
english: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.

anywaa: Yïth agääk jïëthe bëët agëënnï ki kwör lam mo juuga reyø kiper dëërï; ni døøyï mïërö  marï rääö; niï bëëdö ni tietï iï peerø jï cwøw bëët mo wø cur buutï niï kaatha käp marï.
english: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.

anywaa: Ïïna käbö thuwø ki jø paac mana kïïï ki gø, ni beege jø Ijep mo wø mëër ki niine, ni putï käp marï kaath niï tïïya aani naa goota.
english: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, cera atïŋa maal bäätï ni jääla ïïni ni tïïa ŋøøm moï ni nøk; ni cïba ïïni ceŋ nyïïmän moï na many ïïni, ni beege jø Pilitin na wïthge lää ki bëët käp mana tïïyï.
english: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

anywaa: Ïïna käbö thuwø ki jø Aciria kiper yiï kär thum; køør manøgø ïïna put bëëtö niï käbö jaak ki geni ni yiï poot ba thum.
english: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

anywaa: Ïïna käbö døc thuwø ki jø Babiløn, jø wø bëëdö na jø gath, 'ba këël na tïïyï manøgø thuwø ïïna cäŋ bëëtö ni yiï poot ba thum.› »
english: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk acäänö ki Jerucalem, ni kööe, na «?A teeŋ rääya ŋø ni raayï ki gø en? Jammi moøgø bëët atïïyï ni ïïna kääbi mo waŋï teek jaak.
english: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord God, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

anywaa: Kanya geerï øt lam marï yïth agääk jïëthe, ni tïïyï kwör lam møga ni iï geerø ni ena maal kwöra laac dï kiir, ïïna tïmö kede ï patha kääbi, kiper ï ba many gwel mo di coolø jïrï.
english: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;

anywaa: Nya, ï na dhaagø ma kääbi mo buut ka jiy mo path mo patha cwøre en!
english: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø gath dëëtge ki käp, ge wø di cunnö ki gwel, 'ba ïïni, ï cïpö ki muuce jï omëërri moï jaak niï ŋeewa geni ki man öge baŋï ki kwöra enge yïthge bëët, ni käbï ki ge.
english: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, käp marï opääö ki mo jiy møga; ïïni bäŋ dïcwøø mo rïïŋi køørï. Käp marï opääö møn, kiper ïïni ï cïpö ki jammi, ni bäŋ jammi mo cïp jïrï.
english: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na kääbi, wïny dwør Wuuö Jwøk!
english: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the Lord:

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana bëëdï ni riï päädö ni dëërï iï wii wøk jï omëërri moï mo wø käbï ki geni, ge ki kït gïï wø lamï bëët na näk yia raac ki ge, niï bëëdö ni rem mo wäätï kønynyï piny jï kït gïï wø lamï,
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, aani a öö ni cooŋa omëërri moï ni wø jïtï ki met ec ki ri niine ki ge, ni beege jø wø mëërï ki ge bëët, këël jø wø mänï ki geni. Aani, ge cooŋa cooŋø ki kwöra enge yïthge bëët, ni pwödha abïïnï wøk dëërï nyïmge ni putge dëërï bäre neetø niï bëëdö ka dëërï.
english: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø ï jääla jäälö kaamar dhaagø mo okännö ki luk wala mo okuny piny ki rem dhaanhø, naa coola kwör japa tïïyï; ni manøgø tïïa ka køør wëër mara ki këëny cwïny mara.
english: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

anywaa: Køøre ï cïba ceŋ omëërri moï, ni ö geni ni toorge uut lam moï piny, ni raanyge kwör lam moï moa en bäät thuuri, ni pwöthge abïïnï wøk dëërï, ni kälge jap mïërö moï wøk dëërï, ni wecge ïïni jaak niï bëëdö ka dëërï ni bäŋ gïrpiny riï.
english: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.

anywaa: 'Ba geno kän bäätï ki lwaak ni këërge ïïni ki kïte, ni ŋøørge ïïni ni thenh thenh ko opëëlle moge.
english: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

anywaa: Uudi moï owaaŋge ki maac, ni jäälge ïïni ni nëënö nyïm mään mo thööth. Aani käp marï tïïa tïïö nee ŋuude, ni tïmï niï ba cïpï ki jammi këët jï omëërri moï.
english: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

anywaa: Køøre nø wëër mara käla wøk bäätï, ni ö këëny cwïny mara ni paany ree bäätï, ni bëëda ni cwïnya yaa bäädhö ni bäŋ wëër cwïnya ki ïïni këët.
english: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kiper mana bëëdï ni wïïï kärï parø ki nïr thïnhö moï, ni tïmï niï wëëga aani gootø ki jammi moøgø bëët, ka adïëri møn, gïïa tïïyï bëët dwøga wïïï. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. ?Aŋø, bëët käp marï kärï cäŋ meet bäät japa reyø møga bëët na näk yia raac ki ge na tïïyï?
english: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord God: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ennø, jiy bëët mo wø ŋäädö ki luup, aŋaada man ocaange kiperï, ni «Nyilaar dhaagø wø ŋwaala bëët menni.»
english: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.

anywaa: Ïïni, ïïna nyi meru møn na männö ki cwøre ko obwöre moe; ïïni, ïïna cöögö møn dï nyïïmeru moa männö ki cwøwge ki nyïïge. Meru beeye nyijø Këth, ni wäru beeye ŋat Amör.
english: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

anywaa: Coku mana dwøŋ na näk dhaagø beeye Cameria, ni beeye ni wø bëëdö ki nyïïe jï løø wï-piny ki ïïni; ni coku mana thiinh beeye Cødam, ni beeye  ni wø bëëdö ki nyïïe jï løø tier-piny ki ïïni.
english: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.

anywaa: 'Ba ï kär bëëdö keere niï caatha køør tïïe moge niï temma tïïe moge na näk yia raac ki ge. 'Ba ki yïth tïïe moï bëët ïïna köö ni moøgø nøk, ni cäŋï tïïö ki mo kaala moa tïïcge bëët.
english: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

anywaa: A na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, kaaman bëëda naa kwøw en, a caana gø jïrï, coku ma Cødam ge ki nyïïe, bäŋ gïn mo ege tïïö mo caala mana tïïyï ki nyïïï.
english: As I live, saith the Lord God, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba raay mo coku ma Cødam bee en: Eni ki nyïïe ge töödö kiper jïge da cam mo päl ni ge ena yi bëët jwöm; 'ba jiy moa can na näk bäŋ gïrpiny ceŋge ba kønyge.
english: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

anywaa: Gena tïmö ni marge atöör ni ge temma jammi nyïma mo yia raac ki ge. Kiper manøgønø, wïthge adïïra kanya jooda geni ni ge temma japøgø.
english: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.

anywaa: Raay moa tïïyï, këël thääŋŋe bäŋgø mo otïïc jø Cameria. Jammi moa raac yia ki ge na tïïyï okadhø ni kaala moa tïïcge, ni tïïyï nyïïmeru ni kede ge beyø ki køør japa näk yia raac ki ge bëët na tïïyï.
english: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïïï lääe, kiper nyïïmeru atïïyï ni kede ge beyø. 'Ba kiper mana näk mo raay moï okadhø ni kaala moge, gena nëënö ni ge beyø ni kaala ïïni. Kiper manøgønø, wïïï lääe ni røm lään wïci marï dëërï, kiper nyïïmeru atïïyï ni kede ge beyø.
english: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba aani, bëëtö mar Cødam ki nyïïe ki bëëtö mar Cameria ki nyïïe dwøga kare, ni dwøga bëëtö marï kare thuwø ki geni ciel,
english: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:

anywaa: kiper nee lään wïc marï røm dëërï, ni lää wïïï ki køør japa tïïyï bëët niï wëëga nyïïmeru cøm cwïny.
english: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.

anywaa: Køøre nø, nyïïmeru, ni beege Cødam ge ki nyïïe, ki Cameria ge ki nyïïe, geno døø ri bëëtö mana kwøŋge bëëtö ki gø dïkwøŋ, ni ö ïïni thuwø ki nyïï ni døøï ri bëëtö mana kwøŋï bëëtö ki gø dïkwøŋ.
english: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï kär bëëdö niï ŋääta dëër coku ma Cødam yïth nïra beetï niï tïïya atöör,
english: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,

anywaa: ni beeye kanya poode ni japa tïïyï na reyø poot kär nëënö? 'Ba ennø, ïïna tïmö na gïr kwääk jï nyïïakuk Ëdöm ki jø wø bëëdö deŋŋe bëët, ki jï nyïïakuk Pilitin; jiy bëët moa en deŋŋï ïïna taakge.
english: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø jïrï, moøgø beege nyïëdi moa duu bëët käpi marï ki japa näk yia raac ki ge na tïïyï.
english: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luum caana jïrï bee en: Gïnögø tïïa tïïö dëërï kaawat mana tïïyï gø, kiper gïna kööŋï kipere aweyï ki køør mana raanynyï luumma tuut ki ïïni.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba aani wïïa poot para parø ki luumma tuuda ki ïïni yïth nïr thïnhö moï. 'Ba ennø, a tudö ki luubö ki ïïni mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.

anywaa: Køøre nø, wïïï oparï ki uutjïëthe moï ni lää wïïï kanyo jootï nyïïmeru, ni beege mana riek ki mana thiinh. Ge cïba cïbö jïrï kaamar nyïïï, 'ba paa ki køør luumma tuuda ki ïïni.
english: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.

anywaa: Aani luumma tuuda ki ïïni wëëga thur kare. Kanyøgønø ŋäyï ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord:

anywaa: Køøre nø, noo wëënna ïïni ki japa reyø bëët na tïïyï, wïïï oparï ni lää wïïï, ni ba japï dhiï këët kiper lään wïc marï.› » Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, caan luummi na leer jï jø Icriel.
english: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;

anywaa: Ni kööï jïge ni man bee gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Da odhuuth mo dwøŋ, mo bwöm moe teek døc no okwöre moe bäyö, mo dëëre da kït ma teeŋi, mo öö lur Libaanø, ni käl wï jaath mana pere leth na näk wïïe opööth maal.
english: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:

anywaa: Eni wï jaath mana näk opööth maal atuur wøk ni aae ki gø ni kïth gø yi ŋöömma näk kar gath, ni piith gø yi pääny jø gath.
english: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

anywaa: « ‹Eni thuwø, ena kän wøk ki kunhnhö ki yi ŋöömmögø ni piith gø yi ŋöömö mo beer, ni piith gø kaamar ageeta kany mo pïï thööth yie.
english: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.

anywaa: Ni put døøŋŋø, ni tïme no omøk mo dwøŋ ni bääte olaak, ni ö bäädi moe ni løø gø baŋ odhuuth;  'ba lweete odøny piny døc kanya en yie. Ni put tïmö no omøk mo dwøŋ, ni jïte ki bäädi ni lødhe.
english: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba da odhuuth mør thuwø mo dwøŋ, mo bwöm moe teek, mo dëëre päŋ ko okwöre. Kanyøgø omøk lweete aløø baŋ gø ki kanya näk eno piidhø yie, ni peer bäädi moe baŋ gø kiper nee jïte ki pïï.
english: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

anywaa: 'Ba omøk manøgø ena piith yi ŋöömö mo beer, mo yie da pïï mo thööth, 'ba eni doo løny jïre ki man jïte ki bäädi ni nywøle ki nyïëdi ni tïme na jaath omøk mo mïërö.›
english: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.

anywaa: «Caanï jïge ni man bee gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, no ‹?Omøk manøgø, løny ki man lødhe ni døøŋŋe? ?Eni ee, lweete ba puth wøk ni ö nyïïe ni pøni piny ni tale? Eni bäädi moe mo løth tal. 'Ba ki man pudhi wøk, eni ba many cenø mo teek wala jiy mo thööth.
english: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord God; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, këël na cäŋi piithø, eni poot løth këët? ?Eni ba tal na bäre bäre kanyo näk mo eno gøøc jam wø ööi ki kur tuul-cäŋ? ?Eni ba tal kanya näk eno piith yie?› »
english: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jø ageem moøgø, ni ‹?Gïï ni cari ii, tietge kuyu?› Caanï jïge ni tiet gïïögø bee en: Nyeya mar Babiløn aci Jerucalem, ni käl nyeya ki jø kööre moe ni kïth geni yi Babiløn.
english: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;

anywaa: Ni lwöte ki dhaanhø ri tuuŋ nyeya ni tude ki gø ki luubö, ni tïïc gø nee kööŋe. Eni thuwø dïbwöthe mo paac amaae ki tøŋ ni käl ge,
english: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:

anywaa: kiper nee buc nyec dwøk piny ni ba duu maal këët; 'ba nee bëëde ni nut ki køør mano koor gïna näk ee tuudö.
english: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya agëëmö ki ŋata cuum gø, ni jääk Ijep ki jiye nee känge ko okwëënyi ki jø leny mo thööth. ?A ennø, gïnögø thura kare jïre? ?Ŋat wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø bøth ka ajäla? ?A eni, løny jïre ki man raany luubö mana näk ee tuudö ni bødhe ka ajäla?
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?

anywaa: «'Ba aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø ni kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, ŋatøgø thøw yi Babiløn, yi ŋööm nyeya mana cïp gø bäät wälu, ni beeye ŋata taak kööŋ na raany luumma tuude.
english: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.

anywaa: 'Ba Peerø ki jø leny moe na thööth na teek døc ki lwaae moe, ŋatøgø ba cwakge ri leny, këël na bëëtge ni ge thøra ŋøøm ni ge tïïö ki gïï wø cielge kiir ki ge, nee jiy mo thööth 'näkge.
english: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:

anywaa: Eni luumma kööŋe kipere ataae, ni raany luumma tuude; 'ba kiper mana tïïc gïïögø bëët ni cere ee nø cïp, eni ba bøth ka ajäla.
english: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, eni ataa mare mana taak kööŋ mara ki gø, ki luumma tuuda na raanynye, odwøga wïïe.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.

anywaa: Aani ajääp mara opeera bääte, ni maa gø ka abïëp mara. Eno kïtha yi Babiløn ni ŋøla luubö bääte kiper gïna tïïe dëëra na näk patha kare.
english: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.

anywaa: Jø leny moe moo päär wøk, ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni ö moo dööŋ ni keethge yïth tuk piny. Køøre nø, putu ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cäänö.› »
english: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba man bee gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Aani lwinh jaath mana pere leth na näk wïïe opööth maal okäla ni piidha gø kany mo ena maal wï kïdi mana bäär døc.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

anywaa: Eni piidha bäät kïdi mana bäär døc ni beeye kïdi mar Icriel. Eno jïti ki bäädi ni nywøle ki nyïëdi ni tïme na jaath mo mïërö mo pere leth. Teeŋ weny bëët geno gëët bääte ki uudi, ni tïm bäädi moe na tïpö jïge.
english: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø jenni bëët moa en yi pwöla oputge ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø dwøk jaath mana bäär piny, ni wø tïïc jaath mo ciek nee piidhe ni bäär; ni wø tïïc jaath mo onigïït piny nee näre, ni wø tïïc jaath mo otal nee lødhe. Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na caan luummögø; puta ka tïïc nee thur kare.»
english: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the Lord have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken and have done it.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,

anywaa: ni «?Tiere aŋø ni wø  caru aŋaada man kiper ŋööm Icriel na ennø en, «ni ‹Wëëe gena cämö ki nyïïomøki mo wac, ni tïm lak obwöre moge ni liir.›?»
english: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, ka adïëri møn, ba løny jïïu këët ki man caru aŋaada man yi ŋööm Icriel.
english: As I live, saith the Lord God, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jwïëy mo jiy bëët beege 'moa; jwïëy mo wëëe ki jwïëy mo obwöre beege 'moa ge bëët. Ŋat wø tïïö ki raay bee eni noo thøw.
english: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo bëëtö mare tiir mo tïïya gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ,
english: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

anywaa: mo eni ba cämö ko olämme mo wø cïp jï juuga reyø yïth uut lam moa en bäät kïte, wala ki man wøør kït gïï wø lam mo jø Icriel, mo cï wati ba pääde, ni ba buti ki dhaagø mo kar pïïn piny mare opäŋ,
english: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

anywaa: mo bäŋ ŋat mo caare, ni gïn mo ee kälö na dïgïti dwøge dwøgø jï ŋata mäyö baŋe, mo eni ba twëëdö, 'ba eni cïpö ki cam jï jøøa no onäk käci, ni jiy moa näk cäädhi ka dëëtge, dëëtge runynye runynyö ka abïïe,
english: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;

anywaa: ni jammi mo wø mac jiyi baŋe ba tïïe nee dwøgi jïre ni da wïthge, mo ceŋŋe ee mänö ki man tïïe ki gïn mo raac, ni luup ŋøle ŋølø na adïëri yïthakic jiy ariiø,
english: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,

anywaa: mo eni cäädhi ka køør luup 'moa ni ciik 'moa ee gwøø na kare, teeŋ ŋatøgø nø beeye dhaanhø mo bëëtö mare tiir; ka adïëri møn, eni bëëdö ni kwøw. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk teeŋ ŋatøgø jïre da wääde ma ŋat ageem mo kunynya piny ki rem jiy, wala tïïya teeŋ jammi møøk mo reyø dëër wati,
english: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,

anywaa: ni eni na näk wuuö ki dëëre teeŋ japøgø ba tïïe, 'ba wääde manøgø cämö ko olämme mo wø cïp jï juuga reyø yïth uut lam moa en bäät kïte, ni eni cï wati pääde päädö,
english: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,

anywaa: ni jøøa can na näk oööl caare caarø, ni twëëdö, ni gïn mo ee kälö na dïgïti ba dwøge jï ŋata mäyö baŋe, ni eni bëëdö ni wøøra kït gïï wø lam, ni eni tïïö ki gïï mo yia raac ki ge,
english: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,

anywaa: ni jammi mo wø mac baŋe tïïe tïïö nee duui jïre ni da wïthge, ?aŋø, teeŋ ŋatøgø løny ki man bëëde ni kwøw? Ba løny ki man bëëde, kiper eni japøgø ni raac yia ki ge bëët yøø atïïe. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, eni di nääö ni thøøe ni thuunhnha tïïe moe.
english: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.

anywaa: «'Ba nyilaal manøgø ni näk da wääde thuwø mo raay mo wø tïïc wänni ee neetø bëët, ni kweere ki man tïïc teeŋ japøge,
english: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,

anywaa: ni eni ba cämö ko olämme mo wø cïp jï juuga reyø yïth uut lam moa en bäät kïte, wala ki man wøør kït gïï wø lam mo jø Icriel, mo eni cï wati ba pääde,
english: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,

anywaa: ni eni bäŋ ŋat mo caare, wala ki man kan gïn mo ee kälö na dïgïti ni ba dwøge, ni ba twëëdö, 'ba jiy moa no onäk käci mooe mooø ki cam, ni jiy moa näk cäädhi ka dëëtge, dëëtge runynye runynyö ka abïïe,
english: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,

anywaa: ni ceŋŋe ee mänö ki man tïïe ki raay, ni jammi mo wø mac baŋe ba tïïe nee dwøgi jïre ni da wïthge, ni ciik 'moa ee gwøø, ni eni cäädhi ka køør luup 'moa, teeŋ nyilaal manøgø eni ba thøw kiper raay moa tïïc wänni; 'ba ka adïëri møn, eni bëëdö ni kwøw.
english: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.

anywaa: 'Ba wänni thøw kiper raaye keere; kiper eni wati amøde ni twier gø ki teek, ni tïïe ki gïï mo reyø yïthakic jø poge.
english: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk mo u poot pëëö, na ‹?Aperŋø ni tïm nyilaalli na ajäl raay mo wänni kär pïï dëëre en?› beeye kiper mana ö nyilaalli na tïme ni tïïya gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ, ni bëëdö ni wïïe ee gwøø ki man gwøk luup 'moa bëët. Kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, eni bëëdö ni kwøw.
english: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø tïïö ki raay bee eni noo thøw. Nyilaal ba doo jäälö kiper raay moa tïïc wänni, ni wuuö ba doo jäälö kiper raay moa tïïc wääde. Ŋata beer wø maga japa beyø na tïïe, ni ŋata raac japa reyø na tïïe dwøga wïïe.
english: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk da ŋat raay mo cwïnye ee løø yïth raay bëët moa näk ee bayø, ni gwøk luup 'moa, ni bëëde ni tïïya  gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ, ka adïëri møn, eni bëëdö ni kwøw; eni ba thøw.
english: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

anywaa: Raay bëët moa tïïe, bäŋgø mo wïc di parø ki gø mo dwøga wïïe. Eni bëëdö ni kwøw kiper japa beyø na tïïe.»
english: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «?Aŋø, løny ki man mïn yia ki thøø mar ŋat raay? Ba doo løny; 'ba man manynya beeye ki man løk ree nee bëëde ni kwøw.
english: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord God: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk ŋat mo bëëte tiir bëëtö mare na tiir wiie wiiø, ni tïïe ki gïï mo yia raac ki ge mo caala moa tïïc ŋata bëëte raac, ?eni bëëdö ni kwøw? Ba løny; eni japa beyø bëët na tïïe, bäŋgø mo wïc di parø ki gø. 'Ba eni thøw, kiper mana bëëde ni bëëte patha kare, ki køør bääyö mare, ki raay moa temme.
english: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.

anywaa: «'Ba kanymør u poot köö, ni ‹Jöö man tïï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki ki gø en ba tiir.› 'Ba ennø, wïnynyu, u na jø Icriel! ?Aŋø, jöö mara ba tiir? ?Aŋø, paa uuni na näk jïëthe mou ba tiir?
english: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋat mo bëëte tiir bëëtö mare na tiir wiie wiiø ni tïïe ki raay, eni thøw ki køør raay moa tïïe; eni thøw møn kiper raay moa tïïe.
english: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋat mo bëëte raac, cwïnye løøe løø yïth japa reyø na temme, ni tïme ni tïïya gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ, eni jwïëye pieme piemø.
english: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.

anywaa: Kiper eni wïïe acaare yïth japa reyø bëët na tïïe, ni käl ree wøk yïthge; kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, eni bëëdö ni kwøw; eni ba thøw.
english: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel acäŋ köö, ni ‹Jöö man tïï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki ki gø en ba tiir.› ?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, uutjïëthe mo tïïa ki ge ii ba tiir? ?Aŋø, paa uuni na näk uutjïëthe mou ba tiir?»
english: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na jø Icriel, aani u jääla jäälö. Ŋati man nø dëëtu jääla jäälö ki køør bëëtö mare. Løgu cwïnynyu, ni ööu wøk ki yïth japa reyø bëët na tïïyu; køøre nø raay otïmö ni paa gïn wëëk uuni pädhö këët.
english: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord God. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.

anywaa: Kälu dëëtu wøk ki yïth japa reyø bëët na tïïyu; tïïyu cwïnynyu ni nyärö, ni tïïyu jwïëyu ni nyärö! ?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, aperŋø ni manynyu thøø en?
english: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

anywaa: Kiper aani yia ba met ki man dee dhaanhø mo thøw dëëtu. Kiper manøgønø, løgu cwïnynyu nou kwøwu.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord God: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ïïni, wärï ki duut kïmmö kiper kwääri mo Icriel,
english: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

anywaa: ni kööï, «ni ‹?Meru ee, caal ŋø na bëëde? Meru bee ŋuu mo bëëdö yïthakic ŋuuwe; eno but piny yïthakic ŋuuwe moa näk poot na wøpe, ni eni bëëdö ni pïïdhö ki nyïïe.
english: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.

anywaa: Ni lwør nyaare aciel ni pwöny gø, ni tïme na ŋuu mo teek døc, ni kwany dwaar, ni put tïmö ni cämö ki jiy.
english: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.

anywaa: 'Ba luumme awïny wïth juurre, ni cekge gø ki buur ni päth yi gø, ni gänge gø ko obïth, ni peege gø Ijep.
english: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba menni kanya joot gø ni gïna ŋäädhe oränynyö, ni gïna manynye kär thur kare, ena cäŋ lwötö ki nyaare aciel ni pwöny gø, ni tïïc gø na ŋuu mo teek døc.
english: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.

anywaa: Ni put tïmö ni cäädhö yïthakic ŋuuwe, kiper eno løny ni teek. Ni kwany dwaar, ni put tïmö ni cämö ki jiy.
english: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.

anywaa: Ni tøc kwör gwøk røk moge moa teek, ni raany päänye moge; ni ö jiyi bëët moa en yi ŋööm paac ni lwäcge ki löörö mare.
english: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.

anywaa: Køøre wïth juurre gena put öö ki yïth mïëri moa en deŋŋe ni këëtge ki eni.  Ni peerge ajääp marge bääte, ni putge gø maa yi buur marge.
english: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.

anywaa: Ni gänge gø ko obïth ni kïthge gø yi dhwöŋŋö, ni kïthge gø Babiløn baŋ nyeya, ni kïthge gø øt twöc, ni ö löörö mare ni tïme ni ba wïnyi këët bäät kïte mo Icriel.
english: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba meru na bëëde, bëëdö kaamar omøk mo opiith deŋ naam yi pwöth omøki marï, ni eni bëëdö ni nywøl ki nyïëdi ni bäädi moe olaak jaak kiper pïï na thööthge.
english: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.

anywaa: Ni bäädi moe teek, no orømø ki man tïïi na athøc kwär mo cuumme; ni wïïe opööth maal ki bäät lul mana no odhïŋ, ni put tïmö ni nëënö wøk døc kiper bäädi moe na thööth.
english: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.

anywaa: 'Ba lweete acööt wøk ki køør wëër, ni leeŋi yïth ŋøøm, ni ö nyïïe ni taali ya jamø man wø ööi ki kur tuul-cäŋ; bat mare na teek døc acööt wøk ni tale ni put waaŋ ki maac.
english: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ena piith dïtëën, yi ŋöömö mo otal mo bäŋ pïï yie.
english: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

anywaa: 'Ba maac aö wøk ki ri bat mare mana pere leth, ni put lwinh jaath ki nyïï gø thöör ki waaŋ, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ bat aciel mo odööŋ mo rømø ki man tïme na athøny kwär mar cuumme.› Manøgø bee luum kïmmö man wø wär na duut kiper kïmmö.»
english: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri bïriet cwiiri mo mäk marwa ki tøŋ, ni nïr dwää abïïc apaar, jø døøk Icriel møøk gena ö kuna pëënyge Wuuö Jwøk, ni pïge piny nyïma.
english: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the Lord, and sat before me.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bääta, ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, cään jø døøk Icriel ni kööï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, no ‹?U ööa kuna pëënynyu aani? Ka adïëri møn, aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, a caana gø jïïu, u ba jïëa ki man pëënynyu aani.›
english: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.

anywaa: «?Wui, wär dhaanhø, luumge ba ŋøli? Ŋøl luumge ni jäälï geni! Gïïa raac yia ki ge na tïïc kwäcge tïïyï nee ŋäcge;
english: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:

anywaa: ni caanï gø jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Dïcäŋa jiera Icriel aana kööŋ jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap ni nyoodha raa jïge Ijep, ni kööa jïge, ni «Aani, aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.»
english: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the Lord your God;

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa kööŋa nyïmge, beeye kiper nee ge käla wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep nee cige yi ŋöömma jiera kiperge, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, na näk beerra eni døc ki ŋøøm møga bëët.
english: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:

anywaa: Ni kööa jïge, ni «Ŋati man nø dëëtu wet japa reyø nyïme ni wø wøøre, ni ba tïïyu dëëtu ni ba waany ki kït gïï wø lam mo jø Ijep; kiper bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.»
english: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba gena tïmö ni marge ageem ki aani ni kweerge ki man cekge ïthge ki luumma. Japa reyø ni wø wøørge kärge wetø, ni kärge kït gïï wø lam mo jø Ijep wiiø. Kanyøgø aana köö ni wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac kønynya bäätge nø, nee wëër mara put røm dëëtge dï ŋööm Ijep.
english: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø kära tïïö kiper nee nyeŋŋa ba ränynye nyïm wïth juurre moa enge dïge, ni beege wïth juurre moa nyoodha raa jï jø Icriel nyïmge ki køør mana käla jø Icriel wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena bwødha wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ni kïtha ge dï paap.
english: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni pwönynya geni ki luup 'moa, ni tïïa  geni nee ciik 'moa ŋäcge, ni beege gïïa doo cïpö ki kwøw jï ŋato kïth ge bäät tïïc.
english: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.

anywaa: Ni pwönynya geni thuwø ki man gwøkge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm, nee bëëtge ni caala ŋïï yïthakicwa ki geni, nee ŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc geni na jiy mo ena kur keerge.
english: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the Lord that sanctify them.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø Icriel gena cäŋ gëëmö ki aani dï paap. Gena kweer ki man cääthge ki køør luup 'moa, ni wecge ciik 'moa, ni beege gïïa doo cïpö ki kwøw jï ŋato kïth ge bäät tïïc, ni ö geni ni putge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm päät døc. Kanyøgø aana köö ni wëër mara kønynya bäätge nee wïthge puta dïïr dï paap.
english: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø kära tïïö kiper nee nyeŋŋa ba ränynye nyïm wïth juurre moa käla geni wøk ki dïge ni nëënö jïge.
english: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.

anywaa: Ni cäŋa kööŋ thuwø dï paap, nee ge ba kïtha yi ŋöömma cïba jïge, ni beeye ŋöömma näk caak ki maar kïc päl yie, na näk beerra eni døc ki ŋøøm møga bëët.
english: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;

anywaa: Kiper ciik 'moa awecge ni kweerge ki man cääthge ki køør luup 'moa, ni päätge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm. Kiper cwïnyge ena køør kït gïï wø lamge.
english: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, yia acäŋa warrø ki geni, ni kära geni raanynyø këët wala ki man dïïra wïthge dï paap.
english: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö jï obwöre moge dï paap, ni «Käru cäädhö ki køør luup mo wëëgu wala man gwøgu ciik moge wala man päätu dëëtu ki kït gïï wø lamge.
english: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:

anywaa: Aani, aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru; caathu køør luup 'moa ni caarru wïthu ki ciik 'moa ni kïthu ge bäät tïïc.
english: I am the Lord your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;

anywaa: Tïïyu cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm ni ena kur keerge, ni tïmge kaamar ŋïï mo ena yïthakiyø, kiper nee ŋäyu ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.»
english: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the Lord your God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba obwöre moge gena gëëmö ki aani thuwø. Ge kär cäädhö ki køør luup 'moa, ni kärge wïthge caarø ki man kïthge ciik 'moa bäät tïïc, ni beege gïïa doo cïpö ki kwøw jï ŋato kïth ge bäät tïïc; ni ö geni ni putge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm päät. Kanyøgø aana köö ni wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac kønynya bäätge nee wëër mara put røm dëëtge dï paap.
english: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba cera ajooa ki man tïïa gïnögø kiper nee nyeŋŋa ba ränynye nyïm wïth juurre moa käla geni wøk ki dïge ni nëënö jïge.
english: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.

anywaa: 'Ba aana cäŋ kööŋ thuwø dï paap ki man keetha geni dï wïth juurre ki yïth mïëri,
english: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;

anywaa: kiper ciik 'moa kärge jïëö; gena kweer ki luup 'moa, ni päätge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm, ni ge bëëdö ni nyeŋge ena køør kït gïïa lam kwäcge.
english: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.

anywaa: 'Ba gena wëëga gwøk luup mo ba beyø, ki ciik mo ba cïpi ki kwøw jïge;
english: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;

anywaa: gena tïïa nee tïmge ni ge ba waany ki køør mana ö obwöre moge bëët moa näk kaai ni waaŋge ge ki maac ni ge cïpa ge no olämme. Ni manøgø a wëëga ge ränynyö, kiper nee ŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Jöö maya mana ö kwäyu na päätge aani ki gø ki køør japa reyø na tïïcge dëëra bee en:
english: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.

anywaa: Kanya kïtha ge yi ŋöömö mana kööŋa kipere ni cïba cïbö jïge, thuuri moa bäyö bëët ki jenni bëët moa no onigïït piny aneenge, ni ö geni ni cïpge ko olämme kaace ge bëët, ni wëëkge aani gootø ko olämme moge. Ni öge thuwø ni wääŋge ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met kaace, ni kunyge piny ki kwøŋ na muuce.
english: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.

anywaa: Køøre gena pëënynya, ni «?Kar lam man no ogeerø ni ena maal ni cou yie en aŋøøni?» 'Ba nyeŋ kaace këël dïcäŋi cwøl ni Baama.›
english: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, na ‹?Aŋø, dëëtu tïïyu tïïö ni ba waany kaawat mana tïïc kwäyu, ni dëëtu gathu gadhø ki käp ni nyeŋŋu ena køør kït gïïa wara lamge?
english: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?

anywaa: Kany wø cïpu muuce mou, ki kany wø kïthu wäätu yi maac nou waaŋa geni no olämme, u tïïya dëëtu ni ba waany ki kït gïï wø lammu bëët këël dïcäŋi. ?Wui, u na jø Icriel, u jïëa jïëö këët ki  man pëënynyu aani? 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø jïïu, a ba pëënynyu këët.
english: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord God, I will not be enquired of by you.

anywaa: « ‹Uuni, u wø köö, ni «Wa manynya gø nee wa tïmwa ni wa caala wïth juurre møga, ni wa bëëdö kaamar jø bäät piny mo wø lam jenni ki kïte.» 'Ba gïnögø ni caarru enø ba tägi na bäre bäre.
english: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø jïïu, aani, aano tïmö na nyeya bäätu, ni käära uuni ki teek ni cera yaa rwieø bäätu, ni wëër mara ena bäätu.
english: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:

anywaa: Aani, u duua duuö ki baŋ wïth juurre ni cuuŋa uuni ki yïth mïëri moa näk uuno keethø yïthge ki teek ni cera yaa rwieø bäätu ni wëër mara ena bäätu.
english: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.

anywaa: Aani, u kïtha dïtëën mar wïth juurre, ni puta u jääl kaace ni ø neeta nyeŋŋø.
english: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.

anywaa: Uuni, u jääla jäälö kaawat mana jääla kwäyu dïtëën mar ŋööm Ijep. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Aani, u tïïa tïïö nou pöödhu ki tier athøra mara, ni kïtha uuni yi luumma tuuda ki kwäyu.
english: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:

anywaa: Jiy mo wø tïïö ki raay ki jiy mo wø gëëmö ki aani daa daa buutu. Ge käla wøk yi ŋöömö man ni bëëtge yie en, 'ba ge ba døny yi ŋööm Icriel këët. Køøre nø ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba kiperu, u na jø dhi øt Icriel, luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïïu bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Cou, ni ö ŋati man nø ni tïny kït gïï wø lame! 'Ba ki køør gïïögø, uuni ïthu cegu ciiø na adïëri ki luumma, ni tïme ni nyeŋŋa na en kur keere ba päätu këët ki muuce mou ki kït gïï wø lämmu.
english: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord God; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø, ni bäät kïdi mara na en kur keere, ni beeye kïnna bäär mar Icriel, u na jø dhi øt Icriel u bëët, aano tïnynyu bääte kaace yi ŋöömmece, ni jïëa uuni yie. Køøre uuno pëënynya kaace ki muuce mou moa beyø ki japu bëët moa en kur keerge.
english: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord God, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.

anywaa: Uuni, u pänhnha pänhnhö kaamar gïn mo ŋwäänynye met, kanyo duua uuni wøk ki baŋ wïth juurre noo cuuŋa uuni ki yïth mïëri moa näk uuno keethø yïthge; køøre dëëra nyoodha nyoodhø jïïu ni nëënö jï wïth juurre ki man näk maa ena kur keera.
english: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo duua uuni yi ŋööm Icriel, ni beeye ŋöömma kööŋa kipere ni cïba cïbö jï kwäyu.
english: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.

anywaa: Uuni, wïthu parru parø kaace ki bëëtö maru mana bëëdu ki gø ki japa reyø bëët na raanynyu dëëtu ki ge, ni putu dëëtu jääl ki køør japa reyø bëët na tïïyu.
english: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø u na jø Icriel oŋäyu ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo nyoodha bäth ec mara jïïu kiper nyeŋŋa, këël na bëëdu ni uutjïëthe mou reyø nou temma gïï mo reyø.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï jï løø tier-piny ni køpï luubö jï jø ŋöömma en jï løø tier-piny ni wø bëëdö na lul.
english: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;

anywaa: Caanï jï jø ŋöömma en jï løø tierpiny ni wø bëëdö na lul, ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk. Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, Ni ka adïëri møn, aani, a ena bäät man nyeba pou ki maac, nee jenni mou put maaci thöör bëët, ni beege jenni mou moa thec bëët ki moa no otal. 'Ba maac manøgø obëëdö ni ba løny ki bïp, ni ö jammi bëët moa en yi ŋöömö mar jï løø tier-piny këël jï løø wï-piny ni putge waaŋ ki maac.
english: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the Lord; Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø ojoot jiyi bëët ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc maac manøgø; 'ba maaøgø oput bëëtö ni ba løny ki bïp.› »
english: And all flesh shall see that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö, «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk! Geni, ge cäänö kipera ni ge köö, ni ‹?Moøgø paa leere jaak ni car nyenøgø enø?› »
english: Then said I, Ah Lord God! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ Jerucalem ki kwör lam moe. Caan luummi jï ŋööm Icriel niï jääla gø,
english: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,

anywaa: ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aana gootø ki ïïni. Aani opëëllö mara wödha wøk ki yi køp mare ni puta jiy moa bëëtge beyø ki moa bëëtge reyø 'näk.
english: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa bëëtge beyø ki jøøa bëëtge reyø kiper nee ge nääa, opëëllö mara owödha wøk ki yi køp mare bäät jiy bëët, ki mano täge ki jï løø tier-piny këël mano këët wï-piny.
english: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët putge ka ŋäc ki man näk mo a na Wuuö Jwøk opëëllö mara yaa wöth wøk ki yi køp mare ni ba cäŋ dwøk yie këët.›
english: That all flesh may know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, guyï nyïmge, ni cwïnyï opädhö ni yiï iï keeyø døc.
english: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo pëënyge ïïni ni köge, na ‹?Aperŋø ni guyï en?› wärï kööï jïge, na ‹A guyi kaper gïn ni nyään ni ööi en. Dïcäŋeca cwïnynyi bëët bwøk, ni ö bäät jiy bëët ni nigelway; jwïëy bëët ööl, ni ö nyeŋ cøŋŋi bëët ni øcge piny kaamar pïï. Ka adïëri møn, cäŋece öö; öö ni ba kääŋi.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, caan luubö man ni kööï ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö: «Opëëllö anø paak ni nø thoodhi;
english: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the Lord; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:

anywaa: ena paak kiper 'näk; ena thooth ni put tïmö ni paŋŋi kaamar agaackøth. «?Aŋø, løny ki man mïn yïthø ka athøc kwär mar dhaanhnha ma Juuda ni näk opëëllö onø männö ki gø?
english: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.

anywaa: «Opëëllö anø jiiŋŋi ni thoodhi, ena jiiŋŋi kiper nee täge ki tïïc; ena paak ni thoodhi, kiper nee cïp cer dïnääy.
english: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.

anywaa: Wui, ï na wär dhaanhø, jwöŋï ni gööï ko oduuru, kiper opëëllö manøgø jääla jiy 'moa, ki jø kööre mo Icriel. Jiy moøgø yaa cïp dho opëëllö, ge ki jiya bëët. Kiper manøgønø, jwöŋï niï pööta köörï.
english: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.

anywaa: «'Ba päärö öö møn na adïëri. ?'Ba ni näk mo opëëllö onø männö ka athøc kwär mar Juuda, løny ki man cäŋ bëëte këët? Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, caan luup 'moa, ni putï ceŋŋï paŋ. Beerra man ö opëëllö ni nääe ki kwöre ariiø wala adäk. Opëëllö manøgø, ena mar 'näk; eni tïïc kaper 'näk mo dwøŋ, ni put geni rum dïër ki deŋge bäre,
english: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.

anywaa: kiper nee cwïny jiy put bwøk, ni ö mo thööthi ni thøwge. Opëëllö manøgø atïïa kiper 'näk, ni cïba gø dhøk käälle moge bëët. Wui, eno tïïö ni malli døc kaamar agaackøth, eno paaø ni beth døc kiper 'näk.
english: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.

anywaa: Wui, opëëllö! Ŋädï ki bäät cwïïï ki bäät caamï, wala kanyo løøï riï yie jaak!
english: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.

anywaa: Køøre nø, aani thuwø ceŋŋa puta ka paŋ, ni ö wëërri mara ni døø piny. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the Lord have said it.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came unto me again, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, tïïï ki uutjïëthe ariiø kiper opëëllö mar nyeny Babiløn kanyo ööe, ni ge käla yi paac aciel. Ni cööthï piny ki nyuudhi yïth agääk jïëthe yi waŋjöö mano gaa Jerucalem.
english: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.

anywaa: Kïth øtjöö aciel ki nyuudhi kiper opëëllö mano ööi ni cøøa Raaba, pääny jø Amön, ni kïthï øtjöö maya ki nyuudhi mo nyootha Juuda ki Jerucalem na  näk ogeerø ni teek.
english: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.

anywaa: Kiper nyeny Babiløn kanyo ööe, eno cuŋŋi yïth agääk jïëthe moa na ariiø, ni tïïe ki nyuuthe ka athëëre, ni pëëny kït gïï wø lame, ni tïïe ki jap adïëda mo tïïc ka cwïny lääy.
english: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi mano päth cer cwïïe otïmö na mar Jerucalem, kiper nee jenni mo thiel kiir ki ge cïp karge, ni cïpe ki dwøl nee jiy 'näk, nee jiy twäätge ri leny, nee jenni mo thiel dhi kiir ki ge cïpge karge, nee kany eth bäät kiir ki yie thørge, nee kwör leny mo tuk pääny ki yie jiiŋge.
english: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.

anywaa: 'Ba nyuudhi manøgø otïmö kaamar gïr tööt ki jï jø Jerucalem na tudö ki luubö ki eni ni kööŋge bääte. 'Ba wïthge opare ki bääyö marge, ni put ge mak ki tøŋ.
english: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ‹Kiper uuni bääyö maru atïïyu nee wïc par ki gø, ki køør mana ö raay mou ni nyoothge rege, ni tïïe mou bëët mo wø tïïyu nyootha raay mou, kiper mana tïïyu gïnögø, u di maaø ki tøŋ.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.

anywaa: « ‹Wui, ï na dïbwödhi mana raac mar Icriel, ni wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ï na caa marï oløny ni öö, ni caa mar ajäla marï mana näk aŋuudi opïï,
english: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «Abïï nyec man wø meen wïc käl wøk, ni kälï aduda wøk. Jammi ba tïmö këët kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ. Jøøa kwörge therø geno tïŋ maal, ni ö jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø ni dwøk ge piny.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.

anywaa: Pääny ränynyö! Eni ränynyö! Eni raanynya raanynyø! Eni ba døø kare këët këël kanyo ö wänni; 'ba aani, eno cïba cere.» ›
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø, caan gïn ni kööï ni man bee luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiper jø Amön ka ajøøŋ mana tïïcge, ena köö, «no ‹Opëëllö anø wöth wøk kiper 'näk, ni bëëdö no othoodhø nee räänye, ni eni malli døc kaamar agaackøth.
english: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:

anywaa: Kiper gïï wø kööu no onyoodhø jïïu, ki gïï wø caru beege luup tööt; 'ba opëëllö ocïp ŋut jø raay ni 'näk geni. Cäŋ maneca apïï; caa mar ajäla mana näk aŋuudi aöö.
english: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.

anywaa: Opëëllö dwøk yi køp. Uuni, uuno jääla yi ŋöömö mana cwääc uuni yie, ni bee kanya nywøl uuni yie.
english: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

anywaa: Gootø käla bäätu, ni ö wëërri mara ni wø liel kaamar maac ni kønynya gø bäätu; aani u cïba ceŋ jiy mo reyø døc mo geno kwänynyö døc ka aranya.
english: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.

anywaa: Uuno tïmö kaamar jer maac, ni ö remø maru ni øc piny yi ŋöömö maru, ni ba par wïc këët ki uuni; kiper luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «?Wär dhaanhø, luum pääny man ŋølï ŋølø? ?Pääny man ni kuny piny ki rem jiy en, luumme ŋølï ŋølø? Japa näk yia raac ki ge bëët na tïïe caanï jïre nee ŋääe,
english: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.

anywaa: ni caanï gø ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹Wui, ï na pääny man käl ränynyö bäätï keerï en ki køør rem jiy moa kønynyï piny dïërï, ki mana tïïyï riï niï ba waany ki køør kït gïï wø lam moa tïïyï!
english: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord God, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.

anywaa: Ïïna päth yïth raay ki køør rem jiy moa kønynyï piny, ni tïmï niï ba waany ki kït gïï wø lam moa tïïyï. Nïne mo ränynyö marï alaarï tïïc nee laarge öö; aŋuun cwiic kwøw moï aløny ni öö. Kiper manøgønø, ï tïïa tïïö ni ïïna gïr ajøøŋ jï wïth juurre, ni tïïa ïïni na gïr abuua jï mïëri bëët.
english: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.

anywaa: Jiy mo wø en buutï ki moa kwörge bäyö ki ïïni ï  buuge buuö. Ïïni, ïïna pääny mo päŋ ki jammi mo reyø ko okiera.
english: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

anywaa: « ‹Raŋï mø, dïbwöthe mo Icriel moø ni moï yøø, man nø bëëdö ni dëëre ee kønyø ki teek mare ki man køny rem jiy piny.
english: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.

anywaa: Jiy moï bäŋ wödö mo tïïcge kiper wëëe ki mëëe yi paayø; ge bëëdö ni wëëlle caarge caarø, ni ge tïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëët kïïe ki määr thuunhnhi.
english: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.

anywaa: Ïïni, japa na en kur keerge ataagï, ni päätï cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm.
english: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.

anywaa: Ïïni, da jiy moï ma tööte mo ge bëënna waac nyeŋ kiper køny rem jiy piny; ni da jiy moï thuwø mo ge cämö ko olämme mo wø cïp jï juuga reyø yïth uut lam moa en bäät kïte, ni ge bëëdö ni marge käp.
english: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

anywaa: Da jiy moï mo ge buut ki määr wëëkge, ki jiy møøk mo mään makge maa ki teek nee butge ki ge kany wø bëët määnni ni ge ba waany ni kar pïïn piny marge opäŋ.
english: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.

anywaa: Ni ŋat mør kännö ki luk ki cï ŋat atut mare, ni ŋat mør butö ki cï nyaare, ni ŋat mør buti ka nyiwänni kiree mana nywøl wänni.
english: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.

anywaa: Ni da jiy moï mo cïpö ki gwel ki piny kiper køny rem jiy piny. Ni ïïni gwel mo wø mac baŋï tïïyï tïïö nee duui jïrï ni da wïthge, ni gwet jø møøk kälï kälö ni marï twëër, niï bëëdö ni wïïï owïl ki aani.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani, cera rwääa rwääö ki maal ni jääla ïïni kiper gwetï moa jootï ki jöör møt, ki mana kønynyï rem jiy piny dï paac.
english: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kanyo jääla ïïni yie, løny ki man magï cwïnyï wala ki man cwiitï ceŋŋï? Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba puta ka tïïc.
english: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the Lord have spoken it, and will do it.

anywaa: Aani, u keetha keethø dï wïth juurre ki yïth mïëri; ni ö japa näk ba waany mou ni puta ge ŋuudö.
english: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo bëëdu ni uuno nipäät dï wïth juurre, putu ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk. »
english: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, jø dhi øt Icriel gena tïmö kaamar gïn mo ba kunynyi ki baŋa; geni bëët gena tïmö kaamar nyal man wø ö wøk ki røk nywïëny ki køør man wø leeny geni ki maac. Gena tïmö kaamar nyal mar gwel-bïrö.
english: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana tïmu bëët kaamar nyal, aani u cooŋa yi Jerucalem.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö gwel-bïrö ki nywïëny møøk ma teeŋi wø kïthi ya dhaanhe yi maac ni leenya ge, aani thuwø u cooŋa cooŋø ki wëër mara, ni beeye wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac, ni kïtha u dï pääny ni jääla uuni ka ajäla mo caala man wø leeny nywïënyö.
english: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.

anywaa: Aani u cooŋa cooŋø ni koodha maa wëër mara bäätu, ni putu leenyø dï pääny.
english: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø leeny gwel-bïrö yi këën thääth, aani u leenya leenyø dï pääny, ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na køny wëër mare bäätu.› »
english: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the Lord have poured out my fury upon you.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, caanï jï ŋööm Icriel, ni ‹Ïïna ŋöömö mo kär tïïö ni tøŋ, kiper bäŋ køth mo opädhö bäätï yi cäŋ wëër mara.›
english: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe moe moa en yie ge bëëdö kaamar ŋuuwe mo märö bäät lääy mo bakge bagø; jwïëc jiy araanyge ni kälge jammi mo jiy ki gïï møøk mo perge leth. 'Ba ki køør 'näk mana tïïcge, mään mo thööth awëëkge dööŋŋe na määr thuunhnhi.
english: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.

anywaa: Dïlämme moe, ciik 'moa araanyge, ni päätge japa na en kur keerge; gïn mo waany mo ena kur keere ki gïn mo ba waany ba pääŋge. Jiy kärge pwönynyö ki man ŋäcge gïn mo ba waany ki gïn mo waany; ni ge bëëdö ni nyïmge ege løø wøk ki man gwøkge cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm, naa bëëdö naa ege päädö yïthakicge.
english: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

anywaa: Kwääri moe moa en yie, ge bëëdö kaamar orude mo ge baga lääy, ki køør mana bëëtge ni rem jiy kønyge piny, ni jwïëc jiy raanyge raanynyø kiper joot jammi ki jöör møt.
english: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.

anywaa: Nyikuk Jwøk moe, tïïe moøgø ege uumö ki luup tööt mo wø  carge no onyoodhø jïge, ka adïëde mo patha karge. Ge köö jaak, ni ‹Luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en,› ni gïnaca kär caan Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered mortar, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord God, when the Lord hath not spoken.

anywaa: Jiy moa en yi ŋööm paac, jø møøk caarge caarø ni ge twëëdö; ni ge tïïö ki gïï mo reyø dëët kïïe ki jiy moa can, ni jøøa path moa en dïge caarge caarø ki jöö mo patha kare.
english: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.

anywaa: «'Ba aana määnyö dïge ki dhaanhø mo geer kiir, mo cuŋŋö nyïma kanya no opädhö ri kiir, kiper nee paac ba raanynya; 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo yaa joodø.
english: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wëër mara kønynya bäätge ni puta ge thöör ki wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac, ni ö japa tïïcge bëët ni dwøga ge wïthge.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, da mään ariiø mo gena nyïïmëëe,
english: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

anywaa: mo geno tïmö ni gena kääpe Ijep, ni ge bëëdö ni ge gatha dëëtge ki käp ki mana täge ni ge therø. Gena bëëdö ni thurge di maaŋŋø ni ge di gämmö ki mëër yi ŋöömmögø.
english: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïgögø, mana dwøŋ nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Ööla, ni beeye nyeŋ mo nyootha Cameria; ni ö nyeŋ maya ni näk beeye Ööliba, ni beeye nyeŋ mana näk nyootha Jerucalem. 'Ba nyïgögø gena nywøma ni jïta ko obwöre ki geni, ni beege cwøw ki mään.
english: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.

anywaa: «'Ba Ööla ena cäŋ bëëtö ni gatha dëëre ki käp kanya nø tïme na cïïa, ni eni bëëdö ni rïïŋö køør omëërri moe, ni beege jø leny mo jø Aciria,
english: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

anywaa: na näk geno ruyö ka abïïe mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ni beege kwääri ki dïbwöthe, ni ge bëët geno obwöre mo nëëni ni mïërö, ni gena jø leny mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëëc lääy.
english: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.

anywaa: Nyaanøgø dëëre agadhe ki käp baŋ jøøgø bëët, ni beege jø Aciria moa no ojierø. Ena rïïŋö køør jøøgø bëët ni päät ree ki kït gïï wø lam bëët mo jøøgø.
english: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, bëët käp mare mana tääe kanya bëëde Ijep käre wiiø; ki mana käl thïnhö cwøw bëëdö ni buut ki gø. Ni thure na näk poot cuŋŋö maaŋ cwøwi maaŋŋø, ni cwïny cwøw puta pääŋö ki met ec ki eni.
english: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ena cïba ceŋ omëërri moe, ni beege jø Aciria na rïïŋe køørge.
english: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni pwöthge abïïe wøk dëëre, ni kälge wääte ki nyïïe, ni putge gø 'näk ko opëëllö. Ni put tïmö ni beeye ŋat gïre waac dï mään ki køør ajäla mana pïï dëëre.
english: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.

anywaa: «'Ba coki mo Ööliba gïnögø ajoode, 'ba ena cäŋ rïïŋö køør käp ni kaala coki, ni tïm gath dëëlli mare no okaadhø ki mar coki.
english: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.

anywaa: Eni ena rïïŋö døc køør jø Aciria, ni beege kwääri ki dïbwöthe, jøøa bëëdö na jø leny mo dëëtge ege runynyö ka abïïe mo beyø, ni ge këëdi ka bäät okwëëc lääy, ni geno obwöre mo nëëni ni mïërö.
english: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaanøgø ajooda ni dëëre ee päädö døc; ge ki coki bëët gena cør jöö aciel.
english: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

anywaa: «'Ba nyaanøgø käp mare aput kaath. 'Ba ena jïtö ri kiir ki kït jiy mo ogöörö ki booya mo kwaar, ni beege kït jø Babiløn;
english: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men portrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans portrayed with vermilion,

anywaa: ni geno göörö ni pëëtge otöönynyö ki kaae, ni wïthge omëënnö ka abïïe mo wø meen wïc; 'ba ge bëët ge nëëni kaamar kwääc leny mo Babiløn moa nywøl yi Kaldia.
english: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jooti ya nyaanøgø jaak, ena put tïmö ni cwïnye pärö kiperge, ni put jääk baŋ jø Babiløn yi ŋööm Kaldia ki jiy.
english: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.

anywaa: Køøre jø Babiløn gena put ö baŋ gø nee butge ki gø ki mëër, ni putge gø päät ki käp marge. 'Ba kanya nø lønyge ki niine ki gø, nyaanøgø nyïme aput løø wøk ki geni ni männe ki geni.
english: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët nyaanøgø ni käp mare ee täärö nyeŋ jiy ni dëëre ee wii wøk, nyïma aløøa wøk ki gø ki gootø kaawat mana løøa nyïma wøk ki coki.
english: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ bëëtö ni käp mare poot kaadhe kaadhø jaak, ni paaya wïïe ki nïr thïnhö moe kanya bëëde ni käbö Ijep.
english: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
