anywaa: Ena bëëdö  ni rïïŋö køør omëërri moe kaace, jøøa näk jap gääbö moge caala mo arëëni, ni pïï mo wø ö wøk ki yïthge caala mo okwëëc lääy.
english: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Ööliba, ïïna bëëdö ni cwïnyï pärö køør käp mana tïïyï niï thiinh, ni beeye kanya bëët jø Ijepi ni ge maaŋŋa thurï kanya poot thurï ni poot cuŋŋö.
english: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na Ööliba, luubö mana caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, omëërri moï tïïa tïïö nee öge maal bäätï, jøøa løøï nyïmï wøk ki geni na männï ki geni; geni, ge tïïa tïïö nee öge maal bäätï ki kwöra enge yïthge bëët,
english: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;

anywaa: ni beege jø Babiløn, ki jø Kaldia bëët, ki jø Peköt, ki jø Cöa, ki jø Køa, ni jø Aciria bëët ena dïge, ni beege obwöre moa dëëtge mïërö, ni ge bëët gena kwääri ki dïbwöthe, ki dïbwöthe mo jïëth okwëënyi, ki jiy ma kwääri mo døøŋŋø, ni ge bëët ge cäädhi ka bäät okwëëc lääy.
english: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.

anywaa: Jøøgø ge ööa baŋï ni ge käädö ki jap leny, ki jïëth okwëënyi, ki jø møøk mo cwaga geni; geni, ge ööa baŋï kuna tukge ïïni ki deŋŋï bäre, ni ge käädö ki kööt leny mo wø gëëŋ dëël ki ge ki mo wø rïëp wïc. Aani ï cïba ceŋge niï jäälge, ni ö geni ni jäälge ïïni ki køør kööŋŋö marge.
english: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.

anywaa: Aani cwïnya këënynyö ki ïïni, ni tïïa geni nee tïïge dëërï ki gïn mo raac ni geno wëër døc. Geni umï ki ïdhi moï ŋulge wøk, ni ö jiyï moo bøth ni nääi ko opëëllö. Geni wäätï ki nyïïï kälge kälö, ni ö moo bøth rege ni waaŋi ki maac ni puti ya maaci thöör.
english: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.

anywaa: Geni thuwø abïïgï pwöthge wøk dëërï, ni ö jap mïërö moa en dëërï ni kälge ge.
english: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø käp mana wara gathï dëërï ki gø na tägi yi ŋööm Ijep ŋøla ŋølø. Waŋï paanya paanyø bäät japøgø ni ba parï wïïï këët ki Ijep.›
english: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.

anywaa: «Kiper man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, ena köö, na ‹A ena bäät man cïba ïïni ceŋ jøøa mänï ki ge na løøï nyïmï wøk ki geni na männï ki geni.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:

anywaa: 'Ba geno tïïö dëërï ki gïn mo raac ni marge männö ki ïïni, ni kälge jammi moï bëët na öölï kiperge, ni putge ïïni wec niï bëëdö ka dëërï ni bäŋ abïï; ni ö dëërï man wø käbï ki gø ni dööŋe wøk, ni tïm käpi marï man wø gathï dëërï ki gø ni ŋäc.
english: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

anywaa: Japøgø di tïïö dëërï, kiper ïïna käbö ki wïth juurre, ni päätï riï keerï ki kït gïï wø lamge.
english: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.

anywaa: Ïïna tïmö niï cäädhi ka jöör coku; kiper manøgønø, athöönh gïna leth mare owëëga ïïni nee maathï.›
english: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, ena köö, «na ‹Athöönh gïna leth mar coku maathï maadhø, ni beeye athöödhi mo dwøŋ mo yie laac; jiy oŋeethi bäätï ni buuge ïïni, kiper mana näk mo opääŋö døc.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.

anywaa: Ïïno meer døc ki gïna en yie ni kïmmï, kiper beeye athöödhi mo kännö ki lwär mo dwøŋ ki ränynyö, ni beeye athöödhi mar coku ma Cameria.
english: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

anywaa: 'Ba athöönhnhögø omaathï ni taalï tiere; ni putï gø 'näk ni keethe na thäŋi, ni ö thunhnhi moï ni putï ge teellø; kiper luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana wïl wïïï ki aani ni leeŋï aani ŋääï, ajäla mar bëët käp marï mana gathï dëërï ki gø jwørï jwørø.› »
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, Ööla ko Ööliba luumge ba ŋølï? Japa reyø na tïïcge caanï jïge nee ŋäcge.
english: The Lord said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;

anywaa: Kiper gena bëëdö na jø luuï ni kunyge piny ki rem jiy. Gena buut ki kït gïï wø lamge, ni ŋarge nyïïge ni cïpge ge no olämme, ni kïthge ge yi maac ni tïme na cam kiperge, ni beege obwöre moa  nywølge jïra.
english: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.

anywaa: Geni thuwø, gïna cäŋge tïïyö dëëra ni poot na yïth nïrögø, kar bëëtö mara na en kur keere, ki cääŋŋe 'moa mo jwöm apäätge.
english: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø ŋarge nyïïge nee cïpge no olämme jï kït gïï wø lamge, dïcäŋöca thuwø ge puta døny kar bëëtö mara na en kur keere kuna päätge gø; manøgø beeye gïn wø tïïcge yi øtø mara.
english: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.

anywaa: «Geni thuwø ge jääga baŋ jiy mo kwörge bäyö nee öge. 'Ba kanyo ö jøøgø, dëëtge putge ka lwøk kiper jøøgø, ni rwøthge nyeŋge, ni kïthge dëëtge ki jap mïërö.
english: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

anywaa: Ni pïge piny bäät køøm mo mïërö mo nyïme okïthö ki tharabëëta mo bääte ocïpö ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met, ki maar wïïr, ni beege japa näk 'moa.
english: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.

anywaa: 'Ba geni dwør lwaak bëëdö ni lweelli deŋge, ni dïmäthe ege kälö ki kuna näk da paap, ki jøøa näk bäŋ kwörge, ni kïthge ceŋ mään moøgø ko oguudi, ni kïthge wïth mään ka adude mo mïërö.
english: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.

anywaa: Køøre aana cäänö kiper dhaaŋŋa näk onø raany bëët käpi ni kööa, ni ‹Jøøgø ge butö ki kääbi manøgø kawaane ni näk mo eni poot bëëdö ka bëëtö manaca.›
english: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?

anywaa: Køøre gena put butö ki gø møn kaawat man wø butö ki dhaagø ma kääbi. Køøre gena put butö ki mään moøgø bëët na kääpe yøø, ni beege Ööla ko Ööliba.
english: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo bëëtö marge tiir, mään moøgø jäälge jäälö kaawat man wø jääl dhaagø mo okännö ki luk, ki dhaagø mo okuny piny ki rem dhaanhø, kiper gena mään ma jø luuy, mo geno kuny piny ki rem jiy.
english: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö: Jääŋŋu lwaak baŋge ni wëëgu ge lwär ni twierru ge.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.

anywaa: Geno këër lwaaki ki kïte, ni ŋarge geni ko opëëlle moge, ni ö wäätge ki nyïïge ni puti ya lwaaki 'näk ni put uudi moge waaŋ ki maac.
english: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø bëët käp oraanynya yi ŋööm paayø, ni ö määnni bëët ni kwänyge ki køør gïno tägi dëëtu, ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaagø mo ŋwaal bëëtö maru këët.
english: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.

anywaa: Uuni gïï mo leth ojwørru ki køør käp maru ki wödö man wø wøørru kït gïï wø lam. Køøre nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na ri bïŋweer cwiiri mo mäk marwa ki tøŋ, ni nïr dwää apaar, apaar, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, göör nïne mo dïcäŋi piny, ni beeye cäŋ man kiree. Kiper dïcäŋ man kiree nyeny Babiløn Jerucalem aciel dïër.
english: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.

anywaa: Ïïni, caan leer man jï jøø na jø ageem yøø, ni kööï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «ni ‹Thäänh dhiithi maac; thäänh maac ni kunynyï yie ki pïï.
english: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:

anywaa: Kïth yie ki rïŋö mo othemø, ni beege thäk rïŋ bëët moa perge leth, rïŋ ääm ki rïŋ bat. Ni ö cuu mo rïŋ moøgø ni kïthï gø yie thuwø;
english: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.

anywaa: ni rïŋö manøgø beeye rïŋö mana met mar diel. Kïth tier dhiithi ki jenni mo thööth, nee laar twaaø, nee cuu moa en yie ciekge.›
english: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

anywaa: «Kiper man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, « ‹Wui, otïmö ni leth jï pääny man wø kuny piny ki rem jiy, ki jï dhiithi mana näk gïïa reyø na en dëëre poot kär ö wøk. Rïŋö mana no othemø na en yie kwäny wøk na aciel aciel, ni bäŋgø mo jier.
english: Wherefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall upon it.

anywaa: Kiper rem jiy moa køny piny dï pääny poot nutö dïëre, ni ee køny bäät kïte jaak, ni käre koony yïth ŋøøm nee uum ŋøømmi.
english: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;

anywaa: 'Ba aani, remø mare awiia wøk thuwø bäät kïte, ni put bëëte kaace ni kär uumö, naa coola kwör ki køør wëër mara.›
english: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, « ‹Wui, otïmö ni leth jï pääny man wø kuny piny ki rem jiy! Eni ruba rubö ki maac mo päl.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

anywaa: Rup maac ki jenni mo thööth nee liele, ni wëëgï rïŋö twaaø na kare ni kunyï cwege wøk, ni ö cuuwi ni waaŋge.
english: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.

anywaa: Køøre dhiithi wär thäänh maac ni yie bäŋ gïrpiny, ni weyï gø nee lëënhnhe këël kanyo tïm dëëre ni wärri ni kwaar. Kanyøgønø gïïa näk ba tøŋ na en yie oleeny, ni ö gïïa reyø na en yie ni waaŋ ge.
english: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, aana ööle ki tïïc jaak, ni gïïa reyø na en yie kär ö wøk. Ennø, kïtha yi maac.
english: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ennø, ï na Jerucalem, japa reyø na tïïyï, ïïna tïïcge niï ba waany. Kiper ïïna päänynya ki man penya ïïni, 'ba ï kär tïmö niï waany yïth japa reyø na enï yïthge. 'Ba ïïni, ï ba tïmö niï tøŋ këët këël kanyo ö wëërri mara noo røm riï.
english: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.

anywaa: A na Wuuö Jwøk, luubö mara anø caana. Cäŋ man tïïa yie aløny ni öö. Aani cwïnya ba wara, ni bäŋ bäth ec mo nyoodha jïrï, wala ki man päth cwïnya ki gïrï. Aani ï jääla jäälö ki køør uutjïëthe moï ki japa reyø na tïïyï.› Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: I the Lord have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Also the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, ŋat wø neetï ni wø pär cwïnyï kipere daa daa buutï ni cwöba riï; 'ba ïïni, kärï kïmmö, ni ba jwöŋï, ni ba øc pï nyeŋŋï piny.
english: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.

anywaa: Ŋurï ki yi cwïnyï ni ba jwöŋï kiper ŋata thøw. Abïï wïc marï bëëde ni iï meen wïïï, ni kïthï war moï tietï; kär täärnyïmï uumï, ni ba cämï ki caammi mo wø jiiŋŋi kiper jø wø kïmmi.»
english: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.

anywaa: Kanyøgø luummögø acaana jï jiy ka amöölla, 'ba na tïme na abøøya cïïa aput thøø. 'Ba na tïme na amöölla maya gïna kööm aani ki gø aputa tïïc keda mana caani jïra.
english: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.

anywaa: Køøre jiy aana pëënyge, na «?Aŋø, tiet japi ni tïïyï ii ba caanï jïwa?»
english: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana köö jïge, ni «Dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Then I answered them, The word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, Ni aani øt lam mara na en kur keere wëëga päät; ni beeye kanya teek ni wø ŋwöu kipere, nou töödö ni yïthu met ki man raŋŋu gø, ni cwïnynyu ee tïïö ni met. Ni ö wäätu ki nyïïu moa wiiu ŋäthu Jerucalem ni 'näk geni ko opëëllö.
english: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.

anywaa: Køøre nø, tïïyu tïïö kaamana tïïa gø; uuno tïmö ni täärnyïmmu ba loopu, nou ba cämö ki caammi mo wø jiiŋŋi kiper jø wø kïmmi.
english: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.

anywaa: Nou bëëdö na abïïk wïc mou you meen wïthu, ni war mou ena tietu. Nou ba kïmmi wala u jwöŋö, 'ba uuno bëëdö ni uuno dwaalø, nou ŋurö yïthakiyu keeru.
english: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

anywaa: 'Ba Edhikiel otïmö na nyuudhi kiperu; gïna tïïe otïïyu kaawat mana tïïc gø. 'Ba kanyo täk gïnögø oŋäyu ni bee aani na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø en, kanyo raanynya øt lam marge na teek, ni beeye kar met ec marge ka ajiem marge, ni wø raŋge ni yïthge met ni cwïnyge pärö kipere, ni raanynya wäätge ki nyïïge thuwø,
english: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,

anywaa: dïcäŋöca ki røk jiy moo bwøk kiper ränynyö manøgø, dhaanhø mør oööi ni waac gø jïrï.
english: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca dhiï ojap ni cäänï ki eni, ni ba bëëdï këët niï lïŋö. Kanyøgønø ïïno tïmö ni ïïna nyuudhi kiperge, ni ö geni ni ŋäcge gø ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär Dhaanhø, løø nyïmï po jø Amön ni caanï luum ajäla man jïge,
english: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;

anywaa: ni kööï jïge, ni ‹Wïnynyu dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana ŋeethu bäät øt lam mara na en kur keere kanya päädi, ki mana ŋeethu bäät ŋööm Icriel na dööŋe no oränynyö, ki mana ŋeethu bäät mäk mar jø Juuda kanya mak geni ki tøŋ,
english: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, aani, u cïba ceŋ jiy mo wø bëëdö kur tuulcäŋ ni tïmu ni uuna moge. Geno tïïö dïïu ki kwör bëëte moge, ni cwöthge oduŋkaare moge yïthakiyu, ni camge nyïïjenni mou, ni maathge caak mou.
english: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.

anywaa: Aani, pääny Raaba otïïa na kar kwaath mar athïrööle, ni tïïa ŋööm jø Amön na kar jwöm jï dïëk. Køøre putu ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper na paŋŋu ceŋŋu ni päru ki tietu ni yïthu omïnnö nou taaga ŋööm Icriel ki cwïnynyu bäre,
english: For thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, aani, cera otïŋa maal bäätu ni jääla uuni. Ni cïba uuni jï wïth juurre ni twierge uuni. Aani, u raanynya raanynyø dï wïth juurre, ni puta wïthu dïïr dïge. U puta ka raanynyø møn, ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana kö jø Möapi ki jø Cëër, ni «Neenï, dhi øt Juuda atïmö kaamar wïth juurre møøk jaak,»
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, ka adïëri møn, aani, nyeŋ keee mo jø Möap owëëga dööŋŋe ni ŋaam, ni beeye ki mano täge ki päänye moa en keew, ni beege Bëëth- Jecimöt ki Baal-Miyön ki Kiriatayim na näk ajiem ŋöömmögø.
english: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Beth–jeshimoth, Baal–meon, and Kiriathaim,

anywaa: Aani jø Möap ki jø Amön ge cïba ceŋ jø kur tuul-cäŋ ni tïmge na moge, ni raanynya geni, ni put tïmö ni wïc ba par ki jø Amön ki yïthakic wïth juurre.
english: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.

anywaa: Aani, ajäla okïtha bäät jø Möap; køøre putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana ö jø Ëdömmi na tïïge ki gïn mo raac dëër dhi øt Juuda ki køør män marge na dwøŋ, ni tïm gïnögø na bääyö bäätge,›
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk luumma caane kiperge bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Aani cera tïŋa maal bäät ŋööm Ëdöm ni jääla gø, ni nääa jiy moe ki lääc paac moe, ni wëëga gø ränynyö. Geni, ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni beeye ki mano täge ki pääny Tëman këël mano këët pääny Didan.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.

anywaa: Kwör coola coolø dëët jø Ëdöm ki ri jiya ma jø Icriel, ni tïïcge gïnögø dëët jø Ëdöm ki køør wëër mara ki gootø mara. Køøre nø, putge ka ŋäc ni manøgø bee cool kwör mara. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana ö jø Pilitinni na tïïge ki gïn mo raac ki køør ataa marge na dwøŋ, ni cätge ki yïth cwïnyge ki man raanyge Juuda ki køør män marge mana käl ya acääŋŋe,›
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, a ena bäät man tïŋa cera maal bäät jø Pilitin ki man jääla geni, ni ö jø Kelita ni raanynya geni, ni raanynya thäkge moo dööŋ deŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.

anywaa: Aani, kwör coola coolø dëëtge, ni jääla geni ki køør wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac. 'Ba kanyo coola kwör dëëtge, oputge ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurciel, ni nïr dwääy aciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär Dhaanhø, pääny Tayar aŋeethø bäät Jerucalem ni kööe, ni ‹Dhøk kiir mo wø duny wïth juurre yi Jerucalem ki yïthge atoor piny, ni dööŋge ni ŋaam jïra. Ennø, ena ränynyö, 'ba aani, a kwär nø.›
english: Son of man, because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Ï na pääny Tayar en, aani, ï jääla jäälö. Kaawat man wø kän naama dwøŋŋi ka athaga mo dwøŋ, aani, a kännö ki wïth juurre mo thööth ni tukge ïïni.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyre, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.

anywaa: Geni kiiri mo Tayar oraanyge, ni nyaage kwör koor moe piny moa no ogeerø ni teek. Aani, ŋøøm moe ojwiea, ni dööŋe na kïdi jaak.
english: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

anywaa: Ni dööŋ kare dï naama dwøŋ na kar määc ka ajääpi; kiper luummögø anø caana. Eno tïmö ni beeye kany twier wïth juurre. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.

anywaa: Jic Tayar moa en mïëri moa en wøk di nääö ko opëëllö; køøre nø, putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn na näk nyeny nyeye, käla kälö ki wï-piny, ni käädö ko okwëënyi, ki jïëth okwëëc leny, ki jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi, ki jø leny mo thööth nee öge kuna raanyge Tayar.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring upon Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.

anywaa: Ï na pääny Tayar, mïëri moï moa en wøk oraanynye ko opëëllö. Deŋŋï othøre ki ŋøøm, ni tïïe ki kwör leny mo tuk pääny ki yie, ni tïŋ kwöt leny mare maal bäätï ni raany ïïni.
english: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.

anywaa: Eni jenni mo wø thiel kiir ki gø ogøø røk kiiri, ni ö kwör gwøk røk moï ni toor geni piny ki jap leny moe.
english: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper okwëënyi moe na thööth, tør tietge uuno rïëpge piny. Ni ö kiiri moï ni tïmge ni kwanynyi ki dööt tiet okwëëc leny, ki jap leny, ki jïëth okwëëc leny kanyo duny Nabukedenecörri yi kiir. Eno tïmö kaawat man wø ö jø lenynyi wø dønyge yi kiir mo bëëdö no opädhö.
english: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.

anywaa: Okiei mo okwëënyi moe uutjïëthe moï bëët onyørge. Jiy moï onääe ko opëëllö, ni ö kïte moa no otieŋø na no ocwöth piny na gïï lam ni päthge piny yïth ŋøøm.
english: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.

anywaa: Jø leny jap kwär moï ki jap gath moï otwierge, ni ö kiiri moï ni toorge geni piny, ni raanyge uudi moï moa beyø, ni ö kïte ki jenni ki ŋøøm ni putge gø leeŋ yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.

anywaa: Dudi moï moa wara wär tïïa tïïö nee cuŋge, ni ö dööt thøme moï ni ba wïnynyi këët.
english: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï tïïa tïïö kaamar kïdi ma caanynya, ni putï tïmö na kar määc ka ajääpi. Ni ba geer ïïni këët na bäre bäre; kiper luummögø anø caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk jï pääny Tayar, ena köö: Mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, dëëtge otïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär ki dwør pädhö marï kanyo tïm jøøa näk dëëtge da ŋwiili ni cooyø ki 'näk mano tägi yiï.
english: Thus saith the Lord God to Tyre; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?

anywaa: Køøre kwääri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ geno ö piny ki bäät wäle moge, ni kälge abïïk kwär moge wøk, ni ö abïïe moge moa no okwøø ni mïërö ni göönyge ge wøk. Ni ö lwärri ni boony geni kaamar abïï, ni pïge piny yïth ŋøøm, ni bëëtge ni dëëtge kwanynyi ni yïthge othäŋŋö ki gïna tägö dëërï.
english: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.

anywaa: Køøre geno kïmmi kiperï ni köge ki ïïni, « ‹Wui, aŋø, päänya bëëdö ni ŋäc ki jiye mo wø tïïö bäät naama dwøŋ, ni bëëdö ni jïre da teek bäät naama dwøŋ ki jiy moe, ni jøw bëët mo wø bëëdö kaace lwäär ki gø, oränynyö nidïï!
english: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jø wø bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ, dëëtge otïmö ni kwanynyi ki dïcäŋ pädhö marï, ni ö jø wø bëëdö mïëri moa en deŋ naama dwøŋ ni thäŋ yïthge ki ränynyö marï.›
english: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

anywaa: «Kiper man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, ï tïïa tïïö na pääny mo bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni tïmï kaamar pääny mo ba beet. Aani, naam kööla bäätï ni mwøny ïïni,
english: For thus saith the Lord God; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;

anywaa: ni kïtha ïïni piny baŋ jøøa en kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni bee baŋ jøøa thøw cøøn, ni tïïa kar bëëtö marï ni ena tiet ŋøøm, kaamar mïëri moa no oränynyö cøøn, ni kuutu na aciel kar bëët jwïëc jøøgø, ni ba cäŋï duuö niï bëëdï kar bëët jwïëc jiy moa kwøw.
english: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;

anywaa: Aano kän bäätï ki gïn mo leth døc, ni ö ïïni ni ba bëëdï këët. Ïïno manynyï, ni ba joot ïïni këët na bäre bäre.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, wärï ki duut kïmmö mo cäänö kaper pääny Tayar.
english: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyre;

anywaa: Caanï jï pääny Tayar, paana en deŋ naama dwøŋ ni wø gädhö ki wïth juurre mo thööth mo wø en bäät naama dwøŋ, ni kööï jïre ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, « ‹Wui, pääny Tayar, ïïna köö niï mïërö døc.
english: And say unto Tyre, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord God; O Tyre, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.

anywaa: Nyeŋ kee moï ena dï naama dwøŋ; ni jø geer moa geer ïïni, ï ege tïïö kaamar baabuur mo mïërö døc.
english: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.

anywaa: Geni, jenni moa no oŋørø na geer ïïni ki ge bëët kälge ka bäät Kïn Canër. Gena kännö ki jaath mo pere leth ki yi lur Libaanø, nee tïïc na jaath man wø cwöth yi baabuur ni wø lïër abïï jamø bääte.
english: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

anywaa: Geni, opääli moï atïïcge ki jera teek na käl kanya cwøl ni Baacan; ni ö jera teek na käl yïth mïëc Caypara moa en bäät naama dwøŋ ni tïïcge ge no opämi mo wø peeth piny yiï, no ojiiŋŋø ki lak lïëy.
english: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Kittim.

anywaa: Abïïk jamø moï cwääc ka waac lïïna moa tar mo Ijep mo okwøø ni mïërö, ni ge bëëdö kaamar bëëre bäätu, na abïïk gëëŋi moï, mo wø lïër kiper cäŋ, kïtge caala kït abïcøle ki dïmuur, ni beege abïïe moa käl yïth mïëc Elica moa en bäät naama dwøŋ.
english: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.

anywaa: Ni jø Caydan ki jø Arbat bëëdö na dïkïïwe moï. Wui, pääny Tayar, jiy moï moa nyeŋge reegø ena buutï, ni beege jø wø raŋ bëët naam.
english: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyre, that were in thee, were thy pilots.

anywaa: Paana cwøl ni Gëbal, jø døøŋŋø moe ki jiye moa wïthge leer ena buutï, ni ge dwøga jammi moï karge moa no otøyø. Jïëthe bëët mo naama dwøŋ ki jø wø tïïö yïthge, ena buutï niï gädhö ki geni.
english: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Parca, ki jø Lidiya, ki jø Put, ge bëëdö ni gena jø leny dï jø leny moï, ni kööde mo leny mo wø gëëŋ dëël ki ge ki mo wø røø wïc ege lïër dëërï, ni ö nyeŋŋï ni putge gø tïŋ maal.
english: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.

anywaa: Jø Arbat ki jø leny moï ge ena bäät kiir marï ni deŋ gø ege wïrö bäre, ni ö jø Gëmada ni enge bäät uut koor moï moa no ogeerø ni bäyö, ni ge bëëdö ni kööde moge ege lïërö dëër kiir marï, ni deŋ kiir ege wïrö bäre,  ni putge ïïni tïïc niï mïërö.
english: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Tarcëc gena gänhnhö baŋï kiper jap kwärö moï na thööth. Gwetbïrö moge, ki nywïëny moge moa teek, ki kørkørre moge, ki nywïëny moge moa näk eracaac agathge ki ïïni ki jap kwärö moï.
english: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Gïrïïk, ki jø Tubal, ki jø Möcak, gena gänhnhö baŋï. Geni, laaŋe moge ki jammi moa no otïïö ki nywïënyö mana näk jwïël, agathge ki ïïni ki jap kwärö moï.
english: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø Bëëth-Tögarma okwëënyi moge mo tïïc, ko okwëënyi moge mo leny, ki gääŋŋe moge agathge ki ïïni ki jap kwärö moï.
english: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø Didan thuwø gena gänhnhö baŋï. Mïëri mo thööth moa en bäät naama dwøŋ ge gänhnha baŋï. Lak lïëy moge, ki jera teek na cøl agathge ki ïïni.
english: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Ëdöm gena gänhnhö baŋï kiper jammi moï na thööth; geni, nyeŋ kïte moge moa perge leth, ka abïïe mo kwayø, ka abïïe mo okwøø na wøpe, ka abïïk lïïne moa pøøth, ki jap mïërö ma teeŋi, ki tiik jëëthi, agathge ki ïïni.
english: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Juuda ki jø ŋööm Icriel gena bëëdö ni ge gänhnha baŋï. Geni, beega käl kanya cwøl ni Minit, ki muunni mo odeelø, ki maar kïc, ki teeŋ mädhi møøk, ki riie, agathge ki ïïni.
english: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Damacka gena bëëdö thuwø ni ge gänhnha baŋï, kiper mana bëëdï ni jïrï da jammi mo thööth ni ïïno kwär døc. Kwøŋ moa käl Këlbön ki jïëc røømmø moa käl kanya cwøl ni Dhakar agathge ki ïïni.
english: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø tuuŋ Daan ki jø Gïrïïk gena öö ki yi Udhal kuna gänhge baŋï ki jammi. Geni, nywïëny mo othäädhö, ki jer wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met agathge ki ïïni.
english: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Didan abïïk wø peeth bäät okwëëc lääy agathge ki ïïni.
english: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Araba ki kwääri bëët mo Këdar ge bëëdö ni ge gänhnhö baŋï. Geni, nyïïdïëk, ki nyöök rööm, ka atëëe, agathge ki ïïni.
english: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.

anywaa: « ‹Dïgäthe mo Cïïba ki dïgäthe mo Raama gena gänhnhö baŋï, ni ö teeŋ jenni bëët mo wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, ki nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth, ki warkey, ni gathge gø ki ïïni.
english: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.

anywaa: « ‹Jø Aaren, ki jø Kane, ki jø Ëden, ki dïgäthe mo Caaba, ki jø Acör, ki jø Kilmat, gena gädhö ki ïïni.
english: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.

anywaa: Abïïe mo beyø, ka abïïe mo kïtge caala kït abïcøle, ka abïïe mo okwøø ni beyø, ka abïïe mo rege da kït ma teeŋi mo wø peeth dï øtø, ki thøøli mo teek, agathge ki ïïni kar gath marï.
english: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.

anywaa: « ‹Baabuure mo Tarcëc ge bëëdö ni ge jwïëga jammi moï, niï bëëdö ni jammi päŋ jïrï, niï cäädhö dï naama dwøŋ niï peek ki jap gath.
english: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.

anywaa: Dïkïïwe moï ïïna kïthge dï naam kuya. 'Ba jam wø kwönni ki kur tuulcäŋ ïïno tøye na thäŋi dï naama dwøŋ;
english: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

anywaa: ni ö jap kwärö moï, ki japa beyø moï, ki jap gath moï, ki jiy moï moa näk abïïk jamø ena ceŋge, ki jiy moï mo wø raŋ bëët naam, ki jiy moï mo wø dwøk japa näk otøyø karge, ki jø gath moï, ki jø leny moï bëët, ki jiy moï bëët, ni mutge yi naama dwøŋ dïcäŋo raanynya ïïni yie.
english: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

anywaa: Ŋööm ageel naama dwøŋ dëëre jäŋe jäŋö ki dööt jiy moï mo wø raŋ bëët naam kanyo jwöŋge.
english: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.

anywaa: Jiy bëët moa näk ceŋge da opääli, ki jiy moa näk abïïk jamø ena ceŋge, ki jø wø raŋ bëët naam, ge ööa wøk ki yïth baabuure moge, ni cuŋge wøk bäät ageela.
english: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

anywaa: Køøre ge jwöŋö bäätï ni döötge ege tïŋ maal døc ni cwïnyge ege keeyø. Wïthge jööpge jööpö ki tør ni ŋïëlge yi bur.
english: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:

anywaa: Ni gwäärge wïthge wøk kiperï, ni dwølge keece dëëtge. Ge jwöŋö bäätï ni cwïnyge oränynyö, ni ge kïmmö ki kïmmö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo bëëtge ni ge guyö ni ge kïmmö bäätï, duut kïmmö man wärge wärö kiperï ni ge köö na ennønø: ?Wui, Tayar, aŋa ni caal ïïni, aŋa ni caal ïïni no onikïïl dï naama dwøŋ en?
english: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyre, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?

anywaa: Kany wø näk jap gath moï iï jääŋŋö wøk ki bäät naama dwøŋ, wïth juurre mo thööth putï ka wëëk jäŋö; ni ö nyeye mo bäät piny ni wëëgï ge kwärö ki jap kwärö moï bëët ki jap gath moï.
english: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, pï naama dwøŋ ïïna tøye tiet pïï kanya päŋ. Jap gath moï ki japa en jïrï bëët anilïŋ ki ïïni na aciel.
english: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.

anywaa: Mïëri bëët moa en bäät naama dwøŋ, yïthge athäŋŋö bäätï, ni ö nyeye moge ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi ki lwär, ni nyeŋge okwätö.
english: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.

anywaa: 'Ba dïgäthe moa en dï wïth juurre ïïna buuge; ni put gïï mo lethi pïï bäätï, ni ö ïïni ni ba bëëdï këët.› »
english: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caanï jï nyeny Tayar ni kööï ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, «ni ‹Kiper mana näk miï töödö ki cwïnyï, ïïna cäänö kiper dëërï, ni kööï, ni «Aana Jwøk, aana nø pï piny bäät wälu mar Jwøk dï naama dwøŋ.» 'Ba ïïni, ïïna dhaanhø, ï patha Jwøk, këël na cädï ki cwïnyï ni wïïï leer kaamar Jwøk.
english: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyre, Thus saith the Lord God; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:

anywaa: Ïïni wïïï leer møn niï kaala Daniel, ni bäŋ luubö mo tiere okanø ki ïïni.
english: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:

anywaa: Ki køør leec wïc marï ki ŋäc tiet jammi, ïïna jïtö ki jap kwärö kiper dëërï, ni ö warkey ki gwet-bïrö ni cooŋï ge yi øt kän marï.
english: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:

anywaa: Ki køør mana bëëdï ni waŋï riek døc ki gath, jap kwärö moï athöönhnhö, ni ö atöörri ni døøŋŋe cwïnyï kiper jap kwärö moï.
english: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caana kiperï, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, aana köö: ni Kiper mana cädï ni wïïï leer kaamar Jwøk,
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;

anywaa: jiy mo path wëëga ööny maal bäätï, ni beege jøøa no ogäy døc dï wïth juurre; ge ööa baŋï no opëëlle moge ege wöth wøk, ni raanyge mïërö marï ki leec wïc marï, ni putge ajiem marï päät.
english: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.

anywaa: Geni, ge öö ni leeŋge ïïni kar bëët jwïëc jiy moa no othøw, ni thøwï ki thøø mo raac dï naama dwøŋ.
english: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.

anywaa: ?Løny ki man kööï këët, ni «Aana Jwøk»,  nyïm jiy moo 'näk ïïni? Ïïni, ï tïmö ni ïïna dhaanhø ceŋ jiy moo 'näk ïïni, niï patha Jwøk.
english: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï thøw ceŋ jøøa path ki thøø mo caala thøw jiy moa näk kär daŋø. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, wärï ki duut kïmmö mo cäänö kaper nyeny Tayar, ni kööï jïgø, ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk kiperï, ena köö, «ni ‹Ïïna ŋïï mar bëënynyö mo othur kare, ni wïïï leer døc niï mïërö døc.
english: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyre, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord God; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.

anywaa: Ïïna bëëdö yi Ëden, ni bee ya ajïniina mar Jwøk, ni bëëdï ni ïïno ŋwaŋŋø ki nyeŋ kïte ma teeŋi mo mïërö, ni beege mo kwaar kaamar dha adhieŋ, ki mo piilli kaamar warkey, ki mo mar, ki mo caala okwëër, ki mo ŋwaŋŋi, ki mo tøŋ kede wïlli, ki mo ränni, ki mo caala kït dïmuuy, ki mo caala keenh-orwëëdhö. 'Ba nyeŋ kïte moøgø, gïï wø maai piny ki ge bëëdö no otïïö ki warkey, ni ge jiiŋŋi ka dïcäŋa cwääc ïïni.
english: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.

anywaa: Ïïno røønyø na nyïïatwiel maal man wø cwøl ni kirubël; niï yaa cïp kaagø na ŋat koor. Ïïni, ï ena bäät kïnna en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk, niï cäädhï ka bäät kïte mo bëëdö kaamar maac.
english: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.

anywaa: Ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa cwääc ïïni, ï bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö marï; 'ba køøre, ïïna bääyö.
english: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.

anywaa: Ki køør mana tïm jap gath moï ni thööth, cwïnyï atïmö ni päŋ ka ageem, ni tïmï niï bääö. Kiper manøgønø, ïïna wëëga päät, ni käla ïïni wøk ki bäät Kïn Jwøk. Wui, ï na nyïïatwiel ma kirubël ni wø kurö, ïïna wëëga ränynyö yïthakic kïte moa näk caala maac.
english: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.

anywaa: Ïïna tïmö niï töödö ki cwïnyï ki køør mïërö marï, ni wëëgï leec wïc marï ränynyö ki køør beer marï. Kiper manøgønø, ïïna leeŋa piny yïth ŋøøm; ni wëëga ïïni cïp nyïm nyeye niï raŋge.
english: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.

anywaa: Ki køør japa reyø na tïïyï, ki gath mana tïïyï ki jöö mo määnö, karï na en kur keere awëëgï ränynyö. Kiper manøgønø, maac wëëga ööny wøk ki baŋï, ni ö maaci manøgø ni put ïïni waaŋ na bäre, ni puta ïïni tïïc na bur bäät ŋøøm nyïm jiy bëët mo wø neet ïïni.
english: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.

anywaa: Ni ö wïth juurre bëët moa ŋäc ïïni ni thäŋ yïthge ki gïrï, ni put gïï mo lethi pïï bäätï, ni ö ïïni ni ba bëëdï këët.› »
english: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ pääny Caydan, ni cäännï gø niï jääla gø,
english: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,

anywaa: ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, « ‹Wui, ï na Caydan, ï wëëga ajäla ennø, naa jiem ki køørï,  nee ŋäc jiyi moï ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo jääla ïïni, noo nyoodha ajiem mara na en kur keere iï.
english: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.

anywaa: Aani, täw mo leth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätï, ni wëëga remø kwödö ki nyeŋ jïëthe moï. Jiy moï geno näk ko opëëllö ni bëëtge no opäänhnhö dïërï. Køøre nø, oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her streets; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kanyøgønø ki røk wïth juurre moa en deŋ Icriel, otïmö ni bäŋ jiy këët mo ogäy mo ge bëëdö kaamar oŋöön ko otwel mo cööba jø Icriel. Køøre putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kanyo cuuŋa jø Icriel ki dï wïth juurre moa näk geno keethø yïthge, ajiem mara nyoodha nyoodhø dïge ni nëënö jï wïth juurre. Køøre geno bëëdö yi ŋöömö marge mana cïba jï dhaanhnha ma Jeekap.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.

anywaa: Geni, ge bëëdö ni geno gwøø kaace, ni gëëtge ki uudi ni pïïthge ki jer omøki. Geni, ge bëëdö ni geno gwøø kanyo jääla jiy moa en deŋge ni wø cäänö ki gïï mo reyø dëëtge. Køøre nø putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge.› »
english: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar, ni nïr dwää apaar, apaar kurriiø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ Peerø nyeny Ijep, ni caanï luum ajäla man jïre ki jø Ijep bëët.
english: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:

anywaa: Caanï jïre ni kööï, ni man bee luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ena köö, « ‹Ka adïëri møn, ï na Peerø nyeny Ijep, ï jääla jäälö; ï ni bëëdö kaamar lääna dwøŋ, ni ïïno but piny yïthakic nyeŋ näm moï, ni kööï, ni «Naam Nail bee mara, ni eni tïïa kaper dëëra.»
english: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ï gäna gänö ko obïïdhi ki dhiï, ni ö rec nämmi moï ni muna ge dëërï, ni tuuda ïïni wøk ki yïth näm moï ki rec moï bëët moa no onimun dëërï.
english: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.

anywaa: Ïïni ki rec näm moï bëët, uuno weta kany mo otal, ni päthu yi pwöla mo leer, ni bäŋ ŋat cooŋ uuni wala koonya uuni. Uuno tïïa na cam jï lääc paap ki wec maal bëët.
english: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.

anywaa: Køøre jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yi Ijep oputge ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper ï na Ijep, ïïna bëëdö kaamar athøny abaarø man wø ö jø Icrielli wø piemge dëëtge ki gø.
english: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo makge ïïni ki ceŋge, ï puta toor, ni cööbï göökge, ni kany wø piemge dëëtge ki ïïni, ï puta toor, ni ö pëëtge ni putge rege jak.›
english: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, no ‹Opëëllö mara okäla bäätï, ni nääa jiy moï ki lääy moge bëët.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.

anywaa: Ijep odööŋ ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie. Køøre nø, oputge ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk. « ‹'Ba kiper mana kööï, ni «Naam Nail bee mara, ni eni tïïya aani,»
english: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the Lord: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, ï na Peerø, ïïno jääla ki näm moï, ni raanynya ŋööm Ijep ni put dööŋŋö ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni beeye ki mano täge ki Migdöl këël Acwan, ni pööth keew ki ŋööm Kuuc.
english: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø wala lääy mo ŋutö ki yie. Ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat bëëdö yie ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.

anywaa: Aani, ŋööm Ijep tïïa tïïö nee dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie yïthakic mïëri moa no oränynyö; ni ö päänye moe ni putge dööŋŋe no oränynyö ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween yïthakic päänye moa no oniruuth piny cøøn. Ni puta jø Ijep keethø yïthakic wïth juurre ki yïth mïëri.›
english: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

anywaa: «'Ba luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Noo tïme na aŋuun cwiiri moøgø na pïëraŋween yøø, jø Ijep duua duuö ki dï wïth juurre kwöra keetha ge yïthge.
english: Yet thus saith the Lord God; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:

anywaa: Geni, ge duua wøk ki yi bëët laŋ ni kïtha ge yi ŋööm Ijep mana cwøl ni Patröc, ni beeye ŋöömma beet kwäcge. 'Ba buc nyec marge odwøk piny kaagø.
english: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.

anywaa: Eno tïmö ni ena piny ki buc nyeye, ni put tïmö ni ba løny jïre këët ki man tïŋ ree maal bäät wïth juurre. Eni eno tïïa ni jääk nee wïth juurre ba kääre këët.
english: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.

anywaa: Ijep ba tïmö këët na kany ŋääth jø Icrielli, 'ba jø Icriel wïthge oparge ki bääyö marge mana wara ŋääthge Ijep. Ni putge gø ŋäc ni bee aani na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na pïërariiø ka abïriiø, ni dwääy mana dïkwøŋ aciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe, ni
english: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn jø leny moe atïïe ni teek ki man tukge pääny Tayar. Ŋati man nø wïïe ki gööge anipwøth. 'Ba eni ki jø leny moe bäŋ gïn mo ege joodø ki køør gïna tïïe nee pääny Tayar raanynye.
english: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyre, for the service that he had served against it:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Nyeny Ijep cïba cer Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn, ni ö eni ni käl jap kwär moe, ni twier jape; ni beeye jap wø cool jï jø leny moe.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.

anywaa: Ŋööm Ijep cïba cïbö jïre na gät tïïc mare, kiper eni ki jiye gena tïïö kipera. Manøgø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, teek mar jø Icriel duua duuö, ni jaba dhiï yïthakicge, ï na Edhikiel; køøre nø, putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caan luubö man ni kööï ni luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, «ni ‹Gööu ko oduuru, ni kööu, «Wui, otïmö ni leth dïcäŋöca!»
english: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋöca kare aløny ni cään; cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk kare aløny ni cään, ni beeye cäŋ mo maal gääbö ki pøøl, na cäŋ ränynyö mar wïth juurre.
english: For the day is near, even the day of the Lord is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.

anywaa: Jø Ijep ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni ö jwør gïï mo leth ni en bäät jø Kuuc. 'Ba kanyo 'näk jiy Ijep, jap kwärö mo Ijep put ka twier, ni ö kiir mare bäre ni puti toor piny.
english: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.

anywaa: « ‹Ni ö jø Kuuc ki jø Put, ki jø Lidiya, ka Arabe bëët, ki jø Libya, ki jø ŋöömma luumme tuut, ni putge 'näk na aciel ki jø Ijep.›
english: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, « ‹Ka adïëri møn, jiy mo wø cwak Ijep ge pädhö, ni ö teeki mar Ijep man wø tööde kipere ni døø piny; ki mano täge ki jø Migdöl këël mano këët baŋ jø Acwan, ge di nääö ko opëëllö yi Ijep. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus saith the Lord; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Geni, ge ränynyö yïthakic mïëri moa no oränynyö, ni ö päänye moge ni päthge yïthakic päänye moa no oniruuth piny.
english: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk,  kanyo leeŋa maac bäät Ijep, noo raanynya jiy bëët mo wø cwak eni.
english: And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.

anywaa: « ‹Dïcäŋöca a jääga wøk ki jiy ki jïëth naam kuna wëëkge jø Kuuc lwär, ni beege jø wø köö ni geno gwøø. Geni, gïï mo leth tägö bäätge kaawat mana tägö bäät jø Ijep; ni manøgø beeye gïn ma adïëri mo ba kääŋi ki man täge.›
english: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.

anywaa: «Luubö man beeye mana caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «ni ‹Jap kwärö mo Ijep wëëga ränynyö ki ri Nabukedenecör nyeny Babiløn.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.

anywaa: Eni ki jø leny moe, ni beege jøøa no ogäy døc dï wïth juurre, wëëga ööny Ijep kuna raanyge gø. Geni, opëëlle moge wöthge wøk ni 'näkge jø Ijep, ni ö ŋööm Ijep bäre ni pääŋe ki rïŋ dëët jiy mo othøw.
english: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.

anywaa: Løle mo naam Nail wëëga talø, ni gadha ŋööm Ijep ki jøøa reyø. Aani, jøøa path jääŋŋa kuna raanyge gø, ni ö ŋöömö mare ni ränynye ki gïïa en yie bëët. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: «'Ba man thuwø beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «ni ‹Aani, juuga reyø raanynya raanynyø, ni ŋuuda lam mo kït gïï wø lam moa en Mempic. Bäŋ dïbwödhi këët mo bëëdö Ijep; aani, lwär jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäät ŋööm Ijep bäre.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Memphis; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Aani, thääŋ ŋööm Ijep mana cwøl ni Patröc wëëga ränynyö, ni wëëga pääny Dhöän waaŋ ki maac, ni puta pääny Tëbic jääl.
english: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.

anywaa: Wëër mara kønynya bäät Pëlucëm, ni beeye kar gwøk røk mana teek mar Ijep, ni raanynya jø leny moa en Tëbic.
english: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

anywaa: Ijep waaŋa waaŋø ki maac, ni ö gïn mo leth ni päth bäät Pëlucëm. Kiir Tëbic otoor piny, ni ö Mëmpici ni ba ö wøk yïth japa leth.
english: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Memphis shall have distresses daily.

anywaa: Obwöc cwøw mo Awen ki mo Pi- Biceth di nääö ko opëëllö, ni ö jø päänye ki dëëtge ni mak geni ki tøŋ.
english: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo raanynya teek mar Ijep, muudhö onijïïm bäät Thapinac, ni ö teeki mare man wø tööde kipere ni ŋøle kaace. Eni rïëp pøølli rïëbö, ni ö atude moe ni mak geni ki tøŋ.
english: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.

anywaa: Aani jø Ijep jääla jäälö. Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurciel, ni nïr dwää aciel abïriiø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, aani teek bat mar Peerø nyeny Ijep araanynya. Ena ränynyö ki ränynyö mo ba løny ki køny këët ki man døø teeki mare kare no opëëllö maae.
english: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caana, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, aana köö, ni ‹Aani, Peerø nyeny Ijep, a ööa maal bääte. Aani, teek bäädi moe bëët raanynya raanynyø, ni beeye mana kwøŋa raanynyø ki mana no odööŋ ni poot teek. Ni ö opëëllö ni wëëga gø päth piny cere.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.

anywaa: Jø Ijep wëëga nibay dï wïth juurre ni keetha geni yïth mïëri.
english: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

anywaa: Teek bäädi mo nyeny Babiløn wëëga tëënnö ni cïba opëëllö mara cere. 'Ba teek bäädi mo Peerø wëëga ränynyö, ni ö Peerø nyeny Ijep  ni cooye nyïm nyeny Babiløn kaamar dhaanhø mo ree da ŋwellø.
english: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.

anywaa: Teek bäädi mo nyeny Babiløn wëëga tëënnö. 'Ba Peerø bääte pädhö. Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo cïba opëëllö mara cer nyeny Babiløn noo køny ree ki gø ki man raany Ijep.
english: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.

anywaa: Aani jø Ijep wëëga nibay dï wïth juurre, ni keetha geni dï mïëri. Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurciel, ni nïr dwää adäk aciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caanï jï Peerø nyeny Ijep ki lwaak mare, ni kööï, «ni ‹?Ï röömï ki ŋa ki dööŋ kar marï?
english: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ŋööm Aciria abëëdö ni rööma jaath lur Libaanø na pere leth, jaadha näk bäädi moe mïërö, na näk tïpö mare dwøŋ, ni raŋa maal ni wïïe okëët yïth pøøl.
english: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.

anywaa: Ni eno wëëk pïïyi døøŋŋø, ni wëëge ya pïïyi moa en tiere bänynyö. Ni bëët tiere ni kwödö ki pïï ki deŋŋe bäre; ni pïï jääŋŋe wøk ki yïth løle baŋ jenni bëët moa en yïth pwöth.
english: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ena put tïmö na jaath mo bäär døc, ni jenni bëët moa en yïth pwöth ee kaalø; ni bäädi moe olaak ni bäyö ni thööth, kiper thööth pïï.
english: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.

anywaa: Ni ö wenynyi bëët mo maal ni gëëtge bäät gø ki uudi, ni tïm tiere na kar nyööt jï lääy bëët mo paap. Ni wïth juurre bëët moa teek ge bëëdö tier tïpö mare.
english: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.

anywaa: Ena jaath mo mïërö døc ki køør dööŋö mare ki bäädi moe na näk olaak ni bäyö, kiper lweedi moe okëët piny døc baŋ pïï moa thööth.
english: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.

anywaa: 'Ba këël jenni moa perge leth na en ya ajïniina mar Jwøk ba pääri ki eni, ni bäŋ jaath mo mïërö mo bäädi moe rööma bäädi mo gø; ni mïërö mare bäŋ jaath mo röömge ki gø ya ajïniina mar Jwøk.
english: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.

anywaa: Ena tïïa ni mïërö ni bääte okar ni thööth, ni ö jenni bëët moa en Ëden, ni beeye ajïniina mar Jwøk, ni këëcge kipere.›
english: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiper jaadhøgø, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana bäny jaathi manøgø ni lwinhnhe okëët yïth pøøl, ni jït cwïnye ka atöör kiper bär mare,
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;

anywaa: aani, ena cïba cer nyenynya teek na en bäät wïth juurre, ni jääl gø ki køør japa reyø na tïïe. 'Ba ena puta kwier,
english: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.

anywaa: ni ö jøøgø no ogäy døc yøø dï wïth juurre ni putge gø ŋøt piny ni leeŋge gø wøk, ni ö bäädi moe ni päthge bäät kïte ki yïth gøli bëët; ni put bäädi moe bëëtö no otøyø yïth aleye moa bäyö na en yi ŋööm paac. Ni ö wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny ni öge wøk ki yi tïpö mare ni wecge gø.
english: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.

anywaa: Ni ö wenynyi bëët mo maal ni putge bëëte wïth tuge moa no otøyø, ni ö lääyi bëët mo paap ni bëëtge yïthakic bäädi moe.
english: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, bäŋ jaath mo bänynyö deŋ naam këët mo töödö kiper bär mare, mo bäädi moe okëët yïth pøøl. Bäŋ jaath këët mo tiere da pïï mo døøŋŋø ni bäär. Ge thøw bëët ni cige tiet ŋøøm yïthakic jiy moa no othøw na en yïth bwör.›
english: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Dïcäŋa ö jaathi manøgø na ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, jammi bëët awëëga kïmmö kipere, ni ö pïïyi moa en tiere ni ŋøla gø, ni wëëga näm døø mo wø kwöt tier gø. Pïïa thööth ni wø kwöt tiere aŋøl, ni tïïa lur Libaanø nee kïmme bäät gø; ni ö jenni bëët moa en yi pwöla ni talge ki køøre.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre, dëëtge awëëga tïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär ki dwør pädhö mare, kanya wëëga gø ciin kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw baŋ jiy moa no onø ci yïth bwör. Køøre jenni bëët mo Ëden moa näk tietge da pïï, ki jer lur Libaanø moa perge leth na beyø, gena jïtö ki cøm cwïny tiet ŋøøm.
english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa wara bëëdö tier tïpö mare, ki jiy moa no ogöök dëëre dï wïth juurre, gena ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw ki eni ciel, ni dwalge rege na aciel ki jiy moa 'näk ko opëëllö.
english: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.

anywaa: « ‹?Aŋø, da jaath mar Ëden ma ajiem mare ki dööŋö mare röömi ki marï? 'Ba ïïni, ï na Peerø en, ï kïtha yi bwörö tiet ŋøøm ki jer Ëden na aciel; ni peeth ïïni piny na aciel ki jøøa näk kär daŋø na 'näk ko opëëllö. 'Ba manøgø beeye Peerø ki jiy moe bëët.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurriiø, ni nïr dwää apaar kurriiø aciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, wärï ki duut kïmmö kiper Peerø nyeny Ijep ni kööï jïre, «ni ‹Ïïni, dëërï apäärï ki ŋuu mo teek yïthakic wïth juurre, 'ba ïïni, ï caala lääna dwøŋ na en yi naama dwøŋ, niï bëëdö niï jaalla riï yïth nyeŋ näm moï, ni duupï pïï ki tietï, ni put tïmö no odhöönh.›
english: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «ni ‹Lwaak mo päl jääŋŋa baŋï, ni makge ïïni ka ajääp mara, ni tuutge ïïni wøk.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.

anywaa: Ïïno leeŋa wøk bäät ŋøøm, ni weta ïïni yi pwöla mo leer. Wec maal bëët ki lääc paap moa no owär cööra baŋï niï camge, ni jäŋge ki ïïni.
english: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.

anywaa: Rïŋ dëërï kera bäät kïte, ni pääŋa yïth agäp-kïte ki rïŋ moï mo odööŋ.
english: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.

anywaa: Ŋøøm wëëga mäthö ki rem dëërï mano øc piny, këël mano këët røk kïte. Ni ö aleye ni päŋge ki rïŋ dëërï.
english: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo raanynya ïïni, maal puta ka rïëp, ni tïm ceerri ni cøl. Cäŋ ogëëŋa ki pøøl, ni ö dwääyi ni ba cïpe ki tar.
english: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.

anywaa: Gïïa en maal bëët ni wø cïpi ki tar tïïa tïïö ni cøl bäätï, ni ö muudhö ni kïtha gø bäät ŋöömö marï. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Cwïny jiy mo thööth owëëga pädhö kanyo ö ränynyö marï noo wïnye jï wïth juurre, këël mïëri moa näk kuyï.
english: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth geno wëëga bwøk ki gïno tägi dëërï, ni ö nyeye moge ni lwäcge kiper gïïo ö bäätï kanyo tuuŋŋa opëëllö mara nyïmge. 'Ba yi cäŋ mano pädhï yie, ŋati man nø dëëre otïmö ni kwanynyi, ni ö ŋati man nø ni kïmme kiper jwïëye.›
english: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

anywaa: «Kiper Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk luumma caane bee en, ena köö, «no ‹Opëëllö mar nyeny Babiløn öö ni jääl ïïni.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.

anywaa: Aani, lwaae moï owëëga 'näk ko opëëllö mo jø leny moa teek, ni beege jøøa no ogäy døc røk wïth juurre bëët. Geni, atöör mar Ijep oraanyge, ni ö lwaae moe bëët ni dïïr wïthge.
english: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.

anywaa: Lääc paac moe bëët ni wø bëëdö buut pïï moa thööth, ge nääa nääö, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ tier dhaanhø mo duupa pïïögø wala tier lää paac.
english: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.

anywaa: Køøre nø, pïïe tïïa tïïö ni tøŋ, ni tïïa nyeŋ näm moe ni kwödö kaamar maar nyïïjenni. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïïa Ijep ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni jwiea gïïa en yie na bäre, ni nääa jø wø bëëdö yie bëët, putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Manøgø beeye duut kïmmö mano jwøk Ijep ki gø. Nyïïakuue mo wïth juurre, duut manøgø owärge kiper Ijep ki lwaae moe.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
