english: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurriiø, ni nïr dwääy apaar kurbïïc, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, jwöŋï kiper lwaa Ijep, ni caanï gø jïre ki man näk mo eni cøøa piny tiet ŋøøm, ni beeye eni ki jic wïth juurre moa teek, ni beeye baŋ jøøa en kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.

anywaa: Caanï jïge ni kööï, na ‹?Aŋø, u beyø døc nou kaala jø møga? 'Ba ennø, u cøøa piny ni butu piny tiet ŋøøm yïthakic jøøa näk kär daŋø.›
english: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

anywaa: Geni, geno päth piny yïthakic jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö. Opëëllö anø jiiŋŋi; tuudu eni wøk ki lwaae moe bëët.
english: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwöthe moa teek na en kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, geno cäänö kiper Ijep ki jøøa wara køny gø, ni köge, ni ‹Gena ö piny nee butge piny yïthakic jøøa näk kär daŋø, ni beege jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö.›
english: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.

anywaa: «Nyeny Aciria ki jø leny moe, ge ena kaace, ni bwörö mare ociel bwörri mo lwaae moe, ni beege jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö bëët.
english: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:

anywaa: Bwör moge ena piny kuya, ni bwör mo jø leny moe rege ciel deŋ bwörö mare. Jøøa wara tïïc mïëri ni lwäär gena thøw, gena 'näk ko opëëllö.
english: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.

anywaa: «Nyeny Ilam ena kaace, ni bwör mo lwaae moe rege ciel deŋ bwörö mare. Geni bëët gena thøw, ni ge 'näk ko opëëllö. Jøøa wara tïïc mïëri ni lwäär, gena ci tiet ŋøøm ni ge kär daŋø. Geni, lään wïc marge arøm dëëtge, ge ki jøøa no onø ci kar bëët jwïëc jiy moa no othøw.
english: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.

anywaa: Eni ki lwaae moe bëët, gena tïmmi ki kar niine yïthakic jøøa no onääö, ni ö bwörri mo lwaae moe ni cielge bwörö mare dïër. Geni bëët ge 'näk ko opëëllö, ni gena jiy mo ge kär daŋø. Geni na tïïc mïëri ni lwäär, lään wïc marge arøm dëëtge, ni cige piny baŋ jøøa en kar bëët jwïëc jiy moa no othøw. Gena but piny yïthakic jøøa no onääö.
english: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.

anywaa: «Nyeny Möcak ki nyeny Tubal ge ena kaace thuwø, ni bwör moge ociel bwörri mo lwaae moge dïër. Geni bëët, ge na näk kär daŋø, ge 'näk ko opëëllö kiper mana bëëtge ni mïëri ege tïïö ni lwäär.
english: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba kuuti ki jø leny moa näk kär daŋø na näk ge koony ka jap leny moge, ni beege jøøa koony ni geno thäänhö ko opëëlle moge. 'Ba ajäla mana pïï dëëtge akëët yïth cuu moge, këël na kwøŋge bëëte ni mïëri ege tïïö ni lwäär.
english: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.

anywaa: «Wui, Peerø, ïïni thuwø, ïïno tøyi, ni butï piny yïthakic jøøa näk kär daŋø, ni beege jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö.
english: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.

anywaa: «Ëdöm ki nyeye moe ki jø kööre moe, ge ena kaace. Teek marge aränynyö, ni putge but piny ki jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö  na aciel. Gena but piny yïthakic jøøa näk kär daŋø, ni beege jøøa näk onø ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.

anywaa: «Kwääri bëët mo wø bëëdö jï løø wï-piny, ki jø Caydan bëët, ge ena kaace. Gena ci piny baŋ jøøa no othøw ni wïthge olääö, ni beege jøøa wara tïïc mïëri ni lwäär ki teek marge. Gena but piny ni ge kär daŋø, ge ki jøøa no onääö ko opëëllö, ni lään wïc marge orøm dëëtge na aciel ki jøøa näk onø ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw.
english: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.

anywaa: «Peerø ki jø leny moe bëët kanyo neenge jøøgø, geno put jïtö ki cøm cwïny kiper lwaae moe bëët na näk onääö ko opëëllö. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Këël na bëëde ni lwäär mo dwøŋ yaa kïth bäät jøøa kwøw ki køøre, eni na Peerø en ki lwaae moe ge puta but piny yïthakic jøøa näk kär daŋø, ni bee baŋ jøøa 'näk ko opëëllö.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Again the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caanï jï jø pou, ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kanyo wëëga opëëllö ööny yi ŋöömö maru, jiy moa en yi ŋööm pou ge jëëtö ki dhaanhø aciel dïge ni tïïcge gø na ŋat koor geni.
english: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:

anywaa: 'Ba ööny tøŋ yi ŋööm paac ojoot ŋatøgø, ni ö eni ni put tuuŋ kooth ni köömma jiy.
english: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wïny dwør tuuŋ ni bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo lääŋŋe kiper gø, ni näk mo opëëllö ööa bääte ni raany jwïëy moe, remø mare tïmö ni ena bääte keere.
english: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.

anywaa: Eni kiper mana wïny dwør tuuŋ ni bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo lääŋŋe kiper gø, remø mare tïmö ni ena bääte keere. 'Ba doo na dwør tuuŋ ee wïnynyö ni reŋe, jwïëye dee piemø.
english: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋat koor manøgø opëëllö joode joodø ni öö, ni wec tuuŋ ki kooth ki man kööm jiy, ni ö opëëllö ni 'näge ki dhaanhø røk jøøgø, ŋatøca othøw yïth raay moe. 'Ba aani, rem ŋatøgø pëënynya pëënynyö bäät ŋat koor manøgø.›
english: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, ïïna tïïa na ŋat koor bäät jø Icriel. Kiper manøgønø, wïny luup moi ni cara ii, ni köömmï jø Icriel ki ge.
english: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.

anywaa: Ni näk mo aano köö jï ŋat raay, ni ‹Wui ï na ŋat raay, ï thøw møn,› ni kärï ci baŋe kuna köömmï gø nee uutjïëthe moe wiie, ŋat raay manøgø thøw yïth raay moe, 'ba aani remø mare pëënynya pëënynyö bäätï.
english: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋat raay köömmï köömmö ki man wec uutjïëthe moe, ni kweere ki man tïïc gø, eni thøw yïth raay moe, 'ba ïïni, ï dööŋ wøk ra ajäla manøgø.
english: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na wär dhaanhø, caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luum wø caannu, u köö, ni ‹Japa reyø na tïïcwa, ki raay mowa, atïmö na tëër bäätwa, ni ränywa ki køørge. ?Waano kwøwa nidïï këët nø?›
english: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?

anywaa: Caanï jïge, ni Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, cwïnya ba mïnni ki thøø mar ŋat raay, 'ba mana beer, beeye ki man løk cwïnye yïth raay moe ni kwøe. Løgu cwïnynyu! Løgu cwïnynyu ki yïth uutjïëthe mou na reyø! ?Aŋø ni manynyu thøø en, u na jø Icriel?›
english: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?

anywaa: «'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø, caanï jï wäät pou, ni kööï, ni ‹Ŋat mo bëëtö mare tiir, kany wø näk mo eno tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, eni ba piem bëëtö mare na tiir; ni ŋat mo bëëtö mare raac, kany wø näk mo cwïnye ee løø, eni ba wëëk bëëtö mare na raac pädhö. Ŋat mo bëëtö mare tiir, ni näk mo tïïö ki raay, ba løny ki man bëëde ni kwøw kiper bëëtö mare mana dïkwøŋ na tiir.
english: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.

anywaa: Ni näk mo aano köö jï ŋat mo bëëtö mare tiir, ni «Ï bëëdö niï kwøw møn,» ni ö ŋatøca ni put dëëre ŋääth ki køør bëëtö mare na tiir, ni tïïe ki raay, japa beyø bëët na tïïe, bäŋgø mo  wïc di parø ki gø; eni thøw yïth raay moe na tïïe.
english: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo aano köö jï ŋat mo bëëtö mare raac, ni «Ï thøw møn,» ni ö ŋatøca ni løk cwïnye yïth raay moe, ni tïme ni tïïya gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ,
english: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;

anywaa: ni dwøk gïn mo ee kälö na dïgïti baŋ wati, ni dwøk gïn mo ee kwalø baŋ wati, ni caath køør ciik 'moa ni wø cïp kwøw, ni ba tïïö ki gïn mo raac, eni bëëdö ni kwøw møn; eni ba thøw.
english: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.

anywaa: Raay moa tïïe bëët bäŋgø mo wïc di parø ki gø mo eni di jäälö kipere. Kiper ena tïïö ki gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ; eni bëëdö ni kwøw møn.
english: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø pou gena köö, ni «Uutjïëthe mo tïï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki ki ge ii ba thïïŋ.» 'Ba beeye uutjïëthe moge na näk ba thïïŋ.
english: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.

anywaa: Ni näk ŋat mo bëëtö mare tiir, bëëtö mare na tiir wiie wiiø ni tïïe ki raay, eni thøw yïth raaye.
english: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋat mo bëëtö mare raac, bëëtö mare na raac wiie wiiø ni tïme ni tïïya gïn ma adïëri ki gïn mo thïïŋ, eni kwøw ki køør gø.
english: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, uuna cäŋ köö, ni «Uutjïëthe moi ni tïï Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki ki ge ii ba thïïŋ.» 'Ba aani, ŋati man nø dëëtu luumme ŋøla ŋølø ki køør uutjïëthe moe.› »
english: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na apaar kurriiø, ni nïr dwää apaar, abïïc, dhaanhø mør mo opäär wøk ki yi Jerucalem aö baŋa, ni kööe, ni «Pääny anyak!»
english: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.

anywaa: 'Ba ki wäär ni ŋatøgø poot kär öö, cer Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni ö eni ni jap dhaa kanya poot ŋatøgø ni kär öö ka amöölla. Kanyøgø dhaa aput bëëtö ni ree ee jabø, ni put tïmö naa cäänö.
english: Now the hand of the Lord was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta, ni kööe,
english: Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, jiy moø ni bëëdö ŋööm Icriel kwörö no oränynyö yøø, gena köö, ni ‹Eeberam beeye dhaanhø aciel, 'ba eni ŋöömö alwøre. 'Ba øøni, ø thööth; ennø ŋöömö acïp jïïø na marø møn.›
english: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Uuna cämö ki rïŋ mo rege da rem, ni wøørru kït gïï wø lammu, ni kunynyu piny ki rem jiy. ?Aŋø, løny ki man lwørru ŋöömö na maru?
english: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?

anywaa: Uuna bëëdö nou ŋäätha opëëlle mou, ni tïïu ki gïï mo reyø, ni ö ŋati man nø dëëtu ni päät cï wati ki man ci baŋ gø na dhaagø. ?Aŋø, løny ki man lwørru ŋöömö na maru?›
english: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?

anywaa: «Caanï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, jiy moa no odööŋ kwöra no oränynyö ge di nääö ko opëëllö, ni ö jiyi moa en ŋää paac ni wëëga ge lääc paap nee ge cam, ni ö jiyi moa en kwör gwøk røk moa teek ki moa en yïth agäp-kïte ni wëëga ge thøø ki täw mo leth.
english: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.

anywaa: Aani, ŋöömö marge wëëga ränynyö ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni ö teek mar jø wø töödö yie ni cuŋe, ni ö kïte mo Icriel ni dööŋge keerge, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋuti ki bäätge.
english: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo wëëga ŋöömö marge ränynyö ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie ki køør japa raac yia ki ge bëët na tïïcge.›
english: Then shall they know that I am the Lord, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø, jø pou mo wø cäänö kiperï deŋ kiir ki dhøk uudi, dhøkge wø løøŋge løøŋŋø ni ge köö, ni ‹Ööu, ni wïnynyø dwøl man ni ööi ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk en.›
english: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the Lord.

anywaa: Jiy ööa baŋï kaawat man wø tïïc dhaanhe jaak, ni pïge piny nyïmï kuna wïnyge luup moï kede gena jiya, 'ba ba kïthge bäät tïïc. Geni, ge cara luup mo beyø ki dhøkge, 'ba cwïnyge caara gïï mo reyø ki møt.
english: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.

anywaa: 'Ba ki baŋge, ï caala ŋat mo dwøre met, mo wär ki duut mëër, ni thoom pwöde pwödö ni tøøte tøøtø; kiper luup moï wø wïnyge wïnynyö, 'ba ba kïthge bäät tïïc.
english: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moøgø bëët kanyo thurge karge, kiper thura karge møn, ŋäcge ŋääö nø ni da nyikuŋ Jwøk mo bëëdö dïge.»
english: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caan  luum ajäla man jï dïkwääc dïëk mo Icriel, caanï jïge ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, no ‹Otïmö ni leth jï dïkwääc dïëk mo Icriel mo wø bëëdö ni ge gwøga rege keerge. ?Aŋø, tïïc mar dïkwääc dïëk, paa kwaac pïïth dïëk na bëëde?
english: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?

anywaa: Uuni, u cämö ki rïŋ mo olør, ni runynyu dëëtu ka abïïe moa no otïïö ki jïëc rööm, ni 'nägu moa no olør. 'Ba pïïth dïëk ba gwøgu.
english: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.

anywaa: Uuni, moa näk oööl käru wëëk tëënnö, ni käru moa tuu kønyø, ni käru ŋwiili moa en dëëtge bääö, ni käru moa no okeethø cooŋø, ni käru moa no orwäänyö manynyø, 'ba ge kääru ka teek ni ge you caannø.
english: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.

anywaa: Køøre nø, gena put keethø kiper mana bäŋe dïkwääy jïge; 'ba kanya keethge gena put tïmö na cam jï lääc paap bëët.
english: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.

anywaa: Pïïth dïëk 'moa gena thääyö bäät kïte bëët, ki bäät thuuri moa bäyö bëët. Gena keethø bäät piny bäre ni bäŋ ŋat mo omany geni›.
english: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, u na dïkwääc dïëk, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, ka adïëri møn, kiper mana tïm pïïth dïëki 'moa ni bäŋ dïkwääy jïge, gena put tïmö ni ge di tweeyø, ni putge tïmö na cam jï lääc paap bëët, kiper mana bëët dïkwääye ni pïïth dïëk 'moa kärge manynyø, ni tïmge ni ge gwøga dëëtge keerge ni pïïth dïëk 'moa kärge gwøø.›
english: As I live, saith the Lord God, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u na dïkwääc dïëk, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk,
english: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the Lord;

anywaa: man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Dïkwääc dïëk ge jääla jäälö, ni puta dïëk 'moa lwør ceŋge, ni tïïa geni nee dïëk ba kwaacge këët, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ dïkwääy mo caama dëëre rege këët. Pïïth dïëk 'moa ge gwøa gwøø dhøkge, nee ba tïme na cam jïge këët.›
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.

anywaa: «Kiper man bee luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani ki dëëra kiree dïëk 'moa omanynya ni gwøa geni.
english: For thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø ö dïkwääyi wø gwøk pïïth dïëk moe ki dïcäŋ ni ena yïthakic dïëk mo okeethø, aani thuwø dïëk 'moa gwøa gwøø, ni piema geni kwöra enge yïthge na näk geno keethø yïthge dïcäŋo näk cäŋ jwør gïï mo leth mano caal pöölö ki muudhö.
english: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.

anywaa: Geno käla wøk ki yïthakic wïth juurre ni cuuŋa geni ki yïth mïëri, ni käla ge yi ŋöömö marge, ni caama geni bäät kïte mo Icriel, ni ge ena deŋ nyeŋ näm, ni ge ena kwör wø beet bëët yi ŋöömö manøgø.
english: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.

anywaa: Aani, ge caama caamø yi luum mo pulli, ni kar cam marge ena bäät kïte kwöra en maal mo Icriel. Geno bëëdö kaace ni geno but piny yi luum mo pulli ni ge cämö ki cam mo beer bäät kïte mo Icriel.
english: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.

anywaa: Aani, pïïth dïëk 'moa caama caamø ni bwødha geni kar jwöm. Manøgø beeye dwøra, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Aani, dïëk moa no orwäänyö manynya manynyø, ni duua moa no okeethø, ni bääa ŋwiili moa en dëëtge, ni tïïa dëët moa jägö ni teek; 'ba moa no olør ki moa dëëtge teek raanynya raanynyø. 'Ba aani, dïëk 'moa käära käärö ki jöö ma kare.
english: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luum caana kiperu, u na pïïth dïëk 'moa, beeye en: Aani, aano tïmö ni aana dïŋut luup yïthakic diel ki diel, ki yïthakic nywø røømmø ki nywø ateea.
english: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba rømi kiperu ki man cämu jaak ki luum mo beer? ?U manynya gø thuwø nee moa dööŋ cäŋu nyørø ki tietu? ?Aŋø, u ba rømi ki man mädhu jaak ki pïï moa tøŋ? ?U manynya gø thuwø nee pïï moa dööŋ cäŋu duupö ki tietu?
english: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?

anywaa: Pïïth dïëk 'moa gena tïmö ni cama luum mana näk you nyøøn piny, ni tïmge ni ge maatha pïï moa näk you duubö ki tietu.›
english: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïge, ena köö, ni ‹Neennu, aani ki dëëra aano tïmö ni aana dïŋut luup yïthakic diel  mana no olør ki diel mana no odwat.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.

anywaa: Kiper mana bëëdu nou caala dïëk mo dëëtge cööcge cööyö ki göökge, ni dëëtge gïïnge gïïnnö, ni cööpge moa no oööl ki tuŋi, këël man wø putge keethø,
english: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, aani, pïïth dïëk 'moa piema piemø nee ge ba twier këët. Aani a bëëdö ni luup ŋøla ŋølø yïthakic diel man nø ki wati maya.
english: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.

anywaa: Ni cïpa bäätge ki dïkwääy aciel, ni beeye dhaanhnha ma Deebit. Eni, geno caame; eni ki dëëre geno caame ni put tïmö ni ena dïkwääy marge.
english: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, aano bëëdö na Jwøk marge, ni ö dhaanhnha ma Deebit ni tïme na ŋat bwøth geni. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I the Lord will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the Lord have spoken it.

anywaa: « ‹Aani, a tudö ki luum bëët mëër ki jø Icriel, ni ö lääc paapi moa no owär ni riema ge wøk yi ŋöömö, ni öge, ge na dïëk 'moa, ni wëëga geni bëëtö dï paap ni buutge yi lul jaak ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge.
english: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.

anywaa: Aani, ge gwïëdha gwïëdhö, ni bee geni ki kwör bëëte moa en deŋ thuur mara. Aani køth jääŋŋa jääŋŋö yi ŋöömö marge ki kanya näk kare, ni tïm køthi manøgø ni beeye mar gwïëth.
english: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.

anywaa: Jenni mo pwöth geno ŋweel ki nyïëdi, ni ö ŋöömö ni wëëk caammi ciek ni thööth, ni ö geni, ge na jiya, ni putge bëëtö ni geno gwøø yi ŋöömö marge. Kanyøgø nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo käla tëëra peek wøk bäätge na caal jaath puur man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ, noo piema geni ceŋ jøøa tïïc geni na laaŋe.
english: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba twier wïth juurre këët, ni ge ba cam lääc paapi këët. 'Ba geno bëëdö ni geno gwøø ni bäŋ gïn wëëk geni lwär.
english: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.

anywaa: Ni kïtha geni yi ŋöömö mana ŋäc ni cam ciek yie døc, ni putge bëëtö yi gø ni bäŋ käc këët mo ööl geni, ni bäŋ ajøøŋ mo jwørge këët baŋ wïth juurre.
english: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, na bëëdö ki geni; ni ge na jø Icriel, gena jiy 'moa. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus shall they know that I the Lord their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba u na dïëk 'moa, ni bee u dïëk 'moa mo wø caama, uuna jiy 'moa, ni aana Jwøk maru.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ Kïn Cëër ni caanï luum ajäla man jïre,
english: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,

anywaa: ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «ni ‹Ï na ŋööm Kïn Cëër, ï jääla jäälö. Aani, cera rwiea rwieø bäätï, ni wëëga ï dööŋŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yiï ni ïïno ränynyö.
english: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.

anywaa: Aani, päänye moï wëëga ränynyö, ni dööŋï ni bäŋ gïrpiny yiï. Køøre nø, ŋäyï ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper ïïna bëëdö niï män ki jø Icriel ki kany mo yie bäär, ni wëëgï ge 'näk dïcäŋa enge yïth gïïa leth, ni beeye dïcäŋa jääl geni na aŋuudi.
english: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø jïrï, jiy moï køørge oŋwiec ni køny remø marge piny. 'Ba kiper mana bëëdï niï ba män ki køny remø piny, køny remø piny odøø bäätï.
english: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.

anywaa: Aani, ŋööm Kïn Cëër wëëga ränynyö ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie; ni raanynya jiy bëët mo wø ŋuti ki dïëre ki mo wø duui.
english: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.

anywaa: Ï na Kïn Cëër, bäätï pääŋa pääŋö ki rïŋ dëët jiy moa no othøw, ni ö jiyi moo 'näk ko opëëllö ni bëëtge ni geno päänhnhö bäät thuuri moï, ki  yïth gøli moï, ki yïth aleye moï.
english: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï tïïa tïïö niï dööŋï ni bäŋ gïrpiny yiï na bäre bäre; ni ö päänye moï ni ba beedi këët. Køøre nø, ŋäyï ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper ïïna köö, ni «Wïth juurre moi na ariiø ii ki ŋøøm moge, ni beege jø Juuda ki jø Icriel, ge tïmö na 'moa, nee putge dööŋŋö jïwa na thöökwa,» këël na bëëde ni Wuuö Jwøk nut yïthge.
english: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the Lord was there:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat man bëëda naa kwøw en, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, a caana gø jïrï, aani, ï jääla jäälö ki køør wëër marï ki keec marï mana nyoothï bäät jiya kiper mana mänï ki geni; ni ööa ni nyoodha dëëra dïge kanyo jääla ïïni.
english: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ŋäyï ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na wïny japa reyø bëët na caanï dëët kïte mo Icriel, na kööï, ni «Gena nø niruuth piny ni ränyge, ni cïp geni jïwa, ni camwa geni na mowa.»
english: And thou shalt know that I am the Lord, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.

anywaa: Ïïna cäänö niï töödö bääta ki luup mo thööth, ni wïnynya luup moï.
english: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luum caana jïrï bee en: Aani, ï wëëga ränynyö, ni ö jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni mïn yïthge ki ränynyö marï.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.

anywaa: Kiper yiï amïnnö kanya räny ŋööm Icrielli; ni bee tiere noo coola kwör dëërï en. Wui, ï na Kïn Cëër, ï ränynyö, ni bee ïïni ki ŋööm Ëdöm ki kare bäre. Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, cään kïte mo Icriel ni kööï, ‹Wui, u na kïte mo Icriel, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord:

anywaa: Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Nyïïmän mou gena ŋeethø bäätu ni buuge uuni ni köge, ni «Thuuri moa bäyö na käl ya acääŋŋe adööŋ jïwa na mowa.» ›
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïge ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana ö nyïïmän mou na wëëkge ŋöömö maru ränynyö, ni cielge uuni dïër ki deŋŋu bäre, ni tïmu nou ena tiet juurre møga, nou bëëdö ni uuna gïr ajøøŋ dhøkge,
english: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, u na kïte mo Icriel, wïnynyu dwør Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. Luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïïu, u na kïte mo Icriel, ki thuuri, ka aleye, ki gøli, ki kwöra no oränynyö, ki u na päänye moa no odööŋ na tëën, na twier na tïmö na gïr abuua jï wïth juurre moa en deŋŋu,
english: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord God; Thus saith the Lord God to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;

anywaa: gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki jïïu bee en, ena köö: ni Aani, a cäänö ni cwïnya okëënynyö ki wïth juurre møga ki jø Ëdöm bëët. Geni, ŋöömö mara akälge kiper dëëtge ni cwïnyge päŋ ki met ec ki män, nee japa beyø na en yie twierge.›
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Edom, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cäänï kiper ŋööm Icriel ni kööï jï kïte, ki thuuri, ka aleye, ki gøli, ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, a cäänö ni cwïnya okëënynyö naa wëër, kiper uuna bëëdö nou cooyø ka ajaany mar wïth juurre.›
english: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aana kööŋ døc ni wïth juurre moø ni en deŋŋu yøø ki dëëtge geno bëëdö ni ge cooyø ka ajaany.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba u na kïte mo Icriel, jenni moa en bäätu oløth ni ŋweelge ki nyïëdi jï jiya ma jø Icriel; kiper ge duua paac ki kany mo cään.
english: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.

anywaa: Ï na ŋööm Icriel, ennø, a cädö kiperï ni nyoodha bäth ec mara jïrï; ïïno puur ni piith caammi yiï.
english: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:

anywaa: Jiy owëëga nyaay yiï, ni beege jø Icriel bëët. Päänye moï ocäŋ beetø, ni ö gïïa no oränynyö ni cäŋi geerrø.
english: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:

anywaa: Jiy ki lääc paac kwäänge omeeda yiï, ni wëëga ge nyöödö ni nyaacge ni thööth døc. Jiy owëëga bëëtö yiï kaawat mana bëëtge dïkwøŋ, ni tïïa bëëtö marge ni beer ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ. Køøre nø, oŋäyï ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Jiya ma jø Icriel ge wëëga wääth bäätï, ni lwørge ïïni na kurge, ni putï tïmö ni ïïna kar bëëtö jïge na bäre bäre. Køøre nø obwöre moge ba wëëgï thøø këët.›
english: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, ena köö, ni ‹Kiper mana købi, ni «Ïïna dïcäm jiy, ni wï jur marï iï wëëk dööŋŋe ni bäŋ obwöre jïge,»
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, bäŋ jiy mo camï këët, ni wï jur marï ba wëëgï dööŋŋe këët ni bäŋ obwöre jïge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Aani, ï ba tïïa këët nee dee luup abuua mo wïnynyï baŋ juurre, ni bäŋe ajaany mo jwørï këët baŋ wïth juurre, wala ki man wëëgï jiy moï pädhö. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, kanya bëët jø Icrielli yi ŋöömö marge, ŋöömö apäätge ki bëëtö marge ki tïïe moge. Bëëtö marge ki baŋa, nëëni kaamar bäŋ waany mar dhaagø mo gïr mään opïï dëëre.
english: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wëër mara akønynya bäätge kiper gena kuny piny ki rem jiy yi ŋöömö, ni wëëkge ŋöömö päät ki kït gïï wø lamge.
english: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:

anywaa: Aani, gena keetha dï wïth juurre, ni putge nibay yïth mïëri; ni ŋøla luup moge ki køør bëëtö marge ki tïïe moge.
english: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.

anywaa: Kwöra cige yïthge bëët dï wïth juurre, ge bëëdö ni ge pääta nyeŋŋa na en kur keere, kiper jiy cäänö kiperge, ni ‹Moøgø beege jic Wuuö Jwøk ni ee cäŋ mänö yøø ki man bëëtge yi ŋöömme.›
english: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the Lord, and are gone forth out of his land.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a cädö kiper nyeŋŋa na en kur keere na päät jø Icrielli dï wïth juurre kwöra cige yïthge.
english: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, caanï jï jø Icriel ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Wui, u na jø Icriel, gïï noo tïïa ii patha kiper nyeŋŋu, 'ba beeye kiper nyeŋŋa na en kur keere na päätu dï wïth juurre kwöra cou yïthge.
english: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.

anywaa: Aani, ajiem mar nyeŋŋa na dwøŋ na en kur keere na päät dï wïth juurre nyoodha nyoodhø, ni beeye nyeŋŋa na päätu dïge. Køøre nø, ŋäc wïth juurre ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo nyoodha bëëtö mara na en kur keere ki rou ni nëënö jïge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, saith the Lord God, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.

anywaa: « ‹Kiper aani, u käla wøk dï wïth juurre, ni lïma uuni wøk ki yïth mïëri bëët, ni cäŋa uuni duu yi ŋöömö maru.
english: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.

anywaa: Aani, dëëtu jøra jørø ki pïï mo tøŋ ni tïmu nou waany; aani, u penya penyø yïth japa reyø bëët na enu yïthge, ki yïth kït gïï wø lammu bëët.
english: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.

anywaa: Aani, u mooa mooø ki cwïnynyi mo nyärö, ni kïtha dëëtu ki jwïëy mo nyään; cwïnynyi mou na teek na caal kïdi käla wøk dëëtu, ni mooa uuni ki cwïnynyi mo jööm kaamar rïŋö.
english: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.

anywaa: Aani, jwïëy 'moa kïtha dëëtu ni tïïa uuni nou cäädhu køør luup 'moa ni gwøgu ciik 'moa.
english: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.

anywaa: Uuni, u bëëdö yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï kwäyu; ni bëëdu ni uuna jiy 'moa, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk maru.
english: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.

anywaa: Aani, u piema piemø yïth jammi bëët moa tïïc uuni nou ba waany. Aani, u mooa mooø ki beel ni wëëga ge ciek ni thööth, nee bäŋe käc mo ö bäätu këët.
english: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.

anywaa: Aani, nyïïjenni ki beel wëëga ciek ni thööth yïth pwöth mou, nee bäŋe law-waŋ mo ö bäätu dï wïth juurre kiper käc.
english: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.

anywaa: Køøre nø, wïthu caarru caarø ki uutjïëthe mou na reyø ki tïïe mou na näk ba beyø, ni männu ki dëëtu keeru kiper raay mou ki japa näk yia raac ki ge na tïïyu.
english: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a manynya gø nee ŋäyu ni gïn tïïa en patha kiper nyeŋŋu. Wui, u na jø Icriel, beerra man lää wïthu ni päth cwïnynyu ki bëëtö maru!› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord God, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma cäŋ Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki caannø, ena köö, ni ‹Dïcäŋo penya uuni yïth raay mou bëët, u cäŋa ka wëëk bëëtö yïth päänye mou, ni ö kwöra no oränynyö ni cäŋi geerrø.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.

anywaa: Pwöth moa no odööŋ keerge di puurö, ni ba wec no obutö jaak ni nëënö nyïm jiy bëët mo wø pöödhi ki yie.
english: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.

anywaa: Køøre nø,  jiy ge köö, «Ni pwöth moi na bëëdö no odööŋ keerge anø tïmö kaamar ajïniina mar Ëden; ni ö päänye moa no oniruuth piny no oränynyö ni cäŋi geerrø ni teek ni døø jiyi yïthge.»
english: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.

anywaa: Køøre nø, wïth juurre moa en deŋŋu na dööŋ, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na cäŋ japa no oränynyö geerrø, na cäŋ pwöth moa no odööŋ keerge tïïyö nee puur. Bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö en; japøgø tïïa tïïö.›
english: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the Lord build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the Lord have spoken it, and I will do it.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma cäŋ Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki caannø, ena köö, ‹Aani thuwø, jø Icriel ge tïïa tïïö naa pëënyge kiper nee gïn tïïa jïge: Jiy moge meeda meedø nee tïmge kaamar pïïth dïëk,
english: Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.

anywaa: ni ge thööth døc kaamar pïïth dïëk mo wø cïp no olämme yi Jerucalem ki yïth cääŋŋe moa no ocïp piny na mo wödö. Kanyøgønø, päänye moa no oränynyö opäŋ ki lwaa dhaanhø. Køøre nø, ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cere acïp bääta, ni lwør aani ki teek Jwïëy moe ni cïp aani dï pwöla mo päŋ ki cuu mo jiy.
english: The hand of the Lord was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the Lord, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,

anywaa: Ni tïïc aani naa cäädha ki dï cuu moøge. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, dï pwöla bäre aputa joot no 'ogääbö ki cuu mo jiy, ni beege cuu mo otal døc.
english: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïra, «?Wär dhaanhø, cuu moøgø løny ki man cäŋge kwøwø?» Ni dwøga gø jïre, ni «Wui, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, bee ï ni ŋäc gø.»
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord God, thou knowest.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö jïra, ni «Cään cuu moøgø, ni kööï jïge, ‹Wui, u na cuu mo otal ii, wïnynyu dwør Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk luumma caane kiperu bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Jam jwïëy kïtha dëëtu nou cäŋu kwøw.
english: Thus saith the Lord God unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:

anywaa: Dëëtu cäŋa ka mooyø ki läär ki rïŋö, ni rïëba rïŋ dëëtu ki buyö, ni jwïëa bäätu nou cäŋu kwøw; køøre ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena cäänna kaawat mana kööm aani. 'Ba kanya cäänna ge ennø, ka adïëri møn, dööt cuu aput wïnyö ni ge pööta rege kanya cøømge dëëtge; ni ö geni ni putge dëëtge kupö, ni man nø cøøa kare.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.

anywaa: 'Ba na neena ge, ka adïëri møn, läär ki rïŋö aput ci dëëtge, ni rïëp geni ki buyö; 'ba ge ba jwïëy.
english: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jïra, «Wär dhaanhø, cään jam jwïëy, ni kööï jïre ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Wui, jam jwïëy, kwönnï ki yïth tuk piny moa na aŋween, ni ciï røk dëëlli moi no othøw ii, nee cäŋge kwøw.› »
english: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord God; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jam jwïëy acäänna kaawat mana kööm aani, ni ö jam jwïëy ni ci dëëtge, ni putge kwøw, ni cuŋge ki tietge; 'ba gena lwaak mo päl døc kiree.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ köö jïra, «Wär dhaanhø, cuu moøgø a päära ge ki jø dhi øt Icriel bëët. Raŋï, gena köö, ni ‹Wa caala cuu mo otal, ni ŋäädhe marwa oränynyö, ni dïïr wïthwa bëët.›
english: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jï dhi øt Icriel ni kööï, ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperu, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, u na jiya, bwör mou jaba jabø, ni tïïa uuni nou ööu wøk ki yïth bwör mou, ni kïtha uuni yi ŋööm Icriel.
english: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.

anywaa: Køøre nø, u na jiya, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, kanyo jaba bwör mou noo käla uuni wøk ki yïth bwör mou.
english: And ye shall know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,

anywaa: Aani jwïëya okïtha dëëtu ni kwøwu, ni kïtha uuni yi ŋöömö maru. Kar kaace nø, ŋäyu ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na caan luummögø na tïïc gø.› Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the Lord have spoken it, and performed it, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: The word of the Lord came again unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, lwötï ka athøra aciel ni göörï luubö man bääte, ni kööï, ni ‹Man beeye kiper Juuda ki jø Icriel moa näk odwätö ki eni.› Køøre wärï cäŋ lwötö ka athøra mør ni cäŋï luubö  man göör bääte, ni kööï, na ‹Athøra mar Ipariem beeye mar Jocep ki jø Icriel bëët moa näk odwätö ki eni.›
english: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:

anywaa: Køøre athøre moøgøøni wär dwalï na aciel nee tïmge na athøra aciel cerï.
english: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö jø pou noo pëënyge ïïni, ni köge, ni ‹?Gïn ni tïïyï en løny ki man caanï tiere jïwa?›
english: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?

anywaa: wärï kööï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, athøra mar Jocep käla kälö, ni beeye athøra mana en cer Ipariem ki jø Icriel moa näk odwätö ki eni, ni dwala gø ka athøra mar Juuda, ni tïïa ge na aciel, ni putge tïmö na athøra aciel cera.›
english: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.

anywaa: 'Ba athøre moøgø, ni beege moa göötï bäätge ki luup, wär tïŋ maal nyïm jiy,
english: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.

anywaa: ni kööï jïge ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Ka adïëri møn, aani, jø Icriel käla wøk ki dï wïth juurre kwöra näk geno aa yïthge. Ge cuuŋa cuuŋö ki yïth kwörögø bëët ni duua geni yi ŋöömö marge;
english: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

anywaa: ni tïïa geni na wï jur aciel yi ŋöömge, ni beeye bäät kïte mo Icriel. Geno tïmö bëët ni ge käära nyeya acielli, ni ba bëëtge këët ni gena wïth juurre ariiø wala ki man bëëtge ni geno pääŋŋö na buc nyeye ariiø.
english: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

anywaa: Ge ba bëëdö ni dëëtge ege päädö këët ki juuga reyø moge ki kït gïï wø lamge, na näk ec raac ki ge, wala ki teeŋ raay moge møga bëët. Kiper aani, ge piema piemø yïth raay moge moa wara enge yïthge, ni penya geni; ni bëëtge na jiy 'moa, ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge.
english: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.

anywaa: « ‹Dhaanhnha ma Deebit otïmö na nyeya marge, ni tïmge ni ge ena tier dïkwääy aciel bëët. Geni, køør ciik 'moa ocaathge, ni bëëtge ni luup 'moa gwøkge gwøø ni kïthge ge bäät tïïc.
english: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.

anywaa: Geno bëëdö yi ŋöömö mana cïba jï dhaanhnha ma Jeekap, ni beeye ŋöömma bëët kwäyu yie. Geni ko obwöre moge ki nyïïkwaacge geno bëëdö yi ŋöömö manøgø na bäre bäre, ni ö dhaanhnha ma Deebit ni put bëëte na bwödhi marge na bäre bäre.
english: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.

anywaa: Aani, a tudö ki luum bëët mëër ki geni, ni ö luummögø ni put bëëte no otuudö na bäre bäre. Aani, tietge këëlla piny ni teek ni meeda kwäänge, ni ö øt lam mara na en kur keere ni wëëga gø bëëtö dïge na bäre bäre.
english: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.

anywaa: Kar bëëtö mara otïmö ni ena dïge; ni bëëda ni aana Jwøk marge, ni bëëtge ni gena jiy 'moa.
english: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

anywaa: Køøre nø, oŋäc wïth juurre ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk na tïïc jø Icriel ni ena kur keerge, kanyo bëët øt lam mara na en kur keere ni ena dïge na bäre bäre.› »
english: And the heathen shall know that I the Lord do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, løø nyïmï baŋ Göök, ni jäälï gø, ni bee kwäärö mana dwøŋ mar jø Möcak ki Tubal, na en yi ŋööm jø Magöök. Caan luum ajäla man dëëre,
english: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,

anywaa: ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki kiperï, ena köö, ni ‹Wui! Göök, ï na kwäärö mana dwøŋ mar jø Möcak ki Tubal, ïïna jääla.
english: And say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

anywaa: Ïïno dwøga køørï, ni gäna ïïni ko obïth ki tiet nyämme moï, ni tuuda ïïni wøk ki jø leny moï na thööth, ko okwëëc lääy moï, ki jø leny moï mo wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi, ni beege jiy bëët moa näk oruyö ki kööt leny, ni beege jø wø këëdi ki kööt leny moa therø ki moa døøŋŋø, ni ge käädö ko opëëlle.
english: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

anywaa: Ni dwala jø Parca bäätï, ge ki jø Kuuc ki jø Put, ni ge käädö ki kööt leny bëët ki cööc nywïëny,
english: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:

anywaa: ki Gömer ki jø leny moe bëët, ki Bëëth-Tögarma, paana kare bäär na en jï løø wï-piny, ki jø leny moe bëët, ni beege wïth juurre mo thööth noo dwäti ki ïïni.
english: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

anywaa: « ‹Jek riï nø, ni jiiŋŋï dëërï, ni bee ïïni ki lwaae moï moa näk rege cooŋ  buutï, ni bëëdï ni ïïna ŋat kööm geni.
english: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na køør nïne mo thööth, ïïno cwøl baŋ leny. 'Ba noo tïme na yïth cwiiri moo en nyïm, paana näk odøø kare køør leny otugï, ni beege jøøa lem ki røk wïth juurre na duu bäät kïte mo Icriel na bëëdö no oränynyö dïkwøŋ, ni geni bëët ge käl wøk ka røk wïth juurre; 'ba ennø, ge bëët ge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge.
english: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki jø leny moï bëët, ki wïth juurre mo thööth, uuno ö wøk kaamar atuunna, ni tïmu kaamar pöölö, ni putu ŋöömö uum.›
english: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.

anywaa: «'Ba man bee luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, da acaara mo öö wïïï, ni cïpï piny ki gïn mo raac,
english: Thus saith the Lord God; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:

anywaa: ni kööï, na «A cøøa kuna tuua atude moa näk bäŋ kiiri jïge; aani, a cøøa baŋ jøøke ni bëëdö no ojwöm ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge yøøke, ni beege jø wø bëëdö bëët ni bäŋ kiiri jïge, ki dhøk kiiri, ki dïdëëdi.
english: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,

anywaa: Aani japge twiera twierø, ni raanynya kwör bëëte moge moa cäŋ geerrø, ni beege ki jiy bëët moa lem ki røk wïth juurre, na näk okwär ki lääc paac ki jammi mo beyø, ni beege jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömma en dïër.»
english: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Cïïba ki jø Didan, ki dïgäthe mo Tarcëc, ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yïth atude moe, geno köö ki ïïni, na «?Aŋø, ï ööa kuna twierï jøøi møn? ?Lwaae moøgø cooŋï kaper twëër, nee gwet-bïrö ki warkey ki lääc paac ki jammi moa beyø mo thööth nee twierï baŋge?» ›
english: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ï na wär dhaanhø, caan luummi jï Göök ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹?Aŋø, dïcäŋo ö jiya ma jø Icriel noo bëëtge ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge, ba løny man ŋäyï gø?
english: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord God; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno ööi ki kar bëëtö marï na en jï løø wï-piny kuya, ïïni ki wïth juurre mo thööth, ni ge bëët ge cäädhi ka bäät okwëëc lääy, ni gena lwaak mo päl, ni gena jø leny mo teek.
english: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:

anywaa: Niï ööï kaamar pöölö mo uuma piny, nee jiya ma jø Icriel tugï. Wui, Göök, noo tïme na yïth nïne moo ööi, ïïno tïïa nee ŋöömö mara tugï, kiper naa ŋäc wïth juurre kanyo nyoodha bëëtö mara na en kur keere nyïmge ki riï.›
english: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.

anywaa: «Man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, na ‹?Aŋø, paa ïïni na cääna kipere yïth nïne moa pöödhö ki dhøk nyïïkuk 'moa mo jø Icriel? Yïth nïreke gena cäänö ki cwiiri mo thööth ki man näk mo ï tïïa tïïö nee ge tugï.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tägi dïcäŋeca bee en: Kanyo ö Gööki noo tuk ŋöömö mar Icriel, aani wëër mara mo lïëth kaamar maac oput ö maal. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord God, that my fury shall come up in my face.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør këëny cwïny mara ki wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac, a caana gø ni dïcäŋögø otïmö ni da dïjäŋ piny mo dwøŋ døc yi ŋööm Icriel.
english: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;

anywaa: 'Ba rec mo naama dwøŋ, ki wec maal, ki lääc paap, ki gïïa no ocwääö bëët ni wø muuli ki piny, ki jiy bëët moa en wï ŋöömö, dëëtge otïmö ni kwanynyi nyïma. Kïte rege ojaalge, ni ö aleye ni ŋaarge, ni ö kiiri ni pänhge piny yïth ŋøøm.
english: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.

anywaa: Aani opëëllö okäla ni jääla jic Göök bäät kïte 'moa bëët. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk. Ŋati man nø wati onääe ko opëëllö mare.
english: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord God: every man's sword shall be against his brother.

anywaa: Ni jääla geni ki täw mo leth ki køny remø piny. Aani køth mo dwøŋ mo ree da pey mo caala kïte, ki tør mo liel, ojääŋŋa bääte, ni pänh bääte ki jø leny moe ki bäät wïth juurre moa thööth mo wø cäädhi ki eni.
english: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.

anywaa: Køøre nø, aani, dööŋö mara, ki bëëtö mara na en kur keere, nyoodha nyoodhø jïge, ni tïïa dëëra naa ŋäc nyïm wïth juurre mo thööth. Køøre nø, putge ka ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.›
english: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: «Wär dhaanhø, caan luum ajäla man dëër Göök, ni kööï ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹Wui, Göök, ï na kwäärö mana  dwøŋ mar jø Möcak ki Tubal, ïïna jääla.
english: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

anywaa: Ïïno dwøga køørï ni tuuda ïïni. Ïïno käla ki paana kare bäär na en jï løø wï-piny kuya, ni tïïa ïïni nee kïte mo Icriel tugï.
english: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:

anywaa: Køøre atum marï mana en cer caamï leeŋa piny, ni ö athëëre moa en cer cwïïï ni teeŋa ge piny.
english: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.

anywaa: Ïïni ki jø leny moï bëët, ki wïth juurre moa cäädhö ki ïïni, uuno päänhnhi bäät kïte mo Icriel. Uuni, u cïba cïbö na cam jï lääc paap ki teeŋ weny bëët mo wø cwëëdhö.
english: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.

anywaa: Uuni, uuno päänhnhi yi pwöla; kiper luummögø anø caana. Manøgø bee dwøra, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Aani maac ojääŋŋa bäät ŋööm Magöök, ki bäät jø wø bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en bäät naama dwøŋ ni wø bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge; køøre nø ŋäcge ŋääö ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the Lord.

anywaa: « ‹Aani nyeŋŋa na en kur keere tïïa tïïö nee ŋäc dï jiya ma jø Icriel. Køør man ennø, nyeŋŋa na en kur keere ba wëëga päät këët; køøre nø, oput wïth juurre ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel na en kur keere.
english: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, cäŋece öö, ni gïnece tägö møn ni ba kääŋi, ni bee dïcäŋ man cääna kipere en. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord God; this is the day whereof I have spoken.

anywaa: « ‹Køøre jø wø bëëdö yïth päänye mo Icriel, geno ci wøk ni cooŋge jap leny bëët, ni tïïcge ge na jer maac, ni beege kööt leny moa therø ki moa døøŋŋø, ka athëëre, ka atummi, ka athøc leny, ki tøøŋi. Japøge otïïcge na jer maac kiper cwiiri abïriiø.
english: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:

anywaa: Geno put bëëte ni bäŋ ŋat ci paap këët kuna mööte ki jenni, wala ŋøta jenni, kiper jap leny tïmö na jer maac jïge. Geni thuwø jap jøøa twier geni otwierge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, aano cïpi ki kar bwörö yi ŋööm Icriel kiper Göök. Ni bee yi gool man wø ŋutö ki yie ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ mar Naam Acäbö. 'Ba øtjöö manøgø oput cïëgö, kiper mano koony Göök ki lwaae moe yie kaace. Køøre nø, oput cwøl ni Goor Lwaa Göök.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog.

anywaa: 'Ba jø dhi øt Icriel geno bëëdö ki dwäde abïriiø ni ge køønynya jiy, ni marge tïïc ŋöömö ni waany.
english: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.

anywaa: Geno koony jø paaci bëët, ni ö jø Icrielli ni jïtge ki wödö dïcäŋo nyoodha ajiem mara yie. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na køør dwäde abïriiø moøgø, da cwøw mo kïtha yi tïïc kiper nee ŋöömö tïïcge ni waany. Ni ö møøki dïge ni tïï nee cääthge ni ge raŋŋa dï ŋöömö bäre, ni tïïc møøk nee rïŋ dëët jiy moa no odööŋ wøk bäät ŋøøm nee koonyge.
english: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo cige noo cääthge dï ŋöömö, ni näk da dhaanhø mo jïtö ki cöön dhaanhø, eno cïp buut gø ki ŋïï këël kanyo ö jø wø koony bwör noo koonyge ge yi Goor Lwaa Göök.
english: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog.

anywaa: 'Ba päänya näk nyeŋŋe ocaa ri lwaak oen kaace thuwø. Køøre nø, ŋöömö oputge tïïc ni waany.›
english: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.

anywaa: «'Ba ï na wär dhaanhø en, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Cwøl teeŋ weny bëët ki lääc paap bëët, ni kööï, ni «Cooŋŋu dëëtu ni ööu ki yïth kwörögø bëët, kiper 'näk mana tïïa kiperu bäät kïte mo Icriel, ni bee 'näk mo dwøŋ mo caala man wø 'näk lääy mo wø cïp no olämme. Uuno cämö ki rïŋö kaace, ni mädhu ki remø.
english: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord God; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.

anywaa: Rïŋ dëët cwøw moa teek ocammu, ni maathu rem kwääri mo bäät piny, ni ge caala rööm, ka atëëe, ki nyïïrøøe, ki lääc ŋööm Baacan mo olør.
english: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.

anywaa: 'Ba yi kar 'näk manøgø na jiiŋŋa kiperu, uuno cämö ki rïŋ mo olør këël kanyo jäŋŋu, ni mädhu ki remø ni meerru.
english: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.

anywaa: Uuno jäŋ ya akaaŋ mara ki rïŋ okwëëc lääy, ki rïŋ jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëëc lääy, ki rïŋ dëët cwøw moa teek, ki jø leny bëët.» Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹Aani ajiem mara owëëga bëëtö yïthakic wïth juurre, ni ö wïth juurre  bëët ni neenge ajäla mana tïïa ki mana kïtha cera bäätge.
english: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mano täge ki dïcäŋeca këël yi nyïme, jø dhi øt Icriel oŋäcge ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge.
english: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from that day and forward.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre oputge ŋäc ni jø Icriel gïna mak ge ki tøŋ kipere, beeye ki køør raay moge, kiper japa reyø na tïïcge dëëra, ni puta täärnyïma kan ki geni, ni cïba ge ceŋ nyïïmän moge, ni 'näkge ge ko opëëllö.
english: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.

anywaa: Kwör acoola dëëtge ki køør mana bëëtge ni ge ba waany, ni geno gaa wøk ki ri ciik 'moa, ni puta täärnyïma kan ki geni.›
english: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, nyïïkwaac Jeekap na mak ki tøŋ oduua, ni cïba cwïnya piny ki geni, ge na jø Icriel bëët, ni mara këëyö kiper nyeŋŋa na en kur keere.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo duuge yi ŋöömö marge ni ge bëëdö ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëk ge lwär, geni dëëtge jäälge jäälö kiper japa reyø na tïïcge dëëra.
english: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba noo duua geni ki baŋ wïth juurre, ni cuuŋa geni ki yïth mïëri mo nyïïmän moge, aani bëëtö mara na en kur keere nyoodha nyoodhø ki rege, ni nëënö nyïm wïth juurre mo thööth.
english: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;

anywaa: Køøre nø, oputge ŋäc ni bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, kiper gena wëëga mak ki tøŋ ni kïtha ge yïthakic wïth juurre, ni cäŋa ge duu yi ŋöömö marge, ni bäŋgø mo yaa wiiø rege.
english: Then shall they know that I am the Lord their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.

anywaa: Aani täärnyïma ba kana këët ki geni, kiper jwïëya kønynya bäät jø dhi øt Icriel.› Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic mäk marwa ki tøŋ na pïërariiø ka abïïc, ni nïr dwääy apaar ri täk cwiir mana nyään, ni beeye kanya päŋ cwiic ränynyö mar Jerucalem na apaar kurŋween, dïcäŋ manøgø kiree cer Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni käl aani.
english: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me thither.

anywaa: Ni manøgø tägi na gïn mo nyootha Jwøki jïra ki yi wïïa; ni käl aani ni kïth aani yi ŋööm Icriel, ni cïp aani bäät kïdi mo bäär døc. 'Ba bäät kïdi manøgø ki jï løø tier-piny da kany mo ogeerø mo nëëni kaamar pääny.
english: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth kaagø, ni jïta ki dhaanhø mo dëëre nëëni kaamar nywïënyö ma jwïël. 'Ba ŋatøgø cuŋŋö dhi kal ni cere da thøør røm mo tïïc ka waac lïïna, ka athøra mar røm.
english: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, nëënï ki nyeŋŋï, ni wïnyï ki ïdhi moï, ni këëllï wïïï ri jammi bëët moo nyoodha jïrï; kiper beeye tier gïna käl ïïni kany kipere. Jammi bëët moo jootï kany wär caanï jï jø dhi øt Icriel.»
english: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana put jïtö ki kal mo deŋ Øt Jwøk ee wïrö bäre. 'Ba athøra mar røm mana en cer ŋatøgø, bär mare bee gööye abïciel, ni gööyö man nø bääte omëënnö ki kany ma kar lweedi aŋween mo cenø. 'Ba eni, odhïŋ kal arøme, ni tïme na gööyö aciel mar athøra, ni røm bär mar maal mar gø, ni tïme na gööyö aciel thuwø mar athøra.
english: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.

anywaa: Køøre ena ci øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni edhe ki kwöra näk otïïö na kwör tiel, ni røm päl-ec mar thudhi mar øt-dhi-kal, ni tïme na gööyö aciel mar athøra.
english: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.

anywaa: 'Ba uudi mo jø koor, yi-øtø man nø bär mare beeye gööyö aciel mar athøra, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööyö aciel thuwø mar athøra, ni ö yïthakic uudi mo dïkuye ni røm ge na gööye abïïc abïïc. 'Ba thudhi mar øt-dhi-kal mano ci yi-øtø mana en nyïm ki yie na dïët ki Øt Jwøk, dööŋ yie bee gööyö aciel mar athøra.
english: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.

anywaa: Køøre eni yi-øtø mana en nyïm na dïët ki Øt Jwøk arøme, ni tïme na gööyö aciel mar athøra.
english: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

anywaa: Ni tïm gööye mo dööŋ yie na abära, ni tïm odhïŋ dëër øtø mar dhi øtø na gööye ariiø. 'Ba dhøk mar yi-øtø mana en nyïm dïët ki Øt Jwøk.
english: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.

anywaa: 'Ba øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ da uut koor adäk adäk yie ki  yïth deŋŋi moe løøi ki løøi; ni uut koor moøgø rumme moge dïët, ni rumme moa en yïthakicge poot dïët thuwø.
english: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.

anywaa: Køøre eni dhi kal mano døny øt-dhi-kal ki yie arøme, ni tïme na gööye apaar, ni røm dööŋ-ec mar yi øtø, ni tïme na gööye apaar kurdäk.
english: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba buut uut koor da kal mo bär mare gööyö aciel; 'ba uut koor moøgø päl mar yïthge løøi ki løøi bee gööye abïciel.
english: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.

anywaa: Køøre eni dööŋ-ec mar øtø mar dhi kal arøme, ni beeye ki mana täge ki wï øt koor këël wï øt koor maya na näk raŋŋa rege ki gø, ni jïte ki rumme ma pïërariiø ka abïïc, ni manøgø beeye dööŋ-ec mana en yïthakic aŋuun øt koor ka aŋuun øt koor maya.
english: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.

anywaa: Køøre eni yi-kal mana en dïër arøme ki deŋ gø bäre këël mana këët yi-øtø mana en nyïm na dïët ki dï käl, ni tïme na gööye ma pïërabïciel.
english: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki dhi kal mano dønyø ki yie këël mano pïïe ya aŋuun yi-øtø mana en nyïm bee gööye ma pïërabïïc.
english: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
