anywaa: Køøre aana jïtö ki dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi mo therø mo okølø dëët uut koor, ki dëër yi-øtø mana en nyïm ki deŋŋe bäre, ni yïthakic øt koor man nø ogöörö ki kït jaath twöö mo otïïö ni cuŋŋö ni mïërö.
english: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi-kal mana en wøk. 'Ba kaace, aana jïtö yie ki yïth-uudi ma pïëradäk ki deŋ kal bäre; ni dï kal bäre mana en nyïm dhøk uudi moøgø, othørø ki kïte.
english: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

anywaa: 'Ba thør mana thør dï kal ki gø, deŋ dhøk kal othørø ni ena jï piny, ni kany wø ci yi-kal mana en dïër, etha maal.
english: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.

anywaa: Køøre yïthakic dhi øt-dhi-kal mana en wøk ki dhi øt-dhi-kal mana en dïër arøme, ni jïte ki gööye ma dïpa, ni beeye jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø wï-piny.
english: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.

anywaa: Køøre eni øt-dhi-kal mana dïët ki jï løø wï-piny ni wø døny yi-kal mana en wøk, bär mare ki yie, ki dööŋ yie arøme.
english: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba øt-dhi-kal manøgø jïre da uut koor ma adäk adäk, ni beeye løøi ki løøi. Ni yïthakic uut koor moøgø ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm, rumme moge dïët kaamar øt-dhi-kal mana dïkwøŋ; ni bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø ka abïïc.
english: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba awëërnyeŋŋi moe, ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm, ki jer twöe moe moa no ogöörö dëëre ni mïërö, rumme moge dïët kaamar øt-dhi-kal mana näk dïët ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, no othørø na kwör tiel ma tëëŋŋe abïriiø, ni ge raŋŋa rege ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm.
english: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.

anywaa: 'Ba kal mana en dïër, dhee dagø mo raŋŋa rege ki øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø wï-piny kaamar øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö eni ni røm yïthakic uut-dhøk-käälle moa näk raŋŋa rege, ni jïte ki gööye ma dïpa.
english: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth jï løø tier-piny, ni jïta ki øt-dhi-kal mør kaace; ni ö eni ni røm yïthakic dhøk uudi ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm, ni tïm rumme moge ni dïët ni caala møga.
english: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.

anywaa: 'Ba dëër øtdhi- kal manøgø ki yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, da awëërnyeŋŋi ki deŋŋe bäre mo caala awëërnyeŋŋi møga; ni bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø ka abïïc.
english: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba da kwör tiel mo othørø ma tëëŋŋe abïriiø na mo edhø ki bäätge, ni ge raŋŋa rege ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm. Ni da jer twöe mo ogöörö ni mïërö yïthakic uut koor løøi ki løøi.
english: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba kal mana en dïër, dhee dagø mo ena jï løø tier-piny; ni røm yïthakic dhøgi moøgø ni ee tiirø ki jï løø tier-piny, ni jïte ki gööye ma dïpa.
english: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi-kal mana en dïër ki dhøk mana en jï løø tierpiny; ni ö eni ni røm øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø tier-piny, ni tïm rumme moe ni dïët ni caala møga.
english: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;

anywaa: 'Ba uut koor moe thuwø, ki yïthakic uut koor moe, ki yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, rumme moge poot dïët ni caala møga. 'Ba dëër øt-dhi-kal, ki dëër yi-øtø mana en nyïm, da awëërnyeŋŋi ki deŋŋe bäre; ni bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni  ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø kurbïïc.
english: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

anywaa: 'Ba da agööla ki deŋŋe manøgø bäre mo bär mare gööye ma pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye abïïc.
english: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.

anywaa: 'Ba yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, dhee raŋŋa rege ki yi-kal mana en wøk, ni jer twöe ogöörö ni mïërö yïthakic uut koor, ni dhee othørø ki kwör tiel ma tëëŋŋe abära.
english: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi-kal mana en dïër jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni ö eni ni røm øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni tïm rumme moe ni dïët ni caala møga.
english: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.

anywaa: 'Ba uut koor moe thuwø, ki yïthakic uut koor moe, ki yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, rumme moge poot dïët ni caala møga. 'Ba dëër øtdhi- kal, ki dëër yi-øtø mana en nyïm, da awëërnyeŋŋi ki deŋŋe bäre; ni bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø kurbïïc.
english: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.

anywaa: 'Ba yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, dhee raŋŋa rege ki yi-kal mana en wøk, ni jer twöe ogöörö ni mïërö yïthakic uut koor løøi ki løøi, ni dhee othørø ki kwör tiel ma tëëŋŋe abära.
english: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø wï-piny, ni ö eni ni røm gø, ni tïm rumme moe ni dïët ni caala møga.
english: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;

anywaa: 'Ba uut koor moe, ki yïthakic uut koor moe, ki yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, rumme moge poot dïët kaamar møga thuwø. 'Ba dëër øt-dhi-kal da awëërnyeŋŋi ki deŋŋe bäre; ni bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø ka abïïc.
english: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba yi-øtø mare mana en nyïm, dhee raŋŋa rege ki yi-kal mana en wøk; ni jer twöe ogöörö ni mïërö yïthakic uut koor; ni dhee othørø ki kwör tiel ma tëëŋŋe abära.
english: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.

anywaa: 'Ba da øtø mo dhee ena buut yi-øtø mana en nyïm mar øt-dhi-kal mana en dïër, ni beeye kany wø peny olämme yie mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.

anywaa: 'Ba yi-øtø mana en nyïm mar øt-dhi-kal da tharabëëte ariiø løøi ki løøi mo wø ŋaal olämme bäätge, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wëën raay, ko olämme mo wø wëën bääyö ki ge.
english: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.

anywaa: 'Ba løø kal wøk mar dhøk mana en jï løø wï-piny, buut kwöra no othørø na kwör tiel mo edhø ki bäätge, da tharabëëte ariiø yie, ni da ariiø møøk thuwø ki løøk maya mo kwöra no othørø na mo tiel.
english: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, tharabëëte moa en løøk aciel kwäänge tïmö na aŋween, ni ö moa en løøk maya ni tïmge na aŋween thuwø. 'Ba noo dwali bëët nø, tïmö na tharabëëte abära, ni beege tharabëëte mo ŋaal olämme bäätge.
english: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.

anywaa: 'Ba da tharabëëte ma aŋween thuwø mo tïïc ka kïte mo otieŋø, kiper olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ni bär mar man nø bee gööyö aciel ki thääŋö, ni ö dööŋ yi man nø ni näk gööyö aciel ki thääŋö; 'ba bär marge mar maal bee gööyö aciel. 'Ba jap wø ŋaal olämme ki ge ocïp bäätge, ni beege olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki teeŋ olämme møga.
english: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïï mo odølø kaamar obïïdhi mo bär marge rööma kar lweedi aŋween mo cenø, mo ogänö ki deŋ øtø bäre; ni rïŋ mo olämme ocïp bäät tharabëëte.
english: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi-kal mana en dïër. 'Ba kaace yie da uudi ariiø. Aciel ena deŋ øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø wï-piny, ni dhee ena jï løø tier-piny. 'Ba maya ena deŋ øt-dhi-kal mana en jï løø tier-piny, ni dhee ena jï løø wï-piny.
english: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Øtø mana näk dhee ena jï løø tier-piny beeye kiper dïlämme mo wø raŋ tïïe mo Øt Jwøk.
english: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø mana näk dhee ena jï løø wï-piny beeye kiper dïlämme mo wø raŋ gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. 'Ba dïlämme moøgø beege wäät Dhadök, ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay na näk ojierø keerge ki man cige nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kuna tïnyge gø.»
english: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the Lord to minister unto him.

anywaa: Køøre eni bär mar yi-kal arøme, ni jïte ki gööye ma dïpa, ni røm dööŋ yi gø, ni tïme thuwø na gööye ma dïpa. 'Ba gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ena nyïm Øt Jwøk.
english: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi-øtø mana en nyïm mar Øt Jwøk, ni røm odhïŋ dhi øtø, ni tïme na gööye abïïc, ni røm dööŋ ec mar gø, ni tïme na gööye apaar kurŋween, ni bär mar dëër dhi øtø mana en nyïm løøi ki løøi beege gööye adäk adäk.
english: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.

anywaa: 'Ba bär mar yi-øtø mana en nyïm bee gööye ma pïërariiø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye apaar kurciel. 'Ba da kwör tiel mo othørø mo etha maal ki ge, ni da gïï ma ariiø mo caala dïkweeye mo ocwöth piny dhee løøi ki løøi.
english: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana kïth yi øt lam mana en kur keere na en wøk, ni røm odhïŋ deŋ dhi øtø løøi ki løøi, ni tïmge na gööye abïciel abïciel.
english: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.

anywaa: 'Ba dööŋ-ec mar dhi øtø manøgø bee gööye apaar, ni ö bär mar deŋ dhi øtø løøi ki løøi ni tïmge na gööye abïïc abïïc. Ni røm bär mar dï øtø manøgø bäre thuwø, ni tïme na gööye ma pïëraŋween, ni røm päl-ec mar dïëre ni tïme na gööye ma pïërariiø.
english: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.

anywaa: Køøre ena døny yi-øtø mana en dïër ni røm odhïŋ deŋ dhi øtø løøi ki løøi, ni tïmge na gööye ariiø ariiø. 'Ba päl-ec mar dhi øtø bee gööye abïciel, ni ö bär mar deŋ dhi øtø løøi ki løøi ni tïme na gööye abïriiø abïriiø.
english: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.

anywaa: Køøre eni bär mar dï øtø mana en dïër arøme, ni tïme na gööye ma pïërariiø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërariiø thuwø, ni røm ni tägi ka aŋuun øtø mana en wøk. Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Kany beeye kanya en kur keere na pere leth døc.»
english: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.

anywaa: Køøre eni odhïŋ dëër Øt Jwøk arøme, ni tïme na gööye abïciel. Ni røm yïthøtø bëët moa no ocielø ki deŋ Øt Jwøk, ni tïm päl-ec marge na gööye aŋween.
english: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-uudi moøgø ogeerø na tëëŋe adäk, ni man nø ena bäät wati, ni bäät tëëŋŋö man nø, yie da yïth-uudi ma pïëradäk, ni peedhe moge owïrö ki deŋ dëër Øt Jwøk bäre na mo piem yïth-øtø moøgø. 'Ba peedhe moøgø kär tïïö no orep dëër Øt Jwøk.
english: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-øtø moøgø ni en deŋ Øt Jwøk bäre yøø, dööŋö mar yïthge tägi ki mana en maal ni cäätha piny ni therø. Kiper yi jöö mana geer yïth-øtø manøgø ki gø otïïö ni wetø ki tietge ni cäätha maal ni døøŋŋø. Kiper manøgønø, kany wø näk mo dhaanhø etha maal, yïth-øtø tïmö ni reegø. 'Ba da kwör tiel mo othørø ki dï øtø mo etha maal ki yie, ni tägi ka tëëŋ øtø mana en piny këël mana këët tëëŋŋe moa en maal.
english: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

anywaa: Køøre Øt Jwøk ajooda ni tiere othørø ki kïte ki deŋŋe bäre, ni beeye kïte moa cuŋ yïth-øtø bääte, ni bär mar maal mar kanya thør beeye gööye abïciel, ni beeye bär mar athøra.
english: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba dëër øtø ki jï wøk mar yïth-uudi, odhïŋ mare bee gööye abïïc. 'Ba kanya laac na en yïthakic deŋ yïth-øtø mo Øt Jwøk,
english: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

anywaa: ki yïth-øtø mo dïlämme, dööŋ yie bee gööye ma pïërariiø, ni beeye kany mo deŋ Øt Jwøk ee wïrö bäre.
english: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

anywaa: 'Ba kaa ni laac enø, da dhøgi mo dønynya yïth øtø ki ge; dhøk maya ena jï løø wï-piny, ni ö maya ni en jï løø tier-piny. 'Ba kaa ni laac enø, dööŋ yie mar deŋŋe bäre bee gööye abïïc.
english: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.

anywaa: 'Ba da øtø mo ogeerø nyïm yi-kal mar Øt Jwøk ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, mo dööŋ yie bee gööye ma pïërabïriiø. 'Ba odhïŋ dëër øtø manøgø ki deŋŋe bäre bee gööye abïïc, ni ö bärri mare mar piny ni näk gööye ma pïërabïŋween.
english: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.

anywaa: Køøre eni Øt Jwøk arøme; ni joot bär mar piny mar gø na gööye ma dïpa, ni joot bär mar yi-kal mar Øt Jwøk ki dëër øtø maya na gööye ma dïpa thuwø.
english: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;

anywaa: 'Ba dööŋ-ec mar yi-kal mar Øt Jwøk ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki nyïm Øt Jwøk bäre, bee gööye ma dïpa.
english: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.

anywaa: Køøre eni bär mar øtø mana en nyïm kal mar Øt Jwøk na en ŋää Øt Jwøk, arøme ni dwale ka uutjïëthe moa en deŋge, ni tïme na gööye ma dïpa. 'Ba øt lam mana en kur keere na en jï wøk, ki øt lam mana en dïër, ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm na dïët ki kal,
english: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;

anywaa: këël ki  dhøk uudi ka awëërnyeŋŋi moa therø, ki uutjïëthe moa no owïrö ki deŋŋe kiper yïth-øtø moa näk tëëŋŋe adäk, ki jammi bëët moa en deŋŋe, ki were mo dhi øtø, orämmö ko opämi. 'Ba dëëre ki yie orämmö ko opämi ki mana täge ki piny këël dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi; këël awëërnyeŋŋi thuwø orämmö.
english: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, ceiled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;

anywaa: 'Ba yi Øt Jwøk bäre, ki mano täge ki piny këël maal,
english: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.

anywaa: dëëre ogöönnö ki kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli, ki kït jer twöe. Ni kït jer twöe ogöörö ni ena yïthakic kirubël aciel man nø. 'Ba kirubël man nø jïre da täärnyïm ariiø.
english: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;

anywaa: Täärnyïm mana näk otïïö kaamar täärnyïm dhaanhø, odïëdö ki jï løø kït jaath twöö kurciel, ni ö täärnyïm mana näk otïïö kaamar täärnyïm ŋuu, ni dïëdi ki jï løø kït jaath twöö kurciel maya, ni geno göörö na enøgønø ki dëër Øt Jwøk bäre.
english: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki piny këël maal bäät dhi øtø, kït nyïïatwiet maal mo wø cwøl ni kirubëlli ki kït jer twöe ogöör dëër øt lam mana en kur keere na en wøk.
english: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.

anywaa: Øt lam mana en kur keere na en wøk, were moe otieŋø na dibal ma gïïŋŋe aŋween. Ni mana en dhi øt lam mana en kur keere na pere leth dïët ki maya.
english: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïn wø cïp jëëthe bääte ma mar jaath, mo bär mare mar maal bee gööye adäk, ni ö bär mar yïthakic deŋŋi moe ni näk gööye ariiø. 'Ba deŋŋi moe, ki yie, ki teegi moe beeye jaath bäre. Køøre ŋatøgø aköö jïra, ni «Manøgø beeye tharabëëta man wø en nyïm Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba øt lam mana en kur keere na en wøk ki øt lam mana en kur keere na pere leth døc, dhøgi moge man nø okaa na ariiø.
english: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

anywaa: Ni dhøk man nø da thäge ariiø mo jabi ki gø.
english: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøk øt lam mana en kur keere na en wøk ogöörö ki kït nyïïatwiel maal man wø cwøl ni kirubël ki kït jer twöe kaawat moa no ogöörö dëër øtø, ni da jaath nyïm yi-øtø mana en nyïm mo orïïö maal.
english: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋ dhi øtø da awëërnyeŋŋi mo therø mo deŋge ogöörö ki kït jer twöe. Ni beeye deŋ øtø mo Øt Jwøk ki dhøk øtø moe.
english: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana käle ki waŋjöö mana näk coonya yi-kal mana en jï wøk, ni kïth aani yïth-uudi moa näk raŋŋa rege ki yi-kal mar Øt Jwøk, ki yi-kal mana en jï wøk ki løø kur wïpiny.
english: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø manøgø dhøgi moe ena jï løø wï-piny, ni bär mare bee gööye ma dïpa, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïërabïïc.
english: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.

anywaa: Øtø manøgø ogeerø na tëëŋŋe adäk, ni løøk aciel raŋŋa rege ki kanya laac na en yi-kal mana en dïër na näk dööŋ-ec mare gööye ma pïërariiø, ni løøk maya raŋŋa rege ki kanya laac yi-kal mana en wøk na näk opëënhnhö ki kïte.
english: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïm yïth-øtø da waŋjöö ki dïër mo dööŋ yie gööye apaar, ni bär mare gööye ma dïpa. 'Ba dhøk øtø manøgø ena jï løø wï-piny.
english: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-øtø moa en tëëŋ øtø mar maal atïmö ni therø kiper kwör møøk atïmö rege na kwör wääth ni ba caal yïth-øtø moa en tëëŋ øtø mar piny ki dïër.
english: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-øtø moa en dää tëëŋ øtø maal bäŋ cööthe jïge kaamar mo kal; kiper manøgønø, yïthge therø ni ba caal yïthøtø moa en piny ki moa en dïër.
english: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba da kal mo ogeerø ki wøk ki deŋ yïth-øtø ki nyïm dï kal wøk, mo bär mare bee gööye ma pïërabïïc.
english: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-øtø moa en jï løø kal mana en wøk, bär marge bee gööye ma pïërabïïc, ni ö moa en jï løø Øt Jwøk ni näk gööye ma dïpa.
english: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋ yïth-øtø moa en tëëŋŋö mar piny, ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, da dhøk man dønyø ki yie kany wø ö dhaanhe ki dïkal wøk.
english: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï løø tier-piny yïthakic yi-kal mana en wøk ki yi-kal mar Øt Jwøk, da yïth-øtø yie.
english: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth-øtø moøgø da waŋjöö yïthakicge kaamar yïth-øtø moa en jï løø wï-piny, ni bär marge ki dööŋ yïthge röömi. Ni uutjïëthe moa  en nyïmge röömi, ni dhøgi moge thuwø otïïö na teeŋ aciel kaamar moa en jï løø wï-piny.
english: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

anywaa: Ni yïth-øtø moøgø man nø da dhøk jïre, ni døny yïthge ni öö ka dhøk mana en buut dhi kal ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aköö jïra, ni «Yïth-øtø moa en jï løø wï-piny ki moa en jï løø tier-piny na dïët ki kal mar øt Jwøk beege kiper dïlämme, ni beege kwör wø ö dïlämme mo wø ci nyïm Wuuö Jwøk noo camge muuce yïthge moa en kur keerge na perge leth døc. Geni, muuce moa en kur keerge na perge leth døc cïba piny kwörögø, ni beege muuce mo beel, ki muuce mo wëën raay, ki muuce mo wëën bääyö ki ge, kiper kaagø ena kur keere.
english: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the Lord shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

anywaa: Kany wø näk dïlämme geno døny kaagø ni en kur keere enø, ge ba duu wøk ŋää kal na abïïk tïïc moge kärge wii yi øtø, kiper abïïe moøgø ena kur keerge. Geni, abïïe moa näk moge dwøga dëëtge; køøre nø, ge ööa wøk baŋ jiy.»
english: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋatøgø kanya lønye ki røm øtø mana en dïër, aana käl wøk ki dhøk mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni røm deŋ kal bäre ki wøk.
english: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.

anywaa: Eni jï kuna en løø kur tuul-cäŋ arøme ka athøra, ni tïme na gööye ma dïpe abïïc mo athøra.
english: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

anywaa: Ni røm jï løø kur wï-piny, ni tïme na gööye ma dïpe abïïc mo athøra.
english: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

anywaa: Ni røm jï løø kur tier-piny, ni tïme na gööye ma dïpe abïïc mo athøra.
english: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

anywaa: Køøre nyïme aløø jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni røm gø, ni tïme na gööye ma dïpe abïïc mo athøra.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋää kal arøme ki løøk moe moa na aŋween bëët, ni beeye kanya näk deŋŋe ocielø ki kal. 'Ba bär mare atïmö na gööye ma dïpe abïïc, ni tïm dööŋ yie na gööye ma dïpe abïïc. 'Ba kal manøgø pääŋŋa kanya näk ena kur keere na mar Jwøk ki kanya näk ba en kur keere.
english: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana kïth dhi kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ,
english: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:

anywaa: ni puta ajiem Jwø Icriel neen ni öö ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba dwøl mare lwör kaamar pïï mo thööth, ni wëëk piny rieny ka ajiem mare.
english: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø kanya nyoodhi jïra ki yi wïïa, atïmö ni caala mana nyooth jïra na neena kanya ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk na ö kuna raany pääny Jerucalem, ki mana nyooth jïra thuwø na neena kanya ena bäät Naam Kebar. 'Ba dëëra aputa leeŋ piny ni pädha ki bäp yia.
english: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ajiem Wuuö Jwøk aduny yi Øt Jwøk ki dhøk mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And the glory of the Lord came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.

anywaa: Køøre Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk aana tïŋ maal ni kïth aani yi kal mana en dïër, ni ö ajiem Wuuö Jwøki ni pääŋ Øt Jwøk.
english: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni ŋatøgø cuŋŋö buuta, dwøl awïnynya ni cäänna aani ki yi Øt Jwøk,
english: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.

anywaa: ni kööe, «Wär dhaanhø, man beeye kar wälu mara, ni beeye kany këëlla tieta yie. Kany beeye kany bëëda yie dï jø Icriel na bäre bäre. 'Ba jø dhi øt Icriel, ki nyeye moge, nyeŋŋa na en kur keere ba päätge kany këët ki käp marge ki man wø wøørge dëët kït nyeye moge moa no othøw.
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.

anywaa: Kanya wara tïïcge dhøk uudi moge ni ena buut dhi øtø mara, ni tïïcge agööle moge ni ena buut agööla mara, naa pää kalli keere na en yïthakicwa ki geni, nyeŋŋa na en kur keere wø putge ka päät ki jap wø tïïcge na raac yia ki geni. Kiper manøgønø, gena raanynya ki køør gootø mara.
english: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, bëët käp marge, ki man wø wøørge dëët kït nyeye moge moa no othøw, beerra man daakge ge nyïma; køøre nø, aano bëëdö dïge na bäre bäre.
english: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.

anywaa: «'Ba kiperï nø, ï na wär dhaanhø, caan luum Øt Jwøk jï jø Icriel nee wïthge lääge ki raay moge. Beerra man cätge kiper gïna no ocïp piny kiper Øt Jwøk.
english: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo wïthge lää ni caarge wïthge ki japa reyø na tïïcge bëët, yi jöö mana geer Øt Jwøk ki gø wär caanï jïge nee ŋäcge; ni beeye yi øt jöö mare mana jiiŋŋi ki gø, ki yi jöö mana tïïc dhøgi moe ki gø, ki  yi jöö bäre mana geeri ki gø, ki yi jöör bëëtö mare bäre ki ciik moe. Luup moøgø bëët wär göör piny nyïmge, nee yi jöö mana geer Øt Jwøk ki gø nee ŋäcge ni cääthge ki køør ciik moe.
english: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.

anywaa: Man beeye ciik kiper Øt Jwøk: Ŋøøm moa en deŋ øtø bäre bäät kïdi, wär bëëde ni beeye kanya en kur keere døc na pere leth. Manøgø beeye ciik kiper Øt Jwøk.
english: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.

anywaa: «'Ba rumme mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na näk røm ka gööye mo cenø, mo bääte omëënnö ki kany ma kar lweedi aŋween, beege ii: Bär mar aŋaak mare bee gööyö aciel, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööyö aciel thuwø, ni ö odhïŋ deŋŋe ni näk rumi aciel mar yïthakic lweedi. 'Ba rumme mo bëët bär mare beege ii:
english: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.

anywaa: Ki mano täge ki ya aŋaak yïth ŋøøm këël yie mana en jï piny, bär mare bee gööye ariiø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööyö aciel; 'ba ki mano täge ki yie mana en dïër këël yie mana en maal, bär mar gääŋe bee gööye aŋween, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööyö aciel.
english: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.

anywaa: 'Ba kar maac mar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø, bär mar gääŋe bee gööye aŋween, no otïïö ni deŋŋi moe aŋween, ni wïth deŋŋi moe moø na aŋween yøø, da gïï ma aŋween mo cuŋŋö bäätge mo caala tuŋi.
english: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.

anywaa: 'Ba kar maac manøgø bär mare mar dïëre bee gööye apaar kurriiø, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye apaar kurriiø thuwø.
english: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba yie mana en bääte maal, deŋŋi moe otïïö na aŋween thuwø, ni bär mare bee gööye apaar kurŋween, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye apaar kurŋween thuwø. 'Ba odhïŋ deŋŋi moe bee thääŋ gööyö, ni ö dööŋ ec mar aŋaak mana en tiere ni näk gööyö aciel. 'Ba kwöra no othørø na kwör tiel man eth bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø ki gø, ena jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.»
english: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ köö jïra, «Wär dhaanhø, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luum caana jïrï en kiper ciik mo olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki rem mo wø ker bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte kanyo geeri, beege ii:
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord God; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.

anywaa: Ï cïpö ki rwaath jï dïlämme no olämi mar wëën raay, ni beege jï jø tuuŋ Libay na käl dhi øt Dhadök, ni beege jø wø ö nyïm kany mo cään kuna tïnyge aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord God, a young bullock for a sin offering.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, wär lwötï ki rem rwaath ni gweelï gø bäät gïïa na aŋween na caal tuŋi na en bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni gweellï gø ki deŋŋe bäre, niï tïïya gø ni waany, niï tïïya gø no okïdi.
english: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.

anywaa: 'Ba rwaath manøgø thuwø na näk olämi mar wëën raay diï kälö ni waaŋï gø kanya no ojierø na mar Øt Jwøk na näk kare bäär ki kanya en kur keere.
english: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na riet nïne, wärï cïpï ki nywø ateea mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëre ki man cïbi no olämi mar wëën raay, nee gïn wø cïp olämme bääte tïme ni waany, kaawat mana tïï ni waany ki ri rem rwaath.
english: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø tïme ni waany nø, ï cïpö ki rwaath ki nywø røømmø mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëtge.
english: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

anywaa: Lääy moøgø cïbï nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö dïlämme ni kerge acäbö bäätge, ni cïpge ge jï Wuuö Jwøk no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre.
english: And thou shalt offer them before the Lord, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ki yïth nïne abïriiø cooth, wärï cïpï ki nywø ateea na mar wëën raay, ni cïpï thuwø ki rwaath ki nywø røømmø mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëtge.
english: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne abïriiø moøgø, gïn wø cïp olämme bääte tïïcge tïïö ni waany ko okïdi manøgø, nee bëëde ni tøŋ; ni beeye jöö man cïpge gø kur keere jï Jwøk.
english: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne moøgø, ni caka bäc nïne, olämme mou mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, wär cïp dïlämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte. Køøre nø, u jïëa jïëö. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana cäŋ dwøk dhi kal mana en wøk na en jï  løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni beeye dhi kal mar Øt Jwøk bäre; 'ba dhi kal atïmö no odëëdö.
english: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Dhi kal man puta bëëtö no odëëdö ni ba jap, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dønyi ki yie këët, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, onø dønyø ki yie. Kiper manøgønø, bëëde no odëëdö.
english: Then said the Lord unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the Lord, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.

anywaa: 'Ba bee dïbwödhi keere noo pï piny dhi gø kuna cäme nyïm Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba eni dønyi ka dhøk mar yi-øtø mana en nyïm, ni duu wøk ki yi gø thuwø.»
english: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana käle ki dhi kal mana en jï løø wï-piny, ni kïth aani nyïm Øt Jwøk. 'Ba na lwïtha, ajiem Wuuö Jwøk aputa joot ni Øt Wuuö Jwøk ee pääŋö, ni puta dëëra leeŋ piny ni pädha ki bäp yia.
english: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord: and I fell upon my face.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, «Wär dhaanhø, këël wïïï røk luup moi. Raŋï ki waŋï, ni cegï ïthï ki luup caana jïrï bëët ii kiper bëëtö mar Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki ciik moe; ni raŋŋï jiy døøc mo wø dunynyi ki mo wø døny wøk ki yi øt lam mana en kur keere ki man näk mo geno jïëö wala ge kär jïëö.
english: And the Lord said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the Lord, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.

anywaa: Caanï jï jø Icriel ni wø bëëdö na jø ageem, ni man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹Wui jø Icriel, wär yïthu thumge nø ki japa näk yia raac ki ge ni wø tïïyu!
english: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord God; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,

anywaa: Uuni, japa näk yia raac ki ge bëët na tïïyu, bäätge acäŋu mëënnö ki mør, ni beeye ki mana kälu juurre moa path na näk kär daŋø ki yïth cwïnyge ki dëëtge ni kïthu ge yi øt lam mara na en kur keere, ni päätge øt lam mara kany wø cïpu ko olämme jïra, ni beege dwäle ki rem lääy, ni ö uuni ni raanynyu luumma tuuda.
english: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.

anywaa: Uuni ki dëëtu, tïïc maru mana dou tïïö ki man gwøgu jammi 'moa na en kur keerge, käru tïïö; 'ba acïbu ceŋ jøøa path ni tïme ni tïïö geni yi øt lam mara na en kur keere.
english: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, luum caana jïïu bee en: Jøøa path, na näk kär daŋø ki yïth cwïnyge ki dëëtge, kär dee gø mo døny yi øtø mara na en kur keere, ni beege jøøa path bëët mo wø bëëdö dï jø Icriel.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba jø tuuŋ Libay moa tïïc karge ni bäär ki aani kanya ö jø Icrielli na wecge aani ni caathge køør kït gïï wø lamge, ajäla marge ojootge ki køør raay moge.
english: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.

anywaa: Geni, ge poot bëëdö ni ge tïïö yi øtø mara na en kur keere, ni ge gwøga dhøk kal mo Øt Jwøk ni ge tïïö yïthge; ni ge ŋädö ki lääy mo wø cïp no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki teeŋ olämme møga mo wø cïp jiyi; ni ge cuŋŋö nyïm jiy ni ge tïnynya geni.
english: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïnyge jiy ni ge ena nyïm kït gïï wø lamge, ni wëëkge jø Icriel päth yïth raay, ennø, aana kööŋ na adïëri ki man jääla geni ki køør japa reyø na tïïcge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord God, and they shall bear their iniquity.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba nyänh buuta kuna tïnyge aani ni gena dïlämme, ni ge ba nyänh buut jammi 'moa na en kur keerge ki buut olämme 'moa moa en kur keerge na perge leth døc. Geni, geno jïti ki lään wïc ki køør japa näk yia raac ki ge na tïïcge.
english: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ge poot cïba bäät tïïe mo wø tïïc yi Øt Jwøk, ni wëëkge jammi bëët tïïc yi Øt Jwøk.
english: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïlämme, ni beege jø tuuŋ Libay na käl ri dhi øt Dhadök, na wara tïïc tïïe na karge yi øt lam mara na en kur keere kanya bëët jø Icrielli naa ege wiiø, geno nyänh buuta kuna tïnyge aani, ni cuŋge nyïma ni cïpge ko olämme mo dwäle ki rem mo lääy. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord God:

anywaa: Jøøgø keerge beege noo døny yi øt lam mara na en kur keere; ni beege keerge noo nyänh buut tharabëëta mara kuna tïnyge aani ni wëëkge jammi 'moa tïïc.
english: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo wäro dunyge ki dhøk kal mana en dïër, wär rucge ka abïïk lïïna; kärge ruyö ka abïïk jïëc rööm kany wø näk mo ge tïïö dhøk kal mana en dïër wala yi Øt Jwøk.
english: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.

anywaa: Geni, wïthge wär  mëënge ka abïïk lïïna ni runyge dëëtge ki libaae mo abïïk lïïna. Kärge ruyö ki teeŋ abïï mo wëëga dëëtge cöödö ki kwäk.
english: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wäro dønyge yi kal mana en wøk kany wø bëët jiyi yie, abïïk tïïc moa tïïge ki ge na en dëëtge wär kälge wøk ni wiige ge yïth-øtø moa en kur keerge, ni dwøkge abïïe moge dëëtge, nee bëët waany marge na en kur keere ba pööth bäät jiy møga ki køør abïïe moøke.
english: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba geni wïthge kär lielge, ni ba wecge jïëcge nee piithge ni bäyö; 'ba jïër moge wär nyaarge ni ena dïër jaak.
english: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe dïlämi mo mäthi ki køøŋø kany wø näk mo eni dunynya yi kal mana en dïër.
english: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe gø mo nyöömmi ki cï thøø wala dhaagø mo opää ki cwøre; 'ba ge doo nywøma nyïïakuk Icriel moa näk dëët cwøw poot kucge ki määr dïlämme moa näk cwøwge othøw.
english: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.

anywaa: Geni jiya wär pwönyge ki man ŋäcge gïn mo ena kur keere na mar Jwøk ki gïn mo ba en kur keere, ni ŋäcge gïn mo waany ki gïn mo ba waany.
english: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø näk da pïëm mo tägö, dïlämme wär tïïge ni gena jø ŋøl luup, ni ŋølge luup ki køør ciik 'moa. Geni, ciik 'moa ki luup moa caana bëët kiper ajwöm mo wø wøør ki yi cwiir wär gwøkge, ni gwøkge cääŋŋe mo jwöm 'moa ni ena kur keerge.
english: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïlämme kär dëëtge tïïcge ni ba waany ki man cige buut dhaanhø mo othøw; 'ba ni näk mo thøwa wänni, wala menni, wala wääde, wala nyaare, wala coki ma dïcwøø, wala coki ma dhaagø mo poot kär nywømø, løny jïre ki man ci buut gø ni tïm dëëre ni ba waany.
english: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dëëre ee cäŋ dwøk kare ni waany, manynya gø nee kure ki nïne abïriiø, ni ba ci baŋ tïïc yi Øt Jwøk.
english: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, dïcäŋo døny yi kal mana en dïër mar øt lam mana en kur keere ni cøøa baŋ tïïc yi øt lam manøgø, eni wär cïpe ko olämi mar wëën raay kiper dëëre. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kiper luum ŋöömö mana doo dööŋ jïge na marge, bee aani noo dööŋ jïge naa caala ŋöömö mana doo dööŋ na kurge. Kär geni mooyu ki ŋöömö yi ŋööm Icriel; aano dööŋ jïge naa caala ŋöömö mana doo dööŋ na kurge.
english: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.

anywaa: Geno cämö ki beel mo wø cïp na muuce, ko olämme mo wø cïp na mo wëën raay ki mo wø cïp na mo wëën bääyö ki ge; ni ö jammi bëët moa näk ocïp kur keerge na 'moa dï Icriel ni tïmge na moge.
english: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.

anywaa: Nyïïjenni moa beyø ki røk nyïëdi bëët mo wø kwøŋ ŋweelø, ki muuce moa beyø røk muuce mou bëët mo wø cïpu, tïmö na mo dïlämme. Ge wär mooyu ri kwön marra ra abäy mo wø kwøŋ ciek; køøre nø, gwïëth dunynya paac maru.
english: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.

anywaa: Dïlämme kär cämö ki wenyø wala lääy mo thøwa eni keere, wala baga lääyi mør.
english: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo pääŋŋu ŋöömö ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc na nyuuthe, løøk mør wär cïpu jï Wuuö Jwøk na kany mo ena kur keere, mo bär mare beeye gööye ma kume ma pïërariiø kurbïïc, ni dööŋ yie beeye gööye ma kume ma pïërariiø, ni ö yie bäre ni tïï nee bëëde ni ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the Lord, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth ŋøøpøgø, thääŋö mør mo bär mare gööye ma dïpe abïïc, ni dööŋ yie gööye ma dïpe abïïc thuwø, wär tïïyu ni kanya en kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö deŋŋe kany mo jïtö ki gööye ma pïërabïïc ni wii ni ŋaam.
english: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba røk ŋøøpa en kur keere wäru cäŋu rummö ki kany mo bär mare jïtö ki gööye ma kume ma pïërariiø kurbïïc ni dööŋ yie gööye ma kume apaar. 'Ba kaagø øt lam na en kur keere na pere leth otïmö ni ena yie.
english: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋöömö manøgø ni tïme na kany mo ena kur keere kiper dïlämme,  ni bee jø wø tïïö øt lam mana en kur keere ni wø nyänh kany mo cään ki man tïnyge Wuuö Jwøk. Kaagø otïmö na kar uudi moge, ni bëëde no ocïp kur keere kiper øt lam mana en kur keere.
english: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the Lord: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö mo bär mare jïtö ki gööye ma kume ma pïërariiø kurbïïc ni dööŋ yie gööye ma kume apaar, wär cïp jï jø tuuŋ Libay, ni beege jø wø tïïö yi øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïp na kurge man gëëtge yie ki uudi.
english: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba uuni, wäru cïpu ki kany mo orømø ki man tïme na pääny, mo dööŋ yie gööye ma kume abïïc ni bär mare gööye ma pïërariiø kurbïïc, mo kïïö ki thääŋ ŋöömma en kur keere; ni tïme na mar dhi øt Icriel bäre.
english: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba dïbwödhi, ŋøøm moa en buut nyeŋ keee løøi ki løøi na en deŋ ŋöömma en kur keere këël kanyo tïïc na pääny, otïmö na moe, ni beeye ki mano täge ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ki pääny, këël mano këët bäät naama dwøŋ; ni cäŋ tägö ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ mar pääny, ni put këët keew mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba waŋ keew mana en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ki waŋ keew mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ dïët ki nyeŋ keee mo ŋöömö moo cïp jï wï tuuŋ man nø.
english: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.

anywaa: Ŋøøm moøgø otïmö na kur dïbwödhi yi Icriel. 'Ba dïbwöthe 'moa, jiya ba thielge piny këët; 'ba ŋøøm ocïpge jï dhi øt Icriel ki køør wïth tuŋi moge.
english: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man bee luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö: Wui, u na dïbwöthe mo Icriel, yïthu thumge nø ni weyu japa reyø ni wø tïïyu, ki thiel jiya piny, ni tïmu nou tïïya ŋøl ma kare, ki tïïc gïn ma adïëri, ni weyu jiya ki man riemu ge wøk ki yïth ŋøøm moge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Tïïu ki rumme ma kare, ni bee rumi maru man wø cwøl ni iipa, ki rumi man wø cwøl ni baath.
english: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.

anywaa: 'Ba iipa ki baath yïthge wär tïïc ni röömi. Baath yïthe apaar bee kömer, ni iipa yïthe apaar bee kömer; 'ba kömer wär tïme ni bee rumi marge bëët.
english: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.

anywaa: 'Ba rumi mana cwøl ni cekel, yie bee yïth rumme ma pïërariiø mar rumi man wø cwøl ni gëëra. Yïth rumme ma pïërariiø mar cekel, ki yïth rumme ma pïërariiø kurbïïc mar cekel, ki yïth rumme apaar kurbïïc mar cekel, noo dwali bëët, tïmö ni bee yi rumi aciel mar miina.
english: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba man beeye ajwäk mana dou cïbö: Ki røk beek wø cwøl ni cïndë ki gäbci, wäru cïpu ki yi rumi aciel ki røk yïth rumme ma pïërabïciel moi nø, ni bee rumi man wø cwøl ni kömer.
english: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:

anywaa: Maaw man wø cïpu bee rumi aciel ki røk yïth rumme mar dïpa man nø, ni bee rumi man wø cwøl ni köör, ni poot na kömer.
english: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:

anywaa: Ni lwötu ki diel aciel ki røk dïpe ariiø moi nø ki yïth kwör kwaath mo Icriel. Ni gïïögø tïïc kaper muuce mo beel, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, nee tïïc no okïdi kiper jiy. Luummögø caana aani, a na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yi ŋööm Icriel, ŋati man nø eno cïpi ki muuce moøgø jï dïbwödhi mar Icriel.
english: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.

anywaa: Ni tïïc mano tïïc dïbwödhi mar Icriel kar ajwöma bee ki man pääŋ olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel, ki muuce mo kwøk nyïïomøki, ni bee kanyo päär dwääyi yie, ki yïth nïr jwöm, ki yïth nïr ajwöm moa no ocïp piny bëët ni wø wøør jø dhi øt Icriel. Eni olämme moo cïp opääŋŋe, ni bee olämme kiper wëën raay, ki muuce mo beel, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, nee ge tïïc no okïdi kiper dhi øt Icriel.›
english: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹Noo tïme na dwääy mana dïkwøŋ yi cäŋ mana dïkwøŋ kiree, wärï lwötï ki rwaath mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëre, ni tïïyï kanya en kur keere ni waany ki gø.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämi wär lwöte ki rem rwaadhøgø, na näk olämi mar wëën raay, ni naaŋ gø deŋ dhi øt Jwøk, ki røk gøøde moa näk aŋween na en jï kuna da maal mar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ki ri deŋ dhi kal man wø døny yi kal mana en dïër ki gø.
english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.

anywaa: Ni cäŋï teeŋ gïnögø tïïyö thuwø ri bïriet nïne mo dwäänögø kiper jøøa tïïö ki raay mo ba kamge wala mo kucge, niï tïïya gø no okïdi kiper øt Jwøk.
english: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø tïm nïr dwääy mana dïkwøŋ na apaar kurŋween, cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wär wøørru ki nïne abïriiø. 'Ba ki yïth nïrögø wäru cämu ki møø mo ree bäŋ thømmø.
english: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ manøgø kiree, dïbwödhi wär cïpe ki rwaath no olämi mar wëën raay kiper dëëre ki jiy bëët moa en yi ŋööm paac.
english: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.

anywaa: Ki yïth nïrögø na abïriiø yøø mo ajwöma manøgø, ki yi cäŋ cooth, eni wär cïpe ki rwädhe abïriiø ki nyöök rööm abïriiø no olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpe thuwø ki nywø ateea no olämi mar wëën raay.
english: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the Lord, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.

anywaa: Eni wär cïpe ki muuce mo beel ma yi rumi man wø cwøl ni iipa kiper rwaath man nø ki nywø røømmø man nø, ki maaw mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni in kiper rumi man nø mar iipa.
english: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kiper ajwöma man wø tïïc ki nïne abïriiø ri bïriet dwäde ni nïr dwääy apaar kurbïïc, wär eni cïpe ko olämme kiper wëën raay, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki muuce mo beel ki mo mädhi.›
english: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni ‹Dhi kal mana en dïër na en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wär cïëgi ki yïth nïr tïïc moa na abïciel. 'Ba kanyo wäro tïme na cäŋ jwömö ki kanyo wäro päär dwääyi wär jap.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwödhi wär dunynye ki yi-øtø mana en nyïm mar øt-dhi-kal, ni cuŋŋe røk were moa en dï øtø. Ni ö olämme moe mo wø waaŋ bäre ko olämme moe mo wø duunni ki mëër ni cïpi ya dïlämme. Eni Jwøk wär wøøre dhi øtø kaace, køøre nø, eno døny wøk; 'ba dhi kal wär bëëde ni ba dëët këël abøøya.
english: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme na yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm ki kany wø päär dwääyi, jø paac wär öge dhi øtø manøgø thuwø kuna wøørge Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the Lord in the sabbaths and in the new moons.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ni wø käl dïbwödhi jï Wuuö Jwøk ki yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm, wär tïmge na nyïïdïëk abïciel ki nywø røømmø aciel, ni beege lääy mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëtge.
english: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the Lord in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.

anywaa: 'Ba beel moo cïbe na aciel ki nywø røømmø, wär tïme na rumi aciel mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni iipa; 'ba beel moo cïbe na aciel ki nyïïdïëk, wär cïbe ni moa näk løny jïre, ni cïbe na aciel ki maaw ma rumi aciel mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni in kiper iipa man nø mar beel.
english: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo wäro päär dwääyi cooth, eni wär cïpe ki rwaath aciel, ki nyïïdïëk abïciel, ki nywø røømmø aciel, ni beege lääy mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëtge.
english: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.

anywaa: Eni wär cïpe ki muuce mo beel ma yi iipa aciel ki rwaath aciel, ni cïpe ki beel ma yi iipa aciel ki nywø røømmø aciel, ni cïpe ki nyïïdïëk ki beel moa näk løny jïre, ni cïbe na aciel ki maaw ma yi in aciel kiper iipa man nø mar beel.
english: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö dïbwödhi wø dunynye, eni wär dunynye ki dhøk mar yi-øtø mana en nyïm ni døø wøk ki yi gø thuwø.
english: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kany wø ö jø paaci nyïm Wuuö Jwøk kuna wøørge gø ki yïth nïr ajwöm moa no ocaanø, jiy bëët  mo wø dunynyi ki dhøk mana en jï løø wï-piny, wär dønyge wøk ki dhøk mana en jï løø tier-piny; 'ba jiy mo wø dunynyi ki dhøk mana en jï løø tierpiny wär dønyge wøk ki dhøk mana en jï løø wï-piny. Kär dee dhaanhø mo løk ŋääe nee døø wøk ki dhøk mana dunynye ki yie. 'Ba ŋati man nø wär døny wøk ki dhøk mana dïët ki nyïme.
english: But when the people of the land shall come before the Lord in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwödhi wär bëëde dï jiy ni cäädhi ka geni, kany wø duny jiyi yi øtø ki kany wø døny jiyi wøk.
english: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kanyo wäro tïme na yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm ki yïth nïr wödö moa no ocaanø, muuce mo beel moo cïp wär näk rumi aciel mar iipa mo cïp ka rwaath na aciel, ki beel mo iipa aciel mo cïp na aciel ka nywø røømmø, ni ö mo wø cïp na aciel ki nyïïdïëk ni cïbi ki køør moa näk løny jï ŋatøca, ni cïp na aciel ki maaw ma yi in aciel kiper iipa man nø mar beel.
english: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and an ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.

anywaa: « ‹Kany wø näk dïbwödhi cïpö ko olämme ki met ec jï Wuuö Jwøk, ni bee olämi man wø waaŋ bäre wala olämme mo wø duunni ki mëër, dhi kal mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ wär jap jïre. Eni olämi mare man wø waaŋ bäre wala olämme moe mo wø duunni ki mëër wär cïbe kaawat man wø tïïe ki yïth cääŋŋe mo jwöm, køøre eni wär døny wøk. 'Ba kanyo nø døny wøk, dhi kal wär cïëgi.
english: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the Lord, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ki yi cäŋ cooth, wäru cïpu ki nyidiel mo cwiine aciel mo bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi dëëre, ni cïp no olämi man wø waaŋ bäre jï Wuuö Jwøk; ni cïpu ka amöölla cooth.
english: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the Lord of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.

anywaa: Ka amöölla cooth thuwø, wäru cïpu ki muuce mo beel ma bïcier rumi mar iipa, ni cïpu na aciel ki dää rumi mar maaw mano en yi gïr røm man wø cwøl ni in; ni maaw manøgø beeye man jääp ki møø. Manøgø beeye ciik mo bëëdö na bäre bäre na man cïp muuce mo beel ki gø jï Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the Lord.

anywaa: Ni manøgø beeye jöö man wø cïpge nyidiel ki gø, ki muuce mo beel ki maaw, ni cïp ka amöölla cooth kiper olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre.›
english: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.

anywaa: «'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ‹Ni näk dïbwödhi thäk ŋøøm moe cïbe cïbö jï wääde aciel røk wääte, ŋøøm moøgø tïmö na mo nyïïkwaaye; dööŋ jïge na thööŋge.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo thäk ŋøøm moe cïbe na muuy jï ŋat tïïc aciel mare røk jø tïïc moe, ŋat tïïc manøgø ŋøøm moøgø wär bëëde jïre këël kanyo tïme na cwiir mar dwøk jammi; køøre nø, døøa jï kwääye. Eni na dïbwödhi, ŋøøm moe dööŋŋa jï wääte keerge; dööŋ jïge na moge.
english: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwödhi kär dee ŋøøm mo käle kälö baŋ jiy, ni ba rïëm jiy wøk yïth ŋøøm moge. 'Ba beeye ŋøøpe keere noo cïbe jï wääte, nee jiya bëëtge ni bäŋ ŋat mo käl ŋøøm moge wøk ceŋge.› »
english: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.

anywaa: Køøre ŋatøgø aana käle ki dhi øtø mana en deŋ dhi kal ni wëëk aani døny yïth-øtø moa en kur keerge na en jï løø wï-piny, ni beeye yïth-øtø mo dïlämme; ni nyooth kany mør jïra mo ena ya aŋuun øtø ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Kany beeye kany wø ö dïlämme wø thaalge rïŋ olämme yie, ni beege olämme mo wø wëën bääyö ki ge ki mo wø wëën raay ki ge, ni beeye kany thaalge muuce mo beel yie, ni ge mäna gø ki man kïthi yi kal mana en wøk, nee bëët waany marge na en kur keere nee ba pööth dëët jiy.»
english: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana kïth yi kal mana en wøk, ni kïth aani yïth gøøde moa na aŋween. 'Ba yïth gøøde moø na aŋween yøø, aana jïtö yi gøøt man nø ka agur.
english: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

anywaa: Na agure moøgø ni en yïth gøøde moø na aŋween yøø, bär mar  man nø bee gööye ma pïëraŋween, ni ö dööŋ yie ni näk gööye ma pïëradäk. 'Ba agure moø ni en yïth gøøde mo kal manøgø enø, yïthge dïët.
english: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth agure moø na aŋween yøø ki deŋge bëët da këënne mo ocaamø ki kïte.
english: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Moi beege kwör thaal mo jø wø tïïö øt Jwøk, ni beege kwör wø thaalge olämme yïthge mo wø cïp jiyi.»
english: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal aana cäŋ dwøk dhi Øt Jwøk, ni jïta ki pïï mo kwönna wøk ki tier dhi øtø mar Øt Jwøk, ni kwöta jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; kiper Øt Jwøk nyïme ena jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. 'Ba pïï kwönni ka jï løø bäät cwïïc mar Øt Jwøk, ni beeye ki jï løø tier-piny ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana duu wøk ki dhi kal mana en jï løø wï-piny, ni käl aani ki töök kal wøk ki jï løø dhi kal mar wøk mana en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni puta pïï joot ni kwönnö ki jï løø tier-piny.
english: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋatøgø na aa jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni käära thøør røm ki cere, ena rummö ki gööye ma kuma bäät ageel naamøgø; køøre aana wëëk ŋøl naam kany mo päŋ mare ena käät-oguudi.
english: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ankles.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ rummö ki gööye møøk ma kuma bäät ageel naamøgø, ni cäŋ aani wëëk ŋutö ki kany mo päŋ mare ena wï-cuŋ. Køøre ena cäŋ rummö ki gööye møøk ma kuma, ni cäŋ aani wëëk ŋutö ki kany mo päŋ mare ena pier.
english: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ rummö ki gööye møøk ma kuma, 'ba kaace atïmö ni ba løny ki ŋøl jïra; kiper naam päŋ døc ni rømi ka kwaaŋ keere, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man ŋøl gø ki piny.
english: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.

anywaa: Køøre eni aana pëënynye ni kööe, ni «?Wär dhaanhø, gïn nëënö jïrï?» Køøre eni aana cäŋ dwøk bäät ageela.
english: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïa kaace, aana jïtö ki jenni mo thööth døc bäät ageela løøi ki løøi.
english: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Naam man kwöta jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni kwöta yi goor Naam Jördan ni wø cwøl na Araaba, këël mano päth yi Naam Acäbö. 'Ba kanyo päth yi Naam Acäbö kunece, pï Naam Acäbö døøa karge ni met.
english: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.

anywaa: 'Ba naam man kanyo kwöt yie, gïïa näk rege da jwïëy ge bëëdö ni ge kwøw, ni ö Naam Acäbö ni jïte ki rec mo thööth, kiper naam man kwöta yie, ni tïïc pï acäbö ni met. Kiper manøgønø, naam man kany wø kwöt yie jaak, jammi bëët ge bëëdö ni kwøw.
english: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.

anywaa: Dïbïth rec geno cuŋŋi bäät ageel Naam Acäbö man; ki mano täge Ayn-Gadi këël Ayn-Eglam otïmö ni da kwör ma ajääpi di mää yïthge. Otïmö ni da teeŋ rec mo thööth mo di joodø yie kaawat mo wø joot yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from En–gedi even unto En–eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.

anywaa: 'Ba kwöra thec, ki pulli, tïmö ni ba døø karge ni met, kiper ge bëëdö na kany joot acäbö yïthge.
english: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth jenni ma teeŋi mo kännö ki nyïëdi geno tuy bäät ageel naamøgø løøi ki løøi. 'Ba bøøge moge obëëdö ni ba tal, ni bäŋe kany mo ge kääŋö yie ki man ŋweelge ki nyïëdi. Geno bëëdö ni ge ŋweel ki nyïëdi ki yïth dwäde cooth kiper pïï mo wø kwöt baŋge ki tier Øt Lam mana en kur keere. Nyïëdi moge okunynyi kiper cam, ni ö bøøge moge ni kunyge kiper køny täwe.»
english: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luumma caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Moi beege nyeŋ keee mo ŋöömö mano pääŋŋu yïthakiyu, ni bee u wïth tuŋi mo Icriel moa näk apaar kurriiø; 'ba tuuŋ Jocep wär mooyu ki thäk ŋøøm ariiø.
english: Thus saith the Lord God; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋøøm wäru pääŋŋu ni dïët jïge bëët. Kiper aano nø kööŋ ki man cïba ŋöömö manøgø jï kwäyu. Ŋöömö manøgø dööŋ jïïu na maru.
english: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.

anywaa: «'Ba waŋ keew mar ŋöömö manøgø bee en: Ki jï løø wï-piny, tägö ki bäät naama dwøŋ ni døøe ki waŋjöör Ëthlön,  ni cør Lïbö-Amath, ni pööth Cidat,
english: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;

anywaa: ki Bërötha, ki Cibiram, ni beeye waŋ keew mana en yïthakic Damacka ka Amath, ni put pööth Adher-Atikön na en waŋ keew mar Awran.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar–hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.

anywaa: 'Ba keew manøgø täga bäät naama dwøŋ këël mano këët Adhar-Enan, ni rwöbe ka thääŋ Damacka kuna en jï løø wï-piny ki thääŋ Amath kuna en jï løø wï-piny. Manøgø beeye keew mare ki jï løø wï-piny.
english: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar–enon, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.

anywaa: «'Ba waŋ keew mar ŋöömö manøgø ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ cøra yïthakic Awran ki Damacka, ni put døø ki yi naam Jördan yïthakic Gelät ki ŋööm Icriel, këël mano këët bäät Naam Acäbö, ni pïïe Tamar. Manøgø beeye keew mare ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ.
english: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.

anywaa: «'Ba keew mar ŋöömö manøgø ki jï løø tier-piny täga Tamar këël mano pïïe yïth näm mo Meriba-Kadëc, ni cøra waŋ naam Ijep këël naama dwøŋ. Manøgø beeye keew mare ki jï løø tier-piny.
english: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.

anywaa: «'Ba keew mar ŋöömö manøgø ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ beeye bäät naama dwøŋ, ni tägi ka paaba en jï løø tierpiny këël mano pïïe jï løø wï-piny kany mo raŋŋa rege ki Libö-Amath. Manøgø beeye keew mare mana en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.

anywaa: «Ŋöömö manøgø wär pääŋŋu yïthakiyu ki køør wïth tuŋi mou, u na jø Icriel.
english: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Wär pääŋŋu yïthakiyu ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc na nyuuthe, ni bee u bëët ki jøøa path moa en dïïu na näk jïge da obwöre. Wäru cädu kiper jøøa path ni raŋŋu ge kaamar jiy mo nywøla jø Icrielli. Ge wär jïtge ki kurge ri ŋöömö manøgø yïthakic tuŋi mo jø Icriel.
english: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Ŋata path man nø doo jïtö ki kure ri ŋöömö manøgø yïthakic tuuŋ mana en yie dï jø Icriel.» Luummögø caana Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba moi beege nyeŋ mo wïth tuŋi mo jø Icriel ki jöö mano pääŋge ŋöömö ki gø: Ki mano täge ki jï løø kur wï-piny ki deŋ jöö mar Ëthlön mano ci Lïbö-Amath, këël mano këët Adhar-Enan waŋ keew ki Damacka, ni put døø ki jï løø wï-piny ki deŋ Amath, ni beeye ki mano täge ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, beeye ŋöömö mano cïp jï jø tuuŋ Daan na kurge.
