english: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø gena öö ni rege ege kuurö na dhøk, ni jootge Daniel ni lämö ni pëënynya Jwøe kiper køny.
english: Then these men assembled, and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø gena ci nyïm nyeya ni cäänge ki gø kiper ciik moa käl nyeya wøk, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, ï kär kän wøk ki ciik na bëëde ni ŋato lämö ki jwøk mør yïth nïne moø na pïëradäk yøø, wala lama dhaanhø mør ni paa ïïni, ï na nyeya en, eni wär put leeŋ yi buur ŋuuwe?» Ni løgi ya nyeya ni kööe, ni «Yaa, manøgø beeye ciik mo ocemø ni teek, no otïïö ki køør ciik mo jø Mëdön ki mo jø Parca na ciik mo ba pät.»
english: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.

anywaa: Ni putge gø dwøgø nyïm nyeya ni köge, ni «Wui nyeya, Daniel na en røk jøøa mak ki tøŋ Juuda, ïïna taae, ni taak ciik moa göörï piny, ni eni poot bëëdö ni lämö ki dïcäŋ aciel kwöre adäk.»
english: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, which is of the children of the captivity of Judah, regardeth not thee, O king, nor the decree that thou hast signed, but maketh his petition three times a day.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya na wïny luummögø ennø, kööre aput pädhö, ni løø wïïe baŋ acaara man piem Daniel ki gø, ni maaŋ dëëre nee jïte ki jöö man køny gø ki gø këël mana päth cäŋŋi.
english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was sore displeased with himself, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him: and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him.

anywaa: Køøre jøøgø aci baŋ nyeya ni rege ege kuurö na dhøk ni köge, ni «Wui nyeya, beerra man ŋäyï gø ki man näk mo ï na nyeya en teeŋ ciik mana kälï wøk ki køør ciik mo jø Mëdön ki ciik mo jø Parca ba løny ki man wiili.»
english: Then these men assembled unto the king, and said unto the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is, That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya aput cïpö ki dwøl, ni ö Danielli ni øømmi ni puti leeŋ yi buur ŋuuwe. Ni kö nyeya jï Daniel, ni «Jwøk marï ni wø tïnynyï cooth, eni ki dëëre ïïno pieme.»
english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spake and said unto Daniel, Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee.

anywaa: Ni ö kïdi ni puti øømmø ni dëët dhi buur ki gø, ni puti ya nyeya mwön ki ŋïï mare ki ŋïï mar jø kööre moe, nee bäŋe gïn mo wiil ree kiper Daniel.
english: And a stone was brought, and laid upon the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya adøø paan dwøŋ mare, ni thöör wäär bäre ni bäŋ gïn mo ee camø, ni bäŋ gïn mïn yie ki gø mo okäl baŋe, ni käre løny jïre ki man bute.
english: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ruu øwi ennø, nyeya apäny maal ni laar ci bäät buur mar ŋuuwe.
english: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste unto the den of lions.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm kare ni cään ki buur mana en Danielli yie, ena cwötö døc ki dwør pänh cwïny, ni kööe jï Daniel, ni «?Daniel, ï na dhaanh Jwøa kwøw, Jwøk marï ni wø tïnynyï cooth aløny jïre ki man piem ïïni dhøk ŋuuwe?»
english: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Danielli jï nyeya, ni «Wui nyeya, ïïno bëëdö na bäre bäre!
english: Then said Daniel unto the king, O king, live for ever.

anywaa: Jwøk mara nyïïatwiel maal mare ajääŋŋe ni mec dhøk ŋuuwe, ni kärge dëëra mooø ki ŋwellø, kiper aana joot ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø nyïme, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo yaa tïïö dëërï thuwø, ï na nyeya.»
english: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya yie atïmö ni met døc, ni put cïpö ki dwøl nee Daniel käl wøk ki yi buur. Køøre Daniel aput käl wøk ki yi buur, ni bäŋ ŋwellø mo ojoodø dëëre na bäre, kiper mana bëëde ni ŋäätha Jwøk mare.
english: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aput cïpö ki dwøl, ni øøm jøøa kïth bäät Daniel ki luum tööt ni leeŋ geni yi buur ŋuuwe, geni ki määrge ko obwöre moge. 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge poot kär pïï tier buur piny, ŋuuwe aput päär bäätge ni put cuu moge bëët tøyø na thäŋi.
english: And the king commanded, and they brought those men which had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions had the mastery of them, and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya ma Dariöc aput gööt baŋ wïth jiy ki wïth juurre, ki wïth dhøgi, jø wø bëëdö yi ŋöömö bëët, ni kööe, «Bëët-mëër opälli jïïu!
english: Then king Darius wrote unto all people, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied unto you.

anywaa: «Ennø, aana kän wøk ki ciik: Jiy bëët moa en ya akwöm nyec mara bëëtge ni ge lwäära Jwø Daniel ni dëëtge kwanynyi nyïme. «Kiper beeye Jwøa kwøw ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni buc nyec mare beeye man wø bëëdö ni ba ränynyi, ni teek mare bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.

anywaa: Eni jiy di piemø ni køny geni, ni tïïe ki nyuuthe ki gïï mo rëëma ec maal ki piny, eni na piem Daniel ceŋ ŋuuwe.»
english: He delivereth and rescueth, and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

anywaa: 'Ba Daniel, ena bëëdö ni bëëtö mare beer yïth cwiiri moa beet nyeya ma Dariöc, ki yïth cwiiri moa beet nyeya ma Kiröc nyï Parca.
english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

anywaa: Yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana tïm Belthacörri ni ena nyeny Babiløn, Daniel alägö ki lääk ni jïte ki gïï mo onyoodhø jïre ki yi wïïe kanya bëëde ni ena bäät pëëm niine mare. Køøre eni lääk agöör piny, ni caan gø na ennø nø.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.

anywaa: Eni na Daniel ena köö, ni «Kanya bëëda naa neeta gïïa nyooth jïra ki yi wïïa ki wäär, ajooda ni jam maal kwödö ni cura but piny karge ŋweeri ni ge tuuŋŋa naama dwøŋ.
english: Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.

anywaa: Køøre cwëënyi aŋween mo døøŋŋø ma teeŋi aö wøk ki yi naama dwøŋ manøgø.
english: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

anywaa: «Cwieny mana dïkwøŋ caala ŋuu, ni jïre da bwöm mo caala mo odhuuth. Aana bëëdö naa raŋŋa gø këël mana ö bwömmi moe ni pudhi wøk, no otïŋ maal no othïïŋö ni cuŋŋö ki tiel ariiø kaamar dhaanhø, ni cïp acaara mar dhaanhø jïre.
english: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings: I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made stand upon the feet as a man, and a man's heart was given to it.

anywaa: «Køøre riet cwieny mør ajooda mo caala dïb, 'ba eno tïŋ maal ki bwøbe ki løøk aciel, ni dhee da ŋëëdi adäk ki yïthakic lage, ni caani jïre, ni ‹Ö maal ni cämï ki rïŋö mo päl.›
english: And behold another beast, a second, like to a bear, and it raised up itself on one side, and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it: and they said thus unto it, Arise, devour much flesh.

anywaa: «Køør manøgø kanya bëëda naa poot rääŋö, aana nëënnö ki cwieny mør mo caala kwac, mo dïŋääe da bwöm aŋween mo caala mo wenyø; cwieny manøgø thuwø jïre da wïdhi aŋween, ni eno mooø ki teek mar käär jiy.
english: After this I beheld, and lo another, like a leopard, which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

anywaa: «Køør manøgø kanya bëëda ki wäär naa poot raŋŋa gïïa nyooth jïra ki yi wïïa, aana nëënnö ki ŋweer cwëënyi mo cwïny bwøk ki gø, mo di lwäärö, mo teek døc, ni jïre da lak mo døøŋŋø ma nywïëny. Kany wø cäme, cam pete petø ni thenh thenh ni løøny geni, ni  nyør moa dööŋ ki tiete. Eni ba caal cwëënyi moa dïkwøŋ bëët, ni eni jïre da tuŋi apaar.
english: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya bëëda naa caara gïr tuŋi moøgø døc, ka adïëri møn, tuuŋ mør mo thiinh acäŋ tuyö yïthakic tuŋi møga, ni ö tuŋi adäk røk tuŋi moa dïkwøŋ ni pudhi wøk ki tietge nyïm manøgø, ni tuuŋ manøgø jïre da nyeŋ mo caala nyeŋ dhaanhø, ni jïre da dhøk mo cäänö ki luup dhwöle mo døøŋŋø.
english: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

anywaa: «Kanya bëëda naa rääŋö, wäle acïp piny karge, ni ö Eni Na Nut Yïth Nïr Acääŋŋe ni pï piny bäät wälu mare. Abïï mana en dëëre tar ni caala piiø, ni jïëc wïïe caala jïëc røømmø mo pøøth. Wälu mare bëëdö ni wärri ki leep maac, ni tiet wälu liel ki maac.
english: I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.

anywaa: Naam ma maac bëëdö ni kwödö ni ööa wøk ki nyïme, ni kum jiy ma kume tïnynya eni, ni kum jiy apaar kwöre ma kume apaar cuŋŋö nyïme, ni ö kwääy løøk ni pï piny, ni ö weeli ni jabi.
english: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

anywaa: «Køøre aana bëëdö naa poot rääŋö kiper luup dhwöle moa car tuuŋŋi. Aana bëëdö naa poot rääŋö këël mana ö cwienynyi manøgø ni nääi, ni ö rïŋ dëëre ni leeŋi yi maac mo wärri ni raanynyi.
english: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

anywaa: 'Ba cwëënyi møga, teek marge akäl wøk baŋge, 'ba nïr kwøw moge ameet jïge kiper kany mo okwaanø.
english: As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time.

anywaa: «Kanya bëëda ki wäär naa poot raŋŋa gïïa nyooth jïra ki yi wïïa, aana nëënnö ki ŋat mo caala Wär Dhaanhø mo öö ki yïth pøøl mo maal, ni ö baŋe, Eni Na Nut Yïth Nïr Acääŋŋe, ni wëëgi ciin nyïme.
english: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

anywaa: Ni cïp teek jïre ka ajiem ki nyec kiper nee wïth jiy bëët ki wïth juurre, ki wïth dhøgi bëët tïmge ni tïnynya eni. Teek mare mar käär jiy beeye teek mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni buc nyec mare ba ränynyi.
english: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

anywaa: «'Ba a na Daniel en, aana bëëdö ni jwïëy 'moa kïmmö, ni bëët gïïa nyooth jïra ki yi wïïa ni tuuŋŋa cwïnya.
english: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

anywaa: Ni nyiiga buut dhaanhø aciel røk jiy mo cuŋŋö kaace, ni pëënynya eni ki tiet gïïögø bëët moa näk karge. Kanyøgø acaane jïra ni nyooth tier gïna cään gïïögø kiperge.
english: I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni ‹Cwëënyi moø ni døøŋŋø na aŋween yøø nyootha nyeye aŋween moo thïïŋ rege bäät piny.
english: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jic Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, buc nyec oci jïge, ni ö buc nyeci manøgø ni tïme na marge na bäre bäre, ki yïth beenhnhe bëët moo ööi.›
english: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

anywaa: «Køøre aana tïmö ni cwïnya manynya gø døc ki man ŋääa adïëri kiper ŋweer cwieny mana näk ba caal cwëënyi møga bëët, na näk di lwäärö døc, na näk lage beeye nywïëny, ni kwök lweete beeye jwïël, ni kany wø cäme, cam pete petø ni thenh thenh ni løøny geni, ni nyør moa dööŋ ki tiete.
english: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet;

anywaa: Ni tïma thuwø ni cwïnya manynya man ŋääa gïr tuŋi moa näk apaar na en wïïe, ki gïr tuuŋ mana cäŋ tuyö, na päth tuŋi moa na adäk nyïme, na näk jïre da nyeŋ ki dhøk mo cäänö ki luup dhwöle ki gïï mo døøŋŋø, ni nëëni kere dwøŋŋa eni dï tuŋi møga.
english: And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.

anywaa: Kanya bëëda naa poot rääŋö, tuuŋ manøgø da leny maa këële ki jø Jwøk ni bööt geni,
english: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

anywaa: këël kanya ö Eni Na Nut Yïth Nïr Acääŋŋe, eni na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, na ööe ni ŋun jiye, ni beeye kanya ö kanya wäŋŋi ki man cïp buc nyec jïge, ge na jiye.
english: Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

anywaa: «Køøre acaane jïra na ennø: ‹Ŋweer cwieny tïmö na ŋweer akwöp nyec bäät piny, mo ba caal akwöp nyec møga bëët, ni cam piny bäre, ni nyøøn gø piny ni pet gø na thäŋi.
english: Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

anywaa: 'Ba mar tuŋi moa näk apaar, nyeye apaar rege othïïŋge ya akwöm nyec manøgø, ni ö  nyeya mør ni thïïŋ ree køørge, ni eni ba caal nyeye moa dïkwøŋ, ni ö eni ni bööt nyeye adäk.
english: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings.

anywaa: Ni cääne ki luup dëër Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni dïïm jiy moe, Eni na dwøŋ ni en maal, ni cäde ki man wiil kwöra wäŋŋi ki ciik, ni ö jic Jwøk ni cïbi cere ki cwiiri adäk ki thääŋö.
english: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba kwääc løøk kanyo pï piny kiper ŋøl luup, teek mar nyenynyøgø di lwørø ni raanynyi na bäre bäre.
english: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.

anywaa: Køøre teek mar käär jiy, ki dööŋö bäre mar akwöp nyec mo bäät piny put ka cïp ceŋ jic Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal. Buc nyec mar Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal beeye bura mo bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni ö jøøa en teeki ceŋge ni tïnyge eni ni wïnyge mare.›
english: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

anywaa: «Kar kaagø gïna nyooth athum. 'Ba a na Daniel en, acaara mara abëëdö ni tuuŋŋa cwïnya, ni ö täärnyïma ni needuk; 'ba luubö manøgø abëëdö ni yaa kan cwïnya.»
english: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

anywaa: Kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moa beet Belthacörri ni ena nyeya, a na Daniel, aana nyuunhnhi ki lääk køør lääk mana kwøŋ nyooth jïra dïkwøŋ.
english: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda naa raŋŋa gïna nyooth ki yi wïïa, ajooda naa ena yi kiira näk ogeerø ni teek yi pääny Cuca na en po jø Ilam, ni kanya raŋŋa gïna nyooth ki yi wïïa, ajooda naa ena deŋ naam man wø cwøl no Ulay.
english: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

anywaa: Køøre waŋa akëëlla dëëre ni jooda nywø røømmø mo cuŋŋö deŋ naamøgø, mo jïre da tuŋi ariiø. Tuŋi moøgø na ariiø yøø bäyö, 'ba aciel bäärra eni ki maya, ni mana bäär tuya ŋää cään.
english: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

anywaa: Nywø røømmø manøgø ajooda ni cööba jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki jï løø wï-piny ki jï løø tier-piny, ni bäŋ lääy mør mo oløny ki man cuŋŋe nyïm gø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo da gïn mo ee piemø cer teek mar gø; 'ba ena tïmö ni tïïya gïna met yie ki gø, ni døøc dëëre mo dwøŋ.
english: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda naa caara gïr gïnögø, aana nëënnö ki nywø ateea mo käla jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni ŋøla bäät piny bäre ni ŋøøm ba gude, na ateea manøgø yïthakic nyeŋŋe da tuuŋ mo nëënö jaak.
english: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

anywaa: Ni ööe ni cääth baŋ nywø røømmø mana näk jïre da tuŋi ariiø na jooda ni cuŋŋö deŋ naam, ni läät baŋ gø ki wëër mo teek.
english: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

anywaa: Ni jooda gø ni nyiiga buut nywø røømmø ni cwïnye okëënynyö ki gø, ni tuk nywø røømmø ni tëëŋ tuŋi mo gø wøk moa näk ariiø, 'ba nywø røømmø bäŋ teek jïre ki man cuŋŋe ki gø. Kanyøgø ena put ateea gøø piny ni nyør gø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo oløny jïre ki man piem nywø røømmø cer teek mar gø.
english: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

anywaa: Køøre nywø ateea manøgø dëëre aput døøc mo dwøŋ døc, 'ba kanya bëëde ni teek, tuuŋ mare mana dwøŋ atoor, ni ö kare ni twöe ki tuŋi aŋween mo nëënö jaak, ni wïthge ege løø but piny karge ŋweeri kwör wø kwön jam maalli ki yïthge.
english: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba tuuŋ mo thiinh atuy ki ri tuuŋ aciel røk tuŋi moøgø, ni ö teeki mare ni nyaae ni cäätha jï løø tier-piny, ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø ŋøøp wø cwøl ni Mïërö.
english: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.

anywaa: Ena døøŋŋø këël mana put këët ri lwaa gïïa en maal, ni ö lwaa gïïa en maalli møøk ki ceer møøk ni leeŋ ge piny ni nyør ge.
english: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

anywaa: Eni dëëre atïŋ maal ni døøc dëëre mo dwøŋ ni päär dëëre ki Kwääc lwaa gïïa en maal, ni ö olämme mo wø cïp cooth jï Kwääc lwaa gïïa en maal ni män ge, ni päät kar lam na en kur keere.
english: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper gïïa no obayø, lwaa gïïa en maal ko olämme mo wø cïp cooth acïp dhi cere, ni ö jammi bëët mo wø tïïe ni thurge karge, ni ö adïëri ni leeŋi piny.
english: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

anywaa: Køøre aani dwør ŋat mo ena kur keere awïnynya ni cäänö, ni ö ŋat mør mo ena kur keere ni kööe jï mana cäänö, na «?A këël yi wäne no ö gïna nyooth noo thur kare, gïna cäänö kiper olämme mo wø cïp cooth, ki bääyö man wø käl ränynyö, ki cïp kar lam  na en kur keere, ki lwaa gïïa en maal ki man nyøri ki tiel?»
english: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïra, ni «Thöödhö ki nïne ma kuma aciel ki dïpa ki pïërabïïc, no olämme mo wø cïp ka abøøya ka amöölla ba cïp yïthge. Køøre kar lam na en kur keere cäŋ ka dwøk kare ni beer.»
english: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Daniel, kanya bëëda naa raŋŋa gïna nyooth, naa manynya gø nee tiere kwanya, ajooda ni da ŋat mo cuŋŋö nyïma mo caala dhaanhø.
english: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

anywaa: Ni puta dwør dhaanhø wïnynyö mo cwödö ya ageel naam wø cwøl no Ulay ni kööe, ni «Geebriel, caan tier gïna nyooth jï ŋati en nee ŋääe.»
english: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe buut kanya cuŋŋa yie, aana lwäyö ni pädha ki täärnyïma. Ni kööe jïra, ni «Wär dhaanhø, wär ŋäyï ki man näk mo gïna nyooth cäänö kaper kanyo ŋuut pinynyi yie.»
english: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni cäänö ki aani, nyeŋŋa aput gämmö døc ni täärnyïma poot yaa këël yïth ŋøøm; køøre aana gude ni tïŋ aani maal naa thïïŋ.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Neenï, aani gïïo tägi ya aŋuudi yïth nïr wëër caana caanø jïrï, kiper gïna nyooth cäänö kaper kanya wäŋŋi na näk aŋuudi.
english: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.

anywaa: Nywø røømmø mana jootï na näk jïre da tuŋi ariiø, nyootha nyeye mo jø Mëdön ki mo jø Parca.
english: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

anywaa: Ni nywø ateea nyootha nyeny jø Gïrïïk, ni tuuŋ mana dwøŋ na en yïthakic nyeŋŋe nyootha nyeya mana dïkwøŋ.
english: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

anywaa: Ni tuŋi moa näk aŋween moa tuy kar tuuŋ mana toor, nyootha akwöp nyec aŋween mo rege pääŋge ka ri wï jur marge, 'ba ge ba teek ni caala akwöm nyec mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme ni ya aŋuun nyec marge, kanyo tïm jø bääö ni reyø døc, da nyeya mo ree di thïïŋö mo täärnyïme di lwäärö, na ŋat mo waŋe riek ki cwøk.
english: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

anywaa: Eni teek mare tïmö ni dwøŋ døc, 'ba paa teek mare ki dëëre. Eni, räänyö mo dwøŋ tïïe tïïö, ni ö gïn wø tïïe jaak ni thur kare. Eni jiy moa teek, këël ki jic Jwøk raanynye raanynyø.
english: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jöör riek waŋe, cwøk otïïe ni thur kare jïre; ni døøc dëëre mo dwøŋ ki yi cwïnye, ni kanyo bëët jiyi ni bëëtö marge wøp jaak, wïth jiy mo thööth raanynye raanynyø, ni thïïŋ ree dëër Kwääc kwääri. 'Ba eni petø ni bäŋ cer dhaanhø ree.
english: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

anywaa: «Gïna nyooth manøgø na cäänö kiper olämme mo wø cïp ka abøøye ka amöölle na tiere nyooth jïrï beeye adïëri. 'Ba gïna nyooth manøgø wär kan cwïnyï, kiper cäänö kaper nïne mo poot ena yi nyïm kuya.»
english: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Daniel, dëëra aput nidhooth piny, ni bëëda naa tuu ki nïne møøk. Køøre aana cäŋ ö maal ni døøa baŋ tïï nyeya, 'ba aani a bëëdö ni yia othäŋŋö jaak ki gïna nyooth, kiper tiere kär ci wïïa.
english: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.

anywaa: Kanya tïme na yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mar Dariöc wär Ayacewëëröc na käl røk jø Mëdön, ŋata røøny na nyeya mar akwöm nyec mar jø Babiløn,
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

anywaa: yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ kanya bëëde na nyeya, a na Daniel en, da tier gïn maa kwanya yïth weet Jwøk ki køør luubö mana nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jï nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jeremaya, ki man näk mo ränynyö mar Jerucalem thöödhö ki cwiiri ma pïërabïriiø.
english: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïma aputa løø baŋ Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ki lam, naa manynya eni ni mara kwac, naa lämö ki lam wödö ki cam, naa käära keece na abïïe, naa bëëdö yi bur.
english: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

anywaa: Aana lämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, ni køba raay jïre ni kööa, ni «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ï na Jwøa dwøŋ ni wø lwäärö ki eni, ï ni wø gwøk luumma tuutï, ki mëër man wø ba jøøl, ni tuutï ka jø wø mëër ki ïïni, ni wø gwøk ciik moï,
english: And I prayed unto the Lord my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

anywaa: waani, waana gaa wøk, ni bääcwa ni tïïwa ki raay, ni gëëmwa, ni løøwa ŋäthwa baŋ gïïa cemï ki ciik moï.
english: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:

anywaa: Maya thuwø, dööt jiyï ma nyïïkuk Jwøk kärwa wïnynyö, jø wø køp luup ki nyeŋŋï jï nyeye mowa, ki jï kwääri mowa, ki jï wëëkwa, ki jï jiy bëët moa en yi ŋöömö.
english: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

anywaa: «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ïïni bee ï wää bëënynyö, 'ba waani marwa beeye lään wïc, kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en, ni bee wa jø Juuda ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem, ki jø Icriel bëët moa en kwör mo cärö ki moa en kwör mo bäyö yïth mïëri bëët moa riemï ge yïthge, kiper ageeme moa tïïcge dëërï.
english: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.

anywaa: Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, waani marwa beeye lään wïc møn, wa ki nyeye mowa, ki kwääri mowa, ki wëëkwa, kiper waana bääyö dëërï.
english: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.

anywaa: Ï na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, marï beeye mëër ki wëën jiy, këël na bëëtwa ni wa gëëmö ki ïïni,
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

anywaa: ni kärwa dwørï wïnynyö, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ni kärwa cäädhö køør ciik moï na cïpï jïwa ki dhøk jiyï ma nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

anywaa: Dhaanh Icriel bäre ciik moï akaalge, ni løkge ŋäthge, ni kwierge dwørï. «Kiper manøgønø, acïëni ki kööŋ mar ajäla na näk ogöör piny yi wëël ciik Modhe, eni na dhaanh Jwøk, akïth bäätwa, kiper waana bääyö dëërï.
english: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.

anywaa: Ïïni luummï mana caanï dëëtwa ki dëët dïbwöthe mowa, mo wø käär waani, awëëgï thur kare ki man kännï bäätwa ki gïn mo leth mo dwøŋ; kiper ki yi piny bäre poot bäŋ teeŋ gïn mo otïïö mo caala teeŋ gïna tïïc dëër Jerucalem.
english: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.

anywaa: Gïï ni leth bëët ii aö bäätwa ki køør mana näk ogöörö yi wëël ciik Modhe; 'ba waani met yiï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, kärwa manynyø, ni kärwa røkwa løø ki yïth raay mowa, ki man luuwa wïthwa baŋ adïëri marï.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ï kär dwiil ki man kälï gïna leth bäätwa, kiper ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, marï beer ki yïth jammi bëët mo wø tïïyï; 'ba waani dwørï kärwa wïnynyö.
english: Therefore hath the Lord watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, wui ï na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ï na käl jiyï wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep ki køør teek badï, ï na tïïc nyeŋŋï nee wïnye kaawat man bëëde dïcäŋi en, waani, waana bääyö, ni tïïcwa gïï mo reyø.
english: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

anywaa: Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, ki køør tïïe moï bëët na näk mo bëënynyö, ennø beerra man paanyï wëër marï bäät pääny marï ma Jerucalem, ni wø en bäät kïnna en kur keere; kiper Jerucalem ki jiy moï atïmö na gïr ajøøŋ jï jiy bëët moa en deŋwa ki køør gïïa bacwa ki raay mo kwäcwa.
english: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, ï na Jwøk marwa, beerra man wïnynyï lam mar dhaanhnhï man ki kwac mare. Ki køør nyeŋŋï, ï na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, beerra man wëëgï täärnyïmï rieny bäät kar lam marï na näk oränynyö.
english: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.

anywaa: Wui ï na Jwøk mara, cek ïthï ni wïnynyï mara! Jap nyeŋŋï ni raŋï ränynyö marwa ki mar pääny man wø cwøl ri nyeŋŋï. Waani ï ba kwacwa kaper ni da gïn mo beer baŋwa; 'ba beeye kiper mëër marï na päl.
english: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.

anywaa: Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, wïny marwa! Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, wëën waani! Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, cek ïthï ki marwa ni tïïï ki gïrpiny! Wui ï na Jwøk mara, ki køør nyeŋŋï, kärï ruu, kiper pääny marï ki jiy moï cwøla ri nyeŋŋï.»
english: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda naa cäänö naa lämö naa køpa raay 'moa ki mo jø powa ma jø Icriel, naa peedha kwac mara nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, kiper thuur mar Øt Jwøk na en kur keere,
english: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God;

anywaa: kanya bëëda naa poot cäänö ki yi lam, Geebriel, ŋata kwøŋa joot yïth lääk dïkwøŋ, amään baŋa døc kar kany  wø cïp olämi mar abøøya yie.
english: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

anywaa: Ni cïpe ki pwöc jïra ni kööe, ni «Daniel, aana öö ennø kuna mooa ïïni ki leec wïc, nee tiet luup kwanyï.
english: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

anywaa: Kanya tägï ki lam ennø, da luubö ma aöö, ni beeye mano caana jïrï en, kiper ïïna mëërö ki gø døc. Kiper manøgønø, caar luubö man ni ŋäyï tier gïna nyooth.
english: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

anywaa: «Cwiiri abïriiø kwöre ma pïërabïriiø akwaan kiper jø pou ki pääny maru na en kur keere, ki man mwön bääyö yïth cwiiri moøgø, ki man thum raayi, ki man tïïc okïdi kiper gïïa bayi, ki man ö bëënynyö mana näk bëëdö na bäre bäre, ki man thur gïna nyooth kare ki luupa køp nyïïkuk Jwøki, ki man ö kar lam na en kur keere na pere leth ni jøri ki maaw.
english: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ŋäyï gø ni kwanyï tiere ki man näk mo luubö mana caan ki man dwøk Jerucalem kare ki man cäŋi geerrø, këël kanyo ö ŋata näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw, ŋato käär jiy, otïmö na cwiiri abïriiø kwöre abïriiø, ki cwiiri abïriiø kwöre ma pïërabïciel ka ariiø. Jerucalem cäŋ ka geerrø ni da nyeŋ jïëthe ki kwör gwøk røk mo teek. 'Ba kar kaace beeye nïr gïï mo leth.
english: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na køør cwiiri abïriiø kwöre ma pïërabïciel ka ariiø, ŋata näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw di nääö ni bäŋ gïn mo dööŋ jïre, ni ö jø lenynyi mo kwäärö mør mo ena nyïm ni raanyge pääny ki kar lam na en kur keere. 'Ba aŋuunne öö kaamar jwïëö. Leny obëëdö ni cäätha nyïme jaak këël aŋuunne, ni ränynyö bëëdö no onøŋøl.
english: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

anywaa: 'Ba kwäärö manøgø tudö ki luubö mo teek ma kar cwiiri abïriiø, ni tuude ka jiy mo thööth; 'ba noo tïme na thääŋ cwiiri abïriiø moøgø, eni, jiy di mänö ki man cïpö ko olämme ki muuce mo beel. 'Ba eni na käl ränynyö, gïna näk ec raac ki gø døc ocwöth piny wï Øt Jwøk, këël kanyo tïme na aŋuudi mano kïth ränynyö bääte mana näk oŋølø kipere.»
english: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

anywaa: Kanya tïme na ri dää cwiiri moa beet Kiröci ni ena nyeny Parca, da dwøl moo nyoodhø jï Daniel ni wø nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Belthacacör, ni dwørøgø beeye adïëri ni cäänö kaper leny mo dwøŋ. 'Ba tier dwørøgø akwanye, ni nyooth jïre ka yïth lääk.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

anywaa: Kar kaaca, a na Daniel, aana bëëdö naa kïmmö ki juu adäk.
english: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö ni bäŋ cam mo met mo yaa camø, ni bäŋ rïŋö wala køøŋø mo yaa gudö ki dhaa, ni bäŋ maaw mo yaa wïïr dëëra na bäre bäre këël kanya thum juuwi moøgø na adäk yøø.
english: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwääyi mana dïkwøŋ na pïërariiø ka aŋween, kanya bëëda naa ena bäät ageel naama dwøŋ ni wø cwøl ni Thëgerø,
english: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;

anywaa: aani nyeŋŋa ataa maal ni räŋŋa, ni jooda dhaanhø mo oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna, mo piere ee töönynyö ki kaa warkey mana tøŋ mo käli ki yo Upath.
english: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

anywaa: Eni dëëre bëëdö ni paŋŋi, ni täärnyïme nëëni kaamar agaackøth, ni nyeŋŋe caala ameethi mo liel, ni bäädi moe ko otweege, paŋŋi kaamar jwïël mo othoodhø, ni ni luube, dwøre caala dïlweel mar jiy mo thööth.
english: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Daniel, bee a keera na joot gïna nyooth, ni jiy moa nut buuta gïna nyooth kärge joodø; 'ba lwär mo dwøŋ aö bäätge, ni reŋge ni ge kana rege.
english: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana dööŋ a keera naa raŋŋa gïna nyooth manøgø ni thääŋ ec enø. Køøre aput tïmö ni bäŋ teek mo odööŋ dëëra, ni ö täärnyïma ni wiil ree kaamar nyïm dhaanhø mo othøw, ni bëëda ni bäŋ teek dëëra.
english: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

anywaa: 'Ba aani dwør dhaanhø manøgø awïnynya, 'ba kanya wïnynya dwøre ennø mana caane, aani nyeŋŋa aput gämmö døc ni täärnyïma yaa këël piny yïth ŋøøm.
english: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

anywaa: Kanyøgø cenø aana put gut ni cïp aani bäät cøŋŋa, ni ceŋŋa yaa këël piny  ni dëëra miel.
english: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïra, ni «Wui Daniel, ï na näk dhaanhø mo owøørø døc, kwany tier luubö man døøc mano caana jïrï, ni cuŋŋï niï tiir, kiper ennø aani, a jääŋŋa baŋï.» 'Ba kanya nø caan luummögø jïra, aana put ö maal ni dëëra miel.
english: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïra, ni «Daniel, kärï lwäyö, kiper ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa dïkwøŋ na këëllï cwïnyï køør man ŋäyï tier gïna nyooth, ki mana dwøgï dëërï piny nyïm Jwøk marï, luup moï awïnynyi, ni beeye ni ööa ennø kiperge.
english: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal man wø koor buc nyec mar Parca, dëëre athïïŋe dëëra ki nïne ma pïërariiø ka aciel. Køøre Mikaël, eni na kwäärö aciel dï kwääc nyïïatwiet maal, aö kuna køny aani, kiper aano maa piny kaace buut nyeny Parca.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a ööi kaper nee gïno tägi dëët jiyï yïth nïro en nyïm nee tiere tïme ni ŋäyï, kiper gïna nyooth cäänö kaper nïne mo poot ena nyïm.»
english: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni cäänna aani ki luupögø, wïïa aputa kuul piny ni dhaa kära jaalø.
english: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

anywaa: Køøre ŋat mo nëëni kaamar dhaanhø dhaa agude, ni puta dhaa jap ni cäänna ni kööa jïre, eni na cuŋŋö nyïma, ni «Wui kwääya, ki køør gïna nyooth manøgø, lwär mo dwøŋ aö bääta, ni bäŋe teek mo odööŋ dëëra.
english: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

anywaa: ?A na laŋŋï en, lønye jïra nidïï ki man cääna ki teeŋ ïïni, ï na kwääya en? Kiper aani bäŋ teek mo odööŋ dëëra ennø, ni jwïëy mara teek.»
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋatøgø ni caal dhaanhø enø, aana cäŋ gutö, ni mooc aani ki teek.
english: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Wui dhaanhø, ï na näk owøørø døc, kärï lwäyö. Bëëdï ni dëërï jööt. Bëëdï niï teek, ni cwïnyï da cer.» 'Ba kanya nø cään aani ennø, aana put jïtö ki teek, ni kööa, ni «Kwääya, beerra man caanï gïna diï caanø, kiper ïïni, dëëra amooyï ki teek.»
english: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö, ni «?Gïna ööa baŋï kipere ŋäyï? 'Ba ennø, a døøa kuna këëda ki nyïïatwiel maal man wø koor Parca; 'ba kanyo cøøa, nyïïatwiel maal man wø koor po jø Gïrïïk luunynya öö.
english: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk enø nø, aani gïna näk ogöörö yi Wëël Adïëri caana caanø jïrï. 'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo cwak aani ki geni, ni näk mo paa Mikaël, eni na nyïïatwiel maal man wø koor jø Icriel.
english: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya tïme na yi cwiir mana dïkwøŋ mana tïm Dariöc nyï Mëdön ni ena nyeya, aana cuŋŋö kara naa cwaga eni naa gëëŋa eni.
english: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, adïëri caana caanø jïrï. Ka adïëri møn, nyeye adäk møøk rege thïïŋge thïïŋö yi Parca. 'Ba ŋweerge mano caath køørge okwär døc ni kaala møga bëët. 'Ba kanyo joot teek mare ennø ki køør kwärö mare, yïth jiy di theŋø ki man këëtge ka akwöm nyec mar jø Gïrïïk.
english: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya mo teek, dëëre di thïïŋö ni käär piny ki teek mo dwøŋ, ni bëëde ni tïïya mano manynye jaak.
english: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo thïïŋ dëëre ennø, akwöm nyec mare di petø ni pääŋŋi na kwöre aŋween, no odïëdö ki but piny, ni ba ci jï jø okäl dëëre, ni jø oci teeki jïge, teek marge tïmö ni ba caal teek mana en jïre dïkwøŋ. Kiper akwöm nyec mare cööda wøk ni mëëgi jø møøk ni paa jø okäl dëëre.
english: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

anywaa: «'Ba nyeya mano en jï løø Tier-Piny tïmö ni teek. 'Ba dhaanhø aciel røk wïth jø leny moe, tïmö ni teek døc ni kaala eni, ni lwør akwöm nyec ni käär gø ki teek mo dwøŋ.
english: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na køør cwiiri møøk, nyeya mar jï løø Tier-Piny ki nyeya mar jï løø Wï-Piny dhøkge kuurge kuurö, ki køør mano ö nyeya mar jï løø Tier-Piny noo biel nyaare jï nyeya mar jï løø Wï-Piny ni marge tudö ki luum mëër. 'Ba nyaanøgø mëër mano tuut ki køøre ba thur kare, ni cwøre ki teek mare ba ruu. 'Ba nyaanøgø di nääö, ki cwøre, ki nyilaal mare, ki ŋato caam eni yïth nïne moøke.
english: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.

anywaa: «'Ba dhaanhø aciel røk tuuŋ nyaanøgø dëëre di thïïŋö na nyeya mar jï løø Tier-Piny ni tuk lwaa leny mo nyeny Wï-Piny ni døny kar gwøk røk mar gø. Eni këëdö ki geni ni bööde.
english: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

anywaa: Eni thuwø juu moge mo tïïc ka nywïëny na kït gïï wø lam, ki jap paac mo perge leth mo tïïc ka gwel-bïrö ki warkey twiere twierø ni kïth geni Ijep. Køøre eni bëëdö ki cwiiri ni nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny ba tuue.
english: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.

anywaa: Køøre cään, nyeya mar jï løø Wï-Piny cøø ni tuk po nyec mar nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny; 'ba eni di dwøgø ki teek ni døø paac mare.
english: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

anywaa: «Køøre wääte dëëtge jiiŋge jiiŋŋø kiper leny, ni cooŋge wïth lwaa lenye mo thööth, ni ö dhaanhe acielli dïge ni baap geni kaamar jwïëö ni pöödhe ki leny këël mano pïïe kar gwøk røk mar ŋatøce.
english: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeny jï løø Tier- Piny cwïnye jïtö ki wëër mo dwøŋ, ni cøøe ni këëde ki nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny, ŋato cooŋ lwaa leny mo dwøŋ. 'Ba lwaa leny manøgø poot cïba cer ŋata këëtge ki gø.
english: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö lwaa leny manøgø noo maai ki tøŋ, nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny cwïnye jïtö ka atöör mo ena maal døc, ni 'näk jiy ma kume. 'Ba eni ba böödö.
english: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.

anywaa: Kiper nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny cäŋa määnyö ki lwaa leny mør mo pälla eni ki mana dïkwøŋ. 'Ba kanyo tïme na køør cwiiri møøk, eni öö ki lwaa leny mo päl, mo dëëtge päŋ ki jap leny.
english: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na kar kaace, jiy mo thööth dëëtge othïïŋge dëër nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny, ni ö jiyi moa wïnni dëët jø pou ni thïïŋge rege, ni ge wëëga lääk thur karge. 'Ba marge ba thur kare.
english: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny öö ni thør dëër kiir ki ŋääe ni thøra gø maal, ni mak kiir mo ogeerø ni teek. 'Ba lwaa leny mar jï løø Tier-Piny ba cuŋŋi, këël lwaa leny mana no ojierø. Kiper tïmö ni bäŋ teek jïge ki man cuŋge.
english: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato tuk paac tïmö ni tïïya mano met yie ki gø, ni bäŋ ŋat mo løny jïre ki man cuŋŋe ki gø. Eni tiere këëlle piny yi ŋööm wø cwøl ni Mïërö, ni cere da teek man raany paac ki gø.
english: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

anywaa: Køøre eni nyïme løøe baŋ man ööe ki lwaa leny mar akwöm nyec mare bäre, ni kuurge dhøkge ki nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny. Ni bëët baŋ gø ki nyey, kiper nee akwöm nyec mar gø jale. 'Ba acaara mana näk ee cïp piny ba thur kare, ni eni ba kønye.
english: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.

anywaa: Køøre eni nyïme løøe baŋ jø wø bëëdö bäät näm, ni mak jiy mo thööth. 'Ba kwääc lwaa leny, apääda mar gø raanynye raanynyø, ni dwøk apääda manøgø wï gø.
english: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.

anywaa: Køør manøgø, nyïme løøe baŋ kiiri mo poge moa no ogeerø ni teek. 'Ba eni di böötö, ni ba joot këët.
english: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

anywaa: «'Ba da ŋat mo dëëre di thïïŋö kare, ni jääk wøk ki jiy baŋ ajwäk, nee kwärö mar akwöm nyec mare meede. 'Ba ki køør nïne mo nøk eni di nääö, ni paa nyïm jiy wala ri leny.
english: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

anywaa: «'Ba da dhaanhø mo ojarø mo dëëre di thïïŋö kar gø, na ŋat mo eni tøør ri tuuŋ nyec. Eni öö kany mo kär caarø ni mak nyec ki dhøk mo pøøth.
english: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaa leny mo piny ee baabø ni gwaar ge nyïme kaamar jwïëö, ni raany geni, këël Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ mar Jwøk.
english: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø tude ki jiy, jøøgø cøøge cøøgø, ni thïïŋ dëëre, ni jïte ki teek këël na bëëde ni jiy moa en dëëre nøk.
english: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

anywaa: Kanyo tïme ni mïëri moa no okwär ge bëëdö ka bëët-mëër, cøø ni tuk geni, ni tïïc gïn mo kär kwøŋ wëëkge tïïc wala kwäye. Ni ö jammi moa twier ki moa peec ni pääŋ ge yïthakic jiy moa en dëëre. Ni ö eni ni cïp piny ka acaara ki man raany kiiri moa no ogeerø ni teek; 'ba beeta kany mo thiinh keere.
english: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

anywaa: «'Ba eni cwïnye di mooø ki cer, ni cøm cwïnye, ni cøøe ki lwaa leny mo päl ki man këëde ki nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny.  'Ba nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny tøŋ di tïŋö ki lwaa leny mo päl mo teek døc. 'Ba eni ba løny ki man cuŋŋe, kiper acaay aranya onø cïp piny kipere.
english: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø cämö buute ki came na met, eno raanyge, ni ö lwaa leny mare ni riemi, ni ö mo thööth ni nääi.
english: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeye moø na ariiø yøø, cwïnyge oløøge baŋ gïn mo raac, ni pïge piny kar acooŋa, ni ö ŋati man nø ni cään watge ki tööt. 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo thur kare. Kiper aŋuunne poot öö kanya no owäŋŋö.
english: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

anywaa: Køøre nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny duua poge ni käädö ki jap kwärö mo thööth. 'Ba cwïnye bëëdö ni ee løø kuna raany lam mar jø Jwøk. Eni tïïö ki gïrpiny dëër lamøgø, ni ö eni ni døø poge.
english: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.

anywaa: «Kanyo tïme na kanya wäŋŋi, eni cäŋa cøø ni tuk paana en jï løø Tier- Piny, 'ba kar kaagø, gïno tägi, tïmö ni ba caal mana dïkwøŋ.
english: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

anywaa: Kiper baabuure mo jø Kitim këëdö ki eni, ni ö eni ni bwøk cwïnye. Køøre eni duuö ni cwïnye da wëër ki lam mar jø Jwøk, ni tïïe ki gïrpiny dëër gø, ni duue ni nyooth mëër jï jøøa wec lamøgø.
english: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

anywaa: «Ni ö lwaa leny mana en dëëre ni thïïŋge dëëtge dëër kar lam na näk ogeerø ni teek, ni mänge olämme mo wø cïp cooth. Køøre geni gïna näk ec raac ki gø døc na näk gïr ränynyö, cwöthge piny.
english: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jiy moa kwier lam mar jø Jwøk di cøøgø ki luup mo pøøth ki man käl geni løøe. 'Ba jiy moa ŋäc Jwøge ge bëëdö karge ni ge teek, ni dhäthge jïre.
english: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.

anywaa: «'Ba dïbwöthe moa wïthge leer, ge cïpö ki pwöc jï jiy mo thööth. 'Ba geni, ge di nääö ri leny, ni waaŋ møøk ki maac, ni mak møøk ki tøŋ, ni twier møøk ki kany mo bäär mëëth.
english: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo bëëtge ni ge thøwø, ge na jic Jwøk ge jïtö ki køny mo thiinh, ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni dwätge ki geni ki dhøk mo pøøth.
english: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møøk røk jøøa wïthge leer, ge päänhnhö møn ki thøø, kiper nee jiy døøc mo waany, ni tar, ni tøŋ, këël kanyo pïïe ya aŋuunne. Kiper aŋuunne poot öö kanya no owäŋŋö.
english: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.

anywaa: «'Ba nyeya tïmö ni tïïya gïno met yie ki gø jaak, ni tïŋ dëëre maal ni dwøŋŋa eni bäät juu bëët, ni cääne ki luup mo thäŋa ec dëër Jwø wïth juu. Eni bëëdö ni bëëtö mare othur kare, këël kanyo ö kar wëër mar Jwøk noo pääŋe, kiper gïna no onøŋøl, tägö møn.
english: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

anywaa: Eni gïr juu mo kwäye ba kïth ïthe, wala jwøa mëër määnni ki gø, ni gïr jwøk mør jaak ba kïth ïthe. 'Ba eni dëëre døøye mo dwøŋ bäätge bëët.
english: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

anywaa: Ni ki mana dee ge wøørø, eni tïmö ni wøøra jwø wø gëëŋ kwör gwøk røk, na jwøk mo kuc kwäye noo wøøre ki warkey, ki gwel-bïrö, ki nyeŋ kïte mo perge leth, ki muuce mo perge leth.
english: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni tuk kwör gwøk røk moa teek ki køør køny mar jwøk mo path, ni ö eni ni wøør jø wø jïëc mare, ni tïïc geni na kwääri bäät jiy mo thööth, ni pääŋ ŋøøm jïge na gïr mïn ec.
english: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na aŋuun nïne, nyeny jï løø Tier-Piny cwïny nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny di cwøbø. Køøre nyeny jï løø Wï-Piny jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi, ki jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi, ki baabuure mo thööth mo leny, di kälö kaamar atuunna, ni tuk mïëri, ni baap geni kaamar jwïëö.
english: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

anywaa: Ni ö eni thuwø ni tuk ŋööm wø cwøl ni Mïërö. Ni ö mïëri mo thööth ni päthge; 'ba Ëdöm, ki Möap, ki jøøa näk wïth jø Amön, ge di piemø dhi cere.
english: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

anywaa: 'Ba eni cere kïthe dëët mïëri møøk, ni ŋööm Ijep ba bøth.
english: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jïtö ki teek bäät jap kwärö mo warkey, ki mo gwel-bïrö, ki bäät jammi moa perge leth bëët mo Ijep, ni ö jø Libya ki jø Ithiöpia ni caathge køøre.
english: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

anywaa: 'Ba eni cwïnye otïmö ni pärö ki waac moo wïnyi ki jï løø kur tuulcäŋ, ki jï løø wï-piny, ni cøøe ki wëër mo dwøŋ ki man raany jiy mo thööth ni dïïra wïthge.
english: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

anywaa: Ni cwöth oduŋkaare mo nyec moe piny yïthakic naama dwøŋ ki Kïn Jwøk na mïërö na en kur keere. 'Ba eni poot thøw, ni bäŋ ŋat mo køny eni.
english: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na kar kaace, Mikaël, eni na nyïïatwiel maal mana dwøŋ ni wø koor jø pou ma jø Icriel, dëëre di thïïŋö. 'Ba kar kaace tïmö na kar jwør gïï mo leth, na gïï mo poot kär kwøŋ tägö cøøn ki mana täge ki kanya täk wï jur këël kar kaace. 'Ba kar kaace jø pou moo nyeŋge joot no ogöör piny yi wëëlö, ge di piemø.
english: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth moa no othøw no okoony piny yi ŋöömö, ge päy, ni møøk cøøa yi kwøw mana näk bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni møøk cøøa kar lään wïc ki kar ataa mo bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa wïthge leer ge rieny ni caala tar mar maal. Ni ö jø wø bwøth jiy mo thööth jöör bëënynyö ni rienyge kaamar ceer na bäre bäre.
english: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Daniel en, cïëk luup moa en yi wëëlö ni mwönï gø, këël kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne. Jiy mo thööth oreŋ kun ki kun ni ge meeta kwänynyö.»
english: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

anywaa: Køøre a na Daniel, aana räŋŋö, ni jooda jiy ariiø møøk ni ge cuŋŋö, na aciel cuŋŋa bäät naam jï løøi, ni maya cuŋŋa bäät naam løøga.
english: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

anywaa: Ni kö acielli jï dhaanhø mo oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna mo ena bäät pïï yi naam, na «?A këël yi wäne noo ö gïïa näk rëëma ec noo ŋuutge?»
english: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

anywaa: Køøre ŋata näk oruyö ka abïï ma lïïna na en bäät pïï yi naam, ceŋŋe karge riet athaaŋ maal. Ni wïnynya dwøre ni kööŋŋa ri Jwøa kwøw ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre, ni kööe, ni «Beeye cwiiri adäk ki thääŋö. 'Ba kanyo ö bäät jic Jwøk no nigelway, beeye kanyo ö gïïögø noo ŋuutge.»
english: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

anywaa: Køøre aani gïnögø awïnynya, 'ba tiere kär ci wïïa. Køøre aana pëëö, ni «?Kwääya, aŋuun gïïögø otïme nidïï?»
english: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?

anywaa: Ni løk gø, ni «Daniel, aayï ki jöörï. Kiper luup moøgø ocïëgö no omwönö këël kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne.
english: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth di tïïö ni tøŋ, ni tar, ni waany. 'Ba jø raay ge bëëdö ni ge tïïya raay, ni bäŋ ŋat raay mo tiet gïïögø cøøa wïïe; 'ba jøøa wïthge leer, tiet gïïögø cøøa wïthge.
english: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

anywaa: «'Ba ki mano täge ki kanyo män olämme yie mo wø cïp cooth, ki kanyo ö gïna näk ec raac ki gø døc na näk gïr ränynyö noo cwödhi piny, thöödhö ki nïne ma kuma ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïŋween.
english: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät jø wø kurö ni cwïnyge ege maaø noo pïï ri nïne ma kuma ki dïpe adäk ki pïëradäk ka abïïc.
english: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

anywaa: «'Ba ïïni, cäädhï ki jöörï këël aŋuunne. Køøre ï cøøa kar jwöm mar thøø. 'Ba noo tïme na aŋuun piny, ï tïŋa maal ni jootï kurï mano mëëk ïïni.»
english: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Odheea o Bëëri yïth nïra bëët Udhaya, ki Jötham, ki Eeyeth, ki Edhekaya ni gena nyeye mo Juuda, ni Jeröbäm o Jeyöac ena nyeya mar Icriel.
english: The word of the Lord that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Wuuö Jwøki na täge ki cäänö ki ri Odheea, ena köö jï gø, ni «Ciï ni määnynyï riï ki dhaagø ma kääbi ni jïtï ko obwöre mo nywøl ka køør bëët käp, kiper jiy atïmö ni ge bëëdö ka bëët käp mo raac døc yi ŋöömö man, ni wecge aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: The beginning of the word of the Lord by Hosea. And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, Odheea acøø ni nywøm Gömër nyi Dibalëm, ni ö Gömërri ni jït yie ki dhaanhø ki gø, ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Odheea, ni «Cak nyeŋŋe ni Jedhriel, kiper ki kany mo cään dhi øt Jiyu raanynya raanynyø kiper remø mana køny piny päänya cwøl ni Jedhriel, ni ööa ni tïïa buc nyec mar dhi øt Icriel nee cuŋŋe.
english: And the Lord said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, atheerø mar Icriel toora toorø yi goor Jedhriel.»
english: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.

anywaa: Køøre Gömër yie acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø ni lwaare ki gø na nyakøø. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Odheea, ni «Cak nyeŋŋe ni Lö-ruama, kiper aani bäŋ bäth ec mo nyoodha nyoodhø jï dhi øt Icriel këët, ni ge ba wëënna këët.
english: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo–ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, yia obäädha ki dhi øt Juuda, ni piema geni ki køør teek mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ni pïëm mara mano piema ge ki gø paa ka atheerø, wala ko opëëllö, wala leny, wala ko okwëënyi, wala ki jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi.»
english: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Gömërri na ŋøl Löruama ki caak, yie acäŋ jïtö ki dhaanhø mør ni lwaare ki gø na dïcwøø.
english: Now when she had weaned Lo–ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Cak nyeŋŋe ni Lö-ammi, kiper u paa jiya, naa paa Jwøk maru.»
english: Then said God, Call his name Lo–ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jø Icriel poot tïmö ni caala akwöny deŋ naama dwøŋ ni wø ba løny ki røm wala ki kwaan; ni købi ki geni, ni «Uuna wäät Jwøa kwøw;» yi paac mana wara købi jïge yie, no «U patha jiya.»
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Juuda ki nyïïkwaac Icriel rege odwalge na aciel, ni kwänyge dëëtge ki dïbwödhi aciel ma marge; ni putge ö maal ki yi ŋöömö mana path. 'Ba dïcäŋögø otïmö ni beeye cäŋ mo dwøŋ kiper pääny mana cwøl ni Jedhriel.
english: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

anywaa: «Cwøllu nyïïmëëgu moa näk cwøw, ni ‹Jic Jwøk,› ni cwøllu nyïïmëëgu moa näk mään, ni ‹Jøøa nyooth bäth ec jïge.›
english: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru–hamah.

anywaa: «Köömmu miiu, köömmu eni, kiper eni paa cïïa këët, naa patha cwøre këët thuwø. Beerra man wec gath-dëël mare man wø nëëni täärnyïme, ni daak bëët käp mare yïthakic thure.
english: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ba tïïe, eni wëëga wääth ki dëëre, ni put tïmö ni bëëdö ka dëëre ni caala dïcäŋa lwaarø ki gø. Eni tïïa tïïö ni caala paap mo otal, ni tïïa gø ni caala ŋöömö ma tëën, ni puta eni 'näk ki riew.
english: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

anywaa: 'Ba aani thuwø bäŋ bäth ec mo nyoodha jï obwöre moe, kiper geno obwöre mo gena nyïï kääbi.
english: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

anywaa: Kiper miige bëëdö ni gatha dëëre, ni eni jayi ka jöö mo määnö. Kiper ena köö, na ‹A cäädhö køør omëërri 'moa, ni wø cïp cam jïra, ki pïï, ka abïï ma cuup, ka abïï ma lïïna, ki maaw, ki gïn maadha.›
english: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper manøgønø, øt jööre cïëga cïëgö ki koodhi; ni geera deŋŋe ki kiir nee øt jööre ba joode këët.
english: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

anywaa: Eno rïïŋi køør omëërri moe ni ba mak ge; ni many omëërri moe ni ba joot ge. Køøre eno kööi, na ‹A døøa baŋ cwøra mana dïkwøŋ, kiper beerra bëëtö mara manece ki man ennø.›
english: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.

anywaa: Kiper kuue ki man näk mo bee aani ni wø mooc gø ki beel, ki køøŋø mo met, ki maaw, ni wø cïp gwet-bïrö ki warkey ni thööth jaak jïgø, jap wø kønyge dëëtge ki ge ki man jiiŋge jwøge man wø cwøl ni Baal.
english: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, beel 'moa wara warø baŋe ni 'käla ge kanyo ciekge, ni wara køøŋŋa na met ni 'käla gø dïcäŋo kee. Aani thuwø abïï cuup mara ka abïï lïïna mara, moa cïba jïre nee dëëre uume ki ge kiper wääth-dëël mare, wara warø baŋe ni 'käla ge.
english: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, lään wïc mare wëëga nëënne jï omëërri moe, ni bäŋ ŋat mo piema gø cera.
english: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.

anywaa: Aani thuwø ajwöm moe bëët mo wø wøøre ŋøla ŋølø, ni beege ajwöm moe mo wø wøøre ki yi cwiir, ki wödö mare man wø wøør päär mar dwääy ki gø, ki man wø wøør cääŋŋe mo jwöm, ka ajwöm moe møga bëët moa no ocïp piny nee wø wøør.
english: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

anywaa: Jer omøki moe ki jer olämmi moe raanynya raanynyø, jer wø cääne kiperge, ni ‹Moi beege jammi moa maa ceŋ omëërri 'moa na cïpge jïra.› 'Ba geno tïïa na paap, ni puti ya lääc paapi cam ni thöörge ge.
english: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

anywaa: 'Ba eno jääla kiper nïra beede ni lama jwø wø cwøl ni Baal, ni cïpö jïgø ko olämme; nïra beede ni wïïe owïl ki aani ni caatha køør omëërri moe, ni ïthe ee kïthö ki gwet-ïdhi, ni dëëre ee tïïö ni mïërö ki jap mïërö ma teeŋi. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, a cøøa kuna cäänna gø ki luup mo met, ni bwødha eni dïtëën ni cäänna gø ni met ec yaa nyoodhø jïre.
english: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø pwöth omøki moe odwøga jïre kaace, ni tïïa goor Akör na dhi øtø mar ŋäädhe. Eno wär ki duut ni caala mana bëëde ni ena nyakøø, ki kanya ö eni na ö wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep.
english: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca aano cwøle na ‹Acwørø›,  ni ba cwøl a këët ni ‹Kwääya›. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.

anywaa: Aani nyeŋ juuk wø cwøl ni Baal 'käla wøk dhee, nee nyeŋ juu moøge ba cøøri këët.
english: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca a tudö ki luubö ki lääc paap, ki weny mo maal, ki gïï wø muuli ki yïth ŋøøm. Aani, atheerø, ko opëëllö, ki leny, raanynya raanynyø yi ŋöömö, ni wëëga jiya niine jaak ni bäŋ gïn lääŋge.
english: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï miia miiø jïra na bäre bäre; ka adïëri møn, ï miia miiø jïra ki ra adïëri mara, ki ŋøl ma kare, ki køør mëër mara ni wø ba jøøl, ki bäth ec mara.
english: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

anywaa: Aani, ï miia miiø jïra ki ra adïëri, ni ö ïïni ni tïmï ni Wuuö Jwøk ŋäyï.
english: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋöca a na Wuuö Jwøk lam mar jiya ma jø Icriel oløøa. Maal otïïa nee køth jääŋŋe piny,
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

anywaa: ni ö pinynyi ni wëëk caammi tuuö, ni känne ki nyïëdi yi goor Jedhriel; ni beege beel ki kwøŋ ki mädhi.
english: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

anywaa: Jiya ma jø Icriel tietge okëëlla piny ni teek yi ŋöömö. Bäth ec mara onyoodha jï jøøa näk bäth ec kär nyoodhø jïge, ni kööa jï jøøa näk patha jiya, ni ‹Uuna jiy 'moa!› Ni köge jïra, ni ‹Ïïna Jwøk marwa!› »
english: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Ciï ni cäŋï mëër marï nyoothø jï cïïï, këël na bëëde ni mëër ki cwøw møøk ni bëënna käp. Beerra man mëërï ki gø, kaawat mana tïïc Wuuö Jwøki ni bëëde ni mëër ki jø Icriel, këël na bëëtge ni ge lämö ki juu møøk, ni ge mëër ko omøki moa no omiiø na dhøgi na näk ocïbö no olämme.»
english: Then said the Lord unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the Lord toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyaanøgø aputa wïïl wøk ki gwet-bïrö ma apaar kurbïïc mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni cekel, ki beel mo wø cwøl ni gäbci mo røm ka rumi man wø cwøl ni kömer mo yie aciel ki thääŋö.
english: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

anywaa: Køøre ena cäänna ni kööa, ni «Bëëdï ki aani nø ki nïne mo thööth, ni ba gathï dëërï, ni ba ciï baŋ dïcwøø mør këët ki man butï ki gø, ni ba butï ki aani thuwø.»
english: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel geno bëëdö ki kany mo bäär ni bäŋ nyeya ki kwäärö, wala olämme, wala kïte moa no ocwöth piny na gïï lam, wala ëëput mana näk gïr lam, wala juu møøk mo di lamø.
english: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na køør gïïögø, jø Icriel geno duui ni manyge Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ni manyge nyeya marge ma nyikwaar Deebit. Geno duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk ni dëëtge kwanynyi ki lwär kiper gwïëth mare mano en ya aŋuun nïne.
english: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall fear the Lord and his goodness in the latter days.
