anywaa: Wui jø Icriel, cegu ïthu ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jïre da løøk ki uuni, u ni bëëdö yi ŋöömö man en, ni luummaca bee en, ena köö, na «Atïmö ni bäŋ jø ŋäädhe, ni bäŋ mëër, ni bäŋ acaara ki man ŋäc Jwøk yi ŋöömö man.
english: Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö ni nuta acëënne, ki bëët tööt, ki 'näk jiy, ki bëët käw, ki bëët lugi. Jiy atïmö ni ge tïïya okiera, ni bëët remø ni øya piny cooth bäät rem møga.
english: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋöömö atal ni kïmme, ni ö jiyi moa bëëdö yie bëët ni öölge, ni rwöbe ka lääc paap ki wec maal bëët, ni ö reci moa en yi naama dwøŋ ni putge rwäänyö.
english: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

anywaa: «'Ba kär dee dhaanhø mo kïth bäät watge ki luubö, ni bäŋe ŋat mo jääl watge, kiper jø pou caala jiy mo wø pïëmö ki dïlämme.
english: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

anywaa: U bëëdö nou cwanynya tietu ki dïcäŋ ki wäär, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki ni cwanyge tietge ki uuni ciel. Kiper manøgønø, Icriel na caal miiu, raanynya raanynyø.
english: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

anywaa: Jiya araanynyi ki køør bäŋ kwänynyö. 'Ba kiper mana kweerru ki kwänynyö, u na dïlämme, aani thuwø, u kwiera kwierø ki man tïmu ni uuna dïlämme 'moa. Kiper mana wïl wïthu ki ciik 'moa, a na Jwøk maru, aani thuwø wïïa wïl ki nyïïkwaayu.
english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya nyaac dïlämme beeye kanya kaathge tïï raay dëëra. Aani, ajiem marge wiila wiilø na lään wïc.
english: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.

anywaa: Geni, ge bëëdö ni ge cama rïŋ mo lääy mo wø cïp no olämme mo raay mo jiya, ni yïthge met ki man bëët jiyi ni ge tïïö ki raay.
english: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tägi bee en: Dïlämme jääla jäälö na aciel ki jiy kiper uutjïëthe moge, ni cunna geni ki køør tïïe moge.
english: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

anywaa: Geno cämö, 'ba ge ba jäŋ; geno bëëdö ki bëët käp, 'ba ge ba nyaay, kiper wïthge awïl ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord.

anywaa: «Tiet luup atïmö ni ba kwanyge kiper käp, ki maath kwøk nyïïomøki moa no oruu ki moa nyärö.
english: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

anywaa: Jiy atïmö ni pëënynya dhi jaath mana no otieŋø na kït gïn wø lam, ni ö athøra ni løk pïëc marge. Gena tïïc jwïëc käpi nee gaage wøk, ni putge bëëtö ni ge tïïya tïï käp, ni tïm karge ni bäär ki Jwøk marge.
english: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

anywaa: Geni, olämme moge wø cïpge cïbö wïth kïte, ni waaŋge olämme moge mo wø waaŋ bäre bäät thuuri ki tiet jenni moa no onigïït piny, kiper yïthge met ki tïïp moge. Kiper manøgønø, nyïïu ge bëëdö ki bëët käp, ni ö määr nyïïu ni bëëtge ni ge tïïya tïï luk.
english: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

anywaa: Aani, nyïïu ba jääla kanyo bëëtge ki bëët käp, ni määr nyïïu ba jääla kanyo bëëtge ni ge tïïya tïï luk, kiper cwøw ki dëëtge kiree ge cäädhi na aciel ki kääpe, ni ge cïpö ko olämme ki kääpe mo wø bëëdö ni ge tïïya tïï käp kwör lam. Kiper manøgønø, jiy mo tiet luup ba kwanyge, ge ränynyö.
english: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na Icriel, këël na bëëdï niï tïïya tïï käp, Juuda kär näk cäŋa bääyö. Ni ba cou Gëlgela,  wala maru ci maal Bëëth-Awëën, nou kööŋ, ni ‹Ŋëët Jwøa kwøw!›
english: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth–aven, nor swear, The Lord liveth.

anywaa: Jø Icriel wïnni kaamar nyirøøa mo wïnni. ?Aŋø, ennø, løny jï Wuuö Jwøk ki man kïth geni kar kwaath kaamar nyidiel mo ena yi pwöl kwaath mo yie laac?
english: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

anywaa: Ipariem dëëre anø cïbe ki man lam kït gïï wø lam; wiiu eni kare!
english: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

anywaa: Këël kany wø bëëtge ni meerø oniwaany wïthge, ge poot bëëdö ni ge tïïö ki tïï käp jaak; ni dïbwöthe moge bëëdö ni mëër ki jïëth lään wïc marge.
english: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.

anywaa: 'Ba apwøyaweerø öö ni jwiec geni na bäre, ni ö olämme moge ni tïme ni duua lään wïc jïge.»
english: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «U na dïlämme, wïnynyu gïn! U na jø Icriel, cegu ïthu! U na jø paan dwøŋ, cegu ïthu! Ajäla man bee maru, kiper u caala abëëbe bäät jø Micpa, ni bëëdu kaamar ajääpi mo opeerø bäät Kïn Tabör.
english: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

anywaa: Ni jøøa reyø tïï 'näk ege kaadhø, 'ba geni bëët, ge jääla jäälö.
english: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

anywaa: Aani bëët Ipariem ŋääa bäre, ni jø Icriel rege ba løny ki man kange gø ki aani; ennø, u na jø Ipariem, røgu anø løøu køør käp, ni ö Icrielli ni raany dëëre.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.

anywaa: Gena män tïïe moge na reyø ki man duuge baŋ Jwøk marge. 'Ba kiper mana näk yïth cwïnyge päŋ ki jwïëc käp, gena put tïmö ni bäŋ kwänynyö man ŋäcge Wuuö Jwøk ki gø.
english: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba atöör mar jø Icriel adøø rege; jø Icriel ki jø Ipariem ge pädhö yïth raay moge, ni ö jø Juuda thuwø ni putge pädhö ki geni ciel.
english: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ge doo aay ni ge käädö ki dïëk ki dhäk, ni ge manynya Wuuö Jwøk, eni ba jootge, kiper ree ee nø paany dïge.
english: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.

anywaa: Gena tïmö ni ge tïïö ki riek waŋ dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge nyöödö ko obwöre ma nyïïkwaalle. 'Ba geni ki pwöth moge geno ränynyi ki køør wödö man wø wøørge päär mar dwääy ki gø.
english: They have dealt treacherously against the Lord: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

anywaa: «Koothu tuuŋ bäät jø Giba, ni koothu tuuŋ bäät jø Reema! Köögu nee wïny jø Bëëth-Awëën! Wui, jø tuuŋ Benjamen, tïŋŋu leny!
english: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth–aven, after thee, O Benjamin.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na dïcäŋ ajäla, Ipariem ränynyö. Aani, a caana gïn ma adïëri yïthakic wïth tuŋi mo Icriel.
english: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe mo Juuda atïmö kaamar jiy mo kïn keew ege daaø; 'ba wëër mara kønynya bäätge kaamar man wø pänh jwïïö.
english: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

anywaa: Jø Ipariem adwøk piny ni ränyge ki køør ajäla, kiper mana bëëtge ni ge lama gïï mo oballe jaak.
english: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

anywaa: Aana tïmö kaamar alweela ki baŋ jø Ipariem, ni tïma kaamar atwøda mo odheeth dëët jø Juuda.
english: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Ipariemmi ki jø Juuda na jootge gø ni gïï mo leth opïï dëëtge, jø Ipariem nyïmge aløøge baŋ Aciria, ni jääkge baŋe, eni na nyeya mana dwøŋ kiper nee jïtge ki køny. 'Ba ba løny jï nyeny Aciria ki man køny ge ki gïïa leth na en bäätge.
english: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

anywaa: Kiper aani, a tïmö kaamar cïgïï ŋuu ki jï jø Ipariem, ni tïma thuwø kaamar ŋuu mo teek ki jï jø Juuda. Geni, ge peta petø ni thenh thenh ni puta aay; ge käla kälö ni bäŋ ŋat piem ge cera.
english: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.

anywaa: Køøre a aay ni døøa kar bëëtö mara, këël kanyo ŋäcge gïïa reyø na tïïcge, ni duuge ni manyge täärnyïma. Kanyo enge yïth gïï mo leth, aano manyge døc.
english: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

anywaa: «Ööu, nøø døø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, kiper eni, øøna tøye møn na thäŋi, 'ba ø cäŋe ka kønynyø. Eni, dëëtø amooe møn ki ŋwiili, 'ba ŋwiili 'moø cäŋe ka bäyö.
english: Come, and let us return unto the Lord: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

anywaa: Eni dëëtø odwøk kare køør nïne ariiø, ni tïŋ ø maal ri dää nïne, nee ø bëëdø ni ø kwøw nyïme.
english: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ŋääø Wuuö Jwøk; beerra man reedhø ri man ŋääø eni. Öö mare caala man wø kwäär øwi, ni ö baŋø kaamar køth, ni caala køth mar dhi køth ni wø jwøc piny.»
english: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the Lord: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «?Wui, jø tuuŋ Ipariem, agïnaŋø noo tïïa ki uuni nø? Wui, jø tuuŋ Juuda, agïnaŋø noo tïïa ki uuni nø? Kiper mëër maru caala pøøl mo amöölla, ni caala thööy ni wø laar rwäänyö.
english: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, uuna nø ŋøra na thäŋi ki køør ajäla mana caana ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni nø nääa uuni ki luubö mana cur dhaa; ni ö ajäla mara ni put nidaaŋ bäätu kaamar agaackøth.
english: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.

anywaa: Kiper aani, yia wø met ki mëër mo ba jøøl ni kaala olämi man wø cïp, ni yia wø met ki man ŋäc aani, ni kaala olämi man wø waaŋ bäre.
english: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

anywaa: «'Ba kaawat mana tïïc kanya cwøl na Adam, geni luumma tuuda ki kwäcge akwierge, ni ge bëëdö ni nyeŋge ege døøc mo reegø ki aani, a na Jwøk.
english: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

anywaa: Gelät bee pääny mar jø wø tïïö ki gïï mo reyø, ni dïëre ogääbö ki kwör tiel mo ree dhäämmö ki rem.
english: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø møør dïtwïëte piny ni ge kurö ki dhaanhø, lwaa dïlämme atïmö na dïnäk jiy øtjöör Cekam; ka adïëri møn, gena tïïö ki gïï mo reyø døc.
english: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

anywaa: Aani, gïn mo raac døc mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø ajooda dï jø Icriel. Jø Ipariem gena tïmö ni ge tïïya käp kaace, ni ö jø Icrielli ni putge nipäät.
english: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Juuda thuwø, da dïcäŋ mo mar ajäla mo yaa cïp piny kiperu. Køør manøgønø, aano ööi ni dwøga gum dëël mar jiya kare.
english: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø manynya gø nee jø Icriel kønya, ni beege jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ki pääny marge ma Cameria, raay moge ki tïïe moge moa reyø puta nëënne.  Kiper ge bëëdö ka bëët tööt, ni kuuwe uudi tøcge tøyø, ni dïtwïëte bëëdö nyeŋ jïëthe ni ge twëëdö.
english: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.

anywaa: 'Ba ba caarge ki cwïnyge ki man näk mo japa reyø na tïïcge bëët wïïa para parø ki ge. Ge bëëdö ni geno ciel raayi moge dïër; ni raay moge ena nyïma naa raŋŋa geni.
english: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

anywaa: Yi nyeya tïïcge tïïö ni met ki japa reyø moge, ni tïïcge yïth kwääri ni met ki tööt marge.
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

anywaa: 'Ba gena jø luuy ge bëët, mo cwïnyge lïëth kaamar buur maa dääpe man wø äp ŋat wø budö, ni wø wec ni wärri jaak këël kanyo kïth dääpe yie.
english: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na cäŋ ajwöma mar nyeya marø, kwääri gena meer ki køøŋø døc ni bøølge, ni ö eni ni makge ceŋge na aciel ki jø abuua.
english: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

anywaa: Kiper cwïnyge lëënhnhö kaamar këënnö, kany wø manyge tïïö ki gïn mo raac; gootø marge bëëdö ni duuŋ ki wäär bäre, 'ba noo tïme na amöölla puta liel kaamar maac.
english: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.

anywaa: Ge bëët, ge bëëdö ni cwïnyge lïëth kaamar këënnö; dïbwöthe moge athöörge ki 'näk, ni ö nyeye moge bëët ni bëëtge ni geno päänhnhö no othøw. Bäŋgø dëëtge mo ocwøl aani.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

anywaa: «Jø tuuŋ Ipariem dëëtge ajääpge ki wïth juurre, ni putge tïmö kaamar møø mo deel ka løøk aciel ni kär løø.
english: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

anywaa: Teek marge alwør jøøa pathi ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge, këël mana tuc wïthge ki lwaar ni poot kucge.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët jø Icrielli na atöör marge okännö ka ajäla bäätge, ge kär jïëy ki man duuge baŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge; naa kärge manynyø, këël na täk japøge bëët.
english: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the Lord their God, nor seek him for all this.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ipariem gena tïmö kaamar akuuru ma acaara mare thiinh, mo ba cädö na wøp. Geni jø Ijep cwølge cwølø ennø, ni ge cäŋa døø baŋ jø Aciria.
english: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo aacge yie man, ajääp mara peera peerø bäätge, ni tuuda ge piny kaamar wec maal; ge jääla jäälö ki køør japa reyø na tïïcge.
english: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jïge, kiper mana paanyge rege buuta! Ränynyö oen bäätge kiper mana gëëmge ki aani! Gena manynya ki man piema geni, 'ba gena tïmö ni ge cara tööt kipera.
english: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

anywaa: Ge ba jwöŋi dëëra ki jwøk mo käla yïth cwïnyge kany wø gööge ko oduuru kwör niine moge. Kany wø lämge kiper caammi ki kwøk nyïïomøki, dëëtge ŋarge ŋarø, ni wecge aani.
english: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

anywaa: 'Ba bee aani na pwöny geni, na mooc geni ki teek bäädi, 'ba ge poot tudö ki luup mo reyø kipera.
english: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

anywaa: Gena kweer ki man duuge baŋa, a na Jwøa dwøŋ, ni tïm bëëtö marge no okööm kaamar atheerø mo ree täpö. 'Ba dïbwöthe moge geno 'näk ko opëëllö,  kiper cäänö marge man wø cäänge ni ge koorrø. 'Ba gïnögø oput duunnö ka abuua bäätge dï ŋööm Ijep.»
english: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jek riï ki man koothï tuuŋ! Nyimän aöö kaamar coor nee tïïe ki gïn mo raac dëër ŋöömö mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kiper jø Icriel, luumma tuuda ki kwäcge akwierge, ni gëëmge ki ciik 'moa.
english: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

anywaa: Jø Icriel ge wø jwöŋö dëëra ni köge, ‹Wui, ï na Jwøwa, ï ŋäcwa!›
english: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel, gena kweer ki gïna beer; 'ba køørge oŋwiec nyïïmänni.
english: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

anywaa: Gena röönyö ki nyeye naa kärge pëënynyö, ni röönyge ki kwääri ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääa kipere. Gena tïïö ki kït gïï wø lam kiper dëëtge, ni tïïcge ka gwet-bïrö ki warkie moge, 'ba geno put ränynyö ki køør japøgø.
english: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

anywaa: Wui, jø Cameria, kït gïn wø lam na näk otieŋø na nyirøøa yaa kwierø. Wëër mara liel bäät jiy kaamar maac. ?Aŋø, a këël yi wäne nø noo bëët jiyi ni dëëtge ba tïïcge ni waany?
english: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

anywaa: Kiper japøgø tïïya jø Icrielli! Ni kït gïno no otïïö kaamar nyirøøa enø patha Jwøk; ena gïn mo tieŋa dhaanhe ma rëëmmö jaak. Ka adïëri møn, eni di tøyø ni put petø na thäŋi.
english: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

anywaa: Jø Icriel apïïdhö ni tïme kede ge piitha jamø, ni ö gïïa kacge ni tïme kede apwøyaweerø. Beel moa näk cuŋŋö yi pwödhö atïmö na adibøøye, ni bäŋe nyeŋ mo ege joodø. 'Ba këël møøk doo jïtö, jiy mo path puta öö ni thöörge gø.
english: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

anywaa: «Ennø, jø Icriel anø cam, ni ge ena dï wïth juurre møøk, ni tïmge kaamar gïrpiny mo bäŋ gïn kønye këët.
english: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

anywaa: Kiper gena nø ci baŋ jø Aciria ni caala arëën mar paap mo thääyö keere jaak; ni ö jø Ipariem ni nø gathge mëër marge wøk.
english: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëtge ni dëëtge ege gath wøk dï wïth juurre, aani, ge cäŋa ka cooŋ kanya ciel, ni ö geni ni putge gïï mo leth jwør cer nyeya mana teek.
english: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

anywaa: «'Ba këël na ö jø Ipariemmi na tïïcge gïï wø cïp olämme bääte mo wëën raay ni thööth, gïïögø atïmö na jap meetge bääyö marge ki ge.
english: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

anywaa: Këël na gööra ciik mo pwöc 'moa mo thööth kiperge, ciik moøgø aneenge kede luup mo path mo bäŋ tietge.
english: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

anywaa: Geni, gena cïpö ko olämme jïra ni camge rïŋ moge, 'ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, yia kär mïnnö ko olämme moøgø. Ennø, a tïmö naa lääŋŋa gïïa bacge, ni puta ge jääl kiper raay moge. Geni, ge døøa Ijep.
english: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the Lord accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

anywaa: Kiper jø Icriel wïthge awïl ki aani na cwääc geni, ni tïme ni ge geeya mïëri mo døøŋŋø,  ni ö jø Juuda ni tïïge ki päänye mo teek mo thööth. 'Ba aani maac ojääŋŋa bäät päänye moge, ni ö maaci ni put uudi moa no ogeerø ni teek thöör.»
english: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

anywaa: Wui jø Icriel, kär yïthu mïnnö; käru kanynyø kaamar wïth juurre møga. Kiper dëëtu agathu ki käp ni weyu Jwøk maru. Yïthu met ki jap käp mo wø magu yïth laare bëët.
english: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

anywaa: 'Ba kwör wø dïn beel yïthge ki kwör wø biic nyïïjenni yïthge, u ba jïti ki jäŋ yïthge këët. Kwøk omøki tïmö ni ba jootu caar.
english: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

anywaa: U ba bëëdö yi ŋööm Wuuö Jwøk këët; u døøa Ijep, u na jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni cämu ki caammi mo ba waany ya Aciria.
english: They shall not dwell in the Lord's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

anywaa: U ba kuny piny këët ki muuce mo kwøŋ jï Wuuö Jwøk; olämme mou yi Jwøk ba tïïe ni met. Caammi mo wø cïpu no olämme caala mo wø cïp bäät thøø; ni jiy bëët moo cam ge tïmö ni ba waany. 'Ba caammi mou otïïyu kiperu keeru, ni ba kïthu ge yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: They shall not offer wine offerings to the Lord, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the Lord.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo tïïyu yïth cääŋŋe moa no ocïp piny ni wø wøør jï Wuuö Jwøk?
english: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the Lord?

anywaa: Uuni, u këël doo päär wøk nou ŋwieya ränynyö, u mak jø Ijepi maa ni gwaarge uuni, ni ö jø Mempici ni putge uuni 'näk ni koonyge uuni. Japa perge leth moa näk tïïc ka gwel-bïrö, bäätge tuy ko oŋöön; ni ö yïth oduŋkaare mou ni tucge ki koodhi.
english: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

anywaa: Cäŋ ajäla oløny ni öö, cäŋo cool kwör yie dëët jiy kare acäännö; beerra man ŋäyu gïnögø, u na jø Icriel! U köö, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk man wïïe bäŋgø; ni ŋati ni dëëre da Jwïëc Jwøk en bøøl;» kiper raay mou atïmö ni thööth døc, ni ö männi maru ni kadhe.
english: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.

anywaa: Jwøk aana jääŋŋe na nyikuŋ Jwøk man koor uuni, u na jø tuuŋ Ipariem. 'Ba ennø, uutjïëthe 'moa bëët you cïŋŋö ka abëëbe kede man wø cek weny. Këël yi Øt Jwøk kiree, jiy atïmö ni män ki aani.
english: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.

anywaa: Uuna døny yïth raay døc, ni caala mana tïïc yi Giba; 'ba Jwøk wïïe opare ki rääö maru, ni jääl uuni kiper raay mou.
english: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Kanya kwøŋa jø Icriel joot, caala man wø joot nyïïomøki dïtëën; kanya jooda kwäcge, caala man wø joot nyo olaam mo okwøŋ ŋweelø. 'Ba kanya öge baŋ jwø wø cwøl ni Baal-Pëëgör, ni cïpge dëëtge køør gïn mo wïc laay ki gø, gena put tïmö ni ge määnö kaamar gïna mëërge ki gø.
english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal–peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

anywaa: 'Ba ge na jø tuuŋ Ipariem,  ajiem marge omääti kaamar wenyø. Ge ba nyöödö këët, ni bäŋ ŋat mo yie jïti ki dhaanhø këët, ni bäŋ jäc këët!
english: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

anywaa: 'Ba ge këël doo jïtö ko obwöre, ge poot nääa nääö, këël mano tïme ni bäŋgø mo dööŋ. 'Ba otïmö ni leth kiperge kanyo wiia geni!»
english: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ipariem ajooda ni ge bëëdö ni tietge okëët piny yi ŋöömö mo beer kaamar jø Tayar. 'Ba ennø, obwöre moge bwöthge wøk kuna nääi.
english: Ephraim, as I saw Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, agïnaŋø noo ŋølï bäätge? Tïïc geni ni jiy bwönna wøk yïthge, ni wëëgï thurge talø.
english: Give them, O Lord: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Tïï gïï mo reyø atäkge Gëlgela; ni puta männö ki geni kaace! 'Ba kiper rääö mar japa tïïcge, ge riema wøk yi ŋöömö mara, ni ba mëëya ki geni këët; kwääri moge bëët gena jø ageem.
english: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Ipariem ge caala jaath mo lweedi moe otal. Ge ba jïti këët ko obwöre. 'Ba ge këël doo jïtö ko obwöre, obwöre moge na perge leth jïge nääa nääö.»
english: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.

anywaa: 'Ba geni, ge kwier Jwøki mara kwierø, kiper gena kweer ki man cekge ïthge jï gø. 'Ba geno put bëëtö ni ge thääyö yïthakic wïth juurre.
english: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

anywaa: Jø Icriel atïmö kaamar jaath omøk mo oløth, ni jïte ki nyïëdi mo thööth. 'Ba kany wø tïm jammi moge ni thööth beeye kany wø tïïge ki gïï wø cïp olämme bäätge mo thööth; ni kany wø bëëny ŋöömö marge beeye kany wø cööthge piny ki kïte mo thööth mo wø lam.
english: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

anywaa: Cwïnyge bëëdö ni tïïya cwøk. 'Ba ennø, gïno duu raay moge jootge joodø. Wuuö Jwøk, gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge tøye tøyø, ni raany kïte moge moa näk ege cwöth piny na gïï lam.
english: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn geno köö, ni «Waani jïwa bäŋ nyeya, kiper Wuuö Jwøk kärwa lwäärö. 'Ba wa këël doo bëëdö ni jïwa da nyeya, ?agïnaŋø noo duu nyeya dëëtwa?»
english: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the Lord; what then should a king do to us?

anywaa: Geni, ge cäänö ki luup mo oballe jaak, ni tutge ki luup, ni kööŋge bäätge ki kööŋ mo bäŋ tiere; kiper manøgønø, bëët bäŋ adïëri marge wø tuula wøk kaamar luum mo ree da cïm mo tuy yi pwödhö mo opuurö.
english: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

anywaa: Jø Cameria lwäyö kiper gïno tägi dëër gïna no otïïö na nyirøøa mar Bëëth-Awëën. Ka adïëri møn, jiye kïmmö kipere, ni ö dïlämme mo kït gïï wø lam ni gööge ko oduuru bääte kiper mano lwør ajiem mare baŋge noo kïthi paac mør.
english: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

anywaa: Gïnögø ki dëëre jø Aciria aay ki gø ni käärge käärö na muuy jï nyenyge na dwøŋ. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni beege jø Icriel, ni putge nipäät, ni put wïthge lääö ki køør kït gïnögø ni wø lamge.
english: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

anywaa: Cameria ki nyeya mare ŋula wøk,  ni putge tïmö kaamar duul jaath mo thäärö bäät pïï.
english: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

anywaa: Kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri mo Awën, na näk bee kwör wø tïï jø Icrielli yïthge ki raay, di raanynyø. Koodhi ko otwel tuy yïthge ni uumge gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge. Køøre nø, ge köö jï kïte, ni «Rïëpu wa!» Ni köge jï thuuri, ni «Buŋŋu wa!»
english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jø Icriel, ki mana täge yi Giba, ge bëëdö ni ge temma raay, ni putge cääth nyïmge ki tïïc manøgø. ?Aŋø, bäŋ leny mo okëëlö ki jøøa tem raay yi Giba na bëëde?
english: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

anywaa: Kanyo manynya gø jaak, ge jääla jäälö; wïth juurre cooŋa cooŋø ki man tïïge ki gïn mo raac dëëtge, ni jääla ge kiper raay moge na thööth.
english: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

anywaa: Ipariem caala nyirøøa mo opwönynyö mo yie met ki dïn beel. 'Ba ŋute na mïërö okïtha ki gïr puur ni pura ki gø. Ni ö Juuda ni pure, ni Jeekap tøga pøl.
english: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

anywaa: Piithu bëënynyö kiper dëëtu, ni kayu nyïëdi mo mëër mana näk ba jøøl, ni cäŋu pwöth mou puurru na akamme, kiper beeye kare ennø ki man many Wuuö Jwøk, këël kanyo ööe noo tïïc bëënynyö nee pädhe bäätu kaamar køth.
english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the Lord, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna bëëdö nou piitha gïï mo reyø, ni kayu bäŋ ŋøl luup ma kare, ni cammu nyïëdi mo tööt. Kiper uuna bëëdö nou ŋäätha teek maru keeru, ki jø leny mou na thööth.
english: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, okiera mar leny tägö dëët jø pou, ni ö kwör leny mou moa teek ni raanynyi, kaawat mana ö Calmen na raany Bëëth-Arbel ri leny, kanya ö mëëe na nyadhi na aciel ko obwöre moge.
english: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

anywaa: Wui, ï na Bëthël, teeŋ gïnögø tägö dëërï, kiper raay moï atïmö ni thööth døc. Kanyo tïme na kur øw mar dïcäŋeca, nyeya mar Icriel wïïe puta dïdö na bäre bäre.
english: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.

anywaa: «Aani, kanya poot jø Icrielli na wï jur mo thiinh, a mëër ki geni, ni cwöla geni wøk ki Ijep ni caala wääda.
english: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cwøla ge naa manynya geni døc, aputge tïïc ni beeye man wecge aani døc. Geni, ge poot cïpö ko olämme jï juu mo wø cøøri ni Baal, ni ge wääŋö ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met jï kït gïï wø lam.
english: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye aani na pwöny geni ki wääth, ge na jø Ipariem, ni beege jø Icriel, ni maaŋŋa ge ki ceŋŋa naa thaaya geni; 'ba kucge ni bee aani na køny geni.
english: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

anywaa: Gena käära ni ge yaa twöö ki mëër; ni tïma jïge ni beeye ŋata käl tëëra peek wøk göökge,  tëër wø caal jaath man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ ri puur; ni caama geni ni dëëra yaa dwøk piny.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana kweerge ki man luuge nyïmge baŋa, ge døøa yi laŋ kaawat mana bëëtge yi ŋööm Ijep, ni tïmge ni ge ena tier nyeny Aciria.
english: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

anywaa: 'Ba leny nakwaar yïth päänye moge, ni ö dïdëëdi mo odhuule mo dhøk kiir marge ni nigenyaŋŋa piny, ni tïm aŋuun jammi bëët moa caarge ni bäŋgø.
english: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

anywaa: Gena reeth ri man løøge ŋäthge wøk ki aani, 'ba ge këël doo jwöŋö dëëra, a na Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ge ba kønya.
english: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.

anywaa: «?Wui jø tuuŋ Ipariem, olønye nidïï ki man cïba uuni ceŋ jø møøk? ?Wui u na jø Icriel, olønye nidïï ki man wiia uuni nou aayu? ?Aŋø, løny ki man raanynya uuni kaamar jø Adama ki jø Dheböym? Cwïnya akweer ki man tïïa gïnögø, ni ö bäth eci mara ni jääny wøk ki mëër.
english: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

anywaa: U ba jääla këët ki wëër mara ni wø liel kaamar maac. Wïthu ba dïïra këët, u na jø tuuŋ Ipariem. Kiper aana Jwøk, naa patha dhaanhø, ni bee aani na Jwøa en kur keere na en dïïu. A ba ö baŋu këët ki wëër.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno cäädhi køøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni mära kaamar ŋuu. 'Ba kanyo mära, jiya oput öö ni dëëtge kwanynyi ki kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

anywaa: Geno ööi ki Ijep kaamar weny, ni öge ki ya Aciria kaamar akuyi; ni ge ööi ni dëëtge kwanynyi. Køøre geno wëëga pïïn piny yïth mïëri moge. Luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Jø tuuŋ Ipariem deŋŋa acielge ki tööt, ni ö jø dhi øt Icrielli ni cielge deŋŋa ki cwøk. 'Ba jø tuuŋ Juuda thuwø wïthge poot känni ki man jïëcge aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni bee aani na Jwøa en kur keere na näk mare adïëri.»
english: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Ipariem ge ŋwieya køør jamø, ni ge rïïŋö cooth køør jam wø ööi ki kur tuul-cäŋ; ni tööt ki tïïc gïï mo reyø ege kaadhø. Ni geno tudö thuwø ki luubö ki jø Aciria, ni ge jwëëga Ijep ki mädhi mo wø cam.
english: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ena bäät man lööe ki jø Juuda, eni nyïïkwaac Jeekap di jäälö ki køør uutjïëthe moge, ni cool kwör dëëtge ki køør tïïe moge.
english: The Lord hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

anywaa: Geni kwarge ma Jeekap kanya en ec, opuny tier coki amaae; 'ba kanya nywøli na døøŋŋe, ena ŋäbö ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

anywaa: Ena ŋäbö ki nyïïatwiel maal ni bööt gø, ni kwac gø nee met ec nyooth jïre. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ajoode Bëthël, ni beeye kaace thuwø na cään Wuuö Jwøki yie ki øøni.
english: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth–el, and there he spake with us;

anywaa: ni beeye Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Even the Lord God of hosts; the Lord is his memorial.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, duu baŋ Jwøk maru; ni bëëdu nou tïïya mëër ki ŋøl luup na adïëri, nou koora Jwøk maru cooth.
english: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

anywaa: Ŋat gath man wø rumö ki gïr røm mo patha kare, yie met ki møt jiy.
english: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Ipariem ge töödö ni ge köö, ni «Waana jiy mo okwär; waana jïtö ki jammi kiper dëëtwa. 'Ba jammi bëët moa jootwa ki køør öölö marwa, bäŋ gïn mo nyoothge bäätwa ni waana jø raay.»
english: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, na käl uuni wøk ki Ijep; u tïïa tïïö nou cäŋu bëëtö yïth oduŋkaare, kaawat mana wara wøørru ajwöm mou.
english: And I that am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

anywaa: Aani nyïïkuk Jwøk acäänna, ni nyuunhnha geni ki luup mo thööth mo wø nyooth ki yi wïc, ni cääna ki rege ki luup mo keda leere.»
english: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba pääny Gelät yie da raay; ka adïëri møn, jiy moe atïmö ni bäŋ karge. Ki yi Gëlgela dhäk moa näk rwädhe di cïbö no olämme. 'Ba gïï wø cïp olämme moge bäätge otïmö kaamar kïte mo ocooŋ yi pwödhö.
english: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

anywaa: Kwarø ma Jeekap apäär wøk ni ci yi ŋööm jø Aram. 'Ba eni na Icriel nee nyöömme ki dhaagø, ena tïïc ni kwaaya dïëk na kar gwel moa dee køølø.
english: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa öö ki ree, ni beege jø Icriel, gena käl Wuuö Jwøki wøk ki Ijep ki ri nyikuŋ Jwøk. Gena gwøk Wuuö Jwøki ki ri nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: And by a prophet the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tuuŋ Ipariem, ni poot na jø Icriel, Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk atïïcge nee goote ki geni døc. Kiper manøgønø, kwör rem jiy moa kønyge piny odwøk Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki bäätge; ni ö ajøøŋ mana tïïcge ni dwøgi wïthge.
english: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wara cään jø dhi øt Ipariem, jiy dëëtge puta tïmö ni kwanynyi; ni ge bëëdö no owøørø dï Icriel. 'Ba gena bääyö ki køør mana lamge jwøa cwøl ni Baal, ni ö thøø bäätge.
english: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, jø dhi øt Ipariem raay atïmö ni meetge bäätge; geni, ge tïïö ki kït gïï wø lam kiper dëëtge, ni tïïcge ka gwel-bïrö, ni tïïya rëëmmö ki jöör riek waŋ. Ni ö luubö man ni caani kiperge na ennø nø, ni «Geni, ge jëëtö ki dhaanhø man cïp olämme, ni nuumge kït gïï wø lam moøgø na no otïïö ni caala nyïïrøøe.»
english: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ge caala rwöc mar amöölla, ni ge caala thööy ni wø laar rwäänyö, ni ge caala lethø ni wø laar jamø køøl kar dïn beel,  ni ge caala jïrö ni wø duny wøk ki dha awëërnyeŋ.
english: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

anywaa: «'Ba bee aani na Wuuö Jwøk, na bëëdö na Jwøk maru, ki mana täge ki mana enu yi ŋööm Ijep. 'Ba uuni, u doo bëëdö ni bäŋ Jwøk mør mo ŋäyu këët, ni näk mo paa aani keera, kiper bäŋ pïëmi mør këët, 'ba bee aani keera.
english: Yet I am the Lord thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.

anywaa: Aana bëëdö nou yaa gwøø kanya enu dï paap, yi ŋöömma no otal.
english: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

anywaa: Kanya caama uuni, uuna jäŋ. 'Ba kanya jäŋŋu, cwïnynyu ajïtö ka atöör; køøre nø wïthu aput wïlö ki aani.
english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aani, a tïmö kaamar ŋuu jïïu; ni tïma kaamar kwac mo omøør piny thääŋ jöö.
english: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

anywaa: Aani, a päära bäätu kaamar cwieny mo nyïïe okälö, ni puta u cöötö ki kööthu. U cama camø ni puta u thöör, kaawat man wø tïïc ŋuuwi ma maath, ni puta u cöötö kaawat man wø tïïc cwienynyi.
english: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

anywaa: «Wui, jø Icriel, man bee ränynyö maru, kiper uuna tïmö nou gëëmö ki aani, a na kunyi maru.
english: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.

anywaa: ?Age nyeya maru ennø, mo løny jïre ki man piem uuni? ?Age dïbwöthe mou moa en yïth päänye mou bëët, na cäänu ki geni ni kööu, ni ‹Wa röönynyi ki nyeya ki kwääri›?
english: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?

anywaa: Aana cïpö jïïu ki nyeya ni aano wëër, ni lwøra gø ki køør wëër mara.
english: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.

anywaa: «Gïïa reyø na bac dhi øt Ipariem anø göör piny, ni ö wëëlö mana gööri yie ni nø kani kar kän.
english: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.

anywaa: Rääm mo leth mo caala man wø lwaarø ki nyilaal atägö dëër Ipariem. 'Ba eni caala nyilaal mo wïïe ba leer. Kiper kanya pïïc kar lwaar mare man lwaarø ki gø, wïïe käre nyuuth wøk.
english: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, jø dhi øt Ipariem ge daa wïïla wøk cer teek thøø? ?Aŋø, ge daa käl wøk ki yi thøø? ?Wui, ï na thøø, age teek aranya marï? ?Wui, ï na thøø, age teek gïna leth ni wø tïïyï? Aani, cwïnya ba cïba piny këët.
english: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.

anywaa: «'Ba jø dhi øt Ipariem këël doo bëëdö ni jammi bëët päŋ jïge dï nyïïmëëkge, jamø man wø ööi ki kur tuul-cäŋ jääŋŋa jääŋŋö bäätge, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni kwönne ki dïtëën; ni ö jøør moge ni putge niŋul, ni ö aguule moge ni putge talø. Ni ö gïïa perge leth na en kwör kän moge ni puti twier bëët.
english: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the Lord shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

anywaa: Jø Cameria ajäla marge døøa wïthge, kiper gena gëëmö ki aani, a na Jwøk marge. Geni, ge di nääö ko opëëllö. Obwöre moge moa therø di gøyø ki røk kïte ni petge, ni ö määrge moa näk yïthge da jiy ni riet yïthge.»
english: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Icriel, duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, kiper uuna wëëk raayi mou pädhö.
english: O Israel, return unto the Lord thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.

anywaa: Duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni kööu jïre, ni «Wëën raay mowa bëët, ni jïëyï waani ki met ec marï, nee wa cïpwa ki pwøc no olämme.
english: Take with you words, and turn to the Lord: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

anywaa: Nyeny Aciria wa ba kønye, wa ba eth bäät okwëëc leny këët; ni jammi moa tïïcwa ki ceŋwa ba cwølwa këët ni ‹Jwøk marwa,› kiper beeye ïïni ni wø nyooth bäth ec marï jï kïïe.»
english: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Jiya 'duua baŋa, ni nyoodha mëër mara jïge ni yia met jaak, kiper wëër mara anø paanya bäätge.
english: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.

anywaa: A tïmö naa caala thööy ki jï jø Icriel, ni ö jø Icrielli ni løthge ni ŋøøkge kaamar apiitø, ni këët lweetge piny kaamar jer lur Libaanø.
english: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

anywaa: Ni ö bäädi moge moa therø ni løthge ki bäädi møøk, ni tïm mïërö marge ni caala jer wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ni ö ŋwäänyge ni tïme ni met kaamar jer lur Libaanø.
english: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo bëëdö tïpö marge, ge cäŋa løthø kaamar beel, ni tïmge kaamar jer omøki mo thiiw; ni ö wïny nyeŋ marge ni tïme kaamar kwøk nyïïomøki mo Libaanø.
english: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

anywaa: ?Wui jø Ipariem, agïnaŋø mør këët nø ni poot manynyu baŋ juuga reyø? Kiper beeye aani noo løk pïëc mou, noo gwøk uuni. Aani, a caala jaath mo bëëdö ni marr mo bøøge moe ba øc piny, ni bee aani noo jïtu ree ki nyïëdi.»
english: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.

anywaa: Ni näk da ŋat mo wïïe leer, beerra man kwany tiet jammi moi; ni näk da ŋat mo tiet luup ŋääe, beerra man ŋäc ge, kiper jïëthe mo Wuuö Jwøk thïïŋ, ni jø wø marge beer wø cäädhö ki yïthge, 'ba jø wø tïïc raay ge pädhö yïthge.
english: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the Lord are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Jool o Pethuël.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

anywaa: Wui, u ni jø døøŋŋø ii, wïnynyu gïn! Cegu ïthu u bëët, u ni wø bëëdö yi ŋöömmi en! ?Aŋø, teeŋ gïn mo caala man en akwøŋ tägö cøøn yïth nïne mou, wala yïth nïra beet kwäyu?
english: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

anywaa: Beerra man lammu gø jï obwöre mou, ni ö obwöre mou ni lamge gø jï obwöre moge, ni ö obwöre moge ni lamge gø jï beenhnhe moo ööi.
english: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

anywaa: 'Ni caammi 'moø moa bøth dhi bäänyö mana päl, acam bäänyö man wø ŋudö. Ni ö moa bøth dhi bäänyö man wø ŋudö, ni cami ya bäänyö man wø døø piny, ni ö moa bøth dhi bäänyö man wø døø piny, ni thööri bäänyö man wø räänyö.
english: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.

anywaa: U na jø meerø ii, päyu ni jwöŋu; gööu ko oduuru u bëët, u na dïmäth kwøŋ, kiper køøŋŋa ŋweeth aniŋul dhøgu.
english: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

anywaa: Kiper bäänyö aöö mo caala wï jur mo teek, mo kwäänge ba thum, mo lakge caala lak ŋuu, mo lwönne moge caala lwönne mo maath ŋuu, ni raanyge ŋöömö marø.
english: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.

anywaa: Jer omøki 'moø ko olämmi 'moø araanyge, ni pööge apøge wøk, ni leeŋge ge piny,  ni dööŋ bäädi moge ni tar.
english: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

anywaa: Uuni, jwöŋu kaamar nyakøø mo keeca ee røø dëëre, mo jwøga cwøre mo poot na muda.
english: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

anywaa: Muuce mo beel, ki muuce mo kwøŋ bäŋgø mo kïtha yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk këët, ni dïlämme ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk, ge bëëdö ni ge kïmmö.
english: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's ministers, mourn.

anywaa: Pwöth aränynyö, ni bëët ŋöömö ni jwöŋö. Beel aränynyö, ni ö jer omøki ni talge, ni ö jer wø nyïïge wel na maaw ni bäpge.
english: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

anywaa: Wui jø puur, wïthu lääge. Wui jø wø piith omøki, gööu ko oduuru, ni kïmmu kiper beel mou, ni beege cïndë ki gäbci, kiper caammi mo pwöth aränynyö.
english: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

anywaa: Omøki atal, ni ö olämmi ni bäpge. Adïkwäle, ki twöe, ki jenni møøk mo perge leth, ni beege jer pwöth bëët, atal. Ka adïëri møn, mïn ec mar jiy akääŋö.
english: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

anywaa: Wui, u na dïlämme, røøu keece dëëtu na abïïe, ni kïmmu; wui, u ni tïïc maru beeye cïp olämme bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, gööu ko oduuru; wui, u ni wø tïny Jwøk mara, ööu ni thöörru wäär bäre ni keece ena dëëtu; kiper muuce mo beel, ki muuce mo kwøŋ bäŋgø mo kïtha yi Øt Jwøk maru këët.
english: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.

anywaa: Uuni, gööyu piny ki cäŋ mo you cïp kur keere mo jiy ba cämö yie, ni cwötu ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere, ni cooŋŋu jø døøŋŋø yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ki jø wø bëëdö yi paac bëët, ni gööu ko oduuru dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the Lord your God, and cry unto the Lord,

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni raac kiper cäŋ mano ööi, kiper cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk kare acäännö. Cäŋögø öö na cäŋ aranya, ni käla baŋ Jwøa en teeki jïre.
english: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, cam kär raanynyø nyïmmø ni nëënö jïïø, ni ö met eci ki kanynyø ni tïmge ni bäŋgø yi Øt Jwøk marø?
english: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?

anywaa: Köödhi atal piny yïth ŋøøm; uudi mo wø cooŋ beel yïthge bëëdö no oränynyö; ni ö odïïi ni bëëtge no oniruuth, kiper beel atal.
english: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

anywaa: A teeŋ cooyø mo nyïëdi na cooc lääyi ki gø! ni bëët dhäki ni thääyö jaak, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ kwör kwaath jïge, këël dïëk thuwø acännö.
english: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, a jwöŋö dëërï, kiper lïëth piny mo caala maac, kwör kwaath athööre dï paap, ni waaŋ jenni bëët moa en dï pwöla.
english: O Lord, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.

anywaa: Këël lääc paap, ge bëëdö ni ge jwöŋö dëërï, kiper pïï moa en nyeŋ näm atal, ni ö lïëth pinynyi mo caala maac ni waaŋ dï paap kwör kwaath.
english: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

anywaa: Uuni, koothu tuuŋ yi Dhayan, ni koothu ka bäät Kïn Wuuö Jwøk na en kur keere!  Jø wø bëëdö yi ŋöömö bëët beerra man tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi, kiper cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk öö; ka adïëri møn, kare aløny ni cään.
english: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;

anywaa: Ni beeye cäŋ mo piny tïmö ni cøl, ni piny dhïïth, na cäŋ mo piny najïïm na lwøc, ni piny cøl døc. Bäänyö mo caala lwaa dhaanhø mo päl mo teek öö, ni dëëtge ege peerø ni caala man wø ö tiet cäŋŋi mo amöölla ni wø nëënge ni rege ege peerø ki bäät kïte, mo bäŋ teeŋe mo okwøŋ tägö mo caala gø, ni bäŋ teeŋe mo cäŋ tägö këët køør gø yïth cwiiri mo beenhnhe mo oööi.
english: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

anywaa: Maac bwödhö nyïmge ni räänyö, ni maac caatha køørge ni wääŋö. Kanyo poode dïkwøŋ, ŋöömö bëëdö ni caala ajïniina mana en Ëden nyïmge, 'ba kanyo tïme na køørge, ŋöömö ränynyö ni tïme na kaŋ, ni bäŋ gïn mo obøth dhøkge na bäre bäre.
english: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

anywaa: Geni, ge nëëni ni caala okwëënyi ni ge rïïŋi ni caala okwëëc leny,
english: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

anywaa: mo döötge wïnyö ni caala jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi kany wø nigeluŋŋa ki bäät kïte, ni döötge wïnyö ni caala maac mo tinynyi kaamar man wø waaŋ thiek beelli, ni caala jø leny mo teek mo ojiiŋŋø kiper leny.
english: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

anywaa: Jiy cwïnyge obwøk døc nyïmge, ni ö täärnyïmge bëët ni nigeduk.
english: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

anywaa: Geni, ge rïïŋi kaamar jø leny mo teek ni ge ïïdhi kaawat man wø ö dëëci wø iithge kiir. Geni, ge cäädhi ni rege ege bwødhø, ni ge ba gaa wøk ki jöörge.
english: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

anywaa: Geni, dëëtge ba dhïrge; ŋati man nø caatha nyïme ni tiir. Ni kany wø nigerääc piny caala man wø ö jø lenynyi wø nigerääc piny dï jap leny ni tëëŋŋö marge ba gwäyi.
english: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

anywaa: Geni, ge lääta yi pääny, ni reŋge ri kiir, ni dønyge yïth uudi, ni päärge ki dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi kaamar kuuwe.
english: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

anywaa: Kanyo poode dïkwøŋ, piny ree di jäŋö nyïmge, ni ö maalli ni tïme ni kwanynyi, ni ö cäŋŋi ki dwääy ni tïmge ni cøl, ni ö ceerri ni ba rienyge këët.
english: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk dwøre omäri nyïm bäänyö na caal jø leny moe; ka adïëri møn, twïër marge dwøŋ døc, ni ge na jïëc dwør Wuuö Jwøk, ge teek døc. Ka adïëri møn, cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ, ni beeye cäŋ lwär. ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man jïëny gø?
english: And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

anywaa: 'Ba këël kawaane en, Wuuö Jwøk poot köö, ni «Duu baŋa ki cwïnynyu bäre, ni kwierru cam, ni jwöŋu, ni kïmmu.
english: Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

anywaa: Tïmu nou cööta cwïnynyu ki kïmmö, ni patha abïïe mou.» Ennø, duu baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, kiper eni yie met, ni mëër ki jiy, ni bäŋ wø laar wëër, ni mëër mare ni wø ba jøøl päl,  ni cwïnye wø di warø ki gïn mo leth.
english: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni ŋäc gø? Kanymør ree di løø, ni war cwïnye, ni wëëk køøre ki gwïëth, ni jïtu ki beel ki kwøŋ mo løny ki man cïpu ge na muuce jïre, eni na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru.
english: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the Lord your God?

anywaa: Uuni, koothu tuuŋ yi Dhayan, ni gööyu piny ki cäŋ mo you cïp kur keere, mo jiy ba cämö yie, ni cwötu ka acooŋa mo ena kur keere,
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

anywaa: ni cooŋŋu jiy, ni cïbu jø acooŋa kur keerge, nou cooŋa jø døøŋŋø kanya ciel, ko obwöre, ki moa mar na näk poot dhøøth kööthi. Beerra man ö cø dhaagø thiinh ni wec øde, ni ö dhaage thiinhnhi ni wec kar bëëtö mare.
english: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

anywaa: Beerra man ö dïlämme ni wø tïny Wuuö Jwøk, ni jwöŋge yïthakic gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ka agööl dhi Øt Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, cwïnyï pädhe ki gïr jiyï, ni ba tïïyï jiyï na näk thöögï na gïr apääda, na gïr aŋaada dï wïth juurre. ?Aŋø, wïth juurre doo pëëö møn, ni ‹?Jwøk marge en kaa?›»
english: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk gïr ŋöömö mare tïmö ni päl cwïnye, ni päth cwïnye ki gïr jiye;
english: Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

anywaa: ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni løk mare ni kööe jï jiye, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, a cïpö jïïu ki beel, ki kwøŋ mo nyärö, ki maaw, mo rømø ki man jäŋŋu ki geni, ni ba tïïa u këët na gïr apääda dï wïth juurre.
english: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

anywaa: Aani, lwaa bäänyö mana käl jï løø wï-piny enø, riema kany mo bäär ki uuni, ni riema gø yi ŋöömö mo lïëth ma tëën, ni ö moa bwödhö maal ni køøla geni yi Naam Acäbö jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö moa en ŋää cään ni køøla geni yi naama dwøŋ na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni ö ŋwääö marge na tïk ni keel piny, ni ö kwääö marge ni cääth maal, kiper ka adïëri møn, gena tïïö ki gïn mo teek.»
english: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø paac, käru lwäär, yïthu mïnge ni kanynyu, kiper Wuuö Jwøk anø tïïö ki gïï mo døøŋŋø.
english: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.

anywaa: U na lääc paap, käru lwäär, kiper kwör cam mou moa en dï paap, anø lødhø ni marr, ni ö jenni ni nø nywølge ki nyïëdi, no olämmi ko omøki bäädi moge oløny ni ninør ki nyïëdi.
english: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Dhayan, kanynyu, ni mïn yïthu ki Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, kiper eni køth mar dhi køth acïbe ki køør beenynye. Eni, køth akøny piny kiperu, ni beeye køth mar dhi køth, ki mar cwiir, kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ.
english: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

anywaa: Yïth laare tïmö ni päŋ ki beel, ni ö aguli ni bëëtge ni øya piny ki kwøŋ moa nyärö ki mädhi.
english: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

anywaa: «A na Wuuö Jwøk, kar cwiiri moa raany bäänyö dëëtu coola coolø jïïu,  ni beeye moa raany bäänyö mana päl, ki bäänyö man wø ŋudö, ki bäänyö man wø døø piny, ki bäänyö man wø räänyö, ge na thööth na caal jø leny 'moa na jääŋŋa baŋu.
english: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

anywaa: Køøre, uuni, u cämö ki cam mo päl, ni jäŋŋu, ni pwøyu nyeŋŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, a noo tïïc gïn mo rëëma ec jïïu. Køøre u na jiya, wïthu ba lääy këët na bäre bäre.
english: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø putu ka ŋäc naa ena dïïu, u jø Icriel, ni aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, ni bäŋ mør këët, ni u na jiya, wïthu ba lääy këët.
english: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

anywaa: «'Ba noo tïme na køør gïïögø, aani, Jwïëy 'moa kïtha bäät jiy bëët, ni ö wäätu ki nyïïu ni køpge dwøra, ni ö jäle mou ni läkge ki lääk, ni ö wøpe mou ni neenge jammi mo nyïm mo wø nyooth ki yi wïc.
english: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

anywaa: Këël jø tïïc moa näk cwøw ki mään, Jwïëy 'moa kïtha bäätge yïth nïreke.
english: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

anywaa: «Aani, a nyuuthö ki gïï mo rëëma ec maal ki piny, ni beeye remø, ki maac, ki jïrö mo onitul.
english: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

anywaa: Cäŋ ree di wiilø ni cøl, ni ö dwääyi ni tïme na remø, kanyo poode ni cäŋa dwøŋ mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, cäŋo täk lwärri yie poot kär öö.
english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the Lord come.

anywaa: 'Ba gïno tägi, ŋato cøør nyeŋŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, di piemø, kiper ki køør mana caana, a na Wuuö Jwøk, da jiy mo bøth ni kwøw bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni moo bøth ni kwøw beege moo cwøla, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.

anywaa: «'Ba ka adïëri møn, kanyo tïme ni yïth nïreke kar kaace, kanyo ö Jerucalemmi ki Juuda bäre noo dwøga ge karge,
english: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,

anywaa: aani wïth juurre bëët cooŋa kanya ciel, ni kïtha ge goor Jøcapath. Ni ööa ni caana luup ŋøl dëëtge kaace naa ena løø jiya ma jø Icriel na näk thööga, kiper beege na keeth jiya dï wïth juurre, ni ö geni na wïth juurre ni pääŋge ŋöömö mara yïthakicge keerge.
english: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

anywaa: Geni thuwø gena tïïö ki ŋïïce ki ri kwääk ki baw kiper jiya, ni ö nyilaar dïcwøø ni gathge gø kiper käp, ni dwøkge nyilaar nyakøø pwödhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki nee maathge.
english: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

anywaa: «Maya thuwø, u jø Tayar ki jø Caydan ki jiy bëët moa en mïëc Pilitin, ?agïnaŋø na manynyu nee tïïyu dëëra? ? Aŋø, da kwör mo dou coolø dëëra? 'Ba ni näk mo da kwör mo you caarø ni coollu coolø dëëra, laara ka layø ni dwøga gø dëëtu.
english: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

anywaa: Kiper uuni warkey mara, ki gwel-bïrö mara, ki jap kwär 'moa akällu ni kïthu ge yïth uut juu mou.
english: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

anywaa: Uuni, jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem ki dï Juuda bäre agathu baŋ jø Gïrïïk, ni tïïyu karge ni bäär ki ŋöömö marge.
english: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ge tïŋa maal yïth kwöra gathu ge yïthge, ni ö gïna tïïyu dëëtge ni dwøga gø dëëtu.
english: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

anywaa: Aani thuwø, wäätu ki nyïïu gadha gadhø baŋ jø Juuda, ni  ö jø Juuda ni gathge ge baŋ jø Caaba, wï juna kare bäär.» Kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk na caan gø.
english: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: Luubö man gøø piny yïthakic wïth juurre: Ni jiiŋŋu dëëtu kiper leny, ni ö jø lenynyi moa teek ni öge maal. Beerra man ö jø lenynyi bëët ni nyiikge kany mo cään ni tukge.
english: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

anywaa: Thääthu jap puur mou no opëëlle, ni ö jap goor wïth jenni mou ni thääthu ge na tøøŋi; ni ö ŋata jääk ni cøm cwïnye ni ŋwöe, ni «Aana dïcwøø mo teek.»
english: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

anywaa: U na wïth juurre bëët moa kwöru cärö, läädu ni laaru öö, ni cooŋŋu dëëtu kanya ciel yi gool kaace. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jø leny moï na teek wär put jääŋŋö piny.
english: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.

anywaa: «Beerra man ö wïth juurre ni öge maal ni cige goor Jøcapath, kiper aani, a pïïa piny kaace ni caana luup ŋøl dëët wïth juurre bëët moa kwörge cärö.
english: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

anywaa: Kiper mana tïm rääö marge ni päl, nyaaru geni piny kaamar caammi mo ociek mo kaa piny, ni cwöthu ge kaamar nyïïomøki mo di cwödhö ki tiel kar biic marge këël mano tïm pï nyïïomøki ni kwönna wøk.»
english: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

anywaa: Wui lwaak, lwaa päl, u ena goor ŋøl luup, kiper cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk kare acäännö goor ŋøl luup.
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.

anywaa: Cäŋ ki dwääy tïmö ni cøl, ni ö ceerri ni ba rienyge këët.
english: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk määr ki yi Dhayan, ni dwøre wïnyi ka yi Jerucalem, ni ö maalli ki piny ni tïmge ni jäŋŋi. 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö na kar kan røk jï jiye, ni eni caala kiir mo ogeerø ni teek jï jø Icriel.
english: The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.

anywaa: «Køøre nø oŋäyu møn ni beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, naa bëëdö Dhayan bäät kïnna na en kur keere. Jerucalem tïmö ni ena kur keere, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo path mo ŋøla dïëre këët.
english: So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo tïme na dïcäŋece, kïte tïmö ni lwanynyi ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo ŋweeth, ni tïm thuuri ni caak kwönna wøk ki bäätge, ni tïm nyeŋ nämmi moa en Juuda ni kwödö ki pïï. Ni tïm pï jøøro ni kwönna wøk ki yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, ni jwøc goor Cëthim.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

anywaa: Ijep ränynyö ni tïme na tëën, ni ö Ëdömmi ni tïme na paap mo otal, kiper gïïa leth na tïïcge dëët jø Juuda, ni beeye yi ŋöömma kønyge rem jiy piny yie mo bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø.
english: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

anywaa: 'Ba Juuda tïmö ni beeye noo beet na bäre bäre, ni tïm Jerucalemmi na mar beenhnhe bëët mo oööi.
english: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

anywaa: Aani kwör ajäl remø marge mana näk kära kwøŋ cool, coola coolø. Kiper beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni wø bëëdö Dhayan.»
english: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the Lord dwelleth in Zion.

anywaa: Moi beege luupa køp Amøci, na en røk dïpïïth dïëk paana cwøl ni Tëköa. Luupögø beege moa nyooth jïre ki yi wïïe kiper jø Icriel yïth nïra beet Udhaya ni ena nyeny Juuda ki yïth nïra beet Jeröbäm o Jeyöac ni ena nyeny Icriel. Gïïögø akwøŋ nyooth jïre kanya poode ni poot dööŋŋa cwiiri ariiø ki man täk dïjäŋ pinynyi.
english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.

anywaa: Ena köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk märö yi Dhayan, ni køp dwøre yi Jerucalem; ni ö kwör wø kwaac dïëk yïthge ni talge, ni ö luummi mana en bäät Kïn Karmël ni bäbe.»
english: And he said, The Lord will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Damacka na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper jø Gelät anyathge ka abaya ma nywïënyö.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa, ni waaŋ paana geer nyeya ma Adhaël, na näk paan dwøŋ mana bëët nyeya ma Ben-Adat yie.
english: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad.

anywaa: Dïdëët mana en dhi kiir Damacka otoora, ni raanynya jøøa bëëdö yi goor Awën,  ki ŋata en teek paaci cere na en Bëëth-Ëden. Ni ö jø Aram ni maai ni kïth geni paana cwøl ni Kir.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Geedha na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper jø paac bëët amakge ki tøŋ, ni ŋeewge geni ki jø Ëdöm.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa, ni waaŋ kiir mar Geedha ki uudi moa teek na en yie.
english: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

anywaa: Ni raanynya jøøa bëëdö yi Acdöt, ki ŋata en teek paaci cere na en Ackelön. Ni løøa cera røk jø Akarön, ni ö moa näk odööŋ røk jø Pilitin ni thumge.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Tayar na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper jø paac bëët aŋeewge ki jø Ëdöm, ni kärge wïthge caarø ki dwøl mana tuut na näk mar nyïïmëëe na en yïthakicge.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa, ni waaŋ kiir mar Tayar ki uudi moa teek na en yie.»
english: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Ëdömmi na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper na ŋwiecge køør nyïïmëëkge ma jø Icriel ki tøøŋi, ni wecge bäth cwïny mana dege tïïö. Ni ö wëërri marge ni pälle, ni bëëde ni nut cooth.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa, ni waaŋ paana cwøl ni Tëman, ki uudi moa teek na en dï Bödhra.»
english: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Amönni na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper määr jø Gelät moa näk yïthge da jiy arietge ri leny mana këëlge ki jø Gelät, ni ge nyaaya nyeŋ kee moge.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa, ni waaŋ kiir mar paana cwøl ni Raaba, ki uudi moa teek na en yie. Ni tïme ni da dïlweel dïcäŋo këël leny yie, ni tïm lenynyi ni teek kaamar atuunna.
english: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya marge ni käli no omaa, ge ki nyïïkuk moe bëët.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Möapi na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper cuu mo nyeny Ëdöm awaaŋge na bäre, këël mana tïmge na bur.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa Möap, ni waaŋ uudi moa teek na en dï pääny Kiriöt. Ni ö jø Möapi ni thøwge ri leny, ni da dïlweel mo päl, ni jø leny kwöŋŋö ni ge kudhö ki tuŋi.
english: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:

anywaa: Nyeny Möap nääa nääö ki nyïïkuk moe bëët.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Juuda na kaathge bääyö marge, kiper mana kwierge ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ni kärge luumme gwøø; ni gaage wøk thuwø køør juu mo patha adïëri moa cääth kwäcge køørge.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the Lord, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, maac ojääŋŋa Juuda, ni waaŋ uudi moa teek na en dï Jerucalem.»
english: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Kiper mana ö jø Icrielli na kaathge bääyö marge, a ba døø ŋääa ki man jääla geni, kiper ŋata beer wø gathge gadhø kiper pïïn gwel, ni gathge ŋata can kiper pïïn war.
english: Thus saith the Lord; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

anywaa: Wï ŋata näk oööl wø nyøønge piny yi tør, ni kierge wïth jøøa mwöl. Ni ö dhaanhe ki wänni ni cige baŋ dhaagø aciel, kiper nee nyeŋŋa na en kur keere nee raanyge.
