english: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:

anywaa: Ni buutge buut gïï wø waaŋ olämme bäätge, ni ge buta yïth abïïe moa lwør na dïgïti; ni mäthge øt jwøge ki kwøk nyïïomøki mo jøøa näk bäätge ocämmö ki jammi.
english: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

anywaa: «'Ba beeye aani na raany jø Amör nyïmge; këël na bëët bäc jø Amörri ni caala bäc jaath mo bäär, ni teekge caala teek dhegu, wïthge adïïra na bäre bäre.
english: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

anywaa: Ni beeye aani na käl uuni wøk cøøn ki yïth ŋøøp Ijep, ni käära uuni dï paap ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, kiper nee ŋøøp jø Amör cige jïïu.
english: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

anywaa: Køøre aana tïŋ maal ki nyïïkuk Jwøk røk wäätu, ni jëëta ki jiy møøk røk wøpe mou ni cïba geni kur keerge na jø Nadhir.  ?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, gïnögø paa adïëri? Beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni jø Nadhir amaathu ki kwøk nyïïomøki, ni köömmu nyïïkuk Jwøk nee dwør Jwøk ba køpge.
english: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, u nyadha nyadhø kaawat man wø ö tier jääy mo peek ki beel wø nyath gïn mo cøra bäät gø.
english: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

anywaa: Këël dhaanhø mo ŋwïëy ŋääe ba bøth, ni ö ŋata dëëre teek ni bänh dëëre, ni ö ŋat lenynyi ni ba piem jwïëye.
english: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

anywaa: Ŋat mo cere da tøŋ ba cuŋŋi, ni ö ŋat mo rïïŋö døc ni ba køny dëëre, ni ŋato këëdi ni ena bäät okweeny, jwïëye ba kønye.
english: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.

anywaa: Këël ŋat mo oteeø røk jø leny reeŋø ni bäŋ abïï dëëre dïcäŋöce.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Uuni na jø Icriel, wïnynyu luummi en na caan Wuuö Jwøki dëëtu, na caane dëët jø dhi øt Icriel bäre moa käl wøk ki yïth ŋøøp Ijep. Ena köö,
english: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

anywaa: ni «Beege uuni keeru na näk yaa jierø røk tuŋi bëët moa en bäät piny; kiper manøgø nø, aano ööi ni cunna uuni ki køør gïïa reyø bëët na tïïyu.»
english: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jiy ariiø ocääthge na aciel nidïï, ni näk mo gïr wääth kärge tuudö?
english: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

anywaa: ?A ŋuu märö jaak dï paap, ni näk mo bäŋ lääy mo opäär baŋ gø? ?Wala ŋuu köök jaak ni ena kar bëëtö mare, ni näk mo bäŋ lääy mo ee maa?
english: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wenyø mak abïëpi maaø, ni näk mo bäŋ abïëp mo ociiø? ?Wala abïëp napäta jaak, ni näk mo bäŋ gïn mo ogut gø?
english: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

anywaa: ?A ni näk tuuŋ okoodhø dï paac kiper leny, dëët jiy bëët ba kwanynyi? ?Aŋø, ni näk gïn mo raac ööa bäät paac, paa Wuuö Jwøk møn na tïïc gø?
english: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo tïïe jaak ni gïna näk ee cooŋø ki cwïnye käre caanø jï laaŋe na näk nyïïkuk moe.
english: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ŋuu anø määr; ?A ŋata ŋa ni ba lwäyi? Wuuö Jwøk mare anø caane; ?Aŋa no män ree ki man køp luummögø?
english: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?

anywaa: Beerra man caannu gø jï jøøa bëëdö kwöra teek na en yi Acdöt ki moa en Ijep, ni kööu, ni «Cooŋŋu dëëtu bäät kït Cameria, ni neennu okiera mana en dïëre, ki gïïa leth na temmi dëët jiy.
english: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.

anywaa: Jøøgø tïïc gïn mo beer kucge, jøøa näk jap twëër ki gïïa jaaŋge ceŋ jiy ege cooŋ piny yïth uudi moge na teek.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Nyïïmän, ŋöömö maru otiigi dïër, ni raanyge teek maru, ni twierge yïth uudi mou na teek.»
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki na ennø, ni «Ka teeŋ man wø ö dïkwääyi wø käl tiel ariiø ki thääŋ ïth diel wøk ki dhi ŋuu, jø Icriel mo wø bëëdö Cameria oränynyi na enø nø thuwø, jøøa wara bëëdö ni dëëtge ege nyaaŋ piny bäät pëëmme mo opeedhø ka abïïe mo mïërö.»
english: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk eni na wïth jammi bëët acäänö na ennø, ni kööe, ni «Wïnynyu mara, ni caannu gø dëët jic Jeekap.
english: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋo ööa ni jääla jø Icriel kiper gïïa bacge, gïï wø waaŋ olämme bäätge moa en Bëthël oraanynya, ni ö tuk gïï wø waaŋ olämme bäätge ni ŋøri ni päthge piny yïth ŋøøm.
english: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

anywaa: Ni raanynya uudi moa en paac ki moa en gool bëët, ni ö uudi mo oŋwagø ki lak lïëy ni raanynyi, ni ö uudi moa døøŋŋø ni nyaai piny.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wïnynyu gïn, uuni na määr Cameria, uuni no olør kaamar dhää Baacan, uuni ni wø thiel jøøa can piny, ni wø caan jøøa näk oööl, uuni ni wø kööm cwøwu, ni kööu, ni «Kännu ki kwøŋ nee wa mäthwa.»
english: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk akööŋ ri bëëtö mare na en kur keere, ni kööe,  ni «Kare møn, da dïcäŋ mo ööa bäätu, mo u di kälö nou pieyi ka dïgäni, ni piec uuni ko obïïdhi, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dööŋ.
english: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

anywaa: Ni pee uuni wøk ki yïth kwöra näk otunynyö ri kiir, ni ŋati man cøra kanya dïëde ki yie, ni leeŋ uuni wøk kanya cwøl ni Armön.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «U na jø Icriel, cou kar lam maru Bëthël ni putu luumma dhal, ni pööthu Gëlgela thuwø nou meeta adhala maru. Wäro tïme na amöölla cooth, olämme mou wär kïthu kar lam jaak, ni cïpu paac wïth jammi mou ki køør nïne adäk cooth thuwø.
english: Come to Beth–el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:

anywaa: Waaŋŋu møø mo ree da thømmø na muuy mar dwøk met ec, ni ŋwöu kiper olämme mo wø cïpu ki met ec, ni töödu kiperge, kiper beeye mana manynyu.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: «'Ba aani thuwø käc akäla dï mïëri mou bëët, ni tïme ni bäŋ cam kwöra bëëdu yïthge bëët; 'ba këël na tïïa gïnögø, u kär duu baŋa.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Aani køth amäna ki pädhö thuwø, kanya poode ni dööŋŋa dwäde adäk kiper kac beel. Køth awëëga pädhö paac mør, ni kära gø wëëk pädhö paac maya. Køth apädhö yi pwödhö mør, ni ö pwödhö mana käre pädhö yie ni tale.
english: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

anywaa: Køøre jø tiet mïëri mo jïtö ka ariiø wala adäk atïmö ni cäädhö paac mørø ni dëëtge bäth, nee ge jïtge ki pïï mo maathge, 'ba ge kär røm; 'ba këël na tïïa gïïögø bëët, u kär duu baŋa.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Cäŋ ki twöŋö ajääŋŋa ni raanyge beel mou, ni ö bäänyö ni thöör ajïniine mou, ki pwöth omøki, ko olämmi ki jer mädhi mou; 'ba këël na tïïa gïïögø bëët, u kär duu baŋa.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Teeŋ täw mana jääŋŋa bäät jø Ijep ajääŋŋa bäätu thuwø. Wøpe mou awëëga 'näk ri leny, ni ö okwëënyi mou ni maai. ŋwääny dëët jiy moa thøw twïër maru adwøga wïthu; 'ba këël na tïïa gïïögø bëët, u kär duu baŋa.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Jiy møøk araanynya rou, kaawat mana raanynya mïëya näk Cødam ki Gømöra, ni ö uuni na bøth ni tïmu nou caala jaath mo liel mo okäl wøk yi maac; 'ba këël na tïïa gïïögø bëët, u kär duu baŋa.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø nø, u na jø Icriel, da gïn mo tïïa tïïö dëëtu. 'Ba kiper gïno tïïa dëëtu, jiiŋŋu rou ki man røømmu ki aani, a na Jwøk maru.»
english: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, eni na cwääc kïte, ni wø wëëk jamø kwödö, ni wø nyooth acaaye jï dhaanhø; eni ni wø løk tar mar aruunnø ni tïme ni cøl, ni wø cäädhi dï piny ni bäŋ gïn mo gëëŋ gø; bee eni na Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The Lord, The God of hosts, is his name.

anywaa: U na dhi øt Icriel, wïnynyu jwøk thøø man jwøa bäätu en,
english: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.

anywaa: «Dhi øt Icriel na caal nyakøø aränynyö, ni ba ö maal këët. Ena put dööŋö yïth ŋøøm moe kaace, ni bäŋ ŋat mo tïŋ gø maal.»
english: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø, ni «Ni näk paac jääga wøk ki jø leny ma kuma, beeye dïpa keere noo bøth dëëtge; ni ö paac maya ni jääk wøk ki jiy ma dïpa, ni bøth apaarri keerge dëëtge.»
english: For thus saith the Lord God; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk aköö na ennø jï dhi øt Icriel, ni «Manynyu aani kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw;
english: For thus saith the Lord unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:

anywaa: 'ba kär näk mou manynya Bëthël, ni ba cou Gëlgela, ni ba pööthu Bëërcïïba; kiper Gëlgela omak ki tøŋ, ni ö Bëthëlli ni tïme ni bäŋ kare.»
english: But seek not Beth–el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer–sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth–el shall come to nought.

anywaa: Manynyu Wuuö Jwøk kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw. 'Ba ni näk mo ba tïïyu, eni nakwïïth kaamar maac dhi øt Jocep, ni waaŋ Bëthël ni bäŋ ŋat mo bïp gø.
english: Seek the Lord, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth–el.

anywaa: Gïnögø otägi dëëtu, uuni ni wø wiil ŋøl ma adïëri ni tïïyu gø ni raac, ni leeŋu gïna näk kare piny.
english: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

anywaa: Eni na cwääc wäät-odäki ki joonni, ni wø wiil muutha cøl ki tar mar amöölla, ni wø tïïc dïcäŋ na wäär; eni ni wø cwöl pïï wøk ki yi naama dwøŋ, ni wëëk gø pädhö bäät ŋøøm, beeye Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre;
english: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name:

anywaa: ni bee eni ni wø gøø jøøa teek piny, ni raany uudi moge na teek.
english: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

anywaa: U män ki ŋat mo jooga luubö mo raac kar løøk, ni yïthu reyø ki ŋat mo caana adïëri.
english: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

anywaa: Jøøa can wø thielu piny, ni jwägu geni ki beel. kiper manøgø nø, këël na gëënnu dëëtu ki uut kïte mo mïërö, u ba bëëdö yïthge; këël na pïïdhu ki jer omøki mo mïërö, u ba mädhö ki kwøk nyïïomøki moøgø.
english: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.

anywaa: Kiper päl bääyö maru, ki raay mou na thööth, ŋääa, uuni ni wø caan jøøa beyø, ni kädu ki gïï wø cïp ki piny, ni mänu jøøa can ki man jïtge ki ŋøl ma kare.
english: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, eni na näk wïïe da acaara obëëdö ni lïŋö kar kaace, kiper piny bëëdö ni raac.
english: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

anywaa: Manynyu tïïe moa beyø ni patha tïïe moa reyø,  kiper nou bëëdu nou kwøw. Køøre nø, Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, otïmö ni ena buutu møn, ni put thur kare, keda mana køpu gø.
english: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.

anywaa: Männu ki gïna raac, ni mëërru ki gïna beer, ni cïpu ŋøl ma kare kar løøk; kanymør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, yie bänhnhö ki jø paac moa dööŋ.
english: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

anywaa: Ki køør gïïa tïïyu bëët, kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö na ennø, «Dï paac otïmö ni da oduuru ni jiy jwöŋö ni ‹Wui! Wui!›. Ni ö jø puurri ni cwøli kuna jwöŋge, ni ö jø wø ŋäc jwøk thøø ni cwøli baŋ gøøy oduuru;
english: Therefore the Lord, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

anywaa: ni tïm oduuru ni dagø dï pwöth omøki bëët. Gïïögø tägö kiper a pöönhnhö ki dïïu ni mara ajäla.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u ni many dïcäŋa näk mar Wuuö Jwøk. ?Agïnaŋø noo duu dïcäŋa näk mar Wuuö Jwøki jïïu? Dïcäŋa näk mar Wuuö Jwøk otïmö na muudhö ni patha tar.
english: Woe unto you that desire the day of the Lord! to what end is it for you? the day of the Lord is darkness, and not light.

anywaa: Otïmö keda dhaanhø mo ŋwieya ŋuu, ni røømme ki cwieny; køøre noo døny yi øde ni këël cere ri øtø, eni put thwölli ka cam.
english: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dïcäŋa näk mar Wuuö Jwøk paa beeye muudhö ni patha tar? Kare møn, beeye dïcäŋ mo cøl ni bäŋ tar yie.
english: Shall not the day of the Lord be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, na «A män ka ajwöm mo wø tïïyu kipera, ni kwiera geni; acooŋi mo lam mou ba känni ki met ec jïra.
english: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.

anywaa: Këël u doo cïpö jïra ko olämme mo wø waaŋ, ki muuce mo beel, a ba jïëy ki geni; këël lääy mou moa näk olør mo wø cïpu no olämme kiper mëër, jïge ba neena.
english: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.

anywaa: Käru lweelli ki dudi mou buuta; ïtha ba ciia ki dööt thøme mou.
english: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man tïm ŋølli ma kare ni paac ee maa kaamar jwïïö, ni ö bëëtö ma kare ni pälle kaamar naam mo kwödö ni ba tal.
english: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, uuni na jø Icriel, olämme ki muuce moa cïïmmu ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween dï paap, cïpu jïra?
english: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba uuni juu moa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu moa cwøl na Caakut ki Kaywan akääru ni wøørru geni.
english: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, u wëëga mak ki tøŋ ni kïth uuni ŋää Damacka.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, whose name is The God of hosts.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u ni bëëdö ki bëëtö mo jööt jaak yi Dhayan, ki uuni ni cädö ni karu beer yi Cameria, uuni na kwöru døøŋŋø yi paana kare dwøŋ na näk Icriel, u ni wø cääth jø pou baŋu kiper køny.
english: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!

anywaa: Cou ni pööthu Kalnë ni raŋŋu gø; køøre nø, wäru cou Amath paana dwøŋ, ni putu løøc piny yi Gëth po jø Pilitin. ?Aŋø, kadha geni ki jøøi ni en kany ii? ?Wala thöötha ŋøøm moge ki mou?
english: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

anywaa: U wø köö ni dïcäŋa raac kare poot bäär, 'ba dïcäŋa raac nyïïu nyïïö, ni wëëgu pou päth ceŋ jiy mo tïïya gïï mo reyø dëët jiy.
english: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, uuni ni wø buut bäät pëëmme mo oŋwagø ki lak lïëy, nou ŋeella dëëtu kwör niine mou; uuni ni wø cämö ki nyïïdïëk ki nyïïrøøe moa näk olør.
english: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;

anywaa: Uuni ni wø cäŋ dëëtu ki dudi kaamar Deebit, ni wärru geni ki thøme.
english: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

anywaa: Uuni ni wø maath kwøk nyïïomøki ka arööt mo døøŋŋø, ni wïïrru dëëtu ki mädhi mo ŋwäänyge met, 'ba u ba kïmmi kiper ränynyö mar jø Icriel.
english: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, uuno tïmö na jø okwøŋ käl røk jø omak ki tøŋ, ni ö ajwöm mou ki ŋeel røk kwör niine mou ni tïmge ni bäŋgø.
english: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, akööŋ dëëre keere ni kööe, na «A män ka atöör mar jic Jeekap, ni yia raac ki uudi moge na teek; kiper manøgø nø, pääny marge ki gïïa en yie bëët ocïba ceŋ nyïïmän moge.»
english: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, saith the Lord the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.

anywaa: Kar kaace, ni näk da jiy apaar mo odööŋ yi øtø aciel, ge puta thøø.
english: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

anywaa: Køøre, kanyo ö tuuŋ jøøgø no kälge dëët jiy wøk kiper nee koonyge, ŋata en yi øtø tääŋtiel opëënyge ni köge, ni «?Da dhaanhø moo dööŋ buutï këët nø?» Noo kö ŋatøgø, ni «Bäŋgø,» køøre jøøa pëëö puta köö, ni «Lïŋï nø, kiper nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk bäŋa døø cwølø.»
english: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the Lord.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk mare di caanø, ni ö uudi moa døøŋŋø ni nyaa ge piny, ni raany uudi moa therø.
english: For, behold, the Lord commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, okwëënyi rïïŋö ki bäät kïte? ?Wala da ŋat mo puura naam ki dhäk? 'Ba uuni ŋøl ma adïëri awiillu, ni tïïyu gø ni raac kaamar cïm, ni døøyu gïïa beyø mo reyø.
english: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

anywaa: Uuna tïmö nou töödö kiper mana magu pääny Lödebaar, nou cäänö thuwø, ni «Kaarnam amakwa ki teek marwa.»
english: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Uuni na jø Icriel en, jø leny mo tier paac mør owëëga ööny maal bäätu, ni tïïge dëëtu ki gïï mo leth dï pou bäre, ni tägi ka Amath këël mano këët waŋ Araaba.»
english: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the Lord the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness.

anywaa: Man beeye gïna nyooth Wuuö Jwøki jïra ki yi wïïa; ena jooda ni cwääö ki lwaa bäänyö. 'Ba kar kaace beeye kanya täk luummi ki lødhø, køør mana nyaari jï nyeya.
english: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.

anywaa: Kanya ö bäänyö na thöör gïïa no otuy bëët bäät piny, Wuuö Jwøk akwaaa ni kööa, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, wëën jic Jeekap. ?Geno kwøwge nidïï? Kiper ge jägö døc.»
english: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord God, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye aware ni kööe, ni «Gïnögø ba tägi këët.»
english: The Lord repented for this: It shall not be, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Man thuwø beeye gïna cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki nyoothø jïra ki yi wïïa; ena jooda ni jiiŋŋa ree ki man jääl jiye ki maac. Ni ö maaci ni taal pïï moa en tiet ŋøøm ni täge ki man raany pwöth.
english: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord God called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk akwaaa ni kööa, ni «Wuuö Jwøk, wec gïnögø.  ?Jic Jeekap okwøwge nidïï? Kiper ge jägö døc.»
english: Then said I, O Lord God, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk cwïnye aware ni kööe, ni «Gïnögø thuwø ba tägi këët.»
english: The Lord repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord God.

anywaa: Køøre gïn acäŋ nyoothø jïra ki yi wïïa; Wuuö Jwøk ajooda ni cuŋŋö buut dëër øtø mo ogeerø ni thïïŋ, ni cere da thøøl mo nyootha thïïŋ gïrpiny.
english: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «?Amøc, agïnaŋø ni nëëni jïrï enø?» Ni kööa, ni «Beeye thøøl man wø nyooth thïïŋ gïrpiny.» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Bëët jiya ma jø Icriel orøma keda man wø røm dëër øtø ki thøøl man wø nyooth thïïŋ gïrpiny. Køøre nø, ge ba wiia këët.
english: And the Lord said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:

anywaa: Kwör lam mo nyïïkwaac Aydhak na en bäät thuuri oränynyi, ni ö uut lammi mo jø Icriel ni nyaai piny, ni öa maal ni raanynya dhi øt nyeya ma Jeröbäm ki leny.»
english: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

anywaa: Køøre Amaciya, eni na kwääc lam mar Bëthël, ajääk baŋ nyeny Icriel ma Jeröbäm, ni kööe, ni «Amøc manynya man tïïe ka ageem dëërï dï pou ma Icriel, ni luupa care bëët caala baa mo peek bäät paac.
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth–el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.

anywaa: Kiper Amøc aköö, «ni ‹Jeröbäm di nääö ri leny, ni ö jø Icrielli ni maai ki tøŋ, ni käl geni yi ŋöömö marge ni kïth ge paac mør.› »
english: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.

anywaa: Ni kö Amaciya jï Amøc, ni «Ïïni ni wø neen gïï mo ena nyïm, beerra man aayï ni ciï yi ŋööm Juuda, ni jootï cam marï kunöce, ni køpï luum Jwøk kaace.
english: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:

anywaa: 'Ba kär luum Jwøk køpï këët Bëthël kany, kiper beeye kar lam mar nyeya, ni näk øt lam thuwø mar paac bäre.»
english: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Amøci jï Amaciya, ni kööe, na «A patha nyikuŋ Jwøk na bëëda cøøn, naa ba en dëët jøw wø kwaan dëëtge ni gena nyïïkuk Jwøk. 'Ba aana dïpïïth dïëk ni näga ŋat wø cooŋ nyïïjer wø nyïïge cam,
english: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

anywaa: ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cwöl aani wøk ki kar pïïth dïëk, ni poot na Wuuö Jwøk na köö jïra, ni ‹Ciï ni køpï luummi en jï jiya ma jø Icriel.›
english: And the Lord took me as I followed the flock, and the Lord said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Amaciya, wïny luum Wuuö Jwøk. Ïïna köö, «ni ‹Kär luum ajäl Jwøk køpï dëët jø Icriel, ni ba dwøgï luubö bäätge, ge na nyïïkwaac Aydhak.›
english: Now therefore hear thou the word of the Lord: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø nø, gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö,  «ni ‹Cïïï otïmö na kääbi dï pääny, ni ö wäätï ki nyïïï ni nääi ri leny, ni ö ŋøømmi moï ni rømi ni pääŋŋi jï jø møøk, ni ö ïïni ki dëërï ni thøøï yi ŋöömö mo path. Ni ö jø Icrielli ni maai ki tøŋ, ni käl geni ki yi ŋöömö marge ni kïth ge paac mør.› »
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.

anywaa: Man beeye gïna cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki nyoothø jïra ki yi wïïa; aana nyuunhnhe ki gupa mo päŋ ki nyïïjenni mo ociek.
english: Thus hath the Lord God shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Amøc, agïnaŋø ni nëëni jïrï enø?» Ni kööa, ni «Beeye gupa mo päŋ ki nyïïjenni mo ociek.» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, «Aŋuun nïr jiya ma jø Icriel apäŋ kaamar nïr nyïïjenni mo ociek. Ennø, ge ba wiia këët.
english: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the Lord unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.

anywaa: «Dïcäŋöce dudi moo wär po nyeya otïmö na mo jwøk thøø. Ni gääp pinynyi bäre ki dëët jøøa no othøw, ni tuut geni wøk ni bäŋ dwøl mo wïnyi.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord God: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.

anywaa: Wïnynyu gïn, uuni ni wø thiel jøøa can piny, ni dïïrru wïth jøøa näk oööl dï paac bäre,
english: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,

anywaa: ni kööu ki cwïnynyu keeru, ni «?Cäŋ ajwöma mar dwääni na päär en opöödhe yi wäne, kiper nee wa døøwa baŋ gath ki beel? ?A cäŋ jwömö opöödhe yi wäne thuwø, kiper nee beel kïthwa kar ŋïëw, nee gïr røm tïïcwa ni thiinh, ni tïïcwa gäte ni teek, ni møtwa jiy ki rumi mo paa kare,
english: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?

anywaa: ni dwøkwa omate mo beel pwödhö; nee ŋata näk jïre bäŋ gïrpiny ŋeewa ki gwel, ni ŋeewa ŋata can ki tier warø jaak?»
english: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ni wø jït jic Jeekapi ka atöör kipere akööŋ dëëre keere, ni kööe, ni «Røk gïïa tïïcge bëët bäŋ gïn mo wïïa wïl ki gø.
english: The Lord hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere no tïm pinynyi ni jäŋŋi, ni ö jøøa en yie bëët ni kïmge. Ni tïm dëër paaci bäre ni kwanynyi, ni tïme kaamar naam Ijep ni wø päŋ ni døøe.»
english: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, ni «Dïcäŋöca cäŋ owëëga pädhö ki dhöör, ni wëëga piny tïmö na muudhö ki dïcäŋ.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord God, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:

anywaa: Nïr ajwöm mou odøøya nïr kïmmö, ni døøya dut met ec mou mo oduuru. Ni wëëga uuni bëët käär abïïk keece ni nyootha kïmmö maru, ni wïthu ogwäär wøk; dïcäŋöce uuno tïïa nou caala dhaanhø mo kïmmö kiper nyilaal mare ma aciel keere, ni tïm aŋuun dïcäŋöce na pänh cwïny jïïu.»
english: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, «Nïne dagø mo öö, maa jääŋŋö ki käc dï pou, ni käc manøgø paa mar bäŋ cam, wala kiper riew mar bäŋ pïï, 'ba beeye käc mar bäŋ wïny luum Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord God, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the Lord:

anywaa: Ni tïm jiyi ni thääyö jaak, ni ge tägi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ge cøøa jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni pööthge wï-piny ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ; ni ge läägö ni ge manynya luubö mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, 'ba bäŋgø mo jootge.
english: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the Lord, and shall not find it.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöce këël nyïïakuue mo mïërö ki cwøw mo wøpe 'näk riewi nääö.
english: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.

anywaa: Jø wø kööŋ dëët juu mo Cameria, ni wø köö, ni ‹Ŋëët Jwøa en Daan,› wala ‹Ŋëët Jwøa en Bëërcïïba,› jøøgø pädhö ni ge ba duu maal këët.»
english: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beer–sheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk ajooda ni cuŋŋö buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kööe, ni «Gøøc were mo øt lam këël mano tïm dëër øtø ni jäŋŋi, ni tøc were ni päthge wïth jiy; køøre jiy moo dööŋ nääa nääö ri leny, ni bäŋe ŋat mo reŋi rege, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo bøth dëëtge.
english: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.

anywaa: Këël ge doo dønynya yi kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, geno käla wøk kaace ki cera; këël ge doo cøøa maal, geno duua piny ki kunöce.
english: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:

anywaa: Këël røkge dige kana wï Kïn Karmël, ge manynya manynyø ni käla ge wøk ki kaace; këël røkge dige kanø ki aani yi naama dwøŋ kany mo päŋ døc, thwöl mana en tiet pïï köömma köömmö ni kaac geni kaace.
english: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:

anywaa: Këël ge doo maa ki tøŋ ni kïth geni paac mør, geno wëëga 'näk ki tøŋ kunöce. Ni raŋŋa jïge ki waŋ mo raac ni patha waŋ mo beer.»
english: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, piny di gudö ni put tïmö ni jäŋŋi, ni ö jø wø bëëdö yie bëët ni kïmge; Ni tïm pinynyi bäre ni kwöda maal ni døøa piny, kaamar naam Ijep ni wø päŋ ni døøe.
english: And the Lord God of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk paare ee geerø maal, ni tïïc maal na rëëbi bäät piny. Bee eni ni wø cwöl pïï wøk ki yi naama dwøŋ, ni wëëk gø pädhö bäät ŋøøm; eni na tïïc gïïögø bëët, beeye Wuuö Jwøk ki dëëre.
english: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, ena köö, na «?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, u ba caal jø Ithiöpia ki baŋa? U na jø Icriel, uuna käla wøk ki yi Ijep; këël jø Pilitin thuwø akäla wøk ki yi Kaptör, ni käla jø Aram wøk ki yi paana cwøl ni Kir.
english: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the Lord. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, nyeŋŋa ena bäät paac man wø tïïc raay, ni raanynya gø na bäre bäre bäät piny. 'Ba nyïïkwaac Jeekap ba raanynya bëët.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø.
english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord God are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ennø, aano cïpi ki dwøl, ni jiera jø Icriel moa en dï juurre kaawat man wø pieth beel ki luul, ni bäŋ waŋ aciel mo päth piny.
english: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.

anywaa: Jøøa näk jø raay bëët dëët jiya, othøw ri leny, jø wø köö, ni ‹Gïn mo raac ba pïï dëëtwa.›
english: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

anywaa: «Da dïcäŋ mo öö mo wï po Deebit mana no opädhö tïŋa maal, ni dwøga kwöra näk oränynyö karge, ni cäŋa gïïa näk oränynyö geerrø,  ni dwøga gø kare kaawat mana bëëde dïkwøŋ.
english: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:

anywaa: Køøre nø, jøw moa dööŋ dëët jø Ëdöm, ki juurre bëët moa no ocwøl ri nyeŋŋa, otïmö ni ena ceŋ jø Icriel.» Beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni cäänö enø, ni bee eni noo tïïc gø.
english: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the Lord that doeth this.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Da cääŋŋe mo öö, mo beel ciek ni thööth, ni jiy poot kää ni kar puur manynya man täge, ni jiy cäŋa tägö ki pïïdhö ni nywøp kwøk nyïïomøki poot kär thum. Ni tïm nyïïjenni ni thööth, ni pïïge tøøna piny ki bäät kïte, ni löönynya piny ki bäät thuuri.
english: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

anywaa: Jiya ma jø Icriel moa näk omaa ri leny oduua poge, ni cäŋge wïth mïëri moa no oränynyö geerrø, ni bëëtge yïthge; ni piithge jer omøki, ni maathge kwøk gø; ni tïïge ka ajïniine ni camge nyïïjer gø.
english: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

anywaa: Tiet jiya okëëlla piny yïth ŋøøm moge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo daak ge këët yïth ŋøøm moge moa cïba jïge.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki Jwøk maru.
english: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the Lord thy God.

anywaa: Man beeye luumma nyooth jï Obadaya, ni beeye gïna caan Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk kiper jø Ëdöm. Da luubö ma awïnywa ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni da dhaanhø mo ojääŋŋö baŋ wïth juurre, mo käära dwøl mo köö na ennø nø, ni «Ööu maal ni cøø baŋ leny ki jø Ëdöm!»
english: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.

anywaa: «Ï na Ëdöm, ka adïëri møn, ï tïïa tïïö na wï jur mo thiinh ki yïthakic wïth juurre, ni bëëdï ni ïïno taaø.
english: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.

anywaa: Atöör mana en cwïnyï ïïna nøøne, ï na no ogëët bäät kïte, ni tïïyï kar bëëtö marï ni ena maal, ni bee ïïni ni wø cään dëëre keere, na ‹?Aŋa noo dwøk aani piny yïth ŋøøm?› »
english: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Këël ïïno määt maal kaamar odhuuth, ni geerï ødï yïthakic ceer, ï wëëga duun piny ki kanya enï yie.
english: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk kuuwe wala dïtwïëte geno ö baŋï ki wäär, ge ba kwal jammi mo rømge ki ge keerge? ?A ni näk jø wø pøn nyïïomøki geno ö baŋï, ge ba wëëö ki møøk? 'Ba ïïni, ïïno ränynyi ki ränynyö mo dwøŋ.
english: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?

anywaa: Ï na jiy moï käla ri Icøø, ïïno loony, ni ö kwör kän moï ni jaammi ni puti twier.
english: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!

anywaa: Jøøa wara bëëdö ni ïïno dwätö ki geni bëët, jiy moï oriemge nyeŋ kee; nyïïawäätï ïïno nøønge, ni kïthge ïïni tietge, ni ö jøøa wara kønyï ki cam ni cekge ïïni ka abïëp mo tiere ba kwanyï.»
english: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, cwøw moa wïthge leer mo jø Ëdöm, ki cwøw mo wø bëëdö bäät kïn Icøø, ni wø laar tiet luup kwany, ge raanynya raanynyø.
english: Shall I not in that day, saith the Lord, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?

anywaa: Wui Tëman, ï na pääny mar jø Ëdöm, jø leny moï moa teek, geno lwäyi, ni ö nyïïkwaac Icøø bëët mo wø bëëdö paana en bäät kïte ni 'näk geni.
english: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.

anywaa: Kiper gïna leth na tïïyu dëët nyïïmëëgu ma nyïïkwaac Jeekap, otïmö ni käla lään wïc bäätu, ni raany uuni na bäre bäre.
english: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋa ö jøøa pathi na tøcge dhøk kiir mo Jerucalem, ni tïïge ki nyuuthe kiper gø ki man pääŋge gø yïthakicge, ni dønyge yi gø ni twierge jap kwär mo gø, uuna cuŋŋö buutge ni dëëtu you waanyø, ni tïmu nou caala geni.
english: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.

anywaa: 'Ba u ba doo bëëdö jaak nou raŋŋa jï nyïïmëëgu dïcäŋa jwørge gïïa leth na tägö dëëtge; nou ba doo kanynyø bäät jø Juuda dïcäŋ ränynyö marge; nou ba doo ŋeethø bäätge dïcäŋ kïmmö marge.
english: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.

anywaa: Nou ba doo dønyø ki dhi kiir mar jiy 'moa dïcäŋ ränynyö marge, nou ba doo bëëdö nou raŋŋa ränynyö marge jaak dïcäŋa jwørge gïï mo leth. Ni ceŋŋu ba dou kïtha bäät jap kwär moge ni ge ena yïth gïï mo leth.
english: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;

anywaa: Nou ba doo cuŋŋö nou kurö yïth agääk jïëthe ki man 'nägu jøøa no opäär wøk, ni jøøa näk obøth ba dou maaø, dïcäŋa jwørge gïï mo leth.
english: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.

anywaa: «'Ba cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk kiper wïth juurre bëët kare cään; gïïa tïïyu di tïïö dëëtu; ni tïïe moa tïïyu dwøga wïthu.
english: For the day of the Lord is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.

anywaa: Kaawat mana bëëdu nou mädhö jaak bäät kïnna na en kur keere, wïth juurre bëët thuwø geno bëëdö ni ge mädhö jaak. Geno mädhö ni bøømge, ni tïmge kaamar gïn mo bäŋgø na bäre bäre.
english: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy mo bøth mo dööŋ bäät Kïn Dhayan; 'ba Kïn Dhayan otïmö ni ena kur keere, ni ö jø dhi øt Jeekap ni lwørge gø na kurge.
english: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.

anywaa: Dhi øt Jeekap otïmö kaamar maac, ni ö dhi øt Jocep ni tïme kaamar leep maac; 'ba dhi øt Icøø otïmö kaamar lethø, ni puti ya jøøgø nyep ni thööri ya maaci, ni ö dhi øt Icøø ni put tïmö ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dööŋ yie.» Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøa en dïtëën mana en jï løø tier-piny mar ŋööm Juuda, ŋøøp jø dhi øt Icøø na en bäät kïte olwørge, ni ö jøøa en tiet kïte jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ni lwørge ŋøøp jø Pilitin na marge. Geni thuwø ŋøøp jø Ipariem ki ŋøøp jø Cameria olwørge na marge. Ni ö jø tuuŋ Benjamen ni lwørge ŋøøp jø Gelät na kurge.
english: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moa no omaaø ki tøŋ geno duui, ni lwørge ŋøøpa en Keenan këël Dherepeth; ni ö moa no omaaø ki tøŋ yi Jerucalem na kïth Ceparat ni lwørge päänye moa en dïtëën mana en jï løø tier-piny manøgø.
english: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa piem jiy geno ci maal bäät Kïn Dhayan, nee po jø tuuŋ Icøø na en bäät kïte nee käärge. Ni ö buc nyeci ni tïme na mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord's.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Joona wär Amitay, ena köö,
english: Now the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni ciï Nineba, päänya dwøŋ, ni cäänï dëëre, kiper rääö mar jiye aöö ni pïïe maal baŋa.»
english: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.

anywaa: 'Ba Joona aö maal nee reŋ Tarcëc ni kana ree ki Wuuö Jwøk. Køøre ena ci Jøpa ni joot baabuur mar naam mo cøøa Tarcëc, ni cude ki gwel ni ci yie kiper nee ci Tarcëc ki jøøa en yie, ni eni kana ree ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk akännö ki jamø mo dwøŋ bäät naama dwøŋ, ni tïm athage ni dwøŋ døc yi naam, ni tïm baabuurri ni manynya man toore.
english: But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.

anywaa: Køøre jø tïïc mo baabuur alwäyö døc, ni ö ŋati man nø ni jwöŋe dëër jwøe. Ni leeŋge jammi yi naam moa en yi baabuur, kiper nee baabuur tïme ni jööt kiperge. 'Ba Joona onø ci yi baabuur piny ni nyaaŋ dëëre piny ni put nyeŋŋe gämmö døc.
english: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc baabuur aci baŋe ni pëëny gø, na «?Aŋø, ï butï kiperŋø? Ö maal ni cwølï Jwøï. Kanymør Jwøk cädö kiperø, kiper nøø ba thøø.»
english: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

anywaa: 'Ba jø tïïc acäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «Beerra man thöödhø ki nyuuthe kiper nee ŋata päth gïnni ni raac bäätø en ki køøre nee ŋääø.» 'Ba kanya thöörge nyuuthe, nyuudhi aput päth bäät Joona.
english: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.

anywaa: Ni putge gø pëënynyö, ni «Caanï jïwa, ?gïn raac ni pänh bäätø en oöö ka køør ŋa? ?Tïïc marï agïnaŋø? ?Ïïno käla kaa? ?Pou a kaa? ?Ïïna juna ŋø?»
english: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Aana nyï Ibaru, naa bëëdö naa lwäära Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø maal, eni na cwääc naama dwøŋ ki ŋøøm.»
english: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø aput lwäyö døc, ni köge jïre, «?Aŋø, a teeŋ gïnaŋø na tïïyï en?» Kiper ŋäc jiyi ni eni reŋi ni kana ree ki Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ee nø caan jïge.
english: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.

anywaa: 'Ba athaŋ naam poot kadhø jaak. Køøre gena köö jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïcwa ki ïïni ennø kiper nee athaŋ naam døø piny kiperwa?»
english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Lwørru aani ni leeŋu aani yi naam, kiper athaga nee døø piny kiperu, kiper ŋääa na athaŋŋi ni dwøŋ en ö bäätu kapera.»
english: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy baabuur akiiwge døc ki man kïthge gø lak ageela, 'ba kär løny jïge, kiper athaga poot kadhø jaak.
english: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.

anywaa: Køøre gena jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk ni köge, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, wa kwaya ïïni, kär wa 'nägï ki køør mano raanywa jwïëc ŋati en, ni ba kïthï kwör remø mare bäätwa ni näk mo eni kär bääyö, kiper ï na Wuuö Jwøk, gïna tïïyï en beeye gïna met yiï ki gø.»
english: Wherefore they cried unto the Lord, and said, We beseech thee, O Lord, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O Lord, hast done as it pleased thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Joona aputge lwør ni leeŋge gø yi naama dwøŋ, ni ö athage ni put cuŋŋö.
english: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.

anywaa: Køøre jiy aput lwäyö døc ki Wuuö Jwøk, ni cïpge ko olämi jï Wuuö Jwøk ni putge kööŋ.
english: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the Lord, and made vows.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk rëëö mo dwøŋ ajääŋŋe ni løøny Joona, ni ö Joona ni bëëde ki nïne adäk, wärre ki cääŋŋe moge, ni ena yi rëëö.
english: Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

anywaa: 'Ba Joona alämö jï Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mare, ni eni ena yi rëëö.
english: Then Jonah prayed unto the Lord his God out of the fish's belly,

anywaa: 'Ba kanya läme ena köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk acøøra naa ena yi gïn mo leth, ni løk mare jïra; ni rëëda kiper køny naa ena kar bëët jwïëc jøøa no othøw, ni wïny dwøra.
english: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the Lord, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.

anywaa: Kiper ï na Wuuö Jwøk, aana leeŋï kanya päŋ tier kut mar dï naama dwøŋ, ni ö pïïyi ni nigejïk bääta, ni bëët athage marï na teek ni cööya pïï bääta.
english: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.

anywaa: Ni cäda, ni ‹Aana wetï nø ni tïma naa tøør nyïmï. 'Ba øt lam marï na en kur keere poot cäŋa ka neennø.›
english: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.

anywaa: Pïï aana rïëpge piny møn, naa ena tier kut kanya päŋ, ni ö gïïa no otuy tiet pïï yi naam ni meenge wïïa.
english: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

anywaa: Aana nilïŋ piny tiet kïte, ni ö pinynyi ni cïëk ree bääta na bäre bäre. 'Ba ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, aana cäŋï käl wøk ki yi bwörö.
english: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O Lord my God.

anywaa: «Kanya bëëda ni bääta opädhö, wïïa aputa caar ki ï na Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö lammi mara ni pïïe baŋï yi øt lam marï na en kur keere.
english: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the Lord: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.

anywaa: «Jøøa wøør juu mo bäŋ gïn duuge, ge luua ŋäthge baŋï, ï ni wø nyooth mëër mo ba jøøl.
english: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a cïpö jïrï ko olämi ni pwøa ïïni ki duut mar dwøk met ec, ni coola gïna kööŋa kipere. Køny joota baŋï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk rëëö aput köömmö, ni ö rëëe ni ŋöö Joona wøk kanya näk otal.
english: And the Lord spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bäät Joona ri rietge ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto Jonah the second time, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ö  maal ni ciï Nineba, päänya dwøŋ, ni køpï dwøro caana jïrï yie.»
english: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.

anywaa: Køøre Joona aput ö maal ni ci Nineba ki køør dwør Wuuö Jwøk. 'Ba Nineba beeye pääny mo dwøŋ døc, ni ki man ŋøl dïëre känna wøk ki nïne adäk.
english: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.

anywaa: Køøre Joona atägö ki man caath dï päänyögø ki dïcäŋ aciel bäre, ni rëëdö, ni «Ennø, dööŋŋa nïne ma pïëraŋween keerge nee Nineba raanynyi.»
english: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Nineba dwør Jwøk aŋääthge, ni gööcge piny ka awaaci mar wödö, nee ba cämge, ni røøge keece dëëtge na abïïe, ni tägi ka jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø këël jøøa näk kwörge bäŋgø.
english: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dwølli na pïïe baŋ nyeny Nineba, ena put ö maal ki bäät wälu mare ni gööny abïïne wøk ni røø keeca dëëre na abïï ni pï yi bur.
english: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.

anywaa: Ni cïpe ki dwøl dï Nineba mo køp, ni «Man beeye dwøl mana cïp nyeya ki jø kööre moe, «ni ‹Kär dee dhaanhø ki lään paac, teeŋ ka dhäk ki dïëk, mo bïti ki gïrpiny. Kär dee gø mo cämö wala mo mädhö ki pïï.
english: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:

anywaa: 'Ba jiy ki lääy keece wär bëëtge ni ena dëëtge, ni ö jiyi ni jwöŋge døc dëër Jwøk, ni ö ŋati man nø ni løk ree ni wec jöör raay moe ki gïïa reyø ni wø tïïe ki ceŋŋe.
english: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.

anywaa: Aŋa ni ŋäc gø, kanymør Jwøk dëëre di luuö ni war cwïnye, ni paany wëër mare bäätø ni wø liel kaamar maac, kiper nøø ba thøø.› »
english: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki na joot gïna tïïcge, ni beeye jöö mana løkge rege ki gø na wecge jöör raay moge, Jwøk cwïnye aput war ki gïna leth na caane ni käle bäätge, ni käre gø tïïö.
english: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.

anywaa: 'Ba Joona yie atïmö ni raac døc ki gïna tägö ni put gootø.
english: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

anywaa: Ni läme jï Wuuö Jwøk ni kööe, «?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø, manøgø patha gïna caana kanya pooda naa ena powa? Beeye tiere na reŋŋa Tarcëc, kiper ŋääa ni ïïna Jwø wø nyooth met ec, ni ïïna Jwø mëër, niï bäŋ wø laar wëër, ni mëër marï päl ni ba jøøl, ni cwïnyï wø warï warø ki gïn mo leth.
english: And he prayed unto the Lord, and said, I pray thee, O Lord, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wui, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, a kwaya ïïni, lwør jwïëya, kiper theemma thøø jïra ki man bëëda naa kwøw.»
english: Therefore now, O Lord, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki, na «?Aŋø, beeye gïn mo beer jïrï ki man gootï?»
english: Then said the Lord, Doest thou well to be angry?

anywaa: Køøre Joona adøny wøk ki yi pääny ni pï piny jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ. Ni gëën dëëre ka abïla kaace, ni pï piny tïm gø ni koora gïno tägi ri pääny.
english: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk acïpö ko olïïrö deŋ Joona, ni wëëk gø døøŋŋø kiper nee tïme na tïpö bääte, kiper nee kunynye ki man dwøk gootø mare piny. Køøre Joona yie amïnnö døc kiper olïïrö.
english: And the Lord God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla maya, kanya ruu øwi, Jwøk akännö ki twöŋö ni raany olïïrö, ni ö olïïrö ni put närö.
english: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö cäŋŋi maal, Jwøk akännö ki jamø mo lïëth ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö cäŋŋi ni gøøc Joona, ni tïm wïïe ni wïïrö, ni päc dëëre thøø, ni kööe, ni «Theemma thøø jïra ki man bëëda naa kwøw.»
english: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jï Joona, na «?Aŋø, beeye gïn mo beer jïrï ki man gootï kiper olïïrö?»  Ni løk gø, ni «Kare, beeye gïn mo beer jïra ki man goota ki gootø maa manynya thøø.»
english: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Wuuö Jwøki, ni «Raŋï, cwïnyï apädhö kiper olïïrö, mo bäŋ gïn mo iï tïïö kipere, mo kärï wëëk pïth, mo tuy ka wäär aciel keere, ni put ränynyö ki wäär aciel.
english: Then said the Lord, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:

anywaa: ?A aani, cwïnya a ba dee pädhö nidïï kiper Nineba, päänya dwøŋ na näk yie da jiy mo kaala kume ma dïpa ki pïërariiø, jøøa näk bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge ki man gaage bäät cwïcge ki bäät cämge, na näk jïge da dhäk mo thööth thuwø?»
english: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Mikiya nyï Mörëcëth yïth nïra beet Jöthammi, ki Eeyeth, ki Edhekaya ni gena nyec Juuda, ni beeye luubö mana joode kiper Cameria ki Jerucalem.
english: The word of the Lord that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ena köö, ni «Wui, u na jiy bëët, wïnynyu gïn; wui, piny ki gïïa en yie bëët, cegu ïthu;  Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk mare caane caanø dëëtu ni eni ena kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere.
english: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, Wuuö Jwøk öö ki kar bëëtö mare, ni eni ööa piny ni nyør kwöra bäyö bäät piny.
english: For, behold, the Lord cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.

anywaa: Ni ö kïte kwöra nyøre ni leenyge kaawat man wø leeny gage ki maac, ni løøcge piny ki yïth agäm-kïte kaawat man wø løøc pïïyi piny ki kany mo ree ee lääŋö.
english: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët tägö kiper bääyö mar nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni täkge kiper raay moa tïïcge, ge na jø Icriel. ?Aŋø, bääyö mar nyïïkwaac Jeekap ba täga Cameria? ?A kwör lam moa en bäät thuuri po jø Juuda, ba täga Jerucalem?
english: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, aani, Cameria oraanynya ni neeruuth, ni tïme na pwödhö kany piith omøki yie. Ni leeŋa kïte moe piny ya agäm-kïdi, ni ëëla tiet uudi moe wøk.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

anywaa: Gïï wø lam yie bëët di tøyø na thäŋi, ni ö gïïa joot bëët ki køør tïï käp yi øt jwøe ni waaŋi ki maac, ni ö gïïa no otieŋø yie bëët ni wø lam ni raanynya geni, kiper gïïögø tïïc ka jap wø joot ki ri käp, ni gïïögø beege ni wø cäŋ wïth juurre tïïö ki jap käp ki ge.»
english: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper gïïögø, a na Mikiya, a jwöŋö ni gööa ko oduuru, ni bëëda naa cäädhi ki thäny tieta, ni dëëra bäŋ abïï, ni jwöŋa kaamar othöö, ni jwöŋa kaamar tula.
english: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.

anywaa: Kiper ränynyö mar Cameria caala atwøda mo ba caŋŋi, ni ränynyö manøgø kare onø cäännö ki man pïïe Juuda, këël dhi kiir mar jiya mar Jerucalem.
english: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Uuni, kanyo täk ränynyö maru, kär nou caana gø yi Gëth jï nyïïmän, ni kär nou jwöŋu. U na jø Bëëth-Lëapara, dëëtu oŋeellu ki yi tør.
english: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.

anywaa: U ni wø bëëdö Capir, uuno mak ki tøŋ ni käl uuni nou cäädhi ka dëëtu ni bëët wïthu ni laay. Ni u ni wø bëëdö Dhaanan, u ba bøth. Jø Bëëth-Idhel geno bëëdö ni ge kïmmö, ni ba jïtu ki køny baŋge.
english: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.

anywaa: Jø wø bëëdö Maröth geno bëëdö ni cwïnyge pärö kanyo bëëtge ni ge koora gïn mo beer. Kiper gïn mo leth anø öö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni nø tïm kare ni cään ki dhi kiir Jerucalem.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the Lord unto the gate of Jerusalem.

anywaa: U ni wø bëëdö Lakic, twöu jïëth leny dëët okwëënyi ni reŋu! U na jø Lakic, bee u na täk raay dïkwøŋ jï jø Dhayan kiper gïïa bac jø Icrielli ajoot baŋu.
english: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Juuda, jø Mörëcëth- Gëth omääthu, ni kööu, ni «Tuuru nø.» Jø pääny Akdhip geno tïmö na jø cwøk jï nyec Icriel.
english: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth–gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, u jø Marëca, aani, a känna baŋu ki jiy mo maya pou,  ni ö dïbwöthe moa døøŋŋø mo jø Icriel ni kange rege yi øt kïdi mana en ya Adulam.
english: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.

anywaa: U na jø Juuda, gwääru wïthu wøk ni dööŋge no otal, kiper obwöre mou na mëërru ki geni okäl. Uuni gwääru wïthu wøk bäre ni dööŋge kaamar wïth acudhi, kiper obwöre mou di maaø baŋu ki tøŋ ni aacge.
english: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jï jø wø caar gïï mo reyø, jø wø caar tïï gïï mo reyø kany wø enge kwör niine moge. Ni kany wø ruu øwi ka amöölla, gïna caarge wø putge ka tïïc, kiper jïge oløny ni da teek ki man tïïcge gø.
english: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.

anywaa: Geni, cwïnyge døøŋŋø ki pwöth ni macge geni, ni päl cwïnyge ki uudi ni lwørge geni. Geni, jap dhaanhø wø lwørge lwørø ki paac mare, ni lwørge pwöth dhaanhø.
english: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani, a cädö ki man känna bäätu ki gïn mo leth, ni uuni bäŋ ŋat mo bøth ki gø; ni ba cäädhu këët ni jiy raŋu piny, kiper kar kaace, piny obëëdö ni raac.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋece uuno cäŋ jiyi ki duut, ni duudögø beeye duut mar jwøk keec ec, ni beeye duut mano løøgu ni kööu, ni ‹Waana ränynyö na bäre! Wuuö Jwøk ŋøøp jø powa alwøre, alwøre baŋwa møn, ni cïp pwöth mowa jï jø wø mac paac.› »
english: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kanyo duu ŋøøm, otïmö ni bäŋ ŋøøm mo di rømø jïïu dï jø acooŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø køp luup ki wïthge, ge wø köö ki aani, ni «Kär dwør Jwøk køpï. Kär dee dwør Jwøk mo køpï kiper gïï mo tägö dëëtwa. Bäŋ lään wïc mo ö bäätwa.»
english: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.

anywaa: ?Wui u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, aŋø, manøgø beeye gïn mo doo caanø, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk atïmö ni cwïnye ba cïp piny? ?Teeŋ gïnögø dee tïïö?» 'Ba mar Wuuö Jwøk beeye en, ena köö, ni «Luup 'moa wø beyø kaper jøøa marge thïïŋ.
english: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the Lord straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge kany mo cään ennø, u na jiya, dëëtu athïïŋŋu dëëra kaamar nyïïmän. Uuni, abïïe akälu wøk bäät jø wø pöödhi ki jöö mo bäŋ gïn lääŋge, ki bäät jø wø duui ki baŋ leny.
english: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

anywaa: Uuni, määr jiya ariemu wøk, ni ŋati man nø riemu wøk ka yi paare na met yie ki gø, ni kälu ajiem mara wøk bäät obwöre moge na bäre bäre.
english: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.

anywaa: Uuni, u ööa maal ni aayu nou mak ka tøŋ, kiper kany ba tïmö na kar bëëtö maru, kiper mana tïïyu gø ni ba waany ni ränynye, ni tïme kaamar ŋwellø mo bäŋ køny mo joode.
english: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.

anywaa: Ni näk mo da nyikuŋ Jwøk man wø wïdi ni køpa luup tööt ki luup cwøk, mo köö, ni ‹Køøŋ omøki ki kwøŋ mo keec obëëdö ni thööth jaak,› teeŋ ŋatøgø beeye ni wø met yïthu ki gø.»
english: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «U na nyïïkwaac Jeekap, u cooŋa kanya ciel u bëët, ni lema uuni, u na jø Icriel moo dööŋ, ni cïba uuni kanya ciel kaamar dïëk mo ena kaal, ni cuuny pinynyi ki jiy.»
english: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk jöö di jabø ni ci maal nyïm jiye, ni ö jiyi ni cige køøre, ni cørge dhi kiir, ni cige wøk ki yie. Nyeya marge beeye noo cäädhi nyïmge, ni eni na Wuuö Jwøk beeye noo bwödhö maal wïthge.
english: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the Lord on the head of them.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö, ni «U na dïbwöthe mo nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ki u na kwääri moge, ge na jø Icriel, ennø, wïnynyu gïn. ?Aŋø, paa u na doo ŋäc ŋøl ma adïëri?
english: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?

anywaa: Bee u ni wø män ki gïna beer ni mëërru ki gïna raac. Gïna raac ni wø tïïyu, keda u gøøpa dëët jiy, ni kee u käla rïk dëëtge wøk;
english: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;

anywaa: ni bëët keda u cama dëët jiya, ni gøøpu dëëtge, ni tøyu cuu moge, ni ŋøru geni kaamar cuu mo kïtha yi dak, kaamar rïŋö mo kïtha yi dhiithi.»
english: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

anywaa: 'Ba da kany mo öö mou jwöŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ö eni ni ba løk maru jïïu. 'Ba kar kaace, eni täärnyïme okane ki uuni kiper gïïa tïïyu na reyø.
english: Then shall they cry unto the Lord, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk mo wø køp luup ki wïthge, ni wø bwøth jiya nee gaage wøk, ena köö, ni «Kany wø näk da jiy mo tiet lakge di lëëŋŋö ki gïn mo nyamge, ge wø puta tïmö ni ge køpa luum bëët-mëër jïge. 'Ba ni näk da jiy mo dhøkge kär mooø ki cam, ge wø puta tïmö ni ge køpa luum leny jïge.
english: Thus saith the Lord concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, da wäär mo öö kiperge mo bäŋ luup lääk mo ö bäätge, ni ö muudhe mo cøl ni neejïïm bäätge ni bäŋ luup adïëda mo køpge. Cäŋ opädhi bäät nyïïkuk Jwøk moøgø, ni ö dïcäŋŋi ni tïme na muudhö mo cøl bäätge.
english: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.

anywaa: Jø wø køp gïï mo ena nyïm, wïthge olääi, ni ö jø wø køp luup adïëda ni tïm nyeŋge ni law. Geni, ge bëët täärnyïmge ouumge ki lään wïc, kiper mano ö Jwøki noo ba løk marge.»
english: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, dëëra päŋ ki teek, ki Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk, ki ŋøl ma kare, ni cwïnya da cer, ki man caana gïïa bac nyïïkwaac Jeekapi jïge,  ki raay moge, ge na jø Icriel.
english: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the Lord, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wïnynyu gïn, u na dïbwöthe mo nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ki u na kwääri moge, ge na jø Icriel, u ni yïthu reyø ki luum ŋøl mana näk adïëri, ni wø meen luubö mo tiir,
english: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

anywaa: u ni wø geer Dhayan na näk pääny Jwøk ki jap jiy mo wø rem moge kønynyu piny, ni beeye Jerucalem ni wø geerru ki køør tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

anywaa: U na dïbwöthe mo päänyögø, luup wø ŋøllu ka køør gïï wø cïp jïïu ki piny, ni ö dïlämme moe ni pwönyge jiy ki ciik ni ge di cunnö ki jammi, ni ö nyïïkuk Jwøki moe ni køpge luup adïëda kany wø mooc geni ki gwel. 'Ba ge wø poot köö ni dëëtge ege jääŋö dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge köö, na «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ba bëëdö ni nut yïthakicwa? Bäŋ gïn mo leth mo ö bäätwa.»
english: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the Lord, and say, Is not the Lord among us? none evil can come upon us.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Dhayan na näk Jerucalem oränynyi ni neeruuth, ni puuri na pwöth jaak ki køøru, ni ö thuurri mana näk Øt Jwøk ogeer bääte ni tuue ka abuŋŋe.
english: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne, kïdi mana en Øt Wuuö Jwøki bääte okëël piny ni teek, ni tïme na wïth kïte. Eno tïŋ maal ni kaala thuuri, ni ö wïth juurre ni rwäthge bääte.
english: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth juurre mo thööth öö ni köge, ni «Ööu, owaa cøø bäät Kïn Wuuö Jwøk, yi Øt Jwø Jeekap, kiper nee ø pwönynye ki jööre, nee ø cäädhø øtjööre.» Kiper luum ciik Jwøk wø caan ka yi Dhayan, ni beeye Jerucalem ni wø ö luup Wuuö Jwøki ki yie.
english: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba eni luup ŋøle ŋølø yïthakic wïth juurre, ni ö wïth juurre moa teek ni dwøk ge kanya ciel, këël moa kwörge bäyö. Ni ö geni ni thääthge opëëlle moge na jap puur, ni thääthge tøøŋi moge na jap goor wïth jenni ki ge, ni bäŋe wï jur mo kwany tøŋ ki wï jur mør, ni ge ba pwönynyi këët ki leny.
english: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø otïmö ni bëëdö tier jaath omøk mare ki tier olaam mare ni yie met jaak, ni bäŋ ŋat mo wëëk geni lwär; kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee eni na caan luummögø ki dhee kiree.
english: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the Lord of hosts hath spoken it.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëët wïth juurre bëët ni ŋati man nø cäädhi ka nyeŋ jwøe, øøni, ø bëëdö ni ø cäädhi ka nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na bäre bäre, eni na Jwøk marø.
english: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Noo tïme na dïcäŋece, aani, ŋööte cooŋa kanya ciel, ni lema jiy moa no ojarø, ki moa näk bäätge yaa kïthö ki gïï mo leth.
english: In that day, saith the Lord, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;

anywaa: Aani, ŋööte ki jiy moa no ojarø tïïa tïïö na mo dööŋ,  ni tïïa geni na wï jur mo teek. Ni ööa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni käära geni ni aana nyeya marge bäät Kïn Dhayan, ki mano täge kar kaace nø, këël bäre bäre.
english: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the Lord shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.

anywaa: Wui Dhayan, ï na thuur man wø ö Jwøki ni wø neet jiye ki yie, na caal pïïth dïëk, ï na thuur mar jø Dhayan, bëët käär jiy mana dïkwøŋ cäŋ ka duu kare jïrï, ni beeye käädö mar nyec noo dwøk kare yi pääny Jerucalem.
english: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.

anywaa: «?'Ba ennø, aperŋø ni gööï ko oduuru ni dwørï ena maal, ni baŋŋï kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri en? ?Aŋø, beeye kiper mana bäŋe nyeya jïrï? ?A ŋat wø cïpi ki pwöc jïrï athøw?
english: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.

anywaa: Wui jø Dhayan, uuno baŋŋi ni rämu kaamar dhaagø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri, kiper ennø, u dønynya wøk ki yi pääny ni u mak ki tøŋ, ni bëëdu kwör mo uuno nicweeŋŋa wøk jaak. Uuni, u cøøa Babiløn, 'ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, uuno piema ceŋ nyïïmän mou kunece.
english: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the Lord shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u na jø Dhayan, wïth juurre mo thööth dëëtge adwalge na aciel kiperu, ni köge, ni ‹Dhayan ränynyö; ni neetø ränynyö mare ki nyeŋŋø.›
english: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
