anywaa: 'Ba geni, gïna nø caara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, kucge, ni gïïo tïïa, tiere kär ci cwïnyge. Aani gena cooŋa kanya ciel kaawat man wø cooŋ ŋaaŋe yi laara, ni gïnögø tïïa naa jääla geni.
english: But they know not the thoughts of the Lord, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.

anywaa: Wui jø Dhayan, ööu maal ni nyøru geni kaawat man wø ö dhäki wø dïnge beel; kiper u mooa mooø ki teek mo caala teek nywïënyö, ni tïïa tietu ni teek kaamar nywïënyö ma jwïël, ni nyathu wïth juurre na thäŋi.» 'Ba uuni, gïïa jootge bëët ki jöö mo patha kare, ni beege jap kwärö moge, ocïpu jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na Kwäärö mar bäät piny bäre.
english: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the Lord, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, u na jø Dhayan, pääŋŋu rou na dhøgi mo leny. Nyïïmän øøna nø cielge dïër. Nyeya mano ŋøl luup jø Icriel agøøcge ki thøra ki thääŋŋe.
english: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Ï na Bethelem na en Eeparata, këël na bëëdï ni thiinhnha ïïni dï mïëc tuuŋ Juuda, ŋato käär jø Icriel othïïŋa kiper tïïc mara, ni eni ööi ki riï; ni öö mare käla ya acääŋŋe cøøn yïth nïra dïkwøŋ.»
english: But thou, Beth–lehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk jiye cïbe ceŋ nyïïmän, këël kanyo ö nyakøøe noo jït dëëre ki mäc noo lwaare ki nyilaal. Køøre thäk jø poge moa mak ki tøŋ na dööŋ oduui, ni dwätge ki jø poge ma jø Icriel.
english: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba eno ö maal ni kwaac jiye kaamar pïïth dïëk, ni kwaaye ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk na dwøŋ, Jwøk mare, ki teek mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk. Ni ö geni ni bëëtge ni geno nikwak, kiper ki mano täge kar kaace nø, eni bëëdö ni dwøŋŋa eni,  këël cuŋ piny bäre,
english: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the Lord, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.

anywaa: ni bee eni noo käl bëët-mëër.
english: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö jø Aciria noo öge yi ŋöömö marø, noo nyøønge paan dwøŋ ki tietge, øøni, ø puta jääk baŋge ki dïbwöthe moa teek mo leny

Ni ö geni ni käärge jø wø en yi ŋööm Aciria ki dho opëëllö, ni beeye ŋööm Namrut noo käärge no opëëlle moge ege wöth wøk. 'Ba eni ø pieme piemø ceŋ jø Aciria, kanyo öge noo tukge ŋöömö marø, noo nyøønge ŋöömö marø.
english: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Jeekap moo dööŋ, geno bëëdö yïthakic wïth juurre mo thööth, ni ge caala thööy man wø cïp Wuuö Jwøki bäät beel. Ni bëëtge kaamar kuunhnhi mo jwøya beel, ni pädhö marge wala bäŋ pädhö marge ba koor man wø caan jiyi.
english: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the Lord, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.

anywaa: Nyïïkwaac Jeekap moo dööŋ, geno bëëdö yïthakic wïth juurre, ni beeye wïth juurre mo thööth, ni ge caala ŋuu mo ena dï lääc paap, ni bëëtge kaamar nyi ŋuu mo oö dï pïïth dïëk, ni päär bäätge ni jeec ge, ni bäŋ ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man køny geni.
english: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.

anywaa: U na jø Icriel, nyïïmän mou oböötu, ni dïïrru wïthge bëët.
english: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caan Wuuö Jwøki beeye en, ena köö, ni «Noo tïme na dïcäŋece, aani okwëënyi mou moa en dïïu, wïthge dïïra dïïrö, ni raanynya jïëth leny mou mo wø tut okwëënyi.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:

anywaa: Aani thuwø, päänye moa en yi ŋöömö maru raanynya raanynyø, ni ö kwör gwøk røki mou moa teek ni nyaa ge piny.
english: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:

anywaa: Aani, ajuuk moø ni en dïïu yøø wïthge dïïra dïïrö, ni tïme ni bäŋ jiy mo thöödhö ki war dïïu këët.
english: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:

anywaa: Aani, gïïa näk you tieŋø na gïï lam raanynya raanynyø, ni raanynya kïte moa näk you cwöth piny na gïï lam, kiper nee cøŋŋu ba këëllu piny këët nyïm gïïa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu.
english: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.

anywaa: Aani, jenni mo wø lammu na no ocwöth piny ni wø cøøri na Acare pudha wøk, ni raanynya päänye mou.
english: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ki køør wëër mara na dwøŋ, wïth juurre moo ba wïny mara, marge dwøga dëëtge.»
english: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

anywaa: Ennø, wïnynyu gïno caan Wuuö Jwøki dëëtu, u na jø Icriel, ena köö, «Ööu maal ni caannu maru ni nëënö jï kïte, ni dwøl maru wïnyö jï thuuri.
english: Hear ye now what the Lord saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.

anywaa: Wui kïte, u na nut cøøn, wïnynyu luum løøk mar Wuuö Jwøk, kiper Wuuö Jwøk jïre da løøk ki jiye, ni beege jø Icriel noo cääne ki geni.
english: Hear ye, O mountains, the Lord's controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the Lord hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.

anywaa: «?Wui jiya, agïnaŋø na tïïa dëëtu? ?Na agïnaŋø na ööla uuni ki gø? Beerra man løgu gø jïra.
english: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, ya acääŋŋe uuna käla wøk ki Ijep, ni piema uuni ni päda uuni yi bëët laŋ, ni cööra Modhe nyïmmu, eni ka Aran ki Mariyam.
english: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

anywaa: U na jiya, ennø, beerra man parru wïthu ki luum gïna caar Balaki nyeny Möap nee tïïe dëëtu ki ri Beelam, ki gïna dwøk Beelammi o Beeyör ni eni kwiera mar Balak. Parru wïthu ki gïïa tägö kanya tïŋŋu Cëthim nou cøøa Gëlgela, kiper nee tïïe mo Wuuö Jwøk na beyø na tïïe nee ŋäyu.»
english: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the Lord.

anywaa: ?Aani, aano cøøa nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki ŋø, ni cøŋŋa yaa këël piny nyïme, eni na Jwøk ni en maal? ?Løny ki man cøøa nyïme naa käära olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ki nyïïrøøe mo cwiicge oceele mo pulli?
english: Wherewith shall I come before the Lord, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny jï Wuuö Jwøk ki man mïn yie ki nyöök rööm ma kume mo cïp no olämme, ki maaw mo caala pï näm mo thööth døc mo ba kwaan? ?Këël kanynya kiree, rømø ki man cïba gø no olämi kiper gïïa baaa? ?Eni na nyi yia, rømø ki man cïba gø kiper raay mo dëëra?
english: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

anywaa: Wui ï na dhaanhø, Wuuö Jwøk gïna beer anyoodhe jïrï. ?'Ba Wuuö Jwøk agïnaŋø ni manynye baŋï? Beeye ki man ŋølï luup na karge, ki man nyoothï mëër man wø ba jøøl, ki man cäädhï ki Jwøk marï ni riï iï dwøk piny.
english: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?

anywaa: Wui tuuŋ Juuda, ki jø wø käär pääny Jerucalem, wïnynyu gïn. Dwør Wuuö Jwøk cwödö dï pääny, ni köö, ni «Leec wïc beeye ki man lwäär nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The Lord's voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jammi mo wø joot ki jöö mo patha kare yïth uut jøøa reyø, ki jïge ni kuua, ki jap røm moa näk oŋøørø ni cëëgö, na näk ec raac ki ge?
english: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, løny ki man wëënna jiy mo gïr røm marge ba ŋääth, ni gïïge mo wø nyooth peek gïrpiny paa kare?
english: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?

anywaa: Jiy moa no okwär dï pääny, yïthge päŋ ki tïïc gïï mo reyø, ni jø wø bëëdö yi pääny manøgø, ge cara tööt, ni lëëpge cara luup cwøk.
english: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aani u wëëga täw mo leth ni raanynya uuni, ni ränynyu ki køør raay mou.
english: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.

anywaa: Uuni, uuno cämö, 'ba u ba jäŋ, ni bëët yïthu ni poot ŋaam. Jammi mou odaaŋŋu nou kaanna geni, 'ba bäŋgø mo bøth, ni jammi moo kaannu cïba dhi tøŋ.
english: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.

anywaa: Uuni, uuno pïïdhö, 'ba ba kayu. Ni wellu nyïïjaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw, 'ba dëëtu ba wïïrru ki gø. Nyïïomøki obiiyu na køøŋø, 'ba køøŋŋe ba maathu.
english: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.

anywaa: Kiper u bëëdö nou gwøga kööŋŋe mo nyeya ma Ømri, ki gïïa tïïc wääde bëët ma Akap ki jøøa käl dëëre, ni bëëdu nou caatha køør acaare moge.  Kiper manøgønø, aani, u cïba cïbö jï ränynyö; u ni wø bëëdö päänyögø, u tïïa tïïö na gïr abuua, ni bëëdu, u na jiya, nou käära ajøøŋ yi piny bäre.»
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.

anywaa: Wui, aani cwïnya apädhö kiree! Bäŋ ŋat mo cwïnye ena køør Jwøk. Kiper aana määnyö kaamar dïlïm nyïïjenni, kaamar jø wø dädö ki nyïïomøki yïth pwöth, mo bäŋ okut nyïïomøki mo jootge mo di camø, wala nyïïolämmi mo wø kwøŋ ciek.
english: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat mo cwïnye ena køør Jwøk ba joot yi ŋöömö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo mare thïïŋ yïthakic jiy. Geni bëët, ge bëëdö ni ge kønynya rem jiy piny, ni ŋati man nø bëëdö ni dwara watge ka ajääp.
english: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.

anywaa: Ceŋ moge tïï gïn mo raac ege kwanyø ni beer kiree. Dïbwödhi ki dïŋut luup wø manynya gïï mo di cïbö jïge ki piny; ni ŋata kare dwøŋ wø caana mana en cwïnye jaak, ni geni luubö wø meenge meenø na aciel.
english: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

anywaa: Ŋata näk okøbø dïge ni beerra eni døc caala koodhø, ni ŋata näk okøbø ni mare thïïŋ døc, rääye kaala koodhi mo olöör piny. 'Ba uuni, cäŋ mana caan jø koorri ma nyïïkuk Jwøk öö, ni beeye ööny ajäla maru, ni ö paaci ni jïte ko okiera.
english: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

anywaa: Uuni, bëëdu ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋääth ŋat atut mare, ni bäŋe ŋat mo ŋääth watge. Këël cïïï man wø bëëdï ki gø kiree, bëëdï ni dhiï iï gwøø ki eni.
english: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

anywaa: Kiper wäädö wänni oraaŋe ni ee jarø, ni ö nyeyi ni ö maal bäät menni, ni ö cï nyeyi ni thïïŋ ree dëër waŋi mii cwøre; ni tïm dhaanhe ni nyïïmän moe beege jø wø en paare kiree.
english: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aano bëëdö naa raŋŋa mar Wuuö Jwøk ni cwïnya da ŋäädhe, naa koora mar Jwøk, eni noo piem aani. Eni na Jwøk mara, dwøra wïnynye wïnynyö.
english: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

anywaa: Wui nyïïmän mowa, kär yïthu mïnnö bäätwa, wa na jø Icriel! Këël wa doo pädhö, wa poot duua maal, ni këël wa doo bëëdö yi muudhö, Wuuö Jwøk poot bëëdö na tar marwa.
english: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.

anywaa: Waana bääyö dëër Wuuö Jwøk møn; wëër mare bëëdö ni ena bäätwa këël kanyo pïëme kiper luubö marwa, noo këël tier adïëri marwa piny. Eni wa käle wøk ni bëëtwa yi tar, ni jootwa adïëri mare.
english: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaace nø, oraŋ nyïïmänni mowa, ni ö lään wïci ni ö bäätge, ge na köö jïwa, «?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, en kaa?» Waani, geno raŋwa ki nyeŋwa, ni kar kaaca geno nyørø kaamar odhöönh mo jiy caatha dïëre øtjöö.
english: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the Lord thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.

anywaa: U na jø Jerucalem, da nïne mo öö mo kiir maru geerru geerø,  ni yïth nïne moøgø, nyeŋ kee mar ŋöömö maru nyiiga ŋäthge kuya.
english: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.

anywaa: Ni kanyo tïme na yïth nïröke, jiy oö baŋu, ni ge käla ya Aciria, ki yïth päänye mo Ijep, ki mano täge ki Ijep bäre, këël mano këët bäät Naam Upareeti. Ni ö møøki ki bäät naama dwøŋ këël bäät naama dwøŋ maya, ni ö moa kwörge bäyö bäät kïte ki bäät kïte møga ni öge.
english: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

anywaa: 'Ba løø piny mano dööŋ oränynyi ki køør raay mo jø wø bëëdö yie.
english: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, kwaac jiyï na alaŋkaanynyï ena cerï, man wø koorï geni ki gø, ni beege na thöögï na caal pïïth dïëk moï, geni ni wø bëëdö kur keerge kany mo yie da jenni, mo ŋöömö mana en deŋŋe ciek ki caammi. Beerra man kïthï geni Baacan ki Gelät, nee ge bëëtge ni ge cama caammi mo wø ciek kwöröke, kaawat mana bëëde yïth nïra cääŋŋe cøøn.
english: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, nyuuthï jïwa ki gïï mo rëëma ec, kaawat mana kwøŋï nyooth ya acääŋŋe kanya kälï wa wøk ki Ijep.
english: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.

anywaa: Køøre oraŋ wïth juurre ni lää wïthge, kanyo jootge gø ni teek marge bäŋ gïn mo kønye, ni bëëtge ni ceŋge ege maa dhøkge, ni ïthge ba wïnyö.
english: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

anywaa: Geni, geno ööi ni ge muulö yi tør ki bäp yïthge kaamar thwöl, ki gïï wø muuli ki yïth ŋøøm, ni ge ö wøk ka kwör gwøk røk moge ni dëëtge kwanynyi ki lwär, ni ge ööa nyïmï, ï na Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marwa, ni dëëtge miel, ni bëëtge ni ge lwäär nyïmï.
english: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the Lord our God, and shall fear because of thee.

anywaa: ?Ïïni, a Jwøk mane ni caal ïïni, ï ni wø wëën raay, ni wø wec gïïa bac jiyï na näk thöögï moa dööŋ? Ïïni wëër marï ba bëëdö na bäre bäre, 'ba yiï wø mïnni ki man nyoothï mëër marï ni wø ba jøøl.
english: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.

anywaa: Ïïni mëër marï wø nyoothï nyoodhø jïwa, ni nyøønï raay mowa piny, ni ö gïïa bacwa bëët ni leeŋï geni yi kut yi naama dwøŋ.
english: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï bëëdö niï nyootha adïëri jï nyïïkwaac Jeekap, ni nyoothï mëër marï man wø ba jøøl jïge, ge na dhi øt Eeberam, kaawat mana kööŋï jï kwäcwa yïth nïra cääŋŋe.
english: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

anywaa: Man beeye wëëlö mar gïna nyooth jï Neeyam nyï Elköc, ni beeye dwøl mana caal tëër na cäänö kiper pääny Nineba.
english: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk mo cwïnye këënynyö, mo kwör di coolø. Wuuö Jwøk kwör di coolø, ni ena wää wëër. Wuuö Jwøk kwör di coolø dëët jø wø kwier eni, ni bëët wëërri mare bäät nyïïmän moe.
english: God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth; the Lord revengeth, and is furious; the Lord will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ba laar wëër, ni eni teek mare dwøŋ; 'ba Wuuö Jwøk jø raay ba wiie ni ba jääle. Kany wø cäädhe, piny puta jïtö ka apwøyaweerø ka atuunna, ni tïm pøølli na tør mar tiete.
english: The Lord is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the Lord hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

anywaa: Eni naama dwøŋ di jooø ni taal gø, ni taal näm bëët. Ni ö luumme mo pwöle mo Baacan ki jer Kïn Karmël ni talge, ni ö jer Lur Libaanø moa no oŋøøk ni talge.
english: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

anywaa: Kïte atïmö ni jäŋŋi nyïme, ni ö thuuri ni nigemwøny piny. Piny tïmö ni kwanynyi nyïme, këël ki jiy moa en bäät piny bëët.
english: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni løny jïre ki man cuŋŋe ki wëër mare? ?Na aŋa ni løny jïre ki man jïëny wëër mare ni wø liel kaamar maac? Wëër mare liela nyïme kaamar maac, ni ö kïte ni piinge nyïme.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk beer, ni ena teek mar jiye cäŋ gïï mo leth. Jiy mo wø kan rege buute di gwøø.
english: The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jø Nineba baabe baabø kaamar jwïïö, ni dïïr wïthge, ni riem geni na nyïïmän moe yi muudhö mo cøl kar thøø.
english: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

anywaa: Acaara mano caarge kiper Wuuö Jwøk raanynye raanynyø na bäre bäre, ni bäŋe nyïïmän mo cäŋ duu maal këët.
english: What do ye imagine against the Lord? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

anywaa: Geni, ge caala jiy mo omeer mo oŋiel køøŋe, ni ge caala koodhi mo otal mo owaaŋ maaci.
english: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

anywaa: Wui Nineba, da ŋat mo öö ki riï mo cwïnye päŋ ki raay, mo cädö ki gïn mo raac dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the Lord, a wicked counsellor.

anywaa: Man beeye mana caan Wuuö Jwøki: ni «Këël na bëët jø Nineba ni ge teek ni ge thööth døc, wïthge poot di dïïrö ni rwäänyge. U na jiya, këël na tïïa uuni nee dëëtu jïtge ki ŋwiili, uuni u ba tïïa nee dëëtu jïtge ki ŋwiili këët.
english: Thus saith the Lord; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, aani teek marge na en bäätu na caal jaath puur man wø jøøny ŋut rwaath raanynya raanynyø, ni cööta thøøli moa twöc uuni ki ge.»
english: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk akän wøk ki ciik kiperï, ï na Nineba: «Bäŋ jiy mo jootï këët mo öö ki dëërï mo käära nyeŋŋï. Aani juu moï ki kït gïï wø lam ni wø en yi øt juu moï raanynya raanynyø. Aani bwörö marï jiiŋŋa jiiŋŋø, kiper ï bäŋ karï këët.»
english: And the Lord hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.

anywaa: Raŋŋu tiet dhaanhø ni ööi enø, ni cura bäät kïdi, na ŋat mo käla luubö mo nyään mo køpa luum bëët-mëër. Wui jø Juuda, bëëdu nou wøøra ajwöm mou, ni cïpu gïïa kööŋŋu ki ge jï Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper jø raay moøgø u ba cäŋge tugö këët. Geni wïthge di dïïrö na bäre bäre.
english: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.

anywaa: Wui Nineba, ŋat mo keetha ïïni ööa baŋï! Koor kar gwøk røk, ni neetï nyeŋ jïëthe, ni twöyï riï, ni cooŋï jø leny moï!
english: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ajiem mar jø Juuda dwøge kare, kaawat mano dwøk ajiem mar jø Icriel kare, këël na bëëtge ni geno twier dïtwïëte, kaawat man wø tïïc dïlïm omøki ni nyïëdi jaaŋge jaaŋŋø.
english: For the Lord hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

anywaa: Jø leny moe käädö ki kööt leny mo kwayø, ni geno ruyö ka abïïe mo kwayø. Jïëth leny moge mo wø tut okwëënyi nagaaŋ kaamar maac kanyo rwänhge baŋ leny, ni ge wuyö ni tøøŋi moge ena ceŋge.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

anywaa: Jïëth leny moøgø mo wø tut okwëënyi rïïŋi ka ŋwïëc bøøl uutjïëthe,  ni bëëtge ni ge reŋŋa løøi ki løøi yïth kwöra laac dï paac, ni ge nikwiil kaamar ameethi, ni ge nimal kaamar agaackøth.
english: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

anywaa: 'Ba wïth jø leny moe ocwøle ni bëëtge ni ge päänhnhö kanyo cäänhge baŋ leny. 'Ba jøw tuk geni ge laara läät dëër kiir, ni peerge gëëŋi bäät gïno toor kiir piny ki gø.
english: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

anywaa: Ni ö dhøk adïïre mo waŋ naam ni tucge, ni ö lwär mo dwøŋ ni täge paan dwøŋ.
english: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

anywaa: Ni ö gwanynyø ni loonyi ni maai ki tøŋ, ni ö määr tïïci moe ni jwöŋge kaamar atuuy, ni ge pööta kööthge.
english: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

anywaa: Nineba jiye thuma wøk, kaawat man wø ö pï puulli wø thumge wøk ki yi øøl. Këël jiy doo rëëdö, ni «Cuŋŋu! Cuŋŋu!» bäŋ ŋat mo løk ŋääe.
english: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.

anywaa: Twierru gwel-bïrö mare, ni twierru warkey mare, kiper teeŋ jammi moa perge leth ki teeŋ jap kwärö ba thum.
english: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

anywaa: Nineba di twierø ni ränynye ni neeruuth, ni ö cwïny jiy ni bwøkge, ni ö nyeŋ cøŋge ni pöötge rege, ni ö pëët jiy ni nigelway, ni ö täärnyïmge bëët ni nigiduk.
english: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

anywaa: ?Ennø, age pääny Nineba na caal kar bëët ŋuuwe, na kany wø bëët ŋuuwe yie mo ogäy, na kany wø bëët cïgïï ŋuuwi yie ki maath ŋuu, na kany wø bëët nyïïge yie no ogwøø?
english: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?

anywaa: Cïgïï ŋuu wø dwar, ni nääe ki mo orømø jï nyïïe ni jeec møøk jï cïïe, ni pääŋ buur kar bëëtö marge ki dëët gïïa dware.
english: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

anywaa: Neennu, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee en, ena köö, ni «Aani, a tïïö dëëtu ki gïrpiny. Aani jïëth leny mou mo wø tut okwëënyi waaŋa waaŋø ki maac, ni ö tøŋŋi ni thöör jø leny moï na caal ŋuuwe mo ogäy, ni tïïa japa twierru ni bäŋgø yi paac, ni bäŋe dööt jø wø jääŋŋi mo wïnynyi këët.»
english: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.

anywaa: Wui, ï na pääny man wø køny rem jiy piny, otïmö ni raac jïrï. Dëërï opäŋ ki tööt ki twier jiy.
english: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;

anywaa: Wïny dööt nyïbuki, ki dööt tiet jïëth okwëënyi, ki dööt tiet okwëënyi, ki dööt jïëth okwëënyi!
english: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

anywaa: Jø leny mo bäät okwëënyi ge läännö ni ge rwøya okwëënyi; no opëëlle namal, ni tøøŋi nagaaŋ. Lwaa dhaanhø mo päl di nääö, ni bëët dëëtge na athwöe piny, ni kwään dëët jiy ba thum, ni jiy moo cør kaace, tietge di cwanynyø dëëtge.
english: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa tägö bëët beeye kiper mana bëët Nineba ni caala dhaagø ma kääbi. Eni mïërö, ni tïïö ki jap ajuuk, ni bïth wïth juurre ki wïth jiy ki køør bëëtö mare manøgø.
english: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

anywaa: Neennu, mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee en, ena köö, ni «Aani, a tïïö dëërï ki gïrpiny. Aani, abïïnï jaara maal ni pïïe wïïï, naa nyootha dëërï jï wïth juurre,  ni ö akwöp nyec ni jootge lään wïc marï.
english: Behold, I am against thee, saith the Lord of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.

anywaa: Aani gïïa no okwäk wø leeŋ wïthur leeŋa bäätï, ni mara jar ïïni, ni tïïa ïïni na gïr apääda.
english: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.

anywaa: Jø oneen ïïni bëët nyeŋge putge løø wøk dëërï, ni köge, ni ‹Nineba anidwöt. ?Aŋa noo jwöŋi kipere?› ?'Ba ennø, aano jïta kaa ki ŋat mo cøma cwïnyï?»
english: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?

anywaa: ?Wui Nineba, ki jïrï ni beerra ïïni niï kaala Tëbic, pääny Ijep na en bäät Naam Nail, na näk orööc pïïyi, ni naam ee tïïö na gëëŋi, ni tïïc pïï na kiir mare?
english: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

anywaa: Ithiöpia abëëdö na teek mare, këël ki Ijep, ni bëët teeki mare ni bäŋ cuŋŋe; ni ö Puti ki Libya ni bëëtge na jø køny gø.
english: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Libya were thy helpers.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Thëbic gena käl ni ge mak ka tøŋ, ni ö obwöre ni gøyi ki piny nyeŋ jïëthe ni pet ge na thäŋi, ni ö dïbwöthe moe ni pääŋŋi ki køør nyuuthe mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, ni twöc geni ko oguudi.
english: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

anywaa: Ï na Nineba thuwø, ï tïmö kaamar ŋat mo omeer ki køøŋø. Kar gwøk røk marï omanynyï niï kana riï ki nyïïmän moï.
english: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.

anywaa: Kiiri mo pääny moï moa no ogeerø ni teek tïmö ni caala olaam mo nyïïe ociek, mo noo kenyi, nyïïe puta päth piny ni puti leeŋ dhøk.
english: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jø leny moï moø ni en yi paac marï yøø, gena mään. Dhøk kiir mo paac marï ojabø jaak. Dïdëëdi mo dhøk kiir moï othöör maaci.
english: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.

anywaa: Tööm dëërï ki pïï kiper kanyo bëët kiirri no ociel dïër. Tïïc kwör gwøk røk moï ni teek. Ci yo odhöönh ni cwöthï gø, ni tïïï ki thuube.
english: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the mortar, make strong the brickkiln.

anywaa: Jiy moï othöör maaci, ni ö tøŋŋi ni dïïr wïthge kaawat man wø tïïc bäänyö. Määny riï ki lwaak mo päl mo caala lwaa bäänyö, ni thööth kaamar lwaa omør.
english: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, jø gath moï atïïyï ni thööth ni kaala ceer mo maal, 'ba geni paac wø loonyge loonyø ni aacge, kaawat man wø tïïc lwaa bäänyö.
english: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and flieth away.

anywaa: Kwääri moï ki jø kööre moï ge thööth ni caala bäänyö, ni thööthge caala lwaa bäänyö ni wø pï piny bäät kiiri mo pwöth kany wø näk da köö, ni kany wø tuul cäŋŋi, ge puta määtö, ni kany wø cige yie kuc.
english: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

anywaa: Wui nyeny Aciria, dïbwöthe moï obuti ki niir thøø, ni ö jø kööre moï ni narge ki narø mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. Jiy moï okeethi bäät kïte, ni bäŋ ŋat mo cooŋ geni këët.
english: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.

anywaa: Rääö marï na caal ŋwellø ba jïti ki køny, ni ba løny ki man caŋŋe. Jø owïny gïr ränynyö marï bëët ceŋge paŋge paŋø bäätï, ?kiper gïï wø tïïyï na reyø cooth aŋa ni pööth wøk ki ge?
english: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caal tëër na ö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Abakuk.
english: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, akëël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo cøøra ïïni kiper køny, ni dwøra ba wïnynyï? ?Na akëël kany mo nyïëdi nø, noo jwöŋa dëërï kiper gïï ni leth ii, niï ba kunynyï?
english: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!

anywaa: ?Aperŋø na tïïyï aani nee gïï mo leth jooda? ?Na aperŋø na wëëgï gïï ni reyø ii tägö? Ennø, bëët aranya ki tïïc gïï mo leth ajooda; wëëye ko okiera anyaay.
english: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ciik atïmö ni ba tïïö, ni tïm ŋøl luup ni ba thur karge. Jø raay jøøa marge beer acielge dïër, ni tïm ŋøl luup ni di wellø.
english: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

anywaa: «Raŋŋu gïno tïïc wïth juurre ni neennu gø døøc, yïthu othäŋŋi ni rëëm yïthu, kiper aani da gïn mo tïïa tïïö yïth nïne mou,  na gïn mo ba ŋääthu këël doo na olamø jïïu.
english: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, aani jø Kaldia tïŋa maal, jøøa näk cwïnyge keec na näk cwïnyge piew ki lac gïrpiny, ni caathge piny bäre ki man macge kwör bëëte moa näk paa moge.
english: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.

anywaa: Gena jiy mo di lwäärö, mo dëël kwanynyi ki geni. Ciik marge ki teek marge käla baŋge keerge.
english: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

anywaa: Okwëënyi moge rïïŋö døc ni kaala kwäänynye, ni ge kämö ni kaala orude mo wø lwäägi ki wïthïënhö. Jø leny moge ge rïïŋö døc ki bäät okwëënyi, ni ge rïŋŋi ki kany mo bäär, ni ge määnni kaamar odhuuth mo päära bäät gïrpiny.
english: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

anywaa: Ge öö bëët kiper tïï gïn mo leth, ge öö ni gena lwaak ni ge cäänhnha nyïmge ni giirge lwaa dhaanhø ki tøŋ mo caala nyeŋ akwöö.
english: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

anywaa: Geni nyeye wø päätge päädö, ni buuge kwääri, ni ŋïërge bäät päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek, ni thørge ŋøøm maal deŋ päänye ni makge geni.
english: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

anywaa: Køøre ki kany mo thiinh ge puta nimany kaamar jamø, ni laarge pöödhö. 'Ba ge di kwaanø ni geno bääyö, ge na teek marge ege tïïö na jwøk marge.»
english: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, ï na en kur keere, ?aŋø, ï ba käl ya acääŋŋe? Waani, wa ba thøw. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, jø Kaldia akwanyï ki man ŋølge luup. Wui, ï na kïnna teek, tietge akëëllï piny ki man tiirge jiy.
english: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

anywaa: Ïïni, ï tøŋ, niï ba many man neenï gïn mo raac ki waŋï, ni ba løny ki man raŋŋï gïï wø tïïc ni reyø. ?Aperŋø ni neetï jø cwøk jaak en? ?Na aperŋø ni bëëdï niï lïïŋö jaak kany wø öge, ge na jø raay, ni wø thöörge jøøa näk theemma marge ni kaala geni?
english: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

anywaa: Ïïni jiy atïïyï kaamar rec, kaamar gïï wø muuli ki piny mo bäŋ dïbwödhi jïge.
english: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

anywaa: Ge bëët, gena jwïër jø Kaldia wøk kaawat man wø jwïër rec wøk ko obïth, ni piecge geni kaawat man wø pëëö rec wøk ka ajääp bat, ni køølge geni kanya ciel kaawat man wø køøl rec ya ajääp, ni put yïthge mïnnö ni kanyge.
english: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ge wø cïpö ko olämme jï ajääpi moge, ni wääŋge ki gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met jï ajääpi moge, kiper beeye ki køør gïïögø na jïtge ki kwärö, ni tïm cam marge ni päl.
english: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge poot bëëdö no opëëlle moge ege wöth wøk ki man bëëtge ni ge nääŋŋa wïth juurre ni cwïnyge ba pädhi?
english: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

anywaa: Aani a bëëdö naa kurö kaamar ŋat mo cuŋŋa kar koor mare, ni bëëda naa kurö kaamar dhaanhø mo ena bäät gïr koor maal, naa rääŋö ki man neena gïno caan Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ki gïno løøa kanyo jook aani.
english: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jïra ni kööe,  ni «Gïno nyoodha jïrï en göör piny bäät opäm, ni iï tïïö no onieŋ, ni løny ki man kwaani ŋat mo rïïŋö.
english: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

anywaa: Kiper gïno nyooth poot koora kanya wäŋŋi kipere. 'Ba eni laara cwöp øde ni ba kääŋi. Këël doo nëënö no oruu, koor eni, kiper ka adïëri møn, eni öö, ni eni ba ruu.
english: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

anywaa: «Ka adïëri møn, ŋat atöör bäŋ bëëtö mo tiir yi cwïnye, 'ba ŋata mare beer kwøw ki køør ŋäädhe mare.
english: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

anywaa: Maya thuwø, køøŋø jø atöör wø di cøøgø, ni bëëtge ni ge ba jwöm. Geni cwïnyge ege daadø ni päl kaamar bwör, ni caala thøø ni wø ba köö ni ena rømø. Geni wïth juurre bëët wø lemge lemø na moge, ni ge cooŋa jiy bëët kanya ciel na moge.
english: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

anywaa: «?Aŋø, jøøi bëët ii, jøøgø ba cäŋge ki duut aŋaada, ni marge abuua ni ge jøøŋŋa geni, ni köge, ‹Otïmö ni raac jï jø wø löör jammi piny jïge mo paa moge. Kiper akëël kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëtge ni dëëtge thørge thørø ki jap dïgïti?›
english: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ki baŋu ni jiy moa cammu ge ba ö maal ni cwöba rou? ?Ki baŋu ni ge ba päy bäätu ni wëëkge uuni lwär? Ka adïëri møn, u tïmö ni uuna jø otwierge.
english: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?

anywaa: Uuni kiper mana twierru wïth juurre mo thööth, wïth jiy bëët moo dööŋ ni kwøw u twierge twierø, kiper uuni rem jiy akønynyu piny, ni tïïu ki gïï mo leth yi ŋöömö, ki yïth päänye, ki dëët jiy moa bëëdö yïthge.
english: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jï ŋat wø gwän øde ki jammi ki jöö mo raac, ŋat wø bëëdö ni øde ee geer maal kaamar øt wenyø, nee bäŋe gïn mo raany gø.
english: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

anywaa: Gïna caarï ki piny atïmö ni duua lään wïc bäät dhi øtø marï. Ki køør mana dïïrï wïth jiy mo thööth, ïïni ï bääya dëërï keerï.
english: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, kïte moa en dëër øtø orëëdi bäätï, ni ö rïwe moa no opeedhø ni jølge döötge.
english: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jï jø wø geer pääny ki jap rem jiy mo wø kønyge piny, ni wø këël tier pääny piny ni teek ki køør tïïc gïï mo reyø.
english: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

anywaa: ?Neennu, aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, paa eni na caan gø ki man näk mo beeye maac noo pwøc öölö mar jiy, ni ö öölö mar wïth juurre ni cami paapi?
english: Behold, is it not of the Lord of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

anywaa: Kiper piny opäŋ ki ŋäc ajiem mar Wuuö Jwøk, kaawat man wø ö pïïyi ni wø pääŋ naama dwøŋ.
english: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jï ŋat wø lwør athöönh køøŋ ajäla ni maath jø tiet mïëri moa en deŋŋe ni meerge, ki man raŋ lään wïc marge mar bëët wääth dëël.
english: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!

anywaa: Ïïno bëëdö no otaaø na kar mana di ïïni jiemø.  Ennø, ï ki dëërï, ï luunynya mäthö niï dööŋï ki dëërï. Wuuö Jwøk athöönh køøŋ ajäla mar cer cwïïe ï maadhe maadhø ki gø, ni ö ajiemmi marï ni wiil ree ki lään wïc.
english: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

anywaa: Kiper gïna raac na tïïyï dëër lur Libaanø di coolø dëërï, ki mana raanynyï lääy ni wëëgï ge lwär, kiper mana kønynyï rem jiy piny, ni tïïï ki gïï mo leth yi ŋöömö, ki yïth päänye, ki dëët jiy moa bëëdö yïthge.
english: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, gïn wø lam ni wø tieŋ dhaanhe na gïn ma kït gïrpiny, na dïpööy ma twöt, agïnaŋø ni kønye? Kiper ŋat wø tïïc gø, wø ŋäätha gïn wø tïïe ki cere, kany wø tïïe ki kït gïrpiny mo ba cäänö.
english: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jï ŋat wø köö jï jaath, ni ‹Päyï!› ni kööe jï kïdi ni wø bäŋ jwïëy dëëre, ni ‹Ö maal!› ?Aŋø, teeŋ gïnögø, løny jïre ki man cïpe ki pwöc? Neenï, eni dëëre olëënynyö ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö, 'ba eni bäŋ jwïëy dëëre.
english: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö yi øt lam mare na en kur keere; beerra man ö pinynyi bäre ni neebäc nyïme.»
english: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

anywaa: Man beeye lam mar nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Abakuk kanya läme ki yi duut.
english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

anywaa: Wui Wuuö Jwøk, lïëŋ mar nyeŋŋï awïnynya, ni thäŋ yia ki gïr tïïe moï. Wui Wuuö Jwøk, tïïe moa tïïyï, cäŋ tïïyö kar kany ennø, niï tïïya geni nee ŋäc yïth cwiiri moi. Nyooth met ec këël na bëëdï ni ïïno wëër.
english: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

anywaa: Jwøk öö ki yi Tëman, ni eni na en kur keere öö ki bäät Kïn Paran. Ajiem mare maal ee rïëbö bäre, ni piny päŋ ki pwøc mare.
english: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

anywaa: Tar mare caala tac cäŋ, ni tar käla cere, kanya näk teek mare okanø yie.
english: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

anywaa: Eni täw mo leth bwödhö nyïme, ni ö thøøe ni caath køøre.
english: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

anywaa: Ena cuŋŋö ni ree ee jiiø ni nëëk piny, ni räŋŋe ni jäŋ wïth juurre, ni ö kïte na käl piny cøøn ni øcge piny, ni ö thuuri na nut cøøn ni nigemwøny piny. Eni uutjïëth tïïe moe nut ki mana cääŋŋe.
english: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

anywaa: Aani ajooda no oduŋkaare mo jø Kucan ge jäärö, no oduŋkaare mo jø Midien ge leeŋŋa rege.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

anywaa: ?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋø, ï wëër ka näm? ?Aŋø, cwïnyï liel ka nyeŋ näm? ?Aŋø, cwïnyï daaŋ ka näpa døøŋŋø, ni tïme niï cäädhï ka jïëth leny mo wø böödö mo wø tut okwëënyi en?
english: Was the Lord displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?

anywaa: Atum marï akälï wøk, ni jegï atheerø ki man thööthï. Piny akaaŋŋï ki näm.
english: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

anywaa: Kïte ïïna jootge ni putge tïmö ni jäŋŋi, ni ö jwïëö ni pänhnhe, ni ö kanya päŋ ni lwöre ko odhäny, no odhäny mare puta ö maal døc.
english: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

anywaa: Kanya tïm tar mar athëëre moï ni nimal, ni tar mar tøŋ marï nigaaŋ, cäŋ ki dwääy aput cuŋŋö karge maal.
english: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

anywaa: Ki køør räny cwïny marï, dï piny bäre anyørï; ki køør wëër marï, wïth juurre anyøønï piny.
english: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.

anywaa: Ïïna ci nyïm kiper jiyï nee piemï, kiper man piemï dhaanhnhï na näk wïïe othïïmmö ki maaw. Ïïni wï dïbwödhi mar dhi øtø mana raac anyathï, ni lweerï eni na bäre bäre.
english: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

anywaa: Ïïni, tøŋ mar kwääc lwaa leny adwøgï dëëre, kanya öge kaamar apwøyaweerø nee wa keethge, ni met ec marge caala mar jø wø caar jøøa can ki piny.
english: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

anywaa: Naama dwøŋ anyørï ko okwëënyi moï, ni ö pïïa teeki ni nigekum na bööyö.
english: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët awïnynya, ni tïm dëëra ni miel, ni tïm dhaa ni kwanynyi ki lwär, ni ö dëëra ni øc piny, ni tïm tieta ni nhønhnhi. 'Ba a puta bëëtö ni cwïnya yaa cïp piny naa koora cäŋ gïï mo leth mano tägi dëët jiy moo tuk waani.
english: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

anywaa: Këël ni bëëde no olämmi ba nywøl, ni bäŋ nyïëdi ro omøki; ni këël ni bëëde ni bäŋ nyïëdi ro ølipi; ni bäŋ beel yïth pwöth; ni këël ni bëëde ni dïëk bëët othum ki thøø, ni lwääge mo dhäk odööŋ keerge,
english: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

anywaa: a poot bëëdö ni yia met ki ri Wuuö Jwøk, ni bëëda naa kanynyø ki ri Jwøk, eni ni wø piem aani.
english: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

anywaa: Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk beeye teek mara, kiper tieta kwadhe kwadhø ni tïmge ni jööt ni caala tiet aŋer, ni tïïc aani naa cäädha bäät thuuri kwöra en maal.
english: The Lord God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

anywaa: Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana ö bäät Jepaniya o Kuuci, Kuuci o Gedaliya, Gedaliya wär Amariya, Amariya wär Edhekaya. 'Ba dwøl manøgø ööi ki kanya bëët Jöcaya wär Amön ni ena nyeya Juuda.
english: The word of the Lord which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani jammi bëët raanynya raanynyø na bäre bäre bäät piny.
english: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, jiy ge ki lääy bëët, ki weny mo maal, ki rec mo naama dwøŋ, ge raanynya raanynyø. 'Ba kanyo raanynya jiy bäät piny, jøøa reyø geno put ränynyö, ni dööŋge kaamar gïï mo owetø wï thur.
english: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the Lord.

anywaa: «Aani cera tïŋa maal bäät jø Juuda ki jiy bëët mo wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem ni raanynya ge. Aani kwör wø lam jwø wø cwøl ni Baal yïthge, ki thäk jiy moa no odööŋ ni lama gø, ge raanynya raanynyø. Ni raanynya dïlämme mo juuga path nee nyeŋge ba wïnynyi këët.
english: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

anywaa: Ni beege jø wø këël cøŋge piny bäät uudi, ni wø løø wïthge maal kuna lamge cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer, ni wø këël cøŋge piny ni kööŋge ri Wuuö Jwøk, ni ge cäŋa kööŋ ri jwø wø cwøl ni Milköm;
english: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the Lord, and that swear by Malcham;

anywaa: ni beege jøøa døø ŋäthge ki man ba cääthge køør Wuuö Jwøk, na kweer ki man manyge gø wala man pëënyge gø.»
english: And them that are turned back from the Lord; and those that have not sought the Lord, nor enquired for him.

anywaa: Bëëdu nou lïŋö nyïm Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk! Kiper cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk kare acäännö. Kiper Wuuö Jwøk ree ee nø jiiŋŋø ki man 'näk jiy kaawat man wø 'näk lääy mo wø cïp no olämme, ni jøøa näk ee cwølø kiper 'näk manøgø ee nø jiiŋŋø.
english: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is at hand: for the Lord hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Yi cäŋ mano tïïa 'näk mara yie, dïbwöthe, ki wäät nyeya, ki jiy bëët moa näk dëëtge ege røønyø ka abïïk kööŋŋe mo juurre møøk, ge jääla jäälö.
english: And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca jiy bëët mo wø lam juu mo path, ni wø pääŋ uut juu moge ki jammi mo joot ka køør tïïe mo reyø, ki jap twëër, ge jääla jäälö.»
english: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca, oduuru owïnyi ki Dhi Kiir-Rec, ni ö guyö ni wïnye ki thääŋ paac mana nyään, ni ö dööti mo thööth ni wïnye ki bäät thuuri.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

anywaa: Wui, u ni wø bëëdö kwör gath, gööu ko oduuru! Kiper jø gath mou bëët di raanynyø, ni ö jø wø rumö ki gwet-bïrö ni ränyge.
english: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca, yi Jerucalem meenya meenyø ki lambae, ni jääla jø wø bëëdö jaak ni wø cäänö ki cwïnyge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo beer wala gïn mo raac mo tïïe!›
english: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The Lord will not do good, neither will he do evil.

anywaa: Geni, jap kwärö moge otwier, ni dööŋ uudi moge ni bäŋ gïrpiny yïthge. Geno gëëdö ki uudi, 'ba ge ba bëëdö yïthge, ni pïïthge ko omøki, 'ba kwøk nyïïomøki ba maathge.»
english: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

anywaa: Cäŋa dwøŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk aløny ni kare cään; aløny ni kare cään ni läädö døc ki man laar öö. Cegu ïthu, oduuru mo dwøŋ dagø mo tägö yi cäŋ mar Wuuö Jwøk! Yi cäŋ manøgø, jø leny ge kwöŋŋö ki kwöŋŋö mo leth døc.
english: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the Lord: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

anywaa: Cäŋ manøgø tïmö ni beeye cäŋ wëër; na cäŋ kïmmö ki jwør gïï mo leth; na cäŋ aranya ki dïïr wïc; na cäŋ mo piny tïmö na muudhö ni piny dhïïth; na cäŋ mo maal tïmö na pöölö bäre, ki muudhö mo cøl døc.
english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

anywaa: Ni beeye cäŋ mano wïny dwør tuuŋ yie, ki dööt jø leny mo nyaga päänye moa no ogeerø ni teek, ki uut koor moa no ogeer maal yïth gøøde mo kiir.
english: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk gïï mo leth kïthe bäät jiy, ni ö jiyi ni cääthge kaamar cööye, kiper raay moa tïïcge dëëre; remø marge nimata piny kaamar pïï, ni tïm rïŋ dëëtge ni caala wär mo oker piny.
english: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

anywaa: Bäŋ gwel-bïrö marge wala warkey marge mo løny jïre ki man piem geni yi cäŋ wëër mar Wuuö Jwøk; piny bäre ränynyö ki maa këëny cwïny mare, kiper eni jø bäät piny bëët thööre thöörö ki 'näk ki jöö mo di lwäärö.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

anywaa: Wui, u na wï jur mo wïthu ba laay en, cooŋŋu dëëtu kanya ciel,
english: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

anywaa: kanyo poode nou poot kär jwieø wøk kaamar lethø, kanyo poot wëëc Wuuö Jwøk ni wø liel kaamar maac ni poot kär ö bäätu, kanyo poot cäŋ wëëc Wuuö Jwøk ni poot kär ö bäätu.
english: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the Lord's anger come upon you.

anywaa: Manynyu Wuuö Jwøk, u na mwöl bëët bäät piny, ni wø gwøk ciik Wuuö Jwøk. Manynyu bëënynyö, ni manynyu bëët mööl; kanymør u gwøe gwøø cäŋ wëër mare.
english: Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord's anger.

anywaa: Geedha odööŋ ni bäŋ jiy yie, ni ö Ackelön ni dööŋe no oränynyö. Jø Acdöt geno laar käl ki dhöör cäŋ, ni ö jø Akarön ni rïëm geni wøk ki yi pääny marge.
english: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

anywaa: Wui jø Kelita, otïmö ni leth jïïu, u ni wø bëëdö bäät naama dwøŋ. Wui, u ni en yi ŋööm Keenan, ni beeye ŋööm jø Pilitin, dwør Wuuö Jwøk jääla uuni. Eni u raanynye raanynyø, ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dööŋ mo beet ŋöömmögø.
english: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋöömö maru man wø en bäät naama dwøŋ oput tïmö na kar kwaath, na kar bëëtö jï dïkwääye na kar rïïö jï rööm.
english: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

anywaa: Ni put ŋöömmögø tïmö na mar jø dhi øt Juuda moa no odööŋ ni kwøw, ni tïme ni dïëk moge kwaacge yie. 'Ba wø tïme na abøøya, geno wäro ci yïth uut jø Ackelön kuna butge yïthge; kiper geno gwøk Wuuö Jwøki, Jwøk marge; ni ö eni na Wuuö Jwøk ni cäŋ bëëtö marge dwøk kare.
english: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani, ajaany mar jø Möap, ka ajøøŋ mar jø Amön mana tïïcge dëët jiya, ki luupa reyø na carge dëër ŋöömö mar jiya, awïnynya.»
english: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, kaa man bëëda naa kwøw en, jø Möap, poge tïmö kaamar Cødam, ni ö jø Amönni ni tïm poge kaamar Gømöra; ni ö luummi mo raac ni put tuuö yïth ŋøøpge, ni tïm ŋøømmi moge na buri mo acäbö, ni put ŋöömö ränynyö na bäre bäre. Jiy 'moa moa dööŋ ni kwøw, jap jøøgø otwierge, ni putge bëëtö yi ŋöömö mar jøøgø ni tïme na marge.»
english: Therefore as I live, saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

anywaa: Manøgø otïmö na gïno cool dëëtge na kar atöör marge, kiper gena jädö ni buuge jic Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk oput tïmö na gïr lwär jïge kanyo ö Wuuö Jwøki noo raany juu bëët moa en yi ŋöömge. 'Ba wïth juurre bëët moa en bäät naama dwøŋ cøŋge okëëlge piny nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ni wøørge gø, ni ŋati man nø ena yi ŋööm poge.
english: The Lord will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.

anywaa: Wui, u thuwø, u na jø Kuuc, u di nääö ko opëëllö mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk cere orwiee thuwø bäät wï-piny ni jääl gø, ni raany Aciria, ni wëëk pääny Nineba ränynyö ni dööŋe ni bäŋ gïrpiny yie, ni put gø wëëk talø kaamar dïtëën.
english: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba oput tïmö na kar rïc jï pïïth dïëk ki pïïth dhäk, na kany bëët wïth lääy ma teeŋi yie. Tule ki teeŋ wec wäär møga bëët geno noor wïth were mo uudi moe. Weny otïmö ni ge jwöŋi ka dhøk awëërnyeŋŋi mo uudi moe, ni dhøk uudi moe bëëdö no otøyø piny jaak, ni gute mo uudi nëënö wøk jaak.
english: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye gïno tägi dëër pääny mo ogwøø ni teek, mo töödö ni cäänö ki cwïnye, ni «Bee aani keera, ni bäŋ pääny mo kaal aani këët.» Raŋŋu ränynyö mano ränynye ki gø mø; tïmö na kar rïïö jï lääy! Jiy bëët moo pöödhi ki deŋŋe, obuuge, ni ŋeethge bäät gø, ni gwaŋge gø.
english: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

anywaa: Otïmö ni leth jï pääny Jerucalem ni wø caar jiy, ni wø gëëmö ni bëëdö ni ba waany!
english: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

anywaa: Eni bäŋ dwøl mo wïnynye, ni bäŋ acaara mo jïëe. Eni Wuuö Jwøk käre ŋäädhö, ni eni ba nyiik buut Jwøk mare.
english: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord; she drew not near to her God.

anywaa: Dïbwöthe moe ge bëëdö kaamar ŋuuwe mo märö, ni ö dïŋut luupi moe ni bëëtge kaamar kwäänynye mo owär, mo ge cämö ka wäär ni bäŋ gïn wecge kiper amöölla.
english: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

anywaa: Nyïïkuk Jwøk moe gena jiy mo wïthge reyø, ni wïth jiy maaŋge maaŋŋø. Dïlämme moe kar lam mana en kur keere atïïcge ni ba waany, ni raanyge ciik.
english: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk na en yi Jerucalem, mare beeye adïëri, ni eni ba ŋudö ki luup mo patha karge. Ka amöölla cooth adïëri mare wø käle yi tar, ni eni ba døø ŋääe ki gø ki yïth nïne bëët. 'Ba jøøa reyø ge poot temma raay ni wïthge ba lääy.
english: The just Lord is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani wïth juurre anø raanynya, ni wëëga kwör gwøk røk moge na teek na en gøøde mo kiir ränynyö. Nyeŋ jïëthe moge anø raanynya, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo cäädhi ki yïthge; ni wëëga päänye moge niruuth ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo obøth na bäre bäre.
english: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana cädö ni jø Jerucalem doo løny ki man lwäcge ki aani, ni wïnyge pwöc 'moa. Køøre ŋöömö marge daa wiiø ni ba raanynya këët, ni ö ajäla mara bäre mana näk yaa cïp piny kipere ni ba kïtha gø bääte këët. 'Ba geni, ge poot pänynya maal kuna tïïcge japa reyø ki yïth tïïe moge bëët.»
english: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Koorru aani, kiper dïcäŋo cuŋŋa naa cäänna uuni. Aani, anø ŋøla ki man cooŋa wïth juurre ge ki buc nyeye bëët, nee wëër mara bäre ni wø liel kaamar maac nee kønynya bäätge. 'Ba jø bäät piny bäre geno put maaci thöör mar këëny cwïny mara.
english: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

anywaa: «Køøre aano cïpi ki lëëpi mo waany jï wïth juurre, ni tïmge bëët ni ge cøøra nyeŋŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïnyge aani ni dëëtge ege dwalø na aciel.
english: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa en løø näp jø Kuuc løøga, ni beege jiy 'moa moa no okeethø ni wø wøør aani, geno känni jïra ki muuce.
english: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca, u na jiya, wïthu ba lääy këët kiper japa reyø bëët na tïïyu dëëra. Kiper jiy bëët mo wø töödö ni pwøya dëëtge, ge raanynya raanynyø yi Jerucalem; ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo töödö këët bäät kïdi mara na en kur keere.
english: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

anywaa: 'Ba aano kïth yi Jerucalem ki jiy mo mwöl mo dëëtge ege dwøk piny, ni putge bëëtö ni geno göök ri nyeŋŋa, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel moo dööŋ ni kwøw ge ba bääö këët, ni ge ba cäänö ki tööt këët, ni bäŋ luup cwøk mo wïnynyi dhøkge këët. 'Ba geno cämö ni butge jaak, ni bäŋ ŋat wëëk geni lwär.»
english: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

anywaa: Wui Dhayan, ï na caal nyakøø, kwöŋŋï ki met ec! Tïŋ dwørï maal døc, ï na Icriel! Beerra man mïn yiï ni kanynyï ki cwïnyï bäre, ï na Jerucalem na caal nyakøø!
english: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk ajäla marï mana dee ï jäälö ki gø akäl wøk bäätï, ni dwøk nyïïmän moï ŋäthge. Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye nyeny Icriel, nut buutï; bäŋ gïn mo leth mo lwäärï këët.
english: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na Jerucalem, dïcäŋöca ocaan jïrï na ennø nø, «Wui, Dhayan, kärï lwäyö! kär bäätï wëëk pädhö.
english: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marï, nut buutï; ena ŋat leny mo teek man wø böödö. Eni yie omïnni ki ïïni ki met ec mo dwøŋ, ni wëëk ïïni nikïïl yi mëër mare; yie mïnnö bäätï ni kwöŋŋe ki met ec.»
english: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï jø Jerucalem, ni «Kïmmö maru kiper ajwöm mo wø wøørru, käla wøk bäätu; atïmö na tëër bäätu ni känne ki laac wïc bäätu.
english: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca, jiy bëët moa caar uuni jääla jäälö; 'ba puudhi okønya, ni cooŋa jøøa no okeethø na mak ki tøŋ, ni mooa geni ki pwøc ki wödö bäät piny bäre na kar lään wïc marge.
english: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca u cooŋa cooŋø ni duua uuni pou. Aani, u mooa mooø ki wödö ki pwøc ki yïthakic wïth juurre bëët mo bäät ŋøøm, kanyo cäŋa bëëtö maru dwøk kare ni nëënö jïïu ki nyeŋŋu.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Dariöc na ariiø bäät nyec, ni nïr dwää abïciel aciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë kiper Dherubabel o Celatiyal na bëëdö na kwäärö mar akwöm Juuda, ki Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

anywaa: 'Ba gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee en, ena köö, ni «Jiy moi aköö, ni ‹Ennø, kany geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk yie kare poodi.› »
english: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the Lord's house should be built.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk dwøre aput jääŋŋö ki ri nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë na ennø nø,
english: Then came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø, bee gïn mo beer ki jïïu ki man bëëdu yïth uudi mo ogeerø ni beyø, ni øtø mara bëëdö no oränynyö?»
english: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your ceiled houses, and this house lie waste?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, bee en, ena köö, ni «Beerra man cädu kiper bëëtö maru.
english: Now therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

anywaa: Uuna bëëdö nou pïïdhö ki gïï mo thööth, 'ba atïmö ni duua mo nøk. U bëëdö nou cämö, 'ba u ba jäŋ. U bëëdö nou mädhö, 'ba u ba røm. U ruuö ka abïïe, 'ba dëëtu ba murri. U mägö ki jap kwäk mou, 'ba kïïce mou bëëdö kede otuc.»
english: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

anywaa: Man bee gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni «Cädu kiper bëëtö maru!
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Consider your ways.

anywaa: Ethu maal bäät kïte, ni ŋudu ki jenni ni kälu ge piny, ni geerru øtø mara; køøre nø, yia omïnni ki gø, ni jiem a ki køøre.
english: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the Lord.

anywaa: U cädö nou jïtö ki mo thööth, 'ba tïmö nou joota mo nøk. 'Ba kany wø kïthu ge paac, puta ka kooth ki jam dhaa.» Køøre Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, na «?Aperŋø ni wø täk gïïögø? Beeye kiper na weyu øtø mara no oränynyö, ni tïm ŋati man nø ni lääŋŋa øde keere ki man jiiŋ gø.
english: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the Lord of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, maal atïmö ni ba cïpi ki thööy, ni ö pinynyi thuwø ni ba cïpe ki caammi.
english: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.

anywaa: Ni cwöla meel bäät pwöth, ki bäät kïte, ki bäät beel, ki bäät jer omøki, ki bäät jer wø nyïïge wel na maaw, ki bäät gïïa no otuy bäät piny, ki bäät jiy ki lääc paac, ki bäät gïïa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu na ööllu ki ge.»
english: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

anywaa: Køøre Dherubabel o Celatiyal, ki Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk, na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki jiy bëët moa no odööŋ na bøth dhøk gïï mo leth, gena jïëy ki dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, ki luubö mana car nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Agëë, kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge na jääŋ gø baŋge. Ni ö jiyi ni putge lwäyö ki Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre Agëë, na jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki, dwør Wuuö Jwøk man acaane jï jiy na ennø nø, ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Aani, a bëëdö ka uuni.› »
english: Then spake Haggai the Lord's messenger in the Lord's message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk atïïö cwïny Dherubabel o Celatiyal na bëëdö na kwäärö mar akwöm Juuda, ki cwïny Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki cwïny jiy bëët moa no odööŋ na bøth dhøk gïï mo leth, ni putge ö maal ni täkge ki geer Øt Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, eni na wïth jammi bëët,
english: And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of hosts, their God,

anywaa: kanya tïm nïr dwää abïciel na pïërariiø kurŋween ri riet cwiiri mo nyeya ma Dariöc.
english: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää abïriiø na pïërariiø kurciel, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë ni kööe,
english: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the Lord by the prophet Haggai, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï Dherubabel o Celatiyal eni na kwäärö mar akwöm Juuda, ki Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk, eni na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki jiy moa dööŋ na bøth dhøk gïï mo leth, ni kööï,
english: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

anywaa: na ‹?A jøøe dëëtu ni poot kwøw ni ŋäc bëëtö mar Øt Jwøk man ka ajiem mare mana dïkwøŋ? ?A kawaane ennø, nëëne kaamar ŋø ki jïïu? ?Ba nëëni keda gïn mo bäŋgø jaak ki jïïu?
english: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ï na Dherubabel, ki ï na Jøcua wär Jöcëdëk, ni bee ï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki u na jø paac bëët, magu dëëtu ni tïïyu tïïc; 'ba a ena buutu.› Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of hosts:

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ köö, ni ‹Manøgø beeye luumma tuuda ki uuni kanya ööu wøk ki Ijep. 'Ba jwïëy 'moa poot bëëdö ki uuni. Käru lwäyö.›
english: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.

anywaa: «Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni ‹Ki kany mo thiinh, aani, maal ki piny, ki näpa døøŋŋø, ki ŋøøm moa no otal cäŋa ka jäŋŋö ki yie aciel keere.
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

anywaa: Ni jäŋa wïth juurre bëët, ni ö jap kwär mo wïth juurre bëët ni käli; køøre a na Wuuö Jwøk, na en wïth jammi bëët, øtø man pääŋa pääŋö ka ajiem.
english: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Kiper gwet-bïrö beege 'moa, ni warkey beege 'moa thuwø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, na en wïth jammi bëët.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba ajiem mar øtø man tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni døc no opöödhö ki øtø mana dïkwøŋ. 'Ba aani thuwø, bëët-mëër cïba cïbö kany.› Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.»
english: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the Lord of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää abïŋween na pïërariiø kurŋween, ni cwiic Dariöc ariiø bäät nyec, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë na ennø nø,
english: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man bee gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Pëëny dïlämme ki gïna caan ciiki kiper luubö man.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

anywaa: Ni näk dhaanhø käädö ki rïŋö mo ocïp kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk ni ee bääö ka abïï, ni gut møø ki deŋ abïïnögø, wala kadø, wala køøŋ nyïïomøki, wala maaw, wala gïn mo di  camø jaak, ?løny ki man tïm gïïögø ni ena kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk?› » 'Ba kanya pëëny dïlämme ki pïëc manøgø, gena köö, ni «Jïre bäär.»
english: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

anywaa: Køøre Agëë aköö, «?A ni näk da dhaanhø mo otïmö ni ba waany ki køør mana gut gïn mo othøw, ni gute ki gïrpiny aciel røk japøge, gïnaca tïmö ni ba waany?» Ni løgi ya dïlämme, ni «Kare, tïmö ni ba waany.»
english: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Agëë, ni kööe, ni «Gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Gïnögø bee teeŋ gïna tïïc jiyi moi ni beege wï jur man, ni nëëni jïra en, kiper tïïe moge bëët ko olämme mo wø cïpge ba waany.
english: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

anywaa: « ‹'Ba ki mano täge ennø, beerra man caarru gïna tägö kanya poode ni Øt Wuuö Jwøk poot kär tääö ki geer.
english: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the Lord:

anywaa: Kar kaaca, kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo cøøa kar beel nee jïte ki rumme ma pïërariiø, eni tïmö ni joota rumme apaar keerge. Ni kany wø ö dhaanhø noo ci kar biic nyïïomøki nee jïte ki rumme ma pïërabïïc, tïmö ni joota rumme ma pïerariiø keerge.
english: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.

anywaa: Aani jammi moa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu bëët araanynya ki jamø mo lïëth, ki twöŋö, ki pey; 'ba u kär duu baŋa. Manøgø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mano täge dïcäŋ man ni nïr dwää abïŋween pïërariiø kurŋween, cädu kiper dïcäŋa cagu tier Øt Wuuö Jwøk ki geer.
