english: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the Lord's temple was laid, consider it.

anywaa: Këël ni bëëde ni bäŋ köödhi mo odööŋ yo odek, no omøki, ko olämmi, ka adikwäle, ki jaath man wø nyïïe wel na maaw poot kär jïtö ki nyïëdi, ki mano täge dïcäŋi ennø kiree, u gwïëdha gwïëdhö.› »
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ öö ri rietge bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Agëë, ni nïr dwääy pïërariiø kurŋween.
english: And again the word of the Lord came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Caanï jï Dherubabel, eni na kwäärö mar akwöm Juuda, ni kööï, ni ‹Maal ki piny jäŋa jaŋö.
english: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

anywaa: Ni ö wäle mo buc nyeye mo wïth juurre ni jaalla ge, ni raanynya teek marge. Ni raanynya jïëth okwëënyi mo leny, ki jø wø kiiw geni. Ni ö okwëëc leny ki jø wø kiiw ge ni päänhge. Ni ö ŋati man nø ni nägi yo opëëllö mar wati.›
english: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

anywaa: «'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni ‹Noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, ï na dhaanhnha ma Dherubabel o Celatiyal, ï lwøra lwørø ni tïïa ïïni kaamar ogut lweedø mara mana näk ree da ŋïï, kiper ï yaa jierø.› Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.»
english: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the Lord, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Dariöc ni ena nyeya Parca, kanya tïme na ri riet cwiiri moe bäät nyec ki dwää abära, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Dhekaraya wär Berekiya, nyikwaar Idö.
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «A na Wuuö Jwøk, aana bëëdö ni aano gootø ki kwäyu.
english: The Lord hath been sore displeased with your fathers.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, a cäänna uuni, ‹Luu nyïmmu baŋa, nee nyïma luua baŋu.› Manøgø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët.
english: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Käru tïmö kaamar kwäyu. Kwäyu luup 'moa ajääŋŋa baŋge kar kaaca ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk 'moa mo acääŋŋe ni kööa, ni ‹Man beeye dwøra, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët: «Ennø, weyu uutjïëthe mou na reyø ki tïïe mou na reyø.» › 'Ba gena kweer ki man cekge ïthge wala ki man wïnyge luumma. 'Ba luummögø caana aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: ?Age kwäyu ennø? ?A nyïïkuk Jwøk, gena løny ki man bëëtge na bäre bäre?
english: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, luup 'moa ki ciik 'moa na köömma geni ki ge ki dhøk jiya ma nyïïkuk Jwøk kärge kwierø ni jïtge ka ajäla? 'Ba køøre raacge akøpge ni köge, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, gïn atïïe dëëtø ki køør uutjïëthe 'moø ki japa reyø na tïïø, ni beeye tiere ni put gø tïïc møn kaawat mana cooŋ gø.› »
english: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the Lord of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm nïr dwää apaar kurciel na pïërariiø kurŋween, ni beeye dwääna cwøl ni Cebat, ni poot na ri riet cwiic nyec mo Dariöc, dwør Wuuö Jwøk acäŋ ö bäät nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Dhekaraya wär Berekiya, nyikwaar Idö, ni caan japa joode na ennø nø:
english: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the Lord unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

anywaa: Aani, da gïn ma anyooth jïra ki wäär. Aana jïtö ki dhaanhø nyïma mo cäädhi ka bäät okweeny lääy mo kwaar. Ni ööe ni mäk piny ni cuŋŋe tiet jenni bäät waŋ, ni jiy møøk mo cäädhi ka bäät okwëënyi mo kwayø, ki mo obwörö, ki mo tar ena buute.
english: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.

anywaa: Køøre aana pëëö, ni «?Kwäärö, moøgø a jøøe?» Ni løgi ya nyïïatwiel maalli jïra mana cäänö ki aani, ni «Aani, tier luubö marge ocaana jïrï.»
english: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋata näk cuŋŋö tiet jenni aput løk jïra ni kööe, ni «Jøøgø beege jøøa jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki nee cääthge bäät piny bäre.»
english: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the Lord hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø aputge løk jï nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk na näk cuŋŋö tiet jenni, ni köge, ni «Waani bäät piny acaathwa bäre, ni jootwa gø na adïëri møn ni jiy bëët geno jwöm ni ge ena yi bëët-mëër.»
english: And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk aköö, «Wui Wuuö Jwøk, ï na wïth jammi bëët, ?A kany mo nyïëdi noo bëëdï ni bäth ec marï ba nyoothï jï Jerucalem ki päänye mo Juuda na gootï ki geni ki cwiiyi na pïërabïriiø ii?»
english: Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Wuuö Jwøki jï nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani, ni løøe ka dwøl mo met ki yi cäänö mar cøm  cwïny.
english: And the Lord answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aköö jïra, ni «Gøø luubö man piny na ennø nø: Ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Aani, aana këëyö døc kiper Jerucalem ki Dhayan.
english: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

anywaa: 'Ba aana gootø døc ki wïth juurre moa näk bëëtö marge jööt, kiper kanya bëëda ni aano gootø ki mo thiinh, ge poot bëëdö ni ge meeta tïï gïï mo reyø.›
english: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki bee en, ena köö, ni ‹Aani a duua Jerucalem ni bäth ec mara yaa nyoodhø jïre; ni ö øtø mara ni cäŋi geerrø yie, ni ö Jerucalemmi ni cäŋi geerrø bäre.› » Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Therefore thus saith the Lord; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the Lord of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö jïra, ni «Cäŋ luubö man gøø piny na ennø nø: Ni man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Päänye 'moa, yïthge cäŋa päŋŋö ki jap kwär, ni cäŋa cwïny Dhayan cømmø, ni cäŋa Jerucalem jierrø.› »
english: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the Lord of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre aana lwïthö; 'ba ka adïëri møn tuŋi aŋween mo lääy aputa joot.
english: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aputa pëënynyö, ni «?Moi agïïaŋøøni?» Ni løk gø jïra, ni «Moøgø beege jiy moa näk wïthge ege tïŋ maal kaamar tuk lääy, ni beege jøøa wëëk jø Juuda keethø, ki jø Icriel, ki jø Jerucalem.»
english: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk jiy aŋween ma rëëmme mo thääth anyoodhe jïra.
english: And the Lord shewed me four carpenters.

anywaa: Køøre aana pëëö, ni «?Jøøi öge baŋ ŋø nee tïïcge?» Ni løk gø jïra, ni «Rëëmme moøgø ge ööa baŋ jiy moa näk wïthge ege tïŋ maal kaamar tuk lääy, ni beege jøøa wëëk jø Juuda keethø, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny ki man tïŋ wïïe maal. 'Ba öö marge ge ööa kuna wëëkge jøøgø lwär, nee put ge raanynyø, ni beege wïth juurre moa näk wïthge ege tïŋ maal kaamar tuk lääy ki man raanyge ŋööm Juuda nee jiye keethge.»
english: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.

anywaa: Køøre aana lwïthö ni jïta ki dhaanhø nyïma mo cere da thøør røm.
english: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

anywaa: Ni pëënynya gø, ni «Ï ciï kaa ŋø cøøn?» Ni løk gø jïra, na «A cøøa kuna røma Jerucalem nee lïŋ dööŋ yie ki bär mare nee jooda.»
english: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aay, ni put mørri öö ni røømge ki gø,
english: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

anywaa: ni kööe jï gø, ni «Reŋ baŋ nyenece ni cere da thøør røm ice, ni caanï gø jïre, ni ‹Jerucalem otïmö na pääny mo bäŋ kiir deŋŋe kiper mano tïm jiyi ki lääc paac ni thööth yie døc.
english: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra, a na Wuuö Jwøk, aano tïmö kaamar kiir jïre mo bëëdö ni caala maac deŋŋe, ni tïma ni aana ajiem mano en yie.›
english: For I, saith the Lord, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

anywaa: «Wui, u na jiya, ööu maal, ni rïŋŋu wøk ki yi ŋöömma en jï løø wï-piny, kiper aani uuna nø keetha yïth tuk piny moa na aŋween kwör wø ö jamø ki yïthge.
english: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wui, jø Dhayan! U ni wø bëëdö yi Babiløn, pänynyu wøk!»
english: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.

anywaa: Kiper man bee gïna caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, «Køør mana nø jiem aani, aana jääŋŋe baŋ wïth juurre moa caar uuni, kiper ena köö, ni ‹Jø wø gut uuni guta guu waŋa.›
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, cera puta ka tïŋ maal bäätge ni jääla ge, ni ö jøøa näk ege caarø ni twierge ge. Køøre nø, putge ka ŋäc ni bee Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na jääŋ aani.
english: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me.

anywaa: «Wui jø Dhayan! Kwöŋŋu ki met ec, kiper aana öö naa bëëda dïïu. Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïme na dïcäŋeca, wïth juurre mo thööth geno ö baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïmge na jiy 'moa thuwø. Ni bëëda dïïu ni putu gø ŋäc ni bee Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi  bëët, na jääŋ aani baŋu.
english: And many nations shall be joined to the Lord in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk ŋööm Juuda otïmö na kure yi ŋöömma en kur keere, ni cäŋ Jerucalem jierrø na pääny mare.
english: And the Lord shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

anywaa: Wui u na jiy bëët, noukïïl nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, kiper ena nø ö maal ki kar bëëtö mare na en kur keere.»
english: Be silent, O all flesh, before the Lord: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

anywaa: Køøre Wuuö Jwøk Jøcua na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ anyoodhe jïra ni cuŋŋö nyïm nyïïatwiel maal, ni Ceethan cuŋŋö jï løø bäät cer cwïïe, ni kïtha bäät gø ki luup mo reyø.
english: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Ceethan, ni «Nyie Ceethan, ïïno jook Wuuö Jwøki! Wuuö Jwøk na jier Jerucalem ïïno jooe! ?Aŋø, ŋati ni kïthï bääte ki luup mo reyø en paa ŋata caal jaath mo liel mo käl wøk ka yi maac?»
english: And the Lord said unto Satan, The Lord rebuke thee, O Satan; even the Lord that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

anywaa: 'Ba Jøcua kanya cuŋŋe nyïm nyïïatwiel maal, eno ruyö ka abïïe mo okïl ki cïlö.
english: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal aköö jï jiy moa näk cuŋŋö nyïme, na «Abïïk Jøcua moø no okïl ki cïlö yøø, kälu wøk dëëre!» Køøre ena köö jï Jøcua, ni «Raŋï, aani raay moï apaanya bäätï; 'ba dëërï orunynya ka abïïe mo beyø.»
english: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.

anywaa: Køøre aana köö jï jøøa en kaace, ni «Kïthu wï Jøcua ka abïï mo tøŋ man wø rïëp wïc.» Kanyøgø abïï mo tøŋ man wø rïëp wïc aputge kïth wï gø, ni runyge dëër gø ka abïïe, ni nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk poot cuŋŋö buute.
english: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the Lord stood by.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk Jøcua acäänne na ennø nø:
english: And the angel of the Lord protested unto Joshua, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Ni näk miï cäädhö ki uutjïëthe 'moa, ni tïïyï tïïe 'moa, øt lam mara ki yïth käälle moe bëët cïba cerï, ni raŋŋï jammi mo wø tïïc yie bëët; ni jaba jöö jïrï ki man cuŋŋï nyïma kaamar jøøi ni cuŋŋi kany ii.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.

anywaa: « ‹Wui ï na Jøcua, ni bee ï na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, cek ïthï ki nyïïawäätï moø no opï piny buutï yøø, ni beege jøøa näk nyuuthe kiper gïïo tägi yi nyïm. Kiper ka adïëri møn, aani dhaanhnha na caal lwinh jaath 'käla kälö.
english: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

anywaa: Raŋŋu kïdi mø mana näk yaa cïp nyïm Jøcua! Da nyeŋ abïriiø mo raŋ mo ena dëër kïdi manøgø na aciel enø. 'Ba aani, jammi møøk ogööra bääte; ni ööa ni paanya raay bäät jiy moi ni en yi ŋöömö man en ki dïcäŋ aciel.› Manøgø beeye luumma caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.»
english: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the Lord of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca, ŋati man nø dëëtu watge cwøle cwølø ki met ec ni pïge piny ki gø tier jaath omøk mare ki tier olaam mare.»
english: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aduuö ni jiec aani kaa man wø jiec dhaanhø yïth niine.
english: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

anywaa: Ni pëëny aani ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni neetï enø?» Ni løøa gø jïre, na «A neeta gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte mo otïïö ki warkey, ki mäc abïriiø mo liel wïïe, ni wïïe da wïl maaw ki gïï ma abïriiø mo wø jääŋ maaw baŋ mäc moa liel.
english: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:

anywaa: Eni thuwø deŋŋe da jer wø nyïïe wel na maaw ma ariiø mo ena buut wïlli manøgø, na aciel ena bäät cwïïc, ni ö maya ni en bäät caam.»
english: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani apëënynya ni kööa, ni «?Kwääya, moøgø agïïaŋøøni?»
english: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïra, na «?Aŋø, gïïögø kuyï?» Ni kööa, ni «Kuua, kwääya.»
english: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Man beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk mana caane jï Dherubabel, ena köö, ni ‹Paa ki teek wala ki mak røk, 'ba beeye ki køør jwïëy 'moa.› Manøgø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the Lord unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: «Wui, ï na kïnna dwøŋ! ?Ïïna agïnaŋø? Ïïni, ï tïmö na ŋøøm mo ree päärö nyïm  Dherubabel. Køøre eni kïdi mana näk aŋuudi mar geer okäle ni kïth gø dëër Øt Jwøk ni jiy kwöŋŋö ki met ec, ni ‹Eno gwïëth Jwøki! Eno gwïëth Jwøki!› »
english: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aput ö bääta ni kööe,
english: Moreover the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ceŋ mo Dherubabel tier Øt Jwøk man na nø tääe en ki tïïc, oput thöör. Køøre putu ka ŋäc ni bee Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na jääŋ aani baŋu.
english: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you.

anywaa: «?Aŋø, aŋa ni wø taak cäŋ man wø täk tïïc ni thiinh yie? 'Ba jiy yïthge omïnni kanyo jootge gïr røm man wø nyooth tiir mar øtø ni ena cer Dherubabel. «'Ba gïïa na abïriiø beege nyeŋ mo Wuuö Jwøk mo wø bëëdö ni wïdö ni raŋŋa bäät piny bäre.»
english: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the Lord, which run to and fro through the whole earth.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal acäŋa pëënynyö, ni «?Jenni moi na ariiø ii ni wø nyïïe wel na maaw en, na aciel ena cwïï gïn wø cuŋ lambae bääte, ni ö maya ni en bäät caame, tiere aŋø?»
english: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋa pëënynyö, ni «?Bäädi mo jenni mo wø nyïïge wel na maaw moø na ariiø yøø ni en buut gïïö na ariiø yøø no otïïö ki warkey ni yïthge ŋammø ni caala bööl ni wø kuny wøk ki maaw mo caala warkey, gena gïïaŋø?»
english: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïra, na «?Aŋø, gïïögø kuyï?» Ni kööa, ni «Kuua, kwääya.»
english: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø aløøe ni kööe, ni «Gïïögø na ariiø yøø beege jøøa näk wïthge othïïmmö ki maaw ki man tïnyge Wuuö Jwøk, eni na kwääc bäät piny bäre.»
english: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na cäŋa lwïthö, ka adïëri møn, aana put jïtö ki pïën mo onyøŋø mo määdö mo luup Jwøk ogöör bääte.
english: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli jïra, na «Agïnaŋø ni neetï en?» Ni løøa gø, na «A neeta pïën mo määdö, mo bär mare gööye ma pïërariiø, ni dööŋ yie gööye apaar.»
english: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jïra, ni «Manøgø beeye acïëni mano ö bäät piny bäre. Ka adïëri møn, jiy bëët mo wø kwädö geno raanynyi ki køør luup moa no ogöörö løø pïënögø aciel, ni raany jiy mo wø kööŋ jaak ki tööt ki køør luup moa no ogöörö løø pïënögø aciel maya.
english: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.

anywaa: Aani na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, pïën manøgø jääŋŋa jääŋŋö wøk, ni døny yïth uudi mo kuuwe ki yïth uudi mo jø wø kööŋ ri nyeŋŋa jaak ki tööt, këël mano thöör wäär ni raanynya uudi mo jøøgø, ni put jenni ki kïte ränynyö moa geer uudi ki ge.»
english: I will bring it forth, saith the Lord of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aö baŋa ni kööe jïra, ni «Lwïthï ni raŋï gïn ni ö wøk en, man näk gïnaŋø.»
english: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.

anywaa: Køøre aana pëëö, ni «?Gïnögø aŋøøni?» Ni kööe, ni «Gïnögø beeye oröögö mar røm.» Ni cäŋ köö, «Ni gïnögø beeye raay mo jø bäät piny bäre.»
english: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna näk wï oröögö manøgø orïëbö ki gø, na näk otïïö ki nywïënyö ma eracaac, ree ajabe, ni yo orööŋŋögø da dhaagø mo opï piny yi gø.
english: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maal manøgø jïra, ni «Dhaaŋŋøgø beeye nyuudhi mar rääö.» Køøre eni dhaaŋŋøgø aput thiel piny yo orööŋŋögø ni put wï oröögö na näk otïïö ki nywïënyö ma eracaac cïëk bäät gø.
english: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.

anywaa: Køøre na lwïtha maal, aana put jïtö ki mään ariiø mo jïge da bwöm kaamar aliil, mo ge määdö yi jamø, ni öge ni ceecge orööŋŋögø ni määtge maal ki gø.
english: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani aputa pëënynyö, no «?Oröögö kïthge gø kaa?»
english: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïra, ni «Ge kïtha gø yi ŋööm Babiløn nee gëënni ki øtø yie. 'Ba kanyo jiiŋ øtø manøgø, eno put bëëtö kare kunece.»
english: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana cäŋ lwïthö maal ni jooda jïëth okwëënyi aŋween  mo ööa wøk ki yïthakic kïte ariiø; 'ba kïte moøgø bëëdö kaamar nywïënyö ma jwïël.
english: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.

anywaa: 'Ba jään okweeny mana dïkwøŋ tuta okwëënyi mo kwayø, ni rietge tuta okwëënyi mo cøl,
english: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;

anywaa: ni dääge tuta okwëënyi mo tar, ni ŋweerge tuta okwëënyi mo rege da kït ma apøøl. 'Ba geni bëët ge teek døc.
english: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal mana cäänö ki aani apëënynya ni kööa, ni «?Kwäärö mara, moi agïïaŋøøni?»
english: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyïïatwiel maalli jïra, ni «Moøgø beege jwïëy aŋween mo wø en maal, ni ge ö wøk ka kany wø cuŋge yie nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, eni na kwääc bäät piny bäre.
english: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jään okweeny mana tut okwëënyi moa cøl aci yïth mïëri moa en jï løø wï-piny, ni ö jään okweeny mana tut okwëënyi moa tar ni läp køør gø, ni ö jään okweeny mana tut okwëënyi moa näk kïtge apøøl ni ci yïth mïëri moa en jï løø tier-piny.»
english: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

anywaa: 'Ba okwëënyi moøgø ni teek yøø, kanya tïmge ni ge manynya aa wøk, gena bëëdö ni tietge cäcge cäyö kiper wääth man wïrge bäät piny bäre. Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni wïrru bäät piny bäre!» Køøre gena put cøø ni wïrge gø.
english: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiel maal aana cwøle ni kööe, ni «Neenï, jøøa jääŋŋi yïth mïëri moa en wï-piny, cwïny Wuuö Jwøk acïpge piny yi ŋöömö mana en jï løø wï-piny.»
english: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bääta ni kööe na ennø,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ciï ni kännï ki warkey ki gwel-bïrö ki baŋ Kelday, ki Thöbiya, ki Jidaya, jøøa no omaaø ki tøŋ na duuö ki yi Babiløn. 'Ba dïcäŋögø thuwø wär ci po Jöcaya wär Jepaniya,
english: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;

anywaa: ni lwørï warkey ki gwel-bïrö ni tïïï ka aduda ni kïthï gø wï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni beeye Jøcua o Jöcëdëk.
english: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

anywaa: Ni caanï gø jïre ni man bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Man bee dhaanhø mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Lwinh Jaath; eno løth kaamar lwinh jaath kanya en yie, ni geer øtø mar Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the Lord:

anywaa: Bee eni noo geer øtø mar Wuuö Jwøk, ni jïte ka ajiem, ni pï bäät wälu mare ni käär paac, ni put tïmö na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ bäät wälu mare. 'Ba tïïe moø na ariiø yøø odwale ki bëët-mëër.›
english: Even he shall build the temple of the Lord; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

anywaa: 'Ba aduda ocïp cer Kelday ki Thöbiya ki Jidaya ki Jöcaya wär Jepaniya, nee tïme na gïr par wïc yi øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwörge bäyö geno ööi ni kønyge uuni ki geer øtø mar Wuuö Jwøk; køøre putu ka ŋäc ni bee Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, na jääŋ aani baŋu. Gïnögø otägi ni näk dwør Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk maru, leŋu leŋø.»
english: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the Lord, and ye shall know that the Lord of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwïïc Dariöc na aŋween bäät nyec, dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Dhekaraya ni nïr dwää abïŋween aŋween, ni beeye dwääy mana cwøl ni Kiclep.
english: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø jø Bëthël, jiy møøk ege nø jääŋŋö nee Wuuö Jwøk kwacge, ni beege Carëdher ki Regem-Melek ki jicge,
english: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem–melech, and their men, to pray before the Lord,

anywaa: ni ge cäänö ki dïlämme mo wø tïïö Øt Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, wa doo bëëdö ni wa kïmmö ni wa tïïya wödö mar kwier cam ki dwää abïïc, kaawat mana bëëtwa ni wa tïïya gø ki yïth cwiiri moa thööth na pöödhö?»
english: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the Lord of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aö bääta ni kööe,
english: Then came the word of the Lord of hosts unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «Caanï jï jiy bëët moa en yi ŋööm paac, ki dïlämme, ni kööï, ni ‹Kanya bëëdu nou tïïya wödö mar kwier cam nou kïmmö ki dwää abïïc ki dwää abïriiø ki cwiiri moa näk pïërabïriiø na pöödhö, ?aŋø, wödö maru kar kaace mar kwier cam tïïyu kapera na bëëde cøøn enø?
english: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?

anywaa: ?A kanya wara bëëdu thuwø nou cämö nou mädhö, ajwöm moøgø paa kiper dëëtu keeru na bëëde?
english: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

anywaa: ?Aŋø,  moøgø paa luup moa car Wuuö Jwøki ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk mo acääŋŋe, kanya poode ni Jerucalem ki päänye moa en deŋŋe bëëdö ni päŋ ki jiy, ni bëëtö mar jiy jööt jaak, ni mïëri moa en jï løø tier-piny ki mïëri moa en deŋ kïte jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ ge bëëdö ni päŋ ki jiy?› »
english: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk aö bäät Dhekaraya ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah, saying,

anywaa: ni «Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ena köö, ni ‹Ŋøllu luup ki jöör ŋøl mana näk kare, ni ö ŋati man nø ni nyooth mëër ki bäth ec mare jï wati maya.
english: Thus speaketh the Lord of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:

anywaa: Kär määr thuunhnhi, ki kïïe, ki juurre moa path, ki jøøa can thielu piny. Ni ö ŋati man nø ni bäŋe gïn mo raac mo maae ki cwïnye ki wati maya.›
english: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

anywaa: «'Ba jiy akweer ki man cekge ïthge; ni putge ŋäthge løk ki dïwït marge, ni dhïŋge ïthge ni ge kwiera luup.
english: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.

anywaa: Geni, cwïnyge atïïcge ni teek kaamar kïdi, ni tïmge ni ciik ba wïnyge, ki luup Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni beege luupe na jääŋŋe ki køør Jwïëye na en kur keere ki røk nyïïkuk Jwøk mo acääŋŋe. Kiper manøgønø, wëër mo dwøŋ aput öö ki baŋ Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the Lord of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: «Køøre Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni ‹Kar kaagø, aput tïmö ni kany wø cwøla geni dwøra ba wïnyge; ni kany wø cwølge aani döötge ba wïnynya thuwø.
english: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts:

anywaa: 'Ba aani gena puta keethø ka atuunna mo teek døc ni putge ci yïthakic wïth juurre mo kucge. Kanyøgø nø ŋöömö aput dööŋŋö ni bäŋ jiy yie, ni put tïmö ni bäŋ ŋat mo ci yie këët, kiper bee geni na tïïc ŋöömma beer nee dööŋe ni bäŋ jiy yie.› »
english: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.

anywaa: 'Ba dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, acäŋ ö bääta na ennønø:
english: Again the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying,

anywaa: ni «A na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, dwøra mana caana bee en: ‹Aani, aana këëyö døc kiper Dhayan; cwïnya awaaŋ ki këëny mana këëya kipere.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani, a duua yi Dhayan ni beeye Jerucalem, naa bëëda yie. Kanyøgønø Jerucalem ocwøl ni Pääny Mar Adïëri, ni cwøl kïdi mar Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni Kïnna En Kur Keere.»
english: Thus saith the Lord; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the Lord of hosts the holy mountain.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, no «Ocäŋ tïmö ni da cwøw mo ojal ki mään mo ojal mo opï piny nyeŋ jïëthe mo Jerucalem, ni ŋati man nø cere da athøra mo kwömö ki gø kiper jalø mare.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeŋ jïëthe mo pääny ni cäŋge päŋŋö ko obwöc cwøw ko obwöc mään mo kwääk yïthge.»
english: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, na «?Aŋø, këël na bëëde ni luummögø nëëni keda gïn mo ba tägi ki jï thäk jøøi moo bøth ni kwøw kar kaace, dhäthö jïra thuwø ki man täge?» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Ka adïëri møn, aani jiya moa en jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki moa en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ piema piemø,
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;

anywaa: ni duua geni nee bëëtge yi Jerucalem, ni tïmge na jiya ni tïma ni aana Jwøk marge ki ra adïëri ki bëëtö mo thïïŋ.»
english: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «U ni wø wïny luup moi ennø dhøk nyïïkuk 'moa ki mana täge ki kanya cak tier Øt Jwøk ki geer, ni beeye øtø mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, magu dëëtu ki tïïc nee Øt Jwøk geer.
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the Lord of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.

anywaa: Kiper kanya poot nïrögø, bäŋ tïïc mo di cunnö ki gwel kiper dhaanhø wala lääy; ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo duny yi paac wala mo dønynya wøk ki yi paac, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ bëët-mëër kiper nyïïmän. Aani jiy bëët atïïa nee ŋati man nø døø ri nyawatge ki tïï gïn mo raac.
english: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk na en with  jammi bëët, a caana gø jïïu ni teeŋ gïna tïïa røk nïne moa pöödhö, ba tïïa këët dëët thäk jiy moi no odööŋ ni kwøw en.
english: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Kiper maalø køth ojääŋŋe piny, ni ö köödhi ni tucge, ni ö omøki ni nywølge ki nyïëdi, ni ö jap pinynyi ni ciekge. Japøgø bëët wëëga tägö kiper thäk jøøi moa dööŋ ni kwøw.
english: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Juuda ki jø Icriel, kaa mana bëëdu ni uuno cienø dï wïth juurre, u piema piemø ni tïmu ni uuna jiy mo ogwïëdhö. Käru lwäyö; beerra man magu dëëtu ki tïïc.»
english: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Aana bëëdö ki kwäyu ni ge temma temmø ki gïï mo leth kanya bëëtge ni ge raanynya cwïnya naa goota, ni bëëda ni bäth ec mara kära nyoodhø jïge;
english: For thus saith the Lord of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the Lord of hosts, and I repented not:

anywaa: 'ba ennø, yïth nïne moi aana cäŋ cädö ki man tïïa ki gïn mo beer kiper jø Jerucalem ki dhi øt Juuda. Käru lwäyö këët nø!
english: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moi tïme ni beege moo tïïyu: ŋati man nø dëëtu wär tïme ni cäänö ka adïëri jï watge maya; ni ŋøøllu luup na adïëri, nee paac maru jïte ki bëëtmëër.
english: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat mo tudö ki luubö mo raac kiper wati, ni ba mëërru ki man kööŋŋu ki luup tööt. Kiper aani, japøge bëët beege jap wø mäna ki ge.» Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.
english: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre dwør Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, acäŋ ö bääta ni kööe,
english: And the word of the Lord of hosts came unto me, saying,

anywaa: ni «A na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, dwøra mana caana bee en: ‹Wödö mar kwier cam man wø tïïyu ki dwää aŋween, ki dwää abïïc, ki dwää abïriiø, ki man wø tïïyu ki dwää apaar, tïmö na mar met ec ki kanynyø, na kany wøør ajwöm-cam yie kiper dhi øt Juuda. Kiper manøgønø, mëërru ka adïëri ni mëërru ki bëët-mëër.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Wïth juurre mo thööth ki jø päänye mo thööth poot dagø mo öö,
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:

anywaa: ni ö jø päänynyi man nø ni köge jï jø pääny møga, ni ‹Beerra man cøø ennø kuna wøørø Wuuö Jwøk ni manynyø Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët. Waani, wa cøø!›
english: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the Lord, and to seek the Lord of hosts: I will go also.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy mo thööth ki wïth juurre mo teek geno put ö Jerucalem kuna manyge Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, nee wøørge.»
english: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the Lord.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Yïth nïne moøgø, jiy apaar ki røk wïth juurre ki dhøgi bëët abïïn ŋat Juuth man nø omakge ni köge, ni ‹Beerra man aa ki uuni na aciel, kiper awïnywa ni Jwøk ena buutu.› »
english: Thus saith the Lord of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.

anywaa: Luum Wuuö Jwøk na caal tëër ena bäät ŋööm Adrak ni jääla gø, këël mano këët Damacka; kiper jiy ki wïth tuŋi bëët mo Icriel, nyeŋge atïmö ni ena dëër Wuuö Jwøk.
english: The burden of the word of the Lord in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋööm Amath na kïïö ki mïëyögø di jäälö thuwø, këël mano këët Tayar ki Caydan, këël na bëët mïëri moøgø na mïëri mo wïth jiy moge leer døc.
english: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyre, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

anywaa: Tayar dëëre ee gëënnö ki kwör gwøk røk mo teek, ni gwet-bïrö ee löör piny kaamar ŋøøm, ni löör warkey piny ni päl jaak kaamar odhöönh man wø en nyeŋ jïëthe.
english: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.

anywaa: 'Ba kwär mare oraany Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøki, ni leeŋ jap kwär moe yi naama dwøŋ; ni put eni waaŋ ki maac, ni puti ya maaci thöör.
english: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.

anywaa: 'Ba eno joot pääny Ackelön, ni put pääny Ackëlön lwäyö; ni jooti ya pääny Geedha, ni ö pääny Geedha ni put dëëre nikem.  'Ba eno joot pääny Akarön thuwø, ni put ŋäädhe mar pääny Akarön ränynyö. Geedha nyeya mare otïmö ni bäŋgø, ni ö pääny Ackëlön ni tïme ni bäŋ jiy yie.
english: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Wëëlle ŋööm Acdöt omacge, ni ööa ni raanynya atöör mar jø Pilitin.
english: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

anywaa: Aani rïŋ moge mo wø camge ni rege jääbö ki rem käla wøk dhøkge; ni ö caammi moge mo wø camge na näk ba waany ni gwëëna ge wøk tiet lak moge. 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw rege, otïmö na jiy 'moa, a na Wuuö Jwøk, ni putge tïmö na bwöthe yi Juuda; ni ö jø Akarön ni tïmge kaamar jø Jeebuc.
english: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ŋöömö mara ogwøa, nee bäŋe jø leny mo ŋutö ki yie wala mo duuö ki yie. Bäŋ jø dïïm mo ö kuna caarge jiya këët, kiper ennø a nut naa kurö.
english: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.

anywaa: «Wui, Dhayan, yiï mïnne døc! Ni kwöŋŋï ki met ec, ni bee ï na Jerucalem! Raŋï, nyeya marï ööa baŋï, ŋat mo mare beeye adïëri, mo käära pïëm man piem jiy ki gø; eni mwöl, ni ena bäät arëën, ni beeye bäät nya arëën mana thiinh.
english: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.

anywaa: Jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi mo Ipariem, ko okwëënyi mo leny mo wø en Jerucalem, otïïa ni bäŋ tïïc ceŋge, ni tøya tøøk leny bëët. Nyeya manøgø öö kuna køp bëëtmëër jï jiy bëët, ni käär piny ni tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, këël mano këët jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni cäŋ tägö ki Naam Upareeti këël cuŋ piny.
english: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from the river even to the ends of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kiperu thuwø, ki køør rem luumma tuuda ki uuni, u käla wøk yi buura bäär na näk otal na twöö uuni yie.
english: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø twöc mo cwïnyge da ŋäädhe en, døøu kar gwøk røk mana teek; kiper a caana gø jïïu dïcäŋi ni jammi moa jwørru coola coolø jïïu ki gwïëth mo opöödhö.
english: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;

anywaa: Aani jø Juuda ge tïïa tïïö kaamar atummi, ni ö jø Ipariem ni tïmge na athëëre moge. Wui, ï na Dhayan, jiy moï tïïa tïïö kaamar opëël leny, ni öge maal ki leny bäät jø Gïrïïk.»
english: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

anywaa: Kar kaace Wuuö Jwøk ree onyoodhe bäät jiye ki man køny geni, na atheerø mare nadaaŋ kaamar agaackøth. Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk tuuŋ okoodhe, ni wëëk atuunna kwönnö ni teek ki jï løø tier-piny.
english: And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the Lord God shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, jiye ocwaae, ni ö jiye ni dïïrge wïth nyïïmän moge, ni put tïmö ni ge nyøra kïte moa thööc geni ki ge ri leny. Geno twäädö bäät nyïïmän moge kede geno meer ki køøŋø. Dëëtge opäŋ ki rem jiy moa 'näkge,  ni tïmge kaamar athaanh olämme mo päŋ ki remø man wø ker teegi mo gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: The Lord of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge, geno pieme dïcäŋöca kaa man wø ö dïkwääyi wø piem dïëk moe cer gïn mo raac; kiper geno tïmö ni ge mïërö yi ŋöömö mar Wuuö Jwøk kaamar nyeŋ kïte moa perge leth ni wø en dëër aduda.
english: And the Lord their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.

anywaa: A teeŋ kïdö mo nyïëdi ki mïërö mano tägi dëëtge! Beel mo ŋöömmögø obwöc cwøw owëëk piith ni dëëtge teek, ni ö kwøk nyïïomøki moe moa nyärö ni wëëk obwöc mään piith ni dëëtge teek.
english: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.

anywaa: Pëënynyu Wuuö Jwøk nee køth jääŋŋe bäätu kany wø näk dhi køth. Kiper beeye Wuuö Jwøk ni wø jääŋ køth ki ri pøøl; bee eni ni wø wëëk køth ööny piny kiper jiy, ni wëëk gïïa no opiidhø ciek yïth pwöth jï ŋati man nø.
english: Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.

anywaa: Juu moa näk patha adïëri ge cara tööt, ni jø adïëda jammi mo wø carge no onyoodhø jïge beege mo cwøk; geni, ge cara lääk mo patha adïëri, ni ge cøømma cwïny jiy ki gïï mo bäŋ tietge. Kiper manøgønø, jiy thääyö kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge, ni caar geni kiper na bäŋe ŋat bwøth geni.
english: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani, gootø mara liel kaamar maac bäät dïbwöthe. Dïbwöthe jääla jäälö; kiper a na Wuuö Jwøk na en wïth jammi bëët, pïïth mara gwøa gwøø, ni beege jø dhi øt Juuda, ni tïïa ge kaamar okweeny leny man wø ŋwöö ki gø ri leny.
english: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the Lord of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.

anywaa: 'Ba dïbwöthe mo bëëdö kaamar kït gøøt, ki mo bëëdö kaamar mucumääre mo wø gur oduŋkaara piny ki ge, ki mo bëëdö kaamar atheerø mar leny, ki teeŋ dïbwöthe møga bëët, di joodø ki røk jø dhi øt Juuda.
english: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.

anywaa: 'Ba geni bëët, geno tïmö kaamar jø leny mo teek mo wø nyør nyïïmän moge ri leny yïth odhöönhe mo nyeŋ jïëthe. 'Ba kiper mana näk mo Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ka geni, geno këëdi ni böötge jø wø këëdi ki bäät okwëënyi.
english: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.

anywaa: «Aani jø dhi øt Juuda wëëga tëënnö, ni piema jø dhi øt Jocep. Aani bëëtö marge dwøga kare, kiper bäth ec mara yaa nyoodhø bäätge. Geno bëëdö kaamar jiy mo kede ge kära kwøŋ kwier, kiper aana Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk marge. Aani lam man wø lämge ki gø løøa løø jïge.
english: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and will hear them.

anywaa: Jø tuuŋ Ipariem geno bëëdö kaamar jø leny mo teek, ni bëëtge ni cwïnyge omïnnö kaamar jiy mo omädhö ki køøŋø. Obwöre moge køny manøgø ojootge ni kanyge;  ni ö cwïnyge ni mïnne ki aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the Lord.

anywaa: Aani, jø Icriel ocwøla ki lwiyø naa cooŋa geni kanya ciel, kiper aani ge ya nø wïïl wøk; ni tïm kwäänge ni thööth ni caala mana kwøŋge bëëtö.
english: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo keetha geni dï wïth juurre, wïthge parge parø ki aani yïth mïëri moø ni kwörge bäyö yøø, ni ö geni ko obwöre moge ni bëëtge kunece ni cäŋge duuö yi nyïme.
english: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.

anywaa: Aani, ge duua duuö ki yi ŋööm Ijep, ni gwäära geni ki ya Aciria. Ni ööa ni dääa ge yi ŋööm Gelät ki Libaanø, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany mo di joodø mo ge røma yie.
english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.

anywaa: Geni, ge puta pöödhö ki yi bëëtö mo leth mo caala athaŋ naama dwøŋ, 'ba aani, athaga manøgø gøøa gøø, nee kwöra päŋ mo Naam Nail talge, ni ö atöör mar Aciria ni puti dwøk piny, ni ö teeki mar Ijep ni ränynye.
english: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.

anywaa: 'Ba a na Wuuö Jwøk, geno mooa ki teek, ni ö geni ni bëëtge ni ge wøøra nyeŋŋa.» Manøgø bee dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And I will strengthen them in the Lord; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Wui lur Libaanø, jap dhøk odhuule moï, nee jenni moï moa perge leth cam maaci!
english: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

anywaa: Wui, jenni moa beyø, gööu ko oduuru, kiper jenni moa perge leth apädhö, ni ö jenni moa mïërö ni raanynyi. Wui, jenni mo Baacan na døøŋŋø na teek, gööu ko oduuru, kiper lul mana no odhïŋ aŋøt piny.
english: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.

anywaa: Cegu ïthu ko oduuru mar dïkwääc dïëk, kiper kar kwaath mana no oløth ni pulli aränynyö! Cegu ïthu ki märö mar ŋuuwe, kiper lur Jördan mana no odhïŋ aränynyö.
english: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, luumma caane jïra beeye en, ena köö, ni «Gwøk pïïth dïëk moa no omooø ki ŋïï kiper ŋaal.
english: Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø ŋeew ge wø ŋaalge ŋaalø ni putge aay ni dëëtge bäŋ ajäla. Ni ö jøøa gath ge ni köge, ‹Waana kwär! Pwøc en jï Wuuö Jwøk!› 'Ba dïkwääye moge cwïnyge ba pädhi ki gïrge.
english: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.

anywaa: 'Ba aani thuwø, a na Wuuö Jwøk, cwïnya ba pädhi këët ki gïr jiy moi ni bëëdö yi ŋöömö man en. 'Ba ŋati man nø ocïba cer ŋat atut mare ki nyeya marge, ni ö ŋöömö ni putge gø raanynyø. 'Ba aani ge ba piema ceŋge.»
english: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the Lord: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, pïïth dïëk moa no omooø ki ŋïï kiper ŋaal agwøa, ni beege dïëk moa näk ocännö døc. Køøre aana lwötö ka athøre ariiø, ni caa nyeŋ mana dïkwøŋ ni Mëër, ni ö nyeŋ maya ni caa gø ni Dwätö; ni puta pïïth dïëk gwøk.
english: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yi dwääy aciel, dïkwääc dïëk moa na adäk ariemma. Kiper aana kwierge, ni puta gootø ki geni thuwø;
english: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.

anywaa: ni kööa, na «A ba tïmö ni aana dïkwääy maru këët. Moa näk manynya thøø, thøwge, ni ö moa many ränynyö ni ränyge, 'ba moo dööŋ ni kwøw geno døø rege ni camge rïŋ dëëtge.»
english: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.

anywaa: Køøre, athøra mara mana näk nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Mëër alwøra ni toora gø; ni manøgø beeye nyuudhi ki man näk maa raanynya luumma tuuda ki wïth juurre bëët.
english: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.

anywaa: Aputa raanynyø møn dïcäŋöca, ni ö dïëk moa no ocaarø na  bëëdö ni ge køya aani ni putge gø ŋäc ni manøgø beeye dwør Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni caana gø jïge, ni «Ni näk bee gïn mo beer ki jïïu, coollu japa; 'ba ni näk jïïu bäyö, weyu.» Kanyøgønø aana putge cunnö ki gwet-bïrö ma pïëradäk.
english: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö jïra, ni «Leeŋ baŋ dïcwäc dääe,» ni beege gäta mana beer na coolge jïra! Kanyøgø gwet-bïrö moøgø alwøra ni leeŋa ge baŋ dïcwäc dääe yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And the Lord said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the Lord.

anywaa: Køøre riet athøra mara mana näk nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Dwätö alwøra ni toora gø; ni manøgø nyootha ränynyö mar dwätö mana en yïthakic jø Juuda ki jø Icriel.
english: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki jïra, ni «Lwør jap tïïc mo dïkwääy dïëk mo jääk.
english: And the Lord said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

anywaa: Kiper aani a tïŋŋa maal yi ŋöömö man ki dïkwääy dïëk mo ba cädö kiper dïëk moa no orwäänyö, wala ki man many moa therø, wala ki man køny moa näk rege da ŋwiili, wala ki man caam moa dëëtge jööt; 'ba eno bëëdö ni cämö ki rïŋ dïëk moa no ojierø, ni cääny okiei moge wøk.
english: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni leth jï dïkwääy dïëk mo bëëdö ni jääk, ni dïëk ee wiiø! Eni cer cwïïe ki waŋe mana en bäät cwïïe oŋøl ko opëëllö! Cere mana en bäät cwïïe obäp, ni ö waŋe mana en bäät cwïïe ni tïme ni ba rääŋö!»
english: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luum Wuuö Jwøk na caal tëër na caane kiper jø Icriel. Wuuö Jwøk, eni na peer maal, na këël tier piny piny, na kïth jwïëy mo dhaanhø dëër gø, dwøre mana caane bee en, ena köö,
english: The burden of the word of the Lord for Israel, saith the Lord, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.

anywaa: ni «Aani, a ööa kuna tïïa Jerucalem ni caala athöödhi mo yie da køøŋø mo jiy moa en deŋŋe bëët mäthö dëër gø ni wëëk ge bøømmø. 'Ba kanyo ciel Jerucalem dïër, orwöp ki mïëc Juuda møga thuwø.
english: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca, kanyo ö wïth juurre bëët mo bäät piny noo cooŋge rege ki man tukge Jerucalem, aani, Jerucalem otïïa kaamar kïdi mo peek mo ba løny ki tuk kare jï wïth juurre bëët. 'Ba jiy bëët moo pääny gø ki man tïŋge gø maal, ŋwiili mo leth døc opïï dëëtge.»
english: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca, aani, okwëëc leny bëët mo nyïïmän geno wëëga lwär, ni ö jiyi moa cäädhö ki bäätge ni wëëga ge bøølø. 'Ba aani, dhi øt Juuda koora koorø døc ni waŋa yaa këël ree. 'Ba okwëëc leny bëët mo wïth juurre ge tïïa tïïö na cööye.
english: In that day, saith the Lord, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.

anywaa: Køøre dïbwöthe mo Juuda geno cäänö ki cwïnyge ni köge, ni ‹Jø Jerucalem gena jïtö ki teek ki køør mana tïïc Jwøki, kiper Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, beeye Jwøk marge.›
english: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the Lord of hosts their God.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋöca, aani, dïbwöthe mo Juuda ge tïïa tïïö kaamar abat mo yie da maac mo ocïp tiet moonni, ni ge caala ameeth mo liel yïthakic kude mo abäy; ni thöörge wïth juurre bëët moa en deŋge, moo en bäät cwïïc ki moo en bäät caam. 'Ba jø Jerucalem ge cäŋa bëëtö karge yi Jerucalem.»
english: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk kwör bëëte mo jø Juuda kwøŋe ka piem dïkwøŋ, na ajiem mar dhi øt Deebit ka ajiem mar jø Jerucalem nee ba pöödhe ni kaala mar jø Juuda møga.
english: The Lord also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca, Wuuö Jwøk jø Jerucalem ogwøe, ni ö jøøa jägö dïge ni tïmge ni teek dïcäŋöca kaamar Deebit, ni ö jø dhi øt Deebit ni bwøthge jiy kaamar Jwøk, ni ge caala nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö Jwøk mo bwödhö nyïmge.
english: In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca wïth juurre bëët moo tïïc leny bäät Jerucalem ge raanynya raanynyø.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

anywaa: «Dïcäŋöca, aani, jwïëc met ec ki jwïëc lam kønynya bäät dhi øt Deebit ki  bäät jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem. Kanyøgønø geno tïmö ni ge neeta ŋata cwøpge ki tøŋ, ni kïmge kiper gø kaawat man wø kïm dhaanhe bäät nyaare aciel keere mo othøw, ni jwöŋge kiper gø ni yïthge ege keeyø døc kaawat man wø jwöŋ dhaanhe bäät wääde ma kanynye mo othøw.
english: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca oduuru mano en Jerucalem otïmö ni dwøŋ døc ni caala oduuc jø Adat-Rimmön mana jwøkge pwöl paana cwøl ni Megidø.
english: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

anywaa: Jiy moa en ŋööm paac bäre geno kïmmi, jø dhi øtø man nø geno kïmmi keerge; jø dhi øt Deebit geno kïmmi keerge, ni ö määrge ni kïmge keerge; jø dhi øt Nathan geno kïmmi keerge, ni ö määrge ni kïmge keerge;
english: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

anywaa: jø dhi øt Libay geno kïmmi keerge, ni ö määrge ni kïmge keerge; jø dhi øt Cimiy geno kïmmi keerge, ni ö määrge ni kïmge keerge;
english: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;

anywaa: jø dhøk uudi møga bëët geno kïmmi keerge, ni ö määnni moge thuwø ni kïmge keerge.»
english: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Noo tïme na dïcäŋöca jøøro ojap jï dhi øt Deebit ki jø wø bëëdö Jerucalem kiper nee raay moge pïny wøk ni tïïc ge ni waany.»
english: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca, juu moa näk patha adïëri raanynya raanynyø yi ŋöömö ni tïme ni wïc ba par ki nyeŋge këët. Ge raanynya raanynyø ge bëët ki nyïïkuk Jwøk moa näk patha adïëri ki jwïëc juuga reyø na näk ba waany.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

anywaa: 'Ba noo dee dhaanhø mo poot cäänö ki luup mo patha adïëri kiper yi nyïm, wänni ki menni na nywøl gø kiree geno köö jïgø, ni ‹Ï thøw! kiper ïïna cäänö ki luup tööt ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.› 'Ba kanyo caan luummögø kiree, eni put wänni ki menni na nywøl gø cwøp ki tøŋ.
english: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the Lord: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋöca, nyikuŋ Jwøk man nø mana näk patha adïëri wïïe olääy ki køør luup tööt moe na care, ni ba ruye ka abïïna näk cwääc ka jïër ni wø käär nyïïkuk Jwøki, kaa mana wara røc gø ni maaŋŋa wïth jiy ki gø.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:

anywaa: 'Ba eno kööi, na ‹A patha nyikuŋ Jwøk; aana ŋat puur, a bëëdö naa bëënna puur cøøn ki mana käla thïnhö ni aano ŋeeø na laŋŋø.›
english: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

anywaa: 'Ba eno pëëny dhaanhe mørri, ni ‹?Ŋwiili moi otägö dëërï nidïï?› 'Ba oløøe, ni ‹Moøgø beege ŋwiili moa pïï dëëra kanya bëëda po nyïïawääta.› »
english: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, «Wui, opëëllö! Ö maal ni 'nägï dïkwääy mar dïëk 'moa; 'näk eni, eni na kare cään ki aani; 'näk dïkwääy nee dïëk keethge; 'ba aani cera ocäŋa løø bäät obwöre moa therø.»
english: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the Lord of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Dïcäŋöca bäät piny bäre, ki ri jiy adäk, ariiø othøw, ni tïme ni dööŋŋa dhaanhø aciel keere ni kwøw ki ri jiy adäk.
english: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the Lord, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moø noo dööŋ ki ra adäk yøø, geno kïtha yïth gïï mo leth mo caala maac, nee tïmge ni waany, kaamar man wø leeny warkey ki gwel-bïrö ki maac, ni twønna gø. Kanyøgø nyeŋŋa ocwølge, ni løøa luubö marge; aano kööi, ni ‹Beege jiy 'moa,› 'ba geno kööi, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk beeye Jwøk marwa.› »
english: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The Lord is my God.

anywaa: Wui Jerucalem, ka adïëri møn, cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk aløny ni öö, ni beeye cäŋo twier ïïni yie, noo pääŋ jammi moï nyïmï ni nëënö jïrï.
english: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aani, wïth juurre bëët ge cooŋa cooŋø ni öge kuna këëtge ki Jerucalem. Pääny Jerucalem omak, ni twier uudi moe, ni gøc mään moe ki piny, ni ö thääŋö mar jiy ni mak geni ki tøŋ. 'Ba jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw, ge ba ŋul wøk këët yi pääny.»
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk eno døny wøk kuna këëde ki wïth juurre moøgø kaawat man wø këëde dïcäŋ leny.
english: Then shall the Lord go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca Wuuö Jwøk tiere okëël bäät Kïn Ølip ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki Jerucalem, ni ö Kïn Ølip ni kaae ki dïëre ni tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni put dïëre tïmö na waŋ aleya mo dwøŋ, ni jööt thääŋ kïdi maya jï løø wï-piny, ni ö thääŋŋe maya ni jööt jï løø tierpiny.
english: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno reŋi ki ya aleny kïdi mana tïïe, kiper aleny kïdi mana tïïe okëët ŋööm Adhel. Uuno reŋi kaawat mana reŋu ki dïjäŋ piny mana tägö ri nïr Udhaya, nyeny Juuda. Køøre Wuuö Jwøk, Jwøk mara, eno ööi ki nyïïatwiet maal bëët na en kur keerge.
english: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the Lord my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca otïmö ni bäŋ tar, 'ba beeye lwøc mo cøl;
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:

anywaa: kiper otïmö na cäŋ mo ena kur keere mo ŋäya Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye cäŋ mo patha dïcäŋ wala wäär. 'Ba noo tïme na ŋec wëëlle, tar otïmö ni dagø.
english: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the Lord, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca pï kwøw okwön wøk ki yi Jerucalem, ni ö thääŋö mar pïïögø ni jööt yi naama dwøŋ jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni ö thääŋŋe maya ni jööt yi naama dwøŋ na en jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ; ni manøgø tägi ka yi cwiir ki öörö bäre.
english: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk otïmö na nyeya kiper bäät piny bäre. Dïcäŋöca Wuuö Jwøk otïmö ni bee Jwøka eni keere, ni nyeŋŋe bee eni keere.
english: And the Lord shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Lord, and his name one.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋööm paac bäre, ki mano täge Gëba këël Rimön na en jï løø tier-piny ki Jerucalem, otïmö ni ree päärö kaamar ŋööm Araba. 'Ba Jerucalem otïmö ni raŋa maal ni bëëdö kare, ki mano täge ki dhi kiir Benjamen këël buut dhi kiir mana dïkwøŋ na en jï løø dhi kiir mana en gøøt kiir, ki mano cäŋ tägö ki Øt Koor Mar Ananel këël kany wø nywøp køøŋ nyeya yie.
english: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.

anywaa: Jiy obëëdö yie, ni bëëde ni bäŋ acïëni mo ö bääte këët, kiper Jerucalem obëëdö no okoorø.
english: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

anywaa: 'Ba ajäl täw mano ö Wuuö Jwøki noo 'näk jiy bëët ki gø moa tïïc leny dëër Jerucalem bee en: Rïŋ dëëtge kwäk ni ge cuŋŋö ki tietge jaak, ni kwäk nyeŋge yïth aguut nyeŋge, ni ö lëëpge ni kwäkge dhøkge.
english: And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.

anywaa: Dïcäŋöca lwär mo dwøŋ mo käla baŋ Wuuö Jwøk ööa bäätge; ni ö ŋati man nø ni gam cer watge, ni ö manni nø ni tïŋ cere maal bäät watge ni ge pööta rege keerge.
english: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the Lord shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.

anywaa: Jø Juuda thuwø geno këëdi ni ge gwøga Jerucalem, ni ö jap kwär mo wïth juurre bëët moa en deŋge ni cooŋge ge ni thööth døc, ni beege warkey, ki gwet-bïrö, ka abïïe.
english: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.

anywaa: 'Ba ajäl täw mo caala manøgø thuwø ööa bäät lääc paac mo nyïïmän kuna 'näk ge, ni beege bäät okwëëc lääy, ki gääŋŋe, ka athïrööle, ka arëëni, ki bäät lääc paac bëët moa en yïth twëëre moge.
english: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.

anywaa: Køøre jiy moo dööŋ ni kwøw ki røk wïth juurre bëët moa tïïc leny bäät Jerucalem, geno wäro cii ki yi cwiir cooth kuna wøørge nyeya ma Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni cige ni wøørge ajwöm wø wøør ni jøw ena yïth abïle.
english: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.

anywaa: 'Ba jø bäät piny moo kweer ki man cige Jerucalem kuna wøørge nyeya ma Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, otïmö ni bäŋ køth mo pädhi yi ŋöömö marge.
english: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.

anywaa: Ni näk mo jø Ijep ge ba ci baŋ wödö, køth otïmö ni bäŋgø mo pädhi yi ŋöömö marge. Wuuö Jwøk ajäla manøgø ojääŋŋe bäätge kaawat mano jääŋŋe bäät wïth juurre moo kweer ki man cige kuna wøørge ajwöm wø wøør ni jøw ena yïth abïle.
english: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the Lord will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

anywaa: Manøgø otïmö ni beeye ajäla mano jääl jø Ijep ki gø ki wïth juurre bëët moo kweer ki man wøørge ajwöm wø wøør ni jøw ena yïth abïle.
english: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca luubö man ogöör bäät athaliiŋŋi mo wø en ŋut okwëënyi ni  «Gïn ena kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk.» 'Ba dääe thuwø mo Øt Wuuö Jwøk otïmö ni ena kur keerge kaamar athääe mo wø en nyïm gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE Lord; and the pots in the Lord's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.

anywaa: Këël dääe bëët moa en yi Jerucalem ki moa en yi Juuda otïmö ni ena kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët. 'Ba jiy bëët moo wäro ö baŋ cïp olämme, geno lwöti røk dääe moøgø ni tëëtge ki ge. Dïcäŋöca otïmö ni bäŋ dïgäthe këët yi Øt Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the Lord of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Man beeye dwøl mana caan Wuuö Jwøki jï jø Icriel ki dhi nyikuŋŋe ma Milkiya.
english: The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aana bëëdö naa mëër ki uuni.» 'Ba uuna köö, ni «?Mëër marï iï nyoodhø jïwa nidïï?» Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, na «?Aŋø, Icøø paa cöök Jeekapi? 'Ba aana bëëdö naa mëër ki Jeekap,
english: I have loved you, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob,

anywaa: ni männa ki Icøø, ni raanynya poge na en bäät kïte, ni wëëga wï poge dööŋŋö jï othööe na näk lääc paap.»
english: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.

anywaa: Kanymør jø Ëdöm köö, ni «Powa oraanynyø; 'ba waano duui ni cäŋwa kwöra no oränynyö geerrø.» 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Këël ge doo gëëdö, poot nyaa piny. Ni ö jiyi ni cwølge kaace ni po jøøa reyø, ni beege jøøa wëër Wuuö  Jwøki ki geni na bäre bäre.
english: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.

anywaa: Gïnögø ojootu ki nyeŋŋu ni putu köö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk dwøŋ møn, këël yïth mïëri møga ni patha Icriel keere.› »
english: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The Lord will be magnified from the border of Israel.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Nyilaal wänni di wøørø, ni ö ŋat tïïci ni wøør kwäärö mare. Wøp nø; ?ni näk mo aana wääu, age wödö mana nyoothu jïra? ?Ni näk mo aana kwääyu thuwø, age lwär mana nyoothu jïra? Uuni na dïlämme, beeye uuni na taak aani. «'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹?Ï ewa taaø nidïï?›
english: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the Lord of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?

anywaa: «Aana taagu kany wø cïpu ki cam mo raac bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk mara. «'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹?Nyeŋŋï ewa raanynyø nidïï?› «Beeye kiper mana kööu, ni ‹Gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo wøør ree.›
english: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the Lord is contemptible.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kany wø cïpu lääy ma cööye no olämme, paa gïn mo obøth? ?Ni kany wø cïpu lääy ma ŋööte ki moa näk dëëtge da täwe, paa gïn mo obøth thuwø? Wär pääru ki man cïpu teeŋ lääyöge jï kwäärö maru. ?Aŋø, løny jïre ki man tïm yie ni met ki uuni? ?A løny jïre ki man pänh uuni ni yie met?» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: «'Ba kawaane, u na dïlämme, ?aŋø ni ba kwayu Jwøk nø nee yie tïme ni bäth ki waani? ?Aŋø, ki køør teeŋ olämme mo wø cïpu yøø, løny jïre ki man pänh uuni ni yie met?» Gïnögø poot caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, «Beerra mana di dhaanhø acielli cøø dëëtu ni cïëk dhøgi mo kal mar Øt Jwøk, kiper nee bäŋe dhaanhø dïïu mo äp maac bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mana näk mara ki gïn mo bäŋ tiere jaak. Bäŋ gïn mo døøc yia mo met ki uuni; olämme moo cïpu jïra ba jïëa.
english: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the Lord of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋŋa otïmö ni dwøŋ dï juurre, ni tägi ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ këël jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ; ni ö gïn wø jïye ŋwääi ni met ki muuce mo beel moa näk liil ni cïbi jïra ki yi piny bäre, kiper nyeŋŋa otïmö ni dwøŋ dï juurre.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö, «'Ba nyeŋŋa araanynyu kiper na kööu, ni ‹Gïn wø cïp olämme bääte mar Wuuö Jwøk bäŋ gïn mo wøør ree, ni caammi mo wø cïp bääte beege moa no oränynyö jaak.›
english: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the Lord is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
