anywaa: Ni kööu, ni ‹Tïïc man duua öölö jaak,› ni ŋøllu gø ki laaw.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët. Ni cäŋ köö, na «?Aŋø, kany wø kännu ki lääy mo lwørru ka teek ceŋ jiy, wala lääy ma ŋööte wala mo tuu, ni cïpu geni no olämme, you caarø ni daa jïëö baŋu?
english: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the Lord of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba acïëni oen bäät ŋata näk jïre da nywø diel mo beer dï pïïth mare, na näk eno kööŋ ki man cïp gø jïra, ni cïp mana raac na kar gø no olämi jïra, ni møta aani, a na Wuuö Jwøk. Kiper aana nyeya mo kare dwøŋ, ni nyeŋŋa di lwäärö dï wïth juurre bëët.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the Lord of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Uuni na dïlämme, ciik man a cäänna uuni ki gø.
english: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ïthu ba cegu, ni ba kanu gø cwïnynyu ki man wøørru nyeŋŋa, u jääla jäälö døc, ni tïïa gwïëth man wø gwïëthu jiy ki gø na acïëni. Ka adïëri møn, gwïëth maru yaa nø cien ennø, kiper ciik mara käru kan cwïnynyu.
english: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the Lord of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.

anywaa: Neennu, nyïïu jääla jäälö, ni wëëga täärnyïmmu rwøth ki weenynye mo lääy moa cïp no olämme, ni put uuni wetø ki gø na aciel bëët.
english: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.

anywaa: Køøre nø, putu ka ŋäc ni ciik man yaa nø jääŋŋö jïïu kiper nee luumma tuuda nee bëëde ni nut yïthakicwa ki nyïïkwaac Libay na näk dïlämme.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Gïna tuutwa ki nyïïkwaac Libay,  tiere beeye luum kwøw ki bëët-mëër, ni cïba gø jïge kiper naa wøørge, ni ö geni ni wøørge aani ni lwäärge nyeŋŋa.
english: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.

anywaa: Geni, gena pöö ki pwöc ma kare, ni bäŋ gïn mo obøth mo owïnynyö dhøkge. Gena bëëdö ki aani ki bëët-mëër ni cwïnyge leer, ni duuge jiy mo thööth wøk ki jöör raay.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.

anywaa: «Kiper dïlämi doo naa bëëdö ni ciik Jwøk ŋääe ni ena dhee, ni di jiyi ö baŋe kiper pwöc, kiper bee eni na jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuna gaa wøk øtjöö, ni wëëgu jiy mo thööth pädhö ki køør pwöc mou, ni raanynyu gïna tuuda ki nyïïkwaac Libay.
english: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Køøre nø aani thuwø, uuna tïïa ni uuno dwøk piny, ni uuno taaø dï jiy, kiper na käru jööra gwøø, ni jeenynyu jiy ki køør ciik Jwøk.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jïïø ba da wääø aciel? ?Ni patha Jwøk aciel na cwääc øøni bëët? ?Aperŋø nø, ni bëëdø ni ŋati man nø dëëtø tïïö ka atade dëër coki, ni päädø gïna tuut Wuuö Jwøki ki kwäyø?
english: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?

anywaa: Jøøa bëëdö yi ŋööm Juuda gena tïïö ka atade, ni tïïge ki gïn mo raac døc yi Icriel ki yi Jerucalem, kiper jøøa bëëdö yi ŋöömmögø, øt lam na en kur keere mar Wuuö Jwøk mana mëëre ki gø apäätge ki køør mana nyöömge ki mään mo wøøra jwøk mør.
english: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the Lord which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.

anywaa: Beerra man ö Wuuö Jwøki ni raany teeŋ ŋatøgø nø ki nyïïkwaaye bëët dï jic Jeekap, ni tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo dööŋ jïre mo cïpi ko olämme jï Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: The Lord will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Gïn mør maa cäŋu tïïyö thuwø beeye en; u jwöŋö lak gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni tïm pï nyeŋŋu ni øya piny bääte, nou kïmmö kiper mana ö Wuuö Jwøki na ba neen jï muuce mou, ni ba jïëc geni baŋu, ni yie ba met ki geni.
english: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the Lord with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.

anywaa: Ni pëëu ni kööu, na «?Aperŋø na ba jïëc geni?» 'Ba beeye kiper Wuuö Jwøk bëëdö ni neeta luum nywöm mana tuutu yïthakiyu ki cïïï mana nywømï ni ïïna wøp; 'ba ïïna tïïö ka atade dëëre, këël na bëëde ni uuna dëël aciel ki gø ni näk cïïï na tuutu luum nywöm ki gø.
english: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the Lord hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u kär tïïc Wuuö Jwøki na dëël aciel na jwïëy aciel ki cïïï na bëëde? ?Aperŋø na ö Wuuö Jwøki na tïïc gïnögø? Beeye kiper nou jïtö ko obwöre ma jø Jwøk ma adïëri. Kiper manøgø nø, gwøgu dëëtu, nee bäŋe ŋat mo tïïö ka atade dëër cïïe mana nywøme ni ena wøp.
english: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, na «A män ka apääk, ni mäna ki ŋat mo tïïya gïï mo reyø dëër cïïe. Kiper manøgø nø, gwøk dëërï, ni ba tïïï ka atade.»
english: For the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.

anywaa: Uuni, Wuuö Jwøk aööllu ki luup mou. 'Ba uuna köö, ni «?Eni ewa öölö nidïï?» Beeye kiper mana kööu, ni «Ŋat wø tïïc gïn mo raac poot beer ki nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki ŋatøgø.» Wala u köö, ni «?Jwøk ni wø ŋøl luup na karge en kaa?»
english: Ye have wearied the Lord with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the Lord, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Neennu, aani nyïïatwiel mara ojääŋŋa, ni ö eni ni jiiŋ jöö nyïma; ni ö kwäärö na manynyu ni ö yi øt lam mare ni cwöba rou. 'Ba eni na nyïïatwiel mano käär luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy oööi, ni beeye ŋata met yïthu ki gø.»
english: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: ?'Ba aŋa noo løny jïre ki man jïëny gïïo tägi dïcäŋo ööe? ?Na aŋa noo cuŋŋi kanyo pïïe? Kiper eni caala maac mo twøna warkey nee tïme ni tøŋ, ni caala caabuun man wø tïïc abïï ni tar.
english: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' soap:

anywaa: 'Ba eni, eno bëëdö ni caala ŋato leeny gwel-bïrö ni twøn gø; ni ö eni ni tïïc nyïïkwaac Libay ni waany, keda man wø twøn warkey wala gwel-bïrö, ni twøn ka maac, kiper nee ge cïpge ki muuce jïra, aa na Wuuö Jwøk, ni cwïnyge leer.
english: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the Lord an offering in righteousness.

anywaa: Køøre nø, muuce moo cïp jøøa bëëdö yi ŋööm Juuda këël jø Jerucalem otïmö ni tïïya yia ni met, a na Wuuö Jwøk, keda mana bëëde dïkwøŋ yïth cwiiri moa pöödhö.
english: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the Lord, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «Aano ö baŋu kuna jääla uuni, ni puta mara caan dëët ajuuk ki jø luuy ki jø wø kööŋ ni marge tööt, ki jø wø møt gwet jø tïïc, ni wø thiel määr thuunhnhi ki kïïe piny, ki jø wø daaŋ luum wëëlle mo path ki jöö mo patha kare; ni beege jø wø ba lwäär ki aani thuwø.»
english: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, ni «A na Wuuö Jwøk, acaaya ba wiila; ni beeye tiere ni käru ränynyö na bäre en, u na nyïïkwaac Jeekap.
english: For I am the Lord, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge cøøn ki ri kwäyu, uuno gaa wøk ri ciik 'moa, ni käru geni gwøø. Ennø, duu baŋa; køøre nø, aano duu baŋu. «'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹?Waano duuwa baŋï nidïï?›
english: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the Lord of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

anywaa: «?Aŋø, løny jï dhaanhø ki man møt Jwøk? 'Ba uuni aana møtu. «'Ba uuna köö, ni ‹?Ï ewa mødø nidïï?› «Møt mana mudu ki gø beeye mana käru cïpö ki paac wïth jammi ki muuce.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

anywaa: Pou bäre ki jiy bëët moa en yie ocienø kiper mana møtu aani.
english: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye aani na Wuuö Jwøk, a na wïth jammi bëët, ni cäänö en. Ennø, kälu paac wïth jammi na karge ni kïthu gø kar kan na en yi øt lam mara, kiper nee tïme ni da cam yi øda kaace. Tïïyu gïn nou päänynya aani; køøre ojootu ni maal yaa jabø ni wëëga gwïëth mo päl døc ööny bäätu, këël mano rømu ki gø.
english: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

anywaa: Bäänyö mäna mänö ki man cam caammi mou, ni ö nyïïomøki ni ba päthge piny ni poot kär ciek.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Juurre bëët oköö ni dëëtu gum, kiper mana bëëdu paac mo yïth jiy met ki gø.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Uuna cäänö ki luup mo teek dëëra. «'Ba uuna köö, na ‹?A luumma ŋø na caanwa dëërï?›
english: Your words have been stout against me, saith the Lord. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?

anywaa: «Ni kööu, ni ‹Ki man tïny Jwøk beeye gïn mo bäŋ tiere.› Ni kööu thuwø, na ‹?Agïnaŋø na jootwa ki køør mana gwøkwa ciik moe, wala ki køør mana bëëtwa ni wa kïmmö nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët?
english: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the Lord of hosts?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, ki baŋwa jø atöör beege ni yïthge met. Jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø tïmö ni kwärra geni, ni ö geni ni päänyge Jwøk ni bäŋ gïn mo tägi dëëtge.› »
english: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.

anywaa: Køøre jøøa lwäär Wuuö Jwøk gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni cek ïthe ni wïny marge. Ni ö wëëlö ni gööri nyïme kiper jøøa lwäär eni na wøør nyeŋŋe, nee bëëtge ni ge di lääŋŋö.
english: Then they that feared the Lord spake often one to another: and the Lord hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the Lord, and that thought upon his name.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ni «Geno tïmö na 'moa, ni tïmge na thööga dïcäŋo täga ki tïïc. Ni bäädha cwïnya ki geni keda man wø ö dhaanhe wø bääth cwïnye ki wääde man wø tïny gø.
english: And they shall be mine, saith the Lord of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ocäŋ tïmö ni løny jïïu ki man ŋäyu ŋata beer ki ŋata raac; këël ŋat wø tïny Jwøk ki ŋat wø ba tïny gø ŋäyu ŋääö thuwø.»
english: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, aköö, «Neennu, da dïcäŋ mo öö, ni da maac mo liel døc kaamar maa dwaar; ni ö jø atöörri ki jø raay bëët ni tïmge kaamar lethø, ni put ge waaŋ dïcäŋöce kaamar jaath mo owaaŋ ki dëëre bäre këël lweete, ni bäŋgø mo dööŋ dëëtge na bäre bäre.
english: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

anywaa: 'Ba kiperu, u wø lwäär nyeŋŋa, adïëri mara man wø nyooth teek pïëm öö bäätu kaawat man wø tuul cäŋŋi, ni ö kønynyi mara  ni rienye bäätu kaamar cäŋ. Ni cäädhu ni tïm yïthu ni met kaamar nyïïrøøe mo bïëdö kiper mana gøøny geni.
english: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋo tïïa gïnögø yie, jøøa reyø na näk onø tïmö na bur onyøru ki tietu.» Gïnögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the Lord of hosts.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, «Parru wïthu ki ciik dhaanhnha ma Modhe, ni beege gïïa cema ki pwöc moa cïba jïre kiper jø Icriel bëët bäät Kïn Körëp.
english: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo poode ni dïcäŋ mara, a na Wuuö Jwøk, poot kär öö, ni beeye dïcäŋo täk gïïa døøŋŋø yie, noo lwäärö ki gø, nyikugö mara ma Ilaaja ojääŋŋa baŋu.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the Lord:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni løø cwïny wëëe baŋ obwöre, ni løø cwïny obwöre baŋ wëëkge, kiper naa ba ööa ni raanynya pou.»
english: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

anywaa: Man beeye tier tuuŋ mar Jecu Krictø na käl ri Deebit na käl ri Eeberam.
english: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam beeye wää Aydhak, ni ö Aydhaki ni näk wää Jeekap, ni ö Jeekapi ni näk wää Juuda ki nyïïmenni,
english: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

anywaa: ni ö Juuda ni näk wää Peereth ki Dheera na nywøle ki Tamar, ni ö Peerethi ni näk wää Eedharan, ni ö Eedharanni ni näk wää Ram,
english: And Judah begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;

anywaa: ni ö Rammi ni näk wää Aminadap, ni ö Aminadapi ni näk wää Nacøn, ni ö Nacønni ni näk wää Calman,
english: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;

anywaa: ni ö Calmanni ni näk wää Böweeth na nywøle ki Reeyap, ni ö Böweethi ni näk wää Obet na nywøle ki Ruuth, ni ö Obeti ni näk wää Jeci,
english: And Salmon begat Booz of Rahab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

anywaa: ni ö Jeci ni näk wää nyeya ma Deebit. 'Ba Deebit beeye wää Cølöman na nywøle ki ci Uria,
english: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;

anywaa: ni ö Cølömanni ni näk wää Reeyöböm, ni ö Reeyöbömmi ni näk wää Abaaja, ni ö Abaaja ni näk wää Eeca,
english: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;

anywaa: ni ö Eeca ni näk wää Jøcapat, ni ö Jøcapati ni näk wää Jöram, ni ö Jörammi ni näk wää Udhaya,
english: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

anywaa: ni ö Udhaya ni näk wää Jötham, ni ö Jöthammi ni näk wää Eeyeth, ni ö Eeyethi ni näk wää Edhekaya,
english: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;

anywaa: ni ö Edhekaya ni näk wää Maneeca, ni ö Maneeca ni näk wää Eema, ni ö Eema ni näk wää Jöcaya,
english: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;

anywaa: ni ö Jöcaya ni näk wää Jekönaya ki nyïïmenni. 'Ba kar kaagø beeye kanya ö jø Juuthi na magi ya jø Babilønni ni kïthge ge poge.
english: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mana nø duu jø Juuthi ki Babiløn, Jekönaya Cieltiel anywøle. Ni Cieltiel beeye wää Dherubabel,
english: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;

anywaa: ni ö Dherubabelli ni näk wää Abut, ni ö Abuti ni näk wää Eliekim, ni ö Eliekimmi ni näk wää Eedhör,
english: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

anywaa: ni ö Eedhörri ni näk wää Dhadök, ni ö Dhadöki ni näk wää Eekim, ni ö Eekimmi ni näk wää Elut,
english: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;

anywaa: ni ö Eluti ni näk wää Eliedhar, ni ö Eliedharri ni näk wää Mathan, ni ö Mathanni ni näk wää Jeekap.
english: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap beeye wää Jocep, ni Jocep manøgø beeye cø Meeri, na näk mii Jecu, Jecu na cwøl ni Krictø.
english: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge ki ri Eeberam këël mana këët ri Deebit, beege beenhnhe apaar kurŋween. Ni ki mana täge ki ri Deebit këël kanya kïth jø Juuth Babiløn, beege beenhnhe apaar kurŋween. Ni ki mana täge ki kanya kïth jø Juuth Babiløn këël mana këët ri Krictø, beege beenhnhe apaar kurŋween.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaar mana lwaarø ki Jecu Krictø ki gø, na täge, tägi na ennø nø. Menni ma Meeri onø miek jï Jocep nee nywøme. 'Ba kanya poode ni dëëtge poot kärge joodø, ena joot ni yie da dhaanhø mo cïpa Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba cwøre ma Jocep kiper mana näk ena dhaanhø mo beer ni ba cac man lää wï Meeri, acaare ni eno kwiere mëëth ki piny.
english: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni lääŋŋa gïnögø, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö aö bääte ki yïth lääk, ni kööe, ni «Jocep nyikwaar Deebit, kärï lwäyö ki man lwørï cïïï ma Meeri, kiper gïnö ni en yie enøgø, cïpa Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere.
english: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: Eno lwaar ki nyilaal ma cïïŋŋö; 'ba nyeŋŋe ocwølï ni Jecu, kiper beeye eni noo piem jiye yïth raay moge.»
english: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.

anywaa: Moøgø bëët tägi nee gïna caan Wuuö ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk thur kare, na køp,
english: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,

anywaa: ni «Nyakøø mo dëër dïcwøø poot kuue ojïti ki nyilaal ma cïïŋŋö; 'ba nyeŋŋe ocak ni Imanuwel», na näk tiere beeye ni «Jwøk ena buutø».
english: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jocepi na pääe ki yïth niine, gïna caan nyïïatwiel maalli mar Wuuö jïre atïïe na kare, ni put cïïe lwør.
english: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:

anywaa: 'Ba dëër gø kuue, këël mana lwaare ki dhaanhø ma cïïŋŋö; ni ö Jocepi ni cak nyeŋ gø ni Jecu.
english: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lwaarø ki Jecu yi Bethelem na en Judia yïth nïra bëët Eerati na nyeya, da jiy mo wø kwaana ceer ma aöö ki yïth mïëya en jï løø kur tuulcäŋ, ni öge Jerucalem, ni pëëge,
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

anywaa: na «?Age ŋata nywöli na nyeny jø Juuth? Kiper cëënynye ajootwa ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni beeye tiere ni öwa en nee eni wøørwa.»
english: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyeya ma Eerat na wïny gïnögø, cwïnye apädhö këël jø Jerucalem bëët.
english: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

anywaa: Køøre Eerat kwääc laam bëët ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk na en dï jiy, acooŋ kanya ciel ni pëëny geni ni kööe, na «?A kaa na di Krictø nywølø yie?»
english: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.

anywaa: Ni caange gø jïgø, ni «Beeye Bethelem na en Judia. Kiper ogöör nyikuŋ Jwøki na ennø nø,
english: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,

anywaa: «ni ‹Ï na Bethelem ni en yi ŋööm Juuda, karï ba thiinh dï mïëc Juuda, kiper bee ïïni noo ö dïbwödhi ki riï, ŋato gwøk jiya ma jø Icriel.› »
english: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, jø wø kwaan ceer acwøl Eerati ka atade, ni pëëny ge døøc, na «?A yi wäne na nëën cëëyögø?»
english: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.

anywaa: Ni wëëk ge wääth nee cige Bethelem, ni kööe, ni «Cou ni manynyu kar nyilaarøgø døøc. 'Ba noo jootu gø, wär caannu jïra, kiper naa ööa kuna wøøra gø thuwø.»
english: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø wïnyge dwør nyeya, gena put aay. Ni ö cëëya neenge ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni put ci nyïmge, ni cääthge køør gø, këël mana cuŋŋe bäät kanya en nyilaalli yie.
english: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jootge cëëyögø, yïthge amïnnö ki mïnnö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya dønyge yi øtø, nyilaal ajootge ki menni ma Meeri, ni këëlge cøŋge piny ni wøørge gø. Kanyøgønø, opïri moge ajapge, ni moocge eni ki muuce, ni beege warkey, ki mädhi mo ŋwääö ni met ma teeŋi.
english: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni geno kööm Jwøki ki yïth lääk, ni kärge døø baŋ Eerat, gena aay ki jöö mør ni døøge poge.
english: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø døø jø wø kwaan ceer poge, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö aö bäät Jocep ki yïth lääk ni kööe, ni «Ö maal ni lwørï nyilaal ki menni ni reŋŋï Ijep, ni bëëdï kunöce këël kanyo dee gïn caana jïrï. Kiper Eerat tïmö ni manynya kar nyilaal nee nyilaal nääe.»
english: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Jocep aput ö maal ni lwør nyilaal ki mii gø ki wäär ni put aa Ijep.
english: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:

anywaa: 'Ba ena put bëëtö kunöce këël mana thøw Eerati. 'Ba manøgøøni tägi kaper nee luumma caan Wuue ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk thur kare, na køp, ni «Wääda cwöla wøk ki Ijep.»
english: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø jooti Eerati ni eno cøøk jø wø kwaan ceer, wïïe ree anoode ki wëër, ni jääge ki jiy, ni ö obwöc cwøw bëët moa en Bethelem ki mïëya en deŋ paanøgø ni nääi bëët, ni beege obwöre moa näk cwiicge oriewi, ki moa käl køørge, ni cwiiri moøgø kwaane ka køør mana wïnynye dhøk jø wø kwaan ceer kanya pëëny ge.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Jeremaya athur kare, na køp,
english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying,

anywaa: ni «Dwøl awïnyö yi Reema, ni jiy göö ko oduuru mo päl. Ni beeye Reecal na jwöŋö kiper obwöre moe, ni kweere ki man cïp cwïnye piny, kiper na bäŋe nyilaal mo odööŋ.»
english: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thøw Eerati, nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö aö bäät Jocep ki yïth lääk kanya en Ijep, ni kööe,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

anywaa: ni «Ö maal ni lwørï nyilaal ki menni ni døøï yi ŋööm Icriel, kiper jøøa many nyilaal nee 'näkge, gena thøw.»
english: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni put ö maal ni lwør nyilaal ki mii gø ni døø yi ŋööm Icriel.
english: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya Jocepi ni Arkelia odööŋ Judia na kwäärö kar wänni ma Eerat, ena lwäyö ki ciin kaace. 'Ba kiper mana näk eno kööm Jwøki ki yïth lääk, ena daa Galili.
english: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:

anywaa: Ni cøøe ni bëëde yi päänya cwøl ni Nadhareth, nee mana caan nyïïkuk Jwøki thur kare, na køp, ni «Eno cwøl ni nyï Nadhareth.»
english: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögø, Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi aöö ni køpa luum Jwøk dï paap Judia,
english: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,

anywaa: ni köö, ni «Løgu cwïnynyu, kiper buya käl maal kare acäännö.»
english: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn beeye ŋata cään nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea kipere, na kööe, ni «Da dwør dhaanhø mør mo cwödö ŋää paac, ni ‹Jiiŋŋu jöör Wuuö, ni tïïyu uutjïëthe moe ni thïïŋ.› »
english: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn käära abïï mo cwääc ka jïëc athïrööl, ni kaw ee twöö piere, ni cam mare beeye bäänyö ki maar kïc.
english: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø Jerucalem ki jø Judia, ki jø wø bëëdö mïëya en løø Naam Jördan bëët aö wøk baŋe.
english: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,

anywaa: Ni lwøk geni na nyuudhi yi Naam Jördan, ni køpge raacge.
english: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøønni na neen jø Paricith mo thööth ki jø Cajucith ni ge ööa baŋ lwøk na nyuudhi, ena köö jïge, ni «?U na nyïï thwöre en, aŋa na kööm uuni ni bwøgu ki wëër mano ööi?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, bëëdu ki bëëtö man wø rømi ki løk cwïny,
english: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

anywaa: ni kär nou köö ki cwïnynyu, ni ‹Eeberam beeye na kwarwa.› Kiper a caana gø jïïu, ni Jwøk jïre da teek ki man jïte ki jiy jï Eeberam røk kïte moi ii.
english: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kawaane ennø, ley onø cïp tiet jenni. Kiper manøgønø, jenni bëët mo wø ba nywøl ki nyïëdi mo beyø, ŋøda piny ni leeŋi maac.
english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

anywaa: «Aani, dëëtu lwøa ka pïï na nyuudhi kiper løk cwïny, 'ba ŋato ööi køøra dwøŋŋa eni ki aani, ni këël wac tiete kiree a ba rømi ki man käära ge ki cera. Eni uuno lwøe na nyuudhi ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ki maac.
english: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:

anywaa: 'Ba kwödi mare ena cere, ni eni laara mare ojwiie, ni cooŋ beel moe yo odek. 'Ba lethø owaaŋe ki maac mo ba maar jwöc.»
english: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Jecu aöö ki Galili ni cøøa Naam Jördan baŋ Jøøn nee lwøk na nyuudhi.
english: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn manynya man män gø ni kööe, ni «Beeye aani ni many ïïni naa lwøgï na nyuudhi. ?Aŋø, ï doo cäŋ ö baŋa thuwø?»
english: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïre, ni «Wec manøgø kawaane. Kiper beer jïïø ki man wëëgø moa many Jwøki bëët thur karge na ennø nø.» Kanyøgønø, Jøøn ajïëy.
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu kanya nø lwøi na nyuudhi, ena put ö wøk ki yïth pïï. Kanyøgø maal ree ajabe, ni neen Jwïëc Jwøk ni ööa piny kaamar akuuru ni pï bääte.
english: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

anywaa: Ni put dwølli öö ki maal ni kööe, ni «Man beeye Wääda na mëëra ki gø, na met yia ki mare.»
english: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu abwøth Jwïëc Jwøki paap kuna päänynyi ya anägö.
english: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

anywaa: Ni bëëde ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni beeye wärre ki cääŋŋe, ni ba cämö. 'Ba køøre ena 'näk käci.
english: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dïcuuy aöö ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nee ïïna O Jwøk, kööm kïte moi nee tïmge na muunni.»
english: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu, no «Ogöörö, «ni ‹Dhaanhø ba doo kwøw ka cam keere, 'ba eni wø kwøw ka luup bëët mo wø ööi ki dhi Jwøk.› »
english: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena kïth anägö päänya en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni cïp gø wï ocul Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ,
english: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,

anywaa: ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nee ïïna O Jwøk, leeŋ riï piny, kiper ogöörö, «ni ‹Eni nyïïatwiet maal moe oköömme kiperï niï koorge. Ïïno jølge maal ki ceŋge, kiper nee tierï ba cwaanyï ri kïdi.› »
english: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïgø, no «Ocäŋ göörrö, ni ‹Kär Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï päänynyï.› »
english: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, ena cäŋ anägö kïth bäät kïdi mo bäär døc ni nyuth gø buc piny bëët ki beenyge.
english: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;

anywaa: Ni kö anägö jï Jecu, ni «Gïï bëët owëëga ïïni ni näk mo cøŋŋï këëllï piny ni wøørï aani.»
english: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Daak riï, Ceethan, kiper ogöörö, «ni ‹Ï doo wøøra Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï, ni beeye eni keere na diï tïnynyö.› »
english: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena wec anägö, ni put nyïïatwiet maalli öö, ni tïnyge eni.
english: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na wïny gøøni ni Jøøn omaa, ena daa Galili.
english: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;

anywaa: 'Ba na wec Nadhareth, ena aay ni bëëde Kapernaam bäät Puul Galili yi ŋööm Dhebulan ki Naptali,
english: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:

anywaa: kiper nee gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea nee thur kare, na køp,
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ŋööm jø Dhebulan ki ŋööm jø Naptali na en waŋjöör Puul Galili løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni beeye Galili kany beet juurre,
english: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;

anywaa: jøøa bëëdö yi muudhö, tar mo dwøŋ aneenge, ni kwäär øwi bäät jøøa bëëdö dhi thøø.»
english: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.

anywaa: Kar kaagønø, beeye kanya täk Jecu ki køp luum Jwøk, ni cäänö, ni «Løgu cwïnynyu, kiper buya käl maal kare acäännö.»
english: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na cäädhe bäät Puul Galili, eni nyïïmëëe ariiø ajoode, ni beeye Cayman na cwøl ni Piter ki coki ma Andaru, ni ge lëëŋö ka ajääp yi naam, kiper gena dïbïth rec.
english: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Ööu ni caathu køøra. Uuno tïïa na dïbïth jiy.»
english: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ajääpi moge aputge wec, ni läpge køøre.
english: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba na pöödhe, nyïïmëëe ariiø møøk ajoode, ni beeye Jeemeth o Dhebedi ki coki ma Jøøn, ni ge ena yi jääy ki wääge ma Dhebedi, ni ge kwuö ka ajääpi moge. Ni ö Jecu ni cwøl geni.
english: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

anywaa: Ni putge jääy ki wääge wec, ni caathge køøre.
english: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni caath dï Galili bäre, ni pöö yïth uut acook lam moge, ni køp luumma nyään na met mar buc Jwøk, ni kunyö ki teeŋ täwe bëët ki ŋwiili bëët moa en dëët jiy.
english: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, gïre awïnyö dï Ciria bäre, ni kälge jiy bëët moa tuu baŋe, jøøa no omaaŋ täwe ma teeŋi ki ŋwiili ma teeŋi mo rämö, ki jøøa dëëtge da anäge, ki jøøa dëëtge da cet, ki moa näk obäp. Ni køny geni.
english: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatic, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth moa käl Galili ki Dikapöla ki Jerucalem ki Judia ki løø Naam Jördan ni caathge køøre.
english: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na neen lwaak, ena eth maal kö kïdi. 'Ba na pï piny, bääge aö baŋe.
english: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:

anywaa: Ni pwöny geni, ni kööe:
english: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

anywaa: ni «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø ŋäc can marge nyïm Jwøk, kiper buya käl maal beeye marge.
english: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø kïmmi, kiper cwïnyge di cømø.
english: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø mwöl, kiper piny owëëk geni.
english: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø näk owär kiper bëënynyö marge kaamar dhaanhø mo onäk käci ki riew, kiper geno wëëk jäŋö.
english: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø kunyö, kiper geno køny.
english: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø cwïnyge tar, kiper Jwøk neenge neenø.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø tïïc bëët-mëër, kiper geno cwøl ni nyïï Jwøk.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäät jø wø caanni ki køør bëëtö marge na beer nyïm Jwøk, kiper buya käl maal beeye marge.
english: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: «Gwïëth en bäätu kany wø ö jiyi wø janyge uuni, ni caange uuni, ni kïthge bäätu ki teeŋ luup bëët moa reyø mo patha adïëri kiper nyeŋŋa.
english: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

anywaa: Wär yïthu mïnge ni kanynyu, kiper gïno mëëk uuni maal dwøŋ. Kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk moa kwøŋ bëëtö nou poodi, acaan jiyi na enøgønø.
english: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

anywaa: «Uuna acäbö mar piny. ?'Ba ni näk ma acäbö lawe obänhnhö, lawe ocäŋ døø kare nidïï? Bäŋ gïn mo røme ki gø këët, 'ba tiirra man weti ni nyøri ya jiyi ki tietge.
english: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

anywaa: «Uuna tac piny. Paac mo ogeer bäät thuur ba maar kan.
english: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo nyep lamba ni kïth gø tier dak, 'ba wø cïbe bäät tharabëëta, ni ö taye ni meeny yi øtø bäre.
english: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.

anywaa: Wär tayu wëëgu rieny na enø nø nyïm jiy, nee tïïe mou na beyø nee neenge, ni jiemge Wääu ni en maal.
english: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: «Kär nou caara gø naa ööa kuna raanynya ciik Jwøk ki luup moa køp nyïïkuk Jwøki. A ba ööi naa raanynya geni, 'ba a ööi naa wëëga ge thur karge.
english: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

anywaa: Kiper adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni këël kanyo räny maalli ki piny, thääŋ piil ciik Jwøk mo thiinh ba doo rwäänyö, këël mano thur jammi moa wäŋŋi bëët karge.
english: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro raany ciik aciel mana thiinhnha eni dëët moa näk ocemø, ni pwöny jiy na enø nø ki gø, eno cwøl ni thiinhnha kare yi buya käl maal. 'Ba ŋat wø tïïc geni ni pööe ki geni, eno cwøl ni dwøŋŋa kare yi buya käl maal.
english: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni näk bëënynyö maru, bëënynyö mar dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki mar jø Paricith ba kaale, u ba doo døny yi buya käl maal na bäre bäre.
english: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: «Awïnynyu na caani jï jø acääŋŋe, ni ‹Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø. 'Ba ŋat wäro nägi, eni di pëënynyö kar løøk.›
english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø gooti ki coki, eni di pëënynyö kar løøk; ni ŋat wäro jaany coki, eni pëëny kwääc løøe pëënynyö; ni ŋat wäro köö, ni ‹Ïïna bøøl,› eni cøøa yi maac kar ajäla.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk mo olämi marï cïbï bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni parï wïïï kaace ni cöögu cwïnye da gïrpiny ki ïïni,
english: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;

anywaa: wii olämi marï buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kwøŋï ci kuna døøu kanya ciel ki cöögu. Køøre nø, ïïno ööi ni cïpï olämi marï.
english: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.

anywaa: Wärï laar møør bäät ŋat mo manynya løøk ki ïïni ni tïïyï gø na nyawadu, kanyø poodu nou cäätha kar løøk, kiper nee eni ni pee ïïni kar løøk enø, niï ba cïp cer dïŋut luup, ni ö dïŋut luupi ni cïp ïïni cer ŋat koor, ni ö ŋat koorri ni kïth ïïni øt twöc.
english: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, niï bäŋ doo ööa wøk na bäre bäre këël mano coolï mïlïïn mana näk odööŋ.
english: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

anywaa: «Awïnynyu na caani, ni ‹Kärï kännö ki luk.›
english: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø neen dhaagø ni ee parø ki cwïnye, onø kännö ki luk ki gø ki cwïnye.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.

anywaa: Ni näk waŋ cwïïï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, göön wøk, ni wetï gø. Kiper beerra eni ki man räny thääŋ dëërï mør, ki mana di dëërï bäre leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla.
english: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cer cwïïï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, ŋul wøk, ni wetï gø. Kiper beerra eni ki man räny thääŋ dëërï mør, ki mana di dëërï bäre ci yi maac kar ajäla.
english: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

anywaa: «'Ba ocaanø thuwø, ni ‹Ŋat wäro kwier cïïe, wär gööde jïgø ki wëël apääk.›
english: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋato wäro kwier cïïe jaak, ni paa kiper käp, tïïya cïïe na ŋat luuy. Ni ŋato wäro nywøm dhaagø mo opääö ki cwøre, mare luk ki gø.
english: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.

anywaa: «Na awïnynyu thuwø na caani jï jø acääŋŋe, ni ‹Kärï kööŋ ki kööŋ mo patha adïëri. 'Ba gïn wø kööŋï kipere ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, wär put tïïc.›
english: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni käru kööŋ na bäre bäre. Käru kööŋ ŋëët maal, kiper maal beeye wälu mar Jwøk.
english: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God's throne:

anywaa: Käru kööŋ ŋëët piny, kiper piny beeye køøm tiete. Käru kööŋ ŋëët Jerucalem, kiper Jerucalem beeye pääny nyeya mana dwøŋ.
english: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.

anywaa: Ni ba kööŋŋu ŋëët wïthu, kiper ba løny jïïu ki man tïïyu jëënnö aciel ni tar wala cøl.
english: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl man wø caannu wär bëëde kare, nee maru jïëy wala maru kweer. 'Ba ni näk mo kööŋ meedu bääte, maneca käla baŋ ŋata raac.
english: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.

anywaa: «Awïnynyu na caani, ni ‹Waŋ cool ka waŋ, ni lëëö cool ka lëëö.›
english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni kär kwörï coolï dëër ŋat mo tïïö ki gïn mo raac dëërï. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo dhööŋa ïïni ki thääŋ cwïïï, løk thääŋŋï maya jïre thuwø.
english: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo manynya løøk ki ïïni ni lwør koothi marï, wär abïïno en tiere mëëk eni thuwø.
english: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo maga ïïni ki teek ki man käärï tëër mare ki yi kiïlömethër aciel, wär käärï jïre ni cäädhï ki yïth kiïlömethërri ariiø.
english: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

anywaa: Mooc ŋato kwac ïïni, ni ba mänï ŋat mo manynya mäyö baŋï.
english: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.

anywaa: «Awïnynyu na caani, ni ‹Ï doo mëër ki wadu, ni mänï ki nyïïmännï.›
english: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a caana gø jïïu, ni mëërru ki nyïïmännu, ni lämu kiper jø wø caan uuni,
english: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

anywaa: kiper nou tïmu ni uuna nyïï Wääu ni en maal. Kiper eni cäŋ mare wø wëëge tuulö bäät jøøa wïnni ki jøøa mwöl, ni jääŋ køth bäät jøøa beyø ki jøøa reyø.
english: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mou mëër ka jø wø mëër ki uuni keerge, agïnaŋø noo duue jïïu? ?Aŋø, këëlla jø ajwäk, ge ba bëëdö ka bëëtö ma enøgønø thuwø?
english: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mou määtha nyïïmëëgu keerge, agïnaŋø na beer na tïïyu na kaallu jø møga ki gø? ?Aŋø, këël juurre, ge ba bëëdö ka bëëtö ma enøgønø thuwø?
english: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u doo bëëdö ni bëëtö maru bäre beer, kaawat man bëët Wääu ni en maal ni bëëtö mare bäre beer.
english: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.

anywaa: «Gwøgu rou nee tïïc mo beer ba tïïyu nyïm jiy kiper nee neenge. Kiper ni näk ma enøgønø, bäŋ gïn mo jootu baŋ Wääu ni en maal.
english: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, kanyo wäro cïpï ki jammi jï jøøa can, kär kunhnhï ki tuuŋ, kaawat man wø tïïc jø atade yïth uut acook lam ki uutjïëthe, kiper nee ge pwøc jiyi. Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni mana doo ci jïge, anø jootge.
english: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wäro cïpï ki jammi jï jøøa can, kär niï wëëga cer caamï ŋäc gïno tïïc cer cwïïï,
english: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:

anywaa: kiper nee japa cïpï bëëde ni kuc. 'Ba Wäru ni en maal, ni wø neet gïn mo kuc, ïïno ŋade.
english: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.

anywaa: «Ni kanyo wäro lämu, käru tïmö nou caala jø atade. Kiper yïthge met ki lam ni ge cuŋŋö uut acook lam ka agääk jïëthe, kiper nee ge neen jiyi. Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni gïna doo ci jïge, anø jootge.
english: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wäro lämï, ci yi ødï ni cïëgï odhuulu bäätï ni lämï jï Wäru ni en maal ni wø ba neen. 'Ba Wäru ni en maal, ni wø neet gïn mo kuc, ïïno ŋade.
english: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.

anywaa: «'Ba kany wø lämu, kär lam maru cwaatu ki luup mo oballe jaak kaawat man wø tïïc juurre. Kiper ege caarø ni marge di wïnynyö kiper luup moa carge na thööth.
english: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

anywaa: Käru tïmö kaamarge. Kiper Wääu ni en maal gïn wø cannu ki gø ŋääe ni eni poot käru pëënynyö.
english: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wäru wø lämu na ennønø, «ni ‹Wääwa ni en maal, nyeŋŋï wøør,
english: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.

anywaa: buyï ööe. Beerra man tïm mana manynyï ni di tïïö bäät piny kaawat man bëëde ni di tïïö maal enø.
english: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

anywaa: Mëëk wa caapwa waŋcäŋi,
english: Give us this day our daily bread.

anywaa: ni weyï moa bacwa, keda man wø wecwa mo wø bac jø møøki dëëtwa.
english: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

anywaa: Kär wa bwøth kany mo wa di päänynyö yie, 'ba piem wa cer ŋata raac.›
english: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk moa bac jiyi weyu wiiø, Wääu ni en maal thuwø moa bayu wiie wiiø.
english: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk moa bac jiyi ba weyu, Wääu ni en maal thuwø, moa bayu ba wiie.
english: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo wäro lämu ki lam-wödö, kär nyeŋŋu døøyu mo can kaawat man wø tïïc jø atade. Kiper geni dëëtge wø wecge wiiø no ocweer nee wödö marge joot jiyi. Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni mana doo ci jïge, anø jootge.
english: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø wödï, lwøk nyeŋŋï ni wïïrï wïïï ki maaw,
english: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

anywaa: nee wödö marï ba joot jiyi, 'ba beeye Wäru ni en maal ni wø neet gïn mo kuc, noo joot gø. 'Ba Wäru ni en maal, ni wø neet gïn mo kuc, ïïno ŋade.
english: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.

anywaa: «Kär dëëtu kännu ki jammi bäät pinyi en, ni da alweela ki nyal mo raanynya ge, ki kuuwe mo turö ki uudi mo kwädö.
english: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:

anywaa: 'Ba kännu dëëtu ki jammi maalø, kanya näk yie bäŋ alweela ki nyal mo räänyö, ni bäŋ kuuwe mo turö ki uudi mo kwädö.
english: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

anywaa: Kiper kanyo kanï japï yie, cwïnyï oen yie thuwø.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

anywaa: «Waŋ beeye lamba mar dëël. Kiper manøgønø, ni näk waŋï tøŋ, dëërï bäre orømø ki tar.
english: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk waŋï ba tøŋ, dëërï bäre orømø ki muudhö. ?'Ba ni näk tar mana en dëërï cøl, a teeŋ cøl mo nyïëdi noo cøle ki gø?
english: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

anywaa: «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man tïny kwääri ariiø. Kiper eni løny ki man männe ka aciel ni mëëre ki maya. Wala cwïnye wëëge aciel, ni jøøŋ maya. Kiper ba løny jïïu ki man tïnynyu Jwøk ni tïnynyu jap piny.
english: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, a cäänna uuni, ni kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper jwïëyu, ki gïïo cammu, wala gïïo maathu, wala gïïo røøu dëëtu. ?Aŋø, ba letha per jwïëy ki cam, ni leth per dëëlli ka abïïe?
english: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?

anywaa: Raŋŋu wec maal mø. Ge ba pïïdhö, ni ge ba kääö, ni ge ba cuŋ yïth odïï. 'Ba Wääu ni en maal ge wø poot caame caamø. ?Aŋø, ba letha peru ki geni?
english: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

anywaa: ?Na aŋa dïïu ni løny jïre ki man meet nïr kwøw moe ki mo thenh keerge kiper mano lääŋ gø?
english: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

anywaa: ?Na aŋø nø, ni lääŋŋu abïïe? Caarru pïth mar apiite mo ena yi pwöla, ni wø ba ööl dëëtge ni ge ba cwääö ka abïïe kiper dëëtge.
english: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni këël Cølöman ka ajieme bäre, mïërö mar abïïe moe ba caal mïëy aciel dï gïïögø.
english: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk Jwøk luum mo ena yi pwöla ee døøc mo mïërö, ni bëëdö ni mar dïcäŋi ni diøø leeŋa maac, a uuni, u bäŋ dee gwøø ni kaala manøgø, u ni ŋäädhe maru thiinh en?
english: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kär dee gïn lääŋŋu, nou köö, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo camø?› Nou köö, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo maadhø?› Nou köö, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo røø dëëtø?›
english: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

anywaa: Kiper gïïögø bëët cac juurre cayø. 'Ba Wääu ni en maal ŋääe nou can ki gïïögø bëët.
english: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.

anywaa: 'Ba kwøŋu buc Jwøk ki beeny Jwøk cayø. Køøre nø, gïïögø bëët owëëk uuni thuwø.
english: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper diøø. Kiper diøø dëëre olääŋŋe keere. Cäŋ man nø da moe.
english: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.

anywaa: «Kär dee ŋat mo ŋølu wøk, kiper nou ba ŋøl wøk.
english: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

anywaa: Kiper ŋøl mano ŋøllu, beeye noo ŋøl u wøk ki gø. Ni rumi man wø cïpu, beeye rumi mano duu baŋu.
english: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni neetï ŋöömö man wø en waŋ cöögu, ni wïl wïïï ki cuudhö manø ni en waŋï enø?
english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

anywaa: ?Na aŋø na diï köö jï cöögu, ni ‹Ööï nee ŋöömmo en waŋï enø käla wøk,› ni waŋï kiree da cuudhö?
english: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

anywaa: Ï na ŋat atade, kwøŋ cuunhnho en waŋï enø käl wøk; køøre nø, ïïno nëënö ni beer nee ŋöömö manø ni en waŋ cöögu enø kälï wøk.
english: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother's eye.

anywaa: «Kär gïno en kur keere na mar Jwøk mëëgu guu, kiper ge cäŋa duu baŋu ni camge uuni. Ni ba leeŋu tiigu moa perge leth nyïm othuri, kiper nyørge nyørø ki tietge.
english: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

anywaa: «Pëëu, ocïp jïïu. Cääu, ojootu. Dööŋu, ojap jïïu.
english: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø pëëö, wø di cïbö jïge. Ni ŋat wø määnyö, wø joode joodø. Ni ŋat wø dööŋö, wø di jabø jïre.
english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

anywaa: ?Wala aŋa dïïu, ni näk mo opëëny wääde ki møø, ni mooc gø ki kïdi?
english: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

anywaa: ?Wala ni näk eni pëënynya rëëö, ni mooc gø ki thwöl?
english: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk u na näk jø raay muuö ŋäyu ki man cïpu ki muuce mo beyø jï nyïïu, a Wääu ni en maal, okääŋe nidïï ki man cïp gïï mo beyø jï jø wø pëëny eni?
english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïn wäro manynyu nee tïïc jiyi jïïu, wär wø tïïyu jïge thuwø. Kiper manøgø beeye tier pwöc mana en yïth ciik Jwøk ki luup moa køp nyïïkuk Jwøki.
english: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

anywaa: «Dønyu ki dhi kiir mana diiny. Kiper dhi kiir man wø bwöth kar ränynyö päl, ni jööre laac, ni jø wø cii ki yie thööth.
english: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

anywaa: 'Ba dhi kiir man wø bwöth kar kwøw diiny, ni jööre teek, ni jø wø joot gø nøk.
english: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

anywaa: «Gwøgu rou ki nyïïkuk Jwøk mo patha adïëri mo wø ö baŋu ni ge käära duup rööm, 'ba ki yïthge gena kwäänynye mo owär.
english: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

anywaa: 'Ba geno ŋäyu ki køør tïïe moge. ?Aŋø, nyïïomøki wø pønna dëët jer koodhi, wala nyïïolaam wø käla ro otwel?
english: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

anywaa: Kiper jenni bëët mo wø beyø, wø nywøla nyïëdi mo beyø. 'Ba jaath mo raac wø nywøla nyïëdi mo reyø.
english: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

anywaa: Jaath mo beer ba maar nywøl ki nyïëdi mo reyø, ni ö jaathi mo raac ni ba nywøle ki nyïëdi mo beyø.
english: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

anywaa: 'Ba jenni bëët mo wø ba nywøl ki nyïëdi mo beyø, ŋøda piny ni leeŋi maac.
english: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, teeŋ jøøgø, geno ŋäyu ki køør tïïe moge.
english: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

anywaa: «Patha jiy bëët mo wø köö ki aani, ni ‹Kwäärö, Kwäärö,› noo døny yi buya käl maal, 'ba beeye ŋat wø tïïc mana many Wära ni en maal.
english: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca jiy mo thööth oköö ki aani, ni ‹?Kwäärö, Kwäärö, aŋø, luum Jwøk kärwa købø ki nyeŋŋï, ni riemwa anäge wøk ki nyeŋŋï, ni tïïcwa tïïe mo thööth mo døøŋŋø ki nyeŋŋï?›
english: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøca ocaana jïge, no ‹U kuua cøøn na bäre bäre. Daagu rou buuta, u jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø.›
english: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, jiy bëët mo wø wïny luupa ii, ni tïïcge ge, caala ŋat mo wïïe leer, mo øde ee geer bäät kïdi.
english: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

anywaa: Ni päth køthi, ni ö jwïïe, ni cööt jame ni kwöt dëër ødøgø, ni käre pädhö, kiper mana tïme no ogeer bäät kïdi.
english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø wïny luupa ii ni ba tïïcge geni, ocaal ŋat mo wïïe bäŋ acaara, mo øde ee geer ya akwöö.
english: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

anywaa: Ni päth køthi, ni ö jwïïe, ni cööt jame ni kwöt dëër ødøgø, ni pädhe ki pädhö mo ba thiinh.»
english: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na thöör luupögø ki caan, lwaak yïthge arëëm ki pwöc mare,
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:

anywaa: kiper mana pwöny geni na ŋat mo jïre da teek, ni ba caal dïpööye moge mo wø pöö ki ciik Jwøk.
english: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na duu piny ki bäät kïdi, lwaak mo dwøŋ aläp køøre.
english: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋat mo ree da dhøøbø aö baŋe, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm gø, ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, ni näk ïïno jïëy, dëëra diï dwøga kare.»
english: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni rwaak cere baŋ gø ni mul gø, ni kööe, ni «Aana jïëy; dëërï døø kare.» Ni ö dhøøbe ni put aay dëër gø.
english: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Kär dee gïn caanï jï ŋat mør. 'Ba ciï, ni nyoothï dëërï jï dïlämi, ni cïpï ko olämi mana caan Modhe, ni wø näk ŋïï jï jiy.»
english: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pïïe Kapernaam, kwääy tøŋ man wø käär jiy ma dïpa aö baŋe, ni kwac gø,
english: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, laŋŋø mara tuu no obäp paac ni baŋŋi døc.»
english: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Aano ö kuna kønya gø.»
english: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk kwääyögø jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, a patha orømø ki man wëëga ïïni ööny paara. 'Ba cäännï ki luubö keere. Køøre nø, laŋŋø mara dëëre ojöönni.
english: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.

anywaa: Kiper aani thuwø, aana dhaanhø mo bëënna teek ŋat mør, ni jïra da jø tøŋ thuwø mo ena cera, maa doo köö ka aciel rege, ni ‹Ciï,› ni dee cøø. Ni kööa jï mør, ni ‹Ööï,› ni dee öö. Ni daa laŋŋø mara cäännö, ni ‹Tïïc gïn,› ni dee gø tïïö.»
english: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na wïny mare, yie arëëm, ni kööe jï jøøa cäädhö køøre, na «Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni teeŋ ŋäädhe ma enøgønø poot kära joodø, këël dï jø Icriel.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

anywaa: A cäänna uuni, ni jiy mo thööth oööi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ni pïge piny lak cam ki Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap yi buya käl maal;
english: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: ni ö wäät bura ni leeŋi wøk yi muudhö, kany wø jwöŋ jiyi yie ni ge mööta lakge.»
english: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jï kwääy tøŋ, ni «Ciï. Otïïc jïrï kaawat mana ŋäädhï.» Ni put dëër laŋŋø jöönnö ki yi caannøce kiree.
english: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na ci po Piter, mii cï Piter ajoode no obutö ni tuu ka adïrïgi.
english: And when Jesus was come into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother laid, and sick of a fever.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni mul cer gø, ni puti ya adïrïgi wec. Ni ö nyijøøgø maal ni tïny Jecu.
english: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na abøønynyøgø, jiy mo thööth mo dëëtge da anäge akäl baŋe. Ni ö Jecu ni riem juu wøk dëëtge ki dwøre keere, ni køny jøøa tuu bëët.
english: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:

anywaa: Ni manøgøøni tïïc kaper nee gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea thur kare, na køp, ni «Ŋwiili 'moø alwøre ni käär täwe moø.»
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na neen lwaak mo dwøŋ ni ena buute, ena cïpö ki dwøl nee eni ki bääge cige løøga.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyen ma dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk aö baŋe, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Dïpööy, a cäädhö køørï, këël ï doo cøøa kaa.»
english: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, no «Othööe jïge da buri, ni weny jïge da uudi, 'ba Wär Dhaanhø, bäŋ kany mo nyaaŋ thääŋŋe yi gø.»
english: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhaanhø mør dï bääŋi aköö jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, wec aani dïciel, naa cøøa kuna koonya wära.»
english: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Ö køøra, ni weyï jøøa näk othøw nee dëëtge koonyge keerge.»
english: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na ci yi jääy, bääge aeth køøre.
english: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø atuunna mo ba thiinh atägö dï Puul Galili, ni tïm jääyi ni läŋŋi ka athaga. 'Ba kar kaagø, Jecu obutö.
english: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni cige baŋe ni jiecge gø, ni köge, ni «Køny wa, Kwäärö. Øøna thøw.»
english: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø ni lwäyu, u ni ŋäädhe maru thiinh en?» Ni ö maal ni jook jamø ni jook naam. Ni put pinynyi nibäc døc.
english: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni rëëm yïthge, ni köge, na «?A teeŋ dhaanhnha ŋø en, ni këëlla jamø ki naam leŋa dwøre?»
english: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø pïïc Jecu løøga po jø Gadarin, ena røømmø ki jak ma ariiø mo wïthge da anäk, mo käla bäät bwör, mo geno gäy døc, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man pöödhe ki jööröce kiperge.
english: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena put lier døc, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïyï ki waani, ï na O Jwøk? ?Aŋø, ï ö kany kiper nee wa caarï ni kanya wäŋŋi poodi?»
english: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da pïïth othur mo päl mo cämö kany mo bäär mëëth ki geni.
english: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

anywaa: Ni ö anäki ni kwacge Jecu, ni «Noo näk mo wa riemï wøk, wëëk wa ciin dëër pïïth othur.»
english: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou.» Ni öge wøk, ni cige dëët othuri. Kanyøgø pïïth othur bäre aput dhooth ya ageella bäär ni päthge yi Puul Galili, ni thøøge yïth pïï.
english: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.

anywaa: Ni ö dïkwääc othuri ni reŋge. 'Ba na pïïcge paac, jammi bëët acaange, ki gïna tägö dëët jøøa wïthge da anäk.
english: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.

anywaa: Kanyøgø paac bäre ree ajiie ni cige nee røømge ki Jecu. 'Ba kanya jootge eni, ena kwacge nee aae poge.
english: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aeth yi jääy ni ŋut løø poge.
english: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni jiy akän baŋe ki ŋat mo obäp, mo opïël bäät pëëm. 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na neen ŋäädhe marge, ena köö jï ŋata näk obäp, ni «Mak cwïnyï, wääda, raay moï awec.»
english: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jak ma dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk acäänö ki cwïnyge, ni «Nyeni janynya Jwøk.»
english: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na nø ŋäc luumma en cwïnyge, ena köö, na «?Aŋø ni caru gïï mo reyø ki cwïnynyu en?
english: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?

anywaa: ?A mane ni jööta eni na doo caanø, beeye, ni ‹Raay moï awec,› wala ki man caani, ni ‹Ö maal, ni cäädhï›?
english: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee ŋäyu nø ni Wär Dhaanhø jïre da teek bäät piny ki man wec raay,» ena köö jï ŋata näk obäp, ni «Ö maal, ni lwørï pëëmï, ni ciï paac.»
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋatøgø maal ni ci paac.
english: And he arose, and departed to his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö lwaaki na neenge gïnögø, gena lwäyö, ni jiemge Jwøk, na cïp teeŋ teek ma enønø jï jiy.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pöödhe ki kaace, nyen mør ma ŋat ajwäk mo cwøl ni Mathiew ajoode no opï piny kar ajwäk. Ni kööe jïgø, «Ö køøra.» Ni ö maal ni läp køøre.
english: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pï piny kar cam yi øt Mathiew, jiy mo thööth ma jø ajwäk ki jø raay aöö, ni pïge piny buut Jecu ki bääge.
english: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö jø Paricithi na neenge gïnögø, gena köö jï bääge, na «?Aŋø ni cäm dïpööyi maru ki jø ajwäk ki jø raay en?»
english: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na wïny gø, ena köö, ni «Jø wø dëëtge jööt ba many akïïm, 'ba beege jø wø tuu.
english: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

anywaa: Cou ni kwanynyu tier gïna caan Jwøki na kööe, na ‹A manynya mëër, ni kaala olämme.› Kiper a ba ööi naa cwøla jøøa beyø, 'ba a öönynya jø raay.»
english: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääk Jøøn aö baŋ Jecu, ni köge, na «?Aŋø ni wø tïïwa ki lam-wödö ki jø Paricith en, ni bäägï ba wödö?»
english: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, wëët nywöm doo kïmmö ni cø nyakøø poot ena dïge? 'Ba nïne oööi, kanyo ö cø nyakøøe noo lwøri dïge. Kanyøca nø, beeye noo wötge.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo rap thääŋ abïï mo nyään dëër abïï mo otøp. Kiper räbi, kanyo nyøøny dëëre, ree jëëe wøk dëër abïï, ni tïme na jeeø mo raac døc.
english: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään mo kïth yïth opïc pëëne mo otøp. Ni näk di tïïö, opïri cöötö, ni øc køøŋ nyïïomøki piny, ni ö opïri ni ränyge. 'Ba køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään wø kïtha yïth opïc pëëne mo nyärö, ni ö geni ni bëëtge ni geno gwøø karge riet.»
english: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni Jecu cäänna bääk Jøøn na enønø, kwäärö mør mar øt acooŋ lam adunynyö ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Nyaara athøw kawaane en. Ööï ni kïthï cerï bääte, nee kwøe.»
