english: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu maal ki bääge ni läp køør gø.
english: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø dhaagø mo oööl remø mo cwïër dëëre ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø aöö ki ŋää Jecu ni gut deŋ abïï gø.
english: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:

anywaa: Kiper ocaar nyijøøgø ki cwïnye, ni «Këël maa guta deŋ abïïne keere, dëëra jöönnö.»
english: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na løk ree ni neen gøøni, ena köö, ni «Nyaara, mak cwïnyï. Ŋäädhe marï dëërï awëëk jöönnö.» Ni put dëër nyijøøgø døø kare.
english: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Jecu po kwäärö manøgø, jø wø jwöŋi ko opele ki lwaak mo göö ko oduuru ajoode,
english: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Aayu, kiper nyilaari kär thøw, 'ba mare niine.» Ni ö jøøgø ni ŋeethge bäät gø.
english: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø cöör lwaak wøk, ena ci yi øtø, ni mak cer nyilaal, ni ö nyilaalli maal.
english: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.

anywaa: Ni ö gïr gïnögø ni wïnye dï paanøce bäre.
english: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pöödhe ki kaace, jak ma ariiø ma cööye aläp køøre, ni ge rëëdö døc, ni «Wui, Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canwa!»
english: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou Son of David, have mercy on us.

anywaa: 'Ba na døny øtø, jagøgø na cööye yøø aö baŋe. Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «?You ŋäädhö ni løny jïra ki man tïïa gïnögø?» Ni dwøkge gø jïgø, ni «Yaa, Kwäärö.»
english: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeŋge amule, ni kööe, no «Otïïc jïïu kaawat man ŋääthu gø enø.»
english: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeŋge ni døøge karge. Ni ö Jecu ni kööm geni døøc, ni «Kär dee ŋat caannu gø jïre.»
english: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.

anywaa: 'Ba na aacge, gïr Jecu acaange dï paanøgø bäre.
english: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø tïŋ jagøgø na ariiø yøø, nyen mør mo ba cäänö mo dëëre da anägö akäl baŋ Jecu.
english: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø riem anägö wøk, nyena näk ba cäänö aput cäänö. Ni ö lwaaki ni rëëm yïthge, ni köge, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo nëëna gïn mo okwøŋ neen dï Icriel cøøn.»
english: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith aköö, ni «Eni anäk wø riem wøk ka teek kwääy anäge.»
english: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni caath dï mïëri bëët, moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, ni pöö yïth uut acook lam moge, ni køpa luumma nyään na met mar buc Jwøk, ni kunyö ki teeŋ täwe bëët ki teeŋ ŋwiili bëët.
english: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba na neen lwaak, cwïnye apädhö ki gïrge, kiper ge wïïrö jaak, ni bäŋ ŋat køny geni, ni ge bëëdö kaamar dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge aluumme, ni «Pwödhö aciek døc, 'ba jø tïïc nøk.
english: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kwayu Wää pwöthögø no ociek enø, nee jääk yi pwödhö mare ki jø tïïc.»
english: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cwøl bääge baŋe moa na apaar kurriiø, ni mooc ge ki teek bäät juuga reyø, nee riemge wøk; ni mooc ge ki teek ki man kønyge teeŋ täwe ki ŋwiili bëët.
english: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ nyïïatwieli moa na apaar kurriiø beege ii; mana dïkwøŋ beeye Cayman na cwøl ni Piter, ki coki ma Andaru, ki Jeemeth o Dhebedi, ki coki ma Jøøn,
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;

anywaa: ki Pilip, ki Barthølömu, ki Tøma, ki Mathiew ŋat ajwäk, ki Jeemeth wär Alpia, ki Thadia,
english: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

anywaa: ki Cayman ŋat Keena, ki Juudac Ickarïët, ŋata cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmänne.
english: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøgø na apaar kurriiø yøø gena jääŋ Jecu wøk, ni kööm geni, ni «Kär dee kany cou yie dï juurre, ni ba cou po jø Cameria.
english: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:

anywaa: 'Ba cou baŋ jø Icriel ni wø caal dïëk mo orwäänyö.
english: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

anywaa: Cou ni køpu luum Jwøk, ni kööu, ni ‹Buya käl maal kare acäännö.›
english: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.

anywaa: Ni kønynyu jiy moa tuu, ni wëëgu jiy moa no othøw kwøw, ni dwøgu dëët jøøa näk dëëtge da dhøøbø karge, ni riemu anäge wøk. Muuy manøgø awëëk u jaak. 'Ba wär cïpu jaak thuwø.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.

anywaa: Kär dee warkey, wala gwel-bïrö, wala thariipa mo kääru ki yïth kïïce mou,
english: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

anywaa: ni bäŋe opïri mo kääru kiper wääth maru, wala abïïe oriewi, ki war, ki laŋkaace. Kiper ŋat tïïc cam mare wø joode baŋ ŋata tïnynye.
english: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

anywaa: 'Ba paano wäro cou yie jaak, ni näk mo dwøŋ wala thiinh, wäru määnyu ki ŋat mo beer ni bëëdu buute këël mano tïŋŋu.
english: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo dønynyu øtø, wäru määthu.
english: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

anywaa: 'Ba noo näk mo jø paac mo beer, bëët-mëër maru wär wëëgu bëëtö yie. 'Ba noo näk mo ba beer, bëët-mëër maru wär duu baŋu.
english: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mou ba pänhnhe ni ba wïny luupu, kanyo aayu ødøca wala paanøca, tør tietu wär teeŋu yie.
english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, noo tïmö ni theemma ajäl Cødam ki Gømöra ka ajäl paanøca dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie.
english: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

anywaa: «Neennu, aani, a jääŋŋa u wøk kaamar dïëk mo ena dï kwäänynye. Kiper manøgønø, bëëdu ni nyeŋŋu reegø kaamar thwöre nou mwöl kaamar akuyi.
english: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou ki jiy. Kiper uuno kïthge kwör løøe, ni pöötge uuni yïth uut acook lam moge.
english: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;

anywaa: Ni peege uuni nyïm kwääri ki nyeye mo juurre kiper nyeŋŋa, nou køpa gïra nyïmge ki jø poge.
english: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro kïthge uuni kwör løøe, kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper gïno caannu wala uuno cäänu nidïï. Kiper gïno caannu ocïp jïïu yi caannøca.
english: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.

anywaa: Kiper paa uuni noo cäänö, 'ba beeye Jwïëc Wääu ni en maal noo cäänö dhøgu.
english: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.

anywaa: 'Ba cöögö coki okïth yi thøø, ni ö wuue ni kïth nyaare yi thøø. 'Ba obwöre rege othïïŋge ri jøøa nywøl ge, ni kïthge ge yi thøø.
english: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni mänge ki uuni kiper nyeŋŋa. 'Ba ŋato jïëny gïïögø këël aŋuunne, opiem.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro caange uuni yi paac aciel, wär reŋŋu yi paac mør. Kiper adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni ni mïëc Icriel bëët ba dou thöörö ki caath, ni Wär Dhaanhø poot kär öö.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.

anywaa: «Ŋat mo di pwönynyö ba dwøŋŋa eni ki dïpööy mare, ni ŋat tïïc ba dwøŋŋa eni ki kwääye.
english: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.

anywaa: 'Ba orømø ki man tïm ŋat mo di pwönynyö ni caala dïpööy mare, ni tïm ŋat tïïci ni caala kwääye. ?Kiper ni näk wää øtø ege cwølø ni Bieldhebap, jø paare okääŋge nidïï ki man cwølge ge thuwø?
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, käru nou lwäyö ki jiy. Kiper bäŋ gïrpiny mo ouumö mo ba cäŋ nyoothø, wala gïrpiny mo okanø, mo ba cäŋ jootø.
english: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.

anywaa: Gïn mo yaa caanø jïïu yi muudhö, wär køpu yi tar. Ni gïn mo you wïnynyö ni di mooŋø, cäŋu køpø ki wïth uudi.
english: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.

anywaa: Ni käru nou lwäyö ki jø wø 'näk dëël ni ba løny jïge ki man 'näkge jwïëy. 'Ba beerra man lwäärru ŋat wø løny jïre ki man raany jwïëy ki dëël karge riet yi maac kar ajäla.
english: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, acøki ariiø bäŋ wø ŋeew ka thariipa? Ni bäŋ aciel dïge mo päth piny ni näk ba kö Wääu ni en maal.
english: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.

anywaa: 'Ba këël jïëc wïthu okwaanø bëët.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, käru lwäär. Letha peru ka acøki mo thööth.
english: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø jïëc aani nyïm jiy, ojïëa thuwø nyïm Wära ni en maal.
english: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro mooŋ aani nyïm jiy, omooŋa thuwø nyïm Wära ni en maal.
english: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: «Kär caarru naa ööi naa käla bëëtmëër bäät piny. A kär öö naa käla bëët-mëër, 'ba a ööi naa käla opëëllö.
english: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.

anywaa: Naa ööi naa wëëga « ‹dhaanhø apääk ki wänni, ni ö nyakøøe ni pääge ki menni, ni ö cï nyeyi ni pääge ki waŋi.
english: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

anywaa: Ni tïm dhaanhe ni nyïïmänne beege jø wø en paare kiree.›
english: And a man's foes shall be they of his own household.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato mëër ki wänni wala menni ni kaala mëër man mëëre ki aani, ba rømi ki man tïme na dhaanhnha. Ni ŋato mëër ki wääde wala nyaare ni kaala mëër man mëëre ki aani, ba rømi ki man tïme na dhaanhnha.
english: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø ba lwør jaadhe na näk odëëdö ni cäädhe køøra, ba rømi ki man tïme na dhaanhnha.
english: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.

anywaa: Ŋat wø gwøk jwïëye, onyääe. 'Ba ŋato nyääk jwïëye kiper nyeŋŋa, ojoode.
english: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat wø jïëc uuni, jïëya aani. Ni ŋat wø jïëc aani, jïëya eni na jääŋ aani.
english: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø jïëc nyikuŋ Jwøk kiper mana näk ena nyikuŋ Jwøk, omooc ki gïn wø mëëk ŋat ma nyikuŋ Jwøk. Ni ŋat wø jïëc ŋat mo beer kiper mana näk ena ŋat mo beer, omooc ki gïn wø mëëk ŋat mo beer.
english: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro mooc dhaanhø aciel mo kare thiinh røk bääŋi 'moa, ni eni cïpi kaper mana näk mo bääŋ manøgø ena bääŋ mara, këël ŋatøgø cïpa pïï mo ŋec ki ya athöödhi cøøn, ka adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni gïno mëëk eni ba doo kääŋö.»
english: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

anywaa: 'Ba na løny Jecu ki pwöny bääge moa na apaar kurriiø, ena aay kaace ni ci kuna pööye ni køpa luum Jwøk dï mïëri.
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi na en øt twöc, kanya wïny tïïe mo Krictø, dwøl ajääŋŋe ki bääge,
english: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples,

anywaa: ni pëënynya Jecu, ni «?Bee ïïni, ŋata wäŋŋi ni öö, wala cäŋwa dhaanhø mør neetø?»
english: And said unto him, Art thou he that should come, or do we look for another?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «Cou ni køpu gïï wïnynyu ni neetu ii jï Jøøn,
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see:

anywaa: ni cööye nyeŋge adøø karge, ni ö ŋööte ni cääthge, ni ö jøøa näk dëëtge da dhøøbø ni døø dëëtge karge, ni ö meŋŋe ni wïnyge luup, ni ö jøøa näk othøw ni tïŋ ge maal ki yi thøø, ni ö jøøa canni ni køp luumma nyään na met jïge.
english: The blind receive their sight, and the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, and the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have the gospel preached to them.

anywaa: 'Ba gwïëth en bäät ŋat maa käre taaø.»
english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya aac bääk Jøønni, Jecu atägö ki man caan gïr Jøøn jï lwaak, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na cou baŋe dï paap nee neennu? ?Aŋø, u cøøa baŋ otöök mo tuuŋŋa jame?
english: And as they departed, Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

anywaa: ?A agïnaŋø na cou baŋe nee neennu? ?U cii nou neena ŋat mo oruyö ka abïïe mo beyø? Neennu, jø wø käär abïïe mo beyø wø bëëdö kwör bëëte mo nyeye.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

anywaa: ?A aperŋø nø, na cou paap? ?U cøøa kuna neennu nyikuŋ Jwøk? Kare møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni eni kaala cer nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? yea, I say unto you, and more than a prophet.

anywaa: Ŋatøgø beeye ŋata göör gïn kipere yi wëël Jwøk, na køp, «ni ‹Neenï, a jääŋŋa nyïïatwiel mara nyïmï, ŋato jiiŋ jöörï nyïmï.›
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo othïïŋö mo dwøŋŋa kare ki kar Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi dï jøøa nywøl määnni. 'Ba eni na kare thiinhnha eni yi buya käl maal, tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni ki Jøøn.
english: Verily I say unto you, Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist: notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

anywaa: Ki mana täge ki yïth nïr Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi këël kawaane ennø, jøøa teek bëëdö ni tïïö ki gïï mo leth dëër buya käl maal, ni ge manynya gø nee makge ki teek.
english: And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët ki ciik Jwøk acäänö kiper buya käl maal këël mana ö Jøønni.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo yïthu met ki man jïëyu luumma caana kiper Jøøn, Jøøn beeye Ilaaja, ŋata wäŋŋi ni öö.
english: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

anywaa: Ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.
english: He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: «?'Ba jø pinyi en päära gø ki ŋø? Päära kö obwöre mo opï piny kwör ŋïëw, mo cøøra rege ni köge,
english: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,

anywaa: «ni ‹Waani opelø akoothwa jïïu, ni käru miel. Ni jwöŋwa ki jwøk thøø, ni käru kïmmö.›
english: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.

anywaa: Kiper Jøøn aöö ni ba cämö ni ba mädhö, ni kö jiyi, ni ‹Eni wïïe da anägö.›
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.

anywaa: 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø aöö ni cämö ni mädhö, ni kö jiyi, ni ‹Neennu, ŋat wärö, na ŋat maath, na nyawat jø ajwäk ki jø raay.› 'Ba leec wïc ojoot na adïëri ki køør tïïe moe.»
english: The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu atägö ki man jääl mïëri kiper na kärge rege løø, ni beege mïëya tïïe yïthge døc ki tïïe mo døøŋŋø.
english: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:

anywaa: Ni kööe, no «Otïmö ni raac jïrï, ï na Köradhin. Noo tïmö ni raac jïrï, ï na Betheeda. Kiper doo naa tïïe moa døøŋŋø na tïïc dïïu, tïïca yi Tayar ki Caydan, cwïnyge doo na ege nø løk cøøn, ni ge käära keece na abïïe ni ge bëëdö yi bur.
english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, noo tïmö ni theemma ajäl Tayar ki Caydan ka ajäla maru, dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie.
english: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï na Kapernaam, iï caarø niï doo røønyø maal? Beeye kar ajäla noo leeŋ ïïni yie. Kiper doo naa tïïe moa døøŋŋø na tïïc jïrï, tïïca Cødam, paanøgø doo poodø ni nut këël dïcäŋi en.
english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, noo tïmö ni theemma ajäl jø Cødam ka ajäla maru dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie.»
english: But I say unto you, That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment, than for thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö, ni «Ïïna pwøa, Awuuö, ï na Kwääc maal ki piny, kipper mana mänï gïï ki jøøa wïthge leer na ŋäc jammi, ni nyoothï geni jï obwöre moa mar.
english: At that time Jesus answered and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes.

anywaa: Kiper beeye mana manynyï ki met yiï, ï na Wuuö.
english: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.

anywaa: «Jammi bëët onø wëëk Wära aani; ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc Wäädö, 'ba beeye Wuuö keere, ni bäŋe dhaanhø mo ŋäc Wuuö, 'ba beeye Wäädö keere, ki ŋat wø met yi Wäädö ki man nyooth eni jïgø.
english: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

anywaa: «Ööu baŋa, u na näk oööl bëët ki gïï wø tïïyu ki gïïa peek ni wø kääru ki cwïnynyu; uuno mooa ki jwömö.
english: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

anywaa: Kïthu jaadha bäätu, ni wø caal jaath puur man wø rïï ŋut dhieŋ, ni kwänynyu ki køøra, kiper a mwöl ni cwïnya bäŋ atöör. 'Ba uuno jïti ki jwömö kiper gïïa en cwïnynyu.
english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

anywaa: Kiper jaadha man wø rïï ŋut jööt, ni tëër mara ba peek.»
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu acør dï pwöth beel ki cäŋ jwömö. 'Ba bääge onäk käci, ni täkge ki man tøcge wïth beel ni ŋiinyge ge ni nyamge ge.
english: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn; and his disciples were an hungred, and began to pluck the ears of corn, and to eat.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø na jooti ya jø Paricithi, gena köö jïgø, ni «Neenï, bäägï ge tïïya gïn mo ba doo tïïö ki cäŋ jwömö.»
english: But when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto him, Behold, thy disciples do that which is not lawful to do upon the sabbath day.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, gïna tïïc Deebiti käru kwaanø, kanya 'nägi ya käci, ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni bëët?
english: But he said unto them, Have ye not read what David did, when he was an hungred, and they that were with him;

anywaa: Eni, ena døny Øt Jwøk ni lwør muuga näk nyuuthe ni cam ge, na näk ba doo beer jïre ki man cam ge wala ki man cami ya jøøa cäädhö ki eni, 'ba beer kaper dïlämme keerge.
english: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, luubö mana no ogöörö yi ciik Jwøk käru kwaanø thuwø, ni kany wø näk cäŋ jwömö, dïlämme mo wø tïïö Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ luum cäŋ jwömö wø dhalge dhalø, ni ba jääl ge?
english: Or have ye not read in the law, how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath, and are blameless?

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a cäänna uuni, ni gïn mør mo dwøŋŋa eni ki Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ena kany.
english: But I say unto you, That in this place is one greater than the temple.

anywaa: 'Ba doo nää tier gïna caan Jwøki ŋäyu, na køp, na ‹A manynya mëër ni kaala olämme,› jøøa bäŋ ajäla røkge ba dou jäälö.
english: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø beeye Kwääy cäŋ jwömö.»
english: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aay kaace, ni døny yi øt acooŋ lam.
english: And when he was departed thence, he went into their synagogue:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da ŋat mo cere obäp. 'Ba geni Jecu apëënyge, ni «?Beeye gïn mo beer ki man køny dhaanhø mo tuu ki cäŋ jwömö?» Luummögø acaange kiper nee jïtge ki luubö mo kïthge bääte.
english: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋa dïïu, ni näk mo jïre da diel aciel, ni ö dierøgø ni päth yi buur ki cäŋ jwömö, ni ba käl gø wøk?
english: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba letha per dhaanhø ki diel? Kiper manøgønø, beeye gïn mo beer ki man tïïc gïn ma wøp ki cäŋ jwömö.»
english: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jï ŋata näk cere obäp, ni «Rwiec cerï.» Ni ö ŋatøgø ni rwiec cere, ni put cere døø kare na wøp ni caala maya.
english: Then saith he to the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it forth; and it was restored whole, like as the other.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith gena aa wøk ni tuutge gïr Jecu, kiper yi jöö mano 'näkge gø ki gø.
english: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na ŋäc gïnögø, ree adaae kaace. Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni läpge køøre. Ni køny jiy moa tuu bëët.
english: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;

anywaa: Ni kööm geni nee eni ba waacge.
english: And charged them that they should not make him known:

anywaa: Manøgø beeye kiper nee gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea thur kare, na kööe,
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,

anywaa: na «Adïëri møn, ŋat tïïc mara na jiera, ni beeye omëëya, ŋata met yia ki mare, Jwïëya okïtha bääte, ni beeye eni noo køp luum ŋøl luup mo beer mar Jwøk jï wïth juurre.
english: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ba pïëmö, ni ba lweelli, ni bäŋ ŋat mo wïny dwøre uutjïëthe.
english: He shall not strive, nor cry; neither shall any man hear his voice in the streets.

anywaa: Ni ba toor otöök mo onyøc, ni ba jwöc maac mo duuŋ, këël mano wëëk ŋøl luup mo beer mar Jwøk thur kare.
english: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.

anywaa: Ni nyeŋŋe beeye noo ŋääth wïth juurre.»
english: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋat ma cwør mo ba cäänö, mo dëëre da anägö, akäl baŋ Jecu. Ni ö Jecu ni køny ŋatøgø, ni tïm ŋatøgø ni ba cäänö enø, ni cäänö ni nëënö.
english: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil, blind, and dumb: and he healed him, insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw.

anywaa: Ni rëëm yïth jiyi bëët, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, ŋati paa Nyikwaar Deebit wän?»
english: And all the people were amazed, and said, Is not this the son of David?

anywaa: 'Ba na ö jø Paricithi na wïnyge gïnögø, gena köö, ni «Beeye kwääy anäge ma Bieldhebap keere, ni wø ö ŋati wø riem anäge wøk ki nyeŋ gø.»
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu gïïa caar jøøgø ŋääe, ni kööe jïge, ni «Mïëri bëët mo wø pääŋ rege, ränynyö. Ni bäŋ pääny wala jø dhi øtø mo pääŋ rege ni cuŋŋe.
english: And Jesus knew their thoughts, and said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Ceethan dëëre rieme wøk, eni pääŋŋa ree keere. ?Aŋø, buye a dee cuŋŋö nidïï?
english: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk ma anäge wø riema wøk ka teek Bieldhebap, a jiyu nø, anäge wø riemge ge wøk ki nyeŋ ŋa? 'Ba beeye geni noo ŋøl maru piny.
english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Jwïëc Jwøk beeye wø riema anäge wøk ki gø, beeye buc Jwøk na ö bäätu.
english: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

anywaa: ?'Ba dhaanhø a dee døny øt ŋat mo teek nidïï kuna twier jap gø, ni näk ŋata teek käre kwøŋ mak ni twöc gø? Køøre nø, eni cøø møn ni twier øt gø.
english: Or else how can one enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he first bind the strong man? and then he will spoil his house.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ba en kura, eni män ki aani, ni ŋat wø ba cuuŋö ki aani, mare beeye keth.
english: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a caana gø jïïu, ni teeŋ raay bëët ka ajaany owëën Jwøki. 'Ba ŋat wø jany Jwïëc Jwøk ba wëën Jwøki.
english: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro cäänni ki luubö mo raac dëër Wär Dhaanhø, eno wëën Jwøki. 'Ba ŋat wäro cäänni ki luubö mo raac dëër Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, eni ba wëën Jwøki yi pinyi en wala yi mano ööi.
english: And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost, it shall not be forgiven him, neither in this world, neither in the world to come.

anywaa: «Jaath mo beer wø nywøla nyïëdi mo beyø, ni jaath mo raac wø nywøla nyïëdi mo reyø. Kiper jaath wø ŋec ka nyïïe.
english: Either make the tree good, and his fruit good; or else make the tree corrupt, and his fruit corrupt: for the tree is known by his fruit.

anywaa: ?U na nyïï thwöre, luubö ma wøp a dou gø caanø nidïï nou reyø? Kiper gïï wø thööth ni wø en cwïny beege ni wø caan dhøki.
english: O generation of vipers, how can ye, being evil, speak good things? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh.

anywaa: Kiper ŋata beer wø käla gïn mo beer wøk ki røk japa beyø na en cwïnye. 'Ba ŋata raac wø käla gïn mo raac wøk ki røk japa reyø na en cwïnye.
english: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things: and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie, luup bëët mo wø caan jiyi ni bäŋ tietge jaak, ocäŋ døø wïthge.
english: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.

anywaa: Kiper ïïno ŋunni ki køør dwørï, ni jääl ïïni thuwø ki køør dwørï.»
english: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni dïpööye møøk mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith aköö jï Jecu, ni «Dïpööy, wa manynya ŋïï mo neenwa neenø baŋï.»
english: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from thee.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, ni «Jø pinyi ni reyø ii ni wø kwier luum Jwøk en, ge manynya ŋïï, 'ba bäŋ ŋïï mo nyooth jïge. 'Ba beeye ŋïï mar nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Joona keere noo nyooth jïge.
english: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø ojïti ki nïne adäk ki wärre adäk piny, kaawat mana ö Joona na bëëde yi rëëö ki nïne adäk ki wärre adäk.
english: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Nineba, geno ö maal ni jäälge jø pinyi en, dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie. Kiper geni cwïnyge aløkge kanya ö Joona na køp luum Jwøk jïge. 'Ba ennø, da gïn mo dwøŋŋa eni ki Joona mo ena kany.
english: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

anywaa: Nyenynya näk dhaagø mar paana en jï løø tier-piny, ööa maal ni jääl jø pinyi en dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie. Kiper eni ööi ka kany mo bäär døc kuna wïny leec wïc mar Cølöman. 'Ba ennø, da gïn mo dwøŋŋa eni ki Cølöman mo ena kany.
english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

anywaa: «Kany wø ö jwøa raaci wøk dëër dhaanhø, eni wø wïïra kany mo bäŋ pïï, ni manynya kar jwöm. 'Ba eni bäŋ wø jïti.
english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.

anywaa: Kanyøgø eni wø köö, na ‹A døøa øda, kanya kwøŋa bëëtö yie.› 'Ba noo ööe, cwäne cwänö ni ŋaam no ojwiiø no ojiiŋŋø.
english: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.

anywaa: Køøre nø, eni wø aay ni känne ki juu abïriiø møøk mo kadha rääö marge ki mare, ni dønyge yie, ni putge bëëtö kaace. Ni ö bëët ŋatøca ni tïme ni raac døc ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ. Beeye gïnögø thuwø noo tägi dëët jø pinyi ni reyø ii.»
english: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, kanya poode ni Jecu cäänö ki jiy, menni ki nyïïmenni ge cuŋŋö wøk, ni ge manynya cäänö ki eni.
english: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.

anywaa: Ni caani ya ŋat mørri jïre, ni «Meru ki nyïïmeru ge cuŋŋö wøk ni ge manynya luubö ki ïïni.»
english: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøge jï ŋata caan gø jïre, ni «?Mera aŋa? ?Ni nyïïmera a jøøe?»
english: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?

anywaa: Ni nyooth bääge ki lweete, ni kööe, ni «Jøøi ii beege mera ni näkge nyïïmera.
english: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wäro tïïc mana many Wära ni en maal, beeye coka ni näk mera.»
english: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø Jecu adøny wøk ki yi øtø ni ci bäät Puul Galili ni pï piny.
english: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaaki mo päl ni cooŋge rege buute. Kiper manøgønø, ena eth yi jääy ni pï piny yie. Ni ö lwaaki bäre ni cuŋŋe bäät ageela.
english: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.

anywaa: Ni caan luup mo thööth jïge na leere, ni kööe, ni «Neennu, da dïpïïdhi mo oaa wøk kuna pïïthe ni mare jør.
english: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;

anywaa: 'Ba na jude, nyeŋ köödhi møøk apäth thääŋ jöö, ni ö wenynyi ni öge ni camge ge bëët.
english: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:

anywaa: Ni ö köödhi møøk ni päthge yi ŋöömö mo tiere da kïdi, kany mo bäŋ ŋöömö mo päl yie. Ni laarge tuu wøk, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ ŋöömö mo päl.
english: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

anywaa: 'Ba na rieny cäŋŋi, gena waaŋ ni talge, kiper mana tïmge ni bäŋ lweedi jïge.
english: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

anywaa: 'Ba köödhi møøk apäth yïth koodhi. Ni ö koodhi ni døøŋge, ni bøøcge ge.
english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:

anywaa: 'Ba köödhi møøk apäth yi ŋöömö mo beer, ni känge ki nyeŋ. Møøk käla nyeŋ ma dïpa, ni møøk käla pïërabïciel, ni kän møga ki pïëradäk.
english: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

anywaa: Ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: Køøre bääŋi aöö ni köge jï Jecu, na «?Aŋø ni caanï luup jïge kaamar leere en?»
english: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, ni «Beeye uuni na wëëk ŋäc tiet luup moa näk tietge okwøŋ kan kiper buya käl maal. 'Ba jø møga, tier gïnögø kär cïbö jïge nee ŋäcge.
english: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø jïre dagø, møøk ocäŋ cïpö jïre, ni tïm moe ni thööth. 'Ba ŋat wø jïre bäŋgø, këël man wø en jïre di lwørø.
english: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere en na cääna ki ge ki luup mo keda leere; kiper ge nëënö, 'ba bäŋ gïn jootge; ni ge wïnyö, 'ba bäŋ gïn ci cwïnyge; ni tier luummögø ba kwanyge.
english: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, mana caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea athur kare jïge, na kööe, «no ‹U wïnyö møn, ni ba maaru tiere kwany. Nou nëënö møn, 'ba bäŋ gïn jootu.
english: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:

anywaa: Kiper cwïny jøøi ii, atïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo maarge joot, ni ïthge odhïŋ ki man wïnyge luubö, ni nyeŋge ege miiø, kiper nee ba jootge ki nyeŋge, ni ba wïnyge ki ïthge, ni ba kwanyge tier gø ki cwïnyge, ni ba luuge rege baŋa, nee ge kønya.›
english: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuno gwïëdhö, kiper nyeŋŋu nëënö, ni ïthu wïnyö.
english: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni nyïïkuk Jwøk mo thööth ki jiy mo beyø mo thööth, gena many man neenge gïï ni neennu ii, 'ba kärge neenø. Ni manyge man wïnyge gïï ni wïnynyu ii, 'ba kärge wïnynyö.
english: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

anywaa: «Wïnynyu tier luumma caana kaamar leer kiper dïpïïdhi.
english: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

anywaa: Kany wø ö dhaanhe wø wïny luum buya käl maal ni ba kwany tier gø, ŋata raac wø öö ni juth gïna näk opiith cwïnye wøk. Manøgø caala mana näk ojør thääŋ jöö.
english: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.

anywaa: 'Ba mana jør yi ŋöömma näk tiere da kïdi, beeye ŋat wø wïny luubö ni laar gø jïëc ki met cwïny.
english: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ lweedø mo okëët piny ree, ni bëëdö ka kany mo thiinh keere. 'Ba kany wø ö gïï mo lethi ki caannø wø täkge kiper luummögø, eni luummögø laare ka wec.
english: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

anywaa: 'Ba mana jør yïth koodhi, beeye ŋat wø wïny luubö. 'Ba eni bëëdö ni lääŋŋa jap piny, ki mëëc kwär. Ni ö gïïögø ni bøøcge luummögø, ni ba jïte ki nyeŋ.
english: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.

anywaa: 'Ba mana jør yi ŋöömma beer beeye ŋat wø wïny luum Jwøk ni kwany tier gø, ni jïte ki nyeŋ møn, na aciel käla nyeŋ ma dïpa, ni kän maya ki pïërabïciel, ni maya käla pïëradäk.»
english: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu luubö mør mo keda leer acäŋ parrø jïge, ni kööe, ni «Buya käl maal doo päärö ki ŋat mo pwöthe ee jørø ki köödhi ma wøpe.
english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:

anywaa: 'Ba nyimän mare aöö ki wäär ni jiy obutö, ni jør luum mo raac dï beel, ni aae.
english: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tuc beelli ni jïtge ki nyeŋ, luuma raac ree anyoodhe thuwø.
english: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tïïc mo wää pwödhö aö baŋe ni köge, ni ‹?Kwäärö, aŋø, ï ba jør köödhi ma wøpe na bëëde yi pwödhö marï? ?Aŋø, luum mo raac oöö nidïï?›
english: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?

anywaa: «'Ba ena köö jïge, ni ‹Beeye nyimän na tïïc gïnögø.› «Ni kö jø tïïci jïre, ni ‹?Ï manynya waani man ciwa nee luum puthwa wøk ni cooŋwa gø?›
english: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?

anywaa: «'Ba ena köö, ni ‹Patha enøgønø, kiper no pudhu luum wøk, beel kuu ka wøk ki geni na aciel.
english: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.

anywaa: Weyu nø, nee døøŋge karge riet këël kanyo cööp ri kac. 'Ba kanyo tïme na kar kac, ocaana jï jø kac, ni «Kwøŋu luum cooŋ ni twöyu gø na wïdhi kiper nee waaŋ, 'ba beel 'moa wär kïthu yo odek mara.» › »
english: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cäŋ luubö mør parrø jïge mo keda leer, ni kööe, ni «Buya käl maal caala nyi waŋ kunhnhö mo thiinh døc mo okäl dhaanhe ni piith gø yi pwödhö mare.
english: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

anywaa: Ni kunhnhögø thiinhnha waŋe døc dï köödhi bëët. 'Ba kany wø døøŋŋe tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni røk moa no opiidhø bëët, ni tïme na jaath, ni ö wec maalli ni gëëtge bääte ki uudi.»
english: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cäŋ ge cäännö ki luubö mør mo keda leer ni kööe, ni «Buya käl maal caala thømmø mo olwør dhaage ni kïth gø yi møø ma yïth rumme adäk këël mana wäny møø manøgø bäre.»
english: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët acaan Jecu jï lwaak na luup mo keda leere. Ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø jïge ni ba caane na leer.
english: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:

anywaa: Manøgø beeye kiper nee gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki thur kare, na kööe, ni «Aano cäänö ki luup mo keda leere, ni køba gïïa näk okanø ki mana täge ki kanya cwääc piny.»
english: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu lwaak awii piny, ni aae ni ci yi øtø. Ni ö bääge baŋe ni köge, ni «Caan tier leer jïwa mar luuma raac na en yi pwödhö.»
english: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge ni kööe, ni «Ŋata jør köödhi moa näk wøpe beeye Wär Dhaanhø.
english: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;

anywaa: Ni pwödhö beeye piny. Ni köödhi moa näk wøpe beege nyïï buya käl maal. Ni luuma raac beeye nyïï ŋata raac.
english: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;

anywaa: Ni nyimän mana jør köödhi beeye anägö. Ni kar kac beeye aŋuun piny, ni jø kac beege nyïïatwiet maal.
english: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ŋuut pinynyi yie, otïmö keda kanyo cooŋ luuma raac yie ni waaŋi ki maac.
english: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø nyïïatwiet maal moe ojääŋŋe, ni dwarge jø wø wëëk raay öö, ki jø wø tïïc raay, ni kwänyge ge wøk ki yi buye,
english: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;

anywaa: ni leeŋge ge yi maac mana päl kar ajäla, kany wø jwöŋ jiyi yie ni mööta lakge.
english: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca, jøw onäk marge beer, orieny ni caala cäŋ yi buc Wääge ni en maal. Ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi, beerra man cek ïthe.
english: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: «Buya käl maal caala jap kwärö mo perge leth mo okoony piny yi pwödhö, ni jooti ya dhaanhe ni cäŋ gø rïëpö. Ni mïn yie ni aae ni dwøk jape bëët pwödhö, ni ööe ni ŋeew pwöthögø.
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.

anywaa: «Ni buya käl maal caala ŋat nyagadha mo manynya nyeŋ tii ma wøpe.
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋatøgø na joot waŋ tiiø aciel mo gäte thööth døc, ena aay ni dwøk jape bëët pwödhö, ni ööe ni ŋeew waŋ tiinnøgø.
english: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

anywaa: «Ni buya käl maal caala ajääp mo oleeŋ yi naam, ni gwaar wïth rec yie bëët.
english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pääŋe, atuut jiyi wøk dhi waath ni pïge piny ni kwanyge moa beyø yïth olïïte, ni wetge moa reyø.
english: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.

anywaa: Gïnögø beeye teeŋ gïno tägi kanyo tïme na aŋuun piny. Kiper nyïïatwiet maal oööi, ni pääŋge jøøa reyø ki jøøa beyø,
english: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

anywaa: ni leeŋge jøøa reyø yi maac mana päl kar ajäla, kanyo jwöŋ jiyi yie ni ge mööta lakge.»
english: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «?Gïïögø bëët aci cwïnynyu?» Ni köge jïre, ni «Yaa.»
english: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kiper manøgønø, dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk bëët moa no opwönynyö kiper buya käl maal caala wää paaci mo wø käla gïï mo nyärö ki gïï mo oruuö wøk ki yi kar kän mare ni nyooth ge jï jiy.»
english: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jecu ki car luupögø ni keda leere yøø, ena aay kaace.
english: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö dï poge, jiy apwönynye yi øt acooŋ lam marge ki pwöc mo yïthge athäŋŋö ki gø. Ni köge, ni «?Ŋati leec wïc manøgø ki tïïe moi ni døøŋŋø ii ee kwanyø kaa?
english: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, nyenøgø paa wär dïjëëth opämi? ?A menni, paa Meeri? ?A nyïïmenni, paa Jeemeth ki Jocep, ki Cayman, ki Juudac?
english: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?

anywaa: ?A nyïïmenni moa näk mään bëët bäŋ wø bëëdö kany ka øøni? ?Gïïögø bëët okwany nyenøgø kaa ŋø?»
english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?

anywaa: Ni taakge gïr gø. 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk bäŋ wø bëëdö ni ba wøør, 'ba beeye paac mana näk dï poge ki paare kiree noo ba wøøri yie.»
english: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu bäŋ tïïe mo thööth mo døøŋŋø mo ee tïïö kaace kiper mana kärge jïëy.
english: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Eerat na bëën paaci, gïr Jecu awïnynye.
english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,

anywaa: Ni kööe jï jø tïïc moe, ni «Nyenøgø beeye Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi. Eno tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, ni beeye tiere gø ni tïme ni da teek bääte ki man tïïe ki gïï mo rëëma ec enø.»
english: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

anywaa: Kiper dïkwøŋ Eerat Jøøn amaae ni twöc gø, ni kïth gø øt twöc ki køør Eerödia, cï owänni ma Pilip,
english: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.

anywaa: kiper na kö Jøønni ki eni, ni «Ba doo beer jïrï ki man bëëdï ki nyaanøgø na cïïï.»
english: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni Eerat manynya man 'näk Jøøn, ena lwäyö ki jiy. Kiper ojïëc jiyi ni Jøøn beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na cäŋa lwaarø ki Eerat yie, nyi Eerödia amiel nyïm wëëlle, ni døøc yi Eerat mo met.
english: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Eerat nyilaarøgø abuŋŋe ni kööŋe ni gïno pëënynye jaak, mëëge eni.
english: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

anywaa: 'Ba nyilaarøgø yie acoon menni, ni kö nyilaarøgø, ni «Mëëk a wï Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi kany ennø, ni ena ya athäänh.»
english: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na bëëde ni nyeya ma Eerat cwïnye opädhö, ena cïpö ki dwøl nee wï Jøøn mëëk nyilaarøgø, kiper kööŋ mare na nø kööŋe ki gø nyïm wëëlle moe.
english: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.

anywaa: Ni jääge ki jiy nee wï Jøøn ŋul wøk øt twöc.
english: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

anywaa: Ni käl wï Jøøn ki ya athäänh ni mëëgi nyakøønnøgø, ni kïth gø baŋ menni.
english: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.

anywaa: Ni ö bääk Jøønni ni öge ni kälge dëër Jøøn ni koonyge gø. Ni cige ni caange gø jï Jecu.
english: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na wïny gïnögø, ree adaae kaace, ni aay ka jääy, ni ci kany mo bäŋ paac yie. 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya jiyi, jiy mo thööth aöö ki tiet mïëri, ni läpge køøre ki tietge.
english: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na eth wøk, lwaak mo päl ajoode, ni päth cwïnye ki gïrge, ni køny jøøa tuu dïge.
english: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na abøøya, bääŋi aö baŋe, ni köge, ni «Man a paap, ni cäŋ oløny ni thiinh. Wëëk lwaak wääth nee cige dï mïëri kiper nee dëëtge ŋëëmge ki caammi.»
english: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Ge ba aay. 'Ba mooyu geni ki gïn camge.»
english: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jï Jecu, ni «Jïwa da muunni abïïc ki rec ariiø keerge kany.»
english: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kälu ge baŋa kany.»
english: He said, Bring them hither to me.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni lwaak aköömme nee pïge piny yi luum. Ni lwør muuga näk abïïc ki reya näk ariiø, ni neen maal ni gwïëth ge, ni pøt muugögø, ni mëëk ge bääge. Ni ö bääge ni pääŋge ge jï lwaak.
english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

anywaa: Ni cämge bëët ni jäŋge. Ni ö bääge ni kwaanyge thäŋi moa näk opøtø na dhäthö, ni pääŋge yïth gupe apaar kurriiø.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cämö bëët, jïtö ki jiy ma kume abïïc ma cwøw, ni mään ko obwöre kär kwaanø.
english: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu bääge aput köömmö nee ethge yi jääy nee kwøŋge ci nyïme løøga, kanyo poode ni eni wëëga lwaak keethø.
english: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø wëëk lwaak keethø, ena aa bäät kïdi keere kuna läme. 'Ba kanya tïm pinynyi na wäär, ena dööŋ kaace keere.
english: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.

anywaa: 'Ba yi kar kanyøgøøni kar jääy onø tïmö ni bäär ka ageela, ni pööt athaga pöötö, kiper jamø atïmö ni kwönna bäätge.
english: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm kar øwi ni cään ni piny poot cøl, Jecu aö baŋge ni cäädhi ka bäät pïï.
english: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö bääge na jootge eni ni cäädhi ka bäät pïï, gena bwøk, ni köge, ni «Tïpö!» Ni rëëtge ki lwär.
english: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu aput luupö ki geni ni kööe, ni «Magu cwïnynyu. Man a aani. Käru lwäyö.»
english: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Piterri jïre, ni «Kwäärö, ni näk beeye ïïni, cwøl a, naa ööa baŋï ki bäät pïï.»
english: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Ööï.» Kanyøgø Piter aeth piny ki yi jääy, ni cäädhe ki bäät pïï, ni ci baŋ Jecu.
english: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya neen jamø, ena lwäyö. 'Ba na täge ki man neelïŋ, ena köök ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, køny aani.»
english: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni put cere rwaak baŋe ni mak gø, ni cään gø ni kööe, ni «Nyie, ï ni ŋäädhe marï thiinh en. ?Aŋø ni tääï en?»
english: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ethge yi jääy, jamø acuŋŋö.
english: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa en yi jääyi ni wøørge eni, ni köge, na «Adïëri møn, bee ï na O Jwøk møn.»
english: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya kathge løøga, gena mäk piny yi ŋööm jø Genedharet.
english: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø paanøce na ŋecge Jecu, gena jääk tiet mïëyögø bëët, ni kälge jøøa tuu bëët baŋ Jecu.
english: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;

anywaa: Ni kwaacge eni këël ki man gutge deŋ abïïne keere jaak. 'Ba jøøa gut gø bëët, dëëtge adøø karge.
english: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni jø Paricith ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk aöö ki Jerucalem ni öge baŋ Jecu, ni köge,
english: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø ni ö bääŋi moï ni dhalge kööŋŋö mar jøøa døøŋŋø? Kiper geni ceŋge bäŋ wø lwøkge kany wø cämge.»
english: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø ni wø dhallu mana cem Jwøki kiper kööŋŋö maru?
english: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Wøør wäru ki meru.› Ni ‹Ŋato cäänö ki gïn mo raac dëër wänni wala menni wär eni 'näk.›
english: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.

anywaa: 'Ba u wø köö, ni løny jï dhaanhø ki man kööe jï wänni wala menni, ni ‹Køny mana diï joodø baŋa anø mëëga Jwøk.› Ni mooyu gø ki jöö ki man ba wøør wänni ki køør køny.
english: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u raanynya luum Jwøk kiper kööŋŋö maru.
english: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.

anywaa: U jø atade, gïru acaan Aydheea na kare na kööe,
english: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,

anywaa: «ni ‹Jøøi ii a wø wøørge ka lëëpge, 'ba cwïnyge karge bäär ki aani.
english: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

anywaa: Naa wøørge ka wödö mo oballe jaak, ni ge pöö ka pwöc jiy ni keda luum Jwøk.› »
english: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cwøl lwaak baŋe ni kööe jïge, ni «Wïnynyu luummi ni kwanynyu tiere.
english: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:

anywaa: Patha gïn wø ci dhøk ni wø raany dhaanhø, 'ba beeye gïn wø ö wøk ki dhøk ni wø raany dhaanhø.»
english: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge aö baŋe ni köge jïre, na «?Aŋø, ŋäyï ni jø Paricith gena gootø kanya wïnyge gïna caanï en?»
english: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, ni «Gïïa näk otuy bëët ni ba piitha Wära ni en maalø, geno puth wøk.
english: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.

anywaa: Wiiu geni karge. Geni, ge caala cööye mo ge pieya cööye. Ni näk ŋat ma cwør pieya cwørri mør, ge pätha yi buur karge riet.»
english: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö jïre, ni «Caan tier luumma caanï jïwa kiper gïn wø ö wøk ki dhøk.»
english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, uuni thuwø, gïnögø tiere poot käru kwanyø en?
english: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni gïn wø ci dhøk, pöötha ec, ni pööth wøk?
english: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø ö wøk ki dhøk käla yi cwïny, ni beeye gïn wø raany dhaanhø.
english: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.

anywaa: Kiper acaare moa reyø wø ööi ka yi cwïny, teeŋ ka 'näk, ki luk, ki käp, ki käw, ki caan gïn mo patha adïëri, ki waac nyeŋ.
english: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:

anywaa: Gïïögø bëët beege gïï wø raany dhaanhø. 'Ba ki man cämö ki ceŋ mo kär lwøø, dhaanhø ba raanynye.»
english: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni aae kaace, ni daa po jø Tayar ki po jø Caydan.
english: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni, nyijø Keenan mo bëëdö paanøce aöö ni rëëdö ni kööe, ni «Køny canna, Kwäärö, Nyikwaar Deebit. Nyaara omak anägö ni teek døc.»
english: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu bäŋ luubö mo ee dwøgø jïgø. Ni ö bääge ni kwacge eni, ni köge, ni «Riem nyijøøgø, kiper ena tïmö ni jwöŋö køørø.»
english: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu, na «A jääŋŋi kaper jø Icriel keerge ni wø caal dïëk mo orwäänyö.»
english: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aöö ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm Jecu, ni kwaac gø ni kööe, «Kwäärö, køny aani.»
english: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Paa gïn ma wøp ki man lwør møk obwöre ni leeŋi baŋ guu.»
english: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø aköö, ni «Beeye kare, Kwäärö. 'Ba këël guu wø poot cämö ki thäk caammi mo wø thenh thenh ni wø päth piny kar cam mar kwääcge.»
english: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

anywaa: Kanyøgø adwøk Jecu jïre, ni «Nyijøøe, ŋäädhe marï dwøŋ. Gïnö ni manynyï enø otïïc jïrï.» Ni ö dëër nyaare ni put døø kare yi caannøgø.
english: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu ena aay kaace ni cør bäät Puul Galili. Ni eth bäät kïdi ni pï piny kaace.
english: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni jiy mo thööth aö baŋe ni ge käla ŋööte, ki jiy moa näk obäp, ki cööye, ki jøøa näk ba luubö, ki jiy møøk mo thööth mo dëëtge da täwe ma teeŋi, ni cïpge ge piny nyïme. Ni ö Jecu ni køny geni.
english: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, jiy yïthge arëëm kanya neenge jøøa näk ba luubö ni ge cäänö, ni jøøa no obäp dëëtge odøø karge, ni ŋööte ge cäädhö, ni cööye ge nëënö. Ni jiemge Jwø Icriel.
english: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu bääge acwöl baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Cwïnya apädhö ki gïr lwaaøgø, kiper nïne adäk ennø ni ge bëëdö ka aani, ni bäŋ gïn mo camge. 'Ba aani yia ba met ki man wëëga ge wääth ki käc. Kanymør ge bup waŋjöö.»
english: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.

anywaa: 'Ba bääŋi aköö jï Jecu, na «?A kaa noo kälø muunni mo thööth ki yie dï paabi, mo caamø lwaai ni päl en ki gø?»
english: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «?A muunni adïï ni en jïïu?» Ni köge, ni «Muunni abïriiø, ki rec mo nøk mo thenh thenh.»
english: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu lwaak aköömme nee pïge piny.
english: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

anywaa: Ni lwør muuga näk abïriiø ki rec. 'Ba kanya nø dwøk met ec, apøte, ni mëëk ge bääŋi. Ni ö bääŋi ni pääŋge ge jï lwaak.
english: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.

anywaa: Ni cämge bëët ni jäŋge. Ni ö bääge ni kwanyge thäŋi moa no opøtø na dhäthö, ni pääŋge yïth gupe abïriiø.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cämö jïtö ki kar kume aŋween, ni mään ko obwöre kär kwaanø.
english: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.

anywaa: 'Ba na wëëk lwaak wääth ena ci yi jääy ni aa dï mïëc Magadan.
english: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith ki jø Cajucith gena öö ni ge päänynya Jecu. Ni pëënyge gøøni, kiper nee ge nyuunhnhe ki ŋïï mo käla maal.
english: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, ni «Kany wø näk abøøya, u wø köö, ni ‹Piny tïmö ni leer diøø, kiper na kwaar maalli.›
english: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ma amöölla u wø köö, ni ‹Piny jïtö ka atuunna dïcäŋi, kiper maal kwaar ni da pöölö mo odhïŋ.› 'Ba uuni, bëët maal wø laaru ka ŋec, 'ba tiet ŋïïce mo nïri ii ba ŋeyu.
english: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?

anywaa: Jø pinyi ni reyø ii ni wø kwier luum Jwøk en, ge manynya ŋïï. 'Ba bäŋ ŋïï mo nyooth jïge. Beeye ŋïï mar Joona keere noo nyooth jïge.» Køøre Jecu jøøgø awiie ni aae.
english: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïc bääŋi løøga, wïthge awïl ki man käätge ki muunni.
english: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Japu nyeŋŋu ni gwøgu rou ki thøm jø Paricith ki jø Cajucith.»
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni løøŋge gïnögø yïthakicge keerge, ni ge köö, ni «Beeye kiper na kärø käädö ki muunni.»
english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu kanya ŋäc gïnögø, ena köö, ni «?U ni ŋäädhe maru thiinh en, aŋø ni løøŋŋu gïnögø yïthakiyu keeru en, ni jïïu bäŋ muunni?
english: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u poot ba kwänynyi en? ?Wïthu awïl ki muuga näk abïïc na pääŋŋi jï jøøa näk kume abïïc? ?A gupe adïï na yïthge päŋ ki thäŋi moa kwanynyu?
english: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

anywaa: ?A wïthu awïl ki muuga näk abïriiø na pääŋŋi jï jøøa näk kume aŋween? ?A gupe adïï na yïthge päŋ ki thäŋi moa kwanynyu?
english: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, tiere ba kwanynyu gø aperŋø, man näk mo aani, a ba cäänö kaper møø? 'Ba ennø, gwøgu rou ki thømmø mar jø Paricith ki jø Cajucith.»
english: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aput ci cwïnyge ni Jecu ba cään ge ki man gwøkge rege ki thømmø mar møø, 'ba cäänö kiper pwöc mar jø Paricith ki jø Cajucith.
english: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu dï mïëc Cecaria Pilipay, bääge apëënynye, ni «?Jiy wø köge ni Wär Dhaanhø aŋa?»
english: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø, ni «Møøk wø köö, ni ‹Beeye Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi,› ni kö møøki, ni ‹Beeye Ilaaja.› 'Ba møøk wø köö, ni ‹Beeye Jeremaya wala nyikugö aciel dï nyïïkuk Jwøk.› »
english: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, «?A uuni, u wø kööu ni aana ŋa?»
english: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Cayman Piter, ni «Ïïna Krictø, O Jwøa kwøw.»
english: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Ïïna gwïëth, Cayman o Joona. Kiper paa dhaanhø na nyooth luummögø jïrï, 'ba beeye Wära ni en maal na nyooth gø jïrï.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Bar–jona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gø jïrï, ni nyeŋŋï beeye Piter, ni bäät kïdi man en acooŋ Jwøk mara otïïa bääte. Ni ba løny jï teek kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw ki man bööt gø.
english: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.

anywaa: 'Ba kulpïïe mo buya käl maal omëëga ïïni. Ni gïn wäro twöyï piny, onø twöc maal, ni gïn wäro jïëyï piny, onø jïëc maal.»
english: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge aköömme døc, nee bäŋe ŋat caange gø jïgø ni ena Krictø.
english: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.

anywaa: Ki mana täge kar kaace nø, Jecu atägö ki man cään bääge ni eni cøøa Jerucalem ni jwør gïï mo thööth ceŋ jaae ki kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ni nääi, ni cäŋi tïŋ maal ri dää nïne.
english: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.

anywaa: 'Ba ena kïth Piterri wøk, ni täge ki man jook gø, ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, gïna caanï enø omän Jwøki. Gïnögø ba tägi dëërï na bäre bäre.»
english: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu alwïthö ni kööe jï Piter, ni «Daak riï ŋääa, Ceethan! Bee ïïni ni cwany tieta en. Kiper acaara marï ba en løø Jwøk, 'ba ena løø jiy.»
english: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu bääge aluumme ni kööe, ni «Nee da dhaanhø mo manynya man ö køøra, eni dëëre wär taae, ni käär jaadhe na näk odëëdö, ni caath køøra.
english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato wäro many man gwøk jwïëye, nyääga gø. Ni ŋato wäro nyääk jwïëye kiper nyeŋŋa, ojoode.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø noo beer noo duui jï dhaanhø, ni näk mo piny bäre oci jïre, ni nyääk jwïëye? ?Wala agïnaŋø noo cïp dhaanhe ni wiila jwïëye?
english: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø öö ki nyïïatwiet maal moe ka ajiem wänni. Kanyøgønø, jiy bëët ocunne ki køør gïïa tïïcge.
english: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, acaana gø jïïu, ni da jø møøk mo cuŋŋö kany en, mo thøø ba jootge, ni Wär Dhaanhø poot kärge neenø ni öö ki bura mare.»
english: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør nïne abïciel, Jecu, Piter ki Jeemeth ki coki ma Jøøn akäle ni kïth ge wï kïdi mo bäär na ge keerge.
english: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,

anywaa: Ni røøe nyïmge, ni ö täärnyïme ni tïme ni paŋŋi kaamar cäŋ. Ni tïm abïïe moe ni tar døc.
english: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Modhe ki Ilaaja dëëtge anyoothge jïge, ni cäänge ki Jecu.
english: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jï Jecu, ni «Kwäärö, beer døc kiree na enø kany. 'Ba ni näk miï manynya gø, a doo tïïö ka abïle adäk kany, na aciel kiperï, na aciel kiper Modhe, ni maya kiper Ilaaja.»
english: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni cäänö, pöölö mo tar anijïïm bäätge. Ni ö dwølli ki yi pööllögø, ni caana gø, ni «Man beeye Wääda na mëëra ki gø, na met yia ki mare. Wïnynyu luumme.»
english: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö bääge na wïnyge gïnögø, rege aputge gøø piny ni geno lwäyö døc.
english: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aöö ni guun geni, ni kööe, ni «Ööu maal. Käru lwäyö.»
english: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïŋge wïthge maal, bäŋ dhaanhø mo ege joodø, 'ba beeye Jecu keere.
english: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duuge piny ki bäät kïdi, gena kööm Jecu ni kööe, ni «Kär dee ŋat caannu gïna jootu en jïgø, këël mano tïŋ Wär Dhaanhø maal ki yi thøø.»
english: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni pëënyge gø, na «?Aŋø ni wø kö dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ni Ilaaja doo kwøŋa öö turu?»
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, ni «Ilaaja kwøŋa öö møn, ni beeye eni noo dwøk jammi bëët kwörge.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni Ilaaja anø öö, ni kärge gø ŋiiø. 'Ba gïïa met yïthge ki ge atïïcge dëëre. Kaawat manøgø thuwø Wär Dhaanhø gïï mo leth ojwøre ceŋge.»
english: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, aci cwïny bääŋi ni eni cäänö kaper Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya öge baŋ lwaak, nyen mør aö baŋ Jecu, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïme, ni kööe,
english: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,

anywaa: ni «Kwäärö, køny wääda, kiper ree da cet, ni eno ööl ki öölö mo raac døc. Kiper cooth eni wø pätha yi maac, ni päth yi naam.
english: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatic, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

anywaa: 'Ba ena käla baŋ bääŋi moï, ni käre løny jïge ki man kønyge gø.»
english: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «?U na beenhnhø mo bäŋ ŋäädhe jïïu en ni wïthu teek, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo beeda ki uuni? ?Naa këël kany mo nyïëdi noo maa cwïnya ki uuni? Kälu eni baŋa kany.»
english: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø anäŋŋögø akööm Jecu, ni ö anäŋŋögø wøk. Ni put dëër nyilaalli døø kare.
english: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.

anywaa: Køøre bääŋi aö baŋ Jecu ge keerge, ni köge, na «?Aŋø na ba lønye jïwa ki man riemwa anäŋŋögø wøk?»
english: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kiper ŋäädhe maru thiinh. Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, doo na jïïu da ŋäädhe mo caala nyi waŋ kunhnhö mo thiinh døc, u doo köö jï kïnni, ni ‹Daa riï kaace,› ni dee ree daaø. Ni doo na bäŋ gïn mo dhäthi jïïu en.»
english: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu ki bääge na cooŋge rege kanya ciel dï Galili, ena köö jïge, ni «Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ jiy,
