english: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:

anywaa: ni 'näkge gø. 'Ba ki ri dää nïne eno tïŋ maal ki yi thøø.» Ni ö bääge ni päth cwïnyge døc.
english: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya öge Kapernaam, jø wø jwäk jiy kiper Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ gena ö baŋ Piter, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, dïpööy maru bäŋ wø cïpi ka ajwäk kiper Øt Jwøk?»
english: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Wø cïpö.» 'Ba kanya ö Piterri yi øtø, Jecu akwøŋ cäännö ki eni, ni kööe, ni «?Cayman, agïnaŋø na caarï? ?A jøøe ni wø ö nyeye mo piny ni wø lwørge ajwäk baŋge? ?Ge wø käda baŋ wäätge wala baŋ jøøa path?»
english: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Piterri na dwøk gø, ni «Baŋ jøøa path,» Jecu aköö jïre, «Ni näk ma ennønø, wäätge ege wiiø ni ba jwäkge.
english: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee cwïnyge ba raanynyø, ci naam ni lëëŋŋï ko obïth, ni lwørï rëëyo kwøŋï mak, ni japï dhee. 'Ba ïïno jïtï ki gwel dhee. Gwetøgø wär kälï, ni mëëgï gø geni na kara ki karï.»
english: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

anywaa: Ba kanyøgø bääŋi aö baŋ Jecu, ni köge, na «?Aŋa ni kare dwøŋŋa eni yi buya käl maal?»
english: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?

anywaa: Kar kaagø, Jecu acwön baŋe ki nyilaal, ni cïp gø dïge.
english: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,

anywaa: Ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni näk cwïnynyu ba løgu ni tïmu kaamar obwöre, u ba døny yi buya käl maal na bäre bäre.
english: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro døøc dëëre mo mwöl kaamar nyilaari, beeye eni ni kare dwøŋ yi buya käl maal.
english: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wäro pänh nyilaal mo caala man ki nyeŋŋa, eni pänhnha aani.
english: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro wëëk nyilaal aciel bääyö dëët moi ni therø ii no ojïëy ni ŋääthge aani en, doo beerra eni kiper ŋatøgø ki man twöö kïn guur mo dwøŋ døc ŋute, ni leeŋi yi naama dwøŋ kany mo päŋ.
english: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jï jø piny kiper gïï wø wëëk dhaanhø bääyö. Kiper gïï wø wëëk dhaanhø bääyö tägö møn, 'ba otïmö ni raac jï ŋato öge ki køøre.
english: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cerï wala tierï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, ŋul wøk, ni wetï gø. Kiper beerra eni ki man ciï yi kwøw na dïbat ciel wala ïïna ŋwøl, ki mana di ï leeŋ yi maaa näk bäŋ cuŋŋe kar ajäla ki ceŋŋï riet wala tietï riet.
english: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk waŋï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, göön wøk ni wetï gø. Kiper beerra eni jïrï ki man ciï yi kwøw ki waŋ aciel ki mana di ï leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla ki nyeŋŋï riet.
english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

anywaa: «Gwøgu rou døc, nee bäŋe nyilaal aciel røk moi ni therø ii mo taagu. Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni nyïïatwiet maal moge wø bëëdö ni neeta waŋ Wära cooth ni en maal.
english: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: «?Agïnaŋø ni caarru? ?Ni näk mo dhaanhø jïre da dïëk ma dïpa, ni rwääny acielli dïge, eni pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween ba dee wiia karge bäät kïdi, ni ci kuna cac diel mana näk orwäänyö?
english: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?

anywaa: 'Ba adïëri møn a cäänna uuni, ni näk mana no orwäänyö joode joodø, yie mïnnö døc ki gø ni kaala mana di yie mïnnö ki moa näk pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween na näk kär rwäänyö.
english: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgøøni thuwø, Wära ni en maal ba cac man rwääny acielli dëët obwöre moi ni therø ii.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.

anywaa: «Ni näk coku obääyö dëërï, ciï ni caanï gïna baae jïre, yïthakiyu u keeru. 'Ba ni näk marï wïnynye wïnynyö, beeye niï tïïya coku nou døøu kanya ciel ki eni.
english: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk marï ba wïnynye, lwötï ki dhaanhø aciel wala jiy ariiø, kiper nee ‹luubö tïme na kare ki køør gïna caan jiyi ariiø wala adäk moa tïïc gïnögø buutge.›
english: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo coku kweer ki man wïny dööt jøøgø, caanï jï jø acooŋ Jwøk. 'Ba ni näk mo eni kweer ki man wïny dwør acooŋ Jwøk thuwø, wär eni tïme ni caala jur mør wala ŋat ajwäk ki jïrï.
english: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni gïn wäro twöyu piny, onø twöc maalø. Ni gïn wäro jïëyu piny, onø jïëc maalø.
english: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

anywaa: A cäŋa u cäännö, ni näk mo jiy ariiø dïïu cwïnyge ege dwalø pinyi en kiper gïn mo pëënyge pëënynyö, Wära ni en maal gïnöca tïïe tïïö jïge.
english: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø näk da jiy ariiø wala jiy adäk mo dëëtge ege cooŋø ki nyeŋŋa, a ena dïge kaace.»
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter aö baŋ Jecu, ni kööe jïgø, ni «?Kwäärö, a kwöre adïï noo bääc coka dëëra, ni wëënna wëënnö? ?Beeye këël kwöre abïriiø kiree?»
english: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Ba daa caanø jïrï, ni kwöre abïriiø. 'Ba a doo köö, ni beeye pïërabïriiø kwöre abïriiø.
english: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, buya käl maal løny ki man pääri ki nyeya mana many man cwøl jammi moe moa en bäät jø tïïc moe.
english: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täge ki man cwøl jammi moa manynye bäät jø tïïc moe, ŋat tïïc aciel akäl nyïme mo bääte da gwel ma kume apaar.
english: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya dhäthe jï ŋat tïïc manøgø ki man cool gwetøgø, nyeya aköö ni eni ŋeew, ki cïïe, ki nyïïe, ki jammi bëët moa en jïre, kiper nee japa en bääte coole ki ge.
english: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø ŋat tïïc manøgø apäth tiete ni kööe, ‹Wui nyeya, cïp cwïnyï piny ki aani. Jammi bëët coola coolø jïrï.›
english: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

anywaa: «'Ba nyeya cwïnye apädhö ki gïr ŋatøgø, ni pät gø, ni wec jammi moa en bääte.
english: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat tïïc manøgø ki dëëre na aa wøk, ena røømmø ki ŋat tïïc aciel røk jø tïïc mo wø tïïö ki eni ciel, ni tïme ni manynya gwete ma dïpa bäät ŋat tïïc manøgø. Ni mak nyenøgø ki cwaak gø, ni kööe, ni ‹Cool gweta moa en bäätï.›
english: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø ŋat tïïc manøgø apäth tiete ni kööe, ni ‹Cïp cwïnyï piny ki aani. Gwetï coola coolø.›
english: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.

anywaa: 'Ba ena kweer, ni cøøe, ni kïth gø øt twöc këël mano cool pïïdö bäre.
english: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya ö jø tïïci møga mo wø tïïö ki eni ciel na neenge gïna tägö, cwïnyge aränynyö døc; ni cige, ni caange gïïa tägö bëët jï nyeya marge.
english: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø nyeya aööt baŋe, ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Ï na ŋat tïïc mo raac en. Japa en bäätï bëët awëëga ïïni kiper na kwaayï aani.
english: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:

anywaa: ?Aŋø, cwïnyï ba diï dwøga piny ki gïr ŋat tïïc mana tïïö ki ïïni ciel, kaawat mana dwøga cwïnya piny ki ïïni?›
english: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni cïp gø ceŋ jø wø töö, nee twöc, këël mano cool jammi bëët moa en bääte.
english: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

anywaa: «Kaawat manøgø, ni näk mo nyïïmëëgu ba wëënnu ni käla yïth cwïnynyu, Wära ni en maal teeŋ gïnögø otïïe dëëtu na enøgønø thuwø.»
english: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jecu ki caan luupögø, ena tïŋŋö Galili, ni ci yïth mïëc Judia løø Naam Jördan løøga.
english: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni läpge køøre, ni køny jøøa tuu moa en dïge kaace.
english: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Paricith aö baŋ Jecu, ni pëënyge eni, ni ge päänynya gø, ni «?Beeye gïn mo beer jï dhaanhø ki man kwier cïïe kiper luubö mør jaak?»
english: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, käru kwaanø, ni Jwøk na cwääc jiy kanya cwääc piny, ‹gena cwääe na thwønh ki maath?›
english: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,

anywaa: Ni put köö, ni ‹Kiper manøgønø, dhaanhø wänni ki menni wø wiie wiiø ni dwätge ki cïïe. Ni ö geni karge riet, ni tïmge na dëël aciel.›
english: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ge patha jiy ariiø këët, 'ba gena dëël aciel. Kiper manøgønø, gïï mo onø dwal Jwøki, kär dee ŋat pää ge.»
english: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cäŋ pëëö, na «?Aperŋø nø, na caani ya Modhe, ni dhaanhø cïïe dee göönnö ki wëël apääk ni kwier gø?»
english: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kiper mana teek cwïnynyu beeye na ö Modhe na wëëk uuni apääk ki määru. 'Ba ki mana täge ki kanya cwääc piny, kär tïïö na enøgønø.
english: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni ŋat wäro kwier cïïe ni paa kiper käp, ni nyöömme ki dhaagø mør, mare beeye luk.»
english: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge aköö jïre, ni «Ni näk bëët dhaanhø ki cïïe beeye enøgønø, beerra man ba nyööm dhaanhe.»
english: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Patha jiy bëët noo jïëc luummögø, 'ba beeye jø wø wëëgi ge keerge.
english: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.

anywaa: Kiper da jiy mo nywöli na bwöy. Ni dee jiy møøk mo tïïya jiyi na bwöy. Ni dee jiy mo ba nyöömmi ni ge tïïya dëëtge ni caala bwöy kiper buya käl maal. 'Ba ŋat mo løny jïre ki man jïëc gïnögø, wär jïëe.»
english: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø obwöre akäl baŋ Jecu nee ceŋŋe kïth bäätge ni läme kiperge. Ni ö bääŋi ni jookge jøøgø.
english: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Weyu obwöre, nee öge baŋa; ni ba mänu ge. Kiper teeŋ obwöre moøgø nø, buya käl maal beeye marge.»
english: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: Ni kïth ceŋŋe bäätge. Køøre ena aay kaace.
english: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyen mør aö baŋ Jecu, ni kööe, ni «?Dïpööy, agïnaŋø ni beer noo tïïa naa jïta ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe?»
english: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïgø, na «?Aŋø, ï pëënynya aani kiper gïn mo beer? Beeye Jwøk keere ni beer. 'Ba ni näk miï manynya man ciï yi kwøw, gwøk gïïa cem Jwøki.»
english: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïgø, na «?A mane rege?» Ni kö Jecu, ni «Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø; kärï kännö ki luk; kärï kwätö; kärï cäänö ki tööt;
english: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,

anywaa: wøør wäru ki meru; ni mëërï ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï enø.»
english: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenøgø aköö jïgø, ni «Gïïögø bëët yaa gwøø. ?Agïnaŋø ni poot kära tïïö nø?»
english: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Ni näk miï manynya man tïm bëëtö marï no othur kare ni beer bäre, ciï ni dwøgï gïïa en jïrï bëët pwödhö, ni mëëgï gwetge jøøa can, ni ööï ni cäädhï køøra. Køøre nø, ïïno jïti ki jap kwär maal.»
english: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyenøgø na wïny gïnögø, ena aay ni cwïnye opädhö. Kiper eni jïre da jammi mo thööth døc.
english: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jï bääge, na «Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, noo tïmö ni teek døc jï ŋat mo okwär ki man døny yi buya käl maal.
english: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

anywaa: Naa cäŋa u cäännö, ni jööta eni jï athïrööl ki man dønye ki waŋ lïlmu ki man ö ŋat mo okwärri ni døny buc Jwøk.»
english: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö bääŋi na wïnyge gïnögø, yïthge athäŋŋö døc, ni pëëge, na «?Aŋa nø, noo maar piem?»
english: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?

anywaa: 'Ba jïge aneen Jecu, ni kööe jïge, ni «Ki jï jiy, gïnögø ba maar lønyø. 'Ba ki jï Jwøk jammi bëët løny.»
english: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

anywaa: Kanyøgø adwøk Piterri jïre, ni kööe, ni «Kawaane jammi bëët awiiwa piny ni caathwa køørï. ?Agïnaŋø nø, noo jootwa?»
english: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni kanyo døøc piny mo nyään, ni beeye kanyo ö Wär Dhaanhø noo pï bäät wäl ajiem mare, u na caath køøra u pïïa bäät wäle apaar kurriiø thuwø, nou ŋøla luum wïth tuk Icriel karge paari kurriiø.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët moa näk mïëri moge ege wiiø, wala nyïïmëëkge, wala wëëkge, wala mëëkge, wala nyïïge, wala pwöth moge, kiper nyeŋŋa, geno jïti ki møøk mo thööth døc mo kaala geni, ni ci kwøwi mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe jïge.
english: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth mo en nyïm ennø, odøø cään, ni ö mo en cään ennø ni pööthge maal.
english: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.

anywaa: «Kiper buya käl maal caala wää pwödhö mo omøøl wøk ka amöölla kuna cääye ki jø tïïö yi pwöthe.
english: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø jïëc jø tïïci ki man mäkge ki gwel mo kar dïcäŋ aciel, gena wëëk ciin yi pwöthe.
english: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cäŋ døø wøk ki caae abïŋween ka amöölla, jiy møøk acäŋ jootø ni ge cuŋŋö jaak kar ŋïëw.
english: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ‹Uuni thuwø, cou yi pwödhö mara. Aano cïpi jïïu ki gwel mo rømø ki tïïc mano tïïyu.› Køøre gena ci pwödhö.
english: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cäŋ døø wøk ki caae apaar kurriiø ki dhöör, ki caae adäk  ki kur abøøya, ena cäŋ jïtö ki jø møøk ni kïth ge yi pwöthe.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cäŋ døø wøk ki caae abïïc ka abøøya, acäŋ jïtö ki jiy møøk mo ge cuŋŋö jaak. Ni kööe jïge, na ‹?Aŋø ni cuŋŋu kany jaak en ki yi cäŋ bäre?›
english: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?

anywaa: «'Ba adwøkge jïre, ni ‹Beeye kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo omooc wa ki tïïc.› «Ni kööe jïge, ni ‹Uuni thuwø, cou yi pwödhö mara.›
english: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya tïme na abøøya, wää pwödhö ŋat wø raŋ jø tïïc mare aluumme ni kööe, ni ‹Cwøl jø tïïc ni mëëgï japge geni, niï tägï ka jøøa öö ŋää cään, këël mano këëtï baŋ jøøa öö dïkwøŋ.›
english: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya ö jøøa kïth yi tïïc ki caae abïïc ka abøøya, ŋati man nø rege amooc ki gwel ma kar dïcäŋ aciel.
english: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøa kwøŋ tägö ki tïïc, ni ege caarø ni gwel moge doo thöötha ge, ŋati man nø rege, atïmö ni joota gwel ma kar dïcäŋ aciel thuwø.
english: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya nø lwørge gwetge, gena tïmö ni ge ŋurö ki nyeŋ wää pwödhö.
english: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

anywaa: Ni köge, ni ‹Jøøi na öö ŋää cään ii, ge tïïya yi caa aciel keere, 'ba gena päänynyï ki waani na ööl ki yi cäŋ bäre, yi cäŋ mo kwaar døc.›
english: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.

anywaa: «'Ba adwøge jï dhaanhø aciel dëëtge, ni ‹Nyawat, bäŋ gïn mo yaa baaø dëërï. ?Aŋø, ï kär jïëy ki dwøra na bëëde niï daa cunnö ki gwel ma kar dïcäŋ aciel?
english: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?

anywaa: Lwør mana näk marï ni aayï. Kiper a manynya man mooa jøøa öö ŋää cään ki teeŋ mana mëëga ïïni.
english: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba løny jïra ki man tïïa gïna manynya ki gïno näk mara? ?Aŋø, cwïnyï ränynyi kaper mana bäth yia?› »
english: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aköö, ni «Kaawat manøgønø, jiy moa kwörge therø opööth maal, ni ö moa kwörge døøŋŋø ni døøge cään.»
english: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïŋ Jecu ni eni cøøa Jerucalem, bääŋi na näk apaar kurriiø acwøl kur keerge. 'Ba kanya cääthge jöö ena köö jïge,
english: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,

anywaa: ni «Neennu, ø cøøa Jerucalem. 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk. 'Ba eno ŋølge yi thøø,
english: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,

anywaa: ni cïpge gø ceŋ juurre nee buui, ni pwödi, ni nääi bäät jaadha no odëëdö. 'Ba noo tïme na ri dää nïne eno tïŋ maal ki yi thøø.»
english: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø mii wäät Dhebedi aö baŋ Jecu ni eni cäädhi ka wääte. Ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïme, ni pëëny gø ki gïrpiny.
english: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?» Ni dwøgi ya nyijøøgø jïgø, ni «Cïpï ki dwøl nee wääta moi na ariiø ii pïge piny bura marï, na aciel ena bäät cwïïï, ni ö maya ni en bäät caamï.»
english: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, no «U pëënynya gïn mo kuyu. ?Maara lønyø jïïu ki man mäthu ka athöönhnho mätha ki gø?» Ni köge jïgø, ni «Løny jïwa.»
english: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «Athöönhnha omaathu møn. 'Ba pïïn bäät cwïïa wala bäät caama, cïpe ba en jïra, 'ba cïpe ena jï Wära, ni cïbe jï jøøa jiiŋ gø kiperge.»
english: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya bääge moa na apaar, gena gootø ki nyïïmëëe moø na ariiø yøø.
english: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba ge bëët gena cwøl Jecu baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Ŋäyu ni kwääri mo juurre, dëëtge ege cuumö bäät jiy moge, ni ö jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø dïge ni nyoothge teekge bäät jiy moa en tietge.
english: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba u ba doo tïmö na enøgønø. 'Ba ŋat wäro many man tïme ni dwøŋŋa kare dïïu, wär tïme na ŋat mo tïnynya uuni.
english: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;

anywaa: Ni ŋat wäro many man tïme ni ena nyïm dïïu, wär dëëre døøc ma laŋŋø jïïu,
english: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:

anywaa: kaawat man bëët Wär Dhaanhø en ni kär öö nee tïnynyi, 'ba eni ööi kaper nee jø møøk tïnynye, ni cïpa jwïëye na wïïdi kiper jiy mo thööth.»
english: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu ki bääge na tïŋge Jerikö, lwaak mo päl aläp køøre.
english: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø da jak ma cööye ma ariiø mo opï piny thääŋ jöö. 'Ba kanya wïnyge gø ni beeye Jecu ni pöödhi enø, gena köök ni köge, ni «Wui Kwäärö, Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canwa!»
english: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

anywaa: 'Ba gena jook lwaaki, ni cäänge geni nee lïŋge. 'Ba beeye mana putge rëëdö døc, ni «Kwäärö, Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canwa!»
english: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.

anywaa: Ni cuŋ Jecu, ni cwøl geni, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyu nee tïïa jïïu?»
english: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?

anywaa: Ni dwøkge gø jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, jap nyeŋwa.»
english: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

anywaa: Ni päth cwïny Jecu kiperge, ni mul nyeŋge. Ni put nyeŋge døø karge, ni putge wääth køør Jecu.
english: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu ki bääge na pïïcge Bethpec bäät Kïn Ølip, kany mo kare cään ki Jerucalem, Jecu bääŋi moe ariiø ajääŋŋe,
english: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Cou paanø ni en nyïmmu enø. 'Ba uuno jïti ka arëën mo omaa piny, ni nyaare ena buute. Ge wär pätu ni kälu ge baŋa.
english: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba noo näk da ŋat mo cäännö ki uuni, wäru kööu, ni ‹Kwäärö manynya ge.› 'Ba oput ŋatøce wëëk uuni.»
english: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.

anywaa: Manøgø tägi kaper nee gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki thur kare, na kööe,
english: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,

anywaa: ni «Køpu jï jø Dhayan, ni ‹Neennu, nyenynyu ni ö baŋu. Eni mwöl, ni eni cäädhi ka bäät arëën, ni beeye nya arëën, nyi lään wø tïët jammi.› »
english: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.

anywaa: Ni ö bääŋi ni cige ni tïïcge gïnögø kaawat mana caani ya Jecu jïge.
english: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,

anywaa: Ni kälge arëën ki nyaare, ni kïthge abïïe moge bäätge. Ni ö Jecu ni pï bäät nya arëën.
english: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.

anywaa: 'Ba päl lwaak bäre abïïe moge apeethge waŋjöö, ni ö møøki ni ŋøtge bäät jenni ni peethge ge waŋjöö.
english: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa bwödhö nyïme ki moa cäädhö cään, ni rëëtge, ni «Odhaana! Pwøc en jï Nyikwaar Deebit. Gwïëth en ri ŋat ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk! Pwøc en jï Jwøk!»
english: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na døny Jerucalem, pääny bäre aniïïk, ni köge, ni «?Man aŋa?»
english: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?

anywaa: Ni kö lwaaki, ni «Man beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Jecu nyï Nadhareth na en Galili.»
english: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni døny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni rïëm jøøa gädhö ki jammi wøk bëët yi øt Jwøk, ki jøøa ŋëëö, ni jaal tharabëëte mo jø wø wïïdö ki gwel, ni jaal köömmi mo jø wø gädhö ka akuyi.
english: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, no «Ogöörö yi wëël Jwøk ni Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Øda doo cwølø ni øt lam.› 'Ba uuni, atïïyu na kar dïmute.»
english: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.

anywaa: Ni ö cööye ki ŋööte baŋe Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. Ni køny geni.
english: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk cwïnyge aränynyö kanya neenge gïïa näk rëëma ec na tïïc Jecu, no obwöre kwöŋŋö Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni «Odhaana! Pwøc en jï Nyikwaar Deebit,»
english: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,

anywaa: ni pëënyge Jecu, na «?Aŋø, gïn car obwöyi ii ba wïnynyï?» Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïge, na «Awïnynya. ?Aŋø, luubö man käru kwaanø yi wëël Jwøk bäre bäre? Acaan Wëël Jwøki, «ni ‹Ï na Wuuö Jwøk, pwøc man pwøc ï ki gø atïïyï nee thur kare ki køør luup moa car obwöre moa therø këël moa näk poot dhøøth.› »
english: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni wii ge kaagø, ni aae päänyögø ni ci Bethani, ni but yie.
english: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na amöölla, ni Jecu døøa pääny, ena 'näk käci.
english: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.

anywaa: 'Ba na neen olaam thääŋ jöö, ena gaa baŋ gø, ni bäŋe nyïëdi mo ee joodø ri gø, 'ba beeye bøøge keerge na joode. Ni kööe jï olaam, ni «Bäŋ nyïëdi mo cäŋ jootø dëërï këët.» Ni ö olaammi ni put bäbö.
english: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö bääŋi na neenge gø, yïthge arëëm, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, olaam olaar bäbö nidïï ennø?»
english: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni näk jïïu da ŋäädhe nou ba tääö, paa teeŋ gïna tïïc dëër olaam keere noo tïïyu, 'ba këël u köömma kïdi man, ni ‹Tïŋ riï ni leeŋï riï yi naama dwøŋ›, gïnögø puta tägö.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.

anywaa: Ni näk mo jïïu da ŋäädhe, gïn wäro pëënynyu ki lam, cøøa jïïu.»
english: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu adøny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba kanya bëëde ni eni pöö kaace, kwääc laam ki jaae gena ö baŋe ni pëënyge eni, na «?A teega ŋø ni wø tïïyï gïïögøøni ki gø? ?Na aŋa na wëëk teegøgø ïïni?»
english: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, no «U pëënynya pëënynyö ki pïëc aciel thuwø. 'Ba ni näk mo løgu løø jïra, aani, teek man wø tïïa gïïögø ki gø, ocaana jïïu thuwø.»
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Lwøk mana löö Jøønni ki gø na nyuudhi okäla kaa na bëëde? ?Käla maal, wala käla baŋ jiy?» Kanyøgønø, dhøkge aløøŋge yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni «Noo caanø gø, ni ‹Käla maal,› eni köö jïïø, na ‹?Aŋø nø, na ba jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni?›
english: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?

anywaa: 'Ba noo caanø gø, ni ‹Käla baŋ jiy›, ø lwäär ki lwaak, kiper jiy bëët ojïëy ni Jøøn beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk.»
english: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aløkge jï Jecu, ni «Kucwa.» Ni kö Jecu jïge, «'Ba aani thuwø, teek man wø tïïa gïïögø ki gø, ba caana jïïu.
english: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

anywaa: «?Agïnaŋø ni caarru? Da dhaanhø mo jïre da wääte ariiø. Ni ci baŋ mana dïkwøŋ, ni kööe, ni ‹Wääda, ciï ni tïïï yi pwödhö dïcäŋi.›
english: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya wääde jïre, na ‹A ba cii.› 'Ba køøre cään, wïïe acäŋ caarrø, ni cøøe.
english: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ ci baŋ wääde maya, ni cään gø thuwø na enønø. Ni dwøgi ya wääde manøgø, na ‹A cøø, Awuuö.› 'Ba eni kär cøø.
english: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.

anywaa: ?A mane nø røk obwöre moø na ariiø yøø na tïïc mana many wänni?» Ni köge, ni «Mana dïkwøŋ.» Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn a cäänna uuni, ni jø ajwäk ki kääpe oci buc Jwøk nou poodi.
english: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.

anywaa: Kiper Jøøn aö baŋu ni køpa jöör bëënynyö, ni käru jïëy ki mare. 'Ba mare ajïëc jø ajwäki ki kääpe. 'Ba uuni, këël na neennu gïnögø, cwïnynyu käru løø ni jïëyu mare.»
english: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Cäŋu luubö mør wïnynyö mo keda leer. Da wää ŋøømmi mo opïïdhö ki jer omøki yi pwöthe, ni ciel gø ki ciel, ni tïïe ki kany wø bii nyïïomøki yie yi pwöthögø, ni gëëde ki øt koor, ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø puur, ni aa paac mør.
english: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm kar nyïïomøki ni cään ki man ciekge, laaŋe moe ajääŋŋe baŋ jø puur moøgø, nee känge ki nyïïomøki jïre.
english: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.

anywaa: 'Ba jø puur moøgø laaŋe moe amakge, ni pwötge aciel ni 'näkge maya, ni këërge maya ki kïte.
english: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.

anywaa: Køøre wää ŋøømmi acäŋ jäägö ki laaŋe møøk mo thöötha ge ki moa dïkwøŋ. Ni cäŋge teeŋ gïïa dïkwøŋ tïïyö dëët laaŋe moøgø.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.

anywaa: Køøre wää ŋøømmi wääde ajääŋŋe baŋge, ni kööe, ni ‹Wääda wøørge wøørø.›
english: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø puurri na jootge wääde, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge ni köge, ni ‹Man beeye lwiidhø. Beerra man nääø gø, nee jape ci jïïø.›
english: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.

anywaa: Ni makge gø, ni leeŋge gø wøk ŋää pwödhö, ni 'näkge gø.
english: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.

anywaa: ?'Ba kanyo ö wää pwöthögø, agïnaŋø noo tïïe ki jø puur moøgø?»
english: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?

anywaa: Ni dwøkge gø jïre, ni «Jø puur moøgø ni reyø yøø, nääe nääö ki 'näk mo raac døc, ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø puur møøk mo cïpö jïre ki nyïïomøki kany wø ciekge yie.»
english: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, luubö man käru kwaanø yi wëël Jwøk? Acaan wëël Jwøki, «ni ‹Kïdi mana kwier dïgëëte, atïmö na kïn gøøt mana pere letha eni na mak øtø. Ni gïnögø tïïya Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye gïn mo rëëma ec ki nyeŋŋø.›
english: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, a cäänna uuni, ni buc Jwøk okäl wøk ceŋŋu ni wëëgi jø paac mør mo bëëdö ka bëëtö mo orømø ki bëët buc Jwøk.»
english: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.

anywaa: ['Ba ŋato päth bäät kïnnögø opøti ni tïme na thäŋi. 'Ba noo näk mo pätha bäät dhaanhø, ŋatøca oŋiidhe.]
english: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääc laam ki jø Paricith na wïnyge luup Jecu moø ni keda leere yøø, ajootge ki cwïnyge ni Jecu geela geni.
english: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïmge ni ge manynya man makge Jecu, gena lwäyö ki lwaak, kiper ojïëc lwaaki ni Jecu beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu jiy acäŋ cäännö ki luup mo keda leere, ni kööe,
english: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,

anywaa: ni «Buya käl maal doo päärö ki nyeya mo da cam mo ee jiiŋŋø kiper nywöm mar wääde,
english: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,

anywaa: ni jääŋ laaŋe moe wøk kuna cwølge jøøa näk ocwølø kar cam nywöm. 'Ba jøøgø akweer ki öö.
english: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ laaŋe moe møøk jääŋŋö, ni kööe, ni ‹Caannu jï jøøa näk ocwølø kar cam nywöm, ni «Ennø, cam anø jiiŋŋa, ni rwädhe ki røøe 'moa moa no olør yaa nø 'näk, ni jammi bëët onø jiiŋŋø. Ööu kar cam nywöm.» ›
english: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa ööt nyeya baŋge, luumme adøøcge luubö mo bäŋ tiere, ni aacge, ni ö mørri ni ci yi pwöthe, ni ci mørri kar tïïe.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi moa dööŋ ni makge laaŋe mo nyeya, ni caange geni ki caannø mo raac døc, ni 'näkge geni.
english: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya cwïnye aränynyö, ni jääŋ jø tøŋ moe, ni dïïr wïth dïnäge moøgø, ni waaŋ poge.
english: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

anywaa: Køøre nyeya aköö jï laaŋe moe, ni ‹Kar nywöm onø jiiŋŋø. 'Ba jøøa cwøl, gena tïmö ni ge paa jiy mo orømø ki cwøl.
english: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cou uutjïëthe, ni cwøllu jøw ojootu bëët nee öge kar cam nywöm.›
english: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

anywaa: «Ni ö laaŋe moøgø ni aage wøk uutjïëthe ni kälge jøøa jootge bëët, ni beege jiy moa reyø ki moa beyø bëët. Ni ö kar nywömmi ni pääŋe ki wëëlle.
english: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya ö nyeya kuna neen wëëlle, ena jïtö ki dhaanhø mør kaace mo dëëre bäŋ abïï nywöm.
english: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:

anywaa: Ni pëëny gø, ni ‹?Nyawat, ïïno ö kany nidïï ni dëërï bäŋ abïï nywöm?› Ni ö nyenøgø ni magi ya apïte.
english: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyeya aköö jï laaŋe moe, ni ‹Twöyu ceŋŋe ki tiete, ni leeŋu eni wøk yi muudhö, kany wø jwöŋ jiyi yie ni mööta lakge.›
english: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo thööth wø di cwølø, 'ba beege mo nøk noo jier.»
english: For many are called, but few are chosen.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Paricith aay ni cooŋge røkge ki man määnyge ki jöö man dwøc dhi Jecu ki gø ki køør luup moo care.
english: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.

anywaa: Ni jääŋge bääŋi moge baŋe, ni ge cii ka jic Eerat na aciel, ni köge jïgø, ni «Dïpööy, ŋäcwa ni ïïna dhaanhø miï caana adïëri, niï pöö ka jöör Jwøk na adïëri, ni jiy raŋï ka waŋ aciel, ni bäŋ jiy mo kwörge døøŋŋø mo lwäärï.
english: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caanï jïwa. ?Agïnaŋø ni caarï? ?Beeye gïn mo beer ki man cïpö ka ajwäk jï Cidhar, wala ba beer?»
english: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu kanya ŋäc rääö marge, ena köö, na «?Aŋø ni päänynyu aani, u jø atade?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?

anywaa: Nyuunhnhu aani ki gwelø man wø cïp kiper ajwäk.» Ni känge jïgø ki gwelø.
english: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «?Man a kïdö mar ŋa ni nyeŋŋe oput göör bääte en?»
english: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

anywaa: Ni dwøkge gø jïgø, ni «Beeye Cidhar.» Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Dwøgu japa näk jap Cidhar baŋ Cidhar, ni dwøgu japa näk jap Jwøk baŋ Jwøk.»
english: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnyge gïnögøøni, yïthge arëëm, ni wecge Jecu ni aacge.
english: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.

anywaa: 'Ba ni poot na dïcäŋögøøni, jø Cajucith ni wø köö ni bäŋ duun wøk ki yi thøø, møøk aö baŋ Jecu, ni pëënyge eni ki pïëc,
english: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Dïpööy, Modhe aköö, ‹Ni näk dhaanhø thøw ni jïre bäŋ obwöre, coki doo dööŋ ki cï gø, ni dee wï coki nywølø.›
english: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba da jak ma nyïïmëëe abïriiø mo obëëdö dïwa. Mana dïkwøŋ anyöömmö, ni thøøe, ni bäŋ obwöre. Ni wëëk cïïe coki.
english: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:

anywaa: Ni ö rietge thuwø ni thøøe ni bäŋ obwöre, këël dääge, këël mana thumge karge bïriedi.
english: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

anywaa: Køørge nø, dhaagø aläw thøø.
english: And last of all the woman died also.

anywaa: ?Kiper manøgønø, kanyo duu jiyi wøk ki yi thøø, dhaagø manøgø otïme na cï ŋa dï jagøgø na abïriiø yøø? Kiper ena bëëdö na cï ŋati man nø.»
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïge, ni «Uuna bääyö, kiper weet Jwøk kuyu, këël teek Jwøk.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.

anywaa: Kiper kanyo duu jiyi wøk ki yi thøø, røk ba nywøm këët. 'Ba ge tïmö ni ge caala nyïïatwiet maal.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.

anywaa: ?'Ba nee kiper luum duun wøk ki yi thøø, mana caan Jwøki jïïu käru kwaanø? Ena köö,
english: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,

anywaa: ni ‹Aana Jwø Eeberam, ni näga Jwø Aydhak, ni näga Jwø Jeekap.› Eni paa Jwø jøøa näk othøw, 'ba ena Jwø jøøa kwøw.»
english: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö lwaaki na wïnyge gïnögø, yïthge athäŋŋö ki pwöc mare.
english: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnynyi ya jø Paricithi ni Jecu jø Cajucith ee dhällö, jø Paricith rege adwalge na aciel.
english: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

anywaa: Ni ö nyen mørri dïge ma ŋat wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk, ni pëëny eni, ni päänynya gø, ni kööe,
english: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

anywaa: ni «?Dïpööy, a ciik mane ni dwøŋŋa eni røk ciik Jwøk?»
english: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïre, ni « ‹Ï doo mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï ki cwïnyï bäre, ki jwïëyï bäre, ka acaayï bäre.›
english: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye ciik mana dwøŋŋa eni na pere leth.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

anywaa: Ni rietge poot caala manøgø thuwø, ni ‹Ï doo mëër ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï.›
english: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

anywaa: Ni beege ciik moi na ariiø ii na göök ciik Jwøki bëët rege, këël luup moa køp nyïïkuk Jwøki.»
english: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot jø Paricithi ni dëëtge ege cooŋ kanya ciel, gena pëëny Jecu ki pïëc,
english: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

anywaa: ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø ni caarru kiper Krictø? ?Ena o ŋa?» Ni dwøkge gø jïre, ni «Ena O Deebit.»
english: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Aperŋø nø, na cwøli ya Deebiti ni Kwäärö ki køør mana nyooth Jwïëc Jwøki jïre, kanya caan gø,
english: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,

anywaa: «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Kwääya, ni «Pï bäät cwïïa, këël mano cïba nyïïmännï tietï» ›?
english: The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?

anywaa: ?Ni näk eno nø cwøl Deebiti ni Kwäärö na enønø, a dee cäŋ tïmö na wääde nidïï?»
english: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo oløny jïre ki man duun gø ki luubö. Ni bäŋe ŋat mo cwïnye ee maar mak ki man pëëny gø ki pïëc møøk këët køør pïëyögø.
english: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu lwaak ki bääge aluumme, ni kööe,
english: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,

anywaa: ni «Dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith geno dööŋ kar Modhe ni ge pöö.
english: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, tïïyu gïn wäro caange jïïu ni gwøgu gø, 'ba gïn wø tïïcge kär tïïyu. Kiper gïrpiny wø køpge købø, ni ba tïïcge gø.
english: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.

anywaa: Kiper ge wø twöya tëër mo dwøŋ mo peek ki man tïëti, ni kïthge geni göök jiy. 'Ba ge ki dëëtge gïïögø ba maarge gut këël ki lweetge kiree.
english: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

anywaa: Ni tïïe moge bëët wø tïïcge kaper nee neen jiyi. Kiper opïri moge mo wø twöö dëël na näk tiet weet Jwøk okwøø yïthge wø tïïcge tïïö ni døøŋŋø, ni tïïcge okuri mo waare mo wø twöö ceŋ aleeŋŋe moge ni thøøthge bäyö døc,
english: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

anywaa: ni yïthge met ka kwör mo ge di wøørø yïthge kwör caammi, ni yïthge met ki kwör bëëte moa beyø geni yïth uut acook lam,
english: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

anywaa: ni ge manynya man määth geni kwör gath, ni ge cøør jiyi cøørø ni Dïpööye.
english: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u ba doo cwølø ni Dïpööye. Kiper jïïu da Dïpööy aciel, ni uuna nyïïmëëe bëët.
english: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat cwøllu ni wääu bäät piny. Kiper jïïu da Wääu aciel mo ena maal.
english: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

anywaa: Ni ba cwøl u ni uuna kwääri. Kiper jïïu da Kwäärö aciel, ni beeye Krictø.
english: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato kare dwøŋŋa eni dïïu, otïmö ni tïnynya uuni.
english: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø døøc dëëre mo dwøŋ, odwøk piny. 'Ba ŋat wø dwøk dëëre piny, kare otïïc ni dwøŋ.
english: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

anywaa: «'Ba u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, otïmö ni raac jïïu, kiper buya käl maal you mänö ki jiy. Kiper u ki dëëtu u ba ci yie, ni jøøa doo ci yie ba wëënnu thuwø.
english: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, kiper u wø wïïrö nou cäädhi ka yïth näm ni cäädhu ki wøk kiper nou jïtu ki dhaanhø aciel mo løk ree. 'Ba noo nø løk ree, døøyu mo raac døc, ni tïme na ŋat mo orømø ki man leeŋi yi maac kar ajäla ni kaala uuni.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u na dïpïëye ma cööye, u wø köö, ‹Ni näk dhaanhø kööŋŋa ŋëët Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, pere ba leth døc, 'ba ni näk dhaanhø kööŋŋa ŋëët warkey mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, eni gïna kööŋe kipere ba dee wiiø.›
english: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

anywaa: ?U na cööye ni bäŋ wïdhi en, aŋø, a mane ni dwøŋŋa eni, beeye warkey wala Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ na tïïc warkey ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk?
english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

anywaa: Ni kööu, ‹Ni näk dhaanhø kööŋŋa ŋëët gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, pere ba leth døc; 'ba ni näk dhaanhø kööŋŋa ŋëët olämi mano cïp bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, gïna kööŋe kipere ba dee wiiø.›
english: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

anywaa: ?U na cööye en, aŋø, a mane ni dwøŋŋa eni, beeye olämi wala gïn wø cïp olämme bääte na tïïc olämi ni ena kur keere na mar Jwøk?
english: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋat wø kööŋ ŋëët gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, kööŋŋa ŋëët gø ki jammi bëët mo wø en bääte.
english: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø kööŋ ŋëët Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, kööŋŋa ŋëët gø ki ŋëët Jwøk ni wø bëëdö yie.
english: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø kööŋ ŋëët maal, kööŋŋa ŋëët wäl Jwøk ki ŋëët Jwøk ni wø bëëdö bääte.
english: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, kiper u wø cïpa paac wïth jammi jï Jwøk røk gïï wø thenh thenh wø piith lak paac, ni weyu moa perge leth ri ciik Jwøk, teeŋ ka ŋøl luup ni beer, ki køny, ki ŋäädhe. Gïïögø beege gïïa dou tïïö, ni ba weyu moøgø thuwø.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

anywaa: U na dïpïëye ma cööye, u wø thïï twöŋö wøk ni mwønynyu athïrööl.
english: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, kiper u wø penya ŋää awal ki ŋää athäänh, 'ba yïthge päŋ ki møt ki rääö.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

anywaa: U jø Paricith, u na cööye, kwøŋu ya awal ki ya athäänh peny, køøre ŋäthge otïmö ni waany thuwø.
english: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, kiper u caala bwör mo orwødhø ki booya mo tar, ni wø nëëni ni mïërö ki wøk, 'ba yïthge päŋ ki cuu jiy mo othøw ki gïï mo reyø bëët.
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgøøni, u nëëni na jiy mo beyø ki jï jiy, 'ba yïthu päŋ ka atade ki rääö.
english: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, u na jø atade, kiper uuni, uut bwör mo nyïïkuk Jwøk wø geerru geerø ni ŋwaŋŋu bwöc jøøa beyø ni mïërö,
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

anywaa: ni kööu, ni ‹Doo naa ø nut ri nïr kwäyø, ø ba doo dwätö ki geni ki man kønynyø rem mo nyïïkuk Jwøk piny.›
english: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

anywaa: Manøgøøni, u køpa rou ni uuna nyïïkwaac jøøa tïïc gïï mo leth dëët nyïïkuk Jwøk ni 'näkge ge.
english: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, putu bëëtö nou tïïya gïna tïïc kwäyu.
english: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.

anywaa: ?U na thwöre, ni nägu nyïï thwöre, uuno bøthu nidïï ki man ŋøl ajäl maac bäätu?
english: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki jøøa wïthge leer, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk jääŋŋa jääŋŋö baŋu. Jø møøk dïge 'nägu nääö, ni guru ge bäät jenni moa no odëëdö, ni pöötu møøk yïth uut acook lam mou, ni riemu geni wøk paani nø, ki paani nø.
english: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

anywaa: 'Ba kwör rep jøøa beyø na køny piny bäät piny oduu bäätu, ni tägi ka rem Eebel na näk mare beer këël mano këët ri rem Dhekaraya o Barakia, ŋata 'nägu yaakic Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni gïïögø bëët opïï bäät jø pinyi en.
english: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

anywaa: «Wui, Jerucalem, Jerucalem, ï wø nääŋ nyïïkuk Jwøk ni këërï jø wø jääŋŋi baŋï ki kïte. ?A kwöre adïï naa manynya man cooŋa nyïïï kanya ciel, kaawat man wø tïïc gwienø wø cooŋ nyïïe tiet bwöpe, nou kweeyø?
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!

anywaa: 'Ba neennu, pou adööŋ jïïu no oränynyö.
english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

anywaa: Kiper a cäänna uuni, naa ba jootu këët, këël mano kööu, ni ‹Gwïëth en jï ŋat ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu adøny wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni aae. 'Ba bääge aö baŋe nee uudi moa en dëër Øt Jwøk nyooth jïre.
english: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, ni «?Gïïögø bëët ajootu? Adïëri møn a cäänna uuni, otïmö ni bäŋ kïdi aciel kany mo dööŋ bäät watge ni ba leeŋ piny.»
english: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pï piny bäät Kïn Ølip, bääge aö baŋe kur keerge, ni köge, ni «?Caanï jïwa, a wäne noo täk gïïögø, na agïnaŋø noo näk ŋïï mar öönynyï ki mar kanyo cuŋ pinynyi yie?»
english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, ni «Gwøgu rou, nee bäŋe ŋat mo maaŋ wïthu.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo thööth oööi ki nyeŋŋa, ni kö ŋati man nø, ni ‹Beeye aani na Krictø.› Ni ö geni ni maaŋge wïth jiy mo thööth.
english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

anywaa: 'Ba mänye ki waac mänye owïnynyu. 'Ba kär cwïnynyu bwøk. Kiper gïïögø kwøŋa tägö, 'ba cuŋŋe poodi.
english: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

anywaa: Kiper paac mør dëëre othïïŋe ri paac mør, ni ö nyeya mørri ni thïïŋ ree ri nyeya mør, ni jït mïëri mo thööth ki meel, ni tïm kwör mo thööthi ni jäŋŋi.
english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët beege nyäät gïï mo leth moo tägi.
english: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

anywaa: «Kanyøca uuno kïthge dhøk gïï mo leth, ni nääŋge uuni. Ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni mänge ki uuni kiper nyeŋŋa.
english: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba kaaca jiy mo thööth odøø cään, ni tïm ŋati man nø ni dëëre ŋeee ŋeeø ki watge maya, ni mänge ki røkge.
english: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk mo thööth mo patha adïëri rege othïïŋge ni maaŋge wïth jiy mo thööth.
english: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mano tïm rääö ni päl, thööth jiy mëër marge othïnhnhi.
english: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato jïëny gïïögø këël aŋuunne, opiem.
english: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyään na met mar buya käl maal okøp dï piny bäre nee gïre wïny wïth juurre bëët. Køøre aŋuun piny oööi.
english: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

anywaa: «'Ba gïna näk ec raac ki gø døc na näk gïr ränynyö ojootu ni cuŋŋa yi kanya en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk, ni beeye gïna køp nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Daniel.» Beerra man ö ŋato kwaan luubö man ni ŋäc tier gø.
english: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

anywaa: «Kanyøca nø, jø wø en Judia wär bwøkge bäät kïte.
english: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

anywaa: Ni ŋato en wï øtø, kär nee duua piny kuna käl gïï mo ena yi øde.
english: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

anywaa: Ni ö ŋato en yi pwödhö, ni ba duu paac kuna lwør abïïne.
english: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth døc jï määro yïthge da jiy, ki määro dhwödhö yïth nïröke.
english: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

anywaa: 'Ba lämu nee böök maru ba täge ka arïïa, wala cäŋ jwömö.
english: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

anywaa: Kiper kar kaaca piny ojïti ki teeŋ gïï mo leth døc, mo kär kwøŋ tägö ki mana täge ki kanya cwääc piny këël kawaane en, ni bäŋ teeŋe mo cäŋ tägö këët na bäre bäre.
english: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

anywaa: 'Ba doo na nïrögø kär tïïö ni nøk, doo bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo piemø. 'Ba kiper jøøa no ojierø, nïrögø otïïc ni nøk kiperge.
english: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.

anywaa: Kar kaace ni näk da ŋat mo köö ki uuni, ni ‹Neennu, Krictø en,› wala ‹Eni ice,› käru nou jïëy ki gø.
english: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.

anywaa: Kiper Kricte mo patha adïëri ki nyïïkuk Jwøk mo patha adïëri, rege othïïŋge ni tïïge ki ŋïïce mo døøŋŋø ki gïï mo rëëma ec, nee wïth jiy maaŋge; këël wïth jøøa näk ojierø maaŋge maaŋŋø thuwø ni näk mo løny jïge.
english: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a caana gø jïïu kany poode ni poot kär tägö en.
english: Behold, I have told you before.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk ge köö jïïu, ni ‹Neennu, Krictø ena dï paap,› käru nou cøøa wøk. 'Ba ni näk ge köö, ni ‹Neennu, eni ena dï øtø kuya,› käru nou jïëy ki gø.
english: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

anywaa: Kiper ööny Wär Dhaanhø otïmö kaamar agaackøth ni wø nigaaŋ ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ ni këët dääre jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ.
english: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

anywaa: Kaawat man wø købi, ni kany wø näk da dëël mo othøw yie, cøre wø kuuta yie.
english: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

anywaa: «'Ba køør gïïo leth moo tägi yïth nïrögøøni, « ‹cäŋ oput tïïc ni cøl, ni ö dwääyi ni ba cïp taye, ni päänh ceerri ki maal, ni ö gïïa näk jïge da teek maal ni jäŋi.›
english: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ŋïï mar Wär Dhaanhø onëëni maalø, ni ö jø pinynyi bëët ni kïmge, ni ö geni ni neenge Wär Dhaanhø ni öö ki bäät pøøl mo maal ni jïre da teek ka ajiem mo dwøŋ.
english: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

anywaa: Ni jääŋ nyïïatwiet maal moe ni da tuuŋ mo dwøre dwøŋ mo di koodhø, ni cooŋge jiye moa näk ee jierø, ni kälge ka wïth tuk piny karge ŋweeni, ni beeye bäät piny bäre.
english: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

anywaa: «Ennø, kwänynyu ki pwöc dëër olaam. Kany wø tïm bääte ni løth ni jïte ki bøøge, wø ŋäyu ŋääö ni dhikøth kare acäännö.
english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, kanyo neennu gïïo tägi bäät piny bëët, oŋäyu ni ööny Wär Dhaanhø kare acäännö, ni ena dhi kiir kiree.
english: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni beenhnhø man ba pöödhi ni gïïögø bëët poot kär cööp karge.
english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

anywaa: Maal ki piny opöödhi, 'ba luupa ba dak.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋöca ki yi caannøca, bäŋ ŋat ŋäc gø, këël nyïïatwiet maal wala Wäädö. 'Ba beeye Wuuö keere.
english: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

anywaa: 'Ba ööny Wär Dhaanhø otïmö kaamar nïr Nöa.
english: But as the days of Noah were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

anywaa: Kiper kanya poot jwïïe ni kär öö, jiy abëëdö ni ge cämö ni ge mädhö, ni ge nyöömö, këël dïcäŋa ö Nöa na døny yi jääy,
english: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark,

anywaa: ni bëëtge ni ööny jwïïö kucge këël mana ö jwïïe ni dïïr wïthge bëët. 'Ba ööny Wär Dhaanhø otïmö ni caala manøgø thuwø.
english: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.

anywaa: Kar kaaca, nee da jiy ariiø mo ena yi pwödhö, aciel okäl, ni wec maya.
english: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

anywaa: Nee da mään ariiø mo öödö bäät pany, aciel okäl, ni wec maya.
english: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kuru. Kiper dïcäŋo ö Kwääyu yie kuyu.
english: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäyu gïn, onää wää øtø kanyo ö kuuwi yie ki wäär ee ŋääö, eni doo kurö, ni dee øde ba wëëk toor.
english: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, uuni thuwø, bëëdu ni røgu you jiiŋŋø. Kiper Wär Dhaanhø öö ri caa mo käru dïëdö.
english: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

anywaa: «?Na a laŋŋø mane nø, ni wïïe leer mo maar ka ŋääth, ni cuumi kwääye bäät laaŋe mo wø tïïö bëët paare, nee cam marge nee wø mëëk ge kany wø näk ma kare?
english: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋø mano nwän kwääye ni tïïö na enøgønø kanyo ööe, gwïëth oen jïre.
english: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni jape bëët owii cer ŋatøgø.
english: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk laŋŋø manøgø raac, ni kööe ki cwïnye, ni ‹Kwääya aruu,›
english: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

anywaa: ni täge ki man pwöt laaŋe moa tïïö na aciel ki eni, ni cäme ni mädhe ki jø meeye,
english: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

anywaa: kwääc laŋŋø manøgø oööi ki waŋcäŋ mo käre dïëdö, ki yi caa mo kuue,
english: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

anywaa: ni pwöt gø ki pöödö mo teek døc, ni kïth gø dï jø atade, kany wø jwöŋ jiyi yie ni ge mööta lakge.
english: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: «'Ba buya käl maal doo päärö ki nyïïakuue apaar mo lambae moge ege lwørø ni cige kuna jølge ŋat nywöm.
english: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

anywaa: Ki røk nyïïakuue moøgø, abïïc dïge wïthge bäŋ acaara. 'Ba abïïc wïthge leer.
english: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

anywaa: Kiper moa wïthge bäŋ acaara na lwørge lambae moge, bäŋ mädhi mo ege käärö.
english: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

anywaa: 'Ba moa wïthge leer akäädö ki wïlle mo yïthge da mädhi ki lambae moge.
english: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ruu ŋat nywömmi, gena narø ni butge bëët.
english: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dï wäär, dwøl awïnyö, mo köö, ni ‹Neennu, ŋat nywöm aöö. Ööu wøk kuna jølu eni.›
english: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø nyïïakuugögø aö maal ni thoothge lambae moge.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

anywaa: Ni kö moa wïthge bäŋ acaara jï moa wïthge leer, ni ‹Mooyu wa dëët mädhi mou, kiper lambae mowa manynya thøø.›
english: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

anywaa: «'Ba adwøk moa wïthge leer, ni ‹Ba løny; mädhi ba rømi ki øøni bëët. Beerra man cou baŋ jø wø gädhö ki mädhi ni ŋëëmmu dëëtu.›
english: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya cige kuna ŋëëwge, ŋat nywöm aöö. Ni ci jøøa näk rege ege jiiø kar cam nywöm ki eni na aciel. Ni cïëk dhi øtø.
english: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

anywaa: «Køøre nyïïakuue møga aluuny öö thuwø, ni cwølge ŋata nyöömmö ni köge, ni ‹Kwäärö, Kwäärö, jap dhi øtø jïwa.›
english: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

anywaa: «'Ba aduue jïge, na ‹Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, u kuua.›
english: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, kuru, kiper cäŋögø ki caannøgø kuyu karge riet.
english: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.

anywaa: «Kiper gïnögø otïmö kaamar nyen mo manynya wääth, ni cwøl laaŋe moe, ni cïp gwete jïge nee tïïge ki geni.
english: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

anywaa: Ni cïpe jï dhaanhø aciel ki gwel abïïc, ni mooc maya ki gwel ariiø, ni mooc dääge ki gwelø aciel, ni ŋati man nø mooe ka køør mana no orømø ki eni. Køøre ena aay.
english: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata mooc ki gwel abïïc ni put aay ni gädhe ki ge, ni duunne ki gwel abïïc møøk.
english: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

anywaa: Ni poot caala manøgø thuwø, ŋata mooc ki gwel ariiø agädhö ki ge, ni duunne ki gwel ariiø møøk.
english: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata mooc ki gwelø aciel acøø ni kunye ki buur ni kan gwel kwääye yi gø.
english: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya nø ruu kwääy laaŋe moøgø ki kany mo bäär, ena duuö ni cääp gwel moe ki geni.
english: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata mooc ki gwel abïïc aö nyïm kwääye, ni käädö ki gwel abïïc møøk. Ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, gwel abïïc beege na wëëgï aani. En, aana jïtö ka abïïc møøk.›
english: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

anywaa: «Ni kö kwääye jïgø, na ‹Atïïyï na wøp, ïïna laŋŋø mo beer mo di ŋäädhö. Ïïna tïmö niï di ŋäädhö ki jammi mo nøk. 'Ba ennø, jammi mo thööth ocïba cerï. Ööï nee met yi kwääyï bëëde bäätï.›
english: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

anywaa: «Ni ö ŋata mooc ki gwel ariiø ni ö nyïm kwääye, ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, gwel ariiø beege na wëëgï aani. En, aana jïtö ki gwel ariiø møøk.›
english: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

anywaa: «Ni kö kwääye, na ‹Atïïyï na wøp, ïïna laŋŋø mo beer mo di ŋäädhö. Ïïna tïmö niï di ŋäädhö ki jammi mo nøk. 'Ba ennø, jammi mo thööth ocïba cerï. Ööï nee met yi kwääyï bëëde bäätï.›
english: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋata mooc ki gwelø aciel aö nyïm kwääye thuwø, ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, ï ŋääa ni ïïna dhaanhø mo dwørï teek, niï wø kääö kany mo ï kär kwøŋ pïïdhö yie, ni kääï kany mo ï kär kwøŋ judö yie.
english: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aana lwäyö, ni cøøa ni kana gwellï piny. En, lwør mana näk marï.›
english: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.

anywaa: «'Ba adwøk kwäärö mare jïre, ni ‹Ïïna laŋŋø mo raac mo dëërï leth. Ni näk ŋäyï naa wø kääö kany maa kär kwøŋ pïïdhö yie, ni kääa kany maa kär kwøŋ judö yie,
english: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

anywaa: gwel 'moa diï wëëga jø wø gädhö ki jammi, ni kanya daa duuö, mana näk mara daa joodø ni da wïïe.
english: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, lwørru gwelløgø cere, ni mëëgu gø ŋata jïre da gwel apaar.
english: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø jïge dagø, møøk ocäŋ cïpö jïge, ni tïm moge ni thööth. 'Ba ŋat wø jïre bäŋgø, këël man wø en jïre di lwørø.
english: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.

anywaa: Ennø, leeŋu laŋŋø manøgø ni bäŋ gïn kønye enø wøk yi muudhö, kany wø jwöŋ jiyi yie ni ge mööta lakge.›
english: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo ö Wär Dhaanhø ka ajiem mare ki nyïïatwiet maal bëët na aciel, kanyøca eno pï piny ni ena nyeya bäät wäl ajiem mare.
english: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

anywaa: Ni ö wïth juurre bëët ni cooŋi nyïme, ni pääŋ geni kaawat man wø ö dïkwääyi ni wø køc rööm ka atëëe.
english: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:

anywaa: 'Ba rööm ocïp bäät cwïïe, ni ö atëëe ni cïp ge bäät caame.
english: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

anywaa: Kanyøgø eni na nyeya oköö jï jøøa en bäät cwïïe, ni ‹Ööu, u na näk ogwïëth Wära, nee buya käl maal na näk ojiiŋŋø kiperu ki mana täge ki kanya cwääc piny yie ci jïïu.
english: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
