anywaa: Kiper aana 'näk käci, ni mooyu aani ki cam. Aana 'näk riewi, ni mooyu a ki pïï. Ni ööa ni aana wëëllö, ni pänhnhu aani.
english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:

anywaa: Aana cäädhö ki dëëra, ni mooyu aani ka abïï. Aana tuu, ni lïïmmu baŋa. Aana en øt twöc, ni ööu baŋa.›
english: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø odwøk jøøa marge beer na en bäät cwïïc jïre, ni ‹?Kwäärö, a yi wäne na jootwa ïïni ni riï da käc ni caamwa ïïni, wala riï da riew ni moocwa ïïni ki pïï?
english: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?

anywaa: ?Na a yi wäne na jootwa ïïni, ni ïïna wëëllö ni pänhwa ïïni, wala ï cäädhi ka riï ni moocwa ïïni ka abïï?
english: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

anywaa: ?Na a yi wäne na jootwa ïïni niï tuu, wala ï ena øt twöc ni lïïmwa ïïni?›
english: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

anywaa: «'Ba odwøk nyeya jïge, na ‹Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni gïna tïïyu jï dhaanhø aciel mo thiinhnha kare dï moi na nyïïmera ii, gïnögø tïïyu jïra.›
english: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.

anywaa: «Kanyøgønø, eno köö jï jøw oen bäät caame, ni ‹Aayu buuta, u na näk ocienø; cou yi maaa näk bäŋ cuŋŋe kar ajäla, na näk ojiiŋŋø kiper anägö ki nyïïatwiete.
english: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

anywaa: Kiper aana 'näk käci, ni käru a mooø ki gïn cam. Aana 'näk riewi, ni käru a mooø ki pïï.
english: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

anywaa: Ni ööa ni aana wëëllö, ni käru a pänhnhö. Ni cäädha ki dëëra, ni käru a mooø ka abïï. Aana tuu, ni ena øt twöc, ni käru a lïïmö.›
english: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

anywaa: «Kanyøgøøni jøøa en bäät caam thuwø marge odwøkge, ni ‹?Kwäärö, a yi wäne na jootwa ïïni ni riï da käc, wala riew, wala ïïna wëëlö, wala ï cäädhi ka riï, wala ï tuu, wala ï ena øt twöc, ni kärwa ï kønyø?›
english: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

anywaa: «Kanyøgø odwøge jïge, na ‹Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni gïna näk käru tïïö jï dhaanhø aciel mo thiinhnha kare dï moi ii, gïnögø käru tïïö jïra thuwø.›
english: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø jøøgø geno ci kar ajäla mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni ö jøøa marge beer ni cige kar kwøw mana näk adïëri na bäŋ cuŋŋe.»
english: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na thöör luupögø bëët ki caan, ena köö jï bääge,
english: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

anywaa: ni «Ŋäyu ni noo tïme na køør nïne ariiø beeye cäŋ mano wøør cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie. 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ jiy nee 'näk bäät jaadha no odëëdö.»
english: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kwääc laam ki jaae, gena cuuŋö yi øt Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ na cwøl ni Keepa,
english: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

anywaa: ni määnyge ki jöö, kiper nee Jecu makge mëëth ki piny nee 'näkge.
english: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, ni «Paa kanyo poot jiyi kar ajwöm-cam, kiper nee bäŋe dïŋaŋ mo tägi dï jiy.»
english: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en Jecu yi Bethani po Cayman, ŋata kwøŋ bëëtö ni dëëre da dhøøbø,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

anywaa: dhaagø mør aö baŋe ni käädö ki riia mo ena yi wïlli mo ŋeew ka gwel mo thööth døc, ni køny gø wï Jecu, ni Jecu ena kar cam.
english: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö bääge na neenge gïnögø, gena gootø, ni köge, na «?Aŋø ni raany riia en?
english: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

anywaa: Kiper maarøgøøni doo dwøga pwödhö ki gwel mo thööth, ni mëëk gwete jøøa can.»
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na ŋäc gïnögø aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø ni ööllu dhaagø en? Kiper ena tïïö ki gïn mo beer døc jïra.
english: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa can wø ena dïïu cooth. 'Ba aani, a ba en dïïu cooth.
english: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana køny maari dëëra, gïnögø tïïe ni jiiŋŋa aani kiper kanyo koony aani.
english: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

anywaa: Adïëri møn a cäänna uuni, ni kanyo wäro køp luumma nyään na met yie bäät piny bäre, gïna tïïc dhaagø manøgø enø, wø wäro caan ni parra wïc ki eni.»
english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.

anywaa: Køøre dhaanhø aciel ki røk jøøa na apaar kurriiø mo nyeŋŋe Juudac Ickarïët, aci baŋ kwääc laam,
english: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

anywaa: ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø noo mëëgu aani ni näk mo Jecu cïba ceŋŋu?» Ni moocge eni ki gwel ma pïëradäk.
english: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

anywaa: Køøre nø, ena put bëëtö ni määnyö ki jöö man cïp Jecu ceŋ jøøgø ki gø.
english: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar ajwöm-cam mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø, bääŋi aö baŋ Jecu, ni köge, na «?A kaa ŋø ni manynyï nee jiiŋwa jïrï, kiper niï cämï yie ki cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie?»
english: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Cou pääny baŋ dhaanhø mør kaace, ni caannu gø jïre ni dïpööy aköö, ni ‹Kanya no owäŋŋö kipera kare acäännö. Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie wøøra wøørø ki bääŋi 'moa paarï.› »
english: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.

anywaa: Køøre bääge gïnögø atïïcge kaawat mana caani ya Jecu jïge, ni jiiŋge cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm pinynyi na wäär, Jecu apï piny lak cam ki bääge na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cämge, Jecu aköö, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni dhaanhø aciel dïïu aano cïp ceŋ nyïïmän.»
english: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni bwøk cwïnyge døc, ni täkge ki man pëënyge eni no oceele oceele, ni «?Beeye aani, Kwäärö?»
english: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «Ŋata cwïnynyö ki aani na aciel ya athäänh, aano cïp ceŋ nyïïmän.
english: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, Wär Dhaanhø aay keda mana gööri kipere. 'Ba otïmö ni raac døc jï ŋato cïp Wär Dhaanhø ceŋ nyïïmän. Doo beerra eni kiper ŋatøce ki mana ba dii nywølø.»
english: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Juudac ŋata ŋeew ree ki Jecu aköö, ni «?Beeye aani, Dïpööy?» Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïre, na «Acaanï na kare.»
english: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge cämö, Jecu alwötö ki møø, ni gwïëth gø, ni pøt gø, ni mëëk gø bääŋi, ni kööe, ni «Lwørru ni cammu gø. Man beeye dëëra.»
english: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

anywaa: Ni lwør athöödhi. 'Ba na nø dwøk met ec, amëëk geni, ni kööe, ni «Mäthu, u bëët.
english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;

anywaa: Kiper man beeye remma mar luumma tuut ki jiy, nee køny piny kiper jiy mo thööth nee raay wëënni.
english: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, naa ba mäthi ki pï nyïïomøki këët, këël kanyo cäŋa gø maathø yie ni nyään ki uuni yi buc Wära.»
english: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lønyge ki wär duut Jwøk, gena aa wøk ni cige bäät Kïn Ølip.
english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Dïwääni u bëët a weyu wiiø kiper gïno tägi dëëra. Kiper ogöörö, ni ‹Aani dïkwääy ogøøa, ni ö dïëki ma pïïth ni keethge.›
english: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïŋ a maal, a cøøa nyïmmu Galili.»
english: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni kööe jï Jecu, ni «Këël bääŋi bëët ï dege wiiø kiper gïno tägi dëërï, aani, ï ba wiia na bäre bäre.»
english: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïre, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, ni dïwääni ni gwienø poot kär köök, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani kwöre adäk naa kuyï.»
english: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïre, ni «Këël maa thøw ki ïïni na aciel, ï bäŋ daa mooŋø.» Ni ö bääŋi bëët ni caange teeŋ gïnögø thuwø.
english: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu ki bääge gena ci kany mo cwøl ni Gecemeni. Ni kööe jï bääge, ni «Pïïu piny kany dïturu, kany pooda naa cøø kuna läma kaace.»
english: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

anywaa: Køøre eni Piter, ki wäät Dhebedi karge riet alwøre ni aae ki geni. 'Ba ena tïmö ni kïmmö ni cwïnye opädhö døc.
english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïge, ni «Cwïnya peek døc, naa manynya thøø. Dööŋŋu kany nou kurö.»
english: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.

anywaa: Køøre ena ci nyïm mëëth ni leeŋ ree piny ni läme ni kööe, na «Awuuö, ni näk mo løny, wëëk maath athöödhi man pöödhö bääta. 'Ba paa ki køør mana manynya, 'ba beeye ki køør mana manynyï.»
english: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

anywaa: Ni duu baŋ bääŋi moe, ni cwän geni ni geno butö. Ni kööe jï Piter, na «?Aŋø, ba løny jïïu ki man kuru ki aani ki yi caa aciel?
english: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?

anywaa: Kuru ni lämu, kiper nou ba päänynyi. Kiper jwïëy wø jïëy møn, 'ba dëël jääk.»
english: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ døøgø ri rietge ni läme ni kööe, na «Awuuö, ni näk maath athöödhi man ba maar pöödhö, ni ba kääŋi ki man mädha ki gø, tïïc mana manynyï.»
english: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ duuö ni cwän bääge ni geno butö, kiper nyeŋge atïmö ni da niine.
english: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni gena cäŋ weyø ni aae ni läme ri dääge, ni poot cara luupögø.
english: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

anywaa: Køøre ena duu baŋ bääŋi moe ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø, u poot ni uuno butö, nou jwöma rou en? Neennu, kanya wäŋŋi kare acäännö, ni Wär Dhaanhø cïba ceŋ jø raay ennø.
english: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

anywaa: Ööu maal. Ö aaø nø. Neennu, ŋato cïp aani ceŋ nyïïmän kare acäännö ki man ööe.»
english: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Jecu ni cäänö, Juudac na en røk jøøa näk apaar kurriiø aöö ni køøre da lwaak mo päl mo ge käädö ko opëëlle ka athøre, ni ge käla baŋ kwääc laam ki jaae.
english: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Juudac, ŋata cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmänne, ocïpö jïge ki ŋïï, ni kööe, ni «Ŋato dhee nuuma beeye ŋatøca. Wär magu.»
english: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

anywaa: Ni put ö baŋ Jecu ni kööe, ni «Ïïna määth, Dïpööy.» Ni nuum dhi gø.
english: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «?Nyawat, aŋø, ï öömï ŋø kany?» Køøre gena öö ni gäämge Jecu ni makge gø.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa bëëdö ki Jecu, cere arwaak baŋ opëëllö mare ni wöth gø wøk, ni gøøc laŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni cëë ïth gø wøk.
english: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Dwøk opëëllö marï kare. Kiper jiy bëët mo wø kwaany opëëllö, onäk ko opëëllö.
english: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, iï caarø ni ba løny jïra ki man kwaa Wära, ni put jääŋ baŋa ki nyïïatwiet maal mo thööth mo ba løny ki kwaan?
english: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mo beeye enøgønø, weet Jwøk moa köö ni gïn tägi en doo tägö na enøgønø, a dege thur karge nidïï?»
english: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø Jecu aköö jï lwaak, na «?Aŋø, u ööa baŋa kaawat man wø ci baŋ kuu, nou käära opëëlle ka athøre kiper naa magu? Aani, a wø bëëdö yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ naa pöö cooth, 'ba a käru maa.
english: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø bäre tägi kaper nee luupa göör nyïïkuk Jwøki thurge karge.» Kanyøgø bääŋi bëët Jecu awecge ni reŋge.
english: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa mak Jecu ni kälge Jecu nyïm Keepa na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, kanya cuŋ dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jaae yie.
english: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aläp køør gø ni ree ee jädhö kany mo bäär mëëth, këël mana pïïe yi kal mar Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Ni døny yi kal ni pï piny buut dïkuye, naa aŋuun luubö neene.
english: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø kwääc laam ki kwääc løøe bëët, gena määnyö ki luubö mo patha adïëri mo kïthge bäät Jecu nee eni 'näkge.
english: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;

anywaa: 'Ba këël mana ö jiyi mo thööth na caange luup mo patha adïëri kipere, bäŋ gïn mo ege joodø. 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, jak ma ariiø aö nyïm,
english: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Nyeni aköö, ni ‹Løny jïra ki man nyaa Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ piny ni cäŋa gø geerrø ki nïne adäk.› »
english: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.

anywaa: Ni ö Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ maal, ni kööe ka atade, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ gïn mo løgï? ?Agïnaŋø ni car jøøgø dëërï enø?»
english: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu alïŋö jaak. Ni ö Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ ni kööe jïgø, na «A köömma ïïni ki nyeŋ Jwøa kwøw, caanï jïwa ki man näk mo bee ï na Krictø, na näk O Jwøk.»
english: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïre, na «Acaanï na kare. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni køør man en, Wär Dhaanhø oneennu no opï bäät cer cwïï Jwøk na en teeki jïre, ni ööi ka bäät pøøl mo maal.»
english: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ abïïe moe ajeeye, ni kööe, ni «Mare beeye ajaany! ?Aŋø ni poot manynyø lïŋŋe møøk këët en? Ajaany mare anø wïnynyu.
english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø ni caarru kipere?» Ni dwøgi ya jiyi jïre, ni «Eni rømi ka thøø!»
english: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena ŋuut nyeŋŋe ki laaw, ni døøŋge gø, ni ö møøki ni dhööŋge eni,
english: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

anywaa: ni ge köö, ni «Caanï jïwa, ï na Krictø. ?Aŋa na gøøc ïïni?»
english: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?

anywaa: 'Ba Piter opï piny wøk dï kal. Ni ö nyaan ma ŋat tïïc baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Ïïni thuwø, ï bëëdö ka Jecu nyï Galili.»
english: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba dëëre amooŋe nyïm jøøgø bëët, ni kööe, ni «Luumma caanï enø kuua.»
english: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.

anywaa: 'Ba na nyiik dhi kal, ena joot nyaan mørri ma ŋat tïïc thuwø, ni kö nyaanøgø jï jøøa cuŋŋö kaace, ni «Nyeni en bëëdö ka Jecu nyï Nadhareth na aciel.»
english: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ dëëre mooŋŋø ni kööŋe, ni «Ŋatøgø kuua.»
english: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre ki nyi kany mo thiinh, jøøa cuŋŋö kaace anyänh buut Piter ni köge jïre, na «Adïëri møn, ï ena dï jøøgø thuwø, kiper ïïna ŋecwa ki cäänö marï niï cäänö ka cäänö mar jø Galili.»
english: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter atägö ki man cwöl acïëni bääte, ni kööŋe, ni «Ŋatøgø kuua.» Ni put gwienø köö.
english: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni par wïïe ki gïna caan Jecu, ni «Dïwääni ni gwienø poot kär köök, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani ki kwöre adäk naa kuyï.» Ni ci wøk ni jwöŋe ni keeya yie.
english: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, kwääc laam bëët, ki jaae, dhøkge adwalge nee Jecu 'näkge.
english: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

anywaa: Ni twöcge eni ni bwøthge gø wøk, ni kïthge gø baŋ kwäärö ma Paylat.
english: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac, ŋata cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmän, kanya joot gø ni Jecu oŋøl yi thøø, wïïe acäŋ caarrø ni dwøk gweta näk pïëradäk baŋ kwääc laam ki jaae.
english: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Aana bääyö kiper na cïba ŋat mo bäŋ gïn mo ee baaø ceŋ nyïïmän.» 'Ba adwøkge, ni «?Jïwa dee ŋø? Manøgø ena jïrï keerï.»
english: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.

anywaa: Ni ö Juudaci ni leeŋ gweta näk pïëradäk piny yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni aae. Ni cøøe ni lïër dëëre.
english: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam gwetøgø alwørge, ni köge, ni «Ba beer ki man kïth gweti kar kän mar Øt Jwøk, kiper gena gwet remø.»
english: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena cuuŋö ni ŋeewge pwödhö mar dïcwäc dääe ki gwetøge, nee juurre wø koony yie.
english: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, pwöthögø atïmö ni cwøl ni Pwöth Remø, këël dïcäŋi en.
english: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Jeremaya athur kare, na køp, ni «Geni gweta näk pïëradäk alwørge, ni beeye gweta ö jø Icrielli na jïëcge bäät gø ni beeye gät dhaanhø,
english: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;

anywaa: ni ŋeewge pwödhö mar dïcwäc dääe ki gwetøgø, kaawat mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jïra.»
english: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu akäl nyïm kwäärö ma Paylat. Ni ö kwäärö ni pëëny gø, ni «?Bee ïïni na nyeny jø Juuth?» Ni dwøgi ya Jecu jïgø, na «Acaanï na kare.»
english: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kwääc laam ki jaae na kïthge bääte ki luup, eni bäŋ gïn mo ee dwøgø.
english: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø, gïï ni thööth ni kïthge bäätï ii ba wïnyi jïrï?»
english: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo odwøk Jecu jïgø, këël luubö aciel røk moa caan dëëre. Kanyøgø nø, kwäärö yie athäŋŋö døc.
english: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme na kar ajwömcam mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, kwäärö dhaanhø aciel wø päde pädö jï lwaak dëët jøøa no otwöö, ni beeye ŋat wø manyge jaak.
english: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø da nyen mo raac døc øt twöc mo cwøl ni Baraba.
english: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya rööp lwaaki kanya ciel, Paylat apëëö, na «?Aŋa ni manynyu nee päda jïïu, Baraba, wala Jecu na cwøl ni Krictø?»
english: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?

anywaa: Kiper ajoode ni kwääc laam ki jaae, marge keec na kälge Jecu baŋe.
english: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Paylati no opï piny bäät køøm løøk, cïïe aöön baŋe ki dwøl ni kööe, ni «Kär dee gïn tïïyï ki ŋatøgø ni mare beer enø. Kiper gïï mo leth døc ajwøra yawïtïni ki yïth lääk kipere.»
english: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni kwääc laam ki jaae, yïth jiy acoonge ki man kwacge kwäärö nee Baraba pät, nee tïme ni 'näka Jecu.
english: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

anywaa: Køøre kwäärö acäŋ köö jï lwaak, na «?Aŋa dï jøøi na ariiø ii ni manynyu nee päda jïïu?» Ni köge, ni «Baraba.»
english: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

anywaa: Ni kö Paylati jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø nø, noo tïïa ki Jecu na cwøl ni Krictø?» Ni jølge gø bëët, ni «Eni gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö.»
english: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Paylati jïge, na «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na raac ni ee tïïö?» 'Ba kaagønø, lwaak aput rëëdö døc ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ, ni «Eni gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö!»
english: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya Paylati ni bäŋ gïn løny ki tïïc jïre këët, ni dïŋaŋ manynya man täge, ena lwötö ki pïï ni lwøk ceŋŋe nyïm lwaak, ni kööe, ni «Kara tïme ni bäär ki rem ŋatøgø. Manøgø ena jïïu keeru nø.»
english: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya jiyi bëët jïre, ni «Remme ena bäätwa ki nyïïwa.»
english: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Baraba apän geni, ni wëëk Jecu pwöt ka alaŋŋa, ni cïp gø nee gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø tøŋ mo kwäärö, Jecu akälge ni kïthge gø kany wø bëët jø tøŋŋi yie, ni cooŋge jø tøŋ bëët nyïme.
english: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.

anywaa: Ni kälge abïïe moe wøk, ni kïthge abïï mo kwaar dëëre,
english: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.

anywaa: ni cwääge ka adun koodhi ni kïthge gø wïïe, ni moocge cer cwïïe ko otöök, ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïme, ni buuge gø, ni köge, ni «Dëël jööt nø, nyeny jø Juuth!»
english: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

anywaa: Ni ŋuutge bäät gø ki laaw, ni lwørge otöök ni gøøcge gø ki wïïe.
english: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø buuge gø, abïïnögø akälge wøk dëër gø, ni dwøkge abïïe moe dëëre. Ni bwøthge gø wøk kuna guri bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääthge jöö, gena røømmø ki ŋat mør ma nyï Cayriin, mo nyeŋŋe Cayman. Nyenøgø amakge ki teek, nee jaadha no odëëdö mar Jecu kääre.
english: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïcge kany mo cwøl ni Gølgøtha, na näk tiere beeye ni Kar Cuu Wïc,
english: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,

anywaa: Jecu amoocge ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo orwöbö ki gïn mo keec nee maadhe. 'Ba na bel gø, ena kweer ki man maath gø.
english: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø gurge gø bäät jaadha no odëëdö, abïïe moe apääŋge yïthakicge ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw.
english: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.

anywaa: Køøre gena pï piny ni ge køya eni kaace.
english: And sitting down they watched him there;

anywaa: 'Ba løø kur wï Jecu maal agöönge ki luubö mo ege kïth bääte, mo kwaan, ni «Ŋati en beeye Jecu nyeny jø Juuth.»
english: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaagø da kuuwe ariiø mo ogurö ki eni na aciel, ni dhaanhø aciel ena bäät cwïïe, ni maya ena bäät caame.
english: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø pöödhi ki kaace wïthge wø kenyge kenyø, ni ge buua gø,
english: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Ï na doo nyak Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni cäŋi gø geerrø ki nïne adäk, køny riï nø. Ö piny ki bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni näk mo ïïna O Jwøk møn.»
english: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

anywaa: Ni buui ya kwääc laam thuwø ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jaae, ni köge,
english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

anywaa: ni «Eni wø kønya jø møøk, 'ba dëëre ba maar køny. Ni näk mo ena nyeny jø Icriel, eni ö piny ki bäät jaadha no odëëdö ennø, nee wa jïëcwa ki eni.
english: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.

anywaa: Eni kee Wuuö Jwøk ee ŋäädhö. ?Aŋø, Wuuö Jwøk ba køny eni ŋø, nee Wuuö Jwøk yie met ki eni? Kiper ena köö, ni ‹Aana O Jwøk.› »
english: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

anywaa: Ni ö kuuwe moa no ogurö ki eni na aciel ni buuge eni na ennønø thuwø.
english: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na caae apaar kurriiø ki dïcäŋ, piny atïmö na muudhö bäre këël caae adäk ka abøøya.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na kar caae adäk, Jecu aköök ki dwøl mo päl, ni «?Elöi, Elöi, lama cabakthani?» na näk tiere beeye, ni «?Jwøa, Jwøa, aŋø ni weyï aani en?»
english: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk røk jøøa cuŋŋö kaace, na wïnyge gøøni, gena köö, ni «Ŋati cwøla Ilaaja.»
english: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaanhe acielli dïge ni put reeŋø, ni lwöte ki lïïpa ni cøt gø yi køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wac, ni coom gø wï otöök, ni rwaak gø baŋ gø nee maadhe.
english: And straightway one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møga aköö, ni «Weyï, nee neenø nee Ilaaja ööa kuna køny eni.»
english: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jecu köögö ki dwøl mo päl, ni jwïëe ka aŋuudi.
english: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø abïïna näk ogëëŋö mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ aput jeeø ki dïëre, ni tägi ka maal ni këët piny. Ni ö pinynyi ni jäŋ ree, ni kaaŋ kïte.
english: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

anywaa: Ni ö bwörri thuwø ni japge rege, ni ö jø Jwøki mo thööth moa no othøw ni tïŋi maal.
english: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

anywaa: Ni öge wøk ki yïth bwör køør duun Jecu wøk ki yi thøø, ni cige paana en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk, ni beeye Jerucalem, ni neeni ya jiyi mo thööth.
english: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö kwääy jø tøŋ man wø käär jiy ma dïpa ki jøøa en buute, ni beege jøøa koor Jecu, na neenge dïjäŋ piny ki gïïa tägö bëët, gena lwäyö døc, ni köge, na «Adïëri møn, ŋati en beeye O Jwøk.»
english: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace thuwø da mään mo thööth mo nëënö ka kany mo bäär, ni beege jøøa läm køør Jecu ki yi Galili, na tïny eni.
english: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri Magdalin, ki Meeri mii Jeemeth ki Jocep, ki mii wäät Dhebedi ena dï mään moøgø.
english: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na abøøya, nyen mør mo okwär ma nyï Arimathia mo nyeŋŋe Jocep aöö, ŋat ma bääŋ Jecu thuwø,
english: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:

anywaa: ni ci baŋ Paylat ni kwac dëër Jecu. Kanyøgø Paylat acïpö ki dwøl nee dëër Jecu mëëk eni.
english: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni lwør dëër Jecu, ni bøøny gø ka abïï koony mo tøŋ ma lïïna,
english: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

anywaa: ni pïël gø yi bwörö mare kiree mo poot nyään, mo ee nø løøt yi kïdi. Ni ŋïël kïdi mør mo dwøŋ døc dhi bwörö manøgø, ni aae.
english: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri Magdalin ki Meeri maya, ge ena kaace, ni geno pï piny ni ge dïët ki bwörö manøgø.
english: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na aruunnø, cäŋa en køør cäŋ jiiŋ røk, kwääc laam ki jø Paricith, gena ci baŋ Paylat,
english: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Kwäärö, wïthwa aparwa ki luum dïcuuy manøgø, kanya poode ni kwøw ena köö, ni ‹Køør nïne adäk, a cäŋa ö maal ki yi thøø.›
english: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, cïpï ki dwøl nee bwörö mare koor këël mano këët ri dää nïne, kiper nee bääge ba öge kuna kwalge dëëre, ni caange gø jï jiy, ni ‹Ena tïŋ maal ki yi thøø.› Køøre nø, cwøk mano ööi cään tïmö ni kadha rääö mare ki mana dïkwøŋ.»
english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Paylati jïge, ni «Kädu ki jø tøŋ mo kurö. Cou ni dëëtu dhi bwörö kaawat mana ŋäyu.»
english: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena aay ni dëëtge dhi bwörö manøgø, ni moocge dëër kïnnögø ki ŋïï. Ni wecge jø tøŋ ni kurö.
english: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na køør cäŋ jwömö, ni øw manynya kwäärö nee tïme na täk tïïc, Meeri Magdalin ki Meeri maya aci kuna neenge bwörö.
english: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba piny ojïtö ki dïjäŋ piny mo dwøŋ døc. Kiper nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö aöö ki maal ni daak kïdi dhi bwörö, ni pï piny bäät gø.
english: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

anywaa: 'Ba dëëre nagaaŋ ni caala agaackøth, na abïïe moe tar døc kiree.
english: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:

anywaa: 'Ba jø tøŋ moa kurö gena lwäyö ki eni, ni tïm dëëtge ni kwanynyi ni tïmge kaamar jiy mo othøw.
english: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

anywaa: 'Ba määrögø aluum nyïïatwiel maalli ni kööe, ni «Käru lwäyö. Kiper ŋääa nou caya Jecu na gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.

anywaa: Eni tøør kany, kiper ena ö maal ki yi thøø kaawat mana caane. Ööu, ni neennu kanya pïëlli yie.
english: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

anywaa: 'Ba cou ni caannu gø jï bääge, ni ‹Ena ö maal ki yi thøø. 'Ba eni cøøa nyïmmu yi Galili. Eno jootu kaace.› Ennø, anø caana jïïu.»
english: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.

anywaa: Køøre gena put aay bäät bwörö ni geno lwäyö ni yïthge omïnnö døc. Ni reŋge kuna caange gø jï bääge.
english: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu aput røømmø ki geni ni määth geni. Ni öge baŋe ni makge tiete ni wøørge gø.
english: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena cään Jecu, ni «Käru lwäyö. Cou ni caannu gø jï nyïïmera nee cige Galili. Aano jootge kaace.»
english: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot määnni moøgø ni ge cäädhö, jø møøk røk jø tøŋ moa kurö gena ci pääny ni caange gïïa tägö bëët jï kwääc laam.
english: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø cuŋ kwääc laammi ki jaae ni tutge ki luubö, gena cïpö ki gwel mo thööth jï jø tøŋ moøgø,
english: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Caannu jï jiy, ni ‹Bääk Jecu aöö ki wäär ni kwalge dëër Jecu ni waano butö.›
english: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk gïnögø wïnyö jï kwäärö, cwïnye owëëkwa pïïn piny, nou ba jïtu ki luubö mo pïï bäätu.»
english: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tøŋ moøgø gwel alwørge ni caange luubö mana caan jïge. Ni ö luummögø ni keethe ni wïnye dï jø Juuth këël dïcäŋi en.
english: So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying is commonly reported among the Jews until this day.

anywaa: 'Ba bääk Jecu moa na apaar kurciel gena ci Galili bäät kïdi mana kwøŋ Jecu caan jïge.
english: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them.

anywaa: 'Ba na neenge Jecu, ena wøørge. 'Ba møøk dïge gena tääö.
english: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu baŋge ni kööe jïge, ni «Teek mar maal bäre ki mar piny bäre anø wëëk aani.
english: And Jesus came and spake unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cou ni tïïyu wïth juurre mo bäät piny bëët na bääŋi 'moa, ni lwøgu geni na nyuudhi ki nyeŋ Wuuö, ki Wäädö, ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost:

anywaa: Ni pwönynyu geni ki man gwøkge gïïa caana jïïu bëët. 'Ba aani, aano en buutu cooth këël kanyo ŋuut pinynyi yie.»
english: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.

anywaa: Täk luumma nyään na met mar Jecu Krictø na näk O Jwøk,
english: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

anywaa: keda mana gööri ya nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea, na kööe, ni «Neenï, a jääŋŋa nyïïatwiel mara nyïmï, ŋato jiiŋ jöörï nyïmï.
english: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

anywaa: Ni da dwør dhaanhø mør mo cwödö ŋää paac, ni ‹Jiiŋŋu jöör Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïyu uutjïëthe moe ni thïïŋ.› »
english: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

anywaa: Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi ree anyoodhe ŋää paac, ni køpa luum lwøk jiy na nyuudhi na en ri løk cwïny, kiper raac jiy nee wec Jwøki.
english: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

anywaa: Ni ö jø mïëc Judia bëët ni öge wøk baŋe, ki jø Jerucalem bëët. Ni ö geni ni lwøgi ya eni na nyuudhi yi Naam Jördan, ni køpge raacge.
english: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

anywaa: Kar kaagø, Jøøn käära abïï mo cwääc ka jïëc athïrööl, ni kaw ee twöö piere, ni cama bäänyö ki maar kïc.
english: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

anywaa: Ni køp gø, ni «Køøra da dhaanhø mo öö mo dwøŋŋa eni ki aani, ni këël thøøth waye ba doo mïërö jïra ki man pïïa piny ni päda ge wøk tiete.
english: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

anywaa: Aani, dëëtu lwøa ka pïï na nyuudhi, 'ba eni dëëtu olwøe na nyuudhi ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.»
english: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni, Jecu aöö ki yi Nadhareth yi ŋööm Galili, ni lwøgi ya Jøønni na nyuudhi yi Naam Jördan.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu wøk ki yïth pïï, maal aput raŋ ni ree ee jabø, ni neen Jwïëc Jwøk ni ööa piny bääte kaamar akuuru.
english: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

anywaa: Ni ö dwølli ki maal, ni kööe, ni «Ïïna Wääda na mëëra ki gø, na met yia ki marï.»
english: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni puti ya Jwïëc Jwøki bwøth paap.
english: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni bëëde paap ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni pääny Ceethanni päänynyö. Ni eni bëëdö na aciel ki lääc paap. Ni ö nyïïatwiet maalli ni tïnyge gøøni.
english: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø twöc Jøøn, Jecu aluuny ö yi Galili, ni køpa luum Jwøk na nyään na met.
english: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Kanya wäŋŋi athur kare, ni buc Jwøk kare acäännö. Løgu cwïnynyu ni jïëyu luumma nyään na met, ni ŋääthu gøøni.»
english: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääth Jecu bäät Puul Galili, eni Cayman ki coki ma Andaru ajoode, ni ge lëëŋö ka ajääp yi naam, kiper gena dïbïth rec.
english: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Ööu ni caathu køøra. Uuno tïïa na dïbïth jiy.»
english: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ajääpi moge aputge wec, ni läpge køøre.
english: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ci Jecu nyïm mëëth, eni Jeemeth o Dhebedi ki coki ma Jøøn ajoode, ni ge ena yi jääge, ni ge kwuö ka ajääpi.
english: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

anywaa: Ni put geni cwøl. Ni wiige wääge ma Dhebedi yi jääy ki jø tïïc, ni caathge køøre.
english: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena ci yi Kapernaam. 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö Jecu aput ci øt acooŋ lam, ni pööe.
english: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy yïthge arëëm ki pwöc mare, kiper na pwöny geni na ŋat mo jïre da teek, ni ba caal dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk.
english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

anywaa: 'Ba øt acooŋ lam marge da dhaanhø mo dëëre da jwøk mo raac.
english: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni put köö ki dwøl mo päl, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïyï ki waani, ï na Jecu nyï Nadhareth? ?Ï ööa kuna raanynyï waani? Ï ŋääa, ni ïïna ŋata en kur keere, na näk mar Jwøk.»
english: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ajook Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Lïŋï, ni ööï wøk ree.»
english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

anywaa: Ni ö jwøøgøøni na raac enø, ni meec gø ni ö wøk dëëre, ni rëëdö ki dwøl mo päl.
english: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

anywaa: 'Ba geni yïthge arëëm bëët, ni pëënyge dëëtge keerge, ni köge, ni «?Man agïnaŋø? ?Pwöc mo nyään? Këël juuga reyø aköömme ki teek, ni leŋge dwøre.»
english: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

anywaa: Ni put gïre wïnyö dï mïëc Galili bëët.
english: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya öge wøk ki yi øt acooŋ lam, Jecu ki Jeemeth ki Jøøn aput ci po Cayman ki Andaru.
english: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

anywaa: 'Ba mii cï Cayman obutö ni tuu ka adïrïgi, ni putge gø caan jï Jecu.
english: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

anywaa: Ni ööe ni mak cer gø, ni tïŋ gø maal, ni puti ya adïrïgi wec. Ni ö nyijøøgø ni tïny geni.
english: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na näk abøønynyøgø na päth cäŋŋi, jøøa tuu bëët ki jøøa dëëtge da anäge akälge baŋ Jecu.
english: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

anywaa: Ni ö jø paaci bëët ni cooŋge rege dhi øtø.
english: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

anywaa: Ni ööe ni køny jiy mo thööth moa näk dëëtge da teeŋ ŋwiili mo thööth, ni riem anäge wøk mo thööth. Na anäge käre wëëk cäänö, këël na ŋäcge eni.
english: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni piny poot na amöölla døc ni piny cøl, Jecu apäy ni aa paap kany mo bäŋ jiy yie, ni läme kaace.
english: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

anywaa: 'Ba Cayman ki jøøa en buute gena ci kuna manyge eni.
english: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

anywaa: 'Ba na jootge gø, gena köö jïre, «Jiy bëët caya ïïni.»
english: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Beerra man cøø mïëri møga, nee luum Jwøk køba kaace thuwø; kiper beeye gïna ööa kipere.»
english: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

anywaa: Ni caath dï Galili bäre, ni køpa luum Jwøk yïth uut acook lam moge, ni riem anäge wøk.
english: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋat mo ree da dhøøbø ni ö baŋ Jecu, ni kwaya gø, ni këël cøŋŋe piny, ni kwac gø, «Ni näk mo ïïno jïëy, dëëra diï dwøga kare.»
english: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

anywaa: 'Ba na päth cwïnye ki gïre, cere arwaak baŋ gø ni mul gø, ni kööe jïgø, «Aana jïëy, dëërï døø kare!»
english: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

anywaa: Ni ö dhøøbe ni put aay dëër ŋatøgø, ni tïm dëëre ni pøøth.
english: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

anywaa: Ni cem gø døøc, ni put gø wëëk wääth,
english: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

anywaa: ni caan gø jïgø, ni «Kär dee gïn caanï jï ŋat mør. 'Ba ciï, ni nyoothï dëërï jï dïlämi, ni cïpï ko olämi mana caan Modhe kiper døøn dëërï kare ni wø näk ŋïï jï jiy.»
english: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba ena aay ni put tägö ki man car gø jaak, ni køpa gø jï jiy bëët. Kiper manøgø nø, Jecu atïmö ni ba maar ö dï pääny ni ree ee nyoodhø, 'ba bëëdö yïth mïëri moa en wøk. Ni ö jiyi baŋe ki yïth mïëri bëët.
english: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na døø Jecu yi Kapernaam ki køør nïne møøk, awaac ni eni nutö poge.
english: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth kaagø, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany rømge yie, këël dhi øtø wøk. Ni eni køpa luum Jwøk jïge.
english: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø møøk aö baŋe, ni ge käära dhaanhø mo obäp mo käära jiyi aŋweenni.
english: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

anywaa: 'Ba na jootge gøøni ni ge ba maar thur buute kiper lwaak, wï øtø apätge ki kanya cuŋ Jecu yie. 'Ba na nø japge gø, pëëm mana en ŋata näk obäpi yie alwärge piny.
english: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na neen ŋäädhe marge, ena köö jï ŋata näk obäp, «Wääda, raay moï awec.»
english: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace da dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk mo opï piny, ni cäänge ki cwïnyge,
english: But there were certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø na cään nyeni na enø nø? Mare ajaany. ?Aŋa na doo wec raay? ?Aŋø, paa Jwøk keere?»
english: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

anywaa: 'Ba na ŋäyi ya Jecu ki cwïnye ni ge cäänö ki cwïnyge, aput caan jïge, na «?Aŋø ni cäänu na enø nø ki cwïnynyu en?
english: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

anywaa: ?A mane ni jööta eni na doo caanø jï ŋati no obäp en, ni ‹Raayï awec,› wala ki man caani, ni ‹Ö maal, ni lwørï pëëmï ni cäädhï.›?
english: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee ŋäyu nø, ni Wär Dhaanhø jïre da teek bäät piny ki man wec raay,» ena köö jï ŋata näk obäp, na «A cäänna ïïni,
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

anywaa: ö maal ni lwørï pëëmï, ni ciï paac.»
english: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

anywaa: Ni put ŋatøgø ö maal ni lwør pëëm ni aa wøk nyïmge bëët. Kanyøgø nø, yïthge arëëm bëët, ni jiemge Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo ewa kwøŋ neen mo nëëna gïn.»
english: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu acäŋ aa wøk bäät Puul Galili. Ni ö lwaaki bäre ni cooŋge rege buute, ni pwöny geni.
english: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

anywaa: 'Ba na pööth nyïm, Libay wär Alpia ajoode no opï piny kar ajwäk. Ni kööe jïgø, «Ö køøra.» Ni put Libay ö maal, ni läp køør gø.
english: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na pï piny kar cam yi øt Libay, jiy mo thööth ma jø ajwäk ki jø raay gena pï piny ki eni ki bääge na aciel. Kiper jiy thööth moa läp køøre.
english: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk moa näk jø Paricith na neenge eni, ni eni cämö ka jø raay ki jø ajwäk, gena köö jï bääge, na «?Aŋø ni wø cäme ni mädhe na aciel ki jø ajwäk ki jø raay en?»
english: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Jecu ena köö jïge, ni «Jø wø dëëtge jööt ba many akïïm, 'ba beege jø wø tuu. A ba ööi naa cwøla jøøa beyø, 'ba a öönynya jø raay.»
english: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni bääk Jøøn ki jø Paricith gena lämö ki lam-wödö. 'Ba jiy aöö ni köge jï Jecu, na «?Aŋø ni wø wöt bääk Jøønni ki bääk jø Paricith en, ni bäägï ba wödö?»
english: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, wëët nywöm wø wödö ni cø nyakøø poot ena dïge? Ge ba doo maara wödö kany wø poode ni cø nyakøø poot ena dïge.
english: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

anywaa: 'Ba nïne oööi, kanyo ö cø nyakøøe noo lwøri dïge. 'Ba cäŋöca nø, beeye cäŋo wötge yie.
english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

anywaa: «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo rap thääŋ abïï mo nyään dëër abïï mo otøp. Ni näk mo tïïe tïïö, räbi mana nyään ree jëëe wøk dëër abïïna näk otøp, ni tïme na jeeø mana raac døc.
english: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo doo kïtha køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään yïth opïc pëëne mo otøp. 'Ba ni näk mo tïïe tïïö, køøŋ nyïïomøki opïyögø cööte cöötö, ni øc køøŋe piny ni ränynye ko opïyögø na aciel. 'Ba køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään wø rømi ko opïc pëëne mo nyärö.»
english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ma cäŋ jwömö, Jecu aay ni cäädhi ka dï pwöth beel. 'Ba kanya cääthge, bääge atägö ki man tøcge wïth beel.
english: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

anywaa: Ni kö jø Paricithi jïgø, «?Neenï, aŋø ni ö bäägï ni tïïcge gïn mo ba doo tïïö ki cäŋ jwömö en?»
english: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋø, gïna tïïc Deebiti, käru kwaanø bäre bäre, kanya cänne na 'nägi ya käci, ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni?
english: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

anywaa: Ena døny Øt Jwøk kanya bëët Abiethaar na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni cam muuga näk nyuuthe, na näk ba doo beer jï dhaanhø jaak ki man cam gø, 'ba beege dïlämme keerge ni wø cam gø, ni ö eni ni mooc jøøa cäädhö ki eni thuwø.»
english: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cäŋ jwömö tïïc kaper dhaanhø, ni paa dhaanhø na tïïc kiper cäŋ jwömö.
english: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

anywaa: 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø beeye Kwäärö, ni këël cäŋ jwömö bëënna eni.»
english: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Jecu acäŋ ci yi øt acooŋ lam. 'Ba da dhaanhø kaace mo cere obäp.
english: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni neetge gø, nee jootge ki man näk mo eni ŋatøgø kønye kønyø ki cäŋ jwömö, nee jïtge ki luubö mo kïthge bääte.
english: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni kööe jï ŋata näk cere obäp, ni «Ö nyïm kany.»
english: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø no orømø ki køør ciik Jwøk ki man tïïi ki cäŋ jwömö, beeye ki man tïïc gïn mo beer wala gïn mo raac? ?Beeye ki man piem jwïëy wala 'näk?» 'Ba gena lïŋö.
english: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

anywaa: Ni neen nyeŋge bëët ni eno gootø, ni cwïnye oränynyö kiper teek cwïnyge, ni kööe jï ŋatøca, «Rwiec cerï.» Ni rwiec cere, ni put cere døø kare.
english: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith aaa wøk ni putge tudö ki luubö ki jic Eerat na aciel kipere ki jöö man 'näkge gø ki gø.
english: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu adaa bäät Puul Galili ki bääge. Ni ö lwaa Galili mo päl ni läpge køøre. 'Ba jø møøk, kanya wïnyge japa tïïe bëët, gena ö baŋe ki yi Judia,
english: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

anywaa: ki Jerucalem, ki Idumia, ki løø Naam Jördan, ki Tayar ki Caydan ni tïmge na lwaak mo päl døc.
english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

anywaa: Ni kööm bääge nee jääy jiiŋge jïre kiper lwaak na tïme ni päl, kiper nee eni ba decge.
english: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo thööth ee nø køny, ni tïm jøøa dëëtge da ŋwiili ni rïïya bääte, nee gutge.
english: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö jøøa näk dëëtge da juuga reyø wø jootge Jecu, ge wø pätha nyïme, ni ge rëëdö, ni «Bee ïïni na o Jwøk.»
english: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

anywaa: Ni kööm ge døc, nee eni ba nyoothge.
english: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aci maal bäät kïdi, ni cwøl jøøa manynye baŋe. Ni ci jøøgø baŋe.
english: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

anywaa: Ni jier jiy apaar kurriiø, jøøa tïïe na nyïïatwieli, nee bëëtge ki eni na aciel, nee jääŋ wøk kuna køpge luum Jwøk,
english: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

anywaa: ni jïtge ki teek ki man riemge anäge wøk.
english: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

anywaa: Ni beeye Cayman ŋata caae ni Piter,
english: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

anywaa: ki Jeemeth o Dhebedi, ki coki ma Jøøn, ni beege jøøa caae ni Böönerjith, na näk tiere beeye wäät määc køth,
english: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

anywaa: ki Andaru, ki Pilip, ki Barthølömu, ki Mathiew, ki Tøma, ki Jeemeth wär Alpia, ki Thadia, ki Cayman ŋat Keena,
english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

anywaa: ki Juudac Ickarïët, ŋata cïp eni ceŋ nyïïmän.
english: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aci yi øtø.
Ni ö lwaaki ni cäŋge rege cooŋŋø. Kiper manøgø nø, Jecu ki bääge këël cam atïmö ni ba maar lønyø jïge.
english: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya tuuŋge, gena ci wøk kuna makge gø, kiper gena köö, ni «Ena tïmö na bøøl.»
english: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

anywaa: Ni ö dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk moa öö ki yi Jerucalem, ni köge, ni «Dëëre da jwøa cwøl ni Bieldhebap, ni beeye teek kwääy anäge ni wø riem anäge wøk ki gø.»
english: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cwöl ge baŋe, ni caan gø jïge ka ageele, ni «?Ceethan a dii riem Ceethanni wøk nidïï?
english: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

anywaa: Ni näk paac dëëre ee pääŋŋö keere, paanøgø ba doo maara bëëdö.
english: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk jø dhi øtø rege ege pääŋŋö keerge, dhi ødøca ba doo maara cuŋŋö.
english: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Ceethan otïmö ni thïïŋa ree ri dëëre keere, ni pääŋ ree, eni ba doo maara cuŋŋö, 'ba cuŋ mare beeye ränynyö.
english: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo døny øt ŋat mo teek kuna twier jap gø, ni näk ŋata teek käre kwøŋ mak ni twöc gø. 'Ba køøre nø, eni cøø møn ni twier øt gø.
english: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni jammi bëët owec Jwøki jï jiy, këël raay moge ki kwör ajaany bëët mo wø jätge ki ge.
english: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro jany Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, mare ba doo maara wec na bäre bäre. 'Ba eno jäälö ka ajäl bääyö mo bäŋ cuŋŋe;»
english: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:

anywaa: kiper na köge, ni «Dëëre da jwøk mo raac.»
english: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø mii Jecu ki nyïïmenni aöö, ni cuŋge wøk, ni jääkge baŋe, ni cwøli.
english: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaak na näk opï piny buute, gena köö jïre, ni «Meru ki nyïïmeru ge ena wøk, ni ge pëënynya ïïni.»
english: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

anywaa: Ni løk gø, na «?Aŋa na mera ki nyïïmera?»
english: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

anywaa: 'Ba na raŋ jï jøøa näk opï piny buute, ena köö, ni «Jøøi ii beege mera ni näkge nyïïmera.
english: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

anywaa: Ni ŋat wäro tïïc mana many Jwøki beeye coka ni näk mera.»
english: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Jecu acäŋ tägö ki pwöc bäät Puul Galili. Ni ö lwaaki mo päl ni cooŋge rege buute. Kiper manøgønø, ena eth yi jääy, ni pï piny yie yi naam. Ni ö lwaaki bäre ni en bäät ageela.
english: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

anywaa: Ni pwöny geni ki jammi mo thööth ki ri leere. 'Ba na pööe, ena köö jïge,
english: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

anywaa: «Neennu, da dïpïïdhi mo oaa wøk kuna pïïthe ni mare jør.
english: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

anywaa: 'Ba na jude, nyeŋ köödhi møøk apäth thääŋ jöö, ni ö wenynyi ni öge ni camge ge bëët.
english: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

anywaa: Ni ö köödhi møøk ni päthge yi ŋöömö mo tiere da kïdi, kany mo bäŋ ŋöömö mo päl yie. Ni laarge tuu wøk, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ ŋöömö mo päl.
english: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

anywaa: 'Ba na rieny cäŋŋi, gena waaŋ ni talge, kiper mana tïmge ni bäŋ lweedi jïge.
english: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

anywaa: 'Ba köödhi møøk apäth yïth koodhi. Ni ö koodhi ni døøŋge, ni bøøcge ge. Ni kärge jïtö ki nyeŋ.
english: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

anywaa: 'Ba köödhi møøk apäth yi ŋöömö mo beer. Ni døøŋge ni meetge rege, ni känge ki nyeŋ. Ni møøk käla nyeŋ ma pïëradäk ni møøk käla pïërabïciel, ni kän møga ki dïpa.»
english: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: 'Ba na dööŋ Jecu keere, jøøa en buute ki bääŋi moa näk apaar kurriiø, ena pëënyge kiper tiet leere.
english: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Beeye uuni na wëëk luumma näk tiere okwøŋ kan kiper buc Jwøk. 'Ba ki jï jøøa en wøk, jammi bëët caan kaamar leere,
english: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

anywaa: « ‹kiper nee neenge møn, 'ba tier gø ba jootge. Ni wïnyge gø møn, 'ba tier gø ba kwanyge. Kiper kanymør dëëtge dege løø ni wëën geni.› »
english: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø, tier leer man käru kwanyø? ?Leere bëët tietge okwanynyu ge nidïï?
english: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

anywaa: Dïpïïdhi piitha luum Jwøk.
english: The sower soweth the word.

anywaa: 'Ba bëët jø møøk caala köödhi moa päth thääŋ jöö, kanya piith luubö yie. 'Ba kany wø wïnyge luubö, Ceethan wø laara öö ni käl luubö wøk mana piith cwïnyge.
english: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, bëët jø møøk caala köödhi moa jør yi ŋöömma näk tiere da kïdi, ni beege jø wø laar jïëy ki met ec kany wø wïnyge luum Jwøk.
english: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

anywaa: 'Ba jïge bäŋ lweedi, ni bëëtge ki kany mo thiinh keere. 'Ba køøre kany wø ö gïï mo lethi ki caannø wø täkge kiper luummögø, ge wø laara døø cään.
english: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

anywaa: 'Ba bëët jø møøk caala köödhi moa jør yïth koodhi. Ni beege jø wø wïny luubö,
english: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

anywaa: 'ba jap piny ni wø lääŋŋi, ki mëëc kwär, ki many jammi møga wø cøøa yie, ni bøøcge luubö, ni ba jïtge ki nyeŋ.
english: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

anywaa: 'Ba köödhi moa jør yi ŋöömma beer beege jø wø wïny luum Jwøk, ni jïëcge gø, ni känge ki nyeŋ. Ni møøk käla pïëradäk, ni møøk käla pïërabïciel, ni kän møga ki dïpa.»
english: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, lamba wø käli kaper nee kïth tier dak wala tier pëëm, ni patha bäät tharabëëta?
english: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo doo kanø ni ba cäŋ nyoothø. Ni bäŋ gïn mo okanø, ni ba cäŋ käl wøk yi tar.
english: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

anywaa: 'Ba nee da ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö jïge, ni «Cegu ïthu døøc ki gïn wïnynyu en. Rumi man wø cïpu, beeye rumi mano duu baŋu, ni moo cïp jïïu ocäŋ meetø.
english: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø jïre dagø, møøk ocäŋ cïpö jïre. Ni ŋat wø jïre bäŋgø, këël man wø en jïre, di lwørø.»
english: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Buc Jwøk keda dhaanhø mo jøra köödhi piny,
english: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

anywaa: ni buude jaak ki wärre ki cääŋŋe, ni ö köödhi ni täkge ki tuuö, ni døøŋge, ni tucge kuue.
english: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

anywaa: 'Ba piny jammi nywøla e keere. Dïkwøŋ piith na luum. Køøre ŋøøk ki wïc. Køøre wïc kännö ki nyeŋ beel ma karge.
english: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ciek beelli, wää pwödhö caakïïn wø pute ka kwany, kiper na tïme na kac.»
english: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Buc Jwøk a døø gø päärö ki ŋø, wala a leer mane na døø lwørø kipere?
english: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

anywaa: Eni caala waŋ kunhnhö mo thiinh døc, ni thiinhnha eni dï köödhi bëët mo wø piith yïth ŋøøm.
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø piidhi, ni døøŋŋe, wø tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni dï jenni bëët moa en ya ajïniina, ni jïte ki bäädi mo døøŋŋø døc, ni tïm wec maalli ni bëëdö tïmme.»
english: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

anywaa: Ni caan luum buc Jwøk jïge ki yïth leere mo thööth ma yøøgønø, keda mana bëëtge ni løny jïge ki man wïnyge gø.
english: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø jïge ni ba caane na leer. 'Ba tiet jammi bëët apare jï bääge kur keerge.
english: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca kiree, kanya tïm pinynyi na abøøya, Jecu aköö jï bääge, «Beerra man aaø løøga.»
english: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

anywaa: Ni wecge lwaak ni cige yi jääy ni putge cøø ki eni na icenø. 'Ba da jïëthe møøk ma acøø ki geni.
english: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

anywaa: Ni ö atuunne ni put cöödö, ni tïm pï athage ni pänynya yi jääy, ni jääy oløny ni manynya man pääŋe.
english: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ena thar jääy no obutö, no othäänhö ki thänhi. Ni ö bääge ni jiecge gø ni köge ki eni, «?Dïpööy, bäŋ gïn lääŋŋï ni näk mo ø thøw?»
english: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

anywaa: Ni pääe ni jook jamø, ni cään naam, ni «Cuŋŋï, ni lïŋï!» Ni cuŋ jame, ni put pinynyi nibäc.
english: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï bääge, na «?Aŋø ni lwäyu en? ?Jïïu bäŋ ŋäädhe?»
english: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni lwäcge ki lwär mo dwøŋ, ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge, na «?A teeŋ dhaanhø mo nyïëdi en, ni këëlla jamø ki naam leŋa luumme?»
english: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu ki bääge gena pïï løø Puul Galili, po jø Gadarin.
english: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø ö Jecu wøk ki yi jääy, ŋat mør mo dëëre da jwøk mo raac aö baŋe, ni ööi ka bäät bwör,
english: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

anywaa: ŋat mo beeta bäät bwör, mo bäŋ ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man twöc gø këët, këël ki tiimme.
english: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

anywaa: Kiper eni wø di tööyö ki tiimme ko oguudi, 'ba oguudi wø dääde däädö ni cööt tiimme na thäŋi. Ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man mak gø.
english: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

anywaa: 'Ba cooth, wärre ki cääŋŋe wø thööre ni rëëdö bäät bwör ki bäät kïte, ni ŋøøra dëëre keere ki kïte.
english: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

anywaa: 'Ba na joot Jecu ki kany mo bäär ena reŋ baŋ gø ni wøør gø.
english: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

anywaa: Ni kööe ki dwøl mo päl, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïyï ki aani, Jecu, O Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal? Kööŋ ŋëët Jwøk naa ba caarï.»
english: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

anywaa: Kiper ena köömme, ni «Ï na jwøk mana raac, ö wøk dëër dhaanhø!»
english: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba ena pëëny Jecu, ni «?Nyeŋŋï aŋa?» Ni løk gø, ni «Nyeŋŋa Liijan, kiper wa thööth.»
english: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kwaac Jecu døøc, nee geni ba cöör wøk paanøgø.
english: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace da pïïth othur mo dwøŋ mo cämö nyäär thuur.
english: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

anywaa: Ni kwacge eni, ni «Wëëk wa ciin baŋ othuri, ni wëëgï wa ciin dëëtge.»
english: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

anywaa: Ni wëëk geni wääth. Ni ö juuga reyø ni öge wøk, ni cige dëët othuri. Ni ö pïïth othur mo jïtö ki kar kume ariiø, ni dhoothge ya ageella bäär ni putge pööth yi naam, ni mutge bëët yi naamøca.
english: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

anywaa: Ni ö dïkwääc othuri ni reŋge, ni caange gø paac, ki mïëya en wøk. Ni ö jiyi ni öge kuna neenge gïna tägö.
english: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.
