anywaa: Ni öge baŋ Jecu, ni jootge ŋata kwøŋ bëëdö ni dëëre da anäge no opï piny kaace, dëëre ka abïï ni wïïe odøø kare. Ni beeye ŋata kwøŋ anäga thööth na cwøl ni Liijan en dëëre. Ni putge lwäyö.
english: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa neen gïna tägö dëër ŋata dëëre da anäge ki gïna tägö dëët othuri, mana neenge aputge caan jï jiy.
english: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni kwacge Jecu nee aae poge.
english: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya eth Jecu yi jääy, ŋata kwøŋ bëëdö ni dëëre da anäge, ena kwaaye, nee eni bëëde ki gø.
english: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu akweer, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ci paac baŋ nyïïawäätï, ni caanï gïna dwøŋ na tïïc Kwäärö dëërï jïge, kaa mana ööe na køny ïïni.»
english: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

anywaa: Ni aae ni täge ki køp gïna dwøŋ na tïïc Jecu dëëre yïth mïëc Dikapöla. Ni rëëm yïth jiyi bëët.
english: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na cäŋ døø løøga ki jääy, lwaak mo päl rege acooŋge buute, ni eni ena bäät naam.
english: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø dhaanhø aciel dï kwääc øt acooŋ lam mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jaayra aöö. 'Ba na joot Jecu, dëëre aleeŋ piny tiet gø.
english: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

anywaa: Ni kwac gø, ni kööe, «Nyaara mo thiinh ena um thøø. Ööï ni kïthï ceŋŋï bääte, kiper nee dëëre jöönne ni kwøe.»
english: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

anywaa: Ni cige ki gø. Ni ö lwaaki mo päl ni läpge køør Jecu, ni ge rïïya bääte.
english: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da dhaagø mo dëëre bëëdö ni cwïër ki remø ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø.
english: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋøgø, ena ööl døc køør akïïme mo thööth, ni thöör jammi moa en jïre bëët, 'ba dëëre kär jöönnö man thiinh en, 'ba atïmö ni kadhø ni raac.
english: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

anywaa: 'Ba gïï Jecu wø cari awïnynye, ni ööe ki dï lwaak ki ŋää gø, ni gut abïïn gø.
english: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

anywaa: Kiper ena köö, ni «Këël maa guta abïïge keerge, dëëra jöönnö.»
english: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø remø aput cöö. Ni put gø ŋäc ki dëëre, ni dëëre adøø kare.
english: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na ŋäc gø ki dëëre keere ni da teek mo oaay dëëre, ree aput løø baŋ lwaak ni kööe, na «?Aŋa na gut abïïga?»
english: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

anywaa: Ni kö bääge jïre, ni «Ŋäyï ni lwaak rege ege diil buutï. Ï doo cäŋa köö, na ‹?Aŋa na gut aani?› »
english: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu jiy araŋe bëët kiper nee ŋata gut gø joode.
english: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋøgøøni na ŋäc gïna tïïc dëëre, ena öö ki lwär ni dëëre kwanynyi, ni leeŋ dëëre piny nyïm Jecu, ni køp jammi bëët jïgø.
english: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïgø, «Nyaara, ŋäädhe marï dëërï awëëk jöönnö. Ciï nø ki met ec. Ŋwellï ba duu dëërï këët.»
english: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni Jecu poot cäänö, jiy møøk aöö ki po kwääy øt acooŋ lam, ni köge, ni «Nyaarï anø thøw. ?Aŋø ni poot öölï dïpööy en?»
english: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na wïny gïna caange, ena köö jï kwääy øt acooŋ lam, ni «Kärï lwäyö, 'ba ŋäc ŋäädhe keere.»
english: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni män jiy bëët ki køøre, ni jïëc Piter ki Jeemeth ki Jøøn na näk cöök Jeemeth.
english: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

anywaa: 'Ba na öge po kwääy øt acooŋ lam, jiy ajoode ni ge lweelli ni ge jwöŋö, ni ge göö ko oduuru døc.
english: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

anywaa: 'Ba na døny yi øtø, ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋø ni lweellu nou jwöŋö en? Nyilaari kär thøw, 'ba mare niine.»
english: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni ŋeethge bäät gø. 'Ba gena riem wøk bëët, ni lwør wää nyilaalli ki menni ki bääge adäk moøgø, ni dønyge øtø kanya en nyilaalli yie.
english: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

anywaa: Ni mak cer nyilaal ni kööe jïgø, ni «Talitha kumi,» na näk tiere beeye, ni «Nya, nyilaal, a cäänna ïïni, ö maal.»
english: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

anywaa: Ni put nyilaarøgø ö maal, ni cäädhe. 'Ba cwiic dööŋŋe beege cwiiri apaar kurriiø. Ni put yïthge thäŋŋö døc.
english: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni kööm geni døøc, ni bäŋe ŋat mo ŋäc gïn; ni caan gø jïge, ni moocge nyilaal ki gïn came.
english: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aay kaace ni ci paac mana näk poge. Ni ö bääge ni läpge køøre.
english: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö ena tägö ki pwöc yi øt acooŋ lam. 'Ba jøøa thööth na wïny pwöc mare, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni köge, ni «?Nyeni gïï ni thööth ii, ee joodø kaa? ?A teeŋ leec wïc mo nyïëdi na wëëk eni? ?A teeŋ tïïe mo nyïëdi mo døøŋŋø na wii cere?
english: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, paa eni na dïjëëth opämi? ?Eni paa o Meeri, na näk cöök Jeemeth, ki Jöce, ki Juudac, ki Cayman? ?A nyïïmenni moa näk mään bäŋ wø bëëdö kany ki øøni?» Ni taakge gïr gø.
english: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Judas, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk bäŋ wø bëëdö ni ba wøør, 'ba tiirra paac mana näk poge, ki dï tuuŋge, ki yi paare kiree noo ba wøøri yie.»
english: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba eni ba maar tïïö ki tïïc mo dwøŋ kaace, 'ba beeye man cïp ceŋŋe bäät jiy mo nøk keerge mo tuu, ni jöön dëëtge.
english: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

anywaa: Ni rëëm yie kiper mana kärge jïëy. Ni caath dï mïëri ni pöö.
english: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu nyïïatwieta näk apaar kurriiø acwöl baŋe, ni täge ki man jääŋ ge wøk na ariiø ariiø, ni mooc ge ki teek bäät juuga reyø.
english: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

anywaa: Ni kööm geni ni kär dee gïn käärge kiper wääth marge, 'ba tiirra athøre. Ni bäŋe keewa, ko opïri, ki gwel mo käärge ki yïth opïcge.
english: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

anywaa: 'Ba ge doo käära wac kööde jaak, ni bäŋe ŋat rwömö ka abïïe ariiø.
english: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Øtø mano wäro dønynyu yie, wäru putu bëëte kaaca, këël mano tïŋŋu.
english: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da paac mou ba pänhnhe, ni kweerge ki man wïnyge maru, tør tietu wär teeŋŋu kanyo aayu nee tïme na nyuudhi dëëtge.»
english: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena aay, ni køpge gø, ni jiy cwïnyge dege løø.
english: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

anywaa: Ni riemge anäge wøk mo thööth, ni ö jiyi mo thööth moa tuu ni wïïr dëëtge ki maaw, ni jöön dëëtge.
english: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø awïny nyeya ma Eerat, kiper nyeŋ Jecu atïmö ni ŋäc. 'Ba jø møøk aköö, ni «Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi atïŋ maal ki yi thøø. Ni beeye tiere gø ni tïme ni da teek bääte ki man tïïe ki gïï mo rëëma ec enø.»
english: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk aköö, ni «Beeye Ilaaja.» Ni kö møøki, ni «Ena nyikuŋ Jwøk mo caala nyïïkuk Jwøk moa cääŋŋe.»
english: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Eerati, ena köö, ni «Jøøn na wïïe ŋula wøk atïŋ maal ki yi thøø.»
english: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

anywaa: Kiper Eerat beeye na jääk baŋ Jøøn ni mak gø, ni twöc gø ni kïth gø øt twöc ki køør Eerödia, cï owänni ma Pilip, na nywøm Eerati.
english: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

anywaa: Kiper Jøøn atïmö ni cäänö ki Eerat, ni kööe, ni «Ba doo beer jïrï ki man bëëdï ki cï owäru.»
english: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

anywaa: Ni ö Eerödia ni männe ki Jøøn, ni manynya man 'näk gø. 'Ba kär løny jïre.
english: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

anywaa: Kiper Eerat lwäär ki Jøøn, ni ŋääe ni Jøøn a dhaanhø mo beer, ni ena dhaanh Jwøk mo ena kur keere, ni bëët Eerati ni gwøga gø. 'Ba kanya wara wïny luum Jøøn, wïïe wø wïïrö, 'ba yie wø poot met thuwø ki man wïny gø.
english: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel jöö ree ajabe, kanya ö Eerati na cwøl jaae moe, ki kwääc jø leny moe, ki dïbwöthe mo Galili, baŋ cam cäŋa nywøli yie.
english: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

anywaa: Kiper kanya ö nyi Eerödia yi øtø, na miele, yi Eerat adøøc mo met ki wëëte. Ni ö nyeya ni kööe jï nyakøønnøgø, ni «Wär a pëënynyï ki gïno miitï jaak. Mëëga ïïni.»
english: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

anywaa: Ni kööŋe jïgø, ni «Gïno pëënynyï aani ki gø jaak, omëëga ïïni, këël ni näk mo ï manynya thääŋ buya.»
english: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

anywaa: Ni ö nyaanøgø ni aa wøk, ni pëëny menni, na «?Agïnaŋø noo pëënynya?» Ni kö menni, ni «Pëëny wï Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi.»
english: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

anywaa: Ni put døny baŋ nyeya ni rwäänhnhö ni pëëny gø ni kööe, na «A manynya ïïni man mëëgï a wï Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi kany ennø, ni ena ya athäänh.»
english: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya cwïnye apädhö døc. 'Ba kiper mana näk eno nø kööŋ nyïm wëëte, ena tïmö ni ba many man wiil luumme na caane jï nyakøønnøgø.
english: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeya ni put dïkuri jääŋŋö man wø en tïï 'näki cere, ni cïpe ki dwøl, ni «Wï Jøøn kälï.» Ni cøøe, ni ŋul wï Jøøn wøk øt twöc,
english: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

anywaa: ni käl wï gø ki ya athäänh ni mëëgi nyakøønnøgø. Ni ö nyakøønnøgø ni mëëk gø menni.
english: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø na wïnynyi ya bääk Jøønni gena öö ni kälge dëëre ni kïthge gø yi bwörö.
english: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwieli ni duuge baŋ Jecu ni caange gïïa tïïcge ki pwöc bëët moa pööge ki gø jïgø.
english: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Ööu wøk kur keeru kany mo bäŋ paac, ni jwömmu dëëtu ki mo thiinh.» Kiper jiy atïmö ni wïdö, ni tïm Jecu ki bääge ni bäŋ caa jïge këël ki man cämge.
english: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

anywaa: Ni aacge ki jääy ni ge cøøa kany mo bäŋ paac, ge keerge.
english: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni gena neen jiyi mo thööth ni ge aay, ni ŋecge ge, ni reŋge ki wøk, ni ge käla yïth mïëri bëët, ni kwøŋge pïï kaace ni Jecu ki bääge poodi.
english: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ïnh Jecu wøk, lwaak mo päl ajoode, ni päth cwïnye ki gïrge, kiper na tïmge ni ge caala dïëk mo bäŋ dïkwääy jïge. Ni täge ki man pwöny geni ki luup mo thööth.
english: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na abøøya, bääge aö baŋe ni köge, ni «Man a paap, ni caa onø pöödhö.
english: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

anywaa: Wëëk lwaak wääth, nee cige paac ki mïëyö thenh thenh ni en ŋää paac yøø, nee dëëtge ŋëëmge ki gïn camge.»
english: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe jïge, ni kööe, ni «Uuni, mooyu geni ki gïn camge.» Ni köge jïgø, «?Aŋø, ciwa ni ŋëëwa ki muunni ma kar gwel ma dïpe ariiø, nee mëëk geni nee camge?»
english: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?A muunni adïï ni en jïïu? Cou ni neennu ge.» 'Ba na nø jootge gø, gena köö, ni «Nuta muunni abïïc ki rec ariiø.»
english: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy aköömme bëët, ni pïge piny na akääŋi yi luuma mar.
english: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

anywaa: Køøre gena pï piny na akääŋi, na akääŋi møøk a dïpa, ni møøk a pïërabïïc.
english: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

anywaa: Ni lwør muuga näk abïïc ki reya näk ariiø, ni neen maal ni gwïëth ge, ni pøt muugögø ni mëëk ge bääŋi, nee cïïmge nyïm jøøgø. Ni pääŋ reya näk ariiø dïge bëët.
english: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

anywaa: Ni cämge bëët ni jäŋge.
english: And they did all eat, and were filled.

anywaa: Ni ö bääŋi ni jïtge ki yïth gupe apaar kurriiø mo päŋ ki thäk muunni ki thäk rec moa kwanyge piny na dhäthö.
english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cam muugögø, kwään cwøw beege kume abïïc.
english: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni Jecu bääge aput köömmö nee ethge yi jääy nee kwøŋge ci nyïme løøga yi Betheeda, kanya poode ni wëëga lwaak keethø.
english: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø daak ree buutge, ena aa bäät kïdi kuna läme.
english: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na wäär, jääy oløny ni ena dï naam, ni dööŋŋa eni keere bäät ageela.
english: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

anywaa: Ni neen bääge ni geno ööl døc ki kïïö, kiper jamø atïmö ni kwönna bäätge. 'Ba kanya tïm kar øwi ni cään, Jecu aö baŋge, ni cäädhi ka bäät pïï. 'Ba eni manynya man pöödhe ki buutge.
english: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö bääge na jootge eni ni cäädhi ka bäät pïï, ena caarge ni tïpö, ni rëëtge.
english: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

anywaa: Kiper ena jootge bëët, ni bwøkge. 'Ba kanyøgø ena put luupö ki geni, ni kööe, ni «Magu cwïnynyu. Man a aani. Käru lwäyö.»
english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

anywaa: Ni eth yi jääy buutge, ni ö jame ni cuŋŋe. Ni rëëm yïthge døc.
english: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

anywaa: Kiper gïr muunni kär ci cwïnyge døøc. 'Ba cwïnyge wø poot teek.
english: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu ki bääge na nø kathge løøga, gena mäk piny yi ŋööm jø Genedharet, ni cwöthge jääy piny dhi waath.
english: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

anywaa: 'Ba na öge wøk ki yi jääy, Jecu aput jiyi ŋec,
english: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

anywaa: ni ŋwiecge dï paac bäre, ni täk jiyi ki man kälge jiy moa tuu no opïël yïth pëëne moge, kany wø wïnyge eni ni eni ena yie.
english: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ci Jecu yie, nee ena yïth mïëri moa therø ki yïth päänye, wala dï paac, jiy moa tuu wø pïëlge kwör ŋïëw, ni kwaacge eni këël ki man gutge deŋ abïïne keere jaak. 'Ba jøøa gut gø bëët, dëëtge adøø karge.
english: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni jø Paricith ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk møøk moa öö ki yi Jerucalem, rege acooŋge buut Jecu.
english: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ajootge ni bääge møøk ge cämö ni ceŋge ba waany, ni tiere beeye ni kärge lwøø ki køør kööŋŋö.
english: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

anywaa: Kiper jø Paricith ki jø Juuth bëët bäŋ wø cämö ni näk mo ceŋge kärge lwøø ki køør kööŋŋö mar jøøa døøŋŋø.
english: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø duuge ki kar ŋïïw, ge ba cämö ni näk ceŋge kärge lwøø ki køør kööŋŋö manøgø. 'Ba da kööŋŋe møøk mo thööth mo wø gwøkge gwøø, teeŋ ka peny athööthe, ki dääe, ka athääe.
english: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu apëëny jø Paricithi ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ni köge, na «?Aŋø ni ö bäägï ni bëëtge ni kööŋŋö mar jøøa døøŋŋø ba gwøkge, ni ge cämö ka ceŋ mo ba waany en?»
english: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «Gïru acaan Aydheea na kare, u na jø atade, kaa mana gööri, «ni ‹Jøøi ii a wø wøørge ka lëëpge, 'ba cwïnyge karge bäär ki aani.
english: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

anywaa: Naa wø wøørge ka wödö mo oballe jaak, ni ge pöö ka pwöc jiy ni keda luum Jwøk.›
english: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

anywaa: Uuni, mana cem Jwøki aweyu, ni magu kööŋŋö mar jiy.»
english: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Uuna jïtö ki jöö ma wøp man kwierru mana cem Jwøki ki gø, kiper nee kööŋŋö maru gwøgu.
english: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

anywaa: Kiper Modhe aköö, ni ‹Wøør wäru ki meru.› Ni ‹Ŋato cäänö ki gïn mo raac dëër wänni wala menni wär eni 'näk.›
english: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

anywaa: 'Ba u wø köö, ni løny jï dhaanhø ki man kööe jï wänni wala menni, ni ‹Køny mana diï joodø baŋa atïmö na Körban,› ni tiere beeye ni gïnöca onø tïmö na muuy jï Jwøk;
english: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

anywaa: ni manøgø, u mäna eni ni kär dee gïn tïïe jï wänni wala menni;
english: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

anywaa: nou raanynya luum Jwøk na enøgønø ki køør kööŋŋö maru ni wø wëëgu jiy. Nou bëëdö nou tïïya teeŋ gïïögønø mo thööth.»
english: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu lwaak acäŋ cwøl baŋe, ni kööe jïge, ni «Wïnynyu pwöc mara, u bëët, ni kwanynyu tiere.
english: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

anywaa: Bäŋ gïn mo ööi ki wøk, mo dhaanhø dee maara raanynyø kiper mana døny yi dhaanhø, 'ba beege gïï wø ö wøk ki yi dhaanhø ni wø raany dhaanhø. [16
english: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.

anywaa: Nee da ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu, na nø wec jiy ni døny yi øtø, ena pëëny bääge ki tier leer manøgø.
english: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «?Aŋø, këël u thuwø, gïnögø tiere käru kwanyø? ?Käru joodø ni gïn wø ööi ki wøk ni wø døny yi dhaanhø, dhaanhø ba dee maara raanynyø?
english: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

anywaa: Kiper atïmö ni ba ci cwïnye, 'ba cøøa yie, ni pöötha wøk.» 'Ba na caan luummögø, eni caana gø, ni caammi bëët beyø.
english: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Gïn wø ö wøk ki cwïny dhaanhø beeye wø raany dhaanhø.
english: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

anywaa: Ni beeye yi cwïny dhaanhø ni wø ö acaac raay ki yie, teeŋ ka käp, ki käw, ki 'näk, ki luk,
english: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

anywaa: ki par jammi, ki rääö, ki cwøk, ki pär cwïny, ki keec, ki waac nyeŋ, ka atöör, ki bøøl.
english: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

anywaa: Raayøgø bëët wø ööi ka yi cwïny, ni öge ni raanyge dhaanhø.»
english: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu atïŋŋö kaace ni ci yïth mïëc Tayar. Ni døny øtø mør, nee bäŋe ŋat mo ŋäc gø. 'Ba eni ba maar kan.
english: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni ena put dhaage mo dëër nyaare da jwøk mo raac wïnynyö, ni ö nyijøøgø ni päth tiet gø.
english: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

anywaa: 'Ba nyijøøgø beeye nyi jø Gïrïïk, mo nywølla Cayröpönicia. Ni ö nyijøøgø ni kwac Jecu kiper nee anägö riem wøk dëër nyaare.
english: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Wëëk obwöre cam dïkwøŋ, kiper paa gïn mo beer ki man käl møk obwöre ni leeŋi baŋ guu.»
english: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyijøøgø jïgø, «Beeye kare, Kwäärö. 'Ba këël guu wø poot cämö ki thäk caammi mo wø thenh thenh ni wø päth piny kar cam mar obwöre.»
english: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Kiper mana caanï enø, døø paac nø. Anägö anø ö wøk dëër nyaarï.»
english: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

anywaa: Ni ö nyijøøgø ni aa paac, ni nwän nyilaal mare no obutö bäät pëëm, na anägö oaay dëëre.
english: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgøøni Jecu mïëc Tayar awiie, ni cøra yi Caydan, ni døø bäät Puul Galili, ni pïïe dï mïëc Dikapöla.
english: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

anywaa: Ni ö jø møøki ni känge baŋe ki dhaanhø ma miiŋ mo leebe teek ki man cääne. Ni kwacge gø kiper nee ceŋŋe kïth bäät gø.
english: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø käl gø wøk ki dï lwaak ni kïth gø kur keere, lweete akïth ïth gø, ni ŋuute ki laaw ni mul leep gø,
english: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

anywaa: ni neen maal, ni jwïëe, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Epetha,» na näk tiere beeye, ni «Jap riï.»
english: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

anywaa: Ni ö ïth ŋatøgø ni japge rege, ni pät leebe, ni cäänne ni dwøre wïnyö ni tiir.
english: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni kööm geni, ni kär dee ŋat caange gïnögø jïgø. 'Ba kany wø kööm geni, ni kär caange, beeye man wø putge gø kaath ki caan.
english: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

anywaa: Ni rëëm yïth jiyi døc, ni köge, ni «Eni jammi bëët atïïe na wøpe. Këël meŋŋe adøøc mo wïnyö, ni ö jøøa lëëpge teek ki man cäänge ni cäänge.»
english: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögøøni Jecu buute acäŋ jïtö ki lwaak mo päl ni bäŋ gïn camge. Ni ö eni ni cwøl bääge ni kööe jïge,
english: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

anywaa: ni «Aani cwïnya apädhö ki gïr lwaaøgø, kiper nïne adäk ennø ni ge bëëdö ka aani, ni bäŋ gïn mo camge.
english: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ge wëëga wääth mïëcge ni dëëtge da käc, ge bup jöö, kiper møøk ööi ka kwör mo bäyö.»
english: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya bääge jïre, ni «?Dhaanhø a dee jït kaa ki muunni dï paap kany mo caam jøøi ki ge?»
english: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

anywaa: Ni pëëny geni, na «?A muunni adïï ni en jïïu?» Ni köge, na «Abïriiø.»
english: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

anywaa: Ni kööm lwaak ni pïge piny. Ni lwør muuga näk abïriiø; 'ba kanya nø dwøk met ec, apøte, ni mëëk ge bääge nee cïïmge nyïm jiy. Ni ö geni ni pääŋge ge jï lwaak.
english: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

anywaa: 'Ba jïge da rec mo nøk mo thenh thenh. 'Ba na nø ö Jecu na gwïëth ge, bääge aköömme, ni gïï thuwø doo cïïmmö nyïm jiy.
english: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

anywaa: Ni cämge ni jäŋge. Ni ö bääge ni kwaanyge thäŋi moa näk opøtø na dhäthö, ni pääŋge yïth gupe abïriiø.
english: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cämö jïtö ki kar kume aŋween. Køøre Jecu jøøgø awëëk wääth,
english: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

anywaa: ni put ci yi jääy ki bääge, ni ci po jø Dalmanutha.
english: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith aöö ni täkge ki pïëm ki Jecu, ni ge manynya ŋïï baŋe mo ööi ki maal, ni ge päänynya gø.
english: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni jwïëe døc ki yie bäre, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø ni ö beenhnhø man ni many ŋïï en? Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, bäŋ ŋïï mo nyooth jïge.»
english: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

anywaa: Ni wec geni ni cäŋ døø yi jääy, ni ci løøga.
english: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni bääŋi wïthge awïl ki man käätge ki muunni. 'Ba beeye møø aciel keere na en jïge yi jääy.
english: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni kööm geni døc, ni «Japu nyeŋŋu, ni gwøgu rou ki thøm jø Paricith, ki thøm Eerat.»
english: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

anywaa: Ni løøŋge dhøkge yïthakicge keerge, ni ge köö, ni «Beeye kiper mana näk jïïø bäŋ muunni.»
english: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

anywaa: 'Ba aŋäc Jecu ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø ni løøŋŋu dhøgu en, ni jïïu bäŋ muunni? ?Poot ba jootu en, ni kwanynyu tiere? ?Aŋø, cwïnynyu poot teek ni bëëdu en?
english: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

anywaa: ?Jïïu da nyeŋ, nou ba nëënö? ?Ni jïïu da ïdhi, nou ba wïnyö? ?Uuni, wïthu ba parru?
english: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

anywaa: ?Kanya pøta muuga näk abïïc jï lwaaa näk kume abïïc, a yïth gupe adïï na kwanynyu na päŋ ki thäŋi moa näk opøtø?» Ni köge jïre, na «Apaar kurriiø.»
english: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «?Kanya pøta muuga näk abïriiø jï lwaaa näk kume aŋween, a yïth gupe adïï na kwanynyu na päŋ ki thäŋi moa näk opøtø?» Ni köge jïre, na «Abïriiø.»
english: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «?Tiere poot ba kwanynyu nø?»
english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

anywaa: Ni öge yi Betheeda. 'Ba jø møøk akän bäŋ Jecu ki dhaanhø ma cwør, ni kwacge gø nee mule.
english: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

anywaa: Ni mak cer ŋata näk cwør, ni kïth gø wøk ŋää paac. 'Ba na nø ŋuut nyeŋ gø ki laaw, ni kïth ceŋŋe bäät nyeŋ gø, ena pëënynye, ni «?Da gïn mo nëënö jïrï?»
english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

anywaa: Ni tïŋ wïïe maal ni nëënne, ni kööe, na «A neeta jiy, 'ba ge keda jenni mo cäädhö.»
english: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cäŋ ceŋŋe kïth nyeŋ gø, ni put nëënnö døc, ni døø nyeŋŋe karge, ni neen jammi bëët na wøpe.
english: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

anywaa: Ni wëëk gø ciin kar bëëtö mare, ni kööe, ni «Kärï ci dï paac.»
english: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu apööth mïëc Cecaria Pilipay ki bääge. 'Ba na jöökge øtjöö, bääge apëënynye, ni «?Jiy wø köge, ni aana ŋa?»
english: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

anywaa: Ni caange gø jïre, ni «Ge wø köö, ni ïïna Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi; ni kö møøki, ni ïïna Ilaaja. 'Ba møøk wø köö, ni ïïna nyikugö aciel dï nyïïkuk Jwøk.»
english: And they answered, John the Baptist: but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

anywaa: Ni pëëny geni, «?A uuni, u wø kööu, ni aana ŋa?» Ni løgi ya Piterri jïre, ni «Bee ïïni na Krictø.»
english: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

anywaa: Ni kööm geni ni kär eni caange jï ŋat mør.
english: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu atägö ki man pwöny bääge, ni Wär Dhaanhø gïï mo leth mo thööth ojwøre, ni kwieri ya jaae, ki kwääc laam, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ni nääi, ni cäŋ ö maal ri dää nïne.
english: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

anywaa: Ni gïnögø caane ni wïnyö jaak. 'Ba ena kïth Piterri wøk, ni täge ki man jook gø.
english: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

anywaa: 'Ba na løk ree ni neen bääge, Piter ajwøe, ni kööe, ni «Daak riï ŋääa, Ceethan! Kiper acaara marï ba en løø Jwøk, 'ba ena løø jiy.»
english: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

anywaa: Ni cwöl lwaak baŋe ki bääge ni kööe jïge, ni «Nee da dhaanhø mo manynya man ö køøra, eni dëëre wär taae, ni käär jaadhe na näk odëëdö, ni caath køøra.
english: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato wäro many man gwøk jwïëye, nyääga gø. Ni ŋato wäro nyääk jwïëye kiper nyeŋŋa ki luumma nyään na met, gwøga gø.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø ni beer noo duui jï dhaanhø ki man ci pinynyi bäre cere, ni nyääk jwïëye?
english: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø noo maar dhaanhe cïp ni wiila jwïëye?
english: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro wïïe laay ki nyeŋŋa, ki luupa, dï beenhnhø man ni wø kwier luum Jwøk, na jø raay en, Wär Dhaanhø wïïe olaay ki gø thuwø, kanyo ööe ki nyïïatwiet maal moa en kur keerge ka ajiem wänni.»
english: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aköö jïge, na «Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni da jø møøk mo cuŋŋö kany mo thøø ba jootge këël kanyo neenge buc Jwøk ni ööi ka teek.»
english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne abïciel, Jecu Piter ki Jeemeth ki Jøøn akäle, ni bwøth geni wï kïdi mo bäär, ge keerge, ni røøe nyïmge.
english: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

anywaa: Ni ö abïïe moe ni tïmge ni ŋwaŋŋi ni tar døc, ni bäŋ dïpïnyi bäät piny ma abïïge doo täyö ki tayøce.
english: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

anywaa: Ni ö Ilaaja ki Modhe ni nyoothge dëëtge jïge kaace, ni ge cäänö ki Jecu.
english: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jï Jecu, ni «Dïpööy, beer døc kiree na enø kany. Beerra man tïïwa ka abïle adäk, aciel kiperï, na aciel kiper Modhe, ni maya kiper Ilaaja.»
english: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

anywaa: Kiper atïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe mo caane, kiper na tïmge ni ge lwäär døc.
english: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

anywaa: Ni ö pöölö ni neejïïm bäätge. Ni ö dwølli ki yi pööllögø ni kööe, ni «Man beeye Wääda na mëëra ki gø. Wïnynyu luumme.»
english: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

anywaa: 'Ba ki nyi kany mo thiinh na lwïthge, bäŋ dhaanhø mo ege joodø buutge këët, 'ba beeye Jecu keere.
english: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya duuge piny ki bäät kïdi, gena kööm Jecu ni kööe, ni «Gïna jootu en, kär dee ŋat caannu gø jïre, këël mano tïŋ Wär Dhaanhø maal ki yi thøø.»
english: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø akange cwïnyge keerge, ni pëënyge dëëtge, ni «?Tier tïŋ maal ki yi thøø agïnaŋø?»
english: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge eni, na «?Aŋø ni wø kö dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ni Ilaaja doo kwøŋa öö turu?»
english: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Ilaaja kwøŋa öö møn, ni dwøga jammi bëët kwörge. ?'Ba agïnaŋø na göör kiper Wär Dhaanhø thuwø? Beeye ni eni gïï mo leth mo thööth dee jwørø ni caanni.
english: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni Ilaaja anø öö, ni ö jiyi ni tïïcge gïïa met yïthge ki ge dëër gø, keda mana gööri kipere.»
english: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu ki bääge na pïïcge buut bääŋi møga, lwaak mo päl ajootge buutge, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk mo pïëmö ki geni.
english: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö lwaaki na jootge Jecu, yïthge aput thäŋŋö, ni reŋge baŋe ni määthge gø.
english: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni pëëny geni, no «?U pïëmu ŋø?»
english: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk dhaanhe acielli jïre dï lwaak, «Dïpööy, wääda akäla baŋï, kiper dëëre da jwøk mo raac mo otïïc gø ni ba cäänö.
english: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

anywaa: Ni kany wø mak eni, wø gøøe piny, ni ö bööyö wøk ki dhee, ni mööta lage, ni tale ni teek. 'Ba bäägï apëënynya nee riemge wøk, 'ba kär maar lønyø jïge.»
english: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «?U na beenhnhø mo bäŋ ŋäädhe jïïu en, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo beeda ki uuni? ?Naa këël kany mo nyïëdi noo maa cwïnya ki uuni? Kälu eni baŋa.»
english: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

anywaa: Ni kälge nyilaal baŋe. 'Ba na ö jwøøgø na joot Jecu, nyilaal aput meeyø, ni päth yïth ŋøøm, ni rweenynye jaak, ni bööyö onikum dhee.
english: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

anywaa: Ni ö wänni ni pëënynyi ya Jecu, na «?A kany mo nyïëdi na täk gïnni dëëre?» Ni kööe, ni «Käla thïnhö ki gø.
english: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

anywaa: Ni eni wø leeŋe maac ki yïth pïï cooth, ni 'näga gø. 'Ba ni näk da gïn mo løny ki man tïïyï gø, cwïnyï pädhe nø ki canwa, ni kønyï wa.»
english: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, na «?Aŋø, köö ïïni, ni ‹Ni näk da gïn mo løny ki man tïïyï gø›? Jammi bëët wø lønynya jï ŋat wø jïëy ni ŋäädhe.»
english: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

anywaa: Ni put wää nyilaalli köö, ni «Aana jïëy ni ŋäädha. 'Ba køny a ki ŋäädhe mara ni poot thiinh en.»
english: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na neen lwaak ni ge läänna kanya ciel, jwøa raac ajooe, ni kööe jïgø, «Ï na jwøa näk ba luubö na miiŋ, a köömma ïïni, ö wøk dëëre, ni ba cäŋï ci dëëre këët.»
english: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø rëëde ni meec gøøni ni raac døc, ena ö wøk, ni ö nyilaalli ni tïme kede othøw. Kiper manøgønø, jiy mo thööth aköö, ni «Eno thøw.»
english: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu cer nyilaal amaae ni tïŋ gø maal, ni cuŋŋe.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø døny Jecu yi øtø, ena pëëny bääge kur keere, na «?Aŋø na ba lønye jïwa ki man riemwa anäŋŋögø wøk?»
english: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Teeŋ gïnögø ba maar lønyø ki man riemi wøk ki gïn mør jaak, 'ba beeye lam keere.»
english: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu ki bääge gena tïŋŋö kaace ni ge cøra dï Galili. Ni eni ba many man ŋäyi ya ŋat mørri,
english: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

anywaa: kiper na bëëde ni eni pwönynya bääge, ni köö jïge, ni «Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ jiy, ni 'näkge gø. 'Ba no nø 'näkge gø, noo tïme na køør nïne adäk, eno ö maal.»
english: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

anywaa: 'Ba bääge, tier luumma caane kär ci cwïnyge, ni ge lwäär ki man pëënyge eni.
english: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu ki bääge gena ö yi Kapernaam. 'Ba kanya enge yi øtø, eni bääge apëënynye, na «?Agïnaŋø na pïëmu øtjöö kipere?»
english: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

anywaa: 'Ba gena lïŋö. Kiper kanya cääthge waŋjöö, gena pïëmö ge keerge, na aŋa ni kare dwøŋŋa eni.
english: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu apï piny ni cwøl geni, ge na näk apaar kurriiø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Ŋato wäro many man tïme ni ena nyïm, wär dëëre dwøk cään, ni ena ŋat wø tïny jiy bëët.»
english: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

anywaa: Ni lwöte ki nyilaal mo thiinh, ni cïp gø dïge. 'Ba na tïŋ gø ni maa gø kööre, ena köö jïge,
english: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

anywaa: ni «Ŋat wäro pänh nyilaal mo caala man ki nyeŋŋa, eni pänhnha aani. Ni ŋat wäro pänh aani, ba pänh aani, 'ba pänhnha eni na jääŋ aani.»
english: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn aköö jïre, «Dïpööy, waana jïtö ki ŋat mør mo rëëmma wøk ka anäge ki nyeŋŋï, ni mänwa gø, kiper mana ba en dïïø.»
english: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Kär mänu. Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo tïïö ki gïn mo dwøŋ ki nyeŋŋa, mo doo cäŋa öö ni laar nyeŋŋa waac ki gïn mo raac.
english: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø ba män ki øøni, ena kurø.
english: For he that is not against us is on our part.

anywaa: 'Ba adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋato wäro mooc uuni ka athöönh pïï mo maathu kiper na nägu mo Krictø, mano mëëk eni ba doo kääŋö bäre bäre.
english: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋato wäro wëëk nyilaal aciel bääyö dëët moi ni therø ii no ojïëy ni ŋääthge aani en, doo beerra eni kiper ŋatøgø ki man twöö kïn guur mo dwøŋ døc ŋute, ni leeŋi yi naama dwøŋ.
english: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cerï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, ŋul wøk. Kiper beerra eni jïrï ki man ciï yi kwøw na dïbat ciel, ki mana di ï leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla na näk maaa näk bäŋ cuŋŋe ki ceŋŋï riet.
english: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

anywaa: 'Ba nee tierï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, ŋul wøk. Kiper beerra eni jïrï ki man ciï yi kwøw na ŋwøl, ki mana di ï leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla ki tietï riet.
english: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

anywaa: 'Ba nee waŋï beeye wø wëëk ïïni bääyö, göön wøk. Kiper beerra eni jïrï ki man ciï yi buc Jwøk ki waŋ aciel, ki mana di ï leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla ki nyeŋŋï riet,
english: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

anywaa: ni beeye kany wø ba thøw twöŋi yie mo wø cam jiy, ni maac man wø waaŋ geni bëëdö ni ba 'näk.
english: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët otïmö ni law ki maac.
english: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

anywaa: Acäbö met. ?'Ba ni näk ma acäbö lawe obänhnhö, lawe ocäŋu gø dwøk kare nidïï? Bëëdu ni dëëtu da acäbö, ni mëërru ki røgu ni bëëdu ki bëët-mëër.»
english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu atïŋŋö kaace ni ci yïth mïëc Judia løø Naam Jördan løøga, ni ö lwaae ni cäŋge rege cooŋ buute. Ni cäŋ ge pwönynyö keda man wø bëëde cøøn.
english: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Paricithi baŋ Jecu ni pëënyge gø ni ge päänynya gø, ni köge, ni «?Beeye gïn mo beer jï dhaanhø ki man kwier cïïe?»
english: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø na køp Modhe jïïu?»
english: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Modhe dhaanhø ajïëe ki man gööde ki wëël apääk ni kwier cïïe.»
english: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, «Modhe ciigøgø gööre kaper mana teek cwïnynyu.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

anywaa: 'Ba ki kanya cak piny, Jwøk jiy ‹acwääe na thwønh ki maath.›
english: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

anywaa: ‹Kiper manøgønø, dhaanhø wänni ki menni wø wiie wiiø ni dwätge ki cïïe,
english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

anywaa: ni ö geni karge riet ni tïmge na dëël aciel.› Kanyøgønø, ge patha ariiø këët, 'ba gena dëël aciel.
english: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïï mo onø dwal Jwøki, kär dee ŋat pää ge.»
english: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøge yi øtø, ena cäŋ bääŋi pëënynyö kiper gïnögø.
english: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Ŋato wäro kwier cïïe, ni nyöömme ki dhaagø mør, mare luk ki gø.
english: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk kweerra dhaagø ki cwøre, ni nywømi ya dïcwøøe mør, mare luk.»
english: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø møøk akän baŋ Jecu ko obwöre kiper nee ge mule. 'Ba gena jook bääŋi.
english: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø na neeni ya Jecu, cwïnye aränynyö, ni kööe jïge, ni «Weyu obwöre, nee öge baŋa; kär geni mänu. Kiper teeŋ obwöre moøgø nø buc Jwøk a marge.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋato wäro ba jïëc buc Jwøk kaamar nyilaal, ba doo dønynya yi gø.»
english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

anywaa: Ni tïŋ geni kööre, ni kïth ceŋŋe bäätge, ni gwïëth ge.
english: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na tïŋ wääth mare, dhaanhø mør areŋ baŋe, ni këël cøŋŋe piny nyïm gø, ni pëëny gø, ni «Dïpööy mana beer, ?agïnaŋø noo tïïa, kiper nee kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe jooda?»
english: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïgø, na «?Aŋø ni cwølï aani naa beer en? Bäŋ ŋat mo beer, 'ba beeye Jwøk keere.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

anywaa: Gïïa cem ŋäyï, ni ‹Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø. Kärï kännö ki luk. Kärï kwätö. Kärï cäänö ki tööt dëër dhaanhø. Kärï mutö. Wøør wäru ki meru.› »
english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïgø, ni «Dïpööy, gïïögø bëët yaa gwøø, këël ki mana käla thïnhö.»
english: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

anywaa: 'Ba jïre aneen Jecu ni mëër ki gø, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Da gïrpiny aciel mo poot kärï tïïö. Ciï ni dwøgï gïïa en jïrï bëët pwödhö, ni mëëgï gwetge jøøa can, ni ööï ni cäädhï køøra, 'ba ïïno jïti ki jap kwär maal.»
english: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny luummögø, täärnyïme aniduk, ni aae ni cwïnye opädhö. Kiper eni jïre da jammi mo thööth døc.
english: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu alwïthö ni kööe jï bääge, «Døny buc Jwøk oteee ki teek mo nyïëdi jï jøø no okwär yøø ki man dønyge yie.»
english: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

anywaa: 'Ba bääge yïthge athäŋŋö ki luupe. 'Ba Jecu acäŋ köö jïge, «Obwöre, døny buc Jwøk teee ki teek mo nyïëdi ki man døny yie.
english: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

anywaa: Jööta eni jï athïrööl ki man dønye ki waŋ lïlmu ki man ö ŋat mo okwärri ni døny buc Jwøk.»
english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba yïthge athäŋŋö døc, ni köge jïgø, na «?Aŋa nø, noo maar piem?»
english: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

anywaa: 'Ba jïge aneen Jecu ni kööe, ni «Ki jï jiy, gïnögø ba maar lønyø, 'ba paa ki jï Jwøk. Kiper jammi bëët løny jï Jwøk.»
english: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter atägö ki man cään Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Neenï, kawaane waani jammi bëët awiiwa piny, ni caathwa køørï.»
english: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni dhaanhø mo paac ee wiiø, wala nyïïmenni, wala wänni ki menni, wala obwöre, wala pwöth, kiper nyeŋŋa ki luumma nyään na met,
english: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

anywaa: eno mooc ki jammi mo thööth yi pinyi ennø, ni kaala moa dïkwøŋ, teeŋ ka uudi, ki nyïïmëëe, ki mëëe, ko obwöre, ki pwöth, këël ki caannø thuwø. 'Ba piny mano ööi beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth mo en nyïm ennø, odøø cään, ni ö mo en cään ennø, ni pööthge maal.»
english: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu ki bääge na cääthge jöö ni ge cøøa yi Jerucalem, ni Jecu beeye na bwödhö nyïmge, bääge yïthge athäŋŋö, ni lwäc jøøa läp køørge. 'Ba Jecu, bääge na näk apaar kurriiø acäŋ lwørrø, ni täge ki man caan gïno tägi dëëre jïge.
english: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Neennu, ø cøøa yi Jerucalem. 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk. 'Ba eno ŋølge yi thøø, ni cïpge gø ceŋ juurre.
english: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni buuge gø, ni ŋuutge bäät gø ki laaw, ni pwötge gø ni 'näkge gø. 'Ba køør nïne adäk eno ö maal.»
english: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jeemeth ki Jøøn, ge na wäät Dhebedi, gena pööth nyïm baŋ Jecu, ni köge jïgø, ni «Dïpööy, wa manynya ïïni nee gïno pëënywa ïïni ki gø en nee tïïyï jïwa.»
english: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyu nee tïïa jïïu?»
english: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, ni «Wëëk wa pïïn kar ajiemï, ni dhaanhø aciel ena bäät cwïïï, ni ö maya ni en bäät caamï.»
english: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, no «U pëënynya gïn mo kuyu. ?Maara lønyø jïïu ki man mäthu ka athöönhnho mätha ki gø? ?Wala dëëtu di lwøø ki lwøk dëël mano lwøk a ki gø?»
english: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, ni «Løny jïwa.» 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «Athöönhnho maadha, omaathu møn, ni lwøk dëël mano lwøk aani ki gø, uuno lwøk ki gø.
english: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

anywaa: 'Ba pïïn bäät cwïïa wala bäät caama, ba en jïra ki man cïba gø, 'ba ocïp jï jøøa jiiŋ gø kiperge.»
english: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya bääge moa näk apaar, gena tägö ki man gootge ki Jeemeth ki Jøøn.
english: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cwøl geni baŋe, ni kööe jïge, ni «Ŋäyu, ni jø wø näk kwääri bäät juurre, dëëtge ege cuumö bäät jiy moge, ni ö jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø dïge ni nyoothge teekge bäät jiy moa en tietge.
english: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

anywaa: 'Ba ba doo tïmö na enønø ki baŋu. 'Ba ŋato wäro many man tïme ni dwøŋŋa kare dïïu, wär tïme na ŋat mo tïnynya uuni.
english: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

anywaa: Ni ŋat wäro many man tïme ni ena nyïm dïïu, wär dëëre døøc ma laŋŋø jï jiy bëët.
english: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø thuwø kär öö nee tïnynyi, 'ba ööi kaper nee jø møøk tïnynye, ni cïpa jwïëye na wïïdi kiper jiy mo thööth.»
english: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu ki bääge gena ö Jerikö. 'Ba kanya tïŋŋe Jerikö ki bääge ki lwaak mo päl døc, nyen ma cwør mo cwøl ni Bartimia wär Timia ajootge no opï piny thääŋ jöö ni kwääö.
english: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gø ni manøgø beeye Jecu nyï Nadhareth, ena tägö ki rëëdö, ni «Jecu Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canna!»
english: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

anywaa: Ni joogi ya jiyi mo thööthi ni ge caana gø jïre, nee lïŋe. 'Ba beeye mana rëëde døc nø, ni «Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canna!»
english: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

anywaa: Ni cuŋ Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Cwøllu eni.» Ni ö geni ni cwølge ŋata näk cwør, ni köge jïgø, «Mak cwïnyï! Ö maal! Ïïna cwøle.»
english: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni put koonhnhe leeŋ piny, ni päny maal ni ö baŋ Jecu.
english: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï nee tïïa jïrï?» Ni ö cwønøgø ni kööe jïgø, «Dïpööy, wëëk nyeŋŋa døø karge.»
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, «Ciï nø; ŋäädhe marï dëërï adwøk kare.» Ni put nyeŋŋe døø kare, ni läp køør Jecu øtjöö.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm karge ni cään ki Jerucalem, yi Bethpec ki Bethani, buut Kïn Ølip, Jecu bääge ariiø ajääŋŋe,
english: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou paanø ni en nyïmmu enø. 'Ba kanyo dønynyu yie ennø, u puta jïtö ki nya arëën mo otwöö piny, mo poot bäŋ dhaanhø mo oeth bääte. Wär pätu ni kälu gø.
english: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo cäännö ki uuni, na ‹?Aperŋø ni tïïyu gïn?› wär caannu jïre, ni ‹Kwäärö manynya gø, 'ba olaar duu kany.› »
english: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

anywaa: Ni cige ni jootge nya arëën no otwöö piny dhi øtø buut waŋjöö jaak. Ni pätge gø.
english: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cuŋŋö kaace, gena köö jïge, na «?Agïnaŋø ni tïïyu ni pätu nya arëën en?»
english: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

anywaa: Ni caange gïna caan Jecu jïge, ni wëëk geni wääth.
english: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

anywaa: Ni kälge arëënögø baŋ Jecu ni peethge abïïkge bääte. Ni ö Jecu ni pï bäät gø.
english: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni peethge abïïkge waŋjöö, ni ö jø møga ni peethge bøøk jenni waŋjöö moa ŋøtge dï pwöth.
english: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa bwödhö nyïm ki jøøa cäädhö cään, ni rëëtge, ni «Odhaana! Pwøc en jï Jwøk! Gwïëth en ri ŋat ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.
english: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

anywaa: Gwïëth en ri buc kwarø ma Deebit noo ööi. Wui, Odhaana! Pwøc en jï Jwøk ni en maalø!»
english: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni døny yi Jerucalem, ni ci yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba na neen jammi bëët, ni cäŋ oløny ni thiinh, ena aay ni døø yi Bethani ki bääge na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, kanya nø tïŋge ki yi Bethani, Jecu anäk käci.
english: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

anywaa: 'Ba na neen olaam ki kany mo bäär mo dëëre da bøøge, ena ci kuna neen gø, ki man näk mo da nyïëdi mo joode dëër gø. 'Ba na pïïe buut gø, bäŋ gïn mo ee joodø, 'ba beeye bøøge jaak. Kiper patha kanya doo olämmi ciek yie.
english: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïgø, ni «Kär dee dhaanhø mo cämö dëërï ki nyïëdi këët.» 'Ba gïnögø awïny bääge.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena ö yi Jerucalem. Ni ö Jecu ni døny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni täge ki man riem jøøa gädhö ki jammi wøk bëët yi øt Jwøk, ki jøøa ŋëëö, ni jaal tharabëëte mo jø wø wïïdö ki gwel, ni jaal köömmi mo jø wø gädhö ka akuyi.
english: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo ee wëëk ŋøl dï Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni tïëdö ki gïrpiny.
english: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

anywaa: Ni kööm geni ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, paa ogöörö, ni ‹Øda doo cwølø ni øt lam kiper mïëri bëët›? 'Ba atïïyu na kar dïmute.»
english: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø awïny kwääc laammi ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ni määnyge ki jöö man 'näkge eni ki gø, kiper na lwäärge ki eni, kiper mana tïm lwaaki bäre ni yïthge orëëm ki pwöc moe.
english: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na abøøya, Jecu ki bääge gena aa wøk ki dï pääny.
english: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla man ni Jecu ki bääge ge cäädha jöö, olaam aneenge no obäp, ni tägi ka lweedi moe.
english: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni par wïïe ni kööe jï Jecu, «Dïpööy, neen olaama cienï, abäp.»
english: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Ŋääthu Jwøk.
english: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ŋato wäro cäänni jï kïti, ni ‹Tïŋ riï ni leeŋï riï yi naama dwøŋ›, ni cwïnye bäŋ ataa, 'ba ojïëy ni ŋäädhe ni gïna caane thura kare, di tïïö jïre.
english: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a caana gø jïïu, ni gïn wäro pëënynyu ki lam wär ŋääthu ni gïnögø cøøa jïïu. 'Ba oci jïïu.
english: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wäro cuŋŋu nou lämö, ni näk da gïn mo ena cwïnynyu ki ŋat mør, wär weyu, kiper nee Wääu thuwø ni en maal nee mou na dhallu wiie.»
english: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ki bääge ni cäŋge ö yi Jerucalem. 'Ba kanya cäädhe yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, kwääc laam, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ki jaae aö baŋe.
english: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, na «?A teega ŋø ni wø tïïyï gïïögøøni ki gø? ?Na aŋa na wëëk ïïni teegøgø ki man tïïyï ge?»
english: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, no «U pëënynya pëënynyö ki pïëc aciel. 'Ba noo løgu gø jïra, teek man wø tïïa gïïögø ki gø ocaana jïïu.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

anywaa: A pëënynya uuni, ?lwøk mana löö Jøønni ki gø na nyuudhi, käla maal na bëëde, wala käla baŋ jiy? Løgu jïra.»
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

anywaa: Ni jït yïthakicge keerge ki pïëm, ni «Noo caanø gø, ni ‹Käla maal›, eni köö, na ‹?Aŋø nø, na ba jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni?›
english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

anywaa: ?'Ba olønye jïïø nidïï ki man kööø, ni ‹Käla baŋ jiy›?» Kiper ge lwäär ki jiy, kiper mana bëët jiyi bëët ni geno jïëy ni Jøøn a nyikuŋ Jwøk mana na adïëri.
english: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aløkge jï Jecu, ni «Kucwa.» Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Aani thuwø, teek man wø tïïa gïïögø ki gø, ba caana jïïu.»
english: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu atägö ki man cään geni ki luup mo keda leer, ni kööe, ni «Da dhaanhø mør mo opïïdhö ki pwöth omøki, ni ciel gø ki ciel, ni tïïe ki kany bii nyïïomøki yie, ni gëëde ki øt koor, ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø puur, ni aa paac mør.
english: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya päŋ dwäde mo kac, eni laŋŋe ajääŋ baŋ jø puur moøgø, nee käde baŋge ki nyïïjer pwöthögø.
english: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋøgø amakge ni pwötge gø, ni wëëkge gø døø ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

anywaa: Ni ö wää pwöthögø ni cäŋ jääk baŋge ki laŋŋø mør, ni moocge wï gø ki ŋwellø, ni päätge gø.
english: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ mørø jääŋŋö, ni 'näkge gø. Ni tïïcge laaŋe møøk mo thööth na enøgønø, ni møøk pwötge pwödö, ni 'näkge møøk.
english: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

anywaa: «'Ba eni poot da wääde ma aciel, ŋata mëëre ki gø. Køøre cään, wääde manøgø ajääŋ baŋge, ni kööe, ni ‹Wääda wøørge wøørø.›
english: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

anywaa: «'Ba jø puur gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni ‹Man beeye lwiidhø. Beerra man nääø gø, nee pwödhö tïme na marø.›
english: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.

anywaa: Ni makge gø ni 'näkge gø, ni leeŋge gø wøk ŋää pwödhö.
english: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

anywaa: «?'Ba agïnaŋø nø noo tïïc wää pwöthögø? Eni öö ni 'näk jø puur moøgø, ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø møøk.
english: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïn käru kwaanø yi wëël Jwøk? na köö, «ni ‹Kïdi mana kwier dïgëëte, atïmö na kïn gøøt mana pere letha eni na mak øtø.
english: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:

anywaa: Ni gïnögø tïïya Wuuö Jwøki, ni beeye gïn mo rëëma ec ki nyeŋŋø.› »
english: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?

anywaa: Ni tïm dïbwöthe mo jø Juuth ni ge manynya man makge Jecu, 'ba ge lwäär ki lwaak. Kiper ajootge ni tier leeya caane geela geni. Køøre ena wecge ni aacge kaace.
english: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.

anywaa: Køøre dïbwöthe mo jø Juuth, jø Paricith møøk ki jic Eerat møøk ajääŋge baŋ Jecu, kiper nee eni bïthge ki luupe.
english: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.

anywaa: Ni öge ni köge jïgø, «Dïpööy, ŋäcwa ni ïïna dhaanhø miï caana adïëri, ni jiy raŋï ka waŋ aciel, ni bäŋ kwör jiy mo døøŋŋø mo ŋäyï. 'Ba ï pöö ka jöör Jwøk na adïëri. ?Beeye gïn mo beer ki man cïpö ka ajwäk jï Cidhar,  wala ba beer?
english: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?

anywaa: ?Wa doo cïpö, wala kärwa cïpö?» 'Ba na joot atatge, ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋø ni päänynyu aani en? Kännu jïra ki gwelø, nee neena.»
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.

anywaa: Ni känge ka aciel. Ni kööe jïge, ni «?Man a kïdö mar ŋa ni nyeŋŋe oput göör tiere en?» Ni köge jïgø, ni «Beeye Cidhar.»
english: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Dwøgu japa näk jap Cidhar baŋ Cidhar, ni dwøgu japa näk jap Jwøk baŋ Jwøk.» Ni rëëm yïthge ki gø.
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Cajucith ni wø köö ni bäŋ duun wøk ki yi thøø, møøk aö baŋ Jecu, ni pëënyge eni ni köge,
english: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

anywaa: ni «Dïpööy, Modhe waana göönne ki ciik, ni ‹Ni näk mo dhaanhø coki othøw, ni dööŋ cïïe wøk, 'ba jïre bäŋ nyilaal, ŋatøgø cïmädhi dee lwørø, ni dee wï coki nywølø.›
english: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba da jak ma nyïïmëëe abïriiø. Mana dwøŋ anyöömmö ki dhaagø, ni thøøe ni bäŋ nyilaal mo ee nywølø.
english: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.

anywaa: Ni ö nyena käl køøre, ni lwør dhaaŋŋøgø, ni thøøe, ni bäŋ obwöre mo ee nywølø. Ni ö dääge ni poode na enøgønø thuwø,
english: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.

anywaa: këël mana ö geni karge bïriedi ni thøwge, ni bäŋ nyilaal mo ege nywølø. 'Ba na tïme na køøre cään, dhaagø aläw thøø thuwø.
english: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.

anywaa: ?'Ba kanyo duu jiyi wøk ki yi thøø nø, dhaagø manøgø otïme ni ena cï ŋa? Kiper ena bëëdö na dhaagø jï jagøgø karge bïriet.»
english: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, patha gïn en na wëëk u rwäänyö ki jöö, kiper mana kuyu weet Jwøk, ki teek Jwøk bëët?
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?

anywaa: Kiper kanyo duu jiyi wøk ki yi thøø, røkge ba nywømge, ni bäŋ nyïïge mo wëëk nywöm. 'Ba ge tïmö ni ge caala nyïïatwiet maal.
english: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba nee kiper tïŋ jiy maal ki yi thøø, ?käru kwaanø yi wëël Modhe kanya no ocaanø kiper abuŋŋö, kanya kö Jwøki jïgø, ni ‹Aana Jwø Eeberam ni näga Jwø Aydhak, ni näga Jwø Jeekap›?
