english: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?

anywaa: Eni paa Jwø jøøa näk othøw, 'ba ena Jwø jøøa kwøw. Uuna bääyö kiree.»
english: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.

anywaa: 'Ba dïpööy aciel mar ciik Jwøk aöö, ni wïny döötge ni ge pïëmö yïthakicge keerge. 'Ba na joot Jecu ni luup ee løø jïge na karge, Jecu apëënynye, na «?A ciik mane na pere letha eni dï moa cem bëët?»
english: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «Ciik mana pere letha eni beeye en, ‹Wui, u na jø Icriel, wïnynyu! Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøø bee eni keere na Jwøk.
english: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:

anywaa: Niï doo mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï ki cwïnyï bäre, ki jwïëyï bäre, ka acaayï bäre, ki teegï bäre.›
english: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.

anywaa: Ni rietge beeye en, ni ‹Ï doo mëër ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï.› Bäŋ ciik mørø këët mo kaala ciik moï.»
english: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.

anywaa: Ni kö ŋatøgø jïgø, ni «Kare møn, dïpööy. Acaanï na adïëri ni Wuuö Jwøk beeye eni keere, ni bäŋ mør, 'ba beeye eni.
english: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:

anywaa: Ki man mëërö ki eni ki cwïny bäre, ka acaara bäre, ki teek bäre, ni mëërö ki dhaanhø mør keda man wø mëër dhaanhe ki dëëre, letha pere døc ki man cïp olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre ki teeŋ olämme møga.»
english: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na joot gøøni ni luubö ee dwøgø na kare, ena köö jïgø, ni «Karï ba bäär ki buc Jwøk.» 'Ba køør manøgø, bäŋ ŋat mo cwïnye ee maar mak ki man cäŋ gø pëënynyö ki pïëc.
english: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pöö Jecu yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ena köö, ni «?Dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk kany wø köge, ni ‹Krictø beeye O Deebit,› tiere aŋø?
english: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?

anywaa: Kiper Deebit ki dëëre ena cäänö ki køør mana nyooth Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere, ni kööe, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Kwääya, ni «Pï bäät cwïïa, këël mano cïba nyïïmännï tietï.» ›
english: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

anywaa: Eni, ena cwøl Deebiti ki dëëre ni Kwäärö. ?Ena dee cäŋ tïmö na wääde nidïï nø?» Ni ö lwaaøgø ni päl enø ni wïnyge dwøre ni mïn yïthge.
english: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na pööe, ena köö, ni «Gwøgu røgu ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, jø wø yïthge met ki käär abïïe mo mïërö, ni wø many määth kwör gath,
english: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,

anywaa: ni wø yïthge met ki bëëtö kwör bëëte moa beyø geni yïth uut acook lam, ki kwör ajieme kwör caammi,
english: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:

anywaa: jø wø cam uut määr thuunhnhi, ni wø lämö ki lam mo bäär ni nyootha rege. 'Ba geno jïti ka ajäla mo dwøŋŋa eni.»
english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu ena pï piny nyïm gïn wø cïp muuce yie, ni neeta lwaaøgø kanya kïthge muuce yi gø. Ni ö jiyi mo thööth mo okwär ni kïthge yi gø ki gwel mo thööth.
english: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaage ma cï thøø ni kïth yi gø ki mïlïïne ariiø, ni beege thäŋ gwel.
english: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu bääge acwöl baŋe, ni kööe jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni nyijøøgø ni can na cï thøø enø, acïpö ki gwel mo kaala mo jøøgø bëët na cïpö yi gïn wø cïp muuce yie.
english: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:

anywaa: Kiper geni bëët, ge lwöta ri moa thööth na en jïge. 'Ba nyijøøgø, këël na cane, moa en jïre bëët akïth yi gø, ni beege japa dee bëënnö bëët.»
english: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu kanya aae ni eni cøøa wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, bääŋe aciel aköö ki eni, «Dïpööy, neenï, a teeŋ kïta ŋø ni beyø yøø, ki uutögø ni beyø yøø!»
english: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «?Uutögø ni døøŋŋø yøø, ajootï? Otïmö ni bäŋ kïdi aciel kany mo dööŋ bäät watge ni ba leeŋ piny.»
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na pï piny bäät Kïn Ølip na dïët ki nyïm Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ena pëëny Piterri, ki Jeemeth, ki Jøøn, ki Andaru kur keerge,
english: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,

anywaa: ni «?Caanï jïwa, a yi wäne noo täk gïïögø, na agïnaŋø noo näk ŋïï, kanyo ö gïïögø bëët noo täkge?»
english: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni täge ki man cään ge, ni kööe, ni «Gwøgu rou, nee bäŋe ŋat mo maaŋ wïthu.
english: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:

anywaa: Jiy mo thööth oööi ki nyeŋŋa, ni köge, ni ‹Beeye aani na eni.› Ni ö geni ni maaŋge wïth jiy mo thööth.
english: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wïnynyu mänye ki waac mänye, kär nou bwøk. Kiper gïïögø kwøŋa tägö, 'ba cuŋŋe poodi.
english: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.

anywaa: Kiper paac mør dëëre othïïŋe ri paac mør, ni ö nyeya mørri ni thïïŋ ree ri nyeya mør. Ni tïm kwör mo thööthi ni jäŋŋi, ni jït pinynyi ki meel. Ni gïïögøøni beege nyäät gïï mo leth moo tägi.
english: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

anywaa: «'Ba gwøgu rou, kiper uuno kïthge kwör løøe, ni pöötge uuni yïth uut acook lam. Ni cuŋŋu nyïm kwääri ki nyeye kiper nyeŋŋa, nou køpa gïra nyïmge.
english: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma nyään na met okwøŋ køp yïth mïëri bëët.
english: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo makge uuni ni kïthge uuni kar løøk, kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper gïno caannu. 'Ba wäru caannu gïno wëëk u kanyøca, kiper paa uuni noo cäänö, 'ba beeye Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba cöögö coki okïth yi thøø; ni ö wuue ni kïth nyaare. 'Ba obwöre rege othïïŋge ri jøøa nywøl ge, ni kïthge ge yi thøø.
english: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni mänge ki uuni kiper nyeŋŋa. 'Ba ŋato jïëny gïïögø këël aŋuunne, opiem.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

anywaa: «'Ba gïna näk ec raac ki gø døc na näk gïr ränynyö ojootu noo cïp kanya näk mo ba doo maara kïth yie.» Beerra man ö ŋato kwaan luubö man ni ŋäc tier gø! «Kanyøca nø, jø wø en Judia wär bwøkge bäät kïte.
english: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:

anywaa: Ni ŋato en wï øtø, kär nee duua piny, ni døny øde kuna käde ki gïrpiny.
english: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:

anywaa: Ni ö ŋato en yi pwödhö ni ba duu paac kuna lwør abïïne.
english: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth døc jï määro yïthge da jiy, ki määro dhwödhö yïth nïröke.
english: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

anywaa: Lämu kiper nee ba täge ka arïïa.
english: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø, piny ojïti ki teeŋ gïï mo leth mo kär kwøŋ öö këël kanya cak piny mana cwääc Jwøki, gøøc kawaane, ni bäŋgø mo cäŋ tägö këët na bäre bäre.
english: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.

anywaa: 'Ba onää Wuuö nïrögø käre døøc mo nøk, doo bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo piemø. 'Ba nïrögø adøøc mo nøk kiper jøøa miek na näk ee jierø.
english: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøca ni näk da ŋat mo köö ki uuni, ni ‹Neennu, Krictø en›, wala ‹Neennu, eni ice›, kär nou jïëy ki gø.
english: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:

anywaa: Kiper Kricte mo patha adïëri ki nyïïkuk Jwøk mo patha adïëri, rege othïïŋge ni tïïge ki ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec ni maaŋge wïth jøøa näk ojierø ni näk mo løny jïge.
english: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, gwøgu rou. A caana gïï jïïu kany pootge ni poot kär tägö en.
english: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.

anywaa: «'Ba ki yïth nïrögøøni noo näk køør gïïo leth yøø, « ‹cäŋ oput tïïc ni cøl, ni ö dwääyi ni ba cïp taye,›
english: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,

anywaa: ‹ni päänh ceerri ki maal,› ni ö gïïa näk jïge da teek maal ni jäŋi.
english: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nø, Wär Dhaanhø ojoot jiyi ni öö ki yïth pøøl ki teek mo dwøŋ ka ajiem.
english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, nyïïatwiet maal ojääŋŋe, ni cooŋ jiye moa näk ee jierø ni käle ka wïth tuk piny karge ŋweeni, ni ge cuuŋe ka yi piny bäre këël yi maalø bäre.
english: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.

anywaa: «Ennø, kwänynyu ki pwöc dëër olaam. Kany wø tïm bääte ni løth ni jïte ki bøøge, wø ŋäyu ŋääö ni dhikøth kare acäännö.
english: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, kanyo neennu gïïögø ni tägö, oŋäyu ni ööny Wär Dhaanhø kare acäännö, ni ena dhi kiir kiree.
english: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni beenhnhø man ba doo pöödhö, ni gïïögø bëët poot kär cööp karge.
english: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.

anywaa: Maal ki piny opöödhi, 'ba luupa ba dak.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

anywaa: «'Ba dïcäŋöca wala caannøca, bäŋ ŋat ŋäc gø, këël nyïïatwiet maal wala Wäädö. 'Ba beeye Wuuö keere.
english: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou, ni kuru. Kiper kanyo ööe yie kuyu.
english: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

anywaa: Gïnögø caala dhaanhø mo manynya wääth. Kanyo tïŋŋe paac, jammi bëët cïbe ceŋ laage, ni ŋati man nø ki tïïe. Ni kööm ŋat wø koor dhi kiir, ni bëëde ni kurö.
english: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kuru. Kiper kanyo ö wää paaci yie kuyu, nee abøøya, wala dï wäär, wala kany wø köök gwiene, wala amöölla.
english: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

anywaa: Kiper kanymør eni laara ö bäätu ni nwän uuni ni uuno butö.
english: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn caana jïïu en, a cäänna jiy bëët, ni ‹Kuru.› »
english: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø oløny ni dööŋŋa nïne ariiø kiper cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ka ajwöm-cam mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø. 'Ba kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ge caya jöö man makge Jecu ki gø mëëth ki piny, nee 'näkge.
english: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, ni «Paa kanyo poot jiyi kar ajwöm-cam, kiper nee bäŋe dïŋaŋ mo tägi dï jiy.»
english: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en Jecu yi Bethani po Cayman, ŋata kwøŋ bëëtö ni dëëre da dhøøbø, ni eni ena kar cam, dhaagø mør aö baŋe ni käädö ki riia mo ena yi wïlli mo ŋeew ka gwel mo thööth døc. Ni ö dhaaŋŋøgø ni jap dhi gø, ni køny gø wï gø.
english: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk mo ena kaace gena cäänö yïthakicge ni geno gootø, ni köge, na «?Aŋø na raany maari jaak en?
english: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?

anywaa: Kiper maarøgøøni doo dwøga pwödhö ki gwel mo kaala dïpe adäk ni mëëk gwete jøøa can.» Ni jookge dhaaŋŋøgø døc ni geno gootø.
english: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Weyu dhaaŋŋøgø. ?Aperŋø ni ööllu gø en? Kiper ena tïïö ki gïn mo beer døc jïra.
english: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa can wø ena dïïu cooth, ni løny jïïu ki man tïïyu gïï mo beyø jïge kanyo wäro manynyu gø. 'Ba aani, a ba en dïïu cooth.
english: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.

anywaa: Eni, gïna näk løny jïre ki man tïïc gø, atïïe. Eni kwøŋa dëëra wïïr kiper kanyo koony aani.
english: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, kanyo wäro køp luumma nyään na met yie bäät piny bäre, gïna tïïc dhaagø manøgø enø, wø wäro caan ni parra wïc ki eni.»
english: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Juudac Ickarïët, na näk dhaanhø aciel ki røk jøøa näk apaar kurriiø, aci baŋ kwääc laam nee Jecu cïp ceŋge.
english: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge gø, yïthge amïnnö, ni buukge jammi moo mëëkge eni. Ni ö eni ni put määnyö ki jöö man cïp Jecu ki gø.
english: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa täk ajwöm-cam mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø, ni beeye kany wø 'näkge nyidier Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, bääk Jecu aköö jïgø, na «?A kaa noo wëëgï wa ciin yie nee jiiŋwa jïrï, kiper niï cämï yie ki cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie?»
english: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?

anywaa: Ni jääŋ bääge ariiø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou pääny. 'Ba ŋat mo tïëdö ki pïï ki dak orøømmi ki uuni. Wäru läpu køøre.
english: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo døny yie, wäru kööu jï wää paaci, ni ‹Dïpööy aköö, ni «Øt wëël mara en kaa, mano cäma yie ki cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ki bääga?» ›
english: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

anywaa: 'Ba uuno nyuunhnhe ki yi øtø mo laac maal bäät pööki, mo onø peeth. Kanyøce nø, wär jiiŋŋu kiperø.»
english: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.

anywaa: Ni ö bäägögø ni tïŋge ni cige pääny, ni jootge gø keda mana caan gø jïge. Ni jiiŋge cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na wäär, Jecu aöö ki bääge na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enge kar cam ni ge cämö, Jecu aköö, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni dhaanhø aciel dïïu aano cïp ceŋ nyïïmän, ŋat mo wa cämö ki gø ennø.»
english: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.

anywaa: Ni bwøk cwïnyge, ni täkge ki man pëënyge eni no oceele oceele, na «?Aŋø, beeye aani?»
english: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Beeye dhaanhø aciel dïïu, u na apaar kurriiø, ŋat cweny møø ya athäänh ki aani na aciel en.
english: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø aay keda mana gööri kipere. 'Ba otïmö ni raac døc jï ŋato cïp Wär Dhaanhø ceŋ nyïïmän. Doo beerra eni kiper ŋatøce ki mana ba dii nywølø.»
english: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge cämö, Jecu alwötö ki møø, ni gwïëth gø, ni pøt gø, ni mëëk gø geni, ni kööe, «Lwørru. Man beeye dëëra.»
english: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.

anywaa: Ni lwöte ka athöödhi. 'Ba na nø dwøk met ec, amëëk geni, ni mäthge dëër gø bëët.
english: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Man beeye remma mar luumma tuut ki jiy, ni køny piny kiper jiy mo thööth.
english: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, naa ba mäthi ki pï nyïïomøki këët, këël kanyo cäŋa gø maathø yie ni nyään yi buc Jwøk.»
english: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø lønyge ki wär duut Jwøk, gena aa wøk ni cige bäät Kïn Ølip.
english: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Uuni bëët a weyu wiiø. Kiper ogöörö, ni ‹Aani dïkwääy dïëk ogøøa, ni ö dïëki ni keethge.›
english: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïŋ a maal, a cøøa nyïmmu yi Galili.»
english: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö jïgø, ni «Këël bääŋi bëët ï dege wiiø, ba doo løny jïra.»
english: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, ni dïcäŋi, yi wäär man, ni gwienø poot kär köök kwöre ariiø, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani ki kwöre adäk naa kuyï.»
english: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aŋwöyö døc, ni «Këël maa thøw ki ïïni na aciel, ï bäŋ daa mooŋø.» Ni ö geni bëët ni cäänge na enøgønø.
english: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu ki bääge gena ci kany mo cwøl ni Gecemeni. Ni kööe jï bääge, ni «Pïïu piny kany, kanyo pooda naa lämö.»
english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.

anywaa: Ni lwør Piter ki Jeemeth ki Jøøn, ni aae ki geni, ni tïm cwïnye no opädhö døc, ni eni kïmmö.
english: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cwïnya peek døc naa manynya thøø. Dööŋŋu kany ni kuru.»
english: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

anywaa: 'Ba na ci nyïm mëëth ree aleeŋ piny ni läme, ni nee løny ki man bødhe ki kanya wäŋŋi.
english: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

anywaa: Ni kööe, «Abba, Awuuö, jammi bëët lønynya jïrï. Wëëk maath athöödhi man pöödhö bääta. 'Ba paa ki køør mana manynya, 'ba beeye ki køør mana manynyï.»
english: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.

anywaa: Ni duue ni cwän bääge ni geno butö. Ni kööe jï Piter, ni «?Cayman, ïïno butö? ?Ï bäŋ doo maara kurö ki yi caa aciel?
english: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?

anywaa: Kuru ni lämu, kiper nou ba päänynyi. Kiper jwïëy wø jïëy møn, 'ba dëël jääk.»
english: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ aay ni läme, ni nøøya luupa kwøŋ carø.
english: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ duuö ni cwän bääge ni geno butö, kiper nyeŋge atïmö ni peek døc ki niine, ni tïmge ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge mo maarge løk jïre.
english: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu acäŋ duuö ri dääge ni kööe jïge, no «?U poot ni uuno butö en, nou jwöma rou? Manøgø päl nø. Kanya wäŋŋi aöö. Wär Dhaanhø cïba ceŋ jø raay ennø.
english: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

anywaa: Ööu maal nøø aa nø. Neennu, ŋato cïp aani ceŋ nyïïmänna aløny ni öö.»
english: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Jecu ni cäänö, Juudac na en røk jøøa näk apaar kurriiø aöö, ni køøre da lwaak mo käädö ko opëëlle ka athøre, ni ge käla baŋ kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jaae.
english: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac, ŋata cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmänne, ocïpö jïge ki ŋïï, ni kööe, ni «Ŋato dhee nuuma beeye ŋatøca; wär magu ni källu gø ni you koorø døc.»
english: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïe, ena put ci baŋ Jecu, ni kööe, «Dïpööy.» Ni nuum dhi gø.
english: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni gäämge Jecu ni makge gø.
english: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dï bääk Jecu mo cuŋŋö kaace, opëëlle awöth wøk, ni gøøc laŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni cëë ïth gø wøk.
english: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø, u ööa baŋa keda man wø ci baŋ ŋat ageem, nou käära opëëlle ka athøre kiper naa magu?
english: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?

anywaa: Aani, cooth a wø bëëdö ka uuni naa pöö yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni käru a maa. 'Ba gïïögø tägi kaper nee weet Jwøk thurge karge.»
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.

anywaa: Ni ö bääŋi bëët ni wecge Jecu ni reŋge.
english: And they all forsook him, and fled.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyen mo poot na wøp mo käära aleeŋŋa keere, mo cäädhö køør Jecu, ni ö eni na magi ya jøøgø.
english: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:

anywaa: 'Ba ena reeŋø ki dëëre, ni ö abïïne ni dööŋe ceŋ jøøgø.
english: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu akïthge nyïm Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Ni kwääc laam bëët, ki jaae, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk dëëtge ege cooŋø.
english: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aläp køør gø ni ree ee jädhö kany mo bäär mëëth, ni døny yi kiir Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. Ni eno pï piny ki dïkuye, ni juŋö ki maac.
english: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, kwääc laam ki kwääc løøe bëët, gena määnyö ki luubö mo kïthge bäät Jecu, kiper nee eni 'näk. 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo ege joodø.
english: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo thööth aöö ni kïthge bääte ki luup tööt jaak. 'Ba luupge atïmö na gwääe.
english: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.

anywaa: Ni ö jø møøki maalø ni kïthge bääte ki luup tööt, ni köge,
english: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,

anywaa: na «Awïnywa ni eni köö, ni ‹Aani, Øt Jwøk man en na tïïc ki ceŋ, onyaa piny ni geera mør ki nïne adäk mo ba tïïc ka ceŋ.› »
english: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na cäänge na enøgønø, luupge poot na gwääe.
english: But neither so did their witness agree together.

anywaa: Køøre Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aput ö maal dïge, ni pëëny Jecu, ni «?Aŋø, bäŋ gïn mo løgï kiper gïïögø ni car jøøgø dëërï enø?»
english: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?

anywaa: 'Ba ena lïŋö ni bäŋ gïn mo ee dwøgø. Ni cäŋi ya Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ pëënynyö, «?Bee ï na Krictø, O Jwø wø pwøc?»
english: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, ni «Beeye aani. 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø oneennu no opï bäät cer cwïï Jwøk na en teeki jïre, ni eni öö ki yïth pøøt maal.»
english: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ abïïe moe ajeeye, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø ni poot manynyø lïŋŋe møøk këët en?
english: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

anywaa: Ajaany mare anø wïnynyu. ?Agïnaŋø ni caarru kipere?» Ni ö geni bëët ni jäälge gø ni mare rømi ka thøø.
english: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.

anywaa: Ni täk jø møøki ki ŋuut bääte ki laaw, ni twöcge nyeŋ gø, ni døøŋge gø, ni ge köö jïgø, «Caan ŋata gøøc ïïni!» Ni käli ya dïkuye ni dhööŋge dhööŋŋö.
english: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter kanya en yi kal, nyakøø aciel mo ena dëët nyïïakuk wø tïny Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ acur buute.
english: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:

anywaa: 'Ba na neen Piter ni jøŋa dëëre ki maac, jïgø aneene, ni kööe, «Ïïni thuwø, ï ena buut Jecu nyï Nadhareth.»
english: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter dëëre amooŋe, ni kööe, «Aani, gïnö ni caanï enøgø tiere kuua; bäŋ gïn mo ŋääa kipere.» Ni aa dhi kal.
english: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ nyakøønnøgø jootø, ni täge ki man cäŋ gø caannø jï jøøa cuŋŋö kaace, ni «Nyeni en, ena dïge.»
english: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.

anywaa: 'Ba ree acäŋ mooŋŋø. 'Ba køøre ki kany mo thiinh, jøøa cuŋŋö kaagø acäŋ köö jï Piter, na «Adïëri møn ï ena dïge, kiper ïïna nyï Galili.»
english: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter atägö ki man cwöl acïëni bääte, ni kööŋe, ni «Ŋatø ni cäänu kipere enø kuua.»
english: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.

anywaa: Ni put gwienø nwöyö ki köö. Ni ö Piterri ni put wïïe par ki gïna caan Jecu jïre, ni «Dïwääni ni gwienø poot kär köök kwöre ariiø, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani ki kwöre adäk naa kuyï.» Ni päth cwïnye døc ni jwöŋe.
english: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, kwääc laam, ki jaae, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ki kwääc løøe bëët, gena cïp piny ki luubö. Ni twöcge Jecu ni bwøthge gø wøk, ni kïthge gø baŋ Paylat.
english: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena pëëny Paylati, ni «?Bee ïïni na nyeny jø Juuth?» Ni løk gø jïre, na «Acaanï na kare.»
english: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääc laammi ni kïthge bääte ki luup mo thööth.
english: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ Paylati pëënynyö, na «?Aŋø, bäŋ gïn løgï? Neen gïïö ni thööth ni kïthge bäätï yøø.»
english: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu bäŋ gïn mo ee løø këët. Kanyøgø nø, Paylat yie athäŋŋö.
english: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø tïme cooth ni ra ajwömcam mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, Paylat wø pätö jïge ki dhaanhø røk jø wø en øt twöc, ŋat wø pëënyge jaak.
english: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.

anywaa: 'Ba ki røk jø ageem moa en øt twöc, da nyen mo cwøl ni Baraba, ŋat mo onääö ki jiy ra ageem.
english: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaak aöö ni pëënyge Paylat ki man tïïc gïn wø tïïe wø bëëde jïge.
english: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.

anywaa: Ni pëëny geni, no «?U manynya aani man päda nyeny jø Juuth jïïu?»
english: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

anywaa: Kiper ajoode ni kwääc laam marge keec na kälge gø.
english: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam, yi lwaak acoonge nee tïme ni Paylat päta Baraba jïge na kar Jecu.
english: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cäŋ Paylati pëënynyö, na «?Agïnaŋø nø, noo tïïa ki ŋat cwøllu en ni nyeny jø Juuth?»
english: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?

anywaa: Ni cäŋge rëëdö, ni «Gurï bäät jaadha no odëëdö!»
english: And they cried out again, Crucify him.

anywaa: Ni kö Paylati jïge, na «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na raac ni ee tïïö?» 'Ba kaagø nø, gena put rëëdö døc ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ, ni «Gurï bäät jaadha no odëëdö!»
english: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat na many man mïn yi lwaaki, Baraba apän geni, ni wëëk Jecu pwöt ka alaŋŋa, ni cïp gø nee gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tøŋŋi ni bwøthge Jecu yi øtø kany wø bëët jø tøŋŋi yie. Ni cwølge jø tøŋ bëët kanya ciel.
english: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

anywaa: Ni kïthge dëër gø ka abïï ma dïmuur, ni tïïge ka adun koodhi, ni kïthge gø wïïe.
english: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,

anywaa: Ni täkge ki man määthge gø, ni «Dëël jööt nø, nyeny jø Juuth!»
english: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

anywaa: Ni pöötge wï gø ko otöök, ni ŋuutge bäät gø ki laaw, ni këëlge cøŋge piny, keda ge wøøra gø.
english: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø buuge gø, abïïna näk dïmuur akälge wøk dëër gø, ni dwøkge abïïge dëëre. Ni bwøthge gø wøk kuna guri bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, da ŋat mør ma nyï Cayriin mo cäädha jöö mo ööi ka dï paac, mo nyeŋŋe Cayman, na näk wää Alekdhander ki Rupa. Ena mak dïkuye kiper nee jaadha no odëëdö mar Jecu kääre.
english: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.

anywaa: Ni kïthge Jecu kany mo cwøl na Gølgøtha na näk tiere beeye ni Kar Cuu Wïc.
english: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

anywaa: Ni moocge gø ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo orwöbö ki gïn mo keec. 'Ba käre jïëö.
english: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

anywaa: Ni gurge gø bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni pääŋge abïïge yïthakicge, ki køør ŋïïce mo wø tïïc ki ri kwääk ki baw, kiper nee mano käl ŋati man nø joot.
english: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøca beeye kar caae abïŋween ka amöölla na gurge Jecu bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma kïthge bääte, ogöörö, ni «Nyeny jø Juuth.»
english: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø ageem ariiø ma agurge buute thuwø, na aciel ena bäät cwïïe, ni maya ena bäät caame.
english: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø pöödhi ki kaace wïthge wø kenyge kenyø, ni marge abuua, ni köge, «Ï na doo nyak Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni cäŋi gø geerrø ki nïne adäk,
english: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

anywaa: køny riï nø, ni ööï piny ki bäät jaadha no odëëdö.»
english: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

anywaa: 'Ba ena buu kwääc laammi thuwø, ni ge cäänö yïthakicge ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ni ge köö, ni «Eni wø kønya jø møøk, ba dëëre ba maar køny.
english: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.

anywaa: Wär eni na Krictø na näk nyeny jø Icriel ö piny ennø ki bäät jaadha no odëëdö, nee neenø ni jïëø.» 'Ba jøøa näk ogurö ki eni, ena buuge thuwø.
english: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na caae apaar kurriiø ki dïcäŋ, piny atïmö na muudhö bäre këël caae adäk ka abøøya.
english: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na caae adäk, Jecu aköök ki dwøl mo päl, ni «?Elöi, Elöi, lama cabakthani?» na näk tiere beeye, ni «?Jwøa, Jwøa, aŋø ni weyï aani en?»
english: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk røk jøøa cuŋŋö kaace, na wïnyge gøøni, gena köö, ni «Neennu, eni cwøla Ilaaja.»
english: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaanhe acielli ni reeŋe, ni cøt lïïpa yi køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wac, ni coom gø wï otöök, ni rwaak gø baŋ gø nee maadhe, ni kööe, ni «Weyu nee neenø nee Ilaaja ööa kuna käl gø piny.»
english: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköök døc, ni jwïëe ka aŋuudi.
english: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nø, abïïna näk ogëëŋö mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ aput jeeø ki dïëre, ni tägi ka maal ni këët piny.
english: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa mo cuŋŋö ni dïët ki eni, na joot gø, ni ena jwïëy ka aŋuudi na enøgønø, ena köö, na «Adïëri møn, ŋati en beeye O Jwøk.»
english: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace thuwø da mään mo nëënö ka kany mo bäär, ni Meeri Magdalin, ki nyaan ma Calöme, ki Meeri mii Jeemeth mana thiinh ki Jöce, ena dïge,
english: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

anywaa: ni beege määr wø cäädhi køør Jecu kanya en yi Galili, ni tïnynya eni. 'Ba da mään møøk thuwø mo thööth mo oöö yi Jerucalem ki eni na aciel.
english: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm pinynyi na abøøya, kiper mana tïme ni beeye cäŋ jiiŋ røk ni jøw bunna cäŋ jwömö,
english: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,

anywaa: Jocep nyï Arimathia, ŋata ŋäc ni bëëtö mare beer ki røk kwääc løøe, mo bëëdö ni køya buc Jwøk ki dëëre, cwïnye amaae ni ci baŋ Paylat, ni kwac dëër Jecu.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat yie arëëm ki man näk mo Jecu onø thøø. 'Ba na cwøl kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa, apëënynye ki man näk mo Jecu onø thøø.
english: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gø baŋ kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa ni eno nø thøø, dëër gø awëëk Jocep.
english: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni ŋëëe ka abïïn koony, ni käl dëër Jecu piny, ni bøøny gø ka abïïnögø, ni pïël gø yi bwöya näk mare, e na Jocep, na näk onø løøt yi kïdi. Ni ŋïël kïdi mør dhi bwöyögø.
english: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri Magdalin ki Meeri mii Jöce kanya kani yie aneenge.
english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

anywaa: 'Ba na thum cäŋ jwömö, Meeri Magdalin, ki Calöme, ki Meeri mii Jeemeth, gena ŋëëö ki mäth wïïr, kiper nee ge cige nee dëër Jecu wïïrge ki gø.
english: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm pinynyi na amöölla cøøn ki täk tïïc, gena møøl bäät bwörö kanya tuul cäŋŋi.
english: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.

anywaa: Ni ge cäänö keerge, na «?Aŋa noo ŋïël kïdi wøk tïn dhi bwörö kiperø?»
english: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

anywaa: 'Ba na lwïthge, kïdi ajootge no onø ŋïël ŋääe, këël na bëëde na kïdi mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.

anywaa: 'Ba na dønyge yi bwörö, nyen mo poot na wøp ajootge no opï piny kur cwïïc, no oruyö ka abïï mo tar mo ŋwaŋŋi døc. Ni lwäcge døc.
english: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Käru lwäyö. Ŋääa, nou manynya Jecu nyï Nadhareth, ŋata gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö. Ena tïŋ maal. Eni tøør kany. Neennu kanya pïëlge gø yie.
english: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

anywaa: 'Ba cou ni caannu gø jï bääge ki Piter, ni eni cøøa nyïmmu yi Galili. Eno jootu kaace, keda mana caan gø jïïu.»
english: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.

anywaa: Ni öge wøk ki yi bwörö ni reŋge, kiper dëëtge atïmö ni kwanynyi, ni wïthge rege noodø. 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo ege caanø jï dhaanhø mør, kiper mana tïmge ni ge lwäär.
english: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa ö Jecu maal ka amöölla cøøn ki täk tïïc, dëëre akwøŋ nyuth Meeri Magdalin, ŋata riem anäga näk abïriiø wøk dëër gø.
english: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

anywaa: Ni ö Meeri ni cøøe ni køp gø jï jøøa bëëdö ki eni, kanya bëëtge ni ge kïmmö ni ge jwöŋö.
english: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge gø ni Jecu ocäŋ kwøwø, ni eno nø joot Meeri, ge kär jïëy ki mare.
english: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø, Jecu dëëre acäŋ nyoothø ki kïdö mør jï jiy ariiø dëët bääge, mo cäädhö dï paac.
english: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø ni døøge baŋ bääge møga ni køpge gø jïge. 'Ba marge kärge jïëö.
english: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.

anywaa: 'Ba na näk ŋääe cään, Jecu dëëre acäŋ nyuth bääge na näk apaar kurciel ki dëëtge, ni ge ena kar cam, ni cään geni kiper mana teek cwïnyge ni kärge jïëy. Kiper luumma caan jøøa neen gø køør mana ö maal kärge jïëö.
english: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni caathu dï piny bäre, ni køpu luumma nyään na met jï jiy bëët.
english: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro jïëy ni ŋäädhe ni lwøi na nyuudhi, opiem. 'Ba ŋato wäro ba jïëy ni ŋäädhe, ojääl.
english: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋïïce moi ocäädhi ki jø wø jïëy ni ŋääthge. Anäge oriemge wøk ki nyeŋŋa, ni cäänge ki dhøgi mo nyärö,
english: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;

anywaa: ni kwaanyge thwöre. 'Ba ni näk da gïr thøø mo maathge, bäŋ gïn mo tïïe dëëtge. Ni kïthge ceŋge bäät jø täwe, ni jöön dëëtge.»
english: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, na ö Kwäärö ma Jecu na nø cääne ki bääge, ena kïth maal, ni pï bäät cwïï Jwøk.
english: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.

anywaa: Ni aacge ni køpge luumma nyään na met yïth mïëri bëët, ni Wuuö tïïö ka geni, ni nyootha gø ni luummögø ni wø køpge beeye adïëri ki køør ŋïïce mo wø cäädhi ki gø na aciel. Enøgønø.]
english: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.

anywaa: Kawaane jiy mo thööth anø tägö ki man göörge gïïa tïïc Jwøki na nø thur karge dïwa,
english: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

anywaa: ni göörge ka køør luup moa wïnyge baŋ jøøa neen gïïögø ki nyeŋge na nut dïkwøŋ kanya täk gïïögø, na køpge gø.
english: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;

anywaa: 'Ba ï na nyigwaak ma Thïëpöla, yaa caarø, ni doo beer jïra thuwø ki man gööda ki wëëlö jïrï ki køør mana bëëda naa neeta tiet gïïögø døøc ki kanya täkge yie, ni gööra ni yaa cïïmmö,
english: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,

anywaa: nee adïëri mar gïïa pwöny ïïni ki ge nee ŋäyï.
english: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïr Eerat na bëëdö na nyeny Judia, kaaca da dïlämi mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Dhekaraya, na käl dhi øt Abaaja.  Eni jïre da dhaagø mo käla dëët jø dhi øt Aran, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Ilidhabeth.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.

anywaa: 'Ba gena jiy mo beyø nyïm Jwøk karge riet, ni ge caatha køør moa näk ocem Wuue ki ciik moe bëët, ni bäŋ gïn mo ege baaø rege.
english: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.

anywaa: 'Ba jïge bäŋ nyilaal, kiper Ilidhabeth bwøc, ni geno nø jalø karge riet.
english: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm tïïci ni ena ceŋ dïlämme mo dhi øtø mana käl Dhekaraya yie, ni Dhekaraya tïïö na dïlämi nyïm Jwøk,
english: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,

anywaa: døny Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ mar Wuuö ki nyep gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, apäth cere, keda man wø tïïc dïlämme.
english: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaa dhaanhø bäre lämö wøk yi kar caanna nyep gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met.
english: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö dëëre anyoodhe jï Dhekaraya ni cuŋŋa bäät cwïïc kar gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte.
english: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Dhekaraya na neen gø, ena bwøk ni jït cwïnye ki lwär.
english: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal manøgø aköö jïgø, ni «Kärï lwäyö, Dhekaraya, kiper lam marï awïnynyi. 'Ba cïïï ma Ilidhabeth ojïti ki nyilaal ma cïïŋŋö. 'Ba nyeŋŋe ocwølï ni Jøøn.
english: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.

anywaa: 'Ba yiï omïnni ni kanynyï, ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni mïn yïthge kanyo lwaarø ki gø.
english: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.

anywaa: Kiper eno tïmö na ŋat mo dwøŋ nyïm Wuuö Jwøk, ni eni ba mädhö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki wala køøŋø mo keec. 'Ba eno bëëdö ni päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ki mano täge ni ena yi menni.
english: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wäät Icriel mo thööth oløø baŋ Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk marge.
english: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.

anywaa: 'Ba eno cäädhi nyïm Wuuö Jwøk ki teeŋ bëët Ilaaja ki teek mare, ni løø cwïny wëëe baŋ obwöre moge, ni løø wïth jøøa wïthge teek baŋ acaac jøøa marge beyø, ni tïïc jiy na jiy mo ojiiŋŋø kiper Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Dhekaraya aköö jï nyïïatwiel maal manøgø, ni «?Gïnögø oŋääa gø nidïï? Kiper aana jaal, ni cïïa onø jalø thuwø.»
english: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyïïatwiel maalli jïre, ni «Aana Geebriel, ni wø cuŋŋi nyïm Jwøk; naa jääŋŋi kaper niï cäänna, naa køpa luummi ni met en jïrï.
english: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.

anywaa: 'Ba neenï, ïïno bëëdö niï lïŋö, niï ba maar luupö, gøøc dïcäŋo thur gïïögø karge, kiper na kärï luupa jïëö, luupo thur karge dïcäŋo näk kare.»
english: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy abëëdö ni ge køya Dhekaraya, ni thäŋ yïthge kiper mana ruue Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö wøk, ena tïmö ni ba maar luubö ki geni, ni ŋecge gø ki man näk mo da gïn mo ee neenø baŋ Jwøk yi Øt Jwøk. Ni luube ki ge ki lweete ni put bëëtö ni ba cäänö.
english: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum nïr tïïci mare, ena døø paare.
english: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba køør nïrögø, cïïe ma Ilidhabeth agämmö ki dhaanhø, ni ö eni ni kan dëëre ki dwäde abïïc, ni kööe,
english: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,

anywaa: ni «Wuuö Jwøk gïn atïïe dëëra na enønø, kanya nyooth met ec mare jïra, ni wëënna laac wïc mara dï jiy.»
english: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør dwäde abïciel, nyïïatwiel maal ma Geebriel ajääŋ Jwøki yi pääny Galili na cwøl ni Nadhareth,
english: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

anywaa: baŋ nyakøønna näk omiek dïcwøø mo cwøl na Jocep, na käl dhi øt Deebit. 'Ba nyeŋ nyakøønnøgø cwøl ni Meeri.
english: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.

anywaa: Ni ö Geebriel ni ö baŋ Meeri ni kööe, «Ïïna määth, ï na mëër Jwøki ki gø. Wuuö ena buutï.»
english: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri yie athäŋŋö døc kanya wïny luummögø, ni cääne ki cwïnye, ni man a teeŋ määdhe mo nyïëdi cøøn.
english: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwiel maal aköö jïgø, ni «Kärï lwäyö, Meeri, kiper ïïna jïtö ki mëër baŋ Jwøk.
english: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.

anywaa: 'Ba neenï, yiï ojïti ki dhaanhø ni lwaarï ki gø na cïïŋŋö, 'ba nyeŋŋe ocwølï ni Jecu.
english: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.

anywaa: 'Ba kare otïmö ni dwøŋ, ni cwøli ni O Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal. 'Ba eno wëëk Kwäärö ma Jwøk wäl kwari ma Deebit,
english: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:

anywaa: ni ö jø dhi øt Jeekap ni bëën eni na bäre bäre, ni bëët buye ni bäŋ cuŋŋe.»
english: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri aköö jï nyïïatwiel maal, ni «?Gïnögø otäge nidïï, kiper jïra bäŋ dïcwøø?»
english: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli jïgø, ni «Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere öö bäätï, ni ö teek Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal ni rïëp ïïni. Kiper manøgønø, nyilaaro lwaarø ki gø, ocwøl ni ena kur keere na O Jwøk.
english: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba neenï, wadu ma Ilidhabeth na näk onø jalø ajïtö ki dhaanhø thuwø ma cïïŋŋö. 'Ba man beeye bïcier dwäde jïre, eni na wara cwøl ni bwøc.
english: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo dhäthi jï Jwøk.»
english: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

anywaa: Ni kö Meeri, ni «Kare møn, a ena cer Wuuö Jwøk; beerra man täge dëëra kaawat mana caanï enø.» Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli ni aae buut gø.
english: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø Meeri aö maal, ni aae ni rwäänhnhö, ni cøøa po kïte, pääny mo ena Judia.
english: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;

anywaa: Ni ci po Dhekaraya, ni määth Ilidhabeth.
english: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Ilidhabethi na wïny määdhe mar Meeri, nyilaal apäär maal yi gø. Ni ö Ilidhabethi ni pääŋe ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:

anywaa: Ni put köö ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Bee ï na gwïëth dï mään, ni gwïëth ena dëër nyey ni en yiï enø.
english: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïn owëëk aani nidïï, ki man ö mii Kwääya na dee ö baŋa?
english: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

anywaa: Kiper ennø, kanya wïnynya määdhe marï kiree, nyilaal ni en yia en, aput päär maal ni yie omïnnö.
english: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.

anywaa: Ni meta yi nyaana jïëy, ni mana caan Wuuö jïre doo thura kare.»
english: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Meeri, ni «Aani, jwïëya jiema Wuuö,
english: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

anywaa: ni ö cwïnya ni mïnne ki Jwøk na näk Pïëmi mara.
english: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.

anywaa: Kiper eni canna, a na laŋŋe, aneene. 'Ba kawaane, køør man en nø,	 beenhnhe bëët aano cwølge ni beeye aani na gwïëth.
english: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

anywaa: Kiper eni na teek, gïï mo døøŋŋø atïïe jïra, 'ba eni, nyeŋŋe ena kur keere.
english: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.

anywaa: Ni ö mëërri mare ni wø ba jøøl ni bëëde bäät jø wø lwäär ki eni, ni öö ki ri beenhnhi nø, ni pööth ri beenhnhø maya.
english: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.

anywaa: Eni bade bäär ni teege ee nyoodhø, ni keeth jø wø töödö ki yïth cwïnyge.
english: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

anywaa: Eni jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø wø dwøge piny ki bäät wäle moge, ni røøny jøøa can.
english: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cïp gïï mo beyø jï jøøa näk obup, ni cöör jøøa näk okwär wøk ki ceŋge jaak.
english: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.

anywaa: 'Ba eni jiye ma jø Icriel akønye, ni eni nyootha mëër mare,
english: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;

anywaa: kaawat mana caan gø jï kwäyø, ni beeye Eeberam ki nyïïkwaaye, këël bäre bäre.»
english: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

anywaa: Ni ö Meeri ni bëëde ki Ilidhabeth ki kany mo jïtö ki dwäde adäk, ni døø paare.
english: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø kar lwaar apïï dëër Ilidhabeth, ni lwaare ki nyilaal ma cïïŋŋö.
english: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa en buute ya atut ki tuuŋge ni wïnyge gø ni ena nyuunh Wuue ki køny mo dwøŋ døc, ni mïn yïthge ki eni na aciel.
english: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na bäc nïne, gena ö kuna daŋge nyilaal. Ni ge manynya man cakge nyeŋ gø ni Dhekaraya kaamar wänni.
english: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

anywaa: 'Ba mii nyilaal aköö, ni «Patha eni. Eno cwøl ni Jøøn.»
english: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jïgø, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dëët tuuŋu mo ocwølø ki nyeŋŋøgø.»
english: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.

anywaa: Ni cäänge ki wää gø ki lweetge, ni ge pëënynya eni, ki man näk mo nyeŋ nyilaal ocak gø na ŋa.
english: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni pëëny gïn wø gööt bääte, ni göör gø, ni «Nyeŋŋe Jøøn.» Ni rëëm yïthge bëët.
english: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø dhee ree aput jap, ni pät leebe, ni cäänne ni pwøya Jwøk.
english: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa en buute bëët ya atut ni jït cwïnyge ki lwär. Ni ö tiet mïëc Judia bëët moa en bäät kïte ni tïmge ni ge caana gïr gïïögø.
english: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïny gïïögø bëët akange cwïnyge, ni köge, ni «?Nyilaarøgø otïme na ŋø?» Kiper mana bëët cer Wuue bääte.
english: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.

anywaa: Ni ö wänni ma Dhekaraya ni pääŋe ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni caan luumma nyooth Jwøki jïre, ni kööe,
english: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,

anywaa: ni «Pwøc en jï Kwäärö Jwøk, Jwø Icriel, kiper ena lïïmmö ni wïïl jiye wøk,
english: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

anywaa: ni thïïŋŋe ko oteeø na pïëmi kiperø, yi po dhaanhnhe ma Deebit,
english: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;

anywaa: keda mana caan gø dhøk nyïïkuk moe na en kur keerge ya acääŋŋe cøøn,
english: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:

anywaa: ni ø doo piemø ceŋ nyïïmännø, ki ceŋ jøøa män ki øøni bëët,
english: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;

anywaa: nee mëër mare nyoodhe jï kwäyø, ni lääŋŋa luumme na en kur keere na tuude ki geni,
english: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;

anywaa: ni beeye kööŋ mana kööŋe ki gø jï kwarø ma Eeberam,
english: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,

anywaa: nee ø pieme ceŋ nyïïmännø, nee lønyø jïïø ki man tïnynyø eni ni bäŋ lwär,
english: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,

anywaa: nøø bëëdö ni ø ena kur keerø, ni marø beer nyïme ki yïth nïne 'moø bëët.
english: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na nyilaal, ïïno cwøl ni ïïna nyikuŋ Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, kiper ïïno cäädhi nyïm Wuuö niï jiiŋŋa uutjïëthe moe,
english: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;

anywaa: niï nyutha jiye pïëm man piem geni ki gø, kiper mano wec raay moge,
english: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

anywaa: ki køør met yi Jwøk marø na jwør can marø, ni ö bäätø ki maal kaawat man wø cööt øwi,
english: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,

anywaa: nee tar cïbe jï jø wø bëëdö yi muudhö, ni bëëdö dhi thøø, ni bwøth øøni ki waŋjöör bëët-mëër.»
english: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

anywaa: Ni ö nyilaalli ni piidhe ni tïme ni cwïnye da cer; ni eni bëëdö paap këël dïcäŋa nyooth ree jï jø Icriel.
english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø da dwøl ma aöö ki baŋ Cidhar Agacta, ni jø mïëri bëët nyeŋge doo göörö.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø beeye göör nyeŋ mana dïkwøŋ kanya bëët Kwarinia na kwäärö mar jø Ciria.
english: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni cige nee nyeŋge göör, ni ŋati man nø nyeŋŋe gööra wï poge.
english: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.

anywaa: 'Ba Jocep thuwø, ena tïŋŋö yi Galili yi paac mo cwøl ni Nadhareth, ni cøøa Bethelem po Deebit, na en yi Judia, kiper eni käla dhi øt Deebit,
english: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

anywaa: nee nyeŋŋe göör, ge ki Meeri na näk ee miiø, na yie jïtö ki dhaanhø.
english: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya enge kaace, kar lwaar apïï dëër Meeri.
english: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.

anywaa: Ni lwaare ki kanynye ma nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ni rïëp gø ka abïïe ni pïël gø yi pöö, kiper na tïme ni bäŋ kany mo rømge yie yi øt wëëlle.
english: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋää paanøgø da dïkwääc dïëk mo bëëdö wøk yi bäp ni ge wø køya dïëkge ki wäär.
english: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mar Wuuö dëëre anyoodhe jïge, ni ö ajiem Wuuö ni rienye bäätge, ni lwäcge døc.
english: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli jïge, ni «Käru lwäyö, kiper a käla luubö mo nyään mo met jïïu, mano mïn yïth jiy bëët ki gø.
english: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

anywaa: Kiper dïcäŋi Pïëmi anywøl jïïu yi po Deebit, ni beeye Krictø na näk Kwäärö.
english: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba man otïmö na nyuudhi jïïu. Nyilaal ojootu no orïëbö ka abïïe no opïël yi pöö.»
english: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiet maal ma lwaak mo päl aput öö ni dwätge ki maya. Ni ge pwøya Jwøk, ni köge,
english: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,

anywaa: na «Ajiem en jï Jwøk maalø, ni ö bëët-mëër ni en piny bäät jiy na met yie ki ge.»
english: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø na døø nyïïatwiet maal moøgø maal, dïkwääye acäänö keerge, ni «Beerra man cøø Bethelem, kuna neenø gïna tägö na nyooth Wuue jïïø.»
english: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.

anywaa: Ni cige ni ge rwäänhnhö, ni jootge Meeri ki Jocep, ki nyilaal no opïël yi pöö.
english: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.

anywaa: 'Ba na jootge gø, luumma can nyïïatwielli jïge kiper nyilaal, acaange.
english: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïny gø bëët, yïthge athäŋŋö ki gïna caan dïkwääye jïge.
english: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri gïïögø bëët akan cwïnye, ni lääŋ geni.
english: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.

anywaa: Ni ö dïkwääye ni døøkge, ni ge jiema Jwøk, ni ge pwøya gø, kiper jammi bëët moa wïnyge, ki moa neenge, keda mana caani jïge.
english: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm nïne moe na abära wøk, kanya daŋi, nyeŋŋe acak ni Jecu, ni beeye nyeŋ mana cïp nyïïatwiel maalli, kanya poode ni kär ci ec.
english: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum nïr jiiŋ røk marge keda mana näk ogöörö yi ciik Modhe, Jecu akïthge yi Jerucalem kuna cïpge gø kur keere na mar Wuuö Jwøk,
english: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

anywaa: keda mana gööri ri ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Kaai bëët moa näk cwøw mo wø lwaarø ki ge dou cïba kur keerge na mo Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)

anywaa: Ni ge ööi kaper nee ge cïpge ko olämi keda mana näk ogöörö yi ciik Wuuö Jwøk, ni «Wär cïpe ka atuuy ariiø, wala nyïï akuyi ariiø.»
english: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøca da ŋat mo ena yi Jerucalem mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Cimien. 'Ba ena dhaanhø mo beer ni cwïnye ena køør Jwøk, ni bëëdö ni køya ŋato cøm cwïny jø Icriel. Ni Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ena bääte.
english: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

anywaa: Eni, eno nyuth Jwïëc Jwøki, ni eni ba thøw ni Krictø noo jääŋ Wuuö Jwøki poot käre neenø.
english: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

anywaa: Ni wëëgi Jwïëc Jwøki ööny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba kanya ö jøøa nyöödö na kälge nyilaal ma Jecu kuna tïïcge eni keda man wø tïïc ki køør ciik Jwøk wø bëëde,
english: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,

anywaa: Cimien nyilaal atïŋe, ni pwøc Jwøk, ni kööe,
english: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,

anywaa: ni «Ï na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, kawaane wëëk aani wääth nø ki met ec, a na laŋŋï, ki køør luummï.
english: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:

anywaa: Kiper pïëm man piemï jiy ki gø aneena ki nyeŋŋa,
english: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

anywaa: ni beeye mana näk iï jiiŋŋø nyïm jiy bëët,
english: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;

anywaa: na tar mano nyooth jöö jï juurre, na ajiemma eni jï jiyï ma jø Icriel.»
english: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

anywaa: Ni ö wänni ki menni ni rëëm yïthge ki gïïa caan kiper nyilaal.
english: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.

anywaa: 'Ba gena gwïëth Cimienni, ni kööe jï Meeri na näk mii Jecu, ni «Neenï, nyilaari acïp kiper nee jø Icriel mo thööth päthge, ni kwøw mo thööthi. Ni tïme na ŋïï man car gïï mo reyø dëëre,
english: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;

anywaa: kiper nee moa en cwïny jiy mo thööth nyooth. 'Ba ïïno jwöti thuwø kaamar dhaanhø mo ocwøp opëëlle.»
english: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyijø mør ma nyikuŋ Jwøk mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Anna, nyaa Paniel, na käl yi tuuŋ Acer. 'Ba eno døøŋŋø døc, ni eno kwøŋ bëëtö ki cwøre ki cwiiri abïriiø kanya poode ni thiinh.
english: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;

anywaa: Ni bëëde na cï thøø këël mana thöödhe ki cwiiri ma pïërabära kurŋween. Ni eni kär dak yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba bëëdö ni lämö ni wödö, ni wøøra Jwøk ki wärre ki cääŋŋe.
english: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.

anywaa: 'Ba yi caannøgø ena ö maal ni pwøc Jwøk, ni caan gïr nyilaal jï jiy bëët, jøøa køc kanyo piem Jerucalem yie.
english: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jocepi ki Meeri na nø thöörge jammi bëët ki tïïc keda mana näk ogöörö yi ciik Wuuö Jwøk, gena døø poge yi Nadhareth na en yi Galili.
english: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.

anywaa: Ni ö nyilaalli ni piidhe ni tïme ni teek, ni wïïe leer døc, ni mëëc Jwøk ena bääte.
english: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba wää Jecu ki menni wø cøøa Jerucalem ki yïth cwiiri bëët kiper ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm Jecu ni cwiiye apaar kurriiø, gena ci kunöce, kaawat man wø tïïc cooth, kiper ajwöm-cam manøgø.
english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya thum ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ni ge døøk nø, nyilaarøgø na Jecu enø, adööŋ yi Jerucalem. Ni kuc wänni ki menni,
english: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.

anywaa: 'ba ege caarø ni ena dï jøøa cäädhö ki geni. Ni cääthge ki dïcäŋ aciel bäre, ni täkge ki man cacge gø dï tuuŋge ki nyïïawäätge.
english: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni kärge joodø, gena døø yi Jerucalem, ni ge caya gø.
english: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne adäk, ena jootge yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, no opï piny dï dïpööye ni leŋa döötge ni pëënynya ge ki pïëc.
english: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïny luupa caane, yïthge athäŋŋö ki leec wïc mare ki luup moa dwøge.
english: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö wänni ki menni na jootge gø, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni kö menni jïgø, ni «?Nyie, wääda, aŋø ni tïïyï wa na enønø en? Neenï, wäru ki aani, wa bëëdö ni wa caya ïïni ni cwïnywa opädhö døc.»
english: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «?A kaa ŋø na dou a cayø yie? Kuyu naa doo ena øt Wära?»
english: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?

anywaa: 'Ba tier gïna caane jïge kär ci cwïnyge.
english: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

anywaa: Ni aae ki geni ni ci yi Nadhareth, ni bëëdö ni luupge ee leŋø. 'Ba menni gïïögø bëët akan cwïnye.
english: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu adøøŋŋø, ni lëëny wïïe, ni mëëc Jwøk ki mëëc jiy ena bääte.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm cwiic Taybiria Cidhar na apaar kurbïïc yi kwär, na bëët Pøntia Paylat na kwäärö Judia, ni Galili bëënna Eerat, ni ö mïëya cwøl na Ituria ki Tarakønita na bëën owänni ma Pilip, ni ö paana cwøl na Abilin na bëën Lithania,
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,

anywaa: ni beeye kanya bëët Anna ki Keepa na Kwääc Laam, dwør Jwøk aö baŋ Jøøn wär Dhekaraya ŋää paac.
english: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni caath bäät Naam Jördan bäre, ni køpa luum lwøk jiy na nyuudhi na en ri løk cwïny kiper raac jiy nee wec Jwøki.
english: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;

anywaa: Keda mana näk ogöörö yi wëël luup nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea, ni «Da dwør dhaanhø mo cwödö ŋää paac, ni ‹Jiiŋŋu jöör Wuuö Jwøk, ni tïïyu uutjïëthe moe ni thïïŋ.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

anywaa: 'Ba aguule bëët othør, ni ö kïte ki thuuri bëët ni dwøgi piny. 'Ba kwöro näk mo oköömmö, otiir, ni ö uutjïëthe mo ogwalli ni tïïi ni pøøth,
english: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;

anywaa: 'ba jiy bëët pïëm mar Jwøk oneenge.› »
english: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Jøøn wø köö jï lwaae mo wø ö wøk baŋe nee lwøe na nyuudhi, ni «?U na nyïï thwöre en, aŋa na kööm uuni ni bwøgu ki wëër mano ööi?
english: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

anywaa: 'Ba bëëdu ki bëëtö man wø rømi ki løk cwïny, ni ba tägu ki man cäänu ki cwïnynyu, nou köö, ni ‹Eeberam beeye na kwarwa.› Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni Jwøk jïre da teek ki man jïte ki jiy jï Eeberam røk kïte moi ii.
english: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kawaane ennø, ley onø cïp tiet jenni. Kiper manøgønø, jenni bëët mo wø ba nywøl ki nyïëdi mo beyø, ŋøda piny ni leeŋi maac.»
english: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wø pëëny lwaae pëënynyö, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïcwa nø?»
english: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
