anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, «Ŋato jïre da abïïe ariiø, wär pääŋŋe ki ŋato jïre bäŋgø. Ni ö ŋato jïre da cam, ni mooc ŋato näk jïre bäŋgø thuwø na enønø.»
english: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.

anywaa: 'Ba jø ajwäk aö baŋe thuwø nee ge lwøk na nyuudhi, ni köge jïgø, ni «?Dïpööy, agïnaŋø noo tïïcwa?»
english: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kär jap ajwäk meetu ni kaala moa caan jïïu.»
english: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tøŋŋi thuwø ni pëënyge eni, ni köge, «?A waani nø, agïnaŋø noo tïïcwa?» Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kär dee jap ŋat mo lwørru ki teek jaak, ni ba kïthu bäät dhaanhø ki luubö mo patha adïëri. 'Ba rømu ki japu mo wø magu.»
english: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët jiyi ni lääŋŋa gïno tägi, ni ge cara gïr Jøøn ki cwïnyge, ni kanymør beeye eni na Krictø,
english: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

anywaa: Jøøn mare acaane jïge bëët, ni kööe, ni «Aani, dëëtu lwøa ka pïï na nyuudhi, 'ba da ŋat mo dwøŋŋa eni ki aani mo öö, mo thøøth waye ba doo mïërö jïra ki man päda ge wøk. Eni uuno lwøe na nyuudhi ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ki maac.
english: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:

anywaa: 'Ba kwödi mare ena cere, ni jwieya kar kwönne, nee beel kïth yo odiie. 'Ba lethø owaaŋe ki maac mo ba maar jwöc.»
english: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni køp luumma nyään na met jï jiy ni köömma geni ki luup møøk mo thööth.
english: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Eerat na bëën paaci, kany wø jälli ya Jøønni kiper Eerödia na näk cï owänni, ki raay bëët moa tïïc Eerati,
english: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

anywaa: raay moøgø bëët acäŋ meetø ki mana mak Jøøn ni kïth gø øt twöc.
english: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lwøk jiy na nyuudhi, Jecu alwøk thuwø; 'ba na ö Jecu na läme, maal ree ajabe,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,

anywaa: ni ö Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere ni ö bääte ki maal ki dëël mo caala dëër akuuru, ni put dwølli öö ki maal, mo köö, ni «Ïïna Wääda na mëëra ki gø, na met yia ki marï.»
english: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täk Jecu ki tïïc mare, cwiiye jïtö ki pïëradäk, ni bëëdö ni keda o Jocep, ki køør acaara mar jø møøk. 'Ba Jocep ena wär Eeli,
english: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,

anywaa: Eeli o Mathat, Mathat o Libay, Libay o Melki, Melki o Janay, Janay o Jocep,
english: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,

anywaa: Jocep o Matathia, Matathia wär Eema, Eema o Neeyam, Neeyam wär Eecli, Eecli o Nagay,
english: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,

anywaa: Nagay o Maath, Maath o Matathia, Matathia o Cemien, Cemien o Jöcek, Jöcek o Juuda,
english: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

anywaa: Juuda o Jöwaanan, Jöwaanan o Reeca, Reeca o Dherubabel, Dherubabel o Cieltiel, Cieltiel o Neeri,
english: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,

anywaa: Neeri o Melki, Melki wär Adi, Adi o Cöcam, Cöcam wär Elmadam, Elmadam wär Er,
english: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,

anywaa: Er o Jøcua, Jøcua wär Eliedhar, Eliedhar o Jörim, Jörim o Mathat, Mathat o Libay,
english: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,

anywaa: Libay o Cimien, Cimien o Juudac, Juudac o Jocep, Jocep o Jönam, Jönam wär Eliekim,
english: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,

anywaa: Eliekim o Meleea, Meleea o Menna, Menna o Matatha, Matatha o Neethan, Neethan o Deebit,
english: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,

anywaa: Deebit o Jeci, Jeci wär Obet, Obet o Böweeth, Böweeth o Calman, Calman o Nacøn,
english: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,

anywaa: Nacøn wär Aminadap, Aminadap wär Admin, Admin o Ram, Ram wär Eedharan, Eedharan o Peereth, Peereth o Juuda,
english: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Judah,

anywaa: Juuda o Jeekap, Jeekap wär Aydhak, Aydhak wär Eeberam, Eeberam o Teera, Teera o Neeyör,
english: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,

anywaa: Neeyör o Ceeruk, Ceeruk o Reew, Reew o Pelek, Pelek wär Eber, Eber o Ceela,
english: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,

anywaa: Ceela o Keenan, Keenan wär Arpakat, Arpakat o Cem, Cem o Nöa, Nöa o Lamek,
english: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noah, which was the son of Lamech,

anywaa: Lamek o Mathucala, Mathucala wär Inøk, Inøk o Jaret, Jaret o Maalalel, Maalalel o Keenan,
english: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,

anywaa: Keenan wär Inø, Inø o Ceth, Ceth wär Adam, Adam o Jwøk.
english: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aduuö ki yi Naam Jördan ni päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni bwødhi ya Jwïëc Jwøki paap.
english: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,

anywaa: Ni bëëde paap ki nïne ma pïëraŋween, ni pääny anägö päänynyö, ni bäŋ gïn mo ee camø yïth nïrögø. 'Ba na thum nïrögø, ena 'näk käci.
english: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

anywaa: Ni kö anägö jïgø, ni «Nee ïïna O Jwøk, kööm kïdi man nee tïme na møø.»
english: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïgø, no «Ogöörö, ni ‹Dhaanhø ba doo kwøw ka cam keere.› »
english: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.

anywaa: Ni kïthi ya anägö maal bäät kïdi ni nyuth gø buc piny bëët ki nyi kany mo thiinh,
english: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

anywaa: ni kööe jïgø, «Teek mar japøgø bëët ka ajiemge daa wëëga ïïni. Kiper omëëk aani, ni daa mëëga ŋato manynya jaak.
english: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk maa wøørï wøørø nø, doo tïmö na moï.»
english: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïgø, no «Ogöörö, «ni ‹Ï doo wøøra Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï, ni beeye eni keere na diï tïnynyö.› »
english: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.

anywaa: Ni ö anägö ni bwøth Jecu yi Jerucalem, ni wëëk gø cuŋŋö wï ocul Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nee ïïna O Jwøk, leeŋ riï piny ki kany.
english: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö, «ni ‹Eni nyïïatwiet maal moe oköömme kiperï, niï koorge.
english: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:

anywaa: Ïïno jølge maal ki ceŋge, kiper nee tierï ba cwaanyï ri kïdi.› »
english: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïgø, no «Ogöörö, ni ‹Kär Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï päänynyï.› »
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny anägö ki car kwör päänynyö moøgø bëët, ena aay ni wec Jecu, këël mana dee cäŋ jïtö ki jöö.
english: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aduu yi Galili, ni eni teek ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk, ni ö gïre ni wïnye yïth mïëya en kaace bëët.
english: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.

anywaa: Ni pööe yïth uut acook lam moge, ni bëëdö ni eno jiem jiyi bëët.
english: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni døø yi Nadhareth, kanya piidhi yie, ni ci øt acooŋ lam ki cäŋ jwömö keda man wø bëëde. Ni ö maal nee kwääne.
english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.

anywaa: Ni mëëk wëël Aydheea na näk nyikuŋ Jwøk eni; ni jap wëëlö, ni joot kanya näk ogöörö, na köö,
english: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,

anywaa: ni «Jwïëc Wuuö Jwøk ena bääta, kiper aana jiere nee luumma nyään na met caana jï jøøa can. Ni jääŋ aani nee pät mar jøøa näk otwöö køba jïge, ki døøn nyeŋ karge jï cööye, ni päda jøøa näk odïïmö,
english: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,

anywaa: ni køba cwiino ö Wuuö Jwøki noo nyooth met ec mare yie.»
english: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cïëk wëëlö, ni dwøk gø jï ŋata en weeli cere, ni pï piny. Ni ö nyeŋ jøøa en yi øt acooŋ lam bëët ni këëtge ree.
english: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.

anywaa: Ni täge ki man caan gø jïge, ni «Dïcäŋi en wëëlli athur kare keda mana wïnynyu gø.»
english: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni pwøcge gø, ni yïthge orëëm ki luup moa met na ö wøk ki dhee. 'Ba gena köö, na «?Aŋø, ŋati paa o Jocep?»
english: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Ba kääŋi jïïu ki man parru leeyi jïra, na køp, ni ‹Ï na akïïm, køny riï. Gïïa wïnywa na tïïyï Kapernaam, tïïyï dï pou kany thuwø.› »
english: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.

anywaa: Ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni bäŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk mo ojïëö dï poge.
english: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ya acääŋŋe yïth nïr Ilaaja da määr thuunhnhi mo thööth yi Icriel, kanya ö maalli na män køth ki cwiiri adäk ki dwäde abïciel, na jït paaci bäre ki meel mo dwøŋ.
english: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja bäŋ ŋat mo ii jääŋ baŋ gø dï määr thuunhnhi moøgø, 'ba beeye baŋ cï thøø keere mana en yi Dharepeth, yi po jø Caydan, na jääŋŋi baŋ gø.
english: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

anywaa: Ni da jiy mo thööth yi Icriel mo dëëtge da dhøøbø kanya bëët nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Ilaaca. Ni bäŋe ya aciel dïge mo dëëre odwøk kare, 'ba beeye Neeman keere na køny, na näk nyï Ciria.»
english: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en yi øt acooŋ lam bëët, kanya wïnyge gïïögø, cwïnyge ajïtö ki gootø døc.
english: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,

anywaa: Ni öge maal ni cöörge Jecu wøk ki dï paac ni peege gø deŋ apala mana näk poge ogeer bääte, kiper nee cöörge piny ki bäät apala.
english: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.

anywaa: 'Ba ena pöödhö ki dïge ni aae.
english: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni ci yi Kapernaam, paac mo ena yi Galili. Ni pwöny jiy ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.

anywaa: Ni rëëm yïthge ki pwöye, kiper pwöc mare yie da teek.
english: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.

anywaa: 'Ba yi øt acooŋ lam manøgø da dhaanhø mo dëëre da jwøk mo raac, ni kööe ki dwøl mo päl,
english: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,

anywaa: ni «?Wui, ï na Jecu nyï Nadhareth, agïnaŋø noo tïïyï ki waani? ?Ï ööa kuna raanynyï waani? Ï ŋääa, ni ïïna ŋata en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk.»
english: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ajook Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Lïŋï, ni ööï wøk ree.» 'Ba na nø gøyi ya jwøa raaci enø ki piny dïge, aö wøk dëëre, ni bäŋ gïn mo leth mo ee tïïö dëër gø.
english: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.

anywaa: 'Ba geni yïthge arëëm bëët, ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge, ni «Man a teeŋ luumma ŋø! Këël juuga reyø aköömme ki teek, ni öge wøk!»
english: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.

anywaa: Ni ö gïre ni wïnye dï mïëyögø bëët.
english: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aö maal, ni aa wøk ki yi øt acooŋ lam, ni ci po Cayman. 'Ba kanyøgø mii cï Cayman tuu ka adïrïgi mo teek. Ni kwacge eni kipere.
english: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

anywaa: Ni gääŋe bäät gø ni jook adïrïgi, ni put adïrïgi aay dëër gø. Ni ö nyijøøgø ni put ö maal ni tïny geni.
english: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni cäŋ pätha piny, jiy akännö ki jiy mo tuu ki täwe ma teeŋi baŋ Jecu. Ni kïth ceŋŋe bäätge bëët, ni dwøk dëëtge karge.
english: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

anywaa: Ni ö anäge thuwø ni öge wøk dëët jiy mo thööth ni ge rëëdö, ni «Ïïni, ïïna O Jwøk!» 'Ba gena jooe ni ba wëëk ge cäänö, kiper ŋäcge ni beeye eni na Krictø.
english: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, Jecu aay ni ci paap kany mo bäŋ jiy. Ni ö jiyi ni manyge eni, ni öge baŋe, ni ge manynya eni man bëëde buutge ni ba aay.
english: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «A cøøa kuna køba luumma nyään na met kiper buc Jwøk jï mïëri møga thuwø, kiper beeye gïnögø na jääŋ aani kipere.»
english: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni køpa luum Jwøk yïth uut acook lam mo Judia.
english: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Jecu acuŋŋö bäät Puul Genedharet, ni tïm jiyi ni rïïya bääte kiper nee luum Jwøk wïnyge.
english: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,

anywaa: Ni joot jïëthe ariiø yi naam. Ni dïbïth rec onø ö wøk yïthge, ni ge pïnyö ka ajääpi moge.
english: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

anywaa: Ni eth yi jääy aciel røkge, mana näk mar Cayman, ni pëëny gø nee jääy nyiik yi naam mëëth. Ni pï piny ni pwöny jiy ki yi jääy.
english: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø lønye ki pwöc, ena köö jï Cayman, ni «Nyiik jääy dï naam, ni leeŋï ajääpi moi, niï mägï.»
english: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Caymanni, ni «Dïpööy, waana bïdhö ki wäär bäre, ni bäŋe gïn mo ewa joodø. 'Ba kiper luummï nø, ajääpi oleeŋa.»
english: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø tïïcge gøøni, gena mägö ki lwaa rëëö mo päl. 'Ba na tïm ajääpi ni manynya cöötö,
english: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.

anywaa: jøøa bïthge ki geni moa en yi jääy maya arwaacge, nee öge kuna kønyge geni. Ni öge ni pääŋge jïëthe moge karge riet. Ni tïm jïëthe ni manynya mudö.
english: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.

anywaa: 'Ba Cayman Piter na joot gïnögø, ena put päth tiet Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Paany riï buuta, Kwäärö, kiper aana dhaanhø ma ŋat raay.»
english: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

anywaa: Kiper eni ki jøøa en buute bëët cwïnyge abwøk døc, kiper rec moa makge.
english: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:

anywaa: Këël Jeemeth ki Jøøn wäät Dhebedi, na näk jø wø bïdhö ki Cayman, gena bwøk thuwø. 'Ba Jecu aköö jï Cayman, ni «Kärï lwäyö. Køør man ennø, ïïno tïmö na dïbïth jiy.»
english: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kälge jïëthe moge ya ageela, jammi bëët awiige piny ni caathge køør Jecu.
english: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni Jecu ena yi pääny aciel dï mïëyögø, nyen mør mo dëëre ogääbö bäre ki dhøøbø aöö. 'Ba na joot Jecu, dëëre aleeŋ piny nyïm gø, ni kwac gø, ni «Wui Kwäärö, ni näk ïïno jïëy, dëëra diï dwøga kare.»
english: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni rwaak cere baŋ gø ni mul gø, ni kööe, ni «Aana jïëy, dëërï døø kare!» Ni ö dhøøbe ni put aay dëër gø.
english: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.

anywaa: Ni kööm gø, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo caanï gø jïre, 'ba ciï ni nyoothï riï jï dïlämi, ni cïpï ko olämi kiper døøn dëërï kare, keda mana caan Modhe, ni wø näk ŋïï jï jiy.»
english: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø gïr Jecu acäŋ wïnynyö døc ni pööth kany mo bäär. Ni ö lwaae mo thööth ni öge kuna wïnyge mare, nee ŋwiili mo wø en dëëtge køny thuwø.
english: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

anywaa: 'Ba ki kwör møøk Jecu wø cøøa paap ni läme.
english: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel dï nïrögø, ni Jecu pöö, da jø Paricith ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk mo opï piny kaace, mo ge ööi ka yïth mïëc Galili bëët, ki Judia, ki Jerucalem. 'Ba teek Wuuö Jwøk ena bääte ki man køny jøøa tuu.
english: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø møøk aöö mo käädö ki dhaanhø mo obäp ki bäät pëëm ni ge manynya man kïthge gø yi øtø, nee eni pïëlge nyïm Jecu.
english: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.

anywaa: 'Ba na jootge gø ni bäŋ jöö mo kïthge gø yi øtø ki gø kiper lwaak, gena eth maal wï øtø, ni lwarge gø piny ki pëëme ki kany mo ŋaam nyïm Jecu dï jiy.
english: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na neen ŋäädhe marge, ena köö, ni «Nyie nyawat, raay moï awec.»
english: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.

anywaa: 'Ba dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith gena tägö ki man cäänge ki cwïnyge, ni «?Man a ŋa ni cäänö ka ajaany en? ?Aŋa na doo wec raay? ?Aŋø, paa Jwøk keere?»
english: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

anywaa: 'Ba na ŋäyi ya Jecu ni ge cara luupögø ki cwïnyge, aløøe jïge, na «?Aŋø ni cäänu na enø nø ki cwïnynyu en?
english: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?

anywaa: ?A mane ni jööta eni na doo caanø, ki man købi ni ‹Raayï awec›, wala ki man caani, ni ‹Ö maal, ni cäädhï›?
english: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nee ŋäyu nø ni Wär Dhaanhø jïre da teek bäät piny ki man wec raay,» ena köö jï ŋata näk obäp, na «A cäänna ïïni, ö maal ni lwørï pëëmï, ni ciï paac.»
english: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.

anywaa: Ni put ö maal nyïmge bëët, ni lwør gïna näk eno pïël yi gø, ni aa paac, ni jiema Jwøk.
english: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni rëëm yïthge bëët, ni jiemge Jwøk, ni geno lwäyö døc, ni köge, ni «Øøna jïtö ki gïn mo rëëma ec dïcäŋi.»
english: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïnögø, Jecu ena aay, ni joot ŋat ma ŋat ajwäk mo cwøl ni Libay, no opï piny kar ajwäk. Ni kööe jïgø, «Ö køøra.»
english: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.

anywaa: Ni ö Libayi ni wii jammi bëët piny, ni ö maal, ni läp køør Jecu.
english: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni tïnynyi ya Libayi ka atïya mo päl paare. 'Ba da jø ajwäk mo thööth ki jø møøk ma acämö ki geni.
english: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Paricithi ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk moa näk jø Paricith ni ŋurge ki nyeŋ bääge, ni köge, na «?Aŋø ni cämu ni mädhu ki jø ajwäk ki jø raay en?»
english: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «Jø wø dëëtge jööt ba many akïïm, 'ba beege jø wø tuu.
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.

anywaa: Aani, a ba ööi naa cwøla jøøa beyø, 'ba a öönynya jø raay nee cwïnyge løkge.»
english: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

anywaa: Ni köge jï Jecu, ni «Bääk Jøøn wø lämö ki lam-wödö cooth, keda man wø tïïc bääk jø Paricith thuwø, 'ba bäägï, ge cämö ni ge mädhö jaak.»
english: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, wëët nywöm dou wëëk wödö ni cø nyakøø poot ena dïge?
english: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

anywaa: 'Ba nïne oööi, kanyo ö cø nyakøøe noo lwøri dïge; ki yïth nïröke nø, beeye noo wötge.»
english: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cään ge thuwø ki luubö mo keda leer, ni kööe, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo jëëö thääŋ abïï mo nyään wøk ni rap gø dëër abïï mo otøp. 'Ba ni näk tïïe tïïö, eni jeeya mana nyään jaak, ni ö thääŋ abïï mana nyään ni tïm kïte ni ba röömi ka abïï mana näk otøp.
english: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo doo kïtha køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään yïth opïc pëëne mo otøp. 'Ba ni näk mo tïïe tïïö, køøŋ nyïïomøki mana nyään opïyögø cööte cöötö, ni øc køøŋe piny, ni ö opïri ni ränyge.
english: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

anywaa: 'Ba køøŋ nyïïomøki mo nyään doo kïtha yïth opïc pëëne mo nyärö.
english: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo onø mäthö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mana näk oruuö ba many man mäthe këët ki mana nyään, kiper eni köö, ni ‹Mana näk oruuö meta eni.› »
english: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö ni Jecu cäädha dï pwöth beel, bääge atïmö ni ge tøya wïth beel ni ŋiinyge ge ki ceŋge, ni nyamge ge.
english: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith møøk aköö, na «?Aŋø ni tïïyu gïn mo ba doo tïïö ki cäŋ jwömö en?»
english: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, na «?Aŋø, gïna tïïc Deebiti käru kwaanø, kanya 'nägi ya käci, ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni?
english: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;

anywaa: Eni, ena døny Øt Jwøk ni lwør muuga näk nyuuthe ni cam geni, na näk ba doo beer jï dhaanhø jaak ki man cam gø, 'ba beege dïlämme keerge ni wø cam gø, ni ö eni ni mooc jøøa cäädhö ki eni thuwø.»
english: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Wär Dhaanhø beeye Kwääy cäŋ jwömö.»
english: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö mør, kanya ö Jecu na døny øt acooŋ lam ni pöö, da nyen mør kaace mo cer cwïïe obäp.
english: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.

anywaa: Ni ö dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith ni neetge gø døc, nee jootge ki man näk mo eni kunyö ki cäŋ jwömö, kiper nee jïtge ki luubö mo kïthge bääte.
english: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

anywaa: 'Ba eni moa caarge ki cwïnyge ŋääe, ni kööe jï ŋata näk cere obäp, ni «Ööi, ni cuŋŋï nyïm kany.» Ni ö maal ni cuŋŋe kaaca.
english: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?A pëënynya uuni, agïnaŋø no orømø ki køør ciik Jwøk ki man tïïi ki cäŋ jwömö, beeye gïn mo beer wala gïn mo raac? ?Beeye ki man piem jwïëy wala ki man raanynyi?»
english: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

anywaa: Ni neen nyeŋge bëët, ni kööe jï nyenøgø, ni «Rwiec cerï.» Ni put gø rwiec, ni ö cere ni døø kare.
english: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

anywaa: 'Ba gena gootø døc, ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge kiper gïno rømi ki man tïïcge gø dëër Jecu.
english: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögøøni, Jecu aeth maal bäät kïdi kuna läme. Ni thöör wäär bäre ni lama Jwøk.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, bääge acwøle, ni jëëde dïge ki jiy apaar kurriiø, jøøa tïïe na nyïïatwieli.
english: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;

anywaa: Ni beeye Cayman, ŋata caae ni Piter, ki coki ma Andaru, ki Jeemeth, ki Jøøn, ki Pilip, ki Barthølömu,
english: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,

anywaa: ki Mathiew, ki Tøma, ki Jeemeth wär Alpia, ki Cayman na cwøl ni Dhelat,
english: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

anywaa: ki Juudac o Jeemeth, ki Juudac Ickarïët, ŋata cïp eni ceŋ nyïïmän.
english: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aduu piny ki bääge moa jiere, ni cuŋŋe kany mo ree päärö. 'Ba da lwaa bääŋi moe mo thööth, ki lwaa dhaanhø mo päl mana öö ki yi Judia bäre, ki Jerucalem, ki moa öö ki Tayar ki Caydan, mïëya en bäät naama dwøŋ,
english: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

anywaa: jøøa ö kuna wïnyge luumme, nee täwe moge køny thuwø. Ni ö jøøa näk oööl juuwi mo reyø ni jöön dëëtge.
english: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaaøgø bäre ni tïmge ni ge manynya man gutge gø, kiper da teek mo wø öö ki baŋe ni køny ge bëët.
english: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu alwïthö ni neen jï bääge, ni kööe, «Gwïëth en jïïu, u ni can, kiper buc Jwøk a maru.
english: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jïïu, u no onäk käci ennø, kiper uuno jäŋ. Gwïëth en jïïu, u ni jwöŋi ennø, kiper uuno ŋïëri.
english: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jïïu kanyo ö jiyi noo mänge ki uuni ni kwierge uuni ni janyge uuni, ni jøøŋge nyeŋŋu kiper mana näk mo uuna bääk Wär Dhaanhø.
english: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

anywaa: «Wär yïthu mïnge dïcäŋöca, ni kanynyu ki met ec, kiper gïno mëëk uuni maal dwøŋ. Kiper manøgø beeye gïna tïïc kwäcge røk nyïïkuk Jwøk thuwø.
english: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.

anywaa: «'Ba otïmö ni raac jïïu, u no okwär ennø, kiper gïï wø mïn yïthu ki ge anø wëëk u.
english: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u no ojäŋ ennø, kiper uuno 'näk käci. Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u ni ŋïëri ennø, kiper uuno kïmmi ni jwöŋu.
english: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, kanyo ö jiyi noo pwøcge uuni, kiper manøgø beeye gïna tïïc kwäcge røk nyïïkuk Jwøk moa näk patha adïëri thuwø.
english: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.

anywaa: «'Ba a caana gø jïïu, u ni wïny gø en, mëërru ki nyïïmännu, ni tïïyu gïï mo beyø jï jø wø män ki uuni.
english: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,

anywaa: Ni gwïëthu jø wø cien uuni, ni lämu kiper jø wø jany uuni.
english: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato dhööŋ ï ki thääŋŋï, wär thääŋŋï maya løgï jïre thuwø. 'Ba ŋato käl koonhnhï, kär abïïno en tiere mänï ki eni thuwø.
english: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloak forbid not to take thy coat also.

anywaa: Ni mooyï jø wø kwac ïïni bëët. 'Ba ŋat mo japï ee kälö, kär cäŋ pëënynyö.
english: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wäro manynyu nee tïïc jiyi jïïu, wär wø tïïyu jïge thuwø.
english: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.

anywaa: «?'Ba ni näk mou mëër ka jø wø mëër ki uuni keerge, agïnaŋø ni beer noo pwøc uuni kipere? Kiper këëlla jø raay kiree wø mëër ka jø wø mëër ki geni.
english: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk gïï mo beyø wø tïïyu jï jø wø tïïc gïï mo beyø jïïu, agïnaŋø ni beer noo pwøc uuni kipere? Kiper këëlla jø raay wø tïïö na enønø.
english: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mou wëëga jøø ni you ŋäädhö yøø mäyö baŋu nee duuge jïïu, agïnaŋø ni beer noo pwøc uuni kipere? Kiper këëlla jø raay wø wëëga jø raay møga mäyö baŋge, nee cäŋge duuö na kare.
english: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.

anywaa: 'Ba mëërru ki nyïïmännu ni tïïyu gïï mo beyø jïge, ni wëëgu ge mäyö baŋu, ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääthu ni duua baŋu. 'Ba uuno jïti ki gïn mo dwøŋ maalø, ni tïmu na nyïï Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal. Kiper eni ki dëëre mëëye wø nyuthe jø wø kuc dwøk met ec, ki jø raay.
english: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.

anywaa: Bëëdu ni cwïnynyu lïëth ki køny keda mar Wääu na cwïnye lïëth ki køny.
english: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

anywaa: «Kär dee ŋat mo ŋølu wøk, nou ba ŋøl wøk, ni bäŋe ŋat mo jäällu, nou ba jääl thuwø. Ni weyu gïï wø bayi dëëtu, 'ba gïï wø bayu owec thuwø.
english: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:

anywaa: Muu, 'ba ocäŋ mëëk uuni, ni cïp ka rumi mo othielø no oŋenø, ni øya piny, ni kïthi yïth aleeŋŋe mou. Kiper rumi man wø cïpu beeye rumi mano duu baŋu.»
english: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mør acäŋ caannø jïge kaamar leer, ni kööe, ni «?Ŋat ma cwør, cwør mør a dee gø pieyø nidïï? ?Aŋø, ge ba päth yi buur karge riet?
english: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?

anywaa: Ŋat mo di pwönynyö ba dwøŋŋa eni ki dïpööy mare. 'Ba ŋati man nø, kany wø nø pwönynyi døøc, tïmö ni caala dïpööy mare.
english: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni neetï ŋöömö man wø en waŋ cöögu, ni wïl wïïï ki cuudhö manø ni en waŋï enø?
english: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

anywaa: ?Na aŋø na diï köö jï cöögu, ni ‹Coka, ööï nee ŋöömmo en waŋï enø käla wøk,› ni ïïni ki dëërï cuudhö manø en waŋï enø kärï joodø? Ï na ŋat atade, kwøŋ cuunhnho en waŋï enø käl wøk, køøre ïïno nëënö ni beer nee ŋöömö manø en waŋ cöögu enø kälï wøk.
english: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

anywaa: «Bäŋ jaath mo beer mo nywøla nyïëdi mo reyø. Ni bäŋe jaath mo raac mo nywøla nyïëdi mo beyø.
english: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

anywaa: 'Ba jaadhi nø, wø ŋec ka nyïïe. Kiper nyïï olämmi bäŋ wø pønna dëët jer koodhi, ni nyïïomøki bäŋ wø pønna dëët buŋŋe mo da koodhi.
english: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata beer wø käla gïn mo beer wøk ki røk japa beyø na en cwïnye. 'Ba ŋata raac wø käla gïn mo raac wøk ki røk japa reyø na en cwïnye. Ni gïï wø thööth ni wø en cwïny dhaanhø beege ni wø caane ki dhee.
english: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.

anywaa: «?Aŋø ni wø cøøru aani, ni ‹Kwäärö, Kwäärö,› ni ba tïïyu gïï wø caana jïïu?
english: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro ö baŋa ni wïny luupa, ni tïïc geni, teeŋ ŋatøgø caana caanø jïïu ennø.
english: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:

anywaa: Eni caala dhaanhø mo ogëëdö ki øtø, mo tier gø ee koonyø ni thur piny, ni cwää tier gø bäät kïdi. 'Ba na ö jwïëe, pïï akwöt dëër ødøgø, ni käre løny ki man nëëk gø, kiper mana näk mo ogeerø ni teek.
english: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo owïny luupa ni ba tïïc geni, caala ŋat mo øtø ee geer dï ŋøøm jaak, ni tier gø käre koonyø, ni ö jwïëö ni kwöt dëër gø, ni laar pädhö. Ni räny ødøgøøni okadhø døc.»
english: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na ö Jecu na nø thöör luupe bëët ni wïnynyi ya jiyi, ena ci Kapernaam.
english: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa mo jïre da laŋŋø mo pere leth døc jïre. 'Ba laŋŋøgø tuu ni kare cään ki thøø.
english: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gïr Jecu, jaae møøk mo jø Juuth ajääŋŋe baŋ gø, nee eni pëënynye ki man ööe nee laŋŋe kønye.
english: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.

anywaa: 'Ba na öge baŋ Jecu, ena kwaacge døøc, ni köge, ni «Ŋatøce orømø ki man tïïyï gïn jïre,
english: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:

anywaa: kiper eni mëër ki pøø ni øt acooŋ lam marø geera eni.»
english: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.

anywaa: Ni put Jecu aay ki geni. 'Ba na cään kare ki øtø, kwääy jø tøŋ nyïïawääte ajääŋ baŋe, ni caana gø, ni «Kwäärö, dëërï kär öölï, kiper a patha orømø ki man wëëga ïïni ööny paara.
english: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na kööa naa patha orømø ki man ööa baŋï. 'Ba cäännï ki luubö keere; køøre, laŋŋø mara dëëre ojöönni.
english: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.

anywaa: Kiper aani, aana dhaanhø mo bëënna teek ŋat mør, ni jïra da jø tøŋ mo ena cera, maa doo köö ka aciel, ni ‹Ciï,› ni dee cøø. Ni kööa jï mør, ni ‹Ööï,› ni dee öö. Ni daa laŋŋa cäännö, ni ‹Tïïc gïn,› ni dee gø tïïö.»
english: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na wïny luum ŋatøgø, yie arëëm, ni løø ree baŋ lwaa cäädhö køøre, ni kööe, na «A cäänna uuni, ni këël dï jø Icriel, teeŋ ŋäädhe ma enøgønø poot kära joodø.»
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døø jøøa jääŋŋi yøø øtø, laŋŋø ajootge ni dëëre ojöönnö.
english: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre cään, Jecu aci paac mo cwøl ni Neeyin, ni ö bääge ki lwaak mo päl ni cige ki eni.
english: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm kare ni cään ki dhi kiir paanøgø, da dhaanhø mo othøw mo di käärö, ni kïtha wøk, 'ba beeye wäädö keere jï menni. Ni nyijøøgø beeye cï thøø. 'Ba lwaak mo päl mo käla dï paac ena buute.
english: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Kwäärö na joot nyijøøgø, cwïnye apädhö ki gïr gø, ni kööe jïgø, «Kärï jwöŋö.»
english: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.

anywaa: Ni ci nyïm ni gut pëëm, ni ö jøøa tïëdö ni cuŋge. Ni kööe, «Nyie, dïcwøø, a cäänna ïïni, ö maal.»
english: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata näk othøw ni ö maal, ni pï bäät thare, ni put cäänö. Ni ö Jecu ni mëëk gø mii gø.
english: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.

anywaa: Ni put lwärri öö bäätge bëët, ni jiemge Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk mo dwøŋ athïïŋ dïïø, ni Jwøk lïïma jiye.»
english: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.

anywaa: Ni ö gïre manøgø ni wïnye dï Judia bäre, ki yïth mïëya en ŋää paac bëët.
english: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

anywaa: 'Ba bääk Jøøn gïïa tïïc Jecu bëët acaange jï Jøøn.
english: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøønni ni cwøl bääge ariiø baŋe, ni jääŋ geni baŋ Kwäärö ki man pëënyge gø, ni «?Bee ïïni, ŋata wäŋŋi ni öö, wala cäŋwa dhaanhø mør neetø?»
english: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïc jøøgø buut Jecu, gena köö, ni «Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi waana jääŋ baŋï, ni pëënynya ïïni, ni ‹?Bee ïïni, ŋata wäŋŋi ni öö, wala cäŋwa dhaanhø mør neetø?› »
english: When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist hath sent us unto thee, saying, Art thou he that should come? or look we for another?

anywaa: 'Ba yi caannøca Jecu jø täwe mo thööth akønye, ki jøøa dëëtge da ŋwiili, ki jøøa dëëtge da juuga reyø, ni dwøk nyeŋ cööye mo thööth karge.
english: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; and unto many that were blind he gave sight.

anywaa: Køøre aløk Jecu jï jøøa jääŋŋi, ni «Cou ni caannu gïïa neennu na wïnynyu jï Jøøn, ni jøøa näk cööye nyeŋge adøø karge, ni ö ŋööte ni cääthge, ni ö jøøa näk dëëtge da dhøøbø ni døø dëëtge karge, ni ö meŋŋe ni wïnyge luup, ni ö jøøa näk othøw ni tïŋ ge maal ki yi thøø, ni ö jøøa canni ni køp luumma nyään na met jïge.
english: Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things ye have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat maa käre taaø.»
english: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø aac jøøa jääŋ Jøønni, Jecu atägö ki man caan gïr Jøøn jï lwaak, ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na cou baŋe paap nee neennu? ?Aŋø, u cøøa baŋ otöök mo tuuŋŋa jame?
english: And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went ye out into the wilderness for to see? A reed shaken with the wind?

anywaa: ?A uuno cøøa baŋ ŋø nø, nee neennu? ?U cii nou neena ŋat mo oruyö ka abïïe mo beyø? Neennu, jø wø käär abïïe mo beyø ni wø bëëdö yi kwär, wø ena mïëc nyeye.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø nø, na cou baŋe nee neennu? ?Beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk? Kare møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni eni kaala cer nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: But what went ye out for to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet.

anywaa: Ŋatøgø beeye ŋata göör gïn kipere yi wëël Jwøk, na køp, «ni ‹Neenï, a jääŋŋa nyïïatwiel mara nyïmï, ŋato jiiŋ jöörï nyïmï.›
english: This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

anywaa: A caana gø jïïu, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo dwøŋŋa kare ki kar Jøøn dï jøøa nywøl määnni. 'Ba eni na kare thiinhnha eni yi buc Jwøk, tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni ki Jøøn.»
english: For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø karge bëët ki jø ajwäk, na wïnyge gïnögø, gena köö, ni «Mar Jwøk beer,» kiper mana kwøŋ ge lwøk ki lwøk na nyuudhi mar Jøøn.
english: And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith ki jø wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk, mar Jwøk na manynye kiperge akwierge, ni kär geni lwøø na nyuudhi ki ri lwøk mar Jøøn.
english: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, ni «?Beenhnhi en, a daa gø päärö ki ŋø, ni ge caalge ŋø?
english: And the Lord said, Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like?

anywaa: Ge caala obwöre mo opï piny kar ŋïëw, ni cøøra rege, ni köge, «ni ‹Waani opelø akoothwa jïïu, ni käru miel. Ni jwöŋwa ki jwøk thøø, ni käru jwöŋö.›
english: They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned to you, and ye have not wept.

anywaa: Kiper Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi aöö, ni ba cämö ki møø, ni ba mädhö ki køøŋø, ni kööu, ni ‹Wïïe da anägö.›
english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

anywaa: 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø aöö ni cämö ni mädhö, ni kööu, ni ‹Neennu, ŋat wärö na ŋat maath, na nyawat jø ajwäk ki jø raay.›
english: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

anywaa: 'Ba leec wïc ojoot na adïëri ki ri nyïëdi moe bëët.»
english: But wisdom is justified of all her children.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu apëëny ŋat Paricithi mør nee ge cämge ki gø paare. Ni ci po ŋat Paricith manøgø, ni pï piny kar cam.
english: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da dhaagø mo bëëdö päänyögø, ma ŋat raay. 'Ba na wïny gø ni Jecu cämö yi øt ŋat Paricith manøgø, ena kännö ki wïl maaw mo ŋwääö ni met,
english: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

anywaa: ni cuŋŋe ŋää gø kany mo cään ni jwöŋö, ni tïm pï nyeŋŋe ni cwïëra bäät tiet Jecu, ni pooc gø ki jïëye, ni nuum tiet gø, ni wïïr ge ki maarøgø.
english: And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö ŋat Paricith manøgø, ni beeye ŋata cwøl gø baŋ cam, na neen gïnögø, ena köö ki cwïnye, «Onää ŋati nyikuŋ Jwøk møn, dhaaŋŋøgø dee ŋääö, na a teeŋ dhaagø mo nyïëdi ni muur gø enø, kiper nyaanøgø ŋat raay.»
english: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu ni kööe jïgø, «Nyie Cayman, da gïn mo caana caanø jïrï.» Ni løk gø, ni «Caanï nø, dïpööy.»
english: And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And he saith, Master, say on.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Da ŋat mo owëëk jiy ariiø mac jape. Na aciel maya dïpe abïïc, 'ba maya maya pïërabïïc.
english: There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

anywaa: 'Ba na dhäthe jïge ki cool, awëëk geni, karge riet. ?A mane nø, ni mëëye okadhø ki gø dï jøø na ariiø yøø?»
english: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

anywaa: Ni løgi Caymanni, ni «Ki jïra, beeye ŋata wëënne ki japa thööth.» Ni kööe jïgø, na «Acaanï na kare.»
english: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre ree aløø baŋ dhaaŋŋøgø, ni kööe jï Cayman, «?Dhaaŋŋi en ajootï? Aana duny ødï, ni kärï a mooø ki pïï kiper tieta, 'ba eni tieta atïïe ni thec ki pï nyeŋŋe, ni pooc ge ki jïëye.
english: And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, Seest thou this woman? I entered into thine house, thou gavest me no water for my feet: but she hath washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head.

anywaa: Ni kärï a nuumø, 'ba eni kanya ööa yi øtø, tieta poot käre wiiø ki nuum en.
english: Thou gavest me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in hath not ceased to kiss my feet.

anywaa: Ïïni, wïïa kärï wïïrö ki maaw, 'ba eni tieta awïïre ki maaw mo ŋwääö ni met.
english: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a caana gø jïrï, ni raaye ni thööth yøø awec, kiper mëër mare okadhø. 'Ba ŋat wø wëënni ki gïn mo thiinh, mëëye thiinh.»
english: Wherefore I say unto thee, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loveth little.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï dhaaŋŋøgø, ni «Raayï awec.»
english: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøa en kar cam ki eni, gena tägö ki man cäänge yïthakicge, ni «?Man a ŋa, ni köö en, ni këël doo nää raay wiie wiiø?»
english: And they that sat at meat with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgiveth sins also?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jï dhaaŋŋøgø, ni «Ŋäädhe marï ïïna pieme. Ciï nø ki met ec.»
english: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne mo nøk, Jecu aay ni caatha dï mïëri moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, ni pöö, ni køpa luumma nyään na met kiper buc Jwøk. 'Ba bääge na näk apaar kurriiø nut ki eni,
english: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him,

anywaa: ki mään møøk thuwø, jøøa køny ki juuga reyø ki ŋwiili na en dëëtge, ni beege Meeri na cwøl ni Magdalin, ŋata öö anäga näk abïriiø wøk dëëre,
english: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,

anywaa: ki Jöwaana cï Cudha, ŋata tïny Eerat, ki Cucana, ki mään møøk mo thööth. Mään moøgø wø känna wøk ri japge ni kønyge Jecu ki bääge ki ge.
english: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö lwaaki mo päl kanya ciel, ni tïm jiyi ni ööa baŋ Jecu ki tiet mïëri, luubö mør acaane na leer, ni kööe, ni
english: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:

anywaa: «Da dïpïïdhi mo oaa wøk kuna jør kööthe. 'Ba na jude, møøk apäth thääŋ jöö, ni nyøri ki tiel, ni ö wenynyi ni camge ge.
english: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.

anywaa: Ni päth møøki kany mo da kïdi. 'Ba na tucge, gena waaŋ ni talge, kiper na näk karge otal.
english: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

anywaa: Ni päth møøki yïth koodhi, ni ö koodhi ni døøŋge ki geni na aciel, ni bøøcge ge.
english: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk apäth yi ŋöömö mo beer, ni døøŋge ni känge ki nyeŋ ma dïpe.» 'Ba kanya caan gïnögø, dwøre atïŋ maal døc, ni kööe, ni «Nee da ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö bääge na pëënyge eni ki tier luummögø na caane kaamar leer enø,
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

anywaa: ena köö, ni «Beeye uuni na wëëk ŋäc tiet luup moa näk tietge okwøŋ kan kiper buc Jwøk. 'Ba ki jï jø møga, luupögø caan kaamar leer, kiper noo neenge gø, ba jootge; ni wïnyge gø, 'ba tiere ba kwanyge.
english: And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand.

anywaa: 'Ba tier leer manøgø beeye en. Köödhi beege luum Jwøk.
english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

anywaa: 'Ba moa päth thääŋ jöö caala jiy mo wø wïny luum Jwøk; 'ba anägö öö, ni käl luubö wøk cwïnyge, kiper nee ge ba jïëcge ni ŋääthge, nee ge piem.
english: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba moa päth kany mo da kïdi, ge caala jø wø laar jïëy ki met ec kany wø wïnyge luum Jwøk; 'ba jïge bäŋ lweedi, ni ge jïëy ka kany mo thiinh keere. 'Ba kany wø dee päänynyö, ge wø laara døø cään.
english: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.

anywaa: 'Ba moa päth yïth koodhi, beege jø wø wïny luum Jwøk, 'ba kany wø bëëtge, ge bøøc ki køør gïï wø lääŋge ki cwïnyge, ki jap kwär, ki jap wø many dëëlli, ni ba jïtge ki nyïëdi.
english: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.

anywaa: 'Ba moa piith yi ŋöömma beer, beege jø wø wïny luum Jwøk ni putge gø mak na bäre bäre ki cwïny mo leer ma adïëri, ni känge ki nyeŋ ni cwïnyge ege cïp piny.
english: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.

anywaa: «'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo nyep lamba ni cäŋ gø rïëpö ki gïrpiny, wala kïthe tier pëëm, 'ba wø cïbe bäät tharabëëta, kiper nee jø wø dunynyi, nee tar neenge.
english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ gïn mo okanø, mo ba cäŋ nyoothø, ni bäŋ gïn mo omooŋø, mo ba cäŋ käl wøk yi tar.
english: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cegu ïthu døøc ki gïn wïnynyu en. Kiper ŋat wø jïre dagø, møøk ocäŋ cïpö jïre. Ni ŋat wø jïre bäŋgø, këël man wø caare ni mare, di lwørø.»
english: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.

anywaa: Kanyøgø mii Jecu ki nyïïmenni aö baŋ Jecu, 'ba gena tïmö ni ba maar ci buute kiper lwaak.
english: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.

anywaa: Ni købi jïre, ni «Meru ki nyïïmeru cuŋŋö wøk, ni ge manynya ïïni, niï neenge.»
english: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ena kö jïge, ni «Mera ki nyïïmera beege jø wø wïny luum Jwøk ni kïthge gø bäät tïïc.»
english: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel Jecu aci yi jääy ki bääge, ni kööe jïge, ni «Cøø løøga.» Ni putge tïŋŋö.
english: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääth jääyi, ena butö. Ni ö atuunna ni kwön naam, ni tïm jääyi ni manynya man pääŋe ki pïï, ni jääy manynya mudö.
english: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

anywaa: Ni cige baŋ Jecu ni jiecge gø ni köge, «Dïpööy, Dïpööy, øøna thøw!» Ni pääe ni jook atuunna ka athaŋŋøgø ni raac enø. Ni cuŋge, ni put pinynyi nibäc.
english: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï bääge, ni «?Ŋäädhe maru en kaa?» Ni lwäcge, ni rëëm yïthge, ni cäänge yïthakicge keerge, ni «?Man a teeŋ dhaanhø mo nyïëdi en, ni këël atuunna ka athaga jooe jooø, ni leŋge luumme?»
english: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu ki bääge gena pïï po jø Gadarin, na dïët ki Galili.
english: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba na eth Jecu wøk bäät ageela, nyen mør mo käla pääny aö baŋe mo wïïe da anäge, mo obëëdö ki kany mo bäär ni cäädhi ka dëëre ni bäŋ abïïe, ni ba bëëdö paac, 'ba wø beeta dï bwör.
english: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.

anywaa: 'Ba na joot Jecu, ena köök døc ni put päth nyïm gø, ni cäänne ki dwøl mo päl, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïyï ki aani, Jecu, O Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal? A kwaya ïïni, naa ba caarï.»
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.

anywaa: Kiper jwøøgø na raac enø, akööm Jecu, nee ö wøk dëër ŋatøgø. Kiper eni wø maaŋ jwøøgø maaŋŋø ki kwöre mo thööth. Ni eni wø di koorø no otwöö ko oguudi ki thøøli, 'ba gïïögø wø cööte cöötö, ni bwødhi ya anäge paap.
english: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena pëëny Jecu, ni kööe, ni «?Nyeŋŋï aŋa?» Ni løk gø, ni «Aana Liijan,» kiper anäge mo thööth na en ri gø.
english: And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

anywaa: Ni ö anäge ni kwacge Jecu, nee geni ba köömme ki man cige yi buura näk bäye bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da pïïth othur mo päl mo cämö nyäär thuur. Ni kwacge Jecu nee ge wëëk ciin dëët othuri. Ni wëëk ge wääth.
english: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø anäge aö wøk dëër ŋatøgø, ni cige dëët othuri. Ni ö pïïth othur ni dhoothge ya ageella bäär yi naam ni mutge.
english: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö dïkwääc othuri na neenge gïna tägö, gena reeŋø, ni caange gø paac, ki mïëya en wøk.
english: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy aci wøk kuna neenge gïna tägö; 'ba na pïïcge buut Jecu, ŋata aay anäge dëëre anwänge no opï piny tiet Jecu, dëëre ka abïï ni wïïe odøø kare. Ni putge lwäyö.
english: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa neen gïna tägö, køny mana køny ŋata näk dëëre da anäge ki gø acaange jï jøøa öö.
english: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu akwac jø Gadarin bëët nee aae buutge, kiper cwïnyge ajïtö ki lwär mo päl døc. Køøre ena ci yi jääy ni døøe.
english: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata aay anäge wøk dëëre Jecu akwaae, nee eni bëëde ki gø. 'Ba ena wëëk Jecu wääth, ni kööe jïgø,
english: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying,

anywaa: ni «Døø pou, ni køpï gïna dwøŋ na tïïc Jwøki kiperï.» Ni aae, ni køp gïna dwøŋ na tïïc Jecu kipere dï paanøgø bäre.
english: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things God hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya døøk Jecu, ena pänh lwaaki, kiper ge bëëdö ni ge køya eni bëët.
english: And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nyen ma kwääy øt acooŋ lam aöö, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jaayra, ni päth tiet Jecu, ni kwac gøøni nee ö paare,
english: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

anywaa: kiper eni jïre da nyaare ma nyakøø ma aciel keere, mo cwiic dööŋŋe jïtö ka apaar kurriiø. 'Ba eni tuu ni manynya thøø. 'Ba kanya poot Jecu ni cäädhö ni aa po Jaayra, jiy atïmö ni rïïya bääte.
english: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø mør aöö ki ŋääe, mo dëëre bëëdö ni cwïër ki remø ki cwiiri apaar kurriiø; 'ba bäŋ ŋat mo maar lønyø jïgø ki man køny gø.
english: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,

anywaa: Ni ööe ki ŋää Jecu ni gut deŋ abïï gø, ni ö remme ni put cöö dëëre.
english: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, na «?Aŋa na gut aani?» 'Ba na ö jiyi na kweecge rege, Piter ki jøøa en buute aköö, «Dïpööy, ïïno rum lwaaki dïër, ni ge rïïya bäätï.»
english: And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Da dhaanhø mo ogut aani. Kiper ajooda ni da teek mo oaay dëëra.»
english: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö nyijøøgø na joot gø ni eni ŋäc, ena ö nyïm ni dëëre kwanynyi ni päth nyïm Jecu, ni køp gïna gut gø kipere nyïm jiy bëët, ki kanya put dëëre jöönnö.
english: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, «Nyaara, ŋäädhe marï dëërï awëëk jöönnö. Ciï nø ki met ec.»
english: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni poot cäänö, nyen mør aöö ki po kwääy øt acooŋ lam, ni kööe, ni «Nyaarï anø thøw. Kär dïpööy öölï këët.»
english: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na wïny gïnögø, aköö jï Jaayra, ni «Kärï lwäyö, 'ba ŋäc ŋäädhe keere. 'Ba eno køny.»
english: But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö yi øt Jaayra, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo ee wëëk dønyø ki eni, 'ba beeye Piter ki Jøøn ki Jeemeth, ki wää nyakøønnøgø ki menni keerge.
english: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

anywaa: 'Ba kaagø jiy bëët ge jwöŋö ni ge göö ko oduuru kipere. 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Käru jwöŋö, kiper eni kär thøw, 'ba mare niine.»
english: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni ŋeethge bäät gø, kiper na ŋäcge gø ni nyilaal othøw.
english: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu cer nyilaal amaae, ni cwøl gø, ni «Nyilaal, ö maal.»
english: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.

anywaa: Ni duu jwïëye, ni put ö maal. Ni kööm geni, ni «Mooyu eni ki gïn came.»
english: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa nywøl gø ni thäŋ yïthge. 'Ba gena köömme nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo caange gïna tägö jïgø.
english: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cwøl bääge na näk apaar kurriiø ni mooc ge ki teek bäät anäge bëët, ki teek man køny jø täwe.
english: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

anywaa: Ni jääŋ geni wøk kuna køpge luum buc Jwøk ni ge kunyö ki jø täwe.
english: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

anywaa: Ni kööm geni, ni «Kär dee gïn kääru kiper wääthu, teeŋ ka alaŋkaace, wala opïri, wala muunni, wala gwel. Ni bäŋe ŋat käädö ka abïïe ariiø.
english: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø mano wäru dønynyu yie, wäru wø putu bëëte kaaca, këël mano tïŋŋu.
english: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ba pänh uuni yie, kanyo tïŋŋu paanøca, wär tør tietu teeŋu yie, nee tïme na nyuudhi dëëtge.»
english: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

anywaa: Ni tïŋge ni caathge dï mïëri ni ge køpa luumma nyään na met, ni ge kunyö ki jø täwe yïth kwörögø bëët.
english: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.

anywaa: 'Ba Eerat na bëën paaci, gïïa tägö bëët awïnynye, ni ö wïïe ni kier ree, kiper na kö jø møøki ni Jøøn atïŋ maal ki yi thøø,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;

anywaa: ni kö jø møøki ni ööa Ilaaja, ni kö møga, ni beeye dhaanhø aciel røk nyïïkuk Jwøk moa cääŋŋe no oduu wøk enø ki yi thøø.
english: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.

anywaa: 'Ba Eerat aköö, ni «?Jøøn, wïïe aŋula wøk, 'ba man a ŋa, ni poot tïïc teeŋ gïï ni wïnynya ii?» Ni ö eni ni cac man neen gø.
english: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.

anywaa: 'Ba na duu nyïïatwietøgø, gïïa tïïcge bëët acaange jï Jecu. Ni ö Jecu ni käl geni, ni daa paac mør mo cwøl ni Betheeda.
english: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya lwaae, gena läp køøre. Ni pänh geni, ni caan luum buc Jwøk jïge, ni køny jø täwe moa many køny.
english: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø cäŋ atïmö ni thiinh. Ni ö bääge baŋe, ge na näk apaar kurriiø, ni köge jïre, ni «Wëëk lwaaøgø wääth, nee cige yïth mïëri ki mïëyø thenh thenh ni en ŋää paac yøø, nee butge yïthge, nee jïtge ki caammi. Kiper ø ena paap.»
english: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Mooyu geni ki gïn camge.» Ni köge, ni «Jïwa da muunni abïïc ki rec ariiø keerge, 'ba tiirra man ciwa, nee wa ŋëëwa ki caammi jï jøøgø bëët.»
english: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

anywaa: Kiper jøøka jïtö ki jiy ma kume abïïc ma cwøw. Ni kö Jecu jï bääge, «Cïïmmu geni na akääŋi, na akaaŋ man nø jïte ki pïërabïïc.»
english: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.

anywaa: Ni tïïcge gø, ni wëëkge ge pïïn piny bëët.
english: And they did so, and made them all sit down.

anywaa: Ni lwør muuga näk abïïc ki reya näk ariiø, ni neen maal ni gwïëth ge, ni pøt ge, ni mëëk ge bääŋi, nee cïïmge nyïm jøøgø.
english: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.

anywaa: Ni cämge bëët ni jäŋge, ni ö bääge ni kwaanyge thäŋi moa dhäthö, ni jïtge ki yïth gupe apaar kurriiø mo päŋ.
english: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni Jecu lämö na eni keere, ni bääŋi ena buute, bääŋi apëënynye, ni kööe, ni «?Jiy wø köge ni aana ŋa?»
english: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø, ni «Ge wø köö ni ïïna Jøøn na näk dïlööy na nyuudhi, ni kö møøki, ni ïïna Ilaaja. 'Ba møøk wø köö, ni beeye nyikugö aciel dëët nyïïkuk Jwøk moa cääŋŋe no oduu wøk enø.»
english: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «?A uuni, u wø kööu ni aana ŋa?» Ni løgi ya Piterri, ni «Ïïna Krictø na öö ki baŋ Jwøk.»
english: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni kööm geni, ni cem ge døøc, nee bäŋe ŋat mo caange luummögø jïgø.
english: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Wär Dhaanhø gïï mo leth mo thööth ojwøre, ni kwieri ya jaae, ki kwääc laam, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ni nääi, ni cäŋi tïŋ maal ri dää nïne.»
english: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.

anywaa: Ni caan gø jï jiy bëët, ni kööe, ni «Nee da dhaanhø mo manynya man ö køøra, eni dëëre wär taae, ni käär jaadhe na näk odëëdö cooth, ni caath køøra.
english: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato wäro many man gwøk jwïëye, nyääga gø, 'ba ŋato wäro nyääk jwïëye kiper nyeŋŋa, gwøga gø.
english: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø ni beer noo duui jï dhaanhø, ni näk mo piny bäre oci jïre, ni raany ree wala nyääga ree?
english: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro wïïe laay ki nyeŋŋa ki luupa, Wär Dhaanhø wïïe olaay ki gø kanyo ööe ka ajieme, ka ajiem Wuuö Jwøk, ka ajiem mar nyïïatwiet maal moa en kur keerge.
english: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels.

anywaa: 'Ba adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni da jø møøk mo cuŋŋö kany, mo thøø ba jootge ni buc Jwøk poot kärge neenø.»
english: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø na tïm nïne ni jïtö ki kar abära køør luupögø, Jecu Piter, ki Jøøn, ki Jeemeth akäle, ni ci bäät kïdi kuna läme.
english: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.

anywaa: 'Ba na läme, täärnyïme ree awiile, ni tïm abïïe moe ni ŋwaŋŋi ni tar døc.
english: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy ariiø ajootge ni cäänö ki eni, ni beeye Modhe ge ki Ilaaja,
english: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:

anywaa: ni ge ööi ka ajiem, ni caange luum thøø mare mano thøøe yi Jerucalem, ni thööra tïïc mare.
english: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Piter ki jøøa en buute, nyeŋge da niine mo thööth, 'ba kanya päcge, ajieme ajootge ni jootge jøøa näk ariiø na cuŋŋö buute.
english: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme ni jøøgø aay buute, Piter aköö jï Jecu, ni «Dïpööy, beer døc kiree na enø kany. Beerra man tïïwa ka abïle adäk, aciel kiperï, na aciel kiper Modhe, ni maya kiper Ilaaja.» 'Ba gïna caane tier gø kuue.
english: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni caana gïnögø, pöölö aöö, ni neejïïm bäätge. 'Ba kanya ö pööle bäätge, gena lwäyö.
english: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.

anywaa: Ni ö dwølli ki yi pööllögø, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye Wääda na näk yaa jierø. Wïnynyu luumme.»
english: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny dwølli ki cäänö, Jecu ajoot ni dööŋŋa eni keere. 'Ba yïth nïrögøøni, gena bëëdö ni ge lïŋö ni bäŋ gïn mo ege caanø jï dhaanhø mør røk gïïa jootge.
english: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, ni geno nø ö piny ki bäät kïdi, lwaak mo päl aö baŋ Jecu.
english: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.

anywaa: 'Ba dï lwaaøgø dhaanhø mør acwötö ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Dïpööy, a kwaya ïïni nee wääda neenï, kiper beeye nyey keere jïra.
english: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.

anywaa: 'Ba eni wø mak jwøki mo raac maa ni put rëëdö, ni meec gø, këël mano ö bööyö wøk ki dhee, ni mooc gø ki ŋwiili, ni ba maar wec.
