english: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.

anywaa: Ni kwaaa bäägï nee riemge wøk, 'ba kär løny jïge.»
english: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «?U na beenhnhø mo bäŋ ŋäädhe jïïu en ni wïthu teek, a këël kany mo nyïëdi nø noo beeda ki uuni, noo maa cwïnya ki uuni? Käl wäädï kany.»
english: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni cäänhnhö, ena gøø anäge piny, ni meec gø. 'Ba Jecu jwøøgø ni raac enø ajooe, ni køny nyilaarøgø, ni mëëk gø wää gø.
english: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët yïthge athäŋŋö ki teek Jwøk.
english: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni yïthge othäŋŋö ki gïïa tïïe bëët, ena köö jï bääge,
«Uuni, cegu ïthu ki luum caana en, kiper Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ jiy.»
english: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.

anywaa: 'Ba tier luummögøøni kär ci cwïnyge. 'Ba tiere atïmö no okanø ki geni, nee ba ŋäcge. 'Ba gena lwäyö ki man pëënyge eni ki tier luummögøøni.
english: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.

anywaa: Ni jït yïthakic bääge ki pïëm, ni ge pïëmö, na aŋa ni dwøŋŋa kare dïge.
english: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

anywaa: 'Ba mana en cwïnyge na ŋäyi ya Jecu, ena lwötö ki nyilaal mo thiinh ni cïp gø dïër,
english: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,

anywaa: ni kööe jïge, ni «Ŋato wäro jïëc nyilaari ki nyeŋŋa, jïëya aani. Ni ŋato wäro jïëc aani, jïëya ŋata jääŋ aani. Kiper ŋato wäro kare thiinhnha eni dïïu bëët, beeye ŋato kare dwøŋŋa eni.»
english: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn aluupö, ni «Dïpööy, waana jïtö ki ŋat mør mo rëëmma wøk ka anäge ki nyeŋŋï, ni mänwa gø, kiper eni bäŋ wø cäädhi ki øøni.»
english: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Kär mänu. Kiper ŋat wø ba män ki uuni, ena kuru.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu, kanya cään kar nïne moe ki man dwøgi maal, cwïnye atïmö ni lääŋŋa ciin yi Jerucalem.
english: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,

anywaa: Ni jääk nyïme ki jiy. Ni cige paac mør dï mïëc jø Cameria, nee kare jiiŋge.
english: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kär jïëc jøøgø, kiper mana tïme ni eni pöötha yi Jerucalem.
english: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jeemeth ki Jøøn na näk bääge, na jootge gïnögø, gena köö jïgø, ni «?Kwäärö, ï manynya waani man cwötwa ki maac ki maal nee wïthge dïtge bëët?»
english: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

anywaa: 'Ba ena luk baŋge, ni jook geni.
english: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.

anywaa: Ni pööthge paac mør.
english: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääthge øtjöö, ŋat mør aköö jï Jecu, na «A cäädhö køørï, këël ï doo cøøa kaa.»
english: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, no «Othööe jïge da buri, ni weny jïge da uudi, 'ba Wär Dhaanhø, bäŋ kany mo nyaaŋ thääŋŋe yi gø.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu nyen mør aköömme, ni «Cäädhï køøra.» Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Kwäärö, wec a dïciel, naa cøøa kuna koonya wära.»
english: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Wec jøøa näk othøw nee dëëtge koonyge keerge. 'Ba ïïni, ciï ni køpï gïr buc Jwøk.»
english: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Ni kö mørri, na «A cäädhö køørï, Kwäärö. 'Ba wec a dïciel, naa cøøa kuna määdha jø paara.»
english: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo këël cere ri puur ni lwïthe ŋääe mo rømø ki buc Jwøk.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø Kwäärö ajëëdö ki jiy ma pïërabïriiø møøk, ni jääŋ geni nyïme no oriewi oriewi, yïth mïëri ki kwöra dee ci yïthge bëët.
english: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Pwödhö aciek døc, 'ba jø tïïc nøk. Kiper manøgønø, kwayu wää pwödhö, nee jääk yi pwödhö mare ki jø tïïc.
english: Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest.

anywaa: Cou nø. 'Ba neennu, aani, a jääŋŋa u wøk kaamar nyïïdïëk mo ena dï kwäänynye.
english: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.

anywaa: 'Ba käru käädö ki gïr gwel, ko opïr, ki war. Ni bäŋe ŋat määthu waŋjöö.
english: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.

anywaa: 'Ba øtø mano wäro dønynyu yie, wäru wø kwøŋu köö, ni ‹Bëët-mëër bëëde ødi.›
english: And into whatsoever house ye enter, first say, Peace be to this house.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo bëëdö ka bëët-mëër kaace, bëët mëër maru obëëdö bääte. 'Ba nee bäŋgø, bëët-mëër maru oduu baŋu.
english: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

anywaa: Ni putu bëëte ødøca, nou cämö ni mädhu ki gïïo mëëkge uuni. Kiper ŋat tïïc wø rømi ka gät tïïc mare. Ni ba dääŋu, nou cøøa ødi nø, ni cou ødi.
english: And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

anywaa: 'Ba paano wäro cou yie ni pänhge uuni, cammu gïïo cïp nyïmmu jaak.
english: And into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you:

anywaa: Ni kønynyu jøw otuu yi gø, ni kööu jïge, ni ‹Ennø, buc Jwøk anø ö kany mo cään ki uuni.›
english: And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba paano wäro cou yie, ni ba pänhge uuni, wär uutjïëthe moe caathu, nou köö,
english: But into whatsoever city ye enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say,

anywaa: ni ‹Këël tør pou ni en tietwa en, teeŋwa dëëtu. 'Ba wär ŋäyu ni buc Jwøk anø ö kany mo cään ki uuni.›
english: Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, noo tïmö ni theemma ajäl Cødam ki paanøca dïcäŋöca.
english: But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

anywaa: «Otïmö ni raac jïrï, ï na Köradhin. Noo tïmö ni raac jïrï, ï na Betheeda. Kiper doo nää tïïe moa døøŋŋø na tïïc dïïu, tïïca yi Tayar ki Caydan, dëëtge doo na ege nø løk cøøn, ni ge käära keece na abïïe ni geno pï piny yi bur.
english: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni theemma ajäl Tayar ki Caydan ka ajäla maru, kanyo ŋøl luup yie.
english: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.

anywaa: ?'Ba ï na Kapernaam, iï caarø niï doo røønyø maal? Beeye kar ajäla noo leeŋ ïïni yie.»
english: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to hell.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jï bääge, ni «Ŋato wïny maru, wïnynya mara. Ni ŋato kwier uuni, kwiera aani. 'Ba ŋato kwier aani, kwiera eni na jääŋ aani.»
english: He that heareth you heareth me; and he that despiseth you despiseth me; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa näk pïërabïriiø ni duuge ni yïthge met, ni köge, ni «Kwäärö, këël anäge atïmö ni lwäär ki waani kany wø wïnyge nyeŋŋï.»
english: And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Ceethan ajooda ni pänhnhö ki maal kaamar agaackøth.
english: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

anywaa: Neennu, uuna wëëga teek ki man nyøru thwöre ka agarapi, ki teek ki man böötu teek mar nyimän bäre na näk anägö, ni bäŋ gïn mo gwaar uuni.
english: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

anywaa: 'Ba kär yïthu mïnnö kiper mana tïm juuwi moa reyø ni lwäär ki uuni, 'ba yïthu mïnge kiper mana näk mo nyeŋŋu ogöörö maalø.»
english: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba yi caannøca, Jecu yie amïnnö ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni kööe, ni «Ïïna pwøa, Awuuö, ï na Kwääc maal ki piny, kiper mana mänï gïï ki jøøa wïthge leer na ŋäc jammi, ni nyoothï geni jï obwöre moa mar. Kiper beeye mana manynyï ki met yiï, Awuuö.
english: In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.

anywaa: «Jammi bëët onø wëëk Wära aani, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc Wäädö, 'ba beeye Wuuö keere, ni bäŋe dhaanhø mo ŋäc Wuuö, 'ba beeye Wäädö keere, ki ŋat wø met yi Wäädö ki man nyooth eni jïgø.»
english: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni Jecu aluk baŋ bääge, ni cään ge keerge, ni kööe, ni «Gwïëth en røk nyeŋ wø neen gïï wø neennu.
english: And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see:

anywaa: Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni nyïïkuk Jwøk mo thööth ki nyeye, gena many man neenge gïï ni neennu ii, 'ba kärge neenø. Ni manyge man wïnyge gïï ni wïnynyu ii, 'ba kärge wïnynyö.»
english: For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, nyen mør ma ŋat wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk aö maal ni päänynya Jecu, ni kööe, ni «?Dïpööy, agïnaŋø noo tïïa naa jïta ki kwøw mana näk bäŋ cuŋŋe?»
english: And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, na «?Agïnaŋø na näk ogöörö yïth ciik Jwøk? ?Wø kwaanï gø nidïï?»
english: He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

anywaa: Ni løk gø, ni « ‹Ï doo mëër ki Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøï ki cwïnyï bäre, ki jwïëyï bäre, ki teegï bäre, ka acaayï bäre. Ni mëërï ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï.› »
english: And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, na «Aduuï na kare. Put bëëtö niï tïïya gø, niï kwøwï.»
english: And he said unto him, Thou hast answered right: this do, and thou shalt live.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni manynya man piem dëëre, ena köö jï Jecu, ni «?Ŋat mør aŋa ni daa mëër ki gø?»
english: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Da dhaanhø mør mo oaay Jerucalem ni cøøa Jerikö, ni päth ceŋ dïtwïëte, ni twierge eni, ni pwötge gø, ni aacge, ni wiige gø piny ni kare cään ki thøø.
english: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da dïlämi mør ma aöö mo cura jöörögø. 'Ba na joot ŋatøgø, kar gø aŋaade.
english: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø ŋat mør ma ŋat tuuŋ Libay aöö ki kaace ni joot gø, ni cäŋ gø ŋaatø.
english: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyï Cameria mør ma aöö ki jöörögø thuwø, ni pïïe kanya en ŋatøce yie. 'Ba na joot gø, cwïnye apädhö ki gïr gø,
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him,

anywaa: ni ci baŋ gø, ni twöc ŋwiit gø ka abïïe, ni maaw ki køøŋ nyïïomøki ee thii nyeŋge. Ni kïth gø bäät arëëne kiree, ni kïth gø øt wëëlle, ni gwøk gø.
english: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

anywaa: 'Ba na näk aruunnø man, akän wøk ki gwel ariiø, ni mëëk ge ŋata en øt wëëlle cere, ni kööe, ni ‹Gwøk eni. 'Ba ni näk moøgø rëëm, ocoola jïrï kanyo duua.›
english: And on the morrow when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever thou spendest more, when I come again, I will repay thee.

anywaa: ?Aŋa nø, na wat nyena päth ceŋ dïtwïëte, dï jøøa na adäk yøø?»
english: Which now of these three, thinkest thou, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves?

anywaa: Ni kö ŋatøgø, ni «Beeye ŋata køny gø.» Ni kö Jecu jïgø, «Ciï ni tïïï na enøgønø thuwø.»
english: And he said, He that shewed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do thou likewise.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu ki bääge kanya cääthge waŋjöö, ena pïï paac mør, ni pänhnhi ya nyaan mørri mo nyeŋŋe Martha paare.
english: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaanøgø jïre da coki ma nyakøø mo nyeŋŋe Meeri, na pï tiet Kwäärö ni wïnynya pwöc mo gø.
english: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

anywaa: 'Ba Martha wïïe akiere ki tïïc caammi. Ni ci baŋ Jecu ni kööe, na «?Aŋø Kwäärö, bäŋ gïn caarï ki man näk mo coka tïïc caammi ee wëëk aani keera? Caanï jïre naa kønye.»
english: But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Kwäärö jïgø, ni «Martha, Martha, wïïï akierï ni dëërï iï öölö ki jammi mo thööth.
english: And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things:

anywaa: 'Ba da gïrpiny aciel keere na doo manynyø. 'Ba Meeri mana beer ajiere, mo bäŋ ŋat mo doo käla gø wøk cer gø.»
english: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

anywaa: Dïcäŋ aciel Jecu alämö kanymør. 'Ba kanya lønye ki lam, bääŋe aciel aköö jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, pwöny wa ki lam, kaamar Jøøn na pwöny bääge.»
english: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kany wø lämu, wäru wø kööu, «ni ‹Wääwa, nyeŋŋï wøør. Buyï ööe.
english: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.

anywaa: Wëëk wa jïtö ki cam ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

anywaa: Ni weyï moa bacwa, kiper waani thuwø, jø wø bääö dëëtwa bëët wø wecwa wiiø. Ni ba bwødhï wa kany mo wa di päänynyö yie.› »
english: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋa dïïu ni jïre da nyawatge mo doo cøøa baŋe ki dï wäär, ni kööe jïgø, ‹Nyawat, a mänynyö baŋï ki muunni adäk,
english: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

anywaa: kiper da nyawatwa mo oöö, mo käla kany mo bäär, 'ba atïmö ni bäŋ gïn cam mo cïba nyïme.›
english: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?

anywaa: Ni dee gø løø ki yi øtø, ni ‹Kär a öölï. Dhi øtø onø cïëgö, naa ena bäät pëëm ki nyïïa. Ba løny jïra ki man ööa maal niï mooa ki gïrpiny.›
english: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

anywaa: A cäänna uuni, ni këël eni ba doo ööa maal ni mooc gø ki gïrpiny kiper na näk nyawatge, eni doo ööa maal kiper mana reeth ree ni mooc gø ki gïno cane.
english: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

anywaa: «'Ba a cäänna uuni, pëëu, ocïp jïïu. Cääu, ojootu. Dööŋu, ojap jïïu.
english: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø pëëö, wø di cïbö jïge, ni ŋat wø määnyö, wø joode joodø. Ni ŋat wø dööŋö, wø di jabø jïre.
english: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

anywaa: ?A uune mane ni en dïïu, ni näk mo opëëny wääde ki rëëö, ni mooc gø ki thwöl na kar rëëö?
english: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

anywaa: ?Wala eni pëënynya tøŋ gwienø, ni mooc gø ka agarap na kar tøŋø?
english: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk u na näk jø raay muuö ŋäyu ki man cïpu ki muuce mo beyø jï nyïïu, a Wääu ni en maal nø, okääŋe nidïï ki man cïp Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere jï jø wø pëëny eni?»
english: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu rëëmma wøk ka anägö mo dhaanhø ee tïïö ni ba cäänö. 'Ba kanya ö anäŋŋögø wøk, ŋata näk ba cäänö atïmö ni cäänö, ni thäŋ yïth jiyi.
english: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk dïge aköö, ni «Eni anäge wø rïëm wøk ka teek Bieldhebap, na näk kwääy anäge.»
english: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk aköö ni ge manynya ŋïï baŋe mo ööi ki maal, ni ge päänynya eni.
english: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba moa caarge ŋääe, ni kööe, ni «Mïëri bëët mo wø pääŋ rege, bëëdö no ränynyö, ni ö jø dhi øtø mo wø pääŋ rege ni päthge.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk Ceethan thuwø dëëre ee pääŋŋö keere, buye a dee cuŋŋö nidïï? Kiper uuna köö, na anäge wø riema wøk ka teek Bieldhebap.
english: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk ma anäge wø riema wøk ka teek Bieldhebap, a jø pou nø, wø rëëmge wøk ki nyeŋ ŋa? Beeye geni noo ŋøl maru piny.
english: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cer Jwøk beeye wø riema anäge wøk ki gø, beeye buc Jwøk na ö bäätu.
english: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

anywaa: Kany wø dee dhaanhø mo teek mo cere da tøŋ mo koora paare, jape ba ränynyi.
english: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mør mo teeka eni ki gø mo öö, ni päär bäät gø ni bööt gø, jap lenye na näk ee ŋäädhö lwøre lwørø, ni twier jap gø ni pääŋ gïïe na twiere.
english: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

anywaa: Ŋat wø ba en kura, män ki aani, ni ŋat wø ba cuuŋö ki aani, mare keth.
english: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

anywaa: «Kany wø ö jwøa raaci wøk dëër dhaanhø, eni wø wïïra kany mo bäŋ pïï ni manynya kar jwöm. 'Ba wø ba jïte, eni wø köö, na ‹A døøa øda, kanya kwøŋa bëëtö yie.›
english: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.

anywaa: 'Ba noo ööe, cwäne cwänö no onø jwiec no ojiiŋŋø.
english: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, eni wø aay ni känne ki juu abïriiø møøk mo kadha rääö marge ki mare, ni dønyge yie, ni putge bëëtö kaace. Ni ö bëët ŋatøca ni tïme ni raac døc ni kaala mana dïkwøŋ.»
english: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.

anywaa: 'Ba na caan gïnögø, nyijø mør mo ena dï lwaak dwøre atïŋ maal, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Gwïëth en ri yia käär ïïni, ki kööra dhøøthï.»
english: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe ni kööe, ni «Gwïëth doo ena ri jø wø wïny luum Jwøk ni gwøkge gø.»
english: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm lwaae ni thöönhnhö, Jecu aköö, ni «Beenhnhi en, gena jiy mo reyø. Ge manynya ŋïï, 'ba bäŋ ŋïï mo nyooth jïge, 'ba beeye ŋïï mar Joona keere.
english: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø otïmö na ŋïï jï beenhnhi en, keda mana ö Joona na tïme na ŋïï jï jø Nineba.
english: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

anywaa: 'Ba nyenynya näk dhaagø mar paana en jï løø tier-piny, ocuŋŋi ki beenhnhi en dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie, ni jääl geni. Kiper ena öö ki kany mo bäär døc kuna wïny leec wïc mar Cølöman. 'Ba ennø, da gïn mo dwøŋŋa eni ki Cølöman mo ena kany.
english: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Nineba, geno cuŋŋi ki beenhnhi en kanyo ŋøl luup yie, ni jäälge geni. Kiper geni cwïnyge aløkge kanya ö Joona na køp luum Jwøk jïge. 'Ba kawaane da gïn mo dwøŋŋa eni ki Joona mo ena kany.
english: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.

anywaa: «Bäŋ ŋat mo nyep lamba ni cäŋ gø kïth yi buur wala tier dak, 'ba wø cïbe bäät tharabëëta, kiper nee jø wø duny øtø nee tar jootge.
english: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.

anywaa: Waŋï beeye lamba mar dëërï. Ni näk waŋï tøŋ, dëërï bäre orømø ki tar. 'Ba ni näk mo waŋï oränynyö, dëërï bäre orømø ki muudhö.
english: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgøøni, gwøk dëërï nee tayø ni en dëërï enø ba tïme na muudhö.
english: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dëërï orømø ki tar ni bäŋ kany mo cøl, dëërï bäre ena yi tar møn, keda man wø ö lamba wø meeny ïïni ki taye.» *Kanya Ö Jecu Na Jääl Jø Paricith
english: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jecu ki cäänö, ena pëëny ŋat Paricithi mør nee ö paare baŋ cam. Ni cøøe ni pï piny kar cam.
english: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ŋat Paricith manøgø yie athäŋŋö kiper mana neen gø, ni ceŋŋe käre kwøŋ lwøk kiper cam ki køør kööŋŋö mar jø døøŋŋø.
english: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

anywaa: 'Ba Kwäärö aköö jïgø, ni «U na jø Paricith, u wø peny ŋää awal ki ŋää athaa, 'ba yïthu päŋ ki møt ki raay.
english: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

anywaa: ?U ni bäŋ wïdhi, aŋø, ŋata cwääc ŋää gïrpiny, yi gø käre tïïö thuwø?
english: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man cïpu jï jøøa can røk gïï wø en ya athaa. Kanyøgø nø, jammi bëët tïmö ni waany jïïu.
english: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.

anywaa: «'Ba otïmö ni raac jïïu, u jø Paricith. Kiper u wø cïpa paac wïth jammi na jëëthe røk gïï wø thenh thenh wø piith bëët, ni weyu mëëc Jwøk ki ŋøl luup ma kare na caane. Gïïögø beege gïïa dou tïïö, ni ba weyu moøgø thuwø.
english: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u jø Paricith, kiper yïthu wø met ki kwör bëëte moa beyø geni yïth uut acook lam, nou manynya man määth uuni kwör gath.
english: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni raac jïïu, kiper u caala bwör mo ba nëëni mo jiy cäädhö ki bäätge jaak ni kucge.»
english: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk nyen mørri mo ena røk jø wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk, ni kööe, ni «Dïpööy, na caanï gïnögø ï geela waani thuwø.»
english: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, no «Otïmö ni raac jïïu thuwø, u wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk. Kiper beege u wø kïth tëër bäät jiy mo peek ki man tïëti, ni u ki dëëtu gïïö peek yøø ba maaru gut këël ki lweetu oceele.
english: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, kiper uuni, uut bwör mo nyïïkuk Jwøk wø geerru geerø, jøøa 'näk kwäyu.
english: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u nyootha dëëtu ni uuno jïëy ki gïïa tïïc kwäyu. Kiper beeye kwäyu na 'näk geni, ni ö uuni ni geerru uut bwöcge.
english: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.

anywaa: Ni beeye na caani ya Jwøki ki leec wïïe, ni ‹Aano jääk baŋge ki nyïïkuk Jwøk ki nyïïatwieli. 'Ba møøk dïge onäkge, ni caange møøk,›
english: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:

anywaa: kiper nee kwöc nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët na nääŋŋi ki kanya täk pinynyi, nee cool ri beenhnhi en,
english: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

anywaa: ni tägi ka rem Eebel këël mano këët ri rem Dhekaraya, ŋata nää yaakic gïn wø cïp olämme bääte ki Øt Jwøk. Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni kwöri moøgø ocool ri beenhnhi en.
english: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïïu, u wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk. Kiper muktää man wø jap jöör adïëri ki gø, alwørru. Uuni ki dëëtu, u kär ci yie, ni tïmu nou gëëŋŋa jøøa doo dønyø.»
english: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya aac Jecu kaace, dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith gena tïmö ni eni ege bïdhö døc, ni ge menna gø ki pïëc kiper jammi mo thööth,
english: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:

anywaa: ni ge køya gøøni, nee jïtge ki luubö mo caane mo maage gø ri gø.
english: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jiy ma kume mo thööth døc rege acooŋge, ni tïmge ni ge nyøra tietge. 'Ba Jecu bääge acäänne, ni kööe, ni «Gwøgu rou ki thøm jø Paricith, na näk atade.
english: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

anywaa: Bäŋ gïrpiny mo ouumö mo ba cäŋ nyoothø, wala gïrpiny mo okanø, mo ba cäŋ jootø.
english: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.

anywaa: Gïn mo you caanø yi muudhö ocäŋ wïnynye yi tar. Ni gïn mo you mooŋø yi øtø kur keeru, ocäŋ køpø ki wïth uudi.
english: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.

anywaa: «Nyïïawääta, a cäänna uuni, ni käru nou lwäyö ki jø wø 'näk dëël, ni wø bäŋ gïn mo maarge tïïc køør gø këët.
english: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

anywaa: 'Ba a nyutha uuni ŋata dou lwäärö. Lwäärru eni, ŋat wø nää, ni jïre da teek ki man cäŋ dhaanhø leeŋ yi maac kar ajäla. Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, lwäärru eni.
english: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, acøki abïïc bäŋ wø ŋeew ka thariipe ariiø? Ni bäŋ aciel dïge mo wï Jwøk wïl ki gø.
english: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?

anywaa: Këëlla jïëc wïthu okwaanø bëët. Käru lwäär. Uuni, letha peru ka acøki mo thööth.
english: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.

anywaa: «'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni jøw bëët mo wø jïëc aani nyïm jiy, ojïëa thuwø, a na Wär Dhaanhø, nyïm nyïïatwiet maal mo Jwøk.
english: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro mooŋ aani nyïm jiy, omooŋ thuwø nyïm nyïïatwiet maal mo Jwøk.
english: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø cäänö ki luubö mo raac dëër Wär Dhaanhø, owec. 'Ba ŋato wäro jany Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, mare ba doo wiiø.
english: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo kïthge uuni baŋ løøk yïth uut acook lam ki nyïm kwääri ki nyïm jøøa näk ocuumö, kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper gïno løgu wala gïno caannu.
english: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:

anywaa: Kiper Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere uuno pwönynye yi caannøca, ki gïno caannu.»
english: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør dï lwaak aköö, ni «Dïpööy, kööm coka nee jap wääwa pääŋwa ki gø.»
english: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «?Nyie, aano tïïya ŋa na dïŋut luup wala dïpääy jïïu?»
english: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Caarru wïthu ni gwøgu rou ki bëët päl cwïny bäre. Kiper dhaanhø bäŋ wø kwøw kiper jammi na thööth jïre.»
english: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

anywaa: Ni par luubö mør jïge kaamar leer, ni «Da wää pwödhe mør mo okwär mo pwöthe okännö ki beel mo thööth.
english: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:

anywaa: Ni pëëny dëëre keere, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa? Kiper bäŋ kany kïtha beega yie.›
english: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni ‹Gïno tïïa beeye en, odïïga orieda, ni cäŋa cwääc ki møøk mo døøŋŋø. Kanyøgønø, beega ki japa bëët okïtha yïthge.
english: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.

anywaa: Ni köömma raa, ni «Ïïni, jïrï da jammi mo thööth, mo okanø kiper cwiiri mo thööth. Jwöm riï nø, ni cämï ni mädhï, ni yiï met.» ›
english: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö jïgø, ‹Ï ni bäŋ wïc en. Wääni en, jwïëyï olwør. ?A kanyøgønø, japa jiiŋŋï yøø otïmge na mo ŋa?›
english: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?

anywaa: 'Ba beeye enønø jï ŋat wø känö ki jammi kiper dëëre keere, ni patha okwär nyïm Jwøk.»
english: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jï bääge, «Kiper manøgønø, a cäänna uuni, ni kär dee gïn lääŋŋu kiper jwïëyu, ki gïïo cammu, ni ba lääŋŋu dëëtu, ka abïïe moo røøu dëëtu.
english: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.

anywaa: Letha per jwïëy ki cam, ni letha per dëëlli ka abïïe.
english: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

anywaa: Caarru weny ni wø ba pïïdhö, ni ge ba kääö, ni wø jïge bäŋ uudi mo känge yïthge, wala odek. 'Ba Jwøk wø poot caama geni. ?Aŋø, ba letha peru døc ki weny?
english: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?

anywaa: ?Na aŋa dïïu ni løny jïre ki man meet nïr kwøw moe ki mo thenh keerge kiper mano lääŋ gø?
english: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?

anywaa: 'Ba nee ba maar lønyø jïïu ki man tïïyu gïn mo thiinh mo caala manøgø, ?aŋø ni lääŋŋu møga ii?
english: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

anywaa: Caarru pïth mar apiite, ni wø ba ööl dëëtge, ni ge ba cwääö ka abïïe kiper dëëtge. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni këël Cølöman ka ajieme bäre, mïërö mar abïïe moe ba caal mïëy aciel dï gïïögø.
english: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk Jwøk luum ni wø marr yi pwödhö dïcäŋi ni leeŋi maac diøø ee døøc mo mïërö, a uuni, u ba dee gø gwøø nidïï, u ni ŋäädhe maru thiinh en?
english: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

anywaa: Käru bëëdö ni cwïnynyu ena køør gïï wø cammu, ki gïï wø maathu, ni ba bëëdu nou lääŋŋa ge ki cwïnynyu.
english: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

anywaa: Kiper juurre mo bäät piny bëët ge caya gïïögø. 'Ba ŋäc Wääu ni en maal nou can ki ge.
english: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man manynyu bura mare. Køøre nø, gïïögø bëët owëëk uuni thuwø.
english: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.

anywaa: «Käru lwäär, u na pïïth mo thiinh en. Kiper Wääu yie met ki man wëëk bura uuni.
english: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

anywaa: Dwøgu japu pwödhö ni cïpu jammi moøgø jï jøøa can. Ni mooyu dëëtu ko opïri mo ba jøøl, ni beege jammi mo okanø maal, ni wø nut karge cooth, kany wø bäŋ kuu mo ci baŋge, ni bäŋe alweela mo räänyö.
english: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.

anywaa: Kiper kanyo kanu japu yie, cwïnynyu oen kanyøca thuwø.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

anywaa: «Bëëdu na abïïgu you kïth dëëtu, ni lambae mou liel,
english: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

anywaa: nou caala jiy mo koora kwääyge mo duuö ki kar nywöm, kiper nee øtø laarge jap jïgø, kanyo ööe noo dööŋe.
english: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.

anywaa: 'Ba laaŋe mo wø nwän kwäärö marge ni ge nëënö kany wø ööe, gwïëth oen bäätge. Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, dëëre okïthe ka abïï tïïc, ni wëëk ge pïïn kar cam ni tïny geni.
english: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ööa ri riet jø koor, wala dääge, ni nwän geni na enønø, laagøgø gwïëth oen bäätge.
english: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäyu gïn, no onää wää øtø caa mano ö kuuwi yie ee ŋääö, eni øde ba dee wëëk toor.
english: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø bëëdu ni rou you jiiŋŋø. Kiper Wär Dhaanhø öö ri caa mo käru dïëdö.»
english: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö jï Jecu, «?Kwäärö, luummögø ni keda leer enø, ï cäänna wa keerwa, wala jï jiy bëët?»
english: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?

anywaa: Ni kö Kwäärö, na «?A laŋŋø mane nø, ni wïïe leer mo maar ka ŋääth, ŋat mo doo cuum kwääye bäät laaŋe bëët paare, nee caapge wø pääŋŋe jïge kany wø näk ma kare?
english: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋø mano nwän kwääye ni tïïö na enøgønø kanyo ööe, gwïëth oen jïre.
english: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni jape bëët owii cer ŋatøgø.
english: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk laŋŋøgø köö ki cwïnye, ni ‹Kwääya aruu ki man ööe,› ni täge ki man pwöt laaŋe møga moa näk cwøw ki mään, ni tïme ni cämö, ni mädhö, ni meeyø,
english: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;

anywaa: kwääy laŋŋøgø oööi ki waŋcäŋ mo käre dïëdö, ki yi caa mo kuue, ni pwöt gø ki pöödö mo teek døc, ni kïth gø røk jøøa ba maar ŋääth.
english: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋo ŋäc mana many kwääye, ni käre ree jiiŋŋø, ni käre moa many kwääye tïïö, opwöt ki pöödö mo dwøŋ.
english: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata kuc mana dee tïïö, ni tïïc gïï mo rømi ka pöödö, opwöt ki pöödö mo thiinh. 'Ba jiy bëët moo näk omooø ki mo thööth, mo thööth opëënynyi baŋge. Ni ŋato wäro wëëk jammi mo thööth, mo thööth omanynyi baŋe.
english: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.

anywaa: «Aani, a ööi naa lëëŋa maac bäät piny, ni doo beer onää onø nyep.
english: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

anywaa: Aani da gïn mo leth mo jwøra jwørø, ni cwïnya lääŋŋa gø døc, këël mano thur kare.
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!

anywaa: ?Aŋø, you caarø naa ööi naa käla bëët-mëër bäät piny? Jïre bäär. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, naa käla apääk.
english: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:

anywaa: Kiper køør man nø, øtø aciel ojïti ki jiy abïïc mo rege ege pääŋŋö. Na adäk oen kur keerge, ni ö ariiwi ni enge kur keerge.
english: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

anywaa: Geni, røkge opääŋge, ni wuuö opääy ki wäädö, ni ö wäädö ni pääe ki wänni, ni ö mïïe ni pääe ki nyaare, ni ö nyeyi ni pääe ki menni, ni ö waŋe ni pääe ki cï nyaare, ni ö cï nyeyi ni pääe ki waŋø.»
english: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø thuwø, Jecu aköö jï lwaak, ni «Kany wø neennu pöölö ni cwää ki jï løø pänh-cäŋ, u wø laara köö, ni ‹Køth pädhö.› Ni beeye kare.
english: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.

anywaa: Ni kany wø jootu jamø ni kwönni ki jï løø tier-piny, u wø köö, ni ‹Cäŋ rieny ni kwaar døc.› Ni beeye kare.
english: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.

anywaa: U na jø atade! Bëët pinyi en, ki bëët maal wø laaru ka ŋec. ?'Ba aŋø nø ni ba ŋäyu man ŋeyu tiet nïri ii?
english: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?

anywaa: «?Aŋø nø, ni ba ŋøllu mano beer ki dëëtu keeru?
english: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk miï aay ki ŋat mo manynya løøk ki ïïni, nou cøøa nyïm kwäärö, beerra man thöörï luubö ki eni kanyo poodu waŋjöö, kiper nee ï ba peee nyïm dïŋut luup, ni ö dïŋut luupi ni cïp ïïni cer kwääy øt twöci, ni ö kwääy øt twöci ni leeŋ ïïni øt twöc.
english: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

anywaa: Aani, a cäänna ïïni, niï bäŋ doo ööa wøk na bäre bäre këël mano coolï mïlïïn mana näk odööŋ.»
english: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø thuwø da jak møøk mo öö ni parge gïr jø Galili jï Jecu, ni beeye gïr jøøa 'näk Paylati ni kuur remge ki rem olämme moge.
english: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøge jïge, ni «?You caarø ni kadha rääc jø Galili moøgø ki jø Galili møga bëët, kiper gïna leth na pïï dëëtge na enøgønø?
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

anywaa: Jïre bäär. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni näk mo cwïnynyu ba løgu, u ränynyö bëët na enøgønø.
english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

anywaa: ?Wala gïr jøøa näk apaar ka abära, na päth øt pööki bäätge yi Caylööm ni 'näk geni, aŋø, you caarø ni kadha bääyö marge ki jøw møga bëët moa bëëdö yi Jerucalem?
english: Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?

anywaa: Jïre bäär. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni näk mo cwïnynyu ba løgu, u ränynyö bëët na enøgønø.»
english: I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu luummi ni keda leer en aput caan, ni kööe, ni «Da nyen mør mo opïïdhö ko olaam yi pwöth jenni mare. Ni ööe ni caya nyey ri gø, 'ba bäŋgø mo ee joodø.
english: He spake also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none.

anywaa: Ni kööm ŋata en pwödhe cere, ni ‹Neenï, cwiiyi na adäk ii, a bëëdö naa cäädhö naa manynya nyey ro olaami en, 'ba bäŋgø mo jooda. Ŋøt piny. ?Aŋø na nyääk piny jaak en?›
english: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe jïgø, ni ‹Kwäärö, wëëk bëëtö cwiini keere, nee tiere koonya ni kïtha gø ki wär.
english: And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it:

anywaa: 'Ba noo näk mo nywøl ki nyïëdi cwiino ööi, doo beer. 'Ba ni näk mo ba nywøl, oŋødï piny.› »
english: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ma dïcäŋ jwömö, Jecu apöö yi øt acooŋ lam mør.
english: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace da dhaagø mør mo dëëre da jwøk mo raac, mo tuu ki cwiiri apaar ka abära, ni tïm kööre no okööm, ni ba maar lønyø jïre ki man rwiec dëëre.
english: And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya Jecu, acwøle, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Nyijøøe, ïïna wec täwï.»
english: And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, thou art loosed from thine infirmity.

anywaa: Ni kïth ceŋŋe bäät gø, ni put dëëre rwiec ni thïïŋ, ni pwøc Jwøk.
english: And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk kwääy øt acooŋ lam manøgø, ena gootø kiper mana ö Jecu na køny dhaanhø ki cäŋ jwömö, ni kööm jiy, ni «Da nïne abïciel mo tïïe doo tïïö yïthge, mou doo öö nou køny, ni patha cäŋ jwömö.»
english: And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Kwäärö jïgø, ni «?U na jø atade, aŋø, da dhaanhø dïïu mo dhere wala arëëne bäŋ wø gøønye ki cäŋ jwömö ni køøl gø baŋ maath pïï?
english: The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

anywaa: ?A nyijøøi en na nyikwaar Eeberam no otwöy Ceethanni ki cwiiri apaar ka abära bëët yøø, a ba dii pädö nidïï ki cäŋ jwömö?»
english: And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan hath bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caan gïnögø, nyïïmänne bëët wïthge alääö. Ni ö lwaae ni mïn yïthge ki gïïa beyø na tïïe bëët.
english: And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aköö, ni «?Buc Jwøk caal ŋø? ?Na agïnaŋø na daa gø päärö ki gø?
english: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?

anywaa: Eni caala waŋ kunhnhö mo thiinh døc, na käl dhaanhe ni piith gø yi pwöthe, ni døøŋŋe ni tïme na jaath, ni gëët wenynyi bääte ki uudi.»
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu acäŋ köö, ni «?Buc Jwøk opäära gø ki ŋø?
english: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?

anywaa: Eni caala thømmø mo olwør dhaage ni kïth gø yi møø ma yïth rumme adäk këël mana wäny møø manøgø bäre.»
english: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni tïŋ wääthe ni cøøa yi Jerucalem, ni caatha dï mïëri moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, ni pöö.
english: And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør aköö jïgø, ni «?Kwäärö, beege jiy mo nøk keerge noo piem?» Ni kööe jïge,
english: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

anywaa: ni «Magu rou døc ki man dønyu ki dhi kiir mana diiny. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni jiy mo thööth omany man dønyge yie, 'ba otïmö ni ba løny jïge.
english: Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able.

anywaa: Kanyo ö wää øte no ö maal, ni dëët øtø, uuno cuŋŋi wøk nou døøŋŋa dhi øtø, nou köö, ni ‹Kwäärö, japï jïwa.› 'Ba oduue jïïu, ni ‹Uuni, kanya ööu ki yie kuua.›
english: When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni uuno köö, ni ‹Waana cämö ni mäthwa ki ïïni, ni pwönynyï waani dï powa.›
english: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.

anywaa: 'Ba eno köö, na ‹A cäänna uuni, ni kanya ööu ki yie kuua. Daagu rou buuta, u bëët, u jø wø tïïc gïï mo reyø.›
english: But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence ye are; depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce, nou jootu Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap ki nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët ni ge ena buc Jwøk, ni uuni ki dëëtu, uuno cöör wøk, uuno jwöŋi ni möötu lagu.
english: There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when ye shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy oööi ki jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ki jï løø kur pänh-cäŋ, ki wï-piny, ki tier-piny, ni pïge piny kar cam yi buc Jwøk.
english: And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, jø møøk mo ena nyïm ennø, odøø cään, ni ö møøki mo ena cään ennø, ni pööthge maal.»
english: And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last.

anywaa: 'Ba ki nyi kanyøgø kiree, jak møøk ma jø Paricith aöö baŋ Jecu, ni köge jïgø, ni «Laar riï daak kany, kiper Eerat manynya man 'näk ïïni.»
english: The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get thee out, and depart hence: for Herod will kill thee.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Cou ni caannu gø jï anyaayøce, ni ‹Neenï, a rëëmma wøk ka anäge, naa kunyö ki ŋwiili dïcäŋi ki diøø, 'ba noo tïme na dää nïne, tïïc mara othööra.›
english: And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

anywaa: 'Ba a aay ki wäätha dïcäŋi, ki diøø, ka aruunnø man. Kiper nyikuŋ Jwøk ba doo nääö kanymør jaak, ni patha yi Jerucalem.
english: Nevertheless I must walk to day, and to morrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem.

anywaa: «Wui, Jerucalem, Jerucalem, ï wø nääŋ nyïïkuk Jwøk ni këërï jø wø jääŋŋi baŋï ki kïte. ?A kwöre adïï naa manynya man cooŋa nyïïï kanya ciel, kaawat man wø tïïc gwienø wø cooŋ nyïïe tiet bwöpe, nou kweeyø?
english: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

anywaa: 'Ba neennu, pou adööŋ jïïu no oränynyö. 'Ba a cäänna uuni, naa ba jootu këël mano kööu, ni ‹Gwïëth en jï ŋat ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.› »
english: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, Ye shall not see me, until the time come when ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ jwömö aciel na ci Jecu baŋ cam yi øt nyen mør mo kare dwøŋ dï jø Paricith, gena tïmö ni ge neeta eni døc.
english: And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da dhaanhø mør mo ena nyïme mo dëëre obooc.
english: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu jø wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith apëënynye, ni kööe, «?Beeye gïn mo orømø ki køør ciik Jwøk ki man køny dhaanhø mo tuu ki cäŋ jwömö, wala jïre bäär?»
english: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?

anywaa: 'Ba gena lïŋö jaak. Kanyøgø Jecu ŋatøgø akäle ni køny gø, ni wëëk gø wääth.
english: And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go;

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋa dïïu ni jïre da arëën wala dhieŋ mo opäth yi iith ki cäŋ jwömö, ni ba laar gø käl wøk?»
english: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atïmö ni ba maarge løk.
english: And they could not answer him again to these things.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, Jecu jøøa näk ocwølø ki eni kar cam acäänne ki luubö mo keda leer, kanya joot geni ni ge jiera kwör bëëte moa beyø geni. Ni kööe jïge,
english: And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them,

anywaa: ni «Kany wø näk mo ïïno cwøl ŋat mørri kar nywöm, kärï pï kany mo owøørø, kiper kanymør da ŋat mo dwøŋŋa kare ki ïïni mo ee cwølø.
english: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata cwøl uuni öö ni kööm ïïni, ni ‹Wëëk kany nyeni.› Kanyøgønø, wïïï lääö noo daaï kar bëëtö jaak.
english: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee, Give this man place; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø cwøl ï kar nywöm, ciï ni pïï kar bëëtö jaak, kiper kanyo ö ŋata cwøl ïïni niï köömme, ni ‹Nyie nyawat, ci kanyø beer ice.› Kanyøgønø, ï tïmö ni ïïno wøørø nyïm jøøa en kar cam ki ïïni na aciel.
english: But when thou art bidden, go and sit down in the lowest room; that when he that bade thee cometh, he may say unto thee, Friend, go up higher: then shalt thou have worship in the presence of them that sit at meat with thee.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø døøc dëëtge mo døøŋŋø, odwøk piny. 'Ba ŋat wø døøc dëëre mo can, otïïc ni dwøŋ.»
english: For whosoever exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋata cwøl eni kar cam acäänne thuwø, ni kööe, ni «Kany wø tïmï ki cam jï jiy, nee mar wäär wala waŋcäŋ, kär niï cwøla jøøa näk nyïïawäätï, wala nyïïmeru, wala tuuŋu, wala jø atut moï mo okwär. Kanymør ï läwge ka cwøl thuwø ni ge cunna ïïni.
english: Then said he also to him that bade him, When thou makest a dinner or a supper, call not thy friends, nor thy brethren, neither thy kinsmen, nor thy rich neighbours; lest they also bid thee again, and a recompence be made thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ï tïmö ki cam jï jiy, cwøl jøøa can, ki jøøa näk dëëtge oränynyö, ki ŋööte, ki cööye.
english: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:

anywaa: 'Ba ïïno gwïëth, kiper ï ba maarge cunnö. 'Ba ïïno cunni cäŋo duu jøøa beyø wøk ki yi thøø.»
english: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.

anywaa: 'Ba nyen mør dëët jøøa en kar cam ki Jecu na aciel, na wïny gïnögø, ena köö jïgø, ni «Gwïëth oen dëër ŋato cämö ki møø buc Jwøk.»
english: And when one of them that sat at meat with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Da dhaanhø mør mo otïïö ki cam mo päl ni cwøl jiy mo thööth.
english: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïcäŋ cam, eni laŋŋe ajääŋŋe nee jøøa näk ocwølø köömme, ni ‹Ööu, jammi bëët anø løny.›
english: And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready.

anywaa: 'Ba gena kweer karge bëët. Ni kö mana dïkwøŋŋi, ni ‹Aana ŋëëö ki pwödhö, maa bäŋ doo kääŋö ki man neena gø. A kwaya ïïni, naa weyï.›
english: And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must needs go and see it: I pray thee have me excused.

anywaa: Ni kö maya, ni ‹Aana ŋëëö ki rwäth puur apaar. A cøøa kuna päänynya geni. A kwaya ïïni, naa weyï.›
english: And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray thee have me excused.

anywaa: Ni kö mørri, ni ‹Aana nyöömmö ki dhaagø. Kiper manøgønø, a ba maar öö.›
english: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.

anywaa: Køøre laŋŋøgøøni aöö ni køp gïïögø jï kwääye. Kanyøgønø, kwääyögø na wää paaci enø, laŋŋe acäänne no ogootø, ni kööe, ni ‹Laar ci wøk ni caathï uutjïëthe moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø dï pääny, ni kälï jøøa can ki moa näk oränynyö, ki cööye ki ŋööte.›
english: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

anywaa: Ni kö laŋŋøgø, ni ‹Kwäärö, gïna caanï anø tïïc, 'ba poot da kany mo laac.›
english: And the servant said, Lord, it is done as thou hast commanded, and yet there is room.

anywaa: Ni kö kwääyögø jï laŋŋø, ni ‹Ci uutjïëthe moa døøŋŋø ki moa näk ogaaŋŋø ki deŋge, ni magï jiy ki teek nee öge, nee øda pääŋe.
english: And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna ïïni, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa näk ocwølø moo bel cama.› »
english: For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø lwaak mo päl aläp køør Jecu, ni ö eni ni løø nyïme baŋge, ni kööe jïge,
english: And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them,

anywaa: ni «Ni näk da ŋat mo ööa baŋa ni ba män ki wänni, ki menni, ki cïïe, ki nyïïe, ki nyïïmenni, këël jwïëye kiree, ŋatøgø ba maar tïmö na bääŋa.
english: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

anywaa: Ni ŋato wäro ba käär jaadhe na näk odëëdö, ni cäädhe køøra, ba maar tïmö na bääŋa.
english: And whosoever doth not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple.

anywaa: ?Kiper aŋa dïïu ni many man gëëde ki øtø mo dwøŋ ni ba kwøŋ pï piny ni kwaan jape ki man näk mo rømø ki gø?
english: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

anywaa: Kiper kanymør kanyo cwääc tier gø ni tïme ni ba maar lønyø jïre ki man thöör dëër gø, jiy bëët mo wø neen gø tïmö ni buua gø,
english: Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

anywaa: ni ge köö, ni ‹Nyeni agëëdö ki øtø, 'ba atïmö ni ba maar lønyø jïre ki man thöör gø.›
english: Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish.

anywaa: ?Wala a nyenynye mane na doo ci kuna këëde ki nyeya mør mo määnynyö baŋe, ni ba kwøŋ pï piny ni cooŋ jiy, nee maara lønyø jïre ki man aae ki jiy ma kume apaar kuna røømge ki ŋata ö baŋe ki jiy ma kume ma pïërariiø?
english: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ba løny jïre, kanyo poot maya ni kare poot bäär, eni ööta baŋe ki dwøl, ni kwaya bëët-mëër.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ŋato wäro en dïïu noo ba taak japa en jïre bëët, ba maar tïmö na bääŋa.
english: So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsaketh not all that he hath, he cannot be my disciple.

anywaa: «Acäbö met. ?'Ba ni näk ma acäbö lawe obänhnhö, lawe ocäŋ døø kare nidïï?
english: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?

anywaa: Tïmö ni ba rømi ki man jøri yi pwödhö wala leeŋa wï thuur wär. 'Ba wet jiyi wetø. Nee da ŋat mo jïre da ïdhi mo wïnye ki ge, beerra man cek ïthe.»
english: It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø ajwäk ki jø raay bëët gena tïmö ni ge nyänhnha buut Jecu kuna wïnyge dwøre.
english: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk gena ŋurö, ni köge, ni «Nyeni jïëy ki jø raay ni cämö ki ge.»
english: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receiveth sinners, and eateth with them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø luummi na keda leer acaane jïge, ni kööe,
english: And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

anywaa: na «?Aŋa dïïu ni jïre da dïëk ma dïpa, ni näk ma aciel orwäänyö dïge, ni ba wii pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween dï paap ni ci køør mana rwäänyö këël mano joot gø?
english: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?

anywaa: 'Ba noo joot gø, tïŋe ŋute ni yie met.
english: And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö paac, nyïïawääte bëët cwøle cwølø, ki jø wø en buut paare, ni kööe jïge, ni ‹Yïthu mïnge ki aani na aciel, kiper diera mana rwäänyö, ajooda.›
english: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni da met ec mo päl maal ma enønø kiper ŋat raay aciel mo cwïnye ee løø, ni kaala met ec mana di eci mïnnö kiper jiy ma pïërabïŋween ka abïŋween mo beyø mo bäŋ løk cwïny mo manyge.
english: I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

anywaa: «?A dhaaŋŋe mane ni jïre da gwel apaar, ni näk ma aciel orwäänyö dëëre, ni ba nyep lamba ni jwiec øtø ni cac gø døøc, këël mano joot gø?
english: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo joot gø, nyïïawääte cwøle cwølø bëët ki jø wø en buut paare, ni kööe, ni ‹Yïthu mïnge ki aani na aciel, kiper gwella rwäänyö dëëra, ajooda.›
english: And when she hath found it, she calleth her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni da met ec ma enønø nyïm nyïïatwiet maal mo Jwøk kiper ŋat raay aciel mo cwïnye ee løø.»
english: Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, ni «Da ŋat mør mo jïre da wääte ariiø.
english: And he said, A certain man had two sons:

anywaa: 'Ba mana thiinh dïge aköö jï wänni, na ‹Awuuö, mëëk a thääŋ jammi moa näk kura.› Ni pääŋ jape ki dïge.
english: And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me. And he divided unto them his living.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne mo nøk, wäädö mana thiinh jape bëët alwøre ni tïŋŋe ni aa paac mør mo bäär, ni raany jape kaace ki bëëtö mo raac.
english: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø raany jammi bëët, meel mo dwøŋ apïï paanøca, ni tïme ni can døc.
english: And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in want.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, ena ci buut nyen mør ma nyï paanøca, ni ö ŋatøgø ni wëëk gø ciin yi kar kwaath kuna caam othuri.
english: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.

anywaa: 'Ba eni yie doo met ki mana dee cämö ki caap othuri. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo mooc gø ki cam.
english: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba na caar wïïe ni pëëny dëëre keere, ena köö, na ‹?A jø tïïc adïï ni en jï wära ni jïge da cam mo päl mo dhäthö, ni thøøa ki käc kany en?
english: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

anywaa: Aani, a aay ni cøøa baŋ wära, ni caana gø jïre, na «Awuuö, aana bääyö nyïm Jwøk ki nyïmï.
english: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee,

anywaa: A ba rømi ki man cwøl aani ni aana wäädï këët. 'Ba tïïc a ni aana ŋat tïïï jaak.» ›
english: And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

anywaa: Ni ö maal ni tïŋŋe ni ci baŋ wänni. 'Ba kanya poode ni kare bäär, ena joot wänni, ni päth cwïnye ki gïr gø, ni reŋe ni gääm gø, ni nuum dhi gø.
english: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

anywaa: 'Ba wäädö aput köö jïgø, na ‹Awuuö, aana bääyö nyïm Jwøk ki nyïmï. A ba rømi ki man cwøl aani ni aana wäädï këët.›
english: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk wuuö laaŋe moe aluumme, ni ‹Laaru kännö ka abïï ma wøp døc, ni kïthu gø dëëre, ni kïthu cere ko ogut, ni kïthu tiete ki war.
english: But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet:

anywaa: Ni kälu rwaadha näk olør, ni 'nägu gø, nee ø cämø ni mïn yïthø.
english: And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

anywaa: Kiper wääda man en athøw, 'ba acäŋ kwøwø. Ni rwäänye, ni cäŋi jootø.› Ni mïn yïthge.
english: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyøgø wäädö mana riek ena yi pwödhö. 'Ba na ööe ni tïm kare ni cään ki øtø, dwør thoom ki meeŋ awïnynye.
english: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.

anywaa: Ni cwöte ki laŋŋø aciel røk laaŋe, ni pëëny gø, ni ‹?Manøgø tiere aŋø?›
english: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïgø, ni ‹Coku aöö, ni ö wäru ni 'näk rwaadha näk olør, kiper na joot gø ni dëëre jööt.›
english: And he said unto him, Thy brother is come; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf, because he hath received him safe and sound.

anywaa: 'Ba wäädö manøgø agootø ni kweere ki ciin øtø. Ni ö wänni wøk baŋe ni kwaac gø.
english: And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and entreated him.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøge jï wänni, ni ‹Neenï, cwiiyi ni thööth ii a bëëdö naa tïnynya ïïni, ni dwørï kära dhalø dïcäŋ aciel bäre bäre. 'Ba bäŋ dïcäŋ aciel maa iï mooø ki nyidiel nee yia mïnne ki nyïïawääta.
english: And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment: and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends:

anywaa: 'Ba wäädï enøgø na raany japï ki kääpe na ööe, rwaadha näk olør anääŋŋï eni.›
english: But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living with harlots, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf.

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïgø, ni ‹Wääda, cooth ï wø ena buuta, ni japøgø bëët na 'moa yøø beege moï.
english: And he said unto him, Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïn ma wøp ki man kwäägø ni mïn yïthø, kiper coku man en athøw, 'ba acäŋ kwøwø. Ni rwäänye, ni cäŋi jootø.› »
english: It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.

anywaa: Kanyøgø thuwø, Jecu aköö jï bääŋi, ni «Da nyen mør mo okwär mo jïre da kwääy tïïc mo jape ee wii cer gø, ni wïny luup møøk kiper gø, ni eni räänyö ki jape.
english: And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods.

anywaa: Ni put gø cwøl baŋe, ni kööe jïgø, na ‹?Agïnaŋø ni wïnynya kiperï en? Mëëk a wëëlla en cerï nee jammi cääbø, kiper ï ba maar bëëdö ni ïïna kwääy tïïc këët.›
english: And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of thee? give an account of thy stewardship; for thou mayest be no longer steward.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääy tïïögø ni pëëny dëëre keere, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa nø, ni ö kwääya ni käl tïï kwär wøk cera? Kiper a jääk ki puur, ni wïïa laay ki kwac.
english: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.

anywaa: 'Ba mano tïïa ajooda, kiper naa wëëk jiyi ciin mïëcge kanyo käl a wøk yi tïï kwär.›
english: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, jø pïït mo kwäärö mare acøøre no oceele oceele, ni pëëny mana dïkwøŋ, na ‹?A jap kwääya adïï ni en bäätï?›
english: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø, ni ‹Dëëra da baarmïïle mo maaw ma dïpa.› Ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Lwør wëël acääba marï, ni laarï pï piny ni göörï pïërabïïc yie.›
english: And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty.

anywaa: Køøre mør apëënynye, na ‹?A jammi adïï ni en bäätï?› Ni dwøk gø, ni ‹Dëëra da cwaat beel ma dïpa.› Ni kööm gø, ni ‹Lwør wëël acääba marï, ni göörï pïërabära yie.›
english: Then said he to another, And how much owest thou? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take thy bill, and write fourscore.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø nø, kwääyögø, kwääy tïïc manøgø ni bëëte raac enø apwøe kiper mana caar wïïe. Kiper wäät pinyi en, nyeŋge reegø ki man ŋäcge dëëtge keerge ni kaala wäät tar.
english: And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra, a cäänna uuni, ni määnynyu dëëtu ki nyïïawäädi ki jap kwärö mo bäät piny, kiper dïcäŋo thum jammi yie, nou jïëc kwör bëëte moa näk bäŋ cuŋge.
english: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat wø ŋääth ri jammi mo nøk, maar ka ŋääth thuwø ki jammi mo thööth. 'Ba ŋat wø ba ŋääth ri jammi mo nøk, ba maar ŋääth thuwø ki jammi mo thööth.
english: He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mo u kär ŋäädhö ri jap kwärö mo bäät piny, aŋa noo wëëk u jap kwärö moa näk adïëri?
english: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk mo u kär ŋäädhö ri jap ŋat mør, aŋa noo wëëk u japa näk mou?
english: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat tïïc mo doo tïny kwääri ariiø. Kiper eni løny ki man männe ka aciel ni mëëre ki maya, wala cwïnye wëëge aciel ni jøøŋ maya. Kiper ba løny jïïu ki man tïnynyu Jwøk ni tïnynyu jap piny.»
english: No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith na mëër ki jammi, moøgø bëët awïnyge, ni buuge gø.
english: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Beeye uuni ni wø pwøc dëëtu keeru nyïm jiy nou beyø, 'ba cwïnynyu ŋäc Jwøki. Kiper gïn wø näk wøp døc ki jï jiy, beeye gïna raaca eni ki jï Jwøk.
english: And he said unto them, Ye are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knoweth your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God.

anywaa: «Kiper ciik Jwøk ki mo nyïïkuk Jwøk abëëdö këël mana ö Jøønni. Køøre nø, atïmö ni køpa luumma nyään na met kiper buc Jwøk, ni tïm jiyi bëët ni cøøa yie ni ge rïïö.
english: The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presseth into it.

anywaa: 'Ba doo jööta eni ki man dak maalli ki piny, ki man tïm thääŋ piil ciik Jwøki mo thiinh ni pätha wøk.
english: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.

anywaa: «Ŋato wäro kwier cïïe ni cäŋ nyöömmö ki dhaagø mør, mare luk. Ni ŋato wäro nywøm dhaagø mo opääö ki cwøre, mare luk.
english: Whosoever putteth away his wife, and marrieth another, committeth adultery: and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery.

anywaa: «'Ba da nyen mør mo okwär, mo wø käära abïïe ma wøpe, mo cam päl jïre cooth.
english: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:

anywaa: 'Ba dhi kiire da nyen mør mo can mo ree ee nyaaŋ piny mo cwøl ni Ladhara, mo dëëre ogääbö ki ŋwiili.
english: And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores,

anywaa: Ni eni manynya man cam gïï wø päth piny kar cam ŋata no okwär. Ni kaace da guu thuwø mo wø öö ni naaŋge ŋwiite.
english: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋata can athøw, ni kääri ya nyïïatwiet maalli ni kïthge gø köör Eeberam. Køøre ŋata no okwär athøw thuwø, ni koonyi.
english: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

anywaa: 'Ba ena kïth kar pöödö yi rääm mo leth døc. Ni tïŋ wïïe maal ni neen Eeberam kany mo bäär ni Ladhara ena kööre.
english: And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.

anywaa: Ni cwøl gø, na ‹Awuuö ma Eeberam, køny aani. Jääŋ Ladhara, nee wï lweete keere kïth yïth pïï, nee leeba ŋïnynye. Kiper dëëra waŋŋi ki maai.›
english: And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam aköö, ni ‹Wääda, caar wïïï ki kanya bëëdï piny niï kwøw. Ïïno jäŋ ki jammi mo beyø. 'Ba Ladhara bëëdö ka bëët can yïth jammi mo reyø. 'Ba kawaane cwïnye ee cïp piny kany, ni ïïni, ï ena yi rääm.
english: But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

anywaa: 'Ba maya thuwø, yïthakiyø da aŋaak mo dwøŋ døc mo otïïö, kiper nee jøøa doo many man känhge baŋu ki kany, nee ba maar lønyø jïge. Ni bäŋe dhaanhø thuwø mo doo känhnhö ki kunögø ni ö baŋwa.›
english: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö, ‹'Ba a kwaya ïïni, awuuö, nee eni jääŋŋï dhi øt wära.
english: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

anywaa: Kiper jïra da nyïïmera abïïc, nee ge köömme. Kiper kanymør ge ööa kany thuwø na kar rääm en.›
english: For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam aköö, ‹Luup Modhe ki mo nyïïkuk Jwøk ena baŋge. Beerra man wïnyge geni.›
english: Abraham saith unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö, ‹Jïre bäär, awuuö ma Eeberam; ni näk mo da dhaanhø mo cøøa baŋge ki dëët jøøa näk othøw, cwïnyge løkge løø.›
english: And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent.
