anywaa: 'Ba Eeberam aköö jïgø, ‹Ni näk luup mo Modhe ki mo nyïïkuk Jwøk ba wïnyge, këël doo da dhaanhø mo duua wøk ki yi thøø, yïthge ba dege ciiø thuwø.› »
english: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jï bääge, ni «Gïï wø wëëk dhaanhø bääyö öö, ni ba kääŋi. 'Ba otïmö ni raac jï ŋat wø öge ki baŋe.
english: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!

anywaa: Doo beerra eni kiper ŋatøgø ki man twöö kïn guur ŋute, ni leeŋi yi naama dwøŋ, ki man wëëk aciel dëët moi ni therø ii bääyö.
english: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou. Ni näk coku obääyö, joogï; 'ba ni näk mo wïïe caare caarø, wär wëënnï.
english: Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk eni bääyö dëërï kwöre abïriiø ki dïcäŋ aciel ni cäŋ duu baŋï kwöre abïriiø ni kööe, ni ‹Wïïa acaara,› wär wëënnï.»
english: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nyïïatwieli aköö jï Kwäärö, ni «Meet ŋäädhe marwa.»
english: And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

anywaa: 'Ba Kwäärö aköö, ni «Doo na jïïu da ŋäädhe mo caala nyi waŋ kunhnhö mo thiinh døc, doo maar lønyø jïïu ki man köömmu jaadhi en, ni ‹Puth riï wøk kany, ni piidhï riï yi naama dwøŋ,› ni dee luummu leŋø.
english: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

anywaa: «?Da dhaanhø dïïu mo jïre da laŋŋø mo purö wala kwaaya dïëk mo doo köö jïgø kanyo ööe ki yi pwödhö, ni ‹Put pöönhnhö nø, ni pïï piny kar cam›?
english: But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he is come from the field, Go and sit down to meat?

anywaa: ?Bäŋ doo köö jïgø, ni ‹Jiiŋ cam mara ni kïthï abïïk tïïc dëërï ni tïnynyï aani këël mano cäma ni mädha; køøre nø, ïïno cämö ni mädhï.›?
english: And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird thyself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink?

anywaa: ?Eni laŋŋøgø dee pwøø kiper mana tïïc gïna caan jïre?
english: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø, kany wø nø tïïyu gïï wø caan jïïu bëët, wäro wø kööu, ni ‹Waana laaŋe mo bäŋ gïrwa, 'ba wa tïïya tïïa näk owii ceŋwa cøøn.› »
english: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na aae ni cøøa Jerucalem, ena cør yïthakic Cameria ki Galili.
english: And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïe paac mør, jiy apaar mo dëëtge da dhøøbø arøømmø ki eni, ni cuŋge kany mo bäär,
english: And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood afar off:

anywaa: ni tïŋge döötge maal, ni köge, ni «Kwäärö, Jecu, køny canwa!»
english: And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us.

anywaa: 'Ba na neen geni, ena köö jïge, ni «Cou ni nyoothu dëëtu jï dïlämme.» 'Ba kanya aacge, dëëtge adøø karge ni beyø.
english: And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhaanhø aciel dïge na joot gø ni dëëre odøø kare, aduuö, ni eni pwøya Jwøk ki dwøl mo päl.
english: And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God,

anywaa: Ni päth tiet Jecu, ni pwøc gø. 'Ba nyenøgø, ena nyï Cameria.
english: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, Jecu aköö, na «?Aŋø, patha jiy apaar na bëëde na dëëtge køny? ?Age abïŋween?
english: And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine?

anywaa: ?Aperŋø ni bäŋe dhaanhø aciel mo oduuö ni pwøc Jwøk, ni tïme ni duua ŋati keere na jur en?»
english: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ö maal ni ciï ki jöörï. Ŋäädhe marï dëërï adwøk kare.»
english: And he said unto him, Arise, go thy way: thy faith hath made thee whole.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jø Paricithi na pëënyge Jecu ki kany ö buc Jwøki yie, adwøge jïge, ni «Buc Jwøk ba ööi ki ŋïïce mo di neenø.
english: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

anywaa: Ni jiy ba doo köö, ni ‹Neennu, beeye eni en,› wala ‹Eni ice.› Kiper buc Jwøk ena dïïu.»
english: Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.

anywaa: Ni kööe jï bääge, ni «Cääŋŋe oööi, kanyo manynyu Wär Dhaanhø nee jootu ki dïcäŋ aciel keere, 'ba eni ba jootu.
english: And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and ye shall not see it.

anywaa: 'Ba geno köö jïïu, ni ‹Neennu, eni ena kanyøce,› wala ‹Neennu, eni ena kany.› Kär nou cøø ni reŋŋu køørge.
english: And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them.

anywaa: Kiper cäŋ Wär Dhaanhø otïmö kaamar agaackøth ni wø nigaaŋ ni meeny maal ki løøk aciel ni këët løøk maya.
english: For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gïï mo thööth mo leth okwøŋ jwør ni kwieri jø pinyi en.
english: But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation.

anywaa: 'Ba nïr Wär Dhaanhø otïmö kaamar nïr Nöa na bëëde.
english: And as it was in the days of Noah, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man.

anywaa: Kiper jøøka na bëëtge, ge cämö, ni ge mädhö, ni ge nyöömö, ni wëëkge nyïïge nywøm, këël dïcäŋa ö Nöa na døny yi jääy, ni ö jwïïe ni dïïr wïthge bëët.
english: They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, yïth nïr Løøt, jiy abëëdö ni ge cämö ni ge mädhö, ni ge ŋëëö ni dwökge pwöth, ni ge pïïdhö ki caammi, ni gëëtge ki uudi.
english: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they builded;

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋa døny Løøti wøk ki yi Cødam, maac mo lïëth døc apänhnhö ki maal ni dïïr wïthge bëët.
english: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö kaawat manøgø dïcäŋo nyooth Wär Dhaanhø yie.
english: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca, ŋato en wï øtø, ni jape ena yi øtø, kär nee døøa piny kuna lwør ge. Ni ŋato en yi pwödhö thuwø, kär nee døøa paac.
english: In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back.

anywaa: Caarru wïthu ki gïr cï Løøt.
english: Remember Lot's wife.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro gwøk jwïëye, onyääe; 'ba ŋato wäro nyääk jwïëye, ogwøe.
english: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it.

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni wäänöca kiree, cwøw ariiø oen bäät pëëm aciel. Aciel okäl, ni wec maya.
english: I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left.

anywaa: Ni da mään ariiø mo öödö na aciel. Aciel okäl, ni wec maya.
english: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

anywaa: Ni cwøw ariiø oen yi pwödhö. Aciel okäl, ni wec maya.»]
english: Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jïgø, «?A kaa, Kwäärö?» Ni kööe jïge, ni «Kany wø näk da dëël mo othøw yie, cøre wø kuuta yie.»
english: And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, Jecu bääge acäänne ki luubö mo keda leer ni nyootha gø jïge ni ge doo lämö cooth, ni cwïnyge ba jøøm.
english: And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Da pääny mør mo yie da kwääy løøk, ŋat mo ba lwäär ki Jwøk, mo bäŋ luum dhaanhø mør mo ŋääe.
english: Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man:

anywaa: 'Ba paanøca da cï thøø mo cäädhö baŋe cooth, ni cäänö ki gø, ni ‹Ŋøl nyimänna wøk.›
english: And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.

anywaa: «'Ba ena kwøŋ kweeyø. Na näk køøre cään, dëëre acäänne keere, ni kööe, ni ‹Këël na ba lwäära ki Jwøk, ni bäŋ luum dhaanhø mør mo ŋääa,
english: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

anywaa: cï thøønhnhi keere, ŋunna ŋunnö kiper na ööl aani. Kanymør a jøøm ki wääthe cooth.› »
english: Yet because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Kwäärö aköö, na «?Aŋø, gïna caan kwääy løøki mana raac, käru wïnynyö?
english: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.

anywaa: ?A Jwøk nø, jiye na jiere ba ŋunne, jø wø jwöŋi ïthe ki wärre ki cääŋŋe? ?Dëëre gaale gaalø ki gïrge?
english: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?

anywaa: A cäänna uuni, ge laare ka ŋunnö. ?'Ba, kanyo ö Wär Dhaanhe, da ŋäädhe mo joode joodø bäät piny?»
english: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith on the earth?

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cäŋ luummi caannø thuwø ni keda leer jï jø møøk, jøøa näk dëëtge ege jiemø keerge ni beyø geni, ni jøøŋge jø møga.
english: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others:

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Da jiy ariiø mo oaa Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ kuna lämge. Dhaanhø aciel a ŋat Paricith, 'ba maya, ŋat ajwäk.
english: Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋat Paricith acuŋŋö ni läm dëëre keere na enøgø, ni kööe, ni ‹Jwøk, ïïna pwøa kiper na ba caala jø møga bëët, na näk dïmute, ki jøøa reyø, ki jø lugi, naa ba caal ŋat ajwäk manøgø.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank thee, that I am not as other men are, extortioners, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican.

anywaa: Kiper a wø wödö ki kwöre ariiø ki yi jwøk, naa cïpö ki paac wïth jammi na jëëthe røk gïï wø jooda bëët.›
english: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat ajwäk na cuŋŋö kany mo bäär, këël wïïe käre tïŋ maal, 'ba kööre apwöde ni kööe, ni ‹Jwøk, køny aani na ŋat raay en.›
english: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner.

anywaa: «A cäänna uuni, ni ŋatøgø aaa paare no ojïëö ni mare beer, ni kwier maya. Kiper jiy bëët mo wø døøc dëëtge mo døøŋŋø, odwøk piny. 'Ba ŋat wø døøc dëëre mo can, otïïc ni dwøŋ.»
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy atïmö ni känna baŋ Jecu ko obwöre, nee ceŋŋe kïth bäätge. 'Ba na jooti ya bääŋi, gena jookge.
english: And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cwøl Jecu baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Weyu obwöre nee öge baŋa, ni ba mänu ge. Kiper teeŋ obwöre moøgø nø, buc Jwøk a marge.
english: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋato wäro ba jïëc buc Jwøk kaamar nyilaal, ba doo dønynya yi gø.»
english: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu apëëny kwäärö mørri, ni kööe, ni «?Dïpööy mana beer, agïnaŋø noo tïïa, kiper nee kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe jooda?»
english: And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Jecu jïgø, na «?Aŋø ni cwølï aani naa beer en? Bäŋ ŋat mo beer, 'ba beeye Jwøk keere.
english: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

anywaa: Gïïa cem Jwøki ŋäyï, ni ‹Kärï kännö ki luk. Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø. Kärï kwätö. Kärï cäänö ki tööt. Wøør wäru ki meru.› »
english: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour thy father and thy mother.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Gïïögø bëët yaa gwøø, këël ki mana käla thïnhö.»
english: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na wïny gïnögø, aköö jïgø, ni «Gïrpiny aciel poot kärï tïïö. Dwøk gïïo en jïrï bëët pwödhö, ni pääŋŋï gwetge jï jøøa can, ni ööï ni cäädhï køøra. 'Ba ïïno jïti ki jap kwär maal.»
english: Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lackest thou one thing: sell all that thou hast, and distribute unto the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gïnögø, cwïnye apädhö, kiper eno kwär døc na bëëde.
english: And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich.

anywaa: 'Ba jïre aneen Jecu, ni kööe, ni «Døny buc Jwøk teee ki teek mo nyïëdi jï jøø no okwär yøø.
english: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, doo jööta eni jï athïrööl ki man dønye ki waŋ lïlmu ki man ö ŋat mo okwärri ni døny buc Jwøk.»
english: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïny gïnögø aköö, na «?Aŋa nø, noo maar piem?»
english: And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, ni «Gïn wø ba løny jï jiy, løny ki jï Jwøk.»
english: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö, ni «Neenï, waani mïëcwa awiiwa piny, ni caathwa køørï.»
english: Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo paac ee wiiø, wala dhaagø, wala nyïïmenni, wala jøøa nywøl gø, wala obwöre kiper nyeŋ buc Jwøk,
english: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

anywaa: mo ba jïti ki gïï mo thööth yi pinyi en, ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe yi piny mano ööi.»
english: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni käl bääge na näk apaar kurriiø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Neennu, kawaane ø cøøa yi Jerucalem, 'ba jammi bëët moa göör nyïïkuk Jwøki kiper Wär Dhaanhø othur karge.
english: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.

anywaa: Kiper eno cïp ceŋ juurre, ni buui, ni tïïge dëër gø ki gïn mo raac døc, ni ŋuutge bäät gø ki laaw,
english: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully entreated, and spitted on:

anywaa: ni pwötge gø, ni 'näkge gø. 'Ba noo tïme na ri dää nïne, eno ö maal.»
english: And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again.

anywaa: 'Ba røk luupögø, bäŋ gïrpiny aciel mo oci cwïnyge, kiper luummögøøni tiere atïmö no okanø ki geni, ni kucge tier gïna caane.
english: And they understood none of these things: and this saying was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm Jecu ni kare cään ki Jerikö, da ŋat ma cwør mo opï piny thääŋ jöö ni kwääö.
english: And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging:

anywaa: Kanyøgø na wïny tiet lwaak ni cäädhö ki buute, ena pëëö, ni «?Man agïnaŋø?»
english: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.

anywaa: Ni caange gø jïgø, ni «Jecu nyï Nadhareth beeye ni pöödhi en.»
english: And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

anywaa: Ni rëëde døc, ni «Jecu Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canna!»
english: And he cried, saying, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

anywaa: 'Ba ena jook jøøa en nyïm, ni ge caana gø jïre, nee lïŋe. 'Ba beeye mana rëëde døc nø, ni «Nyikwaar Deebit, køny canna!»
english: And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.

anywaa: Ni cuŋ Jecu, ni cïpe ki dwøl, ni käli jïre. 'Ba na ö buute ena pëënynye, ni kööe,
english: And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him,

anywaa: na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï nee tïïa jïrï?» Ni dwøk gø, ni «Kwäärö, wëëk nyeŋŋa døø karge.»
english: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Nyeŋŋï døøge karge. Ŋäädhe marï dëërï adwøk kare.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, Receive thy sight: thy faith hath saved thee.

anywaa: Ni put nyeŋŋe døø karge, ni läp køør Jecu, ni jiema Jwøk. 'Ba na ö jiyi bëët na neenge gïnögø, Jwøk apwøcge.
english: And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïc Jecu Jerikö, ena cør dï gø.
english: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da nyen mør mo nyeŋŋe Dhekiya, ma kwääy ajwäk, mo okwär.
english: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

anywaa: Ni eni manynya man joot Jecu man bëëde nidïï. 'Ba kär maar lønyø jïre kiper lwaak, kiper ena dhaanhø mo ciek.
english: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena reŋ nyïm, ni eth bäät jaath nee neene, kiper Jecu cøra jööröce.
english: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na pïïe kanyøce, alwïthö maal, ni kööe jïgø, ni «Dhekiya, laar ö piny, kiper a pïïa paarï dïcäŋi.»
english: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena laar ö piny, ni pänh gø ki met ec.
english: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya jiyi, gena ŋurö bëët, ni «Eni cøøa kuna tïme na wëël dhaanhø ma ŋat raay.»
english: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner.

anywaa: Køøre Dhekiya aö maal ni cuŋŋe, ni kööe jï Kwäärö, ni «Kwäärö, neenï, thäŋ jammi 'moa mëëga jøøa can. Ni näk da ŋat mo yaa mødø ki gïrpiny, dwøga dwøgø jïre na aŋween.»
english: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Dïcäŋi paani apiem, kiper ŋati en beeye nyikwaar Eeberam thuwø.
english: And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø öönynya kuna many jøøa näk orwäänyö nee pieme.»
english: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge wïnynya gïïögøøni, Jecu luubö mør aput caan ni keda leer, kiper na tïme ni kare cään ki Jerucalem, no onø caar jiyi ni buc Jwøk puta nëënne.
english: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö, ni «Da nyen mør mo käla dhi øtø mo beer, mo oci paac mør mo kare bäär kuna røønyi na nyeya nee duue.
english: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

anywaa: Ni cwøl laage apaar, ni mooc ge ki gwel apaar ni caan gø jïge, ni ‹Gädhu ki gwetøgø këël mano ööa.›
english: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.

anywaa: «'Ba jø poge män ki gø, ni jääkge køøre ki dhaanhø, ni köge, ni ‹Wa ba many nyenøgø nee tïme na nyeya powa.›
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya duue no orøønyø na nyeya, ena cïpö ki dwøl nee laaŋe moa mooe ki gwel nee cwøl jïre, kiper nee buua moa jootge ri gath ŋääe.
english: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

anywaa: «Ni ö mana dïkwøŋŋi nyïme, ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, gwellï na näk aciel, aduunnö ki gwel apaar møøk.›
english: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

anywaa: «Ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Wøp døc, ï na laŋŋø mo beer. Kiper mana tïmï niï maar ka ŋääth ri gïna thiinh, mïëri apaar owëëk ïïni ni tïmge ni ena cerï.›
english: And he said unto him, Well, thou good servant: because thou hast been faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

anywaa: «Ni ö rietge ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, gwellï na näk aciel, aduunnö ka abïïc.›
english: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.

anywaa: «Ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Ïïni, mïërï abïïc oen cerï.›
english: And he said likewise to him, Be thou also over five cities.

anywaa: «Køøre maya aöö, ni kööe, ni ‹Kwäärö, gwellï en, na kana ni yaa bääö ka abïï.
english: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:

anywaa: Kiper aana lwäyö ki ïïni kiper ïïna dhaanhø mo dwørï teek, niï wø kwanya gïrpiny mo kärï kwøŋ cïp piny, niï wø kaya gïn mo kärï kwøŋ piith.›
english: For I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that thou layedst not down, and reapest that thou didst not sow.

anywaa: «Ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Ïïno jääla ki køør mana ö wøk ki dhiï, ï na laŋŋø mo raac en. ?Aŋø, ŋäyï cøøn ni aana dhaanhø mo dwøre teek, naa wø kwanya gïn mo kära kwøŋ cïp piny, naa wø kaya gïn mo kära kwøŋ piith?
english: And he saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow:

anywaa: ?Aŋø nø, na ba kïthï gwella kany wø mac jammi yie, kiper kanya daa öö yie, gwella daa lwørø ni da wïïe?›
english: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury?

anywaa: «Ni kööm jøøa cuŋŋö buute, ni ‹Lwørru gwelløgø cere, ni mëëgu gø ŋata jïre da gwel apaar.›
english: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.

anywaa: «'Ba gena köö jïgø, ‹Kwäärö, ŋatøgø oløny ni jïre da gwel apaar.›
english: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)

anywaa: «Ni kööe, na ‹A cäänna uuni, ni jiy bëët mo wø jïge dagø, møøk ocäŋ cïpö jïge. 'Ba ŋat wø jïre bäŋgø, këël man wø en jïre di lwørø.
english: For I say unto you, That unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.

anywaa: 'Ba mar jøø na nyïïmänna yøø, jøøa näk ba many aani naa tïma na nyeya poge, kälu kany, ni 'nägu ge nyïma.› »
english: But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na nø caan gïnögø, apööth nyïm, ni aa Jerucalem.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm kare ni cään ki Bethpec ki Bethani buut kïnna cwøl ni Kïn Ølip, bääŋi ariiø ajääŋŋe,
english: And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Cou paanø ni en nyïmmu enø. 'Ba kanyo dønynyu yie ennø, uuno jïti ki nya arëën mo otwöö piny, mo poot bäŋ dhaanhø mo oeth bääte. Wär pätu ni kälu gø kany.
english: Saying, Go ye into the village over against you; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him hither.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo pëënynya uuni, na ‹?Aŋø ni pätu gø en?› wäru kööu, ni ‹Kwäärö manynya gø.› »
english: And if any man ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say unto him, Because the Lord hath need of him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøa jääŋŋi aay ni jootge gø keda mana caan gø jïge.
english: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pätge nya arëën, wëëk gø aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø ni pätu nya arëën en?»
english: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

anywaa: Ni dwøkge gø, ni «Kwäärö manynya gø.»
english: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

anywaa: Ni kälge nya arëën baŋ Jecu, ni kïthge abïïkge bäät gø, ni iithge Jecu bäät gø.
english: And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cäädhe ki bäät gø, jiy abïïkge apeethge waŋjöö.
english: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni kare cään ki kany wø løøc piny ki bäät Kïn Ølip, lwaa bääŋa päl enøgø, gena tägö ki man pwøcge Jwøk ki dwøl mo päl ni yïthge met kiper tïïe moa døøŋŋø bëët na jootge.
english: And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen;

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Gwïëth en ri nyenynyi ni ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk! Bëët-mëër en maal, ni ö ajiemmi ni en maalø bäre!»
english: Saying, Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith møøk mo ena dï lwaaøgø gena köö jï Jecu, ni «Dïpööy, jook bäägï.»
english: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke thy disciples.

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, na «A cäänna uuni, ni näk mo jøøi ii lïŋö, këël kïte moi ii ki dëëtge doo rëëdö.»
english: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jecu na tïm kare ni cään na neen pääny, ena jwöŋö ki gïr gø,
english: And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Beer kee jap wø käl bëët-mëër ŋäyu dïcäŋi en nø. 'Ba kawaane, geno mänö ki nyeŋŋu.
english: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

anywaa: Kiper nïne oööi kanyo ö nyïïmännu noo diilge uuni yi kiir, ni bäŋ kany mo thiinh mo dønynyu wøk ki gø,
english: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

anywaa: ni gøcge u ki piny, ni beeye uuni ki nyïïu. Ni bäŋ kïdi aciel mo dege wii bäät kïdi mør pou, kiper mana käru lïïmmö mar Jwøk ŋiiø mana lïïmme baŋu.»
english: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu adøny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni täge ki man riem jø wø gädhö ki jammi wøk.
english: And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought;

anywaa: Ni cääne ki ge, ni kööe, no «Ogöörö, ni ‹Øda doo bëëdö na øt lam.› 'Ba atïïyu na kar dïmute. »
english: Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of thieves.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, ena tïmö ni pöö cooth Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba kwääc laam, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, ki jøøa døøŋŋø wïth jiy, gena määnyö ki jöö man 'näkge eni ki gø.
english: And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him,

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo ege joodø mo maarge tïïc, kiper na tïm jiyi bëët ni leŋa luupe.
english: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ni Jecu pöö ki jiy yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni køpa luumma nyään na met, kwääc laam, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jaae gena öö,
english: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,

anywaa: ni köge jïgø, ni «Caanï jïwa, ?a teega ŋø ni wø tïïyï gïïögøøni ki gø? ?Na aŋa na wëëk teegøgø ïïni?»
english: And spake unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?

anywaa: 'Ba aløøe jïge, no «U pëënynya pëënynyö ki pïëc aciel thuwø. Wär løgu jïra.
english: And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

anywaa: ?Lwøk mar Jøøn na nyuudhi, käla maal na bëëde, wala käla baŋ jiy?»
english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø aløøŋge dïge keerge, ni ge caana gø, ni «Noo caanø gø, ‹Ni käla maal,› eni köö, ‹?Na aŋø na ba jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni?›
english: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

anywaa: 'Ba noo caanø gø, ni ‹Käla baŋ jiy,› jiy bëët ø këërge këërö ki kïte, kiper geno jïëy ni Jøøn a nyikuŋ Jwøk na bëëde.»
english: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, adwøkge ni kanya käl yie kucge.
english: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, «'Ba aani thuwø, teek man wø tïïa gïïögø ki gø, ba caana jïïu.»
english: And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.

anywaa: Kanyøgø luummi ni keda leer en acaane jï jiy, ni kööe, ni «Da dhaanhø mør mo opïïdhö ki pwöth omøki, ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø puur, ni aa paac mør ni ruue.
english: Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

anywaa: 'Ba na päŋ dwäde mo kac, eni laŋŋe ajääŋ baŋ jø puur moøgø, nee eni moocge ki nyïïjer pwöthögø. 'Ba ena pwöt jø puur moøgø, ni wëëkge gø døø ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ jäägö ki laŋŋø mør. Ni cäŋge gø pwötö, ni tïïge dëëre ki gïn mo raac døc, ni wëëkge gø døø ki ceŋŋe jaak.
english: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ dääge jääŋŋö. 'Ba manøgø dëër gø amoocge ki ŋwiili, ni leeŋge gø wøk ŋää pwödhö.
english: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

anywaa: «Kanyøgø nø, wää pwödhe aköö, na ‹?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa? Wääda na mëëra ki gø jääŋŋa jääŋŋö. Kanymør owøørge.›
english: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

anywaa: «'Ba na jooti ya jø puurri moøgø, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni ‹Man beeye lwiidhø. Beerra man nääø gø, nee olaawi tïmge na moø.›
english: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

anywaa: Ni leeŋge gø wøk ŋää pwödhö, ni 'näkge gø. ?'Ba agïnaŋø nø noo tïïc wää pwöthögø ki geni?
english: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

anywaa: Eni öö ni 'näk jø puur moøgø ni cïp pwöthögø ceŋ jø møøk.» 'Ba na wïnyge gïnögø, gena köö, «Wui, gïnögø kär tägö!»
english: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid.

anywaa: Ni raŋ jïge, ni kööe, na «?A luummi no ogöörö na ennø en, tiere agïnaŋø? «ni ‹Kïdi mana kwier dïgëëte, atïmö na kïn gøøt mana pere letha eni na mak øtø.›
english: And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo päth bäät kïnnögø otøyi ni tïmge na thäŋi. 'Ba noo näk mo pätha bäät dhaanhø, ŋatøca oŋiidhe.»
english: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

anywaa: 'Ba yi caannøca kiree, dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki kwääc laam, ge manynya man makge Jecu, kiper aŋäcge ki cwïnyge ni luumma caane ni keda leer, geela geni. 'Ba gena lwäyö ki jiy.
english: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, ena neetge døc, ni jääkge ki jiy ni cøøkge rege ni keda gena jiy mo marge adïëri, nee jïtge ki luubö mo makge gø ki gø ri gïïo care, nee kïthge nyïm kwääc paac, ŋat wø ŋøl luup, na en teeki cere.
english: And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge eni, ni «Dïpööy, ŋäcwa niï cäänö niï pöö ka adïëri, ni jiy raŋï ka waŋ aciel, 'ba ï pöö ka jöör Jwøk na adïëri.
english: And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

anywaa: ?Beeye gïn mo beer jïwa ki man cïpwa ka ajwäk jï Cidhar, wala ba beer?»
english: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

anywaa: 'Ba cwøk marge ŋääe, ni kööe jïge, «Nyuunhnhu aani ki gwelø. ?Man a kïdö mar ŋa, ni nyeŋŋe oput göör tiere en?»
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

anywaa: Ni dwøkge gø, ni «Beeye Cidhar.»
english: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Dwøgu japa näk jap Cidhar baŋ Cidhar, ni dwøgu japa näk jap Jwøk baŋ Jwøk.»
english: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

anywaa: Ni tïme ni ba maar lønyø jïge ki man makge gø nyïm jiy ri gïna caane. 'Ba yïthge athäŋŋö ki luumma dwøge, ni putge lïŋö.
english: And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Cajucith ni wø köö ni bäŋ duun wøk ki yi thøø, møøk aö baŋ Jecu,
english: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,

anywaa: ni pëënyge eni ki pïëc, ni köge, ni «Dïpööy, Modhe waana göönne ki ciik, ni ni näk mo dhaanhø coki othøw, ni jïre da dhaagø, 'ba jïre bäŋ nyilaal, ŋatøgø cïmädhi dee lwørø, ni dee wï coki nywølø.
english: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba da jak ma nyïïmëëe abïriiø. 'Ba mana dwøŋ anyöömmö ki dhaagø, ni thøøe ni bäŋ nyilaal mo ee nywølø.
english: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaaŋŋøgø ni dööŋe ki nyena käl køøre,
english: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

anywaa: ni pïïe ri dääge, këël mana thumge ki thøø karge bïriedi bëët, ni bäŋ jiy mo ege nywølø.
english: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

anywaa: Køøre dhaaŋŋøgø athøw thuwø.
english: Last of all the woman died also.

anywaa: ?'Ba kanyo duu jiyi wøk ki yi thøø nø, eno tïme na cï ŋa nø? Kiper ena bëëdö ki jagøgø karge bïriet, na dhaagø jï ŋati man nø.»
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Jø pinyi en, ge nyöömö, ni wëëkge nyïïge nywøm.
english: And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moo jïëc ni rømø ki ciin yi piny mano ööi ki duun wøk ki yi thøø, røkge ba nywømge, ni bäŋ nyïïge mo wëëk nywøm.
english: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

anywaa: Ni ge ba maar thøø këët, kiper ge röömi ka nyïïatwiet maal, ni gena nyïï Jwøk, na nyïï duun wøk ki yi thøø.
english: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

anywaa: 'Ba këël Modhe nyootha gø ni jiy duua wøk ki yi thøø, yïth luupa caan ki ya abuŋŋö, kanya cwøl Wuuö Jwøk ni Jwø Eeberam, ni näk Jwø Aydhak, ni näk Jwø Jeekap.
english: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

anywaa: Kiper eni paa Jwø jøøa näk othøw, 'ba ena Jwø jøøa kwøw. Kiper jiy bëët kwömma eni.»
english: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk møøk jï Jecu, ni «Dïpööy, acaanï na kare.»
english: Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, thou hast well said.

anywaa: Kiper gena tïmö ni cwïnyge ba maarge mak këët ki man pëënyge gø ki pïëc.
english: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «?Jiy a dege köö nidïï, ni Krictø beeye O Deebit?
english: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

anywaa: Kiper Deebit ki dëëre ee caanø yi Wëël Dut Pwøc, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Kwääya, ni «Pï bäät cwïïa,
english: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

anywaa: këël mano tïïa nyïïmän moï na køøm tietï.» ›
english: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk eno nø cwøl Deebiti ni Kwäärö na enønø, a dee cäŋ tïmö na wääde nidïï?»
english: David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?

anywaa: Ni cään bääge, ni wïny jiyi bëët wïnynyö,
english: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

anywaa: ni «Gwøgu røgu ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, jø wø yïthge met ki käär abïïe mo beyø, ni yïthge met ki määth yïth kwör gath, ni wø many kwör bëëte moa beyø geni yïth uut acook lam, ki kwör ajieme kwör caammi,
english: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

anywaa: jø wø dar uut määr thuunhnhi, ni wø lämö ki lam mo yie bäär ni ge nyootha rege. 'Ba geno jïti ka ajäla mo dwøŋŋa eni.»
english: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu alwïthö ni neen jøøa no okwär ni ge kïtha muuce moge yi gïn wø cïp muuce yie.
english: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.

anywaa: Ni neen cï thøø mo can, ni eni kïtha mïlïïne ariiø yi gø.
english: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.

anywaa: Ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni nyijøøgø ni can na cï thøø enø, acïpö ki jammi mo kaala jap jøøgø bëët.
english: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:

anywaa: Kiper jøøgø bëët, ge lwöta ri japa thööth na en jïge. 'Ba nyijøøgø, këël na cane, japa dee bëënnö bëët akïth yi gø.»
english: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

anywaa: 'Ba bääge møøk atïmö ni ge cara gïr Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ keda mana näk odøøc mo mïërö ki kïte ma wøpe ki jëëthe.
english: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Nee per gïïö ni neennu yøø, cääŋŋe oööi, kanyo bäŋe kïdi aciel kany mo dööŋ bäät watge ni ba leeŋ piny.»
english: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge Jecu, ni «?Dïpööy, a wäne noo täk gïïögø, na agïnaŋø noo näk ŋïï kanyo tïm gïïögø ni karge cään ki tägö?»
english: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Gwøgu rou, nee wïthu ba maaŋŋi. Kiper jiy mo thööth oööi ki nyeŋŋa, ni köge, ni ‹Beeye aani na eni,› ni ‹Kanya wäŋŋi acäännö.› Kär nou cøøa køørge.
english: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wïnynyu lenye ko oduuru, kär nou bwøk. Kiper gïïögø kwøŋa tägö, 'ba cuŋ piny ba laar öö.»
english: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Paac mør dëëre othïïŋe ri paac mør, ni ö nyeya mørri ni thïïŋ ree ri nyeya mør.
english: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:

anywaa: Ni tïm kwör mo thööthi ni jäŋŋi døc, ni jït mïëri møøk ki meele ki gïï mo leth, ni jït pinynyi ki jap böök ki ŋïïce mo døøŋŋø mo ööi ki maal.
english: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo poot gïïögø bëët, uuno maaŋge, ni caange uuni, ni cïpge uuni ceŋ jø uut acook lam ki uut twöc. 'Ba uuno kïthge nyïm nyeye ki nyïm kwääri kiper nyeŋŋa.
english: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

anywaa: Kanyøca nø, beeye kanyo caannu gïra.
english: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.

anywaa: 'Ba cïbu cwïnynyu piny nø, ni bäŋe gïn mo lääŋŋu ennø kiper gïno dwøgu jïge.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:

anywaa: Kiper uuno mooa ki dhøk ki leec wïc, mo ba maar lønyø jï nyïïmännu ki man duunge uuni, wala man piemge gø.
english: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.

anywaa: 'Ba këël jøøa nywøl uuni, ki nyïïmëëgu, ki tuuŋu, ki nyïïawäätu, uuno kïthge ceŋ jø møøk, ni 'näkge møøk dïïu.
english: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni mänge ki uuni kiper nyeŋŋa.
english: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ jëën wïthu mo ränynyi.
english: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.

anywaa: 'Ba jwïëyu ojootu ki køør jïëny gïï mo leth moo jwørru.
english: In your patience possess ye your souls.

anywaa: «'Ba kanyo jootu Jerucalem no ociel jø tøŋŋi, kanyøgønø, wär ŋäyu ni kar ränynye ocäännö.
english: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.

anywaa: Kanyøca nø, jøw oen Judia, wär bwøkge bäät kïte, ni ö jø wø en dï pääny, ni aage wøk yie. Ni ö jø wø en ŋää pääny wøk, ni ba cige yie.
english: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

anywaa: Kiper nïrögøøni beege nïro cool kwöri yïthge, kiper nee luup moa näk ogöörö nee thurge karge bëët.
english: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba otïmö ni leth døc jï määro yïthge da jiy, ki määro dhwödhö yïth nïröke. Kiper gïï mo leth døc ööa yi ŋöömö man, ni ena bäät jøøi ii,
english: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.

anywaa: ni 'näk geni ko opëëlle, ni peec geni dï mïëri bëët. 'Ba Jerucalem onyak juurre ni macge gø, këël mano ö kwör juurre moa wäŋŋi noo thurge karge.
english: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.

anywaa: «'Ba dëër cäŋ ki dwääy ki ceer ojïti ki ŋïïce; 'ba yi pinyi en, mïëri ojïti ki bëëtö mo leth, ni thäŋ yïthge ki lwör mar naama dwøŋ ka athage.
english: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;

anywaa: 'Ba jiy obääp lwärri, ni ge lwäära gïïo tägi piny. Kiper gïïa näk jïge da teek maal di jäŋö.
english: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgønø, Wär Dhaanhø ojootge ni öö ki yi pöölö, ki teek ka ajiem mo dwøŋ.
english: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo täk gïïögø, tïŋu wïthu ni neennu maal, kiper pïëm mano piem uuni ki gø, kare onø cäännö.»
english: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.

anywaa: Ni cään ge ki luubö mo keda leer, ni kööe, ni «Neennu olaam ki jenni bëët.
english: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;

anywaa: Kany wø jït bäätge ki bøøge, jootu joodø ki dëëtu keeru, ni ŋäyu gø ni dhikøth kare onø cäännö.
english: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, kanyo neennu gïïögø ni tägö, oŋäyu ni buc Jwøk kare acäännö.
english: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, ni beenhnhi en ba doo pöödhö ni gïïögø bëët poot kär cööp karge.
english: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.

anywaa: Maal ki piny opöödhi, 'ba luupa ba dak.
english: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.

anywaa: «Gwøgu dëëtu. Kanymør cwïnynyu tïmö ni ena køør caammi, ki meeye, ki lääŋ jap kwøwi en, ni ö cäŋöce ni laar ö bäätu ni caala abïëp.
english: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

anywaa: Kiper cäŋöce ööa bäät jiy bëët moi ni bëëdö wï ŋöömö bäre en.
english: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kuru cooth, nou lämö nee lønye jïïu ki man bøthu ri gïïo tägi bëët, nou cuŋŋu nyïm Wär Dhaanhø.»
english: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïmö ni pöö yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ cooth. 'Ba wø näk wäär, eni aay ni but bäät kïnna cwøl ni Kïn Ølip.
english: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.

anywaa: 'Ba wø tïme na amöölla, jiy bëët ööa baŋe yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ kuna wïnyge mare.
english: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ajwöm-cam mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø na cwøl ni cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, kare acäännö.
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ge caya jöö man 'näkge Jecu ki gø, kiper ge lwäär ki jiy.
english: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people.

anywaa: Kanyøgønø, Ceethan aci cwïny Juudac na cwøl ni Ickarïët, ni beeye dhaanhø aciel ki røk bääge na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

anywaa: Ni aae ni cuuŋe ki kwääc laam, ki kwääc jø wø koor Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, nee jïte ki jöö man cïp Jecu ceŋge ki gø.
english: And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them.

anywaa: Ni mïn yïthge, ni jïëcge ki man moocge eni ki gwel.
english: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.

anywaa: Ni jïëe, ni määnye ki jöö man cïp Jecu ceŋge ki gø ni lwaak tøør.
english: And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na dïcäŋ mana dïkwøŋ mar ajwöm-cam mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø, ni beeye kany wø 'näk nyidier Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie,
english: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.

anywaa: Jecu Piter ki Jøøn ajääŋŋe, ni kööe, ni «Cou ni jiiŋŋu cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie kiperø, nee camø.»
english: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, na «?A kaa ni manynyï nee jiiŋwa yie?»
english: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Neennu, kanyo cou paac, uuno røømmi ki nyen mør mo tïëdö ki pïï ki dak. Wäru läpu køøre yi ødo døny yie.
english: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.

anywaa: Ni caannu gø jï wää paaci, ni ‹Dïpööy aköö ki ïïni, ni «?Øt wëëlle age, kanyo cäma yie ki cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ki bääga?» ›
english: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?

anywaa: 'Ba uuno nyuunhnhe ki yi øtø mo laac maal bäät pööki, mo onø peeth. Kanyøce nø, wär jiiŋŋu kiperø.»
english: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

anywaa: Ni cige, ni jootge gø keda mana caan gø jïge, ni jiiŋge cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.

anywaa: 'Ba na päŋ caae, Jecu apï piny kar cam ki nyïïatwieli na aciel.
english: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Beeye gïna manynya døc, ki man cama cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ki uuni na aciel, ni gïna leth poot kär pïï dëëra.
english: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:

anywaa: 'Ba a cäänna uuni, ni gïn ba cäŋa cammø këët këël mano thur kare yi buc Jwøk.»
english: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Ni lwöte ka athöödhi. 'Ba na nø dwøk met ec, ena köö, ni «Lwørru gïn, ni pääŋŋu gø dïïu.
english: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:

anywaa: Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni køør man en nø, a ba mäthi ki pï nyïïomøki këët këël mano cööp buc Jwøki kare.»
english: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.

anywaa: Ni lwöte ki møø, 'ba na nø dwøk met ec, apøte, ni mëëk gø geni, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye dëëra, na cïp kiperu. Tïïyu gïn, nou para aani.»
english: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.

anywaa: 'Ba køør cam, athöödhi alwøre, ni kööe, na «Athöönhnhi en beeye luumma nyään na tuut ki køør remma na køny piny kiperu.
english: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.

anywaa: 'Ba neennu, ŋato cïp aani ceŋ nyïïmän, cere okuut yi cam ki aani na aciel ennø.
english: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.

anywaa: Kiper Wär Dhaanhø cøø keda mana kwøŋi caan. 'Ba otïmö ni raac jï ŋatøgø noo cïp aani.»
english: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääŋi dëëtge apëënyge keerge, na «?Aŋa dïïø noo tïïc gïnögø?»
english: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.

anywaa: Ni ö bääk Jecu ni jït yïthakicge ki pïëm thuwø, ni ge pïëmö na aŋa no orømø dïge ki man tïme ni kare dwøŋŋa eni.
english: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Nyec juurre dëëtge ege cuumö bäät jiy moge, ni jø wø näk ocuumö wø cwøl ni jø wø kwöm jiy.
english: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.

anywaa: 'Ba maru patha enønø. 'Ba ŋato kare dwøŋŋa eni dïïu, wär dëëre døøc mo thiinhnha eni, ni ö ŋato bwödhö, ni døøc ree ma ŋat mo tïnynya jø møøk.
english: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.

anywaa: ?Aŋa nø, ni kare dwøŋŋa eni, beeye ŋat wø näk opï piny kar cam, wala ŋat wø tïny gø? ?Aŋø, patha ŋat wø näk opï piny kar cam na kare dwøŋŋa eni? 'Ba aani, a ena dïïu naa tïnynya jø møøk.
english: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.

anywaa: «'Ba beege u jøøa bëëdö ki aani dhøk gïïa leth na pääny aani.
english: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.

anywaa: 'Ba keda mana ö Wära na mooc a ki bura, beeye thuwø na wëëga gø uuni,
english: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;

anywaa: kiper nou cämu ni mädhu kar cam mara yi buya, ni pïïu piny bäät wäle, nou ŋøla luum tuk Icriel karge paari kurriiø.»
english: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Cayman, Cayman, neenï, Ceethan uuna manynye, nee u jeee kaamar beel.
english: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

anywaa: 'Ba aana lämö kiperï nee ŋäädhe marï ba ränynye. 'Ba kanyo cäŋï riï løgø, nyïïmeru wär wëëk tëënnö.»
english: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.

anywaa: Ni kö Caymanni jïgø, «Kwäärö, aano jïëy ki man cøøa øt twöc ki ïïni, këëlla yi thøø.»
english: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, na «A cäänna ïïni, Piter, ni dïcäŋi ni gwienø poot kär köök, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani ki kwöre adäk naa kuyï.»
english: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «?Kanya jääŋŋa uuni wøk ni bäŋ gïr gwel, wala opïr ki war, da gïn mo oläämö jïïu?» Ni dwøkge gø, ni «Bäŋgø.»
english: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «'Ba kawaane, ŋato jïre da gïr gwel, wär käle, këël opïr. 'Ba ŋato jïre bäŋ opëëllö, abïïne wär dwøk pwödhö, ni ŋëëm dëëre ka aciel.
english: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.

anywaa: Kiper a cäänna uuni, ni luummi no ogöörö en doo thura kare dëëra, na køp, ni ‹Eno pääri ki jø wø dhal ciik.› Kiper gïna näk ogöörö kipera, doo thura kare.»
english: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Neenï, Kwäärö, opëëlle ariiø ena kany en.» Ni dwøk gø jïge, «Moøgø thööth nø.»
english: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aö wøk, ni ci bäät Kïn Ølip, keda man wø bëëde cøøn, ni bääŋi cäädha køøre.
english: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïe kaace, ena köö jïge, ni «Lämu, kiper nou ba päänynyi.»
english: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.

anywaa: Ni daak ree buutge, ni daa kany mo bäär mëëth ki geni, ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni läme, ni kööe,
english: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

anywaa: na «Awuuö, ni näk mo ïïno jïëy, wëëk maath athöödhi man pöödhö bääta. 'Ba paa ki køør mana manynya, 'ba beeye ki køør mana manynyï na doo tïïö.»
english: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, nyïïatwiel maal aö baŋe, ni cøm cwïny gø.
english: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni cwïnye opädhö døc, ena lämö døc ki cwïnye bäre. Ni ö kwäk mare ni tïme kaamar remø ni tøøna piny.
english: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö maal ki kar lam ena ci baŋ bääŋi, ni nwän geni ni geno butö, kiper na päth cwïnyge.
english: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø ni butu? Ööu maal, ni lämu, kiper nou ba päänynyi.»
english: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Jecu ni cäänö, lwaak aöö, ni ge bwøtha nyena cwøl ni Juudac Ickarïët na en røk jøøa näk apaar kurriiø. Ni ö buut Jecu kuna nuum dhi gø.
english: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «?Juudac, Wär Dhaanhø diï cïba ceŋ nyïïmän ki nuum dhøk na enønø?»
english: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa en buute na neenge gïno tägi, gena köö, «?Kwäärö, pwötwa ge ko opëëlle?»
english: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

anywaa: Ni ö dhaanhe aciel dïge ni gøøc laŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni cëë ïth cwïï gø wøk.
english: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Weyu gïnögø.» Ni mul ïth gø ni dwøk gø kare.
english: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jï kwääc laam, ki kwääc jø wø koor Øt Jwøk, ki jaae na ö baŋe, no «?U ö baŋa keda man wø ci baŋ kuu, nou käära opëëlle ka athøre?
english: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?

anywaa: Kany wø bëëda ki uuni cooth yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ceŋŋu käru kïth dëëra. 'Ba beeye karu ennø, ni beeye kar teek muudhö.»
english: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu amakge ni kälge gø, ni ge kïtha gø yi øt Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba Piter aläp køør gø, ni ree ee jädhö kany mo bäär mëëth.
english: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö jøøgø na äpge ki maac dï kal, ni geno pï piny kanya ciel, Piter apï piny dïge.
english: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nyaan ma ŋat tïïc na neen eni, ni eno pï piny däär maac, jïgø aneene døøc, ni kööe, ni «Nyeni thuwø ena buute.»
english: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.

anywaa: 'Ba dëëre amooŋe, ni kööe, ni «Nya, eni kuua.»
english: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.

anywaa: 'Ba ki nyi kany mo thiinh, acäŋ ŋat mørri jootø, ni kööe, ni «Ï ena røkge thuwø.» 'Ba Piter aköö, «A path, nyie.»
english: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.

anywaa: 'Ba na cäŋ bëëtö ki kany mo jïtö ki yi caa, ŋat mør acäŋ öö, ni pïëme, na «Adïëri møn, nyenøgø thuwø, ena buute. Kiper ena nyï Galili.»
english: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö, ni «Nyie, gïnö ni carï enø, kuua.» 'Ba kanya poode ni cäänö, gwienø aput köö.
english: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.

anywaa: Ni ö Kwäärö ni løk ree ni lwiith Piter. Ni ö Piterri ni put wïïe par ki luumma caan Kwäärö, na kööe jïgø, ni «Dïcäŋi ni gwienø poot kär köök, riï mooŋï mooŋø ki aani ki kwöre adäk naa kuyï.»
english: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.

anywaa: Ni ci wøk ni jwöŋe ni keeya yie.
english: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøa mak Jecu, Jecu abuuge ni pwötge gø.
english: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.

anywaa: Ni twöcge nyeŋ gø thuwø, ni pëënyge eni, ni «Caanï. ?Aŋa na gøøc ïïni?»
english: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?

anywaa: Ni cäänge dëër gø ki luup møøk mo thööth ni ge janynya eni.
english: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ruu øwi, jaae moa en dï jiy gena cuuŋö na aciel, këël kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk bëët. Ni kïthge Jecu kar løøk marge, ni köge,
english: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ni näk bee ïïni na Krictø, caanï jïwa.» 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Noo cäänna uuni, u ba jïëy.
english: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou pëënynya pëënynyö, ba løgu.
english: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.

anywaa: 'Ba køør man ennø, Wär Dhaanhø opï piny bäät cwïï Jwøk kuna en teek Jwøki yie.»
english: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

anywaa: Ni köge, ge bëët, «?Bee ïïni na O Jwøk, nø?» Ni dwøk gø jïge, «Beeye ni caannu enø.»
english: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.

anywaa: Ni köge, na «?A luumma ŋø ni poot manynyø këët? Anø wïnynyø dhee kiree, ø ki dëëtø.»
english: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø acooŋa bëët aö maal ni kälge Jecu nyïm Paylat.
english: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

anywaa: Ni täkge ki man kïthge bääte ki luup, ni köge, ni «Nyeni en ajootwa ni manynya man wëëk powa ageem ka akwöma, ni män wa ki cïp ajwäk jï Cidhar, ni kööe ni eni ki dëëre beeye Krictø, ni ena nyeya.»
english: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena pëëny Paylati, ni «?Bee ïïni na nyeny jø Juuth?» Ni løk gø jïre, na «Acaanï na kare.»
english: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.

anywaa: Køøre Paylat aköö jï kwääc laam ki lwaae, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo obøth mo yaa joodø baŋ nyeni.»
english: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.

anywaa: 'Ba gena reeth ri gø, ni köge, ni «Nyenøgø kiera wïth jiy ki pwöc mare yi Judia bäre, ni täga Galili këël mana këën kany ennø.»
english: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Judaea, beginning from Galilee to this place.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat na wïny gïnögø, ena pëëö ki man näk ŋatøgø nyï Galili.
english: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gø ni ena dhaanh Eerat na näk kwäärö mar Galili, awëëk kïth baŋ Eerat, kiper Eerat atïmö ni ena yi Jerucalem kar kaaca.
english: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Eerati na joot Jecu, yie amïnnö døc, kiper eni bëëdö ni lääŋŋa gø ki kany mo bäär nee neene. Kiper gïr gø awïnynye, ni eni manynya man neen gø ni tïïö ki gïn mo rëëma ec.
english: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu atete døc. 'Ba dhee käre jaalø.
english: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk acuŋŋö buute ni kïthge bääte ki luup mo thööth, ni geno wëër døc.
english: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.

anywaa: 'Ba Eerat ki jø tøŋ moe Jecu acaange døc ni buuge gø. Køøre dëër gø akïthge ka abïï ma wøp døc, ni wëëk gø dwøk baŋ Paylat.
english: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

anywaa: Ni ö Eerati ki Paylat ni putge tïmö na nyïïawäädi dïcäŋöca kiree. Kiper dïkwøŋ na bëëtge, ge män ki røkge.
english: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni, kwääc laam ki jaae ki jiy acwöl Paylati kanya ciel.
english: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Nyeni akälu baŋa ni ena dhaanhø mo wëëga jiy ageem. 'Ba na teta gø døøc nyïmmu, bäŋ gïn mo yaa joodø mo ee tïïö dëët luupa kïthu bääte, mo doo jäälö kipere.
english: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:

anywaa: Ni Eerat thuwø bäŋ gïn mo ee joodø dëër gø, ni beeye na wëëk gø duun baŋø en. 'Ba neennu, eni bäŋ gïn mo ee tïïö mo doo rømø ki thøø.
english: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, eni wëëga pwöt ka alaŋŋe, ni päda gø.» 17
english: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø näk ra ajwöm-cam mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, eni wø pätö jïge ki dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa en øt twöc.]
english: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)

anywaa: 'Ba gena put rëëdö bëët ki dwøl aciel, ni «Aayï ki nyeni, ni pännï wa Baraba.»
english: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:

anywaa: 'Ba Baraba manøgø okïth øt twöc kiper ageem mo ee tääö dï pääny, ki 'näk jiy.
english: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat acäŋ cäännö ki geni, ni manynya man pät Jecu.
english: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena rëëdö døc, ni «Gurï, gurï bäät jaadha no odëëdö!»
english: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ geni cäännö ri dääge, na «?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na raac ni ee tïïö? Kiper bäŋ gïn mo yaa joodø mo obøth jïre mo doo rømø ki thøø. Kiper manøgø nø, eni wëëga pwöt ka alaŋŋe, ni päda gø.»
english: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.

anywaa: 'Ba gena reeth ri gø døc, ni rëëtge døc, ni ge caana gø, ni eni doo gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö. Ni ö döötge ni jïëy.
english: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, Paylat acïpö ki dwøl ni mana manyge doo wëëga geni.
english: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.

anywaa: Ni pät ŋata kwacge, na näk okïth øt twöc kiper ageem ki 'näk jiy. 'Ba Jecu acïp ceŋge kaa mana manyge.
english: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya kïthge Jecu wøk, ŋat mør mo nyeŋŋe Cayman ma nyï Cayriin mo cäädha jöö mo ööi ka dï paac, amakge ki teek, ni kïthge jaadha no odëëdö bääte, nee kääre køør Jecu.
english: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø lwaa dhaanhø mo päl aläp køøre, ki mään mo pööta kööthge ni ge jwöŋö kipere.
english: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu dëëre aløø baŋge ni kööe, ni «Nyïïakuk Jerucalem, käru jwöŋö kipera, 'ba jwöŋu kiper dëëtu keeru ki nyïïu.
english: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.

anywaa: Kiper da cääŋŋe mo öö, mo jiy köö, ni ‹Meta yïth bwöy, ki yïdhi moa näk kär käädö ki jiy, ki kööthi moa näk kär dhwødhø.›
english: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøca geno köö jï kïte, ni ‹Ööu, päthu bäätwa.› Ni luumge thuuri, ni ‹Ööu, rïëpu wa.›
english: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.

anywaa: ?Ni näk gïn tïïcge ni jaath poot mar, agïnaŋø noo tägi kanyo tale?»
english: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy ariiø møøk thuwø mo da gïï mo ege baa, mo okïth wøk nee 'näk ki eni ciel.
english: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge kany mo cwøl ni Kar Cuu Wïc, ena gurge bäät jaadha no odëëdö kaace, ki jøøa näk obääyö, na aciel ena bäät cwïïc, ni maya ena bäät caam.
english: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Wuuö, wëën geni. Kiper gïna tïïcge kucge.» Ni tïïge ki ŋïïce ki ri kwääk ki baw naa abïïk Jecu pääŋge.
english: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy cuŋŋö ni ge neeta gø. Ni ö jøøa näk kwääri ni buuge eni, ni köge, ni «Eni wø kønya jø møøk. Wär ree kønye keere nø, ni näk ena Krictø mana öö ki baŋ Jwøk, na mare, na näk ee jierø.»
english: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ena buu jø tøŋŋi thuwø, ni öge baŋe ni ge manynya man moocge gø ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wac.
english: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,

anywaa: Ni ge cäänö, ni «Ni näk bee ïïni na nyeny jø Juuth, piem dëërï.»
english: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace thuwø da luup mo ogöörö maal wïïe, ni «Ŋati en beeye nyeny jø Juuth.»
english: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dëët jøøa näk obääyö na näk ogurö ki eni na aciel, Jecu abuue, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ï paa Krictø? Piem riï, ni piemï wa.»
english: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.

anywaa: 'Ba ena jook maya, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, ï ba lwäär ki Jwøk? Kee ï poot ena ya ajäla aciel ki eni.
english: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?

anywaa: 'Ba ajäla marø møn beeye kare. Kiper gïna pïï dëëtø en beeye mana näk orømø ki gïïa tïïø. 'Ba ŋati en bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö.»
english: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Jecu, wär a lääŋŋï kanyo ööï ni ïïna nyeya mo teek.»
english: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïgø, na «Adïëri møn, a cäänna ïïni, ni dïcäŋi en, ïïno en kany mo beer ki aani na aciel.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na caae apaar kurriiø ki dïcäŋ, piny atïmö ni muudhö bäre, këël caae adäk ka abøøya,
english: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.

anywaa: ni tïm cäŋŋi ni ba rieny; ni ö abïïn Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni put jeeø ki dïëre na thäŋi ariiø.
english: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Jecu aköök ki dwøl mo päl, na «Awuuö, jwïëya acïba cerï.» 'Ba na nø caan luummögø, ena jwïëy ka aŋuudi.
english: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kwääy dïkuye ma dïpa na neen gïna tägö, Jwøk apwøe, ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, ŋati en, bäŋ gïn mo ee baa.»
english: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaae bëët moa näk dëëtge ege cooŋø kuna raŋge gø, na nø neenge gïna tägö, gena døø mïëcge, ni ge pööta kööthge.
english: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa ŋäc eni bëët, ki mään moa läm køøre ki yi Galili, gena cuŋŋö kany mo bäär ni ge neeta gïïögø.
english: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da dhaanhø mør mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jocep ma nyï Arimathia, paac mør mo poot na po jø Juuth, mo ena ri kwääc løøe, mo ena dhaanhø ma wøp mo cwïnye beer,
english: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:

anywaa: mo kär jïëy ki mana manyge na tïïcge, ni ena dhaanhø mo bëëdö ni køya buc Jwøk na bëëde.
english: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Eni, ena ci baŋ Paylat ni kwac dëër Jecu ki gø.
english: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.

anywaa: Ni käl dëër gø piny, ni bøøny gø ka abïï koony, ni pïël gø yi bwöc kïdi mo orøø, mo poot bäŋ dhaanhø mo okoony yie.
english: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø beeye cäŋ jiiŋ røk, ni cäŋ jwömö manynya man täge.
english: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.

anywaa: 'Ba mään moa öö ki eni ki yi Galili aläpö, ni neenge bwörö, ki koony mana koonyi ki gø.
english: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.

anywaa: Køøre gena døøk, ni jiiŋge mäth wïïr ma teeŋi mo wø ŋwääi ni met. 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö røkge ajwömge, keda mana näk ocemø.
english: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na täk tïïc ka amöölla cøøn, mään aci bäät bwörö, ni ge käära mäth wïïr mo wø ŋwääi ni met na jiiŋge.
english: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

anywaa: Ni jootge kïdi no oŋiel wøk ki dhi bwörö.
english: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba na cige yie, dëër Kwäärö ma Jecu kärge joodø.
english: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cuŋge ni yïthge othäŋŋö kiper gïnögø, jiy ariiø acuŋŋö buutge, mo dëëtge da abïïe mo ŋwaŋŋi.
english: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

anywaa: Ni putge bwøk, ni kuulge wïthge piny yïth ŋøøm. 'Ba jøøgø aköö jïge, na «?Aŋø ni cayu ŋat mo kwøw dï jøøa no othøw en?
english: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?

anywaa: Eni tøør kany. Ena tïŋ maal. Caarru wïthu ki luumma caane jïïu kanya poode yi Galili,
english: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,

anywaa: ni ‹Wär Dhaanhø ocïp ceŋ jø raay, ni guri bäät jaadha no odëëdö, 'ba noo tïme na dää nïne eno ö maal.› »
english: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.

anywaa: Ni putge wïthge par ki luupe,
english: And they remembered his words,

anywaa: ni aacge bäät bwörö, ni køpge gïïögø bëët jï nyïïatwieli moa näk apaar kurciel, ki bääge møga bëët.
english: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa køp gïïögø jï nyïïatwieli beeye Meeri Magdalin, ki Jöwaana, ki Meeri mii Jeemeth, ki mään møga moa cøø ki geni.
english: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba luupögø atïmö keda waac jaak ki jïge, ni kärge marge jïëö.
english: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aö maal ni reŋ bäät bwörö. 'Ba na gääŋe ni neena yi bwörö, abïïk koony ajoode no odööŋ keerge. Ni aa paac ni yie othäŋŋö kiper gïna tägö.
