english: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø kiree, jiy ariiø dïge aay ni ge cøøa paac mør mo cwøl ni Imeeya, mo yaakicge ki Jerucalem jïtö ki kiïlömethërri apaar kurciel,
english: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

anywaa: ni ge cara gïïa tägö yøø bëët.
english: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge cäänö ni ge løøŋŋa dhøkge ki luummögø, Jecu ki dëëre anyänh buutge, ni cäädhe ki geni na aciel.
english: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋge omänö ki man ŋecge gø.
english: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?A luupa ŋø cøøn ni caru yïthakiyu nou cäädhö en?» Ni cuŋge, ni nyeŋge okwätö.
english: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?

anywaa: Kanyøgø aløk dhaanhe acielli jïgø mo cwøl ni Kilöpa, ni «?Bee ï keerï na wëëllö yi Jerucalem na kuc gïïa tägö kaace yïth nïri ii?»
english: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?

anywaa: Ni dwøk gø jïge, na «?A gïïa ŋø cøøn?» Ni köge jïgø, ni «Gïr Jecu nyï Nadhareth, ŋat ma nyikuŋ Jwøk na pöö ki pwöc mo met, na tïïö ki tïïe mo døøŋŋø nyïm Jwøk ki nyïm jiy.
english: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:

anywaa: Eni, ena mak kwääc laammi mowa ki jaae ni cïpge gø nee ŋøl yi thøø, ni nääge gø bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.

anywaa: 'Ba ewa ŋäädhö ni beeye eni na doo wïïl jø Icriel wøk. 'Ba ennø thuwø, anø tïmö na nïne adäk ki mana täk gïïögø.
english: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.

anywaa: 'Ba da mään møøk dïwa, mo yïthwa ege thääŋö. Kiper ka amöölla cøøn, geno møøl bäät bwörö,
english: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;

anywaa: ni kärge dëër gø joodø, ni duuge, ni köge, ni da nyïïatwiet maal mo ege neenø, mo ocaan gø, ni ena kwøw.
english: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk dïwa gena ci bäät bwörö, ni jootge gø keda mana caani ya määnni. 'Ba eni kärge joodø.»
english: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, «U ni bäŋ wïdhi en, ni cwïnynyu teek ki man jïëyu moa car nyïïkuk Jwøki bëët!
english: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:

anywaa: ?Aŋø, paa gïïögø na doo pïï dëër Krictø ki man jwør gïï mo leth, ni ci ya ajieme na enønø?»
english: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?

anywaa: Ni par luup bëët jïge moa en yïth weet Jwøk na näk ocaanø kipere, ni tääe ka luup Modhe këël mo nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët.
english: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm karge ni cään ki paana cige yie, Jecu atïmö keda pöötha nyïm.
english: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.

anywaa: 'Ba ena kwacge, ni köge, ni «Bëëdï ki waani, kiper piny anø tïmö na abøøya, ni cäŋ onø tïmö ni thiinh.» Kanyøgø ena cøø ni bëëde ki geni.
english: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en kar cam ki geni, ena lwötö ki møø, ni gwïëth gø, ni pøt gø, ni mëëk gø geni.
english: And it came to pass, as he sat at the table with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.

anywaa: Ni ö nyeŋge ni putge rege jap, ni ŋecge gø. 'Ba kanyøgønø, ena put rwäänyö jïge.
english: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.

anywaa: Ni cäänge keerge, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, kärø joodø ki cwïnynyø møn ya adïëti kanya cään øøni øtjöö, na par luup weet Jwøk jïïø?»
english: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?

anywaa: Ni putge ö maal yi caannøce kiree ni døøge yi Jerucalem, ni nwänge nyïïatwieli na näk apaar kurciel ni dëëtge ege cooŋø, ge ki jøøa en buutge.
english: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Kwäärö aduu wøk ki yi thøø møn, ni nyuth dëëre Cayman.»
english: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, gïïa tägö waŋjöö akøpge, ki mana ŋecge gø ki ri møø na pøte.
english: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge cara gïïögø, Jecu ki dëëre acuŋŋö dïge, ni kööe jïge, ni «Bëët-mëër bëëde bäätu.»
english: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba gena bwøk ni lwäcge, ni ege caarø ni ge joota tïpö.
english: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, na «?Aŋø ni ö wïthu ni kierge rege en? ?Na aŋø ni cäänu ki cwïnynyu en?
english: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

anywaa: Neennu ceŋŋa ki tieta. Beeye aani ki dëëra. Mullu aani, nee jootu, kiper tïpö bäŋ dëël ni bäŋ cuu teeŋ kaawat man en dëëra ni neennu en.»
english: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan gïnögø ceŋŋe ki tiete anyuth geni.
english: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.

anywaa: Ni mïn yïthge døc, ni yïthge othäŋŋö. 'Ba yïthge poot teek. Kanyøgø ena köö jïge, «?Jïïu da gïn cam?»
english: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

anywaa: Ni moocge gø ki thääŋ rëëö mo obulö.
english: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.

anywaa: Ni lwør gø ni cam gø nyïmge.
english: And he took it, and did eat before them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jïge, ni «Moi beege luupa na caana jïïu kanya pooda naa bëëdö ka uuni, ni luup bëët moa näk ogöörö kipera ri ciik Modhe, ki mo nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki moa en yi Dut Pwøc thura karge.»
english: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.

anywaa: Ni par wïthge nee luup moa en yïth weet Jwøk kwanyge.
english: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Beeye mana näk ogöörö, ni ‹Krictø gïï mo leth ojwøre, 'ba noo tïme na dää nïne, eno ö maal ki yi thøø,
english: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:

anywaa: ni ö løk cwïny ki wec raac jiy ni købi ki nyeŋŋe yïth mïëri bëët, ni tägi ka yi Jerucalem.›
english: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni bee uuni na neen gïïögø.
english: And ye are witnesses of these things.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, a wëëga gïna buuk Wära uuni. 'Ba bëëdu paani, këël mano jïtu ki teek mano ööi ki maal.»
english: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena käle këël mana pïïcge Bethani. Ni tïŋ ceŋŋe maal ni gwïëth geni.
english: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëde ni gwïëtha geni, ena aay buutge ni kïthi maal.
english: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni døøge yi Jerucalem ni yïthge met døc.
english: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:

anywaa: Ni putge bëëtö Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ cooth, ni ge pwøya Jwøk.
english: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

anywaa: Wïlöölö Dwøl nutö, ni Dwørøgøøni ena kanya ciel ki Jwøk, ni Dwørøgøøni beeye Jwøk.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

anywaa: Wïlöölö eni ena kanya ciel ki Jwøk.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

anywaa: Ni jammi bëët cwääc ka ree, ni bäŋ gïn mo ocwääö ri moa cwääc bëët, ni eni tøør ree.
english: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

anywaa: Ni kwøw ena ree, ni kwøwøgøøni beeye na cïp tar jï jiy.
english: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

anywaa: Ni tayøgø meenya muudhö, ni käri ya muudhe nää.
english: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

anywaa: Da dhaanhø mo ojääŋ Jwøki, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Jøøn.
english: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

anywaa: Ena öö kiper nee cääne, nee gïr tayøgøøni købe, kiper nee jiy bëët jïëcge ni ŋääthge ki køøre.
english: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.

anywaa: Eni patha tayøgøøni, 'ba ena öö nee gïr tayøgøøni købe.
english: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.

anywaa: 'Ba taya näk adïëri na cïpö ki tar jï jiy bëët, beeye eni na ö piny.
english: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.

anywaa: Eni ena piny, ni beeye eni na cwääc piny ki køøre, 'ba eni kär ŋec jø pinynyi.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

anywaa: Ena ö baŋ moa näk moe, ni kär moe jïëy ki eni.
english: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa jïëy ki eni bëët na ŋääth nyeŋŋe, amooe ki teek ki man tïmge na nyïï Jwøk.
english: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

anywaa: Ni jøøgøøni atïmö na nyïï Jwøk kiper mana tïïc Jwøki ki dëëre, ni paa kiper na nywøl ge na tuuŋ, wala kiper mana cac dëër dhaanhe, wala kiper mana caar dhaanhe nee tïïe ee keere.
english: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

anywaa: Ni ö Dwørøgøøni ni tïme na dhaanhø ni bëëde dïïø, ni mëër ka adïëri okadhø jïre. Ni waani ajiem mare ewa neenø, ajiema en jï Wäädö na näk aciel jï Wuuö.
english: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

anywaa: Jøøn acäänö ki gïre, ni cwödö, ni «Man beeye ŋata gïre caana, ni ‹Eni noo ööi køøra dwøŋŋa eni ki aani, kiper eni nutö cøøn naa poodi.› »
english: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.

anywaa: Ni ö øøni bëët ni jïtø ri met ec mare na näk okadhø, ni cäŋ bäät gwïëth marø mëënnö ki gwïëth.
english: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

anywaa: Kiper Ciik Jwøk cïp ka ri Modhe, 'ba met ec ki moa näk adïëri ööi ka køør Jecu Krictø.
english: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo Jwøk ee neenø, 'ba beeye Wäädö mana näk acielø jï Jwøk na en kö Wuuö na nyooth gøøni.
english: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.

anywaa: 'Ba man en beeye luumma køp Jøønni na ö jø Juuthi na jääŋge kwääc laam ki tuuŋ jø Libay møøk ki yi Jerucalem kuna pëënyge eni, ni «?Ïïna ŋa?»
english: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?

anywaa: Ni caan mare nyïmge ni käre mooŋø, 'ba aput caan, na «A paa Krictø.»
english: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni pëënyge gø, ni «?Ïïna ŋa? ?Ïïna Ilaaja?» Ni kööe, na «A patha eni.» Ni köge, ni «?Ïïna nyikuŋ Jwøk mana wäŋŋi?» Ni løk gø, ni «Jïra bäär.»
english: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jïre, ni «?Ïïna ŋa nø? Caan marï jïwa nee dwøkwa baŋ jøøa jääŋ waani. ?Agïnaŋø ni caanï kiper dëërï?»
english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Aana dwør dhaanhø mo cwödö ŋää paac, ni ‹Tïïyu jöör Wuuö Jwøk ni thïïŋ,› kaawat mana caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea.»
english: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgøøni na öge, jääŋŋa jø Paricithi.
english: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge gøøni, ni «?Ni näk enøgønø, niï patha Krictø, wala Ilaaja, wala nyikuŋ Jwøk mana wäŋŋi, aŋø ni lööï na nyuudhi en?»
english: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

anywaa: Ni ö Jøønni ni løk gø jïge, ni «Aani, a löö ka pïï na nyuudhi, 'ba dïïu da dhaanhø mo nutö mo kuyu,
english: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;

anywaa: ni beeye eni noo ööi køøra, ŋata näk thøøth waye ba doo mïërö jïra ki man päda ge wøk tiete.»
english: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

anywaa: Gïïögøøni täga Bethani løø Naam Jördan, kanya löö Jøønni na nyuudhi yie.
english: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, Jøøn Jecu aneene ni ööa baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Neennu, Nyidier Jwøk ŋato wëën raay mo jø piny.
english: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

anywaa: Eni beeye na gïre køba, ni ‹Da dhaanhø mo öö køøra, mo dwøŋŋa eni ki aani, kiper eni nutö cøøn naa poodi.›
english: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra eni kuua. 'Ba kiper nee eni ree nyoodhe jï jø Icriel beeye na ööa ni lööa na nyuudhi kipere.»
english: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.

anywaa: Ni ö Jøønni ni køp dwøre kipere, ni kööe, ni «Aani Jwïëc Jwøk aneena ni öö ki maal kaamar akuuru, ni pï bääte.
english: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

anywaa: 'Ba aani ki dëëra eni kuua. 'Ba eni na jääŋ aani kuna lööa ki pïï na nyuudhi beeye na caan gø jïra, ni ‹Ŋato jootï Jwïëc Jwøk ni öö ni pïïa bääte ni bëëde, beeye ŋato löö ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.›
english: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, ajooda ki waŋa ni køba gø, ni ‹Man beeye na O Jwøk.› »
english: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø maya, Jøøn acäŋ cuŋŋö ki bääge ariiø,
english: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;

anywaa: ni neen Jecu ni cäädhö, ni kööe, «Neennu, Nyidier Jwøk.»
english: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya bääŋi riet ni caana gïnögø, gena läp køør Jecu.
english: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni løk ree ni joot geni ni ge lämma køøre, ni kööe jïge, «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyu?» Ni köge jïre, ni «?Raabay,» na näk tiere beeye Dïpööy, «Ï bëëdï kaa ŋø?»
english: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Ööu nee neennu.» Ni cige ni jootge kanya bëëde yie, ni putge bëëdö kanyøce ki eni dïcäŋögø, kiper na näk cäŋ abøøya ki caae aŋween.
english: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.

anywaa: 'Ba dëët jøø na ariiø yøø na wïny dwør Jøøn ni luubö, na läp køør Jecu, dhaanhø aciel beeye Andaru na näk cöök Cayman Piter.
english: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

anywaa: Ni cøøe ni kwøŋ coki ma Cayman joot, ni kööe jïgø, «Waani Macaaya ajootwa;» na näk tiere beeye Krictø.
english: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

anywaa: Ni ööe ni käl gø baŋ Jecu. 'Ba na ö Jecu na neen gø, ena köö, ni «Bee ï, Cayman wär Jøøn. Beer, ïïno cwøl ni Ciipa, wala Piter;» na näk tiere beeye Kïdi.
english: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, Jecu aköö ni eni cøøa Galili. Ni joot Pilip ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ööï ni cäädhï køøra.»
english: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba Pilip beeye nyï Betheeda po jø Andaru ki Piter.
english: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

anywaa: 'Ba Pilip Nathaniel ajoode ni kööe jïgø, «Waani, ŋata gööt Modhe kipere yi wëël Ciik Jwøk na näk da luup thuwø mo ogöör nyïïkuk Jwøki kipere, ajootwa, ni beeye Jecu nyï Nadhareth na näk o Jocep.»
english: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba Nathaniel aköö, ni «?Da gïn mo beer mo doo ööa wøk ki yi Nadhareth?» Ni kö Pilipi jïre, «Ööï nee neenï.»
english: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na joot Nathaniel ni ööa baŋe, ena köö jïgø, «Neennu, man beeye nyï Icriel møn, mana näk bäŋ cwøk cwïnye.»
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

anywaa: Ni kö Nathanielli jïre, na «?A ï ŋääö nidïï?» Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Kanya poodï ni ïïno pï piny tier olaam, niï poot kär cwøl Pilipi, ïïna jooda.»
english: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Nathanielli jïre, «Dïpööy, beeye ïïni na O Jwøk, na näk Nyeya mar Icriel.»
english: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, na «?Aŋø, kiper na caana gø jïrï ni ïïna jooda tier olaam, beeye na jïëyï? Ïïni gïï mo døøŋŋø geni ki moi oneenï.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jecu köö jïgø, na «Adïëri møn a cäänna uuni, uuni, maal oneennu ni ree ee jabø, ni nyïïatwiet maal mo Jwøk cøøa maal ni ööa piny bäät Wär Dhaanhø.»
english: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na ri dää nïne da nywöm ma atïïc yi Keena yi Galili. 'Ba mii Jecu ena kanyøce.
english: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:

anywaa: Ni Jecu thuwø ocwølø kar nywöm ki bääge.
english: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.

anywaa: 'Ba na thum køøŋ nyïïomøki, mii Jecu aköö jï Jecu, ni «Køøŋ nyïïomøki athum jïge.»
english: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jï menni, «?Ayaŋ, agïnaŋø ni tïïyï ki aani en? Kara poot kär öö.»
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.

anywaa: Ni kö menni jï jø tïïc, ni «Noo dee gïn mo caane jïïu, wär tïïyu.»
english: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace da dääe abïciel mo otïïc jø Juuthi na mo wø jiiŋge dëëtge ki geni, na aciel yie da rumme ariiø wala adägö.
english: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Pääŋŋu däägögø ki pïï.» Ni ö geni ni pääŋge ge gøøc dhøkge.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «Lwötu rege kawaane ni mëëgu gø kwääy nywöm.» Ni putge gø käl.
english: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kwääy nywömmi na bel pïïögø na tïmö na køøŋ nyïïomøki, ni kanya käl yie kuue, 'ba ŋäya jø tïïci na twøm pïï; eni ŋat nywöm acwøle.
english: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïre, «Nyie, jiy bëët wø kwøŋa køøŋ nyïïomøki moa met kälö, 'ba noo mäth jiyi døøc, køøre mo wø bäth cäŋ ka kälö nø. 'Ba ïïni køøŋ nyïïomøki moa met adwøgï cään, gøøc kawaane en nø.»
english: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye ŋïï mana tïïc Jecu dïkwøŋ yi Keena yi Galili, ni nyootha ajieme. Ni ö bääge ni jïëcge ki eni ni ŋääthge gøøni.
english: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgøøni Jecu aci yi Kapernaam, ki menni ki nyïïmenni ki bääge. Ni bëëtge kaace ki nïne mo nøk.
english: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.

anywaa: 'Ba ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie mar jø Juuth kare ocäännö, ni ö Jecu ni ci yi Jerucalem.
english: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

anywaa: 'Ba na ö yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, jø wø dwök pwödhö ki rwädhe ki dïëk ka akuyi, ki jø wø wïïdö ki gwel ajoode ni geno pï piny kwör tïïe moge.
english: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena tïïö ka adaay, ni riem jøøgø wøk bëët ki yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ki dïëk ki rwädhe, ni køny gwel piny mo jø wø wïïdö ki gwel, ni jaal tharabëëte moge.
english: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

anywaa: Ni ööe ni luum jø wø gädhö ka akuyi, ni «Kïthu gïïögø wøk. Uuni øt Wära ba dou tïïö na øt gath.»
english: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge wïthge aputge caar ki luumma no ogöörö, ni «Remø mara atwak kiper øtø marï.»
english: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth aköö jïre, na «?A ŋïï mane noo nyoothï jïwa, na tïïyï gïnögø kipere?»
english: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Nyagu Øt Jwøk man. 'Ba aani, ødøgø otïŋa maal ki nïne adägö.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni, jø Juuth aköö jïre, ni «Kanya geer Øt Jwøk manøgøøni, akän wøk ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween ka abïciel. ?Aŋø, ï doo köö ni tïŋï maal ki nïne adägö keerge?»
english: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?

anywaa: 'Ba eni caana Øt Jwøk mana näk dëëre.
english: But he spake of the temple of his body.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kanya tïŋi maal ki yi thøø, bääge wïthge aputge caar, ni luummögø akwøŋ caan, ni jïëcge ki luup moa no ogöörö, ki luup moa caan Jecu.
english: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya en Jecu yi Jerucalem ya ajwöm-cam cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, jiy mo thööth ajïëy ki nyeŋŋe ni ŋääthge gøøni, kanya jootge ŋïïce moa tïïe.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu, dëëre käre wëëk geni, kiper eni jiy ŋääe bëët,
english: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,

anywaa: ni eni ba cac dhaanhø mør mo køp gïr ŋat mør jïre. Kiper eni ki dëëre gïn wø en cwïny dhaanhø ŋääe.
english: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

anywaa: Da dhaanhø mør ma ŋat Paricith mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Niködima ma dhaanhø aciel røk dïbwöthe mo jø Juuth.
english: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:

anywaa: Ŋatøgø aö baŋ Jecu ki wäär ni kööe jïre, ni «Dïpööy, ŋäcwa ni ïïna dïpööy mo käla baŋ Jwøk, kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo maara tïïö ki ŋïïce moøgø ni wø tïïyï yøø, ni näk Jwøk tøør buute.»
english: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu jïgø, ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn a caana gø jïrï, ni näk mo dhaanhø kär cäŋ nywøllø ni nyään, eni buc Jwøk ba dee maara joot.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Ni kö Niködima jïre, na «?Aŋø, dhaanhø a dii cäŋ nywøllø nidïï ni eno nø døøŋŋø? ?Eni doo cäŋa døø yi menni nee cäŋ nywøllø?»
english: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu jïre, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, ni näk mo dhaanhø kär nywølø ki pïï ki Jwïëc Jwøk, eni ba doo maara døny yi buc Jwøk.
english: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.

anywaa: Gïn wø nywøl dëëlli beeye dëël, 'ba gïn wø nywøl Jwïëc Jwøki beeye jwïëy.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

anywaa: Kär yiï thäŋŋö kiper na caana gø jïrï, no ‹U doo cäŋa nywøllø nou nyärö.›
english: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

anywaa: Jamø wø kwödö kaawat mana caye, ni ö dhaanhe ni wïny dwør gø, 'ba kun wø käl yie ki kun wø ci yie, kuc dhaanhe. Kaawat manøgø thuwø, jiy bëët mo wø näk mo onywøl Jwïëc Jwøki ge bëëdö na enøgønø.»
english: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba Niködima aköö jïre, «?Manøgøøni a dee maar tägö nidïï?»
english: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «?Ï paa dïpööy mar Icriel? ?Gïnögø doo poodø ni kuyï?
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïrï, wa caana gïn mo ŋäcwa, ni wa køpa mana neenwa. 'Ba u kär jïëy ki luumwa.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.

anywaa: ?Ni näk jap piny yaa caanø jïïu, ni käru ge jïëö, uuno jïëyu nidïï, noo caana jap maal jïïu?
english: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo oci maal, 'ba beeye eni na öö ki maal, ni beeye Wär Dhaanhø.
english: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba Wär Dhaanhø ŋaaba maal kaawat mana ö Modhe na ŋaap thwöl maal dï paap,
english: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:

anywaa: kiper nee ŋato wäro jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø nee jïte ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

anywaa: «Kiper Jwøk mëër ki jø piny døc, ni beeye na cïp Wääde ma aciel, kiper nee ŋato wäro jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø nee kwøe ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, nee ba ränynye.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk Wääde käre jääŋŋö piny nee piny jääle, 'ba beeye kiper nee piny piem ki køøre.
english: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø, bäŋ ajäla bääte këët. 'Ba ŋat wø ba jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø, eno nø jääl kawaane ennø, kiper na käre jïëy ni ŋääth nyeŋ O Jwøk na näk aciel.
english: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna käl ajäla bäät jiy beeye en; kiper kanya ö tarri piny, jiy atïmö ni ge mëër ka muudhö ni kaala tar, kiper gïïa tïïcge reyø.
english: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïïa reyø, ge män ki tar, ni ge ba ö yi tar, kiper nee gïïa tïïcge nee rege ba nyoothge.
english: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø tïïc gïn ma adïëri wø ööa yi tar, kiper nee joot møn ni gïïa tïïe käla baŋ Jwøk.»
english: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgøøni, Jecu ki bääge gena ci yi ŋööm Judia. Ni bëëde ki bääge kaace ni lööe na nyuudhi.
english: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn thuwø alöö na nyuudhi yi Eenan buut Caalim, kiper kaace da pïï mo thööth. Ni ö jiyi ni öge nee ge lwøk na nyuudhi yie.
english: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

anywaa: 'Ba Jøøn poot kär twöö kar kaaca.
english: For John was not yet cast into prison.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nø, da pïëm ma atägö yïthakic bääk Jøøn ki ŋat Juuth mør, ni ge piema luum lwøk na nyuudhi.
english: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

anywaa: Ni öge baŋ Jøøn ni köge jïre, ni «Dïpööy, ŋata bëëdö ki ïïni løø Naam Jördan løøga, na gïre køpï, ena kany ni löö na nyuudhi, ni jiy bëët cøøa baŋe.»
english: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jøønni, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo jïtö ki gïrpiny, ni näk ba mëëk eni ka maal.
english: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.

anywaa: Uuni ki dëëtu, mara awïnynyu na caana gø, na ‹A paa Krictø, 'ba beeye aani na jääŋŋi nyïme.›
english: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø nyöömmi beeye na wää dhaagø thiinh. 'Ba lwöm wää nywömmi ni wø cuŋŋi ni wïnynya mare, yie wø mïnnö døc kany wø wïny dwør wää nywömmi. Ni beeye na mïn yia døøc kawaane.
english: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba eni kare odøøŋŋi, ni tïm kara ni thiinh.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

anywaa: «Eni na öö ki maal, ena wïth jammi bëët. 'Ba eni ni en piny, beeye ŋat piny, ni jap piny beege wø caane. 'Ba eni na öö ki maal, ena wïth jammi bëët.
english: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.

anywaa: Ni eni wø køpa gïna neene na wïnynye, 'ba bäŋ ŋat mo ojïëy ki gïn wø købe.
english: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø jïëy ki luumma caane, mare wø pute ka køp, ni ‹Jwøk beeye na adïëri.›
english: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na jääŋ Jwøki wø køpa luup Jwøk. Kiper Jwøk Jwïëye bäŋ wø cïbe ni ee rømø.
english: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö mëër ki Wäädö ni cïp jammi bëët cer gø.
english: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø jïëy ki Wäädö ni ŋääth gø, ree da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. 'Ba ŋat wø ba leŋ dwør Wäädö, kwøw ba dee joodø, 'ba ajäla mar Jwøk bëëdö bääte.»
english: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni awïny jø Paricithi, ni Jecu löö na nyuudhi ni tïïya bääŋi mo thööth mo kaala mo Jøøn.
english: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu ki dëëre kär löö na nyuudhi, 'ba beege bääge keerge na löö.
english: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na ŋäc gïnögø, eni Judia awiie, ni cäŋ aa yi Galili.
english: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

anywaa: Ni eni doo pöödhö ki yi Cameria.
english: And he must needs go through Samaria.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ena ci yi paac mør mo ena yi Cameria mo cwøl ni Caykar, na cään ki pwötha cïp Jeekapi jï wääde ma Jocep.
english: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

anywaa: 'Ba iith Jeekap ena kanyøce. Kanyøgø nø, Jecu kiper mana näk eno ööl ki wääth mare, ena pï piny buut iidhøgø. Ni cäŋ ena dhöör.
english: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni nyijø Cameria mør aö kuna öömme ki pïï. Ni kö Jecu jïre, ni «Mooc aani ki pïï naa mätha.»
english: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

anywaa: 'Ba bääge oaa dï paac kuna ŋëëwge ki cam.
english: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

anywaa: 'Ba nyijø Cameria aköö jïre, na «?Aŋø ni pëënynyï nyijø Cameria ki pïï mo maathï en, ni ïïna ŋat Juuth?» Kiper jø Juuth ki jø Cameria røkge ba liimge.
english: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, «Onää muu Jwøk ŋäyï, ki ŋat cäänö ki ïïni en, ni ‹Mooc aani ki pïï naa mätha›, eni diï pëënynyö, ni dee cïpö jïrï ki pï kwøw.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋøgø aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, jïrï bäŋ gïrpiny mo diï töömmö ki gø, kiper iith man bäär. ?Pï kwøw a diï gø kälö ki kaa?
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dwøŋŋa ïïni ki kwarwa ma Jeekap na cïp iidhi jïwa, na kwøŋ mädhö yie ki dëëre, ki wääte, ki dhäk moe bëët?»
english: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu jïre, ni kööe, ni «Jiy bëët mo wø maath pïïögø, wø cäŋ riewi ka nägö.
english: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro mäthi ki pïïo cïba jïre, ba näk riewi këët. 'Ba pïïo cïba jïre otïmö na jøøro mo kwödö yie, mo kännö ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.»
english: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

anywaa: Ni kö dhaaŋŋøgø jïre, «Kwäärö, mëëk a pïïögø, naa ba 'näk riewi këët, naa ba ööa kany këët kuna öömma ki pïï.»
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, «Ciï ni cwølï cwørï ni duu kany.»
english: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk dhaage jïre, «Aani jïra bäŋ dïcwøø.» Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Marï adïëri møn na caanï gø ni jïrï bäŋ dïcwøø.
english: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

anywaa: Kiper ïïna kwøŋ bëëdö ki cwøw abïïc, 'ba dïcwøø manø ni bëëdï ki gø kawaane enøgø, paa cwørï. Manøgø acaanï na adïëri møn.»
english: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, ajooda ni ïïna nyikuŋ Jwøk.
english: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

anywaa: Kwäcwa wø lämö bäät kïdi man, 'ba ïïna köö, ni yi Jerucalem beeye kanya di jiyi lämö yie.»
english: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Nyijøøe, jïëyï ni ŋääthï luubö mara man, da kany mo öö, mo jiy Wuuö ba lamge bäät kïdi man wala yi Jerucalem.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

anywaa: Uuni, u lama gïn mo kuyu, 'ba waani, wa lama gïn mo ŋäcwa. Kiper pïëm man piem jiy ki gø ena baŋ jø Juuth.
english: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba kare anø cäännö, ni beeye kawaane en, kanyo ö jø wø lämö na adïëri, noo lamge Wuuö ki cwïnyge na adïëri. Kiper beege teeŋ jøøgø wø many Wuue nee eni lamge.
english: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

anywaa: Jwøk a Jwïëy, ni jø wø lam gø doo lämö ki cwïnyge na adïëri.»
english: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaage ni kööe jïre, ni «Ŋääa ni Macaaya ni wø cwøl ni Krictø öö. 'Ba noo ööe, jammi bëët onyoodhe jïwa.»
english: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Beeye aani ni cäänö ki ïïni en.»
english: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, bääge aput öö, ni thäŋ yïthge kiper mana cääne ki dhaagø. 'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo oköö, na «?Agïnaŋø ni manynyï?» Wala, «?Aŋø ni cäänï ki dhaaŋŋi en?»
english: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

anywaa: Køøre dhaaŋŋøgø dak mare awii piny, ni put ci dï paac ni caan gø jï jiy,
english: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,

anywaa: ni «Ööu, ni neennu ŋati ni caan gïïa tïïa bëët en. ?Løny ki man tïme ni beeye Krictø?»
english: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?

anywaa: Ni öge wøk ki dï paac ni cige baŋ gø.
english: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot dhaage ni kär duuö, bääge aö baŋe ni köge, ni «Dïpööy, ööï, ocämï.»
english: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Aani jïra da cam mo cama camø mo kuyu.»
english: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, bääge acäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni «?Da ŋat mo okännö jïre ki gïn cam?»
english: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Cam mara beeye ki man tïïa mana many Ŋata jääŋ aani ni thööra tïïc mare.
english: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u bäŋ wø cäänö, ni ‹Da dwäde aŋween mo poodi, 'ba noo näk køøre, beeye noo kac beel›? 'Ba a caana gø jïïu, ni tïŋu wïthu maal ni neennu pwöth ki nyeŋŋu no onø ciek ni rømi ka kac.
english: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kää wø jïtö ki jammi, ni cooŋ moa no ociek kiper kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, kiper nee dïpïïdhi ki dïkääy tïmge ni yïthge met bëët.
english: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

anywaa: Kiper luum wø caan jiyi beeye adïëri, ni ‹Ŋat mør a dïpïïdhi, ni ŋat mør a dïkääy.›
english: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

anywaa: 'Ba, uuna jääŋŋa wøk baŋ kac kany mou kär kwøŋ öölö yie. Jø møøk beege na ööl ri tïïögø, ni ö uuni ni cou yïth gïïa tïïcge na ööl geni.»
english: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Cameria mo thööth na en paanøgø gena jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø kiper mana caan dhaaŋŋøce, ni «Eni japa tïïa bëët acaane jïra.»
english: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

anywaa: Køøre na ö jø Cameria baŋe, ena pëënyge ki man bëëde ki geni. Ni ö eni ni bëëde kanyøce ki nïne ariiø.
english: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth møøk ni jïëcge ki eni ni ŋääthge gø kiper mana caane.
english: And many more believed because of his own word;

anywaa: Ni köge jï dhaagø, ni «Paa kiper luummï këët na jïëcwa ki gøøni ni ŋääthwa gø, 'ba luumme awïnywa ki dëëtwa, ni beeye na jïëcwa ni ŋääthwa gøøni en. Ni ŋäcwa gø na adïëri møn ni beeye eni na Pïëmi mar piny bäre.»
english: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne ariiø, Jecu atïŋŋö ni aa Galili.
english: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba ee caanø ki dëëre, ni «Nyikuŋ Jwøk bäŋ wø wøør dï poge.»
english: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, na ö yi Galili, ena pänh jø Galili kiper gïïa jootge bëët na tïïe yi Jerucalem kar ajwöm-cam. Kiper geno ci kar ajwöm-cam manøgø thuwø.
english: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

anywaa: Køøre ena cäŋ ö yi Keena na en yi Galili, kanya kwøŋ pïï tïïc na køøŋ nyïïomøki yie. 'Ba yi Kapernaam da dhaanhø ma kwäärö mo wääde tuu.
english: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gøøni ni Jecu aöö ki yi Judia ni ö yi Galili, ena cøø ni kwac gøøni nee ö kuna køny wääde. Kiper wääde kare cään ki thøø.
english: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Ni näk ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec ba neennu, u ba jïëy ni ŋäädhu.»
english: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääyögø aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, ööï, kany poot wääda ni kär thøw en.»
english: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Ciï nø, wäädï okwøw.» Ni ö ŋatøgø ni jïëe ki mana caan Jecu jïre, ni put gø ŋääth, ni døø kuna ööe ki yie.
english: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni eni poot cäädhö, ena røømmø ki laage, ni caange gø jïre, ni «Wäädï akwøw.»
english: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena pëënynye ki caanna jöön dëëre yie. Ni köge jïre, ni «Ya awääre ki caa acielø beeye na aac täwi dëëre.»
english: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.

anywaa: Ni puti ya wänni ŋäc ni beeye caanna ö Jecu na caan gø jïgø, ni «Wäädï okwøw.» Ni ö eni ki dëëre ni jïëe ki Jecu ni ŋääth gø, ki jø paare bëët.
english: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye riet ŋïïce mana tïïc Jecu kanya ööe ki yi Judia ni ööa yi Galili.
english: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgøøni Jecu aci yi Jerucalem baŋ ajwöm-cam mar jø Juuth.
english: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kanyøce yi Jerucalem da aguula mo cwøl ni Bethdhata ki dhi Ibaru, mo bääte da kwör rïc ma abïïc, mo ena buut Dhi Kiir Dïëk.
english: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.

anywaa: Ni yïth kwör rïc moøgø da jiy mo thööth mo obut piny yïthge, mo dëëtge da täwe mo oruu, ni beege cööye ki ŋööte ki jiy moa näk dëëtge obäp.
english: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

anywaa: 'Ba da dhaanhø aciel kanyøce mo dëëre da täw ki cwiiri ma pïëradäk ka abära.
english: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na joot gøøni, ni ŋäc gø ni eni wø bëëdö no obut piny ni eno ruu kanyøce, ena köö jïre, «?Ï caya man køny ïïni?»
english: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?

anywaa: Ni ö ŋata tuuwi ni løk gø jïre, ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, bäŋ ŋat mo kïth aani ya aguula kany wø wal pïïyi yie, 'ba kany wø pooda naa poot cäädhö, dhaanhø mør laara ci yie naa poodi.»
english: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, ni «Ö maal ni lwørï pïënï ni cäädhï.»
english: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.

anywaa: Ni put dëër ŋatøgø døø kare, ni lwør pïëne ni cäädhe. 'Ba dïcäŋögø beeye cäŋ jwömö.
english: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni jø Juuth aköö jï ŋata näk dëëre odøø kare, ni «Man a cäŋ jwömö. Ba doo beer ki køør ciik ki man käärï pïënï.»
english: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk ŋatøgø jïge, ni «Ŋata køny aani beeye na caan gø jïra, ni ‹Lwør pïënï ni cäädhï.› »
english: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jïre, na «?Aŋa na caan gø jïrï, ni ‹Lwør pïënï ni cäädhï›?»
english: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata dëëre dwøk kare, ŋata køny gø kuue, kiper Jecu onø pööth dï lwaak mana päl kanyøce.
english: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.

anywaa: 'Ba na näk køøre, ena joot Jecu yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni kööe jïgø, «Neenï, dëërï anø jöönnö. Kär niï bääyö këët, kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo raac mo kaala man mo pïï dëërï.»
english: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋatøgø ni aae ni caan gø jï jø Juuth, ki man näk mo beeye Jecu na køny eni.
english: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø na ö jø Juuthi na caange Jecu, kiper mana tïïc køny manøgø ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu jïge, ni «Wära poot tïïö, ni pooda naa tïïö thuwø.»
english: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna ö jø Juuthi na kath mana en cwïnyge kipere, ni ge caya man 'näkge gø, beeye kiper mana cwøl Jwøk ni wänni, ni päär ree ni ena aciel ki Jwøk, ni paa kiper mana dhal luum cäŋ jwömö keere.
english: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni Wäädö bäŋ gïn mo dee maara tïïc ki wïïe keere, 'ba gïn wø neene ni wø tïïc Wuue beeye wø tïïe thuwø. Kiper gïn wø tïïc Wuue beeye wø tïïc Wäädö thuwø.
english: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö mëër ki Wäädö, ni nyooth gïï wø tïïe bëët jïgø. Ni tïïe mo døøŋŋø geni ki moi onyoodhe jïre, nee yïthu thäŋge.
english: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.

anywaa: Kiper kaawat man wø ö Wuue wø tïŋ jøøa no othøw maal ni mooc ge ki kwøw, këël Wäädö thuwø cïpö ki kwøw jï jø wø manynye.
english: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö luup jiy ba ŋøle, 'ba luum ŋøl bäre awëëk Wäädö,
english: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:

anywaa: kiper nee jiy bëët tïmge ni ge wøøra Wäädö, kaawat man wø wøørge Wuuö. 'Ba ŋat wø ba wøør Wäädö, Wuuö na jääŋ eni ba wøøre thuwø.
english: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø wïny luumma ni jïëe ki eni na jääŋ aani, ree da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. Ni eni ba doo cøøa kar ŋøl luup. 'Ba eno nø ö wøk ri thøø ni ci yi kwøw.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.

anywaa: «Adïëri møn, a cäänna uuni, da kany mo öö, ni beeye ennø, kanyo ö jøøa no othøwi noo wïnyge dwør O Jwøk. 'Ba jøw owïny gø, okwøw.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.

anywaa: Kiper kaawat man bëët Wuue ni kwøw ena cere, Wäädö thuwø teek kwøw awii cere.
english: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;

anywaa: Ni wëëk teek mar ŋøl luup cer gø, kiper na näk ena Wär Dhaanhø.
english: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.

anywaa: Kär yïthu thäŋŋö ki luummögø, kiper da kany mo öö, kanyo ö jøw oen yïth bwörri bëët noo wïnyge dwøre,
english: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

anywaa: ni öge wøk. Ni ö jøøa tïïc gïïa beyø, ni öge wøk ni cige yi kwøw. Ni ö jøøa tïïc gïïa reyø, ni öge wøk ni cige ya ajäla.
english: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

anywaa: «Aani bäŋ gïn mo daa maara tïïc ki wïïa keera. 'Ba luup wø ŋøla ki køør mo wø wïnynya baŋ Jwøk, ni ŋøl mara thïïŋ, kiper a ba cac man wø manynya keera, 'ba a wø caya man wø many Ŋata jääŋ aani.
english: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.

anywaa: Ni näk maa køpa dëëra keera, mana caana ba doo naa adïëri.
english: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.

anywaa: 'Ba da ŋat mør mo wø køpa gïra, ni ŋääa gø ni mare ni wø care kipera beeye adïëri.
english: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.

anywaa: Uuna jääk baŋ Jøøn, ni ö eni ni køp gïra na adïëri.
english: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.

anywaa: 'Ba a ba bëën dwør dhaanhø mo caana gïra. 'Ba gïn caana en, caana kaper nou piem.
english: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.

anywaa: Jøøn na bëëde caala lamba mo onyebø ni liel, ni yïthu met ki man bëëdu yi taye dïciel.
english: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø køp gïra, dwøŋŋa eni ki mar Jøøn, kiper gïïa tïïa ki dëëtge na näk owëëk Wuue aani nee thööra, beege wø køp gïra, naa jääŋŋa Wuue.
english: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö na jääŋ aani, gïra akøbe ki dëëre. 'Ba dwøre käru wïnynyö bäre bäre, ni dëëre käru neenø.
english: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.

anywaa: Ni luumme ba en cwïnynyu, kiper na käru jïëy ki ŋata jääŋŋe ni ŋääthu gø.
english: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.

anywaa: U wø määnyö yïth weet Jwøk, kiper you caarø ni yïth luupögø beeye noo jootu kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. Ni beege geni ni wø køp gïra.
english: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.

anywaa: 'Ba u kweeyø ki man ööu baŋa nou jïtu ki kwøw.
english: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.

anywaa: 'Ba ajiem mara ba jooda baŋ jiy.
english: I receive not honour from men.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, u ŋääa, ni ŋääa ni mëëc Jwøk tøørø cwïnynyu.
english: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.

anywaa: Aani, aana öö ki nyeŋ Wära, 'ba a käru jïëö. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mør mo öö ki nyeŋŋe keere, beeye ŋato jïëyu.
english: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

anywaa: ?Uuno jïëyu nidïï ni näk mou poot caya pwøc dhaanhø mør, nou ba cac pwøc man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk aciel keere?
english: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?

anywaa: Käru nou caara gø nou jääla jäälö nyïm Wära, 'ba beeye Modhe ni ŋääthu en, ni wø jääl uuni.
english: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.

anywaa: Onää Modhe you jïëö møn, a dou jïëö, kiper ena göödö kipera.
english: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk moa gööre käru jïëö, uuna dou jïëy ki luupa nidïï?»
english: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgøøni, Jecu aci løø Puul Galili, ni beeye Puul Taybiria.
english: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaaki mo päl ni läp køøre, kiper ŋïïce moa neenge na thööth na tïïe røk jøøa tuu.
english: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aaa bäät thuur ni pï piny kaace ki bääge.
english: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ajwöm-cam mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie mar jø Juuth kare ocäännö.
english: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na tïŋ wïïe maalø, ni joot lwaak ni ööa baŋe, ena köö jï Pilip, «?Øøno ŋëëwø kaa ki muunni kiper nee cam jøøi ni thööth ii?»
english: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?

anywaa: Luummögø caane ni eni päänynya gø, 'ba eni ki dëëre gïno tïïe ŋääe.
english: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Pilipi, «Gwel ma dïpe ariiø ba doo rømø ki ŋïëw ki muunni kiper nee ŋati man nø jïte ki mo thiinh.»
english: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dï bääge, ni beeye Andaru cöök Cayman Piter, aköö jïre,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

anywaa: ni «Da nyilaal kany mo jïre da muunni abïïc ki rec ariiø. ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo kønyge jï jøøi ni thööth ii?»
english: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Köömmu jiy nee pïge piny.» 'Ba kaace da luum mo mar yie. Ni ö jøøgøøni ni pïge piny. 'Ba kwäänge bëët jïtö ki kume abïïc.
english: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni Jecu muunni alwøre. 'Ba na nø dwøk met ec jï Jwøk, apääŋŋe jï jøøa no opï piny, këël rec. Ni rømge bëët kaa mana manyge.
english: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø cämge ni jäŋge bëët, eni bääge aluumme, ni kööe, ni «Cooŋŋu moa no odhäthö, nee bäŋe gø mo rwäänyi.»
english: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.

anywaa: Køøre acooŋge ni päŋ gupe apaar kurriiø ki thäk muunni moa then then, na dööŋ piny baŋ jøøa cam ge.
english: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö jøøgø na neenge ŋïï mana tïïe, gena köö, ni «Ŋati beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk møn, na wäŋŋi ni doo thïïŋö bäät piny.»
english: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na joot gø ni geni caya man makge eni ki teek nee tïïcge na nyeya, ena cäŋ døø bäät thuur e keere.
english: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na abøøya ni cäŋ pätha piny, bääge aci Puul Galili,
english: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,

anywaa: ni cige yi jääy, ni täkge ki man ŋutge løøga yi Kapernaam. 'Ba kanyøgøøni piny oløny ni cøl, ni Jecu poot kär pïï buutge.
english: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.

anywaa: 'Ba naam ajïtö ka athaga mo päl, kiper jamø kwödö ni teek døc.
english: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.

anywaa: 'Ba na kïïge, ni geno nø kän wøk ki kiïlömethërri abïïc wala abïciel, Jecu ajootge ni cäädhö ki bäät pïï yi naam ni ööa kany mo cään ki jääy. Ni putge bwøk.
english: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Man a aani. Käru lwäyö.»
english: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.

anywaa: Kanyøgø yïthge amïnnö ki man kïthge gøøni yi jääy, ni put jääyi pïï lak ageela kuna cige yie.
english: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, jøøa no odööŋ løø Puul Galili, ajootge ni beeye jääy aciel keere na kwøŋge neen kanyøce, ni Jecu kär ci yi jäänögøøni ki bääge, 'ba beege bääge keerge na aay.
english: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

anywaa: 'Ba da jïëthe mo oöö ki yi Taybiria ni öge kany mo cään ki kanya ö Kwäärö na dwøk met ec jï Jwøk ni camge muunni yie.
english: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, na ö jøøgø na neenge Jecu ni tøør kaace ki bääge bëët, geni ki dëëtge gena ci yïth jïëthe ni cige yi Kapernaam kuna cacge Jecu.
english: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na jootge eni løøga, gena köö jïre, «?Dïpööy, ïïno ö kany yi wäne?»
english: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, naa ba cayu kaper ŋïïce moa neennu, 'ba a cayu kaper muunni moa cammu ni jäŋŋu.
english: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.

anywaa: Kär røgu ööllu kiper cam man wø ränynyi, 'ba tïïu kiper cam mano bëëdö, ni beeye mano këët ri kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, mano cïp Wär Dhaanhe jïïu. Kiper beeye eni na ö Jwøki na näk Wuuö na jïëe ki eni ni kïth ŋïï mare dëër gø.»
english: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena köö jïre, na «?Agïnaŋø na dewa tïïö, nee tïme ni wa tïïö ki tïï Jwøk?»
english: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Ki man jïëyu ki eni na jääŋ Jwøki ni ŋääthu gøøni beeye eni na tïï Jwøk.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.

anywaa: Køøre gena köö jïre, na «?A ŋïï mana ŋø nø noo tïïyï kiper nee neenwa nee wa jïëcwa ki ïïni ni ŋääthwa? ?Ïïni, agïnaŋø noo tïïyï?
english: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?

anywaa: Kwäcwa acämö ki meena dï paap kaawat mana gööri, ni ‹Gena mooe ki møø mo ööi ki maal nee camge.› »
english: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni paa Modhe na mooc uuni ki møø mana öö ki maal, 'ba beeye Wära wø cïp møø mana näk adïëri jïïu ni wø ööi ki maal.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.

anywaa: Kiper møø mar Jwøk beeye na öö ki maal ni ö piny, ni cïpe ki kwøw jï jø piny.»
english: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, ni «Kwäärö, cïp møgøgø jïwa cooth.»
english: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Beeye aani na møk kwøw. 'Ba ŋat wø ö baŋa doo bäŋ käc ree, ni ŋat wø jïëy ni ŋääth aani doo bäŋ riew ree na bäre bäre.
english: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gø jïïu, ni aana nø neennu, 'ba u kär jïëy.
english: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo wø cïp Wära jïra bëët ööa baŋa. 'Ba ŋat wø ö baŋa, ba riemma.
english: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

anywaa: A kär öö ki maal ni ööa piny naa tïïa mana manynya ki wïïa keera, 'ba beeye mana many Ŋata jääŋ aani ni wø tïïa.
english: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.

anywaa: Ni mana many Ŋata jääŋ aani beeye en, ni bäŋe ŋat mo rwäänya ri jøøa cïbe jïra bëët, 'ba beeye ki man tïŋa ge maal yi cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.
english: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

anywaa: 'Ba mana many Wära beeye en, ni ŋato wäro ŋec Wäädö ni jïëe ki eni ni ŋääth gø, jïtö ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. 'Ba aani, ŋatøgø otïŋa maal yi cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.»
english: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Juuth, gena ŋurö ki nyeŋŋe kiper na kööe, ni «Aana møø mana öö ki maal na ö piny.»
english: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö, na «?Aŋø, ŋati en paa Jecu o Jocep na wänni ki menni ŋääø? ?Aperŋø ni caan gïnögø kawaane, ni ‹Aana öö ki maal ni ööa piny›?»
english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Käru muuŋö yïthakiyu keeru.
english: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo maara ö baŋa ni näk ba nyïï Wära na jääŋ aani. 'Ba eni otïŋa maal yi cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.
english: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.

anywaa: 'Ba ogöörö yïth luup nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni ‹Geno pwöny Jwøki bëët.› 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø wïny dwør Wuuö ni kwanyge tier gø, ge ööa baŋa.
english: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo Wuuö ee neenø, 'ba beeye eni na käl baŋ Jwøk keere, na neen Wuuö.
english: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø jïëy ni ŋäädhe, ree da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.

anywaa: Beeye aani na møk kwøw.
english: I am that bread of life.

anywaa: Kwäyu acämö ki meena dï paap. 'Ba gena thøw.
english: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.

anywaa: 'Ba man en beeye møga öö ki maal ni ö piny, nee dhaanhø cäme ree, nee ba thøøe.
english: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye aani na møk kwøw mana öö ki maal na ö piny. Noo dee ŋat mo cam møgøgøøni, eni okwøw na bäre bäre. 'Ba møgo cïba kiper nee jø piny kwøwge, beeye dëëra.»
english: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø Juuth gena jïtö ki pïëm yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni «?Ŋati dëëre a dee gø cïbö jïïø nidïï nee camø?»
english: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Jecu aköö jïge, na «Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni näk dëër Wär Dhaanhø ba cammu, ni maathu remme, bäŋ kwøw dëëtu.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cam dëëra ni maath remma, ree da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni eno tïŋa maal yi cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.
english: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

anywaa: Kiper dëëra beeye cam møn, ni remma beeye maath møn.
english: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø cam dëëra ni maath remma beeye wø bëëdö dëëra, ni bëëda ree.
english: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.

anywaa: Wuuö ni wø bëëdö ni kwøw beeye na jääŋ aani, ni kwøa en kiper Wuuö. Kaawat manøgø, ŋat wø cam aani, okwøw ki køøra.
english: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.

anywaa: 'Ba møø manøgø beeye møga öö ki maal na ö piny, ni paa møga cam kwäyu ni thøwge. 'Ba ŋat wø cam møgøgøøni, okwøw na bäre bäre.»
english: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.

anywaa: Luummögø beeye mana caane yi øt acooŋ lam kanya pööe yi Kapernaam.
english: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

anywaa: 'Ba bääk Jecu mo thööth na wïnyge luummögø, gena köö, ni «Man a luubö mo teek. ?Aŋa noo lønye jïre ki man jïëc gøøni?»
english: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na ŋäc gø ki dëëre ni bääge moøgø muuŋö kiper luummögøøni, ena köö jïge, na «?Aŋø, cwïnynyu ränynyö kiper luubö man?
english: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?

anywaa: ?A dee tïmö nidïï nø ni näk mo Wär Dhaanhø neennu neenø ni cøøa maal kuna kwøŋ öö ki yie dïkwøŋ?
english: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?

anywaa: Beeye Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø cïpi ki kwøw; 'ba teek mar dhaanhø bäŋ gïn tïïe. 'Ba luupa caana jïïu kännö ki kwøw ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.

anywaa: 'Ba da jiy møøk dëëtu mo ba jïëy ni ŋääthge.» Kiper dëët jøøa kär jïëy, ŋäc Jecu cøøn, ki ŋato cïp eni ceŋ nyïïmän.
english: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni kööe, ni «Beeye tiere na caana gø jïïu, ni doo bäŋ ŋat mo doo maara ö baŋa, ni näk ba wëëga Wuue öö.»
english: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.

anywaa: Køør manøgøøni bääge mo thööth adøø cään ni tïmge ni ge ba cäädhi ki eni këët.
english: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jï jøøa näk apaar kurriiø, «?A uuni, u aay thuwø?»
english: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Cayman Piterri jïre, «?Wui Kwäärö, waano ciwa baŋ ŋa? Luum kwøw mana näk adïëri na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe ena baŋï.
english: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.

anywaa: Ni ewa ŋäädhö ni jootwa gøøni, ni beeye ïïni na en kur keerï na näk mar Jwøk.»
english: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, paa aani na jier uuni ni uuna apaar kurriiø, ni ö acielli røgu ni jït ree ka anägö?»
english: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?

anywaa: 'Ba eni cäänö kaper Juudac o Cayman Ickarïët, kiper beeye eni noo cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmän, ni ena bääŋ aciel røk jøøa näk apaar kurriiø.
english: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgøøni, Jecu atïmö ni wïïra yi Galili, ni ba many man ci Judia, kiper na tïm jø Juuthi ni ge manynya man 'näkge eni.
english: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Judaea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kaaca Ajwöm Cam mar jø Juuth man wø wøør ni jøw bëëdö yïth abïle kare ocäännö.
english: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmenni aköö jïre, ni «Wec kany, ni ciï yi Judia, nee tïïe mo wø tïïyï nee neen bäägï.
english: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo tïïö ni mare ee kanø, ni näk eni manynya man ŋäc mare. Ni näk gïïögø iï tïïö, nyooth riï jï jiy.»
english: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, këël nyïïmenni kär jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gøøni.
english: For neither did his brethren believe in him.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Caa mara poot kär öö, 'ba uuni, caae bëët beyø kiperu.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.

anywaa: 'Ba jø piny ba doo maara männö ki uuni, 'ba beeye aani na mänge ki gø, kiper na caana moa reyø na tïïcge.
english: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.

anywaa: Uuni, løny jïïu ki man cou kar ajwöma keeru. 'Ba aani, a ba ci kar ajwöma manøgø, kiper caa mara poot kär öö.»
english: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan luummögøøni, ena dööŋ yi Galili.
english: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.

anywaa: 'Ba na näk køøre ni nyïïmenni onø ci kar ajwöma, ena luuny cøø thuwø, 'ba dëëre käre nyoodhø.
english: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth ge neeta gø kar ajwöma, ni köge, na «?Age eni?»
english: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jiy atïmö ni ge muuŋö døc ki nyeŋŋe. Ni jø møøk köö, ni «Ena dhaanhø mo beer,» ni kö møøki, ni «Path, eni cøøga jiy jaak.»
english: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana lwäärge ki jø Juuth, bäŋ ŋat mo ocwøl nyeŋŋe ni wïnyö.
english: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot jiyi ni ge ena kar ajwöma, Jecu aci Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni pööe.
english: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth yïthge athäŋŋö ki pwöc moe ni köge, ni «?Ŋati en luupögø ee kwanyø kaa, ni eni kär pwönynyö?»
english: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «A ba pöö ka mara, 'ba beeye mar eni na jääŋ aani.
english: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.

anywaa: Nee da dhaanhø mo caya man tïïc mana many Jwøki, eni dee ŋääö ki man näk mo pwöc man en käla baŋ Jwøk, wala caana ka wïïa a keera.
english: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.

anywaa: Ŋat wø cäänö ki wïïe keere, wø cäänö kaper nee eni pwøc. 'Ba ŋat wø many Eni na jääŋ gøøni nee pwøc beeye na adïëri, ni eni bäŋ cwøk jïre.
english: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ciik Jwøk kär cïp Modhe jïïu? 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïïu mo ciik Jwøk ee gwøø. ?Aŋø ni cayu man 'nägu aani en?»
english: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jøøgø jïre, «Ïïni, riï da anägö. ?Aŋa ni cac man 'näk ïïni?»
english: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Aani gïrpiny aciel atïïa, ni ö uuni ni thäŋ yïthu bëët ki gø.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.

anywaa: Modhe luum daŋ acïbe jïïu, ni manøgøøni ba täga ri Modhe, 'ba täga ri kwäyu; ni ö uuni ni putu dhaanhø daŋ ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ni näk dhaanhø you daŋø ki cäŋ jwömö, kiper nee ciik mo Modhe ba dhallu, u doo wëër ki aani kiper na wëëga dëër dhaanhø mo tuu jöönnö bäre ki cäŋ jwömö?
english: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

anywaa: Kär nou ŋuta piny ki køør mana neennu ki nyeŋŋu, 'ba ŋudu ki ŋøl ma adïëri.»
english: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni jø møøk dï jø Jerucalem aköö, na «?Aŋø, paa ŋata manyge en, nee 'näkge?
english: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane eni luubö jaak, ni bäŋ gïn mo caange jïre. ?Aŋø, ŋäc kwääri wän ni ŋatøgøøni beeye Krictø?
english: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati kanya ööe ki yie ŋääø bëët. 'Ba Krictø noo ööe doo bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc kuno ööe ki yie.»
english: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
