anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na pööe Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, dwøre atïŋ maal døc, ni kööe, «Uuni, a ŋäyu. Ni ŋäyu kuna ööa ki yie. 'Ba aani, a kär öö ki wïïa, a keera. Eni na jääŋ aani beeye na adïëri, 'ba eni kuyu.
english: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, eni ŋääa, kiper a käla baŋe, ni beeye eni na jääŋ aani.»
english: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena tïmö ni ge manynya man makge gø, 'ba bäŋ ŋat mo cere ee rwaak baŋ gø, kiper na poot caa mare ni kär öö.
english: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth ajïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø, ni köge, «?Aŋø, kanyo ö Krictø yie, eni doo tïmö ki ŋïïce mo thööth mo kaala moa tïïc ŋati en?»
english: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith luum lwaaøgø awïnyge ni ge muuŋö na enøgønø ki nyeŋ Jecu. Ni ö kwääc laammi ki jø Paricith ni jääŋge dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk kuna makge gø.
english: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö, ni «Aano en buutu ki kany mo thiinh; noo näk køøre, aano døø baŋ Ŋata jääŋ aani.
english: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.

anywaa: Aano cayu, ni ba jootu aani. 'Ba kanyo ena yie, u ba doo maara ö yie.»
english: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth acäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, ni «?Ŋati, a kanya ŋø cøøn noo ci yie, ni eni ba joodø en? ?Aŋø, eni manynya man ci baŋ jø Juuth moa näk okeethø dï jø Gïrïïk, nee jø Gïrïïk pwönynye?
english: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?

anywaa: ?Tier mare nidïï na caan luummögøøni, ni ‹Aano cayu, ni ba jootu aani, ni kanyo ena yie, u ba doo maara ö yie›?»
english: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aŋuun nïr ajwöm-cam, cäŋa näk mo dwøŋŋa eni, Jecu ree athïïŋe ni tïŋ dwøre maal døc ni kööe, «Nee da dhaanhø mo ree da riew, wär eni ö baŋa nee mädhe.
english: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

anywaa: Ŋato jïëy ni ŋääth aani, cwïnye ojïti ki näm mo kwödö ki pï kwøw, kaa mana caani ya wëël Jwøki.»
english: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögøøni caane kaper Jwïëc Jwøk mano ö bäät jøw ojïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø. Kiper kar kaaca Jwïëc Jwøk poot kär cïbö, kiper na poot Jecu ni poot kär jïtö ka ajiem.
english: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luupögøøni, jø møøk aköö, ni «Ŋati beeye nyikuŋ Jwøk møn mana wäŋŋi.»
english: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.

anywaa: Ni kö møøki, ni «Ŋati beeye Krictø.» 'Ba møøk aköö, na «?Aŋø, Krictø doo öö ki yi Galili?
english: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?

anywaa: ?Kär caan wëël Jwøki na bëëde, ni Krictø doo käla ri nyïïkwaac Deebit, ni doo öö ki yi Bethelem, paana kwøŋ Deebiti bëëdö yie?»
english: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?

anywaa: Yi kar kanyøgøøni, jiy røkge apääŋge kipere.
english: So there was a division among the people because of him.

anywaa: Ni møøk dïge caya man makge gø, 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo cere ee rwaak baŋ gø.
english: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni, dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk adøøk ni cige baŋ kwääc laam ki jø Paricith. Ni ö kwääc laammi ki jø Paricith ni köge jïge, na «?Aŋø na ba kälu gøøni?»
english: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya dïkuye, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø mo okwøŋ cäänö kaamar ŋatøgøøni.»
english: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø Paricithi jïge, «?Aŋø, uuna cøøge thuwø?
english: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

anywaa: ?Da kwääri wala jø Paricith mo ojïëy ni ŋääthge eni?
english: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?

anywaa: 'Ba lwaaøgø enø, na kuc mana en ri ciik Jwøk, geno cienø.»
english: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

anywaa: 'Ba Niködima na en dëëtge, ŋata kwøŋ ci baŋ Jecu, aköö jïge,
english: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)

anywaa: «?Aŋø, ki køør ciik mo pøø, dhaanhø doo ŋøla wøk ni mare kär kwøŋ wïnynyö, ni kwany tier gïna tïïe?»
english: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø, «?A ïïni, ïïna nyï Galili thuwø? Noo manynyï yïth weet Jwøk døøc, diï joodø ni doo bäŋ nyikuŋ Jwøk mo doo öö ki yi Galili.»
english: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋati man nø ni døø paare.
english: And every man went unto his own house.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aci bäät Kïn Ølip.
english: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla cøøn, ena cäŋ duu Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. Ni ö jiyi bëët baŋe, ni pï piny ni pwöny geni.
english: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.

anywaa: 'Ba dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk ki jø Paricith, gena kännö ki dhaagø mo omaa ki luk. 'Ba na cïpge gø dïër,
english: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,

anywaa: gena köö jï Jecu, «Dïpööy, dhaaŋŋi en omaa ki luk.
english: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.

anywaa: Ki ri ciik Jwøk acaan Modhe jïwa, ni teeŋ dhaagø ma enøgø nø wär këëri ki kïte. ?A ïïni nø, agïnaŋø noo caanï kipere?»
english: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?

anywaa: Manøgø acaange ni ge päänynya gø nee ge jïtge ki jöö man kïthge bääte ki luubö. 'Ba Jecu agääŋ ni gööde piny ki lweete.
english: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana pootge ni ge pëënynya gøøni, eni ree athïïŋe ni kööe jïge, ni «Ŋato dëëre bäŋ raay dïïu wär kwøŋ lwötö ki kïdi ni thöör gøøni.»
english: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ gääŋŋö piny, ni gööde ki lweete.
english: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luummögø, gena aay no oceele ceele, ni tägi ka jøøa døøŋŋø. Ni ö Jecu ni dööŋe keere ki dhaaŋŋøgø na cuŋŋö nyïme.
english: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na thïïŋ ree aköö jïre, «?Nyijøøe, age geni? ?Bäŋ dhaanhø mo ojääl ïïni?»
english: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?

anywaa: Ni kö dhaaŋŋøgøøni, ni «Bäŋgø, Kwäärö.» Ni kö Jecu, «Aani thuwø, ï ba jääla. Ciï nø, ni ba bääyï këët.»]
english: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni cäŋ cäännö ki geni ni kööe, ni «Aana tac piny. Ŋat wø cäädhi køøra, ba cäädhi yi muudhö këët, 'ba beeye tac kwøw noo joode.»
english: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni, jø Paricith aköö jïre, «Ïïni, ï køpa gïrï keerï. 'Ba luummögø ni caanï enø patha adïëri.»
english: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «Këël doo nää a køpa gïra keera, luumma caana beeye adïëri. Kiper aani, kuna käla yie ki kuno cøøa yie ŋääa. 'Ba uuni kuna käla yie ki kuno cøøa yie kuyu.
english: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.

anywaa: Uuni, luup ŋølu piny ka køør acaac dhaanhø, 'ba aani bäŋ dhaanhø mo luumme ŋøla piny.
english: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ni näk maa ŋuta piny ki luup, ŋut piny mara beeye adïëri. Kiper paa a keera ni wø ŋøl luup piny, 'ba beeye aani ki Ŋata jääŋ aani.
english: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.

anywaa: Ki ri ciik Jwøk maru ogöörö, ni ‹Gïn wø caan jiyi ariiø, beeye adïëri.›
english: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.

anywaa: Aani, a caana mara, ni Wära na jääŋ aani wø køpa gïra.»
english: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, gena köö jïre, «?Aŋø, wäru, age eni?» Ni løgi ya Jecu, «Uuni, a kuyu, ni kuyu Wära thuwø. Onää a ŋäyu, Wära dou ŋääö thuwø.»
english: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

anywaa: Luupögøøni caane buut kar gïn wø cïp muuce yie, kanya pööe yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo omak gø, kiper na poot caa mare ni poot kär öö.
english: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Jecu köö jïge, ni «Aano aay, ni cayu aani, 'ba uuno thøw yïth raay mou. Ni kuno cøøa yie, u ba dou maara ö yie.»
english: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.

anywaa: Køøre jø Juuth aköö, «?Aŋø, ree nääe nääö, na caan gïnögø, ni ‹Kuno cøøa yie, u ba doo maara ö yie›?»
english: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, «Uuni, u käla piny, 'ba aani, a käla maalø. Uuna jø pinyi en, 'ba aani, a paa ŋat pinyi.
english: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.

anywaa: Anø caana jïïu, ni ‹Uuno thøø yïth raay mou.› Kiper ni näk mou ba jïëy ni beeye aani na eni, u thøøa yïth raay mou.»
english: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.

anywaa: 'Ba gena köö jïre, «?Ïïna ŋa cøøn?» Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Mana kwøŋa caan jïïu wïlöölö beeye ni pooda ree en.
english: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.

anywaa: Aani jïra da luup mo thööth mo caana caanø kiperu, ki mo thööth mo ŋøla piny. 'Ba eni na jääŋ aani beeye adïëri, ni luup moa wïnynya baŋe beeye ni wø caana jï jø piny.»
english: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.

anywaa: 'Ba geni tier gø kucge, ki man näk mo eni cäänö kaper Wuuö.
english: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö, ni «Noo ŋaabu Wär Dhaanhø maal, oŋäyu nø ni beeye aani na eni, ni bäŋ gïn mo tïïa ki wïïa keera, 'ba a wø cäänö keda mana ö Wuue na pwöny aani.
english: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na jääŋ aani, ena buuta. Naa käre wiiø a keera, kiper a wø tïïya gïï wø mïn yie ki ge cooth.»
english: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.

anywaa: 'Ba na cääne na enønø, jiy mo thööth ajïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø.
english: As he spake these words, many believed on him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø Jecu aköö jï jø Juuth moa näk ojïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø, ni «Ni näk mo pwöc 'moa wø kïthu bäät tïïc cooth, uuna bääga møn.
english: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;

anywaa: Ni dou adïëri ŋääö ni ö adïëri ni pät uuni.»
english: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

anywaa: Ni løkge gøøni jïre, ni «Waana nyïïkwaac Eeberam, ni wa kär kwøŋ tïmö ni waana laaŋe jï jø møøk. ?Aŋø ni kööï, ni wa doo pädö?»
english: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïïa reyø, gena laaŋe mo raay.
english: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.

anywaa: 'Ba laŋŋø ba doo bëëdö paana maai yie ki tøŋ na bäre bäre, 'ba wäädö beeye ni wø bëëdö poge na bäre bäre.
english: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.

anywaa: Kiper manøgøøni, ni näk uuno pät Wäädö, uuno pädö møn.
english: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

anywaa: Ŋääa ni uuna nyïïkwaac Eeberam, 'ba u poot caya man 'nägu aani, kiper luumma käru maa ki cwïnynyu.
english: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

anywaa: Aani, a caana moa jooda baŋ Wära, ba uuni, u tïïya moa wïnynyu baŋ wääu.»
english: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jï Jecu, ni «Eeberam beeye na wääwa.» Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Onää uuna nyïï Eeberam, u doo tïïya gïïa tïïc Eeberammi.
english: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane u caya man 'nägu aani, ni aana ŋat maa caana adïëri jïïu mana wïnynya baŋ Jwøk. Manøgøøni patha mana tïïc Eeberammi.
english: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba u bëëdö nou tïïya mana tïïc wääu.» Ni köge jïre, ni «Wa kär nywølø ni waana wäät kääpe. Jïwa da wääwa aciel, na näk beeye Jwøk.»
english: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Onää Jwøk beeye Wääu, u doo mëër ki aani, kiper Jwøk beeye na käla baŋe. A kär öö ki wïïa a keera, 'ba beeye eni na jääŋ aani.
english: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni ba wïnynyu luup mo wø caana jïïu en? Tiere beeye ni ïthu you dhïïŋö ki luumma.
english: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.

anywaa: U käla ri wääu na näk anägö, nou manynya man tïïyu man wø many wääu. Eni, ena dïnääy këël ki kanya täge yie, ni bäŋ gïn manynye ra adïëri, kiper na bäŋe adïëri cwïnye. 'Ba kany wø caan tööt, eni caana gïr bëëtö mare, kiper na näk ena dïtwöt, ni beeye wää tööti.
english: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, kiper na caana adïëri, u bäŋ wø jïëy ki aani.
english: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

anywaa: ?Aŋa dïïu na joot aani ni aano bääyö? ?'Ba ni näk a caana adïëri, aŋø ni ba jïëyu ki aani?
english: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø näk dhaanh Jwøk, wø wïnynya luup Jwøk. 'Ba kiper na ba nägu mo Jwøk, beeye ni ba wïnynyu luupe.»
english: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø Juuthi jï Jecu, na «?Aŋø, marwa paa adïëri møn, na caanwa gøøni ni ïïna nyï Cameria, ni riï da anägö?»
english: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «Raa bäŋ anägö. 'Ba aani, a wøøra Wära, ni ö uuni ni ba wøørru aani.
english: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a ba cac man ö jiyi ni pwøcge aani. 'Ba beeye Jwøk ni wø cac man pwøc aani, eni ni wø ŋøl luup.
english: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, noo dee ŋat mo gwøk luumma, eni thøø ba dee belø.»
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth aköö jïre, ni «Kawaane, aŋäcwa møn ni riï da anägö. Eeberam athøw, kaawat mana thøw nyïïkuk Jwøki. ?Ï doo köö, ni ‹Noo dee ŋat mo gwøk luumma, eni thøø ba dee belø›?
english: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dwøŋŋa ïïni ki kwarwa ma Eeberam na thøw? Këël nyïïkuk Jwøk athøw. ?Ïïni, riï otïïyï gø na ŋa cøøn?»
english: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «Ni näk maa pwøya dëëra, pwøc mara ba doo thura kare. 'Ba beeye Wära ni wø pwøc aani, ŋat wø gïre caannu ni beeye Jwøk maru.
english: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:

anywaa: 'Ba eni kuyu. 'Ba aani, eni ŋääa. Onää yaa caanø, ni eni kuua, a doo tïmö ni aana twöt kaawat maru. 'Ba aani eni ŋääa, ni luumme yaa gwøø.
english: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.

anywaa: 'Ba kwaru ma Eeberam yie amïnnö na wëëgi man neen nïra. Ni neen gø, ni mïn yie.»
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

anywaa: Yi kar kanyøgøøni jø Juuth aköö jïre, «Ïïni, cwiiyï poot kär tïmö na pïërabïïyu. ?Aŋø, Eeberam iï neenø wäne?»
english: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, kanya poot Eeberammi ni poot kär nywølø, a nutö.»
english: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena kwänynyö ki kïte nee eni këërge ki ge, 'ba Jecu ree akane ki geni, ni aa wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ.
english: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Jecu ni cäädhö, eni dhaanhø mo nywöli na cwør ajoode.
english: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni pëënyge gøøni, ni «?Dïpööy, aŋa na bääyö, beeye nyenøgø, wala jøøa nywøl gø, ni nywöli na cwør en?»
english: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «Paa kiper ni nyenøgø obääyö, wala jøøa nywøl gø, 'ba beeye kiper nee tïïe mo Jwøk nyooth ki ree.
english: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.

anywaa: Ø doo tïïya tïïe mo Ŋata jääŋ aani, kany wø poode na waŋcäŋ. Kiper piny otïmö na wäär, kany wø bäŋe ya ŋat mo tïïö.
english: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.

anywaa: Kany pooda naa poot ena piny en, aana tac piny.»
english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caan gïnögø, ena ŋuut piny ki laaw, ni bïl døødø ki laawøgøøni, ni rwøth døødø nyeŋ ŋata näk cwør,
english: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,

anywaa: ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ciï ni lwøgï yi puul Caylööm;» na näk tier nyeŋŋe beeye Jääk. Køøre ena cøø ni lwøe, ni duue ni nëënö.
english: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ bëëdö ki eni na aciel, ki jøøa wara neen gø ni kwääö, gena köö, na «?Aŋø, ŋati en, paa eni na wara näk opï piny ni kwääö?»
english: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?

anywaa: Ni kö jø møøki, ni «Beeye eni.» 'Ba jø møøk aköö, ni «Path, ge caala rege.» 'Ba ŋatøgø aköö, ni «Beeye aani ki dëëra kiree.»
english: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, ni «?Ni näk beeye ïïni, nyeŋŋï røkge ege jabø nidïï?»
english: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?

anywaa: Ni løk gø, ni «Ŋat wø cwøl ni Jecu beeye na bïl døødø ni rwøth gø nyeŋŋa ni kööe ki aani, ni ‹Ciï yi Caylööm ni lwøgï.› Køøre aana cøø ni lwøa ni put nyeŋŋa døø karge.»
english: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «?Age eni?» Ni kööe, «Kare kuua.»
english: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyenøgø na näk okwøŋ cøørø akäl jiyi baŋ jø Paricith.
english: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø beeye cäŋ jwömö na ö Jecu na bïl døødø ni jap nyeŋ gø.
english: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith ŋatøgø apëënyge thuwø, ni «?Nyeŋŋï odøø karge nidïï?» Ni kööe jïge, ni «Eni døødø arwøth nyeŋŋa, ni lwøa ni neena en.»
english: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith møøk aköö, ni «Ŋatøgø ba käl baŋ Jwøk, kiper eni luum cäŋ jwömö bäŋ wø gwøe.» 'Ba møøk aköö, no «?Onää ŋatøgø ŋat raay, ŋïïce ma yøøgønø a dee gø tïïö nidïï?» Yi kar kanyøgøøni yïthakicge ajïtö ki pïëm.
english: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.

anywaa: Køøre gena cäŋ köö jï ŋata näk ocøør, ni «?Ïïni, agïnaŋø noo caanï kiper ŋatøgø kaa mana jap nyeŋŋï enøgø?» Ni kööe, ni «Ena nyikuŋ Jwøk.»
english: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth patha ojïëy ni eno kwøŋ bëëdö na cwør, ni cäŋ nyeŋŋe døø karge, këël mana ö geni na cwølge jøøa nywøl ŋata näk nyeŋŋe odøø karge.
english: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.

anywaa: Ni pëënyge ge, ni «?Man beeye wäädu mana kööu ni nywöli na cwør? ?Eni ocäŋ nëënne nidïï kawaane?»
english: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?

anywaa: Ni dwøgi jøøa nywøl gø, ni «Ŋäcwa ni ŋatøgø beeye wäätwa, ni nywöli na cwør.
english: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:

anywaa: 'Ba jöö mana nëëne ki gøøni kawaane kucwa, ki ŋata jap nyeŋ gø. Pëënynyu eni. Eni dwøŋ. Eno cäänö kiper dëëre keere.»
english: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.

anywaa: Luummögø acaan jøøa nywøl gø kiper na lwäärge ki jø Juuth. Kiper onø ŋøl jø Juuthi ni noo dee dhaanhø mo caan gø ni Jecu beeye Krictø, eni di mänö ki ööny øt acooŋ lam.
english: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.

anywaa: Ni beeye na kö jøøa nywøl gø, ni «Eni dwøŋ. Pëënynyu eni.»
english: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋata näk ocøør acäŋge cwøllø ri rietge ni köge jïre, ni «Pwøc ka Jwøk. Ŋäcwa ni nyenøgø ŋat raay.»
english: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, ni «Nee ena ŋat raay, wala patha eni, kuua. 'Ba gïrpiny aciel keere beeye ni ŋääa, aani, aana kwøŋ bëëdö ni aana cwør møn, ni nëëna ennø.»
english: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «?Agïnaŋø na tïïe dëërï? ?Nyeŋŋï ee jabø nidïï?»
english: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïge, «Anø caana jïïu, ni ba wïnynyu gøøni. ?Aŋø ni manynyu man cäŋu gø wïnynyö këët en? ?Aŋø, u caya man tïmu ni uuna bääge thuwø?»
english: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni cäänge ki luubö mo raac dëëre, ni köge, ni «Bee ïïni na bääŋ ŋatøgø, 'ba waani, waana bääk Modhe.
english: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

anywaa: Ŋäcwa ni Jwøk acäänö ki Modhe, 'ba mar nyenøgø, kanya ööe ki yie kiree kucwa.»
english: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk ŋatøgøøni, ni «Eni kuna käl yie kuyu, 'ba eni nyeŋŋa ajabe. Manøgø beeye gïn mo rëëma ec.
english: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.

anywaa: Ŋääø ni Jwøk dööt jø raay bäŋ wø wïnynye. 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo wø wøøra Jwøk ni tïïc mana many Jwøki, dwøre wø wïny Jwøki wïnynyö.
english: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.

anywaa: 'Ba poot kär wïnynyö bäre bäre ki kanya täk pinynyi, ni da ŋat mo nyeŋ dhaanhø mo nywöli na cwør ee jabø.
english: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.

anywaa: Onää ŋatøgø ba käl baŋ Jwøk, doo bäŋ gïn mo dee maara tïïc.»
english: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïre, ni köge, ni «Ïïni, ï nywöla yïth raay. ?Aŋø, wa diï pwönynyö?» Ni putge gø cöör wøk.
english: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.

anywaa: 'Ba awïny Jecu ni ŋatøgø ocöör wøk. 'Ba na joot gøøni, ena köö, ni «?Ïïna jïëy ki Wär Dhaanhø ni ŋäädhï?»
english: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?

anywaa: Ni løk gø jïre, ni «?Kwäärö, ena ŋa? Kiper naa jïëa ni ŋäädha eni.»
english: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Ena nø neenï, ni bee eni ni cäänö ki ïïni en.»
english: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö, aana jïëy ni ŋäädha.» Ni wøør gø.
english: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, ni «Aani, a ö piny kaper nee luup jiy ŋøla, nee jøøa bäŋ nyeŋ, nee nëënge, ni tïm jøøa da nyeŋ na cööye.»
english: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Paricith møøk mo ena buute na wïnyge luummögø, gena köö jïre, «?A waani, waana cööye thuwø?»
english: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Onää uuna cööye, doo bäŋ ajäla bäätu, 'ba kawaane kiper mana kööu, ni jïïu da nyeŋ, ajäla maru adööŋ bäätu.»
english: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø ba dønyi ki dhi kal mar dïëk, 'ba eni edhi ka jöö mør, ŋatøgø beeye kuu ni näk dïtwïëdi.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø dønyi ki dhi kal beeye dïkwääy dïëk.
english: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋat wø koor dhi kal ni jap gø jïre. Ni ö dïëki ni wïnyge dwøre. Ni eni dïëge wø cøøre cøørø ki nyeŋge, ni bwøth geni wøk.
english: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.

anywaa: 'Ba wø nø käl moe wøk bëët, eni cøøa nyïmge, ni ö dïëki ni cääthge køøre, kiper na ŋäcge dwør gø.
english: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.

anywaa: Ni geni ba doo cäädhö køør ŋat mo path, 'ba ge bwøk, kiper na kucge dööt jiy mo path.»
english: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.

anywaa: Luummögø acaan Jecu jïge kaamar leer, 'ba tier mana caane jïge kärge kwanyø ni beer.
english: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgøøni Jecu acäŋ köö jïge, na «Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni beeye aani na dhi øt dïëk.
english: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ öö bëët naa poodi beege kuuwe ni näkge dïtwïëte. 'Ba marge kär leŋ dïëki.
english: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

anywaa: Aana dhi øtø. Noo dee ŋat mo dunynyi ki raa, eni di piemø. Ni eni dønynya yie ni duu wøk cooth ni jïte ki pwöla mo yie da luum mo mar.
english: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.

anywaa: 'Ba kuu wø ööi kaper kwal keere, ki 'näk, ka aranya. 'Ba aani, a ööi kaper nee ge kwøwge ki kwøw mana näk adïëri.
english: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

anywaa: Aana dïkwääy mana näk adïëri. 'Ba dïkwääy mana näk adïëri jwïëye cïbe cïbö kiper dïëk.
english: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo tïïö ka jammi ni paa dïkwääy ni dïëk paa moe, kany wø joot kwac ni öö, dïëk wø wiie wiiø ni reeŋe. Ni ö kwaci ni maaŋ dïëk ni keeth geni.
english: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.

anywaa: Eni reŋi kaper na tïïe ki jammi ni bäŋ gïn mo maar caar kiper dïëk.
english: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aana dïkwääy mana näk adïëri. Ni moa näk 'moa ŋääa, ni ö 'moa ni ŋäcge aani,
english: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.

anywaa: kaa mana ö Wuue ni ŋäc aani, ni ŋääa Wuuö thuwø. Ni aani jwïëya cïba cïbö kiper dïëk.
english: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.

anywaa: 'Ba jïra da dïëk møøk mo tøør ri pïïth man. 'Ba geni käla kälö thuwø, ni wïnyge dwøra. Køøre geno tïmö na pïïth aciel ki dïkwääy aciel.
english: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.

anywaa: 'Ba tier mëër mar Wuuö ki aani beeye kiper mana jïëa ki man cïba jwïëya, nee cäŋa lwørrø.
english: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo käl gø wøk cera, 'ba cïpa a keera ki wïïa. Jïra da teek ki man cïba gø, ki teek man cäŋa gø lwørrø. 'Ba luummögø jooda baŋ Wära.»
english: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø yïthakic jø Juuth acäŋ jïtö ka apääk kiper luupögø.
english: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.

anywaa: Ni kö mo thööthi, ni «Eni ree da anägö, ni ena dïbøøl. ?Aŋø ni cegu ïthu ki luumme?»
english: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?

anywaa: 'Ba møøk aköö, ni «Luupi ba doo caan dhaanhe mo ree da anägö. ?Aŋø, anägö nyeŋ dhaanhø ma cwør dee jabø?»
english: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgøøni beeye nïr ajwöma yi Jerucalem, ni beeye ajwöm par wïc kiper kanya cïp Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ kur keere.
english: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.

anywaa: 'Ba kar kanyøgø, piny arïïa, ni Jecu nutö kaagø, ni eni cäädhö ya agööl Cølöman na en deŋ Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ.
english: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Juuth røkge acooŋge buute, ni köge jïre, ni «?Marï ocaanï gø wäne ni wëëgï wa koor en? Ni näk beeye ïïni na Krictø, caanï jïwa ni wïnyö jaak.»
english: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «Anø caana jïïu, 'ba u bäŋ wø jïëy. 'Ba tïïe mo wø tïïa ki nyeŋ Wära beege wø køp gïra.
english: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u kär jïëy, kiper na ba enu ri dïëga.
english: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba dïëga dwøra wø wïnyge wïnynyö, ni ŋääa geni, ni ö geni ni cääthge køøra.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:

anywaa: Ni cïpa jïge ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. 'Ba ge ba doo maara ränynyö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo doo gwëën ge wøk cera.
english: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

anywaa: Wära na cïp geni jïra, dwøŋŋa eni ki jammi bëët, ni bäŋ ŋat mo doo maara lønyø jïre ki man gwëën ge wøk cer Wära.
english: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.

anywaa: Aani ki Wuuö, waana acielø.»
english: I and my Father are one.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth gena cäŋ kwänynyö ki kïte nee eni këërge.
english: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, «Aani tïïe mo thööth mo beyø mo käla baŋ Wära, anyoodha jïïu. ?A manaŋø nø dëëtge noo këëru aani kipere?»
english: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø Juuthi jïre, ni «Paa per tïïc mo beer noo këërwa ïïni kipere, 'ba beeye per ajaany. Kiper ïïna dhaanhø mo nëëna waani, ni tïïyï riï na Jwøk.»
english: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, paa ogöörö yi Wëël Ciik Jwøk maru, ni ‹Jwøk aköö, ni uuna juu›?
english: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?

anywaa: ?Ni näk jøøa ö luum Jwøki baŋge ee cwølø ni juu, ni moa en yi wëël Jwøk ba maar dhal,
english: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

anywaa: aŋø, u doo köö, naa jädö, a na cïp Wuue kur keere ni jääŋŋi piny, kiper na kööa, ni ‹Aana O Jwøk›?
english: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa ba tïïc tïïe mo Wära, käru jïëy ki aani.
english: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa tïïya geni, këël u bäŋ doo jïëy ni ŋääthu aani, jïëyu ki tïïe, kiper nee ŋäyu ni ci cwïnynyu ni Wuuö ena raa, ni ena ri Wuuö.»
english: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

anywaa: Ni cäŋge tïmö ni ge manynya man makge gø, 'ba kär päth ceŋge.
english: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,

anywaa: 'Ba ena cäŋ ŋut løø Naam Jördan kanya kwøŋ Jøønni löö yie na nyuudhi, ni put bëëte kaace.
english: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi mo thööth baŋe ni ge köö, ni «Jøøn bäŋ ŋïï mo ee tïïö, 'ba luup bëët moa car Jøønni kiper ŋatøgø athur karge na adïëri.»
english: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.

anywaa: Ni jïëc mo thööthi ki eni kanyøce, ni ŋääthge gø.
english: And many believed on him there.

anywaa: Kanyøgø, da dhaanhø mo tuu mo cwøl ni Ladhara, ma nyï Bethani po Meeri ki coki ma Martha.
english: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri manøgø beeye Meeri mana wïïr Kwäärö ki maaw ni pooc tiet gø ki jïëye, ni beeye coki ma Ladhara na tuu.
english: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni nyïïmii Ladhara na tuu gena jääk baŋ Jecu, ni ge caana gø, ni «Kwäärö, ŋata mëërï ki gø tuu.»
english: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Jecu, ena köö, ni «Täwögøøni ba cööp ri thøø, 'ba beeye noo käl ajiem jï Jwøk, kiper nee O Jwøk jiem ri gøøni.»
english: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu mëër ki Martha ki coki ma Meeri, ki Ladhara.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïny gøøni ni Ladhara tuu, ena bëëdö ki nïne ariiø møøk kanya en yie.
english: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgøøni, ena köö jï bääge, ni «Beerra man døø Judia.»
english: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

anywaa: 'Ba bääge aköö jïre, «Dïpööy, kany mo cään en jø Juuth caya man këërge ïïni ki kïte. ?Ï doo cäŋa døø kaace këët?»
english: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «?Aŋø, paa kwör caae apaar kurriiø ki yi cäŋ bäre? Ni näk dhaanhø cäädhi ka dïcäŋ, tiete ba dee cwanynyø, kiper tac piny man nëënö jïre.
english: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaanhø cäädhi ka wäär, tiete dee cwanynyø, kiper na bäŋe tar jïre.»
english: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.

anywaa: Køøre na nø cääne na enønø, ena luuny köö jïge, «Nyawadø ma Ladhara abutö, 'ba a cøøa kuna jiia gøøni yïth niine.»
english: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääge aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, ni näk mare niine ki täw, dëëre opï piny.»
english: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu cäänö kaper thøw Ladhara, 'ba ki baŋge ni Jecu cäänö ni Ladhara jwöma ree yïth niine.
english: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.

anywaa: Kanyøgø acaan Jecu jïge na kare, ni «Ladhara athøw.
english: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kiperu yia met na ba ena kaace, kiper nou jïëyu ni ŋäädhu. 'Ba ø cøøa baŋe ennø.»
english: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Tøma na cwøl na Acwiek aköö jï bääŋi møga, «Ø cøø thuwø, nee ø thøø ki eni na aciel.»
english: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Jecu kunöce, Ladhara ajoode no onø jïtö ki nïne aŋween yi bwörö.
english: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.

anywaa: 'Ba Bethani kare cään ki Jerucalem ni yaakicge jïtö ki kiïlömethërri adäk.
english: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth mo thööth oö kuna lïïmge Martha ki Meeri ni cøma cwïnyge kiper thøw cöökge.
english: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Martha ni Jecu aöö, ena ci kuna røømge ki gø, ni dööŋ Meeri no opï piny yi øtø.
english: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.

anywaa: Ni kö Martha jï Jecu, «Kwäärö, onää ï ena kany, coka ba doo thøw.
english: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kawaane ŋääa ni gïno pëënynyï ki Jwøk, ocïp Jwøki jïrï.»
english: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïgø, ni «Cöögu ocäŋ ö maal.»
english: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.

anywaa: 'Ba Martha aköö jïre, «Ŋääa ni eno cäŋ ö maal kanyo tïŋ jiy maal ki yi thøø, cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.»
english: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Beeye aani wø tïŋ jiy maal ki yi thøø ni näga kwøw. Ŋat wø jïëy ni ŋääth aani, këël doo thøw, eni doo cäŋa kwøwø.
english: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo kwøw, mo ojïëy ni ŋääth aani, ba thøw bäre bäre. ?Manøgø kärï jïëö?»
english: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Martha jïre, «Kare møn, Kwäärö, aana jïëy ni beeye ïïni na Krictø na näk O Jwøk, ŋata wäŋŋi ni ööa piny.»
english: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

anywaa: Køøre Martha, na nø caan luummögø, ena cøø ni cwøl coki ma Meeri ni caan gø jï gø mëëth, ni «Dïpööy ena kany, ni pëënynya ïïni.»
english: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Meeri, ena laar ö maal ni ci baŋ gø.
english: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu poot kär ci dï paac, 'ba poot ena kanya røømge yie ki Martha.
english: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth na en yi øtø ki Meeri ni cøma cwïny gøøni, na jootge Meeri ni laara ö maal ni cøøa wøk, gena läp køøre; ki baŋge ni eni cøøa kuna jwöŋe bäät bwörö.
english: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na pïïc Meeri kanya en Jecu yie ni joot gø, ena päth tiet gø, ni kööe jïgø, «Wui Kwäärö, onää ï ena kany, coka ba doo thøw.»
english: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu na joot Meeri ni jwöŋö ki jø Juuth moa öö ki eni na aciel, cwïnye apädhö døc ni kïmme.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Eni you koonya kaa?» Ni köge jïre, «Ööï, Kwäärö, ö neenï.»
english: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.

anywaa: Ni ö Jecu ni put jwöŋö.
english: Jesus wept.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø Juuth aköö, «Neennu mëëye ki gø.»
english: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!

anywaa: 'Ba møøk dïge aköö, na «?Aŋø, eni na jap nyeŋ ŋata näk cwør, ŋatøgø ba dee mänö ki thøø?»
english: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?

anywaa: Kanyøgø cwïny Jecu acäŋ pädhö døc, ni ci bäät bwörö. 'Ba bwöyögøøni beeye kany mo ŋaam yi kïdi. Ni da kïdi mør mo oŋiel dhee.
english: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu, «Daagu kïdi.» 'Ba Martha na näk cöök ŋata näk othøwi aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, kawaane ennø, dëëre onø kwääö, kiper nïr thøwe oløny na aŋweenø.»
english: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «?Aŋø, kära caana jïrï, ni ‹Ni näk ïïno jïëy ni ŋäädhï, ajiem Jwøk diï neenø›?»
english: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

anywaa: Kanyøgø kïdi adaakge. Ni ö Jecu ni lwïthe maal ni kööe, «Awuuö, a duua met ec jïrï kiper na wïnynyï mara.
english: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.

anywaa: Ni ŋääa ni mara wø wïnynyï wïnynyö cooth. 'Ba man, caana kaper jøøi ni cuŋŋi buuta en, kiper nee jïëcge naa jääŋŋa ïïni.»
english: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan gïnögøøni, ena cwötö ki dwøl mo päl, ni kööe, «Ladhara, ö wøk!»
english: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.

anywaa: Ni put ŋata näk othøwi ö wøk ni ceŋŋe ki tiete omeenø ka abïïe, ni wïïe obøønyø ka abïï mør. Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Pätu eni nee aae.»
english: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Juuth mo thööth moa öö ki Meeri, na neenge gïna tïïc Jecu, gena jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø.
english: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk dïge, gena ci baŋ jø Paricith ni waacge gïna tïïc Jecu.
english: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.

anywaa: Køøre kwääc laam ki jø Paricith, kwääc løøe acooŋge kanya ciel, ni köge, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø? Kiper ŋati atïïö ki ŋïïce mo thööth.
english: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.

anywaa: Ni näk mo wiiø wiiø ni tïïö na enøgønø, jiy bëët jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gøøni, ni ö jø Römmi ni öge ni nyakge Øt Jwøk marø ki pøø bäre.»
english: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dïge mo cwøl ni Keepa, ma Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ cwiinøca, aköö jïge, «Bäŋ gïn ŋäyu møn.
english: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni doo beerra eni ki mana di dhaanhe acielli thøw kiper jiy, ki man räny paaci bäre?»
english: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø käre caanø ki wïïe keere. 'Ba kiper mana näk ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ cwiinøca, beeye na caan gø ki køør mana cïp Jwøki cwïnye, ni Jecu doo thøw kiper paac bäre,
english: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;

anywaa: ni paa kiper paac keere, 'ba kiper nee nyïï Jwøk moa näk okeethø tiet mïëri møøk nee cooŋ kanya ciel.
english: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca gena put tïmö ni ge määnyö ki jöö man 'näkge Jecu ki gø.
english: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu atïmö ni ba cäädhi dï jø Juuth këët ni ree ee nyoodhø. 'Ba ena dak kanyøgøøni ni ci pääny mør mo cwøl ni Ipariem mo ena ŋäth mïëri møga, ni bëëde kaace ki bääge.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie mar jø Juuth kare ocäännö. Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ki dï paac ni cige yi Jerucalem, kanya poot cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie ni poodi, kuna jiiŋge dëëtge.
english: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

anywaa: Ni neetge Jecu, kanya cuŋge yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni ge pëënynya dëëtge, na «?Agïnaŋø na caarru? ?Eni ööa ya ajwöm-cam?»
english: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam ki jø Paricith onø cïpö ki dwøl, ni noo dee dhaanhø mo ŋäc kanya en yie, wär caane jïge, kiper nee eni makge.
english: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni dööŋŋa nïne abïciel kiper ajwömcam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, Jecu aö yi Bethani, kanya bëët Ladhara yie, ŋata tïŋ Jecu maal ki yi thøø.
english: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu atïmge ki cam. 'Ba Martha beeye na käl cam, ni Ladhara ena dï jøøa en kar cam ki eni na aciel.
english: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.

anywaa: Ni ö Meeri ni lwöte ki maaw mo ŋeew ka gwel mo thööth, ni wïïr tiet Jecu ki gøøni, ni pøc gø ki jïëye. Ni ö øte bäre ni pääŋe ki ŋwääny maaw manøgø.
english: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac Ickarïët na en dï bääge, ŋato cïp eni ceŋ nyïïmänne, aköö,
english: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,

anywaa: na «?Aŋø na ba dwøk maarøgøøni pwödhö ki gwel ma dïpe adägö, ni mëëk gwete jøøa can?»
english: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?

anywaa: 'Ba luummögøøni ba caane kaper ni yie met ki man køny jøøa can, 'ba caane kaper na näk ena kuu, no opïr gwel ena cere, ni eni wø lwötö ri mo wø kïth yie.
english: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, «Wec nyaanøgø, nee gïnögø bëëde na ŋïï kiper cäŋo koony aani yie.
english: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.

anywaa: Jøøa can wø ena dïïu cooth, 'ba aani, a ba en dïïu cooth.»
english: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnynyi ya lwaa jø Juuthi ni eni ena kaace, gena öö bëët, ni ge ba ööi kaper Jecu keere, 'ba ge ööi nee Ladhara raŋge thuwø, ŋata tïŋ maal ki yi thøø.
english: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni kwääc laam ocäänö ni Ladhara 'näkge nääö thuwø,
english: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;

anywaa: kiper mana tïm jø Juuthi mo thööth ni rege ege løø baŋ Jecu, ni jïëcge ki eni ni ŋääthge gøøni ki køør mana neenge ri Ladhara.
english: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïme na aruunnø man lwaak mo päl mana ö kar ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, awïnyge ni Jecu ööa yi Jerucalem.
english: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena käädö ki bäät tuue ni cige kuna røømge ki eni, ni ge rëëdö, ni «Odhaana! Pwøc en jï Jwøk!  Gwïëth en ri ŋat ööi en ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk, ni beeye na Nyeny jø Icriel.»
english: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na joot nya arëën, ena pï bäät gøøni kaa mana gööri,
english: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

anywaa: ni «Kärï lwäyö, Dhayan. Raŋï, nyeya marï ööa baŋï, ni ena bäät nya arëën.»
english: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

anywaa: 'Ba dïkwøŋ tier luummögø kär ci cwïny bääge ni beer. 'Ba na jït Jecu ka ajiem, wïthge aputge par ni gïïa näk ogöörö kipere athur karge.
english: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaaa en buute kanya cwöl Ladhara wøk ki yi bwörö, ni tïŋ gø maal ki yi thøø, beege na køp gïr gø.
english: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na ci lwaaki nee røømge ki eni, kiper na wïnyge ŋïï manøgø na tïïe.
english: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni jø Paricith acäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni «Käru joodø, uuni, bäŋ gïn mo maaru tïïc! Neennu, dhaanhø bäre aci køøre!»
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø Gïrïïk dï jøøa ci baŋ lam yi kar ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie.
english: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

anywaa: Ni öge baŋ Pilip na näk nyï Betheeda, paac mo ena yi Galili, ni köge jïre, «Ŋat dwøŋ, wa caya man neenwa Jecu.»
english: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

anywaa: Ni ci Pilipi ni caan gø jï Andaru. Ni ci Andaru ki Pilip ni caange gø jï Jecu.
english: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïge, ni «Kanyo jiem Wär Dhaanhø yie kare acäännö.
english: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, acaana gø jïïu, ni näk waŋ bëëlö kär päth yïth ŋøøm ni thøøe, waŋ bëëllögø doo bëëdö keere. 'Ba ni näk mo othøw, beeye wø känne ki nyïëdi mo thööth.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.

anywaa: Ŋat wø mëër ki jwïëye, wø nyääga gø. 'Ba ŋat wø män ki jwïëye yi pinyi en, gwøga gø kiper kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo tïnynya aani, wär eni caath køøra. Ni kanyo ena yie, beeye kanyo en ŋat wø tïny aani yie thuwø. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo tïnynya aani, eno røøny Wära.
english: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.

anywaa: «Kawaane ennø cwïnya opädhö. ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo caana? ?A doo köö, na ‹Awuuö, wëëk a pöödhö ki yi gïn›? Patha eni, kiper beeye kanya wäŋŋi en na öönynya.
english: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.

anywaa: Awuuö, jiem nyeŋŋï.» Køøre dwøl aput öö ki maal, ni kööe, na «Anø jiema, ni cäŋa ka jiemmø.»
english: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

anywaa: 'Ba lwaaa cuŋŋö buute na wïnyge dwørøgø, gena köö, ni «Køth amäär.» 'Ba møøk aköö, «Ni cäänö nyïïatwiel maal ki eni.»
english: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «Dwørøgøøni ööi kaperu, ni ba ööi kapera.
english: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye kar ŋøl luum piny en nø. Ni kawaane beeye kanyo riem kwääy pinyi wøk yie.
english: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

anywaa: 'Ba aani kanyo tïŋ a maal bäät piny, jiy bëët onyïïa baŋa.»
english: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

anywaa: Luummögø caane ni nyootha thøø mano thøøe ki gø.
english: This he said, signifying what death he should die.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk lwaaki jïre, na «Awïnywa ri ciik Jwøk ni Krictø doo bëëdö na bäre bäre. ?Aŋø na caanï gø, ni Wär Dhaanhø doo tïŋa maal? ?Wär Dhaanhnhøgø aŋa?»
english: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, ni «Tar obëëdö dïïu ki kany mo thiinh. Cäädhu kany poode ni tar bëëdö dïïu en, kiper nou ba mac muudhe. 'Ba ŋat wø cäädhi yi muudhö, kun wø ci yie kuue.
english: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

anywaa: Kany poode ni tar ena buutu en, jïëyu ki tayøgø ni ŋääthu gø, kiper nou tïmu ni uuna nyïï tayøgøøni.»
english: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.

anywaa: 'Ba na løny Jecu ki caan luummögøøni, ena aay ni kan ree ki ge.
'Ba këël na bëët Jecu ni tïïö ki ŋïïce mo thööth, jø Juuth kär jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø.
english: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:

anywaa: Ni beeye kiper nee luumma caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea thur kare, na kööe, ni «?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa na ŋääth luumma køpwa? ?Na a jï ŋa na nyuth bat Wuuö Jwøk eni?»
english: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

anywaa: Ni beeye na kärge jïëy, kaawat mana cäŋ Aydheea caannø,
english: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,

anywaa: ni «Nyeŋge awëëk Jwøki cøørø, ni tïïc cwïnyge ni teek, kiper nee ba neenge ki nyeŋge, ni ba kwanyge tier gø ki cwïnyge, nee rege ba cäŋge luu baŋa nee ge kønya.»
english: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

anywaa: Luummögø acaan Aydheea kiper na joot ajiem Jecu, ni cääne kiper gø.
english: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.

anywaa: 'Ba këël dïbwöthe mo thööth ojïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gøøni, 'ba kiper mana lwäärge ki jø Paricith, marge kärge caanø, kiper nee ge ba riem wøk øt acooŋ lam.
english: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

anywaa: Kiper ge mëër ka pwøc jiy, ni kaala pwøc mar Jwøk.
english: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu dwøre atïŋ maal døc ni kööe, ni «Ŋat wø jïëy ki aani ni ŋääth a, ba jïëc aani keere, 'ba jïëya eni na jääŋ aani thuwø.
english: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø neen aani, neena eni na jääŋ aani.
english: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.

anywaa: Aana öö ni aana tar kiper piny, nee ŋato jïëy ki aani ni ŋääth aani nee ba dööŋe yi muudhö.
english: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.

anywaa: 'Ba noo dee ŋat mo wïny luup moa caana ni ba gwøk geni, eni ba ŋøla wøk. Kiper a kär ö kuna ŋøla luup mo piny, 'ba a ööa kuna piema piny.
english: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø kweer ki aani ni ba wïny luup moa caana, da ŋat mo ŋøla luumme piny. Ni beeye luubö mana kwøŋa caan noo ŋøl mare piny yi cäŋo cuŋ pinynyi yie.
english: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.

anywaa: Kiper aani, a ba caan luup mo käla wïïa, a keera. 'Ba Wuuö ki dëëre na jääŋ aani beeye na cïp luubö mano caana ki mano looba.
english: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

anywaa: Ni ŋääa ni ciik mare beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe. Kiper manøgønø, aani, gïï wø caana, wø caana keda mana køpi ya Wuue jïra.»
english: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cään kar ajwöm-cam Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, aŋäc Jecu ni kanyo aae pinyi en noo ci baŋ Wuuö kare acäännö. Ni eni mëër ki jiye na en piny, ni bëëdö ni mëër ki geni këël aŋuun kwøw mare.
english: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge ena kar cam, na anägö gïn mør ee nø kïth cwïny Juudac Ickarïët na näk o Cayman nee Jecu cïbe ceŋ nyïïmänne,
english: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;

anywaa: Jecu na ŋäc gø ni jammi bëët ocïp Wuue cere, ni eni ööi ka baŋ Jwøk, ni eni cäŋa døø baŋ Jwøk,
english: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;

anywaa: aö maal kar cam, ni cïp abïïge piny, ni lwöte ki puutha, ni dwøl gø dëëre.
english: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.

anywaa: Køøre pïï akøny ya athäänh ni täge ki man lwøk tiet bääge, ni pooc geni ki puunhnha näk ee dwøl dëëre.
english: After that he poureth water into a basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

anywaa: Ni ö baŋ Cayman Piter. Ni kö Piterri jïre, na «?Aŋø Kwäärö, tieta diï lwøø?»
english: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, «Man tïïa en kuyï ennø, 'ba noo näk køøre tiere ojootï.»
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïre, «Ïïni tieta ba diï lwøø na bäre.» Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, «Ni näk ï ba lwøa, jïrï bäŋ karï buuta.»
english: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

anywaa: Ni kö Caymanni Piter jïre, «Kwäärö, paa tieta keerge noo lwøgï, 'ba këël ceŋŋa ki wïïa thuwø.»
english: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, ni «Ŋat mo onø lwøk, ba many lwøk këët, 'ba beeye tiete keerge na dee lwøø, kiper dëëre bäre waany. Ni uuni, dëëtu waany, 'ba paa u bëët.»
english: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

anywaa: Kiper eni ŋato cïp eni ceŋ nyïïmänne ŋääe. Beeye na caan luummi, ni «Paa dëëtu bëët ni waany.»
english: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.

anywaa: 'Ba na lønye ki lwøk tietge, ni lwør abïïge ni døø kare, ena köö jï bääge, «?Gïna tïïa jïïu en tiere ŋäyu?
english: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?

anywaa: A wø cwøllu cwølø ni Dïpööy, ni cwøllu a ni Kwäärö, ni beeye kare, kiper beeye aani.
english: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

anywaa: Ni näk aani na näk Kwääyu, ni näga Dïpööy, tietu yaa lwøø, uuni thuwø ŋati man nø tiet watge dee lwøø.
english: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

anywaa: Kiper man beeye nyuudhi mana cïba jïïu, nee tïïyu thuwø kaawat mana tïïa gø jïïu.
english: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat tïïc ba dwøŋŋa eni ki kwääye, wala eni na jääŋŋi ba dwøŋŋa eni ki ŋata jääŋ gø.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.

anywaa: Ni näk mo gïïögø ŋäyu, uuno gwïëth kany wø tïïyu geni.
english: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

anywaa: A ba cäänö kaperu bëët. Aani moa jiera ŋääa. 'Ba mana no ogöörö thura kare, na en nø, ni ‹Eni na cam møga, aana cääbe ko opunye.›
english: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gïn jïïu kawaane, kany poode ni poot kär tägö, kiper kanyo täge nee u jïëyu ni beeye aani na Eni.
english: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wäro jïëc ŋato jääŋŋa, jïëya aani; ni ŋato wäro jïëc aani, jïëya eni na jääŋ aani.»
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba na løny Jecu ki caan luummögø, cwïnye apädhö, ni put dwøre caan, ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni dhaanhø aciel dïïu aano cïp ceŋ nyïïmän.»
english: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

anywaa: Ni ö bääge ni neetge nyeŋge, ni ŋata cääne kipere kucge.
english: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dï bääge mana mëër Jecu ki gøøni, ree ee nyaaŋ piny na akicge cään ki Jecu.
english: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cayman Piter amuuŋ bäät ŋatøgø ni kööe, «Caan ŋata cääne kiper gø jïwa.»
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.

anywaa: Køøre ŋata näk ree ee nyaaŋ piny na akicge cään ki Jecu aköö, ni «?Kwäärö, aŋa na wärï?»
english: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «Beeye ŋato cïba møgo cwenya en jïre.» 'Ba na nø cweny møø, amëëk Juudac o Cayman Ickarïët.
english: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

anywaa: 'Ba køør møgøgø, Ceethan aput døny cwïnye. Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Gïno tïïyï, laar tïïc nø.»
english: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø aciel kar cam mo oŋäc tier gïna caane jï ŋatøgø.
english: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk acädö ni Jecu caana gø jïre, ni «Ci ŋëëwï ki gïï wø manynyi kiper ajwöm cam,» wala caana gø nee ci kuna cïpe ki gïrpiny jï jøøa can, kiper mana näk opïr gwel ena cere, e na Juudac.
english: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.

anywaa: Køøre Juudac na nø lwør møgøgø, ena put aa wøk. 'Ba piny a wäär.
english: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø aa Juudac wøk, Jecu aköö, ni «Kawaane, ajiem Wär Dhaanhø aci kare, ni ö Jwøki ni jïte ka ajiem ki ree.
english: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Jwøk ojiemø ki ree, eno jiem Jwøki thuwø ka ajiem mana en jïre, ni put gø jiem.
english: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

anywaa: Nyïïobwöre, a poot en buutu ka kany mo thiinh. Aani, aano cayu, 'ba kanyo cøøa yie, u ba doo maara ö yie, kaawat mana caana gø jï jø Juuth. Ni beeye ni caana jïïu en.
english: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.

anywaa: 'Ba a wëëga uuni ciik mo nyään, ni mëërru ki røgu, keda mana mëëra ki uuni, kiper nou tïmu nou mëër ki røgu thuwø.
english: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.

anywaa: Beeye noo ŋäyi ya jø bëëti ni uuna bääga, ni näk mou mëër ki røgu.»
english: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

anywaa: 'Ba Cayman Piter aköö jïre, ni «?Kwäärö, a kaa ŋø noo ciï yie?» Ni løgi ya Jecu, ni «Kanyo cøøa yie en, ï ba doo ööa køøra. 'Ba ïïno läm køøra cään.»
english: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïre, ni «?Kwäärö, aŋø ni ba ööa køørï ennø? Jwïëya ocïba kiperï.»
english: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, na «?Aŋø, ïïni jwïëyï diï cïbö kipera? Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, ni gwienø ba doo köök, ni riï poot kärï mooŋø ki aani kwöre adäk naa kuyï.»
english: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Kär cwïnynyu wëëgu ränynyö. Jïëyu ni ŋääthu Jwøk, ni jïëyu ni ŋääthu aani thuwø.
english: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

anywaa: Kiper po Wära da uudi mo thööth. ?Onää bäŋ tiere daa caana jïïu naa cøøa kuna jiiŋŋa karu?
english: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

anywaa: 'Ba noo cøøa noo jiiŋŋa karu, aano cäŋ duuö, ni lwøra uuni ni käla uuni baŋa, ni kanyo bëëda yie, uuno bëëdö yie thuwø.
english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

anywaa: Ni jöör kanyo cøøa yie ŋäyu.»
english: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.

anywaa: 'Ba Tøma aköö jïre, ni «Kwäärö, kanyo ciï yie kucwa. ?Jöörögøøni oŋäcwa gø nidïï?»
english: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Beeye aani na jöö, ni näga adïëri, ni näga kwøw. Ni bäŋ ŋat mo ö baŋ Wuuö ni näk eni ba ööi ka raa.
english: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

anywaa: Onää a ŋäyu, Wära dou ŋääö thuwø. 'Ba køør man ennø, tïme ni ŋäyu, ni you nø neen.»
english: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

anywaa: 'Ba Pilip aköö jïre, «Kwäärö, nyooth Wuuö jïwa, nee cwïnywa pïge piny.»
english: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «?Aŋø, a kär bëëdö ki uuni ki kany mo bäär? ?A poot kuyï en, Pilip? Ŋat maa ee neenø, Wuuö ee nø neen. ?Aŋø ni kööï, ni ‹Nyuth wa Wuuö›?
english: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?

anywaa: ?Ï paa ojïëy naa ena ri Wuuö, ni ö Wuue ni en raa? Ni luup moa cara jïïu, ba caana ka wïïa keera. 'Ba Wuuö ni wø bëëdö raa, beeye wø tïïc tïïe moe.
english: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.

anywaa: Jïëyu ni ŋääthu aani, naa ena ri Wuuö ni ö Wuue ni en raa. Wala jïëyu ni ŋääthu aani kiper tïïe ki dëëtge.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

anywaa: «Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni ŋat wø jïëy ni ŋääth aani, tïïe moa tïïa otïïe thuwø, ni tïïe mo døøŋŋø geni ki moi otïïe, kiper a cøøa baŋ Wära.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.

anywaa: Gïn wäro pëënynyu ki nyeŋŋa, otïïa, kiper nee Wuuö jïte ka ajiem ki ri Wäädö.
english: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

anywaa: Noo dee gïn pëënynyu ki nyeŋŋa, otïïa.
english: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.

anywaa: «Ni näk mou mëër ki aani, luupa dou gwøø.
english: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö okwaa, ni mooc uuni ki Dïkunyi mør, nee bëëde ki uuni na bäre bäre,
english: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;

anywaa: na näk beeye Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø nyooth adïëri, na näk jø piny ba doo maara jïëy ki gøøni. Kiper eni ba neen jø pinynyi, ni kucge gøøni. 'Ba uuni, eni ŋäyu kiper eni bëëdö ka uuni, ni eno bëëdö cwïnynyu.
english: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.

anywaa: «U ba wiia ni uuna kïïe. A duua baŋu.
english: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

anywaa: Ki kany mo thiinh a ba neen jø pinynyi këët, 'ba aano neennu. 'Ba kiper na kwøa, uuno kwøw thuwø.
english: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca oŋäyu naa ena ri Wära, ni enu raa, ni ena røgu.
english: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø ŋäc luupa ni gwøk geni beeye ŋat wø mëër ki aani. 'Ba ŋat wø mëër ki aani, Wära omëëyi ki gø, ni ööa ni mëëya ki eni ni nyoodha raa jïre.»
english: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac mør, mo patha Ickarïët, aköö jïre, ni «?Kwäärö, aŋø noo nyoothï riï jïwa keerwa, ni patha jï jø piny?»
english: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Ni näk mo dhaanhø mëër ki aani, luumma gwøe gwøø, ni ö Wära ni mëëye ki gø, ni öwa baŋe ni bëëtwa ki eni na aciel.
english: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø ba mëër ki aani, luupa bäŋ wø gwøe. 'Ba luupa wïnynyu, paa 'moa keere, 'ba beege mo Wära na jääŋ aani.
english: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

anywaa: «Moøgø bëët acaana jïïu, kany pooda naa bëëdö ka uuni en.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

anywaa: 'Ba Dïkunyi na näk Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ŋato jääŋ Wuue ki nyeŋŋa, uuno pwönynye ki jammi bëët, ni par wïthu ki jammi bëët moa kwøŋa caan jïïu.
english: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

anywaa: Bëët-mëër wø wëëga uuni, ni bëët-mëër mara wø cïba cïbö jïïu. Ni man wø cïba jïïu en, ba caal mana doo cïp pinynyi jïïu. Kär cwïnynyu wëëgu ränynyö, ni ba lwäyu.
english: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

anywaa: Awïnynyu na kööa jïïu, na ‹A aay, ni duua baŋu.› Onää u mëër ki aani, yïthu doo mïnnö, kiper a cøøa baŋ Wuuö. Kiper Wuuö dwøŋŋa eni ki aani.
english: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, anø caana jïïu kany poode ni poot kär tägö en, kiper kanyo täge nou jïëyu ni ŋäädhu.
english: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.

anywaa: 'Ba a ba cäänö ki luup mo thööth ki uuni këët, kiper kwäärö mar piny man en öö. 'Ba eni jïre bäŋ teek bääta.
english: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.

anywaa: 'Ba a tïïya mana caan Wära jïra, kiper nee ŋäc jø pinynyi naa mëër ki Wuuö. Ööu, cøø aa.»
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö, ni «Aana jaath mana näk adïëri. Ni Wära beeye ŋat wø tïïc jenni.
english: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät jenni bëët moa näk 'moa, mo wø ba nywøl ki nyïëdi, wø käla wøk. Ni bäät jenni bëët mo wø nywøl ki nyïëdi, wø goora goorø nee nywølge ki nyïëdi mo thööth.
english: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.

anywaa: Uuna nø tïmö nou waany ki køør luumma caana jïïu.
english: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
