anywaa: Bëëdu dëëra, 'ba aano bëëdö dëëtu. Kiper ba løny jïïu keeru ki man kännu ki nyïëdi ni näk mou ba bëëdö dëëra, kaa mana ba lønye jï bat jaath ki man ŋweele ki nyïëdi keere, ni näk mo ba bëëdö ri jaath.
english: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

anywaa: Beeye aani na jaath, ni uuna bäät jaath. Ŋat wø bëëdö dëëra, ni bëëda ree beeye wø känni ki nyïëdi mo thööth. Kiper bäŋ gïn mo maaru tïïc ni näk maa tøør.
english: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

anywaa: Ni näk dhaanhø ba bëëdö dëëra, eni weta wøk keda bat jaath, ni tale. 'Ba teeŋ bäät jenni moøgø ocooŋ kanya ciel ni leeŋi maac ni waaŋ ge.
english: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.

anywaa: Ni näk mou bëëdö dëëra ni bëët luupa cwïnynyu, gïn wäro manynyu, pëënynyu. Otïïc jïïu.
english: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïn wø käl ajiem jï Wära, ni näk mou kännö ki nyïëdi mo thööth ni dëëtu you nyoodhø ni uuna bääga.
english: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

anywaa: Kaawat mana mëër Wuue ki aani, beeye na mëëra ki uuni. Bëëdu ni mëëya ena bäätu.
english: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk luupa you gwøø, uuno bëëdö ni mëëya ena bäätu, keda mana gwøa luup Wära ni bëët mëëye bääta.
english: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

anywaa: Moi bëët a caana jïïu, kiper nee met ec mara bëëde cwïnynyu, ni ö met eci maru ni kadhe.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

anywaa: «Man beeye dwøra, ni mëërru ki røgu keda mana mëëra ki uuni.
english: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo jïre da mëër mo kaala man ö dhaanhe ni cïp jwïëye kiper nyïïawääte.
english: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

anywaa: Uuna nyïïawääta ni näk mana caana jïïu tïïyu tïïö.
english: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.

anywaa: U ba cwøla ni uuna laaŋe këët. Kiper laŋŋø gïn wø tïïc kwääye kuue. 'Ba uuna cwøla ni uuna nyïïawääta, kiper jammi bëët moa wïnynya baŋ Wära anyoodha jïïu.
english: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

anywaa: Paa uuni na jier aani, 'ba beeye aani na jier uuni, ni kwanya uuni nou cou ni kännu ki nyïëdi, ni tïm nyïëdi mou ni bëëdö. Kiper manøgønø, nee gïn wäro pëënynyu Wuuö ki gø ki nyeŋŋa, nee cïbe jïïu.
english: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.

anywaa: Man beeye ni caana jïïu en, ni ‹Mëërru ki røgu.›
english: These things I command you, that ye love one another.

anywaa: «'Ba ni näk piny män ki uuni, wär ŋäyu ni ena kwøŋ männö ki aani kanya poode ni poot kär männö ki uuni.
english: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

anywaa: Onää uuna mo piny, piny doo mëër ki uuni kiper na nägu moe. 'Ba kiper mana nägu paa mo piny, ni jiera u wøk dï mo piny, beeye na män pinynyi ki uuni.
english: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

anywaa: Kär wïthu wïl ki luumma caana jïïu, ni ‹Laŋŋø ba dwøŋŋa eni ki kwääye.› Ni näk maa ege caannø, uuno caange thuwø. 'Ba ni näk luumma ege gwøø, luummu ogwøkge thuwø.
english: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø bëët otïïcge dëëtu kiper nyeŋŋa, kiper na kucge Ŋata jääŋ aani.
english: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

anywaa: Onää a kär öö ni cääna ki geni, doo bäŋ ajäla bäätge. 'Ba kawaane bäŋ jöö mo bøthge ki gø ka ajäla kiper raacge.
english: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø män ki aani, män ka Wära thuwø.
english: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.

anywaa: Onää a kär öö ni tïïa dïge ki tïïe mo ba doo løny ki man tïïyi ya ŋat mørri jaak, dëëtge doo bäŋ ajäla. 'Ba kawaane aana neenge ni mänge ki aani ki Wära bëët.
english: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

anywaa: Ni beeye kiper luumma näk ogöörö ri ciik Jwøk moge nee thur kare, na køp, ni ‹Gena männö ki aani ki män mo bäŋ tiere.›
english: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Dïkunyi mano jääŋŋa baŋu ki buut Wuuö, na näk beeye Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø cïp adïëri, noo ööi ki baŋ Wuuö, gïra okøbe.
english: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø, gïra okøpu, kiper uuna bëëdö ki aani ki kanya täga.
english: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.

anywaa: «Luup moï bëët acaana jïïu, nou ba døøu cään.
english: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.

anywaa: Uuno mänge ki ciin uut acook lam. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, da caa mo öö, mo jø wø 'näk uuni caarge caarø ni ge tïnynya Jwøk.
english: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø otïïcge kiper na kucge Wuuö ki aani bëët.
english: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moi bëët acaana jïïu, kiper kanyo täk gïnögø, nee wïthu parru, ni gïïögøøni yaa kwøŋ caan jïïu.
english: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.

anywaa: «'Ba dïkwøŋ luummögøøni kära kwøŋ caan jïïu, kiper na pooda naa ena buutu.
'Ba kawaane a døøa baŋ Ŋata jääŋ aani. 'Ba poot bäŋ dhaanhø dïïu mo opëëny aani en, ni ‹?Ï ciï kaa ŋø cøøn?›
english: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana caana gïï jïïu, beeye ni bëët cwïnynyu ni kïmmö døc en.
english: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a cäänna uuni ka adïëri, ni doo beerra eni jïïu ki man aa. Kiper ni näk maa ba aay, Dïkunyi ba ö baŋu. 'Ba ni näk maa aay, eni ojääŋŋa baŋu.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba noo ööe, gïïa bac jø pinynyi onyuth geni, ki bëënynyö, ki ŋøl luup.
english: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:

anywaa: Bääyö mar jø piny onyuth geni, kiper na ba jïëcge ni ŋääthge aani.
english: Of sin, because they believe not on me;

anywaa: 'Ba bëënynyö onyuth geni, kiper a cøøa baŋ Wuuö naa ba laaru joot.
english: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;

anywaa: Ni ŋøl luup onyuth geni, kiper kwääy pinyi oŋøl wøk.
english: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

anywaa: «'Ba jïra poot da luup mo thööth mo daa caanø jïïu. 'Ba ba maar lønyø jïïu ki man wïnynyu gø kawaane.
english: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Jwïëc Jwøki ni wø cïp adïëri, moa näk adïëri bëët onyoodhe jïïu. Kiper eni bäŋ gïn mo caane ki wïïe keere, 'ba man wäro wïnynye beeye noo caane. 'Ba japo tägi yi nyïm, ocaane jïïu.
english: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.

anywaa: 'Ba aano jieme, kiper gïno näk mara olwøre ni køp gø jïïu.
english: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba moa en jï Wuuö bëët beege 'moa. Beeye na caana gø, ni gïno näk mara olwøre ni køp gø jïïu.
english: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.

anywaa: «'Ba ki kany mo thiinh a ba neennu. 'Ba ki kany mo thiinh aano cäŋu neennø.»
english: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk dï bääge røkge apëënyge, ni «?Man agïnaŋø ni caane jïïø en, ni ‹Ki kany mo thiinh a ba neennu, 'ba ki kany mo thiinh aano cäŋu neennø›, ki mana caane ni kööe, ni ‹Kiper a cøøa baŋ Wuuö›?»
english: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «?Tier ‹kany mo thiinh› agïnaŋø na caan gø? Tier gïna caane kuuø.»
english: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäc Jecu ni ge caya man pëënyge eni, ni kööe jïge, ni «?U pëënynya røgu ki tier gïna caana jïïu, ni ‹Ki kany mo thiinh a ba neennu, 'ba ki kany mo thiinh aano cäŋu neennu›?
english: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?

anywaa: Adïëri møn a caana gø jïïu, ni uuno jwöŋi ni dhööŋŋu kööthu, 'ba jø piny yïthge omïnni. Uuni cwïnynyu opädhi, 'ba pänh cwïny maru oløk na met ec.
english: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

anywaa: Dhaagø kany wø täk mäc lwaarri dëëre, cwïnye wø pädhö, kiper na ö kare. 'Ba kany wø ö nyilaalli wøk, eni wïïe ba caare ki rääm këët, kiper na tïm yie ni met ki nyilaal mana nywøle.
english: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, beeye kar pänh cwïny maru, 'ba uuno cäŋa neennø, ni ö cwïnynyu ni mïnge, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo raany met ec maru këët.
english: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca bäŋ gïn mo pëënynyu a ki gø. Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïïu, ni gïn wäro pëënynyu Wuuö ki gø ki nyeŋŋa, ocïbe jïïu.
english: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane poot bäŋ gïn mo you pëënynyö ki nyeŋŋa. Pëëu, ocïp jïïu, nee met ec maru kathe.
english: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

anywaa: «Luup moi acaana jïïu ni tietge ba nëëni døøc, 'ba da kany mo öö maa ba cäänö jïïu ki luup mo tietge ba nëëni këët, 'ba mo Wuuö oputa caan jïïu ni wïnyö jaak.
english: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca uuno pëëö ki nyeŋŋa. 'Ba a ba caan gø jïïu, ni Wuuö okwaa kiperu.
english: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö ki dëëre mëër ki uuni, kiper na mëërru ki aani ni jïëyu naa käla baŋ Wuuö.
english: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.

anywaa: A käla baŋ Wuuö møn, ni ööa piny en. 'Ba a cäŋa aay piny ni døøa baŋ Wuuö.»
english: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.

anywaa: Ni kö bääge, «Adïëri møn, acaanï ni tiere wïnyö kawaane, ni paa luup mo tietge ba nëëni këët.
english: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane ï ŋäcwa ni jammi bëët ŋäyï, ni doo bäŋ dhaanhø mo pëëny ïïni këët. Ni beeye na jïëcwa niï käla baŋ Jwøk.»
english: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Jecu jïge, na «?Aŋø, uuna jïëy ennø?
english: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

anywaa: Da kany mo öö, ni beeye ennø møn, kanyo keethu noo ö ŋati man nø noo aa paare, ni weyu aani keera. 'Ba a ba dööŋ a keera, kiper Wuuö ena buuta.
english: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

anywaa: Man en a caana jïïu, nee bëët-mëër nee jootu baŋa. Uuni, gïï mo leth ojwørru yi pinyi en. 'Ba magu cwïnynyu, kiper piny yaa nø böötö.»
english: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na løny Jecu ki caan luupögøøni, ena lwïthö maal ni läme, ni kööe, na «Awuuö, kanya wäŋŋi aöö. Jiem Wäädï, niï jiem Wäädö,
english: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:

anywaa: kaa mana wëëgï gø teek bäät jiy bëët, kiper nee cïpe ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe jï moa cïpï jïre bëët.
english: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.

anywaa: Ni man en beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, niï ŋäcge, ï na näk Jwøk mana näk adïëri keere, ki Jecu Krictø na jääŋŋï.
english: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.

anywaa: Ïïna jiema piny ni thööra tïïc mana cïpï jïra nee tïïa.
english: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, Wuuö, jiem aani buutï ka ajiem mana kwøŋï aani jiem ki gø na pooda buutï, ni piny poot kär cwääö.
english: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.

anywaa: «Aani nyeŋŋï anyoodha jï jøøa cïpï jïra ri jø piny. Gena moï, ni cïpï ge jïra, ni luummï ege gwøø.
english: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.

anywaa: Kawaane ŋäcge ni jammi bëët moa cïpï jïra käla baŋï.
english: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.

anywaa: Kiper luup moa cïpï jïra, acaana jïge, ni jïëcge ge, ni ŋäcge na adïëri naa käla baŋï. Ni jïëcge naa jääŋŋa ïïni.
english: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni kiperge. Naa ba kwääö kaper jø piny, 'ba a kwääö kaper jøøa cïpï jïra, kiper gena moï,
english: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.

anywaa: ni 'moa bëët beege moï, ni moï bëët beege 'moa, ni aano jiemø rege.
english: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a ba en piny këët, 'ba bee geni ni en piny, ni aani, a ööa baŋï. Awuuö, ï na en kur keerï, gwøk geni ki køør nyeŋŋï na teek na näk iï cïbö jïra, nee tïmge na aciel, kaawat marø na nägø aciel.
english: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.

anywaa: Kanya pooda buutge, gena gwøa ki nyeŋŋï na näk iï cïbö jïra. Ni koora geni, ni bäŋe ya aciel dïge mo orwäänyö, 'ba beeye o ränynyö keere na rwäänyö, kiper nee moa en yi wëël Jwøk nee thur karge.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a ööa baŋï, naa caana gïï ii kany pooda naa ena piny, nee met ec mara thur kare jïge.
english: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.

anywaa: Luummï acïba jïge, ni män pinynyi ki geni kiper na ba enge ri mo piny, kaawat mara na ba ena ri mo piny.
english: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

anywaa: A ba kwääö kaper nee ge käla wøk yi piny, 'ba a kwääö kaper nee ge gwøgï ki ŋata raac.
english: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.

anywaa: Ge ba en ri mo piny, kaawat mara na ba ena ri mo piny.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

anywaa: Cïp geni kur keerge kiperï ki køør adïëri. 'Ba luummï beeye na adïëri.
english: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.

anywaa: Gena jääŋŋa dï piny kaawat mana jääŋŋï aani dï piny.
english: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.

anywaa: Ni raa yaa cïp kur keera kiperge, nee rege cïpge kur keerge thuwø ni ge ŋäya adïëri.
english: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.

anywaa: «'Ba a ba kwääö kaper jøøi keerge, 'ba a kwääö thuwø kaper jiy moo jïëy ni ŋääthge aani ki køør luumge,
english: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;

anywaa: kiper nee tïmge na aciel bëët, kaawat ïïni na Wuuö ni en raa en, ni ena riï, nee tïmge thuwø ni ge ena røgø, kiper nee jø piny jïëcge naa jääŋŋa ïïni.
english: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.

anywaa: 'Ba ajiem mana cïpï jïra acïba jïge, nee ge tïmge na aciel kaawat marø na nägø aciel,
english: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:

anywaa: ni ena rege, ni enï raa, nee dwätö marge thur kare ni gena aciel, kiper nee ŋäc jø pinynyi naa jääŋŋa ïïni, niï mëër ki geni kaawat mana mëërï ki aani.
english: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.

anywaa: Awuuö, a manynya geni thuwø, ge na cïpï jïra, nee bëëtge ki aani na aciel kanyo ena yie, na ajiem mana cïpï jïra nee neenge, kaawat mana mëërï ki aani, ki mana täge ni piny poot kär caa.
english: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.

anywaa: Awuuö, ï na marï beer, këël na bëëde niï kuc pinynyi, aani ï ŋääa. Ni ŋäyi ya jøøi naa jääŋŋa ïïni.
english: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.

anywaa: Nyeŋŋï anyoodha jïge, 'ba cäŋa ka nyoothø, kiper nee mëër mana mëërï ki aani ki gø, nee tïme ni ena cwïnyge, ni ena rege.»
english: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya løny Jecu ki caan luupögøøni ena aay ki bääge, ni ŋøl waŋ Kidaran, ni cige jï løøa näk da pwöth jenni ki bääge.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac, ŋata cïp Jecu ceŋ nyïïmän, kaace ŋääe thuwø, kiper Jecu wø cuuŋö yie ki bääge cooth.
english: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nø, Juudac akännö ki lwaa jø tøŋ mo jø Röm, ki dïkuye møøk mo Øt Jwøk mo käla baŋ kwääc laam ki jø Paricith, ni cige ni ge käädö ki lambae ka ameethi ki jap leny.
english: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu kiper na ŋäc japo pïï dëëre, ena ci nyïm ni kööe jï jøøgø, na «?Aŋa ni cayu?»
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø jïre, ni «Wa caya Jecu nyï Nadhareth.» Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Beeye aani en.» 'Ba Juudac na cïp gø ceŋge cuŋŋa dïge.
english: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.

anywaa: 'Ba na kööe jïge, ni «Beeye aani en,» gena nyiik ŋäthge ni päthge.
english: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ ge pëënynyö, na «?Aŋa ni cayu?» Ni köge, ni «Wa caya Jecu nyï Nadhareth.»
english: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, na «A caana jïïu, ni beeye aani en. Ni näk u caya aani, weyu jøøi nee aacge.»
english: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

anywaa: Manøgø tägi kaper nee luumma kwøŋ Jecu caan thur kare, na kööe, ni «Jøøa cïpï jïra, bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo yaa rwäänyö rege.»
english: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cayman Piter na näk jïre da opëëllö, opëëllö awöth wøk ki yi køp, ni gøøc laŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni cëë ïth cwïï gø wøk. 'Ba nyeŋ laŋŋøgøøni cwøl ni Malka.
english: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö ki Piter, ni «Dwøk opëëllö marï yi købe. ?Aŋø, athöönhnha cïp Wära jïra ba daa maadhø?»
english: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø tøŋ mo jø Röm ki kwäärö marge ki dïkuye mo jø Juuth, Jecu amakge ni twöcge gø.
english: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,

anywaa: Ni kwøŋge gø kïth baŋ Anna, kiper ena wää cï Keepa na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ cwiinøca.
english: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.

anywaa: Ni beeye Keepa na cïpö ki luubö jï jø Juuth ni doo beer ki man thøw dhaanhe acielli kiper jiy.
english: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.

anywaa: 'Ba Cayman Piter aläp køør Jecu ki bääŋ mør. 'Ba bääŋ manøgø ŋäc Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ, ni beeye na døny yi kal mar Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ki Jecu ciel,
english: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.

anywaa: ni dööŋ Piterri ni cuŋŋö wøk dhi kal. 'Ba bääŋ mana ŋäc Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ aö wøk ni caan gø jï nyaan wø koor dhi kal, ni käl Piter yi kal.
english: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.

anywaa: 'Ba nyaana koor dhi kal aköö jï Piter, na «?Aŋø, ï paa bääŋ mar ŋatøgø thuwø?» Ni kööe, ni «Jïra bäär.»
english: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jø tïïc ki dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk geno äbö ki maac, kiper piny da köö, ni ge cuŋŋö ni ge juŋö ki maac. 'Ba Piter thuwø ena dïge ni cuŋŋö ni juŋö ki maac.
english: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ Jecu apëënynye kiper bääge ki pwöc mare.
english: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «A wø cäänö ni wïnyö jaak jï jø piny, naa wø pöö cooth yïth uut acook lam ki yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, kany wø cuŋ jø Juuthi yie bëët, ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa caanø ni yaa mooŋø.
english: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.

anywaa: ?Aŋø ni pëënynyï aani en? Pëëny jøøa wïny mara ki gïïa caana jïge. Gïïa caana jïge ŋäcge.»
english: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.

anywaa: 'Ba na caan gïnögø dïkuri aciel mo cuŋŋö buute, Jecu adhööŋe, ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, beeye mana diï løø jï Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ enøgø?»
english: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «?Ni näk luumma caana raac, aŋø ni ba caanï mara na raac na caana? ?'Ba ni näk maa caana gïn mo beer, aŋø ni dhööŋï aani en?»
english: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

anywaa: Kanyøgø ni eni poot no otwöö, ena wëëk Anna kïth baŋ Keepa na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ.
english: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ni Cayman Piter poot cuŋŋö ni juŋö ki maac, ena pëënynyi, na «?Aŋø, ï paa bääŋ ŋatøgø thuwø?» Ni mooŋ ree ni kööe, ni «Jïra bäär.»
english: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat tïïc aciel mar Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ma tuuŋ ki ŋata ïthe ceec Piterri, apëëö, na «?Aŋø, ï kära joodø yi pwöth jenni ki eni?»
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?

anywaa: 'Ba Piter ree acäŋ mooŋŋø. Ni put gwienø köö.
english: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø Juuth Jecu akälge wøk ki yi øt Keepa ni kïthge gø øt bura mar kwäärö ma Paylat, ni piny poot cøl. 'Ba geni ki dëëtge ge kär døny yi ødøgø, kiper nee ba tïmge ni ge ba waany, kiper nee cam Ajwöma Mar Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie camge.
english: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat aö wøk baŋge ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø na baac nyeni?»
english: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, «Onää nyenøgø paa ŋat raay, ba dewa käl baŋï.»
english: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat aköö jïge, «Källu ki dëëtu ni ŋølu luumme piny ki køør ciik pou.» 'Ba jø Juuth aköö jïre, ni «Bäŋ teek jïwa ki man 'näkwa dhaanhø.»
english: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:

anywaa: Manøgø tägi kaper nee luubö mana kwøŋ Jecu caan thur kare, ni nyootha thøø mano thøøe ki gøøni.
english: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat acäŋ døny yi øt bura ni cwøl Jecu ni pëëny gø, ni «?Bee ïïni na nyeny jø Juuth?»
english: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «?Luummögøøni caanï ka wïïï keerï, wala caana jø møøki jïrï?»
english: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Paylati, «?Aŋø, aana nyï Juuth? Bee jø pou ki dëëtge, ki kwääc laam na käl ïïni baŋa. ?Agïnaŋø na tïïyï?»
english: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu, «Buya ba en pinyi. Onää buya ena pinyi, jiya doo këëdö, kiper naa ba cïp ceŋ jø Juuth. 'Ba buya ba en pinyi.»
english: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

anywaa: Ni kö Paylati jïre, «?Aŋø, ïïna nyeya nø?» Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, na «Acaanï na kare ni aana nyeya. Ni beeye na nywöl a kipere, ni beeye gïna ööa piny kipere, naa køpa gïr adïëri. 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø en ra adïëri, dwøra wø leŋge leŋø.»
english: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat aköö jïre, na «?Adïëri agïnaŋø?»
english: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat na nø caan gïïögø, acäŋ døø wøk baŋ jø Juuth ni caan gø jïge, ni kööe, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo obøth mo yaa joodø baŋe.
'Ba jïïu da kööŋŋö mo dhaanhø aciel wø päda pädö jïïu, kany wø näk ra ajwöm-cam mar Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie. ?Yïthu ba met nø, ki man päda nyeny jø Juuth jïïu?»
english: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?

anywaa: 'Ba gena cäŋ rëëdö døc, ni köge, ni «Patha ŋatøgøøni, 'ba beeye Baraba.» 'Ba Baraba beeye nyen ma ŋat ageem.
english: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat Jecu alwøre ni wëëk gø pwöt.
english: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.

anywaa: Ni ö jø tøŋŋi ni tïïcge koodhi na aduda ni kïthge gø wïïe, ni runyge dëër gø ka abïï ma dïmuur.
english: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

anywaa: Ni öge baŋe ni köge, ni «Ïïna määth, nyeny jø Juuth.» Ni dhööŋge gø ki ceŋge.
english: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat acäŋ ö wøk ni kööe jï jø Juuth, «Neennu, ena käla wøk baŋu en, kiper nee ŋäyu ni bäŋ gïn mo obøth mo yaa joodø baŋe.»
english: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.

anywaa: Køøre Jecu aö wøk na adun koodhi ena wïïe, ni dëëre orunynyö ka abïï ma dïmuur. Ni kö Paylati jïge, «Neennu, ŋatøca en.»
english: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!

anywaa: 'Ba na neeni ya kwääc laammi ki dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk, gena rëëdö døc, ni köge, ni «Gurï! Gurï bäät jaadha no odëëdö!» 'Ba Paylat aköö jïge, ni «Lwørru ki dëëtu ni guru gøøni bäät jaadha no odëëdö, kiper aani bäŋ gïn mo obøth mo yaa joodø baŋe.»
english: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk jø Juuthi jïre, ni «Jïwa da luubö ri ciik Jwøk, 'ba ki køør luummögøøni, eni doo nääö kiper na døøc ree O Jwøk.»
english: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat na wïny luummögøøni, lwär mare akadhø.
english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;

anywaa: Ni cäŋ døø øt bura ni kööe jï Jecu, na «?A kaa na kälï yie?» 'Ba Jecu bäŋ gïn mo ee løø.
english: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Paylat aköö jïre, na «?Aŋø, ï ba cäänö ki aani? ?Kuyï ni jïra da teek ki man päda ïïni, ki teek man gura ïïni bäät jaadha no odëëdö?»
english: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?

anywaa: Ni løgi ya Jecu jïre, ni «Jïrï doo bäŋ teek bääta, onää kär wëëk ïïni ki maal. Kiper manøgønø, ŋata cïp aani jïrï, dwøŋŋa ajälle ki marï.»
english: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Paylat amäänyö ki jöö man pät Jecu ki gø. 'Ba jø Juuth arëëdö døc, ni köge, ni «Noo pätï ŋatøgøøni, ï paa nyawat Cidharri këët. Kiper jiy bëët mo wø thïïŋ rege na nyeye, ge thïïŋa rege bäät Cidhar.»
english: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat na wïny gïïögøøni, Jecu akäl wøk, ni pï piny bäät køøm løøk bäät thudhi, na cwøl ni Gabatha ki dhi Ibaru.
english: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø beeye dïcäŋ jiiŋ røk kiper ajwöm-cam mar cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie. 'Ba beeye caae abïciel. Ni kö Paylati jï jø Juuth, ni «Nyenynyu en.»
english: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!

anywaa: 'Ba gena rëëdö døc, ni köge, «Aayï ki gø, aayï ki gø, ni gurï gø bäät jaadha no odëëdö!» 'Ba Paylat aköö jïge, «?Aŋø, nyenynyu daa gurö bäät jaadha no odëëdö?» Ni løgi ya kwääc laammi, ni «Waani jïwa bäŋ nyeya mør, 'ba beeye Cidhar keere na nyeya marwa.»
english: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena cïbe jïge, nee gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.

anywaa: Ni ö dïkuye ni kälge Jecu, ni cøøe, ni käära jaadhe na no odëëdö, ni cøøa kany mo cwøl ni Kar Cuu Wïc, na cwøl ni Gølgøtha ki dhi Ibaru.
english: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:

anywaa: Kanyøce ena gurge bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni 'näkge gø ki jiy ariiø møøk, na aciel ena bäät caam, ni maya ena bäät cwïïc. Ni Jecu ena yïthakicge.
english: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.

anywaa: 'Ba Paylat agöödö ki luubö, ni kïth gø wï jaadha no odëëdö. Ni luumma gööre beeye en, «Ŋati en beeye Jecu nyï Nadhareth na näk nyeny jø Juuth.»
english: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuthi mo thööth ni kwaange luummögø, kiper kanya 'näk Jecu yie bäät jaadha no odëëdö kare cään ki pääny. Ni luummögø göör ka dhi Ibaru, ki dhi Latin, ki dhi Gïrïïk.
english: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni kwääc laam mo jø Juuth aköö jï Paylat, ni «Kär luummögø göörï, ni ‹Nyeny jø Juuth›, 'ba göörï, ni ‹Nyeni en aköö, ni Beeye aani na nyeny jø Juuth.› »
english: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba aløk Paylati, ni «Mana gööra, anø gööra.»
english: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na ö jø tøŋŋi na nø gurge Jecu bäät jaadha no odëëdö, abïïge alwørge ni pääŋge ge na thäŋi aŋween, ni røm dïkuye moøgø karge ŋweeni. Ni jalabiinynye patha okwøø, 'ba ocwääö na aciel bäre, ni tägi ka maal këël mana këët piny.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena cäänö yïthakicge keerge, ni köge, «Kär jeeyø; 'ba beerra man kwäägø ki baw nee ŋato ci jïre nee joodø.» Manøgø tägi kaper nee luumma en yi wëël Jwøk thur kare, na køp, na «Abïïga apääŋge yïthakicge, ni tïïge ki nyuuthe kiper abïïna maya.»
english: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.

anywaa: Køøre gïnögø atïïc jø tøŋŋi. 'Ba jøøa cuŋŋö buut jaadha no odëëdö mar Jecu beeye menni ki cöök menni, ki Meeri cï Kilöpa, ki Meeri Magdalin.
english: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na neen menni, ki bääŋ mana mëëre ki gøøni ni ge cuŋŋa kany mo cään, ena köö ki menni, «Ayaŋ, neen wäädï.»
english: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!

anywaa: Køøre ena köö jï bääŋ manøgø, ni «Neen meru.» Ni puti ya bääŋögø lwør yi caannøgø ni kïth gø paare.
english: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.

anywaa: Køør manøgø na ŋäyi ya Jecu ni jammi bëët anø thur karge, ena köö, ni «Raa da riew.» Manøgø acaane nee luumma en yi Wëël Jwøk thur kare.
english: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.

anywaa: 'Ba kaace da awal mo ocïp piny mo yie da køøŋ nyïïomøki mo wac. Kanyøgø gena lwötö ki lïïpa ni cøtge gø yi køøŋø manøgø, ni cømge gø wï jaath, ni rwaakge gø dhee.
english: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a sponge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Jecu na bel køøŋ nyïïomøki manøgø na wac enø, ena köö, «Aløny nø.» Ni put wïïe kuul piny ni cïp jwïëye.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïm cäŋögø na cäŋ jiiŋ røk, jø Juuth Paylat apëënyge nee tiet jøøgø tøyi, nee dëëtge käl wøk, kiper nee ge ba bëëtge bäät jera no odëëdö ki cäŋ jwömö, kiper mana näk cäŋ jwömöce beeye cäŋ mo dwøŋ.
english: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jø tøŋ aöö ni tøcge tiet ŋata cwöpge ki gø, ki tiet dhaanhø maya mana näk ogurö buut Jecu bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.

anywaa: 'Ba na öge baŋ Jecu na jootge gø ni eno nø thøø, tiet gø kärge tøyø.
english: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dëët jø tøŋ tier-buut Jecu acwøbe ki tøŋ, ni put remø ki pïï ö wøk.
english: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata neen gøøni ki waŋe beeye na caan mare kiper gø, ni mana caane beeye adïëri, ni ŋääe ni eni caana adïëri, kiper nee uuni thuwø, nou jïëyu ni ŋäädhu.
english: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.

anywaa: Gïïögøøni atägö kaper nee luumma en yi Wëël Jwøk thur kare, na køp, ni «Eni bäŋ cöö dëëre mo otoor.»
english: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.

anywaa: 'Ba ocäŋ caannø yi wëëlö maya, ni «Dëër ŋata cwøpge, oneenge.»
english: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør manøgø, ŋat mo cwøl ni Jocep nyï Arimathia, ma bääŋ Jecu mo ree käre nyoodhø kiper mana lwääre ki jø Juuth, Paylat apëënynye nee dëër Jecu käle. Ni ö Paylati ni jïëe ki mare. Ni ööe ni lwør dëër Jecu.
english: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba Niködima na kwøŋ ö baŋ Jecu ki wäär, aöö ni käla jer wø ŋwääi ni met mo orubö mo jïtö ki kïïle ma pïëradäk.
english: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

anywaa: Ni öge ni lwørge dëër Jecu ni bøønyge gø ka abïïk koony, ni pørge bäät gø ki jerøgø ni wø ŋwääi ni met, ki køør kööŋŋö mar koony mar jø Juuth.
english: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nääi yie bäät jaadha no odëëdö, da pwöth jenni. 'Ba yi pwöthögø yie da bwöc kïdi mo orøø mo nyään, mo poot bäŋ dhaanhø mo okoony yie.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïm cäŋögø na cäŋ jiiŋ røk mar jø Juuth, ni bwöyögøøni kare cään, dëër Jecu akïthge yie.
english: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na täk tïïc ka amöölla cøøn ni piny poot cøl, Meeri Magdalin amøøl bäät bwörö ni joot kïdi no odaa dhi bwörö.
english: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.

anywaa: Køøre ena reeŋø ni ci baŋ Cayman Piter ki bääŋ maya, ŋata mëër Jecu ki gø, ni kööe jïge, «Geni dëër Kwäärö ege käl wøk yi bwörö, 'ba kanya kïthge gø yie kucwa.»
english: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter aö wøk ki bääŋ manøgø ni cige bäät bwörö,
english: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.

anywaa: ni ge rïïŋö bëët. 'Ba bääŋögøøni Piter ajööme ni kwøŋ pïï bäät bwörö.
english: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba na gääŋe ni neeta yi bwörö, abïï koony ajoode no odööŋ kaace. 'Ba eni kär døny yi bwörö.
english: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na pïïc Cayman Piterri na läm køøre, ena døny yi bwörö ni joot abïï koony no odööŋ kaace,
english: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,

anywaa: ki puunhnha näk obøøny wïïe no obanø kur keere, ni ba en røk abïïk koony møga.
english: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

anywaa: Kanyøgø bääŋa kwøŋ pïï bäät bwörö adøny yie thuwø, ni joot gïnögø, ni put jïëy.
english: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.

anywaa: Kiper kar kaace luumma en yi Wëël Jwøk tiere poot kärge kwanyø, ni eni ööa maal ki yi thøø.
english: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.

anywaa: Køøre bäägögø adøø mïëcge.
english: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.

anywaa: 'Ba Meeri adööŋ ni cuŋŋö lak bwörö ni jwöŋö. 'Ba kanya jwöŋe ena gääŋ ni neena yi bwörö.
english: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,

anywaa: Ni joot nyïïatwiet maal ariiø mo oruyö ka abïïe mo tar, ni geno pï piny jï kuna pïël dëër Jecu yie, na aciel opï kur wïïe, ni en maya kur tiete.
english: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, ni «?Nyijøøe, agïnaŋø ni jwøgï?» Ni løgi ya dhaaŋŋøgø jïge, na «A jwöŋi kaper dëër Kwääya na kälge, ni kanya kïthge gø yie kuua.»
english: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.

anywaa: 'Ba na caan gïnögø, eni ree aløøe ni joot Jecu ni cuŋŋö. 'Ba kuue ni beeye Jecu.
english: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «?Nyijøøe, agïnaŋø ni jwøgï? ?Aŋa ni cayï?» 'Ba kaa mana näk ee gø caarø ni beeye wää pwöthögøøni, ena köö jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, nee käla ïïni, caan kanya kïthï gø yie jïra, nee käla.»
english: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïgø, ni «Meeri.» Ni ö dhaaŋŋøgøøni ni put ree løk, ni kööe jïre ki dhi Ibaru, «Rabönay,» na näk tiere beeye Dïpööy.
english: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu aköö jïre, «A kär gäämï, kiper a poot kär ci baŋ Wuuö. 'Ba ci baŋ nyïïmera ni caanï gø jïge, na ‹A cøøa baŋ Wära ni näk Wääu, ni beeye Jwøa ni näk Jwøu.› »
english: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.

anywaa: Ni aac Meeri Magdalin ni caan gø jï bääŋi, ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö ajooda.» Ni køp gïïa caane jïre jïge.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋögø na tïm pinynyi na wïthïënhö ki täk tïïc, ni dhøk odhuule mo øda en bääŋi yie ocïëgö kiper mana lwäärge ki jø Juuth, Jecu aöö ni cuŋŋe dïge, ni kööe jïge, ni «Bëët-mëër bëëde bäätu.»
english: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan gïnögø, ceŋŋe anyoodhe jïge ki tier-buute. Kanyøgø bääŋi yïthge amïnnö na neenge Kwäärö.
english: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu acäŋ köö jïge, ni «Bëët-mëër bëëde bäätu. Kaa mana ö Wuue na jääŋ aani, u jääŋŋa jääŋŋö thuwø.»
english: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.

anywaa: 'Ba na lønye ki caan gïnögø, ena jwïëy bäätge ki jamø, ni kööe jïge, ni «Jwïëc Jwøk	 na en kur keere jïëyu nee ci dëëtu.
english: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:

anywaa: Ni näk raac jø møøk weyu wiiø, raacge onø wec. 'Ba ni näk raac jø møøk you wii bäätge, raacge onø wii bäätge.»
english: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

anywaa: 'Ba Tøma na näk dhaanhø aciel dï bääŋi na näk apaar kurriiø, na cwøl na Acwiek, tøørø dïge kanya ö Jecu.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan bääŋi møga jïre, ni «Waani Kwäärö ajootwa.» 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Ni näk ceŋŋe kwöra gur ki mucumääre kära joodø, ni kïtha lweeta kwör mucumääre, ni cøta cera tier-buute, aani, a ba jïëy.»
english: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne abära, bääge acäŋ dwät yi øtø, ni Tøma ena dïge, no odhuuth øtø ocïëgö. 'Ba Jecu aöö ni cuŋŋe dïge, ni kööe, ni «Bëëtmëër bëëde bäätu.»
english: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena köö jï Tøma, «Kïth lweetï kany ni neenï ceŋŋa, ni kälï cerï ni kïthï gø tier-buuta. Kärï bëëdö ni bäŋ ŋäädhe cwïnyï, 'ba jïëyï ni ŋäädhï.»
english: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.

anywaa: Ni puti ya Tøma løk jïre, «Wui, bee ï na Kwääya, ni bee ï na Jwøa.»
english: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, na «?Aŋø, ïïna jïëy kiper mana neenï aani? Gwïëth en jï jøøa jïëy ni ŋääthge, këël na kärge aani neenø.»
english: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu atïïö ki ŋïïce møøk mo thööth buut bääge, mo kär göörö yi wëëlö man en.
english: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:

anywaa: 'Ba moi göör kaper nou jïëyu ni Jecu beeye na Krictø ni näk O Jwøk, kiper nee u jïëyu ki eni ni ŋääthu gø, nou jïtu ki kwøw ki nyeŋŋe.
english: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø Jecu ree acäŋ nyoothø jï bääge bäät Puul Taybiria. Ni ree nyoodhe na ennønø jïge.
english: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.

anywaa: Cayman Piter, ki Tøma na cwøl na Acwiek, ki Nathaniel nyï Keena paana en yi Galili, ki wäät Dhebedi, ki bääge ariiø møøk, geno dwät kanya ciel bëët.
english: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba Cayman Piter aköö jïge, na «A cøøa baŋ bïth.» Ni köge jïre, ni «Wa cøø ki ïïni na aciel.» Ni cige wøk ni cige yi jääy. 'Ba dïwäänögø, bäŋ gïn mo ege maa.
english: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla ni cäŋ tuulö, Jecu acuŋŋö bäät ageela. 'Ba kuc bääge ni beeye Jecu.
english: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, no «?Obwöre, jïïu da rec?» Ni løkge gø jïre, ni «Bäŋgø.»
english: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, «Leeŋu ajääp kur jääy manø ni bäät cwïïc enø. Uuno jïti.» Køøre ajääp aleeŋge, ni putge mägö, ni dhäl geni ki man kälge gø wøk, kiper rec na thööth yie.
english: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.

anywaa: 'Ba bääŋ mana mëër Jecu ki gøøni aköö jï Piter, ni «Nyie, manøgø beeye Kwäärö.» 'Ba na wïnynyi ya Cayman Piterri ni beeye Kwäärö, eni abïïge akïth dëëre, kiper na bëëde na abïïge ee käl wøk kiper bïth, ni put päär yi naam.
english: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

anywaa: 'Ba bääge møga gena öö ki jääy ni ge pieya ajääp na päŋ ki rec, kiper na ba bäär karge ka ageela. 'Ba ge ena yi naam mëëth.
english: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge wøk bäät ageela, cuk mo oäbö ajootge no otwäät, ni yie da rec ki møø.
english: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïge, «Kännu ki rec dëët moa magu yøø.»
english: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.

anywaa: Køøre Cayman Piter aci yi jääy ni tuut ajääp bäät ageela, ni päŋ ki rec mo døøŋŋø ma dïpa aciel ki pïërabïïc kurdäk. 'Ba këël na thööth reci døc, bäŋ kany mo ojeec ra ajääp.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aköö jïge, ni «Ööu, ni cämu nø.» 'Ba bäŋ bääŋ aciel mo cwïnye ee maa ki man pëëny gø, ni «?Ïïna ŋa?» 'Ba aŋäcge ni beeye Kwäärö.
english: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Jecu aöö ni lwør møø ki rec ni cïp gø jïge.
english: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.

anywaa: Manøgø beeye dää nyuudhi mana ö Jecu na nyooth ree jï bääge ki køør mana tïŋi maal ki yi thøø.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.

anywaa: 'Ba na lønyge ki cam, Jecu aköö jï Cayman Piter, ni «?Cayman o Jøøn, ï mëër ki aani ni kaala moi?» Ni kööe jïgø, «Ŋäyï, Kwäärö, naa mëër ki ïïni.» Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Piith nyïï dïëga.»
english: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö ri rietge, ni «?Cayman o Jøøn, ï mëër ki aani?» Ni kööe jïgø, «Ŋäyï, Kwäärö, naa mëër ki ïïni.» Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Gwøk dïëga.»
english: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö ri dääge, «?Cayman o Jøøn, ï mëër ki aani?» Kanyøgø Piter cwïnye apädhö kiper na pëënynyi ya Jecu kwöre adäk, ni «?Ï mëër ki aani?» ni kööe jïgø, ni «Kwäärö, kawaane jammi bëët ŋäyï. Ni ŋäyï ki man näk maa mëër ki ïïni.» Ni kö Jecu jïre, «Piith dïëga.
english: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, a caana gø jïrï, ni kanya poodï ni ïïna wøp, ï wø ruyö ka abïï, ni ciï kany wø manynyï. 'Ba kanyo jalï, ceŋŋï orwaagï, ni ö dhaanhø mør ni kïth abïïnï dëërï, ni kïth ïïni kany mo kärï parø ki man ciï yie.»
english: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.

anywaa: Luummögø acaane ni nyootha teeŋ thøø mano thøw Piterri ki gø, ni jiema Jwøk. 'Ba køør luummögø ena köö jïgø, ni «Ööï ni cäädhï køøra.»
english: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter ree aløøe ni joot bääŋ mana mëër Jecu ki gøøni ni lämma køørge, ŋata nyaaŋ ree piny buut Jecu kar cam, na köö, ni «?Kwäärö, aŋa noo cïp ïïni ceŋ nyïïmän?»
english: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?

anywaa: Ba na jooti ya Piterri, ena köö jï Jecu, ni «?Kwäärö, a ŋati?»
english: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?

anywaa: Ni kö Jecu jïre, «?Ni näk beeye mana manynya ni eni dööŋe këël mano ööa, jïrï dee ŋø? Ööï, ni cäädhï køøra.»
english: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø akeethø dï nyïïmëëe bëët, ni ge cäänö ni bääŋ manøgø ba thøw. 'Ba paa mana caan Jecu jïre, ni «Eni ba thøw.» 'Ba mana caane beeye, ni «?Ni näk beeye mana manynya ni eni dööŋe këël mano ööa, jïrï dee ŋø?»
english: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?

anywaa: 'Ba bääŋ manøca beeye ni caan mare en kiper gïïögøøni, ni beeye ni göör gïï ii. Ni ŋääø ni mana caane, adïëri.
english: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïï møøk mo thööth thuwø mo otïïc Jecu. 'Ba onää gïïögø ogöörö bëët, yaa caarø ni piny doo tïmö ni thiinh kiper weeli moøgø na dii göörö.
english: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.

anywaa: Ï na Thïëpöla, yi wëëlö mana kwøŋa göör, a caana japa täk Jecu ki tïïc ki pwöc moe bëët,
english: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

anywaa: gøøc dïcäŋa lwøri na kïthi maal, køør mana kööm nyïïatwieli moe ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, jøøa näk ee jierø.
english: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïïa leth na jwøre, eni dëëre anyoodhe jïge ni eni kwøw ki yïth nyuuthe mo thööth. Ni eni ree wø nyoodhe nyoodhø jïge ki yïth nïra näk pïëraŋween, ni eni wø cäänö kiper buc Jwøk.
english: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

anywaa: 'Ba eni kanya bëëde ki geni, gena köömme, ni kööe, ni «Käru aay yi Jerucalem, 'ba koorru gïna buuk Wära, kaawat mana wïnynyu gø baŋa,
english: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.

anywaa: kiper Jøøn alöö ki pïï na nyuudhi, 'ba ki køør nïne mo nøk uuno lwøk ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.»
english: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø nø, kanya cooŋge rege kanya ciel, ena pëënyge, ni köge, ni «?Kwäärö, beeye kany duuï buc nyec baŋ jø Icriel yie ennø?»
english: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïge, ni «Paa kare kiperu ki man ŋäyu nïne ki kwöra wäŋŋi na caan Jwøki ki teege.
english: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno jïti ki teek kanyo ö Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere bäätu, ni tïmu ni uuna lïŋŋe 'moa yi Jerucalem, ki yi Judia bäre, ki Cameria, këël yi piny bäre.»
english: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan gïnögø, ni ge poot neeta gø, ena put tïŋ maal, ni puti ya pööle gëëŋ.
english: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge raŋŋa maal kanya aae, jiy ariiø aput cuŋŋö buutge, mo dëëtge da abïïe mo tar.
english: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «?U na jø Galili, aŋø ni cuŋŋu nou raŋŋa maal en? Jecu man en, na käl buutu en ni kïthi maal, ocäŋ duuö na enøgønø thuwø kaawat man neennu gø ni aa maal enø.»
english: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

anywaa: Køøre gena duu yi Jerucalem ni ge ööi ki bäät kïnna cwøl ni Kïn Ølip, na kare cään ki Jerucalem, mo bäye caala wääth man wø caath dhaanhe ki cäŋ jwömö.
english: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

anywaa: 'Ba na duuge, gena ci maal yi øtø kanya bëëtge yie. Ni beeye Piter ki Jøøn ki Jeemeth ki Andaru, ki Pilip, ki Tøma, ki Barthølömu, ki Mathiew, ki Jeemeth wär Alpia, ki Cayman na näk Dhelat, ki Juudac o Jeemeth.
english: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët røkge acïpge køør lam ki cwïny aciel, ki mään bëët, ki Meeri mii Jecu ki nyïïmenni.
english: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø Piter ree athïïŋe dï nyïïmëëe moa näk bääk Jecu. 'Ba acooŋa bäre jïtö ki kar jiy ma dïpa aciel ki pïërariiø. Ni kö Piterri jïge,
english: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)

anywaa: «Nyïïmera, wëël Jwøk manynya gø nee thur kare, kaa mana kwøŋi ya Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere caan ki dhi Deebit, ni caan kaper Juudac na näk dïnyuudhi jï jøøa mak Jecu.
english: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.

anywaa: Kiper ena kwøŋ kwaan dëëtø, ni eni jïre da kare ri tïïc man.»
english: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac aŋëëö ki pwödhö ki japa joode dëër gïna raac na tïïe. Ni ö eni ni päth bäät ŋute, ni cööt yie, ni ö cïïre ni øcge wøk.
english: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø aŋäc jø Jerucalemmi bëët, ni beeye na cwølge pwöthögø ki dhi poge na Akeldema, ni tiere beeye pwöth remø.
english: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri, no «Ogöörö yi wëël Dut Pwøc, «ni ‹Wëëk wï paare dïdö, ni bäŋe dhaanhø aciel mo bëëdö yie,› ni ‹Beerra man ö kar tïïe ni lwøri ya ŋat mørri.›
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ø doo lwötö ki dhaanhø aciel røk jøøa bëëdö ki øøni yïth nïra caath Kwäärö ma Jecu dïïø,
english: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

anywaa: ni tägi ka ri lwøk na nyuudhi mar Jøøn, këël dïcäŋa käl Jecu dïïø ni aa maal. Dhaanhø aciel dï jøøgø doo dwätö ki øøni na aciel nee tïme na lïŋi kiper duun Jecu wøk ki yi thøø na neene.»
english: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni kïthge jiy ariiø nyïm, ni beeye Jocep na cwøl ni Barcaba ni wø cwøl ni Jacta, ki Mathaya.
english: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

anywaa: Ni lämge, ni köge, ni «Wui Wuuö, ï ni wø ŋäc cwïny jøw bëët, nyooth ŋata jierï jïwa dëët jøøi na ariiø ii,
english: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,

anywaa: kiper nee jïte ki kare ri tïïc man en, nee tïme na nyïïatwiel na kar Juudac na gaa wøk na joot mare nyïme.»
english: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni tïmge ki ŋïïce, ni päth wï Mathaya. Ni put dwätö ki nyïïatwieli na näk apaar kurciel.
english: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ Pentikø, bääk Jecu dëëtge ege cooŋø kanya ciel bëët.
english: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

anywaa: 'Ba ki kany mo thiinh dwøl mør aöö ki maal kaamar jamø mo kwödö ni teek ni pääŋ øtø mana bëëtge yie bäre.
english: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

anywaa: Ni neenge gïï møøk mo nëëna lëëp mäc, ni gïïögø ni nëën lëëp mäc yøø opääŋŋö jïge ni ena bäät ŋati man nø.
english: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.

anywaa: Ni pääŋ dëëtge bëët ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni täkge ki cäänö ki dhøgi møøk, kaa mana ö Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere na wëëk ge cäänö.
english: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da jø Juuth mo bëëdö yi Jerucalem mo cwïnyge ege cïp køør Jwøk, mo ge käla tiet mïëri bëët piny bäre.
english: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge dööt jøøgøøni gena ö kanya ciel na lwaak mo päl, ni yïthge onithay kiper ŋati man nø dhi poge awïnynye dhøk jøøgø kanya cäänge.
english: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.

anywaa: 'Ba geni yïthge athäŋŋö ni rëëm yïthge, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, jøøi ni cäänö ii, paa jø Galili bëët?
english: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

anywaa: ?Otägö nidïï, ni tïme ni ŋati man nø dïïø dhi poge wïnynye wïnynyö baŋ jøøgø?
english: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?

anywaa: Jø Parthia, ki jø Miith, ki jø Ilam, ki jø wø bëëdö yi Mecöpatemia, ki Judia, ki Kapadöcia ki Pønta ki Eecia,
english: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

anywaa: ki Parijia ki Pampilia, ki Ijep, ki jøøa käl thäŋ Libya na bëën Cayriin, ki wëëlle moa käl Röm, këël jø Juuth ki jøøa løk dëëtge na jø Juuth,
english: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,

anywaa: ki jø Kariit ki jø Areebia, luupge wïnyö jïïø ni ge cäänö ka dhøgi mo pøø, ni ge caana tïïe moa døøŋŋø na tïïc Jwøki.»
english: Cretans and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.

anywaa: Ni thäŋ yïthge bëët ni yïthge onithay, ni pëënyge røkge, ni «?Tier gïn agïnaŋø?»
english: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?

anywaa: Ba gena buu møøki ni köge, ni «Jøøgø geno meer ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mo poot no oguk.»
english: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter ree athïïŋe ki nyïïatwieli moa näk apaar kurciel, ni tïŋ dwøre maal ni cään jøøgø, ni kööe, ni «U na jø Judia, ki u bëët, u wø bëëdö yi Jerucalem, cegu ïthu ki luupa nee tier gïn caana jïïu.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

anywaa: Kiper jøøi ii ge paa omeer kaawat man caarru gø enø, kiper man poot na caae abïŋween mo aruunnø.
english: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn en beeye gïna caan nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Jool, na kööe,
english: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;

anywaa: «ni ‹Jwøk aköö ni ki yïth nïne moo näk aŋuudi, Jwïëya okïtha bäät jiy bëët. Ni ö wäätu ki nyïïu ni køpge dwøra, ni ö wøpe mou ni neenge jammi moo en yi nyïm mo wø nyooth ki yi wïc, ni ö jäle mou ni läkge ki lääk.
english: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God, I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:

anywaa: Yïth nïrögøøni Jwïëya okïtha bäät jøw otïny aani moa näk cwøw ki mään, ni ö geni ni køpge dwøra.
english: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

anywaa: 'Ba gïï mo rëëma ec onyoodha maal, ni ö ŋïïce ni nyoodha ge piny, ni beege remø ki maac ki jïc maac.
english: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:

anywaa: 'Ba cäŋ odøøc mo cøl, ni ö dwääyi ni tïme na remø, kanyo poot cäŋ Wuuö ni kär öö, ni beeye cäŋo dwøŋ døc noo rëëm ec.
english: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöce, jøw ocøør nyeŋ Wuuö bëët di piemø.›
english: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.

anywaa: «U na jø Icriel, wïnynyu luupi ii. Aani, a cäänna uuni kiper Jecu nyï Nadhareth, ŋata nyooth Jwøki jïïu ki tïïe mo døøŋŋø ki gïï mo rëëma ec ki ŋïïce moa tïïc Jwøki dïïu ki køøre, kaa mana ŋäyu gø ki dëëtu.
english: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:

anywaa: Jecu manøgø acïp ceŋŋu keda mana kwøŋi ya Jwøki cooŋ ki cwïnye ni ŋääe cøøn, 'ba acïbu ceŋ jøøa kuc ciik Jwøk, ni guru gø bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni 'nägu gø.
english: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø ni pät gø cer thøø, kiper ba doo løny jï thøø ki man mak gø.
english: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.

anywaa: Kiper gïre acaan Deebiti, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk a wara neeta nyïma cooth, kiper eni wø ena bäät cer cwïïa naa ba pädha.
english: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, yia atïmö ni met ni kanynya, ni ö dëëra ni bëën ŋäädhe.
english: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:

anywaa: Kiper jwïëya ba wiiï kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw, ni ba wëëgï dëër dhaanhnhï na en kur keere kwääö.
english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

anywaa: 'Ba uutjïëth kwøw anyuthï aani, ni yia odøøyï mo met døc kiper noo nudï buuta.›
english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.

anywaa: «Nyïïmera, a caana gïr kwarø ma Deebit jïïu na adïëri, ni ena thøw ni koonyi, ni bwöye poot ena buutø këël waŋcäŋi en.
english: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk ena nyikuŋ Jwøk ni ŋääe ni Jwøk onø kööŋ jïre ni dhaanhø aciel røk nyïïkwaaye ocïp bäät wälle,
english: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;

anywaa: gïnögø akwøŋ neen cøøn ni køp duun Krictø wøk ki yi thøø, ni eni kär wii kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw, ni rïŋ dëëre kwääö käre joodø.
english: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jecu manøgø na tïŋ Jwøki maal, ni gïnögø aneenwa bëët.
english: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane kiper na tïŋi maal ni wëëgi ajiem bäät cwïï Jwøk, ni wëëgi Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere na buuk Wuue jïre, gïn neennu en ni wïnynyu en awëëk ööny bäätwa.
english: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.

anywaa: Kiper Deebit kär ci maalø, 'ba eni ki dëëre aköö, «ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk aköö jï Kwääya, ni «Pï bäät cer cwïïa,
english: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

anywaa: këël mano døøya nyïïmännï køøm tietï.» ›
english: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wär ŋäc dhi øt Icrielli bäre na adïëri døøc ni ŋatøgø adøøc Jwøki Kwäärö ni näk Krictø, ni beeye Jecu manøgø kiree na guru bäät jaadha no odëëdö.»
english: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luummögø, cwïnyge abwøk, ni köge jï Piter ki nyïïatwieli møga, «?Nyïïmëëkwa, agïnaŋø noo tïïcwa?»
english: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïge, ni «Løgu cwïnynyu ni lwøk uuni na nyuudhi u bëët, ki nyeŋ Jecu Krictø, kiper nee gïïa bayu nee wec. 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ocïp jïïu na muuy.
english: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: Kiper gïna buuk, buuga jïïu ki nyïïu ki jøøa kwörge bäyö bëët, këël jiy bëët moo cwøl Wuuö Jwøki na näk Jwøø baŋe.»
english: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.

anywaa: 'Ba gena cäänne ki luup møøk mo thööth ni köömma geni, ni kööe, ni «Gwøgu rou ki jø pinyi ni reyø ii.»
english: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nø jøøa jïëy ki luumme, gena lwøk na nyuudhi. 'Ba dïcäŋöca jøøa dwätö ki bääk Jecu, ge jïtö ki kar kume adäk.
english: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.

anywaa: Ni cïpge cwïnyge køør pwöc nyïïatwieli ni dwalge cwïnyge na aciel, ni møø wø pøtge pøtø, ni lämge.
english: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

anywaa: 'Ba lwär aö bäät jiy bëët. Ni ö gïï mo thööth mo rëëma ec ki ŋïïce ni tïïi ki røk nyïïatwieli.
english: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa jïëy bëët, røkge adwalge na aciel ni nywaakge japge bëët.
english: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;

anywaa: Ni dwøkge ŋøøm moa näk moge pwöth ki gïïa en jïge, ni pääŋge gwetge jï jøøa näk ceŋge orëëm bëët.
english: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ge wø cøøa Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ na aciel, ni muunni wø pøtge pøtø uutge, ni ge wø cämö na aciel ni ge ŋeethø ni yïthge met.
english: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,

anywaa: Ni ge wø pwøya Jwøk, ni jiy bëët yïthge met ki geni. Ni ö Wuue ni mëën bäät geni ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët ki jø wø piem.
english: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter ki Jøøn gena aay ni ge cøøa Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki kar caae adäk ka abøøya kany wø läm jiyi.
english: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da dhaanhø mo nywöli na puuth mo obiel kaace, ŋat mo wø kïthge dhi kal cooth mana cwøl ni Mïërö mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ kiper nee kwääe ki jap cane baŋ jø wø ci yi Øt Jwøk.
english: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;

anywaa: 'Ba na neen Piter ki Jøøn ni ge cøøa Øt Jwøk, ena pëëö ki jap cane.
english: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.

anywaa: 'Ba jïre aneen Piterri ge ki Jøøn, ni kö Piterri, ni «Neen jïwa.»
english: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.

anywaa: Ni put nyeŋŋe kem dëëtge ni ee ŋäädhö ni eni jïtö ki gïrpiny baŋge.
english: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö, ni «Aani jïra bäŋ gwel, 'ba gïn en jïra en mëëga ïïni. Ki nyeŋ Jecu Krictø nyï Nadhareth, cäädhï!»
english: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.

anywaa: Ni mak gø ki cer cwïïe ni tïŋ gø maal. Ni put tiete ki nyeŋ ogweye tëënnö.
english: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.

anywaa: Ni päär maal ni cuŋŋe ni cäädhe ni døny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki ge, ni cäädhi ni pärö ni jiema Jwøk.
english: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi bëët ni neenge gø ni cäädhö ni jiema Jwøk.
english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:

anywaa: Ni ŋecge gø ni beeye ŋat wø bëëdö ni kwääö ki jap cane dhi kal mana cwøl ni Mïërö mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. Ni thäŋ yïthge døc ni yïthge orëëm ki gïna tägö dëëre.
english: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot ŋatøgø no ogöök ri Piter ki Jøøn, jiy bëët areŋ baŋge kanya ciel ya agööl Cølöman, ni yïthge orëëm.
english: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
