anywaa: 'Ba na ö Piterri na neen gïnögø, jøøgø aluumme, ni kööe, ni «?Jø Icriel, aŋø ni thäŋ yïthu ki gïn en, wala aŋø ni raŋŋu jïwa, kee ŋati wëëga wa wääth ki teek marwa wala karwa cään ki Jwøk?
english: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?

anywaa: Beeye Jwø Eeberam ki Aydhak ki Jeekap na näk Jwø kwäyø, na wëëk ajiem dhaanhnhe ma Jecu, ŋata cïbu ceŋ jiy nee 'näkge, ni kwierru gø nyïm Paylat kanya caar gø ni päde pädö.
english: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na näk mar Jwøk na en kur keere na mare beer akwierru, ni pëënynyu dïnääy nee cïp jïïu,
english: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;

anywaa: ni 'nägu ŋat wø cïp kwøw; 'ba ena tïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø. Ni waani, waana lïŋŋe kiper gïnögø.
english: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jecu manøgø ki ŋäädhe na en ri nyeŋŋe na wëëk ŋati tëënnö ni neennu en ni ŋäyu. Ni beeye ŋäädhe mana öö ki ri Jecu na wëëk dëër ŋati døø kare na bäre nyïmmu bëët.
english: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

anywaa: «'Ba kawaane, nyïïmera, ŋääa ni gïna tïïyu kar kaaca kuyu, keda mana kuyi ya kwääri mou thuwø.
english: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa kwøŋ Jwøki caan dhøk nyïïkuge bëët, ni dhaanhnhe ma Krictø gïï mo leth dee jwørø, luupögø awëëk thur karge na enønø.
english: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, cäŋu wïthu caarrø ni løgu cwïnynyu, kiper nee moa bayu puu wøk, nee yïthu cäŋge mïnnö kiper Wuuö Jwøk noo en buutu,
english: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

anywaa: kiper nee Krictø jääŋŋe na näk ojierø kiperu, na näk Jecu,
english: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

anywaa: ŋato bëëdö maal gøøc mano ö jammi bëët noo døøyi mo nyään keda mana kwøŋi ya Jwøki køp ki dhøk nyïïkuk moe na en kur keerge.
english: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

anywaa: Kiper Modhe aköö, ni ‹Wuuö Jwøk na näk Jwøk maru uuno thïïŋŋe ki nyikuŋ Jwøk røk nyïïmëëgu keda mana thïïŋ aani. 'Ba mare owïnynyu yïth luupo care jïïu bëët.
english: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋöca jiy bëët moo ba wïny luum nyikuŋŋögø, ge di raanynyø bëët dï jiy.›
english: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët moa cäänö, ki mana täge ki Camiel ki moa öö køøre, gena cäänö thuwø kiper nïri ii.
english: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuna wäät nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni nägu wäät luumma tuut na wëëk Jwøki kwäyu, na kööe jï Eeberam, ni ‹Jø bäät piny bëët ogwïëth ki ri kunhnhö marï.›
english: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk na thïïŋ Wääde, akwøŋ jääŋ baŋu nee u gwïëdhe ni løga u yi rääö maru karubëët.»
english: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Piterri ki Jøøn ni ge cäänna jiy, kwääc laam ki kwääy lwaak mar jø wø koor Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ki jø Cajucith, gena ö baŋge.
english: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,

anywaa: Ni geno gootø ki ge kiper na pwönyge jiy, ni køpge gø ni jiy duua wøk ki yi thøø ki ri Jecu.
english: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

anywaa: Ni ö geni ni makge ge ni kïthge geni øt twöc gøøc amöölla, kiper piny onø tïmö na wäär.
english: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth moa wïny luum Jwøk gena jïëy ni ŋääthge. 'Ba jøøka jïtö ki kume abïïc.
english: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla kwääri, ki jaae, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk gena cuuŋö yi Jerucalem,
english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

anywaa: ki Anna na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ki Keepa, ki Jøøn, ki Alekdhander, ki tuuŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ bëët.
english: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø cïpge Piter ki Jøøn piny dïge, gena pëënyge, na «?A teeŋ teega ŋø wala a nyeŋŋa ŋø na tïïyu gïn ki gø?»
english: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Piter na cwïnye päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, aköö jïge, ni «U na kwääc jiy ki u na jaae,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

anywaa: nee u löö ka wa dïcäŋi kiper gïna beer na tïïc dëër ŋata näk puuth, kiper tier køny mana køny ŋatøgø ki gø,
english: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

anywaa: wär ŋäyu bëët, u ki jø Icriel bëët, ni beeye nyeŋ Jecu Krictø nyï Nadhareth, na 'nägu bäät jaadha no odëëdö na tïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø, na wëëk dëër ŋatøgø ni cuŋŋi nyïmmu enø døø kare.
english: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.

anywaa: Ni beeye ‹kïnna kwierru, u na dïgëëte, na tïmö na cöödhi mar gøøt.›
english: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mør mo doo piem jiy. Kiper bäŋ nyeŋ mør bäät piny bäre mo ocïbö dï jiy mo ø doo piemø ki køøre.»
english: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba na neenge Piter ki Jøøn ni cwïnyge da cer, ni ŋäcge ni jøøgø kär pwönynyö ni gena jiy jaak, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni ŋecge gø ni gena jøøa bëëdö ki Jecu.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na neenge ŋata køny ni cuŋŋö buutge, gena tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo maarge caan.
english: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø köömge geni ni daakge rege nyïm kwääc løøe, gena cäänö keerge,
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

anywaa: ni köge, na «?Agïnaŋø noo tïïø ki jøøi? Kiper ŋïï mo dwøŋ atïïc ki røkge, ni ŋäc jø Jerucalemmi bëët, ni ba løny jïïø ki man mooŋø gø.
english: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper luummögø nee ba nyaae këët dï jiy, beerra man köömmø ge, nee nyeŋŋøgø ba caange jï dhaanhø mør këët.»
english: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, gena cwølge ni cemge ge nee ge ba cäänge wala ge pöö ki nyeŋ Jecu këët na bäre bäre.
english: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Piterri ki Jøøn jïge, ni köge, ni «Nee beer jï Jwøk ki man wïnywa luummu ni kaala mare, ŋølu piny.
english: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

anywaa: Kiper waani mana jootwa ki mana wïnywa ba maarwa wec ki caan.»
english: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø ŋwönyge ge døøc, gena wëëkge wääth, ni bäŋ jöö mo ege joodø ki man pwötge ge, kiper gïno caan jiyi. Kiper jiy bëët Jwøk apwøcge kiper gïna tägö.
english: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.

anywaa: Kiper ŋatøgø na køny ki jöö mo rëëma ec enø, cwiiye jïtö ki pïëraŋween ki wïthge.
english: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter ki Jøøn kanya pät geni, gena døø baŋ nyïïawäätge ni caange gïïa caan kwääc laammi ki jaae jïge.
english: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge gø, döötge atïŋge maal karge bëët jï Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Wuuö Jwøk na näk Kwäärö, ï na cwääc maal ki piny ki näm ki jammi bëët moa en yïthge,
english: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:

anywaa: ïïna kwøŋ cäänö ki dhi kwarwa ma Deebit na näk dhaanhnhï na caanï ki ri Jwïëyï na en kur keere, na kööï, «na ‹?Aŋø na wëër juurre, ni cät jiyi ki gïï ma baal jaak en?
english: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?

anywaa: Nyec piny dëëtge ege thïïŋö ni ö kwääri ni dwätge kanya ciel ni nywääkge dëër Wuuö Jwøk, ki dhaanhnhe na näk ee jierø.›
english: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.

anywaa: Kiper ka adïëri møn, yi paani en, Eerat ki Pøntia Paylat, ki juurre ki jø Icriel, gena dwätö ni nywääkge dëër Dhaanhnhï ma Jecu na en kur keere, na näk iï jierø.
english: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,

anywaa: Ni ge tïïya gïna näk iï cooŋø ki cwïnyï ki teek marï cøøn ni doo tïmö.
english: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, ï na Wuuö, neen luupa reyø na caange, ni wëëgï laagï caan luummï ni cwïnyge da cer ni bäŋ lwär,
english: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

anywaa: kany bëëdï ni cerï iï rwääö baŋ køny en, ni ö ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec ni tïïi ki køør nyeŋ Dhaanhnhï ma Jecu na en kur keere.»
english: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni na lønyge ki lam, kanya näk dëëtge ege cooŋ yie ree ajäŋe, ni pääŋ cwïnyge bëët ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere. Ni køpge luum Jwøk ni cwïnyge da cer.
english: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jøøa näk ojïëy cwïnyge aciel ni jwïëcge aciel, ni bäŋ dhaanhø aciel dïge mo köö ni japa en jïre moe keere. 'Ba geni japge anywaakge na aciel bëët.
english: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwieli gïr duun Kwäärö ma Jecu wøk ki yi thøø akøpge ni ge teek døc, ni met ec mo päl ena bäätge.
english: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo bëëdö ni can dïge, kiper jøøa jïge da ŋøøm ki uudi, gïïögø adwøkge pwöth, ni kälge japa jootge ri gïïa dwøkge pwöth,
english: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,

anywaa: ni peethge ge nyïm nyïïatwieli, ni pääŋge ge jï jøøa näk ceŋge orëëm.
english: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, da dhaanhø ma nyï tuuŋ Libay mo käla Caypara, mo cwøl ni Jocep, mo nyeŋŋe ocak nyïïatwieli ni Barnaba, na näk tiere beeye O Cøm-cwïny.
english: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,

anywaa: Eni pwötha en jïre adwøk pwödhö, ni käl jap gø ni peeth gø nyïm nyïïatwieli.
english: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

anywaa: 'Ba da dhaanhø mør mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Ananaya ki cïïe ma Capaayra. Eni ŋøøpe adwøk pwödhö.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

anywaa: 'Ba gwel møøk akan paac ni ŋäc cïïe, ni käl thäŋ gwel keerge ni peeth ge nyïm nyïïatwieli.
english: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö, na «?Ananaya, aŋø ni ö Ceethanni ni pääŋ cwïnyï en, ki man cäänï ki tööt jï Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni kanï thäŋ gwet pwödhö en?
english: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kanya poot pwödhö ni kärï dwøk pwödhö, ba bëëdö na marï? ?'Ba køøre na nø dwøgï gø pwödhö, paa wïïï ki mana diï tïïö ki gwete? ?Aŋø na tïïyï gïn en ki cwïnyï? Ï ba cään jiy ki tööt, 'ba ï cäänna Jwøk.»
english: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Ananaya na wïny luupögøøni, ena pädhö ni thøøe. Ni ö lwärri mo päl ni ö bäät jøøa wïny gïnögø bëët.
english: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.

anywaa: 'Ba jak ma wøpe aö maal ni bøønyge gø, ni bielge gø wøk, ni koonyge gø.
english: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ruue ki kany mo jïtö ki kar caae adäk, cïïe aläm køøre ni gïna tägö kuue.
english: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïre, «Caanï jïra. ?Beege japa ŋeewu pwödhö ki gø ii?» Ni kö nyijøøgø, «Yaa, bee geni.»
english: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö jïre, na «?Aŋø ni jïëyu ki man päänynyu Jwïëc Wuuö? Neen, jøøa koony cwørï karge cään ki duuö ennø; 'ba ïïno bielge wøk thuwø.»
english: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.

anywaa: Ni put dhaaŋŋøgø päth tiete ni thøøe. Ni ö jaga näk wøpe ni dunyge ni jootge gø no othøw, ni bielge gø wøk, ni koonyge gø buut cwøre.
english: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.

anywaa: Ni ö lwärri mo päl bäät acooŋ Jwøk bäre, ki bäät jøøa wïny gïïögø bëët.
english: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø da ŋïïce mo thööth ki gïï mo rëëma ec ma atïïc dï jiy ki røk nyïïatwieli. 'Ba jøøa jïëy ki Jecu bëët, dëëtge wø cooŋge ya agööl Cølöman.
english: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo omaar cwïnye mak røk jiy møga ki man dwäte ki geni. 'Ba geno wøør jiyi døøc.
english: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth ajïëy ki Wuuö ni dwätge ki geni ni kaala moa dïkwøŋ, ni gena jiy mo thööth døc na cwøw ki mään.
english: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)

anywaa: Ni tïm jiyi ni ge kïtha wøk ki jø täwe uutjïëthe, ni pïëlge geni bäät pëëmme ki pëëne, kiper nee kany wäro ö Piterri ki buutge, nee tïmme pööth bäät møøk dïge.
english: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy moa käl yïth mïëya en ŋää Jerucalem, dëëtge acooŋge kanya ciel thuwø, ni ge käla jø täwe ki jøøa dëëtge da juu mo reyø. Ni dwøk dëëtge karge bëët.
english: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.

anywaa: 'Ba Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ree athïïŋe ki jøøa en buute, na näk jø Cajucith. 'Ba kiper mana näk geno këëyö døc,
english: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,

anywaa: nyïïatwieli amakge ni kïthge ge øt twöc.
english: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na wäär, nyïïatwiel maal mør mar Wuuö odhuuth øt twöc ajabe ni käl geni wøgø, ni kööe,
english: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,

anywaa: ni «Cou ni cuŋŋu yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni caannu luum kwøwøgø bäre jï jiy.»
english: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø wïnyge gïnögø, gena døny yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ni cäŋ tuulö, ni pööge. 'Ba kanyøgøøni, Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aöö ki jøøa en buute, ni cooŋ kwääc løøe ki jaae mo Icriel, ni jääk baŋ jøøa twöc nee ge käli.
english: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ci dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk, ge kärge joodø øt twöc. Ni døøkge ni caange gø,
english: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,

anywaa: ni «Øt twöc ajootwa ni poot no odëëdö kare, ni jøøa kurö cuŋŋa dhøk odhuule. 'Ba na japwa gø, bäŋ dhaanhø mo ewa joodø yie.»
english: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kwäärö mar dïkuye mo Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki kwääc laam na wïnyge luummögø, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni köge, ni «?Cuŋ gïn otïme na ŋø?»
english: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, ŋat mør aöö ni caan gø jïge, ni «Raŋŋu, jøøa kïthu øt twöc, ge cuŋŋö Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni ge pöö ki jiy.»
english: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.

anywaa: Køøre kwääc dïkuye ki jiye gena put cøø ni kälge geni. 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ege tïïö dëëtge, kiper na lwäcge ni ge këër jiyi këërö ki kïte.
english: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kälge ge, gena kïthge nyïm kwääc løøe. Ni ö Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ ni pëëny geni,
english: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,

anywaa: ni kööe, na «?Aŋø, u kärwa mänö ki man pööu ki nyeŋŋøgø? 'Ba kawaane Jerucalem apääŋŋu ki pwöc maru, nou manynya man kälu rem ŋatøgø bäätwa.»
english: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Piterri ki nyïïatwieli møga, ni «Beerra man lwäärwa Jwøk ki man lwäärwa jiy.
english: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.

anywaa: Kiper Jwø kwäyø, Jecu atïŋ maal, ŋata ŋaabu bäät jaath ni 'nägu gø.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.

anywaa: 'Ba ena cuum Jwøki bäät cwïïe ni tïïc gø na Kwäärö ni näk Pïëmi, kiper nee jø Icriel wëëk løk cwïnyge, ni wec raay moge.
english: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.

anywaa: 'Ba waana lïŋŋe kiper gïïögø, këël Jwïëc Jwøk thuwø na en kur keere na cïp Jwøki jï jø wø leŋ dwøre.»
english: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya wïnyge gïnögø, cwïnyge aränynyö døc, ni tïmge ni ge manynya man 'näkge geni.
english: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat Paricith aciel røk kwääc løøe, mo nyeŋŋe cwøl ni Gameeliel, ŋat ma dïpööy mar ciik Jwøk mo owøør jiyi bëët, ree athïïŋe, ni cïpe ki dwøl nee jøøgø kïth wøk ki kany mo thiinh.
english: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, ni «U na jø Icriel, gwøgu røgu ki gïno tïïyu dëët jøøgø.
english: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.

anywaa: Kiper nïr acääŋŋe Thuda ree athïïŋe ni døøc dëëre mo dwøŋ. Ni ö jiyi mo jïtö ki kar dïpe aŋween ni cige dëëre. 'Ba ena 'näk, ni ö jøøa cäädhö køøre ni keethge, ni tïm gïnöca ni bäŋgø.
english: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.

anywaa: Køør ŋatøgø, yïth nïr wø kwaan jiy yie, Juudac nyï Galili ree athïïŋe, ni kän dëëre ki jiy mo cäädhi køøre. 'Ba nyenøgø thuwø athøw, ni ö jøøa cäädhö køøre ni keethge.
english: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ri luummi en, aani, a cäänna uuni, ni bëëdu ni karu bäär ki jøøgø ni weyu ge. Kiper ni näk luummögø ki gïno ni tïïcge enø käla baŋ jiy, oränynyi.
english: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk marge käla baŋ Jwøk, ge ba maaru böötö. Kanymør tïmö nou gëëmö ka Jwøk.»
english: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwøre aleŋge. Ba na nø cwølge nyïïatwieli yi øtø, gena pwötge ni cemge ge nee nyeŋ Jecu ba caange këët, ni wëëkge ge wääth.
english: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni gena put ö wøk ki nyïm kwääc løøe ni aacge, ni yïthge met kiper gïna wëëk Jwøki geni nee jwørge kiper nyeŋŋøgø.
english: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne bëët yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ ki yïth mïëcge, pwöc kärge wiiø ki man køpge luumma nyään na met ni Jecu beeye Krictø.
english: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø kanya ö bääŋi na meetge rege, jø Juuth moa näk odhoom na jø Gïrïïk gena tïmö ni ge ŋurö ki nyeŋ jø Ibaru, kiper määr thuunhnhi moge atïmö ni di kääŋö ki jammi mo wø pääŋŋi ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwieli na näk apaar kurriiø bääŋi bëët acwølge kanya ciel, ni köge, ni «Ennø, ba beer jïwa ki man wecwa køp luum Jwøk, ni tïïcwa tïï pääŋ jammi.
english: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, jëëtu dïïu ki jiy abïriiø mo ŋäyu ni beyø, mo cwïnyge päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk, mo wïthge leer, kiper nee tïïögø wëëkwa geni.
english: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

anywaa: 'Ba waani dëëtwa ocïpwa køør lam cooth ki køp luum Jwøk.»
english: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma caange, lwaak bäre yïthge amïnnö ki gø. Ni jierge Ectipen, ŋat mo ŋäädhe mare dwøŋ døc, ni cwïnye päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ki Pilip, ki Parököra, ki Nikanör, ki Timøn, ki Parmena, ki Nikööla nyï Antïëk, ŋata løk dëëre dïkwøŋ cøøn na ŋat Juuth.
english: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:

anywaa: Jøøgø akïthge nyïm nyïïatwieli. Ni ö geni ni cïpge ceŋge bäätge ni lämge.
english: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

anywaa: 'Ba luum Jwøk anyaay. Ni ö bääŋi ni thöönhge døc yi Jerucalem. Ni ö dïlämme møøk mo thööth ni jïëcge luum ŋäädhe manøgø.
english: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

anywaa: 'Ba Ectipen na cwïnye päŋ ki met yi Jwøk ki teek Jwøk, gïï mo døøŋŋø døc mo rëëma ec ki ŋïïce atïïe dï jiy.
english: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, jø møøk mo ena dëët jø øt acooŋ lam mana cwøl ni mar jøøa näk opädö, ki jø øt acooŋ lam mar jø Cayriin, ki mar Alekdhandaria, ki jø møøk mo käla Cilicia ki Eecia, rege athïïŋge ni pïëmge ki Ectipen.
english: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

anywaa: 'Ba kär løny jïge ki man maarge dwök baŋe ki luubö, kiper leec wïc ki Jwïëc Jwøk na cääne ki gø.
english: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre yïth jø møøk acoonge. Ni kö jøøgø, ni «Nyenøgø ajootwa ni cäänö ki luup mo reyø dëër Modhe ki Jwøk.»
english: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jiy, ki jaae, ki dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk awëëkge niïïk. Ni öge baŋ Ectipen, ni makge gø, ni kïthge gø nyïm kwääc løøe.
english: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,

anywaa: Ni kïthge jiy nyïm mo cäänö ki luup tööt, ni köge, ni «Nyenøgø wø cäänö ki luup mo reyø dëër Øtø man ni en kur keere na mar Jwøk en, ki ciik Jwøk, ni ba maar wec.
english: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:

anywaa: Kiper mare awïnywa ni eni cäänö ni Jecu nyï Nadhareth manøgø, kany raanynye raanynyø, ni wiil kööŋŋe moa wëëk Modhe øøni.»
english: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc løøe bëët na näk opï piny kar løøk na neenge jïre, täärnyïme ajootge ni caala täärnyïm nyïïatwiel maal.
english: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ aköö jï Ectipen, ni «?Luupögø acaanï møn?»
english: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

anywaa: 'Ba Ectipen aköö, «Nyie, nyïïmera ki wëëga, cegu ïthu ki luumma. Jwø ajiem ree anyoodhe jï kwarø ma Eeberam, kanya bëëde yi Mecöpatemia, ni eni poot kär ci yi Aaren.
english: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïgø, ni ‹Dagï kany ni weyï pou ki tuuŋu, ni ciï paano nyoodha jïrï.›
english: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ena put daa ni wec po jø Kaldia, ni daa yi Aaren. 'Ba køør thøw wänni, ena daak Jwøki kaace ni käl gø paani ni bëëdu yie ennø.
english: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

anywaa: 'Ba eni poot kär mooc Jwøki ki ŋøøm, këël nyi kany mo thiinh mo caala kar tier dhaanhø. 'Ba ena buŋ Jwøki ni eni di mooø ki ŋøøm ma moe ki nyïïkwaaye moo ööi køøre, këël na bëëde ni bäŋ nyilaal jïre.
english: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.

anywaa: 'Ba acaan Jwøki na ennønø jïre, ni ‹Nyïïkwaayï otïmö ni path po jø møøk, ni ö jøøgø ni tïïcge ge na laaŋe ni caange ge ki cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween.›
english: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Jø paano tïnyge, oŋøla wøk. 'Ba noo näk køøre geno ö wøk ni wøørge aani kany.›
english: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.

anywaa: Ni wëëk Eeberam daŋ na ŋïï mar luubö mana tuut. 'Ba Eeberam wääde ma Aydhak anywøle, ni daŋ gø kanya tïm nïre na abära wøk. Ni ö Aydhaki ni nywøl wääde ma Jeekap. Ni ö Jeekapi ni nywøl kwäre na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.

anywaa: «'Ba kwäre moøgø gena këëyö kiper o wääge ma Jocep, ni gathge eni baŋ jø Ijep. 'Ba Jwøk abëëdö buute,
english: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,

anywaa: ni piem gø yïth gïïa leth bëët na pïï dëëre, ni døøc wï gø mo leer nyïm Peerø nyeny Ijep, ni wëëk Peerø mëëyö ki gø, ni put gø tïïc na kwäärö bäät Ijep, ki bäät paare bäre.
english: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Ijep ki Keenan bäre ajïtö ki meel mo päl, ki gïï mo leth døc. Ni tïm kwäyø ni bäŋ cam mo maarge joot.
english: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

anywaa: 'Ba Jeekap na wïny gø ni da beel Ijep, kwäyø ajääŋŋe tietge mana dïkwøŋ.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.

anywaa: 'Ba na cäŋge døøgø, Jocep ree anyoodhe jï uutwänni. Ni ö tuuŋ Jocepi ni tïmge ni ŋäc Peerø.
english: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

anywaa: Ni ö Jocepi ni jääk baŋ wänni ma Jeekap ni cwöl gø baŋe, ki tuuŋge bëët, ni gena jiy ma pïërabïriiø kurbïïc.
english: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.

anywaa: Køøre Jeekap aci Ijep, ni thøø kunöce, eni ki kwäyø bëët.
english: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,

anywaa: Ni ö rïŋ dëëtge ni dwøgi Cekam, ni pïëlge geni yi kään kïdi mana näk oŋeew Eeberammi ki gwel baŋ wäät Eemör yi Cekam.
english: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.

anywaa: «'Ba na cään kanya wäŋŋi na näk obuuö na wëëk Jwøki Eeberam, jø pøø athöönhnhö ni meetge rege yi Ijep,
english: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

anywaa: gøøc mana ö nyeya mørri mo Jocep kuue na thïïŋi Ijep.
english: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

anywaa: Ni tïïc jø pøø ka amala, ni mak kwäyø ki teek nee nyïïge wetge, kiper nee ba bëëtge ni kwøw.
english: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.

anywaa: 'Ba kaagø Modhe alwaarø ki gø, ni eni mïërö jï Jwøk. Ni bëëde köör menni ki dwäde adäk yi øt wänni.
english: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na kïthi wøk, ena käl nyi Peerø ni tïïc gø na wääde.
english: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

anywaa: Ni ö Modhe ni pwönynyi ki gïïa ŋäc jø Ijepi bëët, ni tïme ni teek ki tïïc ki cäänö.
english: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.

anywaa: «'Ba kanya døøŋŋe ni cwiiye pïëraŋween, gïr nyïïmenni ma wäät Icriel apïï cwïnye ki man lïïmme baŋge.
english: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba na neen dhaanhø aciel dïge ni di caarø, ŋata caari acwaae, ni put nyï Ijep 'näk ni coola kwör ŋatøgø.
english: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:

anywaa: Ni ee caarø ni doo ŋäc jø poge ni geno piem Jwøki ki køøre. 'Ba kärge caarø.
english: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, jø Icriel ariiø acwäne ni ge wëër, ni thääk ge ni manynya man dwal geni, ni kööe, ‹Nyie jaay, uuna nyïïmëëe. ?Aŋø ni raanynyu røgu keeru en?›
english: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata bääyö yïthakic jøøgø na ariiø yøø, Modhe athanye, ni kööe, na ‹?Aŋø, ïïno tïïya ŋa na kwäärö wala dïŋut luup bäätwa?
english: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?

anywaa: ?Ï manynya gø naa 'nägï kaawat nyï Ijep mana awääre na 'nägï?›
english: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe na wïny gïnögø, aput päär wøk, ni put bëëte wøgø yi ŋööm Midien. Ni nywøl wääte ariiø paanøce.
english: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.

anywaa: «'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri ma pïëraŋween, nyïïatwiel maal mør ree anyoodhe jïre paap buut Kïn Caynay, ya abuŋŋö mo liel ki maac.
english: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.

anywaa: 'Ba na neeni ya Modhe yie athäŋŋö ki gïna joode. 'Ba na nyiik buut gø kany mo cään kiper nee neene døc, dwør Wuuö Jwøk awïnynye ni köö,
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,

anywaa: ni ‹Aana Jwø kwäyï, na näk Jwø Eeberam, ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap.› 'Ba Modhe dëëre atïmö ni miel, ni lwäye ki man cäŋ gø neennø.
english: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk aköö ki eni, ni ‹Käl war wøk tietï, kiper kany ni cuŋŋï yie en, ena kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, aani, gïïa reyø ni wø tïïc dëët jiya na en yi Ijep aneena døøc, ni wïnynya cooyø marge, ni beeye ni ööa piny en nee ge piema. 'Ba ennø, ööï nø, niï jääŋŋa Ijep.›
english: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.

anywaa: «'Ba Modhe manøgø na kwøŋ jø Icrielli kwier, na köge ki eni, ni ‹?Ïïno tïïya ŋa na kwäärö wala dïŋut luup bäätwa?› beeye na jääŋ Jwøki na kwäärö ni näk pïëmi, ki køør nyïïatwiel maal mana nyooth dëëre jïgø ya abuŋŋö.
english: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.

anywaa: Ni bwøth jø Icriel wøk ni tïïe ki gïï mo rëëma ec ki ŋïïce yi Ijep, ki bäät Naama Kwaar, ki dï paap ki yïth cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.

anywaa: Ni beeye Modhe manøgø na köö jï jø Icriel, ni ‹Jwøk uuno thïïŋŋe ki nyikuŋ Jwøk røk nyïïmëëgu, kaawat mana thïïŋ aani.›
english: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na nut ya acooŋ Jwøk dï paap, ge ki kwäyø, ki nyïïatwiel maal na cäänö ki eni bäät Kïn Caynay, ni beeye ŋata wëëk luup mo kwøw eni nee mëëk øøni.
english: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:

anywaa: 'Ba kwäyø gena kweer ki man leŋge mare, ni køøge gø kur keere, ni cwïnyge poot manynya Ijep.
english: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,

anywaa: Ni köge ka Aran, ni ‹Tïmï jïïø ki juu nee cääthge nyïmmø. Kiper Modhe manøgø na käl øøni wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, gïna tägö dëëre kuuø.›
english: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

anywaa: Ni tïmge ki kït gïn wø lam mo caala nyirøøa yïth nïrögø ni cïpge ko olämme jïgø, ni mïn yïthge kiper gïïa tïïcge ki ceŋge.
english: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ree aløøe ni wëëk geni lam gïïa thööth na en maal, kaawat mana gööri yi wëël nyïïkuk Jwøk, «na ‹?Aŋø, u na jø Icriel, olämme ki muuce moa cïïmmu ki yïth cwiiri moa näk pïëraŋween dï paap, cïpu jïra na bëëde?
english: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?

anywaa: 'Ba beeye oduŋkaany jwøa cwøl ni Möløk na kääru, ki cëërö mar jwøu ma Reepan, ni beege gïïa tïïyu nee wøørru. 'Ba uuno daaa ŋää Babiløn.›
english: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

anywaa: «'Ba kwäyø oduŋkaany wø køp gïr Jwøk ena jïge dï paap, keda mana caani ya Wuuö Jwøki jï Modhe nee tïïe ki køør gïna neene.
english: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.

anywaa: Ni ö kwäyø ni läwge gø kälö ki Jøcua, kanya macge mïëri moa näk wëëkge oriem Jwøki wøk nyïmge. Ni put bëëte na enøgønø gøøc yïth nïr Deebit,
english: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;

anywaa: ŋata mëër Jwøki ki gø, na pëëö nee tïïe ki kar bëëtö jï Jwø Jeekap.
english: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Cølöman na gëëdö ki øtø jïgø.
english: But Solomon built him an house.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal bäŋ wø bëëdö yïth uudi mo geer ka ceŋ, keda mana caani ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk,
english: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,

anywaa: «ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Maalø beeye wälu mara, ni ö pinynyi ni näk køøm tieta. ?A øda ŋø na dou geerø jïra? ?Wala a kanya ŋø na daa jwöm raa yie?
english: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, paa cera na tïïc japøgø bëët?›
english: Hath not my hand made all these things?

anywaa: «U jø wïthu teek en, nou patha odaŋø ki yïth cwïnynyu ki ïthu en, cooth u wø kweeyø ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere. Keda mana kwøŋ kwäyu tïïc, beeye eni ni tïïyu en thuwø.
english: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.

anywaa: ?A nyikuŋ Jwøk mane na kär caar kwäyu? Geni, jøøa køp ööny ŋata mare beer kanya poode anäkge, 'ba uuni nø, ŋatøgø acïbu ceŋ nyïïmän ni 'nägu gø,
english: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:

anywaa: u na wëëk ciik Jwøk uuni na öö ki køør nyïïatwiet maal, ni käru gø gwøø.»
english: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge gïïögø, gena gootø døc ni kaacge lakge kipere.
english: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.

anywaa: 'Ba Ectipen na cwïnye päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, maal anëëne ni joot ajiem Jwøk, ni Jecu cuŋŋa bäät cwïï Jwøk.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Neennu, maal ajooda ni ree ee jabø, ni Wär Dhaanhø cuŋŋa bäät cwïï Jwøk»
english: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.

anywaa: 'Ba gena rëëdö døc ki dwøl mo päl ni mecge ïthge ni läätge bäät gø bëët.
english: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,

anywaa: Ni peege gø wøk ŋää paac ni këërge gø ki kïte. 'Ba jøøa këër gø, abïïkge awiige buut nyen ma wøp mo nyeŋŋe Cøøl.
english: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pootge ni ge këëra Ectipen, Ectipen alämö, ni kööe, ni «Kwäärö Jecu, lwør jwïëya.»
english: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

anywaa: Ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni kööe ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Kwäärö, kär gïn ni baacge en wiiï bäätge.» 'Ba na nø caan gïnögø, ena thøw.
english: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl ajïëy ki thøw Ectipen. 'Ba dïcäŋöca caarø mo päl atägö dëët jø acooŋ Jwøk moa en yi Jerucalem. Ni ö jiyi ni keethge ni cige wøk bëët yïth mïëc Judia ki Cameria, 'ba beege nyïïatwieli keerge na dööŋ.
english: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba Ectipen akoony jøøa näk cwïnyge ege cïp køør Jwøk, ni jwøkge gø ki jwøk mo dwøŋ.
english: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl acooŋ Jwøk araanynye, ni duunye yïth uudi bëët ni maaŋŋa cwøw ki mään ni kïth geni øt twöc.
english: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa keethø, gena cäädhö ni ge køpa luum Jwøk.
english: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

anywaa: Ni ö Pilipi ni aa pääny Cameria, ni køp gïr Krictø jïge.
english: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.

anywaa: Ni ö lwaae mo døøŋŋø ni cekge ïthge ki cwïny aciel ki luupa caan Pilipi kanya wïnyge pwöc mare ni neenge ŋïïce moa tïïe.
english: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.

anywaa: Kiper juuga reyø aö wøk dëët jiy mo thööth moa näk dëëtge dagø, ni öge wøk ni ge rëëdö ki dwøl mo päl. Ni ö jøøa näk obäpi mo thööth ki ŋööte ni døø dëëtge kwörge.
english: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, met ec mo päl apïï paanøce.
english: And there was great joy in that city.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøce da nyen mør mo nyeŋŋe Cayman, mo okwøŋ tïïö ki tïï ajwøa paanøce, na thääŋ yïth jø Cameria bëët, ni eni wø köö ni ena ŋat mo dwøŋ døc.
english: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

anywaa: Ni cekge ïthge bëët jïre, ni beege jøøa kwörge therø ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ni köge, ni «Ŋatøgø teek mana en jïre beeye teek mar jwø wø cwøl ni Teega Dwøŋ.»
english: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

anywaa: Ni cekge ïthge ki luupe, kiper mana thääŋ yïthge ka ajwønne ki kany mo bäär.
english: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya jïëcge dwør Pilip na køp luumma nyään na met kiper buc Jwøk ki nyeŋ Jecu Krictø, gena lwøk na nyuudhi, na cwøw ki mään.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

anywaa: Këël Cayman manøgø ki dëëre ajïëy ni ŋäädhe. 'Ba køøre na lwøi na nyuudhi, ena put bëëte ni cäädhi ka Pilip. 'Ba na neen ŋïïce ki gïï mo døøŋŋø mo rëëma ec moa tïïc, yie athäŋŋö.
english: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø na wïnynyi ya nyïïatwieli na en yi Jerucalem ni jø Cameria ajïëy ki luum Jwøk, geni Piter ki Jøøn ajääŋge baŋge.
english: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:

anywaa: Ni öge ni lämge kiperge, nee cwïnyge jïtge ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:

anywaa: Kiper Jwïëc Jwøk poot kär ö bäätge, 'ba beeye lwøk keere na nyuudhi ki nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu.
english: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ceŋge acïpge bäätge, ni ci Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere cwïnyge.
english: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya Caymanni ni Jwïëc Jwøk acïp ki køør nyïïatwieli na cïpge ceŋge bäätge, ena kän wøk ki jammi nee mëëk geni.
english: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Mëëgu aani teegøgø thuwø, kiper nee ŋat wäro kïtha cera bääte, nee jïte ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.»
english: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö ki eni, ni «Ränynyï ki japï na aciel, kiper na caarï gø ni muuy mar Jwøk diï joodø ki gwel.
english: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.

anywaa: Ïïni, bäŋ karï man thiinh en ri tïïc man, kiper cwïnyï patha kare nyïm Jwøk.
english: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, løk cwïnyï ki gïnö ni raac ni en cwïnyï enø, ni kwayï Wuuö nee løny ki man wec gïnö ni raac na caarï ki cwïnyï.
english: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

anywaa: Kiper ïïna jooda ni ïïna dhaanhø ma ŋat keec ni ïïno twöö yïth raay.»
english: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.

anywaa: Ni dwøgi ya Caymanni, ni «Kwac Wuuö kipera, nee bäŋe gïrpiny aciel dëët luupa caanï yøø mo ö bääta.»
english: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caange marge ni køpge luum Wuuö, gena døø yi Jerucalem, ni ge cäädhi ni ge køpa luumma nyään na met yïth mïëc Cameria mo thööth.
english: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mør mar Wuuö aköö jï Pilip, «Ö maal, ni ciï nyïm jï løø tier-piny yi jöör wø cør yi Jerucalem ni aa Geedha, ni beeye jööra en dï paap.»
english: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.

anywaa: Ni ö maal ni aae. 'Ba kanyøgø da nyï Ithiöpia mo odïnö mo tïnynya nyijøøa cwøl ni Kandace, ma nyeny jø Ithiöpia, na en jape bëët cere, mo oöö yi Jerucalem kuna wøør Jwøk.
english: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,

anywaa: 'Ba mare døø nø, no opï yi jääy mare man wø tut okweenynyi, ni kwäänö ki luup moa göör nyikuŋ Jwøki ma Aydheea.
english: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.

anywaa: Ni kö Jwïëc Jwøki jï Pilip, ni «Ci baŋ jäänögø.»
english: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Pilip areŋ baŋe ni joot ŋatøgø ni kwäänö ki luup nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea, ni pëëny gø, ni «?Gïïögø ni kwaanï yøø ŋäyï?»
english: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Ŋääa gø kaa, ni näk bäŋ dhaanhø mo nyooth gø jïra?» Ni cwøl Pilip nee eth yi jääy buute.
english: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.

anywaa: 'Ba luupa kwaane yi wëël Jwøk beege ii, ni «Eni dhee käre jaalø, keda diel mo køøla baŋ ŋaal, wala nyidiel mo lïŋö cer ŋat wø nyaar jïëye.
english: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø caange gø, ena jäälge ka ajäla mo patha adïëri. ?Aŋa noo par gïr nyïïkwaaye? Kiper ena ŋul wøk ri kwøw mar bäät piny.»
english: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk odïnö aköö jï Pilip, ni «Caanï jïra, ?aŋa na cään nyikuŋ Jwøki kipere? ?Cäänö kaper dëëre, wala caana gïr ŋat mør bäre?»
english: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Pilip atägö ki man cääne, ni tägi ka wëëllögø ni køp luumma nyään na met mar Jecu jïgø.
english: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääthge, gena pïï kany mo da pïï, ni kö ŋata näk odïnö, ni «Neenï, pïï ii. ?Agïnaŋø noo män aani ki lwøk na nyuudhi?» [37
english: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?

anywaa: Ni kö Pilipi, ni «Ni näk mo ïïno jïëy ki cwïnyï bäre, ï di lwøø.» Ni dwøk gø, ni «Aana jïëy ni Jecu Krictø beeye o Jwøk.»]
Ni jook jääne nee cuŋŋe, ni ïnhge piny ni cige yïth pïï karge riet, Pilip ki ŋata näk odïnö. Ni lwøk gø na nyuudhi.
english: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.

anywaa: 'Ba na duuge wøk ki yïth pïï, Pilip aput Jwïëc Wuuö käl. Ni käri ya ŋata näk odïnö joodø këët. Ni pööth jööre ni yie met.
english: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.

anywaa: 'Ba Pilip ajoot yi Eedhöta, ni cäädhi ni pöötha nyïm ni køpa luumma nyään na met yïth mïëri bëët gøøc mana pïïe yi Cecaria.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl cwïnye poot raac ni manynya man 'näk bääk Wuuö, ni ci baŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ,
english: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,

anywaa: ni pëëny gø ki weeli kiper uut acook lam moa en Damacka, kiper noo näk mo eni jïtö ki jiy mo ena ri Jöör Lam mar Jecu, nee cwøw wala mään, nee ge käl yi Jerucalem ni geno twöö.
english: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba yi wääth mare na tïm kare ni cään ki Damacka, tar aput öö ki maal ni rienye bääte.
english: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:

anywaa: Ni put pädhö ni wïny dwøl ni cäänö ki eni, ni köö, ni «?Cøøl, Cøøl, aŋø ni gëëmï ki aani en?»
english: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Ïïna ŋa, Wuuö?» Ni duu gø, ni «Aana Jecu ni gëëmï ki gøøni enø.
english: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

anywaa: 'Ba ö maal ni ciï pääny; gïno tïïyï ocaan jïrï.»
english: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa cäädhö ki eni gena mak apïte, kiper dwøl wïnyö jïge, 'ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo jootge.
english: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.

anywaa: Ni ö Cøølli maal. 'Ba na jap nyeŋŋe ena tïmö ni ba nëënö. Kiper manøgønø, ena piecge ki cere ni kïthge gø yi Damacka.
english: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

anywaa: Ni bëëde ki nïne adäk ni ba nëënö, ni ba cämö, ni ba mädhö.
english: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.

anywaa: 'Ba da bääŋ aciel yi Damacka mo nyeŋŋe Ananaya. Wuuö acäänö ki eni yïth lääk, ni kööe, «Ananaya.» Ni dwøk gø, ni «Aani en, Wuuö.»
english: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.

anywaa: Ni kö Wuue jïre, ni «Ö maal ni ciï yi øtjöör wø cwøl ni Tiir, ni pëënynyï nyen mør yi øt Juudac mo nyeŋŋe Cøøl ma nyï Tarca. Kiper eni lämö.
english: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,

anywaa: 'Ba yi lam mare, da ŋat mør mo nyeŋŋe Ananaya mo ee joodø ni ööa baŋe ni peeth ceŋŋe bääte kiper nyeŋŋe nee døøge karge.»
english: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk Ananaya, ni kööe, ni «Wuuö, gïï nyenøgø awïnynya dhøk jiy mo thööth, ni gïï mo thööth mo reyø døc ee tïïö dëët jiyï yi Jerucalem.
english: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:

anywaa: Ni eni jïre da teek kany, mo owëëk kwääc laammi eni, man twöc jiy mo wø cøør nyeŋŋï.»
english: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö aköö jïre, ni «Ciï, kiper eni yaa jierø na gïr tïïc mara, nee nyeŋŋa kääre dï juurre ki nyeye ki dï wäät Icriel.
english: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:

anywaa: 'Ba eno nyutha gïï mo thööth mo jwøre jwørø kiper nyeŋŋa.»
english: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Ananaya acøø ni døny yi øtø. Ni peeth ceŋŋe bäät Cøøl, ni kööe, ni «Cøøl, coka, Kwäärö ma Jecu na nyuth dëëre ïïni øtjööra ööï ki gø, aana jääŋŋe nee nyeŋŋï cäŋge døø karge, ni päŋ cwïnyï ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.»
english: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gïï mo caala kwönne aput päth piny ki nyeŋŋe, ni døø nyeŋŋe karge. Ni ö maal ni lwøi na nyuudhi.
english: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.

anywaa: Ni cäme ni tëën dëëre.
english: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cøøl abëëdö ki bääŋi yi Damacka ki nïne mo boop.
Ni put gïr nyeŋ Jecu køp yïth uut acook lam, ni caana gø, ni Jecu beeye O Jwøk.
english: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wïny luumme bëët, yïthge athäŋŋö, ni köge, na «?Aŋø, nyeni en, paa nyena wara raany jiy yi Jerucalem mo wø cøør nyeŋŋøgø? Ni beeye na ö kany nee jøøa jïëy ki Jecu kïth baŋ kwääc laam no otwöö.»
english: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?

anywaa: 'Ba teek Cøøl ree ameede, ni tïm wïth jø Juuthi moa bëëdö yi Damacka ni wïïrö, kiper man wø nyuth gø geni ni Jecu beeye Krictø.
english: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne mo thööth, jø Juuth atïmö ni ge caya man 'näkge Cøøl.
english: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:

anywaa: 'Ba luum 'näk marge atïmö ni ŋäc Cøølli. 'Ba gena tïmö ni ge køya dhøk kiir ki cääŋŋe ki wärre nee eni 'näkge.
english: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

anywaa: 'Ba ena käl bääge ni kïthge gø yi dhwöŋŋö, ni gapge gø wøk ŋää kiir.
english: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl na nø ö yi Jerucalem, ena tïmö ni manynya man dwäte ki bääŋi. 'Ba bääŋi alwäyö bëët ki eni, kiper patha ege jïëö ni ena bääŋ.
english: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.

anywaa: 'Ba ena käl Barnaba ni kïth gø baŋ nyïïatwieli. Kanyøgø gïr luum Cøøl kanya neen Wuuö waŋjöö ni cääne ki eni acaane jïge døøc. Ni caan kanya bëët Cøølli yi Damacka na køp gïr nyeŋ Jecu ni cwïnye da cer.
english: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Cøøl atïmö ni cäädhö dïge yi Jerucalem, ni køp luum Jwøk ki nyeŋ Wuuö ni cwïnye da cer.
english: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Ni cääne ni pïëme ki jø Juuth moa näk odhoom na jø Gïrïïk. 'Ba gena tïmö ni ge caya man 'näkge gø.
english: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö gïnögø na jooti ya nyïïmëëe, ena kïthge Cecaria ni jääŋge gø Tarca.
english: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

anywaa: Kanyøgø acook Jwøk mo Judia bäre, ki Galili ki Cameria, gena bëëdö ki bëët-mëër ni tëënge. Ni ge bëëdö ni ge wøøra Wuuö, ni meetge rege ki køør cøm cwïny mar Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Piterri ni cäädhö dï mïëri, ena ci baŋ jø Jwøk moa näk bëëdö Lida thuwø.
english: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.

anywaa: Ni joot nyen mo nyeŋŋe Aneea, mo obëëdö bäät pëëm ki cwiiri abära no obäp.
english: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

anywaa: Ni kö Piterri jïgø, na «Aneea, ïïna køny Jecu Krictø; ö maal ni jegï pëëmï.» Ni put ö maal.
english: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Lida bëët ki jø Caran ni jootge Aneea, ni løøge rege baŋ Wuuö.
english: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba da bääŋ aciel mo bëëdö Jøpa, mo nyeŋŋe Tabitha, na näk tiere beeye Dørka. Ena nyijø mo wø tïïya gïï mo beyø na ŋat køny.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø ena mak täwi ni thøøe. 'Ba na nø lwøkge dëër gø, apïëlge yi øt pööki mana en maal.
english: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni Lida kare cään ki Jøpa, na wïnynyi ya bääŋi ni Piter ena yie, gena jääk baŋe ki jiy ariiø nee kwacge ki man ö baŋge ni ba ruu.
english: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter aö maal ni cøøe ki ge. 'Ba na pïïe, ena kälge ni kïthge gø yi øt pööki mana en maal. Ni ö määr thuunhnhi bëët ni cuŋge buute ni ge jwöŋö, ni ge nyøtha koothe ka abïïe moa tïïc Dørka kanya poode dïge.
english: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.

anywaa: 'Ba gena wëëk Piterri ciin wøk bëët. Ni ö Piterri ni këël cøŋŋe piny ni läme. Køøre ree aløø baŋ dëër nyijøøgø, ni kööe, ni «Tabitha, ö maal.» Ni ö nyijøøgø ni jap nyeŋŋe. 'Ba na joot Piter, ena ö maal ni bëëde.
english: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni rwaak cere baŋ gø ni tïŋ gø maal. Køøre jø Jwøk acwøle ki määr thuunhnhi, ni käl gø nyïmge no okwøw.
english: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.

anywaa: Ni put gïnögø tïmö ni ŋäc jø Jøpa bëët. Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni jïëcge Wuuö ni ŋääthge gø.
english: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni bëëde yi Jøpa ki nïne mo thööth buut Cayman, ŋat ma dïnyuŋ pëëne.
english: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.

anywaa: 'Ba yi Cecaria da ŋat mo nyeŋŋe Körnilia. Ni ena kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa, lwaa wø cwøl ni lwaa Itali.
english: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

anywaa: Ena dhaanhø mo cwïnye ena køør Jwøk ni wø wøøra gø ki jø paare bëët, ni eni wø muuö ki jap cane jï jiy, ni eni wø bëëdö ni lama Jwøk cooth.
english: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel kar caae adäk ka abøøya, nyïïatwiel maal mør mar Jwøk ajoode døøc ni ööa baŋe ni kööe jïre, ni «Körnilia.»
english: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.

anywaa: Ni raŋ jïgø ni cwïnye obwøk. Ni kööe, na «?Agïnaŋø, Kwäärö?» Ni kö nyïïatwielli jïre, ni «Lam marï ki muuce moï apïï maal na ŋïï nyïm Jwøk.
english: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, jääk Jøpa ki jiy, ni kälï Cayman ni wø cwøl ni Piter.
english: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:

anywaa: 'Ba eni bëëdö ka Cayman mør ma dïnyuŋ pëëne, mo paare ena bäät naama dwøŋ.»
english: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø aac nyïïatwiel maalli mana cäänö ki eni, eni jiy ariiø røk jø tïïc moe acwøle, ki dïkuri aciel mo cwïnye ena køør Jwøk dëët jø wø tïny gø.
english: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan jammi bëët jïge, gena jääŋŋe Jøpa.
english: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, ni ge poot cäädhö ni karge oløny ni cään ki paanøca, Piter aeth maal wï øtø kuna läme, ki kar caae apaar kurriiø ki dïcäŋ.
english: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:

anywaa: Ni jït ree ki käc ni manynya gïn mo came. 'Ba kanya poode ni ge poot jiiŋŋa cam, nyeŋŋe animääw,
english: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,

anywaa: ni neen maal ni ree ee jabø, ni gïn mør mo caala aleeŋŋa mo dwøŋ ööa piny, ni lwär piny no omaa ki dhøge ŋweeni.
english: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

anywaa: 'Ba yie da teeŋ lääy mo thööth, ki thwöre ki weny.
english: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

anywaa: Ni ö dwølli baŋe, ni kööe, ni «Piter, ö maal ni 'nägï ni cämï.»
english: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter aköö, ni «Jïra bäär, Kwäärö, kiper a poot kär cämö ki gïn mør jaak bäre bäre, wala gïn mo ba waany.»
english: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.

anywaa: 'Ba dwøl manøgø acäŋ ö baŋe ri rietge, ni kööe, ni «Gïn mo odøøc Jwøki mo waany, kär cwølï ni gïn mør jaak.»
english: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

anywaa: Gïnögø atägö kwöre adäk, ni puti dwøk maal.
english: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Piterri ni yie othäŋŋö kiper gïna joode ki man näk tiere ŋø, jøøa jääŋ Körnilia oløny ni ge cuŋŋö dhi kal, ni geno nø pëëö, ni «?Po Cayman age?»
english: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

anywaa: Ni cwötge ni ge pëëö ki man näk Cayman ni wø cwøl ni Piter bëëdö kanyøce.
english: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Piterri ni caara wïïe ki lääk, Jwïëc Jwøk aköö jïre, ni «Neenï, jiy adäk caya ïïni.
english: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.

anywaa: Ö maal ni ciï piny ni aayï ki geni ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋï, kiper ge jääŋŋa aani.»
english: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni ci piny baŋ jøøgø ni kööe, ni «Aani en, na cayu. ?Agïnaŋø na ööu kipere?»
english: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Waani, wa jääŋŋa Körnilia ma kwääy jø tøŋ ma dïpa, mo ena dhaanhø mo beer ni lwäär ki Jwøk, ni eni wø pwøc jø Juuthi pwøø bëët. Eni, ena nyuunh nyïïatwiel maalli mør na en kur keere na mar Jwøk kiper nee jääk baŋï niï ööï paare, kiper nee luupo caanï wïnynye.»
english: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena put cwöl yi øtø na wëëlle moe. 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, ena tïŋŋö ni aae ki geni, ni ö nyïïmëëe møøk mo jø Jøpa ni lööpge ki eni.
english: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø maya, gena pïï Cecaria. 'Ba Körnilia lääŋŋa geni, ni tuuŋge bëët ki nyïïawääte ee nø cwøl.
english: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

anywaa: 'Ba na døny Piterri, Körnilia aput ci baŋe, ni päth tiet gø ni wøør gø.
english: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.

anywaa: 'Ba ena tïŋ Piterri maal ni kööe, ni «Ö maal, aani, aana dhaanhø thuwø.»
english: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääne ki gø, ena ci yi øtø ni joot jiy mo thööth mo dëëtge ege cooŋø.
english: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.

anywaa: Ni kööe ki geni, ni «Uuni ki dëëtu, ŋäyu ni ba beer ki køør ciik mowa ki man o ŋat Juuth ni cuuŋe ki juurre møøk wala ki man lïïmme baŋge. 'Ba anyooth Jwøki jïra ni kär dee dhaanhø mo cwøla ni dhaanhø jaak wala ba waany.
english: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na öönnï baŋa, aana öö ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa pëënynyö. 'Ba beeye ni pëëa ennø, na ?Aperŋø na öönnï baŋa?»
english: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?

anywaa: Ni kö Körnilia, ni «Ki køør nïne aŋween moa pöödhö, teeŋ ka kar caanni ennø, naa lämö yi øda kar caae adäk ka abøøya, dhaanhø mør ajooda ni cuŋŋö nyïma ni dëëre da abïï mo tar,
english: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

anywaa: ni kööe, ‹Körnilia, lam marï awïnyö ni ö muuce moï ni ŋäyi ya Jwøki.
english: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jääk Jøpa ni pëënynyï Cayman ni wø cwøl ni Piter. Eni bëëdö øt Cayman mør ma dïnyuŋ pëëne mo paare ena bäät naama dwøŋ.›
english: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.

anywaa: Ni beeye na puta öön baŋï en, ni put tïmö ni beer ni ööï ennø. Ni beeye ni enwa kany en bëët nyïm Jwøk, nee luupa køp Wuuö jïrï bëët nee wïnywa.»
english: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Piter dhee atuue ni kööe, na «Adïëri møn, ajooda ni Jwøk luumme aciel keere kiper jiy bëët.
english: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth mïëri bëët ni näk da ŋat mo wøøra gø ni wø tïïya gïno beer, wø jïëc Jwøki jïëö.
english: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma jääŋ Jwøki baŋ jø Icriel ŋäyu, ni køpa luumma nyään na met mar bëët-mëër ki køør Jecu Krictø, ŋata näk Kwääc jiy bëët,
english: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)

anywaa: luumma køp yi Judia bäre, ni täga yi Galili køør lwøk na nyuudhi mana køp Jøønni,
english: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

anywaa: ki mana ö Jwøki na jør Jecu nyï Nadhareth ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni mooc gø ki teek, ki kanya cäädhe ni tïïya gïï mo beyø, ni køny jøøa näk oraany anägö bëët. Kiper Jwøk ena buute.
english: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.

anywaa: Ni waana lïŋŋe mo japa tïïe bëët yïth mïëc jø Juuth ki yi Jerucalem. 'Ba ena ŋaapge bäät jaadha no odëëdö ni 'näkge gø.
english: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:

anywaa: 'Ba atïŋ Jwøki maal ri dää nïne ni wëëk gø joot.
english: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;

anywaa: 'Ba paa jï jiy bëët, 'ba beeye waani na näk ojier Jwøki na lïŋŋe, wa na cämö ni mäthwa ki eni køør duunne wøk ki yi thøø.
english: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.

anywaa: Ni kööm waani ki man køpwa luummi jï jiy, ni caanwa gø ni beeye eni na jier Jwøki na ŋato ŋøl luup piny mo jøøa kwøw ki mo jøøa näk othøw.
english: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na gïre caan nyïïkuk Jwøki bëët, ni jiy bëët moo jïëy ki eni ni ŋääthge gø, raacge owec ki køør nyeŋŋe.»
english: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Piterri ni caana luupögø, Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere aö bäät jøøa wïny luubö bëët.
english: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøa näk ojïëy dï jøøa näk odaŋø na öö ki Piter na aciel, ni thäŋ yïthge kiper na wëëk Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere juurre thuwø.
english: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: Kiper marge awïnyge ni ge cäänö ki dhøgi møøk ni ge pwøya Jwøk. Kanyøgø Piter acäänö ki ge, ni kööe,
english: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,

anywaa: ni «?Da ŋat mo maar pïï mänö ki man lwøk jøøi na nyuudhi? Geni Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere onø wëëk geni kaamarø!»
english: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?

anywaa: Ni cïpe ki dwøl ni ge lwøk na nyuudhi ki nyeŋ Jecu Krictø. Køøre Piter akwacge ki man bëëde ki geni ki nïne møøk.
english: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø awïny nyïïatwieli ki nyïïmëëe moa en Judia, ni juurre luum Jwøk ege jïëö thuwø.
english: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na døø Piterri Jerucalem ena jääl jøøa näk odaŋø.
english: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,

anywaa: Ni köge, na «?Aŋø na ciï baŋ jøøa näk kär daŋø ni cämï ki geni?»
english: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter atägö ki man caan tier gø jïge, ni kööe,
english: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

anywaa: ni «Kanya ena pääny Jøpa naa lämö, nyeŋŋa animääw ni neena gïn mo caala aleeŋŋa mo ööi ki maal, ni lwära piny no omaa ki dhøge ŋweeni, ni ö baŋa.
english: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:

anywaa: 'Ba na neena gø døøc ki buute, a joota lääy ki cwëënyi, ki thwöre, ki weny.
english: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dwøl ni cäänna aani, ni ‹Piter, ö maal, ni 'nägï ni cämï.›
english: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.

anywaa: 'Ba aana köö, ni ‹Jïra bäär, Kwäärö, kiper poot bäŋ gïn mør jaak wala gïn mo ba waany mo onø ci dhaa.›
english: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.

anywaa: 'Ba acäŋ dwølli manøgø duuö jïra ki maal, ni ‹Gïn mo onø døøc Jwøki mo waany, kär cwølï ni gïn mør jaak.›
english: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.

anywaa: Gïnögø atägö kwöre adäk, ni cäŋ gïïögø tuut maal bëët.
english: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
