anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø kiree, jiy adäk aput pïï dhi øtø mana bëëtwa yie, ni öör baŋa ki Cecaria.
english: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

anywaa: Ni caani ya Jwïëc Jwøki jïra, ni cøøa ki geni ni bäŋ gïn lääŋŋa. Ni ö nyïïmëëe moi na abïciel ii ni lööpge ki aani thuwø, ni ciwa ni dønywa yi øt nyenøca.
english: And the Spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni caan luum nyïïatwiel maal jïwa mana joode ni cuŋŋö yi øde, na köö jïre, ni ‹Jääk Jøpa ni kälï Cayman ni wø cwøl ni Piter.
english: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;

anywaa: Eni luubö mo nyään mano piem ïïni ki køøre ki jø paarï bëët okøbe jïrï.›
english: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya täga ki cäänö, Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere aö bäätge, kaawat mana kwøŋ ö bäätø.
english: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.

anywaa: Ni puta wïïa par ki luum Kwäärö na caane, ni ‹Jøøn löö ka pïï na nyuudhi, 'ba uuno lwøk ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.›
english: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: ?'Ba na nø cïpi ya Jwøki jïge kaawat mana mooc øøni kanya jïëø Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø, aana ŋa nø na doo män mo Jwøk?»
english: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luummögø, gena lïŋö ni jiemge Jwøk, ni köge, ni «Këël juurre thuwø awëëk Jwøki løk cwïny nee kwøw jootge.»
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø jøøa keethø kiper gïïa leth na tägö køør kanya 'näk Ectipen, gena aay gøøc mana pïïcge Pönicia, ki Caypara, ki Antïëk, ni luum Jwøk køpge købø jï jø Juuth keerge.
english: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø møøk dïge ma jø Caypara ki Cayriin mo öö yi Antïëk ni ge cäänna jø Gïrïïk thuwø, ni ge køpa gïr Kwäärö ma Jecu jïge.
english: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Greeks, preaching the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba cer Wuuö ena bäätge. Ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni jïëcge ni løøge rege baŋ Wuuö.
english: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba gïr gïna tägö awïny acooŋ Jwøki mana en Jerucalem. Ni jääŋge Barnaba Antïëk.
english: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïe ni neen gïna tägö ki køør met yi Jwøk, yie amïnnö. Ni pwöny geni bëët døøc ki man bëëtge ni cwïnyge ena køør Wuuö, ni cwïnyge ege maa ni teek.
english: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba eni, ena dhaanhø mo beer, mo cwïnye päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ki ŋäädhe. Ni ö lwaaki mo päl ni løøge rege baŋ Wuuö.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Barnaba aci Tarca kuna cac Cøøl.
english: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

anywaa: 'Ba na joot gø, ena käl Antïëk. Ni cuŋge ka acooŋ Jwøk ki cwiir bäre ni pwönyge jiy mo thööth. 'Ba yi Antïëk beeye kanya kwøŋ bääŋi cak yie ni jø Krictø.
english: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïrögø da nyïïkuk Jwøk mo oöö ki yi Jerucalem ni öge Antïëk.
english: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dïge mo cwøl ni Agaba aö maal ni køp gïna nyooth Jwïëc Jwøki jïre, ni piny bäre jïtö ki meel. 'Ba gïnögø täga ri nïr nyeya ma Kalødia.
english: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

anywaa: Ni ö bääŋi ni jïëcge ki man jääŋge jap køny jï nyïïmëëe moa en Judia, ni ŋati man nø cïpö kaawat mano en cere.
english: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

anywaa: Ni putge gø tïïc, ni jääŋge gø baŋ jaak acooŋ Jwøk, ni käära Barnaba ki Cøøl.
english: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø nyeya ma Eerat cere arwaak dëët jø møøk røk jø acooŋ Jwøk.
english: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.

anywaa: Ni wëëk Jeemeth cöök Jøønni 'näk ko opëëllö.
english: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

anywaa: 'Ba na joot gø ni jø Juuth yïthge met kiper gïna tïïe, ena cäŋ köö ni Piter mak thuwø. 'Ba gïïögø täga yïth nïr Ajwöma Mar Møga Näk Ree Bäŋ Thømmø.
english: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)

anywaa: 'Ba na nø mak Piter, ena kïth øt twöc, ni cïp gø ceŋ jø tøŋ mo wø kurö ni welli na aŋween-aŋween, nee koorge, ni ee cooŋø ki cwïnye ni noo tïme na køør Cäŋ Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, nee käl wøk nyïm jiy.
english: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø Piter awii øt twöc. 'Ba jø acooŋ Jwøk, Jwøk akwaacge døøc kipere ki cwïnyge bäre.
english: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.

anywaa: 'Ba dïwääna ö Eerati na bun man käl Piter wøk ka amöölla, Piter obutö yïthakic jø tøŋ ariiø, no otwöö ko oguudi ariiø, ni dïkuye ena dhi øtø ni ge koora øt twöc.
english: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mør mar Wuuö aput öö, ni ö tarri ni meeny yi øda bëëde yie. Ni gween Piter ki tier-buut gø ni jiec gø, ni kööe, ni «Laar ö maal!» Ni ö oguudi ni päthge piny ceŋŋe.
english: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.

anywaa: Ni kö nyïïatwiel maalli manøgø jïre, ni «Røø abïïgï dëërï, ni kïthï wayï tietï.» Ni tïïc ge. Ni kö nyïïatwielli jïre, ni «Meen aleeŋŋï yiï ni lämmï køøra.»
english: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

anywaa: Ni døny wøk køør gø, ni kuue ni gïna tïïc nyïïatwiel maalli adïëri, 'ba ki baŋe ni mare lääk.
english: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kaalge dïkuye moa dïkwøŋ ki moa en køørge, gena pïï dhi kal mana näk odhuulle nywïënyö, na en jï løø pääny. Ni ö dhi kal manøgø ni jap ree keere jïge, ni dønyge wøk, ni putge pöödhö ni ge caatha jöörögø. Ni puti ya nyïïatwiel maalli wec.
english: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.

anywaa: Ni ö Piterri ni put dëëre ŋäc ni kööe, ni «Kawaane, ajooda na adïëri møn, ni Wuuö nyïïatwiel maal mare ajääŋŋe ni piem aani cer Eerat, ki luupa näk ocooŋ jø Juuthi bëët ki cwïnyge.»
english: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ŋäc gïnögø ki cwïnye, ena aa po Meeri mii Jøønni ni wø cwøl ni Maak, kanya cuŋ jiyi yie mo thööth ni ge lämö.
english: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya dwøŋ dhi kal, nyakøø mo nyeŋŋe Rööda aö kuna neen gø.
english: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.

anywaa: 'Ba na ŋec dwør Piter, yie amïnnö ni put døø ni rïïŋö ni dhi kal käre jabø, ni caan gø ni Piter cuŋŋö dhi kal.
english: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

anywaa: Ni köge jïre, ni «Ïïna bøøl.» 'Ba na nieŋ ri gø ni beeye adïëri, gena köö, ni «Manøgø tïmö ni beeye nyïïatwiel maal mare.»
english: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter poot dööŋö. 'Ba na japge dhi kal, ena jootge ni thäŋ yïthge.
english: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

anywaa: 'Ba Piter cere atïŋ maal ni jooga geni nee lïŋge, ni caan yi jöö mana ö Wuue na käl eni wøk øt twöc ki gø jïge. Ni kööe jïge, ni «Caannu gïn jï Jeemeth ki nyïïmëëe.» Kanyøgø ena aay ni ci kanymør.
english: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, luubö mo ba thiinh apïï dëët jø tøŋ kiper na tøør Piterri.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.

anywaa: 'Ba na cayi ya Eerati ni käre gø joodø, dïkuye atete døøc, ni cïpe ki dwøl ni ge 'näk. Køøre Eerat aaa Judia ni pööth Cecaria, ni bëëde kunöce.
english: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.

anywaa: 'Ba Eerat bëëdö no ogootø ki jø Tayar ki jø Caydan. Ni ö jøøgø baŋe bëët ni rege ege cooŋø. 'Ba na nø kwaacge Balacta na näk nyikuŋ nyeya, na jïëc marge, nyeya akwaacge kiper nee bëëtge ki bëët-mëër. Kiper poge bëënna po nyeya ma Eerat kiper caammi.
english: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dïcäŋa näk ocaanø, Eerat abïïk nyec arøø dëëre, ni pï bäät wälu mare, ni cään geni.
english: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

anywaa: Ni köök jiyi bëët, ni köge, ni «Manøgø beeye dwør jwøk kiree! Patha dwør dhaanhø!»
english: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.

anywaa: Ni puti ya nyïïatwiel maalli mør mar Wuuö gøøc, kiper na käre Jwøk jiemø. Ni ö dëëre ni cami twöŋi ni thøøe.
english: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba luum Jwøk anyaay ni pälle.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø Barnaba ki Cøøl na thöörge tïïge, gena duuö ki yi Jerucalem, ni kuuge Jøøn ni wø cwøl ni Maak.
english: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ya acooŋ Jwøk mana en Antïëk da nyïïkuk Jwøk ki dïpööye, ni beege Barnaba ki Cimien ni wø cwøl ni Najer, ki Lucia ŋat ma nyï Cayriin, ki Manien na piith po kwäärö ma Eerat, ki Cøøl.
english: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

anywaa: Kanya wøørge Wuuö ni ge lämö ki lam-wödö, Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere aköö, ni «Cïbu Barnaba ki Cøøl kur keerge jïra, kiper tïïc mana cöölla geni gø.»
english: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na nø lämge ki lam-wödö, ceŋge acïpge bäätge, ni jääŋge ge wøk.
english: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni ge jääŋŋa Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere, gena aa Celucia, ni lunyge ci Caypara ki jää naam.
english: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge Calami, luum Jwøk akøpge yïth uut acook lam mo jø Juuth. Ni Jøøn ena buutge ni kønya ge.
english: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caathge dï acuullögø bäre ni pööthge Peepa, gena røømmø ki nyen mør ma ajwøa, ma nyï Juuth ma nyikuŋ Jwøk mo patha adïëri, mo nyeŋŋe Bar-Jecu.
english: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar–jesus:

anywaa: Ni eni bëëdö ka kwäärö mo cwøl ni Cerjia Pøøla, nyen mo wïïe leer. 'Ba kwäärö manøgø Barnaba ki Cøøl acwøle ni manynya man wïny luum Jwøk.
english: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ajwønnøgø, na näk nyeŋŋe beeye Elima ki dhi Gïrïïk, luum Cøøl ki Barnaba akwiere, ni manynya man maaŋ wï kwäärö nee ba jïëe.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.

anywaa: 'Ba Cøøl, ni wø cwøl ni Pøøl thuwø, na cwïnye päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, jï ajwønnøgø aneene døøc,
english: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,

anywaa: ni kööe jïgø, ni «Ïïni, ïïna wär anägö, niï män ki moa beyø bëët, ni cwïnyï päŋ ki cwøk, ni ïïna ŋat dïwït. ?Aŋø, gïnögø ba weyï bäre bäre ki man bëëdï niï tïïya uutjïëth Wuuö moa tiir no oköömmö?
english: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, neenï, cer Wuuö ena bäätï, 'ba ïïno tïmö ni ïïna cwør ni cäŋ ba neenï ki nïne møøk.» Kanyøgø rwöc ki muudhö aput ö bääte, ni aae ni thäämmö ni cää ki jiy mo mak cere nee pieyi.
english: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgø kwäärö ajïëy ni ŋäädhe kanya neen gïna tägö. Kiper yie arëëm ki pwöc Wuuö.
english: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Pøøl ki jøøa cäädhö ki eni, gena tïŋŋö ki jää naam ni ge aaya Peepa, ni pïïcge Perga yi Pampilia. 'Ba Jøøn jøøgø awiie ni døø yi Jerucalem.
english: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba gena pöödhö ki Perga ni cige Antïëk yi Picidia. 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö, gena ci øt acooŋ lam ni pïge piny.
english: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na kwaan Ciik Jwøk ki mo Nyïïkuk Jwøk, kwääri mo øt acooŋ lam ajääk baŋge, ni köge, «Nyïïmera, ni näk jïïu da luubö mo dou købø jï jiy, caannu.»
english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Pøøl aö maal, ni tïŋ cere maal ni kööe, ni «U na jø Icriel ki uuni ni wø lwäär ki Jwøk, wïnynyu luumma.
english: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.

anywaa: Jwø jøøi na jø Icriel en beeye na jier kwäyø ni wëëk ge nyaay ni thööth kanya bëëtge yi ŋööm Ijep, ni bwøth ge wøk ki teek mo dwøŋ.
english: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.

anywaa: Ni käär geni ki dï paap ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø nyak wïth juurre abïriiø moa en yi ŋööm Keenan, ŋöömmögø amëëk geni na marge ni bëëtge yie, ni gïïögø bëët akän wøk ki cwiiri mo jïtö ki dïpe aŋween ki pïërabïïc.
english: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he divided their land to them by lot.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør manøgø gena mooe ki kwääri, këël mana këët ri nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Camiel.
english: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre gena pëëö kiper nyeya. Ni ö Jwøki ni cïp Cøøl o Kic jïge, na käl dhi øt Benjamen, ni bëëde na nyeya ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø käl gø wøk, Deebit athïïŋe nee tïme na nyeya jïge, ŋata cääne kipere, na kööe, ni ‹Cwïny Deebit o Jeci ajooda ni ena dhaanhø mo cwïnye ena baŋa, ni beeye ŋato tïïc gïïo manynya bëët.›
english: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.

anywaa: Ni beeye ki røk nyïïkwaac Deebit manøgø na ö Jwøki na käl Pïëmi jï jø Icriel, ni beeye Jecu, kaawat mana kwøŋ gø buuk.
english: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni eni poot kär öö, Jøøn gïr lwøk na nyuudhi mar løk cwïny akøbe jï jø Icriel bëët.
english: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jøønni ni tïme ni thööra tïïc mare, ena köö, ni ‹?Ki jïïu, u wø köö ni aana ŋa? Aani, a patha eni. Jïra bäär, 'ba da dhaanhø mo öö køøra, mo thøøth waye a ba doo mïërö ki man päda ge wøk tiete.›
english: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.

anywaa: «Nyïïmera, u na wäät nyïïkwaac Eeberam, ki jøø ni en dïïu ni wø lwäär Jwøk yøø, beeye øøni na wëëk luum pïëm man piem jiy ki gø.
english: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Jerucalem ki kwääri moge, kiper mana kärge Jecu ŋiiø ni kärge tiet luup moa car nyïïkuk Jwøki kwanyø, ni wø kwari ki yïth nïr jwömö bëët, luupögø awëëkge thur karge ki køør mana ŋølge gø yi thøø.
english: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.

anywaa: Këël na bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo ege joodø mo eni doo rømø ki thøø, geni Paylat apëënyge nee eni 'näk.
english: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø wëëkge gïïa näk ogöörö bëët kipere thur karge, rïŋ dëëre akäl piny ki bäät jaath, ni pïëlli yi bwörö.
english: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.

anywaa: 'Ba atïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø,
english: But God raised him from the dead:

anywaa: ni nyøth dëëre ki nïne mo thööth jï jøøa öö ki eni ki yi Galili na ö Jerucalem. Ni bee geni na lïŋŋe moe jï jiy.
english: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.

anywaa: Ni beeye ni kälwa luumma nyään na met baŋu, ni beeye luumma kwøŋ Jwøki buuk jï kwäyø.
english: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø awëëk Jwøki thur kare røgø, ø na näk nyïïkwaacge, kanya tïŋ Jecu maal. Kaawat mana gööri ri riet Dut Pwøc thuwø, «ni ‹Ïïna wääda, ni dïcäŋi en aana tïmö ni aana wäru.›
english: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.

anywaa: 'Ba luum mana tïŋ gø maal ki yi thøø, ni ba cäŋ døø yi kwääö këët, ena köö na enønø, «ni ‹Gwïëth Deebit na näk adïëri na en kur keere, mëëga ïïni.›
english: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ena cäŋ köö thuwø yi Dut Pwøc kany mørø, «ni ‹Ïïni, dhaanhnhï na en kur keere ba diï wiiø nee kwääö joode.›
english: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.

anywaa: «Kiper Deebit na nø tïïc mo Jwøk yïth cwiiri moe, ena thøw, ni pïëli buut kwäye, ni ö dëëre ni joot kwääö.
english: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:

anywaa: 'Ba eni na tïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø, kwääö käre joodø.
english: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man ŋäyu gø, nyïïmera, ni beeye ŋatøgø ni køp wëën raay ki køøre jïïu en.
english: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køøre no ö jøw ojïëy bëët ni ŋääthge noo pädi yïth jammi bëët moa ba doo maar lønyø jï ciik Modhe ki man pät uuni.
english: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gwøgu rou, kiper nee bäŋe ya gïn mo ö bäätu dëët moa caan nyïïkuk Jwøki, na køp,
english: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;

anywaa: «ni ‹Neennu, u jø ataa, yïthu rëëmge ni ränynyu. Kiper gïn mør otïïa yïth nïne mou, gïn mou ba doo maara jïëy ki gø, ni näk mo køp ŋat mørri købø jïïu.› »
english: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya aacge wøk, gena kwaac jiyi kiper gïïögøøni nee cäŋ caannø jïge cäŋ jwömö mano ööi.
english: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.

anywaa: 'Ba na keeth jiyi øt acooŋ lam, jø Juuth mo thööth, ki jøøa näk dëëtge ege løø na jø Juuth na cwïnyge en køør Jwøk, gena läp køør Pøøl ki Barnaba. Ni ö Pøølli ki Barnaba ni cäänge ki geni ni cøma cwïnyge ki man putge cwïnyge cïp køør met yi Jwøk.
english: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni cäŋ jwömö maya, päl pääny ki kare bäre røkge acooŋge kanya ciel nee luum Wuuö wïnyge.
english: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö jø Juuthi na jootge jiy ni thööth, gena këëyö døc, ni peemge luumma caan Pøølli, ni janyge eni.
english: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl ki Barnaba gena put cäänö døc ni cwïnyge da cer, ni köge, ni «Doo beer ki mana di luum Jwøk caanø jïïu dïkwøŋ. 'Ba kawaane na thanyu gø wøk, ni ŋølu rou wøk nou ba rømi ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, wa luga baŋ juurre nø.
english: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

anywaa: Kiper beeye luumma caan Wuuö jïwa, na kööe, «ni ‹Ïïna thïïŋa niï tïmï ni ïïna tar kiper juurre, kiper nee pïëm man piem jiy ki gø kïthï yi piny kare bäre.› »
english: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö luupögø na wïnynyi ya juurre, yïthge amïnnö ni jiemge luum Wuuö. Ni ö jøøa näk ojier Jwøki bëët kiper kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni jïëcge.
english: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.

anywaa: Ni ö luum Wuue ni nyaae yïth mïëyögø bëët.
english: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth yïth määr wø lämö na näk kwör cwøwge døøŋŋø, ki yïth jaae mo pääny, acoonge, ni tïïge ka ageem dëër Pøøl ki Barnaba, ni riemge ge wøk poge.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.

anywaa: 'Ba geni tør tietge ateeŋge piny paanøgø, ni cige Ayköniem.
english: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.

anywaa: 'Ba bääŋi yïthge amïnnö døc ni cwïnyge päŋ ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba Barnaba ki Pøøl, kanya bëëtge yi Ayköniem, gena døny yi øt acooŋ lam mar jø Juuth, ni pööge, ni ö jiyi mo thööth ni jïëcge ni ŋääthge, ni beege jø Juuth ki jø Gïrïïk.
english: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth moa näk kär jïëy, yïth juurre acoonge ni wëëkge ge männö ki nyïïmëëe.
english: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena bëëdö ki kany mo bäär ni ge køpa gïr Wuuö ni cwïnyge da cer. Ni ö Kwäärö ni nyooth luum met yie na adïëri ki køør ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec na wëëk tïïc ki rege.
english: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

anywaa: 'Ba jø paanøgø dëëtge apääŋge. Ni ö jø møøki ni cige kur jø Juuth, ni ci møøki kur nyïïatwieli.
english: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm juurre ki jø Juuth ki kwääri moge bëët ni ge manynya man tïïge ka ageem nee jøøgø këërge ki kïte,
english: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,

anywaa: awïny jøøgø, ni reŋge Litara ki Derbe mïëc Laykönia, ki mïëya en deŋ paanøgø.
english: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:

anywaa: Ni køpge luumma nyään na met kaace.
english: And there they preached the gospel.

anywaa: 'Ba yi Litara da nyen mo opï piny mo tiete ba maar tuk, ni eni nywöli na puuth, ŋat mo wääth kuue bäre bäre.
english: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

anywaa: Eni ïthe aciie ki dwør Pøøl na cääne. Ni ö Pøølli ni neen jïgø døøc. 'Ba na joot gø ni cwïnye da ŋäädhe man køny eni,
english: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,

anywaa: ena cäännö ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Ö maal ni cuŋŋï ki tietï!» Ni put päny maal ni cäädhe.
english: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa thööth na en kaagø bëët na neenge gïna tïïc Pøølli, döötge atïŋge maal ni köge ki dhi Laykönia, ni «Juu aö piny baŋø ni caala jiy.»
english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.

anywaa: Ni cakge nyeŋ Barnaba ni Dhuc, 'ba Pøøl kiper mana näk ŋat wø cäänö, nyeŋ gø acakge ni Eermec.
english: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääy lammi mar jwøa cwøl na Dhuc, na näk øt lam mare ena nyïm pääny, ni kïth dhøk kiir ki rwädhe ki ïth jenni mo oŋøøk ni mïërö, ni eni manynya man 'näk rwädhe moøgø no olämme jï Barnaba ki Pøøl nyïm jiy.
english: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø na wïnynyi ya Barnaba ki Pøøl, ge na näk nyïïatwieli, abïïkge ajeecge ni reŋge dï lwaak, ni ge rëëdö,
english: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,

anywaa: ni «?Jaay, aŋø ni tïïyu gïnögø? Waani, waana jiy thuwø mo caala uuni, ni wa käla luumma nyään na met jïïu, kiper nee gïïö no oballe yøø nee weyu, ni løøu dëëtu baŋ Jwøa kwøw na cwääc maal ki piny, ki näm ki jammi bëët moø ni en yïthge yøø.
english: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:

anywaa: Kiper yïth cwiiri moa pöödhö, Jwøk mïëri bëët awëëk bëëtö kaawat mana manyge.
english: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk enøgønø, eni kär bëëdö ni dëëre käre nyoodhø. Kiper ena tïïö ki gïï mo beyø; eni køth wø jääŋŋe jääŋŋö jïïu ki maal, ni cïpe jïïu ki kwör ciek caammi mou yie yi cwiir, ni wëëk cwïnynyu mïnnö ki caammi mou, ni bëëdu ni yïthu met.»
english: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na carge luupögøøni, gïïa dege nääö jïge no olämme, bøth ka kany mo thiinh.
english: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø Juuth møøk mo oö kanyøgø mo käla yi Antïëk ki Ayköniem. 'Ba na nø coonge yïth jiy, Pøøl akëërge ki kïte, ni jwaage gø wøk ŋää paac, ni ege caarø no othøw.
english: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö bääŋi na cooŋge dëëtge buute, ena ö maal, ni ci paac ki geni na aciel. 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man, ena aa Derbe ge ki Barnaba.
english: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø køpge luumma nyään na met paanøce, ni tïïcge jiy mo thööth na bääŋi, gena døø Litara, ni pööthge Ayköniem ki Antïëk,
english: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,

anywaa: ni ge cøømma cwïny bääŋi, ni köömge geni døøc ki man putge bëëtö ri ŋäädhe. Ni ge cara gø, ni «Ki yïth gïï mo leth mo thööth moo jwørø beeye noo dønynyø buc Jwøk.»
english: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kwänyge ki jaae yïth acook Jwøk bëët ki køør lam ki wödö, gena wiige cer Wuuö, ŋata jïëcge ni ŋääthge.
english: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.

anywaa: Køøre gena cør yi Picidia ni öge Pampilia.
english: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caange luum Jwøk yi Perga, gena pööth Atalia.
english: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:

anywaa: Ni tïŋge kaace ki jää naam ni ge cøøa Antïëk, kanya kwøŋ geni cïp cer met yi Jwøk kiper tïïc manøgø na thöörge enø.
english: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge, acooŋ Jwøk bäre acooŋge kanya ciel, ni køpge gïïa tïïc Jwøki ki rege, ki kanya jap øtjöör ŋäädhe jï juurre.
english: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.

anywaa: Ni putge bëëtö ki bääŋi ki kany mo bäär.
english: And there they abode long time with the disciples.

anywaa: 'Ba da jø møøk mo oöö ki yi Judia, ni ge pwönynya nyïïmëëe, ni köge, ni «Ni näk mou ba daŋ ki køør kööŋŋö mana caan Modhe, u ba doo mara piem.»
english: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø jït Pøølli ki Barnaba ki pïëm mo ba thiinh ni ge løøŋŋa luummögø ki jøøgø, gena kwany ki jø møøk nee cige yi Jerucalem baŋ nyïïatwieli ki jaak acooŋ Jwøk, nee tier luummögø neenge.
english: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

anywaa: Køøre gena aay ni ge jääŋŋa acooŋ Jwøki, ni cørge Pönicia ki Cameria ni ge caana luum løk røk mar juurre, ni ö cwïny nyïïmëëe mo thööth ni døøcge ge mo met.
english: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïc Pøølli ki Barnaba yi Jerucalem, gena pänh acooŋ Jwøki, ki nyïïatwieli, ki jaae. Ni køpge jammi bëët moa tïïc Jwøki ki rege.
english: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk moa näk ojïëy dëët jø Paricith gena ö maal, ni köge, ni «Manynya gø nee juurre daŋ, ni kööm geni ki man gwøkge ciik Modhe.»
english: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïatwieli ki jaae rege acooŋge kanya ciel kuna løøŋge tier luummögø.
english: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na nø manyge tier luummögø ki kany mo bäär, Piter aö maal, ni kööe jïge, ni «Nyïïmera, ŋäyu ni yïth cwiiri moa pöödhö, Jwøk aana jiere dïïu, nee luumma nyään na met wïny juurre dhaa, nee jïëcge.
english: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ni wø ŋäc cwïny, mare anyoodhe na adïëri kanya wëëk Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere geni, kaawat mana tïïe jïïø.
english: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ajeeny mo ee tïïö yïthakiyø ki geni, 'ba cwïnyge adøøc mo waany ki køør ŋäädhe.
english: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.

anywaa: ?Kiper manøgønø, aŋø ni päänynyu Jwøk en, nou manynya man kïthu ŋut bääŋi ki gïn mo caala jaath puur man wø rïï ŋut rwaath, gïna näk kär løny jï kwäyø wala øøni ki man tïëti?
english: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

anywaa: 'Ba yøø ŋäädhø ni øøno piem ki køør met yi Kwäärö ma Jecu, kaawat marge.»
english: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.

anywaa: Ni ö acooŋa bäre ni lïŋe. Ni cekge ïthge jï Barnaba ki Pøøl kanya caange luum ŋïïce ki gïï mo rëëma ec moa tïïc Jwøki ki rege dï juurre.
english: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.

anywaa: Køøre na lønyge ki cäänö, Jeemeth ajutö, ni kööe, ni «Nyïïmera, wïnynyu mara.
english: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:

anywaa: Luum kanya ö Jwøki dïkwøŋ na liim juurre, nee kwänye dïge ki jiy kiper nyeŋŋe, acaan Caymanni jïïu.
english: Simon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.

anywaa: 'Ba luup nyïïkuk Jwøk ojïëy ki manøgø thuwø, kaawat mana gööri,
english: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,

anywaa: «ni ‹Køør man, aano duui, ni cäŋa wï po Deebit mana no opädhö geerrø, ni cäŋa gïna näk oränynyö geerrø, ni dwøga gø kare.
english: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:

anywaa: Kiper nee jiy møga bëët nee Wuuö manyge, ki juurre bëët moa näk nyeŋŋa ocaa rege.
english: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.

anywaa: Luupögø caana Wuuö Jwøki, ŋata døøc jammi bëët mo ŋäc cøøn.›
english: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, luumma na ŋøla piny beeye en: Øøni, doo beerra man ba kierø wïth juurre këët mo wø luk baŋ Jwøk.
english: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:

anywaa: 'Ba ø doo gööta baŋge nee bëëtge ni karge bäyö ki jap juu na reyø, ni wecge käp, ni ba cämge ki gïn mo odeeø, ki remø.
english: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

anywaa: Kiper ki mana täge ya acääŋŋe cøøn Modhe jïre da jiy yïth mïëri bëët mo wø køp gïre. Kiper luumme wø di kwaanø yïth nïr jwömö bëët yïth uut acook lam.»
english: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwieli, ki jaae, ka acooŋ Jwøk bäre yïthge atïmö ni met ki man jëëtge ki jiy dïge, nee jääŋge Antïëk ki Pøøl ki Barnaba na aciel. Ni jääŋge Juudac ni wø cwøl ni Barcaba, ki Cayla, jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø dï nyïïmëëe.
english: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:

anywaa: Ni ge käära wëëlö mo ogöörö na ennø nø, ni «Waana nyïïatwieli ki jaak acooŋ Jwøk ni määth uuni en, u na nyïïmëëe ma juurre, u na en yi Antïëk, ki Ciria, ki Cilicia.
english: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:

anywaa: «Awïnywa ni da jø møøk dëëtwa mou ege öölö ni ge kiera wïthu, këël na kärwa geni luummö.
english: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, yïthwa atïmö ni met ya acooŋa marwa ki man jëëtwa ki jiy nee jääŋwa baŋu, nee löömge ko omëëyø ma Barnaba ki Pøøl,
english: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

anywaa: jøøa taak jwïëcge kiper nyeŋ Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Juudac ki Cayla ajääŋwa baŋu, jøw okøp luupögø jïïu thuwø ki dhøkge.
english: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.

anywaa: Kiper atïmö ni beer jï Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ki jïwa thuwø, ki man ba öölwa uuni ki gïï mo thööth, 'ba beege gïï ii keerge na doo beer kiperu,
english: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;

anywaa: ki man bëëdu ni karu bäyö ki gïï mo onää jï juu, ki cam remø, ki gïn mo odeeø, ki käp. Ni näk dëëtu you gwøø ki gïïögø, maru doo beer. Tuuru nø.»
english: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.

anywaa: Køøre na nø jääŋ geni, gena aa Antïëk. 'Ba na nø cooŋge jø acooŋa kanya ciel, wëëllögø acïpge.
english: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

anywaa: 'Ba na kwaange gø, yïthge amïnnö ki dwøl manøgø.
english: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.

anywaa: 'Ba Juudac ki Cayla na näk nyïïkuk Jwøk thuwø, nyïïmëëe acäänge ki luup mo thööth ni cømge cwïnyge.
english: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø bëëtge ki nïne møøk, gena tïŋŋö ni jiethi ya nyïïmëëe ki mëër, ni døøge baŋ jøøa jääŋ geni. [34
english: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö ni beer jï Cayla ki man bëëde kaace.]
'Ba Pøøl ki Barnaba gena dööŋ yi Antïëk, ni ge pöö ni køpa luum Wuuö, ge ki jiy møøk mo thööth thuwø.
english: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne møøk, Pøøl aköö jï Barnaba, ni «Beerra man døø kuna liimmø nyïïmëëe yïth mïëri bëët, kwöra købø luum Wuuö yïthge, nee neenø wala ge bëëtge nidïï.»
english: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.

anywaa: 'Ba Barnaba atïmö ni manynya Jøøn man wø cwøl ni Maak nee aae ki geni na aciel.
english: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

anywaa: 'Ba acaar Pøølli ni ba doo beer ki man kälge ŋata kwøŋ aay buutge yi Pampilia, ni käre ci baŋ tïïc ki geni.
english: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.

anywaa: Ni jït yïthakicge ki pïëm mo teek ni pääge. Ni ö Barnaba ni aacge ki Maak na aciel, ni cige Caypara ki jää naam.
english: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl Cayla ajiere ni aae, ni geno cïp nyïïmëëe cer met yi Wuuö.
english: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.

anywaa: Ni caath dï Ciria ki Cilicia, ni wëëk acook Jwøk tëënnö.
english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl ki Cayla gena öö Derbe ki Litara thuwø. 'Ba kaace da bääŋ mo nyeŋŋe Timöthi, ma o nyakøøn jø Juuth mo ojïëy. 'Ba wänni ŋat Gïrïïk.
english: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

anywaa: Ni eni ŋäc nyïïmëëe moa en Litara ki Ayköniem ni ena dhaanhø mo beer.
english: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl manynya Timöthi nee cäädhe ki eni na aciel. Ni käl gø ni daŋ gø kiper nyeŋ jø Juuth moa en kwörögø, kiper ŋäcge bëët ni wänni ŋat Gïrïïk.
english: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääthge dï mïëri, luup moa ŋøl nyïïatwieli ki jaak acooŋ Jwøk yi Jerucalem akøpge jïge nee gwøkge.
english: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, acook Jwøk atëënnö ki ri ŋäädhe, ni ö jiyi ni bëëtge ni meeta rege ki yïth cääŋŋe bëët.
english: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.

anywaa: Ni ö Pøølli ki jøøa en buute ni caathge yïth mïëc Parijia ki Galeecia, kiper mana mäni ya Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere ki man køpge luum Jwøk yi Eecia.
english: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge Micia, gena tïmö ni ge manynya man cige Bithinia, 'ba gena män Jwïëc Jecu.
english: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena pöödhö ki buut Micia ni cige Tarööa.
english: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.

anywaa: Ni ö Pøølli ni läge ki wäär, kee da dhaanhø ma nyï Macedönia mo cuŋŋö ni kwaaya gø, ni köö, ni «Ö yi Macedönia, ni kønyï wa.»
english: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør lääk, waana put tïmö ni wa manynya man ciwa Macedönia, ni ewa caarø ni wa cwøla Jwøki ki man køpwa luumma nyään na met jïge.
english: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, waana tïŋŋö Tarööa ki jää naam ni putwa pööth Camöthareci. 'Ba na tïme na aruunnø man waana ci Niepöli.
english: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;

anywaa: Ni pööthwa Pilipay ki kaace, paana dwøŋŋa eni yi Macedönia, ni beeye paana daa jø Römmi møøk yie. Ni bëëtwa paanøgø ki nïne møøk.
english: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na cäŋ jwömö, waana døny wøk ŋää kiir ni ciwa bäät naam, ni ewa caarø ni waano jïti ki kar lam kaace. Ni pïwa piny ni cäänwa mään mo rege ege cooŋ kanya ciel.
english: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø aciel dïge mana wïny luumwa beeye nyijø mo nyeŋŋe Lidia, ma nyijø pääny Thayatira, mo wø gädhö ka abïïe ma wøpe, ŋat mo wø bëëdö ni wøøra Jwøk. Eni cwïnye ajap Wuue, ni cek ïthe ki luupa caan Pøølli.
english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na nø lwøk dëëre na nyuudhi ki jø paare bëët, waana kwaae, ni kööe, ni «Ni näk you ŋäädhö ni aano jïëy ki Wuuö na adïëri, ööu, ni bëëdu paara.» Ni ö eni ni käre wa wiiø.
english: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääthwa ni wa cøøa kar lam, waana røømmø ki nyakøø ma laŋŋø mo dëëre da jwøk mo raac mo wø dëëdö ki jammi, ni eni wø kännö ki jammi mo thööth jï jøøa bëënne ki køør adïëda mare.
english: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:

anywaa: 'Ba ena läm køør Pøøl ki waani ni rëëdö, ni köö, ni «Jøøi ii beege jø wø tïny Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en Maal, ni ge køpa luum jöör pïëm man piem jiy ki gø jïïu.»
english: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.

anywaa: Ni put gïnögø tïïc ki nïne mo thööth. 'Ba Pøøl yie acwat, ni løk ree ni cään jwøa raac na en dëër nyakøønnøgø, na «A köömma ïïni ki nyeŋ Jecu Krictø, ö wøk dëëre!» Ni put ö wøk dëër gø yi caannøca.
english: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya jøøa bëënne ni japa wara ŋääthge otïmö ni bäŋgø, geni Pøøl ki Cayla amakge ni peege ge kar gath nyïm kwääri.
english: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kälge geni nyïm kwääri, gena köö, ni «Jøøi ii beege jø Juuth na öö ni ge raanynya pøø en.
english: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

anywaa: Ni ge pwönynya jiy ki kööŋŋe mo ba doo beer kiperø, ø na jø Röm, ki man jïëø geni wala man tïïø ge.»
english: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa thööth na en kaace gena dwätö ki jøøgø ni ge manynya man pwötge geni. Ni ö abïïkge ni cöödi ya kwääri wøk dëëtge, ni cïpge ki dwøl nee ge pwöt ka athøre.
english: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø pwötge geni ki pöödö mo päl, gena leeŋge øt twöc, ni köömge kwääy øt twöc nee ge gwøe døøc.
english: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely:

anywaa: 'Ba na nø wïny luummögø døøc, gena kïth yi øtø mana en dï øt twöc, ni rwaak tietge yïth orøge.
english: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na dï wäär, Pøøl ki Cayla gena lämö ni wärge ki dudi jï Jwøk. 'Ba jøøa näk otwöö, ïthge acekge jïge.
english: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø piny ree aput jäŋ døc. Ni tïm dëër øt twöci ni kwanynyi. Ni ö dhøk odhuule bëët ni putge rege jap, ni ö gïïa näk jø twöc otwöö ki ge bëët ni pätge rege.
english: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

anywaa: 'Ba na päc kwääy øt twöci ni neen dhøk odhuule bëët ni ŋammø, opëëllö mare awöth wøk ni manynya man 'näk dëëre, kiper ki baŋe ni jø twöc bëët onø päär wøk.
english: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl acwötö ki dwøl mo päl, ni kööe, ni «Kär dëërï nyäägï, kiper wa nutö bëët!»
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.

anywaa: Ni ö nyenøgø ni cwöte ki lambae ni reŋ yi øt twöc, ni leeŋ ree piny nyïm Pøøl ki Cayla, ni dëëre kwanynyi ki lwär.
english: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,

anywaa: Ni käl geni wøk ni kööe, ni «?Jaay, agïnaŋø noo tïïa naa piem?»
english: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

anywaa: Ni løkge gø, ni «Jïëyï ki Kwäärö ma Jecu ni ŋääthï gø. Ïïno piem ki jø paarï bëët.»
english: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.

anywaa: Ni køpge luum Wuuö jïre, ki jøøa en paare bëët.
english: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääy øt twöci ni käl geni wøk wäänögø yi caannøca kiree, ni peny ŋwiili moa en dëëtge. Ni put dëëre lwøk na nyuudhi, ki jø paare bëët.
english: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.

anywaa: Køøre gena kïth øde ni mooc geni ki cam. Ni mïn yie ki jø paare bëët, kiper na jïëe ki Jwøk ni ŋääth gø.
english: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na amöölla, kwääri dïkuye ajääŋge, ni köge, ni «Jøøgø wär wec nee aacge.»
english: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.

anywaa: Ni ö kwääy øt twöci ni caan luupögø jï Pøøl, ni kööe, ni «Kwääri aöönnö, nou wec ni aayu. Kiper manøgønø, ööu wøk ni aayu ki met ec.»
english: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl aköö jïge, ni «Waana pwötge jaak nyïm jiy ni bäŋ ajäla dëëtwa, wa na näk wäät thwöth Röm, ni leeŋge wa øt twöc. ?Aŋø, kawaane wa dege cööra wøk jaak ni ege mooŋø? Jïwa bäyö. Beerra man öge ki dëëtge ni kälge waani wøk.»
english: But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privily? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out.

anywaa: 'Ba dïkuye luupögø adwøkge baŋ kwääri. 'Ba na wïnyge gø ni gena wäät thwöth Röm, gena lwäyö.
english: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

anywaa: Kanyøgø gena öö ni kwaacge ge nee cwïnyge cïpge piny. Ni kälge geni wøk ni pëënyge geni nee aacge paanøgø.
english: And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city.

anywaa: Køøre gena ö wøk ki øt twöc, ni cige po Lidia. 'Ba na nø neenge nyïïmëëe, gena luumge døøc ni aacge.
english: And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Pøøl ki Cayla na nø kaalge Ampipöli ki Apölönia, gena pïï Thecalönika, kanya näk da øt acooŋ lam mar jø Juuth.
english: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:

anywaa: Ni ö Pøølli ni ci yie kaawat man wø bëëde cøøn. Ni thöödhe ki nïr jwömö adäk ni eni lama tier luupa en yïth weet Jwøk ki geni.
english: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,

anywaa: Ni para tier gø ni nyootha gø jïge ni Krictø ba doo kääŋö ki man jwør gïï mo leth ni tïŋi maal ki yi thøø. Ni cara gø, ni «Jecu man en ni køba jïïu en beeye Krictø.»
english: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba møøk dïge gena jïëy ni dwätge ki Pøøl ki Cayla. 'Ba jø Gïrïïk mo thööth moa näk cwïnyge ege cïp køør Jwøk, gena jïëy thuwø, ki mään mo ba nøk moa näk kwör cwøwge døøŋŋø.
english: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth akëëyö, ni kwanyge jak mo reyø ni cuŋge ki lwaak, ni wëëkge pääny niïïk, ni tiekge øt Jeecan, ni ge manynya man kälge Pøøl ki Cayla wøk baŋ jiy.
english: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.

anywaa: 'Ba na kärge geni joodø, Jeecan ki nyïïmëëe møøk apeege nyïm kwääy pääny, ni ge rëëdö, ni ge köö, ni «Jøøi ii na jal piny gena ö kany en thuwø,
english: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;

anywaa: ni pänhnhi ya Jeecanni. Ni ge gëëmö karge bëët ri ciik Cidhar, ni ge köö, ni da nyeya mør ma Jecu.»
english: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy ki kwääy pääny na wïnyge luummögø, gena niïïk.
english: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø kätge ki dïgïti baŋ Jeecan ki jø møga, gena wëëkge wääth.
english: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïmëëe ni putge Pøøl ki Cayla jääŋ Beria ki wäär. 'Ba na pïïcge kaace, gena ci yi øt acooŋ lam mar jø Juuth.
english: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth moøgø theemma geni ki moa en Thecalönika, kiper gena laar jïëy ki luum Jwøk, ni bëëtge ni ge raŋŋa luup moa en yïth weet Jwøk cooth ki man näk mo luupögø adïëri.
english: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jiy mo thööth dïge gena jïëy ni ŋääthge, ki määr jø Gïrïïk mo ba nøk moa näk kwör cwøwge døøŋŋø, ki cwøw thuwø.
english: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Juuth mo Thecalönika, na wïnyge gø ni luum Jwøk okøp Pøølli yi Beria thuwø, gena ci kaace, ni coonge yïth jiy ni wëëkge lwaae niïïk.
english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïmëëe Pøøl aputge jääŋŋö bäät naam. 'Ba Cayla ki Timöthi, gena dööŋ kaace.
english: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timothy abode there still.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa jieth Pøøl, ena kälge këël mana pïïcge ya Athen. Ba na nø cek jøøgø nee Cayla ki Timöthi nee laarge ö baŋe, gena døøk.
english: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed, they departed.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Pøølli ni koora Cayla ki Timöthi ya Athen, cwïnye apädhö kanya joot paac ni päŋ ki juu.
english: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ena bëëdö ni pïëmö ki jø Juuth ki jøøa cwïnyge en køør Jwøk yi øt acooŋ lam. Ni eni wø pïëmö cooth ki jø wø en kar gath ki jø wø cäädhi kaagø.
english: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk thuwø dëët jø acaara mo Epikurien ki jø acaara mo Ectöik arøømmø ki eni. Ni kö jø møøki, na «?Agïnaŋø ni wø caan ŋati na ŋat dïlweel en?» 'Ba møøk aköö, «Eni nëëni kee pwönynya jiy ki teeŋ juu møøk,» kiper na køp luumma nyään na met mar Jecu ki mar duun wøk ki yi thøø.
english: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

anywaa: Ni makge cer Pøøl ni kälge gø ya Ariøpaga, ni köge, «?Pwöc man ni nyään ni pööï ki gø enø, løny ki man caanï gø jïwa?
english: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?

anywaa: Kiper ïïna kännö ki luubö mo nyään baŋwa, mo kärwa kwøŋ wïnynyö cøøn. Kiper manøgønø, wa manynya man ŋäcwa tiet luupögø.»
english: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Athen bëët ki jøøa path mo wø bëëdö kaace, cääŋŋe bëët wø thöörge ni ge cara luup mo nyärö ni wïnynya moge.
english: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)

anywaa: Kanyøgø Pøøl acuŋŋö dï Ariøpaga ni kööe, ni «Jø Athen, ajooda nou cara nyeŋ Jwøk ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

anywaa: Kiper kanya caadha dïïu ni neena lam maru, kar jëëdhi mør ajooda ki luubö mo ogöörö na ennønø dëëre, ni ‹Jï jwøk mo kuc.› Kiper manøgønø, gïna lammu ni kuyu beeye ni køba jïïu en.
english: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

anywaa: Jwøk na cwääc piny ki jammi bëët moi ni en yie en, na näk Kwääy maal ki piny, bäŋ wø bëëdö tiet arïëki mo tïïya dhaanhe.
english: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;

anywaa: Ni eni ba tïny jiyi ki ceŋge, kee da gïn manynye, kiper bee eni ki dëëre ni wø cïp kwøw jï jiy bëët, ki jwïëy, ki jammi bëët.
english: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

anywaa: Ni eni wïth juurre bëët tïïe ka dëër dhaanhø aciel, nee bëëtge bäät piny bäre, ni cïp nïr bëëtö jïge ki nyeŋ keee mo kwör bëëte moge,
english: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;

anywaa: kiper nee Jwøk manyge; kanymør ojootge ri thäämmö marge. 'Ba eni kare ba bäär ki øøni bëët.
english: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

anywaa: Kiper « ‹beeye eni ni kwøø kipere en, ni cäädhø, ni nudø en,› kaawat mana caani ya lööŋe møøk dïïu, «ni ‹Øøna nyïïe møn.›
english: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane kiper mana nägø nyïï Jwøk, ba døø caarø ni Jwøk caala warkey, wala gwel-bïrö, wala kïdi, na gïn wø tieŋ dhaanhe ni ee päärö ki gïn mo ee caarø ki wïïe ki køør riek waŋ mare.
english: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

anywaa: Kanya poot dhaanhe ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe, Jwøk abëëdö ni cwïnye ee cïp piny. 'Ba kawaane eni jiy bëët aköömme ki man løkge cwïnyge yi piny bäre.
english: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:

anywaa: Kiper da cäŋ mo ee nø jier, cäŋo ŋøl luup mo piny yie ka adïëri ki køør ŋata näk ee jierø. Ni manøgø ee nø nyuth jiy bëët nee ŋäcge na adïëri, ki køør mana tïŋ ŋatøce maal ki yi thøø.»
english: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø na wïnyge luum duun wøk ki yi thøø, ena buu jø møøki. 'Ba møøk aköö, ni «Luummögø ocäŋwa wïnynyö baŋï.»
english: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Pøøl aput aa wøk dïge.
english: So Paul departed from among them.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk adwätö ki eni ni jïëcge. 'Ba Dayönicia ŋat Ariøpaga ena dïge ki dhaagø mo nyeŋŋe Damari, ki jø møøk.
english: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgø Pøøl Athen awiie ni ci Körin.
english: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth;

anywaa: Ni joot ŋat Juuth mør mo nyeŋŋe Akwila ma nyï Pønta, ni beeye öönynye ki po jø Itali ki cïïe ma Paricila, kiper nyeya ma Kalødia ocïpö ki dwøl, ni jø Juuth bëët aage wøk ki yi Röm. Ni ci Pøølli kuna neen geni.
english: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk mo gena jiy mo ge tïïya teeŋ tïïc aciel, ena bëëdö ki geni ni ge tïïö. Kiper tïïa tïïcge, gena dïkwöc oduŋkaare.
english: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

anywaa: Ni eni wø pïëmö øt acooŋ lam yïth nïr jwömö bëët, ni cøga jø Juuth ki jø Gïrïïk.
english: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïc Cayla ki Timöthi ki yi Macedönia, Pøøl acwänge ni køpa luum Jwøk, ni cäänna jø Juuth ni Krictø beeye Jecu.
english: And when Silas and Timothy were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba na kwierge luumme ni janyge eni, abïïge akenye, ni kööe jïge, ni «Remø maru odööŋ wïthu. A tøør yie. Køør man ennø, a cøøa baŋ juurre.»
english: And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.

anywaa: Ni aae kaace, ni ci øt nyen mo nyeŋŋe Tayta Jacta, ŋat mo bëëdö ni wø lama Jwøk, mo øde ena buut øt acooŋ lam.
english: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

anywaa: 'Ba Karicpa na näk kwääy øt acooŋ lam ajïëy ki Wuuö ni ŋääth gø ki jø paare bëët. Ni ö jø Körinni mo thööth ni wïnyge luum Pøøl, ni jïëcge ni lwøk geni na nyuudhi.
english: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ki wäär Wuuö acäänö ki Pøøl yïth lääk, ni kööe, ni «Kärï lwäyö. Cäänï, ni ba lïŋï.
english: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:

anywaa: Kiper aani, a nutö buutï, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo ï dee røødhø mo tïïö dëërï ki gïn mo raac. Kiper jïra da jiy mo thööth yi paani en.»
english: For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.

anywaa: Ni put bëëte ki cwiir aciel ki dwäde abïciel, ni pöö ki luum Jwøk dïge.
english: And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëët Galliø na kwäärö mar Akeea, jø Juuth adwätö ni makge Pøøl ni kälge gø kar løøk.
english: And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Nyeni en, cøga jiy nee Jwøk lamge ki jöö mo ba en ri ciik Jwøk.»
english: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya tïm Pøølli ni manynya man jaal dhee, Galliø aköö jï jø Juuth, no «Onää u käla luum gïn mo obøth wala gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö ennø, kanymør ïtha daa ciiø ki luummu, u na jø Juuth.
english: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na luum pïëc kiper luup ki nyeŋŋi, ki luum ciik Jwøk maru, neennu yie keeru. Aana kweer ki man ŋøla luupögø piny.»
english: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

anywaa: Ni riem ge wøk ki kar løøk.
english: And he drave them from the judgment seat.

anywaa: Ni cige bëët ni makge Cøtheni na näk kwääy øt acooŋ lam, ni pwötge gø nyïm kar løøk. 'Ba Galliø bäŋ gïn mo ee caanø kiper gïnögø.
english: Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things.

anywaa: 'Ba køør manøgønø, Pøøl aruu yi Körin ki nïne møøk mo thööth. Køøre ena tïŋŋö buut nyïïmëëe ni aa Ciria ki jää naam. Ni Paricila ka Akwila cäädhi ka eni na aciel. 'Ba kanya jöök Cencure, jïëye agwäär wøk, kiper kööŋ mana kööŋe ki gø.
english: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcge Epeca, gena wii kaace. 'Ba eni ki dëëre adøny yi øt acooŋ lam ni pïëme ki jø Juuth.
english: And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pëënyge eni ki man bëëde ki geni dïciel, eni kär jïëy.
english: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

anywaa: 'Ba na tïŋŋe buutge, ena köö, ni «Aano duu baŋu noo kö Jwøki.» Ni tïŋŋe yi Epeca ki jää naam.
english: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïe Cecaria, ena cøø ni määth acooŋ Jwøk. Køøre ena ci Antïëk.
english: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

anywaa: 'Ba na thöödhe ki nïne møøk kaace, ena aay ni cäädhe ni gaa paani nø ni ci paani nø yïth mïëc Galeecia ki Parijia, ni eni cøømma cwïny bääŋi bëët.
english: And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples.

anywaa: Kanyøgø da ŋat Juuth mør mo nyeŋŋe Apøla mo oöö ki Alekdhandaria, ni ö yi Epeca. Eni, ena ŋat mo ŋäc cäänö, ni luup moa en yïth weet Jwøk ŋääe døøc,
english: And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus.

anywaa: ni eno pwönynyö ki jöör Wuuö. 'Ba kiper na en cwïnye køør gø, eni wø cäänö ni pöö ka luum Jecu døøc na karge, këël na ŋäc lwøk mar Jøøn keere na nyuudhi.
english: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John.

anywaa: Ena tägö ki man cääne yi øt acooŋ lam ni cwïnye da cer. 'Ba na ö luumme na wïnynyi ya Paricila ka Akwila, ena kälge ni cäŋge tier luum jöör Jwøk lammø jïre døøc.
english: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na tïme ni manynya man kath løøga ya Akeea, cwïnye acøm nyïïmëëe, ni göönge bääŋi ki wëëlö, nee eni pänhge. 'Ba na pïïe kaagø, jøøa näk ojïëy ki køør met yi Jwøk akønye døc.
english: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:

anywaa: Kiper ena cäänö ni teek ni bööt jø Juuth ka cäänö nyïm jiy, ni nyøth luup moa en yïth weet Jwøk ni Krictø beeye Jecu.
english: For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publickly, shewing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poot Apøla ni ena Körin, Pøøl agak ni lwøra dï mïëri moa en wøk ni ö yi Epeca. Ni cwänne ki bääŋi møøk kaace.
english: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,

anywaa: Ni kööe jïge, no «?U kär jïtö ki Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere kanya jïëyu?» Ni köge, ni «Jïwa bäyö. Poot kärwa wïnynyö cøøn ni da Jwïëc Jwøk mo ena kur keere.»
english: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «?Uuno lwøø na nyuudhi ka nyeŋ ŋø?» Ni köge, ni «Wa lwøk ka lwøø Jøøn na nyuudhi.»
english: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl aköö, ni «Jøøn alöö ki lwøk na nyuudhi mar løk cwïny, ni kööm jiy ki man jïëcge ŋato ööi køøre, ni beeye Jecu.»
english: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luummögø, gena lwøk na nyuudhi ki nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu.
english: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø ö Pøølli na peeth ceŋŋe bäätge, Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere aö bäätge. Ni cäänge ki dhøgi møøk, ni køpge dwør Jwøk.
english: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.

anywaa: 'Ba ge bëët ge jïtö ki kar apaar kurriiø.
english: And all the men were about twelve.

anywaa: Ni ö Pøølli ni døny yi øt acooŋ lam, ni pwöny geni ki dwäde adäk ni cwïnye da cer, ni pïëmö ni cøga jiy kiper buc Jwøk.
english: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïm jø møøki ni wïthge teek ni ge kär jïëy, ni ge cäänö ki luup mo reyø kiper Jöör Lam mar Jecu nyïm acooŋa, Pøøl ree adaae dïge, ni cwöl bääŋi køøre. Ni tïme ni pïëmö yi øt pwöc mar Tirana cooth.
english: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

anywaa: Ni put gïnögø tïïc ki cwiiri ariiø. Kiper manøgønø, luum Wuuö awïnyö jï jø Juuth ki jø Gïrïïk bëët moa en Eecia.
english: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

anywaa: Ni ö Jwøki ni tïïe ki gïï mo døøŋŋø mo rëëma ec ki ri Pøøl.
english: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:

anywaa: Ni tïme ni manydhïïle wala thäk abïïe di kälö ki baŋe ni kïthi baŋ jøøa tuu, ni aac täwe dëëtge, ni ö juuga reyø ni öge wøk dëëtge.
english: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø ajuuk mo jø Juuth mo wø cäädhi kaagø, gena tägö ki man cøørge nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu bäät jøøa näk rege da juuga reyø, ni ge köö, na «A köömma uuni ki nyeŋ Jecu ni wø køp Pøølli.»
english: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.

anywaa: 'Ba jak ma abïriiø ma wäät Eckiiba, na näk Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ mar jø Juuth, gïnögø wø tïïcge tïïö.
english: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.

anywaa: 'Ba adwøk jwøa raaci jïge, ni «Jecu ŋääa, ni ŋääa Pøøl, 'ba uuna jøøe?»
english: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata näk dëëre da jwøa raac apäär bäätge ki teek, ni put geni böötö. Ni ö geni ni reŋge wøk ki yi øtø ni dëëtge da ŋwiili ni bäŋ abïïe dëëtge.
english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

anywaa: Ni put gïnögø tïmö ni ŋäc jø Juuthi ki jø Gïrïïk bëët moa en Epeca. Ni jït cwïnyge bëët ki lwär. Ni ö nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu ni jiemi døøc.
english: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jøøa näk ojïëy mo thööth thuwø aö nyïm, ni ö gïïa reyø na wara tïïcge ni caange ge nyïm jiy bëët.
english: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.

anywaa: Ni ö jø møøki dëët jøøa tïïö ki tïï ajuuk ni kälge weeli moge kanya ciel ni waaŋge geni nyïm jiy bëët. 'Ba na kwaange japa ŋeewge weeli ki ge, atïmö na gwel ma kume ma pïërabïïc.
english: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.

anywaa: Kanyøgø luum Wuuö anyaay døc.
english: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør gïïögø bëët, acaar Pøølli ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni eni doo cøøa Jerucalem, ni cøra Macedönia ka Akeea, ni kööe, ni «Noo nø bëëda kaace, a cøøa kuna neena Röm thuwø.»
english: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø jääk Macedönia ki jiy ariiø mo wø køny gø, ni beege Timöthi ki Eracta, eni ki dëëre adööŋ Eecia ki nïne møøk.
english: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timothy and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø luubö mo ba thiinh atägö kiper Jöör Lam mar Jecu.
english: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.

anywaa: Kiper da nyen mør mo nyeŋŋe Dimitaria ma rëëm gwet-bïrö, ni beeye ŋat wø tïïc gwet-bïrö na kït øt jwø wø cwøl na Artema. Ni eni jø wø tïïö tiere wø wëëge joot jammi mo ba nøk ki køør tïïögø.
english: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

anywaa: Eni jøøgø acooŋ kanya ciel ki jø wø tïïc teeŋ tïïögø, ni kööe, ni «Jaay, ŋäyu ni kwärö marø ööi ka køør tïïc man.
english: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.

anywaa: 'Ba aneennu ni wïnynyu gø ni paa Epeca keere, 'ba päl Eecia ki kare bäre, jiy mo thööth anø pwöny Pøøløgø ni løø cwïnyge wøk, ki køør mana kööe, ni ‹Juu mo tïïc ka ceŋ, paa juu ma adïëri.›
english: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:

anywaa: 'Ba, paa tïïc marø keere noo ränynyi, 'ba këël øt jwøk mar jwøa dwøŋ ma Artema, kanymør di taaø. Ni kanymør nyeŋŋe døøa cään ni bäŋ ŋat jiem gø këët, jwø wø wøør jø Eecia bëët gøøc piny bäre.»
english: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

anywaa: 'Ba na wïnyge luummögø, cwïnyge aränynyö døc, ni kwöŋge, ni «Dwøŋŋa Artema jwø jø Epeca!»
