english: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre na nø pïï jøwi wøk ni bäŋ gïn mo otägö dëëtge, awïnywa na acuullögø beeye acuula mo cwøl ni Malta.
english: And when they were escaped, then they knew that the island was called Melita.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa bëëdö kaace met ec mo dwøŋ døc anyoothge jïwa. Kiper waana ämge ki maac ni pänhge wa bëët, kiper køth atïmö ni pädhö ni piny da köö.
english: And the barbarous people shewed us no little kindness: for they kindled a fire, and received us every one, because of the present rain, and because of the cold.

anywaa: 'Ba Pøøl akännö ki jenni ni kïth geni yi maac. 'Ba na tïm kar maaci ni lïëth, thwöl aö wøk ni gam cer Pøøl.
english: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö jøøa en kaagø na neenge thwöl ni lïërö cere, gena cäänö keerge, ni köge, ni «Nyenøgø dïnääy møn. Këël na bødhe ki naam, kär wec Jwøki nee kwøe.»
english: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

anywaa: 'Ba eni thwöl ateeŋ yi maac, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo otägö dëëre.
english: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.

anywaa: Ni raŋge gø ni ki baŋge ni dëëre puta kwöt, wala kanymør laara pädhö ni thøøe. 'Ba na nø ruuge ni ge neeta gø ki kany mo bäär, ni bäŋ gïn mo raac mo otägö dëëre mo ege joodø, acäŋge caarø ni köge, ni «Ena jwøk mør.»
english: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

anywaa: 'Ba buut kanya enwa yie ya acuullögø, yie da ŋøøp kwäärö mo cwøl ni Publia. Eni waana cwöl paare ki mëër ni caam waani ki nïne adäk.
english: In the same quarters were possessions of the chief man of the island, whose name was Publius; who received us, and lodged us three days courteously.

anywaa: 'Ba wää Publia atïmö ni tuu ka adïrïgi ki ŋwel ec. Ni liimmi ya Pøølli, ni läme, ni kïth ceŋŋe bäät gø ni køny gø.
english: And it came to pass, that the father of Publius lay sick of a fever and of a bloody flux: to whom Paul entered in, and prayed, and laid his hands on him, and healed him.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø täk gïnögø, jø møga bëët moa näk dëëtge da ŋwiili ya acuullögø gena öö thuwø, ni køny geni.
english: So when this was done, others also, which had diseases in the island, came, and were healed:

anywaa: Ni moocge wa ki muuce mo thööth. 'Ba kanya tïŋwa, yi jääy akïthge ki japa canwa bëët.
english: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør dwäde adäk, waana tïŋŋö ki jääy mør ma arïïa ee thöörö ya acuullögø, ni beeye jää paana cwøl ni Alekdhandaria, mo deŋŋe ogöönnö ki kït juu moa cwøl ni Cïp Jwøk ni beeye ŋïï mare.
english: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

anywaa: Ni mäkwa piny Ciraku ni bëëtwa kaace ki nïne adäk.
english: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïŋwa kaace, naam agørwa ni pïïcwa Regiem. 'Ba na nø rïïwa ki dicäŋ aciel, jam wø rïïw piny acööt. 'Ba na tïme na riet nïne, waana pïï Putiöli.
english: And from thence we fetched a compass, and came to Rhegium: and after one day the south wind blew, and we came the next day to Puteoli:

anywaa: Ni jïtwa ki nyïïmëëe kaace, ni cwølge waani nee wa bëëtwa ki geni ki nïne abïriiø. Køør manøgø nø, waana pïï Röm.
english: Where we found brethren, and were desired to tarry with them seven days: and so we went toward Rome.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmëëe moa en kunöce kanya wïnyge waani, gena öö ni julge waani ni wa poot ena Apia Pöram ki Tharii Tabaren. 'Ba na jootwa geni, Pøøl Jwøk apwøe ni put cwïnye mak.
english: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

anywaa: 'Ba na pïïcwa Röm, Pøøl awëëk bëëtö keere ki dïkuri man wø koor gø.
english: And when we came to Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard: but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør nïne adäk, dïbwöthe mo jø Juuth moa en kaace acwöl Pøølli kanya ciel. 'Ba na nø öge kanya ciel, ena köö jïge, «Nyïïmera, këël na bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa tïïö dëët jø pøø wala dëët kööŋŋe mo kwäyø, aana twöc yi Jerucalem ni cïp aani ceŋ jø Röm.
english: And it came to pass, that after three days Paul called the chief of the Jews together: and when they were come together, he said unto them, Men and brethren, though I have committed nothing against the people, or customs of our fathers, yet was I delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø tetge aani, gena tïmö ni ge manynya man pätge aani, kiper na bäŋe luubö mo doo rømø ki thøø dëëra.
english: Who, when they had examined me, would have let me go, because there was no cause of death in me.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya kweer jø Juuthi, aana köö ni beerra man cøøa nyïm Cidhar, këël na bäŋe gïn mo raac mo caana dëët jø pøø.
english: But when the Jews spake against it, I was constrained to appeal unto Caesar; not that I had ought to accuse my nation of.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, beeye na cwøla uuni naa lïïmu, naa cääna ki uuni. Kiper beeye ki køør ŋato ööi ni wø ŋääth jø Icrielli ni twöc aani kipere ko oguudi en.»
english: For this cause therefore have I called for you, to see you, and to speak with you: because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.

anywaa: Ni köge jïgø, ni «Bäŋ weeli mo oö baŋwa ki yi Judia mo caana gïrï. Ni bäŋ nyïïmëëe mo oö kany mo ocaan gø wala mo ocäänö ki gïn mo raac ki nyeŋŋï.
english: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, wa manynya man wïnywa mano caanï. 'Ba luum jöör lam manøgø, ŋäcwa ni piny bäre wø cara gïï mo reyø kipere.»
english: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø cïpge piny ki cäŋ man öge baŋe yie, gena put ö baŋe kanya bëëde yie ni ge thööth døc. Ni par tier luummögø jïge, ni tägi ka amöölla këël abøøya, ni køpa gïr buc Jwøk, ni nyootha luum Jecu jïge ni beeye adïëri, ni nyoodhe ka ri luup moa en ri Ciik Modhe ki mo Nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: And when they had appointed him a day, there came many to him into his lodging; to whom he expounded and testified the kingdom of God, persuading them concerning Jesus, both out of the law of Moses, and out of the prophets, from morning till evening.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møøk ajïëy kiper gïïa care, ni ö jø møga ni kärge jïëy.
english: And some believed the things which were spoken, and some believed not.

anywaa: Køøre na jït dïge ki pïëm gena aay, køør luumma näk aciel na caan Pøølli, na kööe, ni «Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere mare adïëri na caan gø jï kwäyu ki dhi nyikuŋ Jwøk ma Aydheea, na kööe,
english: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Holy Ghost by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,

anywaa: «ni ‹Ci baŋ jøøgø, ni kööï, no «Owïnynyu møn, ni ba maaru tiere kwany, ni nëënu møn, 'ba bäŋ gïn jootu.
english: Saying, Go unto this people, and say, Hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and not perceive:

anywaa: Kiper cwïny jøøi ii, atïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo maarge joot, ni ïthge odhïŋ ki man wïnyge luubö, ni nyeŋge ege miiø kiper nee ba jootge ki nyeŋge, ni ba wïnyge ki ïthge, ni ba kwanyge tier gø ki cwïnyge, ni ba luŋge baŋa, nee ge køny.» ›
english: For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgø nø, wär ŋäyu nø, ni luum pïëm man piem jiy ki gø man en, na öö ki baŋ Jwøk, awëëk kïth baŋ juurre. Kiper geni ïthge cekge ciiø.»
english: Be it known therefore unto you, that the salvation of God is sent unto the Gentiles, and that they will hear it.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø caan luummögøøni, jø Juuth gena aay buute, ni ge pïëmö døc yïthakicge keerge.]
english: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.

anywaa: Ni ö Pøølli ni put bëëtö kaace ki cwiiri ariiø bëët, ni dëëre caama eni keere. Ni pänh jiy mo wø ö baŋe bëët.
english: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,

anywaa: Ni køp gïr buc Jwøk, ni pööe ki luum Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø ni wïnyö jaak ni bäŋ ŋat mo omän gø.
english: Preaching the kingdom of God, and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, with all confidence, no man forbidding him.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na laŋ Jecu Krictø ni göön baŋu ki wëëlö en. Ni aano cwølø naa tïma na nyïïatwiel, ni aano cïp kur keera kiper luumma nyään na met mar Jwøk,
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

anywaa: luumma kwøŋ buuk ki dhøk nyïïkuk moe yïth weet Jwøk na en kur keerge.
english: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

anywaa: Ni luummögø na nyään na met enø beeye luubö kiper Wääde na nywöli na dhaanhø ki ri nyïïkwaac Deebit.
english: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na nyooth na O Jwøk ni eni teek ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere kanya tïŋi maal ki yi thøø. Ni beeye Jecu Krictø na näk Kwääyø,
english: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

anywaa: ŋata jïtwa ki met ec ki køøre ki twiel man tïïcwa jiy nee jïëcge ni ŋääthge, nee nyeŋŋe tïme ni wïnyö dï juurre bëët,
english: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

anywaa: këël uuni ki dëëtu, u na cwøl nou tïmu na mo Jecu Krictø.
english: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

anywaa: Uuni bëët na mëër Jwøki ki u yi Röm, a göönna baŋu, u na no ocwølø nou tïmu na jø Jwøk. Met ec bëëde bäätu ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a pwøya Jwøa ki køør Jecu Krictø kiperu bëët, kiper gïr ŋäädhe maru akøp piny bäre.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk beeye ni ŋäc mara, ŋat wø tïnynya ki cwïnya bäre ki ri luumma nyään na met mar Wääde, naa wø cøøra nyeŋŋu cooth ki yïth laam 'moa, naa ba kääŋi.
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

anywaa: Naa kwaaya gø kiper naa jïta ki jöö man ööa baŋu ki gø, noo kö Jwøki.
english: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

anywaa: Kiper cwïnya manynya man neena uuni døc, kiper nou muunynya ki luubö mo käla baŋ Jwøk, nou tëënnu ki gø,
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

anywaa: kiper nee cwïnynyø cøømmø karøbëët ki ŋäädhe marø, ni beeye maru ki mara.
english: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

anywaa: Jaay, nyïïmera, a caya uuni man ŋäyu gø na a wø caya man ööa baŋu cooth, 'ba a poot di gëëŋŋö. 'Ba gïna daa ö baŋu kipere beeye kiper nee luum Jwøk thur kare dïïu, kaawat mana kwøŋa tïïc dï juurre møga.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, mana daa tïïö jï jøøa no okwänynyö ki jï jøøa näk kär kwänynyö, ki jï jøøa wïthge leer ki jøøa wïthge ba leer, bäŋ daa maara wec.
english: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

anywaa: Ni beeye ni tïm cwïnya ni caya gø døc ki man køba luumma nyään na met jïïu thuwø, u ni en yi Röm.
english: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

anywaa: Kiper aani, wïïa ba laay ki luumma nyään na met, kiper beeye teek Jwøk ki man piem jiy bëët mo wø jïëy ni ŋääthge, ni tägi ka jø Juuth, këël mano këët baŋ jøw mo patha jø Juuth.
english: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

anywaa: Kiper bëënynyö man wø cïp Jwøki onyoodhø ree, ni wø joot ki køør ŋäädhe keere na bäre bäre, kaawat mana gööri, ni «Eni noo bëënynyi ki køør ŋäädhe okwøw.»
english: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

anywaa: Kiper wëëc Jwøk onyoodhø ni ööi ki maal dëët jø wø ba wøør Jwøk bëët ki rääö mar jiy na thiel adïëri piny ki køør rääö marge.
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

anywaa: Kiper gïna doo ŋääö kiper Jwøk, ege nø neen, kiper okwøŋ Jwøki nyooth jïge.
english: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

anywaa: Kiper ki kanya cwääc piny këël kawaane, mo Jwøk na näk ba neen dhaanhe ki waŋe anëënö ni beyø ri gïïa näk ee cwääö, ni beeye teek mare na näk ba cuŋ, ki bëëtö mare ni ena Jwøk. Kiper manøgø nø, røkge ba maarge piem.
english: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

anywaa: Kiper geni këël na ŋäcge Jwøk, eni kärge wøørø kaawat mana dege Jwøk wøørø, ni met ec kärge dwøk baŋ gø. 'Ba gena rwäänyö ki mana dege caarø, ni tïm cwïnyge ni bäŋ gïn jootge këët.
english: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

anywaa: 'Ba na köge ni wïthge leer, gena tïmö na bøøre,
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

anywaa: ni wiilge ajiem Jwøa näk ba maar thøø, ni tïïge ki gïï mo kïtge caala kït dhaanhø ni bëën thøø en, ki kït weny, ki lääy, ki thwöre.
english: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena kwier Jwøki ni wii ge yïth gïïa reyø na näk cwïnyge onieŋ køørge, ki man tïïge ki gïï mo patha karge dëëtge yïthakicge keerge.
english: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

anywaa: Kiper geni mana näk adïëri kiper Jwøk awiilge ki tööt. Ni wøørge gïna cwääc Jwøki ni tïnyge gø, ni wecge eni na näk Cwääy, eni na doo pwøø na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gena wec Jwøki ki man bëëtge ni cwïnyge onieŋ ri gïï wø lää wïci ki ge. Ni ö määrge ni wiilge bëëtö mana dege bëëdö ki gø, ni tïïge ki gïï mo ba doo maara tïïc.
english: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

anywaa: Ni ö cwøwi thuwø ni wecge niine mana dege tïïö ki mään, ni tïm cwïnyge no onieŋ ki man døø ŋati man nø ri niine ki watge maya. Ni tïmge ni ge tïïö ki gïï laac wïc ki cwøw møga. Ni jïtge ki gïï mo leth ki dëëtge ni beeye ajäla mana näk orømø ki gïïa baacge.
english: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïmge ni yïthge ba met ki man ŋäcge Jwøk, gena kwier Jwøki ni wëëk ge bëëtö ki cwïny mo raac ni wø caar gïï mo reyø, ki bëëtö mo patha kare.
english: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

anywaa: Ni cwïnyge bëëdö ni päŋ ki teeŋ gïïa reyø bëët, ki raay, ki päl cwïny, ki cøl cwïny. Ni cwïnyge päŋ ki gwön, ki 'näk jiy, ki wëëye, ki cwøk, ka aranya. Ni gena dïwääc nyeŋŋi,
english: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

anywaa: na dïkïth luup bäät jø møøk, na jø män ki Jwøk, na jø adhala, na jø koorrø, na jø atöör, na dïcwøny raay, na dïdhal luup mo jøøa nywøl geni,
english: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

anywaa: na dïbøøre, na jøw mo ba maar ŋääth, na jøw mo bäŋ cwïnynyi na jø aranya.
english: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

anywaa: 'Ba këël na ŋäcge luumma cem Jwøki, ni jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø, marge wø rømi ka thøø, ge poot bëëdö ni ge tïïya teeŋ gïïögø, ni ge jïëy ki jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø thuwø.
english: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ï na dhaanhø, këël mo ïïna ŋa cøøn, kany wø ŋølï luum dhaanhø mør piny, riï ba diï maara piem. Kiper kany wø ŋølï luum dhaanhø mør piny, ï jääla riï. Kiper ïïni ni wø ŋut piny, ï poot bëëdö niï tïïya gïïögø ki dëëtge.
english: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni ŋøl mar Jwøk kany wø ŋøl jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø wøk, mare beeye adïëri.
english: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

anywaa: ?A ï na dhaanhø nø, iï caarø ni kany wø ŋølï jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø wøk, niï poot tïïya geni ki dëërï, niï doo bøth ki mano ŋøl Jwøki piny?
english: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, met yi Jwøk na päl na bëëde ni cwïnye ee cïp piny ni ba laar jøømø iï taaø? ?Aŋø, kuyï ni met yi Jwøk beeye kiper nee cwïnyï løgï?
english: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper cwïnyï na teek na ba maarï løk, ï känna riï ki wëër mo päl, yi cäŋo ö wëërri yie, kanyo ö ŋøl luup mar Jwøk na näk adïëri noo nyoodhi.
english: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

anywaa: Kiper eno cïpi jï jiy bëët, ni ŋati man nø ojïti ki mo orømø ki gïïa tïïe.
english: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

anywaa: Ni eno cïpi ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe jï jøw wø tïïc gïïa beyø ni cwïnyge ege cïp piny, ni ge caya ajiem, ki wödö, ki kwøw mana näk bäŋ thøø ree.
english: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

anywaa: 'Ba mar jø wø ŋäc dëëtge keerge ni wø ba leŋ adïëri ni ge jïëya raay, beeye gootø ki wëër noo en nyïmge.
english: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

anywaa: 'Ba da gïï mo leth ki gïï mo reyø mo pïï dëët jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïno raac. Ni tägi ka jø Juuth këël mano këët baŋ jøw mo patha jø Juuth.
english: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ajiem ki pwøc ki bëët-mëër noo cïp jï jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïno beer. Ni tägi ka jø Juuth këël mano këët baŋ jøw mo patha jø Juuth.
english: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk luumme aciel kiper jiy bëët.
english: For there is no respect of persons with God.

anywaa: Jiy bëët moa bääö ni ciik Jwøk bäŋgø jïge, geno ränynyi ni bäŋ ciik Jwøk jïge. 'Ba jiy moa bääö ni ge bëënna ciik Jwøk, luup moge oŋøl piny ki køør luup moa en yi ciik Jwøk.
english: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

anywaa: Kiper patha jø wø wïny ciik Jwøk ni wø marge beer nyïm Jwøk, 'ba beege jø wø tïïc moa en yi ciik Jwøk noo jïëc ni marge beer.
english: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

anywaa: 'Ba juurre na näk bäŋ ciik Jwøk jïge, kany wø tïïcge moa caan ciik Jwøki ki køør mana en cwïnyge, marge tïmö keda ciik Jwøk jïge, këël na bäŋe ciik Jwøk jïge;
english: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

anywaa: ni manøgø, ge nyootha gø ni moa caan ciik Jwøki ogöör cwïnyge, ni cwïnyge wø cara gø thuwø ni da ciik Jwøk.
english: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

anywaa: Ni ge cädö ni kanymør ge di jäälö wala ge di ŋunnö dïcäŋöca, kanyo ö Jwøki noo ŋøl luup jiy piny moa näk ege kanø, ki køør Krictø Jecu, kaawat man wø en ri luumma nyään na met ni wø køba.
english: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk riï iï cwølø ni ïïna ŋat Juuth, ni ïïno göök ri ciik Jwøk, niï töödö kiper Jwøk,
english: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

anywaa: ni moa manynye ŋäyï, niï wø jïëya gïno beer, kiper mana näk ïïno pwönynyö ki ciik Jwøk,
english: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

anywaa: ni ŋäyï døøc ni ïïna dïpeec cööye, na tar kiper jø wø en yi muudhö,
english: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

anywaa: na dïtïït luup mo jøøa bäŋ wïdhi, na dïpööy mar obwöre, ni moa doo ŋäc dhaanhe, ki mana näk adïëri, iï joodø ri ciik Jwøk,
english: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

anywaa: aŋø, ïïni ni wø pwöny jø møøk nø, dëërï ba diï pwönynyö? ?Ï ni wø pöö, ni «Kärï kwätö,» ï doo kwätö?
english: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

anywaa: ?Ï ni wø köö, ni «Kär dee ŋat känni ki luk,» ï doo kännö ki luk? ?Ï ni wø ciil ki gïï wø lam, ï doo mudö uut juu?
english: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

anywaa: ?Ï ni wø töödö kiper ciik Jwøk, nyeŋ Jwøk diï raanynyø niï dhala ciik Jwøk?
english: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö, ni «Nyeŋ Jwøk ajøøŋŋi dï juurre kiperu.»
english: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

anywaa: 'Ba daŋ beeye gïn mo beer møn ni näk mo ciik Jwøk iï gwøø. 'Ba ni näk ciik Jwøk dhalï dhalø, daŋ marï tïmö ni rööma ŋat mo kär daŋø.
english: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk ŋat mo kär daŋø luup moa caan ciik Jwøki wø gwøe gwøø, aŋø, mare na käri daŋø ba jïëc ni daŋ?
english: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jø wø näk kär daŋø, 'ba ciik Jwøk ege gwøø, uuno jäälge kiper man bëëdu en nou poot dhala ciik Jwøk, këël na bëëde ni ciik Jwøk ki luum daŋ nut baŋu.
english: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

anywaa: Kiper dhaanhø ba doo tïmö na ŋat Juuth ma adïëri kiper mana nywöli ni ena ŋat Juuth. Ni daŋ ma adïëri patha gïn wø tïïc wøk dëër dhaanhø, 'ba beeye gïn wø en cwïny dhaanhø.
english: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhø wø tïmö ni ena ŋat Juuth ma adïëri kiper man wø en cwïnye. Ni daŋ ma adïëri beeye gïn mo ena cwïny, na gïr jwïëy ni patha gïn mo tïïc ka cenø. Ni pwøc mare ba käl baŋ jiy, 'ba käla baŋ Jwøk.
english: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk enøgønø, agïnaŋø nø ni beer jï jø Juuth ni kaala jø møøk? ?Wala agïnaŋø na duu daŋŋi?
english: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

anywaa: Oduunnö møn ki yïth luup bëët. Mana dïkwøŋ beeye ni jø Juuth luup moa caan Jwøki awëëk geni.
english: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø nø, këël na tïm jø møøki dïge ni ba maar jïëy, bëëtö marge ni ge ba jïëy, Jwøk ni wø ŋääth dee tïïö ni ba ŋääth?
english: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

anywaa: Ba doo løny. Jootu joodø, ni Jwøk poot bëëdö kare na adïëri këël jiy bëët doo tïmö ni ge ba maar ŋääth, kaawat mana gööri, ni «Kiper manøgønø, luummï na caanï beeye adïëri, ni tïm marï na kare ki køør luummï noo ŋølï.»
english: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk rääö marø beeye ni wø nyooth gø ni ŋøl luup mar Jwøk beeye adïëri, agïnaŋø nø noo caanø? ?Aŋø, ø doo köö ni mar Jwøk raac kany wø wëëre ki øøni? (Man caana en, caana kaawat man wø caan dhaanhe jaak.)
english: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

anywaa: Ba doo løny! ?Onää enøgønø, Jwøk luup piny a dee gø ŋølø nidïï?
english: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk tööt mara beeye wø døøc adïëri mar Jwøk mo nëënö ni ree da ajiem, aŋø ni pooda ni aano jäälö na ŋat raay en?
english: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

anywaa: ?Na aŋø nø ni ba tïïø ki raay nee gïïa beyø öge? keda man wø caan jø møøki ni ge kïtha luubö bäätwa, ni beeye gïn wø caanwa. 'Ba ajäla marge orøm dëëtge.
english: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

anywaa: ?A mana ŋø nø? ?Aŋø, øøni na jø Juuth theemma marø ki jø møga? Patha eni bäre bäre. Kiper yaa nø caan, ni jiy bëët teek raay ena bäätge, këël jø Juuth ki jøw mo patha jø Juuth bëët.
english: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

anywaa: Kaawat mana gööri, ni «Bäŋ dhaanhø aciel mo mare beer. Bäŋgø, këël doo naa aciel.
english: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat mo kwany tier luubö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo mar Jwøk ee cayø.
english: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

anywaa: Geno gaa wøk bëët, ni tïmge ni ge reyø bëët. Ni bäŋgø mo tïïö ki gïn mo beer, këël dhaanhø aciel.»
english: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

anywaa: «Lwör moge atïmö keda bwörö mo ojabø, ni ge cara cwøk ki lëëpge.» «Ni cïmmi mo thwöre ena dhøkge.»
english: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

anywaa: «Ni dhøkge bëënna ajaany keere ki luup mo reyø.»
english: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

anywaa: «Ni tietge piew ki køny rem jiy piny.
english: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

anywaa: Ni nuta ränynyö ki kïmmö uutjïëthe mo wø cørge yïthge.
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

anywaa: Ni jöör bëët-mëër kucge.»
english: And the way of peace have they not known:

anywaa: «Ni Jwøk ba lwäärge bäre bäre.»
english: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni gïn mo ocaan ciik Jwøki wø cäänna jøøa bëën ciik Jwøk, kiper nee bäŋe dhaanhø mo jaal dhee këët, nee jø piny bäre ba maarge köö ni mana many Jwøki kucge.
english: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo jïëc ni mare beer nyïm Jwøk ki køør tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk. Kiper beeye ciik Jwøk ni wø ö dhaanhe wø ŋäc raay ki køøre.
english: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane bëënynyö man wø cïp Jwøki onyoodhø ni ciik Jwøk tøør ree, ni beeye na cään ciik Jwøki ki mo nyïïkuk Jwøk kipere,
english: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

anywaa: ni beeye bëënynyö man wø cïp Jwøki man wø joot ki ri ŋäädhe ni en ri Jecu Krictø, ni beeye kiper jiy bëët mo wø jïëy ni ŋääthge. Kiper jiy röömi bëët.
english: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïm jiyi bëët no obääyö ni geno kääŋö ka ajiem Jwøk,
english: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

anywaa: gena jïëc Jwøki ni marge beer ki met yie na muuy mo di cïbö jaak, ki køør wïïdö mana ö Krictø Jecu na wïïl geni wøk,
english: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

anywaa: ŋata kïth Jwøki nyïm no olämi ki køør remme, na doo jïëö ki køør ŋäädhe. Manøgø atïïc kiper nee ŋøl luup mar Jwøk na näk adïëri nyoodhe, kiper na kwøŋ bëëdö ni cwïnye ee cïp piny ni käre raay moa dïkwøŋ kwaan.
english: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

anywaa: Ni eni nyootha gø ennø ni eni ki dëëre ŋøl luup mare beeye adïëri, ni ŋat wø ŋääth Jecu wø jïëe jïëö ni mare beer nyïme.
english: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

anywaa: ?Ni näk ma enøgønø, gïna døø töödö kipere, age eni? Bäŋgø. ?A køør ŋø? ?Køør tïïe? Patha eni. 'Ba beeye ki køør ŋäädhe.
english: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

anywaa: Kiper wa wø köö, ni dhaanhø wø jïëc ni mare beer ka køør ŋäädhe, ni tïïe mo ciik Jwøk tøør ree.
english: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

anywaa: ?Wala Jwøk a Jwø jø Juuth keerge, ni patha Jwø juurre thuwø? Adïëri møn, ena Jwø juurre thuwø.
english: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk aciel. Ni eni jøøa näk odaŋø ojïëe ni marge beer ki køør ŋäädhe marge, ni jïëc jøøa näk patha odaŋø ni marge beer kiper ŋäädhe marge.
english: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

anywaa: ?Kiper manøgønø, ø weta ciik Jwøk wøk ki køør ŋäädhe man? Ba doo løny. Ø poot gwøga ciik Jwøk.
english: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo caanø kiper kwarø ma Eeberam na kälø ree?
english: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

anywaa: Kiper onää Eeberam ojïëö ni mare beer ki køør tïïe, eni doo jïtö ki gïn mo tööde kiper gø, 'ba paa ki nyïm Jwøk.
english: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø na caan wëël Jwøki? Wëël Jwøk aköö, ni «Eeberam ajïëy ki Jwøk ni ŋääth gø, ni ö eni ni jïëyi ya Jwøki no obëënynyö ki køør ŋäädhe mare.»
english: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba mar ŋat wø tïïö, jape ni wø maae bäŋ wø cwøl ni muuy, 'ba beeye jape na tïnynye.
english: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

anywaa: 'Ba mar ŋat wø ba tïïö, 'ba ŋäätha Jwøk ni wø jïëc jø raay ni marge beer, ŋatøgø ojïëc no obëënynyö ki køør ŋäädhe mare.
english: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, Deebit wø køpa gwïëth mar ŋat wø jïëc Jwøki no obëënynyö ni tïïe tøør ree, na kööe,
english: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

anywaa: ni «Gwïëth en bäät jøøa näk raay moge owiiø, ni moa bacge orïëbö
english: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

anywaa: Gwïëth en bäät ŋat mo bääyö mare ba kwaan Wuuö bääte.»
english: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

anywaa: ?Gwïëth manøgø caan kaper jøøa näk odaŋø keerge? ?Wala caan kaper jøøa näk patha odaŋø thuwø? Ø wø köö, ni Eeberam ajïëc ni mare beer ki køør ŋäädhe.
english: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

anywaa: ?Eno jïëö nidïï? ?Eni jïëc ki kanya poode ni kär daŋø, wala køør mana nø daŋi? Eni jïëc ki kanya poode ni kär daŋø, ni patha køør mana nø daŋi.
english: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

anywaa: Ena daŋ na ŋïï wala nyuudhi mar bëënynyö mana joode ki køør ŋäädhe kanya poode ni kär daŋø. Ni gïnögø tïïc kaper nee tïme na kwar jø wø jïëy ni ŋääthge bëët ni ge patha odaŋø, kiper nee ge jïëc Jwøki ni marge beer na enøgønø.
english: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

anywaa: Ni tïme na kwar jøøa näk odaŋø thuwø, na näk marge patha daŋ keere, 'ba ge caatha jöör ŋäädhe mana en jï kwarø ma Eeberam kanya poode ni eni poot kär daŋø.
english: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna buuk jï Eeberam ki nyïïkwaaye, ni piny doo cøøa jïge, kär öö ki køør ciik Jwøk, 'ba ööi ka køør bëënynyö man wø en ri ŋäädhe.
english: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk jø wø bëën ciik Jwøk beege wø tïmö na lwiidhi, ŋäädhe tïmö ni bäŋ tiere, ni ö buuki ni ränynye.
english: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

anywaa: Kiper ciik Jwøk käla ajäla, 'ba kany mo bäŋ ciik Jwøk, bäŋ gïn mo caan no odhalø yie.
english: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

anywaa: Beeye tiere na tïm gïnni en no ogöök ri ŋäädhe, kiper nee buuk tïme ni bëënna met yi Jwøk, nee cööp kare na adïëri jï nyïïkwaac Eeberam bëët, ni paa jï jø wø bëën ciik Jwøk keerge, 'ba këël jø wø nywaak ŋäädhe mar Eeberam, kiper ena kwarø bëët,
english: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

anywaa: kaawat mana gööri, ni «Ïïna tïïa na kwar juurre mo thööth.» Ni ena kwarø bëët nyïm Jwøk, ŋata ŋäädhe ni wø cïp kwøw jï jøøa näk othøw, ŋat wø wëëk jammi mo bäŋgø, tägö ni tïmge na jammi.
english: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

anywaa: 'Ba eni gïn mo ba doo maara ŋääth aŋäädhe, ni eni doo tïmö na kwar juurre mo thööth, keda mana kwøŋi caan jïre, ni «Nyïïkwaayï otïmö ni thööth na yøøgønø.»
english: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

anywaa: Ŋäädhe mare käre wiiø, këël na caar dëëre ni kare cään ki thøø kiper mana näk mo jïre da cwiiri mo jïtö ki dïpa, wala kanya caar bwøc cïïe ma Ceera.
english: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ataa cwïnye mo kier wïïe kiper luumma buuk Jwøki, 'ba ena put tëënnö ki ri ŋäädhe mare kanya bëëde ni jeemma Jwøk,
english: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

anywaa: ni luum gø ee maa ki cwïnye, ni løny jï Jwøk ki man tïïc gïna buue.
english: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na ö eni na jïëi ni mare beer ki køør ŋäädhe mare.
english: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba luupögø na køp, ni «Ena jïëc ni mare beer,» kär göörö kipere keere,
english: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

anywaa: 'ba göör kaperø thuwø. 'Ba øøno jïëc thuwø ni marø beer, ø na näk ojïëy na ŋääth ŋata tïŋ Kwääyø ma Jecu maal ki yi thøø,
english: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

anywaa: ŋata wëëk thøø kiper moa dhalø, ni cäŋi tïŋ maal kiper nøø jïëc ni marø beer.
english: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane na tïme ni øøno jïëö ni marø beer ki køør ŋäädhe, yïthakiyø ki Jwøk ajïtö ki bëët-mëër ki køør Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køøre na jïtø ki karø ri met ec man ni cuŋŋø ree en, ni kanynyø kiper mana ŋäädhø noo nywaaø ajiem mar Jwøk.
english: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

anywaa: 'Ba paa manøgø keere, 'ba ø kanynyø thuwø yïth gïï ni leth ni jwørø en, kiper mana ŋääø gø ni gïï wø leth wø jwør dhaanhe wø käla tëënnö,
english: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

anywaa: ni ö tëënnö ni käl bëëtö mo beer, ni ö bëëtö mo beer ni käl ŋäädhe.
english: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäädhe cwïnynyø bäŋ wø wëëk pädhö. Kiper mëëc Jwøk okïth cwïnynyø ni päl ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere na cïp jïïø.
english: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

anywaa: Kanya poodø ni røgø ba maarø køny, Krictø athuunh jø raay ki kanya wäŋŋi ni kare.
english: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

anywaa: Kiper teek døc jï dhaanhø ki man thøøe kiper ŋat mør mo bëëte beer, 'ba ŋääø ni kanymør dhaanhø cwïnye dee maaø kiper ŋat mør ma wøp døc këël doo cööpa ri thøø.
english: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk mëëye ee nyoodhø jïïø, kiper kanya poodø ni øøna jø raay beeye kanya thøw Krictø kiperø.
english: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

anywaa: ?'Ba kawaane na tïme ni øøno jïëö ni marø beer ki køør remme, a teeŋ pïëm mo nyïëdi noo piem øøni ki wëëc Jwøk?
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk kanya poodø ni øøna jø män, øøna cäŋ dwøk kanya ciel ki Jwøk ki køør thøw Wääde, ?a kawaane nø, na cäŋø døø kanya ciel, a teeŋ pïëm mo nyïëdi noo piem øøni ki gø ki køør kwøwe?
english: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

anywaa: 'Ba patha manøgø keere, 'ba ø kanynyø thuwø ki nyeŋ Jwøk ki køør Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, ŋata joodø døøn kanya ciel ki køøre.
english: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

anywaa: 'Ba raay atägö bäät piny ki køør dhaanhø aciel, ni ö thøøe ni ööe ki køør raay, ni tïm thøøe ni nyaa bäät jiy bëët, kiper mana näk jiy obääyö bëët.
english: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

anywaa: Kiper raay nut møn piny cøøn kanya poode ni ciik Jwøk poot kär cïbö, 'ba raay ba cwøl ni bääyö ki kany mo bäŋ ciik yie.
english: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

anywaa: 'Ba thøø adïmö ra Adam këël mana këët ri Modhe, këël bäät jøøa näk bääyö marge ba caal dhal luubö mana dhal Adammi, eni na caal ŋata doo öö.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

anywaa: 'Ba muuy mana cïp ba caal luumma dhal. Kiper ni näk jiy mo thööth othøw ki køør luubö mana dhal dhaanhe acielli, a teeŋ met yi Jwøk mo nyïëdi ki muuy mano cïp ki met ec noo pälli jï jiy mo thööth ki ri met yi ŋata näk aciel enøgø na näk Jecu Krictø!
english: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

anywaa: Ni muuy mana cïp ba caal gïna duu luumma baac dhaanhe acielli. Kiper mana ŋøl piny na öö ki køør luubö mana näk aciel na dhal, akännö ka ajäl thøø. 'Ba muuy mana cïp na öö ki køør luup moa thööth na dhal, akännö ki jöö man ŋun jiy ki gø.
english: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk thøø odïmö ki køør luumma näk aciel na dhal dhaanhe acielli, a teeŋ kwøw mo nyïëdi noo kwøw jø wø ci met yi Jwøki mana päl jïge ki bëënynyö mana cïp ki køør ŋatøgø na aciel enø, na näk Jecu Krictø!
english: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

anywaa: Kiper beeye gïna beer na tïïc dhaanhe acielli na käl ŋunnö ki kwøw kiper jiy bëët, kaawat mana ö luumma näk aciel na dhal dhaanhe acielli na käl ajäla bäät jiy bëët.
english: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

anywaa: Ni beeye leŋ luubö mar dhaanhø aciel noo tïïc jiy mo thööth ni marge beer, kaawat mana ö bäŋ leŋ luubö mar dhaanhø aciel na tïïc jiy mo thööth na jø raay.
english: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

anywaa: 'Ba ciik Jwøk aci yie thuwø kiper nee rääc luumma dhal nyoodhe ni päl. 'Ba kanya ö raayi na pälle, met ec opällö ni kadha eni,
english: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

anywaa: kiper nee met yi Jwøk tïme ni dwøŋŋa eni ki køør bëënynyö mano cööp ri kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe ki køør Jecu Krictø na näk Kwääyø, kaawat mana ö raayi na dïïm jiy dïkwøŋ na känne ki thøø.
english: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo caanø nø? ?Aŋø, ø doo puta bëëtö yïth raay, nee met yi Jwøk pälle?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

anywaa: Ba doo løny. ?Øøni na näk othøw ni teek raay bäŋgø bäätø këët, øøna døø poodø ni ø bëëdö yïth raay nidïï?
english: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

anywaa: ?Kuyu ni øøni bëët na näk olwøø na nyuudhi dëër Krictø Jecu, ø lwøk na nyuudhi yi thøwe?
english: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, øøna koony ki eni na aciel ki køør lwøk marø na lwøk øøni na nyuudhi yi thøwe, kiper nee jöör kwøw mana nyään caadhø, kaawat mana ö Krictø na tïŋi maal ki yi thøø ki køør ajiem Wuuö Jwøk.
english: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk øøno dwätö ki eni, ni thøøø kaawat mana thøøe, ka adïëri møn, øøno dwäti ki eni thuwø ki duunne wøk ki yi thøø kaawat mare.
english: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

anywaa: Ŋääø ni gïïa kwøŋ en cwïnynyø anäk bäät jaadha no odëëdö ki eni na aciel, kiper nee dëël mana päŋ ki raay nee ränynye, nøø tïmø ni ø patha laaŋe jï raay këët.
english: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat mo othøw, bäŋ teek raay bääte këët.
english: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo øøno thøw ki Krictø, yøø ŋäädhö ni øøno kwøw ki eni thuwø.
english: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

anywaa: Kiper ŋääø ni Krictø na tïŋ maal ki yi thøø ba cäŋ thøwø këët bäre bäre, kiper thøø jïre bäŋ teek bääte këët.
english: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

anywaa: 'Ba thøwa thøøe ki gø, thøw kaper raay ni yie aciel, ni bäŋ mør këët. Ni kwøw mana kwøe ki gø, kwøwa jï Jwøk.
english: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø uuni thuwø, wär dëëtu caarru ni uuno thøw ni raay bäŋ teek bäätu këët, ni cäŋu kwøwø jï Jwøk ki ri Krictø Jecu.
english: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, käru nou wëëga raay jïtö ki teek bäät dëëtu ni bëën thøø enø, ki man wëëkge uuni leŋ gïïge na reyø wø nieŋge køørge.
english: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

anywaa: Ni käru nou wëëga thäk dëëtu raay ni gena gïï wø tïïc gïï mo reyø. 'Ba cïpu dëëtu jï Jwøk ni uuna jiy mo okäl wøk ki yi thøø, ni cäŋge kwøw. Ni cïpu thäk dëëtu jï Jwøk na gïï wø tïïc gïï mo beyø.
english: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

anywaa: Kiper raay ba doo tïmö na kwäärö bäätu, kiper mana tïme nou ba bëën ciik Jwøk, 'ba u bëënna met yi Jwøk.
english: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø nø? ?Ø doo bääö kiper mana bëënnø met yi Jwøk ni ø ba bëën ciik Jwøk këët? Ba doo løny.
english: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni ni näk dëëtu you cïbö jï ŋat mør ni uuna laaŋe mo leŋa luupe, u puta tïmö ni uuna laaŋe jï ŋata dwøre leŋŋu? 'Ba ni näk mou leŋa dwør raay, cuŋŋe beeye thøø, 'ba ni näk mou leŋa dwør Jwøk, cuŋŋe beeye bëënynyö.
english: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Jwøk kiper uuni na kwøŋ bëëtö na laaŋe mo raay, uuna tïmö nou leŋa pwöc ki cwïnynyu bäre, mana cïp jïïu,
english: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

anywaa: ni uuna pät ceŋ raay, ni tïmu ni uuna laaŋe mo gïïa beyø.
english: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba man caana en, a cäänö keda man wø caan dhaanhe, kiper mana tïme ni teek jïïu ki man laar ci cwïnynyu. 'Ba kawaane cïpu thäk dëëtu jï gïïa beyø nee tïmge ni ena kur keerge na mo Jwøk, kaawat mana kwøŋu thäk dëëtu cïp jï gïï mo patha adïëri ki rääö mo raac døc.
english: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

anywaa: Kiper kanya poodu ni uuna laaŋe mo raay, u ba bëën gïïa beyø.
english: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

anywaa: ?'Ba kanyøca nø, agïnaŋø na duu japøka ni wïthu olää ki ge kawaane yøø? Cuŋ japøgø beeye thøø.
english: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane na nø pät uuni ceŋ raay, ni tïmu na laaŋe mo Jwøk, gïna duue jïïu, uuna tïmö nou ena kur keeru na mo Jwøk, ni cuŋŋe beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

anywaa: Kiper gïï wø mak cer raay beeye thøø, 'ba muuy mana cïp Jwøki beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe ki ri Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääyø.
english: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

anywaa: ?Nyïïmera, kuyu ni ciik Jwøk wø ena bäät dhaanhø kany wø poot dhaanhe ni kwøw keere? Kiper a cäänö ka jøø ni ŋäc ciik Jwøk yøø.
english: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø mo onywømø wø bëënna cwøre kany wø poot cwøre ni kwøw ki køør mana caan ciiki. 'Ba ni näk cwøre othøw, eno pädö ri ciik manøgø.
english: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk mo eni cøø ni bëëde ki dïcwøø mør ni cwøre poot kwøw, eni di cwølø ni kääbi. 'Ba ni näk mo cwøre othøw, eno pädö ri gïna caan ciiki. Køøre ni näk mo eni nywøm dïcwøø mørri nywømø, mare patha käp.
english: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, nyïïmera, uuna nø thøw ni ciik Jwøk jïre bäŋ teek bäätu këët ki køør dëër Krictø, nou tïmu ni uuna moe, eni na tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, kiper nøø tïïø ki gïï mo beyø jï Jwøk.
english: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

anywaa: Kanya poodø ni ø bëënna moa wara cac dëëlli, gïïa reyø na wara nieŋø køørge, gena jiec ciik Jwøki, ni tïïge thäk dëëtø ni känge ki gïï mo duua thøø.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane øøna dööŋ wøk ri ciik Jwøk, ni thøø jï gïna kwøŋ øøni mak ki teek, ni tïme ni ø ba tïny luubö mana kwøŋ göör na näk oruuö, 'ba ø tïnynya kwøw mana nyään na en ri Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo caanø nø? ?Ø doo köö, ni ciik Jwøk beeye raay? Ba doo løny. Onää bäŋ ciik Jwøk, raay ba daa ŋääö. Ni rääc par gïr ŋat mør ba daa ŋääö, onää kär caan ciik Jwøki, ni «Kärï pädö.»
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

anywaa: 'Ba raay ajïtö ki jöö ri mana cem Jwøki, ni kïth cwïnya ki teeŋ par gïï mo thööth døc. Kiper kanya bäŋe ya ciik Jwøk, raay bëëdö no othøw.
english: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

anywaa: Kiper dïkwøŋ kanya bëëda ni bäŋ ciik Jwøk mo ŋääa, a bëëdö naa kwøw. 'Ba kanya ö mana cem Jwøki, raay acär, ni thøøa.
english: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

anywaa: Ni ö cemøgø kiree na doo cïpö ki kwøw ni tïme ni käla thøø dëëra.
english: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

anywaa: Kiper raay ajïtö ki jöö ri mana cem Jwøki ni cøøkge aani ni 'näkge aani ki gø.
english: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ciik Jwøk ena kur keere na mar Jwøk, ni mana cem Jwøki ena kur keere ni beer na wøp.
english: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, beeye gïna beer nø, na käl thøø dëëra? Ba doo løny. Beege raay na tïïc thøø dëëra ki køør gïna beer, kiper nee raay nyooth ni beeye raay møn, nee rääcge joot ni reyø døc ki køør mana cem.
english: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni ciik Jwøk beeye mar Jwøk. 'Ba aani a ena kur piny, ni aano ŋeeø na laŋŋø jï raay.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

anywaa: Ni gïna tïïa gïï kipere kuua. Kiper a bäŋ wø tïïc gïna daa tïïö, 'ba beeye gïna mäna ki gø kiree ni wø tïïa.
english: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa tïïya gïna ba daa tïïö, aano jïëy ni ciik Jwøk beer.
english: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, patha aani këët ni wø tïïc gø, 'ba beeye raay ni wø bëëdö cwïnya.
english: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ni bäŋ gïn mo beer jïra mo en dëëra. Løny jïra ki man caya gïn mo beer, 'ba ba løny jïra ki man tïïa gø.
english: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

anywaa: Kiper a bäŋ wø tïïc gïna beer na daa manynyø. 'Ba beeye raay na ba daa manynyø ni wø tïïa.
english: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa tïïya gïna ba daa manynyø, patha aani këët ni wø tïïc gø, 'ba beeye raay ni wø bëëdö cwïnya.
english: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane nø, a jooda møn, ni kany wø manynya man tïïa ki gïn mo beer, raay karge cään.
english: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

anywaa: Kiper yia met ki ciik Jwøk ki yi cwïnya kiree,
english: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

anywaa: 'ba da gïn mør mo wø jooda joodø thäk dëëra mo këëdö ki luubö mana en wïïa, ni tïïya aani ni aana laŋ raay mo otwöö, ni bëëdö thäk dëëra.
english: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

anywaa: Wui, a na dhaanhø mo oränynyö en! ?Aŋa noo piem aani cer dëëri ni bëën thøø en?
english: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Jwøk ki køør Jecu Krictø na näk Kwääyø. 'Ba kawaane nø, a tïnynya ciik Jwøk ki luumma en wïïa, 'ba ki rïŋ dëëra a tïnynya mo raay.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kawaane bäŋ ajäla bäät jø wø en dëër Krictø Jecu.
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

anywaa: Kiper kwøw mana cïp Jwïëc Jwøki ki ri Krictø Jecu, aana päde cer raay ki thøø.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

anywaa: Kiper gïna ba maar lønyø jï ciik Jwøk ki man tïïc gø kiper mana døøyi ya dëëlli mo jääk, atïïc Jwøki kanya jääŋ Wääde kiree, ki dëël mo caala dëër dhaanhø ni da raay en, ni tïme no olämi kiper raay, ni jääl raay ri dëël.
english: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

anywaa: Ni manøgø tïïe kaper nee bëënynyö mana many ciik Jwøki nee thur kare dëëtø, ø wø caath køør Jwïëc Jwøk ni patha køør mo dëël.
english: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø bëën dëël, cwïnyge ege cïp køør jap wø many dëëlli. 'Ba jø wø bëën Jwïëc Jwøk, cwïnyge ege cïp køør jap wø many Jwïëc Jwøki.
english: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

anywaa: Ki man cïp cwïny køør dëël beeye thøø. 'Ba ki man cïp cwïny køør Jwïëc Jwøk beeye kwøw ki bëët-mëër.
english: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

anywaa: Kiper cwïny man wø näk ocïp køør dëël, män ki Jwøk, ni dwør ciik Jwøk ba leŋe, ni ba maar lønyø jïre ki man leŋ gø.
english: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

anywaa: Ni jø wø näk cwïnyge ege cïp ri mo dëël ba maar lønyø jïge ki man tïïcge gïï wø met yi Jwøki ki ge.
english: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u ba en ri mo dëël. U ena ri mo Jwïëc Jwøk, ni näk Jwïëc Jwøk bëëdö cwïnynyu møn. Kiper ŋat wø Jwïëc Krictø tøør cwïnye, ŋatøgø patha mare.
english: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Krictø ena cwïnynyu, këël na näk dëëtu othøw kiper raay, jwïëyu kwøw kiper bëënynyö.
english: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Jwïëc ŋata tïŋ Jecu maal ki yi thøø bëëdö cwïnynyu, ŋata tïŋ Krictø Jecu maal ki yi thøø, dëëtu ni bëën thøø enø ocäŋ wëëk kwøw thuwø ki køør Jwïëye ni bëëdö cwïnynyu enø.
english: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, mana døø tïïö nø, ø ba doo bëën jap wø many dëëlli ki man bëëdø ni ø tïïya gïï wø cac dëëlli.
english: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk mou bëëdö nou tïïya gïï wø cac dëëlli, u thøw. 'Ba ni näk tïïe mo dëël you wëëk thøø ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk, uuno kwøw.
english: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø bwøth Jwïëc Jwøki, gena nyïï Jwøk.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

anywaa: Kiper u kär wëëk jwïëy mo tïïya uuni na laaŋe nou cäŋu lwäyö. 'Ba uuna wëëk Jwïëy mo tïïya uuni na nyïï Jwøk. Kiper kany wø jwöŋø, ni «Abba, Awuuö,»
english: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

anywaa: beeye Jwïëc Jwøk kiree ni wø cäänö na aciel ki jwïëyø ni øøna nyïï Jwøk.
english: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk øøna nyïïe nø, øøna lwiidhi, na lwiidhi mo Jwøk, ni øøna lwiidhi ki Krictø na aciel, ni näk mo ø jwøra gïï mo leth ki eni na aciel, kiper nøø jiem ki eni na aciel thuwø.
english: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

anywaa: Kiper yaa caarø ni gïï leth ni nut ii ba doo rømø ki man pääri ka ajiem mano nyooth jïïø.
english: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

anywaa: Kiper jammi bëët moa näk ocwääc Jwøki ge koora kanyo nyooth nyïï Jwøk yie, ni nyeŋge ege peerø.
english: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

anywaa: Kiper gïïö no ocwääö yøø omänö ki man cööp marge kare. Ni manøgø patha luumge, 'ba beeye luum ŋata bëënge, ni mooya ge ki ŋäädhe,
english: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

anywaa: ki man näk mo gïïa näk ocwääö ki dëëtge käla wøk cer laŋ ni wø tøpge yie, ni jootge pät mana pät nyïï Jwøk ki gø ni bëëdö ka ajiem.
english: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

anywaa: Ni ŋääø ni gïïö no ocwääö yi piny bäre yøø wø bëëdö ni ge cooyø ciel ki cooyø mo rööma coony mäc lwaar, këël kawaane.
english: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

anywaa: Ni paa gïïa näk ocwääö keerge ni wø cooyi, 'ba këël øøni ki dëëtø, øøna näk këël wï Jwøk mo Jwïëc Jwøk, ø wø cooyø ki cwïnynyø kany poodø ni ø køya kanyo ŋec øøni ni øøna nyïïe, ni beeye kanyo wiil dëëtø yie.
english: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

anywaa: Kiper beeye ŋääthögø na piem øøni ki køøre. 'Ba gïn mo nëënö ni ŋäädhi, manøgø patha ŋäädhe. ?Aŋa wø ŋääth gïn mo ee nø neen?
english: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø ŋäätha gïn mo kärø neenø, ø koora gø ni cwïnynyø yøø cïp piny.
english: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, Jwïëc Jwøk wø kønya øøni kiper mana jägø. Kiper lam mana døø lämö ki gø kuuø. 'Ba beeye Jwïëc Jwøk ki dëëre ni wø kwääö kiperø nyïm Jwøk, ni eni jwöŋö ki cwïnye bäre ki dwøl mo ba maar caan ki dhøk.
english: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø dar cwïny jiy, gïna en cwïny Jwïëc Jwøk ŋääe, kiper beeye Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø kwääö kiper jø Jwøk keda mana many Jwøki.
english: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni Jwøk tïïö ri jammi bëët nee bëënyge jï jøw wø mëër ki eni, jøøa näk ee cwølø keda mana manynye.
english: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

anywaa: Kiper jøøa ŋääe cøøn, ee miiø thuwø ki man tïmge ni kïtge caala kït Wääde, kiper nee eni tïme na kaa dï nyïïmëëe mo thööth.
english: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk ee miiø, ee cwølø thuwø. Ni jøøa näk ee cwølø, ee jïëö thuwø ni marge beer. Ni jøøa näk ee jïëö ni marge beer, ee jiemø thuwø.
english: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø nø, noo caanø kiper gïïögø? ?Ni näk mo Jwøk ena kurø, aŋa noo männi ki øøni?
english: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

anywaa: ?Ŋata kär män Wääde kiree, 'ba acïbe kiperø bëët, jammi bëët ba dee mëëga øøni ki eni na aciel?
english: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo känni ki luubö mo raac bäät jøøa jier Jwøki? Kiper beeye Jwøk wø jïëc dhaanhø ni mare beer.
english: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo jääl dhaanhø? ?Beeye Krictø Jecu? Patha eni, kiper beeye eni na thøw, ni tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, ni en bäät cwïï Jwøk, ni wø kwääö kiperø.
english: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo pää øøni ki mëëc Krictø? ?Aŋø, beeye gïïo leth noo jwørø, wala moo thäŋ yïthø ki ge, wala caannø, wala meel, wala wääth dëël, wala kany mo raac ma kar thøø, wala opëëllö?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

anywaa: Kaawat mana gööri, ni «Beeye kiperï ni bëëtwa ni wa di nääŋŋö cooth, ni waano tïmö kaamar dïëk mo di ŋarø.»
english: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

anywaa: Jïre bäär. 'Ba ki yïth gïïögø bëët teeka øøni ki køør ŋata mëër ki øøni, ni bäŋ gïn mo maarge tïïc.
english: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa døøc ni thøø, wala kwøw, wala nyïïatwiet maal, wala gïïa jïge da teek maalø, wala gïï ni nutö ii, wala japo ööi, wala moa jïge da teek,
english: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

anywaa: wala gïï mo ena maal, wala gïï mo ena piny tiet ŋøøm, wala gïn mør jaak dëët moa näk ocwääö bëët, bäŋ gïrpiny aciel dïge mo doo maara lønyø jïre ki man pää øøni ki mëëc Jwøk ni en dëër Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääyø.
english: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gïn ma adïëri ki nyeŋ Krictø, naa ba caan tööt, ni beeye gïn mo ŋääa ki cwïnya ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere,
english: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

anywaa: ni cwïnya da kïmmö mo dwøŋ, ni cwïnya rämö cooth ki rääm mo ba cöök.
english: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

anywaa: Doo beer kee aani ki dëëra, aano cienø, ni ŋul aani wøk dëër Krictø kiper nyïïmera, na näk tuuŋwa na jø powa.
english: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

anywaa: Kiper gena jø Icriel, ni beeye geni na tïïc Jwøki na nyïïe. Na ajiem, ki luupa tuut, ki ciik Jwøk na cïp, ki lam, ki gïïa buuk wëëga geni,
english: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

anywaa: ni kwäre moa døøŋŋø beege moge. Ni bee ki rege na nywøl Krictø na dhaanhø, eni na Jwøk na en bäät jammi bëët na doo pwøø na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

anywaa: Ni manøgø ba caan gø ni luum Jwøk kär thur kare. Kiper nyïïkwaac Icriel paa jø Icriel bëët,
english: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

anywaa: ni ge patha nyïï Eeberam bëët kiper mana näkge nyïïkwaaye. 'Ba akøp, ni «Aydhak beeye noo cwøl nyeŋ nyïïkwaayï ree.»
english: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø nyootha gø ni patha nyïëdi mo wø nywöli ki ec jaak noo tïmö na nyïï Jwøk, 'ba beege nyïëdi mo wø nywöli ki køør buuk ni wø jïëc ni gena nyïïkwaaye.
english: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

anywaa: Kiper gïna buuk beeye en, ni «Aano duui kanyo näk kar kany nø, kanyøca Ceera ojïti ki dhaanhø ma cïïŋŋö.»
english: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

anywaa: Ni patha manøgø keere. 'Ba Rebëëka thuwø kanya jït yie ki jiy baŋ ŋata näk aciel na näk kwarø ma Aydhak,
english: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

anywaa: këël kanya pootge ni kär nywølø, ni bäŋ gïn mo beer wala mo raac mo ege tïïö,
english: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

anywaa: acaan jïre, ni «Ŋata dwøŋ ŋata thiinh otïnynye.»
english: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

anywaa: Kaa mana gööri, na «A mëër ka Jeekap, ni mäna ki Icøø.» Ni gïnögø atïïc Jwøki kiper nee tier jïër mare bëëde kare kiper cwönne, ni patha kiper tïïe.
english: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo caanø nø? ?Ø doo köö ni mar Jwøk raac? Ba doo løny.
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

anywaa: Kiper ena köö jï Modhe, ni «Ŋato kønya beeye ŋato kønya. Ni ŋato päth cwïnya ki gïre, beeye ŋato päth cwïnya ki gïre.»
english: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ba en ri gïn wø many dhaanhe wala tïïe moe, 'ba beeye køny Jwøk keere.
english: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

anywaa: Kiper wëël Jwøk aköö jï Peerø, ni «Beeye gïn kiree na thïïŋa ïïni kipere, kiper nee teek mara nyoodha ki riï, nee nyeŋŋa tïme ni wïnyö dï piny bäre.»
english: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, eni wø kønya ŋat wø kønye kaa mana manynye, ni ŋat wø cwïny gø døøc mo teek, wø døøye mo teek kaawat mana manynye.
english: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

anywaa: 'Ba kanymør ï pëëö, na «?Aŋø ni poot Jwøki ni jääla dhaanhø en? ?Kiper aŋa na doo dhal mare na manynye?»
english: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

anywaa: ?'Ba ï na dhaanhø, ïïna ŋa na doo dwök baŋ Jwøk? Gïn mo ocwääö doo köö jï ŋata cwääc gø, na «?Aŋø ni cwääyï aani na ennø nø?»
english: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, dïcwäc dääe jïre bäŋ teek bäät odhöönh mo ee göölö ki man cwääe ki dääe ariiø ro odhöönhögø na aciel enø? ?Na aciel ee kadø ni mïërö, ni maya ee cwääö na mar tïïc?
english: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

anywaa: Këël na bëëde ni Jwøk manynya man nyooth wëëye nee teege tïïc ni ŋäc, ena tïmö ni poot bëëdö ni cwïnye ee cïp piny ki gïïo wëërö ki geni na rømø ki raanynyø,
english: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

anywaa: kiper na ajiem mare na päl nyoodhe jï gïïo kønye na kwøŋ jiiŋŋø nee ge jiem.
english: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

anywaa: Ni beeye øøni na cwøle, ni patha ø keerø na en røk jø Juuth, 'ba këël ki røk juurre thuwø.
english: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

anywaa: Kaawat mana caane møn yi wëël Odheea, ni «Jøøa näk patha jiya ocwøla ni jiya. Ni nyaana näk bäŋ omëëye, ocwøla no omëëya.»
english: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

anywaa: «'Ba yi kanya kwøŋ ge cäännö yie kiree, no ‹U patha jiya,› bee geni noo cwøl ni ‹nyïï Jwøa kwøw.› »
english: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

anywaa: 'Ba Aydheea acäänö ki dwøl mo dwøŋ kiper gïr jø Icriel, ni «Këël wäät Icriel doo thööth ni caala akwöny naama dwøŋ, mo nøk keerge beege noo piem.
english: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk luumme ŋøle piny ni laar gø thöör ni ciek.»
english: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

anywaa: Ni manøgø caala luumma køp Aydheea, na kööe, no «Onää Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët, ø käre wëënnö ki köödhi, doo na øøno nø tïmö kaamar Cødam, ni tïïc ø kaamar Gømöra.»
english: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodom, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo caanø nø? Juurre na kär løp køør bëënynyö, bëënynyö ajootge. Ni beeye bëënynyö man wø joot ki køør ŋäädhe.
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

anywaa: 'Ba jø Icriel na løp køør bëënynyö man wø göök ri ciik Jwøk, kär løny jïge ki man thöörge ciigøgø.
english: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

anywaa: ?A per ŋø nø? Beeye kiper na kärge køøre løpø ki køør ŋäädhe, 'ba atïïcge keda gïn mo ogöök ri tïïe. Ni cwanyge tietge ri kïn wø cwany tiel,
english: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

anywaa: kaawat mana gööri, ni «Neennu, akïtha kïdi yi Dhayan, na kïdi mano cwany tiet jiy, na kïnno wëëk ge päänhnhö. 'Ba ŋato jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø, wïïe ba lääy.»
english: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, mana manynya ki cwïnya kiper jø Icriel, ki man wø kwaaya Jwøk kiperge, beeye nee ge piem.
english: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

anywaa: 'Ba marge ŋääa ni ge caya Jwøk døøc, 'ba mar Jwøk kärge ŋiiø.
english: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

anywaa: 'Ba na kucge bëënynyö man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk ni tïmge ni ge caya man jootge bëënynyö marge keerge, dëëtge kärge cïbö køør bëënynyö man wø cïp Jwøki.
english: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

anywaa: Kiper ciik Jwøk bëënna Krictø, kiper nee jiy bëët mo wø ŋäädhö nee ge piem.
english: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe agöödö, ni kööe, ni «Ŋato caath jöör bëënynyö man wø göök ri ciik Jwøk, okwøw ki køør gø.»
english: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

anywaa: 'Ba bëënynyö mana no ogöök ri ŋäädhe wø köö, ni «Kär niï köö ki cwïnyï, na ‹?Aŋa noo ci maal?› » Ni tiere beeye nee Krictø käl piny.
english: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

anywaa: «Wala ‹?Aŋa noo ci kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw?› » Ni tiere beeye nee Krictø tïŋ maal ki yi thøø.
english: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø ni wø caane? Køpa gø, ni «Luubö kare cään ki ïïni ni ena dhiï, ni en cwïnyï.» Ni beeye luum ŋäädhe man wø køpwa.
english: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

anywaa: Kiper ni näk mo iï caanø ki dhiï, ni «Jecu beeye Kwäärö,» ni jïëyï ki cwïnyï ni ena tïŋ Jwøki maal ki yi thøø, ï di piemø.
english: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

anywaa: Kiper dhaanhø wø jïëy ka cwïnye ni läwi jïëc ni mare beer. Ni caan mare ki dhee, ni läwi piem.
english: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

anywaa: Kiper wëël Jwøk wø köö, ni «Ŋato jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø wïïe ba lääy.»
english: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ ajeeny yïthakic jø Juuth ki jøw mo patha jø Juuth. Kiper Uunögø na aciel enø beeye Wääge bëët, ni jap kwärö moe na thööth wø mëëge jø wø cøør nyeŋŋe bëët.
english: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

anywaa: Kiper «Jiy bëët mo wø cøør nyeŋ Wuuö ge di piemø.»
english: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

anywaa: ?'Ba jiy nyeŋŋe a dege gø cwølø nidïï, ŋat mo kärge jïëö ni ŋääthge gø? ?Na a dege gø jïëö ni ŋääthge gø nidïï, ŋat mo luumme kärge wïnynyö bäre bäre? ?A luumme a dege gø wïnynyö nidïï, ni bäŋ ŋat mo okøp gø?
english: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

anywaa: ?A jiy a dege pöö nidïï ni näk mo ge kär jääŋŋö? Kaawat mana gööri, na «A teeŋ öönynya ŋø ni beer en jï jø wø køp luumma nyään na met!»
english: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

anywaa: 'Ba ïthge kärge ciiø bëët ki luumma nyään na met. Kiper acaan Aydheea, ni «?Wui Wuuö Jwøk, aŋa na jïëy ki luumma køpwa?»
