anywaa: ni cwïnye ee pääŋŋö. 'Ba nee dhaagø mo kär nywømø wala nyakøø, eni wø lääŋŋa gïï Wuuö, ki man cïp dëëre ki cwïnye kur keere na mar Jwøk. 'Ba dhaagø mo onywømø, wø lääŋŋa jap pinyi en, ki man tïïc gïï wø met yi cwøre ki ge.
english: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø caana naa kønya uuni, naa ba cem uuni. 'Ba a nyutha u jöö mo beer, kiper nee røgu cïpu jï Wuuö na bäre bäre.
english: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo wïïe ee caarø ni gïna tïïe paa gïna beer na dee tïïö jï nyakøønna dee nywømø, ni cwïnye caya gø døc, ni ba maar wec, mana manynye wär tïïe. Mare paa bääyö. Wär rege nywømge.
english: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wäro mak cwïnye døøc, ni eni kär maa ki teek, ni cwïnye ee mänö ki gïïa dee cayø, ni ee nø cooŋ ki cwïnye, ni mare mëër ki nyaanøgø kaamar dhaanhø ki coki, mare doo beer.
english: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø ŋat wø nywøm nyaana mëëre ki gø, mare beer. Ni ŋat wø kwier nywöm, mare beerra eni.
english: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø wø bëënna cwøre kany wø poot cwøre ni kwøw. 'Ba ni näk mo cwøre othøw, ni dhaagø yie met ki man nywømi, eni doo nywøm ŋata manynye. 'Ba eni doo nywøma dïcwøø mo ena ri Wuuö.
english: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana caara, yie doo meta eni ki mana dee bëëdö keere ni ba nywøm këët. Ni yaa caarø ni Jwïëc Jwøk ena bääta.
english: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane mar luum olämme mo wø ŋaal ni wø cïp jï gïï wø lam, ŋääø bëët ni tiet jammi yøø kwanyø. 'Ba gïn wø kwany dhaanhe wø käla atöör, 'ba mëër beeye wø wëëk jiy tëënnö.
english: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

anywaa: 'Ba nee da ŋat mo wïïe ee caarø ni da gïn mo ŋääe, eni poot bäŋ gïn mo ŋääe keda mana dee gø ŋääö.
english: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaanhø mëër ka Jwøk, eni ŋäc Jwøki.
english: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, mar luum olämme mo wø ŋaal ni wø cïp jï gïï wø lam ni wø cam, ŋääø ni gïn wø lam patha gïn ma adïëri pinyi en, ni bäŋ Jwøk mør, 'ba beeye aciel keere.
english: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na dee gïï mo cøøri ni juu maal ki piny, kaawat man bëëde en ni juu thööth ki kwääri bëët,
english: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

anywaa: ki jïïø, beeye Jwøk aciel keere, na näk Wuuö, eni na ö jammi bëët ki baŋe, ni beeye eni ni bëënnø en, ki Kwäärö aciel ma Jecu Krictø, ŋata ö jammi bëët ki køøre, ni poot na eni ni tïmø ni ø nut en ki køøre.
english: But to us there is but one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Jesus Christ, by whom are all things, and we by him.

anywaa: 'Ba paa jiy bëët ni gïnögø ege nø kwany. 'Ba jø møøk kiper mana näk geno ŋïyö ki gïï wø lam, ge wø poot cämö ni camge no olämme mo ocïbö jï gïn wø lam. Ni räny leec cwïny marge kiper na thiinh ŋäädhe marge.
english: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø camø ø ba wëëk kïth baŋ Jwøk. Ni näk mo ø cämö, bäŋ gïn mo bëënynyi, 'ba ni näk mo ø ba cämö, bäŋ gïn mo raanynye thuwø.
english: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïn en keere, beerra man gwøgu rou, nee pät maru ba tïme na gïn wø ö jøøa näk ŋäädhe marge poot thiinh ni cwanyge tietge ki gø.
english: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.

anywaa: ?Kiper ni näk da ŋat mo joota ïïni, ï na näk tier gïnögø iï kwanyø, niï cämö yi øt gïï wø lam, ni näk eni ŋäädhe mare poot thiinh, aŋø, eni cwïnye ba mïnni ki man cam olämme mo wø ŋaal ni wø cïp jï gïï wø lam?
english: For if any man see thee which hast knowledge sit at meat in the idol's temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

anywaa: 'Ba køøre, eni na cöögu na ŋäädhe mare thiinh enø aränynyö ki køør gïna kwanyï, eni na thøw Krictø kipere.
english: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?

anywaa: Ni tïmu nou tïïya raay dëër Krictø, kiper mana tïme nou tïïya raay dëët nyïïmëëgu, ni raanynyu cwïnyge, kany wø pootge ni ŋäädhe marge thiinh.
english: But when ye sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, ye sin against Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk beeye cam rïŋö wø wëëk coka pädhö, a ba doo cämö ki rïŋö na bäre bäre, kiper ni näk maa cämö, kanymør coka wëëga pädhö.
english: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, a ba bëën dëëra? ?Aŋø, a patha nyïïatwiel? ?A Jecu na näk Kwääyø kära joodø? ?A uuni, u patha gïïa tïïa ki ri Wuuö?
english: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? are not ye my work in the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa patha nyïïatwiel ki jï jø møga, aana nyïïatwiel ki jïïu. Kiper uuna nyuudhi na näk onyoodhø ni aana nyïïatwiel møn ki ri Wuuö.
english: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye luum odwøga jï jøw opëëny aani.
english: Mine answer to them that do examine me is this,

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ba beer jïwa ki man cämwa ni mäthwa?
english: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

anywaa: ?A ba beer jïwa ki mana dewa cäädhö ki määrwa kaawat man wø tïïc nyïïatwieli møga, këël Ciipa, ki nyïïmëëe mo Kwäärö ma Jecu?
english: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, beeye aani ki Barnaba keerwa na doo tïïö ki tïï cam marwa?
english: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni wø tïïö ki tïï koor paac ni jape joode baŋe keere? ?Na aŋa ni wø pïïdhö ki pwöth omøki ni ba cämö ki nyïëdi mo gø? ?Na aŋa ni wø kwaac dïëk ni ba mädhö ki caak?
english: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eateth not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eateth not of the milk of the flock?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, luummögø caana kaawat man wø caan dhaanhe jaak ki teege? ?Luummögø bäŋ wø caan Ciik Jwøki thuwø?
english: Say I these things as a man? or saith not the law the same also?

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö yi wëël Ciik Modhe, ni «Kär dee ŋat mo twöc dhi rwaath kany wø dïne ki beel.» ?Aŋø, luummögø caan Jwøki kaper rwädhe?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn. Doth God take care for oxen?

anywaa: ?Luummögø ba caane kaperø kiree? Ogöörö kiperø møn, ni ŋat wø purö, doo purö ni ee ŋäädhö, ni ö ŋat wø dïn beel, ni dïne ni ee ŋäädhö ni eni jïtö ki kure.
english: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

anywaa: ?Ni näk luup Jwøk na beyø ewa piith cwïnynyu, doo tïmö na gïn mo dwøŋ ni näk wa jïtö ri japu moa tïïyu ki ceŋŋu?
english: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

anywaa: ?'Ba nee jø møga da kurge mo beer jïge ki man lwørge gø baŋu, ba kadha marwa? 'Ba këël na näk enønø, kurwa na doo beer jïwa ki man lwørwa gø baŋu awecwa, ni tïmwa ni wa jwøra gïïa leth, kiper nee bäŋe dïdëët mo kïthwa jöör luumma nyään na met mar Krictø.
english: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni jø wø tïïö yi Øt Jwøk, wø cama caap Øt Jwøk, ni jø wø tïïö kar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte wø jïta ro olämme mo wø cïp bääte?
english: Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, ocaan Kwäärö ni jø wø køp luumma nyään na met, cam marge dege joodø ki køør luumma nyään na met.
english: Even so hath the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

anywaa: 'Ba aani bäŋ gïrpiny aciel mo yaa lwørø ri gïïögø, naa ba göönni kaper nee teeŋ gïïögø mëëk aani. Kiper doo beerra mana daa thøw ki man ö ŋat mørri ni raany par mana di a parø ki gø.
english: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa køpa luumma nyään na met, doo bäŋ gïn maa doo töödö kipere. Kiper køp luummögø ba maara wec. Ni doo tïmö ni raac jïra ni näk maa ba køp luumma nyään na met.
english: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk gïnögø tïïa ki met ec mara, a doo jïtö ki gïn mo mëëk aani. 'Ba ni näk mo ba tïïa ki met ec mara, beeye tïïc mo wëëga aani.
english: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

anywaa: ?Mana beer nø na mëëk aani agïnaŋø? Mana beer na mëëk aani beeye ni kany wø køba luumma nyään na met, bäŋ jammi mo cwøla, ni ba pëënynya kura na doo beer jïra ki pëënynyö ri luumma nyään na met.
english: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ni bëëda ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo bëënna, dëëra atïïa na laŋŋø jï jiy bëët, kiper naa känna kura ki jiy mo thööth.
english: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

anywaa: Ki jï jø Juuth dëëra atïïa keda aana ŋat Juuth, kiper naa känna kura ki jø Juuth. 'Ba ki jï jøøa bëën ciik Jwøk, dëëra atïïa keda aana dhaanhø mo bëënna ciik Jwøk.
english: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï jøøa kuc ciik Jwøk, dëëra atïïa keda aana dhaanhø mo ciik Jwøk kuua. Naa ba kuc ciik Jwøk, 'ba a bëënna ciik Krictø, kiper naa känna kura ki jøøa kuc ciik Jwøk.
english: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï jøøa näk ŋäädhe marge thiinh, dëëra atïïa keda aana dhaanhø mo ŋäädhe mare thiinh, kiper naa känna kura ki jøøa ŋäädhe marge thiinh. Aani, dëëra atïïa na enøgønø ki yïth jammi bëët jï jiy bëët, kiper naa jïta ki jöö ki yïth japøgø bëët nee jø møøk piema.
english: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

anywaa: Ni moøgø bëët tïïa kaper luumma nyään na met, kiper naa tïma ni da kara ri bëënynye.
english: And this I do for the gospel's sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kuyu ni jø wø reŋi, wø läätö bëët, 'ba beeye dhaanhø aciel keere ni wø jïti ki gïn wø mëëk eni? 'Ba reŋu nø ki ŋwïëögø nee ci jïïu.
english: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø tuuk bëët, dëëtge ege mänö ki yïth jammi bëët. Ni gïnögø tïïcge ni ge jïtö ka adun ajiem mo wø laar ränynyö, 'ba øøni, ø tïïö kaper nøø jïtö ki gïn mo ba maar ränynyö.
english: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a ba rïïŋi jaak ki ŋwïëy mo bäŋ tiere, naa bäŋ wø dhööŋi keda dhaanhø mo pööta jamø jaak.
english: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

anywaa: 'Ba a pööta dëëra, ni dïïma gø, kiper naa ba tïma naa patha orømø, a na kwøŋ jø møga pwönynyö.
english: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, a manynya uuni man ŋäyu gø, ni kwäyø akwøŋ en tier pöölö, ni ŋølge naama dwøŋ bëët,
english: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

anywaa: ni lwøk geni bëët na nyuudhi ri Modhe ni ge ena yi pöölö ki yi naam.
english: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

anywaa: Ni camge cam mar Jwøk bëët,
english: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

anywaa: ni maathge maath mar Jwøk bëët. Kiper ge mätha ri Kïn Jwøk na cäädhö køørge. Ni kïnnögø beeye Krictø.
english: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk enøgønø, thööthge yi Jwøk kär mïnnö ki ge; ni ö geni ni dïïr wïthge dï paap.
english: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane gïïögø beege nyuuthe kiperø, ni köömma øøni nøø ba manynyø raay kaawat mana tïïcge.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

anywaa: Käru tïmö nou lämö ki gïï wø lam kaawat mana tïïc jø møøki dïge. Kaawat mana gööri, ni «Jøøgø gena pï piny ni cämge ni mäthge, ni öge maal baŋ meeŋ.»
english: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, ø ba doo tïmö ni øøna jø luuy kaawat mana tïïc jø møøki dïge, na ö jiyi ma kume ma pïërariiø kurdäk ni thøwge ki dïcäŋ aciel.
english: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

anywaa: Øøni Wuuö Jwøk ba døø päänynyö, keda mana tïïc jø møøki dïge, na nääŋŋi ya thwöre.
english: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

anywaa: Ni ba dwaallø, keda mana tïïc jø møøki dïge, na raanynyi ya dïräänyi.
english: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø atägö dëëtge na nyuuthe mo köömma geni, ni gööri piny kiper nee ø pwönyge, ø ni bëëdö ni karø cään en ki kanyo cuŋ pinynyi yie.
english: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋat mo ee caarø ni eni cuŋŋa kare wär ree gwøe, kiper ni näk mo ree ba gwøe, kanymør pädhö.
english: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ päänynyö mo tägi dëëtu mo patha man wø tägi dëër dhaanhø. 'Ba Jwøk dwøre ba dak, nou ba wëëk päänynyö ki päänynyö mo kaala teek maru. 'Ba kanyo pääny uuni, uuno mooe ki jöö man bøthu ki gø thuwø, kiper nee maar lønyø jïïu ki man jïënynyu gø.
english: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u no omëëya, bëëdu ni karu bäär ki wøør gïï wø lam.
english: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

anywaa: A cäänö ka uuni ni uuna jiy mo wïthu leer. Uuni ki dëëtu, ŋølu luumma caana piny.
english: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, athöönh gwïëth man wø dwøgø pwøc kipere, paa dwätö eni ri rem Krictø? ?A møø man wø pøtø, paa dwätö eni dëër Krictø?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?

anywaa: 'Ba kiper na näk beeye møø aciel, ø na thööth, øøna tïmö na dëël aciel, kiper øøni bëët, ø wø nywaaga møgøgø na aciel enø.
english: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

anywaa: Neennu tïï jø Icriel mø. ?Aŋø, jø wø cam olämme mo wø cïp, ge ba jïëc gïn wø cïp olämme bääte manøgø thuwø?
english: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø ni caana? ?Kööa no olämme mo wø ŋaal mo wø cïp jï gïï wø lam, a gïrpiny? ?Wala gïn wø lam a gïrpiny?
english: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

anywaa: Patha eni. Man køba beeye en, olämme mo wø cïp jø wø kuc Jwøk, ge mooya anäge ni patha Jwøk. Aani, a ba many uuni nou nywääu ka anäge.
english: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.

anywaa: Ba doo løny jïïu ki man mäthu ya athöönh Kwäärö, ni mäthu ya athöönh anäge. Ni ba løny jïïu ki man cammu cam mar Kwäärö ki cam mar anäge.
english: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord's table, and of the table of devils.

anywaa: ?Kwäärö døø wëëga këëyö? ?Aŋø, teeka øøni ki eni?
english: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

anywaa: Jammi bëët doo maara tïïc, 'ba jammi bëët bäŋ wø kunyö. Jammi bëët doo maara tïïc, 'ba paa jammi bëët ni wø wëëk ø tëënnö.
english: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat ŋäc dëëre keere, 'ba watge wär ŋääe thuwø.
english: Let no man seek his own, but every man another's wealth.

anywaa: Cammu gïn mo oŋeeø kar ŋïëw rïŋö nou ba pëëö kiper gïno en cwïnynyu,
english: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

anywaa: kiper «Piny bäre ki jammi bëët moa en yie beeye mo Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: For the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou cwøl ŋat mo kär jïëy cwølø baŋ cam ni yïthu met ki man cou, gïno cïp nyïmmu, wär cammu ni bäŋ pïëc kiper gïno en cwïnynyu.
english: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo köö ki uuni, ni «Gïn en acïp no olämi,» kanyøgø nø kär nou cama gø kiper mana caani ya ŋatøgø jïïu, wala kiper mana en cwïny.
english: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord's, and the fulness thereof:

anywaa: Naa ba wäŋ cwïnynyu, 'ba beeye gïno en cwïnye. ?Aperŋø na ö ŋat mørri na dee cään aani ki mana daa tïïö ki mana daa ba tïïö kiper mana en cwïnye?
english: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man's conscience?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk maa cämö ni dwøga met ec baŋ Jwøk, aŋø na di nyeŋŋa waa kiper gïna dwøga met ec kipere?
english: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk mou cämö wala u mädhö, wala gïn wäro tïïyu jaak, wäru tïïyu bëët nou jiema Jwøk.
english: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.

anywaa: Kär cwïny jø Juuth, ki cwïny jø mo patha jø Juuth, wala cwïny jø acooŋ Jwøk, wëëgu ränynyö,
english: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:

anywaa: keda mara ni manynya man døøya yïth jiy mo met ki yïth jammi bëët mo wø tïïa, naa ba caar mara a keera. 'Ba a caara gïr jiy mo thööth, nee ge piem.
english: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

anywaa: Tïmu nou ŋwaala mara, keda man wø ŋwaala mar Krictø.
english: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.

anywaa: Uuna pwøa kiper mana lääŋŋu aani ki yïth jammi bëët, ni gwøgu kööŋŋe kaawat mana wëëga ge uuni.
english: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.

anywaa: 'Ba a manynya man ŋäyu gø, ni dïcwøø man nø bëënna Krictø, ni dhaagø bëënna cwøre, ni ö Krictø ni bëën Jwøk.
english: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcwønno wäro lämö wala køpa dwør Jwøk ni wïïe ee loobø, lääa wïïe.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋo wäro lämö wala køpa dwør Jwøk ni wïïe paa ee loobø, lääa wïïe. Eni mare röömi ka mana dee öö ni wïïe ogwäär wøk.
english: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaagø okweer ki man loop wïïe, doo beerra mana dee jïëye nyaarø. 'Ba ni näk nyaar ki gwän wøk beege gïï wø määnö ki jï dhaagø, wär eni wïïe loobe.
english: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcwøø ba doo løny ki man loop wïïe, kiper mana tïme ni ena kïdö na ajiem mar Jwøk. 'Ba dhaagø beeye ajiem dïcwøø.
english: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.

anywaa: Kiper dïcwøø ba cwääca dëër dhaagø, 'ba beeye dhaagø na cwääc ki ri dëër dïcwøø.
english: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

anywaa: Ni dïcwøø ba cwääc kaper dhaagø, 'ba beeye dhaagø na cwääc kiper dïcwøø.
english: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, dhaagø wïïe dee loobø kiper nyïïatwiet maal, ni nyootha gø ni dhaagø ena tier teek mar dïcwøø.
english: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk enøgønø, ki kur Wuuö, doo bäŋ dhaagø onää bäŋ dïcwøø, ni doo bäŋ dïcwøø onää bäŋ dhaagø.
english: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø cwääc ni käla dëër dïcwøø, ni ö dïcwøø thuwø ni tïme ni nywøla dhaage. Ni jammi bëët ööi ki baŋ Jwøk.
english: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.

anywaa: ?Ennø, luummögø nëëne nidïï ki baŋu? ?Beeye gïn mo beer jï dhaagø ki man lam Jwøk ni wïïe patha ee loobø?
english: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, u bäŋ wø pwöny gïn wø en cwïnynyu ni beeye gïn mo määnö jï dïcwøø ki man kääde ki jïër mo bäyö?
english: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaagø käära jïër mo bäyö, beeye gïr ajiem jïre. Kiper jïëye amëëk eni na rëëbi.
english: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

anywaa: 'Ba nee da ŋat mo manynya man pïëme kiper gïn, bäŋ jöö mør mo ŋäcwa, këël ki yïth acook Jwøk.
english: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

anywaa: 'Ba luup caana jïïu en, a ba pwøc uuni, kiper dwätö maru man wø dwätu kanya ciel paa dwän bëënynyö, 'ba beeye dwän rääö.
english: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.

anywaa: Kiper mana dïkwøŋ na wïnynya, akøp ni kany wø cooŋŋu dëëtu ni uuna acooŋ Jwøk, ni da apääk dïïu, ni jïëa gø ki mo thiinh.
english: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

anywaa: Kiper apääk atïïyu møn, kiper nee jøøa näk marge adïëri nee ŋec dïïu.
english: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø cooŋŋu dëëtu kanya ciel, atïmö ni paa cam mar Kwäärö ni wø cammu.
english: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord's supper.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø näk kar cam, ŋati man nø laara pööth ri cam mare keere ni cam gø, ni wati maya onäk käci, ni ö maya ni meere.
english: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jïïu bäŋ mïëri mo cämu yïthge ni mädhu? ?Wala u jøøŋŋa acooŋ Jwøk, ni lääu wïth jøøa jïge bäŋgø? ?Agïnaŋø noo caana jïïu? ?Aŋø, u daa pwøø kiper manøgø? Jïra bäär, u ba daa pwøø.
english: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

anywaa: Kiper gïna jooda baŋ Kwäärö beeye na mëëga u thuwø, ni Kwäärö ma Jecu, wääna ö eni na cïbi ceŋ nyïïmän, alwötö ki møø.
english: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:

anywaa: 'Ba na nø dwøk met ec, møø apøte, ni kööe, ni «Man beeye dëëra, na pøti kiperu. Gïn wär tïïyu nou para aani.»
english: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø athöödhi alwøre kanya lønyge ki cam, ni kööe, na «Athöönhnhi beeye athöönh luumma nyään na tuut ki køør remma. Tïïyu gïn kany wäro maathu gø, nou para aani.»
english: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wäro cammu møgi ni mäthu ya athöönhnhi, u køpa thøw Kwäärö ma Jecu gøøc mano ööe.
english: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋat wäro cam møk Kwäärö ma Jecu, ni mäthe ya athöönhnhe ni wïïe käre caarø, eni di jäälö kiper mana päät dëër Kwäärö ki remme.
english: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man dëëre wär caare keere. Køøre eno luuny cam ki møgøgø ni mäthe ya athöönhnhögø.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato wäro cämö ni mädhe ni bäŋ gïn mo ee caarø kiper dëërögø, cam mare ki maath mare käla ajäla bääte.
english: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord's body.

anywaa: Ni beeye na tïm jø mo thööthi dïïu ni jägö ni tuu, ni thøw jø møøki.
english: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.

anywaa: 'Ba onää dëëtø yøø jäälö na adïëri døc, ø ba doo jäälö.
english: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö Wuue wø jääl øøni, pwönynya øøni, kiper nee ø ba jääl ki jø piny na aciel.
english: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, kany wø cooŋŋu røgu kiper cam, beerra man jïtu røgu.
english: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.

anywaa: 'Ba nee da ŋat mo dëëre da käc, wär eni cäme paac. Kiper ni näk mou ba tïïö na enøgønø, tïmö nou cooŋa acooŋ ajäla. 'Ba mar jammi møga, uuno nyuunhnha ki jöö kanyo ööa.
english: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, nyïïmera, a ba many man bëëdu ni muuce mo Jwïëc Jwøk kuyu.
english: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ni kanya bëëdu ni luum Jwøk kuyu, wïthu amaaŋŋi ki uutjïëthe møøk ma teeŋi, ni wøørru gïï wø lam ni wø ba cäänö.
english: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a manynya man ŋäyu gø, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo cäänö ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk mo köö, ni «Jecu cien.» Ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo maara köö, ni «Jecu beeye Kwäärö,» ni näk ba caan ka ri Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane da muuce ma teeŋi, 'ba poot na Jwïëy aciel ni wø cïp geni.
english: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

anywaa: Ni da jïëth køny ma teeŋi, 'ba poot na Wuuö aciel.
english: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

anywaa: Ni da jïëth tïïe ma teeŋi, 'ba poot na Jwøk aciel, ŋat wø cïp ge bëët jï ŋati man nø.
english: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.

anywaa: Ni ŋati man nø onyuunh Jwïëc Jwøki ki muuy, kiper jiy bëët nee bëënyge.
english: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

anywaa: Ŋat mør wø wëëga cäänö mar leec wïc ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk. 'Ba ŋat mør wø wëëga ŋäc jammi ni poot na køør Jwïëyögø.
english: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mør wø wëëk Jwïëyögø ŋäädhe. Ni ö ŋat mørri ni wëëgi muuy mar riem täwe, ni poot na Jwïëyögø na aciel enø.
english: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mør wø wëëga tïïc tïïe mo rëëma ec. Ni ö ŋat mørri ni wëëgi køp dwør Jwøk. 'Ba ŋat mør wø wëëga teek ki man ŋec juu. Ni ö ŋat mørri ni wëëgi caan teeŋ dhøgi møøk. 'Ba ŋat mør wø wëëga teek ki man dwøk tiet luup dhøgi ma teeŋi.
english: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø bëët ööi ka køør Jwïëyögø na aciel enø, ŋat wø pääŋ japøgø jï ŋati man nø, kaawat man wø manynye.
english: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëët dëëlli na aciel en ni dëëre da thäŋi mo thööth; ni poot na dëël aciel, këël na bëët thäŋi moe ni thööth, Krictø thuwø poot na enøgønø.
english: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.

anywaa: Kiper øøna lwøk bëët na nyuudhi ki ri Jwïëy aciel nøø tïmø na dëël aciel, nee jø Juuth wala jø mo patha jø Juuth, ki laaŋe wala jøøa bëëdö ki wïthge. Ni wëëk ø maath bëët ki ri Jwïëy aciel.
english: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.

anywaa: Kiper dëël paa ocwääö na thääŋö aciel, 'ba ree da thäŋi mo thööth.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo tielø köö, na «A ba en ri dëël kiper na näk maa patha cenø,» ba doo tïïc gïnögø ni ba en ri dëël man thiinh en.
english: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ïth köö, na «A ba en ri dëël, kiper na näk maa patha waŋ,» ba doo tïïc gïnögø ni ba en ri dëël man thiinh en.
english: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?

anywaa: ?Onää dëël ki kare bäre beeye waŋ, luup a dee gø wïnynyö ki kaa? ?'Ba onää dëël ki kare bäre beeye ïth, a dee ŋwääö ki kaa?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëëde en, Jwøk thäŋi bëët ee kïthö na kwörge ri dëël. Ni thääŋö man nø ee kïth kanya manynye.
english: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.

anywaa: ?Onää dëël a thääŋö aciel bäre, dëël a dee en kaa?
english: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëëde en, da thäŋi mo thööth, 'ba poot na dëël aciel.
english: But now are they many members, yet but one body.

anywaa: Kiper waŋ ba doo maara köö jï cenø, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo manynya baŋï.» Wala wïc thuwø ba doo köö jï tiel, ni «Bäŋ gïn mo manynya baŋu.»
english: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö ni thäŋi mo dëël moa nëënö ni keda jägö, atïmö ni letha perge.
english: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:

anywaa: Ni ö thäŋi mo dëël mo wø tagi, ni tïmge ni ø wøøra ge døc. Ni tïm thäk dëëtø moa ba mïërö ki neen, ni ø gwøga ge døc.
english: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe gïn mo tïïø kiper thäk dëëtø moa mïërö ki neen. 'Ba Jwøk dëël atïïe ni cïpa ajiem mana dwøŋŋa eni jï thääŋ dëël mana näk otaaø,
english: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe apääk ri dëël bäre, ni tïm thäŋi bëët ni käära rege ki dwøl aciel.
english: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk thääŋö aciel da gïn mo ee jwørø, wø jwøra ge bëët na aciel. 'Ba ni näk thääŋö aciel owøørø, wø mïnna yïthge bëët na aciel.
english: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, uuna dëër Krictø, ni ŋati man nø ena thääŋö dëër gø.
english: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk aröönyö ki jiy ya acooŋ Jwøk. Dïkwøŋ beege nyïïatwieli, rietge beege nyïïkuk Jwøk, dääge beege dïpööye, køøre beege jø wø tïïc gïï mo rëëma ec, køøre ki muuy mar riem täwe, ki dïkunynye, ki dïnyuuthe, ki jøøa wëëk teek ki man cäänge ki teeŋ dhøgi møøk.
english: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gena nyïïatwieli bëët? ?Gena nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët? ?Gena dïpööye bëët? ?Ge wø tïïya tïï gïï mo rëëma ec bëët?
english: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

anywaa: ?Muuy mar riem täwe ena jïge bëët? ?Ge wø cäänö ki teeŋ dhøgi møøk bëët? ?Ge wø dwögö ki teeŋ dhøgi møøk bëët? Jïre bäär.
english: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, beerra man manynyu muuce moa døøŋŋø geni ki cwïnynyu bäre. 'Ba u poot nyuunhnha nyuunhnhö ki jöö mør mo beerra eni.
english: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa cäänö ka dhøk jiy wala ki mo nyïïatwiet maal, ni jïra bäŋ mëër, a caala gïn mo darri jaak, wala okööt mo di pöötö.
english: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo jïra da muuy mar køp dwør Jwøk, ni gïïa näk tietge okwøŋ kan bëët yaa kwanyø, ni jammi bëët ŋääa, ni jïra da ŋäädhe mo päl døc mo løny ki man daaa kïte ki gø, 'ba jïra bäŋ mëër, bäŋ gïn duua.
english: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk japa bëët yaa muuö, ni wëëga dëëra waaŋ, 'ba jïra bäŋ mëër, bäŋ gïn jooda.
english: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

anywaa: Mëër kunyö ni ba jøøm. Mëër ba këëö ni ba töödö.
english: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

anywaa: Ni eni ba koorri, ni dhee ba teek. Mëër bäŋ wø ŋäc dëëre keere, ni ba wëëyi, ni gïï raay mo wø tïïc dëëre ba keee.
english: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

anywaa: Ni yie ba mïnni ki gïï mo reyø, 'ba yie wø mïnni ka gïn ma adïëri.
english: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;

anywaa: Mëër rïëpa jammi bëët, ni jïëc jammi bëët, ni ŋääth jammi bëët mo poot ena nyïm, ni jïëny jammi bëët.
english: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

anywaa: Mëër ba cuŋ. 'Ba køp dwør Jwøk jøøl. Ni muuy mar cäänö ki dhøgi møøk ocuŋ. Ni ki man ŋäc jammi, jøøl.
english: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa ŋääø, paa othur karge. Ni marø wø købø dwør Jwøk, paa othur kare.
english: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö mano näk othur kare, mana näk patha othur kare jøøl.
english: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.

anywaa: Kanya pooda ni aana nyilaal, a cäänö ka luum lal, naa caara acaac lal, ni tiet luup caana ka cään lal. 'Ba kanya tïma ni aana dïcwøø mo dwøŋ, jap lal awiia.
english: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane jammi poot nëënö ni jïrri yi räŋi, 'ba kanyo tïme na kanyøca, dëëtø oneetø ni ø neeta nyeŋŋø. 'Ba kawaane a ŋäya mo thiinh keere, 'ba kanyøca oŋääa bäre, keda man ŋäc aani døøc en.
english: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, ŋäädhe, ki ŋäädhe mar nyïm, ki mëër, gïï na adäk ii, bëëdö ni nut. 'Ba mana dwøŋŋa eni dï gïïögø beeye mëër.
english: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

anywaa: Këëllu wïthu køør mëër, ni manynyu muuce mo Jwïëc Jwøk døc, ni kadha man tïmu nou køpa dwør Jwøk røk.
english: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø cäänö ki dhøk mør, ba cään jiy, 'ba cäänna Jwøk, kiper na bäŋe dhaanhø mo wïny mare, 'ba eni cara luup mo tietge okanø ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.

anywaa: 'Ba løøk maya, ŋat wø køp dwør Jwøk, cäänna jiy ni wëëga ge tëënnö, ni cøma cwïnyge, ni cøga geni.
english: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø cäänö ki dhøk mør, wø wëëga dëëre tëënnö e keere. 'Ba ŋat wø køp dwør Jwøk wø wëëga acooŋ Jwøk tëënnö.
english: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.

anywaa: A doo naa manynya man cäänu ki dhøgi møøk, u bëët, 'ba mana pere letha eni røk beeye ki man køpu dwør Jwøk. Kiper ŋat wø køp dwør Jwøk, wø dwøŋŋa eni ki ŋat wø cäänö ki dhøk mør, 'ba ŋat mo cäänö ki dhøk mør beer ki kany wø näk da dhaanhø mo dwøga luupe, kiper nee acooŋ Jwøk tëënne.
english: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

anywaa: ?'Ba kawaane nyïïmera, ni näk maa ööa baŋu naa cäänö ka dhøgi møøk, naa ba muuny uuni ki gïn mo onyoodhø, wala gïn mo dou ŋääö, naa ba køp dwør Jwøk jïïu, wala pwöc, agïnaŋø noo kwanynyu baŋa?
english: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

anywaa: 'Ba këëlla jap tuuk ni bäŋ jwïëy dëëtge en, teeŋ kaa opelø ki thoom, ni näk mo jwöŋi ni bäŋ dwøl mo met mo wïnyi, ?teeŋ duudöca a di ŋäc dhaanhe nidïï, wala ena duuda ŋø?
english: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk tuuŋ di koodhø ni dwøre ba ŋec, aŋa noo jek dëëre kiper leny?
english: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?

anywaa: 'Ba maru poot na enøgønø; ?ni näk mou cäänö ka dhøk mør mo ba wïnynyi, gïna caan oŋäyi ya dhaanhe nidïï? Kiper u tïmö nou cäänö yi jamø jaak.
english: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.

anywaa: Yaa caarø ni da dhøgi ma teeŋi mo thööth dï piny man, ni bäŋe ya aciel mo bäŋ tiere.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhøøca kuua, a tïmö ni aana jur jï ŋata cäänö, ni tïm ŋatøca na jur ki jïra.
english: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba maru poot na enøgønø. 'Ba kiper mana tïmu ni cwïnynyu päl kiper nyuuthe mo Jwïëc Jwøk, putu cwïnynyu cïp ra acooŋ Jwøk nee tëënne.
english: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ŋat wäro cäänö ki dhøk mør doo lämö kiper nee jïte ki teek ki man nyooth tier gø.
english: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk maa lämö ki dhøk mør, beeye jwïëya wø lämö, 'ba bäŋ gïn jooda ki wïïa.
english: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo tïïa? Aano lämö ki jwïëya, ni läma ki wïïa thuwø. Ni wära duut ki jwïëya, ni wära ki wïïa thuwø.
english: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

anywaa: ?Ni näk paa enøgønø, ni näk miï pwøya Jwøk ki jwïëyï, ŋat mo path okööe nidïï, ni «Enøgønø» ki køør met iï na dwøgï, ni gïïa carï kuue?
english: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?

anywaa: Kiper kanymør met yiï iï dwøgø na wøp døøc, 'ba dhaanhø maya bäŋ gïn joode mo tëënne ki gø.
english: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk apwøa kiper na cääna ki dhøgi møøk naa kaala u bëët.
english: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk enøgønø, doo beerra eni jïra ki man cääna ki luup abïïc mo ŋääa ki wïïa ya acooŋ Jwøk kiper nee jø møga pwönynya, ki mana daa caan luup ma kume apaar ki dhøk mør.
english: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.

anywaa: 'Ba, nyïïmera, kär acaara maru tïmö na acaac obwöre. Bëëdu ni uuno obwöre mo marr ki kur raay, ni tïmu nou døøŋŋø ki kur acaara.
english: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö yi Wëël Jwøk, ni Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni «Beeye ki dhøk jiy mo path ki dhøk juurre noo cäänna jøøi ki gø. 'Ba këël ni näk ma enøgønø, mara ba wïnyge.»
english: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, dhøgi møøk paa nyuudhi mo cïp kaper jøøa näk ojïëy, 'ba cïp kaper jøøa näk kär jïëy. Ni køp dwør Jwøk, paa kiper jøøa näk kär jïëy, 'ba beeye kiper jøøa näk ojïëy.
english: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ni näk ma acooŋ Jwøk bäre odwät kanya ciel, ni ö jø acooŋa bëët ni cäänge ki dhøgi møøk, ni ö jøøa pathi wala jiy mo patha ojïëy ni dunyge, ?aŋø, ge ba köö ni uuna bøøre?
english: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou køpa dwør Jwøk bëët, ni ö ŋat mo kär jïëy wala ŋat mo path ni dunynye, eni cwïnye opädhi ki raaye kiper mana caange bëët, ni ö gïna en cwïnye ni pëënynyi jøw bëëti,
english: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

anywaa: ni ö gïïa en cwïnye ni ŋääi. 'Ba køøre nø, Jwøk owøøre ni täärnyïme ee këël piny, ni put gø caan, na «Adïëri møn, Jwøk ena dïïu.»
english: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo tïïø nø, nyïïmera? Kany wø dwätu kanya ciel, ni ŋat mør jïre da duut, ni dhaanhø mør jïre da pwöc, ni dhaanhø mør da gïn mo onyoodhø jïre, ni maya cäänö ka dhøk mør, wala da luubö mo di dwøgø, wär japøgø bëët tïïc nou wëëga acooŋ Jwøk tëënnö.
english: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo cäänö ki dhøk mør, wär tïme na jiy ariiø keerge, wala adäk, ni bäŋe mør këët. Ni ŋati man nø dïge da kare mo cäänne yie. 'Ba wär dhaanhø aciel dwöge.
english: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk bäŋ ŋat mo dwögi, wär lïŋge bëët ya acooŋ Jwøk, ni tïm ŋati man nø ni cäänna dëëre keere ki Jwøk.
english: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.

anywaa: Wär nyïïkuk Jwøk ariiø wala adägö køpge dwør Jwøk, ni ö jiyi møga ni cekge ïthge ki gïïo caan.
english: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da gïn mo onyoodhø jï dhaanhø mør mo opï piny, ŋata cäänö wär lïŋe.
english: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.

anywaa: Kiper køp dwør Jwøk løny jïïu bëët no oceele oceele, kiper nee jiy bëët kwänyge ni cøm cwïnyge.
english: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.

anywaa: Kiper jwïëc nyïïkuk Jwøk leŋa dööt nyïïkuk Jwøk.
english: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk paa Jwø wø kier wïc, 'ba beeye Jwø bëët-mëër.
english: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.

anywaa: 'Ba mään doo bëëdö ni ge lïŋö yïth acook Jwøk bëët keda man wø tïïc yïth acooŋe bëët mo jø Jwøk. Kiper ge paa owëëk cäänö, 'ba ge doo bëëdö ni bäŋ dööti jïge, kaawat mana caani ya ciik Jwøki thuwø.
english: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da gïn mo manyge nee ŋäcge, wär cwøwge pëënyge mïëri. Kiper beeye gïr laac wïc ki man cään dhaage ya acooŋ Jwøk.
english: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

anywaa: ?Uuna kööu nidïï? ?Aŋø, beeye uuni na täk luum Jwøki dïïu na bëëde, wala beeye uuni keeru na pïïc luummögø baŋu?
english: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo dëëre ee caarø ni ena nyikuŋ Jwøk, wala jïre da muuy mar Jwïëc Jwøk, beerra man jïëc gïn ni gööra jïïu en, na gïn mo cema Wuue.
english: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo gïnögø ba jïëe, eni kär jïëc thuwø.
english: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, nyïïmera, manynyu man køpu dwør Jwøk ki cwïnynyu bäre, ni ba mänu cäänö ki dhøgi møøk.
english: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët doo tïïö ni mïërö na karge.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, nyïïmera, a para wïthu ki luumma nyään na met na køba jïïu, na jïëyu, ni cuŋŋu ree,
english: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

anywaa: ni beeye mana piem uuni ki køøre, ni näk mo you maa ni teek. 'Ba ni näk ba magu ni teek, ŋäädhe maru tïmö ni bäŋ tiere.
english: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

anywaa: 'Ba mana pere letha eni beeye na cïba jïïu, ni beeye mana wëëk aani thuwø, ni Krictø athuunh raayø, kaawat mana no ogöörö yïth Weet Jwøk,
english: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

anywaa: ni koonyi, ni tïŋi maal ri dää nïne, kaawat mana no ogöörö yïth Weet Jwøk,
english: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

anywaa: ni nyooth ree jï Ciipa. Køøre dëëre anyuth bääŋi na näk apaar kurriiø.
english: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

anywaa: Køør manøgø, dëëre anyuth nyïïmëëe mo kaala dïpe abïïyö ni ge ena kanya ciel, jøø ni thööthge poot kwøw en, këël na thøø møøki dïge.
english: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre dëëre anyuth Jeemeth. Køør manøgø, dëëre anyuth nyïïatwieli bëët.
english: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba køør moøgø bëët nø, dëëre anyuth aani thuwø, a na näk caala dhaanhø mo obwön wøk.
english: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

anywaa: Kiper thiinhnha kara døc dï nyïïatwieli, naa patha orømø ki man cwøl aani ni nyïïatwiel, kiper aana gëëmö ka acooŋ Jwøk.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye met ec mar Jwøk na tïïc aani ni aana dhaanhø en. 'Ba met yie na nyuth aani paa oballe jaak. 'Ba atïmö ni tïïö aani døc naa kaala geni. 'Ba paa aani, 'ba beeye met yi Jwøk ni wø tïïö dëëra.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nee aani wala geni, wa wø pöö, ni ö uuni ni jïëyu.
english: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

anywaa: ?'Ba kawaane ni näk Krictø okøbø jïïu no otïŋ maal ki yi thøø, jø møøk dïïu a dege köö nidïï ni bäŋ duun wøk ki yi thøø?
english: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk bäŋ duun wøk ki yi thøø nø, Krictø kär tïŋ maal.
english: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Krictø kär tïŋ maal nø, luupa køpwa beeye oballe jaak, ni ŋäädhe maru oballe thuwø.
english: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

anywaa: Ni näk beeye adïëri møn ni jø wø thøw bäŋ wø tïŋ maal, waana tïmö ni wa caana tööt jaak bäät Jwøk, kiper mana caanwa gïr Jwøk, ni eni Krictø atïŋ maal ki yi thøø, ni eni kär tïŋ maal.
english: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk jø wø thøw bäŋ wø tïŋ maal nø, Krictø kär tïŋ maal.
english: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Krictø kär tïŋ maal, ŋäädhe maru bäŋ tiere, nou poot ena yïth raayu.
english: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

anywaa: Ni ö jøøgø thuwø na thøw ni ena kur Krictø ni ränyge.
english: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk øøni ni en dëër Krictø, ø ŋäätha kwøw man en keere, øøna jiy mo cwïny doo pädhö ki gïrø døc, ni bäŋ jiy mo oränynyö kaamarø.
english: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn Krictø atïŋ maal ki yi thøø, ni beeye ŋata bwödhö ki duun wøk ki yi thøø dï jøøa näk othøw.
english: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni thøø ööi ka køør dhaanhø aciel, kaawat manøgø thuwø duun wøk ki yi thøø aöö ki køør dhaanhø aciel.
english: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

anywaa: 'Ba keda man wø thøw jiyi bëët ki kur Adam, kaawat manøgø thuwø, jiy bëët owëëk kwøw ki kur Krictø.
english: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

anywaa: 'Ba tïŋ maal ki yi thøø da kare kiper jiy bëët. Dïkwøŋ beeye Krictø na bwödhö ki tïŋ maal, 'ba kanyo ö Krictø, beeye kar jøøa en dëëre ki man tïŋ ge maal.
english: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ's at his coming.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgøøni beeye cuŋ piny, kanyo ö Krictø noo dwøk bura jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö, køør mano raany bure bëët, ki kwääri, ni bäŋ teek mør këët.
english: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

anywaa: Kiper Krictø obëëdö na nyeya këël mano ö Jwøki noo tïïc nyïïmänne bëët ni bëëdö tiete.
english: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

anywaa: 'Ba nyimän mano raanynyi na aŋuudi beeye thøø.
english: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

anywaa: «Kiper Jwøk jammi bëët adïïme ni wëëk ge bëëtö tiere.» 'Ba kanya caani, ni «Jammi bëët odïïmö ni bëëdö tiere,» ŋäc ni Jwøk na cïp jammi bëët nee bëëtge tier Krictø, eni ki dëëre ba en tier Krictø.
english: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted which did put all things under him.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïm jammi bëët ni ena tiere, yi kar kanyøca, Wäädö ki dëëre thuwø otïmö ni ena tier ŋata cïp jammi bëët tiere, nee Jwøk tïme ni beeye Jwøka eni keere jï jammi bëët.
english: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk patha enøgønø, aperŋø ni wø ö jø møøki wø lwøk dëëtge na nyuudhi ki kur jøøa näk othøw? ?A ni näk jøøa näk othøw ba tïŋ maal na bäre bäre, aŋø ni wø ö jø møøki wø lwøk dëëtge ki kurge?
english: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

anywaa: ?A waani nø, aŋø ni wø enwa dhøk gïï mo leth cooth en?
english: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

anywaa: Aani, a wø ena um thøø cooth, nyïïmera, ni gïnögø caana kiper atöör mara na en cwïnya kiperu ki køør Krictø Jecu, eni na Kwääyø.
english: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

anywaa: ?Ni näk mo aano këëdö ki lääy yi Epeca kaawat man wø tïïc dhaanhø jaak, a bunna ŋø nø noo jooda? Ni näk jøøa no othøw ba tïŋ maal, «Beerra man cämø ni mädhø jaak, kiper diøø ø thøw.»
english: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

anywaa: Kär wïthu maaŋŋi. Dwätö ki nyïïawäädi mo reyø beeye wø raany bëëtö mo beer.
english: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

anywaa: Cäŋu wïthu caarrø, ni ba bääyu këët. Kiper jø møøk bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge kiper Jwøk. Ni gïn caana naa lääa wïthu.
english: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

anywaa: 'Ba kanymør da ŋat mo pëëö, ni «?Jøøa näk othøw otïŋi maal nidïï? ?Na a dëël mo nyïëdi noo en dëëtge?»
english: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

anywaa: Nyie, ï ni bäŋ wïc en! Kunhnhö man wø piithï, ba tuy ni näk mo kär thøw.
english: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

anywaa: Ni kanyo pïïdhï, ï ba piith dëël mano tuy, 'ba beeye waŋ kunhnhö keere, nee abäy wala teeŋ beel møga.
english: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wø cïpö ki dëël jï gø, keda mana manynye, ni teeŋ kunhnhö man nø, dëëre ena kur keere.
english: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

anywaa: Kiper rïŋ dëëlli bëët ba röömi. 'Ba da teeŋ rïŋ dëël aciel jï jiy, ni maya ena jï lääy, ni maya ena jï weny, ni ö maya ni en jï rec.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

anywaa: Ni da dëëlli mo maal, ni dee dëëlli mo piny. 'Ba ajiem mar dëëlli mo maal ena kur keere, na ajiem mar dëëlli mo piny ena kur keere.
english: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

anywaa: Teeŋ ajiem aciel ena jï cäŋ, ni teeŋ ajiem maya ena jï dwääy, ni ö teeŋ ajiemmi maya ni en jï ceer. Kiper cëërö man nø, ajieme ena kur keere.
english: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

anywaa: 'Ba duun wøk ki yi thøø poot na enøgø thuwø. Dëël mano koony piny beeye dëël man wø bëën thøø, 'ba otïŋ maal na dëël mo ba bëën thøø këët.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

anywaa: Eni wø koonya piny na gïn mo otaaø, ni tïŋi maal ka ajiem. Eni wø koonya piny ni jääk, ni tïŋi maal ni eni teek.
english: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

anywaa: Eni wø koonya piny na dëël man wø kwøw ki kwøw mar piny man en, ni tïŋi maal na jwïëy mo da dëël. 'Ba ni näk da dëël man wø kwøw ki kwøw mar piny man en, da jwïëy thuwø mo da dëël.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

anywaa: Beeye na gööri na en nø, ni «Dhaanhø mana dïkwøŋ na näk Adam atïmö ni ree da jwïëy mo kwøw,» 'ba Adam mana en cään atïmö na jwïëy man wø cïp kwøw.
english: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba paa mo jwïëy ni wø kwøŋ nut, 'ba beeye kwøw mar piny man en, noo näk køøre beeye mar jwïëy.
english: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

anywaa: Kiper dhaanhø mana dïkwøŋ käla piny, ni beeye dhaanhø mo käla ri ŋøøm. 'Ba ŋata en cään, käla maal.
english: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa käl ri ŋøøm, caala eni na käl ri ŋøøm. 'Ba jøøa en dëër Krictø, dëëtge otïmö ni caala dëër Krictø na käl maalø.
english: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

anywaa: Kaawat man bëëdø en ni ø caala ŋata käl ri ŋøøm, øøno tïmö thuwø ni ø caala ŋata käl maal.
english: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gïn jïïu, nyïïmera, ni dëël man wø thøw en buc Jwøk ba joode. Ni gïn wø ränynyi, gïn wø ba ränynyi ba joode thuwø.
english: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

anywaa: Neennu, aani, a caana luubö jïïu mo tiere okwøŋ kan. Ø ba buti bëët. 'Ba dëëtø di wiilø bëët,
english: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

anywaa: ki kany mo thiinh mo caala mec waŋ, kanyo köök tuuŋŋi mar aŋuudi. Kiper tuuŋ okooth, ni ö jøøa näk othøwi ni tïŋ ge maal ni ge ba ränynyi këët, ni wiil dëëtø bëët.
english: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

anywaa: Kiper dëël man ni wø ränynyi en, di wiilø ki dëël mo ba ränynyi, ni kwøw man ni bëën thøø en, di wiilø ki kwøw mo ba thøw.
english: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo wiil dëël man wø ränynyi ki dëël man wø ba ränynyi, ni wiil kwøw man wø thøw ki kwøw man wø ba thøw, kanyøgø nø, luupa caan na näk ogöörö othur kärge: ni «Thøø oraanynyø na bäre bäre.»
english: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

anywaa: «?Wui, ï na thøø, teek marï en kaa? ?Wui, ï na thøø, kac marï age eni?»
english: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

anywaa: Kac mar thøø beeye raay. Ni teek mar raay beeye ciik Jwøk.
english: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Jwøk, ŋat wø wëëk ø teek dïïm ki køør Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera ni nägu omëëya, bëëdu karu nou ba dääŋi, nou tïïya tïï Wuuö cooth, ni ŋäyu ni öölö maru kiper Wuuö ba aay jaak.
english: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane kiper luum muuce moo cïp kiper jø Jwøk, uuni thuwø, u doo tïïö kaawat mana køba gø jï acook Jwøk moa en Galeecia.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.

anywaa: Kany wø tïme na cäŋ Jwøk ki yïth juu bëët, ŋati man nø dïïu wäro lwöte ki gïrpiny ni kan gø, kaawat mano en jïre, kiper nee bäŋe jammi mo poot di cooŋø këët dïcäŋo ööa.
english: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.

anywaa: 'Ba cäŋo pïïa, jøw omanynyu geno jääŋŋa Jerucalem ni käära muuce mou, ki wëëlö mo yaa cïp ceŋge.
english: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ojoodø ni gïn mo beer ki man cøøa thuwø, ge doo lööbö ki aani.
english: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

anywaa: 'Ba uuno lïïma køør mano pöödha ki dï Macedönia, kiper yaa caarø naa doo cøra yi Macedönia,
english: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.

anywaa: ni kanymør aano bëëdö buutu, wala kanymør arïïa kiree othööra ki uuni, kiper nee tïme ni beeye uuni noo jieth aani ki wääth mara kanyo cøøa yie.
english: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.

anywaa: Kiper kawaane a ba many man neena uuni naa puta pöödhö jaak, kiper yaa ŋäädhö naa doo ruu buutu dïciel, ni näk köö Wuuö.
english: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

anywaa: 'Ba aano bëëdö yi Epeca këël mano tïme na cäŋ Pentikø,
english: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

anywaa: kiper aano jämmö ki jöö mo päl, ni beeye jöör tïïc ma wøp døc, 'ba da nyïïmän mo thööth døc.
english: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Timöthi, wär ŋäyu ki man ba wëëgu cwïnye lwär. Kiper eni tïïya tïï Wuuö kaamar aani.
english: Now if Timothy come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee ŋat mo taak gïr gø. 'Ba wär wëëgu wääth ki bëët-mëër, nee duu baŋa. Kiper a ŋäätha eni, ni eni öö ki nyïïmëëe møga.
english: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba mar cöögø ma Apøla, ena cøga døc ki man lïïm uuni ki nyïïmëëe møga, 'ba atïmö ni paa mana many Jwøki kipere ki man ö baŋu kawaane. 'Ba eno ööi kanyo jïte ki jöö mo ööe ki gø.
english: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.

anywaa: Kuru, ni cuŋŋu nou teek ri ŋäädhe maru. Magu cwïnynyu nou teek.
english: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

anywaa: Ni ö jammi bëët mo wø tïïyu, ni tïïi ki mëër.
english: Let all your things be done with charity.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane nyïïmera, ŋäyu ni tuuŋ Ectipana beege na kwøŋ jïëy ya Akeea, ni cïpge cwïnyge køør tïny jø Jwøk.
english: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)

anywaa: 'Ba a köömma uuni ni beerra man leŋŋu teeŋ dööt jiy ma yøøgønø, këël jiy bëët mo wø kunyö na ööl ki tïïc man.
english: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.

anywaa: 'Ba yia amïnnö døc ki ööny Ectipana, ki Pörcunata, ka Akeeyika, kiper gena läw karu.
english: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.

anywaa: Kiper cwïnya awëëkge mïnnö døc, kaawat mana wëëkge cwïnynyu mïnnö. Wøørru teeŋ jiy ma yøøgønø.
english: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna määth acook Jwøki mo Eecia. 'Ba Akwila ki Paricka, ka acooŋ Jwøk man wø cooŋ yi øtø marge, uuna määthge døøc ki nyeŋ Wuuö.
english: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.

anywaa: Uuni, uuna määth nyïïmëëe bëët. 'Ba määthu ŋati man nø ki nuum dhøk mana en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk.
english: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye aani na Pøøl ni göör määdhe moi ii ki cera kiree.
english: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

anywaa: 'Ba nee da dhaanhø mo ba mëër ki Kwäärö, ŋatøca, acïëni oen bääte. Wui, Kwääcwa, laar öö!
english: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

anywaa: Met ec mar Kwäärö ma Jecu bëëde bäätu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

anywaa: 'Ba mëëya bëëde bäätu bëët ki ri Krictø Jecu. Enøgønø.
english: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel mar Krictø Jecu, ki køør mana many Jwøki, ki cöögø ma Timöthi. A göönna baŋ acooŋ Jwøk mana en yi Körin, ki jï jø Jwøk bëët moa en dï Akeea bäre.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu, ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Jwøk na näk Wää Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, na näk Uun køny, eni na Jwø wø cøm cwïny jiy bëët,
english: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;

anywaa: ŋat wø cøm cwïnywa yïth gïï wø leth bëët ni wø pïï dëëtwa, kiper nee jiy møga mo wø jïti ki gïï mo leth nee cwïnyge cømwa ki cøm cwïny man wø ö Jwøki wø cøm cwïnywa ki gø.
english: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëëtwa cooth en ni wa jøøya teeŋ gïïa leth na jwør Krictø, cwïnywa ocøm thuwø cooth ki køør Krictø.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

anywaa: Ni näk dëëtwa jïtö ki gïï mo leth, jootwa kaper nou jïtu ki cøm cwïny ki pïëm man piem uuni ki gø. 'Ba ni näk cwïnywa ocømø, cøm kaper nou jïtu ki cøm cwïny kany wø jïënynyu gïïö ni leth yøø ni wø jwørru kaamarwa ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny.
english: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäädhe marwa kiperu kär dak. Kiper ŋäcwa ni keda man bëëdu en nou nywaaga gïï wø leth ni wø jwørwa, cwïnynyu ocøm thuwø ki teeŋ cøm cwïny marwa.
english: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.

anywaa: Kiper wa ba many man kuyu gïr gïna leth na pïï dëëtwa yi Eecia, nyïïmëëkwa. Kiper gïnöce atïmö ni teek døc jïwa, ni cwïnywa kärwa maar mak, ni caarwa gø ni wa ba kwøw këët.
english: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, acaarwa ni luum thøø onø ŋøl bäätwa. 'Ba beeye kiper nee wa ba göökwa dëëtwa, 'ba, nee wa göökwa ri Jwøk ni wø tïŋ jiy maal ki yi thøø.
english: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:

anywaa: Waana käl wøk cer gïn mo raac døc mo doo kännö ki thøø dëëtwa. 'Ba waani, waano cäŋ käl wøk. Ni eni ewa ŋäädhö ni wa poot käle wøk cooth.
english: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø, wa dou kønyø ni kwaayu Jwøk, kiper nee jiy mo thööth tïmge ni pwøya Jwøk kiperwa, kiper gwïëth mano wëëk waani noo duui ki køør laam mo jiy mo thööth.
english: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

anywaa: 'Ba atöör marwa beeye en, kiper ŋäcwa ki cwïnywa ni waana bëëdö pinyi en ki bëëtö mana en kur keere na käl baŋ Jwøk, ni bäŋ atade yie, ni kadha bëëtö mana beetwa nyïmmu. Ni bëëtö marwa ba käl ri riek waŋ mar pinyi en, 'ba käla ri met yi Jwøk.
english: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.

anywaa: Kiper wa ba göör luup mo teek baŋu, 'ba beege luup mo løny jïïu ki kwaan ni kwanynyu tietge. Yaa ŋäädhö ni tietge okwanynyu bäre,
english: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;

anywaa: keda mana kwøŋu gø kwany ki mo thiinh, kiper nou töödu kiperwa kaawat mano töötwa kiperu dïcäŋo näk cäŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu.
english: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper na tïm moøgø bëët ni ŋääa ki cwïnya, aana tïmö naa manynya man ööa baŋu dïkwøŋ, kiper nee yïthu mïnge kwöre ariiø.
english: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;

anywaa: Kiper a doo naa manynya man lïïma uuni kanya cøøa Macedönia, ni daa cäŋ gää baŋu kanya duua ki yi Macedönia, ni daa tïŋŋö ki buutu naa cøøa Judia.
english: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, mara paa kier wïc kanya manynya man tïïa gïnögø. Aani, a ba cäänö kaa man wø cään jø pinynyi, ni wø laar cäänö ki dööti ariiø.
english: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëëde ni Jwøk adïëri en, luumwa na caanwa jïïu kär tïmö na dööti ariiø.
english: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

anywaa: Kiper O Jwøk ma Jecu Krictø na nyeŋŋe wara køpwa dïïu, ni beeye aani, ki Cilbana, ki Timöthi, luumme patha dööti ariiø. 'Ba ki nyeŋŋe wø joota dwøl aciel cooth.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timothy, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa buuk Jwøki bëët wø thura karge ki ri Krictø. Ni beeye ni wø kööø ni «Enøgønø» ki køøre, ni ø jiema Jwøk.
english: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jwøk ni wø wëëk waani ki uuni tëënnö ki ri Krictø, ni jier øøni.
english: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;

anywaa: Ni mooc dëëtø ki ŋïï mare, ni kïth Jwïëye cwïnynyø na kuri.
english: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.

anywaa: 'Ba acaara mara ŋäc Jwøki kiree, ki man näk mo gïna kääŋa ki ööny yi Körin, a kääŋi kaper nou ba cäänna ki dwøl mo teek.
english: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.

anywaa: Ni patha ni ŋäädhe maru bëënna waani, 'ba marwa tïïc ki uuni na aciel nee yïthu mïnge, kiper u cuŋŋi nou teek ki ri ŋäädhe maru.
english: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.

anywaa: Kiper wïïa acaara naa ba doo cäŋa lïïmmö baŋu këët ni cwïnya oränynyö.
english: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.

anywaa: ?Kiper ni näk cwïnynyu yaa raanynyø, aŋa noo døøc cwïnya mo met, ni näk mo patha uuni na cwïnynyu kwøŋa raanynyø?
english: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

anywaa: 'Ba wëëllöca agööra baŋu kiper nee dïcäŋa daa ö baŋu nee cwïnya ba raany jøøa doo døøc yia mo met, kiper u yaa ŋäädhö døc u bëët, ni met yia beeye met ec maru bëët.
english: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.

anywaa: Kiper aana göön baŋu ni yia oränynyö døc, naa kïmmö døc ki cwïnya, ni nyeŋŋa lïïö ki pïï. Ni mara a ba raany cwïnynyu, 'ba a wëëga uuni ŋäc mëër mara na päl kiperu.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo okännö ki räny cwïny, paa cwïnya keere na raanynye, 'ba ki kwör møøk beeye cwïnynyø bëët na raanynye. 'Ba a ba many man cääna ki luup mo thööth kiper gø.
english: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

anywaa: Kiper teeŋ dhaanhø ma enøgønø, ajäla mana kïth jøøa thööthi bääte, orømø.
english: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, eni dou wëënnö, ni cømmu cwïnye, kiper nee cwïnye ba pädhe no okadhø døc.
english: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a kwaya uuni ki man cäŋu mëër maru dwøk kare ki eni.
english: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.

anywaa: Ni beeye na göönna baŋu naa päänynya uuni, nee ŋääa ki man näk luup bëët you leŋø.
english: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato wäro wëënnu, wëënna wëënnö thuwø. Ni näk cwïnya yaa cïp piny ki gïrpiny, gïna cïba cwïnya piny ki gø, tïïa kaperu nyïm Krictø,
english: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

anywaa: kiper nee ø ba bööt Ceethanni. Kiper atade moe paa gïï mo kuuø.
english: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cøøa Tarööa kuna køba luumma nyään na met mar Krictø, jööra atïmö ni ŋaam ki nyeŋ Wuuö.
english: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

anywaa: 'Ba cwïnya kär pï piny, kiper na kära coka ma Tayta joodø kaace. Kiper manøgønø, aana tïŋŋö dïge ni pöötha Macedönia.
english: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Jwøk, ni wø bwøth waani cooth ni dïïmwa jammi bëët ki nyeŋ Krictø, ni tïïc nyeŋ gø ni ŋäc yi piny bäre ki køørwa, ni caala gïn mo ŋwäänynye met.
english: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.

anywaa: Kiper wa caala gïï mo ŋwäänyge met mo Krictø ki nyïm Jwøk dï jø wø piem ki jø wø raanynyi.
english: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

anywaa: Ki kur ciel ŋwänynyi na thøø na bäre bäre, 'ba ki kur ciel ŋwänynyi na kwøw na bäre bäre. ?Aŋa na doo rømø ki gïïögø?
english: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?

anywaa: Kiper wa ba caal jøø ni thööth yøø ni wø køp luum Jwøk kiper gwel. 'Ba waana jiy mo bäŋ atade cwïnywa, mo jiera Jwøki, ni wa cäänö ka nyeŋ Krictø nyïm Jwøk.
english: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
