anywaa: ?Aŋø, man acäŋ tïmö ni wa nyootha dëëtwa ennø? ?Da weeli mo dewa manynyø man gööri kiper nee wa ŋäyu ki ge, kaawat man wø tïïc jø møøki? ?Wala wa doo kädö baŋu ki weeli?
english: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?

anywaa: 'Ba uuni ki dëëtu, uuna wëël ŋïï marwa mo ogöör cwïnywa, ni wø kwaan jø bëëti ni ŋäcge gø.
english: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:

anywaa: Ni røgu you nyoodhø ni uuna wëëlö mar Krictø na cïpwa, mo ba göör ka peen, 'ba göör ka Jwïëc Jwøa kwøw, ni paa ogöör bäät opäp kïte, 'ba ogöör bäät opämi moa näk cwïny jiy.
english: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø caanwa ka køør ŋäädhe marwa na en cwïnywa ki køør Krictø ki nyïm Jwøk.
english: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:

anywaa: Ni wa ba caar gø ni waano rømø ki man köwa ni beeye waani wø tïïc jammi. 'Ba beeye Jwøk ni wø tïïc wa ni waano rømø,
english: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;

anywaa: ŋata wëëk wa rømø ki man tïnywa luubö mana nyään na tuut Jwøki ki jiy, na näk patha ciik mo ogöörö, 'ba ena ri mo Jwïëc Jwøk. Kiper ciik mana näk ogöörö wø duua thøø, 'ba Jwïëc Jwøk wø cïpa kwøw.
english: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk Ciik Modhe na näk ogöör bäät opäm kïdi na bwöth baŋ thøø oöö ka ajiem mo kär løny jï jø Icriel ki man neenge täärnyïm Modhe kiper taye, këël na bëët tayøgø ni cäätha piny,
english: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

anywaa: a tïïc mar Jwïëc Jwøk a dee bäŋ ajiem mare nidïï mo kaala gø?
english: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

anywaa: Kiper ni näk Ciik Modhe ni wø cïp ajäla ree da ajiem, ajiem tïïc man wø cïp bëënynyö doo dwøŋŋa eni.
english: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn, gïna kwøŋ ajiemmi en dëëre atïmö ni bäŋ ajiem dëëre këët, kiper ajiem mana kaal gø.
english: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.

anywaa: Ni näk gïna jøøl oöö ka ajiem, gïno bëëdö, ajieme doo dwøŋŋa eni.
english: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk jïwa da ŋäädhe ma enøgønø, wa cäänö ni cwïnywa da cer.
english: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

anywaa: Ni wa ba caal Modhe na rïëp täärnyïme ka abïï, kiper nee thumö mar ajiem na many man jøøle nee ba raŋ jø Icrielli.
english: And not as Moses, which put a veil over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:

anywaa: 'Ba cwïnyge adøøc mo teek. Këël dïcäŋi en, kany wø kwaange luumma kwøŋ Jwøki tuut ki jiy, abïïnøca poot bëëdö kare ni kär käl wøk. Kiper beeye Krictø keere noo käli wøk ki køøre.
english: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same veil untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which veil is done away in Christ.

anywaa: Adïëri møn, këël dïcäŋi en, kany wø kwaan luup Modhe, acaara marge poot no orïëp gïnögø na caal abïï man wø rïëp wïc.
english: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the veil is upon their heart.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö dhaanhe wø løø ree baŋ Wuuö, abïïnögø odaaø.
english: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the veil shall be taken away.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö beeye na Jwïëy. Ba kany wø en Jwïëc Wuuö yie, jiy opädö kanyøca.
english: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

anywaa: Ni øøni bëët, ø neeta ajiem Wuuö ni bäŋ abïï mo orïëp wïthø, ni øøno røø ni ø caala kïte ni øøno wëëk koor ajiem man nø ni cøøø baŋ man nø. Ni gïnögø wø ööi ka baŋ Wuuö na näk Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na tïme ni tïïc man ni tïïcwa en, jootwa ka køør met yi Jwøk, cwïnywa ba wëëkwa pädhö.
english: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

anywaa: Waani tïï atade ni wø määnö akwierwa, ni wa ba caath jöör riek waŋ, wala ki man wiilwa luum Jwøk. 'Ba dëëtwa ewa nyoodhø jï jiy bëët nyïm Jwøk ki køør luumma näk adïëri ni wø køpwa ni wïnyö jaak.
english: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ni näk luumwa na nyään na met ogëëŋö, gëëŋ ka kur jø wø raanynyi keerge.
english: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

anywaa: 'Ba beeye jwø pinyi en na wëëk jøøa kär jïëy cøørø, nee tac luumma nyään na met mar ajiem Krictø nee ba neenge, ŋata kïte caal kït Jwøk.
english: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.

anywaa: Kiper wa ba køp dëëtwa, 'ba wa køpa gø ni Jecu Krictø beeye Kwäärö, ni waani ki dëëtwa waana laaŋe mou kiper nyeŋ Krictø.
english: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.

anywaa: Kiper beeye Jwøk na köö, ni «Tar rienye yi muudhö,» na wëëk tar rieny yïth cwïnynyø, nee tay ajiem Jwøk ni en täärnyïm Krictø wëëk ŋäc.
english: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnö ni pere leth ni en jïwa en, okan yïth dääk odhöönh, nee ŋäc ni teegøgø ni dwøŋ enø, wø ena jï Jwøk ni patha marwa.
english: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.

anywaa: Gïï mo leth wø jwørwa jwørø ki yïth jammi bëët, 'ba wa bäŋ wø ŋiithge. Yïthwa wø thäŋŋö, 'ba yïthwa ba cwat.
english: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

anywaa: Waana caanni, 'ba wa kär wec Jwøki. Wa wø di pöötö, 'ba wa kär ränynyö.
english: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa wø käära thøw Jecu ki dëëtwa cooth, kiper nee kwøw mar Jecu joot dëëtwa thuwø.
english: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.

anywaa: Kiper kany pootwa ni wa kwøw en, waano wëëk thøø cooth kiper nyeŋ Jecu, kiper nee kwøw mar Jecu joot dëëtwa ni bëën thøø en.
english: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, thøø tïïö dëëtwa, ni ö kwøwi ni tïïe dëëtu.
english: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni jïwa da teeŋ ŋäädhe aciel ki ŋata göödö, ni «Aana jïëy, ni beeye na cääna,» waani thuwø, waana jïëy, ni beeye ni cäänwa en.
english: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;

anywaa: Ni ŋäcwa ni ŋata tïŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu maal, waano tïŋ maal thuwø ki Jecu, ni kïth waani nyïme ki uuni na aciel.
english: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.

anywaa: Ni gïïögø bëët tïïc kaperu, kiper kanyo nyaa met yi Jwøki baŋ jiy, nee dwøk met ec jï Jwøk pälle, ni jït Jwøki ka ajiem.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cwïnywa ba pädhi. Këël na näk dëëtwa moi ni wøk ii oränynyö, yïth cwïnywa wø døøya mo nyärö cooth.
english: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

anywaa: Kiper gïn ni thiinh ni leth noo laar pöödhö en, jiiŋŋa waani kiper ajiem mana näk adïëri na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe na bäŋ gïn pääri ki gø.
english: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

anywaa: Kiper wa ba neet gïï mo nëënö, 'ba wa neeta gïï mo ba nëëni. Kiper gïï wø nëëni wø laara jøølø, 'ba gïï wø ba nëëni beege gïïa näk adïëri na näk bäŋ cuŋge.
english: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäcwa ni ni näk abïl bëëtwa yie pinyi en onyaaø, jïwa da øtø baŋ Jwøk, mo ba tïïc ka ceŋ, ni beeye øtø mana näk adïëri na en maal ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane wa cooyø møn, ni wa neeta øtø marwa ni en maalø nee røø dëëtwa,
english: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:

anywaa: ni kïth bäätwa kaper nee wa ba joot ni wa cäädhi ka dëëtwa.
english: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

anywaa: Kiper kany pootwa ni wa ena ya abïlli en, wa wø mïïmmö ki gïno tägi. Ni patha kiper ni wa doo tïmö ni bäŋ abïï dëëtwa, 'ba wa doo manynya man røc waani ki mør, kiper nee gïn ni wø bëën thøø en mwøny kwøwi.
english: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata jiiŋ waani kiper gïnögø kiree beeye Jwøk, ŋata wëëk Jwïëye waani na kuri.
english: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, cwïnywa wø makwa maa cooth ni yïthwa met. Ni ŋäcwa ni kany pootwa ni wa bëëdö ka dëël man en, wa tøør buut Wuuö.
english: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:

anywaa: Kiper wa cäädhi ka ŋäädhe, ni patha gïn mo di neenø.
english: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

anywaa: Ni cwïnywa ewa maa ni yïthwa met, ni doo beerra eni ki mana dewa tøør ri dëël man, ni enwa buut Wuuö.
english: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, nee wa ena kany wala wa tøør kany, wïthwa poot ewa këël ri gïï wø met yie ki ge.
english: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.

anywaa: Kiper øøni bëët ø cuŋŋö nyïm thunh løøk mar Krictø, nee ŋati man nø jïte ki gïno joode na näk orømø ki gïïa tïïe na en ri dëël, nee gïï mo beyø, wala gïï mo reyø.
english: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na ŋäcwa gø ni Wuuö di lwäärö, jiy wø cøkwa cøgø. 'Ba man en cwïnywa ŋäya Jwøki, ni yaa ŋäädhö ni ŋäyu thuwø ki cwïnynyu.
english: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.

anywaa: Wa ba cäŋ dëëtwa nyoothø jïïu, 'ba wa wëëga uuni atöör kiperwa, kiper nee maar lønyø jïïu ki man duunnu jø wø töödö kiper dëër dhaanhø man ni wøk en, ni patha kiper gïn mo ena cwïnye.
english: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.

anywaa: Ni näk waana bøøre, wa bøøl kaper Jwøk, 'ba ni näk wïthwa leer, leer kaperu.
english: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.

anywaa: Kiper mëëc Krictø wa ee maa, kiper ewa jïëö ni da dhaanhø aciel mo othøw kiper jiy bëët. Kiper manøgønø, jiy bëët athøw.
english: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:

anywaa: 'Ba ena thuunh jiy bëët, kiper nee jøøa kwøw bëënge eni na thøw kiperge ni tïŋi maal, ni ge ba bëën dëëtge këët.
english: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kawaane bäŋ dhaanhø mo caarwa ni dhaanhø jaak. Këël na kwøŋwa Krictø caar ni dhaanhø jaak, eni ba caarwa na enøgønø këët.
english: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ni näk mo dhaanhø ena dëër Krictø, eno cwääö ni nyään. Ni ö bëëtö mana näk oruuö ni aae, ni tïm jammi bëët ni nyärö.
english: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

anywaa: Ni moi bëët käla baŋ Jwøk, ŋata cäŋwa dwøk kanya ciel ki eni ki køør Krictø, ni wëëk wa tïïc man cäŋ jiy dwøk kanya ciel ki Jwøk.
english: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;

anywaa: Ni beeye ni Jwøk ena dëër Krictø ni dwøga piny baŋe, ni eni ba caan moa dhal jø pinynyi dëëtge, ni wëëk wa twiel man cäŋ jiy dwøk kanya ciel ki eni.
english: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, waana kar dhøk mo Krictø, ni Jwøk jiy wø köömme ka køørwa. Wa kwaaya uuni ki køør Krictø ki man døøu kanya ciel ki Jwøk.
english: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.

anywaa: Kiper ŋata kuc raay atïïe na ŋat raay kiperø, kiper nee ø bëënynyø ki beeny Jwøk ki køøre.
english: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

anywaa: 'Ba waana tïmö ni wa tïïö ka Jwøk na aciel, ni wa köömma uuni nee met yi Jwøk ba jïëyu ki dhøgu jaak.
english: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.

anywaa: Kiper eni wø köö, ni «Maru awïnynya kanya näk kare, ni kønya uuni dïcäŋa näk cäŋ pïëm man piem jiy ki gø.» 'Ba beeye kanya näk kare ennø, ni beeye cäŋa näk cäŋ pïëm man piem jiy ki gø ennø.
english: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

anywaa: Bäŋ ŋat mo jööre kïthwa ki dïdëët, kiper nee bäŋe ŋat mo jøøŋ tïïc marwa.
english: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:

anywaa: 'Ba dëëtwa ewa nyoodhø ki yïth jammi bëët ni waana laaŋe mo Jwøk ki køør gïï wø leth døc wø jïënywa, teeŋ ka gïï wø pïï dëëtwa, ki caannø, ki rïm can,
english: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,

anywaa: ki pöödö, ki tööyö, ki dïŋaŋ, ki öölö, ki bäŋ niine, ki bëët käc.
english: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;

anywaa: Ni dëëtwa ewa nyoodhø ki køør mana ciilwa ki raay, ki køør ŋäc luup, ki cïp cwïny piny, ki bäth ec, ki køør teek Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ki mëër mana näk adïëri,
english: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

anywaa: ki køør caan luup na adïëri, ki køør teek Jwøk, ki køør jap leny mar cer cwïïc ki cer caam, na näk beeye bëënynyö.
english: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

anywaa: Ni dëëtwa ewa nyoodhø kany wø wøør waani, ki kany wø ba wøør waani, ki kany wø waac nyeŋwa ni wa reyø, ki kany wø pwøc waani. Ni waano caarø ni waana jø cwøk, këël na näk marwa adïëri.
english: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

anywaa: Ni caar wa ni wa kuc, këël na ŋäc wa døøc. Ni wa wø cööpa kany mo cään ki thøø, 'ba wa wø cäŋa kwøw. Waani, wa di pöötö, 'ba wa bäŋ wø 'näk.
english: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

anywaa: Ni kïmwa, 'ba yïthwa wø poot mïnnö cooth. Wa wø cännö, 'ba jiy mo thööth poot wëëkwa kwärö. Ceŋwa wø dar, ni poot jammi bëët na mowa.
english: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

anywaa: Waani, bäŋ gïn mo ewa mooŋø jïïu, u na jø Körin. Cwïnywa ewa jabø jïïu,
english: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.

anywaa: ni yïthwa ba diir ki uuni, 'ba beeye uuni na yïthu diir ki waani.
english: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.

anywaa: 'Ba man, a cäänna uuni kaawat man wø cään obwöre, japu cwïnynyu jïwa thuwø.
english: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.

anywaa: Kär dëëtu kuupu ki jiy mo kär jïëy. ?Aŋø, bëënynyö ki rääö a dege dwätö na aciel nidïï? ?Wala a tuuŋa ŋø ni en yïthakic tar ki muudhö?
english: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

anywaa: ?Wala a tuuda ŋø ni en yïthakic Krictø ki Biliel? Wala agïnaŋø noo gääp ŋat mo ojïëy ki ŋat mo kär jïëy?
english: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?

anywaa: ?Wala Øt Jwøk ojïëe ki gïï wø lam nidïï? Kiper øøna øtø mar Jwøa kwøw, kaawat mana caan Jwøki, ni «Aano bëëdö ki geni ni cäädha dïge, ni tïma ni aana Jwøk marge, ni tïmge na jiya.»
english: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, ocaan Wuuö Jwøki, ni ‹Ööu wøk dïge, ni pääu ki geni, ni bäŋe gïn mo gutu mo ba waany. Kanyøgø nø, uuno pänhnha.› »
english: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

anywaa: «Noo caan Wuuö Jwøki na en teeki jïre, ni ‹Aano tïmö ni aana Wuuö jïïu, ni tïmu ni uuna wääta ki nyïïa.› »
english: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.

anywaa: 'Ba omëëya, kiper mana tïme ni gïïögø buuka jïïø nø, beerra man døøyø dëëtø mo waany ki gïï wø raany dëël ki jwïëy, ni tïïø bëëtö mana en kur keere no othur kare ni ø lwäära Jwøk.
english: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

anywaa: Uuni, japu cwïnynyu jïwa. Bäŋ gïn mo raac mo ewa tïïö dëër ŋat mør, ni bäŋ ŋat mo ewa raanynyø. Ni bäŋ ŋat mo gïre ewa mødø.
english: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

anywaa: Aani, gïnögø ba caana naa jääla uuni. Kiper akwøŋa caan ki man näk mo wa lääŋŋa uuni ki cwïnywa, ki man thøø na aciel wala man kwøø na aciel.
english: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.

anywaa: Aani, cwïnya da ŋäädhe mo päl døc kiperu, naa töödö døc kiperu, ni cwïnya yaa cømø. Këël ni jøøcwa gïï mo leth en, yia poot met døc.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na pïïcwa Macedönia, bäŋ jwöm mo ewa joodø. Waana jïtö ki gïï mo leth ki yïth jammi bëët. Ŋaap atïmö ni ena bäätwa, ni tïm cwïnywa ni lääŋŋa gïn mør.
english: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ni wø cøm cwïny jø wø can, cwïnywa acøme ki køør ööny Tayta.
english: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

anywaa: Ni patha kiper öönynye keere, 'ba beeye kiper cøm cwïny mana cømmu cwïnye ki gø thuwø, kaawat mana køp äp cwïny maru jïwa, ki kïmmö maru, ki mëër maru ki aani. Manøgø yia acäŋ døøc mo met kiree.
english: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk cwïnynyu yaa raanynyø ki wëëlö mara, dëëra ba jääla, këël na kwøŋa dëëra jääl. Kiper ajooda ni wëëllögø cwïnynyu awëëk pädhö, këël na näk nyi kany mo thiinh.
english: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane yia met, ni patha kiper mana räny cwïnynyu, 'ba yia met kaper räny cwïny maru na wëëk cwïnynyu løk. Kiper uuna tïmö nou kïmmi ka teeŋ kïmmö man wø many Jwøki, ni bäŋe gïn mo oraany uuni ki køørwa.
english: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.

anywaa: Kiper teeŋ kïmmö man wø many Jwøki wø käla løk cwïny man wø bwöth baŋ pïëm man piem jiy ki gø, ni bäŋ jääl røk. 'Ba kïmmö mar pinyi en wø duua thøø.
english: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.

anywaa: Neennu a teeŋ acaara mo nyïëdi na jootu ki køør kïmmö manøgø ni wø many Jwøki, na a teeŋ piew cwïny mo nyïëdi na laaru dëëtu nyooth nou beyø, na a teeŋ räny cwïny mo nyïëdi, ki lwär, ki äp cwïny, ki cïp cwïny køør gø, ka ajäla na cïpu. Ki yïth japøgø bëët røgu anyoothu ni bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö jïïu ri luummögø.
english: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na göönna baŋu, a ba göön baŋu kaper ŋata bääyö, wala ŋata bääyö dëëre, 'ba a göönni kaper nee mëër maru ki waani nëëne jïïu nyïm Jwøk.
english: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cwïnywa acøm. Ni patha cøm cwïny mana cøm cwïnywa ki gø keere, 'ba yïthwa acäŋ mïnnö døc na neenwa Tayta ni yie met, kiper cwïnye acïbu piny karubëët.
english: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk Tayta yaa cäännö naa töödö kiperu, wïïa kär lääö. 'Ba kaawat mana bëët japa caanwa jïïu bëët na adïëri, atöör marwa nyïm Tayta ajoot na adïëri thuwø.
english: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

anywaa: 'Ba Tayta cwïnye puta tïmö ni ena baŋu kiree, kany wø par gïru na leŋŋu dwøre karubëët, kanya pänhnhu eni ki lwär, ni dëëtu kwanynyi.
english: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.

anywaa: Aani yia met, kiper u yaa ŋäädhö møn.
english: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, wa manynya man ŋäyu met yi Jwøk na nyooth yïth acook Jwøk mo Macedönia.
english: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

anywaa: Kiper këël na pääny geni ki gïna leth na pïï dëëtge, yïthge poot met døc ni cïpge ki jammi mo thööth ki bäth ec, këël na cange døc.
english: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

anywaa: Kiper gena cïpö kaawat moa en ceŋge, ni ŋääa døøc, ni moa cïpge kaala moa dege cïbö, ni cïpge ka met ec marge keerge.
english: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

anywaa: Ni kwaacge waani døøc, kiper nee ge jïtge ki kurge man kønyge can jø Jwøk ki gø.
english: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

anywaa: Ni tïïcge gïnögø ni kaala mana ŋääthwa baŋge, kiper dëëtge akwøŋge wëëk Wuuö ki waani ki køør Jwøk na tïïc gïnögø cwïnyge.
english: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, Tayta aköömwa ki man thöör tïïögø thuwø dïïu ni en ri met ec enø, kaawat mana nø täk gø.
english: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane kaawat man ŋäyu jammi bëët ennø, teeŋ ka ŋäädhe, ki cäänö, ki ŋäc luup, ni cwïnynyu you cïp ri tïïu, nou mëër ki waani, caarru wïthu nee tïïc man ni en ri met ec en, nee ŋäyu thuwø.
english: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø ba caana naa cema uuni, 'ba a cäänö kaper gïïa tïïc jø møga ki cwïnyge bäre, kiper nee dëëtu nyoothu thuwø ni mëër maru adïëri.
english: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

anywaa: Kiper met yi Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø ŋäyu, ni eni këël na näk mo okwär, acännö kiperu, kiper nou kwärru ki køør canne.
english: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.

anywaa: 'Ba mana en cwïnya kiper luummi nø, a cäänna uuni, ni doo beerra eni jïïu ki man thöörru gïna tägu ki tïïc cwiina pöödhö, na näk beeye gïna manynyu ki cwïnynyu kiree.
english: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

anywaa: Kiper nee jïëy maru na laaru jïëy ki gø nee tïïyu nee thur kare nø ki køør moo en ceŋŋu kaawat mana kwøŋu gø caan.
english: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk cwïny dhaanhø tar ki man cïpe, ojïëö kaawat mano nut cere, ni eni ba pëënynyi ki gïno tøør cere.
english: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

anywaa: Naa ba caan gø ni jø møga kurge tïme ni jööt, ni tïm kuru ni teek.
english: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gø, nee maru ki marge tïme ni röömi, ni kønynyu cange ki gïïö ni thööth ni en ceŋŋu ennø, nee cannu läwge køny ki gïïo thööth noo en ceŋge dïcäŋ aciel, ni tïm maru ki marge ni röömi.
english: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

anywaa: Kaawat mana gööri, ni «Ŋata cuuŋö ki mo thööth, bäŋgø mo odööŋ wøk wïth moe, 'ba ŋata cooŋ mo nøk, bäŋgø mo orëëm wïth moe.»
english: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï Jwøk, na løø cwïny Tayta baŋu ni mëëye ki uuni døc kaamara.
english: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

anywaa: Kiper eni ba jïëc döötwa keere, 'ba eni ki dëëre cwïnye manynya gø døc ki man ö baŋu, ki met ec mare.
english: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba cöögö mana nyeŋŋe lïëŋ dï acook Jwøk bëët kiper pwöc mare ki luumma nyään na met ni wø købe, ajääŋwa ki eni na aciel.
english: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

anywaa: Ni patha manøgø keere, 'ba ena jier acook Jwøki thuwø nee wø cäädhe ki waani ri tïïc man ni en ri met ec ni poot tïïcwa en, kiper Wuuö nee jiem, nee tac cwïny marwa ŋäc thuwø.
english: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

anywaa: Ni gïnögø tïïcwa kaper nee bäŋe ŋat mo jääl waani kiper muuce moi ni thööth ii na cïp ki tac cwïny, ni tïïcwa en.
english: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

anywaa: Kiper wa manynya gïn mo mïërö, ni patha ki waŋ Wuuö keere, 'ba këël ki jï jiy thuwø.
english: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

anywaa: 'Ba cöögø, ŋata päärwa kwöre mo thööth, na jootwa ni cwïnye tar ki yïth jammi mo thööth, ajääŋwa ki geni na aciel. 'Ba kawaane cwïnye ee cïp køør tïïögø kiree, kiper u ee ŋäädhø døc.
english: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

anywaa: 'Ba Tayta beeye eni ni wø cäädhi ki aani, ni ena ŋat tïïc ki aani ri tïïc maru. 'Ba nyïïmëëe møga, ge jääŋŋa acook Jwøki, ni gena jø wø jiem Krictø ki køørge.
english: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyoothu mëër maru jïge, nee tier atöör marwa kiperu nee ŋäc acook Jwøki.
english: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane bäŋ gïn maa doo göönna baŋu këët kiper muuce mo wø cïp jï jø Jwøk moa en Judia.
english: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ni beeye mana manynyu ki cwïnynyu, ni beeye ni wø tööda kiperu nyïm jø Macedönia, ni wø caana ni uuni na jø Akeea dëëtu you nø jiiŋŋø cwiina pöödhö. 'Ba thööthge cwïnyge ajïtö ki luum køny thuwø kiper maru na nieŋ cwïnynyu ree.
english: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

anywaa: 'Ba a jääŋŋa nyïïmëëe naa atöör marwa kiperu ba joot no oballe jaak ri luummögø, kiper nee japu jiiŋŋu kaawat mana caana gø jïge ni japu you nø jiiŋŋø.
english: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:

anywaa: Kiper noo näk da jø Macedönia møøk mo öö ki aani, nou ba cwänge nou poodi, ni tïm wïthwa ni laay kiper mana ŋääthwa uuni døc. 'Ba laac wïc maru ba caana nø.
english: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

anywaa: Ni beeye na caara gø ni beer ki man laar nyïïmëëe ö baŋu naa poodi, nee muuce moøgø na buugu yøø nee jiiŋge dïkwøŋ, kiper nee tïme no onø jiiŋŋø, na muuy mo cïp ka met ec ni patha gïn mo mak ka teek.
english: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

anywaa: 'Ba tiere beeye en, ŋat wø pïïdhö ni cere ee noogø, ociek jïre thuwø no onoogø. 'Ba ŋat wø pïïdhö ni ee møgø, ociek jïre thuwø no omøgø.
english: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø, wär cïpe ki mano näk ee cooŋø ki cwïnye, ni ba cwiigi, wala eni mak ka teek. Kiper Jwøk wø mëër ka ŋat wø cïpi ki met cwïny.
english: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

anywaa: Kiper løny jï Jwøk ki man gwïëth uuni døc ki yïth jammi bëët, nou bëëdu ni jïïu da jammi mo orømø cooth, nee u cïpö døc kiper tïïe bëët mo wø beyø cooth.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

anywaa: Kaawat mana gööri, ni «Jape wø keethe keethø, ni mooc jøøa can. Ni beenynye wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.»
english: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø cïp köödhi jï dïpïïdhi ki møø kiper cam, uuno mooe ni meet japu, ni put uuni tïïc nou kønya can jiy cooth.
english: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

anywaa: Uuni, uuno kwär ki yïth jammi bëët nee yïthu bänhge døc ki muuc, man wø käl dwøk met ec jï Jwøk ki køørwa.
english: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.

anywaa: Kiper tïïc manøgø ba køny can jø Jwøk keerge, 'ba duua dwøk met ec mo päl jï Jwøk thuwø.
english: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;

anywaa: Kiper tïïögø nyootha bëëtö maru, ki man näk mo uuno tïmö nou jiema Jwøk ki køør mana leŋŋu luumma nyään na met mar Krictø na jïëyu, ki man cïpu ki muuce mo thööth ki bäth ec kiperge ki jø møga bëët,
english: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

anywaa: kanyo bëëtge ni ge lääŋŋa uuni, ni ge lämö kiperu, ki køør met yi Jwøk na päl ni en cwïnynyu.
english: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Jwøk kiper muuy mare na bäŋ gïn pääri ki gø.
english: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

anywaa: A na Pøøl ki dëëra, a kwaya uuni ki køør mööl mar Krictø, ki bäth ec mare, ni beeye a ŋat wø døøc dëëra mo mwöl kany wø ena buutu, ni en cerri cwïnya kany wø tøøra.
english: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

anywaa: A kwaya uuni, käru nou wëëga aani cäänö ki luubö mo teek ki uuni kanyo ööa baŋu, kaawat man yaa gø cooŋø ki cwïnya en noo caana jï jø wø cäänö kiperwa ni wa tïïya teeŋ gïï wø tïïc jø pinynyi jaak.
english: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

anywaa: Kiper këël man bëëtwa piny en, wa ba leny teeŋ leny man wø këël jø pinynyi.
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

anywaa: Kiper jap leny mowa, patha mo piny, 'ba jïge da teek Jwøk ki man nyakge kwör wø teek.
english: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)

anywaa: Wa wø nyaga pïëm, ki jammi bëët mo wø thïïŋ røkge ka atöör ni ge gëëŋa jöör Jwøk ki man ŋääi. Ni peecwa acaare bëët nee dwør Krictø leŋge.
english: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nø leŋŋu luup bëët, dëëtwa ewa jiiø ki man jäälwa jø adhala bëët.
english: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

anywaa: Uuni, u neeta dëët jiy wøk. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo ree ee ŋäädhö ni ena dhaanh Krictø, beerra man ŋäc gø ni waana jø Krictø thuwø, kaawat mare.
english: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.

anywaa: Kiper këël atöör mara doo kääthö ki mo thiinh kiper cuum marwa mana wëëk Wuue waani kiper man wëëkwa uuni tëënnö ni patha man raanywa uuni, wïïa bäŋ doo lääö.
english: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

anywaa: 'Ba a ba many man tïma keda a døøya uuni mo lwäär ki weeli.
english: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

anywaa: Kiper jiy wø cäänö kipera, ni «Weeli moe yïthge da luup mo leth ni teek, 'ba dëëre kiree jääk, ni dwøre ba wïnyi ni beer.»
english: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ŋäyi ya teeŋ jøøgø nø, ni gïn wø caanwa ki yi wëëlö kany wø tøørwa buutge, wø poot caanwa caanø kany wø nutwa.
english: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

anywaa: 'Ba dëëtwa ba dewa päärö ki jø wø nyooth dëëtge, wala wa døøya dëëtwa mo röömi ki geni. 'Ba kany wø päänyge dëëtge ki ŋat mør ni päänyge dëëtge keerge, bäŋa gïn mo ŋäcge.
english: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa ba töödö ka atöör mo okadhø, 'ba wa töödö ka atöör mana wëëk Jwøki waani, ni beeye mano cööp baŋu thuwø.
english: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba atöör marwa ba pöödhi døc kee wa kär kwøŋ ö baŋu, kiper bee wa na kwøŋ ö baŋu ki luumma nyään na met mar Krictø.
english: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:

anywaa: Wa bäŋ wø töödö ka atöör mo okadhø ki køør öölö mar jø møøk. 'Ba ewa ŋäädhö ni kanyo døøŋ ŋäädhe maru, karwa opälli dïïu døc,
english: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

anywaa: kiper nee luumma nyään na met køpwa yïth mïëri moø ni ŋäthu yøø, ni wa ba töödö kiper tïïc mo onø tïïc ŋat mørri.
english: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.

anywaa: Kaawat mana gööri, «Beerra man ö ŋat wø töödö ni tööde ki nyeŋ Wuuö Jwøk.»
english: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper paa ŋat wø nyooth dëëre ni wø jïëc, 'ba beeye ŋat wø nyooth Wuue.
english: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

anywaa: A doo naa manynya man cegu ïthu ki luum bøøl mara ki kany mo thiinh. Käru jøøm ki aani.
english: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

anywaa: Kiper gïru yaa keeø ki keec man wø näk mar Jwøk. Kiper u yaa miiø jï Krictø, nou cïba jïre keda dhaagø thiinh mo dëëre joota cwøre keere.
english: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba aana lwäyö ni wïthu di maaŋŋø ni weyu mëër mana näk adïëri ni en cwïnynyu kiper Krictø, kaawat mana tïïc thwölli ki riek waŋe na ööe ni cøøk Iip.
english: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

anywaa: Kiper uuni, u wø laara jïëy ni näk da ŋat mør mo öö ni køp Jecu mør ni patha mana køpwa, wala ni näk uuno jïtö ki teeŋ jwïëy mør ni patha mana jootu baŋwa, wala teeŋ luubö mør mo nyään mo met ni patha mana kwøŋu jïëc.
english: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

anywaa: Ki jïra, naa ba thiinh ki nyïïatwietøgø ni døøŋŋø yøø.
english: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

anywaa: 'Ba këël ni näk dwøra ba wïnyi ni beer, a paa orëëm ki ŋäc luup. Ni manøgø ewa nyoodhø jïïu ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aana bääyö nø, kiper mana dwøga dëëra cään nou cou nyïm, kanya køba luumma nyään na met mar Jwøk ni bäŋ gïn mo yaa cwølø baŋu?
english: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?

anywaa: 'Ba acook Jwøk møga atwøa ki køør mana jïëa køny marge, kiper nou tïnynya.
english: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya bëëda ki uuni a can, ni bäŋ ŋat mo yaa öölö kiper køny. 'Ba gïïa manynya acïp nyïïmëëe moa öö ki Macedönia. Kiper manøgønø, u kära öölö nou ba ööla këët na bäre bäre.
english: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

anywaa: 'Ba kaawat man bëët adïëri mar Krictø cwïnya en, atöör man na mara en ba mäni ki man wïnye yïth mïëc Akeea.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø? ?Ki baŋu naa ba mëër ki uuni? Ŋäya Jwøki.
english: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø tïïa nø, aano put bëëtö naa tïïya gø, kiper na acaara mar jø wø cäänö kipera ni wø köö, ni tïïc marge na jääŋ geni ki gø ni töötge kipere enø ni rööma tïïwa, nee raanynya.
english: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

anywaa: Kiper teeŋ jiy ma yøøgønø, ge patha nyïïatwieli ma adïëri. Gena jø tïïc mo tïïö ka cwøk, ni dëëtge døøya ge nyïïatwiet Krictø keerge.
english: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba paa gïn mo ec thäŋŋö ki gø, kiper këëlla Ceethan dëëre wø døøye nyïïatwiel maal mar tar.
english: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, patha gïn mo nyään ni näk jø wø tïny eni thuwø dëëtge ege døøc jø tïny bëënynyö. 'Ba cuŋ marge orømi ki tïïe moge.
english: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

anywaa: A nwøya gø, ni kär dee ŋat caar aani ni aana bøøl. 'Ba këël a dou caarø na enønø, jïëyu aani ni aana bøøl, kiper naa tööda ki mo thiinh thuwø.
english: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

anywaa: 'Ba man caana en, ba caana ka cuum mana cïp Wuue, 'ba a cäänö kaawat man wø cään bøølli, kany tööda ka atööri ni päl en.
english: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni jiy mo thööth töödö kiper jap piny, aani thuwø, a töödö.
english: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

anywaa: Kiper uuni, ïthu wø laaru ka cek jï bøøre, u ni wø ŋäc jammi bëët.
english: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

anywaa: Kiper u wø laara jïëy ni näk da ŋat mo öö ni døøc u laaŋe, wala eni raanynya japu, wala møta uuni, wala cäädhi ka atöör, wala dhööŋŋa thäŋŋu.
english: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

anywaa: 'Ba a doo köö, ni wïïa alääö, kiper mana jääkwa ki man tïïcwa teeŋ gïn ma enøgønø. 'Ba a cäänö kaawat man wø cään bøølli, ni gïn wø tööt dhaanhe kipere ni waŋe teek, aani thuwø løny jïra ki man tööda kipere ni waŋa teek.
english: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gena jø Ibaru? ?A aani? ?Gena jø Icriel? ?A aani? ?Gena nyïïkwaac Eeberam? ?A aani?
english: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

anywaa: ?Gena jiy mo tïnynya Krictø? Theemma aani. Ŋääa naa cäänö kee aana bøøl. Aani, kadha öölö mara, ni kadha aani ki tööyö uut tööc. Aana pööti ki kwör pöödö mo ba kwaan, ni bødha kwör mo thööth ki thøø.
english: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

anywaa: Aana pwöt jø Juuthi kwöre abïïc ka alaŋŋe mo doo tïmö na pïëraŋween, 'ba tøørra aciel.
english: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.

anywaa: Ni pwöt aani ka athøre kwöre adäk, ni këër aani ki kïte yie aciel, ni räny jïëth naammi moa cäädha ki geni ki kwöre adäk, ni thäära yi naama dwøŋ ki wäär ki cäŋ.
english: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

anywaa: Ni jïta ki wäädhi mo thööth, naa ena dhøk gïï mo leth yïth näm, ni ena dhøk gïï mo leth ceŋ dïtwïëte, ni ena dhøk gïï mo leth ceŋ jø powa ki juurre, ni ena dhøk gïï mo leth yïth päänye, ki paap, ki yïth näpa døøŋŋø, ni ena dhøk gïï mo leth ceŋ nyïïmëëe moa näk patha adïëri.
english: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

anywaa: Naa wø ööl ki tïïe mo teek yïth gïï mo leth, ni bäŋ niine ki wärre mo thööth, naa wø bëëdö ki käc ki riew, naa bäŋ wø jïti ki gïn cama ki kwör mo thööth, naa wø bëëdö yi köö ni bäŋ gïn rïëba bääta.
english: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

anywaa: 'Ba bäät gïïögø thuwø, a wø lääŋŋa acook Jwøk bëët ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni jääk, ni ba jääa thuwø? ?Na aŋa na wëëk pädhö, ni ba goota?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa töödö, a töödö ka gïïo nyooth jäk mara.
english: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk na näk Wää Kwäärö ma Jecu, ŋata näk opwøø na bäre bäre, ŋääe ki man näk maa ba caan tööt.
english: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.

anywaa: Kiper kanya ena Damacka, kwääc paac mana bëën nyenynya cwøl ni Areeta, dï pääny Damacka akoore naa mak.
english: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

anywaa: 'Ba aana gäp wøk ki dhwöŋŋö ki waŋ awëërnyeŋ mo ena dëër kiir, ni bødha cere.
english: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a töödö nø, këël na bëëde ni bäŋ gïn mo joot dëër gø, 'ba aano pööth baŋ luup lääk ki gïïa nyooth Wuue jïra.
english: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

anywaa: Da ŋat mo ŋääa ni ena dëër Krictø mo ojudhö ni kïthi yi dää maal køør cwiiri ma apaar kurŋween mo opöödhö, 'ba nee eni ena ri dëël wala ba en ri dëël kuua. Ŋäya Jwøki.
english: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

anywaa: Ŋääa ni ŋatøgø ajuth ni kïthi maal kany mo beer døc, 'ba nee ena ri dëël, wala ba en ri dëël kuua. Ŋäya Jwøki.
english: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)

anywaa: Eni gïï mo ba maar lønyø ki caan, mo ba beer jï dhaanhø ki man caan ge, awïnynye.
english: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

anywaa: Ŋatøgø beeye noo tööda kipere. Aani, a bäŋ doo töödö kiper dëëra keera, 'ba beeye jäk mara keere noo tööda kipere.
english: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa manynya man tööda, a ba doo tïmö ni aana bøøl, kiper a cara adïëri. 'Ba aani, dëëra amäna ki gø, kiper nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo caar aani ni kara dwøŋ ni kaala mo wø neene dëëra wala man wø wïnynye baŋa.
english: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper naa ba kanynya døc ni kaala kanynyø mana daa kanynyø ki gø kiper gïïa thööth na nyooth jïra, koodhø akïth dëëra na näk nyïïatwiel Ceethan kiper naa ööle, naa ba kanynya døc ni kaala kanynyø mana daa kanynyø ki gø.
english: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö akwaaya kwöre adäk kiper nee gïnögø aae dëëra.
english: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

anywaa: 'Ba ena köö jïra, ni «Met ec mara orømø kiperï, kiper teek mara wø thur kare ka ri jäk.» Kiper manøgønø, yia met døc ki man tööda kiper jäk mara, kiper nee teek Krictø tïme ni bëëdö bääta.
english: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, aano jïëy ki jäk ki nyeŋ Krictø, ni aano jïëy ki man wac nyeŋŋa, ni jïëa ki jwør gïï mo leth, ki caannø, ki rïm can. Kiper kany wø jääa, beeye teek mara eni.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

anywaa: Aani, aana tïmö keda aana bøøl, 'ba beeye uuni na wëëk aani tïïc gïnögø. Kiper doo naa beeye uuni na doo pwøc aani, kiper aani, kara ba thiinh ki nyïïatwietøgø no okadhø døc yøø, këël na kuc nyeŋŋa.
english: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø ŋec nyïïatwiel ma adïëri ki ge atïïc dïïu ni bäŋ jøømø, ni beege ŋïïce, ki gïï mo rëëma ec, ki tïïe mo døøŋŋø.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, agïnaŋø na tïïc dï acook Jwøk møga, ni kääŋu ki gø? ?Paa mana kära uuni öölö keere? Cïbu cwïnynyu piny ki aani kiper gïnö ni yaa baa enø.
english: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane dëëra yaa nø jek ki dää wäädhi ki man ööa baŋu. 'Ba u ba ööla, kiper a ba many japu, 'ba beeye dëëtu keere ni manynya. Kiper patha obwöre na doo känö ki jammi jï jøøa nywøl geni, 'ba beeye jøøa nyöödö ni wø känö jï nyïïge.
english: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

anywaa: 'Ba yia met døc ki man cïba dëëra bäre kiper jwïëyu. ?Ni näk maa mëër ki uuni døc, mëëyu ki aani doo tïmö ni thiinh?
english: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na ŋäyu gø nou kära öölö, u wø poot köö, ni yia da atade, nou yaa mødø ki riek waŋ mara.
english: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, da gïn mo yaa lwørø baŋu ki riek waŋ ki køør jøøa jääŋŋa baŋu?
english: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

anywaa: Tayta aköömma ni ö baŋu, ni jääŋŋa cöögø ki eni na aciel. ?Aŋø, da gïn mo olwør Tayta baŋu ki riek waŋ? ?Eni, gïna tïïe ki gïna tïïa patha aciel? ?Wa kär cäädhö ki jöö aciel?
english: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, you caarø ni wa piema dëëtwa nyïmmu? Beeye nyïm Jwøk ni cäänwa en ki nyeŋ Krictø. Ni gïïögø bëët tïïcwa kaper nou tëënnu, u no omëëcwa.
english: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

anywaa: Kiper a lwäär ni kanymør noo ööa, u cwäna cwänö ki bëëtö mo patha mana manynya, ni jootu aani naa cäänö ki dwøl mo ba manynyu. Ni kanymør kanyøca jïtö ki pïëm, ki keec, ki wëër, ki ŋäc røk, ki raany nyeŋ ŋat mør, ki waac nyeŋ, ka atöör, ki dïlweel.
english: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

anywaa: A lwäär kiper kanyo cäŋa duu baŋu, Jwøk mara waŋa odøøc mo law nyïmmu, ni kïmma ki gïr jøø ni thööth no obääyö yøø, ni ge poot bëëdö ni cwïnyge ba løkge ki man wecge rääö, ki käp, ki jap laac wïc na tïïcge.
english: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

anywaa: Man beeye dää wäädhi jïra ki man ööa baŋu. 'Ba nee da luubö mo di caanø, wär caan ni da jiy ariiø wala adäk mo ŋäc gø.
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ bääyö dïkwøŋ ki jø møga bëët yaa nø köömmö. 'Ba a cäŋa ge köömmö ennø kany pooda naa tøør, kaawat mana caana gø jïge kanya ena dïge ri riet lïïmmö mara, ni ni näk maa cäŋa öö, ge ba wiia.
english: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

anywaa: Kiper u wø köö nou manynya ŋïï nee jootu ki man näk mo Krictø cäänö ki raa. Eni ba jääk ki man cääne ki uuni, 'ba eni wø tïïya tïïc mo teek dïïu.
english: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

anywaa: Kiper ena 'näk bäät jaadha no odëëdö ni jääk, ni cäŋ kwøwø ki køør teek Jwøk. Kaawat manøgø thuwø, waani, wa jägö ki ree, 'ba waano kwøw ki eni ki køør teek Jwøk, nou tïnywa.
english: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

anywaa: Pëënynyu dëëtu, nee jootu ki man näk mou poot bëëdö ri ŋäädhe mana näk adïëri. Päänynyu rou. ?Aŋø, ŋäyu møn ni Jecu Krictø ena cwïnynyu? Wala kanymør uuno nø pädhö ri päänynyö manøgø.
english: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

anywaa: Aani, yaa ŋäädhö ni wa jootu joodø ni wa kär pädhö.
english: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk wø lamwa lamø kiper nou ba bääyu, ni paa kiper nee wa joot ni wa kär pädhö ki päänynyö manøgø, 'ba kiper nou tïmö nou tïïya gïno beer, këël wa doo nëënö keda waano pädhö.
english: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo raac mo maarwa tïïc ŋëët gïn ma adïëri, 'ba wa wø tïnynya adïëri keere.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

anywaa: Kiper yïthwa met kany wø jääkwa ni teegu. Ni wa wø lämö kiper nee bëëtö maru thur kare ni beer.
english: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na gööra gïï kany pooda naa tøør buutu en, kiper kanyo ööa naa ba cääna ki teek mara mana wëëk Wuue aani, teega wëëk aani kiper nou tëënnu, ni patha kiper nou raanynya.
english: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, nyïïmera, turu paar nø. Bëëdu ki bëëtö mana beer. Leŋŋu kwac mara. Mëërru ki røgu. 'Ba Jwø wø cïp mëër ki bëët-mëër oen buutu.
english: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

anywaa: Määthu røgu ki nuum dhøk mana en kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

anywaa: Uuna määth jø Jwøki bëët.
english: All the saints salute you.

anywaa: 'Ba met yi Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø, ki mëëc Jwøk, ki dwätö mar Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere en bäätu bëët.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel, ni twiel mara ba jooda baŋ jiy ni ba wïnynya baŋ dhaanhø, 'ba jooda baŋ Jecu Krictø, ki Jwøk na näk Wuuö, na tïŋ gø maal ki yi thøø.
english: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

anywaa: Aani ki nyïïmëëe moa en buuta bëët, wa göönna baŋ acook Jwøk mo Galeecia.
english: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø, ki Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø,
english: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,

anywaa: ŋata cïp dëëre kiper raay moø, nee ø pieme yi piny man en ni raac en, kaawat mana many Jwøø na näk Wääø,
english: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:

anywaa: ni beeye na doo jiemø, këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Aani, yia athäŋŋö kiper na laaru eni wec na cwøl uuni yi mëëc Krictø, ni løøu røgu baŋ teeŋ luubö mør mo nyään.
english: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø paa luumma nyään na met. 'Ba da jø møøk mo kiera wïthu, ni ge manynya man wiilge luum Krictø na nyään na met.
english: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba këël doo naa waani wala nyïïatwiet maal, ni näk da ŋat mo køpa luubö mør jïïu mo patha luumma nyään na met mana kwøŋwa køp jïïu, ŋatøca, acïëni oen bääte.
english: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

anywaa: 'Ba, kaawat mana kwøŋwa gø caan, këël kawaane cäŋa ka caannø, ni nee da ŋat mo køpa luubö mør jïïu ni patha luumma nyään na met mana kwøŋu jïëc, ŋatøca, acïëni oen bääte.
english: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, aani kawaane, a manynya man ö jiyi ni pwøcge aani, ni patha pwøc mar Jwøk? Wala, a manynya man døøya yïth jiy mo met? Onää a poot døøya yïth jiy mo met, a bäŋ doo tïmö ni aana laŋŋø mar Krictø.
english: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gø jïïu, nyïïmera, ni luumma nyään na met na køba, patha luum dhaanhø.
english: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

anywaa: Kiper luummögø kära wïnynyö dhi dhaanhø, naa kär pwönynyö ki gø, 'ba beeye Jecu Krictø na nyooth gø jïra.
english: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Ni ŋäyu bëëtö mara dïkwøŋ na en ri lam jø Juuth, kaa mana gëëma ka acooŋ Jwøk ni raac døc kiree, naa manynya man raanynya gø.
english: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:

anywaa: Ni aano kadhø ri lam jø Juuth, ni tïëŋwa mo thööth yaa kaalø dï jø powa, kiper cwïnya yaa cïbö døc køør kööŋŋe mo kwäya.
english: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na cïp aani kur keera naa poot kär nywølø, na cwøl aani ki met ec mare,
english: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,

anywaa: kanya tïm yie ni met ki man nyooth Wääde jïra, nee gïre køba jï juurre bëët, bäŋ ŋat mo yaa pëënynyö ka acaara.
english: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

anywaa: Naa kär døø Jerucalem baŋ jøøa näk nyïïatwieli kanya pooda. 'Ba aana put ci ya Areebia. Køøre, aana cäŋ døø yi Damacka.
english: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri adäk, aana døø yi Jerucalem kuna liimma Piter, ni bëëtwa ki eni ki nïne apaar kurbïïc.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ ŋat mo yaa joodø dï nyïïatwieli, 'ba beeye Jeemeth na näk cöök Kwäärö ma Jecu keere na jooda.
english: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.

anywaa: 'Ba luup moi ni gööra baŋu ii, ki nyïm Jwøk, a ba caan tööt.
english: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

anywaa: Køøre aana aa yïth mïëc Ciria ki Cilicia.
english: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

anywaa: 'Ba dëëra poot kuc acook Jwøk moa en dëër Krictø yi Judia.
english: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:

anywaa: 'Ba mana wïnyge keere na caan, ni «Ŋata wara gëëmö ki øøni, atïmö ni køpa gïr ŋäädhe mana wara manynye nee raanynye.»
english: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.

anywaa: Ni pwøcge Jwøk kipera.
english: And they glorified God in me.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme na køør cwiiri apaar kurŋween, aana cäŋ døø yi Jerucalem, ki Barnaba, ni aacwa ki Tayta na aciel.
english: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

anywaa: Naa cii kaper na nyoothi ya Jwøki jïra, ni peedha luumma nyään na met nyïmge ni wø køba cooth dï juurre. 'Ba mara caana jï jøøa døøŋŋø kur keerwa naa ba tïma kaamar ŋat mo rïïŋö jaak, wala ŋat mo reeŋø ni ŋwiec mare bäŋ tiere.
english: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

anywaa: 'Ba Tayta na bëëdö buuta, këël na näk ŋat Gïrïïk, kär maa ki teek nee daŋ.
english: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø täga baŋ nyïïmëëe moa näk patha adïëri na duny ya acooŋa ki waŋjöö mør mo kuc, ni ge raŋa pät marwa na en ri Krictø Jecu, nee wa cäŋge dwøk yi twöc.
english: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:

anywaa: 'Ba wa kär jïëy ki luumge, këël kany mo thiinh, kiper nee luumma nyään na met na näk adïëri, nee put bëëtö kare kiperu.
english: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa wäŋŋi ni døøŋŋø kwörge yøø, a caana gø jïïu, ni jøøgø bäŋ gïn mo ege nyoodhø jïra. Nee kwörge døøŋŋø wala therø bäŋ gïrge ki jïra. Kiper Jwøk luumme aciel kiper jiy bëët.
english: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

anywaa: 'Ba ajootge møn, ni luumma nyään na met owëëk aani kiper jøøa näk patha odaŋø, kaawat mana wëëk luumma nyään na met Piter kiper jøøa näk odaŋø.
english: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

anywaa: Kiper eni na tïïö dëër Piter nee tïme na nyïïatwiel ki man ci baŋ jøøa näk odaŋø, atïïö dëëra thuwø kiper juurre.
english: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

anywaa: 'Ba na ŋäcge met yi Jwøk mana wëëk aani, Jeemeth ki Ciipa, ki Jøøn, jøøa wäŋŋi ni døøŋŋø kwörge, ceŋwa amakge ki Barnaba ni ge nyootha dwätö jïwa, ni wa doo cøøa baŋ juurre, ni cige baŋ jøøa näk odaŋø.
english: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye luubö aciel keere na caange jïwa, ni lääŋwa jøøa can. Ni beeye mana manynya ki cwïnya, nee tïïa.
english: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Ciipa yi Antïëk, ena jääla nyïme, kiper eno bääyö.
english: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

anywaa: Kiper dïkwøŋ kanya poode ni bäŋ jiy mo oöö ki baŋ Jeemeth, eni wø cämö ki juurre. 'Ba na ö jøøgø, ena døø cään, ni pääe ki ge, kiper mana lwääre ki jøøa no odwätö ri luum daŋ.
english: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

anywaa: Ni ö jø Juuthi møga ni cige ya atade manøgø ki eni ciel. Këël Barnaba akïthge ra atatge.
english: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooda geni ni ge ba cäädhi ki køør luubö mana näk adïëri na en ri luumma nyään na met, acaana jï Ciipa nyïmge bëët, ni kööa, na «Aŋø, ni näk ïïna ŋat Juuth mo bëëdö kaamar jur, niï ba bëëdö kaamar jø Juuth, juurre a diï gø maaø ki teek nidïï nee bëëtge kaamar jø Juuth?»
english: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

anywaa: 'Ba këël waani ki dëëtwa na näk onywølø na jø Juuth, ni patha juurre ni wø cwøl na jø raay,
english: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

anywaa: ŋäcwa ni dhaanhø ba jïëc Jwøki ni mare beer ki køør tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk, 'ba beeye ki køør ŋäädhe ni en ri Jecu Krictø. Këël waani, waana jïëy ni ŋääthwa Krictø Jecu, kiper nee wa jïëc ni marwa beer ki køør ŋäädhe ni en ri Krictø, ni paa ki køør tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk. Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mo jïëc ni mare beer ki køør tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk.
english: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk waani ki dëëtwa, waano cwølø ni waana jø raay kany bëëtwa en ni wa manynya gø nee wa jïëc ni marwa beer ki ri Krictø, a Krictø nø, atïmö ni beeye ŋata käl raay? Ba doo løny!
english: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa dwøga gïïa kwøŋa kwier karge, a nyootha raa møn, ni aana ŋat wø dhal ciik Jwøk.
english: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør ciik Jwøk beeye na thøøa, ni tïma naa ba en tiet ciik Jwøk, kiper naa kwøa jï Jwøk.
english: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba aana gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö ki Krictø na aciel. Ni patha aani ni kwøw en, 'ba beeye Krictø ni bëëdö ni kwøw dëëra en. Ni bëëtö man bëëda ki gø kawaane ki dëël man en, a bëëdö ka ri ŋäädhe na en ri O Jwøk, ŋata mëër ki aani, ni cïp ree kipera.
english: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

anywaa: Naa ba tïïc met yi Jwøk ni bäŋ tiere. 'Ba ni näk ciik Jwøk beeye wø jïëc dhaanhø ni mare beer ki køøre, nyootha gø ni Krictø athuunh jaak.
english: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

anywaa: Wui, u na jø Galeecia ni bäŋ wïdhi en! ?Aŋa na maaŋ wïthu, u na Jecu Krictø anyooth nyïmmu bëët ni eno gur bäät jaadha no odëëdö?
english: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

anywaa: 'Ba wïnynyu mara, nou pëënynya ki gïrpiny aciel keere. ?Jwïëc Jwøk, jootu kaper tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk wala jootu kaper mana wïnynyu ni ŋääthu gø?
english: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, uuna tïmö ni uuna bøøre? ?U na nø tägö ki mo Jwïëc Jwøk, u doo cäŋ døø baŋ tïïe mo dëël?
english: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, gïïa thööth na kwøŋu jwør, jwørru ka jaak? Ki jïra, ni bäŋ dou jwørø jaak.
english: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

anywaa: ?Eni ni wø cïp Jwïëc Jwøk jïïu, ni tïïc gïï mo døøŋŋø mo rëëma ec dïïu, wø tïïe ka køør tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk, wala tïïe kaper mana wïnynyu ni ŋääthu gø?
english: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

anywaa: Këël Eeberam «Ena jïëy ki Jwøk ni ŋääth gø, ni jïëy no obëënynyö ki køør ŋäädhe mare.»
english: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

anywaa: ?Käru joodø? Jø wø näk jø ŋäädhe beege na wäät Eeberam.
english: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

anywaa: 'Ba wëël Jwøk, na ŋäc gø cøøn dïkwøŋ ni juurre jïëc Jwøki jïëö ni marge beer ki køør ŋäädhe, luumma nyään na met akwøŋ køp jï Eeberam, ni kööe, ni «Beeye ïïni noo gwïëth wïth juurre bëët ki køørï.»
english: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, jø wø näk jø ŋäädhe ogwïëdhö ki Eeberam na aciel, ŋata kwøŋ ŋäädhö.
english: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

anywaa: Kiper jiy bëët mo wø ŋääth tïïe moa en ri ciik Jwøk, acïëni ena bäätge. Kiper ogöörö, na «Acïëni oen bäät jiy bëët mo wø ba gwøk jammi bëët moa näk ogöör yi wëël ciik Jwøk, ki man tïïcge ge.»
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane ajoot, ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo doo jïëö ni mare beer nyïm Jwøk ki køør ciik Jwøk. 'Ba «Ŋat wø jïëc ki køør ŋäädhe, kwøw.»
english: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.

anywaa: 'Ba ciik Jwøk ba en ri ŋäädhe. Kiper «Ŋat wø tïïc ge, okwøw ki køørge.»
english: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.

anywaa: 'Ba Krictø acïëni mana doo en bäätø kiper ciik Jwøk, awëënne, kiper mana tïme ni cien kaperø. Kiper ogöörö, na «Acïëni oen bäät jiy bëët mo wø 'näk no oŋaap bäät jaath.»
english: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

anywaa: Ni beeye kiper nee gwïëth mana kwøŋ Eeberam gwïëth ki gø nee tïme ni ena bäät juurre ki ri Krictø Jecu, kiper nee Jwïëc Jwøk mana kwøŋ buuk nee joodø ki ri ŋäädhe.
english: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, nou cäänna ki luubö mo yaa päärö ki teeŋ gïn wø tïïc jiyi. Ni këël dwør dhaanhø mo othøw, bäŋ ŋat mo wiil gø, wala cäŋe ka meetø, ni näk mo onø caan.
english: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa buuk, buuka jï Eeberam ki nyikwaare. Ni kär cwøl Wëël Jwøki ni «Nyïïkwaayï» ni kede ge thööth. 'Ba caana aciel keere, ni «Nyikwaarï,» ni beeye Krictø.
english: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba tier mana caana beeye en, ni ciik Jwøk na cïp ki køør cwiiri ma dïpe aŋween ki pïëradäk, luumma kwøŋ Jwøki tuut bäŋ wø wiile, ni tïïc gïna buue ni bäŋ tiere.
english: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk olaawi wø cïp ka køør ciik Jwøk, ba cïp ka køør gïna buuk këët. 'Ba acïp Jwøki jï Eeberam møn, ki køør buuk.
english: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

anywaa: ?Aperŋø nø, ni dee ciik Jwøk? Ciik Jwøk acïp kiper luup moa dhal, këël kanya di nyikwaarø öö, ŋata buuk. 'Ba luummögø caana nyïïatwiet maalli ki dhi nyïjöö.
english: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïjöö wø caatha luum acooŋe ariiø. 'Ba Jwøk beeye aciel.
english: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ciik Jwøk nø, atïmö ni män ki gïïa buuk Jwøki? Ba doo løny! Kiper onää da ciik Jwøk mo ocïbö mo maara cïpö ki kwøw, bëënynyö doo ena køør ciik Jwøk.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

anywaa: 'Ba Wëël Jwøk aköö, ni jiy bëët otwöc raayi, kiper nee luumma kwøŋ buuk ki køør ŋäädhe ki ri Jecu Krictø, nee tïme ni mëëga jø wø jïëy ni ŋääthge.
english: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya poode ni ŋäädhe poot kär öö, ciik Jwøk ena bäätø, ni øøno maa ki teek, këël kanya di ŋäädhe nyoodhø yie.
english: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ciik Jwøk beeye dïkuri marø këël mana ö Krictø, kiper nee ø jïëc Jwøki ni marø beer ki ri ŋäädhe.
english: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane na nø ö ŋäädhe, ø ba en tier dïkuri këët.
english: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

anywaa: Kiper uuna wäät Jwøk bëët ki køør mana ŋääthu Krictø Jecu.
english: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni bëët na lwøk na nyuudhi dëër Krictø, Krictø arøøu dëëtu.
english: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane bäŋ ŋat Juuth wala ŋat Gïrïïk këët, ni bäŋe laŋŋø wala ŋat mo bëëdö ka wïïe keere, ni bäŋe thwønh wala maath, kiper uuna tïmö ni uuna aciel dëër Krictø Jecu.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk uuna mo Krictø, uuna nyïïkwaac Eeberam møn, ni uuna lwiidhi, kaawat mana kwøŋ buuk.
english: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.

anywaa: 'Ba mana caana, beeye ni lwiidhø kanyo poode ni thiinh, bëëdö kaamar laŋŋø, këël na näk jammi bëët moe.
english: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

anywaa: 'Ba eni bëëdö ni wïnynya luum jøøa piith gø ki jøøa en jammi moe ceŋge, këël kanyo ö cwiina caan wänni.
english: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

anywaa: Ni øøni, marø poot na enøgønø thuwø. Kanya poodø ni ø therø, øøna laaŋe jï juu mo bäät piny.
english: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

anywaa: 'Ba na ö kanya wäŋŋi na thur kare, Jwøk Wääde ajääŋŋe, ni nywøli ya dhaage ni ciik Jwøk ena bääte,
english: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

anywaa: kiper nee jøøa en ciik Jwøki bäätge, nee wïïl wøk, nee ø tïïe na wääte.
english: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk uuna wääte, Jwøk Jwïëc Wääde ajääŋŋe yïth cwïnynyø, ni wø jwöŋi na «Abba, Awuuö.»
english: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, kiper mana tïïc Jwøki, ï patha laŋŋø këët, 'ba ïïna wäädö. 'Ba ni näk ïïna wäädö, ïïna lwiidhø møn.
english: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ kanya poodu ni Jwøk kuyu, u bëëdö ni uuna laaŋe jï juu mo paa adïëri.
english: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

anywaa: ?'Ba kawaane na tïmu ni Jwøk ŋäyu, ni doo beerra mana daa köö, ni uuna tïmö nou ŋäc Jwøki, uuna dou cäŋ døø baŋ juu moøgø nidïï, na näk jïge bäŋ teek ni bäŋ karge, ni cäŋu tïmö ni uuna laakge en?
