english: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

anywaa: Uuni, uuna tïmö nou gwøga cääŋŋe, ki dwäde, ki kwöra näk owäŋŋö yi cwiir, ki cwiiri.
english: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

anywaa: Aani, yia athäŋŋö, ni kanymør tïïc mana tïïa dïïu aay jaak.
english: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

anywaa: A kwaya uuni, nyïïmera, tïmu kaamar mara, kaawat mana tïma kaamar maru. Bäŋ gïn mo raac mo you tïïö dëëra.
english: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

anywaa: Ŋäyu, ni luumma nyään na met na kwøŋa gø køp jïïu, køba kaper täw na mak aani.
english: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kanya bëëda naa tuu dïïu, ni u yaa öölö ki täw mara, u kär jøøm ki aani, wala da gïn mo raac mo you caanø dëëra, 'ba aana pänhnhu kede aana nyïïatwiel maal mar Jwøk, wala kaawat mana dou Krictø Jecu pänhnhö.
english: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø na tägö ri met ec mana kwøŋu joot? Kiper maru ajooda na adïëri, ni onää løny jïïu kar kaaca, nyeŋŋu dou gööna wøk, ni dou ge mëëk aani.
english: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kawaane, aana tïmö na nyimän maru kiper na caana mana näk adïëri jïïu?
english: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

anywaa: Jøøgø ge mwøtha uuni døc, 'ba tier marge patha gïn mo beer. 'Ba ge manynya man køøge u wøk, nou tïmu nou pwøya geni.
english: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo dhaanhø mwøth kaper tier gïn mo beer, doo beer ki mana dii mwødhø cooth, ni paa kany wø ena buutu keere.
english: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

anywaa: U na nyïïa, cwïnya ajïtö ki gïn mo caala mäc lwaar kiperu, këël mano tïm Krictø ni ena cwïnynyu.
english: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

anywaa: Beer kaa ena buutu kawaane ennø. A doo cäännö ki uuni mëëth. Kiper yia anithay ki maru.
english: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

anywaa: Caannu jïra, u ni many bëëtö ni ciik Jwøk ena bäätu en, ?luup moa en yi ciik Jwøk bäŋ wø wïnynyu?
english: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö, ni Eeberam jïre da wääte ariiø. Aciel nywøle ka laŋŋø, na aciel nywøle ka dhaagø mana cøøde.
english: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

anywaa: 'Ba wäädö mana nywøl laŋŋø, nywøl ka ri mo dëël, 'ba wäädö mana nywøl dhaaŋŋa näk ocøødø, nywøl ka køør mana buuk Jwøki.
english: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

anywaa: Ni luummögø caala leer mo da tiere. Määrögø caala luup ariiø mo otuudö. Aciel käla ri Kïn Caynay, ni nyïïe nywøle yi laŋ. Ni beeye Eegar.
english: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

anywaa: 'Ba Eegar beeye Kïn Caynay ni en ya Areebia. Ni eni caala Jerucalem man en, kiper ena laŋŋø ki nyïïe bëët.
english: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

anywaa: 'Ba Jerucalem mana en maal paa laŋŋø, ni beeye eni na miiø.
english: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö: ni «Yiï mïnne, ï na bwøc ni ba nywøl en. Tïŋ dwørï maal ni kwöŋŋï ki met ec, ï na dëërï bäŋ mäc. Kiper nyaana bëëdö keere, ajïtö ki nyïëdi, ni kaala cer nyaana näk jïre da dïcwøø.»
english: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, nyïïmera, uuni, u caala Aydhak, ni uuna nyïï buuk.
english: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

anywaa: 'Ba keda mana ö ŋata nywöli ki ri mo dëël ni gëëme ki ŋata nywöli ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk, beeye ni jïëø ennø.
english: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø ni wø caan Wëël Jwøki? Wø köö, ni «Riemu laŋŋøgø wøk ki wääde. Kiper ba doo beer ki man ö o laŋŋø ni nywaakge olaawi ki o dhaaŋŋa näk cøøtø.»
english: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø, nyïïmera, ø patha nyïï laŋŋø, 'ba øøna nyïï dhaaŋŋa näk cøøtø.
english: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

anywaa: 'Ba øøna pät Krictø, nee ø bëëdö ni øøno pädö. Kiper manøgønø, cuŋŋu nou teek. Ni ba cäŋu jïëy ki bëët laŋ ni caal twöc.
english: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a na Pøøl, a caana gø jïïu, ni ni näk uuno jïëy ki man daŋ uuni, Krictø u ba dee maara køny.
english: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.

anywaa: A cäŋa mara caannø jï jiy bëët mo wø jïëy ki man daŋi, wär ŋäc ŋatøca ni ciik Jwøk karge bëët poot gwøe gwøø.
english: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

anywaa: U ni many man jïëc u ni maru beer ki køør ciik Jwøk, uuna ŋul wøk ri Krictø, ni tïmu nou tøør ri met ec.
english: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.

anywaa: 'Ba waani, wa jïta bëënynyö man ni ŋääthwa en, ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk ki ri ŋäädhe.
english: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jï jø wø en dëër Krictø Jecu, daŋ wala bäŋ daŋ bäŋ gïn tïïcge, 'ba gïn mo pere leth beeye ŋäädhe ni wø tïïö ki køør mëër.
english: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.

anywaa: Uuni, uuna kwøŋ rïïŋu ki ŋwïëy mo beer. ?Aŋø, aŋa na røøth nyïmmu ki man leŋŋu mana näk adïëri?
english: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ gïnögø ba käl baŋ ŋata kwøŋ uuni cwøl.
english: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

anywaa: Thømmø mo thiinh møø wø maae maaø bäre.
english: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö yaa ŋäädhö døc, ni uuno jïëy ki dwøl mara ni bäŋ dwøl mør këët. 'Ba eni ni kier wïthu enø, ajälle ojoode, këël ena ŋa jaak.
english: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, aani, onää a poot køpa luum daŋ, doo bäŋ jiy mo gëëmö ki aani. Onää a poot køpa luum daŋ, doo bäŋ jiy mo män ki aani kiper køp luum jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

anywaa: A doo naa manynya jøø ni kier wïthu yøøgø, mana dege mätge dïnö.
english: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, uuna cwøl nou bëëdu ni uuno pädö. 'Ba kär nou tïïya pät maru ni beeye jöö man tïïyu mo dëël ki gø. 'Ba ŋati man nø beerra man tïny ŋati man nø ki køør mëër.
english: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

anywaa: Kiper ciik Jwøk ki kare bäre wø thur kare ka ri luubö aciel, ni «Ï doo mëër ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï.»
english: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou kaaya dëëtu ni møønnu rou, dëëtu wär gwøgu, nee dëëtu ba raanynyu.
english: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

anywaa: 'Ba a caana gø jïïu, ni caathu køør Jwïëc Jwøk, ni ba jïëyu ki gïï wø cac dëëlli.
english: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

anywaa: Kiper gïï wø cac dëëlli män ki gïï wø many Jwïëc Jwøki. Ni ö Jwïëc Jwøki ni mäne ki gïï wø many dëëlli. Kiper gïïögø män ki rege, ni ge mäna uuni ki mana dou tïïö.
english: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk uuno bwøth Jwïëc Jwøki, luum ciik Jwøk ba en bäätu këët.
english: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

anywaa: 'Ba gïï wø tïïc dëëlli, ŋäc. Ni beege käp, ki rääö, ki bäŋ mak røk,
english: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

anywaa: ki wøør juu møøk, ki thïëth, ki män, ki pïëm, ki keec, ki wëër, ki ŋäc røk keel, ki wëëye, ki pääŋ røk,
english: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

anywaa: ki gwönö, ki maath, ki meeye mo dëël oraanynyø, ki teeŋ møga bëët. A köömma uuni, kaawat mana kwøŋa u köömmö, jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïïögø, buc Jwøk ba dege joodø.
english: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïëdi mo wø ööi ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk, beege mëër, ki met ec, ki bëët-mëër, ki bäŋ jøømø, ki bäth ec, ki køny, ki ŋääth dhaanhø,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

anywaa: ki mööl, ki män røk. Teeŋ gïïögøøni, bäŋ ciik aciel mo kwier ge.
english: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa näk mo Krictø Jecu, gïï wø many dëëlli agurge bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ki jape na reyø wø caye.
english: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø bëënna Jwïëc Jwøk, wär cäädhø køør mo Jwïëc Jwøk thuwø.
english: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

anywaa: Kär dee atöör jïïø, ni bäŋe ŋat miin ŋat mør, ni bäŋe ŋat gwöni ki watge mør.
english: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, noo dee ŋat jootu no obääyö, u ni cwïnynyu en køør Jwøk, wär cou baŋe nou mwöl, ni dwøgu gø kare. 'Ba riï wär gwøgï, niï ba päänynyi thuwø.
english: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni køny watge maya ki gïïa peek na kääre, nee ciik Krictø thur kare jïïu na enøgønø.
english: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø caar dëëre keere ni kare dwøŋ, ni kare ba dwøŋ, eni cøøga ree keere.
english: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

anywaa: Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni raŋ tïïc mare keere, no orømø. Køøre, gïno tööde kipere oen jïre keere, ni paa kiper mano pääny dëëre ki watge mør.
english: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

anywaa: Kiper ŋati man nø baanne okääre keere.
english: For every man shall bear his own burden.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø pwönynyi ki luum Jwøk, wär jape na beyø bëët nywaae ki ŋat wø pöö.
english: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.

anywaa: Kär dëëtu cøøgu. Jwøk ba maar cøøgø. Kiper gïn wø piith dhaanhe, beeye wø cäŋ kayø.
english: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø piith gïï wø many dëëlli, beeye ränynyö noo kaae. 'Ba ŋat wø piith gïï wø many Jwïëc Jwøki, kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe na en ri Jwïëc Jwøk okaae.
english: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

anywaa: Beerra man ba jøømø ki tïï gïïa beyø. Kiper øøno kää kanyo näk ma kare, ni näk mo bäätø ba wëëgø pädhö.
english: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat man bëëdö ni da jöö jïïø en, beerra man tïïø ki gïï mo beyø jï jiy bëët. 'Ba jøøa døø kønyø røk beege nyïïmëëe moa näk jø Jwøk.
english: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

anywaa: Neennu wëëlö man ni gööra ki cera jïïu ni nyeŋge døøŋŋø en.
english: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.

anywaa: Jøø ni many man nyoothge dëëtge ni marge beer yøø, beege ni many man makge uuni ki teek nou daŋ. Ni tïïcge kaper nee bäŋe luubö mo leth mo caan dëëtge kiper jaadha no odëëdö mar Krictø.
english: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba këël geni ki dëëtge na näk odaŋø, ciik Jwøk bäŋ wø gwøkge. 'Ba ge manynya man daŋ uuni, kiper nee ge töötge ki mano tïïc dëëtu.
english: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

anywaa: 'Ba aani kara bäär ki teeŋ atöör manøgø, 'ba beeye luum jaadha no odëëdö mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø keere ni daa tööda kipere, ni beeye na tïïc jap piny keda gïn mo ogur bäät jaadha no odëëdö ki baŋa, ni tïma ni aano thøw jï jap piny.
english: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

anywaa: 'Ba daŋ wala bäŋ daŋ, bäŋ gïn mo dege tïïö, 'ba beeye cwääc mana nyään keere.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

anywaa: Bëët-mëër ki met ec obëëdö bäät jø wø bëën luummi en, na näk jø Icriel moa näk adïëri mo Jwøk.
english: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.

anywaa: 'Ba køør man nø, kär dee ŋat mo ööl aani këët. Kiper aani, a käära pööc mo Jecu ki dëëra.
english: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba u na nyïïmera, met ec mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø obëëdö cwïnynyu. Enøgønø.
english: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel mar Krictø Jecu ki køør mana many Jwøki. A määtha u na jø Jwøk ni wø ŋääth ki ri Krictø Jecu.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu, ki bëët mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Pwøc en ri Jwøk na näk Wää Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, ŋata gwïëth øøni dëër Krictø, ki gwëëthe bëët mo Jwïëc Jwøk mo wø en maal,
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:

anywaa: kaawat mana ö eni ni jier øøni ni kïth øøni dëër Krictø kanya poot pinynyi ni kär cwääö, kiper nøø tïmø ni ø ena kur keerø na mo Jwøk ni bäŋ ajäla dëëtø nyïme.
english: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

anywaa: Ni ø ee kwøŋ miek ki mëëye nøø tïmø ni øøna wääte ki køør Jecu Krictø kaawat mana manynye,
english: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

anywaa: nee met yie na bäŋ teeŋe na cïbe jïïø ki bäth ec dëër Omëëye, nee pwøø.
english: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køøre na wïïl øøni wøk ki køør remme, ni wec moa dhalø ki met yie na dwøŋ
english: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

anywaa: na wëëk øøni ni päl ki ra acaaya dwøŋ, ki ŋäc tiet jammi.
english: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

anywaa: 'Ba mana manynye na näk ee kwøŋ kan anyuth øøni, kaawat mana kwøŋ gø cooŋ ki cwïnye ni tïïe ka ri Krictø.
english: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:

anywaa: Ni manøgø ee cooŋø ki cwïnye nee tïïe kanyo ö kanya wäŋŋi noo thur kare, kiper nee jammi bëët dwal dëëre, mo maal ki mo piny.
english: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køøre na ö waani na kwøŋ Krictø ŋääth na miek na jier nee wa bëëtwa ni wa pwøya ajieme, keda mana many Ŋat wø tïïc jammi bëët keda man wø näk ee cooŋø ki cwïnye.

Ni beeye ki køøre na ö uuni thuwø, u na wïny luumma näk adïëri, luumma nyään na met na jootu pïëm ree man piem uuni ki gø, ni jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni, ni mooc uuni ki ŋïï na näk Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, na kwøŋ buuk.
english: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

anywaa: Ni beeye kuri mar olaaw marø këël mano wïïl øøni wøk, ø na näk jiye, ni tïme ni ø pwøya ajieme.
english: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, na wïnynya gøøni ni Kwäärö ma Jecu you ŋäädhö møn, nou mëër ki jø Jwøk bëët,
english: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,

anywaa: pwøc mara man pwøa Jwøk kiperu kära wiiø, naa lääŋŋa uuni ki yïth laam 'moa cooth,
english: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

anywaa: nee Jwøk na näk Jwø Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, ni näk Uun ajiem, nee u mooe ki wïdhi mo leer, ki cwïny mou wëëge ka ŋäc eni,
english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

anywaa: ni jap nyeŋ mo cwïnynyu kiper nou tïmu nou ŋäya ŋäädhe mana en nyïm mana cwøl u kipere, ni ŋäyu dööŋ olaaw mare na näk ree da ajiem mo bäŋ teeŋe ni wø en jï jø Jwøk,
english: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

anywaa: nou ŋäya teege ni wø dööŋŋe ba maar røm ni tïïe dëëtø, ø na näk ojïëy ni ŋäädhø, ki køør tïïc mana tïïe ki teege na dwøŋ døc,
english: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

anywaa: na nyoodhe dëër Krictø, kanya tïŋ gø maal ki yi thøø, ni wëëk gø pïïn bäät cwïïe maalø.
english: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

anywaa: Ni dwøŋŋa eni dï moa näk ocuumö bëët, ki teeŋ teek bëët ki rööny, ni lïëŋŋa nyeŋŋe dï nyeŋ moa näk ocaa bëët, ni patha yi piny man keere, 'ba këël yi piny mano ööi thuwø.
english: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

anywaa: Ni cïp jammi bëët cer gø, ni tïïc gø ni ena wïth jammi bëët kiper acooŋ Jwøk,
english: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,

anywaa: na näk beeye dëëre, ni beeye ni wø wëëk gø thur kare, ni tïm jammi bëët ni thura karge ki køøre.
english: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk uuna tïïe nou kwøw kanya bëëdu ni uuno thøw kiper gïïa dhallu ki japa reyø na tïïyu,
english: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

anywaa: japa kwøŋu køørge caath na jïëyu ki luum pinyi en, na caathu køør kwääy juuga reyø ni wø jïge da teek yi jamø, ni beeye jwøøgø ni poot tïïö cwïny jø adhala enø.
english: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø bëët, øøna kwøŋ bëëtö yïthge na bëënnø japa reyø na many cwïnynyø, na caadhø køør gïï wø many dëëlli ki cwïny, ni bëëdø ni øøna jø raay kaamar jøw bëët, ni wëëc Jwøk ena bäätø.
english: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ni wø kunyö døc, këël na bëëdø ni øøno thøw ki køør gïïa dhalø, øøna døøc mo kwøw ki Krictø na aciel ki køør mëër mare na päl na mëëre ki øøni. Kiper beeye met yi Jwøk na piem uuni.
Ni tïŋ øøni maal, ni wëëk ø pïïn kanya ciel ki eni maalø ki ri Krictø Jecu,
english: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:

anywaa: kiper nee met yie na päl na bäŋ teeŋe nee nyoodhe jïïø ki bäth ec ki ri Krictø Jecu yi piny mano ööi.
english: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.

anywaa: Kiper beeye met ec na piem uuni ki køør ŋäädhe. Ni manøgø ba tïïc uuni, 'ba beeye muuy mana cïp Jwøki ki met ec,
english: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:

anywaa: ni paa kiper tïïe, kiper nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo töödö.
english: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

anywaa: Kiper øøna gïïa tïïe, ni cwääc ka ri Krictø Jecu kiper tïïe moa beyø, moa näk ojiiŋ Jwøki cøøn, nee ø bëëdø ni ø tïïya geni.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, parru wïthu ni u nywöli ni uuna juurre dïkwøŋ, nou cøøri nou patha odaŋø ki jï jøøa näk odaŋø, ni beeye daŋ man wø tïïc ki cenø dëël.
english: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

anywaa: Ni parru wïthu ki man näk kar kaaca karu bäär ki Krictø, ni uuna jiy mo path ki po jø Icriel, nou tøør ri luupa tuut Jwøki na buuk, ni jïïu bäŋ ŋäädhe kiper yi nyïm, ni jïïu bäŋ Jwøk piny.
english: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane ki ri Krictø Jecu uuni na karu bäär dïkwøŋ, uuna käl kany mo cään ki køør rem Krictø.
english: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na wëëk ø bëët-mëër, ŋata dwal jø Juuth ki juurre na aciel, ni raany keew mar män na pääŋ øøni,
english: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

anywaa: ki køør mana dïïm ciik moa cem ki luupa en yïthge ki rïŋ dëëre, kiper nee cwääc na dhaanhø aciel mo nyään ki ree na kar ariiø, ni tïïya bëët-mëër,
english: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

anywaa: nee ø dwøk baŋ Jwøk karøbëët na dëël aciel ki køør thøø mare bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni raanynya män na eno nø.
english: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

anywaa: Ni ööe ni køp luum bëët-mëër jïïu, u na karu bäär, këël jï jøøa karge cään.
english: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køøre na jïtø ki jöö karøbëët man cøø baŋ Wuuö ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na näk aciel.
english: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u ba path këët nou patha wëëlle, 'ba uuna wäät thwöth paac ki jø Jwøk na aciel, nou ena ri tuuŋ Jwøk.
english: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;

anywaa: Ni uuna øtø mo ogeer bäät nyïïatwieli ki nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni ö Krictø Jecu ki dëëre ni näk kïn gøøt mana mak dëër ødøgø,
english: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;

anywaa: ŋata cuŋ øtø kare bäre ree, ni døøŋŋe ni tïme na øt Jwøk mo dwøŋ ni ena kur keere dëër Wuuö.
english: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na ö uuni thuwø ni wø geer u ree, kiper nou tïmu na kar bëëtö mar Jwøk ki køør Jwïëye.
english: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.

anywaa: Ni beeye na ööa, a na Pøøl, na tööny Krictø Jecu kiperu, u na juurre.
english: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,

anywaa: Ni yaa caarø ni tïï met yi Jwøk na wëëk aani kiperu you wïnynyö,
english: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

anywaa: kaawat mana wëëk aani ŋäc gïna näk tiere okwøŋ kan ki køør mana nyuthi aani, keda mana gööra gø ni ciek en.
english: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

anywaa: Kiper kanyo kwaannu gïn, nee mana ŋääa kiper gïna näk tiere okwøŋ kan mar Krictø nee ŋäyu,
english: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

anywaa: gïna näk kär kwøŋ wëëk ŋäc jï jiy yïth beenhnhe moa cääŋŋe, keda mana nyoodhi ennø jï nyïïatwiete na en kur keerge ki nyïïkuk Jwøk ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

anywaa: Ni beeye ni juurre atïmö na lwiidhi ki jø Jwøk na aciel, ni gena dëël aciel, ni karge dagø ri buuk mana buuk ki ri Krictø Jecu ki køør luumma nyään na met.
english: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:

anywaa: 'Ba aani, aana wëëk tïny luummögø ki køør met yi Jwøk na cïbe jïra, na wëëk a ka køør teege ni wø tïïö.
english: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, këël na thiinh kara døc dï jø Jwøk bëët, met ec manøgø awëëk aani, nee gïr kwär mar Krictø na näk bäŋ teeŋe køba jï juurre,
english: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;

anywaa: nee jiy bëët wëëga neen tïï gïna näk tiere okwøŋ Jwøki kan cwïnye cøøn, eni na cwääc jammi bëët,
english: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:

anywaa: nee leec wï Jwøk na päl wëëk ŋäc ennø ki køør acooŋ Jwøk jï moa näk ocuumö maalø ki moa jïge da teek maalø.
english: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,

anywaa: Ni beeye gïna näk ee kwøŋ cooŋ ki cwïnye cøøn kanya poot pinynyi, ni beeye na wëëk thur kare ennø ki ri Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääyø,
english: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:

anywaa: eni na mooc cwïnynyø ki cer ki man ŋääø gø ni jïïø da jöö man cøø nyïm Jwøk ki køør mana ŋäädhø eni.
english: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a kwaya uuni, kär cwïnynyu wëëgu pädhö ki gïr gïï ni leth ni jwøra kiperu en. Kiper ge kännö ka ajiem jïïu.
english: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cøŋŋa wø këëlla piny nyïm Wuuö,
english: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

anywaa: eni na ö nyeŋ tuŋi bëët moa en maal ki moa en piny na caai ree,
english: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

anywaa: naa lämö nee u wëëk tëënnö ki teek mano ööi ki køør Jwïëye ki yïth cwïnynyu, keda mana päl ajieme,
english: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

anywaa: nee Krictø bëëde cwïnynyu ki køør ŋäädhe, nou cuŋŋu nou teek ri mëër,
english: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

anywaa: nee lønye jïïu ki jø Jwøk bëët na aciel ki man ŋäyu bäc mëëyögø, ki päl yie, ki bäye man ci maal, ki bäye man ci piny,
english: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

anywaa: nee mëëc Krictø putu ŋäc, mëëya näk ba løny ki man ŋääi bäre, nee cwïnynyu pääŋe ki beeny Jwøk bäre.
english: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.

anywaa: Pwøc en jïre, eni ni wø løny jïre ki man tïïc gïï mo kaala gïï wø pëënynyø wala gïï wø caarø, ki køør teege ni wø tïïö cwïnynyø.
english: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

anywaa: Ajiem en jïre ki ya acooŋ Jwøk ki ri Krictø Jecu ki yïth beenhnhe bëët këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a na tööny Wuuö, a kwaya uuni ki man bëëdu ki bëëtö mo orømø ki cwödö mana cwøl uuni kipere,
english: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

anywaa: nou mwöl ni bäŋ atöör cwïnynyu, ni bäŋ jøømø, ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny ki røgu ki ri mëër,
english: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

anywaa: ni cwïnynyu jööt ki man putu bëëtö ki cwïny aciel man wø cïp Jwïëc Jwøki, nou bëëdö ka bëët-mëër man wø dwal uuni.
english: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

anywaa: Kiper beeye dëël aciel ki Jwïëc Jwøk aciel, keda mana cööl u ŋäädhe aciel mano en nyïm na cwøl u kipere,
english: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;

anywaa: ni beeye Kwäärö aciel, ki ŋäädhe aciel, ki lwøk aciel na nyuudhi,
english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

anywaa: ni beeye Jwøk aciel na näk Wääø bëët, eni na en wïth jammi bëët, ni nude ri jammi bëët, ni ena cwïnynyø bëët.
english: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø dïïø amooc ki muuy ki køør met yi Jwøk kaawat mana cïpi ya Krictø ni ee rømø.
english: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

anywaa: Ni beeye na caani, «Ni kanya ci maal akädö ki jiy mo thööth mo ee maaø ki tøŋ, ni cïpe ki muuce jï jiy.»
english: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

anywaa: 'Ba na købi ni ena ci maalø, tiere ŋø? Beeye ni ena ö piny kiree thuwø.
english: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

anywaa: 'Ba eni na ö piny poot na eni na ci maal thuwø, ni ena maal wïth jammi bëët, kiper nee maal bäre ki piny bäre pääŋe ki dëëre.
english: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

anywaa: 'Ba muuce moe moa cïbe beeye ki man tïm jø møøki na nyïïatwieli, ni tïm jø møøki na nyïïkuk Jwøk, ni tïm jø møøki na jø wø køp luum Jwøk, ni tïm jø møøki na dïkwääc jiy ki dïpööye,
english: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo läämö jï jø Jwøk kiper tïïc man wø tïïcge ni ge wëëga dëër Krictø tëënnö,
english: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:

anywaa: këël mano dwätø karøbëët na aciel ki ri ŋäädhe ki ŋäc man ŋääø O Jwøk, ni døøŋŋø, ni thurø karø kaamar Krictø ni wø näk othur kare,
english: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:

anywaa: kiper nee ø ba bëëdø kaamar obwöre këët ni wø wïïri køør pwöc ma teeŋi ki køør reek nyeŋ jiy ni wø maaŋ wïth jiy ki cwøkge.
english: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

anywaa: 'Ba ø doo caana adïëri ni ø mëër, ni ø døøŋŋø ki yïth jammi bëët ki ri Krictø, eni na en wïth jammi bëët,
english: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:

anywaa: ni beeye eni ni wø ö dëëlli bäre wø piidhe ki ree ni tëënne ki ri mëër, dëëra näk okupö ni dwäte na aciel ki køør mut na kïth dëëre, kany wø ö thääŋö man nø wø tïïc kuna näk mare.
english: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a cäänna uuni ni mara køba ka nyeŋ Wuuö, ni kär nou bëëdö këët kaawat man wø bëët juurre ni wø bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn kwanyge, ni ge tøør ri kwøw mar Jwøk kiper na bäŋe gïn mo ŋäcge ki køør mana teek cwïnyge.
english: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

anywaa: Ni tïmge na jø ataa, ni putge cwïnyge cïp køør gïï mo patha karge, ni geno wär ki man tïïcge teeŋ jammi bëët moa reyø.
english: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

anywaa: 'Ba bëëtö manøgø paa mana kwanynyu baŋ Krictø.
english: But ye have not so learned Christ;

anywaa: Ni u yaa ŋäädhö ni gïre you wïnynyö ni pwöny uuni ki nyeŋŋe, ki køør adïëri mana en ri Jecu.
english: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

anywaa: Weyu bëëtö maru mana dïkwøŋ na kwøŋu bëëtö ki gø na raac ki køør japa reyø na nieŋ cwïnynyu køørge na cøøk uuni.
english: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

anywaa: Døøyu cwïnynyu mo nyärö,
english: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

anywaa: ni bëëdu ki bëëtö mana nyään, na näk ocwääö ni caala bëët Jwøk, na bëëtö mana beer na näk adïëri na en kur keere.
english: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, weyu tööt, ni tïmu karubëët nou cäänö ka adïëri jï wat mør. Kiper ø ena ri dëël aciel.
english: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

anywaa: «Ni näk mou wëër, käru bääyö.» Ni ba wëëgu cäŋ päth piny nou poot ni uuno gootø,
english: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

anywaa: ni ba wëënnu anägö ki jöö.
english: Neither give place to the devil.

anywaa: Kär dee kuu mo kwädö këët, 'ba beerra man tïïe ki cere ki tïïc ma adïëri, kiper nee lønye jïre ki man cïpe jï jø wø can.
english: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

anywaa: Kär dee luubö mo raac mo wïnyi dhøgu, 'ba näk gïn mo beer keere mo dhaanhø tëënnö ki gø kaawat man wø manynyi, nee tïme ni beer jï jø wø wïny gø.
english: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

anywaa: Kär cwïny Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere wëëgu ränynyö, ŋata jootu ŋïï ree kiper cäŋo wïïr kwöri mou yie.
english: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.

anywaa: Weyu keec cwïny na bäre bäre, ki wëër, ki gootø, ki pïëm, ka ajaany, ki cøl cwïny bäre.
english: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

anywaa: 'Ba køønynyu røgu, ni cwïnynyu da mëër, ni wëënnu røgu kaawat mana ö Jwøki na wec raayu ki ri Krictø.
english: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋwaallu mar Jwøk kaamar obwöre mo di mëërö ki ge.
english: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;

anywaa: Ni caathu jöör mëër, kaamar Krictø na mëër ki øøni ni cïp dëëre kiperø na jëëdhi mo ŋwääö ni met no olämi man wø 'näk jï Jwøk.
english: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.

anywaa: 'Ba bëët käp, ki rääö, ki päl cwïny kär nee wïnyö dïïu na bäre bäre, kiper gïïögø beege gïïa ba beyø kiper jø Jwøk.
english: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;

anywaa: Kär dee rääc dhøk dïïu, wala luum lal, wala waac mo reyø, gïï wø ba mïërö. 'Ba mana doo beerra eni beeye dwøk met ec jï Jwøk.
english: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wär ŋäyu døøc, ni bäŋe ŋat ma kääbi, wala ŋat mo raac, wala ŋat mo cwïnye päl ki jammi, ni wø caal wøør juu møøk, mo jïre da kare yi buc Krictø ge ki Jwøk.
english: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat mo cøøk uuni ki luup mo oballe jaak. Kiper beeye teeŋ gïïögønø ni wø käl wëëc Jwøk bäät jø adhala.
english: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, käru cäädhö ki geni.
english: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.

anywaa: Kiper dïkwøŋ uuna muudhö, 'ba kawaane uuna tar ki ri Wuuö. Cäädhu ni uuna nyïï tar.
english: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

anywaa: Kiper nyïëdi mo wø nywøl tarri wø joota ri gïï wø näk adïëri bëët, na beyø ni näkge wøpe.
english: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

anywaa: Ni kwanynyu bëëtö man wø met yi Wuuö ki gø.
english: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

anywaa: Tïïyu karu ni bäär ki tïïe mo muudhö ni wø bäŋ gïn duuge. 'Ba u doo jooga geni.
english: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

anywaa: Kiper beeye gïr laac wïc këël ki man caan gïï wø tïïc jøøgø ni ege kanø.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wø nyooth tarri wø tïmö ni nëënö, kiper gïn wø nëëni, tar wø ena dëëre.
english: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.

anywaa: Ni beeye na købi, «Ni päyï nø, ï no obutö, ni ööï maal ki yi thøø. 'Ba Krictø ïïno mooe ki tar.»
english: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gwøgu dëëtu døøc ki wääthu, ni wïthu leer nou patha jiy mo wïthge ba leer.
english: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

anywaa: Ni magu rou døc ki man tïïyu gïï mo beyø, kiper nïri ii beege nïne mo raay.
english: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, käru tïmö ni uuna bøøre, 'ba ŋäyu gïna many Wuue.
english: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

anywaa: Käru meeyø ki kwøŋ, kiper beeye wø käl bëëtö mo raac, 'ba cwïnynyu päŋge ki Jwïëc Jwøk,
english: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

anywaa: ni cäänu ki røgu nou cäänö ka ri Dut Pwøc, ki dut Jwøk, ki dut met ec mo wø wär ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk, nou wära dudi mo met jï Wuuö ki cwïnynyu bäre,
english: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

anywaa: nou dwøga met ec jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö cooth ki yïth jammi bëët, ki nyeŋ Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

anywaa: Bëënnu røgu kiper mana lwäärru Krictø.
english: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.

anywaa: U na mään, bëënnu cwøwu kede tïïyu jï Wuuö.
english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper dhaagø wø bëënna cwøre, kaawat man wø bëët Krictø ni ena wïc mar acooŋ Jwøk na näk beeye dëëre, ni bëëdö na Pïëmi mare.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

anywaa: 'Ba keda man ö acooŋ Jwøki ni bëën Krictø en, beerra man ö määnni thuwø ni bëënge cwøwge na enønø ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

anywaa: U na cwøw, mëërru ki määru kaamar Krictø na mëër ka acooŋ Jwøk ni cïp dëëre kiper gø,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

anywaa: kiper na acooŋ Jwøk døøc mo ena kur keere na mar Jwøk ki køør mana peny gø ki pïï ki luumme ni døøc gø mo waany,
english: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

anywaa: na acooŋ Jwøk peeth nyïme ka ajiem, ni bäŋ kïdö mo raac wala kany mo ba mïërö wala gïn mør mo ena dëëre, nee tïme ni ena kur keere ni bäŋ kany mo jøøŋŋi dëëre.
english: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, cwøw doo mëër ki määrge kaawat man wø mëërge ki dëëtge. Ŋat wø mëër ki cïïe, mëër ki dëëre.
english: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ ŋat mo män ki dëëre, 'ba wø piitha gø ni gwøk gø, kaawat man wø tïïc Krictø kiper acooŋ Jwøk.
english: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

anywaa: Kiper øøna thäk dëëre.
english: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

anywaa: «Kiper manøgønø, beeye tiere ni wø ö dhaanhe wø wec wänni ki menni ni dwätge ki cïïe. Ni ö ge riet ni tïmge na dëël aciel.»
english: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

anywaa: Gïnögø beeye gïn mo dwøŋ døc mo tiere okwøŋ kan, naa cäänö kaper Krictø ka acooŋ Jwøk.
english: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni mëëre ki cïïe keda dëëre, ni ö dhaage ni lwäär cwøre.
english: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

anywaa: Obwöre, leŋŋu luup jøøa nywøl uuni, ki ri Wuuö, kiper beeye mana beer.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

anywaa: «Wøør wäru ki meru,» ni manøgø beeye luubö mana kwøŋ cem ni ree da buuk,
english: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

anywaa: «Nee tïme ni beer jïrï, niï ruuwï wïth ŋøøm.»
english: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

anywaa: U na wëëe, kär cwïny nyïïu wëëgu ränynyö nee gootge. 'Ba piithu geni ki pwöc ni nyuthu geni jöör Wuuö.
english: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

anywaa: U na laaŋe, leŋŋu dööt jøø ni bëënnu pinyi en ki cwïnynyu bäre nou lwäär ni dëëtu kwanynyi, kede tïïyu jï Krictø.
english: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

anywaa: Ni ba tïïyu kaper na mïëre ki nyeŋ jiy nou døøya yïth jiy mo met. 'Ba tïïyu ni uuna laak Krictø, nou tïïya mana many Jwøki ki cwïnynyu bäre,
english: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

anywaa: nou tïïö ka met cwïny kede u tïnynya Wuuö ni patha jiy,
english: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

anywaa: ni ŋäyu ni gïn wø beer wø tïïc dhaanhe, wø cäŋe ka jootø baŋ Wuuö, nee ena laŋŋø wala ŋat mo bëëdö ka wïïe.
english: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

anywaa: U na kwääri, bëëdu na enønø ki geni, ni weyu geni ki ŋwönynyö, kiper ŋäyu ni ŋata näk Kwääyge ni näk Kwääyu ena maal, ni luumme aciel kiper jiy bëët.
english: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

anywaa: 'Ba mana dööŋ keere nø, tëënnu ki ri Wuuö ki køør teege, eni ni wø teek.
english: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

anywaa: Røøu kwöt leny mar Jwøk dëëtu kare bäre nou ba bööt cwøk anägö.
english: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

anywaa: Kiper leny marø ba këëlø ka jiy, 'ba ø këëdi ka gïïa jïge da teek maalø, ki moa jïge da teek piny, ki kwääc muudhö ni en pinyi en, ni ø këëdi ka juu na reyø ni en maalø na thööth døc.
english: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, källu kwöt leny mar Jwøk kare bäre, kiper nou cuŋŋu nou teek dïcäŋo raac. 'Ba noo nø tïïyu gïïögø bëët, uuno cuŋŋi nou teek møn.
english: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cuŋŋu ni kaw na näk adïëri you twöö ŋäthu, ni kwöt nywïënyö na näk bëënynyö you kïth kööthu,
english: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

anywaa: ni jap luumma nyään na met mar bëët-mëër you røø tietu.
english: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

anywaa: 'Ba mana pere letha eni dï japøgø bëët, lwørru kwöt leny na näk ŋäädhe, ni beeye gïno jwöyu tøøk maac mo ŋata raac ki gø.
english: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

anywaa: Ni kääru cöör nywïënyö na näk pïëm man piem jiy ki gø, ko opëëllö mar Jwïëc Jwøk, ni beeye luum Jwøka eni.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

anywaa: Lämu cooth ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk, ki teeŋ laam bëët ki kwac. Kiper manøgønø, bëëdu ni nyeŋŋu you jabø ni dëëtu you gwøø, nou kwaaya Jwøk kiper jø Jwøk bëët,
english: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

anywaa: këël kipera thuwø, naa wëënni ki jöö man jaba dhaa ki gø ni cwïnya da cer ki man køba luumma nyään na met na näk tiere okwøŋ kan,
english: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

anywaa: luumma tïma ni aana kar dhøk kipere ni bëëda yïth oguudi en. Lämu kipera kiper nee luummögø køba døøc ni cwïnya da cer keda mana daa gø caanø.
english: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane Taykika, cöögö mana mëërö ki gø na näk ŋat tïïc mo oŋäädhö ki nyeŋ Wuuö, jammi bëët ocaane jïïu, kiper nee bëëtö mara man bëëda ki gø en, ki gïn tïïa en, nee ŋäyu thuwø.
english: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø ni jääŋŋa eni baŋu kipere, nee bëëtö marwa man wa bëëtwa nidïï nee ŋäyu, ni cøm cwïnynyu.
english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

anywaa: 'Ba bëët-mëër en bäät nyïïmëëe, ki mëër, ki ŋäädhe ciel man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wuuö, ge ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäät jø wø mëër ki Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø ki mëër mo ba jøøl.
english: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl ki Timöthi, wa na laak Krictø Jecu. Wa määtha uuni na jø Jwøk bëët ni en dëër Krictø yi Pilipay, ki jø wø raŋ acooŋ Jwøk, ki jø wø tïny acooŋa.
english: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu, ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøa wø pwøa pwøø kany wø para gïru
english: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

anywaa: ki yïth laam 'moa bëët, naa wø lämö cooth ni yia met.
english: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

anywaa: Ni met ec mara wø dwøga dwøgø kiper na dwätu ki aani ri luumma nyään na met, ki mana täge ki dïcäŋa wïnynyu gø yie, këël kawaane en.
english: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääa ni eni na nø tägö ki tïïc mo beer dëëtu, oput tïïö këël mano thur kare dïcäŋo näk cäŋ Jecu Krictø.
english: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

anywaa: Wøp jïra ki mana caara gïnögø kiperu bëët. Kiper gïru ena cwïnya u bëët, kaawat mana dwätu ki aani ri met yi Jwøk, këël ki yi twöc mara, ki piem luumma nyään na met nee cuŋŋe ni teek.
english: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk beeye ni ŋäc mara, naa lääŋŋa uuni døc ki mëër mana en jï Krictø Jecu.
english: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba a wø kwaya Jwøk nee mëër maru pälle cooth, ka acaara ki man ŋäyu gïno beer ki gïno raac,
english: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

anywaa: kiper nou jïëyu ki gïïa beyø, ni putu bëëtö ni cwïnynyu tar ni bäŋ ajäla dëëtu dïcäŋo duu Krictø,
english: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

anywaa: nou bëëdu ni cwïnynyu päŋ ki nyïï bëënynyö mo wø ööi ki køør Jecu Krictø, nee Jwøk jiem ni pwøi ki køøru.
english: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, a manynya uuni man ŋäyu gø ni gïna tägö dëëra atïmö møn ni tïïya luumma nyään na met ni nyaai.
english: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

anywaa: Ni puti ya dïkuye moa kurö ŋäc, këël jø møga bëët, naa twöc kaper Krictø.
english: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

anywaa: Ni ö thööth nyïïmëëe ni tëënge ki ri Wuuö kiper twöc mara, ni tïmge ni ge teek døc ki man caange luum Jwøk ni bäŋ lwär.
english: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk gïr Krictø køpge kaper gwön ki pïëm na en cwïnyge, ni ö jø møøki ni køpge gø ni cwïnyge leer jaak.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø køp gïr Krictø ni cwïnyge leer wø tïïcge ka mëër, ni ŋäcge ni aano kïth kany kiper luumma nyään na met ni wø caana.
english: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

anywaa: 'Ba jø gwön ki jø pïëm moøgø, gïr Krictø wø køpge kaper dëëtge keerge, ni yïthge da atade, 'ba ege caarø noo lïnhnhi jïra, a ni en øt twöc en.
english: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø noo caana nø? Beeye aciel keere. Nee cwøk wala adïëri, gïr Krictø wø di købø ki yïth moøgø bëët. Ni beeye ni mïn yia en ki gø. 'Ba ka adïëri møn, yia omïnni,
english: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

anywaa: kiper ŋääa ki cwïnya ni cuŋ gïn en otïmö ni beeye pïëm man piem aani ki gø, ki køør laam mou, ki køny mar Jwïëc Jecu Krictø.
english: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

anywaa: Kiper yaa ŋäädhø døc ni wïïa ba doo lää bäre bäre, 'ba cwïnya yaa maa døc kawaane kaawat man wø bëëda cooth, nee Krictø wøør ki dëëra, nee mara kwøw wala thøø.
english: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk maa kwøw, a bëënna Krictø, 'ba ni näk maa thøw, beeye beenynye eni.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk beeye kwøw ki dëël man en, a doo tïmö naa tïïö ki tïïc mo beer. 'Ba mano jiera kuua.
english: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

anywaa: Gïï na ariiø ii a ege diyø døc. 'Ba a doo naa manynya man aa ni cøøa buut Krictø, kiper beeye mana beerra eni døc.
english: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

anywaa: 'Ba ki man bëëda naa kwøw ki dëël man en, beer kaperu.
english: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø ŋääa døc, ni ŋääa ni aano ruu naa bëëdö dïïu, kiper nou tëënnu, nee yïthu mïnge ri ŋäädhe man,
english: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

anywaa: kiper manøgønø, nou jïtu ki jöö man mïn yïthu ki gø dëër Krictø Jecu ki køøra, kiper mano duua baŋu.
english: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

anywaa: 'Ba man caana jïïu keere nø, bëëdu ni bëëtö maru orømø ki luumma nyään na met mar Krictø. Kiper ni näk maa duua baŋu ni neena uuni, wala a ba ö baŋu, nee wïnynya ki man näk mou cuŋŋö nou teek ki cwïny aciel, ni döötu aciel, nou tïïö døc ni dëëtu you maa karubëët, kiper ŋäädhe mar luumma nyään na met.
english: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

anywaa: 'Ba kär nou lwäyö ki gïï wø tïïc jø wø män ki uuni bëët. Kiper manøgøøni beeye nyuudhi jïge mar ränynyö marge, 'ba ki jïïu beeye pïëm man piem uuni ki gø, ni beeye man wø cïp Jwøki.
english: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

anywaa: 'Ba ocïbö jïïu kiper nyeŋ Krictø, ki man jwørru gïï mo leth kipere, ni paa man jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni keere.
english: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, u ena yi gïn mo teek mo keda leny, mo caala mana kwøŋu gø joot dëëra ca, ni cäŋu gø wïnynyö kawaane naa poot ena yie en.
english: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk ŋäyu ni da cøm cwïny ki ri Krictø, ki mëër ni tïïö cwïnynyu, ni uuno kuut ri Jwïëc Jwøk, ni da met ec ki pänh cwïny kiper jø møøk mo you joodø,
english: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

anywaa: putu yia døøc mo met na adïëri, ki man bëëdu ki cwïny aciel, ki mëër aciel, ki bëëtö aciel, ni cwïnynyu you dwalø.
english: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe gïn mo tïïyu ki cøl cwïny wala atöör, 'ba beerra man caarru gïr jiy møga, ni beyø geni ki uuni, nou mwöl.
english: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee ŋat ŋäc dëëre keere. 'Ba uuni, beerra man ŋäyu jiy møga thuwø.
english: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

anywaa: Putu bëëtö ki køør acaara mana jootu baŋ Krictø Jecu.
english: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

anywaa: Kiper eni, këël na rööme ki Jwøk, bëëtö mare na näk röömi ki mar Jwøk käre caarø ni beeye gïna dee maa ki teek.
english: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

anywaa: 'Ba dëëre adwøk piny, ni tïme ni mare rømi ka bëët laŋ, ni nywöli ni nëëna dhaanhø.
english: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

anywaa: 'Ba na joodi ni eni röömi ki dhaanhø, eni ree adwøk cään, ni leŋ luup bëët mo Jwøk, këël mana cööp ri thøø, ni beeye thøw bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ena thïïŋ Jwøki ni røøny gø, ni mooc gø ki nyeŋ mo dwøŋŋa eni dï nyeŋ bëët moa näk ocaaø.
english: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kany wäro wïny nyeŋ Jecu, cøŋŋi bëët doo këëlla piny, ni beege moa en maal, ki moa en piny, këël ki moa en tiet ŋøøm.
english: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

anywaa: Ni ö lëëpi bëët ni caange gø, ni Jecu Krictø beeye Kwäärö, ni jiemma Jwøk na näk Wuuö.
english: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, u no omëëya, u ni wø leŋ luup cooth, beerra man putu pïëm man piem uuni ki gø tïïc no othur kare nou lwäär ni dëëtu kwanynyi, ni paa kany wø nuda buutu keere, 'ba doo beerra eni man putu gø tïïc, këël kany tøøra buutu en.
english: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

anywaa: Kiper beeye Jwøk ni wø tïïö cwïnynyu, ni mooya uuni ki teek ki man tïïyu moe na met yie ki ge.
english: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

anywaa: Tïïyu jammi bëët nou ba dwaalli ni bäŋ pïëm,
english: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe ajäla mo ö dëëtu, ni bëëtö maru beer, ni uuna nyïï Jwøk mo bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö maru, kany bëëdu dï jøøi ni reyø ni wïthge teek ni en piny en, jøøo rienynyu dïge keda ceer ni wø meeny piny,
english: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

anywaa: ni luubö mana en kwøwi ree you maa cwïnynyu, kiper naa tïma naa töödö dïcäŋo näk cäŋ Krictø, ki man näk mo ŋwïëy mara kära ŋwieø jaak, wala raa kära öölö jaak.
english: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk aano tïmö kaamar ogweea ni køny aani bäät jëëdhi na näk ŋäädhe maru, yia met, ni yïthø met, karøbëët.
english: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø, yïthu doo met na enøgønø, ni mïn yïthu ki aani na aciel.
english: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

anywaa: 'Ba yaa ŋäädhö ki ri Kwäärö ma Jecu ki man laara Timöthi jääŋ baŋu, nee yia mïnne ki gïïo wïnynya baŋu.
english: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ dhaanhø mør buuta mo nëëna eni mo cwïnye ena baŋu na adïëri kiper bëëtö maru.
english: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy møga atïmö ni ge ŋäya dëëtge keerge, ni paa moa näk mo Jecu Krictø.
english: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

anywaa: 'Ba beeny Timöthi ŋäyu, kaawat mana bëëde ni tïïö ki aani na aciel ri luumma nyään na met, ni eni bëëdö keda nyilaal mo ena buut wänni.
english: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, yaa ŋäädhö ni eni laara ka jääŋ baŋu, kanyo jooda bëëtö mara mano tïme nidïï.
english: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

anywaa: Ni yaa ŋäädhö ki ri Wuuö ni aani ki dëëra, aano ööi thuwø kany mo cään.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

anywaa: 'Ba yaa caarø ni doo beerra eni ki man jääŋŋa coka ma Eparödaata baŋu, eni ni wø tïïö ki aani, na ŋat leny mo odwätö ki aani, ni beeye ŋata jääŋŋu, na køny canna.
english: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

anywaa: Kiper ena tïmö ni lääŋŋa uuni bëët, ni cwïnye opädhö kiper mana wïnynyu gø ni eni tuu.
english: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

anywaa: Ena tuu møn, ki täw mo bøtha dhi thøø. 'Ba ena køny Jwøki, ni paa eni keere, këël aani thuwø, kiper naa ba tïma naa kïmmö bäät kïmmö maya.
english: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a manynya gø døc ki man jääŋŋa gø baŋu, kiper nee yïthu cäŋ mïnnö kanyo jootu eni, nee cwïnya pï piny mëëth.
english: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, pänhnhu eni ki nyeŋ Wuuö ni mïn yïthu bëët, ni wøørru teeŋ jøøgø.
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

anywaa: Kiper eni bøtha kany mo thiinh ki thøø kiper tïï Krictø, ni taak jwïëye, kiper mana dou tïïö jïra, nee thur kare.
english: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

anywaa: 'Ba mana dööŋ keere nø, nyïïmera, yïthu mïnge ki ri Wuuö. Aani, a ba ööl ki man gööra gïïa kwøŋa göör jïïu, ni beeye gïn mo beer kiperu.
english: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou kiper guu, ni gwøgu rou ki jø wø tïïc raay, ni gwøgu rou ki jø wø pöö ki pwöc mo patha adïëri kiper luum daŋ.
english: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

anywaa: Kiper øøni, øøna jøøa daŋ na adïëri, ni wø wøør Jwøk ki ri Jwïëy, ni ø töödö ka ri Krictø Jecu, ni ø ba ŋääth mo dëël na bäre bäre.
english: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

anywaa: Kiper aani ki dëëra doo mïërö jïra ki man ŋäädha dëëra. 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo ee caarø ni mïërö jïre ki man ŋääth dëëre, kadha mara.
english: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

anywaa: Kiper aana daŋ ri bäc nïne, ni aana thwønh ki yi Icriel, ni aana nyï dhi øt Benjamen, ni aana ŋat Ibaru, naa nywöli ni aana Ibaru. 'Ba nee kiper Ciik Jwøk, aana ŋat Paricith.
english: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

anywaa: Nee kiper tïïc mana tïïa ki cwïnya bäre, aana gëëmö ka acooŋ Jwøk. 'Ba ni näk mo beeye kiper bëënynyö man wø en køør Ciik Jwøk, bäŋ ajäla dëëra.
english: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, gïïögø bëët na wara beyø jïra ataa kiper nyeŋ Krictø.
english: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

anywaa: Ni jammi bëët ataa møn, kiper mana beerra eni døc beeye ki man ŋääa Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääya. Ni beeye kipere na taaa jammi bëët, ni neeta geni kaamar juu mo owetø, kiper nee Krictø ci jïra,
english: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

anywaa: kiper naa joot naa ena dëëre, naa ba en dëëre kaper bëënynyö mana näk mara keera ni wø en ri ciik Jwøk, 'ba beeye bëënynyö man wø joot ki køør ŋäädhe ki ri Krictø, ni beeye bëënynyö man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk ogöök ri ŋäädhe,
english: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

anywaa: kiper naa tïma naa ŋäya eni, ki teek duunne wøk ki yi thøø, naa tïma naa nywaaga gïïa leth na jwøre, ni tïma kaamare ri thøwe;
english: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

anywaa: naa ŋäätha gø ni løny ki man duua wøk ki yi thøø.
english: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

anywaa: Naa ba caan gø ni moøgø bëët onø ö jïra, wala aano nø thur kara. 'Ba dëëra yaa maa, nee tïïa na mara, kiper Krictø Jecu aana nø tïïe na mare.
english: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, paa yaa caarø ni manøgø yaa maa bäre. Ba gïrpiny aciel keere man wø tïïa, wïïa bäŋ wø para kiper gïïa no opöödhö, 'ba cwïnya yaa mïnnö kiper gïnö ni en nyïma ice.
english: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

anywaa: Ni dëëra yaa maa, naa pïïa kanya manynyi, kiper nee muuy mana cwøl aani kipere maal ki ri Krictø Jecu, nee cïp jïra.
english: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba ø ni døøŋŋø ii, beege gïïögø na døø lääŋŋö ki cwïnynyø. 'Ba ni näk gïïögø poot ba røm cwïnynyu, onyooth Jwøki jïïu thuwø.
english: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man putø mana nø joodø mak na adïëri.
english: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, ŋwaallu mara, u bëët. Ni neetu jø wø bëëdö ki teeŋ bëëtö mana jootu baŋwa.
english: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example.

anywaa: Kiper kaawat man wø caana jïïu cooth, naa cäŋa gø caannø jïïu kawaane naa jwöŋö en, jiy mo thööth atïmö ni ge män ki jaadha no odëëdö mar Krictø.
english: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

anywaa: 'Ba cuŋ marge beeye ränynyö, ni jwøge beeye ec, ni lään wïc marge ege tïïö na ajiem, ni cwïnyge ege cïp køør jap piny.
english: Whose end is destruction, whose god is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, pøø beeye maal, ni ø koora Pïëmi no ööi ki yie, na näk Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø,
english: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

anywaa: ŋato wiil dëëtø moi ni reyø ii, ni tïïc ge ni caala dëëre na näk dëër ajiem, ki køør teek man wø en jïre ki man tïïc jammi bëët ni leŋa mare.
english: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, u na mëëra ki uuni, ni cwïnya lääŋŋa uuni, u na tïïc yia ni met, na gïr ajiem jïra, cuŋŋu nou teek ki ri Wuuö, u no omëëya.
english: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

anywaa: A kwaya ï na Yudia, naa kwaya ï na Cintike, ki man dwallu cwïnynyu ki ri Wuuö.
english: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

anywaa: Naa kwaya ïïni thuwø, ï na näk ŋat tïïc ma adïëri ki aani, køny määrögø, kiper gena tïïö ki aani na aciel ri luumma nyään na met, ge ki Kalement ki jø møga moa tïïö ki aani bëët, jøøa nyeŋge en yi wëël kwøw.
english: And I entreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

anywaa: Yïthu mïnge ki ri Wuuö cooth, naa cäŋa gø caannø jïïu, ni yïthu mïnge.
english: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

anywaa: Beerra man ö jøwi bëët man ŋäcge uuni nou mwöl, kiper Wuuö kare acäännö.
english: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn lääŋŋu ki cwïnynyu, 'ba ki yïth jammi bëët, gïn wäro manynyu wäru pëënynyu ki Jwøk nou lämö, nou kwaya eni, nou dwøga met ec baŋe.
english: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

anywaa: 'Ba leec cwïny man wø cïp Jwøki, na näk ba løny ki par, cwïnynyu ogwøe ka acaayu ki ri Krictø Jecu.
english: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba mana dööŋ keere nø, nyïïmera, gïn wäro näk adïëri, ki gïn mo orømø ki wödö, ki gïn mo thïïŋ, ki gïn mo bäŋ raay dëëre, ki gïr mëër, ki luubö mo beer, ni näk beege gïï mo met, na gïï mo orømø ki pwøc, caarru gïïögø.
english: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

anywaa: 'Ba tïïyu gïna kwanynyu, ki gïna jootu, ki gïna wïnynyu, ki gïna neennu baŋa. 'Ba Jwø wø cïp bëët-mëër, obëëdö ki uuni.
english: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

anywaa: 'Ba yia amïnnö døc ki ri Wuuö, kiper kawaane wïthu acäŋu caarrø cään, ni kønynyu aani. Kiper aana lääŋŋu møn, 'ba atïmö ni bäŋ jöö jïïu.
english: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, a ba dwaalli naa can. Kiper yaa nø kwany ki man bëëda ni cwïnya yaa cïp piny, këël a doo bëëdö kanya ŋø.
english: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

anywaa: Kiper ŋääa ki man bëëda naa can, ni ŋääa ki man bëëda ni da jammi jïra. 'Ba ki yïth jammi bëët, nee bëët jäŋö, wala bëët käc, yaa nø kwany ki man bëëda ni cwïnya yaa cïp piny.
english: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët løny jïra ki man tïïa ge ki køør ŋat wø tïïc aani naa teek.
english: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna tïïö ki gïn mo beer jïra, na kønynyu aani ki gïna leth na pïï dëëra.
english: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

anywaa: 'Ba u na jø Pilipay, ŋäyu ki dëëtu ni kanya täk luumma nyään na met dïïu, kanya wiia Macedönia, bäŋ acooŋ Jwøk mo ocïpö ki gïrpiny jïra, 'ba beeye u keeru.
english: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na ena Thecalönika, aana kønynyu, ni cäŋu aani kønynyø.
english: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a ba neet køny, 'ba a neeta gïna beer ni wø meet ree, noo cïp jïïu.
english: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

anywaa: 'Ba aana nø jïtö ki muuce baŋu mo thööth døc, ni jäŋa ki muuce moa cïbu cer Eparödaata, na näk caala olämi man wø waaŋ ni ŋwääö ni met, man wø jïëc Jwøki ki gø, ni wø met yie ki gø.
english: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøa uuno kønye ki gïïo manynyu bëët, kaawat mana näk eno kwär ka ajiem ki ri Krictø Jecu.
english: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

anywaa: Ajiem en jï Jwøø na näk Wuuö këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Määthu jø Jwøk bëët ki ri Krictø Jecu. Uuna määth nyïïmëëe moi ni en buuta ii.
english: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

anywaa: Uuni, uuna määth jø Jwøki bëët. 'Ba beeye jø po Cidhar ni määth uuni røk.
english: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø bëëde cwïnynyu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel mar Krictø Jecu ki køør mana many Jwøki, ki cöögø ma Timöthi.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

anywaa: A määtha uuni na jø Jwøk na en Köløcia, u na nyïïmëëe moa näk oŋäädhö ni en dëër Krictø. Met ec ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø bëëde bäätu.
english: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Cooth Jwøk na näk Wää Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, wø pwøcwa pwøø kany wø lämwa kiperu.
english: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

anywaa: Kiper awïnywa ni uuno jïëy ni ŋääthu Krictø Jecu, ni wïnywa mëër maru, nou mëër ki jø Jwøk bëët,
english: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,

anywaa: kiper gïna ŋääth na näk okanø jïïu maal. Ni beeye mana kwøŋu wïnynyö ri luubö mana näk adïëri, ni beeye luumma nyään na met,
english: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

anywaa: na ö baŋu, kaawat mana keethe møn yi piny bäre ni känne ki nyïëdi ni nyaae, kaawat mana tïïc dïïu thuwø dïcäŋa wïnynyu gø yie, ni kwanynyu tier met yi Jwøk ka adïëri,
english: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:

anywaa: kaawat mana kwanynyu gø baŋ Epapara, omëëcwa, na näk laŋ Krictø ki waani na aciel. Ena ŋat tïïc mo oŋäädhö mar Krictø mo kønya waani,
english: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;

anywaa: ni beeye eni na caan mëër maru na en ri Jwïëc Jwøk jïwa.
english: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, ki mana täge dïcäŋa wïnywa gø yie, bäŋ dïcäŋ aciel mo ewa ŋøl wøk, ni wa ba lämö kiperu, ni wa kwaaya Jwøk nee moa many Jwøki bëët tïme ni ŋäyu ki køør leec wïc ka acaare bëët mo wø en ri Jwïëye,
english: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

anywaa: nou bëëdu ki bëëtö mo beer mo rømø jï Wuuö, ni tïïyu gïï wø met yie ki geni keerge, nou kännö ki nyïëdi yïth tïïe moo beyø moo tïïyu bëët, ni meetu mana ŋäyu kiper Jwøk,
english: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

anywaa: nou tëënnu døc ki køør teek mare na bäŋ teeŋe, nee cwïnynyu magu, ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny ki met ec,
english: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

anywaa: nou pwøya Wuuö Jwøk, ŋata tïïc øøni ni øøno rømø ki man nywaaø olaawi ki jø Jwøk yi tar.
english: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na käl øøni wøk ki yi teek muudhö, ni kïth ø yi buc Wääde na mëëre ki gø.
english: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋata wiil øøni, ni wec raay 'moø ki køøre.
english: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Krictø röömi ka Jwøk na näk ba neen, ni beeye kaa dï jammi bëët moa cwääc.
english: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:

anywaa: Kiper jammi bëët cwääc ka ree, moa en maal, ki moa en piny, ki moa näk nëënö, ki moa näk ba nëëni, nee nyeye wala kwääri, wala gïïa jïge da teek maal, ki moa jïge da teek piny. Ni jammi bëët cwääc ka køøre, ni cwänynya eni.
english: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na nut kanya poot jammi bëët. Ni beeye eni na ö jammi bëët na kuutge ree.
english: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na Wïc jï dëël na näk acooŋ Jwøk. Ni beeye eni na nut wïlöölö, ni beeye eni na kwøŋ duu wøk ki yi thøø. Kiper manøgø nø, nee nyeŋŋe tïme ni lïëŋŋa eni dï jammi bëët.
