english: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni na mïn yi Jwøki ki man bëëde ree ki dëëre bäre.
english: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

anywaa: Ni duu jammi bëët baŋe ki køøre, moa en maal ki moa en piny, ni dwøga bëët-mëër kare, ki køør remme na cwïër piny bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba u na kwøŋ bëëtö ni uuno pää ki Jwøk, nou män ki Jwøk ki yïth acaare mou, nou tïïya raay,
english: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

anywaa: kawaane, uuna dwøk baŋe ki køør thøw Jecu, na cïp rïŋ dëëre, kiper nou kïth nyïme nou ena kur keeru, ni bäŋ ajäla dëëtu, ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi dëëtu nyïme,
english: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

anywaa: ni näk mou puta bëëtö ri ŋäädhe man nou ba dääŋi, ni putu bëëtö nou teek, ni ba weyu gïna ŋääthu ri luumma nyään na met na wïnynyu. Ni luummögø beeye mana køp jï moa näk ocwääö bëët dï piny bäre, ni put aani tïïc ni aana ŋat tïï gø, a na Pøøl en.
english: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, yia amïnnö ki gïïa leth ni wø jwøra kiperu. 'Ba ki dëëra man, a thööra gïïa dööŋ ri moa jwør Krictø kiper dëëre na näk acooŋ Jwøk.
english: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:

anywaa: Ni beeye na ööa na tïma ni aana ŋat tïï gø, kaawat mana wëëgi Jwøki aani kiperu, kiper nee luum Jwøk tïïa ni wïnyö ki pälle bäre,
english: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

anywaa: luumma näk tiere okwøŋ kan cøøn yïth beenhnhe moa pöödhö, 'ba kawaane anyooth jï jiye.
english: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

anywaa: 'Ba gïna nyooth Jwøki jïge ki met yie, beeye ni moa beyø døc na näk rege da ajiem, na en ri luumma näk tiere okwøŋ kan, awëëk pällö dï juurre; ni luummögø beeye ni Krictø ena cwïnynyu, ŋata näk gïïa beyø na en nyïm ŋääth ka ree.
english: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Krictø ni wø gïre køpwa, ni köömwa jiy bëët, ni pwönywa jiy bëët ki køør luup leec wïc bëët, kiper nee jiy bëët kïthwa nyïm Jwøk, ni kwänynyö marge othur kare na wøp ri Krictø.
english: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:

anywaa: Ni beeye ni ööla døc ki tïïc en, naa tïïö ka ki køør teek mare bäre, keda man tïïe cwïnya ki teege en.
english: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a manynya man ŋäyu gø, ki man näk maa lääŋŋa u døc ki cwïnya bäre, ki jøø ni en Leeyödicia yøø, ki jø møga bëët moa näk a poot kärge joodø.
english: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

anywaa: Kiper a doo naa manynya geni man jïtge ki cøm cwïny, kaawat mana kuutge bëët ki mëër, nee gïna näk tiere okwøŋ Jwøki kan, na näk beeye Krictø, nee kwanyge ki pälle bäre, ni ci cwïnyge døøc,
english: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;

anywaa: ŋata näk jap kwärö mo leec wïc ki kwänynyö bäre okan ree.
english: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø acaana jïïu kiper nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo maaŋ wïthu ki luup mo keda beyø jaak.
english: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na tøøra buutu ki dëëra en, cwïnya kiree poot ena baŋu, ni yia met kiper na jooda gø nou poot bëëdö karu ni beer, ni ŋäädhe maru dwøŋ ri Krictø.
english: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, putu bëëtö ree, kaawat mana jïëyu Krictø Jecu na näk Kwäärö.
english: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:

anywaa: Ni put tietu këët piny, ni tëënnu ki ree, ni ŋäädhe maru you maa, kaawat mana pwöny uuni, ni put pwøci bëëtö dhøgu cooth.
english: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou, nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo tïïc uuni na laaŋe ki køør luum acaare mo jiy, ki man maaŋ wïthu ki luup mo oballe jaak, keda luup kwäre ni wø caan jiyi, ki juu mo bäät piny, ni paa moa näk mo Krictø.
english: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

anywaa: Kiper bëët Jwøk bäre bëëdö dëër Krictø.
english: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, uuna nø thur karu ki ree, ŋata näk wïth kwääri bëët ki moa no ocuumö bëët.
english: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

anywaa: 'Ba beeye eni thuwø, na ö uuni ni jïtu ki daŋ, ni beeye kanya gøønyu mo dëël piny, ni daŋ manøgø paa man wø tïïc ki ceŋ, 'ba beeye daŋ mana näk mar Krictø.
english: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya lwøk dëëtu na nyuudhi, koonynya uuni ki eni na aciel, ni beeye mana tïŋ uuni maal thuwø ki eni, ki køør ŋäädhe mana ŋääthu teek Jwøk na tïïö, ŋata tïŋ gø maal ki yi thøø.
english: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.

anywaa: 'Ba u na näk othøw yïth gïïa dhallu, ni mo dëëtu paa odaŋø, uuna tïïc Jwøki nou kwøw ki eni na aciel, ni wec moa dhalø bëët,
english: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

anywaa: ni wec luubö mana doo caanø dëëtø, na dee marø ŋøl piny ki køøre. Luummögøøni alwøre, ni guri bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni dwøc tøøk gïïa jïge da teek maal ki moa näk ocuumö, ni tïïe ni ee nyoodhø jï jiy bëët, ni dïïm geni ki køøre.
english: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kär dee ŋat ŋøl maru piny kiper gïï wø cammu wala gïï wø maathu, wala kiper ajwöm-cam, wala kiper cäŋ man wø päär dwääy, wala cäŋ jwömö mar Jwøk.
english: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

anywaa: Kiper gïïögø caala tïpö jaak mar gïïo ööi. 'Ba mano näk adïëri ena jï Krictø.
english: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee ŋat jääl uuni ni caana gø, ni «Dwøgu rou cään,» ni «Wøørru nyïïatwiet maal,» ni eni ŋäya lääk moe keere, ni eni töödö kiper gïn mo bäŋ tiere, kiper cwïnye na poode køør mo piny,
english: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

anywaa: ni Wïc käre maa, na näk Krictø, ŋata ö dëëlli bäre ni wø piidhe ki ree no odwätö na aciel ki ri mut ki läär na dwal gø, ni piith ka pïth mana en baŋ Jwøk.
english: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

anywaa: ?'Ba ni näk uuno thøw ki Krictø na aciel jï juu mo bäät piny, aŋø ni poot bëëdu keda uuna mo piny en? ?Na aŋø wø leŋŋu dööt jiy mo wø köö,
english: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

anywaa: ni «Kär gïnögø magu,» «Kär gïnögø bellu,» «Kär gïnögø gutu»?
english: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

anywaa: ni beege ciik mo wø laar ränynyö kany wø nø køny røk ki ge, kiper ge cuŋŋa ri pwöc ki ciik mo jiy.
english: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

anywaa: Kiper ciik moøgø nëëni keda ena ri leec wïc ma adïëri møn, kany wø lämö ki teeŋ lame møøk, ni dëël okïyö, ni dëël odwøk piny. 'Ba bäŋ gïn kønyge ki man mänge dëël ki gïïa caye.
english: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk uuno tïŋ maal nø ki Krictø, beerra man manynyu moa en maal, ni beeye kanya en Krictø yie, no opï piny kur cer cwïï Jwøk.
english: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

anywaa: Cïbu cwïnynyu køør jammi moa en maal, ni patha køør jap piny.
english: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

anywaa: Kiper uuna thøw, ni kwøw maru okanø ki Krictø na aciel baŋ Jwøk.
english: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ö Krictø, ŋata näk kwøw marø, noo nyooth ree, uuni thuwø, dëëtu onëëni ki eni na aciel ka ajiem.
english: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, 'nägu jap piny ni en cwïnynyu, teeŋ kaa käp, ki rääö, ki gïïa reyø wø nieŋ cwïnynyu køørge, ki many raay, ki päl cwïny, na näk beeye wøør juu møøk.
english: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

anywaa: Kiper gïïögøøni beeye no ö wëëc Jwøki bäät jø adhala.
english: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

anywaa: 'Ba gïïögø, uuna kwøŋ cäädhö køørge thuwø, kanya bëëdu dïge.
english: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane nø, weyu gïï ii bëët, teeŋ kaa wëër, ki gootø, ki cøl cwïny, ki waac nyeŋ, ni bäŋ rääc dhøk dhøgu.
english: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat cään watge ki tööt. Kiper bëëtö mana dïkwøŋ you nø wec, ki tïïe moe bëët,
english: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

anywaa: ni tïmu ni uuna jiy mo nyärö, ni wø kïtu caal kït ŋata cwääc uuni, nou døøc mo nyärö ki køør man ŋäyu eni.
english: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

anywaa: 'Ba ki ri bëëtö manøgø, bäŋ ŋat mo jeeny ni ena ŋat Gïrïïk, wala ŋat Juuth, wala ŋat mo odaŋø, wala ŋat mo kär daŋø, wala jur, wala jøw mo otaaø, wala laŋŋø, wala ŋat mo bëëdö ka wïïe; 'ba Krictø ena wïth jøøgø bëët, ni en cwïnyge bëët.
english: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat mana ö Jwøki na jier uuni, nou ena kur keeru na mo Jwøk ni uuno omëëye, bëëdu ni cwïnynyu jööt, ni yïthu bäth, nou mwöl, ni bäŋ atöör, ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny.
english: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ya ŋat mo cwïnye laara ränynyö ki watge maya. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo manynya cäänö kiper gïn mo oraany watge, beerra man cïp cwïnye piny ki gø. Kiper cwïnynyu dou cïba piny thuwø, keda mana ö Wuue na cïp cwïnye piny ki uuni.
english: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

anywaa: 'Ba dï gïïögø bëët, ŋäyu mëër keere, ni beeye ni wø dwal jammi bëët ni thurge karge ki cwïny aciel.
english: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

anywaa: Ni wëëgu leec cwïny mar Krictø bwøth uuni ki yïth cwïnynyu, ni beeye gïna cwøl uuni kipere møn, na tïmu na dëël aciel. Ni dwøgu met ec jï Jwøk.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

anywaa: Wëëgu luum Krictø bëëtö cwïnynyu na adïëri, kaawat man wø pwönynyu røgu, nou jøga røgu ki køør acaare bëët mo leec wïc, kaawat man wø wärru Dut Pwøc ki dut Jwøk, nou dwøga met ec jï Jwøk.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët moo wäro tïïyu, ni näk luubö wala tïïc, wär tïïyu ki nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu, ni dwøgu met ec jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö ki køøre.
english: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

anywaa: U na mään, bëënnu cwøwu, ni beeye mana mïërö jï Wuuö.
english: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

anywaa: U na cwøw, mëërru ki määru, ni ba cäännu geni ki luup mo reyø.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

anywaa: U no obwöre, leŋŋu luup jøøa nywøl uuni ki yïth jammi bëët, kiper beeye man wø mïn yi Wuuö ki gø.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

anywaa: U na wëëe, kär cwïny nyïïu raanynyu, nee cwïnyge ba päthge.
english: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

anywaa: U na laaŋe, leŋŋu luup jøø ni bëënnu piny en ki yïth jammi bëët. Ni ba tïïyu kaper man wø neet uuni nou døøya yïth jiy mo met. 'Ba tïïu ni cwïnynyu leer, nou lwäära Wuuö.
english: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:

anywaa: 'Ba gïn wäro tïïyu, tïïyu ki cwïnynyu bäre, kede tïïyu jï Wuuö, ni patha jï jiy.
english: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

anywaa: Ni ŋäyu gø, nou jïtö ko olaawi baŋ Wuuö, na ŋade maru. Kiper u tïnynya Kwäärö ma Krictø.
english: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.

anywaa: Kiper ŋato tïïc gïn mo raac, kwör ocool dëëre kiper gïna raac na tïïe, ni bäŋ ajeeny.
english: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.

anywaa: U na kwääri, bëëdu ki laaŋe mou na wøpe, ni ba caannu geni, ni ŋäyu gø ni jïïu da Kwäärö maal thuwø.
english: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba putu bëëtö nou lämö cooth ki cwïnynyu bäre, nou dwøga met ec.
english: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

anywaa: Ni lämu kiperwa thuwø, kiper nee wa jäm Jwøki ki jöö man køpwa luum Jwøk ki gø, ni køpwa gïr Krictø na näk tiere okwøŋ kan, ni beeye gïn twöc aani kipere en.
english: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:

anywaa: Ni lämu kiper nee tiere caana ni beer kaawat mana daa gø caanø.
english: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou ni tïm wïthu ni leer dï jøø ni kär jïëy yøø, ni magu rou døc ki man tïïu yi jöö mano jap jïïu jaak.
english: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.

anywaa: 'Ba döötu bëëtge ni met cooth, keda kadø ma acämme met, kiper nee luubö maaru ŋäc ki man løgu gø jï ŋati man nø.
english: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïa tägö dëëra bëët, ocaan Taykika jïïu. Eni, ena cöögö na mëërø ki gø, ni ena ŋat tïïc mo oŋäädhö, ni tïïö ka waani na aciel ki ri Wuuö.
english: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:

anywaa: Ena jääŋŋa baŋu kiper nee ŋäyu ki man näk wa bëëtwa nidïï, nee cwïnynyu cøme.
english: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;

anywaa: 'Ba Onecima, na näk oŋäädhö, löömmö ki gø, ni beeye cöögø na mëërø ki gø, ŋata öö ki baŋu. 'Ba jammi bëët moa tägö kany, ocaange jïïu.
english: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna määth Aritarka, no otwöö ki aani en, ki Maak na näk tuuŋ ki Barnaba, ŋata gïre caana jïïu, ni «Noo pïïe buutu, wär pänhnhu.»
english: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Mark, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)

anywaa: Ni uuna määth Jecu, ŋata cwøl ni Jacta. Beege jøøgø keerge na jø Juuth dï jø wø tïny buc Jwøk ki aani na aciel. 'Ba cwïnya acømge døc.
english: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna määth Epapara ŋata öö ki baŋu, na näk laŋ Krictø Jecu. Eni lääŋŋa uuni cooth ki cwïnye bäre yïth laam moe, nou cuŋŋu ni uuno thur karu, ni moa many Jwøki bëët you kwanyø na adïëri.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

anywaa: Kiper ena jooda ni ree ee öölö døc kiperu, ki jøø ni en Leeyödicia yøø, ki moa en Eerapöla.
english: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.

anywaa: 'Ba Luk na näk akïïm na mëërø ki gø, ki Diima, uuna määthge.
english: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.

anywaa: Caannu määdhe mara jï nyïïmëëe moa en yi Leeyödicia, ni caannu gø jï nyijøøa cwøl ni Nyimpa ka acooŋ Jwøk mana en paare.
english: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

anywaa: 'Ba noo nø kwaannu wëëlö man dïïu, wär kwaannu ya acooŋ Jwøk mar jø Leeyödicia. 'Ba wëëlö mana gööra baŋ jø Leeyödicia wär kwaannu thuwø.
english: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

anywaa: Ni caannu gø jï Arcipa, ni «Beerra man thöörï tïïc mana cïp Wuuö jïrï.»
english: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.

anywaa: 'Ba määdhe man en, gööra aani ki cera kiree, a na Pøøl. Caarru gïr tiimme ni en cera en. Met yi Jwøk bëëde bäätu.
english: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl ki Cilbana ki Timöthi, a göönna baŋ acooŋ Jwøk mar jø Thecalönika na en ri Jwøk na näk Wuuö, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø. Met ec ki bëët-mëër bëëde bäätu.
english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec wø dwøkwa dwøgø cooth jï Jwøk kiperu bëët, ni wa cara nyeŋŋu cooth yïth laam mowa.
english: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;

anywaa: Ni wa lääŋŋa tïïc maru nyïm Jwøø na näk Wääø, ni wø tïïyu ki køør ŋäädhe, ni uuno ööl ki køør mëër, nou bëëdö ni dëëtu you maaø ri ŋäädhe mana ŋääthu Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;

anywaa: Kiper ŋäcwa, nyïïmera, ni Jwøk mëër ki uuni, ni jier uuni.
english: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.

anywaa: Kiper luumwa na nyään na met kär ö baŋu na luubö keere, 'ba aöö ki teek thuwø ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, na caanwa na gïn mo ŋäcwa døøc. Ni ŋäyu gø ki man näk a teeŋ bëëtö mo nyïëdi na beetwa dïïu, na kønywa uuni.
english: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.

anywaa: Ni tïmu nou ŋwaala marwa ki mar Wuuö, ni jïëyu luummögø yïth gïïa leth døc, ni yïthu met ki met ec mana cïp Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere.
english: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:

anywaa: Ni tïmu ni uuna nyuudhi jï jøøa näk ojïëy bëët yi Macedönia ki ya Akeea.
english: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.

anywaa: Kiper patha jø Macedönia ki jø Akeea keerge na wïny luum Wuuö baŋu, 'ba luum ŋäädhe maru na ŋääthu Jwøk, apööth kany mo bäär, ni bäŋ gïn mo caanwa kipere këët.
english: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.

anywaa: Kiper geni ki dëëtge ge wø cäänö kiperwa, ni waana pänhnhu døc kanya bëëtwa dïïu, na ö uuni na løøu rou baŋ Jwøk, ni weyu juu, ni tïmu nou tïnynya Jwøk mana kwøw, na näk adïëri,
english: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;

anywaa: nou koora duun Wääde ma Jecu ki maal, ŋata tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, ni beeye ŋato piem øøni ki wëër mano ööi.
english: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ki dëëtu, nyïïmera, ni lïïmmö marwa na lïïmwa baŋu, kär cam paapi.
english: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:

anywaa: 'Ba waani, këël na jwørwa gïï mo leth ni caan wa døc yi Pilipay, kaawat mana ŋäyu gø, cwïnywa amakwa ki ri Jwøk marwa ki man køpwa luumma nyään na met na näk mar Jwøk jïïu, ni waano mänö døc ki man caanwa gø.
english: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.

anywaa: Kiper köömmö marwa mana köömwa uuni ki gø paa mar cwøk, wala gïn mo käla raay, wala gïn mo tïïc ka atade.
english: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:

anywaa: 'Ba wa wø cäänö kaawat mana ö Jwøki na jïëc waani ki man caanwa luumma nyään na met, ni paa nee yïth jiy døøcwa mo met, 'ba wa wø tïïya mo wø mïn yi Jwøki ki ge, ŋat wø pääny cwïnywa.
english: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.

anywaa: 'Ba wa kär cäänö ni wa mwøtha uuni ni wa lwøra japu ka atade, kaawat mana ŋäyu gø, ni Jwøk beeye lïŋï marwa.
english: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloak of covetousness; God is witness:

anywaa: Ni bäŋ pwøc mo ewa manynyø baŋ jiy, nee uuni wala jø møøk,
english: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.

anywaa: këël na mïëre jïwa ki man caanwa gø, ni «Tïïyu gïn kiper mana näk waana nyïïatwiet Krictø.» 'Ba waana bëëdö ni wa mwöl dïïu, keda waŋø mo neeta nyïïkwaaye.
english: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana mëërwa ki uuni døc, yïthwa met ki man nywaaø luumma nyään na met mar Jwøk ki uuni na aciel. Ni patha luum Jwøk keere, 'ba këël dëëtwa kiree, kiper uuna tïmö ni peru leth jïwa døc.
english: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.

anywaa: Kiper wïthu kär wïl ki tïïc marwa na öölwa døc, nyïïmera. Waana tïïö ki wärre ki cääŋŋe bëët, kiper nou ba öölwa, kanya køpwa luumma nyään na met na näk mar Jwøk jïïu.
english: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

anywaa: Ni uuna lïŋŋe ki Jwøk bëët kiper bëëtö marwa, ni bäŋ gïn mo wa doo jäälö ki gø, ni beeye bëëtö mo ena kur keere ni beer døc nyïmmu, u jøøa jïëy.
english: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ni uuna köömwa døc, kaamar wuuö wø kööm nyïïe,
english: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,

anywaa: ni cømwa cwïnynyu, ni caanwa gø jïïu, ki man bëëdu ki bëëtö mo beer mo orømø ki Jwøk, ŋat wø cøør uuni yi buye kiree ni mooc uuni ka ajiem.
english: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.

anywaa: Ni beeye wø pwøcwa Jwøk cooth thuwø, kiper kanya wïnynyu luum Jwøk baŋwa, aputu jïëc ni beeye luum Jwøk, ni näk adïëri møn, ni patha luum jiy jaak, ni beeye ni tïïö cwïnynyu, u na jïëy.
english: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.

anywaa: Kiper uuni, nyïïmera, uuna tïmö ni maru röömi ki mo acook Jwøk moa en yi Judia ki nyeŋ Krictø Jecu. Kiper gïïa jwørru baŋ jø pou aciel ki moa jwørge baŋ jø Juuth,
english: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:

anywaa: ni beege jøøa 'näk Kwäärö ma Jecu ge ki nyïïkuk Jwøk bëët, na riem waani wøk. Geni, ge wø raanynya cwïny Jwøk, ni tïmge ni ge män ki jiy bëët,
english: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:

anywaa: kiper mana mänge waani ki man caanwa luum Jwøk jï juurre, nee ge piem. Ni beeye gïï wø tïïcge cooth ni ge meeta ray moge ni thööth. 'Ba ka aŋuudi, wëëc Jwøk arøm dëëtge.
english: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, kiper mana pääwa ki uuni ki kany mo thiinh, cwïnywa atïmö ni manynya gø døc ki man cäŋwa u neennø. Kiper tøørra dëëtwa keerge, ni patha cwïnywa.
english: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.

anywaa: Kiper cwïnywa manynya gø døc ki man öwa baŋu. Ka adïëri møn, a na Pøøl, beeye man wø manynya cooth cooth. 'Ba waano män Ceethanni.
english: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.

anywaa: ?Kiper agïnaŋø noo ŋääthwa? ?Na agïnaŋø noo mïn cwïnywa kipere? ?Na a rööny mane noo töötwa kipere nyïm Kwääyø ma Jecu, kanyo ööe? ?Aŋø, patha uuni?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?

anywaa: Ka adïëri møn beeye uuni na käl ajiem dëëtwa ki mïn ec.
english: For ye are our glory and joy.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni ba maar lønyø jïwa ki man makwa cwïnywa këët, waana jïëy ki man dööŋwa yi Athen keerwa.
english: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;

anywaa: Ni jääŋwa cöögø ma Timöthi, na näk laŋ Jwøk ri luum Krictø na nyään na met, nou wëëk tëënnö ki ri ŋäädhe maru, ni kööm uuni
english: And sent Timothy, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:

anywaa: nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo cwïnye dak kiper gïïö ni leth yøø. Kiper ŋäyu ki dëëtu ni manøgø beeye bëëtö marø.
english: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

anywaa: Kiper kanya pootwa dïïu, acaanwa jïïu, ni gïï mo leth jwørø jwørø, kaawat mana nø täge enø, ni ŋäyu gø.
english: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na tïm cwïnya ni ba maara mak këët, aana jääk baŋu, kiper bëët ŋäädhe maru nee wïnynya, kiper na lwäya ni kanymør ŋat wø pääny jiy, u ee päänynyö, ni tïm öölö marwa no oaay jaak.
english: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, Timöthi aduu baŋwa, na öö ki baŋu, ni känne jïwa ki dwøl mo met kiper ŋäädhe maru ki mëër maru, ni caan gø ni cooth u lääŋŋa waani, ni yïthu met, ni cwïnynyu oäpö ki man jootu waani, keda man wø äp cwïnywa ki man jootwa uuni.
english: But now when Timothy came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, dï gïïögø bëët ni wø jwørwa ki mo wø kïmwa ki ge, cwïnywa apï piny ki bëëtö maru, kiper ŋäädhe maru.
english: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, waana kwøw nø, ni näk mou puta bëëtö nou teek ki ri Wuuö.
english: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

anywaa: ?'Ba a teeŋ met ec mo nyïëdi noo dwøkwa jï Jwøk kiperu kiper met ec mana päl na jootwa kiperu nyïm Jwøø?
english: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;

anywaa: Ni wa lämö ki cwïnywa bäre ki yïth cääŋŋe ki wärre bëët, kiper nee wa cäŋwa røømmø ki uuni, nou kønywa ki gïno many ŋäädhe maru.
english: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, Jwøø na näk Wääø ki dëëre, ki Kwääyø ma Jecu, waano nyuunhnhe ki jöö man öwa baŋu ki gø.
english: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö mëëyu omeede ni tïme ni päl ni mëërru ki røgu, ki jiy bëët, kaawat mana mëërwa ki uuni.
english: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø nee cwïnynyu tïïe ni ba jøøŋŋi ni ena kur keerge nyïm Jwøø na näk Wääø, yi cäŋo ö Kwääyø ma Jecu ki jiye bëët.
english: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, mana dööŋ keere nø, wa kwaya uuni ni wa köömma uuni ki ri Kwäärö ma Jecu, nou bëëdu ki bëëtö mana dou bëëdö ki gøøni, ni tïïyu gïïa met yi Jwøki ki ge, kaawat mana kwanynyu gø baŋwa. Ni putu gø tïïc ni cäätha nyïm kaawat man tïïyu gø enøgø.
english: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa pwönywa uuni ki ge ki køør Kwäärö ma Jecu, ŋäyu.
english: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

anywaa: Ni beeye mana many Jwøki nou tïmu nou ena kur keeru, nou tïmu ni karu bäär ki käp,
english: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

anywaa: ni ö ŋati man nø dïïu ni kwänynye ki jöö man bëëde ki gø ki cïïe ki bëëtö mana en kur keere na mïërö,
english: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;

anywaa: ni ba en ri bëët käp, kaawat man wø tïïc juurre, jø wø kuc Jwøk.
english: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ya dhaanhø mo dhal luummögø, ni tïme ki gïn mo raac dëër coki kiper gïnögø. Kiper Wuuö kwöri wø coole kaper gïïögø bëët, keda mana kwøŋwa u köömmö døøc.
english: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk ø käre cwølø nøø tïmø ni ø reyø, 'ba nøø tïmø ni ø ena kur keerø.
english: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋato taak luummögø, ba taak dhaanhø, 'ba taaga Jwøk, ŋat wø cïp Jwïëye na en kur keere jïïu.
english: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mëër man mëërru ki nyïïmëëe, u ba many ŋat göön baŋu kipere, kiper u ki dëëtu, uuna pwöny Jwøki ki man mëërru ki røgu.
english: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.

anywaa: Ni näk adïëri møn, nou wø mëër ki nyïïmëëe bëët moa en dï Macedönia bäre. 'Ba wa köömma uuni, nyïïmera, nee putu tïïc ni cäätha nyïm.
english: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;

anywaa: Ni manynyu bëëtö mëëth, nou ŋäya bëëtö maru, nou tïïö ka ceŋŋu, kaawat mana köömwa uuni.
english: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nou wøør jøøa pathi, nee bäŋe gïn cannu.
english: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, wa ba many man kuyu gïno tägi kiper jøøa thøw, kiper nou ba kïmmu, kaamar jø møga moa näk jïge bäŋ ŋäädhe mar nyïm.
english: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.

anywaa: Kiper mana jïëø ni Jecu athøw ni cäŋi tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, kaawat manøgø thuwø yøø jïëø, ni ki køør Jecu, Jwøk jøøa näk othøw okäle ki eni na aciel.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

anywaa: Kiper beeye man caanwa jïïu en ki køør luum Kwäärö, ni ka adïëri møn, øøni noo dööŋ ni poot kwøw ii këël mano duu Kwäärö, paa ø noo bwödhö ki jøøa näk othøw.
english: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.

anywaa: Kiper Kwäärö ki dëëre ööa piny ki maal, ki dwøl mo päl, ki dwør kwääy nyïïatwiet maal, ki dwør tuuŋ mar Jwøk. Ni ö jøøa thøw ri Krictø, ni kwøŋge ö maal.
english: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

anywaa: Køøre, ø noo dööŋ ni ø poot kwøw, øøno tïŋ maal ki geni na aciel yïth pøøl, nee ø røømmø ki Kwäärö yi jamø. Kanyøgø nø, øøno en buut Kwäärö cooth.
english: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, cømmu cwïnynyu keeru ki ri luupögø.
english: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø nyïïmera, ni näk per nïne ki kwöra wäŋŋi, u ba many man göön baŋu ki luubö kipere.
english: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.

anywaa: Kiper uuni ki dëëtu, ŋäyu døøc, ni Cäŋ Kwäärö öö kaamar kuu ni wø ööi ki wäär.
english: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.

anywaa: Kanyo kö jiyi ni «Kawaane nuta bëët-mëër ni bäŋ thøø këët,» kanyøgø beeye kanyo ö thøøe noo neelïm bäätge kaamar dhaagø mo yie da dhaanhø mo ogøøc mäc lwaarri, ni bäŋ ŋat mo bøth.
english: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, u ba en yi muudhö ki man thäŋ cwïnynyu ki cäŋöce noo caal kuu.
english: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.

anywaa: Kiper uuna nyïï tar bëët, ni uuna nyïï cäŋ, ni ø paa mo wäär, wala mo muudhö.
english: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kärø butø kaawat man wø tïïc jø møga. 'Ba beerra man bëëdø ni ø nëënö, ni dëëtø yøø gwøø.
english: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø buti, wø buti ka wäär, ni jø wø meeyi wø meer ka wäär.
english: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana näk mo øøna nyïï dïcäŋ, beerra man gwøø dëëtø, ni kïthø kwöt nywïënyö mar ŋäädhe ki mëër kööthø, ni ö pïëmmi mana piem øøni ki gø ni wø ŋäädhø ni kïthø gø wïthø kaamar cöör nywïënyö.
english: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.

anywaa: Kiper ø kär mëëŋ Jwøki wëër, 'ba beeye kiper nee pïëm man piem øøni ki gø nee joodø ki køør Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø,
english: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,

anywaa: ŋata thøw kiperø, kiper nøø tïmø ni ø bëëdö ka eni na aciel, nee øøno thøw wala ø kwøw.
english: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cømmu cwïnynyu keeru, ni kääru dëëtu keeru, keda man tïïyu gø enøgø.
english: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, wa kwaya uuni ki man wøørru jøøgø ni tïïö dïïu yøø, ni enu ceŋge ki ri Wuuö, ni jøga uuni.
english: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;

anywaa: Wøørru geni døøc nou mëër ki geni, kiper tïïc marge. Ni bëëdu ki bëët-mëër ki dëëtu keeru.
english: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

anywaa: 'Ba wa köömma uuni, nyïïmera, ki man köömmu jøø ni bëëdö jaak yøø, ni cømmu cwïny jøø ni cwïnyge lwäär yøø, ni kønynyu jøøa jägö, ni ba jøømmu ki geni bëët.
english: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.

anywaa: Caarru wïthu, nee bäŋe ya ŋat mo dwøk raay jï ŋato caan gïn mo raac dëëre, 'ba cooth manynyu gïn mo beer mo dou tïïö jï wat maya, ki jiy bëët.
english: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.

anywaa: Yïthu mïnge ki yïth nïne bëët.
english: Rejoice evermore.

anywaa: Ni lämu cooth.
english: Pray without ceasing.

anywaa: Ni dwøgu met ec ki yïth jammi bëët. Kiper beeye mana many Jwøki jïïu ki ri Krictø Jecu.
english: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

anywaa: Ni kär nou bïpa Jwïëc Jwøk.
english: Quench not the Spirit.

anywaa: Ni ba taagu jiy mo køpa dwør Jwøk.
english: Despise not prophesyings.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi bëët wär päänynyu, ni magu gïno beer.
english: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

anywaa: Ni tïïyu karu ni bäär ki teeŋ raay bëët.
english: Abstain from all appearance of evil.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk ki dëëre, ni wø cïp bëëtmëër, uuno tïïe nou ena kur keeru ki karu bäre, ni ö jwïëyu, ki kwøw maru, ki dëëtu, ni bëëtge na karge ni bäŋ ajäla røkge, kanyo ö Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na cwøl uuni, dwøre ba dak. Otïïe.
english: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, lämu kiperwa.
english: Brethren, pray for us.

anywaa: Määthu nyïïmëëe bëët ki nuum dhøk mana en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk.
english: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

anywaa: 'Ba a köömma uuni ki ri Wuuö, ni wëëlö man en wär kwaannu jï nyïïmëëe bëët.
english: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.

anywaa: Met ec mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø bëëde bäätu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl ki Cilbana, ki Timöthi, a göönna baŋ acooŋ Jwøk mar jø Thecalönika, na en ri Jwøk na näk Wuuö, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timothy, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu ki bëët-mëër mano ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, met ec marwa ba maarwa wec ki man dwøkwa gø jï Jwøk cooth kiperu, ni beeye mana beer ki man tïïcwa gø, kiper mana tïm ŋäädhe maru ni päl, ni ö mëërri maru mana mëërru ki røgu ni meet ree.
english: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;

anywaa: Beeye ni töötwa kiperu yïth acook Jwøk en, kiper mana bëëdu nou teek nou ŋäädhö yïth gïïa caan uuni ki ge, ki moø ni leth ni poot jwørru yøø.
english: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø nyootha gø ni ŋøl mar Jwøk beeye adïëri, nou tïmu ni uuno rømø ki buc Jwøk, ni beeye ni jwørru gïïögø kipere.
english: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:

anywaa: Kiper ocaan Jwøki møn, ni beer jïre ki man cool kwöri dëët jø wø tïïc gïï mo leth dëëtu,
english: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

anywaa: ni cïp jwömö jïïu ki waani bëët, u ni en yïth gïï mo leth enø, kanyo nyooth Kwäärö ma Jecu ki maal, ki nyïïatwiet maal moe na teek, ki yi maac mo liel,
english: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,

anywaa: ni cool kwöri dëët jøøa kuc Jwøk, ki moa taak luumma nyään na met mar Kwääyø ma Jecu.
english: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:

anywaa: 'Ba geno ränynyi ki ränynyö mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni riem ge wøk nyïm Kwäärö, ni ö teege na näk ree da ajiem ni ba jootge gø këët,
english: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;

anywaa: dïcäŋo ööe noo jiemi dï jiye, noo tïm yïth jøøa ŋäädhö bëët no orëëm ki mare, kiper mana jïëyu marwa na køpwa jïïu kiper cäŋöce.
english: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.

anywaa: Ni beeye ni wø lämwa cooth kiperu, nee Jwøk marø, nou tïïe ni uuno rømø ki cwönne, nee moa beyø bëët, ki tïïe mo ŋäädhe, nee thurge karge jïïu ki køør teege,
english: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:

anywaa: kiper nee nyeŋ Kwääyø ma Jecu nee tïme ni jiem ka køøru, ni ö uuni ni jiemi ki køøre, ki køør met ec mar Jwøk marø ki Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, nyïïmera, kiper luum ööny Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, ki røømmø marø mano røømmø ki eni, wa kwaya uuni
english: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

anywaa: kiper nee wïthu ba wïïrge, wala cwïnynyu pärö, ni bëët keda gïn mo wïnynyu ka ri Jwïëc Jwøk, wala luubö mør mo you wïnynyö, wala wëëlö mo caan ni ööi ki baŋwa, ni caana gø, ni Cäŋ Kwäärö anø öö.
english: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat maaŋ wïthu ki jöö mør. Kiper cäŋögø ba ööi jaak, ni näk ageem kär kwøŋ tägö, ki ööny ŋata raac noo nyooth ree, ni beeye ŋato raanynyi,
english: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;

anywaa: noo cuum ree, ni män ki gïï wø cøøri bëët ni juu, wala gïï wø wøør, këël mano ööe no opï bäät køøme yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni kööe, ni eni ki dëëre beeye na Jwøk.
english: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïthu awïl ki gïïögø na kwøŋa caan jïïu kanya pooda dïïu?
english: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?

anywaa: 'Ba gïn bëëde kawaane en ni eno mänö ki mana dee tïïö ŋäyu, beeye kiper nee tïme ni eni neenna yi cäŋo näk cäŋ mare.
english: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

anywaa: Kiper gïna raac na näk tiere okan piny, aløny ni tïïö. 'Ba kawaane poot da ŋat mo mäna gøøni ki mana dee tïïö, këël mano ö ŋatøgø noo daai jööre.
english: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøca nø, Ŋata raac oneen. 'Ba eno 'näk Kwäärö ma Jecu ki jam dhee, ni raany gø, kanyo ööe noo nëëne.
english: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

anywaa: 'Ba ööny Ŋata raac, oööi ki køør teek Ceethan, ni ööi ka teek mo dwøŋ døc, ki ŋïïce mo cwøk ki gïï mo rëëma ec,
english: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

anywaa: ni ööi ka atade mo reyø døc baŋ jøw oraanynyi, kiper na kweerge ki man mëërge ki gïna näk adïëri, na di ge piemø ki køøre.
english: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere no ö Jwøki noo mooc ge ki bøølø, ki man jïëcge ki gïn mo patha adïëri,
english: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

anywaa: kiper nee jiy bëët moa näk yïthge met ka gïï mo reyø, na näk kär jïëy ki gïna näk adïëri, nee ge jääl.
english: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, u na mëër Wuue ki uuni, met ec marwa ba maarwa wec ki man dwøkwa gø jï Jwøk cooth kiperu. Kiper u jiera Jwøki cøøn wïlöölö nou pieme, kaawat mana tïïc uuni nou ena kur keeru ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk, ni ŋääthu gïna näk adïëri.
english: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:

anywaa: Ni beeye na ö eni na cwøl uuni ki køør luumwa na nyään na met na køpwa, kiper nee moa beyø na näk mo Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø na näk rege da ajiem, nee cige jïïu.
english: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø, nyïïmera, cuŋŋu nou teek, nou ŋäya luup moa pwönywa uuni ki ge, kaawat mana wïnynyu dhøkwa, wala moa jootu yi wëëlö.
english: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø ki dëëre, ki Jwøk na näk Wääø, ŋata mëër ki øøni, na mooc øøni ki cøm cwïny mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ki ŋäädhe ma wøp mar nyïm ki køør met yie,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,

anywaa: cwïnynyu ocøme, ni wëëk u tëënnö ki man tïïyu tïïe bëët moa beyø, këël luupu.
english: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.

anywaa: 'Ba mana dööŋ keere nø, nyïïmera, lämu kiperwa, nee luum Wuuö nyaae døc ni di jiemø, keda mana täge dïïu,
english: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:

anywaa: nee wa ba päthwa ceŋ jøøa reyø na näk jø raay. Kiper jiy bëët paa oŋäädhö.
english: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö dwøre ba dak, ni uuno wëëk tëënnö ni koor uuni ki ŋata raac.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö ewa ŋäädhö døc kiperu, nou tïïya mo wø caanwa jïïu, ni uuno put bëëtö nou tïïya ge.
english: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö cwïnynyu oløø baŋ mëër mar Jwøk, ni bëëdu nou teek kaamar Krictø.
english: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, nyïïmera, wa köömma uuni ki nyeŋ Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, nou bëëdu ni kwöru bäyö ki nyïïmëëe moø ni bëëdö jaak yøø ni ge ba tïïö ni wø ba cäädhi ki køør pwöc mana kwanynyu baŋwa.
english: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.

anywaa: Kiper uuni ki dëëtu ŋäyu nou doo ŋwaala bëëtö marwa. Kiper wa kär bëëdö jaak ni wa ba tïïö kanya bëëtwa dïïu.
english: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;

anywaa: Ni bäŋ ŋat mo cam mare ewa camø jaak ni kärwa cunnö. 'Ba waana tïïö ki wärre ki cääŋŋe, ni waano ööl døc, kiper nee bäŋe ŋat öölwa dïïu.
english: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:

anywaa: Ni manøgø kärwa tïïö ni ba beer ki mana dewa pëëö, 'ba wa nyootha jöö mar bëëtö marwa nee ŋwaallu.
english: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.

anywaa: Kiper këël kanya pootwa dïïu, luummögø acaanwa jïïu, ni «Ni näk da ŋat mo bëëdö jaak ni ba tïïö, kär eni mooc ki cam.»
english: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

anywaa: Kiper awïnywa ni da jø møøk dïïu mo ge bëëdö jaak ni ge ba tïïö, ni marge wïïrö jaak, ni bäŋ tïïc mo maarge tïïc.
english: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

anywaa: Teeŋ jøøgø nø, wa köömma geni ni wa jooga geni ki nyeŋ Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø, ki man tïïcge tïïe moge ni cwïnyge ege cïp piny, nee cam marge jootge keerge.
english: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, käru jøøm ki gïïa beyø ni wø tïïyu.
english: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo kwier gïï ni caanwa yi wëëlö man en, ŋatøca wäru bëëdu ni ŋäyu nø, ni ba dwätu ki gø, nee wïïe lääe.
english: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

anywaa: 'Ba kär nou tïïya gø keda nyimän, 'ba joogu eni kaamar cöögu.
english: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane Kwäärö ki dëëre ni wø cïp bëët-mëër, uuno wëëk bëët-mëër cooth ki yïth jammi bëët. 'Ba Kwäärö bëëde ki uuni bëët.
english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

anywaa: 'Ba määdhe man en, gööra aani ki cera kiree, a na Pøøl. Ni man en beeye ŋïï mara yïth weeli 'moa bëët. Naa wø göödö na enønø.
english: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.

anywaa: Met ec mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø bëëde bäätu bëët.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel mar Krictø Jecu ki køør mana ö Jwøki na kööm aani, eni na näk Pïëmi marø, ki Krictø Jecu, ŋata ŋäädhø kiper yi nyïm.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

anywaa: A göönna baŋï, ï na Timöthi, ï na wääda ma adïëri ki køør ŋäädhe. Met ec ki bäth-ec ki bëët-mëër na en jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö ki Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääyø bëëde bäätï.
english: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

anywaa: Dööŋï Epeca kaawat mana caana gø jïrï kanya aa Macedönia, kiper nee jø møøk joogï nee ba pööge ki teeŋ pwöc mør,
english: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

anywaa: ni ba öölge dëëtge ki leere, ki luup tiet tuŋi mo kwäre moge, ni wø känni ki pïëm mo bäŋ tiere, ni wø ba pwöny dhaanhø ki jöör Jwøk na en ri ŋäädhe.
english: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

anywaa: 'Ba tier pwöc marø beeye mëër mo käla yi cwïny mo tar, ki bëëtö ma adïëri, ki ŋäädhe ma adïëri.
english: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

anywaa: 'Ba jø møøk gïïögø awecge ni gaage wøk køør luup mo oballe jaak.
english: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

anywaa: Ni ge manynya man tïmge ni gena dïpööye mo ciik Jwøk, këël na kucge tiet gïï wø carge, wala gïï wø pïëmge kiperge.
english: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni ciik Jwøk beer, ni näk mo otïïc dhaanhe na karge.
english: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

anywaa: Ni ŋääø ni ciik Jwøk bäŋ wø caan kaper jøøa beyø, 'ba wø caan kaper jø wø wïnni na wïthge teek, ki jø wø kuc Jwøk, ki jø raay, ki jø wø bäŋ gïn wøørge ni wø taak mo Jwøk, ki jø wø nääŋ wëëkge ki mëëkge, ki jø wø nääŋ jiy jaak.
english: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

anywaa: Ni cïp kaper kääpe, ki cwøw mo wø døø rege ki niine, ki jø wø kwädö ki jiy, ki tööte, ki jø wø kööŋ ko oballe jaak, ki jø wø tïïc teeŋ gïï møøk bëët ni wø män ki pwöc ma adïëri,
english: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

anywaa: kaawat pwöc mana en ri luumma nyään na met mar Jwøø ajiem na näk ogwïëdhö na wëëk aani.
english: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

anywaa: 'Ba a wø dwøga met yia baŋ Krictø Jecu na näk Kwääyø, ŋata wëëk aani tëënnö, kiper mana caar aani, ni aano rømø ki man ŋäädhi, kanya jier aani ni kïth a yi tïïc mare,
english: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

anywaa: këël na kwøŋa bëëtö naa caanna eni, naa pääta eni, naa tïïö ki gïï mo reyø bääte. 'Ba aana kønye kiper na kuua mana tïïa na kära jïëy.
english: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

anywaa: Ni ö met eci mar Kwääyø ni tïme ni päl bääta, ki ŋäädhe ki mëër na en jï Krictø Jecu.
english: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö man en beeye adïëri møn mo doo jïëö, ni Krictø Jecu aö piny kuna piem jø raay. 'Ba beeye aani na näk wïth jø raay.
english: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

anywaa: 'Ba aana køny, a na näk wïth jø raay, kiper nee Jecu Krictø nee cwïnye na näk ee cïp piny ki kare bäre, nee nyoodhe ki raa, nee tïme na jöö jï jø wø jïëy ni ŋäätha eni kiper kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

anywaa: 'Ba wödö ka ajiem en jï Nyeny beenhnhe bëët këël na bäre bäre, ŋata näk ba thøw na näk ba neen, ni beeye Jwøk keere. Enøgønø.
english: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba ï na wääda ma Timöthi, a köömma ïïni ki luummi en, kaawat mana caan nyïïkuk Jwøki na wara nyoothge ïïni, kiper noo lääŋŋï gïïögø, yiï omïnni ki man këëdï ki leny ma adïëri,
english: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

anywaa: niï ŋäya ŋäädhe, ni putï bëëtö ki bëëtö ma adïëri. Kiper da jø møøk mo ŋäädhe marge ege nø raanynyø, ni tïïcge gø kaamar thääŋ jääy mo oränynyö, kiper mana kwierge luup moa näk adïëri na ŋäcge ki cwïnyge.
english: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø beege Aymeneea, ki Alekdhander, jøøa cïba jï Ceethan kiper nee ŋäcge møn ni ba doo beer jïge ki man bëëtge ni dhøkge reyø.
english: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.

anywaa: 'Ba dïkwøŋ nø, aana köö, ni jiy doo kwaaya Jwøk, ni ge lämö, ni pëënyge gø, ni ge dwøga met ec baŋe kiper jiy bëët,
english: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;

anywaa: ki nyeye, ki jøø ni kwörge døøŋŋø yøø, nee ø wëëk bëëtö mëëth ki bëët-mëër, ni øøna jø Jwøk, ni bëëtö marø wøp ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

anywaa: Ni beeye mana näk wøp na mïërö ki waŋ Jwøk na näk Pïëmi marø,
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;

anywaa: ŋat wø many man piem jiy bëët, ki man kwanyge gïïa näk adïëri.
english: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

anywaa: Kiper beeye Jwøk aciel, ki nyïjöö aciel keere ni en yïthakic Jwøk ki jiy, ni beeye dhaanhnha näk Krictø Jecu,
english: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

anywaa: ŋata wïïr ree nyeŋ kwöc jiy bëët, ni gïre ocaanø ki kanya näk kare.
english: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïna jier aani kipere, naa tïma naa køpa luum Jwøk, ni näga nyïïatwiel, ni aana dïpööy jï juurre, ki man pwönynya geni ki ŋäädhe ka adïëri. 'Ba a caana adïëri, naa ba caan tööt.
english: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

anywaa: 'Ba mana manynya nø, jiy doo lämö yïth kwörögø bëët, ni dëëtge ege cïp kur keerge, ni thaaŋge ceŋge jï Jwøk ni bäŋ gootø wala wëër.
english: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.

anywaa: 'Ba mään thuwø, doo käära abïïe mo orømø ki bëëtö mo beer ni patha mo atöör, ni wøp marge man døøcge dëëtge mo mïërö patha dwøc wïc, wala käär warkey, wala käär tii mo beyø, ki gïï mo ŋeew ka jammi mo thööth.
english: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

anywaa: 'Ba ge doo tïïya gïï mo beyø, kaawat mana doo tïïc määnni mo wø köö ni geno jïëy ki luum Jwøk.
english: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

anywaa: Beerra man ö dhaage ni kwany luup ni eni lïŋö, ni mwöl.
english: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, a ba jïëy ki dhaagø ki man pööe, wala ki man tïme na wïth cwøw. 'Ba eni doo lïŋö jaak.
english: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

anywaa: Kiper Adam beeye na kwøŋ cwääc, ni cwääc Iip køøre.
english: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

anywaa: 'Ba paa Adam na cøøgi, 'ba beeye dhaagø na cøøgi ni tïme na ŋata dhal luum Jwøk.
english: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaagø okøny thuwø kiper mana nywøl jiy, ni näk eni puta bëëtö ri ŋäädhe ki mëër, ni ena kur keere, ni mwöl.
english: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.

anywaa: 'Ba luummi en beeye adïëri. Ni näk dhaanhø manynya man tïme na ŋat wø raŋ acooŋ Jwøk, tïïc mana manynye wøp.
english: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø raŋ acooŋ Jwøk doo tïmö na dhaanhø mo bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö mare, mo cïïe aciel, ni ree ee mänö ki raay, ni wïïe leer, ni eno rømø ki wøør, na ŋat mo pänhnha wëëlle, ni ŋäc pwöc,
english: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

anywaa: ni patha ŋat meeye, wala ŋat lenye, ni ba wëëyi, 'ba eni doo mwöl, ni cwïnye ba päl ki jammi.
english: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;

anywaa: 'Ba eni doo pwönynya nyïïe ki jø paare bëët, ni luumme ojïëc nyïïe, ni eno wøør nyïïe ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;

anywaa: ?Kiper ni näk ba løny jï dhaanhø ki man pwöny jø paare, a acooŋ Jwøk ogwøk gø nidïï?
english: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

anywaa: 'Ba eni kär näk ŋat mo kanya jïëe yie poot cään, kiper kanymør cwïnye laara jïtö ka atöör, ni päth ya ajäla kaamar anägö.
english: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

anywaa: 'Ba wär tïme na dhaanhø mo ŋäc jøø ni en wøk yøø ni bëëtö mare beer. Kiper kanymør eni jïtö ka ajøøŋ, ni päth ya abïëp anägö.
english: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, jø wø tïny acooŋ Jwøk doo tïmö na jiy mo owøørø, ni bäŋ luup oriewi dhøkge, ni ge patha oŋïyö ki maath kwøŋ mo thööth, ni ge patha owär ki joot jammi.
english: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

anywaa: 'Ba ge doo ŋäya ŋäädhe mana näk tiere okwøŋ kan piny, ni bäŋ gïn mo jäälge rege ki gø.
english: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

anywaa: 'Ba geni thuwø, ge doo kwøŋa päänynyö. Køøre nø, noo nyoothge røkge ni bäŋ gïn jøøŋŋi ri bëëtö marge, wär tïmge na jø wø tïny acooŋ Jwøk.
english: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, mään doo tïmö na jiy mo owøørø, ni ge patha dïwääc nyeŋ, 'ba røkge dege mänö ki raay, ni geno ŋäädhö ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø tïny acooŋ Jwøk wär nyöömge ki mään oceele, ni pwönyge nyïïge na wøp ki jø mïëcge bëët.
english: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø tïny acooŋ Jwøk na wøp, nyeŋge wø tïmö ni wïnyö ni beer, ni ö ŋäädhe marge na en ri Krictø Jecu ni pälle thuwø.
english: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba yaa ŋäädhö naa laara ö baŋï. 'Ba a gööra luup moi baŋï,
english: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

anywaa: kiper noo näk maa ruu, nee bëët dhaanhø mana dee bëëdö ki gø ya acooŋ Jwøk nee ŋäyï, na näk beeye acooŋ Jwøa kwøw, na näk werø, na cuŋ adïëri ree.
english: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

anywaa: Ajïëø møn, ni gïna näk tiere okwøŋ kan mar lam marø, dwøŋ møn. Kiper øøna jïëy, ni ena nyooth kanya tïme na dhaanhø, ni ŋunni ya Jwïëc Jwøki, ni ena neen nyïïatwiet maalli, ni nyeŋŋe okøbø dï mïëri, ni jïëc nyeŋŋe dï piny, ni kïthi maal ka ajiem.
english: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, ocaan Jwïëc Jwøki møn ni noo tïm kar aŋuun piny ni cään, jø møøk ŋäädhe marge owecge ki køør mano cekge ïthge jï juuk atade ki pwöc anäge,
english: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

anywaa: kanyo ö tööte moa bäŋ cwïnyge noo cøøkge geni ki tööt marge,
english: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

anywaa: jø wø män jiy ki nywöm, ni mänge jiy ki caammi møøk moa cwääc Jwøki, na doo jïëc jø wø jïëy ni ŋäcge adïëri ni ge dwøga met ec jï Jwøk.
english: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.

anywaa: Kiper jammi bëët moa näk ocwääc Jwøki, beyø, ni bäŋ gïn mo doo kwierø ni näk tïïc ni nyeŋ Jwøk opwøø kipere.
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:

anywaa: Kiper beeye dwør Jwøk ki lam noo tïïc gø ni ena kur keere.
english: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk luupi ii peedhï nyïm nyïïmëëe, ï tïmö ni ïïna dïpööy mo beer jï Krictø Jecu, ni piidhï yïth luup ŋäädhe, ki pwöc mo beer mana caathï køøre.
english: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.

anywaa: Bëëdï ni karï bäär ki leere mo oballe na näk ba en ri luum Jwøk. Pwöny riï ki bëët jöör Jwøk.
english: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.

anywaa: Ŋääø ni pwöny røk beeye gïn mo beer, 'ba bëët jöör Jwøk beeye gïna beerra eni døc ki kare bäre, kiper beeye eni ni cïp kwøw ennø, ki kwøw mano en yi nyïm thuwø.
english: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö manøgø beeye adïëri møn, mo doo jïëyö.
english: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäädhe marø ena ri Jwøa kwøw, ŋata näk Pïëmi mar jiy bëët, ni piema jøøa näk ojïëy røk, ni beeye ni tïïø ni øøno ööl døc en.
english: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.

anywaa: Kööm jiy ni pwönynyï geni ki gïïögø.
english: These things command and teach.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat jøøŋ ïïni kiper thïnhö marï, 'ba tïmï ni ïïna jöö jï jøøa näk ojïëy ki yïth luup moï, ki bëëtö marï, ki mëër marï, ki ŋäädhe marï, niï ciil ki raay bëët.
english: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

anywaa: Kwaan wëël Jwøk nyïm jiy bëët, ni køpï luum Jwøk, ni pööï këël mano ööa.
english: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.

anywaa: Kär niï taaga muuy manø ni en jïrï enø, na wëëk ïïni ki køør mana caan nyikuŋ Jwøki, kanya ö jaak acooŋ Jwøki na cïpge ceŋge bäätï.
english: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

anywaa: Tïïc gïïögø cooth, ni cïbï cwïnyï køørge, kiper nee tïïc marï joot jiyi niï cäätha nyïm.
english: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

anywaa: Gwøk riï ki pwöc marï ni putï gø ŋäc, kiper noo tïïï na enøgønø dëërï okønyï ki jøw owïny moï.
english: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.

anywaa: Kär ŋat mo dwøŋ joogï ki luubö mo teek, 'ba köömmï kaawat mana diï wäru köömmö, ni cäännï wøpe kaamar nyïïmeru.
english: Rebuke not an elder, but entreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;

anywaa: Ni cäännï cïdëëre kaamar mëëe, ni köömmï nyïïakuue kaamar nyïïmeru, niï ciil ki raay bëët.
english: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.

anywaa: Wøør mään moø ni bëëdö na määr thuunhnhi ni bäŋ ŋat køny ge yøø.
english: Honour widows that are widows indeed.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cï thøø jïre da obwöre wala nyïïkwaaye, beerra man kwanyge tïïc mana dege tïïö jï tuuŋge dïkwøŋ ki køør bëët jöör Jwøk, ni kønyge jøøa nywøl ge. Kiper gïnögø beeye gïn mo beer nyïm Jwøk.
english: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋ wø näk cï thøø møn, ni dööŋŋa eni keere, wø ŋäätha Jwøk møn, ni put bëëtö ni kwaaya Jwøk cooth, ni lämö ki wärre ki cääŋŋe.
english: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.

anywaa: 'Ba cï thøø man wø ba kïïn gïr cwøre, eno thøw këël na bëëde ni kwøw.
english: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.

anywaa: Køp luummögø jïge, nee bäŋe ŋat jøøŋ geni.
english: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo tuuŋge ba caame, ni letha per jø paare røk, ŋatøgø nyootha gø ni eno kweer ki lam man, ni kadha rääye døc ki ŋat mo kär jïëy.
english: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

anywaa: Kär dee cï thøø mo nyeŋŋe göör røk määr thuunhnhi ni näk cwiiri moe poot kär tïmö na pïërabïciel, ni nywöm mare patha aciel.
english: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,

anywaa: 'Ba eni wär tïme na dhaagø mo wøp mare ee nyoodhø kiper tïïe moa beyø ni wø tïïe, na ŋat mo piitha obwöre, mo pänhnha jiy, mo lwøga tiet jø Jwøk, mo kønya jøøa näk dëëtge da gïï mo leth, mo puta tïmö ni tïïya gïï wø beyø ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

anywaa: 'Ba määr thuunhnhi moø ni therø yøø, kär nyeŋge göör røk määr thuunhnhi. Kiper kanyo tïm cwïnyge ni manynya nywöm, ge jøøl ki bëët jöör Krictø.
english: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;

anywaa: Kanyøgø ge jïtö ka ajäla kiper mana taakge kööŋ marge mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør bëëtö manøgø thuwø, ge kwänynyö ki bëëtö jaak, ni tïmge ni ge wïïrö jaak ni ge cøøa paani nø, ni cige paani nø. Ni paa bëëtö jaak keere, 'ba ge tïmö ni gena dïwääc nyeŋŋi, ni ge cøøa yïth luup jø møøk, ni ge cara gïï mo ba mïërö ki man carge ge.
english: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

anywaa: 'Ba a doo naa manynya man nywøm mään moø ni therø yøø, ni nywølge ki jiy, ni jekge mïëcge, nee nyimän ba jïte ki jöö man buu øøni ki gø.
english: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

anywaa: Kiper møøk anø luk kur Ceethan.
english: For some are already turned aside after Satan.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaagø mo ojïëy ni ŋäädhe mo jïre da tuuŋge ma määr thuunhnhi, beerra man gwøk geni, nee ba tïme na öölö bäät acooŋ Jwøk, na acooŋ Jwøk tïme ni gwøga määra näk määr thuunhnhi møn.
english: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

anywaa: 'Ba jaak acooŋ Jwøk moø ni tïïö døc yøø, wär tïmge na jiy mo di wøørø døøc, ni letha per jøø no oööl røk yøø ki køp luum Jwøk ki pwöc.
english: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.

anywaa: Kiper wø can wëël Jwøki caanø, ni «Kär niï rïëpa dhi rwaath kany wø dïne ki beel,» ni «Ŋat tïïc doo maga gät tïïc mare.»
english: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

anywaa: Kär niï jïëy ki luubö mo di caanø, ni da gïn mo raac mo otïïc jaan acooŋ Jwøki ni näk ba caana jiyi ariiø wala adäk, jøøa ŋäc gø.
english: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da jiy mo poot no onieŋ yïth raay, jook geni nyïm jiy bëët, nee jiy møga putge lwäyö.
english: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

anywaa: 'Ba a köömma ïïni nyïm Jwøk, ki nyïm Krictø Jecu, ki nyïm nyïïatwiet maal na näk ojierø, ki man gwøgï luup moi ii, ni bäŋe ŋat mo pere letha eni jïrï, ni luummï aciel kiper jiy bëët.
english: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

anywaa: Kär niï läädö ki cïp ceŋ bäät dhaanhø kiper tïny Jwøk, ni ba ciï yïth raay mo ŋat mør. 'Ba bëëdï karï, niï ciil ki raay bëët.
english: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.

anywaa: Kärï maath pïï keerge këët, 'ba mädhï ki køøŋø mo thiinh kiper yiï, kiper täwe moï cooth.
english: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.

anywaa: Raay mo jø møøk nëënö jaak, ni ŋäc ni ge cøøa kar ajäla, 'ba raay mo jø møga dëëtge onyoothge cään.
english: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, gïï wø beyø ni wø tïïc dhaanhe wø nëënö jaak. 'Ba këël doo ba nëënö, ba doo puta bëëtö no okanø.
english: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.

anywaa: 'Ba jøø bëët ni bëëdö yi laŋ ni caal twöc enø, beerra man ŋäcge kwääri moge no orømø ki wödö ma wøp, kiper nee nyeŋ Jwøk ki pwöc moe bëët nee ba jøøŋŋi.
english: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.

anywaa: 'Ba jøø ni kwääri moge ojïëy yøø, kär wïthge tïmö ni teek kiper mana tïmge na nyïïmëëe. 'Ba ge doo puta tïïö ki tïïc ma wøp, kiper mana tïme ni jøø ni tïnyge yøø, gena jiy mo ojïëy ni ŋääthge, no omëëcge. Beerra man pwönynyï geni ni köömmï geni ki gïïögø.
english: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da dhaanhø mo pöö ki teeŋ pwöc mør, ni ba jïëy ki luup moa näk adïëri mo Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø, ki pwöc mana en jöör Jwøk,
english: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

anywaa: ŋatøgø päŋŋa cwïnye ka atöör, ni bäŋ gïn ŋääe. Eni wïïe raac no okadhø ki pïëc, ni yie met ki pïëm tiet luup, ni wø käl gwön, ki wëëye, ki waac nyeŋ, ka adïëde mo reyø,
english: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

anywaa: ki pïëm mo ba cuŋ dï jiy moa wïthge reyø, jø wø kuy adïëri, ni wø caar gø ni bëët jöör Jwøk beeye jöö man joot jammi ki køøre.
english: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn mo dwøŋ wø di joodø møn ki køør bëët jöör Jwøk ni näk mo dhaanhø cwïnye ocïp piny ki jammi moa nut jïre.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo yøø käl piny, ni bäŋ gïn mo maarø käl wøk piny.
english: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk jïïø da caammi ka abïïe, yïthø doo met.
english: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø many man tïmge no okwär, wø pätha jöör päänynyö ya abïëp, ni tïmge ni ge manynya gïï mo oballe jaak mo raanynya geni, ni beege gïï wø käl rääö ki ränynyö dëëtge.
english: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

anywaa: Kiper mëëc jammi beeye wø käl teeŋ raay bëët. Ni beeye päl cwïny kiper jammi na tïm jø møøki ni geno gaa wøk ri ŋäädhe, ni raanyge cwïnyge ki luup mo thööth mo leth.
english: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni, ï na dhaanh Jwøk, tïïc karï ni bäär ki gïïögø. Këël wïïï ri gïïa beyø ki bëët jöör Jwøk, ki ŋäädhe, ki mëër, niï teek, niï mwöl.
english: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.

anywaa: Këël leny ŋäädhe ki leny ma wøp. Ni magï kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe na cwøl ïïni kipere, kanya køpï luubö marï na wøp nyïm jøøa thööth na wïny gø.
english: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

anywaa: A köömma ïïni nyïm Jwøk, eni ni wø cïp kwøw jï jammi bëët, ki nyïm Krictø Jecu, ŋata käl luubö mare wøk ni beer kanya køp mare nyïm Pøntia Paylat,
english: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;

anywaa: ki man gwøgï mana cem Jwøki na kare, nee bäŋe ŋat jøøŋ gø këël mano neen Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
