anywaa: 'Ba noo tïm kar gïnögø na kare, manøgøøni onyooth Ŋata dwøŋŋa eni keere, na näk ogwïëdhö, eni na näk Nyeny nyeye, ni näk Kwääny kwääri,
english: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

anywaa: eni keere ni wø bëëdö ni ba thøw, ni wø bëëdö yi tayo näk bäŋ ŋat ci buute, eni na näk bäŋ ŋat mo oneen gø, na ba doo maara neen. Ajiem en jïre ki rööny na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø no okwär yi piny man en, kööm geni nee ba töötge, ni ba ŋääthge jap kwärö moge. 'Ba beerra man ŋääthge Jwøk, eni ni wø cïp jammi bëët jïïø nee yïthø mïnge.
english: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

anywaa: 'Ba ge doo tïïya tïïe mo beyø, ni tïm kønynyi ni päl jïge, ni ceŋge jööt ki muuc, ni cwïnyge piew ki køny.
english: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo tïïcge gïïögø ge këëlla tietge piny na wøp kiper yi nyïm, kiper nee un kwøw mana näk adïëri makge.
english: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.

anywaa: Ï na Timöthi, gwøk gïna wëëk ïïni. Kwier luup mo ba en jöör Jwøk, ki pïëm mar gïn wø cwøl ni kwänynyö, ni patha eni.
english: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

anywaa: Kiper da jø møøk mo ogaa wøk ki jöör ŋäädhe, kiper mana jïëcge gïnögø. Met ec bëëde bäätu.
english: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na nyïïatwiel mar Krictø Jecu ki køør mana many Jwøki kiper kwøw mana buue ni di cïbö ni en ri Krictø Jecu.
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,

anywaa: A göönna baŋï, ï na wääda ma Timöthi, na mëëra ki ïïni. Met ec, ki bäth-ec, ki bëët-mëër ni en jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö ki Kwääyø ma Krictø Jecu en bäätï.
english: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

anywaa: Jwøk apwøa, eni na tïnynya ni cwïnya leer bäre, kaawat mana tïïc kwäya, kany wø caara gïrï cooth yïth laam 'moa.
english: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

anywaa: Kany wø para jwøk marï na jwöŋï, cwïnya puta äpö ki wärre ki cääŋŋe ki man neena ïïni, nee cwïnya mïnne.
english: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;

anywaa: Naa lääŋŋa ŋäädhe marï na näk adïëri, ni beeye ŋäädhe mana kwøŋ en cwïny waŋu ma Lööi ki meru ma Yuni, ni ŋääa ni ena cwïnyï kawaane.
english: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

anywaa: 'Ba a doo naa para wïïï nee wïïï ba wïle ki muuy manø ni cwïnyï enø na cïp Jwøki jïrï ki køør mana cïba ceŋŋa bäätï.
english: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk ø käre mooø ki cwïnynyi mo lwäär, 'ba cïpa cwïnynyi mo teek, ki mëër, ki män røk ki raay.
english: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.

anywaa: 'Ba kär wïïï lääö nø, ki man nyoothï riï kiper Kwääyø, wala kipera, a na tööny eni. 'Ba lwør kurï ri gïïö ni leth yøø, kiper luumma nyään na met, ki køør teek man wø cïp Jwøki jïrï,
english: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;

anywaa: eni na piem øøni, na cwøl øøni ki cwönna en kur keere, ni paa kiper tïïe 'moø moa tïïø, 'ba beeye ki køør met ec mare ki mana manynye e keere, ni beeye met yie mana cïbe jïïø cøøn ki ri Krictø Jecu ni piny poot käre cwääö,
english: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,

anywaa: na nyooth kawaane kiper mana joot Pïëmi marø ma Krictø Jecu, ŋata raany thøø ni käl kwøw, ni beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni tïïc gø ni nëënö ki køør luumma nyään na met.
english: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:

anywaa: Ni beeye luummögø na nyään na met na kwany aani kiper nee køba, ni aana nyïïatwiel ni näga dïpööy.
english: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

anywaa: Ni beeye ni jwøra gïï ni leth ii. 'Ba wïïa ba doo lääö, kiper ŋata ŋäädha ŋääa, ni ŋääa ni løny jïre ki man gwøk gïna wëëga eni këël mano këët cäŋöca.
english: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.

anywaa: Caath køør luum pwöc mana näk adïëri na wïnynyï baŋa, niï caatha køør ŋäädhe ki mëër na en ri Krictø Jecu.
english: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: Gwøk gïna näk adïëri na wëëk ïïni, ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere ni bëëdö cwïnynyø.
english: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.

anywaa: 'Ba awïnynyï ni jø Eecia bëët aana wecge, ni ö Pijela ki Ermøjeni ni dwätge ki geni.
english: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.

anywaa: 'Ba bäth-ec mar Wuuö en bäät po Onecipera, kiper aana kønye kwöre mo thööth. Ni wïïe kär lääö ko oguudi 'moa.
english: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya pïïe Röm, aana manynye ni yie met døc ni joot aani.
english: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.

anywaa: 'Ba ojïti ki met ec baŋ Wuuö dïcäŋöca. Ni ŋäyï døøc na ateeŋ køny mo nyïëdi na køny aani ki gø yi Epeca.
english: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.

anywaa: Ï na wääda nø, bëëdï niï teek ki ri met ec mana en ri Krictø Jecu.
english: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba mana wïnynyï baŋa buut jøøa thööth na wïny gø, wär wëëk jiy mo iï ŋäädhö mo maara lønyø jïge ki man pwönyge jiy møøk thuwø.
english: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.

anywaa: Lwør kurï ri gïï wø leth, ni ïïna ŋat leny ma wøp mar Krictø Jecu.
english: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat leny wïïe bäŋ wø maaŋŋe ki tïïe møøk, kiper mano këël wïïe ri tïï ŋata kïth gø yi tïïc ni døøya yi gø mo met.
english: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.

anywaa: Ni ŋat wø lääti, bäŋ wø røøny ni näk ba reŋi ka køør dwøl.
english: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋat puur man wø tïïö døc, na doo kwøŋ kure lwør ri beel moo kwøŋ ciek.
english: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

anywaa: Caar wïïï ki gïï caana ii, kiper ïïno køny Wuue ki man ŋäyï tiet jammi bëët.
english: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.

anywaa: Lääŋ Jecu Krictø na tïŋ maal ki yi thøø, na näk nyikwaar Deebit, kaawat mana en ri luumma nyään na met na caana,
english: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:

anywaa: ni beeye luummögø na nyään na met ni jwøra gïï ni leth ii kipere, ni aano twöö ko oguudi kede aana kuu. 'Ba luum Jwøk patha otwöö.
english: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cwïnya yaa maa ki yïth jammi bëët kiper jø Jwøk, nee pïëm man piem geni ki gø na en ri Krictø Jecu jootge thuwø, ni beeye pïëm man wø cäädhi ka ajiema näk adïëri na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

anywaa: Man beeye luubö ma adïëri: Ni näk øøno thøw ki eni, øøno kwøw thuwø ki eni na aciel.
english: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

anywaa: Wala ni näk cwïnynyø yøø maa, øøno røøny thuwø ki eni na aciel. 'Ba ni näk eni mooŋø mooŋø, ø mooŋe mooŋø thuwø.
english: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk jïïø bäŋ ŋäädhe, eni mare poot na adïëri. Kiper eni ree ba maar mooŋ.
english: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

anywaa: Par wïthge ki gïn, ni köömmï geni nyïm Jwøk, ki man kwierge pïëm tiet luup ni wø bäŋ gïn mo joot rege, 'ba beeye ränynyö keere jï jø wø wïny gø.
english: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.

anywaa: Put dëërï mak døøc niï ciï nyïm Jwøk ni ïïna ŋat mo ee jïëö, na ŋat tïïc mo wïïe ba lääy, ni luum adïëri iï gwøø døøc na wøp.
english: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

anywaa: Kwier luup moø ni ba en jöör Jwøk yøø, kiper jiy bwødhe wøk jöör Jwøk, ni kadhe døc.
english: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

anywaa: Ni ö luupge ni tïmge ni nyaa nyïmge kaamar atwøda mo ba caŋŋi. 'Ba Aymeneea ki Piliita adwätö ki geni,
english: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

anywaa: jøøa gaa wøk ra adïëri, kiper mana caange gø ni duun wøk ki yi thøø anø tägö, ni raanyge ŋäädhe mar jø møøk.
english: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwøk, mare na näk ee këël piny wø cuŋŋa kare, ni ŋïï man ena dëëre na ennø, ni «Wuuö moa näk moe ŋääe,» ni «Jiy bëët mo wø cøør nyeŋ Wuuö, raay wär kwierge.»
english: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.

anywaa: 'Ba paac mo beer, patha dääe mo warkey wala dääe mo gwel-bïrö keerge ni wø en yie, 'ba yie da dääk jenni mo otieŋø thuwø, ki dääk odhöönhe, ni møøk tïïc kaper tïïe mo mïërö ni møøk tïïc kaper tïïe moa ba mïërö.
english: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk dhaanhø dëëre ee jiiø ni wec gïna näk ba mïërö, eni doo tïmö ni caala dak mar tïïa mïërö, no ocïp kur keere ni pere leth døc jï wää paaci, no ojiiŋŋø kiper tïïe moo beyø.
english: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, tïïc karï ni bäär ki jap thïnhö, ni këëllï wïïï ri gïïa beyø, ki ŋäädhe, ki mëër, ki bëët-mëër, ni ïïno dwätö ki jø wø cøør nyeŋ Wuuö ki cwïny mo tar.
english: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

anywaa: Kär dee gïn jølï ri pïëm luup bøøl moø ni bäŋ tietge yøø. Ŋäyï ni gïïögø wø käla wëëye.
english: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.

anywaa: 'Ba laŋ Wuuö ba doo tïmö na ŋat wëëye, 'ba eni doo mwöl jï jiy bëët, na dïpööy mo ŋäc pwöc, ni cwïnye ee cïp piny,
english: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,

anywaa: na ŋat wø pwöny jøøa wïthge teek ni eni mwöl, ni kanymør geno wëëk Jwøki løk cwïny, ki man ŋäcge adïëri,
english: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

anywaa: nee bøthge ki ya abïëp mar anägö, na kwøŋ ge peec kiper nee mana manynye tïïcge.
english: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäc gïn en: kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne, bëët piny otïmö ni raac døc.
english: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

anywaa: Kiper otïmö ni ŋati man nø mëër ka ree, ni jiy mëër ka jammi, ni ge töödö, ni ge koorrø, ni dhøkge ŋaam, ni wïthge teek ki jøøa nywøl geni, ni bäŋ met ec mo maarge dwøgø, ni luum Jwøk kucge.
english: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

anywaa: Ni cwïnyge bäŋ mëër, ni cwïnyge ba maarge dwøk piny, ni gena dïwääc nyeŋŋi, ni bäŋ gïn mo lwäärge, ni ge caala cwëënyi, ni ge män ki gïï mo beyø,
english: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

anywaa: na jø abuua, ni gena köönynye, ni cwïnyge päŋ ka atöör, ni ge mëër ka jap dëëtge ni ge ba mëër ki Jwøk.
english: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

anywaa: Ni ge nëënö keda gena jø lam, 'ba teek Jwøk ba maar ci cwïnyge. Teeŋ jøøgø nø, wär kwierï.
english: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

anywaa: 'Ba dïge da jiy mo wø duunyö yïth mïëri, ni maaŋge wïth mään mo cwïnyge cwøk, na näk cwïnyge opäŋ ki raay, ni wïthge onoot gïïa reyø ni wø many cwïnyge,
english: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

anywaa: määr wø laar dööt jiy jïëc jaak, na adïëri ba maarge kwany.
english: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø ge wø kweer ka adïëri thuwø, kaamar Jeene ki Jambare na kwier luum Modhe, ni beeye jiy mo wïthge reyø, ni geno kweer ki jöör ŋäädhe.
english: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo jootge, kiper bøøl marge otïmö ni ŋäc jøw bëëti, keda mana joot bøølø mar jøøgø na ariiø yøø.
english: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane pwöc mara araŋï, ki bëëtö mara, ki gïna këëlla wïïa ree, ki ŋäädhe mara, ki mëër mara, ni cwïnya yaa cïp piny naa ba dääŋi;
english: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

anywaa: ni caannø mara ŋäyï, ki gïïa leth na jwøra, ki gïïa pïï dëëra yi Antïëk, ki yi Ayköniem, ki yi Litara, a teeŋ caarø mo nyïëdi na maa cwïnya ki gø. 'Ba Wuuö aana pieme yïth gïïögø bëët.
english: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, jiy bëët mo wø many man bëëtge ki bëëtö mar jöör Jwøk ki ri Krictø Jecu, geno caanni.
english: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa reyø, ki jø wø cwöö, rääö marge otïmö no okadhø døc, ni gena jø cwøk ni ge cøøga rege.
english: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïni ki dëërï put bëëtö ki køør gïna kwanyï na jïëyï døøc ki cwïnyï bäre, niï lääŋŋa jøøa kwanyï gø baŋge,
english: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;

anywaa: kaawat mana kwanyï weet Jwøk na en kur keerge na ööï ki gø ki thïnhö, ni wø løny ki man pwönyge ïïni ki jöör pïëm man piem jiy ki gø ki køør ŋäädhe na en ri Krictø Jecu.
english: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: 'Ba wëël Jwøk bäre göör ka dwør Jwøk, ni beer kiper pwöc, ki jook dhaanhø, ki twieny bëëtö, ki pwöny røk ki moa beyø.
english: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

anywaa: Kiper nee ŋata näk dhaanh Jwøk nee tïme ni eno thur kare, ni ree ee jiiø kiper tïïe mo wø beyø bëët.
english: That the man of God may be perfect, thoroughly furnished unto all good works.

anywaa: A köömma ïïni nyïm Jwøk ki Krictø Jecu, ŋato ŋøl luup jøøa kwøw ki moa näk othøw kanyo ööe noo këël buye piny,
english: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

anywaa: ki man køpï luum Jwøk cooth ki cwïnyï bäre, kany wø näk ma kare, ki kany wø näk mo patha kare, niï cøga jiy, ni joogï geni, ni köömmï ge, ni pwöc marï ba weyï, niï ba jøøm.
english: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

anywaa: Kiper da kany mo öö, kanyo ö jiyi noo ba manyge pwöc ma adïëri, 'ba dëëtge omäänyge ki dïpööye moo caan gïïo mïn yïthge ki ge, kiper ïthge na jel ki man wïnyge luup mo ŋweeth.
english: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

anywaa: 'Ba ge kweer ki man wïnyge adïëri, ni tïmge ni ge wïïra jöör leer.
english: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

anywaa: 'Ba ï ki dëërï, bëëdï karï cooth, ni cwïnyï iï maa ki gïï wø leth, ni tïïyï tïï ŋat wø køp luum Jwøk, nee tïïc marï put thur kare.
english: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.

anywaa: Kiper kara acäännö ki man tïïc aani no olämi, ni kar tïŋŋö mara anø cäännö.
english: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

anywaa: Aana këëdö ki leny ma wøp, ni thööra ŋwïëy mara, ni gwøa ŋäädhe.
english: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

anywaa: 'Ba køør man nø, Kwäärö, ŋata näk ŋøl mare adïëri, adun wø cïp jï jøøa beyø na kan kipera, omëëk aani dïcäŋöca. 'Ba ba mëëk a keera, 'ba omëëk jiy bëët mo wø mëër ki öönynye.
english: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

anywaa: 'Ba mak dëërï ki man laarï ö baŋa.
english: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:

anywaa: Kiper Diima aana wiie ni aae, kiper mana mëëre ki piny man en, ni ci Thecalönika. 'Ba Karecen aci Galeecia, ni ö Tayta ni ci Dalmacia.
english: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Luk keere ni en buuta. Wärï gaa baŋ Maak, ni löömmu ki gø na aciel, kiper eni pere leth jïra ki man køny aani ki tïïc.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

anywaa: 'Ba Taykika ajääŋŋa yi Epeca.
english: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo ööï, koothi mana wiia buut Karpa yi Tarööa, wär kuuï. Ni kuuï weeli thuwø, 'ba letha per weet Jwøk.
english: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

anywaa: 'Ba Alekdhander na näk rëëmmö atïïö dëëra ki gïn mo leth døc. 'Ba moøgø ocool Wuue dëëre.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:

anywaa: Gwøk riï thuwø ki eni, kiper eni män døc ki pwöc marø.
english: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya kwøŋa tier mara caan, bäŋ dhaanhø mo oö kura. 'Ba jøøgø bëët aana wecge. 'Ba beerra man ba ö Jwøki ni caan gïnögø dëëtge.
english: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö acuŋŋö buuta, ni wëëk a tëënnö ki man køba luum Jwøk ki kare bäre, kiper nee wïny juurre bëët. 'Ba aana piem ni bødha dhi ŋuu.
english: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö aano pieme yïth gïïa reyø bëët, ni gwøk aani kiper buye na en maalø. Ajiem en jïre këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Määth Paricka ka Akwila, ki jø po Onecipera.
english: Salute Priscilla and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

anywaa: 'Ba Eracta adööŋ Körin, ni ö Taröpima ni wiia gø piny ni tuu yi Milita.
english: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletus sick.

anywaa: Mak dëërï ki man laarï öö, kany poot arïïa. Ïïna määth Yubula, ki Puden, ki Lina, ki Kalødia, ki nyïïmëëe bëët.
english: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö bëëde cwïnyï, ni bëët met eci bäätu.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na laŋ Jwøk ni näga nyïïatwiel mar Jecu Krictø, kiper nee ŋäädhe mar jøøa jier Jwøki nee cääth nyïm, ki moa dege ŋääö ra adïëri ni wø kïth jiy jöör Jwøk,
english: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

anywaa: kiper mana ŋääthge kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe mana buuk Jwøki cøøn, eni na kuc tööt.
english: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

anywaa: Ni beeye na nyooth kawaane kanya näk kare ki køør dwøre, ki køør luumma wëëk aani ni køba kiper mana ö Jwøki na näk Pïëmi marø na kööm aani.
english: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

anywaa: A göönna baŋï, ï na Tayta, ï na wääda ma adïëri ki ri ŋäädhe mana nywaaø. Met ec ki bëët-mëër ni en jï Jwøk na näk Wuuö ki Krictø Jecu na näk Pïëmi marø, en bäätï.
english: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna wiia ïïni Kariit kipere, beeye kiper nee gïïa näk ogwäyö dwøgï karge, ni kwänyï ki jaae kiper acook Jwøk yïth päänye bëët, kaawat mana caana gø jïrï,
english: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:

anywaa: na jiy mo bäŋ ajäla ri bëëtö marge, mo määrge oceele, na jiy mo nyïïge ojïëy ni ŋääthge, ni paa jiy mo di køø, ni räänyö ki japge, wala wïthge teek.
english: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø raŋ acooŋ Jwøk, kiper mana tïme na ŋat wø tïny Jwøk, doo bäŋ ajäla ri bëëtö mare, ni paa ŋat mo koorrø, wala ŋat mo cwïnye laara ränynyö ni wëëre, wala ŋat meeye, wala wïnni, wala ŋat mo cwïnye päl kiper gïn joode.
english: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

anywaa: 'Ba eni doo tïmö na ŋat mo pänhnha wëëlle, ni mëër ka gïïa beyø, ni wïïe leer, ni bëëte tiir, ni cwïnye ena køør Jwøk, ni ree ee mänö ki raay.
english: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

anywaa: Ni eni doo maga luumma näk adïëri keda mana pwönynyi ki gø, kiper nee tïme ni maara pöö ki pwöc ma adïëri, ni pïëme ki jø wø taak pwöc moe thuwø.
english: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

anywaa: Kiper da jiy mo thööth mo wïthge teek, mo wø cara oballe, na jø cwøk, ni käätha jøø no odaŋø røk yøø.
english: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

anywaa: Män geni nee lïŋge, kiper ge kiera wïth tuŋi møga karge bëët, kiper mana pööge ki pwöc mana ba dege pöö ki gø. 'Ba pwöc marge bee kiper nee ge jïtge ki gwel ki jöö mo patha kare.
english: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

anywaa: 'Ba këëlla dhaanhø aciel dïge ma nyikuŋ jwøge aköö, ni «Jø Kariit gena dïtööte cooth, ni gena lääy mo reyø, ni dëëtge leth na jø wärö.»
english: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretans are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø beeye adïëri. Kiper manøgønø, jook geni ki luubö mo teek, nee putge jïëy na adïëri ni ŋääthge,
english: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

anywaa: ni ba cekge ïthge ki leere mo jø Juuth, wala dööt jøøa kweer ka adïëri.
english: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

anywaa: Kiper jammi bëët wø beyø jï jø wø cwïnyge leer, 'ba ki jï jø wø cwïnyge reyø na näk patha ojïëy, bäŋ gïn mo beer mo ŋäcge. 'Ba acaacge kiree ki cwïnyge reyø.
english: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

anywaa: Ge wø köö ni Jwøk ŋäcge møn, 'ba ege kwierø ki køør jap wø tïïcge. Ge reyø døc, na jø adhala, ni ge ba rømi ki tïïc gïn mo beer, bäre bäre.
english: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

anywaa: 'Ba ï ki dëërï, pööï ki gïï mo orømø ki pwöc mana näk adïëri.
english: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

anywaa: Ni köömmï jäle nee bëëtge mëëth, ni rege ege wøørø, ni ge ŋäc cäänö ni wïthge leer, ni geno jïëy ni ŋääthge møn, ni ge mëër, ni ge bëëdö ni ge teek karge.
english: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

anywaa: Ni köömmï cïdëëre nee bëëtge na enønø thuwø, ni bëëtö marge wøp, ni ba tïmge na dïwääc nyeŋŋi, wala owär ki kwøŋ. 'Ba ge doo pöö ka gïïa beyø,
english: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

anywaa: kiper nee määrögø ni therø yøø nee pwönyge ki man mëërge ki cwøwge ki nyïïge,
english: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

anywaa: ni bëëtge ni wïthge leer, ni ge ciil ki raay bëët, ni mïëcge ege jiiŋŋø, ni ge mwöl, ni ge wø leŋa luup cwøwge, kiper nee bäŋe gïn mo jøøŋŋi ri luum Jwøk.
english: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

anywaa: Ni köömmï wøpe na enøgønø thuwø, nee dëëtge mänge ki raay.
english: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

anywaa: Ni nyoothï riï ki yïth jammi bëët, nee bëëtö mana beer kwanyge ki køørï. 'Ba kany wø pööï, pööï ki dwøl aciel, na pwöc mo bäŋ tuuk ree,
english: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

anywaa: na pwöc mo bäŋ ŋat mo jøøŋ gø, kiper nee jø ataa nee wïthge lääge kiper noo bäŋe gïn mo raac mo caange ni yøø tïïö.
english: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

anywaa: Ni köömmï laaŋe nee luup kwääri moge leŋge, ni døøcge yïth kwääri moge mo met ki yïth jammi bëët, ni ba duunge kwääri moge ki luup mo reyø,
english: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

anywaa: ni ba jel ceŋge ki jammi, 'ba ge doo tïmö na jiy mo di ŋäädhö møn, kiper nee pwöc Jwøk na näk Pïëmi marø, nee tïme ni pwøc ka køørge ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

anywaa: Kiper met yi Jwøk man piem jiy bëët ki gø anyooth,
english: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,

anywaa: ni wø pwöny øøni ni wiiø gïïa ba en jöör Jwøk ki gïïa reyø ni wø many cwïnynyø, nee ø bëëdø ni dëëtø yøø mänö ki raay, ni marø beer, ni bëëtö marø pinyi en ena jöör Jwøk,
english: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

anywaa: kany poodø ni ø koora kanyo gwïëth øøni na ŋäädhø, noo nëën ajiem Jwøø na dwøŋ, ni beeye Pïëmi ma Jecu Krictø,
english: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

anywaa: ŋata cïp ree kiperø, nee ø wïïl wøk yïth raay bëët, ni tïïc øøni ni ø waany na moe, na jiy mo cwïnyge ege cïp køør tïïe moa beyø.
english: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

anywaa: Køp gïïögø jïge døøc. Ni köömmï geni ni joogï ge, ni teegï iï nyoodhø jïge, ni bäŋe ŋat mo taak marï.
english: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

anywaa: Kööm geni ki man wøørge kwääri ki jøøa jïge da teek, ni bëëtge na dïleŋ luup, ni yïthge met ki man kunyge ri tïïe mo wø beyø bëët, ni cwïnyge leer,
english: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

anywaa: ni bäŋe ya gïn mo raac mo caange dëër ŋat mør, ni kwierge wëëye, ni tïmge ni ge mwöl, ni tïmge ni jiy bëët ege wøørø na adïëri.
english: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

anywaa: Kiper øøni ki dëëtø, øøna kwøŋ bëëtö ni øøna bøøre, na jø adhala, ni wïthø omaaŋŋø, ni øøna laaŋe jï gïïa reyø na en cwïnynyø, ki teeŋ gïïa many dëëtø bëët, ni thöörø ruun 'moø bëët ni cwïnynyø cøl ki jiy ni ø gwönö, ni jiy män ki øøni, ni ø män ki røgø.
english: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki, eni na Pïëmi marø, na nyooth beenynye ki mëëye,
english: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,

anywaa: øøna pieme, ni paa kiper ni da tïïe mo beyø mo yøø tïïö, 'ba ø pieme ka met yie keere, kanya ööe ni peny cwïnynyø ni døøc ge mo nyärö, kanya døøc ge mo nyärö ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere,
english: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

anywaa: na cïbe jïïø no opöödhö ki køør Jecu Krictø, eni na Pïëmi marø,
english: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;

anywaa: kiper nee ø ŋunni ki met yie, nee ø tïmø ni øøna lwiidhi ri ŋäädhe mar kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

anywaa: 'Ba luummögø beeye adïëri. Naa manynya ïïni man køpï gïïögø døøc, kiper nee jøøgø no ojïëy ki Jwøk yøø, nee dëëtge makge ki man cïpge cwïnyge køør gïïo beyø na dege tïïö. Kiper gïïögø beege gïï ma wøpe døc, mo jiy kønyge kønyø.
english: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

anywaa: 'Ba kwier pïëm bøøre, ki luup tiet tuŋi mo kwäre, ki wëëye, ki pïëm bäät tiet luup mo ciik Jwøk. Kiper gïïögø reyø, ni bäŋ gïn duuge.
english: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo tïïya apääk, noo köömmï gø yie aciel wala ariiø ni luummï ba wïnynye, wär kwierï nø, ni ba dwätï ki gø këët.
english: A man that is an heretic after the first and second admonition reject;

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyï ni teeŋ ŋatøgø nø cwïnye odak na ŋat raay, ni jääla ree keere.
english: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo jääŋŋa Artema wala Taykika baŋï, wär dëërï magï ki man laarï ö baŋa yi Nikøpöli. Kiper yaa caarø naa cøøa kunöce, na arïïa thööra kaace.
english: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

anywaa: Mak dëërï ki man kønyï Dhina na näk ŋat wø caan tiet ciik Jwøk, ka Apøla, ki wääth marge, nee bäŋe gïn mo läämö jïge.
english: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man ö jø Jwøki moa en Kariit kaagø man kwanyge tïï gïï mo beyø, nee kany wø dee gïï mo leth mo tägö nee ge wø laarge kunynyö, ni ba bëëtge jaak.
english: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna määth jøøi ni en buuta bëët ii. 'Ba määth jøøgø bëët ni mëër ki waani ki ri ŋäädhe yøø. Met yi Jwøk bëëde bäätu bëët.
english: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Pøøl na tööny Krictø Jecu, ki Timöthi na näk cöögø. A määtha ïïni, Piliiman, ï na näk omëër marwa na tïïö ki waani na aciel,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

anywaa: ki nyijøøa na Apia na näk cöögø, ki Arcipa na näk ŋat leny ŋäädhe ki øøni na aciel, ka acooŋ Jwøk mana en paarï.
english: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:

anywaa: Met ec ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wääø, ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø, bëëde bäätï.
english: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba aani, Jwøa wø pwøa pwøø cooth, kany wø para gïrï ki yïth laam 'moa.
english: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

anywaa: Kiper ŋäädhe marï na en jïrï kiper Kwäärö ma Jecu, ki mëër marï man wø mëërï ki jø Jwøk bëët, wø wïnynya wïnynyö.
english: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;

anywaa: Kiper aani, a wø lämö nee ŋäädhe marï nywaagï ki jø møga, nee gïïa beyø bëët na näk 'moø ri Krictø, nee wëëk ŋäc.
english: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.

anywaa: Kiper aana jïtö ki met ec mo dwøŋ ki cøm cwïny ki køør mëër marï, coka. Kiper cwïny jø Jwøk amïnnö ki køørï.
english: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, doo løny jïra ki ri Krictø ki man köömma ïïni ki man tïïyï gïna diï tïïö.
english: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,

anywaa: 'Ba kiper nyeŋ mëër keere doo beerra mana daa ï kwaa, a na Pøøl, ni aana ŋat dwøŋ, a no otööny Krictø  Jecu en.
english: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: A kwaya ïïni kiper wääda ma Onecima, ŋata tïma ni aana wänni yi øt twöc en.
english: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

anywaa: Dïkwøŋ eni bäŋ gïn mo ee kønyø dëërï, 'ba kawaane atïmö niï maare ka køny, ki aani bëët.
english: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

anywaa: A duua eni baŋï, keda a jääŋŋa cwïnya kiree.
english: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:

anywaa: Aani yia doo met døc ki mana dee bëëdö kany buuta, naa tïnynye na karï, kany ena øt twöc en kiper luumma nyään na met.
english: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø ba daa tïïö ni dwørï poot kära wïnynyö, kiper nee met ec marï nee ba tïme keda gïn mo mak ka teek, 'ba doo beerra mana diï gø tïïö ki met cwïnyï.
english: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

anywaa: Kanymør gïna tøøre buutï en dïciel, beeye kiper nee duu baŋï nee put bëëte buutï na bäre bäre,
english: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;

anywaa: ni ba bëëdö kaamar laŋŋø këët, 'ba tïmö na cöögö ni wø mëërö ki gø, ni beeye gïna beerra eni. Ni ena coka møn maa mëër ki gø, 'ba kadha marï røk, kiper ena dhaanhnhï, ni beeye cöögu ki ri Wuuö.
english: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa iï ŋäädhö døøc ni aana nyawadu, pänh eni keda mana diï aani pänhnhö.
english: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da gïn mo raac mo ee tïïö dëërï, wala da gïn mo manynyï manynyø baŋe, pëëny aani ki gø,
english: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

anywaa: coola coolø jïrï. 'Ba luubö man gööra aani ki cera, a na Pøøl. 'Ba marï na mayï baŋa ba caana nø, këël dëërï kiree.
english: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.

anywaa: 'Ba ka adïëri møn, coka, a manynya met yiï nee jooda ki ri Wuuö. Wëëk cwïnya mïnnö ki ri Krictø.
english: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana ŋäädha ïïni døc ni luumma leŋï leŋø, beeye na göönna baŋï en, ni ŋääa ni manøgø tïïyï tïïö ni kaala cer mana caana jïrï.
english: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.

anywaa: 'Ba maya thuwø, øt wëël wär jiiŋŋï kipera. Kiper yaa ŋäädhö ni aano wëëk ööny baŋu ki køør laam mou.
english: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

anywaa: 'Ba ïïna määth Epapara, ni en øt twöc ki aani na aciel en ki køør Krictø Jecu.
english: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;

anywaa: Ïïna määth Maaki thuwø, ki Aritarka, ki Diima, ki Luk, jø wø tïïö ki aani na aciel.
english: Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, Luke, my fellowlabourers.

anywaa: Ba met ec mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø bëëde cwïnynyu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne mo acääŋŋe cøøn Jwøk acäänö ki kwäyø ki dhøk nyïïkuk Jwøk, ki uutjïëthe mo thööth ma teeŋi.
english: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

anywaa: 'Ba ki yïth nïne moi ii, ena cäänö ki øøni ki ri Wäädö, ŋata nyoodhe ni beeye lwiidhø mana en jammi bëët cere, ŋata ö eni thuwø na cwääc piny ki køøre,
english: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

anywaa: ŋata joot ajiem Jwøk dëëre, ni kït Jwøk kiree ena dëëre, ŋata bëën jammi bëët ki dwøre na teek. 'Ba eni, kanya nø wëën ajäl raay, ena pï piny bäät cwïï Jwøa dwøŋ ni en maalø.
english: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

anywaa: Ni tïm kare ni dwøŋŋa eni ki nyïïatwiet maal, kaamar nyeŋŋe ni lïëŋ dï nyeŋge.
english: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

anywaa: ?Kiper a nyïïatwiel maal mane na cään Jwøki ki gø, ni «Ïïna Wääda, ni ïïna tïïa ni ïïna Wääda dïcäŋi en»? Wala oköö, ni «Aano tïmö ni aana Wuuö jïre, ni tïme ni ena Wäädö jïra.»
english: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

anywaa: 'Ba kanya käl wääde na näk kaa piny, ena köö, ni «Beerra man ö nyïïatwiet maalli mo Jwøk bëët ni wøørge eni.»
english: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.

anywaa: 'Ba mar nyïïatwiet maal, ee caanø, ni «Beeye wø tïïc nyïïatwiete na jamø, ni tïïc laage na lëëp mäc.»
english: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

anywaa: 'Ba mar Wäädö, ee caanø, ni «Ï na Jwøk, wälu marï obëëdö këël na bäre bäre; ni ŋøl ma adïëri otïmö ni beeye athøny kwär mar buyï.
english: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

anywaa: 'Ba ï mëër ki bëëtö mo beer niï män ki raay; kiper manøgø nø, Jwøk na näk Jwøï ïïna jøre ki maar met ec, ni kaala mar nyïïawäätu.»
english: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Ï na Kwäärö, piny caga ïïni wïlöölö, ni maalø tïïya ïïni ki cerï.
english: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:

anywaa: Geno ränynyi, 'ba ïïni, ï dööŋ karï. Geno ränynyi bëët kaamar abïï.
english: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;

anywaa: Ni banï ge kaamar jalabiiya, ni wiil geni kaawat man wø wiil abïï. 'Ba ïïni, ï poot bëëdö na karï karï, ni cwiiri moï ba thum.»
english: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.

anywaa: ?'Ba a nyïïatwiel maal mane na köömme, ni «Pï bäät cwïïa, këël mano tïïa nyïïmän moï na køøm tietï»?
english: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ge paa jwïëy bëët ni wø tïny Jwøk, ni wø jääŋŋi kiper nee jø wø jïti ki pïëm man piem ge ki gø, nee bëënyge?
english: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wär ïthø ciiø døøc ki gïïa wïnynyø, kiper kanymør ø pöödhö ki buutge.
english: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk luumma køp nyïïatwiet maalli beeye adïëri, ni ö jøøa dhal gø bëët ki jøøa wïthge teek ni jïtge ki pöödö mo rømø ki gø,
english: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

anywaa: ?a øøni, øøno bødhø nidïï, ni näk teeŋ pïëm man piem jiy ki gø manø ni dwøŋ enø yøø wiiø? Kiper akwøŋ Kwäärö køp, ni ö jøøa wïny dwøre ni nyoothge gø jïïø ni beeye adïëri.
english: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

anywaa: Ni Jwøk thuwø ojïëy ki mare ki køør nyuuthe ki tïïe mo døøŋŋø døc, ki gïï mo rëëma ec ma teeŋi, ki muuce moa öö ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, na pääŋŋe kaawat mana manynye keere.
english: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?

anywaa: Kiper paa nyïïatwiet maal na kööm Jwøki ni piny mano ööi oen ceŋge na kwääri, ni cäänwa kipere en.
english: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

anywaa: 'Ba da kany mo ogöörö yie, ni «?Dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni lääŋŋï gø en? ?Ni wär dhaanhø agïnaŋø, ni gwøgï gø en?
english: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?

anywaa: 'Ba eni iï tïïö ni thiinhnha eni ki kany mo thiinh ki nyïïatwiet maal, ni røønyï gø ka ajiem ki wödö,
english: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:

anywaa: ni cïbï jammi bëët cere.» 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki na cïp jammi bëët cer dhaanhø, bäŋ gïn mo ee wii wøk, ni ba en cere. 'Ba kawaane, jammi bëët poot ba neetø ni ena cere.
english: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

anywaa: 'Ba ø neeta Jecu, ŋata tïïc ni thiinhnha eni ki nyïïatwiet maal ki kany mo thiinh kiper nee thøø bele kiper jiy bëët, ki køør met yi Jwøk. 'Ba ennø, ø neeta eni no orøønyø ka ajiem ki wödö kiper thøwa leth na jwøre.
english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.

anywaa: Kiper orømø jï Jwøk, eni na en jammi bëët jïre, ni ööi ki baŋe, ki man tïïc ŋata bwøth jiy jöör pïëm man piem geni ki gø no othur kare ki køør gïïa leth na jwøre, kanya ö eni na käl nyïïe mo thööth kar ajiem.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

anywaa: Kiper eni ni wø tïïc jiy ni ena kur keerge, ki jøøa no otïïö ni ena kur keerge yøø, wääge aciel. Ni beeye tiere ni ba laac wïïe ki man cwøl geni ni nyïïmenni,
english: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

anywaa: kanya caan gø, ni «Aani nyeŋŋï caana caanø jï nyïïmera, ni pwøa ïïni ya acooŋ Jwøk.»
english: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.

anywaa: Ki kanya cäŋ köö, na «A bëëdö naa ŋäätha eni.» Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Aani en, ko obwöre moa cïp Jwøki jïra.»
english: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na tïme ni jøøgø beege jic dëël ki remø, eni ki dëëre, ena tïmö na dhaanhø kaamarge, kiper nee ŋata en teek thøø cere na näk anägö, nee raanynye ki køør thøwe,
english: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

anywaa: ni pät jiy bëët yi laŋ mar thøø na lwäärge ki gø yïth nïne moge bëët.
english: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

anywaa: Kiper adïëri møn, paa nyïïatwiet maal na öönynye, 'ba beeye nyïïkwaac Eeberam na öönynye nee kønye.
english: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na kwøŋi tïïc ni caala nyïïmenni ki yi bëëte bäre, kiper nee eni tïme na Kwääy Lam Mo Dwøŋ yi tïï Jwøk, mo yie bäth mo oŋäädhö, nee raac jiy wëënne.
english: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

anywaa: Ni løny jïre ki man køny jø wø päänynyi, kiper eni ki dëëre gïï mo leth akwøŋ jwør, ni päänynyi.
english: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, u na en kur keeru na mo Jwøk, ni nywaak cwönna öö ki maal, caarru gïr Jecu, na näk Nyïïatwiel na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ mana jïëø ki gø.
english: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

anywaa: Kiper eni dwør ŋata jier gø agwøe kaamar Modhe thuwø na gwøk tïïe mo Øt Jwøk.
english: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu atïmö no orømø ka ajiem mo dwøŋ døc ni kaala mar Modhe, kaamar dïgëëdi ni wø nyeŋŋe pwøc ni kaala øtø.
english: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.

anywaa: Kiper uudi bëët, wø da dïgëëte moge, 'ba dïgëëdi man wø geer jammi bëët beeye Jwøk.
english: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.

anywaa: 'Ba Modhe tïï Øt Jwøk bäre agwøe ni ena ŋat tïïc mo oŋäädhö, ni køp jammi moa doo caan Jwøki yi nyïm.
english: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

anywaa: 'Ba Krictø Øt Jwøk agwøe ni ena wäädö. 'Ba beeye øøni na øde, ni näk mo ø puta bëëtö ni cwïnynyø yøø maa ki mana jïëø ki gø, ni ø jeemma ŋäädhe marø.
english: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kaawat mana caani ya Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere, ni «Dïcäŋi, noo wïnynyu dwøre,
english: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,

anywaa: kär cwïnynyu døøyu mo teek, ni caala dïcäŋ mar ageem, cäŋa näk cäŋ päänynyö dï paap,
english: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

anywaa: kanya ö kwäyu na päänyge aani, ni jootge tïïe 'moa ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween.
english: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cwïnya aränynyö ki beenhnhece, ni kööa, ni ‹Cooth cwïnyge wø gaa wøk, ni uutjïëthe 'moa poot ba kwanyge.›
english: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

anywaa: Kaawat mana kööŋa kanya goota, ni kööa, ni ‹Ge ba doo dønynya kar jwöm mara bäre bäre.› »
english: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

anywaa: Nyïïmera, gwøgu rou nee bäŋe dhaanhø dïïu mo cwïnye jïti ki raay ni tääe, ni gaa wøk cer Jwøa kwøw.
english: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man köömmu røgu keeru cooth, kany poode na dïcäŋi en, nee bäŋe ya dhaanhø aciel dïïu mo cwïnye tïmö ni teek kiper mano cøøgi ya raayi.
english: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

anywaa: Kiper ø dwäti ka Krictø, ni näk gïna kwøŋø ŋääth yøø maa cwïnynyø møn këël cuŋŋe;
english: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

anywaa: kaawat mana no ogöörö, ni «Dïcäŋi en, noo wïnynyu dwøre, kär cwïnynyu døøyu mo teek ni caala dïcäŋ mar ageem.»
english: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

anywaa: ?'Ba a jøøe moe na wïny gø, ni pootge ni ge poot gëëmö, këël na wïnyge gø? ?Aŋø, paa jøøa ö wøk ki Ijep bëët ni ge bwøtha Modhe?
english: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

anywaa: ?Na a jøøe moe na räny cwïny Jwøki ki ge ki cwiiri ma pïëraŋween? ?Aŋø, paa ge jøøgø bëët na bääyö, na thøø dï paap?
english: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

anywaa: ?Na a jøøe moe na kööŋe kiperge, ni «Ge ba doo dønynya kar jwöm mara bäre bäre?» ?Aŋø, paa ge jøøa wïthge teek?
english: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ajoodø ni kär løny jïge ki man dønyge kiper na tääge.
english: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kany poode ni buuk mar ciin kar jwömö mare poot nut en, beerra man caarø wïthø, kiper nee ba caan ni uuna kääŋö ki gø.
english: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

anywaa: Kiper luumma nyään mar jwömö aö baŋø kaawat mana ö baŋge. 'Ba luubö mana wïnyge bäŋ gïn mo beer mo ege joodø ree, kiper mana kärge jïëy ni ŋääthge gø.
english: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

anywaa: Kiper øøni na näk ojïëy, ø dønynya kar jwömöce, kaawat mana caan gø, ni «Kaawat mana kööŋa kanya goota, ni ge ba doo dønynya kar jwöm mara na bäre bäre,» këël na thum tïïe moe ki kanya täk pinynyi.
english: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

anywaa: Kiper da kanymør yi Wëël Jwøk mo cäänö kiper bïriet nïne mo ogöörö na enønø, ni «Jwøk ree ajwöme ki tïïe moe bëët ri bïriet nïne.»
english: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ mana kwøŋ caan nwøyø kany thuwø, ni «Ge ba doo dønynya kar jwöm mara na bäre bäre.»
english: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana tïme ni da jiy mo poot dønynya kar jwömö manøgø, ni kääŋ jøøa kwøŋ luumma nyään na met wïnynyö ki man dønyge yie, kiper mana teek wïthge,
english: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

anywaa: ena cäŋ cïpö ki cäŋ mør, kiper nee jø møøk dønyge yie. Ni beeye dïcäŋi en, na caane cään ki ri Deebit køør mana näk ee caanø cøøn. Ni beeye luupi ii na nø caan en, ni «Dïcäŋi noo wïnynyu dwøre, kär cwïnynyu døøyu mo teek.»
english: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

anywaa: Kiper onää geno mooc Jøcua ki jwömö, Jwøk cäŋ mør ba dee cäŋa caannø.
english: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

anywaa: Kiper manøgø nø, cäŋa näk cäŋ jwömö poot nutö jï jø Jwøk, na caal cäŋa ö Jwøki na jwöm ree ri bïriet nïne.
english: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø ci kar jwöm Jwøk, tïïe moe wø wiie wiiø thuwø, kaamar Jwøk na jwöm ree ki tïïe moe.
english: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man maa dëëtø ki man dønynyø kar jwömöce, nee bäŋe ŋat kääŋi kiper teek wïc mo caala manøgø.
english: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

anywaa: Kiper luum Jwøk beeye gïn mo kwøw ni tïïö, ni betha eni ko opëëllö mo lage ariiø, ni cööbö këël man wø pääŋ kwøw ki jwïëy, ki mut ki maar cuu, ni ŋäya acaany cwïny ki mo wø many cwïnynyi.
english: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ gïn mo okanø røk moa no ocwääö bëët, 'ba jammi bëët ena wøgø, ni nëënö jï Jwøk jaak, eni noo cuŋŋø nyïme.
english: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme nø, ni jïïø da Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋŋa eni, ŋata pöödhö ki dï pøøl na døø maal, ni beeye Jecu, O Jwøk, beerra man putø mana jïëø ki gøøni maa cwïnynyø.
english: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.

anywaa: Kiper Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ man na marø en, paa ŋat mo cwïnye ba maar pädhö ki gïr jäk marø. 'Ba beeye ŋata päänynyi ki yïth jammi bëët kaamarø, 'ba eni kär pädhö.
english: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man nyiigø buut wäl met ec ni yøø ŋäädhö, kiper nøø jïtø ki bäth ec, ni joodø met ec mano køny øøni kany wø cännø.
english: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

anywaa: 'Ba kwääc laam moa døøŋŋø bëët mo wø kwany dï jiy, wø jier kaper nee luup mo jiy caange nyïm Jwøk, ni cïpge ki muuce ko olämme kiper raay.
english: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

anywaa: Ni ŋatøca løny jïre ki man cääne mëëth ki jø wø bäŋ gïn ŋäcge ki jø wø bääyi, kiper eni ki dëëre e jääk thuwø.
english: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, eni wø cïpö ko olämme kiper raay moe ki dëëre, ki mo jiy møga bëët.
english: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

anywaa: Kiper dhaanhø, dëëre ba røønye keere, 'ba eni wø cwøla Jwøki, kaamar Aran na cwøl.
english: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, Krictø dëëre käre thïïŋö e keere nee tïme na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ. 'Ba eni jiera Jwøki, na luum gø, ni «Ïïna Wääda; dïcäŋi aana tïmö na Wuuö jïrï.»
english: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.

anywaa: Kaawat mana caan gø thuwø kanymør yi Wëël Jwøk, ni «Ï bëëdö ni ïïna dïlämi këël na bäre bäre, niï caala Melkidhedek.»
english: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïne moa bëët Jecu bäät piny, Jecu alämö ni kwac Jwøk, ni jwöŋe ki pï nyeŋ ki dwøl mo päl, ni jwönna ŋata näk løny jïre ki man piem gø nee ba thøøe, ni wïny mare kiper mana leŋ luup mo Jwøk.
english: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

anywaa: 'Ba këël na näk ena O Jwøk, ena kwänynyö ki man leŋ luup ki køør gïïa leth na jwøre.
english: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør mana tïïi no othur kare, ena tïmö na tier pïëm man piem jiy ki gø mana näk adïëri na bäŋ cuŋŋe jï jø wø leŋ dwøre bëët,
english: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

anywaa: ni puti ya Jwøki nyooth ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni caala Melkidhedek.
english: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, da luup mo thööth jïwa mo dewa caanø kiper gïnögø, mo tietge teek ki par, kiper mana tïm ïthu ni bääö ki man wïnynyu gø.
english: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

anywaa: Uuni, doo naa uuna dïpööye ennø, 'ba u poot manynya ŋat mør mo cäŋ u pwönynyö ki luup mo wø kwøŋ tägö ki geni ri luup Jwøk. Uuni, u manynya caak, ni paa cam mo teek.
english: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø bëën caak bëët, ge poot kär kwänynyö ki luum bëënynyö, kiper mana näk geno obwöre.
english: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

anywaa: Kiper cam mo teek rømi ka jiy mo døøŋŋø, jøøa näk onø kwänynyö ki man ŋecge gïïa beyø ki gïïa reyø, kiper man wø pwönyge rege ki gø.
english: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man kaalø pwöc man wø kwøŋ dhaanhø pwönynyö ki gø kiper Krictø, ni cøø baŋ pwöc man wø wëëk dhaanhø døøŋŋø ki ri ŋäädhe, ni ø ba nøøc tier løk cwïny man wø løk røk ri tïïe moa en ri thøø, ki mar ŋäädhe man wø en ri Jwøk,
english: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

anywaa: ki pwöc kiper lwøk dëël na nyuudhi, ki cïp ceŋ bäät dhaanhø, ki duun wøk køør thøø, ki ŋøl luup mana näk ba wiil.
english: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø otïïø noo kö Jwøki.
english: And this will we do, if God permit.

anywaa: Kiper jiy mo okwøŋ bëëtö yi tar, mo muuy mana öö ki maal ege belø, ni jïtge ki kurge ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, ni belge met luum Jwøk ki teek piny mano ööi, ni näk mo geno gaa wøk, ba løny ki man dwøk ge karge ki man cäŋge cwïnyge løgø. Kiper marge, ge cäŋa O Jwøk nägö bäät jaadha no odëëdö, ni ge wëëga gø buuö.
Kiper ŋöömö man wø maath pï køth man wø päth yie cooth, ni känne ki gïï ma wøpe jï jø wø puuri kiperge, wø gwïëth Jwøki gwïëdhö.
english: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from God:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk tuya koodhi yie ko otwelø, bäŋ gïn mo rømi ki gø këët, 'ba kare cään ka cien ni cuŋŋe beeye waaŋ.
english: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

anywaa: 'Ba këël man caanwa gïïögø na enønø, u no omëëcwa, maru poot ewa ŋäädhö ni da gïï mo beyø jïïu, gïï wø en ri pïëm man piem u ki gø.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk ŋøl mare tiir, ni tïïe mou ba taae, ki mëër mana nyoothu kiper nyeŋŋe kanya tïnynyu jø Jwøk, kaawat man poodu nou tïïya gø enø.
english: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

anywaa: Ni wa manynya man ö ŋati man nø dïïu, ni put cwïnye cïp køør ŋäädhe mare mar yi nyïm ki teeŋ jöörögø, ni put gø ŋäc na adïëri ki kare bäre, këël cuŋŋe,
english: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

anywaa: nee dëëtu ba tïmge ni peek. 'Ba nou tïmu nou ŋwaala mar jø wø ci gïïa buuk jïge ki køør ŋäädhe marge ki bäŋ jøømø.
english: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Jwøki na buŋ Eeberam, ena kööŋ ri dëëre keere, kiper mana tïme ni bäŋ ŋat mo dwøŋŋa eni ki eni, mana dee kööŋ ri gø,
english: For when God made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

anywaa: na kööe, na «Adïëri møn, ï gwïëdha gwïëdhö ni meeda ïïni.»
english: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

anywaa: Ni beeye na ci buuki jïre, kiper mana bëëde ni cwïnye ee cïp piny.
english: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

anywaa: Kiper jiy wø kööŋ møn, ni ge kööŋŋa ŋëët ŋat mo dwøŋŋa eni ki ge. 'Ba ki yïth pïëm moge bëët, beeye kööŋ wø ŋøl luup piny.
english: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kanya ö Jwøki na many man nyooth mare døøc mano tïïe jï lwiidhi ni wø ci buuki jïge, nee jootge ni luumme ba maar daaø, eni ree aput kïth yie ki kööŋ.
english: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

anywaa: Kiper nee øøni na reŋ kar køny nee cwïnynyø cømø døc ki man maaø ŋäädhe mar yi nyïm mana møør nyïmmø, ki køør gïïögø na ariiø yøø na näk ba maar daaø, gïïa näk ba løny jï Jwøk ki man caan luup mo patha adïëri rege.
english: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

anywaa: Ni ŋääthögøøni ena jïïø en ni caala alïŋ mar jääy, mo bëëdö kare na gïn ma adïëri kiper kwøw marø, ni beeye ŋäädhe mar yi nyïm man wø pööth yi øtø kuya ya abïïna näk ogëëŋö,
english: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

anywaa: kanya ci Jecu yie na kwøŋ pïï kiperø, kiper mana tïme ni ena Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ këël na bäre bäre, ni caala Melkidhedek.
english: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

anywaa: 'Ba Melkidhedek manøgø, nyeny pääny Calem, na näk dïlämi mar Jwøa dwøŋ na en maal, arøømmø ki Eeberam, kanya duu Eeberammi ki kuna 'näk nyeye, ni gwïëth gø.
english: For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high God, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

anywaa: Ni ö Eeberammi ni cïpe jï gø ki paac wïth jammi ri gïïa kääre bëët. 'Ba eni, tier nyeŋŋe beeye «nyeny bëënynyö,» ni näk nyeny Calem thuwø, na näk tiere beeye ni «nyeny bëët-mëër.»
english: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

anywaa: Ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäc kiper wänni ki menni, wala tier tuuŋ mar kwäye, ni bäŋ kany mo eno tägö yie, wala kany cuŋ kwøwe yie, 'ba eni caala O Jwøk, ni bëëdö ni ena kwääy lam këël na bäre bäre.
english: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

anywaa: Neennu dööŋŋe mø! Eeberam na näk kwarø, acïpö jï gø ki paac wïth jammi ri gïïa twiere bëët.
english: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkwaac Libay na tïïc na dïlämme, jïge da teek ki køør ciik Jwøk ki man lwötge ki paac wïth jammi bëët baŋ jiy, ni manøce tïïcge dëët nyïïmëëkge, këël na näk jøøgø gena nyïïkwaac Eeberam thuwø.
english: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

anywaa: 'Ba Melkidhedek na näk ba en ri kwar jøøgø, ajïtö ki paac wïth jammi baŋ Eeberam, ni gwïëth eni, ŋata ci buuki jïre.
english: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø bëët ni bäŋ ŋat mo piem gø, ni ŋata thiinh wø gwïëtha ŋata dwøŋŋi.
english: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

anywaa: 'Ba kany en, paac wïth jammi wø lwøra jiyi mo wø thøw. 'Ba kaace, paac wïth jammi lwøra ŋat wø gïre caan, ni kwøw.
english: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.

anywaa: Ni dhaanhø doo köö ni Libay ki dëëre ni wø lwør paac wïth jammi, acïpö ki paac wïth jammi ki ri Eeberam,
english: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

anywaa: kiper eni poot kär nywølø kanya røøm kwari ki Melkidhedek.
english: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

anywaa: ?'Ba onää mo løny ki mana di jiyi thur karge ki køør kwäc-lam mar dhi øt Libay, aperŋø nø, na di jøwi määnyö ki dïlämi mør këët mo caala Melkidhedek, ni wec ŋata caath køør Aran? Kiper ciik Jwøk ajoot jiyi ri kwääc lam mar dhi øt Libay.
english: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

anywaa: Kiper kany wø wiil kwääy lam, ciik wø di wiilø thuwø.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata caan japi ii kipere, ena nyï tuuŋ mør, tuuŋa näk bäŋ dhaanhø aciel rege mo otïïö kar gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäc ni Kwääyø käla dhi øt Juuda. 'Ba kur tuuŋøce bäŋ gïn mo ocaan Modhe kiper dïlämme.
english: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

anywaa: Manøgø atïmö ni ŋäc døc kanya ö kwääy lammi mør na thïïŋi ni caala Melkidhedek,
english: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

anywaa: ni tïme na kwääy lam ki køør teek kwøwe na ba maar ränynyö, ni paa ki køør man wø caan yïth ciik kiper nyïïkwaac dhaanhø mo ööi ki dëël.
english: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

anywaa: Kiper da gïn mo ocaanø kipere, na ennø nø: «Ï bëëdö ni ïïna kwääy lam këël na bäre bäre, niï caala Melkidhedek.»
english: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

anywaa: 'Ba ki løøk aciel, luubö mana kwøŋ cem adaak, kiper mana näk mo jääk ni bäŋ gïn mo kønye.
english: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo otïïc ciik Modhe no othur kare. 'Ba ki løøk maya, ŋäädhe mar yi nyïm mana beerra eni, apïï, ni beeye gïn wø nyiigø buut Jwøk ki køøre.
english: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto God.

anywaa: Ni gïnögøøni paa gïn mo bäŋ kööŋ ree. 'Ba jøøa kwøŋ tïmö na dïlämme, tïïc marge alwørge ni bäŋ kööŋ.
english: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati, mare acaan jïre ki kööŋ, ni «Wuuö Jwøk anø kööŋ, ni mana caane ba wiile këët, na kööe, ni ‹Ï bëëdö ni ïïna dïlämi këël na bäre bäre.› »
english: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Lord sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)

anywaa: Ni beeye gïn na tïïc Jecu na waaci mar luubö mana beerra eni na tuut Jwøki ki jiy.
english: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme moa dïkwøŋ ge thöönhnhi kaper mana mäni ya thøøe ki man bëëtge bäät tïïc.
english: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

anywaa: 'Ba eni kwäclam mare ba daak kiper eni puta bëëtö këël na bäre bäre.
english: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, løny jïre ki man køny jø wø nyänh buut Jwøk ki køøre na bäre bäre, kiper mana bëëde ni kwøw cooth, ni kwaaya Jwøk kiperge.
english: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

anywaa: Kiper teeŋ Kwääy Lam Mo Dwøŋ ma enøgønø, orømø ki can marø, ŋata en kur keere, ni bäŋ ajäla dëëre, ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ree, ni ba en dï jø raay, no orøønyø ni dwøŋŋa eni maalø bäre.
english: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

anywaa: 'Ba eni bäŋ gïn manynye kaamar kwääc laam moa døøŋŋø moøke, ki man cïpe ko olämme cooth, ni dïkwøŋ cïpö kiper raay moe, køøre cïpö kiper raac jiy. Kiper gïnögø atïïe yie aciel keere na bäre bäre, kanya cïp dëëre kiree no olämi.
english: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

anywaa: 'Ba adïëri møn, ciik Modhe wø jiera jiy mo wø jägö na kwääc laam moa døøŋŋø. 'Ba luumma kööŋe ki gø na öö køør ciigøgø, jiera ŋata näk Wäädö, ŋata tïïc no othur kare këël na bäre bäre.
english: For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

anywaa: 'Ba tier gïn cäänwa kipere, beeye en. Ni teeŋ Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ manøgø ena jïïø, ŋata pï bäät cwïïc buut wäl Jwøa Dwøŋ ni en maal,
english: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

anywaa: na ŋat wø tïïö yi kanya en kur keere yo oduŋkaanynya näk adïëri na näk ba geera dhaanhe, 'ba geera Wuuö.
english: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

anywaa: Kiper kwääc laam mo wø døøŋŋø bëët wø di jierø nee cïpge ki muuce ko olämme. Kiper manøgønø, kwääy lamøgø manynya gïn mo cïbe cïbö thuwø.
english: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane onää eni ena piny, ba doo tïmö na dïlämi na bäre. Kiper dïlämme nutö mo wø cïpi ko olämme kaawat mana caan yïth ciik Modhe.
english: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

anywaa: Ni ge tïïö yi kar lam man wø nyooth kanya en kur keere ni en maal na näk mar Jwøk, ni beeye nyuudhi mar gø. Kiper kanya ö Modhe na tïme ni manynya man tïïc oduŋkaany lam, ena kööm Jwøki, na kööe, ni «Wär ŋäyï ki man tïïyï jammi bëët na karge ki køør nyuudhi mana nyooth jïrï bäät kïdi.»
english: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane Krictø awëëk tïïc mana beerra eni ki tïïa näk oruuö, kaawat luubö mana tuut na käle, na beerra eni døc ki mana dïkwøŋ, kiper mana tïme no ogöök ri luupa buuk moa beyø geni.
english: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

anywaa: 'Ba onää luubö mana kwøŋ tuut dïkwøŋ, bäŋ gïn mo ogwäyö ree, doo bäŋ riet luubö këët mo cäŋ tuutö.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

anywaa: 'Ba Wuuö Jwøk gïna näk ogwäyö ri luummögø ajoode, ni kööe, ni «Da nïne mo öö, maa tudö ki luubö mo nyään ki tuuŋ Icriel, ki dhi øt Juuda.
english: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah:

anywaa: Ni ba caal luubö mana tuuda ki kwäcge, dïcäŋa maa ceŋge naa bwødha ge wøk ki yi ŋööm Ijep, kiper ge kär put bëëtö ri luumma tuuda ki geni, ni beeye na kära marge wïnynyö. Luummögø caana Wuuö Jwøki.»
english: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Lord.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøki köö, ni «Man beeye luubö mano tuuda ki tuuŋ Icriel køør nïrögøøni. Ciik 'moa okïtha wïthge, ni gööra ge cwïnyge, ni tïma ni aana Jwøk marge, ni tïmge na jiya;
english: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people:

anywaa: ni bäŋ ŋat mo pwöny wati wala coki, mo köö, ni ‹Beerra man ŋäyï Wuuö Jwøk,› kiper aano ŋäcge bëët, ni tägi ka jiy moa kwörge therø këël moa kwörge døøŋŋø.
english: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa baacge wiia wiiø, ni ba para wïïa ki raay moge këët.»
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya cääne kiper luubö mør mo nyään man cäŋ tuutö, mana näk oruuö atïïe keda gïn mo kare onø pöödhö. Kiper gïn wø many man tïme ni kare onø pöödhö ni manynya man jøøle, kar rwäänyö mare ocäännö.
english: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

anywaa: 'Ba këël luubö mana kwøŋ tuut, yie da luup kiper yi jöö man käär lam ki gø, ki luup kiper kar lam mar pinyi en.
english: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

anywaa: Kiper da oduŋkaara mo otïïö, ni thääŋŋe mana en wøk beeye mana wara bëët lamba yie, ki tharabëëta, ki møga näk nyuudhi. Ni kaace cwøl ni kanya en kur keere na mar Jwøk.
english: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋää abïï maya mana näk ogëëŋö, da thääŋö mør mo cwøl ni kanya en kur keere na mar Jwøk na pere letha eni,
english: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

anywaa: ni beeye mana näk yie da gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte na näk tïïc ki warkey, ka acanduk mar luumma tuut Jwøki ki jiy, mo dëëre orømø ki warkey bäre, na näk yie da daa warkey mana bëët møga näk meena yie, ka athøny Aran na løth, ko opäp kïte moa göör luumma tuut bäätge.
english: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

anywaa: 'Ba bäät acanduk da gïï mo ocwääö ni caala nyïïatwiet maal mo cwøl ni kirubëlli, mo nyootha ajiem Jwøk, ni bwöpge ege määö bäät rëëbi mar kany wø ö Jwøki wø køny jiy yie. 'Ba kawaane atïmö ni bäŋ kany caanwa tiet japøgø yie këët.
english: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

anywaa: 'Ba moøgø beege gïïa jiiŋŋi kiper lam. Ni dïlämme wø cäädhö yi thääŋ oduŋkaanynya en wøk, ni ge tïïya jap wø lämge ki ge.
english: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of God.

anywaa: 'Ba Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ keere beeye wø ci yi thääŋ oduŋkaara maya, 'ba eni wø ci yie ka yie aciel keere ki yi cwiir bäre, ni ba cii jaak ni cere bäŋ remø mo kääre, man wø cïbe kiper dëëre ki moa bac jiyi ni kucge.
english: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

anywaa: Ni beeye gïn wø ö Jwïëc Jwøki na en kur keere wø nyooth gø, ni jöö mano døny jiyi yi kanya en kur keere na pere letha eni, poot kär jabø, kany poode no oduŋkaara mana en wøgø poot cuŋŋö kare.
