english: The Holy Ghost this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

anywaa: Ni manøgø beeye nyuudhi mo nyootha nïne moi. Ni nyootha gøøni ni muuce ko olämme mo wø cïp, ba løny ki man tïïcge cwïny ŋat wø lämö ni waany,
english: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

anywaa: kiper mana tïme ni ge caana luup caammi, ki maath, ki luup lwøk na nyuudhi ma teeŋi keerge, ni beege jap dëël moa cem gøøc kanya di luumma nyään na wäŋŋi cööp kare.
english: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

anywaa: 'Ba Krictø kanya ööe na Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ, ni ena kwääy lam mar gïïa beyø na öö, ena öö ki ro oduŋkaanynya dwøŋŋa eni na beerra eni døc na näk kär tïïö ki ceŋ, ni ba joota ri moa cwääc.
english: But Christ being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

anywaa: Ni eni kär öö ki rem dïëk ki mo nyïïrøøe, 'ba ena døny yi kanya en kur keere na pere letha eni yie aciel keere ni käära remme kiree, ni wïïl øøni wøk na enønø, këël na bäre bäre.
english: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo rem dïëk ki mo rwädhe ki bur mar dhieŋ ma nyakøø mo wø jør dëët jø wø näk ba waany wø døøya geni mo ena kur keerge ni døøc dëëtge mo waany,
english: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

anywaa: a teeŋ lwøk mo nyïëdi nø noo lwøk øøni ki rem Krictø, ŋata cïp dëëre jï Jwøk ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi ree, ni cïbe ka ri Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre, noo døøc cwïnynyø mo waany ni wiiø tïïe mo thøø ni tïnynyø Jwøa kwøw.
english: How much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ena nyïjöö mar luumma tuut na nyään, kiper nee olaaw mana näk adïëri na bäŋ cuŋŋe na buuk nee ci jï jøøa cwøl, kiper mana tïme ni da ŋat mo othøw man wø wïïl geni wøk yïth moa dhalge ri luumma kwøŋ tuut na bëënge.
english: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø näk yie da dhøk mo di caanø, wär ŋäc ni ŋata dhee caan, othøw møn.
english: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

anywaa: Kiper dhøk wø caanna køør thøø, ni kïth luup moa caan bäät tïïc køør thøø, ni bäŋ gïn mo doo kïtha bäät tïïc ni näk ŋata caan gø poot kwøw.
english: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgønø, këël luumma kwøŋ tuut kär jïëö ni bäŋ remø dëëre.
english: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya ö Modhe na caan luupa cem bëët yïth ciik Jwøk jï jiy bëët, ena lwötö ki rem nyïïrøøe, ki rem dïëk, ki pïï ciel, ki jïëc røømmø mo kwaar, ki lïïpa, ni jør wëël ciik kiree, ki jiy bëët ki gø,
english: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

anywaa: ni kööe, ni «Remmi en beeye rem luumma tuut mana ö Jwøki na cem uuni ki gø.»
english: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which God hath enjoined unto you.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni jør oduŋkaara thuwø ki remø manøgø na enøgønø, ki jammi bëët moa wara tïïge ki ge kar lam.
english: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

anywaa: 'Ba jammi moa wara bëën ciik Modhe, thööthge bëët bëënynyi ka remø møn. Ni raay ba wëënni ni näk baŋ remø mo ogwier piny.
english: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, gïïa wara nyooth jap maal manynya man bëënyge ki køør olämme moøgø. 'Ba jap maal ki dëëtge manynya olämme moa beyø geni ki moøgø.
english: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

anywaa: Kiper Krictø kär døny yi kanya en kur keere mana näk tïïc ka ceŋ, man wø nyooth kanya en kur keere mana näk adïëri. 'Ba ena ci maalø kiree, ni eni cuŋŋö nyïm Jwøk ennø kiperø.
english: For Christ is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us:

anywaa: 'Ba eni kär dønyø ki man cïp ree cooth kaamar Kwääy Lam Mana Dwøŋ ni wø døny yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki yïth cwiiri bëët, ni cii ka remø mo patha remme.
english: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;

anywaa: Kiper onää enøgønø, gïïa leth dee jøøyø cøøn, ki kanya täk pinynyi. 'Ba atïmö ni eni ööi ka yie aciel keere ya aŋuun piny man en, ni ba nwøe këët, kiper nee raay wëënne ki køør dëëre na cïbe;
english: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

anywaa: keda man bëëde no onyoodhø jï jiy, ni dhaanhø thøw yie aciel, ni køøre beeye ŋøl luup.
english: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø Krictø na cïp yie aciel keere nee raac jiy mo thööth kääre, ocäŋ duuö, ni ba ööi kaper raay nee kääre, 'ba oööi ni piema jø wø koor eni.
english: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper na tïme ni ciik Modhe beeye nyuudhi mar gïïa beyø na doo öö, ni paa gïïaka ki dëëtge, ba maar lønyø jïge ki man tïïcge jø wø ö baŋ lam no othur karge, ki køør olämme moøgø ni wø cïp cooth ki yïth cwiiri bëët.
english: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

anywaa: ?'Ba onää oløny jï ciigøgø, olämme ba doo naa ege nø wec ki cïp en? Onää jø lam dëëtge onø tïmö ni waany yie aciel na bäre bäre, ge ba doo poodø këët ni da raay mo jwørge jwørø ki cwïnyge.
english: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth olämme moøgø da gïn mo wø para wïthge ki raay moge ki yïth cwiiri bëët.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

anywaa: Kiper ba doo maara lønyø ki man ö rem rwädhe ki mo dïëk ki mana dege raay wëënnö.
english: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

anywaa: Kiper manøgøøni, kanya ö Krictø piny, ena köö, no «Olämme ki muuce, paa gïïa manynyï. 'Ba da dëël mo iï tïïö kipera.
english: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:

anywaa: 'Ba olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, ko olämme mo wëën raay, paa gïïa met yiï ki ge.
english: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyøgø, aana köö, ni ‹A nut ennø; aana öö kuna tïïa mana manynyï, ï na Jwøk, kaawat mana gööri yi Wëël Jwøk kipera.› »
english: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya caan gïïögø ni maalø yøø, ni «Ï ba many olämme ki muuce, ko olämme mo wø waaŋ bäre, wala olämme mo wëën raay, ni yiï bäŋ wø mïnni ki ge,» këël na bëëde ni gïïögø wø cïp ka køør ciik Modhe,
english: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

anywaa: ena cäŋ köö, ni «Neenï, aana ö kuna tïïa mana manynyï.» 'Ba eni wiila luumma dïkwøŋ, kiper nee maya kïth kare.
english: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.

anywaa: Ni beeye manøce na many Jwøki na tïïc øøni ni ø ena kur keerø, ki køør dëër Jecu Krictø na cïp no olämi yie aciel na bäre bäre.
english: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

anywaa: 'Ba dïlämme bëët, ge wø bëëdö kar tïïe moge ki yïth nïne bëët, ni ge cïpö ki teeŋ olämme moøgø cooth cooth, mo wø ba maar lønyø jïge ki man wëënge raay.
english: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

anywaa: 'Ba Krictø, kanya ööe na nø cïp dëëre no olämi yie aciel na bäre bäre kiper raay, ena pï bäät cwïï Jwøk.
english: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;

anywaa: 'Ba ki mana täge kar kanyøce, eni koora kanya di nyïïmänne tïïö yie na køøm tiete.
english: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ki køør olämi aciel keere na ö eni na tïïc jøøa näk ocïp kur keerge no othur karge na bäre bäre.
english: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere, mare akøbe jïïø thuwø, na kööe,
english: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

anywaa: ni «Wuuö Jwøk aköö, ni ‹Man beeye luubö mano tuuda ki geni køør nïrögøøni, Ciik 'moa okïtha cwïnyge, ni gööra ge wïthge.› »
english: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

anywaa: 'Ba køøre ena cäŋ köö, ni «Raay moge ki gïïa bacge ba lääŋŋa këët.»
english: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

anywaa: 'Ba kanya nø wec raay, doo bäŋ olämi këët mo cäŋ cïpö kiper raay.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, kiper mana tïme ni ø tëënnö ki man dønynyø kanya en kur keere na pere leth ki køør rem Jecu,
english: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,

anywaa: na näk jöö mana nyään na kwøw, na jabe kiperø, ki køør abïïna näk ogëëŋö, na näk beeye dëëre,
english: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

anywaa: ni tïme ni jïïø da kwääy lam mo dwøŋ ni en Øt Jwøki cere,
english: And having an high priest over the house of God;

anywaa: beerra man nyiigø kany mo cään ki cwïny ma adïëri, ni ŋäädhe päl cwïnynyø, ni cwïnynyø ojørø ni leer, ni bäŋ raay mo pär cwïnynyø ki ge, ni dëëtø olwøø ki pïï mo tøŋ.
english: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

anywaa: Beerra man putø ŋäädhe marø mar yi nyïm mana jïëø ki gøøni maa cwïnynyø ni ø ba dääŋi. Kiper wää buuki dwøre ba dak.
english: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

anywaa: Beerra man neetø dëëtø ki man cøømmø cwïnynyø ni ø mëër ni tïïø ki tïïe mo beyø,
english: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

anywaa: ni ba wiiø røømmø kar acooŋ Jwøk, kaawat man wø tïïc jø møga, 'ba cømø cwïnynyø kaa man ŋäyu gøøni enø ni cäŋ Wuuö Jwøk kare acäännö.
english: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø poot cøøa yïth raay ki teek wïc, ni luumma näk adïëri yøø nø kwany, doo bäŋ olämi këët mo dagø kiper raay.
english: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

anywaa: 'Ba dööŋŋa lwäy ajäla mano en nyïm, ki maac mo liel ni raac døc, mano cam jø wø män ki Jwøk.
english: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo ciik Modhe ee taaø, eni thøw ni bäŋ køny mo joode, ki køør dööt jiy ariiø wala adäk mo wø caan bääyö mare.
english: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

anywaa: ?'Ba a teeŋ rääc ajäla mo nyïëdi nø, na caarru noo rømi ki ŋat mo O Jwøk ee raanynyø, ni käre rem luumma tuut wøørø, mana tïïc eni ni ena kur keere, ni jøøŋ Jwïëc Jwøk ni wø cïp met ec?
english: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

anywaa: Kiper eni na caan gøøni, ni «Cool kwör beeye mara, ni beeye aani noo cool gø,» ŋääø. Ni cäŋ köö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk mar jiye oŋøle.»
english: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.

anywaa: Beeye gïn mo di lwäärö døc ki man päth dhaanhe cer Jwøa kwøw.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

anywaa: 'Ba cäŋu wïthu caarrø ki nïra kwøŋu beet kanya magu cwïnynyu ki gïïa leth na jwørru, køør mana cwøl u yi tar,
english: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

anywaa: na wara jïtu ki gïï mo leth, nou di buuö nyïm jiy bëët ki kwör møøk, ni ki kwör møøk gïï mo leth wø jwørru kaper mana dwallu cwïnynyu ki jø wø caanni na enøgønø.
english: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

anywaa: Kiper cwïnynyu apädhö ki gïr jø tööc, ni jïëyu ki man twier jammi mou ni yïthu met, kiper mana ŋäyu gø ni jïïu da gïn mo beerra eni mo puta bëëte.
english: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, kär teek ŋäädhe maru wetu, kiper beeye noo känni ki gïn mo dwøŋ jïïu.
english: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

anywaa: Kiper manynya man magu cwïnynyu, nee mana many Jwøki tïïyu ni ci buuki jïïu.
english: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.

anywaa: «Kiper dööŋŋa kany mo thiinh, nee eni na doo öö, ööe, ni eni ba ruu.
english: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaanhnha mana beer, okwøw ki køør ŋäädhe, 'ba noo näk mo ree di kwalø, cwïnya ba many gø këët.»
english: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ø ba en dï jø wø kwal dëëtge ni raanynyi, 'ba ø ena dï jø wø jïge da ŋäädhe, ni gwøga jwïëcge.
english: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäädhe beeye wø tïïc jap wø ŋääth yi nyïm ni ŋäc na adïëri, ni nyøtha jammi mo wø näk ba nëëni, ni nutö.
english: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

anywaa: Ni beeye na ö kwäre na jïëyi ya Jwøki ki køøre.
english: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe ni ŋääø gø ki man näk mo piny cwääc ka dwør Jwøk, ni tïme ni gïï wø nëëni ii, cwääca ri gïï mo ba nëëni.
english: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Eebelli na cïp olämi mana tïmö ni beerra eni jï Jwøk ki mar Keen, ni beeye na jïëc eni ni eni beer ki køøre, kanya ö Jwøki na jïëe ko olämme moa cïbe. 'Ba këël na thøøe, eni poot luubö ki køør ŋäädhe mare.
english: By faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, God testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe na ö Inøki na käli ni kïthi maal nee thøø ba neene, ni käri joodø kiper mana käli ya Jwøki. 'Ba kanya poode ni eni kär kälö, acaan ni yi Jwøk ee døøc mo met.
english: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk bäŋ ŋäädhe, ba maar lønyø jï dhaanhø ki man døøc yi Jwøk mo met. Kiper ŋat wø nyiik buut Jwøk kany mo cään, wär cwïnye dee ŋäädhe ni Jwøk nutö, ni wø cïpö ki jammi jï jø wø many eni.
english: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Noa na leŋ luubö mana caan Jwøki jïre ni tïïc jääy, ni piem jø paare, kanya ö Jwøki na køp gïïa näk poot kär nëënö jïre. Ni beeye gïnögø na jääl piny ki gø, ni tïm Nöa na lwiidhø mar jïëc man wø ööi ki ri ŋäädhe.
english: By faith Noah, being warned of God of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Eeberammi na leŋ luubö kanya cwøli ni aa kanya wäŋŋi ni cøøa jïre no olaaw. Ni aae ni kanyo ci yie kuue.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö eni na bëëde yi paana buuk, kaawat man wø bëët wëëllö yi ŋöömö mo path, ni bëëdö yïth oduŋkaare ki Aydhak, ki Jeekap, na näk lwiidhi ki eni ri buuögø na aciel enøgø.
english: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

anywaa: Kiper eni neeta pääny mana näk ogeerø na adïëri, na näk dïgëëdi mare ki ŋata tïïc gø beeye Jwøk.
english: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Ceera ki dëëre na jïte ki teek nyöödö, këël na näk eno døøŋŋø ni kare onø pöödhö, kiper na caar ŋata buŋ gø ni dwøre ba dak.
english: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ki ri dhaanhø aciel, ŋata näk dëëre onø rømø ki thøø, nyïïkwaaye anyaay ni tïmge ni thööth kaamar ceec maal ki nyeŋ akwöny naama dwøŋ wø ba løny ki kwaan.
english: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøi bëët ii, gena thøø yïth ŋäädhe, ni gïna buuk kär ci jïge, 'ba aneenge ni kare bäär ni mïn yïthge ki gø, ni ege jïëö ni gena jiy mo path mo bäŋ poge bäät piny.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

anywaa: Kiper jø wø cäänö na enøgønø, wø nyootha gø ni ge manynya kany mo tïmö na poge.
english: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

anywaa: 'Ba onää wïthge ege caarø ki gïr paana aacge yie, ge doo jïtö ki jöö man døøkge ki gø.
english: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

anywaa: 'Ba atïmö ni cwïnyge lääŋŋa paac mana beerra eni, ni beeye paana en maalø. Kiper manøgø, Jwøk wïïe ba laay ki man cwøli na Jwøk marge, kiper da pääny mo ee jiiŋŋø kiperge.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore God is not ashamed to be called their God: for he hath prepared for them a city.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Eeberammi na cïp Aydhak no olämi kanya päänynyi ya Jwøki. Ni ö eni na ci buuki jïre, ni put jïëy ki man cïp wääde na näk aciel no olämi,
english: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

anywaa: ŋata gïre caan, ni «Beeye Aydhak noo cak nyïïkwaayï ki ree.»
english: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall thy seed be called:

anywaa: Kiper ee caarø ni løny jï Jwøk, këël ki man tïŋ jiy maal ki yi thøø. Kiper manøgønø, doo caanø, ni ena thøw, ni cäŋi jootø.
english: Accounting that God was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Aydhaki na kwac gwïëth bëët moo en nyïm nee ci ri Jeekap ki Icøø.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Jeekapi, kanya thøøe, na gwïëth wäät Jocep karge riet, ni wøør Jwøk ni ree ee jääŋö ka athøra mare.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Jocepi na caan wääth mar jø Icriel, kanya tïm kare ni cään ki thøø, ni cem ge kiper cuuwe.
english: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Israel; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Modhe na kani ya menni ki wänni ki dwäde adäk kanya nywøli, kiper na jootge nyilaal na wøp, ni kärge lwäyö ki dwør nyeya.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Modhe na kweere ki man cwøli ni ena o nyi Peerø kanya døøŋŋe.
english: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;

anywaa: Ni tïme ni jiera bëët caarø ki jø Jwøk na aciel, ki mana di yie mïnnö ki jap raay ni wø laar jøølø.
english: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

anywaa: Ni ee caarø na abuua mana buui ki gø kiper Krictø beeye kwärö eni mana dwøŋ ki kwär mar Ijep, kiper na neet gïno cïp yi nyïm.
english: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö eni ni wec Ijep ni kär lwäyö ki wëëc nyeya. 'Ba cwïnye ee maa ni tïme keda neeta Jwøk ni wø ba maar neen.
english: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Modhe na gwøk Cäŋa Pööth Thøøe Yie, ni jør rem, kiper nee ŋata ö kuna 'näk kaai nee kaai mo jø Icriel ba gude.
english: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö jiyi na kaathge Naama Kwaar, ni ge cäädhi ka kany mo otal. 'Ba na ö jø Ijepi na ŋwaalge gø, gena mut.
english: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö kiir mar Jerikö na pädhe køør mana wïr lage ki cääŋŋe abïriiø.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

anywaa: Ni beeye ŋäädhe, na ö Reeyapi na näk kääbi na käre thøw na aciel ki jøøa wïthge teek, kiper na pänh jøøa liew paac ki mëër.
english: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø mør nø, noo cäŋa caannø? Kiper piny pöödhö bääta noo caana gïr Gidien, ki Barak, ki Camcøn, c ki Jepta, wala mar Deebit, ki Camiel,  ki gïï nyïïkuk Jwøk,
english: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

anywaa: jøøa dïïm mïëc nyeye ki køør ŋäädhe, na ŋøl luup ki ŋøl ma adïëri, na joot gïïa buuk, na mec dhøk ŋuuwe,
english: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

anywaa: na jwöc mäc mo døøŋŋø, na bøth dhøk opëëlle, na tïïc ni ge teek ki ri jäk, ni tïmge na atïëte mo tøŋ, ni riemge lwaa lenye mo juurre.
english: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

anywaa: Ni ö määnni ni jootge jicge moa thøw ki køør mana duuge wøk ki yi thøø. Ni ö møøki ni caari, ni kweerge ki man pät geni, kiper nee ge cäŋge duu wøk ki yi thøø, ki kwøw mana beerra eni.
english: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

anywaa: Ni ö jø møøki ni buui ni pööti, ni ö møøki ni tööc geni ko oguudi ni kïth ge øt twöc.
english: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

anywaa: Ni këër ge ki kïte këël mana thøwge, ni ŋøør ge na thäŋi, ni nääŋ geni ko opëëlle, ni ge wïïrö jaak ni ge käära duup rööm ki mo atëëe, ni ge can, ni ge jøøya gïï mo leth, ni ge di caannø,
english: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

anywaa: ni ge wïïrö dï paap ki bäät kïte, ki yïth buri ki kwör mo ŋammø piny, ni beege jøøa beyø na näk ba doo rømø ki man bëëtge dï jø piny.
english: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø bëët, këël na ŋäc geni møn ni jïge da ŋäädhe, gïna buuk kär ci jïge,
english: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

anywaa: kiper mana tïme ni da gïn mør mo beerra eni mo ŋäc Jwøki kiperø, ki man näk mo ge ba thur karge ni ø tøør.
english: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na tïme ni buutø da teeŋ lwaa lïŋŋe mo thööth ma yøøgø nø, beerra man ööø thuwø ni cïbø gïïö ni peek yøø piny, ki raay no onigän dëëtø ii, ni ŋwieø ŋwïëy man en nyïmmø en, ni cwïnynyø yøø maaø,
english: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

anywaa: ni ø neeta Jecu, eni na täk ŋäädhe marø ni wø tïïc gø nee thur kare, ni beeye ŋata jïëny thøw bäät jaadha no odëëdö kiper met ec mana en nyïme, na taak laac wïc, ni pï piny buut wäl Jwøk bäät cwïïc.
english: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.

anywaa: Caarru eni na jïëny teeŋ männa män jø raayi ki gø, kiper nou ba ööllu ni räny cwïnynyu.
english: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.

anywaa: 'Ba leny maru ki raay, u poot kär cööp ri køny remmu piny.
english: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, wïthu awïl ki luumma købe jïïu kede köömma wääte? na kööe, ni «Wääda, kär pwöc Wuuö Jwøk neetï keda gïn mo jööt jaak, ni ba räny cwïnyï ki juuk mare.
english: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö Jwøk wø pwönynya jø wø mëëre ki geni, ni pwöt wääte bëët mo wø jïëe ki ge.»
english: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

anywaa: Jïënynyu gïï mo leth ni beeye pwöc. Kiper u käär Jwøki ni uuna wääte. ?A wäädö mane ni bäŋ wø pwöny wänni?
english: If ye endure chastening, God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo uuno wiiø nou ba pwönynyi ki pwöc man wø pwöny øøni bëët ki gø, u tïmö ni uuna wäät akwanya nou patha wääte këët.
english: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

anywaa: 'Ba jïïø da wëëe piny thuwø mo wø pwönynya øøni, ni wøørø geni. ?Aŋø nø, ni ba jïëø ki Wää jwïëy 'moø ni kwøø?
english: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

anywaa: Kiper wëëgø øøna pwönyge ki kany mo thiinh kaawat mana manyge, 'ba Jwøk ø wø pwönynye kaper nøø bëënynyø, nøø tïmø ni ø ena kur keerø na mo Jwøk ki eni na aciel.
english: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

anywaa: Kiper pwöc nëëni keda gïn mo leth kawaane ennø, ni patha gïn mo beer. 'Ba køøre cään obëënynyi jï jø wø ŋïïyi ki gø, ni cïpe ki bëët-mëër ki bëënynyö jïge.
english: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, tïŋu ceŋŋu maal no oniläp yøø, ni wëëgu cøŋŋu moa no ojöönyö tëënnö.
english: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

anywaa: Ni tïïu ki uutjïëthe mo thïŋŋö kiper tietu, kiper nee ŋat wø kwömi nee waŋ ocwiie ba needunynya, 'ba nee bëënynye.
english: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

anywaa: Manynyu man bëëdu ki bëët-mëër ki jiy bëët, ni manynyu man tïmu nou ena kur keeru na mo Jwøk, kiper bäŋ ŋat mo Wuuö dee neenø ni näk ba en kur keere.
english: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

anywaa: Gwøgu røgu nee bäŋe ŋat mo kääŋi ki met yi Jwøk, nee bäŋe gïn mo keec mo tuy ni ööl uuni, ni raany jiy mo thööth.
english: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo bëëte patha kare, wala ŋat mo taaga Jwøk, ni caala Icøø na ŋeew dööŋö mare ki kar cam aciel.
english: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ni køøre cään kanya tïme ni manynya gwïëth mana doo ci jïre, ena kwier, kiper na käre jïtö ki jöö man cäŋ wïïe caarrø ki gø, këël na many gø ni eni jwöŋö ki pï nyeŋ.
english: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

anywaa: Kiper u kär ö baŋ gïn mo di mulö, kaamar Kïn Caynay, na neen kwäyu ni bääte da maac mo liel, ki muudhö, ki kany mo dhïïth, ka atuunna,
english: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

anywaa: ki dwør tuuŋ, ki dwøl mo luupe tïïya jøøa wïny gø ni kwääö nee bäŋe luubö mør mo cäŋ caannø jïge këët.
english: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

anywaa: Kiper gena tïmö ni ge lwäär ki luumma køp jïge, ni «Këël doo naa lääy noo gut kïnnögø, doo këërö ki kïte.»
english: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

anywaa: Ni näk adïëri møn, kiper na tïm gïna joot ni kännö ki lwär mo raac døc, Modhe aköö, ni «Dëëra atïmö ni kwanynyi ki lwär.»
english: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

anywaa: 'Ba u ööa bäät Kïn Dhayan yi pääny Jwøa kwøw na näk Jerucalem mar maal, ki nyïïatwiet maal mo ba maar lønyø ki kwaan na näk dëëtge ege cooŋø ki met ec,
english: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

anywaa: ki jø Jwøk moa näk ojierø na caal kaai, jøøa näk nyeŋge ogöörö maal. Uuna ö baŋ dïŋut luup na näk Jwø jøw bëët, ki baŋ jwïëc jøøa beyø na näk otïïö no othur karge,
english: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

anywaa: ki baŋ Jecu na näk nyïjöö mar luumma nyään na tuut, ki baŋ remma jør, na näk meta dwøre ki dwør rem Eebel.
english: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.

anywaa: Gwøgu rou nou ba kweerru ki ŋatøgø ni cäänö enø. Kiper ni näk jøøka kär bøth kanya kwierge ŋata kööm geni piny, ø ba bøth na bäre bäre ni näk ŋat wø kööm øøni ki maal yøø kwierø.
english: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

anywaa: Kanyøca piny atïïc dwøre ni jäŋŋi, 'ba kawaane ena bugö, ni «Poot da aciel mør, kanyo cäŋa piny tïïyö ni jäŋŋi, ni paa piny keere, 'ba këël maalø thuwø.»
english: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

anywaa: 'Ba luummi na kööe, ni «Poot da aciel mør,» caana gø ni gïï wø jäŋŋi, daae daa, ni beege jammi moa no ocwääö, nee gïï wø ba maar jäŋ, nee dööŋge.
english: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man dwøgø pwøc jïre kiper mana jïtø ki bura mo ba maar jäŋŋi, ni tïnynyø Jwøk ni ø tïïya gïï wø mïn yie ki ge, ni ø pwøya eni ni yøø wøørø, ni ø lwäär.
english: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve God acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

anywaa: Kiper Jwøk marø beeye maa wø räänyö.
english: For our God is a consuming fire.

anywaa: Bëëdu nou mëër ki dëëtu ki mëëc nyïïmëëe.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

anywaa: Kär nou weya man pänhnhu jøw mo path, kiper jø møøk nyïïatwiet maal apänhge na enøgønø ni kucge.
english: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

anywaa: Lääŋŋu jøøa no otwöö, kede u ena yi twöc ki geni. Ni lääŋŋu jø wø caanni, keda u di caannø thuwø.
english: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

anywaa: Beerra man tïm nywömmi na gïn mo owøørø jï jiy bëët, ni ba wëëk kar joot dëël mar nywöm ränynyö. Kiper kääpe ki jø lugi, marge oŋøl Jwøki wøk.
english: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.

anywaa: Bëëdu ni dëëtu you gwøø ki mëëc jammi, ni uuno rømø ki mou na en jïïu. Kiper Jwøk aköö, ni «U ba leeŋa piny, ni ba wiia uuni.»
english: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ø doo köö ni yøø ŋäädhö, ni «Wuuö Jwøk beeye dïkunyi mara, naa ba doo lwäyö. ?Aŋø, dhaanhø jaak, agïnaŋø noo tïïe dëëra?»
english: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

anywaa: Lääŋŋu jøøa bwøth uuni, jøøa caan luum Jwøk jïïu. Caarru bëëtö marge këël aŋuunne, ni ŋwaallu ŋäädhe marge.
english: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

anywaa: 'Ba Jecu Krictø poot na kare, ya awääre ki dïcäŋi, këël na bäre bäre.
english: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

anywaa: Kär nou wëëga wïthu maaŋŋø ki pwöc ma teeŋi mo path. 'Ba gïna beerra eni beeye ki man wëëgø cwïnynyø tëënnö ki ri met yi Jwøk, ni patha kiper gwøk ciik mo caammi ni wø bäŋ gïn duuge jï jø wø caath køørge.
english: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

anywaa: 'Ba jïïø da gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, mo jø wø tïïö yo oduŋkaara kär jïëö ki man camge gïno cïp bääte.
english: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

anywaa: Kiper dëët lääy mo wø remge kïth Kwääy Lammi Mana Dwøŋ yi kanya en kur keere na pere leth no okïdi kiper wëën raay, dëëtge wø waaŋŋa wøk ŋää kiir.
english: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, Jecu gïï mo leth ajwøre wøk ŋää kiir, kiper nee jiy tïïe ni ena kur keerge na mo Jwøk ki køør remme kiree.
english: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man cøø baŋe ŋää kiir, ni ø di buuö kipere.
english: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

anywaa: Kiper jïïø bäŋ pääny mo ruu kany, 'ba ø manynya pääny mano ööi.
english: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man cïpø ki pwøc na muuce cooth jï Jwøk ki ri Jecu, ni beege gïï wø ööi ki dhøgi mo wø jïëc nyeŋŋe.
english: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

anywaa: Kär tïï gïïa beyø weyu, ki nywaak gïïa en jïïu. Kiper teeŋ muuce moøgø, Jwøk yie met ki geni.
english: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

anywaa: Leŋŋu dööt jø wø bwøth uuni, ni jïëyu geni. Kiper ge koora jwïëyu, ni ŋäcge ni beege noo pëënynyi ki gïïa tïïcge. Beerra man wëëgu geni tïïc gïnögø ni yïthge met, ni cwïnyge ba peek. Kiper ni näk ma enøgønø tïmö ni bäŋ gïn mo beer mo kwanynyu.
english: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

anywaa: Lämu kiperwa. 'Ba ŋäcwa ni cwïnywa leer, ni wa manynya man bëëtwa ki bëëtö mana näk adïëri ki yïth jammi bëët.
english: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

anywaa: A kwaya uuni ki man lämu ki cwïnynyu bäre, kiper naa laara duu baŋu.
english: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane Jwøa näk Jwø bëëtmëër, ŋata duu Kwääyø ma Jecu wøk ki yi thøø, na näk dïkwääy dïëk mana dwøŋ, ki ri rem luumma tuut na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe,
english: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

anywaa: uuno wëëk gïïa beyø bëët, kiper nee mana manynye tïïyu, ni tïïc gïï wø met yie ki ge yïth cwïnynyø, ki ri Jecu Krictø, ŋat wø en ajiemmi jïre këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, a kwaya uuni ki man cegu ïthu ki luumma köömma uuni ki gø, kaawat mana göönna baŋu ki luubö mo ciek en.
english: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

anywaa: Beerra man ŋäyu gøøni ni cöögø ma Timöthi apät, ni uuno jootwa ki eni ni näk eni laara öö.
english: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

anywaa: Määthu jø wø bwøth uuni, ki jø Jwøk bëët. 'Ba uuna määth jøøa käl yi ŋööm Itali.
english: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

anywaa: Met ec bëëde bäätu bëët. Enøgønø.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Jeemeth na laŋ Jwøk ki Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø. A määtha uuni na tuŋi apaar kurriiø, u no okeethø dï piny.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, yïthu mïnge ki teeŋ gïïö ni leth yøø bëët kany wø pïïcge dëëtu.
english: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ni pääny ŋäädhe maru beeye wø käl tëënnö.
english: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

anywaa: 'Ba wëëgu tëënnö thur kare, kiper nou thuru karu na bäre bäre, ni bäŋ gïn mo läämö.
english: But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo leec wïc mare orëëm dïïu, Jwøk wär pëënynye, ŋat wø cïpi jï jiy bëët ki cwïnye bäre ni ba pëëö, 'ba omëëk eni.
english: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

anywaa: 'Ba wär pëëe ni ee ŋäädhö, ni bäŋ ataa, kiper ŋat wø tääö caala athaŋ naama dwøŋ ni wø jøøc jame jaak.
english: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

anywaa: 'Ba teeŋ ŋat ma enøgønø mo cwïnye da luup ariiø ni wø dääŋi ki yi bëëtö mare bäre, kär nee caara gø ni da gïn mo joode joodø baŋ Wuuö.
'Ba cöögö mo can beerra man mïn yie ni näk mo di røønyø,
english: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

anywaa: ni ö ŋata näk okwär ni mïn yie ni näk mo ocännö, kiper eni ränynyö kaamar wï luum mo oŋøøk ni wø ränynyi.
english: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

anywaa: Kiper cäŋ wø tuulö ki kwaaye ni taal luum. Ni päth wïïe piny, ni räny beenynye. Kaawat manøgø thuwø, ŋat mo okwär ocänni ni eni ena bäät tïïc mare.
english: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falleth, and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

anywaa: Meta yi ŋat wø jïëny päänynyö, kiper kany wø bööt päänynyö, eno jïti ka adun kwøw mana näk obuuk Jwøki jï jø wø mëër ki eni.
english: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.

anywaa: Kär dee ŋat köö kany wø päänynyi, na «A päänynya Jwøki.» Kiper ba maar lønyø ki man pääny Jwøk ki raay, ni eni ki dëëre bäŋ ŋat mo päänynye.
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of God: for God cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

anywaa: 'Ba ŋati man nø wø päänynyi kaper gïn wø nieŋ køør gø, kany wø pari ya cwïnye ni cøøra gø.
english: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

anywaa: Køøre gïn wø nieŋ ri gø, wø jïtö ki nyey ni nywøl raay. 'Ba kany wø døøŋ raayi, wø käla thøø.
english: Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.

anywaa: Käru cøøgi, nyïïmera, u na mëëra ki uuni.
english: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

anywaa: Muuce bëët moa näk othur karge wø ööi ki maal ni öge piny ki baŋ Wuuö na näk wää tarri ni wø ba dak, ni ba caal tïpö ni wø dääŋi.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køør mana manynye ki wïïe keere na cwääc øøni ki køør luum adïëri nøø tïmø ni ø caala thwöth beel ri moa cwääe.
english: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäyu gïn, nyïïmera, u na mëëra ki uuni. Beerra man ö ŋati man nø ni laar luubö wïnynyö, ni ba laar cäännö, ni ba laar wëër.
english: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

anywaa: Kiper wëëc dhaanhø bäŋ wø wëëk beeny Jwøk thur kare.
english: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, weyu gïïa reyø bëët ki gïïa näk patha karge bëët, ni jïëyu ki luumma piith cwïnynyu nou mwöl, na näk løny jïre ki man piem jwïëyu.
english: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

anywaa: 'Ba bëëdu ni uuna jø wø tïïc luum Jwøk, ni ba tïmu nou wïnynya luubö keere nou cøøga dëëtu.
english: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk da ŋat mo wïnynya luum Jwøk jaak, ni ba tïïc gø, eni caala dhaanhø mo raŋŋa ree ki räŋi.
english: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

anywaa: Kiper dëëre wø raŋŋe raŋŋø ni aae ki wääthe ni put wïïe wïlö ki kïte.
english: For he beholdeth himself, and goeth his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø raŋ ciik Jwøk na näk kare døøc, na näk beeye jöör pät jiy, ni put bëëtö ri gø ni ena ŋat tïïc man wø tïïc gø, ni ba tïme na ŋat wø wïny luubö jaak ni wø wïïe wïl, teeŋ ŋatøgøøni ogwïëth kiper mana tïïe.
english: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo dëëre ee caarø ni ena ŋat Jwøk, ni leebe käre gwøø, eni cøøga ree keere, ni lam mare bäŋ tiere.
english: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man's religion is vain.

anywaa: 'Ba lam mana näk adïëri na näk bäŋ gïn mo raac dëëre nyïm Jwøk na näk Wuuö, beeye ki man gwøk obwöre moa näk kïïe ki määr thuunhnhi ri gïï wø leth wø pïï dëëtge, ki man ö dhaanhe ni män ree ki raac piny.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, kär dee ŋat jeenynyu kaawat man bëëdu nou ŋäätha Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø enø, eni na Kwääy ajiem.
english: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

anywaa: Kiper ni näk da ŋat mo ööa kar acooŋa maru no oruyö ka abïïe mo beyø, ni cere da ogut warkey, ni ö ŋat mo canni thuwø, ni ööe ni käära abïïe ma nywate,
english: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

anywaa: ni tïmu nou cega ïthu ki luup ŋata røc abïïga beyø, ni kööu, ni «Pï kany, nyawat,» ni kööu jï ŋata can, ni «Cuŋŋï kaagø,» wala «Ö pï piny yïth ŋøøm buut tieta,»
english: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

anywaa: ?aŋø, manøgø u ba tïïya apääk yïthakiyu, ni tïmu ni uuna dïŋut luup mo caara gïï mo reyø?
english: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

anywaa: 'Ba wïnynyu nø, nyïïmera, u na mëëra ki uuni. ?Aŋø, Jwøk ba jier jø pinyi moa can na bëëde, nee kwärge ri ŋäädhe, nee ge tïmge na lwiidhi mo bura mana näk ee buuö jï jø wø mëër ki eni?
english: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him?

anywaa: 'Ba ŋata can wïïe alääu. ?Aŋø, paa jøøa no okwär ni wø caan uuni? ?Paa geni ni wø pee uuni kwör løøe?
english: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, patha geni ni wø jany nyeŋŋa mïërö ki wøør, na caa u ree?
english: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mou tïïya ciik Jwøk møn na caal ciik nyeya keda mana caan yi wëël Jwøk, «Mëërï ki ŋat mør kaawat man wø mëërï ki dëërï,» nou tïïyu gø na enøgønø, u tïïya gïna beer na doo tïïö.
english: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

anywaa: 'Ba noo tïïyu ajeeny, uuna bääyö, ni uuno nyooth ciik Jwøki ni uuna jø adhala.
english: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø gwøk ciik Jwøk bëët ni baaya aciel dïge, ena tïmö ni baaya ge bëët.
english: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

anywaa: Kiper eni na köö, ni «Kärï kännö ki luk,» aköö thuwø, ni «Kärï nägö ki dhaanhø.» 'Ba ni näk miï ba kännï ki luk, 'ba ï 'näga dhaanhø, ïïna tïmö niï dhala ciik Jwøk.
english: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, beerra man cäänu ni tïïu ni uuna jiy mo luupge ŋøl piny ka ri luum jöör pät jiy.
english: So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø ba køny can dhaanhø mør, wø ŋøla wøk ni bäŋ køny kipere. 'Ba ŋat wø kunyö, bäŋ kany mo ŋøli wøk ki gø.
english: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment.

anywaa: ?Nyïïmera, agïnaŋø ni beer ni näk mo dhaanhø köö, ni cwïnye da ŋäädhe, 'ba bäŋ tïïe mo tïïe? ?Aŋø, eni maar ŋääthe ka piem?
english: What doth it profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk cöögu ma dïcwøø wala nyakøø cäädhi ka dëëre ni bäŋ abïïe ni manynya cam,
english: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

anywaa: ni kö dhaanhe acielli dïïu, ni «Beer, ciï ki met ec, ïïno jäŋ ni lëënh dëërï,» ni cam ki gïïa many dëëre käre cïbö jï gø, ?agïnaŋø ni beer ri gø?
english: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit?

anywaa: Kiper ŋäädhe ni näk ma eni keere ni bäŋ tïïe ree, caala gïn mo othøw.
english: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

anywaa: 'Ba kanymør da ŋat mo köö, ni «Ïïni cwïnyï da ŋäädhe, 'ba aani mara beeye tïïe.» Beer, nyuth a ŋäädhe marï na näk bäŋ tïïe ree, 'ba ŋäädhe mara onyoodha jïrï ki ri tïïe 'moa.
english: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.

anywaa: Ïïno jïëy ni Jwøk aciel. Marï wøp. Këël anäge wø jïëy ni dëëtge miel ki lwär.
english: Thou believest that there is one God; thou doest well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, ï manynya gø nee nyooth jïrï, ï ni bäŋ wïc en, ki man näk mo ŋäädhe ni näk bäŋ tïïe ree, bäŋ gïn duue?
english: But wilt thou know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

anywaa: ?A kwarø ma Eeberam ba jïëc ni mare beer ka køør tïïe na bëëde, kanya cïp wääde ma Aydhak no olämi bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte?
english: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

anywaa: ?Aŋø, kärï joodø ni ŋäädhe mare cäädhi ka tïïe moe na aciel, ni thur ŋäädhe mare kare ki køør gïna tïïe?
english: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

anywaa: Ni ö wëël Jwøki ni thur kare, ni wø caan, ni «Eeberam Jwøk aŋäädhe, ni ö Wuuö Jwøki ni jïëc Eeberam ni ena dhaanhø mo beer ki køør ŋäädhe mare.» Ni cwøli ni ena nyawat Jwøki.
english: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, käru joodø ni dhaanhø wø jïëc ni mare beer ka køør tïïe, ni patha ki køør ŋäädhe keere?
english: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, këël Reeyap thuwø na näk kääbi, ba jïëc ni mare beer ka køør tïïe, kanya pänh nyïïatwieli na kwal ge wøk ki jöö mør?
english: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋäädhe ni näk bäŋ tïïe ree, caala gïn mo othøw, kaawat man bëët dëëlli en, ni näk mo jwïëy tøør ree, othøw.
english: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, kär jiy mo thööth tïmö na dïpööye dïïu. Kiper ŋäyu ni waani ni pöö en, ajäla marwa tïmö ni dwøŋŋa eni.
english: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

anywaa: Kiper ø bëët, ø wø bääö ki gïï mo thööth. 'Ba nee da dhaanhø mo ba bääyi ri gïï wø care, ena dhaanhø mo bäŋ gïn mo gwäyi jïre, ni maara lønyø jïre ki man män dëëre bäre ki raay thuwø.
english: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo oguudi yøø kïth dhøk okwëënyi nee luupø leŋge, ø weya dëëtge bäre.
english: Behold, we put bits in the horses' mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

anywaa: Raŋŋu jïëth naam mø, këël na døøŋge ni ge kiiwa jame mo teek, ge wø weya ogeelle mo thenh thenh, kun wø many ŋato kiiw gø.
english: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgønø, leep a thääŋ dëël mo thiinh, 'ba eni töödö ka gïï mo døøŋŋø. Neennu, paap bäre wø waaŋa maaci mo thiinh.
english: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

anywaa: 'Ba leep caala maac, ni leep caala pinyi ni raac en, ni ena thäk dëëtø, ni raanynya dëël bäre, ni waaŋa kwøw bäre, na acaare moøgø bëët käla bäŋ anägö.
english: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defileth the whole body, and setteth on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

anywaa: Kiper teeŋ lääy bëët, ki weny, ki lääy mo wø muuli ki piny, ki gïï wø bëëdö yïth näm, løny ki man pwönynyi ni möölge, ni møøk onø pwöny dhaanhe.
english: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo maar lønyø jïre ki man pwöny leep nee möölle, 'ba beeye gïn mo raac mo wïïrö, ni dëëre päŋ ki jaath thøø.
english: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

anywaa: Ni beeye eni wø pwøø Kwäärö na näk Wääø ki gø, ni cäŋø jiy ciennø ki gø, jøøa näk ocwääö ni kïtge rööma kït Jwøk.
english: Therewith bless we God, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of God.

anywaa: Ni beeye dhøøgø na aciel enø ni wø pwöö ni cïëne. 'Ba nyïïmera, manøgø ba doo naa enønø.
english: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

anywaa: ?Aŋø, jøøro wø kwönnö ki pïï mo met, ni kwönne ki pïï mo keec ki dhøøgø na aciel enø?
english: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

anywaa: ?Nyïïmera, olaam doo nywøl ki nyïïjwiel, wala leemuun doo nywøl ki nyïïolaam? Kaawat manøgø thuwø, pï acäbö ba maar bänhnhö ni tïmge ni met.
english: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

anywaa: ?Aŋa dïïu ni wïïe leer ni ŋäc luup? Beerra man ööe ni nyooth tïïe moe ki möölle mana öö ki ra acaara ki køør bëëtö mare na beer.
english: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo cwïnynyu keec, ni ŋati man nø ŋäya dëëre keere, käru töödö ni tïmu nou kwiera adïëri mana dou ŋääö.
english: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

anywaa: 'Ba acaayøgøøni patha teeŋ man wø ööi ki maal, 'ba beeye mar piny, ni ba en jöör Jwøk, 'ba beeye mar anägö.
english: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

anywaa: Kiper kany wø näk yie da keec, ni ŋati man nø ŋäya ree keere, kanyøca jïtö ko okiera ki teeŋ tïïe moa reyø bëët.
english: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

anywaa: 'Ba acaara man wø ööi ki maal, bäŋ gïn mo raac dëëre, 'ba bëët-mëër ena ree, ki mööl, ki leŋ luup, ki køny mo päl, ki tïïe mo beyø, ni bäŋ dööti ariiø, wala atade.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be entreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

anywaa: 'Ba jø wø many bëët-mëër, köödhi mo wø piithge ki mëër wø kännö ki bëënynyö.
english: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

anywaa: ?Agïnaŋø ni wø käl lenye ki wëëye dïïu? ?Aŋø, patha gïïa reyø ni wø nieŋ cwïnynyu køørge ni wø këëdi yïth cwïnynyu?
english: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

anywaa: Gïrpiny wø manynyu manynyø, 'ba noo ba jootu gø, u nägö. Ni parru gïrpiny, 'ba noo ba ci jïïu, u wëër ni këëdu. Ni ba ci jïïu kaper na käru pëëö.
english: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.

anywaa: 'Ba u wø pëëö møn, ni ba mëëgi uuni, kiper u pëëö ka pïëc mo patha kare, nou manynya gïïa reyø wø nieŋ cwïnynyu køørge nee yïthu mïnge.
english: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.

anywaa: ?Nyie, u ni wø kwier luum Jwøk en, kuyu ni ŋat wø näk nyïïawäädi ki piny, mare män ki Jwøk? Kiper manøgønø, ŋat wø many piny nee tïme na nyawatge, wø tïïya ree ni ena nyimän Jwøk.
english: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

anywaa: Wala you caarø ni gïn wø caan Wëël Jwøki oballe jaak, ni wø köö, ni «Jwøk cwïnye lääŋŋa jwïëy mana tïïe nee bëëde dëëtø.»
english: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?

anywaa: 'Ba eni wø cïpö ki met ec mo päl. Ni beeye ni wø caan, ni «Jwøk män ka jø atöör, 'ba met ec wø wëëge jøøa mwöl.»
english: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, cïpu dëëtu jï Jwøk. Ni cuŋŋu karu ni kwierru anägö, 'ba eno reŋi dïïu.
english: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

anywaa: Nyiigu buut Jwøk, 'ba eno nyänh buutu. Lwøgu ceŋŋu, u na jø raay, ni døøyu cwïnynyu mo leer, u ni luup oriewi cwïnynyu en.
english: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.

anywaa: Beerra man kïmmu, ni päth cwïnynyu, ni jwöŋu. Døøyu ŋeethø maru pänh cwïny, ni døøyu met ec maru kïmmö.
english: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

anywaa: Døøyu dëëtu mo mwöl nyïm Wuuö, 'ba uuno røønye.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, käru cäänö ki raay dëëtu keeru. Kiper ŋat wø cäänö ki raay dëër coki, wala ŋøla coki wøk, ŋatøgø caana raay ri ciik Jwøk, ni ŋøla ciik Jwøk wøk. 'Ba ni näk ciik Jwøk iï ŋøl wøk, ï patha ŋat wø gwøk ciik Jwøk, 'ba ïïna tïmö ni ïïna dïŋut luup.
english: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

anywaa: Kiper ŋata cïp ciik Jwøk nut ni beeye dïŋut luup, ni beeye eni ni løny jïre ki man piem jiy wala ki man raany geni. ?'Ba ïïna ŋa, ni ŋølï wadu wøk?
english: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

anywaa: 'Ba ööu nø, u jø wø köö, ni «Dïcäŋi wala diøø wa cøøa paani nø ni ciwa paani nø, nee wa bëëtwa ki cwiir kaace, nee wa gäthwa ni jïtwa ki jammi,»
english: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

anywaa: ni gïno tägi diøø kuyu. ?Kwøw maru agïnaŋø? Kiper u caala rwöc ni wø nëëni ki kany mo thiinh ni laar rwäänyö.
english: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.

anywaa: 'Ba mana dou caanø, beeye ni «Noo kö Wuue, wa kwøw, ni tïïcwa gïn wala manece.»
english: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

anywaa: 'Ba maru atïmö na atöör ni bäŋ gïn mo ŋäyu. 'Ba teeŋ atöör manøgø bäre raac.
english: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø ŋäc gïn mo beer mo dee tïïö, ni ba tïïc gø, atïmö na bääyö jï ŋatøgø.
english: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ööu nø, u no okwär, ni jwöŋu ni rëëdu kiper gïïo leth moo ö bäätu.
english: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.

anywaa: Jap kwärö mou akwäk, ni ö abïïe mou ni cami ya alweele.
english: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

anywaa: Ni ö warkie mou ki gwet-bïrö mou ni cami ya nyalli. 'Ba nyal marge otïmö na nyuudhi mo jääla uuni, ni waaŋ dëëtu keda maac. Uuna känö ki jammi kiper nïr cuŋ piny.
english: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.

anywaa: Neennu, gwet jøøa kac pwöth mou na møtu atïmö ni rëëdö. Ni ö oduuru mar jøøa kac caammi mou ni wïnye ïth Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk, eni na wïth jammi bëët.
english: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

anywaa: 'Ba uuna bëëdö yi kwär bäät piny ni yïthu met, ni mïn cwïnynyu ni jäŋŋu keda cäŋ twëër.
english: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

anywaa: Ni jäällu ŋat mo mare beer ni 'nägu gø. 'Ba eni bäŋ wø pïëmö ki uuni.
english: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, cïbu cwïnynyu piny, këël mano ö Kwäärö. 'Ba ŋääø, ni ŋat puur wø koora jap wø beyø ni wø ciek yi ŋöömö, ni cwïnye ee cïp piny ki gø, këël mano päth køth dhikøthi ki køth arïïa.
english: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni thuwø cïbu cwïnynyu piny, ni maau cwïnynyu kanya ciel, kiper ööny Kwäärö kare acäännö.
english: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

anywaa: Käru dwaallø ki dëëtu keeru, nyïïmera, nou ba ŋøl wøk. Kiper neennu, dïŋut luup cuŋŋa dhøk uudi.
english: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.

anywaa: Nyïïmera, ni näk mou manynya neen jöör jwør gïï mo leth ni cwïny ocïp piny, raŋŋu bëët nyïïkuk Jwøk, jøøa cäänö ki nyeŋ Wuuö.
english: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

anywaa: 'Ba neennu, jø wø ba dääŋi wø cwølø cwølø ni jøøa näk ogwëëdhö. 'Ba bëët Jööp na bëëde kare awïnynyu, ni neennu gïna tïïc Wuue kipere ya aŋuudi, kaawat mana bëët Wuuö ni yie bäth, ni cwïnye laara pädhö ki gïr dhaanhø.
english: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, dï japøgø bëët, weyu kööŋ, ni bäŋe ŋat kööŋ ŋëët ŋøøm wala maalø, wala kööŋŋe møga mo wø kööŋö ki ge. 'Ba wär dwøl man wø caannu bëëde kare, nee maru jïëy, put bëëtö na jïëy, 'ba nee maru kweer, put bëëtö na kweer, kiper nee bäŋe ya ajäla mo ö bäätu.
english: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.

anywaa: ?Da dhaanhø dïïu mo da gïn mo leth mo opïï dëëre? Wär läme. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo yie met, wär wäre ki dudi ni pwøya Jwøk.
english: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

anywaa: ?Da dhaanhø mo tuu dïïu? Wär jaak acooŋ Jwøk cwøle, ni ö geni ni lämge bääte, ni wïïrge dëëre ki maaw ki nyeŋ Wuuö.
english: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

anywaa: 'Ba lam ŋat mo cwïnye da ŋäädhe, dëër ŋata tuu owëëk jöönnö, ni ö Wuue ni tïŋ gø maal. 'Ba ni näk eno bääyö, raaye owec.
english: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, køpu raay mou yïthakiyu keeru, ni lämu kiperu keeru, kiper nee dëëtu wø jöönge. 'Ba lam ŋat mo beer jïre da teek mo dwøŋ døc ki man tïïc jammi ni cööpge karge.
english: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

anywaa: 'Ba Ilaaja na bëëde, ena dhaanhø mo ocwääö kaamarø. 'Ba ena lämö ki cwïnye bäre nee køth ba pädhe. Ni bëët køthi ki cwiiri adäk ki dwäde abïciel ni kär pädhö bäät piny.
english: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre ena cäŋ lämö, ni ö maalli ni cïp køth, ni ö pinynyi ni ciek jape.
english: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïmera, ni näk da dhaanhø dïïu mo gaa wøk ri jöör adïëri, ni duui ya ŋat mørri kare,
english: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

anywaa: wär ŋääe ni ŋat wø duu ŋat raay kare, ni mäna gø ki jööre na raac, piema jwïëc ŋatøca ki thøø, ni raay mo thööth ogëëŋe.
english: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

anywaa: Aana Piter na näk nyïïatwiel mar Jecu Krictø, a määtha u na jø Jwøk na näk okeethø, ni wø bëëdö na wëëlle yi Pønta, ki Galeecia, ki Kapadöcia, ki Eecia, ki Bithinia,
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

anywaa: u na näk ojier Jwøki na näk Wuuö, nou ee miiø, ni cïp uuni kur keeru ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk, nou bëëdu nou leŋa luup Jecu Krictø, ni jør uuni ki remme. Met ec ki bëët-mëër pälle bäätu.
english: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

anywaa: Pwøc en jï Jwøk, eni na Wää Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø; kiper beeye ki køør met yie na dwøŋ na cäŋ ø nywøllø ni ø nyärö, ni jït cwïnynyø ki ŋäädhe mo kwøw ki køør duun Jecu Krictø wøk ki yi thøø.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

anywaa: Ni joodø olaaw mana näk ba maar ränynyö, na näk bäŋ gïr raay ree, na näk ba jøøl, na näk okanø maal kiperu,
english: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

anywaa: u na näk ogwøk Jwøki ki teege ki køør ŋäädhe, nee pïëm man piem u ki gø mana näk onø jiiŋŋø noo nyooth kanyo cuŋ pinynyi yie nee jootu.
english: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø ni wø mïn yïthu kipere, këël teeŋ gïïö ni leth yøø dou jwørø ki kany mo thiinh,
english: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

anywaa: kiper nee ŋäädhe maru na näk adïëri na pere letha eni ki warkey ni wø päänynyi ki maac këël na ŋääi ni ränynyö, nee känne ki pwøc, ka ajiem, ki wödö yi cäŋo nyooth Jecu Krictø yie.
english: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:

anywaa: 'Ba u mëër ki eni, këël na käru gø neenø, ni jïëyu ni ŋääthu eni, këël na ba neennu gø, ni mïn yïthu ki met ec mo päl døc mo ba løny ki par.
english: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

anywaa: 'Ba mana duu ŋäädhe maru jïïu, jwïëyu apiem.
english: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïkuk Jwøk moa cäänö kiper muuy mana doo tïmö na maru, gena cää ni pëëge kiper pïëm manøgø man piem jiy ki gø.
english: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

anywaa: Ni pëëge na a teeŋ dhaanhø mo nyïëdi, wala a cäŋa ŋø na cään Jwïëc Krictø na en cwïnyge kiper gø, kanya køpge gïïa leth moo jwør Krictø, ka ajiem mano joode cään.
english: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.

anywaa: 'Ba anyooth jïge, ni ge ba tïny dëëtge, 'ba ge tïnynya uuni kanya cäänge kar kanyaca, 'ba poot na luupögø na køp jøøa caan luumma nyään na met jïïu yïth nïne moi en, ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere na jääŋŋi ki maal, ni beeye gïïa many cwïny nyïïatwiet maalli nee tiet gïïögø neenge.
english: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, caarru wïthu døøc ni magu wïthu, ni ŋääthu met ec ki cwïnynyu bäre, mano jootu yi cäŋo nyooth Jecu Krictø yie.
english: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

anywaa: Bëëdu ni uuno obwöre ma dïlïŋ luup, ni ba tïmu nou caatha køør gïïa reyø na nieŋ cwïnynyu køørge kanya poode ni bäŋ gïn ŋäyu.
english: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

anywaa: 'Ba bëëdu ki bëëtö mana en kur keere ki yi bëëtö maru bäre, kaamar Jwøk na cwøl uuni ni en kur keere.
english: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö, ni «Bëëdu nou ena kur keeru, kiper a ena kur keera.»
english: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk eni na Jwøk, ni wø ŋøl luum ŋati man nø keda moa tïïe ni wø bäŋ ŋat mo jeenye, you cwølø ni Wuuö, bëëdu nou lwäär cooth kany poodu pinyi en.
english: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

anywaa: Kiper ŋäyu ni uuna wïïl wøk ki yïth uutjïëthe mou ni wø bäŋ gïn duuge jïïu na kwanynyu baŋ kwäyu, nou ba wiil ka teeŋ jap wø ränynyi, teeŋ ka gwel-bïrö wala warkey.
english: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

anywaa: 'Ba u wiil ka rem Krictø na näk pere leth, na caal rem nyidiel mo bäŋ kany mo jøøŋŋi dëëre, wala kïdö mo raac.
english: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

anywaa: Ni eno miiø kanya poode ni piny poot kär cwääö. 'Ba ena nyooth kiperu ya aŋuun nïne.
english: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

anywaa: 'Ba beeye ki køøre na tïmu nou ŋäätha Jwøk, eni na duu Krictø wøk ki yi thøø, ni mooc gø ka ajiem. Kiper manøgønø, jïëy maru ki ŋäädhe maru ena ri Jwøk.
english: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.

anywaa: 'Ba na tïme ni cwïnynyu you døøc mo tar kiper mana leŋŋu adïëri ni jït cwïnynyu ki mëëc nyïïmëëe ma adïëri, putu bëëtö nou mëër ki røgu ki cwïnynyu bäre.
english: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:

anywaa: Kiper uuna cäŋ nywøllø nou nyärö, nou ba nywöli ka ri kunh wø ränynyi, 'ba u nywöli ka ri kunh wø ba maar ränynyö, ki køør luum Jwøk na kwøw ni wø bëëdö na bäre bäre.
english: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

anywaa: Kiper «Jiy bëët caala luum, na ajiem marge caala wï luum mo oŋøøk. 'Ba luum wø tal, ni päth wïïe piny.
english: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:

anywaa: 'Ba luum Wuuö bëëdö këël na bäre bäre.» Ni luummögøøni beeye luumma nyään na met na caan jïïu.
english: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, weyu keec cwïny bäre, ki cwøk bëët, ka atade, ki gwön, ki waac nyeŋ bëët.
english: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

anywaa: Ni tïmu kaamar obwöre mo marr, nou manynya caak, ni beeye caak mana näk luum Jwøk na näk bäŋ gïn mo raac yie, nou døøŋŋu ki gø ki ri pïëm mana piem uuni ki gø,
english: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

anywaa: ni näk met yi Wuuö you belø møn.
english: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

anywaa: Ööu baŋe, eni na kïdi mo kwøw, na kwier jiyi, 'ba ki jï Jwøk ee jierø ni pere leth døc.
english: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,

anywaa: Ni tïmu nou caala kïte mo kwøw, ni uuno geerø ni uuna øt Jwøk, nou tïmu ni uuna dïlämme moa en kur keerge, nou cïpa cwïnynyu na en køør Jwøk jï Jwøk no olämme mo wø jïëc Jwøki ki køør Jecu Krictø.
english: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper ogöörö yi wëël Jwøk, ni «Neennu, aani, a kïtha yi Dhayan ki kïdi, na näk mo ojierø na pere leth na näk kïn gøøt, 'ba ŋat wø jïëy ki eni ni ŋääth gø, wïïe ba doo lääö.»
english: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.

anywaa: 'Ba ki jïïu, u no ojïëy ni ŋäädhu, pere letha jïïu. 'Ba ki jï jøø ni kär jïëy yøø, «Beeye kïnnögø ki dëëre na kwier dïgëëte, na tïmö ni beeye pïëmi mar gøøt,»
english: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

anywaa: na «Kïdi mano cwany tiet jiy, na kïnno wëëk ge päänhnhö.» Ni tietge cwanyge kaper na dhalge luubö, kaawat mana kwøŋ geni mëëŋ gø.
english: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuna jiy mo ojierø, ni nägu dïlämme mo tuuŋ kwär, na jiy mo ena kur keerge, na jic Jwøk kiree, kiper nee moa beyø na tïïc ŋata cwöl uuni wøk ki yi muudhö ni kïth uuni yi taye na beer døc, nee køpu.
english: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

anywaa: 'Ba dïkwøŋ u patha jiy mo nyeŋŋu ŋäc, 'ba kawaane uuna tïmö ni uuna jic Jwøk. Ni dïkwøŋ bäŋ køny mo you joodø, 'ba kawaane uuna jïtö ki køny.
english: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

anywaa: U na mëëra ki uuni, a kwaya uuni, kiper mana näk uuna wëëlle nou path yi pinyi en, bëëdu ni karu bäär ki gïïa reyø wø many dëëlli ni wø këëdi ki jwïëyu.
english: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

anywaa: Bëëdu ki bëëtö ma wøp dï juurre, kiper manøgønø, këël ge doo cäänö dëëtu ki gïï mo reyø ni uuna jø raay, nee tïïe moa beyø ni wø tïïyu nee neenge ni jiemge Jwøk dïcäŋo lïïmme.
english: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.

anywaa: 'Ba ki køør nyeŋ Wuuö, bëëdu nou leŋa luup jøø ni teek ocïp ceŋge yøø bëët, noo näk mo kwääy paac bäre,
english: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

anywaa: wala noo näk kwääri mo atude mo ööi ka dwøre kuna jäälge jøøa näk obääyö, ni pwøcge jø wø tïïc gïï mo beyø.
english: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

anywaa: Kiper beeye mana many Jwøki ni døøyu jøøa bäŋ wïdhi na näk bäŋ gïn mo ŋäcge mo lïŋö ki køør tïïe moa beyø ni wø tïïyu.
english: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

anywaa: Bëëdu ni uuna jiy mo opädö. 'Ba bëëtö maru ni uuno pädö, kär nou døøya gø jöö man tïïu ki raay ki gø. 'Ba bëëdu ni uuna jiy mo tïnynya Jwøk.
english: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloak of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.

anywaa: Wøørru jiy bëët. Ni mëërru ki nyïïmëëe. Lwäärru Jwøk. Ni wøørru nyeya mana dwøŋ.
english: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.

anywaa: 'Ba u na laaŋe, leŋŋu luup kwääri mou nou lwäär, ni manøgø ba tïïyu jï jø wø mwöl keerge na cwïnyge bäth, 'ba këël jø wø wïnni thuwø.
english: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

anywaa: Kiper met yi Jwøk wø ena bäät ŋat wø jïëny gïï mo leth kiper mana lääŋ Jwøk, këël na bäŋe gïn mo ee baaø.
english: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
