anywaa: ?'Ba agïnaŋø noo pwøc uuni kipere, ni näk mo uuno bääyö ni pwöt u kipere, këël na bëëdu ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny? 'Ba ni näk mou tïïya gïn mo beer ni jwørru gïï mo leth kipere ni cwïnynyu you cïp piny, pwøc Jwøk ena bäätu.
english: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïnögø na cwøl uuni kipere, kiper Krictø thuwø gïï mo leth ajwøre kiperu, ni nyuth uuni jöö, nee jööre caathu.
english: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

anywaa: 'Ba eni bäŋ raay mo ee tïïö, ni bäŋ cwøk mo owïnynyö dhee.
english: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

anywaa: 'Ba kanya janynyi bäŋ ajaany mo ee dwøgø. 'Ba kanya jwør gïï mo leth, eni kär ŋwöö. 'Ba mare awëëk ŋat wø ŋøl luup na karge.
english: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

anywaa: 'Ba eni ki dëëre raay 'moø akääre ki rïŋ dëëre bäät jaath nee ø ba bëënnø raay, 'ba nee ø bëënnø moa beyø. Ni beeye ŋwiili moe na wëëk dëëtø jöönnö.
english: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.

anywaa: Kiper uuna kwøŋ bëëdö kaamar rööm mo orwäänyö, 'ba kawaane uuna duu baŋ Dïkwääy na näk Dïkuri mar jwïëyu.
english: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, u na mään, leŋŋu luup cwøw mou, kiper këël na bëët møøki ni luum Jwøk ba leŋge, nee ge jïëcge ki køør bëët määrge na beer ni bäŋ luubö mo caange,
english: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

anywaa: kiper mana neenge bëëtö maru ni beer nou lwäär.
english: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.

anywaa: 'Ba wøp maru kär näk wøp dwøc wïc, ki käär warkey, ki røc abïïe, gïï wø en wøk dëër dhaanhø.
english: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

anywaa: 'Ba wøp maru wär tïme na mööl ki lïŋŋö ni en cwïnynyu ni wø ba ränynyi, ni beege ni mïërö ki waŋ Jwøk.
english: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.

anywaa: Kiper ya acääŋŋe määra en kur keerge na wara ŋääth Jwøk, dëëtge atïïcge ni mïërö na enøgønø, ni leŋge luup cwøwge,
english: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

anywaa: kaamar Ceera na lwäär Eeberam ni cwøl gø ni kwäärö. 'Ba kawaane uuna nyïïe, ni näk mou tïïya gïn mo beer, ni bäŋ gïn lwäärru mou bwøk ki gø.
english: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgøøni, u na cwøw, bëëdu ki määru nou cädu kiperge, ni wøørru geni kiper geno cwääö ni jägö, kiper mana tïme ni kwøw mana cïp Jwøki ki met ec omëëk u riet, nee bäŋe gïn gëëŋ lam maru.
english: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

anywaa: 'Ba luubö mana dööŋ keere nø, uuni bëët, beerra man dwallu cwïnynyu na aciel, ni bëëdu ni cwïnynyu jööt, ni mëërru ki nyïïmëëe, ni cwïnynyu lïëth ki køny, nou bëëdö nou mwöl.
english: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

anywaa: Kär nou dwøga raay jï ŋato tïïc raay dëëtu, wala ajaany jï ŋato jany uuni, 'ba mana dou tïïö, u doo gwïëtha eni. Ni beeye gïnögøøni na cwøl uuni kipere, nou gwïëth.
english: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

anywaa: 'Ba «Ŋat wø mëër ki kwøw ni manynya man neen cääŋŋe moa beyø, wär leebe gwøe ki raay, ni män dhee ki luup cwøk.
english: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

anywaa: Kare wär tïïe ni bäär ki raay, ni tïïc gïn wø beer, ni many bëët-mëër ni caath køør gø døøc.
english: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

anywaa: Kiper nyeŋ Wuuö ena bäät jø wø beyø, ni ïthe ee ciiø ki lamge. 'Ba täärnyïm Wuuö cøl ka jø wø tïïc raay.»
english: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.

anywaa: ?'Ba kawaane aŋa noo tïmmi ki gïn mo raac dëëtu, ni näk mo cwïnynyu you cïp køør gïn mo beer?
english: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?

anywaa: 'Ba këël gïï mo leth dou jwørø kiper moa beyø, uuno gwïëdhö. Käru lwäyö ki geni, ni ba wëëgu cwïnynyu ränynyö.
english: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

anywaa: 'Ba wøørru Krictø ki cwïnynyu, ni beeye Kwäärö. 'Ba cooth bëëdu ni dëëtu you jiiø ki man dwøgu luubö jï ŋat wäro pëëny uuni kiper ŋäädhe manø ni en cwïnynyu enø. 'Ba wär dwøgu jïre nou mwöl ni you wøørø.
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

anywaa: Weyu cwïnynyu ni leer, kiper kany wø jany uuni, nee jø wø jany bëëtö maru na beer ki ri Krictø, nee wïthge lääge.
english: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.

anywaa: Kiper doo beerra eni ki man jwør gïï mo leth kiper tïïc mo beer ni näk mo beeye mana many Jwøki, ni kaala man jwør gïï mo leth kiper tïïc mo raac.
english: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

anywaa: Kiper Krictø thuwø athøw kiper raay yie aciel na bäre bäre, ŋata beer na thuunh jøøa reyø, kiper nee ø kïth baŋ Jwøk, ki køør mana 'näk dëëre ni cäŋi wëëk kwøw ki ri jwïëy.
english: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

anywaa: Ni beeye kanya aae na pwöny jwïëy moa en kar tööc,
english: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

anywaa: jøøa dhal luubö dïkwøŋ kanya bëët Jwøki ni cwïnye ee cïp piny ni kurö yïth nïr Nöa, kanya tïïc jääy, jääna piem jøøa nøk keerge na näk abära ki thøw pïï.
english: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

anywaa: 'Ba lwøk na nyuudhi ni caal gïnögø, piema uuni kawaane, ni paa kiper man wø käl cïlö wøk dëël, 'ba beeye kwac nyïm Jwøk ki cwïny mo leer, ki køør duun Jecu Krictø wøk ki yi thøø,
english: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:

anywaa: ŋata aa maal, ni en bäät cwïï Jwøk, ni bëët nyïïatwiet maal, ki kwääri, ki teek bäre ni ge leŋa dwøre.
english: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, na tïme ni Krictø gïï mo leth ee nø jwør ki rïŋ dëëre, jegu dëëtu ni caarru wïthu na enønø thuwø. Kiper ŋat mo da gïï mo leth lääŋŋe këët,
english: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;

anywaa: kiper nee nïre moa no odööŋ moo beede piny, nee ba beede këët ni cwïnye onieŋ køør gïïa reyø ni wø many dhaanhe, 'ba nee bëën moa many Jwøki.
english: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.

anywaa: Wär yïthu thumge nø ki nïra pöödhö na wara tïïyu gïï wø met yïth juurre ki ge ni wø tïïcge, keda man bëëtge ni geno nieŋ dëët gïï mo patha karge, ni cwïnyge ena køør raay, ki maath, ki wïïrö kwör kwøŋ, ki meeye, ki wøør juu møøk na reyø døc.
english: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

anywaa: 'Ba yïthge othäŋŋö kawaane kiper mana ba dwätu ki geni këët ri gïïa reyø ni wø rïïŋge køørge, ni tïmge ni ge janynya uuni.
english: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

anywaa: 'Ba marge opëëny ŋata näk ree ee jiiø ki man ŋøl luup jøøa kwøw ki moa no othøw.
english: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

anywaa: Ni beeye tiere na køp luumma nyään na met këël jï jøøa näk othøw, kiper manøgønø, këël na ŋøl luumge piny ni gena jiy kaawat man wø ŋøl luup jiy piny, nee ge maar wëënnö ki jöö man kwøwge ki ri jwïëy kaawat man kwøw Jwøki en na jwïëy.
english: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba aŋuun jammi bëët kare acäännö. Bëëdu ni wïthu leer, ni koorru dëëtu ni lämu.
english: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

anywaa: 'Ba dï japøgø bëët, ŋäyu mëër man mëërru ki røgu cooth, kiper mëër beeye wø gëëŋ raay mo thööth.
english: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

anywaa: Bëëdu nou pänhnha røgu ni bäŋ jøømø.
english: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

anywaa: Kaawat man bëëde ni ŋati man nø ojïtö ki muuy en, røgu wär køønynyu ki ge, ni uuna jø tïïc mo beyø, mo teeŋ gïï met ec mo thööth mo Jwøk owëëk uuni.
english: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.

anywaa: 'Ba noo näk da ŋat mo cäänö, wär cääne ni ena dhaanhø mo køpa luup Jwøk. Ni ŋat wäro tïny jø møøk wär tïïe ni ena dhaanhø mo tïïö ka teek man wø cïp Jwøki, kiper nee Jwøk jiem ki yïth jammi bëët ki køør Jecu Krictø. 'Ba ajiem ki rööny en jïre, këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Omëëya, kär yïthu thäŋŋö ki gïïo ni leth ni caal maac ni wø tägi dëëtu ni päänynya uuni, ni keda gïn mo nyään mo täga dëëtu.
english: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

anywaa: 'Ba yïthu mïnge kaawat man bëëdu nou nywaaga gïïa leth na jwør Krictø, kiper nee yïthu mïnge ni ŋeethu kanyo nyooth ajiem mare.
english: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo u di caannø kiper nyeŋ Krictø, uuno gwïëdhö, kiper Jwïëy ajiem na näk mar Jwøk bëëdö bäätu.
english: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

anywaa: 'Ba kär dee dhaanhø mo jwør gïï mo leth kiper mana näk mo ena dïnääy, wala ena kuu, wala ŋat mo tïïya teeŋ raay møga, wala ŋat wø kïth ree yi luum dhaanhø mør.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo jwør gïï mo leth kiper mana näk ena dhaanh Krictø, kär wïïe lääö. 'Ba Jwøk wär jieme ki køør nyeŋŋøgø.
english: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

anywaa: Kiper nïr løøk anø öö, ni tägi ka jø Jwøk. ?'Ba ni näk mo tägi ka øøni, a cuŋ mar jø wø ba leŋ luum Jwøk na nyään na met obëëde nidïï?
english: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

anywaa: 'Ba «?Ni näk mo teek jï ŋat mo mare beer ki man piemi, a ŋat raay ki ŋat wø tïïc gïï mo reyø oenge kaa?»
english: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, wär jø wø jwør gïï mo leth keda mana many Jwøki, tïïcge gïï mo beyø, ni cïpge jwïëcge cer Jwøk na näk Cwääy na dwøre ba dak.
english: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, a köömma jaak acooŋ Jwøk ni en dïïu, ni näga jaa thuwø, na ŋata neen gïïa leth na jwør Krictø, naa nywaaga ajiem mano nyooth.
english: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

anywaa: Gwøgu pïïth mar Jwøk ni en ceŋŋu, ni paa ni uuno maa ki teek, 'ba tïïyu ka met ec kaawat man wø many Jwøki; ni paa kiper nou jïtu ki jammi ree, 'ba beeye kiper mana cïbu cwïnynyu køøre bäre.
english: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

anywaa: Ni ba tïmu ni uuna kwääri bäät jøø ni en ceŋŋu yøø, 'ba bëëdu ni uuna jiy ma wøpe nee bëëtö maru ŋwaal pïïthi.
english: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

anywaa: 'Ba kanyo nyooth Kwääy dïkwääye, uuno jïti ka adun ajiem man wø ba jøøl.
english: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

anywaa: 'Ba u ni therø thuwø, leŋŋu luup jaak acooŋ Jwøk. Bëëdu nou mwöl ki røgu keeru karubëët, kiper Jwøk män ka jø atöör, 'ba met ec wø wëëge jøøa mwöl.
english: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, døøyu dëëtu mo mwöl nou ena cer Jwøk na teek, kiper nee u røønye kanya näk kare.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:

anywaa: Cïbu gïï wø pär cwïnynyu ki geni cere, kiper eni lääŋŋa uuni.
english: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

anywaa: Koorru dëëtu, ni bëëdu ni nyeŋŋu you jabø. Kiper nyimän maru na näk anägö wïïrö ni caala ŋuu mo jwöŋö, ni eni caya ŋat mo løønye.
english: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:

anywaa: Cuŋŋu karu ni kwierru eni, ni putu dëëtu mak ri ŋäädhe maru, ni ŋäyu gø ni nyïïmëëgu poot jwøra gïïö ni leth yøøgø yi piny bäre.
english: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

anywaa: 'Ba køøre, nou nø jwørru gïïö ni leth yøø ki kany mo thiinh, Jwøa näk Jwø met ec bäre, ŋata cwøl uuni ya ajieme mana näk bäŋ cuŋŋe ki ri Krictø, oööi ki dëëre ni dwøk u karu, ni wëëk u tëënnö, ni këël tietu piny.
english: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

anywaa: 'Ba teek oen jïre këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Cilbana na cöögö mo yaa ŋäädhö ni cïba wëëlli ni ciek na gööra baŋu en cere, naa köömma uuni naa køpa gø jïïu, ni man beeye met yi Jwøk na näk adïëri. Bëëdu nou teek ri gø.
english: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.

anywaa: Uuna määth acooŋ Babiløn, jøøa näk ojierø thuwø. Ni uuna määth wääda ma Maak thuwø.
english: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Mark my son.

anywaa: Määthu røgu ki nuum dhøk mar mëër. Bëët-mëër en jïïu bëët, u ni en dëër Krictø.
english: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

anywaa: Aana Cayman Piter na laŋŋø na nyïïatwiel Jecu Krictø, a määtha uuni, u na wëëk ŋäädhe mo röömi ki marwa ki ri beeny Jwøk marø, ge ki Pïëmi ma Jecu Krictø.
english: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

anywaa: Met ec ki bëët-mëër bëëde ni päl bäätu ki man ŋäyu Jwøk døøc, ki Jecu na näk Kwääyø.
english: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

anywaa: 'Ba teege na näk teek Jwøk, jap kwøw bëët ki jap bëët jöör Jwøk awëëk øøni ki køør mana ŋääø eni, ŋata cwøl øøni ya ajieme ki beenynye.
english: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

anywaa: Ni beeye ki køør gïïögø, na wëëk ø jape na døøŋŋø na perge leth na buue, kiper nou bøthu ki ränynyö ni en piny ni wø ööi ki køør gïïa reyø ni wø nieŋ cwïnynyi køørge, nou tïmu nou nywaaga bëët Jwøk.
english: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, magu dëëtu ki man kuurru ŋäädhe maru ki bëëtö ma wøp,
english: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

anywaa: ni kuurru bëëtö ma wøp ki ŋäc luup, ni kuurru ŋäc luup ki bëëtö kar ni teek, ni kuurru bëëtö kar ni teek ki män røk ki raay, ni kuurru män røk ki raay ki bëët jöör Jwøk,
english: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

anywaa: ni kuurru bëët jöör Jwøk ki mëëc nyïïmëëe, ni kuurru mëëc nyïïmëëe ki mëër.
english: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk gïïögø mou, ni cwïnynyu päŋ ki ge, ge tïïya uuni nou ba jägö nou patha jiy mo bäŋ gïn mo ege duuö, nou ŋäya Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø jïre bäŋ gïïögø, ena cwør, ni neeta gïï mo kwörge cärö, ni wïïe owïl ki lwøk raay moe moa dïkwøŋ.
english: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, nyïïmera, putu cwïnynyu cïp ri cwödö mana cwøl uuni ki gø ki mana jier u, nee tïme na adïëri. Kiper ni näk gïnögø tïïyu tïïö, u ba maar pädhö.
english: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

anywaa: 'Ba uuno wëëk jöö mo päl man dønynyu yi buya näk bäŋ cuŋŋe mar Kwääyø na näk Pïëmi ma Jecu Krictø.
english: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, yia met ki man para wïthu cooth ki gïïögø, këël na ŋäyu geni, nou cuŋŋu nou teek ra adïëri na ŋäyu.
english: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.

anywaa: 'Ba yaa caarø ni beer jïra kany pooda naa poot kwøw ki dëël man en, ki man jiia uuni naa para wïthu,
english: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

anywaa: kiper mana ŋääa gø ni kar käl dëël man en kare cään, keda mana nyoothi ya Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø jïra.
english: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

anywaa: 'Ba manøgø, aano tïïö bääte døc, kiper kanyo tïme na køør thøø mara, nee maar lønyø jïïu ki man cäŋu wïthu parrø ki gïïögø kany wäro manynyu.
english: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

anywaa: Kiper kanya køpwa gïr teek Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø ki öönynye, wa ba caath køør waac mo waac ka riek waŋ, 'ba waana lïŋŋe ma ajiem mare ewa neenø ki nyeŋwa.
english: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

anywaa: Kiper kanya ö eni na wëëgi wøør ka ajiem mana käl baŋ Jwøk na näk Wuuö, kanya ö dwøra öö ki baŋ Kwääy ajiem na bäŋ teeŋe na caan gïn kipere, ni «Man beeye Wääda, ŋata mëëra ki gø, na met yia ki mare,»
english: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

anywaa: dwørøgø awïnywa na ööe ki maal, kiper wa ena buute kaace bäät kïnna en kur keere.
english: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

anywaa: 'Ba luumma kwøŋ nyïïkuk Jwøki køp, ajootwa na adïëri møn. Doo beerra eni jïïu ki man cegu ïthu døøc ki gøøni keda lamba mo liella yi muudhö, gøøc mano ö tiet øwi noo kwääre ni päny cëëy amöölla yïth cwïnynyu.
english: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man kwøŋu gïn ŋäc, ni bäŋ gïn mo okøp nyïïkuk Jwøki yi wëël Jwøk na gïn mo køpa dhaanhe ki wïïe keere.
english: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

anywaa: Kiper bäŋ gïn mo okøp nyïïkuk Jwøki bäre bäre, mo käla dhi dhaanhø, 'ba ge wø køpa moa käl dhi Jwøk, kanya ö Jwïëc Jwøki na käär geni.
english: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.

anywaa: 'Ba da nyïïkuk Jwøk mo patha adïëri thuwø mo røkge ege thïïŋö dï jiy, kaawat mano ö dïpööye mo patha adïëri noo thïïŋge rege dïïu, jøw okäl teeŋ pwöc ränynyö baŋu ki jöö mør. Këël Kwäärö ma Jecu okwierge, ŋata ŋeew geni, ni ge käla ränynyö mo laara ö bäätge.
english: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy mo thööth oluk køør bëëtö marge na näk patha karge, ni ö jöör adïëri ni janynyi kiperge.
english: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mano wärge ki uuni, uuno møøthge ki luup atade. 'Ba ajäla marge nutö cøøn ni ena dëëtge, ni ränynyö marge patha okääŋö.
english: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

anywaa: Kiper nyïïatwiet maal kär wec Jwøki kanya bääcge, 'ba gena leeŋ kar pöödö, ni kïth ge yïth buri mo cøl døc, nee bëëtge yïthge këël mano ŋøl luup moge piny.
english: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

anywaa: Ni jøøa cääŋŋe na bëëdö bäät piny kär wec Jwøki, 'ba Jwøk gwøga Nöa ki jiy abïriiø møøk, ni beeye Nöa na bëëdö ni køpa luup moa thïŋŋö, kanya käl jwïïö piny bäät jø raay.
english: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

anywaa: Ni døøc pääny Cødam ki pääny Gømöra bur, ni dïïr wïthge bëët, ni tïïya ge na nyuudhi jï jø raay.
english: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

anywaa: Ni piem Løøt, ŋata beer na näk cwïnye oränynyö døc ki gïïa näk patha karge na rïïŋ jø raayi køørge.
english: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

anywaa: Kiper ŋatøgø na beer enø cwïnye na leer wø ränynyö cooth ki gïïa näk patha karge na wara tïïcge, ni wø neete ni wø wïnynye.
english: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk eni na Wuuö gïïögø ee tïïö bëët, ŋääe ki man piem jø wø wøør Jwøk ki gïï wø pääny geni, ni maa jøøa reyø kar pöödö këël dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie.
english: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

anywaa: Ni kadha jø wø rïïŋi køør gïïa reyø ni wø nieŋ cwïnynyi køørge røk, ni wø taak teek Jwøk. 'Ba kiper na bäŋe gïn mo wøørge ni cwïnyge teek, ge ba lwäär ki man janyge moa jïge da ajiem maalø.
english: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

anywaa: 'Ba këël nyïïatwiet maal na døøŋŋø ge ki geni na teeka ge døc, jøøgø bäŋ wø jäälge ki dhøgi mo reyø nyïm Wuuö.
english: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

anywaa: 'Ba geni na caal lääy na bøøre, gïïa näk ocwääö ni wø caath køør gïï wø ŋäcge ki cwïnyge, na nywöli kiper nee maaŋŋi ni nääŋŋi, ge buua gïï mo kucge, 'ba geno ränynyi ki geni ciel kanyo raany geni,
english: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

anywaa: ni jïtge ki gïn mo raac na kwör gïïa reyø na tïïcge. 'Ba yïthge met ki wïïrö jaak kwör kwääk ki nyeŋ cääŋŋe. Ni ge caala kït mo reyø ki gïï mo di jøøŋŋø, ni yïthge met ka atade moge, kany wø cämge ni mäthge ki caapge na thööth ki uuni na aciel.
english: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

anywaa: Ni nyeŋge ena køør käp, ni raay ba maarge wec. Ni ge maaŋŋa wïth jøøa cwïnyge cwøk. Ni cwïnyge ege pwönynyö ki wärö. Ni gena jiy mo ocienø.
english: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

anywaa: Jöö mana thïïŋ akwierge ni tïmge ni ge wïïrö, ni ge caatha jöör Beelam o Beeyör, ŋata yie met ki joot jammi ki køør tïïc raay.
english: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

anywaa: 'Ba ena jook kiper gïna raac na tïïe, na tïm arëënni na näk ba luubö ni cäänö kaamar dhaanhø, ni mäna nyikuŋ Jwøk manøgø ki mana dee tïïö ki bøølle.
english: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø caala jøør mo bäŋ pïï yïthge, ni ge caala rwöc mo käära apøyaweerø. 'Ba kany mo cøl døc ojiiŋŋø kiperge.
english: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba dhøkge päŋ ka atöör jammi mo oballe jaak, ni ge maaŋŋa wïth jøøa bøth kany mo cään en, ceŋ jøøa en yïth raay, ki gïïa reyø ni wø many dëër dhaanhe.
english: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

anywaa: Ni wø køpge købø jïge, ni «Uuno bëëdö ki wïthu,» 'ba ge ki dëëtge gena laak gïïa reyø. Kiper gïn wø bööt dhaanhø, eni tïmö na laŋ gïnöca.
english: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk wïthge ocäŋ maaŋŋø ni bööt geni, køør mana bøthge ki japa doo raany geni piny, ki køør ŋäc mana ŋäcge Kwääyø na näk Pïëmi ma Jecu Krictø, bëëtö mana en cään atïmö ni raaca eni døc ki bëëtö mana dïkwøŋ.
english: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

anywaa: Kiper doo naa beerra eni ki mana ba dege jöör adïëri kwanyø ki man cäŋge døø ŋäthge ni wecge ciik mana en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk na käl baŋge.
english: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

anywaa: 'Ba gïnögø atägö dëëtge keda man wø ŋaadi na adïëri, ni «Gwök wø cäŋa døø baŋ ŋwøge, no othur wø lööŋŋa jaak, ni cäŋa døø yo onøt.»
english: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

anywaa: 'Ba omëëya, kawaane man en beeye riet weeli man gööra baŋu. 'Ba weetøgø karge riet, a tuga cwïnynyu na leer ki ge, kiper mana para wïthu,
english: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

anywaa: kiper nou bëëdu nou lääŋŋa luup moa køp nyïïkuk Jwøki na en kur keerge ni tägö, ki ciik Kwäärö ma Jecu na näk Pïëmi na wïnynyu baŋ nyïïatwietu.
english: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

anywaa: 'Ba beerra man kwøŋu gïn ŋäc, ni kanyo tïme na aŋuun nïne, jø abuua oööi ni ge buuö, ni ge caatha køør gïïa reyø ni wø many cwïnyge,
english: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

anywaa: ni köge, na «?Age öönynye na buuk, ni öö? Kiper ki mana thøw kwäcwa ca, jammi bëët poot cäätha nyïm keda mana bëëtge ki kanya cak piny.»
english: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

anywaa: Ni ge tïïya wïthge no owïl ki gïn en, ni maal nutö cøøn ki køør dwør Jwøk, ni piny käl wøk ka yïth pïï, ni bëëdö dï pïï.
english: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

anywaa: Ni beege pïïögø na ö pinynyi na mayi ya jwïïö ni ränynye.
english: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

anywaa: Ni poot na dwørøgø, ni piny ki maal ni nut ii, ge bëëdö ni ge bëënna maac, ni geno wiiø këël dïcäŋo ŋøl luup yie, cäŋ mano raany jø wø ba wøør Jwøk.
english: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

anywaa: 'Ba u no omëëya, kär wïthu wïl ki gïn na aciel en, ki jï Wuuö dïcäŋ aciel keda cwiiri ma kuma, ni cwiiri ma kuma keda dïcäŋ aciel.
english: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

anywaa: Kiper Wuuö ba dwiil ki mana buue, keda man wø caan jø møøki ni dwiil, 'ba eni poot koora uuni ni cwïnye ee cïp piny, ni bäŋ ŋat manynye nee ränynye, 'ba eni manynya jiy bëët nee thumge ri løk cwïny.
english: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

anywaa: 'Ba Cäŋ Kwäärö oööi ni caala kuu, 'ba kanyøca maal oränynyi ni lwöre ki lwör mo päl døc, ni ö jap maalli ni raanynyi ya maaci, ni ö pinynyi ki japa en yie bëët ni waaŋ ge.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

anywaa: ?'Ba kiper mana tïme ni japøgø bëët di raanynyø na enønø, uuno tïmu na teeŋ jiy mo nyïëdi nø? U doo bëëdö ki bëëtö mana en kur keere ki ŋäc bëët jöör Jwøk,
english: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

anywaa: kany poodu nou koora cäŋo ö Jwøki yie, nou tïïya gø nee lääde, ni beeye kanyo ö maalli noo nyebi ni ränynye, no ö jammi noo leenyi ya maaci.
english: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

anywaa: 'Ba ø koora maal mana nyään ki piny mana nyään keda mana buuk gø, kanya näk kar bëët bëënynyö.
english: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, omëëya, na tïme nou koora gïïögø, putu manynyø ki cwïnynyu bäre nou nwäne ki bëëtmëër ni bäŋ kïdö mo raac wala gïn mo jøøŋŋi dëëtu.
english: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

anywaa: Ni ŋäyu gøøni ni koor mar Kwääyø ni bëëdö ni cwïnye ee cïp piny beeye kiper nee ø piem. Ni beeye mana göör cöögø ma Pøøl na näk omëëyø jïïu, ki køør leec wïc mana wëëk eni,
english: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;

anywaa: kanya cääne kiper luummögø, keda man wø caane yïth weeli moe bëët. 'Ba da luup møøk dïge mo teek ki man kwanyi, gïï wø wiir jø wø bäŋ gïn ŋäcge ki moa cwïnyge cwøk, ni ge raanynya dëëtge, keda man wø bëëtge ni ge wiira luup weet Jwøk møga.
english: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, omëëya, na tïme ni gïn ŋäyu kany poode en, gwøgu røgu, kiper nee wïthu ba maaŋ cwøk jø wø bääö, ni tïmu nou dääŋö.
english: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

anywaa: 'Ba cääthu nyïm nou ŋäya met ec ki ŋäc man ŋäyu Kwääyø na näk Pïëmi ma Jecu Krictø. 'Ba ajiem en jïre en nø, këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

anywaa: 'Ba luummi ni göörwa baŋu en, wa gööra luum kwøw, na nut cøøn wïlöölö, na wïnywa, ni neenwa gø ki nyeŋwa, ni neetwa gø, ni mulwa gø ki ceŋwa.
english: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

anywaa: 'Ba kwøw manøgø anyooth, ni neenwa gø, ni wa wø køpa gïre, ni beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe na køpwa jïïu ennø, kwøwa nut ki Wuuö na nyooth jïwa.
english: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

anywaa: 'Ba gïna neenwa na wïnywa, wa køpa gø jïïu thuwø, kiper nou dwätu ki waani na aciel. 'Ba dwätö marwa, wa dwäti ka Wuuö ki Wääde ma Jecu Krictø.
english: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Ni luupi ii göörwa kaper nee met cwïny marwa thur kare.
english: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

anywaa: 'Ba man en beeye dwøl mana wïnywa baŋe ni køpwa jïïu en, ni Jwøk beeye tar, ni bäŋ kany mo cøl cwïnye bäre bäre.
english: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

anywaa: Ni näk mo ø köö ni øøno dwätö ki eni, ni ø poot cäädhö yi muudhö, ø caana tööt, ni ø ba bëëdö ka bëëtö mana en ra adïëri.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø cäädha yi tar, kaawat mare ni en yi tar, øøno dwätö karøbëët, ni rem Jecu na näk Wääde penya øøni yïth raay bëët.
english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø köö ni bäŋ raay dëëtø, ø cøøga røgø, na adïëri ba en cwïnynyø.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø bëëdö ni ø køpa raay moø, mare beer ni dwøre ba dak. Eni raay 'moø owiie, ni peny øøni yïth gïïa ba beyø bëët.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø köö ni ø kär bääyö, ø døøya eni twöt, ni luumme ba en cwïnynyø.
english: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

anywaa: Nyïïa, u ni therø, a gööra luubö man baŋu kiper nou ba bääyu. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo bääyö, jïïø da ŋat mo ena kurø buut Wuuö, ni beeye Jecu Krictø na beer.
english: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:

anywaa: Ni beeye eni no olämi kiper raay moø, 'ba patha per raay 'moø keerø, 'ba beeye kiper raay mo jø piny bäre.
english: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

anywaa: Ni näk luup moa cem Jwøki yøø gwøø, beeye noo ŋääø gø ni eni ŋääø.
english: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø köö, ni «Eni ŋääa,» ni bëëdö ni dhala gïïa ceme, ena dïtwöt, na adïëri ba en cwïnye.
english: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø gwøk luumme, ŋatøca mëëc Jwøk othur kare cwïnye na adïëri. Ni beeye gïnögø noo ŋääø gø ni ø ena dëëre.
english: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø köö ni eni bëëdö ree doo cäädhö ki jööra cääth Jecu ki yie.
english: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

anywaa: Omëëya, a ba göör dwøl mo nyään baŋu, 'ba beeye dwøl mana näk oruuö cøøn na en jïïu. Ni dwøl manøgø no oruuö enø beeye luumma wïnynyu.
english: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.

anywaa: 'Ba u poot göönna göönnö ki dwøl mo nyään, ni luummögø athur kare ki ri Jecu, ni beeye ni tïïyu enø, kiper muudhö aay en, ni tar mana näk adïëri oløny ni rïënyö.
english: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø köö ni eni ena yi tar, ni män ki coki, eni poot ena yi muudhö.
english: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø mëër ki coki bëëdö yi tar, ni yie bäŋ gïn mo wëëk dhaanhø bääyö.
english: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø män ki coki ena yi muudhö ni cäädha yi muudhö, ni kany wø ci yie kuue, kiper nyeŋŋe na cøøri ya muudhe.
english: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.

anywaa: A göönna baŋu, u ni therø, kiper raay mou awec ki køør nyeŋŋe.
english: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

anywaa: Naa göönna baŋu, u na wëëe, kiper na ŋäyu eni na nut cøøn. Naa göönna baŋu, u na wøpe, kiper na böötu ŋata raac. Naa göönna baŋu, u no obwöre, kiper na ŋäyu Wuuö.
english: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.

anywaa: Naa göönna baŋu, u na wëëe, kiper na ŋäyu eni na nut cøøn. Naa göönna baŋu, u na wøpe, kiper na teegu, ni luum Jwøk wø bëëdö cwïnynyu, ni böötu ŋata raac.
english: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.

anywaa: Käru mëër ki piny wala japi ni en yi pinyi en. Ni näk da ŋat mo mëër ki piny, mëër man wø mëërö ki Wuuö ba en cwïnye.
english: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

anywaa: Kiper jammi bëët mo en piny ii, teeŋ ka gïï wø par dëëlli, ki mo wø par nyeŋŋi, ki ŋääth jap piny, gïïögø patha mo Wuuö, 'ba gena mo piny.
english: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

anywaa: 'Ba piny aay ki gïïe ni wø paaye. 'Ba ŋat wø tïïc mana many Jwøki wø bëëdö këël na bäre bäre.
english: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.

anywaa: Obwöre, man a aŋuun caa. 'Ba keda mana wïnynyu gø ni nyimän Krictø öö, kawaane jiy mo thööth mo män ki Krictø aöö. Kiper manøgønø, ŋääø nø, ni man beeye aŋuun caa.
english: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

anywaa: Gena aay dïïø, 'ba ge ba en dëëtø cøøn. Onää ge ena dëëtø, ge doo puta bëëtö ki øøni. 'Ba gena aay dïïø, kiper nee ge ŋäc ni ge ba en dïïø cøøn.
english: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, uuna jør ŋata en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk ki maaw, ni jammi bëët ŋäyu.
english: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

anywaa: A ba göön baŋu ni per na adïëri kuyu, 'ba beeye kiper mana ŋäyu gø, ni ŋäyu ni bäŋ tööt ra adïëri.
english: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

anywaa: ?Aŋa na dïtwöt? Dïtwöt beeye ŋat wø kweer ni Jecu patha Krictø. Ŋatøgø beeye na nyimän Krictø, ŋat wø kweer ki Wuuö ki Wäädö.
english: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

anywaa: Ŋat wø kweer ki Wäädö tøør ri Wuuö. 'Ba ŋat wø jïëc Wäädö, ena ri Wuuö thuwø.
english: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.

anywaa: Wëëgu gïna wïnynyu cøøn bëëtö cwïnynyu. Ni näk gïna wïnynyu cøøn bëëdö cwïnynyu møn, uuno put bëëtö dëër Wäädö ki Wuuö.
english: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna buue jïïø beeye kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.

anywaa: A gööra luubö man baŋu kiper jøøa doo cøøk uuni.
english: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

anywaa: 'Ba uuni, jør maaw mana jootu baŋe ena cwïnynyu, ni bäŋe ŋat mo manynyu nou pwönynye, kiper jør maaw mare beeye wø pwöny uuni ki jammi bëët, ni beeye adïëri, ni patha tööt. 'Ba bëëdu ri Krictø, keda mana pwöny uuni.
english: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane, u ni therø, bëëdu ree, kiper kanyo ööe nee cwïnynyø dee ŋäädhe, ni ba kwalø dëëtø ki eni ni wïthø olää ki öönynye.
english: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

anywaa: Ni näk ŋäyu ni mare beer, dou ŋääö ni jiy bëët mo wø tïïc gïno beer, nywøla eni.
english: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.

anywaa: Neennu a mëër mo nyïëdi na wëëk Wuue øøni, ki man cwøl øøni ni øøna nyïï Jwøk, ni näk adïëri. 'Ba gïn wø ö pinynyi wø kuc øøni, beeye kiper mana kuc eni.
english: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.

anywaa: Omëëya, øøna nyïï Jwøk ennø. 'Ba kïdö mano bëëdø ki gø poot ba nëëni. 'Ba ŋääø ni kanyo ööe ø tïmö kaamare. Kiper eno neenø keda man wø bëëde.
english: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy bëët mo wø ŋääth eni na enønø, dëëtge wø døøcge mo ciil ki raay, kaawat mare na ciil.
english: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø bääö wø dhala ciik Jwøk. Kiper bääyö beeye dhal ciik Jwøk.
english: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋäyu ni ena ö kuna wëën raay. Ni eni bäŋ raay dëëre.
english: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo bëëdö dëëre ni bëëdö ni bääö. 'Ba ŋat wø bëëdö ni bääö, Krictø poot käre joodø wala ki man ŋäc gø.
english: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.

anywaa: U ni therø, kär dee ŋat cøøk uuni. Ŋat wø tïïc gïn mo beer, eni beer keda mar Krictø na beer.
english: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø bëëdö ni bääö, ena mar anägö, kiper anägö wø bëëdö ni bääö ki kanya täk pinynyi. Ni beeye na ö O Jwøki nee tïïe mo anägö raanynye.
english: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

anywaa: Ni bäŋe ŋat mo onywøl Jwøki mo bëëdö ni bääö, kiper bëët Jwøk ena cwïnye, ni eni ba maar bëëdö ni bääö kiper mana nywøli ya Jwøki.
english: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø noo joot jø wø näk nyïï Jwøk ki jø wø näk nyïï anägö. 'Ba ŋat wø ba tïïc gïn mo beer, ki ŋat wø ba mëër ki coki, eni patha mar Jwøk.
english: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.

anywaa: 'Ba man beeye dwøra wïnynyu cøøn, ni ø doo mëër ki røgø,
english: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

anywaa: ni ba tïmø kaamar Keen, eni na dhaanh ŋata raac na 'näk coki. ?Aperŋø na 'näk gø? Nääe kaper tïïe moe na reyø, ni ö mo coki ni becge.
english: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

anywaa: Kär yïthu thäŋŋö, nyïïmera, kiper mana män pinynyi ki uuni.
english: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

anywaa: Ŋääø ni øøna pööth wøk ki yi thøø ni cøø yi kwøw, kiper mana mëërø ki nyïïmëëe. 'Ba ŋat wø ba mëër, poot ena yi thøø.
english: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.

anywaa: Ŋat wø män ki coki, ena dïnääy, ni ŋäyu ni bäŋ dïnääy mo cwïnye da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna ŋääø mëër, ŋääø kaper mana ö Jecu na cïp jwïëye kiperø. Ni øøni thuwø, jwïëyø da ŋat mo jïre da jap piny ni neen coki ni can, ni mec waŋe ki gø, mëëc Jwøk bëëde cwïnye nidïï?
english: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

anywaa: U ni therø, kärø mëër ki dhøgø jaak wala cäänö, 'ba mëërø ki ri tïïe ka adïëri.
english: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø noo ŋääø gø ni ø ena ra adïëri, ni beeye noo cøm cwïnynyø nyïme,
english: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

anywaa: kany wø ö cwïnynyø wø pärge nyïme. Kiper Jwøk dwøŋŋa eni ki cwïnynyø, ni jammi bëët ŋääe.
english: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.

anywaa: Omëëya, ni näk cwïnynyø ba päri, Jwøk yøø ŋäädhö møn,
english: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.

anywaa: ni gïn wäro pëënynyø joodø joodø baŋe, kiper man bëëdø ni ø gwøga gïïa ceme, ni ø tïïya gïï wø met yie ki ge.
english: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

anywaa: 'Ba gïna ceme beeye en, ni jïëø ki nyeŋ Wääde ma Jecu Krictø, ni mëërø ki røgø keda mana kööm øøni.
english: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø gwøk gïïa ceme wø bëëdö dëëre, ni en dëëtge. Ni beeye ki køør Jwïëc Jwøk na wëëk øøni ni ŋääø gø ni eni bëëdö dëëtø.
english: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.

anywaa: Omëëya, kär jwïëy jïëyu bëët. 'Ba päänynyu jwïëy nee neennu nee gena mo Jwøk. Kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk mo thööth mo patha adïëri okeethø dï piny.
english: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

anywaa: 'Ba Jwïëc Jwøk oŋäyu ki køør luummi en: Jwïëy bëët mo wø jïëy ni Jecu Krictø oöö ni da dëël beege mo Jwøk.
english: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:

anywaa: 'Ba jwïëy bëët mo wø ba jïëc Jecu ni ööi ni da dëël, ge patha mo Jwøk. Manøgø beeye jwïëc nyimän Krictø na wïnynyu ni öö, ni enø nø ö piny ennø.
english: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

anywaa: U ni therø, uuna mo Jwøk, ni jwïëyögø you nø böötø. Kiper ŋat en cwïnynyu en dwøŋŋa eni ki ŋati ni en piny en.
english: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

anywaa: Gena mo piny. Kiper manøgønø, gïn wø caange, ge caana mo piny, ni ö pinynyi ni wïny marge.
english: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.

anywaa: 'Ba øøni, øøna mo Jwøk. Ŋat wø ŋäc Jwøk, marø wø wïnynye wïnynyö. 'Ba ŋat wø näk patha mar Jwøk, marø bäŋ wø wïnynye. Ni beeye gïnögø ni ŋääø jwïëy moa en ra adïëri, ki moa en ri cwøk.
english: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

anywaa: Omëëya, beerra man mëërø ki røgø, kiper mëër a mar Jwøk. Ni ŋat wø mëër nywøla Jwøki ni ŋäc Jwøk.
english: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø ba mëër, Jwøk kuue, kiper Jwøk a mëër.
english: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïn en na nyooth mëëc Jwøk dïïø, kiper mana ö Jwøki na jääŋ Wääde na näk aciel piny kiper nøø kwøø ki køøre.
english: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

anywaa: 'Ba mëër beeye en, ni patha øøni na mëër ki Jwøk, 'ba beeye eni na mëër ki øøni ni jääŋ Wääde nee tïme no olämi kiper raay moø.
english: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

anywaa: Omëëya, nee Jwøk mëër ki øøni na enønø, ø doo mëër ki røgø thuwø.
english: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

anywaa: Bäŋ dhaanhø mo oneen Jwøk. Ni näk mo ø mëër ki røgø, Jwøk bëëdö dëëtø, ni mëëye othur kare cwïnynyø.
english: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïn en ni ŋääø gø ni ø bëëdö dëëre, ni bëëde dëëtø, kiper mana mëëk Jwïëye øøni.
english: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba mana neenwa ni wø køpwa beeye ni Wuuö Wääde ajääŋŋe na Pïëmi mar piny.
english: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø jïëc Jecu ni ena O Jwøk, Jwøk wø bëëdö dëëre, ni en dëër Jwøk.
english: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, ŋääø ni yøø jïëø ni Jwøk mëër ki øøni. Jwøk a mëër. Ni ŋat wø bëëdö ri mëër, bëëdö ri Jwøk, ni Jwøk wø bëëdö dëëre.
english: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

anywaa: Ni beeye gïnögø na thur mëërri kare cwïnynyø, kiper nøø bëëdø ni cwïnynyø da ŋäädhe kiper cäŋa näk cäŋ ŋøl luup. Kiper kany bëëdø pinyi en, ø bëëdö keda manø bëëde.
english: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

anywaa: Bäŋ lwär ri mëër. 'Ba mëër mana näk adïëri, lwär wø rieme wøk. Kiper lwär ena kur pöödö, ni ŋat wø lwäär, mëëye paa othur kare.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

anywaa: Ø mëër kaper na kwøŋ mëër ki øøni.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

anywaa: Ni näk da ŋat mo köö, na «A mëër ki Jwøk,» ni mäne ki coki, ena dïtwöt. Kiper ŋat wø ba mëër ki coki na näk ee neenø, ba løny ki man mëëre ki Jwøk na näk käre neenø.
english: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

anywaa: 'Ba man en beeye dwøl mana jootwa baŋe, ni ŋat wø mëër ki Jwøk, doo mëër ki coki thuwø.
english: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.

anywaa: Jiy bëët mo wø jïëy ni Jecu beeye Krictø, gena nyïï Jwøk, ni jiy bëët mo wø mëër ki wuuö, ge mëër ki nyey thuwø.
english: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye gïn en noo ŋääø gø ni ø mëër ki nyïï Jwøk, beeye man bëëdø ni ø mëër ki Jwøk ni leŋø moa ceme.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.

anywaa: 'Ba mëër ki Jwøk beeye ki man gwøø gïïa ceme. Ni gïïa ceme dhaanhø ba ööle.
english: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

anywaa: Kiper ŋat wø näk nywøla Jwøki, piny wø bööte böötö. 'Ba gïn wø bööt piny ki gø beeye ŋäädhe marø.
english: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

anywaa: ?Aŋa ni wø bööt piny? Beeye ŋat wø jïëy ni Jecu beeye O Jwøk.
english: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

anywaa: 'Ba eni na Jecu Krictø beeye na öö ki ri pïï ki remø, ni eni kär öö ki ri pïï keerge, 'ba beeye ki ri pïï ki remø.
english: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.

anywaa: 'Ba beeye Jwïëc Jwøk na näk lïŋi, kiper Jwïëc Jwøk beeye adïëri.
english: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.

anywaa: Da lïŋŋe adäk, Jwïëc Jwøk, ki pïï, ki remø. Ni geno dwätö karge dääi.
english: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ø jïëy ki lïŋ mar jiy, dwøŋŋa lïŋ mar Jwøk. 'Ba man beeye lïŋ mar Jwøk na købe kiper Wääde,
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

anywaa: ni ŋat wø jïëy ki O Jwøk, lïŋ ena cwïnye kiree. 'Ba ŋat wø ba jïëy ki Jwøk, døøya Jwøk twöt, kiper na käre jïëy ki lïŋ mana køp Jwøki kiper Wääde.
english: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.

anywaa: 'Ba lïŋ mana køp beeye en, ni øøna mooc Jwøki ki kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni kwøwøgø ena ri Wääde.
english: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

anywaa: Ŋat wø en ri Wäädö, kwøw ena jïre. 'Ba ŋat wø tøør ri Wäädö, kwøw bäŋgø jïre.
english: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.

anywaa: A gööra luubö man baŋu, u no ojïëy ki nyeŋ O Jwøk, nee ŋäyu ni jïïu da kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.

anywaa: Ni man beeye ŋäädhe man wø ŋäädhø eni ki gø, ni ni näk eni pëënynyø pëënynyö ki gïrpiny keda mano manynye, döötø wïnynye wïnynyö.
english: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk mo ŋääø nø ni eni döötø wø wïnynye wïnynyö ki gïï wäro pëënynyø bëët, ŋääø nø ni gïïa pëënynyø baŋe wø cøøa jïïø.
english: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo neena coki no obääyö ni patha bääyö man wø cööp ri thøø, Jwøk opëënynye, ni ö Jwøki ni wëëk eni kwøw, ni beeye teeŋ jøø ni bääyö marge patha bääyö man wø cööp ri thøø enø. Kiper da raay mo wø cööpa ri thøø. Naa ba caan gø ni dhaanhø doo lämö kiper manøgø.
english: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

anywaa: Kiper gïïa ba beyø bëët beege raay. 'Ba da raay mo ba cööp ri thøø.
english: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

anywaa: Ni ŋääø ni ŋat mo onywøl Jwøki bäŋ wø bëëdö ni bääö, kiper mano gwøgi ya O Jwøki, ni ba guti ya ŋata raaci.
english: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.

anywaa: Ŋääø ni øøna mo Jwøk, ni piny bäre ena kur ŋata raac.
english: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋääø ni O Jwøk anø öö, ni mooc øøni ka acaara ki man ŋääø ŋata näk adïëri. Ni ø ena ri ŋata näk adïëri ki køør Wääde ma Jecu Krictø. Manøgø beeye Jwøk mana näk adïëri ni näk kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

anywaa: U ni therø, bëëdu ni karu bäär ki gïï wø lam jaak.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

anywaa: Aana jaan acooŋ Jwøk naa määtha dhaaŋŋa näk ojierø ki nyïïe, jøøa mëëra ki geni ki ra adïëri, ni patha a keera, 'ba këël jøøa ŋäc adïëri bëët thuwø,
english: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

anywaa: ni beeye adïëri man ni en cwïnynyø en, ni wø bëëdö ki øøni këël na bäre bäre.
english: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.

anywaa: 'Ba met ec, ki køny, ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ Jwøk na näk Wuuö, ki baŋ Jecu Krictø na näk O Wuuö obëëdö ki øøni ki ra adïëri ki mëër.
english: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

anywaa: Yia amïnnö døc na jooda nyïïï møøk ni caatha køør adïëri, keda mana ö Wuue na kööm øøni.
english: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a kwaya ïïni, ï na dhaagø, ni paa naa gööra dwøl mo nyään baŋï, 'ba beeye mana en jïïø cøøn, ni mëërø ki røgø.
english: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

anywaa: 'Ba mëër beeye ki man caadhø køør gïïa cem. Ni mana ceme beeye en, keda mana wïnynyu gø cøøn, nou doo caatha køør mëër.
english: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.

anywaa: Kiper jø cwøk mo thööth okeethø dï piny, jøøa näk kär jïëy ni Jecu Krictø oöö ni da dëël. Teeŋ ŋatøgø nø, beeye dïcuuy ni ena nyimän Krictø.
english: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

anywaa: Gwøgu dëëtu, kiper nee gïna tïïu kipere nee ba rwäänye jïïu, 'ba nee mana doo ci jïïu nee wëëk uuni na kare.
english: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat wø reŋ nyïm ni ba bëëdö ri pwöc Krictø, tøør ri Jwøk. 'Ba ŋat wø bëën pwöc Krictø, ena ri Wuuö ki Wäädö karge riet.
english: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo ööa baŋu ni ba käl pwöc moøgø, kär nou jïëya gø ki man døny paac, ni ba määthu gø.
english: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

anywaa: Kiper ŋato määth gø, eni tïmö ni nywaaga tïïc mare na raac.
english: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

anywaa: 'Ba këël na dee luup mo thööth mo gööra baŋu, a ba many man gööra gø yi warakata ki peen, 'ba yaa ŋäädhö naa ööa kuna neena uuni, ni cäänø ni ø raŋŋa nyeŋŋø, kiper nee met ec marø thur kare.
english: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

anywaa: Ïïna määth nyïï coku, nyïï dhaaŋŋa näk ojierø.
english: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.

anywaa: Aana jaan acooŋ Jwøk, a määtha ïïni, ï na Geea, ï na nyawatwa mana mëëra ki gø ki ra adïëri.
english: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

anywaa: Omëëya, a wø lämö nee jammi bëët cääthge ni beyø ki ïïni, niï bëëdï ni dëërï jööt, keda man ŋääa gø en ni cwïnyï ena køør Jwøk møn.
english: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

anywaa: Kiper yia amïnnö døc kanya pïïc nyïïmëëe møøk na caange bëët adïëri marï, keda man caathï køør adïëri møn enø.
english: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.

anywaa: 'Ba bäŋ met ec mo daa joodø mo kaala man këët, kany wø wïnynya gø ni nyïïa caatha køør adïëri.
english: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

anywaa: 'Ba omëëya, manøgø beeye gïn ma wøp døc ni wø tïïyï, kany wø tïnynyï nyïïmëëe, këël na näk dëëtge kuyï,
english: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;

anywaa: jøøa køp mëër marï nyïm acooŋ Jwøk. Beeye gïn mo doo beer jïrï ni näk ge wëëgï wääth marge, niï kunyö ki køny mo orømø ki ŋat wø tïny Jwøk.
english: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:

anywaa: Kiper beeye nyeŋ Krictø na aage wøk kipere, ni bäŋe gïn mo ege lwørø ceŋ jøøa kuc luum Jwøk.
english: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, teeŋ jøøgønø døø kønyø, nøø tïmø ni øøna jø tïïc ki geni ra adïëri.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

anywaa: 'Ba da gïn mo yaa göör baŋ acooŋ Jwøk. 'Ba Dïtaripa, ŋat wø many man cuum dëëre keere, ba many man leŋ dwøra.
english: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.

anywaa: 'Ba ni näk maa öö, gïïa reyø ni wø tïïe ni cara nyeŋŋa ki luup mo oballe jaak, ocaana. 'Ba eni kär ŋuudö ki manøgø keere, 'ba eni ki dëëre, ena kweer thuwø ki man pänh nyïïmëëe, ni män jø wø many man pänhge geni thuwø, ni riema ge wøk ya acooŋ Jwøk.
english: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

anywaa: 'Ba omëëya, kär tïï raay ŋwaalï, 'ba ŋwaal gïn wø beer. Ŋat wø tïïc gïn mo beer, ena mar Jwøk. 'Ba ŋat wø tïïc raay, Jwøk poot käre joodø.
english: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.

anywaa: 'Ba Dimitaria gïre wø caan jøw bëëti caanø; këël bëëtö mare na näk kare, wø nëënö dëëre. Naa køpa gïre thuwø, ni ŋäyï ni gïn wø køba beeye adïëri.
english: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.

anywaa: 'Ba doo da luup mo thööth mo daa göör baŋï na bëëde, 'ba a ba many man gööra ge ki peen.
english: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

anywaa: Yaa ŋäädhö ni ïïno jooda kany mo cään, nøø cäänø ni nyeŋŋø raŋŋø raŋŋø.
english: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.

anywaa: 'Ba bëët-mëër en jïrï. Ïïna määth nyïïawäädi. 'Ba määth nyïïawäädi karge bëët, ni ŋati man nø ki nyeŋge.
Aana Juut cöök Jeemeth, ni aana laŋ Jecu Krictø. A määtha uuni na cwøl, na näk jø wø mëër Jwøki ki geni na näk Wuuö, u na näk ogwøø kiper Jecu Krictø.
english: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:

anywaa: Køny, ki bëët-mëër, ki mëër pälle bäätu.
english: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

anywaa: Omëëya, a doo manynya man göönna baŋu kiper luum pïëm man piem øøni ki gø ni nywaaø en, 'ba acäŋa jootø ni doo beerra eni jïra ki man göönna baŋu naa köömma uuni ki man pïëmu kiper ŋäädhe mana wëëk jø Jwøk yie aciel ni bäŋ mørø.
english: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

anywaa: Kiper da jø møøk mo odunynyö ki jöö mør ki piny, jøøa näk omiiø cøøn kiper ajäl Jwøk, jøøa ba wøør Jwøk na wiil luum met yi Jwøk marø ni døøcge gø jöö man tïïcge gïï mo patha karge, ni kwierge Kwääyø ma aciel na näk Kwäärö ma Jecu Krictø.
english: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane a manynya man para wïthu, këël na näk you nø wïnynyö ni beer, ni Wuuö Jwøk na piem jiy yi ŋööm jø Ijep, jøøa näk kär jïëy ni ŋääthge acäŋ raanynyø.
english: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

anywaa: Ni eni, nyïïatwiet maal moa kwier kwör kööre moge, na wec kanya beer na beetge, awii yi tööc mana näk bäŋ cuŋŋe kany mo cøl døc, këël mano ŋøl luup dïcäŋo dwøŋ.
english: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

anywaa: Kaawat manøgø thuwø, Cødam ki Gømöra ki mïëri moa en deŋge, jøøa cïp dëëtge køør käp ni ge kapa dëëtge na enønø thuwø, atïmö na nyuudhi ki køør mana jääl geni ki maaa näk bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø poot raanynya dëëtge na enøgønø thuwø ki gïï mo patha karge ni wø lääŋge, ni kwierge teega bëënge, ni janyge moa jïge da ajiem maalø.
english: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

anywaa: 'Ba këël kwääy nyïïatwiet maal na näk Maykal, kanya pïëmge ka anägö ni ge caana gïr dëër Modhe, eni wïïe käre caarø ki man jääl anägö ki dhøk mo raac, 'ba ena köö, ni «Ïïno jook Wuue.»
english: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gïï wø kucge wø janyge janynyø. Ge bëëdö kaamar lääy ni wø ba cädö, ni gïï wø tïïcge beege gïï wø raany geni.
english: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

anywaa: Otïmö ni raac jïge. Kiper ge caatha jöör Keen, ni cïpge dëëtge cer bääyö mar Beelam kiper nee ge jïtge ki jammi, ni thøwge ra ageem Köra. c
english: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø caala kït gïï mo reyø mo raanynya kwör cam mou ni wø cammu ki mëër, kany wø cämge ki uuni ni nyeŋge teek, ni marge loor dëëtge. 'Ba ge caala pøøl mo bäŋ køth rege, mo käära jame, ni ge caala jenni mo bäŋ nyïëdi ka arïïa, mo othøw na bäre bäre, mo lweetge oö wøk.
english: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

anywaa: Ni ge caala athak naama dwøŋ mo reyø døc, ni lään wïc marge oö maal kaamar bööyö mo athage moøgø. Ni ge caala ceer mo wïïrö, jøøa näk kany mo cøl døc ojiiŋŋø kiperge këël na bäre bäre.
english: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

anywaa: Ni poot na jøøgø thuwø na gïïge køp Inøki, ŋata en ri bïriet beenhnhe moa nywøl køør Adam, na kööe, ni «Neennu, Kwäärö aöö ki nyïïatwiet maal moe na en kur keerge na näk kume mo thööth døc,
english: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,

anywaa: kuna ŋøl luup jiy bëët, ni jääl jøøa ba wøør Jwøk kiper gïïa reyø na tïïcge na näk ba en jöör Jwøk, ni beege gïïa tïïcge ki jöö mo raac døc na näk paa jöör Jwøk, ki jø raay na ba wøør Jwøk kiper gïïa reyø bëët na carge dëëre.»
english: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøgø gena jø gwön ni bäŋ gïn mo pwøcge, ni ge caatha køør gïïa reyø ni wø nieŋ cwïnyge køørge, ni dhøkge päŋ ka atöör, na jø wø mwøth jiy kiper nee ge jïtge ki jammi.
english: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.

anywaa: 'Ba u no omëëya, beerra man caarru wïthu ki luupa køp nyïïatwiet Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø.
english: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;

anywaa: Acaange jïïu, ni köge, ni «Noo tïme na aŋuun nïne da jø abuua mo öö, jøw ocaath køør gïïa reyø ni wø ba en jöör Jwøk ni wø nieŋ cwïnyge køørge.»
english: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

anywaa: Ni beege jøøgø ni wø tïïc apääk, ni cwïnyge ena køør jap piny, ni bäŋ Jwïëc Jwøk cwïnyge.
english: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

anywaa: 'Ba u no omëëya, tëënnu ki ri ŋäädhe maru na en kur keere na pere letha eni ki cwïnynyu bäre, ni lämu ki ri Jwïëc Jwøk na en kur keere.
english: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,

anywaa: Ni bëënnu mëëc Jwøk, nou koora køny mar Kwääyø ma Jecu Krictø mano cööp ri kwøw mana näk adïëri mo bäŋ cuŋŋe.
english: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.

anywaa: Ni joogu jøø ni tääö yøø.
english: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

anywaa: Ni judhu jø møøk wøk ki yi maac nou piema geni. Ni päth cwïnynyu ki gïr jø møøk nou lwäär, nou ciil këël ka abïïe moge na näk oraany japa en dëëtge na reyø.
english: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

anywaa: 'Ba pwøc en jï ŋat wø løny jïre ki man gwøk uuni ki pädhö, ni bwøth uuni kar ajieme, ni bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi dëëtu ni yïthu met.
english: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

anywaa: 'Ba ajiem, ki rööny, ki teek, ki cuum, opoot en jïre, eni na Jwøa näk aciel enø, na näk Pïëmi marø, ki ri Jecu Krictø na näk Kwääyø, ki mana täge cøøn, këël ennø, këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.
english: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Wëëlö man caana luup gïïa nyooth Jecu Krictø, na wëëk Jwøki eni, nee gïïo laar tägö nee nyoodhe jï laage. Ni nyoodhe ka dhi nyïïatwiel maal mare na jääŋŋe baŋ laŋŋe ma Jøøn,
english: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

anywaa: ŋata køp gïr luum Jwøk ki gïr luum adïëri mana caan Jecu Krictø, këël gïr gïïa neene bëët.
english: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.

anywaa: Gwïëth en jï ŋato kwaan luupi ni køp gïï mo poot ena nyïm nee wïnye. Ni gwïëth en jï jøw owïny ge, ni gwøkge gïïa näk ogöör yie, kiper kanya wäŋŋi acäännö.
english: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

anywaa: Aana Jøøn ni määth acook Jwøk karge bïriedi, ni en yi Eecia. Met ec bëëde bäätu ki bëët-mëër man wø ööi ki baŋ ŋat nut en, na nut cøøn, ni beeye noo ööi, ki baŋ jwïëy karge bïriedi ni wø en nyïm wälle,
english: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

anywaa: ki baŋ Jecu Krictø, na näk lïŋi mana näk adïëri, ŋata kwøŋ duu wøk ki yi thøø, eni na wïth nyeye mo piny. Ajiem ki rööny en jïre këël na bäre bäre, ŋata mëër ki øøni, na pät øøni ki remme yïth raay moø,
english: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

anywaa: ni tïïc øøni ni øøna jø bura, na dïlämme jï Jwøe na näk Wänni. Enøgønø.
english: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Neennu! Eni öö ki yïth pøøl, ni ö nyeŋŋi bëët ni neenge eni, ki jiy bëët moa mooc dëëre ki ŋwiili. Ni ö jø pinynyi bëët ni kïmge ki gïre. Ni beeye kare, na enønø.
english: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

anywaa: Kwäärö Jwøk aköö, ni «Aana Alpa ni näga Omëëga, ŋat nut en, na nut cøøn, ni beeye eni no ööi, ŋata en teeki jïre.»
english: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

anywaa: Aana cöögu ma Jøøn na dwätö ki uuni ki nyeŋ Jecu ki ri jwør gïï mo leth, ki ri bura, ki ri mak cwïny ni teek. Aani, aana kïth ya acuulla cwøl ni Patma kiper mana køba luum Jwøk ki gïr luum adïëri mana caan Jecu.
english: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: 'Ba dïcäŋ aciel ma Cäŋ Jwøk, Jwïëc Jwøk aö bääta, ni wïnynya dwøl ŋääa mo dwøŋ, mo keda dwør tuuŋ,
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

anywaa: ni cäänö, ni «Göör gïn ni neetï en yi wëëlö, ni jääŋŋï gø baŋ acook Jwøk karge bïriedi, ni beeye yi Epeca, ki Camerna, ki Pergamum, ki Thayatira, ki Carda, ki Piladelpia, ki Leeyödicia.»
english: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dëëra aløøa naa neena dwørøgø na cäänö ki aani. 'Ba na løøa dëëra, a joota lambae abïriiø mo ena bäät tëëde ma warkey.
english: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
