anywaa: 'Ba dï lambae moøgø da ŋat mo keda Wär Dhaanhø, mo orøø ka abïï mo okëët tiete, ni kööre da kaa warkey.
english: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

anywaa: Ni wïïe ki jïëye tar, keda jïëc røømmø mo tar. Ni taye caala piiø mo tar døc. Ni nyeŋŋe caala maac mo liel.
english: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

anywaa: Ni tiete caala jwëëlli mo othoodhø, ni ŋwaŋŋi kee poot ena yi maac. Ni dwøre caala lwör mar pïï mo thööth.
english: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

anywaa: 'Ba cer cwïïe da ceer abïriiø, ni dhee da opëëllö mo beth mo lage ariiø. Ni täärnyïme caala cäŋ mo orieny ni kwaar døc.
english: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooda gøøni, aana päth tiete kede aano thøw. 'Ba cer cwïïe acïp bääta, ni kööe, ni «Kärï lwäyö. Beeye aani na dïkwøŋ, ni näga aŋuudi.
english: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

anywaa: Ni beeye aani ni kwøw. Kiper aana thøw møn, 'ba kawaane aana cäŋ kwøwø, këël na bäre bäre. Ni muktääe mo thøø ki kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw ena cera.
english: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

anywaa: 'Ba kawaane gïïa neenï, ki gïï ni nut ii, këël moo tägi cään, göör piny.
english: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

anywaa: 'Ba luum ceer moa na abïriiø na jootï cer cwïïa, ki lambae moa näk abïriiø na näk warkey, ni beege japa näk tietge okwøŋ kan, tiere beeye en. Ceer moøgø karge bïriet gena nyïïatwiet acook Jwøk karge bïriedi. 'Ba lambae karge bïriet beege acook Jwøk karge bïriedi.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.

anywaa: «'Ba gööt baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Epeca ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋata näk cer cwïïe da ceer abïriiø, ni wø cäädhi ki dï lambae abïriiø ni wø en bäät tëëde ma warkey karge bïriet.
english: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

anywaa: «Aani, tïïe moï ŋääa, ki öölö marï, ni cwïnyï iï maa, niï ba maar jïëy ki jø raay. 'Ba jøøa døøc dëëtge nyïïatwieli ni ge patha nyïïatwieli, gena päänynyï, ni jootï geni ni marge tööt.
english: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:

anywaa: Ni ŋääa ni cwïnyï iï maa niï jøøya gïï mo leth kiper nyeŋŋa, ni kärï ööl.
english: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.

anywaa: «'Ba gïna jääla ïïni ki gø en beeye kiper mana weyï mëëyï mana dïkwøŋ.
english: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.

anywaa: Caar wïïï ki gïna døøï cään ki gø. Løk cwïnyï, ni tïïyï tïïe moa wara tïïyï dïkwøŋ. 'Ba ni näk ba tïïyï, ni ba løgï cwïnyï, a ööa baŋï, ni lwøra lamba marï kare, ni daaa gø.
english: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn ni poot beer jïrï en, beeye kiper mana mänï ki tïïe mo jø Niköölac, na mäna ki ge thuwø.
english: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk. 'Ba ŋato böödö, owëëga cam jaath kwøw, ni en yi pwötha beer mar Jwøk.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Camerna, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋata dïkwøŋ ni näk aŋuudi, na thøw ni cäŋ kwøwø.
english: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;

anywaa: «Aani, gïïö ni leth ni jwørï yøø ŋääa, ki cannï, 'ba ïïno kwär. Ni ŋääa gïïö ni reyø ni wø cari dëërï, ni beege jø wø köö ni gena jø Juuth, ni ge path. 'Ba gena øt acooŋa mar Ceethan.
english: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

anywaa: Kär niï lwäyö ki gïn ni kare cään en noo jwørï. Kiper jø møøk røk jiy moï, oleeŋ anägö øt twöc kany mo cään en, niï päänynyi. 'Ba nïne apaar obeetï niï jwøra gïï mo leth. 'Ba wärï bëëdï ni cwïnyï iï maa këël doo cööpa ri thøø, køøre ïïno mooa ka adun kwøw.
english: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk. 'Ba ŋato böödö, ba doo gwaar thøøe mano en cään.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Pergamum, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋata näk jïre da opëëllö mo beth mo lage ariiø.
english: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;

anywaa: «Aani, kany bëëdï yie enø ŋääa, ni beeye kany wø bëët wäl Ceethanni yie. 'Ba nyeŋŋa iï jïëö møn, ni ŋäädhe marï mana ŋääthï aani ki gø kärï mooŋø, këël yïth nïr lïŋi mara ma Antipa ŋata näk yaa ŋäädhö, na 'näk dïïu, kanyø ni bëët Ceethanni yie enø.
english: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.

anywaa: «'Ba jïra da luup møøk mo ï yaa jäälö ki ge. Kiper jïrï da jø møøk kaagø mo ojïëy ki pwöc Beelam, ŋata pwöny Beelak ki jöö man wëëk wäät Icriel cwany tietge ki gø, nee ge cämge ki caammi mo wø 'näk jï juu, ni bëëtge ki bëët käp.
english: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.

anywaa: Ni jïrï da jø møøk thuwø mo ojïëy ki pwöc jø Niköölac.
english: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.

anywaa: Kiper manøgønø, løk cwïnyï. 'Ba ni näk ba løgï, a laara ö baŋï ni këëda ki jøøgø ko opëël dhaa.
english: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk. 'Ba ŋato böödö, owëëga cam meena mana näk okanø, ni mooa gø ki kïdi mo tar, mo nyeŋ mo nyään ogöör bääte mo bäŋ ŋat mo ŋäc gø, 'ba beeye ŋato cï jïre keere noo ŋäc gø.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Thayatira, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup O Jwøk, ŋata nyeŋŋe caal maac mo liel, ni tiete caala jwëëlli mo othoodhø.
english: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;

anywaa: «Aani, tïïc marï ŋääa, ki mëëyï, ki ŋäädhe marï, ki tïny jø møøk, ki mak cwïny marï. Ni ŋääa ni tïïe moï moa en cään thöötha geni ki moa dïkwøŋ.
english: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.

anywaa: «'Ba gïna jääla ïïni ki gø, beeye kiper mana wëëgï nyaanøgø na Jedhebal bëëtö dïïu, nyaanø ni dëëre ee døøc nyikuŋ Jwøk enø, ni pöö ni maaŋŋa wïth laaŋe 'moa nee bëëtge ki bëët käp, ni cämge ki caammi mo wø 'näk jï juu.
english: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.

anywaa: Ena wëënna ki nïne nee cwïnye løøe, 'ba eni kweeyø ki man løk cwïnye ni wec käp mare.
english: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.

anywaa: 'Ba ennø, eno wëëga täw bäät pëëm. 'Ba ni näk jøøa näk kääpe ki eni na aciel cwïnyge ba løkge ni kwierge gïï wø tïïc nyaanøgø, ge mooa mooø ki gïï mo leth døc.
english: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïïe onääa ni thøwge ki thøø mo leth. Ni ö acook Jwøki bëët ni ŋäcge gø ni beeye aani ni wø neen gïï wø en yi cwïny ki wïc. 'Ba ŋati man nø dïïu omooa ki mano rømi ki tïïe moe.
english: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.

anywaa: 'Ba maru, u na jø møga ni en yi Thayatira, u na näk kär jïëy ki pwöc moøgø, na kär kwany gïï wø cwøl jø møøki ni jap Ceethan moa teek, a køpa gø jïïu, ni bäŋ gïn mør mo u ööla öölö ki gø.
english: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.

anywaa: 'Ba putu gïna nut jïïu mak ni teek këël mano ööa.
english: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋato böödö, ni gwøk tïïe 'moa këël cuŋŋe, omooa ki teek bäät mïëc piny,
english: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:

anywaa: keda mana ö Wära na wëëk a teek thuwø. « ‹Ni ö eni ni dïïm geni ka athøny nywïënyö, ni pööt geni ni keeth ge na thäŋi keda thäk dak mo ogøø piny,›
english: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

anywaa: «Ni wëëga cëëy amöölla eni.
english: And I will give him the morning star.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Carda, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋat en Jwïëc Jwøki karge bïriet jïre, ki ceer karge bïriedi: «Aani, tïïe moï ŋääa. Ni nyeŋŋï wïnyö niï kwøw, 'ba ïïno thøw.
english: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.

anywaa: Päyï, ni wëëgï gïïo no odööŋ ni karge cään ki thøø yøø tëënnö. Kiper bäŋ tïïe moï mo yaa joodø mo othur karge nyïm Jwøa.
english: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

anywaa: Caar wïïï nø, ki gïna wëëk ïïni na wïnynyï. Gwøgï, ni løgï cwïnyï. 'Ba ni näk ï ba päy, a öö kaawat man wø ö kuuwi, ni kuyï caanno ööa baŋï yie.
english: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋääa ni jïrï poot da jiy mo nøk yi Carda, jiy ma abïïkge kärge raanynyø. 'Ba geno cäädhi ki aani ka abïïe mo tar. Kiper geno rømø.
english: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato böödö, dëëre orunynyi ka abïïe mo tar na enøgønø, ni nyeŋŋe ba käla wøk yi wëël kwøw. 'Ba gïr nyeŋŋe køba købø nyïm Wära ki nyïm nyïïatwiet maal moe.
english: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en yi Piladelpia, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋata en kur keere, na näk adïëri, ni en muktään Deebit cere, ŋat wø jäbö, ni bäŋ ŋat mo dëët gø, ni wø cïëö ni bäŋ ŋat mo jap gø:
english: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;

anywaa: «Aani, tïïe moï ŋääa. 'Ba neenï, ïïna wëënna ko odhuulu mo ojabø, mo bäŋ ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man cïëk gø. Ni ŋääa ni teek marï thiinh, 'ba luumma poot iï gwøø, ni nyeŋŋa kärï mooŋø.
english: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.

anywaa: 'Ba jøø na jø øt acooŋ Ceethan yøø, ni beege jø wø köö ki tööt ni gena jø Juuth, ni ge path, geno tïïa nee öge ni këëlge cøŋge piny nyïmï, nee ŋäcge naa mëër ki ïïni.
english: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana gwøgï luumma na bëëdï ni cwïnyï iï maa, ïïno gwøa kanyo ö gïïa lethi no öge bäät piny bäre kuna päänyge jøøi ni bëëdö bäät piny en.
english: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.

anywaa: «Aani, a laara öö. Put gïna nut jïrï mak ni teek, kiper nee bäŋe ŋat mo mak aduda marï.
english: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋato böödö, eno tïïa na werø yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ mar Jwøa. Ni ba ö wøk yi gø bäre bäre. 'Ba nyeŋ Jwøa ogööra dëëre, ki nyeŋ pääny Jwøa, ni beeye Jerucalem mana nyään noo ööi ki maal ki baŋ Jwøa, ni gööra nyeŋŋa mo nyään dëëre.
english: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk.
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

anywaa: «Ni göötï baŋ nyïïatwiel maal mar acooŋ Jwøk mana en Leeyödicia, ni kööï, ni «Moi beege luup ŋat wø cwøl ni Enøgønø, na näk lïŋi mana näk adïëri ni wø cäänö ka adïëri, ni beeye na ö Jwøki na cwääc jammi ki ree:
english: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

anywaa: «Aani, tïïe moï ŋääa, niï ba lïëth, niï ba ŋec. 'Ba doo beerra mana diï lïëth wala ï ŋec.
english: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.

anywaa: 'Ba kiper mana caalï pïï mo mør, niï ba ŋec wala ï lïëth, ï ŋuula wøk dhaa.
english: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

anywaa: Kiper ï wø köö, ni ‹Aano kwär, ni japa atïmö ni thööth, ni bäŋ gïn manynya.› Ni kuyï gø ni ïïno ränynyö, ni cwïny opädhö ki gïrï, niï can, ni ïïna cwør, niï cäädhï ka dëërï.
english: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

anywaa: 'Ba a pwönynya ïïni ki man ŋëëmmï baŋa ki warkey mo oleenyø ki maac, kiper niï kwärï, ni ŋëëmmï baŋa ka abïïe mo tar, nee røøï dëërï, nee laac wïc manø ni cäädhï ki dëërï enø, nee ba neen, ni ŋëëmmï baŋa ki jaath nee nyeŋŋï wïïrï ki gø, niï nëënï.
english: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.

anywaa: «Kiper a wø jooga jø wø mëëra ki geni, ni pwöda geni. Kiper manøgønø, këëyï, ni løgï cwïnyï.
english: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.

anywaa: 'Ba neenï, a cuŋŋa dhi øtø, naa dööŋö. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo wïnynya dwøra, ni jap dhi øtø, a cøøa baŋe, ni cäma ki eni, ni ö eni ni cäme ki aani.
english: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

anywaa: «'Ba ŋato böödö, owëëga pïïn piny bäät wälla, keda mara na bööda, ni pïïa kanya ciel ki Wära bäät wälle.
english: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.

anywaa: 'Ba ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man wïny gïn ni caan Jwïëc Jwøki en jï acook Jwøk.»
english: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïïögø aana nëënnö, ni jooda dhøk mo ŋaam maal. 'Ba dwøl mana kwøŋa wïnynyö na cäänö ki aani ni caala dwør tuuŋ aköö, ni «Ö maal baŋa kany. 'Ba ïïno nyutha gïïo tägi køør moi ii.»
english: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.

anywaa: Ni put Jwïëc Jwøki ö bääta. Ni jooda wälu no ocïp piny maalø, ni da ŋat mo opï bäät gø.
english: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.

anywaa: 'Ba eni na en bääte nëëni keda kïdi mo ŋwaŋŋi ni mïrri. Ni deŋ wälu bäre da daanø mo nëëni keda kïdi mo mar.
english: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

anywaa: 'Ba deŋ wälu manøgø bäre da wäle ma pïërariiø kurŋween, ni bäät wätöge da jaae ma pïërariiø kurŋween, mo ge käära abïïe mo tar, ni wïthge da adude ma warkey.
english: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.

anywaa: 'Ba dëër wällögøøni da agaackøth mo mal, ki dööti, ki køth mo märö. Ni nyïm wällögø da ameethi abïriiø mo liel, na näk beege Jwïëc Jwøk karge bïriedi.
english: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

anywaa: 'Ba nyïm wälu manøgø da gïn mør mo keda naam mo dwøŋ mo kede tïïc ka wïlli mo tøŋ døc. 'Ba wällögø na en dïër enø, deŋŋe da gïï ma aŋween mo kwøw mo nyïmge ki ŋäthge ogääbö ki nyeŋ mo raŋ.
english: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.

anywaa: Ni mana dïkwøŋ røk gïïo ni kwøw yøø caala ŋuu, ni ö rietge ni caal rwaath, ni dääge, täärnyïme caala täärnyïm dhaanhø, ni ö ŋweerge ni caal coor mo määdö.
english: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.

anywaa: 'Ba gïïo na aŋween ni kwøw yøø ni dëëtge ogääbö ki nyeŋ ki wøk ki yïthge, man nø dëëre da bwöm abïciel. Ni wärre ki cääŋŋe duut ba cöök dhøkge, ni duut man wø wärge beeye en: «Kwäärö Jwøk na en teeki jïre, ena kur keere, ena kur keere, ena kur keere, ŋata nut cøøn, ni nut en, ni beeye eni noo ööi.»
english: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø ö gïïo ni kwøw yøø wø jiemge eni na näk opï bäät wälu, ni wøørge eni ni dwøkge met ec baŋe, eni ni wø bëëdö ni kwøw këël na bäre bäre,
english: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,

anywaa: jaae na näk pïërariiø kurŋween ge wø pätha nyïm eni na näk opï bäät wällögø, ni wøørge gø, eni ni wø bëëdö ni kwøw këël na bäre bäre, ni leeŋge adude moge nyïm wällögø, ni wärge,
english: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,

anywaa: ni «Ïïno rømø ka ajiem, ki wödö, ki teek, ï na Kwääywa ni nägï Jwøk marwa. Kiper beeye ïïni na cwääc jammi bëët, ni beeye ki køør mana manynyï na cwääyï geni ni bëëtge ni ge nut ii.»
english: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.

anywaa: Ni neena wëëlö cer cwïï ŋata näk opï bäät wälu, mo yie ki ŋääe ogöörö, no omwönö ki möönne abïriiø.
english: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.

anywaa: Ni neena nyïïatwiel maal mo teek mo cäänö ki dwøl mo päl, ni pëëö, na «?Aŋa no orømø ki man jap wëëlö ni jap möönne moe?»
english: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?

anywaa: Ni tïme ni bäŋ dhaanhø maal wala bäät piny, wala tiet ŋøøm, mo maar lønyø jïre ki man jap gø wala ki man neen yi gø.
english: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.

anywaa: Ni jwöŋa døc kiper na bäŋe dhaanhø mo ojoodø mo orømø ki man jap wëëlö wala neena yi gø.
english: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dhaanhø aciel røk jaae aköö jïra, ni «Kärï jwöŋö. Ŋuur tuuŋ Juuda na løth ri Deebit, nyïïmänne adïïme. Løny jïre ki man jap wëëlö ki möönne karge bïriet.»
english: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

anywaa: 'Ba yïthakic wälu ki gïïa kwøw karge ŋweeni ki dï jaae aana nëënnö ki Nyidiel mo cuŋŋö, mo kede onää, dëëre ki tuŋi abïriiø ki nyeŋ abïriiø na näk Jwïëc Jwøk karge bïriedi mo ojääŋŋö dï piny bäre.
english: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.

anywaa: Ni cøøe ni lwør wëëlö cer cwïï ŋata näk opï bäät wälu.
english: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.

anywaa: 'Ba na nø lwør wëëlö, gïïa kwøw karge ŋweeni ki jaae na näk pïërariiø kurŋween gena päth nyïm Nyidiel, ni ŋati man nø cere da thoom ki kuura ma warkey mo päŋ ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met, na näk laam mo jø Jwøk.
english: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

anywaa: Ni wärge ki duut mo nyään, ni köge, ni «Røma ïïni ki lwør wëëlö ni japï möönne moe. Kiper ïïna 'näk, ni wïïrï kwör jiy ki remmï kiper Jwøk, jøøa käl røk tuŋi bëët, ki dhøgi, ki wïth juurre, ki yïth mïëri bëët.
english: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;

anywaa: Ni tïïyï geni na jø bura na dïlämme jï Jwøk marø. 'Ba geno bëënni bäät piny.»
english: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana nëënnö, ni wïnynya dööt nyïïatwiet maal mo thööth døc døc, mo jïtö ki kume ma kume mo ena deŋ wälu bäre, ki deŋ gïïa kwøw, ki deŋ jaae,
english: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;

anywaa: mo köö ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Røma Nyidiel na 'näk, ki man wëëk teek eni, ki kwär, ki leec wïc, ki dööŋ-kar, ki wödö, ka ajiem, ki pwøc.»
english: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dööt gïïa näk ocwääö bëët, moa en maal ki moa en bäät piny, ki moa en tiet ŋøøm, ki moa en yïth näpa døøŋŋø, ki gïïa en yïthge bëët, ni ge köö, ni «Pwøc, ki wödö, ka ajiem, ki teek, en jïre, eni na en bäät wälu ki Nyidiel, këël na bäre bäre.»
english: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ni kö gïïa kwøw karge ŋweeni, ni «Enøgønø.» Ni ö jaae ni leeŋge rege piny ni wøørge Jwøk ki Nyidiel.
english: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana nëënnö kanya ö Nyidielli na jap mööni aciel røk möönne abïriiø, ni wïnynya dwør aciel røk gïïa kwøw karge ŋweeni, ni cäänni ka dwøl mo keda määc køth, ni kööe, ni «Ööï.»
english: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.

anywaa: Ni nëënna, ni jooda okweeny *2* mo tar, mo bääte da ŋat mo cere da atum. Ni mooi ka aduda, ni cøøe ni ena ŋat dïïm nee nyïïmänne dïïme.
english: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Nyidiel na jap riet möönne, dwør riet gïïa kwøw awïnynya, ni köö, ni «Ööï.»
english: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.

anywaa: Ni cäŋ okweenynyi mør ö wøk mo kwaar døc. 'Ba ŋata en bääte omooø ki teek man raany bëët-mëër bäät piny, kiper nee jiy røkge 'näkge. Ni mooi ko opëëllö mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Nyidiel na jap dää möönne, dwør dää gïïa kwøw awïnynya, ni köö, ni «Ööï.» Ni nëënna, ni jooda okweeny mør mo cøl, mo bääte da ŋat mo cere da rumi.
english: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya gïnmør mo keda dwøl dï gïïa näk aŋween na kwøw, ni köö, ni «Rumi aciel mar beek wø cwøl ni cïndë ŋeew ka gwel mo röömi ki gät tïïc man wø cool jï dhaanhø ki yi cäŋ, ni beek wø cwøl ni gäbci *3* mo yïth rumme adäk poot ŋeew ka gwel mo caala moøgø. 'Ba kär niï raanynya maaw ki køøŋ nyïïomøki.»
english: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Nyidiel na jap ŋweer möönne, dwør ŋweer gïïa kwøw awïnynya, ni köö, ni «Ööï.»
english: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.

anywaa: Ni nëënna, ni jooda okweeny mør mo obwörö, mo bääte da ŋat mo nyeŋŋe Thøø, ni kar bëët jwïëc jøøa näk othøw cäädha køøre. Ni geno wëëk teek bäät ŋweer thääŋö mar piny, nee 'näkge ko opëëllö, ki meel, ki ŋwiili, ni wëëk geni 'näk dhøk cwëënyi mo owär.
english: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Nyidiel na jap bïï möönne, jwïëc jøøa 'näk kiper luum Jwøk ki luum Jecu na køpge, ajooda tier gïn wø cïp olämme bääte.
english: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:

anywaa: Ni köökge ki dwøl mo päl, ni «?Wui Kwäärö Jwøk na en teeki jïre, na en kur keere na näk adïëri, awäne noo ŋølï luubö noo coolï kwör remwa dëët jøø ni bëëdö bäät piny en?»
english: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋati man nø amooc ka abïï mo tar mo røøe, ni köömmi ni cäŋge bëëtö ki kany mo thiinh, këël mano päŋ kwään nyïïmëëkge, jø wø tïny Krictø ki geni na aciel moo 'näk kaamar marge.
english: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

anywaa: 'Ba na ö Nyidiel na jap bïcier möönne, aana nëënnö, ni jooda dïjäŋ piny mo dwøŋ døc. Ni ö cäŋŋi ni tïme ni cøl døc, ni ö dwääyi kare bäre ni tïme ni caala remø.
english: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;

anywaa: Ni ö ceerri mo maal ni pänhge piny, keda mar olaam wø øc nyïïe piny ka arïïa, kany wø jäŋi ya jame mo teek.
english: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.

anywaa: Ni ö maalli ni rwäänye keda mar wëëlö mo di dølø. Ni ö kïte bëët ka acuule ni daai kwörge.
english: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyec piny, ki jøøa kwörge døøŋŋø, ki kwääc jø leny, ki jøøa näk okwär, ki jøøa teek, ki jiy bëët, nee laŋŋø wala ŋat mo bëëdö ka wïïe, rege akange yïth buri ki dï ogeeme mo kïte,
english: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;

anywaa: ni ge cøøra kïte ko ogeeme, ni «Päthu bäätwa ni kannu waani ki waŋ ŋat en bäät wälu, ki wëëc Nyidiel.
english: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:

anywaa: Kiper cäŋa dwøŋ na näk mar wëër marge apïï. ?Na aŋa noo maar cuŋŋö?»
english: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?

anywaa: Køør manøgøøni, nyïïatwiet maal aŋween ajooda ni ge cuŋŋa yïth tuk piny karge ŋweeni, ni kwör wø kwön jame ki yïthge karge ŋweeni ege mänö nee bäŋe jamø mo kwön bäät piny, wala bäät näpa døøŋŋø, wala ri jaathø.
english: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mør ajooda ni ö maal ka jï løø kur tuul-cäŋ, ni cere da ŋïï mar Jwøa kwøw, ni cwøl nyïïatwieta näk aŋween ki dwøl mo päl, geni na wëëk teek ki man raanyge piny ki näpa døøŋŋø.
english: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

anywaa: Ni kööe, ni «Kär nou raanynya piny, wala näpa døøŋŋø, wala jen, këël mano kïthwa täärnyïm laak Jwøø ki ŋïï.»
english: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya kwään jøøa täärnyïmge kïthi ki ŋïï, na jiy mo jïtö ki kume ma dïpa ki pïëraŋween kurŋween, mo ööi ki røk tuk wäät Icriel bëët.
english: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.

anywaa: Ri tuuŋ Juuda da kume apaar kurriiø na mooc ki ŋïï. Ki ri tuuŋ Ruben, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Gaat, da kume apaar kurriiø.
english: Of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.

anywaa: Ki ri tuuŋ Acer, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Naptali, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Maneeca, da kume apaar kurriiø.
english: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.

anywaa: Ki ri tuuŋ Cimien, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Libay, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Icakar, da kume apaar kurriiø.
english: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.

anywaa: Ki ri tuuŋ Dhebulan, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Jocep, da kume apaar kurriiø. Ki ri tuuŋ Benjamen, da kume apaar kurriiø.
english: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

anywaa: Køør gïïögø aana nëënnö, ni jooda lwaak mo päl døc, mo bäŋ ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man kwaan geni, ni ööi ki yïth mïëri bëët, ki røk tuŋi bëët, ki røk jiy bëët, ki teeŋ dhøgi bëët, ni ge cuŋŋa nyïm wälu ki nyïm Nyidiel, ni geno ruyö ka abïïe mo tar, ni ceŋge da bäät twöe.
english: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;

anywaa: Ni köökge ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Pïëm man piem jiy ki gø, en jï Jwøø, eni ni en bäät wälu en, ki Nyidiel.»
english: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiet maalli bëët ni cuŋge deŋ wällögø bäre, ki deŋ jaae ki gïïa näk aŋween na kwøw, ni päthge ki nyïmge nyïm wälu ni wøørge Jwøk,
english: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,

anywaa: ni köge, ni «Enøgønø. Pwøc ka ajiem ki leec wïc, ki dwøk met ec, ki wödö, ki teek, ki dööŋ-kar, en jï Jwøø këël na bäre bäre. Enøgønø.»
english: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

anywaa: Kanyøgø jaa aciel aluupö ki aani ni kööe, ni «?Moø a jøøe, ni käädö ka abïïe mo tar yøø, na a kaa na kälge yie?»
english: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?

anywaa: Ni dwøga gø jïre, ni «Ŋäyï, kwäärö.» Ni duu gø jïra, ni «Jøøgø beege jøøa ö wøk ki yi gïna leth døc na wäŋŋi. Abïïkge apenyge ni tïïcge ge ni tar ki rem Nyidiel.
english: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

anywaa: «Ni beeye tiere ni cuŋge nyïm wäl Jwøk en, ni ge tïnynya eni ki cääŋŋe ki wärre yi Øt Lam mare na dwøŋ. 'Ba eni ni en bäät wälu kiper na nude, geno gëëŋe.
english: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.

anywaa: Geni, ge ba 'näk käci këët, ni bäŋe riew rege këët. Ni ge ba 'näk cäŋŋi këët, wala kwaac cäŋ mo jootge.
english: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.

anywaa: Kiper Nyidiel ni en dï thudhi tïmö na dïkwääy marge, ni nyooth geni kwör jøør mo pï kwøw, 'Ba Jwøk pï nyeŋge opwøe bëët.»
english: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

anywaa: Kanyøgø na ö Nyidielli na jap bïriet möönne, maal anibäc ki kany mo jïtö ki thääŋ caa.
english: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

anywaa: Køøre nyïïatwiet maal abïriiø mo wø cuŋŋi nyïm Jwøk ajooda. Ni ö tuŋi abïriiø ni mëëgi geni.
english: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mør ni ööe ni cuŋŋe buut gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni cere da athaa ma warkey. Ni mooi ki gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met mo thööth, nee rwöbe ki lam mar jø Jwøk na aciel na en bäät gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte na näk tïïc ki warkey na en nyïm wälu.
english: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

anywaa: Ni ö jïc jer wø ŋwääi ni met ni duuŋe cer nyïïatwiel maal manøgø ki lam mar jø Jwøk na aciel nyïm Jwøk.
english: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal manøgø athaa alwøre ni pääŋ gø ki maac mana en bäät gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni lëëŋ gø bäät piny. Ni tïm køthi ni märö, ni tïm pinynyi ni dïmmi døc, na agaackøth mal, ni piny jäŋŋi.
english: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiet maal moa näk jïge da tuŋi abïriiø, dëëtge ajekge ki man koothge tuŋi.
english: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maal mana dïkwøŋ ni kooth tuuŋ mare, ni put piiø ki maac mo orwöbö ki remø öö, ni pänh bäät piny. Ni ö dää thääŋö mar piny ni waaŋe, ni waaŋ dää thääŋö mo jen, ni ö luummi mana marr ni waaŋe ki kare bäre.
english: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

anywaa: Ni ö riet nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare. Ni ö gïn mørri mo keda kïdi mo dwøŋ mo liel ki maac ni lëëŋi yïth näpa døøŋŋø.
english: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

anywaa: Ni ö dää thääŋö mo näpa døøŋŋø ni tïmge na remø, ni ö dää thääŋö mo gïïa kwøw yïth näpa døøŋŋø ni thøwge, ni räny dää thääŋö mo jïëth näm.
english: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.

anywaa: Ni ö dää nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare. Ni ö cëërö mo dwøŋ døc mo liel keda ameeth ni pänhnhe ki maal, ni pänh bäät dää thäk näm, ki bäät jøøre mo pïï.
english: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;

anywaa: 'Ba nyeŋ cëëyögø cwøl ni Jaadha Keec. Ni tïm dää thäk pï näm ni keec. Ni thøw jiyi mo thööth ki pïï, kiper na tïmge ni keec.
english: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋweer nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare. Ni ö dää thääŋö mar cäŋ, ki dää thääŋö mar dwääy, ki dää thääŋö mar ceer ni gøøi, ni tïm dää thääŋö mar tar moge na muudhö. Ni ö dää thääŋö mar dïcäŋöca ni mäni ki man tïme ni leer, ni ö dää thääŋö mar wäär thuwø ni tïïi na enøgønø.
english: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana nëënnö, ni wïnynya dwør coor mo määdö maal ni rëëdö ki dwøl mo päl, no «Oraac, oraac, oraac, jï jø oen bäät piny kiper dööt tuŋi møga moo cäŋ nyïïatwiet maalli moa na adäk koothø kawaane.»
english: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

anywaa: Ni ö bïï nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare, ni jooda cëërö mør mo opänh piny ki maal. Ni muktää mar buura näk bäye bäŋ cuŋŋe omëëk eni.
english: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

anywaa: Ni jap dhi buura näk bäye bäŋ cuŋŋe. Ni ö jïrö wøk ki dhi buur manøgø, mo caala jïc maac mo päl døc. Ni ö maalli ki cäŋ ni døøyi muudhö ki jïyögø na ö wøk ki dhi buurögø.
english: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.

anywaa: Kanyøgøøni bäänyö aö piny ki yi jïyögø, ni dhøkge odøøc mo leth ni caala leth dhøk agarapi mo piny.
english: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

anywaa: Ni köömmi ni kär luum mar piny raanyge wala gïn mo otuy wala jaath, 'ba beeye jiy keerge moa näk täärnyïmge bäŋ ŋïï mar Jwøk noo raanyge.
english: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

anywaa: Ni wëëgi man caange geni ki dwäde abïïc, 'ba paa per man 'näk geni. 'Ba caannø mano caarge geni ki gø, leth mare caala leth dha agarap kany wø kac dhaanhø.
english: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.

anywaa: 'Ba yïth nïrögø jiy thøø omanyge ni ba jootge gø. Ni parge thøø, 'ba thøø oreŋi buutge.
english: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.

anywaa: 'Ba bäänyö manøgø nëëni keda okwëënyi mo ojiiŋŋø kiper leny. Ni wïthge da gïï mo nëëni keda adude mo warkey. Ni täärnyïmge keda täärnyïm dhaanhø.
english: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.

anywaa: Ni jïëcge keda jïëc dhaagø. Ni lakge keda lak ŋuuwe.
english: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.

anywaa: Ni dëëtge da kwök mo nëëni keda kwöt nywïënyö mar käw. Ni lwöc bwöpge caala lwöc dööt jïëth leny mo wø tut okwëënyi mo thööth mo reŋŋa baŋ leny.
english: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.

anywaa: Ni jïpge caala jïp agarapi, ni ge kää, ni teek marge man caarge jiy ki gø ki dwäde abïïc ena jïpge.
english: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

anywaa: 'Ba nyeya marge beeye nyïïatwiel mar buura näk bäye bäŋ cuŋŋe, ni nyeŋŋe ki dhi Ibaru cwøl na Abadøn, 'ba ki dhi Gïrïïk cwøl ni Apølïën, na näk tiere beeye Dïräänyi.
english: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.

anywaa: Gïna raac mana dïkwøŋ apöödhö nø. 'Ba poot da ariiø mo öö.
english: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

anywaa: Ni ö bïcier nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare. Ni wïnynya dwøl mo ööi ka yïth tuŋi karge ŋweeni mo gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte na näk tïïc ki warkey na en nyïm Jwøk,
english: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,

anywaa: ni köömma bïcier nyïïatwiet maal na en tuuŋŋi cere, ni «Pät nyïïatwiet maal moa näk aŋween na näk otwöö bäät Naam Upareeti na dwøŋ.»
english: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwietøgø karge ŋweeni gena pät, geni na näk ojiiŋŋø kiper yi caannøca, ki dïcäŋöca, ki dwäänöca, ki cwiinøca, nee dää thäk jiy 'näkge røk jø bäät piny bëët.
english: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.

anywaa: 'Ba kwään jø leny mo wø cäädhi ki bäät okwëënyi thööth døc, ni beege miilïënni ma dïpe ariiø. Ni wïnynya kwäänge.
english: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.

anywaa: 'Ba man en beeye gïna jooda kanya neena okwëënyi ki yi lääk. Ni jøøa en bäätge ge käära kööt käw mo kïtge caala maac mo kwaar, ni caala kït abïcøle ki kïdö ma abäga. 'Ba wïth okwëënyi caala wïth ŋuuwe, ni maac, ki jïrö, ki jïrö mør mo keec ni lïëth døc bëëdö ni ööa wøk ki dhøkge.
english: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

anywaa: Ni ö dää thäk jiyi moa en røk jø bäät piny bëët ni nääi ki gïïo na jap räny piny moø na adäk yøø, ni beeye maac, ki jïrö, ki jïrö maya mana keec ni lïëth døc na bëëdö ni ööa wøk ki dhøkge.
english: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.

anywaa: Kiper 'näk mar okwëënyi atïmö ni ena dhøkge ki jïpge. 'Ba jïpge caala thwöre ni da wïdhi, ni ge räänyö ka ge.
english: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.

anywaa: 'Ba jøøa dööŋ, na näk kär thøw ki jap räny piny moøgø, cwïnyge kärge løø ki man wecge wøør gïïa tïïcge ki ceŋge, ni ba wecge wøør anäge, ki gïï wø lam mo warkey, ki gwet-bïrö, ki jwëëlli, ki kïdi, ki jaath, gïï wø bäŋ gïn mo maarge raŋ, ni ge ba wïnyö, ni ge ba cäädhi.
english: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:

anywaa: Ni cwïnyge kärge løø ki 'näk marge man wø 'näkge jiy, wala thïëth marge, wala käp marge, wala käw marge.
english: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mør mo teek ajooda ni ööa piny ki maal, no oboony pöölö, ni wïïe da daanø, ni täärnyïme caala cäŋ, ni tiete caala jøøde mo liel ki maac.
english: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

anywaa: Ni cere da wëëlö mo thiinh mo ojabø. Ni ööe ni këël tier cwïïe yi naama dwøŋ, ni këël tier caame dï piny wøk.
english: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,

anywaa: Ni cwöte ki dwøl mo päl mo caala dwør ŋuu mo määr. 'Ba na cwöte, køth amäär kwöre abïriiø.
english: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.

anywaa: 'Ba määc køth moø na abïriiø yøø na määrge, ni marge cäänö, aana tïmö naa manynya göör. 'Ba dwøl mør awïnynya mo ööi ki maal ni kööe, ni «Mwön gïïa køp määc køthi karge bïriet, ni ba göörï ge.»
english: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maal na neena ni tiere ee këël yi naama dwøŋ, ni tiere maya ee këël dï piny wøk, ni tïŋ cer cwïïe maal,
english: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,

anywaa: ni kööŋ ŋëët ŋat wø bëëdö ni kwøw këël na bäre bäre, eni na cwääc maal ki piny ki gïïa en yïthge bëët, ki näpa døøŋŋø ki gïïa en yïthge, ni kööe, ni «Doo bäŋ gaalø këët,
english: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:

anywaa: 'ba gïna näk tiere okwøŋ Jwøki kan doo wëëga thur kare yïth nïro ö bïriet nyïïatwiel maalli noo kooth tuuŋ, keda mana caan gø jï laage ma nyïïkuk Jwøk.»
english: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwøl mana kwøŋa wïnynyö na öö ki maal acäŋ cäännö ki aani ni kööe, ni «Ciï ni lwørï wëëlö mana no ojabø enøce cer nyïïatwiel maal manø ni tiere aciel en yi naam enø, ni tiere maya ena wøk dï piny.»
english: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.

anywaa: Ni cøøa baŋ nyïïatwiel maal manøgø ni luumma gø nee wëëlö manø ni thiinh enø mëëk aani. Ni kööe jïra, ni «Lwørï ni camï gø. 'Ba otïmö ni keec yiï, 'ba ki dhiï, ŋweeth kaamar maar kïc.»
english: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.

anywaa: Ni lwøra wëëlla thiinh cer nyïïatwiel maal, ni cama gø. Ni ŋweeth døc dhaa keda maar kïc. 'Ba na nø cama gø, yia atïïe ni keec.
english: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.

anywaa: Ni kööm aani, ni «Gïr jiy mo thööth mo poot ena nyïm ki gïr mïëri, ki gïr dhøgi, ki gïr nyeye, ocäŋï køpø.»
english: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana mooc ki thiir ma mar røøm, ni kööm aani, ni «Ö maal ni rømï Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ki gïn wø cïp olämme bääte, ni kwaanï jø wø lämö kaace.
english: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

anywaa: 'Ba kär niï røma yi kal mar Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. Wec kanyøce nee dööŋ wøk. Kiper owëëk juurre. 'Ba geni paana en kur keere na näk mar Jwøk oraanyge ki dwäde ma pïëraŋween kurriiø.
english: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

anywaa: 'Ba aani lïŋŋe 'moa moa na ariiø owëëga teek man køpge dwør Jwøk ki yïth nïne ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïciel, ni ge käära keece na abïïe.»
english: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

anywaa: Lïŋŋe moøgø na ariiø yøø beege jer wø cwøl ni ølip karge riet ki tëëde mo lambae karge riet ni wø cuŋŋi nyïm Kwäärö mar piny.
english: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba kany wø näk da ŋat mo manynya man raany geni, maac wø ööa wøk ki dhøkge ni dïïr wïth jø wø män ki geni. Kiper manøgø nø, ŋat wø many man raany geni, cuŋ mare beeye thøø.
english: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

anywaa: Ni jïge da teek ki man mänge pöölö nee køth ba pädhe yïth nïro køpge dwør Jwøk yie. Ni jïge da teek bäät pïï ki man døøcge geni remø, ki teek man raanyge piny ki teeŋ jap räny piny bëët, kany wø manyge gø.
english: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.

anywaa: 'Ba noo nø thöörge gïrge na køpge, Lään wø ö wøk ki yi buura näk bäye bäŋ cuŋŋe, okëëdi ki geni ni bööt geni, ni 'näk geni,
english: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.

anywaa: ni ö rïŋ dëëtge ni bëëtge no opäänhnhö waŋjöör paana dwøŋ, na näk nyeŋŋe obaaŋ ri Cødam ki Ijep, kanya 'näk Kwääcge yie bäät jaadha no odëëdö.
english: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.

anywaa: 'Ba jiy oööi ki røk tuŋi, ki wïth juurre, ki dhøgi, ki yïth mïëri, ni neetge dëët jøøgø na näk othøw ki nïne adäk ki thääŋö, ni kwierge geni ki man kïth geni yi kää.
english: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.

anywaa: Ni ö jø wø bëëdö bäät piny ni mïn yïthge ki gïrge, ni kanyge, ni moocge dëëtge ki muuce, kiper nyïïkuk Jwøk moø na ariiø yøø na bëëtge ni caara jøøa bëëdö bäät piny.
english: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.

anywaa: 'Ba køør nïrögø na adäk ki thääŋö yøø, jwïëc kwøw aöö ki baŋ Jwøk ni ci dëëtge, ni öge maal ni cuŋge ki tietge. Ni jït cwïny jøøa neen geni ki lwär mo päl.
english: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwøl mo päl awïnyge ni ööi ki maal, ni kööe jïge, ni «Ööu maal kany.» Ni aage maal ki yi pöölö, ni neet nyïïmänge neetø.
english: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø piny atïmö ni jäŋŋi døc yi caannøca. Ni ö paac thääŋ päänynyi ni pädhe. Ni ö jiyi ma kume abïriiø ni nääi ki dïjäŋ piny, ni ö moa dööŋŋi ni lwäcge døc, ni jiemge Jwø maalø.
english: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

anywaa: Riet gïïa reyø yøø apöödhö nø. 'Ba dää gïïa reyø laara öö.
english: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

anywaa: Ni ö bïriet nyïïatwiet maalli ni kooth tuuŋ mare. Ni jït maalli ki dööti mo døøŋŋø, mo cäänö, ni «Buc piny atïmö na buc Kwääyø ma Jwøk, eni ki Krictø na røønye. 'Ba eno bëënni këël na bäre bäre.»
english: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ni ö jaae moa näk pïërariiø kurŋween na en bäät wäle moge nyïm Jwøk, ni päthge ki nyïmge ni wøørge Jwøk.
english: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,

anywaa: Ni köge, ni «Wui Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk na en teeki jïre, wa dwøga met ec jïrï, ï ni nut en, ni nudï cøøn, kiper na lwørï teegï na dwøŋ, ni tägï ki man bëën ïïni.
english: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.

anywaa: 'Ba mïëri abëëdö ni wëëyö. 'Ba wëëyï apïï, ki kanya di luum jøøa näk othøw ŋølø, ki kanyo ŋat laagï yie ma nyïïkuk Jwøk ki jø Jwøk, ki jø wø lwäär ki nyeŋŋï, moa døøŋŋø ki moa therø, ni beeye kanyo raany jøøa raany piny.»
english: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ maalø ajap, ni ö acanduki mar luumme na tuude ki jiy ni neeni yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ. Ni tïm agaackøthi ni mal, ni piny dïmmi døc, ki køth mo märö, ki dïjäŋ piny, ki piiø mo päl.
english: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.

anywaa: Ni ö ŋïïyi mo dwøŋ ni nëëne maal, na dhaagø mo cäŋ ee røø dëëre, ni dwääy ena tiete, ni wïïe da adun ceer apaar kurriiø.
english: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:

anywaa: Eni yie da dhaanhø ni kwöŋŋe ki mäc lwaar na en dëëre, ni baŋŋi døc ni manynya lwaar.
english: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋïï mør acäŋ nëënne maal, na thwöl mo dwøŋ døc mo kwaar ni keda nyaaŋ, ni wïthe abïriiø ki tuŋi apaar, ni wïthe da adude abïriiø.
english: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.

anywaa: Ni gøøc dää thäk ceec maal ki jïbe ni lëëŋ ge piny. Ni ö thwörögø ni cuŋŋe nyïm dhaaŋŋa kare cään ki lwaar, nee nyi gø løønye kanyo lwaare ki gø.
english: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.

anywaa: Ni lwaar dhaaŋŋøgø ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø, ŋato käär mïëri bëët ka athøny nywïënyö. 'Ba wääde ajuth ni kïthi maal baŋ Jwøk ki wälle.
english: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.

anywaa: Ni ö dhaage ni reŋ paap, yi kanya näk ojiiŋ Jwøki kipere, kanya dii caamø yie ki nïne ma kuma aciel ki dïpe ariiø ki pïërabïciel.
english: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.

anywaa: Kanyøgø leny atägö maal. Maykal ki nyïïatwiet maal moe akëëdö ki thwöl, ni ö thwörögø ki nyïïatwiete ni këëtge ki ge.
english: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

anywaa: 'Ba gena bööti, ni tïme ni bäŋ kany bëëtge yie maal këët.
english: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

anywaa: Ni ö thwöra dwøŋ ni lëëŋi piny. Ni beeye thwöra cääŋŋe cøøn, na cwøl na anägö ni näk Ceethan, na näk dïcuuy mar piny bäre. Ena lëëŋ piny, ni ö nyïïatwiet maalli moe ni lëëŋi piny ki eni na aciel.
english: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dwøl mo päl maalø, ni köö, ni «Kawaane, pïëm man piem jiy ki gø, ki teek, ki buc Jwøø, ki teek Krictø na røønye apïï. Kiper ŋat wø wac nyeŋ nyïïmëëgø aleeŋ piny, ŋat wø wac nyeŋge nyïm Jwøø ki cääŋŋe ki wärre.
english: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.

anywaa: 'Ba ena böötge ki køør rem Nyidiel ki luum Jwøk na køpge, ni per jwïëcge ba leth jïge, këël doo cööpa ri thøø.
english: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.

anywaa: Ï na maal, yiï mïnne nø, ki uuni ni bëëdö yie. 'Ba oraac jï piny ki näm, kiper anägö aö piny baŋu ki wëër mo päl, kiper ŋääe ni kare acäännö.»
english: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

anywaa: 'Ba na jooti ya thwölli ni eno lëëŋ piny, køør dhaaŋŋa lwaar ki nyilaal ma dïcwøø aŋwiee.
english: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.

anywaa: 'Ba dhaaŋŋøgø omooø ki bwöp ariiø mo coor mana dwøŋ, kiper nee määt paap kiper thwöl, kanya dii caamø yie dïciel ki cwiiri adäk ki thääŋö.
english: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

anywaa: Ni ö thwölli ni ŋöö pïï wøk ki dhee mo keda naam køør dhaaŋŋøgø, kiper nee dhaaŋŋøgø käl jwïïe.
english: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

anywaa: 'Ba piny, dhaaŋŋøgø akønye ni ööe ni jap dhee ni mwøny naamøgø, na ŋöö thwölli wøk ki dhee enø.
english: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø thwörögø awëër ki dhaagø, ni ci kuna këëde ki nyïïkwaac dhaaŋŋøgø møga, jø wø gwøk gïïa cem Jwøki, ni wø køp gïr Jecu.
english: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.

anywaa: Ni ö eni ni cuŋŋe ya akwöny naama dwøŋ.
Ni neena Lääy mør mo ööa maal ki dï naama dwøŋ, mo wïthe abïriiø, ni wïthe da tuŋi apaar, ni wïth tuge da adude apaar, ni nyeŋ mo raac døc mo janynya Jwøk ogöör wïthe.
english: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.

anywaa: 'Ba Läänögø na jooda enø caala kwac, ni ö tiete ni caal tiet cwieny mør mo dwøŋ mo lweete beth døc, ni ö dhee ni caal dhi ŋuu. 'Ba thwöl teek mare ki wälu mare ee wëëk Läänögø, ki cuum mo dwøŋ døc.
english: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.

anywaa: 'Ba Läänögø wïïe aciel nëëni kede da ŋwellø mo cööpa ri thøø. 'Ba ŋwelle na doo cööp ri thøø ocaŋŋø, ni ö jø bäät pinynyi bëët ni caathge køør Läänögø, ni yïthge orëëm.
english: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.

anywaa: Ni ö jiyi ni wøørge thwöl, kiper mana wëëk cuum mare Läänögø. Ni wøørge Läänögø, ni köge, na «?Aŋa ni caal Lääni? ?Na aŋa ni maar lønyø jïre ki man këëde ki gø?»
english: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?

anywaa: 'Ba Läänögø omooø ki dhøk mo cara luup atöör ki luup mo reyø døc mo janynya Jwøk. Ni eno wëëk man cääne ki cuum mare ki dwäde ma pïëraŋween kurriiø.
english: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.

anywaa: Ni jap dhee ni car luup mo reyø døc dëër Jwøk, ni jany nyeŋ gø ki kar bëëte, ki mo wø bëëdö maal.
english: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.

anywaa: Ni eno wiiø ki man këëde ki jø Jwøk thuwø nee jø Jwøk bööte. Ni eno mooø ki teek bäät wïth tuŋi bëët, ki wïth juurre bëët, ki bäät teeŋ dhøgi bëët, ki tiet mïëri bëët.
english: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.

anywaa: 'Ba eno wøør jø wø bëëdö bäät piny, ni beege jiy bëët moa näk nyeŋge kär göör yi wëël kwøw mar Nyidiel na bëëdö no onää ki kanya poot pinynyi ni kär caa.
english: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

anywaa: Ŋat mo jïre da ïth, beerra man cek ïthe.
english: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

anywaa: Ni näk da ŋat mo dëëre da weny peec ri leny, eni put ka peec. 'Ba ni näk da ŋat mo dëëre da weny thøw opëëllö, eni di nääö ko opëëllö. Man nø, manynya jïëny gïï mo leth ki ŋäädhe mar jø Jwøk.
english: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

anywaa: Kanyøgø Lääy mør aneena mo ö wøk ki yïth ŋøøm, mo wïïe da tuŋi ariiø keda nyidiel, ni cäänö keda thwöra caal nyaaŋ.
english: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.

anywaa: Eni tïïö ki køør cuum mar Lääna dïkwøŋ, ni eni wø cäänö buut gø, ni tïïc piny ki jøøa bëëdö yie ni wøøra Lääna dïkwøŋ, Lääna ŋwelle caŋŋø, na doo cööp ri thøø.
english: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.

anywaa: Ni eni wø tïïö ki ŋïïce mo døøŋŋø døc, mo këëlla maac wëëge ööny piny ki maal ni nëënö jï jiy.
english: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,

anywaa: Ni eni wø cøøga jø wø bëëdö bäät piny ki køør ŋïïce na näk owëëk eni nee tïïe buut Läänögø. Ni kööm geni ni cwääge ki kït Lääna näk dëëre da ŋwel opëëllö, na kwøw.
english: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.

anywaa: Ni eno wëëk man mooc kït Läänögø na näk ocwääö ki jwïëy, kiper nee kït Läänögø tïme ni cäänö, nee jø wø ba wøør kït Läänögø 'näk.
english: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.

anywaa: Ni wëëk ceŋ cwïc jiy bëët mooc ki ŋïï wala täärnyïmge, ni beege moa therø ki moa døøŋŋø, ki moa näk okwär ki moa can, ki moa bëëdö ki wïthge ki laaŋe,
english: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:

anywaa: kiper nee bäŋe ŋat mo maar lønyø jïre ki man dääbe wala ŋëëö ni näk dëëre bäŋ ŋïï, ni beeye nyeŋ Läänögø, wala göör man wø göör kwään nyeŋŋe ki gø.
english: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

anywaa: 'Ba gïn manynya acaara. Ŋato wïïe leer beerra man caar wïïe kiper tier kwäänö mar nyeŋ Läänögø, kiper beeye kwäänö ma mar dhaanhø. Ni kwäänö mar nyeŋŋe beeye dïpe abïciel ki pïërabïciel ka abïciel.
english: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana nëënnö, ni jooda Nyidiel ni cuŋŋö bäät Kïn Dhayan, ni buute da jiy ma kume ma dïpa ki pïëraŋween kurŋween, jøøa näk nyeŋŋe ki nyeŋ Wänni ogöör täärnyïmge.
english: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dwøl mør mo ööi ki maal mo caala lwöc pïï mo thööth, ni caala dwør køth mo määr døc. 'Ba dwønøgø na wïnynya gø atïmö ni keda dööt thøme mo pwöta jiyi.
english: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

anywaa: Ni ge wär ki duut mo nyään nyïm wälu, ki nyïm gïïa näk aŋween na kwøw, ki nyïm jaae. 'Ba bäŋ dhaanhø mo maar duudace kwany, 'ba beege jøøa wïïl wøk piny na näk kume ma dïpa ki pïëraŋween kurŋween, na kwany gø.
english: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

anywaa: Beege jøøa näk dëëtge kärge raanynyø ki mään. Kiper dëët mään kucge. Ni beege geni wø caath køør Nyidiel kany wø ci yie jaak. Geni, ge wïïl wøk ka røk teeŋ jiy bëët, na këël wï Jwøk jï Jwøk ki Nyidiel.
english: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.

anywaa: Ni bäŋ tööt mo ojoodø dhøkge, kiper bäŋ gïn mo jøøŋŋi dëëtge.
english: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mør mo määdö maal ajooda, ni käära luumma nyään na met na näk bäŋ cuŋŋe mo købe købø jï jø wø bëëdö bäät piny, ni beege mïëri bëët, ki wïth tuŋi bëët, ki teeŋ dhøgi bëët, ki wïth juurre bëët.
english: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,

anywaa: Ni cäänne ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Lwäärru Jwøk ni jiemmu gø, kiper kany ŋøl luup yie apïï. Wøørru eni, eni na cwääc maal ki piny ki näpa døøŋŋø, ki kwöra tuul pïïyi ki yïthge.»
english: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

anywaa: Ni ö riet nyïïatwiet maalli mør ni läw cäännö, ni «Babiløn na dwøŋ apädhö ki pädhö mo ba thiinh, nyaana wëëk mïëri bëët mäthö ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mar käp mare.»
english: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.

anywaa: Ni ö dää nyïïatwiet maalli mør ni läw cäännö ki dwøl mo päl, ni «Ni näk da ŋat mo wøøra Läänögø ki gïna näk ocwääö na kïte, ni jït täärnyïme ki ŋïï, wala cere,
english: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

anywaa: ŋatøgø thuwø, omäthi ki køøŋ nyïïomøki mar wëëc Jwøk, mo okøny yaa athöönh wëër mare, ni bäŋ gïn mo ojääbö ki gø. 'Ba eno caari ki maac, ki maac mør mo jïye keec ni lïëth døc nyïm nyïïatwiet maal na en kur keerge, ki nyïm Nyidiel.
english: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:

anywaa: Ni ö jïc maac mano caar geni ki gø ni duuŋe këël na bäre bäre. Ni bäŋ jwömö jïge ki wärre ki cääŋŋe, ni beege jø wø wøør Läänögø ki gïna näk ocwääö na kïte, ki jø wø dëëtge jïti ki ŋïï mar nyeŋŋe.»
english: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

anywaa: Manøgø nø, manynya jïëny gïï mo leth mar jø Jwøk, jø wø gwøk gïïa cem Jwøki, ni ŋäädhe marge na en ri Jecu ege maa ni teek.
english: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

anywaa: Ni wïnynya dwøl mør mo ööi ki maal, ni kööe, ni «Göör gïn, ‹Køør man ennø gwïëth en jï jø wø thøw ni ge ena ri Wuuö.› » Ni kö Jwïëc Jwøki, ni «Gena gwïëth møn, kiper nee dëëtge jwömge ki öölö marge, kiper tïïe moge cäädhi ka geni na aciel.»
english: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

anywaa: Kanyøgø aana nëënnö ni jooda pöölö mo tar, ni ŋat mo keda Wär Dhaanhø opï bääte, ni wïïe da adun warkey, ni cere da manyjil mo beth.
english: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mør wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni cwøl ŋata bëëdö bäät pöölö manøgø ki dwøl mo päl, ni kööe, ni «Lwør manyjil marï ni kääï, kiper kar kac apïï. Kiper gïïo kac piny atal døc.»
english: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nø, ŋata bëëdö bäät pöölö manøgø manyjil mare awïre bäät piny, ni ö gïïa en bäät pinynyi ni kaay.
english: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mør wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ mana en maalø. Ni cere da manyjil mo beth thuwø.
english: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiel maalli mør wøk ki yi gïn wø waaŋ gïï wø jïcge ŋwääi ni met bääte, ni beeye nyïïatwiella en luum maaci cere. Ni cwøl nyïïatwiella näk cere da manyjil mo beth ki dwøl mo päl, ni kööe, ni «Lwør manyjil marï, ni kayï nyïïomøki mo piny. Kiper nyïïomøki moe ociek.»
english: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal manøgø manyjil mare awïre bäät piny ni kac nyïïomøki mo piny, ni leeŋ ge yi buur wø biic nyïïomøki yie, ni beeye buur mana dwøŋ døc mar wëëc Jwøk.
english: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

anywaa: Ni ö buur wø biic nyïïomøki yie ni nyøri ki tiel ŋää paac wøk. Ni ö remø ni kwön wøk ki yi buur wø biic nyïïomøki yie, ni päŋ mare ena dho okweeny ni møle ni cööp kany mo jïtö ki kiïlömethërri ma dïpe adäk.
english: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.

anywaa: Kanyøgø ŋïï mør mo dwøŋ døc na gïn mo rëëma ec aneena maal, ni beege nyïïatwiet maal abïriiø mo käära teeŋ jap räny piny abïriiø moo näk aŋuudi. Kiper gïïögø beeye geni noo ŋuut wëëc Jwøki ki ge.
english: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

anywaa: Ni neena gïn mør mo nëëni keda naam mo dwøŋ mar wïlli mo orwöbö ki maac. 'Ba jøøa näk Lääy ege böötö, ki gïna näk ocwääö na caal kïte, ki kwäänö mar nyeŋŋe, ge cuŋŋa bäät naamøgø na mar wïlli enø, ni ceŋge da thøme moa wëëk Jwøki geni.
english: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.

anywaa: Ni ge wära duut Modhe, na näk laŋ Jwøk, ki duut Nyidiel, ni ge köö, ni «Ï na Kwäärö Wuuö Jwøk na en teeki jïrï, Nyeny piny bäre, tïïe moï døøŋŋø, ni beege gïï mo rëëma ec. Ni luup moï beyø ni näkge adïëri.
english: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.

anywaa: ?Aŋa noo ba lwäyi ni ba jiem nyeŋŋï, ï na Wuuö? Kiper bee ï keerï niï ena kur keerï. Mïëri bëët öö ni wøørge ïïni, kiper ŋøl marï anyooth.»
english: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.

anywaa: 'Ba køør gïïögø, aana nëënnö, ni jooda kanya en kur keere na pere leth na en yo oduŋkaany wø køp gïr Jwøk no ojabø maalø.
english: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:

anywaa: Ni ö nyïïatwiet maal moøgø na abïriiø yøø ni öge wøk ki yi Øt Jwøk manøgø ni ge käära jap räny piny karge bïriet. Ni dëëtge da abïïe mo tøŋ ni ŋwaŋŋi, ni kööthge da kaae ma warkey.
english: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.

anywaa: Ni ö acielli dëët gïïa näk aŋween na kwøw ni mooc nyïïatwiet maal moøgø na abïriiø yøø ki kuure abïriiø ma warkey mo päŋ ki wëëc Jwøk, eni ni wø bëëdö ni kwøw këël na bäre bäre.
english: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.

anywaa: Ni ö Øt Jwøki manøgø ni pääŋe ki jïrö mo käla ra ajiem Jwøk ki teege. Ni bäŋ dhaanhø mo løny jïre ki man døny øtø, këël mano ö gïï räny piny karge bïriedi mo nyïïatwiet maal karge bïriet no lønyge.
english: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.

anywaa: Kanyøgø dwøl mør mo päl awïnynya Øt Jwøk Mana Dwøŋ, ni dwøl manøgø köömma nyïïatwiet maal karge bïriet, ni kööe, ni «Cou ni kønynyu kuure karge bïriedi mo wëëc Jwøk bäät piny.»
english: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.

anywaa: Kanyøgø nyïïatwiel maal mana dïkwøŋ acøø ni køny kuura mare bäät piny, ni ö atwøti mo odheeth mo ŋwääö ni reyø ni öge bäät jøøa näk dëëtge da ŋïï mar Lääy, na wøør gïna näk ocwääö na caal kïte.
